verses.text: Alif-Laam-Meem
verses.translation: Alif-Laam-Meem

verses.text: yeh kitab aesi hai kay iss mein koi shak nahi ,   yeh hidayat hai unn darr rakhney walon kay liye
verses.translation: yeh kitab aesi hai kay iss mein koi shak nahi ,   yeh hidayat hai unn darr rakhney walon kay liye

verses.text: jo bey dekhi cheezon per emaan latay hain ,   aur namaz qaeem kertay hain , aur jo kuch hum ney unhen diya hai uss mein say ( Allah ki khushnoodi kay kamon mein ) kharch kertay hain
verses.translation: jo bey dekhi cheezon per emaan latay hain ,   aur namaz qaeem kertay hain , aur jo kuch hum ney unhen diya hai uss mein say ( Allah ki khushnoodi kay kamon mein ) kharch kertay hain

verses.text: aur jo uss ( wahi ) per bhi emaan latay hain jo aap per utaari gaee aur uss per bhi jo aap say pehlay utaari gaee ,   aur aakhirat per woh mukammal yaqeen rakhtay hain
verses.translation: aur jo uss ( wahi ) per bhi emaan latay hain jo aap per utaari gaee aur uss per bhi jo aap say pehlay utaari gaee ,   aur aakhirat per woh mukammal yaqeen rakhtay hain

verses.text: yeh hain woh log jo apney perwerdigar ki taraf say sahih raastay per hain , aur yehi woh log hain jo falah paaney walay hain
verses.translation: yeh hain woh log jo apney perwerdigar ki taraf say sahih raastay per hain , aur yehi woh log hain jo falah paaney walay hain

verses.text: beyshak woh log jinhon ney kufr apna liya hai ,   unn kay haq mein dono baaten barabar hain , chahye aap unn ko darayen , ya naa darayen ,   woh emaan nahi layen gay
verses.translation: beyshak woh log jinhon ney kufr apna liya hai ,   unn kay haq mein dono baaten barabar hain , chahye aap unn ko darayen , ya naa darayen ,   woh emaan nahi layen gay

verses.text: Allah ney unn kay dilon per aur unn kay kanon per mohar lagadi hai ,   aur unn ki aankhon per perda parra huwa hai , aur unn kay liye zabardast azab hai
verses.translation: Allah ney unn kay dilon per aur unn kay kanon per mohar lagadi hai ,   aur unn ki aankhon per perda parra huwa hai , aur unn kay liye zabardast azab hai

verses.text: kuch log woh hain jo kehtay hain kay hum Allah per aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan ley aaye , halankay woh ( haqeeqat mein ) momin nahi hain
verses.translation: kuch log woh hain jo kehtay hain kay hum Allah per aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan ley aaye , halankay woh ( haqeeqat mein ) momin nahi hain

verses.text: woh Allah ko aur unn logon  ko jo ( waqaee ) emaan laa-chukay hain dhoka detay hain . aur ( haqeeqat to yeh hai kay ) woh apney siwa kissi aur ko dhoka nahi dey rahey , lekin unhen iss baat ka ehsas nahi hai
verses.translation: woh Allah ko aur unn logon  ko jo ( waqaee ) emaan laa-chukay hain dhoka detay hain . aur ( haqeeqat to yeh hai kay ) woh apney siwa kissi aur ko dhoka nahi dey rahey , lekin unhen iss baat ka ehsas nahi hai

verses.text: inn kay dilon mein rog hai , chunacheh Allah ney inn kay rog mein aur izafa kerdiya hai ,   aur inn kay liye dardnak saza tayyar hai , kiyonkay woh jhoot bola kertay thay
verses.translation: inn kay dilon mein rog hai , chunacheh Allah ney inn kay rog mein aur izafa kerdiya hai ,   aur inn kay liye dardnak saza tayyar hai , kiyonkay woh jhoot bola kertay thay

verses.text: aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay tum zameen mein fasad naa machao to woh kehtay hain kay hum to islaah kernay walay hain
verses.translation: aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay tum zameen mein fasad naa machao to woh kehtay hain kay hum to islaah kernay walay hain

verses.text: yaad rakho ! yehi log fasad phelaney walay hain , lekin enhen iss baat ka ehsas nahi hai
verses.translation: yaad rakho ! yehi log fasad phelaney walay hain , lekin enhen iss baat ka ehsas nahi hai

verses.text: aur jab inn say kaha jata hai kay tum bhi ussi tarah emaan ley aao jaisay doosray log emaan laye hain to woh kehtay hain kay kiya hum bhi ussi tarah emaan layen jaisay beywaqoof log emaan laye hain-? khoob achi tarah sunn lo kay yehi log bey waqoof hain , lekin woh yeh baat nahi jantay
verses.translation: aur jab inn say kaha jata hai kay tum bhi ussi tarah emaan ley aao jaisay doosray log emaan laye hain to woh kehtay hain kay kiya hum bhi ussi tarah emaan layen jaisay beywaqoof log emaan laye hain-? khoob achi tarah sunn lo kay yehi log bey waqoof hain , lekin woh yeh baat nahi jantay

verses.text: aur jab yeh unn logon  say miltay hain jo emaan laa-chukay hain to kehtay hain kay hum emaan ley aaye , aur jab yeh apney shetanon   kay paas tanhai mein jatay hain to kehtay hain kay hum tumharay sath hain , hum to mazaq ker-rahey thay
verses.translation: aur jab yeh unn logon  say miltay hain jo emaan laa-chukay hain to kehtay hain kay hum emaan ley aaye , aur jab yeh apney shetanon   kay paas tanhai mein jatay hain to kehtay hain kay hum tumharay sath hain , hum to mazaq ker-rahey thay

verses.text: Allah unn say mazaq ( ka moamla ) kerta hai aur unhen aesi dheel deta hai kay woh apni sarkashi mein bhataktay rahen
verses.translation: Allah unn say mazaq ( ka moamla ) kerta hai aur unhen aesi dheel deta hai kay woh apni sarkashi mein bhataktay rahen

verses.text: yeh woh log hain jinhon ney hidayat kay badlay gumrahi khareed li hai , lehaza naa unn ki tijarat mein nafaa huwa , aur naa unhen sahih raasta naseeb huwa
verses.translation: yeh woh log hain jinhon ney hidayat kay badlay gumrahi khareed li hai , lehaza naa unn ki tijarat mein nafaa huwa , aur naa unhen sahih raasta naseeb huwa

verses.text: unn ki misal uss shaks ki si hai jiss ney aik aag roshan ki ,   phir jab uss ( aag ney ) uss kay mahol ko roshan kerdiya to Allah ney unn ka noor salb kerliya aur unhen andheriyon mein chorr diya kay unhen kuch sujhai nahi deta
verses.translation: unn ki misal uss shaks ki si hai jiss ney aik aag roshan ki ,   phir jab uss ( aag ney ) uss kay mahol ko roshan kerdiya to Allah ney unn ka noor salb kerliya aur unhen andheriyon mein chorr diya kay unhen kuch sujhai nahi deta

verses.text: woh behray hain , goongay hain , andhay hain , chunacheh abb woh wapis nahi ayen gay
verses.translation: woh behray hain , goongay hain , andhay hain , chunacheh abb woh wapis nahi ayen gay

verses.text: ya phir ( inn munafiqon ki misal aesi hai )   jaisay aasman say barasti aik barish ho , jiss mein andheriyan bhi hon , aur garaj bhi aur chamak bhi . woh karrkon ki aawaz per moat kay khof say apni ungliyan apney kanon mein dey letay hain . aur Allah ney kafiron ko gheray mein   ley rakha hai
verses.translation: ya phir ( inn munafiqon ki misal aesi hai )   jaisay aasman say barasti aik barish ho , jiss mein andheriyan bhi hon , aur garaj bhi aur chamak bhi . woh karrkon ki aawaz per moat kay khof say apni ungliyan apney kanon mein dey letay hain . aur Allah ney kafiron ko gheray mein   ley rakha hai

verses.text: aisa lagta hai kay bijli unn ki aankhon ko uchak ley jaye gi . jab bhi bijli unn kay liye roshni ker-deti hai , woh uss ( roshni ) mein chal parrtay hain , aur jab woh unn per andhera ker-deti hai to kharray reh jatay hain , aur agar Allah chahta to unn kay sunney aur dekhney ki taqaten cheen leta , beyshak Allah her cheez per qudrat rakhta hai
verses.translation: aisa lagta hai kay bijli unn ki aankhon ko uchak ley jaye gi . jab bhi bijli unn kay liye roshni ker-deti hai , woh uss ( roshni ) mein chal parrtay hain , aur jab woh unn per andhera ker-deti hai to kharray reh jatay hain , aur agar Allah chahta to unn kay sunney aur dekhney ki taqaten cheen leta , beyshak Allah her cheez per qudrat rakhta hai

verses.text: aey logo ! apney uss perwerdigar ki ibadat kero jiss ney tumhen aur unn logon  ko peda kiya jo tum say pehlay guzray hain , takay tum muttaqi ban jao
verses.translation: aey logo ! apney uss perwerdigar ki ibadat kero jiss ney tumhen aur unn logon  ko peda kiya jo tum say pehlay guzray hain , takay tum muttaqi ban jao

verses.text: . ( woh perwerdigar ) jiss ney tumharay liye zameen ko bichona banaya , aur aasman ko chhat aur aasman say paani barsaya , phir iss kay zariye tumharay rizq kay tor per phal nikalay , lehaza Allah kay sath shareek naa thehrao , jabkay tum ( yeh sabb baaten ) jantay ho
verses.translation: . ( woh perwerdigar ) jiss ney tumharay liye zameen ko bichona banaya , aur aasman ko chhat aur aasman say paani barsaya , phir iss kay zariye tumharay rizq kay tor per phal nikalay , lehaza Allah kay sath shareek naa thehrao , jabkay tum ( yeh sabb baaten ) jantay ho

verses.text: aur agar tum iss( Quran ) kay baaray mein zara bhi shak mein ho jo hum ney apney banday Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) per utaara hai , to iss jaisi koi aik surat hi bana lao , aur agar sachay ho to Allah kay siwa apney tamam madad gaaron ko bulalo
verses.translation: aur agar tum iss( Quran ) kay baaray mein zara bhi shak mein ho jo hum ney apney banday Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) per utaara hai , to iss jaisi koi aik surat hi bana lao , aur agar sachay ho to Allah kay siwa apney tamam madad gaaron ko bulalo

verses.text: phir bhi agar tum yeh kaam naa ker-sako , aur yaqeenan kabhi nahi ker-sako gay , to daro uss aag say jiss ka endhan insan aur pathar hon gay , woh kafiron kay liye tayyar ki gaee hai .
verses.translation: phir bhi agar tum yeh kaam naa ker-sako , aur yaqeenan kabhi nahi ker-sako gay , to daro uss aag say jiss ka endhan insan aur pathar hon gay , woh kafiron kay liye tayyar ki gaee hai .

verses.text: aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ko khushkhabri dey do kay unn kay liye aesay baaghaat ( tayyar ) hain jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi ,   jab kabhi unn ko unn ( baaghaat ) mein say koi phal rizq kay tor per diya jaye ga , to woh kahen gay " yeh to wohi hai jo hamen pehlay bhi diya gaya tha   aur unhen woh rizq aisa hi diya jaye ga jo dekhney mein milta julta hoga ,   aur unn kay liye wahan pakeezah biwiyan hon gi , aur woh unn ( baaghaat ) mein hamesha hamesha rahen gay
verses.translation: aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ko khushkhabri dey do kay unn kay liye aesay baaghaat ( tayyar ) hain jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi ,   jab kabhi unn ko unn ( baaghaat ) mein say koi phal rizq kay tor per diya jaye ga , to woh kahen gay " yeh to wohi hai jo hamen pehlay bhi diya gaya tha   aur unhen woh rizq aisa hi diya jaye ga jo dekhney mein milta julta hoga ,   aur unn kay liye wahan pakeezah biwiyan hon gi , aur woh unn ( baaghaat ) mein hamesha hamesha rahen gay

verses.text: beyshak Allah iss baat say nahi sharmata kay woh ( kissi baat ko wazeh kernay kay liye ) koi bhi misal dey , chahye woh machar ( jaisi mamooli cheez ) ki ho , ya kissi aesi cheez ki jo machar say bhi ziyada ( mamooli ) ho ,   abb jo log momin hain woh khoob jantay hain kay yeh misal aik haq baat hai jo unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say aai hai . albatta jo log kafir hain woh yehi kehtay hain kay bhala iss ( haqeer ) misal say Allah ka kiya matlab hai-? ( iss tarah ) Allah iss misal say boht say logon  ko gumrahi mein mubtala kerta hai , aur boht so ko hidayat deta hai . ( magar ) woh gumrah unhi ko kerta hai jo nafarman hain
verses.translation: beyshak Allah iss baat say nahi sharmata kay woh ( kissi baat ko wazeh kernay kay liye ) koi bhi misal dey , chahye woh machar ( jaisi mamooli cheez ) ki ho , ya kissi aesi cheez ki jo machar say bhi ziyada ( mamooli ) ho ,   abb jo log momin hain woh khoob jantay hain kay yeh misal aik haq baat hai jo unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say aai hai . albatta jo log kafir hain woh yehi kehtay hain kay bhala iss ( haqeer ) misal say Allah ka kiya matlab hai-? ( iss tarah ) Allah iss misal say boht say logon  ko gumrahi mein mubtala kerta hai , aur boht so ko hidayat deta hai . ( magar ) woh gumrah unhi ko kerta hai jo nafarman hain

verses.text: woh jo Allah say kiye huye ehad ko pukhta kernay kay baad bhi torr detay hain ,   aur jinn rishton ko Allah ney jorrney ka hukum diya hai , unhen kaat daaltay hain aur zameen mein fasad machatay hain ,   aesay hi log bara nuqsan uthaney walay hain
verses.translation: woh jo Allah say kiye huye ehad ko pukhta kernay kay baad bhi torr detay hain ,   aur jinn rishton ko Allah ney jorrney ka hukum diya hai , unhen kaat daaltay hain aur zameen mein fasad machatay hain ,   aesay hi log bara nuqsan uthaney walay hain

verses.text: tum Allah kay sath kufr ka tarz-e-amal aakhir kaisay ikhtiyar kerletay ho , halankay tum bey jaan thay , ussi ney tumhen zindagi bakhshi , phir wohi tumhen moat dey ga , phir wohi tum ko ( dobara ) zinda keray ga , aur phir tum ussi kay paas lot ker jao gay
verses.translation: tum Allah kay sath kufr ka tarz-e-amal aakhir kaisay ikhtiyar kerletay ho , halankay tum bey jaan thay , ussi ney tumhen zindagi bakhshi , phir wohi tumhen moat dey ga , phir wohi tum ko ( dobara ) zinda keray ga , aur phir tum ussi kay paas lot ker jao gay

verses.text: wohi hai jiss ney zameen mein jo kuch hai tumharay liye peda kiya ,   phir woh aasman ki taraf mutawajjah huwa , chunacheh unn ko saat aasmano ki shakal mein theek theek banadiya , aur woh her cheez ka poora ilm rakhney wala hai
verses.translation: wohi hai jiss ney zameen mein jo kuch hai tumharay liye peda kiya ,   phir woh aasman ki taraf mutawajjah huwa , chunacheh unn ko saat aasmano ki shakal mein theek theek banadiya , aur woh her cheez ka poora ilm rakhney wala hai

verses.text: aur ( uss waqt ka tazkarah suno ) jab tumharay perwerdigar ney farishton say kaha kay mein zameen mein aik khalifa bananey wala hun ,   woh kehney lagay :  kiya aap zameen mein aesi makhlooq peda keren gay jo uss mein fasad machaye , aur khoon kharaba keray , halankay hum aap ki tasbeeh aur hamd o taqdees mein lagay huye hain ?    Allah ney kaha :  mein woh baaten janta hun jo tum nahi jantay
verses.translation: aur ( uss waqt ka tazkarah suno ) jab tumharay perwerdigar ney farishton say kaha kay mein zameen mein aik khalifa bananey wala hun ,   woh kehney lagay :  kiya aap zameen mein aesi makhlooq peda keren gay jo uss mein fasad machaye , aur khoon kharaba keray , halankay hum aap ki tasbeeh aur hamd o taqdees mein lagay huye hain ?    Allah ney kaha :  mein woh baaten janta hun jo tum nahi jantay

verses.text: aur Adam ko ( Allah ney ) saray kay saray naam sikha-diye ,   phir unn ko farishton kay samney paish kiya aur ( unn say ) kaha :  agar tum sachay ho to mujhay inn cheezon kay naam to batlao
verses.translation: aur Adam ko ( Allah ney ) saray kay saray naam sikha-diye ,   phir unn ko farishton kay samney paish kiya aur ( unn say ) kaha :  agar tum sachay ho to mujhay inn cheezon kay naam to batlao

verses.text: woh bol uthay : aap hi ki zaat pak hai , jo kuch ilm aap ney hamen diya hai uss kay siwa hum kuch nahi jantay .   haqeeqat mein ilm o hikmat kay malik to sirf aap hain
verses.translation: woh bol uthay : aap hi ki zaat pak hai , jo kuch ilm aap ney hamen diya hai uss kay siwa hum kuch nahi jantay .   haqeeqat mein ilm o hikmat kay malik to sirf aap hain

verses.text: Allah ney kaha :  Adam ! tum inn ko inn cheezon kay naam batado  chunacheh jab uss ney unn kay naam unn ko batadiye to Allah ney ( farishton say ) kaha :  kiya mein ney tum say nahi kaha tha kay mein aasmano aur zameen kay bhed janta hun-? aur jo kuch tum zahir kertay ho aur jo kuch tum chupatay ho mujhay uss sabb ka ilm hai
verses.translation: Allah ney kaha :  Adam ! tum inn ko inn cheezon kay naam batado  chunacheh jab uss ney unn kay naam unn ko batadiye to Allah ney ( farishton say ) kaha :  kiya mein ney tum say nahi kaha tha kay mein aasmano aur zameen kay bhed janta hun-? aur jo kuch tum zahir kertay ho aur jo kuch tum chupatay ho mujhay uss sabb ka ilm hai

verses.text: aur ( uss waqt ka tazkarah suno ) jab hum ney farishton say kaha kay :  Adam ko sajda kero ,   chunacheh sabb ney sajda kiya , siwaye iblees kay kay uss ney inkar kiya ,   aur mutakabbirana ravaiyya ikhtiyar kiya aur kafiron mein shamil hogaya
verses.translation: aur ( uss waqt ka tazkarah suno ) jab hum ney farishton say kaha kay :  Adam ko sajda kero ,   chunacheh sabb ney sajda kiya , siwaye iblees kay kay uss ney inkar kiya ,   aur mutakabbirana ravaiyya ikhtiyar kiya aur kafiron mein shamil hogaya

verses.text: aur hum ney kaha :  Adam ! tum aur tumhari biwi jannat mein raho , aur uss mein say jahan say chahao ji bhar kay khao , magar iss darkht kay paas bhi matt jana ,   werna tum zalimon mein shumar hogay .
verses.translation: aur hum ney kaha :  Adam ! tum aur tumhari biwi jannat mein raho , aur uss mein say jahan say chahao ji bhar kay khao , magar iss darkht kay paas bhi matt jana ,   werna tum zalimon mein shumar hogay .

verses.text: phir huwa yeh kay shetan ney unn dono ko wahan say dagmaga diya , aur jiss ( aesh ) mein woh thay uss say unhen nikal ker raha   aur hum ney ( Adam , unn ki biwi aur iblees say ) kaha :  abb tum sabb yahan say utar jao , tum aik doosray kay dushman hogay , aur tumharay liye aik mauddat tak zameen mein thehrna aur kissi qadar faeeda uthana ( tey kerdiya gaya ) hai
verses.translation: phir huwa yeh kay shetan ney unn dono ko wahan say dagmaga diya , aur jiss ( aesh ) mein woh thay uss say unhen nikal ker raha   aur hum ney ( Adam , unn ki biwi aur iblees say ) kaha :  abb tum sabb yahan say utar jao , tum aik doosray kay dushman hogay , aur tumharay liye aik mauddat tak zameen mein thehrna aur kissi qadar faeeda uthana ( tey kerdiya gaya ) hai

verses.text: phir Adam ney apney perwerdigar say ( tauba kay ) kuch alfaz seekh liye ( jinn kay zariye unhon ney tauba maangi ) chunacheh Allah ney unn ki tauba qubool kerli .   beyshak woh boht moaaf kernay wala , bara meharban hai
verses.translation: phir Adam ney apney perwerdigar say ( tauba kay ) kuch alfaz seekh liye ( jinn kay zariye unhon ney tauba maangi ) chunacheh Allah ney unn ki tauba qubool kerli .   beyshak woh boht moaaf kernay wala , bara meharban hai

verses.text: hum ney :  kaha abb tum sabb yahan say utar jao . phir agar meri taraf say koi hidayat tumhen phonchay , to jo log meri hidayat ki perwi keren gay , unn ko naa koi khof hoga , aur naa woh kissi ghum mein mubtala hon gay .
verses.translation: hum ney :  kaha abb tum sabb yahan say utar jao . phir agar meri taraf say koi hidayat tumhen phonchay , to jo log meri hidayat ki perwi keren gay , unn ko naa koi khof hoga , aur naa woh kissi ghum mein mubtala hon gay .

verses.text: aur jo log kufr ka irtikab keren gay aur humari aayaton ko jhutlayen gay woh dozakh walay log hain jahan woh hamesha rahen gay .
verses.translation: aur jo log kufr ka irtikab keren gay aur humari aayaton ko jhutlayen gay woh dozakh walay log hain jahan woh hamesha rahen gay .

verses.text: aey bani Israel ! meri woh naimat yaad karo jo mein ney tum ko ata ki thi , aur tum mujh say kiya huwa ehad poora karo , takay mein bhi tum say kiya huwa ehad poora karun , aur tum ( kissi aur say nahi , balkay ) sirf mujhi say daro
verses.translation: aey bani Israel ! meri woh naimat yaad karo jo mein ney tum ko ata ki thi , aur tum mujh say kiya huwa ehad poora karo , takay mein bhi tum say kiya huwa ehad poora karun , aur tum ( kissi aur say nahi , balkay ) sirf mujhi say daro

verses.text: aur jo kalam mein ney nazil kiya hai uss per emaan lao , jabkay woh uss kitab ( yani toraat ) ki tasdeeq bhi ker-raha hai jo tumharay paas hai , aur tum hi sabb say pehlay iss kay munkir naa ban jao . aur meri aayaton ko mamooli si qeemat ley ker naa becho , aur ( kissi aur kay bajaye ) sirf mera khof dil mein rakho
verses.translation: aur jo kalam mein ney nazil kiya hai uss per emaan lao , jabkay woh uss kitab ( yani toraat ) ki tasdeeq bhi ker-raha hai jo tumharay paas hai , aur tum hi sabb say pehlay iss kay munkir naa ban jao . aur meri aayaton ko mamooli si qeemat ley ker naa becho , aur ( kissi aur kay bajaye ) sirf mera khof dil mein rakho

verses.text: aur haq ko batil kay sath gaddmadd naa kero , aur naa haq baat ko chupao jabkay ( asal haqeeqat ) tum achi tarah jantay ho
verses.translation: aur haq ko batil kay sath gaddmadd naa kero , aur naa haq baat ko chupao jabkay ( asal haqeeqat ) tum achi tarah jantay ho

verses.text: aur namaz qaeem karo , aur zakat ada karo , aur rukoo kernay walon kay sath rukoo karo
verses.translation: aur namaz qaeem karo , aur zakat ada karo , aur rukoo kernay walon kay sath rukoo karo

verses.text: kiya tum ( doosray ) logon  ko to naiki ka hukum detay ho , aur khud apney aap ko bhool jatay ho-? halankay tum kitab ki tilawat bhi kertay ho ! kiya tumhen itni bhi samajh nahi-?
verses.translation: kiya tum ( doosray ) logon  ko to naiki ka hukum detay ho , aur khud apney aap ko bhool jatay ho-? halankay tum kitab ki tilawat bhi kertay ho ! kiya tumhen itni bhi samajh nahi-?

verses.text: aur sabar aur namaz say madad hasil kero . namaz bhari zaroor maloom hoti hai , magar unn logon  ko nahi jo khushoo ( yani dhiyan aur aajzi ) say parhtay hain
verses.translation: aur sabar aur namaz say madad hasil kero . namaz bhari zaroor maloom hoti hai , magar unn logon  ko nahi jo khushoo ( yani dhiyan aur aajzi ) say parhtay hain

verses.text: jo iss baat ka khayal rakhtay hain kay woh apney perwerdigar say milney walay hain , aur unn ko ussi ki taraf lot ker jana hai
verses.translation: jo iss baat ka khayal rakhtay hain kay woh apney perwerdigar say milney walay hain , aur unn ko ussi ki taraf lot ker jana hai

verses.text: aey bani Israel ! meri woh naimat yaad karo jo mein ney tum ko ata ki thi , aur yeh baat ( yaad kero ) kay mein ney tum ko saray jahano per fazilat di thi
verses.translation: aey bani Israel ! meri woh naimat yaad karo jo mein ney tum ko ata ki thi , aur yeh baat ( yaad kero ) kay mein ney tum ko saray jahano per fazilat di thi

verses.text: aur uss din say daro , jiss din koi shaks bhi kissi kay kuch kaam nahi aaye ga , naa kissi say koi sifarish qubool ki jaye gi , naa kissi say kissi qisam ka fidya liya jaye ga , aur naa unn ko koi madad phonchay gi
verses.translation: aur uss din say daro , jiss din koi shaks bhi kissi kay kuch kaam nahi aaye ga , naa kissi say koi sifarish qubool ki jaye gi , naa kissi say kissi qisam ka fidya liya jaye ga , aur naa unn ko koi madad phonchay gi

verses.text: aur woh ( waqt yaad kero ) jab hum ney tum ko firon kay logon  say najat di jo tumhen bara azab detay thay , tumharay beton ko zabah ker daaltay aur tumhari aurton ko zinda rakhtay thay .   aur iss sari soorat-e-haal mein tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say tumhara bara imtihan tha .
verses.translation: aur woh ( waqt yaad kero ) jab hum ney tum ko firon kay logon  say najat di jo tumhen bara azab detay thay , tumharay beton ko zabah ker daaltay aur tumhari aurton ko zinda rakhtay thay .   aur iss sari soorat-e-haal mein tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say tumhara bara imtihan tha .

verses.text: aur ( yaad karo ) jab hum ney tumhari khatir samandar ko phaarr daala tha , chunacheh tum sabb ko bachaliya tha aur firon kay logon  ko ( samandar mein ) gharq ker daala tha   aur tum yeh sara nazara dekh rahey thay
verses.translation: aur ( yaad karo ) jab hum ney tumhari khatir samandar ko phaarr daala tha , chunacheh tum sabb ko bachaliya tha aur firon kay logon  ko ( samandar mein ) gharq ker daala tha   aur tum yeh sara nazara dekh rahey thay

verses.text: aur ( woh waqt yaad kero ) jab hum ney musa say chaalees raaton ka wada thehraya tha , phir tum ney unn kay peechay ( apni janon per ) zulm kerkay bachrray ko mabood bana-liya
verses.translation: aur ( woh waqt yaad kero ) jab hum ney musa say chaalees raaton ka wada thehraya tha , phir tum ney unn kay peechay ( apni janon per ) zulm kerkay bachrray ko mabood bana-liya

verses.text: phir iss sabb kay baad bhi hum ney tum ko moaaf kerdiya takay tum shukar ada karo
verses.translation: phir iss sabb kay baad bhi hum ney tum ko moaaf kerdiya takay tum shukar ada karo

verses.text: aur ( yaad kero ) jab hum ney musa ko kitab di , aur haq o batil mein tameez ka mayaar ( bakhsha ) takay tum raah-e-raast per aao
verses.translation: aur ( yaad kero ) jab hum ney musa ko kitab di , aur haq o batil mein tameez ka mayaar ( bakhsha ) takay tum raah-e-raast per aao

verses.text: aur jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay " aey meri qoam ! haqeeqat mein tum ney bachrray ko mabood bana ker khud apni janon per zulm kiya hai , lehaza abb apney khaliq say tauba karo aur apney aap ko qatal kero . tumharay khaliq kay nazdeek yehi tumharay haq mein behtar hai .  iss tarah Allah ney tumhari tauba qubool kerli . bey shak wohi hai jo itna moaaf kernay wala , itna reham kernay wala hai
verses.translation: aur jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay " aey meri qoam ! haqeeqat mein tum ney bachrray ko mabood bana ker khud apni janon per zulm kiya hai , lehaza abb apney khaliq say tauba karo aur apney aap ko qatal kero . tumharay khaliq kay nazdeek yehi tumharay haq mein behtar hai .  iss tarah Allah ney tumhari tauba qubool kerli . bey shak wohi hai jo itna moaaf kernay wala , itna reham kernay wala hai

verses.text: aur jab tum ney kaha tha ! aey musa hum uss waqt tak hergiz tumhara yaqeen nahi keren gay jab tak Allah ko hum khud khuli aankhon naa dekh len  nateeja yeh huwa kay karrkay ney tumhen iss tarah aa pakra kay tum dekhtay reh gaye
verses.translation: aur jab tum ney kaha tha ! aey musa hum uss waqt tak hergiz tumhara yaqeen nahi keren gay jab tak Allah ko hum khud khuli aankhon naa dekh len  nateeja yeh huwa kay karrkay ney tumhen iss tarah aa pakra kay tum dekhtay reh gaye

verses.text: phir hum ney tumhen tumharay marney kay baad doosri zindagi di takay tum shukar guzaar bano
verses.translation: phir hum ney tumhen tumharay marney kay baad doosri zindagi di takay tum shukar guzaar bano

verses.text: aur hum ney tum ko badal ka saya ata kiya , aur tum per mann-o-salwa nazil kiya ( aur kaha kay : ) jo pakeezah rizq hum ney tumhen bakhsha hai ( shoq say ) khao   aur yeh ( nafarmaniyan kerkay ) unhon ney humara kuch nahi bigaara , balkay woh khud apni janon per hi zulm kertay rahey
verses.translation: aur hum ney tum ko badal ka saya ata kiya , aur tum per mann-o-salwa nazil kiya ( aur kaha kay : ) jo pakeezah rizq hum ney tumhen bakhsha hai ( shoq say ) khao   aur yeh ( nafarmaniyan kerkay ) unhon ney humara kuch nahi bigaara , balkay woh khud apni janon per hi zulm kertay rahey

verses.text: aur ( woh waqt bhi yaad kero ) jab hum ney kaha tha kay : "" iss basti mein dakhil hojao aur iss mein jahan say chahao ji bhar ker khao , aur ( basti kay ) darwazay mein jhukay saron kay sath dakhil hona , aur yeh kehtay jana kay ( ya-Allah ! ) hum aap ki bakhshish kay talab gaar hain , ( iss tarah ) hum tumhari khatayen moaaf kerden gay , aur naiki kernay walon ko aur ziyada ( sawab ) bhi den gay .
verses.translation: aur ( woh waqt bhi yaad kero ) jab hum ney kaha tha kay : "" iss basti mein dakhil hojao aur iss mein jahan say chahao ji bhar ker khao , aur ( basti kay ) darwazay mein jhukay saron kay sath dakhil hona , aur yeh kehtay jana kay ( ya-Allah ! ) hum aap ki bakhshish kay talab gaar hain , ( iss tarah ) hum tumhari khatayen moaaf kerden gay , aur naiki kernay walon ko aur ziyada ( sawab ) bhi den gay .

verses.text: magar huwa yeh kay jo baat unn say kahi gaee thi , zalimon ney ussay badal ker aik aur baat banali .   nateeja yeh kay jo nafarmaniyan woh kertay aarahey thay hum ney unn ki saza mein unn zalimon per aasman say azab nazil kiya
verses.translation: magar huwa yeh kay jo baat unn say kahi gaee thi , zalimon ney ussay badal ker aik aur baat banali .   nateeja yeh kay jo nafarmaniyan woh kertay aarahey thay hum ney unn ki saza mein unn zalimon per aasman say azab nazil kiya

verses.text: aur ( woh waqt bhi yaad kero ) jab musa ney apni qoam kay liye paani maanga to hum ney kaha :  apni laathi pathar per maaro   chunacheh iss ( pathar ) say baara chashmay phoot niklay .   her aik qabeelay ney apney paani lenay ki jagah maloom kerli . ( hum ney kaha : ) Allah ka diya huwa rizq khao piyo , aur zameen mein fasad machatay matt phirna .
verses.translation: aur ( woh waqt bhi yaad kero ) jab musa ney apni qoam kay liye paani maanga to hum ney kaha :  apni laathi pathar per maaro   chunacheh iss ( pathar ) say baara chashmay phoot niklay .   her aik qabeelay ney apney paani lenay ki jagah maloom kerli . ( hum ney kaha : ) Allah ka diya huwa rizq khao piyo , aur zameen mein fasad machatay matt phirna .

verses.text: aur ( woh waqt bhi ) jab tum ney kaha tha kay aey musa ! hum aik hi khaney per sabar nahi ker-saktay , lehaza humari khatir apney perwerdigar say maangiye kay woh humaray liye kuch woh cheezen peda keray jo zameen ugaya kerti hai , yani zameen ki tarkariyan , uss ki kakriyan , uss ka gandum , uss ki daalen aur uss ki piyaz . musa ney kaha : " jo ( ghiza ) behtar thi kiya tum uss ko aesi cheezon say badalna chahtay ho jo ghatiya darjay ki hain-? ( khair ! ) aik shehar mein jaa utro , to wahan tumhen woh cheezen mil jayen gi jo tum ney maangi hain .    aur unn ( yahudiyon ) per zillat aur beykasi ka thappa lagadiya gaya , aur woh Allah ka ghazab ley ker lotay . yeh sabb iss liye huwa kay woh Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kertay thay aur payghumberon ko nahaq qatal ker-detay thay . yeh sabb iss liye huwa kay unhon ney nafarmani ki , aur woh beyhad ziyadtiyan kertay thay .
verses.translation: aur ( woh waqt bhi ) jab tum ney kaha tha kay aey musa ! hum aik hi khaney per sabar nahi ker-saktay , lehaza humari khatir apney perwerdigar say maangiye kay woh humaray liye kuch woh cheezen peda keray jo zameen ugaya kerti hai , yani zameen ki tarkariyan , uss ki kakriyan , uss ka gandum , uss ki daalen aur uss ki piyaz . musa ney kaha : " jo ( ghiza ) behtar thi kiya tum uss ko aesi cheezon say badalna chahtay ho jo ghatiya darjay ki hain-? ( khair ! ) aik shehar mein jaa utro , to wahan tumhen woh cheezen mil jayen gi jo tum ney maangi hain .    aur unn ( yahudiyon ) per zillat aur beykasi ka thappa lagadiya gaya , aur woh Allah ka ghazab ley ker lotay . yeh sabb iss liye huwa kay woh Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kertay thay aur payghumberon ko nahaq qatal ker-detay thay . yeh sabb iss liye huwa kay unhon ney nafarmani ki , aur woh beyhad ziyadtiyan kertay thay .

verses.text: haq to yeh hai kay jo log bhi , khuwa woh musalman hon ya yahudi ya nasrani ya saabi , Allah aur aakhirat kay din per emaan ley ayen gay aur naik amal keren gay , woh apney perwerdigar kay paas apney ajar kay mustahiq hon gay , aur unn ko naa koi khof hoga , naa woh kissi ghum mein mubtala hon gay .
verses.translation: haq to yeh hai kay jo log bhi , khuwa woh musalman hon ya yahudi ya nasrani ya saabi , Allah aur aakhirat kay din per emaan ley ayen gay aur naik amal keren gay , woh apney perwerdigar kay paas apney ajar kay mustahiq hon gay , aur unn ko naa koi khof hoga , naa woh kissi ghum mein mubtala hon gay .

verses.text: aur wo waqt yaad karo jab hum ney tum say ( toraat per amal kernay ka ) ehad liya tha , aur koh-e-toor ko tumharay oopper utha kharra kiya tha ( kay ) jo ( kitab ) hum ney tumhen di hai uss ko mazbooti say thaamo ,   aur uss mein jo kuch ( likha ) hai uss ko yaad rakho , takay tumhen taqwa hasil ho
verses.translation: aur wo waqt yaad karo jab hum ney tum say ( toraat per amal kernay ka ) ehad liya tha , aur koh-e-toor ko tumharay oopper utha kharra kiya tha ( kay ) jo ( kitab ) hum ney tumhen di hai uss ko mazbooti say thaamo ,   aur uss mein jo kuch ( likha ) hai uss ko yaad rakho , takay tumhen taqwa hasil ho

verses.text: iss sabb kay bawajood tum dobara ( raah-e-raast say ) phir gaye . chunacheh agar Allah ka fazal aur rehmat tum per naa hoti to tum zaroor sakht nuqsan uthaney walon mein shamil hojatay .
verses.translation: iss sabb kay bawajood tum dobara ( raah-e-raast say ) phir gaye . chunacheh agar Allah ka fazal aur rehmat tum per naa hoti to tum zaroor sakht nuqsan uthaney walon mein shamil hojatay .

verses.text: aur tum apney unn logon  ko achi tarah jantay ho jo saneechar ( sabt ) kay moamlay mein hadd say guzar gaye thay , chunacheh hum ney unn say kaha tha kay tum dhutkaray huye bandar ban jao
verses.translation: aur tum apney unn logon  ko achi tarah jantay ho jo saneechar ( sabt ) kay moamlay mein hadd say guzar gaye thay , chunacheh hum ney unn say kaha tha kay tum dhutkaray huye bandar ban jao

verses.text: phir hum ney iss waqaey ko uss zamaney kay aur uss kay baad kay logon  kay liye ibrat , aur darney walon kay liye naseehat ka saman banadiya
verses.translation: phir hum ney iss waqaey ko uss zamaney kay aur uss kay baad kay logon  kay liye ibrat , aur darney walon kay liye naseehat ka saman banadiya

verses.text: aur ( wo waqt yaad kero ) jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay Allah tumhen hukum deta hai kay tum aik gaye zibah kero . woh kehney lagay kay kiya aap humara mazaq banatay hain-?   musa ney kaha : mein iss baat say Allah ki panah maangta hun kay mein ( aesay ) nadanon mein shamil hun ( jo mazaq mein jhoot bolen )
verses.translation: aur ( wo waqt yaad kero ) jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay Allah tumhen hukum deta hai kay tum aik gaye zibah kero . woh kehney lagay kay kiya aap humara mazaq banatay hain-?   musa ney kaha : mein iss baat say Allah ki panah maangta hun kay mein ( aesay ) nadanon mein shamil hun ( jo mazaq mein jhoot bolen )

verses.text: unhon ney kaha kay aap humari khatir apney rab say darkhuwast kijiye kay hamen saaf saaf bataye kay woh gaye kaisi ho-? uss ney kaha :  Allah farmata hai kay woh aesi gaye ho kay naa boht boorhi ho naa bilkul bachi , ( balkay ) inn dono kay bech bech mein ho . bus abb jo hukum tumhen diya gaya hai uss per amal kerlo .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha kay aap humari khatir apney rab say darkhuwast kijiye kay hamen saaf saaf bataye kay woh gaye kaisi ho-? uss ney kaha :  Allah farmata hai kay woh aesi gaye ho kay naa boht boorhi ho naa bilkul bachi , ( balkay ) inn dono kay bech bech mein ho . bus abb jo hukum tumhen diya gaya hai uss per amal kerlo .

verses.text: kehney lagay : aap humari khatir apney rab say darkhuwast kijiye kay hamen saaf saaf bataye kay uss ka rang kaisa ho-? musa ney kaha : Allah farmata hai kay woh aesay tez zard rang ki gaye ho jo dekhney walon ka dil khush kerday .
verses.translation: kehney lagay : aap humari khatir apney rab say darkhuwast kijiye kay hamen saaf saaf bataye kay uss ka rang kaisa ho-? musa ney kaha : Allah farmata hai kay woh aesay tez zard rang ki gaye ho jo dekhney walon ka dil khush kerday .

verses.text: unhon ney ( phir ) kaha kay aap humari khatir apney rab say darkhuwast kijiye kay hamen saaf saaf bataye kay woh gaye kaisi ho-? iss gaye ney to hamen shubhay mein daal diya hai . aur Allah ney chaha to hum zaroor iss ka pata lagalen gay .
verses.translation: unhon ney ( phir ) kaha kay aap humari khatir apney rab say darkhuwast kijiye kay hamen saaf saaf bataye kay woh gaye kaisi ho-? iss gaye ney to hamen shubhay mein daal diya hai . aur Allah ney chaha to hum zaroor iss ka pata lagalen gay .

verses.text: musa ney kaha : Allah farmata hai kay woh aesi gaye ho jo kaam mein jutt ker zameen naa gahati ho , aur naa kheti ko paani deti ho , poori tarah sahih saalim ho jiss mein koi dagh naa ho . unhon ney kaha : haan ! abb aap theek theek pata ley ker aaye . iss kay baad unhon ney ussay zibah kiya , jabkay lagta nahi tha kay woh ker payen gay .
verses.translation: musa ney kaha : Allah farmata hai kay woh aesi gaye ho jo kaam mein jutt ker zameen naa gahati ho , aur naa kheti ko paani deti ho , poori tarah sahih saalim ho jiss mein koi dagh naa ho . unhon ney kaha : haan ! abb aap theek theek pata ley ker aaye . iss kay baad unhon ney ussay zibah kiya , jabkay lagta nahi tha kay woh ker payen gay .

verses.text: aur ( yaad karo ) jab tum ney aik shaks ko qatal kerdiya tha , aur uss kay baad uss ka ilzam aik doosray per daal rahey thay , aur Allah ko woh raaz nikal bahir kerna tha jo tum chupaye huye thay .
verses.translation: aur ( yaad karo ) jab tum ney aik shaks ko qatal kerdiya tha , aur uss kay baad uss ka ilzam aik doosray per daal rahey thay , aur Allah ko woh raaz nikal bahir kerna tha jo tum chupaye huye thay .

verses.text: chunacheh hum ney kaha kay uss ( maqtool ) ko uss ( gaye ) kay aik hissay say maaro .   issi tarah Allah murdon ko zinda kerta hai , aur tumhen ( apni qudrat ki ) nishaniyan dikhata hai takay tum samajh sako .
verses.translation: chunacheh hum ney kaha kay uss ( maqtool ) ko uss ( gaye ) kay aik hissay say maaro .   issi tarah Allah murdon ko zinda kerta hai , aur tumhen ( apni qudrat ki ) nishaniyan dikhata hai takay tum samajh sako .

verses.text: iss sabb kay baad tumharay dil phir sakht hogaye , yahan tak kay woh aesay hogaye jaisay pathar ! balkay sakhti mein kuch unn say bhi ziyada . ( kiyonkay ) pathraon mein say kuch aesay bhi hotay hain jinn say nehren phoot behti hain , aur unhi mein say kuch woh hotay hain jo khud phatt parrtay hain aur unn say paani nikal aata hai , aur unhi mein woh ( pathar ) bhi hain jo Allah kay khof say lurhak jatay hain .   . aur ( iss kay bar-khilaf ) jo kuch tum ker rahey ho , Allah uss say bey khabar nahi hai .
verses.translation: iss sabb kay baad tumharay dil phir sakht hogaye , yahan tak kay woh aesay hogaye jaisay pathar ! balkay sakhti mein kuch unn say bhi ziyada . ( kiyonkay ) pathraon mein say kuch aesay bhi hotay hain jinn say nehren phoot behti hain , aur unhi mein say kuch woh hotay hain jo khud phatt parrtay hain aur unn say paani nikal aata hai , aur unhi mein woh ( pathar ) bhi hain jo Allah kay khof say lurhak jatay hain .   . aur ( iss kay bar-khilaf ) jo kuch tum ker rahey ho , Allah uss say bey khabar nahi hai .

verses.text: . ( musalmano ! ) kiya abb bhi tumhen yeh lalach hai kay yeh log tumharay kehney say emaan ley ayen gay-? halankay inn mein say aik giroh kay log Allah ka kalam suntay thay , phir uss ko achi tarah samajhney kay baad bhi jantay boojhtay uss mein tehreef kar daaltay thay .
verses.translation: . ( musalmano ! ) kiya abb bhi tumhen yeh lalach hai kay yeh log tumharay kehney say emaan ley ayen gay-? halankay inn mein say aik giroh kay log Allah ka kalam suntay thay , phir uss ko achi tarah samajhney kay baad bhi jantay boojhtay uss mein tehreef kar daaltay thay .

verses.text: aur jab yeh log inn ( musalmanon ) say miltay hain jo pehlay emaan laa-chukay hain to ( zaban say ) keh detay hain kay hum ( bhi ) emaan ley aaye hain , aur jab yeh aik doosray kay sath tanhai mein jatay hain to ( aapas mein aik doosray say ) kehtay hain kay :  kiya tum inn ( musalmanon ) ko woh baaten batatay ho jo Allah taalaa ney tum per kholi hain takay yeh ( musalman ) tumharay perwerdigar kay paas jaker enhe tumharay khilaf daleel kay tor per paish keren-?   kiya tumhen itni bhi aqal nahi ?
verses.translation: aur jab yeh log inn ( musalmanon ) say miltay hain jo pehlay emaan laa-chukay hain to ( zaban say ) keh detay hain kay hum ( bhi ) emaan ley aaye hain , aur jab yeh aik doosray kay sath tanhai mein jatay hain to ( aapas mein aik doosray say ) kehtay hain kay :  kiya tum inn ( musalmanon ) ko woh baaten batatay ho jo Allah taalaa ney tum per kholi hain takay yeh ( musalman ) tumharay perwerdigar kay paas jaker enhe tumharay khilaf daleel kay tor per paish keren-?   kiya tumhen itni bhi aqal nahi ?

verses.text: kiya yeh log ( jo aesi baaten kertay hain ) yeh nahi jantay kay Allah ko unn sari baaton ka khoob ilm hai , jo woh chupatay hain aur jo woh zahir kertay hain ?
verses.translation: kiya yeh log ( jo aesi baaten kertay hain ) yeh nahi jantay kay Allah ko unn sari baaton ka khoob ilm hai , jo woh chupatay hain aur jo woh zahir kertay hain ?

verses.text: aur inn mein say kuch log ann parh hain jo kitab ( toraat ) ka ilm to rakhtay nahi , albatta kuch aarzooyen pakaye bethay hain , aur unn ka kaam bus yeh hai kay weham o gumaan baandhtay rehtay hain .
verses.translation: aur inn mein say kuch log ann parh hain jo kitab ( toraat ) ka ilm to rakhtay nahi , albatta kuch aarzooyen pakaye bethay hain , aur unn ka kaam bus yeh hai kay weham o gumaan baandhtay rehtay hain .

verses.text: lehaza tabahi hai unn logon  ki jo apney haathon say kitab likhtay hain , phir ( logon  say ) kehtay hain kay yeh Allah ki taraf say hai , takay uss kay zariye thori si aamdani kama len .   pus tabahi hai unn logon  per uss tehreer ki wajeh say bhi jo unn kay haathon ney likhi , aur tabahi hai unn per uss aamdani ki wajeh say bhi jo woh kamatay hain .
verses.translation: lehaza tabahi hai unn logon  ki jo apney haathon say kitab likhtay hain , phir ( logon  say ) kehtay hain kay yeh Allah ki taraf say hai , takay uss kay zariye thori si aamdani kama len .   pus tabahi hai unn logon  per uss tehreer ki wajeh say bhi jo unn kay haathon ney likhi , aur tabahi hai unn per uss aamdani ki wajeh say bhi jo woh kamatay hain .

verses.text: aur yahudiyon ney kaha hai kay hamen ginti kay chand dino kay ilawa aag hergiz nahi chooye gi . aap unn say kahiye kay kiya tum ney Allah ki taraf say koi ehad ley rakha hai jiss ki bana per woh apney ehad ki khilaf warzi nahi ker-sakta , ya tum Allah kay zimmay woh baat laga rahey ho jiss ka tumhen kuch pata nahi-?
verses.translation: aur yahudiyon ney kaha hai kay hamen ginti kay chand dino kay ilawa aag hergiz nahi chooye gi . aap unn say kahiye kay kiya tum ney Allah ki taraf say koi ehad ley rakha hai jiss ki bana per woh apney ehad ki khilaf warzi nahi ker-sakta , ya tum Allah kay zimmay woh baat laga rahey ho jiss ka tumhen kuch pata nahi-?

verses.text: . ( aag tumhen ) kiyon nahi ( chooye gi ) ? jo log bhi badi kamatay hain aur unn ki badi unhen gher leti hai   to aesay log hi dozakh kay baasi hain . woh hamesha uss mein rahen gay .
verses.translation: . ( aag tumhen ) kiyon nahi ( chooye gi ) ? jo log bhi badi kamatay hain aur unn ki badi unhen gher leti hai   to aesay log hi dozakh kay baasi hain . woh hamesha uss mein rahen gay .

verses.text: aur jo log emaan latay hain aur naik amal kertay hain , to woh jannat kay baasi hain . woh hamesha uss mein rahen gay .
verses.translation: aur jo log emaan latay hain aur naik amal kertay hain , to woh jannat kay baasi hain . woh hamesha uss mein rahen gay .

verses.text: aur ( woh waqt yaad karo ) jab hum ney bani Israel say paka ehad liya tha kay :  tum Allah kay siwa kissi ki ibadat nahi kero gay , aur walaiden say acha sulook karo gay , aur rishta daaron say bhi aur yateemon aur miskeeno say bhi . aur logon  say bhali baat kehna , aur namaz qaeem kerna aur zakat dena .  ( magar ) phir tum mein say thoray say logon  kay siwa baqi sabb ( uss ehad say ) mun morr ker phir gaye .
verses.translation: aur ( woh waqt yaad karo ) jab hum ney bani Israel say paka ehad liya tha kay :  tum Allah kay siwa kissi ki ibadat nahi kero gay , aur walaiden say acha sulook karo gay , aur rishta daaron say bhi aur yateemon aur miskeeno say bhi . aur logon  say bhali baat kehna , aur namaz qaeem kerna aur zakat dena .  ( magar ) phir tum mein say thoray say logon  kay siwa baqi sabb ( uss ehad say ) mun morr ker phir gaye .

verses.text: aur ( yaad kero ) jab hum ney tum say paka ehad liya tha kay :  tum aik doosray ka khoon nahi bahao gay , aur apney aadmiyon ko apney gharon say nahi nikalo gay  phir tum ney iqrar kiya tha , aur tum khud uss kay gawah ho .
verses.translation: aur ( yaad kero ) jab hum ney tum say paka ehad liya tha kay :  tum aik doosray ka khoon nahi bahao gay , aur apney aadmiyon ko apney gharon say nahi nikalo gay  phir tum ney iqrar kiya tha , aur tum khud uss kay gawah ho .

verses.text: uss kay baad ( aaj ) tum hi woh log ho kay apney hi aadmiyon ko qatal kertay ho , aur apney hi mein say kuch logon  ko unn kay gharon say nikal bahir kertay ho , aur unn kay khilaf gunah aur ziyadti ka irtikab ker kay ( unn kay dushmanon ki ) madad kertay ho , aur agar woh ( dushmanon kay ) qedi ban ker tumharay paas aajatay hain to tum unn ko fidya dey ker churra letay ho , halankay unn ko ( ghar say ) nikalna hi tumharay liye haram tha .   to kiya tum kitab ( toraat ) kay kuch hissay per to emaan rakhtay ho aur kuch ka inkar kertay ho-? abb batao kay jo shaks aisa keray uss ki saza iss kay siwa kiya hai kay dunyawi zindagi mein uss ki ruswai ho-? aur qayamat kay din aesay logon  ko sakht tareen azab ki taraf bhej diya jaye ga . aur jo kuch tum amal kertay ho Allah uss say ghafil nahi hai .
verses.translation: uss kay baad ( aaj ) tum hi woh log ho kay apney hi aadmiyon ko qatal kertay ho , aur apney hi mein say kuch logon  ko unn kay gharon say nikal bahir kertay ho , aur unn kay khilaf gunah aur ziyadti ka irtikab ker kay ( unn kay dushmanon ki ) madad kertay ho , aur agar woh ( dushmanon kay ) qedi ban ker tumharay paas aajatay hain to tum unn ko fidya dey ker churra letay ho , halankay unn ko ( ghar say ) nikalna hi tumharay liye haram tha .   to kiya tum kitab ( toraat ) kay kuch hissay per to emaan rakhtay ho aur kuch ka inkar kertay ho-? abb batao kay jo shaks aisa keray uss ki saza iss kay siwa kiya hai kay dunyawi zindagi mein uss ki ruswai ho-? aur qayamat kay din aesay logon  ko sakht tareen azab ki taraf bhej diya jaye ga . aur jo kuch tum amal kertay ho Allah uss say ghafil nahi hai .

verses.text: yeh woh log hain jinhon ney dunyawi zindagi ko aakhirat kay badlay khareed liya hai , lehaza naa unn kay azab mein koi takhfeef hogi aur naa unn ki madad ki jayegi .
verses.translation: yeh woh log hain jinhon ney dunyawi zindagi ko aakhirat kay badlay khareed liya hai , lehaza naa unn kay azab mein koi takhfeef hogi aur naa unn ki madad ki jayegi .

verses.text: aur beyshak hum ney musa ko kitab di , aur uss kay baad pey-dar-pay Rasool bhejay . aur hum ney essa ibn-e-maryam ko khuli khuli nishaniyan den , aur rooh-ul-qudus say unn ki taeed ki .   phir yeh aakhir kiya moamla hai kay jab kabhi koi Rasool tumharay paas koi aesi baat ley ker aaya jo tumhari nafsani khuwaishaat ko pasand nahi thi to tum akarr gaye ? chunacheh baaz ( anbiya ) ko tum ney jhutlaya , aur baaz ko qatal kertay rahey .
verses.translation: aur beyshak hum ney musa ko kitab di , aur uss kay baad pey-dar-pay Rasool bhejay . aur hum ney essa ibn-e-maryam ko khuli khuli nishaniyan den , aur rooh-ul-qudus say unn ki taeed ki .   phir yeh aakhir kiya moamla hai kay jab kabhi koi Rasool tumharay paas koi aesi baat ley ker aaya jo tumhari nafsani khuwaishaat ko pasand nahi thi to tum akarr gaye ? chunacheh baaz ( anbiya ) ko tum ney jhutlaya , aur baaz ko qatal kertay rahey .

verses.text: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  humaray dil ghilaf mein hain .   nahi ! balkay unn kay kufr ki wajeh say Allah ney unn per phitkaar daal rakhi hai , iss liye woh kam hi emaan latay hain .
verses.translation: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  humaray dil ghilaf mein hain .   nahi ! balkay unn kay kufr ki wajeh say Allah ney unn per phitkaar daal rakhi hai , iss liye woh kam hi emaan latay hain .

verses.text: aur jab unn kay paas Allah ki taraf say woh kitab aai ( yani Quran ) jo uss ( toraat ) ki tasdeeq bhi kerti hai jo pehlay say unn kay paas hai , ( to unn ka tarz-e-amal dekho ! ) bawajood-yeh-kay yeh khud shuroo mein kafiron ( yani butt paraston ) kay khilaf ( iss kitab kay hawalay say ) Allah say fatah ki duayen maanga kertay thay ,   magar jab woh cheez unn kay paas aagae jissay unhon ney pehchan bhi liya , to uss ka inkar ker bethay . pus phitkaar hai Allah ki aesay kafiron per !
verses.translation: aur jab unn kay paas Allah ki taraf say woh kitab aai ( yani Quran ) jo uss ( toraat ) ki tasdeeq bhi kerti hai jo pehlay say unn kay paas hai , ( to unn ka tarz-e-amal dekho ! ) bawajood-yeh-kay yeh khud shuroo mein kafiron ( yani butt paraston ) kay khilaf ( iss kitab kay hawalay say ) Allah say fatah ki duayen maanga kertay thay ,   magar jab woh cheez unn kay paas aagae jissay unhon ney pehchan bhi liya , to uss ka inkar ker bethay . pus phitkaar hai Allah ki aesay kafiron per !

verses.text: buri hai woh qeemat jiss kay badlay unhon ney apni janon ko bech daala hai , kay yeh Allah ki nazil ki hoi kitab ka sirf iss jalan ki bana per inkar ker rahey hain kay Allah apney fazal ka koi hissa ( yani wahi ) apney bandon mein say jiss per chah raha hai ( kiyon ) utaar raha hai ? chunacheh yeh ( apni iss/uss jalan ki wajeh say ) ghazab balaye ghazab ley ker lotay hain .   aur kafir log zillat aamez saza kay mustahiq hain .
verses.translation: buri hai woh qeemat jiss kay badlay unhon ney apni janon ko bech daala hai , kay yeh Allah ki nazil ki hoi kitab ka sirf iss jalan ki bana per inkar ker rahey hain kay Allah apney fazal ka koi hissa ( yani wahi ) apney bandon mein say jiss per chah raha hai ( kiyon ) utaar raha hai ? chunacheh yeh ( apni iss/uss jalan ki wajeh say ) ghazab balaye ghazab ley ker lotay hain .   aur kafir log zillat aamez saza kay mustahiq hain .

verses.text: aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay Allah ney jo kalam utaara hai uss per emaan ley aao , to woh kehtay hain kay hum to ( sirf ) ussi kalam per emaan rakhen gay jo hum per nazil kiya gaya , ( yani toraat ) aur woh uss kay siwa ( doosri aasmani kitabon ) ka inkar kertay hain , halankay woh bhi haq hain , ( aur ) jo kitab unn kay paas hai woh uss ki tasdeeq bhi kerti hain . ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn say kaho kay agar tum waqaee ( toraat per ) emaan rakhtay thay to Allah kay nabiyon ko pehlay zamaney mein kiyon qatal kertay rahey-?
verses.translation: aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay Allah ney jo kalam utaara hai uss per emaan ley aao , to woh kehtay hain kay hum to ( sirf ) ussi kalam per emaan rakhen gay jo hum per nazil kiya gaya , ( yani toraat ) aur woh uss kay siwa ( doosri aasmani kitabon ) ka inkar kertay hain , halankay woh bhi haq hain , ( aur ) jo kitab unn kay paas hai woh uss ki tasdeeq bhi kerti hain . ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn say kaho kay agar tum waqaee ( toraat per ) emaan rakhtay thay to Allah kay nabiyon ko pehlay zamaney mein kiyon qatal kertay rahey-?

verses.text: aur khud musa tumharay paas roshan nishaniyan ley ker aaye , phir tum ney unn kay peeth peechay yeh sitam dhaaya kay gaye kay bachrray ko mabood bana liya .
verses.translation: aur khud musa tumharay paas roshan nishaniyan ley ker aaye , phir tum ney unn kay peeth peechay yeh sitam dhaaya kay gaye kay bachrray ko mabood bana liya .

verses.text: aur woh waqt yaad karo jab hum ney tum say ehad liya aur tumharay oopper toor ko buland kerdiya ( aur yeh kaha kay )  jo kuch hum ney tum ko diya hai uss ko mazbooti say thaamo   aur ( jo kuch kaha jaye ussay hosh say ) suno  . kehney lagay :  hum ney ( pehlay bhi ) sunn liya tha , magar amal nahi kiya tha ( abb bhi aisa hi keren gay )  aur ( darasal ) unn kay kufr ki nahoosat say unn kay dilon mein bachrra basa huwa tha . aap ( unn say ) kahiye kay agar tum momin ho to kitni buri hain woh baaten jo tumhara emaan tumhen talqeen ker raha hai !
verses.translation: aur woh waqt yaad karo jab hum ney tum say ehad liya aur tumharay oopper toor ko buland kerdiya ( aur yeh kaha kay )  jo kuch hum ney tum ko diya hai uss ko mazbooti say thaamo   aur ( jo kuch kaha jaye ussay hosh say ) suno  . kehney lagay :  hum ney ( pehlay bhi ) sunn liya tha , magar amal nahi kiya tha ( abb bhi aisa hi keren gay )  aur ( darasal ) unn kay kufr ki nahoosat say unn kay dilon mein bachrra basa huwa tha . aap ( unn say ) kahiye kay agar tum momin ho to kitni buri hain woh baaten jo tumhara emaan tumhen talqeen ker raha hai !

verses.text: aap ( unn say ) kahiye kay :  agar Allah kay nazdeek aakhirat ka ghar tamam insanon ko chorr ker sirf tumharay hi liye makhsoos hai ( jaisa kay tumhara kehna hai ) to moat ki tamanna to ker kay dikhao , agar waqaee sachay ho
verses.translation: aap ( unn say ) kahiye kay :  agar Allah kay nazdeek aakhirat ka ghar tamam insanon ko chorr ker sirf tumharay hi liye makhsoos hai ( jaisa kay tumhara kehna hai ) to moat ki tamanna to ker kay dikhao , agar waqaee sachay ho

verses.text: aur ( hum bataye detay hain kay ) unhon ney apney jo kartoot aagay bhej rakhay hain , unn ki wajeh say yeh kabhi aesi tamanna nahi keren gay .   Allah zalimon ko khoob janta hai .
verses.translation: aur ( hum bataye detay hain kay ) unhon ney apney jo kartoot aagay bhej rakhay hain , unn ki wajeh say yeh kabhi aesi tamanna nahi keren gay .   Allah zalimon ko khoob janta hai .

verses.text: . ( balkay ) yaqeenan tum unn logon  ko pao gay kay unhen zinda rehney ki hirs doosray tamam insanon say ziyada hai , yahan tak kay mushrikeen say bhi ziyada . inn mein ka aik aik shaks yeh chahta hai kay aik hazar saal umar paye , halankay kissi ka bari umar paalena ussay azab say door nahi ker-sakta . aur yeh jo amal bhi kertay hain Allah ussay achi tarah dekh raha hai .
verses.translation: . ( balkay ) yaqeenan tum unn logon  ko pao gay kay unhen zinda rehney ki hirs doosray tamam insanon say ziyada hai , yahan tak kay mushrikeen say bhi ziyada . inn mein ka aik aik shaks yeh chahta hai kay aik hazar saal umar paye , halankay kissi ka bari umar paalena ussay azab say door nahi ker-sakta . aur yeh jo amal bhi kertay hain Allah ussay achi tarah dekh raha hai .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay agar koi shaks jibraeel ka dushman hai   to ( huwa keray ) unhon ney to yeh kalam Allah ki ijazat say tumharay dil per utaara hai jo apney say pehlay ki kitabon ki tasdeeq ker raha hai , aur emaan walon kay liye mujassam hidayat aur khushkhabri hai .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay agar koi shaks jibraeel ka dushman hai   to ( huwa keray ) unhon ney to yeh kalam Allah ki ijazat say tumharay dil per utaara hai jo apney say pehlay ki kitabon ki tasdeeq ker raha hai , aur emaan walon kay liye mujassam hidayat aur khushkhabri hai .

verses.text: agar koi shaks Allah ka , uss kay farishton aur Rasoolon ka , aur jibraeel aur mekael ka dushman hai to ( woh sunn rakhay kay ) Allah kafiron ka dushman hai .
verses.translation: agar koi shaks Allah ka , uss kay farishton aur Rasoolon ka , aur jibraeel aur mekael ka dushman hai to ( woh sunn rakhay kay ) Allah kafiron ka dushman hai .

verses.text: aur beyshak hum ney aap per aesi aayaten utaari hain jo haq ko aashkaar kernay wali hain , aur unn ka inkar wohi log kertay hain jo nafarman hain .
verses.translation: aur beyshak hum ney aap per aesi aayaten utaari hain jo haq ko aashkaar kernay wali hain , aur unn ka inkar wohi log kertay hain jo nafarman hain .

verses.text: yeh aakhir kiya moamla hai kay inn logon  ney jab koi ehad kiya , inn kay aik giroh ney ussay hamesha torr phenka-? balkay unn mein say aksar log emaan latay hi nahi .
verses.translation: yeh aakhir kiya moamla hai kay inn logon  ney jab koi ehad kiya , inn kay aik giroh ney ussay hamesha torr phenka-? balkay unn mein say aksar log emaan latay hi nahi .

verses.text: aur jab unn kay paas Allah ki taraf say aik Rasool aaye jo uss ( toraat ) ki tasdeeq ker rahey thay jo inn kay paas hai , to ehal-e-kitab mein say aik giroh ney Allah ki kitab ( toraat o injeel ) ko iss tarah pus-e-pusht daal diya goya woh kuch jantay hi naa thay ( kay uss mein nabi aakhir-uz-zaman SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam kay baaray mein kiya hidayaat di gaee then )
verses.translation: aur jab unn kay paas Allah ki taraf say aik Rasool aaye jo uss ( toraat ) ki tasdeeq ker rahey thay jo inn kay paas hai , to ehal-e-kitab mein say aik giroh ney Allah ki kitab ( toraat o injeel ) ko iss tarah pus-e-pusht daal diya goya woh kuch jantay hi naa thay ( kay uss mein nabi aakhir-uz-zaman SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam kay baaray mein kiya hidayaat di gaee then )

verses.text: aur yeh ( bani Israel ) unn ( mantaron ) kay peechay lagg gaye jo suleman ( aleh-assalam ) ki saltanat kay zamaney mein shayateen parha kertay thay . aur suleman ( aleh-assalam ) ney koi kufr nahi kiya tha , albatta shayateen logon  ko jadoo ki taleem dey ker kufr ka irtikab kertay thay .   neez ( yeh bani Israel ) uss cheez kay peechay lagg gaye jo shehar babil mein haroot aur maaroot naami do farishton per nazil ki gaee thi .   yeh do farishtay kissi ko uss waqt tak koi taleem nahi detay thay jab tak uss say yeh naa keh den kay :  hum mehaz aazmaesh kay liye ( bhejay gaye ) hain , lehaza tum ( jadoo kay peechay lagg ker ) kufr ikhtiyar naa kerna .  phir bhi yeh log unn say woh cheezen seekhtay thay jiss kay zariye mard aur uss ki biwi mein judai peda kerden . ( wesay yeh wazeh rahey kay ) woh uss kay zariye kissi ko Allah ki mashiyat kay baghair koi nuqsan nahi phoncha saktay thay .   ( magar ) woh aesi baaten seekhtay thay jo unn kay liye nuqsan deh then , aur faeeda mand naa then . aur woh yeh bhi khoob jantay thay kay jo shaks inn cheezon ka khareedaar banay ga , aakhirat mein uss ka koi hissa nahi hoga . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh cheez boht buri thi jiss kay badlay unhon ney apni janen bech daalen . kaash kay unn ko ( iss baat ka haqeeqi ) ilm hota .
