( wesay yeh wazeh rahey kay ) woh uss kay zariye kissi ko Allah ki mashiyat kay baghair koi nuqsan nahi phoncha saktay thay .   ( magar ) woh aesi baaten seekhtay thay jo unn kay liye nuqsan deh then , aur faeeda mand naa then . aur woh yeh bhi khoob jantay thay kay jo shaks inn cheezon ka khareedaar banay ga , aakhirat mein uss ka koi hissa nahi hoga . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh cheez boht buri thi jiss kay badlay unhon ney apni janen bech daalen . kaash kay unn ko ( iss baat ka haqeeqi ) ilm hota .

verses.text: aur ( iss kay bar-aks ) agar woh emaan aur taqwa ikhtiyar kertay to Allah kay paas say milney wala sawab yaqeenan kahen ziyada behtar hota . kaash kay unn ko ( iss baat ka bhi haqeeqi ) ilm hota .
verses.translation: aur ( iss kay bar-aks ) agar woh emaan aur taqwa ikhtiyar kertay to Allah kay paas say milney wala sawab yaqeenan kahen ziyada behtar hota . kaash kay unn ko ( iss baat ka bhi haqeeqi ) ilm hota .

verses.text: emaan walo ! ( Rasool Allah SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam say mukhatib hoker ) raeena naa kaha karo , aur unzurna keh diya kero .   aur suna kero . aur kafiron kay liye dardnak azab hai .
verses.translation: emaan walo ! ( Rasool Allah SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam say mukhatib hoker ) raeena naa kaha karo , aur unzurna keh diya kero .   aur suna kero . aur kafiron kay liye dardnak azab hai .

verses.text: kafir log khuwa ehal-e-kitab mein say hon ya mushrikeen mein say , yeh pasand nahi kertay kay tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say koi bhalai tum per nazil ho , halankay Allah jiss ko chahta hai apni rehmat kay liye makhsoos farma leta hai . aur Allah fazal-e-azeem ka malik hai .
verses.translation: kafir log khuwa ehal-e-kitab mein say hon ya mushrikeen mein say , yeh pasand nahi kertay kay tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say koi bhalai tum per nazil ho , halankay Allah jiss ko chahta hai apni rehmat kay liye makhsoos farma leta hai . aur Allah fazal-e-azeem ka malik hai .

verses.text: hum jab bhi koi aayat mansookh kertay hain ya ussay bhula detay hain to uss say behtar ya ussi jaisi ( aayat ) ley aatay hain .   kiya tumhen yeh maloom nahi kay Allah her cheez per qudrat rakhta hai-?
verses.translation: hum jab bhi koi aayat mansookh kertay hain ya ussay bhula detay hain to uss say behtar ya ussi jaisi ( aayat ) ley aatay hain .   kiya tumhen yeh maloom nahi kay Allah her cheez per qudrat rakhta hai-?

verses.text: kiya tumhen yeh maloom nahi kay Allah woh zaat hai kay aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat tanha ussi ki hai , aur Allah kay siwa naa koi tumhara rakhwala hai naa madadgaar-?
verses.translation: kiya tumhen yeh maloom nahi kay Allah woh zaat hai kay aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat tanha ussi ki hai , aur Allah kay siwa naa koi tumhara rakhwala hai naa madadgaar-?

verses.text: kiya tum yeh chahtay ho kay apney Rasool say ussi qisam kay sawal kero jaisay pehlay musa say kiye ja-chukay hain-?   aur jo shaks emaan kay badlay kufr ikhtiyar keray woh yaqeenan seedhay raastay say bhatak gaya .
verses.translation: kiya tum yeh chahtay ho kay apney Rasool say ussi qisam kay sawal kero jaisay pehlay musa say kiye ja-chukay hain-?   aur jo shaks emaan kay badlay kufr ikhtiyar keray woh yaqeenan seedhay raastay say bhatak gaya .

verses.text: . ( musalmano ) boht say ehal-e-kitab apney dilon kay hasad ki bana per yeh chahtay hain kay tumharay emaan laney kay baad tumhen palta ker phir kafir bana den , bawajood-yeh-kay haq unn per wazeh hochuka hai . chunacheh tum moaaf kero aur darguzar say kaam lo yahan tak kay Allah khud apna faisla bhej dey . beyshak Allah her cheez per qadir hai .
verses.translation: . ( musalmano ) boht say ehal-e-kitab apney dilon kay hasad ki bana per yeh chahtay hain kay tumharay emaan laney kay baad tumhen palta ker phir kafir bana den , bawajood-yeh-kay haq unn per wazeh hochuka hai . chunacheh tum moaaf kero aur darguzar say kaam lo yahan tak kay Allah khud apna faisla bhej dey . beyshak Allah her cheez per qadir hai .

verses.text: aur namaz qaeem kero aur zakat ada kero , aur ( yaad rakho kay ) jo bhalai ka amal bhi tum khud apney faeeday kay liye aagay bhej do gay uss ko Allah kay paas pao gay . beyshak jo amal bhi tum kertay ho Allah ussay dekh raha hai .
verses.translation: aur namaz qaeem kero aur zakat ada kero , aur ( yaad rakho kay ) jo bhalai ka amal bhi tum khud apney faeeday kay liye aagay bhej do gay uss ko Allah kay paas pao gay . beyshak jo amal bhi tum kertay ho Allah ussay dekh raha hai .

verses.text: aur yeh ( yani yahudi aur essai ) kehtay hain kay :  jannat mein siwaye yahudiyon ya essaiyon kay koi bhi hergiz dakhil nahi hoga .    yeh mehaz inn ki aarzooyen hain . aap inn say kahiye kay agar tum ( apney iss daway mein ) sachay ho to apni koi daleel ley ker aao .
verses.translation: aur yeh ( yani yahudi aur essai ) kehtay hain kay :  jannat mein siwaye yahudiyon ya essaiyon kay koi bhi hergiz dakhil nahi hoga .    yeh mehaz inn ki aarzooyen hain . aap inn say kahiye kay agar tum ( apney iss daway mein ) sachay ho to apni koi daleel ley ker aao .

verses.text: kiyon nahi-? ( qaeeda yeh hai kay ) jo shaks bhi apna rukh Allah kay aagay jhuka dey , aur woh naik amal kernay wala ho , ussay apna ajar apney perwerdigar kay paas milay ga . aur aesay logon  ko naa koi khof hoga , aur naa woh ghumgeen hon gay .
verses.translation: kiyon nahi-? ( qaeeda yeh hai kay ) jo shaks bhi apna rukh Allah kay aagay jhuka dey , aur woh naik amal kernay wala ho , ussay apna ajar apney perwerdigar kay paas milay ga . aur aesay logon  ko naa koi khof hoga , aur naa woh ghumgeen hon gay .

verses.text: aur yahudi kehtay hain kay essaiyon ( kay mazahab ) ki koi buniyad nahi , aur essai kehtay hain kay yahudiyon ( kay mazahab ) ki koi buniyad nahi , halankay yeh sabb ( aasmani ) kitab parhtay hain . issi tarah woh ( mushrikeen ) jinn kay paas koi ( aasmani ) ilm hi siray say nahi hai , unhon ney bhi inn ( ehal-e-kitab ) ki jaisi baaten kehni shuroo kerdi hain . chunacheh Allah hi qayamat kay din inn kay darmiyan unn baaton ka faisla keray ga jinn mein yeh ikhtilaf kertay rahey hain .
verses.translation: aur yahudi kehtay hain kay essaiyon ( kay mazahab ) ki koi buniyad nahi , aur essai kehtay hain kay yahudiyon ( kay mazahab ) ki koi buniyad nahi , halankay yeh sabb ( aasmani ) kitab parhtay hain . issi tarah woh ( mushrikeen ) jinn kay paas koi ( aasmani ) ilm hi siray say nahi hai , unhon ney bhi inn ( ehal-e-kitab ) ki jaisi baaten kehni shuroo kerdi hain . chunacheh Allah hi qayamat kay din inn kay darmiyan unn baaton ka faisla keray ga jinn mein yeh ikhtilaf kertay rahey hain .

verses.text: aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah ki masjidon per iss baat ki bandish laga dey kay unn mein Allah ka naam liya jaye , aur unn ko weeran kernay ki koshish keray . aesay logon  ko yeh haq nahi phonchta kay woh unn ( masjidon ) mein dakhil hon magar dartay huye .   aesay logon  kay liye duniya mein ruswai hai aur unhi ko aakhirat mein zabardast azab hoga .
verses.translation: aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah ki masjidon per iss baat ki bandish laga dey kay unn mein Allah ka naam liya jaye , aur unn ko weeran kernay ki koshish keray . aesay logon  ko yeh haq nahi phonchta kay woh unn ( masjidon ) mein dakhil hon magar dartay huye .   aesay logon  kay liye duniya mein ruswai hai aur unhi ko aakhirat mein zabardast azab hoga .

verses.text: aur mashriq o maghrib sabb Allah hi ki hain . lehaza jiss taraf bhi tum rukh karo gay , wahin Allah ka rukh hai .   beyshak Allah boht wusat wala , bara ilm rakhney wala hai .
verses.translation: aur mashriq o maghrib sabb Allah hi ki hain . lehaza jiss taraf bhi tum rukh karo gay , wahin Allah ka rukh hai .   beyshak Allah boht wusat wala , bara ilm rakhney wala hai .

verses.text: yeh log kehtay hain kay Allah ney koi beta banaya huwa hai , ( halankay ) uss ki zaat ( iss qisam ki cheezon say ) pak hai , balkay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai ussi ka hai . sabb kay sabb uss kay farmanbardaar hain .
verses.translation: yeh log kehtay hain kay Allah ney koi beta banaya huwa hai , ( halankay ) uss ki zaat ( iss qisam ki cheezon say ) pak hai , balkay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai ussi ka hai . sabb kay sabb uss kay farmanbardaar hain .

verses.text: woh aasmano aur zameen ka mojid hai , aur jab woh kissi baat ka faisla kerta hai to uss kay baaray mein bus itna kehta hai kay :  hoja  chunacheh woh hojati hai .
verses.translation: woh aasmano aur zameen ka mojid hai , aur jab woh kissi baat ka faisla kerta hai to uss kay baaray mein bus itna kehta hai kay :  hoja  chunacheh woh hojati hai .

verses.text: aur jo log ilm nahi rakhtay woh kehtay hain kay : Allah hum say ( barah-e-raast ) kiyon baat nahi kerta-? ya humaray paas koi nishani kiyon nahi aati-? jo log inn say pehlay guzray hain woh bhi issi tarah ki baaten kehtay thay jaisi yeh kehtay hain . inn sabb kay dil aik jaisay hain . haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log yaqeen kerna chahen unn kay liye hum nishaniyan pehlay hi wazeh ker-chukay hain .
verses.translation: aur jo log ilm nahi rakhtay woh kehtay hain kay : Allah hum say ( barah-e-raast ) kiyon baat nahi kerta-? ya humaray paas koi nishani kiyon nahi aati-? jo log inn say pehlay guzray hain woh bhi issi tarah ki baaten kehtay thay jaisi yeh kehtay hain . inn sabb kay dil aik jaisay hain . haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log yaqeen kerna chahen unn kay liye hum nishaniyan pehlay hi wazeh ker-chukay hain .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) beyshak hum ney tumhen ko haq dey ker iss tarah bheja hai kay tum ( jannat ki ) khushkhabri do aur ( jahannum say ) darao aur jo log ( apni marzi say ) jahannum ( ka raasta ) ikhtiyar ker-chukay hain unn kay baaray mein aap say koi baaz purs nahi hogi .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) beyshak hum ney tumhen ko haq dey ker iss tarah bheja hai kay tum ( jannat ki ) khushkhabri do aur ( jahannum say ) darao aur jo log ( apni marzi say ) jahannum ( ka raasta ) ikhtiyar ker-chukay hain unn kay baaray mein aap say koi baaz purs nahi hogi .

verses.text: aur yahood o nasara tum say uss waqt tak hergiz razi nahi hon gay jab tak tum unn kay mazahab ki perwi nahi kero gay . keh do kay haqeeqi hidayat to Allah hi ki hidayat hai . aur tumharay paas ( wahi kay zariye ) jo ilm aagaya hai , agar kahen tum ney uss kay baad bhi inn logon  ki khuwaishaat ki perwi kerli to tumhen Allah say bachaney kay liye naa koi himayati milay ga naa koi madadgaar .
verses.translation: aur yahood o nasara tum say uss waqt tak hergiz razi nahi hon gay jab tak tum unn kay mazahab ki perwi nahi kero gay . keh do kay haqeeqi hidayat to Allah hi ki hidayat hai . aur tumharay paas ( wahi kay zariye ) jo ilm aagaya hai , agar kahen tum ney uss kay baad bhi inn logon  ki khuwaishaat ki perwi kerli to tumhen Allah say bachaney kay liye naa koi himayati milay ga naa koi madadgaar .

verses.text: jinn logon  ko hum ney kitab di, jabkay woh uss ki tilawat iss tarah kertay hon jaisa uss ki tilawat ka haq hai , to woh log hi ( dar-haqeeqat ) uss per emaan rakhtay hain .   aur jo iss ka inkar kertay hon , to aesay log hi nuqsan uthaney walay hain
verses.translation: jinn logon  ko hum ney kitab di, jabkay woh uss ki tilawat iss tarah kertay hon jaisa uss ki tilawat ka haq hai , to woh log hi ( dar-haqeeqat ) uss per emaan rakhtay hain .   aur jo iss ka inkar kertay hon , to aesay log hi nuqsan uthaney walay hain

verses.text: aey bani Israel ! meri woh naimat yaad kero jo mein ney tum ko ata ki thi , aur yeh baat ( yaad kero ) kay mein ney tum ko saray jahano per fazilat di thi .
verses.translation: aey bani Israel ! meri woh naimat yaad kero jo mein ney tum ko ata ki thi , aur yeh baat ( yaad kero ) kay mein ney tum ko saray jahano per fazilat di thi .

verses.text: aur uss din say daro jiss din koi shaks bhi kissi kay kuch kaam nahi aaye ga , naa kissi say kissi qisam ka fidya qubool kiya jaye ga , naa uss ko koi sifarish faeeda dey gi , aur naa unn ko koi madad phonchay gi .
verses.translation: aur uss din say daro jiss din koi shaks bhi kissi kay kuch kaam nahi aaye ga , naa kissi say kissi qisam ka fidya qubool kiya jaye ga , naa uss ko koi sifarish faeeda dey gi , aur naa unn ko koi madad phonchay gi .

verses.text: aur ( woh waqt yaad karo ) jab Ibrahim ko unn kay perwerdigar ney kaee baaton say aazmaya , aur unhon ney woh sari baaten poori ken , Allah ney ( unn say ) kaha :  mein tumhen tamam insanon ka peshwa bananey wala hun .  Ibrahim ney poocha :  aur meri aulad mein say-?  Allah ney farmaya :  mera ( yeh ) ehad zalimon ko shamil nahi hai .
verses.translation: aur ( woh waqt yaad karo ) jab Ibrahim ko unn kay perwerdigar ney kaee baaton say aazmaya , aur unhon ney woh sari baaten poori ken , Allah ney ( unn say ) kaha :  mein tumhen tamam insanon ka peshwa bananey wala hun .  Ibrahim ney poocha :  aur meri aulad mein say-?  Allah ney farmaya :  mera ( yeh ) ehad zalimon ko shamil nahi hai .

verses.text: aur woh waqt yaad karo jab hum ney baitullah ko logon  kay liye aesi jagah banaya jiss ki taraf woh lot lot ker jayen aur jo sarapa aman ho .   aur tum maqam-e-Ibrahim ko namaz parhney ki jagah bana lo .   aur hum ney Ibrahim aur Ismail ko yeh takeed ki kay :  tum dono meray ghar ko unn logon  kay liye pak karo jo ( yahan ) tawaf keren aur aetikaf mein bethen aur rukoo aur sajda baja layen .
verses.translation: aur woh waqt yaad karo jab hum ney baitullah ko logon  kay liye aesi jagah banaya jiss ki taraf woh lot lot ker jayen aur jo sarapa aman ho .   aur tum maqam-e-Ibrahim ko namaz parhney ki jagah bana lo .   aur hum ney Ibrahim aur Ismail ko yeh takeed ki kay :  tum dono meray ghar ko unn logon  kay liye pak karo jo ( yahan ) tawaf keren aur aetikaf mein bethen aur rukoo aur sajda baja layen .

verses.text: aur ( woh waqt bhi yaad karo ) jab Ibrahim ney kaha tha kay :  aey meray perwerdigar ! iss ko aik pur aman shehar bana dijiye , aur iss kay bashindon mein say jo Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan layen unhen qisam qisam kay phalon say rizq ata farmaiye .  Allah ney kaha :  aur jo kufr ikhtiyar keray ga uss ko bhi mein kuch arsay kay liye lutf uthaney ka moaqa dun ga , ( magar ) phir ussay dozakh kay azab ki taraf kheench ley jaon ga . aur woh bad-tareen thikana hai .
verses.translation: aur ( woh waqt bhi yaad karo ) jab Ibrahim ney kaha tha kay :  aey meray perwerdigar ! iss ko aik pur aman shehar bana dijiye , aur iss kay bashindon mein say jo Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan layen unhen qisam qisam kay phalon say rizq ata farmaiye .  Allah ney kaha :  aur jo kufr ikhtiyar keray ga uss ko bhi mein kuch arsay kay liye lutf uthaney ka moaqa dun ga , ( magar ) phir ussay dozakh kay azab ki taraf kheench ley jaon ga . aur woh bad-tareen thikana hai .

verses.text: aur uss waqt ka tasawwur kero jab Ibrahim baitullah ki buniyaden utha rahey thay ,   aur Ismail bhi ( unn kay sath shareek thay , aur dono yeh kehtay jatay thay kay : )  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum say ( yeh khidmat ) qubool farma ley . beyshak tu , aur sirf tu hi , her aik ki sunney wala , her aik ko janney wala hai .
verses.translation: aur uss waqt ka tasawwur kero jab Ibrahim baitullah ki buniyaden utha rahey thay ,   aur Ismail bhi ( unn kay sath shareek thay , aur dono yeh kehtay jatay thay kay : )  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum say ( yeh khidmat ) qubool farma ley . beyshak tu , aur sirf tu hi , her aik ki sunney wala , her aik ko janney wala hai .

verses.text: aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum dono ko apna mukammal farmanbardaar bana ley , aur humari nasal say bhi aesi ummat peda ker jo teri poori tabey daar ho . aur hum ko humari ibadton kay tareeqay sikha dey , aur humari tauba qubool farma ley . beyshak tu , aur sirf tu hi , moaaf ker-denay ka khoogar ( aur ) bari rehmat ka malik hai .
verses.translation: aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum dono ko apna mukammal farmanbardaar bana ley , aur humari nasal say bhi aesi ummat peda ker jo teri poori tabey daar ho . aur hum ko humari ibadton kay tareeqay sikha dey , aur humari tauba qubool farma ley . beyshak tu , aur sirf tu hi , moaaf ker-denay ka khoogar ( aur ) bari rehmat ka malik hai .

verses.text: aur humaray perwerdigar ! inn mein aik aisa Rasool bhi bhejna jo inhi mein say ho , jo inn kay samney teri aayaton ki tilawat keray , enhen kitab aur hikmat ki taleem dey , aur inn ko pakeezah banaye .   beyshak teri , aur sirf teri , zaat woh hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .
verses.translation: aur humaray perwerdigar ! inn mein aik aisa Rasool bhi bhejna jo inhi mein say ho , jo inn kay samney teri aayaton ki tilawat keray , enhen kitab aur hikmat ki taleem dey , aur inn ko pakeezah banaye .   beyshak teri , aur sirf teri , zaat woh hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .

verses.text: aur kon hai jo Ibrahim kay tareeqay say inehraaf keray-? siwaye uss shaks kay jo khud apney aap ko himaqat mein mubtala ker-chuka ho ! haqeeqat to yeh hai kay hum ney duniya mein unhen ( apney liye ) chunn liya tha , aur aakhirat mein unn ka shumar sualeheen mein hoga .
verses.translation: aur kon hai jo Ibrahim kay tareeqay say inehraaf keray-? siwaye uss shaks kay jo khud apney aap ko himaqat mein mubtala ker-chuka ho ! haqeeqat to yeh hai kay hum ney duniya mein unhen ( apney liye ) chunn liya tha , aur aakhirat mein unn ka shumar sualeheen mein hoga .

verses.text: jab unn kay perwerdigar ney unn say kaha kay :  sar-e-tasleem kham kerdo !    to woh ( foran ) bolay :  mein ney Rabb-ul-Aalameen kay ( her hukum kay ) aagay sar jhuka diya .
verses.translation: jab unn kay perwerdigar ney unn say kaha kay :  sar-e-tasleem kham kerdo !    to woh ( foran ) bolay :  mein ney Rabb-ul-Aalameen kay ( her hukum kay ) aagay sar jhuka diya .

verses.text: aur issi baat ki Ibrahim ney apney beton ko wasiyyat ki , aur Yaqoob ney bhi ( apney beton ko ) kay :  aey meray beto ! Allah ney yeh deen tumharay liye muntakhib farma liya hai , lehaza tumhen moat bhi aaye to iss halat mein aaye kay tum muslim ho .
verses.translation: aur issi baat ki Ibrahim ney apney beton ko wasiyyat ki , aur Yaqoob ney bhi ( apney beton ko ) kay :  aey meray beto ! Allah ney yeh deen tumharay liye muntakhib farma liya hai , lehaza tumhen moat bhi aaye to iss halat mein aaye kay tum muslim ho .

verses.text: kiya uss waqt tum khud mojood thay jab Yaqoob ki moat ka waqt aaya tha ,   jab unhon ney apney beton say kaha tha kay tum meray baad kiss ki ibadat kero gay-? unn sabb ney kaha tha kay : hum ussi aik khuda ki ibadat keren gay jo aap ka mabood hai aur aap kay baap dadon Ibrahim , Ismail aur Ishaq ka mabood hai . aur hum sirf ussi kay farmanbardaar hain .
verses.translation: kiya uss waqt tum khud mojood thay jab Yaqoob ki moat ka waqt aaya tha ,   jab unhon ney apney beton say kaha tha kay tum meray baad kiss ki ibadat kero gay-? unn sabb ney kaha tha kay : hum ussi aik khuda ki ibadat keren gay jo aap ka mabood hai aur aap kay baap dadon Ibrahim , Ismail aur Ishaq ka mabood hai . aur hum sirf ussi kay farmanbardaar hain .

verses.text: woh aik ummat thi jo guzar gaee . jo kuch unhon ney kamaya woh unn ka hai , aur jo kuch tum ney kamaya woh tumhara hai , aur tum say yeh nahi poocha jaye ga kay woh kiya amal kertay thay .
verses.translation: woh aik ummat thi jo guzar gaee . jo kuch unhon ney kamaya woh unn ka hai , aur jo kuch tum ney kamaya woh tumhara hai , aur tum say yeh nahi poocha jaye ga kay woh kiya amal kertay thay .

verses.text: aur yeh ( yahudi aur essai musalmanon say ) kehtay hain kay :  tum yahudi ya essai hojao , raah-e-raast per aajao gay .  keh do kay :  nahi , balkay ( hum to ) Ibrahim kay deen ki perwi keren gay jo theek theek seedhi raah per thay , aur woh unn logon  mein say naa thay jo Allah kay sath kissi ko shareek thehratay hain .
verses.translation: aur yeh ( yahudi aur essai musalmanon say ) kehtay hain kay :  tum yahudi ya essai hojao , raah-e-raast per aajao gay .  keh do kay :  nahi , balkay ( hum to ) Ibrahim kay deen ki perwi keren gay jo theek theek seedhi raah per thay , aur woh unn logon  mein say naa thay jo Allah kay sath kissi ko shareek thehratay hain .

verses.text: . ( musalmano ) keh do kay :  hum Allah per emaan laye hain , aur uss kalam per bhi jo hum per utaara gaya aur uss per bhi jo Ibrahim , Ismail , Ishaq , Yaqoob aur unn ki aulad per utaara gaya , aur uss per bhi jo musa aur essa ko diya gaya aur uss per bhi jo doosray payghumberon ko unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say ata huwa . hum unn payghumberon kay darmiyan koi tafreeq nahi kertay , aur hum ussi ( aik khuda ) kay tabey farman hain .
verses.translation: . ( musalmano ) keh do kay :  hum Allah per emaan laye hain , aur uss kalam per bhi jo hum per utaara gaya aur uss per bhi jo Ibrahim , Ismail , Ishaq , Yaqoob aur unn ki aulad per utaara gaya , aur uss per bhi jo musa aur essa ko diya gaya aur uss per bhi jo doosray payghumberon ko unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say ata huwa . hum unn payghumberon kay darmiyan koi tafreeq nahi kertay , aur hum ussi ( aik khuda ) kay tabey farman hain .

verses.text: iss kay baad agar yeh log bhi issi tarah emaan ley ayen jaisay tum emaan laye ho to yeh raah-e-raast per aajayen gay . aur agar yeh mun morr len to dar-haqeeqat woh dushmani mein parr-gaye hain . abb Allah tumhari himayat mein unqareeb unn say nimat ley ga , aur woh her baat sunney wala , her baat janney wala hai .
verses.translation: iss kay baad agar yeh log bhi issi tarah emaan ley ayen jaisay tum emaan laye ho to yeh raah-e-raast per aajayen gay . aur agar yeh mun morr len to dar-haqeeqat woh dushmani mein parr-gaye hain . abb Allah tumhari himayat mein unqareeb unn say nimat ley ga , aur woh her baat sunney wala , her baat janney wala hai .

verses.text: . ( aey musalmano ! keh do kay : )  hum per to Allah ney apna rang charha diya hai , aur kon hai jo Allah say behtar rang charrhaye-? aur hum sirf ussi ki ibadat kertay hain .
verses.translation: . ( aey musalmano ! keh do kay : )  hum per to Allah ney apna rang charha diya hai , aur kon hai jo Allah say behtar rang charrhaye-? aur hum sirf ussi ki ibadat kertay hain .

verses.text: keh do kay :  kiya tum hum say Allah kay baaray mein hujjat kertay ho-? halankay woh humara bhi perwerdigar hai aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar . ( yeh ) aur ( baat hai kay ) humaray aemal humaray liye hain , aur tumharay amal tumharay liye . aur hum ney to apni bandagi ussi kay liye khalis kerli hai .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  kiya tum hum say Allah kay baaray mein hujjat kertay ho-? halankay woh humara bhi perwerdigar hai aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar . ( yeh ) aur ( baat hai kay ) humaray aemal humaray liye hain , aur tumharay amal tumharay liye . aur hum ney to apni bandagi ussi kay liye khalis kerli hai .

verses.text: bhala kiya tum yeh kehtay ho kay Ibrahim , Ismail , Ishaq , Yaqoob aur unn ki auladen yahudi ya nasrani then-? ( aey payghumber ! unn say ) kaho : kiya tum ziyada jantay ho ya Allah-? aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo aesi shahadat ko chupaye jo uss kay paas Allah ki taraf say phonchi ho-?   aur jo kuch tum kertay ho Allah uss say bey khabar nahi hai .
verses.translation: bhala kiya tum yeh kehtay ho kay Ibrahim , Ismail , Ishaq , Yaqoob aur unn ki auladen yahudi ya nasrani then-? ( aey payghumber ! unn say ) kaho : kiya tum ziyada jantay ho ya Allah-? aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo aesi shahadat ko chupaye jo uss kay paas Allah ki taraf say phonchi ho-?   aur jo kuch tum kertay ho Allah uss say bey khabar nahi hai .

verses.text: . ( baharhal ! ) woh aik ummat thi jo guzar gaee . jo kuch unhon ney kamaya woh inn/unn ka hai , aur jo kuch tum ney kamaya , woh tumhara hai , aur tum say yeh nahi poocha jaye ga kay woh kiya amal kertay thay-?
verses.translation: . ( baharhal ! ) woh aik ummat thi jo guzar gaee . jo kuch unhon ney kamaya woh inn/unn ka hai , aur jo kuch tum ney kamaya , woh tumhara hai , aur tum say yeh nahi poocha jaye ga kay woh kiya amal kertay thay-?

verses.text: abb yeh beywaqoof log kahen gay kay aakhir woh kiya cheez hai jiss ney inn ( musalmanon ) ko uss qiblay say rukh pherney per aamada kerdiya jiss ki taraf woh mun kertay chalay aarahey thay-? aap keh dijiye kay mashriq aur maghrib sabb Allah hi ki hain . woh jiss ko chahta hai seedhi raah ki hidayat ker deta hai
verses.translation: abb yeh beywaqoof log kahen gay kay aakhir woh kiya cheez hai jiss ney inn ( musalmanon ) ko uss qiblay say rukh pherney per aamada kerdiya jiss ki taraf woh mun kertay chalay aarahey thay-? aap keh dijiye kay mashriq aur maghrib sabb Allah hi ki hain . woh jiss ko chahta hai seedhi raah ki hidayat ker deta hai

verses.text: aur ( musalmano ! ) issi tarah to hum ney tum ko aik moatadil ummat banaya hai takay tum doosray logon  per gawah bano , aur Rasool tum per gawah banay .   aur jiss qiblay per tum pehlay kaar band thay , ussay hum ney kissi aur wajeh say nahi , balkay sirf yeh dekhney kay liye muqarrar kiya tha kay kon Rasool ka hukum manta hai aur kon ultay paon phir jata hai ?   aur iss mein shak nahi kay yeh baat thi bari mushkil , lekin unn logon  kay liye ( zara bhi mushkil naa hoi ) jinn ko Allah ney hidayat dey di thi . aur Allah taalaa aisa nahi kay tumharay emaan ko zaya kerday .   dar-haqeeqat Allah logon  per boht shafqat kernay wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: aur ( musalmano ! ) issi tarah to hum ney tum ko aik moatadil ummat banaya hai takay tum doosray logon  per gawah bano , aur Rasool tum per gawah banay .   aur jiss qiblay per tum pehlay kaar band thay , ussay hum ney kissi aur wajeh say nahi , balkay sirf yeh dekhney kay liye muqarrar kiya tha kay kon Rasool ka hukum manta hai aur kon ultay paon phir jata hai ?   aur iss mein shak nahi kay yeh baat thi bari mushkil , lekin unn logon  kay liye ( zara bhi mushkil naa hoi ) jinn ko Allah ney hidayat dey di thi . aur Allah taalaa aisa nahi kay tumharay emaan ko zaya kerday .   dar-haqeeqat Allah logon  per boht shafqat kernay wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) hum tumharay chehray ko baar baar aasman ki taraf uthtay huye dekh rahey hain . chunacheh hum tumhara rukh zaroor uss qiblay ki taraf pher den gay jo tumhen pasand hai .   lo abb apna rukh masjid-e-haram ki samt kerlo . aur ( aaenda ) jahan kahen tum ho apney chehron ka rukh ( namaz parhtay huye ) ussi ki taraf rakha kero . aur jinn logon  ko kitab di gaee hai woh khoob jantay hain kay yehi baat haq hai jo unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say aai hai .   aur jo kuch yeh ker rahey hain Allah uss say ghafil nahi hai .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) hum tumharay chehray ko baar baar aasman ki taraf uthtay huye dekh rahey hain . chunacheh hum tumhara rukh zaroor uss qiblay ki taraf pher den gay jo tumhen pasand hai .   lo abb apna rukh masjid-e-haram ki samt kerlo . aur ( aaenda ) jahan kahen tum ho apney chehron ka rukh ( namaz parhtay huye ) ussi ki taraf rakha kero . aur jinn logon  ko kitab di gaee hai woh khoob jantay hain kay yehi baat haq hai jo unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say aai hai .   aur jo kuch yeh ker rahey hain Allah uss say ghafil nahi hai .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ko kitab di gaee thi agar tum unn kay paas her qisam ki nishaniyan ley aao tab bhi yeh tumharay qiblay ki perwi nahi keren gay . aur naa tum unn kay qiblay per amal kernay walay ho , naa yeh aik doosray kay qiblay per amal kernay walay hain .   aur jo ilm tumharay paas aa-chuka hai uss kay baad agar kahen tum ney inn ki khuwaishaat ki perwi kerli to uss soorat mein yaqeenan tumhara shumar zalimon mein hoga .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ko kitab di gaee thi agar tum unn kay paas her qisam ki nishaniyan ley aao tab bhi yeh tumharay qiblay ki perwi nahi keren gay . aur naa tum unn kay qiblay per amal kernay walay ho , naa yeh aik doosray kay qiblay per amal kernay walay hain .   aur jo ilm tumharay paas aa-chuka hai uss kay baad agar kahen tum ney inn ki khuwaishaat ki perwi kerli to uss soorat mein yaqeenan tumhara shumar zalimon mein hoga .

verses.text: jinn logon  ko hum ney kitab di hai woh uss ko itni achi tarah pehchantay hain jaisay apney beton ko pehchantay hain .   aur yaqeen jano kay unn mein say kuch logon  ney haq ko jaan bojh ker chupa rakha hai .
verses.translation: jinn logon  ko hum ney kitab di hai woh uss ko itni achi tarah pehchantay hain jaisay apney beton ko pehchantay hain .   aur yaqeen jano kay unn mein say kuch logon  ney haq ko jaan bojh ker chupa rakha hai .

verses.text: aur haq wohi hai jo tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aaya hai , lehaza shak kernay walon mein hergiz shamil naa hojana .
verses.translation: aur haq wohi hai jo tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aaya hai , lehaza shak kernay walon mein hergiz shamil naa hojana .

verses.text: aur her giroh ki aik samt hai jiss ki taraf woh rukh kerta hai . lehaza tum naik kamon mein aik doosray say aagay barhney ki koshish kero . tum jahan bhi hogay , Allah tum sabb ko ( apney paas ) ley aaye ga .   yaqeenan Allah her cheez per qadir hai .
verses.translation: aur her giroh ki aik samt hai jiss ki taraf woh rukh kerta hai . lehaza tum naik kamon mein aik doosray say aagay barhney ki koshish kero . tum jahan bhi hogay , Allah tum sabb ko ( apney paas ) ley aaye ga .   yaqeenan Allah her cheez per qadir hai .

verses.text: aur tum jahan say bhi ( safar kay liye ) niklo , apna mun ( namaz kay waqt ) masjid-e-haram ki taraf kero . aur yaqeenan yehi baat haq hai jo tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aai hai .   aur jo kuch tum kertay ho Allah uss say bey khabar nahi hai .
verses.translation: aur tum jahan say bhi ( safar kay liye ) niklo , apna mun ( namaz kay waqt ) masjid-e-haram ki taraf kero . aur yaqeenan yehi baat haq hai jo tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aai hai .   aur jo kuch tum kertay ho Allah uss say bey khabar nahi hai .

verses.text: aur jahan say bhi tum niklo , apna mun masjid-e-haram ki taraf kero . aur tum jahan kahen ho , apney chehray ussi ki taraf rakho , takay logon  ko tumharay khilaf hujjat bazi ka moaqa naa milay   albatta unn mein jo log zulm kay khoogar hain , ( woh kabhi khamosh naa hon gay ) so unn ka kuch khof naa rakho , haan mera khof rakho aur takay mein tum per apna inaam mukammal kerdun aur takay tum hidayat hasil kerlo .
verses.translation: aur jahan say bhi tum niklo , apna mun masjid-e-haram ki taraf kero . aur tum jahan kahen ho , apney chehray ussi ki taraf rakho , takay logon  ko tumharay khilaf hujjat bazi ka moaqa naa milay   albatta unn mein jo log zulm kay khoogar hain , ( woh kabhi khamosh naa hon gay ) so unn ka kuch khof naa rakho , haan mera khof rakho aur takay mein tum per apna inaam mukammal kerdun aur takay tum hidayat hasil kerlo .

verses.text: . ( yeh inaam aisa hi hai ) jaisay hum ney tumharay darmiyan tum hi mein say aik Rasool bheja jo tumharay samney humari aayaton ki tilawat kerta hai , aur tumhen pakeezah banata hai , aur tumhen kitab aur hikmat ki taleem deta hai ,   aur tumhen woh baaten sikhata hai jo tum nahi jantay thay .
verses.translation: . ( yeh inaam aisa hi hai ) jaisay hum ney tumharay darmiyan tum hi mein say aik Rasool bheja jo tumharay samney humari aayaton ki tilawat kerta hai , aur tumhen pakeezah banata hai , aur tumhen kitab aur hikmat ki taleem deta hai ,   aur tumhen woh baaten sikhata hai jo tum nahi jantay thay .

verses.text: lehaza mujhay yaad kero , mein tumhen yaad rakhun ga . aur mera shukar ada kero , aur meri nashukri naa kero .
verses.translation: lehaza mujhay yaad kero , mein tumhen yaad rakhun ga . aur mera shukar ada kero , aur meri nashukri naa kero .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! sabar aur namaz say madad hasil kero .   beyshak Allah sabar kernay walon kay sath hai
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! sabar aur namaz say madad hasil kero .   beyshak Allah sabar kernay walon kay sath hai

verses.text: aur jo log Allah kay raastay mein qatal hon unn ko murda naa kaho . darasal woh zinda hain , magar tum ko ( unn ki zindagi ka ) ehsas nahi hota
verses.translation: aur jo log Allah kay raastay mein qatal hon unn ko murda naa kaho . darasal woh zinda hain , magar tum ko ( unn ki zindagi ka ) ehsas nahi hota

verses.text: aur dekho hum tumhen aazmayen gay zaroor , ( kabhi ) khof say , aur ( kabhi ) bhook say , aur ( kabhi ) maal o jaan aur phalon mein kami ker kay . aur jo log ( aesay halaat mein ) sabar say kaam len unn ko khushkhabri suna do .
verses.translation: aur dekho hum tumhen aazmayen gay zaroor , ( kabhi ) khof say , aur ( kabhi ) bhook say , aur ( kabhi ) maal o jaan aur phalon mein kami ker kay . aur jo log ( aesay halaat mein ) sabar say kaam len unn ko khushkhabri suna do .

verses.text: yeh woh log hain kay jab inn ko koi museebat phonchti hai to yeh kehtay hain kay   hum sabb Allah hi kay hain aur hum ko Allah hi ki taraf lot ker jana hai
verses.translation: yeh woh log hain kay jab inn ko koi museebat phonchti hai to yeh kehtay hain kay   hum sabb Allah hi kay hain aur hum ko Allah hi ki taraf lot ker jana hai

verses.text: yeh woh log hain jinn per unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say khusoosi inayaten hain , aur rehmat hai . aur yehi log hain jo hidayat per hain .
verses.translation: yeh woh log hain jinn per unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say khusoosi inayaten hain , aur rehmat hai . aur yehi log hain jo hidayat per hain .

verses.text: beyshak safa aur marwa Allah ki nishaniyon mein say hain . lehaza jo shaks bhi baitullah ka hajj keray ya umrah keray to uss kay liye iss baat mein koi gunah nahi hai kay woh unn kay darmiyan chakkar lagaye .   aur jo shaks khushi say koi bhalai ka kaam keray to Allah yaqeenan qadar daan ( aur ) janney wala hai .
verses.translation: beyshak safa aur marwa Allah ki nishaniyon mein say hain . lehaza jo shaks bhi baitullah ka hajj keray ya umrah keray to uss kay liye iss baat mein koi gunah nahi hai kay woh unn kay darmiyan chakkar lagaye .   aur jo shaks khushi say koi bhalai ka kaam keray to Allah yaqeenan qadar daan ( aur ) janney wala hai .

verses.text: beyshak woh log jo humari nazil ki hoi roshan daleelon aur hidayat ko chupatay hain , bawajood-yeh-kay hum unhen kitab mein khol khol ker logon  kay liye biyan ker-chukay hain ,   to aesay logon  per Allah bhi lanat bhejta hai aur doosray lanat kernay walay bhi lanat bhejtay hain
verses.translation: beyshak woh log jo humari nazil ki hoi roshan daleelon aur hidayat ko chupatay hain , bawajood-yeh-kay hum unhen kitab mein khol khol ker logon  kay liye biyan ker-chukay hain ,   to aesay logon  per Allah bhi lanat bhejta hai aur doosray lanat kernay walay bhi lanat bhejtay hain

verses.text: haan woh log jinhon ney tauba kerli ho aur apni islaah kerli ho aur ( chupai hoi baaton ko ) khol khol ker biyan kerdiya ho to mein aesay logon  ki tauba qubool kerleta hun . aur mein tauba qubool kernay ka khoogar hun , bara rehmat wala
verses.translation: haan woh log jinhon ney tauba kerli ho aur apni islaah kerli ho aur ( chupai hoi baaton ko ) khol khol ker biyan kerdiya ho to mein aesay logon  ki tauba qubool kerleta hun . aur mein tauba qubool kernay ka khoogar hun , bara rehmat wala

verses.text: beyshak woh log jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya aur kafir honey ki halat hi mein maray , unn per Allah ki aur farishton ki aur saray insanon ki lanat hai
verses.translation: beyshak woh log jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya aur kafir honey ki halat hi mein maray , unn per Allah ki aur farishton ki aur saray insanon ki lanat hai

verses.text: woh hamesha issi phitkaar mein rahen gay . naa unn per say azab ko halka kiya jaye ga , aur naa unn ko mohlat di jaye gi
verses.translation: woh hamesha issi phitkaar mein rahen gay . naa unn per say azab ko halka kiya jaye ga , aur naa unn ko mohlat di jaye gi

verses.text: tumhara khuda aik hi khuda hai . uss kay siwa koi khuda nahi jo sabb per meharban , boht meharban hai .
verses.translation: tumhara khuda aik hi khuda hai . uss kay siwa koi khuda nahi jo sabb per meharban , boht meharban hai .

verses.text: beyshak aasmano aur zameen ki takhleeq mein , raat din kay lagataar aaney janey mein , unn kashtiyon mein jo logon  kay faeeday ka saman leyker samandar mein terti hain , uss paani mein jo Allah ney aasman say utaara aur uss kay zariye zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad zindagi bakhshi aur uss mein her qisam kay janwer phela diye , aur hawaon ki gardish mein , aur unn badalon mein jo aasman aur zameen kay darmiyan tabey daar ban ker kaam mein lagay hoye hain , unn logon  kay liye nishaniyan hi nishaniyan hain jo apni aqal say kaam letay hain .
verses.translation: beyshak aasmano aur zameen ki takhleeq mein , raat din kay lagataar aaney janey mein , unn kashtiyon mein jo logon  kay faeeday ka saman leyker samandar mein terti hain , uss paani mein jo Allah ney aasman say utaara aur uss kay zariye zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad zindagi bakhshi aur uss mein her qisam kay janwer phela diye , aur hawaon ki gardish mein , aur unn badalon mein jo aasman aur zameen kay darmiyan tabey daar ban ker kaam mein lagay hoye hain , unn logon  kay liye nishaniyan hi nishaniyan hain jo apni aqal say kaam letay hain .

verses.text: aur ( iss kay bawajood ) logon  mein kuch woh bhi hain jo Allah kay ilawa doosron ko uss ki khudai mein iss tarah shareek qarar detay hain kay unn say aesi mohabbat rakhtay hain jaisay Allah ki mohabbat ( rakhni chahiye ) . aur jo log emaan laa-chukay hain woh Allah hi say sabb say ziyada mohabbat rakhtay hain . aur kaash kay yeh zalim jab ( duniya mein ) koi takleef dekhtay hain ussi waqt yeh samajh liya keren kay tamam tarr taqat Allah hi ko hasil hai , aur yeh kay Allah ka azab ( aakhirat mein ) uss waqt bara sakht hoga .
verses.translation: aur ( iss kay bawajood ) logon  mein kuch woh bhi hain jo Allah kay ilawa doosron ko uss ki khudai mein iss tarah shareek qarar detay hain kay unn say aesi mohabbat rakhtay hain jaisay Allah ki mohabbat ( rakhni chahiye ) . aur jo log emaan laa-chukay hain woh Allah hi say sabb say ziyada mohabbat rakhtay hain . aur kaash kay yeh zalim jab ( duniya mein ) koi takleef dekhtay hain ussi waqt yeh samajh liya keren kay tamam tarr taqat Allah hi ko hasil hai , aur yeh kay Allah ka azab ( aakhirat mein ) uss waqt bara sakht hoga .

verses.text: jab woh ( peshwa ) jinn kay peechay yeh log chaltay rahey hain , apney perokaaron say mukammal bey talluqi ka aelaan keren gay , aur yeh sabb log azab ko apni aankhon kay samney dekh len gay , aur inn kay tamam bahami rishtay katt ker reh jayen gay
verses.translation: jab woh ( peshwa ) jinn kay peechay yeh log chaltay rahey hain , apney perokaaron say mukammal bey talluqi ka aelaan keren gay , aur yeh sabb log azab ko apni aankhon kay samney dekh len gay , aur inn kay tamam bahami rishtay katt ker reh jayen gay

verses.text: aur jinhon ney inn ( peshwaon ) ki perwi ki thi woh kahen gay kay kaash hamen aik martaba phir ( duniya mein ) loattney ka moaqa dey diya jaye , to hum bhi inn ( peshwaon ) say issi tarah bey talluqi ka aelaan keren jaisay unhon ney hum say bey talluqi ka aelaan kiya hai . iss tarah Allah enhen dikha dey ga kay inn kay aemal ( aaj ) inn kay liye hasrat hi hasrat ban chukay hain , aur abb woh kissi soorat dozakh say nikalney walay nahi hain .
verses.translation: aur jinhon ney inn ( peshwaon ) ki perwi ki thi woh kahen gay kay kaash hamen aik martaba phir ( duniya mein ) loattney ka moaqa dey diya jaye , to hum bhi inn ( peshwaon ) say issi tarah bey talluqi ka aelaan keren jaisay unhon ney hum say bey talluqi ka aelaan kiya hai . iss tarah Allah enhen dikha dey ga kay inn kay aemal ( aaj ) inn kay liye hasrat hi hasrat ban chukay hain , aur abb woh kissi soorat dozakh say nikalney walay nahi hain .

verses.text: aey logo ! zameen mein jo halal pakeezah cheezen hain woh khao ,   aur shetan kay naqsh-e-qadam per naa chalo . yaqeen jano kay woh tumharay liye aik khula dushman hai
verses.translation: aey logo ! zameen mein jo halal pakeezah cheezen hain woh khao ,   aur shetan kay naqsh-e-qadam per naa chalo . yaqeen jano kay woh tumharay liye aik khula dushman hai

verses.text: woh to tum ko yehi hukum dey ga kay tum badi aur bey hayai kay kaam kero aur Allah kay zimmay woh baaten lagao jinn ka tumhen ilm nahi hai .
verses.translation: woh to tum ko yehi hukum dey ga kay tum badi aur bey hayai kay kaam kero aur Allah kay zimmay woh baaten lagao jinn ka tumhen ilm nahi hai .

verses.text: aur jab inn ( kafiron ) say kaha jata hai kay uss kalam ki perwi kero jo Allah ney utaara hai , to woh kehtay hain kay nahi ! hum to unn baaton ki perwi keren gay jinn per hum ney apney baap dadon ko paya hai . bhala kiya uss soorat mein bhi ( inn ko yehi chahiye ) jab unn kay baap daday ( deen ki ) zara bhi samajh naa rakhtay hon , aur unhon ney koi ( aasmani ) hidayat bhi hasil naa ki ho-?
verses.translation: aur jab inn ( kafiron ) say kaha jata hai kay uss kalam ki perwi kero jo Allah ney utaara hai , to woh kehtay hain kay nahi ! hum to unn baaton ki perwi keren gay jinn per hum ney apney baap dadon ko paya hai . bhala kiya uss soorat mein bhi ( inn ko yehi chahiye ) jab unn kay baap daday ( deen ki ) zara bhi samajh naa rakhtay hon , aur unhon ney koi ( aasmani ) hidayat bhi hasil naa ki ho-?

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr ko apna liya hai unn ( ko haq ki dawat denay ) ki misal kuch aesi hai jaisay koi shaks unn ( janweron ) ko zor zor say bulaye jo haank pukar kay siwa kuch nahi suntay . yeh behray , goongay andhay hain , lehaza kuch nahi samajhtay .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr ko apna liya hai unn ( ko haq ki dawat denay ) ki misal kuch aesi hai jaisay koi shaks unn ( janweron ) ko zor zor say bulaye jo haank pukar kay siwa kuch nahi suntay . yeh behray , goongay andhay hain , lehaza kuch nahi samajhtay .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! jo pakeezah cheezen hum ney tumhen rizq kay tor per ata ki hain , unn mein say ( jo chahao ) khao , aur Allah ka shukar ada kero , agar waqaee tum sirf ussi ki bandagi kertay ho .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! jo pakeezah cheezen hum ney tumhen rizq kay tor per ata ki hain , unn mein say ( jo chahao ) khao , aur Allah ka shukar ada kero , agar waqaee tum sirf ussi ki bandagi kertay ho .

verses.text: uss ney to tumharay liye bus murdar janwer , khoon , aur soowar haram kiya hai , neez woh janwer jis jiss per Allah kay siwa kissi aur ka naam pukara gaya ho .   haan agar koi shaks intehai majboori ki halat mein ho ( aur unn cheezon mein say kuch kha ley ) jabkay uss ka maqsad naa lazzat hasil kerna ho aur naa woh ( zaroorat ki ) hadd say aagay barhay , to uss per koi gunah nahi . yaqeenan Allah boht bakhshney wala bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: uss ney to tumharay liye bus murdar janwer , khoon , aur soowar haram kiya hai , neez woh janwer jis jiss per Allah kay siwa kissi aur ka naam pukara gaya ho .   haan agar koi shaks intehai majboori ki halat mein ho ( aur unn cheezon mein say kuch kha ley ) jabkay uss ka maqsad naa lazzat hasil kerna ho aur naa woh ( zaroorat ki ) hadd say aagay barhay , to uss per koi gunah nahi . yaqeenan Allah boht bakhshney wala bara meharban hai .

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log Allah ki nazil ki hoi kitab ko chupatay hain aur uss kay badlay thori si qeemat wasool kerletay hain , woh apney pet mein aag kay siwa kuch nahi bhar rahey . qayamat kay din Allah unn say kalam bhi nahi keray ga , aur naa unn ko pak keray ga , aur unn kay liye dardnak azab hai
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log Allah ki nazil ki hoi kitab ko chupatay hain aur uss kay badlay thori si qeemat wasool kerletay hain , woh apney pet mein aag kay siwa kuch nahi bhar rahey . qayamat kay din Allah unn say kalam bhi nahi keray ga , aur naa unn ko pak keray ga , aur unn kay liye dardnak azab hai

verses.text: yeh woh log hain jinhon ney hidayat kay badlay gumrahi , aur maghfirat kay badlay azab ki khareedaari kerli hai . chunacheh ( andaza kero kay ) yeh dozakh ki aag sehnay kay liye kitney tayyar hain !
verses.translation: yeh woh log hain jinhon ney hidayat kay badlay gumrahi , aur maghfirat kay badlay azab ki khareedaari kerli hai . chunacheh ( andaza kero kay ) yeh dozakh ki aag sehnay kay liye kitney tayyar hain !

verses.text: yeh sabb kuch iss liye hoga kay Allah ney haq per mushtamil kitab utaari hai , aur jinn logon  ney aesi kitab kay baaray mein mukhalifat ka ravaiyya ikhtiyar kiya hai woh zida ziddi mein boht door nikal gaye hain .
verses.translation: yeh sabb kuch iss liye hoga kay Allah ney haq per mushtamil kitab utaari hai , aur jinn logon  ney aesi kitab kay baaray mein mukhalifat ka ravaiyya ikhtiyar kiya hai woh zida ziddi mein boht door nikal gaye hain .

verses.text: naiki bus yehi to nahi hai kay apney chehray mashriq ya maghrib ki taraf kerlo ,   balkay naiki yeh hai kay log Allah per , aakhirat kay din per , farishton per aur Allah ki kitabon aur uss kay nabiyon per emaan layen , aur Allah ki mohabbat mein apna maal rishta daaron , yateemon , miskeeno , musfiron aur saeelon ko den , aur ghulamon ko azad keraney mein kharch keren , aur namaz qaeem keren aur zakat ada keren , aur jab koi ehad kerlen to apney ehad ko poora kernay kay aadi hon , aur tangi aur takleef mein , neez jang kay waqt , sabar o istaqlal kay khoogar hon . aesay log hain jo sachay ( kehlaney kay mustahiq ) hain , aur yehi log hain jo muttaqi hain .
verses.translation: naiki bus yehi to nahi hai kay apney chehray mashriq ya maghrib ki taraf kerlo ,   balkay naiki yeh hai kay log Allah per , aakhirat kay din per , farishton per aur Allah ki kitabon aur uss kay nabiyon per emaan layen , aur Allah ki mohabbat mein apna maal rishta daaron , yateemon , miskeeno , musfiron aur saeelon ko den , aur ghulamon ko azad keraney mein kharch keren , aur namaz qaeem keren aur zakat ada keren , aur jab koi ehad kerlen to apney ehad ko poora kernay kay aadi hon , aur tangi aur takleef mein , neez jang kay waqt , sabar o istaqlal kay khoogar hon . aesay log hain jo sachay ( kehlaney kay mustahiq ) hain , aur yehi log hain jo muttaqi hain .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! jo log ( jaan boojh ker nahaq ) qatal kerdiye jayen unn kay baaray mein tum per qisaas ( ka hukum ) farz kerdiya gaya hai . azad kay badlay azad , ghulam kay badlay ghulam aur aurat kay badlay aurat ( hi ko qatal kiya jaye )   , phir agar qatil ko uss kay bhai ( yani maqtool kay waris ) ki taraf say kuch moaafi dey di jaye   to maroof tareeqay kay mutabiq ( khoon baha ka ) mutalba kerna ( waris ka ) haq hai , aur ussay khush asloobi say ada kerna ( qatil ka ) farz hai . yeh tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik aasani peda ki gaee hai aur aik rehmat hai . iss kay baad bhi koi ziyadti keray to woh dardnak azab ka mustahiq hai
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! jo log ( jaan boojh ker nahaq ) qatal kerdiye jayen unn kay baaray mein tum per qisaas ( ka hukum ) farz kerdiya gaya hai . azad kay badlay azad , ghulam kay badlay ghulam aur aurat kay badlay aurat ( hi ko qatal kiya jaye )   , phir agar qatil ko uss kay bhai ( yani maqtool kay waris ) ki taraf say kuch moaafi dey di jaye   to maroof tareeqay kay mutabiq ( khoon baha ka ) mutalba kerna ( waris ka ) haq hai , aur ussay khush asloobi say ada kerna ( qatil ka ) farz hai . yeh tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik aasani peda ki gaee hai aur aik rehmat hai . iss kay baad bhi koi ziyadti keray to woh dardnak azab ka mustahiq hai

verses.text: aur aey aqal rakhney walo ! tumharay liye qisaas mein zindagi ( ka saman hai ) umeed hai kay tum ( iss ki khilaf warzi say ) bacho gay .
verses.translation: aur aey aqal rakhney walo ! tumharay liye qisaas mein zindagi ( ka saman hai ) umeed hai kay tum ( iss ki khilaf warzi say ) bacho gay .

verses.text: tum per farz kiya gaya hai kay agar tum mein say koi , apney peechay maal chorr ker janey wala ho to jab uss ki moat ka waqt qareeb aajaye , woh apney walaiden aur qareebi rishta daaron kay haq mein dastoor kay mutabiq wasiyyat keray .   yeh muttaqi logon  kay zimmay aik lazimi haq hai
verses.translation: tum per farz kiya gaya hai kay agar tum mein say koi , apney peechay maal chorr ker janey wala ho to jab uss ki moat ka waqt qareeb aajaye , woh apney walaiden aur qareebi rishta daaron kay haq mein dastoor kay mutabiq wasiyyat keray .   yeh muttaqi logon  kay zimmay aik lazimi haq hai

verses.text: phir jo shaks iss wasiyyat ko sunney kay baad uss mein koi tabdeeli keray ga , to uss ka gunah unn logon  per hoga jo uss mein tabdeeli keren gay .   yaqeen rakho kay Allah ( sabb kuch ) sunta janta hai
verses.translation: phir jo shaks iss wasiyyat ko sunney kay baad uss mein koi tabdeeli keray ga , to uss ka gunah unn logon  per hoga jo uss mein tabdeeli keren gay .   yaqeen rakho kay Allah ( sabb kuch ) sunta janta hai

verses.text: haan agar kissi shaks ko yeh andesha ho kay koi wasiyyat kernay wala bey jaa taraf daari ya gunah ka irtikab ker raha hai , aur woh mutalliqa aadmiyon kay darmiyan sulah kera dey to uss per koi gunah nahi .   beyshak Allah taalaa boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: haan agar kissi shaks ko yeh andesha ho kay koi wasiyyat kernay wala bey jaa taraf daari ya gunah ka irtikab ker raha hai , aur woh mutalliqa aadmiyon kay darmiyan sulah kera dey to uss per koi gunah nahi .   beyshak Allah taalaa boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! tum per rozay farz kerdiye gaye hain , jiss tarah tum say pehlay logon  per farz kiye gaye thay , takay tumharay andar taqwa peda ho
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! tum per rozay farz kerdiye gaye hain , jiss tarah tum say pehlay logon  per farz kiye gaye thay , takay tumharay andar taqwa peda ho

verses.text: ginti kay chand din rozay rakhney hain . phir bhi agar tum mein say koi shaks beemar ho ya safar per ho to woh doosray dino mein itni hi tadaad poori kerlay . aur jo log iss ki taqat rakhtay hon woh aik miskeen ko khana khila ker ( rozay ka ) fidya ada kerden   iss kay ilawa agar koi shaks apni khushi say koi naiki keray to yeh uss kay haq mein behtar hai . aur agar tum ko samajh ho to rozay rakhney mein tumharay liye ziyada behtari hai
verses.translation: ginti kay chand din rozay rakhney hain . phir bhi agar tum mein say koi shaks beemar ho ya safar per ho to woh doosray dino mein itni hi tadaad poori kerlay . aur jo log iss ki taqat rakhtay hon woh aik miskeen ko khana khila ker ( rozay ka ) fidya ada kerden   iss kay ilawa agar koi shaks apni khushi say koi naiki keray to yeh uss kay haq mein behtar hai . aur agar tum ko samajh ho to rozay rakhney mein tumharay liye ziyada behtari hai

verses.text: ramzan ka maheena woh hai jiss mein Quran nazil kiya gaya jo logon  kay liye sarapa hidayat , aur aesi roshan nishaniyon ka hamil hai jo sahih raasta dikhati aur haq o batil kay darmiyan do tok faisla ker-deti hain , lehaza tum mein say jo shaks bhi yeh maheena paye , woh iss mein zaroor roza rakhay . aur agar koi shaks beemar ho ya safar per ho to woh doosray dino mein itni hi tadaad poori kerlay . Allah tumharay sath aasani ka moamla kerna chahta hai , aur tumharay liye mushkil peda kerna nahi chahta , takay ( tum rozon ki ) ginti poori kerlo , aur Allah ney tumhen jo raah dikhai uss per Allah ki takbeer kaho ,   aur takay tum shukar guzaar bano .
verses.translation: ramzan ka maheena woh hai jiss mein Quran nazil kiya gaya jo logon  kay liye sarapa hidayat , aur aesi roshan nishaniyon ka hamil hai jo sahih raasta dikhati aur haq o batil kay darmiyan do tok faisla ker-deti hain , lehaza tum mein say jo shaks bhi yeh maheena paye , woh iss mein zaroor roza rakhay . aur agar koi shaks beemar ho ya safar per ho to woh doosray dino mein itni hi tadaad poori kerlay . Allah tumharay sath aasani ka moamla kerna chahta hai , aur tumharay liye mushkil peda kerna nahi chahta , takay ( tum rozon ki ) ginti poori kerlo , aur Allah ney tumhen jo raah dikhai uss per Allah ki takbeer kaho ,   aur takay tum shukar guzaar bano .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab meray banday aap say meray baaray mein poochen to ( aap unn say keh dijiye kay ) mein itna qareeb hun kay jab koi mujhay pukarta hai to mein pukarney walay ki pukar sunta hun .   lehaza woh bhi meri baat dil say qubool keren , aur mujh per emaan layen , takay woh raah-e-raast per aajayen .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab meray banday aap say meray baaray mein poochen to ( aap unn say keh dijiye kay ) mein itna qareeb hun kay jab koi mujhay pukarta hai to mein pukarney walay ki pukar sunta hun .   lehaza woh bhi meri baat dil say qubool keren , aur mujh per emaan layen , takay woh raah-e-raast per aajayen .

verses.text: tumharay liye halal kerdiya gaya hai kay rozon ki raat mein tum apni biwiyon say bey takalluf sohbat kero . woh tumharay liye libas hain , aur tum unn kay liye libas ho . Allah ko ilm tha kay tum apney aap say khayanat ker rahey thay , phir uss ney tum per inayat ki aur tumhari ghalati moaaf farma-di ,   chunacheh abb tum unn say sohbat kerliya kero , aur jo kuch Allah ney tumharay liye likh rakha hai ussay talab kero ,   aur uss waqt tak khao piyo jab tak subha ki safaid dhaari siyah dhaari say mumtaz ho ker tum per wazeh ( naa ) hojaye . uss kay baad raat aaney tak rozay pooray kero . aur inn ( apni biwiyon ) say uss halat mein mubashrat naa kero jab tum masjidon mein aetikaf mein bethay ho . yeh Allah ki ( muqarrar ki hoi ) hudood hain , lehaza inn ( ki khilaf warzi ) kay qareeb bhi matt jana . issi tarah Allah apni nishaniyan logon  kay samney khol khol ker biyan kerta hai , takay woh taqwa ikhtiyar keren .
verses.translation: tumharay liye halal kerdiya gaya hai kay rozon ki raat mein tum apni biwiyon say bey takalluf sohbat kero . woh tumharay liye libas hain , aur tum unn kay liye libas ho . Allah ko ilm tha kay tum apney aap say khayanat ker rahey thay , phir uss ney tum per inayat ki aur tumhari ghalati moaaf farma-di ,   chunacheh abb tum unn say sohbat kerliya kero , aur jo kuch Allah ney tumharay liye likh rakha hai ussay talab kero ,   aur uss waqt tak khao piyo jab tak subha ki safaid dhaari siyah dhaari say mumtaz ho ker tum per wazeh ( naa ) hojaye . uss kay baad raat aaney tak rozay pooray kero . aur inn ( apni biwiyon ) say uss halat mein mubashrat naa kero jab tum masjidon mein aetikaf mein bethay ho . yeh Allah ki ( muqarrar ki hoi ) hudood hain , lehaza inn ( ki khilaf warzi ) kay qareeb bhi matt jana . issi tarah Allah apni nishaniyan logon  kay samney khol khol ker biyan kerta hai , takay woh taqwa ikhtiyar keren .

verses.text: aur aapas mein aik doosray ka maal nahaq tareeqon say naa khao , aur naa unn ka muqadma hakimon kay paas iss gharz say ley jao kay logon  kay maal ka koi hissa jantay boojhtay harrap kernay ka gunah kero .
verses.translation: aur aapas mein aik doosray ka maal nahaq tareeqon say naa khao , aur naa unn ka muqadma hakimon kay paas iss gharz say ley jao kay logon  kay maal ka koi hissa jantay boojhtay harrap kernay ka gunah kero .

verses.text:
log aap say naye maheenon kay chaand kay baaray mein poochtay hain . aap unhen bata dijiye kay yeh logon  kay ( mukhtalif moamlaat kay ) aur hajj kay oqaat mutayyan kernay kay liye hain .  
  aur yeh koi naiki nahi hai kay tum gharon mein unn ki pusht ki taraf say dakhil ho ,   balkay naiki yeh hai kay insan taqwa ikhtiyar keray , aur tum gharon mein unn kay darwazon say dakhil huwa kero , aur Allah say dartay raho , takay tumhen falah hasil ho .
verses.translation:
log aap say naye maheenon kay chaand kay baaray mein poochtay hain . aap unhen bata dijiye kay yeh logon  kay ( mukhtalif moamlaat kay ) aur hajj kay oqaat mutayyan kernay kay liye hain .  
  aur yeh koi naiki nahi hai kay tum gharon mein unn ki pusht ki taraf say dakhil ho ,   balkay naiki yeh hai kay insan taqwa ikhtiyar keray , aur tum gharon mein unn kay darwazon say dakhil huwa kero , aur Allah say dartay raho , takay tumhen falah hasil ho .

verses.text: aur unn logon  say Allah kay raastay mein jang kero jo tum say jang kertay hain , aur ziyadti naa kero . yaqeen jano kay Allah ziyadti kernay walon ko pasand nahi kerta .
verses.translation: aur unn logon  say Allah kay raastay mein jang kero jo tum say jang kertay hain , aur ziyadti naa kero . yaqeen jano kay Allah ziyadti kernay walon ko pasand nahi kerta .

verses.text: aur tum unn logon  ko jahan pao qatal kero , aur unhen uss jagah say nikal bahir kero jahan say unhon ney tumhen nikala tha . aur fitna qatal say ziyada sangeen burai hai .   aur tum unn say masjid-e-haram kay paas uss waqt tak larraee naa kero jab tak woh khud uss mein tum say larraee shuroo naa keren . haan agar woh tum say uss mein larraee shuroo kerden to tum unn ko qatal ker-saktay ho . aesay kafiron ki saza yehi hai
verses.translation: aur tum unn logon  ko jahan pao qatal kero , aur unhen uss jagah say nikal bahir kero jahan say unhon ney tumhen nikala tha . aur fitna qatal say ziyada sangeen burai hai .   aur tum unn say masjid-e-haram kay paas uss waqt tak larraee naa kero jab tak woh khud uss mein tum say larraee shuroo naa keren . haan agar woh tum say uss mein larraee shuroo kerden to tum unn ko qatal ker-saktay ho . aesay kafiron ki saza yehi hai

verses.text: phir agar woh baaz aajayen to beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai
verses.translation: phir agar woh baaz aajayen to beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai

verses.text: aur tum unn say larrtay raho yahan tak kay fitna baqi naa rahey , aur deen Allah ka hojaye .   phir agar woh baaz aajayen to ( samajh lo kay ) tashaddud siwaye zalimon kay kissi per nahi hona chahiye .
verses.translation: aur tum unn say larrtay raho yahan tak kay fitna baqi naa rahey , aur deen Allah ka hojaye .   phir agar woh baaz aajayen to ( samajh lo kay ) tashaddud siwaye zalimon kay kissi per nahi hona chahiye .

verses.text: hurmat walay maheenay ka badla hurmat wala maheena hai , aur hurmaton per bhi badlay kay ehkaam jari hotay hain .   chunacheh agar koi shaks tum per koi ziyadti keray to tum bhi wesi hi ziyadti uss per kero jaisi ziyadti uss ney tum per ki ho , aur Allah say dartay raho , aur achi tarah samajh lo kay Allah unhi ka sathi hai jo uss ka khof dil mein rakhtay hain
verses.translation: hurmat walay maheenay ka badla hurmat wala maheena hai , aur hurmaton per bhi badlay kay ehkaam jari hotay hain .   chunacheh agar koi shaks tum per koi ziyadti keray to tum bhi wesi hi ziyadti uss per kero jaisi ziyadti uss ney tum per ki ho , aur Allah say dartay raho , aur achi tarah samajh lo kay Allah unhi ka sathi hai jo uss ka khof dil mein rakhtay hain

verses.text: aur Allah kay raastay mein maal kharch kero , aur apney aap ko khud apney haathon halakat mein naa daalo ,   aur naiki ikhtiyar kero . beyshak Allah naiki kernay walon say mohabbat kerta hai .
verses.translation: aur Allah kay raastay mein maal kharch kero , aur apney aap ko khud apney haathon halakat mein naa daalo ,   aur naiki ikhtiyar kero . beyshak Allah naiki kernay walon say mohabbat kerta hai .

verses.text: aur hajj aur umrah Allah kay liye poora poora ada kero , haan agar tumhen rok diya jaye to jo qurbani moyassar ho , ( Allah kay huzoor paish kerdo ) .   aur apney sar uss waqt tak naa mundao jab tak qurbani apni jagah naa phonch jaye . haan agar tum mein say koi shaks beemar ho , ya uss kay sar mein koi takleef ho to rozon ya sadqay ya qurbani ka fidya dey .   phir jab tum aman hasil kerlo to jo shaks hajj kay sath umray ka faeeda bhi uthaye woh jo qurbani moyassar ho ( Allah kay huzoor paish keray ) . haan agar kissi kay paas iss ki taqat naa ho to woh hajj kay dino mein teen rozay rakhay , aur saat ( rozay ) uss waqt jab tum ( gharon ko ) loat jao . iss tarah yeh kul das rozay hon gay .   yeh hukum unn logon  kay liye hai jinn kay ghar walay masjid-e-haram kay paas naa rehtay hon   . aur Allah say dartay raho , aur jaan rakho kay Allah ka azab bara sakht hai .
verses.translation: aur hajj aur umrah Allah kay liye poora poora ada kero , haan agar tumhen rok diya jaye to jo qurbani moyassar ho , ( Allah kay huzoor paish kerdo ) .   aur apney sar uss waqt tak naa mundao jab tak qurbani apni jagah naa phonch jaye . haan agar tum mein say koi shaks beemar ho , ya uss kay sar mein koi takleef ho to rozon ya sadqay ya qurbani ka fidya dey .   phir jab tum aman hasil kerlo to jo shaks hajj kay sath umray ka faeeda bhi uthaye woh jo qurbani moyassar ho ( Allah kay huzoor paish keray ) . haan agar kissi kay paas iss ki taqat naa ho to woh hajj kay dino mein teen rozay rakhay , aur saat ( rozay ) uss waqt jab tum ( gharon ko ) loat jao . iss tarah yeh kul das rozay hon gay .   yeh hukum unn logon  kay liye hai jinn kay ghar walay masjid-e-haram kay paas naa rehtay hon   . aur Allah say dartay raho , aur jaan rakho kay Allah ka azab bara sakht hai .

verses.text: hajj kay chand mutayyan maheenay hain . chunacheh jo shaks inn maheenon mein ( ehraam baandh ker ) apney oopper hajj lazim kerlay to hajj kay doran naa woh koi fohash baat keray , naa koi gunah , naa koi jhagrra . aur tum jo koi naik kaam kero gay , Allah ussay jaan ley ga . aur ( hajj kay safar mein ) zaad-e-raah sath ley jaya kero , kiyonkay behtareen zaad-e-raah taqwa hai .   aur aey aqal walo ! meri nafarmani say dartay raho
verses.translation: hajj kay chand mutayyan maheenay hain . chunacheh jo shaks inn maheenon mein ( ehraam baandh ker ) apney oopper hajj lazim kerlay to hajj kay doran naa woh koi fohash baat keray , naa koi gunah , naa koi jhagrra . aur tum jo koi naik kaam kero gay , Allah ussay jaan ley ga . aur ( hajj kay safar mein ) zaad-e-raah sath ley jaya kero , kiyonkay behtareen zaad-e-raah taqwa hai .   aur aey aqal walo ! meri nafarmani say dartay raho

verses.text: tum per iss baat mein koi gunah nahi hai kay tum ( hajj kay doran tijarat ya mazdoori kay zariye ) apney perwerdigar ka fazal talash kero .   phir jab tum arafaat say rawana ho to mashar-e-haram kay paas ( jo muzdalfa mein waqay hai ) Allah ka ziker kero , aur uss ka ziker ussi tarah kero jiss tarah uss ney tumhen hidayat ki hai ,   jabkay iss say pehlay tum bilkul na-waqif thay
verses.translation: tum per iss baat mein koi gunah nahi hai kay tum ( hajj kay doran tijarat ya mazdoori kay zariye ) apney perwerdigar ka fazal talash kero .   phir jab tum arafaat say rawana ho to mashar-e-haram kay paas ( jo muzdalfa mein waqay hai ) Allah ka ziker kero , aur uss ka ziker ussi tarah kero jiss tarah uss ney tumhen hidayat ki hai ,   jabkay iss say pehlay tum bilkul na-waqif thay

verses.text: iss kay ilawa ( yeh baat bhi yaad rakho kay ) tum ussi jagah say rawana ho jahan say aam log rawana hotay hain .   aur Allah say maghfirat maango . beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: iss kay ilawa ( yeh baat bhi yaad rakho kay ) tum ussi jagah say rawana ho jahan say aam log rawana hotay hain .   aur Allah say maghfirat maango . beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: phir jab tum apney hajj kay kaam pooray ker-chuko to Allah ka iss tarah ziker kero jaisay tum apney baap dadon ka ziker kiya kertay ho , balkay uss say bhi ziyada ziker kero .   abb baaz log to woh hain jo ( dua mein bus ) yeh kehtay hain kay :  " aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen duniya mein bhalai ata farma " aur aakhirat mein unn ka koi hissa nahi hota
verses.translation: phir jab tum apney hajj kay kaam pooray ker-chuko to Allah ka iss tarah ziker kero jaisay tum apney baap dadon ka ziker kiya kertay ho , balkay uss say bhi ziyada ziker kero .   abb baaz log to woh hain jo ( dua mein bus ) yeh kehtay hain kay :  " aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen duniya mein bhalai ata farma " aur aakhirat mein unn ka koi hissa nahi hota

verses.text: aur unhi mein say woh bhi hain jo yeh kehtay hain kay :   aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen duniya mein bhi bhalai ata farma aur aakhirat mein bhi bhalai , aur hamen dozakh kay azab say bacha ley
verses.translation: aur unhi mein say woh bhi hain jo yeh kehtay hain kay :   aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen duniya mein bhi bhalai ata farma aur aakhirat mein bhi bhalai , aur hamen dozakh kay azab say bacha ley

verses.text: yeh woh log hain jinhen apney aemal ki kamai ka hissa ( sawab ki soorat mein ) milay ga , aur Allah jald hisab lenay wala hai .

verses.text: aur Allah ko ginti kay ( unn chand ) dino mein ( jab tum mina mein muqeem ho ) yaad kertay raho . phir jo shaks do hi din mein jaldi chala jaye uss per bhi koi gunah nahi hai , aur jo shaks ( aik din ) baad mein jaye uss per bhi koi gunah nahi .   yeh ( tafseel ) uss kay liye hai jo taqwa ikhtiyar keray . aur tum sabb taqwa ikhtiyar kero , aur yaqeen rakho kay tum sabb ko ussi ki taraf ley jaa ker jama kiya jaye ga

verses.text: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay liye dunyawi zindagi bari dilkash bana di gaee hai , aur woh ehal-e-emaan ka mazaq uratay hain , halankay jinhon ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya hai woh qayamat kay din inn say kahen buland hon gay . aur Allah jiss ko chahta hai bey hisab rizq deta hai .

verses.text: . ( shuroo mein ) saray insan aik hi deen kay pero thay . phir ( jab unn mein ikhtilaf huwa to ) Allah ney nabi bhejay jo ( haq walon ko ) khushkhabri sunatay , aur ( batil walon ko ) daratay thay , aur unn kay sath haq per mushtamil kitab nazil ki , takay woh logon  kay darmiyan unn baaton ka faisla keray jinn mein unn ka ikhtilaf tha . aur ( afsos ki baat yeh hai kay ) kissi aur ney nahi balkay khud unhon ney jinn ko woh kitab di gaee thi , roshan dalaeel aajaney kay baad bhi , sirf bahami zidd ki wajeh say issi ( kitab ) mein ikhtilaf nikal liya . phir jo log emaan laye Allah ney unhen apney hukum say haq ki unn baaton mein raah-e-raast tak phonchaya jinn mein unhon ney ikhtilaf kiya tha , aur Allah jissay chahta hai raah-e-raast tak phoncha deta hai .

( musalmano ! ) kiya tum ney yeh samajh rakha hai kay tum jannat mein ( yunhi ) dakhil hojao gay , halankay abhi tumhen uss jaisay halaat paish nahi aaye jaisay unn logon  ko paish aaye thay jo tum say pehlay ho guzray hain . unn per sakhtiyan aur takleefen ayen , aur unhen halla daala gaya , yahan tak kay Rasool aur unn kay emaan walay sathi bol uthay kay   Allah ki madad kab aaye gi ?" , yaad rakho ! verses.text: log aap say poochtay hain kay woh ( Allah ki khushnoodi kay liye ) kiya kharch keren-? aap keh dijiye kay jo maal bhi tum kharch kero woh walaiden , qareebi rishta daaron , yateemon , miskeeno aur musfiron kay liye hona chahiye . aur tum bhalai ka jo kaam bhi kero , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: log aap say poochtay hain kay woh ( Allah ki khushnoodi kay liye ) kiya kharch keren-? aap keh dijiye kay jo maal bhi tum kharch kero woh walaiden , qareebi rishta daaron , yateemon , miskeeno aur musfiron kay liye hona chahiye . aur tum bhalai ka jo kaam bhi kero , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: tum per ( dushmanon say ) jang kerna farz kiya gaya hai , aur woh tum per giraan hai . aur yeh aen mumkin hai kay tum aik cheez ko bura samjho halankay woh tumharay haq mein behtar ho . aur yeh bhi mumkin hai kay tum aik cheez ko pasand kero , halankay woh tumharay haq mein buri ho . aur ( asal haqeeqat to ) Allah janta hai , aur tum nahi jantay .
verses.translation: tum per ( dushmanon say ) jang kerna farz kiya gaya hai , aur woh tum per giraan hai . aur yeh aen mumkin hai kay tum aik cheez ko bura samjho halankay woh tumharay haq mein behtar ho . aur yeh bhi mumkin hai kay tum aik cheez ko pasand kero , halankay woh tumharay haq mein buri ho . aur ( asal haqeeqat to ) Allah janta hai , aur tum nahi jantay .

verses.text: log aap say hurmat walay maheenay kay baaray mein poochtay hain kay uss mein jang kerna kaisa hai ?   aap keh dijiye kay uss mein jang kerna bara gunah hai , magar logon  ko Allah kay raastay say rokna , uss kay khilaf kufr ki rawish ikhtiyar kerna , masjid-e-haram per bandish lagana aur uss kay baasiyon ko wahan say nikal bahir kerna Allah kay nazdeek ziyada bara gunah hai . aur fitna qatal say bhi ziyada sangeen cheez hai . aur yeh ( kafir ) tum logon  say barabar jang kertay rahen gay , yahan tak kay agar inn ka bus chalay to yeh tum ko tumhara deen chorney per aamada kerden . aur agar tum mein say koi shaks apna deen chorr dey , aur kafir honey ki halat hi mein maray , to aesay logon  kay aemal duniya aur aakhirat dono mein ikarat hojayen gay . aesay log dozakh walay hain . woh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .
verses.translation: log aap say hurmat walay maheenay kay baaray mein poochtay hain kay uss mein jang kerna kaisa hai ?   aap keh dijiye kay uss mein jang kerna bara gunah hai , magar logon  ko Allah kay raastay say rokna , uss kay khilaf kufr ki rawish ikhtiyar kerna , masjid-e-haram per bandish lagana aur uss kay baasiyon ko wahan say nikal bahir kerna Allah kay nazdeek ziyada bara gunah hai . aur fitna qatal say bhi ziyada sangeen cheez hai . aur yeh ( kafir ) tum logon  say barabar jang kertay rahen gay , yahan tak kay agar inn ka bus chalay to yeh tum ko tumhara deen chorney per aamada kerden . aur agar tum mein say koi shaks apna deen chorr dey , aur kafir honey ki halat hi mein maray , to aesay logon  kay aemal duniya aur aakhirat dono mein ikarat hojayen gay . aesay log dozakh walay hain . woh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .

verses.text: . ( iss kay bar-khilaf ) jo log emaan laye aur jinhon ney hijrat ki aur Allah kay raastay mein jihad kiya , to woh beyshak Allah ki rehmat kay umeedwaar hain , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: . ( iss kay bar-khilaf ) jo log emaan laye aur jinhon ney hijrat ki aur Allah kay raastay mein jihad kiya , to woh beyshak Allah ki rehmat kay umeedwaar hain , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: log aap say sharab aur joye kay baaray mein poochtay hain . aap keh dijiye kay inn dono mein bara gunah bhi hai , aur logon  kay liye kuch faeeday bhi hain , aur inn dono ka gunah inn kay faeeday say ziyada barha huwa hai .   aur log aap say poochtay hain kay woh ( Allah ki khushnoodi kay liye ) kiya kharch keren-? aap keh dijiye kay   jo tumhari zaroorat say zaeed ho " .   Allah issi tarah apney ehkaam tumharay liye saaf saaf biyan kerta hai takay tum ghor-o-fiker say kaam lo .
verses.translation: log aap say sharab aur joye kay baaray mein poochtay hain . aap keh dijiye kay inn dono mein bara gunah bhi hai , aur logon  kay liye kuch faeeday bhi hain , aur inn dono ka gunah inn kay faeeday say ziyada barha huwa hai .   aur log aap say poochtay hain kay woh ( Allah ki khushnoodi kay liye ) kiya kharch keren-? aap keh dijiye kay   jo tumhari zaroorat say zaeed ho " .   Allah issi tarah apney ehkaam tumharay liye saaf saaf biyan kerta hai takay tum ghor-o-fiker say kaam lo .

verses.text: duniya kay baaray mein bhi aur aakhirat kay baaray mein bhi . aur log aap say yateemon kay baaray mein poochtay hain . aap keh dijiye kay unn ki bhalai chahana naik kaam hai , aur agar tum unn kay sath mil jul ker raho to ( kuch harj nahi kiyonkay ) woh tumharay bhai hi to hain . aur Allah khoob janta hai kay kon moamlaat bigaarney wala hai . aur kon sanwarney wala . aur agar Allah chahta to tumhen mushkil mein daal deta .   yaqeenan Allah ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil .

verses.text: aur mushrik aurton say uss waqt tak nikah naa kero jab tak woh emaan naa ley ayen . yaqeenan aik momin baandi kissi bhi mushrik aurat say behtar hai , khuwa woh mushrik aurat tumhen pasand aarahi ho . aur apni aurton ka nikah mushrik mardon say naa kerao jab tak woh emaan naa ley ayen . aur yaqeenan aik momin ghulam kissi bhi mushrik mard say behtar hai , khuwa woh mushrik mard tumhen pasand aaraha ho . yeh sabb dozakh ki taraf bulatay hain , jabkay Allah apney hukum say jannat aur maghfirat ki taraf bulata hai , aur apney ehkaam logon  kay samney saaf saaf biyan kerta hai takay woh naseehat hasil keren .
verses.translation: aur mushrik aurton say uss waqt tak nikah naa kero jab tak woh emaan naa ley ayen . yaqeenan aik momin baandi kissi bhi mushrik aurat say behtar hai , khuwa woh mushrik aurat tumhen pasand aarahi ho . aur apni aurton ka nikah mushrik mardon say naa kerao jab tak woh emaan naa ley ayen . aur yaqeenan aik momin ghulam kissi bhi mushrik mard say behtar hai , khuwa woh mushrik mard tumhen pasand aaraha ho . yeh sabb dozakh ki taraf bulatay hain , jabkay Allah apney hukum say jannat aur maghfirat ki taraf bulata hai , aur apney ehkaam logon  kay samney saaf saaf biyan kerta hai takay woh naseehat hasil keren .

verses.text: aur log aap say haiz kay baaray mein poochtay hain . aap keh dijiye kay woh gandagi hai lehaza haiz ki halat mein aurton say alag raho , aur jab tak woh pak naa hojayen unn say qurbat ( yani jamaa ) naa kero . haan jab woh pak hojayen to unn kay paas ussi tareeqay say jao jiss tarah Allah ney tumhen hukum diya hai . beyshak Allah unn logon  say mohabbat kerta hai jo uss ki taraf kasrat say rujoo keren aur unn say mohabbat kerta hai jo khoob pak saaf rahen .
verses.translation: aur log aap say haiz kay baaray mein poochtay hain . aap keh dijiye kay woh gandagi hai lehaza haiz ki halat mein aurton say alag raho , aur jab tak woh pak naa hojayen unn say qurbat ( yani jamaa ) naa kero . haan jab woh pak hojayen to unn kay paas ussi tareeqay say jao jiss tarah Allah ney tumhen hukum diya hai . beyshak Allah unn logon  say mohabbat kerta hai jo uss ki taraf kasrat say rujoo keren aur unn say mohabbat kerta hai jo khoob pak saaf rahen .

verses.text: tumhari biwiyan tumharay liye khetiyan hain : lehaza apni kheti mein jahan say chahao jao   aur apney liye ( achay amal ) aagay bhejo , aur Allah say dartay raho , aur yaqeen rakho kay tum uss say jaker milney walay ho . aur mominon ko khush khabri suna do .
verses.translation: tumhari biwiyan tumharay liye khetiyan hain : lehaza apni kheti mein jahan say chahao jao   aur apney liye ( achay amal ) aagay bhejo , aur Allah say dartay raho , aur yaqeen rakho kay tum uss say jaker milney walay ho . aur mominon ko khush khabri suna do .

verses.text: aur Allah ( kay naam ) ko apni qasmon mein iss gharz say istimal naa kero kay uss kay zariye naiki aur taqwa kay kamon aur logon  kay darmiyan sulah safai keraney say bach sako .   aur Allah sabb kuch sunta janta hai .
verses.translation: aur Allah ( kay naam ) ko apni qasmon mein iss gharz say istimal naa kero kay uss kay zariye naiki aur taqwa kay kamon aur logon  kay darmiyan sulah safai keraney say bach sako .   aur Allah sabb kuch sunta janta hai .

verses.text: Allah tumhari laghw qasmon per tumhari girift nahi keray ga   , albatta jo qasmen tum ney apney dilon kay iraday say khai hon gi unn per girift keray ga . aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara burdbaar hai .
verses.translation: Allah tumhari laghw qasmon per tumhari girift nahi keray ga   , albatta jo qasmen tum ney apney dilon kay iraday say khai hon gi unn per girift keray ga . aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara burdbaar hai .

verses.text: jo log apni biwiyon say ielaa kertay hain ( yani unn kay paas naa janey ki qasam kha letay hain ) unn kay liye chaar maheenay ki mohlat hai   . chunacheh agar woh ( qasam torr ker ) rujoo kerlen to beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: jo log apni biwiyon say ielaa kertay hain ( yani unn kay paas naa janey ki qasam kha letay hain ) unn kay liye chaar maheenay ki mohlat hai   . chunacheh agar woh ( qasam torr ker ) rujoo kerlen to beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: aur agar unhon ney talaq hi ki thaan li ho to ( bhi ) Allah sunney janney wala hai .
verses.translation: aur agar unhon ney talaq hi ki thaan li ho to ( bhi ) Allah sunney janney wala hai .

verses.text: aur jinn aurton ko talaq dey di gaee ho woh teen martaba haiz aaney tak apney aap ko intizar mein rakhen   aur agar woh Allah per aur aakhirat kay din per emaan rakhti hon to unn kay liye halal nahi hai kay Allah ney unn kay reham mein jo kuch ( hamal ya haiz ) peda kiya hai ussay chupayen . aur iss mauddat mein agar unn kay shohar halaat behtar banana chahen to unn ko haq hai kay woh unn aurton ko ( apni zojiyat ) mein wapis ley len . aur unn aurton ko maroof tareeqay kay mutabiq wesay hi huqooq hasil hain jaisay ( mardon ko ) unn per hasil hain . haan mardon ko unn per aik darja foqiyat hai   aur Allah ghalib aur hikmat wala hai .
verses.translation: aur jinn aurton ko talaq dey di gaee ho woh teen martaba haiz aaney tak apney aap ko intizar mein rakhen   aur agar woh Allah per aur aakhirat kay din per emaan rakhti hon to unn kay liye halal nahi hai kay Allah ney unn kay reham mein jo kuch ( hamal ya haiz ) peda kiya hai ussay chupayen . aur iss mauddat mein agar unn kay shohar halaat behtar banana chahen to unn ko haq hai kay woh unn aurton ko ( apni zojiyat ) mein wapis ley len . aur unn aurton ko maroof tareeqay kay mutabiq wesay hi huqooq hasil hain jaisay ( mardon ko ) unn per hasil hain . haan mardon ko unn per aik darja foqiyat hai   aur Allah ghalib aur hikmat wala hai .

verses.text: talaq ( ziyada say ziyada ) do baar honi chahiye . uss kay baad ( shohar kay liye do hi raastay hain ) ya to qaeeday kay mutabiq ( biwi ko ) rok rakhay ( yani talaq say rujoo kerlay ) ya khush asloobi say chorr dey ( yani rujoo kay baghair iddat guzar janey dey ) . aur ( aey shohro ! ) tumharay liye halal nahi hai kay tum ney unn ( biwiyon ) ko jo kuch diya ho woh ( talaq kay badlay ) unn say wapis lo , illa yeh kay dono ko iss baat ka andesha ho kay woh ( nikah baqi rehney ki soorat mein ) Allah ki muqarrar ki hoi hudood ko qaeem nahi rakh saken gay   . chunacheh agar tumhen iss baat ka andesha ho kay woh dono Allah ki hudood ko qaeem naa rakh saken gay to unn dono kay liye iss mein koi gunah nahi hai kay aurat maali moawza dey ker alehdgi hasil kerlay . yeh Allah ki muqarrar ki hoi hudood hain , lehaza inn say tajawuz naa kero . aur jo log Allah ki hudood say tajawuz kertay hain woh baray zalim log hain .
