verses.text: phir agar shohar ( teesri ) talaq deydey to woh ( mutlaqa aurat ) uss kay liye uss waqt tak halal nahi hogi jab tak woh kissi aur shohar say nikah naa keray , haan agar woh ( doosra shohar bhi ) ussay talaq deydey to unn dono per koi gunah nahi kay woh aik doosray kay paas ( naya nikah ker kay ) dobara wapis aajayen , ba-shartey-kay unhen yeh ghalib gumaan ho kay abb woh Allah ki hudood qaeem rakhen gay . aur yeh sabb Allah ki hudood hain jo woh unn logon  kay liye wazeh ker raha hai jo samajh rakhtay hon .
verses.translation: phir agar shohar ( teesri ) talaq deydey to woh ( mutlaqa aurat ) uss kay liye uss waqt tak halal nahi hogi jab tak woh kissi aur shohar say nikah naa keray , haan agar woh ( doosra shohar bhi ) ussay talaq deydey to unn dono per koi gunah nahi kay woh aik doosray kay paas ( naya nikah ker kay ) dobara wapis aajayen , ba-shartey-kay unhen yeh ghalib gumaan ho kay abb woh Allah ki hudood qaeem rakhen gay . aur yeh sabb Allah ki hudood hain jo woh unn logon  kay liye wazeh ker raha hai jo samajh rakhtay hon .

verses.text: aur jab tum ney aurton ko talaq dey di ho aur woh apni iddat kay qareeb phonch jayen , to ya to unn ko bhalai kay sath ( apni zojiyat mein ) rok rakho , ya unhen bhalai kay sath chorr do . aur unhen sataney ki khatir iss liye rok ker naa rakho kay unn per zulm ker-sako . aur jo shaks aisa keray ga woh khud apni jaan per zulm keray ga . aur Allah ki aayaton ko mazaq matt banao aur Allah ney tum per jo inaam farmaya hai ussay , aur tum per jo kitab aur hikmat ki baaten tumhen naseehat kernay kay liye nazil ki hain unhen yaad rakho . aur Allah say dartay raho , aur jaan rakho kay Allah her cheez ko khoob janta hai .
verses.translation: aur jab tum ney aurton ko talaq dey di ho aur woh apni iddat kay qareeb phonch jayen , to ya to unn ko bhalai kay sath ( apni zojiyat mein ) rok rakho , ya unhen bhalai kay sath chorr do . aur unhen sataney ki khatir iss liye rok ker naa rakho kay unn per zulm ker-sako . aur jo shaks aisa keray ga woh khud apni jaan per zulm keray ga . aur Allah ki aayaton ko mazaq matt banao aur Allah ney tum per jo inaam farmaya hai ussay , aur tum per jo kitab aur hikmat ki baaten tumhen naseehat kernay kay liye nazil ki hain unhen yaad rakho . aur Allah say dartay raho , aur jaan rakho kay Allah her cheez ko khoob janta hai .

verses.text: aur jab tum ney aurton ko talaq dey di ho , aur woh apni iddat ko phonch jayen , to ( aey meykay walo ! ) unhen iss baat say mana naa kero kay woh apney ( pehlay ) shohron say ( dobara ) nikah keren , ba-shartey-kay woh bhalai kay sath aik doosray say razi hogaye hon .   inn baaton ki naseehat tum mein say unn logon  ko ki jarahi hai jo Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan rakhtay hon . yehi tumharay liye ziyada suthra aur pakeezah tareeqa hai . Allah janta hai aur tum nahi jantay .
verses.translation: aur jab tum ney aurton ko talaq dey di ho , aur woh apni iddat ko phonch jayen , to ( aey meykay walo ! ) unhen iss baat say mana naa kero kay woh apney ( pehlay ) shohron say ( dobara ) nikah keren , ba-shartey-kay woh bhalai kay sath aik doosray say razi hogaye hon .   inn baaton ki naseehat tum mein say unn logon  ko ki jarahi hai jo Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan rakhtay hon . yehi tumharay liye ziyada suthra aur pakeezah tareeqa hai . Allah janta hai aur tum nahi jantay .

verses.text: aur mayen apney bacchon ko pooray do saal tak doodh pilayen . yeh mauddat inn kay liye hai jo doodh pilaney ki mauddat poori kerna chahen . aur jiss baap ka woh baccha hai uss per wajib hai kay woh maroof tareeqay per unn maon kay khaney aur libas ka kharch uthaye   . ( haan ) kissi shaks ko uss ki wusat say ziyada takleef nahi di jati . naa to maa ko apney bacchay ki wajeh say sataya jaye , aur naa baap ko apney bacchay ki wajeh say   . aur issi tarah ki zimma daari waris per bhi hai   . phir agar woh dono ( yani walaiden ) aapas ki raza mandi aur bahami mashwaray say ( do saal guzarney say pehlay hi ) doodh churana chahen to uss mein bhi unn per koi gunah nahi hai . aur agar tum yeh chahao kay apney bacchon ko kissi ana say doodh pilwao to bhi tum per koi gunah nahi , jabkay tum ney jo ujrat thehrai thi woh ( doodh pilaney wali ana ko ) bhalay tareeqay say dey do . aur Allah say dartay raho , aur jaan rakho kay Allah tumharay saray kamon ko achi tarah dekh raha hai .

verses.text: aur tum mein say jo log wafaat paajayen , aur biwiyan chorr ker jayen to woh biwiyan apney aap ko chaar maheenay aur das din intizar mein rakhen gi . phir jab woh apni ( iddat ki ) miyaad ko phonch jayen to woh apney baaray mein jo kaarawai ( maslan doosra nikah ) qaeeday kay mutabiq keren to tum per kuch gunah nahi . aur jo kuch tum kertay ho Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: aur ( iddat kay doran ) agar tum unn aurton ko isharay kanaye mein nikah ka paygham do ya ( unn say nikah ka irada ) dil mein chupaye rakho to tum per koi gunah nahi hai . Allah janta hai kay tum unn ( say nikah ) ka khayal to dil mein lao gay , lekin unn say nikah ka do tarfa wada matt kerna , illa yeh kay munasib tareeqay say koi baat keh do   . aur nikah ka aqd paka kernay ka uss waqt tak irada bhi matt kerna jab tak iddat ki muqarrara mauddat apni miyaad ko naa phonch jaye . aur yaad rakho kay jo kuch tumharay dilon mein hai Allah ussay khoob janta hai ; lehaza uss say dartay raho ; aur yaad rakho kay Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara burdbaar hai .
verses.translation: aur ( iddat kay doran ) agar tum unn aurton ko isharay kanaye mein nikah ka paygham do ya ( unn say nikah ka irada ) dil mein chupaye rakho to tum per koi gunah nahi hai . Allah janta hai kay tum unn ( say nikah ) ka khayal to dil mein lao gay , lekin unn say nikah ka do tarfa wada matt kerna , illa yeh kay munasib tareeqay say koi baat keh do   . aur nikah ka aqd paka kernay ka uss waqt tak irada bhi matt kerna jab tak iddat ki muqarrara mauddat apni miyaad ko naa phonch jaye . aur yaad rakho kay jo kuch tumharay dilon mein hai Allah ussay khoob janta hai ; lehaza uss say dartay raho ; aur yaad rakho kay Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara burdbaar hai .

verses.text: tum per iss mein bhi koi gunah nahi hai kay tum aurton ko aesay waqt talaq do jabkay abhi tum ney unn ko chooa bhi naa ho , aur naa unn kay liye koi mehar muqarrar kiya ho , aur ( aesi soorat mein ) unn ko koi tohfa do   , khushal shaks apni haisiyat kay mutabiq aur gharib aadmi apni haisiyat kay mutabiq bhalay tareeqay say yeh tohfa dey . yeh naik aadmiyon per aik lazimi haq hai .
verses.translation: tum per iss mein bhi koi gunah nahi hai kay tum aurton ko aesay waqt talaq do jabkay abhi tum ney unn ko chooa bhi naa ho , aur naa unn kay liye koi mehar muqarrar kiya ho , aur ( aesi soorat mein ) unn ko koi tohfa do   , khushal shaks apni haisiyat kay mutabiq aur gharib aadmi apni haisiyat kay mutabiq bhalay tareeqay say yeh tohfa dey . yeh naik aadmiyon per aik lazimi haq hai .

verses.text: aur agar tum ney unhen chooney say pehlay hi iss halat mein talaq di ho jabkay unn kay liye ( nikah kay waqt ) koi mehar muqarrar kerliya tha to jitna mehar tum ney muqarrar kiya tha uss ka aadha dena ( wajib hai ) illa yeh kay woh aurten riyat kerden ( aur aadhay mehar ka bhi mutalba naa keren ) ya woh ( shohar ) jiss kay haath mein nikah ki girah hai , riyat keray ( aur poora mehar deydey ) aur agar tum riyat kero to yeh taqwa kay ziyada qareeb hai . aur aapas mein faraakh dili ka bartao kerna matt bhoolo . jo amal bhi tum kertay ho , Allah yaqeenan ussay dekh raha hai .
verses.translation: aur agar tum ney unhen chooney say pehlay hi iss halat mein talaq di ho jabkay unn kay liye ( nikah kay waqt ) koi mehar muqarrar kerliya tha to jitna mehar tum ney muqarrar kiya tha uss ka aadha dena ( wajib hai ) illa yeh kay woh aurten riyat kerden ( aur aadhay mehar ka bhi mutalba naa keren ) ya woh ( shohar ) jiss kay haath mein nikah ki girah hai , riyat keray ( aur poora mehar deydey ) aur agar tum riyat kero to yeh taqwa kay ziyada qareeb hai . aur aapas mein faraakh dili ka bartao kerna matt bhoolo . jo amal bhi tum kertay ho , Allah yaqeenan ussay dekh raha hai .

verses.text: tamam namazon ka poora poora khayal rakho , aur ( khaas tor per ) bech ki namaz ka   . aur Allah kay samney ba-adab farmanbardaar ban ker kharray huwa kero .
verses.translation: tamam namazon ka poora poora khayal rakho , aur ( khaas tor per ) bech ki namaz ka   . aur Allah kay samney ba-adab farmanbardaar ban ker kharray huwa kero .

verses.text: aur agar tumhen ( dushman ka ) khof laahaq ho to kharray kharray ya sawar honey ki halat hi mein ( namaz parh lo )   phir jab tum aman ki halat mein aajao to Allah ka ziker uss tareeqay say kero jo uss ney tumhen sikhaya hai jiss say tum pehlay na-waqif thay
verses.translation: aur agar tumhen ( dushman ka ) khof laahaq ho to kharray kharray ya sawar honey ki halat hi mein ( namaz parh lo )   phir jab tum aman ki halat mein aajao to Allah ka ziker uss tareeqay say kero jo uss ney tumhen sikhaya hai jiss say tum pehlay na-waqif thay

verses.text: aur tum mein say jo log wafaat paajayen aur apney peechay biwiyan chorr jayen to woh apni biwiyon kay haq mein yeh wasiyyat ker jaya keren kay aik saal tak woh ( tarkay say nafqa wasool kernay ka ) faeeda uthayen gi aur unn ko ( shohar kay ghar say ) nikala nahi jaye ga .   haan agar woh khud nikal jayen to apney haq mein qaeeday kay mutabiq woh jo kuch bhi keren uss mein tum per koi gunah nahi hoga . aur Allah sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , sahab-e-hikmat bhi .
verses.translation: aur tum mein say jo log wafaat paajayen aur apney peechay biwiyan chorr jayen to woh apni biwiyon kay haq mein yeh wasiyyat ker jaya keren kay aik saal tak woh ( tarkay say nafqa wasool kernay ka ) faeeda uthayen gi aur unn ko ( shohar kay ghar say ) nikala nahi jaye ga .   haan agar woh khud nikal jayen to apney haq mein qaeeday kay mutabiq woh jo kuch bhi keren uss mein tum per koi gunah nahi hoga . aur Allah sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , sahab-e-hikmat bhi .

verses.text: aur mutlaqa aurton ko qaeeday kay mutabiq faeeda phonchana muttaqiyon per unn ka haq hai .
verses.translation: aur mutlaqa aurton ko qaeeday kay mutabiq faeeda phonchana muttaqiyon per unn ka haq hai .

verses.text: Allah apney ehkaam issi tarah wazahat say tumharay samney biyan kerta hai , takay tum samajh daari say kaam lo .
verses.translation: Allah apney ehkaam issi tarah wazahat say tumharay samney biyan kerta hai , takay tum samajh daari say kaam lo .

verses.text: kiya tumhen unn logon  ka haal maloom nahi huwa jo moat say bachnay kay liye apney gharon say nikal aaye thay , aur woh hazaron ki tadaad mein thay ? chunacheh Allah ney unn say kaha :  mar jao  phir unhen zinda kiya .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah logon  per boht fazal farmaney wala hai , lekin aksar log shukar ada nahi kertay .
verses.translation: kiya tumhen unn logon  ka haal maloom nahi huwa jo moat say bachnay kay liye apney gharon say nikal aaye thay , aur woh hazaron ki tadaad mein thay ? chunacheh Allah ney unn say kaha :  mar jao  phir unhen zinda kiya .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah logon  per boht fazal farmaney wala hai , lekin aksar log shukar ada nahi kertay .

verses.text: aur Allah kay raastay mein jang kero , aur yaqeen rakho kay Allah khoob sunney wala , khoob janney wala hai .
verses.translation: aur Allah kay raastay mein jang kero , aur yaqeen rakho kay Allah khoob sunney wala , khoob janney wala hai .

verses.text: kon hai jo Allah ko achay tareeqay per qarz dey , takay woh ussay uss kay mafad mein itna barhaye charrhaye kay woh badar jaha ziyada hojaye ?   aur Allah hi tangi peda kerta hai , aur wohi wusat deta hai , aur ussi ki taraf tum sabb ko lotaya jaye ga .
verses.translation: kon hai jo Allah ko achay tareeqay per qarz dey , takay woh ussay uss kay mafad mein itna barhaye charrhaye kay woh badar jaha ziyada hojaye ?   aur Allah hi tangi peda kerta hai , aur wohi wusat deta hai , aur ussi ki taraf tum sabb ko lotaya jaye ga .

verses.text: kiya tumhen musa kay baad bani Israel kay giroh kay uss waqaey ka ilm nahi huwa jab unhon ney apney aik nabi say kaha tha kay humara aik badshah muqarrar ker-dijiye takay ( uss kay jhandey talay ) hum Allah kay raastay mein jang ker-saken .   nabi ney kaha :  kiya tum logon  say yeh baat kuch baeed hai kay jab tum per jang farz ki jaye to tum naa larro-?  unhon ney kaha :  bhala hamen kiya hojaye ga jo hum Allah kay raastay mein jang naa keren gay halankay hamen apney gharon aur apney bacchon kay paas say nikal bahir kiya gaya hai .  phir ( huwa yehi kay ) jab unn per jang farz ki gaee to unn mein say thoray logon  ko chorr ker baqi sabb peeth pher gaye . aur Allah zalimon ko khoob janta hai .
verses.translation: kiya tumhen musa kay baad bani Israel kay giroh kay uss waqaey ka ilm nahi huwa jab unhon ney apney aik nabi say kaha tha kay humara aik badshah muqarrar ker-dijiye takay ( uss kay jhandey talay ) hum Allah kay raastay mein jang ker-saken .   nabi ney kaha :  kiya tum logon  say yeh baat kuch baeed hai kay jab tum per jang farz ki jaye to tum naa larro-?  unhon ney kaha :  bhala hamen kiya hojaye ga jo hum Allah kay raastay mein jang naa keren gay halankay hamen apney gharon aur apney bacchon kay paas say nikal bahir kiya gaya hai .  phir ( huwa yehi kay ) jab unn per jang farz ki gaee to unn mein say thoray logon  ko chorr ker baqi sabb peeth pher gaye . aur Allah zalimon ko khoob janta hai .

verses.text: aur unn kay nabi ney unn say kaha kay :  Allah ney tumharay liye taloot ko badshah bana ker bheja hai .  kehney lagay :  bhala uss ko hum per badshahat kernay ka haq kahan say aagaya-? hum uss kay muqablay mein badshahat kay ziyada mustahiq hain . aur uss ko to maali wusat bhi hasil nahi .  nabi ney kaha :  Allah ney unn ko tum per fazilat dey ker chuna hai , aur unhen ilm aur jism mein ( tum say ) ziyada wusat ata ki hai . aur Allah apna mulk jiss ko chahta hai deta hai . aur Allah bari wusat aur bara ilm rakhney wala hai .
verses.translation: aur unn kay nabi ney unn say kaha kay :  Allah ney tumharay liye taloot ko badshah bana ker bheja hai .  kehney lagay :  bhala uss ko hum per badshahat kernay ka haq kahan say aagaya-? hum uss kay muqablay mein badshahat kay ziyada mustahiq hain . aur uss ko to maali wusat bhi hasil nahi .  nabi ney kaha :  Allah ney unn ko tum per fazilat dey ker chuna hai , aur unhen ilm aur jism mein ( tum say ) ziyada wusat ata ki hai . aur Allah apna mulk jiss ko chahta hai deta hai . aur Allah bari wusat aur bara ilm rakhney wala hai .

verses.text: aur inn say unn kay nabi ney yeh bhi kaha kay :  taloot ki badshahat ki alamat yeh hai kay tumharay paas woh sandooq ( wapis ) aajaye ga jiss mein tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say sakeenat ka saman hai , aur musa aur Haroon ney jo ashiya chorri then unn mein say kuch baqi maandda cheezen hain . ussay farishtay uthaye huye layen gay   agar tum momin ho to tumharay liye uss mein bari nishani hai .
verses.translation: aur inn say unn kay nabi ney yeh bhi kaha kay :  taloot ki badshahat ki alamat yeh hai kay tumharay paas woh sandooq ( wapis ) aajaye ga jiss mein tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say sakeenat ka saman hai , aur musa aur Haroon ney jo ashiya chorri then unn mein say kuch baqi maandda cheezen hain . ussay farishtay uthaye huye layen gay   agar tum momin ho to tumharay liye uss mein bari nishani hai .

verses.text: chunacheh jab taloot lashkar kay sath rawana huwa to uss ney ( lashkar walon say ) kaha kay :  Allah aik darya kay zariye tumhara imtihan lenay wala hai . jo shaks iss darya say paani piye ga woh mera aadmi nahi hoga , aur jo issay nahi chakhay ga woh mera aadmi hoga , illa yeh kay koi apney haath say aik chullu bhar ley ( to kuch harj nahi ) .    phir ( huwa yeh kay ) unn mein say thoray aadmiyon kay siwa baqi sabb ney uss darya say ( khoob ) paani piya . chunacheh jab woh ( yani taloot ) aur uss kay sath emaan rakhney walay darya kay paar utray , to yeh log ( jinhon ney taloot ka hukum nahi maana tha ) kehney lagay kay :  aaj jaloot aur uss kay lashkar ka muqabla kernay ki hum mein bilkul taqat nahi hai .  ( magar ) jinn logon  ka emaan tha kay woh Allah say jaa milney walay hain unhon ney kaha kay :  najaney kitni choti jamaten hain jo Allah kay hukum say bari jamaton per ghalib aai hain . aur Allah unn logon  ka sathi hai jo sabar say kaam letay hain .

( magar ) jinn logon  ka emaan tha kay woh Allah say jaa milney walay hain unhon ney kaha kay :  najaney kitni choti jamaten hain jo Allah kay hukum say bari jamaton per ghalib aai hain . aur Allah unn logon  ka sathi hai jo sabar say kaam letay hain .

verses.text: aur jab yeh log jaloot aur uss kay lashkaron kay aamney samney huye to inhon ney kaha :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! sabar o istaqlal ki sift hum per undel dey , hamen sabit qadmi bakhsh dey , aur hamen iss kafir qoam kay muqablay mein fatah o nusrat ata farmadey .
verses.translation: aur jab yeh log jaloot aur uss kay lashkaron kay aamney samney huye to inhon ney kaha :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! sabar o istaqlal ki sift hum per undel dey , hamen sabit qadmi bakhsh dey , aur hamen iss kafir qoam kay muqablay mein fatah o nusrat ata farmadey .

verses.text: chunacheh inhon ney Allah kay hukum say unn ( jaloot kay sathiyon ) ko shikast di aur dawood ney jaloot ko qatal kiya ,   aur Allah ney uss ko saltanat aur danai ata ki , aur jo ilm chaha uss ko ata farmaya . agar Allah logon  ka aik doosray kay zariye difaa naa keray to zameen mein fasad phel jaye , lekin Allah tamam jahano per bara fazal farmaney wala hai .
verses.translation: chunacheh inhon ney Allah kay hukum say unn ( jaloot kay sathiyon ) ko shikast di aur dawood ney jaloot ko qatal kiya ,   aur Allah ney uss ko saltanat aur danai ata ki , aur jo ilm chaha uss ko ata farmaya . agar Allah logon  ka aik doosray kay zariye difaa naa keray to zameen mein fasad phel jaye , lekin Allah tamam jahano per bara fazal farmaney wala hai .

verses.text: yeh Allah ki aayaat hain jo hum aap kay samney theek theek parh ker sunatay hain , aur aap beyshak unn payghumberon mein say hain jo Rasool bana ker bhejay gaye hain .
verses.translation: yeh Allah ki aayaat hain jo hum aap kay samney theek theek parh ker sunatay hain , aur aap beyshak unn payghumberon mein say hain jo Rasool bana ker bhejay gaye hain .

verses.text: yeh payghumber jo hum ney ( makhlooq ki islaah kay liye ) bhejay hain , inn ko hum ney aik doosray per fazilat ata ki hai . inn mein say baaz woh hain jinn say Allah ney kalam farmaya , aur inn mein say baaz ko uss ney badarjaha bulandi ata ki .   aur hum ney essa ibn-e-maryam ko khuli nishaniyan den , aur rooh-ul-qudus say unn ki madad farmaee .   aur agar Allah chahta to unn kay baad walay log apney paas roshan dalaeel aajaney kay baad aapas mein naa larrtay , lekin unhon ney khud ikhtilaf kiya , chunacheh unn mein say kuch woh thay jo emaan laye , aur kuch woh jinhon ney kufr apnaya . aur agar Allah chahta to woh aapas mein naa larrtay , lekin Allah wohi kerta hai jo woh chahta hai .
verses.translation: yeh payghumber jo hum ney ( makhlooq ki islaah kay liye ) bhejay hain , inn ko hum ney aik doosray per fazilat ata ki hai . inn mein say baaz woh hain jinn say Allah ney kalam farmaya , aur inn mein say baaz ko uss ney badarjaha bulandi ata ki .   aur hum ney essa ibn-e-maryam ko khuli nishaniyan den , aur rooh-ul-qudus say unn ki madad farmaee .   aur agar Allah chahta to unn kay baad walay log apney paas roshan dalaeel aajaney kay baad aapas mein naa larrtay , lekin unhon ney khud ikhtilaf kiya , chunacheh unn mein say kuch woh thay jo emaan laye , aur kuch woh jinhon ney kufr apnaya . aur agar Allah chahta to woh aapas mein naa larrtay , lekin Allah wohi kerta hai jo woh chahta hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! jo rizq hum ney tumhen diya hai uss mein say woh din aaney say pehlay pehlay ( Allah kay raastay mein ) kharch kerlo jiss din naa koi soda hoga , naa koi dosti ( kaam aaye gi ) , aur naa koi sifarish hosakay gi .   aur zalim woh log hain jo kufr ikhtiyar kiye huye hain .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! jo rizq hum ney tumhen diya hai uss mein say woh din aaney say pehlay pehlay ( Allah kay raastay mein ) kharch kerlo jiss din naa koi soda hoga , naa koi dosti ( kaam aaye gi ) , aur naa koi sifarish hosakay gi .   aur zalim woh log hain jo kufr ikhtiyar kiye huye hain .

verses.text: Allah woh hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi jo sada zinda hai . jo poori kainat sanbhalay huye hai ; jiss ko naa kabhi oongh lagti hai , naa neend . aasmano mein jo kuch hai ( woh bhi ) aur zameen mein jo kuch hai ( woh bhi ) , sabb ussi ka hai . kon hai jo uss kay huzoor uss ki ijazat kay baghair kissi ki sifarish ker-sakay-? woh saray bandon kay tamam aagay peechay kay halaat ko khoob janta hai , aur woh log uss kay ilm ki koi baat apney ilm kay daeray mein nahi laasaktay , siwaye uss baat kay jissay woh khud chahye . uss ki kursi ney saray aasmano aur zameen ko ghera huwa hai ; aur inn dono ki nigehbani say ussay zara bhi bojh nahi hota , aur woh bara aali maqam , sahab-e-azmat hai .
verses.translation: Allah woh hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi jo sada zinda hai . jo poori kainat sanbhalay huye hai ; jiss ko naa kabhi oongh lagti hai , naa neend . aasmano mein jo kuch hai ( woh bhi ) aur zameen mein jo kuch hai ( woh bhi ) , sabb ussi ka hai . kon hai jo uss kay huzoor uss ki ijazat kay baghair kissi ki sifarish ker-sakay-? woh saray bandon kay tamam aagay peechay kay halaat ko khoob janta hai , aur woh log uss kay ilm ki koi baat apney ilm kay daeray mein nahi laasaktay , siwaye uss baat kay jissay woh khud chahye . uss ki kursi ney saray aasmano aur zameen ko ghera huwa hai ; aur inn dono ki nigehbani say ussay zara bhi bojh nahi hota , aur woh bara aali maqam , sahab-e-azmat hai .

verses.text: deen kay moamlay mein koi zabardasti nahi hai . hidayat ka raasta gumrahi say mumtaz ho ker wazeh hochuka . iss kay baad jo shaks taghoot ka inkar ker kay Allah per emaan ley aaye ga , uss ney aik mazboot kunda thaam liya jiss kay tootney ka koi imkan nahi . aur Allah khoob sunney wala , sabb kuch janney wala hai .
verses.translation: deen kay moamlay mein koi zabardasti nahi hai . hidayat ka raasta gumrahi say mumtaz ho ker wazeh hochuka . iss kay baad jo shaks taghoot ka inkar ker kay Allah per emaan ley aaye ga , uss ney aik mazboot kunda thaam liya jiss kay tootney ka koi imkan nahi . aur Allah khoob sunney wala , sabb kuch janney wala hai .

verses.text: Allah emaan walon ka rakhwala hai ; woh unhen andheriyon say nikal ker roshni mein lata hai . aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay rakhwalay woh shetan hain jo unhen roshni say nikal ker andheriyon mein ley jatay hain . woh sabb aag kay baasi hain ; woh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .
verses.translation: Allah emaan walon ka rakhwala hai ; woh unhen andheriyon say nikal ker roshni mein lata hai . aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay rakhwalay woh shetan hain jo unhen roshni say nikal ker andheriyon mein ley jatay hain . woh sabb aag kay baasi hain ; woh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .

verses.text: kiya tum ney uss shaks ( kay haal ) per ghor kiya jiss ko Allah ney saltanat kiya dey di thi kay woh apney perwerdigar ( kay wajood hi ) kay baaray mein Ibrahim say behas kernay laga-? jab Ibrahim ney kaha kay :  mera perwerdigar woh hai jo zindagi bhi deta hai aur moat bhi  to woh kehney laga kay :  mein bhi zindagi deta hun aur moat deta hun .    Ibrahim ney kaha :  acha ! Allah to sooraj ko mashriq say nikalta hai , tum zara ussay maghrib say to nikal ker lao .  iss per woh kafir mabhoot ho ker reh gaya . aur Allah aesay zalimon ko hidayat nahi diya kerta .
verses.translation: kiya tum ney uss shaks ( kay haal ) per ghor kiya jiss ko Allah ney saltanat kiya dey di thi kay woh apney perwerdigar ( kay wajood hi ) kay baaray mein Ibrahim say behas kernay laga-? jab Ibrahim ney kaha kay :  mera perwerdigar woh hai jo zindagi bhi deta hai aur moat bhi  to woh kehney laga kay :  mein bhi zindagi deta hun aur moat deta hun .    Ibrahim ney kaha :  acha ! Allah to sooraj ko mashriq say nikalta hai , tum zara ussay maghrib say to nikal ker lao .  iss per woh kafir mabhoot ho ker reh gaya . aur Allah aesay zalimon ko hidayat nahi diya kerta .

verses.text: ya ( tum ney ) uss jaisay shaks ( kay waqaey ) per ( ghor kiya ) jiss ka aik basti per aesay waqt guzar huwa jab woh chatton kay ball giri parri thi ?   uss ney kaha kay :  Allah uss basti ko uss kay marney kay baad kaisay zinda keray ga-?  phir Allah ney uss shaks ko so saal tak kay liye moat di , aur uss kay baad zinda kerdiya . ( aur phir ) poocha kay tum kitney arsay tak ( iss halat mein ) rahey ho-? uss ney kaha :  aik din ya aik din ka kuch hissa !  Allah ney kaha :  nahi ! balkay tum so saal issi tarah rahey ho . abb apney khaney peenay ki cheezon ko dekho kay woh zara nahi sarren . aur ( doosri taraf ) apney gadhay ko dekho ( kay gal sarr ker uss ka kiya haal hogaya hai ) aur yeh hum ney iss liye kiya takay hum tumhen logon  kay liye ( apni qudrat ka ) aik nishan bana den , aur ( abb apney gadhay ki ) haddiyon ko dekho kay hum kiss tarah unhen uthatay hain , phir unn ko gosht ka libas pehnatay hain !  chunacheh jab haqeeqat khul ker uss kay samney aagae to woh bol utha kay :  mujhay yaqeen hai Allah her cheez per qudrat rakhta hai .
verses.translation: ya ( tum ney ) uss jaisay shaks ( kay waqaey ) per ( ghor kiya ) jiss ka aik basti per aesay waqt guzar huwa jab woh chatton kay ball giri parri thi ?   uss ney kaha kay :  Allah uss basti ko uss kay marney kay baad kaisay zinda keray ga-?  phir Allah ney uss shaks ko so saal tak kay liye moat di , aur uss kay baad zinda kerdiya . ( aur phir ) poocha kay tum kitney arsay tak ( iss halat mein ) rahey ho-? uss ney kaha :  aik din ya aik din ka kuch hissa !  Allah ney kaha :  nahi ! balkay tum so saal issi tarah rahey ho . abb apney khaney peenay ki cheezon ko dekho kay woh zara nahi sarren . aur ( doosri taraf ) apney gadhay ko dekho ( kay gal sarr ker uss ka kiya haal hogaya hai ) aur yeh hum ney iss liye kiya takay hum tumhen logon  kay liye ( apni qudrat ka ) aik nishan bana den , aur ( abb apney gadhay ki ) haddiyon ko dekho kay hum kiss tarah unhen uthatay hain , phir unn ko gosht ka libas pehnatay hain !  chunacheh jab haqeeqat khul ker uss kay samney aagae to woh bol utha kay :  mujhay yaqeen hai Allah her cheez per qudrat rakhta hai .

verses.text: aur ( uss waqt ka tazkarah suno ) jab Ibrahim ney kaha tha kay meray perwerdigar ! mujhay dikhaiye kay aap murdon ko kaisay zinda kertay hain-? Allah ney kaha :  kiya tumhen yaqeen nahi-?  kehney lagay :  yaqeen kiyon naa hota-? magar ( yeh khuwaish iss liye ki hai ) takay meray dil ko poora itminan hasil hojaye .    Allah ney kaha :  acha ! to chaar perinday lo , aur unhen apney say manoos kerlo , phir ( unn ko zibah ker kay ) unn ka aik aik hissa her pahar per rakh do , phir unn ko bulao , woh chaaron tumharay paas dorray chalay ayen gay .   aur jaan rakho kay Allah poori tarah sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , aalaa darjay ki hikmat wala bhi .
verses.translation: aur ( uss waqt ka tazkarah suno ) jab Ibrahim ney kaha tha kay meray perwerdigar ! mujhay dikhaiye kay aap murdon ko kaisay zinda kertay hain-? Allah ney kaha :  kiya tumhen yaqeen nahi-?  kehney lagay :  yaqeen kiyon naa hota-? magar ( yeh khuwaish iss liye ki hai ) takay meray dil ko poora itminan hasil hojaye .    Allah ney kaha :  acha ! to chaar perinday lo , aur unhen apney say manoos kerlo , phir ( unn ko zibah ker kay ) unn ka aik aik hissa her pahar per rakh do , phir unn ko bulao , woh chaaron tumharay paas dorray chalay ayen gay .   aur jaan rakho kay Allah poori tarah sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , aalaa darjay ki hikmat wala bhi .

verses.text: jo log Allah kay raastay mein apney maal kharch kertay hain unn ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik dana saat baalen ugaye ( aur ) her baal mein so daney hon .   aur Allah jiss kay liye chahta hai ( sawab mein ) kaee guna izafa ker deta hai . Allah boht wusat wala ( aur ) baray ilm wala hai .
verses.translation: jo log Allah kay raastay mein apney maal kharch kertay hain unn ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik dana saat baalen ugaye ( aur ) her baal mein so daney hon .   aur Allah jiss kay liye chahta hai ( sawab mein ) kaee guna izafa ker deta hai . Allah boht wusat wala ( aur ) baray ilm wala hai .

verses.text: jo log apney maal Allah kay raastay mein kharch kertay hain , phir kharch kernay kay baad naa ehsan jatlatay hain aur naa koi takleef phonchatay hain , woh apney perwerdigar kay paas apna sawab payen gay ; naa unn ko koi khof laahaq hoga aur naa koi ghum phonchay ga .
verses.translation: jo log apney maal Allah kay raastay mein kharch kertay hain , phir kharch kernay kay baad naa ehsan jatlatay hain aur naa koi takleef phonchatay hain , woh apney perwerdigar kay paas apna sawab payen gay ; naa unn ko koi khof laahaq hoga aur naa koi ghum phonchay ga .

verses.text: bhali baat keh dena aur darguzar kerna uss sadqay say behtar hai jiss kay baad koi takleef phonchai jaye .   aur Allah bara bey niaz , boht burdbaar hai .
verses.translation: bhali baat keh dena aur darguzar kerna uss sadqay say behtar hai jiss kay baad koi takleef phonchai jaye .   aur Allah bara bey niaz , boht burdbaar hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! apney sadqaat ko ehsan jatla ker aur takleef phoncha ker uss shaks ki tarah zaya matt kero jo apna maal logon  ko dikhaney kay liye kharch kerta hai aur Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhta . chunacheh uss ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik chikni chatan per mitti jami ho , phir uss per zor ki barish parray aur uss ( mitti ko baha ker chatan ) ko ( dobara ) chikni bana choray .   aesay logon  ney jo kamai ki hoti hai woh zara bhi unn kay haath nahi lagti . aur Allah ( aesay ) kafiron ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! apney sadqaat ko ehsan jatla ker aur takleef phoncha ker uss shaks ki tarah zaya matt kero jo apna maal logon  ko dikhaney kay liye kharch kerta hai aur Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhta . chunacheh uss ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik chikni chatan per mitti jami ho , phir uss per zor ki barish parray aur uss ( mitti ko baha ker chatan ) ko ( dobara ) chikni bana choray .   aesay logon  ney jo kamai ki hoti hai woh zara bhi unn kay haath nahi lagti . aur Allah ( aesay ) kafiron ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .

verses.text: aur jo log apney maal Allah ki khushnoodi talab kernay kay liye aur apney aap mein pukhtagi peda kernay kay liye kharch kertay hain unn ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik baagh kissi teelay per waqay ho ; uss per zor ki barish barsay to woh dugna phal ley ker aaye . aur agar uss per zor ki barish naa bhi barsay to halki phuwaar bhi uss kay liye kafi hai . aur tum jo amal bhi kertay ho Allah ussay/issay khoob achi tarah dekhta hai .
verses.translation: aur jo log apney maal Allah ki khushnoodi talab kernay kay liye aur apney aap mein pukhtagi peda kernay kay liye kharch kertay hain unn ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik baagh kissi teelay per waqay ho ; uss per zor ki barish barsay to woh dugna phal ley ker aaye . aur agar uss per zor ki barish naa bhi barsay to halki phuwaar bhi uss kay liye kafi hai . aur tum jo amal bhi kertay ho Allah ussay/issay khoob achi tarah dekhta hai .

verses.text: kiya tum mein say koi yeh pasand keray ga kay uss ka khujooron aur angooron ka aik baagh ho jiss kay neechay nehren behti hon ( aur ) uss ko uss baagh mein aur bhi her tarah kay phal hasil hon , aur burhapay ney ussay aa-pakra ho , aur uss kay bacchay abhi kamzor hon ; itney mein aik aag say bhara bagola aa-ker uss ko apni zadd mein ley ley aur poora baagh jal ker reh jaye ?   issi tarah Allah tumharay liye apni aayaten khol khol ker biyan kerta hai takay tum ghor kero .
verses.translation: kiya tum mein say koi yeh pasand keray ga kay uss ka khujooron aur angooron ka aik baagh ho jiss kay neechay nehren behti hon ( aur ) uss ko uss baagh mein aur bhi her tarah kay phal hasil hon , aur burhapay ney ussay aa-pakra ho , aur uss kay bacchay abhi kamzor hon ; itney mein aik aag say bhara bagola aa-ker uss ko apni zadd mein ley ley aur poora baagh jal ker reh jaye ?   issi tarah Allah tumharay liye apni aayaten khol khol ker biyan kerta hai takay tum ghor kero .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! jo kuch tum ney kamaya ho aur jo pedawaar hum ney tumharay liye zameen say nikali ho uss ki achi cheezon ka aik hissa ( Allah kay raastay mein ) kharch kiya kero ; aur yeh niyyat naa rakho kay bus aesi kharab qisam ki cheezen ( Allah kay naam per ) diya kero gay jo ( agar koi doosra tumhen dey to nafrat kay maaray ) tum ussay aankhen meechay baghair naa ley sako . aur yaad rakho kay Allah aisa bey niaz hai kay her qisam ki tareef ussi ki taraf loatti hai .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! jo kuch tum ney kamaya ho aur jo pedawaar hum ney tumharay liye zameen say nikali ho uss ki achi cheezon ka aik hissa ( Allah kay raastay mein ) kharch kiya kero ; aur yeh niyyat naa rakho kay bus aesi kharab qisam ki cheezen ( Allah kay naam per ) diya kero gay jo ( agar koi doosra tumhen dey to nafrat kay maaray ) tum ussay aankhen meechay baghair naa ley sako . aur yaad rakho kay Allah aisa bey niaz hai kay her qisam ki tareef ussi ki taraf loatti hai .

verses.text: shetan tumhen muflisi say darata hai aur tumhen bey hayai ka hukum deta hai ; aur Allah tum say apni maghfirat aur fazal ka wada kerta hai . Allah bari wusat wala , her baat janney wala hai .
verses.translation: shetan tumhen muflisi say darata hai aur tumhen bey hayai ka hukum deta hai ; aur Allah tum say apni maghfirat aur fazal ka wada kerta hai . Allah bari wusat wala , her baat janney wala hai .

verses.text: woh jiss ko chahta hai danai ata ker deta hai , aur jissay danai ata hogaee ussay wafir miqdaar mein bhalai mil gaee . aur naseehat wohi log hasil kertay hain jo samajh kay malik hain .
verses.translation: woh jiss ko chahta hai danai ata ker deta hai , aur jissay danai ata hogaee ussay wafir miqdaar mein bhalai mil gaee . aur naseehat wohi log hasil kertay hain jo samajh kay malik hain .

verses.text: aur tum jo koi kharch kero ya koi mannat maano Allah ussay janta hai . aur zalimon ko kissi tarah kay madadgaar moyassar nahi ayen gay .
verses.translation: aur tum jo koi kharch kero ya koi mannat maano Allah ussay janta hai . aur zalimon ko kissi tarah kay madadgaar moyassar nahi ayen gay .

verses.text: agar tum sadaqaat zahir ker kay do tab bhi acha hai ; aur agar unn ko chupa ker fuqra ko do to yeh tumharay haq mein kahen behtar hai . aur Allah tumhari buraiyon ka kaffara kerday ga ; aur Allah tumharay tamam kamon say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: agar tum sadaqaat zahir ker kay do tab bhi acha hai ; aur agar unn ko chupa ker fuqra ko do to yeh tumharay haq mein kahen behtar hai . aur Allah tumhari buraiyon ka kaffara kerday ga ; aur Allah tumharay tamam kamon say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ) inn ( kafiron ) ko raah-e-raast per ley aana aap ki zimma daari nahi hai , lekin Allah jiss ko chahta hai raah-e-raast per ley aata hai .   aur jo maal bhi tum kharch kertay ho woh khud tumharay faeeday kay liye hota hai jabkay tum Allah ki khushnoodi talab kernay kay siwa kissi aur gharz say kharch nahi kertay . aur jo maal bhi tum kharch kero gay tumhen poora poora diya jaye ga aur tum per zara bhi zulm nahi hoga .

verses.text: . ( maali imdad kay bator-e-khaas ) mustahiq woh fuqra hain jinhon ney apney aap ko Allah ki raah mein iss tarah muqayyad ker rakha hai kay woh ( moaash ki talash kay liye ) zameen mein chal phir nahi saktay . chunkay woh itney pak daman hain kay kissi say sawal nahi kertay , iss liye na-waqif aadmi unhen maal daar samajhta hai . tum unn kay chehray ki alamaton say unn ( ki androoni halat ) ko pehchan saktay ho ( magar ) woh logon  say lagg lipat ker sawal nahi kertay .   aur tum jo maal bhi kharch kertay ho Allah ussay khoob janta hai .

verses.text: jo log apney maal din raat khamoshi say bhi aur aelania bhi kharch kertay hain woh apney perwerdigar kay paas apna sawab payen gay , aur naa unhen koi khof laahaq hoga , naa koi ghum phonchay ga .
verses.translation: jo log apney maal din raat khamoshi say bhi aur aelania bhi kharch kertay hain woh apney perwerdigar kay paas apna sawab payen gay , aur naa unhen koi khof laahaq hoga , naa koi ghum phonchay ga .

verses.text: jo log sood khatay hain woh ( qayamat mein ) uthen gay to uss shaks ki tarah uthen gay jissay shetan ney choo-ker pagal bana diya ho . yeh iss liye hoga kay unhon ney kaha tha kay :  bey bhi to sood hi ki tarah hoti hai .    halankay Allah ney bey ko halal kiya hai aur sood ko haram qarar diya hai . lehaza jiss shaks kay paas uss kay perwerdigar ki taraf say naseehat aagae aur woh ( soodi moamlaat say ) baaz aagaya to mazi mein jo kuch huwa woh ussi ka hai .   aur uss ( ki batni kayfiyat ) ka moamla Allah kay hawalay hai . aur jiss shaks ney loat ker phir wohi kaam kiya   to aesay log dozakhi hain . woh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .
verses.translation: jo log sood khatay hain woh ( qayamat mein ) uthen gay to uss shaks ki tarah uthen gay jissay shetan ney choo-ker pagal bana diya ho . yeh iss liye hoga kay unhon ney kaha tha kay :  bey bhi to sood hi ki tarah hoti hai .    halankay Allah ney bey ko halal kiya hai aur sood ko haram qarar diya hai . lehaza jiss shaks kay paas uss kay perwerdigar ki taraf say naseehat aagae aur woh ( soodi moamlaat say ) baaz aagaya to mazi mein jo kuch huwa woh ussi ka hai .   aur uss ( ki batni kayfiyat ) ka moamla Allah kay hawalay hai . aur jiss shaks ney loat ker phir wohi kaam kiya   to aesay log dozakhi hain . woh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .

verses.text: Allah sood ko mitatta hai aur sadqaat ko barhata hai . aur Allah her uss shaks ko napasand kerta hai jo nashukra gunehgaar ho .
verses.translation: Allah sood ko mitatta hai aur sadqaat ko barhata hai . aur Allah her uss shaks ko napasand kerta hai jo nashukra gunehgaar ho .

verses.text: . ( haan ) woh log jo emaan layen , naik amal keren , namaz qaeem keren aur zakat ada keren woh apney rab kay paas apney ajar kay mustahiq hon gay ; naa unhen koi khof laahaq hoga , naa koi ghum phonchay ga .
verses.translation: . ( haan ) woh log jo emaan layen , naik amal keren , namaz qaeem keren aur zakat ada keren woh apney rab kay paas apney ajar kay mustahiq hon gay ; naa unhen koi khof laahaq hoga , naa koi ghum phonchay ga .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah say daro aur agar tum waqai momin ho to sood ka jo hissa bhi ( kissi kay zimmay ) baqi reh gaya ho ussay chorr do .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah say daro aur agar tum waqai momin ho to sood ka jo hissa bhi ( kissi kay zimmay ) baqi reh gaya ho ussay chorr do .

verses.text: phir bhi agar tum aisa naa kero gay to Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki taraf say aelaan-e-jang sunn lo . aur agar tum ( sood say ) tauba kero to tumhara asal sarmaya tumhara haq hai . naa tum kissi per zulm kero , naa tum per zulm kiya jaye .
verses.translation: phir bhi agar tum aisa naa kero gay to Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki taraf say aelaan-e-jang sunn lo . aur agar tum ( sood say ) tauba kero to tumhara asal sarmaya tumhara haq hai . naa tum kissi per zulm kero , naa tum per zulm kiya jaye .

verses.text: aur agar koi tangdast ( qarz daar ) ho to uss ka haath khulney tak mohlat deni hai . aur sadqa hi kerdo to yeh tumharay haq mein kahen ziyada behtar hai , ba-shartey-kay tum ko samajh ho .
verses.translation: aur agar koi tangdast ( qarz daar ) ho to uss ka haath khulney tak mohlat deni hai . aur sadqa hi kerdo to yeh tumharay haq mein kahen ziyada behtar hai , ba-shartey-kay tum ko samajh ho .

verses.text: aur daro uss din say jab tum sabb Allah kay paas loat ker jao gay , phir her her shaks ko jo kuch uss ney kamaya hai poora poora diya jaye ga , aur unn per koi zulm nahi hoga .
verses.translation: aur daro uss din say jab tum sabb Allah kay paas loat ker jao gay , phir her her shaks ko jo kuch uss ney kamaya hai poora poora diya jaye ga , aur unn per koi zulm nahi hoga .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! jab tum kissi moyyan miyaad kay liye udhaar ka koi moamla kero to ussay likh liya kero , aur tum mein say jo shaks likhna janta ho insaf kay sath tehreer likhay , aur jo shaks likhna janta ho , likhney say inkar naa keray . jab Allah ney ussay yeh ilm diya hai to ussay likhna chahiye . aur tehreer woh shaks likhwaye jiss kay zimmay haq wajib horaha ho , aur ussay chahiye kay woh Allah say daray jo uss ka perwerdigar hai aur uss ( haq ) mein koi kami naa keray .   haan agar woh shaks jiss kay zimmay haq wajib horaha hai nasamajh ya kamzor ho ya ( kissi aur wajeh say ) tehreer naa likhwa sakta ho to uss ka sarparast insaf kay sath likhwaye . aur apney mein say do mardon ko gawah bana lo , haan agar do mard mojood naa hon to aik mard aur do aurten unn gawahon mein say hojayen jinhen tum pasand kertay ho , takay agar unn do aurton mein say aik bhool jaye to doosri ussay yaad diladay . aur jab gawahon ko ( gawahi denay kay liye ) bulaya jaye to woh inkar naa keren . aur jo moamla apni miyaad say wabasta ho , chahye woh chota ho ya bara , ussay likhney say uktao nahi . yeh baat Allah kay nazdeek ziyada qareen-e-insaf aur gawahi ko durust rakhney ka behtar zariya hai , aur iss baat ki qareebi zamanat hai kay tum aaenda shak mein nahi parro gay . haan agar tumharay darmiyan koi naqad lain dain ka soda ho to uss ko naa likhney mein tumharay liye kuch harj nahi hai . aur jab kharid-o-farokht kero to gawah bana liya kero . aur naa likhney walay ko koi takleef phonchai jaye , naa gawah ko . aur agar aisa kero gay to yeh tumhari taraf say nafarmani hogi . aur Allah ka khof dil mein rakho . Allah tumhen taleem deta hai , aur Allah her cheez ka ilm rakhta hai .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! jab tum kissi moyyan miyaad kay liye udhaar ka koi moamla kero to ussay likh liya kero , aur tum mein say jo shaks likhna janta ho insaf kay sath tehreer likhay , aur jo shaks likhna janta ho , likhney say inkar naa keray . jab Allah ney ussay yeh ilm diya hai to ussay likhna chahiye . aur tehreer woh shaks likhwaye jiss kay zimmay haq wajib horaha ho , aur ussay chahiye kay woh Allah say daray jo uss ka perwerdigar hai aur uss ( haq ) mein koi kami naa keray .   haan agar woh shaks jiss kay zimmay haq wajib horaha hai nasamajh ya kamzor ho ya ( kissi aur wajeh say ) tehreer naa likhwa sakta ho to uss ka sarparast insaf kay sath likhwaye . aur apney mein say do mardon ko gawah bana lo , haan agar do mard mojood naa hon to aik mard aur do aurten unn gawahon mein say hojayen jinhen tum pasand kertay ho , takay agar unn do aurton mein say aik bhool jaye to doosri ussay yaad diladay . aur jab gawahon ko ( gawahi denay kay liye ) bulaya jaye to woh inkar naa keren . aur jo moamla apni miyaad say wabasta ho , chahye woh chota ho ya bara , ussay likhney say uktao nahi . yeh baat Allah kay nazdeek ziyada qareen-e-insaf aur gawahi ko durust rakhney ka behtar zariya hai , aur iss baat ki qareebi zamanat hai kay tum aaenda shak mein nahi parro gay . haan agar tumharay darmiyan koi naqad lain dain ka soda ho to uss ko naa likhney mein tumharay liye kuch harj nahi hai . aur jab kharid-o-farokht kero to gawah bana liya kero . aur naa likhney walay ko koi takleef phonchai jaye , naa gawah ko . aur agar aisa kero gay to yeh tumhari taraf say nafarmani hogi . aur Allah ka khof dil mein rakho . Allah tumhen taleem deta hai , aur Allah her cheez ka ilm rakhta hai .

verses.text: aur agar tum safar per ho aur tumhen koi likhney wala naa milay to ( adaegi ki zamanat kay tor per ) rehan qabazay mein rakh liye jayen . haan agar tum aik doosray per bharosa kero to jiss per bharosa kiya gaya hai woh apni amanat theek theek ada keray aur Allah say daray jo uss ka perwerdigar hai . aur gawahi ko naa chupao , aur jo gawahi ko chupaye woh gunehgaar dil ka hamil hai . aur jo amal bhi tum kertay ho Allah uss say khoob waqif hai .
verses.translation: aur agar tum safar per ho aur tumhen koi likhney wala naa milay to ( adaegi ki zamanat kay tor per ) rehan qabazay mein rakh liye jayen . haan agar tum aik doosray per bharosa kero to jiss per bharosa kiya gaya hai woh apni amanat theek theek ada keray aur Allah say daray jo uss ka perwerdigar hai . aur gawahi ko naa chupao , aur jo gawahi ko chupaye woh gunehgaar dil ka hamil hai . aur jo amal bhi tum kertay ho Allah uss say khoob waqif hai .

verses.text: jo kuch aasmano mein hai aur jo kuch zameen mein hai sabb Allah hi ka hai . aur jo baaten tumharay dilon mein hain , khuwa tum unn ko zahir kero ya chupao , Allah tum say unn ka hisab ley ga .   phir jiss ko chahye ga moaaf kerday ga aur jiss ko chahye ga saza dey ga . aur Allah her cheez per qudrat rakhta hai .
verses.translation: jo kuch aasmano mein hai aur jo kuch zameen mein hai sabb Allah hi ka hai . aur jo baaten tumharay dilon mein hain , khuwa tum unn ko zahir kero ya chupao , Allah tum say unn ka hisab ley ga .   phir jiss ko chahye ga moaaf kerday ga aur jiss ko chahye ga saza dey ga . aur Allah her cheez per qudrat rakhta hai .

verses.text: yeh Rasool ( yani hazrat Muhammad SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) uss cheez per emaan laye hain jo unn ki taraf unn kay rab ki taraf say nazil ki gaee hai , aur ( unn kay sath ) tamam musalman bhi . yeh sabb Allah per , uss kay farishton per , uss ki kitabon per aur uss kay Rasoolon per emaan laye hain . ( woh kehtay hain kay ) hum uss kay Rasoolon kay darmiyan koi tafreeq nahi kertay ( kay kissi per emaan layen , kissi per naa layen ) aur woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  hum ney ( Allah aur Rasool kay ehkaam ko tawajjah say ) sunn liya hai , aur hum khushi say ( unn ki ) tameel kertay hain . aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum aap ki maghfirat kay talabgaar hain . aur aap hi ki taraf hamen loat ker-jana hai .
verses.translation: yeh Rasool ( yani hazrat Muhammad SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) uss cheez per emaan laye hain jo unn ki taraf unn kay rab ki taraf say nazil ki gaee hai , aur ( unn kay sath ) tamam musalman bhi . yeh sabb Allah per , uss kay farishton per , uss ki kitabon per aur uss kay Rasoolon per emaan laye hain . ( woh kehtay hain kay ) hum uss kay Rasoolon kay darmiyan koi tafreeq nahi kertay ( kay kissi per emaan layen , kissi per naa layen ) aur woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  hum ney ( Allah aur Rasool kay ehkaam ko tawajjah say ) sunn liya hai , aur hum khushi say ( unn ki ) tameel kertay hain . aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum aap ki maghfirat kay talabgaar hain . aur aap hi ki taraf hamen loat ker-jana hai .

verses.text: Allah kissi bhi shaks ko uss ki wusat say ziyada zimma daari nahi sonpta . uss ko faeeda bhi ussi kaam say hoga jo woh apney iraday say keray , aur nuqsan bhi ussi kaam say hoga jo apney iraday say keray . ( musalmano Allah say yeh dua kiya kero kay : )  aey humaray perwerdigar ! agar hum say koi bhool chowk hojaye to humari girift naa farmaiye . aur aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum per uss tarah ka bojh naa daaliye jaisa aap ney hum say pehlay logon  per daala tha . aur aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum per aisa bojh naa daaliye jissay uthaney ki hum mein taqat naa ho . aur humari khataon say darguzar farmaiye , hamen bakhsh dijiye , aur hum per reham farmaiye . aap hi humaray haami o nasir hain , iss liye kafir logon  kay muqablay mein hamen nusrat ata farmaiye .
verses.translation: Allah kissi bhi shaks ko uss ki wusat say ziyada zimma daari nahi sonpta . uss ko faeeda bhi ussi kaam say hoga jo woh apney iraday say keray , aur nuqsan bhi ussi kaam say hoga jo apney iraday say keray . ( musalmano Allah say yeh dua kiya kero kay : )  aey humaray perwerdigar ! agar hum say koi bhool chowk hojaye to humari girift naa farmaiye . aur aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum per uss tarah ka bojh naa daaliye jaisa aap ney hum say pehlay logon  per daala tha . aur aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum per aisa bojh naa daaliye jissay uthaney ki hum mein taqat naa ho . aur humari khataon say darguzar farmaiye , hamen bakhsh dijiye , aur hum per reham farmaiye . aap hi humaray haami o nasir hain , iss liye kafir logon  kay muqablay mein hamen nusrat ata farmaiye .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: Alif-Laam-Meem
ayahs.translation: Alif-Laam-Meem

ayahs.text: yeh kitab aesi hai kay iss mein koi shak nahi ,   yeh hidayat hai unn darr rakhney walon kay liye
ayahs.translation: yeh kitab aesi hai kay iss mein koi shak nahi ,   yeh hidayat hai unn darr rakhney walon kay liye

ayahs.text: jo bey dekhi cheezon per emaan latay hain ,   aur namaz qaeem kertay hain , aur jo kuch hum ney unhen diya hai uss mein say ( Allah ki khushnoodi kay kamon mein ) kharch kertay hain
ayahs.translation: jo bey dekhi cheezon per emaan latay hain ,   aur namaz qaeem kertay hain , aur jo kuch hum ney unhen diya hai uss mein say ( Allah ki khushnoodi kay kamon mein ) kharch kertay hain

ayahs.text: aur jo uss ( wahi ) per bhi emaan latay hain jo aap per utaari gaee aur uss per bhi jo aap say pehlay utaari gaee ,   aur aakhirat per woh mukammal yaqeen rakhtay hain
ayahs.translation: aur jo uss ( wahi ) per bhi emaan latay hain jo aap per utaari gaee aur uss per bhi jo aap say pehlay utaari gaee ,   aur aakhirat per woh mukammal yaqeen rakhtay hain

ayahs.text: yeh hain woh log jo apney perwerdigar ki taraf say sahih raastay per hain , aur yehi woh log hain jo falah paaney walay hain
ayahs.translation: yeh hain woh log jo apney perwerdigar ki taraf say sahih raastay per hain , aur yehi woh log hain jo falah paaney walay hain

ayahs.text: beyshak woh log jinhon ney kufr apna liya hai ,   unn kay haq mein dono baaten barabar hain , chahye aap unn ko darayen , ya naa darayen ,   woh emaan nahi layen gay
ayahs.translation: beyshak woh log jinhon ney kufr apna liya hai ,   unn kay haq mein dono baaten barabar hain , chahye aap unn ko darayen , ya naa darayen ,   woh emaan nahi layen gay

ayahs.text: Allah ney unn kay dilon per aur unn kay kanon per mohar lagadi hai ,   aur unn ki aankhon per perda parra huwa hai , aur unn kay liye zabardast azab hai
ayahs.translation: Allah ney unn kay dilon per aur unn kay kanon per mohar lagadi hai ,   aur unn ki aankhon per perda parra huwa hai , aur unn kay liye zabardast azab hai

ayahs.text: kuch log woh hain jo kehtay hain kay hum Allah per aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan ley aaye , halankay woh ( haqeeqat mein ) momin nahi hain
ayahs.translation: kuch log woh hain jo kehtay hain kay hum Allah per aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan ley aaye , halankay woh ( haqeeqat mein ) momin nahi hain

ayahs.text: woh Allah ko aur unn logon  ko jo ( waqaee ) emaan laa-chukay hain dhoka detay hain . aur ( haqeeqat to yeh hai kay ) woh apney siwa kissi aur ko dhoka nahi dey rahey , lekin unhen iss baat ka ehsas nahi hai
ayahs.translation: woh Allah ko aur unn logon  ko jo ( waqaee ) emaan laa-chukay hain dhoka detay hain . aur ( haqeeqat to yeh hai kay ) woh apney siwa kissi aur ko dhoka nahi dey rahey , lekin unhen iss baat ka ehsas nahi hai

ayahs.text: inn kay dilon mein rog hai , chunacheh Allah ney inn kay rog mein aur izafa kerdiya hai ,   aur inn kay liye dardnak saza tayyar hai , kiyonkay woh jhoot bola kertay thay
ayahs.translation: inn kay dilon mein rog hai , chunacheh Allah ney inn kay rog mein aur izafa kerdiya hai ,   aur inn kay liye dardnak saza tayyar hai , kiyonkay woh jhoot bola kertay thay

ayahs.text: aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay tum zameen mein fasad naa machao to woh kehtay hain kay hum to islaah kernay walay hain
ayahs.translation: aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay tum zameen mein fasad naa machao to woh kehtay hain kay hum to islaah kernay walay hain

ayahs.text: yaad rakho ! yehi log fasad phelaney walay hain , lekin enhen iss baat ka ehsas nahi hai
ayahs.translation: yaad rakho ! yehi log fasad phelaney walay hain , lekin enhen iss baat ka ehsas nahi hai

ayahs.text: aur jab inn say kaha jata hai kay tum bhi ussi tarah emaan ley aao jaisay doosray log emaan laye hain to woh kehtay hain kay kiya hum bhi ussi tarah emaan layen jaisay beywaqoof log emaan laye hain-? khoob achi tarah sunn lo kay yehi log bey waqoof hain , lekin woh yeh baat nahi jantay
ayahs.translation: aur jab inn say kaha jata hai kay tum bhi ussi tarah emaan ley aao jaisay doosray log emaan laye hain to woh kehtay hain kay kiya hum bhi ussi tarah emaan layen jaisay beywaqoof log emaan laye hain-? khoob achi tarah sunn lo kay yehi log bey waqoof hain , lekin woh yeh baat nahi jantay

ayahs.text: aur jab yeh unn logon  say miltay hain jo emaan laa-chukay hain to kehtay hain kay hum emaan ley aaye , aur jab yeh apney shetanon   kay paas tanhai mein jatay hain to kehtay hain kay hum tumharay sath hain , hum to mazaq ker-rahey thay
ayahs.translation: aur jab yeh unn logon  say miltay hain jo emaan laa-chukay hain to kehtay hain kay hum emaan ley aaye , aur jab yeh apney shetanon   kay paas tanhai mein jatay hain to kehtay hain kay hum tumharay sath hain , hum to mazaq ker-rahey thay

ayahs.text: Allah unn say mazaq ( ka moamla ) kerta hai aur unhen aesi dheel deta hai kay woh apni sarkashi mein bhataktay rahen
ayahs.translation: Allah unn say mazaq ( ka moamla ) kerta hai aur unhen aesi dheel deta hai kay woh apni sarkashi mein bhataktay rahen

ayahs.text: yeh woh log hain jinhon ney hidayat kay badlay gumrahi khareed li hai , lehaza naa unn ki tijarat mein nafaa huwa , aur naa unhen sahih raasta naseeb huwa
ayahs.translation: yeh woh log hain jinhon ney hidayat kay badlay gumrahi khareed li hai , lehaza naa unn ki tijarat mein nafaa huwa , aur naa unhen sahih raasta naseeb huwa

ayahs.text: unn ki misal uss shaks ki si hai jiss ney aik aag roshan ki ,   phir jab uss ( aag ney ) uss kay mahol ko roshan kerdiya to Allah ney unn ka noor salb kerliya aur unhen andheriyon mein chorr diya kay unhen kuch sujhai nahi deta
ayahs.translation: unn ki misal uss shaks ki si hai jiss ney aik aag roshan ki ,   phir jab uss ( aag ney ) uss kay mahol ko roshan kerdiya to Allah ney unn ka noor salb kerliya aur unhen andheriyon mein chorr diya kay unhen kuch sujhai nahi deta

ayahs.text: woh behray hain , goongay hain , andhay hain , chunacheh abb woh wapis nahi ayen gay
ayahs.translation: woh behray hain , goongay hain , andhay hain , chunacheh abb woh wapis nahi ayen gay

ayahs.text: ya phir ( inn munafiqon ki misal aesi hai )   jaisay aasman say barasti aik barish ho , jiss mein andheriyan bhi hon , aur garaj bhi aur chamak bhi . woh karrkon ki aawaz per moat kay khof say apni ungliyan apney kanon mein dey letay hain . aur Allah ney kafiron ko gheray mein   ley rakha hai
ayahs.translation: ya phir ( inn munafiqon ki misal aesi hai )   jaisay aasman say barasti aik barish ho , jiss mein andheriyan bhi hon , aur garaj bhi aur chamak bhi . woh karrkon ki aawaz per moat kay khof say apni ungliyan apney kanon mein dey letay hain . aur Allah ney kafiron ko gheray mein   ley rakha hai

ayahs.text: aisa lagta hai kay bijli unn ki aankhon ko uchak ley jaye gi . jab bhi bijli unn kay liye roshni ker-deti hai , woh uss ( roshni ) mein chal parrtay hain , aur jab woh unn per andhera ker-deti hai to kharray reh jatay hain , aur agar Allah chahta to unn kay sunney aur dekhney ki taqaten cheen leta , beyshak Allah her cheez per qudrat rakhta hai
ayahs.translation: aisa lagta hai kay bijli unn ki aankhon ko uchak ley jaye gi . jab bhi bijli unn kay liye roshni ker-deti hai , woh uss ( roshni ) mein chal parrtay hain , aur jab woh unn per andhera ker-deti hai to kharray reh jatay hain , aur agar Allah chahta to unn kay sunney aur dekhney ki taqaten cheen leta , beyshak Allah her cheez per qudrat rakhta hai

ayahs.text: aey logo ! apney uss perwerdigar ki ibadat kero jiss ney tumhen aur unn logon  ko peda kiya jo tum say pehlay guzray hain , takay tum muttaqi ban jao
ayahs.translation: aey logo ! apney uss perwerdigar ki ibadat kero jiss ney tumhen aur unn logon  ko peda kiya jo tum say pehlay guzray hain , takay tum muttaqi ban jao

ayahs.text: . ( woh perwerdigar ) jiss ney tumharay liye zameen ko bichona banaya , aur aasman ko chhat aur aasman say paani barsaya , phir iss kay zariye tumharay rizq kay tor per phal nikalay , lehaza Allah kay sath shareek naa thehrao , jabkay tum ( yeh sabb baaten ) jantay ho
ayahs.translation: . ( woh perwerdigar ) jiss ney tumharay liye zameen ko bichona banaya , aur aasman ko chhat aur aasman say paani barsaya , phir iss kay zariye tumharay rizq kay tor per phal nikalay , lehaza Allah kay sath shareek naa thehrao , jabkay tum ( yeh sabb baaten ) jantay ho

ayahs.text: aur agar tum iss( Quran ) kay baaray mein zara bhi shak mein ho jo hum ney apney banday Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) per utaara hai , to iss jaisi koi aik surat hi bana lao , aur agar sachay ho to Allah kay siwa apney tamam madad gaaron ko bulalo
ayahs.translation: aur agar tum iss( Quran ) kay baaray mein zara bhi shak mein ho jo hum ney apney banday Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) per utaara hai , to iss jaisi koi aik surat hi bana lao , aur agar sachay ho to Allah kay siwa apney tamam madad gaaron ko bulalo

ayahs.text: phir bhi agar tum yeh kaam naa ker-sako , aur yaqeenan kabhi nahi ker-sako gay , to daro uss aag say jiss ka endhan insan aur pathar hon gay , woh kafiron kay liye tayyar ki gaee hai .
ayahs.translation: phir bhi agar tum yeh kaam naa ker-sako , aur yaqeenan kabhi nahi ker-sako gay , to daro uss aag say jiss ka endhan insan aur pathar hon gay , woh kafiron kay liye tayyar ki gaee hai .

ayahs.text: aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ko khushkhabri dey do kay unn kay liye aesay baaghaat ( tayyar ) hain jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi ,   jab kabhi unn ko unn ( baaghaat ) mein say koi phal rizq kay tor per diya jaye ga , to woh kahen gay " yeh to wohi hai jo hamen pehlay bhi diya gaya tha   aur unhen woh rizq aisa hi diya jaye ga jo dekhney mein milta julta hoga ,   aur unn kay liye wahan pakeezah biwiyan hon gi , aur woh unn ( baaghaat ) mein hamesha hamesha rahen gay
ayahs.translation: aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ko khushkhabri dey do kay unn kay liye aesay baaghaat ( tayyar ) hain jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi ,   jab kabhi unn ko unn ( baaghaat ) mein say koi phal rizq kay tor per diya jaye ga , to woh kahen gay " yeh to wohi hai jo hamen pehlay bhi diya gaya tha   aur unhen woh rizq aisa hi diya jaye ga jo dekhney mein milta julta hoga ,   aur unn kay liye wahan pakeezah biwiyan hon gi , aur woh unn ( baaghaat ) mein hamesha hamesha rahen gay

ayahs.text: beyshak Allah iss baat say nahi sharmata kay woh ( kissi baat ko wazeh kernay kay liye ) koi bhi misal dey , chahye woh machar ( jaisi mamooli cheez ) ki ho , ya kissi aesi cheez ki jo machar say bhi ziyada ( mamooli ) ho ,   abb jo log momin hain woh khoob jantay hain kay yeh misal aik haq baat hai jo unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say aai hai . albatta jo log kafir hain woh yehi kehtay hain kay bhala iss ( haqeer ) misal say Allah ka kiya matlab hai-? ( iss tarah ) Allah iss misal say boht say logon  ko gumrahi mein mubtala kerta hai , aur boht so ko hidayat deta hai . ( magar ) woh gumrah unhi ko kerta hai jo nafarman hain
ayahs.translation: beyshak Allah iss baat say nahi sharmata kay woh ( kissi baat ko wazeh kernay kay liye ) koi bhi misal dey , chahye woh machar ( jaisi mamooli cheez ) ki ho , ya kissi aesi cheez ki jo machar say bhi ziyada ( mamooli ) ho ,   abb jo log momin hain woh khoob jantay hain kay yeh misal aik haq baat hai jo unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say aai hai . albatta jo log kafir hain woh yehi kehtay hain kay bhala iss ( haqeer ) misal say Allah ka kiya matlab hai-? ( iss tarah ) Allah iss misal say boht say logon  ko gumrahi mein mubtala kerta hai , aur boht so ko hidayat deta hai . ( magar ) woh gumrah unhi ko kerta hai jo nafarman hain

ayahs.text: woh jo Allah say kiye huye ehad ko pukhta kernay kay baad bhi torr detay hain ,   aur jinn rishton ko Allah ney jorrney ka hukum diya hai , unhen kaat daaltay hain aur zameen mein fasad machatay hain ,   aesay hi log bara nuqsan uthaney walay hain
ayahs.translation: woh jo Allah say kiye huye ehad ko pukhta kernay kay baad bhi torr detay hain ,   aur jinn rishton ko Allah ney jorrney ka hukum diya hai , unhen kaat daaltay hain aur zameen mein fasad machatay hain ,   aesay hi log bara nuqsan uthaney walay hain

ayahs.text: tum Allah kay sath kufr ka tarz-e-amal aakhir kaisay ikhtiyar kerletay ho , halankay tum bey jaan thay , ussi ney tumhen zindagi bakhshi , phir wohi tumhen moat dey ga , phir wohi tum ko ( dobara ) zinda keray ga , aur phir tum ussi kay paas lot ker jao gay
ayahs.translation: tum Allah kay sath kufr ka tarz-e-amal aakhir kaisay ikhtiyar kerletay ho , halankay tum bey jaan thay , ussi ney tumhen zindagi bakhshi , phir wohi tumhen moat dey ga , phir wohi tum ko ( dobara ) zinda keray ga , aur phir tum ussi kay paas lot ker jao gay

ayahs.text: wohi hai jiss ney zameen mein jo kuch hai tumharay liye peda kiya ,   phir woh aasman ki taraf mutawajjah huwa , chunacheh unn ko saat aasmano ki shakal mein theek theek banadiya , aur woh her cheez ka poora ilm rakhney wala hai
ayahs.translation: wohi hai jiss ney zameen mein jo kuch hai tumharay liye peda kiya ,   phir woh aasman ki taraf mutawajjah huwa , chunacheh unn ko saat aasmano ki shakal mein theek theek banadiya , aur woh her cheez ka poora ilm rakhney wala hai

ayahs.text: aur ( uss waqt ka tazkarah suno ) jab tumharay perwerdigar ney farishton say kaha kay mein zameen mein aik khalifa bananey wala hun ,   woh kehney lagay :  kiya aap zameen mein aesi makhlooq peda keren gay jo uss mein fasad machaye , aur khoon kharaba keray , halankay hum aap ki tasbeeh aur hamd o taqdees mein lagay huye hain ?    Allah ney kaha :  mein woh baaten janta hun jo tum nahi jantay
ayahs.translation: aur ( uss waqt ka tazkarah suno ) jab tumharay perwerdigar ney farishton say kaha kay mein zameen mein aik khalifa bananey wala hun ,   woh kehney lagay :  kiya aap zameen mein aesi makhlooq peda keren gay jo uss mein fasad machaye , aur khoon kharaba keray , halankay hum aap ki tasbeeh aur hamd o taqdees mein lagay huye hain ?    Allah ney kaha :  mein woh baaten janta hun jo tum nahi jantay

ayahs.text: aur Adam ko ( Allah ney ) saray kay saray naam sikha-diye ,   phir unn ko farishton kay samney paish kiya aur ( unn say ) kaha :  agar tum sachay ho to mujhay inn cheezon kay naam to batlao
ayahs.translation: aur Adam ko ( Allah ney ) saray kay saray naam sikha-diye ,   phir unn ko farishton kay samney paish kiya aur ( unn say ) kaha :  agar tum sachay ho to mujhay inn cheezon kay naam to batlao

ayahs.text: woh bol uthay : aap hi ki zaat pak hai , jo kuch ilm aap ney hamen diya hai uss kay siwa hum kuch nahi jantay .   haqeeqat mein ilm o hikmat kay malik to sirf aap hain
ayahs.translation: woh bol uthay : aap hi ki zaat pak hai , jo kuch ilm aap ney hamen diya hai uss kay siwa hum kuch nahi jantay .   haqeeqat mein ilm o hikmat kay malik to sirf aap hain

ayahs.text: Allah ney kaha :  Adam ! tum inn ko inn cheezon kay naam batado  chunacheh jab uss ney unn kay naam unn ko batadiye to Allah ney ( farishton say ) kaha :  kiya mein ney tum say nahi kaha tha kay mein aasmano aur zameen kay bhed janta hun-? aur jo kuch tum zahir kertay ho aur jo kuch tum chupatay ho mujhay uss sabb ka ilm hai
ayahs.translation: Allah ney kaha :  Adam ! tum inn ko inn cheezon kay naam batado  chunacheh jab uss ney unn kay naam unn ko batadiye to Allah ney ( farishton say ) kaha :  kiya mein ney tum say nahi kaha tha kay mein aasmano aur zameen kay bhed janta hun-? aur jo kuch tum zahir kertay ho aur jo kuch tum chupatay ho mujhay uss sabb ka ilm hai

ayahs.text: aur ( uss waqt ka tazkarah suno ) jab hum ney farishton say kaha kay :  Adam ko sajda kero ,   chunacheh sabb ney sajda kiya , siwaye iblees kay kay uss ney inkar kiya ,   aur mutakabbirana ravaiyya ikhtiyar kiya aur kafiron mein shamil hogaya
ayahs.translation: aur ( uss waqt ka tazkarah suno ) jab hum ney farishton say kaha kay :  Adam ko sajda kero ,   chunacheh sabb ney sajda kiya , siwaye iblees kay kay uss ney inkar kiya ,   aur mutakabbirana ravaiyya ikhtiyar kiya aur kafiron mein shamil hogaya

ayahs.text: aur hum ney kaha :  Adam ! tum aur tumhari biwi jannat mein raho , aur uss mein say jahan say chahao ji bhar kay khao , magar iss darkht kay paas bhi matt jana ,   werna tum zalimon mein shumar hogay .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney kaha :  Adam ! tum aur tumhari biwi jannat mein raho , aur uss mein say jahan say chahao ji bhar kay khao , magar iss darkht kay paas bhi matt jana ,   werna tum zalimon mein shumar hogay .

ayahs.text: phir huwa yeh kay shetan ney unn dono ko wahan say dagmaga diya , aur jiss ( aesh ) mein woh thay uss say unhen nikal ker raha   aur hum ney ( Adam , unn ki biwi aur iblees say ) kaha :  abb tum sabb yahan say utar jao , tum aik doosray kay dushman hogay , aur tumharay liye aik mauddat tak zameen mein thehrna aur kissi qadar faeeda uthana ( tey kerdiya gaya ) hai
ayahs.translation: phir huwa yeh kay shetan ney unn dono ko wahan say dagmaga diya , aur jiss ( aesh ) mein woh thay uss say unhen nikal ker raha   aur hum ney ( Adam , unn ki biwi aur iblees say ) kaha :  abb tum sabb yahan say utar jao , tum aik doosray kay dushman hogay , aur tumharay liye aik mauddat tak zameen mein thehrna aur kissi qadar faeeda uthana ( tey kerdiya gaya ) hai

ayahs.text: phir Adam ney apney perwerdigar say ( tauba kay ) kuch alfaz seekh liye ( jinn kay zariye unhon ney tauba maangi ) chunacheh Allah ney unn ki tauba qubool kerli .   beyshak woh boht moaaf kernay wala , bara meharban hai
ayahs.translation: phir Adam ney apney perwerdigar say ( tauba kay ) kuch alfaz seekh liye ( jinn kay zariye unhon ney tauba maangi ) chunacheh Allah ney unn ki tauba qubool kerli .   beyshak woh boht moaaf kernay wala , bara meharban hai

ayahs.text: hum ney :  kaha abb tum sabb yahan say utar jao . phir agar meri taraf say koi hidayat tumhen phonchay , to jo log meri hidayat ki perwi keren gay , unn ko naa koi khof hoga , aur naa woh kissi ghum mein mubtala hon gay .
ayahs.translation: hum ney :  kaha abb tum sabb yahan say utar jao . phir agar meri taraf say koi hidayat tumhen phonchay , to jo log meri hidayat ki perwi keren gay , unn ko naa koi khof hoga , aur naa woh kissi ghum mein mubtala hon gay .

ayahs.text: aur jo log kufr ka irtikab keren gay aur humari aayaton ko jhutlayen gay woh dozakh walay log hain jahan woh hamesha rahen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log kufr ka irtikab keren gay aur humari aayaton ko jhutlayen gay woh dozakh walay log hain jahan woh hamesha rahen gay .

ayahs.text: aey bani Israel ! meri woh naimat yaad karo jo mein ney tum ko ata ki thi , aur tum mujh say kiya huwa ehad poora karo , takay mein bhi tum say kiya huwa ehad poora karun , aur tum ( kissi aur say nahi , balkay ) sirf mujhi say daro
ayahs.translation: aey bani Israel ! meri woh naimat yaad karo jo mein ney tum ko ata ki thi , aur tum mujh say kiya huwa ehad poora karo , takay mein bhi tum say kiya huwa ehad poora karun , aur tum ( kissi aur say nahi , balkay ) sirf mujhi say daro

ayahs.text: aur jo kalam mein ney nazil kiya hai uss per emaan lao , jabkay woh uss kitab ( yani toraat ) ki tasdeeq bhi ker-raha hai jo tumharay paas hai , aur tum hi sabb say pehlay iss kay munkir naa ban jao . aur meri aayaton ko mamooli si qeemat ley ker naa becho , aur ( kissi aur kay bajaye ) sirf mera khof dil mein rakho
ayahs.translation: aur jo kalam mein ney nazil kiya hai uss per emaan lao , jabkay woh uss kitab ( yani toraat ) ki tasdeeq bhi ker-raha hai jo tumharay paas hai , aur tum hi sabb say pehlay iss kay munkir naa ban jao . aur meri aayaton ko mamooli si qeemat ley ker naa becho , aur ( kissi aur kay bajaye ) sirf mera khof dil mein rakho

ayahs.text: aur haq ko batil kay sath gaddmadd naa kero , aur naa haq baat ko chupao jabkay ( asal haqeeqat ) tum achi tarah jantay ho
ayahs.translation: aur haq ko batil kay sath gaddmadd naa kero , aur naa haq baat ko chupao jabkay ( asal haqeeqat ) tum achi tarah jantay ho

ayahs.text: aur namaz qaeem karo , aur zakat ada karo , aur rukoo kernay walon kay sath rukoo karo
ayahs.translation: aur namaz qaeem karo , aur zakat ada karo , aur rukoo kernay walon kay sath rukoo karo

ayahs.text: kiya tum ( doosray ) logon  ko to naiki ka hukum detay ho , aur khud apney aap ko bhool jatay ho-? halankay tum kitab ki tilawat bhi kertay ho ! kiya tumhen itni bhi samajh nahi-?
ayahs.translation: kiya tum ( doosray ) logon  ko to naiki ka hukum detay ho , aur khud apney aap ko bhool jatay ho-? halankay tum kitab ki tilawat bhi kertay ho ! kiya tumhen itni bhi samajh nahi-?

ayahs.text: aur sabar aur namaz say madad hasil kero . namaz bhari zaroor maloom hoti hai , magar unn logon  ko nahi jo khushoo ( yani dhiyan aur aajzi ) say parhtay hain
ayahs.translation: aur sabar aur namaz say madad hasil kero . namaz bhari zaroor maloom hoti hai , magar unn logon  ko nahi jo khushoo ( yani dhiyan aur aajzi ) say parhtay hain

ayahs.text: jo iss baat ka khayal rakhtay hain kay woh apney perwerdigar say milney walay hain , aur unn ko ussi ki taraf lot ker jana hai
ayahs.translation: jo iss baat ka khayal rakhtay hain kay woh apney perwerdigar say milney walay hain , aur unn ko ussi ki taraf lot ker jana hai

ayahs.text: aey bani Israel ! meri woh naimat yaad karo jo mein ney tum ko ata ki thi , aur yeh baat ( yaad kero ) kay mein ney tum ko saray jahano per fazilat di thi
ayahs.translation: aey bani Israel ! meri woh naimat yaad karo jo mein ney tum ko ata ki thi , aur yeh baat ( yaad kero ) kay mein ney tum ko saray jahano per fazilat di thi

ayahs.text: aur uss din say daro , jiss din koi shaks bhi kissi kay kuch kaam nahi aaye ga , naa kissi say koi sifarish qubool ki jaye gi , naa kissi say kissi qisam ka fidya liya jaye ga , aur naa unn ko koi madad phonchay gi
ayahs.translation: aur uss din say daro , jiss din koi shaks bhi kissi kay kuch kaam nahi aaye ga , naa kissi say koi sifarish qubool ki jaye gi , naa kissi say kissi qisam ka fidya liya jaye ga , aur naa unn ko koi madad phonchay gi

ayahs.text: aur woh ( waqt yaad kero ) jab hum ney tum ko firon kay logon  say najat di jo tumhen bara azab detay thay , tumharay beton ko zabah ker daaltay aur tumhari aurton ko zinda rakhtay thay .   aur iss sari soorat-e-haal mein tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say tumhara bara imtihan tha .
ayahs.translation: aur woh ( waqt yaad kero ) jab hum ney tum ko firon kay logon  say najat di jo tumhen bara azab detay thay , tumharay beton ko zabah ker daaltay aur tumhari aurton ko zinda rakhtay thay .   aur iss sari soorat-e-haal mein tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say tumhara bara imtihan tha .

ayahs.text: aur ( yaad karo ) jab hum ney tumhari khatir samandar ko phaarr daala tha , chunacheh tum sabb ko bachaliya tha aur firon kay logon  ko ( samandar mein ) gharq ker daala tha   aur tum yeh sara nazara dekh rahey thay
ayahs.translation: aur ( yaad karo ) jab hum ney tumhari khatir samandar ko phaarr daala tha , chunacheh tum sabb ko bachaliya tha aur firon kay logon  ko ( samandar mein ) gharq ker daala tha   aur tum yeh sara nazara dekh rahey thay

ayahs.text: aur ( woh waqt yaad kero ) jab hum ney musa say chaalees raaton ka wada thehraya tha , phir tum ney unn kay peechay ( apni janon per ) zulm kerkay bachrray ko mabood bana-liya
ayahs.translation: aur ( woh waqt yaad kero ) jab hum ney musa say chaalees raaton ka wada thehraya tha , phir tum ney unn kay peechay ( apni janon per ) zulm kerkay bachrray ko mabood bana-liya

ayahs.text: phir iss sabb kay baad bhi hum ney tum ko moaaf kerdiya takay tum shukar ada karo
ayahs.translation: phir iss sabb kay baad bhi hum ney tum ko moaaf kerdiya takay tum shukar ada karo

ayahs.text: aur ( yaad kero ) jab hum ney musa ko kitab di , aur haq o batil mein tameez ka mayaar ( bakhsha ) takay tum raah-e-raast per aao
ayahs.translation: aur ( yaad kero ) jab hum ney musa ko kitab di , aur haq o batil mein tameez ka mayaar ( bakhsha ) takay tum raah-e-raast per aao

ayahs.text: aur jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay " aey meri qoam ! haqeeqat mein tum ney bachrray ko mabood bana ker khud apni janon per zulm kiya hai , lehaza abb apney khaliq say tauba karo aur apney aap ko qatal kero . tumharay khaliq kay nazdeek yehi tumharay haq mein behtar hai .  iss tarah Allah ney tumhari tauba qubool kerli . bey shak wohi hai jo itna moaaf kernay wala , itna reham kernay wala hai
ayahs.translation: aur jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay " aey meri qoam ! haqeeqat mein tum ney bachrray ko mabood bana ker khud apni janon per zulm kiya hai , lehaza abb apney khaliq say tauba karo aur apney aap ko qatal kero . tumharay khaliq kay nazdeek yehi tumharay haq mein behtar hai .  iss tarah Allah ney tumhari tauba qubool kerli . bey shak wohi hai jo itna moaaf kernay wala , itna reham kernay wala hai

ayahs.text: aur jab tum ney kaha tha ! aey musa hum uss waqt tak hergiz tumhara yaqeen nahi keren gay jab tak Allah ko hum khud khuli aankhon naa dekh len  nateeja yeh huwa kay karrkay ney tumhen iss tarah aa pakra kay tum dekhtay reh gaye
ayahs.translation: aur jab tum ney kaha tha ! aey musa hum uss waqt tak hergiz tumhara yaqeen nahi keren gay jab tak Allah ko hum khud khuli aankhon naa dekh len  nateeja yeh huwa kay karrkay ney tumhen iss tarah aa pakra kay tum dekhtay reh gaye

ayahs.text: phir hum ney tumhen tumharay marney kay baad doosri zindagi di takay tum shukar guzaar bano
ayahs.translation: phir hum ney tumhen tumharay marney kay baad doosri zindagi di takay tum shukar guzaar bano

ayahs.text: aur hum ney tum ko badal ka saya ata kiya , aur tum per mann-o-salwa nazil kiya ( aur kaha kay : ) jo pakeezah rizq hum ney tumhen bakhsha hai ( shoq say ) khao   aur yeh ( nafarmaniyan kerkay ) unhon ney humara kuch nahi bigaara , balkay woh khud apni janon per hi zulm kertay rahey
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney tum ko badal ka saya ata kiya , aur tum per mann-o-salwa nazil kiya ( aur kaha kay : ) jo pakeezah rizq hum ney tumhen bakhsha hai ( shoq say ) khao   aur yeh ( nafarmaniyan kerkay ) unhon ney humara kuch nahi bigaara , balkay woh khud apni janon per hi zulm kertay rahey

ayahs.text: aur ( woh waqt bhi yaad kero ) jab hum ney kaha tha kay : "" iss basti mein dakhil hojao aur iss mein jahan say chahao ji bhar ker khao , aur ( basti kay ) darwazay mein jhukay saron kay sath dakhil hona , aur yeh kehtay jana kay ( ya-Allah ! ) hum aap ki bakhshish kay talab gaar hain , ( iss tarah ) hum tumhari khatayen moaaf kerden gay , aur naiki kernay walon ko aur ziyada ( sawab ) bhi den gay .
ayahs.translation: aur ( woh waqt bhi yaad kero ) jab hum ney kaha tha kay : "" iss basti mein dakhil hojao aur iss mein jahan say chahao ji bhar ker khao , aur ( basti kay ) darwazay mein jhukay saron kay sath dakhil hona , aur yeh kehtay jana kay ( ya-Allah ! ) hum aap ki bakhshish kay talab gaar hain , ( iss tarah ) hum tumhari khatayen moaaf kerden gay , aur naiki kernay walon ko aur ziyada ( sawab ) bhi den gay .

ayahs.text: magar huwa yeh kay jo baat unn say kahi gaee thi , zalimon ney ussay badal ker aik aur baat banali .   nateeja yeh kay jo nafarmaniyan woh kertay aarahey thay hum ney unn ki saza mein unn zalimon per aasman say azab nazil kiya
ayahs.translation: magar huwa yeh kay jo baat unn say kahi gaee thi , zalimon ney ussay badal ker aik aur baat banali .   nateeja yeh kay jo nafarmaniyan woh kertay aarahey thay hum ney unn ki saza mein unn zalimon per aasman say azab nazil kiya

ayahs.text: aur ( woh waqt bhi yaad kero ) jab musa ney apni qoam kay liye paani maanga to hum ney kaha :  apni laathi pathar per maaro   chunacheh iss ( pathar ) say baara chashmay phoot niklay .   her aik qabeelay ney apney paani lenay ki jagah maloom kerli . ( hum ney kaha : ) Allah ka diya huwa rizq khao piyo , aur zameen mein fasad machatay matt phirna .
ayahs.translation: aur ( woh waqt bhi yaad kero ) jab musa ney apni qoam kay liye paani maanga to hum ney kaha :  apni laathi pathar per maaro   chunacheh iss ( pathar ) say baara chashmay phoot niklay .   her aik qabeelay ney apney paani lenay ki jagah maloom kerli . ( hum ney kaha : ) Allah ka diya huwa rizq khao piyo , aur zameen mein fasad machatay matt phirna .

ayahs.text: aur ( woh waqt bhi ) jab tum ney kaha tha kay aey musa ! hum aik hi khaney per sabar nahi ker-saktay , lehaza humari khatir apney perwerdigar say maangiye kay woh humaray liye kuch woh cheezen peda keray jo zameen ugaya kerti hai , yani zameen ki tarkariyan , uss ki kakriyan , uss ka gandum , uss ki daalen aur uss ki piyaz . musa ney kaha : " jo ( ghiza ) behtar thi kiya tum uss ko aesi cheezon say badalna chahtay ho jo ghatiya darjay ki hain-? ( khair ! ) aik shehar mein jaa utro , to wahan tumhen woh cheezen mil jayen gi jo tum ney maangi hain .    aur unn ( yahudiyon ) per zillat aur beykasi ka thappa lagadiya gaya , aur woh Allah ka ghazab ley ker lotay . yeh sabb iss liye huwa kay woh Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kertay thay aur payghumberon ko nahaq qatal ker-detay thay . yeh sabb iss liye huwa kay unhon ney nafarmani ki , aur woh beyhad ziyadtiyan kertay thay .
