( khair ! ) aik shehar mein jaa utro , to wahan tumhen woh cheezen mil jayen gi jo tum ney maangi hain .    aur unn ( yahudiyon ) per zillat aur beykasi ka thappa lagadiya gaya , aur woh Allah ka ghazab ley ker lotay . yeh sabb iss liye huwa kay woh Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kertay thay aur payghumberon ko nahaq qatal ker-detay thay . yeh sabb iss liye huwa kay unhon ney nafarmani ki , aur woh beyhad ziyadtiyan kertay thay .

ayahs.text: haq to yeh hai kay jo log bhi , khuwa woh musalman hon ya yahudi ya nasrani ya saabi , Allah aur aakhirat kay din per emaan ley ayen gay aur naik amal keren gay , woh apney perwerdigar kay paas apney ajar kay mustahiq hon gay , aur unn ko naa koi khof hoga , naa woh kissi ghum mein mubtala hon gay .
ayahs.translation: haq to yeh hai kay jo log bhi , khuwa woh musalman hon ya yahudi ya nasrani ya saabi , Allah aur aakhirat kay din per emaan ley ayen gay aur naik amal keren gay , woh apney perwerdigar kay paas apney ajar kay mustahiq hon gay , aur unn ko naa koi khof hoga , naa woh kissi ghum mein mubtala hon gay .

ayahs.text: aur wo waqt yaad karo jab hum ney tum say ( toraat per amal kernay ka ) ehad liya tha , aur koh-e-toor ko tumharay oopper utha kharra kiya tha ( kay ) jo ( kitab ) hum ney tumhen di hai uss ko mazbooti say thaamo ,   aur uss mein jo kuch ( likha ) hai uss ko yaad rakho , takay tumhen taqwa hasil ho
ayahs.translation: aur wo waqt yaad karo jab hum ney tum say ( toraat per amal kernay ka ) ehad liya tha , aur koh-e-toor ko tumharay oopper utha kharra kiya tha ( kay ) jo ( kitab ) hum ney tumhen di hai uss ko mazbooti say thaamo ,   aur uss mein jo kuch ( likha ) hai uss ko yaad rakho , takay tumhen taqwa hasil ho

ayahs.text: iss sabb kay bawajood tum dobara ( raah-e-raast say ) phir gaye . chunacheh agar Allah ka fazal aur rehmat tum per naa hoti to tum zaroor sakht nuqsan uthaney walon mein shamil hojatay .
ayahs.translation: iss sabb kay bawajood tum dobara ( raah-e-raast say ) phir gaye . chunacheh agar Allah ka fazal aur rehmat tum per naa hoti to tum zaroor sakht nuqsan uthaney walon mein shamil hojatay .

ayahs.text: aur tum apney unn logon  ko achi tarah jantay ho jo saneechar ( sabt ) kay moamlay mein hadd say guzar gaye thay , chunacheh hum ney unn say kaha tha kay tum dhutkaray huye bandar ban jao
ayahs.translation: aur tum apney unn logon  ko achi tarah jantay ho jo saneechar ( sabt ) kay moamlay mein hadd say guzar gaye thay , chunacheh hum ney unn say kaha tha kay tum dhutkaray huye bandar ban jao

ayahs.text: phir hum ney iss waqaey ko uss zamaney kay aur uss kay baad kay logon  kay liye ibrat , aur darney walon kay liye naseehat ka saman banadiya
ayahs.translation: phir hum ney iss waqaey ko uss zamaney kay aur uss kay baad kay logon  kay liye ibrat , aur darney walon kay liye naseehat ka saman banadiya

ayahs.text: aur ( wo waqt yaad kero ) jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay Allah tumhen hukum deta hai kay tum aik gaye zibah kero . woh kehney lagay kay kiya aap humara mazaq banatay hain-?   musa ney kaha : mein iss baat say Allah ki panah maangta hun kay mein ( aesay ) nadanon mein shamil hun ( jo mazaq mein jhoot bolen )
ayahs.translation: aur ( wo waqt yaad kero ) jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay Allah tumhen hukum deta hai kay tum aik gaye zibah kero . woh kehney lagay kay kiya aap humara mazaq banatay hain-?   musa ney kaha : mein iss baat say Allah ki panah maangta hun kay mein ( aesay ) nadanon mein shamil hun ( jo mazaq mein jhoot bolen )

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha kay aap humari khatir apney rab say darkhuwast kijiye kay hamen saaf saaf bataye kay woh gaye kaisi ho-? uss ney kaha :  Allah farmata hai kay woh aesi gaye ho kay naa boht boorhi ho naa bilkul bachi , ( balkay ) inn dono kay bech bech mein ho . bus abb jo hukum tumhen diya gaya hai uss per amal kerlo .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha kay aap humari khatir apney rab say darkhuwast kijiye kay hamen saaf saaf bataye kay woh gaye kaisi ho-? uss ney kaha :  Allah farmata hai kay woh aesi gaye ho kay naa boht boorhi ho naa bilkul bachi , ( balkay ) inn dono kay bech bech mein ho . bus abb jo hukum tumhen diya gaya hai uss per amal kerlo .

ayahs.text: kehney lagay : aap humari khatir apney rab say darkhuwast kijiye kay hamen saaf saaf bataye kay uss ka rang kaisa ho-? musa ney kaha : Allah farmata hai kay woh aesay tez zard rang ki gaye ho jo dekhney walon ka dil khush kerday .
ayahs.translation: kehney lagay : aap humari khatir apney rab say darkhuwast kijiye kay hamen saaf saaf bataye kay uss ka rang kaisa ho-? musa ney kaha : Allah farmata hai kay woh aesay tez zard rang ki gaye ho jo dekhney walon ka dil khush kerday .

ayahs.text: unhon ney ( phir ) kaha kay aap humari khatir apney rab say darkhuwast kijiye kay hamen saaf saaf bataye kay woh gaye kaisi ho-? iss gaye ney to hamen shubhay mein daal diya hai . aur Allah ney chaha to hum zaroor iss ka pata lagalen gay .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney ( phir ) kaha kay aap humari khatir apney rab say darkhuwast kijiye kay hamen saaf saaf bataye kay woh gaye kaisi ho-? iss gaye ney to hamen shubhay mein daal diya hai . aur Allah ney chaha to hum zaroor iss ka pata lagalen gay .

ayahs.text: musa ney kaha : Allah farmata hai kay woh aesi gaye ho jo kaam mein jutt ker zameen naa gahati ho , aur naa kheti ko paani deti ho , poori tarah sahih saalim ho jiss mein koi dagh naa ho . unhon ney kaha : haan ! abb aap theek theek pata ley ker aaye . iss kay baad unhon ney ussay zibah kiya , jabkay lagta nahi tha kay woh ker payen gay .
ayahs.translation: musa ney kaha : Allah farmata hai kay woh aesi gaye ho jo kaam mein jutt ker zameen naa gahati ho , aur naa kheti ko paani deti ho , poori tarah sahih saalim ho jiss mein koi dagh naa ho . unhon ney kaha : haan ! abb aap theek theek pata ley ker aaye . iss kay baad unhon ney ussay zibah kiya , jabkay lagta nahi tha kay woh ker payen gay .

ayahs.text: aur ( yaad karo ) jab tum ney aik shaks ko qatal kerdiya tha , aur uss kay baad uss ka ilzam aik doosray per daal rahey thay , aur Allah ko woh raaz nikal bahir kerna tha jo tum chupaye huye thay .
ayahs.translation: aur ( yaad karo ) jab tum ney aik shaks ko qatal kerdiya tha , aur uss kay baad uss ka ilzam aik doosray per daal rahey thay , aur Allah ko woh raaz nikal bahir kerna tha jo tum chupaye huye thay .

ayahs.text: chunacheh hum ney kaha kay uss ( maqtool ) ko uss ( gaye ) kay aik hissay say maaro .   issi tarah Allah murdon ko zinda kerta hai , aur tumhen ( apni qudrat ki ) nishaniyan dikhata hai takay tum samajh sako .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh hum ney kaha kay uss ( maqtool ) ko uss ( gaye ) kay aik hissay say maaro .   issi tarah Allah murdon ko zinda kerta hai , aur tumhen ( apni qudrat ki ) nishaniyan dikhata hai takay tum samajh sako .

ayahs.text: iss sabb kay baad tumharay dil phir sakht hogaye , yahan tak kay woh aesay hogaye jaisay pathar ! balkay sakhti mein kuch unn say bhi ziyada . ( kiyonkay ) pathraon mein say kuch aesay bhi hotay hain jinn say nehren phoot behti hain , aur unhi mein say kuch woh hotay hain jo khud phatt parrtay hain aur unn say paani nikal aata hai , aur unhi mein woh ( pathar ) bhi hain jo Allah kay khof say lurhak jatay hain .   . aur ( iss kay bar-khilaf ) jo kuch tum ker rahey ho , Allah uss say bey khabar nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: iss sabb kay baad tumharay dil phir sakht hogaye , yahan tak kay woh aesay hogaye jaisay pathar ! balkay sakhti mein kuch unn say bhi ziyada . ( kiyonkay ) pathraon mein say kuch aesay bhi hotay hain jinn say nehren phoot behti hain , aur unhi mein say kuch woh hotay hain jo khud phatt parrtay hain aur unn say paani nikal aata hai , aur unhi mein woh ( pathar ) bhi hain jo Allah kay khof say lurhak jatay hain .   . aur ( iss kay bar-khilaf ) jo kuch tum ker rahey ho , Allah uss say bey khabar nahi hai .

ayahs.text: . ( musalmano ! ) kiya abb bhi tumhen yeh lalach hai kay yeh log tumharay kehney say emaan ley ayen gay-? halankay inn mein say aik giroh kay log Allah ka kalam suntay thay , phir uss ko achi tarah samajhney kay baad bhi jantay boojhtay uss mein tehreef kar daaltay thay .
ayahs.translation: . ( musalmano ! ) kiya abb bhi tumhen yeh lalach hai kay yeh log tumharay kehney say emaan ley ayen gay-? halankay inn mein say aik giroh kay log Allah ka kalam suntay thay , phir uss ko achi tarah samajhney kay baad bhi jantay boojhtay uss mein tehreef kar daaltay thay .

ayahs.text: aur jab yeh log inn ( musalmanon ) say miltay hain jo pehlay emaan laa-chukay hain to ( zaban say ) keh detay hain kay hum ( bhi ) emaan ley aaye hain , aur jab yeh aik doosray kay sath tanhai mein jatay hain to ( aapas mein aik doosray say ) kehtay hain kay :  kiya tum inn ( musalmanon ) ko woh baaten batatay ho jo Allah taalaa ney tum per kholi hain takay yeh ( musalman ) tumharay perwerdigar kay paas jaker enhe tumharay khilaf daleel kay tor per paish keren-?   kiya tumhen itni bhi aqal nahi ?
ayahs.translation: aur jab yeh log inn ( musalmanon ) say miltay hain jo pehlay emaan laa-chukay hain to ( zaban say ) keh detay hain kay hum ( bhi ) emaan ley aaye hain , aur jab yeh aik doosray kay sath tanhai mein jatay hain to ( aapas mein aik doosray say ) kehtay hain kay :  kiya tum inn ( musalmanon ) ko woh baaten batatay ho jo Allah taalaa ney tum per kholi hain takay yeh ( musalman ) tumharay perwerdigar kay paas jaker enhe tumharay khilaf daleel kay tor per paish keren-?   kiya tumhen itni bhi aqal nahi ?

ayahs.text: kiya yeh log ( jo aesi baaten kertay hain ) yeh nahi jantay kay Allah ko unn sari baaton ka khoob ilm hai , jo woh chupatay hain aur jo woh zahir kertay hain ?
ayahs.translation: kiya yeh log ( jo aesi baaten kertay hain ) yeh nahi jantay kay Allah ko unn sari baaton ka khoob ilm hai , jo woh chupatay hain aur jo woh zahir kertay hain ?

ayahs.text: aur inn mein say kuch log ann parh hain jo kitab ( toraat ) ka ilm to rakhtay nahi , albatta kuch aarzooyen pakaye bethay hain , aur unn ka kaam bus yeh hai kay weham o gumaan baandhtay rehtay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur inn mein say kuch log ann parh hain jo kitab ( toraat ) ka ilm to rakhtay nahi , albatta kuch aarzooyen pakaye bethay hain , aur unn ka kaam bus yeh hai kay weham o gumaan baandhtay rehtay hain .

ayahs.text: lehaza tabahi hai unn logon  ki jo apney haathon say kitab likhtay hain , phir ( logon  say ) kehtay hain kay yeh Allah ki taraf say hai , takay uss kay zariye thori si aamdani kama len .   pus tabahi hai unn logon  per uss tehreer ki wajeh say bhi jo unn kay haathon ney likhi , aur tabahi hai unn per uss aamdani ki wajeh say bhi jo woh kamatay hain .
ayahs.translation: lehaza tabahi hai unn logon  ki jo apney haathon say kitab likhtay hain , phir ( logon  say ) kehtay hain kay yeh Allah ki taraf say hai , takay uss kay zariye thori si aamdani kama len .   pus tabahi hai unn logon  per uss tehreer ki wajeh say bhi jo unn kay haathon ney likhi , aur tabahi hai unn per uss aamdani ki wajeh say bhi jo woh kamatay hain .

ayahs.text: aur yahudiyon ney kaha hai kay hamen ginti kay chand dino kay ilawa aag hergiz nahi chooye gi . aap unn say kahiye kay kiya tum ney Allah ki taraf say koi ehad ley rakha hai jiss ki bana per woh apney ehad ki khilaf warzi nahi ker-sakta , ya tum Allah kay zimmay woh baat laga rahey ho jiss ka tumhen kuch pata nahi-?
ayahs.translation: aur yahudiyon ney kaha hai kay hamen ginti kay chand dino kay ilawa aag hergiz nahi chooye gi . aap unn say kahiye kay kiya tum ney Allah ki taraf say koi ehad ley rakha hai jiss ki bana per woh apney ehad ki khilaf warzi nahi ker-sakta , ya tum Allah kay zimmay woh baat laga rahey ho jiss ka tumhen kuch pata nahi-?

ayahs.text: . ( aag tumhen ) kiyon nahi ( chooye gi ) ? jo log bhi badi kamatay hain aur unn ki badi unhen gher leti hai   to aesay log hi dozakh kay baasi hain . woh hamesha uss mein rahen gay .
ayahs.translation: . ( aag tumhen ) kiyon nahi ( chooye gi ) ? jo log bhi badi kamatay hain aur unn ki badi unhen gher leti hai   to aesay log hi dozakh kay baasi hain . woh hamesha uss mein rahen gay .

ayahs.text: aur jo log emaan latay hain aur naik amal kertay hain , to woh jannat kay baasi hain . woh hamesha uss mein rahen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log emaan latay hain aur naik amal kertay hain , to woh jannat kay baasi hain . woh hamesha uss mein rahen gay .

ayahs.text: aur ( woh waqt yaad karo ) jab hum ney bani Israel say paka ehad liya tha kay :  tum Allah kay siwa kissi ki ibadat nahi kero gay , aur walaiden say acha sulook karo gay , aur rishta daaron say bhi aur yateemon aur miskeeno say bhi . aur logon  say bhali baat kehna , aur namaz qaeem kerna aur zakat dena .  ( magar ) phir tum mein say thoray say logon  kay siwa baqi sabb ( uss ehad say ) mun morr ker phir gaye .
ayahs.translation: aur ( woh waqt yaad karo ) jab hum ney bani Israel say paka ehad liya tha kay :  tum Allah kay siwa kissi ki ibadat nahi kero gay , aur walaiden say acha sulook karo gay , aur rishta daaron say bhi aur yateemon aur miskeeno say bhi . aur logon  say bhali baat kehna , aur namaz qaeem kerna aur zakat dena .  ( magar ) phir tum mein say thoray say logon  kay siwa baqi sabb ( uss ehad say ) mun morr ker phir gaye .

ayahs.text: aur ( yaad kero ) jab hum ney tum say paka ehad liya tha kay :  tum aik doosray ka khoon nahi bahao gay , aur apney aadmiyon ko apney gharon say nahi nikalo gay  phir tum ney iqrar kiya tha , aur tum khud uss kay gawah ho .
ayahs.translation: aur ( yaad kero ) jab hum ney tum say paka ehad liya tha kay :  tum aik doosray ka khoon nahi bahao gay , aur apney aadmiyon ko apney gharon say nahi nikalo gay  phir tum ney iqrar kiya tha , aur tum khud uss kay gawah ho .

ayahs.text: uss kay baad ( aaj ) tum hi woh log ho kay apney hi aadmiyon ko qatal kertay ho , aur apney hi mein say kuch logon  ko unn kay gharon say nikal bahir kertay ho , aur unn kay khilaf gunah aur ziyadti ka irtikab ker kay ( unn kay dushmanon ki ) madad kertay ho , aur agar woh ( dushmanon kay ) qedi ban ker tumharay paas aajatay hain to tum unn ko fidya dey ker churra letay ho , halankay unn ko ( ghar say ) nikalna hi tumharay liye haram tha .   to kiya tum kitab ( toraat ) kay kuch hissay per to emaan rakhtay ho aur kuch ka inkar kertay ho-? abb batao kay jo shaks aisa keray uss ki saza iss kay siwa kiya hai kay dunyawi zindagi mein uss ki ruswai ho-? aur qayamat kay din aesay logon  ko sakht tareen azab ki taraf bhej diya jaye ga . aur jo kuch tum amal kertay ho Allah uss say ghafil nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: uss kay baad ( aaj ) tum hi woh log ho kay apney hi aadmiyon ko qatal kertay ho , aur apney hi mein say kuch logon  ko unn kay gharon say nikal bahir kertay ho , aur unn kay khilaf gunah aur ziyadti ka irtikab ker kay ( unn kay dushmanon ki ) madad kertay ho , aur agar woh ( dushmanon kay ) qedi ban ker tumharay paas aajatay hain to tum unn ko fidya dey ker churra letay ho , halankay unn ko ( ghar say ) nikalna hi tumharay liye haram tha .   to kiya tum kitab ( toraat ) kay kuch hissay per to emaan rakhtay ho aur kuch ka inkar kertay ho-? abb batao kay jo shaks aisa keray uss ki saza iss kay siwa kiya hai kay dunyawi zindagi mein uss ki ruswai ho-? aur qayamat kay din aesay logon  ko sakht tareen azab ki taraf bhej diya jaye ga . aur jo kuch tum amal kertay ho Allah uss say ghafil nahi hai .

ayahs.text: yeh woh log hain jinhon ney dunyawi zindagi ko aakhirat kay badlay khareed liya hai , lehaza naa unn kay azab mein koi takhfeef hogi aur naa unn ki madad ki jayegi .
ayahs.translation: yeh woh log hain jinhon ney dunyawi zindagi ko aakhirat kay badlay khareed liya hai , lehaza naa unn kay azab mein koi takhfeef hogi aur naa unn ki madad ki jayegi .

ayahs.text: aur beyshak hum ney musa ko kitab di , aur uss kay baad pey-dar-pay Rasool bhejay . aur hum ney essa ibn-e-maryam ko khuli khuli nishaniyan den , aur rooh-ul-qudus say unn ki taeed ki .   phir yeh aakhir kiya moamla hai kay jab kabhi koi Rasool tumharay paas koi aesi baat ley ker aaya jo tumhari nafsani khuwaishaat ko pasand nahi thi to tum akarr gaye ? chunacheh baaz ( anbiya ) ko tum ney jhutlaya , aur baaz ko qatal kertay rahey .
ayahs.translation: aur beyshak hum ney musa ko kitab di , aur uss kay baad pey-dar-pay Rasool bhejay . aur hum ney essa ibn-e-maryam ko khuli khuli nishaniyan den , aur rooh-ul-qudus say unn ki taeed ki .   phir yeh aakhir kiya moamla hai kay jab kabhi koi Rasool tumharay paas koi aesi baat ley ker aaya jo tumhari nafsani khuwaishaat ko pasand nahi thi to tum akarr gaye ? chunacheh baaz ( anbiya ) ko tum ney jhutlaya , aur baaz ko qatal kertay rahey .

ayahs.text: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  humaray dil ghilaf mein hain .   nahi ! balkay unn kay kufr ki wajeh say Allah ney unn per phitkaar daal rakhi hai , iss liye woh kam hi emaan latay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  humaray dil ghilaf mein hain .   nahi ! balkay unn kay kufr ki wajeh say Allah ney unn per phitkaar daal rakhi hai , iss liye woh kam hi emaan latay hain .

ayahs.text: aur jab unn kay paas Allah ki taraf say woh kitab aai ( yani Quran ) jo uss ( toraat ) ki tasdeeq bhi kerti hai jo pehlay say unn kay paas hai , ( to unn ka tarz-e-amal dekho ! ) bawajood-yeh-kay yeh khud shuroo mein kafiron ( yani butt paraston ) kay khilaf ( iss kitab kay hawalay say ) Allah say fatah ki duayen maanga kertay thay ,   magar jab woh cheez unn kay paas aagae jissay unhon ney pehchan bhi liya , to uss ka inkar ker bethay . pus phitkaar hai Allah ki aesay kafiron per !
ayahs.translation: aur jab unn kay paas Allah ki taraf say woh kitab aai ( yani Quran ) jo uss ( toraat ) ki tasdeeq bhi kerti hai jo pehlay say unn kay paas hai , ( to unn ka tarz-e-amal dekho ! ) bawajood-yeh-kay yeh khud shuroo mein kafiron ( yani butt paraston ) kay khilaf ( iss kitab kay hawalay say ) Allah say fatah ki duayen maanga kertay thay ,   magar jab woh cheez unn kay paas aagae jissay unhon ney pehchan bhi liya , to uss ka inkar ker bethay . pus phitkaar hai Allah ki aesay kafiron per !

ayahs.text: buri hai woh qeemat jiss kay badlay unhon ney apni janon ko bech daala hai , kay yeh Allah ki nazil ki hoi kitab ka sirf iss jalan ki bana per inkar ker rahey hain kay Allah apney fazal ka koi hissa ( yani wahi ) apney bandon mein say jiss per chah raha hai ( kiyon ) utaar raha hai ? chunacheh yeh ( apni iss/uss jalan ki wajeh say ) ghazab balaye ghazab ley ker lotay hain .   aur kafir log zillat aamez saza kay mustahiq hain .
ayahs.translation: buri hai woh qeemat jiss kay badlay unhon ney apni janon ko bech daala hai , kay yeh Allah ki nazil ki hoi kitab ka sirf iss jalan ki bana per inkar ker rahey hain kay Allah apney fazal ka koi hissa ( yani wahi ) apney bandon mein say jiss per chah raha hai ( kiyon ) utaar raha hai ? chunacheh yeh ( apni iss/uss jalan ki wajeh say ) ghazab balaye ghazab ley ker lotay hain .   aur kafir log zillat aamez saza kay mustahiq hain .

ayahs.text: aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay Allah ney jo kalam utaara hai uss per emaan ley aao , to woh kehtay hain kay hum to ( sirf ) ussi kalam per emaan rakhen gay jo hum per nazil kiya gaya , ( yani toraat ) aur woh uss kay siwa ( doosri aasmani kitabon ) ka inkar kertay hain , halankay woh bhi haq hain , ( aur ) jo kitab unn kay paas hai woh uss ki tasdeeq bhi kerti hain . ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn say kaho kay agar tum waqaee ( toraat per ) emaan rakhtay thay to Allah kay nabiyon ko pehlay zamaney mein kiyon qatal kertay rahey-?

( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn say kaho kay agar tum waqaee ( toraat per ) emaan rakhtay thay to Allah kay nabiyon ko pehlay zamaney mein kiyon qatal kertay rahey-?

ayahs.text: aur khud musa tumharay paas roshan nishaniyan ley ker aaye , phir tum ney unn kay peeth peechay yeh sitam dhaaya kay gaye kay bachrray ko mabood bana liya .
ayahs.translation: aur khud musa tumharay paas roshan nishaniyan ley ker aaye , phir tum ney unn kay peeth peechay yeh sitam dhaaya kay gaye kay bachrray ko mabood bana liya .

ayahs.text: aur woh waqt yaad karo jab hum ney tum say ehad liya aur tumharay oopper toor ko buland kerdiya ( aur yeh kaha kay )  jo kuch hum ney tum ko diya hai uss ko mazbooti say thaamo   aur ( jo kuch kaha jaye ussay hosh say ) suno  . kehney lagay :  hum ney ( pehlay bhi ) sunn liya tha , magar amal nahi kiya tha ( abb bhi aisa hi keren gay )  aur ( darasal ) unn kay kufr ki nahoosat say unn kay dilon mein bachrra basa huwa tha . aap ( unn say ) kahiye kay agar tum momin ho to kitni buri hain woh baaten jo tumhara emaan tumhen talqeen ker raha hai !
ayahs.translation: aur woh waqt yaad karo jab hum ney tum say ehad liya aur tumharay oopper toor ko buland kerdiya ( aur yeh kaha kay )  jo kuch hum ney tum ko diya hai uss ko mazbooti say thaamo   aur ( jo kuch kaha jaye ussay hosh say ) suno  . kehney lagay :  hum ney ( pehlay bhi ) sunn liya tha , magar amal nahi kiya tha ( abb bhi aisa hi keren gay )  aur ( darasal ) unn kay kufr ki nahoosat say unn kay dilon mein bachrra basa huwa tha . aap ( unn say ) kahiye kay agar tum momin ho to kitni buri hain woh baaten jo tumhara emaan tumhen talqeen ker raha hai !

ayahs.text: aap ( unn say ) kahiye kay :  agar Allah kay nazdeek aakhirat ka ghar tamam insanon ko chorr ker sirf tumharay hi liye makhsoos hai ( jaisa kay tumhara kehna hai ) to moat ki tamanna to ker kay dikhao , agar waqaee sachay ho

ayahs.text: aur ( hum bataye detay hain kay ) unhon ney apney jo kartoot aagay bhej rakhay hain , unn ki wajeh say yeh kabhi aesi tamanna nahi keren gay .   Allah zalimon ko khoob janta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( hum bataye detay hain kay ) unhon ney apney jo kartoot aagay bhej rakhay hain , unn ki wajeh say yeh kabhi aesi tamanna nahi keren gay .   Allah zalimon ko khoob janta hai .

ayahs.text: . ( balkay ) yaqeenan tum unn logon  ko pao gay kay unhen zinda rehney ki hirs doosray tamam insanon say ziyada hai , yahan tak kay mushrikeen say bhi ziyada . inn mein ka aik aik shaks yeh chahta hai kay aik hazar saal umar paye , halankay kissi ka bari umar paalena ussay azab say door nahi ker-sakta . aur yeh jo amal bhi kertay hain Allah ussay achi tarah dekh raha hai .
ayahs.translation: . ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay agar koi shaks jibraeel ka dushman hai   to ( huwa keray ) unhon ney to yeh kalam Allah ki ijazat say tumharay dil per utaara hai jo apney say pehlay ki kitabon ki tasdeeq ker raha hai , aur emaan walon kay liye mujassam hidayat aur khushkhabri hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay agar koi shaks jibraeel ka dushman hai   to ( huwa keray ) unhon ney to yeh kalam Allah ki ijazat say tumharay dil per utaara hai jo apney say pehlay ki kitabon ki tasdeeq ker raha hai , aur emaan walon kay liye mujassam hidayat aur khushkhabri hai .

ayahs.text: agar koi shaks Allah ka , uss kay farishton aur Rasoolon ka , aur jibraeel aur mekael ka dushman hai to ( woh sunn rakhay kay ) Allah kafiron ka dushman hai .
ayahs.translation: agar koi shaks Allah ka , uss kay farishton aur Rasoolon ka , aur jibraeel aur mekael ka dushman hai to ( woh sunn rakhay kay ) Allah kafiron ka dushman hai .

ayahs.text: aur beyshak hum ney aap per aesi aayaten utaari hain jo haq ko aashkaar kernay wali hain , aur unn ka inkar wohi log kertay hain jo nafarman hain .
ayahs.translation: aur beyshak hum ney aap per aesi aayaten utaari hain jo haq ko aashkaar kernay wali hain , aur unn ka inkar wohi log kertay hain jo nafarman hain .

ayahs.text: yeh aakhir kiya moamla hai kay inn logon  ney jab koi ehad kiya , inn kay aik giroh ney ussay hamesha torr phenka-? balkay unn mein say aksar log emaan latay hi nahi .
ayahs.translation: yeh aakhir kiya moamla hai kay inn logon  ney jab koi ehad kiya , inn kay aik giroh ney ussay hamesha torr phenka-? balkay unn mein say aksar log emaan latay hi nahi .

ayahs.text: aur jab unn kay paas Allah ki taraf say aik Rasool aaye jo uss ( toraat ) ki tasdeeq ker rahey thay jo inn kay paas hai , to ehal-e-kitab mein say aik giroh ney Allah ki kitab ( toraat o injeel ) ko iss tarah pus-e-pusht daal diya goya woh kuch jantay hi naa thay ( kay uss mein nabi aakhir-uz-zaman SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam kay baaray mein kiya hidayaat di gaee then )
ayahs.translation: aur jab unn kay paas Allah ki taraf say aik Rasool aaye jo uss ( toraat ) ki tasdeeq ker rahey thay jo inn kay paas hai , to ehal-e-kitab mein say aik giroh ney Allah ki kitab ( toraat o injeel ) ko iss tarah pus-e-pusht daal diya goya woh kuch jantay hi naa thay ( kay uss mein nabi aakhir-uz-zaman SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam kay baaray mein kiya hidayaat di gaee then )

ayahs.text: aur yeh ( bani Israel ) unn ( mantaron ) kay peechay lagg gaye jo suleman ( aleh-assalam ) ki saltanat kay zamaney mein shayateen parha kertay thay . aur suleman ( aleh-assalam ) ney koi kufr nahi kiya tha , albatta shayateen logon  ko jadoo ki taleem dey ker kufr ka irtikab kertay thay .   neez ( yeh bani Israel ) uss cheez kay peechay lagg gaye jo shehar babil mein haroot aur maaroot naami do farishton per nazil ki gaee thi .   yeh do farishtay kissi ko uss waqt tak koi taleem nahi detay thay jab tak uss say yeh naa keh den kay :  hum mehaz aazmaesh kay liye ( bhejay gaye ) hain , lehaza tum ( jadoo kay peechay lagg ker ) kufr ikhtiyar naa kerna .  phir bhi yeh log unn say woh cheezen seekhtay thay jiss kay zariye mard aur uss ki biwi mein judai peda kerden . ( wesay yeh wazeh rahey kay ) woh uss kay zariye kissi ko Allah ki mashiyat kay baghair koi nuqsan nahi phoncha saktay thay .   ( magar ) woh aesi baaten seekhtay thay jo unn kay liye nuqsan deh then , aur faeeda mand naa then . aur woh yeh bhi khoob jantay thay kay jo shaks inn cheezon ka khareedaar banay ga , aakhirat mein uss ka koi hissa nahi hoga . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh cheez boht buri thi jiss kay badlay unhon ney apni janen bech daalen . kaash kay unn ko ( iss baat ka haqeeqi ) ilm hota .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh ( bani Israel ) unn ( mantaron ) kay peechay lagg gaye jo suleman ( aleh-assalam ) ki saltanat kay zamaney mein shayateen parha kertay thay . aur suleman ( aleh-assalam ) ney koi kufr nahi kiya tha , albatta shayateen logon  ko jadoo ki taleem dey ker kufr ka irtikab kertay thay .   neez ( yeh bani Israel ) uss cheez kay peechay lagg gaye jo shehar babil mein haroot aur maaroot naami do farishton per nazil ki gaee thi .   yeh do farishtay kissi ko uss waqt tak koi taleem nahi detay thay jab tak uss say yeh naa keh den kay :  hum mehaz aazmaesh kay liye ( bhejay gaye ) hain , lehaza tum ( jadoo kay peechay lagg ker ) kufr ikhtiyar naa kerna .  phir bhi yeh log unn say woh cheezen seekhtay thay jiss kay zariye mard aur uss ki biwi mein judai peda kerden . ( wesay yeh wazeh rahey kay ) woh uss kay zariye kissi ko Allah ki mashiyat kay baghair koi nuqsan nahi phoncha saktay thay .   ( magar ) woh aesi baaten seekhtay thay jo unn kay liye nuqsan deh then , aur faeeda mand naa then . aur woh yeh bhi khoob jantay thay kay jo shaks inn cheezon ka khareedaar banay ga , aakhirat mein uss ka koi hissa nahi hoga . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh cheez boht buri thi jiss kay badlay unhon ney apni janen bech daalen . kaash kay unn ko ( iss baat ka haqeeqi ) ilm hota .

ayahs.text: aur ( iss kay bar-aks ) agar woh emaan aur taqwa ikhtiyar kertay to Allah kay paas say milney wala sawab yaqeenan kahen ziyada behtar hota . kaash kay unn ko ( iss baat ka bhi haqeeqi ) ilm hota .
ayahs.translation: aur ( iss kay bar-aks ) agar woh emaan aur taqwa ikhtiyar kertay to Allah kay paas say milney wala sawab yaqeenan kahen ziyada behtar hota . kaash kay unn ko ( iss baat ka bhi haqeeqi ) ilm hota .

ayahs.text: emaan walo ! ( Rasool Allah SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam say mukhatib hoker ) raeena naa kaha karo , aur unzurna keh diya kero .   aur suna kero . aur kafiron kay liye dardnak azab hai .
ayahs.translation: emaan walo ! ( Rasool Allah SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam say mukhatib hoker ) raeena naa kaha karo , aur unzurna keh diya kero .   aur suna kero . aur kafiron kay liye dardnak azab hai .

ayahs.text: kafir log khuwa ehal-e-kitab mein say hon ya mushrikeen mein say , yeh pasand nahi kertay kay tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say koi bhalai tum per nazil ho , halankay Allah jiss ko chahta hai apni rehmat kay liye makhsoos farma leta hai . aur Allah fazal-e-azeem ka malik hai .
ayahs.translation: kafir log khuwa ehal-e-kitab mein say hon ya mushrikeen mein say , yeh pasand nahi kertay kay tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say koi bhalai tum per nazil ho , halankay Allah jiss ko chahta hai apni rehmat kay liye makhsoos farma leta hai . aur Allah fazal-e-azeem ka malik hai .

ayahs.text: hum jab bhi koi aayat mansookh kertay hain ya ussay bhula detay hain to uss say behtar ya ussi jaisi ( aayat ) ley aatay hain .   kiya tumhen yeh maloom nahi kay Allah her cheez per qudrat rakhta hai-?
ayahs.translation: hum jab bhi koi aayat mansookh kertay hain ya ussay bhula detay hain to uss say behtar ya ussi jaisi ( aayat ) ley aatay hain .   kiya tumhen yeh maloom nahi kay Allah her cheez per qudrat rakhta hai-?

ayahs.text: kiya tumhen yeh maloom nahi kay Allah woh zaat hai kay aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat tanha ussi ki hai , aur Allah kay siwa naa koi tumhara rakhwala hai naa madadgaar-?
ayahs.translation: kiya tumhen yeh maloom nahi kay Allah woh zaat hai kay aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat tanha ussi ki hai , aur Allah kay siwa naa koi tumhara rakhwala hai naa madadgaar-?

ayahs.text: kiya tum yeh chahtay ho kay apney Rasool say ussi qisam kay sawal kero jaisay pehlay musa say kiye ja-chukay hain-?   aur jo shaks emaan kay badlay kufr ikhtiyar keray woh yaqeenan seedhay raastay say bhatak gaya .
ayahs.translation: kiya tum yeh chahtay ho kay apney Rasool say ussi qisam kay sawal kero jaisay pehlay musa say kiye ja-chukay hain-?   aur jo shaks emaan kay badlay kufr ikhtiyar keray woh yaqeenan seedhay raastay say bhatak gaya .

ayahs.text: . ( musalmano ) boht say ehal-e-kitab apney dilon kay hasad ki bana per yeh chahtay hain kay tumharay emaan laney kay baad tumhen palta ker phir kafir bana den , bawajood-yeh-kay haq unn per wazeh hochuka hai . chunacheh tum moaaf kero aur darguzar say kaam lo yahan tak kay Allah khud apna faisla bhej dey . beyshak Allah her cheez per qadir hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( musalmano ) boht say ehal-e-kitab apney dilon kay hasad ki bana per yeh chahtay hain kay tumharay emaan laney kay baad tumhen palta ker phir kafir bana den , bawajood-yeh-kay haq unn per wazeh hochuka hai . chunacheh tum moaaf kero aur darguzar say kaam lo yahan tak kay Allah khud apna faisla bhej dey . beyshak Allah her cheez per qadir hai .

ayahs.text: aur namaz qaeem kero aur zakat ada kero , aur ( yaad rakho kay ) jo bhalai ka amal bhi tum khud apney faeeday kay liye aagay bhej do gay uss ko Allah kay paas pao gay . beyshak jo amal bhi tum kertay ho Allah ussay dekh raha hai .
ayahs.translation: aur namaz qaeem kero aur zakat ada kero , aur ( yaad rakho kay ) jo bhalai ka amal bhi tum khud apney faeeday kay liye aagay bhej do gay uss ko Allah kay paas pao gay . beyshak jo amal bhi tum kertay ho Allah ussay dekh raha hai .

ayahs.text: aur yeh ( yani yahudi aur essai ) kehtay hain kay :  jannat mein siwaye yahudiyon ya essaiyon kay koi bhi hergiz dakhil nahi hoga .    yeh mehaz inn ki aarzooyen hain . aap inn say kahiye kay agar tum ( apney iss daway mein ) sachay ho to apni koi daleel ley ker aao .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh ( yani yahudi aur essai ) kehtay hain kay :  jannat mein siwaye yahudiyon ya essaiyon kay koi bhi hergiz dakhil nahi hoga .    yeh mehaz inn ki aarzooyen hain . aap inn say kahiye kay agar tum ( apney iss daway mein ) sachay ho to apni koi daleel ley ker aao .

ayahs.text: kiyon nahi-? ( qaeeda yeh hai kay ) jo shaks bhi apna rukh Allah kay aagay jhuka dey , aur woh naik amal kernay wala ho , ussay apna ajar apney perwerdigar kay paas milay ga . aur aesay logon  ko naa koi khof hoga , aur naa woh ghumgeen hon gay .
ayahs.translation: kiyon nahi-? ( qaeeda yeh hai kay ) jo shaks bhi apna rukh Allah kay aagay jhuka dey , aur woh naik amal kernay wala ho , ussay apna ajar apney perwerdigar kay paas milay ga . aur aesay logon  ko naa koi khof hoga , aur naa woh ghumgeen hon gay .

ayahs.text: aur yahudi kehtay hain kay essaiyon ( kay mazahab ) ki koi buniyad nahi , aur essai kehtay hain kay yahudiyon ( kay mazahab ) ki koi buniyad nahi , halankay yeh sabb ( aasmani ) kitab parhtay hain . issi tarah woh ( mushrikeen ) jinn kay paas koi ( aasmani ) ilm hi siray say nahi hai , unhon ney bhi inn ( ehal-e-kitab ) ki jaisi baaten kehni shuroo kerdi hain . chunacheh Allah hi qayamat kay din inn kay darmiyan unn baaton ka faisla keray ga jinn mein yeh ikhtilaf kertay rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: aur yahudi kehtay hain kay essaiyon ( kay mazahab ) ki koi buniyad nahi , aur essai kehtay hain kay yahudiyon ( kay mazahab ) ki koi buniyad nahi , halankay yeh sabb ( aasmani ) kitab parhtay hain . issi tarah woh ( mushrikeen ) jinn kay paas koi ( aasmani ) ilm hi siray say nahi hai , unhon ney bhi inn ( ehal-e-kitab ) ki jaisi baaten kehni shuroo kerdi hain . chunacheh Allah hi qayamat kay din inn kay darmiyan unn baaton ka faisla keray ga jinn mein yeh ikhtilaf kertay rahey hain .

ayahs.text: aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah ki masjidon per iss baat ki bandish laga dey kay unn mein Allah ka naam liya jaye , aur unn ko weeran kernay ki koshish keray . aesay logon  ko yeh haq nahi phonchta kay woh unn ( masjidon ) mein dakhil hon magar dartay huye .   aesay logon  kay liye duniya mein ruswai hai aur unhi ko aakhirat mein zabardast azab hoga .
ayahs.translation: aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah ki masjidon per iss baat ki bandish laga dey kay unn mein Allah ka naam liya jaye , aur unn ko weeran kernay ki koshish keray . aesay logon  ko yeh haq nahi phonchta kay woh unn ( masjidon ) mein dakhil hon magar dartay huye .   aesay logon  kay liye duniya mein ruswai hai aur unhi ko aakhirat mein zabardast azab hoga .

ayahs.text: aur mashriq o maghrib sabb Allah hi ki hain . lehaza jiss taraf bhi tum rukh karo gay , wahin Allah ka rukh hai .   beyshak Allah boht wusat wala , bara ilm rakhney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur mashriq o maghrib sabb Allah hi ki hain . lehaza jiss taraf bhi tum rukh karo gay , wahin Allah ka rukh hai .   beyshak Allah boht wusat wala , bara ilm rakhney wala hai .

ayahs.text: yeh log kehtay hain kay Allah ney koi beta banaya huwa hai , ( halankay ) uss ki zaat ( iss qisam ki cheezon say ) pak hai , balkay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai ussi ka hai . sabb kay sabb uss kay farmanbardaar hain .
ayahs.translation: yeh log kehtay hain kay Allah ney koi beta banaya huwa hai , ( halankay ) uss ki zaat ( iss qisam ki cheezon say ) pak hai , balkay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai ussi ka hai . sabb kay sabb uss kay farmanbardaar hain .

ayahs.text: woh aasmano aur zameen ka mojid hai , aur jab woh kissi baat ka faisla kerta hai to uss kay baaray mein bus itna kehta hai kay :  hoja  chunacheh woh hojati hai .
ayahs.translation: woh aasmano aur zameen ka mojid hai , aur jab woh kissi baat ka faisla kerta hai to uss kay baaray mein bus itna kehta hai kay :  hoja  chunacheh woh hojati hai .

ayahs.text: aur jo log ilm nahi rakhtay woh kehtay hain kay : Allah hum say ( barah-e-raast ) kiyon baat nahi kerta-? ya humaray paas koi nishani kiyon nahi aati-? jo log inn say pehlay guzray hain woh bhi issi tarah ki baaten kehtay thay jaisi yeh kehtay hain . inn sabb kay dil aik jaisay hain . haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log yaqeen kerna chahen unn kay liye hum nishaniyan pehlay hi wazeh ker-chukay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log ilm nahi rakhtay woh kehtay hain kay : Allah hum say ( barah-e-raast ) kiyon baat nahi kerta-? ya humaray paas koi nishani kiyon nahi aati-? jo log inn say pehlay guzray hain woh bhi issi tarah ki baaten kehtay thay jaisi yeh kehtay hain . inn sabb kay dil aik jaisay hain . haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log yaqeen kerna chahen unn kay liye hum nishaniyan pehlay hi wazeh ker-chukay hain .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) beyshak hum ney tumhen ko haq dey ker iss tarah bheja hai kay tum ( jannat ki ) khushkhabri do aur ( jahannum say ) darao aur jo log ( apni marzi say ) jahannum ( ka raasta ) ikhtiyar ker-chukay hain unn kay baaray mein aap say koi baaz purs nahi hogi .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) beyshak hum ney tumhen ko haq dey ker iss tarah bheja hai kay tum ( jannat ki ) khushkhabri do aur ( jahannum say ) darao aur jo log ( apni marzi say ) jahannum ( ka raasta ) ikhtiyar ker-chukay hain unn kay baaray mein aap say koi baaz purs nahi hogi .

ayahs.text: aur yahood o nasara tum say uss waqt tak hergiz razi nahi hon gay jab tak tum unn kay mazahab ki perwi nahi kero gay . keh do kay haqeeqi hidayat to Allah hi ki hidayat hai . aur tumharay paas ( wahi kay zariye ) jo ilm aagaya hai , agar kahen tum ney uss kay baad bhi inn logon  ki khuwaishaat ki perwi kerli to tumhen Allah say bachaney kay liye naa koi himayati milay ga naa koi madadgaar .

ayahs.text: jinn logon  ko hum ney kitab di, jabkay woh uss ki tilawat iss tarah kertay hon jaisa uss ki tilawat ka haq hai , to woh log hi ( dar-haqeeqat ) uss per emaan rakhtay hain .   aur jo iss ka inkar kertay hon , to aesay log hi nuqsan uthaney walay hain
ayahs.translation: jinn logon  ko hum ney kitab di, jabkay woh uss ki tilawat iss tarah kertay hon jaisa uss ki tilawat ka haq hai , to woh log hi ( dar-haqeeqat ) uss per emaan rakhtay hain .   aur jo iss ka inkar kertay hon , to aesay log hi nuqsan uthaney walay hain

ayahs.text: aey bani Israel ! meri woh naimat yaad kero jo mein ney tum ko ata ki thi , aur yeh baat ( yaad kero ) kay mein ney tum ko saray jahano per fazilat di thi .
ayahs.translation: aey bani Israel ! meri woh naimat yaad kero jo mein ney tum ko ata ki thi , aur yeh baat ( yaad kero ) kay mein ney tum ko saray jahano per fazilat di thi .

ayahs.text: aur uss din say daro jiss din koi shaks bhi kissi kay kuch kaam nahi aaye ga , naa kissi say kissi qisam ka fidya qubool kiya jaye ga , naa uss ko koi sifarish faeeda dey gi , aur naa unn ko koi madad phonchay gi .
ayahs.translation: aur uss din say daro jiss din koi shaks bhi kissi kay kuch kaam nahi aaye ga , naa kissi say kissi qisam ka fidya qubool kiya jaye ga , naa uss ko koi sifarish faeeda dey gi , aur naa unn ko koi madad phonchay gi .

ayahs.text: aur ( woh waqt yaad karo ) jab Ibrahim ko unn kay perwerdigar ney kaee baaton say aazmaya , aur unhon ney woh sari baaten poori ken , Allah ney ( unn say ) kaha :  mein tumhen tamam insanon ka peshwa bananey wala hun .  Ibrahim ney poocha :  aur meri aulad mein say-?  Allah ney farmaya :  mera ( yeh ) ehad zalimon ko shamil nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( woh waqt yaad karo ) jab Ibrahim ko unn kay perwerdigar ney kaee baaton say aazmaya , aur unhon ney woh sari baaten poori ken , Allah ney ( unn say ) kaha :  mein tumhen tamam insanon ka peshwa bananey wala hun .  Ibrahim ney poocha :  aur meri aulad mein say-?  Allah ney farmaya :  mera ( yeh ) ehad zalimon ko shamil nahi hai .

ayahs.text: aur woh waqt yaad karo jab hum ney baitullah ko logon  kay liye aesi jagah banaya jiss ki taraf woh lot lot ker jayen aur jo sarapa aman ho .   aur tum maqam-e-Ibrahim ko namaz parhney ki jagah bana lo .   aur hum ney Ibrahim aur Ismail ko yeh takeed ki kay :  tum dono meray ghar ko unn logon  kay liye pak karo jo ( yahan ) tawaf keren aur aetikaf mein bethen aur rukoo aur sajda baja layen .
ayahs.translation: aur woh waqt yaad karo jab hum ney baitullah ko logon  kay liye aesi jagah banaya jiss ki taraf woh lot lot ker jayen aur jo sarapa aman ho .   aur tum maqam-e-Ibrahim ko namaz parhney ki jagah bana lo .   aur hum ney Ibrahim aur Ismail ko yeh takeed ki kay :  tum dono meray ghar ko unn logon  kay liye pak karo jo ( yahan ) tawaf keren aur aetikaf mein bethen aur rukoo aur sajda baja layen .

ayahs.text: aur ( woh waqt bhi yaad karo ) jab Ibrahim ney kaha tha kay :  aey meray perwerdigar ! iss ko aik pur aman shehar bana dijiye , aur iss kay bashindon mein say jo Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan layen unhen qisam qisam kay phalon say rizq ata farmaiye .  Allah ney kaha :  aur jo kufr ikhtiyar keray ga uss ko bhi mein kuch arsay kay liye lutf uthaney ka moaqa dun ga , ( magar ) phir ussay dozakh kay azab ki taraf kheench ley jaon ga . aur woh bad-tareen thikana hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( woh waqt bhi yaad karo ) jab Ibrahim ney kaha tha kay :  aey meray perwerdigar ! iss ko aik pur aman shehar bana dijiye , aur iss kay bashindon mein say jo Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan layen unhen qisam qisam kay phalon say rizq ata farmaiye .  Allah ney kaha :  aur jo kufr ikhtiyar keray ga uss ko bhi mein kuch arsay kay liye lutf uthaney ka moaqa dun ga , ( magar ) phir ussay dozakh kay azab ki taraf kheench ley jaon ga . aur woh bad-tareen thikana hai .

ayahs.text: aur uss waqt ka tasawwur kero jab Ibrahim baitullah ki buniyaden utha rahey thay ,   aur Ismail bhi ( unn kay sath shareek thay , aur dono yeh kehtay jatay thay kay : )  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum say ( yeh khidmat ) qubool farma ley . beyshak tu , aur sirf tu hi , her aik ki sunney wala , her aik ko janney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur uss waqt ka tasawwur kero jab Ibrahim baitullah ki buniyaden utha rahey thay ,   aur Ismail bhi ( unn kay sath shareek thay , aur dono yeh kehtay jatay thay kay : )  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum say ( yeh khidmat ) qubool farma ley . beyshak tu , aur sirf tu hi , her aik ki sunney wala , her aik ko janney wala hai .

ayahs.text: aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum dono ko apna mukammal farmanbardaar bana ley , aur humari nasal say bhi aesi ummat peda ker jo teri poori tabey daar ho . aur hum ko humari ibadton kay tareeqay sikha dey , aur humari tauba qubool farma ley . beyshak tu , aur sirf tu hi , moaaf ker-denay ka khoogar ( aur ) bari rehmat ka malik hai .
ayahs.translation: aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum dono ko apna mukammal farmanbardaar bana ley , aur humari nasal say bhi aesi ummat peda ker jo teri poori tabey daar ho . aur hum ko humari ibadton kay tareeqay sikha dey , aur humari tauba qubool farma ley . beyshak tu , aur sirf tu hi , moaaf ker-denay ka khoogar ( aur ) bari rehmat ka malik hai .

ayahs.text: aur humaray perwerdigar ! inn mein aik aisa Rasool bhi bhejna jo inhi mein say ho , jo inn kay samney teri aayaton ki tilawat keray , enhen kitab aur hikmat ki taleem dey , aur inn ko pakeezah banaye .   beyshak teri , aur sirf teri , zaat woh hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .
ayahs.translation: aur humaray perwerdigar ! inn mein aik aisa Rasool bhi bhejna jo inhi mein say ho , jo inn kay samney teri aayaton ki tilawat keray , enhen kitab aur hikmat ki taleem dey , aur inn ko pakeezah banaye .   beyshak teri , aur sirf teri , zaat woh hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .

ayahs.text: aur kon hai jo Ibrahim kay tareeqay say inehraaf keray-? siwaye uss shaks kay jo khud apney aap ko himaqat mein mubtala ker-chuka ho ! haqeeqat to yeh hai kay hum ney duniya mein unhen ( apney liye ) chunn liya tha , aur aakhirat mein unn ka shumar sualeheen mein hoga .
ayahs.translation: aur kon hai jo Ibrahim kay tareeqay say inehraaf keray-? siwaye uss shaks kay jo khud apney aap ko himaqat mein mubtala ker-chuka ho ! haqeeqat to yeh hai kay hum ney duniya mein unhen ( apney liye ) chunn liya tha , aur aakhirat mein unn ka shumar sualeheen mein hoga .

ayahs.text: jab unn kay perwerdigar ney unn say kaha kay :  sar-e-tasleem kham kerdo !    to woh ( foran ) bolay :  mein ney Rabb-ul-Aalameen kay ( her hukum kay ) aagay sar jhuka diya .
ayahs.translation: jab unn kay perwerdigar ney unn say kaha kay :  sar-e-tasleem kham kerdo !    to woh ( foran ) bolay :  mein ney Rabb-ul-Aalameen kay ( her hukum kay ) aagay sar jhuka diya .

ayahs.text: aur issi baat ki Ibrahim ney apney beton ko wasiyyat ki , aur Yaqoob ney bhi ( apney beton ko ) kay :  aey meray beto ! Allah ney yeh deen tumharay liye muntakhib farma liya hai , lehaza tumhen moat bhi aaye to iss halat mein aaye kay tum muslim ho .
ayahs.translation: aur issi baat ki Ibrahim ney apney beton ko wasiyyat ki , aur Yaqoob ney bhi ( apney beton ko ) kay :  aey meray beto ! Allah ney yeh deen tumharay liye muntakhib farma liya hai , lehaza tumhen moat bhi aaye to iss halat mein aaye kay tum muslim ho .

ayahs.text: kiya uss waqt tum khud mojood thay jab Yaqoob ki moat ka waqt aaya tha ,   jab unhon ney apney beton say kaha tha kay tum meray baad kiss ki ibadat kero gay-? unn sabb ney kaha tha kay : hum ussi aik khuda ki ibadat keren gay jo aap ka mabood hai aur aap kay baap dadon Ibrahim , Ismail aur Ishaq ka mabood hai . aur hum sirf ussi kay farmanbardaar hain .
ayahs.translation: kiya uss waqt tum khud mojood thay jab Yaqoob ki moat ka waqt aaya tha ,   jab unhon ney apney beton say kaha tha kay tum meray baad kiss ki ibadat kero gay-? unn sabb ney kaha tha kay : hum ussi aik khuda ki ibadat keren gay jo aap ka mabood hai aur aap kay baap dadon Ibrahim , Ismail aur Ishaq ka mabood hai . aur hum sirf ussi kay farmanbardaar hain .

ayahs.text: woh aik ummat thi jo guzar gaee . jo kuch unhon ney kamaya woh unn ka hai , aur jo kuch tum ney kamaya woh tumhara hai , aur tum say yeh nahi poocha jaye ga kay woh kiya amal kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: woh aik ummat thi jo guzar gaee . jo kuch unhon ney kamaya woh unn ka hai , aur jo kuch tum ney kamaya woh tumhara hai , aur tum say yeh nahi poocha jaye ga kay woh kiya amal kertay thay .

ayahs.text: aur yeh ( yahudi aur essai musalmanon say ) kehtay hain kay :  tum yahudi ya essai hojao , raah-e-raast per aajao gay .  keh do kay :  nahi , balkay ( hum to ) Ibrahim kay deen ki perwi keren gay jo theek theek seedhi raah per thay , aur woh unn logon  mein say naa thay jo Allah kay sath kissi ko shareek thehratay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh ( yahudi aur essai musalmanon say ) kehtay hain kay :  tum yahudi ya essai hojao , raah-e-raast per aajao gay .  keh do kay :  nahi , balkay ( hum to ) Ibrahim kay deen ki perwi keren gay jo theek theek seedhi raah per thay , aur woh unn logon  mein say naa thay jo Allah kay sath kissi ko shareek thehratay hain .

ayahs.text: . ( musalmano ) keh do kay :  hum Allah per emaan laye hain , aur uss kalam per bhi jo hum per utaara gaya aur uss per bhi jo Ibrahim , Ismail , Ishaq , Yaqoob aur unn ki aulad per utaara gaya , aur uss per bhi jo musa aur essa ko diya gaya aur uss per bhi jo doosray payghumberon ko unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say ata huwa . hum unn payghumberon kay darmiyan koi tafreeq nahi kertay , aur hum ussi ( aik khuda ) kay tabey farman hain .
ayahs.translation: . ( musalmano ) keh do kay :  hum Allah per emaan laye hain , aur uss kalam per bhi jo hum per utaara gaya aur uss per bhi jo Ibrahim , Ismail , Ishaq , Yaqoob aur unn ki aulad per utaara gaya , aur uss per bhi jo musa aur essa ko diya gaya aur uss per bhi jo doosray payghumberon ko unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say ata huwa . hum unn payghumberon kay darmiyan koi tafreeq nahi kertay , aur hum ussi ( aik khuda ) kay tabey farman hain .

ayahs.text: iss kay baad agar yeh log bhi issi tarah emaan ley ayen jaisay tum emaan laye ho to yeh raah-e-raast per aajayen gay . aur agar yeh mun morr len to dar-haqeeqat woh dushmani mein parr-gaye hain . abb Allah tumhari himayat mein unqareeb unn say nimat ley ga , aur woh her baat sunney wala , her baat janney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: iss kay baad agar yeh log bhi issi tarah emaan ley ayen jaisay tum emaan laye ho to yeh raah-e-raast per aajayen gay . aur agar yeh mun morr len to dar-haqeeqat woh dushmani mein parr-gaye hain . abb Allah tumhari himayat mein unqareeb unn say nimat ley ga , aur woh her baat sunney wala , her baat janney wala hai .

ayahs.text: . ( aey musalmano ! keh do kay : )  hum per to Allah ney apna rang charha diya hai , aur kon hai jo Allah say behtar rang charrhaye-? aur hum sirf ussi ki ibadat kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey musalmano ! keh do kay : )  hum per to Allah ney apna rang charha diya hai , aur kon hai jo Allah say behtar rang charrhaye-? aur hum sirf ussi ki ibadat kertay hain .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  kiya tum hum say Allah kay baaray mein hujjat kertay ho-? halankay woh humara bhi perwerdigar hai aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar . ( yeh ) aur ( baat hai kay ) humaray aemal humaray liye hain , aur tumharay amal tumharay liye . aur hum ney to apni bandagi ussi kay liye khalis kerli hai .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  kiya tum hum say Allah kay baaray mein hujjat kertay ho-? halankay woh humara bhi perwerdigar hai aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar . ( yeh ) aur ( baat hai kay ) humaray aemal humaray liye hain , aur tumharay amal tumharay liye . aur hum ney to apni bandagi ussi kay liye khalis kerli hai .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya tum yeh kehtay ho kay Ibrahim , Ismail , Ishaq , Yaqoob aur unn ki auladen yahudi ya nasrani then-? ( aey payghumber ! unn say ) kaho : kiya tum ziyada jantay ho ya Allah-? aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo aesi shahadat ko chupaye jo uss kay paas Allah ki taraf say phonchi ho-?   aur jo kuch tum kertay ho Allah uss say bey khabar nahi hai .

( aey payghumber ! unn say ) kaho : kiya tum ziyada jantay ho ya Allah-? aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo aesi shahadat ko chupaye jo uss kay paas Allah ki taraf say phonchi ho-?   aur jo kuch tum kertay ho Allah uss say bey khabar nahi hai .

ayahs.text: . ( baharhal ! ) woh aik ummat thi jo guzar gaee . jo kuch unhon ney kamaya woh inn/unn ka hai , aur jo kuch tum ney kamaya , woh tumhara hai , aur tum say yeh nahi poocha jaye ga kay woh kiya amal kertay thay-?
ayahs.translation: . ( baharhal ! ) woh aik ummat thi jo guzar gaee . jo kuch unhon ney kamaya woh inn/unn ka hai , aur jo kuch tum ney kamaya , woh tumhara hai , aur tum say yeh nahi poocha jaye ga kay woh kiya amal kertay thay-?

ayahs.text: abb yeh beywaqoof log kahen gay kay aakhir woh kiya cheez hai jiss ney inn ( musalmanon ) ko uss qiblay say rukh pherney per aamada kerdiya jiss ki taraf woh mun kertay chalay aarahey thay-? aap keh dijiye kay mashriq aur maghrib sabb Allah hi ki hain . woh jiss ko chahta hai seedhi raah ki hidayat ker deta hai
ayahs.translation: abb yeh beywaqoof log kahen gay kay aakhir woh kiya cheez hai jiss ney inn ( musalmanon ) ko uss qiblay say rukh pherney per aamada kerdiya jiss ki taraf woh mun kertay chalay aarahey thay-? aap keh dijiye kay mashriq aur maghrib sabb Allah hi ki hain . woh jiss ko chahta hai seedhi raah ki hidayat ker deta hai

ayahs.text: aur ( musalmano ! ) issi tarah to hum ney tum ko aik moatadil ummat banaya hai takay tum doosray logon  per gawah bano , aur Rasool tum per gawah banay .   aur jiss qiblay per tum pehlay kaar band thay , ussay hum ney kissi aur wajeh say nahi , balkay sirf yeh dekhney kay liye muqarrar kiya tha kay kon Rasool ka hukum manta hai aur kon ultay paon phir jata hai ?   aur iss mein shak nahi kay yeh baat thi bari mushkil , lekin unn logon  kay liye ( zara bhi mushkil naa hoi ) jinn ko Allah ney hidayat dey di thi . aur Allah taalaa aisa nahi kay tumharay emaan ko zaya kerday .   dar-haqeeqat Allah logon  per boht shafqat kernay wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( musalmano ! ) issi tarah to hum ney tum ko aik moatadil ummat banaya hai takay tum doosray logon  per gawah bano , aur Rasool tum per gawah banay .   aur jiss qiblay per tum pehlay kaar band thay , ussay hum ney kissi aur wajeh say nahi , balkay sirf yeh dekhney kay liye muqarrar kiya tha kay kon Rasool ka hukum manta hai aur kon ultay paon phir jata hai ?   aur iss mein shak nahi kay yeh baat thi bari mushkil , lekin unn logon  kay liye ( zara bhi mushkil naa hoi ) jinn ko Allah ney hidayat dey di thi . aur Allah taalaa aisa nahi kay tumharay emaan ko zaya kerday .   dar-haqeeqat Allah logon  per boht shafqat kernay wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) hum tumharay chehray ko baar baar aasman ki taraf uthtay huye dekh rahey hain . chunacheh hum tumhara rukh zaroor uss qiblay ki taraf pher den gay jo tumhen pasand hai .   lo abb apna rukh masjid-e-haram ki samt kerlo . aur ( aaenda ) jahan kahen tum ho apney chehron ka rukh ( namaz parhtay huye ) ussi ki taraf rakha kero . aur jinn logon  ko kitab di gaee hai woh khoob jantay hain kay yehi baat haq hai jo unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say aai hai .   aur jo kuch yeh ker rahey hain Allah uss say ghafil nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) hum tumharay chehray ko baar baar aasman ki taraf uthtay huye dekh rahey hain . chunacheh hum tumhara rukh zaroor uss qiblay ki taraf pher den gay jo tumhen pasand hai .   lo abb apna rukh masjid-e-haram ki samt kerlo . aur ( aaenda ) jahan kahen tum ho apney chehron ka rukh ( namaz parhtay huye ) ussi ki taraf rakha kero . aur jinn logon  ko kitab di gaee hai woh khoob jantay hain kay yehi baat haq hai jo unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say aai hai .   aur jo kuch yeh ker rahey hain Allah uss say ghafil nahi hai .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ko kitab di gaee thi agar tum unn kay paas her qisam ki nishaniyan ley aao tab bhi yeh tumharay qiblay ki perwi nahi keren gay . aur naa tum unn kay qiblay per amal kernay walay ho , naa yeh aik doosray kay qiblay per amal kernay walay hain .   aur jo ilm tumharay paas aa-chuka hai uss kay baad agar kahen tum ney inn ki khuwaishaat ki perwi kerli to uss soorat mein yaqeenan tumhara shumar zalimon mein hoga .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ko kitab di gaee thi agar tum unn kay paas her qisam ki nishaniyan ley aao tab bhi yeh tumharay qiblay ki perwi nahi keren gay . aur naa tum unn kay qiblay per amal kernay walay ho , naa yeh aik doosray kay qiblay per amal kernay walay hain .   aur jo ilm tumharay paas aa-chuka hai uss kay baad agar kahen tum ney inn ki khuwaishaat ki perwi kerli to uss soorat mein yaqeenan tumhara shumar zalimon mein hoga .

ayahs.text: jinn logon  ko hum ney kitab di hai woh uss ko itni achi tarah pehchantay hain jaisay apney beton ko pehchantay hain .   aur yaqeen jano kay unn mein say kuch logon  ney haq ko jaan bojh ker chupa rakha hai .
ayahs.translation: jinn logon  ko hum ney kitab di hai woh uss ko itni achi tarah pehchantay hain jaisay apney beton ko pehchantay hain .   aur yaqeen jano kay unn mein say kuch logon  ney haq ko jaan bojh ker chupa rakha hai .

ayahs.text: aur haq wohi hai jo tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aaya hai , lehaza shak kernay walon mein hergiz shamil naa hojana .
ayahs.translation: aur haq wohi hai jo tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aaya hai , lehaza shak kernay walon mein hergiz shamil naa hojana .

ayahs.text: aur her giroh ki aik samt hai jiss ki taraf woh rukh kerta hai . lehaza tum naik kamon mein aik doosray say aagay barhney ki koshish kero . tum jahan bhi hogay , Allah tum sabb ko ( apney paas ) ley aaye ga .   yaqeenan Allah her cheez per qadir hai .

ayahs.text: aur jahan say bhi tum niklo , apna mun masjid-e-haram ki taraf kero . aur tum jahan kahen ho , apney chehray ussi ki taraf rakho , takay logon  ko tumharay khilaf hujjat bazi ka moaqa naa milay   albatta unn mein jo log zulm kay khoogar hain , ( woh kabhi khamosh naa hon gay ) so unn ka kuch khof naa rakho , haan mera khof rakho aur takay mein tum per apna inaam mukammal kerdun aur takay tum hidayat hasil kerlo .
