ayahs.text: aur dekho hum tumhen aazmayen gay zaroor , ( kabhi ) khof say , aur ( kabhi ) bhook say , aur ( kabhi ) maal o jaan aur phalon mein kami ker kay . aur jo log ( aesay halaat mein ) sabar say kaam len unn ko khushkhabri suna do .
ayahs.translation: aur dekho hum tumhen aazmayen gay zaroor , ( kabhi ) khof say , aur ( kabhi ) bhook say , aur ( kabhi ) maal o jaan aur phalon mein kami ker kay . aur jo log ( aesay halaat mein ) sabar say kaam len unn ko khushkhabri suna do .

ayahs.text: yeh woh log hain kay jab inn ko koi museebat phonchti hai to yeh kehtay hain kay   hum sabb Allah hi kay hain aur hum ko Allah hi ki taraf lot ker jana hai
ayahs.translation: yeh woh log hain kay jab inn ko koi museebat phonchti hai to yeh kehtay hain kay   hum sabb Allah hi kay hain aur hum ko Allah hi ki taraf lot ker jana hai

ayahs.text: yeh woh log hain jinn per unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say khusoosi inayaten hain , aur rehmat hai . aur yehi log hain jo hidayat per hain .
ayahs.translation: yeh woh log hain jinn per unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say khusoosi inayaten hain , aur rehmat hai . aur yehi log hain jo hidayat per hain .

ayahs.text: beyshak safa aur marwa Allah ki nishaniyon mein say hain . lehaza jo shaks bhi baitullah ka hajj keray ya umrah keray to uss kay liye iss baat mein koi gunah nahi hai kay woh unn kay darmiyan chakkar lagaye .   aur jo shaks khushi say koi bhalai ka kaam keray to Allah yaqeenan qadar daan ( aur ) janney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: beyshak safa aur marwa Allah ki nishaniyon mein say hain . lehaza jo shaks bhi baitullah ka hajj keray ya umrah keray to uss kay liye iss baat mein koi gunah nahi hai kay woh unn kay darmiyan chakkar lagaye .   aur jo shaks khushi say koi bhalai ka kaam keray to Allah yaqeenan qadar daan ( aur ) janney wala hai .

ayahs.text: beyshak woh log jo humari nazil ki hoi roshan daleelon aur hidayat ko chupatay hain , bawajood-yeh-kay hum unhen kitab mein khol khol ker logon  kay liye biyan ker-chukay hain ,   to aesay logon  per Allah bhi lanat bhejta hai aur doosray lanat kernay walay bhi lanat bhejtay hain
ayahs.translation: beyshak woh log jo humari nazil ki hoi roshan daleelon aur hidayat ko chupatay hain , bawajood-yeh-kay hum unhen kitab mein khol khol ker logon  kay liye biyan ker-chukay hain ,   to aesay logon  per Allah bhi lanat bhejta hai aur doosray lanat kernay walay bhi lanat bhejtay hain

ayahs.text: haan woh log jinhon ney tauba kerli ho aur apni islaah kerli ho aur ( chupai hoi baaton ko ) khol khol ker biyan kerdiya ho to mein aesay logon  ki tauba qubool kerleta hun . aur mein tauba qubool kernay ka khoogar hun , bara rehmat wala
ayahs.translation: haan woh log jinhon ney tauba kerli ho aur apni islaah kerli ho aur ( chupai hoi baaton ko ) khol khol ker biyan kerdiya ho to mein aesay logon  ki tauba qubool kerleta hun . aur mein tauba qubool kernay ka khoogar hun , bara rehmat wala

ayahs.text: beyshak woh log jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya aur kafir honey ki halat hi mein maray , unn per Allah ki aur farishton ki aur saray insanon ki lanat hai
ayahs.translation: beyshak woh log jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya aur kafir honey ki halat hi mein maray , unn per Allah ki aur farishton ki aur saray insanon ki lanat hai

ayahs.text: woh hamesha issi phitkaar mein rahen gay . naa unn per say azab ko halka kiya jaye ga , aur naa unn ko mohlat di jaye gi
ayahs.translation: woh hamesha issi phitkaar mein rahen gay . naa unn per say azab ko halka kiya jaye ga , aur naa unn ko mohlat di jaye gi

ayahs.text: tumhara khuda aik hi khuda hai . uss kay siwa koi khuda nahi jo sabb per meharban , boht meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: tumhara khuda aik hi khuda hai . uss kay siwa koi khuda nahi jo sabb per meharban , boht meharban hai .

ayahs.text: beyshak aasmano aur zameen ki takhleeq mein , raat din kay lagataar aaney janey mein , unn kashtiyon mein jo logon  kay faeeday ka saman leyker samandar mein terti hain , uss paani mein jo Allah ney aasman say utaara aur uss kay zariye zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad zindagi bakhshi aur uss mein her qisam kay janwer phela diye , aur hawaon ki gardish mein , aur unn badalon mein jo aasman aur zameen kay darmiyan tabey daar ban ker kaam mein lagay hoye hain , unn logon  kay liye nishaniyan hi nishaniyan hain jo apni aqal say kaam letay hain .
ayahs.translation: beyshak aasmano aur zameen ki takhleeq mein , raat din kay lagataar aaney janey mein , unn kashtiyon mein jo logon  kay faeeday ka saman leyker samandar mein terti hain , uss paani mein jo Allah ney aasman say utaara aur uss kay zariye zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad zindagi bakhshi aur uss mein her qisam kay janwer phela diye , aur hawaon ki gardish mein , aur unn badalon mein jo aasman aur zameen kay darmiyan tabey daar ban ker kaam mein lagay hoye hain , unn logon  kay liye nishaniyan hi nishaniyan hain jo apni aqal say kaam letay hain .

ayahs.text: aur ( iss kay bawajood ) logon  mein kuch woh bhi hain jo Allah kay ilawa doosron ko uss ki khudai mein iss tarah shareek qarar detay hain kay unn say aesi mohabbat rakhtay hain jaisay Allah ki mohabbat ( rakhni chahiye ) . aur jo log emaan laa-chukay hain woh Allah hi say sabb say ziyada mohabbat rakhtay hain . aur kaash kay yeh zalim jab ( duniya mein ) koi takleef dekhtay hain ussi waqt yeh samajh liya keren kay tamam tarr taqat Allah hi ko hasil hai , aur yeh kay Allah ka azab ( aakhirat mein ) uss waqt bara sakht hoga .
ayahs.translation: aur ( iss kay bawajood ) logon  mein kuch woh bhi hain jo Allah kay ilawa doosron ko uss ki khudai mein iss tarah shareek qarar detay hain kay unn say aesi mohabbat rakhtay hain jaisay Allah ki mohabbat ( rakhni chahiye ) . aur jo log emaan laa-chukay hain woh Allah hi say sabb say ziyada mohabbat rakhtay hain . aur kaash kay yeh zalim jab ( duniya mein ) koi takleef dekhtay hain ussi waqt yeh samajh liya keren kay tamam tarr taqat Allah hi ko hasil hai , aur yeh kay Allah ka azab ( aakhirat mein ) uss waqt bara sakht hoga .

ayahs.text: jab woh ( peshwa ) jinn kay peechay yeh log chaltay rahey hain , apney perokaaron say mukammal bey talluqi ka aelaan keren gay , aur yeh sabb log azab ko apni aankhon kay samney dekh len gay , aur inn kay tamam bahami rishtay katt ker reh jayen gay
ayahs.translation: jab woh ( peshwa ) jinn kay peechay yeh log chaltay rahey hain , apney perokaaron say mukammal bey talluqi ka aelaan keren gay , aur yeh sabb log azab ko apni aankhon kay samney dekh len gay , aur inn kay tamam bahami rishtay katt ker reh jayen gay

ayahs.text: aur jinhon ney inn ( peshwaon ) ki perwi ki thi woh kahen gay kay kaash hamen aik martaba phir ( duniya mein ) loattney ka moaqa dey diya jaye , to hum bhi inn ( peshwaon ) say issi tarah bey talluqi ka aelaan keren jaisay unhon ney hum say bey talluqi ka aelaan kiya hai . iss tarah Allah enhen dikha dey ga kay inn kay aemal ( aaj ) inn kay liye hasrat hi hasrat ban chukay hain , aur abb woh kissi soorat dozakh say nikalney walay nahi hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jinhon ney inn ( peshwaon ) ki perwi ki thi woh kahen gay kay kaash hamen aik martaba phir ( duniya mein ) loattney ka moaqa dey diya jaye , to hum bhi inn ( peshwaon ) say issi tarah bey talluqi ka aelaan keren jaisay unhon ney hum say bey talluqi ka aelaan kiya hai . iss tarah Allah enhen dikha dey ga kay inn kay aemal ( aaj ) inn kay liye hasrat hi hasrat ban chukay hain , aur abb woh kissi soorat dozakh say nikalney walay nahi hain .

ayahs.text: aey logo ! zameen mein jo halal pakeezah cheezen hain woh khao ,   aur shetan kay naqsh-e-qadam per naa chalo . yaqeen jano kay woh tumharay liye aik khula dushman hai
ayahs.translation: aey logo ! zameen mein jo halal pakeezah cheezen hain woh khao ,   aur shetan kay naqsh-e-qadam per naa chalo . yaqeen jano kay woh tumharay liye aik khula dushman hai

ayahs.text: woh to tum ko yehi hukum dey ga kay tum badi aur bey hayai kay kaam kero aur Allah kay zimmay woh baaten lagao jinn ka tumhen ilm nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: woh to tum ko yehi hukum dey ga kay tum badi aur bey hayai kay kaam kero aur Allah kay zimmay woh baaten lagao jinn ka tumhen ilm nahi hai .

ayahs.text: aur jab inn ( kafiron ) say kaha jata hai kay uss kalam ki perwi kero jo Allah ney utaara hai , to woh kehtay hain kay nahi ! hum to unn baaton ki perwi keren gay jinn per hum ney apney baap dadon ko paya hai . bhala kiya uss soorat mein bhi ( inn ko yehi chahiye ) jab unn kay baap daday ( deen ki ) zara bhi samajh naa rakhtay hon , aur unhon ney koi ( aasmani ) hidayat bhi hasil naa ki ho-?
ayahs.translation: aur jab inn ( kafiron ) say kaha jata hai kay uss kalam ki perwi kero jo Allah ney utaara hai , to woh kehtay hain kay nahi ! hum to unn baaton ki perwi keren gay jinn per hum ney apney baap dadon ko paya hai . bhala kiya uss soorat mein bhi ( inn ko yehi chahiye ) jab unn kay baap daday ( deen ki ) zara bhi samajh naa rakhtay hon , aur unhon ney koi ( aasmani ) hidayat bhi hasil naa ki ho-?

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr ko apna liya hai unn ( ko haq ki dawat denay ) ki misal kuch aesi hai jaisay koi shaks unn ( janweron ) ko zor zor say bulaye jo haank pukar kay siwa kuch nahi suntay . yeh behray , goongay andhay hain , lehaza kuch nahi samajhtay .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr ko apna liya hai unn ( ko haq ki dawat denay ) ki misal kuch aesi hai jaisay koi shaks unn ( janweron ) ko zor zor say bulaye jo haank pukar kay siwa kuch nahi suntay . yeh behray , goongay andhay hain , lehaza kuch nahi samajhtay .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! jo pakeezah cheezen hum ney tumhen rizq kay tor per ata ki hain , unn mein say ( jo chahao ) khao , aur Allah ka shukar ada kero , agar waqaee tum sirf ussi ki bandagi kertay ho .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! jo pakeezah cheezen hum ney tumhen rizq kay tor per ata ki hain , unn mein say ( jo chahao ) khao , aur Allah ka shukar ada kero , agar waqaee tum sirf ussi ki bandagi kertay ho .

ayahs.text: uss ney to tumharay liye bus murdar janwer , khoon , aur soowar haram kiya hai , neez woh janwer jis jiss per Allah kay siwa kissi aur ka naam pukara gaya ho .   haan agar koi shaks intehai majboori ki halat mein ho ( aur unn cheezon mein say kuch kha ley ) jabkay uss ka maqsad naa lazzat hasil kerna ho aur naa woh ( zaroorat ki ) hadd say aagay barhay , to uss per koi gunah nahi . yaqeenan Allah boht bakhshney wala bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: uss ney to tumharay liye bus murdar janwer , khoon , aur soowar haram kiya hai , neez woh janwer jis jiss per Allah kay siwa kissi aur ka naam pukara gaya ho .   haan agar koi shaks intehai majboori ki halat mein ho ( aur unn cheezon mein say kuch kha ley ) jabkay uss ka maqsad naa lazzat hasil kerna ho aur naa woh ( zaroorat ki ) hadd say aagay barhay , to uss per koi gunah nahi . yaqeenan Allah boht bakhshney wala bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log Allah ki nazil ki hoi kitab ko chupatay hain aur uss kay badlay thori si qeemat wasool kerletay hain , woh apney pet mein aag kay siwa kuch nahi bhar rahey . qayamat kay din Allah unn say kalam bhi nahi keray ga , aur naa unn ko pak keray ga , aur unn kay liye dardnak azab hai
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log Allah ki nazil ki hoi kitab ko chupatay hain aur uss kay badlay thori si qeemat wasool kerletay hain , woh apney pet mein aag kay siwa kuch nahi bhar rahey . qayamat kay din Allah unn say kalam bhi nahi keray ga , aur naa unn ko pak keray ga , aur unn kay liye dardnak azab hai

ayahs.text: yeh woh log hain jinhon ney hidayat kay badlay gumrahi , aur maghfirat kay badlay azab ki khareedaari kerli hai . chunacheh ( andaza kero kay ) yeh dozakh ki aag sehnay kay liye kitney tayyar hain !
ayahs.translation: yeh woh log hain jinhon ney hidayat kay badlay gumrahi , aur maghfirat kay badlay azab ki khareedaari kerli hai . chunacheh ( andaza kero kay ) yeh dozakh ki aag sehnay kay liye kitney tayyar hain !

ayahs.text: yeh sabb kuch iss liye hoga kay Allah ney haq per mushtamil kitab utaari hai , aur jinn logon  ney aesi kitab kay baaray mein mukhalifat ka ravaiyya ikhtiyar kiya hai woh zida ziddi mein boht door nikal gaye hain .
ayahs.translation: yeh sabb kuch iss liye hoga kay Allah ney haq per mushtamil kitab utaari hai , aur jinn logon  ney aesi kitab kay baaray mein mukhalifat ka ravaiyya ikhtiyar kiya hai woh zida ziddi mein boht door nikal gaye hain .

ayahs.text: naiki bus yehi to nahi hai kay apney chehray mashriq ya maghrib ki taraf kerlo ,   balkay naiki yeh hai kay log Allah per , aakhirat kay din per , farishton per aur Allah ki kitabon aur uss kay nabiyon per emaan layen , aur Allah ki mohabbat mein apna maal rishta daaron , yateemon , miskeeno , musfiron aur saeelon ko den , aur ghulamon ko azad keraney mein kharch keren , aur namaz qaeem keren aur zakat ada keren , aur jab koi ehad kerlen to apney ehad ko poora kernay kay aadi hon , aur tangi aur takleef mein , neez jang kay waqt , sabar o istaqlal kay khoogar hon . aesay log hain jo sachay ( kehlaney kay mustahiq ) hain , aur yehi log hain jo muttaqi hain .
ayahs.translation: naiki bus yehi to nahi hai kay apney chehray mashriq ya maghrib ki taraf kerlo ,   balkay naiki yeh hai kay log Allah per , aakhirat kay din per , farishton per aur Allah ki kitabon aur uss kay nabiyon per emaan layen , aur Allah ki mohabbat mein apna maal rishta daaron , yateemon , miskeeno , musfiron aur saeelon ko den , aur ghulamon ko azad keraney mein kharch keren , aur namaz qaeem keren aur zakat ada keren , aur jab koi ehad kerlen to apney ehad ko poora kernay kay aadi hon , aur tangi aur takleef mein , neez jang kay waqt , sabar o istaqlal kay khoogar hon . aesay log hain jo sachay ( kehlaney kay mustahiq ) hain , aur yehi log hain jo muttaqi hain .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! jo log ( jaan boojh ker nahaq ) qatal kerdiye jayen unn kay baaray mein tum per qisaas ( ka hukum ) farz kerdiya gaya hai . azad kay badlay azad , ghulam kay badlay ghulam aur aurat kay badlay aurat ( hi ko qatal kiya jaye )   , phir agar qatil ko uss kay bhai ( yani maqtool kay waris ) ki taraf say kuch moaafi dey di jaye   to maroof tareeqay kay mutabiq ( khoon baha ka ) mutalba kerna ( waris ka ) haq hai , aur ussay khush asloobi say ada kerna ( qatil ka ) farz hai . yeh tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik aasani peda ki gaee hai aur aik rehmat hai . iss kay baad bhi koi ziyadti keray to woh dardnak azab ka mustahiq hai
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! jo log ( jaan boojh ker nahaq ) qatal kerdiye jayen unn kay baaray mein tum per qisaas ( ka hukum ) farz kerdiya gaya hai . azad kay badlay azad , ghulam kay badlay ghulam aur aurat kay badlay aurat ( hi ko qatal kiya jaye )   , phir agar qatil ko uss kay bhai ( yani maqtool kay waris ) ki taraf say kuch moaafi dey di jaye   to maroof tareeqay kay mutabiq ( khoon baha ka ) mutalba kerna ( waris ka ) haq hai , aur ussay khush asloobi say ada kerna ( qatil ka ) farz hai . yeh tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik aasani peda ki gaee hai aur aik rehmat hai . iss kay baad bhi koi ziyadti keray to woh dardnak azab ka mustahiq hai

ayahs.text: aur aey aqal rakhney walo ! tumharay liye qisaas mein zindagi ( ka saman hai ) umeed hai kay tum ( iss ki khilaf warzi say ) bacho gay .
ayahs.translation: aur aey aqal rakhney walo ! tumharay liye qisaas mein zindagi ( ka saman hai ) umeed hai kay tum ( iss ki khilaf warzi say ) bacho gay .

ayahs.text: tum per farz kiya gaya hai kay agar tum mein say koi , apney peechay maal chorr ker janey wala ho to jab uss ki moat ka waqt qareeb aajaye , woh apney walaiden aur qareebi rishta daaron kay haq mein dastoor kay mutabiq wasiyyat keray .   yeh muttaqi logon  kay zimmay aik lazimi haq hai
ayahs.translation: tum per farz kiya gaya hai kay agar tum mein say koi , apney peechay maal chorr ker janey wala ho to jab uss ki moat ka waqt qareeb aajaye , woh apney walaiden aur qareebi rishta daaron kay haq mein dastoor kay mutabiq wasiyyat keray .   yeh muttaqi logon  kay zimmay aik lazimi haq hai

ayahs.text: phir jo shaks iss wasiyyat ko sunney kay baad uss mein koi tabdeeli keray ga , to uss ka gunah unn logon  per hoga jo uss mein tabdeeli keren gay .   yaqeen rakho kay Allah ( sabb kuch ) sunta janta hai
ayahs.translation: phir jo shaks iss wasiyyat ko sunney kay baad uss mein koi tabdeeli keray ga , to uss ka gunah unn logon  per hoga jo uss mein tabdeeli keren gay .   yaqeen rakho kay Allah ( sabb kuch ) sunta janta hai

ayahs.text: haan agar kissi shaks ko yeh andesha ho kay koi wasiyyat kernay wala bey jaa taraf daari ya gunah ka irtikab ker raha hai , aur woh mutalliqa aadmiyon kay darmiyan sulah kera dey to uss per koi gunah nahi .   beyshak Allah taalaa boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: haan agar kissi shaks ko yeh andesha ho kay koi wasiyyat kernay wala bey jaa taraf daari ya gunah ka irtikab ker raha hai , aur woh mutalliqa aadmiyon kay darmiyan sulah kera dey to uss per koi gunah nahi .   beyshak Allah taalaa boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! tum per rozay farz kerdiye gaye hain , jiss tarah tum say pehlay logon  per farz kiye gaye thay , takay tumharay andar taqwa peda ho
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! tum per rozay farz kerdiye gaye hain , jiss tarah tum say pehlay logon  per farz kiye gaye thay , takay tumharay andar taqwa peda ho

ayahs.text: ginti kay chand din rozay rakhney hain . phir bhi agar tum mein say koi shaks beemar ho ya safar per ho to woh doosray dino mein itni hi tadaad poori kerlay . aur jo log iss ki taqat rakhtay hon woh aik miskeen ko khana khila ker ( rozay ka ) fidya ada kerden   iss kay ilawa agar koi shaks apni khushi say koi naiki keray to yeh uss kay haq mein behtar hai . aur agar tum ko samajh ho to rozay rakhney mein tumharay liye ziyada behtari hai
ayahs.translation: ginti kay chand din rozay rakhney hain . phir bhi agar tum mein say koi shaks beemar ho ya safar per ho to woh doosray dino mein itni hi tadaad poori kerlay . aur jo log iss ki taqat rakhtay hon woh aik miskeen ko khana khila ker ( rozay ka ) fidya ada kerden   iss kay ilawa agar koi shaks apni khushi say koi naiki keray to yeh uss kay haq mein behtar hai . aur agar tum ko samajh ho to rozay rakhney mein tumharay liye ziyada behtari hai

ayahs.text: ramzan ka maheena woh hai jiss mein Quran nazil kiya gaya jo logon  kay liye sarapa hidayat , aur aesi roshan nishaniyon ka hamil hai jo sahih raasta dikhati aur haq o batil kay darmiyan do tok faisla ker-deti hain , lehaza tum mein say jo shaks bhi yeh maheena paye , woh iss mein zaroor roza rakhay . aur agar koi shaks beemar ho ya safar per ho to woh doosray dino mein itni hi tadaad poori kerlay . Allah tumharay sath aasani ka moamla kerna chahta hai , aur tumharay liye mushkil peda kerna nahi chahta , takay ( tum rozon ki ) ginti poori kerlo , aur Allah ney tumhen jo raah dikhai uss per Allah ki takbeer kaho ,   aur takay tum shukar guzaar bano .
ayahs.translation: ramzan ka maheena woh hai jiss mein Quran nazil kiya gaya jo logon  kay liye sarapa hidayat , aur aesi roshan nishaniyon ka hamil hai jo sahih raasta dikhati aur haq o batil kay darmiyan do tok faisla ker-deti hain , lehaza tum mein say jo shaks bhi yeh maheena paye , woh iss mein zaroor roza rakhay . aur agar koi shaks beemar ho ya safar per ho to woh doosray dino mein itni hi tadaad poori kerlay . Allah tumharay sath aasani ka moamla kerna chahta hai , aur tumharay liye mushkil peda kerna nahi chahta , takay ( tum rozon ki ) ginti poori kerlo , aur Allah ney tumhen jo raah dikhai uss per Allah ki takbeer kaho ,   aur takay tum shukar guzaar bano .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab meray banday aap say meray baaray mein poochen to ( aap unn say keh dijiye kay ) mein itna qareeb hun kay jab koi mujhay pukarta hai to mein pukarney walay ki pukar sunta hun .   lehaza woh bhi meri baat dil say qubool keren , aur mujh per emaan layen , takay woh raah-e-raast per aajayen .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab meray banday aap say meray baaray mein poochen to ( aap unn say keh dijiye kay ) mein itna qareeb hun kay jab koi mujhay pukarta hai to mein pukarney walay ki pukar sunta hun .   lehaza woh bhi meri baat dil say qubool keren , aur mujh per emaan layen , takay woh raah-e-raast per aajayen .

ayahs.text: tumharay liye halal kerdiya gaya hai kay rozon ki raat mein tum apni biwiyon say bey takalluf sohbat kero . woh tumharay liye libas hain , aur tum unn kay liye libas ho . Allah ko ilm tha kay tum apney aap say khayanat ker rahey thay , phir uss ney tum per inayat ki aur tumhari ghalati moaaf farma-di ,   chunacheh abb tum unn say sohbat kerliya kero , aur jo kuch Allah ney tumharay liye likh rakha hai ussay talab kero ,   aur uss waqt tak khao piyo jab tak subha ki safaid dhaari siyah dhaari say mumtaz ho ker tum per wazeh ( naa ) hojaye . uss kay baad raat aaney tak rozay pooray kero . aur inn ( apni biwiyon ) say uss halat mein mubashrat naa kero jab tum masjidon mein aetikaf mein bethay ho . yeh Allah ki ( muqarrar ki hoi ) hudood hain , lehaza inn ( ki khilaf warzi ) kay qareeb bhi matt jana . issi tarah Allah apni nishaniyan logon  kay samney khol khol ker biyan kerta hai , takay woh taqwa ikhtiyar keren .
ayahs.translation: tumharay liye halal kerdiya gaya hai kay rozon ki raat mein tum apni biwiyon say bey takalluf sohbat kero . woh tumharay liye libas hain , aur tum unn kay liye libas ho . Allah ko ilm tha kay tum apney aap say khayanat ker rahey thay , phir uss ney tum per inayat ki aur tumhari ghalati moaaf farma-di ,   chunacheh abb tum unn say sohbat kerliya kero , aur jo kuch Allah ney tumharay liye likh rakha hai ussay talab kero ,   aur uss waqt tak khao piyo jab tak subha ki safaid dhaari siyah dhaari say mumtaz ho ker tum per wazeh ( naa ) hojaye . uss kay baad raat aaney tak rozay pooray kero . aur inn ( apni biwiyon ) say uss halat mein mubashrat naa kero jab tum masjidon mein aetikaf mein bethay ho . yeh Allah ki ( muqarrar ki hoi ) hudood hain , lehaza inn ( ki khilaf warzi ) kay qareeb bhi matt jana . issi tarah Allah apni nishaniyan logon  kay samney khol khol ker biyan kerta hai , takay woh taqwa ikhtiyar keren .

ayahs.text: aur aapas mein aik doosray ka maal nahaq tareeqon say naa khao , aur naa unn ka muqadma hakimon kay paas iss gharz say ley jao kay logon  kay maal ka koi hissa jantay boojhtay harrap kernay ka gunah kero .
ayahs.translation: aur aapas mein aik doosray ka maal nahaq tareeqon say naa khao , aur naa unn ka muqadma hakimon kay paas iss gharz say ley jao kay logon  kay maal ka koi hissa jantay boojhtay harrap kernay ka gunah kero .

ayahs.text:
log aap say naye maheenon kay chaand kay baaray mein poochtay hain . aap unhen bata dijiye kay yeh logon  kay ( mukhtalif moamlaat kay ) aur hajj kay oqaat mutayyan kernay kay liye hain .  
  aur yeh koi naiki nahi hai kay tum gharon mein unn ki pusht ki taraf say dakhil ho ,   balkay naiki yeh hai kay insan taqwa ikhtiyar keray , aur tum gharon mein unn kay darwazon say dakhil huwa kero , aur Allah say dartay raho , takay tumhen falah hasil ho .
ayahs.translation:
log aap say naye maheenon kay chaand kay baaray mein poochtay hain . aap unhen bata dijiye kay yeh logon  kay ( mukhtalif moamlaat kay ) aur hajj kay oqaat mutayyan kernay kay liye hain .  
  aur yeh koi naiki nahi hai kay tum gharon mein unn ki pusht ki taraf say dakhil ho ,   balkay naiki yeh hai kay insan taqwa ikhtiyar keray , aur tum gharon mein unn kay darwazon say dakhil huwa kero , aur Allah say dartay raho , takay tumhen falah hasil ho .

ayahs.text: aur unn logon  say Allah kay raastay mein jang kero jo tum say jang kertay hain , aur ziyadti naa kero . yaqeen jano kay Allah ziyadti kernay walon ko pasand nahi kerta .
ayahs.translation: aur unn logon  say Allah kay raastay mein jang kero jo tum say jang kertay hain , aur ziyadti naa kero . yaqeen jano kay Allah ziyadti kernay walon ko pasand nahi kerta .

ayahs.text: aur tum unn logon  ko jahan pao qatal kero , aur unhen uss jagah say nikal bahir kero jahan say unhon ney tumhen nikala tha . aur fitna qatal say ziyada sangeen burai hai .   aur tum unn say masjid-e-haram kay paas uss waqt tak larraee naa kero jab tak woh khud uss mein tum say larraee shuroo naa keren . haan agar woh tum say uss mein larraee shuroo kerden to tum unn ko qatal ker-saktay ho . aesay kafiron ki saza yehi hai
ayahs.translation: aur tum unn logon  ko jahan pao qatal kero , aur unhen uss jagah say nikal bahir kero jahan say unhon ney tumhen nikala tha . aur fitna qatal say ziyada sangeen burai hai .   aur tum unn say masjid-e-haram kay paas uss waqt tak larraee naa kero jab tak woh khud uss mein tum say larraee shuroo naa keren . haan agar woh tum say uss mein larraee shuroo kerden to tum unn ko qatal ker-saktay ho . aesay kafiron ki saza yehi hai

ayahs.text: phir agar woh baaz aajayen to beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai
ayahs.translation: phir agar woh baaz aajayen to beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai

ayahs.text: aur tum unn say larrtay raho yahan tak kay fitna baqi naa rahey , aur deen Allah ka hojaye .   phir agar woh baaz aajayen to ( samajh lo kay ) tashaddud siwaye zalimon kay kissi per nahi hona chahiye .
ayahs.translation: aur tum unn say larrtay raho yahan tak kay fitna baqi naa rahey , aur deen Allah ka hojaye .   phir agar woh baaz aajayen to ( samajh lo kay ) tashaddud siwaye zalimon kay kissi per nahi hona chahiye .

ayahs.text: hurmat walay maheenay ka badla hurmat wala maheena hai , aur hurmaton per bhi badlay kay ehkaam jari hotay hain .   chunacheh agar koi shaks tum per koi ziyadti keray to tum bhi wesi hi ziyadti uss per kero jaisi ziyadti uss ney tum per ki ho , aur Allah say dartay raho , aur achi tarah samajh lo kay Allah unhi ka sathi hai jo uss ka khof dil mein rakhtay hain
ayahs.translation: hurmat walay maheenay ka badla hurmat wala maheena hai , aur hurmaton per bhi badlay kay ehkaam jari hotay hain .   chunacheh agar koi shaks tum per koi ziyadti keray to tum bhi wesi hi ziyadti uss per kero jaisi ziyadti uss ney tum per ki ho , aur Allah say dartay raho , aur achi tarah samajh lo kay Allah unhi ka sathi hai jo uss ka khof dil mein rakhtay hain

ayahs.text: aur Allah kay raastay mein maal kharch kero , aur apney aap ko khud apney haathon halakat mein naa daalo ,   aur naiki ikhtiyar kero . beyshak Allah naiki kernay walon say mohabbat kerta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah kay raastay mein maal kharch kero , aur apney aap ko khud apney haathon halakat mein naa daalo ,   aur naiki ikhtiyar kero . beyshak Allah naiki kernay walon say mohabbat kerta hai .

ayahs.text: aur hajj aur umrah Allah kay liye poora poora ada kero , haan agar tumhen rok diya jaye to jo qurbani moyassar ho , ( Allah kay huzoor paish kerdo ) .   aur apney sar uss waqt tak naa mundao jab tak qurbani apni jagah naa phonch jaye . haan agar tum mein say koi shaks beemar ho , ya uss kay sar mein koi takleef ho to rozon ya sadqay ya qurbani ka fidya dey .   phir jab tum aman hasil kerlo to jo shaks hajj kay sath umray ka faeeda bhi uthaye woh jo qurbani moyassar ho ( Allah kay huzoor paish keray ) . haan agar kissi kay paas iss ki taqat naa ho to woh hajj kay dino mein teen rozay rakhay , aur saat ( rozay ) uss waqt jab tum ( gharon ko ) loat jao . iss tarah yeh kul das rozay hon gay .   yeh hukum unn logon  kay liye hai jinn kay ghar walay masjid-e-haram kay paas naa rehtay hon   . aur Allah say dartay raho , aur jaan rakho kay Allah ka azab bara sakht hai .
ayahs.translation: aur hajj aur umrah Allah kay liye poora poora ada kero , haan agar tumhen rok diya jaye to jo qurbani moyassar ho , ( Allah kay huzoor paish kerdo ) .   aur apney sar uss waqt tak naa mundao jab tak qurbani apni jagah naa phonch jaye . haan agar tum mein say koi shaks beemar ho , ya uss kay sar mein koi takleef ho to rozon ya sadqay ya qurbani ka fidya dey .   phir jab tum aman hasil kerlo to jo shaks hajj kay sath umray ka faeeda bhi uthaye woh jo qurbani moyassar ho ( Allah kay huzoor paish keray ) . haan agar kissi kay paas iss ki taqat naa ho to woh hajj kay dino mein teen rozay rakhay , aur saat ( rozay ) uss waqt jab tum ( gharon ko ) loat jao . iss tarah yeh kul das rozay hon gay .   yeh hukum unn logon  kay liye hai jinn kay ghar walay masjid-e-haram kay paas naa rehtay hon   . aur Allah say dartay raho , aur jaan rakho kay Allah ka azab bara sakht hai .

ayahs.text: hajj kay chand mutayyan maheenay hain . chunacheh jo shaks inn maheenon mein ( ehraam baandh ker ) apney oopper hajj lazim kerlay to hajj kay doran naa woh koi fohash baat keray , naa koi gunah , naa koi jhagrra . aur tum jo koi naik kaam kero gay , Allah ussay jaan ley ga . aur ( hajj kay safar mein ) zaad-e-raah sath ley jaya kero , kiyonkay behtareen zaad-e-raah taqwa hai .   aur aey aqal walo ! meri nafarmani say dartay raho
ayahs.translation: hajj kay chand mutayyan maheenay hain . chunacheh jo shaks inn maheenon mein ( ehraam baandh ker ) apney oopper hajj lazim kerlay to hajj kay doran naa woh koi fohash baat keray , naa koi gunah , naa koi jhagrra . aur tum jo koi naik kaam kero gay , Allah ussay jaan ley ga . aur ( hajj kay safar mein ) zaad-e-raah sath ley jaya kero , kiyonkay behtareen zaad-e-raah taqwa hai .   aur aey aqal walo ! meri nafarmani say dartay raho

ayahs.text: tum per iss baat mein koi gunah nahi hai kay tum ( hajj kay doran tijarat ya mazdoori kay zariye ) apney perwerdigar ka fazal talash kero .   phir jab tum arafaat say rawana ho to mashar-e-haram kay paas ( jo muzdalfa mein waqay hai ) Allah ka ziker kero , aur uss ka ziker ussi tarah kero jiss tarah uss ney tumhen hidayat ki hai ,   jabkay iss say pehlay tum bilkul na-waqif thay
ayahs.translation: tum per iss baat mein koi gunah nahi hai kay tum ( hajj kay doran tijarat ya mazdoori kay zariye ) apney perwerdigar ka fazal talash kero .   phir jab tum arafaat say rawana ho to mashar-e-haram kay paas ( jo muzdalfa mein waqay hai ) Allah ka ziker kero , aur uss ka ziker ussi tarah kero jiss tarah uss ney tumhen hidayat ki hai ,   jabkay iss say pehlay tum bilkul na-waqif thay

ayahs.text: iss kay ilawa ( yeh baat bhi yaad rakho kay ) tum ussi jagah say rawana ho jahan say aam log rawana hotay hain .   aur Allah say maghfirat maango . beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: iss kay ilawa ( yeh baat bhi yaad rakho kay ) tum ussi jagah say rawana ho jahan say aam log rawana hotay hain .   aur Allah say maghfirat maango . beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: phir jab tum apney hajj kay kaam pooray ker-chuko to Allah ka iss tarah ziker kero jaisay tum apney baap dadon ka ziker kiya kertay ho , balkay uss say bhi ziyada ziker kero .   abb baaz log to woh hain jo ( dua mein bus ) yeh kehtay hain kay :  " aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen duniya mein bhalai ata farma " aur aakhirat mein unn ka koi hissa nahi hota
ayahs.translation: phir jab tum apney hajj kay kaam pooray ker-chuko to Allah ka iss tarah ziker kero jaisay tum apney baap dadon ka ziker kiya kertay ho , balkay uss say bhi ziyada ziker kero .   abb baaz log to woh hain jo ( dua mein bus ) yeh kehtay hain kay :  " aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen duniya mein bhalai ata farma " aur aakhirat mein unn ka koi hissa nahi hota

ayahs.text: aur unhi mein say woh bhi hain jo yeh kehtay hain kay :   aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen duniya mein bhi bhalai ata farma aur aakhirat mein bhi bhalai , aur hamen dozakh kay azab say bacha ley
ayahs.translation: aur unhi mein say woh bhi hain jo yeh kehtay hain kay :   aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen duniya mein bhi bhalai ata farma aur aakhirat mein bhi bhalai , aur hamen dozakh kay azab say bacha ley

ayahs.text: yeh woh log hain jinhen apney aemal ki kamai ka hissa ( sawab ki soorat mein ) milay ga , aur Allah jald hisab lenay wala hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh woh log hain jinhen apney aemal ki kamai ka hissa ( sawab ki soorat mein ) milay ga , aur Allah jald hisab lenay wala hai .

ayahs.text: aur Allah ko ginti kay ( unn chand ) dino mein ( jab tum mina mein muqeem ho ) yaad kertay raho . phir jo shaks do hi din mein jaldi chala jaye uss per bhi koi gunah nahi hai , aur jo shaks ( aik din ) baad mein jaye uss per bhi koi gunah nahi .   yeh ( tafseel ) uss kay liye hai jo taqwa ikhtiyar keray . aur tum sabb taqwa ikhtiyar kero , aur yaqeen rakho kay tum sabb ko ussi ki taraf ley jaa ker jama kiya jaye ga
ayahs.translation: aur Allah ko ginti kay ( unn chand ) dino mein ( jab tum mina mein muqeem ho ) yaad kertay raho . phir jo shaks do hi din mein jaldi chala jaye uss per bhi koi gunah nahi hai , aur jo shaks ( aik din ) baad mein jaye uss per bhi koi gunah nahi .   yeh ( tafseel ) uss kay liye hai jo taqwa ikhtiyar keray . aur tum sabb taqwa ikhtiyar kero , aur yaqeen rakho kay tum sabb ko ussi ki taraf ley jaa ker jama kiya jaye ga

ayahs.text: aur logon  mein aik woh shaks bhi hai kay dunyawi zindagi kay baaray mein uss ki baaten tumhen bari achi lagti hain , aur jo kuch uss kay dil mein hai uss per woh Allah ko gawah bhi banata hai , halankay woh ( tumharay ) dushmanon mein sabb say ziyada kattar hai
ayahs.translation: aur logon  mein aik woh shaks bhi hai kay dunyawi zindagi kay baaray mein uss ki baaten tumhen bari achi lagti hain , aur jo kuch uss kay dil mein hai uss per woh Allah ko gawah bhi banata hai , halankay woh ( tumharay ) dushmanon mein sabb say ziyada kattar hai

ayahs.text: aur jab uth ker jata hai to zameen mein uss ki dorr dhoop iss liye hoti hai kay woh uss mein fasad machaye , aur faslen aur naslen tabah keray , halankay Allah fasad ko pasand nahi kerta
ayahs.translation: aur jab uth ker jata hai to zameen mein uss ki dorr dhoop iss liye hoti hai kay woh uss mein fasad machaye , aur faslen aur naslen tabah keray , halankay Allah fasad ko pasand nahi kerta

ayahs.text: aur jab uss say kaha jata hai kay Allah ka khof ker , to nakhwat uss ko gunah per aur aamada ker-deti hai . chunacheh aesay shaks ko to jahannum hi raas aaye gi ,
ayahs.translation: aur jab uss say kaha jata hai kay Allah ka khof ker , to nakhwat uss ko gunah per aur aamada ker-deti hai . chunacheh aesay shaks ko to jahannum hi raas aaye gi ,

ayahs.text: aur yaqeen kero woh boht bura bichona hai aur ( doosri taraf ) logon  mein woh shaks bhi hai jo Allah ki khushnoodi ki khatir apni jaan ka soda kerleta hai ,   aur Allah ( aesay ) bandon per bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: aur yaqeen kero woh boht bura bichona hai aur ( doosri taraf ) logon  mein woh shaks bhi hai jo Allah ki khushnoodi ki khatir apni jaan ka soda kerleta hai ,   aur Allah ( aesay ) bandon per bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! Islam mein pooray kay pooray dakhil hojao , aur shetan kay naqsh-e-qadam per naa chalo . yaqeen jano woh tumhara khula dushman hai
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! Islam mein pooray kay pooray dakhil hojao , aur shetan kay naqsh-e-qadam per naa chalo . yaqeen jano woh tumhara khula dushman hai

ayahs.text: phir jo roshan dalaeel tumharay paas aa-chukay hain , agar tum unn kay baad bhi ( raah-e-raast say ) phisal gaye to yaad rakho kay Allah iqtidar mein bhi kamil hai , hikmat mein bhi kamil
ayahs.translation: phir jo roshan dalaeel tumharay paas aa-chukay hain , agar tum unn kay baad bhi ( raah-e-raast say ) phisal gaye to yaad rakho kay Allah iqtidar mein bhi kamil hai , hikmat mein bhi kamil

ayahs.text: yeh ( kuffaar emaan laney kay liye ) uss kay siwa kiss baat ka intizar ker rahey hain kay Allah khud badal kay sayebanon mein unn kay samney aa-mojood ho , aur farishtay bhi ( uss kay sath hon ) aur sara moamla abhi chuka diya jaye ?   halankay aakhir kaar saray moamlaat Allah hi ki taraf to loat ker rahen gay
ayahs.translation: yeh ( kuffaar emaan laney kay liye ) uss kay siwa kiss baat ka intizar ker rahey hain kay Allah khud badal kay sayebanon mein unn kay samney aa-mojood ho , aur farishtay bhi ( uss kay sath hon ) aur sara moamla abhi chuka diya jaye ?   halankay aakhir kaar saray moamlaat Allah hi ki taraf to loat ker rahen gay

ayahs.text: bani Israel say poocho hum ney unn ko kitni sari khuli nishaniyan di then ! aur jiss shaks kay paas Allah ki naimat aa-chuki ho , phir woh uss ko badal daalay , to ( ussay yaad rakhna chahiye kay ) Allah ka azab bara sakht hai
ayahs.translation: bani Israel say poocho hum ney unn ko kitni sari khuli nishaniyan di then ! aur jiss shaks kay paas Allah ki naimat aa-chuki ho , phir woh uss ko badal daalay , to ( ussay yaad rakhna chahiye kay ) Allah ka azab bara sakht hai

ayahs.text: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay liye dunyawi zindagi bari dilkash bana di gaee hai , aur woh ehal-e-emaan ka mazaq uratay hain , halankay jinhon ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya hai woh qayamat kay din inn say kahen buland hon gay . aur Allah jiss ko chahta hai bey hisab rizq deta hai .
ayahs.translation: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay liye dunyawi zindagi bari dilkash bana di gaee hai , aur woh ehal-e-emaan ka mazaq uratay hain , halankay jinhon ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya hai woh qayamat kay din inn say kahen buland hon gay . aur Allah jiss ko chahta hai bey hisab rizq deta hai .

ayahs.text: . ( shuroo mein ) saray insan aik hi deen kay pero thay . phir ( jab unn mein ikhtilaf huwa to ) Allah ney nabi bhejay jo ( haq walon ko ) khushkhabri sunatay , aur ( batil walon ko ) daratay thay , aur unn kay sath haq per mushtamil kitab nazil ki , takay woh logon  kay darmiyan unn baaton ka faisla keray jinn mein unn ka ikhtilaf tha . aur ( afsos ki baat yeh hai kay ) kissi aur ney nahi balkay khud unhon ney jinn ko woh kitab di gaee thi , roshan dalaeel aajaney kay baad bhi , sirf bahami zidd ki wajeh say issi ( kitab ) mein ikhtilaf nikal liya . phir jo log emaan laye Allah ney unhen apney hukum say haq ki unn baaton mein raah-e-raast tak phonchaya jinn mein unhon ney ikhtilaf kiya tha , aur Allah jissay chahta hai raah-e-raast tak phoncha deta hai .

ayahs.text: log aap say poochtay hain kay woh ( Allah ki khushnoodi kay liye ) kiya kharch keren-? aap keh dijiye kay jo maal bhi tum kharch kero woh walaiden , qareebi rishta daaron , yateemon , miskeeno aur musfiron kay liye hona chahiye . aur tum bhalai ka jo kaam bhi kero , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
ayahs.translation: log aap say poochtay hain kay woh ( Allah ki khushnoodi kay liye ) kiya kharch keren-? aap keh dijiye kay jo maal bhi tum kharch kero woh walaiden , qareebi rishta daaron , yateemon , miskeeno aur musfiron kay liye hona chahiye . aur tum bhalai ka jo kaam bhi kero , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

ayahs.text: tum per ( dushmanon say ) jang kerna farz kiya gaya hai , aur woh tum per giraan hai . aur yeh aen mumkin hai kay tum aik cheez ko bura samjho halankay woh tumharay haq mein behtar ho . aur yeh bhi mumkin hai kay tum aik cheez ko pasand kero , halankay woh tumharay haq mein buri ho . aur ( asal haqeeqat to ) Allah janta hai , aur tum nahi jantay .

ayahs.text: log aap say hurmat walay maheenay kay baaray mein poochtay hain kay uss mein jang kerna kaisa hai ?   aap keh dijiye kay uss mein jang kerna bara gunah hai , magar logon  ko Allah kay raastay say rokna , uss kay khilaf kufr ki rawish ikhtiyar kerna , masjid-e-haram per bandish lagana aur uss kay baasiyon ko wahan say nikal bahir kerna Allah kay nazdeek ziyada bara gunah hai . aur fitna qatal say bhi ziyada sangeen cheez hai . aur yeh ( kafir ) tum logon  say barabar jang kertay rahen gay , yahan tak kay agar inn ka bus chalay to yeh tum ko tumhara deen chorney per aamada kerden . aur agar tum mein say koi shaks apna deen chorr dey , aur kafir honey ki halat hi mein maray , to aesay logon  kay aemal duniya aur aakhirat dono mein ikarat hojayen gay . aesay log dozakh walay hain . woh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .

ayahs.text: . ( iss kay bar-khilaf ) jo log emaan laye aur jinhon ney hijrat ki aur Allah kay raastay mein jihad kiya , to woh beyshak Allah ki rehmat kay umeedwaar hain , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( iss kay bar-khilaf ) jo log emaan laye aur jinhon ney hijrat ki aur Allah kay raastay mein jihad kiya , to woh beyshak Allah ki rehmat kay umeedwaar hain , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: log aap say sharab aur joye kay baaray mein poochtay hain . aap keh dijiye kay inn dono mein bara gunah bhi hai , aur logon  kay liye kuch faeeday bhi hain , aur inn dono ka gunah inn kay faeeday say ziyada barha huwa hai .   aur log aap say poochtay hain kay woh ( Allah ki khushnoodi kay liye ) kiya kharch keren-? aap keh dijiye kay   jo tumhari zaroorat say zaeed ho " .   Allah issi tarah apney ehkaam tumharay liye saaf saaf biyan kerta hai takay tum ghor-o-fiker say kaam lo .

Allah issi tarah apney ehkaam tumharay liye saaf saaf biyan kerta hai takay tum ghor-o-fiker say kaam lo .

ayahs.text: duniya kay baaray mein bhi aur aakhirat kay baaray mein bhi . aur log aap say yateemon kay baaray mein poochtay hain . aap keh dijiye kay unn ki bhalai chahana naik kaam hai , aur agar tum unn kay sath mil jul ker raho to ( kuch harj nahi kiyonkay ) woh tumharay bhai hi to hain . aur Allah khoob janta hai kay kon moamlaat bigaarney wala hai . aur kon sanwarney wala . aur agar Allah chahta to tumhen mushkil mein daal deta .   yaqeenan Allah ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil .

ayahs.text: aur mushrik aurton say uss waqt tak nikah naa kero jab tak woh emaan naa ley ayen . yaqeenan aik momin baandi kissi bhi mushrik aurat say behtar hai , khuwa woh mushrik aurat tumhen pasand aarahi ho . aur apni aurton ka nikah mushrik mardon say naa kerao jab tak woh emaan naa ley ayen . aur yaqeenan aik momin ghulam kissi bhi mushrik mard say behtar hai , khuwa woh mushrik mard tumhen pasand aaraha ho . yeh sabb dozakh ki taraf bulatay hain , jabkay Allah apney hukum say jannat aur maghfirat ki taraf bulata hai , aur apney ehkaam logon  kay samney saaf saaf biyan kerta hai takay woh naseehat hasil keren .
ayahs.translation: aur mushrik aurton say uss waqt tak nikah naa kero jab tak woh emaan naa ley ayen . yaqeenan aik momin baandi kissi bhi mushrik aurat say behtar hai , khuwa woh mushrik aurat tumhen pasand aarahi ho . aur apni aurton ka nikah mushrik mardon say naa kerao jab tak woh emaan naa ley ayen . aur yaqeenan aik momin ghulam kissi bhi mushrik mard say behtar hai , khuwa woh mushrik mard tumhen pasand aaraha ho . yeh sabb dozakh ki taraf bulatay hain , jabkay Allah apney hukum say jannat aur maghfirat ki taraf bulata hai , aur apney ehkaam logon  kay samney saaf saaf biyan kerta hai takay woh naseehat hasil keren .

ayahs.text: aur log aap say haiz kay baaray mein poochtay hain . aap keh dijiye kay woh gandagi hai lehaza haiz ki halat mein aurton say alag raho , aur jab tak woh pak naa hojayen unn say qurbat ( yani jamaa ) naa kero . haan jab woh pak hojayen to unn kay paas ussi tareeqay say jao jiss tarah Allah ney tumhen hukum diya hai . beyshak Allah unn logon  say mohabbat kerta hai jo uss ki taraf kasrat say rujoo keren aur unn say mohabbat kerta hai jo khoob pak saaf rahen .

ayahs.text: tumhari biwiyan tumharay liye khetiyan hain : lehaza apni kheti mein jahan say chahao jao   aur apney liye ( achay amal ) aagay bhejo , aur Allah say dartay raho , aur yaqeen rakho kay tum uss say jaker milney walay ho . aur mominon ko khush khabri suna do .
ayahs.translation: tumhari biwiyan tumharay liye khetiyan hain : lehaza apni kheti mein jahan say chahao jao   aur apney liye ( achay amal ) aagay bhejo , aur Allah say dartay raho , aur yaqeen rakho kay tum uss say jaker milney walay ho . aur mominon ko khush khabri suna do .

ayahs.text: aur Allah ( kay naam ) ko apni qasmon mein iss gharz say istimal naa kero kay uss kay zariye naiki aur taqwa kay kamon aur logon  kay darmiyan sulah safai keraney say bach sako .   aur Allah sabb kuch sunta janta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah ( kay naam ) ko apni qasmon mein iss gharz say istimal naa kero kay uss kay zariye naiki aur taqwa kay kamon aur logon  kay darmiyan sulah safai keraney say bach sako .   aur Allah sabb kuch sunta janta hai .

ayahs.text: Allah tumhari laghw qasmon per tumhari girift nahi keray ga   , albatta jo qasmen tum ney apney dilon kay iraday say khai hon gi unn per girift keray ga . aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara burdbaar hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah tumhari laghw qasmon per tumhari girift nahi keray ga   , albatta jo qasmen tum ney apney dilon kay iraday say khai hon gi unn per girift keray ga . aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara burdbaar hai .

ayahs.text: jo log apni biwiyon say ielaa kertay hain ( yani unn kay paas naa janey ki qasam kha letay hain ) unn kay liye chaar maheenay ki mohlat hai   . chunacheh agar woh ( qasam torr ker ) rujoo kerlen to beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: jo log apni biwiyon say ielaa kertay hain ( yani unn kay paas naa janey ki qasam kha letay hain ) unn kay liye chaar maheenay ki mohlat hai   . chunacheh agar woh ( qasam torr ker ) rujoo kerlen to beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: aur agar unhon ney talaq hi ki thaan li ho to ( bhi ) Allah sunney janney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur agar unhon ney talaq hi ki thaan li ho to ( bhi ) Allah sunney janney wala hai .

ayahs.text: aur jinn aurton ko talaq dey di gaee ho woh teen martaba haiz aaney tak apney aap ko intizar mein rakhen   aur agar woh Allah per aur aakhirat kay din per emaan rakhti hon to unn kay liye halal nahi hai kay Allah ney unn kay reham mein jo kuch ( hamal ya haiz ) peda kiya hai ussay chupayen . aur iss mauddat mein agar unn kay shohar halaat behtar banana chahen to unn ko haq hai kay woh unn aurton ko ( apni zojiyat ) mein wapis ley len . aur unn aurton ko maroof tareeqay kay mutabiq wesay hi huqooq hasil hain jaisay ( mardon ko ) unn per hasil hain . haan mardon ko unn per aik darja foqiyat hai   aur Allah ghalib aur hikmat wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn aurton ko talaq dey di gaee ho woh teen martaba haiz aaney tak apney aap ko intizar mein rakhen   aur agar woh Allah per aur aakhirat kay din per emaan rakhti hon to unn kay liye halal nahi hai kay Allah ney unn kay reham mein jo kuch ( hamal ya haiz ) peda kiya hai ussay chupayen . aur iss mauddat mein agar unn kay shohar halaat behtar banana chahen to unn ko haq hai kay woh unn aurton ko ( apni zojiyat ) mein wapis ley len . aur unn aurton ko maroof tareeqay kay mutabiq wesay hi huqooq hasil hain jaisay ( mardon ko ) unn per hasil hain . haan mardon ko unn per aik darja foqiyat hai   aur Allah ghalib aur hikmat wala hai .

ayahs.text: talaq ( ziyada say ziyada ) do baar honi chahiye . uss kay baad ( shohar kay liye do hi raastay hain ) ya to qaeeday kay mutabiq ( biwi ko ) rok rakhay ( yani talaq say rujoo kerlay ) ya khush asloobi say chorr dey ( yani rujoo kay baghair iddat guzar janey dey ) . aur ( aey shohro ! ) tumharay liye halal nahi hai kay tum ney unn ( biwiyon ) ko jo kuch diya ho woh ( talaq kay badlay ) unn say wapis lo , illa yeh kay dono ko iss baat ka andesha ho kay woh ( nikah baqi rehney ki soorat mein ) Allah ki muqarrar ki hoi hudood ko qaeem nahi rakh saken gay   . chunacheh agar tumhen iss baat ka andesha ho kay woh dono Allah ki hudood ko qaeem naa rakh saken gay to unn dono kay liye iss mein koi gunah nahi hai kay aurat maali moawza dey ker alehdgi hasil kerlay . yeh Allah ki muqarrar ki hoi hudood hain , lehaza inn say tajawuz naa kero . aur jo log Allah ki hudood say tajawuz kertay hain woh baray zalim log hain .
ayahs.translation: talaq ( ziyada say ziyada ) do baar honi chahiye . uss kay baad ( shohar kay liye do hi raastay hain ) ya to qaeeday kay mutabiq ( biwi ko ) rok rakhay ( yani talaq say rujoo kerlay ) ya khush asloobi say chorr dey ( yani rujoo kay baghair iddat guzar janey dey ) . aur ( aey shohro ! ) tumharay liye halal nahi hai kay tum ney unn ( biwiyon ) ko jo kuch diya ho woh ( talaq kay badlay ) unn say wapis lo , illa yeh kay dono ko iss baat ka andesha ho kay woh ( nikah baqi rehney ki soorat mein ) Allah ki muqarrar ki hoi hudood ko qaeem nahi rakh saken gay   . chunacheh agar tumhen iss baat ka andesha ho kay woh dono Allah ki hudood ko qaeem naa rakh saken gay to unn dono kay liye iss mein koi gunah nahi hai kay aurat maali moawza dey ker alehdgi hasil kerlay . yeh Allah ki muqarrar ki hoi hudood hain , lehaza inn say tajawuz naa kero . aur jo log Allah ki hudood say tajawuz kertay hain woh baray zalim log hain .

ayahs.text: phir agar shohar ( teesri ) talaq deydey to woh ( mutlaqa aurat ) uss kay liye uss waqt tak halal nahi hogi jab tak woh kissi aur shohar say nikah naa keray , haan agar woh ( doosra shohar bhi ) ussay talaq deydey to unn dono per koi gunah nahi kay woh aik doosray kay paas ( naya nikah ker kay ) dobara wapis aajayen , ba-shartey-kay unhen yeh ghalib gumaan ho kay abb woh Allah ki hudood qaeem rakhen gay . aur yeh sabb Allah ki hudood hain jo woh unn logon  kay liye wazeh ker raha hai jo samajh rakhtay hon .

ayahs.text: aur jab tum ney aurton ko talaq dey di ho aur woh apni iddat kay qareeb phonch jayen , to ya to unn ko bhalai kay sath ( apni zojiyat mein ) rok rakho , ya unhen bhalai kay sath chorr do . aur unhen sataney ki khatir iss liye rok ker naa rakho kay unn per zulm ker-sako . aur jo shaks aisa keray ga woh khud apni jaan per zulm keray ga . aur Allah ki aayaton ko mazaq matt banao aur Allah ney tum per jo inaam farmaya hai ussay , aur tum per jo kitab aur hikmat ki baaten tumhen naseehat kernay kay liye nazil ki hain unhen yaad rakho . aur Allah say dartay raho , aur jaan rakho kay Allah her cheez ko khoob janta hai .

ayahs.text: aur jab tum ney aurton ko talaq dey di ho , aur woh apni iddat ko phonch jayen , to ( aey meykay walo ! ) unhen iss baat say mana naa kero kay woh apney ( pehlay ) shohron say ( dobara ) nikah keren , ba-shartey-kay woh bhalai kay sath aik doosray say razi hogaye hon .   inn baaton ki naseehat tum mein say unn logon  ko ki jarahi hai jo Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan rakhtay hon . yehi tumharay liye ziyada suthra aur pakeezah tareeqa hai . Allah janta hai aur tum nahi jantay .

Allah janta hai aur tum nahi jantay .

ayahs.text: aur mayen apney bacchon ko pooray do saal tak doodh pilayen . yeh mauddat inn kay liye hai jo doodh pilaney ki mauddat poori kerna chahen . aur jiss baap ka woh baccha hai uss per wajib hai kay woh maroof tareeqay per unn maon kay khaney aur libas ka kharch uthaye   . ( haan ) kissi shaks ko uss ki wusat say ziyada takleef nahi di jati . naa to maa ko apney bacchay ki wajeh say sataya jaye , aur naa baap ko apney bacchay ki wajeh say   . aur issi tarah ki zimma daari waris per bhi hai   . phir agar woh dono ( yani walaiden ) aapas ki raza mandi aur bahami mashwaray say ( do saal guzarney say pehlay hi ) doodh churana chahen to uss mein bhi unn per koi gunah nahi hai . aur agar tum yeh chahao kay apney bacchon ko kissi ana say doodh pilwao to bhi tum per koi gunah nahi , jabkay tum ney jo ujrat thehrai thi woh ( doodh pilaney wali ana ko ) bhalay tareeqay say dey do . aur Allah say dartay raho , aur jaan rakho kay Allah tumharay saray kamon ko achi tarah dekh raha hai .

( haan ) kissi shaks ko uss ki wusat say ziyada takleef nahi di jati . naa to maa ko apney bacchay ki wajeh say sataya jaye , aur naa baap ko apney bacchay ki wajeh say   . aur issi tarah ki zimma daari waris per bhi hai   . phir agar woh dono ( yani walaiden ) aapas ki raza mandi aur bahami mashwaray say ( do saal guzarney say pehlay hi ) doodh churana chahen to uss mein bhi unn per koi gunah nahi hai . aur agar tum yeh chahao kay apney bacchon ko kissi ana say doodh pilwao to bhi tum per koi gunah nahi , jabkay tum ney jo ujrat thehrai thi woh ( doodh pilaney wali ana ko ) bhalay tareeqay say dey do . aur Allah say dartay raho , aur jaan rakho kay Allah tumharay saray kamon ko achi tarah dekh raha hai .

ayahs.text: aur tum mein say jo log wafaat paajayen , aur biwiyan chorr ker jayen to woh biwiyan apney aap ko chaar maheenay aur das din intizar mein rakhen gi . phir jab woh apni ( iddat ki ) miyaad ko phonch jayen to woh apney baaray mein jo kaarawai ( maslan doosra nikah ) qaeeday kay mutabiq keren to tum per kuch gunah nahi . aur jo kuch tum kertay ho Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
ayahs.translation: aur tum mein say jo log wafaat paajayen , aur biwiyan chorr ker jayen to woh biwiyan apney aap ko chaar maheenay aur das din intizar mein rakhen gi . phir jab woh apni ( iddat ki ) miyaad ko phonch jayen to woh apney baaray mein jo kaarawai ( maslan doosra nikah ) qaeeday kay mutabiq keren to tum per kuch gunah nahi . aur jo kuch tum kertay ho Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( iddat kay doran ) agar tum unn aurton ko isharay kanaye mein nikah ka paygham do ya ( unn say nikah ka irada ) dil mein chupaye rakho to tum per koi gunah nahi hai . Allah janta hai kay tum unn ( say nikah ) ka khayal to dil mein lao gay , lekin unn say nikah ka do tarfa wada matt kerna , illa yeh kay munasib tareeqay say koi baat keh do   . aur nikah ka aqd paka kernay ka uss waqt tak irada bhi matt kerna jab tak iddat ki muqarrara mauddat apni miyaad ko naa phonch jaye . aur yaad rakho kay jo kuch tumharay dilon mein hai Allah ussay khoob janta hai ; lehaza uss say dartay raho ; aur yaad rakho kay Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara burdbaar hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( iddat kay doran ) agar tum unn aurton ko isharay kanaye mein nikah ka paygham do ya ( unn say nikah ka irada ) dil mein chupaye rakho to tum per koi gunah nahi hai . Allah janta hai kay tum unn ( say nikah ) ka khayal to dil mein lao gay , lekin unn say nikah ka do tarfa wada matt kerna , illa yeh kay munasib tareeqay say koi baat keh do   . aur nikah ka aqd paka kernay ka uss waqt tak irada bhi matt kerna jab tak iddat ki muqarrara mauddat apni miyaad ko naa phonch jaye . aur yaad rakho kay jo kuch tumharay dilon mein hai Allah ussay khoob janta hai ; lehaza uss say dartay raho ; aur yaad rakho kay Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara burdbaar hai .

ayahs.text: tum per iss mein bhi koi gunah nahi hai kay tum aurton ko aesay waqt talaq do jabkay abhi tum ney unn ko chooa bhi naa ho , aur naa unn kay liye koi mehar muqarrar kiya ho , aur ( aesi soorat mein ) unn ko koi tohfa do   , khushal shaks apni haisiyat kay mutabiq aur gharib aadmi apni haisiyat kay mutabiq bhalay tareeqay say yeh tohfa dey . yeh naik aadmiyon per aik lazimi haq hai .
ayahs.translation: tum per iss mein bhi koi gunah nahi hai kay tum aurton ko aesay waqt talaq do jabkay abhi tum ney unn ko chooa bhi naa ho , aur naa unn kay liye koi mehar muqarrar kiya ho , aur ( aesi soorat mein ) unn ko koi tohfa do   , khushal shaks apni haisiyat kay mutabiq aur gharib aadmi apni haisiyat kay mutabiq bhalay tareeqay say yeh tohfa dey . yeh naik aadmiyon per aik lazimi haq hai .

ayahs.text: aur agar tum ney unhen chooney say pehlay hi iss halat mein talaq di ho jabkay unn kay liye ( nikah kay waqt ) koi mehar muqarrar kerliya tha to jitna mehar tum ney muqarrar kiya tha uss ka aadha dena ( wajib hai ) illa yeh kay woh aurten riyat kerden ( aur aadhay mehar ka bhi mutalba naa keren ) ya woh ( shohar ) jiss kay haath mein nikah ki girah hai , riyat keray ( aur poora mehar deydey ) aur agar tum riyat kero to yeh taqwa kay ziyada qareeb hai . aur aapas mein faraakh dili ka bartao kerna matt bhoolo . jo amal bhi tum kertay ho , Allah yaqeenan ussay dekh raha hai .
ayahs.translation: aur agar tum ney unhen chooney say pehlay hi iss halat mein talaq di ho jabkay unn kay liye ( nikah kay waqt ) koi mehar muqarrar kerliya tha to jitna mehar tum ney muqarrar kiya tha uss ka aadha dena ( wajib hai ) illa yeh kay woh aurten riyat kerden ( aur aadhay mehar ka bhi mutalba naa keren ) ya woh ( shohar ) jiss kay haath mein nikah ki girah hai , riyat keray ( aur poora mehar deydey ) aur agar tum riyat kero to yeh taqwa kay ziyada qareeb hai . aur aapas mein faraakh dili ka bartao kerna matt bhoolo . jo amal bhi tum kertay ho , Allah yaqeenan ussay dekh raha hai .

ayahs.text: tamam namazon ka poora poora khayal rakho , aur ( khaas tor per ) bech ki namaz ka   . aur Allah kay samney ba-adab farmanbardaar ban ker kharray huwa kero .
ayahs.translation: tamam namazon ka poora poora khayal rakho , aur ( khaas tor per ) bech ki namaz ka   . aur Allah kay samney ba-adab farmanbardaar ban ker kharray huwa kero .

ayahs.text: aur agar tumhen ( dushman ka ) khof laahaq ho to kharray kharray ya sawar honey ki halat hi mein ( namaz parh lo )   phir jab tum aman ki halat mein aajao to Allah ka ziker uss tareeqay say kero jo uss ney tumhen sikhaya hai jiss say tum pehlay na-waqif thay
ayahs.translation: aur agar tumhen ( dushman ka ) khof laahaq ho to kharray kharray ya sawar honey ki halat hi mein ( namaz parh lo )   phir jab tum aman ki halat mein aajao to Allah ka ziker uss tareeqay say kero jo uss ney tumhen sikhaya hai jiss say tum pehlay na-waqif thay

ayahs.text: aur tum mein say jo log wafaat paajayen aur apney peechay biwiyan chorr jayen to woh apni biwiyon kay haq mein yeh wasiyyat ker jaya keren kay aik saal tak woh ( tarkay say nafqa wasool kernay ka ) faeeda uthayen gi aur unn ko ( shohar kay ghar say ) nikala nahi jaye ga .   haan agar woh khud nikal jayen to apney haq mein qaeeday kay mutabiq woh jo kuch bhi keren uss mein tum per koi gunah nahi hoga . aur Allah sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , sahab-e-hikmat bhi .
ayahs.translation: aur tum mein say jo log wafaat paajayen aur apney peechay biwiyan chorr jayen to woh apni biwiyon kay haq mein yeh wasiyyat ker jaya keren kay aik saal tak woh ( tarkay say nafqa wasool kernay ka ) faeeda uthayen gi aur unn ko ( shohar kay ghar say ) nikala nahi jaye ga .   haan agar woh khud nikal jayen to apney haq mein qaeeday kay mutabiq woh jo kuch bhi keren uss mein tum per koi gunah nahi hoga . aur Allah sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , sahab-e-hikmat bhi .

ayahs.text: aur mutlaqa aurton ko qaeeday kay mutabiq faeeda phonchana muttaqiyon per unn ka haq hai .
ayahs.translation: aur mutlaqa aurton ko qaeeday kay mutabiq faeeda phonchana muttaqiyon per unn ka haq hai .

ayahs.text: Allah apney ehkaam issi tarah wazahat say tumharay samney biyan kerta hai , takay tum samajh daari say kaam lo .
ayahs.translation: Allah apney ehkaam issi tarah wazahat say tumharay samney biyan kerta hai , takay tum samajh daari say kaam lo .

ayahs.text: kiya tumhen unn logon  ka haal maloom nahi huwa jo moat say bachnay kay liye apney gharon say nikal aaye thay , aur woh hazaron ki tadaad mein thay ? chunacheh Allah ney unn say kaha :  mar jao  phir unhen zinda kiya .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah logon  per boht fazal farmaney wala hai , lekin aksar log shukar ada nahi kertay .
ayahs.translation: kiya tumhen unn logon  ka haal maloom nahi huwa jo moat say bachnay kay liye apney gharon say nikal aaye thay , aur woh hazaron ki tadaad mein thay ? chunacheh Allah ney unn say kaha :  mar jao  phir unhen zinda kiya .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah logon  per boht fazal farmaney wala hai , lekin aksar log shukar ada nahi kertay .

ayahs.text: aur Allah kay raastay mein jang kero , aur yaqeen rakho kay Allah khoob sunney wala , khoob janney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah kay raastay mein jang kero , aur yaqeen rakho kay Allah khoob sunney wala , khoob janney wala hai .

ayahs.text: kon hai jo Allah ko achay tareeqay per qarz dey , takay woh ussay uss kay mafad mein itna barhaye charrhaye kay woh badar jaha ziyada hojaye ?   aur Allah hi tangi peda kerta hai , aur wohi wusat deta hai , aur ussi ki taraf tum sabb ko lotaya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: kon hai jo Allah ko achay tareeqay per qarz dey , takay woh ussay uss kay mafad mein itna barhaye charrhaye kay woh badar jaha ziyada hojaye ?   aur Allah hi tangi peda kerta hai , aur wohi wusat deta hai , aur ussi ki taraf tum sabb ko lotaya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: kiya tumhen musa kay baad bani Israel kay giroh kay uss waqaey ka ilm nahi huwa jab unhon ney apney aik nabi say kaha tha kay humara aik badshah muqarrar ker-dijiye takay ( uss kay jhandey talay ) hum Allah kay raastay mein jang ker-saken .   nabi ney kaha :  kiya tum logon  say yeh baat kuch baeed hai kay jab tum per jang farz ki jaye to tum naa larro-?  unhon ney kaha :  bhala hamen kiya hojaye ga jo hum Allah kay raastay mein jang naa keren gay halankay hamen apney gharon aur apney bacchon kay paas say nikal bahir kiya gaya hai .  phir ( huwa yehi kay ) jab unn per jang farz ki gaee to unn mein say thoray logon  ko chorr ker baqi sabb peeth pher gaye . aur Allah zalimon ko khoob janta hai .
ayahs.translation: kiya tumhen musa kay baad bani Israel kay giroh kay uss waqaey ka ilm nahi huwa jab unhon ney apney aik nabi say kaha tha kay humara aik badshah muqarrar ker-dijiye takay ( uss kay jhandey talay ) hum Allah kay raastay mein jang ker-saken .   nabi ney kaha :  kiya tum logon  say yeh baat kuch baeed hai kay jab tum per jang farz ki jaye to tum naa larro-?  unhon ney kaha :  bhala hamen kiya hojaye ga jo hum Allah kay raastay mein jang naa keren gay halankay hamen apney gharon aur apney bacchon kay paas say nikal bahir kiya gaya hai .  phir ( huwa yehi kay ) jab unn per jang farz ki gaee to unn mein say thoray logon  ko chorr ker baqi sabb peeth pher gaye . aur Allah zalimon ko khoob janta hai .

ayahs.text: aur unn kay nabi ney unn say kaha kay :  Allah ney tumharay liye taloot ko badshah bana ker bheja hai .  kehney lagay :  bhala uss ko hum per badshahat kernay ka haq kahan say aagaya-? hum uss kay muqablay mein badshahat kay ziyada mustahiq hain . aur uss ko to maali wusat bhi hasil nahi .  nabi ney kaha :  Allah ney unn ko tum per fazilat dey ker chuna hai , aur unhen ilm aur jism mein ( tum say ) ziyada wusat ata ki hai . aur Allah apna mulk jiss ko chahta hai deta hai . aur Allah bari wusat aur bara ilm rakhney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur unn kay nabi ney unn say kaha kay :  Allah ney tumharay liye taloot ko badshah bana ker bheja hai .  kehney lagay :  bhala uss ko hum per badshahat kernay ka haq kahan say aagaya-? hum uss kay muqablay mein badshahat kay ziyada mustahiq hain . aur uss ko to maali wusat bhi hasil nahi .  nabi ney kaha :  Allah ney unn ko tum per fazilat dey ker chuna hai , aur unhen ilm aur jism mein ( tum say ) ziyada wusat ata ki hai . aur Allah apna mulk jiss ko chahta hai deta hai . aur Allah bari wusat aur bara ilm rakhney wala hai .

ayahs.text: aur inn say unn kay nabi ney yeh bhi kaha kay :  taloot ki badshahat ki alamat yeh hai kay tumharay paas woh sandooq ( wapis ) aajaye ga jiss mein tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say sakeenat ka saman hai , aur musa aur Haroon ney jo ashiya chorri then unn mein say kuch baqi maandda cheezen hain . ussay farishtay uthaye huye layen gay   agar tum momin ho to tumharay liye uss mein bari nishani hai .
ayahs.translation: aur inn say unn kay nabi ney yeh bhi kaha kay :  taloot ki badshahat ki alamat yeh hai kay tumharay paas woh sandooq ( wapis ) aajaye ga jiss mein tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say sakeenat ka saman hai , aur musa aur Haroon ney jo ashiya chorri then unn mein say kuch baqi maandda cheezen hain . ussay farishtay uthaye huye layen gay   agar tum momin ho to tumharay liye uss mein bari nishani hai .

ayahs.text: chunacheh jab taloot lashkar kay sath rawana huwa to uss ney ( lashkar walon say ) kaha kay :  Allah aik darya kay zariye tumhara imtihan lenay wala hai . jo shaks iss darya say paani piye ga woh mera aadmi nahi hoga , aur jo issay nahi chakhay ga woh mera aadmi hoga , illa yeh kay koi apney haath say aik chullu bhar ley ( to kuch harj nahi ) .    phir ( huwa yeh kay ) unn mein say thoray aadmiyon kay siwa baqi sabb ney uss darya say ( khoob ) paani piya . chunacheh jab woh ( yani taloot ) aur uss kay sath emaan rakhney walay darya kay paar utray , to yeh log ( jinhon ney taloot ka hukum nahi maana tha ) kehney lagay kay :  aaj jaloot aur uss kay lashkar ka muqabla kernay ki hum mein bilkul taqat nahi hai .  ( magar ) jinn logon  ka emaan tha kay woh Allah say jaa milney walay hain unhon ney kaha kay :  najaney kitni choti jamaten hain jo Allah kay hukum say bari jamaton per ghalib aai hain . aur Allah unn logon  ka sathi hai jo sabar say kaam letay hain .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh jab taloot lashkar kay sath rawana huwa to uss ney ( lashkar walon say ) kaha kay :  Allah aik darya kay zariye tumhara imtihan lenay wala hai . jo shaks iss darya say paani piye ga woh mera aadmi nahi hoga , aur jo issay nahi chakhay ga woh mera aadmi hoga , illa yeh kay koi apney haath say aik chullu bhar ley ( to kuch harj nahi ) .    phir ( huwa yeh kay ) unn mein say thoray aadmiyon kay siwa baqi sabb ney uss darya say ( khoob ) paani piya . chunacheh jab woh ( yani taloot ) aur uss kay sath emaan rakhney walay darya kay paar utray , to yeh log ( jinhon ney taloot ka hukum nahi maana tha ) kehney lagay kay :  aaj jaloot aur uss kay lashkar ka muqabla kernay ki hum mein bilkul taqat nahi hai .  ( magar ) jinn logon  ka emaan tha kay woh Allah say jaa milney walay hain unhon ney kaha kay :  najaney kitni choti jamaten hain jo Allah kay hukum say bari jamaton per ghalib aai hain . aur Allah unn logon  ka sathi hai jo sabar say kaam letay hain .

ayahs.text: aur jab yeh log jaloot aur uss kay lashkaron kay aamney samney huye to inhon ney kaha :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! sabar o istaqlal ki sift hum per undel dey , hamen sabit qadmi bakhsh dey , aur hamen iss kafir qoam kay muqablay mein fatah o nusrat ata farmadey .
ayahs.translation: aur jab yeh log jaloot aur uss kay lashkaron kay aamney samney huye to inhon ney kaha :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! sabar o istaqlal ki sift hum per undel dey , hamen sabit qadmi bakhsh dey , aur hamen iss kafir qoam kay muqablay mein fatah o nusrat ata farmadey .

ayahs.text: chunacheh inhon ney Allah kay hukum say unn ( jaloot kay sathiyon ) ko shikast di aur dawood ney jaloot ko qatal kiya ,   aur Allah ney uss ko saltanat aur danai ata ki , aur jo ilm chaha uss ko ata farmaya . agar Allah logon  ka aik doosray kay zariye difaa naa keray to zameen mein fasad phel jaye , lekin Allah tamam jahano per bara fazal farmaney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh inhon ney Allah kay hukum say unn ( jaloot kay sathiyon ) ko shikast di aur dawood ney jaloot ko qatal kiya ,   aur Allah ney uss ko saltanat aur danai ata ki , aur jo ilm chaha uss ko ata farmaya . agar Allah logon  ka aik doosray kay zariye difaa naa keray to zameen mein fasad phel jaye , lekin Allah tamam jahano per bara fazal farmaney wala hai .

ayahs.text: yeh Allah ki aayaat hain jo hum aap kay samney theek theek parh ker sunatay hain , aur aap beyshak unn payghumberon mein say hain jo Rasool bana ker bhejay gaye hain .
ayahs.translation: yeh Allah ki aayaat hain jo hum aap kay samney theek theek parh ker sunatay hain , aur aap beyshak unn payghumberon mein say hain jo Rasool bana ker bhejay gaye hain .

ayahs.text: yeh payghumber jo hum ney ( makhlooq ki islaah kay liye ) bhejay hain , inn ko hum ney aik doosray per fazilat ata ki hai . inn mein say baaz woh hain jinn say Allah ney kalam farmaya , aur inn mein say baaz ko uss ney badarjaha bulandi ata ki .   aur hum ney essa ibn-e-maryam ko khuli nishaniyan den , aur rooh-ul-qudus say unn ki madad farmaee .   aur agar Allah chahta to unn kay baad walay log apney paas roshan dalaeel aajaney kay baad aapas mein naa larrtay , lekin unhon ney khud ikhtilaf kiya , chunacheh unn mein say kuch woh thay jo emaan laye , aur kuch woh jinhon ney kufr apnaya . aur agar Allah chahta to woh aapas mein naa larrtay , lekin Allah wohi kerta hai jo woh chahta hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh payghumber jo hum ney ( makhlooq ki islaah kay liye ) bhejay hain , inn ko hum ney aik doosray per fazilat ata ki hai . inn mein say baaz woh hain jinn say Allah ney kalam farmaya , aur inn mein say baaz ko uss ney badarjaha bulandi ata ki .   aur hum ney essa ibn-e-maryam ko khuli nishaniyan den , aur rooh-ul-qudus say unn ki madad farmaee .   aur agar Allah chahta to unn kay baad walay log apney paas roshan dalaeel aajaney kay baad aapas mein naa larrtay , lekin unhon ney khud ikhtilaf kiya , chunacheh unn mein say kuch woh thay jo emaan laye , aur kuch woh jinhon ney kufr apnaya . aur agar Allah chahta to woh aapas mein naa larrtay , lekin Allah wohi kerta hai jo woh chahta hai .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! jo rizq hum ney tumhen diya hai uss mein say woh din aaney say pehlay pehlay ( Allah kay raastay mein ) kharch kerlo jiss din naa koi soda hoga , naa koi dosti ( kaam aaye gi ) , aur naa koi sifarish hosakay gi .   aur zalim woh log hain jo kufr ikhtiyar kiye huye hain .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! jo rizq hum ney tumhen diya hai uss mein say woh din aaney say pehlay pehlay ( Allah kay raastay mein ) kharch kerlo jiss din naa koi soda hoga , naa koi dosti ( kaam aaye gi ) , aur naa koi sifarish hosakay gi .   aur zalim woh log hain jo kufr ikhtiyar kiye huye hain .

ayahs.text: Allah woh hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi jo sada zinda hai . jo poori kainat sanbhalay huye hai ; jiss ko naa kabhi oongh lagti hai , naa neend . aasmano mein jo kuch hai ( woh bhi ) aur zameen mein jo kuch hai ( woh bhi ) , sabb ussi ka hai . kon hai jo uss kay huzoor uss ki ijazat kay baghair kissi ki sifarish ker-sakay-? woh saray bandon kay tamam aagay peechay kay halaat ko khoob janta hai , aur woh log uss kay ilm ki koi baat apney ilm kay daeray mein nahi laasaktay , siwaye uss baat kay jissay woh khud chahye . uss ki kursi ney saray aasmano aur zameen ko ghera huwa hai ; aur inn dono ki nigehbani say ussay zara bhi bojh nahi hota , aur woh bara aali maqam , sahab-e-azmat hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah woh hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi jo sada zinda hai . jo poori kainat sanbhalay huye hai ; jiss ko naa kabhi oongh lagti hai , naa neend . aasmano mein jo kuch hai ( woh bhi ) aur zameen mein jo kuch hai ( woh bhi ) , sabb ussi ka hai . kon hai jo uss kay huzoor uss ki ijazat kay baghair kissi ki sifarish ker-sakay-? woh saray bandon kay tamam aagay peechay kay halaat ko khoob janta hai , aur woh log uss kay ilm ki koi baat apney ilm kay daeray mein nahi laasaktay , siwaye uss baat kay jissay woh khud chahye . uss ki kursi ney saray aasmano aur zameen ko ghera huwa hai ; aur inn dono ki nigehbani say ussay zara bhi bojh nahi hota , aur woh bara aali maqam , sahab-e-azmat hai .

ayahs.text: deen kay moamlay mein koi zabardasti nahi hai . hidayat ka raasta gumrahi say mumtaz ho ker wazeh hochuka . iss kay baad jo shaks taghoot ka inkar ker kay Allah per emaan ley aaye ga , uss ney aik mazboot kunda thaam liya jiss kay tootney ka koi imkan nahi . aur Allah khoob sunney wala , sabb kuch janney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: deen kay moamlay mein koi zabardasti nahi hai . hidayat ka raasta gumrahi say mumtaz ho ker wazeh hochuka . iss kay baad jo shaks taghoot ka inkar ker kay Allah per emaan ley aaye ga , uss ney aik mazboot kunda thaam liya jiss kay tootney ka koi imkan nahi . aur Allah khoob sunney wala , sabb kuch janney wala hai .

ayahs.text: Allah emaan walon ka rakhwala hai ; woh unhen andheriyon say nikal ker roshni mein lata hai . aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay rakhwalay woh shetan hain jo unhen roshni say nikal ker andheriyon mein ley jatay hain . woh sabb aag kay baasi hain ; woh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .
ayahs.translation: Allah emaan walon ka rakhwala hai ; woh unhen andheriyon say nikal ker roshni mein lata hai . aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay rakhwalay woh shetan hain jo unhen roshni say nikal ker andheriyon mein ley jatay hain . woh sabb aag kay baasi hain ; woh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .

ayahs.text: kiya tum ney uss shaks ( kay haal ) per ghor kiya jiss ko Allah ney saltanat kiya dey di thi kay woh apney perwerdigar ( kay wajood hi ) kay baaray mein Ibrahim say behas kernay laga-? jab Ibrahim ney kaha kay :  mera perwerdigar woh hai jo zindagi bhi deta hai aur moat bhi  to woh kehney laga kay :  mein bhi zindagi deta hun aur moat deta hun .    Ibrahim ney kaha :  acha ! Allah to sooraj ko mashriq say nikalta hai , tum zara ussay maghrib say to nikal ker lao .  iss per woh kafir mabhoot ho ker reh gaya . aur Allah aesay zalimon ko hidayat nahi diya kerta .
ayahs.translation: kiya tum ney uss shaks ( kay haal ) per ghor kiya jiss ko Allah ney saltanat kiya dey di thi kay woh apney perwerdigar ( kay wajood hi ) kay baaray mein Ibrahim say behas kernay laga-? jab Ibrahim ney kaha kay :  mera perwerdigar woh hai jo zindagi bhi deta hai aur moat bhi  to woh kehney laga kay :  mein bhi zindagi deta hun aur moat deta hun .    Ibrahim ney kaha :  acha ! Allah to sooraj ko mashriq say nikalta hai , tum zara ussay maghrib say to nikal ker lao .  iss per woh kafir mabhoot ho ker reh gaya . aur Allah aesay zalimon ko hidayat nahi diya kerta .

ayahs.text: ya ( tum ney ) uss jaisay shaks ( kay waqaey ) per ( ghor kiya ) jiss ka aik basti per aesay waqt guzar huwa jab woh chatton kay ball giri parri thi ?   uss ney kaha kay :  Allah uss basti ko uss kay marney kay baad kaisay zinda keray ga-?  phir Allah ney uss shaks ko so saal tak kay liye moat di , aur uss kay baad zinda kerdiya . ( aur phir ) poocha kay tum kitney arsay tak ( iss halat mein ) rahey ho-? uss ney kaha :  aik din ya aik din ka kuch hissa !  Allah ney kaha :  nahi ! balkay tum so saal issi tarah rahey ho . abb apney khaney peenay ki cheezon ko dekho kay woh zara nahi sarren . aur ( doosri taraf ) apney gadhay ko dekho ( kay gal sarr ker uss ka kiya haal hogaya hai ) aur yeh hum ney iss liye kiya takay hum tumhen logon  kay liye ( apni qudrat ka ) aik nishan bana den , aur ( abb apney gadhay ki ) haddiyon ko dekho kay hum kiss tarah unhen uthatay hain , phir unn ko gosht ka libas pehnatay hain !  chunacheh jab haqeeqat khul ker uss kay samney aagae to woh bol utha kay :  mujhay yaqeen hai Allah her cheez per qudrat rakhta hai .
ayahs.translation: ya ( tum ney ) uss jaisay shaks ( kay waqaey ) per ( ghor kiya ) jiss ka aik basti per aesay waqt guzar huwa jab woh chatton kay ball giri parri thi ?   uss ney kaha kay :  Allah uss basti ko uss kay marney kay baad kaisay zinda keray ga-?  phir Allah ney uss shaks ko so saal tak kay liye moat di , aur uss kay baad zinda kerdiya . ( aur phir ) poocha kay tum kitney arsay tak ( iss halat mein ) rahey ho-? uss ney kaha :  aik din ya aik din ka kuch hissa !  Allah ney kaha :  nahi ! balkay tum so saal issi tarah rahey ho . abb apney khaney peenay ki cheezon ko dekho kay woh zara nahi sarren . aur ( doosri taraf ) apney gadhay ko dekho ( kay gal sarr ker uss ka kiya haal hogaya hai ) aur yeh hum ney iss liye kiya takay hum tumhen logon  kay liye ( apni qudrat ka ) aik nishan bana den , aur ( abb apney gadhay ki ) haddiyon ko dekho kay hum kiss tarah unhen uthatay hain , phir unn ko gosht ka libas pehnatay hain !  chunacheh jab haqeeqat khul ker uss kay samney aagae to woh bol utha kay :  mujhay yaqeen hai Allah her cheez per qudrat rakhta hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( uss waqt ka tazkarah suno ) jab Ibrahim ney kaha tha kay meray perwerdigar ! mujhay dikhaiye kay aap murdon ko kaisay zinda kertay hain-? Allah ney kaha :  kiya tumhen yaqeen nahi-?  kehney lagay :  yaqeen kiyon naa hota-? magar ( yeh khuwaish iss liye ki hai ) takay meray dil ko poora itminan hasil hojaye .    Allah ney kaha :  acha ! to chaar perinday lo , aur unhen apney say manoos kerlo , phir ( unn ko zibah ker kay ) unn ka aik aik hissa her pahar per rakh do , phir unn ko bulao , woh chaaron tumharay paas dorray chalay ayen gay .   aur jaan rakho kay Allah poori tarah sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , aalaa darjay ki hikmat wala bhi .

Allah ney kaha :  acha ! to chaar perinday lo , aur unhen apney say manoos kerlo , phir ( unn ko zibah ker kay ) unn ka aik aik hissa her pahar per rakh do , phir unn ko bulao , woh chaaron tumharay paas dorray chalay ayen gay .   aur jaan rakho kay Allah poori tarah sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , aalaa darjay ki hikmat wala bhi .

ayahs.text: jo log Allah kay raastay mein apney maal kharch kertay hain unn ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik dana saat baalen ugaye ( aur ) her baal mein so daney hon .   aur Allah jiss kay liye chahta hai ( sawab mein ) kaee guna izafa ker deta hai . Allah boht wusat wala ( aur ) baray ilm wala hai .
ayahs.translation: jo log Allah kay raastay mein apney maal kharch kertay hain unn ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik dana saat baalen ugaye ( aur ) her baal mein so daney hon .   aur Allah jiss kay liye chahta hai ( sawab mein ) kaee guna izafa ker deta hai . Allah boht wusat wala ( aur ) baray ilm wala hai .

ayahs.text: jo log apney maal Allah kay raastay mein kharch kertay hain , phir kharch kernay kay baad naa ehsan jatlatay hain aur naa koi takleef phonchatay hain , woh apney perwerdigar kay paas apna sawab payen gay ; naa unn ko koi khof laahaq hoga aur naa koi ghum phonchay ga .
ayahs.translation: jo log apney maal Allah kay raastay mein kharch kertay hain , phir kharch kernay kay baad naa ehsan jatlatay hain aur naa koi takleef phonchatay hain , woh apney perwerdigar kay paas apna sawab payen gay ; naa unn ko koi khof laahaq hoga aur naa koi ghum phonchay ga .

ayahs.text: bhali baat keh dena aur darguzar kerna uss sadqay say behtar hai jiss kay baad koi takleef phonchai jaye .   aur Allah bara bey niaz , boht burdbaar hai .
ayahs.translation: bhali baat keh dena aur darguzar kerna uss sadqay say behtar hai jiss kay baad koi takleef phonchai jaye .   aur Allah bara bey niaz , boht burdbaar hai .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! apney sadqaat ko ehsan jatla ker aur takleef phoncha ker uss shaks ki tarah zaya matt kero jo apna maal logon  ko dikhaney kay liye kharch kerta hai aur Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhta . chunacheh uss ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik chikni chatan per mitti jami ho , phir uss per zor ki barish parray aur uss ( mitti ko baha ker chatan ) ko ( dobara ) chikni bana choray .   aesay logon  ney jo kamai ki hoti hai woh zara bhi unn kay haath nahi lagti . aur Allah ( aesay ) kafiron ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! apney sadqaat ko ehsan jatla ker aur takleef phoncha ker uss shaks ki tarah zaya matt kero jo apna maal logon  ko dikhaney kay liye kharch kerta hai aur Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhta . chunacheh uss ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik chikni chatan per mitti jami ho , phir uss per zor ki barish parray aur uss ( mitti ko baha ker chatan ) ko ( dobara ) chikni bana choray .   aesay logon  ney jo kamai ki hoti hai woh zara bhi unn kay haath nahi lagti . aur Allah ( aesay ) kafiron ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .

ayahs.text: aur jo log apney maal Allah ki khushnoodi talab kernay kay liye aur apney aap mein pukhtagi peda kernay kay liye kharch kertay hain unn ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik baagh kissi teelay per waqay ho ; uss per zor ki barish barsay to woh dugna phal ley ker aaye . aur agar uss per zor ki barish naa bhi barsay to halki phuwaar bhi uss kay liye kafi hai . aur tum jo amal bhi kertay ho Allah ussay/issay khoob achi tarah dekhta hai .
