ayahs.text: kiya tum mein say koi yeh pasand keray ga kay uss ka khujooron aur angooron ka aik baagh ho jiss kay neechay nehren behti hon ( aur ) uss ko uss baagh mein aur bhi her tarah kay phal hasil hon , aur burhapay ney ussay aa-pakra ho , aur uss kay bacchay abhi kamzor hon ; itney mein aik aag say bhara bagola aa-ker uss ko apni zadd mein ley ley aur poora baagh jal ker reh jaye ?   issi tarah Allah tumharay liye apni aayaten khol khol ker biyan kerta hai takay tum ghor kero .
ayahs.translation: kiya tum mein say koi yeh pasand keray ga kay uss ka khujooron aur angooron ka aik baagh ho jiss kay neechay nehren behti hon ( aur ) uss ko uss baagh mein aur bhi her tarah kay phal hasil hon , aur burhapay ney ussay aa-pakra ho , aur uss kay bacchay abhi kamzor hon ; itney mein aik aag say bhara bagola aa-ker uss ko apni zadd mein ley ley aur poora baagh jal ker reh jaye ?   issi tarah Allah tumharay liye apni aayaten khol khol ker biyan kerta hai takay tum ghor kero .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! jo kuch tum ney kamaya ho aur jo pedawaar hum ney tumharay liye zameen say nikali ho uss ki achi cheezon ka aik hissa ( Allah kay raastay mein ) kharch kiya kero ; aur yeh niyyat naa rakho kay bus aesi kharab qisam ki cheezen ( Allah kay naam per ) diya kero gay jo ( agar koi doosra tumhen dey to nafrat kay maaray ) tum ussay aankhen meechay baghair naa ley sako . aur yaad rakho kay Allah aisa bey niaz hai kay her qisam ki tareef ussi ki taraf loatti hai .

ayahs.text: shetan tumhen muflisi say darata hai aur tumhen bey hayai ka hukum deta hai ; aur Allah tum say apni maghfirat aur fazal ka wada kerta hai . Allah bari wusat wala , her baat janney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: shetan tumhen muflisi say darata hai aur tumhen bey hayai ka hukum deta hai ; aur Allah tum say apni maghfirat aur fazal ka wada kerta hai . Allah bari wusat wala , her baat janney wala hai .

ayahs.text: woh jiss ko chahta hai danai ata ker deta hai , aur jissay danai ata hogaee ussay wafir miqdaar mein bhalai mil gaee . aur naseehat wohi log hasil kertay hain jo samajh kay malik hain .
ayahs.translation: woh jiss ko chahta hai danai ata ker deta hai , aur jissay danai ata hogaee ussay wafir miqdaar mein bhalai mil gaee . aur naseehat wohi log hasil kertay hain jo samajh kay malik hain .

ayahs.text: aur tum jo koi kharch kero ya koi mannat maano Allah ussay janta hai . aur zalimon ko kissi tarah kay madadgaar moyassar nahi ayen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur tum jo koi kharch kero ya koi mannat maano Allah ussay janta hai . aur zalimon ko kissi tarah kay madadgaar moyassar nahi ayen gay .

ayahs.text: agar tum sadaqaat zahir ker kay do tab bhi acha hai ; aur agar unn ko chupa ker fuqra ko do to yeh tumharay haq mein kahen behtar hai . aur Allah tumhari buraiyon ka kaffara kerday ga ; aur Allah tumharay tamam kamon say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
ayahs.translation: agar tum sadaqaat zahir ker kay do tab bhi acha hai ; aur agar unn ko chupa ker fuqra ko do to yeh tumharay haq mein kahen behtar hai . aur Allah tumhari buraiyon ka kaffara kerday ga ; aur Allah tumharay tamam kamon say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ) inn ( kafiron ) ko raah-e-raast per ley aana aap ki zimma daari nahi hai , lekin Allah jiss ko chahta hai raah-e-raast per ley aata hai .   aur jo maal bhi tum kharch kertay ho woh khud tumharay faeeday kay liye hota hai jabkay tum Allah ki khushnoodi talab kernay kay siwa kissi aur gharz say kharch nahi kertay . aur jo maal bhi tum kharch kero gay tumhen poora poora diya jaye ga aur tum per zara bhi zulm nahi hoga .

ayahs.text: . ( maali imdad kay bator-e-khaas ) mustahiq woh fuqra hain jinhon ney apney aap ko Allah ki raah mein iss tarah muqayyad ker rakha hai kay woh ( moaash ki talash kay liye ) zameen mein chal phir nahi saktay . chunkay woh itney pak daman hain kay kissi say sawal nahi kertay , iss liye na-waqif aadmi unhen maal daar samajhta hai . tum unn kay chehray ki alamaton say unn ( ki androoni halat ) ko pehchan saktay ho ( magar ) woh logon  say lagg lipat ker sawal nahi kertay .   aur tum jo maal bhi kharch kertay ho Allah ussay khoob janta hai .

ayahs.text: jo log apney maal din raat khamoshi say bhi aur aelania bhi kharch kertay hain woh apney perwerdigar kay paas apna sawab payen gay , aur naa unhen koi khof laahaq hoga , naa koi ghum phonchay ga .
ayahs.translation: jo log apney maal din raat khamoshi say bhi aur aelania bhi kharch kertay hain woh apney perwerdigar kay paas apna sawab payen gay , aur naa unhen koi khof laahaq hoga , naa koi ghum phonchay ga .

ayahs.text: jo log sood khatay hain woh ( qayamat mein ) uthen gay to uss shaks ki tarah uthen gay jissay shetan ney choo-ker pagal bana diya ho . yeh iss liye hoga kay unhon ney kaha tha kay :  bey bhi to sood hi ki tarah hoti hai .    halankay Allah ney bey ko halal kiya hai aur sood ko haram qarar diya hai . lehaza jiss shaks kay paas uss kay perwerdigar ki taraf say naseehat aagae aur woh ( soodi moamlaat say ) baaz aagaya to mazi mein jo kuch huwa woh ussi ka hai .   aur uss ( ki batni kayfiyat ) ka moamla Allah kay hawalay hai . aur jiss shaks ney loat ker phir wohi kaam kiya   to aesay log dozakhi hain . woh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .

ayahs.text: Allah sood ko mitatta hai aur sadqaat ko barhata hai . aur Allah her uss shaks ko napasand kerta hai jo nashukra gunehgaar ho .
ayahs.translation: Allah sood ko mitatta hai aur sadqaat ko barhata hai . aur Allah her uss shaks ko napasand kerta hai jo nashukra gunehgaar ho .

ayahs.text: . ( haan ) woh log jo emaan layen , naik amal keren , namaz qaeem keren aur zakat ada keren woh apney rab kay paas apney ajar kay mustahiq hon gay ; naa unhen koi khof laahaq hoga , naa koi ghum phonchay ga .
ayahs.translation: . ( haan ) woh log jo emaan layen , naik amal keren , namaz qaeem keren aur zakat ada keren woh apney rab kay paas apney ajar kay mustahiq hon gay ; naa unhen koi khof laahaq hoga , naa koi ghum phonchay ga .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah say daro aur agar tum waqai momin ho to sood ka jo hissa bhi ( kissi kay zimmay ) baqi reh gaya ho ussay chorr do .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah say daro aur agar tum waqai momin ho to sood ka jo hissa bhi ( kissi kay zimmay ) baqi reh gaya ho ussay chorr do .

ayahs.text: phir bhi agar tum aisa naa kero gay to Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki taraf say aelaan-e-jang sunn lo . aur agar tum ( sood say ) tauba kero to tumhara asal sarmaya tumhara haq hai . naa tum kissi per zulm kero , naa tum per zulm kiya jaye .
ayahs.translation: phir bhi agar tum aisa naa kero gay to Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki taraf say aelaan-e-jang sunn lo . aur agar tum ( sood say ) tauba kero to tumhara asal sarmaya tumhara haq hai . naa tum kissi per zulm kero , naa tum per zulm kiya jaye .

ayahs.text: aur agar koi tangdast ( qarz daar ) ho to uss ka haath khulney tak mohlat deni hai . aur sadqa hi kerdo to yeh tumharay haq mein kahen ziyada behtar hai , ba-shartey-kay tum ko samajh ho .
ayahs.translation: aur agar koi tangdast ( qarz daar ) ho to uss ka haath khulney tak mohlat deni hai . aur sadqa hi kerdo to yeh tumharay haq mein kahen ziyada behtar hai , ba-shartey-kay tum ko samajh ho .

ayahs.text: aur daro uss din say jab tum sabb Allah kay paas loat ker jao gay , phir her her shaks ko jo kuch uss ney kamaya hai poora poora diya jaye ga , aur unn per koi zulm nahi hoga .
ayahs.translation: aur daro uss din say jab tum sabb Allah kay paas loat ker jao gay , phir her her shaks ko jo kuch uss ney kamaya hai poora poora diya jaye ga , aur unn per koi zulm nahi hoga .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! jab tum kissi moyyan miyaad kay liye udhaar ka koi moamla kero to ussay likh liya kero , aur tum mein say jo shaks likhna janta ho insaf kay sath tehreer likhay , aur jo shaks likhna janta ho , likhney say inkar naa keray . jab Allah ney ussay yeh ilm diya hai to ussay likhna chahiye . aur tehreer woh shaks likhwaye jiss kay zimmay haq wajib horaha ho , aur ussay chahiye kay woh Allah say daray jo uss ka perwerdigar hai aur uss ( haq ) mein koi kami naa keray .   haan agar woh shaks jiss kay zimmay haq wajib horaha hai nasamajh ya kamzor ho ya ( kissi aur wajeh say ) tehreer naa likhwa sakta ho to uss ka sarparast insaf kay sath likhwaye . aur apney mein say do mardon ko gawah bana lo , haan agar do mard mojood naa hon to aik mard aur do aurten unn gawahon mein say hojayen jinhen tum pasand kertay ho , takay agar unn do aurton mein say aik bhool jaye to doosri ussay yaad diladay . aur jab gawahon ko ( gawahi denay kay liye ) bulaya jaye to woh inkar naa keren . aur jo moamla apni miyaad say wabasta ho , chahye woh chota ho ya bara , ussay likhney say uktao nahi . yeh baat Allah kay nazdeek ziyada qareen-e-insaf aur gawahi ko durust rakhney ka behtar zariya hai , aur iss baat ki qareebi zamanat hai kay tum aaenda shak mein nahi parro gay . haan agar tumharay darmiyan koi naqad lain dain ka soda ho to uss ko naa likhney mein tumharay liye kuch harj nahi hai . aur jab kharid-o-farokht kero to gawah bana liya kero . aur naa likhney walay ko koi takleef phonchai jaye , naa gawah ko . aur agar aisa kero gay to yeh tumhari taraf say nafarmani hogi . aur Allah ka khof dil mein rakho . Allah tumhen taleem deta hai , aur Allah her cheez ka ilm rakhta hai .

ayahs.text: jo kuch aasmano mein hai aur jo kuch zameen mein hai sabb Allah hi ka hai . aur jo baaten tumharay dilon mein hain , khuwa tum unn ko zahir kero ya chupao , Allah tum say unn ka hisab ley ga .   phir jiss ko chahye ga moaaf kerday ga aur jiss ko chahye ga saza dey ga . aur Allah her cheez per qudrat rakhta hai .
ayahs.translation: jo kuch aasmano mein hai aur jo kuch zameen mein hai sabb Allah hi ka hai . aur jo baaten tumharay dilon mein hain , khuwa tum unn ko zahir kero ya chupao , Allah tum say unn ka hisab ley ga .   phir jiss ko chahye ga moaaf kerday ga aur jiss ko chahye ga saza dey ga . aur Allah her cheez per qudrat rakhta hai .

ayahs.text: yeh Rasool ( yani hazrat Muhammad SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) uss cheez per emaan laye hain jo unn ki taraf unn kay rab ki taraf say nazil ki gaee hai , aur ( unn kay sath ) tamam musalman bhi . yeh sabb Allah per , uss kay farishton per , uss ki kitabon per aur uss kay Rasoolon per emaan laye hain . ( woh kehtay hain kay ) hum uss kay Rasoolon kay darmiyan koi tafreeq nahi kertay ( kay kissi per emaan layen , kissi per naa layen ) aur woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  hum ney ( Allah aur Rasool kay ehkaam ko tawajjah say ) sunn liya hai , aur hum khushi say ( unn ki ) tameel kertay hain . aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum aap ki maghfirat kay talabgaar hain . aur aap hi ki taraf hamen loat ker-jana hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh Rasool ( yani hazrat Muhammad SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) uss cheez per emaan laye hain jo unn ki taraf unn kay rab ki taraf say nazil ki gaee hai , aur ( unn kay sath ) tamam musalman bhi . yeh sabb Allah per , uss kay farishton per , uss ki kitabon per aur uss kay Rasoolon per emaan laye hain . ( woh kehtay hain kay ) hum uss kay Rasoolon kay darmiyan koi tafreeq nahi kertay ( kay kissi per emaan layen , kissi per naa layen ) aur woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  hum ney ( Allah aur Rasool kay ehkaam ko tawajjah say ) sunn liya hai , aur hum khushi say ( unn ki ) tameel kertay hain . aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum aap ki maghfirat kay talabgaar hain . aur aap hi ki taraf hamen loat ker-jana hai .

ayahs.text: Allah kissi bhi shaks ko uss ki wusat say ziyada zimma daari nahi sonpta . uss ko faeeda bhi ussi kaam say hoga jo woh apney iraday say keray , aur nuqsan bhi ussi kaam say hoga jo apney iraday say keray . ( musalmano Allah say yeh dua kiya kero kay : )  aey humaray perwerdigar ! agar hum say koi bhool chowk hojaye to humari girift naa farmaiye . aur aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum per uss tarah ka bojh naa daaliye jaisa aap ney hum say pehlay logon  per daala tha . aur aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum per aisa bojh naa daaliye jissay uthaney ki hum mein taqat naa ho . aur humari khataon say darguzar farmaiye , hamen bakhsh dijiye , aur hum per reham farmaiye . aap hi humaray haami o nasir hain , iss liye kafir logon  kay muqablay mein hamen nusrat ata farmaiye .
ayahs.translation: Allah kissi bhi shaks ko uss ki wusat say ziyada zimma daari nahi sonpta . uss ko faeeda bhi ussi kaam say hoga jo woh apney iraday say keray , aur nuqsan bhi ussi kaam say hoga jo apney iraday say keray . ( musalmano Allah say yeh dua kiya kero kay : )  aey humaray perwerdigar ! agar hum say koi bhool chowk hojaye to humari girift naa farmaiye . aur aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum per uss tarah ka bojh naa daaliye jaisa aap ney hum say pehlay logon  per daala tha . aur aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum per aisa bojh naa daaliye jissay uthaney ki hum mein taqat naa ho . aur humari khataon say darguzar farmaiye , hamen bakhsh dijiye , aur hum per reham farmaiye . aap hi humaray haami o nasir hain , iss liye kafir logon  kay muqablay mein hamen nusrat ata farmaiye .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: Alif-Laam-Meem .
verses.translation: Alif-Laam-Meem .

verses.text: Allah woh hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi , jo sada zinda hai , jo poori kainat sanbhalay huye hai ;
verses.translation: Allah woh hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi , jo sada zinda hai , jo poori kainat sanbhalay huye hai ;

verses.text: uss ney tum per woh kitab nazil ki hai jo haq per mushtamil hai jo apney say pehli kitabon ki tasdeeq kerti hai , aur ussi ney toraat aur injeel utaaren .
verses.translation: uss ney tum per woh kitab nazil ki hai jo haq per mushtamil hai jo apney say pehli kitabon ki tasdeeq kerti hai , aur ussi ney toraat aur injeel utaaren .

verses.text: jo iss say pehlay logon  kay liye mujassam hidayat ban ker aai then , aur ussi ney haq o batil ko parakhney ka mayaar nazil kiya .   . beyshak jinn logon  ney Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kiya hai unn kay liye sakht azab hai , aur Allah zabardast iqtidar ka malik aur burai ka badla denay wala hai .
verses.translation: jo iss say pehlay logon  kay liye mujassam hidayat ban ker aai then , aur ussi ney haq o batil ko parakhney ka mayaar nazil kiya .   . beyshak jinn logon  ney Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kiya hai unn kay liye sakht azab hai , aur Allah zabardast iqtidar ka malik aur burai ka badla denay wala hai .

verses.text: yaqeen rakho kay Allah say koi cheez chup nahi sakti , naa zameen mein naa aasman mein
verses.translation: yaqeen rakho kay Allah say koi cheez chup nahi sakti , naa zameen mein naa aasman mein

verses.text: wohi hai jo maon kay pet mein jiss tarah chahta hai tumhari soorten banata hai . uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi . woh zabardast iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , aalaa darjay ki hikmat ka bhi
verses.translation: wohi hai jo maon kay pet mein jiss tarah chahta hai tumhari soorten banata hai . uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi . woh zabardast iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , aalaa darjay ki hikmat ka bhi

verses.text: . ( aey Rasool ! ) wohi Allah hai jiss ney tum per kitab nazil ki hai jiss ki kuch aayaaten to mohkam hain jinn per kitab ki asal buniyad hai , aur kuch doosri aayaaten mutashabeh hain .   abb jinn logon  kay dilon mein tairrah hai woh inn mutashabeh aayaton kay peechay parray rehtay hain takay fitna peda keren aur inn aayaton ki taweelaat talash keren , halankay inn aayaton ka theek theek matlab Allah kay siwa koi nahi janta , aur jinn logon  ka ilm pukhta hai woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  hum uss ( matlab ) per emaan latay hain ( jo Allah ko maloom hai ) . sabb kuch humaray perwerdigar hi ki taraf say hai .  aur naseehat wohi log hasil kertay hain jo aqal walay hain

verses.text: . ( aesay log yeh dua kertay hain kay : )  aey humaray rab ! tu ney hamen jo hidayat ata farmaee hai uss kay baad humaray dilon mein tairrah peda naa honey dey , aur khaas apney paas say hamen rehmat ata farma . beyshak teri , aur sirf teri zaat woh hai jo bey inteha bakhshish ki khoogar hai
verses.translation: . ( aesay log yeh dua kertay hain kay : )  aey humaray rab ! tu ney hamen jo hidayat ata farmaee hai uss kay baad humaray dilon mein tairrah peda naa honey dey , aur khaas apney paas say hamen rehmat ata farma . beyshak teri , aur sirf teri zaat woh hai jo bey inteha bakhshish ki khoogar hai

verses.text: humaray perwerdigar ! tu tamam insanon ko aik aesay din jama kernay wala hai jiss kay aaney mein koi shak nahi .  beyshak Allah apney waday ki khilaf warzi nahi kerta .
verses.translation: humaray perwerdigar ! tu tamam insanon ko aik aesay din jama kernay wala hai jiss kay aaney mein koi shak nahi .  beyshak Allah apney waday ki khilaf warzi nahi kerta .

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , Allah kay muqablay mein naa unn ki dolat unn kay kuch kaam aaye gi , naa unn ki aulad , aur wohi hain jo aag ka endhan ban ker rahen gay .
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , Allah kay muqablay mein naa unn ki dolat unn kay kuch kaam aaye gi , naa unn ki aulad , aur wohi hain jo aag ka endhan ban ker rahen gay .

verses.text: unn ka haal firon aur unn say pehlay kay logon  kay moamlay jaisa hai . unhon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya , chunacheh Allah ney unn ko unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say pakar mein ley liya , aur Allah ka azab bara sakht hai .
verses.translation: unn ka haal firon aur unn say pehlay kay logon  kay moamlay jaisa hai . unhon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya , chunacheh Allah ney unn ko unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say pakar mein ley liya , aur Allah ka azab bara sakht hai .

verses.text: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai unn say keh do kay tum maghloob hogay   aur tumhen jama ker kay jahannum ki taraf ley jaya jaye ga , aur woh boht bura bichona hai .
verses.translation: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai unn say keh do kay tum maghloob hogay   aur tumhen jama ker kay jahannum ki taraf ley jaya jaye ga , aur woh boht bura bichona hai .

verses.text: tumharay liye unn do girohon ( kay waqaey ) mein bari nishani hai jo aik doosray say takraye thay . unn mein say aik giroh Allah kay raastay mein larr raha tha , aur doosra kafiron ka giroh tha jo apney aap ko khuli aankhon unn say kaee guna ziyada dekh raha tha .   aur Allah jiss ki chahta hai apni madad say taeed kerta hai . beyshak uss waqaey mein aankhon walon kay liye ibrat ka bara saman hai .
verses.translation: tumharay liye unn do girohon ( kay waqaey ) mein bari nishani hai jo aik doosray say takraye thay . unn mein say aik giroh Allah kay raastay mein larr raha tha , aur doosra kafiron ka giroh tha jo apney aap ko khuli aankhon unn say kaee guna ziyada dekh raha tha .   aur Allah jiss ki chahta hai apni madad say taeed kerta hai . beyshak uss waqaey mein aankhon walon kay liye ibrat ka bara saman hai .

verses.text: logon  kay liye unn cheezon ki mohabbat khushnuma bana di gaee hai jo unn ki nafsani khuwaish kay mutabiq hoti hai , yani aurten , bacchay , soney chaandi kay lagay huye dher , nishan lagaye huye ghorray , chopaye aur khetiyan . yeh sabb dunyawi zindagi ka saman hai ( lekin ) abadi anjam ka hussn to sirf Allah kay paas hai .
verses.translation: logon  kay liye unn cheezon ki mohabbat khushnuma bana di gaee hai jo unn ki nafsani khuwaish kay mutabiq hoti hai , yani aurten , bacchay , soney chaandi kay lagay huye dher , nishan lagaye huye ghorray , chopaye aur khetiyan . yeh sabb dunyawi zindagi ka saman hai ( lekin ) abadi anjam ka hussn to sirf Allah kay paas hai .

verses.text: keh do ! kiya mein tumhen woh cheezen bataon jo inn sabb say kahen behtar hain-? jo log taqwa ikhtiyar kertay hain unn kay liye unn kay rab kay paas woh baaghaat hain jinn kay neechay nehren behti hain , jinn mein woh hamesha rahen gay , aur pakeezah biwiyan hain , aur Allah ki taraf say khushnoodi hai . aur tamam bandon ko Allah achi tarah dekh raha hai .
verses.translation: keh do ! kiya mein tumhen woh cheezen bataon jo inn sabb say kahen behtar hain-? jo log taqwa ikhtiyar kertay hain unn kay liye unn kay rab kay paas woh baaghaat hain jinn kay neechay nehren behti hain , jinn mein woh hamesha rahen gay , aur pakeezah biwiyan hain , aur Allah ki taraf say khushnoodi hai . aur tamam bandon ko Allah achi tarah dekh raha hai .

verses.text: yeh woh log hain jo kehtay hain kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum aap per emaan ley aaye hain . abb humaray gunahon ko bakhsh dijiye , aur hamen dozakh kay azab say bacha lijiye .
verses.translation: yeh woh log hain jo kehtay hain kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum aap per emaan ley aaye hain . abb humaray gunahon ko bakhsh dijiye , aur hamen dozakh kay azab say bacha lijiye .

verses.text: yeh log baray sabar kernay walay hain , sachai kay khoogar hain , ibadat guzaar hain , ( Allah ki khushnoodi kay liye ) kharch kernay walay hain , aur sehri kay oqaat mein astaghfaar kertay rehtay hain .
verses.translation: yeh log baray sabar kernay walay hain , sachai kay khoogar hain , ibadat guzaar hain , ( Allah ki khushnoodi kay liye ) kharch kernay walay hain , aur sehri kay oqaat mein astaghfaar kertay rehtay hain .

verses.text: Allah ney khud iss baat ki gawahi di hai , aur farishton aur ehal-e-ilm ney bhi , kay uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi jiss ney insaf kay sath ( kainat ) ka intizam sanbhala huwa hai . uss kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil .
verses.translation: Allah ney khud iss baat ki gawahi di hai , aur farishton aur ehal-e-ilm ney bhi , kay uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi jiss ney insaf kay sath ( kainat ) ka intizam sanbhala huwa hai . uss kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil .

verses.text: beyshak ( moatabir ) deen to Allah kay nazdeek Islam hi hai . aur jinn logon  ko kitab di gaee thi unhon ney alag raasta laa-ilmi mein nahi balkay ilm aajaney kay baad mehaz aapas ki zidd ki wajeh say ikhtiyar kiya aur , jo shaks bhi Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlaye to ( ussay yaad rakhna chahiye kay ) Allah boht jald hisab lenay wala hai
verses.translation: beyshak ( moatabir ) deen to Allah kay nazdeek Islam hi hai . aur jinn logon  ko kitab di gaee thi unhon ney alag raasta laa-ilmi mein nahi balkay ilm aajaney kay baad mehaz aapas ki zidd ki wajeh say ikhtiyar kiya aur , jo shaks bhi Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlaye to ( ussay yaad rakhna chahiye kay ) Allah boht jald hisab lenay wala hai

verses.text: phir bhi agar yeh tum say jhagrren to keh do kay :  mein ney to apna rukh Allah ki taraf kerliya hai , aur jinhon ney meri ittaba ki hai unhon ney bhi .  aur ehal-e-kitab say aur ( arab kay ) ann parh ( mushrikeen ) say keh do kay kiya tum bhi Islam latay ho-? phir agar woh Islam ley ayen to hidayat paajayen gay , aur agar unhon ney mun morra to tumhari zimma daari sirf paygham phonchanay ki hadd tak hai , aur Allah tamam bandon ko khud dekh raha hai .
verses.translation: phir bhi agar yeh tum say jhagrren to keh do kay :  mein ney to apna rukh Allah ki taraf kerliya hai , aur jinhon ney meri ittaba ki hai unhon ney bhi .  aur ehal-e-kitab say aur ( arab kay ) ann parh ( mushrikeen ) say keh do kay kiya tum bhi Islam latay ho-? phir agar woh Islam ley ayen to hidayat paajayen gay , aur agar unhon ney mun morra to tumhari zimma daari sirf paygham phonchanay ki hadd tak hai , aur Allah tamam bandon ko khud dekh raha hai .

verses.text: jo log Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlatay hain aur nabiyon ko nahaq qatal kertay hain , aur insaf ki talqeen kernay walay logon  ko bhi qatal kertay hain , unn ko dardnak azab ki   khushkhabri " suna do .
verses.translation: jo log Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlatay hain aur nabiyon ko nahaq qatal kertay hain , aur insaf ki talqeen kernay walay logon  ko bhi qatal kertay hain , unn ko dardnak azab ki   khushkhabri " suna do .

verses.text: yeh woh log hain jinn kay aemal duniya aur aakhirat mein gharat ho chukay hain , aur inn ko kissi qisam kay madadgaar naseeb nahi hon gay .
verses.translation: yeh woh log hain jinn kay aemal duniya aur aakhirat mein gharat ho chukay hain , aur inn ko kissi qisam kay madadgaar naseeb nahi hon gay .

verses.text: kiya tum ney unn logon  ko nahi dekha jinhen kitab ka aik hissa diya gaya tha kay unhen Allah ki kitab ki taraf dawat di jati hai takay woh unn kay darmiyan faisla keray , iss kay bawajood unn mein say aik giroh mun morr ker inehraaf ker-jata hai .
verses.translation: kiya tum ney unn logon  ko nahi dekha jinhen kitab ka aik hissa diya gaya tha kay unhen Allah ki kitab ki taraf dawat di jati hai takay woh unn kay darmiyan faisla keray , iss kay bawajood unn mein say aik giroh mun morr ker inehraaf ker-jata hai .

verses.text: yeh sabb iss liye hai kay unhon ney yeh kaha huwa hai kay hamen ginti kay chand dino kay siwa aag hergiz nahi chooay gi . aur unhon ney jo jhooti baaten tarash rakhi hain unhon ney unn kay deen kay moamlay mein unn ko dhokay mein daal diya hai
verses.translation: yeh sabb iss liye hai kay unhon ney yeh kaha huwa hai kay hamen ginti kay chand dino kay siwa aag hergiz nahi chooay gi . aur unhon ney jo jhooti baaten tarash rakhi hain unhon ney unn kay deen kay moamlay mein unn ko dhokay mein daal diya hai

verses.text: bhala uss waqt unn ka kiya haal hoga jab hum unhen aik aesay din ( ka samna kernay ) kay liye jama ker layen gay jiss kay aaney mein zara bhi shak nahi hai , aur her her shaks ney jo kuch kamai ki hogi woh uss ko poori poori dey di jaye gi , aur kissi per koi zulm nahi hoga .
verses.translation: bhala uss waqt unn ka kiya haal hoga jab hum unhen aik aesay din ( ka samna kernay ) kay liye jama ker layen gay jiss kay aaney mein zara bhi shak nahi hai , aur her her shaks ney jo kuch kamai ki hogi woh uss ko poori poori dey di jaye gi , aur kissi per koi zulm nahi hoga .

verses.text: kaho kay :  aey Allah ! aey iqtidar kay malik ! to jiss ko chahta hai iqtidar bakhshta hai , aur jiss say chahta hai iqtidar cheen leta hai , aur jiss ko chahta hai izzat bakhshta hai aur jiss ko chahta hai ruswa ker deta hai , tamam tarr bhalai teray hi haath mein hai . yaqeenan tu her cheez per qadir hai .
verses.translation: kaho kay :  aey Allah ! aey iqtidar kay malik ! to jiss ko chahta hai iqtidar bakhshta hai , aur jiss say chahta hai iqtidar cheen leta hai , aur jiss ko chahta hai izzat bakhshta hai aur jiss ko chahta hai ruswa ker deta hai , tamam tarr bhalai teray hi haath mein hai . yaqeenan tu her cheez per qadir hai .

verses.text: tu hi raat ko din mein dakhil kerta hai aur din ko raat mein dakhil kerta hai .   aur tu hi bey jaan cheez mein say jandaar ko bar-aamad kerleta hai aur jandaar mein say bey jaan cheez nikal lata hai ,   aur jiss ko chahta hai bey hisab rizq ata farmata hai .
verses.translation: tu hi raat ko din mein dakhil kerta hai aur din ko raat mein dakhil kerta hai .   aur tu hi bey jaan cheez mein say jandaar ko bar-aamad kerleta hai aur jandaar mein say bey jaan cheez nikal lata hai ,   aur jiss ko chahta hai bey hisab rizq ata farmata hai .

verses.text: momin log musalmanon ko chorr ker kafiron ko apna yaar-o-madadgaar naa banayen . aur jo aisa keray ga uss ka Allah say koi talluq nahi , illa yeh kay tum unn ( kay zulm ) say bachney kay liye bachao ka koi tareeqa ikhtiyar kero .   aur Allah tumhen apney ( azab ) say bachata hai . aur ussi ki taraf ( sabb ko ) loat ker jana hai .
verses.translation: momin log musalmanon ko chorr ker kafiron ko apna yaar-o-madadgaar naa banayen . aur jo aisa keray ga uss ka Allah say koi talluq nahi , illa yeh kay tum unn ( kay zulm ) say bachney kay liye bachao ka koi tareeqa ikhtiyar kero .   aur Allah tumhen apney ( azab ) say bachata hai . aur ussi ki taraf ( sabb ko ) loat ker jana hai .

verses.text: . ( aey Rasool ! ) logon  ko bata do kay jo kuch tumharay dilon mein hai tum ussay chupao ya zahir kero , Allah ussay jaan ley ga . aur jo kuch aasmano mein hai aur jo kuch zameen mein hai , woh sabb janta hai , aur Allah her cheez per qadir hai .
verses.translation: . ( aey Rasool ! ) logon  ko bata do kay jo kuch tumharay dilon mein hai tum ussay chupao ya zahir kero , Allah ussay jaan ley ga . aur jo kuch aasmano mein hai aur jo kuch zameen mein hai , woh sabb janta hai , aur Allah her cheez per qadir hai .

verses.text: woh din yaad rakho jiss din kissi bhi shaks ney naiki ka jo kaam kiya hoga ussay apney samney mojood paye ga , aur burai ka jo kaam kiya hoga uss ko bhi ( apney samney dekh ker ) yeh tamanna keray ga kay kaash uss kay aur uss ki badi kay darmiyan boht door ka fasla hota ! aur Allah tumhen apney ( azab ) say bachata hai , aur Allah bandon per boht shafqat rakhta hai .
verses.translation: woh din yaad rakho jiss din kissi bhi shaks ney naiki ka jo kaam kiya hoga ussay apney samney mojood paye ga , aur burai ka jo kaam kiya hoga uss ko bhi ( apney samney dekh ker ) yeh tamanna keray ga kay kaash uss kay aur uss ki badi kay darmiyan boht door ka fasla hota ! aur Allah tumhen apney ( azab ) say bachata hai , aur Allah bandon per boht shafqat rakhta hai .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! logon  say ) keh do kay agar tum Allah say mohabbat rakhtay ho to meri ittaba kero , Allah tum say mohabbat keray ga aur tumhari khatir tumharay gunah moaaf kerday ga . aur Allah boht moaaf kernay wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! logon  say ) keh do kay agar tum Allah say mohabbat rakhtay ho to meri ittaba kero , Allah tum say mohabbat keray ga aur tumhari khatir tumharay gunah moaaf kerday ga . aur Allah boht moaaf kernay wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: keh do kay Allah aur Rasool ki itaat kero . phir bhi agar mun morro gay to Allah kafiron ko pasand nahi kerta .
verses.translation: keh do kay Allah aur Rasool ki itaat kero . phir bhi agar mun morro gay to Allah kafiron ko pasand nahi kerta .

verses.text: Allah ney Adam , nooh , Ibrahim kay khandan , aur imran kay khandan ko chunn ker tamam jahano per fazilat di thi .
verses.translation: Allah ney Adam , nooh , Ibrahim kay khandan , aur imran kay khandan ko chunn ker tamam jahano per fazilat di thi .

verses.text: yeh aesi nasal thi jiss kay afrad ( naiki aur ikhlas mein ) aik doosray say miltay jultay thay .   aur Allah ( her aik ki baat ) sunney wala hai , her cheez ka ilm rakhta hai .
verses.translation: yeh aesi nasal thi jiss kay afrad ( naiki aur ikhlas mein ) aik doosray say miltay jultay thay .   aur Allah ( her aik ki baat ) sunney wala hai , her cheez ka ilm rakhta hai .

verses.text: . ( chunacheh Allah kay dua sunney ka woh waqiaa yaad kero ) jab imran ki biwi ney kaha tha kay :  ya rab ! mein ney nazar maani hai kay meray pet mein jo baccha hai mein ussay her kaam say azad ker kay teray liye waqf rakhun gi . meri iss nazar ko qubool farma . beyshak tu sunney wala hai , her cheez ka ilm rakhta hai .
verses.translation: . ( chunacheh Allah kay dua sunney ka woh waqiaa yaad kero ) jab imran ki biwi ney kaha tha kay :  ya rab ! mein ney nazar maani hai kay meray pet mein jo baccha hai mein ussay her kaam say azad ker kay teray liye waqf rakhun gi . meri iss nazar ko qubool farma . beyshak tu sunney wala hai , her cheez ka ilm rakhta hai .

verses.text: phir jab unn say larki peda hoi to woh ( hasrat say ) kehney lagen :  ya rab ! yeh to mujh say larki peda hogaee hai .  halankay Allah ko khoob ilm tha kay unn kay yahan kiya peda huwa hai .  aur larka larki jaisa nahi hota . mein ney uss ka naam maryam rakh diya hai aur mein ussay aur uss ki aulad ko shetan mardood say hifazat kay liye aap ki panah mein deti hun .
verses.translation: phir jab unn say larki peda hoi to woh ( hasrat say ) kehney lagen :  ya rab ! yeh to mujh say larki peda hogaee hai .  halankay Allah ko khoob ilm tha kay unn kay yahan kiya peda huwa hai .  aur larka larki jaisa nahi hota . mein ney uss ka naam maryam rakh diya hai aur mein ussay aur uss ki aulad ko shetan mardood say hifazat kay liye aap ki panah mein deti hun .

verses.text: chunacheh uss kay rab ney uss ( maryam ) ko ba-tareeq ahsan qubool kiya aur ussay behtareen tareeqay say perwan charrhaya . aur zakriya uss kay sarparast banay .   jab bhi zakriya unn kay paas unn ki ibadat gaah mein jatay , unn kay paas koi rizq paatay . unhon ney poocha :  maryam ! tumharay paas yeh cheezen kahan say ayen-?  woh bolen :  Allah kay paas say ! Allah jiss ko chahta hai bey hisab rizq deta hai .
verses.translation: chunacheh uss kay rab ney uss ( maryam ) ko ba-tareeq ahsan qubool kiya aur ussay behtareen tareeqay say perwan charrhaya . aur zakriya uss kay sarparast banay .   jab bhi zakriya unn kay paas unn ki ibadat gaah mein jatay , unn kay paas koi rizq paatay . unhon ney poocha :  maryam ! tumharay paas yeh cheezen kahan say ayen-?  woh bolen :  Allah kay paas say ! Allah jiss ko chahta hai bey hisab rizq deta hai .

verses.text: iss moaqa per zakriya ney apney rab say dua ki , kehney lagay :  ya rab ! mujhay khaas apney paas say pakeezah aulad ata farmadey . beyshak tu dua ka sunney wala hai .
verses.translation: iss moaqa per zakriya ney apney rab say dua ki , kehney lagay :  ya rab ! mujhay khaas apney paas say pakeezah aulad ata farmadey . beyshak tu dua ka sunney wala hai .

verses.text: chunacheh ( aik din ) jab zakriya ibadat gaah mein kharray namaz parh rahey thay , farishton ney unhen aawaz di kay :  Allah aap ko Yahya ki ( pedaeesh ) ki khushkhabri deta hai jo iss shaan say peda hon gay kay Allah kay aik kalmay ki tasdeeq keren gay ,   logon  kay peshwa hon gay , apney aap ko nafsani khuwaishaat say mukammal tor per rokay huye hon gay ,   aur nabi hon gay aur unn ka shumar raast bazon mein hoga .
verses.translation: chunacheh ( aik din ) jab zakriya ibadat gaah mein kharray namaz parh rahey thay , farishton ney unhen aawaz di kay :  Allah aap ko Yahya ki ( pedaeesh ) ki khushkhabri deta hai jo iss shaan say peda hon gay kay Allah kay aik kalmay ki tasdeeq keren gay ,   logon  kay peshwa hon gay , apney aap ko nafsani khuwaishaat say mukammal tor per rokay huye hon gay ,   aur nabi hon gay aur unn ka shumar raast bazon mein hoga .

verses.text: zakriya ney kaha :  ya rab ! meray yahan larka kiss tarah peda hoga jabkay mujhay burhapa aa-phoncha hai aur meri biwi baanjh hai ?    Allah ney kaha :  issi tarah ! Allah jo chahta hai kerta hai .
verses.translation: zakriya ney kaha :  ya rab ! meray yahan larka kiss tarah peda hoga jabkay mujhay burhapa aa-phoncha hai aur meri biwi baanjh hai ?    Allah ney kaha :  issi tarah ! Allah jo chahta hai kerta hai .

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  perwerdigar ! meray liye koi nishani muqarrar ker-dijiye . Allah ney kaha :  tumhari nishani yeh hogi kay tum teen din tak isharon kay siwa koi baat nahi ker-sako gay .   aur apney rab ka kasrat say ziker kertay raho , aur dhalay din kay waqt bhi aur subha saweray bhi Allah ki tasbeeh kiya kero .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  perwerdigar ! meray liye koi nishani muqarrar ker-dijiye . Allah ney kaha :  tumhari nishani yeh hogi kay tum teen din tak isharon kay siwa koi baat nahi ker-sako gay .   aur apney rab ka kasrat say ziker kertay raho , aur dhalay din kay waqt bhi aur subha saweray bhi Allah ki tasbeeh kiya kero .

verses.text: aur ( abb uss waqt ka tazkarah suno ) jab farishton ney kaha tha kay :  aey maryam ! beyshak Allah ney tumhen chunn liya hai , tumhen pakeezgi ata ki hai aur duniya jahan ki sari aurton mein tumhen muntakhib kerkay fazilat bakhshi hai .
verses.translation: aur ( abb uss waqt ka tazkarah suno ) jab farishton ney kaha tha kay :  aey maryam ! beyshak Allah ney tumhen chunn liya hai , tumhen pakeezgi ata ki hai aur duniya jahan ki sari aurton mein tumhen muntakhib kerkay fazilat bakhshi hai .

verses.text: aey maryam ! tum apney rab ki ibadat mein lagi raho , aur sajda kero aur rukoo kernay walon kay sath rukoo bhi kiya kero .
verses.translation: aey maryam ! tum apney rab ki ibadat mein lagi raho , aur sajda kero aur rukoo kernay walon kay sath rukoo bhi kiya kero .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh sabb ghaib ki khabren hain jo hum wahi kay zariye tumhen dey rahey hain . tum uss waqt unn kay paas nahi thay jab woh yeh tey kernay kay liye apney qalam daal rahey thay kay unn mein say kon maryam ki kafalat keray ga ,   aur naa uss waqt tum unn kay paas thay jab woh ( iss maslay mein ) aik doosray say ikhtilaf ker-rahey thay .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh sabb ghaib ki khabren hain jo hum wahi kay zariye tumhen dey rahey hain . tum uss waqt unn kay paas nahi thay jab woh yeh tey kernay kay liye apney qalam daal rahey thay kay unn mein say kon maryam ki kafalat keray ga ,   aur naa uss waqt tum unn kay paas thay jab woh ( iss maslay mein ) aik doosray say ikhtilaf ker-rahey thay .

verses.text: . ( woh waqt bhi yaad kero ) jab farishton ney maryam say kaha tha kay :  aey maryam ! Allah taalaa tumhen apney aik kalmay ki ( pedaeesh ) ki khushkhabri deta hai jiss ka naam maseeh essa ibn-e-maryam hoga ,   jo duniya aur aakhirat dono mein sahab-e-wajahat hoga , aur ( Allah kay ) muqarrab bandon mein say hoga .

Allah taalaa tumhen apney aik kalmay ki ( pedaeesh ) ki khushkhabri deta hai jiss ka naam maseeh essa ibn-e-maryam hoga ,   jo duniya aur aakhirat dono mein sahab-e-wajahat hoga , aur ( Allah kay ) muqarrab bandon mein say hoga .

verses.text: aur woh gehwaray mein bhi logon  say baat keray ga   aur bari umar mein bhi , aur raast baaz logon  mein say hoga .
verses.translation: aur woh gehwaray mein bhi logon  say baat keray ga   aur bari umar mein bhi , aur raast baaz logon  mein say hoga .

verses.text: maryam ney kaha :  perwerdigar ! mujh say larka kaisay peda hojaye ga jabkay mujhay kissi bashar ney chooa tak nahi-?  Allah ney farmaya :  Allah issi tarah jiss ko chahta hai peda kerta hai . jab woh koi kaam kernay ka faisla kerleta hai to sirf itna kehta hai kay   hoja " bus woh hojata hai .

Allah ney farmaya :  Allah issi tarah jiss ko chahta hai peda kerta hai . jab woh koi kaam kernay ka faisla kerleta hai to sirf itna kehta hai kay   hoja " bus woh hojata hai .

verses.text: aur wohi ( Allah ) uss ko ( yani essa ibn-e-maryam ko ) kitab o hikmat aur toraat o injeel ki taleem dey ga .
verses.translation: aur wohi ( Allah ) uss ko ( yani essa ibn-e-maryam ko ) kitab o hikmat aur toraat o injeel ki taleem dey ga .

verses.text: aur ussay bani Israel kay paas Rasool bana ker bhejay ga ( jo logon  say yeh kahey ga ) kay :  mein tumharay paas tumharay rab ki taraf say aik nishani ley ker aaya hun , ( aur woh nishani yeh hai ) kay mein tumharay samney garay say perinday jaisi aik shakal banata hun , phir uss mein phoonk maarta hun , to woh Allah kay hukum say perinda ban jata hai , aur mein Allah kay hukum say madarzaad andhay aur korhi ko tandurust ker deta hun , aur murdon ko zinda ker deta hun , aur tum log jo kuch apney gharon mein khatay ya zakheera ker kay rakhtay ho mein woh sabb bata deta hun .   agar tum emaan laney walay ho to inn tamam baaton mein tumharay liye ( kafi ) nishani hai .
verses.translation: aur ussay bani Israel kay paas Rasool bana ker bhejay ga ( jo logon  say yeh kahey ga ) kay :  mein tumharay paas tumharay rab ki taraf say aik nishani ley ker aaya hun , ( aur woh nishani yeh hai ) kay mein tumharay samney garay say perinday jaisi aik shakal banata hun , phir uss mein phoonk maarta hun , to woh Allah kay hukum say perinda ban jata hai , aur mein Allah kay hukum say madarzaad andhay aur korhi ko tandurust ker deta hun , aur murdon ko zinda ker deta hun , aur tum log jo kuch apney gharon mein khatay ya zakheera ker kay rakhtay ho mein woh sabb bata deta hun .   agar tum emaan laney walay ho to inn tamam baaton mein tumharay liye ( kafi ) nishani hai .

verses.text: aur jo kitab mujh say pehlay aa-chuki hai , yani toraat , mein uss ki tasdeeq kernay wala hun , aur ( iss liye bheja gaya hun ) takay kuch cheezen jo tum per haram ki gaee then , abb tumharay liye halal kerdun .   aur mein tumharay paas tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say nishani ley ker aaya hun , lehaza Allah say daro aur mera kehna maano .
verses.translation: aur jo kitab mujh say pehlay aa-chuki hai , yani toraat , mein uss ki tasdeeq kernay wala hun , aur ( iss liye bheja gaya hun ) takay kuch cheezen jo tum per haram ki gaee then , abb tumharay liye halal kerdun .   aur mein tumharay paas tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say nishani ley ker aaya hun , lehaza Allah say daro aur mera kehna maano .

verses.text: beyshak Allah mera bhi perwerdigar hai aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar . yehi seedha raasta hai ( kay sirf ussi ki ibadat kero )
verses.translation: beyshak Allah mera bhi perwerdigar hai aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar . yehi seedha raasta hai ( kay sirf ussi ki ibadat kero )

verses.text: phir jab essa ney mehsoos kiya kay woh kufr per aamada hain , to unhon ney ( apney pairo-on say ) kaha :  kon kon log hain jo Allah ki raah mein meray madadgaar hon-?  hawariyon   ney kaha :  hum Allah ( kay deen ) kay madadgaar hain , hum Allah per emaan laa-chukay hain , aur aap gawah rahiye kay hum farmanbardaar hain .
verses.translation: phir jab essa ney mehsoos kiya kay woh kufr per aamada hain , to unhon ney ( apney pairo-on say ) kaha :  kon kon log hain jo Allah ki raah mein meray madadgaar hon-?  hawariyon   ney kaha :  hum Allah ( kay deen ) kay madadgaar hain , hum Allah per emaan laa-chukay hain , aur aap gawah rahiye kay hum farmanbardaar hain .

verses.text: aey humaray rab ! aap ney jo kuch nazil kiya hai hum uss per emaan laye hain aur hum ney Rasool ki ittaba ki hai , lehaza hamen unn logon  mein likh lijiye jo ( haq ki ) gawahi denay walay hain .
verses.translation: aey humaray rab ! aap ney jo kuch nazil kiya hai hum uss per emaan laye hain aur hum ney Rasool ki ittaba ki hai , lehaza hamen unn logon  mein likh lijiye jo ( haq ki ) gawahi denay walay hain .

verses.text: aur unn kafiron ney ( essa ( aleh-assalam ) kay khilaf ) khufiya tadbeer ki , aur Allah ney bhi khufiya tadbeer ki . aur Allah sabb say behtar tadbeer kernay wala hai .
verses.translation: aur unn kafiron ney ( essa ( aleh-assalam ) kay khilaf ) khufiya tadbeer ki , aur Allah ney bhi khufiya tadbeer ki . aur Allah sabb say behtar tadbeer kernay wala hai .

verses.text: . ( uss ki tadbeer uss waqt samney aai ) jab Allah ney kaha tha kay :  aey essa ! mein tumhen sahih saalim wapis ley lun ga ,   aur tumhen apni taraf utha lun ga , aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai unn ( ki eeza ) say tumhen pak kerdun ga . aur jinn logon  ney tumhari ittaba ki hai , unn ko qayamat kay din tak unn logon  per ghalib rakhun ga jinhon ney tumhara inkar kiya hai .   phir tum sabb ko meray paas loat ker aana hai , uss waqt mein tumharay darmiyan unn baaton ka faisla kerun ga jinn mein tum ikhtilaf kertay thay .
verses.translation: . ( uss ki tadbeer uss waqt samney aai ) jab Allah ney kaha tha kay :  aey essa ! mein tumhen sahih saalim wapis ley lun ga ,   aur tumhen apni taraf utha lun ga , aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai unn ( ki eeza ) say tumhen pak kerdun ga . aur jinn logon  ney tumhari ittaba ki hai , unn ko qayamat kay din tak unn logon  per ghalib rakhun ga jinhon ney tumhara inkar kiya hai .   phir tum sabb ko meray paas loat ker aana hai , uss waqt mein tumharay darmiyan unn baaton ka faisla kerun ga jinn mein tum ikhtilaf kertay thay .

verses.text: chunacheh jo log aesay hain kay unhon ney kufr apna liya hai , unn ko to mein duniya aur aakhirat mein sakht azab dun ga , aur unn ko kissi tarah kay madadgaar moyassar nahi ayen gay .
verses.translation: chunacheh jo log aesay hain kay unhon ney kufr apna liya hai , unn ko to mein duniya aur aakhirat mein sakht azab dun ga , aur unn ko kissi tarah kay madadgaar moyassar nahi ayen gay .

verses.text: albatta jo log emaan laye hain aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ko Allah unn ka poora poora sawab dey ga , aur Allah zalimon ko pasand nahi kerta .
verses.translation: albatta jo log emaan laye hain aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ko Allah unn ka poora poora sawab dey ga , aur Allah zalimon ko pasand nahi kerta .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh woh aayaten aur hikmat bhara ziker hai jo hum tumhen parh ker suna rahey hain .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh woh aayaten aur hikmat bhara ziker hai jo hum tumhen parh ker suna rahey hain .

verses.text: Allah kay nazdeek essa ki misal Adam jaisi hai ; Allah ney unhen mitti say peda kiya , phir unn say kaha :  hojao  bus woh hogaye
verses.translation: Allah kay nazdeek essa ki misal Adam jaisi hai ; Allah ney unhen mitti say peda kiya , phir unn say kaha :  hojao  bus woh hogaye

verses.text: haq wohi hai jo tumharay rab ki taraf say aaya hai , lehaza shak kernay walon mein shamil naa hojana .
verses.translation: haq wohi hai jo tumharay rab ki taraf say aaya hai , lehaza shak kernay walon mein shamil naa hojana .

verses.text: tumharay paas ( hazrat essa ( aleh-assalam ) kay waqaey ka ) jo sahih ilm aagaya hai uss kay baad bhi jo log iss moamlay mein tum say behas keren to unn say keh do kay :   aao hum apney beton ko bulayen aur tum apney beton ko , aur hum apni aurton ko aur tum apni aurton ko , aur hum apney logon  ko aur tum apney logon  ko , phir hum sabb milker Allah kay samney girr-girrayen , aur jo jhootay hon unn per Allah ki lanat bhejen .
verses.translation: tumharay paas ( hazrat essa ( aleh-assalam ) kay waqaey ka ) jo sahih ilm aagaya hai uss kay baad bhi jo log iss moamlay mein tum say behas keren to unn say keh do kay :   aao hum apney beton ko bulayen aur tum apney beton ko , aur hum apni aurton ko aur tum apni aurton ko , aur hum apney logon  ko aur tum apney logon  ko , phir hum sabb milker Allah kay samney girr-girrayen , aur jo jhootay hon unn per Allah ki lanat bhejen .

verses.text: yaqeen jano kay waqiyaat ka sacha biyan yehi hai . aur Allah kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . aur yaqeenan Allah hi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
verses.translation: yaqeen jano kay waqiyaat ka sacha biyan yehi hai . aur Allah kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . aur yaqeenan Allah hi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

verses.text: phir bhi agar yeh log mun morren to Allah mufsidon ko achi tarah janta hai .
verses.translation: phir bhi agar yeh log mun morren to Allah mufsidon ko achi tarah janta hai .

verses.text: . ( musalmano ! yahood o nasara say ) keh do kay :  aey ehal-e-kitab ! aik aesi baat ki taraf aajao jo hum tum mein mushtariq ho , ( aur woh yeh ) kay hum Allah kay siwa kissi ki ibadat naa keren , aur uss kay sath kissi ko shareek naa thehrayen , aur Allah ko chorr ker hum aik doosray ko rab naa banayen .  phir bhi agar woh mun morren to keh do :  gawah rehna kay hum musalman hain .
verses.translation: . ( musalmano ! yahood o nasara say ) keh do kay :  aey ehal-e-kitab ! aik aesi baat ki taraf aajao jo hum tum mein mushtariq ho , ( aur woh yeh ) kay hum Allah kay siwa kissi ki ibadat naa keren , aur uss kay sath kissi ko shareek naa thehrayen , aur Allah ko chorr ker hum aik doosray ko rab naa banayen .  phir bhi agar woh mun morren to keh do :  gawah rehna kay hum musalman hain .

verses.text: aey ehal-e-kitab ! tum Ibrahim kay baaray mein kiyon behas kertay ho halankay toraat aur injeel unn kay baad hi to nazil hoi then ; kiya tumhen itni bhi samajh nahi hai ?
verses.translation: aey ehal-e-kitab ! tum Ibrahim kay baaray mein kiyon behas kertay ho halankay toraat aur injeel unn kay baad hi to nazil hoi then ; kiya tumhen itni bhi samajh nahi hai ?

verses.text: dekho ! yeh tum hi to ho jinhon ney unn moamlaat mein apni si behas kerli hai jinn ka tumhen kuch naa kuch ilm tha .   abb unn moamlaat mein kiyon behas kertay ho jinn ka tumhen siray say koi ilm hi nahi hai ? Allah janta hai , aur tum nahi jantay .
verses.translation: dekho ! yeh tum hi to ho jinhon ney unn moamlaat mein apni si behas kerli hai jinn ka tumhen kuch naa kuch ilm tha .   abb unn moamlaat mein kiyon behas kertay ho jinn ka tumhen siray say koi ilm hi nahi hai ? Allah janta hai , aur tum nahi jantay .

verses.text: Ibrahim naa yahudi thay , naa nasrani , balkay woh to seedhay seedhay musalman thay , aur shirk kernay walon mein kabhi shamil nahi huye .
verses.translation: Ibrahim naa yahudi thay , naa nasrani , balkay woh to seedhay seedhay musalman thay , aur shirk kernay walon mein kabhi shamil nahi huye .

verses.text: Ibrahim kay sath talluq kay sabb say ziyada haq daar woh log hain jinhon ney unn ki perwi ki , neez yeh nabi ( aakhir-uz-zaman SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) aur woh log hain jo ( unn per ) emaan laye hain , aur Allah mominon ka kaarsaz hai .
verses.translation: Ibrahim kay sath talluq kay sabb say ziyada haq daar woh log hain jinhon ney unn ki perwi ki , neez yeh nabi ( aakhir-uz-zaman SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) aur woh log hain jo ( unn per ) emaan laye hain , aur Allah mominon ka kaarsaz hai .

verses.text: . ( musalmano ! ) ehal-e-kitab ka aik giroh yeh chahta hai kay tum logon  ko gumrah kerday , halankay woh apney siwa kissi aur ko gumrah nahi ker rahey , agar-cheh unhen uss ka ehsas nahi hai
verses.translation: . ( musalmano ! ) ehal-e-kitab ka aik giroh yeh chahta hai kay tum logon  ko gumrah kerday , halankay woh apney siwa kissi aur ko gumrah nahi ker rahey , agar-cheh unhen uss ka ehsas nahi hai

verses.text: aey ehal-e-kitab ! Allah ki aayaton ka kiyon inkar kertay ho halankay tum khud ( unn kay min-janib Allah honey kay ) gawah ho ?
verses.translation: aey ehal-e-kitab ! Allah ki aayaton ka kiyon inkar kertay ho halankay tum khud ( unn kay min-janib Allah honey kay ) gawah ho ?

verses.text: aey ehal-e-kitab ! tum haq ko batil kay sath kiyon gaddmadd kertay ho aur kiyon jaan boojh ker haq baat ko chupatay ho-?
verses.translation: aey ehal-e-kitab ! tum haq ko batil kay sath kiyon gaddmadd kertay ho aur kiyon jaan boojh ker haq baat ko chupatay ho-?

verses.text: ehal-e-kitab kay aik giroh ney ( aik doosray say ) kaha hai kay :  jo kalam musalmanon per nazil kiya gaya hai , uss per din kay shuroo mein to emaan ley aao , aur din kay aakhri hissay mein uss say inkar ker-dena , shayad iss tarah musalman ( bhi apney deen say ) phir jayen .
verses.translation: ehal-e-kitab kay aik giroh ney ( aik doosray say ) kaha hai kay :  jo kalam musalmanon per nazil kiya gaya hai , uss per din kay shuroo mein to emaan ley aao , aur din kay aakhri hissay mein uss say inkar ker-dena , shayad iss tarah musalman ( bhi apney deen say ) phir jayen .

verses.text: magar dil say unn logon  kay siwa kissi ki naa manna jo tumharay deen kay muttabey hain .  aap unn say keh dijiye kay hidayat to wohi hidayat hai jo Allah ki di hoi ho . yeh sari baaten tum uss zidd mein ker rahey ho kay kissi ko uss jaisi cheez ( yani nabwooat aur aasmani kitab ) kiyon mil gaee jaisi kabhi tumhen di gaee thi ya yeh ( musalman ) tumharay rab kay aagay tum per ghalib kiyon aagaye !  aap keh dijiye kay fazilat tamam tarr Allah kay haath mein hai , woh jiss ko chahta hai dey deta hai , aur Allah bari wusat wala hai , her cheez ka ilm rakhta hai .
verses.translation: magar dil say unn logon  kay siwa kissi ki naa manna jo tumharay deen kay muttabey hain .  aap unn say keh dijiye kay hidayat to wohi hidayat hai jo Allah ki di hoi ho . yeh sari baaten tum uss zidd mein ker rahey ho kay kissi ko uss jaisi cheez ( yani nabwooat aur aasmani kitab ) kiyon mil gaee jaisi kabhi tumhen di gaee thi ya yeh ( musalman ) tumharay rab kay aagay tum per ghalib kiyon aagaye !  aap keh dijiye kay fazilat tamam tarr Allah kay haath mein hai , woh jiss ko chahta hai dey deta hai , aur Allah bari wusat wala hai , her cheez ka ilm rakhta hai .

verses.text: woh apni rehmat kay liye jiss ko chahta hai khaas tor per muntakhib kerleta hai , aur Allah fazal-e-azeem ka malik hai .
verses.translation: woh apni rehmat kay liye jiss ko chahta hai khaas tor per muntakhib kerleta hai , aur Allah fazal-e-azeem ka malik hai .

verses.text: ehal-e-kitab mein kuch log to aesay hain kay agar tum unn kay paas dolat ka aik dher bhi amanat kay tor per rakhwa do to woh tumhen wapis kerden gay , aur unhi mein say kuch aesay hain kay agar aik deenar ki amanat bhi unn kay paas rakhwao to woh tumhen wapis nahi den gay , illa yeh kay tum unn kay sar per kharray raho . unn ka yeh tarz-e-amal iss liye hai kay unhon ney yeh keh rakha hai kay :  ummyon ( yani ghair yahudi arbon ) kay sath moamla kernay mein humari koi pakar nahi hogi .  aur ( iss tarah ) woh Allah per jaan boojh ker jhoot baandhtay hain .
verses.translation: ehal-e-kitab mein kuch log to aesay hain kay agar tum unn kay paas dolat ka aik dher bhi amanat kay tor per rakhwa do to woh tumhen wapis kerden gay , aur unhi mein say kuch aesay hain kay agar aik deenar ki amanat bhi unn kay paas rakhwao to woh tumhen wapis nahi den gay , illa yeh kay tum unn kay sar per kharray raho . unn ka yeh tarz-e-amal iss liye hai kay unhon ney yeh keh rakha hai kay :  ummyon ( yani ghair yahudi arbon ) kay sath moamla kernay mein humari koi pakar nahi hogi .  aur ( iss tarah ) woh Allah per jaan boojh ker jhoot baandhtay hain .

verses.text: bhala pakar kiyon nahi hogi-? ( qaeeda yeh hai kay ) jo apney ehad ko poora keray ga aur gunah say bacchay ga to Allah aesay perhezgaron say mohabbat kerta hai .
verses.translation: bhala pakar kiyon nahi hogi-? ( qaeeda yeh hai kay ) jo apney ehad ko poora keray ga aur gunah say bacchay ga to Allah aesay perhezgaron say mohabbat kerta hai .

verses.text: . ( iss kay bar-khilaf ) jo log Allah say kiye huye ehad aur apni khai hoi qasmon ka soda ker kay thori si qeemat hasil kerletay hain unn ka aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi hoga , aur qayamat kay din naa Allah unn say baat keray ga , naa unhen ( riyat ki nazar say ) dekhay ga , naa unhen pak keray ga , aur unn ka hissa to bus azab hoga , intehai dardnak !
verses.translation: . ( iss kay bar-khilaf ) jo log Allah say kiye huye ehad aur apni khai hoi qasmon ka soda ker kay thori si qeemat hasil kerletay hain unn ka aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi hoga , aur qayamat kay din naa Allah unn say baat keray ga , naa unhen ( riyat ki nazar say ) dekhay ga , naa unhen pak keray ga , aur unn ka hissa to bus azab hoga , intehai dardnak !

verses.text: aur unhi mein say aik giroh kay log aesay hain jo kitab ( yani toraat ) parhtay waqt apni zabanon ko marortay hain takay tum ( unn ki maror ker banai hoi ) uss ibarat ko kitab ka hissa samjho , halankay woh kitab ka hissa nahi hoti . aur woh kehtay hain kay yeh ( ibarat ) Allah ki taraf say hai , halankay woh Allah ki taraf say nahi hoti . aur ( iss tarah ) woh Allah per jantay boojhtay jhoot baandhtay hain .
verses.translation: aur unhi mein say aik giroh kay log aesay hain jo kitab ( yani toraat ) parhtay waqt apni zabanon ko marortay hain takay tum ( unn ki maror ker banai hoi ) uss ibarat ko kitab ka hissa samjho , halankay woh kitab ka hissa nahi hoti . aur woh kehtay hain kay yeh ( ibarat ) Allah ki taraf say hai , halankay woh Allah ki taraf say nahi hoti . aur ( iss tarah ) woh Allah per jantay boojhtay jhoot baandhtay hain .

verses.text: yeh kissi bashar ka kaam nahi kay Allah to ussay kitab aur hikmat aur nabwooat ata keray , aur woh uss kay bawajood logon  say kahey kay Allah ko chorr ker meray banday ban jao .   iss kay bajaye ( woh to yehi kahey ga kay ) Allah walay ban jao , kiyonkay tum jo kitab parhatay rahey ho aur jo kuch parhtay rahey ho , uss ka yehi nateeja hona chahiye .
verses.translation: yeh kissi bashar ka kaam nahi kay Allah to ussay kitab aur hikmat aur nabwooat ata keray , aur woh uss kay bawajood logon  say kahey kay Allah ko chorr ker meray banday ban jao .   iss kay bajaye ( woh to yehi kahey ga kay ) Allah walay ban jao , kiyonkay tum jo kitab parhatay rahey ho aur jo kuch parhtay rahey ho , uss ka yehi nateeja hona chahiye .

verses.text: aur naa woh tumhen yeh hukum dey sakta hai kay farishton aur payghumberon ko khuda qarar dey do . jab tum musalman ho chukay to kiya uss kay baad woh tumhen kufr ikhtiyar kernay ka hukum dey ga-?
verses.translation: aur naa woh tumhen yeh hukum dey sakta hai kay farishton aur payghumberon ko khuda qarar dey do . jab tum musalman ho chukay to kiya uss kay baad woh tumhen kufr ikhtiyar kernay ka hukum dey ga-?

verses.text: aur ( inn ko woh waqt yaad dilao ) jab Allah ney payghumberon say ehad liya tha kay :  agar mein tum ko kitab aur hikmat ata kerun , phir tumharay paas koi Rasool aaye jo uss ( kitab ) ki tasdeeq keray jo tumharay paas hai , to tum uss per zaroor emaan lao gay , aur zaroor uss ki madad kero gay .  Allah ney ( unn payghumberon say ) kaha tha kay :  kiya tum iss baat ka iqrar kertay ho aur meri taraf say di hoi yeh zimma daari uthatay ho-?  unhon ney kaha tha :  hum iqrar kertay hain .  Allah ney kaha :  to phir ( aik doosray kay iqrar kay ) gawah ban jao , aur mein bhi tumharay sath gawahi mein shamil hun .
verses.translation: aur ( inn ko woh waqt yaad dilao ) jab Allah ney payghumberon say ehad liya tha kay :  agar mein tum ko kitab aur hikmat ata kerun , phir tumharay paas koi Rasool aaye jo uss ( kitab ) ki tasdeeq keray jo tumharay paas hai , to tum uss per zaroor emaan lao gay , aur zaroor uss ki madad kero gay .  Allah ney ( unn payghumberon say ) kaha tha kay :  kiya tum iss baat ka iqrar kertay ho aur meri taraf say di hoi yeh zimma daari uthatay ho-?  unhon ney kaha tha :  hum iqrar kertay hain .  Allah ney kaha :  to phir ( aik doosray kay iqrar kay ) gawah ban jao , aur mein bhi tumharay sath gawahi mein shamil hun .

verses.text: iss kay baad bhi jo log ( hidayat say ) mun morren gay to aesay log nafarman hon gay .
verses.translation: iss kay baad bhi jo log ( hidayat say ) mun morren gay to aesay log nafarman hon gay .

verses.text: abb kiya yeh log Allah kay deen kay ilawa kissi aur deen ki talash mein hain-? halankay aasmano aur zameen mein jitni makhlooqaat hain unn sabb ney Allah hi kay aagay gardan jhuka rakhi hai , ( kuch ney ) khushi say aur ( kuch ney ) nachaar hoker ,   aur ussi ki taraf woh sabb loat ker jayen gay .
verses.translation: abb kiya yeh log Allah kay deen kay ilawa kissi aur deen ki talash mein hain-? halankay aasmano aur zameen mein jitni makhlooqaat hain unn sabb ney Allah hi kay aagay gardan jhuka rakhi hai , ( kuch ney ) khushi say aur ( kuch ney ) nachaar hoker ,   aur ussi ki taraf woh sabb loat ker jayen gay .

verses.text: keh do kay :  hum emaan laye Allah per aur jo ( kitab ) hum per utaari gaee uss per , aur uss ( hidayat ) per jo Ibrahim , Ismail , Ishaq , Yaqoob aur ( unn ki ) aulad per unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say utaari gaee , aur unn baaton per jo musa , essa aur ( doosray ) payghumberon ko ata ki gaeen . hum unn ( payghumberon ) mein say kissi kay darmiyan koi farq nahi kertay , aur hum ussi ( aik Allah ) kay aagay sar jhukaye huye hain .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  hum emaan laye Allah per aur jo ( kitab ) hum per utaari gaee uss per , aur uss ( hidayat ) per jo Ibrahim , Ismail , Ishaq , Yaqoob aur ( unn ki ) aulad per unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say utaari gaee , aur unn baaton per jo musa , essa aur ( doosray ) payghumberon ko ata ki gaeen . hum unn ( payghumberon ) mein say kissi kay darmiyan koi farq nahi kertay , aur hum ussi ( aik Allah ) kay aagay sar jhukaye huye hain .

verses.text: jo koi shaks Islam kay siwa koi aur deen ikhtiyar kerna chahye ga , to uss say woh deen qubool nahi kiya jaye ga , aur aakhirat mein woh unn logon  mein shamil hoga jo sakht nuqsan uthaney walay hain .
verses.translation: jo koi shaks Islam kay siwa koi aur deen ikhtiyar kerna chahye ga , to uss say woh deen qubool nahi kiya jaye ga , aur aakhirat mein woh unn logon  mein shamil hoga jo sakht nuqsan uthaney walay hain .

verses.text: Allah aesay logon  ko kaisay hidayat dey jinhon ney emaan laney kay baad kufr ikhtiyar kerliya-? halankay woh gawahi dey chukay thay kay yeh Rasool sachay hain , aur unn kay paas ( uss kay ) roshan dalaeel bhi aa-chukay thay . Allah aesay zalimon ko hidayat nahi diya kerta .
verses.translation: Allah aesay logon  ko kaisay hidayat dey jinhon ney emaan laney kay baad kufr ikhtiyar kerliya-? halankay woh gawahi dey chukay thay kay yeh Rasool sachay hain , aur unn kay paas ( uss kay ) roshan dalaeel bhi aa-chukay thay . Allah aesay zalimon ko hidayat nahi diya kerta .

verses.text: aesay logon  ki saza yeh hai kay unn per Allah ki , farishton ki , aur tamam insanon ki phitkaar hai .
verses.translation: aesay logon  ki saza yeh hai kay unn per Allah ki , farishton ki , aur tamam insanon ki phitkaar hai .

verses.text: issi ( phitkaar ) mein yeh hamesha rahen gay , naa inn kay liye azab halka kiya jaye ga , aur naa enhen koi mohlat di jaye gi .
verses.translation: issi ( phitkaar ) mein yeh hamesha rahen gay , naa inn kay liye azab halka kiya jaye ga , aur naa enhen koi mohlat di jaye gi .

verses.text: albatta jo log iss sabb kay baad bhi tauba ker kay apni islaah kerlen , to beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: albatta jo log iss sabb kay baad bhi tauba ker kay apni islaah kerlen , to beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: . ( iss kay bar-khilaf ) jinn logon  ney emaan laney kay baad kufr ikhtiyar kiya , phir kufr mein barhtay hi chalay gaye , unn ki tauba hergiz qubool naa hogi ,   aesay log raastay say bilkul hi bhatak chukay hain .
verses.translation: . ( iss kay bar-khilaf ) jinn logon  ney emaan laney kay baad kufr ikhtiyar kiya , phir kufr mein barhtay hi chalay gaye , unn ki tauba hergiz qubool naa hogi ,   aesay log raastay say bilkul hi bhatak chukay hain .

verses.text: jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya aur kafir honey ki halat hi mein maray , unn mein say kissi say poori zameen bhar ker sona bhi qubool nahi kiya jaye ga , khuwa woh apni jaan churraney kay liye uss ki paishkash hi kiyon naa keray . unn ko to dardnak azab ho ker rahey ga , aur unn ko kissi qisam kay madadgaar moyassar nahi ayen gay .
verses.translation: jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya aur kafir honey ki halat hi mein maray , unn mein say kissi say poori zameen bhar ker sona bhi qubool nahi kiya jaye ga , khuwa woh apni jaan churraney kay liye uss ki paishkash hi kiyon naa keray . unn ko to dardnak azab ho ker rahey ga , aur unn ko kissi qisam kay madadgaar moyassar nahi ayen gay .

verses.text: tum naiki kay maqam tak uss waqt tak hergiz nahi phoncho gay jab tak unn cheezon mein say ( Allah kay liye ) kharch naa kero jo tumhen mehboob hain .   aur jo kuch bhi tum kharch kero , Allah ussay khoob janta hai .
verses.translation: tum naiki kay maqam tak uss waqt tak hergiz nahi phoncho gay jab tak unn cheezon mein say ( Allah kay liye ) kharch naa kero jo tumhen mehboob hain .   aur jo kuch bhi tum kharch kero , Allah ussay khoob janta hai .

verses.text: toraat kay nazil honey say pehlay khaney ki tamam cheezen ( jo musalmanon kay liye halal hain ) bani Israel kay liye ( bhi ) halal then , siwaye uss cheez kay jo Israel ( yani Yaqoob aleh-assalam ) ney apney oopper haram kerli thi . ( aey payghumber ! yahudiyon say ) keh do kay :  agar tum sachay ho to toraat ley ker aao aur uss ki tilawat kero .
verses.translation: toraat kay nazil honey say pehlay khaney ki tamam cheezen ( jo musalmanon kay liye halal hain ) bani Israel kay liye ( bhi ) halal then , siwaye uss cheez kay jo Israel ( yani Yaqoob aleh-assalam ) ney apney oopper haram kerli thi . ( aey payghumber ! yahudiyon say ) keh do kay :  agar tum sachay ho to toraat ley ker aao aur uss ki tilawat kero .

verses.text: phir inn baaton kay ( wazeh honey kay ) baad bhi jo log Allah per jhoota bohtan baandhen , to aesay log baray zalim hain .
verses.translation: phir inn baaton kay ( wazeh honey kay ) baad bhi jo log Allah per jhoota bohtan baandhen , to aesay log baray zalim hain .

verses.text: aap kahiye kay Allah ney sach kaha hai , lehaza tum Ibrahim kay deen ka ittaba kero jo poori tarah seedhay raastay per thay , aur unn logon  mein say nahi thay jo Allah ki khudai mein kissi ko shareek mantay hain .
verses.translation: aap kahiye kay Allah ney sach kaha hai , lehaza tum Ibrahim kay deen ka ittaba kero jo poori tarah seedhay raastay per thay , aur unn logon  mein say nahi thay jo Allah ki khudai mein kissi ko shareek mantay hain .

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay sabb say pehla ghar jo logon  ( ki ibadat ) kay liye banaya gaya yaqeeni tor per woh hai jo makkah mein waqay hai ( aur ) bananey kay waqt hi say barkaton wala aur duniya jahan kay logon  kay liye hidayat ka saman hai .
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay sabb say pehla ghar jo logon  ( ki ibadat ) kay liye banaya gaya yaqeeni tor per woh hai jo makkah mein waqay hai ( aur ) bananey kay waqt hi say barkaton wala aur duniya jahan kay logon  kay liye hidayat ka saman hai .

verses.text: uss mein roshan nishaniyan hain , maqam-e-Ibrahim hai , aur jo uss mein dakhil hota hai aman paajata hai . aur logon  mein say jo log uss tak phonchney ki istataat rakhtay hon unn per Allah kay liye uss ghar ka hajj kerna farz hai , aur agar koi inkar keray to Allah duniya jahan kay tamam logon  say bey niaz hai .
verses.translation: uss mein roshan nishaniyan hain , maqam-e-Ibrahim hai , aur jo uss mein dakhil hota hai aman paajata hai . aur logon  mein say jo log uss tak phonchney ki istataat rakhtay hon unn per Allah kay liye uss ghar ka hajj kerna farz hai , aur agar koi inkar keray to Allah duniya jahan kay tamam logon  say bey niaz hai .

verses.text: keh do kay :  aey ehal-e-kitab ! Allah ki aayaton ka kiyon inkar kertay ho-? jo kuch tum kertay ho Allah uss sabb ka gawah hai .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  aey ehal-e-kitab ! Allah ki aayaton ka kiyon inkar kertay ho-? jo kuch tum kertay ho Allah uss sabb ka gawah hai .

verses.text: keh do kay :  aey ehal-e-kitab ! Allah kay raastay mein tairrah peda kernay ki koshish ker kay aik momin kay liye uss mein kiyon rukawat daaltay ho jabkay tum khud haqeeqat-e-haal kay gawah ho-?   jo kuch tum ker rahey ho Allah uss say ghafil nahi hai .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  aey ehal-e-kitab ! Allah kay raastay mein tairrah peda kernay ki koshish ker kay aik momin kay liye uss mein kiyon rukawat daaltay ho jabkay tum khud haqeeqat-e-haal kay gawah ho-?   jo kuch tum ker rahey ho Allah uss say ghafil nahi hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! agar tum ehal-e-kitab kay aik giroh ki baat maan lo gay to woh tumharay emaan laney kay baad tum ko dobara kafir bana ker choren gay .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! agar tum ehal-e-kitab kay aik giroh ki baat maan lo gay to woh tumharay emaan laney kay baad tum ko dobara kafir bana ker choren gay .

verses.text: aur tum kaisay kufr apnao gay jabkay Allah ki aayaten tumharay samney tilawat ki jati hain aur uss ka Rasool tumharay darmiyan mojood hai-? aur ( Allah ki sunnat yeh hai kay ) jo shaks Allah ka sahara mazbooti say thaam ley , woh seedhay raastay tak phoncha diya jata hai .
verses.translation: aur tum kaisay kufr apnao gay jabkay Allah ki aayaten tumharay samney tilawat ki jati hain aur uss ka Rasool tumharay darmiyan mojood hai-? aur ( Allah ki sunnat yeh hai kay ) jo shaks Allah ka sahara mazbooti say thaam ley , woh seedhay raastay tak phoncha diya jata hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! dil mein Allah ka wesa hi khof rakho jaisa khof rakhna uss ka haq hai , aur khabrdar ! tumhen kissi aur halat mein moat naa aaye , balkay issi halat mein aaye kay tum musalman ho .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! dil mein Allah ka wesa hi khof rakho jaisa khof rakhna uss ka haq hai , aur khabrdar ! tumhen kissi aur halat mein moat naa aaye , balkay issi halat mein aaye kay tum musalman ho .

verses.text: aur Allah ki rassi ko sabb milker mazbooti say thamay rakho , aur aapas mein phoot naa daalo , aur Allah ney tum per jo inaam kiya hai ussay yaad rakho kay aik waqt tha jab tum aik doosray kay dushman thay , phir Allah ney tumharay dilon ko jorr diya aur tum Allah kay fazal say bhai bhai ban gaye , aur tum aag kay garrhey kay kinaray per thay , Allah ney tumhen uss say nijat ata farmaee . issi tarah Allah tumharay liye apni nishaniyan khol khol ker wazeh kerta hai , takay tum raah-e-raast per aajao .
verses.translation: aur Allah ki rassi ko sabb milker mazbooti say thamay rakho , aur aapas mein phoot naa daalo , aur Allah ney tum per jo inaam kiya hai ussay yaad rakho kay aik waqt tha jab tum aik doosray kay dushman thay , phir Allah ney tumharay dilon ko jorr diya aur tum Allah kay fazal say bhai bhai ban gaye , aur tum aag kay garrhey kay kinaray per thay , Allah ney tumhen uss say nijat ata farmaee . issi tarah Allah tumharay liye apni nishaniyan khol khol ker wazeh kerta hai , takay tum raah-e-raast per aajao .

verses.text: aur tumharay darmiyan aik jamat aesi honi chahiye jiss kay afrad ( logon  ko ) bhalai ki taraf bulayen , naiki ki talqeen keren , aur burai say roken . aesay hi log hain jo falah paaney walay hain .
verses.translation: aur tumharay darmiyan aik jamat aesi honi chahiye jiss kay afrad ( logon  ko ) bhalai ki taraf bulayen , naiki ki talqeen keren , aur burai say roken . aesay hi log hain jo falah paaney walay hain .

verses.text: aur unn logon  ki tarah naa hojana jinn kay paas khulay khulay dalaeel aa-chukay thay , uss kay baad bhi unhon ney aapas mein phoot daal li aur ikhtilaf mein parr-gaye . aesay logon  ko sakht saza hogi .
verses.translation: aur unn logon  ki tarah naa hojana jinn kay paas khulay khulay dalaeel aa-chukay thay , uss kay baad bhi unhon ney aapas mein phoot daal li aur ikhtilaf mein parr-gaye . aesay logon  ko sakht saza hogi .

verses.text: uss din jab kuch chehray chamaktay hon gay aur kuch chehray siyah parr-jayen gay ! chunacheh jinn logon  kay chehray siyah parr-jayen gay unn say kaha jaye ga kay :  kiya tum ney apney emaan kay baad kufr ikhtiyar kerliya-?   lo phir abb maza chakho iss azab ka , kiyonkay tum kufr kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: uss din jab kuch chehray chamaktay hon gay aur kuch chehray siyah parr-jayen gay ! chunacheh jinn logon  kay chehray siyah parr-jayen gay unn say kaha jaye ga kay :  kiya tum ney apney emaan kay baad kufr ikhtiyar kerliya-?   lo phir abb maza chakho iss azab ka , kiyonkay tum kufr kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: doosri taraf jinn logon  kay chehray chamaktay hon gay woh Allah ki rehmat mein jagah payen gay . woh ussi mein hamesha hamesha rahen gay .
verses.translation: doosri taraf jinn logon  kay chehray chamaktay hon gay woh Allah ki rehmat mein jagah payen gay . woh ussi mein hamesha hamesha rahen gay .

verses.text: yeh Allah ki aayaten hain jo hum tumhen theek theek parh ker suna rahey hain , aur Allah duniya jahan kay logon  per kissi tarah ka zulm kerna nahi chahta
verses.translation: yeh Allah ki aayaten hain jo hum tumhen theek theek parh ker suna rahey hain , aur Allah duniya jahan kay logon  per kissi tarah ka zulm kerna nahi chahta

verses.text: aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , Allah hi ka hai aur ussi ki taraf tamam moamlaat lotaye jayen gay .
verses.translation: aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , Allah hi ka hai aur ussi ki taraf tamam moamlaat lotaye jayen gay .

verses.text: . ( musalmano ! ) tum woh behtareen ummat ho jo logon  kay faeeday kay liye wajood mein laee gaee hai . tum naiki ki talqeen kertay ho , burai say roktay ho aur Allah per emaan rakhtay ho . agar ehal-e-kitab emaan ley aatay to yeh unn kay haq mein kahen behtar hota . unn mein say kuch to momin hain , magar unn ki aksariyat nafarman hai .
verses.translation: . ( musalmano ! ) tum woh behtareen ummat ho jo logon  kay faeeday kay liye wajood mein laee gaee hai . tum naiki ki talqeen kertay ho , burai say roktay ho aur Allah per emaan rakhtay ho . agar ehal-e-kitab emaan ley aatay to yeh unn kay haq mein kahen behtar hota . unn mein say kuch to momin hain , magar unn ki aksariyat nafarman hai .

verses.text: woh thora boht sataney kay siwa tumhen koi bara nuqsan hergiz nahi phoncha saken gay . aur agar woh tum say larren gay bhi to tumhen peeth dikha jayen gay , phir unhen koi madad bhi nahi phonchay gi
verses.translation: woh thora boht sataney kay siwa tumhen koi bara nuqsan hergiz nahi phoncha saken gay . aur agar woh tum say larren gay bhi to tumhen peeth dikha jayen gay , phir unhen koi madad bhi nahi phonchay gi

verses.text: woh jahan kahen paye jayen , unn per zillat ka thappa laga diya gaya hai , illa yeh kay Allah ki taraf say koi sabab peda hojaye ya insanon ki taraf say koi zariya nikal aaye jo unn ko sahara deydey ; anjam kaar woh Allah ka ghazab ley ker lotay hain , aur unn per mohtaji musallat kerdi gaee hai . iss ki wajeh yeh hai kay woh Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kertay thay , aur payghumberon ko nahaq qatal kertay thay . ( neez ) iss ki wajeh yeh hai kay woh nafarmani kertay thay , aur sari haden phalang jaya kertay thay
verses.translation: woh jahan kahen paye jayen , unn per zillat ka thappa laga diya gaya hai , illa yeh kay Allah ki taraf say koi sabab peda hojaye ya insanon ki taraf say koi zariya nikal aaye jo unn ko sahara deydey ; anjam kaar woh Allah ka ghazab ley ker lotay hain , aur unn per mohtaji musallat kerdi gaee hai . iss ki wajeh yeh hai kay woh Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kertay thay , aur payghumberon ko nahaq qatal kertay thay . ( neez ) iss ki wajeh yeh hai kay woh nafarmani kertay thay , aur sari haden phalang jaya kertay thay

verses.text: . ( lekin ) saray ehal-e-kitab aik jaisay nahi hain . ehal-e-kitab hi mein woh log bhi hain jo ( raah-e-raast per ) qaeem hain , jo raat kay oqaat mein Allah ki aayaton ki tilawat kertay hain , aur jo ( Allah kay aagay ) sajda rez hotay hain
verses.translation: . ( lekin ) saray ehal-e-kitab aik jaisay nahi hain . ehal-e-kitab hi mein woh log bhi hain jo ( raah-e-raast per ) qaeem hain , jo raat kay oqaat mein Allah ki aayaton ki tilawat kertay hain , aur jo ( Allah kay aagay ) sajda rez hotay hain

verses.text: yeh log Allah per aur aakhirat kay din per emaan rakhtay hain , achai ki talqeen kertay aur burai say roktay hain , aur naik kamon ki taraf lapaktay hain . yeh woh log hain jinn ka shumar sualeheen mein hai .
verses.translation: yeh log Allah per aur aakhirat kay din per emaan rakhtay hain , achai ki talqeen kertay aur burai say roktay hain , aur naik kamon ki taraf lapaktay hain . yeh woh log hain jinn ka shumar sualeheen mein hai .

verses.text: woh jo bhalai bhi keren gay , uss ki hergiz na-qadri nahi ki jaye gi , aur Allah perhezgaron ko khoob janta hai .
verses.translation: woh jo bhalai bhi keren gay , uss ki hergiz na-qadri nahi ki jaye gi , aur Allah perhezgaron ko khoob janta hai .

verses.text: . ( iss kay bar-aks ) jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , Allah kay muqablay mein naa unn kay maal unn kay kuch kaam ayen gay , naa aulad . woh dozakhi log hain ; ussi mein woh hamesha rahen gay
verses.translation: . ( iss kay bar-aks ) jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , Allah kay muqablay mein naa unn kay maal unn kay kuch kaam ayen gay , naa aulad . woh dozakhi log hain ; ussi mein woh hamesha rahen gay

verses.text: jo kuch yeh log dunyawi zindagi mein kharch kertay hain , uss ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik sakht sardi wali tez huwa ho jo unn logon  ki kheti ko jaa lagay jinhon ney apni janon per zulm ker rakha ho , aur woh iss kheti ko barbad kerday .   unn per Allah ney zulm nahi kiya , balkay woh khud apni janon per zulm kertay rahey hain .
verses.translation: jo kuch yeh log dunyawi zindagi mein kharch kertay hain , uss ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik sakht sardi wali tez huwa ho jo unn logon  ki kheti ko jaa lagay jinhon ney apni janon per zulm ker rakha ho , aur woh iss kheti ko barbad kerday .   unn per Allah ney zulm nahi kiya , balkay woh khud apni janon per zulm kertay rahey hain .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! apney say bahir kay kissi shaks ko raz daar naa banao , yeh log tumhari bad-khuwahi mein koi kasar utha nahi rakhtay .   unn ki dili khuwaish yeh hai kay tum takleef uthao . bughz unn kay mun say zahir hochuka hai , aur jo kuch ( adawat ) unn kay seenay chupaye huye hain woh kahen ziyada hai . hum ney pattay ki baaten tumhen khol khol ker bata di hain , ba-shartey-kay tum samajh say kaam lo .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! apney say bahir kay kissi shaks ko raz daar naa banao , yeh log tumhari bad-khuwahi mein koi kasar utha nahi rakhtay .   unn ki dili khuwaish yeh hai kay tum takleef uthao . bughz unn kay mun say zahir hochuka hai , aur jo kuch ( adawat ) unn kay seenay chupaye huye hain woh kahen ziyada hai . hum ney pattay ki baaten tumhen khol khol ker bata di hain , ba-shartey-kay tum samajh say kaam lo .

verses.text: dekho ! tum to aesay ho kay unn say mohabbat rakhtay ho , magar woh tum say mohabbat nahi rakhtay , aur tum to tamam ( aasmani ) kitabon per emaan rakhtay ho , aur ( unn ka haal yeh hai kay ) woh jab tum say miltay hain to kehtay hain kay hum ( Quran per ) emaan ley aaye , aur jab tanhai mein jatay hain to tumharay khilaf ghussay kay maaray apni ungliyan chabatay hain . ( unn say ) keh do kay  apney ghussay mein khud mar raho . Allah seenon mein chupi hoi baaten khoob janta hai .
verses.translation: dekho ! tum to aesay ho kay unn say mohabbat rakhtay ho , magar woh tum say mohabbat nahi rakhtay , aur tum to tamam ( aasmani ) kitabon per emaan rakhtay ho , aur ( unn ka haal yeh hai kay ) woh jab tum say miltay hain to kehtay hain kay hum ( Quran per ) emaan ley aaye , aur jab tanhai mein jatay hain to tumharay khilaf ghussay kay maaray apni ungliyan chabatay hain . ( unn say ) keh do kay  apney ghussay mein khud mar raho . Allah seenon mein chupi hoi baaten khoob janta hai .

verses.text: agar tumhen koi bhalai mil jaye to unn ko bura lagta hai , aur agar tumhen koi gazand phonchay to yeh uss say khush hotay hain . agar tum sabar aur taqwa say kaam lo to unn ki chaalen tumhen koi nuqsan nahi phonchayen gi . jo kuch yeh ker rahey hain woh sabb Allah kay ( ilm aur qudrat kay ) ehatay mein hai .
verses.translation: agar tumhen koi bhalai mil jaye to unn ko bura lagta hai , aur agar tumhen koi gazand phonchay to yeh uss say khush hotay hain . agar tum sabar aur taqwa say kaam lo to unn ki chaalen tumhen koi nuqsan nahi phonchayen gi . jo kuch yeh ker rahey hain woh sabb Allah kay ( ilm aur qudrat kay ) ehatay mein hai .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! Jang-e-ohad ka woh waqt yaad kero ) jab tum subha kay waqt apney ghar say nikal ker musalmanon ko jang kay thikanon per jama rahey thay ,   aur Allah sabb kuch sunney janney wala hai
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! Jang-e-ohad ka woh waqt yaad kero ) jab tum subha kay waqt apney ghar say nikal ker musalmanon ko jang kay thikanon per jama rahey thay ,   aur Allah sabb kuch sunney janney wala hai

verses.text: jab tumhi mein kay do girohon ney yeh socha tha kay woh himmat haar bethen ,   halankay Allah unn ka haami o nasir tha , aur mominon ko Allah hi per bharosa rakhna chahiye .
verses.translation: jab tumhi mein kay do girohon ney yeh socha tha kay woh himmat haar bethen ,   halankay Allah unn ka haami o nasir tha , aur mominon ko Allah hi per bharosa rakhna chahiye .

verses.text: Allah ney to ( jang ) badar kay moaqa per aesi halat mein tumhari madad ki thi jab tum bilkul bey sar-o-saman thay .   lehaza ( sirf ) Allah ka khof dil mein rakho , takay tum shukar guzaar ban sako .
verses.translation: Allah ney to ( jang ) badar kay moaqa per aesi halat mein tumhari madad ki thi jab tum bilkul bey sar-o-saman thay .   lehaza ( sirf ) Allah ka khof dil mein rakho , takay tum shukar guzaar ban sako .

verses.text: jab ( badar ki jang mein ) tum mominon say keh rahey thay kay :  kiya tumharay liye yeh baat kafi nahi hai kay tumhara perwerdigar teen hazar farishtay utaar ker tumhari madad ko bhej dey ?
verses.translation: jab ( badar ki jang mein ) tum mominon say keh rahey thay kay :  kiya tumharay liye yeh baat kafi nahi hai kay tumhara perwerdigar teen hazar farishtay utaar ker tumhari madad ko bhej dey ?

verses.text: haan ! balkay agar tum sabar aur taqwa ikhtiyar kero aur woh log apney ussi relay mein achanak tum tak phonch jayen to tumhara perwerdigar paanch hazar farishtay tumhari madad ko bhej dey ga jinhon ney apni pehchan numaya ki hoi hogi .
