verses.text: phir yeh unn ki ehad shikni hi to thi jiss ki wajeh say hum ney unn ko apni rehmat say door kiya , aur unn kay dilon ko sakht bana diya . woh baaton ko apney moaqa mehal say hata detay hain . aur jiss baat ki unn ko naseehat ki gaee thi uss ka aik bara hissa bhula chukay hain , aur unn mein say kuch logon  ko chorr ker tumhen aaye din unn ki kissi naa kissi khayanat ka pata chalta rehta hai . lehaza ( filhal ) unhen moaaf kerdo aur darguzar say kaam lo .   beyshak Allah ehsan kernay walon ko pasand kerta hai
verses.translation: phir yeh unn ki ehad shikni hi to thi jiss ki wajeh say hum ney unn ko apni rehmat say door kiya , aur unn kay dilon ko sakht bana diya . woh baaton ko apney moaqa mehal say hata detay hain . aur jiss baat ki unn ko naseehat ki gaee thi uss ka aik bara hissa bhula chukay hain , aur unn mein say kuch logon  ko chorr ker tumhen aaye din unn ki kissi naa kissi khayanat ka pata chalta rehta hai . lehaza ( filhal ) unhen moaaf kerdo aur darguzar say kaam lo .   beyshak Allah ehsan kernay walon ko pasand kerta hai

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney kaha tha kay hum nasrani hain , unn say ( bhi ) hum ney ehad liya tha , phir jiss cheez ki unn ko naseehat ki gaee thi , uss ka aik bara hissa woh ( bhi ) bhula bethay . chunacheh hum ney unn kay darmiyan qayamat kay din tak kay liye dushmani aur bughz peda kerdiya .   aur Allah unhen unqareeb bata dey ga kay woh kiya kuch kertay rahey hain .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kaha tha kay hum nasrani hain , unn say ( bhi ) hum ney ehad liya tha , phir jiss cheez ki unn ko naseehat ki gaee thi , uss ka aik bara hissa woh ( bhi ) bhula bethay . chunacheh hum ney unn kay darmiyan qayamat kay din tak kay liye dushmani aur bughz peda kerdiya .   aur Allah unhen unqareeb bata dey ga kay woh kiya kuch kertay rahey hain .

verses.text: aey ehal-e-kitab ! tumharay paas humaray ( yeh ) payghumber aagaye hain jo kitab ( yani toraat aur injeel ) ki boht si unn baaton ko khol khol ker biyan kertay hain jo tum chupaya kertay ho , aur boht si baaton say darguzar ker jatay hain .   tumharay paas Allah ki taraf say aik roshni aai hai , aur aik aesi kitab jo haq ko wazeh ker-denay wali hai .
verses.translation: aey ehal-e-kitab ! tumharay paas humaray ( yeh ) payghumber aagaye hain jo kitab ( yani toraat aur injeel ) ki boht si unn baaton ko khol khol ker biyan kertay hain jo tum chupaya kertay ho , aur boht si baaton say darguzar ker jatay hain .   tumharay paas Allah ki taraf say aik roshni aai hai , aur aik aesi kitab jo haq ko wazeh ker-denay wali hai .

verses.text: jiss kay zariye Allah unn logon  ko salamti ki raahen dikhata hai jo uss ki khushnoodi kay talib hain , aur unhen apney hukum say andheriyon say nikal ker roshni ki taraf lata hai , aur unhen seedhay raastay ki hidayat ata farmata hai .
verses.translation: jiss kay zariye Allah unn logon  ko salamti ki raahen dikhata hai jo uss ki khushnoodi kay talib hain , aur unhen apney hukum say andheriyon say nikal ker roshni ki taraf lata hai , aur unhen seedhay raastay ki hidayat ata farmata hai .

verses.text: jinn logon  ney yeh kaha hai kay Allah hi maseeh ibn-e-maryam hai , woh yaqeenan kafir hogaye hain . ( aey nabi ! unn say ) keh do kay agar Allah maseeh ibn-e-maryam ko aur unn ki maa ko aur zameen mein jitney log hain unn sabb ko halak kerna chahye to kon hai jo Allah kay muqablay mein kuch kernay ki zara bhi taqat rakhta ho-? tamam aasmano aur zameen per aur unn kay darmiyan jo kuch mojood hai uss per tanha milkiyat Allah hi ki hai . woh jo cheez chahta hai peda kerta hai . aur Allah her cheez per poori poori qudrat rakhta hai .
verses.translation: jinn logon  ney yeh kaha hai kay Allah hi maseeh ibn-e-maryam hai , woh yaqeenan kafir hogaye hain . ( aey nabi ! unn say ) keh do kay agar Allah maseeh ibn-e-maryam ko aur unn ki maa ko aur zameen mein jitney log hain unn sabb ko halak kerna chahye to kon hai jo Allah kay muqablay mein kuch kernay ki zara bhi taqat rakhta ho-? tamam aasmano aur zameen per aur unn kay darmiyan jo kuch mojood hai uss per tanha milkiyat Allah hi ki hai . woh jo cheez chahta hai peda kerta hai . aur Allah her cheez per poori poori qudrat rakhta hai .

verses.text: yahood o nasara kehtay hain kay  hum Allah kay betay aur uss kay chaeetay hain  ( unn say ) kaho kay  phir Allah tumharay gunahon ki wajeh say tumhen saza kiyon deta hai-?   nahi ! balkay tum unhi insanon ki tarah insan ho jo uss ney peda kiye hain . woh jiss ko chahta hai bakhsh deta hai aur jiss ko chahta hai azab deta hai . aasmano aur zameen per aur unn kay darmiyan jo kuch mojood hai uss per tanha milkiyat Allah hi ki hai , aur ussi ki taraf ( sabb ko ) loat ker jana hai .
verses.translation: yahood o nasara kehtay hain kay  hum Allah kay betay aur uss kay chaeetay hain  ( unn say ) kaho kay  phir Allah tumharay gunahon ki wajeh say tumhen saza kiyon deta hai-?   nahi ! balkay tum unhi insanon ki tarah insan ho jo uss ney peda kiye hain . woh jiss ko chahta hai bakhsh deta hai aur jiss ko chahta hai azab deta hai . aasmano aur zameen per aur unn kay darmiyan jo kuch mojood hai uss per tanha milkiyat Allah hi ki hai , aur ussi ki taraf ( sabb ko ) loat ker jana hai .

verses.text: aey ehal-e-kitab ! tumharay paas humaray payghumber aesay waqt deen ki wazahat kernay aaye hain jab payghumberon ki aamad ruki hoi thi , takay tum yeh naa keh sako kay humaray paas naa koi ( jannat ki ) khushkhabri denay wala aaya , naa koi ( jahannum say ) daraney wala . lo abb tumharay paas khushkhabri denay wala aur daraney wala aagaya hai . aur Allah her baat per poori poori qudrat rakhta hai .
verses.translation: aey ehal-e-kitab ! tumharay paas humaray payghumber aesay waqt deen ki wazahat kernay aaye hain jab payghumberon ki aamad ruki hoi thi , takay tum yeh naa keh sako kay humaray paas naa koi ( jannat ki ) khushkhabri denay wala aaya , naa koi ( jahannum say ) daraney wala . lo abb tumharay paas khushkhabri denay wala aur daraney wala aagaya hai . aur Allah her baat per poori poori qudrat rakhta hai .

verses.text: aur uss waqt ka dhiyan kero jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay  aey meri qoam ! Allah ki uss naimat ko yaad kero jo uss ney tum per nazil farmaee hai kay uss ney tum mein nabi peda kiye , tumhen hukmran banaya , aur tumhen woh kuch ata kiya jo tum say pehlay duniya jahan kay kissi fard ko ata nahi kiya tha .
verses.translation: aur uss waqt ka dhiyan kero jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay  aey meri qoam ! Allah ki uss naimat ko yaad kero jo uss ney tum per nazil farmaee hai kay uss ney tum mein nabi peda kiye , tumhen hukmran banaya , aur tumhen woh kuch ata kiya jo tum say pehlay duniya jahan kay kissi fard ko ata nahi kiya tha .

verses.text: aey meri qoam ! uss muqaddas sarzameen mein dakhil hojao jo Allah ney tumharay wastay likh di hai ,   aur apni pusht kay ball peechay naa loto , werna palat ker na-murad jao gay .
verses.translation: aey meri qoam ! uss muqaddas sarzameen mein dakhil hojao jo Allah ney tumharay wastay likh di hai ,   aur apni pusht kay ball peechay naa loto , werna palat ker na-murad jao gay .

verses.text: woh bolay ,  aey musa ! uss ( mulk ) mein to baray taqatwar log rehtay hain , aur jab tak woh log wahan say nikal naa jayen , hum hergiz uss mein dakhil nahi hon gay . haan agar woh wahan say nikal jayen to beyshak hum uss mein dakhil hojayen gay .
verses.translation: woh bolay ,  aey musa ! uss ( mulk ) mein to baray taqatwar log rehtay hain , aur jab tak woh log wahan say nikal naa jayen , hum hergiz uss mein dakhil nahi hon gay . haan agar woh wahan say nikal jayen to beyshak hum uss mein dakhil hojayen gay .

verses.text: jo log ( khuda ka ) khof rakhtay thay , unn mein say do mard jinn ko Allah ney apney fazal say nawaza tha ,   bol uthay kay  tum unn per charrhai ker kay ( shehar kay ) darwazay mein ghuss to jao . jab ghuss jao gay to tum hi ghalib raho gay . aur apna bharosa sirf Allah per rakho , agar tum waqaee sahab-e-emaan ho .
verses.translation: jo log ( khuda ka ) khof rakhtay thay , unn mein say do mard jinn ko Allah ney apney fazal say nawaza tha ,   bol uthay kay  tum unn per charrhai ker kay ( shehar kay ) darwazay mein ghuss to jao . jab ghuss jao gay to tum hi ghalib raho gay . aur apna bharosa sirf Allah per rakho , agar tum waqaee sahab-e-emaan ho .

verses.text: woh kehney lagay  aey musa ! jab tak woh log uss ( mulk ) mein mojood hain , hum hergiz hergiz uss mein qadam nahi rakhen gay . ( agar unn say larrna hai to ) bus tum aur tumhara rab chalay jao , aur unn say larro , hum to yahin bethay hain .
verses.translation: woh kehney lagay  aey musa ! jab tak woh log uss ( mulk ) mein mojood hain , hum hergiz hergiz uss mein qadam nahi rakhen gay . ( agar unn say larrna hai to ) bus tum aur tumhara rab chalay jao , aur unn say larro , hum to yahin bethay hain .

verses.text: musa ney kaha  aey meray perwerdigar ! siwaye meri apni jaan kay aur meray bhai kay koi meray qaboo mein nahi hai . abb aap humaray aur inn nafarman logon  kay darmiyan alag alag faisla ker-dijiye .
verses.translation: musa ney kaha  aey meray perwerdigar ! siwaye meri apni jaan kay aur meray bhai kay koi meray qaboo mein nahi hai . abb aap humaray aur inn nafarman logon  kay darmiyan alag alag faisla ker-dijiye .

verses.text: Allah ney kaha  acha ! to woh sarzameen inn per chaalees saal tak haram kerdi gaee hai , yeh ( iss doran ) zameen mein bhataktay phiren gay .   to ( aey musa ! ) abb tum bhi inn nafarman logon  per taras matt khana .
verses.translation: Allah ney kaha  acha ! to woh sarzameen inn per chaalees saal tak haram kerdi gaee hai , yeh ( iss doran ) zameen mein bhataktay phiren gay .   to ( aey musa ! ) abb tum bhi inn nafarman logon  per taras matt khana .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn kay samney Adam kay do beton ka waqiaa theek theek parh ker sunao . jab dono ney aik aik qurbani paish ki thi , aur unn mein say aik ki qurbani qubool hogaee , aur doosray ki qubool naa hoi .   uss ( doosray ney pehlay say ) kaha kay  mein tujhay qatal ker daalun ga .  pehlay ney kaha kay  Allah to unn logon  say ( qurbani ) qubool kerta hai jo muttaqi hon .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn kay samney Adam kay do beton ka waqiaa theek theek parh ker sunao . jab dono ney aik aik qurbani paish ki thi , aur unn mein say aik ki qurbani qubool hogaee , aur doosray ki qubool naa hoi .   uss ( doosray ney pehlay say ) kaha kay  mein tujhay qatal ker daalun ga .  pehlay ney kaha kay  Allah to unn logon  say ( qurbani ) qubool kerta hai jo muttaqi hon .

verses.text: agar tum ney mujhay qatal kernay ko apna haath barhaya tab bhi mein tumhen qatal kernay ko apna haath nahi barhaon ga . mein to Allah Rabb-ul-Aalameen say darta hun .
verses.translation: agar tum ney mujhay qatal kernay ko apna haath barhaya tab bhi mein tumhen qatal kernay ko apna haath nahi barhaon ga . mein to Allah Rabb-ul-Aalameen say darta hun .

verses.text: mein to yeh chahta hun kay anjam kaar tum apney aur meray dono kay gunah mein pakray jao ,   aur dozakhiyon mein shamil ho . aur yehi zalimon ki saza hai .
verses.translation: mein to yeh chahta hun kay anjam kaar tum apney aur meray dono kay gunah mein pakray jao ,   aur dozakhiyon mein shamil ho . aur yehi zalimon ki saza hai .

verses.text: aakhir kaar uss kay nafs ney uss ko apney bhai kay qatal per aamada kerliya , chunacheh uss ney apney bhai ko qatal ker daala , aur na-muradon mein shamil hogaya .
verses.translation: aakhir kaar uss kay nafs ney uss ko apney bhai kay qatal per aamada kerliya , chunacheh uss ney apney bhai ko qatal ker daala , aur na-muradon mein shamil hogaya .

verses.text: phir Allah ney aik kawwa bheja jo zameen khodney laga takay ussay dikhaye kay woh apney bhai ki laash kaisay chupaye .   ( yeh dekh ker ) woh bola  haaye afsos ! kiya mein iss kawway jaisa bhi naa hosaka kay apney bhai ki laash chupa deta .  iss tarah baad mein woh bara sharminda huwa .
verses.translation: phir Allah ney aik kawwa bheja jo zameen khodney laga takay ussay dikhaye kay woh apney bhai ki laash kaisay chupaye .   ( yeh dekh ker ) woh bola  haaye afsos ! kiya mein iss kawway jaisa bhi naa hosaka kay apney bhai ki laash chupa deta .  iss tarah baad mein woh bara sharminda huwa .

verses.text: issi wajeh say hum ney bani Israel ko yeh farman likh diya tha kay jo koi kissi ko qatal keray , jabkay yeh qatal naa kissi aur jaan ka badla lenay kay liye ho aur naa kissi kay zameen mein fasad phelaney ki wajeh say ho , to yeh aisa hai jaisay uss ney tamam insanon ko qatal kerdiya ,   aur jo shaks kissi ki jaan bachaley to yeh aisa hai jaisay uss ney tamam insanon ki jaan bachali . aur waqiaa yeh hai kay humaray payghumber inn kay paas khuli khuli hidayaat ley ker aaye , magar uss kay baad bhi unn mein say boht say log zameen mein ziyadtiyan hi kertay rahey hain .
verses.translation: issi wajeh say hum ney bani Israel ko yeh farman likh diya tha kay jo koi kissi ko qatal keray , jabkay yeh qatal naa kissi aur jaan ka badla lenay kay liye ho aur naa kissi kay zameen mein fasad phelaney ki wajeh say ho , to yeh aisa hai jaisay uss ney tamam insanon ko qatal kerdiya ,   aur jo shaks kissi ki jaan bachaley to yeh aisa hai jaisay uss ney tamam insanon ki jaan bachali . aur waqiaa yeh hai kay humaray payghumber inn kay paas khuli khuli hidayaat ley ker aaye , magar uss kay baad bhi unn mein say boht say log zameen mein ziyadtiyan hi kertay rahey hain .

verses.text: jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool say larraee kertay aur zameen mein fasad machatay phirtay hain , unn ki saza yehi hai kay unhen qatal kerdiya jaye , ya sooli per charha diya jaye , ya unn kay haath paon mukhalif samton say kaat daalay jayen ,   ya unhen zameen say door kerdiya jaye .   yeh to duniya mein unn ki ruswai hai , aur aakhirat mein unn kay liye zabardast azab hai .
verses.translation: jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool say larraee kertay aur zameen mein fasad machatay phirtay hain , unn ki saza yehi hai kay unhen qatal kerdiya jaye , ya sooli per charha diya jaye , ya unn kay haath paon mukhalif samton say kaat daalay jayen ,   ya unhen zameen say door kerdiya jaye .   yeh to duniya mein unn ki ruswai hai , aur aakhirat mein unn kay liye zabardast azab hai .

verses.text: haan woh log iss say mustasna hain jo tumharay unn ko qaboo mein laney say pehlay hi tauba kerlen .   aesi soorat mein yeh jaan rakho kay Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: haan woh log iss say mustasna hain jo tumharay unn ko qaboo mein laney say pehlay hi tauba kerlen .   aesi soorat mein yeh jaan rakho kay Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah say daro , aur uss tak phonchney kay liye waseela talash kero ,   aur uss kay raastay mein jihad kero .   umeed hai kay tumhen falah hasil hogi .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah say daro , aur uss tak phonchney kay liye waseela talash kero ,   aur uss kay raastay mein jihad kero .   umeed hai kay tumhen falah hasil hogi .

verses.text: yaqeen rakho kay jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , agar zameen mein jitni cheezen hain woh sabb unn kay paas hon , aur itni hi aur bhi hon , takay woh qayamat kay din kay azab say bachtay kay liye woh sabb fidya mein paish kerden , tab bhi unn ki yeh paishkash qubool nahi ki jaye gi , aur unn ko dardnak azab hoga .
verses.translation: yaqeen rakho kay jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , agar zameen mein jitni cheezen hain woh sabb unn kay paas hon , aur itni hi aur bhi hon , takay woh qayamat kay din kay azab say bachtay kay liye woh sabb fidya mein paish kerden , tab bhi unn ki yeh paishkash qubool nahi ki jaye gi , aur unn ko dardnak azab hoga .

verses.text: woh chahen gay kay aag say nikal jayen , halankay woh uss say nikalney walay nahi hain , aur unn ko aisa azab hoga jo qaeem rahey ga .
verses.translation: woh chahen gay kay aag say nikal jayen , halankay woh uss say nikalney walay nahi hain , aur unn ko aisa azab hoga jo qaeem rahey ga .

verses.text: aur jo mard chori keray aur jo aurat chori keray , dono kay haath kaat do , takay unn ko apney kiye ka badla milay , aur Allah ki taraf say ibrat naak saza ho . aur Allah sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , sahab-e-hikmat bhi
verses.translation: aur jo mard chori keray aur jo aurat chori keray , dono kay haath kaat do , takay unn ko apney kiye ka badla milay , aur Allah ki taraf say ibrat naak saza ho . aur Allah sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , sahab-e-hikmat bhi

verses.text: phir jo shaks apni zalimana kaarawai say tauba kerlay , aur moamlaat durust kerlay , to Allah uss ki tauba qubool kerlay ga .   beyshak Allah taalaa boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: phir jo shaks apni zalimana kaarawai say tauba kerlay , aur moamlaat durust kerlay , to Allah uss ki tauba qubool kerlay ga .   beyshak Allah taalaa boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: kiya tum nahi jantay kay aasmano aur zameen ki hukmrani sirf Allah kay paas hai-? woh jiss ko chahye azab dey , aur jiss ko chahye bakhsh dey , aur Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai .
verses.translation: kiya tum nahi jantay kay aasmano aur zameen ki hukmrani sirf Allah kay paas hai-? woh jiss ko chahye azab dey , aur jiss ko chahye bakhsh dey , aur Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai .

verses.text: aey payghumber ! jo log kufr mein bari tezi dikha rahey hain , woh tumhen ghum mein mubtala naa keren ,   yani aik to woh log hain jinhon ney zaban say to keh diya hai kay hum emaan ley aaye hain , magar unn kay dil emaan nahi laye , aur doosray woh log hain jinhon ney ( khulay bandon ) yahoodiyat ka deen ikhtiyar kerliya hai . yeh log jhooti baaten kaan laga laga ker sunney walay hain ,   ( aur tumhari baaten ) unn logon  ki khatir suntay hain jo tumharay paas nahi aaye ,   jo ( Allah ki kitab kay ) alfaz ka moaqa mehal tey hojaney kay baad bhi unn mein tehreef kertay hain . kehtay hain kay agar tumhen yeh hukum diya jaye to iss ko qubool kerlena , aur agar yeh hukum naa diya jaye to bach ker rehna . aur jiss shaks ko Allah fitney mein daalney ka irada kerlay to ussay Allah say bachaney kay liye tumhara koi zor hergiz nahi chal sakta . yeh woh log hain kay ( unn ki nafarmani ki wajeh say ) Allah ney unn kay dilon ko pak kernay ka irada nahi kiya .   unn kay liye duniya mein ruswai hai , aur unhi kay liye aakhirat mein zabardast azab hai .
verses.translation: aey payghumber ! jo log kufr mein bari tezi dikha rahey hain , woh tumhen ghum mein mubtala naa keren ,   yani aik to woh log hain jinhon ney zaban say to keh diya hai kay hum emaan ley aaye hain , magar unn kay dil emaan nahi laye , aur doosray woh log hain jinhon ney ( khulay bandon ) yahoodiyat ka deen ikhtiyar kerliya hai . yeh log jhooti baaten kaan laga laga ker sunney walay hain ,   ( aur tumhari baaten ) unn logon  ki khatir suntay hain jo tumharay paas nahi aaye ,   jo ( Allah ki kitab kay ) alfaz ka moaqa mehal tey hojaney kay baad bhi unn mein tehreef kertay hain . kehtay hain kay agar tumhen yeh hukum diya jaye to iss ko qubool kerlena , aur agar yeh hukum naa diya jaye to bach ker rehna . aur jiss shaks ko Allah fitney mein daalney ka irada kerlay to ussay Allah say bachaney kay liye tumhara koi zor hergiz nahi chal sakta . yeh woh log hain kay ( unn ki nafarmani ki wajeh say ) Allah ney unn kay dilon ko pak kernay ka irada nahi kiya .   unn kay liye duniya mein ruswai hai , aur unhi kay liye aakhirat mein zabardast azab hai .

verses.text: yeh kaan laga laga ker jhooti baaten sunney walay , ji bhar bhar ker haram khaney walay hain .   chunacheh agar yeh tumharay paas ayen to chahye inn kay darmiyan faisla kerdo , aur chahye inn say mun morr lo .   agar tum inn say mun morr lo gay to yeh tumhen koi nuqsan nahi phoncha saken gay , aur agar faisla kerna ho to insaf say faisla kero . yaqeenan Allah insaf kernay walon say mohabbat kerta hai .
verses.translation: yeh kaan laga laga ker jhooti baaten sunney walay , ji bhar bhar ker haram khaney walay hain .   chunacheh agar yeh tumharay paas ayen to chahye inn kay darmiyan faisla kerdo , aur chahye inn say mun morr lo .   agar tum inn say mun morr lo gay to yeh tumhen koi nuqsan nahi phoncha saken gay , aur agar faisla kerna ho to insaf say faisla kero . yaqeenan Allah insaf kernay walon say mohabbat kerta hai .

verses.text: aur yeh kaisay tum say faisla lena chahtay hain jabkay inn kay paas toraat mojood hai jiss mein Allah ka faisla darj hai-? phir uss kay baad ( faislay say ) mun bhi pher letay hain .   darasal yeh emaan walay nahi hain .
verses.translation: aur yeh kaisay tum say faisla lena chahtay hain jabkay inn kay paas toraat mojood hai jiss mein Allah ka faisla darj hai-? phir uss kay baad ( faislay say ) mun bhi pher letay hain .   darasal yeh emaan walay nahi hain .

verses.text: beyshak hum ney toraat nazil ki thi jiss mein hidayat thi aur noor tha . tamam nabi jo Allah taalaa kay farmanbardaar thay , issi kay mutabiq yahudiyon kay moamlaat ka faisla kertay thay , aur tamam Allah walay aur ulama bhi ( issi per amal kertay rahey ) kiyonkay unn ko Allah ki kitab ka mohafiz banaya gaya tha , aur woh uss kay gawah thay . lehaza ( aey yahudiyo ! ) tum logon  say naa daro , aur mujh say daro , aur thori si qeemat lenay ki khatir meri aayaton ka soda naa kiya kero . aur jo log Allah kay nazil kiye huye hukum kay mutabiq faisla naa keren , woh log kafir hain .
verses.translation: beyshak hum ney toraat nazil ki thi jiss mein hidayat thi aur noor tha . tamam nabi jo Allah taalaa kay farmanbardaar thay , issi kay mutabiq yahudiyon kay moamlaat ka faisla kertay thay , aur tamam Allah walay aur ulama bhi ( issi per amal kertay rahey ) kiyonkay unn ko Allah ki kitab ka mohafiz banaya gaya tha , aur woh uss kay gawah thay . lehaza ( aey yahudiyo ! ) tum logon  say naa daro , aur mujh say daro , aur thori si qeemat lenay ki khatir meri aayaton ka soda naa kiya kero . aur jo log Allah kay nazil kiye huye hukum kay mutabiq faisla naa keren , woh log kafir hain .

verses.text: aur hum ney iss ( toraat mein ) unn kay liye yeh hukum likh diya tha kay jaan kay badlay jaan , aankh kay badlay aankh , naak kay badlay naak , kaan kay badlay kaan , daant kay badlay daant . aur zakhmo ka bhi ( issi tarah ) badla liya jaye . haan jo shaks iss ( badlay ) ko moaaf kerday to yeh uss kay liye gunahon ka kaffara hojaye ga . aur jo log Allah kay nazil kiye huye hukum kay mutabiq faisla naa keren , woh log zalim hain .
verses.translation: aur hum ney iss ( toraat mein ) unn kay liye yeh hukum likh diya tha kay jaan kay badlay jaan , aankh kay badlay aankh , naak kay badlay naak , kaan kay badlay kaan , daant kay badlay daant . aur zakhmo ka bhi ( issi tarah ) badla liya jaye . haan jo shaks iss ( badlay ) ko moaaf kerday to yeh uss kay liye gunahon ka kaffara hojaye ga . aur jo log Allah kay nazil kiye huye hukum kay mutabiq faisla naa keren , woh log zalim hain .

verses.text: aur hum ney unn ( payghumberon ) kay baad essa ibn-e-maryam ko apney say pehli kitab yani toraat ki tasdeeq kernay wala bana ker bheja , aur hum ney unn ko injeel ata ki jiss mein hidayat thi aur noor tha , aur jo apney say pehli kitab yani toraat ki tasdeeq kernay wali aur muttaqiyo kay liye sarapa hidayat o naseehat ban ker aai thi .
verses.translation: aur hum ney unn ( payghumberon ) kay baad essa ibn-e-maryam ko apney say pehli kitab yani toraat ki tasdeeq kernay wala bana ker bheja , aur hum ney unn ko injeel ata ki jiss mein hidayat thi aur noor tha , aur jo apney say pehli kitab yani toraat ki tasdeeq kernay wali aur muttaqiyo kay liye sarapa hidayat o naseehat ban ker aai thi .

verses.text: aur injeel walon ko chahiye kay Allah ney uss mein jo kuch nazil kiya hai , uss kay mutabiq faisla keren , aur jo log Allah kay nazil kiye huye hukum kay mutabiq faisla naa keren , woh log fasiq hain .
verses.translation: aur injeel walon ko chahiye kay Allah ney uss mein jo kuch nazil kiya hai , uss kay mutabiq faisla keren , aur jo log Allah kay nazil kiye huye hukum kay mutabiq faisla naa keren , woh log fasiq hain .

verses.text: aur ( aey Rasool Muhammad ! SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) hum ney tum per bhi haq per mushtamil kitab nazil ki hai jo apney say pehli kitabon ki tasdeeq kerti hai aur unn ki nigehban hai . lehaza inn logon  kay darmiyan ussi hukum kay mutabiq faisla kero jo Allah ney nazil kiya hai , aur jo haq baat tumharay paas aagae hai ussay chorr ker unn ki khuwaishaat kay peechay naa chalo . tum mein say her aik ( ummat ) kay liye hum ney aik ( alag ) shariyat aur tareeqa muqarrar kiya hai .   aur agar Allah chahta to tum sabb ko aik ummat bana deta , lekin ( alag shariyaten iss liye den ) takay jo kuch uss ney tumhen diya hai uss mein tumhen aazamaye . lehaza naikiyon mein aik doosray say aagay barhney ki koshish kero . Allah hi ki taraf tum sabb ko loat ker jana hai . uss waqt woh tumhen woh baaten bataye ga jinn mein tum ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: aur ( aey Rasool Muhammad ! SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) hum ney tum per bhi haq per mushtamil kitab nazil ki hai jo apney say pehli kitabon ki tasdeeq kerti hai aur unn ki nigehban hai . lehaza inn logon  kay darmiyan ussi hukum kay mutabiq faisla kero jo Allah ney nazil kiya hai , aur jo haq baat tumharay paas aagae hai ussay chorr ker unn ki khuwaishaat kay peechay naa chalo . tum mein say her aik ( ummat ) kay liye hum ney aik ( alag ) shariyat aur tareeqa muqarrar kiya hai .   aur agar Allah chahta to tum sabb ko aik ummat bana deta , lekin ( alag shariyaten iss liye den ) takay jo kuch uss ney tumhen diya hai uss mein tumhen aazamaye . lehaza naikiyon mein aik doosray say aagay barhney ki koshish kero . Allah hi ki taraf tum sabb ko loat ker jana hai . uss waqt woh tumhen woh baaten bataye ga jinn mein tum ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: aur ( hum hukum detay hain ) kay tum inn logon  kay darmiyan ussi hukum kay mutabiq faisla kero jo Allah ney nazil kiya hai   aur unn ki khuwaishaat ki perwi naa kero , aur unn ki iss baat say bach ker raho kay woh tumhen fitney mein daal ker kissi aesay hukum say hata den jo Allah ney tum per nazil kiya ho . iss per agar woh mun morren to jaan rakho kay Allah ney unn kay baaz gunahon ki wajeh say unn ko museebat mein mubtala kernay ka irada ker rakha hai .   aur inn logon  mein say boht say fasiq hain .
verses.translation: aur ( hum hukum detay hain ) kay tum inn logon  kay darmiyan ussi hukum kay mutabiq faisla kero jo Allah ney nazil kiya hai   aur unn ki khuwaishaat ki perwi naa kero , aur unn ki iss baat say bach ker raho kay woh tumhen fitney mein daal ker kissi aesay hukum say hata den jo Allah ney tum per nazil kiya ho . iss per agar woh mun morren to jaan rakho kay Allah ney unn kay baaz gunahon ki wajeh say unn ko museebat mein mubtala kernay ka irada ker rakha hai .   aur inn logon  mein say boht say fasiq hain .

verses.text: bhala kiya yeh jahiliyat ka faisla hasil kerna chahtay hain-? halankay jo log yaqeen rakhtay hon unn kay liye Allah say acha faisla kernay wala kon hosakta hai ?
verses.translation: bhala kiya yeh jahiliyat ka faisla hasil kerna chahtay hain-? halankay jo log yaqeen rakhtay hon unn kay liye Allah say acha faisla kernay wala kon hosakta hai ?

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! yahudiyon aur nasraniyon ko yaar-o-madadgaar naa banao .   yeh khud hi aik doosray kay yaar-o-madadgaar hain . aur tum mein say jo shaks inn ki dosti ka dum bharay ga to phir woh inhi mein say hoga . yaqeenan Allah zalim logon  ko hidayat nahi deta .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! yahudiyon aur nasraniyon ko yaar-o-madadgaar naa banao .   yeh khud hi aik doosray kay yaar-o-madadgaar hain . aur tum mein say jo shaks inn ki dosti ka dum bharay ga to phir woh inhi mein say hoga . yaqeenan Allah zalim logon  ko hidayat nahi deta .

verses.text: chunacheh jinn logon  kay dilon mein ( nifaq ka ) rog hai , tum unhen dekhtay ho kay woh lapak lapak ker unn mein ghustay hain , kehtay hain :  hamen darr hai kay hum per koi museebat ka chakkar aa-parey ga    ( lekin ) kuch baeed nahi kay Allah ( musalmanon ko ) fatah ata farmaye ya apni taraf say koi aur baat zahir kerday ,   aur uss waqt yeh log uss baat per pachtayen jo unhon ney apney dilon mein chupa rakhi thi .
verses.translation: chunacheh jinn logon  kay dilon mein ( nifaq ka ) rog hai , tum unhen dekhtay ho kay woh lapak lapak ker unn mein ghustay hain , kehtay hain :  hamen darr hai kay hum per koi museebat ka chakkar aa-parey ga    ( lekin ) kuch baeed nahi kay Allah ( musalmanon ko ) fatah ata farmaye ya apni taraf say koi aur baat zahir kerday ,   aur uss waqt yeh log uss baat per pachtayen jo unhon ney apney dilon mein chupa rakhi thi .

verses.text: aur ( uss waqt ) emaan walay ( aik doosray say ) kahen gay kay kiya yeh wohi log hain jinhon ney baray zor o shor say Allah ki qasmen khai then kay woh tumharay sath hain . unn kay aemal gharat hogaye , aur woh na-murad ho ker rahey .
verses.translation: aur ( uss waqt ) emaan walay ( aik doosray say ) kahen gay kay kiya yeh wohi log hain jinhon ney baray zor o shor say Allah ki qasmen khai then kay woh tumharay sath hain . unn kay aemal gharat hogaye , aur woh na-murad ho ker rahey .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! agar tum mein say koi apney deen say phir jaye ga to Allah aesay log peda kerday ga jinn say woh mohabbat kerta hoga , aur woh uss say mohabbat kertay hon gay , jo mominon kay liye naram aur kafiron kay liye sakht hon gay , Allah kay raastay mein jihad keren gay , aur kissi malamat kernay walay ki malamat say nahi daren gay . yeh Allah ka fazal hai jo woh jiss ko chahta hai ata farmata hai , aur Allah bari wusat wala , baray ilm wala hai .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! agar tum mein say koi apney deen say phir jaye ga to Allah aesay log peda kerday ga jinn say woh mohabbat kerta hoga , aur woh uss say mohabbat kertay hon gay , jo mominon kay liye naram aur kafiron kay liye sakht hon gay , Allah kay raastay mein jihad keren gay , aur kissi malamat kernay walay ki malamat say nahi daren gay . yeh Allah ka fazal hai jo woh jiss ko chahta hai ata farmata hai , aur Allah bari wusat wala , baray ilm wala hai .

verses.text: . ( musalmano ! ) tumharay yaar-o-madadgaar to Allah , uss kay Rasool aur woh emaan walay hain jo iss tarah namaz qaeem kertay aur zakat ada kertay hain kay woh ( dil say ) Allah kay aagay jhukay huye hotay hain .
verses.translation: . ( musalmano ! ) tumharay yaar-o-madadgaar to Allah , uss kay Rasool aur woh emaan walay hain jo iss tarah namaz qaeem kertay aur zakat ada kertay hain kay woh ( dil say ) Allah kay aagay jhukay huye hotay hain .

verses.text: aur jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool ko aur emaan walon ko dost banaye to ( woh Allah ki jamat mein shamil hojata hai aur ) Allah ki jamat hi ghalba paaney wali hai .
verses.translation: aur jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool ko aur emaan walon ko dost banaye to ( woh Allah ki jamat mein shamil hojata hai aur ) Allah ki jamat hi ghalba paaney wali hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! jinn logon  ko tum say pehlay kitab di gaee thi unn mein say aesay logon ko jinhon ney tumharay deen ko mazaq aur khel bana rakha hai aur kafiron ko yaar-o-madadgaar naa banao , aur agar tum waqaee sahab-e-emaan ho to Allah say dartay raho .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! jinn logon  ko tum say pehlay kitab di gaee thi unn mein say aesay logon ko jinhon ney tumharay deen ko mazaq aur khel bana rakha hai aur kafiron ko yaar-o-madadgaar naa banao , aur agar tum waqaee sahab-e-emaan ho to Allah say dartay raho .

verses.text: aur jab tum namaz kay liye ( logon  ko ) pukartay ho to woh uss ( pukar ) ko mazaq aur khel ka nishana banatay hain . yeh sabb ( harkaten ) iss wajeh say hain kay inn logon  ko aqal nahi hai .
verses.translation: aur jab tum namaz kay liye ( logon  ko ) pukartay ho to woh uss ( pukar ) ko mazaq aur khel ka nishana banatay hain . yeh sabb ( harkaten ) iss wajeh say hain kay inn logon  ko aqal nahi hai .

verses.text: tum ( inn say ) kaho kay :  aey ehal-e-kitab ! tumhen iss kay siwa humari kon si baat buri lagti hai kay hum Allah per aur jo kalam hum per utaara gaya uss per aur jo pehlay utaara gaya tha uss per emaan ley aaye hain , jabkay tum mein say aksar log nafarman hain-?
verses.translation: tum ( inn say ) kaho kay :  aey ehal-e-kitab ! tumhen iss kay siwa humari kon si baat buri lagti hai kay hum Allah per aur jo kalam hum per utaara gaya uss per aur jo pehlay utaara gaya tha uss per emaan ley aaye hain , jabkay tum mein say aksar log nafarman hain-?

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho kay :  kiya mein tumhen bataon kay ( jiss baat ko tum bura samajh rahey ho ) uss say ziyada buray anjam walay kon hain-? yeh woh log hain jinn per Allah ney phitkaar daali , jinn per apna ghazab nazil kiya , jinn mein say logon  ko bandar aur soowar banaya , aur jinhon ney shetan ki parastish ki ! woh log hain jinn ka thikana bhi bad-tareen hai aur woh seedhay raastay say bhi boht bhatkay huye hain .

verses.text: inn kay mashaeeq aur ulama inn ko gunah ki baaten kehney aur haram khaney say aakhir kiyon mana nahi kertay-? haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn ka yeh tarz-e-amal nihayat bura hai

verses.text: aur yahudi kehtay hain kay  Allah kay haath banday huye hain    haath to khud inn kay bandhay huye hain , aur jo baat unhon ney kahi hai uss ki wajeh say inn per lanat alag parri hai , werna Allah kay dono haath poori tarah kushada hain , woh jiss tarah chahta hai kharch kerta hai . aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jo wahi tum per nazil ki gaee hai woh inn mein say boht son ki sarkashi aur kufr mein mazeed izafa ker kay rahey gi , aur hum ney inn kay darmiyan qayamat kay din tak kay liye adawat aur bughz peda kerdiya hai . jab kabhi yeh jang ki aag bharkatay hain , Allah uss ko bujha deta hai ,   aur yeh zameen mein fasad machatay phirtay hain , jabkay Allah fasad machaney walon ko pasand nahi kerta .

( agar-cheh ) unn mein aik jamat raah-e-raast per chalney wali bhi hai , magar inn mein say boht say log aesay hi hain kay unn kay aemal kharab hain .

verses.text: keh do kay :  aey ehal-e-kitab ! jab tak tum toraat aur injeel per aur jo ( kitab ) tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say tumharay paas ( abb ) bheji gaee hai uss ki poori pabandi nahi kero gay , tumhari koi buniyad nahi hogi jiss per tum kharray hosako .  aur ( aey Rasool ! ) jo wahi tum per tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say nazil ki gaee hai woh inn mein say boht son ki sarkashi aur kufr mein mazeed izafa ker kay rahey gi , lehaza tum inn kafir logon  per afsos matt kerna .

verses.text: hum ney bano Israel say ehad liya tha , aur unn kay paas Rasool bhejay thay . jab koi Rasool unn kay paas koi aesi baat ley ker aata jiss ko inn ka dil nahi chahta tha to kuch ( Rasoolon ) ko unhon ney jhutlaya aur kuch ko qatal kertay rahey .

verses.text: aur woh yeh samajh bethay kay koi pakar nahi hogi , iss liye andhay behray ban gaye , phir Allah ney unn ki tauba qubool ki to unn mein say boht say phir andhay behray ban gaye , aur Allah unn kay tamam aemal ko khoob dekh raha hai .

verses.translation: tum unn mein say boht son ko dekhtay ho kay unhon ney ( butt parast ) kafiron ko apna dost banaya huwa hai .   yaqeenan jo kuch unhon ney apney haq mein apney aagay bhej rakha hai woh boht bura hai kiyonkay ( inn ki wajeh say ) Allah unn say naraz hogaya hai , aur woh hamesha azab mein rahen gay .

verses.text: agar yeh log Allah per aur nabi per aur jo kalam unn per nazil huwa hai uss per emaan rakhtay to inn ( butt paraston ) ko dost naa banatay , lekin ( baat yeh hai kay ) inn mein ziyada tadaad unn ki hai jo nafarman hain .
verses.translation: agar yeh log Allah per aur nabi per aur jo kalam unn per nazil huwa hai uss per emaan rakhtay to inn ( butt paraston ) ko dost naa banatay , lekin ( baat yeh hai kay ) inn mein ziyada tadaad unn ki hai jo nafarman hain .

verses.text: tum yeh baat zaroor mehsoos kerlo gay kay musalmanon say sabb say sakht dushmani rakhney walay aik to yahudi hain , aur doosray woh log hain jo ( khul ker ) shirk kertay hain . aur tum yeh baat bhi zaroor mehsoos kerlo gay kay ( ghair muslimon mein ) musalmanon say dosti mein qareeb tarr woh log hain jinhon ney apney aap ko nasrani kaha hai . iss ki wajeh yeh hai kay unn mein boht say ilm dost aalam aur boht say tarak-ud-duniya darwaish hain ,   neez yeh wajeh bhi hai kay woh takabbur nahi kertay .
verses.translation: tum yeh baat zaroor mehsoos kerlo gay kay musalmanon say sabb say sakht dushmani rakhney walay aik to yahudi hain , aur doosray woh log hain jo ( khul ker ) shirk kertay hain . aur tum yeh baat bhi zaroor mehsoos kerlo gay kay ( ghair muslimon mein ) musalmanon say dosti mein qareeb tarr woh log hain jinhon ney apney aap ko nasrani kaha hai . iss ki wajeh yeh hai kay unn mein boht say ilm dost aalam aur boht say tarak-ud-duniya darwaish hain ,   neez yeh wajeh bhi hai kay woh takabbur nahi kertay .

verses.text: aur jab yeh log woh kalam suntay hain jo Rasool per nazil huwa hai to chunkay unhon ney haq ko pehchan liya hota hai , iss liye tum inn ki aankhon ko dekho gay kay woh aansoon say beh rahi hain ,   ( aur ) woh keh rahey hain kay  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum emaan ley aaye hain , lehaza gawahi denay walon kay sath humara naam bhi likh lijiye .
verses.translation: aur jab yeh log woh kalam suntay hain jo Rasool per nazil huwa hai to chunkay unhon ney haq ko pehchan liya hota hai , iss liye tum inn ki aankhon ko dekho gay kay woh aansoon say beh rahi hain ,   ( aur ) woh keh rahey hain kay  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum emaan ley aaye hain , lehaza gawahi denay walon kay sath humara naam bhi likh lijiye .

verses.text: aur hum Allah per aur jo haq humaray paas aagaya hai uss per aakhir kiyon emaan naa layen , aur phir yeh tawaqqo bhi rakhen kay humara rab hamen naik logon  mein shumar keray ga-?
verses.translation: aur hum Allah per aur jo haq humaray paas aagaya hai uss per aakhir kiyon emaan naa layen , aur phir yeh tawaqqo bhi rakhen kay humara rab hamen naik logon  mein shumar keray ga-?

verses.text: chunacheh inn kay iss qol ki wajeh say Allah inn ko woh baaghaat dey ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jinn mein woh hamesha rahen gay . yehi naiki kernay walon ka sila hai
verses.translation: chunacheh inn kay iss qol ki wajeh say Allah inn ko woh baaghaat dey ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jinn mein woh hamesha rahen gay . yehi naiki kernay walon ka sila hai

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya hai aur humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , woh dozakh walay log hain .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya hai aur humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , woh dozakh walay log hain .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah ney tumharay liye jo pakeezah cheezen halal ki hain unn ko haram qarar naa do , aur hadd say tajawuz naa kero . yaqeen jano kay Allah hadd say tajawuz kernay walon ko pasand nahi kerta .   .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah ney tumharay liye jo pakeezah cheezen halal ki hain unn ko haram qarar naa do , aur hadd say tajawuz naa kero . yaqeen jano kay Allah hadd say tajawuz kernay walon ko pasand nahi kerta .   .

verses.text: aur Allah ney tumhen jo rizq diya hai uss mein say halal pakeezah cheezen khao , aur jiss Allah per tum emaan rakhtay ho uss say dartay raho .
verses.translation: aur Allah ney tumhen jo rizq diya hai uss mein say halal pakeezah cheezen khao , aur jiss Allah per tum emaan rakhtay ho uss say dartay raho .

verses.text: Allah tumhari laghw qasmon per tumhari pakar nahi keray ga ,   lekin jo qasmen tum ney pukhtagi kay sath khai hon ,   unn per tumhari pakar keray ga . chunacheh iss ka kaffara yeh hai kay das miskeeno ko woh aosat darjay ka khana khilao jo tum apney ghar walon ko khilaya kertay ho , ya unn ko kapray do , ya aik ghulam ko azad kero . haan agar kissi kay paas ( inn cheezon mein say ) kuch naa ho to woh teen din rozay rakhay . yeh tumhari qasmon ka kaffara hai jab tum ney koi qasam khali ho ( aur ussay torr diya ho ) , aur apni qasmon ki hifazat kiya kero .   issi tarah Allah apni aayaten khol khol ker tumharay samney wazeh kerta hai , takay tum shukar ada kero .
verses.translation: Allah tumhari laghw qasmon per tumhari pakar nahi keray ga ,   lekin jo qasmen tum ney pukhtagi kay sath khai hon ,   unn per tumhari pakar keray ga . chunacheh iss ka kaffara yeh hai kay das miskeeno ko woh aosat darjay ka khana khilao jo tum apney ghar walon ko khilaya kertay ho , ya unn ko kapray do , ya aik ghulam ko azad kero . haan agar kissi kay paas ( inn cheezon mein say ) kuch naa ho to woh teen din rozay rakhay . yeh tumhari qasmon ka kaffara hai jab tum ney koi qasam khali ho ( aur ussay torr diya ho ) , aur apni qasmon ki hifazat kiya kero .   issi tarah Allah apni aayaten khol khol ker tumharay samney wazeh kerta hai , takay tum shukar ada kero .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! sharab , juoa , button kay thaan aur joye kay teer ,   yeh sabb napak shetani kaam hain , lehaza inn say bacho , takay tumhen falah hasil ho .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! sharab , juoa , button kay thaan aur joye kay teer ,   yeh sabb napak shetani kaam hain , lehaza inn say bacho , takay tumhen falah hasil ho .

verses.text: shetan to yehi chahta hai kay sharab aur joye kay zariye tumharay darmiyan dushmani aur bughz kay beej daal dey , aur tumhen Allah ki yaad aur namaz say rok dey . abb batao kay kiya tum ( inn cheezon say ) baaz aajao gay-?
verses.translation: shetan to yehi chahta hai kay sharab aur joye kay zariye tumharay darmiyan dushmani aur bughz kay beej daal dey , aur tumhen Allah ki yaad aur namaz say rok dey . abb batao kay kiya tum ( inn cheezon say ) baaz aajao gay-?

verses.text: aur Allah ki itaat kero , aur Rasool ki itaat kero , aur ( nafarmani say ) bachtay raho . aur agar tum ( iss hukum say ) mun morro gay to jaan rakho kay humaray Rasool per sirf yeh zimma daari hai kay woh saaf saaf tareeqay say ( Allah kay hukum ki ) tableegh kerden .
verses.translation: aur Allah ki itaat kero , aur Rasool ki itaat kero , aur ( nafarmani say ) bachtay raho . aur agar tum ( iss hukum say ) mun morro gay to jaan rakho kay humaray Rasool per sirf yeh zimma daari hai kay woh saaf saaf tareeqay say ( Allah kay hukum ki ) tableegh kerden .

verses.text: jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur naiki per kaar band rahey hain , unhon ney pehlay jo kuch khaya piya hai , uss ki wajeh say unn per koi gunah nahi hai ,   ba-shartey-kay woh aaenda inn gunahon say bachtay rahen , aur emaan rakhen aur naik amal kertay rahen , phir ( jinn cheezon say aaenda roka jaye unn say ) bacha keren , aur emaan per qaeem rahen , aur uss kay baad bhi taqwa aur ehsan ko apnayen .   Allah ehsan per amal kernay walon say mohabbat kerta hai .
verses.translation: jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur naiki per kaar band rahey hain , unhon ney pehlay jo kuch khaya piya hai , uss ki wajeh say unn per koi gunah nahi hai ,   ba-shartey-kay woh aaenda inn gunahon say bachtay rahen , aur emaan rakhen aur naik amal kertay rahen , phir ( jinn cheezon say aaenda roka jaye unn say ) bacha keren , aur emaan per qaeem rahen , aur uss kay baad bhi taqwa aur ehsan ko apnayen .   Allah ehsan per amal kernay walon say mohabbat kerta hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah tumhen shikar kay kuch janweron kay zariye zaroor aazamaye ga jo tumharay haathon aur tumharay naizon ki zadd mein aajayen gay ,   takay woh yeh jaan ley kay kon hai jo ussay dekhay baghair bhi uss say darta hai . phir jo shaks uss kay baad bhi hadd say tajawuz keray ga woh dardnak saza ka mustahiq hoga .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah tumhen shikar kay kuch janweron kay zariye zaroor aazamaye ga jo tumharay haathon aur tumharay naizon ki zadd mein aajayen gay ,   takay woh yeh jaan ley kay kon hai jo ussay dekhay baghair bhi uss say darta hai . phir jo shaks uss kay baad bhi hadd say tajawuz keray ga woh dardnak saza ka mustahiq hoga .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! jab tum ehraam ki halat mein ho to kissi shikar ko qatal naa kero . aur agar tum mein say koi ussay jaan boojh ker qatal kerday to uss ka badla dena wajib hoga ( jiss ka tareeqa yeh hoga kay ) jo janwer uss ney qatal kiya hai , uss janwer kay barabar chopayo mein say kissi janwer ko jiss ka faisla tum mein say do diyanat daar tajarba kaar aadmi keren gay , kaaba phoncha ker qurban kiya jaye , ya ( uss ki qeemat ka ) kaffara miskeeno ko khana khila ker ada kiya jaye , ya uss kay barabar rozay rakhay jayen ,   takay woh shaks apney kiye ka badla chakhay . pehlay jo kuch hochuka Allah ney ussay moaaf kerdiya , aur jo shaks dobara aisa keray ga to Allah uss say badla ley ga , aur Allah iqtidar aur intiqam ka malik hai .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! jab tum ehraam ki halat mein ho to kissi shikar ko qatal naa kero . aur agar tum mein say koi ussay jaan boojh ker qatal kerday to uss ka badla dena wajib hoga ( jiss ka tareeqa yeh hoga kay ) jo janwer uss ney qatal kiya hai , uss janwer kay barabar chopayo mein say kissi janwer ko jiss ka faisla tum mein say do diyanat daar tajarba kaar aadmi keren gay , kaaba phoncha ker qurban kiya jaye , ya ( uss ki qeemat ka ) kaffara miskeeno ko khana khila ker ada kiya jaye , ya uss kay barabar rozay rakhay jayen ,   takay woh shaks apney kiye ka badla chakhay . pehlay jo kuch hochuka Allah ney ussay moaaf kerdiya , aur jo shaks dobara aisa keray ga to Allah uss say badla ley ga , aur Allah iqtidar aur intiqam ka malik hai .

verses.text: tumharay liye samandar ka shikar aur uss ka khana halal kerdiya gaya hai , takay woh tumharay liye aur qaflon kay liye faeeda uthaney ka zariya banay , lekin jab tak tum halat-e-ehraam mein ho tum per khushki ka shikar haram kerdiya gaya hai , aur Allah say dartay raho jiss ki taraf tum sabb ko jama ker kay ley jaya jaye ga .
verses.translation: tumharay liye samandar ka shikar aur uss ka khana halal kerdiya gaya hai , takay woh tumharay liye aur qaflon kay liye faeeda uthaney ka zariya banay , lekin jab tak tum halat-e-ehraam mein ho tum per khushki ka shikar haram kerdiya gaya hai , aur Allah say dartay raho jiss ki taraf tum sabb ko jama ker kay ley jaya jaye ga .

verses.text: Allah ney kaabay ko jo bari hurmat wala ghar hai logon  kay liye qayam-e-aman ka zariya bana diya hai , neez hurmat walay maheenay , nazraney kay janweron aur unn kay galay mein parray huye patton ko bhi ( aman ka zariya banaya hai ) ,   yeh sab is liye takay tumhen maloom ho kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai Allah ussay khoob janta hai , aur Allah her baat say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: Allah ney kaabay ko jo bari hurmat wala ghar hai logon  kay liye qayam-e-aman ka zariya bana diya hai , neez hurmat walay maheenay , nazraney kay janweron aur unn kay galay mein parray huye patton ko bhi ( aman ka zariya banaya hai ) ,   yeh sab is liye takay tumhen maloom ho kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai Allah ussay khoob janta hai , aur Allah her baat say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: yeh baat bhi jaan rakho kay Allah azab denay mein sakht hai , aur yeh bhi kay Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: yeh baat bhi jaan rakho kay Allah azab denay mein sakht hai , aur yeh bhi kay Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: Rasool per siwaye tableegh kernay kay koi aur zimma daari nahi hai . aur jo kuch tum khulay bandon kertay ho aur jo kuch chupatay ho , Allah unn sabb baaton ko janta hai .
verses.translation: Rasool per siwaye tableegh kernay kay koi aur zimma daari nahi hai . aur jo kuch tum khulay bandon kertay ho aur jo kuch chupatay ho , Allah unn sabb baaton ko janta hai .

verses.text: . ( aey Rasool ! logon  say ) keh do kay napak aur pakeezah cheezen barabar nahi hoten , chahye tumhen napak cheezon ki kasrat achi lagti ho .   lehaza aey aqal walo ! Allah say dartay raho takay tumhen falah hasil ho .
verses.translation: . ( aey Rasool ! logon  say ) keh do kay napak aur pakeezah cheezen barabar nahi hoten , chahye tumhen napak cheezon ki kasrat achi lagti ho .   lehaza aey aqal walo ! Allah say dartay raho takay tumhen falah hasil ho .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! aesi cheezon kay baaray mein sawalaat naa kiya kero jo agar tum per zahir kerdi jayen to tumhen nagawar hon , aur agar tum unn kay baaray mein aesay waqt sawalaat kero gay jab Quran nazil kiya jaraha ho to woh tum per zahir kerdi jayen gi .   ( albatta ) Allah ney pichli baaten moaaf kerdi hain . aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara burdbaar hai .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! aesi cheezon kay baaray mein sawalaat naa kiya kero jo agar tum per zahir kerdi jayen to tumhen nagawar hon , aur agar tum unn kay baaray mein aesay waqt sawalaat kero gay jab Quran nazil kiya jaraha ho to woh tum per zahir kerdi jayen gi .   ( albatta ) Allah ney pichli baaten moaaf kerdi hain . aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara burdbaar hai .

verses.text: tum say pehlay aik qoam ney iss qisam kay sawalaat kiye thay , phir unn ( kay jo jawabaat diye gaye unn ) say munkir hogaye .
verses.translation: tum say pehlay aik qoam ney iss qisam kay sawalaat kiye thay , phir unn ( kay jo jawabaat diye gaye unn ) say munkir hogaye .

verses.text: Allah ney kissi janwer ko naa bahiraah banana tey kiya hai , naa saeeba , naa waseela aur naa haami ,   lekin jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya huwa hai woh Allah per jhoot baandhtay hain , aur unn mein say aksar logon  ko sahih samajh nahi hai .
verses.translation: Allah ney kissi janwer ko naa bahiraah banana tey kiya hai , naa saeeba , naa waseela aur naa haami ,   lekin jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya huwa hai woh Allah per jhoot baandhtay hain , aur unn mein say aksar logon  ko sahih samajh nahi hai .

verses.text: aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay Allah ney jo kalam nazil kiya hai , uss ki taraf aur Rasool ki taraf aao , to woh kehtay hain kay :  hum ney jiss ( deen per ) apney baap dadon ko paya hai , humaray liye wohi kafi hai .  bhala agar unn kay baap daday aesay hon kay naa unn kay paas koi ilm ho , aur naa koi hidayat to kiya phir bhi ( yeh unhi kay peechay chaltay rahen gay-? )
verses.translation: aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay Allah ney jo kalam nazil kiya hai , uss ki taraf aur Rasool ki taraf aao , to woh kehtay hain kay :  hum ney jiss ( deen per ) apney baap dadon ko paya hai , humaray liye wohi kafi hai .  bhala agar unn kay baap daday aesay hon kay naa unn kay paas koi ilm ho , aur naa koi hidayat to kiya phir bhi ( yeh unhi kay peechay chaltay rahen gay-? )

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! tum apni fiker kero . agar tum sahih raastay per hogay to jo log gumrah hain woh tumhen koi nuqsan nahi phoncha saktay .   Allah hi ki taraf tum sabb ko loat ker jana hai . uss waqt woh tumhen bataye ga kay tum kiya amal kertay rahey ho .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! tum apni fiker kero . agar tum sahih raastay per hogay to jo log gumrah hain woh tumhen koi nuqsan nahi phoncha saktay .   Allah hi ki taraf tum sabb ko loat ker jana hai . uss waqt woh tumhen bataye ga kay tum kiya amal kertay rahey ho .

verses.text: aey emaan walo !   jab tum mein say koi marney kay qareeb ho to wasiyyat kertay waqt aapas kay moamlaat tey kernay kay liye gawah bananey ka tareeqa yeh hai kay tum mein say do diyanat daar aadmi hon ( jo tumhari wasiyyat kay gawah banen ) ya agar tum zameen mein safar ker rahey ho , aur wahin tumhen moat ki museebat paish aajaye to gheron ( yani ghair muslimon ) mein say do shaks hojayen . phir agar tumhen koi shak parr-jaye to unn do gawahon ko namaz kay baad rok saktay ho , aur woh Allah ki qasam kha ker kahen kay hum iss gawahi kay badlay koi maali faeeda lena nahi chahtay , chahye moamla humaray kissi rishta daar hi ka kiyon naa ho , aur Allah ney hum per jiss gawahi ki zimma daari daali hai , iss ko hum nahi chupayen gay , werna hum gunehgaaron mein shumar hon gay .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo !   jab tum mein say koi marney kay qareeb ho to wasiyyat kertay waqt aapas kay moamlaat tey kernay kay liye gawah bananey ka tareeqa yeh hai kay tum mein say do diyanat daar aadmi hon ( jo tumhari wasiyyat kay gawah banen ) ya agar tum zameen mein safar ker rahey ho , aur wahin tumhen moat ki museebat paish aajaye to gheron ( yani ghair muslimon ) mein say do shaks hojayen . phir agar tumhen koi shak parr-jaye to unn do gawahon ko namaz kay baad rok saktay ho , aur woh Allah ki qasam kha ker kahen kay hum iss gawahi kay badlay koi maali faeeda lena nahi chahtay , chahye moamla humaray kissi rishta daar hi ka kiyon naa ho , aur Allah ney hum per jiss gawahi ki zimma daari daali hai , iss ko hum nahi chupayen gay , werna hum gunehgaaron mein shumar hon gay .

verses.text: phir baad mein agar yeh pata chalay kay unhon ney ( jhoot bol ker ) apney oopper gunah ka bojh utha liya hai to unn logon  mein say do aadmi unn ki jagah ( gawahi kay liye ) kharray hojayen jinn kay khilaf inn pehlay do aadmiyon ney gunah apney sar liya tha ,   aur woh Allah ki qasam khayen kay humari gawahi unn pehlay do aadmiyon ki gawahi kay muqablay mein ziyada sachi hai , aur hum ney ( iss gawahi mein ) koi ziyadti nahi ki hai , werna hum zalimon mein shumar hon gay .
verses.translation: phir baad mein agar yeh pata chalay kay unhon ney ( jhoot bol ker ) apney oopper gunah ka bojh utha liya hai to unn logon  mein say do aadmi unn ki jagah ( gawahi kay liye ) kharray hojayen jinn kay khilaf inn pehlay do aadmiyon ney gunah apney sar liya tha ,   aur woh Allah ki qasam khayen kay humari gawahi unn pehlay do aadmiyon ki gawahi kay muqablay mein ziyada sachi hai , aur hum ney ( iss gawahi mein ) koi ziyadti nahi ki hai , werna hum zalimon mein shumar hon gay .

verses.text: iss tareeqay mein iss baat ki ziyada umeed hai kay log ( shuroo hi mein ) theek theek gawahi den ya iss baat say daren kay ( jhooti gawahi ki soorat mein ) unn ki qasmon kay baad loata ker doosri qasmen li jayen gi ( jo humari tardeed kerden gi ) . aur Allah say daro , aur ( jo kuch uss ki taraf say kaha gaya hai ussay qubool kernay ki niyyat say ) suno . Allah nafarmano ko hidayat nahi deta .
verses.translation: iss tareeqay mein iss baat ki ziyada umeed hai kay log ( shuroo hi mein ) theek theek gawahi den ya iss baat say daren kay ( jhooti gawahi ki soorat mein ) unn ki qasmon kay baad loata ker doosri qasmen li jayen gi ( jo humari tardeed kerden gi ) . aur Allah say daro , aur ( jo kuch uss ki taraf say kaha gaya hai ussay qubool kernay ki niyyat say ) suno . Allah nafarmano ko hidayat nahi deta .

verses.text: woh din yaad kero jab Allah tamam Rasoolon ko jama keray ga , aur kahey ga kay  tumhen kiya jawab diya gaya tha-?  woh kahen gay kay  hamen kuch ilm nahi , posheeda baaton ka tamam tarr ilm to aap hi kay paas hai .
verses.translation: woh din yaad kero jab Allah tamam Rasoolon ko jama keray ga , aur kahey ga kay  tumhen kiya jawab diya gaya tha-?  woh kahen gay kay  hamen kuch ilm nahi , posheeda baaton ka tamam tarr ilm to aap hi kay paas hai .

verses.text: . ( yeh waqiaa uss din hoga ) jab Allah kahey ga :  aey essa ibn-e-maryam ! mera inaam yaad kero jo mein ney tum per aur tumhari walida per kiya tha , jab mein ney rooh-ul-qudus kay zariye tumhari madad ki thi .   tum logon  say gehwaray mein bhi baat kertay thay , aur bari umar mein bhi . aur jab mein ney tumhen kitab o hikmat aur toraat o injeel ki taleem di thi , aur jab tum meray hukum say gaara ley ker uss say perinday ki jaisi shakal banatay thay , phir uss mein phoonk maartay thay to woh meray hukum say ( sach mooch ka ) perinda ban jata tha , aur tum madarzaad andhay aur korhi ko meray hukum say acha ker-detay thay , aur jab tum meray hukum say murdon ko ( zinda ) nikal kharra kertay thay , aur jab mein ney bani Israel ko uss waqt tum say door rakha jab tum unn kay paas khuli nishaniyan ley ker aaye thay , aur unn mein say jo kafir thay unhon ney kaha tha kay yeh khulay jadoo kay siwa kuch nahi .
verses.translation: . verses.text: jab mein ney hawariyon kay dil mein yeh baat daali kay :  tum mujh per aur meray Rasool per emaan lao  to unhon ney kaha :  hum emaan ley aaye  aur aap gawah rahiye kay hum farmanbardaar hain .

verses.text: . ( aur unn kay uss waqaey ka bhi ziker suno ) jab hawariyon ney kaha tha kay :  aey essa ibn-e-maryam ! kiya aap ka perwerdigar aisa ker-sakta hai kay hum per aasman say ( khaney ka ) aik khuwan utaray-?  essa ney kaha :  Allah say daro agar tum momin ho .

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  hum chahtay hain kay iss khuwan say khana khayen , aur uss kay zariye humaray dil poori tarah mutmaeen hojayen , aur hamen ( pehlay say ziyada yaqeen kay sath ) yeh maloom hojaye kay aap ney hum say jo kuch kaha hai woh sach hai , aur hum uss per gawahi denay walon mein shamil hojayen .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  hum chahtay hain kay iss khuwan say khana khayen , aur uss kay zariye humaray dil poori tarah mutmaeen hojayen , aur hamen ( pehlay say ziyada yaqeen kay sath ) yeh maloom hojaye kay aap ney hum say jo kuch kaha hai woh sach hai , aur hum uss per gawahi denay walon mein shamil hojayen .

verses.text: . ( chunacheh ) essa ibn-e-maryam ney darkhuwast ki kay :  ya Allah ! hum per aasman say aik khuwan utaar dijiye jo humaray liye aur humaray aglon aur pichlon kay liye aik khushi ka moaqa ban jaye , aur aap ki taraf say aik nishani ho . aur hamen yeh naimat ata farma hi dijiye , aur aap sabb say behtar ata farmaney walay hain .
verses.translation: . ( chunacheh ) essa ibn-e-maryam ney darkhuwast ki kay :  ya Allah ! hum per aasman say aik khuwan utaar dijiye jo humaray liye aur humaray aglon aur pichlon kay liye aik khushi ka moaqa ban jaye , aur aap ki taraf say aik nishani ho . aur hamen yeh naimat ata farma hi dijiye , aur aap sabb say behtar ata farmaney walay hain .

verses.text: Allah ney kaha kay :  mein beyshak tum per woh khuwan utaar dun ga , lekin uss kay baad tum mein say jo shaks bhi kufr keray ga uss ko mein aesi saza dun ga jo duniya jahan kay kissi bhi shaks ko nahi dun ga .
verses.translation: Allah ney kaha kay :  mein beyshak tum per woh khuwan utaar dun ga , lekin uss kay baad tum mein say jo shaks bhi kufr keray ga uss ko mein aesi saza dun ga jo duniya jahan kay kissi bhi shaks ko nahi dun ga .

verses.text: aur ( uss waqt ka bhi ziker suno ) jab Allah kahey ga kay :  aey essa ibn-e-maryam ! kiya tum ney logon  say kaha tha kay mujhay aur meri maa ko Allah kay ilawa do mabood banao-?    woh kahen gay :  hum to aap ki zaat ko ( shirk say ) pak samajhtay hain . meri majal nahi thi kay mein aesi baat kahun jiss ka mujhay koi haq nahi . agar mein ney aisa kaha hota to aap ko yaqeenan maloom hojata . aap woh baaten jantay hain jo meray dil mein posheeda hain , aur mein aap ki posheeda baaton ko nahi janta . yaqeenan aap ko tamam chupi hoi baaton ka poora poora ilm hai .
verses.translation: aur ( uss waqt ka bhi ziker suno ) jab Allah kahey ga kay :  aey essa ibn-e-maryam ! kiya tum ney logon  say kaha tha kay mujhay aur meri maa ko Allah kay ilawa do mabood banao-?    woh kahen gay :  hum to aap ki zaat ko ( shirk say ) pak samajhtay hain . meri majal nahi thi kay mein aesi baat kahun jiss ka mujhay koi haq nahi . agar mein ney aisa kaha hota to aap ko yaqeenan maloom hojata . aap woh baaten jantay hain jo meray dil mein posheeda hain , aur mein aap ki posheeda baaton ko nahi janta . yaqeenan aap ko tamam chupi hoi baaton ka poora poora ilm hai .

verses.text: mein ney inn logon  say uss kay siwa koi baat nahi kahi jiss ka aap ney mujhay hukum diya tha , aur woh yeh kay :  Allah ki ibadat kero jo mera bhi perwerdigar hai aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar  .  aur jab tak mein inn kay darmiyan mojood raha , mein inn kay halaat say waqif raha . phir jab aap ney mujhay utha liya to aap khud inn kay nigran thay , aur aap her cheez kay gawah hain .
verses.translation: mein ney inn logon  say uss kay siwa koi baat nahi kahi jiss ka aap ney mujhay hukum diya tha , aur woh yeh kay :  Allah ki ibadat kero jo mera bhi perwerdigar hai aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar  .  aur jab tak mein inn kay darmiyan mojood raha , mein inn kay halaat say waqif raha . phir jab aap ney mujhay utha liya to aap khud inn kay nigran thay , aur aap her cheez kay gawah hain .

verses.text: agar aap inn ko saza den , to yeh aap kay banday hain hi , aur agar aap enhen moaaf farmaden to yaqeenan aap ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil .
verses.translation: agar aap inn ko saza den , to yeh aap kay banday hain hi , aur agar aap enhen moaaf farmaden to yaqeenan aap ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil .

verses.text: Allah kahey ga kay :  yeh woh din hai jiss mein sachay logon  ko unn ka sach faeeda phonchaye ga . inn kay liye woh baaghaat hain jinn kay neechay nehren beh rahi hain , jinn mein yeh log hamesha hamesha rahen gay . Allah inn say khush hai aur yeh uss say khush hain . yehi bari zabardast kamiyabi hai .
verses.translation: Allah kahey ga kay :  yeh woh din hai jiss mein sachay logon  ko unn ka sach faeeda phonchaye ga . inn kay liye woh baaghaat hain jinn kay neechay nehren beh rahi hain , jinn mein yeh log hamesha hamesha rahen gay . Allah inn say khush hai aur yeh uss say khush hain . yehi bari zabardast kamiyabi hai .

verses.text: tamam aasmano aur zameen aur unn mein jo kuch hai uss sabb ki badshahi Allah hi kay liye hai , aur woh her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai .
verses.translation: tamam aasmano aur zameen aur unn mein jo kuch hai uss sabb ki badshahi Allah hi kay liye hai , aur woh her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! moahidon ko poora kero . tumharay liye woh chopaye halal kerdiye gaye hain jo maweshiyon mein dakhil ( ya unn kay mushabeh ) hun ,   siwaye unn kay jinn kay baaray mein tumhen parh ker sunaya jaye ga ,   ba-shartey-kay jab tum ehraam ki halat mein ho uss waqt shikar ko halal naa samjho .   Allah jiss cheez ka irada kerta hai uss ka hukum deta hai .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! moahidon ko poora kero . tumharay liye woh chopaye halal kerdiye gaye hain jo maweshiyon mein dakhil ( ya unn kay mushabeh ) hun ,   siwaye unn kay jinn kay baaray mein tumhen parh ker sunaya jaye ga ,   ba-shartey-kay jab tum ehraam ki halat mein ho uss waqt shikar ko halal naa samjho .   Allah jiss cheez ka irada kerta hai uss ka hukum deta hai .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! naa Allah ki nishaniyon ki bey hurmati kero , naa hurmat walay maheenay ki , naa unn janweron ki jo qurbani kay liye haram ley jaye jayen , naa unn patton ki jo unn kay galay mein parray hon , aur naa unn logon  ki jo Allah ka fazal aur uss ki raza-mandi hasil kernay ki khatir bait-e-haraam ka irada ley ker jarahey hon . aur jab tum ehraam khol do to shikar ker-saktay ho . aur kissi qoam kay sath tumhari yeh dushmani kay unhon ney tumhen masjid-e-haram say roka tha tumhen iss baat per aamada naa keray kay tum ( unn per ) ziyadti kernay lago .   aur naiki aur taqwa mein aik doosray kay sath taawwun kero , aur gunah aur zulm mein taawwun naa kero , aur Allah say dartay raho . beyshak Allah ka azab bara sakht hai .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! naa Allah ki nishaniyon ki bey hurmati kero , naa hurmat walay maheenay ki , naa unn janweron ki jo qurbani kay liye haram ley jaye jayen , naa unn patton ki jo unn kay galay mein parray hon , aur naa unn logon  ki jo Allah ka fazal aur uss ki raza-mandi hasil kernay ki khatir bait-e-haraam ka irada ley ker jarahey hon . aur jab tum ehraam khol do to shikar ker-saktay ho . aur kissi qoam kay sath tumhari yeh dushmani kay unhon ney tumhen masjid-e-haram say roka tha tumhen iss baat per aamada naa keray kay tum ( unn per ) ziyadti kernay lago .   aur naiki aur taqwa mein aik doosray kay sath taawwun kero , aur gunah aur zulm mein taawwun naa kero , aur Allah say dartay raho . beyshak Allah ka azab bara sakht hai .

ayahs.text: tum per murdar janwer aur khoon aur soowar ka gosht aur woh janwer haram kerdiya gaya hai jiss per Allah kay siwa kissi aur ka naam pukara gaya ho , aur woh jo gala ghutney say mara ho , aur jissay chott maar ker halak kiya gaya ho , aur jo oopper say gir ker mara ho , aur jissay kissi janwer ney seeng maar ker halak kiya ho , aur jissay kissi darinday ney khaliya ho , illa yeh kay tum ( uss kay marney say pehlay ) uss ko zibah ker-chukay ho , aur woh ( janwer bhi haram hai ) jissay button ki qurban gaah per zibah kiya gaya ho . aur yeh baat bhi ( tumharay liye haram hai ) kay tum joye kay teeron say ( gosht waghera ) taqseem kero .   yeh sari baaten sakht gunah ki hain . aaj kafir log tumharay deen ( kay maghloob honey ) say na-umeed hogaye hain , lehaza unn say matt daro , aur mera darr dil mein rakho . aaj mein ney tumharay liye tumhara deen mukammal kerdiya , tum per apni naimat poori kerdi , aur tumharay liye Islam ko deen kay tor per ( hamesha kay liye ) pasand kerliya .   ( lehaza iss deen kay ehkaam ki poori pabandi kero ) haan jo shaks shadeed bhook kay aalam mein bilkul majboor hojaye ( aur uss majboori mein unn haram cheezon mein say kuch kha ley ) , ba-shartey-kay gunah ki raghbat ki bana per aisa naa kiya ho , to beyshak Allah boht moaaf kernay wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: tum per murdar janwer aur khoon aur soowar ka gosht aur woh janwer haram kerdiya gaya hai jiss per Allah kay siwa kissi aur ka naam pukara gaya ho , aur woh jo gala ghutney say mara ho , aur jissay chott maar ker halak kiya gaya ho , aur jo oopper say gir ker mara ho , aur jissay kissi janwer ney seeng maar ker halak kiya ho , aur jissay kissi darinday ney khaliya ho , illa yeh kay tum ( uss kay marney say pehlay ) uss ko zibah ker-chukay ho , aur woh ( janwer bhi haram hai ) jissay button ki qurban gaah per zibah kiya gaya ho . aur yeh baat bhi ( tumharay liye haram hai ) kay tum joye kay teeron say ( gosht waghera ) taqseem kero .   yeh sari baaten sakht gunah ki hain . aaj kafir log tumharay deen ( kay maghloob honey ) say na-umeed hogaye hain , lehaza unn say matt daro , aur mera darr dil mein rakho . aaj mein ney tumharay liye tumhara deen mukammal kerdiya , tum per apni naimat poori kerdi , aur tumharay liye Islam ko deen kay tor per ( hamesha kay liye ) pasand kerliya .   ( lehaza iss deen kay ehkaam ki poori pabandi kero ) haan jo shaks shadeed bhook kay aalam mein bilkul majboor hojaye ( aur uss majboori mein unn haram cheezon mein say kuch kha ley ) , ba-shartey-kay gunah ki raghbat ki bana per aisa naa kiya ho , to beyshak Allah boht moaaf kernay wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: log tum say poochtay hain kay unn kay liye kon si cheezen halal hain-? keh do kay  tumharay liye tamam pakeezah cheezen halal ki gaee hain . aur jinn shikari janweron ko tum ney Allah kay bataye huye tareeqay kay mutabiq sikha sikha ker ( shikar kay liye ) sidha liya ho , woh jiss janwer ko ( shikar ker kay ) tumharay liye rok rakhen , uss mein say tum kha saktay ho , aur uss per Allah ka naam liya kero   aur Allah say dartay raho . Allah jald hisab lenay wala hai .
ayahs.translation: log tum say poochtay hain kay unn kay liye kon si cheezen halal hain-? keh do kay  tumharay liye tamam pakeezah cheezen halal ki gaee hain . aur jinn shikari janweron ko tum ney Allah kay bataye huye tareeqay kay mutabiq sikha sikha ker ( shikar kay liye ) sidha liya ho , woh jiss janwer ko ( shikar ker kay ) tumharay liye rok rakhen , uss mein say tum kha saktay ho , aur uss per Allah ka naam liya kero   aur Allah say dartay raho . Allah jald hisab lenay wala hai .

ayahs.text: aaj tumharay liye pakeezah cheezen halal kerdi gaee hain , aur jinn logon  ko ( tum say pehlay ) kitab di gaee thi , unn ka khana bhi tumharay liye halal hai , aur tumhara khana unn kay liye halal hai   neez mominon mein say pak daman aurten bhi aur unn logon mein say pak daman aurten bhi tumharay liye halal hain jinn ko tum say pehlay kitab di gaee thi ,   jabkay tum ney unn ko nikah ki hifazat mein laney kay liye unn kay mehar dey diye hon , naa to ( baghair nikah kay ) sirf hawas nikalna maqsood ho aur naa khufiya aashnai peda kerna . aur jo shaks emaan say inkar keray uss ka sara kiya dhara gharat ho jaye ga , aur aakhirat mein uss ka shumar khasara uthaney walon mein hoga .
ayahs.translation: aaj tumharay liye pakeezah cheezen halal kerdi gaee hain , aur jinn logon  ko ( tum say pehlay ) kitab di gaee thi , unn ka khana bhi tumharay liye halal hai , aur tumhara khana unn kay liye halal hai   neez mominon mein say pak daman aurten bhi aur unn logon mein say pak daman aurten bhi tumharay liye halal hain jinn ko tum say pehlay kitab di gaee thi ,   jabkay tum ney unn ko nikah ki hifazat mein laney kay liye unn kay mehar dey diye hon , naa to ( baghair nikah kay ) sirf hawas nikalna maqsood ho aur naa khufiya aashnai peda kerna . aur jo shaks emaan say inkar keray uss ka sara kiya dhara gharat ho jaye ga , aur aakhirat mein uss ka shumar khasara uthaney walon mein hoga .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! jab tum namaz kay liye utho to apney chehray , aur kohniyon tak apney haath dho lo , aur apney saron ka masah kero , aur apney paon ( bhi ) takhnon- tak ( dho liya kero ) . aur agar tum janabat ki halat mein ho to saray jism ko ( ghusul kay zariye ) khoob achi tarah pak kero . aur agar tum beemar ho ya safar per ho ya tum mein say koi qazaye hajat ker kay aaya ho , ya tum ney aurton say jismani milaap kiya ho , aur tumhen paani naa milay to pak mitti say tayammum kero ,   aur apney chehron aur haathon ka uss ( mitti ) say masah kerlo . Allah tum per koi tangi musallat kerna nahi chahta , lekin yeh chahta hai kay tum ko pak saaf keray , aur yeh kay tum per apni naimat tamam kerday , takay tum shukar guzaar bano .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! jab tum namaz kay liye utho to apney chehray , aur kohniyon tak apney haath dho lo , aur apney saron ka masah kero , aur apney paon ( bhi ) takhnon- tak ( dho liya kero ) . aur agar tum janabat ki halat mein ho to saray jism ko ( ghusul kay zariye ) khoob achi tarah pak kero . aur agar tum beemar ho ya safar per ho ya tum mein say koi qazaye hajat ker kay aaya ho , ya tum ney aurton say jismani milaap kiya ho , aur tumhen paani naa milay to pak mitti say tayammum kero ,   aur apney chehron aur haathon ka uss ( mitti ) say masah kerlo . Allah tum per koi tangi musallat kerna nahi chahta , lekin yeh chahta hai kay tum ko pak saaf keray , aur yeh kay tum per apni naimat tamam kerday , takay tum shukar guzaar bano .

ayahs.text: Allah ney tum per jo inaam farmaya hai ussay aur uss ehad ko yaad rakho jo uss ney tum say liya tha . jab tum ney kaha tha kay :  hum ney ( Allah kay ehkaam ko ) achi tarah sunn liya hai , aur itaat qubool kerli hai  aur Allah say dartay raho . Allah yaqeenan seenon kay bhed say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

Allah yaqeenan seenon kay bhed say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! aesay ban jao kay Allah ( kay ehkaam ki pabandi ) kay liye her waqt tayyar ho , ( aur ) insaf ki gawahi denay walay ho . aur kissi qoam ki dushmani tumhen iss baat per aamada naa keray kay tum na-insafi kero . insaf say kaam lo , yehi tareeqa taqwa say qareeb tarr hai . aur Allah say dartay raho . Allah yaqeenan tumharay tamam kamon say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! aesay ban jao kay Allah ( kay ehkaam ki pabandi ) kay liye her waqt tayyar ho , ( aur ) insaf ki gawahi denay walay ho . aur kissi qoam ki dushmani tumhen iss baat per aamada naa keray kay tum na-insafi kero . insaf say kaam lo , yehi tareeqa taqwa say qareeb tarr hai . aur Allah say dartay raho . Allah yaqeenan tumharay tamam kamon say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

ayahs.text: jo log emaan laye hain aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain unn say Allah ney wada kiya hai kay ( aakhirat mein ) unn ko maghfirat aur zabardast sawab hasil hoga .
ayahs.translation: jo log emaan laye hain aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain unn say Allah ney wada kiya hai kay ( aakhirat mein ) unn ko maghfirat aur zabardast sawab hasil hoga .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya aur humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya , woh dozakh kay baasi hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya aur humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya , woh dozakh kay baasi hain .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah ney tum per jo inaam farmaya uss ko yaad kero . jab kuch logon  ney irada kiya tha kay tum per dast darazi keren , to Allah ney tumhen nuqsan phonchaney say unn kay haath rok diye ,   aur ( iss naimat ka shukar yeh hai kay ) Allah ka roab dil mein rakhtay huye amal kero , aur mominon ko sirf Allah hi per bharosa rakhna chahiye .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah ney tum per jo inaam farmaya uss ko yaad kero . jab kuch logon  ney irada kiya tha kay tum per dast darazi keren , to Allah ney tumhen nuqsan phonchaney say unn kay haath rok diye ,   aur ( iss naimat ka shukar yeh hai kay ) Allah ka roab dil mein rakhtay huye amal kero , aur mominon ko sirf Allah hi per bharosa rakhna chahiye .

ayahs.text: aur yaqeenan Allah ney bani Israel say ehad liya tha , aur hum ney unn mein say baara nigran muqarrar kiye thay ,   aur Allah ney kaha tha kay mein tumharay sath hun , agar tum ney namaz qaeem ki , zakat ada ki , meray payghumberon per emaan laye , izzat say unn ka sath diya aur Allah ko acha qarz diya   to yaqeen jano kay mein tumhari buraiyon ka kaffara kerdun ga , aur tumhen unn baaghaat mein dakhil kerun ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi . phir iss/uss kay baad bhi tum mein say jo shaks kufr ikhtiyar keray ga to dar-haqeeqat woh seedhi raah say bhatak jaye ga

ayahs.text: phir yeh unn ki ehad shikni hi to thi jiss ki wajeh say hum ney unn ko apni rehmat say door kiya , aur unn kay dilon ko sakht bana diya . woh baaton ko apney moaqa mehal say hata detay hain . aur jiss baat ki unn ko naseehat ki gaee thi uss ka aik bara hissa bhula chukay hain , aur unn mein say kuch logon  ko chorr ker tumhen aaye din unn ki kissi naa kissi khayanat ka pata chalta rehta hai . lehaza ( filhal ) unhen moaaf kerdo aur darguzar say kaam lo .   beyshak Allah ehsan kernay walon ko pasand kerta hai
ayahs.translation: phir yeh unn ki ehad shikni hi to thi jiss ki wajeh say hum ney unn ko apni rehmat say door kiya , aur unn kay dilon ko sakht bana diya . woh baaton ko apney moaqa mehal say hata detay hain . aur jiss baat ki unn ko naseehat ki gaee thi uss ka aik bara hissa bhula chukay hain , aur unn mein say kuch logon  ko chorr ker tumhen aaye din unn ki kissi naa kissi khayanat ka pata chalta rehta hai . lehaza ( filhal ) unhen moaaf kerdo aur darguzar say kaam lo .   beyshak Allah ehsan kernay walon ko pasand kerta hai

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney kaha tha kay hum nasrani hain , unn say ( bhi ) hum ney ehad liya tha , phir jiss cheez ki unn ko naseehat ki gaee thi , uss ka aik bara hissa woh ( bhi ) bhula bethay . chunacheh hum ney unn kay darmiyan qayamat kay din tak kay liye dushmani aur bughz peda kerdiya .   aur Allah unhen unqareeb bata dey ga kay woh kiya kuch kertay rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kaha tha kay hum nasrani hain , unn say ( bhi ) hum ney ehad liya tha , phir jiss cheez ki unn ko naseehat ki gaee thi , uss ka aik bara hissa woh ( bhi ) bhula bethay . chunacheh hum ney unn kay darmiyan qayamat kay din tak kay liye dushmani aur bughz peda kerdiya .   aur Allah unhen unqareeb bata dey ga kay woh kiya kuch kertay rahey hain .

ayahs.text: aey ehal-e-kitab ! tumharay paas humaray ( yeh ) payghumber aagaye hain jo kitab ( yani toraat aur injeel ) ki boht si unn baaton ko khol khol ker biyan kertay hain jo tum chupaya kertay ho , aur boht si baaton say darguzar ker jatay hain .   tumharay paas Allah ki taraf say aik roshni aai hai , aur aik aesi kitab jo haq ko wazeh ker-denay wali hai .
ayahs.translation: aey ehal-e-kitab ! tumharay paas humaray ( yeh ) payghumber aagaye hain jo kitab ( yani toraat aur injeel ) ki boht si unn baaton ko khol khol ker biyan kertay hain jo tum chupaya kertay ho , aur boht si baaton say darguzar ker jatay hain .   tumharay paas Allah ki taraf say aik roshni aai hai , aur aik aesi kitab jo haq ko wazeh ker-denay wali hai .

ayahs.text: jiss kay zariye Allah unn logon  ko salamti ki raahen dikhata hai jo uss ki khushnoodi kay talib hain , aur unhen apney hukum say andheriyon say nikal ker roshni ki taraf lata hai , aur unhen seedhay raastay ki hidayat ata farmata hai .
ayahs.translation: jiss kay zariye Allah unn logon  ko salamti ki raahen dikhata hai jo uss ki khushnoodi kay talib hain , aur unhen apney hukum say andheriyon say nikal ker roshni ki taraf lata hai , aur unhen seedhay raastay ki hidayat ata farmata hai .

ayahs.text: jinn logon  ney yeh kaha hai kay Allah hi maseeh ibn-e-maryam hai , woh yaqeenan kafir hogaye hain . ( aey nabi ! unn say ) keh do kay agar Allah maseeh ibn-e-maryam ko aur unn ki maa ko aur zameen mein jitney log hain unn sabb ko halak kerna chahye to kon hai jo Allah kay muqablay mein kuch kernay ki zara bhi taqat rakhta ho-? tamam aasmano aur zameen per aur unn kay darmiyan jo kuch mojood hai uss per tanha milkiyat Allah hi ki hai . woh jo cheez chahta hai peda kerta hai . aur Allah her cheez per poori poori qudrat rakhta hai .
ayahs.translation: jinn logon  ney yeh kaha hai kay Allah hi maseeh ibn-e-maryam hai , woh yaqeenan kafir hogaye hain . ( aey nabi ! unn say ) keh do kay agar Allah maseeh ibn-e-maryam ko aur unn ki maa ko aur zameen mein jitney log hain unn sabb ko halak kerna chahye to kon hai jo Allah kay muqablay mein kuch kernay ki zara bhi taqat rakhta ho-? tamam aasmano aur zameen per aur unn kay darmiyan jo kuch mojood hai uss per tanha milkiyat Allah hi ki hai . woh jo cheez chahta hai peda kerta hai . aur Allah her cheez per poori poori qudrat rakhta hai .

ayahs.text: yahood o nasara kehtay hain kay  hum Allah kay betay aur uss kay chaeetay hain  ( unn say ) kaho kay  phir Allah tumharay gunahon ki wajeh say tumhen saza kiyon deta hai-?   nahi ! balkay tum unhi insanon ki tarah insan ho jo uss ney peda kiye hain . woh jiss ko chahta hai bakhsh deta hai aur jiss ko chahta hai azab deta hai . aasmano aur zameen per aur unn kay darmiyan jo kuch mojood hai uss per tanha milkiyat Allah hi ki hai , aur ussi ki taraf ( sabb ko ) loat ker jana hai .
ayahs.translation: yahood o nasara kehtay hain kay  hum Allah kay betay aur uss kay chaeetay hain  ( unn say ) kaho kay  phir Allah tumharay gunahon ki wajeh say tumhen saza kiyon deta hai-?   nahi ! balkay tum unhi insanon ki tarah insan ho jo uss ney peda kiye hain . woh jiss ko chahta hai bakhsh deta hai aur jiss ko chahta hai azab deta hai . aasmano aur zameen per aur unn kay darmiyan jo kuch mojood hai uss per tanha milkiyat Allah hi ki hai , aur ussi ki taraf ( sabb ko ) loat ker jana hai .

ayahs.text: aey ehal-e-kitab ! tumharay paas humaray payghumber aesay waqt deen ki wazahat kernay aaye hain jab payghumberon ki aamad ruki hoi thi , takay tum yeh naa keh sako kay humaray paas naa koi ( jannat ki ) khushkhabri denay wala aaya , naa koi ( jahannum say ) daraney wala . lo abb tumharay paas khushkhabri denay wala aur daraney wala aagaya hai . aur Allah her baat per poori poori qudrat rakhta hai .
ayahs.translation: aey ehal-e-kitab ! tumharay paas humaray payghumber aesay waqt deen ki wazahat kernay aaye hain jab payghumberon ki aamad ruki hoi thi , takay tum yeh naa keh sako kay humaray paas naa koi ( jannat ki ) khushkhabri denay wala aaya , naa koi ( jahannum say ) daraney wala . lo abb tumharay paas khushkhabri denay wala aur daraney wala aagaya hai . aur Allah her baat per poori poori qudrat rakhta hai .

ayahs.text: aur uss waqt ka dhiyan kero jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay  aey meri qoam ! Allah ki uss naimat ko yaad kero jo uss ney tum per nazil farmaee hai kay uss ney tum mein nabi peda kiye , tumhen hukmran banaya , aur tumhen woh kuch ata kiya jo tum say pehlay duniya jahan kay kissi fard ko ata nahi kiya tha .
ayahs.translation: aur uss waqt ka dhiyan kero jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay  aey meri qoam ! Allah ki uss naimat ko yaad kero jo uss ney tum per nazil farmaee hai kay uss ney tum mein nabi peda kiye , tumhen hukmran banaya , aur tumhen woh kuch ata kiya jo tum say pehlay duniya jahan kay kissi fard ko ata nahi kiya tha .
