ayahs.text: aey meri qoam ! uss muqaddas sarzameen mein dakhil hojao jo Allah ney tumharay wastay likh di hai ,   aur apni pusht kay ball peechay naa loto , werna palat ker na-murad jao gay .
ayahs.translation: aey meri qoam ! uss muqaddas sarzameen mein dakhil hojao jo Allah ney tumharay wastay likh di hai ,   aur apni pusht kay ball peechay naa loto , werna palat ker na-murad jao gay .

ayahs.text: woh bolay ,  aey musa ! uss ( mulk ) mein to baray taqatwar log rehtay hain , aur jab tak woh log wahan say nikal naa jayen , hum hergiz uss mein dakhil nahi hon gay . haan agar woh wahan say nikal jayen to beyshak hum uss mein dakhil hojayen gay .
ayahs.translation: woh bolay ,  aey musa ! uss ( mulk ) mein to baray taqatwar log rehtay hain , aur jab tak woh log wahan say nikal naa jayen , hum hergiz uss mein dakhil nahi hon gay . haan agar woh wahan say nikal jayen to beyshak hum uss mein dakhil hojayen gay .

ayahs.text: jo log ( khuda ka ) khof rakhtay thay , unn mein say do mard jinn ko Allah ney apney fazal say nawaza tha ,   bol uthay kay  tum unn per charrhai ker kay ( shehar kay ) darwazay mein ghuss to jao . jab ghuss jao gay to tum hi ghalib raho gay . aur apna bharosa sirf Allah per rakho , agar tum waqaee sahab-e-emaan ho .
ayahs.translation: jo log ( khuda ka ) khof rakhtay thay , unn mein say do mard jinn ko Allah ney apney fazal say nawaza tha ,   bol uthay kay  tum unn per charrhai ker kay ( shehar kay ) darwazay mein ghuss to jao . jab ghuss jao gay to tum hi ghalib raho gay . aur apna bharosa sirf Allah per rakho , agar tum waqaee sahab-e-emaan ho .

ayahs.text: woh kehney lagay  aey musa ! jab tak woh log uss ( mulk ) mein mojood hain , hum hergiz hergiz uss mein qadam nahi rakhen gay . ( agar unn say larrna hai to ) bus tum aur tumhara rab chalay jao , aur unn say larro , hum to yahin bethay hain .
ayahs.translation: woh kehney lagay  aey musa ! jab tak woh log uss ( mulk ) mein mojood hain , hum hergiz hergiz uss mein qadam nahi rakhen gay . ( agar unn say larrna hai to ) bus tum aur tumhara rab chalay jao , aur unn say larro , hum to yahin bethay hain .

ayahs.text: musa ney kaha  aey meray perwerdigar ! siwaye meri apni jaan kay aur meray bhai kay koi meray qaboo mein nahi hai . abb aap humaray aur inn nafarman logon  kay darmiyan alag alag faisla ker-dijiye .
ayahs.translation: musa ney kaha  aey meray perwerdigar ! siwaye meri apni jaan kay aur meray bhai kay koi meray qaboo mein nahi hai . abb aap humaray aur inn nafarman logon  kay darmiyan alag alag faisla ker-dijiye .

ayahs.text: Allah ney kaha  acha ! to woh sarzameen inn per chaalees saal tak haram kerdi gaee hai , yeh ( iss doran ) zameen mein bhataktay phiren gay .   to ( aey musa ! ) abb tum bhi inn nafarman logon  per taras matt khana .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney kaha  acha ! to woh sarzameen inn per chaalees saal tak haram kerdi gaee hai , yeh ( iss doran ) zameen mein bhataktay phiren gay .   to ( aey musa ! ) abb tum bhi inn nafarman logon  per taras matt khana .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn kay samney Adam kay do beton ka waqiaa theek theek parh ker sunao . jab dono ney aik aik qurbani paish ki thi , aur unn mein say aik ki qurbani qubool hogaee , aur doosray ki qubool naa hoi .   uss ( doosray ney pehlay say ) kaha kay  mein tujhay qatal ker daalun ga .  pehlay ney kaha kay  Allah to unn logon  say ( qurbani ) qubool kerta hai jo muttaqi hon .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn kay samney Adam kay do beton ka waqiaa theek theek parh ker sunao . jab dono ney aik aik qurbani paish ki thi , aur unn mein say aik ki qurbani qubool hogaee , aur doosray ki qubool naa hoi .   uss ( doosray ney pehlay say ) kaha kay  mein tujhay qatal ker daalun ga .  pehlay ney kaha kay  Allah to unn logon  say ( qurbani ) qubool kerta hai jo muttaqi hon .

ayahs.text: agar tum ney mujhay qatal kernay ko apna haath barhaya tab bhi mein tumhen qatal kernay ko apna haath nahi barhaon ga . mein to Allah Rabb-ul-Aalameen say darta hun .
ayahs.translation: agar tum ney mujhay qatal kernay ko apna haath barhaya tab bhi mein tumhen qatal kernay ko apna haath nahi barhaon ga . mein to Allah Rabb-ul-Aalameen say darta hun .

ayahs.text: mein to yeh chahta hun kay anjam kaar tum apney aur meray dono kay gunah mein pakray jao ,   aur dozakhiyon mein shamil ho . aur yehi zalimon ki saza hai .
ayahs.translation: mein to yeh chahta hun kay anjam kaar tum apney aur meray dono kay gunah mein pakray jao ,   aur dozakhiyon mein shamil ho . aur yehi zalimon ki saza hai .

ayahs.text: aakhir kaar uss kay nafs ney uss ko apney bhai kay qatal per aamada kerliya , chunacheh uss ney apney bhai ko qatal ker daala , aur na-muradon mein shamil hogaya .
ayahs.translation: aakhir kaar uss kay nafs ney uss ko apney bhai kay qatal per aamada kerliya , chunacheh uss ney apney bhai ko qatal ker daala , aur na-muradon mein shamil hogaya .

ayahs.text: phir Allah ney aik kawwa bheja jo zameen khodney laga takay ussay dikhaye kay woh apney bhai ki laash kaisay chupaye .   ( yeh dekh ker ) woh bola  haaye afsos ! kiya mein iss kawway jaisa bhi naa hosaka kay apney bhai ki laash chupa deta .  iss tarah baad mein woh bara sharminda huwa .
ayahs.translation: phir Allah ney aik kawwa bheja jo zameen khodney laga takay ussay dikhaye kay woh apney bhai ki laash kaisay chupaye .   ( yeh dekh ker ) woh bola  haaye afsos ! kiya mein iss kawway jaisa bhi naa hosaka kay apney bhai ki laash chupa deta .  iss tarah baad mein woh bara sharminda huwa .

ayahs.text: issi wajeh say hum ney bani Israel ko yeh farman likh diya tha kay jo koi kissi ko qatal keray , jabkay yeh qatal naa kissi aur jaan ka badla lenay kay liye ho aur naa kissi kay zameen mein fasad phelaney ki wajeh say ho , to yeh aisa hai jaisay uss ney tamam insanon ko qatal kerdiya ,   aur jo shaks kissi ki jaan bachaley to yeh aisa hai jaisay uss ney tamam insanon ki jaan bachali . aur waqiaa yeh hai kay humaray payghumber inn kay paas khuli khuli hidayaat ley ker aaye , magar uss kay baad bhi unn mein say boht say log zameen mein ziyadtiyan hi kertay rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: issi wajeh say hum ney bani Israel ko yeh farman likh diya tha kay jo koi kissi ko qatal keray , jabkay yeh qatal naa kissi aur jaan ka badla lenay kay liye ho aur naa kissi kay zameen mein fasad phelaney ki wajeh say ho , to yeh aisa hai jaisay uss ney tamam insanon ko qatal kerdiya ,   aur jo shaks kissi ki jaan bachaley to yeh aisa hai jaisay uss ney tamam insanon ki jaan bachali . aur waqiaa yeh hai kay humaray payghumber inn kay paas khuli khuli hidayaat ley ker aaye , magar uss kay baad bhi unn mein say boht say log zameen mein ziyadtiyan hi kertay rahey hain .

ayahs.text: jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool say larraee kertay aur zameen mein fasad machatay phirtay hain , unn ki saza yehi hai kay unhen qatal kerdiya jaye , ya sooli per charha diya jaye , ya unn kay haath paon mukhalif samton say kaat daalay jayen ,   ya unhen zameen say door kerdiya jaye .   yeh to duniya mein unn ki ruswai hai , aur aakhirat mein unn kay liye zabardast azab hai .
ayahs.translation: jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool say larraee kertay aur zameen mein fasad machatay phirtay hain , unn ki saza yehi hai kay unhen qatal kerdiya jaye , ya sooli per charha diya jaye , ya unn kay haath paon mukhalif samton say kaat daalay jayen ,   ya unhen zameen say door kerdiya jaye .   yeh to duniya mein unn ki ruswai hai , aur aakhirat mein unn kay liye zabardast azab hai .

ayahs.text: haan woh log iss say mustasna hain jo tumharay unn ko qaboo mein laney say pehlay hi tauba kerlen .   aesi soorat mein yeh jaan rakho kay Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: haan woh log iss say mustasna hain jo tumharay unn ko qaboo mein laney say pehlay hi tauba kerlen .   aesi soorat mein yeh jaan rakho kay Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah say daro , aur uss tak phonchney kay liye waseela talash kero ,   aur uss kay raastay mein jihad kero .   umeed hai kay tumhen falah hasil hogi .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah say daro , aur uss tak phonchney kay liye waseela talash kero ,   aur uss kay raastay mein jihad kero .   umeed hai kay tumhen falah hasil hogi .

ayahs.text: yaqeen rakho kay jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , agar zameen mein jitni cheezen hain woh sabb unn kay paas hon , aur itni hi aur bhi hon , takay woh qayamat kay din kay azab say bachtay kay liye woh sabb fidya mein paish kerden , tab bhi unn ki yeh paishkash qubool nahi ki jaye gi , aur unn ko dardnak azab hoga .
ayahs.translation: yaqeen rakho kay jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , agar zameen mein jitni cheezen hain woh sabb unn kay paas hon , aur itni hi aur bhi hon , takay woh qayamat kay din kay azab say bachtay kay liye woh sabb fidya mein paish kerden , tab bhi unn ki yeh paishkash qubool nahi ki jaye gi , aur unn ko dardnak azab hoga .

ayahs.text: woh chahen gay kay aag say nikal jayen , halankay woh uss say nikalney walay nahi hain , aur unn ko aisa azab hoga jo qaeem rahey ga .
ayahs.translation: woh chahen gay kay aag say nikal jayen , halankay woh uss say nikalney walay nahi hain , aur unn ko aisa azab hoga jo qaeem rahey ga .

ayahs.text: aur jo mard chori keray aur jo aurat chori keray , dono kay haath kaat do , takay unn ko apney kiye ka badla milay , aur Allah ki taraf say ibrat naak saza ho . aur Allah sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , sahab-e-hikmat bhi
ayahs.translation: aur jo mard chori keray aur jo aurat chori keray , dono kay haath kaat do , takay unn ko apney kiye ka badla milay , aur Allah ki taraf say ibrat naak saza ho . aur Allah sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , sahab-e-hikmat bhi

ayahs.text: phir jo shaks apni zalimana kaarawai say tauba kerlay , aur moamlaat durust kerlay , to Allah uss ki tauba qubool kerlay ga .   beyshak Allah taalaa boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: phir jo shaks apni zalimana kaarawai say tauba kerlay , aur moamlaat durust kerlay , to Allah uss ki tauba qubool kerlay ga .   beyshak Allah taalaa boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: kiya tum nahi jantay kay aasmano aur zameen ki hukmrani sirf Allah kay paas hai-? woh jiss ko chahye azab dey , aur jiss ko chahye bakhsh dey , aur Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai .
ayahs.translation: kiya tum nahi jantay kay aasmano aur zameen ki hukmrani sirf Allah kay paas hai-? woh jiss ko chahye azab dey , aur jiss ko chahye bakhsh dey , aur Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai .

ayahs.text: aey payghumber ! jo log kufr mein bari tezi dikha rahey hain , woh tumhen ghum mein mubtala naa keren ,   yani aik to woh log hain jinhon ney zaban say to keh diya hai kay hum emaan ley aaye hain , magar unn kay dil emaan nahi laye , aur doosray woh log hain jinhon ney ( khulay bandon ) yahoodiyat ka deen ikhtiyar kerliya hai . yeh log jhooti baaten kaan laga laga ker sunney walay hain ,   ( aur tumhari baaten ) unn logon  ki khatir suntay hain jo tumharay paas nahi aaye ,   jo ( Allah ki kitab kay ) alfaz ka moaqa mehal tey hojaney kay baad bhi unn mein tehreef kertay hain . kehtay hain kay agar tumhen yeh hukum diya jaye to iss ko qubool kerlena , aur agar yeh hukum naa diya jaye to bach ker rehna . aur jiss shaks ko Allah fitney mein daalney ka irada kerlay to ussay Allah say bachaney kay liye tumhara koi zor hergiz nahi chal sakta . yeh woh log hain kay ( unn ki nafarmani ki wajeh say ) Allah ney unn kay dilon ko pak kernay ka irada nahi kiya .   unn kay liye duniya mein ruswai hai , aur unhi kay liye aakhirat mein zabardast azab hai .
ayahs.translation: aey payghumber ! jo log kufr mein bari tezi dikha rahey hain , woh tumhen ghum mein mubtala naa keren ,   yani aik to woh log hain jinhon ney zaban say to keh diya hai kay hum emaan ley aaye hain , magar unn kay dil emaan nahi laye , aur doosray woh log hain jinhon ney ( khulay bandon ) yahoodiyat ka deen ikhtiyar kerliya hai . yeh log jhooti baaten kaan laga laga ker sunney walay hain ,   ( aur tumhari baaten ) unn logon  ki khatir suntay hain jo tumharay paas nahi aaye ,   jo ( Allah ki kitab kay ) alfaz ka moaqa mehal tey hojaney kay baad bhi unn mein tehreef kertay hain . kehtay hain kay agar tumhen yeh hukum diya jaye to iss ko qubool kerlena , aur agar yeh hukum naa diya jaye to bach ker rehna . aur jiss shaks ko Allah fitney mein daalney ka irada kerlay to ussay Allah say bachaney kay liye tumhara koi zor hergiz nahi chal sakta . yeh woh log hain kay ( unn ki nafarmani ki wajeh say ) Allah ney unn kay dilon ko pak kernay ka irada nahi kiya .   unn kay liye duniya mein ruswai hai , aur unhi kay liye aakhirat mein zabardast azab hai .

ayahs.text: yeh kaan laga laga ker jhooti baaten sunney walay , ji bhar bhar ker haram khaney walay hain .   chunacheh agar yeh tumharay paas ayen to chahye inn kay darmiyan faisla kerdo , aur chahye inn say mun morr lo .   agar tum inn say mun morr lo gay to yeh tumhen koi nuqsan nahi phoncha saken gay , aur agar faisla kerna ho to insaf say faisla kero . yaqeenan Allah insaf kernay walon say mohabbat kerta hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh kaan laga laga ker jhooti baaten sunney walay , ji bhar bhar ker haram khaney walay hain .   chunacheh agar yeh tumharay paas ayen to chahye inn kay darmiyan faisla kerdo , aur chahye inn say mun morr lo .   agar tum inn say mun morr lo gay to yeh tumhen koi nuqsan nahi phoncha saken gay , aur agar faisla kerna ho to insaf say faisla kero . yaqeenan Allah insaf kernay walon say mohabbat kerta hai .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kaisay tum say faisla lena chahtay hain jabkay inn kay paas toraat mojood hai jiss mein Allah ka faisla darj hai-? phir uss kay baad ( faislay say ) mun bhi pher letay hain .   darasal yeh emaan walay nahi hain .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kaisay tum say faisla lena chahtay hain jabkay inn kay paas toraat mojood hai jiss mein Allah ka faisla darj hai-? phir uss kay baad ( faislay say ) mun bhi pher letay hain .   darasal yeh emaan walay nahi hain .

ayahs.text: beyshak hum ney toraat nazil ki thi jiss mein hidayat thi aur noor tha . tamam nabi jo Allah taalaa kay farmanbardaar thay , issi kay mutabiq yahudiyon kay moamlaat ka faisla kertay thay , aur tamam Allah walay aur ulama bhi ( issi per amal kertay rahey ) kiyonkay unn ko Allah ki kitab ka mohafiz banaya gaya tha , aur woh uss kay gawah thay . lehaza ( aey yahudiyo ! ) tum logon  say naa daro , aur mujh say daro , aur thori si qeemat lenay ki khatir meri aayaton ka soda naa kiya kero . aur jo log Allah kay nazil kiye huye hukum kay mutabiq faisla naa keren , woh log kafir hain .
ayahs.translation: beyshak hum ney toraat nazil ki thi jiss mein hidayat thi aur noor tha . tamam nabi jo Allah taalaa kay farmanbardaar thay , issi kay mutabiq yahudiyon kay moamlaat ka faisla kertay thay , aur tamam Allah walay aur ulama bhi ( issi per amal kertay rahey ) kiyonkay unn ko Allah ki kitab ka mohafiz banaya gaya tha , aur woh uss kay gawah thay . lehaza ( aey yahudiyo ! ) tum logon  say naa daro , aur mujh say daro , aur thori si qeemat lenay ki khatir meri aayaton ka soda naa kiya kero . aur jo log Allah kay nazil kiye huye hukum kay mutabiq faisla naa keren , woh log kafir hain .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney iss ( toraat mein ) unn kay liye yeh hukum likh diya tha kay jaan kay badlay jaan , aankh kay badlay aankh , naak kay badlay naak , kaan kay badlay kaan , daant kay badlay daant . aur zakhmo ka bhi ( issi tarah ) badla liya jaye . haan jo shaks iss ( badlay ) ko moaaf kerday to yeh uss kay liye gunahon ka kaffara hojaye ga . aur jo log Allah kay nazil kiye huye hukum kay mutabiq faisla naa keren , woh log zalim hain .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney iss ( toraat mein ) unn kay liye yeh hukum likh diya tha kay jaan kay badlay jaan , aankh kay badlay aankh , naak kay badlay naak , kaan kay badlay kaan , daant kay badlay daant . aur zakhmo ka bhi ( issi tarah ) badla liya jaye . haan jo shaks iss ( badlay ) ko moaaf kerday to yeh uss kay liye gunahon ka kaffara hojaye ga . aur jo log Allah kay nazil kiye huye hukum kay mutabiq faisla naa keren , woh log zalim hain .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney unn ( payghumberon ) kay baad essa ibn-e-maryam ko apney say pehli kitab yani toraat ki tasdeeq kernay wala bana ker bheja , aur hum ney unn ko injeel ata ki jiss mein hidayat thi aur noor tha , aur jo apney say pehli kitab yani toraat ki tasdeeq kernay wali aur muttaqiyo kay liye sarapa hidayat o naseehat ban ker aai thi .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney unn ( payghumberon ) kay baad essa ibn-e-maryam ko apney say pehli kitab yani toraat ki tasdeeq kernay wala bana ker bheja , aur hum ney unn ko injeel ata ki jiss mein hidayat thi aur noor tha , aur jo apney say pehli kitab yani toraat ki tasdeeq kernay wali aur muttaqiyo kay liye sarapa hidayat o naseehat ban ker aai thi .

ayahs.text: aur injeel walon ko chahiye kay Allah ney uss mein jo kuch nazil kiya hai , uss kay mutabiq faisla keren , aur jo log Allah kay nazil kiye huye hukum kay mutabiq faisla naa keren , woh log fasiq hain .
ayahs.translation: aur injeel walon ko chahiye kay Allah ney uss mein jo kuch nazil kiya hai , uss kay mutabiq faisla keren , aur jo log Allah kay nazil kiye huye hukum kay mutabiq faisla naa keren , woh log fasiq hain .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey Rasool Muhammad ! SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) hum ney tum per bhi haq per mushtamil kitab nazil ki hai jo apney say pehli kitabon ki tasdeeq kerti hai aur unn ki nigehban hai . lehaza inn logon  kay darmiyan ussi hukum kay mutabiq faisla kero jo Allah ney nazil kiya hai , aur jo haq baat tumharay paas aagae hai ussay chorr ker unn ki khuwaishaat kay peechay naa chalo . tum mein say her aik ( ummat ) kay liye hum ney aik ( alag ) shariyat aur tareeqa muqarrar kiya hai .   aur agar Allah chahta to tum sabb ko aik ummat bana deta , lekin ( alag shariyaten iss liye den ) takay jo kuch uss ney tumhen diya hai uss mein tumhen aazamaye . lehaza naikiyon mein aik doosray say aagay barhney ki koshish kero . Allah hi ki taraf tum sabb ko loat ker jana hai . uss waqt woh tumhen woh baaten bataye ga jinn mein tum ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey Rasool Muhammad ! SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) hum ney tum per bhi haq per mushtamil kitab nazil ki hai jo apney say pehli kitabon ki tasdeeq kerti hai aur unn ki nigehban hai . lehaza inn logon  kay darmiyan ussi hukum kay mutabiq faisla kero jo Allah ney nazil kiya hai , aur jo haq baat tumharay paas aagae hai ussay chorr ker unn ki khuwaishaat kay peechay naa chalo . tum mein say her aik ( ummat ) kay liye hum ney aik ( alag ) shariyat aur tareeqa muqarrar kiya hai .   aur agar Allah chahta to tum sabb ko aik ummat bana deta , lekin ( alag shariyaten iss liye den ) takay jo kuch uss ney tumhen diya hai uss mein tumhen aazamaye . lehaza naikiyon mein aik doosray say aagay barhney ki koshish kero . Allah hi ki taraf tum sabb ko loat ker jana hai . uss waqt woh tumhen woh baaten bataye ga jinn mein tum ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: aur ( hum hukum detay hain ) kay tum inn logon  kay darmiyan ussi hukum kay mutabiq faisla kero jo Allah ney nazil kiya hai   aur unn ki khuwaishaat ki perwi naa kero , aur unn ki iss baat say bach ker raho kay woh tumhen fitney mein daal ker kissi aesay hukum say hata den jo Allah ney tum per nazil kiya ho . iss per agar woh mun morren to jaan rakho kay Allah ney unn kay baaz gunahon ki wajeh say unn ko museebat mein mubtala kernay ka irada ker rakha hai .   aur inn logon  mein say boht say fasiq hain .
ayahs.translation: aur ( hum hukum detay hain ) kay tum inn logon  kay darmiyan ussi hukum kay mutabiq faisla kero jo Allah ney nazil kiya hai   aur unn ki khuwaishaat ki perwi naa kero , aur unn ki iss baat say bach ker raho kay woh tumhen fitney mein daal ker kissi aesay hukum say hata den jo Allah ney tum per nazil kiya ho . iss per agar woh mun morren to jaan rakho kay Allah ney unn kay baaz gunahon ki wajeh say unn ko museebat mein mubtala kernay ka irada ker rakha hai .   aur inn logon  mein say boht say fasiq hain .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya yeh jahiliyat ka faisla hasil kerna chahtay hain-? halankay jo log yaqeen rakhtay hon unn kay liye Allah say acha faisla kernay wala kon hosakta hai ?
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya yeh jahiliyat ka faisla hasil kerna chahtay hain-? halankay jo log yaqeen rakhtay hon unn kay liye Allah say acha faisla kernay wala kon hosakta hai ?

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! yahudiyon aur nasraniyon ko yaar-o-madadgaar naa banao .   yeh khud hi aik doosray kay yaar-o-madadgaar hain . aur tum mein say jo shaks inn ki dosti ka dum bharay ga to phir woh inhi mein say hoga . yaqeenan Allah zalim logon  ko hidayat nahi deta .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! yahudiyon aur nasraniyon ko yaar-o-madadgaar naa banao .   yeh khud hi aik doosray kay yaar-o-madadgaar hain . aur tum mein say jo shaks inn ki dosti ka dum bharay ga to phir woh inhi mein say hoga . yaqeenan Allah zalim logon  ko hidayat nahi deta .

ayahs.text: chunacheh jinn logon  kay dilon mein ( nifaq ka ) rog hai , tum unhen dekhtay ho kay woh lapak lapak ker unn mein ghustay hain , kehtay hain :  hamen darr hai kay hum per koi museebat ka chakkar aa-parey ga    ( lekin ) kuch baeed nahi kay Allah ( musalmanon ko ) fatah ata farmaye ya apni taraf say koi aur baat zahir kerday ,   aur uss waqt yeh log uss baat per pachtayen jo unhon ney apney dilon mein chupa rakhi thi .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh jinn logon  kay dilon mein ( nifaq ka ) rog hai , tum unhen dekhtay ho kay woh lapak lapak ker unn mein ghustay hain , kehtay hain :  hamen darr hai kay hum per koi museebat ka chakkar aa-parey ga    ( lekin ) kuch baeed nahi kay Allah ( musalmanon ko ) fatah ata farmaye ya apni taraf say koi aur baat zahir kerday ,   aur uss waqt yeh log uss baat per pachtayen jo unhon ney apney dilon mein chupa rakhi thi .

ayahs.text: aur ( uss waqt ) emaan walay ( aik doosray say ) kahen gay kay kiya yeh wohi log hain jinhon ney baray zor o shor say Allah ki qasmen khai then kay woh tumharay sath hain . unn kay aemal gharat hogaye , aur woh na-murad ho ker rahey .
ayahs.translation: aur ( uss waqt ) emaan walay ( aik doosray say ) kahen gay kay kiya yeh wohi log hain jinhon ney baray zor o shor say Allah ki qasmen khai then kay woh tumharay sath hain . unn kay aemal gharat hogaye , aur woh na-murad ho ker rahey .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! agar tum mein say koi apney deen say phir jaye ga to Allah aesay log peda kerday ga jinn say woh mohabbat kerta hoga , aur woh uss say mohabbat kertay hon gay , jo mominon kay liye naram aur kafiron kay liye sakht hon gay , Allah kay raastay mein jihad keren gay , aur kissi malamat kernay walay ki malamat say nahi daren gay . yeh Allah ka fazal hai jo woh jiss ko chahta hai ata farmata hai , aur Allah bari wusat wala , baray ilm wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! agar tum mein say koi apney deen say phir jaye ga to Allah aesay log peda kerday ga jinn say woh mohabbat kerta hoga , aur woh uss say mohabbat kertay hon gay , jo mominon kay liye naram aur kafiron kay liye sakht hon gay , Allah kay raastay mein jihad keren gay , aur kissi malamat kernay walay ki malamat say nahi daren gay . yeh Allah ka fazal hai jo woh jiss ko chahta hai ata farmata hai , aur Allah bari wusat wala , baray ilm wala hai .

ayahs.text: . ( musalmano ! ) tumharay yaar-o-madadgaar to Allah , uss kay Rasool aur woh emaan walay hain jo iss tarah namaz qaeem kertay aur zakat ada kertay hain kay woh ( dil say ) Allah kay aagay jhukay huye hotay hain .
ayahs.translation: . ( musalmano ! ) tumharay yaar-o-madadgaar to Allah , uss kay Rasool aur woh emaan walay hain jo iss tarah namaz qaeem kertay aur zakat ada kertay hain kay woh ( dil say ) Allah kay aagay jhukay huye hotay hain .

ayahs.text: aur jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool ko aur emaan walon ko dost banaye to ( woh Allah ki jamat mein shamil hojata hai aur ) Allah ki jamat hi ghalba paaney wali hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool ko aur emaan walon ko dost banaye to ( woh Allah ki jamat mein shamil hojata hai aur ) Allah ki jamat hi ghalba paaney wali hai .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! jinn logon  ko tum say pehlay kitab di gaee thi unn mein say aesay logon ko jinhon ney tumharay deen ko mazaq aur khel bana rakha hai aur kafiron ko yaar-o-madadgaar naa banao , aur agar tum waqaee sahab-e-emaan ho to Allah say dartay raho .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! jinn logon  ko tum say pehlay kitab di gaee thi unn mein say aesay logon ko jinhon ney tumharay deen ko mazaq aur khel bana rakha hai aur kafiron ko yaar-o-madadgaar naa banao , aur agar tum waqaee sahab-e-emaan ho to Allah say dartay raho .

ayahs.text: aur jab tum namaz kay liye ( logon  ko ) pukartay ho to woh uss ( pukar ) ko mazaq aur khel ka nishana banatay hain . yeh sabb ( harkaten ) iss wajeh say hain kay inn logon  ko aqal nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jab tum namaz kay liye ( logon  ko ) pukartay ho to woh uss ( pukar ) ko mazaq aur khel ka nishana banatay hain . yeh sabb ( harkaten ) iss wajeh say hain kay inn logon  ko aqal nahi hai .

ayahs.text: tum ( inn say ) kaho kay :  aey ehal-e-kitab ! tumhen iss kay siwa humari kon si baat buri lagti hai kay hum Allah per aur jo kalam hum per utaara gaya uss per aur jo pehlay utaara gaya tha uss per emaan ley aaye hain , jabkay tum mein say aksar log nafarman hain-?
ayahs.translation: tum ( inn say ) kaho kay :  aey ehal-e-kitab ! tumhen iss kay siwa humari kon si baat buri lagti hai kay hum Allah per aur jo kalam hum per utaara gaya uss per aur jo pehlay utaara gaya tha uss per emaan ley aaye hain , jabkay tum mein say aksar log nafarman hain-?

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho kay :  kiya mein tumhen bataon kay ( jiss baat ko tum bura samajh rahey ho ) uss say ziyada buray anjam walay kon hain-? yeh woh log hain jinn per Allah ney phitkaar daali , jinn per apna ghazab nazil kiya , jinn mein say logon  ko bandar aur soowar banaya , aur jinhon ney shetan ki parastish ki ! woh log hain jinn ka thikana bhi bad-tareen hai aur woh seedhay raastay say bhi boht bhatkay huye hain .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho kay :  kiya mein tumhen bataon kay ( jiss baat ko tum bura samajh rahey ho ) uss say ziyada buray anjam walay kon hain-? yeh woh log hain jinn per Allah ney phitkaar daali , jinn per apna ghazab nazil kiya , jinn mein say logon  ko bandar aur soowar banaya , aur jinhon ney shetan ki parastish ki ! woh log hain jinn ka thikana bhi bad-tareen hai aur woh seedhay raastay say bhi boht bhatkay huye hain .

ayahs.text: aur jab yeh tumharay paas aatay hain to kehtay hain kay  hum emaan ley aaye hain  halankay yeh kufr ley ker hi aaye thay , aur ussi kufr ko ley ker bahir niklay hain . aur Allah khoob janta hai kay yeh kiya kuch chupatay rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jab yeh tumharay paas aatay hain to kehtay hain kay  hum emaan ley aaye hain  halankay yeh kufr ley ker hi aaye thay , aur ussi kufr ko ley ker bahir niklay hain . aur Allah khoob janta hai kay yeh kiya kuch chupatay rahey hain .

ayahs.text: aur inn mein say boht son ko tum dekho gay kay woh gunah , zulm aur haram khori mein lapak lapak ker aagay barhtay hain . sach to yeh hai kay jo harkaten yeh kertay hain woh nihayat buri hain .
ayahs.translation: aur inn mein say boht son ko tum dekho gay kay woh gunah , zulm aur haram khori mein lapak lapak ker aagay barhtay hain . sach to yeh hai kay jo harkaten yeh kertay hain woh nihayat buri hain .

ayahs.text: inn kay mashaeeq aur ulama inn ko gunah ki baaten kehney aur haram khaney say aakhir kiyon mana nahi kertay-? haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn ka yeh tarz-e-amal nihayat bura hai
ayahs.translation: inn kay mashaeeq aur ulama inn ko gunah ki baaten kehney aur haram khaney say aakhir kiyon mana nahi kertay-? haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn ka yeh tarz-e-amal nihayat bura hai

ayahs.text: aur yahudi kehtay hain kay  Allah kay haath banday huye hain    haath to khud inn kay bandhay huye hain , aur jo baat unhon ney kahi hai uss ki wajeh say inn per lanat alag parri hai , werna Allah kay dono haath poori tarah kushada hain , woh jiss tarah chahta hai kharch kerta hai . aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jo wahi tum per nazil ki gaee hai woh inn mein say boht son ki sarkashi aur kufr mein mazeed izafa ker kay rahey gi , aur hum ney inn kay darmiyan qayamat kay din tak kay liye adawat aur bughz peda kerdiya hai . jab kabhi yeh jang ki aag bharkatay hain , Allah uss ko bujha deta hai ,   aur yeh zameen mein fasad machatay phirtay hain , jabkay Allah fasad machaney walon ko pasand nahi kerta .
ayahs.translation: aur yahudi kehtay hain kay  Allah kay haath banday huye hain    haath to khud inn kay bandhay huye hain , aur jo baat unhon ney kahi hai uss ki wajeh say inn per lanat alag parri hai , werna Allah kay dono haath poori tarah kushada hain , woh jiss tarah chahta hai kharch kerta hai . aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jo wahi tum per nazil ki gaee hai woh inn mein say boht son ki sarkashi aur kufr mein mazeed izafa ker kay rahey gi , aur hum ney inn kay darmiyan qayamat kay din tak kay liye adawat aur bughz peda kerdiya hai . jab kabhi yeh jang ki aag bharkatay hain , Allah uss ko bujha deta hai ,   aur yeh zameen mein fasad machatay phirtay hain , jabkay Allah fasad machaney walon ko pasand nahi kerta .

ayahs.text: aur agar ehal-e-kitab emaan ley aatay aur taqwa ikhtiyar kertay to hum zaroor unn ki buraiyan moaaf ker-detay , aur unhen zaroor aaram o rahat kay baaghaat mein dakhil kertay .
ayahs.translation: aur agar ehal-e-kitab emaan ley aatay aur taqwa ikhtiyar kertay to hum zaroor unn ki buraiyan moaaf ker-detay , aur unhen zaroor aaram o rahat kay baaghaat mein dakhil kertay .

ayahs.text: aur agar woh toraat aur injeel aur jo kitab ( abb ) inn kay paas inn kay rab ki taraf say bheji gaee hai uss ki theek theek pabandi kertay to woh apney oopper aur apney paon kay neechay her taraf say ( Allah ka rizq ) khatay . ( agar-cheh ) unn mein aik jamat raah-e-raast per chalney wali bhi hai , magar inn mein say boht say log aesay hi hain kay unn kay aemal kharab hain .
ayahs.translation: aur agar woh toraat aur injeel aur jo kitab ( abb ) inn kay paas inn kay rab ki taraf say bheji gaee hai uss ki theek theek pabandi kertay to woh apney oopper aur apney paon kay neechay her taraf say ( Allah ka rizq ) khatay . ( agar-cheh ) unn mein aik jamat raah-e-raast per chalney wali bhi hai , magar inn mein say boht say log aesay hi hain kay unn kay aemal kharab hain .

ayahs.text: aey Rasool ! jo kuch tumharay rab ki taraf say tum per nazil kiya gaya hai uss ki tableegh kero . aur agar aisa nahi kero gay to ( iss ka matlab yeh hoga kay ) tum ney Allah ka paygham nahi phonchaya . aur Allah tumhen logon  ( ki sazishon ) say bachaye ga . yaqeen rakho kay Allah kafir logon  ko hidayat nahi deta .
ayahs.translation: aey Rasool ! jo kuch tumharay rab ki taraf say tum per nazil kiya gaya hai uss ki tableegh kero . aur agar aisa nahi kero gay to ( iss ka matlab yeh hoga kay ) tum ney Allah ka paygham nahi phonchaya . aur Allah tumhen logon  ( ki sazishon ) say bachaye ga . yaqeen rakho kay Allah kafir logon  ko hidayat nahi deta .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  aey ehal-e-kitab ! jab tak tum toraat aur injeel per aur jo ( kitab ) tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say tumharay paas ( abb ) bheji gaee hai uss ki poori pabandi nahi kero gay , tumhari koi buniyad nahi hogi jiss per tum kharray hosako .  aur ( aey Rasool ! ) jo wahi tum per tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say nazil ki gaee hai woh inn mein say boht son ki sarkashi aur kufr mein mazeed izafa ker kay rahey gi , lehaza tum inn kafir logon  per afsos matt kerna .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  aey ehal-e-kitab ! jab tak tum toraat aur injeel per aur jo ( kitab ) tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say tumharay paas ( abb ) bheji gaee hai uss ki poori pabandi nahi kero gay , tumhari koi buniyad nahi hogi jiss per tum kharray hosako .  aur ( aey Rasool ! ) jo wahi tum per tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say nazil ki gaee hai woh inn mein say boht son ki sarkashi aur kufr mein mazeed izafa ker kay rahey gi , lehaza tum inn kafir logon  per afsos matt kerna .

ayahs.text: haq to yeh hai kay jo log bhi , khuwa woh musalman hon ya yahudi ya saabi ya nasrani , Allah aur aakhirat kay din per emaan ley ayen gay aur naik amal keren gay unn ko naa koi khof hoga , naa woh kissi ghum mein mubtala hon gay .
ayahs.translation: haq to yeh hai kay jo log bhi , khuwa woh musalman hon ya yahudi ya saabi ya nasrani , Allah aur aakhirat kay din per emaan ley ayen gay aur naik amal keren gay unn ko naa koi khof hoga , naa woh kissi ghum mein mubtala hon gay .

ayahs.text: hum ney bano Israel say ehad liya tha , aur unn kay paas Rasool bhejay thay . jab koi Rasool unn kay paas koi aesi baat ley ker aata jiss ko inn ka dil nahi chahta tha to kuch ( Rasoolon ) ko unhon ney jhutlaya aur kuch ko qatal kertay rahey .
ayahs.translation: hum ney bano Israel say ehad liya tha , aur unn kay paas Rasool bhejay thay . jab koi Rasool unn kay paas koi aesi baat ley ker aata jiss ko inn ka dil nahi chahta tha to kuch ( Rasoolon ) ko unhon ney jhutlaya aur kuch ko qatal kertay rahey .

ayahs.text: aur woh yeh samajh bethay kay koi pakar nahi hogi , iss liye andhay behray ban gaye , phir Allah ney unn ki tauba qubool ki to unn mein say boht say phir andhay behray ban gaye , aur Allah unn kay tamam aemal ko khoob dekh raha hai .
ayahs.translation: aur woh yeh samajh bethay kay koi pakar nahi hogi , iss liye andhay behray ban gaye , phir Allah ney unn ki tauba qubool ki to unn mein say boht say phir andhay behray ban gaye , aur Allah unn kay tamam aemal ko khoob dekh raha hai .

ayahs.text: woh log yaqeenan kafir hochukay hain jinhon ney yeh kaha hai kay  Allah maseeh ibn-e-maryam hi hai  halankay maseeh ney to yeh kaha tha kay  aey bani Israel ! Allah ki ibadat kero jo mera bhi perwerdigar hai aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar . yaqeen jaano kay jo shaks Allah kay sath kissi ko shareek thehraye , Allah ney uss kay liye jannat haram kerdi hai , aur uss ka thikana jahannum hai , aur jo log ( yeh ) zulm kertay hain , unn ko kissi qisam kay yaar-o-madadgaar moyassar nahi ayen gay .
ayahs.translation: woh log yaqeenan kafir hochukay hain jinhon ney yeh kaha hai kay  Allah maseeh ibn-e-maryam hi hai  halankay maseeh ney to yeh kaha tha kay  aey bani Israel ! Allah ki ibadat kero jo mera bhi perwerdigar hai aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar . yaqeen jaano kay jo shaks Allah kay sath kissi ko shareek thehraye , Allah ney uss kay liye jannat haram kerdi hai , aur uss ka thikana jahannum hai , aur jo log ( yeh ) zulm kertay hain , unn ko kissi qisam kay yaar-o-madadgaar moyassar nahi ayen gay .

ayahs.text: woh log ( bhi ) yaqeenan kafir hochukay hain jinhon ney yeh kaha hai kay :  Allah teen mein ka teesra hai    halankay aik khuda kay siwa koi khuda nahi hai . aur agar yeh log apni iss baat say baaz naa aaye to inn mein say jinn logon  ney ( aesay ) kufr ka irtikab kiya hai , unn ko dardnak azab pakar ker rahey ga .
ayahs.translation: woh log ( bhi ) yaqeenan kafir hochukay hain jinhon ney yeh kaha hai kay :  Allah teen mein ka teesra hai    halankay aik khuda kay siwa koi khuda nahi hai . aur agar yeh log apni iss baat say baaz naa aaye to inn mein say jinn logon  ney ( aesay ) kufr ka irtikab kiya hai , unn ko dardnak azab pakar ker rahey ga .

ayahs.text: kiya phir bhi yeh log moaafi kay liye Allah ki taraf rujoo nahi keren gay , aur uss say maghfirat nahi maangen gay-? halankay Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai !
ayahs.translation: kiya phir bhi yeh log moaafi kay liye Allah ki taraf rujoo nahi keren gay , aur uss say maghfirat nahi maangen gay-? halankay Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai !

ayahs.text: maseeh ibn-e-maryam to aik Rasool thay , iss say ziyada kuch nahi , unn say pehlay ( bhi ) boht say Rasool guzar chukay hain , aur unn ki maa siddiqa then . yeh dono khana khatay thay .   dekho ! hum inn kay samney kiss tarah khol khol ker nishaniyan wazeh ker rahey hain ! phir yeh bhi dekho kay inn ko ondhay mun kahan ley jaya jaraha hai !
ayahs.translation: maseeh ibn-e-maryam to aik Rasool thay , iss say ziyada kuch nahi , unn say pehlay ( bhi ) boht say Rasool guzar chukay hain , aur unn ki maa siddiqa then . yeh dono khana khatay thay .   dekho ! hum inn kay samney kiss tarah khol khol ker nishaniyan wazeh ker rahey hain ! phir yeh bhi dekho kay inn ko ondhay mun kahan ley jaya jaraha hai !

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho kay :  kiya tum Allah kay siwa aesi makhlooq ki ibadat kertay ho jo tumhen naa koi nuqsan phonchaney ki taqat rakhti hai , aur naa faeeda phonchaney ki ,   jabkay Allah her baat ko sunney wala , her cheez ko janney wala hai ?
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho kay :  kiya tum Allah kay siwa aesi makhlooq ki ibadat kertay ho jo tumhen naa koi nuqsan phonchaney ki taqat rakhti hai , aur naa faeeda phonchaney ki ,   jabkay Allah her baat ko sunney wala , her cheez ko janney wala hai ?

ayahs.text: . ( aur inn say yeh bhi kaho kay : )  aey ehal-e-kitab ! apney deen mein nahaq ghulw naa kero ,   aur unn logon  ki khuwaishaat kay peechay naa chalo jo pehlay khud bhi gumrah huye , boht say doosron ko bhi gumrah kiya , aur seedhay raastay say bhatak gaye .
ayahs.translation: . ( aur inn say yeh bhi kaho kay : )  aey ehal-e-kitab ! apney deen mein nahaq ghulw naa kero ,   aur unn logon  ki khuwaishaat kay peechay naa chalo jo pehlay khud bhi gumrah huye , boht say doosron ko bhi gumrah kiya , aur seedhay raastay say bhatak gaye .

ayahs.text: bani Israel kay jo log kafir huye unn per dawood aur essa ibn-e-maryam ki zaban say lanat bheji gaee thi .   yeh sabb iss liye huwa kay unhon ney nafarmani ki thi , aur woh hadd say guzar jaya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: bani Israel kay jo log kafir huye unn per dawood aur essa ibn-e-maryam ki zaban say lanat bheji gaee thi .   yeh sabb iss liye huwa kay unhon ney nafarmani ki thi , aur woh hadd say guzar jaya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: woh jiss badi ka irtikab kertay thay , iss say aik doosray ko mana nahi kertay thay . haqeeqat yeh hai kay unn ka yeh tarz-e-amal nihayat bura tha .
ayahs.translation: woh jiss badi ka irtikab kertay thay , iss say aik doosray ko mana nahi kertay thay . haqeeqat yeh hai kay unn ka yeh tarz-e-amal nihayat bura tha .

ayahs.text: tum unn mein say boht son ko dekhtay ho kay unhon ney ( butt parast ) kafiron ko apna dost banaya huwa hai .   yaqeenan jo kuch unhon ney apney haq mein apney aagay bhej rakha hai woh boht bura hai kiyonkay ( inn ki wajeh say ) Allah unn say naraz hogaya hai , aur woh hamesha azab mein rahen gay .
ayahs.translation: tum unn mein say boht son ko dekhtay ho kay unhon ney ( butt parast ) kafiron ko apna dost banaya huwa hai .   yaqeenan jo kuch unhon ney apney haq mein apney aagay bhej rakha hai woh boht bura hai kiyonkay ( inn ki wajeh say ) Allah unn say naraz hogaya hai , aur woh hamesha azab mein rahen gay .

ayahs.text: agar yeh log Allah per aur nabi per aur jo kalam unn per nazil huwa hai uss per emaan rakhtay to inn ( butt paraston ) ko dost naa banatay , lekin ( baat yeh hai kay ) inn mein ziyada tadaad unn ki hai jo nafarman hain .
ayahs.translation: agar yeh log Allah per aur nabi per aur jo kalam unn per nazil huwa hai uss per emaan rakhtay to inn ( butt paraston ) ko dost naa banatay , lekin ( baat yeh hai kay ) inn mein ziyada tadaad unn ki hai jo nafarman hain .

ayahs.text: tum yeh baat zaroor mehsoos kerlo gay kay musalmanon say sabb say sakht dushmani rakhney walay aik to yahudi hain , aur doosray woh log hain jo ( khul ker ) shirk kertay hain . aur tum yeh baat bhi zaroor mehsoos kerlo gay kay ( ghair muslimon mein ) musalmanon say dosti mein qareeb tarr woh log hain jinhon ney apney aap ko nasrani kaha hai . iss ki wajeh yeh hai kay unn mein boht say ilm dost aalam aur boht say tarak-ud-duniya darwaish hain ,   neez yeh wajeh bhi hai kay woh takabbur nahi kertay .
ayahs.translation: tum yeh baat zaroor mehsoos kerlo gay kay musalmanon say sabb say sakht dushmani rakhney walay aik to yahudi hain , aur doosray woh log hain jo ( khul ker ) shirk kertay hain . aur tum yeh baat bhi zaroor mehsoos kerlo gay kay ( ghair muslimon mein ) musalmanon say dosti mein qareeb tarr woh log hain jinhon ney apney aap ko nasrani kaha hai . iss ki wajeh yeh hai kay unn mein boht say ilm dost aalam aur boht say tarak-ud-duniya darwaish hain ,   neez yeh wajeh bhi hai kay woh takabbur nahi kertay .

ayahs.text: aur jab yeh log woh kalam suntay hain jo Rasool per nazil huwa hai to chunkay unhon ney haq ko pehchan liya hota hai , iss liye tum inn ki aankhon ko dekho gay kay woh aansoon say beh rahi hain ,   ( aur ) woh keh rahey hain kay  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum emaan ley aaye hain , lehaza gawahi denay walon kay sath humara naam bhi likh lijiye .
ayahs.translation: aur jab yeh log woh kalam suntay hain jo Rasool per nazil huwa hai to chunkay unhon ney haq ko pehchan liya hota hai , iss liye tum inn ki aankhon ko dekho gay kay woh aansoon say beh rahi hain ,   ( aur ) woh keh rahey hain kay  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum emaan ley aaye hain , lehaza gawahi denay walon kay sath humara naam bhi likh lijiye .

ayahs.text: aur hum Allah per aur jo haq humaray paas aagaya hai uss per aakhir kiyon emaan naa layen , aur phir yeh tawaqqo bhi rakhen kay humara rab hamen naik logon  mein shumar keray ga-?
ayahs.translation: aur hum Allah per aur jo haq humaray paas aagaya hai uss per aakhir kiyon emaan naa layen , aur phir yeh tawaqqo bhi rakhen kay humara rab hamen naik logon  mein shumar keray ga-?

ayahs.text: chunacheh inn kay iss qol ki wajeh say Allah inn ko woh baaghaat dey ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jinn mein woh hamesha rahen gay . yehi naiki kernay walon ka sila hai
ayahs.translation: chunacheh inn kay iss qol ki wajeh say Allah inn ko woh baaghaat dey ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jinn mein woh hamesha rahen gay . yehi naiki kernay walon ka sila hai

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya hai aur humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , woh dozakh walay log hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya hai aur humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , woh dozakh walay log hain .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah ney tumharay liye jo pakeezah cheezen halal ki hain unn ko haram qarar naa do , aur hadd say tajawuz naa kero . yaqeen jano kay Allah hadd say tajawuz kernay walon ko pasand nahi kerta .   .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah ney tumharay liye jo pakeezah cheezen halal ki hain unn ko haram qarar naa do , aur hadd say tajawuz naa kero . yaqeen jano kay Allah hadd say tajawuz kernay walon ko pasand nahi kerta .   .

ayahs.text: aur Allah ney tumhen jo rizq diya hai uss mein say halal pakeezah cheezen khao , aur jiss Allah per tum emaan rakhtay ho uss say dartay raho .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah ney tumhen jo rizq diya hai uss mein say halal pakeezah cheezen khao , aur jiss Allah per tum emaan rakhtay ho uss say dartay raho .

ayahs.text: Allah tumhari laghw qasmon per tumhari pakar nahi keray ga ,   lekin jo qasmen tum ney pukhtagi kay sath khai hon ,   unn per tumhari pakar keray ga . chunacheh iss ka kaffara yeh hai kay das miskeeno ko woh aosat darjay ka khana khilao jo tum apney ghar walon ko khilaya kertay ho , ya unn ko kapray do , ya aik ghulam ko azad kero . haan agar kissi kay paas ( inn cheezon mein say ) kuch naa ho to woh teen din rozay rakhay . yeh tumhari qasmon ka kaffara hai jab tum ney koi qasam khali ho ( aur ussay torr diya ho ) , aur apni qasmon ki hifazat kiya kero .   issi tarah Allah apni aayaten khol khol ker tumharay samney wazeh kerta hai , takay tum shukar ada kero .
ayahs.translation: Allah tumhari laghw qasmon per tumhari pakar nahi keray ga ,   lekin jo qasmen tum ney pukhtagi kay sath khai hon ,   unn per tumhari pakar keray ga . chunacheh iss ka kaffara yeh hai kay das miskeeno ko woh aosat darjay ka khana khilao jo tum apney ghar walon ko khilaya kertay ho , ya unn ko kapray do , ya aik ghulam ko azad kero . haan agar kissi kay paas ( inn cheezon mein say ) kuch naa ho to woh teen din rozay rakhay . yeh tumhari qasmon ka kaffara hai jab tum ney koi qasam khali ho ( aur ussay torr diya ho ) , aur apni qasmon ki hifazat kiya kero .   issi tarah Allah apni aayaten khol khol ker tumharay samney wazeh kerta hai , takay tum shukar ada kero .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! sharab , juoa , button kay thaan aur joye kay teer ,   yeh sabb napak shetani kaam hain , lehaza inn say bacho , takay tumhen falah hasil ho .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! sharab , juoa , button kay thaan aur joye kay teer ,   yeh sabb napak shetani kaam hain , lehaza inn say bacho , takay tumhen falah hasil ho .

ayahs.text: shetan to yehi chahta hai kay sharab aur joye kay zariye tumharay darmiyan dushmani aur bughz kay beej daal dey , aur tumhen Allah ki yaad aur namaz say rok dey . abb batao kay kiya tum ( inn cheezon say ) baaz aajao gay-?
ayahs.translation: shetan to yehi chahta hai kay sharab aur joye kay zariye tumharay darmiyan dushmani aur bughz kay beej daal dey , aur tumhen Allah ki yaad aur namaz say rok dey . abb batao kay kiya tum ( inn cheezon say ) baaz aajao gay-?

ayahs.text: aur Allah ki itaat kero , aur Rasool ki itaat kero , aur ( nafarmani say ) bachtay raho . aur agar tum ( iss hukum say ) mun morro gay to jaan rakho kay humaray Rasool per sirf yeh zimma daari hai kay woh saaf saaf tareeqay say ( Allah kay hukum ki ) tableegh kerden .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah ki itaat kero , aur Rasool ki itaat kero , aur ( nafarmani say ) bachtay raho . aur agar tum ( iss hukum say ) mun morro gay to jaan rakho kay humaray Rasool per sirf yeh zimma daari hai kay woh saaf saaf tareeqay say ( Allah kay hukum ki ) tableegh kerden .

ayahs.text: jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur naiki per kaar band rahey hain , unhon ney pehlay jo kuch khaya piya hai , uss ki wajeh say unn per koi gunah nahi hai ,   ba-shartey-kay woh aaenda inn gunahon say bachtay rahen , aur emaan rakhen aur naik amal kertay rahen , phir ( jinn cheezon say aaenda roka jaye unn say ) bacha keren , aur emaan per qaeem rahen , aur uss kay baad bhi taqwa aur ehsan ko apnayen .   Allah ehsan per amal kernay walon say mohabbat kerta hai .
ayahs.translation: jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur naiki per kaar band rahey hain , unhon ney pehlay jo kuch khaya piya hai , uss ki wajeh say unn per koi gunah nahi hai ,   ba-shartey-kay woh aaenda inn gunahon say bachtay rahen , aur emaan rakhen aur naik amal kertay rahen , phir ( jinn cheezon say aaenda roka jaye unn say ) bacha keren , aur emaan per qaeem rahen , aur uss kay baad bhi taqwa aur ehsan ko apnayen .   Allah ehsan per amal kernay walon say mohabbat kerta hai .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah tumhen shikar kay kuch janweron kay zariye zaroor aazamaye ga jo tumharay haathon aur tumharay naizon ki zadd mein aajayen gay ,   takay woh yeh jaan ley kay kon hai jo ussay dekhay baghair bhi uss say darta hai . phir jo shaks uss kay baad bhi hadd say tajawuz keray ga woh dardnak saza ka mustahiq hoga .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah tumhen shikar kay kuch janweron kay zariye zaroor aazamaye ga jo tumharay haathon aur tumharay naizon ki zadd mein aajayen gay ,   takay woh yeh jaan ley kay kon hai jo ussay dekhay baghair bhi uss say darta hai . phir jo shaks uss kay baad bhi hadd say tajawuz keray ga woh dardnak saza ka mustahiq hoga .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! jab tum ehraam ki halat mein ho to kissi shikar ko qatal naa kero . aur agar tum mein say koi ussay jaan boojh ker qatal kerday to uss ka badla dena wajib hoga ( jiss ka tareeqa yeh hoga kay ) jo janwer uss ney qatal kiya hai , uss janwer kay barabar chopayo mein say kissi janwer ko jiss ka faisla tum mein say do diyanat daar tajarba kaar aadmi keren gay , kaaba phoncha ker qurban kiya jaye , ya ( uss ki qeemat ka ) kaffara miskeeno ko khana khila ker ada kiya jaye , ya uss kay barabar rozay rakhay jayen ,   takay woh shaks apney kiye ka badla chakhay . pehlay jo kuch hochuka Allah ney ussay moaaf kerdiya , aur jo shaks dobara aisa keray ga to Allah uss say badla ley ga , aur Allah iqtidar aur intiqam ka malik hai .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! jab tum ehraam ki halat mein ho to kissi shikar ko qatal naa kero . aur agar tum mein say koi ussay jaan boojh ker qatal kerday to uss ka badla dena wajib hoga ( jiss ka tareeqa yeh hoga kay ) jo janwer uss ney qatal kiya hai , uss janwer kay barabar chopayo mein say kissi janwer ko jiss ka faisla tum mein say do diyanat daar tajarba kaar aadmi keren gay , kaaba phoncha ker qurban kiya jaye , ya ( uss ki qeemat ka ) kaffara miskeeno ko khana khila ker ada kiya jaye , ya uss kay barabar rozay rakhay jayen ,   takay woh shaks apney kiye ka badla chakhay . pehlay jo kuch hochuka Allah ney ussay moaaf kerdiya , aur jo shaks dobara aisa keray ga to Allah uss say badla ley ga , aur Allah iqtidar aur intiqam ka malik hai .

ayahs.text: tumharay liye samandar ka shikar aur uss ka khana halal kerdiya gaya hai , takay woh tumharay liye aur qaflon kay liye faeeda uthaney ka zariya banay , lekin jab tak tum halat-e-ehraam mein ho tum per khushki ka shikar haram kerdiya gaya hai , aur Allah say dartay raho jiss ki taraf tum sabb ko jama ker kay ley jaya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: tumharay liye samandar ka shikar aur uss ka khana halal kerdiya gaya hai , takay woh tumharay liye aur qaflon kay liye faeeda uthaney ka zariya banay , lekin jab tak tum halat-e-ehraam mein ho tum per khushki ka shikar haram kerdiya gaya hai , aur Allah say dartay raho jiss ki taraf tum sabb ko jama ker kay ley jaya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: Allah ney kaabay ko jo bari hurmat wala ghar hai logon  kay liye qayam-e-aman ka zariya bana diya hai , neez hurmat walay maheenay , nazraney kay janweron aur unn kay galay mein parray huye patton ko bhi ( aman ka zariya banaya hai ) ,   yeh sab is liye takay tumhen maloom ho kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai Allah ussay khoob janta hai , aur Allah her baat say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney kaabay ko jo bari hurmat wala ghar hai logon  kay liye qayam-e-aman ka zariya bana diya hai , neez hurmat walay maheenay , nazraney kay janweron aur unn kay galay mein parray huye patton ko bhi ( aman ka zariya banaya hai ) ,   yeh sab is liye takay tumhen maloom ho kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai Allah ussay khoob janta hai , aur Allah her baat say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

ayahs.text: yeh baat bhi jaan rakho kay Allah azab denay mein sakht hai , aur yeh bhi kay Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh baat bhi jaan rakho kay Allah azab denay mein sakht hai , aur yeh bhi kay Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: Rasool per siwaye tableegh kernay kay koi aur zimma daari nahi hai . aur jo kuch tum khulay bandon kertay ho aur jo kuch chupatay ho , Allah unn sabb baaton ko janta hai .
ayahs.translation: Rasool per siwaye tableegh kernay kay koi aur zimma daari nahi hai . aur jo kuch tum khulay bandon kertay ho aur jo kuch chupatay ho , Allah unn sabb baaton ko janta hai .

ayahs.text: . ( aey Rasool ! logon  say ) keh do kay napak aur pakeezah cheezen barabar nahi hoten , chahye tumhen napak cheezon ki kasrat achi lagti ho .   lehaza aey aqal walo ! Allah say dartay raho takay tumhen falah hasil ho .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey Rasool ! logon  say ) keh do kay napak aur pakeezah cheezen barabar nahi hoten , chahye tumhen napak cheezon ki kasrat achi lagti ho .   lehaza aey aqal walo ! Allah say dartay raho takay tumhen falah hasil ho .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! aesi cheezon kay baaray mein sawalaat naa kiya kero jo agar tum per zahir kerdi jayen to tumhen nagawar hon , aur agar tum unn kay baaray mein aesay waqt sawalaat kero gay jab Quran nazil kiya jaraha ho to woh tum per zahir kerdi jayen gi .   ( albatta ) Allah ney pichli baaten moaaf kerdi hain . aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara burdbaar hai .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! aesi cheezon kay baaray mein sawalaat naa kiya kero jo agar tum per zahir kerdi jayen to tumhen nagawar hon , aur agar tum unn kay baaray mein aesay waqt sawalaat kero gay jab Quran nazil kiya jaraha ho to woh tum per zahir kerdi jayen gi .   ( albatta ) Allah ney pichli baaten moaaf kerdi hain . aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara burdbaar hai .

ayahs.text: tum say pehlay aik qoam ney iss qisam kay sawalaat kiye thay , phir unn ( kay jo jawabaat diye gaye unn ) say munkir hogaye .
ayahs.translation: tum say pehlay aik qoam ney iss qisam kay sawalaat kiye thay , phir unn ( kay jo jawabaat diye gaye unn ) say munkir hogaye .

ayahs.text: Allah ney kissi janwer ko naa bahiraah banana tey kiya hai , naa saeeba , naa waseela aur naa haami ,   lekin jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya huwa hai woh Allah per jhoot baandhtay hain , aur unn mein say aksar logon  ko sahih samajh nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney kissi janwer ko naa bahiraah banana tey kiya hai , naa saeeba , naa waseela aur naa haami ,   lekin jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya huwa hai woh Allah per jhoot baandhtay hain , aur unn mein say aksar logon  ko sahih samajh nahi hai .

ayahs.text: aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay Allah ney jo kalam nazil kiya hai , uss ki taraf aur Rasool ki taraf aao , to woh kehtay hain kay :  hum ney jiss ( deen per ) apney baap dadon ko paya hai , humaray liye wohi kafi hai .  bhala agar unn kay baap daday aesay hon kay naa unn kay paas koi ilm ho , aur naa koi hidayat to kiya phir bhi ( yeh unhi kay peechay chaltay rahen gay-? )
ayahs.translation: aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay Allah ney jo kalam nazil kiya hai , uss ki taraf aur Rasool ki taraf aao , to woh kehtay hain kay :  hum ney jiss ( deen per ) apney baap dadon ko paya hai , humaray liye wohi kafi hai .  bhala agar unn kay baap daday aesay hon kay naa unn kay paas koi ilm ho , aur naa koi hidayat to kiya phir bhi ( yeh unhi kay peechay chaltay rahen gay-? )

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! tum apni fiker kero . agar tum sahih raastay per hogay to jo log gumrah hain woh tumhen koi nuqsan nahi phoncha saktay .   Allah hi ki taraf tum sabb ko loat ker jana hai . uss waqt woh tumhen bataye ga kay tum kiya amal kertay rahey ho .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! tum apni fiker kero . agar tum sahih raastay per hogay to jo log gumrah hain woh tumhen koi nuqsan nahi phoncha saktay .   Allah hi ki taraf tum sabb ko loat ker jana hai . uss waqt woh tumhen bataye ga kay tum kiya amal kertay rahey ho .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo !   jab tum mein say koi marney kay qareeb ho to wasiyyat kertay waqt aapas kay moamlaat tey kernay kay liye gawah bananey ka tareeqa yeh hai kay tum mein say do diyanat daar aadmi hon ( jo tumhari wasiyyat kay gawah banen ) ya agar tum zameen mein safar ker rahey ho , aur wahin tumhen moat ki museebat paish aajaye to gheron ( yani ghair muslimon ) mein say do shaks hojayen . phir agar tumhen koi shak parr-jaye to unn do gawahon ko namaz kay baad rok saktay ho , aur woh Allah ki qasam kha ker kahen kay hum iss gawahi kay badlay koi maali faeeda lena nahi chahtay , chahye moamla humaray kissi rishta daar hi ka kiyon naa ho , aur Allah ney hum per jiss gawahi ki zimma daari daali hai , iss ko hum nahi chupayen gay , werna hum gunehgaaron mein shumar hon gay .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo !   jab tum mein say koi marney kay qareeb ho to wasiyyat kertay waqt aapas kay moamlaat tey kernay kay liye gawah bananey ka tareeqa yeh hai kay tum mein say do diyanat daar aadmi hon ( jo tumhari wasiyyat kay gawah banen ) ya agar tum zameen mein safar ker rahey ho , aur wahin tumhen moat ki museebat paish aajaye to gheron ( yani ghair muslimon ) mein say do shaks hojayen . phir agar tumhen koi shak parr-jaye to unn do gawahon ko namaz kay baad rok saktay ho , aur woh Allah ki qasam kha ker kahen kay hum iss gawahi kay badlay koi maali faeeda lena nahi chahtay , chahye moamla humaray kissi rishta daar hi ka kiyon naa ho , aur Allah ney hum per jiss gawahi ki zimma daari daali hai , iss ko hum nahi chupayen gay , werna hum gunehgaaron mein shumar hon gay .

ayahs.text: phir baad mein agar yeh pata chalay kay unhon ney ( jhoot bol ker ) apney oopper gunah ka bojh utha liya hai to unn logon  mein say do aadmi unn ki jagah ( gawahi kay liye ) kharray hojayen jinn kay khilaf inn pehlay do aadmiyon ney gunah apney sar liya tha ,   aur woh Allah ki qasam khayen kay humari gawahi unn pehlay do aadmiyon ki gawahi kay muqablay mein ziyada sachi hai , aur hum ney ( iss gawahi mein ) koi ziyadti nahi ki hai , werna hum zalimon mein shumar hon gay .
ayahs.translation: phir baad mein agar yeh pata chalay kay unhon ney ( jhoot bol ker ) apney oopper gunah ka bojh utha liya hai to unn logon  mein say do aadmi unn ki jagah ( gawahi kay liye ) kharray hojayen jinn kay khilaf inn pehlay do aadmiyon ney gunah apney sar liya tha ,   aur woh Allah ki qasam khayen kay humari gawahi unn pehlay do aadmiyon ki gawahi kay muqablay mein ziyada sachi hai , aur hum ney ( iss gawahi mein ) koi ziyadti nahi ki hai , werna hum zalimon mein shumar hon gay .

ayahs.text: iss tareeqay mein iss baat ki ziyada umeed hai kay log ( shuroo hi mein ) theek theek gawahi den ya iss baat say daren kay ( jhooti gawahi ki soorat mein ) unn ki qasmon kay baad loata ker doosri qasmen li jayen gi ( jo humari tardeed kerden gi ) . aur Allah say daro , aur ( jo kuch uss ki taraf say kaha gaya hai ussay qubool kernay ki niyyat say ) suno . Allah nafarmano ko hidayat nahi deta .
ayahs.translation: iss tareeqay mein iss baat ki ziyada umeed hai kay log ( shuroo hi mein ) theek theek gawahi den ya iss baat say daren kay ( jhooti gawahi ki soorat mein ) unn ki qasmon kay baad loata ker doosri qasmen li jayen gi ( jo humari tardeed kerden gi ) . aur Allah say daro , aur ( jo kuch uss ki taraf say kaha gaya hai ussay qubool kernay ki niyyat say ) suno . Allah nafarmano ko hidayat nahi deta .

ayahs.text: woh din yaad kero jab Allah tamam Rasoolon ko jama keray ga , aur kahey ga kay  tumhen kiya jawab diya gaya tha-?  woh kahen gay kay  hamen kuch ilm nahi , posheeda baaton ka tamam tarr ilm to aap hi kay paas hai .
ayahs.translation: woh din yaad kero jab Allah tamam Rasoolon ko jama keray ga , aur kahey ga kay  tumhen kiya jawab diya gaya tha-?  woh kahen gay kay  hamen kuch ilm nahi , posheeda baaton ka tamam tarr ilm to aap hi kay paas hai .

ayahs.text: . ( yeh waqiaa uss din hoga ) jab Allah kahey ga :  aey essa ibn-e-maryam ! mera inaam yaad kero jo mein ney tum per aur tumhari walida per kiya tha , jab mein ney rooh-ul-qudus kay zariye tumhari madad ki thi .   tum logon  say gehwaray mein bhi baat kertay thay , aur bari umar mein bhi . aur jab mein ney tumhen kitab o hikmat aur toraat o injeel ki taleem di thi , aur jab tum meray hukum say gaara ley ker uss say perinday ki jaisi shakal banatay thay , phir uss mein phoonk maartay thay to woh meray hukum say ( sach mooch ka ) perinda ban jata tha , aur tum madarzaad andhay aur korhi ko meray hukum say acha ker-detay thay , aur jab tum meray hukum say murdon ko ( zinda ) nikal kharra kertay thay , aur jab mein ney bani Israel ko uss waqt tum say door rakha jab tum unn kay paas khuli nishaniyan ley ker aaye thay , aur unn mein say jo kafir thay unhon ney kaha tha kay yeh khulay jadoo kay siwa kuch nahi .
ayahs.translation: . ( yeh waqiaa uss din hoga ) jab Allah kahey ga :  aey essa ibn-e-maryam ! mera inaam yaad kero jo mein ney tum per aur tumhari walida per kiya tha , jab mein ney rooh-ul-qudus kay zariye tumhari madad ki thi .   tum logon  say gehwaray mein bhi baat kertay thay , aur bari umar mein bhi . aur jab mein ney tumhen kitab o hikmat aur toraat o injeel ki taleem di thi , aur jab tum meray hukum say gaara ley ker uss say perinday ki jaisi shakal banatay thay , phir uss mein phoonk maartay thay to woh meray hukum say ( sach mooch ka ) perinda ban jata tha , aur tum madarzaad andhay aur korhi ko meray hukum say acha ker-detay thay , aur jab tum meray hukum say murdon ko ( zinda ) nikal kharra kertay thay , aur jab mein ney bani Israel ko uss waqt tum say door rakha jab tum unn kay paas khuli nishaniyan ley ker aaye thay , aur unn mein say jo kafir thay unhon ney kaha tha kay yeh khulay jadoo kay siwa kuch nahi .

ayahs.text: jab mein ney hawariyon kay dil mein yeh baat daali kay :  tum mujh per aur meray Rasool per emaan lao  to unhon ney kaha :  hum emaan ley aaye  aur aap gawah rahiye kay hum farmanbardaar hain .
ayahs.translation: jab mein ney hawariyon kay dil mein yeh baat daali kay :  tum mujh per aur meray Rasool per emaan lao  to unhon ney kaha :  hum emaan ley aaye  aur aap gawah rahiye kay hum farmanbardaar hain .

ayahs.text: . ( aur unn kay uss waqaey ka bhi ziker suno ) jab hawariyon ney kaha tha kay :  aey essa ibn-e-maryam ! kiya aap ka perwerdigar aisa ker-sakta hai kay hum per aasman say ( khaney ka ) aik khuwan utaray-?  essa ney kaha :  Allah say daro agar tum momin ho .
ayahs.translation: . ( aur unn kay uss waqaey ka bhi ziker suno ) jab hawariyon ney kaha tha kay :  aey essa ibn-e-maryam ! kiya aap ka perwerdigar aisa ker-sakta hai kay hum per aasman say ( khaney ka ) aik khuwan utaray-?  essa ney kaha :  Allah say daro agar tum momin ho .

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha :  hum chahtay hain kay iss khuwan say khana khayen , aur uss kay zariye humaray dil poori tarah mutmaeen hojayen , aur hamen ( pehlay say ziyada yaqeen kay sath ) yeh maloom hojaye kay aap ney hum say jo kuch kaha hai woh sach hai , aur hum uss per gawahi denay walon mein shamil hojayen .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha :  hum chahtay hain kay iss khuwan say khana khayen , aur uss kay zariye humaray dil poori tarah mutmaeen hojayen , aur hamen ( pehlay say ziyada yaqeen kay sath ) yeh maloom hojaye kay aap ney hum say jo kuch kaha hai woh sach hai , aur hum uss per gawahi denay walon mein shamil hojayen .

ayahs.text: . ( chunacheh ) essa ibn-e-maryam ney darkhuwast ki kay :  ya Allah ! hum per aasman say aik khuwan utaar dijiye jo humaray liye aur humaray aglon aur pichlon kay liye aik khushi ka moaqa ban jaye , aur aap ki taraf say aik nishani ho . aur hamen yeh naimat ata farma hi dijiye , aur aap sabb say behtar ata farmaney walay hain .
ayahs.translation: . ( chunacheh ) essa ibn-e-maryam ney darkhuwast ki kay :  ya Allah ! hum per aasman say aik khuwan utaar dijiye jo humaray liye aur humaray aglon aur pichlon kay liye aik khushi ka moaqa ban jaye , aur aap ki taraf say aik nishani ho . aur hamen yeh naimat ata farma hi dijiye , aur aap sabb say behtar ata farmaney walay hain .

ayahs.text: Allah ney kaha kay :  mein beyshak tum per woh khuwan utaar dun ga , lekin uss kay baad tum mein say jo shaks bhi kufr keray ga uss ko mein aesi saza dun ga jo duniya jahan kay kissi bhi shaks ko nahi dun ga .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney kaha kay :  mein beyshak tum per woh khuwan utaar dun ga , lekin uss kay baad tum mein say jo shaks bhi kufr keray ga uss ko mein aesi saza dun ga jo duniya jahan kay kissi bhi shaks ko nahi dun ga .

ayahs.text: aur ( uss waqt ka bhi ziker suno ) jab Allah kahey ga kay :  aey essa ibn-e-maryam ! kiya tum ney logon  say kaha tha kay mujhay aur meri maa ko Allah kay ilawa do mabood banao-?    woh kahen gay :  hum to aap ki zaat ko ( shirk say ) pak samajhtay hain . meri majal nahi thi kay mein aesi baat kahun jiss ka mujhay koi haq nahi . agar mein ney aisa kaha hota to aap ko yaqeenan maloom hojata . aap woh baaten jantay hain jo meray dil mein posheeda hain , aur mein aap ki posheeda baaton ko nahi janta . yaqeenan aap ko tamam chupi hoi baaton ka poora poora ilm hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( uss waqt ka bhi ziker suno ) jab Allah kahey ga kay :  aey essa ibn-e-maryam ! kiya tum ney logon  say kaha tha kay mujhay aur meri maa ko Allah kay ilawa do mabood banao-?    woh kahen gay :  hum to aap ki zaat ko ( shirk say ) pak samajhtay hain . meri majal nahi thi kay mein aesi baat kahun jiss ka mujhay koi haq nahi . agar mein ney aisa kaha hota to aap ko yaqeenan maloom hojata . aap woh baaten jantay hain jo meray dil mein posheeda hain , aur mein aap ki posheeda baaton ko nahi janta . yaqeenan aap ko tamam chupi hoi baaton ka poora poora ilm hai .

ayahs.text: mein ney inn logon  say uss kay siwa koi baat nahi kahi jiss ka aap ney mujhay hukum diya tha , aur woh yeh kay :  Allah ki ibadat kero jo mera bhi perwerdigar hai aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar  .  aur jab tak mein inn kay darmiyan mojood raha , mein inn kay halaat say waqif raha . phir jab aap ney mujhay utha liya to aap khud inn kay nigran thay , aur aap her cheez kay gawah hain .
ayahs.translation: mein ney inn logon  say uss kay siwa koi baat nahi kahi jiss ka aap ney mujhay hukum diya tha , aur woh yeh kay :  Allah ki ibadat kero jo mera bhi perwerdigar hai aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar  .  aur jab tak mein inn kay darmiyan mojood raha , mein inn kay halaat say waqif raha . phir jab aap ney mujhay utha liya to aap khud inn kay nigran thay , aur aap her cheez kay gawah hain .

ayahs.text: agar aap inn ko saza den , to yeh aap kay banday hain hi , aur agar aap enhen moaaf farmaden to yaqeenan aap ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil .
ayahs.translation: agar aap inn ko saza den , to yeh aap kay banday hain hi , aur agar aap enhen moaaf farmaden to yaqeenan aap ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil .

ayahs.text: Allah kahey ga kay :  yeh woh din hai jiss mein sachay logon  ko unn ka sach faeeda phonchaye ga . inn kay liye woh baaghaat hain jinn kay neechay nehren beh rahi hain , jinn mein yeh log hamesha hamesha rahen gay . Allah inn say khush hai aur yeh uss say khush hain . yehi bari zabardast kamiyabi hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah kahey ga kay :  yeh woh din hai jiss mein sachay logon  ko unn ka sach faeeda phonchaye ga . inn kay liye woh baaghaat hain jinn kay neechay nehren beh rahi hain , jinn mein yeh log hamesha hamesha rahen gay . Allah inn say khush hai aur yeh uss say khush hain . yehi bari zabardast kamiyabi hai .

ayahs.text: tamam aasmano aur zameen aur unn mein jo kuch hai uss sabb ki badshahi Allah hi kay liye hai , aur woh her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai .
ayahs.translation: tamam aasmano aur zameen aur unn mein jo kuch hai uss sabb ki badshahi Allah hi kay liye hai , aur woh her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: tamam tareefen Allah ki hain jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya , aur andheriyan aur roshni banai . phir bhi jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai woh doosron ko ( khudai mein ) apney perwerdigar kay barabar qarar dey rahey hain .
verses.translation: tamam tareefen Allah ki hain jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya , aur andheriyan aur roshni banai . phir bhi jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai woh doosron ko ( khudai mein ) apney perwerdigar kay barabar qarar dey rahey hain .

verses.text: wohi zaat hai jiss ney tum ko geeli mitti say peda kiya , phir ( tumhari zindagi ki ) aik miyaad muqarrar kerdi . aur ( dobara zinda honey ki ) aik mutayyan miyaad ussi kay paas hai .   phir bhi tum shak mein parray huye ho .
verses.translation: wohi zaat hai jiss ney tum ko geeli mitti say peda kiya , phir ( tumhari zindagi ki ) aik miyaad muqarrar kerdi . aur ( dobara zinda honey ki ) aik mutayyan miyaad ussi kay paas hai .   phir bhi tum shak mein parray huye ho .

verses.text: aur wohi Allah aasmano mein bhi hai , aur zameen mein bhi . woh tumharay chupay huye bhed bhi janta hai , aur khulay huye halaat bhi , aur jo kuch kamai tum ker rahey ho , uss say bhi waqif hai .
verses.translation: aur wohi Allah aasmano mein bhi hai , aur zameen mein bhi . woh tumharay chupay huye bhed bhi janta hai , aur khulay huye halaat bhi , aur jo kuch kamai tum ker rahey ho , uss say bhi waqif hai .

verses.text: aur ( inn kafiron ka haal yeh hai kay ) inn kay paas inn kay perwerdigar ki nishaniyon mein say jab bhi koi nishani aati hai , to yeh log uss say mun morr letay hain .
verses.translation: aur ( inn kafiron ka haal yeh hai kay ) inn kay paas inn kay perwerdigar ki nishaniyon mein say jab bhi koi nishani aati hai , to yeh log uss say mun morr letay hain .

verses.text: chunacheh jab haq inn kay paas aagaya to inn logon  ney ussay jhutla diya . nateeja yeh kay jiss baat ka yeh mazaq uratay rahey hain , jald hi inn ko uss ki khabren phonch jayen gi .
verses.translation: chunacheh jab haq inn kay paas aagaya to inn logon  ney ussay jhutla diya . nateeja yeh kay jiss baat ka yeh mazaq uratay rahey hain , jald hi inn ko uss ki khabren phonch jayen gi .

verses.text: kiya unhon ney nahi dekha kay hum inn say pehlay kitni qoamon ko halak ker-chukay hain ! unn ko hum ney zameen mein woh iqtidar diya tha jo tumhen nahi diya . hum ney unn per aasman say khoob barishen bhejen , aur hum ney daryaon ko muqarrar kerdiya kay woh unn kay neechay behtay rahen . lekin phir unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say hum ney unn ko halak ker daala , aur unn kay baad doosri naslen peda ken .
verses.translation: kiya unhon ney nahi dekha kay hum inn say pehlay kitni qoamon ko halak ker-chukay hain ! unn ko hum ney zameen mein woh iqtidar diya tha jo tumhen nahi diya . hum ney unn per aasman say khoob barishen bhejen , aur hum ney daryaon ko muqarrar kerdiya kay woh unn kay neechay behtay rahen . lekin phir unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say hum ney unn ko halak ker daala , aur unn kay baad doosri naslen peda ken .

verses.text: aur ( inn kafiron ka haal yeh hai kay ) agar hum tum per koi aesi kitab nazil ker-detay jo kaghaz per likhi hoi hoti , phir yeh ussay apney haathon say choo ker bhi dekh letay to jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai woh phir bhi yehi kehtay kay yeh khulay huye jadoo kay siwa kuch nahi .
verses.translation: aur ( inn kafiron ka haal yeh hai kay ) agar hum tum per koi aesi kitab nazil ker-detay jo kaghaz per likhi hoi hoti , phir yeh ussay apney haathon say choo ker bhi dekh letay to jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai woh phir bhi yehi kehtay kay yeh khulay huye jadoo kay siwa kuch nahi .

verses.text: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  iss ( payghumber ) per koi farishta kiyon nahi utaara gaya-?  halankay agar hum koi farishta utaar detay to sara kaam hi tamam hojata ,   phir inn ko koi mohlat naa di jati
verses.translation: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  iss ( payghumber ) per koi farishta kiyon nahi utaara gaya-?  halankay agar hum koi farishta utaar detay to sara kaam hi tamam hojata ,   phir inn ko koi mohlat naa di jati

verses.text: aur agar hum farishtay hi ko payghumber banatay , tab bhi ussay kissi mard hi ( ki shakal mein ) banatay , aur inn ko phir hum issi shubhay mein daal detay jiss mein abb mubtala hain .
verses.translation: aur agar hum farishtay hi ko payghumber banatay , tab bhi ussay kissi mard hi ( ki shakal mein ) banatay , aur inn ko phir hum issi shubhay mein daal detay jiss mein abb mubtala hain .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum say pehlay bhi boht say Rasoolon ka mazaq uraya gaya hai , lekin nateeja yeh huwa kay unn mein say jinn logon  ney mazaq uraya tha , unn ko ussi cheez ney aa-ghera jiss ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum say pehlay bhi boht say Rasoolon ka mazaq uraya gaya hai , lekin nateeja yeh huwa kay unn mein say jinn logon  ney mazaq uraya tha , unn ko ussi cheez ney aa-ghera jiss ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay .

verses.text: . ( inn kafiron say ) kaho kay :  zara zameen mein chalo phiro , phir dekho kay ( payghumberon ko ) jhutlaney walon ka kaisa anjam huwa-?
verses.translation: . ( inn kafiron say ) kaho kay :  zara zameen mein chalo phiro , phir dekho kay ( payghumberon ko ) jhutlaney walon ka kaisa anjam huwa-?

verses.text: . ( inn say ) poocho kay :  aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai woh kiss ki milkiyat hai-?  ( phir agar woh jawab naa den to khud hi ) keh do kay :  Allah hi ki milkiyat hai . uss ney rehmat ko apney oopper lazim ker rakha hai . ( iss liye tauba kerlo to pichlay saray gunah moaaf kerday ga , werna ) woh tum sabb ko zaroor bil-zaroor qayamat kay din jama keray ga jiss kay aaney mein koi shak nahi hai , ( lekin ) jinn logon  ney apni janon kay liye ghatay ka soda ker rakha hai , woh ( iss haqeeqat per ) emaan nahi latay .
verses.translation: . ( inn say ) poocho kay :  aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai woh kiss ki milkiyat hai-?  ( phir agar woh jawab naa den to khud hi ) keh do kay :  Allah hi ki milkiyat hai . uss ney rehmat ko apney oopper lazim ker rakha hai . ( iss liye tauba kerlo to pichlay saray gunah moaaf kerday ga , werna ) woh tum sabb ko zaroor bil-zaroor qayamat kay din jama keray ga jiss kay aaney mein koi shak nahi hai , ( lekin ) jinn logon  ney apni janon kay liye ghatay ka soda ker rakha hai , woh ( iss haqeeqat per ) emaan nahi latay .

verses.text: aur raat aur din mein jitni makhlooqaat aaram paati hain , sabb ussi kay qabazay mein hain ,   aur woh her baat ko sunta , her cheez ko janta hai .
verses.translation: aur raat aur din mein jitni makhlooqaat aaram paati hain , sabb ussi kay qabazay mein hain ,   aur woh her baat ko sunta , her cheez ko janta hai .

verses.text: keh do kay :  kiya mein Allah kay siwa kissi aur ko rakhwala banaon-? ( uss Allah ko chorr ker ) jo aasmano aur zameen ka peda kernay wala hai , aur jo sabb ko khilata hai , kissi say khata nahi-?  keh do kay :  mujhay yeh hukum diya gaya hai kay farmanbardaari mein sabb logon  say pehal kernay wala mein banon .  aur tum mushrikon mein hergiz shamil naa hona .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  kiya mein Allah kay siwa kissi aur ko rakhwala banaon-? ( uss Allah ko chorr ker ) jo aasmano aur zameen ka peda kernay wala hai , aur jo sabb ko khilata hai , kissi say khata nahi-?  keh do kay :  mujhay yeh hukum diya gaya hai kay farmanbardaari mein sabb logon  say pehal kernay wala mein banon .  aur tum mushrikon mein hergiz shamil naa hona .

verses.text: keh do kay :  agar mein apney perwerdigar ki nafarmani kerun to mujhay aik zabardast din kay azab ka khof hai .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  agar mein apney perwerdigar ki nafarmani kerun to mujhay aik zabardast din kay azab ka khof hai .

verses.text: jiss kissi shaks say uss din woh azab hata diya gaya , uss per Allah ney bara reham kiya , aur yehi wazeh kamiyabi hai .
verses.translation: jiss kissi shaks say uss din woh azab hata diya gaya , uss per Allah ney bara reham kiya , aur yehi wazeh kamiyabi hai .

verses.text: agar Allah tumhen koi takleef phonchaye to khud uss kay siwa ussay door kernay wala koi nahi , aur agar woh tumhen koi bhalai phonchaye to woh her cheez per qudrat rakhta hi hai .
verses.translation: agar Allah tumhen koi takleef phonchaye to khud uss kay siwa ussay door kernay wala koi nahi , aur agar woh tumhen koi bhalai phonchaye to woh her cheez per qudrat rakhta hi hai .

verses.text: aur woh apney bandon kay oopper mukammal iqtidar rakhta hai , aur woh hakeem bhi hai , poori tarah ba-khabar bhi
verses.translation: aur woh apney bandon kay oopper mukammal iqtidar rakhta hai , aur woh hakeem bhi hai , poori tarah ba-khabar bhi

verses.text: kaho :  kon si cheez aesi hai jo ( kissi baat ki ) gawahi denay kay liye sabb say aalaa darjay ki ho ?  kaho :  Allah ! ( aur wohi ) meray aur tumharay darmiyan gawah hai . aur mujh per yeh Quran wahi kay tor per iss liye nazil kiya gaya hai takay iss kay zariye mein tumhen bhi daraon , aur unn sabb ko bhi jinhen yeh Quran phonchay . kiya sach mooch tum yeh gawahi dey saktay ho kay Allah kay sath aur bhi mabood hain-?  keh do kay :  mein to aesi gawahi nahi dun ga .  keh do kay :  woh to sirf aik khuda hai , aur jinn jinn cheezon ko tum uss ki khudai mein shareek thehratay ho , mein unn sabb say beyzar hun .
verses.translation: kaho :  kon si cheez aesi hai jo ( kissi baat ki ) gawahi denay kay liye sabb say aalaa darjay ki ho ?  kaho :  Allah ! ( aur wohi ) meray aur tumharay darmiyan gawah hai . aur mujh per yeh Quran wahi kay tor per iss liye nazil kiya gaya hai takay iss kay zariye mein tumhen bhi daraon , aur unn sabb ko bhi jinhen yeh Quran phonchay . kiya sach mooch tum yeh gawahi dey saktay ho kay Allah kay sath aur bhi mabood hain-?  keh do kay :  mein to aesi gawahi nahi dun ga .  keh do kay :  woh to sirf aik khuda hai , aur jinn jinn cheezon ko tum uss ki khudai mein shareek thehratay ho , mein unn sabb say beyzar hun .

verses.text: jinn logon  ko hum ney kitab di hai , woh inn ko ( yani khaatam-an-Nabiyeen SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ko ) iss tarah pehchantay hain jaisay woh apney beton ko pehchantay hain . ( phir bhi ) jinn logon  ney apni janon kay liye ghatay ka soda ker rakha hai , woh emaan nahi latay .
verses.translation: jinn logon  ko hum ney kitab di hai , woh inn ko ( yani khaatam-an-Nabiyeen SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ko ) iss tarah pehchantay hain jaisay woh apney beton ko pehchantay hain . ( phir bhi ) jinn logon  ney apni janon kay liye ghatay ka soda ker rakha hai , woh emaan nahi latay .

verses.text: aur uss shaks say barh ker zalim kon hosakta hai jo Allah per jhoota bohtan baandhay , ya Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlaye-? yaqeen rakho kay zalim log falah nahi paaskatay .
verses.translation: aur uss shaks say barh ker zalim kon hosakta hai jo Allah per jhoota bohtan baandhay , ya Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlaye-? yaqeen rakho kay zalim log falah nahi paaskatay .

verses.text: uss din ( ko yaad rakho ) jab hum inn sabb ko ikattha keren gay , phir jinn logon  ney shirk kiya hoga unn say poochen gay kay :  kahan hain tumharay woh mabood jinn kay baaray mein tum yeh dawa kertay thay kay woh khudai mein Allah kay shareek hain-?
verses.translation: uss din ( ko yaad rakho ) jab hum inn sabb ko ikattha keren gay , phir jinn logon  ney shirk kiya hoga unn say poochen gay kay :  kahan hain tumharay woh mabood jinn kay baaray mein tum yeh dawa kertay thay kay woh khudai mein Allah kay shareek hain-?

verses.text: uss waqt unn kay paas koi bahana nahi hoga , siwaye iss kay kay woh kahen gay :  Allah ki qasam jo humara perwerdigar hai hum to mushrik nahi thay .
verses.translation: uss waqt unn kay paas koi bahana nahi hoga , siwaye iss kay kay woh kahen gay :  Allah ki qasam jo humara perwerdigar hai hum to mushrik nahi thay .

verses.text: dekho ! yeh apney moamlay mein kiss tarah jhoot bol jayen gay , aur jo ( mabood ) unhon ney jhoot moott tarash rakhay thay , unn ka enhen koi suragh nahi mil sakay ga !
verses.translation: dekho ! yeh apney moamlay mein kiss tarah jhoot bol jayen gay , aur jo ( mabood ) unhon ney jhoot moott tarash rakhay thay , unn ka enhen koi suragh nahi mil sakay ga !

verses.text: aur inn mein say kuch log aesay hain jo tumhari baat kaan laga ker suntay hain , magar ( chunkay yeh sunna talab-e-haq kay bajaye zidd per array rehney kay liye hota hai , iss liye ) hum ney inn kay dilon per aesay perday daal diye hain kay woh uss ko samajhtay nahi hain , aur unn kay kanon mein behra-pann peda kerdiya hai . aur agar woh aik aik ker kay sari nishaniyan dekh len tab bhi woh inn per emaan nahi layen gay . inteha yeh hai kay jab tumharay paas jhagrra kernay kay liye aatay hain to yeh kafir log yun kehtay hain kay yeh ( Quran ) pichlay logon  ki dastano kay siwa kuch nahi .
verses.translation: aur inn mein say kuch log aesay hain jo tumhari baat kaan laga ker suntay hain , magar ( chunkay yeh sunna talab-e-haq kay bajaye zidd per array rehney kay liye hota hai , iss liye ) hum ney inn kay dilon per aesay perday daal diye hain kay woh uss ko samajhtay nahi hain , aur unn kay kanon mein behra-pann peda kerdiya hai . aur agar woh aik aik ker kay sari nishaniyan dekh len tab bhi woh inn per emaan nahi layen gay . inteha yeh hai kay jab tumharay paas jhagrra kernay kay liye aatay hain to yeh kafir log yun kehtay hain kay yeh ( Quran ) pichlay logon  ki dastano kay siwa kuch nahi .
