verses.text: aur yeh doosron ko bhi iss ( Quran ) say roktay hain , aur khud bhi iss say door rehtay hain . aur ( iss tarah ) woh apni janon kay siwa kissi aur ko halakat mein nahi daal rahey , lekin unn ko ehsas nahi hai .
verses.translation: aur yeh doosron ko bhi iss ( Quran ) say roktay hain , aur khud bhi iss say door rehtay hain . aur ( iss tarah ) woh apni janon kay siwa kissi aur ko halakat mein nahi daal rahey , lekin unn ko ehsas nahi hai .

verses.text: aur ( bara holnaak nazara hoga ) agar tum woh waqt dekho jab unn ko dozakh per kharra kiya jaye ga , aur yeh kahen gay :  aey kaash ! hamen wapis ( duniya mein ) bhej diya jaye , takay iss baar hum apney perwerdigar ki nishaniyon ko naa jhutlayen , aur humara shumar mominon mein hojaye !
verses.translation: aur ( bara holnaak nazara hoga ) agar tum woh waqt dekho jab unn ko dozakh per kharra kiya jaye ga , aur yeh kahen gay :  aey kaash ! hamen wapis ( duniya mein ) bhej diya jaye , takay iss baar hum apney perwerdigar ki nishaniyon ko naa jhutlayen , aur humara shumar mominon mein hojaye !

verses.text: halankay ( inn ki yeh aarzoo bhi sachi naa hogi ) balkay darasal woh cheez ( yani aakhirat ) inn kay samney khul ker aa-chuki hogi jissay woh pehlay chupaya kertay thay , ( iss liye majbooran yeh dawa keren gay ) werna agar inn ko waqaee wapis bheja jaye to yeh dobara wohi kuch keren gay jiss say enhen roka gaya hai , aur yaqeen jano yeh pakay jhootay hain .
verses.translation: halankay ( inn ki yeh aarzoo bhi sachi naa hogi ) balkay darasal woh cheez ( yani aakhirat ) inn kay samney khul ker aa-chuki hogi jissay woh pehlay chupaya kertay thay , ( iss liye majbooran yeh dawa keren gay ) werna agar inn ko waqaee wapis bheja jaye to yeh dobara wohi kuch keren gay jiss say enhen roka gaya hai , aur yaqeen jano yeh pakay jhootay hain .

verses.text: yeh to yun kehtay hain kay jo kuch hai bus yehi dunyawi zindagi hai aur hum mar ker dobara zinda nahi kiye jayen gay .
verses.translation: yeh to yun kehtay hain kay jo kuch hai bus yehi dunyawi zindagi hai aur hum mar ker dobara zinda nahi kiye jayen gay .

verses.text: aur agar tum woh waqt dekho jab yeh apney rab kay samney kharray kiye jayen gay ! woh kahey ga :  kiya yeh ( doosri zindagi ) haq nahi hai ?  woh kahen gay :  beyshak humaray rab ki qasam !  Allah kahey ga :  to phir chakho azab ka maza , kiyonkay tum kufr kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: aur agar tum woh waqt dekho jab yeh apney rab kay samney kharray kiye jayen gay ! woh kahey ga :  kiya yeh ( doosri zindagi ) haq nahi hai ?  woh kahen gay :  beyshak humaray rab ki qasam !  Allah kahey ga :  to phir chakho azab ka maza , kiyonkay tum kufr kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay baray khasaray mein hain woh log jinhon ney Allah say jaa milney ko jhutlaya hai , yahan tak kay jab qayamat achanak unn kay samney aa-khari hogi to woh kahen gay :  haaye afsos ! kay hum ney iss ( qayamat ) kay baaray mein bari kotahi ki .  aur woh ( uss waqt ) apni peethon per apney gunahon ka bojh laadey huye hon gay . ( lehaza ) khabrdar raho kay boht bura bojh hai jo yeh log utha rahey hain .
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay baray khasaray mein hain woh log jinhon ney Allah say jaa milney ko jhutlaya hai , yahan tak kay jab qayamat achanak unn kay samney aa-khari hogi to woh kahen gay :  haaye afsos ! kay hum ney iss ( qayamat ) kay baaray mein bari kotahi ki .  aur woh ( uss waqt ) apni peethon per apney gunahon ka bojh laadey huye hon gay . ( lehaza ) khabrdar raho kay boht bura bojh hai jo yeh log utha rahey hain .

verses.text: aur dunyawi zindagi to aik khel tamashay kay siwa kuch nahi ,   aur yaqeen jano kay jo log taqwa ikhtiyar kertay hain , unn kay liye aakhirat wala ghar kahen ziyada behtar hai . to kiya itni si baat tumhari aqal mein nahi aati-?
verses.translation: aur dunyawi zindagi to aik khel tamashay kay siwa kuch nahi ,   aur yaqeen jano kay jo log taqwa ikhtiyar kertay hain , unn kay liye aakhirat wala ghar kahen ziyada behtar hai . to kiya itni si baat tumhari aqal mein nahi aati-?

verses.text: . ( aey Rasool ! ) hamen khoob maloom hai kay yeh log jo baaten kertay hain unn say tumhen ranj hota hai , kiyonkay darasal yeh tumhen nahi jhutlatay , balkay yeh zalim Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kertay hain .
verses.translation: . ( aey Rasool ! ) hamen khoob maloom hai kay yeh log jo baaten kertay hain unn say tumhen ranj hota hai , kiyonkay darasal yeh tumhen nahi jhutlatay , balkay yeh zalim Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kertay hain .

verses.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum say pehlay boht say Rasoolon ko jhutlaya gaya hai . phir jiss tarah unhen jhutlaya gaya aur takleefen di gaeen , uss sabb per unhon ney sabar kiya , yahan tak kay humari madad unn ko phonch gaee . aur koi nahi hai jo Allah ki baaton ko badal sakay . aur ( pichlay ) Rasoolon kay kuch waqiyaat aap tak phonch hi chukay hain .
verses.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum say pehlay boht say Rasoolon ko jhutlaya gaya hai . phir jiss tarah unhen jhutlaya gaya aur takleefen di gaeen , uss sabb per unhon ney sabar kiya , yahan tak kay humari madad unn ko phonch gaee . aur koi nahi hai jo Allah ki baaton ko badal sakay . aur ( pichlay ) Rasoolon kay kuch waqiyaat aap tak phonch hi chukay hain .

verses.text: aur agar inn logon  ka mun morray rehna tumhen boht bhari maloom horaha hai to agar tum zameen kay andar ( janey kay liye ) koi surang ya aasman mein ( charrney kay liye ) koi seerhi dhoond saktay ho to unn kay paas ( unn ka mun maanga yeh ) moajza ley aao . aur agar Allah chahta to inn sabb ko hidayat per jama ker deta . lehaza tum nadanon mein hergiz shamil naa hona .
verses.translation: aur agar inn logon  ka mun morray rehna tumhen boht bhari maloom horaha hai to agar tum zameen kay andar ( janey kay liye ) koi surang ya aasman mein ( charrney kay liye ) koi seerhi dhoond saktay ho to unn kay paas ( unn ka mun maanga yeh ) moajza ley aao . aur agar Allah chahta to inn sabb ko hidayat per jama ker deta . lehaza tum nadanon mein hergiz shamil naa hona .

verses.text: baat to wohi log maan saktay hain jo ( haq kay talib ban ker ) sunen . jahan tak inn murdon ka talluq hai inn ko to Allah hi qabron say uthaye ga , phir yeh ussi ki taraf lotaye jayen gay .
verses.translation: baat to wohi log maan saktay hain jo ( haq kay talib ban ker ) sunen . jahan tak inn murdon ka talluq hai inn ko to Allah hi qabron say uthaye ga , phir yeh ussi ki taraf lotaye jayen gay .

verses.text: yeh log kehtay hain kay ( agar yeh nabi hain to ) inn per inn/unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say koi nishani kiyon nahi utaari gaee-? tum ( inn say ) kaho kay Allah beyshak iss baat per qadir hai kay koi nishani nazil kerday , lekin inn mein say aksar log ( iss ka anjam ) nahi jantay .
verses.translation: yeh log kehtay hain kay ( agar yeh nabi hain to ) inn per inn/unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say koi nishani kiyon nahi utaari gaee-? tum ( inn say ) kaho kay Allah beyshak iss baat per qadir hai kay koi nishani nazil kerday , lekin inn mein say aksar log ( iss ka anjam ) nahi jantay .

verses.text: aur zameen mein jitney janwer chaltay hain , aur jitney perinday apney peron say urtay hain , woh sabb makhlooqaat ki tum jaisi hi asnaaf hain . hum ney kitab ( yani loah-e-mehfooz ) mein koi kasar nahi chorri hai . phir inn sabb ko jama ker kay inn kay perwerdigar ki taraf ley jaya jaye ga .
verses.translation: aur zameen mein jitney janwer chaltay hain , aur jitney perinday apney peron say urtay hain , woh sabb makhlooqaat ki tum jaisi hi asnaaf hain . hum ney kitab ( yani loah-e-mehfooz ) mein koi kasar nahi chorri hai . phir inn sabb ko jama ker kay inn kay perwerdigar ki taraf ley jaya jaye ga .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai woh andheron mein bhataktay bhataktay behray aur goongay hochukay hain .   Allah jissay chahta hai , ( uss ki hatt dharami ki wajeh say ) gumrahi mein daal deta hai , aur jissay chahta hai , seedhi raah per laga deta hai .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai woh andheron mein bhataktay bhataktay behray aur goongay hochukay hain .   Allah jissay chahta hai , ( uss ki hatt dharami ki wajeh say ) gumrahi mein daal deta hai , aur jissay chahta hai , seedhi raah per laga deta hai .

verses.text: . ( inn kafiron ) say kaho :  agar tum sachay ho to zara yeh batao kay agar tum per Allah ka azab aajaye , ya tum per qayamat toot parray to kiya Allah kay siwa kissi aur ko pukaro gay-?
verses.translation: . ( inn kafiron ) say kaho :  agar tum sachay ho to zara yeh batao kay agar tum per Allah ka azab aajaye , ya tum per qayamat toot parray to kiya Allah kay siwa kissi aur ko pukaro gay-?

verses.text: balkay ussi ko pukaro gay , phir jiss pareshani kay liye tum ney ussay pukara hai , agar woh chahye ga to ussay door kerday ga , aur jinn ( deotaon ) ko tum Allah kay sath shareek thehratay ho ( uss waqt ) unn ko bhool jao gay .
verses.translation: balkay ussi ko pukaro gay , phir jiss pareshani kay liye tum ney ussay pukara hai , agar woh chahye ga to ussay door kerday ga , aur jinn ( deotaon ) ko tum Allah kay sath shareek thehratay ho ( uss waqt ) unn ko bhool jao gay .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum say pehlay hum ney boht si qoamon kay paas payghumber bhejay , phir hum ney ( unn ki nafarmani ki bana per ) unhen sakhtiyon aur takleefon mein girftaar kiya , takay woh ijz o niaz ka shewa apnayen .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum say pehlay hum ney boht si qoamon kay paas payghumber bhejay , phir hum ney ( unn ki nafarmani ki bana per ) unhen sakhtiyon aur takleefon mein girftaar kiya , takay woh ijz o niaz ka shewa apnayen .

verses.text: phir aisa kiyon naa huwa kay jab unn kay paas humari taraf say sakhti aai thi , uss waqt woh aajzi ka ravaiyya ikhtiyar kertay-? balkay unn kay dil to aur sakht hogaye , aur jo kuch woh ker rahey thay , shetan ney unhen yeh sujhaya kay wohi baray shandaar kaam hain .
verses.translation: phir aisa kiyon naa huwa kay jab unn kay paas humari taraf say sakhti aai thi , uss waqt woh aajzi ka ravaiyya ikhtiyar kertay-? balkay unn kay dil to aur sakht hogaye , aur jo kuch woh ker rahey thay , shetan ney unhen yeh sujhaya kay wohi baray shandaar kaam hain .

verses.text: phir unhen jo naseehat ki gaee thi , jab woh ussay bhula bethay to hum ney unn per her naimat kay darwazay khol diye ,   yahan tak kay jo naimaten unhen di gaee then , jab woh unn per itraney lagay to hum ney achanak unn ko aa-pakra , jiss ka nateeja yeh huwa kay woh bilkul mayyus ho ker reh gaye .
verses.translation: phir unhen jo naseehat ki gaee thi , jab woh ussay bhula bethay to hum ney unn per her naimat kay darwazay khol diye ,   yahan tak kay jo naimaten unhen di gaee then , jab woh unn per itraney lagay to hum ney achanak unn ko aa-pakra , jiss ka nateeja yeh huwa kay woh bilkul mayyus ho ker reh gaye .

verses.text: iss tarah jinn logon  ney zulm kiya tha unn ki jarr kaat ker rakh di gaee , aur tamam tareefen Allah ki hain jo tamam jahano ka perwerdigar hai .
verses.translation: iss tarah jinn logon  ney zulm kiya tha unn ki jarr kaat ker rakh di gaee , aur tamam tareefen Allah ki hain jo tamam jahano ka perwerdigar hai .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho :  zara mujhay batao kay agar Allah tumhari sunney ki taqat aur tumhari aankhen tum say cheen ley aur tumharay dilon per mohar laga dey , to Allah kay siwa konsa mabood hai jo yeh cheezen tumhen laaker deydey-?  dekho , hum kaisay kaisay mukhtalif tareeqon say dalaeel biyan kertay hain , phir bhi yeh log mun pher letay hain .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho :  zara mujhay batao kay agar Allah tumhari sunney ki taqat aur tumhari aankhen tum say cheen ley aur tumharay dilon per mohar laga dey , to Allah kay siwa konsa mabood hai jo yeh cheezen tumhen laaker deydey-?  dekho , hum kaisay kaisay mukhtalif tareeqon say dalaeel biyan kertay hain , phir bhi yeh log mun pher letay hain .

verses.text: kaho :  zara yeh batao kay agar Allah ka azab tumharay paas achanak aaye ya aelaan kerkay , dono soorton mein kiya zalimon kay siwa kissi aur ko halak kiya jaye ga-?
verses.translation: kaho :  zara yeh batao kay agar Allah ka azab tumharay paas achanak aaye ya aelaan kerkay , dono soorton mein kiya zalimon kay siwa kissi aur ko halak kiya jaye ga-?

verses.text: hum payghumberon ko issi liye to bhejtay hain kay woh ( naikiyon per ) khushkhabri sunayen , ( aur nafarmani per Allah kay azab say ) darayen . chunacheh jo log emaan ley aaye aur apni islaah kerli , unn ko naa koi khof hoga , aur naa woh ghumgeen hon gay .
verses.translation: hum payghumberon ko issi liye to bhejtay hain kay woh ( naikiyon per ) khushkhabri sunayen , ( aur nafarmani per Allah kay azab say ) darayen . chunacheh jo log emaan ley aaye aur apni islaah kerli , unn ko naa koi khof hoga , aur naa woh ghumgeen hon gay .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya , unn ko azab phonch ker rahey ga , kiyonkay woh nafarmani kay aadi thay .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya , unn ko azab phonch ker rahey ga , kiyonkay woh nafarmani kay aadi thay .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) inn say kaho :  mein tum say yeh nahi kehta kay meray paas Allah kay khazaney hain aur naa mein ghaib ka ( poora ) ilm rakhta hun , aur naa mein tum say yeh kehta hun kay mein farishta hun .   mein to sirf uss wahi ki ittaba kerta hun jo mujh per nazil ki jati hai .  kaho kay :  kiya aik andha aur doosra beenai rakhney wala dono barabar hosaktay hain-? phir kiya tum ghor nahi kertay-?
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) inn say kaho :  mein tum say yeh nahi kehta kay meray paas Allah kay khazaney hain aur naa mein ghaib ka ( poora ) ilm rakhta hun , aur naa mein tum say yeh kehta hun kay mein farishta hun .   mein to sirf uss wahi ki ittaba kerta hun jo mujh per nazil ki jati hai .  kaho kay :  kiya aik andha aur doosra beenai rakhney wala dono barabar hosaktay hain-? phir kiya tum ghor nahi kertay-?

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum iss wahi kay zariye unn logon  ko khabrdar kero jo iss baat ka khof rakhtay hain kay unn ko unn kay perwerdigar kay paas aesi halat mein jama ker kay laya jaye ga kay iss/uss kay siwa naa unn ka koi yaar-o-madadgaar hoga , naa koi sirfarishi ,   takay woh log taqwa ikhtiyar kerlen .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum iss wahi kay zariye unn logon  ko khabrdar kero jo iss baat ka khof rakhtay hain kay unn ko unn kay perwerdigar kay paas aesi halat mein jama ker kay laya jaye ga kay iss/uss kay siwa naa unn ka koi yaar-o-madadgaar hoga , naa koi sirfarishi ,   takay woh log taqwa ikhtiyar kerlen .

verses.text: aur unn logon  ko apni majlis say naa nikalna jo subha o shaam apney perwerdigar ko uss ki khushnoodi hasil kernay kay liye pukartay rehtay hain .   unn kay hisab mein jo aemal hain unn mein say kissi ki zimma daari tum per nahi hai , aur tumharay hisab mein jo aemal hain unn mein say kissi ki zimma daari unn per nahi hai jiss ki wajeh say tum unhen nikal bahir kero , aur zalimon mein shamil hojao .
verses.translation: aur unn logon  ko apni majlis say naa nikalna jo subha o shaam apney perwerdigar ko uss ki khushnoodi hasil kernay kay liye pukartay rehtay hain .   unn kay hisab mein jo aemal hain unn mein say kissi ki zimma daari tum per nahi hai , aur tumharay hisab mein jo aemal hain unn mein say kissi ki zimma daari unn per nahi hai jiss ki wajeh say tum unhen nikal bahir kero , aur zalimon mein shamil hojao .

verses.text: issi tarah hum ney kuch logon  ko kuch doosron kay zariye aazmaesh mein daala hai   takay woh ( unn kay baaray mein ) yeh kahen kay :  kiya yeh hain woh log jinn ko Allah ney hum sabb ko chorr ker ehsan kernay kay liye chuna hai-?    kiya ( jo kafir yeh baat keh rahey hain unn kay khayal mein ) Allah apney shukar guzaar bandon ko doosron say ziyada nahi janta-?
verses.translation: issi tarah hum ney kuch logon  ko kuch doosron kay zariye aazmaesh mein daala hai   takay woh ( unn kay baaray mein ) yeh kahen kay :  kiya yeh hain woh log jinn ko Allah ney hum sabb ko chorr ker ehsan kernay kay liye chuna hai-?    kiya ( jo kafir yeh baat keh rahey hain unn kay khayal mein ) Allah apney shukar guzaar bandon ko doosron say ziyada nahi janta-?

verses.text: aur jab tumharay paas woh log ayen jo humari aayaton per emaan rakhtay hain to unn say kaho :  salamti ho tum per ! tumharay perwerdigar ney apney oopper rehmat ka yeh moamla kerna lazim kerliya hai kay agar tum mein say koi nadani say koi bura kaam ker bethay , phir uss kay baad tauba kerlay aur apni islaah kerlay to Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: aur jab tumharay paas woh log ayen jo humari aayaton per emaan rakhtay hain to unn say kaho :  salamti ho tum per ! tumharay perwerdigar ney apney oopper rehmat ka yeh moamla kerna lazim kerliya hai kay agar tum mein say koi nadani say koi bura kaam ker bethay , phir uss kay baad tauba kerlay aur apni islaah kerlay to Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: aur hum issi tarah nishaniyan tafseel kay sath biyan kertay hain , ( takay seedha raasta bhi wazeh hojaye ) aur takay mujrimon ka raasta bhi khul ker samney aajaye
verses.translation: aur hum issi tarah nishaniyan tafseel kay sath biyan kertay hain , ( takay seedha raasta bhi wazeh hojaye ) aur takay mujrimon ka raasta bhi khul ker samney aajaye

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho kay :  tum Allah kay siwa jinn ( jhootay khudaon ) ko pukartay ho mujhay unn ki ibadat kernay say mana kiya gaya hai .  kaho kay :  mein tumhari khuwaishaat kay peechay nahi chal sakta . agar mein aisa kerun ga to gumrah hun ga , aur mera shumar hidayat yafta logon  mein nahi hoga .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho kay :  tum Allah kay siwa jinn ( jhootay khudaon ) ko pukartay ho mujhay unn ki ibadat kernay say mana kiya gaya hai .  kaho kay :  mein tumhari khuwaishaat kay peechay nahi chal sakta . agar mein aisa kerun ga to gumrah hun ga , aur mera shumar hidayat yafta logon  mein nahi hoga .

verses.text: kaho kay :  mujhay apney perwerdigar ki taraf say aik roshan daleel mil chuki hai jiss per mein qaeem hun , aur tum ney ussay jhutla diya hai . jiss cheez kay jaldi aaney ka tum mutalba ker rahey ho woh meray paas mojood nahi hai .   hukum Allah kay siwa kissi ka nahi chalta . woh haq baat biyan ker deta hai , aur wohi sabb say behtar faisla kernay wala hai .
verses.translation: kaho kay :  mujhay apney perwerdigar ki taraf say aik roshan daleel mil chuki hai jiss per mein qaeem hun , aur tum ney ussay jhutla diya hai . jiss cheez kay jaldi aaney ka tum mutalba ker rahey ho woh meray paas mojood nahi hai .   hukum Allah kay siwa kissi ka nahi chalta . woh haq baat biyan ker deta hai , aur wohi sabb say behtar faisla kernay wala hai .

verses.text: kaho kay :  jiss cheez ki tum jaldi macha rahey ho , agar woh meray paas hoti to meray aur tumharay darmiyan faisla hochuka hota . aur Allah zalimon ko khoob janta hai .
verses.translation: kaho kay :  jiss cheez ki tum jaldi macha rahey ho , agar woh meray paas hoti to meray aur tumharay darmiyan faisla hochuka hota . aur Allah zalimon ko khoob janta hai .

verses.text: aur ussi kay paas ghaib ki kunjiyan hain jinhen uss kay siwa koi nahi janta . aur khushki aur samandar mein jo kuch hai woh uss say waqif hai . kissi darkht ka koi pata nahi girta jiss ka ussay ilm naa ho , aur zameen ki andheriyon mein koi dana ya koi khushk ya tarr cheez aesi nahi hai jo aik khuli kitab mein darj naa ho .
verses.translation: aur ussi kay paas ghaib ki kunjiyan hain jinhen uss kay siwa koi nahi janta . aur khushki aur samandar mein jo kuch hai woh uss say waqif hai . kissi darkht ka koi pata nahi girta jiss ka ussay ilm naa ho , aur zameen ki andheriyon mein koi dana ya koi khushk ya tarr cheez aesi nahi hai jo aik khuli kitab mein darj naa ho .

verses.text: aur wohi hai jo raat kay waqt ( neend mein ) tumhari rooh ( aik hadd tak ) qabz kerleta hai , aur din bhar mein tum ney jo kuch kiya hota hai , ussay khoob janta hai , phir uss ( naye din ) mein tumhen nai zindagi deta hai , takay ( tumhari umar ki ) muqarrara mauddat poori hojaye . phir ussi kay paas tum ko loat ker jana hai . uss waqt woh tumhen bataye ga kay tum kiya kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: aur wohi hai jo raat kay waqt ( neend mein ) tumhari rooh ( aik hadd tak ) qabz kerleta hai , aur din bhar mein tum ney jo kuch kiya hota hai , ussay khoob janta hai , phir uss ( naye din ) mein tumhen nai zindagi deta hai , takay ( tumhari umar ki ) muqarrara mauddat poori hojaye . phir ussi kay paas tum ko loat ker jana hai . uss waqt woh tumhen bataye ga kay tum kiya kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: wohi apney bandon per mukammal iqtidar rakhta hai , aur tumharay liye nigehban ( farishtay ) bhejta hai ,   yahan tak kay jab tum mein say kissi ki moat ka waqt aajata hai to humaray bhejay huye farishtay uss ko poora poora wasool kerletay hain , aur woh zara bhi kotahi nahi kertay .
verses.translation: wohi apney bandon per mukammal iqtidar rakhta hai , aur tumharay liye nigehban ( farishtay ) bhejta hai ,   yahan tak kay jab tum mein say kissi ki moat ka waqt aajata hai to humaray bhejay huye farishtay uss ko poora poora wasool kerletay hain , aur woh zara bhi kotahi nahi kertay .

verses.text: phir unn sabb ko Allah ki taraf loata diya jata hai jo inn/unn ka molaye bar-haq hai . yaad rakho ! hukum ussi ka chalta hai , aur woh sabb say ziyada jaldi hisab lenay wala hai .
verses.translation: phir unn sabb ko Allah ki taraf loata diya jata hai jo inn/unn ka molaye bar-haq hai . yaad rakho ! hukum ussi ka chalta hai , aur woh sabb say ziyada jaldi hisab lenay wala hai .

verses.text: kaho :  khushki aur samandar ki tareekiyon say uss waqt kon tumhen nijat deta hai jab tum ussay girr-girra ker aur chupkay chupkay pukartay ho , ( aur yeh kehtay ho kay ) agar uss ney hamen iss museebat say bacha liya to hum zaroor bil-zaroor shukar guzaar bandon mein shamil hojayen gay ?
verses.translation: kaho :  khushki aur samandar ki tareekiyon say uss waqt kon tumhen nijat deta hai jab tum ussay girr-girra ker aur chupkay chupkay pukartay ho , ( aur yeh kehtay ho kay ) agar uss ney hamen iss museebat say bacha liya to hum zaroor bil-zaroor shukar guzaar bandon mein shamil hojayen gay ?

verses.text: kaho :  Allah hi tumhen uss museebat say bhi bachata hai , aur her doosri takleef say bhi , phir bhi tum shirk kertay ho .
verses.translation: kaho :  Allah hi tumhen uss museebat say bhi bachata hai , aur her doosri takleef say bhi , phir bhi tum shirk kertay ho .

verses.text: kaho kay :  woh iss baat per poori tarah qudrat rakhta hai kay tum per koi azab tumharay oopper say bhej dey ya tumharay paon kay neechay say ( nikal dey ) ya tumhen mukhtalif toliyon mein baant ker aik doosray say bhira dey , aur aik doosray ki taqat ka maza chakha dey . dekho ! hum kiss tarah mukhtalif tareeqon say apni nishaniyan wazeh ker rahey hain , takay yeh kuch samajh say kaam ley len .
verses.translation: kaho kay :  woh iss baat per poori tarah qudrat rakhta hai kay tum per koi azab tumharay oopper say bhej dey ya tumharay paon kay neechay say ( nikal dey ) ya tumhen mukhtalif toliyon mein baant ker aik doosray say bhira dey , aur aik doosray ki taqat ka maza chakha dey . dekho ! hum kiss tarah mukhtalif tareeqon say apni nishaniyan wazeh ker rahey hain , takay yeh kuch samajh say kaam ley len .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tumhari qoam ney iss ( Quran ) ko jhutlaya hai , halankay woh bilkul haq hai . tum keh do kay :  mujh ko tumhari zimma daari nahi sonpi gaee hai .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tumhari qoam ney iss ( Quran ) ko jhutlaya hai , halankay woh bilkul haq hai . tum keh do kay :  mujh ko tumhari zimma daari nahi sonpi gaee hai .

verses.text: her waqaey ka aik waqt muqarrar hai , aur jald hi tumhen sabb maloom hojaye ga .
verses.translation: her waqaey ka aik waqt muqarrar hai , aur jald hi tumhen sabb maloom hojaye ga .

verses.text: aur jab tum unn logon  ko dekho jo humari aayaton ko bura bhala kehney mein lagay huye hain to unn say uss waqt tak kay liye alag hojao jab tak woh kissi aur baat mein mashghool naa hojayen . aur agar kabhi shetan tumhen yeh baat bhula dey to yaad aaney kay baad zalim logon  kay sath naa betho .
verses.translation: aur jab tum unn logon  ko dekho jo humari aayaton ko bura bhala kehney mein lagay huye hain to unn say uss waqt tak kay liye alag hojao jab tak woh kissi aur baat mein mashghool naa hojayen . aur agar kabhi shetan tumhen yeh baat bhula dey to yaad aaney kay baad zalim logon  kay sath naa betho .

verses.text: unn kay khatay mein jo aemal hain unn ki koi zimma daari perhezgaron per aaeed nahi hoti . albatta naseehat ker-dena unn ka kaam hai , shayad woh bhi ( aesi baaton say ) perhez kernay lagen .
verses.translation: unn kay khatay mein jo aemal hain unn ki koi zimma daari perhezgaron per aaeed nahi hoti . albatta naseehat ker-dena unn ka kaam hai , shayad woh bhi ( aesi baaton say ) perhez kernay lagen .

verses.text: aur chorr do unn logon  ko jinhon ney apney deen ko khel tamasha bana rakha hai ,   aur jinn ko dunyawi zindagi ney dhokay mein daal diya hai , aur iss ( Quran ) kay zariye ( logon  ko ) naseehat kertay raho , takay aisa naa ho kay koi shaks apney aemal kay sabab iss tarah girftaar hojaye kay Allah ( kay azab ) say bachaney kay liye Allah ko chorr ker naa koi uss ka yaar-o-madadgaar ban sakay naa sirfarishi , aur agar woh ( apni rehai kay liye ) her tarah ka fidya bhi paish kerna chahye to uss say woh qubool naa kiya jaye . ( chunacheh ) yehi ( deen ko khel tamasha bananey walay ) woh log hain jo apney kiye ki badolat girftaar hogaye hain . chunkay unhon ney kufr apna rakha tha , iss liye unn kay liye kholtay huye paani ka mashroob aur aik dukh denay wala azab ( tayyar ) hai .
verses.translation: aur chorr do unn logon  ko jinhon ney apney deen ko khel tamasha bana rakha hai ,   aur jinn ko dunyawi zindagi ney dhokay mein daal diya hai , aur iss ( Quran ) kay zariye ( logon  ko ) naseehat kertay raho , takay aisa naa ho kay koi shaks apney aemal kay sabab iss tarah girftaar hojaye kay Allah ( kay azab ) say bachaney kay liye Allah ko chorr ker naa koi uss ka yaar-o-madadgaar ban sakay naa sirfarishi , aur agar woh ( apni rehai kay liye ) her tarah ka fidya bhi paish kerna chahye to uss say woh qubool naa kiya jaye . ( chunacheh ) yehi ( deen ko khel tamasha bananey walay ) woh log hain jo apney kiye ki badolat girftaar hogaye hain . chunkay unhon ney kufr apna rakha tha , iss liye unn kay liye kholtay huye paani ka mashroob aur aik dukh denay wala azab ( tayyar ) hai .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) inn say kaho :  kiya hum Allah ko chorr ker aesi cheezon ko pukaren jo hamen naa koi faeeda phoncha sakti hain , naa nuqsan , aur jab Allah hamen hidayat dey chuka hai to kiya uss kay baad bhi hum ultay paon phir jayen-? ( aur ) uss shaks ki tarah ( hojayen ) jissay shetan behka ker sehra mein ley gaye hon , aur woh hayrani kay aalam mein bhatakta phirta ho , uss kay kuch sathi hon jo ussay theek raastay ki taraf bula rahey hon kay humaray paas aajao  kaho kay :  Allah ki di hoi hidayat hi sahih maani mein hidayat hai , aur hamen yeh hukum diya gaya hai kay hum Rabb-ul-Aalameen kay aagay jhuk jayen .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) inn say kaho :  kiya hum Allah ko chorr ker aesi cheezon ko pukaren jo hamen naa koi faeeda phoncha sakti hain , naa nuqsan , aur jab Allah hamen hidayat dey chuka hai to kiya uss kay baad bhi hum ultay paon phir jayen-? verses.text: aur yeh ( hukum diya gaya hai ) kay :  namaz qaeem kero , aur uss ( ki nafarmani ) say dartay raho . aur wohi hai jiss ki taraf tum sabb ko ikattha ker kay ley jaya jaye ga .
verses.translation: aur yeh ( hukum diya gaya hai ) kay :  namaz qaeem kero , aur uss ( ki nafarmani ) say dartay raho . aur wohi hai jiss ki taraf tum sabb ko ikattha ker kay ley jaya jaye ga .

verses.text: aur wohi zaat hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq peda kiya hai ,   aur jiss din woh ( roz-e-qayamat say ) kahey ga kay :  to hoja  to woh hojaye ga . uss ka qol bar-haq hai . aur jiss din soor phoonka jaye ga , uss din badshahi ussi ki hogi .   woh ghaeeb o hazir her cheez ko janney wala hai , aur wohi bari hikmat wala , poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: aur wohi zaat hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq peda kiya hai ,   aur jiss din woh ( roz-e-qayamat say ) kahey ga kay :  to hoja  to woh hojaye ga . uss ka qol bar-haq hai . aur jiss din soor phoonka jaye ga , uss din badshahi ussi ki hogi .   woh ghaeeb o hazir her cheez ko janney wala hai , aur wohi bari hikmat wala , poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: aur ( uss waqt ka ziker suno ) jab Ibrahim ney apney baap aazar say kaha tha kay :  kiya aap button ko khuda banaye bethay hain-? mein dekh raha hun kay aap aur aap ki qoam khuli gumrahi mein mubtala hain .
verses.translation: aur ( uss waqt ka ziker suno ) jab Ibrahim ney apney baap aazar say kaha tha kay :  kiya aap button ko khuda banaye bethay hain-? mein dekh raha hun kay aap aur aap ki qoam khuli gumrahi mein mubtala hain .

verses.text: aur issi tarah hum Ibrahim ko aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat ka nazara keratay thay , aur maqsad yeh tha kay woh mukammal yaqeen rakhney walon mein shamil hon .
verses.translation: aur issi tarah hum Ibrahim ko aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat ka nazara keratay thay , aur maqsad yeh tha kay woh mukammal yaqeen rakhney walon mein shamil hon .

verses.text: chunacheh jab unn per raat chai to unhon ney aik sitara dekha . kehney lagay :  yeh mera rab hai .    phir jab woh doob gaya to unhon ney kaha :  mein doobney walon ko pasand nahi kerta .
verses.translation: chunacheh jab unn per raat chai to unhon ney aik sitara dekha . kehney lagay :  yeh mera rab hai .    phir jab woh doob gaya to unhon ney kaha :  mein doobney walon ko pasand nahi kerta .

verses.text: phir jab unhon ney chaand ko chamaktay dekha to kaha kay :  yeh mera rab hai .  lekin jab woh bhi doob gaya to kehney lagay :  agar mera rab mujhay hidayat naa dey to mein yaqeenan gumrah logon  mein shamil hojaon .
verses.translation: phir jab unhon ney chaand ko chamaktay dekha to kaha kay :  yeh mera rab hai .  lekin jab woh bhi doob gaya to kehney lagay :  agar mera rab mujhay hidayat naa dey to mein yaqeenan gumrah logon  mein shamil hojaon .

verses.text: phir jab unhon ney sooraj ko chamaktay dekha to kaha :  yeh mera rab hai . yeh ziyada bara hai .  phir jab woh ghuroob huwa to unhon ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! jinn jinn cheezon ko tum Allah ki khudai mein shareek qarar detay ho , mein unn sabb say beyzar hun .
verses.translation: phir jab unhon ney sooraj ko chamaktay dekha to kaha :  yeh mera rab hai . yeh ziyada bara hai .  phir jab woh ghuroob huwa to unhon ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! jinn jinn cheezon ko tum Allah ki khudai mein shareek qarar detay ho , mein unn sabb say beyzar hun .

verses.text: mein ney to poori tarah yaksoo ho ker apna rukh uss zaat ki taraf kerliya hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya hai , aur mein shirk kernay walon mein say nahi hun .
verses.translation: mein ney to poori tarah yaksoo ho ker apna rukh uss zaat ki taraf kerliya hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya hai , aur mein shirk kernay walon mein say nahi hun .

verses.text: aur ( phir yeh huwa kay ) unn ki qoam ney unn say hujjat shuroo kerdi .   Ibrahim ney ( unn say ) kaha :  kiya tum mujh say Allah kay baaray mein hujjat kertay ho jabkay uss ney mujhay hidayat dey di hai ? aur jinn cheezon ko tum Allah kay sath shareek mantay ho , mein unn say nahi darta ( kay woh mujhay koi nuqsan phoncha den gi ) illa yeh kay mera perwerdigar ( mujhay ) kuch ( nuqsan phonchana ) chahye ( to woh her haal mein phonchay ga ) meray perwerdigar ka ilm her cheez ka ehata kiye huye hai . kiya tum phir bhi koi naseehat nahi mantay-?
verses.translation: aur ( phir yeh huwa kay ) unn ki qoam ney unn say hujjat shuroo kerdi .   Ibrahim ney ( unn say ) kaha :  kiya tum mujh say Allah kay baaray mein hujjat kertay ho jabkay uss ney mujhay hidayat dey di hai ? aur jinn cheezon ko tum Allah kay sath shareek mantay ho , mein unn say nahi darta ( kay woh mujhay koi nuqsan phoncha den gi ) illa yeh kay mera perwerdigar ( mujhay ) kuch ( nuqsan phonchana ) chahye ( to woh her haal mein phonchay ga ) meray perwerdigar ka ilm her cheez ka ehata kiye huye hai . kiya tum phir bhi koi naseehat nahi mantay-?

verses.text: aur jinn cheezon ko tum ney Allah ka shareek bana rakha hai , mein unn say kaisay darr sakta hun jabkay tum unn cheezon ko Allah ka shareek manney say nahi dartay jinn kay baaray mein  uss ney tum per koi daleel nazil nahi ki hai-? abb agar tumharay paas koi ilm hai to batao kay hum do fareeqon mein say kon bey khof rehney ka ziyada mustahiq hai ?
verses.translation: aur jinn cheezon ko tum ney Allah ka shareek bana rakha hai , mein unn say kaisay darr sakta hun jabkay tum unn cheezon ko Allah ka shareek manney say nahi dartay jinn kay baaray mein  uss ney tum per koi daleel nazil nahi ki hai-? abb agar tumharay paas koi ilm hai to batao kay hum do fareeqon mein say kon bey khof rehney ka ziyada mustahiq hai ?

verses.text: . ( haqeeqat to yeh hai kay ) jo log emaan ley aaye hain aur unhon ney apney emaan kay sath kissi zulm ka shayeba bhi aaney nahi diya ,   aman aur chain to bus unhi ka haq hai , aur wohi hain jo sahih raastay per phonch chukay hain .
verses.translation: . ( haqeeqat to yeh hai kay ) jo log emaan ley aaye hain aur unhon ney apney emaan kay sath kissi zulm ka shayeba bhi aaney nahi diya ,   aman aur chain to bus unhi ka haq hai , aur wohi hain jo sahih raastay per phonch chukay hain .

verses.text: yeh humari woh kamiyab daleel thi jo hum ney Ibrahim ko unn ki qoam kay muqablay mein ata ki thi . hum jiss kay chahtay hain darjay buland ker-detay hain . beyshak tumharay rab ki hikmat bhi bari hai , ilm bhi kamil hai .
verses.translation: yeh humari woh kamiyab daleel thi jo hum ney Ibrahim ko unn ki qoam kay muqablay mein ata ki thi . hum jiss kay chahtay hain darjay buland ker-detay hain . beyshak tumharay rab ki hikmat bhi bari hai , ilm bhi kamil hai .

verses.text: aur hum ney Ibrahim ko Ishaq ( jaisa beta ) aur Yaqoob ( jaisa pota ) ata kiya . ( inn mein say ) her aik ko hum ney hidayat di , aur nooh ko hum ney pehlay hi hidayat di thi , aur unn ki aulad mein say dawood , suleman , Ayub , yousuf , musa aur Haroon ko bhi . aur issi tarah hum naik kaam kernay walon ko badla detay hain .
verses.translation: aur hum ney Ibrahim ko Ishaq ( jaisa beta ) aur Yaqoob ( jaisa pota ) ata kiya . ( inn mein say ) her aik ko hum ney hidayat di , aur nooh ko hum ney pehlay hi hidayat di thi , aur unn ki aulad mein say dawood , suleman , Ayub , yousuf , musa aur Haroon ko bhi . aur issi tarah hum naik kaam kernay walon ko badla detay hain .

verses.text: aur zakariya , Yahya , essa aur Ilyas ko ( bhi hidayat ata farmaee ) . yeh sabb naik logon  mein say thay .
verses.translation: aur zakariya , Yahya , essa aur Ilyas ko ( bhi hidayat ata farmaee ) . yeh sabb naik logon  mein say thay .

verses.text: neez Ismail , Al-Yasaa , Younus aur loot ko bhi . aur inn sabb ko hum ney duniya jahan kay logon  per fazilat bakhshi thi .
verses.translation: neez Ismail , Al-Yasaa , Younus aur loot ko bhi . aur inn sabb ko hum ney duniya jahan kay logon  per fazilat bakhshi thi .

verses.text: aur inn kay baap dadon , inn ki auladon aur inn kay bhaiyon mein say bhi boht say logon  ko . hum ney inn sabb ko muntakhib ker kay raah-e-raast tak phoncha diya tha .
verses.translation: aur inn kay baap dadon , inn ki auladon aur inn kay bhaiyon mein say bhi boht say logon  ko . hum ney inn sabb ko muntakhib ker kay raah-e-raast tak phoncha diya tha .

verses.text: yeh Allah ki di hoi hidayat hai jiss kay zariye woh apney bandon mein say jiss ko chahta hai raah-e-raast tak phoncha deta hai . aur agar woh shirk kernay lagtay to unn kay saray ( naik ) aemal ikarat hojatay .
verses.translation: yeh Allah ki di hoi hidayat hai jiss kay zariye woh apney bandon mein say jiss ko chahta hai raah-e-raast tak phoncha deta hai . aur agar woh shirk kernay lagtay to unn kay saray ( naik ) aemal ikarat hojatay .

verses.text: woh log thay jinn ko hum ney kitab , hikmat aur nabwooat ata ki thi .   abb agar yeh ( arab kay ) log iss ( nabwooat ) ka inkar keren to ( kuch perwa naa kero , kiyonkay ) iss kay manney kay liye hum ney aesay log muqarrar kerdiye hain jo iss kay munkir nahi .
verses.translation: woh log thay jinn ko hum ney kitab , hikmat aur nabwooat ata ki thi .   abb agar yeh ( arab kay ) log iss ( nabwooat ) ka inkar keren to ( kuch perwa naa kero , kiyonkay ) iss kay manney kay liye hum ney aesay log muqarrar kerdiye hain jo iss kay munkir nahi .

verses.text: yeh log ( jinn ka ziker oopper huwa ) woh thay jinn ko Allah ney ( makhalfeen kay ravaiyyey per sabar kernay ki ) hidayat ki thi , lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum bhi unhi kay raastay per chalo . ( makhalfeen say ) keh do kay mein tum say iss ( dawat ) per koi ujrat nahi maangta . yeh to duniya jahan kay sabb logon  kay liye aik naseehat hai , aur bus .
verses.translation: yeh log ( jinn ka ziker oopper huwa ) woh thay jinn ko Allah ney ( makhalfeen kay ravaiyyey per sabar kernay ki ) hidayat ki thi , lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum bhi unhi kay raastay per chalo . ( makhalfeen say ) keh do kay mein tum say iss ( dawat ) per koi ujrat nahi maangta . yeh to duniya jahan kay sabb logon  kay liye aik naseehat hai , aur bus .

verses.text: aur inn ( kafir ) logon  ney jab yeh kaha kay Allah ney kissi insan per kuch nazil nahi kiya to unhon ney Allah ki sahih qadar nahi pehchani .   ( unn say ) kaho kay :  woh kitab kiss ney nazil ki thi jo musa ley ker aaye thay , jo logon  kay liye roshni aur hidayat thi , aur jiss ko tum ney mutafarriq kaghazon ki shakal mein rakha huwa hai .   jinn ( mein say kuch ) ko tum zahir kertay ho , aur boht say hissay chupa letay ho , aur ( jiss kay zariye ) tum ko unn baaton ki taleem di gaee thi jo naa tum jantay thay , naa tumharay baap dada-?  ( aey payghumber ! tum khud hi iss sawal kay jawab mein ) itna keh do kay :  woh kitab Allah ney nazil ki thi .  phir inn ko inn kay haal per chorr do kay yeh apni beyhooda guftoogo mein mashghool reh ker dil lagi kertay rahen .
verses.translation: aur inn ( kafir ) logon  ney jab yeh kaha kay Allah ney kissi insan per kuch nazil nahi kiya to unhon ney Allah ki sahih qadar nahi pehchani .   ( unn say ) kaho kay :  woh kitab kiss ney nazil ki thi jo musa ley ker aaye thay , jo logon  kay liye roshni aur hidayat thi , aur jiss ko tum ney mutafarriq kaghazon ki shakal mein rakha huwa hai .   jinn ( mein say kuch ) ko tum zahir kertay ho , aur boht say hissay chupa letay ho , aur ( jiss kay zariye ) tum ko unn baaton ki taleem di gaee thi jo naa tum jantay thay , naa tumharay baap dada-?  ( aey payghumber ! tum khud hi iss sawal kay jawab mein ) itna keh do kay :  woh kitab Allah ney nazil ki thi .  phir inn ko inn kay haal per chorr do kay yeh apni beyhooda guftoogo mein mashghool reh ker dil lagi kertay rahen .

verses.text: aur ( issi tarah ) yeh bari barkat wali kitab hai jo hum ney utaari hai , pichli aasmani hidayaat ki tasdeeq kernay wali hai , takay tum iss kay zariye bastiyon kay markaz ( yani makkah ) aur uss kay ird-gird kay logon  ko khabrdar kero . aur jo log aakhirat per emaan rakhtay hain woh iss per bhi emaan rakhtay hain , aur woh apni namaz ki poori poori nigehdasht kertay hain .
verses.translation: aur ( issi tarah ) yeh bari barkat wali kitab hai jo hum ney utaari hai , pichli aasmani hidayaat ki tasdeeq kernay wali hai , takay tum iss kay zariye bastiyon kay markaz ( yani makkah ) aur uss kay ird-gird kay logon  ko khabrdar kero . aur jo log aakhirat per emaan rakhtay hain woh iss per bhi emaan rakhtay hain , aur woh apni namaz ki poori poori nigehdasht kertay hain .

verses.text: aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay , ya yeh kahey kay mujh per wahi nazil ki gaee hai , halankay uss per koi wahi nazil naa ki gaee ho , aur issi tarah woh jo yeh kahey kay mein bhi wesa hi kalam nazil kerdun ga jaisa Allah ney nazil kiya hai ? aur agar tum woh waqt dekho ( to bara holnaak manzar nazar aaye ) jab zalim log moat ki sakhtiyon mein girftaar hon gay , aur farishtay apney haath phelaye huye ( keh rahey hon gay kay )  apni janen nikalo , aaj tumhen zillat ka azab diya jaye ga , iss liye kay tum jhooti baaten Allah kay zimmay lagatay thay , aur iss liye kay tum uss ki nishaniyon kay khilaf takabbur ka ravaiyya ikhtiyar kertay thay .
verses.translation: aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay , ya yeh kahey kay mujh per wahi nazil ki gaee hai , halankay uss per koi wahi nazil naa ki gaee ho , aur issi tarah woh jo yeh kahey kay mein bhi wesa hi kalam nazil kerdun ga jaisa Allah ney nazil kiya hai ? aur agar tum woh waqt dekho ( to bara holnaak manzar nazar aaye ) jab zalim log moat ki sakhtiyon mein girftaar hon gay , aur farishtay apney haath phelaye huye ( keh rahey hon gay kay )  apni janen nikalo , aaj tumhen zillat ka azab diya jaye ga , iss liye kay tum jhooti baaten Allah kay zimmay lagatay thay , aur iss liye kay tum uss ki nishaniyon kay khilaf takabbur ka ravaiyya ikhtiyar kertay thay .

verses.text: . ( phir qayamat kay din Allah taalaa unn say kahey ga kay : )  tum humaray paas issi tarah tan-tanha aagaye ho jaisay hum ney tumhen pehli baar peda kiya tha , aur jo kuch hum ney tumhen bakhsha tha woh sabb apney peechay chorr aaye ho , aur hamen to tumharay woh sirfarishi kahen nazar nahi aarahey jinn kay baaray mein tumhara dawa tha kay woh tumharay moamlaat tey kernay mein ( humaray sath ) shareek hain . haqeeqat yeh hai kay unn kay sath tumharay saray talluqaat toot chukay hain , aur jinn ( deotaon ) kay baaray mein tumhen bara zoam tha woh sabb tum say gumm ho ker reh gaye hain .

verses.text: beyshak Allah hi daney aur guthli ko phaarney wala hai . woh jandaar cheezon ko bey jaan cheezon say nikal lata hai , aur wohi bey jaan cheezon ko jandaar cheezon say nikalney wala hai .   logo ! woh hai Allah ! phir koi tumhen behka ker kiss ondhi taraf liye jaraha hai ?
verses.translation: beyshak Allah hi daney aur guthli ko phaarney wala hai . woh jandaar cheezon ko bey jaan cheezon say nikal lata hai , aur wohi bey jaan cheezon ko jandaar cheezon say nikalney wala hai .   logo ! woh hai Allah ! phir koi tumhen behka ker kiss ondhi taraf liye jaraha hai ?

verses.text: wohi hai jiss kay hukum say subha ko po phoot-ti hai , aur ussi ney raat ko sukoon ka waqt banaya hai , aur sooraj aur chaand ko aik hisab ka paband ! yeh sabb kuch uss zaat ki mansooba bandi hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , ilm bhi kamil
verses.translation: wohi hai jiss kay hukum say subha ko po phoot-ti hai , aur ussi ney raat ko sukoon ka waqt banaya hai , aur sooraj aur chaand ko aik hisab ka paband ! yeh sabb kuch uss zaat ki mansooba bandi hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , ilm bhi kamil

verses.text: aur ussi ney tumharay liye sitaray banaye hain , takay tum unn kay zariye khushki aur samandar ki tareekiyon mein raastay maloom ker-sako-? . hum ney sari nishaniyan aik aik ker kay khol di hain , ( magar ) unn logon  kay liye jo ilm say kaam len
verses.translation: aur ussi ney tumharay liye sitaray banaye hain , takay tum unn kay zariye khushki aur samandar ki tareekiyon mein raastay maloom ker-sako-? . hum ney sari nishaniyan aik aik ker kay khol di hain , ( magar ) unn logon  kay liye jo ilm say kaam len

verses.text: wohi hai jiss ney tum sabb ko aik jaan say peda kiya , phir her shaks ka aik mustaqar hai , aur aik amanat rakhney ki jagah .   hum ney sari nishaniyan aik aik kerkay khol di hain , ( magar ) unn logon  kay liye jo samajh say kaam len .
verses.translation: wohi hai jiss ney tum sabb ko aik jaan say peda kiya , phir her shaks ka aik mustaqar hai , aur aik amanat rakhney ki jagah .   hum ney sari nishaniyan aik aik kerkay khol di hain , ( magar ) unn logon  kay liye jo samajh say kaam len .

verses.text: aur Allah wohi hai jiss ney tumharay liye aasman say paani barsaya . phir hum ney uss kay zariye her qisam ki konpalen ugayen . inn ( konpalon ) say hum ney sabziyan peda ken jinn say hum teh bar teh daney nikaltay hain , aur khujoor kay gabhon say phalon kay woh guchay nikaltay hain jo ( phal kay bojh say ) jhukay jatay hain , aur hum ney angooron kay baagh ugaye , aur zaitoon aur anaar ! jo aik doosray say miltay jultay bhi hain , aur aik doosray say mukhtalif bhi .   jab yeh darkht phal detay hain to inn kay phalon aur unn kay pakney ki kayfiyat ko ghor say dekho . logo ! inn sabb cheezon mein bari nishaniyan hain , ( magar ) unn logon  kay liye jo emaan layen .
verses.translation: aur Allah wohi hai jiss ney tumharay liye aasman say paani barsaya . phir hum ney uss kay zariye her qisam ki konpalen ugayen . inn ( konpalon ) say hum ney sabziyan peda ken jinn say hum teh bar teh daney nikaltay hain , aur khujoor kay gabhon say phalon kay woh guchay nikaltay hain jo ( phal kay bojh say ) jhukay jatay hain , aur hum ney angooron kay baagh ugaye , aur zaitoon aur anaar ! jo aik doosray say miltay jultay bhi hain , aur aik doosray say mukhtalif bhi .   jab yeh darkht phal detay hain to inn kay phalon aur unn kay pakney ki kayfiyat ko ghor say dekho . logo ! inn sabb cheezon mein bari nishaniyan hain , ( magar ) unn logon  kay liye jo emaan layen .

verses.text: aur logon  ney jinnaat ko Allah kay sath khudai mein shareek qarar dey liya ,   halankay Allah ney hi unn ko peda kiya hai aur samajh boojh kay baghair uss kay liye betay aur betiyan tarash len ,   halankay Allah kay baaray mein jo baaten yeh banatay hain , woh unn sabb say pak aur baala-o-bartar hai .
verses.translation: aur logon  ney jinnaat ko Allah kay sath khudai mein shareek qarar dey liya ,   halankay Allah ney hi unn ko peda kiya hai aur samajh boojh kay baghair uss kay liye betay aur betiyan tarash len ,   halankay Allah kay baaray mein jo baaten yeh banatay hain , woh unn sabb say pak aur baala-o-bartar hai .

verses.text: woh to aasmano aur zameen ka mojid hai . uss ka koi beta kahan hosakta hai , jabkay uss ki koi biwi nahi-? Ussi ney her cheez peda ki hai , aur woh her her cheez ka poora poora ilm rakhta hai .
verses.translation: woh to aasmano aur zameen ka mojid hai . uss ka koi beta kahan hosakta hai , jabkay uss ki koi biwi nahi-? Ussi ney her cheez peda ki hai , aur woh her her cheez ka poora poora ilm rakhta hai .

verses.text: logo ! woh hai Allah jo tumhara paalney wala hai ! uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi , woh her cheez ka khaliq hai . lehaza uss ki ibadat kero . woh her cheez ki nigrani kernay wala hai .
verses.translation: logo ! woh hai Allah jo tumhara paalney wala hai ! uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi , woh her cheez ka khaliq hai . lehaza uss ki ibadat kero . woh her cheez ki nigrani kernay wala hai .

verses.text: nigahen uss ko nahi paaskten , aur woh tamam nigahon ko paaleta hai . uss ki zaat itni hi lateef hai , aur woh itna hi ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: nigahen uss ko nahi paaskten , aur woh tamam nigahon ko paaleta hai . uss ki zaat itni hi lateef hai , aur woh itna hi ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn logon  say kaho kay : )  tumharay paas tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say baseerat kay saman phonch chukay hain . abb jo shaks aankhen khol ker dekhay ga , woh apna hi bhala keray ga , aur jo shaks andha ban jaye ga , woh apna hi nuqsan keray ga . aur mujhay tumhari hifazat ki zimma daari nahi sonpi gaee hai .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn logon  say kaho kay : )  tumharay paas tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say baseerat kay saman phonch chukay hain . abb jo shaks aankhen khol ker dekhay ga , woh apna hi bhala keray ga , aur jo shaks andha ban jaye ga , woh apna hi nuqsan keray ga . aur mujhay tumhari hifazat ki zimma daari nahi sonpi gaee hai .

verses.text: issi tarah hum aayaten mukhtalif tareeqon say baar baar wazeh kertay hain , ( takay tum enhen logon  tak phoncha do ) aur bil-aakhir yeh log to yun kahen kay :  tum ney kissi say seekha hai .    aur jo log ilm say kaam letay hain unn kay liye hum haq ko aashkaar kerden .
verses.translation: issi tarah hum aayaten mukhtalif tareeqon say baar baar wazeh kertay hain , ( takay tum enhen logon  tak phoncha do ) aur bil-aakhir yeh log to yun kahen kay :  tum ney kissi say seekha hai .    aur jo log ilm say kaam letay hain unn kay liye hum haq ko aashkaar kerden .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) tum per tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say jo wahi bheji gaee hai , tum ussi ki perwi kero , uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai , aur jo log Allah kay sath shirk kertay hain , unn say bey perwa hojao .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) tum per tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say jo wahi bheji gaee hai , tum ussi ki perwi kero , uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai , aur jo log Allah kay sath shirk kertay hain , unn say bey perwa hojao .

verses.text: agar Allah chahta to yeh log shirk naa kertay .   hum ney naa tumhen inn ki hifazat per muqarrar kiya hai , aur naa tum inn kay kamon kay zimma daar ho .
verses.translation: agar Allah chahta to yeh log shirk naa kertay .   hum ney naa tumhen inn ki hifazat per muqarrar kiya hai , aur naa tum inn kay kamon kay zimma daar ho .

verses.text: . ( musalmano ! ) jinn ( jhootay maboodon ) ko yeh log Allah kay bajaye pukartay hain tum unn ko bura naa kaho , jiss kay nateejay mein yeh log jihalat kay aalam mein hadd say aagay barh ker Allah ko bura kehney lagen .   ( iss duniya mein to ) hum ney issi tarah her giroh kay amal ko uss ki nazar mein khushnuma bana rakha hai .   phir inn sabb ko apney perwerdigar hi kay paas loattna hai . uss waqt woh unhen bataye ga kay woh kiya kuch kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: . ( musalmano ! ) jinn ( jhootay maboodon ) ko yeh log Allah kay bajaye pukartay hain tum unn ko bura naa kaho , jiss kay nateejay mein yeh log jihalat kay aalam mein hadd say aagay barh ker Allah ko bura kehney lagen .   ( iss duniya mein to ) hum ney issi tarah her giroh kay amal ko uss ki nazar mein khushnuma bana rakha hai .   phir inn sabb ko apney perwerdigar hi kay paas loattna hai . uss waqt woh unhen bataye ga kay woh kiya kuch kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: aur inn logon  ney bari zor daar qasmen khai hain kay agar inn kay paas waqaee koi nishani ( yani inn ka matloob moajza ) aagae to yeh yaqeenan zaroor iss/uss per emaan ley ayen gay . ( inn say ) kaho kay :  sari nishaniyan Allah kay qabazay mein hain .    aur ( musalmano ! ) tumhen kiya pata kay agar woh ( moajzay ) aa-bhi gaye tab bhi yeh emaan nahi layen gay .
verses.translation: aur inn logon  ney bari zor daar qasmen khai hain kay agar inn kay paas waqaee koi nishani ( yani inn ka matloob moajza ) aagae to yeh yaqeenan zaroor iss/uss per emaan ley ayen gay . ( inn say ) kaho kay :  sari nishaniyan Allah kay qabazay mein hain .    aur ( musalmano ! ) tumhen kiya pata kay agar woh ( moajzay ) aa-bhi gaye tab bhi yeh emaan nahi layen gay .

verses.text: jiss tarah yeh log pehli baar ( Quran jaisay moajzay per ) emaan nahi laye , hum bhi ( inn ki zidd ki padash mein ) inn kay dilon aur nigahon ka rukh pher detay hain , aur inn ko iss halat mein chorr detay hain kay yeh apni sarkashi mein bhataktay phiren .
verses.translation: jiss tarah yeh log pehli baar ( Quran jaisay moajzay per ) emaan nahi laye , hum bhi ( inn ki zidd ki padash mein ) inn kay dilon aur nigahon ka rukh pher detay hain , aur inn ko iss halat mein chorr detay hain kay yeh apni sarkashi mein bhataktay phiren .

verses.text: aur agar bil-farz hum inn kay paas farishtay bhej detay , aur murday inn say baaten kernay lagtay , aur ( inn ki maangi hoi ) her cheez hum khuli aankhon inn kay samney laaker kay rakh detay ,   tab bhi yeh emaan laney walay nahi thay , illa yeh kay Allah hi chahta ( kay enhen zabardasti emaan per majboor kerday to baat doosri thi , magar aisa emaan naa matloob hai naa moatabir . ) lekin inn mein say aksar log jihalat ki baaten kertay hain .
verses.translation: aur agar bil-farz hum inn kay paas farishtay bhej detay , aur murday inn say baaten kernay lagtay , aur ( inn ki maangi hoi ) her cheez hum khuli aankhon inn kay samney laaker kay rakh detay ,   tab bhi yeh emaan laney walay nahi thay , illa yeh kay Allah hi chahta ( kay enhen zabardasti emaan per majboor kerday to baat doosri thi , magar aisa emaan naa matloob hai naa moatabir . ) lekin inn mein say aksar log jihalat ki baaten kertay hain .

verses.text: aur ( jiss tarah yeh log humaray nabi say dushmani ker rahey hain ) issi tarah hum ney her ( pichlay ) nabi kay liye koi naa koi dushman peda kiya tha , yani insanon aur jinnaat mein say shetan qisam kay log , jo dhoka denay ki khatir aik doosray ko bari chikni chupri baaten sikhatay rehtay thay . aur agar Allah chahta to woh aisa naa ker-saktay .   lehaza inn ko apni iftra perdaziyon mein parra rehney do .
verses.translation: aur ( jiss tarah yeh log humaray nabi say dushmani ker rahey hain ) issi tarah hum ney her ( pichlay ) nabi kay liye koi naa koi dushman peda kiya tha , yani insanon aur jinnaat mein say shetan qisam kay log , jo dhoka denay ki khatir aik doosray ko bari chikni chupri baaten sikhatay rehtay thay . aur agar Allah chahta to woh aisa naa ker-saktay .   lehaza inn ko apni iftra perdaziyon mein parra rehney do .

verses.text: aur ( woh anbiya kay dushman chikni chupri baaten iss liye banatay thay ) takay jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , unn kay dil inn baaton ki taraf khoob maeel hojayen , aur woh inn mein magan rahen , aur sari woh harkaten keren jo woh kernay walay thay .
verses.translation: aur ( woh anbiya kay dushman chikni chupri baaten iss liye banatay thay ) takay jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , unn kay dil inn baaton ki taraf khoob maeel hojayen , aur woh inn mein magan rahen , aur sari woh harkaten keren jo woh kernay walay thay .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn logon  say kaho kay : )  kiya mein Allah ko chorr ker kissi aur ko faisal banaon , halankay ussi ney tumhari taraf yeh kitab nazil kerkay bheji hai jiss mein saray ( mutnazeh ) moamlaat ki tafseel mojood hai-?  aur jinn logon  ko hum ney pehlay kitab di thi woh yaqeen say jantay hain kay yeh tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say haq ley ker nazil hoi hai . lehaza tum shak kernay walon mein hergiz shamil naa hona .

verses.text: aur tumharay rab ka kalam sachai aur insaf mein kamil hai . uss ki baaton ko koi badalney wala nahi . woh her baat sunney wala , her baat janney wala hai .
verses.translation: aur tumharay rab ka kalam sachai aur insaf mein kamil hai . uss ki baaton ko koi badalney wala nahi . woh her baat sunney wala , her baat janney wala hai .

verses.text: aur agar tum zameen mein basney walon ki aksariyat kay peechay chalo gay to woh tumhen Allah kay raastay say gumrah ker daalen gay . woh to weham o gumaan kay siwa kissi cheez kay peechay nahi chaltay , aur unn ka kaam iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay khayali andazay lagatay rahen .
verses.translation: aur agar tum zameen mein basney walon ki aksariyat kay peechay chalo gay to woh tumhen Allah kay raastay say gumrah ker daalen gay . woh to weham o gumaan kay siwa kissi cheez kay peechay nahi chaltay , aur unn ka kaam iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay khayali andazay lagatay rahen .

verses.text: yaqeen rakho kay tumhara rab khoob janta hai kay kon apney raastay say bhatak raha hai , aur wohi unn logon  ko khoob janta hai jo sahih raastay per hain .
verses.translation: yaqeen rakho kay tumhara rab khoob janta hai kay kon apney raastay say bhatak raha hai , aur wohi unn logon  ko khoob janta hai jo sahih raastay per hain .

verses.text: chunacheh her uss ( halal ) janwer mein say khao jiss per Allah ka naam liya gaya ho , agar tum waqaee uss ki aayaton per emaan rakhtay ho .
verses.translation: chunacheh her uss ( halal ) janwer mein say khao jiss per Allah ka naam liya gaya ho , agar tum waqaee uss ki aayaton per emaan rakhtay ho .

verses.text: aur tumharay liye kon si rukawat hai jiss ki bana per tum uss janwer mein say naa khao jiss per Allah ka naam ley liya gaya ho-? halankay uss ney woh cheezen tumhen tafseel say bata di hain jo uss ney tumharay liye ( aam halaat mein ) haram qarar di hain , albatta jinn ko khaney per tum bilkul majboor hi hojao , ( to unn haram cheezon ki bhi baqdar-e-zaroorat ijazat hojati hai ) aur boht say log kissi ilm ki buniyad per nahi , ( balkay sirf ) apni khuwaishaat ki buniyad per doosron ko gumrah kertay hain . bila shubha tumhara rab hadd say guzarney walon ko khoob janta hai .
verses.translation: aur tumharay liye kon si rukawat hai jiss ki bana per tum uss janwer mein say naa khao jiss per Allah ka naam ley liya gaya ho-? halankay uss ney woh cheezen tumhen tafseel say bata di hain jo uss ney tumharay liye ( aam halaat mein ) haram qarar di hain , albatta jinn ko khaney per tum bilkul majboor hi hojao , ( to unn haram cheezon ki bhi baqdar-e-zaroorat ijazat hojati hai ) aur boht say log kissi ilm ki buniyad per nahi , ( balkay sirf ) apni khuwaishaat ki buniyad per doosron ko gumrah kertay hain . bila shubha tumhara rab hadd say guzarney walon ko khoob janta hai .

verses.text: aur tum zahiri aur batni dono qisam kay gunah chorr do .   yeh yaqeeni baat hai kay jo log gunah kamatay hain , unhen unn tamam jaraeem ki jald hi saza milay gi jinn ka woh irtikab kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: aur tum zahiri aur batni dono qisam kay gunah chorr do .   yeh yaqeeni baat hai kay jo log gunah kamatay hain , unhen unn tamam jaraeem ki jald hi saza milay gi jinn ka woh irtikab kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: aur jiss janwer per Allah ka naam naa liya gaya ho , uss mein say matt khao , aur aisa kerna sakht gunah hai . ( musalmano ! ) shayateen apney doston ko warghalatay rehtay hain takay woh tum say behas keren . aur agar tum ney unn ki baat maan li to tum yaqeenan mushrik hojao gay .
verses.translation: aur jiss janwer per Allah ka naam naa liya gaya ho , uss mein say matt khao , aur aisa kerna sakht gunah hai . ( musalmano ! ) shayateen apney doston ko warghalatay rehtay hain takay woh tum say behas keren . aur agar tum ney unn ki baat maan li to tum yaqeenan mushrik hojao gay .

verses.text: zara batao kay jo shaks murda ho , phir hum ney ussay zindagi di ho , aur uss ko aik roshni mohaiyya kerdi ho jiss kay saharay woh logon  kay darmiyan chalta phirta ho ,   kiya woh uss shaks ki tarah hosakta hai jiss ka haal yeh ho kay woh andheron mein ghira huwa ho jinn say kabhi nikal naa paye ? issi tarah kafiron ko yeh sujha diya gaya hai kay jo kuch woh kertay rahey hain , woh bara khushnuma kaam hai .
verses.translation: zara batao kay jo shaks murda ho , phir hum ney ussay zindagi di ho , aur uss ko aik roshni mohaiyya kerdi ho jiss kay saharay woh logon  kay darmiyan chalta phirta ho ,   kiya woh uss shaks ki tarah hosakta hai jiss ka haal yeh ho kay woh andheron mein ghira huwa ho jinn say kabhi nikal naa paye ? issi tarah kafiron ko yeh sujha diya gaya hai kay jo kuch woh kertay rahey hain , woh bara khushnuma kaam hai .

verses.text: aur issi tarah hum ney her basti mein wahan kay mujrimon kay sarghanon ko yeh moaqa diya hai kay woh uss ( basti ) mein ( musalmanon kay khilaf ) sazishen kiya keren .   aur woh jo sazishen kertay hain , ( dar-haqeeqat ) woh kissi aur kay nahi , balkay khud unn kay apney khilaf parrti hain , jabkay unn ko iss ka ehsas nahi hota .
verses.translation: aur issi tarah hum ney her basti mein wahan kay mujrimon kay sarghanon ko yeh moaqa diya hai kay woh uss ( basti ) mein ( musalmanon kay khilaf ) sazishen kiya keren .   aur woh jo sazishen kertay hain , ( dar-haqeeqat ) woh kissi aur kay nahi , balkay khud unn kay apney khilaf parrti hain , jabkay unn ko iss ka ehsas nahi hota .

verses.text: aur jab inn ( ehal-e-makkah ) kay paas ( Quran ki ) koi aayat aati hai to yeh kehtay hain kay :  hum uss waqt tak hergiz emaan nahi layen gay jab tak kay uss jaisi cheez khud hamen naa dey di jaye jaisi Allah kay payghumberon ko di gaee thi .    ( halankay ) Allah hi behtar janta hai kay woh apni payghumberi kiss ko supurd keray . jinn logon  ney ( iss qisam ki ) mujrimana baaten ki hain unn ko apni makkariyon kay badlay mein Allah kay paas jaker zillat aur sakht azab ka samna hoga .
verses.translation: aur jab inn ( ehal-e-makkah ) kay paas ( Quran ki ) koi aayat aati hai to yeh kehtay hain kay :  hum uss waqt tak hergiz emaan nahi layen gay jab tak kay uss jaisi cheez khud hamen naa dey di jaye jaisi Allah kay payghumberon ko di gaee thi .    ( halankay ) Allah hi behtar janta hai kay woh apni payghumberi kiss ko supurd keray . jinn logon  ney ( iss qisam ki ) mujrimana baaten ki hain unn ko apni makkariyon kay badlay mein Allah kay paas jaker zillat aur sakht azab ka samna hoga .

verses.text: gharz jiss shaks ko Allah hidayat tak phonchaney ka irada kerlay , uss ka seena Islam kay liye khol deta hai , aur jiss ko ( uss ki zidd ki wajeh say ) gumrah kernay ka irada kerlay , uss kay seenay ko tang aur itna ziyada tang ker deta hai kay ( ussay emaan lana aisa mushkil maloom hota hai ) jaisay ussay zabardasti aasman per charrhna parr raha ho . issi tarah Allah ( kufr ki ) gandagi unn logon  per musallat ker deta hai jo emaan nahi latay .
verses.translation: gharz jiss shaks ko Allah hidayat tak phonchaney ka irada kerlay , uss ka seena Islam kay liye khol deta hai , aur jiss ko ( uss ki zidd ki wajeh say ) gumrah kernay ka irada kerlay , uss kay seenay ko tang aur itna ziyada tang ker deta hai kay ( ussay emaan lana aisa mushkil maloom hota hai ) jaisay ussay zabardasti aasman per charrhna parr raha ho . issi tarah Allah ( kufr ki ) gandagi unn logon  per musallat ker deta hai jo emaan nahi latay .

verses.text: aur yeh ( Islam ) tumharay perwerdigar ka ( bataya huwa ) seedha seedha raasta hai . jo log naseehat qubool kertay hain , unn kay liye hum ney ( iss raastay ki ) nishaniyan khol khol ker biyan kerdi hain .
verses.translation: aur yeh ( Islam ) tumharay perwerdigar ka ( bataya huwa ) seedha seedha raasta hai . jo log naseehat qubool kertay hain , unn kay liye hum ney ( iss raastay ki ) nishaniyan khol khol ker biyan kerdi hain .

verses.text: inn kay perwerdigar kay paas sukh chain ka ghar aesay hi logon  kay liye hai , aur jo amal woh kertay rahey hain , unn ki wajeh say woh khud unn ka rakhwala hai .
verses.translation: inn kay perwerdigar kay paas sukh chain ka ghar aesay hi logon  kay liye hai , aur jo amal woh kertay rahey hain , unn ki wajeh say woh khud unn ka rakhwala hai .

verses.text: aur ( uss din ka dhiyan rakho ) jiss din Allah inn sabb ko gher ker ikattha keray ga , aur ( shayateen jinnaat say kahey ga kay : )  aey jinnaat kay giroh ! tum ney insanon ko boht barh charh ker gumrah kiya .  aur insanon mein say jo unn kay dost hon gay , woh kahen gay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum aik doosray say khoob mazay letay rahey hain ,   aur abb apni uss miyaad ko phonch gaye hain jo aap ney humaray liye muqarrar ki thi .  Allah kahey ga :  ( abb ) aag tum sabb ka thikana hai , jiss mein tum hamesha raho gay , illa yeh kay Allah kuch aur chahye .   yaqeen rakho kay tumharay perwerdigar ki hikmat bhi kamil hai , ilm bhi kamil .
verses.translation: aur ( uss din ka dhiyan rakho ) jiss din Allah inn sabb ko gher ker ikattha keray ga , aur ( shayateen jinnaat say kahey ga kay : )  aey jinnaat kay giroh ! tum ney insanon ko boht barh charh ker gumrah kiya .  aur insanon mein say jo unn kay dost hon gay , woh kahen gay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum aik doosray say khoob mazay letay rahey hain ,   aur abb apni uss miyaad ko phonch gaye hain jo aap ney humaray liye muqarrar ki thi .  Allah kahey ga :  ( abb ) aag tum sabb ka thikana hai , jiss mein tum hamesha raho gay , illa yeh kay Allah kuch aur chahye .   yaqeen rakho kay tumharay perwerdigar ki hikmat bhi kamil hai , ilm bhi kamil .

verses.text: aur issi tarah hum zalimon ko unn kay kamaye huye aemal ki wajeh say aik doosray per musallat ker-detay hain .   .
verses.translation: aur issi tarah hum zalimon ko unn kay kamaye huye aemal ki wajeh say aik doosray per musallat ker-detay hain .   .

verses.text: aey jinnaat aur insanon kay giroh ! kiya tumharay paas khud tum mein say woh payghumber nahi aaye thay jo tumhen meri aayaten parh ker sunatay thay ,   aur tum ko issi din ka samna kernay say khabrdar kertay thay jo aaj tumharay samney hai ?  woh kahen gay :  ( aaj ) hum ney khud apney khilaf gawahi dey di hai ( kay waqaee humaray paas payghumber aaye thay , aur hum ney unhen jhutlaya tha )    aur ( dar-haqeeqat ) unn ko dunyawi zindagi ney dhokay mein daal diya tha , aur ( abb ) unhon ney khud apney khilaf gawahi dey di kay woh kafir thay .
verses.translation: aey jinnaat aur insanon kay giroh ! kiya tumharay paas khud tum mein say woh payghumber nahi aaye thay jo tumhen meri aayaten parh ker sunatay thay ,   aur tum ko issi din ka samna kernay say khabrdar kertay thay jo aaj tumharay samney hai ?  woh kahen gay :  ( aaj ) hum ney khud apney khilaf gawahi dey di hai ( kay waqaee humaray paas payghumber aaye thay , aur hum ney unhen jhutlaya tha )    aur ( dar-haqeeqat ) unn ko dunyawi zindagi ney dhokay mein daal diya tha , aur ( abb ) unhon ney khud apney khilaf gawahi dey di kay woh kafir thay .

verses.text: yeh ( payghumber bhejney ka ) sara silsila iss liye tha kay tumharay perwerdigar ko yeh gawara nahi tha kay woh bastiyon ko kissi ziyadti ki wajeh say   iss halat mein halak kerday kay uss kay log bey khabar hon .
verses.translation: yeh ( payghumber bhejney ka ) sara silsila iss liye tha kay tumharay perwerdigar ko yeh gawara nahi tha kay woh bastiyon ko kissi ziyadti ki wajeh say   iss halat mein halak kerday kay uss kay log bey khabar hon .

verses.text: aur her qisam kay logon  ko mukhtalif darjaat unn aemal kay hisab say miltay hain jo unhon ney kiye hotay hain . aur jo aemal bhi woh kertay hain , tumhara perwerdigar unn say ghafil nahi hai .
verses.translation: aur her qisam kay logon  ko mukhtalif darjaat unn aemal kay hisab say miltay hain jo unhon ney kiye hotay hain . aur jo aemal bhi woh kertay hain , tumhara perwerdigar unn say ghafil nahi hai .

verses.text: aur tumhara perwerdigar aisa bey niaz hai jo rehmat wala bhi hai .   agar woh chahye to tum sabb ko ( duniya say ) utha ley , aur tumharay baad  jiss ko chahye tumhari jagah ley aaye , jaisay uss ney tum ko kuch aur logon  ki nasal say peda kiya tha .
verses.translation: aur tumhara perwerdigar aisa bey niaz hai jo rehmat wala bhi hai .   agar woh chahye to tum sabb ko ( duniya say ) utha ley , aur tumharay baad  jiss ko chahye tumhari jagah ley aaye , jaisay uss ney tum ko kuch aur logon  ki nasal say peda kiya tha .

verses.text: yaqeen rakho kay jiss cheez ka tum say wada kiya jaraha hai uss ko aana hi aana hai ,   aur tum ( Allah ko ) aajiz nahi ker-saktay .
verses.translation: yaqeen rakho kay jiss cheez ka tum say wada kiya jaraha hai uss ko aana hi aana hai ,   aur tum ( Allah ko ) aajiz nahi ker-saktay .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn logon  say ) kaho kay :  aey meri qoam ! tum apni jagah ( apney tareeqay kay mutabiq ) amal kero , mein ( apney tareeqay kay mutabiq ) amal ker raha hun . phir jald hi tumhen maloom hojaye ga kay iss duniya ka anjam kiss kay haq mein nikalta hai . yeh haqeeqat ( apni jagah ) hai kay zalim log falah nahi paatay .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn logon  say ) kaho kay :  aey meri qoam ! tum apni jagah ( apney tareeqay kay mutabiq ) amal kero , mein ( apney tareeqay kay mutabiq ) amal ker raha hun . phir jald hi tumhen maloom hojaye ga kay iss duniya ka anjam kiss kay haq mein nikalta hai . yeh haqeeqat ( apni jagah ) hai kay zalim log falah nahi paatay .

verses.text: aur Allah ney jo khetiyan aur chopaye peda kiye hain , inn logon  ney unn mein say Allah ka bus aik hissa muqarrar kiya hai .   chunacheh ba-zoam khud yun kehtay hain kay yeh hissa to Allah ka hai , aur yeh humaray unn maboodon ka hai jinn ko hum khudai mein Allah ka shareek mantay hain . phir jo hissa inn kay shareekon ka hota hai , woh to ( kabhi ) Allah kay paas nahi phonchta , aur jo hissa Allah ka hota hai , woh inn kay gharray huye maboodon ko phonch jata hai . aesi buri buri baaten hain jo enhon ney tey ker rakhi hain !
verses.translation: aur Allah ney jo khetiyan aur chopaye peda kiye hain , inn logon  ney unn mein say Allah ka bus aik hissa muqarrar kiya hai .   chunacheh ba-zoam khud yun kehtay hain kay yeh hissa to Allah ka hai , aur yeh humaray unn maboodon ka hai jinn ko hum khudai mein Allah ka shareek mantay hain . phir jo hissa inn kay shareekon ka hota hai , woh to ( kabhi ) Allah kay paas nahi phonchta , aur jo hissa Allah ka hota hai , woh inn kay gharray huye maboodon ko phonch jata hai . aesi buri buri baaten hain jo enhon ney tey ker rakhi hain !

verses.text: aur issi tarah boht say mushrikeen ko unn kay shareekon ney yeh sujha rakha hai kay apni aulad ko qatal kerna bara acha kaam hai , takay woh inn ( mushrikeen ) ko bilkul tabah ker daalen , aur inn kay liye unn kay deen kay moamlay mein moghaltay peda kerden . aur agar Allah chahta to woh aisa naa ker-saktay .   lehaza inn ko apni iftra perdaziyon mein parra rehney do .
verses.translation: aur issi tarah boht say mushrikeen ko unn kay shareekon ney yeh sujha rakha hai kay apni aulad ko qatal kerna bara acha kaam hai , takay woh inn ( mushrikeen ) ko bilkul tabah ker daalen , aur inn kay liye unn kay deen kay moamlay mein moghaltay peda kerden . aur agar Allah chahta to woh aisa naa ker-saktay .   lehaza inn ko apni iftra perdaziyon mein parra rehney do .

verses.text: aur yun kehtay hain kay :  inn chopayo aur khetiyon per pabandi lagi hoi hai .  inn ka zoam yeh hai kay :  inn ko siwaye unn logon  kay koi nahi kha sakta jinhen hum khilana chahen .    aur kuch chopaye aesay hain jinn ki pusht haram qarar dey di gaee hai ,   aur kuch chopaye woh hain jinn kay baaray mein Allah per yeh bohtan baandhtay hain kay unn per Allah ka naam nahi letay .   jo iftra perdazi yeh log ker rahey hain , Allah unhen unqareeb iss ka poora poora badla dey ga .
verses.translation: aur yun kehtay hain kay :  inn chopayo aur khetiyon per pabandi lagi hoi hai .  inn ka zoam yeh hai kay :  inn ko siwaye unn logon  kay koi nahi kha sakta jinhen hum khilana chahen .    aur kuch chopaye aesay hain jinn ki pusht haram qarar dey di gaee hai ,   aur kuch chopaye woh hain jinn kay baaray mein Allah per yeh bohtan baandhtay hain kay unn per Allah ka naam nahi letay .   jo iftra perdazi yeh log ker rahey hain , Allah unhen unqareeb iss ka poora poora badla dey ga .

verses.text: neez woh kehtay hain kay :  inn khaas chopayo kay pet mein jo bacchay hain woh sirf humaray mardon kay liye makhsoos hain , aur humari aurton kay liye haram hain .  aur agar woh baccha murda peda ho to uss say faeeda uthaney mein sabb ( mard o aurat ) shareek hojatay hain .   jo baaten yeh log bana rahey hain , Allah unhen unqareeb unn ka poora poora badla dey ga . yaqeenan woh hikmat ka bhi malik hai , ilm ka bhi malik .
verses.translation: neez woh kehtay hain kay :  inn khaas chopayo kay pet mein jo bacchay hain woh sirf humaray mardon kay liye makhsoos hain , aur humari aurton kay liye haram hain .  aur agar woh baccha murda peda ho to uss say faeeda uthaney mein sabb ( mard o aurat ) shareek hojatay hain .   jo baaten yeh log bana rahey hain , Allah unhen unqareeb unn ka poora poora badla dey ga . yaqeenan woh hikmat ka bhi malik hai , ilm ka bhi malik .

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh log baray khasaray mein hain jinhon ney apni aulad ko kissi ilmi wajeh kay baghair mehaz himaqat say qatal kiya hai , aur Allah ney jo rizq inn ko diya tha ussay Allah per bohtan baandh ker haram kerliya hai . woh buri tarah gumrah hogaye hain , aur kabhi hidayat per aaye hi nahi .
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh log baray khasaray mein hain jinhon ney apni aulad ko kissi ilmi wajeh kay baghair mehaz himaqat say qatal kiya hai , aur Allah ney jo rizq inn ko diya tha ussay Allah per bohtan baandh ker haram kerliya hai . woh buri tarah gumrah hogaye hain , aur kabhi hidayat per aaye hi nahi .

verses.text: Allah woh hai jiss ney baaghaat peda kiye jinn mein say kuch , ( bail daar hain jo ) saharon say oopper charrhaye jatay hain , aur kuch saharon kay baghair buland hotay hain , aur nakhlistan aur khetiyan , jinn kay zaeeqay alag alag hain , aur zaitoon aur anaar , jo aik doosray say miltay jultay bhi hain , aur aik doosray say mukhtalif bhi .   jab yeh darkht phal den to inn kay phalon ko khaney mein istimal kero , aur jab inn ki katai ka din aaye to Allah ka haq ada kero ,   aur fuzool kharchi naa kero . yaad rakho , woh fuzool kharch logon  ko pasand nahi kerta .
verses.translation: Allah woh hai jiss ney baaghaat peda kiye jinn mein say kuch , ( bail daar hain jo ) saharon say oopper charrhaye jatay hain , aur kuch saharon kay baghair buland hotay hain , aur nakhlistan aur khetiyan , jinn kay zaeeqay alag alag hain , aur zaitoon aur anaar , jo aik doosray say miltay jultay bhi hain , aur aik doosray say mukhtalif bhi .   jab yeh darkht phal den to inn kay phalon ko khaney mein istimal kero , aur jab inn ki katai ka din aaye to Allah ka haq ada kero ,   aur fuzool kharchi naa kero . yaad rakho , woh fuzool kharch logon  ko pasand nahi kerta .

verses.text: aur chopayo mein say Allah ney woh janwer bhi peda kiye hain jo bojh uthatay hain , aur woh bhi jo zameen say lagay huye hotay hain .   Allah ney jo rizq tumhen diya hai , uss mein say khao , aur shetan kay naqsh-e-qadam per naa chalo . yaqeen jano , woh tumharay liye aik khula dushman hai .
verses.translation: aur chopayo mein say Allah ney woh janwer bhi peda kiye hain jo bojh uthatay hain , aur woh bhi jo zameen say lagay huye hotay hain .   Allah ney jo rizq tumhen diya hai , uss mein say khao , aur shetan kay naqsh-e-qadam per naa chalo . yaqeen jano , woh tumharay liye aik khula dushman hai .

verses.text: . ( maweshiyon kay ) kul aath jooray Allah ney peda kiye hain , do sinfen ( nar aur mada ) bheron ki nasal say aur do bakron ki nasal say . zara unn say poocho kay :  kiya dono naron ko Allah ney haram kiya hai , ya dono mada ko-? ya her uss bacchay ko jo dono naslon ki mada kay pet mein mojood ho-? agar tum sachay ho to kissi ilmi buniyad per mujhay jawab do !
verses.translation: . ( maweshiyon kay ) kul aath jooray Allah ney peda kiye hain , do sinfen ( nar aur mada ) bheron ki nasal say aur do bakron ki nasal say . zara unn say poocho kay :  kiya dono naron ko Allah ney haram kiya hai , ya dono mada ko-? ya her uss bacchay ko jo dono naslon ki mada kay pet mein mojood ho-? agar tum sachay ho to kissi ilmi buniyad per mujhay jawab do !

verses.text: aur issi tarah oonton ki bhi do sinfen ( nar aur mada Allah ney ) peda ki hain , aur gaye ki bhi do sinfen . inn say kaho kay :  kiya dono naron ko Allah ney haram kiya hai , ya dono mada ko-? ya her uss bacchay ko jo dono naslon ki mada kay pet mein mojood ho-? kiya tum uss waqt khud hazir thay jab Allah ney tumhen iss ka hukum diya tha-? ( agar nahi , aur yaqeenan nahi ) to phir uss shaks say barh ker zalim kon hoga jo Allah per iss liye jhoot baandhay takay kissi ilmi buniyad kay baghair logon  ko gumrah ker-sakay-? haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah zalim logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .

( agar nahi , aur yaqeenan nahi ) to phir uss shaks say barh ker zalim kon hoga jo Allah per iss liye jhoot baandhay takay kissi ilmi buniyad kay baghair logon  ko gumrah ker-sakay-? haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah zalim logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho kay :  jo wahi mujh per nazil ki gaee hai uss mein to mein koi aesi cheez nahi pata jiss ka khana kissi khaney walay kay liye haram ho ,   illa yeh kay woh murdar ho , ya behta huwa khoon ho , ya soowar ka gosht ho , kiyonkay woh napak hai , ya jo aisa gunah ka janwer ho jiss per Allah kay siwa kissi aur ka naam pukara gaya ho . haan jo shaks ( inn cheezon mein say kissi kay khaney per ) intehai majboor hojaye ,   jabkay woh naa lazzat hasil kernay ki gharz say aisa ker raha ho , aur naa zaroorat ki hadd say aagay barhay , to beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: aur yahudiyon per hum ney her nakhun walay janwer ko haram kerdiya tha , aur gaye aur bakri kay ajza mein say unn ki charbiyan hum ney haram ki then , albatta jo charbi unn ki pusht per ya aanton per lagi ho , ya jo kissi haddi say mili hoi ho woh mustasna thi . yeh hum ney unn ko unn ki sarkashi ki saza di thi . aur poora yaqeen rakho kay hum sachay hain .

verses.text: phir bhi agar yeh ( kafir ) tumhen jhutlayen to keh do kay :  tumhara perwerdigar bari wasee rehmat ka malik hai aur uss kay azab ko mujrimon say talaya nahi jasakta .

verses.text: jinn logon  ney shirk apnaya huwa hai , woh yeh kahen gay kay :  agar Allah chahta to naa hum shirk kertay , naa humaray baap dada , aur naa hum kissi bhi cheez ko haram qarar detay .    inn say pehlay kay logon  ney bhi issi tarah ( Rasoolon ko ) jhutlaya tha , yahan tak kay unhon ney humaray azab ka maza chakh liya . tum inn say kaho kay :  kiya tumharay paas koi ilm hai jo humaray samney nikal ker paish ker-sako-? tum to jiss cheez kay peechay chal rahey ho woh gumaan kay siwa kuch nahi , aur tumhara kaam iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay wehmi andazay lagatay raho .

verses.text: inn say kaho kay :  apney woh gawah zara samney to lao jo yeh gawahi den kay Allah ney inn cheezon ko haram qarar diya hai .  phir agar yeh khud gawahi dey bhi den to tum unn kay sath gawahi mein shareek naa hona , aur unn logon  ki khuwaishaat kay peechay naa chalna jinhon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , jo aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , aur jo doosron ko ( khudai mein ) apney perwerdigar kay barabar mantay hain .
verses.translation: inn say kaho kay :  apney woh gawah zara samney to lao jo yeh gawahi den kay Allah ney inn cheezon ko haram qarar diya hai .  phir agar yeh khud gawahi dey bhi den to tum unn kay sath gawahi mein shareek naa hona , aur unn logon  ki khuwaishaat kay peechay naa chalna jinhon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , jo aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , aur jo doosron ko ( khudai mein ) apney perwerdigar kay barabar mantay hain .

verses.text: . ( unn say ) kaho kay :  aao , mein tumhen parh ker sunaon kay tumharay perwerdigar ney ( dar-haqeeqat ) tum per konsi baaten haram ki hain . woh yeh hain kay uss kay sath kissi ko shareek naa thehrao , aur maa baap kay sath acha sulook kero , aur ghurbat ki wajeh say apney bacchon ko qatal naa kero . hum tumhen bhi rizq den gay , aur unn ko bhi . aur bey hayai kay kamon kay paas bhi naa phatko , chahye woh bey hayai khuli hoi ho ya chupi hoi ,   aur jiss jaan ko Allah ney hurmat ata ki hai ussay kissi bar-haq wajeh kay baghair qatal naa kero . logo ! yeh hain woh baaten jinn ki Allah ney takeed ki hai takay tumhen kuch samajh aaye .
