verses.text: aur yateem jab tak pukhtagi ki umar ko naa phonch jaye , uss waqt tak uss kay maal kay qareeb bhi naa jao , magar aesay tareeqay say jo ( uss kay haq mein ) behtareen ho , aur naap tol insaf kay sath poora poora kiya kero , ( albatta ) Allah kissi bhi shaks ko uss ki taqat say ziyada ki takleef nahi deta .   aur jab koi baat kaho to insaf say kaam lo , chahye moamla apney qareebi rishta daar hi ka ho , aur Allah kay ehad ko poora kero .   logo ! yeh baaten hain jinn ki Allah ney takeed ki hai , takay tum naseehat qubool kero .
verses.translation: aur yateem jab tak pukhtagi ki umar ko naa phonch jaye , uss waqt tak uss kay maal kay qareeb bhi naa jao , magar aesay tareeqay say jo ( uss kay haq mein ) behtareen ho , aur naap tol insaf kay sath poora poora kiya kero , ( albatta ) Allah kissi bhi shaks ko uss ki taqat say ziyada ki takleef nahi deta .   aur jab koi baat kaho to insaf say kaam lo , chahye moamla apney qareebi rishta daar hi ka ho , aur Allah kay ehad ko poora kero .   logo ! yeh baaten hain jinn ki Allah ney takeed ki hai , takay tum naseehat qubool kero .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) yeh bhi kaho kay :  yeh mera seedha seedha raasta hai , lehaza iss kay peechay chalo , aur doosray raaston kay peechay naa parro , werna woh tumhen Allah kay raastay say alag kerden gay .  logo ! yeh baaten hain jinn ki Allah ney takeed ki hai takay tum muttaqi bano .

verses.text: phir hum ney musa ko kitab ata ki thi jiss ka maqsad yeh tha kay naik logon  per Allah ki naimat poori ho , aur her cheez ki tafseel biyan kerdi jaye , aur woh ( logon  kay liye ) rehnumai aur rehmat ka sabab banay , takay woh ( aakhirat mein ) apney perwerdigar say jaa milney per emaan ley ayen .

verses.text: aur ( issi tarah ) yeh barkat wali kitab hai jo hum ney nazil ki hai . lehaza iss ki perwi kero , aur taqwa ikhtiyar kero , takay tum per rehmat ho
verses.translation: aur ( issi tarah ) yeh barkat wali kitab hai jo hum ney nazil ki hai . lehaza iss ki perwi kero , aur taqwa ikhtiyar kero , takay tum per rehmat ho

verses.text: . ( yeh kitab hum ney iss liye nazil ki kay ) kabhi tum yeh kehney lago kay kitab to hum say pehlay do girohon ( yahood o nasara ) per nazil ki gaee thi , aur jo kuch woh parhtay parhatay thay , hum to uss say bilkul bey khabar thay .
verses.translation: . ( yeh kitab hum ney iss liye nazil ki kay ) kabhi tum yeh kehney lago kay kitab to hum say pehlay do girohon ( yahood o nasara ) per nazil ki gaee thi , aur jo kuch woh parhtay parhatay thay , hum to uss say bilkul bey khabar thay .

verses.text: ya yeh kaho kay agar hum logon  per kitab nazil hojati to hum inn ( yahudiyon aur essaiyon ) say yaqeenan ziyada hidayat per hotay . lo ! phir tumharay paas tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik roshan daleel aur hidayat o rehmat ka saman aagaya hai ! abb uss say barh ker zalim kon hoga jo Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlaye aur unn say mun morr ley ? jo log humari aayaton say mun morr rahey hain , unn ko hum boht bura azab den gay , kiyonkay woh barabar mun morray hi rahey .
verses.translation: ya yeh kaho kay agar hum logon  per kitab nazil hojati to hum inn ( yahudiyon aur essaiyon ) say yaqeenan ziyada hidayat per hotay . lo ! phir tumharay paas tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik roshan daleel aur hidayat o rehmat ka saman aagaya hai ! abb uss say barh ker zalim kon hoga jo Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlaye aur unn say mun morr ley ? jo log humari aayaton say mun morr rahey hain , unn ko hum boht bura azab den gay , kiyonkay woh barabar mun morray hi rahey .

verses.text: yeh ( emaan laney kay liye ) iss kay siwa kiss baat ka intizar ker rahey hain kay inn kay paas farishtay ayen , ya tumhara perwerdigar khud aaye , ya tumharay perwerdigar ki kuch nishaniyan aajayen-? ( halankay ) jiss din tumharay perwerdigar ki koi nishani aagae , uss din kissi aesay shaks ka emaan uss kay liye kaar aamad nahi hoga jo pehlay emaan naa laya ho , ya jiss ney apney emaan kay sath kissi naik amal ki kamai naa ki ho .   ( lehaza inn logon  say ) keh do kay :  acha , intizar kero , hum bhi intizar ker rahey hain .
verses.translation: yeh ( emaan laney kay liye ) iss kay siwa kiss baat ka intizar ker rahey hain kay inn kay paas farishtay ayen , ya tumhara perwerdigar khud aaye , ya tumharay perwerdigar ki kuch nishaniyan aajayen-? ( halankay ) jiss din tumharay perwerdigar ki koi nishani aagae , uss din kissi aesay shaks ka emaan uss kay liye kaar aamad nahi hoga jo pehlay emaan naa laya ho , ya jiss ney apney emaan kay sath kissi naik amal ki kamai naa ki ho .   ( lehaza inn logon  say ) keh do kay :  acha , intizar kero , hum bhi intizar ker rahey hain .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yaqeen jano kay jinn logon  ney apney deen mein tafarqa peda kiya hai , aur girohon mein butt gaye hain , unn say tumhara koi talluq nahi hai . unn ka moamla to Allah kay hawalay hai . phir woh unhen jatlaye ga kay woh kiya kuch kertay rahey hain .

verses.text: jo shaks koi naiki ley ker aaye ga , uss kay liye uss jaisi das naikiyon ka sawab hai , aur jo shaks koi badi ley ker aaye ga , to uss ko sirf ussi aik badi ki saza di jaye gi , aur unn per koi zulm nahi hoga .
verses.translation: jo shaks koi naiki ley ker aaye ga , uss kay liye uss jaisi das naikiyon ka sawab hai , aur jo shaks koi badi ley ker aaye ga , to uss ko sirf ussi aik badi ki saza di jaye gi , aur unn per koi zulm nahi hoga .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay meray perwerdigar ney mujhay aik seedhay raastay per laga diya hai jo kaji say pak deen hai , Ibrahim ka deen ! jinhon ney poori tarah yaksoo ho ker apna rukh sirf Allah ki taraf kiya huwa tha , aur woh shirk kernay walon mein say nahi thay .

verses.text: keh do kay :  beyshak meri namaz , meri ibadat aur mera jeena marna sabb kuch Allah kay liye hai jo tamam jahano ka perwerdigar hai .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  beyshak meri namaz , meri ibadat aur mera jeena marna sabb kuch Allah kay liye hai jo tamam jahano ka perwerdigar hai .

verses.text: uss ka koi shareek nahi hai , issi baat ka mujhay hukum diya gaya hai , aur mein uss kay aagay sabb say pehlay sar jhukaney wala hun .
verses.translation: uss ka koi shareek nahi hai , issi baat ka mujhay hukum diya gaya hai , aur mein uss kay aagay sabb say pehlay sar jhukaney wala hun .

verses.text: keh do-kay :  kiya mein Allah kay siwa koi aur perwerdigar talash kerun , halankay woh her cheez ka malik hai ? aur jo koi shaks koi kamai kerta hai , uss ka nafaa nuqsan kissi aur per nahi , khud ussi per parrta hai , aur koi bojh uthaney wala kissi aur ka bojh nahi uthaye ga .   phir tumharay perwerdigar hi ki taraf tum sabb ko loattna hai . uss waqt woh tumhen woh sari baaten bataye ga jinn mein tum ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: keh do-kay :  kiya mein Allah kay siwa koi aur perwerdigar talash kerun , halankay woh her cheez ka malik hai ? aur jo koi shaks koi kamai kerta hai , uss ka nafaa nuqsan kissi aur per nahi , khud ussi per parrta hai , aur koi bojh uthaney wala kissi aur ka bojh nahi uthaye ga .   phir tumharay perwerdigar hi ki taraf tum sabb ko loattna hai . uss waqt woh tumhen woh sari baaten bataye ga jinn mein tum ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: tamam tareefen Allah ki hain jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya , aur andheriyan aur roshni banai . phir bhi jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai woh doosron ko ( khudai mein ) apney perwerdigar kay barabar qarar dey rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: tamam tareefen Allah ki hain jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya , aur andheriyan aur roshni banai . phir bhi jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai woh doosron ko ( khudai mein ) apney perwerdigar kay barabar qarar dey rahey hain .

ayahs.text: wohi zaat hai jiss ney tum ko geeli mitti say peda kiya , phir ( tumhari zindagi ki ) aik miyaad muqarrar kerdi . aur ( dobara zinda honey ki ) aik mutayyan miyaad ussi kay paas hai .   phir bhi tum shak mein parray huye ho .
ayahs.translation: wohi zaat hai jiss ney tum ko geeli mitti say peda kiya , phir ( tumhari zindagi ki ) aik miyaad muqarrar kerdi . aur ( dobara zinda honey ki ) aik mutayyan miyaad ussi kay paas hai .   phir bhi tum shak mein parray huye ho .

ayahs.text: aur wohi Allah aasmano mein bhi hai , aur zameen mein bhi . woh tumharay chupay huye bhed bhi janta hai , aur khulay huye halaat bhi , aur jo kuch kamai tum ker rahey ho , uss say bhi waqif hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( inn kafiron ka haal yeh hai kay ) inn kay paas inn kay perwerdigar ki nishaniyon mein say jab bhi koi nishani aati hai , to yeh log uss say mun morr letay hain .

ayahs.text: chunacheh jab haq inn kay paas aagaya to inn logon  ney ussay jhutla diya . nateeja yeh kay jiss baat ka yeh mazaq uratay rahey hain , jald hi inn ko uss ki khabren phonch jayen gi .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh jab haq inn kay paas aagaya to inn logon  ney ussay jhutla diya . nateeja yeh kay jiss baat ka yeh mazaq uratay rahey hain , jald hi inn ko uss ki khabren phonch jayen gi .

ayahs.text: kiya unhon ney nahi dekha kay hum inn say pehlay kitni qoamon ko halak ker-chukay hain ! unn ko hum ney zameen mein woh iqtidar diya tha jo tumhen nahi diya . hum ney unn per aasman say khoob barishen bhejen , aur hum ney daryaon ko muqarrar kerdiya kay woh unn kay neechay behtay rahen . lekin phir unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say hum ney unn ko halak ker daala , aur unn kay baad doosri naslen peda ken .

ayahs.text: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  iss ( payghumber ) per koi farishta kiyon nahi utaara gaya-?  halankay agar hum koi farishta utaar detay to sara kaam hi tamam hojata ,   phir inn ko koi mohlat naa di jati

ayahs.text: aur agar hum farishtay hi ko payghumber banatay , tab bhi ussay kissi mard hi ( ki shakal mein ) banatay , aur inn ko phir hum issi shubhay mein daal detay jiss mein abb mubtala hain .
ayahs.translation: aur agar hum farishtay hi ko payghumber banatay , tab bhi ussay kissi mard hi ( ki shakal mein ) banatay , aur inn ko phir hum issi shubhay mein daal detay jiss mein abb mubtala hain .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum say pehlay bhi boht say Rasoolon ka mazaq uraya gaya hai , lekin nateeja yeh huwa kay unn mein say jinn logon  ney mazaq uraya tha , unn ko ussi cheez ney aa-ghera jiss ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum say pehlay bhi boht say Rasoolon ka mazaq uraya gaya hai , lekin nateeja yeh huwa kay unn mein say jinn logon  ney mazaq uraya tha , unn ko ussi cheez ney aa-ghera jiss ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: . ( inn kafiron say ) kaho kay :  zara zameen mein chalo phiro , phir dekho kay ( payghumberon ko ) jhutlaney walon ka kaisa anjam huwa-?
ayahs.translation: . ( inn kafiron say ) kaho kay :  zara zameen mein chalo phiro , phir dekho kay ( payghumberon ko ) jhutlaney walon ka kaisa anjam huwa-?

ayahs.text: . ( inn say ) poocho kay :  aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai woh kiss ki milkiyat hai-?  ( phir agar woh jawab naa den to khud hi ) keh do kay :  Allah hi ki milkiyat hai . uss ney rehmat ko apney oopper lazim ker rakha hai . ( iss liye tauba kerlo to pichlay saray gunah moaaf kerday ga , werna ) woh tum sabb ko zaroor bil-zaroor qayamat kay din jama keray ga jiss kay aaney mein koi shak nahi hai , ( lekin ) jinn logon  ney apni janon kay liye ghatay ka soda ker rakha hai , woh ( iss haqeeqat per ) emaan nahi latay .
ayahs.translation: . ( inn say ) poocho kay :  aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai woh kiss ki milkiyat hai-?  ( phir agar woh jawab naa den to khud hi ) keh do kay :  Allah hi ki milkiyat hai . uss ney rehmat ko apney oopper lazim ker rakha hai . ( iss liye tauba kerlo to pichlay saray gunah moaaf kerday ga , werna ) woh tum sabb ko zaroor bil-zaroor qayamat kay din jama keray ga jiss kay aaney mein koi shak nahi hai , ( lekin ) jinn logon  ney apni janon kay liye ghatay ka soda ker rakha hai , woh ( iss haqeeqat per ) emaan nahi latay .

ayahs.text: aur raat aur din mein jitni makhlooqaat aaram paati hain , sabb ussi kay qabazay mein hain ,   aur woh her baat ko sunta , her cheez ko janta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur raat aur din mein jitni makhlooqaat aaram paati hain , sabb ussi kay qabazay mein hain ,   aur woh her baat ko sunta , her cheez ko janta hai .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  kiya mein Allah kay siwa kissi aur ko rakhwala banaon-? ( uss Allah ko chorr ker ) jo aasmano aur zameen ka peda kernay wala hai , aur jo sabb ko khilata hai , kissi say khata nahi-?  keh do kay :  mujhay yeh hukum diya gaya hai kay farmanbardaari mein sabb logon  say pehal kernay wala mein banon .  aur tum mushrikon mein hergiz shamil naa hona .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  kiya mein Allah kay siwa kissi aur ko rakhwala banaon-? ( uss Allah ko chorr ker ) jo aasmano aur zameen ka peda kernay wala hai , aur jo sabb ko khilata hai , kissi say khata nahi-?  keh do kay :  mujhay yeh hukum diya gaya hai kay farmanbardaari mein sabb logon  say pehal kernay wala mein banon .  aur tum mushrikon mein hergiz shamil naa hona .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  agar mein apney perwerdigar ki nafarmani kerun to mujhay aik zabardast din kay azab ka khof hai .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  agar mein apney perwerdigar ki nafarmani kerun to mujhay aik zabardast din kay azab ka khof hai .

ayahs.text: jiss kissi shaks say uss din woh azab hata diya gaya , uss per Allah ney bara reham kiya , aur yehi wazeh kamiyabi hai .
ayahs.translation: jiss kissi shaks say uss din woh azab hata diya gaya , uss per Allah ney bara reham kiya , aur yehi wazeh kamiyabi hai .

ayahs.text: agar Allah tumhen koi takleef phonchaye to khud uss kay siwa ussay door kernay wala koi nahi , aur agar woh tumhen koi bhalai phonchaye to woh her cheez per qudrat rakhta hi hai .
ayahs.translation: agar Allah tumhen koi takleef phonchaye to khud uss kay siwa ussay door kernay wala koi nahi , aur agar woh tumhen koi bhalai phonchaye to woh her cheez per qudrat rakhta hi hai .

ayahs.text: aur woh apney bandon kay oopper mukammal iqtidar rakhta hai , aur woh hakeem bhi hai , poori tarah ba-khabar bhi
ayahs.translation: aur woh apney bandon kay oopper mukammal iqtidar rakhta hai , aur woh hakeem bhi hai , poori tarah ba-khabar bhi

ayahs.text: kaho :  kon si cheez aesi hai jo ( kissi baat ki ) gawahi denay kay liye sabb say aalaa darjay ki ho ?  kaho :  Allah ! ( aur wohi ) meray aur tumharay darmiyan gawah hai . aur mujh per yeh Quran wahi kay tor per iss liye nazil kiya gaya hai takay iss kay zariye mein tumhen bhi daraon , aur unn sabb ko bhi jinhen yeh Quran phonchay . kiya sach mooch tum yeh gawahi dey saktay ho kay Allah kay sath aur bhi mabood hain-?  keh do kay :  mein to aesi gawahi nahi dun ga .  keh do kay :  woh to sirf aik khuda hai , aur jinn jinn cheezon ko tum uss ki khudai mein shareek thehratay ho , mein unn sabb say beyzar hun .
ayahs.translation: kaho :  kon si cheez aesi hai jo ( kissi baat ki ) gawahi denay kay liye sabb say aalaa darjay ki ho ?  kaho :  Allah ! ( aur wohi ) meray aur tumharay darmiyan gawah hai . aur mujh per yeh Quran wahi kay tor per iss liye nazil kiya gaya hai takay iss kay zariye mein tumhen bhi daraon , aur unn sabb ko bhi jinhen yeh Quran phonchay . kiya sach mooch tum yeh gawahi dey saktay ho kay Allah kay sath aur bhi mabood hain-?  keh do kay :  mein to aesi gawahi nahi dun ga .  keh do kay :  woh to sirf aik khuda hai , aur jinn jinn cheezon ko tum uss ki khudai mein shareek thehratay ho , mein unn sabb say beyzar hun .

ayahs.text: jinn logon  ko hum ney kitab di hai , woh inn ko ( yani khaatam-an-Nabiyeen SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ko ) iss tarah pehchantay hain jaisay woh apney beton ko pehchantay hain . ( phir bhi ) jinn logon  ney apni janon kay liye ghatay ka soda ker rakha hai , woh emaan nahi latay .
ayahs.translation: jinn logon  ko hum ney kitab di hai , woh inn ko ( yani khaatam-an-Nabiyeen SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ko ) iss tarah pehchantay hain jaisay woh apney beton ko pehchantay hain . ( phir bhi ) jinn logon  ney apni janon kay liye ghatay ka soda ker rakha hai , woh emaan nahi latay .

ayahs.text: aur uss shaks say barh ker zalim kon hosakta hai jo Allah per jhoota bohtan baandhay , ya Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlaye-? yaqeen rakho kay zalim log falah nahi paaskatay .
ayahs.translation: aur uss shaks say barh ker zalim kon hosakta hai jo Allah per jhoota bohtan baandhay , ya Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlaye-? yaqeen rakho kay zalim log falah nahi paaskatay .

ayahs.text: uss din ( ko yaad rakho ) jab hum inn sabb ko ikattha keren gay , phir jinn logon  ney shirk kiya hoga unn say poochen gay kay :  kahan hain tumharay woh mabood jinn kay baaray mein tum yeh dawa kertay thay kay woh khudai mein Allah kay shareek hain-?
ayahs.translation: uss din ( ko yaad rakho ) jab hum inn sabb ko ikattha keren gay , phir jinn logon  ney shirk kiya hoga unn say poochen gay kay :  kahan hain tumharay woh mabood jinn kay baaray mein tum yeh dawa kertay thay kay woh khudai mein Allah kay shareek hain-?

ayahs.text: uss waqt unn kay paas koi bahana nahi hoga , siwaye iss kay kay woh kahen gay :  Allah ki qasam jo humara perwerdigar hai hum to mushrik nahi thay .
ayahs.translation: uss waqt unn kay paas koi bahana nahi hoga , siwaye iss kay kay woh kahen gay :  Allah ki qasam jo humara perwerdigar hai hum to mushrik nahi thay .

ayahs.text: dekho ! yeh apney moamlay mein kiss tarah jhoot bol jayen gay , aur jo ( mabood ) unhon ney jhoot moott tarash rakhay thay , unn ka enhen koi suragh nahi mil sakay ga !
ayahs.translation: dekho ! yeh apney moamlay mein kiss tarah jhoot bol jayen gay , aur jo ( mabood ) unhon ney jhoot moott tarash rakhay thay , unn ka enhen koi suragh nahi mil sakay ga !

ayahs.text: aur inn mein say kuch log aesay hain jo tumhari baat kaan laga ker suntay hain , magar ( chunkay yeh sunna talab-e-haq kay bajaye zidd per array rehney kay liye hota hai , iss liye ) hum ney inn kay dilon per aesay perday daal diye hain kay woh uss ko samajhtay nahi hain , aur unn kay kanon mein behra-pann peda kerdiya hai . aur agar woh aik aik ker kay sari nishaniyan dekh len tab bhi woh inn per emaan nahi layen gay . inteha yeh hai kay jab tumharay paas jhagrra kernay kay liye aatay hain to yeh kafir log yun kehtay hain kay yeh ( Quran ) pichlay logon  ki dastano kay siwa kuch nahi .
ayahs.translation: aur inn mein say kuch log aesay hain jo tumhari baat kaan laga ker suntay hain , magar ( chunkay yeh sunna talab-e-haq kay bajaye zidd per array rehney kay liye hota hai , iss liye ) hum ney inn kay dilon per aesay perday daal diye hain kay woh uss ko samajhtay nahi hain , aur unn kay kanon mein behra-pann peda kerdiya hai . aur agar woh aik aik ker kay sari nishaniyan dekh len tab bhi woh inn per emaan nahi layen gay . inteha yeh hai kay jab tumharay paas jhagrra kernay kay liye aatay hain to yeh kafir log yun kehtay hain kay yeh ( Quran ) pichlay logon  ki dastano kay siwa kuch nahi .

ayahs.text: aur yeh doosron ko bhi iss ( Quran ) say roktay hain , aur khud bhi iss say door rehtay hain . aur ( iss tarah ) woh apni janon kay siwa kissi aur ko halakat mein nahi daal rahey , lekin unn ko ehsas nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh doosron ko bhi iss ( Quran ) say roktay hain , aur khud bhi iss say door rehtay hain . aur ( iss tarah ) woh apni janon kay siwa kissi aur ko halakat mein nahi daal rahey , lekin unn ko ehsas nahi hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( bara holnaak nazara hoga ) agar tum woh waqt dekho jab unn ko dozakh per kharra kiya jaye ga , aur yeh kahen gay :  aey kaash ! hamen wapis ( duniya mein ) bhej diya jaye , takay iss baar hum apney perwerdigar ki nishaniyon ko naa jhutlayen , aur humara shumar mominon mein hojaye !
ayahs.translation: aur ( bara holnaak nazara hoga ) agar tum woh waqt dekho jab unn ko dozakh per kharra kiya jaye ga , aur yeh kahen gay :  aey kaash ! hamen wapis ( duniya mein ) bhej diya jaye , takay iss baar hum apney perwerdigar ki nishaniyon ko naa jhutlayen , aur humara shumar mominon mein hojaye !

ayahs.text: halankay ( inn ki yeh aarzoo bhi sachi naa hogi ) balkay darasal woh cheez ( yani aakhirat ) inn kay samney khul ker aa-chuki hogi jissay woh pehlay chupaya kertay thay , ( iss liye majbooran yeh dawa keren gay ) werna agar inn ko waqaee wapis bheja jaye to yeh dobara wohi kuch keren gay jiss say enhen roka gaya hai , aur yaqeen jano yeh pakay jhootay hain .
ayahs.translation: halankay ( inn ki yeh aarzoo bhi sachi naa hogi ) balkay darasal woh cheez ( yani aakhirat ) inn kay samney khul ker aa-chuki hogi jissay woh pehlay chupaya kertay thay , ( iss liye majbooran yeh dawa keren gay ) werna agar inn ko waqaee wapis bheja jaye to yeh dobara wohi kuch keren gay jiss say enhen roka gaya hai , aur yaqeen jano yeh pakay jhootay hain .

ayahs.text: yeh to yun kehtay hain kay jo kuch hai bus yehi dunyawi zindagi hai aur hum mar ker dobara zinda nahi kiye jayen gay .
ayahs.translation: yeh to yun kehtay hain kay jo kuch hai bus yehi dunyawi zindagi hai aur hum mar ker dobara zinda nahi kiye jayen gay .

ayahs.text: aur agar tum woh waqt dekho jab yeh apney rab kay samney kharray kiye jayen gay ! woh kahey ga :  kiya yeh ( doosri zindagi ) haq nahi hai ?  woh kahen gay :  beyshak humaray rab ki qasam !  Allah kahey ga :  to phir chakho azab ka maza , kiyonkay tum kufr kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: aur agar tum woh waqt dekho jab yeh apney rab kay samney kharray kiye jayen gay ! woh kahey ga :  kiya yeh ( doosri zindagi ) haq nahi hai ?  woh kahen gay :  beyshak humaray rab ki qasam !  Allah kahey ga :  to phir chakho azab ka maza , kiyonkay tum kufr kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay baray khasaray mein hain woh log jinhon ney Allah say jaa milney ko jhutlaya hai , yahan tak kay jab qayamat achanak unn kay samney aa-khari hogi to woh kahen gay :  haaye afsos ! kay hum ney iss ( qayamat ) kay baaray mein bari kotahi ki .  aur woh ( uss waqt ) apni peethon per apney gunahon ka bojh laadey huye hon gay . ( lehaza ) khabrdar raho kay boht bura bojh hai jo yeh log utha rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay baray khasaray mein hain woh log jinhon ney Allah say jaa milney ko jhutlaya hai , yahan tak kay jab qayamat achanak unn kay samney aa-khari hogi to woh kahen gay :  haaye afsos ! kay hum ney iss ( qayamat ) kay baaray mein bari kotahi ki .  aur woh ( uss waqt ) apni peethon per apney gunahon ka bojh laadey huye hon gay . ( lehaza ) khabrdar raho kay boht bura bojh hai jo yeh log utha rahey hain .

ayahs.text: aur dunyawi zindagi to aik khel tamashay kay siwa kuch nahi ,   aur yaqeen jano kay jo log taqwa ikhtiyar kertay hain , unn kay liye aakhirat wala ghar kahen ziyada behtar hai . to kiya itni si baat tumhari aqal mein nahi aati-?
ayahs.translation: aur dunyawi zindagi to aik khel tamashay kay siwa kuch nahi ,   aur yaqeen jano kay jo log taqwa ikhtiyar kertay hain , unn kay liye aakhirat wala ghar kahen ziyada behtar hai . to kiya itni si baat tumhari aqal mein nahi aati-?

ayahs.text: . ( aey Rasool ! ) hamen khoob maloom hai kay yeh log jo baaten kertay hain unn say tumhen ranj hota hai , kiyonkay darasal yeh tumhen nahi jhutlatay , balkay yeh zalim Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey Rasool ! ) hamen khoob maloom hai kay yeh log jo baaten kertay hain unn say tumhen ranj hota hai , kiyonkay darasal yeh tumhen nahi jhutlatay , balkay yeh zalim Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kertay hain .

ayahs.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum say pehlay boht say Rasoolon ko jhutlaya gaya hai . phir jiss tarah unhen jhutlaya gaya aur takleefen di gaeen , uss sabb per unhon ney sabar kiya , yahan tak kay humari madad unn ko phonch gaee . aur koi nahi hai jo Allah ki baaton ko badal sakay . aur ( pichlay ) Rasoolon kay kuch waqiyaat aap tak phonch hi chukay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum say pehlay boht say Rasoolon ko jhutlaya gaya hai . phir jiss tarah unhen jhutlaya gaya aur takleefen di gaeen , uss sabb per unhon ney sabar kiya , yahan tak kay humari madad unn ko phonch gaee . aur koi nahi hai jo Allah ki baaton ko badal sakay . aur ( pichlay ) Rasoolon kay kuch waqiyaat aap tak phonch hi chukay hain .

ayahs.text: aur agar inn logon  ka mun morray rehna tumhen boht bhari maloom horaha hai to agar tum zameen kay andar ( janey kay liye ) koi surang ya aasman mein ( charrney kay liye ) koi seerhi dhoond saktay ho to unn kay paas ( unn ka mun maanga yeh ) moajza ley aao . aur agar Allah chahta to inn sabb ko hidayat per jama ker deta . lehaza tum nadanon mein hergiz shamil naa hona .
ayahs.translation: aur agar inn logon  ka mun morray rehna tumhen boht bhari maloom horaha hai to agar tum zameen kay andar ( janey kay liye ) koi surang ya aasman mein ( charrney kay liye ) koi seerhi dhoond saktay ho to unn kay paas ( unn ka mun maanga yeh ) moajza ley aao . aur agar Allah chahta to inn sabb ko hidayat per jama ker deta . lehaza tum nadanon mein hergiz shamil naa hona .

ayahs.text: baat to wohi log maan saktay hain jo ( haq kay talib ban ker ) sunen . jahan tak inn murdon ka talluq hai inn ko to Allah hi qabron say uthaye ga , phir yeh ussi ki taraf lotaye jayen gay .
ayahs.translation: baat to wohi log maan saktay hain jo ( haq kay talib ban ker ) sunen . jahan tak inn murdon ka talluq hai inn ko to Allah hi qabron say uthaye ga , phir yeh ussi ki taraf lotaye jayen gay .

ayahs.text: yeh log kehtay hain kay ( agar yeh nabi hain to ) inn per inn/unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say koi nishani kiyon nahi utaari gaee-? tum ( inn say ) kaho kay Allah beyshak iss baat per qadir hai kay koi nishani nazil kerday , lekin inn mein say aksar log ( iss ka anjam ) nahi jantay .
ayahs.translation: yeh log kehtay hain kay ( agar yeh nabi hain to ) inn per inn/unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say koi nishani kiyon nahi utaari gaee-? tum ( inn say ) kaho kay Allah beyshak iss baat per qadir hai kay koi nishani nazil kerday , lekin inn mein say aksar log ( iss ka anjam ) nahi jantay .

ayahs.text: aur zameen mein jitney janwer chaltay hain , aur jitney perinday apney peron say urtay hain , woh sabb makhlooqaat ki tum jaisi hi asnaaf hain . hum ney kitab ( yani loah-e-mehfooz ) mein koi kasar nahi chorri hai . phir inn sabb ko jama ker kay inn kay perwerdigar ki taraf ley jaya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: aur zameen mein jitney janwer chaltay hain , aur jitney perinday apney peron say urtay hain , woh sabb makhlooqaat ki tum jaisi hi asnaaf hain . hum ney kitab ( yani loah-e-mehfooz ) mein koi kasar nahi chorri hai . phir inn sabb ko jama ker kay inn kay perwerdigar ki taraf ley jaya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai woh andheron mein bhataktay bhataktay behray aur goongay hochukay hain .   Allah jissay chahta hai , ( uss ki hatt dharami ki wajeh say ) gumrahi mein daal deta hai , aur jissay chahta hai , seedhi raah per laga deta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai woh andheron mein bhataktay bhataktay behray aur goongay hochukay hain .   Allah jissay chahta hai , ( uss ki hatt dharami ki wajeh say ) gumrahi mein daal deta hai , aur jissay chahta hai , seedhi raah per laga deta hai .

ayahs.text: . ( inn kafiron ) say kaho :  agar tum sachay ho to zara yeh batao kay agar tum per Allah ka azab aajaye , ya tum per qayamat toot parray to kiya Allah kay siwa kissi aur ko pukaro gay-?
ayahs.translation: . ( inn kafiron ) say kaho :  agar tum sachay ho to zara yeh batao kay agar tum per Allah ka azab aajaye , ya tum per qayamat toot parray to kiya Allah kay siwa kissi aur ko pukaro gay-?

ayahs.text: balkay ussi ko pukaro gay , phir jiss pareshani kay liye tum ney ussay pukara hai , agar woh chahye ga to ussay door kerday ga , aur jinn ( deotaon ) ko tum Allah kay sath shareek thehratay ho ( uss waqt ) unn ko bhool jao gay .
ayahs.translation: balkay ussi ko pukaro gay , phir jiss pareshani kay liye tum ney ussay pukara hai , agar woh chahye ga to ussay door kerday ga , aur jinn ( deotaon ) ko tum Allah kay sath shareek thehratay ho ( uss waqt ) unn ko bhool jao gay .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum say pehlay hum ney boht si qoamon kay paas payghumber bhejay , phir hum ney ( unn ki nafarmani ki bana per ) unhen sakhtiyon aur takleefon mein girftaar kiya , takay woh ijz o niaz ka shewa apnayen .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum say pehlay hum ney boht si qoamon kay paas payghumber bhejay , phir hum ney ( unn ki nafarmani ki bana per ) unhen sakhtiyon aur takleefon mein girftaar kiya , takay woh ijz o niaz ka shewa apnayen .

ayahs.text: phir aisa kiyon naa huwa kay jab unn kay paas humari taraf say sakhti aai thi , uss waqt woh aajzi ka ravaiyya ikhtiyar kertay-? balkay unn kay dil to aur sakht hogaye , aur jo kuch woh ker rahey thay , shetan ney unhen yeh sujhaya kay wohi baray shandaar kaam hain .
ayahs.translation: phir aisa kiyon naa huwa kay jab unn kay paas humari taraf say sakhti aai thi , uss waqt woh aajzi ka ravaiyya ikhtiyar kertay-? balkay unn kay dil to aur sakht hogaye , aur jo kuch woh ker rahey thay , shetan ney unhen yeh sujhaya kay wohi baray shandaar kaam hain .

ayahs.text: phir unhen jo naseehat ki gaee thi , jab woh ussay bhula bethay to hum ney unn per her naimat kay darwazay khol diye ,   yahan tak kay jo naimaten unhen di gaee then , jab woh unn per itraney lagay to hum ney achanak unn ko aa-pakra , jiss ka nateeja yeh huwa kay woh bilkul mayyus ho ker reh gaye .
ayahs.translation: phir unhen jo naseehat ki gaee thi , jab woh ussay bhula bethay to hum ney unn per her naimat kay darwazay khol diye ,   yahan tak kay jo naimaten unhen di gaee then , jab woh unn per itraney lagay to hum ney achanak unn ko aa-pakra , jiss ka nateeja yeh huwa kay woh bilkul mayyus ho ker reh gaye .

ayahs.text: iss tarah jinn logon  ney zulm kiya tha unn ki jarr kaat ker rakh di gaee , aur tamam tareefen Allah ki hain jo tamam jahano ka perwerdigar hai .
ayahs.translation: iss tarah jinn logon  ney zulm kiya tha unn ki jarr kaat ker rakh di gaee , aur tamam tareefen Allah ki hain jo tamam jahano ka perwerdigar hai .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho :  zara mujhay batao kay agar Allah tumhari sunney ki taqat aur tumhari aankhen tum say cheen ley aur tumharay dilon per mohar laga dey , to Allah kay siwa konsa mabood hai jo yeh cheezen tumhen laaker deydey-?  dekho , hum kaisay kaisay mukhtalif tareeqon say dalaeel biyan kertay hain , phir bhi yeh log mun pher letay hain .

ayahs.text: kaho :  zara yeh batao kay agar Allah ka azab tumharay paas achanak aaye ya aelaan kerkay , dono soorton mein kiya zalimon kay siwa kissi aur ko halak kiya jaye ga-?
ayahs.translation: kaho :  zara yeh batao kay agar Allah ka azab tumharay paas achanak aaye ya aelaan kerkay , dono soorton mein kiya zalimon kay siwa kissi aur ko halak kiya jaye ga-?

ayahs.text: hum payghumberon ko issi liye to bhejtay hain kay woh ( naikiyon per ) khushkhabri sunayen , ( aur nafarmani per Allah kay azab say ) darayen . chunacheh jo log emaan ley aaye aur apni islaah kerli , unn ko naa koi khof hoga , aur naa woh ghumgeen hon gay .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya , unn ko azab phonch ker rahey ga , kiyonkay woh nafarmani kay aadi thay .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya , unn ko azab phonch ker rahey ga , kiyonkay woh nafarmani kay aadi thay .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) inn say kaho :  mein tum say yeh nahi kehta kay meray paas Allah kay khazaney hain aur naa mein ghaib ka ( poora ) ilm rakhta hun , aur naa mein tum say yeh kehta hun kay mein farishta hun .   mein to sirf uss wahi ki ittaba kerta hun jo mujh per nazil ki jati hai .  kaho kay :  kiya aik andha aur doosra beenai rakhney wala dono barabar hosaktay hain-? phir kiya tum ghor nahi kertay-?
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) inn say kaho :  mein tum say yeh nahi kehta kay meray paas Allah kay khazaney hain aur naa mein ghaib ka ( poora ) ilm rakhta hun , aur naa mein tum say yeh kehta hun kay mein farishta hun .   mein to sirf uss wahi ki ittaba kerta hun jo mujh per nazil ki jati hai .  kaho kay :  kiya aik andha aur doosra beenai rakhney wala dono barabar hosaktay hain-? phir kiya tum ghor nahi kertay-?

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum iss wahi kay zariye unn logon  ko khabrdar kero jo iss baat ka khof rakhtay hain kay unn ko unn kay perwerdigar kay paas aesi halat mein jama ker kay laya jaye ga kay iss/uss kay siwa naa unn ka koi yaar-o-madadgaar hoga , naa koi sirfarishi ,   takay woh log taqwa ikhtiyar kerlen .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum iss wahi kay zariye unn logon  ko khabrdar kero jo iss baat ka khof rakhtay hain kay unn ko unn kay perwerdigar kay paas aesi halat mein jama ker kay laya jaye ga kay iss/uss kay siwa naa unn ka koi yaar-o-madadgaar hoga , naa koi sirfarishi ,   takay woh log taqwa ikhtiyar kerlen .

ayahs.text: aur unn logon  ko apni majlis say naa nikalna jo subha o shaam apney perwerdigar ko uss ki khushnoodi hasil kernay kay liye pukartay rehtay hain .   unn kay hisab mein jo aemal hain unn mein say kissi ki zimma daari tum per nahi hai , aur tumharay hisab mein jo aemal hain unn mein say kissi ki zimma daari unn per nahi hai jiss ki wajeh say tum unhen nikal bahir kero , aur zalimon mein shamil hojao .
ayahs.translation: aur unn logon  ko apni majlis say naa nikalna jo subha o shaam apney perwerdigar ko uss ki khushnoodi hasil kernay kay liye pukartay rehtay hain .   unn kay hisab mein jo aemal hain unn mein say kissi ki zimma daari tum per nahi hai , aur tumharay hisab mein jo aemal hain unn mein say kissi ki zimma daari unn per nahi hai jiss ki wajeh say tum unhen nikal bahir kero , aur zalimon mein shamil hojao .

ayahs.text: issi tarah hum ney kuch logon  ko kuch doosron kay zariye aazmaesh mein daala hai   takay woh ( unn kay baaray mein ) yeh kahen kay :  kiya yeh hain woh log jinn ko Allah ney hum sabb ko chorr ker ehsan kernay kay liye chuna hai-?    kiya ( jo kafir yeh baat keh rahey hain unn kay khayal mein ) Allah apney shukar guzaar bandon ko doosron say ziyada nahi janta-?
ayahs.translation: issi tarah hum ney kuch logon  ko kuch doosron kay zariye aazmaesh mein daala hai   takay woh ( unn kay baaray mein ) yeh kahen kay :  kiya yeh hain woh log jinn ko Allah ney hum sabb ko chorr ker ehsan kernay kay liye chuna hai-?    kiya ( jo kafir yeh baat keh rahey hain unn kay khayal mein ) Allah apney shukar guzaar bandon ko doosron say ziyada nahi janta-?

ayahs.text: aur jab tumharay paas woh log ayen jo humari aayaton per emaan rakhtay hain to unn say kaho :  salamti ho tum per ! tumharay perwerdigar ney apney oopper rehmat ka yeh moamla kerna lazim kerliya hai kay agar tum mein say koi nadani say koi bura kaam ker bethay , phir uss kay baad tauba kerlay aur apni islaah kerlay to Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jab tumharay paas woh log ayen jo humari aayaton per emaan rakhtay hain to unn say kaho :  salamti ho tum per ! tumharay perwerdigar ney apney oopper rehmat ka yeh moamla kerna lazim kerliya hai kay agar tum mein say koi nadani say koi bura kaam ker bethay , phir uss kay baad tauba kerlay aur apni islaah kerlay to Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: aur hum issi tarah nishaniyan tafseel kay sath biyan kertay hain , ( takay seedha raasta bhi wazeh hojaye ) aur takay mujrimon ka raasta bhi khul ker samney aajaye
ayahs.translation: aur hum issi tarah nishaniyan tafseel kay sath biyan kertay hain , ( takay seedha raasta bhi wazeh hojaye ) aur takay mujrimon ka raasta bhi khul ker samney aajaye

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho kay :  tum Allah kay siwa jinn ( jhootay khudaon ) ko pukartay ho mujhay unn ki ibadat kernay say mana kiya gaya hai .  kaho kay :  mein tumhari khuwaishaat kay peechay nahi chal sakta . agar mein aisa kerun ga to gumrah hun ga , aur mera shumar hidayat yafta logon  mein nahi hoga .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho kay :  tum Allah kay siwa jinn ( jhootay khudaon ) ko pukartay ho mujhay unn ki ibadat kernay say mana kiya gaya hai .  kaho kay :  mein tumhari khuwaishaat kay peechay nahi chal sakta . agar mein aisa kerun ga to gumrah hun ga , aur mera shumar hidayat yafta logon  mein nahi hoga .

ayahs.text: kaho kay :  mujhay apney perwerdigar ki taraf say aik roshan daleel mil chuki hai jiss per mein qaeem hun , aur tum ney ussay jhutla diya hai . jiss cheez kay jaldi aaney ka tum mutalba ker rahey ho woh meray paas mojood nahi hai .   hukum Allah kay siwa kissi ka nahi chalta . woh haq baat biyan ker deta hai , aur wohi sabb say behtar faisla kernay wala hai .
ayahs.translation: kaho kay :  mujhay apney perwerdigar ki taraf say aik roshan daleel mil chuki hai jiss per mein qaeem hun , aur tum ney ussay jhutla diya hai . jiss cheez kay jaldi aaney ka tum mutalba ker rahey ho woh meray paas mojood nahi hai .   hukum Allah kay siwa kissi ka nahi chalta . woh haq baat biyan ker deta hai , aur wohi sabb say behtar faisla kernay wala hai .

ayahs.text: kaho kay :  jiss cheez ki tum jaldi macha rahey ho , agar woh meray paas hoti to meray aur tumharay darmiyan faisla hochuka hota . aur Allah zalimon ko khoob janta hai .
ayahs.translation: kaho kay :  jiss cheez ki tum jaldi macha rahey ho , agar woh meray paas hoti to meray aur tumharay darmiyan faisla hochuka hota . aur Allah zalimon ko khoob janta hai .

ayahs.text: aur ussi kay paas ghaib ki kunjiyan hain jinhen uss kay siwa koi nahi janta . aur khushki aur samandar mein jo kuch hai woh uss say waqif hai . kissi darkht ka koi pata nahi girta jiss ka ussay ilm naa ho , aur zameen ki andheriyon mein koi dana ya koi khushk ya tarr cheez aesi nahi hai jo aik khuli kitab mein darj naa ho .
ayahs.translation: aur ussi kay paas ghaib ki kunjiyan hain jinhen uss kay siwa koi nahi janta . aur khushki aur samandar mein jo kuch hai woh uss say waqif hai . kissi darkht ka koi pata nahi girta jiss ka ussay ilm naa ho , aur zameen ki andheriyon mein koi dana ya koi khushk ya tarr cheez aesi nahi hai jo aik khuli kitab mein darj naa ho .

ayahs.text: aur wohi hai jo raat kay waqt ( neend mein ) tumhari rooh ( aik hadd tak ) qabz kerleta hai , aur din bhar mein tum ney jo kuch kiya hota hai , ussay khoob janta hai , phir uss ( naye din ) mein tumhen nai zindagi deta hai , takay ( tumhari umar ki ) muqarrara mauddat poori hojaye . phir ussi kay paas tum ko loat ker jana hai . uss waqt woh tumhen bataye ga kay tum kiya kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: aur wohi hai jo raat kay waqt ( neend mein ) tumhari rooh ( aik hadd tak ) qabz kerleta hai , aur din bhar mein tum ney jo kuch kiya hota hai , ussay khoob janta hai , phir uss ( naye din ) mein tumhen nai zindagi deta hai , takay ( tumhari umar ki ) muqarrara mauddat poori hojaye . phir ussi kay paas tum ko loat ker jana hai . uss waqt woh tumhen bataye ga kay tum kiya kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: wohi apney bandon per mukammal iqtidar rakhta hai , aur tumharay liye nigehban ( farishtay ) bhejta hai ,   yahan tak kay jab tum mein say kissi ki moat ka waqt aajata hai to humaray bhejay huye farishtay uss ko poora poora wasool kerletay hain , aur woh zara bhi kotahi nahi kertay .
ayahs.translation: wohi apney bandon per mukammal iqtidar rakhta hai , aur tumharay liye nigehban ( farishtay ) bhejta hai ,   yahan tak kay jab tum mein say kissi ki moat ka waqt aajata hai to humaray bhejay huye farishtay uss ko poora poora wasool kerletay hain , aur woh zara bhi kotahi nahi kertay .

ayahs.text: phir unn sabb ko Allah ki taraf loata diya jata hai jo inn/unn ka molaye bar-haq hai . yaad rakho ! hukum ussi ka chalta hai , aur woh sabb say ziyada jaldi hisab lenay wala hai .
ayahs.translation: phir unn sabb ko Allah ki taraf loata diya jata hai jo inn/unn ka molaye bar-haq hai . yaad rakho ! hukum ussi ka chalta hai , aur woh sabb say ziyada jaldi hisab lenay wala hai .

ayahs.text: kaho :  khushki aur samandar ki tareekiyon say uss waqt kon tumhen nijat deta hai jab tum ussay girr-girra ker aur chupkay chupkay pukartay ho , ( aur yeh kehtay ho kay ) agar uss ney hamen iss museebat say bacha liya to hum zaroor bil-zaroor shukar guzaar bandon mein shamil hojayen gay ?
ayahs.translation: kaho :  khushki aur samandar ki tareekiyon say uss waqt kon tumhen nijat deta hai jab tum ussay girr-girra ker aur chupkay chupkay pukartay ho , ( aur yeh kehtay ho kay ) agar uss ney hamen iss museebat say bacha liya to hum zaroor bil-zaroor shukar guzaar bandon mein shamil hojayen gay ?

ayahs.text: kaho :  Allah hi tumhen uss museebat say bhi bachata hai , aur her doosri takleef say bhi , phir bhi tum shirk kertay ho .
ayahs.translation: kaho :  Allah hi tumhen uss museebat say bhi bachata hai , aur her doosri takleef say bhi , phir bhi tum shirk kertay ho .

ayahs.text: kaho kay :  woh iss baat per poori tarah qudrat rakhta hai kay tum per koi azab tumharay oopper say bhej dey ya tumharay paon kay neechay say ( nikal dey ) ya tumhen mukhtalif toliyon mein baant ker aik doosray say bhira dey , aur aik doosray ki taqat ka maza chakha dey . dekho ! hum kiss tarah mukhtalif tareeqon say apni nishaniyan wazeh ker rahey hain , takay yeh kuch samajh say kaam ley len .
ayahs.translation: kaho kay :  woh iss baat per poori tarah qudrat rakhta hai kay tum per koi azab tumharay oopper say bhej dey ya tumharay paon kay neechay say ( nikal dey ) ya tumhen mukhtalif toliyon mein baant ker aik doosray say bhira dey , aur aik doosray ki taqat ka maza chakha dey . dekho ! hum kiss tarah mukhtalif tareeqon say apni nishaniyan wazeh ker rahey hain , takay yeh kuch samajh say kaam ley len .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tumhari qoam ney iss ( Quran ) ko jhutlaya hai , halankay woh bilkul haq hai . tum keh do kay :  mujh ko tumhari zimma daari nahi sonpi gaee hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tumhari qoam ney iss ( Quran ) ko jhutlaya hai , halankay woh bilkul haq hai . tum keh do kay :  mujh ko tumhari zimma daari nahi sonpi gaee hai .

ayahs.text: her waqaey ka aik waqt muqarrar hai , aur jald hi tumhen sabb maloom hojaye ga .
ayahs.translation: her waqaey ka aik waqt muqarrar hai , aur jald hi tumhen sabb maloom hojaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur jab tum unn logon  ko dekho jo humari aayaton ko bura bhala kehney mein lagay huye hain to unn say uss waqt tak kay liye alag hojao jab tak woh kissi aur baat mein mashghool naa hojayen . aur agar kabhi shetan tumhen yeh baat bhula dey to yaad aaney kay baad zalim logon  kay sath naa betho .
ayahs.translation: aur jab tum unn logon  ko dekho jo humari aayaton ko bura bhala kehney mein lagay huye hain to unn say uss waqt tak kay liye alag hojao jab tak woh kissi aur baat mein mashghool naa hojayen . aur agar kabhi shetan tumhen yeh baat bhula dey to yaad aaney kay baad zalim logon  kay sath naa betho .

ayahs.text: unn kay khatay mein jo aemal hain unn ki koi zimma daari perhezgaron per aaeed nahi hoti . albatta naseehat ker-dena unn ka kaam hai , shayad woh bhi ( aesi baaton say ) perhez kernay lagen .
ayahs.translation: unn kay khatay mein jo aemal hain unn ki koi zimma daari perhezgaron per aaeed nahi hoti . albatta naseehat ker-dena unn ka kaam hai , shayad woh bhi ( aesi baaton say ) perhez kernay lagen .

ayahs.text: aur chorr do unn logon  ko jinhon ney apney deen ko khel tamasha bana rakha hai ,   aur jinn ko dunyawi zindagi ney dhokay mein daal diya hai , aur iss ( Quran ) kay zariye ( logon  ko ) naseehat kertay raho , takay aisa naa ho kay koi shaks apney aemal kay sabab iss tarah girftaar hojaye kay Allah ( kay azab ) say bachaney kay liye Allah ko chorr ker naa koi uss ka yaar-o-madadgaar ban sakay naa sirfarishi , aur agar woh ( apni rehai kay liye ) her tarah ka fidya bhi paish kerna chahye to uss say woh qubool naa kiya jaye . ( chunacheh ) yehi ( deen ko khel tamasha bananey walay ) woh log hain jo apney kiye ki badolat girftaar hogaye hain . chunkay unhon ney kufr apna rakha tha , iss liye unn kay liye kholtay huye paani ka mashroob aur aik dukh denay wala azab ( tayyar ) hai .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) inn say kaho :  kiya hum Allah ko chorr ker aesi cheezon ko pukaren jo hamen naa koi faeeda phoncha sakti hain , naa nuqsan , aur jab Allah hamen hidayat dey chuka hai to kiya uss kay baad bhi hum ultay paon phir jayen-? ( aur ) uss shaks ki tarah ( hojayen ) jissay shetan behka ker sehra mein ley gaye hon , aur woh hayrani kay aalam mein bhatakta phirta ho , uss kay kuch sathi hon jo ussay theek raastay ki taraf bula rahey hon kay humaray paas aajao  kaho kay :  Allah ki di hoi hidayat hi sahih maani mein hidayat hai , aur hamen yeh hukum diya gaya hai kay hum Rabb-ul-Aalameen kay aagay jhuk jayen .

ayahs.text: aur wohi zaat hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq peda kiya hai ,   aur jiss din woh ( roz-e-qayamat say ) kahey ga kay :  to hoja  to woh hojaye ga . uss ka qol bar-haq hai . aur jiss din soor phoonka jaye ga , uss din badshahi ussi ki hogi .   woh ghaeeb o hazir her cheez ko janney wala hai , aur wohi bari hikmat wala , poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
ayahs.translation: aur wohi zaat hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq peda kiya hai ,   aur jiss din woh ( roz-e-qayamat say ) kahey ga kay :  to hoja  to woh hojaye ga . uss ka qol bar-haq hai . aur jiss din soor phoonka jaye ga , uss din badshahi ussi ki hogi .   woh ghaeeb o hazir her cheez ko janney wala hai , aur wohi bari hikmat wala , poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( uss waqt ka ziker suno ) jab Ibrahim ney apney baap aazar say kaha tha kay :  kiya aap button ko khuda banaye bethay hain-? mein dekh raha hun kay aap aur aap ki qoam khuli gumrahi mein mubtala hain .
ayahs.translation: aur ( uss waqt ka ziker suno ) jab Ibrahim ney apney baap aazar say kaha tha kay :  kiya aap button ko khuda banaye bethay hain-? mein dekh raha hun kay aap aur aap ki qoam khuli gumrahi mein mubtala hain .

ayahs.text: aur issi tarah hum Ibrahim ko aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat ka nazara keratay thay , aur maqsad yeh tha kay woh mukammal yaqeen rakhney walon mein shamil hon .
ayahs.translation: aur issi tarah hum Ibrahim ko aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat ka nazara keratay thay , aur maqsad yeh tha kay woh mukammal yaqeen rakhney walon mein shamil hon .

ayahs.text: chunacheh jab unn per raat chai to unhon ney aik sitara dekha . kehney lagay :  yeh mera rab hai .    phir jab woh doob gaya to unhon ney kaha :  mein doobney walon ko pasand nahi kerta .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh jab unn per raat chai to unhon ney aik sitara dekha . kehney lagay :  yeh mera rab hai .    phir jab woh doob gaya to unhon ney kaha :  mein doobney walon ko pasand nahi kerta .

ayahs.text: phir jab unhon ney chaand ko chamaktay dekha to kaha kay :  yeh mera rab hai .  lekin jab woh bhi doob gaya to kehney lagay :  agar mera rab mujhay hidayat naa dey to mein yaqeenan gumrah logon  mein shamil hojaon .
ayahs.translation: phir jab unhon ney chaand ko chamaktay dekha to kaha kay :  yeh mera rab hai .  lekin jab woh bhi doob gaya to kehney lagay :  agar mera rab mujhay hidayat naa dey to mein yaqeenan gumrah logon  mein shamil hojaon .

ayahs.text: phir jab unhon ney sooraj ko chamaktay dekha to kaha :  yeh mera rab hai . yeh ziyada bara hai .  phir jab woh ghuroob huwa to unhon ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! jinn jinn cheezon ko tum Allah ki khudai mein shareek qarar detay ho , mein unn sabb say beyzar hun .
ayahs.translation: phir jab unhon ney sooraj ko chamaktay dekha to kaha :  yeh mera rab hai . yeh ziyada bara hai .  phir jab woh ghuroob huwa to unhon ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! jinn jinn cheezon ko tum Allah ki khudai mein shareek qarar detay ho , mein unn sabb say beyzar hun .

ayahs.text: mein ney to poori tarah yaksoo ho ker apna rukh uss zaat ki taraf kerliya hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya hai , aur mein shirk kernay walon mein say nahi hun .
ayahs.translation: mein ney to poori tarah yaksoo ho ker apna rukh uss zaat ki taraf kerliya hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya hai , aur mein shirk kernay walon mein say nahi hun .

ayahs.text: aur ( phir yeh huwa kay ) unn ki qoam ney unn say hujjat shuroo kerdi .   Ibrahim ney ( unn say ) kaha :  kiya tum mujh say Allah kay baaray mein hujjat kertay ho jabkay uss ney mujhay hidayat dey di hai ? aur jinn cheezon ko tum Allah kay sath shareek mantay ho , mein unn say nahi darta ( kay woh mujhay koi nuqsan phoncha den gi ) illa yeh kay mera perwerdigar ( mujhay ) kuch ( nuqsan phonchana ) chahye ( to woh her haal mein phonchay ga ) meray perwerdigar ka ilm her cheez ka ehata kiye huye hai . kiya tum phir bhi koi naseehat nahi mantay-?
ayahs.translation: aur ( phir yeh huwa kay ) unn ki qoam ney unn say hujjat shuroo kerdi .   Ibrahim ney ( unn say ) kaha :  kiya tum mujh say Allah kay baaray mein hujjat kertay ho jabkay uss ney mujhay hidayat dey di hai ? aur jinn cheezon ko tum Allah kay sath shareek mantay ho , mein unn say nahi darta ( kay woh mujhay koi nuqsan phoncha den gi ) illa yeh kay mera perwerdigar ( mujhay ) kuch ( nuqsan phonchana ) chahye ( to woh her haal mein phonchay ga ) meray perwerdigar ka ilm her cheez ka ehata kiye huye hai . kiya tum phir bhi koi naseehat nahi mantay-?

ayahs.text: aur jinn cheezon ko tum ney Allah ka shareek bana rakha hai , mein unn say kaisay darr sakta hun jabkay tum unn cheezon ko Allah ka shareek manney say nahi dartay jinn kay baaray mein  uss ney tum per koi daleel nazil nahi ki hai-? abb agar tumharay paas koi ilm hai to batao kay hum do fareeqon mein say kon bey khof rehney ka ziyada mustahiq hai ?
ayahs.translation: aur jinn cheezon ko tum ney Allah ka shareek bana rakha hai , mein unn say kaisay darr sakta hun jabkay tum unn cheezon ko Allah ka shareek manney say nahi dartay jinn kay baaray mein  uss ney tum per koi daleel nazil nahi ki hai-? abb agar tumharay paas koi ilm hai to batao kay hum do fareeqon mein say kon bey khof rehney ka ziyada mustahiq hai ?

ayahs.text: . ( haqeeqat to yeh hai kay ) jo log emaan ley aaye hain aur unhon ney apney emaan kay sath kissi zulm ka shayeba bhi aaney nahi diya ,   aman aur chain to bus unhi ka haq hai , aur wohi hain jo sahih raastay per phonch chukay hain .
ayahs.translation: . ( haqeeqat to yeh hai kay ) jo log emaan ley aaye hain aur unhon ney apney emaan kay sath kissi zulm ka shayeba bhi aaney nahi diya ,   aman aur chain to bus unhi ka haq hai , aur wohi hain jo sahih raastay per phonch chukay hain .

ayahs.text: yeh humari woh kamiyab daleel thi jo hum ney Ibrahim ko unn ki qoam kay muqablay mein ata ki thi . hum jiss kay chahtay hain darjay buland ker-detay hain . beyshak tumharay rab ki hikmat bhi bari hai , ilm bhi kamil hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh humari woh kamiyab daleel thi jo hum ney Ibrahim ko unn ki qoam kay muqablay mein ata ki thi . hum jiss kay chahtay hain darjay buland ker-detay hain . beyshak tumharay rab ki hikmat bhi bari hai , ilm bhi kamil hai .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney Ibrahim ko Ishaq ( jaisa beta ) aur Yaqoob ( jaisa pota ) ata kiya . ( inn mein say ) her aik ko hum ney hidayat di , aur nooh ko hum ney pehlay hi hidayat di thi , aur unn ki aulad mein say dawood , suleman , Ayub , yousuf , musa aur Haroon ko bhi . aur issi tarah hum naik kaam kernay walon ko badla detay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney Ibrahim ko Ishaq ( jaisa beta ) aur Yaqoob ( jaisa pota ) ata kiya . ( inn mein say ) her aik ko hum ney hidayat di , aur nooh ko hum ney pehlay hi hidayat di thi , aur unn ki aulad mein say dawood , suleman , Ayub , yousuf , musa aur Haroon ko bhi . aur issi tarah hum naik kaam kernay walon ko badla detay hain .

ayahs.text: aur zakariya , Yahya , essa aur Ilyas ko ( bhi hidayat ata farmaee ) . yeh sabb naik logon  mein say thay .
ayahs.translation: aur zakariya , Yahya , essa aur Ilyas ko ( bhi hidayat ata farmaee ) . yeh sabb naik logon  mein say thay .

ayahs.text: neez Ismail , Al-Yasaa , Younus aur loot ko bhi . aur inn sabb ko hum ney duniya jahan kay logon  per fazilat bakhshi thi .
ayahs.translation: neez Ismail , Al-Yasaa , Younus aur loot ko bhi . aur inn sabb ko hum ney duniya jahan kay logon  per fazilat bakhshi thi .

ayahs.text: aur inn kay baap dadon , inn ki auladon aur inn kay bhaiyon mein say bhi boht say logon  ko . hum ney inn sabb ko muntakhib ker kay raah-e-raast tak phoncha diya tha .
ayahs.translation: aur inn kay baap dadon , inn ki auladon aur inn kay bhaiyon mein say bhi boht say logon  ko . hum ney inn sabb ko muntakhib ker kay raah-e-raast tak phoncha diya tha .

ayahs.text: yeh Allah ki di hoi hidayat hai jiss kay zariye woh apney bandon mein say jiss ko chahta hai raah-e-raast tak phoncha deta hai . aur agar woh shirk kernay lagtay to unn kay saray ( naik ) aemal ikarat hojatay .
ayahs.translation: yeh Allah ki di hoi hidayat hai jiss kay zariye woh apney bandon mein say jiss ko chahta hai raah-e-raast tak phoncha deta hai . aur agar woh shirk kernay lagtay to unn kay saray ( naik ) aemal ikarat hojatay .

ayahs.text: woh log thay jinn ko hum ney kitab , hikmat aur nabwooat ata ki thi .   abb agar yeh ( arab kay ) log iss ( nabwooat ) ka inkar keren to ( kuch perwa naa kero , kiyonkay ) iss kay manney kay liye hum ney aesay log muqarrar kerdiye hain jo iss kay munkir nahi .
ayahs.translation: woh log thay jinn ko hum ney kitab , hikmat aur nabwooat ata ki thi .   abb agar yeh ( arab kay ) log iss ( nabwooat ) ka inkar keren to ( kuch perwa naa kero , kiyonkay ) iss kay manney kay liye hum ney aesay log muqarrar kerdiye hain jo iss kay munkir nahi .

ayahs.text: yeh log ( jinn ka ziker oopper huwa ) woh thay jinn ko Allah ney ( makhalfeen kay ravaiyyey per sabar kernay ki ) hidayat ki thi , lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum bhi unhi kay raastay per chalo . ( makhalfeen say ) keh do kay mein tum say iss ( dawat ) per koi ujrat nahi maangta . yeh to duniya jahan kay sabb logon  kay liye aik naseehat hai , aur bus .
ayahs.translation: yeh log ( jinn ka ziker oopper huwa ) woh thay jinn ko Allah ney ( makhalfeen kay ravaiyyey per sabar kernay ki ) hidayat ki thi , lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum bhi unhi kay raastay per chalo . ( makhalfeen say ) keh do kay mein tum say iss ( dawat ) per koi ujrat nahi maangta . yeh to duniya jahan kay sabb logon  kay liye aik naseehat hai , aur bus .

ayahs.text: aur inn ( kafir ) logon  ney jab yeh kaha kay Allah ney kissi insan per kuch nazil nahi kiya to unhon ney Allah ki sahih qadar nahi pehchani .   ( unn say ) kaho kay :  woh kitab kiss ney nazil ki thi jo musa ley ker aaye thay , jo logon  kay liye roshni aur hidayat thi , aur jiss ko tum ney mutafarriq kaghazon ki shakal mein rakha huwa hai .   jinn ( mein say kuch ) ko tum zahir kertay ho , aur boht say hissay chupa letay ho , aur ( jiss kay zariye ) tum ko unn baaton ki taleem di gaee thi jo naa tum jantay thay , naa tumharay baap dada-?  ( aey payghumber ! tum khud hi iss sawal kay jawab mein ) itna keh do kay :  woh kitab Allah ney nazil ki thi .  phir inn ko inn kay haal per chorr do kay yeh apni beyhooda guftoogo mein mashghool reh ker dil lagi kertay rahen .
ayahs.translation: aur inn ( kafir ) logon  ney jab yeh kaha kay Allah ney kissi insan per kuch nazil nahi kiya to unhon ney Allah ki sahih qadar nahi pehchani .   ( unn say ) kaho kay :  woh kitab kiss ney nazil ki thi jo musa ley ker aaye thay , jo logon  kay liye roshni aur hidayat thi , aur jiss ko tum ney mutafarriq kaghazon ki shakal mein rakha huwa hai .   jinn ( mein say kuch ) ko tum zahir kertay ho , aur boht say hissay chupa letay ho , aur ( jiss kay zariye ) tum ko unn baaton ki taleem di gaee thi jo naa tum jantay thay , naa tumharay baap dada-?  ( aey payghumber ! tum khud hi iss sawal kay jawab mein ) itna keh do kay :  woh kitab Allah ney nazil ki thi .  phir inn ko inn kay haal per chorr do kay yeh apni beyhooda guftoogo mein mashghool reh ker dil lagi kertay rahen .

ayahs.text: aur ( issi tarah ) yeh bari barkat wali kitab hai jo hum ney utaari hai , pichli aasmani hidayaat ki tasdeeq kernay wali hai , takay tum iss kay zariye bastiyon kay markaz ( yani makkah ) aur uss kay ird-gird kay logon  ko khabrdar kero . aur jo log aakhirat per emaan rakhtay hain woh iss per bhi emaan rakhtay hain , aur woh apni namaz ki poori poori nigehdasht kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur ( issi tarah ) yeh bari barkat wali kitab hai jo hum ney utaari hai , pichli aasmani hidayaat ki tasdeeq kernay wali hai , takay tum iss kay zariye bastiyon kay markaz ( yani makkah ) aur uss kay ird-gird kay logon  ko khabrdar kero . aur jo log aakhirat per emaan rakhtay hain woh iss per bhi emaan rakhtay hain , aur woh apni namaz ki poori poori nigehdasht kertay hain .

ayahs.text: aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay , ya yeh kahey kay mujh per wahi nazil ki gaee hai , halankay uss per koi wahi nazil naa ki gaee ho , aur issi tarah woh jo yeh kahey kay mein bhi wesa hi kalam nazil kerdun ga jaisa Allah ney nazil kiya hai ? aur agar tum woh waqt dekho ( to bara holnaak manzar nazar aaye ) jab zalim log moat ki sakhtiyon mein girftaar hon gay , aur farishtay apney haath phelaye huye ( keh rahey hon gay kay )  apni janen nikalo , aaj tumhen zillat ka azab diya jaye ga , iss liye kay tum jhooti baaten Allah kay zimmay lagatay thay , aur iss liye kay tum uss ki nishaniyon kay khilaf takabbur ka ravaiyya ikhtiyar kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay , ya yeh kahey kay mujh per wahi nazil ki gaee hai , halankay uss per koi wahi nazil naa ki gaee ho , aur issi tarah woh jo yeh kahey kay mein bhi wesa hi kalam nazil kerdun ga jaisa Allah ney nazil kiya hai ? aur agar tum woh waqt dekho ( to bara holnaak manzar nazar aaye ) jab zalim log moat ki sakhtiyon mein girftaar hon gay , aur farishtay apney haath phelaye huye ( keh rahey hon gay kay )  apni janen nikalo , aaj tumhen zillat ka azab diya jaye ga , iss liye kay tum jhooti baaten Allah kay zimmay lagatay thay , aur iss liye kay tum uss ki nishaniyon kay khilaf takabbur ka ravaiyya ikhtiyar kertay thay .

ayahs.text: . ( phir qayamat kay din Allah taalaa unn say kahey ga kay : )  tum humaray paas issi tarah tan-tanha aagaye ho jaisay hum ney tumhen pehli baar peda kiya tha , aur jo kuch hum ney tumhen bakhsha tha woh sabb apney peechay chorr aaye ho , aur hamen to tumharay woh sirfarishi kahen nazar nahi aarahey jinn kay baaray mein tumhara dawa tha kay woh tumharay moamlaat tey kernay mein ( humaray sath ) shareek hain . haqeeqat yeh hai kay unn kay sath tumharay saray talluqaat toot chukay hain , aur jinn ( deotaon ) kay baaray mein tumhen bara zoam tha woh sabb tum say gumm ho ker reh gaye hain .
ayahs.translation: .
