ayahs.text: beyshak Allah hi daney aur guthli ko phaarney wala hai . woh jandaar cheezon ko bey jaan cheezon say nikal lata hai , aur wohi bey jaan cheezon ko jandaar cheezon say nikalney wala hai .   logo ! woh hai Allah ! phir koi tumhen behka ker kiss ondhi taraf liye jaraha hai ?
ayahs.translation: beyshak Allah hi daney aur guthli ko phaarney wala hai . woh jandaar cheezon ko bey jaan cheezon say nikal lata hai , aur wohi bey jaan cheezon ko jandaar cheezon say nikalney wala hai .   logo ! woh hai Allah ! phir koi tumhen behka ker kiss ondhi taraf liye jaraha hai ?

ayahs.text: wohi hai jiss kay hukum say subha ko po phoot-ti hai , aur ussi ney raat ko sukoon ka waqt banaya hai , aur sooraj aur chaand ko aik hisab ka paband ! yeh sabb kuch uss zaat ki mansooba bandi hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , ilm bhi kamil
ayahs.translation: wohi hai jiss kay hukum say subha ko po phoot-ti hai , aur ussi ney raat ko sukoon ka waqt banaya hai , aur sooraj aur chaand ko aik hisab ka paband ! yeh sabb kuch uss zaat ki mansooba bandi hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , ilm bhi kamil

ayahs.text: aur ussi ney tumharay liye sitaray banaye hain , takay tum unn kay zariye khushki aur samandar ki tareekiyon mein raastay maloom ker-sako-? . hum ney sari nishaniyan aik aik ker kay khol di hain , ( magar ) unn logon  kay liye jo ilm say kaam len
ayahs.translation: aur ussi ney tumharay liye sitaray banaye hain , takay tum unn kay zariye khushki aur samandar ki tareekiyon mein raastay maloom ker-sako-? . hum ney sari nishaniyan aik aik ker kay khol di hain , ( magar ) unn logon  kay liye jo ilm say kaam len

ayahs.text: wohi hai jiss ney tum sabb ko aik jaan say peda kiya , phir her shaks ka aik mustaqar hai , aur aik amanat rakhney ki jagah .   hum ney sari nishaniyan aik aik kerkay khol di hain , ( magar ) unn logon  kay liye jo samajh say kaam len .
ayahs.translation: wohi hai jiss ney tum sabb ko aik jaan say peda kiya , phir her shaks ka aik mustaqar hai , aur aik amanat rakhney ki jagah .   hum ney sari nishaniyan aik aik kerkay khol di hain , ( magar ) unn logon  kay liye jo samajh say kaam len .

ayahs.text: aur Allah wohi hai jiss ney tumharay liye aasman say paani barsaya . phir hum ney uss kay zariye her qisam ki konpalen ugayen . inn ( konpalon ) say hum ney sabziyan peda ken jinn say hum teh bar teh daney nikaltay hain , aur khujoor kay gabhon say phalon kay woh guchay nikaltay hain jo ( phal kay bojh say ) jhukay jatay hain , aur hum ney angooron kay baagh ugaye , aur zaitoon aur anaar ! jo aik doosray say miltay jultay bhi hain , aur aik doosray say mukhtalif bhi .   jab yeh darkht phal detay hain to inn kay phalon aur unn kay pakney ki kayfiyat ko ghor say dekho . logo ! inn sabb cheezon mein bari nishaniyan hain , ( magar ) unn logon  kay liye jo emaan layen .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah wohi hai jiss ney tumharay liye aasman say paani barsaya . phir hum ney uss kay zariye her qisam ki konpalen ugayen . inn ( konpalon ) say hum ney sabziyan peda ken jinn say hum teh bar teh daney nikaltay hain , aur khujoor kay gabhon say phalon kay woh guchay nikaltay hain jo ( phal kay bojh say ) jhukay jatay hain , aur hum ney angooron kay baagh ugaye , aur zaitoon aur anaar ! jo aik doosray say miltay jultay bhi hain , aur aik doosray say mukhtalif bhi .   jab yeh darkht phal detay hain to inn kay phalon aur unn kay pakney ki kayfiyat ko ghor say dekho . logo ! inn sabb cheezon mein bari nishaniyan hain , ( magar ) unn logon  kay liye jo emaan layen .

ayahs.text: aur logon  ney jinnaat ko Allah kay sath khudai mein shareek qarar dey liya ,   halankay Allah ney hi unn ko peda kiya hai aur samajh boojh kay baghair uss kay liye betay aur betiyan tarash len ,   halankay Allah kay baaray mein jo baaten yeh banatay hain , woh unn sabb say pak aur baala-o-bartar hai .
ayahs.translation: aur logon  ney jinnaat ko Allah kay sath khudai mein shareek qarar dey liya ,   halankay Allah ney hi unn ko peda kiya hai aur samajh boojh kay baghair uss kay liye betay aur betiyan tarash len ,   halankay Allah kay baaray mein jo baaten yeh banatay hain , woh unn sabb say pak aur baala-o-bartar hai .

ayahs.text: woh to aasmano aur zameen ka mojid hai . uss ka koi beta kahan hosakta hai , jabkay uss ki koi biwi nahi-? Ussi ney her cheez peda ki hai , aur woh her her cheez ka poora poora ilm rakhta hai .
ayahs.translation: woh to aasmano aur zameen ka mojid hai . uss ka koi beta kahan hosakta hai , jabkay uss ki koi biwi nahi-? Ussi ney her cheez peda ki hai , aur woh her her cheez ka poora poora ilm rakhta hai .

ayahs.text: logo ! woh hai Allah jo tumhara paalney wala hai ! uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi , woh her cheez ka khaliq hai . lehaza uss ki ibadat kero . woh her cheez ki nigrani kernay wala hai .
ayahs.translation: logo ! woh hai Allah jo tumhara paalney wala hai ! uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi , woh her cheez ka khaliq hai . lehaza uss ki ibadat kero . woh her cheez ki nigrani kernay wala hai .

ayahs.text: nigahen uss ko nahi paaskten , aur woh tamam nigahon ko paaleta hai . uss ki zaat itni hi lateef hai , aur woh itna hi ba-khabar hai .
ayahs.translation: nigahen uss ko nahi paaskten , aur woh tamam nigahon ko paaleta hai . uss ki zaat itni hi lateef hai , aur woh itna hi ba-khabar hai .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn logon  say kaho kay : )  tumharay paas tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say baseerat kay saman phonch chukay hain . abb jo shaks aankhen khol ker dekhay ga , woh apna hi bhala keray ga , aur jo shaks andha ban jaye ga , woh apna hi nuqsan keray ga . aur mujhay tumhari hifazat ki zimma daari nahi sonpi gaee hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn logon  say kaho kay : )  tumharay paas tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say baseerat kay saman phonch chukay hain . abb jo shaks aankhen khol ker dekhay ga , woh apna hi bhala keray ga , aur jo shaks andha ban jaye ga , woh apna hi nuqsan keray ga . aur mujhay tumhari hifazat ki zimma daari nahi sonpi gaee hai .

ayahs.text: issi tarah hum aayaten mukhtalif tareeqon say baar baar wazeh kertay hain , ( takay tum enhen logon  tak phoncha do ) aur bil-aakhir yeh log to yun kahen kay :  tum ney kissi say seekha hai .    aur jo log ilm say kaam letay hain unn kay liye hum haq ko aashkaar kerden .
ayahs.translation: issi tarah hum aayaten mukhtalif tareeqon say baar baar wazeh kertay hain , ( takay tum enhen logon  tak phoncha do ) aur bil-aakhir yeh log to yun kahen kay :  tum ney kissi say seekha hai .    aur jo log ilm say kaam letay hain unn kay liye hum haq ko aashkaar kerden .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) tum per tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say jo wahi bheji gaee hai , tum ussi ki perwi kero , uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai , aur jo log Allah kay sath shirk kertay hain , unn say bey perwa hojao .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) tum per tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say jo wahi bheji gaee hai , tum ussi ki perwi kero , uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai , aur jo log Allah kay sath shirk kertay hain , unn say bey perwa hojao .

ayahs.text: agar Allah chahta to yeh log shirk naa kertay .   hum ney naa tumhen inn ki hifazat per muqarrar kiya hai , aur naa tum inn kay kamon kay zimma daar ho .
ayahs.translation: agar Allah chahta to yeh log shirk naa kertay .   hum ney naa tumhen inn ki hifazat per muqarrar kiya hai , aur naa tum inn kay kamon kay zimma daar ho .

ayahs.text: . ( musalmano ! ) jinn ( jhootay maboodon ) ko yeh log Allah kay bajaye pukartay hain tum unn ko bura naa kaho , jiss kay nateejay mein yeh log jihalat kay aalam mein hadd say aagay barh ker Allah ko bura kehney lagen .   ( iss duniya mein to ) hum ney issi tarah her giroh kay amal ko uss ki nazar mein khushnuma bana rakha hai .   phir inn sabb ko apney perwerdigar hi kay paas loattna hai . uss waqt woh unhen bataye ga kay woh kiya kuch kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: . ( musalmano ! ) jinn ( jhootay maboodon ) ko yeh log Allah kay bajaye pukartay hain tum unn ko bura naa kaho , jiss kay nateejay mein yeh log jihalat kay aalam mein hadd say aagay barh ker Allah ko bura kehney lagen .   ( iss duniya mein to ) hum ney issi tarah her giroh kay amal ko uss ki nazar mein khushnuma bana rakha hai .   phir inn sabb ko apney perwerdigar hi kay paas loattna hai . uss waqt woh unhen bataye ga kay woh kiya kuch kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: aur inn logon  ney bari zor daar qasmen khai hain kay agar inn kay paas waqaee koi nishani ( yani inn ka matloob moajza ) aagae to yeh yaqeenan zaroor iss/uss per emaan ley ayen gay . ( inn say ) kaho kay :  sari nishaniyan Allah kay qabazay mein hain .    aur ( musalmano ! ) tumhen kiya pata kay agar woh ( moajzay ) aa-bhi gaye tab bhi yeh emaan nahi layen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur inn logon  ney bari zor daar qasmen khai hain kay agar inn kay paas waqaee koi nishani ( yani inn ka matloob moajza ) aagae to yeh yaqeenan zaroor iss/uss per emaan ley ayen gay . ( inn say ) kaho kay :  sari nishaniyan Allah kay qabazay mein hain .    aur ( musalmano ! ) tumhen kiya pata kay agar woh ( moajzay ) aa-bhi gaye tab bhi yeh emaan nahi layen gay .

ayahs.text: jiss tarah yeh log pehli baar ( Quran jaisay moajzay per ) emaan nahi laye , hum bhi ( inn ki zidd ki padash mein ) inn kay dilon aur nigahon ka rukh pher detay hain , aur inn ko iss halat mein chorr detay hain kay yeh apni sarkashi mein bhataktay phiren .
ayahs.translation: jiss tarah yeh log pehli baar ( Quran jaisay moajzay per ) emaan nahi laye , hum bhi ( inn ki zidd ki padash mein ) inn kay dilon aur nigahon ka rukh pher detay hain , aur inn ko iss halat mein chorr detay hain kay yeh apni sarkashi mein bhataktay phiren .

ayahs.text: aur agar bil-farz hum inn kay paas farishtay bhej detay , aur murday inn say baaten kernay lagtay , aur ( inn ki maangi hoi ) her cheez hum khuli aankhon inn kay samney laaker kay rakh detay ,   tab bhi yeh emaan laney walay nahi thay , illa yeh kay Allah hi chahta ( kay enhen zabardasti emaan per majboor kerday to baat doosri thi , magar aisa emaan naa matloob hai naa moatabir . ) lekin inn mein say aksar log jihalat ki baaten kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur agar bil-farz hum inn kay paas farishtay bhej detay , aur murday inn say baaten kernay lagtay , aur ( inn ki maangi hoi ) her cheez hum khuli aankhon inn kay samney laaker kay rakh detay ,   tab bhi yeh emaan laney walay nahi thay , illa yeh kay Allah hi chahta ( kay enhen zabardasti emaan per majboor kerday to baat doosri thi , magar aisa emaan naa matloob hai naa moatabir . ) lekin inn mein say aksar log jihalat ki baaten kertay hain .

ayahs.text: aur ( jiss tarah yeh log humaray nabi say dushmani ker rahey hain ) issi tarah hum ney her ( pichlay ) nabi kay liye koi naa koi dushman peda kiya tha , yani insanon aur jinnaat mein say shetan qisam kay log , jo dhoka denay ki khatir aik doosray ko bari chikni chupri baaten sikhatay rehtay thay . aur agar Allah chahta to woh aisa naa ker-saktay .   lehaza inn ko apni iftra perdaziyon mein parra rehney do .
ayahs.translation: aur ( jiss tarah yeh log humaray nabi say dushmani ker rahey hain ) issi tarah hum ney her ( pichlay ) nabi kay liye koi naa koi dushman peda kiya tha , yani insanon aur jinnaat mein say shetan qisam kay log , jo dhoka denay ki khatir aik doosray ko bari chikni chupri baaten sikhatay rehtay thay . aur agar Allah chahta to woh aisa naa ker-saktay .   lehaza inn ko apni iftra perdaziyon mein parra rehney do .

ayahs.text: aur ( woh anbiya kay dushman chikni chupri baaten iss liye banatay thay ) takay jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , unn kay dil inn baaton ki taraf khoob maeel hojayen , aur woh inn mein magan rahen , aur sari woh harkaten keren jo woh kernay walay thay .
ayahs.translation: aur ( woh anbiya kay dushman chikni chupri baaten iss liye banatay thay ) takay jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , unn kay dil inn baaton ki taraf khoob maeel hojayen , aur woh inn mein magan rahen , aur sari woh harkaten keren jo woh kernay walay thay .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn logon  say kaho kay : )  kiya mein Allah ko chorr ker kissi aur ko faisal banaon , halankay ussi ney tumhari taraf yeh kitab nazil kerkay bheji hai jiss mein saray ( mutnazeh ) moamlaat ki tafseel mojood hai-?  aur jinn logon  ko hum ney pehlay kitab di thi woh yaqeen say jantay hain kay yeh tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say haq ley ker nazil hoi hai . lehaza tum shak kernay walon mein hergiz shamil naa hona .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn logon  say kaho kay : )  kiya mein Allah ko chorr ker kissi aur ko faisal banaon , halankay ussi ney tumhari taraf yeh kitab nazil kerkay bheji hai jiss mein saray ( mutnazeh ) moamlaat ki tafseel mojood hai-?  aur jinn logon  ko hum ney pehlay kitab di thi woh yaqeen say jantay hain kay yeh tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say haq ley ker nazil hoi hai . lehaza tum shak kernay walon mein hergiz shamil naa hona .

ayahs.text: aur tumharay rab ka kalam sachai aur insaf mein kamil hai . uss ki baaton ko koi badalney wala nahi . woh her baat sunney wala , her baat janney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur tumharay rab ka kalam sachai aur insaf mein kamil hai . uss ki baaton ko koi badalney wala nahi . woh her baat sunney wala , her baat janney wala hai .

ayahs.text: aur agar tum zameen mein basney walon ki aksariyat kay peechay chalo gay to woh tumhen Allah kay raastay say gumrah ker daalen gay . woh to weham o gumaan kay siwa kissi cheez kay peechay nahi chaltay , aur unn ka kaam iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay khayali andazay lagatay rahen .
ayahs.translation: aur agar tum zameen mein basney walon ki aksariyat kay peechay chalo gay to woh tumhen Allah kay raastay say gumrah ker daalen gay . woh to weham o gumaan kay siwa kissi cheez kay peechay nahi chaltay , aur unn ka kaam iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay khayali andazay lagatay rahen .

ayahs.text: yaqeen rakho kay tumhara rab khoob janta hai kay kon apney raastay say bhatak raha hai , aur wohi unn logon  ko khoob janta hai jo sahih raastay per hain .
ayahs.translation: yaqeen rakho kay tumhara rab khoob janta hai kay kon apney raastay say bhatak raha hai , aur wohi unn logon  ko khoob janta hai jo sahih raastay per hain .

ayahs.text: chunacheh her uss ( halal ) janwer mein say khao jiss per Allah ka naam liya gaya ho , agar tum waqaee uss ki aayaton per emaan rakhtay ho .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh her uss ( halal ) janwer mein say khao jiss per Allah ka naam liya gaya ho , agar tum waqaee uss ki aayaton per emaan rakhtay ho .

ayahs.text: aur tumharay liye kon si rukawat hai jiss ki bana per tum uss janwer mein say naa khao jiss per Allah ka naam ley liya gaya ho-? halankay uss ney woh cheezen tumhen tafseel say bata di hain jo uss ney tumharay liye ( aam halaat mein ) haram qarar di hain , albatta jinn ko khaney per tum bilkul majboor hi hojao , ( to unn haram cheezon ki bhi baqdar-e-zaroorat ijazat hojati hai ) aur boht say log kissi ilm ki buniyad per nahi , ( balkay sirf ) apni khuwaishaat ki buniyad per doosron ko gumrah kertay hain . bila shubha tumhara rab hadd say guzarney walon ko khoob janta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur tumharay liye kon si rukawat hai jiss ki bana per tum uss janwer mein say naa khao jiss per Allah ka naam ley liya gaya ho-? halankay uss ney woh cheezen tumhen tafseel say bata di hain jo uss ney tumharay liye ( aam halaat mein ) haram qarar di hain , albatta jinn ko khaney per tum bilkul majboor hi hojao , ( to unn haram cheezon ki bhi baqdar-e-zaroorat ijazat hojati hai ) aur boht say log kissi ilm ki buniyad per nahi , ( balkay sirf ) apni khuwaishaat ki buniyad per doosron ko gumrah kertay hain . bila shubha tumhara rab hadd say guzarney walon ko khoob janta hai .

ayahs.text: aur tum zahiri aur batni dono qisam kay gunah chorr do .   yeh yaqeeni baat hai kay jo log gunah kamatay hain , unhen unn tamam jaraeem ki jald hi saza milay gi jinn ka woh irtikab kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: aur tum zahiri aur batni dono qisam kay gunah chorr do .   yeh yaqeeni baat hai kay jo log gunah kamatay hain , unhen unn tamam jaraeem ki jald hi saza milay gi jinn ka woh irtikab kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: aur jiss janwer per Allah ka naam naa liya gaya ho , uss mein say matt khao , aur aisa kerna sakht gunah hai . ( musalmano ! ) shayateen apney doston ko warghalatay rehtay hain takay woh tum say behas keren . aur agar tum ney unn ki baat maan li to tum yaqeenan mushrik hojao gay .
ayahs.translation: aur jiss janwer per Allah ka naam naa liya gaya ho , uss mein say matt khao , aur aisa kerna sakht gunah hai . ( musalmano ! ) shayateen apney doston ko warghalatay rehtay hain takay woh tum say behas keren . aur agar tum ney unn ki baat maan li to tum yaqeenan mushrik hojao gay .

ayahs.text: zara batao kay jo shaks murda ho , phir hum ney ussay zindagi di ho , aur uss ko aik roshni mohaiyya kerdi ho jiss kay saharay woh logon  kay darmiyan chalta phirta ho ,   kiya woh uss shaks ki tarah hosakta hai jiss ka haal yeh ho kay woh andheron mein ghira huwa ho jinn say kabhi nikal naa paye ? issi tarah kafiron ko yeh sujha diya gaya hai kay jo kuch woh kertay rahey hain , woh bara khushnuma kaam hai .
ayahs.translation: zara batao kay jo shaks murda ho , phir hum ney ussay zindagi di ho , aur uss ko aik roshni mohaiyya kerdi ho jiss kay saharay woh logon  kay darmiyan chalta phirta ho ,   kiya woh uss shaks ki tarah hosakta hai jiss ka haal yeh ho kay woh andheron mein ghira huwa ho jinn say kabhi nikal naa paye ? issi tarah kafiron ko yeh sujha diya gaya hai kay jo kuch woh kertay rahey hain , woh bara khushnuma kaam hai .

ayahs.text: aur issi tarah hum ney her basti mein wahan kay mujrimon kay sarghanon ko yeh moaqa diya hai kay woh uss ( basti ) mein ( musalmanon kay khilaf ) sazishen kiya keren .   aur woh jo sazishen kertay hain , ( dar-haqeeqat ) woh kissi aur kay nahi , balkay khud unn kay apney khilaf parrti hain , jabkay unn ko iss ka ehsas nahi hota .
ayahs.translation: aur issi tarah hum ney her basti mein wahan kay mujrimon kay sarghanon ko yeh moaqa diya hai kay woh uss ( basti ) mein ( musalmanon kay khilaf ) sazishen kiya keren .   aur woh jo sazishen kertay hain , ( dar-haqeeqat ) woh kissi aur kay nahi , balkay khud unn kay apney khilaf parrti hain , jabkay unn ko iss ka ehsas nahi hota .

ayahs.text: aur jab inn ( ehal-e-makkah ) kay paas ( Quran ki ) koi aayat aati hai to yeh kehtay hain kay :  hum uss waqt tak hergiz emaan nahi layen gay jab tak kay uss jaisi cheez khud hamen naa dey di jaye jaisi Allah kay payghumberon ko di gaee thi .    ( halankay ) Allah hi behtar janta hai kay woh apni payghumberi kiss ko supurd keray . jinn logon  ney ( iss qisam ki ) mujrimana baaten ki hain unn ko apni makkariyon kay badlay mein Allah kay paas jaker zillat aur sakht azab ka samna hoga .
ayahs.translation: aur jab inn ( ehal-e-makkah ) kay paas ( Quran ki ) koi aayat aati hai to yeh kehtay hain kay :  hum uss waqt tak hergiz emaan nahi layen gay jab tak kay uss jaisi cheez khud hamen naa dey di jaye jaisi Allah kay payghumberon ko di gaee thi .    ( halankay ) Allah hi behtar janta hai kay woh apni payghumberi kiss ko supurd keray . jinn logon  ney ( iss qisam ki ) mujrimana baaten ki hain unn ko apni makkariyon kay badlay mein Allah kay paas jaker zillat aur sakht azab ka samna hoga .

ayahs.text: gharz jiss shaks ko Allah hidayat tak phonchaney ka irada kerlay , uss ka seena Islam kay liye khol deta hai , aur jiss ko ( uss ki zidd ki wajeh say ) gumrah kernay ka irada kerlay , uss kay seenay ko tang aur itna ziyada tang ker deta hai kay ( ussay emaan lana aisa mushkil maloom hota hai ) jaisay ussay zabardasti aasman per charrhna parr raha ho . issi tarah Allah ( kufr ki ) gandagi unn logon  per musallat ker deta hai jo emaan nahi latay .
ayahs.translation: gharz jiss shaks ko Allah hidayat tak phonchaney ka irada kerlay , uss ka seena Islam kay liye khol deta hai , aur jiss ko ( uss ki zidd ki wajeh say ) gumrah kernay ka irada kerlay , uss kay seenay ko tang aur itna ziyada tang ker deta hai kay ( ussay emaan lana aisa mushkil maloom hota hai ) jaisay ussay zabardasti aasman per charrhna parr raha ho . issi tarah Allah ( kufr ki ) gandagi unn logon  per musallat ker deta hai jo emaan nahi latay .

ayahs.text: aur yeh ( Islam ) tumharay perwerdigar ka ( bataya huwa ) seedha seedha raasta hai . jo log naseehat qubool kertay hain , unn kay liye hum ney ( iss raastay ki ) nishaniyan khol khol ker biyan kerdi hain .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh ( Islam ) tumharay perwerdigar ka ( bataya huwa ) seedha seedha raasta hai . jo log naseehat qubool kertay hain , unn kay liye hum ney ( iss raastay ki ) nishaniyan khol khol ker biyan kerdi hain .

ayahs.text: inn kay perwerdigar kay paas sukh chain ka ghar aesay hi logon  kay liye hai , aur jo amal woh kertay rahey hain , unn ki wajeh say woh khud unn ka rakhwala hai .
ayahs.translation: inn kay perwerdigar kay paas sukh chain ka ghar aesay hi logon  kay liye hai , aur jo amal woh kertay rahey hain , unn ki wajeh say woh khud unn ka rakhwala hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( uss din ka dhiyan rakho ) jiss din Allah inn sabb ko gher ker ikattha keray ga , aur ( shayateen jinnaat say kahey ga kay : )  aey jinnaat kay giroh ! tum ney insanon ko boht barh charh ker gumrah kiya .  aur insanon mein say jo unn kay dost hon gay , woh kahen gay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum aik doosray say khoob mazay letay rahey hain ,   aur abb apni uss miyaad ko phonch gaye hain jo aap ney humaray liye muqarrar ki thi .  Allah kahey ga :  ( abb ) aag tum sabb ka thikana hai , jiss mein tum hamesha raho gay , illa yeh kay Allah kuch aur chahye .   yaqeen rakho kay tumharay perwerdigar ki hikmat bhi kamil hai , ilm bhi kamil .
ayahs.translation: aur ( uss din ka dhiyan rakho ) jiss din Allah inn sabb ko gher ker ikattha keray ga , aur ( shayateen jinnaat say kahey ga kay : )  aey jinnaat kay giroh ! tum ney insanon ko boht barh charh ker gumrah kiya .  aur insanon mein say jo unn kay dost hon gay , woh kahen gay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum aik doosray say khoob mazay letay rahey hain ,   aur abb apni uss miyaad ko phonch gaye hain jo aap ney humaray liye muqarrar ki thi .  Allah kahey ga :  ( abb ) aag tum sabb ka thikana hai , jiss mein tum hamesha raho gay , illa yeh kay Allah kuch aur chahye .   yaqeen rakho kay tumharay perwerdigar ki hikmat bhi kamil hai , ilm bhi kamil .

ayahs.text: aur issi tarah hum zalimon ko unn kay kamaye huye aemal ki wajeh say aik doosray per musallat ker-detay hain .   .
ayahs.translation: aur issi tarah hum zalimon ko unn kay kamaye huye aemal ki wajeh say aik doosray per musallat ker-detay hain .   .

ayahs.text: aey jinnaat aur insanon kay giroh ! kiya tumharay paas khud tum mein say woh payghumber nahi aaye thay jo tumhen meri aayaten parh ker sunatay thay ,   aur tum ko issi din ka samna kernay say khabrdar kertay thay jo aaj tumharay samney hai ?  woh kahen gay :  ( aaj ) hum ney khud apney khilaf gawahi dey di hai ( kay waqaee humaray paas payghumber aaye thay , aur hum ney unhen jhutlaya tha )    aur ( dar-haqeeqat ) unn ko dunyawi zindagi ney dhokay mein daal diya tha , aur ( abb ) unhon ney khud apney khilaf gawahi dey di kay woh kafir thay .
ayahs.translation: aey jinnaat aur insanon kay giroh ! kiya tumharay paas khud tum mein say woh payghumber nahi aaye thay jo tumhen meri aayaten parh ker sunatay thay ,   aur tum ko issi din ka samna kernay say khabrdar kertay thay jo aaj tumharay samney hai ?  woh kahen gay :  ( aaj ) hum ney khud apney khilaf gawahi dey di hai ( kay waqaee humaray paas payghumber aaye thay , aur hum ney unhen jhutlaya tha )    aur ( dar-haqeeqat ) unn ko dunyawi zindagi ney dhokay mein daal diya tha , aur ( abb ) unhon ney khud apney khilaf gawahi dey di kay woh kafir thay .

ayahs.text: yeh ( payghumber bhejney ka ) sara silsila iss liye tha kay tumharay perwerdigar ko yeh gawara nahi tha kay woh bastiyon ko kissi ziyadti ki wajeh say   iss halat mein halak kerday kay uss kay log bey khabar hon .
ayahs.translation: yeh ( payghumber bhejney ka ) sara silsila iss liye tha kay tumharay perwerdigar ko yeh gawara nahi tha kay woh bastiyon ko kissi ziyadti ki wajeh say   iss halat mein halak kerday kay uss kay log bey khabar hon .

ayahs.text: aur her qisam kay logon  ko mukhtalif darjaat unn aemal kay hisab say miltay hain jo unhon ney kiye hotay hain . aur jo aemal bhi woh kertay hain , tumhara perwerdigar unn say ghafil nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur her qisam kay logon  ko mukhtalif darjaat unn aemal kay hisab say miltay hain jo unhon ney kiye hotay hain . aur jo aemal bhi woh kertay hain , tumhara perwerdigar unn say ghafil nahi hai .

ayahs.text: aur tumhara perwerdigar aisa bey niaz hai jo rehmat wala bhi hai .   agar woh chahye to tum sabb ko ( duniya say ) utha ley , aur tumharay baad  jiss ko chahye tumhari jagah ley aaye , jaisay uss ney tum ko kuch aur logon  ki nasal say peda kiya tha .
ayahs.translation: aur tumhara perwerdigar aisa bey niaz hai jo rehmat wala bhi hai .   agar woh chahye to tum sabb ko ( duniya say ) utha ley , aur tumharay baad  jiss ko chahye tumhari jagah ley aaye , jaisay uss ney tum ko kuch aur logon  ki nasal say peda kiya tha .

ayahs.text: yaqeen rakho kay jiss cheez ka tum say wada kiya jaraha hai uss ko aana hi aana hai ,   aur tum ( Allah ko ) aajiz nahi ker-saktay .
ayahs.translation: yaqeen rakho kay jiss cheez ka tum say wada kiya jaraha hai uss ko aana hi aana hai ,   aur tum ( Allah ko ) aajiz nahi ker-saktay .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn logon  say ) kaho kay :  aey meri qoam ! tum apni jagah ( apney tareeqay kay mutabiq ) amal kero , mein ( apney tareeqay kay mutabiq ) amal ker raha hun . phir jald hi tumhen maloom hojaye ga kay iss duniya ka anjam kiss kay haq mein nikalta hai . yeh haqeeqat ( apni jagah ) hai kay zalim log falah nahi paatay .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn logon  say ) kaho kay :  aey meri qoam ! tum apni jagah ( apney tareeqay kay mutabiq ) amal kero , mein ( apney tareeqay kay mutabiq ) amal ker raha hun . phir jald hi tumhen maloom hojaye ga kay iss duniya ka anjam kiss kay haq mein nikalta hai . yeh haqeeqat ( apni jagah ) hai kay zalim log falah nahi paatay .

ayahs.text: aur Allah ney jo khetiyan aur chopaye peda kiye hain , inn logon  ney unn mein say Allah ka bus aik hissa muqarrar kiya hai .   chunacheh ba-zoam khud yun kehtay hain kay yeh hissa to Allah ka hai , aur yeh humaray unn maboodon ka hai jinn ko hum khudai mein Allah ka shareek mantay hain . phir jo hissa inn kay shareekon ka hota hai , woh to ( kabhi ) Allah kay paas nahi phonchta , aur jo hissa Allah ka hota hai , woh inn kay gharray huye maboodon ko phonch jata hai . aesi buri buri baaten hain jo enhon ney tey ker rakhi hain !
ayahs.translation: aur Allah ney jo khetiyan aur chopaye peda kiye hain , inn logon  ney unn mein say Allah ka bus aik hissa muqarrar kiya hai .   chunacheh ba-zoam khud yun kehtay hain kay yeh hissa to Allah ka hai , aur yeh humaray unn maboodon ka hai jinn ko hum khudai mein Allah ka shareek mantay hain . phir jo hissa inn kay shareekon ka hota hai , woh to ( kabhi ) Allah kay paas nahi phonchta , aur jo hissa Allah ka hota hai , woh inn kay gharray huye maboodon ko phonch jata hai . aesi buri buri baaten hain jo enhon ney tey ker rakhi hain !

ayahs.text: aur issi tarah boht say mushrikeen ko unn kay shareekon ney yeh sujha rakha hai kay apni aulad ko qatal kerna bara acha kaam hai , takay woh inn ( mushrikeen ) ko bilkul tabah ker daalen , aur inn kay liye unn kay deen kay moamlay mein moghaltay peda kerden . aur agar Allah chahta to woh aisa naa ker-saktay .   lehaza inn ko apni iftra perdaziyon mein parra rehney do .
ayahs.translation: aur issi tarah boht say mushrikeen ko unn kay shareekon ney yeh sujha rakha hai kay apni aulad ko qatal kerna bara acha kaam hai , takay woh inn ( mushrikeen ) ko bilkul tabah ker daalen , aur inn kay liye unn kay deen kay moamlay mein moghaltay peda kerden . aur agar Allah chahta to woh aisa naa ker-saktay .   lehaza inn ko apni iftra perdaziyon mein parra rehney do .

ayahs.text: aur yun kehtay hain kay :  inn chopayo aur khetiyon per pabandi lagi hoi hai .  inn ka zoam yeh hai kay :  inn ko siwaye unn logon  kay koi nahi kha sakta jinhen hum khilana chahen .    aur kuch chopaye aesay hain jinn ki pusht haram qarar dey di gaee hai ,   aur kuch chopaye woh hain jinn kay baaray mein Allah per yeh bohtan baandhtay hain kay unn per Allah ka naam nahi letay .   jo iftra perdazi yeh log ker rahey hain , Allah unhen unqareeb iss ka poora poora badla dey ga .
ayahs.translation: aur yun kehtay hain kay :  inn chopayo aur khetiyon per pabandi lagi hoi hai .  inn ka zoam yeh hai kay :  inn ko siwaye unn logon  kay koi nahi kha sakta jinhen hum khilana chahen .    aur kuch chopaye aesay hain jinn ki pusht haram qarar dey di gaee hai ,   aur kuch chopaye woh hain jinn kay baaray mein Allah per yeh bohtan baandhtay hain kay unn per Allah ka naam nahi letay .   jo iftra perdazi yeh log ker rahey hain , Allah unhen unqareeb iss ka poora poora badla dey ga .

ayahs.text: neez woh kehtay hain kay :  inn khaas chopayo kay pet mein jo bacchay hain woh sirf humaray mardon kay liye makhsoos hain , aur humari aurton kay liye haram hain .  aur agar woh baccha murda peda ho to uss say faeeda uthaney mein sabb ( mard o aurat ) shareek hojatay hain .   jo baaten yeh log bana rahey hain , Allah unhen unqareeb unn ka poora poora badla dey ga . yaqeenan woh hikmat ka bhi malik hai , ilm ka bhi malik .
ayahs.translation: neez woh kehtay hain kay :  inn khaas chopayo kay pet mein jo bacchay hain woh sirf humaray mardon kay liye makhsoos hain , aur humari aurton kay liye haram hain .  aur agar woh baccha murda peda ho to uss say faeeda uthaney mein sabb ( mard o aurat ) shareek hojatay hain .   jo baaten yeh log bana rahey hain , Allah unhen unqareeb unn ka poora poora badla dey ga . yaqeenan woh hikmat ka bhi malik hai , ilm ka bhi malik .

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh log baray khasaray mein hain jinhon ney apni aulad ko kissi ilmi wajeh kay baghair mehaz himaqat say qatal kiya hai , aur Allah ney jo rizq inn ko diya tha ussay Allah per bohtan baandh ker haram kerliya hai . woh buri tarah gumrah hogaye hain , aur kabhi hidayat per aaye hi nahi .
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh log baray khasaray mein hain jinhon ney apni aulad ko kissi ilmi wajeh kay baghair mehaz himaqat say qatal kiya hai , aur Allah ney jo rizq inn ko diya tha ussay Allah per bohtan baandh ker haram kerliya hai . woh buri tarah gumrah hogaye hain , aur kabhi hidayat per aaye hi nahi .

ayahs.text: Allah woh hai jiss ney baaghaat peda kiye jinn mein say kuch , ( bail daar hain jo ) saharon say oopper charrhaye jatay hain , aur kuch saharon kay baghair buland hotay hain , aur nakhlistan aur khetiyan , jinn kay zaeeqay alag alag hain , aur zaitoon aur anaar , jo aik doosray say miltay jultay bhi hain , aur aik doosray say mukhtalif bhi .   jab yeh darkht phal den to inn kay phalon ko khaney mein istimal kero , aur jab inn ki katai ka din aaye to Allah ka haq ada kero ,   aur fuzool kharchi naa kero . yaad rakho , woh fuzool kharch logon  ko pasand nahi kerta .
ayahs.translation: Allah woh hai jiss ney baaghaat peda kiye jinn mein say kuch , ( bail daar hain jo ) saharon say oopper charrhaye jatay hain , aur kuch saharon kay baghair buland hotay hain , aur nakhlistan aur khetiyan , jinn kay zaeeqay alag alag hain , aur zaitoon aur anaar , jo aik doosray say miltay jultay bhi hain , aur aik doosray say mukhtalif bhi .   jab yeh darkht phal den to inn kay phalon ko khaney mein istimal kero , aur jab inn ki katai ka din aaye to Allah ka haq ada kero ,   aur fuzool kharchi naa kero . yaad rakho , woh fuzool kharch logon  ko pasand nahi kerta .

ayahs.text: aur chopayo mein say Allah ney woh janwer bhi peda kiye hain jo bojh uthatay hain , aur woh bhi jo zameen say lagay huye hotay hain .   Allah ney jo rizq tumhen diya hai , uss mein say khao , aur shetan kay naqsh-e-qadam per naa chalo . yaqeen jano , woh tumharay liye aik khula dushman hai .
ayahs.translation: aur chopayo mein say Allah ney woh janwer bhi peda kiye hain jo bojh uthatay hain , aur woh bhi jo zameen say lagay huye hotay hain .   Allah ney jo rizq tumhen diya hai , uss mein say khao , aur shetan kay naqsh-e-qadam per naa chalo . yaqeen jano , woh tumharay liye aik khula dushman hai .

ayahs.text: . ( maweshiyon kay ) kul aath jooray Allah ney peda kiye hain , do sinfen ( nar aur mada ) bheron ki nasal say aur do bakron ki nasal say . zara unn say poocho kay :  kiya dono naron ko Allah ney haram kiya hai , ya dono mada ko-? ya her uss bacchay ko jo dono naslon ki mada kay pet mein mojood ho-? agar tum sachay ho to kissi ilmi buniyad per mujhay jawab do !
ayahs.translation: . ( maweshiyon kay ) kul aath jooray Allah ney peda kiye hain , do sinfen ( nar aur mada ) bheron ki nasal say aur do bakron ki nasal say . zara unn say poocho kay :  kiya dono naron ko Allah ney haram kiya hai , ya dono mada ko-? ya her uss bacchay ko jo dono naslon ki mada kay pet mein mojood ho-? agar tum sachay ho to kissi ilmi buniyad per mujhay jawab do !

ayahs.text: aur issi tarah oonton ki bhi do sinfen ( nar aur mada Allah ney ) peda ki hain , aur gaye ki bhi do sinfen . inn say kaho kay :  kiya dono naron ko Allah ney haram kiya hai , ya dono mada ko-? ya her uss bacchay ko jo dono naslon ki mada kay pet mein mojood ho-? kiya tum uss waqt khud hazir thay jab Allah ney tumhen iss ka hukum diya tha-? ( agar nahi , aur yaqeenan nahi ) to phir uss shaks say barh ker zalim kon hoga jo Allah per iss liye jhoot baandhay takay kissi ilmi buniyad kay baghair logon  ko gumrah ker-sakay-? haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah zalim logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .
ayahs.translation: aur issi tarah oonton ki bhi do sinfen ( nar aur mada Allah ney ) peda ki hain , aur gaye ki bhi do sinfen . inn say kaho kay :  kiya dono naron ko Allah ney haram kiya hai , ya dono mada ko-? ya her uss bacchay ko jo dono naslon ki mada kay pet mein mojood ho-? kiya tum uss waqt khud hazir thay jab Allah ney tumhen iss ka hukum diya tha-? ( agar nahi , aur yaqeenan nahi ) to phir uss shaks say barh ker zalim kon hoga jo Allah per iss liye jhoot baandhay takay kissi ilmi buniyad kay baghair logon  ko gumrah ker-sakay-? haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah zalim logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho kay :  jo wahi mujh per nazil ki gaee hai uss mein to mein koi aesi cheez nahi pata jiss ka khana kissi khaney walay kay liye haram ho ,   illa yeh kay woh murdar ho , ya behta huwa khoon ho , ya soowar ka gosht ho , kiyonkay woh napak hai , ya jo aisa gunah ka janwer ho jiss per Allah kay siwa kissi aur ka naam pukara gaya ho . haan jo shaks ( inn cheezon mein say kissi kay khaney per ) intehai majboor hojaye ,   jabkay woh naa lazzat hasil kernay ki gharz say aisa ker raha ho , aur naa zaroorat ki hadd say aagay barhay , to beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: . ayahs.text: aur yahudiyon per hum ney her nakhun walay janwer ko haram kerdiya tha , aur gaye aur bakri kay ajza mein say unn ki charbiyan hum ney haram ki then , albatta jo charbi unn ki pusht per ya aanton per lagi ho , ya jo kissi haddi say mili hoi ho woh mustasna thi . yeh hum ney unn ko unn ki sarkashi ki saza di thi . aur poora yaqeen rakho kay hum sachay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur yahudiyon per hum ney her nakhun walay janwer ko haram kerdiya tha , aur gaye aur bakri kay ajza mein say unn ki charbiyan hum ney haram ki then , albatta jo charbi unn ki pusht per ya aanton per lagi ho , ya jo kissi haddi say mili hoi ho woh mustasna thi . yeh hum ney unn ko unn ki sarkashi ki saza di thi . aur poora yaqeen rakho kay hum sachay hain .

ayahs.text: phir bhi agar yeh ( kafir ) tumhen jhutlayen to keh do kay :  tumhara perwerdigar bari wasee rehmat ka malik hai aur uss kay azab ko mujrimon say talaya nahi jasakta .
ayahs.translation: phir bhi agar yeh ( kafir ) tumhen jhutlayen to keh do kay :  tumhara perwerdigar bari wasee rehmat ka malik hai aur uss kay azab ko mujrimon say talaya nahi jasakta .

ayahs.text: jinn logon  ney shirk apnaya huwa hai , woh yeh kahen gay kay :  agar Allah chahta to naa hum shirk kertay , naa humaray baap dada , aur naa hum kissi bhi cheez ko haram qarar detay .    inn say pehlay kay logon  ney bhi issi tarah ( Rasoolon ko ) jhutlaya tha , yahan tak kay unhon ney humaray azab ka maza chakh liya . tum inn say kaho kay :  kiya tumharay paas koi ilm hai jo humaray samney nikal ker paish ker-sako-? tum to jiss cheez kay peechay chal rahey ho woh gumaan kay siwa kuch nahi , aur tumhara kaam iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay wehmi andazay lagatay raho .
ayahs.translation: jinn logon  ney shirk apnaya huwa hai , woh yeh kahen gay kay :  agar Allah chahta to naa hum shirk kertay , naa humaray baap dada , aur naa hum kissi bhi cheez ko haram qarar detay .    inn say pehlay kay logon  ney bhi issi tarah ( Rasoolon ko ) jhutlaya tha , yahan tak kay unhon ney humaray azab ka maza chakh liya . tum inn say kaho kay :  kiya tumharay paas koi ilm hai jo humaray samney nikal ker paish ker-sako-? tum to jiss cheez kay peechay chal rahey ho woh gumaan kay siwa kuch nahi , aur tumhara kaam iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay wehmi andazay lagatay raho .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho kay :  aesi daleel to Allah hi ki hai jo ( dilon tak ) phonchney wali ho . chunacheh agar woh chahta to tum sabb ko ( zabardasti ) hidayat per ley aata .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho kay :  aesi daleel to Allah hi ki hai jo ( dilon tak ) phonchney wali ho . chunacheh agar woh chahta to tum sabb ko ( zabardasti ) hidayat per ley aata .

ayahs.text: inn say kaho kay :  apney woh gawah zara samney to lao jo yeh gawahi den kay Allah ney inn cheezon ko haram qarar diya hai .  phir agar yeh khud gawahi dey bhi den to tum unn kay sath gawahi mein shareek naa hona , aur unn logon  ki khuwaishaat kay peechay naa chalna jinhon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , jo aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , aur jo doosron ko ( khudai mein ) apney perwerdigar kay barabar mantay hain .
ayahs.translation: inn say kaho kay :  apney woh gawah zara samney to lao jo yeh gawahi den kay Allah ney inn cheezon ko haram qarar diya hai .  phir agar yeh khud gawahi dey bhi den to tum unn kay sath gawahi mein shareek naa hona , aur unn logon  ki khuwaishaat kay peechay naa chalna jinhon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , jo aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , aur jo doosron ko ( khudai mein ) apney perwerdigar kay barabar mantay hain .

ayahs.text: . ( unn say ) kaho kay :  aao , mein tumhen parh ker sunaon kay tumharay perwerdigar ney ( dar-haqeeqat ) tum per konsi baaten haram ki hain . woh yeh hain kay uss kay sath kissi ko shareek naa thehrao , aur maa baap kay sath acha sulook kero , aur ghurbat ki wajeh say apney bacchon ko qatal naa kero . hum tumhen bhi rizq den gay , aur unn ko bhi . aur bey hayai kay kamon kay paas bhi naa phatko , chahye woh bey hayai khuli hoi ho ya chupi hoi ,   aur jiss jaan ko Allah ney hurmat ata ki hai ussay kissi bar-haq wajeh kay baghair qatal naa kero . logo ! yeh hain woh baaten jinn ki Allah ney takeed ki hai takay tumhen kuch samajh aaye .
ayahs.translation: . ( unn say ) kaho kay :  aao , mein tumhen parh ker sunaon kay tumharay perwerdigar ney ( dar-haqeeqat ) tum per konsi baaten haram ki hain . woh yeh hain kay uss kay sath kissi ko shareek naa thehrao , aur maa baap kay sath acha sulook kero , aur ghurbat ki wajeh say apney bacchon ko qatal naa kero . hum tumhen bhi rizq den gay , aur unn ko bhi . aur bey hayai kay kamon kay paas bhi naa phatko , chahye woh bey hayai khuli hoi ho ya chupi hoi ,   aur jiss jaan ko Allah ney hurmat ata ki hai ussay kissi bar-haq wajeh kay baghair qatal naa kero . logo ! yeh hain woh baaten jinn ki Allah ney takeed ki hai takay tumhen kuch samajh aaye .

ayahs.text: aur yateem jab tak pukhtagi ki umar ko naa phonch jaye , uss waqt tak uss kay maal kay qareeb bhi naa jao , magar aesay tareeqay say jo ( uss kay haq mein ) behtareen ho , aur naap tol insaf kay sath poora poora kiya kero , ( albatta ) Allah kissi bhi shaks ko uss ki taqat say ziyada ki takleef nahi deta .   aur jab koi baat kaho to insaf say kaam lo , chahye moamla apney qareebi rishta daar hi ka ho , aur Allah kay ehad ko poora kero .   logo ! yeh baaten hain jinn ki Allah ney takeed ki hai , takay tum naseehat qubool kero .
ayahs.translation: aur yateem jab tak pukhtagi ki umar ko naa phonch jaye , uss waqt tak uss kay maal kay qareeb bhi naa jao , magar aesay tareeqay say jo ( uss kay haq mein ) behtareen ho , aur naap tol insaf kay sath poora poora kiya kero , ( albatta ) Allah kissi bhi shaks ko uss ki taqat say ziyada ki takleef nahi deta .   aur jab koi baat kaho to insaf say kaam lo , chahye moamla apney qareebi rishta daar hi ka ho , aur Allah kay ehad ko poora kero .   logo ! yeh baaten hain jinn ki Allah ney takeed ki hai , takay tum naseehat qubool kero .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) yeh bhi kaho kay :  yeh mera seedha seedha raasta hai , lehaza iss kay peechay chalo , aur doosray raaston kay peechay naa parro , werna woh tumhen Allah kay raastay say alag kerden gay .  logo ! yeh baaten hain jinn ki Allah ney takeed ki hai takay tum muttaqi bano .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) yeh bhi kaho kay :  yeh mera seedha seedha raasta hai , lehaza iss kay peechay chalo , aur doosray raaston kay peechay naa parro , werna woh tumhen Allah kay raastay say alag kerden gay .  logo ! yeh baaten hain jinn ki Allah ney takeed ki hai takay tum muttaqi bano .

ayahs.text: phir hum ney musa ko kitab ata ki thi jiss ka maqsad yeh tha kay naik logon  per Allah ki naimat poori ho , aur her cheez ki tafseel biyan kerdi jaye , aur woh ( logon  kay liye ) rehnumai aur rehmat ka sabab banay , takay woh ( aakhirat mein ) apney perwerdigar say jaa milney per emaan ley ayen .
ayahs.translation: phir hum ney musa ko kitab ata ki thi jiss ka maqsad yeh tha kay naik logon  per Allah ki naimat poori ho , aur her cheez ki tafseel biyan kerdi jaye , aur woh ( logon  kay liye ) rehnumai aur rehmat ka sabab banay , takay woh ( aakhirat mein ) apney perwerdigar say jaa milney per emaan ley ayen .

ayahs.text: aur ( issi tarah ) yeh barkat wali kitab hai jo hum ney nazil ki hai . lehaza iss ki perwi kero , aur taqwa ikhtiyar kero , takay tum per rehmat ho
ayahs.translation: aur ( issi tarah ) yeh barkat wali kitab hai jo hum ney nazil ki hai . lehaza iss ki perwi kero , aur taqwa ikhtiyar kero , takay tum per rehmat ho

ayahs.text: . ( yeh kitab hum ney iss liye nazil ki kay ) kabhi tum yeh kehney lago kay kitab to hum say pehlay do girohon ( yahood o nasara ) per nazil ki gaee thi , aur jo kuch woh parhtay parhatay thay , hum to uss say bilkul bey khabar thay .
ayahs.translation: . ( yeh kitab hum ney iss liye nazil ki kay ) kabhi tum yeh kehney lago kay kitab to hum say pehlay do girohon ( yahood o nasara ) per nazil ki gaee thi , aur jo kuch woh parhtay parhatay thay , hum to uss say bilkul bey khabar thay .

ayahs.text: ya yeh kaho kay agar hum logon  per kitab nazil hojati to hum inn ( yahudiyon aur essaiyon ) say yaqeenan ziyada hidayat per hotay . lo ! phir tumharay paas tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik roshan daleel aur hidayat o rehmat ka saman aagaya hai ! abb uss say barh ker zalim kon hoga jo Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlaye aur unn say mun morr ley ? jo log humari aayaton say mun morr rahey hain , unn ko hum boht bura azab den gay , kiyonkay woh barabar mun morray hi rahey .
ayahs.translation: ya yeh kaho kay agar hum logon  per kitab nazil hojati to hum inn ( yahudiyon aur essaiyon ) say yaqeenan ziyada hidayat per hotay . lo ! phir tumharay paas tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik roshan daleel aur hidayat o rehmat ka saman aagaya hai ! abb uss say barh ker zalim kon hoga jo Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlaye aur unn say mun morr ley ? jo log humari aayaton say mun morr rahey hain , unn ko hum boht bura azab den gay , kiyonkay woh barabar mun morray hi rahey .

ayahs.text: yeh ( emaan laney kay liye ) iss kay siwa kiss baat ka intizar ker rahey hain kay inn kay paas farishtay ayen , ya tumhara perwerdigar khud aaye , ya tumharay perwerdigar ki kuch nishaniyan aajayen-? ( halankay ) jiss din tumharay perwerdigar ki koi nishani aagae , uss din kissi aesay shaks ka emaan uss kay liye kaar aamad nahi hoga jo pehlay emaan naa laya ho , ya jiss ney apney emaan kay sath kissi naik amal ki kamai naa ki ho .   ( lehaza inn logon  say ) keh do kay :  acha , intizar kero , hum bhi intizar ker rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: yeh ( emaan laney kay liye ) iss kay siwa kiss baat ka intizar ker rahey hain kay inn kay paas farishtay ayen , ya tumhara perwerdigar khud aaye , ya tumharay perwerdigar ki kuch nishaniyan aajayen-? ( halankay ) jiss din tumharay perwerdigar ki koi nishani aagae , uss din kissi aesay shaks ka emaan uss kay liye kaar aamad nahi hoga jo pehlay emaan naa laya ho , ya jiss ney apney emaan kay sath kissi naik amal ki kamai naa ki ho .   ( lehaza inn logon  say ) keh do kay :  acha , intizar kero , hum bhi intizar ker rahey hain .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yaqeen jano kay jinn logon  ney apney deen mein tafarqa peda kiya hai , aur girohon mein butt gaye hain , unn say tumhara koi talluq nahi hai . unn ka moamla to Allah kay hawalay hai . phir woh unhen jatlaye ga kay woh kiya kuch kertay rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yaqeen jano kay jinn logon  ney apney deen mein tafarqa peda kiya hai , aur girohon mein butt gaye hain , unn say tumhara koi talluq nahi hai . unn ka moamla to Allah kay hawalay hai . phir woh unhen jatlaye ga kay woh kiya kuch kertay rahey hain .

ayahs.text: jo shaks koi naiki ley ker aaye ga , uss kay liye uss jaisi das naikiyon ka sawab hai , aur jo shaks koi badi ley ker aaye ga , to uss ko sirf ussi aik badi ki saza di jaye gi , aur unn per koi zulm nahi hoga .
ayahs.translation: jo shaks koi naiki ley ker aaye ga , uss kay liye uss jaisi das naikiyon ka sawab hai , aur jo shaks koi badi ley ker aaye ga , to uss ko sirf ussi aik badi ki saza di jaye gi , aur unn per koi zulm nahi hoga .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay meray perwerdigar ney mujhay aik seedhay raastay per laga diya hai jo kaji say pak deen hai , Ibrahim ka deen ! jinhon ney poori tarah yaksoo ho ker apna rukh sirf Allah ki taraf kiya huwa tha , aur woh shirk kernay walon mein say nahi thay .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay meray perwerdigar ney mujhay aik seedhay raastay per laga diya hai jo kaji say pak deen hai , Ibrahim ka deen ! jinhon ney poori tarah yaksoo ho ker apna rukh sirf Allah ki taraf kiya huwa tha , aur woh shirk kernay walon mein say nahi thay .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  beyshak meri namaz , meri ibadat aur mera jeena marna sabb kuch Allah kay liye hai jo tamam jahano ka perwerdigar hai .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  beyshak meri namaz , meri ibadat aur mera jeena marna sabb kuch Allah kay liye hai jo tamam jahano ka perwerdigar hai .

ayahs.text: uss ka koi shareek nahi hai , issi baat ka mujhay hukum diya gaya hai , aur mein uss kay aagay sabb say pehlay sar jhukaney wala hun .
ayahs.translation: uss ka koi shareek nahi hai , issi baat ka mujhay hukum diya gaya hai , aur mein uss kay aagay sabb say pehlay sar jhukaney wala hun .

ayahs.text: keh do-kay :  kiya mein Allah kay siwa koi aur perwerdigar talash kerun , halankay woh her cheez ka malik hai ? aur jo koi shaks koi kamai kerta hai , uss ka nafaa nuqsan kissi aur per nahi , khud ussi per parrta hai , aur koi bojh uthaney wala kissi aur ka bojh nahi uthaye ga .   phir tumharay perwerdigar hi ki taraf tum sabb ko loattna hai . uss waqt woh tumhen woh sari baaten bataye ga jinn mein tum ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: keh do-kay :  kiya mein Allah kay siwa koi aur perwerdigar talash kerun , halankay woh her cheez ka malik hai ? aur jo koi shaks koi kamai kerta hai , uss ka nafaa nuqsan kissi aur per nahi , khud ussi per parrta hai , aur koi bojh uthaney wala kissi aur ka bojh nahi uthaye ga .   phir tumharay perwerdigar hi ki taraf tum sabb ko loattna hai . uss waqt woh tumhen woh sari baaten bataye ga jinn mein tum ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: aur wohi hai jiss ney tumhen zameen mein aik doosray ka janasheen banaya , aur tum mein say kuch logon  ko doosron say darjaat mein bulandi ata ki , takay uss ney tumhen jo naimaton di hain , unn mein tumhen aazamaye . yeh haqeeqat hai kay tumhara rab jald saza denay wala hai , aur yeh ( bhi ) haqeeqat hai kay woh boht bakhshney wala bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: aur wohi hai jiss ney tumhen zameen mein aik doosray ka janasheen banaya , aur tum mein say kuch logon  ko doosron say darjaat mein bulandi ata ki , takay uss ney tumhen jo naimaton di hain , unn mein tumhen aazamaye . yeh haqeeqat hai kay tumhara rab jald saza denay wala hai , aur yeh ( bhi ) haqeeqat hai kay woh boht bakhshney wala bara meharban hai .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: Alif-Laam-Meem-Suad
verses.translation: Alif-Laam-Meem-Suad

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh kitab hai jo tum per iss liye utaari gaee hai kay tum iss kay zariye logon  ko hoshiyar kero , lehaza iss ki wajeh say tumharay dil mein koi pareshani naa honi chahiye ,   aur mominon kay liye yeh aik naseehat ka paygham hai .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh kitab hai jo tum per iss liye utaari gaee hai kay tum iss kay zariye logon  ko hoshiyar kero , lehaza iss ki wajeh say tumharay dil mein koi pareshani naa honi chahiye ,   aur mominon kay liye yeh aik naseehat ka paygham hai .

verses.text: . ( logo ! ) jo kitab tum per tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say utaari gaee hai , uss kay peechay chalo , aur apney perwerdigar ko chorr ker doosray ( mann gharrat ) sarpraston kay peechay naa chalo . ( magar ) tum log naseehat kam hi mantay ho .
verses.translation: . ( logo ! ) jo kitab tum per tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say utaari gaee hai , uss kay peechay chalo , aur apney perwerdigar ko chorr ker doosray ( mann gharrat ) sarpraston kay peechay naa chalo . ( magar ) tum log naseehat kam hi mantay ho .

verses.text: kitni hi bastiyan hain jinn ko hum ney halak kiya . chunacheh unn kay paas humara azab raaton raat aagaya , ya aesay waqt aaya jab woh dophare ko aaram ker rahey thay .
verses.translation: kitni hi bastiyan hain jinn ko hum ney halak kiya . chunacheh unn kay paas humara azab raaton raat aagaya , ya aesay waqt aaya jab woh dophare ko aaram ker rahey thay .

verses.text: phir jab unn per humara azab aa-phoncha to unn kay paas kehney ko aur toh kuch tha nahi , bus bol uthay kay waqaee hum hi zalim thay .
verses.translation: phir jab unn per humara azab aa-phoncha to unn kay paas kehney ko aur toh kuch tha nahi , bus bol uthay kay waqaee hum hi zalim thay .

verses.text: abb hum unn logon  say zaroor baaz purs keren gay jinn kay paas payghumber bhejay gaye thay , aur hum khud payghumberon say bhi poochen gay ( kay unhon ney kiya paygham phonchaya , aur unhen kiya jawab mila-? )
verses.translation: abb hum unn logon  say zaroor baaz purs keren gay jinn kay paas payghumber bhejay gaye thay , aur hum khud payghumberon say bhi poochen gay ( kay unhon ney kiya paygham phonchaya , aur unhen kiya jawab mila-? )

verses.text: phir hum unn kay samney saray waqiyaat khud apney ilm ki buniyad per biyan kerden gay , ( kiyonkay ) hum ( unn waqiyaat kay waqt ) kahen ghaeeb to nahi thay .
verses.translation: phir hum unn kay samney saray waqiyaat khud apney ilm ki buniyad per biyan kerden gay , ( kiyonkay ) hum ( unn waqiyaat kay waqt ) kahen ghaeeb to nahi thay .

verses.text: aur uss din ( aemal ka ) wazan hona atal haqeeqat hai . chunacheh jinn ki tarazoo kay pallay bhari hon gay , wohi falah paaney walay hon gay .
verses.translation: aur uss din ( aemal ka ) wazan hona atal haqeeqat hai . chunacheh jinn ki tarazoo kay pallay bhari hon gay , wohi falah paaney walay hon gay .

verses.text: aur jinn ki tarazoo kay pallay halkay hon gay , wohi log hain jinhon ney humari aayaton kay sath ziyadtiyan ker ker kay khud apni janon ko ghatay mein daala hai .
verses.translation: aur jinn ki tarazoo kay pallay halkay hon gay , wohi log hain jinhon ney humari aayaton kay sath ziyadtiyan ker ker kay khud apni janon ko ghatay mein daala hai .

verses.text: aur khuli baat hai kay hum ney tumhen zameen mein rehney ki jagah di , aur uss mein tumharay liye rozi kay asbaab peda kiye . ( phir bhi ) tum log shukar kam hi ada kertay ho .
verses.translation: aur khuli baat hai kay hum ney tumhen zameen mein rehney ki jagah di , aur uss mein tumharay liye rozi kay asbaab peda kiye . ( phir bhi ) tum log shukar kam hi ada kertay ho .

verses.text: aur hum ney tumhen peda kiya , phir tumhari soorat banai , phir farishton say kaha kay :  Adam ko sajda kero .  chunacheh sabb ney sajda kiya , siwaye iblees kay . woh sajda kernay walon mein shamil naa huwa .
verses.translation: aur hum ney tumhen peda kiya , phir tumhari soorat banai , phir farishton say kaha kay :  Adam ko sajda kero .  chunacheh sabb ney sajda kiya , siwaye iblees kay . woh sajda kernay walon mein shamil naa huwa .

verses.text: Allah ney kaha :  jab mein ney tujhay hukum dey diya tha to tujhay sajda kernay say kiss cheez ney roka-? woh bola :  mein uss say behtar hun . tu ney mujhay aag say peda kiya , aur uss ko mitti say peda kiya .
verses.translation: Allah ney kaha :  jab mein ney tujhay hukum dey diya tha to tujhay sajda kernay say kiss cheez ney roka-? woh bola :  mein uss say behtar hun . tu ney mujhay aag say peda kiya , aur uss ko mitti say peda kiya .

verses.text: Allah ney kaha :  acha to yahan say neechay utar , kiyonkay tujhay yeh haq nahi phonchta kay yahan takabbur keray . abb nikal jaa , yaqeenan to zaleelon mein say hai .
verses.translation: Allah ney kaha :  acha to yahan say neechay utar , kiyonkay tujhay yeh haq nahi phonchta kay yahan takabbur keray . abb nikal jaa , yaqeenan to zaleelon mein say hai .

verses.text: uss ney kaha :  mujhay uss din tak ( zinda rehney ki ) mohlat deydey jiss din logon  ko qabron say zinda ker kay uthaya jaye ga .
verses.translation: uss ney kaha :  mujhay uss din tak ( zinda rehney ki ) mohlat deydey jiss din logon  ko qabron say zinda ker kay uthaya jaye ga .

verses.text: Allah ney farmaya :  tujhay mohlat dey di gaee .
verses.translation: Allah ney farmaya :  tujhay mohlat dey di gaee .

verses.text: kehney laga :  abb chunkay tu ney mujhay gumrah kiya hai ,   iss liye mein ( bhi ) qasam khata hun kay inn ( insanon ) ki ghaat laga ker teray seedhay raastay per beth rahun ga .
verses.translation: kehney laga :  abb chunkay tu ney mujhay gumrah kiya hai ,   iss liye mein ( bhi ) qasam khata hun kay inn ( insanon ) ki ghaat laga ker teray seedhay raastay per beth rahun ga .

verses.text: phir mein inn per ( chaaron taraf say ) hamlay kerun ga , inn kay samney say bhi aur inn kay peechay say bhi , aur inn ki dayen taraf say bhi , aur inn ki bayen taraf say bhi . aur to inn mein say aksar logon  ko shukar guzaar nahi paye ga .
verses.translation: phir mein inn per ( chaaron taraf say ) hamlay kerun ga , inn kay samney say bhi aur inn kay peechay say bhi , aur inn ki dayen taraf say bhi , aur inn ki bayen taraf say bhi . aur to inn mein say aksar logon  ko shukar guzaar nahi paye ga .

verses.text: Allah ney kaha :  nikal jaa yahan say , zaleel aur mardood hoker . inn mein say jo teray peechay chalay ga , ( woh bhi tera sathi hoga ) aur mein tum sabb say jahannum ko bhar dun ga .
verses.translation: Allah ney kaha :  nikal jaa yahan say , zaleel aur mardood hoker . inn mein say jo teray peechay chalay ga , ( woh bhi tera sathi hoga ) aur mein tum sabb say jahannum ko bhar dun ga .

verses.text: aur aey Adam ! tum aur tumhari biwi dono jannat mein raho , aur jahan say jo cheez chahao , khao . albatta iss ( khaas ) darkht kay qareeb bhi matt phatakna , werna tum ziyadti kernay walon mein shamil hojao gay .
verses.translation: aur aey Adam ! tum aur tumhari biwi dono jannat mein raho , aur jahan say jo cheez chahao , khao . albatta iss ( khaas ) darkht kay qareeb bhi matt phatakna , werna tum ziyadti kernay walon mein shamil hojao gay .

verses.text: phir huwa yeh kay shetan ney unn dono kay dil mein waswasa daala , takay unn ki sharam ki jaghen jo unn say chupai gaee then , aik doosray kay samney khol dey .   kehney laga kay : tumharay perwerdigar ney tumhen uss darkht say kissi aur wajeh say nahi , balkay sirf iss wajeh say roka tha kay kahen tum farishtay naa ban jao , ya tumhen hamesha ki zindagi naa hasil hojaye .
verses.translation: phir huwa yeh kay shetan ney unn dono kay dil mein waswasa daala , takay unn ki sharam ki jaghen jo unn say chupai gaee then , aik doosray kay samney khol dey .   kehney laga kay : tumharay perwerdigar ney tumhen uss darkht say kissi aur wajeh say nahi , balkay sirf iss wajeh say roka tha kay kahen tum farishtay naa ban jao , ya tumhen hamesha ki zindagi naa hasil hojaye .

verses.text: aur unn kay samney woh qasmen kha gaya kay yaqeen jano mein tumharay khair khuwahon mein say hon .
verses.translation: aur unn kay samney woh qasmen kha gaya kay yaqeen jano mein tumharay khair khuwahon mein say hon .

verses.text: iss tarah uss ney dono ko dhoka dey ker neechay utaar hi liya .   chunacheh jab dono ney uss darkht ka maza chakha to unn dono ki sharam ki jaghen aik doosray per khul gaeen , aur woh jannat kay kuch pattay jorr jorr ker apney badan per chipkaney lagay .   aur unn kay perwerdigar ney unhen aawaz di kay :  kiya mein ney tum dono ko uss darkht say roka nahi tha , aur tum say yeh nahi kaha tha kay shetan tum dono ka khula dushman hai ?
verses.translation: iss tarah uss ney dono ko dhoka dey ker neechay utaar hi liya .   chunacheh jab dono ney uss darkht ka maza chakha to unn dono ki sharam ki jaghen aik doosray per khul gaeen , aur woh jannat kay kuch pattay jorr jorr ker apney badan per chipkaney lagay .   aur unn kay perwerdigar ney unhen aawaz di kay :  kiya mein ney tum dono ko uss darkht say roka nahi tha , aur tum say yeh nahi kaha tha kay shetan tum dono ka khula dushman hai ?

verses.text: dono bol uthay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum apni janon per zulm ker guzray hain , aur agar aap ney hamen moaaf naa farmaya , aur hum per reham naa kiya to yaqeenan hum na-murad logon  mein shamil hojayen gay .
verses.translation: dono bol uthay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum apni janon per zulm ker guzray hain , aur agar aap ney hamen moaaf naa farmaya , aur hum per reham naa kiya to yaqeenan hum na-murad logon  mein shamil hojayen gay .

verses.text: Allah ney ( Adam , unn ki biwi aur iblees say ) farmaya :  abb tum sabb yahan say utar jao , tum aik doosray kay dushman hogay , aur tumharay liye aik mauddat tak zameen mein thehrna aur kissi qadar faeeda uthana ( tey kerdiya gaya ) hai .
verses.translation: Allah ney ( Adam , unn ki biwi aur iblees say ) farmaya :  abb tum sabb yahan say utar jao , tum aik doosray kay dushman hogay , aur tumharay liye aik mauddat tak zameen mein thehrna aur kissi qadar faeeda uthana ( tey kerdiya gaya ) hai .

verses.text: farmaya kay :  ussi ( zameen ) mein tum jio gay , aur ussi mein tumhen moat aaye gi , aur ussi say tumhen dobara zinda kerkay nikala jaye ga .
verses.translation: farmaya kay :  ussi ( zameen ) mein tum jio gay , aur ussi mein tumhen moat aaye gi , aur ussi say tumhen dobara zinda kerkay nikala jaye ga .

verses.text: aey Adam kay beto aur betiyo ! hum ney tumharay liye libas nazil kiya hai jo tumharay jism kay unn hisson ko chupa sakay jinn ka kholna bura hai , aur jo khushnumai ka zariya bhi hai .   aur taqwa ka jo libas hai woh sabb say behtar hai .   yeh sabb Allah ki nishaniyon ka hissa hai , jinn ka maqsad yeh hai kay log sabaq hasil keren .
verses.translation: aey Adam kay beto aur betiyo ! hum ney tumharay liye libas nazil kiya hai jo tumharay jism kay unn hisson ko chupa sakay jinn ka kholna bura hai , aur jo khushnumai ka zariya bhi hai .   aur taqwa ka jo libas hai woh sabb say behtar hai .   yeh sabb Allah ki nishaniyon ka hissa hai , jinn ka maqsad yeh hai kay log sabaq hasil keren .

verses.text: aey Adam kay beto aur betiyo ! shetan ko aisa moaqa hergiz hergiz naa dena kay woh tumhen ussi tarah fitney mein daal dey jaisay uss ney tumharay maa baap ko jannat say nikala , jabkay unn ka libas unn kay jism say utarwa liya tha , takay unn ko aik doosray ki sharam ki jaghen dikha dey . woh aur uss ka jatha tumhen wahan say dekhta hai jahan say tum unhen nahi dekh saktay . unn shetanon ko hum ney unhi ka dost bana diya hai jo emaan nahi latay .
verses.translation: aey Adam kay beto aur betiyo ! shetan ko aisa moaqa hergiz hergiz naa dena kay woh tumhen ussi tarah fitney mein daal dey jaisay uss ney tumharay maa baap ko jannat say nikala , jabkay unn ka libas unn kay jism say utarwa liya tha , takay unn ko aik doosray ki sharam ki jaghen dikha dey . woh aur uss ka jatha tumhen wahan say dekhta hai jahan say tum unhen nahi dekh saktay . unn shetanon ko hum ney unhi ka dost bana diya hai jo emaan nahi latay .

verses.text: aur jab yeh ( kafir ) log koi bey hayai ka kaam kertay hain to kehtay hain kay hum ney apney baap dadon ko issi tareeqay per amal kertay paya hai , aur Allah ney hamen aisa hi hukum diya hai .   tum ( unn say ) kaho kay :  Allah bey hayai ka hukum nahi diya kerta . kiya tum woh baaten Allah kay naam lagatay ho jinn ka tumhen zara ilm nahi-?
verses.translation: aur jab yeh ( kafir ) log koi bey hayai ka kaam kertay hain to kehtay hain kay hum ney apney baap dadon ko issi tareeqay per amal kertay paya hai , aur Allah ney hamen aisa hi hukum diya hai .   tum ( unn say ) kaho kay :  Allah bey hayai ka hukum nahi diya kerta . kiya tum woh baaten Allah kay naam lagatay ho jinn ka tumhen zara ilm nahi-?

verses.text: kaho kay :  meray perwerdigar ney to insaf ka hukum diya hai .   aur ( yeh hukum diya hai kay : )  jab kahen sajda kero , apna rukh theek theek rakho , aur iss yaqeen kay sath uss ko pukaro kay itaat khalis ussi ka haq hai . jiss tarah uss ney tumhen ibtida mein peda kiya tha . ussi tarah tum dobara peda hogay .
verses.translation: kaho kay :  meray perwerdigar ney to insaf ka hukum diya hai .   aur ( yeh hukum diya hai kay : )  jab kahen sajda kero , apna rukh theek theek rakho , aur iss yaqeen kay sath uss ko pukaro kay itaat khalis ussi ka haq hai . jiss tarah uss ney tumhen ibtida mein peda kiya tha . ussi tarah tum dobara peda hogay .

verses.text: . ( tum mein say ) aik giroh ko to Allah ney hidayat tak phoncha diya hai , aur aik giroh woh hai jiss per gumrahi musallat hogaee hai , kiyonkay inn logon  ney Allah kay bajaye shetanon ko dost bana liya hai , aur samajh yeh rahey hain kay woh seedhay raastay per hain .
verses.translation: . ( tum mein say ) aik giroh ko to Allah ney hidayat tak phoncha diya hai , aur aik giroh woh hai jiss per gumrahi musallat hogaee hai , kiyonkay inn logon  ney Allah kay bajaye shetanon ko dost bana liya hai , aur samajh yeh rahey hain kay woh seedhay raastay per hain .

verses.text: aey Adam kay beto aur betiyo ! jab kabhi masjid mein aao to apni khushnumai ka saman ( yani libas jism per ) ley ker aao , aur khao aur piyo , aur fuzool kharchi matt kero . yaad rakho kay Allah fuzool kharch logon  ko pasand nahi kerta .
verses.translation: aey Adam kay beto aur betiyo ! jab kabhi masjid mein aao to apni khushnumai ka saman ( yani libas jism per ) ley ker aao , aur khao aur piyo , aur fuzool kharchi matt kero . yaad rakho kay Allah fuzool kharch logon  ko pasand nahi kerta .

verses.text: kaho kay :  aakhir kon hai jiss ney zeenat kay uss saman ko haram qarar diya ho jo Allah ney apney bandon kay liye peda kiya hai , aur ( issi tarah ) pakeezah rizq ki cheezon ko-?    kaho kay :  jo log emaan rakhtay hain unn ko yeh naimatainen jo dunyawi zindagi mein mili hoi hain , qayamat kay din khalis unhi kay liye hon gi .    issi tarah hum tamam aayaten unn logon  kay liye tafseel say biyan kertay hain jo ilm say kaam len .
verses.translation: kaho kay :  aakhir kon hai jiss ney zeenat kay uss saman ko haram qarar diya ho jo Allah ney apney bandon kay liye peda kiya hai , aur ( issi tarah ) pakeezah rizq ki cheezon ko-?    kaho kay :  jo log emaan rakhtay hain unn ko yeh naimatainen jo dunyawi zindagi mein mili hoi hain , qayamat kay din khalis unhi kay liye hon gi .    issi tarah hum tamam aayaten unn logon  kay liye tafseel say biyan kertay hain jo ilm say kaam len .

verses.text: keh do kay :  meray perwerdigar ney to bey hayai kay kamon ko haram qarar diya hai , chahye woh bey hayai khuli hoi ho , ya chupi hoi . neez her qisam kay gunah ko aur nahaq kissi say ziyadti kernay ko , aur iss baat ko kay tum Allah kay sath kissi aesi cheez ko shareek maano jiss kay baaray mein Allah ney koi daleel nazil nahi ki hai , neez iss baat ko kay tum Allah kay zimmay woh baaten lagao jinn ki haqeeqat ka tumhen zara bhi ilm nahi hai .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  meray perwerdigar ney to bey hayai kay kamon ko haram qarar diya hai , chahye woh bey hayai khuli hoi ho , ya chupi hoi . neez her qisam kay gunah ko aur nahaq kissi say ziyadti kernay ko , aur iss baat ko kay tum Allah kay sath kissi aesi cheez ko shareek maano jiss kay baaray mein Allah ney koi daleel nazil nahi ki hai , neez iss baat ko kay tum Allah kay zimmay woh baaten lagao jinn ki haqeeqat ka tumhen zara bhi ilm nahi hai .

verses.text: aur her qoam kay liye aik miyaad muqarrar hai . chunacheh jab unn ki muqarrara miyaad aajati hai to woh gharri bhar bhi uss say aagay peechay nahi hosaktay .
verses.translation: aur her qoam kay liye aik miyaad muqarrar hai . chunacheh jab unn ki muqarrara miyaad aajati hai to woh gharri bhar bhi uss say aagay peechay nahi hosaktay .

verses.text: . ( aur Allah ney insan ko peda kertay waqt hi yeh tanbeeh kerdi thi kay : )  aey Adam kay beto aur betiyo ! agar tumharay paas tum hi mein say kuch payghumber ayen jo tumhen meri aayaten parh ker sunayen , to jo log taqwa ikhtiyar keren gay aur apni islaah kerlen gay , unn per naa koi khof taari hoga , aur naa woh ghumgeen hon gay .
verses.translation: . ( aur Allah ney insan ko peda kertay waqt hi yeh tanbeeh kerdi thi kay : )  aey Adam kay beto aur betiyo ! agar tumharay paas tum hi mein say kuch payghumber ayen jo tumhen meri aayaten parh ker sunayen , to jo log taqwa ikhtiyar keren gay aur apni islaah kerlen gay , unn per naa koi khof taari hoga , aur naa woh ghumgeen hon gay .

verses.text: aur jinhon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , aur takabbur kay sath unn say mun morra hai , woh log dozakh kay baasi hain . woh uss mein hamesha rahen gay .
verses.translation: aur jinhon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , aur takabbur kay sath unn say mun morra hai , woh log dozakh kay baasi hain . woh uss mein hamesha rahen gay .

verses.text: abb batao kay uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay , ya uss ki aayaton ko jhutlaye-? aesay logon  kay muqaddar mein ( rizq ka ) jitna hissa likha huwa hai , woh unhen ( duniya ki zindagi mein ) phonchta rahey ga ,   yahan tak kay jab unn kay paas humaray bhejay huye farishtay unn ki rooh qabz kernay kay liye aa-phonchen gay to woh kahen gay kay :  kahan hain woh ( tumharay mabood ) jinhen tum Allah kay bajaye pukara kertay thay ?  yeh jawab den gay kay :  woh sabb hum say gumm hochukay hain .  aur woh khud apney khilaf gawahi den gay kay woh kafir thay .
verses.translation: abb batao kay uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay , ya uss ki aayaton ko jhutlaye-? aesay logon  kay muqaddar mein ( rizq ka ) jitna hissa likha huwa hai , woh unhen ( duniya ki zindagi mein ) phonchta rahey ga ,   yahan tak kay jab unn kay paas humaray bhejay huye farishtay unn ki rooh qabz kernay kay liye aa-phonchen gay to woh kahen gay kay :  kahan hain woh ( tumharay mabood ) jinhen tum Allah kay bajaye pukara kertay thay ?  yeh jawab den gay kay :  woh sabb hum say gumm hochukay hain .  aur woh khud apney khilaf gawahi den gay kay woh kafir thay .

verses.text: Allah farmaye ga kay :  jao , jinnaat aur insanon kay unn girohon kay sath tum bhi dozakh mein dakhil hojao jo tum say pehlay guzar chukay hain .  ( iss tarah ) jab bhi koi giroh dozakh mein dakhil hoga , woh apney jaison per lanat bhejay ga ,   yahan tak kay jab aik kay baad aik , sabb uss mein ikatthay hojayen gay to unn mein say jo log baad mein aaye thay , woh apney say pehlay aaney walon kay baaray mein kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! enhon ney hamen ghalat raastay per daala tha , iss liye inn ko aag ka dugna azab dena .  Allah farmaye ga kay :  sabhi ka azab dugna hai ,   lekin tumhen ( abhi ) pata nahi hai .
verses.translation: Allah farmaye ga kay :  jao , jinnaat aur insanon kay unn girohon kay sath tum bhi dozakh mein dakhil hojao jo tum say pehlay guzar chukay hain .  ( iss tarah ) jab bhi koi giroh dozakh mein dakhil hoga , woh apney jaison per lanat bhejay ga ,   yahan tak kay jab aik kay baad aik , sabb uss mein ikatthay hojayen gay to unn mein say jo log baad mein aaye thay , woh apney say pehlay aaney walon kay baaray mein kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! enhon ney hamen ghalat raastay per daala tha , iss liye inn ko aag ka dugna azab dena .  Allah farmaye ga kay :  sabhi ka azab dugna hai ,   lekin tumhen ( abhi ) pata nahi hai .

verses.text: aur pehlay aaney walay baad mein aaney walon say kahen gay :  to phir tum ko hum per koi foqiyat to hasil naa hoi . lehaza jo kamai tum khud kertay rahey ho uss kay badlay azab ka maza chakho .
verses.translation: aur pehlay aaney walay baad mein aaney walon say kahen gay :  to phir tum ko hum per koi foqiyat to hasil naa hoi . lehaza jo kamai tum khud kertay rahey ho uss kay badlay azab ka maza chakho .

verses.text: . ( logo ! ) yaqeen rakho kay jinn logon  ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , aur takabbur kay sath unn say mun morra hai , unn kay liye aasman kay darwazay nahi kholay jayen gay , aur woh jannat mein uss waqt tak dakhil nahi hon gay jab tak koi oont aik soi kay nakay mein dakhil nahi hojata ,   aur issi tarah hum mujrimon ko unn kay kiye ka badla diya kertay hain .
verses.translation: . ( logo ! ) yaqeen rakho kay jinn logon  ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , aur takabbur kay sath unn say mun morra hai , unn kay liye aasman kay darwazay nahi kholay jayen gay , aur woh jannat mein uss waqt tak dakhil nahi hon gay jab tak koi oont aik soi kay nakay mein dakhil nahi hojata ,   aur issi tarah hum mujrimon ko unn kay kiye ka badla diya kertay hain .

verses.text: unn kay liye to dozakh hi ka bichona hai , aur oopper say ussi ka oarhna . aur issi tarah hum zalimon ko unn kay kiye ka badla diya kertay hain .
verses.translation: unn kay liye to dozakh hi ka bichona hai , aur oopper say ussi ka oarhna . aur issi tarah hum zalimon ko unn kay kiye ka badla diya kertay hain .

verses.text: aur jo log emaan laye hain aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain ( yaad rahey kay ) hum kissi bhi shaks ko uss ki taqat say ziyada ki takleef nahi detay   to aesay log jannat kay baasi hain . woh hamesha uss mein rahen gay .
verses.translation: aur jo log emaan laye hain aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain ( yaad rahey kay ) hum kissi bhi shaks ko uss ki taqat say ziyada ki takleef nahi detay   to aesay log jannat kay baasi hain . woh hamesha uss mein rahen gay .

verses.text: aur unn kay seenon mein ( aik doosray say duniya mein ) jo koi ranjish rahi hogi , ussay hum nikal bahir keren gay .   unn kay neechay say nehren behti hon gi , aur woh kahen gay :  tamam tarr shukar Allah ka hai , jiss ney hamen iss manzil tak phonchaya . agar Allah hamen naa phonchata to hum kabhi manzil tak naa phonchtay . humaray perwerdigar kay payghumber waqaee humaray paas bilkul sachi baat ley ker aaye thay .  aur unn say pukar ker kaha jaye ga kay :  logo ! yeh hai jannat ! tum jo amal kertay rahey ho , unn ki bana per tumhen iss ka waris bana diya gaya hai .
verses.translation: aur unn kay seenon mein ( aik doosray say duniya mein ) jo koi ranjish rahi hogi , ussay hum nikal bahir keren gay .   unn kay neechay say nehren behti hon gi , aur woh kahen gay :  tamam tarr shukar Allah ka hai , jiss ney hamen iss manzil tak phonchaya . agar Allah hamen naa phonchata to hum kabhi manzil tak naa phonchtay . humaray perwerdigar kay payghumber waqaee humaray paas bilkul sachi baat ley ker aaye thay .  aur unn say pukar ker kaha jaye ga kay :  logo ! yeh hai jannat ! tum jo amal kertay rahey ho , unn ki bana per tumhen iss ka waris bana diya gaya hai .

verses.text: aur jannat kay log dozakh walon say pukar ker kahen gay kay :  humaray perwerdigar ney hum say jo wada kiya tha , hum ney ussay bilkul sacha paya hai . abb tum batao kay tumharay perwerdigar ney jo wada kiya tha , kiya tum ney bhi ussay sacha paya-?  woh jawab mein kahen gay :  haan  itney mein aik munadi unn kay darmiyan pukaray ga kay :  Allah ki lanat hai unn zalimon per .
verses.translation: aur jannat kay log dozakh walon say pukar ker kahen gay kay :  humaray perwerdigar ney hum say jo wada kiya tha , hum ney ussay bilkul sacha paya hai . abb tum batao kay tumharay perwerdigar ney jo wada kiya tha , kiya tum ney bhi ussay sacha paya-?  woh jawab mein kahen gay :  haan  itney mein aik munadi unn kay darmiyan pukaray ga kay :  Allah ki lanat hai unn zalimon per .

verses.text: jo Allah kay raastay say logon  ko roktay thay , aur uss mein tairrah nikalna chahtay thay , aur jo aakhirat ka bilkul inkar kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: jo Allah kay raastay say logon  ko roktay thay , aur uss mein tairrah nikalna chahtay thay , aur jo aakhirat ka bilkul inkar kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: aur inn dono girohon ( yani jannatiyon aur dozakhiyon ) kay darmiyan aik aarr hogi , aur aeraaf per ( yani uss aarr ki bulandiyon per ) kuch log hon gay jo her giroh kay logon  ko unn ki alamaton say pehchantay hon gay .   aur woh jannat walon ko aawaz dey ker kahen gay :  salam ho tum per !  woh ( aeraaf walay ) khud to uss mein dakhil nahi huye hon gay , albatta ishtiaq kay sath umeed lagaye huye hon gay .
verses.translation: aur inn dono girohon ( yani jannatiyon aur dozakhiyon ) kay darmiyan aik aarr hogi , aur aeraaf per ( yani uss aarr ki bulandiyon per ) kuch log hon gay jo her giroh kay logon  ko unn ki alamaton say pehchantay hon gay .   aur woh jannat walon ko aawaz dey ker kahen gay :  salam ho tum per !  woh ( aeraaf walay ) khud to uss mein dakhil nahi huye hon gay , albatta ishtiaq kay sath umeed lagaye huye hon gay .

verses.text: aur jab unn ki nigahon ko dozakh walon ki samt morra jaye ga to woh kahen gay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen inn zalim logon  kay sath naa rakhna .
verses.translation: aur jab unn ki nigahon ko dozakh walon ki samt morra jaye ga to woh kahen gay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen inn zalim logon  kay sath naa rakhna .

verses.text: aur aeraaf walay unn logon  ko aawaz den gay jinn ko woh unn ki alamaton say pehchantay hon gay . kahen gay kay :  naa tumhari jama poonji tumharay kuch kaam aai , aur naa woh jinhen tum bara samjhay bethay thay .
verses.translation: aur aeraaf walay unn logon  ko aawaz den gay jinn ko woh unn ki alamaton say pehchantay hon gay . kahen gay kay :  naa tumhari jama poonji tumharay kuch kaam aai , aur naa woh jinhen tum bara samjhay bethay thay .

verses.text: . ( phir jannatiyon ki taraf ishara ker kay kahen gay kay : )  kiya yehi woh log hain jinn kay baaray mein tum ney qasmen khai then kay Allah inn ko apni rehmat ka koi hissa nahi dey ga-? ( unn say to keh diya gaya hai kay ) jannat mein dakhil hojao , naa tum ko kissi cheez ka darr hoga , aur naa tumhen kabhi koi ghum paish aaye ga .
verses.translation: . ( phir jannatiyon ki taraf ishara ker kay kahen gay kay : )  kiya yehi woh log hain jinn kay baaray mein tum ney qasmen khai then kay Allah inn ko apni rehmat ka koi hissa nahi dey ga-? ( unn say to keh diya gaya hai kay ) jannat mein dakhil hojao , naa tum ko kissi cheez ka darr hoga , aur naa tumhen kabhi koi ghum paish aaye ga .

verses.text: aur dozakh walay jannat walon say kahen gay kay :  hum per thora saa paani hi daal do , ya Allah ney tumhen jo naimaten di hain , unn ka koi hissa ( hum tak bhi phoncha do )  woh jawab den gay kay :  Allah ney yeh dono cheezen unn kafiron per haram kerdi hain .
verses.translation: aur dozakh walay jannat walon say kahen gay kay :  hum per thora saa paani hi daal do , ya Allah ney tumhen jo naimaten di hain , unn ka koi hissa ( hum tak bhi phoncha do )  woh jawab den gay kay :  Allah ney yeh dono cheezen unn kafiron per haram kerdi hain .

verses.text: jinhon ney apney deen ko khel tamasha bana rakha tha , aur jinn ko dunyawi zindagi ney dhokay mein daal diya tha .  chunacheh aaj hum bhi unn ko issi tarah bhula den gay jaisay woh iss baat ko bhulaye bethay thay kay unhen iss din ka samna kerna hai , aur jaisay woh humari aayaton ka khullam khula inkar kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: jinhon ney apney deen ko khel tamasha bana rakha tha , aur jinn ko dunyawi zindagi ney dhokay mein daal diya tha .  chunacheh aaj hum bhi unn ko issi tarah bhula den gay jaisay woh iss baat ko bhulaye bethay thay kay unhen iss din ka samna kerna hai , aur jaisay woh humari aayaton ka khullam khula inkar kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum inn kay paas aik aesi kitab ley aaye hain jiss mein hum ney apney ilm ki buniyad per her cheez ki tafseel bata di hai , aur jo log emaan layen unn kay liye woh hidayat aur rehmat hai .
verses.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum inn kay paas aik aesi kitab ley aaye hain jiss mein hum ney apney ilm ki buniyad per her cheez ki tafseel bata di hai , aur jo log emaan layen unn kay liye woh hidayat aur rehmat hai .

verses.text: . ( abb ) yeh ( kafir ) uss aakhri anjam kay siwa kiss baat kay muntazir hain jo iss kitab mein mazkoor hai ?   ( halankay ) jiss din woh aakhri anjam aagaya jo iss kitab ney bataya hai , uss din yeh log jo uss anjam ko pehlay bhula chukay thay , yeh kahen gay kay :  humaray perwerdigar kay payghumber waqaee sachi khabar laye thay . abb kiya hamen kuch sirfarishi moyassar aa-saktay hain jo humari sifarish keren , ya kiya aisa hosakta hai kay hamen dobara wahin ( duniya mein ) bhej diya jaye , takay hum jo ( buray ) kaam pehlay kertay rahey hain , unn kay bar-khilaf doosray ( naik ) amal keren-?  haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh log apni janon kay liye sakht ghatay ka soda ker-chukay hain , aur jo ( deota ) unhon ney gharr rakhay hain , enhen ( uss din ) unn ka kahen suragh nahi milay ga .
verses.translation: . ( abb ) yeh ( kafir ) uss aakhri anjam kay siwa kiss baat kay muntazir hain jo iss kitab mein mazkoor hai ?
