verses.text: yaqeenan tumhara perwerdigar woh Allah hai jiss ney saray aasman aur zameen cheh din mein banaye ,   phir uss ney arsh per istawa farmaya .   woh din ko raat ki chadar urrha deta hai , jo tez raftari say chalti hoi uss ko aa-dabochti hai . aur uss ney sooraj aur chaand taray peda kiye hain jo sabb uss kay hukum kay aagay raam hain . yaad rakho kay peda kerna aur hukum dena sabb ussi/issi ka kaam hai . bari barkat wala hai Allah jo tamam jahano ka perwerdigar hai !
verses.translation: yaqeenan tumhara perwerdigar woh Allah hai jiss ney saray aasman aur zameen cheh din mein banaye ,   phir uss ney arsh per istawa farmaya .   woh din ko raat ki chadar urrha deta hai , jo tez raftari say chalti hoi uss ko aa-dabochti hai . aur uss ney sooraj aur chaand taray peda kiye hain jo sabb uss kay hukum kay aagay raam hain . yaad rakho kay peda kerna aur hukum dena sabb ussi/issi ka kaam hai . bari barkat wala hai Allah jo tamam jahano ka perwerdigar hai !

verses.text: tum apney perwerdigar ko aajzi kay sath chupkay chupkay pukara kero . yaqeenan woh hadd say guzarney walon ko pasand nahi kerta .
verses.translation: tum apney perwerdigar ko aajzi kay sath chupkay chupkay pukara kero . yaqeenan woh hadd say guzarney walon ko pasand nahi kerta .

verses.text: aur zameen mein uss ki islaah kay baad fasad barpa naa kero ,   aur uss ki ibadat iss tarah kero kay dil mein khof bhi ho aur umeed bhi .   yaqeenan Allah ki rehmat naik logon  say qareeb hai .
verses.translation: aur zameen mein uss ki islaah kay baad fasad barpa naa kero ,   aur uss ki ibadat iss tarah kero kay dil mein khof bhi ho aur umeed bhi .   yaqeenan Allah ki rehmat naik logon  say qareeb hai .

verses.text: aur wohi ( Allah ) hai jo apni rehmat ( yani barish ) kay aagay aagay hawayen bhejta hai jo ( barish ki ) khushkhabri deti hain , yahan tak kay jab woh bojhal badalon ko utha leti hain to , hum unhen kissi murda zameen ki taraf hankaley jatay hain , phir wahan paani barsatay hain , aur uss kay zariye her qisam kay phal nikaltay hain . issi tarah hum murdon ko bhi zinda ker kay nikalen gay . shayad ( inn baaton per ghor ker kay ) tum sabaq hasil kerlo .
verses.translation: aur wohi ( Allah ) hai jo apni rehmat ( yani barish ) kay aagay aagay hawayen bhejta hai jo ( barish ki ) khushkhabri deti hain , yahan tak kay jab woh bojhal badalon ko utha leti hain to , hum unhen kissi murda zameen ki taraf hankaley jatay hain , phir wahan paani barsatay hain , aur uss kay zariye her qisam kay phal nikaltay hain . issi tarah hum murdon ko bhi zinda ker kay nikalen gay . shayad ( inn baaton per ghor ker kay ) tum sabaq hasil kerlo .

verses.text: aur jo zameen achi hoti hai uss ki pedawaar to apney rab kay hukum say nikal aati hai aur jo zameen kharab hogaee ho uss say naqis pedawaar kay siwa kuch nahi nikalta .   issi tarah hum apni nishaniyon kay mukhtalif rukh dikhatay rehtay hain , ( magar ) unn logon  kay liye jo qadardaani keren .
verses.translation: aur jo zameen achi hoti hai uss ki pedawaar to apney rab kay hukum say nikal aati hai aur jo zameen kharab hogaee ho uss say naqis pedawaar kay siwa kuch nahi nikalta .   issi tarah hum apni nishaniyon kay mukhtalif rukh dikhatay rehtay hain , ( magar ) unn logon  kay liye jo qadardaani keren .

verses.text: hum ney nooh ko unn ki qoam kay paas bheja .   chunacheh unhon ney kaha :  aey meri qoam kay logo ! Allah ki ibadat kero , uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi hai . yaqeen jano mujhay sakht andesha hai kay tum per aik zabardast din ka azab naa aa-khara ho .
verses.translation: hum ney nooh ko unn ki qoam kay paas bheja .   chunacheh unhon ney kaha :  aey meri qoam kay logo ! Allah ki ibadat kero , uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi hai . yaqeen jano mujhay sakht andesha hai kay tum per aik zabardast din ka azab naa aa-khara ho .

verses.text: unn ki qoam kay sardaron ney kaha :  hum to yaqeeni toor per dekh rahey hain kay tum khuli gumrahi mein mubtala ho .
verses.translation: unn ki qoam kay sardaron ney kaha :  hum to yaqeeni toor per dekh rahey hain kay tum khuli gumrahi mein mubtala ho .

verses.text: nooh ney jawab diya :  aey meri qoam ! mujhay koi gumrahi nahi lagi , magar mein Rabb-ul-Aalameen ka bheja huwa payghumber hun .
verses.translation: nooh ney jawab diya :  aey meri qoam ! mujhay koi gumrahi nahi lagi , magar mein Rabb-ul-Aalameen ka bheja huwa payghumber hun .

verses.text: mein tumhen apney rab kay payghamaat phonchata hun , aur tumhara bhala chahta hun . mujhay Allah ki taraf say aesi baaton ka ilm hai , jinn ka tumhen pata nahi hai .
verses.translation: mein tumhen apney rab kay payghamaat phonchata hun , aur tumhara bhala chahta hun . mujhay Allah ki taraf say aesi baaton ka ilm hai , jinn ka tumhen pata nahi hai .

verses.text: bhala kiya tumhen iss baat per taajjub hai kay tumharay rab ki naseehat aik aesay aadmi kay zariye tum tak phonchi hai jo khud tum hi mein say hai , takay woh tumhen khabrdar keray aur tum bad-amli say bach ker ho , aur takay tum per ( Allah ki ) rehmat ho-?
verses.translation: bhala kiya tumhen iss baat per taajjub hai kay tumharay rab ki naseehat aik aesay aadmi kay zariye tum tak phonchi hai jo khud tum hi mein say hai , takay woh tumhen khabrdar keray aur tum bad-amli say bach ker ho , aur takay tum per ( Allah ki ) rehmat ho-?

verses.text: phir bhi unhon ney nooh ko jhutlaya , chunacheh hum ney unn ko aur kashti mein unn kay sathiyon ko nijat di ,   aur unn sabb logon  ko gharq kerdiya jinhon ney humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya tha . yaqeenan woh andhay log thay .

verses.text: aur qoam-e-aad ki taraf hum ney inn/unn kay bhai Hood ko bheja .   unhon ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! Allah ki ibadat kero . uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi . kiya phir bhi tum Allah say nahi daro gay ?

verses.text: unn ki qoam kay sardar jinhon ney kufr apna rakha tha , kehney lagay :  hum to yaqeeni tor per dekh rahey hain kay tum beywaqoofi mein mubtala ho , aur beyshak humara gumaan yeh hai kay tum aik jhootay aadmi ho

verses.text: Hood ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! mujhay koi beywaqoofi laahaq nahi hoi , balkay mein Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki taraf say bheja huwa payghumber hun .

verses.text: mein apney perwerdigar kay payghamaat tum tak phonchata hun , aur mein tumhara aisa khair khuwa hun jiss per tum itminan ker-saktay ho .
verses.translation: mein apney perwerdigar kay payghamaat tum tak phonchata hun , aur mein tumhara aisa khair khuwa hun jiss per tum itminan ker-saktay ho .

verses.text: bhala kiya tumhen iss baat per taajjub hai kay tumharay rab ki naseehat aik aesay aadmi kay zariye tum tak phonchi hai jo khud tum hi mein say hai , takay woh tumhen khabrdar keray-? aur woh waqt yaad kero jab uss ney nooh ( aleh-assalam ) ki qoam kay baad tumhen janasheen banaya , aur jism ki deel dol mein tumhen ( doosron say ) barha charha ker rakha .   lehaza Allah ki naimaton per dhiyan do , takay tumhen falah naseeb ho .

Allah ki ibadat kero . uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi hai . tumharay paas tumharay rab ki taraf say aik roshan daleel aa-chuki hai . yeh Allah ki oontni hai jo tumharay liye aik nishani ban ker aai hai . iss liye iss ko azad chorr do kay woh Allah ki zameen mein charti phiray , aur issay kissi burai kay iraday say choona bhi nahi , kahen aisa naa ho kay tumhen aik dukh denay wala azab aa-pakray .

verses.text: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab Allah ney tumhen qoam-e-aad kay baad janasheen banaya , aur tumhen zameen per iss tarah basaya kay tum uss kay humwaar ilaqon mein mehal banatay ho , aur paharon ko tarash ker gharon ki shakal dey detay ho . lehaza Allah ki naimaton per dhiyan do , aur zameen mein fasad machatay naa phiro .
verses.translation: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab Allah ney tumhen qoam-e-aad kay baad janasheen banaya , aur tumhen zameen per iss tarah basaya kay tum uss kay humwaar ilaqon mein mehal banatay ho , aur paharon ko tarash ker gharon ki shakal dey detay ho . lehaza Allah ki naimaton per dhiyan do , aur zameen mein fasad machatay naa phiro .

verses.text: unn ki qoam kay sardaron ney jo barai kay ghamand mein thay , unn kamzoron say poocha jo emaan ley aaye thay kay :  kiya tumhen iss baat ka yaqeen hai kay saleh apney rab ki taraf say bhejay huye payghumber hain-?  unhon ney kaha kay :  beyshak hum to uss paygham per poora emaan rakhtay hain jo unn kay zariye bheja gaya hai
verses.translation: unn ki qoam kay sardaron ney jo barai kay ghamand mein thay , unn kamzoron say poocha jo emaan ley aaye thay kay :  kiya tumhen iss baat ka yaqeen hai kay saleh apney rab ki taraf say bhejay huye payghumber hain-?  unhon ney kaha kay :  beyshak hum to uss paygham per poora emaan rakhtay hain jo unn kay zariye bheja gaya hai

verses.text: woh maghroor log kehney lagay :  jiss paygham per tum emaan laye ho , uss kay to hum sabb munkir hain .
verses.translation: woh maghroor log kehney lagay :  jiss paygham per tum emaan laye ho , uss kay to hum sabb munkir hain .

verses.text: chunacheh unhon ney oontni ko maar daala , aur apney perwerdigar kay hukum say sarkashi ki , aur kaha :  saleh ! agar tum waqaee aik payghumber ho to ley aao woh ( azab ) jiss ki hamen dhamki detay ho !
verses.translation: chunacheh unhon ney oontni ko maar daala , aur apney perwerdigar kay hukum say sarkashi ki , aur kaha :  saleh ! agar tum waqaee aik payghumber ho to ley aao woh ( azab ) jiss ki hamen dhamki detay ho !

verses.text: nateeja yeh huwa kay unhen zalzalay ney aa-pakra , aur woh apney ghar mein ondhay parray reh gaye .
verses.translation: nateeja yeh huwa kay unhen zalzalay ney aa-pakra , aur woh apney ghar mein ondhay parray reh gaye .

verses.text: iss moaqa per saleh unn say mun morr ker chal diye , aur kehney lagay :  aey meri qoam ! mein ney tumhen apney rab ka paygham phonchaya , aur tumhari khair khuwahi ki , magar ( afsos kay ) tum khair khuwahon ko pasand hi nahi kertay thay
verses.translation: iss moaqa per saleh unn say mun morr ker chal diye , aur kehney lagay :  aey meri qoam ! mein ney tumhen apney rab ka paygham phonchaya , aur tumhari khair khuwahi ki , magar ( afsos kay ) tum khair khuwahon ko pasand hi nahi kertay thay

verses.text: aur hum ney loot ko bheja , ,   jab uss ney apni qoam say kaha :  kiya tum uss bey hayai ka irtikab kertay ho jo tum say pehlay duniya jahan kay kissi shaks ney nahi ki ?
verses.translation: aur hum ney loot ko bheja , ,   jab uss ney apni qoam say kaha :  kiya tum uss bey hayai ka irtikab kertay ho jo tum say pehlay duniya jahan kay kissi shaks ney nahi ki ?

verses.text: tum jinsi hawas poori kernay kay liye aurton kay bajaye mardon kay paas jatay ho . ( aur yeh koi ittifaqi waqiaa nahi , ) balkay tum aesay log ho kay ( sharafat ki ) tamam haden phalang chukay ho .
verses.translation: tum jinsi hawas poori kernay kay liye aurton kay bajaye mardon kay paas jatay ho . ( aur yeh koi ittifaqi waqiaa nahi , ) balkay tum aesay log ho kay ( sharafat ki ) tamam haden phalang chukay ho .

verses.text: unn ki qoam ka jawab yeh kehney kay siwa kuch aur nahi tha kay :  nikalo inn ko apni basti say ! yeh log hain jo baray pakbaaz bantay hain !
verses.translation: unn ki qoam ka jawab yeh kehney kay siwa kuch aur nahi tha kay :  nikalo inn ko apni basti say ! yeh log hain jo baray pakbaaz bantay hain !

verses.text: phir huwa yeh kay hum ney unn ko ( yani loot aleh-assalam ko ) aur unn kay ghar walon ko ( basti say nikal ker ) bacha liya , albatta unn ki biwi thi jo baqi logon  mein shamil rahi ( jo azab ka nishana banay )
verses.translation: phir huwa yeh kay hum ney unn ko ( yani loot aleh-assalam ko ) aur unn kay ghar walon ko ( basti say nikal ker ) bacha liya , albatta unn ki biwi thi jo baqi logon  mein shamil rahi ( jo azab ka nishana banay )

verses.text: aur hum ney unn per ( pathraon ki ) aik barish barsai . abb dekho ! inn mujrimon ka anjam kaisa ( holnaak ) huwa-?
verses.translation: aur hum ney unn per ( pathraon ki ) aik barish barsai . abb dekho ! inn mujrimon ka anjam kaisa ( holnaak ) huwa-?

verses.text: aur madiyan ki taraf hum ney unn kay bhai shoaib ko bheja .   unhon ney kaha :  aey meri qoam kay logo ! Allah ki ibadat kero . uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi hai . tumharay paas tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik roshan daleel aa-chuki hai . lehaza naap tol poora poora kiya kero , aur jo cheezen logon  ki milkiyat mein hain , unn mein unn ki haq talfi naa kero .   aur zameen mein uss ki islaah kay baad fasad barpa naa kero .   logo ! yehi tareeqa tumharay liye bhalai ka hai , agar tum meri baat maan lo .
verses.translation: aur madiyan ki taraf hum ney unn kay bhai shoaib ko bheja .   unhon ney kaha :  aey meri qoam kay logo ! Allah ki ibadat kero . uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi hai . tumharay paas tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik roshan daleel aa-chuki hai . lehaza naap tol poora poora kiya kero , aur jo cheezen logon  ki milkiyat mein hain , unn mein unn ki haq talfi naa kero .   aur zameen mein uss ki islaah kay baad fasad barpa naa kero .   logo ! yehi tareeqa tumharay liye bhalai ka hai , agar tum meri baat maan lo .

verses.text: aur aisa naa kiya kero kay raaston per beth ker logon  ko dhamkiyan do , aur jo log Allah per emaan laye hain , unn ko Allah kay raastay say roko , aur uss mein tairrah peda kernay ki koshish kero . aur woh waqt yaad kero jab tum kam thay , phir Allah ney tumhen ziyada kerdiya ,   aur yeh bhi dekho kay fasad machaney walon ka anjam kaisa huwa hai .
verses.translation: aur aisa naa kiya kero kay raaston per beth ker logon  ko dhamkiyan do , aur jo log Allah per emaan laye hain , unn ko Allah kay raastay say roko , aur uss mein tairrah peda kernay ki koshish kero . aur woh waqt yaad kero jab tum kam thay , phir Allah ney tumhen ziyada kerdiya ,   aur yeh bhi dekho kay fasad machaney walon ka anjam kaisa huwa hai .

verses.text: aur agar tum mein say aik giroh uss paygham per emaan ley aaya hai jo meray zariye bheja gaya hai , aur doosra giroh emaan nahi laya , to zara uss waqt tak sabar kero jab tak Allah humaray darmiyan faisla kerday .   aur wohi sabb say behtar faisla kernay wala hai .
verses.translation: aur agar tum mein say aik giroh uss paygham per emaan ley aaya hai jo meray zariye bheja gaya hai , aur doosra giroh emaan nahi laya , to zara uss waqt tak sabar kero jab tak Allah humaray darmiyan faisla kerday .   aur wohi sabb say behtar faisla kernay wala hai .

verses.text: unn ki qoam kay sardar jo barai kay ghamand mein thay , kehney lagay :  aey shoaib ! hum ney paka irada kerliya hai kay hum tumhen aur tumharay sath tamam emaan laane walon ko apni basti say nikal bahir keren gay , werna tum sabb ko humaray deen mein wapis aana parray ga .  shoaib ney kaha :  acha agar hum ( tumharay deen say ) nafrat kertay hon , tab bhi-?
verses.translation: unn ki qoam kay sardar jo barai kay ghamand mein thay , kehney lagay :  aey shoaib ! hum ney paka irada kerliya hai kay hum tumhen aur tumharay sath tamam emaan laane walon ko apni basti say nikal bahir keren gay , werna tum sabb ko humaray deen mein wapis aana parray ga .  shoaib ney kaha :  acha agar hum ( tumharay deen say ) nafrat kertay hon , tab bhi-?

verses.text: hum Allah per jhoota bohtan baandhen gay , agar tumharay deen ki taraf loat ayen gay ,   jabkay Allah ney hamen uss say nijat dey di hai . humaray liye to yeh mumkin hi nahi hai kay uss ki taraf wapis jayen . haan Allah humara perwerdigar hi kuch chahye to aur baat hai .   humaray rab ney apney ilm say her cheez ka ehata kiya huwa hai . Allah hi per hum ney bharosa ker rakha hai . aey humaray rab ! humaray aur humari qoam kay darmiyan haq ka faisla farmadey . aur tu hi sab say behtar faisla kernay wala hai .
verses.translation: hum Allah per jhoota bohtan baandhen gay , agar tumharay deen ki taraf loat ayen gay ,   jabkay Allah ney hamen uss say nijat dey di hai . humaray liye to yeh mumkin hi nahi hai kay uss ki taraf wapis jayen . haan Allah humara perwerdigar hi kuch chahye to aur baat hai .   humaray rab ney apney ilm say her cheez ka ehata kiya huwa hai . Allah hi per hum ney bharosa ker rakha hai . aey humaray rab ! humaray aur humari qoam kay darmiyan haq ka faisla farmadey . aur tu hi sab say behtar faisla kernay wala hai .

verses.text: aur unn ki qoam kay woh sardar jinhon ney kufr apnaya huwa tha ( qoam kay logon  say ) kehney lagay :  agar tum shoaib kay peechay chalay to yaad rakho uss soorat mein tumhen sakht nuqsan uthana parray ga .
verses.translation: aur unn ki qoam kay woh sardar jinhon ney kufr apnaya huwa tha ( qoam kay logon  say ) kehney lagay :  agar tum shoaib kay peechay chalay to yaad rakho uss soorat mein tumhen sakht nuqsan uthana parray ga .

verses.text: phir huwa yeh kay unhen zalzalay ney aa-pakra ,   aur woh apney ghar mein ondhay parray reh gaye .
verses.translation: phir huwa yeh kay unhen zalzalay ney aa-pakra ,   aur woh apney ghar mein ondhay parray reh gaye .

verses.text: jinn logon  ney shoaib ko jhutlaya , woh aesay hogaye jaisay kabhi wahan basay hi nahi thay . jinn logon  ney shoaib ko jhutlaya , aakhir ko nuqsan uthaney walay wohi huye .
verses.translation: jinn logon  ney shoaib ko jhutlaya , woh aesay hogaye jaisay kabhi wahan basay hi nahi thay . jinn logon  ney shoaib ko jhutlaya , aakhir ko nuqsan uthaney walay wohi huye .

verses.text: chunacheh woh ( yani shoaib aleh-assalam ) unn say mun morr ker chal diye , aur kehney lagay :  aey qoam ! mein ney tujhay apney rab kay payghamaat phoncha diye thay , aur tera bhala chaha tha . ( magar ) abb mein uss qoam per kiya afsos kerun jo nashukri thi !
verses.translation: chunacheh woh ( yani shoaib aleh-assalam ) unn say mun morr ker chal diye , aur kehney lagay :  aey qoam ! mein ney tujhay apney rab kay payghamaat phoncha diye thay , aur tera bhala chaha tha . ( magar ) abb mein uss qoam per kiya afsos kerun jo nashukri thi !

verses.text: aur hum ney jiss kissi basti mein koi payghumber bheja , uss mein rehney walon ko bad-haali aur takleefon mein girftaar zaroor kiya , takay woh aajzi ikhtiyar keren .
verses.translation: aur hum ney jiss kissi basti mein koi payghumber bheja , uss mein rehney walon ko bad-haali aur takleefon mein girftaar zaroor kiya , takay woh aajzi ikhtiyar keren .

verses.text: phir hum ney kayfiyat badli , bad-haali ki jagah khushhali ata farmaee , yahan tak kay woh khoob phalay phoolay , aur kehney lagay kay dukh sukh to humaray baap dadon ko bhi phonchtay rahey hain . phir hum ney unhen achanak iss tarah pakar liya kay unhen ( pehlay say ) pata bhi nahi chal saka .
verses.translation: phir hum ney kayfiyat badli , bad-haali ki jagah khushhali ata farmaee , yahan tak kay woh khoob phalay phoolay , aur kehney lagay kay dukh sukh to humaray baap dadon ko bhi phonchtay rahey hain . phir hum ney unhen achanak iss tarah pakar liya kay unhen ( pehlay say ) pata bhi nahi chal saka .

verses.text: aur agar yeh bastiyon walay emaan ley aatay aur taqwa ikhtiyar kerletay to hum unn per aasman aur zameen dono taraf say barkaton kay darwazay khol detay . lekin unhon ney ( haq ko ) jhutlaya , iss liye unn ki musalsal bad-amli ki padash mein hum ney unn ko apni pakar mein ley liya .
verses.translation: aur agar yeh bastiyon walay emaan ley aatay aur taqwa ikhtiyar kerletay to hum unn per aasman aur zameen dono taraf say barkaton kay darwazay khol detay . lekin unhon ney ( haq ko ) jhutlaya , iss liye unn ki musalsal bad-amli ki padash mein hum ney unn ko apni pakar mein ley liya .

verses.text: abb batao kay kiya ( doosri ) bastiyon kay log iss baat say bilkul bey khof hogaye hain kay kissi raat humara azab unn per aesay waqt aa-parey jab woh soye huye hon-?
verses.translation: abb batao kay kiya ( doosri ) bastiyon kay log iss baat say bilkul bey khof hogaye hain kay kissi raat humara azab unn per aesay waqt aa-parey jab woh soye huye hon-?

verses.text: aur kiya unn bastiyon kay logon  ko iss baat ka ( bhi ) koi darr nahi hai kay humara azab unn per kabhi din charrhay aajaye jab woh khel kood mein lagay huye hon-?
verses.translation: aur kiya unn bastiyon kay logon  ko iss baat ka ( bhi ) koi darr nahi hai kay humara azab unn per kabhi din charrhay aajaye jab woh khel kood mein lagay huye hon-?

verses.text: bhala kiya yeh log Allah ki di hoi dheel ( kay anjam ) say bey fiker hochukay hain-?   ( agar aisa hai ) to ( yeh yaad rakhen kay ) Allah ki di hoi dheel say wohi log bey fiker ho bethtay hain jo aakhir kaar nuqsan uthaney walay hotay hain .
verses.translation: bhala kiya yeh log Allah ki di hoi dheel ( kay anjam ) say bey fiker hochukay hain-?   ( agar aisa hai ) to ( yeh yaad rakhen kay ) Allah ki di hoi dheel say wohi log bey fiker ho bethtay hain jo aakhir kaar nuqsan uthaney walay hotay hain .

verses.text: jo log kissi zameen ( kay bashindon ki halakat ) kay baad uss kay waris ban jatay hain , bhala kiya unn ko yeh sabaq nahi mila kay agar hum chahen to unn ko ( bhi ) unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say kissi museebat mein mubtala kerden-? aur ( jo log apni zidd ki wajeh say yeh sabaq nahi letay ) hum unn kay dilon per mohar laga detay hain , jiss kay nateejay mein woh koi baat nahi suntay .
verses.translation: jo log kissi zameen ( kay bashindon ki halakat ) kay baad uss kay waris ban jatay hain , bhala kiya unn ko yeh sabaq nahi mila kay agar hum chahen to unn ko ( bhi ) unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say kissi museebat mein mubtala kerden-? aur ( jo log apni zidd ki wajeh say yeh sabaq nahi letay ) hum unn kay dilon per mohar laga detay hain , jiss kay nateejay mein woh koi baat nahi suntay .

verses.text: yeh hain woh bastiyan jinn kay waqiyaat hum tumhen suna rahey hain . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn sabb kay paas inn kay payghumber khulay khulay dalaeel ley ker aaye thay , magar jiss baat ko woh pehlay jhutla chukay thay , uss per kabhi emaan laney ko tayyar nahi huye . jo log kufr ko apna chukay hotay hain , unn kay dilon per Allah issi tarah mohar laga deta hai .
verses.translation: yeh hain woh bastiyan jinn kay waqiyaat hum tumhen suna rahey hain . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn sabb kay paas inn kay payghumber khulay khulay dalaeel ley ker aaye thay , magar jiss baat ko woh pehlay jhutla chukay thay , uss per kabhi emaan laney ko tayyar nahi huye . jo log kufr ko apna chukay hotay hain , unn kay dilon per Allah issi tarah mohar laga deta hai .

verses.text: hum ney unn ki aksariyat mein ehad ki koi paasdaari nahi pai , aur waqiaa yeh hai kay unn mein say aksar logon  ko hum ney nafarman hi paya .
verses.translation: hum ney unn ki aksariyat mein ehad ki koi paasdaari nahi pai , aur waqiaa yeh hai kay unn mein say aksar logon  ko hum ney nafarman hi paya .

verses.text: phir hum ney unn sabb kay baad musa ko apni nishaniyon kay sath firon aur uss kay sardaron kay paas bheja ,   to unhon ney ( bhi ) unn ( nishaniyon ) ki zalimana na-qadri ki . abb dekho kay unn mufsidon ka anjam kaisa huwa .
verses.translation: phir hum ney unn sabb kay baad musa ko apni nishaniyon kay sath firon aur uss kay sardaron kay paas bheja ,   to unhon ney ( bhi ) unn ( nishaniyon ) ki zalimana na-qadri ki . abb dekho kay unn mufsidon ka anjam kaisa huwa .

verses.text: musa ney kaha tha kay :  aey firon ! yaqeen jano kay mein Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki taraf say payghumber ban ker aaya hun .
verses.translation: musa ney kaha tha kay :  aey firon ! yaqeen jano kay mein Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki taraf say payghumber ban ker aaya hun .

verses.text: mera farz hai kay mein Allah ki taraf mansoob ker kay haq kay siwa koi aur baat naa kahun . mein tumharay paas tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik khuli daleel ley ker aaya hun , lehaza bani Israel ko meray sath bhej do .
verses.translation: mera farz hai kay mein Allah ki taraf mansoob ker kay haq kay siwa koi aur baat naa kahun . mein tumharay paas tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik khuli daleel ley ker aaya hun , lehaza bani Israel ko meray sath bhej do .

verses.text: uss ney kaha kay :  agar tum koi nishani ley ker aaye ho to ussay paish kero , agar tum aik sachay aadmi ho .
verses.translation: uss ney kaha kay :  agar tum koi nishani ley ker aaye ho to ussay paish kero , agar tum aik sachay aadmi ho .

verses.text: iss per musa ney apni laathi phenki to achanak woh aik saaf saaf azdaha ban gaya .
verses.translation: iss per musa ney apni laathi phenki to achanak woh aik saaf saaf azdaha ban gaya .

verses.text: aur apna haath ( giraybaan say ) kheencha to woh saray dekhney walon kay samney yakayak chamakney laga .
verses.translation: aur apna haath ( giraybaan say ) kheencha to woh saray dekhney walon kay samney yakayak chamakney laga .

verses.text: firon ki qoam kay sardar ( aik doosray say ) kehney lagay kay :  yeh to yaqeeni tor per bara mahir jadoogar hai .
verses.translation: firon ki qoam kay sardar ( aik doosray say ) kehney lagay kay :  yeh to yaqeeni tor per bara mahir jadoogar hai .

verses.text: yeh chahta hai kay tumhen tumhari zameen say nikal bahir keray . abb batao tumhari kiya raye hai-?
verses.translation: yeh chahta hai kay tumhen tumhari zameen say nikal bahir keray . abb batao tumhari kiya raye hai-?

verses.text: unhon ney kaha kay :  zara iss ko aur iss kay bhai ko kuch mohlat do , aur tamam shehron mein herkaray bhej do .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha kay :  zara iss ko aur iss kay bhai ko kuch mohlat do , aur tamam shehron mein herkaray bhej do .

verses.text: takay woh tamam mahir jadoogaron ko jama ker kay tumharay paas ley ayen .
verses.translation: takay woh tamam mahir jadoogaron ko jama ker kay tumharay paas ley ayen .

verses.text: . ( chunacheh aisa hi huwa ) aur jadoogar firon kay paas aagaye ( aur ) unhon ney kaha kay :  agar hum ( musa per ) ghalib aagaye to hamen koi inaam to zaroor milay ga .
verses.translation: . ( chunacheh aisa hi huwa ) aur jadoogar firon kay paas aagaye ( aur ) unhon ney kaha kay :  agar hum ( musa per ) ghalib aagaye to hamen koi inaam to zaroor milay ga .

verses.text: firon ney kaha :  haan , aur tumhara shumar yaqeenan humaray muqarrab logon  mein ( bhi ) hoga .
verses.translation: firon ney kaha :  haan , aur tumhara shumar yaqeenan humaray muqarrab logon  mein ( bhi ) hoga .

verses.text: unhon ney ( musa say ) kaha :  musa ! chahao to ( jo phenkna chahtay ho ) tum phenko , werna hum ( apney jadoo ki cheezain ) phenken-?
verses.translation: unhon ney ( musa say ) kaha :  musa ! chahao to ( jo phenkna chahtay ho ) tum phenko , werna hum ( apney jadoo ki cheezain ) phenken-?

verses.text: musa ney kaha :  tum phenko !  chunacheh jab unhon ney ( apni lathiyan aur rassiyan ) phenken to logon  ki aankhon per jadoo kerdiya , unn per dehshat taari kerdi , aur zabardast jadoo ka muzahira kiya .
verses.translation: musa ney kaha :  tum phenko !  chunacheh jab unhon ney ( apni lathiyan aur rassiyan ) phenken to logon  ki aankhon per jadoo kerdiya , unn per dehshat taari kerdi , aur zabardast jadoo ka muzahira kiya .

verses.text: aur hum ney musa ko wahi kay zariye hukum diya kay tum apni laathi daal do . bus phir kiya tha , uss ney dekhtay hi dekhtay woh sari cheezen nigalni shuroo kerden jo unhon ney jhoot moott banai then
verses.translation: aur hum ney musa ko wahi kay zariye hukum diya kay tum apni laathi daal do . bus phir kiya tha , uss ney dekhtay hi dekhtay woh sari cheezen nigalni shuroo kerden jo unhon ney jhoot moott banai then

verses.text: iss tarah haq khul ker samney aagaya , aur unn ka bana banaya kaam malya mait hogaya .
verses.translation: iss tarah haq khul ker samney aagaya , aur unn ka bana banaya kaam malya mait hogaya .

verses.text: iss moaqa per woh maghloob huye , aur shadeed subki ki halat mein ( muqablay say ) palat ker aagaye .
verses.translation: iss moaqa per woh maghloob huye , aur shadeed subki ki halat mein ( muqablay say ) palat ker aagaye .

verses.text: aur iss waqaey ney saray jadoogaron ko bey saakhta sajday mein gira diya .
verses.translation: aur iss waqaey ney saray jadoogaron ko bey saakhta sajday mein gira diya .

verses.text: woh pukar uthay kay :  hum uss Rabb-ul-Aalameen per emaan ley aaye .
verses.translation: woh pukar uthay kay :  hum uss Rabb-ul-Aalameen per emaan ley aaye .

verses.text: jo musa aur Haroon ka rab hai .
verses.translation: jo musa aur Haroon ka rab hai .

verses.text: firon bola :  tum mere ijazat denay say pehlay hi uss shaks per emaan ley aaye . yeh zaroor koi sazish hai jo tum ney uss shehar mein mili bhugat ker kay banai hai , takay tum yahan kay rehney walon ko yahan say nikal bahir kero . acha to tumhen abhi pata chal jaye ga .

verses.text: mein ney bhi paka irada kerliya hai kay tumharay haath paon mukhalif samton say kaat daalun ga , phir tum sabb ko ikatthay sooli per latka ker rahun ga .
verses.translation: mein ney bhi paka irada kerliya hai kay tumharay haath paon mukhalif samton say kaat daalun ga , phir tum sabb ko ikatthay sooli per latka ker rahun ga .

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  yaqeen rakh kay hum ( mar ker ) apney malik hi kay paas wapis jayen gay .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  yaqeen rakh kay hum ( mar ker ) apney malik hi kay paas wapis jayen gay .

verses.text: aur tu iss kay siwa humari kiss baat say naraz hai kay jab humaray malik ki nishaniyan humaray paas aagaen to hum unn per emaan ley aaye-? aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum per sabar kay paymaney undel dey , aur hamen iss halat mein moat dey kay hum teray tabey daar hon .
verses.translation: aur tu iss kay siwa humari kiss baat say naraz hai kay jab humaray malik ki nishaniyan humaray paas aagaen to hum unn per emaan ley aaye-? aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum per sabar kay paymaney undel dey , aur hamen iss halat mein moat dey kay hum teray tabey daar hon .

verses.text: aur firon ki qoam kay sardaron ney ( firon say ) kaha :  kiya aap musa aur uss ki qoam ko khula chorr rahey hain , takay woh zameen mein fasad machayen , aur aap aur aap kay khudaon ko pus-e-pusht daal den-?    woh bola :  hum inn kay beton ko qatal keren gay aur inn ki aurton ko zinda rakhen gay aur hamen unn per poora poora qaboo hasil hai .

verses.text: musa ney apni qoam say kaha :  Allah say madad maango aur sabar say kaam lo . yaqeen rakho kay zameen Allah ki hai . woh apney bandon mein say jissay chahta hai uss ka waris bana deta hai . aur aakhri anjam perhezgaron hi kay haq mein hota hai .
verses.translation: musa ney apni qoam say kaha :  Allah say madad maango aur sabar say kaam lo . yaqeen rakho kay zameen Allah ki hai . woh apney bandon mein say jissay chahta hai uss ka waris bana deta hai . aur aakhri anjam perhezgaron hi kay haq mein hota hai .

verses.text: unhon ney kaha kay :  hamen to aap kay aaney say pehlay bhi sataya gaya tha , aur aap kay aaney kay baad bhi ( sataya jaraha hai )  musa ney kaha :  umeed rakho kay Allah tumharay dushman ko halak kerday ga , aur tumhen zameen mein uss ka janasheen bana dey ga , phir dekhay ga kay tum kaisa kaam kertay ho .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha kay :  hamen to aap kay aaney say pehlay bhi sataya gaya tha , aur aap kay aaney kay baad bhi ( sataya jaraha hai )  musa ney kaha :  umeed rakho kay Allah tumharay dushman ko halak kerday ga , aur tumhen zameen mein uss ka janasheen bana dey ga , phir dekhay ga kay tum kaisa kaam kertay ho .

verses.text: aur hum ney firon kay logon  ko qehat saali aur pedawaar ki kami mein mubtala kiya , takay unn ko tanbeeh ho .
verses.translation: aur hum ney firon kay logon  ko qehat saali aur pedawaar ki kami mein mubtala kiya , takay unn ko tanbeeh ho .

verses.text: nateeja yeh huwa kay hum ney unn say badla liya aur unhen samandar mein gharq kerdiya .   kiyonkay unhon ney humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya tha , aur unn say bilkul bey perwa hogaye thay .
verses.translation: nateeja yeh huwa kay hum ney unn say badla liya aur unhen samandar mein gharq kerdiya .   kiyonkay unhon ney humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya tha , aur unn say bilkul bey perwa hogaye thay .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ko kamzor samjha jata tha , hum ney unhen uss sarzameen kay mashriq o maghrib ka waris bana diya jiss per hum ney barkaten nazil ki then .   aur bani Israel kay haq mein tumharay rab ka kalma khair poora huwa , kiyonkay unhon ney sabar say kaam liya tha . aur firon aur uss ki qoam jo kuch banati charrhati rahi thi ,   uss sabb ko hum ney malya mait kerdiya .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ko kamzor samjha jata tha , hum ney unhen uss sarzameen kay mashriq o maghrib ka waris bana diya jiss per hum ney barkaten nazil ki then .   aur bani Israel kay haq mein tumharay rab ka kalma khair poora huwa , kiyonkay unhon ney sabar say kaam liya tha . aur firon aur uss ki qoam jo kuch banati charrhati rahi thi ,   uss sabb ko hum ney malya mait kerdiya .

verses.text: aur hum ney bani Israel say samandar paar kerwaya , to woh kuch logon  kay paas say guzray jo apney button say lagay bethay thay . bani Israel kehney lagay :  aey musa ! humaray liye bhi koi aisa hi deota bana do jaisay inn logon  kay deota hain .    musa ney kaha :  tum aesay ( ajeeb ) log ho jo jihalat ki baaten kertay ho .
verses.translation: aur hum ney bani Israel say samandar paar kerwaya , to woh kuch logon  kay paas say guzray jo apney button say lagay bethay thay . bani Israel kehney lagay :  aey musa ! humaray liye bhi koi aisa hi deota bana do jaisay inn logon  kay deota hain .    musa ney kaha :  tum aesay ( ajeeb ) log ho jo jihalat ki baaten kertay ho .

verses.text: aray yeh log to woh hain kay jiss dhanday mein lagay huye hain , sabb barbad honey wala hai , aur jo kuch kertay aarahey hain , sabb batil hai .
verses.translation: aray yeh log to woh hain kay jiss dhanday mein lagay huye hain , sabb barbad honey wala hai , aur jo kuch kertay aarahey hain , sabb batil hai .

verses.text: . ( aur ) kaha kay :  kiya tumharay liye Allah kay siwa koi aur mabood dhoond ker laon ? halankay ussi ney tumhen duniya jahan kay saray logon  per fazilat dey rakhi hai !
verses.translation: . ( aur ) kaha kay :  kiya tumharay liye Allah kay siwa koi aur mabood dhoond ker laon ? halankay ussi ney tumhen duniya jahan kay saray logon  per fazilat dey rakhi hai !

verses.text: aur ( Allah farmata hai kay ) yaad kero kay hum ney tumhen firon kay logon  say bachaya hai jo tumhen bad-tareen takleefen phonchatay thay . tumharay beton ko qatal ker daaltay thay , aur tumhari aurton ko zinda chorr detay thay . aur uss mein tumharay rab ki taraf say bari aazmaesh thi .
verses.translation: aur ( Allah farmata hai kay ) yaad kero kay hum ney tumhen firon kay logon  say bachaya hai jo tumhen bad-tareen takleefen phonchatay thay . tumharay beton ko qatal ker daaltay thay , aur tumhari aurton ko zinda chorr detay thay . aur uss mein tumharay rab ki taraf say bari aazmaesh thi .

verses.text: aur hum ney musa say tees raaton ka wada thehraya ( kay unn raaton mein koh-e-toor per aa-ker aetikaf keren ) , phir das raaten mazeed barha ker unn ki takmeel ki ,   aur iss tarah unn kay rab ki thehrai hoi miyaad kul chaalees raaten hogaee . aur musa ney apney bhai Haroon say kaha kay :  meray peechay tum meri qoam mein meray qaeem maqam ban jana , tamam moamlaat durust rakhna aur mufsid logon  kay peechay naa chalna .
verses.translation: aur hum ney musa say tees raaton ka wada thehraya ( kay unn raaton mein koh-e-toor per aa-ker aetikaf keren ) , phir das raaten mazeed barha ker unn ki takmeel ki ,   aur iss tarah unn kay rab ki thehrai hoi miyaad kul chaalees raaten hogaee . aur musa ney apney bhai Haroon say kaha kay :  meray peechay tum meri qoam mein meray qaeem maqam ban jana , tamam moamlaat durust rakhna aur mufsid logon  kay peechay naa chalna .

verses.text: aur jab musa humaray muqarrara waqt per phonchay aur unn ka rab unn say hum kalam huwa , to woh kehney lagay :  meray perwerdigar ! mujhay deedar kera dijiye kay mein aap ko dekh lun .  farmaya :  tum mujhay hergiz nahi dekh sako gay , albatta pahar ki taraf nazar uthao , uss kay baad agar woh apni jagah barqarar raha to tum mujhay dekh lo gay .    phir jab unn kay rab ney pahar per tajalli farmaee to uss ko reza reza kerdiya , aur musa bey hosh ho ker gir parray . baad mein jab unhen hosh aaya to unhon ney kaha :  pak hai aap ki zaat ! mein aap kay huzoor tauba kerta hun , aur ( aap ki iss baat per kay duniya mein koi aap ko nahi dekh sakta ) mein sabb say pehlay emaan lata hun .
verses.translation: aur jab musa humaray muqarrara waqt per phonchay aur unn ka rab unn say hum kalam huwa , to woh kehney lagay :  meray perwerdigar ! mujhay deedar kera dijiye kay mein aap ko dekh lun .  farmaya :  tum mujhay hergiz nahi dekh sako gay , albatta pahar ki taraf nazar uthao , uss kay baad agar woh apni jagah barqarar raha to tum mujhay dekh lo gay .    phir jab unn kay rab ney pahar per tajalli farmaee to uss ko reza reza kerdiya , aur musa bey hosh ho ker gir parray . baad mein jab unhen hosh aaya to unhon ney kaha :  pak hai aap ki zaat ! mein aap kay huzoor tauba kerta hun , aur ( aap ki iss baat per kay duniya mein koi aap ko nahi dekh sakta ) mein sabb say pehlay emaan lata hun .

verses.text: farmaya :  aey musa ! mein ney apney paygham dey ker aur tum say hum kalam ho ker tumhen tamam insanon per foqiyat di hai . lehaza mein ney jo kuch tumhen diya hai , ussay ley lo , aur aik shukar guzaar shaks ban jao .
verses.translation: farmaya :  aey musa ! mein ney apney paygham dey ker aur tum say hum kalam ho ker tumhen tamam insanon per foqiyat di hai . lehaza mein ney jo kuch tumhen diya hai , ussay ley lo , aur aik shukar guzaar shaks ban jao .

verses.text: aur hum ney unn kay liye takhtiyon mein her qisam ki naseehat aur her cheez ki tafseel likh di , ( aur yeh hukum diya kay : )  abb iss ko mazbooti say thaam lo , aur apni qoam ko hukum do kay iss kay behtareen ehkaam per amal keren .   mein unqareeb tum ko nafarmano ka ghar dikha dun ga .
verses.translation: aur hum ney unn kay liye takhtiyon mein her qisam ki naseehat aur her cheez ki tafseel likh di , ( aur yeh hukum diya kay : )  abb iss ko mazbooti say thaam lo , aur apni qoam ko hukum do kay iss kay behtareen ehkaam per amal keren .   mein unqareeb tum ko nafarmano ka ghar dikha dun ga .

verses.text: mein apni nishaniyon say unn logon  ko bargushta rakhun ga jo zameen mein nahaq takabbur kertay hain , aur woh agar her tarah ki nishaniyan dekh len to unn per emaan nahi layen gay . aur agar unhen hidayat ka seedha raasta nazar aaye , to uss ko apna tareeqa nahi banayen gay , aur agar gumrahi ka raasta nazar aajaye to uss ko apna tareeqa bana len gay . yeh sabb kuch iss liye hai kay unhon ney humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya , aur unn say bilkul bey perwa hogaye .
verses.translation: mein apni nishaniyon say unn logon  ko bargushta rakhun ga jo zameen mein nahaq takabbur kertay hain , aur woh agar her tarah ki nishaniyan dekh len to unn per emaan nahi layen gay . aur agar unhen hidayat ka seedha raasta nazar aaye , to uss ko apna tareeqa nahi banayen gay , aur agar gumrahi ka raasta nazar aajaye to uss ko apna tareeqa bana len gay . yeh sabb kuch iss liye hai kay unhon ney humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya , aur unn say bilkul bey perwa hogaye .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney humari nishaniyon ko aur aakhirat ka samna kernay ko jhutlaya hai , unn kay aemal gharat hogaye hain . unhen jo badla diya jaye ga , woh kissi aur cheez ka nahi , khud unn aemal ka hoga jo woh kertay aaye thay .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney humari nishaniyon ko aur aakhirat ka samna kernay ko jhutlaya hai , unn kay aemal gharat hogaye hain . unhen jo badla diya jaye ga , woh kissi aur cheez ka nahi , khud unn aemal ka hoga jo woh kertay aaye thay .

verses.text: aur musa ki qoam ney unn kay janey kay baad apney zewaron say aik bachrra bana liya ( bachrra kiya tha-? ) aik bey jaan jism jiss say bail ki si aawaz nikalti thi !   bhala kiya unhon ney itna bhi nahi dekha kay woh naa unn say baat ker-sakta hai , aur naa unhen koi raasta bata sakta hai-? ( magar ) ussay mabood bana liya , aur ( khud apni janon kay liye ) zalim ban bethay .

verses.text: aur jab apney kiye per pachtaye , aur samajh gaye kay woh gumrah hogaye hain to kehney lagay :  agar Allah ney hum per reham naa farmaya , aur humari bakhshish naa ki to yaqeenan hum barbad hojayen gay .
verses.translation: aur jab apney kiye per pachtaye , aur samajh gaye kay woh gumrah hogaye hain to kehney lagay :  agar Allah ney hum per reham naa farmaya , aur humari bakhshish naa ki to yaqeenan hum barbad hojayen gay .

verses.text: musa ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! meri aur meray bhai ki maghfirat farmadey , aur hamen apni rehmat mein dakhil kerday . tu tamam reham kernay walon say barh ker reham kernay wala hai .
verses.translation: musa ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! meri aur meray bhai ki maghfirat farmadey , aur hamen apni rehmat mein dakhil kerday . tu tamam reham kernay walon say barh ker reham kernay wala hai .

( zahir hai kay nahi . lehaza pata chala kay ) yeh waqiaa aap ki taraf say sirf aik imtihan hai jiss kay zariye aap jiss ko chahen , gumrah kerden , aur jiss ko chahen hidayat dey den . aap hi humaray rakhwalay hain . iss liye hamen moaaf ker-dijiye , aur hum per reham farmaiye . beyshak aap saray moaaf kernay walon say behtar moaaf kernay walay hain .
