Allah ney farmaya :  apna azab to mein ussi per nazil kerta hun jiss per chahta hun . aur jahan tak meri rehmat ka talluq hai woh her cheez per chai hoi hai .   chunacheh mein yeh rehmat ( mukammal tor per ) unn logon  kay liye likhun ga jo taqwa ikhtiyar keren , aur zakat ada keren , aur jo humari aayaton per emaan rakhen .
verses.translation: aur humaray liye iss duniya mein bhi bhalai likh dijiye , aur aakhirat mein bhi . hum ( iss gharz kay liye ) aap hi say rujoo kertay hain .  Allah ney farmaya :  apna azab to mein ussi per nazil kerta hun jiss per chahta hun . aur jahan tak meri rehmat ka talluq hai woh her cheez per chai hoi hai .   chunacheh mein yeh rehmat ( mukammal tor per ) unn logon  kay liye likhun ga jo taqwa ikhtiyar keren , aur zakat ada keren , aur jo humari aayaton per emaan rakhen .

verses.text: jo uss Rasool , yani nabi ummi kay peechay chalen jiss ka ziker woh apney paas toraat aur injeel mein likha huwa payen gay ,   jo unhen achi baaton ka hukum dey ga , buraiyon say rokay ga , aur unn kay liye pakeezah cheezon ko halal aur gandi cheezon ko haram qarar dey ga , aur unn per say woh bojh aur galay kay woh toq utaar dey ga jo unn per laday huye thay .   chunacheh jo log uss ( nabi ) per emaan layen gay ,uss ki taazeem keren gay uss ki madad keren gay , aur uss kay sath jo noor utaara gaya hai , uss kay peechay chalen gay , to wohi log falah paaney walay hon gay .
verses.translation: jo uss Rasool , yani nabi ummi kay peechay chalen jiss ka ziker woh apney paas toraat aur injeel mein likha huwa payen gay ,   jo unhen achi baaton ka hukum dey ga , buraiyon say rokay ga , aur unn kay liye pakeezah cheezon ko halal aur gandi cheezon ko haram qarar dey ga , aur unn per say woh bojh aur galay kay woh toq utaar dey ga jo unn per laday huye thay .   chunacheh jo log uss ( nabi ) per emaan layen gay ,uss ki taazeem keren gay uss ki madad keren gay , aur uss kay sath jo noor utaara gaya hai , uss kay peechay chalen gay , to wohi log falah paaney walay hon gay .

verses.text: . ( aey Rasool ! inn say ) kaho kay :  aey logo ! mein tum sabb ki taraf uss Allah ka bheja huwa Rasool hun   jiss kay qabazay mein tamam aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat hai . uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . wohi zindagi aur moat deta hai . abb tum Allah per aur uss kay Rasool per emaan ley aao jo nabi ummi hai , aur jo Allah per aur uss kay kalmaat per emaan rakhta hai , aur uss ki perwi kero , takay tumhen hidayat hasil ho .
verses.translation: . ( aey Rasool ! inn say ) kaho kay :  aey logo ! mein tum sabb ki taraf uss Allah ka bheja huwa Rasool hun   jiss kay qabazay mein tamam aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat hai . uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . wohi zindagi aur moat deta hai . abb tum Allah per aur uss kay Rasool per emaan ley aao jo nabi ummi hai , aur jo Allah per aur uss kay kalmaat per emaan rakhta hai , aur uss ki perwi kero , takay tumhen hidayat hasil ho .

verses.text: aur musa ki qoam mein aik jamat aesi bhi hai jo logon  ko haq ka raasta dikhati hai , aur ussi ( haq ) kay mutabiq insaf say kaam leti hai .
verses.translation: aur musa ki qoam mein aik jamat aesi bhi hai jo logon  ko haq ka raasta dikhati hai , aur ussi ( haq ) kay mutabiq insaf say kaam leti hai .

verses.text: aur hum ney unn ko ( yani bani Israel ko ) baara khandano mein iss tarah taqseem kerdiya tha kay woh alag alag ( intizami ) jamaton ki soorat ikhtiyar ker gaye thay . aur jab musa ki qoam ney unn say paani maanga to hum ney unn ko wahi kay zariye hukum diya kay apni laathi falan pathar per maaro .   chunacheh uss pathar say baara chashmay phoot parray . her khandan ko apni paani peenay ki jagah maloom hogaee . aur hum ney unn ko badal ka saya diya , aur hum ney unn per mann-o-salwa ( yeh keh ker ) utaara kay :  khao woh pakeezah rizq jo hum ney tumhen diya hai .  aur ( iss kay bawajood unhon ney jo nashukri ki to ) unhon ney humara koi nuqsan nahi kiya , balkay woh khud apni janon per zulm kertay rahey .
verses.translation: aur hum ney unn ko ( yani bani Israel ko ) baara khandano mein iss tarah taqseem kerdiya tha kay woh alag alag ( intizami ) jamaton ki soorat ikhtiyar ker gaye thay . aur jab musa ki qoam ney unn say paani maanga to hum ney unn ko wahi kay zariye hukum diya kay apni laathi falan pathar per maaro .   chunacheh uss pathar say baara chashmay phoot parray . her khandan ko apni paani peenay ki jagah maloom hogaee . aur hum ney unn ko badal ka saya diya , aur hum ney unn per mann-o-salwa ( yeh keh ker ) utaara kay :  khao woh pakeezah rizq jo hum ney tumhen diya hai .  aur ( iss kay bawajood unhon ney jo nashukri ki to ) unhon ney humara koi nuqsan nahi kiya , balkay woh khud apni janon per zulm kertay rahey .

verses.text: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab unn say kaha gaya tha kay :  uss basti mein jaker bus jao , aur uss mein jahan say chahao khao , aur yeh kehtay jana kay ( ya Allah ! ) hum aap ki bakhshish kay talab gaar hain , aur ( basti kay ) darwazay mein jhukay huye saron kay sath dakhil hona , to hum tumhari khatayen moaaf kerden gay , ( aur ) naiki kernay walon ko aur ziyada ( sawab ) bhi den gay .
verses.translation: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab unn say kaha gaya tha kay :  uss basti mein jaker bus jao , aur uss mein jahan say chahao khao , aur yeh kehtay jana kay ( ya Allah ! ) hum aap ki bakhshish kay talab gaar hain , aur ( basti kay ) darwazay mein jhukay huye saron kay sath dakhil hona , to hum tumhari khatayen moaaf kerden gay , ( aur ) naiki kernay walon ko aur ziyada ( sawab ) bhi den gay .

verses.text: phir huwa yeh kay jo baat unn say kahi gaee thi , unn mein say zalim logon  ney ussay badal ker doosri baat bana li . tab hum ney unn ki musalsal ziyadtiyon ki wajeh say unn per aasman say azab bheja .
verses.translation: phir huwa yeh kay jo baat unn say kahi gaee thi , unn mein say zalim logon  ney ussay badal ker doosri baat bana li . tab hum ney unn ki musalsal ziyadtiyon ki wajeh say unn per aasman say azab bheja .

verses.text: aur unn say uss basti kay baaray mein poocho jo samandar kay kinaray abad thi , jab woh sabt ( saneechar ) kay moamlay mein ziyadtiyan kertay thay .   jab unn ( kay samandar ) ki machliyan saneechar kay din to uchal uchal ker samney aati then , aur jab woh saneechar ka din naa mana rahey hotay , to woh nahi aati then . iss tarah unn ki musalsal nafarmaniyon ki wajeh say hum unhen aazmatay thay .
verses.translation: aur unn say uss basti kay baaray mein poocho jo samandar kay kinaray abad thi , jab woh sabt ( saneechar ) kay moamlay mein ziyadtiyan kertay thay .   jab unn ( kay samandar ) ki machliyan saneechar kay din to uchal uchal ker samney aati then , aur jab woh saneechar ka din naa mana rahey hotay , to woh nahi aati then . iss tarah unn ki musalsal nafarmaniyon ki wajeh say hum unhen aazmatay thay .

verses.text: aur ( woh waqt unhen yaad dilao ) jab unhi kay aik giroh ney ( doosray giroh say ) kaha tha kay :  tum unn logon  ko kiyon naseehat ker rahey ho jinhen Allah ya to halak kernay wala hai , ya koi sakht qisam ka azab denay wala hai ?    doosray giroh kay logon  ney kaha kay :  yeh hum iss liye kertay hain takay tumharay rab kay huzoor bari-uz-zimma hosaken , aur shayad iss ( naseehat say ) yeh log perhezgari ikhtiyar kerlen .
verses.translation: aur ( woh waqt unhen yaad dilao ) jab unhi kay aik giroh ney ( doosray giroh say ) kaha tha kay :  tum unn logon  ko kiyon naseehat ker rahey ho jinhen Allah ya to halak kernay wala hai , ya koi sakht qisam ka azab denay wala hai ?    doosray giroh kay logon  ney kaha kay :  yeh hum iss liye kertay hain takay tumharay rab kay huzoor bari-uz-zimma hosaken , aur shayad iss ( naseehat say ) yeh log perhezgari ikhtiyar kerlen .

verses.text: phir jab yeh log woh baat bhula bethay jiss ki unhen naseehat ki gaee thi to burai say rokney walon ko to hum ney bacha liya , aur jinhon ney ziyadtiyan ki then , unn ki musalsal nafarmani ki bana per hum ney unhen aik sakht azab mein pakar liya .
verses.translation: phir jab yeh log woh baat bhula bethay jiss ki unhen naseehat ki gaee thi to burai say rokney walon ko to hum ney bacha liya , aur jinhon ney ziyadtiyan ki then , unn ki musalsal nafarmani ki bana per hum ney unhen aik sakht azab mein pakar liya .

verses.text: chunacheh huwa yeh kay jiss kaam say unhen roka gaya tha , jab unhon ney uss kay khilaf sarkashi ki to hum ney unn say kaha :  jao , zaleel bandar ban jao .
verses.translation: chunacheh huwa yeh kay jiss kaam say unhen roka gaya tha , jab unhon ney uss kay khilaf sarkashi ki to hum ney unn say kaha :  jao , zaleel bandar ban jao .

verses.text: aur ( yaad kero woh waqt ) jab tumharay rab ney aelaan kiya kay woh unn per qayamat kay din tak koi naa koi aisa shaks musallat kerta rahey ga jo unn ko buri buri takleefen phonchaye ga .   beyshak tumhara rab jald hi saza denay wala bhi hai , aur yaqeenan woh boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban bhi hai .
verses.translation: aur ( yaad kero woh waqt ) jab tumharay rab ney aelaan kiya kay woh unn per qayamat kay din tak koi naa koi aisa shaks musallat kerta rahey ga jo unn ko buri buri takleefen phonchaye ga .   beyshak tumhara rab jald hi saza denay wala bhi hai , aur yaqeenan woh boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban bhi hai .

verses.text: aur hum ney duniya mein unn ko mukhtalif jamaton mein baant diya . chunacheh unn mein naik log bhi thay , aur kuch doosri tarah kay log bhi . aur hum ney unhen achay aur buray halaat say aazmaya , takay woh ( raah-e-raast ki taraf ) loat ayen .
verses.translation: aur hum ney duniya mein unn ko mukhtalif jamaton mein baant diya . chunacheh unn mein naik log bhi thay , aur kuch doosri tarah kay log bhi . aur hum ney unhen achay aur buray halaat say aazmaya , takay woh ( raah-e-raast ki taraf ) loat ayen .

verses.text: phir unn kay baad unn ki jagah aesay janasheen aaye jo kitab ( yani toraat ) kay waris banay , magar unn ka haal yeh tha kay iss/ zaleel duniya ka saz-o-saman ( rishwat mein ) letay , aur yeh kehtay kay :  humari bakhshish hojaye gi  halankay agar ussi jaisa saz-o-saman dobara unn kay paas aata to woh ussay bhi ( rishwat mein ) ley letay .   kiya unn say kitab mein mazkoor yeh ehad nahi liya gaya tha kay woh Allah ki taraf haq kay siwa koi baat mansoob naa keren-? aur uss ( kitab ) mein jo kuch likha tha , woh unhon ney ba-qaeeda parha bhi tha . aur aakhirat wala ghar unn logon  kay liye kahen behtar hai jo taqwa ikhtiyar kertay hain . ( aey yahood ! ) kiya phir bhi tum aqal say kaam nahi letay-?
verses.translation: phir unn kay baad unn ki jagah aesay janasheen aaye jo kitab ( yani toraat ) kay waris banay , magar unn ka haal yeh tha kay iss/ zaleel duniya ka saz-o-saman ( rishwat mein ) letay , aur yeh kehtay kay :  humari bakhshish hojaye gi  halankay agar ussi jaisa saz-o-saman dobara unn kay paas aata to woh ussay bhi ( rishwat mein ) ley letay .   kiya unn say kitab mein mazkoor yeh ehad nahi liya gaya tha kay woh Allah ki taraf haq kay siwa koi baat mansoob naa keren-? aur uss ( kitab ) mein jo kuch likha tha , woh unhon ney ba-qaeeda parha bhi tha . aur aakhirat wala ghar unn logon  kay liye kahen behtar hai jo taqwa ikhtiyar kertay hain . ( aey yahood ! ) kiya phir bhi tum aqal say kaam nahi letay-?

verses.text: aur jo log kitab ko mazbooti say thamtay hain , aur namaz qaeem kertay hain , to hum aesay islaah kernay walon ka ajar zaya nahi kertay .
verses.translation: aur jo log kitab ko mazbooti say thamtay hain , aur namaz qaeem kertay hain , to hum aesay islaah kernay walon ka ajar zaya nahi kertay .

verses.text: aur ( yaad kero ) jab hum ney pahar ko inn/unn kay oopper iss/uss tarah utha diya tha jaisay woh koi sayeban ho ,   aur enhen/unhen yeh gumaan hogaya tha kay woh inn/unn kay oopper girney hi wala hai , ( iss/uss waqt hum ney hukum diya tha kay : )  hum ney tumhen jo kitab di hai , ussay/issay mazbooti say thaamo , aur iss/uss ki baaton ko yaad kero , takay tum taqwa ikhtiyar ker-sako-? .
verses.translation: aur ( yaad kero ) jab hum ney pahar ko inn/unn kay oopper iss/uss tarah utha diya tha jaisay woh koi sayeban ho ,   aur enhen/unhen yeh gumaan hogaya tha kay woh inn/unn kay oopper girney hi wala hai , ( iss/uss waqt hum ney hukum diya tha kay : )  hum ney tumhen jo kitab di hai , ussay/issay mazbooti say thaamo , aur iss/uss ki baaton ko yaad kero , takay tum taqwa ikhtiyar ker-sako-? .

verses.text: aur ( aey Rasool ! logon  ko woh waqt yaad dilao ) jab tumharay perwerdigar ney Adam kay beton ki pusht say unn ki sari aulad ko nikala tha , aur unn ko khud apney oopper gawah banaya tha , ( aur poocha tha kay : )  kiya mein tumhara rab nahi hun-?  sabb ney jawab diya tha kay :  kiyon nahi-? hum sabb iss baat ki gawahi detay hain .    ( aur yeh iqrar hum ney iss liye liya tha ) takay tum qayamat kay din yeh naa keh sako kay :  hum to iss baat say bey khabar thay .
verses.translation: aur ( aey Rasool ! logon  ko woh waqt yaad dilao ) jab tumharay perwerdigar ney Adam kay beton ki pusht say unn ki sari aulad ko nikala tha , aur unn ko khud apney oopper gawah banaya tha , ( aur poocha tha kay : )  kiya mein tumhara rab nahi hun-?  sabb ney jawab diya tha kay :  kiyon nahi-? hum sabb iss baat ki gawahi detay hain .    ( aur yeh iqrar hum ney iss liye liya tha ) takay tum qayamat kay din yeh naa keh sako kay :  hum to iss baat say bey khabar thay .

verses.text: ya yeh naa keh do kay :  shirk ( ka aaghaz ) to boht pehlay humaray baap dadon ney kiya tha , aur hum unn kay baad unhi ki aulad banay . to kiya aap hamen unn kamon ki wajeh say halak kerden gay jo ghalat kaar logon  ney kiye thay ?
verses.translation: ya yeh naa keh do kay :  shirk ( ka aaghaz ) to boht pehlay humaray baap dadon ney kiya tha , aur hum unn kay baad unhi ki aulad banay . to kiya aap hamen unn kamon ki wajeh say halak kerden gay jo ghalat kaar logon  ney kiye thay ?

verses.text: aur issi tarah hum nishaniyon ko tafseel say biyan kertay hain , takay log ( haq ki taraf ) palat ayen .
verses.translation: aur issi tarah hum nishaniyon ko tafseel say biyan kertay hain , takay log ( haq ki taraf ) palat ayen .

verses.text: aur ( aey Rasool ! ) inn ko uss shaks ka waqiaa parh ker sunao jiss ko hum ney apni aayaten ata farmayen magar woh unn ko bilkul hi chorr nikla , phir shetan uss kay peechay laga , jiss ka nateeja yeh huwa kay woh gumrah logon  mein shamil hogaya .
verses.translation: aur ( aey Rasool ! ) inn ko uss shaks ka waqiaa parh ker sunao jiss ko hum ney apni aayaten ata farmayen magar woh unn ko bilkul hi chorr nikla , phir shetan uss kay peechay laga , jiss ka nateeja yeh huwa kay woh gumrah logon  mein shamil hogaya .

verses.text: aur agar hum chahtay to inn aayaton ki badolat ussay sarbuland kertay , magar woh to zameen hi ki taraf jhuk ker reh gaya , aur apni khuwaishaat kay peechay parra raha , iss liye uss ki misal uss kuttay ki si hogaee kay agar tum uss per hamla kero tab bhi woh zaban latka ker haanpay ga , aur agar ussay ( uss kay haal per ) chorr do tab bhi zaban latka ker haanpay ga .   yeh hai misal unn logon  ki jinhon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai . lehaza tum yeh waqiyaat unn ko sunatay raho , takay yeh kuch sochen .
verses.translation: aur agar hum chahtay to inn aayaton ki badolat ussay sarbuland kertay , magar woh to zameen hi ki taraf jhuk ker reh gaya , aur apni khuwaishaat kay peechay parra raha , iss liye uss ki misal uss kuttay ki si hogaee kay agar tum uss per hamla kero tab bhi woh zaban latka ker haanpay ga , aur agar ussay ( uss kay haal per ) chorr do tab bhi zaban latka ker haanpay ga .   yeh hai misal unn logon  ki jinhon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai . lehaza tum yeh waqiyaat unn ko sunatay raho , takay yeh kuch sochen .

verses.text: kitni buri misal hai unn logon  ki jinhon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , aur jo apni janon per zulm kertay rahey hain !
verses.translation: kitni buri misal hai unn logon  ki jinhon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , aur jo apni janon per zulm kertay rahey hain !

verses.text: jissay Allah hidayat dey , bus wohi hidayat yafta hota hai , aur jissay woh gumrah kerday , to aesay hi log hain jo nuqsan uthatay hain .
verses.translation: jissay Allah hidayat dey , bus wohi hidayat yafta hota hai , aur jissay woh gumrah kerday , to aesay hi log hain jo nuqsan uthatay hain .

verses.text: aur hum ney jinnaat aur insanon mein say boht say log jahannum kay liye peda kiye .   unn kay paas dil hain jinn say woh samajhtay nahi , unn kay paas aankhen hain jinn say woh dekhtay nahi , aur unn kay paas kaan hain jinn say woh suntay nahi . woh log chopayo ki tarah hain , balkay woh unn say bhi ziyada bhatkay huye hain . yehi log hain jo ghaflat mein parray huye hain .
verses.translation: aur hum ney jinnaat aur insanon mein say boht say log jahannum kay liye peda kiye .   unn kay paas dil hain jinn say woh samajhtay nahi , unn kay paas aankhen hain jinn say woh dekhtay nahi , aur unn kay paas kaan hain jinn say woh suntay nahi . woh log chopayo ki tarah hain , balkay woh unn say bhi ziyada bhatkay huye hain . yehi log hain jo ghaflat mein parray huye hain .

verses.text: aur asmaye hussna ( achay achay naam ) Allah hi kay hain . lehaza uss ko unhi naamon say pukaro ,   aur unn logon  ko chorr do jo uss kay naamon mein tairrah raasta ikhtiyar kertay hain .   woh jo kuch ker rahey hain , uss ka badla unhen diya jaye ga .
verses.translation: aur asmaye hussna ( achay achay naam ) Allah hi kay hain . lehaza uss ko unhi naamon say pukaro ,   aur unn logon  ko chorr do jo uss kay naamon mein tairrah raasta ikhtiyar kertay hain .   woh jo kuch ker rahey hain , uss ka badla unhen diya jaye ga .

verses.text: aur humari makhlooq mein aik jamat aesi bhi hai jo logon  ko haq ka raasta dikhati hai , aur ussi ( haq ) kay mutabiq insaf say kaam leti hai .
verses.translation: aur humari makhlooq mein aik jamat aesi bhi hai jo logon  ko haq ka raasta dikhati hai , aur ussi ( haq ) kay mutabiq insaf say kaam leti hai .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , unhen hum iss tarah dheeray dheeray pakar mein len gay kay unhen pata bhi nahi chalay ga .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , unhen hum iss tarah dheeray dheeray pakar mein len gay kay unhen pata bhi nahi chalay ga .

verses.text: aur mein unn ko dheel deta hun , yaqeen jano kay meri khufiya tadbeer bari mazboot hai .
verses.translation: aur mein unn ko dheel deta hun , yaqeen jano kay meri khufiya tadbeer bari mazboot hai .

verses.text: bhala kiya inn logon  ney socha nahi kay yeh sahab jinn say inn ka sabiqa hai , ( yani aan-Hazrat SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) inn mein junoon ka koi shayeba nahi hai . woh aur kuch nahi , balkay saaf saaf tareeqay say logon  ko mutanabeh kernay walay hain .
verses.translation: bhala kiya inn logon  ney socha nahi kay yeh sahab jinn say inn ka sabiqa hai , ( yani aan-Hazrat SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) inn mein junoon ka koi shayeba nahi hai . woh aur kuch nahi , balkay saaf saaf tareeqay say logon  ko mutanabeh kernay walay hain .

verses.text: aur kiya inn logon  ney aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat per aur Allah ney jo jo cheezen peda ki hain unn per ghor nahi kiya , aur yeh ( nahi socha ) kay shayad unn ka muqarrara waqt qareeb hi aa-phoncha ho-? abb iss kay baad aakhir woh konsi baat hai jiss per yeh emaan layen gay ?
verses.translation: aur kiya inn logon  ney aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat per aur Allah ney jo jo cheezen peda ki hain unn per ghor nahi kiya , aur yeh ( nahi socha ) kay shayad unn ka muqarrara waqt qareeb hi aa-phoncha ho-? abb iss kay baad aakhir woh konsi baat hai jiss per yeh emaan layen gay ?

verses.text: jiss ko Allah gumrah kerday , uss ko koi hidayat nahi dey sakta , aur aesay logon  ko Allah ( bey-yaro-madadgaar ) chorr deta hai kay woh apni sarkashi mein bhataktay phiren .
verses.translation: jiss ko Allah gumrah kerday , uss ko koi hidayat nahi dey sakta , aur aesay logon  ko Allah ( bey-yaro-madadgaar ) chorr deta hai kay woh apni sarkashi mein bhataktay phiren .

verses.text: . ( aey Rasool ! ) log tum say qayamat kay baaray mein poochtay hain kay woh kab barpa hogi-? keh do kay :  uss ka ilm to sirf meray rab kay paas hai . wohi ussay apney waqt per khol ker dikhaye ga , koi aur nahi . woh aasmano aur zameen mein bari bhari cheez hai , jab aaye gi to tumharay paas achanak aajaye gi .  yeh log tum say iss tarah poochtay hain jaisay tum ney uss ki poori tehqeeq ker rakhi hai . keh do kay :  uss ka ilm sirf Allah kay paas hai , lekin aksar log ( iss baat ko ) nahi jantay .
verses.translation: . ( aey Rasool ! ) log tum say qayamat kay baaray mein poochtay hain kay woh kab barpa hogi-? keh do kay :  uss ka ilm to sirf meray rab kay paas hai . wohi ussay apney waqt per khol ker dikhaye ga , koi aur nahi . woh aasmano aur zameen mein bari bhari cheez hai , jab aaye gi to tumharay paas achanak aajaye gi .  yeh log tum say iss tarah poochtay hain jaisay tum ney uss ki poori tehqeeq ker rakhi hai . keh do kay :  uss ka ilm sirf Allah kay paas hai , lekin aksar log ( iss baat ko ) nahi jantay .

verses.text: kaho kay :  jab tak Allah naa chahye , mein khud apney aap ko bhi koi nafaa ya nuqsan phonchaney ka ikhtiyar nahi rakhta , aur agar mujhay ghaib ka ilm hota to mein achi achi cheezen khoob jama kerta , aur mujhay kabhi koi takleef hi naa phonchti .   mein to bus aik hoshiyar kernay wala aur khushkhabri sunaney wala hun , unn logon  kay liye jo meri baat maanen .
verses.translation: kaho kay :  jab tak Allah naa chahye , mein khud apney aap ko bhi koi nafaa ya nuqsan phonchaney ka ikhtiyar nahi rakhta , aur agar mujhay ghaib ka ilm hota to mein achi achi cheezen khoob jama kerta , aur mujhay kabhi koi takleef hi naa phonchti .   mein to bus aik hoshiyar kernay wala aur khushkhabri sunaney wala hun , unn logon  kay liye jo meri baat maanen .

verses.text: Allah woh hai jiss ney tumhen aik jaan say peda kiya , aur ussi say uss ki biwi banai , takay woh uss kay paas aa-ker taskeen hasil keray .   phir jab mard ney aurat ko dhaank liya to aurat ney hamal ka aik halka saa bojh utha liya , jissay ley ker woh chalti phirti rahi .   phir jab woh bojhal hogaee to dono ( miyan biwi ) ney apney perwerdigar Allah say dua ki kay :  agar tu ney hamen tandurust aulad di to hum zaroor bil-zaroor tera shukar ada keren gay .
verses.translation: Allah woh hai jiss ney tumhen aik jaan say peda kiya , aur ussi say uss ki biwi banai , takay woh uss kay paas aa-ker taskeen hasil keray .   phir jab mard ney aurat ko dhaank liya to aurat ney hamal ka aik halka saa bojh utha liya , jissay ley ker woh chalti phirti rahi .   phir jab woh bojhal hogaee to dono ( miyan biwi ) ney apney perwerdigar Allah say dua ki kay :  agar tu ney hamen tandurust aulad di to hum zaroor bil-zaroor tera shukar ada keren gay .

verses.text: lekin jab Allah ney unn ko aik tandurust baccha dey diya to unn dono ney Allah ki ata ki hoi naimat mein Allah kay sath doosron ko shareek thehrana shuroo kerdiya , halankay Allah unn ki mushrikana baaton say kahen buland aur bartar hai .
verses.translation: lekin jab Allah ney unn ko aik tandurust baccha dey diya to unn dono ney Allah ki ata ki hoi naimat mein Allah kay sath doosron ko shareek thehrana shuroo kerdiya , halankay Allah unn ki mushrikana baaton say kahen buland aur bartar hai .

verses.text: kiya woh aesi cheezon ko ( Allah kay sath khudai mein ) shareek mantay hain jo koi cheez peda nahi kertay , balkay khud unn ko peda kiya jata hai ?
verses.translation: kiya woh aesi cheezon ko ( Allah kay sath khudai mein ) shareek mantay hain jo koi cheez peda nahi kertay , balkay khud unn ko peda kiya jata hai ?

verses.text: aur jo naa unn logon  ki koi madad ker-saktay hain , aur naa khud apni madad kertay hain .
verses.translation: aur jo naa unn logon  ki koi madad ker-saktay hain , aur naa khud apni madad kertay hain .

verses.text: aur agar tum unhen kissi sahih raastay ki taraf dawat do to woh tumhari baat naa maanen , ( balkay ) tum unhen pukaro ya khamosh raho , unn kay liye dono baaten barabar hain .
verses.translation: aur agar tum unhen kissi sahih raastay ki taraf dawat do to woh tumhari baat naa maanen , ( balkay ) tum unhen pukaro ya khamosh raho , unn kay liye dono baaten barabar hain .

verses.text: yaqeen jano kay Allah ko chorr ker jinn jinn ko tum pukartay ho , woh sabb tumhari tarah ( Allah kay ) banday hain . abb zara unn say dua maango , phir agar tum sachay ho to unhen tumhari dua qubool kerni chahiye .
verses.translation: yaqeen jano kay Allah ko chorr ker jinn jinn ko tum pukartay ho , woh sabb tumhari tarah ( Allah kay ) banday hain . abb zara unn say dua maango , phir agar tum sachay ho to unhen tumhari dua qubool kerni chahiye .

verses.text: bhala kiya unn kay paas paon hain jinn say woh chalen-? ya unn kay paas haath hain jinn say woh pakren ya unn kay paas aankhen hain jinn say woh dekhen-? ya unn kay paas kaan hain jinn say woh sunen-? ( unn say keh do kay : )  tum unn sabb deotaon ko bula lao jinhen tum ney Allah ka shareek bana rakha hai , phir meray khilaf koi sazish kero , aur mujhay zara bhi mohlat naa do .
verses.translation: bhala kiya unn kay paas paon hain jinn say woh chalen-? ya unn kay paas haath hain jinn say woh pakren ya unn kay paas aankhen hain jinn say woh dekhen-? ya unn kay paas kaan hain jinn say woh sunen-? ( unn say keh do kay : )  tum unn sabb deotaon ko bula lao jinhen tum ney Allah ka shareek bana rakha hai , phir meray khilaf koi sazish kero , aur mujhay zara bhi mohlat naa do .

verses.text: mera rakhwala to Allah hai jiss ney kitab nazil ki hai , aur woh naik logon  ki rakhwali kerta hai .
verses.translation: mera rakhwala to Allah hai jiss ney kitab nazil ki hai , aur woh naik logon  ki rakhwali kerta hai .

verses.text: aur tum uss ko chorr ker jinn jinn ko pukartay ho woh naa tumhari madad ker-saktay hain , naa apni madad kertay hain .
verses.translation: aur tum uss ko chorr ker jinn jinn ko pukartay ho woh naa tumhari madad ker-saktay hain , naa apni madad kertay hain .

verses.text: aur agar tum unhen sahih raastay ki taraf bulao to woh sunen gay bhi nahi . woh tumhen nazar to iss tarah aatay hain jaisay tumhen dekh rahey hon , lekin haqeeqat mein unhen kuch sujhai nahi deta .
verses.translation: aur agar tum unhen sahih raastay ki taraf bulao to woh sunen gay bhi nahi . woh tumhen nazar to iss tarah aatay hain jaisay tumhen dekh rahey hon , lekin haqeeqat mein unhen kuch sujhai nahi deta .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) darguzar ka ravaiyya apnao , aur ( logon  ko ) naiki ka hukum do , aur jahilon ki taraf dhiyan naa do .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) darguzar ka ravaiyya apnao , aur ( logon  ko ) naiki ka hukum do , aur jahilon ki taraf dhiyan naa do .

verses.text: aur agar kabhi shetan ki taraf say tumhen koi kachoka lagg jaye to Allah ki panah maang lo .   yaqeenan woh her baat sunney wala , her cheez janney wala hai .
verses.translation: aur agar kabhi shetan ki taraf say tumhen koi kachoka lagg jaye to Allah ki panah maang lo .   yaqeenan woh her baat sunney wala , her cheez janney wala hai .

verses.text: jinn logon  ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya hai , unhen jab shetan ki taraf say koi khayal aa-ker choota bhi hai to woh ( Allah ko ) yaad kerletay hain ,   chunacheh achanak unn ki aankhen khul jati hain
verses.translation: jinn logon  ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya hai , unhen jab shetan ki taraf say koi khayal aa-ker choota bhi hai to woh ( Allah ko ) yaad kerletay hain ,   chunacheh achanak unn ki aankhen khul jati hain

verses.text: aur jo inn shayateen kay bhai hain , unn ko yeh shayateen gumrahi mein ghaseetay ley jatay hain , nateeja yeh kay woh ( gumrahi say ) baaz nahi aatay .
verses.translation: aur jo inn shayateen kay bhai hain , unn ko yeh shayateen gumrahi mein ghaseetay ley jatay hain , nateeja yeh kay woh ( gumrahi say ) baaz nahi aatay .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab tum inn kay samney ( inn ka mun maanga ) moajza paish nahi kertay to yeh kehtay hain kay :  tum ney yeh moajza khud apni pasand say kiyon naa paish kerdiya-?  keh do kay :  mein to ussi baat ka ittaba kerta hun jo meray rab ki taraf say wahi kay zariye mujh tak phonchai jati hai .   . yeh ( Quran ) tumharay rab ki taraf say baseeraton ka majmooa hai , aur jo log emaan layen unn kay liye hidayat aur rehmat !
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab tum inn kay samney ( inn ka mun maanga ) moajza paish nahi kertay to yeh kehtay hain kay :  tum ney yeh moajza khud apni pasand say kiyon naa paish kerdiya-?  keh do kay :  mein to ussi baat ka ittaba kerta hun jo meray rab ki taraf say wahi kay zariye mujh tak phonchai jati hai .   . yeh ( Quran ) tumharay rab ki taraf say baseeraton ka majmooa hai , aur jo log emaan layen unn kay liye hidayat aur rehmat !

verses.text: aur jab Quran parha jaye to uss ko kaan laga ker suno , aur khamosh raho takay tum per rehmat ho .
verses.translation: aur jab Quran parha jaye to uss ko kaan laga ker suno , aur khamosh raho takay tum per rehmat ho .

verses.text: aur apney rab ka subha o shaam ziker kiya kero , apney dil mein bhi , aajzi aur khof kay ( jazbaat kay ) sath , aur zaban say bhi , aawaz boht buland kiye baghair ! aur unn logon  mein shamil naa hojana jo ghaflat mein parray huye hain .
verses.translation: aur apney rab ka subha o shaam ziker kiya kero , apney dil mein bhi , aajzi aur khof kay ( jazbaat kay ) sath , aur zaban say bhi , aawaz boht buland kiye baghair ! aur unn logon  mein shamil naa hojana jo ghaflat mein parray huye hain .

verses.text: yaad rakho kay jo ( farishtay ) tumharay rab kay paas hain , woh uss ki ibadat say takabbur ker kay mun nahi morrtay , aur uss ki tasbeeh kertay hain , aur ussi kay aagay sajda rez hotay hain .
verses.translation: yaad rakho kay jo ( farishtay ) tumharay rab kay paas hain , woh uss ki ibadat say takabbur ker kay mun nahi morrtay , aur uss ki tasbeeh kertay hain , aur ussi kay aagay sajda rez hotay hain .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: Alif-Laam-Meem-Suad
ayahs.translation: Alif-Laam-Meem-Suad

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh kitab hai jo tum per iss liye utaari gaee hai kay tum iss kay zariye logon  ko hoshiyar kero , lehaza iss ki wajeh say tumharay dil mein koi pareshani naa honi chahiye ,   aur mominon kay liye yeh aik naseehat ka paygham hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh kitab hai jo tum per iss liye utaari gaee hai kay tum iss kay zariye logon  ko hoshiyar kero , lehaza iss ki wajeh say tumharay dil mein koi pareshani naa honi chahiye ,   aur mominon kay liye yeh aik naseehat ka paygham hai .

ayahs.text: . ( logo ! ) jo kitab tum per tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say utaari gaee hai , uss kay peechay chalo , aur apney perwerdigar ko chorr ker doosray ( mann gharrat ) sarpraston kay peechay naa chalo . ( magar ) tum log naseehat kam hi mantay ho .
ayahs.translation: . ( logo ! ) jo kitab tum per tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say utaari gaee hai , uss kay peechay chalo , aur apney perwerdigar ko chorr ker doosray ( mann gharrat ) sarpraston kay peechay naa chalo . ( magar ) tum log naseehat kam hi mantay ho .

ayahs.text: kitni hi bastiyan hain jinn ko hum ney halak kiya . chunacheh unn kay paas humara azab raaton raat aagaya , ya aesay waqt aaya jab woh dophare ko aaram ker rahey thay .
ayahs.translation: kitni hi bastiyan hain jinn ko hum ney halak kiya . chunacheh unn kay paas humara azab raaton raat aagaya , ya aesay waqt aaya jab woh dophare ko aaram ker rahey thay .

ayahs.text: phir jab unn per humara azab aa-phoncha to unn kay paas kehney ko aur toh kuch tha nahi , bus bol uthay kay waqaee hum hi zalim thay .
ayahs.translation: phir jab unn per humara azab aa-phoncha to unn kay paas kehney ko aur toh kuch tha nahi , bus bol uthay kay waqaee hum hi zalim thay .

ayahs.text: abb hum unn logon  say zaroor baaz purs keren gay jinn kay paas payghumber bhejay gaye thay , aur hum khud payghumberon say bhi poochen gay ( kay unhon ney kiya paygham phonchaya , aur unhen kiya jawab mila-? )
ayahs.translation: abb hum unn logon  say zaroor baaz purs keren gay jinn kay paas payghumber bhejay gaye thay , aur hum khud payghumberon say bhi poochen gay ( kay unhon ney kiya paygham phonchaya , aur unhen kiya jawab mila-? )

ayahs.text: phir hum unn kay samney saray waqiyaat khud apney ilm ki buniyad per biyan kerden gay , ( kiyonkay ) hum ( unn waqiyaat kay waqt ) kahen ghaeeb to nahi thay .
ayahs.translation: phir hum unn kay samney saray waqiyaat khud apney ilm ki buniyad per biyan kerden gay , ( kiyonkay ) hum ( unn waqiyaat kay waqt ) kahen ghaeeb to nahi thay .

ayahs.text: aur uss din ( aemal ka ) wazan hona atal haqeeqat hai . chunacheh jinn ki tarazoo kay pallay bhari hon gay , wohi falah paaney walay hon gay .
ayahs.translation: aur uss din ( aemal ka ) wazan hona atal haqeeqat hai . chunacheh jinn ki tarazoo kay pallay bhari hon gay , wohi falah paaney walay hon gay .

ayahs.text: aur jinn ki tarazoo kay pallay halkay hon gay , wohi log hain jinhon ney humari aayaton kay sath ziyadtiyan ker ker kay khud apni janon ko ghatay mein daala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn ki tarazoo kay pallay halkay hon gay , wohi log hain jinhon ney humari aayaton kay sath ziyadtiyan ker ker kay khud apni janon ko ghatay mein daala hai .

ayahs.text: aur khuli baat hai kay hum ney tumhen zameen mein rehney ki jagah di , aur uss mein tumharay liye rozi kay asbaab peda kiye . ( phir bhi ) tum log shukar kam hi ada kertay ho .
ayahs.translation: aur khuli baat hai kay hum ney tumhen zameen mein rehney ki jagah di , aur uss mein tumharay liye rozi kay asbaab peda kiye . ( phir bhi ) tum log shukar kam hi ada kertay ho .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney tumhen peda kiya , phir tumhari soorat banai , phir farishton say kaha kay :  Adam ko sajda kero .  chunacheh sabb ney sajda kiya , siwaye iblees kay . woh sajda kernay walon mein shamil naa huwa .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney tumhen peda kiya , phir tumhari soorat banai , phir farishton say kaha kay :  Adam ko sajda kero .  chunacheh sabb ney sajda kiya , siwaye iblees kay . woh sajda kernay walon mein shamil naa huwa .

ayahs.text: Allah ney kaha :  jab mein ney tujhay hukum dey diya tha to tujhay sajda kernay say kiss cheez ney roka-? woh bola :  mein uss say behtar hun . tu ney mujhay aag say peda kiya , aur uss ko mitti say peda kiya .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney kaha :  jab mein ney tujhay hukum dey diya tha to tujhay sajda kernay say kiss cheez ney roka-? woh bola :  mein uss say behtar hun . tu ney mujhay aag say peda kiya , aur uss ko mitti say peda kiya .

ayahs.text: Allah ney kaha :  acha to yahan say neechay utar , kiyonkay tujhay yeh haq nahi phonchta kay yahan takabbur keray . abb nikal jaa , yaqeenan to zaleelon mein say hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney kaha :  acha to yahan say neechay utar , kiyonkay tujhay yeh haq nahi phonchta kay yahan takabbur keray . abb nikal jaa , yaqeenan to zaleelon mein say hai .

ayahs.text: uss ney kaha :  mujhay uss din tak ( zinda rehney ki ) mohlat deydey jiss din logon  ko qabron say zinda ker kay uthaya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: uss ney kaha :  mujhay uss din tak ( zinda rehney ki ) mohlat deydey jiss din logon  ko qabron say zinda ker kay uthaya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: Allah ney farmaya :  tujhay mohlat dey di gaee .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney farmaya :  tujhay mohlat dey di gaee .

ayahs.text: kehney laga :  abb chunkay tu ney mujhay gumrah kiya hai ,   iss liye mein ( bhi ) qasam khata hun kay inn ( insanon ) ki ghaat laga ker teray seedhay raastay per beth rahun ga .
ayahs.translation: kehney laga :  abb chunkay tu ney mujhay gumrah kiya hai ,   iss liye mein ( bhi ) qasam khata hun kay inn ( insanon ) ki ghaat laga ker teray seedhay raastay per beth rahun ga .

ayahs.text: phir mein inn per ( chaaron taraf say ) hamlay kerun ga , inn kay samney say bhi aur inn kay peechay say bhi , aur inn ki dayen taraf say bhi , aur inn ki bayen taraf say bhi . aur to inn mein say aksar logon  ko shukar guzaar nahi paye ga .
ayahs.translation: phir mein inn per ( chaaron taraf say ) hamlay kerun ga , inn kay samney say bhi aur inn kay peechay say bhi , aur inn ki dayen taraf say bhi , aur inn ki bayen taraf say bhi . aur to inn mein say aksar logon  ko shukar guzaar nahi paye ga .

ayahs.text: Allah ney kaha :  nikal jaa yahan say , zaleel aur mardood hoker . inn mein say jo teray peechay chalay ga , ( woh bhi tera sathi hoga ) aur mein tum sabb say jahannum ko bhar dun ga .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney kaha :  nikal jaa yahan say , zaleel aur mardood hoker . inn mein say jo teray peechay chalay ga , ( woh bhi tera sathi hoga ) aur mein tum sabb say jahannum ko bhar dun ga .

ayahs.text: aur aey Adam ! tum aur tumhari biwi dono jannat mein raho , aur jahan say jo cheez chahao , khao . albatta iss ( khaas ) darkht kay qareeb bhi matt phatakna , werna tum ziyadti kernay walon mein shamil hojao gay .
ayahs.translation: aur aey Adam ! tum aur tumhari biwi dono jannat mein raho , aur jahan say jo cheez chahao , khao . albatta iss ( khaas ) darkht kay qareeb bhi matt phatakna , werna tum ziyadti kernay walon mein shamil hojao gay .

ayahs.text: phir huwa yeh kay shetan ney unn dono kay dil mein waswasa daala , takay unn ki sharam ki jaghen jo unn say chupai gaee then , aik doosray kay samney khol dey .   kehney laga kay : tumharay perwerdigar ney tumhen uss darkht say kissi aur wajeh say nahi , balkay sirf iss wajeh say roka tha kay kahen tum farishtay naa ban jao , ya tumhen hamesha ki zindagi naa hasil hojaye .
ayahs.translation: phir huwa yeh kay shetan ney unn dono kay dil mein waswasa daala , takay unn ki sharam ki jaghen jo unn say chupai gaee then , aik doosray kay samney khol dey .   kehney laga kay : tumharay perwerdigar ney tumhen uss darkht say kissi aur wajeh say nahi , balkay sirf iss wajeh say roka tha kay kahen tum farishtay naa ban jao , ya tumhen hamesha ki zindagi naa hasil hojaye .

ayahs.text: aur unn kay samney woh qasmen kha gaya kay yaqeen jano mein tumharay khair khuwahon mein say hon .
ayahs.translation: aur unn kay samney woh qasmen kha gaya kay yaqeen jano mein tumharay khair khuwahon mein say hon .

ayahs.text: iss tarah uss ney dono ko dhoka dey ker neechay utaar hi liya .   chunacheh jab dono ney uss darkht ka maza chakha to unn dono ki sharam ki jaghen aik doosray per khul gaeen , aur woh jannat kay kuch pattay jorr jorr ker apney badan per chipkaney lagay .   aur unn kay perwerdigar ney unhen aawaz di kay :  kiya mein ney tum dono ko uss darkht say roka nahi tha , aur tum say yeh nahi kaha tha kay shetan tum dono ka khula dushman hai ?
ayahs.translation: iss tarah uss ney dono ko dhoka dey ker neechay utaar hi liya .   chunacheh jab dono ney uss darkht ka maza chakha to unn dono ki sharam ki jaghen aik doosray per khul gaeen , aur woh jannat kay kuch pattay jorr jorr ker apney badan per chipkaney lagay .   aur unn kay perwerdigar ney unhen aawaz di kay :  kiya mein ney tum dono ko uss darkht say roka nahi tha , aur tum say yeh nahi kaha tha kay shetan tum dono ka khula dushman hai ?

ayahs.text: dono bol uthay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum apni janon per zulm ker guzray hain , aur agar aap ney hamen moaaf naa farmaya , aur hum per reham naa kiya to yaqeenan hum na-murad logon  mein shamil hojayen gay .
ayahs.translation: dono bol uthay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum apni janon per zulm ker guzray hain , aur agar aap ney hamen moaaf naa farmaya , aur hum per reham naa kiya to yaqeenan hum na-murad logon  mein shamil hojayen gay .

ayahs.text: Allah ney ( Adam , unn ki biwi aur iblees say ) farmaya :  abb tum sabb yahan say utar jao , tum aik doosray kay dushman hogay , aur tumharay liye aik mauddat tak zameen mein thehrna aur kissi qadar faeeda uthana ( tey kerdiya gaya ) hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney ( Adam , unn ki biwi aur iblees say ) farmaya :  abb tum sabb yahan say utar jao , tum aik doosray kay dushman hogay , aur tumharay liye aik mauddat tak zameen mein thehrna aur kissi qadar faeeda uthana ( tey kerdiya gaya ) hai .

ayahs.text: farmaya kay :  ussi ( zameen ) mein tum jio gay , aur ussi mein tumhen moat aaye gi , aur ussi say tumhen dobara zinda kerkay nikala jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: farmaya kay :  ussi ( zameen ) mein tum jio gay , aur ussi mein tumhen moat aaye gi , aur ussi say tumhen dobara zinda kerkay nikala jaye ga .

ayahs.text: aey Adam kay beto aur betiyo ! hum ney tumharay liye libas nazil kiya hai jo tumharay jism kay unn hisson ko chupa sakay jinn ka kholna bura hai , aur jo khushnumai ka zariya bhi hai .   aur taqwa ka jo libas hai woh sabb say behtar hai .   yeh sabb Allah ki nishaniyon ka hissa hai , jinn ka maqsad yeh hai kay log sabaq hasil keren .
ayahs.translation: aey Adam kay beto aur betiyo ! hum ney tumharay liye libas nazil kiya hai jo tumharay jism kay unn hisson ko chupa sakay jinn ka kholna bura hai , aur jo khushnumai ka zariya bhi hai .   aur taqwa ka jo libas hai woh sabb say behtar hai .   yeh sabb Allah ki nishaniyon ka hissa hai , jinn ka maqsad yeh hai kay log sabaq hasil keren .

ayahs.text: aey Adam kay beto aur betiyo ! shetan ko aisa moaqa hergiz hergiz naa dena kay woh tumhen ussi tarah fitney mein daal dey jaisay uss ney tumharay maa baap ko jannat say nikala , jabkay unn ka libas unn kay jism say utarwa liya tha , takay unn ko aik doosray ki sharam ki jaghen dikha dey . woh aur uss ka jatha tumhen wahan say dekhta hai jahan say tum unhen nahi dekh saktay . unn shetanon ko hum ney unhi ka dost bana diya hai jo emaan nahi latay .
ayahs.translation: aey Adam kay beto aur betiyo ! shetan ko aisa moaqa hergiz hergiz naa dena kay woh tumhen ussi tarah fitney mein daal dey jaisay uss ney tumharay maa baap ko jannat say nikala , jabkay unn ka libas unn kay jism say utarwa liya tha , takay unn ko aik doosray ki sharam ki jaghen dikha dey . woh aur uss ka jatha tumhen wahan say dekhta hai jahan say tum unhen nahi dekh saktay . unn shetanon ko hum ney unhi ka dost bana diya hai jo emaan nahi latay .

ayahs.text: aur jab yeh ( kafir ) log koi bey hayai ka kaam kertay hain to kehtay hain kay hum ney apney baap dadon ko issi tareeqay per amal kertay paya hai , aur Allah ney hamen aisa hi hukum diya hai .   tum ( unn say ) kaho kay :  Allah bey hayai ka hukum nahi diya kerta . kiya tum woh baaten Allah kay naam lagatay ho jinn ka tumhen zara ilm nahi-?
ayahs.translation: aur jab yeh ( kafir ) log koi bey hayai ka kaam kertay hain to kehtay hain kay hum ney apney baap dadon ko issi tareeqay per amal kertay paya hai , aur Allah ney hamen aisa hi hukum diya hai .   tum ( unn say ) kaho kay :  Allah bey hayai ka hukum nahi diya kerta . kiya tum woh baaten Allah kay naam lagatay ho jinn ka tumhen zara ilm nahi-?

ayahs.text: kaho kay :  meray perwerdigar ney to insaf ka hukum diya hai .   aur ( yeh hukum diya hai kay : )  jab kahen sajda kero , apna rukh theek theek rakho , aur iss yaqeen kay sath uss ko pukaro kay itaat khalis ussi ka haq hai . jiss tarah uss ney tumhen ibtida mein peda kiya tha . ussi tarah tum dobara peda hogay .
ayahs.translation: kaho kay :  meray perwerdigar ney to insaf ka hukum diya hai .   aur ( yeh hukum diya hai kay : )  jab kahen sajda kero , apna rukh theek theek rakho , aur iss yaqeen kay sath uss ko pukaro kay itaat khalis ussi ka haq hai . jiss tarah uss ney tumhen ibtida mein peda kiya tha . ussi tarah tum dobara peda hogay .

ayahs.text: . ( tum mein say ) aik giroh ko to Allah ney hidayat tak phoncha diya hai , aur aik giroh woh hai jiss per gumrahi musallat hogaee hai , kiyonkay inn logon  ney Allah kay bajaye shetanon ko dost bana liya hai , aur samajh yeh rahey hain kay woh seedhay raastay per hain .
ayahs.translation: . ( tum mein say ) aik giroh ko to Allah ney hidayat tak phoncha diya hai , aur aik giroh woh hai jiss per gumrahi musallat hogaee hai , kiyonkay inn logon  ney Allah kay bajaye shetanon ko dost bana liya hai , aur samajh yeh rahey hain kay woh seedhay raastay per hain .

ayahs.text: aey Adam kay beto aur betiyo ! jab kabhi masjid mein aao to apni khushnumai ka saman ( yani libas jism per ) ley ker aao , aur khao aur piyo , aur fuzool kharchi matt kero . yaad rakho kay Allah fuzool kharch logon  ko pasand nahi kerta .
ayahs.translation: aey Adam kay beto aur betiyo ! jab kabhi masjid mein aao to apni khushnumai ka saman ( yani libas jism per ) ley ker aao , aur khao aur piyo , aur fuzool kharchi matt kero . yaad rakho kay Allah fuzool kharch logon  ko pasand nahi kerta .

ayahs.text: kaho kay :  aakhir kon hai jiss ney zeenat kay uss saman ko haram qarar diya ho jo Allah ney apney bandon kay liye peda kiya hai , aur ( issi tarah ) pakeezah rizq ki cheezon ko-?    kaho kay :  jo log emaan rakhtay hain unn ko yeh naimatainen jo dunyawi zindagi mein mili hoi hain , qayamat kay din khalis unhi kay liye hon gi .    issi tarah hum tamam aayaten unn logon  kay liye tafseel say biyan kertay hain jo ilm say kaam len .
ayahs.translation: kaho kay :  aakhir kon hai jiss ney zeenat kay uss saman ko haram qarar diya ho jo Allah ney apney bandon kay liye peda kiya hai , aur ( issi tarah ) pakeezah rizq ki cheezon ko-?    kaho kay :  jo log emaan rakhtay hain unn ko yeh naimatainen jo dunyawi zindagi mein mili hoi hain , qayamat kay din khalis unhi kay liye hon gi .    issi tarah hum tamam aayaten unn logon  kay liye tafseel say biyan kertay hain jo ilm say kaam len .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  meray perwerdigar ney to bey hayai kay kamon ko haram qarar diya hai , chahye woh bey hayai khuli hoi ho , ya chupi hoi . neez her qisam kay gunah ko aur nahaq kissi say ziyadti kernay ko , aur iss baat ko kay tum Allah kay sath kissi aesi cheez ko shareek maano jiss kay baaray mein Allah ney koi daleel nazil nahi ki hai , neez iss baat ko kay tum Allah kay zimmay woh baaten lagao jinn ki haqeeqat ka tumhen zara bhi ilm nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  meray perwerdigar ney to bey hayai kay kamon ko haram qarar diya hai , chahye woh bey hayai khuli hoi ho , ya chupi hoi . neez her qisam kay gunah ko aur nahaq kissi say ziyadti kernay ko , aur iss baat ko kay tum Allah kay sath kissi aesi cheez ko shareek maano jiss kay baaray mein Allah ney koi daleel nazil nahi ki hai , neez iss baat ko kay tum Allah kay zimmay woh baaten lagao jinn ki haqeeqat ka tumhen zara bhi ilm nahi hai .

ayahs.text: aur her qoam kay liye aik miyaad muqarrar hai . chunacheh jab unn ki muqarrara miyaad aajati hai to woh gharri bhar bhi uss say aagay peechay nahi hosaktay .
ayahs.translation: aur her qoam kay liye aik miyaad muqarrar hai . chunacheh jab unn ki muqarrara miyaad aajati hai to woh gharri bhar bhi uss say aagay peechay nahi hosaktay .

ayahs.text: . ( aur Allah ney insan ko peda kertay waqt hi yeh tanbeeh kerdi thi kay : )  aey Adam kay beto aur betiyo ! agar tumharay paas tum hi mein say kuch payghumber ayen jo tumhen meri aayaten parh ker sunayen , to jo log taqwa ikhtiyar keren gay aur apni islaah kerlen gay , unn per naa koi khof taari hoga , aur naa woh ghumgeen hon gay .
ayahs.translation: . ( aur Allah ney insan ko peda kertay waqt hi yeh tanbeeh kerdi thi kay : )  aey Adam kay beto aur betiyo ! agar tumharay paas tum hi mein say kuch payghumber ayen jo tumhen meri aayaten parh ker sunayen , to jo log taqwa ikhtiyar keren gay aur apni islaah kerlen gay , unn per naa koi khof taari hoga , aur naa woh ghumgeen hon gay .

ayahs.text: aur jinhon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , aur takabbur kay sath unn say mun morra hai , woh log dozakh kay baasi hain . woh uss mein hamesha rahen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur jinhon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , aur takabbur kay sath unn say mun morra hai , woh log dozakh kay baasi hain . woh uss mein hamesha rahen gay .

ayahs.text: abb batao kay uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay , ya uss ki aayaton ko jhutlaye-? aesay logon  kay muqaddar mein ( rizq ka ) jitna hissa likha huwa hai , woh unhen ( duniya ki zindagi mein ) phonchta rahey ga ,   yahan tak kay jab unn kay paas humaray bhejay huye farishtay unn ki rooh qabz kernay kay liye aa-phonchen gay to woh kahen gay kay :  kahan hain woh ( tumharay mabood ) jinhen tum Allah kay bajaye pukara kertay thay ?  yeh jawab den gay kay :  woh sabb hum say gumm hochukay hain .  aur woh khud apney khilaf gawahi den gay kay woh kafir thay .
ayahs.translation: abb batao kay uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay , ya uss ki aayaton ko jhutlaye-? aesay logon  kay muqaddar mein ( rizq ka ) jitna hissa likha huwa hai , woh unhen ( duniya ki zindagi mein ) phonchta rahey ga ,   yahan tak kay jab unn kay paas humaray bhejay huye farishtay unn ki rooh qabz kernay kay liye aa-phonchen gay to woh kahen gay kay :  kahan hain woh ( tumharay mabood ) jinhen tum Allah kay bajaye pukara kertay thay ?  yeh jawab den gay kay :  woh sabb hum say gumm hochukay hain .  aur woh khud apney khilaf gawahi den gay kay woh kafir thay .

ayahs.text: Allah farmaye ga kay :  jao , jinnaat aur insanon kay unn girohon kay sath tum bhi dozakh mein dakhil hojao jo tum say pehlay guzar chukay hain .  ( iss tarah ) jab bhi koi giroh dozakh mein dakhil hoga , woh apney jaison per lanat bhejay ga ,   yahan tak kay jab aik kay baad aik , sabb uss mein ikatthay hojayen gay to unn mein say jo log baad mein aaye thay , woh apney say pehlay aaney walon kay baaray mein kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! enhon ney hamen ghalat raastay per daala tha , iss liye inn ko aag ka dugna azab dena .  Allah farmaye ga kay :  sabhi ka azab dugna hai ,   lekin tumhen ( abhi ) pata nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah farmaye ga kay :  jao , jinnaat aur insanon kay unn girohon kay sath tum bhi dozakh mein dakhil hojao jo tum say pehlay guzar chukay hain .  ( iss tarah ) jab bhi koi giroh dozakh mein dakhil hoga , woh apney jaison per lanat bhejay ga ,   yahan tak kay jab aik kay baad aik , sabb uss mein ikatthay hojayen gay to unn mein say jo log baad mein aaye thay , woh apney say pehlay aaney walon kay baaray mein kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! enhon ney hamen ghalat raastay per daala tha , iss liye inn ko aag ka dugna azab dena .  Allah farmaye ga kay :  sabhi ka azab dugna hai ,   lekin tumhen ( abhi ) pata nahi hai .

ayahs.text: aur pehlay aaney walay baad mein aaney walon say kahen gay :  to phir tum ko hum per koi foqiyat to hasil naa hoi . lehaza jo kamai tum khud kertay rahey ho uss kay badlay azab ka maza chakho .
ayahs.translation: aur pehlay aaney walay baad mein aaney walon say kahen gay :  to phir tum ko hum per koi foqiyat to hasil naa hoi . lehaza jo kamai tum khud kertay rahey ho uss kay badlay azab ka maza chakho .

ayahs.text: . ( logo ! ) yaqeen rakho kay jinn logon  ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , aur takabbur kay sath unn say mun morra hai , unn kay liye aasman kay darwazay nahi kholay jayen gay , aur woh jannat mein uss waqt tak dakhil nahi hon gay jab tak koi oont aik soi kay nakay mein dakhil nahi hojata ,   aur issi tarah hum mujrimon ko unn kay kiye ka badla diya kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: . ( logo ! ) yaqeen rakho kay jinn logon  ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , aur takabbur kay sath unn say mun morra hai , unn kay liye aasman kay darwazay nahi kholay jayen gay , aur woh jannat mein uss waqt tak dakhil nahi hon gay jab tak koi oont aik soi kay nakay mein dakhil nahi hojata ,   aur issi tarah hum mujrimon ko unn kay kiye ka badla diya kertay hain .

ayahs.text: unn kay liye to dozakh hi ka bichona hai , aur oopper say ussi ka oarhna . aur issi tarah hum zalimon ko unn kay kiye ka badla diya kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: unn kay liye to dozakh hi ka bichona hai , aur oopper say ussi ka oarhna . aur issi tarah hum zalimon ko unn kay kiye ka badla diya kertay hain .

ayahs.text: aur jo log emaan laye hain aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain ( yaad rahey kay ) hum kissi bhi shaks ko uss ki taqat say ziyada ki takleef nahi detay   to aesay log jannat kay baasi hain . woh hamesha uss mein rahen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log emaan laye hain aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain ( yaad rahey kay ) hum kissi bhi shaks ko uss ki taqat say ziyada ki takleef nahi detay   to aesay log jannat kay baasi hain . woh hamesha uss mein rahen gay .

ayahs.text: aur unn kay seenon mein ( aik doosray say duniya mein ) jo koi ranjish rahi hogi , ussay hum nikal bahir keren gay .   unn kay neechay say nehren behti hon gi , aur woh kahen gay :  tamam tarr shukar Allah ka hai , jiss ney hamen iss manzil tak phonchaya . agar Allah hamen naa phonchata to hum kabhi manzil tak naa phonchtay . humaray perwerdigar kay payghumber waqaee humaray paas bilkul sachi baat ley ker aaye thay .  aur unn say pukar ker kaha jaye ga kay :  logo ! yeh hai jannat ! tum jo amal kertay rahey ho , unn ki bana per tumhen iss ka waris bana diya gaya hai .
ayahs.translation: aur unn kay seenon mein ( aik doosray say duniya mein ) jo koi ranjish rahi hogi , ussay hum nikal bahir keren gay .   unn kay neechay say nehren behti hon gi , aur woh kahen gay :  tamam tarr shukar Allah ka hai , jiss ney hamen iss manzil tak phonchaya . agar Allah hamen naa phonchata to hum kabhi manzil tak naa phonchtay . humaray perwerdigar kay payghumber waqaee humaray paas bilkul sachi baat ley ker aaye thay .  aur unn say pukar ker kaha jaye ga kay :  logo ! yeh hai jannat ! tum jo amal kertay rahey ho , unn ki bana per tumhen iss ka waris bana diya gaya hai .

ayahs.text: aur jannat kay log dozakh walon say pukar ker kahen gay kay :  humaray perwerdigar ney hum say jo wada kiya tha , hum ney ussay bilkul sacha paya hai . abb tum batao kay tumharay perwerdigar ney jo wada kiya tha , kiya tum ney bhi ussay sacha paya-?  woh jawab mein kahen gay :  haan  itney mein aik munadi unn kay darmiyan pukaray ga kay :  Allah ki lanat hai unn zalimon per .
ayahs.translation: aur jannat kay log dozakh walon say pukar ker kahen gay kay :  humaray perwerdigar ney hum say jo wada kiya tha , hum ney ussay bilkul sacha paya hai . abb tum batao kay tumharay perwerdigar ney jo wada kiya tha , kiya tum ney bhi ussay sacha paya-?  woh jawab mein kahen gay :  haan  itney mein aik munadi unn kay darmiyan pukaray ga kay :  Allah ki lanat hai unn zalimon per .

ayahs.text: jo Allah kay raastay say logon  ko roktay thay , aur uss mein tairrah nikalna chahtay thay , aur jo aakhirat ka bilkul inkar kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: jo Allah kay raastay say logon  ko roktay thay , aur uss mein tairrah nikalna chahtay thay , aur jo aakhirat ka bilkul inkar kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: aur inn dono girohon ( yani jannatiyon aur dozakhiyon ) kay darmiyan aik aarr hogi , aur aeraaf per ( yani uss aarr ki bulandiyon per ) kuch log hon gay jo her giroh kay logon  ko unn ki alamaton say pehchantay hon gay .   aur woh jannat walon ko aawaz dey ker kahen gay :  salam ho tum per !  woh ( aeraaf walay ) khud to uss mein dakhil nahi huye hon gay , albatta ishtiaq kay sath umeed lagaye huye hon gay .
ayahs.translation: aur inn dono girohon ( yani jannatiyon aur dozakhiyon ) kay darmiyan aik aarr hogi , aur aeraaf per ( yani uss aarr ki bulandiyon per ) kuch log hon gay jo her giroh kay logon  ko unn ki alamaton say pehchantay hon gay .   aur woh jannat walon ko aawaz dey ker kahen gay :  salam ho tum per !  woh ( aeraaf walay ) khud to uss mein dakhil nahi huye hon gay , albatta ishtiaq kay sath umeed lagaye huye hon gay .

ayahs.text: aur jab unn ki nigahon ko dozakh walon ki samt morra jaye ga to woh kahen gay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen inn zalim logon  kay sath naa rakhna .
ayahs.translation: aur jab unn ki nigahon ko dozakh walon ki samt morra jaye ga to woh kahen gay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen inn zalim logon  kay sath naa rakhna .

ayahs.text: aur aeraaf walay unn logon  ko aawaz den gay jinn ko woh unn ki alamaton say pehchantay hon gay . kahen gay kay :  naa tumhari jama poonji tumharay kuch kaam aai , aur naa woh jinhen tum bara samjhay bethay thay .
ayahs.translation: aur aeraaf walay unn logon  ko aawaz den gay jinn ko woh unn ki alamaton say pehchantay hon gay . kahen gay kay :  naa tumhari jama poonji tumharay kuch kaam aai , aur naa woh jinhen tum bara samjhay bethay thay .

ayahs.text: . ( phir jannatiyon ki taraf ishara ker kay kahen gay kay : )  kiya yehi woh log hain jinn kay baaray mein tum ney qasmen khai then kay Allah inn ko apni rehmat ka koi hissa nahi dey ga-? ( unn say to keh diya gaya hai kay ) jannat mein dakhil hojao , naa tum ko kissi cheez ka darr hoga , aur naa tumhen kabhi koi ghum paish aaye ga .
ayahs.translation: . ( phir jannatiyon ki taraf ishara ker kay kahen gay kay : )  kiya yehi woh log hain jinn kay baaray mein tum ney qasmen khai then kay Allah inn ko apni rehmat ka koi hissa nahi dey ga-? ( unn say to keh diya gaya hai kay ) jannat mein dakhil hojao , naa tum ko kissi cheez ka darr hoga , aur naa tumhen kabhi koi ghum paish aaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur dozakh walay jannat walon say kahen gay kay :  hum per thora saa paani hi daal do , ya Allah ney tumhen jo naimaten di hain , unn ka koi hissa ( hum tak bhi phoncha do )  woh jawab den gay kay :  Allah ney yeh dono cheezen unn kafiron per haram kerdi hain .
ayahs.translation: aur dozakh walay jannat walon say kahen gay kay :  hum per thora saa paani hi daal do , ya Allah ney tumhen jo naimaten di hain , unn ka koi hissa ( hum tak bhi phoncha do )  woh jawab den gay kay :  Allah ney yeh dono cheezen unn kafiron per haram kerdi hain .

ayahs.text: jinhon ney apney deen ko khel tamasha bana rakha tha , aur jinn ko dunyawi zindagi ney dhokay mein daal diya tha .  chunacheh aaj hum bhi unn ko issi tarah bhula den gay jaisay woh iss baat ko bhulaye bethay thay kay unhen iss din ka samna kerna hai , aur jaisay woh humari aayaton ka khullam khula inkar kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: jinhon ney apney deen ko khel tamasha bana rakha tha , aur jinn ko dunyawi zindagi ney dhokay mein daal diya tha .  chunacheh aaj hum bhi unn ko issi tarah bhula den gay jaisay woh iss baat ko bhulaye bethay thay kay unhen iss din ka samna kerna hai , aur jaisay woh humari aayaton ka khullam khula inkar kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum inn kay paas aik aesi kitab ley aaye hain jiss mein hum ney apney ilm ki buniyad per her cheez ki tafseel bata di hai , aur jo log emaan layen unn kay liye woh hidayat aur rehmat hai .
ayahs.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum inn kay paas aik aesi kitab ley aaye hain jiss mein hum ney apney ilm ki buniyad per her cheez ki tafseel bata di hai , aur jo log emaan layen unn kay liye woh hidayat aur rehmat hai .

ayahs.text: . ( abb ) yeh ( kafir ) uss aakhri anjam kay siwa kiss baat kay muntazir hain jo iss kitab mein mazkoor hai ?   ( halankay ) jiss din woh aakhri anjam aagaya jo iss kitab ney bataya hai , uss din yeh log jo uss anjam ko pehlay bhula chukay thay , yeh kahen gay kay :  humaray perwerdigar kay payghumber waqaee sachi khabar laye thay . abb kiya hamen kuch sirfarishi moyassar aa-saktay hain jo humari sifarish keren , ya kiya aisa hosakta hai kay hamen dobara wahin ( duniya mein ) bhej diya jaye , takay hum jo ( buray ) kaam pehlay kertay rahey hain , unn kay bar-khilaf doosray ( naik ) amal keren-?  haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh log apni janon kay liye sakht ghatay ka soda ker-chukay hain , aur jo ( deota ) unhon ney gharr rakhay hain , enhen ( uss din ) unn ka kahen suragh nahi milay ga .
ayahs.translation: . ( abb ) yeh ( kafir ) uss aakhri anjam kay siwa kiss baat kay muntazir hain jo iss kitab mein mazkoor hai ?   ( halankay ) jiss din woh aakhri anjam aagaya jo iss kitab ney bataya hai , uss din yeh log jo uss anjam ko pehlay bhula chukay thay , yeh kahen gay kay :  humaray perwerdigar kay payghumber waqaee sachi khabar laye thay . abb kiya hamen kuch sirfarishi moyassar aa-saktay hain jo humari sifarish keren , ya kiya aisa hosakta hai kay hamen dobara wahin ( duniya mein ) bhej diya jaye , takay hum jo ( buray ) kaam pehlay kertay rahey hain , unn kay bar-khilaf doosray ( naik ) amal keren-?  haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh log apni janon kay liye sakht ghatay ka soda ker-chukay hain , aur jo ( deota ) unhon ney gharr rakhay hain , enhen ( uss din ) unn ka kahen suragh nahi milay ga .

ayahs.text: yaqeenan tumhara perwerdigar woh Allah hai jiss ney saray aasman aur zameen cheh din mein banaye ,   phir uss ney arsh per istawa farmaya .   woh din ko raat ki chadar urrha deta hai , jo tez raftari say chalti hoi uss ko aa-dabochti hai . aur uss ney sooraj aur chaand taray peda kiye hain jo sabb uss kay hukum kay aagay raam hain . yaad rakho kay peda kerna aur hukum dena sabb ussi/issi ka kaam hai . bari barkat wala hai Allah jo tamam jahano ka perwerdigar hai !
ayahs.translation: yaqeenan tumhara perwerdigar woh Allah hai jiss ney saray aasman aur zameen cheh din mein banaye ,   phir uss ney arsh per istawa farmaya .   woh din ko raat ki chadar urrha deta hai , jo tez raftari say chalti hoi uss ko aa-dabochti hai . aur uss ney sooraj aur chaand taray peda kiye hain jo sabb uss kay hukum kay aagay raam hain . yaad rakho kay peda kerna aur hukum dena sabb ussi/issi ka kaam hai . bari barkat wala hai Allah jo tamam jahano ka perwerdigar hai !

ayahs.text: tum apney perwerdigar ko aajzi kay sath chupkay chupkay pukara kero . yaqeenan woh hadd say guzarney walon ko pasand nahi kerta .
ayahs.translation: tum apney perwerdigar ko aajzi kay sath chupkay chupkay pukara kero . yaqeenan woh hadd say guzarney walon ko pasand nahi kerta .

ayahs.text: aur zameen mein uss ki islaah kay baad fasad barpa naa kero ,   aur uss ki ibadat iss tarah kero kay dil mein khof bhi ho aur umeed bhi .   yaqeenan Allah ki rehmat naik logon  say qareeb hai .

ayahs.text: aur wohi ( Allah ) hai jo apni rehmat ( yani barish ) kay aagay aagay hawayen bhejta hai jo ( barish ki ) khushkhabri deti hain , yahan tak kay jab woh bojhal badalon ko utha leti hain to , hum unhen kissi murda zameen ki taraf hankaley jatay hain , phir wahan paani barsatay hain , aur uss kay zariye her qisam kay phal nikaltay hain . issi tarah hum murdon ko bhi zinda ker kay nikalen gay . shayad ( inn baaton per ghor ker kay ) tum sabaq hasil kerlo .

ayahs.text: aur jo zameen achi hoti hai uss ki pedawaar to apney rab kay hukum say nikal aati hai aur jo zameen kharab hogaee ho uss say naqis pedawaar kay siwa kuch nahi nikalta .   issi tarah hum apni nishaniyon kay mukhtalif rukh dikhatay rehtay hain , ( magar ) unn logon  kay liye jo qadardaani keren .

ayahs.text: hum ney nooh ko unn ki qoam kay paas bheja .   chunacheh unhon ney kaha :  aey meri qoam kay logo ! Allah ki ibadat kero , uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi hai . yaqeen jano mujhay sakht andesha hai kay tum per aik zabardast din ka azab naa aa-khara ho .

ayahs.text: unn ki qoam kay sardaron ney kaha :  hum to yaqeeni toor per dekh rahey hain kay tum khuli gumrahi mein mubtala ho .
ayahs.translation: unn ki qoam kay sardaron ney kaha :  hum to yaqeeni toor per dekh rahey hain kay tum khuli gumrahi mein mubtala ho .

ayahs.text: nooh ney jawab diya :  aey meri qoam ! mujhay koi gumrahi nahi lagi , magar mein Rabb-ul-Aalameen ka bheja huwa payghumber hun .
ayahs.translation: nooh ney jawab diya :  aey meri qoam ! mujhay koi gumrahi nahi lagi , magar mein Rabb-ul-Aalameen ka bheja huwa payghumber hun .

ayahs.text: mein tumhen apney rab kay payghamaat phonchata hun , aur tumhara bhala chahta hun . mujhay Allah ki taraf say aesi baaton ka ilm hai , jinn ka tumhen pata nahi hai .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya tumhen iss baat per taajjub hai kay tumharay rab ki naseehat aik aesay aadmi kay zariye tum tak phonchi hai jo khud tum hi mein say hai , takay woh tumhen khabrdar keray aur tum bad-amli say bach ker ho , aur takay tum per ( Allah ki ) rehmat ho-?

ayahs.text: phir bhi unhon ney nooh ko jhutlaya , chunacheh hum ney unn ko aur kashti mein unn kay sathiyon ko nijat di ,   aur unn sabb logon  ko gharq kerdiya jinhon ney humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya tha . yaqeenan woh andhay log thay .

ayahs.text: Hood ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! mujhay koi beywaqoofi laahaq nahi hoi , balkay mein Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki taraf say bheja huwa payghumber hun .

ayahs.text: mein apney perwerdigar kay payghamaat tum tak phonchata hun , aur mein tumhara aisa khair khuwa hun jiss per tum itminan ker-saktay ho .
ayahs.translation: mein apney perwerdigar kay payghamaat tum tak phonchata hun , aur mein tumhara aisa khair khuwa hun jiss per tum itminan ker-saktay ho .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya tumhen iss baat per taajjub hai kay tumharay rab ki naseehat aik aesay aadmi kay zariye tum tak phonchi hai jo khud tum hi mein say hai , takay woh tumhen khabrdar keray-? aur woh waqt yaad kero jab uss ney nooh ( aleh-assalam ) ki qoam kay baad tumhen janasheen banaya , aur jism ki deel dol mein tumhen ( doosron say ) barha charha ker rakha .   lehaza Allah ki naimaton per dhiyan do , takay tumhen falah naseeb ho .

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha :  kiya tum humaray paas iss liye aaye ho kay hum tanha Allah ki ibadat keren , aur jinn ( button ) ki ibadat humaray baap dada kertay aaye hain , unhen chorr bethen-? acha agar tum sachay ho to ley aao humaray samney woh ( azab ) jiss ki hamen dhamki dey rahey ho !

ayahs.text: Hood ney kaha :  abb tumharay rab ki taraf say tum per azab aur qehar ka aana tey hochuka hai . kiya tum mujh say ( mukhtalif button kay ) unn naamon kay baaray mein jhagarrtay ho jo tum ney aur tumharay baap dadon ney rakh liye hain , jinn ki taeed mein Allah ney koi daleel nazil nahi ki-? bus to abb tum intizar kero , mein bhi tumharay sath intizar kerta hun

ayahs.text: chunacheh hum ney unn ko ( yani Hood aleh-assalam ko ) aur unn kay sathiyon ko apni rehmat kay zariye nijat di , aur unn logon  ki jarr kaat daali jinhon ney humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya tha , aur momin nahi huye thay .

ayahs.text: aur samood ki taraf hum ney unn kay bhai saleh ko bheja .   unhon ney kaha :  aey meri qoam kay logo ! ayahs.text: woh maghroor log kehney lagay :  jiss paygham per tum emaan laye ho , uss kay to hum sabb munkir hain .
