ayahs.text: aur hum ney jiss kissi basti mein koi payghumber bheja , uss mein rehney walon ko bad-haali aur takleefon mein girftaar zaroor kiya , takay woh aajzi ikhtiyar keren .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney jiss kissi basti mein koi payghumber bheja , uss mein rehney walon ko bad-haali aur takleefon mein girftaar zaroor kiya , takay woh aajzi ikhtiyar keren .

ayahs.text: phir hum ney kayfiyat badli , bad-haali ki jagah khushhali ata farmaee , yahan tak kay woh khoob phalay phoolay , aur kehney lagay kay dukh sukh to humaray baap dadon ko bhi phonchtay rahey hain . phir hum ney unhen achanak iss tarah pakar liya kay unhen ( pehlay say ) pata bhi nahi chal saka .
ayahs.translation: phir hum ney kayfiyat badli , bad-haali ki jagah khushhali ata farmaee , yahan tak kay woh khoob phalay phoolay , aur kehney lagay kay dukh sukh to humaray baap dadon ko bhi phonchtay rahey hain . phir hum ney unhen achanak iss tarah pakar liya kay unhen ( pehlay say ) pata bhi nahi chal saka .

ayahs.text: aur agar yeh bastiyon walay emaan ley aatay aur taqwa ikhtiyar kerletay to hum unn per aasman aur zameen dono taraf say barkaton kay darwazay khol detay . lekin unhon ney ( haq ko ) jhutlaya , iss liye unn ki musalsal bad-amli ki padash mein hum ney unn ko apni pakar mein ley liya .
ayahs.translation: aur agar yeh bastiyon walay emaan ley aatay aur taqwa ikhtiyar kerletay to hum unn per aasman aur zameen dono taraf say barkaton kay darwazay khol detay . lekin unhon ney ( haq ko ) jhutlaya , iss liye unn ki musalsal bad-amli ki padash mein hum ney unn ko apni pakar mein ley liya .

ayahs.text: abb batao kay kiya ( doosri ) bastiyon kay log iss baat say bilkul bey khof hogaye hain kay kissi raat humara azab unn per aesay waqt aa-parey jab woh soye huye hon-?
ayahs.translation: abb batao kay kiya ( doosri ) bastiyon kay log iss baat say bilkul bey khof hogaye hain kay kissi raat humara azab unn per aesay waqt aa-parey jab woh soye huye hon-?

ayahs.text: aur kiya unn bastiyon kay logon  ko iss baat ka ( bhi ) koi darr nahi hai kay humara azab unn per kabhi din charrhay aajaye jab woh khel kood mein lagay huye hon-?
ayahs.translation: aur kiya unn bastiyon kay logon  ko iss baat ka ( bhi ) koi darr nahi hai kay humara azab unn per kabhi din charrhay aajaye jab woh khel kood mein lagay huye hon-?

ayahs.text: bhala kiya yeh log Allah ki di hoi dheel ( kay anjam ) say bey fiker hochukay hain-?   ( agar aisa hai ) to ( yeh yaad rakhen kay ) Allah ki di hoi dheel say wohi log bey fiker ho bethtay hain jo aakhir kaar nuqsan uthaney walay hotay hain .
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya yeh log Allah ki di hoi dheel ( kay anjam ) say bey fiker hochukay hain-?   ( agar aisa hai ) to ( yeh yaad rakhen kay ) Allah ki di hoi dheel say wohi log bey fiker ho bethtay hain jo aakhir kaar nuqsan uthaney walay hotay hain .

ayahs.text: jo log kissi zameen ( kay bashindon ki halakat ) kay baad uss kay waris ban jatay hain , bhala kiya unn ko yeh sabaq nahi mila kay agar hum chahen to unn ko ( bhi ) unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say kissi museebat mein mubtala kerden-? aur ( jo log apni zidd ki wajeh say yeh sabaq nahi letay ) hum unn kay dilon per mohar laga detay hain , jiss kay nateejay mein woh koi baat nahi suntay .
ayahs.translation: jo log kissi zameen ( kay bashindon ki halakat ) kay baad uss kay waris ban jatay hain , bhala kiya unn ko yeh sabaq nahi mila kay agar hum chahen to unn ko ( bhi ) unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say kissi museebat mein mubtala kerden-? aur ( jo log apni zidd ki wajeh say yeh sabaq nahi letay ) hum unn kay dilon per mohar laga detay hain , jiss kay nateejay mein woh koi baat nahi suntay .

ayahs.text: yeh hain woh bastiyan jinn kay waqiyaat hum tumhen suna rahey hain . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn sabb kay paas inn kay payghumber khulay khulay dalaeel ley ker aaye thay , magar jiss baat ko woh pehlay jhutla chukay thay , uss per kabhi emaan laney ko tayyar nahi huye . jo log kufr ko apna chukay hotay hain , unn kay dilon per Allah issi tarah mohar laga deta hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh hain woh bastiyan jinn kay waqiyaat hum tumhen suna rahey hain . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn sabb kay paas inn kay payghumber khulay khulay dalaeel ley ker aaye thay , magar jiss baat ko woh pehlay jhutla chukay thay , uss per kabhi emaan laney ko tayyar nahi huye . jo log kufr ko apna chukay hotay hain , unn kay dilon per Allah issi tarah mohar laga deta hai .

ayahs.text: hum ney unn ki aksariyat mein ehad ki koi paasdaari nahi pai , aur waqiaa yeh hai kay unn mein say aksar logon  ko hum ney nafarman hi paya .
ayahs.translation: hum ney unn ki aksariyat mein ehad ki koi paasdaari nahi pai , aur waqiaa yeh hai kay unn mein say aksar logon  ko hum ney nafarman hi paya .

ayahs.text: phir hum ney unn sabb kay baad musa ko apni nishaniyon kay sath firon aur uss kay sardaron kay paas bheja ,   to unhon ney ( bhi ) unn ( nishaniyon ) ki zalimana na-qadri ki . abb dekho kay unn mufsidon ka anjam kaisa huwa .
ayahs.translation: phir hum ney unn sabb kay baad musa ko apni nishaniyon kay sath firon aur uss kay sardaron kay paas bheja ,   to unhon ney ( bhi ) unn ( nishaniyon ) ki zalimana na-qadri ki . abb dekho kay unn mufsidon ka anjam kaisa huwa .

ayahs.text: musa ney kaha tha kay :  aey firon ! yaqeen jano kay mein Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki taraf say payghumber ban ker aaya hun .
ayahs.translation: musa ney kaha tha kay :  aey firon ! yaqeen jano kay mein Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki taraf say payghumber ban ker aaya hun .

ayahs.text: mera farz hai kay mein Allah ki taraf mansoob ker kay haq kay siwa koi aur baat naa kahun . mein tumharay paas tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik khuli daleel ley ker aaya hun , lehaza bani Israel ko meray sath bhej do .
ayahs.translation: mera farz hai kay mein Allah ki taraf mansoob ker kay haq kay siwa koi aur baat naa kahun . mein tumharay paas tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik khuli daleel ley ker aaya hun , lehaza bani Israel ko meray sath bhej do .

ayahs.text: uss ney kaha kay :  agar tum koi nishani ley ker aaye ho to ussay paish kero , agar tum aik sachay aadmi ho .
ayahs.translation: uss ney kaha kay :  agar tum koi nishani ley ker aaye ho to ussay paish kero , agar tum aik sachay aadmi ho .

ayahs.text: iss per musa ney apni laathi phenki to achanak woh aik saaf saaf azdaha ban gaya .
ayahs.translation: iss per musa ney apni laathi phenki to achanak woh aik saaf saaf azdaha ban gaya .

ayahs.text: aur apna haath ( giraybaan say ) kheencha to woh saray dekhney walon kay samney yakayak chamakney laga .
ayahs.translation: aur apna haath ( giraybaan say ) kheencha to woh saray dekhney walon kay samney yakayak chamakney laga .

ayahs.text: firon ki qoam kay sardar ( aik doosray say ) kehney lagay kay :  yeh to yaqeeni tor per bara mahir jadoogar hai .
ayahs.translation: firon ki qoam kay sardar ( aik doosray say ) kehney lagay kay :  yeh to yaqeeni tor per bara mahir jadoogar hai .

ayahs.text: yeh chahta hai kay tumhen tumhari zameen say nikal bahir keray . abb batao tumhari kiya raye hai-?
ayahs.translation: yeh chahta hai kay tumhen tumhari zameen say nikal bahir keray . abb batao tumhari kiya raye hai-?

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha kay :  zara iss ko aur iss kay bhai ko kuch mohlat do , aur tamam shehron mein herkaray bhej do .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha kay :  zara iss ko aur iss kay bhai ko kuch mohlat do , aur tamam shehron mein herkaray bhej do .

ayahs.text: takay woh tamam mahir jadoogaron ko jama ker kay tumharay paas ley ayen .
ayahs.translation: takay woh tamam mahir jadoogaron ko jama ker kay tumharay paas ley ayen .

ayahs.text: . ( chunacheh aisa hi huwa ) aur jadoogar firon kay paas aagaye ( aur ) unhon ney kaha kay :  agar hum ( musa per ) ghalib aagaye to hamen koi inaam to zaroor milay ga .
ayahs.translation: . ( chunacheh aisa hi huwa ) aur jadoogar firon kay paas aagaye ( aur ) unhon ney kaha kay :  agar hum ( musa per ) ghalib aagaye to hamen koi inaam to zaroor milay ga .

ayahs.text: firon ney kaha :  haan , aur tumhara shumar yaqeenan humaray muqarrab logon  mein ( bhi ) hoga .
ayahs.translation: firon ney kaha :  haan , aur tumhara shumar yaqeenan humaray muqarrab logon  mein ( bhi ) hoga .

ayahs.text: unhon ney ( musa say ) kaha :  musa ! chahao to ( jo phenkna chahtay ho ) tum phenko , werna hum ( apney jadoo ki cheezain ) phenken-?
ayahs.translation: unhon ney ( musa say ) kaha :  musa ! chahao to ( jo phenkna chahtay ho ) tum phenko , werna hum ( apney jadoo ki cheezain ) phenken-?

ayahs.text: musa ney kaha :  tum phenko !  chunacheh jab unhon ney ( apni lathiyan aur rassiyan ) phenken to logon  ki aankhon per jadoo kerdiya , unn per dehshat taari kerdi , aur zabardast jadoo ka muzahira kiya .
ayahs.translation: musa ney kaha :  tum phenko !  chunacheh jab unhon ney ( apni lathiyan aur rassiyan ) phenken to logon  ki aankhon per jadoo kerdiya , unn per dehshat taari kerdi , aur zabardast jadoo ka muzahira kiya .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney musa ko wahi kay zariye hukum diya kay tum apni laathi daal do . bus phir kiya tha , uss ney dekhtay hi dekhtay woh sari cheezen nigalni shuroo kerden jo unhon ney jhoot moott banai then
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney musa ko wahi kay zariye hukum diya kay tum apni laathi daal do . bus phir kiya tha , uss ney dekhtay hi dekhtay woh sari cheezen nigalni shuroo kerden jo unhon ney jhoot moott banai then

ayahs.text: iss tarah haq khul ker samney aagaya , aur unn ka bana banaya kaam malya mait hogaya .
ayahs.translation: iss tarah haq khul ker samney aagaya , aur unn ka bana banaya kaam malya mait hogaya .

ayahs.text: iss moaqa per woh maghloob huye , aur shadeed subki ki halat mein ( muqablay say ) palat ker aagaye .
ayahs.translation: iss moaqa per woh maghloob huye , aur shadeed subki ki halat mein ( muqablay say ) palat ker aagaye .

ayahs.text: aur iss waqaey ney saray jadoogaron ko bey saakhta sajday mein gira diya .
ayahs.translation: aur iss waqaey ney saray jadoogaron ko bey saakhta sajday mein gira diya .

ayahs.text: woh pukar uthay kay :  hum uss Rabb-ul-Aalameen per emaan ley aaye .
ayahs.translation: woh pukar uthay kay :  hum uss Rabb-ul-Aalameen per emaan ley aaye .

ayahs.text: jo musa aur Haroon ka rab hai .
ayahs.translation: jo musa aur Haroon ka rab hai .

ayahs.text: firon bola :  tum mere ijazat denay say pehlay hi uss shaks per emaan ley aaye . yeh zaroor koi sazish hai jo tum ney uss shehar mein mili bhugat ker kay banai hai , takay tum yahan kay rehney walon ko yahan say nikal bahir kero . acha to tumhen abhi pata chal jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: firon bola :  tum mere ijazat denay say pehlay hi uss shaks per emaan ley aaye . yeh zaroor koi sazish hai jo tum ney uss shehar mein mili bhugat ker kay banai hai , takay tum yahan kay rehney walon ko yahan say nikal bahir kero . acha to tumhen abhi pata chal jaye ga .

ayahs.text: mein ney bhi paka irada kerliya hai kay tumharay haath paon mukhalif samton say kaat daalun ga , phir tum sabb ko ikatthay sooli per latka ker rahun ga .
ayahs.translation: mein ney bhi paka irada kerliya hai kay tumharay haath paon mukhalif samton say kaat daalun ga , phir tum sabb ko ikatthay sooli per latka ker rahun ga .

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha :  yaqeen rakh kay hum ( mar ker ) apney malik hi kay paas wapis jayen gay .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha :  yaqeen rakh kay hum ( mar ker ) apney malik hi kay paas wapis jayen gay .

ayahs.text: aur tu iss kay siwa humari kiss baat say naraz hai kay jab humaray malik ki nishaniyan humaray paas aagaen to hum unn per emaan ley aaye-? aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum per sabar kay paymaney undel dey , aur hamen iss halat mein moat dey kay hum teray tabey daar hon .
ayahs.translation: aur tu iss kay siwa humari kiss baat say naraz hai kay jab humaray malik ki nishaniyan humaray paas aagaen to hum unn per emaan ley aaye-? aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum per sabar kay paymaney undel dey , aur hamen iss halat mein moat dey kay hum teray tabey daar hon .

ayahs.text: aur firon ki qoam kay sardaron ney ( firon say ) kaha :  kiya aap musa aur uss ki qoam ko khula chorr rahey hain , takay woh zameen mein fasad machayen , aur aap aur aap kay khudaon ko pus-e-pusht daal den-?    woh bola :  hum inn kay beton ko qatal keren gay aur inn ki aurton ko zinda rakhen gay aur hamen unn per poora poora qaboo hasil hai .
ayahs.translation: aur firon ki qoam kay sardaron ney ( firon say ) kaha :  kiya aap musa aur uss ki qoam ko khula chorr rahey hain , takay woh zameen mein fasad machayen , aur aap aur aap kay khudaon ko pus-e-pusht daal den-?    woh bola :  hum inn kay beton ko qatal keren gay aur inn ki aurton ko zinda rakhen gay aur hamen unn per poora poora qaboo hasil hai .

ayahs.text: musa ney apni qoam say kaha :  Allah say madad maango aur sabar say kaam lo . yaqeen rakho kay zameen Allah ki hai . woh apney bandon mein say jissay chahta hai uss ka waris bana deta hai . aur aakhri anjam perhezgaron hi kay haq mein hota hai .
ayahs.translation: musa ney apni qoam say kaha :  Allah say madad maango aur sabar say kaam lo . yaqeen rakho kay zameen Allah ki hai . woh apney bandon mein say jissay chahta hai uss ka waris bana deta hai . aur aakhri anjam perhezgaron hi kay haq mein hota hai .

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha kay :  hamen to aap kay aaney say pehlay bhi sataya gaya tha , aur aap kay aaney kay baad bhi ( sataya jaraha hai )  musa ney kaha :  umeed rakho kay Allah tumharay dushman ko halak kerday ga , aur tumhen zameen mein uss ka janasheen bana dey ga , phir dekhay ga kay tum kaisa kaam kertay ho .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha kay :  hamen to aap kay aaney say pehlay bhi sataya gaya tha , aur aap kay aaney kay baad bhi ( sataya jaraha hai )  musa ney kaha :  umeed rakho kay Allah tumharay dushman ko halak kerday ga , aur tumhen zameen mein uss ka janasheen bana dey ga , phir dekhay ga kay tum kaisa kaam kertay ho .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney firon kay logon  ko qehat saali aur pedawaar ki kami mein mubtala kiya , takay unn ko tanbeeh ho .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney firon kay logon  ko qehat saali aur pedawaar ki kami mein mubtala kiya , takay unn ko tanbeeh ho .

ayahs.text: . ( magar ) nateeja yeh huwa kay agar unn per khush haali aati to woh kehtay :  yeh to humara haq tha  aur agar unn per koi museebat parr-jati to uss ko musa aur unn kay sathiyon ki nahoosat qarar detay . aray ( yeh to ) khud unn ki nahoosat ( thi jo ) Allah kay ilm mein thi , lekin unn mein say aksar log jantay nahi thay .
ayahs.translation: . ( magar ) nateeja yeh huwa kay agar unn per khush haali aati to woh kehtay :  yeh to humara haq tha  aur agar unn per koi museebat parr-jati to uss ko musa aur unn kay sathiyon ki nahoosat qarar detay . aray ( yeh to ) khud unn ki nahoosat ( thi jo ) Allah kay ilm mein thi , lekin unn mein say aksar log jantay nahi thay .

ayahs.text: aur ( musa say ) kehtay thay kay :  tum hum per apna jadoo chalaney kay liye chahye kaisi bhi nishani ley ker aajao , hum tum per emaan laney walay nahi hain .
ayahs.translation: aur ( musa say ) kehtay thay kay :  tum hum per apna jadoo chalaney kay liye chahye kaisi bhi nishani ley ker aajao , hum tum per emaan laney walay nahi hain .

ayahs.text: chunacheh hum ney unn per toofan , taddiyon , ghunn kay keeron , mandakon aur khoon ki balayen choren , jo sabb alehda alehda nishaniyan then .   phir bhi unhon ney takabbur ka muzahira kiya , aur woh baray mujrim log thay .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh hum ney unn per toofan , taddiyon , ghunn kay keeron , mandakon aur khoon ki balayen choren , jo sabb alehda alehda nishaniyan then .   phir bhi unhon ney takabbur ka muzahira kiya , aur woh baray mujrim log thay .

ayahs.text: aur jab unn per azab aa-parta to woh kehtay :  aey musa ! tumharay paas Allah ka jo ehad hai , uss ka wasta dey ker humaray liye apney rab say dua kerdo ( kay yeh azab hum say door hojaye ) . aur agar waqaee tum ney hum per say yeh azab hata diya to hum tumhari baat maan len gay , aur bani Israel ko zaroor tumharay sath bhej den gay
ayahs.translation: aur jab unn per azab aa-parta to woh kehtay :  aey musa ! tumharay paas Allah ka jo ehad hai , uss ka wasta dey ker humaray liye apney rab say dua kerdo ( kay yeh azab hum say door hojaye ) . aur agar waqaee tum ney hum per say yeh azab hata diya to hum tumhari baat maan len gay , aur bani Israel ko zaroor tumharay sath bhej den gay

ayahs.text: phir jab hum unn per say azab ko , itni mauddat tak hata letay jiss tak unhen phonchna hi tha ,   to woh aik dum apney waday say phir jatay .
ayahs.translation: phir jab hum unn per say azab ko , itni mauddat tak hata letay jiss tak unhen phonchna hi tha ,   to woh aik dum apney waday say phir jatay .

ayahs.text: nateeja yeh huwa kay hum ney unn say badla liya aur unhen samandar mein gharq kerdiya .   kiyonkay unhon ney humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya tha , aur unn say bilkul bey perwa hogaye thay .
ayahs.translation: nateeja yeh huwa kay hum ney unn say badla liya aur unhen samandar mein gharq kerdiya .   kiyonkay unhon ney humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya tha , aur unn say bilkul bey perwa hogaye thay .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ko kamzor samjha jata tha , hum ney unhen uss sarzameen kay mashriq o maghrib ka waris bana diya jiss per hum ney barkaten nazil ki then .   aur bani Israel kay haq mein tumharay rab ka kalma khair poora huwa , kiyonkay unhon ney sabar say kaam liya tha . aur firon aur uss ki qoam jo kuch banati charrhati rahi thi ,   uss sabb ko hum ney malya mait kerdiya .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ko kamzor samjha jata tha , hum ney unhen uss sarzameen kay mashriq o maghrib ka waris bana diya jiss per hum ney barkaten nazil ki then .   aur bani Israel kay haq mein tumharay rab ka kalma khair poora huwa , kiyonkay unhon ney sabar say kaam liya tha . aur firon aur uss ki qoam jo kuch banati charrhati rahi thi ,   uss sabb ko hum ney malya mait kerdiya .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney bani Israel say samandar paar kerwaya , to woh kuch logon  kay paas say guzray jo apney button say lagay bethay thay . bani Israel kehney lagay :  aey musa ! humaray liye bhi koi aisa hi deota bana do jaisay inn logon  kay deota hain .    musa ney kaha :  tum aesay ( ajeeb ) log ho jo jihalat ki baaten kertay ho .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney bani Israel say samandar paar kerwaya , to woh kuch logon  kay paas say guzray jo apney button say lagay bethay thay . bani Israel kehney lagay :  aey musa ! humaray liye bhi koi aisa hi deota bana do jaisay inn logon  kay deota hain .    musa ney kaha :  tum aesay ( ajeeb ) log ho jo jihalat ki baaten kertay ho .

ayahs.text: aray yeh log to woh hain kay jiss dhanday mein lagay huye hain , sabb barbad honey wala hai , aur jo kuch kertay aarahey hain , sabb batil hai .
ayahs.translation: aray yeh log to woh hain kay jiss dhanday mein lagay huye hain , sabb barbad honey wala hai , aur jo kuch kertay aarahey hain , sabb batil hai .

ayahs.text: . ( aur ) kaha kay :  kiya tumharay liye Allah kay siwa koi aur mabood dhoond ker laon ? halankay ussi ney tumhen duniya jahan kay saray logon  per fazilat dey rakhi hai !
ayahs.translation: . ( aur ) kaha kay :  kiya tumharay liye Allah kay siwa koi aur mabood dhoond ker laon ? halankay ussi ney tumhen duniya jahan kay saray logon  per fazilat dey rakhi hai !

ayahs.text: aur ( Allah farmata hai kay ) yaad kero kay hum ney tumhen firon kay logon  say bachaya hai jo tumhen bad-tareen takleefen phonchatay thay . tumharay beton ko qatal ker daaltay thay , aur tumhari aurton ko zinda chorr detay thay . aur uss mein tumharay rab ki taraf say bari aazmaesh thi .
ayahs.translation: aur ( Allah farmata hai kay ) yaad kero kay hum ney tumhen firon kay logon  say bachaya hai jo tumhen bad-tareen takleefen phonchatay thay . tumharay beton ko qatal ker daaltay thay , aur tumhari aurton ko zinda chorr detay thay . aur uss mein tumharay rab ki taraf say bari aazmaesh thi .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney musa say tees raaton ka wada thehraya ( kay unn raaton mein koh-e-toor per aa-ker aetikaf keren ) , phir das raaten mazeed barha ker unn ki takmeel ki ,   aur iss tarah unn kay rab ki thehrai hoi miyaad kul chaalees raaten hogaee . aur musa ney apney bhai Haroon say kaha kay :  meray peechay tum meri qoam mein meray qaeem maqam ban jana , tamam moamlaat durust rakhna aur mufsid logon  kay peechay naa chalna .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney musa say tees raaton ka wada thehraya ( kay unn raaton mein koh-e-toor per aa-ker aetikaf keren ) , phir das raaten mazeed barha ker unn ki takmeel ki ,   aur iss tarah unn kay rab ki thehrai hoi miyaad kul chaalees raaten hogaee . aur musa ney apney bhai Haroon say kaha kay :  meray peechay tum meri qoam mein meray qaeem maqam ban jana , tamam moamlaat durust rakhna aur mufsid logon  kay peechay naa chalna .

ayahs.text: aur jab musa humaray muqarrara waqt per phonchay aur unn ka rab unn say hum kalam huwa , to woh kehney lagay :  meray perwerdigar ! mujhay deedar kera dijiye kay mein aap ko dekh lun .  farmaya :  tum mujhay hergiz nahi dekh sako gay , albatta pahar ki taraf nazar uthao , uss kay baad agar woh apni jagah barqarar raha to tum mujhay dekh lo gay .    phir jab unn kay rab ney pahar per tajalli farmaee to uss ko reza reza kerdiya , aur musa bey hosh ho ker gir parray . baad mein jab unhen hosh aaya to unhon ney kaha :  pak hai aap ki zaat ! mein aap kay huzoor tauba kerta hun , aur ( aap ki iss baat per kay duniya mein koi aap ko nahi dekh sakta ) mein sabb say pehlay emaan lata hun .
ayahs.translation: aur jab musa humaray muqarrara waqt per phonchay aur unn ka rab unn say hum kalam huwa , to woh kehney lagay :  meray perwerdigar ! mujhay deedar kera dijiye kay mein aap ko dekh lun .  farmaya :  tum mujhay hergiz nahi dekh sako gay , albatta pahar ki taraf nazar uthao , uss kay baad agar woh apni jagah barqarar raha to tum mujhay dekh lo gay .    phir jab unn kay rab ney pahar per tajalli farmaee to uss ko reza reza kerdiya , aur musa bey hosh ho ker gir parray . baad mein jab unhen hosh aaya to unhon ney kaha :  pak hai aap ki zaat ! mein aap kay huzoor tauba kerta hun , aur ( aap ki iss baat per kay duniya mein koi aap ko nahi dekh sakta ) mein sabb say pehlay emaan lata hun .

ayahs.text: farmaya :  aey musa ! mein ney apney paygham dey ker aur tum say hum kalam ho ker tumhen tamam insanon per foqiyat di hai . lehaza mein ney jo kuch tumhen diya hai , ussay ley lo , aur aik shukar guzaar shaks ban jao .
ayahs.translation: farmaya :  aey musa ! mein ney apney paygham dey ker aur tum say hum kalam ho ker tumhen tamam insanon per foqiyat di hai . lehaza mein ney jo kuch tumhen diya hai , ussay ley lo , aur aik shukar guzaar shaks ban jao .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney unn kay liye takhtiyon mein her qisam ki naseehat aur her cheez ki tafseel likh di , ( aur yeh hukum diya kay : )  abb iss ko mazbooti say thaam lo , aur apni qoam ko hukum do kay iss kay behtareen ehkaam per amal keren .   mein unqareeb tum ko nafarmano ka ghar dikha dun ga .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney unn kay liye takhtiyon mein her qisam ki naseehat aur her cheez ki tafseel likh di , ( aur yeh hukum diya kay : )  abb iss ko mazbooti say thaam lo , aur apni qoam ko hukum do kay iss kay behtareen ehkaam per amal keren .   mein unqareeb tum ko nafarmano ka ghar dikha dun ga .

ayahs.text: mein apni nishaniyon say unn logon  ko bargushta rakhun ga jo zameen mein nahaq takabbur kertay hain , aur woh agar her tarah ki nishaniyan dekh len to unn per emaan nahi layen gay . aur agar unhen hidayat ka seedha raasta nazar aaye , to uss ko apna tareeqa nahi banayen gay , aur agar gumrahi ka raasta nazar aajaye to uss ko apna tareeqa bana len gay . yeh sabb kuch iss liye hai kay unhon ney humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya , aur unn say bilkul bey perwa hogaye .
ayahs.translation: mein apni nishaniyon say unn logon  ko bargushta rakhun ga jo zameen mein nahaq takabbur kertay hain , aur woh agar her tarah ki nishaniyan dekh len to unn per emaan nahi layen gay . aur agar unhen hidayat ka seedha raasta nazar aaye , to uss ko apna tareeqa nahi banayen gay , aur agar gumrahi ka raasta nazar aajaye to uss ko apna tareeqa bana len gay . yeh sabb kuch iss liye hai kay unhon ney humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya , aur unn say bilkul bey perwa hogaye .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney humari nishaniyon ko aur aakhirat ka samna kernay ko jhutlaya hai , unn kay aemal gharat hogaye hain . unhen jo badla diya jaye ga , woh kissi aur cheez ka nahi , khud unn aemal ka hoga jo woh kertay aaye thay .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney humari nishaniyon ko aur aakhirat ka samna kernay ko jhutlaya hai , unn kay aemal gharat hogaye hain . unhen jo badla diya jaye ga , woh kissi aur cheez ka nahi , khud unn aemal ka hoga jo woh kertay aaye thay .

ayahs.text: aur musa ki qoam ney unn kay janey kay baad apney zewaron say aik bachrra bana liya ( bachrra kiya tha-? ) aik bey jaan jism jiss say bail ki si aawaz nikalti thi !   bhala kiya unhon ney itna bhi nahi dekha kay woh naa unn say baat ker-sakta hai , aur naa unhen koi raasta bata sakta hai-? ( magar ) ussay mabood bana liya , aur ( khud apni janon kay liye ) zalim ban bethay .
ayahs.translation: aur musa ki qoam ney unn kay janey kay baad apney zewaron say aik bachrra bana liya ( bachrra kiya tha-? ) aik bey jaan jism jiss say bail ki si aawaz nikalti thi !   bhala kiya unhon ney itna bhi nahi dekha kay woh naa unn say baat ker-sakta hai , aur naa unhen koi raasta bata sakta hai-? ( magar ) ussay mabood bana liya , aur ( khud apni janon kay liye ) zalim ban bethay .

ayahs.text: aur jab apney kiye per pachtaye , aur samajh gaye kay woh gumrah hogaye hain to kehney lagay :  agar Allah ney hum per reham naa farmaya , aur humari bakhshish naa ki to yaqeenan hum barbad hojayen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur jab apney kiye per pachtaye , aur samajh gaye kay woh gumrah hogaye hain to kehney lagay :  agar Allah ney hum per reham naa farmaya , aur humari bakhshish naa ki to yaqeenan hum barbad hojayen gay .

ayahs.text: aur jab musa ghussay aur ranj mein bharay huye apni qoam kay paas wapis aaye to unhon ney kaha :  tum ney meray baad meri kitni buri numaendagi ki . kiya tum ney itni jald bazi say kaam liya kay apney rab kay hukum ka bhi intizar nahi kiya?  aur ( yeh keh ker ) unhon ney takhtiyan phenk den .   aur apney bhai ( Haroon aleh-assalam ) ka sar pakar ker unn ko apni taraf kheechney lagay . woh bolay :  aey meri maa kay betay ! yaqeen janiye kay inn logon  ney mujhay kamzor samjha , aur qareeb tha kay mujhay qatal hi ker-detay . abb aap dushmanon ko mujh per hansney ka moaqa naa dijiye , aur mujhay inn zalim logon  mein shumar naa kijiye .
ayahs.translation: aur jab musa ghussay aur ranj mein bharay huye apni qoam kay paas wapis aaye to unhon ney kaha :  tum ney meray baad meri kitni buri numaendagi ki . kiya tum ney itni jald bazi say kaam liya kay apney rab kay hukum ka bhi intizar nahi kiya?  aur ( yeh keh ker ) unhon ney takhtiyan phenk den .   aur apney bhai ( Haroon aleh-assalam ) ka sar pakar ker unn ko apni taraf kheechney lagay . woh bolay :  aey meri maa kay betay ! yaqeen janiye kay inn logon  ney mujhay kamzor samjha , aur qareeb tha kay mujhay qatal hi ker-detay . abb aap dushmanon ko mujh per hansney ka moaqa naa dijiye , aur mujhay inn zalim logon  mein shumar naa kijiye .

ayahs.text: musa ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! meri aur meray bhai ki maghfirat farmadey , aur hamen apni rehmat mein dakhil kerday . tu tamam reham kernay walon say barh ker reham kernay wala hai .
ayahs.translation: musa ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! meri aur meray bhai ki maghfirat farmadey , aur hamen apni rehmat mein dakhil kerday . tu tamam reham kernay walon say barh ker reham kernay wala hai .

ayahs.text: . ( Allah ney farmaya : )  jinn logon  ney bachrray ko mabood banaya hai ,unn per jald hi unn kay rab ka ghazab aur dunyawi zindagi hi mein zillat aa-parey gi . jo log iftra perdazi kertay hain , unn ko hum issi tarah saza detay hain .
ayahs.translation: . ( Allah ney farmaya : )  jinn logon  ney bachrray ko mabood banaya hai ,unn per jald hi unn kay rab ka ghazab aur dunyawi zindagi hi mein zillat aa-parey gi . jo log iftra perdazi kertay hain , unn ko hum issi tarah saza detay hain .

ayahs.text: aur jo log buray kaam ker guzren , phir unn kay baad tauba kerlen , aur emaan ley ayen to tumhara rab uss tauba kay baad ( unn kay liye ) boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log buray kaam ker guzren , phir unn kay baad tauba kerlen , aur emaan ley ayen to tumhara rab uss tauba kay baad ( unn kay liye ) boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: aur jab musa ka ghussa thum gaya to unhon ney takhtiyan utha len , aur unn mein jo baaten likhi then , uss mein unn logon  kay liye hidayat aur rehmat ka saman tha jo apney rab say dartay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jab musa ka ghussa thum gaya to unhon ney takhtiyan utha len , aur unn mein jo baaten likhi then , uss mein unn logon  kay liye hidayat aur rehmat ka saman tha jo apney rab say dartay hain .

ayahs.text: aur musa ney apni qoam kay satar aadmi muntakhib kiye , takay unhen humaray tey kiye huye waqt per ( koh-e-toor ) layen .   phir jab unhen zalzalay ney aa-pakra to musa ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! agar aap chahtay to inn ko , aur khud mujh ko bhi pehlay hi halak ker-detay , kiya hum mein say kuch bey waqoofon ki harkat ki wajeh say aap hum sabb ko halak kerden gay ?   ( zahir hai kay nahi . lehaza pata chala kay ) yeh waqiaa aap ki taraf say sirf aik imtihan hai jiss kay zariye aap jiss ko chahen , gumrah kerden , aur jiss ko chahen hidayat dey den . aap hi humaray rakhwalay hain . iss liye hamen moaaf ker-dijiye , aur hum per reham farmaiye . beyshak aap saray moaaf kernay walon say behtar moaaf kernay walay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur musa ney apni qoam kay satar aadmi muntakhib kiye , takay unhen humaray tey kiye huye waqt per ( koh-e-toor ) layen .   phir jab unhen zalzalay ney aa-pakra to musa ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! agar aap chahtay to inn ko , aur khud mujh ko bhi pehlay hi halak ker-detay , kiya hum mein say kuch bey waqoofon ki harkat ki wajeh say aap hum sabb ko halak kerden gay ?   ( zahir hai kay nahi . lehaza pata chala kay ) yeh waqiaa aap ki taraf say sirf aik imtihan hai jiss kay zariye aap jiss ko chahen , gumrah kerden , aur jiss ko chahen hidayat dey den . aap hi humaray rakhwalay hain . iss liye hamen moaaf ker-dijiye , aur hum per reham farmaiye . beyshak aap saray moaaf kernay walon say behtar moaaf kernay walay hain .

ayahs.text: aur humaray liye iss duniya mein bhi bhalai likh dijiye , aur aakhirat mein bhi . hum ( iss gharz kay liye ) aap hi say rujoo kertay hain .  Allah ney farmaya :  apna azab to mein ussi per nazil kerta hun jiss per chahta hun . aur jahan tak meri rehmat ka talluq hai woh her cheez per chai hoi hai .   chunacheh mein yeh rehmat ( mukammal tor per ) unn logon  kay liye likhun ga jo taqwa ikhtiyar keren , aur zakat ada keren , aur jo humari aayaton per emaan rakhen .
ayahs.translation: aur humaray liye iss duniya mein bhi bhalai likh dijiye , aur aakhirat mein bhi . hum ( iss gharz kay liye ) aap hi say rujoo kertay hain .  Allah ney farmaya :  apna azab to mein ussi per nazil kerta hun jiss per chahta hun . aur jahan tak meri rehmat ka talluq hai woh her cheez per chai hoi hai .   chunacheh mein yeh rehmat ( mukammal tor per ) unn logon  kay liye likhun ga jo taqwa ikhtiyar keren , aur zakat ada keren , aur jo humari aayaton per emaan rakhen .

ayahs.text: jo uss Rasool , yani nabi ummi kay peechay chalen jiss ka ziker woh apney paas toraat aur injeel mein likha huwa payen gay ,   jo unhen achi baaton ka hukum dey ga , buraiyon say rokay ga , aur unn kay liye pakeezah cheezon ko halal aur gandi cheezon ko haram qarar dey ga , aur unn per say woh bojh aur galay kay woh toq utaar dey ga jo unn per laday huye thay .   chunacheh jo log uss ( nabi ) per emaan layen gay ,uss ki taazeem keren gay uss ki madad keren gay , aur uss kay sath jo noor utaara gaya hai , uss kay peechay chalen gay , to wohi log falah paaney walay hon gay .
ayahs.translation: jo uss Rasool , yani nabi ummi kay peechay chalen jiss ka ziker woh apney paas toraat aur injeel mein likha huwa payen gay ,   jo unhen achi baaton ka hukum dey ga , buraiyon say rokay ga , aur unn kay liye pakeezah cheezon ko halal aur gandi cheezon ko haram qarar dey ga , aur unn per say woh bojh aur galay kay woh toq utaar dey ga jo unn per laday huye thay .   chunacheh jo log uss ( nabi ) per emaan layen gay ,uss ki taazeem keren gay uss ki madad keren gay , aur uss kay sath jo noor utaara gaya hai , uss kay peechay chalen gay , to wohi log falah paaney walay hon gay .

ayahs.text: . ( aey Rasool ! inn say ) kaho kay :  aey logo ! mein tum sabb ki taraf uss Allah ka bheja huwa Rasool hun   jiss kay qabazay mein tamam aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat hai . uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . wohi zindagi aur moat deta hai . abb tum Allah per aur uss kay Rasool per emaan ley aao jo nabi ummi hai , aur jo Allah per aur uss kay kalmaat per emaan rakhta hai , aur uss ki perwi kero , takay tumhen hidayat hasil ho .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey Rasool ! inn say ) kaho kay :  aey logo ! mein tum sabb ki taraf uss Allah ka bheja huwa Rasool hun   jiss kay qabazay mein tamam aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat hai . uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . wohi zindagi aur moat deta hai . abb tum Allah per aur uss kay Rasool per emaan ley aao jo nabi ummi hai , aur jo Allah per aur uss kay kalmaat per emaan rakhta hai , aur uss ki perwi kero , takay tumhen hidayat hasil ho .

ayahs.text: aur musa ki qoam mein aik jamat aesi bhi hai jo logon  ko haq ka raasta dikhati hai , aur ussi ( haq ) kay mutabiq insaf say kaam leti hai .
ayahs.translation: aur musa ki qoam mein aik jamat aesi bhi hai jo logon  ko haq ka raasta dikhati hai , aur ussi ( haq ) kay mutabiq insaf say kaam leti hai .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney unn ko ( yani bani Israel ko ) baara khandano mein iss tarah taqseem kerdiya tha kay woh alag alag ( intizami ) jamaton ki soorat ikhtiyar ker gaye thay . aur jab musa ki qoam ney unn say paani maanga to hum ney unn ko wahi kay zariye hukum diya kay apni laathi falan pathar per maaro .   chunacheh uss pathar say baara chashmay phoot parray . her khandan ko apni paani peenay ki jagah maloom hogaee . aur hum ney unn ko badal ka saya diya , aur hum ney unn per mann-o-salwa ( yeh keh ker ) utaara kay :  khao woh pakeezah rizq jo hum ney tumhen diya hai .  aur ( iss kay bawajood unhon ney jo nashukri ki to ) unhon ney humara koi nuqsan nahi kiya , balkay woh khud apni janon per zulm kertay rahey .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney unn ko ( yani bani Israel ko ) baara khandano mein iss tarah taqseem kerdiya tha kay woh alag alag ( intizami ) jamaton ki soorat ikhtiyar ker gaye thay . aur jab musa ki qoam ney unn say paani maanga to hum ney unn ko wahi kay zariye hukum diya kay apni laathi falan pathar per maaro .   chunacheh uss pathar say baara chashmay phoot parray . her khandan ko apni paani peenay ki jagah maloom hogaee . aur hum ney unn ko badal ka saya diya , aur hum ney unn per mann-o-salwa ( yeh keh ker ) utaara kay :  khao woh pakeezah rizq jo hum ney tumhen diya hai .  aur ( iss kay bawajood unhon ney jo nashukri ki to ) unhon ney humara koi nuqsan nahi kiya , balkay woh khud apni janon per zulm kertay rahey .

ayahs.text: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab unn say kaha gaya tha kay :  uss basti mein jaker bus jao , aur uss mein jahan say chahao khao , aur yeh kehtay jana kay ( ya Allah ! ) hum aap ki bakhshish kay talab gaar hain , aur ( basti kay ) darwazay mein jhukay huye saron kay sath dakhil hona , to hum tumhari khatayen moaaf kerden gay , ( aur ) naiki kernay walon ko aur ziyada ( sawab ) bhi den gay .
ayahs.translation: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab unn say kaha gaya tha kay :  uss basti mein jaker bus jao , aur uss mein jahan say chahao khao , aur yeh kehtay jana kay ( ya Allah ! ) hum aap ki bakhshish kay talab gaar hain , aur ( basti kay ) darwazay mein jhukay huye saron kay sath dakhil hona , to hum tumhari khatayen moaaf kerden gay , ( aur ) naiki kernay walon ko aur ziyada ( sawab ) bhi den gay .

ayahs.text: phir huwa yeh kay jo baat unn say kahi gaee thi , unn mein say zalim logon  ney ussay badal ker doosri baat bana li . tab hum ney unn ki musalsal ziyadtiyon ki wajeh say unn per aasman say azab bheja .
ayahs.translation: phir huwa yeh kay jo baat unn say kahi gaee thi , unn mein say zalim logon  ney ussay badal ker doosri baat bana li . tab hum ney unn ki musalsal ziyadtiyon ki wajeh say unn per aasman say azab bheja .

ayahs.text: aur unn say uss basti kay baaray mein poocho jo samandar kay kinaray abad thi , jab woh sabt ( saneechar ) kay moamlay mein ziyadtiyan kertay thay .   jab unn ( kay samandar ) ki machliyan saneechar kay din to uchal uchal ker samney aati then , aur jab woh saneechar ka din naa mana rahey hotay , to woh nahi aati then . iss tarah unn ki musalsal nafarmaniyon ki wajeh say hum unhen aazmatay thay .
ayahs.translation: aur unn say uss basti kay baaray mein poocho jo samandar kay kinaray abad thi , jab woh sabt ( saneechar ) kay moamlay mein ziyadtiyan kertay thay .   jab unn ( kay samandar ) ki machliyan saneechar kay din to uchal uchal ker samney aati then , aur jab woh saneechar ka din naa mana rahey hotay , to woh nahi aati then . iss tarah unn ki musalsal nafarmaniyon ki wajeh say hum unhen aazmatay thay .

ayahs.text: aur ( woh waqt unhen yaad dilao ) jab unhi kay aik giroh ney ( doosray giroh say ) kaha tha kay :  tum unn logon  ko kiyon naseehat ker rahey ho jinhen Allah ya to halak kernay wala hai , ya koi sakht qisam ka azab denay wala hai ?    doosray giroh kay logon  ney kaha kay :  yeh hum iss liye kertay hain takay tumharay rab kay huzoor bari-uz-zimma hosaken , aur shayad iss ( naseehat say ) yeh log perhezgari ikhtiyar kerlen .
ayahs.translation: aur ( woh waqt unhen yaad dilao ) jab unhi kay aik giroh ney ( doosray giroh say ) kaha tha kay :  tum unn logon  ko kiyon naseehat ker rahey ho jinhen Allah ya to halak kernay wala hai , ya koi sakht qisam ka azab denay wala hai ?    doosray giroh kay logon  ney kaha kay :  yeh hum iss liye kertay hain takay tumharay rab kay huzoor bari-uz-zimma hosaken , aur shayad iss ( naseehat say ) yeh log perhezgari ikhtiyar kerlen .

ayahs.text: phir jab yeh log woh baat bhula bethay jiss ki unhen naseehat ki gaee thi to burai say rokney walon ko to hum ney bacha liya , aur jinhon ney ziyadtiyan ki then , unn ki musalsal nafarmani ki bana per hum ney unhen aik sakht azab mein pakar liya .
ayahs.translation: phir jab yeh log woh baat bhula bethay jiss ki unhen naseehat ki gaee thi to burai say rokney walon ko to hum ney bacha liya , aur jinhon ney ziyadtiyan ki then , unn ki musalsal nafarmani ki bana per hum ney unhen aik sakht azab mein pakar liya .

ayahs.text: chunacheh huwa yeh kay jiss kaam say unhen roka gaya tha , jab unhon ney uss kay khilaf sarkashi ki to hum ney unn say kaha :  jao , zaleel bandar ban jao .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney duniya mein unn ko mukhtalif jamaton mein baant diya . chunacheh unn mein naik log bhi thay , aur kuch doosri tarah kay log bhi . aur hum ney unhen achay aur buray halaat say aazmaya , takay woh ( raah-e-raast ki taraf ) loat ayen .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney duniya mein unn ko mukhtalif jamaton mein baant diya . chunacheh unn mein naik log bhi thay , aur kuch doosri tarah kay log bhi . aur hum ney unhen achay aur buray halaat say aazmaya , takay woh ( raah-e-raast ki taraf ) loat ayen .

ayahs.text: phir unn kay baad unn ki jagah aesay janasheen aaye jo kitab ( yani toraat ) kay waris banay , magar unn ka haal yeh tha kay iss/ zaleel duniya ka saz-o-saman ( rishwat mein ) letay , aur yeh kehtay kay :  humari bakhshish hojaye gi  halankay agar ussi jaisa saz-o-saman dobara unn kay paas aata to woh ussay bhi ( rishwat mein ) ley letay .   kiya unn say kitab mein mazkoor yeh ehad nahi liya gaya tha kay woh Allah ki taraf haq kay siwa koi baat mansoob naa keren-? aur uss ( kitab ) mein jo kuch likha tha , woh unhon ney ba-qaeeda parha bhi tha . aur aakhirat wala ghar unn logon  kay liye kahen behtar hai jo taqwa ikhtiyar kertay hain . ( aey yahood ! ) kiya phir bhi tum aqal say kaam nahi letay-?
ayahs.translation: phir unn kay baad unn ki jagah aesay janasheen aaye jo kitab ( yani toraat ) kay waris banay , magar unn ka haal yeh tha kay iss/ zaleel duniya ka saz-o-saman ( rishwat mein ) letay , aur yeh kehtay kay :  humari bakhshish hojaye gi  halankay agar ussi jaisa saz-o-saman dobara unn kay paas aata to woh ussay bhi ( rishwat mein ) ley letay .   kiya unn say kitab mein mazkoor yeh ehad nahi liya gaya tha kay woh Allah ki taraf haq kay siwa koi baat mansoob naa keren-? aur uss ( kitab ) mein jo kuch likha tha , woh unhon ney ba-qaeeda parha bhi tha . aur aakhirat wala ghar unn logon  kay liye kahen behtar hai jo taqwa ikhtiyar kertay hain . ( aey yahood ! ) kiya phir bhi tum aqal say kaam nahi letay-?

ayahs.text: aur jo log kitab ko mazbooti say thamtay hain , aur namaz qaeem kertay hain , to hum aesay islaah kernay walon ka ajar zaya nahi kertay .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log kitab ko mazbooti say thamtay hain , aur namaz qaeem kertay hain , to hum aesay islaah kernay walon ka ajar zaya nahi kertay .

ayahs.text: aur ( yaad kero ) jab hum ney pahar ko inn/unn kay oopper iss/uss tarah utha diya tha jaisay woh koi sayeban ho ,   aur enhen/unhen yeh gumaan hogaya tha kay woh inn/unn kay oopper girney hi wala hai , ( iss/uss waqt hum ney hukum diya tha kay : )  hum ney tumhen jo kitab di hai , ussay/issay mazbooti say thaamo , aur iss/uss ki baaton ko yaad kero , takay tum taqwa ikhtiyar ker-sako-? .
ayahs.translation: aur ( yaad kero ) jab hum ney pahar ko inn/unn kay oopper iss/uss tarah utha diya tha jaisay woh koi sayeban ho ,   aur enhen/unhen yeh gumaan hogaya tha kay woh inn/unn kay oopper girney hi wala hai , ( iss/uss waqt hum ney hukum diya tha kay : )  hum ney tumhen jo kitab di hai , ussay/issay mazbooti say thaamo , aur iss/uss ki baaton ko yaad kero , takay tum taqwa ikhtiyar ker-sako-? .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey Rasool ! logon  ko woh waqt yaad dilao ) jab tumharay perwerdigar ney Adam kay beton ki pusht say unn ki sari aulad ko nikala tha , aur unn ko khud apney oopper gawah banaya tha , ( aur poocha tha kay : )  kiya mein tumhara rab nahi hun-?  sabb ney jawab diya tha kay :  kiyon nahi-? hum sabb iss baat ki gawahi detay hain .    ( aur yeh iqrar hum ney iss liye liya tha ) takay tum qayamat kay din yeh naa keh sako kay :  hum to iss baat say bey khabar thay .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey Rasool ! logon  ko woh waqt yaad dilao ) jab tumharay perwerdigar ney Adam kay beton ki pusht say unn ki sari aulad ko nikala tha , aur unn ko khud apney oopper gawah banaya tha , ( aur poocha tha kay : )  kiya mein tumhara rab nahi hun-?  sabb ney jawab diya tha kay :  kiyon nahi-? hum sabb iss baat ki gawahi detay hain .    ( aur yeh iqrar hum ney iss liye liya tha ) takay tum qayamat kay din yeh naa keh sako kay :  hum to iss baat say bey khabar thay .

ayahs.text: ya yeh naa keh do kay :  shirk ( ka aaghaz ) to boht pehlay humaray baap dadon ney kiya tha , aur hum unn kay baad unhi ki aulad banay . to kiya aap hamen unn kamon ki wajeh say halak kerden gay jo ghalat kaar logon  ney kiye thay ?
ayahs.translation: ya yeh naa keh do kay :  shirk ( ka aaghaz ) to boht pehlay humaray baap dadon ney kiya tha , aur hum unn kay baad unhi ki aulad banay . to kiya aap hamen unn kamon ki wajeh say halak kerden gay jo ghalat kaar logon  ney kiye thay ?

ayahs.text: aur issi tarah hum nishaniyon ko tafseel say biyan kertay hain , takay log ( haq ki taraf ) palat ayen .
ayahs.translation: aur issi tarah hum nishaniyon ko tafseel say biyan kertay hain , takay log ( haq ki taraf ) palat ayen .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey Rasool ! ) inn ko uss shaks ka waqiaa parh ker sunao jiss ko hum ney apni aayaten ata farmayen magar woh unn ko bilkul hi chorr nikla , phir shetan uss kay peechay laga , jiss ka nateeja yeh huwa kay woh gumrah logon  mein shamil hogaya .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey Rasool ! ) inn ko uss shaks ka waqiaa parh ker sunao jiss ko hum ney apni aayaten ata farmayen magar woh unn ko bilkul hi chorr nikla , phir shetan uss kay peechay laga , jiss ka nateeja yeh huwa kay woh gumrah logon  mein shamil hogaya .

ayahs.text: aur agar hum chahtay to inn aayaton ki badolat ussay sarbuland kertay , magar woh to zameen hi ki taraf jhuk ker reh gaya , aur apni khuwaishaat kay peechay parra raha , iss liye uss ki misal uss kuttay ki si hogaee kay agar tum uss per hamla kero tab bhi woh zaban latka ker haanpay ga , aur agar ussay ( uss kay haal per ) chorr do tab bhi zaban latka ker haanpay ga .   yeh hai misal unn logon  ki jinhon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai . lehaza tum yeh waqiyaat unn ko sunatay raho , takay yeh kuch sochen .
ayahs.translation: aur agar hum chahtay to inn aayaton ki badolat ussay sarbuland kertay , magar woh to zameen hi ki taraf jhuk ker reh gaya , aur apni khuwaishaat kay peechay parra raha , iss liye uss ki misal uss kuttay ki si hogaee kay agar tum uss per hamla kero tab bhi woh zaban latka ker haanpay ga , aur agar ussay ( uss kay haal per ) chorr do tab bhi zaban latka ker haanpay ga .   yeh hai misal unn logon  ki jinhon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai . lehaza tum yeh waqiyaat unn ko sunatay raho , takay yeh kuch sochen .

ayahs.text: kitni buri misal hai unn logon  ki jinhon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , aur jo apni janon per zulm kertay rahey hain !
ayahs.translation: kitni buri misal hai unn logon  ki jinhon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , aur jo apni janon per zulm kertay rahey hain !

ayahs.text: jissay Allah hidayat dey , bus wohi hidayat yafta hota hai , aur jissay woh gumrah kerday , to aesay hi log hain jo nuqsan uthatay hain .
ayahs.translation: jissay Allah hidayat dey , bus wohi hidayat yafta hota hai , aur jissay woh gumrah kerday , to aesay hi log hain jo nuqsan uthatay hain .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney jinnaat aur insanon mein say boht say log jahannum kay liye peda kiye .   unn kay paas dil hain jinn say woh samajhtay nahi , unn kay paas aankhen hain jinn say woh dekhtay nahi , aur unn kay paas kaan hain jinn say woh suntay nahi . woh log chopayo ki tarah hain , balkay woh unn say bhi ziyada bhatkay huye hain . yehi log hain jo ghaflat mein parray huye hain .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney jinnaat aur insanon mein say boht say log jahannum kay liye peda kiye .   unn kay paas dil hain jinn say woh samajhtay nahi , unn kay paas aankhen hain jinn say woh dekhtay nahi , aur unn kay paas kaan hain jinn say woh suntay nahi . woh log chopayo ki tarah hain , balkay woh unn say bhi ziyada bhatkay huye hain . yehi log hain jo ghaflat mein parray huye hain .

ayahs.text: aur asmaye hussna ( achay achay naam ) Allah hi kay hain . lehaza uss ko unhi naamon say pukaro ,   aur unn logon  ko chorr do jo uss kay naamon mein tairrah raasta ikhtiyar kertay hain .   woh jo kuch ker rahey hain , uss ka badla unhen diya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: aur asmaye hussna ( achay achay naam ) Allah hi kay hain . lehaza uss ko unhi naamon say pukaro ,   aur unn logon  ko chorr do jo uss kay naamon mein tairrah raasta ikhtiyar kertay hain .   woh jo kuch ker rahey hain , uss ka badla unhen diya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur humari makhlooq mein aik jamat aesi bhi hai jo logon  ko haq ka raasta dikhati hai , aur ussi ( haq ) kay mutabiq insaf say kaam leti hai .
ayahs.translation: aur humari makhlooq mein aik jamat aesi bhi hai jo logon  ko haq ka raasta dikhati hai , aur ussi ( haq ) kay mutabiq insaf say kaam leti hai .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , unhen hum iss tarah dheeray dheeray pakar mein len gay kay unhen pata bhi nahi chalay ga .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , unhen hum iss tarah dheeray dheeray pakar mein len gay kay unhen pata bhi nahi chalay ga .

ayahs.text: aur mein unn ko dheel deta hun , yaqeen jano kay meri khufiya tadbeer bari mazboot hai .
ayahs.translation: aur mein unn ko dheel deta hun , yaqeen jano kay meri khufiya tadbeer bari mazboot hai .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya inn logon  ney socha nahi kay yeh sahab jinn say inn ka sabiqa hai , ( yani aan-Hazrat SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) inn mein junoon ka koi shayeba nahi hai . woh aur kuch nahi , balkay saaf saaf tareeqay say logon  ko mutanabeh kernay walay hain .
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya inn logon  ney socha nahi kay yeh sahab jinn say inn ka sabiqa hai , ( yani aan-Hazrat SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) inn mein junoon ka koi shayeba nahi hai . woh aur kuch nahi , balkay saaf saaf tareeqay say logon  ko mutanabeh kernay walay hain .

ayahs.text: aur kiya inn logon  ney aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat per aur Allah ney jo jo cheezen peda ki hain unn per ghor nahi kiya , aur yeh ( nahi socha ) kay shayad unn ka muqarrara waqt qareeb hi aa-phoncha ho-? abb iss kay baad aakhir woh konsi baat hai jiss per yeh emaan layen gay ?
ayahs.translation: aur kiya inn logon  ney aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat per aur Allah ney jo jo cheezen peda ki hain unn per ghor nahi kiya , aur yeh ( nahi socha ) kay shayad unn ka muqarrara waqt qareeb hi aa-phoncha ho-? abb iss kay baad aakhir woh konsi baat hai jiss per yeh emaan layen gay ?

ayahs.text: jiss ko Allah gumrah kerday , uss ko koi hidayat nahi dey sakta , aur aesay logon  ko Allah ( bey-yaro-madadgaar ) chorr deta hai kay woh apni sarkashi mein bhataktay phiren .
ayahs.translation: jiss ko Allah gumrah kerday , uss ko koi hidayat nahi dey sakta , aur aesay logon  ko Allah ( bey-yaro-madadgaar ) chorr deta hai kay woh apni sarkashi mein bhataktay phiren .

ayahs.text: . ( aey Rasool ! ) log tum say qayamat kay baaray mein poochtay hain kay woh kab barpa hogi-? keh do kay :  uss ka ilm to sirf meray rab kay paas hai . wohi ussay apney waqt per khol ker dikhaye ga , koi aur nahi . woh aasmano aur zameen mein bari bhari cheez hai , jab aaye gi to tumharay paas achanak aajaye gi .  yeh log tum say iss tarah poochtay hain jaisay tum ney uss ki poori tehqeeq ker rakhi hai . keh do kay :  uss ka ilm sirf Allah kay paas hai , lekin aksar log ( iss baat ko ) nahi jantay .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey Rasool ! ) log tum say qayamat kay baaray mein poochtay hain kay woh kab barpa hogi-? keh do kay :  uss ka ilm to sirf meray rab kay paas hai . wohi ussay apney waqt per khol ker dikhaye ga , koi aur nahi . woh aasmano aur zameen mein bari bhari cheez hai , jab aaye gi to tumharay paas achanak aajaye gi .  yeh log tum say iss tarah poochtay hain jaisay tum ney uss ki poori tehqeeq ker rakhi hai . keh do kay :  uss ka ilm sirf Allah kay paas hai , lekin aksar log ( iss baat ko ) nahi jantay .

ayahs.text: kaho kay :  jab tak Allah naa chahye , mein khud apney aap ko bhi koi nafaa ya nuqsan phonchaney ka ikhtiyar nahi rakhta , aur agar mujhay ghaib ka ilm hota to mein achi achi cheezen khoob jama kerta , aur mujhay kabhi koi takleef hi naa phonchti .   mein to bus aik hoshiyar kernay wala aur khushkhabri sunaney wala hun , unn logon  kay liye jo meri baat maanen .
ayahs.translation: kaho kay :  jab tak Allah naa chahye , mein khud apney aap ko bhi koi nafaa ya nuqsan phonchaney ka ikhtiyar nahi rakhta , aur agar mujhay ghaib ka ilm hota to mein achi achi cheezen khoob jama kerta , aur mujhay kabhi koi takleef hi naa phonchti .   mein to bus aik hoshiyar kernay wala aur khushkhabri sunaney wala hun , unn logon  kay liye jo meri baat maanen .

ayahs.text: Allah woh hai jiss ney tumhen aik jaan say peda kiya , aur ussi say uss ki biwi banai , takay woh uss kay paas aa-ker taskeen hasil keray .   phir jab mard ney aurat ko dhaank liya to aurat ney hamal ka aik halka saa bojh utha liya , jissay ley ker woh chalti phirti rahi .   phir jab woh bojhal hogaee to dono ( miyan biwi ) ney apney perwerdigar Allah say dua ki kay :  agar tu ney hamen tandurust aulad di to hum zaroor bil-zaroor tera shukar ada keren gay .
ayahs.translation: Allah woh hai jiss ney tumhen aik jaan say peda kiya , aur ussi say uss ki biwi banai , takay woh uss kay paas aa-ker taskeen hasil keray .   phir jab mard ney aurat ko dhaank liya to aurat ney hamal ka aik halka saa bojh utha liya , jissay ley ker woh chalti phirti rahi .   phir jab woh bojhal hogaee to dono ( miyan biwi ) ney apney perwerdigar Allah say dua ki kay :  agar tu ney hamen tandurust aulad di to hum zaroor bil-zaroor tera shukar ada keren gay .

ayahs.text: lekin jab Allah ney unn ko aik tandurust baccha dey diya to unn dono ney Allah ki ata ki hoi naimat mein Allah kay sath doosron ko shareek thehrana shuroo kerdiya , halankay Allah unn ki mushrikana baaton say kahen buland aur bartar hai .
ayahs.translation: lekin jab Allah ney unn ko aik tandurust baccha dey diya to unn dono ney Allah ki ata ki hoi naimat mein Allah kay sath doosron ko shareek thehrana shuroo kerdiya , halankay Allah unn ki mushrikana baaton say kahen buland aur bartar hai .

ayahs.text: kiya woh aesi cheezon ko ( Allah kay sath khudai mein ) shareek mantay hain jo koi cheez peda nahi kertay , balkay khud unn ko peda kiya jata hai ?
ayahs.translation: kiya woh aesi cheezon ko ( Allah kay sath khudai mein ) shareek mantay hain jo koi cheez peda nahi kertay , balkay khud unn ko peda kiya jata hai ?

ayahs.text: aur jo naa unn logon  ki koi madad ker-saktay hain , aur naa khud apni madad kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jo naa unn logon  ki koi madad ker-saktay hain , aur naa khud apni madad kertay hain .

ayahs.text: aur agar tum unhen kissi sahih raastay ki taraf dawat do to woh tumhari baat naa maanen , ( balkay ) tum unhen pukaro ya khamosh raho , unn kay liye dono baaten barabar hain .
ayahs.translation: aur agar tum unhen kissi sahih raastay ki taraf dawat do to woh tumhari baat naa maanen , ( balkay ) tum unhen pukaro ya khamosh raho , unn kay liye dono baaten barabar hain .

ayahs.text: yaqeen jano kay Allah ko chorr ker jinn jinn ko tum pukartay ho , woh sabb tumhari tarah ( Allah kay ) banday hain . abb zara unn say dua maango , phir agar tum sachay ho to unhen tumhari dua qubool kerni chahiye .
ayahs.translation: yaqeen jano kay Allah ko chorr ker jinn jinn ko tum pukartay ho , woh sabb tumhari tarah ( Allah kay ) banday hain . abb zara unn say dua maango , phir agar tum sachay ho to unhen tumhari dua qubool kerni chahiye .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya unn kay paas paon hain jinn say woh chalen-? ya unn kay paas haath hain jinn say woh pakren ya unn kay paas aankhen hain jinn say woh dekhen-? ya unn kay paas kaan hain jinn say woh sunen-? ( unn say keh do kay : )  tum unn sabb deotaon ko bula lao jinhen tum ney Allah ka shareek bana rakha hai , phir meray khilaf koi sazish kero , aur mujhay zara bhi mohlat naa do .
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya unn kay paas paon hain jinn say woh chalen-? ya unn kay paas haath hain jinn say woh pakren ya unn kay paas aankhen hain jinn say woh dekhen-? ya unn kay paas kaan hain jinn say woh sunen-? ( unn say keh do kay : )  tum unn sabb deotaon ko bula lao jinhen tum ney Allah ka shareek bana rakha hai , phir meray khilaf koi sazish kero , aur mujhay zara bhi mohlat naa do .

ayahs.text: mera rakhwala to Allah hai jiss ney kitab nazil ki hai , aur woh naik logon  ki rakhwali kerta hai .
ayahs.translation: mera rakhwala to Allah hai jiss ney kitab nazil ki hai , aur woh naik logon  ki rakhwali kerta hai .

ayahs.text: aur tum uss ko chorr ker jinn jinn ko pukartay ho woh naa tumhari madad ker-saktay hain , naa apni madad kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur tum uss ko chorr ker jinn jinn ko pukartay ho woh naa tumhari madad ker-saktay hain , naa apni madad kertay hain .

ayahs.text: aur agar tum unhen sahih raastay ki taraf bulao to woh sunen gay bhi nahi . woh tumhen nazar to iss tarah aatay hain jaisay tumhen dekh rahey hon , lekin haqeeqat mein unhen kuch sujhai nahi deta .
ayahs.translation: aur agar tum unhen sahih raastay ki taraf bulao to woh sunen gay bhi nahi . woh tumhen nazar to iss tarah aatay hain jaisay tumhen dekh rahey hon , lekin haqeeqat mein unhen kuch sujhai nahi deta .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) darguzar ka ravaiyya apnao , aur ( logon  ko ) naiki ka hukum do , aur jahilon ki taraf dhiyan naa do .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) darguzar ka ravaiyya apnao , aur ( logon  ko ) naiki ka hukum do , aur jahilon ki taraf dhiyan naa do .

ayahs.text: aur agar kabhi shetan ki taraf say tumhen koi kachoka lagg jaye to Allah ki panah maang lo .   yaqeenan woh her baat sunney wala , her cheez janney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur agar kabhi shetan ki taraf say tumhen koi kachoka lagg jaye to Allah ki panah maang lo .   yaqeenan woh her baat sunney wala , her cheez janney wala hai .

ayahs.text: jinn logon  ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya hai , unhen jab shetan ki taraf say koi khayal aa-ker choota bhi hai to woh ( Allah ko ) yaad kerletay hain ,   chunacheh achanak unn ki aankhen khul jati hain
ayahs.translation: jinn logon  ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya hai , unhen jab shetan ki taraf say koi khayal aa-ker choota bhi hai to woh ( Allah ko ) yaad kerletay hain ,   chunacheh achanak unn ki aankhen khul jati hain

ayahs.text: aur jo inn shayateen kay bhai hain , unn ko yeh shayateen gumrahi mein ghaseetay ley jatay hain , nateeja yeh kay woh ( gumrahi say ) baaz nahi aatay .
ayahs.translation: aur jo inn shayateen kay bhai hain , unn ko yeh shayateen gumrahi mein ghaseetay ley jatay hain , nateeja yeh kay woh ( gumrahi say ) baaz nahi aatay .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab tum inn kay samney ( inn ka mun maanga ) moajza paish nahi kertay to yeh kehtay hain kay :  tum ney yeh moajza khud apni pasand say kiyon naa paish kerdiya-?  keh do kay :  mein to ussi baat ka ittaba kerta hun jo meray rab ki taraf say wahi kay zariye mujh tak phonchai jati hai .   . yeh ( Quran ) tumharay rab ki taraf say baseeraton ka majmooa hai , aur jo log emaan layen unn kay liye hidayat aur rehmat !
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab tum inn kay samney ( inn ka mun maanga ) moajza paish nahi kertay to yeh kehtay hain kay :  tum ney yeh moajza khud apni pasand say kiyon naa paish kerdiya-?  keh do kay :  mein to ussi baat ka ittaba kerta hun jo meray rab ki taraf say wahi kay zariye mujh tak phonchai jati hai .   . yeh ( Quran ) tumharay rab ki taraf say baseeraton ka majmooa hai , aur jo log emaan layen unn kay liye hidayat aur rehmat !

ayahs.text: aur jab Quran parha jaye to uss ko kaan laga ker suno , aur khamosh raho takay tum per rehmat ho .
ayahs.translation: aur jab Quran parha jaye to uss ko kaan laga ker suno , aur khamosh raho takay tum per rehmat ho .

ayahs.text: aur apney rab ka subha o shaam ziker kiya kero , apney dil mein bhi , aajzi aur khof kay ( jazbaat kay ) sath , aur zaban say bhi , aawaz boht buland kiye baghair ! aur unn logon  mein shamil naa hojana jo ghaflat mein parray huye hain .
ayahs.translation: aur apney rab ka subha o shaam ziker kiya kero , apney dil mein bhi , aajzi aur khof kay ( jazbaat kay ) sath , aur zaban say bhi , aawaz boht buland kiye baghair ! aur unn logon  mein shamil naa hojana jo ghaflat mein parray huye hain .

ayahs.text: yaad rakho kay jo ( farishtay ) tumharay rab kay paas hain , woh uss ki ibadat say takabbur ker kay mun nahi morrtay , aur uss ki tasbeeh kertay hain , aur ussi kay aagay sajda rez hotay hain .
ayahs.translation: yaad rakho kay jo ( farishtay ) tumharay rab kay paas hain , woh uss ki ibadat say takabbur ker kay mun nahi morrtay , aur uss ki tasbeeh kertay hain , aur ussi kay aagay sajda rez hotay hain .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) log tum say maal-e-ghaneemat kay baaray mein poochtay hain . keh do kay maal-e-ghaneemat ( kay baaray mein faislay ) ka ikhtiyar Allah aur Rasool ko hasil hai . lehaza tum Allah say daro , aur aapas kay talluqaat durust kerlo ,   aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki itaat kero , agar tum waqaee momin ho .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) log tum say maal-e-ghaneemat kay baaray mein poochtay hain . keh do kay maal-e-ghaneemat ( kay baaray mein faislay ) ka ikhtiyar Allah aur Rasool ko hasil hai . lehaza tum Allah say daro , aur aapas kay talluqaat durust kerlo ,   aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki itaat kero , agar tum waqaee momin ho .

verses.text: momin to woh log hain kay jab unn kay samney Allah ka ziker hota hai to unn kay dil darr jatay hain , aur jab unn kay samney uss ki aayaten parhi jati hain to woh aayaten unn kay emaan ko aur taraqqi deti hain , aur woh apney perwerdigar per bharosa kertay hain .
verses.translation: momin to woh log hain kay jab unn kay samney Allah ka ziker hota hai to unn kay dil darr jatay hain , aur jab unn kay samney uss ki aayaten parhi jati hain to woh aayaten unn kay emaan ko aur taraqqi deti hain , aur woh apney perwerdigar per bharosa kertay hain .

verses.text: jo namaz qaeem kertay hain , aur hum ney unn ko jo rizq diya hai , uss mein say ( fi sabeel Allah ) kharch kertay hain .
verses.translation: jo namaz qaeem kertay hain , aur hum ney unn ko jo rizq diya hai , uss mein say ( fi sabeel Allah ) kharch kertay hain .

verses.text: yehi log hain jo haqeeqat mein momin hain . inn kay liye inn kay rab kay paas baray darjay hain , maghfirat hai , aur ba-izzat rizq hai .
verses.translation: yehi log hain jo haqeeqat mein momin hain . inn kay liye inn kay rab kay paas baray darjay hain , maghfirat hai , aur ba-izzat rizq hai .

verses.text: . ( maal-e-ghaneemat ki taqseem ka ) yeh moamla kuch aisa hi hai jaisay tumharay rab ney tumhen apney ghar say haq ki khatir nikala , jabkay musalmanon kay aik giroh ko yeh baat napasand thi .
verses.translation: . ( maal-e-ghaneemat ki taqseem ka ) yeh moamla kuch aisa hi hai jaisay tumharay rab ney tumhen apney ghar say haq ki khatir nikala , jabkay musalmanon kay aik giroh ko yeh baat napasand thi .

verses.text: woh tum say haq kay moamlay mein uss kay wazeh hojaney kay bawajood iss tarah behas ker rahey thay jaisay unn ko moat ki taraf hanka kerlay jaya jaraha ho , aur woh ( ussay ) aankhon say dekh rahey hon .
verses.translation: woh tum say haq kay moamlay mein uss kay wazeh hojaney kay bawajood iss tarah behas ker rahey thay jaisay unn ko moat ki taraf hanka kerlay jaya jaraha ho , aur woh ( ussay ) aankhon say dekh rahey hon .

verses.text: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab Allah tum say yeh wada ker raha tha kay do girohon mein say koi aik tumhara hoga , aur tumhari khuwaish thi kay jiss giroh mein ( khatray ka ) koi kaantta nahi tha , woh tumhen milay   aur Allah yeh chahta tha kay apney ehkaam say haq ko haq ker dikhaye , aur kafiron ki jarr kaat daalay .
verses.translation: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab Allah tum say yeh wada ker raha tha kay do girohon mein say koi aik tumhara hoga , aur tumhari khuwaish thi kay jiss giroh mein ( khatray ka ) koi kaantta nahi tha , woh tumhen milay   aur Allah yeh chahta tha kay apney ehkaam say haq ko haq ker dikhaye , aur kafiron ki jarr kaat daalay .

verses.text: takay haq ka haq hona aur batil ka batil hona sabit kerday , chahye mujrim logon  ko yeh baat kitni nagawar ho .
verses.translation: takay haq ka haq hona aur batil ka batil hona sabit kerday , chahye mujrim logon  ko yeh baat kitni nagawar ho .

verses.text: yaad kero jab tum apney rab say fariyad ker rahey thay , to uss ney tumhari fariyad ka jawab diya kay mein tumhari madad kay liye aik hazar farishton ki kumak bhejney wala hun jo lagataar ayen gay .
verses.translation: yaad kero jab tum apney rab say fariyad ker rahey thay , to uss ney tumhari fariyad ka jawab diya kay mein tumhari madad kay liye aik hazar farishton ki kumak bhejney wala hun jo lagataar ayen gay .

verses.text: aur yeh wada Allah ney kissi aur wajeh say nahi , balkay sirf iss liye kiya kay woh khushkhabri banay , aur takay tumharay dilon ko itminan hasil ho , werna madad kissi aur kay paas say nahi , sirf Allah kay paas say aati hai .   yaqeenan Allah iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
verses.translation: aur yeh wada Allah ney kissi aur wajeh say nahi , balkay sirf iss liye kiya kay woh khushkhabri banay , aur takay tumharay dilon ko itminan hasil ho , werna madad kissi aur kay paas say nahi , sirf Allah kay paas say aati hai .   yaqeenan Allah iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

verses.text: yaad kero jab tum per say ghabrahat door kernay kay liye woh apney hukum say tum per ghunoodgi taari ker-raha tha ,   aur tum per aasman say paani barsa raha tha ,   takay uss kay zariye tumhen pak keray , tum say shetan ki gandagi door keray ,   tumharay dilon ki daahrus bandhaye , aur uss kay zariye ( tumharay ) paon achi tarah jama dey .
verses.translation: yaad kero jab tum per say ghabrahat door kernay kay liye woh apney hukum say tum per ghunoodgi taari ker-raha tha ,   aur tum per aasman say paani barsa raha tha ,   takay uss kay zariye tumhen pak keray , tum say shetan ki gandagi door keray ,   tumharay dilon ki daahrus bandhaye , aur uss kay zariye ( tumharay ) paon achi tarah jama dey .

verses.text: woh waqt jab tumhara rab farishton ko wahi kay zariye hukum dey raha tha kay :  mein tumharay sath hun , abb tum mominon kay qadam jamao mein kafiron kay dilon mein roab taari kerdun ga , phir tum gardanon kay oopper waar kero , aur unn ki ungliyon kay her her jorr per zarab lagao .
verses.translation: woh waqt jab tumhara rab farishton ko wahi kay zariye hukum dey raha tha kay :  mein tumharay sath hun , abb tum mominon kay qadam jamao mein kafiron kay dilon mein roab taari kerdun ga , phir tum gardanon kay oopper waar kero , aur unn ki ungliyon kay her her jorr per zarab lagao .

verses.text: yeh iss liye kay unhon ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool say dushmani mol li hai , aur agar koi shaks Allah aur uss kay Rasool say dushmani mol leta hai , to yaqeenan Allah ka azab bara sakht hai .
verses.translation: yeh iss liye kay unhon ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool say dushmani mol li hai , aur agar koi shaks Allah aur uss kay Rasool say dushmani mol leta hai , to yaqeenan Allah ka azab bara sakht hai .

verses.text: yeh sabb to ( abb ) chakh lo , iss kay ilawa haqeeqat yeh hai kay kafiron kay liye ( asal ) azab dozakh ka hai .
verses.translation: yeh sabb to ( abb ) chakh lo , iss kay ilawa haqeeqat yeh hai kay kafiron kay liye ( asal ) azab dozakh ka hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! jab kafiron say tumhara aamna samna hojaye , jabkay woh charrhai ker kay aarahey hon , to unn ko peeth matt dikhao .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! jab kafiron say tumhara aamna samna hojaye , jabkay woh charrhai ker kay aarahey hon , to unn ko peeth matt dikhao .

verses.text: aur agar koi shaks kissi jangi chaal ki wajeh say aisa ker raha ho , ya apni kissi jamat say jaa milna chahta ho , uss ki baat to aur hai , magar uss kay siwa jo shaks aesay din apni peeth pheray ga to woh Allah ki taraf say ghazab ley ker lotay ga , aur uss ka thikana jahannum hoga , aur woh boht bura thikana hai .
verses.translation: aur agar koi shaks kissi jangi chaal ki wajeh say aisa ker raha ho , ya apni kissi jamat say jaa milna chahta ho , uss ki baat to aur hai , magar uss kay siwa jo shaks aesay din apni peeth pheray ga to woh Allah ki taraf say ghazab ley ker lotay ga , aur uss ka thikana jahannum hoga , aur woh boht bura thikana hai .

verses.text: chunacheh ( musalmano ! haqeeqat mein ) tum ney unn ( kafiron ko ) qatal nahi kiya tha , balkay unhen Allah ney qatal kiya tha , aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab tum ney unn per ( mitti ) phenki thi to woh tum ney nahi , balkay Allah ney phenki thi ,   aur ( tumharay haathon yeh kaam iss liye keraya tha ) takay uss kay zariye Allah mominon ko behtareen ajar ata keray . beyshak Allah her baat ko sunney wala , her cheez ko janney wala hai .
verses.translation: chunacheh ( musalmano ! haqeeqat mein ) tum ney unn ( kafiron ko ) qatal nahi kiya tha , balkay unhen Allah ney qatal kiya tha , aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab tum ney unn per ( mitti ) phenki thi to woh tum ney nahi , balkay Allah ney phenki thi ,   aur ( tumharay haathon yeh kaam iss liye keraya tha ) takay uss kay zariye Allah mominon ko behtareen ajar ata keray . beyshak Allah her baat ko sunney wala , her cheez ko janney wala hai .

verses.text: yeh sabb kuch to apni jagah , iss kay ilawa yeh baat bhi thi kay Allah ko kafiron ki her sazish ko kamzor kerna tha .
verses.translation: yeh sabb kuch to apni jagah , iss kay ilawa yeh baat bhi thi kay Allah ko kafiron ki her sazish ko kamzor kerna tha .

verses.text: . ( aey kafiro ! ) agar tum faisla chahtay thay , to lo ! abb faisla tumharay samney aagaya . abb agar tum baaz aajao to yeh tumharay hi liye behtar hoga , aur agar tum phir wohi kaam kero gay ( jo abb tak kertay rahey ho ) to hum bhi phir wohi kaam keren gay ( jo abb kiya hai ) . aur tumhara jatha tumharay kuch kaam nahi aaye ga , chahye woh kitna ziyada ho , aur yaad rakho kay Allah mominon kay sath hai .
verses.translation: . ( aey kafiro ! ) agar tum faisla chahtay thay , to lo ! abb faisla tumharay samney aagaya . abb agar tum baaz aajao to yeh tumharay hi liye behtar hoga , aur agar tum phir wohi kaam kero gay ( jo abb tak kertay rahey ho ) to hum bhi phir wohi kaam keren gay ( jo abb kiya hai ) . aur tumhara jatha tumharay kuch kaam nahi aaye ga , chahye woh kitna ziyada ho , aur yaad rakho kay Allah mominon kay sath hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki tabey daari kero , aur iss ( tabey daari ) say mun naa morro , jabkay tum ( Allah aur Rasool kay ehkaam ) sunn rahey ho .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki tabey daari kero , aur iss ( tabey daari ) say mun naa morro , jabkay tum ( Allah aur Rasool kay ehkaam ) sunn rahey ho .

verses.text: aur unn logon  ki tarah naa hojana jo kehtay to hain kay hum ney sunn liya , magar woh ( haqeeqat mein ) suntay nahi hain .
verses.translation: aur unn logon  ki tarah naa hojana jo kehtay to hain kay hum ney sunn liya , magar woh ( haqeeqat mein ) suntay nahi hain .

verses.text: yaqeen rakho kay Allah kay nazdeek bad-tareen janwer woh behray goongay log hain jo aqal say kaam nahi letay .
verses.translation: yaqeen rakho kay Allah kay nazdeek bad-tareen janwer woh behray goongay log hain jo aqal say kaam nahi letay .

verses.text: aur agar Allah kay ilm mein unn kay andar koi bhalai hoti to woh unn ko sunney ki tofiq dey deta , lekin abb ( jabkay unn mein bhalai nahi hai ) agar unn ko sunney ki tofiq dey bhi dey to woh mun morr ker bhag jayen gay .
verses.translation: aur agar Allah kay ilm mein unn kay andar koi bhalai hoti to woh unn ko sunney ki tofiq dey deta , lekin abb ( jabkay unn mein bhalai nahi hai ) agar unn ko sunney ki tofiq dey bhi dey to woh mun morr ker bhag jayen gay .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah aur Rasool ki dawat qubool kero , jab Rasool tumhen uss baat ki taraf bulaye jo tumhen zindagi bakhshney wali hai .   aur yeh baat jaan rakho kay Allah insan aur uss kay dil kay darmiyan aarr ban jata hai ,   aur yeh kay tum sabb ko ussi ki taraf ikattha ker kay ley jaya jaye ga .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah aur Rasool ki dawat qubool kero , jab Rasool tumhen uss baat ki taraf bulaye jo tumhen zindagi bakhshney wali hai .   aur yeh baat jaan rakho kay Allah insan aur uss kay dil kay darmiyan aarr ban jata hai ,   aur yeh kay tum sabb ko ussi ki taraf ikattha ker kay ley jaya jaye ga .

verses.text: aur daro uss wabal say jo tum mein say sirf unn logon  per nahi parray ga jinhon ney zulm kiya hoga ,   aur jaan rakho kay Allah ka azab bara sakht hai .
verses.translation: aur daro uss wabal say jo tum mein say sirf unn logon  per nahi parray ga jinhon ney zulm kiya hoga ,   aur jaan rakho kay Allah ka azab bara sakht hai .

verses.text: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab tum tadaad mein thoray thay , tumhen logon  ney ( tumhari ) sarzameen mein daba ker rakha huwa tha , tum dartay thay kay log tumhen uchak kerlay jayen gay . phir Allah ney tumhen thikana diya , aur apni madad say tumhen mazboot bana diya , aur tumhen pakeezah cheezon ka rizq ata kiya , takay tum shuker kero .
verses.translation: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab tum tadaad mein thoray thay , tumhen logon  ney ( tumhari ) sarzameen mein daba ker rakha huwa tha , tum dartay thay kay log tumhen uchak kerlay jayen gay . phir Allah ney tumhen thikana diya , aur apni madad say tumhen mazboot bana diya , aur tumhen pakeezah cheezon ka rizq ata kiya , takay tum shuker kero .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah aur Rasool say bey wafai naa kerna , aur naa jantay boojhtay apni amanton mein khayanat kay murtakib hona .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah aur Rasool say bey wafai naa kerna , aur naa jantay boojhtay apni amanton mein khayanat kay murtakib hona .

verses.text: aur yeh baat samajh lo kay tumharay maal aur tumhari aulad aik aazmaesh hain ,   aur yeh kay azeem inaam Allah hi kay paas hai .
verses.translation: aur yeh baat samajh lo kay tumharay maal aur tumhari aulad aik aazmaesh hain ,   aur yeh kay azeem inaam Allah hi kay paas hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! agar tum Allah kay sath taqwa ki rawish ikhtiyar kero gay to woh tumhen ( haq o batil ki ) tameez ata kerday ga ,   aur tumhari buraiyon ka kaffara kerday ga , aur tumhen maghfirat say nawazay ga , aur Allah fazal-e-azeem ka malik hai .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! agar tum Allah kay sath taqwa ki rawish ikhtiyar kero gay to woh tumhen ( haq o batil ki ) tameez ata kerday ga ,   aur tumhari buraiyon ka kaffara kerday ga , aur tumhen maghfirat say nawazay ga , aur Allah fazal-e-azeem ka malik hai .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) woh waqt yaad kero jab kafir log tumharay khilaf mansoobay bana rahey thay kay tumhen girftaar kerlen , ya tumhen qatal kerden , ya tumhen ( watan say ) nikal den . woh apney mansoobay bana rahey thay , aur Allah apna mansooba bana raha tha , aur Allah sabb say behtar mansooba bananey wala hai .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) woh waqt yaad kero jab kafir log tumharay khilaf mansoobay bana rahey thay kay tumhen girftaar kerlen , ya tumhen qatal kerden , ya tumhen ( watan say ) nikal den . woh apney mansoobay bana rahey thay , aur Allah apna mansooba bana raha tha , aur Allah sabb say behtar mansooba bananey wala hai .

verses.text: aur jab unn kay samney humari aayaton ki tilawat ki jati hai to yeh kehtay hain kay :  ( bus ! ) hum ney sunn liya , agar hum chahen to iss jaisi baaten hum bhi keh layen . yeh ( Quran ) aur kuch nahi , sirf pichlay logon  kay afsaney hain .
verses.translation: aur jab unn kay samney humari aayaton ki tilawat ki jati hai to yeh kehtay hain kay :  ( bus ! ) hum ney sunn liya , agar hum chahen to iss jaisi baaten hum bhi keh layen . yeh ( Quran ) aur kuch nahi , sirf pichlay logon  kay afsaney hain .

verses.text: . ( aur aik waqt woh tha ) jab enhon ney kaha tha kay :  ya Allah ! agar yeh ( Quran ) hi woh haq hai jo teri taraf say aaya hai to hum per aasman say pathraon ki barish barsa dey , ya hum per koi aur takleef deh azab daal dey .
verses.translation: . ( aur aik waqt woh tha ) jab enhon ney kaha tha kay :  ya Allah ! agar yeh ( Quran ) hi woh haq hai jo teri taraf say aaya hai to hum per aasman say pathraon ki barish barsa dey , ya hum per koi aur takleef deh azab daal dey .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) Allah aisa nahi hai kay inn ko iss halat mein azab dey jab tum inn kay darmiyan mojood ho , aur Allah iss halat mein bhi inn ko azab denay wala nahi hai jab woh astaghfaar kertay hon .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) Allah aisa nahi hai kay inn ko iss halat mein azab dey jab tum inn kay darmiyan mojood ho , aur Allah iss halat mein bhi inn ko azab denay wala nahi hai jab woh astaghfaar kertay hon .

verses.text: aur bhala inn mein kiya khoobi hai kay Allah inn ko azab naa dey jabkay woh logon  ko masjid-e-haram say roktay hain ,   halankay woh uss kay mutawalli nahi hain . muttaqi logon  kay siwa kissi qisam kay log uss kay mutawalli nahi hosaktay , lekin unn mein say aksar log ( iss baat ko ) nahi jantay .
verses.translation: aur bhala inn mein kiya khoobi hai kay Allah inn ko azab naa dey jabkay woh logon  ko masjid-e-haram say roktay hain ,   halankay woh uss kay mutawalli nahi hain . muttaqi logon  kay siwa kissi qisam kay log uss kay mutawalli nahi hosaktay , lekin unn mein say aksar log ( iss baat ko ) nahi jantay .

verses.text: aur baitullah kay paas unn ki namaz seetiyan bajaney aur taliyan peetney kay siwa kuch bhi nahi . lehaza ( aey kafiro ! ) jo kafirana baaten tum kertay rahey ho , unn ki wajeh say abb azab ka maza chakho .
verses.translation: aur baitullah kay paas unn ki namaz seetiyan bajaney aur taliyan peetney kay siwa kuch bhi nahi . lehaza ( aey kafiro ! ) jo kafirana baaten tum kertay rahey ho , unn ki wajeh say abb azab ka maza chakho .

verses.text: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai woh apney maal iss kaam kay liye kharch ker rahey hain kay logon  ko Allah kay raastay say roken ,   nateeja yeh hoga kay yeh log kharch to keren gay , magar phir yeh sabb kuch inn kay liye hasrat ka sabab ban jaye ga , aur aakhir kaar yeh maghloob hojayen gay . aur ( aakhirat mein ) inn kafir logon  ko jahannum ki taraf ikattha ker kay laya jaye ga .
verses.translation: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai woh apney maal iss kaam kay liye kharch ker rahey hain kay logon  ko Allah kay raastay say roken ,   nateeja yeh hoga kay yeh log kharch to keren gay , magar phir yeh sabb kuch inn kay liye hasrat ka sabab ban jaye ga , aur aakhir kaar yeh maghloob hojayen gay . aur ( aakhirat mein ) inn kafir logon  ko jahannum ki taraf ikattha ker kay laya jaye ga .

verses.text: takay Allah napak ( logon  ) ko pak ( logon  ) say alag kerday , aur aik napak ko doosray napak per rakh ker sabb ka aik dher banaye , aur uss dher ko jahannum mein daal dey . yehi log hain jo sarasar khasaray mein hain .
verses.translation: takay Allah napak ( logon  ) ko pak ( logon  ) say alag kerday , aur aik napak ko doosray napak per rakh ker sabb ka aik dher banaye , aur uss dher ko jahannum mein daal dey . yehi log hain jo sarasar khasaray mein hain .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai unn say keh do kay :  agar woh baaz aajayen to pehlay unn say jo kuch huwa hai , ussay moaaf kerdiya jaye ga .    aur agar woh phir wohi kaam keren gay to pichlay logon  kay sath jo moamla huwa , woh ( unn kay samney ) guzar hi chuka hai .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai unn say keh do kay :  agar woh baaz aajayen to pehlay unn say jo kuch huwa hai , ussay moaaf kerdiya jaye ga .    aur agar woh phir wohi kaam keren gay to pichlay logon  kay sath jo moamla huwa , woh ( unn kay samney ) guzar hi chuka hai .

verses.text: aur ( musalmano ! ) inn kafiron say larrtay raho , yahan tak kay fitna baqi naa rahey , aur deen pooray ka poora Allah ka hojaye .   phir agar yeh baaz aajayen to inn kay aemal ko Allah khoob dekh raha hai .
verses.translation: aur ( musalmano ! ) inn kafiron say larrtay raho , yahan tak kay fitna baqi naa rahey , aur deen pooray ka poora Allah ka hojaye .   phir agar yeh baaz aajayen to inn kay aemal ko Allah khoob dekh raha hai .

verses.text: aur agar yeh mun morray rakhen , to yaqeen jano kay Allah tumhara rakhwala hai , behtareen rakhwala aur behtareen madadgaar !
verses.translation: aur agar yeh mun morray rakhen , to yaqeen jano kay Allah tumhara rakhwala hai , behtareen rakhwala aur behtareen madadgaar !

verses.text: aur ( musalmano ! ) yeh baat apney ilm mein ley aao kay tum jo kuch maal-e-ghaneemat hasil kero , uss ka paanchwan hissa Allah aur Rasool aur unn kay qurbat qraabat daaron aur yateemon aur miskeeno aur musfiron ka haq hai   ( jiss ki adaegi tum per wajib hai , ) agar tum Allah per aur uss cheez per emaan rakhtay ho jo hum ney apney banday per faislay kay din nazil ki thi ,   jiss din do jamaten baham takrai then , aur Allah her cheez per qadir hai .
