verses.translation: aur ( musalmano ! ) yeh baat apney ilm mein ley aao kay tum jo kuch maal-e-ghaneemat hasil kero , uss ka paanchwan hissa Allah aur Rasool aur unn kay qurbat qraabat daaron aur yateemon aur miskeeno aur musfiron ka haq hai   ( jiss ki adaegi tum per wajib hai , ) agar tum Allah per aur uss cheez per emaan rakhtay ho jo hum ney apney banday per faislay kay din nazil ki thi ,   jiss din do jamaten baham takrai then , aur Allah her cheez per qadir hai .

verses.text: woh waqt yaad kero jab tum log wadi kay qareeb walay kinaray per thay , aur woh log door walay kinaray per , aur qafla tum say neechay ki taraf .   aur agar tum pehlay say ( larraee ka ) waqt aapas mein tey kertay to waqt tey kernay mein tumharay darmiyan zaroor ikhtilaf hojata , lekin yeh waqiaa ( kay pehlay say tey kiye baghair lashkar takra gaye ) iss liye huwa kay jo kaam ho ker rehna tha , Allah ussay poora ker dikhaye , takay jissay barbad hona ho , woh wazeh daleel dekh ker barbad ho , aur jissay zinda rehna ho woh wazeh daleel dekh ker zinda rahey ,   aur Allah her baat sunney wala , her cheez janney wala hai .
verses.translation: woh waqt yaad kero jab tum log wadi kay qareeb walay kinaray per thay , aur woh log door walay kinaray per , aur qafla tum say neechay ki taraf .   aur agar tum pehlay say ( larraee ka ) waqt aapas mein tey kertay to waqt tey kernay mein tumharay darmiyan zaroor ikhtilaf hojata , lekin yeh waqiaa ( kay pehlay say tey kiye baghair lashkar takra gaye ) iss liye huwa kay jo kaam ho ker rehna tha , Allah ussay poora ker dikhaye , takay jissay barbad hona ho , woh wazeh daleel dekh ker barbad ho , aur jissay zinda rehna ho woh wazeh daleel dekh ker zinda rahey ,   aur Allah her baat sunney wala , her cheez janney wala hai .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) woh waqt yaad kero jab Allah khuwab mein tumhen unn ( dushmanon ) ki tadaad kam dikha raha tha ,   aur agar tumhen unn ki tadaad ziyada dikha deta to ( aey musalmano ! ) tum himmat haar jatay , aur tumharay darmiyan iss moamlay mein ikhtilaf peda hojata , lekin Allah ney ( tumhen uss say ) bacha liya . yaqeenan woh seenon mein chupi baaten khoob janta hai .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) woh waqt yaad kero jab Allah khuwab mein tumhen unn ( dushmanon ) ki tadaad kam dikha raha tha ,   aur agar tumhen unn ki tadaad ziyada dikha deta to ( aey musalmano ! ) tum himmat haar jatay , aur tumharay darmiyan iss moamlay mein ikhtilaf peda hojata , lekin Allah ney ( tumhen uss say ) bacha liya . yaqeenan woh seenon mein chupi baaten khoob janta hai .

verses.text: aur woh waqt yaad kero kay jab tum aik doosray kay madd-e-muqabil aaye thay to Allah tumhari nigahon mein unn ki tadaad kam dikha raha tha , aur unn ki nigahon mein tumhen kam ker kay dikha raha tha ,   takay jo kaam ho ker rehna tha , Allah ussay poora ker dikhaye . aur tamam moamlaat Allah hi ki taraf lotaye jatay hain .
verses.translation: aur woh waqt yaad kero kay jab tum aik doosray kay madd-e-muqabil aaye thay to Allah tumhari nigahon mein unn ki tadaad kam dikha raha tha , aur unn ki nigahon mein tumhen kam ker kay dikha raha tha ,   takay jo kaam ho ker rehna tha , Allah ussay poora ker dikhaye . aur tamam moamlaat Allah hi ki taraf lotaye jatay hain .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! jab tumhara kissi giroh say muqabla hojaye to sabit qadam raho , aur Allah ka kasrat say ziker kero , takay tumhen kamiyabi hasil ho .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! jab tumhara kissi giroh say muqabla hojaye to sabit qadam raho , aur Allah ka kasrat say ziker kero , takay tumhen kamiyabi hasil ho .

verses.text: aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki itaat kero , aur aapas mein jhagrra naa kero , werna tum kamzor parr-jao gay , aur tumhari huwa ukhar jaye gi . aur sabar say kaam lo . yaqeen rakho kay Allah sabar kernay walon kay sath hai .
verses.translation: aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki itaat kero , aur aapas mein jhagrra naa kero , werna tum kamzor parr-jao gay , aur tumhari huwa ukhar jaye gi . aur sabar say kaam lo . yaqeen rakho kay Allah sabar kernay walon kay sath hai .

verses.text: aur unn logon  ki tarah naa hojana jo apney gharon say akartay huye , aur logon  ko apni shaan dikhatay huye niklay thay , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay say rok rahey thay .   aur Allah ney logon  kay saray aemal ko ( apney ilm kay ) ehatay mein liya huwa hai .
verses.translation: aur unn logon  ki tarah naa hojana jo apney gharon say akartay huye , aur logon  ko apni shaan dikhatay huye niklay thay , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay say rok rahey thay .   aur Allah ney logon  kay saray aemal ko ( apney ilm kay ) ehatay mein liya huwa hai .

verses.text: aur woh waqt ( bhi qabil-e-ziker hai ) jab shetan ney unn ( kafiron ) ko yeh sujhaya tha kay unn kay aemal baray khushnuma hain , aur yeh kaha tha kay :  aaj insanon mein koi nahi hai jo tum per ghalib aa-sakay , aur mein tumhara mohafiz hun .    phir jab dono giroh aamney samney aaye to woh aeriyon kay ball peechay hata , aur kehney laga :  mein tumhari koi zimma daari nahi ley sakta , mujhay jo kuch nazar aaraha hai , woh tumhen nazar nahi aaraha . mujhay Allah say darr lagg raha hai , aur Allah ka azab bara sakht hai .
verses.translation: aur woh waqt ( bhi qabil-e-ziker hai ) jab shetan ney unn ( kafiron ) ko yeh sujhaya tha kay unn kay aemal baray khushnuma hain , aur yeh kaha tha kay :  aaj insanon mein koi nahi hai jo tum per ghalib aa-sakay , aur mein tumhara mohafiz hun .    phir jab dono giroh aamney samney aaye to woh aeriyon kay ball peechay hata , aur kehney laga :  mein tumhari koi zimma daari nahi ley sakta , mujhay jo kuch nazar aaraha hai , woh tumhen nazar nahi aaraha . mujhay Allah say darr lagg raha hai , aur Allah ka azab bara sakht hai .

verses.text: aur yaad kero jab munafiqeen aur woh log jinn kay dilon mein rog tha , yeh keh rahey thay kay :  inn ( musalmanon ) ko inn kay deen ney dhokay mein daal rakha hai .    halankay jo koi Allah per bharosa keray to Allah sabb per ghalib hai , bari hikmat wala hai .
verses.translation: aur yaad kero jab munafiqeen aur woh log jinn kay dilon mein rog tha , yeh keh rahey thay kay :  inn ( musalmanon ) ko inn kay deen ney dhokay mein daal rakha hai .    halankay jo koi Allah per bharosa keray to Allah sabb per ghalib hai , bari hikmat wala hai .

verses.text: aur agar tum dekhtay ( to woh ajeeb manzar tha ) jab farishtay unn kafiron ki rooh qabz ker rahey thay , unn kay chehron aur pusht per maartay jatay thay , ( aur kehtay jatay thay kay : )  abb jalney kay azab ka maza ( bhi ) chakhna .
verses.translation: aur agar tum dekhtay ( to woh ajeeb manzar tha ) jab farishtay unn kafiron ki rooh qabz ker rahey thay , unn kay chehron aur pusht per maartay jatay thay , ( aur kehtay jatay thay kay : )  abb jalney kay azab ka maza ( bhi ) chakhna .

verses.text: yeh sabb kuch unn aemal ka badla hai jo tum ney apney haathon aagay bhej rakhay thay , aur yeh baat tey hai kay Allah bandon per zulm kernay wala nahi hai .
verses.translation: yeh sabb kuch unn aemal ka badla hai jo tum ney apney haathon aagay bhej rakhay thay , aur yeh baat tey hai kay Allah bandon per zulm kernay wala nahi hai .

verses.text: . ( inn logon  ka haal aisa hi huwa ) jaisa firon ki qoam aur unn say pehlay logon  ka haal huwa tha . unhon ney Allah ki nishaniyon ko manney say inkar kiya , nateeja yeh huwa kay Allah ney unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say unhen apni girift mein ley liya . yaqeenan Allah ki taqat bari hai ( aur ) azab bara sakht !
verses.translation: . ( inn logon  ka haal aisa hi huwa ) jaisa firon ki qoam aur unn say pehlay logon  ka haal huwa tha . unhon ney Allah ki nishaniyon ko manney say inkar kiya , nateeja yeh huwa kay Allah ney unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say unhen apni girift mein ley liya . yaqeenan Allah ki taqat bari hai ( aur ) azab bara sakht !

verses.text: yeh sabb kuch iss liye huwa kay Allah ka dastoor yeh hai kay uss ney jo naimat kissi qoam ko di ho , ussay uss waqt tak badalna gawara nahi kerta jab tak woh log khud apni halat tabdeel naa kerlen ,   aur Allah her baat sunta , sabb kuch janta hai .
verses.translation: yeh sabb kuch iss liye huwa kay Allah ka dastoor yeh hai kay uss ney jo naimat kissi qoam ko di ho , ussay uss waqt tak badalna gawara nahi kerta jab tak woh log khud apni halat tabdeel naa kerlen ,   aur Allah her baat sunta , sabb kuch janta hai .

verses.text: . ( iss moamlay mein bhi unn ka haal ) aisa hi huwa jaisa firon ki qoam aur unn say pehlay logon  ka haal huwa tha . unhon ney apney rab ki nishaniyon ko jhutlaya . nateeja yeh huwa kay hum ney unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say unhen halak kerdiya , aur firon ki qoam ko gharq kerdiya , aur yeh sab zalim log thay .
verses.translation: . ( iss moamlay mein bhi unn ka haal ) aisa hi huwa jaisa firon ki qoam aur unn say pehlay logon  ka haal huwa tha . unhon ney apney rab ki nishaniyon ko jhutlaya . nateeja yeh huwa kay hum ney unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say unhen halak kerdiya , aur firon ki qoam ko gharq kerdiya , aur yeh sab zalim log thay .

verses.text: yaqeen jano kay Allah kay nazdeek zameen per chalney walay jaan daaron mein bad-tareen log woh hain jinhon ney kufr apna liya hai , jiss ki wajeh say woh emaan nahi latay .
verses.translation: yaqeen jano kay Allah kay nazdeek zameen per chalney walay jaan daaron mein bad-tareen log woh hain jinhon ney kufr apna liya hai , jiss ki wajeh say woh emaan nahi latay .

verses.text: yeh log woh hain jinn say tum ney ehad ley rakha hai , iss kay bawajood yeh her martaba apney ehad ko torr detay hain , aur zara nahi dartay .
verses.translation: yeh log woh hain jinn say tum ney ehad ley rakha hai , iss kay bawajood yeh her martaba apney ehad ko torr detay hain , aur zara nahi dartay .

verses.text: lehaza agar kabhi yeh log jang mein tumharay haath lagg jayen to , inn ko saman-e-ibrat bana ker unn logon  ko bhi tittar-bittar ker daalo jo inn kay peechay hain , takay woh yaad rakhen .
verses.translation: lehaza agar kabhi yeh log jang mein tumharay haath lagg jayen to , inn ko saman-e-ibrat bana ker unn logon  ko bhi tittar-bittar ker daalo jo inn kay peechay hain , takay woh yaad rakhen .

verses.text: aur agar tumhen kissi qoam say bad-ehadi ka andesha ho to tum woh moahida unn ki taraf saaf seedhay tareeqay say phenk do .   yaad rakho kay Allah badd ehadi kernay walon ko pasand nahi kerta .
verses.translation: aur agar tumhen kissi qoam say bad-ehadi ka andesha ho to tum woh moahida unn ki taraf saaf seedhay tareeqay say phenk do .   yaad rakho kay Allah badd ehadi kernay walon ko pasand nahi kerta .

verses.text: aur kafir log hergiz yeh khayal bhi dil mein naa layen kay woh bhag niklay hain .   yeh yaqeeni baat hai kay woh ( Allah ko ) aajiz nahi ker-saktay .
verses.translation: aur kafir log hergiz yeh khayal bhi dil mein naa layen kay woh bhag niklay hain .   yeh yaqeeni baat hai kay woh ( Allah ko ) aajiz nahi ker-saktay .

verses.text: aur ( musalmano ! ) jiss qadar taqat aur ghorron ki jitni chaoniyan tum say ban parren , unn say muqablay kay liye tayyar kero ,   jinn kay zariye tum Allah kay dushman aur apney ( mojooda ) dushman per bhi heybat taari ker-sako-? , aur inn kay ilawa doosron per bhi jinhen abhi tum nahi jantay , ( magar ) Allah unhen janta hai .   aur Allah kay raastay mein tum jo kuch kharch kero gay , woh tumhen poora poora dey diya jaye ga , aur tumharay liye koi kami nahi ki jaye gi .
verses.translation: aur ( musalmano ! ) jiss qadar taqat aur ghorron ki jitni chaoniyan tum say ban parren , unn say muqablay kay liye tayyar kero ,   jinn kay zariye tum Allah kay dushman aur apney ( mojooda ) dushman per bhi heybat taari ker-sako-? , aur inn kay ilawa doosron per bhi jinhen abhi tum nahi jantay , ( magar ) Allah unhen janta hai .   aur Allah kay raastay mein tum jo kuch kharch kero gay , woh tumhen poora poora dey diya jaye ga , aur tumharay liye koi kami nahi ki jaye gi .

verses.text: aur agar woh log sulah ki taraf jhuken to tum bhi uss ki taraf jhuk jao ,   aur Allah per bharosa rakho . yaqeen jano wohi hai jo her baat sunta , sabb kuch janta hai .
verses.translation: aur agar woh log sulah ki taraf jhuken to tum bhi uss ki taraf jhuk jao ,   aur Allah per bharosa rakho . yaqeen jano wohi hai jo her baat sunta , sabb kuch janta hai .

verses.text: aur agar woh tumhen dhoka denay ka irada keren gay to Allah tumharay liye kafi hai . wohi to hai jiss ney apni madad kay zariye aur mominon kay zariye tumharay haath mazboot kiye .
verses.translation: aur agar woh tumhen dhoka denay ka irada keren gay to Allah tumharay liye kafi hai . wohi to hai jiss ney apni madad kay zariye aur mominon kay zariye tumharay haath mazboot kiye .

verses.text: aur unn kay dilon mein aik doosray ki ulfat peda kerdi . agar tum zameen bhar ki sari dolat bhi kharch kerletay to unn kay dilon mein yeh ulfat peda naa ker-saktay , lekin Allah ney unn kay dilon ko jorr diya . woh yaqeenan iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
verses.translation: aur unn kay dilon mein aik doosray ki ulfat peda kerdi . agar tum zameen bhar ki sari dolat bhi kharch kerletay to unn kay dilon mein yeh ulfat peda naa ker-saktay , lekin Allah ney unn kay dilon ko jorr diya . woh yaqeenan iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

verses.text: aey nabi ! tumharay liye to bus Allah aur woh momin log kafi hain jinhon ney tumhari perwi ki hai .
verses.translation: aey nabi ! tumharay liye to bus Allah aur woh momin log kafi hain jinhon ney tumhari perwi ki hai .

verses.text: aey nabi ! mominon ko jang per ubharo . agar tumharay bees aadmi aesay hon gay jo sabit qadam rehney walay hon to woh do so per ghalib aajayen gay . aur agar tumharay so aadmi hon gay to woh kafiron kay aik hazar per ghalib aajayen gay , kiyonkay woh aesay log hain jo samajh nahi rakhtay .
verses.translation: aey nabi ! mominon ko jang per ubharo . agar tumharay bees aadmi aesay hon gay jo sabit qadam rehney walay hon to woh do so per ghalib aajayen gay . aur agar tumharay so aadmi hon gay to woh kafiron kay aik hazar per ghalib aajayen gay , kiyonkay woh aesay log hain jo samajh nahi rakhtay .

verses.text: loa abb Allah ney tum say bojh halka kerdiya , aur uss kay ilm mein hai kay tumharay andar kuch kamzori hai . lehaza ( abb hukum yeh hai kay ) agar tumharay sabit qadam rehney walay so aadmi hon to woh do so per ghalib aajayen gay , aur agar tumharay aik hazar aadmi hon to woh Allah kay hukum say do hazar per ghalib aajayen gay , aur Allah sabit qadam rehney walon kay sath hai .
verses.translation: loa abb Allah ney tum say bojh halka kerdiya , aur uss kay ilm mein hai kay tumharay andar kuch kamzori hai . lehaza ( abb hukum yeh hai kay ) agar tumharay sabit qadam rehney walay so aadmi hon to woh do so per ghalib aajayen gay , aur agar tumharay aik hazar aadmi hon to woh Allah kay hukum say do hazar per ghalib aajayen gay , aur Allah sabit qadam rehney walon kay sath hai .

verses.text: yeh baat kissi nabi kay shayaan shaan nahi hai kay uss kay paas qedi rahen ,   jab tak kay woh zameen mein ( dushmanon ka ) khoon achi tarah naa baha chuka ho , ( jiss say unn ka roab poori tarah toot jaye ) tum duniya ka saz-o-saman chahtay ho , aur Allah ( tumharay liye ) aakhirat ( ki bhalai ) chahta hai , aur Allah sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , sahab-e-hikmat bhi .
verses.translation: yeh baat kissi nabi kay shayaan shaan nahi hai kay uss kay paas qedi rahen ,   jab tak kay woh zameen mein ( dushmanon ka ) khoon achi tarah naa baha chuka ho , ( jiss say unn ka roab poori tarah toot jaye ) tum duniya ka saz-o-saman chahtay ho , aur Allah ( tumharay liye ) aakhirat ( ki bhalai ) chahta hai , aur Allah sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , sahab-e-hikmat bhi .

verses.text: agar Allah ki taraf say aik likha huwa hukum pehlay naa aa-chuka hota to jo raasta tum ney ikhtiyar kiya , uss ki wajeh say tum per koi bari saza aajati .
verses.translation: agar Allah ki taraf say aik likha huwa hukum pehlay naa aa-chuka hota to jo raasta tum ney ikhtiyar kiya , uss ki wajeh say tum per koi bari saza aajati .

verses.text: lehaza abb tum ney jo maal-e-ghaneemat mein hasil kiya hai , ussay pakeezah halal maal kay tor per khao , aur Allah say dartay raho . yaqeenan Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: lehaza abb tum ney jo maal-e-ghaneemat mein hasil kiya hai , ussay pakeezah halal maal kay tor per khao , aur Allah say dartay raho . yaqeenan Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: aey nabi ! tum logon  kay haathon mein jo qedi hain , ( aur jinhon ney musalman honey ka irada zahir kiya hai ) unn say keh do kay :  agar Allah tumharay dilon mein bhalai dekhay ga to jo maal tum say ( fidya mein ) liya gaya hai uss say behtar tumhen deydey ga ,   aur tumhari bakhshish kerday ga , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: aey nabi ! tum logon  kay haathon mein jo qedi hain , ( aur jinhon ney musalman honey ka irada zahir kiya hai ) unn say keh do kay :  agar Allah tumharay dilon mein bhalai dekhay ga to jo maal tum say ( fidya mein ) liya gaya hai uss say behtar tumhen deydey ga ,   aur tumhari bakhshish kerday ga , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: aur agar unn logon  ney ( aey nabi ! ) tum say khayanat kernay ka irada kiya , to yeh iss say pehlay Allah kay sath khayanat ker-chukay hain , jiss kay nateejay mein Allah ney enhen tumharay qaboo mein dey diya , aur Allah ka ilm bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil .
verses.translation: aur agar unn logon  ney ( aey nabi ! ) tum say khayanat kernay ka irada kiya , to yeh iss say pehlay Allah kay sath khayanat ker-chukay hain , jiss kay nateejay mein Allah ney enhen tumharay qaboo mein dey diya , aur Allah ka ilm bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil .

verses.text: jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney hijrat ki hai , aur apney maalon aur janon say Allah kay raastay mein jihad kiya hai , woh aur jinhon ney unn ko ( madina mein ) abad kiya , aur unn ki madad ki , yeh sabb log aapas mein aik doosray kay wali waris hain . aur jo log emaan ley aaye hain , ( magar ) unhon ney hijrat nahi ki , jab tak woh hijrat naa kerlen , ( aey musalmano ! ) tumhara unn say virasat ka koi rishta nahi hai .   haan agar deen ki wajeh say woh tum say koi madad maangen to tum per unn ki madad wajib hai , siwaye uss soorat kay jabkay woh madad kissi aesi qoam kay khilaf ho jiss kay sath tumhara koi moahida hai .   aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah ussay achi tarah dekhta hai .
verses.translation: jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney hijrat ki hai , aur apney maalon aur janon say Allah kay raastay mein jihad kiya hai , woh aur jinhon ney unn ko ( madina mein ) abad kiya , aur unn ki madad ki , yeh sabb log aapas mein aik doosray kay wali waris hain . aur jo log emaan ley aaye hain , ( magar ) unhon ney hijrat nahi ki , jab tak woh hijrat naa kerlen , ( aey musalmano ! ) tumhara unn say virasat ka koi rishta nahi hai .   haan agar deen ki wajeh say woh tum say koi madad maangen to tum per unn ki madad wajib hai , siwaye uss soorat kay jabkay woh madad kissi aesi qoam kay khilaf ho jiss kay sath tumhara koi moahida hai .   aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah ussay achi tarah dekhta hai .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna rakha hai , woh aapas mein aik doosray kay wali waris hain . agar tum aisa nahi kero gay to zameen mein fitna aur bara fasad barpa hoga .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna rakha hai , woh aapas mein aik doosray kay wali waris hain . agar tum aisa nahi kero gay to zameen mein fitna aur bara fasad barpa hoga .

verses.text: aur jo log emaan ley aaye , aur unhon ney hijrat ki , aur Allah kay raastay mein jihad kiya , woh aur jinhon ney unhen abad kiya , aur unn ki madad ki , woh sabb sahih maani mein momin hain .   aesay log maghfirat aur ba-izzat rizq kay mustahiq hain .
verses.translation: aur jo log emaan ley aaye , aur unhon ney hijrat ki , aur Allah kay raastay mein jihad kiya , woh aur jinhon ney unhen abad kiya , aur unn ki madad ki , woh sabb sahih maani mein momin hain .   aesay log maghfirat aur ba-izzat rizq kay mustahiq hain .

verses.text: aur jinhon ney baad mein emaan qubool kiya , aur hijrat ki , aur tumharay sath jihad kiya , to woh bhi tum mein shamil hain . aur ( unn mein say ) jo log ( puraney mohajreen kay ) rishta daar hain , woh Allah ki kitab mein aik doosray ( ki meeras kay doosron say ) ziyada haq daar hain .   yaqeenan Allah her cheez ka poora poora ilm rakhta hai .
verses.translation: aur jinhon ney baad mein emaan qubool kiya , aur hijrat ki , aur tumharay sath jihad kiya , to woh bhi tum mein shamil hain . aur ( unn mein say ) jo log ( puraney mohajreen kay ) rishta daar hain , woh Allah ki kitab mein aik doosray ( ki meeras kay doosron say ) ziyada haq daar hain .   yaqeenan Allah her cheez ka poora poora ilm rakhta hai .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) log tum say maal-e-ghaneemat kay baaray mein poochtay hain . keh do kay maal-e-ghaneemat ( kay baaray mein faislay ) ka ikhtiyar Allah aur Rasool ko hasil hai . lehaza tum Allah say daro , aur aapas kay talluqaat durust kerlo ,   aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki itaat kero , agar tum waqaee momin ho .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) log tum say maal-e-ghaneemat kay baaray mein poochtay hain . keh do kay maal-e-ghaneemat ( kay baaray mein faislay ) ka ikhtiyar Allah aur Rasool ko hasil hai . lehaza tum Allah say daro , aur aapas kay talluqaat durust kerlo ,   aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki itaat kero , agar tum waqaee momin ho .

ayahs.text: momin to woh log hain kay jab unn kay samney Allah ka ziker hota hai to unn kay dil darr jatay hain , aur jab unn kay samney uss ki aayaten parhi jati hain to woh aayaten unn kay emaan ko aur taraqqi deti hain , aur woh apney perwerdigar per bharosa kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: momin to woh log hain kay jab unn kay samney Allah ka ziker hota hai to unn kay dil darr jatay hain , aur jab unn kay samney uss ki aayaten parhi jati hain to woh aayaten unn kay emaan ko aur taraqqi deti hain , aur woh apney perwerdigar per bharosa kertay hain .

ayahs.text: jo namaz qaeem kertay hain , aur hum ney unn ko jo rizq diya hai , uss mein say ( fi sabeel Allah ) kharch kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: jo namaz qaeem kertay hain , aur hum ney unn ko jo rizq diya hai , uss mein say ( fi sabeel Allah ) kharch kertay hain .

ayahs.text: yehi log hain jo haqeeqat mein momin hain . inn kay liye inn kay rab kay paas baray darjay hain , maghfirat hai , aur ba-izzat rizq hai .
ayahs.translation: yehi log hain jo haqeeqat mein momin hain . inn kay liye inn kay rab kay paas baray darjay hain , maghfirat hai , aur ba-izzat rizq hai .

ayahs.text: . ( maal-e-ghaneemat ki taqseem ka ) yeh moamla kuch aisa hi hai jaisay tumharay rab ney tumhen apney ghar say haq ki khatir nikala , jabkay musalmanon kay aik giroh ko yeh baat napasand thi .
ayahs.translation: . ( maal-e-ghaneemat ki taqseem ka ) yeh moamla kuch aisa hi hai jaisay tumharay rab ney tumhen apney ghar say haq ki khatir nikala , jabkay musalmanon kay aik giroh ko yeh baat napasand thi .

ayahs.text: woh tum say haq kay moamlay mein uss kay wazeh hojaney kay bawajood iss tarah behas ker rahey thay jaisay unn ko moat ki taraf hanka kerlay jaya jaraha ho , aur woh ( ussay ) aankhon say dekh rahey hon .
ayahs.translation: woh tum say haq kay moamlay mein uss kay wazeh hojaney kay bawajood iss tarah behas ker rahey thay jaisay unn ko moat ki taraf hanka kerlay jaya jaraha ho , aur woh ( ussay ) aankhon say dekh rahey hon .

ayahs.text: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab Allah tum say yeh wada ker raha tha kay do girohon mein say koi aik tumhara hoga , aur tumhari khuwaish thi kay jiss giroh mein ( khatray ka ) koi kaantta nahi tha , woh tumhen milay   aur Allah yeh chahta tha kay apney ehkaam say haq ko haq ker dikhaye , aur kafiron ki jarr kaat daalay .
ayahs.translation: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab Allah tum say yeh wada ker raha tha kay do girohon mein say koi aik tumhara hoga , aur tumhari khuwaish thi kay jiss giroh mein ( khatray ka ) koi kaantta nahi tha , woh tumhen milay   aur Allah yeh chahta tha kay apney ehkaam say haq ko haq ker dikhaye , aur kafiron ki jarr kaat daalay .

ayahs.text: takay haq ka haq hona aur batil ka batil hona sabit kerday , chahye mujrim logon  ko yeh baat kitni nagawar ho .
ayahs.translation: takay haq ka haq hona aur batil ka batil hona sabit kerday , chahye mujrim logon  ko yeh baat kitni nagawar ho .

ayahs.text: yaad kero jab tum apney rab say fariyad ker rahey thay , to uss ney tumhari fariyad ka jawab diya kay mein tumhari madad kay liye aik hazar farishton ki kumak bhejney wala hun jo lagataar ayen gay .
ayahs.translation: yaad kero jab tum apney rab say fariyad ker rahey thay , to uss ney tumhari fariyad ka jawab diya kay mein tumhari madad kay liye aik hazar farishton ki kumak bhejney wala hun jo lagataar ayen gay .

ayahs.text: aur yeh wada Allah ney kissi aur wajeh say nahi , balkay sirf iss liye kiya kay woh khushkhabri banay , aur takay tumharay dilon ko itminan hasil ho , werna madad kissi aur kay paas say nahi , sirf Allah kay paas say aati hai .   yaqeenan Allah iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh wada Allah ney kissi aur wajeh say nahi , balkay sirf iss liye kiya kay woh khushkhabri banay , aur takay tumharay dilon ko itminan hasil ho , werna madad kissi aur kay paas say nahi , sirf Allah kay paas say aati hai .   yaqeenan Allah iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

ayahs.text: yaad kero jab tum per say ghabrahat door kernay kay liye woh apney hukum say tum per ghunoodgi taari ker-raha tha ,   aur tum per aasman say paani barsa raha tha ,   takay uss kay zariye tumhen pak keray , tum say shetan ki gandagi door keray ,   tumharay dilon ki daahrus bandhaye , aur uss kay zariye ( tumharay ) paon achi tarah jama dey .
ayahs.translation: yaad kero jab tum per say ghabrahat door kernay kay liye woh apney hukum say tum per ghunoodgi taari ker-raha tha ,   aur tum per aasman say paani barsa raha tha ,   takay uss kay zariye tumhen pak keray , tum say shetan ki gandagi door keray ,   tumharay dilon ki daahrus bandhaye , aur uss kay zariye ( tumharay ) paon achi tarah jama dey .

ayahs.text: woh waqt jab tumhara rab farishton ko wahi kay zariye hukum dey raha tha kay :  mein tumharay sath hun , abb tum mominon kay qadam jamao mein kafiron kay dilon mein roab taari kerdun ga , phir tum gardanon kay oopper waar kero , aur unn ki ungliyon kay her her jorr per zarab lagao .
ayahs.translation: woh waqt jab tumhara rab farishton ko wahi kay zariye hukum dey raha tha kay :  mein tumharay sath hun , abb tum mominon kay qadam jamao mein kafiron kay dilon mein roab taari kerdun ga , phir tum gardanon kay oopper waar kero , aur unn ki ungliyon kay her her jorr per zarab lagao .

ayahs.text: yeh iss liye kay unhon ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool say dushmani mol li hai , aur agar koi shaks Allah aur uss kay Rasool say dushmani mol leta hai , to yaqeenan Allah ka azab bara sakht hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh iss liye kay unhon ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool say dushmani mol li hai , aur agar koi shaks Allah aur uss kay Rasool say dushmani mol leta hai , to yaqeenan Allah ka azab bara sakht hai .

ayahs.text: yeh sabb to ( abb ) chakh lo , iss kay ilawa haqeeqat yeh hai kay kafiron kay liye ( asal ) azab dozakh ka hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh sabb to ( abb ) chakh lo , iss kay ilawa haqeeqat yeh hai kay kafiron kay liye ( asal ) azab dozakh ka hai .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! jab kafiron say tumhara aamna samna hojaye , jabkay woh charrhai ker kay aarahey hon , to unn ko peeth matt dikhao .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! jab kafiron say tumhara aamna samna hojaye , jabkay woh charrhai ker kay aarahey hon , to unn ko peeth matt dikhao .

ayahs.text: aur agar koi shaks kissi jangi chaal ki wajeh say aisa ker raha ho , ya apni kissi jamat say jaa milna chahta ho , uss ki baat to aur hai , magar uss kay siwa jo shaks aesay din apni peeth pheray ga to woh Allah ki taraf say ghazab ley ker lotay ga , aur uss ka thikana jahannum hoga , aur woh boht bura thikana hai .
ayahs.translation: aur agar koi shaks kissi jangi chaal ki wajeh say aisa ker raha ho , ya apni kissi jamat say jaa milna chahta ho , uss ki baat to aur hai , magar uss kay siwa jo shaks aesay din apni peeth pheray ga to woh Allah ki taraf say ghazab ley ker lotay ga , aur uss ka thikana jahannum hoga , aur woh boht bura thikana hai .

ayahs.text: chunacheh ( musalmano ! haqeeqat mein ) tum ney unn ( kafiron ko ) qatal nahi kiya tha , balkay unhen Allah ney qatal kiya tha , aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab tum ney unn per ( mitti ) phenki thi to woh tum ney nahi , balkay Allah ney phenki thi ,   aur ( tumharay haathon yeh kaam iss liye keraya tha ) takay uss kay zariye Allah mominon ko behtareen ajar ata keray . beyshak Allah her baat ko sunney wala , her cheez ko janney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh ( musalmano ! haqeeqat mein ) tum ney unn ( kafiron ko ) qatal nahi kiya tha , balkay unhen Allah ney qatal kiya tha , aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab tum ney unn per ( mitti ) phenki thi to woh tum ney nahi , balkay Allah ney phenki thi ,   aur ( tumharay haathon yeh kaam iss liye keraya tha ) takay uss kay zariye Allah mominon ko behtareen ajar ata keray . beyshak Allah her baat ko sunney wala , her cheez ko janney wala hai .

ayahs.text: yeh sabb kuch to apni jagah , iss kay ilawa yeh baat bhi thi kay Allah ko kafiron ki her sazish ko kamzor kerna tha .
ayahs.translation: yeh sabb kuch to apni jagah , iss kay ilawa yeh baat bhi thi kay Allah ko kafiron ki her sazish ko kamzor kerna tha .

ayahs.text: . ( aey kafiro ! ) agar tum faisla chahtay thay , to lo ! abb faisla tumharay samney aagaya . abb agar tum baaz aajao to yeh tumharay hi liye behtar hoga , aur agar tum phir wohi kaam kero gay ( jo abb tak kertay rahey ho ) to hum bhi phir wohi kaam keren gay ( jo abb kiya hai ) . aur tumhara jatha tumharay kuch kaam nahi aaye ga , chahye woh kitna ziyada ho , aur yaad rakho kay Allah mominon kay sath hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey kafiro ! ) agar tum faisla chahtay thay , to lo ! abb faisla tumharay samney aagaya . abb agar tum baaz aajao to yeh tumharay hi liye behtar hoga , aur agar tum phir wohi kaam kero gay ( jo abb tak kertay rahey ho ) to hum bhi phir wohi kaam keren gay ( jo abb kiya hai ) . aur tumhara jatha tumharay kuch kaam nahi aaye ga , chahye woh kitna ziyada ho , aur yaad rakho kay Allah mominon kay sath hai .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki tabey daari kero , aur iss ( tabey daari ) say mun naa morro , jabkay tum ( Allah aur Rasool kay ehkaam ) sunn rahey ho .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki tabey daari kero , aur iss ( tabey daari ) say mun naa morro , jabkay tum ( Allah aur Rasool kay ehkaam ) sunn rahey ho .

ayahs.text: aur unn logon  ki tarah naa hojana jo kehtay to hain kay hum ney sunn liya , magar woh ( haqeeqat mein ) suntay nahi hain .
ayahs.translation: aur unn logon  ki tarah naa hojana jo kehtay to hain kay hum ney sunn liya , magar woh ( haqeeqat mein ) suntay nahi hain .

ayahs.text: yaqeen rakho kay Allah kay nazdeek bad-tareen janwer woh behray goongay log hain jo aqal say kaam nahi letay .
ayahs.translation: yaqeen rakho kay Allah kay nazdeek bad-tareen janwer woh behray goongay log hain jo aqal say kaam nahi letay .

ayahs.text: aur agar Allah kay ilm mein unn kay andar koi bhalai hoti to woh unn ko sunney ki tofiq dey deta , lekin abb ( jabkay unn mein bhalai nahi hai ) agar unn ko sunney ki tofiq dey bhi dey to woh mun morr ker bhag jayen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur agar Allah kay ilm mein unn kay andar koi bhalai hoti to woh unn ko sunney ki tofiq dey deta , lekin abb ( jabkay unn mein bhalai nahi hai ) agar unn ko sunney ki tofiq dey bhi dey to woh mun morr ker bhag jayen gay .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah aur Rasool ki dawat qubool kero , jab Rasool tumhen uss baat ki taraf bulaye jo tumhen zindagi bakhshney wali hai .   aur yeh baat jaan rakho kay Allah insan aur uss kay dil kay darmiyan aarr ban jata hai ,   aur yeh kay tum sabb ko ussi ki taraf ikattha ker kay ley jaya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah aur Rasool ki dawat qubool kero , jab Rasool tumhen uss baat ki taraf bulaye jo tumhen zindagi bakhshney wali hai .   aur yeh baat jaan rakho kay Allah insan aur uss kay dil kay darmiyan aarr ban jata hai ,   aur yeh kay tum sabb ko ussi ki taraf ikattha ker kay ley jaya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur daro uss wabal say jo tum mein say sirf unn logon  per nahi parray ga jinhon ney zulm kiya hoga ,   aur jaan rakho kay Allah ka azab bara sakht hai .
ayahs.translation: aur daro uss wabal say jo tum mein say sirf unn logon  per nahi parray ga jinhon ney zulm kiya hoga ,   aur jaan rakho kay Allah ka azab bara sakht hai .

ayahs.text: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab tum tadaad mein thoray thay , tumhen logon  ney ( tumhari ) sarzameen mein daba ker rakha huwa tha , tum dartay thay kay log tumhen uchak kerlay jayen gay . phir Allah ney tumhen thikana diya , aur apni madad say tumhen mazboot bana diya , aur tumhen pakeezah cheezon ka rizq ata kiya , takay tum shuker kero .
ayahs.translation: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab tum tadaad mein thoray thay , tumhen logon  ney ( tumhari ) sarzameen mein daba ker rakha huwa tha , tum dartay thay kay log tumhen uchak kerlay jayen gay . phir Allah ney tumhen thikana diya , aur apni madad say tumhen mazboot bana diya , aur tumhen pakeezah cheezon ka rizq ata kiya , takay tum shuker kero .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah aur Rasool say bey wafai naa kerna , aur naa jantay boojhtay apni amanton mein khayanat kay murtakib hona .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah aur Rasool say bey wafai naa kerna , aur naa jantay boojhtay apni amanton mein khayanat kay murtakib hona .

ayahs.text: aur yeh baat samajh lo kay tumharay maal aur tumhari aulad aik aazmaesh hain ,   aur yeh kay azeem inaam Allah hi kay paas hai .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh baat samajh lo kay tumharay maal aur tumhari aulad aik aazmaesh hain ,   aur yeh kay azeem inaam Allah hi kay paas hai .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! agar tum Allah kay sath taqwa ki rawish ikhtiyar kero gay to woh tumhen ( haq o batil ki ) tameez ata kerday ga ,   aur tumhari buraiyon ka kaffara kerday ga , aur tumhen maghfirat say nawazay ga , aur Allah fazal-e-azeem ka malik hai .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! agar tum Allah kay sath taqwa ki rawish ikhtiyar kero gay to woh tumhen ( haq o batil ki ) tameez ata kerday ga ,   aur tumhari buraiyon ka kaffara kerday ga , aur tumhen maghfirat say nawazay ga , aur Allah fazal-e-azeem ka malik hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) woh waqt yaad kero jab kafir log tumharay khilaf mansoobay bana rahey thay kay tumhen girftaar kerlen , ya tumhen qatal kerden , ya tumhen ( watan say ) nikal den . woh apney mansoobay bana rahey thay , aur Allah apna mansooba bana raha tha , aur Allah sabb say behtar mansooba bananey wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) woh waqt yaad kero jab kafir log tumharay khilaf mansoobay bana rahey thay kay tumhen girftaar kerlen , ya tumhen qatal kerden , ya tumhen ( watan say ) nikal den . woh apney mansoobay bana rahey thay , aur Allah apna mansooba bana raha tha , aur Allah sabb say behtar mansooba bananey wala hai .

ayahs.text: aur jab unn kay samney humari aayaton ki tilawat ki jati hai to yeh kehtay hain kay :  ( bus ! ) hum ney sunn liya , agar hum chahen to iss jaisi baaten hum bhi keh layen . yeh ( Quran ) aur kuch nahi , sirf pichlay logon  kay afsaney hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jab unn kay samney humari aayaton ki tilawat ki jati hai to yeh kehtay hain kay :  ( bus ! ) hum ney sunn liya , agar hum chahen to iss jaisi baaten hum bhi keh layen . yeh ( Quran ) aur kuch nahi , sirf pichlay logon  kay afsaney hain .

ayahs.text: . ( aur aik waqt woh tha ) jab enhon ney kaha tha kay :  ya Allah ! agar yeh ( Quran ) hi woh haq hai jo teri taraf say aaya hai to hum per aasman say pathraon ki barish barsa dey , ya hum per koi aur takleef deh azab daal dey .
ayahs.translation: . ( aur aik waqt woh tha ) jab enhon ney kaha tha kay :  ya Allah ! agar yeh ( Quran ) hi woh haq hai jo teri taraf say aaya hai to hum per aasman say pathraon ki barish barsa dey , ya hum per koi aur takleef deh azab daal dey .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) Allah aisa nahi hai kay inn ko iss halat mein azab dey jab tum inn kay darmiyan mojood ho , aur Allah iss halat mein bhi inn ko azab denay wala nahi hai jab woh astaghfaar kertay hon .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) Allah aisa nahi hai kay inn ko iss halat mein azab dey jab tum inn kay darmiyan mojood ho , aur Allah iss halat mein bhi inn ko azab denay wala nahi hai jab woh astaghfaar kertay hon .

ayahs.text: aur bhala inn mein kiya khoobi hai kay Allah inn ko azab naa dey jabkay woh logon  ko masjid-e-haram say roktay hain ,   halankay woh uss kay mutawalli nahi hain . muttaqi logon  kay siwa kissi qisam kay log uss kay mutawalli nahi hosaktay , lekin unn mein say aksar log ( iss baat ko ) nahi jantay .
ayahs.translation: aur bhala inn mein kiya khoobi hai kay Allah inn ko azab naa dey jabkay woh logon  ko masjid-e-haram say roktay hain ,   halankay woh uss kay mutawalli nahi hain . muttaqi logon  kay siwa kissi qisam kay log uss kay mutawalli nahi hosaktay , lekin unn mein say aksar log ( iss baat ko ) nahi jantay .

ayahs.text: aur baitullah kay paas unn ki namaz seetiyan bajaney aur taliyan peetney kay siwa kuch bhi nahi . lehaza ( aey kafiro ! ) jo kafirana baaten tum kertay rahey ho , unn ki wajeh say abb azab ka maza chakho .
ayahs.translation: aur baitullah kay paas unn ki namaz seetiyan bajaney aur taliyan peetney kay siwa kuch bhi nahi . lehaza ( aey kafiro ! ) jo kafirana baaten tum kertay rahey ho , unn ki wajeh say abb azab ka maza chakho .

ayahs.text: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai woh apney maal iss kaam kay liye kharch ker rahey hain kay logon  ko Allah kay raastay say roken ,   nateeja yeh hoga kay yeh log kharch to keren gay , magar phir yeh sabb kuch inn kay liye hasrat ka sabab ban jaye ga , aur aakhir kaar yeh maghloob hojayen gay . aur ( aakhirat mein ) inn kafir logon  ko jahannum ki taraf ikattha ker kay laya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai woh apney maal iss kaam kay liye kharch ker rahey hain kay logon  ko Allah kay raastay say roken ,   nateeja yeh hoga kay yeh log kharch to keren gay , magar phir yeh sabb kuch inn kay liye hasrat ka sabab ban jaye ga , aur aakhir kaar yeh maghloob hojayen gay . aur ( aakhirat mein ) inn kafir logon  ko jahannum ki taraf ikattha ker kay laya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: takay Allah napak ( logon  ) ko pak ( logon  ) say alag kerday , aur aik napak ko doosray napak per rakh ker sabb ka aik dher banaye , aur uss dher ko jahannum mein daal dey . yehi log hain jo sarasar khasaray mein hain .
ayahs.translation: takay Allah napak ( logon  ) ko pak ( logon  ) say alag kerday , aur aik napak ko doosray napak per rakh ker sabb ka aik dher banaye , aur uss dher ko jahannum mein daal dey . yehi log hain jo sarasar khasaray mein hain .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai unn say keh do kay :  agar woh baaz aajayen to pehlay unn say jo kuch huwa hai , ussay moaaf kerdiya jaye ga .    aur agar woh phir wohi kaam keren gay to pichlay logon  kay sath jo moamla huwa , woh ( unn kay samney ) guzar hi chuka hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai unn say keh do kay :  agar woh baaz aajayen to pehlay unn say jo kuch huwa hai , ussay moaaf kerdiya jaye ga .    aur agar woh phir wohi kaam keren gay to pichlay logon  kay sath jo moamla huwa , woh ( unn kay samney ) guzar hi chuka hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( musalmano ! ) inn kafiron say larrtay raho , yahan tak kay fitna baqi naa rahey , aur deen pooray ka poora Allah ka hojaye .   phir agar yeh baaz aajayen to inn kay aemal ko Allah khoob dekh raha hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( musalmano ! ) inn kafiron say larrtay raho , yahan tak kay fitna baqi naa rahey , aur deen pooray ka poora Allah ka hojaye .   phir agar yeh baaz aajayen to inn kay aemal ko Allah khoob dekh raha hai .

ayahs.text: aur agar yeh mun morray rakhen , to yaqeen jano kay Allah tumhara rakhwala hai , behtareen rakhwala aur behtareen madadgaar !
ayahs.translation: aur agar yeh mun morray rakhen , to yaqeen jano kay Allah tumhara rakhwala hai , behtareen rakhwala aur behtareen madadgaar !

ayahs.text: aur ( musalmano ! ) yeh baat apney ilm mein ley aao kay tum jo kuch maal-e-ghaneemat hasil kero , uss ka paanchwan hissa Allah aur Rasool aur unn kay qurbat qraabat daaron aur yateemon aur miskeeno aur musfiron ka haq hai   ( jiss ki adaegi tum per wajib hai , ) agar tum Allah per aur uss cheez per emaan rakhtay ho jo hum ney apney banday per faislay kay din nazil ki thi ,   jiss din do jamaten baham takrai then , aur Allah her cheez per qadir hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( musalmano ! ) yeh baat apney ilm mein ley aao kay tum jo kuch maal-e-ghaneemat hasil kero , uss ka paanchwan hissa Allah aur Rasool aur unn kay qurbat qraabat daaron aur yateemon aur miskeeno aur musfiron ka haq hai   ( jiss ki adaegi tum per wajib hai , ) agar tum Allah per aur uss cheez per emaan rakhtay ho jo hum ney apney banday per faislay kay din nazil ki thi ,   jiss din do jamaten baham takrai then , aur Allah her cheez per qadir hai .

ayahs.text: woh waqt yaad kero jab tum log wadi kay qareeb walay kinaray per thay , aur woh log door walay kinaray per , aur qafla tum say neechay ki taraf .   aur agar tum pehlay say ( larraee ka ) waqt aapas mein tey kertay to waqt tey kernay mein tumharay darmiyan zaroor ikhtilaf hojata , lekin yeh waqiaa ( kay pehlay say tey kiye baghair lashkar takra gaye ) iss liye huwa kay jo kaam ho ker rehna tha , Allah ussay poora ker dikhaye , takay jissay barbad hona ho , woh wazeh daleel dekh ker barbad ho , aur jissay zinda rehna ho woh wazeh daleel dekh ker zinda rahey ,   aur Allah her baat sunney wala , her cheez janney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: woh waqt yaad kero jab tum log wadi kay qareeb walay kinaray per thay , aur woh log door walay kinaray per , aur qafla tum say neechay ki taraf .   aur agar tum pehlay say ( larraee ka ) waqt aapas mein tey kertay to waqt tey kernay mein tumharay darmiyan zaroor ikhtilaf hojata , lekin yeh waqiaa ( kay pehlay say tey kiye baghair lashkar takra gaye ) iss liye huwa kay jo kaam ho ker rehna tha , Allah ussay poora ker dikhaye , takay jissay barbad hona ho , woh wazeh daleel dekh ker barbad ho , aur jissay zinda rehna ho woh wazeh daleel dekh ker zinda rahey ,   aur Allah her baat sunney wala , her cheez janney wala hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) woh waqt yaad kero jab Allah khuwab mein tumhen unn ( dushmanon ) ki tadaad kam dikha raha tha ,   aur agar tumhen unn ki tadaad ziyada dikha deta to ( aey musalmano ! ) tum himmat haar jatay , aur tumharay darmiyan iss moamlay mein ikhtilaf peda hojata , lekin Allah ney ( tumhen uss say ) bacha liya . yaqeenan woh seenon mein chupi baaten khoob janta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) woh waqt yaad kero jab Allah khuwab mein tumhen unn ( dushmanon ) ki tadaad kam dikha raha tha ,   aur agar tumhen unn ki tadaad ziyada dikha deta to ( aey musalmano ! ) tum himmat haar jatay , aur tumharay darmiyan iss moamlay mein ikhtilaf peda hojata , lekin Allah ney ( tumhen uss say ) bacha liya . yaqeenan woh seenon mein chupi baaten khoob janta hai .

ayahs.text: aur woh waqt yaad kero kay jab tum aik doosray kay madd-e-muqabil aaye thay to Allah tumhari nigahon mein unn ki tadaad kam dikha raha tha , aur unn ki nigahon mein tumhen kam ker kay dikha raha tha ,   takay jo kaam ho ker rehna tha , Allah ussay poora ker dikhaye . aur tamam moamlaat Allah hi ki taraf lotaye jatay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur woh waqt yaad kero kay jab tum aik doosray kay madd-e-muqabil aaye thay to Allah tumhari nigahon mein unn ki tadaad kam dikha raha tha , aur unn ki nigahon mein tumhen kam ker kay dikha raha tha ,   takay jo kaam ho ker rehna tha , Allah ussay poora ker dikhaye . aur tamam moamlaat Allah hi ki taraf lotaye jatay hain .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! jab tumhara kissi giroh say muqabla hojaye to sabit qadam raho , aur Allah ka kasrat say ziker kero , takay tumhen kamiyabi hasil ho .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! jab tumhara kissi giroh say muqabla hojaye to sabit qadam raho , aur Allah ka kasrat say ziker kero , takay tumhen kamiyabi hasil ho .

ayahs.text: aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki itaat kero , aur aapas mein jhagrra naa kero , werna tum kamzor parr-jao gay , aur tumhari huwa ukhar jaye gi . aur sabar say kaam lo . yaqeen rakho kay Allah sabar kernay walon kay sath hai .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki itaat kero , aur aapas mein jhagrra naa kero , werna tum kamzor parr-jao gay , aur tumhari huwa ukhar jaye gi . aur sabar say kaam lo . yaqeen rakho kay Allah sabar kernay walon kay sath hai .

ayahs.text: aur unn logon  ki tarah naa hojana jo apney gharon say akartay huye , aur logon  ko apni shaan dikhatay huye niklay thay , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay say rok rahey thay .   aur Allah ney logon  kay saray aemal ko ( apney ilm kay ) ehatay mein liya huwa hai .
ayahs.translation: aur unn logon  ki tarah naa hojana jo apney gharon say akartay huye , aur logon  ko apni shaan dikhatay huye niklay thay , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay say rok rahey thay .   aur Allah ney logon  kay saray aemal ko ( apney ilm kay ) ehatay mein liya huwa hai .

ayahs.text: aur woh waqt ( bhi qabil-e-ziker hai ) jab shetan ney unn ( kafiron ) ko yeh sujhaya tha kay unn kay aemal baray khushnuma hain , aur yeh kaha tha kay :  aaj insanon mein koi nahi hai jo tum per ghalib aa-sakay , aur mein tumhara mohafiz hun .    phir jab dono giroh aamney samney aaye to woh aeriyon kay ball peechay hata , aur kehney laga :  mein tumhari koi zimma daari nahi ley sakta , mujhay jo kuch nazar aaraha hai , woh tumhen nazar nahi aaraha . mujhay Allah say darr lagg raha hai , aur Allah ka azab bara sakht hai .
ayahs.translation: aur woh waqt ( bhi qabil-e-ziker hai ) jab shetan ney unn ( kafiron ) ko yeh sujhaya tha kay unn kay aemal baray khushnuma hain , aur yeh kaha tha kay :  aaj insanon mein koi nahi hai jo tum per ghalib aa-sakay , aur mein tumhara mohafiz hun .    phir jab dono giroh aamney samney aaye to woh aeriyon kay ball peechay hata , aur kehney laga :  mein tumhari koi zimma daari nahi ley sakta , mujhay jo kuch nazar aaraha hai , woh tumhen nazar nahi aaraha . mujhay Allah say darr lagg raha hai , aur Allah ka azab bara sakht hai .

ayahs.text: aur yaad kero jab munafiqeen aur woh log jinn kay dilon mein rog tha , yeh keh rahey thay kay :  inn ( musalmanon ) ko inn kay deen ney dhokay mein daal rakha hai .    halankay jo koi Allah per bharosa keray to Allah sabb per ghalib hai , bari hikmat wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur yaad kero jab munafiqeen aur woh log jinn kay dilon mein rog tha , yeh keh rahey thay kay :  inn ( musalmanon ) ko inn kay deen ney dhokay mein daal rakha hai .    halankay jo koi Allah per bharosa keray to Allah sabb per ghalib hai , bari hikmat wala hai .

ayahs.text: aur agar tum dekhtay ( to woh ajeeb manzar tha ) jab farishtay unn kafiron ki rooh qabz ker rahey thay , unn kay chehron aur pusht per maartay jatay thay , ( aur kehtay jatay thay kay : )  abb jalney kay azab ka maza ( bhi ) chakhna .
ayahs.translation: aur agar tum dekhtay ( to woh ajeeb manzar tha ) jab farishtay unn kafiron ki rooh qabz ker rahey thay , unn kay chehron aur pusht per maartay jatay thay , ( aur kehtay jatay thay kay : )  abb jalney kay azab ka maza ( bhi ) chakhna .

ayahs.text: yeh sabb kuch unn aemal ka badla hai jo tum ney apney haathon aagay bhej rakhay thay , aur yeh baat tey hai kay Allah bandon per zulm kernay wala nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh sabb kuch unn aemal ka badla hai jo tum ney apney haathon aagay bhej rakhay thay , aur yeh baat tey hai kay Allah bandon per zulm kernay wala nahi hai .

ayahs.text: . ( inn logon  ka haal aisa hi huwa ) jaisa firon ki qoam aur unn say pehlay logon  ka haal huwa tha . unhon ney Allah ki nishaniyon ko manney say inkar kiya , nateeja yeh huwa kay Allah ney unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say unhen apni girift mein ley liya . yaqeenan Allah ki taqat bari hai ( aur ) azab bara sakht !
ayahs.translation: . ( inn logon  ka haal aisa hi huwa ) jaisa firon ki qoam aur unn say pehlay logon  ka haal huwa tha . unhon ney Allah ki nishaniyon ko manney say inkar kiya , nateeja yeh huwa kay Allah ney unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say unhen apni girift mein ley liya . yaqeenan Allah ki taqat bari hai ( aur ) azab bara sakht !

ayahs.text: yeh sabb kuch iss liye huwa kay Allah ka dastoor yeh hai kay uss ney jo naimat kissi qoam ko di ho , ussay uss waqt tak badalna gawara nahi kerta jab tak woh log khud apni halat tabdeel naa kerlen ,   aur Allah her baat sunta , sabb kuch janta hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh sabb kuch iss liye huwa kay Allah ka dastoor yeh hai kay uss ney jo naimat kissi qoam ko di ho , ussay uss waqt tak badalna gawara nahi kerta jab tak woh log khud apni halat tabdeel naa kerlen ,   aur Allah her baat sunta , sabb kuch janta hai .

ayahs.text: . ( iss moamlay mein bhi unn ka haal ) aisa hi huwa jaisa firon ki qoam aur unn say pehlay logon  ka haal huwa tha . unhon ney apney rab ki nishaniyon ko jhutlaya . nateeja yeh huwa kay hum ney unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say unhen halak kerdiya , aur firon ki qoam ko gharq kerdiya , aur yeh sab zalim log thay .
ayahs.translation: . ( iss moamlay mein bhi unn ka haal ) aisa hi huwa jaisa firon ki qoam aur unn say pehlay logon  ka haal huwa tha . unhon ney apney rab ki nishaniyon ko jhutlaya . nateeja yeh huwa kay hum ney unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say unhen halak kerdiya , aur firon ki qoam ko gharq kerdiya , aur yeh sab zalim log thay .

ayahs.text: yaqeen jano kay Allah kay nazdeek zameen per chalney walay jaan daaron mein bad-tareen log woh hain jinhon ney kufr apna liya hai , jiss ki wajeh say woh emaan nahi latay .
ayahs.translation: yaqeen jano kay Allah kay nazdeek zameen per chalney walay jaan daaron mein bad-tareen log woh hain jinhon ney kufr apna liya hai , jiss ki wajeh say woh emaan nahi latay .

ayahs.text: yeh log woh hain jinn say tum ney ehad ley rakha hai , iss kay bawajood yeh her martaba apney ehad ko torr detay hain , aur zara nahi dartay .
ayahs.translation: yeh log woh hain jinn say tum ney ehad ley rakha hai , iss kay bawajood yeh her martaba apney ehad ko torr detay hain , aur zara nahi dartay .

ayahs.text: lehaza agar kabhi yeh log jang mein tumharay haath lagg jayen to , inn ko saman-e-ibrat bana ker unn logon  ko bhi tittar-bittar ker daalo jo inn kay peechay hain , takay woh yaad rakhen .
ayahs.translation: lehaza agar kabhi yeh log jang mein tumharay haath lagg jayen to , inn ko saman-e-ibrat bana ker unn logon  ko bhi tittar-bittar ker daalo jo inn kay peechay hain , takay woh yaad rakhen .

ayahs.text: aur agar tumhen kissi qoam say bad-ehadi ka andesha ho to tum woh moahida unn ki taraf saaf seedhay tareeqay say phenk do .   yaad rakho kay Allah badd ehadi kernay walon ko pasand nahi kerta .
ayahs.translation: aur agar tumhen kissi qoam say bad-ehadi ka andesha ho to tum woh moahida unn ki taraf saaf seedhay tareeqay say phenk do .   yaad rakho kay Allah badd ehadi kernay walon ko pasand nahi kerta .

ayahs.text: aur kafir log hergiz yeh khayal bhi dil mein naa layen kay woh bhag niklay hain .   yeh yaqeeni baat hai kay woh ( Allah ko ) aajiz nahi ker-saktay .
ayahs.translation: aur kafir log hergiz yeh khayal bhi dil mein naa layen kay woh bhag niklay hain .   yeh yaqeeni baat hai kay woh ( Allah ko ) aajiz nahi ker-saktay .

ayahs.text: aur ( musalmano ! ) jiss qadar taqat aur ghorron ki jitni chaoniyan tum say ban parren , unn say muqablay kay liye tayyar kero ,   jinn kay zariye tum Allah kay dushman aur apney ( mojooda ) dushman per bhi heybat taari ker-sako-? , aur inn kay ilawa doosron per bhi jinhen abhi tum nahi jantay , ( magar ) Allah unhen janta hai .   aur Allah kay raastay mein tum jo kuch kharch kero gay , woh tumhen poora poora dey diya jaye ga , aur tumharay liye koi kami nahi ki jaye gi .
ayahs.translation: aur ( musalmano ! ) jiss qadar taqat aur ghorron ki jitni chaoniyan tum say ban parren , unn say muqablay kay liye tayyar kero ,   jinn kay zariye tum Allah kay dushman aur apney ( mojooda ) dushman per bhi heybat taari ker-sako-? , aur inn kay ilawa doosron per bhi jinhen abhi tum nahi jantay , ( magar ) Allah unhen janta hai .   aur Allah kay raastay mein tum jo kuch kharch kero gay , woh tumhen poora poora dey diya jaye ga , aur tumharay liye koi kami nahi ki jaye gi .

ayahs.text: aur agar woh log sulah ki taraf jhuken to tum bhi uss ki taraf jhuk jao ,   aur Allah per bharosa rakho . yaqeen jano wohi hai jo her baat sunta , sabb kuch janta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur agar woh log sulah ki taraf jhuken to tum bhi uss ki taraf jhuk jao ,   aur Allah per bharosa rakho . yaqeen jano wohi hai jo her baat sunta , sabb kuch janta hai .

ayahs.text: aur agar woh tumhen dhoka denay ka irada keren gay to Allah tumharay liye kafi hai . wohi to hai jiss ney apni madad kay zariye aur mominon kay zariye tumharay haath mazboot kiye .
ayahs.translation: aur agar woh tumhen dhoka denay ka irada keren gay to Allah tumharay liye kafi hai . wohi to hai jiss ney apni madad kay zariye aur mominon kay zariye tumharay haath mazboot kiye .

ayahs.text: aur unn kay dilon mein aik doosray ki ulfat peda kerdi . agar tum zameen bhar ki sari dolat bhi kharch kerletay to unn kay dilon mein yeh ulfat peda naa ker-saktay , lekin Allah ney unn kay dilon ko jorr diya . woh yaqeenan iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
ayahs.translation: aur unn kay dilon mein aik doosray ki ulfat peda kerdi . agar tum zameen bhar ki sari dolat bhi kharch kerletay to unn kay dilon mein yeh ulfat peda naa ker-saktay , lekin Allah ney unn kay dilon ko jorr diya . woh yaqeenan iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

ayahs.text: aey nabi ! tumharay liye to bus Allah aur woh momin log kafi hain jinhon ney tumhari perwi ki hai .
ayahs.translation: aey nabi ! tumharay liye to bus Allah aur woh momin log kafi hain jinhon ney tumhari perwi ki hai .

ayahs.text: aey nabi ! mominon ko jang per ubharo . agar tumharay bees aadmi aesay hon gay jo sabit qadam rehney walay hon to woh do so per ghalib aajayen gay . aur agar tumharay so aadmi hon gay to woh kafiron kay aik hazar per ghalib aajayen gay , kiyonkay woh aesay log hain jo samajh nahi rakhtay .
ayahs.translation: aey nabi ! mominon ko jang per ubharo . agar tumharay bees aadmi aesay hon gay jo sabit qadam rehney walay hon to woh do so per ghalib aajayen gay . aur agar tumharay so aadmi hon gay to woh kafiron kay aik hazar per ghalib aajayen gay , kiyonkay woh aesay log hain jo samajh nahi rakhtay .

ayahs.text: loa abb Allah ney tum say bojh halka kerdiya , aur uss kay ilm mein hai kay tumharay andar kuch kamzori hai . lehaza ( abb hukum yeh hai kay ) agar tumharay sabit qadam rehney walay so aadmi hon to woh do so per ghalib aajayen gay , aur agar tumharay aik hazar aadmi hon to woh Allah kay hukum say do hazar per ghalib aajayen gay , aur Allah sabit qadam rehney walon kay sath hai .
ayahs.translation: loa abb Allah ney tum say bojh halka kerdiya , aur uss kay ilm mein hai kay tumharay andar kuch kamzori hai . lehaza ( abb hukum yeh hai kay ) agar tumharay sabit qadam rehney walay so aadmi hon to woh do so per ghalib aajayen gay , aur agar tumharay aik hazar aadmi hon to woh Allah kay hukum say do hazar per ghalib aajayen gay , aur Allah sabit qadam rehney walon kay sath hai .

ayahs.text: yeh baat kissi nabi kay shayaan shaan nahi hai kay uss kay paas qedi rahen ,   jab tak kay woh zameen mein ( dushmanon ka ) khoon achi tarah naa baha chuka ho , ( jiss say unn ka roab poori tarah toot jaye ) tum duniya ka saz-o-saman chahtay ho , aur Allah ( tumharay liye ) aakhirat ( ki bhalai ) chahta hai , aur Allah sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , sahab-e-hikmat bhi .
ayahs.translation: yeh baat kissi nabi kay shayaan shaan nahi hai kay uss kay paas qedi rahen ,   jab tak kay woh zameen mein ( dushmanon ka ) khoon achi tarah naa baha chuka ho , ( jiss say unn ka roab poori tarah toot jaye ) tum duniya ka saz-o-saman chahtay ho , aur Allah ( tumharay liye ) aakhirat ( ki bhalai ) chahta hai , aur Allah sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , sahab-e-hikmat bhi .

ayahs.text: agar Allah ki taraf say aik likha huwa hukum pehlay naa aa-chuka hota to jo raasta tum ney ikhtiyar kiya , uss ki wajeh say tum per koi bari saza aajati .
ayahs.translation: agar Allah ki taraf say aik likha huwa hukum pehlay naa aa-chuka hota to jo raasta tum ney ikhtiyar kiya , uss ki wajeh say tum per koi bari saza aajati .

ayahs.text: lehaza abb tum ney jo maal-e-ghaneemat mein hasil kiya hai , ussay pakeezah halal maal kay tor per khao , aur Allah say dartay raho . yaqeenan Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: lehaza abb tum ney jo maal-e-ghaneemat mein hasil kiya hai , ussay pakeezah halal maal kay tor per khao , aur Allah say dartay raho . yaqeenan Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: aey nabi ! tum logon  kay haathon mein jo qedi hain , ( aur jinhon ney musalman honey ka irada zahir kiya hai ) unn say keh do kay :  agar Allah tumharay dilon mein bhalai dekhay ga to jo maal tum say ( fidya mein ) liya gaya hai uss say behtar tumhen deydey ga ,   aur tumhari bakhshish kerday ga , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: aey nabi ! tum logon  kay haathon mein jo qedi hain , ( aur jinhon ney musalman honey ka irada zahir kiya hai ) unn say keh do kay :  agar Allah tumharay dilon mein bhalai dekhay ga to jo maal tum say ( fidya mein ) liya gaya hai uss say behtar tumhen deydey ga ,   aur tumhari bakhshish kerday ga , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: aur agar unn logon  ney ( aey nabi ! ) tum say khayanat kernay ka irada kiya , to yeh iss say pehlay Allah kay sath khayanat ker-chukay hain , jiss kay nateejay mein Allah ney enhen tumharay qaboo mein dey diya , aur Allah ka ilm bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil .
ayahs.translation: aur agar unn logon  ney ( aey nabi ! ) tum say khayanat kernay ka irada kiya , to yeh iss say pehlay Allah kay sath khayanat ker-chukay hain , jiss kay nateejay mein Allah ney enhen tumharay qaboo mein dey diya , aur Allah ka ilm bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil .

ayahs.text: jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney hijrat ki hai , aur apney maalon aur janon say Allah kay raastay mein jihad kiya hai , woh aur jinhon ney unn ko ( madina mein ) abad kiya , aur unn ki madad ki , yeh sabb log aapas mein aik doosray kay wali waris hain . aur jo log emaan ley aaye hain , ( magar ) unhon ney hijrat nahi ki , jab tak woh hijrat naa kerlen , ( aey musalmano ! ) tumhara unn say virasat ka koi rishta nahi hai .   haan agar deen ki wajeh say woh tum say koi madad maangen to tum per unn ki madad wajib hai , siwaye uss soorat kay jabkay woh madad kissi aesi qoam kay khilaf ho jiss kay sath tumhara koi moahida hai .   aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah ussay achi tarah dekhta hai .
ayahs.translation: jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney hijrat ki hai , aur apney maalon aur janon say Allah kay raastay mein jihad kiya hai , woh aur jinhon ney unn ko ( madina mein ) abad kiya , aur unn ki madad ki , yeh sabb log aapas mein aik doosray kay wali waris hain . aur jo log emaan ley aaye hain , ( magar ) unhon ney hijrat nahi ki , jab tak woh hijrat naa kerlen , ( aey musalmano ! ) tumhara unn say virasat ka koi rishta nahi hai .   haan agar deen ki wajeh say woh tum say koi madad maangen to tum per unn ki madad wajib hai , siwaye uss soorat kay jabkay woh madad kissi aesi qoam kay khilaf ho jiss kay sath tumhara koi moahida hai .   aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah ussay achi tarah dekhta hai .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna rakha hai , woh aapas mein aik doosray kay wali waris hain . agar tum aisa nahi kero gay to zameen mein fitna aur bara fasad barpa hoga .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna rakha hai , woh aapas mein aik doosray kay wali waris hain . agar tum aisa nahi kero gay to zameen mein fitna aur bara fasad barpa hoga .

ayahs.text: aur jo log emaan ley aaye , aur unhon ney hijrat ki , aur Allah kay raastay mein jihad kiya , woh aur jinhon ney unhen abad kiya , aur unn ki madad ki , woh sabb sahih maani mein momin hain .   aesay log maghfirat aur ba-izzat rizq kay mustahiq hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log emaan ley aaye , aur unhon ney hijrat ki , aur Allah kay raastay mein jihad kiya , woh aur jinhon ney unhen abad kiya , aur unn ki madad ki , woh sabb sahih maani mein momin hain .   aesay log maghfirat aur ba-izzat rizq kay mustahiq hain .

ayahs.text: aur jinhon ney baad mein emaan qubool kiya , aur hijrat ki , aur tumharay sath jihad kiya , to woh bhi tum mein shamil hain . aur ( unn mein say ) jo log ( puraney mohajreen kay ) rishta daar hain , woh Allah ki kitab mein aik doosray ( ki meeras kay doosron say ) ziyada haq daar hain .   yaqeenan Allah her cheez ka poora poora ilm rakhta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jinhon ney baad mein emaan qubool kiya , aur hijrat ki , aur tumharay sath jihad kiya , to woh bhi tum mein shamil hain . aur ( unn mein say ) jo log ( puraney mohajreen kay ) rishta daar hain , woh Allah ki kitab mein aik doosray ( ki meeras kay doosron say ) ziyada haq daar hain .   yaqeenan Allah her cheez ka poora poora ilm rakhta hai .

verses.text: . ( musalmano ! ) yeh Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki taraf say dastbardari ka aelaan hai unn tamam mushrikeen kay khilaf jinn say tum ney moahida kiya huwa hai .
verses.translation: . ( musalmano ! ) yeh Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki taraf say dastbardari ka aelaan hai unn tamam mushrikeen kay khilaf jinn say tum ney moahida kiya huwa hai .

verses.text: lehaza ( aey mushriko ! ) tumhen chaar maheenay tak ijazat hai kay tum ( arab ki ) sarzameen mein azadi say ghoomo phiro , aur yeh baat jaan rakho kay tum Allah ko aajiz nahi ker-saktay , aur yeh baat bhi kay Allah abb kafiron ko ruswa kernay wala hai .
verses.translation: lehaza ( aey mushriko ! ) tumhen chaar maheenay tak ijazat hai kay tum ( arab ki ) sarzameen mein azadi say ghoomo phiro , aur yeh baat jaan rakho kay tum Allah ko aajiz nahi ker-saktay , aur yeh baat bhi kay Allah abb kafiron ko ruswa kernay wala hai .

verses.text: aur hajj-e-akbar kay din   Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki taraf say tamam insanon kay liye yeh aelaan kiya jata hai kay Allah bhi mushrikeen say dast bardar hochuka hai , aur uss ka Rasool bhi . abb ( aey mushriko ! ) agar tum tauba kerlo to yeh tumharay haq mein boht behtar hoga , aur agar tum ney ( abb bhi ) mun morray rakha to yaad rakho kay tum Allah ko aajiz nahi ker-saktay , aur tamam kafiron ko aik dukh denay walay azab ki  khushkhabri  suna do .
verses.translation: aur hajj-e-akbar kay din   Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki taraf say tamam insanon kay liye yeh aelaan kiya jata hai kay Allah bhi mushrikeen say dast bardar hochuka hai , aur uss ka Rasool bhi . abb ( aey mushriko ! ) agar tum tauba kerlo to yeh tumharay haq mein boht behtar hoga , aur agar tum ney ( abb bhi ) mun morray rakha to yaad rakho kay tum Allah ko aajiz nahi ker-saktay , aur tamam kafiron ko aik dukh denay walay azab ki  khushkhabri  suna do .

verses.text: albatta ( musalmano ! ) jinn mushrikeen say tum ney moahida kiya , phir unn logon  ney tumharay sath ehad mein koi kotahi nahi ki , aur tumharay khilaf kissi ki madad bhi nahi ki , to unn kay sath kiye huye moahiday ki mauddat ko poora kero . beyshak Allah ehtiyat kernay walon ko pasand kerta hai .
verses.translation: albatta ( musalmano ! ) jinn mushrikeen say tum ney moahida kiya , phir unn logon  ney tumharay sath ehad mein koi kotahi nahi ki , aur tumharay khilaf kissi ki madad bhi nahi ki , to unn kay sath kiye huye moahiday ki mauddat ko poora kero . beyshak Allah ehtiyat kernay walon ko pasand kerta hai .

verses.text: chunacheh jab hurmat walay maheenay guzar jayen to unn mushrikeen ko ( jinhon ney tumharay sath bad-ehadi ki thi ) jahan bhi pao , qatal ker daalo , aur unhen pakro , unhen ghero , aur enhen/unhen pakarney kay liye her ghaat ki jagah taak laga ker betho .   haan agar woh tauba kerlen , aur namaz qaeem keren , aur zakat ada keren to inn/unn ka raasta chorr do . yaqeenan Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: chunacheh jab hurmat walay maheenay guzar jayen to unn mushrikeen ko ( jinhon ney tumharay sath bad-ehadi ki thi ) jahan bhi pao , qatal ker daalo , aur unhen pakro , unhen ghero , aur enhen/unhen pakarney kay liye her ghaat ki jagah taak laga ker betho .   haan agar woh tauba kerlen , aur namaz qaeem keren , aur zakat ada keren to inn/unn ka raasta chorr do . yaqeenan Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: aur agar mushrikeen mein say koi tum say panah maangay to ussay uss waqt tak panah do jab tak woh Allah ka kalam sunn ley ,   phir ussay uss ki aman ki jagah phoncha do .   yeh iss liye kay yeh aesay log hain jinhen ilm nahi hai .
verses.translation: aur agar mushrikeen mein say koi tum say panah maangay to ussay uss waqt tak panah do jab tak woh Allah ka kalam sunn ley ,   phir ussay uss ki aman ki jagah phoncha do .   yeh iss liye kay yeh aesay log hain jinhen ilm nahi hai .

verses.text: inn mushrikeen say Allah aur uss kay Rasool kay sath koi moahida kaisay baqi reh sakta hai ?   albatta jinn logon  say tum ney masjid-e-haram kay qareeb moahida kiya hai , jab tak woh tumharay sath seedhay rahen , tum bhi unn kay sath seedhay raho .   beyshak Allah muttaqi logon  ko pasand kerta hai .
verses.translation: inn mushrikeen say Allah aur uss kay Rasool kay sath koi moahida kaisay baqi reh sakta hai ?   albatta jinn logon  say tum ney masjid-e-haram kay qareeb moahida kiya hai , jab tak woh tumharay sath seedhay rahen , tum bhi unn kay sath seedhay raho .   beyshak Allah muttaqi logon  ko pasand kerta hai .

verses.text: . ( lekin doosray mushrikeen kay sath ) kaisay moahida barqarar reh sakta hai jabkay unn ka haal yeh hai kay agar kabhi tum per ghalib aajayen to tumharay moamlay mein naa kissi rishta daari ka khayal keren , aur naa kissi moahiday ka ? yeh tumhen apni zabani baaton say razi kerna chahtay hain , halankay inn kay dil inkar kertay hain , aur inn mein say aksar log nafarman hain .
verses.translation: . ( lekin doosray mushrikeen kay sath ) kaisay moahida barqarar reh sakta hai jabkay unn ka haal yeh hai kay agar kabhi tum per ghalib aajayen to tumharay moamlay mein naa kissi rishta daari ka khayal keren , aur naa kissi moahiday ka ? yeh tumhen apni zabani baaton say razi kerna chahtay hain , halankay inn kay dil inkar kertay hain , aur inn mein say aksar log nafarman hain .

verses.text: unhon ney Allah ki aayaton kay badlay ( duniya ki ) thori si qeemat ley lena pasand kerliya hai ,   aur iss kay nateejay mein logon  ko Allah kay raastay say roka hai . waqiaa yeh hai kay inn kay kartoot boht buray hain .
verses.translation: unhon ney Allah ki aayaton kay badlay ( duniya ki ) thori si qeemat ley lena pasand kerliya hai ,   aur iss kay nateejay mein logon  ko Allah kay raastay say roka hai . waqiaa yeh hai kay inn kay kartoot boht buray hain .

verses.text: yeh kissi bhi momin kay moamlay mein kissi rishta daari ya moahiday ka paas nahi kertay , aur yehi hain jo haden torrney walay hain .
verses.translation: yeh kissi bhi momin kay moamlay mein kissi rishta daari ya moahiday ka paas nahi kertay , aur yehi hain jo haden torrney walay hain .

verses.text: lehaza agar yeh tauba kerlen , aur namaz qaeem keren , aur zakat ada keren , to yeh tumharay deeni bhai ban jayen gay .   aur hum ehkaam ki yeh tafseel unn logon  kay liye biyan ker rahey hain jo janna chahen .
verses.translation: lehaza agar yeh tauba kerlen , aur namaz qaeem keren , aur zakat ada keren , to yeh tumharay deeni bhai ban jayen gay .   aur hum ehkaam ki yeh tafseel unn logon  kay liye biyan ker rahey hain jo janna chahen .

verses.text: aur agar inn logon  ney apna ehad dey denay kay baad apni qasmen torr daali hon , aur tumharay deen ko taaney diye hon , to aesay kufr kay sarbarahon say iss niyyat say jang kero kay woh baaz aajayen ,   kiyonkay yeh aesay log hain kay inn ki qasmon ki koi haqeeqat nahi .
verses.translation: aur agar inn logon  ney apna ehad dey denay kay baad apni qasmen torr daali hon , aur tumharay deen ko taaney diye hon , to aesay kufr kay sarbarahon say iss niyyat say jang kero kay woh baaz aajayen ,   kiyonkay yeh aesay log hain kay inn ki qasmon ki koi haqeeqat nahi .

verses.text: kiya tum unn logon  say jang nahi kero gay jinhon ney apni qasmon ko torra , aur Rasool ko ( watan say ) nikalney ka irada kiya , aur wohi hain jinhon ney tumharay khilaf ( cher-chaar kernay mein ) pehal ki ?   kiya tum unn say dartay ho-? ( agar aisa hai ) to Allah iss baat ka ziyada haq rakhta hai kay tum uss say daro , agar tum momin ho .
verses.translation: kiya tum unn logon  say jang nahi kero gay jinhon ney apni qasmon ko torra , aur Rasool ko ( watan say ) nikalney ka irada kiya , aur wohi hain jinhon ney tumharay khilaf ( cher-chaar kernay mein ) pehal ki ?   kiya tum unn say dartay ho-? ( agar aisa hai ) to Allah iss baat ka ziyada haq rakhta hai kay tum uss say daro , agar tum momin ho .

verses.text: unn say jang kero , takay Allah tumharay haathon say unn ko saza dilwaye , unhen ruswa keray , unn kay khilaf tumhari madad keray , aur mominon kay dil thanday kerday ,
verses.translation: unn say jang kero , takay Allah tumharay haathon say unn ko saza dilwaye , unhen ruswa keray , unn kay khilaf tumhari madad keray , aur mominon kay dil thanday kerday ,

verses.text: aur unn kay dil ki kurrhan door kerday , aur jiss ki chahye tauba qubool kerlay .   aur Allah ka ilm bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil
verses.translation: aur unn kay dil ki kurrhan door kerday , aur jiss ki chahye tauba qubool kerlay .   aur Allah ka ilm bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil

verses.text: bhala kiya tum ney yeh samajh rakha hai kay tumhen yunhi chorr diya jaye ga , halankay abhi Allah ney yeh to dekha hi nahi kay tum mein say kon log jihad kertay hain , aur Allah , uss kay Rasool aur mominon kay siwa kissi aur ko khusoosi razdaar nahi banatay-?   aur tum jo kuch kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: bhala kiya tum ney yeh samajh rakha hai kay tumhen yunhi chorr diya jaye ga , halankay abhi Allah ney yeh to dekha hi nahi kay tum mein say kon log jihad kertay hain , aur Allah , uss kay Rasool aur mominon kay siwa kissi aur ko khusoosi razdaar nahi banatay-?   aur tum jo kuch kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: mushrikeen iss baat kay ehal nahi hain kay woh Allah ki masjidon ko abad keren ,   halankay woh khud apney kufr kay gawah banay huye hain , inn logon  kay to aemal hi gharat hochukay hain , aur dozakh hi mein inn ko hamesha rehna hai .
verses.translation: mushrikeen iss baat kay ehal nahi hain kay woh Allah ki masjidon ko abad keren ,   halankay woh khud apney kufr kay gawah banay huye hain , inn logon  kay to aemal hi gharat hochukay hain , aur dozakh hi mein inn ko hamesha rehna hai .

verses.text: Allah ki masjidon ko to wohi log abad kertay hain jo Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan laye hon , aur namaz qaeem keren , aur zakat ada keren , aur Allah kay siwa kissi say naa daren . aesay hi logon  say yeh tawaqqo hosakti hai kay woh sahih raasta ikhtiyar kernay walon mein shamil hon gay .
verses.translation: Allah ki masjidon ko to wohi log abad kertay hain jo Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan laye hon , aur namaz qaeem keren , aur zakat ada keren , aur Allah kay siwa kissi say naa daren . aesay hi logon  say yeh tawaqqo hosakti hai kay woh sahih raasta ikhtiyar kernay walon mein shamil hon gay .

verses.text: kiya tum logon  ney hajiyon ko paani pilaney aur masjid-e-haram kay abad rakhney ko uss shaks kay ( aemal kay ) barabar samajh rakha hai jo Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan laya hai , aur jiss ney Allah kay raastay mein jihad kiya hai .   Allah kay nazdeek yeh sabb barabar nahi hosaktay . aur Allah zalim logon  ko manzil-e-maqsood tak nahi phonchata .
verses.translation: kiya tum logon  ney hajiyon ko paani pilaney aur masjid-e-haram kay abad rakhney ko uss shaks kay ( aemal kay ) barabar samajh rakha hai jo Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan laya hai , aur jiss ney Allah kay raastay mein jihad kiya hai .   Allah kay nazdeek yeh sabb barabar nahi hosaktay . aur Allah zalim logon  ko manzil-e-maqsood tak nahi phonchata .

verses.text: jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney Allah kay raastay mein hijrat ki hai , aur apney maal aur apni janon say jihad kiya hai , woh Allah kay nazdeek darjay mein kahen ziyada hain , aur wohi log hain jo kamiyab honey walay hain .
verses.translation: jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney Allah kay raastay mein hijrat ki hai , aur apney maal aur apni janon say jihad kiya hai , woh Allah kay nazdeek darjay mein kahen ziyada hain , aur wohi log hain jo kamiyab honey walay hain .

verses.text: unn ka perwerdigar unhen apni taraf say rehmat aur khushnoodi ki , aur aesay baaghaat ki khushkhabri deta hai jinn mein unn kay liye daemi naimaten hain .
verses.translation: unn ka perwerdigar unhen apni taraf say rehmat aur khushnoodi ki , aur aesay baaghaat ki khushkhabri deta hai jinn mein unn kay liye daemi naimaten hain .

verses.text: woh unn mein hamesha rahen gay . yaqeenan Allah hi hai jiss kay paas azmat wala ajar mojood hai .
verses.translation: woh unn mein hamesha rahen gay . yaqeenan Allah hi hai jiss kay paas azmat wala ajar mojood hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! agar tumharay baap bhai kufr ko emaan kay muqablay mein tarjeeh den to unn ko apna sarparast naa banao ,   aur jo log unn ko sarparast banayen gay , woh zalim hon gay .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! agar tumharay baap bhai kufr ko emaan kay muqablay mein tarjeeh den to unn ko apna sarparast naa banao ,   aur jo log unn ko sarparast banayen gay , woh zalim hon gay .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! musalmano say ) keh do kay :  agar tumharay baap , tumharay betay , tumharay bhai , tumhari biwiyan , aur tumhara khandan , aur woh maal o dolat jo tum ney kamaya hai , aur woh karobar jiss kay manda honey ka tumhen andesha hai , aur woh rehaeeshi makan jo tumhen pasand hain , tumhen Allah aur uss kay Rasool say , aur uss kay raastay mein jihad kernay say ziyada mehboob hain , to intizar kero , yahan tak kay Allah apna faisla sadir farma dey ,   aur Allah nafarman logon  ko manzil tak nahi phonchata .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! musalmano say ) keh do kay :  agar tumharay baap , tumharay betay , tumharay bhai , tumhari biwiyan , aur tumhara khandan , aur woh maal o dolat jo tum ney kamaya hai , aur woh karobar jiss kay manda honey ka tumhen andesha hai , aur woh rehaeeshi makan jo tumhen pasand hain , tumhen Allah aur uss kay Rasool say , aur uss kay raastay mein jihad kernay say ziyada mehboob hain , to intizar kero , yahan tak kay Allah apna faisla sadir farma dey ,   aur Allah nafarman logon  ko manzil tak nahi phonchata .

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah taalaa ney tumhari boht say maqamaat per madad ki hai , aur ( khaas tor per ) hunain kay din jab tumhari tadaad ki kasrat ney tumhen magan kerdiya tha ,   magar woh kasrat-e-tadaad tumharay kuch kaam naa aai , aur zameen apni sari wasaton kay bawajood tum per tang hogaee , phir tum ney peeth dikha ker meydan say rukh morr liya .
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah taalaa ney tumhari boht say maqamaat per madad ki hai , aur ( khaas tor per ) hunain kay din jab tumhari tadaad ki kasrat ney tumhen magan kerdiya tha ,   magar woh kasrat-e-tadaad tumharay kuch kaam naa aai , aur zameen apni sari wasaton kay bawajood tum per tang hogaee , phir tum ney peeth dikha ker meydan say rukh morr liya .

verses.text: phir Allah ney apney Rasool per aur mominon per apni taraf say taskeen nazil ki ,   aur aesay lashkar utaray jo tumhen nazar nahi aaye , aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna rakha tha , Allah ney unn ko saza di , aur aesay kafiron ka yehi badla hai .
verses.translation: phir Allah ney apney Rasool per aur mominon per apni taraf say taskeen nazil ki ,   aur aesay lashkar utaray jo tumhen nazar nahi aaye , aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna rakha tha , Allah ney unn ko saza di , aur aesay kafiron ka yehi badla hai .

verses.text: phir Allah jiss ko chahye iss/uss kay baad tauba naseeb kerday ,   aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: phir Allah jiss ko chahye iss/uss kay baad tauba naseeb kerday ,   aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! mushrik log to sarapa napaki hain ,   lehaza woh iss saal kay baad masjid-e-haram kay qareeb bhi naa aaney payen .   aur ( musalmano ! ) agar tum ko muflisi ka andesha ho to agar Allah chahye ga to tumhen apney fazal say ( mushrikeen say ) bey niaz kerday ga .   beyshak Allah ka ilm bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! mushrik log to sarapa napaki hain ,   lehaza woh iss saal kay baad masjid-e-haram kay qareeb bhi naa aaney payen .   aur ( musalmano ! ) agar tum ko muflisi ka andesha ho to agar Allah chahye ga to tumhen apney fazal say ( mushrikeen say ) bey niaz kerday ga .   beyshak Allah ka ilm bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil .

verses.text: woh ehal-e-kitab   jo naa Allah per emaan rakhtay hain , naa yoam-e-aakhirat per ,   aur jo Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki haram ki hoi cheezon ko haram nahi samajhtay , aur naa deen-e-haq ko apna deen mantay hain , unn say jang kero , yahan tak kay woh khuwar ho ker apney haath say jiziya ada keren .
verses.translation: woh ehal-e-kitab   jo naa Allah per emaan rakhtay hain , naa yoam-e-aakhirat per ,   aur jo Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki haram ki hoi cheezon ko haram nahi samajhtay , aur naa deen-e-haq ko apna deen mantay hain , unn say jang kero , yahan tak kay woh khuwar ho ker apney haath say jiziya ada keren .

verses.text: yahudi to yeh kehtay hain kay uzair Allah kay betay hain ,   aur nasrani yeh kehtay hain kay maseeh Allah kay betay hain . yeh sabb unn ki mun ki banai hoi baaten hain . yeh unn logon  ki si baaten ker rahey hain jo inn say pehlay kafir hochukay hain .   Allah ki maar ho inn per ! yeh kahan ondhay behkay jarahey hain-?
verses.translation: yahudi to yeh kehtay hain kay uzair Allah kay betay hain ,   aur nasrani yeh kehtay hain kay maseeh Allah kay betay hain . yeh sabb unn ki mun ki banai hoi baaten hain . yeh unn logon  ki si baaten ker rahey hain jo inn say pehlay kafir hochukay hain .   Allah ki maar ho inn per ! yeh kahan ondhay behkay jarahey hain-?

verses.text: unhon ney Allah kay bajaye apney ahbaar ( yani yahudi ulama ) aur rahibon ( yani essai darwaishon ) ko khuda bana liya hai ,   aur maseeh ibn-e-maryam ko bhi , halankay unn ko aik khuda kay siwa kissi ki ibadat kernay ka hukum nahi diya gaya tha . uss kay siwa koi khuda nahi . woh unn ki mushrikana baaton say bilkul pak hai .
verses.translation: unhon ney Allah kay bajaye apney ahbaar ( yani yahudi ulama ) aur rahibon ( yani essai darwaishon ) ko khuda bana liya hai ,   aur maseeh ibn-e-maryam ko bhi , halankay unn ko aik khuda kay siwa kissi ki ibadat kernay ka hukum nahi diya gaya tha . uss kay siwa koi khuda nahi . woh unn ki mushrikana baaton say bilkul pak hai .

verses.text: yeh log chahtay hain kay Allah kay noor ko apney mun ki phoonkon say bujha den , halankay Allah ko apney noor ki takmeel kay siwa her baat na-manzoor hai , chahye kafiron ko yeh baat kitni buri lagay .
