verses.translation: yeh log chahtay hain kay Allah kay noor ko apney mun ki phoonkon say bujha den , halankay Allah ko apney noor ki takmeel kay siwa her baat na-manzoor hai , chahye kafiron ko yeh baat kitni buri lagay .

verses.text: woh Allah hi to hai jiss ney apney Rasool ko hidayat aur sacha deen dey ker bheja hai , takay ussay her doosray deen per ghalib kerday , chahye mushrik logon  ko yeh baat kitni napasand ho .
verses.translation: woh Allah hi to hai jiss ney apney Rasool ko hidayat aur sacha deen dey ker bheja hai , takay ussay her doosray deen per ghalib kerday , chahye mushrik logon  ko yeh baat kitni napasand ho .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! ( yahudi ) ahbaar aur ( essai ) rahibon mein say boht say aesay hain kay logon  ka maal nahaq tareeqay say khatay hain , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roktay hain .   aur jo log soney chaandi ko jama ker ker kay rakhtay hain , aur uss ko Allah kay raastay mein kharch nahi kertay , unn ko aik dardnak azab ki  khushkhabri  suna do .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! ( yahudi ) ahbaar aur ( essai ) rahibon mein say boht say aesay hain kay logon  ka maal nahaq tareeqay say khatay hain , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roktay hain .   aur jo log soney chaandi ko jama ker ker kay rakhtay hain , aur uss ko Allah kay raastay mein kharch nahi kertay , unn ko aik dardnak azab ki  khushkhabri  suna do .

verses.text: jiss din uss dolat ko jahannum ki aag mein tapaya jaye ga , phir uss say unn logon  ki paishaniyan aur unn ki kerwaten aur unn ki peethen daghi jayen gi , ( aur kaha jaye ga kay : )  yeh hai woh khazana jo tum ney apney liye jama kiya tha ! abb chakho uss khazaney ka maza jo tum jorr jorr ker rakha kertay thay .
verses.translation: jiss din uss dolat ko jahannum ki aag mein tapaya jaye ga , phir uss say unn logon  ki paishaniyan aur unn ki kerwaten aur unn ki peethen daghi jayen gi , ( aur kaha jaye ga kay : )  yeh hai woh khazana jo tum ney apney liye jama kiya tha ! abb chakho uss khazaney ka maza jo tum jorr jorr ker rakha kertay thay .

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah kay nazdeek maheenon ki tadaad baara maheenay hai ,   jo Allah ki kitab ( yani loah-e-mehfooz ) kay mutabiq iss/uss din say nafiz chali aati hai jiss din Allah ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya tha . inn/unn ( baara maheenon ) mein say chaar hurmat walay maheenay hain . yehi deen ( ka ) seedha saada ( taqaza ) hai , lehaza inn/unn maheenon kay moamlay mein apni janon per zulm naa kero ,   aur tum sabb milker mushrikon say ussi/issi tarah larro jaisay woh sabb tum say larrtay hain , aur yaqeen rakho kay Allah muttaqi logon  kay sath hai .
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah kay nazdeek maheenon ki tadaad baara maheenay hai ,   jo Allah ki kitab ( yani loah-e-mehfooz ) kay mutabiq iss/uss din say nafiz chali aati hai jiss din Allah ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya tha . inn/unn ( baara maheenon ) mein say chaar hurmat walay maheenay hain . yehi deen ( ka ) seedha saada ( taqaza ) hai , lehaza inn/unn maheenon kay moamlay mein apni janon per zulm naa kero ,   aur tum sabb milker mushrikon say ussi/issi tarah larro jaisay woh sabb tum say larrtay hain , aur yaqeen rakho kay Allah muttaqi logon  kay sath hai .

verses.text: aur yeh nasee ( yani maheenon ko aagay peechay ker-dena ) to kufr mein aik mazeed izafa hai jiss kay zariye kafiron ko gumrah kiya jata hai . yeh log iss amal ko aik saal halal kerletay hain , aur aik saal haram qarar dey detay hain , takay Allah ney jo maheenay haram kiye hain , unn ki bus ginti poori kerlen , aur ( iss tarah ) jo baat Allah ney haram qarar di thi , ussay halal samajh len .   inn ki bad-amli inn ki nigah mein khushnuma bana di gaee hai , aur Allah aesay kafir logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .
verses.translation: aur yeh nasee ( yani maheenon ko aagay peechay ker-dena ) to kufr mein aik mazeed izafa hai jiss kay zariye kafiron ko gumrah kiya jata hai . yeh log iss amal ko aik saal halal kerletay hain , aur aik saal haram qarar dey detay hain , takay Allah ney jo maheenay haram kiye hain , unn ki bus ginti poori kerlen , aur ( iss tarah ) jo baat Allah ney haram qarar di thi , ussay halal samajh len .   inn ki bad-amli inn ki nigah mein khushnuma bana di gaee hai , aur Allah aesay kafir logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .

verses.text: aey logo jo emaan laye ho ! tumhen kiya hogaya hai kay jab tum say kaha gaya kay Allah kay raastay mein ( jihad kay liye ) kooch kero to tum bojhal ho ker zameen say lagg gaye ?   kiya tum aakhirat kay muqablay mein dunyawi zindagi per razi hochukay ho-? ( agar aisa hai ) to ( yaad rakho kay ) dunyawi zindagi ka maza aakhirat kay muqablay mein kuch bhi nahi , magar boht thora .
verses.translation: aey logo jo emaan laye ho ! tumhen kiya hogaya hai kay jab tum say kaha gaya kay Allah kay raastay mein ( jihad kay liye ) kooch kero to tum bojhal ho ker zameen say lagg gaye ?   kiya tum aakhirat kay muqablay mein dunyawi zindagi per razi hochukay ho-? ( agar aisa hai ) to ( yaad rakho kay ) dunyawi zindagi ka maza aakhirat kay muqablay mein kuch bhi nahi , magar boht thora .

verses.text: agar tum kooch nahi kero gay to Allah tumhen dardnak saza dey ga , aur tumhari jagah koi aur qoam ley aaye ga , aur tum ussay/issay kuch bhi nuqsan nahi phoncha sako gay . aur Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai .
verses.translation: agar tum kooch nahi kero gay to Allah tumhen dardnak saza dey ga , aur tumhari jagah koi aur qoam ley aaye ga , aur tum ussay/issay kuch bhi nuqsan nahi phoncha sako gay . aur Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai .

verses.text: agar tum inn ki ( yani nabi karim SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ki ) madad nahi kero gay to , ( inn ka kuch nuqsan nahi , kiyonkay ) Allah inn ki madad uss waqt ker-chuka hai , jab inn ko kafir logon  ney aesay waqt ( makkah say ) nikala tha jab woh do aadmiyon mein say doosray thay , jab woh dono ghaar mein thay , jab woh apney sathi say keh rahey thay kay :  ghum naa kero Allah humaray sath hai .    chunacheh Allah ney unn per apni taraf say taskeen nazil farmaee , aur unn ki aesay lashkaron say madad ki jo tumhen nazar nahi aaye , aur kafir logon  ka bol neecha ker dikhaya , aur bol to Allah hi ka baala hai . aur Allah iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
verses.translation: agar tum inn ki ( yani nabi karim SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ki ) madad nahi kero gay to , ( inn ka kuch nuqsan nahi , kiyonkay ) Allah inn ki madad uss waqt ker-chuka hai , jab inn ko kafir logon  ney aesay waqt ( makkah say ) nikala tha jab woh do aadmiyon mein say doosray thay , jab woh dono ghaar mein thay , jab woh apney sathi say keh rahey thay kay :  ghum naa kero Allah humaray sath hai .    chunacheh Allah ney unn per apni taraf say taskeen nazil farmaee , aur unn ki aesay lashkaron say madad ki jo tumhen nazar nahi aaye , aur kafir logon  ka bol neecha ker dikhaya , aur bol to Allah hi ka baala hai . aur Allah iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

verses.text: . ( jihad kay liye ) nikal kharray ho , chahye tum halkay ho ya bojhal , aur apney maal o jaan say Allah kay raastay mein jihad kero . agar tum samajh rakhtay ho to yehi tumharay haq mein behtar hai .
verses.translation: . ( jihad kay liye ) nikal kharray ho , chahye tum halkay ho ya bojhal , aur apney maal o jaan say Allah kay raastay mein jihad kero . agar tum samajh rakhtay ho to yehi tumharay haq mein behtar hai .

verses.text: agar duniya ka saman kahen qareeb milney wala hota , aur safar darmiyana qisam ka hota , to yeh ( munafiq log ) zaroor tumharay peechay ho letay , lekin yeh kathan fasla inn kay liye boht door parr-gaya . aur abb yeh Allah ki qasmen khayen gay kay agar hum mein istataat hoti to hum zaroor aap kay sath nikal jatay . yeh log apni janon ko halak ker rahey hain , aur Allah khoob janta hai kay yeh jhootay hain .
verses.translation: agar duniya ka saman kahen qareeb milney wala hota , aur safar darmiyana qisam ka hota , to yeh ( munafiq log ) zaroor tumharay peechay ho letay , lekin yeh kathan fasla inn kay liye boht door parr-gaya . aur abb yeh Allah ki qasmen khayen gay kay agar hum mein istataat hoti to hum zaroor aap kay sath nikal jatay . yeh log apni janon ko halak ker rahey hain , aur Allah khoob janta hai kay yeh jhootay hain .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) Allah ney tumhen moaaf kerdiya hai ,   ( magar ) tum ney inn ko ( jihad mein shareek naa honey ki ) ijazat iss say pehlay hi kiyon dey di kay tum per yeh baat khul jati kay kon hain jinhon ney sach bola hai , aur tum jhooton ko bhi achi tarah jaan letay .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) Allah ney tumhen moaaf kerdiya hai ,   ( magar ) tum ney inn ko ( jihad mein shareek naa honey ki ) ijazat iss say pehlay hi kiyon dey di kay tum per yeh baat khul jati kay kon hain jinhon ney sach bola hai , aur tum jhooton ko bhi achi tarah jaan letay .

verses.text: jo log Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan rakhtay hain , woh apney maal o jaan say jihad naa kernay kay liye tum say ijazat nahi maangtay , aur Allah muttaqi logon  ko khoob janta hai .
verses.translation: jo log Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan rakhtay hain , woh apney maal o jaan say jihad naa kernay kay liye tum say ijazat nahi maangtay , aur Allah muttaqi logon  ko khoob janta hai .

verses.text: tum say ijazat to woh log maangtay hain jo Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , aur unn kay dil shak mein parray huye hain , aur woh apney shak ki wajeh say daanwa-dol hain .
verses.translation: tum say ijazat to woh log maangtay hain jo Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , aur unn kay dil shak mein parray huye hain , aur woh apney shak ki wajeh say daanwa-dol hain .

verses.text: agar unn ka irada nikalney ka hota to uss kay liye unhon ney kuch naa kuch tayyari ki hoti .   lekin Allah ney unn ka uthna pasand hi nahi kiya , iss liye unhen sust parra rehney diya , aur keh diya gaya kay jo ( apahaj honey ki wajeh say ) bethay hain , unn kay sath tum bhi beth raho .
verses.translation: agar unn ka irada nikalney ka hota to uss kay liye unhon ney kuch naa kuch tayyari ki hoti .   lekin Allah ney unn ka uthna pasand hi nahi kiya , iss liye unhen sust parra rehney diya , aur keh diya gaya kay jo ( apahaj honey ki wajeh say ) bethay hain , unn kay sath tum bhi beth raho .

verses.text: agar yeh log tumharay sath nikal kharray hotay to siwaye fasad phelaney kay tumharay darmiyan koi aur izafa naa kertay , aur tumharay liye fitna peda kernay ki koshish mein tumhari safon kay darmiyan dorray dorray phirtay . aur khud tumharay darmiyan aesay log mojood hain jo unn kay matlab ki baaten khoob suntay hain ,   aur Allah inn zalimon ko achi tarah janta hai .
verses.translation: agar yeh log tumharay sath nikal kharray hotay to siwaye fasad phelaney kay tumharay darmiyan koi aur izafa naa kertay , aur tumharay liye fitna peda kernay ki koshish mein tumhari safon kay darmiyan dorray dorray phirtay . aur khud tumharay darmiyan aesay log mojood hain jo unn kay matlab ki baaten khoob suntay hain ,   aur Allah inn zalimon ko achi tarah janta hai .

verses.text: inn logon  ney iss say pehlay bhi fitna peda kernay ki koshish ki hai , aur yeh tumhen nuqsan phonchaney kay liye moamlaat ki ulat pher kertay rahey hain , yahan tak kay haq aaya , Allah ka hukum ghalib huwa , aur yeh kurrhtay reh gaye .
verses.translation: inn logon  ney iss say pehlay bhi fitna peda kernay ki koshish ki hai , aur yeh tumhen nuqsan phonchaney kay liye moamlaat ki ulat pher kertay rahey hain , yahan tak kay haq aaya , Allah ka hukum ghalib huwa , aur yeh kurrhtay reh gaye .

verses.text: aur inhi mein woh sahab bhi hain jo kehtay hain kay :  mujhay ijazat dey dijiye , aur mujhay fitney mein naa daaliye .   aray fitney hi mein to yeh khud parray huye hain ! aur yaqeen rakho kay jahannum saray kafiron ko gheray mein lenay wali hai .
verses.translation: aur inhi mein woh sahab bhi hain jo kehtay hain kay :  mujhay ijazat dey dijiye , aur mujhay fitney mein naa daaliye .   aray fitney hi mein to yeh khud parray huye hain ! aur yaqeen rakho kay jahannum saray kafiron ko gheray mein lenay wali hai .

verses.text: agar tumhen koi bhalai mil jaye to enhen dukh hota hai , aur agar tum per koi museebat aa-parey to kehtay hain kay :  hum ney to pehlay hi apna bachao kerliya tha  aur ( yeh keh ker ) baray khush khush wapis chalay jatay hain .
verses.translation: agar tumhen koi bhalai mil jaye to enhen dukh hota hai , aur agar tum per koi museebat aa-parey to kehtay hain kay :  hum ney to pehlay hi apna bachao kerliya tha  aur ( yeh keh ker ) baray khush khush wapis chalay jatay hain .

verses.text: keh do kay :  Allah ney humaray muqaddar mein jo takleef likh di hai , hamen uss kay siwa koi aur takleef hergiz nahi phonch sakti . woh humara rakhwala hai , aur Allah hi per mominon ko bharosa rakhna chahiye .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  Allah ney humaray muqaddar mein jo takleef likh di hai , hamen uss kay siwa koi aur takleef hergiz nahi phonch sakti . woh humara rakhwala hai , aur Allah hi per mominon ko bharosa rakhna chahiye .

verses.text: keh do kay :  tum humaray liye jiss cheez kay muntazir ho , woh iss kay siwa aur kiya hai kay ( aakhir kaar ) do bhalaiyon mein say aik naa aik bhalai hamen milay .   aur hamen tumharay baaray mein intizar iss ka hai kay Allah tumhen apni taraf say ya humaray haathon saza dey . bus abb intizar kero , hum bhi tumharay sath muntazir hain .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  tum humaray liye jiss cheez kay muntazir ho , woh iss kay siwa aur kiya hai kay ( aakhir kaar ) do bhalaiyon mein say aik naa aik bhalai hamen milay .   aur hamen tumharay baaray mein intizar iss ka hai kay Allah tumhen apni taraf say ya humaray haathon saza dey . bus abb intizar kero , hum bhi tumharay sath muntazir hain .

verses.text: keh do kay :  tum apna maal chahye khushi khushi chanday mein do , ya bad-dili say , woh tum say hergiz qubool nahi kiya jaye ga .   tum aesay log ho jo musalsal nafarmani kertay rahey ho .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  tum apna maal chahye khushi khushi chanday mein do , ya bad-dili say , woh tum say hergiz qubool nahi kiya jaye ga .   tum aesay log ho jo musalsal nafarmani kertay rahey ho .

verses.text: aur unn kay chanday qubool kiye janey mein rukawat ki koi aur wajeh iss kay siwa nahi hai kay unhon ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool kay sath kufr ka moamla kiya hai , aur yeh namaz mein aatay hain to kusmusatay huye aatay hain , aur ( kissi naiki mein ) kharch kertay hain to bura mantay huye kharch kertay hain .
verses.translation: aur unn kay chanday qubool kiye janey mein rukawat ki koi aur wajeh iss kay siwa nahi hai kay unhon ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool kay sath kufr ka moamla kiya hai , aur yeh namaz mein aatay hain to kusmusatay huye aatay hain , aur ( kissi naiki mein ) kharch kertay hain to bura mantay huye kharch kertay hain .

verses.text: tumhen inn kay maal aur aulad ( ki kasrat ) say taajjub nahi hona chahiye . Allah to yeh chahta hai kay inhi cheezon say inn ko dunyawi zindagi mein azab dey ,   aur inn ki jaan bhi kufr hi ki halat mein niklay .
verses.translation: tumhen inn kay maal aur aulad ( ki kasrat ) say taajjub nahi hona chahiye . Allah to yeh chahta hai kay inhi cheezon say inn ko dunyawi zindagi mein azab dey ,   aur inn ki jaan bhi kufr hi ki halat mein niklay .

verses.text: yeh Allah ki qasmen kha ker kehtay hain kay woh tum mein say hain , halankay woh tum mein say nahi hain , balkay woh darpok log hain
verses.translation: yeh Allah ki qasmen kha ker kehtay hain kay woh tum mein say hain , halankay woh tum mein say nahi hain , balkay woh darpok log hain

verses.text: agar inn ko koi panah gaah mil jati , ya kissi qisam kay ghaar mil jatay , ya ghuss bethney ki aur koi jagah , to yeh bey lagaam bhag ker udhar hi ka rukh kerletay .
verses.translation: agar inn ko koi panah gaah mil jati , ya kissi qisam kay ghaar mil jatay , ya ghuss bethney ki aur koi jagah , to yeh bey lagaam bhag ker udhar hi ka rukh kerletay .

verses.text: aur inhi ( munafiqeen ) mein woh bhi hain jo sadqaat ( ki taqseem ) kay baaray mein aap ko taana detay hain .   chunacheh agar unhen sadqaat mein say ( unn ki marzi kay mutabiq ) dey diya jaye to razi hojatay hain , aur agar unn mein say unhen naa diya jaye to zara si dair mein naraz hojatay hain .
verses.translation: aur inhi ( munafiqeen ) mein woh bhi hain jo sadqaat ( ki taqseem ) kay baaray mein aap ko taana detay hain .   chunacheh agar unhen sadqaat mein say ( unn ki marzi kay mutabiq ) dey diya jaye to razi hojatay hain , aur agar unn mein say unhen naa diya jaye to zara si dair mein naraz hojatay hain .

verses.text: jo kuch bhi enhen/unhen Allah aur iss/uss kay Rasool ney dey diya tha , kiya acha hota kay yeh iss/uss per razi rehtay , aur yeh kehtay kay :  Allah humaray liye kafi hai , aaenda Allah apney fazal say hamen nawazay ga , aur iss/uss ka Rasool bhi ! hum to Allah hi say lo lagaye huye hain .
verses.translation: jo kuch bhi enhen/unhen Allah aur iss/uss kay Rasool ney dey diya tha , kiya acha hota kay yeh iss/uss per razi rehtay , aur yeh kehtay kay :  Allah humaray liye kafi hai , aaenda Allah apney fazal say hamen nawazay ga , aur iss/uss ka Rasool bhi ! hum to Allah hi say lo lagaye huye hain .

verses.text: sadqaat to darasal haq hai faqeeron ka , miskeeno ka ,   aur unn ehalkaaron ka jo sadqaat ki wasooli per muqarrar hotay hain ,   aur unn ka jinn ki dildari maqsood hai .   neez unhen ghulamon ko azad kernay mein ,   aur qarz daaron kay qarzay ada kernay mein ,   aur Allah kay raastay mein ,   aur musfiron ki madad mein ,   kharch kiya jaye . yeh aik fareeza hai Allah ki taraf say ! aur Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
verses.translation: sadqaat to darasal haq hai faqeeron ka , miskeeno ka ,   aur unn ehalkaaron ka jo sadqaat ki wasooli per muqarrar hotay hain ,   aur unn ka jinn ki dildari maqsood hai .   neez unhen ghulamon ko azad kernay mein ,   aur qarz daaron kay qarzay ada kernay mein ,   aur Allah kay raastay mein ,   aur musfiron ki madad mein ,   kharch kiya jaye . yeh aik fareeza hai Allah ki taraf say ! aur Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

verses.text: aur inhi ( munafiqeen ) mein woh log bhi hain jo nabi ko dukh phonchatay hain , aur ( unn kay baaray mein ) yeh kehtay hain kay :  woh to sarapa kaan hain .    keh do kay :  woh kaan hain uss cheez kay liye jo tumharay liye bhalai hai .   woh Allah per emaan rakhtay hain aur mominon ki baat ka yaqeen kertay hain , aur tum mein say jo ( zahiri tor per ) emaan ley aaye hain , unn kay liye woh rehmat ( ka moamla kernay walay ) hain . aur jo log Allah kay Rasool ko dukh phonchatay hain , unn kay liye dukh denay wala azab tayyar hai .
verses.translation: aur inhi ( munafiqeen ) mein woh log bhi hain jo nabi ko dukh phonchatay hain , aur ( unn kay baaray mein ) yeh kehtay hain kay :  woh to sarapa kaan hain .    keh do kay :  woh kaan hain uss cheez kay liye jo tumharay liye bhalai hai .   woh Allah per emaan rakhtay hain aur mominon ki baat ka yaqeen kertay hain , aur tum mein say jo ( zahiri tor per ) emaan ley aaye hain , unn kay liye woh rehmat ( ka moamla kernay walay ) hain . aur jo log Allah kay Rasool ko dukh phonchatay hain , unn kay liye dukh denay wala azab tayyar hai .

verses.text: . ( musalmano ! ) yeh log tumharay samney Allah ki qasmen iss liye khatay hain takay tumhen razi keren , halankay agar yeh waqaee momin hon to Allah aur uss kay Rasool iss baat kay ziyada mustahiq hain kay yeh unn ko razi keren .
verses.translation: . ( musalmano ! ) yeh log tumharay samney Allah ki qasmen iss liye khatay hain takay tumhen razi keren , halankay agar yeh waqaee momin hon to Allah aur uss kay Rasool iss baat kay ziyada mustahiq hain kay yeh unn ko razi keren .

verses.text: kiya enhen yeh maloom nahi kay jo shaks Allah aur uss kay Rasool say takkar ley to yeh baat tey hai kay uss kay liye dozakh ki aag hai jiss mein woh hamesha rahey ga-? yeh bari bhari ruswai hai !
verses.translation: kiya enhen yeh maloom nahi kay jo shaks Allah aur uss kay Rasool say takkar ley to yeh baat tey hai kay uss kay liye dozakh ki aag hai jiss mein woh hamesha rahey ga-? yeh bari bhari ruswai hai !

verses.text: munafiq log iss baat say dartay hain kay musalmanon per kahen koi aesi surat nazil naa kerdi jaye jo unhen inn ( munafiqeen ) kay dilon ki baaten batla dey .   keh do kay :  ( acha ) tum mazaq uratay raho ; Allah woh baat zahir kernay wala hai jiss say tum dartay thay .
verses.translation: munafiq log iss baat say dartay hain kay musalmanon per kahen koi aesi surat nazil naa kerdi jaye jo unhen inn ( munafiqeen ) kay dilon ki baaten batla dey .   keh do kay :  ( acha ) tum mazaq uratay raho ; Allah woh baat zahir kernay wala hai jiss say tum dartay thay .

verses.text: aur agar tum unn say poocho to yeh yaqeenan yun kahen gay kay :  hum to hansi mazaq aur dil lagi ker rahey thay .  kaho kay :  kiya tum Allah aur uss ki aayaton aur uss kay Rasool kay sath dil lagi ker rahey thay ?
verses.translation: aur agar tum unn say poocho to yeh yaqeenan yun kahen gay kay :  hum to hansi mazaq aur dil lagi ker rahey thay .  kaho kay :  kiya tum Allah aur uss ki aayaton aur uss kay Rasool kay sath dil lagi ker rahey thay ?

verses.text: bahaney naa banao , tum emaan ka izhar kernay kay baad kufr kay murtakib hochukay ho . agar hum tum mein say aik giroh ko moaafi dey bhi den , to doosray giroh ko zaroor saza den gay ,   kiyonkay woh mujrim log hain .
verses.translation: bahaney naa banao , tum emaan ka izhar kernay kay baad kufr kay murtakib hochukay ho . agar hum tum mein say aik giroh ko moaafi dey bhi den , to doosray giroh ko zaroor saza den gay ,   kiyonkay woh mujrim log hain .

verses.text: munafiq mard aur munafiq aurten sabb aik hi tarah kay hain . woh burai ki talqeen kertay hain , aur bhalai say roktay hain , aur apney haathon ko band rakhtay hain .   unhon ney Allah ko bhula diya hai , to Allah ney bhi inn ko bhula diya . bilashuba yeh munafiq baray nafarman hain .
verses.translation: munafiq mard aur munafiq aurten sabb aik hi tarah kay hain . woh burai ki talqeen kertay hain , aur bhalai say roktay hain , aur apney haathon ko band rakhtay hain .   unhon ney Allah ko bhula diya hai , to Allah ney bhi inn ko bhula diya . bilashuba yeh munafiq baray nafarman hain .

verses.text: Allah ney munafiq mardon , munafiq aurton aur tamam kafiron say dozakh ki aag ka ehad ker rakha hai , jiss mein woh hamesha rahen gay . wohi unn ko raas aaye gi . Allah ney unn per phitkaar daal di hai , aur unn kay liye atal azab hai .
verses.translation: Allah ney munafiq mardon , munafiq aurton aur tamam kafiron say dozakh ki aag ka ehad ker rakha hai , jiss mein woh hamesha rahen gay . wohi unn ko raas aaye gi . Allah ney unn per phitkaar daal di hai , aur unn kay liye atal azab hai .

verses.text: . ( munafiqo ! ) tum unhi logon  ki tarah ho jo tum say pehlay ho guzray hain . woh taqat mein tum say mazboot tarr aur maal aur aulad mein tum say kahen ziyada thay . chunacheh unhon ney apney hissay kay mazay urra liye , phir tum ney ussi tarah apney hissay kay mazay uraye , jaisay tum say pehlay logon  ney apney hissay kay mazay uraye thay , aur tum bhi wesi hi beyhooda baaton mein parray jaisay woh parray thay . yeh woh log thay jinn kay aemal duniya aur aakhirat mein gharat hogaye , aur yehi woh log thay jinhon ney khasaray ka soda kiya .
verses.translation: . ( munafiqo ! ) tum unhi logon  ki tarah ho jo tum say pehlay ho guzray hain . woh taqat mein tum say mazboot tarr aur maal aur aulad mein tum say kahen ziyada thay . chunacheh unhon ney apney hissay kay mazay urra liye , phir tum ney ussi tarah apney hissay kay mazay uraye , jaisay tum say pehlay logon  ney apney hissay kay mazay uraye thay , aur tum bhi wesi hi beyhooda baaton mein parray jaisay woh parray thay . yeh woh log thay jinn kay aemal duniya aur aakhirat mein gharat hogaye , aur yehi woh log thay jinhon ney khasaray ka soda kiya .

verses.text: kiya inn ( munafiqon ) ko unn logon  ki khabar nahi phonchi jo inn say pehlay guzray hain-? nooh ki qoam , aur aad o samood , Ibrahim ki qoam , madiyan kay bashinday , aur woh bastiyan jinhen ulat daala gaya !   inn sabb kay paas inn kay Rasool roshan dalaeel ley ker aaye thay . phir Allah aisa nahi tha kay unn per zulm kerta , lekin yeh khud apni janon per zulm dahatay rahey .
verses.translation: kiya inn ( munafiqon ) ko unn logon  ki khabar nahi phonchi jo inn say pehlay guzray hain-? nooh ki qoam , aur aad o samood , Ibrahim ki qoam , madiyan kay bashinday , aur woh bastiyan jinhen ulat daala gaya !   inn sabb kay paas inn kay Rasool roshan dalaeel ley ker aaye thay . phir Allah aisa nahi tha kay unn per zulm kerta , lekin yeh khud apni janon per zulm dahatay rahey .

verses.text: aur momin mard aur momin aurten aapas mein aik doosray kay madadgaar hain . woh naiki ki talqeen kertay hain , aur burai say roktay hain , aur namaz qaeem kertay hain , aur zakat ada kertay hain , aur Allah aur  uss  kay Rasool ki farmanbardaari kertay hain . yeh aesay log hain jinn ko Allah apni rehmat say nawazay ga . yaqeenan Allah iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik !
verses.translation: aur momin mard aur momin aurten aapas mein aik doosray kay madadgaar hain . woh naiki ki talqeen kertay hain , aur burai say roktay hain , aur namaz qaeem kertay hain , aur zakat ada kertay hain , aur Allah aur  uss  kay Rasool ki farmanbardaari kertay hain . yeh aesay log hain jinn ko Allah apni rehmat say nawazay ga . yaqeenan Allah iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik !

verses.text: Allah ney momin mardon aur momin aurton say wada kiya hai unn baaghaat ka jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jinn mein woh hamesha rahen gay , aur unn pakeezah makanaat ka jo sada bahar baaghaat mein hon gay . aur Allah ki taraf say khushnoodi to sabb say bari cheez hai ( jo jannat walon ko naseeb hogi ) yehi to zabardast kamiyabi hai .
verses.translation: Allah ney momin mardon aur momin aurton say wada kiya hai unn baaghaat ka jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jinn mein woh hamesha rahen gay , aur unn pakeezah makanaat ka jo sada bahar baaghaat mein hon gay . aur Allah ki taraf say khushnoodi to sabb say bari cheez hai ( jo jannat walon ko naseeb hogi ) yehi to zabardast kamiyabi hai .

verses.text: aey nabi ! kafiron aur munafiqon say jihad kero ,   aur unn per sakhti kero . unn ka thikana jahannum hai , aur woh boht bura thikana hai .
verses.translation: aey nabi ! kafiron aur munafiqon say jihad kero ,   aur unn per sakhti kero . unn ka thikana jahannum hai , aur woh boht bura thikana hai .

verses.text: yeh log Allah ki qasmen kha jatay hain kay enhon ney falan baat nahi kahi , halankay enhon ney kufr ki baat kahi hai ,   aur apney Islam laney kay baad enhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya hai .   enhon ney woh kaam kernay ka irada kerliya tha jiss mein yeh kamiyabi hasil naa ker-sakay ,   aur enhon ney sirf iss baat ka badla diya kay Allah aur uss kay Rasool ney enhen apney fazal say maal daar banadiya hai .   abb agar yeh tauba kerlen to inn kay haq mein behtar hoga , aur agar yeh mun morren gay to Allah inn ko duniya aur aakhirat mein dardnak azab dey ga , aur rooaey zameen per inn ka naa koi yaar hoga naa madadgaar .
verses.translation: yeh log Allah ki qasmen kha jatay hain kay enhon ney falan baat nahi kahi , halankay enhon ney kufr ki baat kahi hai ,   aur apney Islam laney kay baad enhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya hai .   enhon ney woh kaam kernay ka irada kerliya tha jiss mein yeh kamiyabi hasil naa ker-sakay ,   aur enhon ney sirf iss baat ka badla diya kay Allah aur uss kay Rasool ney enhen apney fazal say maal daar banadiya hai .   abb agar yeh tauba kerlen to inn kay haq mein behtar hoga , aur agar yeh mun morren gay to Allah inn ko duniya aur aakhirat mein dardnak azab dey ga , aur rooaey zameen per inn ka naa koi yaar hoga naa madadgaar .

verses.text: aur inhi mein woh log bhi hain jinhon ney Allah say yeh ehad kiya tha kay agar woh apney fazal say hamen nawazay ga to hum zaroor sadqa keren gay , aur yaqeenan naik logon  mein shamil hojayen gay .
verses.translation: aur inhi mein woh log bhi hain jinhon ney Allah say yeh ehad kiya tha kay agar woh apney fazal say hamen nawazay ga to hum zaroor sadqa keren gay , aur yaqeenan naik logon  mein shamil hojayen gay .

verses.text: lekin jab Allah ney unn ko apney fazal say nawaza to uss mein bukhul kernay lagay , aur mun morr ker chal diye .
verses.translation: lekin jab Allah ney unn ko apney fazal say nawaza to uss mein bukhul kernay lagay , aur mun morr ker chal diye .

verses.text: nateeja yeh kay Allah ney saza kay tor per nifaq inn kay dilon mein uss din tak kay liye jama diya hai jiss din woh Allah say jaker milen gay , kiyonkay unhon ney Allah say jo wada kiya tha , uss ki khilaf warzi ki , aur kiyonkay woh jhoot bola kertay thay .
verses.translation: nateeja yeh kay Allah ney saza kay tor per nifaq inn kay dilon mein uss din tak kay liye jama diya hai jiss din woh Allah say jaker milen gay , kiyonkay unhon ney Allah say jo wada kiya tha , uss ki khilaf warzi ki , aur kiyonkay woh jhoot bola kertay thay .

verses.text: kiya unhen yeh pata nahi tha kay Allah unn ki tamam posheeda baaton aur sargoshiyon ko janta hai , aur yeh kay uss ko ghaib ki sari baaton ka poora poora ilm hai ?
verses.translation: kiya unhen yeh pata nahi tha kay Allah unn ki tamam posheeda baaton aur sargoshiyon ko janta hai , aur yeh kay uss ko ghaib ki sari baaton ka poora poora ilm hai ?

verses.text: . ( yeh munafiq wohi hain ) jo khushi say sadqa kernay walay walon mominon ko bhi taaney detay hain , aur unn logon  ko bhi jinhen apni mehnat ( ki aamdani ) kay siwa kuch aur moyassar nahi hai ,   iss liye woh unn ka mazaq uratay hain . Allah unn ka mazaq urata hai ,   aur unn kay liye dardnak azab tayyar hai .
verses.translation: . ( yeh munafiq wohi hain ) jo khushi say sadqa kernay walay walon mominon ko bhi taaney detay hain , aur unn logon  ko bhi jinhen apni mehnat ( ki aamdani ) kay siwa kuch aur moyassar nahi hai ,   iss liye woh unn ka mazaq uratay hain . Allah unn ka mazaq urata hai ,   aur unn kay liye dardnak azab tayyar hai .

verses.text: . ( aey nabi ! ) tum inn kay liye astaghfaar kero ya naa kero , agar tum inn kay liye satar martaba astaghfaar kero gay tab bhi Allah enhen moaaf nahi keray ga . yeh iss liye kay unhon ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool kay sath kufr ka ravaiyya apnaya hai , aur Allah nafarman logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .
verses.translation: . ( aey nabi ! ) tum inn kay liye astaghfaar kero ya naa kero , agar tum inn kay liye satar martaba astaghfaar kero gay tab bhi Allah enhen moaaf nahi keray ga . yeh iss liye kay unhon ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool kay sath kufr ka ravaiyya apnaya hai , aur Allah nafarman logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .

verses.text: jinn logon  ko ( ghazwa tabook say ) peechay rehney diya gaya tha , woh Rasool Allah kay janey kay baad apney ( gharon mein ) bethay rehney say baray khush huye , aur unn ko yeh baat nagawar thi kay woh Allah kay raastay mein apney maal o jaan say jihad keren , aur unhon ney kaha tha kay :  iss garmi mein naa niklo !  kaho kay :  jahannum ki aag garmi mein kahen ziyada sakht hai !  kaash ! inn ko samajh hoti !
verses.translation: jinn logon  ko ( ghazwa tabook say ) peechay rehney diya gaya tha , woh Rasool Allah kay janey kay baad apney ( gharon mein ) bethay rehney say baray khush huye , aur unn ko yeh baat nagawar thi kay woh Allah kay raastay mein apney maal o jaan say jihad keren , aur unhon ney kaha tha kay :  iss garmi mein naa niklo !  kaho kay :  jahannum ki aag garmi mein kahen ziyada sakht hai !  kaash ! inn ko samajh hoti !

verses.text: abb yeh log ( duniya mein ) thora boht hans len , aur phir ( aakhirat mein ) khoob rotay rahen , kiyonkay jo kuch kamai yeh kertay rahey hain , uss ka yehi badla hai .
verses.translation: abb yeh log ( duniya mein ) thora boht hans len , aur phir ( aakhirat mein ) khoob rotay rahen , kiyonkay jo kuch kamai yeh kertay rahey hain , uss ka yehi badla hai .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) iss kay baad agar Allah tumhen inn mein say kissi giroh kay paas wapis ley aaye , aur yeh ( kissi aur jihad mein ) nikalney kay liye tum say ijazat maangen to inn say keh dena kay :  abb tum meray sath kabhi nahi chal sako gay , aur meray sath milker kissi dushman say kabhi nahi larr sako gay . tum ney pehli baar bethay rehney ko pasand kiya tha , lehaza abb bhi unhi kay sath beth raho jinn ko ( kissi maazoori ki wajeh say ) peechay rehna hai .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) iss kay baad agar Allah tumhen inn mein say kissi giroh kay paas wapis ley aaye , aur yeh ( kissi aur jihad mein ) nikalney kay liye tum say ijazat maangen to inn say keh dena kay :  abb tum meray sath kabhi nahi chal sako gay , aur meray sath milker kissi dushman say kabhi nahi larr sako gay . tum ney pehli baar bethay rehney ko pasand kiya tha , lehaza abb bhi unhi kay sath beth raho jinn ko ( kissi maazoori ki wajeh say ) peechay rehna hai .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn ( munafiqeen ) mein say jo koi mar-jaye , to tum uss per kabhi namaz ( janaza ) matt parhna , aur naa uss ki qabar per kharray hona .   yaqeen jano yeh woh log hain jinhon ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool kay sath kufr ka ravaiyya apnaya , aur iss halat mein maray hain kay woh nafarman thay .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn ( munafiqeen ) mein say jo koi mar-jaye , to tum uss per kabhi namaz ( janaza ) matt parhna , aur naa uss ki qabar per kharray hona .   yaqeen jano yeh woh log hain jinhon ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool kay sath kufr ka ravaiyya apnaya , aur iss halat mein maray hain kay woh nafarman thay .

verses.text: aur tumhen unn kay maal aur aulad ( ki kasrat ) say taajjub nahi hona chahiye . Allah to yeh chahta hai kay inhi cheezon say inn ko duniya mein azab dey ,   aur inn ki jaan bhi kufr hi ki halat mein niklay .
verses.translation: aur tumhen unn kay maal aur aulad ( ki kasrat ) say taajjub nahi hona chahiye . Allah to yeh chahta hai kay inhi cheezon say inn ko duniya mein azab dey ,   aur inn ki jaan bhi kufr hi ki halat mein niklay .

verses.text: aur jab koi surat yeh hukum ley ker nazil hoti hai kay :  Allah per emaan lao , aur uss kay Rasool ki rafaqat mein jihad kero  to inn ( munafiqon ) mein say woh log jo sahab-e-istataat hain , tum say ijazat maangtay hain , aur kehtay hain kay hamen bhi unn logon  mein shamil honey dijiye jo ( ghar mein ) bethay rahen gay .
verses.translation: aur jab koi surat yeh hukum ley ker nazil hoti hai kay :  Allah per emaan lao , aur uss kay Rasool ki rafaqat mein jihad kero  to inn ( munafiqon ) mein say woh log jo sahab-e-istataat hain , tum say ijazat maangtay hain , aur kehtay hain kay hamen bhi unn logon  mein shamil honey dijiye jo ( ghar mein ) bethay rahen gay .

verses.text: yeh iss baat say khush hain kay peechay rehney wali aurton mein shamil hojayen , aur inn kay dilon per mohar laga di gaee hai , chunacheh woh nahi samajhtay ( kay woh kiya ker rahey hain ) .
verses.translation: yeh iss baat say khush hain kay peechay rehney wali aurton mein shamil hojayen , aur inn kay dilon per mohar laga di gaee hai , chunacheh woh nahi samajhtay ( kay woh kiya ker rahey hain ) .

verses.text: lekin Rasool aur jo log unn kay sath emaan laye hain , unhon ney apney maal aur apni janon say jihad kiya hai . unhen kay liye sari bhalaiyan hain , aur yehi log hain jo falah paaney walay hain .
verses.translation: lekin Rasool aur jo log unn kay sath emaan laye hain , unhon ney apney maal aur apni janon say jihad kiya hai . unhen kay liye sari bhalaiyan hain , aur yehi log hain jo falah paaney walay hain .

verses.text: Allah ney inn kay liye woh baaghaat tayyar ker rakhay hain jinn kay neechay nehren behti hain , jinn mein yeh hamesha rahen gay , aur yeh bari zabardast kamiyabi hai .
verses.translation: Allah ney inn kay liye woh baaghaat tayyar ker rakhay hain jinn kay neechay nehren behti hain , jinn mein yeh hamesha rahen gay , aur yeh bari zabardast kamiyabi hai .

verses.text: aur dehaatiyon mein say bhi bahana baaz log aaye kay unn ko ( jihad say ) chutti di jaye ,   aur ( iss tarah ) jinn logon  ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool say jhoot bola tha , woh sabb beth rahey . unn mein say jinhon ney kufr ( mustaqil tor per ) apna liya hai , unn ko dardnak azab hoga .
verses.translation: aur dehaatiyon mein say bhi bahana baaz log aaye kay unn ko ( jihad say ) chutti di jaye ,   aur ( iss tarah ) jinn logon  ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool say jhoot bola tha , woh sabb beth rahey . unn mein say jinhon ney kufr ( mustaqil tor per ) apna liya hai , unn ko dardnak azab hoga .

verses.text: kamzor logon  per ( jihad mein naa janey ka ) koi gunah nahi , naa beemaron per , aur naa unn logon  per jinn kay paas kharch kernay ko kuch nahi hai , jabkay woh Allah aur uss kay Rasool kay liye mukhlis hon . naik logon  per koi ilzam nahi , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: kamzor logon  per ( jihad mein naa janey ka ) koi gunah nahi , naa beemaron per , aur naa unn logon  per jinn kay paas kharch kernay ko kuch nahi hai , jabkay woh Allah aur uss kay Rasool kay liye mukhlis hon . naik logon  per koi ilzam nahi , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: aur naa unn logon  per ( koi gunah hai ) jinn ka haal yeh hai kay jab woh tumharay paas iss gharz say aaye kay tum unhen koi sawari mohaiyya kerdo , aur tum ney kaha kay :  meray paas to koi aesi cheez nahi hai jiss per mein tumhen sawar ker-sakun  to woh iss halat mein wapis gaye kay unn ki aankhen iss ghum mein aansoon say beh rahi then kay unn kay paas kharch kernay ko kuch nahi hai .

verses.text: ilzam to unn logon  per hai jo maal daar honey kay bawajood tum say ijazat maangtay hain . woh iss baat per khush hain kay woh peechay rehney wali aurton mein shamil hogaye . aur Allah ney unn kay dilon per mohar laga di hai , iss liye unhen haqeeqat ka pata nahi hai .

verses.text: . ( musalmano ! ) jab tum log ( tabook say ) wapis inn ( munafiqon ) kay paas jao gay , to yeh tumharay samney ( tarah tarah kay ) uzr paish keren gay . ( aey payghumber ! ) inn say keh dena kay :  tum uzr paish naa kero hum hergiz tumhari baat ka yaqeen nahi keren gay . verses.text: aur mohajreen aur ansaar mein say jo log pehlay emaan laye , aur jinhon ney naiki kay sath unn ki perwi ki , Allah unn sabb say razi hogaya hai , aur woh uss say razi hain , aur Allah ney unn kay liye aesay baaghaat tayyar ker rakhay hain jinn kay neechay nehren behti hain , jinn mein woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay . yehi bari zabardast kamiyabi hai .
