ayahs.text: aur insanon ka haal yeh hai kay jab unn ko phonchney wali kissi takleef kay baad hum unn ko rehmat ka maza chakhatay hain to zara si dair mein woh humari nishaniyon kay baaray mein chaalbaazi shuroo ker-detay hain .   keh do kay :   Allah iss say bhi jaldi koi chaal chal sakta hai .    yaqeenan humaray farishtay tumhari sari chaalbaaziyon ko likh rahey hain .

ayahs.text: woh Allah hi to hai jo tumhen khushki mein bhi aur samandar mein bhi safar kerata hai , yahan tak kay jab tum kashtiyon mein sawar hotay ho , aur yeh kashtiyan logon  ko ley ker khushgawar hawa kay sath paani per chalti hain , aur log iss baat per magan hotay hain to achanak unn kay paas aik tez aandhi aati hai , aur her taraf say unn per mojen uthti hain , aur woh yeh samajh letay hain kay woh her taraf say ghir gaye , to uss waqt woh khuloos kay sath sirf Allah per aetiqaad ker kay sirf ussi ko pukartay hain , ( aur kehtay hain kay : )   ( ya Allah ! ) agar tu ney hamen iss ( museebat say ) nijat dey di to hum zaroor bil-zaroor shukar guzaar logon  mein shamil hojayen gay . "

ayahs.text: lekin jab Allah unn ko nijat dey deta hai to ziyada dair nahi guzarti kay woh zameen mein nahaq sarkashi kernay lagtay hain . aray logo ! tumhari yeh sarkashi dar-haqeeqat khud tumharay apney khilaf par rahi hai . abb to dunyawi zindagi kay mazay urra lo , aakhir ko humaray paas hi tumhen loat ker aana hai . uss waqt hum tumhen batayen gay kay tum kiya kuch kertay rahey ho .
ayahs.translation: lekin jab Allah unn ko nijat dey deta hai to ziyada dair nahi guzarti kay woh zameen mein nahaq sarkashi kernay lagtay hain . aray logo ! tumhari yeh sarkashi dar-haqeeqat khud tumharay apney khilaf par rahi hai . abb to dunyawi zindagi kay mazay urra lo , aakhir ko humaray paas hi tumhen loat ker aana hai . uss waqt hum tumhen batayen gay kay tum kiya kuch kertay rahey ho .

ayahs.text: dunyawi zindagi ki misal to kuch aesi hai jaisay hum ney aasman say paani barsaya jiss ki wajeh say zameen say ugney wali woh cheezen khoob ghani hogaeen jo insan aur maweshi khatay hain , yahan tak kay jab zameen ney apna yeh zewar pehan liya , aur singhaar ker kay khushnuma hogaee , aur uss kay malik samajhney lagay kay bus abb yeh poori tarah unn kay qaboo mein hai , to kissi raat ya din kay waqt humara hukum aagaya ( kay uss per koi aafat aajaye ) , aur hum ney uss ko katti hoi kheti ki sapaat zameen mein iss tarah tabdeel kerdiya jaisay kal woh thi hi nahi .   issi tarah hum nishaniyon ko unn logon  kay liye khol khol ker biyan kertay hain jo ghor-o-fiker say kaam letay hain .

ayahs.text: aur Allah logon  ko salamti kay ghar ki taraf dawat deta hai , aur jiss ko chahta hai seedhay raastay tak phoncha deta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah logon  ko salamti kay ghar ki taraf dawat deta hai , aur jiss ko chahta hai seedhay raastay tak phoncha deta hai .

ayahs.text: jinn logon  ney behtar kaam kiye hain , behtareen halat unhi kay liye hai aur uss say barh ker kuch aur bhi !   neez unn kay chehron per naa kabhi siyahi chaye gi , naa zillat . woh jannat kay baasi hain ! woh uss mein hamesha rahen gay .

ayahs.text: rahey woh log jinhon ney buraiyan kamai hain , to ( unn ki ) burai ka badla ussi jaisa bura hoga .   aur unn per zillat chai hoi hogi , Allah ( kay azab ) say unhen koi bachaney wala nahi hoga . aisa lagay ga jaisay unn kay chehron per andheri raat ki tehen charrhadi gaee hain . woh dozakh kay baasi hain . woh uss mein hamesha rahen gay .

ayahs.text: aur ( yaad rakho ) woh din jab hum unn sabb ko ikattha keren gay , phir jinn logon  ney shirk kiya tha , unn say kahen gay kay :   zara apni jagah thehrao , tum bhi aur woh bhi jinn ko tum ney Allah ka shareek maana tha !  phir unn kay darmiyan ( abid aur mabood ka ) jo rishta tha , hum woh khatam kerden gay , aur unn kay woh shareek kahen gay kay :   tum humari ibadat to nahi kertay thay

ayahs.translation: phir to logo ! wohi Allah hai jo tumhara malik-e-bar-haq hai . phir haq wazeh hojaney kay baad gumrahi kay siwa aur kiya baqi reh gaya-? uss kay bawajood tumhen koi kahan ulta liye jaraha hai ?

ayahs.text: issi tarah jinn logon  ney nafarmani ka shewa apna liya hai , unn kay baaray mein Allah ki yeh baat sachi hogaee hai kay woh emaan nahi layen gay .
ayahs.translation: issi tarah jinn logon  ney nafarmani ka shewa apna liya hai , unn kay baaray mein Allah ki yeh baat sachi hogaee hai kay woh emaan nahi layen gay .

ayahs.text: kaho kay :   jinn ko tum Allah kay sath shareek mantay ho , kiya unn mein koi aisa hai jo makhlooqaat ko pehli baar peda keray , phir ( unn ki moat kay baad ) unhen dobara phir peda kerday-? " kaho kay :   Allah hai jo makhlooqaat ko pehli baar peda kerta hai , phir unn ( ki moat kay baad ) unhen dobara phir peda kerday ga . phir aakhir koi tumhen kahan ondhay mun liye jaraha hai-?"
ayahs.translation: kaho kay :   jinn ko tum Allah kay sath shareek mantay ho , kiya unn mein koi aisa hai jo makhlooqaat ko pehli baar peda keray , phir ( unn ki moat kay baad ) unhen dobara phir peda kerday-? " kaho kay :   Allah hai jo makhlooqaat ko pehli baar peda kerta hai , phir unn ( ki moat kay baad ) unhen dobara phir peda kerday ga . phir aakhir koi tumhen kahan ondhay mun liye jaraha hai-?"

ayahs.text: kaho kay :   jinn ko tum Allah kay sath shareek mantay ho , kiya unn mein koi aisa hai jo tumhen haq ka raasta dikhaye-? " kaho kay :   Allah haq ka raasta dikhata hai . abb batao kay jo haq ka raasta dikhata ho , kiya woh iss baat ka ziyada haq daar hai kay uss ki baat maani jaye , ya woh ( ziyada haq daar hai ) jiss ko khud uss waqt tak raasta naa soojhay jab tak koi doosra uss ki rehnumai naa keray-? bhala tumhen ho kiya gaya hai ? tum kiss tarah ki baaten tey kerletay ho ?"
ayahs.translation: kaho kay :   jinn ko tum Allah kay sath shareek mantay ho , kiya unn mein koi aisa hai jo tumhen haq ka raasta dikhaye-? " kaho kay :   Allah haq ka raasta dikhata hai . abb batao kay jo haq ka raasta dikhata ho , kiya woh iss baat ka ziyada haq daar hai kay uss ki baat maani jaye , ya woh ( ziyada haq daar hai ) jiss ko khud uss waqt tak raasta naa soojhay jab tak koi doosra uss ki rehnumai naa keray-? bhala tumhen ho kiya gaya hai ? tum kiss tarah ki baaten tey kerletay ho ?"

ayahs.text: aur ( haqeeqat yeh hai kay ) inn ( mushrikeen ) mein say aksar log kissi aur cheez kay nahi , sirf wehmi andazay kay peechay chaltay hain , aur yeh yaqeeni baat hai kay haq kay moamlay mein wehmi andaza kuch bhi kaam nahi dey sakta . yaqeen jano , jo kuch yeh log ker rahey hain , Allah uss ka poora poora ilm rakhta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( haqeeqat yeh hai kay ) inn ( mushrikeen ) mein say aksar log kissi aur cheez kay nahi , sirf wehmi andazay kay peechay chaltay hain , aur yeh yaqeeni baat hai kay haq kay moamlay mein wehmi andaza kuch bhi kaam nahi dey sakta . yaqeen jano , jo kuch yeh log ker rahey hain , Allah uss ka poora poora ilm rakhta hai .

ayahs.text: aur yeh Quran aisa nahi hai kay issay kissi ney apni taraf say gharr liya ho , Allah ney naa utaara ho balkay yeh ( wahi ki ) unn baaton ki tasdeeq kerta hai jo iss say pehlay aa-chuki hain , aur Allah ney jo baaten ( loah-e-mehfooz mein ) likh rakhi hain , unn ki tafseel biyan kerta hai .   iss mein zara bhi shak ki gunjaeesh nahi hai . yeh uss zaat ki taraf say hai jo tamam jahano ki perwerish kerti hai .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh Quran aisa nahi hai kay issay kissi ney apni taraf say gharr liya ho , Allah ney naa utaara ho balkay yeh ( wahi ki ) unn baaton ki tasdeeq kerta hai jo iss say pehlay aa-chuki hain , aur Allah ney jo baaten ( loah-e-mehfooz mein ) likh rakhi hain , unn ki tafseel biyan kerta hai .   iss mein zara bhi shak ki gunjaeesh nahi hai . yeh uss zaat ki taraf say hai jo tamam jahano ki perwerish kerti hai .

ayahs.text: kiya phir bhi yeh log kehtay hain kay :  payghumber ney ussay apni taraf say gharr liya hai ?  kaho kay :  phir to tum bhi iss jaisi aik hi surat ( gharr ker ) ley aao , aur ( iss kaam mein madad lenay kay liye ) Allah kay siwa jiss kissi ko bula sako bula lo , agar sachay ho .
ayahs.translation: kiya phir bhi yeh log kehtay hain kay :  payghumber ney ussay apni taraf say gharr liya hai ?  kaho kay :  phir to tum bhi iss jaisi aik hi surat ( gharr ker ) ley aao , aur ( iss kaam mein madad lenay kay liye ) Allah kay siwa jiss kissi ko bula sako bula lo , agar sachay ho .

ayahs.text: baat darasal yeh hai kay jiss cheez ka ehata yeh apney ilm say nahi ker-sakay , ussay unhon ney jhoot qarar dey diya , aur abhi iss ka anjam bhi unn kay samney nahi aaya .   issi tarah jo log inn say pehlay thay , unhon ney bhi ( apney payghumberon ko ) jhutlaya tha . phir dekho kay unn zalimon ka anjam kaisa huwa-?
ayahs.translation: baat darasal yeh hai kay jiss cheez ka ehata yeh apney ilm say nahi ker-sakay , ussay unhon ney jhoot qarar dey diya , aur abhi iss ka anjam bhi unn kay samney nahi aaya .   issi tarah jo log inn say pehlay thay , unhon ney bhi ( apney payghumberon ko ) jhutlaya tha . phir dekho kay unn zalimon ka anjam kaisa huwa-?

ayahs.text: aur unn mein say kuch aesay hain jo iss ( Quran ) per emaan ley ayen gay , aur kuch woh hain jo iss per emaan nahi layen gay , aur tumhara perwerdigar fasad phelaney walon ko khoob janta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur unn mein say kuch aesay hain jo iss ( Quran ) per emaan ley ayen gay , aur kuch woh hain jo iss per emaan nahi layen gay , aur tumhara perwerdigar fasad phelaney walon ko khoob janta hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) agar yeh tumhen jhutlayen to ( inn say ) keh do kay :  mera amal meray liye hai , aur tumhara amal tumharay liye . jo kaam mein kerta hun , uss ki zimma daari tum per nahi hai , aur jo kaam tum kertay ho , uss ki zimma daari mujh per nahi .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) agar yeh tumhen jhutlayen to ( inn say ) keh do kay :  mera amal meray liye hai , aur tumhara amal tumharay liye . jo kaam mein kerta hun , uss ki zimma daari tum per nahi hai , aur jo kaam tum kertay ho , uss ki zimma daari mujh per nahi .

ayahs.text: aur unn mein kuch aesay bhi hain jo tumhari baaton ko ( ba-zahir ) kaan laga ker suntay hain , ( magar dil mein haq ki talab nahi rakhtay , iss liye dar-haqeeqat behray hain ) to kiya tum behron ko sunao gay , chahye woh samajhtay naa hon-?
ayahs.translation: aur unn mein kuch aesay bhi hain jo tumhari baaton ko ( ba-zahir ) kaan laga ker suntay hain , ( magar dil mein haq ki talab nahi rakhtay , iss liye dar-haqeeqat behray hain ) to kiya tum behron ko sunao gay , chahye woh samajhtay naa hon-?

ayahs.text: aur inn mein say kuch woh hain jo tumhari taraf dekhtay hain , ( magar dil mein insaf naa honey ki wajeh say woh andhon jaisay hain ) to kiya tum andhon ko raasta dikhao gay , chahye unhen kuch bhi sujhai naa deta ho-?
ayahs.translation: aur inn mein say kuch woh hain jo tumhari taraf dekhtay hain , ( magar dil mein insaf naa honey ki wajeh say woh andhon jaisay hain ) to kiya tum andhon ko raasta dikhao gay , chahye unhen kuch bhi sujhai naa deta ho-?

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah logon  per zara bhi zulm nahi kerta , lekin insan hain jo khud apni janon per zulm kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah logon  per zara bhi zulm nahi kerta , lekin insan hain jo khud apni janon per zulm kertay hain .

ayahs.text: aur jiss din Allah inn ko ( meydan-e-hashar mein ) ikattha keray ga , to unhen aisa maloom hoga jaisay woh ( duniya mein ya qabar mein ) din ki aik gharri say ziyada nahi rahey ( issi liye ) woh aapas mein aik doosray ko pehchantay hon gay .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay unn logon  ney baray ghatay ka soda kiya hai jinhon ney Allah say ( aakhirat mein ) ja-milney ko jhutlaya hai , aur jo raah-e-raast per nahi aaye .
ayahs.translation: aur jiss din Allah inn ko ( meydan-e-hashar mein ) ikattha keray ga , to unhen aisa maloom hoga jaisay woh ( duniya mein ya qabar mein ) din ki aik gharri say ziyada nahi rahey ( issi liye ) woh aapas mein aik doosray ko pehchantay hon gay .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay unn logon  ney baray ghatay ka soda kiya hai jinhon ney Allah say ( aakhirat mein ) ja-milney ko jhutlaya hai , aur jo raah-e-raast per nahi aaye .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jinn baaton ki hum ney inn ( kafiron ko ) dhamki di hoi hai , chahye unn mein say koi baat hum tumhen ( tumhari zindagi mein ) dikha den , ya ( uss say pehlay ) tumhari rooh qabz kerlen , bahar-soorat inn ko aakhir mein humari taraf hi loattna hai ,   phir ( yeh to zahir hi hai kay ) jo kuch yeh kertay hain , Allah uss ka poora poora mushaeeda ker raha hai . ( lehaza wahan inn ko saza dey ga )
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jinn baaton ki hum ney inn ( kafiron ko ) dhamki di hoi hai , chahye unn mein say koi baat hum tumhen ( tumhari zindagi mein ) dikha den , ya ( uss say pehlay ) tumhari rooh qabz kerlen , bahar-soorat inn ko aakhir mein humari taraf hi loattna hai ,   phir ( yeh to zahir hi hai kay ) jo kuch yeh kertay hain , Allah uss ka poora poora mushaeeda ker raha hai . ( lehaza wahan inn ko saza dey ga )

ayahs.text: aur her ummat kay liye aik Rasool bheja gaya hai . phir jab unn ka Rasool aajata hai to unn ka faisla pooray insaf say kiya jata hai , aur unn per zulm nahi kiya jata .
ayahs.translation: aur her ummat kay liye aik Rasool bheja gaya hai . phir jab unn ka Rasool aajata hai to unn ka faisla pooray insaf say kiya jata hai , aur unn per zulm nahi kiya jata .

ayahs.text: aur yeh ( kafir ) log ( musalmanon say mazaq uraney kay liye ) kehtay hain kay :  agar tum sachay ho to ( Allah ki taraf say azab ka ) yeh wada kab poora hoga-?
ayahs.translation: aur yeh ( kafir ) log ( musalmanon say mazaq uraney kay liye ) kehtay hain kay :  agar tum sachay ho to ( Allah ki taraf say azab ka ) yeh wada kab poora hoga-?

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) keh do kay :  mein to khud apni zaat ko bhi na koi nuqsan pohchaney ka ikhtiyar rakhta hun na fiada pohchaney ka  , magar jitna Allah chahye . her ummat ka aik waqt muqarrar hai . chunacheh jab unn ka woh waqt aajata hai to woh uss say naa aik gharri peechay jasaktay hain , naa aagay aa-saktay hain .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) keh do kay :  mein to khud apni zaat ko bhi na koi nuqsan pohchaney ka ikhtiyar rakhta hun na fiada pohchaney ka  , magar jitna Allah chahye . her ummat ka aik waqt muqarrar hai . chunacheh jab unn ka woh waqt aajata hai to woh uss say naa aik gharri peechay jasaktay hain , naa aagay aa-saktay hain .

ayahs.text: unn say kaho kay :  zara mujhay yeh batao kay agar Allah ka azab tum per raat kay waqt aaye ya din kay waqt to uss mein kon si aesi ( ishtiaq kay qabil ) cheez hai jiss kay jald aaney ka yeh mujrim log mutalba ker rahey hain-?
ayahs.translation: unn say kaho kay :  zara mujhay yeh batao kay agar Allah ka azab tum per raat kay waqt aaye ya din kay waqt to uss mein kon si aesi ( ishtiaq kay qabil ) cheez hai jiss kay jald aaney ka yeh mujrim log mutalba ker rahey hain-?

ayahs.text: kiya jab woh azab aa-hi parray ga , tab ussay maano gay ? ( uss waqt toh tum say yeh kaha jaye ga kay : )  abb maaney-? halankay tum hi ( iss ka inkar ker kay )uss ki jaldi machaya kertay thay !
ayahs.translation: kiya jab woh azab aa-hi parray ga , tab ussay maano gay ? ( uss waqt toh tum say yeh kaha jaye ga kay : )  abb maaney-? halankay tum hi ( iss ka inkar ker kay )uss ki jaldi machaya kertay thay !

ayahs.text: phir zalimon say kaha jaye ga kay :  abb hamesha kay azab ka maza chakho . tumhen kissi aur cheez ka nahi . sirf uss ( badi ) ka badla diya jaraha hai jo tum kamatay rahey ho
ayahs.translation: phir zalimon say kaha jaye ga kay :  abb hamesha kay azab ka maza chakho . tumhen kissi aur cheez ka nahi . sirf uss ( badi ) ka badla diya jaraha hai jo tum kamatay rahey ho

ayahs.text: aur yeh log tum say poochtay hain kay  kiya yeh ( aakhirat ka azab ) waqaee sach hai ?  keh do kay :  meray perwerdigar ki qasam ! yeh bilkul sach hai , aur tum ( Allah ko ) aajiz nahi ker-saktay .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh log tum say poochtay hain kay  kiya yeh ( aakhirat ka azab ) waqaee sach hai ?  keh do kay :  meray perwerdigar ki qasam ! yeh bilkul sach hai , aur tum ( Allah ko ) aajiz nahi ker-saktay .

ayahs.text: aur jiss jiss shaks ney zulm ka irtikab kiya hai , agar uss kay paas rooaey zameen ki sari dolat bhi hogi to woh apni jaan churraney kay liye uss ki paishkash kerday ga . aur jab woh azab ko aankhon say dekh len gay to apni sharmindagi ko chupana chahen gay , aur unn ka faisla insaf kay sath hoga , aur unn per zulm nahi hoga .
ayahs.translation: aur jiss jiss shaks ney zulm ka irtikab kiya hai , agar uss kay paas rooaey zameen ki sari dolat bhi hogi to woh apni jaan churraney kay liye uss ki paishkash kerday ga . aur jab woh azab ko aankhon say dekh len gay to apni sharmindagi ko chupana chahen gay , aur unn ka faisla insaf kay sath hoga , aur unn per zulm nahi hoga .

ayahs.text: yaad rakho kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai Allah hi ka hai . yaad rakho kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , lekin aksar log nahi jantay .
ayahs.translation: yaad rakho kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai Allah hi ka hai . yaad rakho kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , lekin aksar log nahi jantay .

ayahs.text: wohi zinda kerta hai , aur wohi moat deta hai , aur ussi kay paas tum sabb ko lotaya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: wohi zinda kerta hai , aur wohi moat deta hai , aur ussi kay paas tum sabb ko lotaya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: logo ! tumharay paas aik aesi cheez aai hai jo tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik naseehat hai , aur dilon ki beemariyon kay liye shifa hai , aur emaan walon kay liye hidayat aur rehmat ka saman hai .
ayahs.translation: logo ! tumharay paas aik aesi cheez aai hai jo tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik naseehat hai , aur dilon ki beemariyon kay liye shifa hai , aur emaan walon kay liye hidayat aur rehmat ka saman hai .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) kaho kay :  yeh sabb kuch Allah kay fazal aur rehmat say huwa hai , lehaza issi per to unhen khush hona chahiye . yeh uss tamam dolat say kahen behtar hai jissay yeh jama ker ker kay rakhtay hain .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) kaho kay :  yeh sabb kuch Allah kay fazal aur rehmat say huwa hai , lehaza issi per to unhen khush hona chahiye . yeh uss tamam dolat say kahen behtar hai jissay yeh jama ker ker kay rakhtay hain .

ayahs.text: kaho kay :  bhala batao Allah ney tumharay liye jo rizq nazil kiya tha , tum ney apni taraf say uss mein say kissi ko haram aur kissi ko halal qarar dey diya !   inn say poocho kay :  kiya Allah ney tumhen iss ki ijazat di thi ya tum Allah per jhoota bohtan baandhtay ho-?
ayahs.translation: kaho kay :  bhala batao Allah ney tumharay liye jo rizq nazil kiya tha , tum ney apni taraf say uss mein say kissi ko haram aur kissi ko halal qarar dey diya !   inn say poocho kay :  kiya Allah ney tumhen iss ki ijazat di thi ya tum Allah per jhoota bohtan baandhtay ho-?

ayahs.text: aur jo log Allah per bohtan baandhtay hain , roz-e-qayamat kay baaray mein unn ka kiya gumaan hai ? iss mein shak nahi kay Allah insanon kay sath fazal ka moamla kernay wala hai , lekin unn mein say aksar log shukar ada nahi kertay .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log Allah per bohtan baandhtay hain , roz-e-qayamat kay baaray mein unn ka kiya gumaan hai ? iss mein shak nahi kay Allah insanon kay sath fazal ka moamla kernay wala hai , lekin unn mein say aksar log shukar ada nahi kertay .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum jiss halat mein bhi hotay ho , aur Quran ka jo hissa bhi tilawat kertay ho , aur ( aey logo ! ) tum jo kaam bhi kertay ho , toh jiss waqt tum iss kaam mein mashghool hotay ho , hum tumhen dekhtay rehtay hain . aur tumharay rab say koi zarra barabar cheez bhi posheeda nahi hai , naa zameen mein naa aasman mein , naa uss say choti , naa bari , magar woh aik wazeh kitab mein darj hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum jiss halat mein bhi hotay ho , aur Quran ka jo hissa bhi tilawat kertay ho , aur ( aey logo ! ) tum jo kaam bhi kertay ho , toh jiss waqt tum iss kaam mein mashghool hotay ho , hum tumhen dekhtay rehtay hain . aur tumharay rab say koi zarra barabar cheez bhi posheeda nahi hai , naa zameen mein naa aasman mein , naa uss say choti , naa bari , magar woh aik wazeh kitab mein darj hai .

ayahs.text: yaad rakho kay jo Allah kay dost hain , unn ko naa koi khof hoga , naa woh ghumgeen hon gay .
ayahs.translation: yaad rakho kay jo Allah kay dost hain , unn ko naa koi khof hoga , naa woh ghumgeen hon gay .

ayahs.text: yeh woh log hain jo emaan laye , aur taqwa ikhtiyar kiye rahey .
ayahs.translation: yeh woh log hain jo emaan laye , aur taqwa ikhtiyar kiye rahey .

ayahs.text: unn kay liye khushkhabri hai dunyawi zindagi mein bhi aur aakhirat mein bhi . Allah ki baaton mein koi tabdeeli nahi hoti . yehi zabardast kamiyabi hai .
ayahs.translation: unn kay liye khushkhabri hai dunyawi zindagi mein bhi aur aakhirat mein bhi . Allah ki baaton mein koi tabdeeli nahi hoti . yehi zabardast kamiyabi hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh log jo baaten banatay hain woh tumhen ranjeedah naa keren . yaqeen rakho kay iqtidar tamam tarr Allah ka hai , aur woh her baat sunney wala , sabb kuch janney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh log jo baaten banatay hain woh tumhen ranjeedah naa keren . yaqeen rakho kay iqtidar tamam tarr Allah ka hai , aur woh her baat sunney wala , sabb kuch janney wala hai .

ayahs.text: yaad rakho kay aasmano aur zameen mein jitney jaan daar hain woh sabb Allah hi ki milkiyat mein hain . aur jo log Allah kay siwa doosron ko pukartay hain , woh koi Allah kay ( haqeeqi ) shurka ki perwi nahi kertay . woh kissi aur cheez ki nahi , mehaz gumaan ki perwi kertay hain , aur unn ka kaam iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay andazon kay teer chalatay rahen .
ayahs.translation: yaad rakho kay aasmano aur zameen mein jitney jaan daar hain woh sabb Allah hi ki milkiyat mein hain . aur jo log Allah kay siwa doosron ko pukartay hain , woh koi Allah kay ( haqeeqi ) shurka ki perwi nahi kertay . woh kissi aur cheez ki nahi , mehaz gumaan ki perwi kertay hain , aur unn ka kaam iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay andazon kay teer chalatay rahen .

ayahs.text: Allah woh hai jiss ney tumharay liye raat banai , takay tum uss mein sukoon hasil kero , aur din ko aisa banaya jo tumhen dekhney ki salahiyat dey . uss mein yaqeenan unn logon  kay liye nishaniyan hain jo ghor say suntay hon .
ayahs.translation: Allah woh hai jiss ney tumharay liye raat banai , takay tum uss mein sukoon hasil kero , aur din ko aisa banaya jo tumhen dekhney ki salahiyat dey . uss mein yaqeenan unn logon  kay liye nishaniyan hain jo ghor say suntay hon .

ayahs.text: . ( kuch ) logon  ney keh diya kay Allah aulad rakhta hai . pak hai uss ki zaat ! woh her cheez say bey niaz hai .   aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , ussi ka hai . tumharay paas uss baat ki zara bhi koi daleel nahi hai . kiya tum Allah kay zimmay woh baat lagatay ho jiss ka tumhen koi ilm nahi-?
ayahs.translation: . ( kuch ) logon  ney keh diya kay Allah aulad rakhta hai . pak hai uss ki zaat ! woh her cheez say bey niaz hai .   aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , ussi ka hai . tumharay paas uss baat ki zara bhi koi daleel nahi hai . kiya tum Allah kay zimmay woh baat lagatay ho jiss ka tumhen koi ilm nahi-?

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  jo log Allah per jhoota bohtan baandhtay hain , woh falah nahi payen gay .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  jo log Allah per jhoota bohtan baandhtay hain , woh falah nahi payen gay .

ayahs.text: . ( unn kay liye ) bus duniya mein thora saa maza hai . phir humaray paas hi unhen loat ker aana hai . phir kufr ka jo ravaiyya unhon ney apna rakha tha , uss kay badlay hum unhen shadeed azab ka maza chakhayen gay .
ayahs.translation: . ( unn kay liye ) bus duniya mein thora saa maza hai . phir humaray paas hi unhen loat ker aana hai . phir kufr ka jo ravaiyya unhon ney apna rakha tha , uss kay badlay hum unhen shadeed azab ka maza chakhayen gay .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn kay samney nooh ka waqiaa parh ker sunao , jab unhon ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  meri qoam kay logo ! agar tumharay darmiyan mera rehna , aur Allah ki aayaat kay zariye khabrdar kerna tumhen bhari maloom horaha hai to mein ney to Allah hi per bharosa ker rakha hai . abb tum apney shareekon ko sath mila ker ( meray khilaf ) apni tadbeeron ko khoob pukhta kerlo , phir jo tadbeer tum kero woh tumharay dil mein kissi ghuttan ka baees naa banay , balkay meray khilaf jo faisla tum ney kiya ho , ussay ( dil khol ker ) ker guzro , aur mujhay zara bhi mohlat naa do ,

ayahs.text: phir huwa yeh kay unn logon  ney nooh ko jhutlaya , aur nateeja yeh huwa kay hum ney nooh ko aur jo log unn kay sath kashti mein thay unhen bacha liya , aur unn ko kafiron ki jagah zameen mein basaya , aur jinn logon  ney humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya tha , unhen ( toofan mein ) gharq kerdiya . abb dekho kay jinn logon  ko khabrdar kiya gaya tha , unn ka anjam kaisa huwa ?

ayahs.text: iss kay baad hum ney mukhtalif payghumber unn ki apni apni qoamon kay paas bhejay , woh unn kay paas khulay khulay dalaeel ley ker aaye , lekin unn logon  ney jiss baat ko pehli baar jhutla diya tha ussay maan ker hi naa diya . jo log hadd say guzar jatay hain , unn kay dilon per hum issi tarah mohar laga detay hain .
ayahs.translation: iss kay baad hum ney mukhtalif payghumber unn ki apni apni qoamon kay paas bhejay , woh unn kay paas khulay khulay dalaeel ley ker aaye , lekin unn logon  ney jiss baat ko pehli baar jhutla diya tha ussay maan ker hi naa diya . jo log hadd say guzar jatay hain , unn kay dilon per hum issi tarah mohar laga detay hain .

ayahs.text: iss kay baad hum ney musa aur Haroon ko firon aur uss kay sardaron kay paas apni nishaniyan dey ker bheja , to unhon ney takabbur ka moamla kiya , aur woh mujrim log thay .
ayahs.translation: iss kay baad hum ney musa aur Haroon ko firon aur uss kay sardaron kay paas apni nishaniyan dey ker bheja , to unhon ney takabbur ka moamla kiya , aur woh mujrim log thay .

ayahs.text: chunacheh jab unn kay paas humari taraf say haq ka paygham aaya to woh kehney lagay kay zaroor yeh khula huwa jadoo hai .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh jab unn kay paas humari taraf say haq ka paygham aaya to woh kehney lagay kay zaroor yeh khula huwa jadoo hai .

ayahs.text: musa ney kaha :  kiya tum haq kay baaray mein aesi baat keh rahey ho jabkay woh tumharay paas aa-chuka hai ? bhala kiya yeh jadoo hai ? halankay jadoogar falah nahi paya kertay .
ayahs.translation: musa ney kaha :  kiya tum haq kay baaray mein aesi baat keh rahey ho jabkay woh tumharay paas aa-chuka hai ? bhala kiya yeh jadoo hai ? halankay jadoogar falah nahi paya kertay .

ayahs.text: kehney lagay :  kiya tum humaray paas iss liye aaye ho kay jiss tor tareeqay per hum ney apney baap dadon ko paya hai , uss say hamen bargushta kerdo , aur iss sarzameen mein tum dono ki chaudhraahat qaeem hojaye-? hum to tum dono ki baat manney walay nahi hain .
ayahs.translation: kehney lagay :  kiya tum humaray paas iss liye aaye ho kay jiss tor tareeqay per hum ney apney baap dadon ko paya hai , uss say hamen bargushta kerdo , aur iss sarzameen mein tum dono ki chaudhraahat qaeem hojaye-? hum to tum dono ki baat manney walay nahi hain .

ayahs.text: aur firon ney ( apney mulazimon say ) kaha kay :  jitney mahir jadoogar hain unn sabb ko meray paas ley ker aao .
ayahs.translation: aur firon ney ( apney mulazimon say ) kaha kay :  jitney mahir jadoogar hain unn sabb ko meray paas ley ker aao .

ayahs.text: chunacheh jab jadoogar aagaye , to musa ney unn say kaha :  phenko jo kuch tumhen phenkna hai .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh jab jadoogar aagaye , to musa ney unn say kaha :  phenko jo kuch tumhen phenkna hai .

ayahs.text: phir jab unhon ney ( apni laathiyon aur rassiyon ko ) phenka ( aur woh saanp ban ker chalti hoi nazar ayen ) to musa ney kaha kay :  yeh jo kuch tum ney dikhaya hai , jadoo hai . Allah abhi iss ko malya mait kiye deta hai . Allah fasadiyon ka kaam banney nahi deta .
ayahs.translation: phir jab unhon ney ( apni laathiyon aur rassiyon ko ) phenka ( aur woh saanp ban ker chalti hoi nazar ayen ) to musa ney kaha kay :  yeh jo kuch tum ney dikhaya hai , jadoo hai . Allah abhi iss ko malya mait kiye deta hai . Allah fasadiyon ka kaam banney nahi deta .

ayahs.text: aur Allah sach ko apney hukum say sach ker dikhata hai , chahye mujrim log kitna bura samjhen .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah sach ko apney hukum say sach ker dikhata hai , chahye mujrim log kitna bura samjhen .

ayahs.text: phir huwa yeh kay musa per koi aur nahi , lekin khud unn ki qoam kay kuch nojawan firon aur apney sardaron say dartay dartay emaan laye kay kahen firon unhen naa sataye .   aur yaqeenan firon zameen mein bara zor aawar tha , aur woh unn logon  mein say tha jo kissi hadd per qaeem nahi rehtay .
ayahs.translation: phir huwa yeh kay musa per koi aur nahi , lekin khud unn ki qoam kay kuch nojawan firon aur apney sardaron say dartay dartay emaan laye kay kahen firon unhen naa sataye .   aur yaqeenan firon zameen mein bara zor aawar tha , aur woh unn logon  mein say tha jo kissi hadd per qaeem nahi rehtay .

ayahs.text: aur musa ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! agar tum waqaee Allah per emaan ley aaye ho to phir ussi per bharosa rakho , agar tum farmanbardaar ho .
ayahs.translation: aur musa ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! agar tum waqaee Allah per emaan ley aaye ho to phir ussi per bharosa rakho , agar tum farmanbardaar ho .

ayahs.text: iss per unhon ney kaha :  Allah hi per hum ney bharosa kerliya hai . aey humaray perwerdigar hamen inn zalim logon  kay haathon aazmaesh mein naa daaliye .
ayahs.translation: iss per unhon ney kaha :  Allah hi per hum ney bharosa kerliya hai . aey humaray perwerdigar hamen inn zalim logon  kay haathon aazmaesh mein naa daaliye .

ayahs.text: aur apni rehmat say hamen kafir qoam say nijat dey dijiye .
ayahs.translation: aur apni rehmat say hamen kafir qoam say nijat dey dijiye .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney musa aur unn kay bhai per wahi bheji kay :  tum dono apni qoam ko misir hi kay gharon mein basao , aur apney gharon ko namaz ki jagah bana lo ,   aur ( iss tarah ) namaz qaeem kero , aur emaan laney walon ko khushkhabri dey do .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney musa aur unn kay bhai per wahi bheji kay :  tum dono apni qoam ko misir hi kay gharon mein basao , aur apney gharon ko namaz ki jagah bana lo ,   aur ( iss tarah ) namaz qaeem kero , aur emaan laney walon ko khushkhabri dey do .

ayahs.text: aur musa ney kaha :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! aap ney firon aur uss kay sardaron ko dunyawi zindagi mein bari sajj dhajj aur maal o dolat bakhshi hai . aey humaray perwerdigar ! iss ka nateeja yeh horaha hai kay woh logon  ko aap kay raastay say bhatka rahey hain . aey humaray perwerdigar ! unn kay maal o dolat ko tehas nehas ker-dijiye , aur unn kay dilon ko itna sakht ker-dijiye kay woh uss waqt tak emaan naa layen jab tak dard naak azab aankhon say naa dekh len .
ayahs.translation: aur musa ney kaha :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! aap ney firon aur uss kay sardaron ko dunyawi zindagi mein bari sajj dhajj aur maal o dolat bakhshi hai . aey humaray perwerdigar ! iss ka nateeja yeh horaha hai kay woh logon  ko aap kay raastay say bhatka rahey hain . aey humaray perwerdigar ! unn kay maal o dolat ko tehas nehas ker-dijiye , aur unn kay dilon ko itna sakht ker-dijiye kay woh uss waqt tak emaan naa layen jab tak dard naak azab aankhon say naa dekh len .

ayahs.text: Allah ney farmaya :  tumhari dua qubool kerli gaee hai . abb tum dono sabit qadam raho , aur unn logon  kay peechay hergiz naa chalna jo haqeeqat say na-waqif hain .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney farmaya :  tumhari dua qubool kerli gaee hai . abb tum dono sabit qadam raho , aur unn logon  kay peechay hergiz naa chalna jo haqeeqat say na-waqif hain .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney bano Israel ko samandar paar keradiya , to firon aur uss kay lashkar ney bhi zulm aur ziyadti ki niyyat say unn ka peecha kiya , yahan tak kay jab doobney ka anjam uss kay sar per aa-phoncha to kehney laga :  mein maan gaya kay jiss khuda per bano Israel emaan laye hain uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi , aur mein bhi farmanbardaaron mein shamil hota hun .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney bano Israel ko samandar paar keradiya , to firon aur uss kay lashkar ney bhi zulm aur ziyadti ki niyyat say unn ka peecha kiya , yahan tak kay jab doobney ka anjam uss kay sar per aa-phoncha to kehney laga :  mein maan gaya kay jiss khuda per bano Israel emaan laye hain uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi , aur mein bhi farmanbardaaron mein shamil hota hun .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney bano Israel ko aesi jagah basaya jo sahih maani mein basney kay laeeq jagah thi , aur unn ko pakeezah cheezon ka rizq bakhsha . phir unhon ney ( deen-e-haq kay baaray mein ) uss waqt tak ikhtilaf nahi kiya jab tak unn kay paas ilm nahi aagaya .   yaqeen rakho kay jinn baaton mein woh ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay , unn ka faisla tumhara perwerdigar qayamat kay din keray ga .

ayahs.text: aur Allah taalaa ko chorr ker kissi aesay ( mann gharrat mabood ) ko naa pukarna jo tumhen naa koi faeeda phoncha sakta hai , naa koi nuqsan . phir bhi agar tum ( bafrz-e-mohaal ) aisa ker bethay to tumhara shumar bhi zalimon mein hoga .

ayahs.text: aur agar tumhen Allah koi takleef phoncha dey to uss kay siwa koi nahi hai jo ussay door kerday , aur agar woh tumhen koi bhalai phonchaney ka irada kerlay to koi nahi hai jo uss kay fazal ka rukh pher dey . woh apna fazal apney bandon mein say jiss ko chahta hai phoncha deta hai , aur woh boht bakhshney wala bara meharban hai .

verses.text: Alif-Laam-Raa .   yeh woh kitab hai jiss ki aayaton ko ( dalaeel say ) mazboot kiya gaya hai ,   phir aik aesi zaat ki taraf say unn ko tafseel kay sath biyan kiya gaya hai jo hikmat ki malik aur her baat say ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: Alif-Laam-Raa .   yeh woh kitab hai jiss ki aayaton ko ( dalaeel say ) mazboot kiya gaya hai ,   phir aik aesi zaat ki taraf say unn ko tafseel kay sath biyan kiya gaya hai jo hikmat ki malik aur her baat say ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: . ( yeh kitab payghumber ko hukum deti hai kay woh logon  say yeh kahen ) kay :  Allah kay siwa kissi ki ibadat naa kero . mein uss ki taraf say tumhen aagah kernay wala aur khushkhabri sunaney wala hun .
verses.translation: . ( yeh kitab payghumber ko hukum deti hai kay woh logon  say yeh kahen ) kay :  Allah kay siwa kissi ki ibadat naa kero . mein uss ki taraf say tumhen aagah kernay wala aur khushkhabri sunaney wala hun .

verses.text: aur yeh ( hidayat deta ) kay :  apney perwerdigar say gunahon ki moaafi maango , phir uss ki taraf rujoo kero ,   woh tumhen aik muqarrar waqt tak ( zindagi say ) acha lutf uthaney ka moaqa dey ga , aur her uss shaks ko jiss ney ziyada amal kiya hoga , apni taraf say ziyada ajar dey ga . aur agar tum ney mun morra to mujhay tum per aik baray din kay azab ka andesha hai .
verses.translation: aur yeh ( hidayat deta ) kay :  apney perwerdigar say gunahon ki moaafi maango , phir uss ki taraf rujoo kero ,   woh tumhen aik muqarrar waqt tak ( zindagi say ) acha lutf uthaney ka moaqa dey ga , aur her uss shaks ko jiss ney ziyada amal kiya hoga , apni taraf say ziyada ajar dey ga . aur agar tum ney mun morra to mujhay tum per aik baray din kay azab ka andesha hai .

verses.text: Allah hi kay paas tumhen loat ker jana hai , aur woh her cheez ki poori qudrat rakhta hai
verses.translation: Allah hi kay paas tumhen loat ker jana hai , aur woh her cheez ki poori qudrat rakhta hai

verses.text: dekho yeh ( kafir ) log apney seenon ko uss say chupney kay liye dohra kerletay hain . yaad rakho jab yeh apney oopper kapray lapettay hain , Allah unn ki woh baaten bhi janta hai jo yeh chupatay hain , aur woh bhi jo yeh al-al-aelaan kertay hain .   yaqeenan Allah seenon mein chupi hoi baaton ka ( bhi ) poora poora ilm rakhta hai .
verses.translation: dekho yeh ( kafir ) log apney seenon ko uss say chupney kay liye dohra kerletay hain . yaad rakho jab yeh apney oopper kapray lapettay hain , Allah unn ki woh baaten bhi janta hai jo yeh chupatay hain , aur woh bhi jo yeh al-al-aelaan kertay hain .   yaqeenan Allah seenon mein chupi hoi baaton ka ( bhi ) poora poora ilm rakhta hai .

verses.text: aur zameen per chalney wala koi jandaar aisa nahi hai jiss ka rizq Allah ney apney zimmay naa ley rakha ho . woh uss kay mustaqil thikaney ko bhi janta hai , aur aarzi thikaney ko bhi . her baat aik wazeh kitab mein darj hai .
verses.translation: aur zameen per chalney wala koi jandaar aisa nahi hai jiss ka rizq Allah ney apney zimmay naa ley rakha ho . woh uss kay mustaqil thikaney ko bhi janta hai , aur aarzi thikaney ko bhi . her baat aik wazeh kitab mein darj hai .

verses.text: aur wohi hai jiss ney tamam aasmano aur zameen ko cheh din mein peda kiya . jabkay uss ka arsh paani per tha .   takay tumhen aazamaye kay amal kay aetbar say tum mein kon ziyada acha hai .   aur agar tum ( logon  say ) yeh kaho kay tumhen marney kay baad dobara zinda kiya jaye ga to jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh yeh kahen gay kay yeh khulay jadoo kay siwa kuch nahi hai .
verses.translation: aur wohi hai jiss ney tamam aasmano aur zameen ko cheh din mein peda kiya . jabkay uss ka arsh paani per tha .   takay tumhen aazamaye kay amal kay aetbar say tum mein kon ziyada acha hai .   aur agar tum ( logon  say ) yeh kaho kay tumhen marney kay baad dobara zinda kiya jaye ga to jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh yeh kahen gay kay yeh khulay jadoo kay siwa kuch nahi hai .

verses.text: aur agar hum inn logon  say kuch arsay kay liye azab ko moakhir kerden to woh yehi kehtay rahen gay kay :  aakhir kiss cheez ney iss ( azab ) ko rok rakha hai ?    aray jiss din woh azab aagaya , to woh inn say talaye nahi talay ga , aur jiss cheez ka yeh mazaq urra rahey hain , woh inn ko chaaron taraf say gher ley gi .
verses.translation: aur agar hum inn logon  say kuch arsay kay liye azab ko moakhir kerden to woh yehi kehtay rahen gay kay :  aakhir kiss cheez ney iss ( azab ) ko rok rakha hai ?    aray jiss din woh azab aagaya , to woh inn say talaye nahi talay ga , aur jiss cheez ka yeh mazaq urra rahey hain , woh inn ko chaaron taraf say gher ley gi .

verses.text: aur jab hum insan ko apni taraf say kissi rehmat ka maza chakha detay hain , phir woh uss say wapis ley letay hain to woh mayyus ( aur ) nashukra ban jata hai .
verses.translation: aur jab hum insan ko apni taraf say kissi rehmat ka maza chakha detay hain , phir woh uss say wapis ley letay hain to woh mayyus ( aur ) nashukra ban jata hai .

verses.text: aur agar ussay koi takleef phonchney kay baad hum ussay naimaton ka maza chakha den to woh kehta hai kay sari buraiyan mujh say door hogaeen . ( uss waqt ) woh itra ker shekhiyan bgharney lagta hai .
verses.translation: aur agar ussay koi takleef phonchney kay baad hum ussay naimaton ka maza chakha den to woh kehta hai kay sari buraiyan mujh say door hogaeen . ( uss waqt ) woh itra ker shekhiyan bgharney lagta hai .

verses.text: haan ! magar jo log sabar say kaam letay hain , aur naik amal kertay hain woh aesay nahi hain . unn ko maghfirat aur bara ajar naseeb hoga .
verses.translation: haan ! magar jo log sabar say kaam letay hain , aur naik amal kertay hain woh aesay nahi hain . unn ko maghfirat aur bara ajar naseeb hoga .

verses.text: phir ( aey payghumber ! ) jo wahi tum per nazil ki jarahi hai , kiya yeh mumkin hai kay tum uss ka koi hissa chorr betho-?   aur uss say tumhara dil tang hojaye-? kiyonkay yeh log kehtay hain kay :  inn ( Muhammad SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) per koi khazana kiyon nazil nahi huwa , ya koi farishta inn kay sath kiyon nahi aaya-?  tum to aik aagah kernay walay ho ! aur Allah hai jo her cheez ka mukammal ikhtiyar rakhta hai .
verses.translation: phir ( aey payghumber ! ) jo wahi tum per nazil ki jarahi hai , kiya yeh mumkin hai kay tum uss ka koi hissa chorr betho-?   aur uss say tumhara dil tang hojaye-? kiyonkay yeh log kehtay hain kay :  inn ( Muhammad SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) per koi khazana kiyon nazil nahi huwa , ya koi farishta inn kay sath kiyon nahi aaya-?  tum to aik aagah kernay walay ho ! aur Allah hai jo her cheez ka mukammal ikhtiyar rakhta hai .

verses.text: bhala kiya yeh log yun kehtay hain kay yeh wahi iss ( payghumber ) ney apni taraf say gharr li hai ? ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) keh do kay :  phir to tum bhi iss jaisi gharri hoi das suraten bana lao ,   aur ( iss kaam mein madad kay liye ) Allah kay siwa jiss kissi ko bula sako bula lo , agar tum sachay ho .
verses.translation: bhala kiya yeh log yun kehtay hain kay yeh wahi iss ( payghumber ) ney apni taraf say gharr li hai ? ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) keh do kay :  phir to tum bhi iss jaisi gharri hoi das suraten bana lao ,   aur ( iss kaam mein madad kay liye ) Allah kay siwa jiss kissi ko bula sako bula lo , agar tum sachay ho .

verses.text: iss kay baad agar yeh tumhari baat qubool naa keren to ( aey logo ! ) yaqeen kerlo kay yeh wahi sirf Allah kay ilm say utri hai , aur yeh kay Allah kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi hai . to kiya abb tum farmanbardaar bano gay-?
verses.translation: iss kay baad agar yeh tumhari baat qubool naa keren to ( aey logo ! ) yaqeen kerlo kay yeh wahi sirf Allah kay ilm say utri hai , aur yeh kay Allah kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi hai . to kiya abb tum farmanbardaar bano gay-?

verses.text: jo log ( sirf ) dunyawi zindagi aur uss ki sajj dhajj chahtay hain , hum unn kay aemal ka poora poora sila issi duniya mein bhugta den gay , aur yahan unn kay haq mein koi kami nahi hogi .
verses.translation: jo log ( sirf ) dunyawi zindagi aur uss ki sajj dhajj chahtay hain , hum unn kay aemal ka poora poora sila issi duniya mein bhugta den gay , aur yahan unn kay haq mein koi kami nahi hogi .

verses.text: yeh woh log hain jinn kay liye aakhirat mein dozakh kay siwa kuch nahi hai , aur jo kuch kaarguzari unhon ney ki thi , woh aakhirat mein beykaar hojaye gi , aur jo amal woh ker rahey hain , ( aakhirat kay lehaz say ) kal-adam hain .
verses.translation: yeh woh log hain jinn kay liye aakhirat mein dozakh kay siwa kuch nahi hai , aur jo kuch kaarguzari unhon ney ki thi , woh aakhirat mein beykaar hojaye gi , aur jo amal woh ker rahey hain , ( aakhirat kay lehaz say ) kal-adam hain .

verses.text: bhala batao kay woh shaks ( unn kay barabar kaisay hosakta hai ) jo apney rab ki taraf say aai hoi roshan hidayat ( yani Quran ) per qaeem ho , jiss kay peechay uss ki haqqaniyat ka aik saboot to khud ussi mein aaya hai ,   aur uss say pehlay musa ki kitab bhi ( uss ki haqqaniyat ka saboot hai ) jo logon  kay liye qabil-e-ittaba aur baees-e-rehmat thi . aesay log iss ( Quran per ) emaan rakhtay hain . aur inn girohon mein say jo shaks iss ka inkar keray , to dozakh hi uss ki tey shuda jagah hai . lehaza iss ( Quran ) kay baaray mein kisi shak mein naa parro . yaqeen rakho kay yeh haq hai jo tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aaya hai , lekin aksar log emaan nahi laarahey .
verses.translation: bhala batao kay woh shaks ( unn kay barabar kaisay hosakta hai ) jo apney rab ki taraf say aai hoi roshan hidayat ( yani Quran ) per qaeem ho , jiss kay peechay uss ki haqqaniyat ka aik saboot to khud ussi mein aaya hai ,   aur uss say pehlay musa ki kitab bhi ( uss ki haqqaniyat ka saboot hai ) jo logon  kay liye qabil-e-ittaba aur baees-e-rehmat thi . aesay log iss ( Quran per ) emaan rakhtay hain . aur inn girohon mein say jo shaks iss ka inkar keray , to dozakh hi uss ki tey shuda jagah hai . lehaza iss ( Quran ) kay baaray mein kisi shak mein naa parro . yaqeen rakho kay yeh haq hai jo tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aaya hai , lekin aksar log emaan nahi laarahey .

verses.text: aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay-? aesay logon  ki unn kay rab kay paas paishi hogi , aur gawahi denay walay kahen gay kay :  yeh hain woh log jinhon ney apney perwerdigar per jhooti baaten lagai then .    sabb log sunn len kay Allah ki lanat hai inn zalimon per .
verses.translation: aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay-? aesay logon  ki unn kay rab kay paas paishi hogi , aur gawahi denay walay kahen gay kay :  yeh hain woh log jinhon ney apney perwerdigar per jhooti baaten lagai then .    sabb log sunn len kay Allah ki lanat hai inn zalimon per .

verses.text: jo Allah kay raastay say doosron ko roktay thay , aur uss mein kaji talash kertay thay ,   aur aakhirat kay to woh bilkul hi munkir thay .
verses.translation: jo Allah kay raastay say doosron ko roktay thay , aur uss mein kaji talash kertay thay ,   aur aakhirat kay to woh bilkul hi munkir thay .

verses.text: aesay log rooaey zameen per kahen bhi Allah say bach ker nahi nikal saktay , aur Allah kay siwa enhen koi yaar-o-madadgaar moyassar nahi aa-saktay . unn ko dugna azab diya jaye ga .   yeh ( haq baat ko nafrat ki wajeh say ) naa sunn saktay thay , aur naa unn ko ( haq ) sujhai deta tha .
verses.translation: aesay log rooaey zameen per kahen bhi Allah say bach ker nahi nikal saktay , aur Allah kay siwa enhen koi yaar-o-madadgaar moyassar nahi aa-saktay . unn ko dugna azab diya jaye ga .   yeh ( haq baat ko nafrat ki wajeh say ) naa sunn saktay thay , aur naa unn ko ( haq ) sujhai deta tha .

verses.text: yeh woh log hain jinhon ney apni janon kay liye ghatay ka soda kerliya tha , aur jo mabood unhon ney gharr rakhay thay , unhen unn ka koi suragh nahi milay ga .
verses.translation: yeh woh log hain jinhon ney apni janon kay liye ghatay ka soda kerliya tha , aur jo mabood unhon ney gharr rakhay thay , unhen unn ka koi suragh nahi milay ga .

verses.text: la-mohala yehi log hain jo aakhirat mein sabb say ziyada nuqsan uthaney walay hain .
verses.translation: la-mohala yehi log hain jo aakhirat mein sabb say ziyada nuqsan uthaney walay hain .

verses.text: . ( doosri taraf ) jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , aur woh apney perwerdigar kay aagay jhuk ker mutmaeen hogaye hain , to woh jannat kay basney walay hain . woh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .
verses.translation: . ( doosri taraf ) jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , aur woh apney perwerdigar kay aagay jhuk ker mutmaeen hogaye hain , to woh jannat kay basney walay hain . woh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .

verses.text: inn do girohon ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik andha aur behra ho , aur doosra dekhta bhi ho , sunta bhi ho . kiya yeh dono apney halaat mein barabar hosaktay hain-? kiya phir bhi tum ibrat hasil nahi kertay ?
verses.translation: inn do girohon ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik andha aur behra ho , aur doosra dekhta bhi ho , sunta bhi ho . kiya yeh dono apney halaat mein barabar hosaktay hain-? kiya phir bhi tum ibrat hasil nahi kertay ?

verses.text: aur hum ney nooh ko unn ki qoam kay paas yeh paygham dey ker bheja kay :  mein tumhen iss baat say saaf saaf aagah kernay wala payghumber hun .
verses.translation: aur hum ney nooh ko unn ki qoam kay paas yeh paygham dey ker bheja kay :  mein tumhen iss baat say saaf saaf aagah kernay wala payghumber hun .

verses.text: kay Allah kay siwa kissi aur ki ibadat naa kero . yaqeen jano mujhay tum per aik dukh denay walay din kay azab ka andesha hai .
verses.translation: kay Allah kay siwa kissi aur ki ibadat naa kero . yaqeen jano mujhay tum per aik dukh denay walay din kay azab ka andesha hai .

verses.text: iss per unn ki qoam kay woh sardar log jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kerliya tha , kehney lagay kay :  hamen to iss say ziyada ( tum mein ) koi baat nazar nahi aarahi kay tum hum jaisay hi aik insan ho . aur hum yeh bhi dekh rahey hain kay sirf woh log tumharay peechay lagay hain jo hum mein sabb say ziyada bey haisiyat hain , aur woh bhi satahi tor per raye qaeem kerkay . aur hamen tum mein koi aesi baat bhi dikhai nahi deti jiss ki wajeh say hum per tumhen koi fazilat hasil ho , balkay humara khayal to yeh hai kay tum sabb jhootay ho
verses.translation: iss per unn ki qoam kay woh sardar log jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kerliya tha , kehney lagay kay :  hamen to iss say ziyada ( tum mein ) koi baat nazar nahi aarahi kay tum hum jaisay hi aik insan ho . aur hum yeh bhi dekh rahey hain kay sirf woh log tumharay peechay lagay hain jo hum mein sabb say ziyada bey haisiyat hain , aur woh bhi satahi tor per raye qaeem kerkay . aur hamen tum mein koi aesi baat bhi dikhai nahi deti jiss ki wajeh say hum per tumhen koi fazilat hasil ho , balkay humara khayal to yeh hai kay tum sabb jhootay ho

verses.text: nooh ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! zara mujhay yeh batao kay agar mein apney perwerdigar ki taraf say aai hoi aik roshan hidayat per qaeem hun , aur uss ney mujhay khaas apney paas say aik rehmat ( yani nabwooat ) ata farmaee hai , phir bhi woh tumhen sujhai nahi dey rahi , to kiya hum uss ko tum per zabardasti musallat kerden jabkay tum ussay napasand kertay ho-?
verses.translation: nooh ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! zara mujhay yeh batao kay agar mein apney perwerdigar ki taraf say aai hoi aik roshan hidayat per qaeem hun , aur uss ney mujhay khaas apney paas say aik rehmat ( yani nabwooat ) ata farmaee hai , phir bhi woh tumhen sujhai nahi dey rahi , to kiya hum uss ko tum per zabardasti musallat kerden jabkay tum ussay napasand kertay ho-?

verses.text: aur aey meri qoam ! mein iss ( tableegh ) per tum say koi maal nahi maangta . mera ajar Allah kay siwa kissi aur ney zimmay nahi liya . aur jo log emaan laa-chukay hain , mein unn ko dhutkarney wala nahi hun . unn sabb ko apney rab say jaa milna hai . lekin mein to yeh dekh raha hun kay tum aesay log ho jo nadani ki baaten ker rahey ho .
verses.translation: aur aey meri qoam ! mein iss ( tableegh ) per tum say koi maal nahi maangta . mera ajar Allah kay siwa kissi aur ney zimmay nahi liya . aur jo log emaan laa-chukay hain , mein unn ko dhutkarney wala nahi hun . unn sabb ko apney rab say jaa milna hai . lekin mein to yeh dekh raha hun kay tum aesay log ho jo nadani ki baaten ker rahey ho .

verses.text: aur aey meri qoam ! agar mein inn logon  ko dhutkar dun to kon mujhay Allah ( ki pakar ) say bachaye ga-? kiya tum phir bhi dhiyan nahi do gay-?
verses.translation: aur aey meri qoam ! agar mein inn logon  ko dhutkar dun to kon mujhay Allah ( ki pakar ) say bachaye ga-? kiya tum phir bhi dhiyan nahi do gay-?

verses.text: aur mein tum say yeh nahi keh raha hun kay meray qabazay mein Allah kay khazaney hain , naa mein ghaib ki sari baaten janta hun , aur naa mein tum say yeh keh raha hun kay mein koi farishta hun .   aur jinn logon  ko tumhari nigahen haqeer samajhti hain , unn kay baaray mein bhi mein yeh nahi keh sakta kay Allah unhen kabhi koi bhalai ata nahi keray ga . unn kay dilon mein jo kuch hai , ussay Allah sabb say ziyada janta hai . agar mein unn kay baaray mein aesi baaten kahun to mera shumar yaqeenan zalimon mein hoga .
verses.translation: aur mein tum say yeh nahi keh raha hun kay meray qabazay mein Allah kay khazaney hain , naa mein ghaib ki sari baaten janta hun , aur naa mein tum say yeh keh raha hun kay mein koi farishta hun .   aur jinn logon  ko tumhari nigahen haqeer samajhti hain , unn kay baaray mein bhi mein yeh nahi keh sakta kay Allah unhen kabhi koi bhalai ata nahi keray ga . unn kay dilon mein jo kuch hai , ussay Allah sabb say ziyada janta hai . agar mein unn kay baaray mein aesi baaten kahun to mera shumar yaqeenan zalimon mein hoga .

verses.text: unhon ney kaha kay :  aey nooh ! tum hum say behas ker-chukay , aur boht behas ker-chukay . abb agar tum sachay ho to ley aao woh ( azab ) jiss ki dhamki hamen dey rahey ho .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha kay :  aey nooh ! tum hum say behas ker-chukay , aur boht behas ker-chukay . abb agar tum sachay ho to ley aao woh ( azab ) jiss ki dhamki hamen dey rahey ho .

verses.text: nooh ney kaha kay :  ussay to Allah hi tumharay paas ley kar aaye ga , agar chahye ga , aur tum ussay bey bus nahi ker-saktay .
verses.translation: nooh ney kaha kay :  ussay to Allah hi tumharay paas ley kar aaye ga , agar chahye ga , aur tum ussay bey bus nahi ker-saktay .

verses.text: agar mein tumhari khair khuwahi kerna chahaon to meri khair khuwahi uss soorat mein tumharay koi kaam nahi aa-sakti jab Allah hi ney ( tumhari zidd aur hatt dharami ki wajeh say ) tumhen gumrah kernay ka irada kerliya ho . wohi tumhara perwerdigar hai , aur ussi kay paas tumhen wapis ley jaya jaye ga .
verses.translation: agar mein tumhari khair khuwahi kerna chahaon to meri khair khuwahi uss soorat mein tumharay koi kaam nahi aa-sakti jab Allah hi ney ( tumhari zidd aur hatt dharami ki wajeh say ) tumhen gumrah kernay ka irada kerliya ho . wohi tumhara perwerdigar hai , aur ussi kay paas tumhen wapis ley jaya jaye ga .

verses.text: bhala kiya ( arab kay yeh kafir ) log kehtay hain kay Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) ney yeh Quran apni taraf say gharr liya hai ? ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay :  agar mein ney issay gharra hoga to meray jurm ka wabal mujhi per hoga , aur jo jurm tum ker rahey ho , mein uss ka zimma daar nahi hun .
verses.translation: bhala kiya ( arab kay yeh kafir ) log kehtay hain kay Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) ney yeh Quran apni taraf say gharr liya hai ? ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay :  agar mein ney issay gharra hoga to meray jurm ka wabal mujhi per hoga , aur jo jurm tum ker rahey ho , mein uss ka zimma daar nahi hun .

verses.text: aur nooh kay paas wahi bheji gaee kay :  tumhari qoam mein say jo log abb tak emaan laa-chukay hain , unn kay siwa abb koi aur emaan nahi laye ga . lehaza jo harkaten yeh log kertay rahey hain , tum unn per sadma naa kero .
verses.translation: aur nooh kay paas wahi bheji gaee kay :  tumhari qoam mein say jo log abb tak emaan laa-chukay hain , unn kay siwa abb koi aur emaan nahi laye ga . lehaza jo harkaten yeh log kertay rahey hain , tum unn per sadma naa kero .

verses.text: aur humari nigrani mein aur humari wahi ki madad say kashti banao ,   aur jo log zalim ban chukay hain , unn kay baaray mein mujh say koi baat naa kerna . yeh abb gharq ho ker rahen gay .
verses.translation: aur humari nigrani mein aur humari wahi ki madad say kashti banao ,   aur jo log zalim ban chukay hain , unn kay baaray mein mujh say koi baat naa kerna . yeh abb gharq ho ker rahen gay .

verses.text: chunacheh woh kashti bananey lagay . aur jab bhi unn ki qoam kay kuch sardar unn kay paas say guzartay to unn ka mazaq uratay thay .   nooh ney kaha kay :  agar tum hum per hanstay ho to jaisay tum hans rahey ho , ussi tarah hum bhi tum per hanstay hain .
verses.translation: chunacheh woh kashti bananey lagay . aur jab bhi unn ki qoam kay kuch sardar unn kay paas say guzartay to unn ka mazaq uratay thay .   nooh ney kaha kay :  agar tum hum per hanstay ho to jaisay tum hans rahey ho , ussi tarah hum bhi tum per hanstay hain .

verses.text: unqareeb tumhen pata chal jaye ga kay kiss per woh azab aaraha hai jo ussay ruswa ker kay rakh dey ga , aur kiss per woh qehar nazil honey wala hai jo kabhi tall nahi sakay ga .
verses.translation: unqareeb tumhen pata chal jaye ga kay kiss per woh azab aaraha hai jo ussay ruswa ker kay rakh dey ga , aur kiss per woh qehar nazil honey wala hai jo kabhi tall nahi sakay ga .

verses.text: yahan tak kay jab humara hukum aagaya , aur tanoor ubal parra ,   to hum ney ( nooh say ) kaha kay :  iss kashti mein her qisam kay janweron mein say do do kay joray sawar kerlo ,   aur tumharay ghar walon mein say jinn kay baaray mein pehlay kaha jaa chuka hai ( kay woh kufr ki wajeh say gharq hon gay ) unn ko chorr ker baqi ghar walon ko bhi , aur jitney log emaan laye hain unn ko bhi ( sath ley lo ) .  aur thoray hi say log thay jo unn kay sath emaan laye thay !
verses.translation: yahan tak kay jab humara hukum aagaya , aur tanoor ubal parra ,   to hum ney ( nooh say ) kaha kay :  iss kashti mein her qisam kay janweron mein say do do kay joray sawar kerlo ,   aur tumharay ghar walon mein say jinn kay baaray mein pehlay kaha jaa chuka hai ( kay woh kufr ki wajeh say gharq hon gay ) unn ko chorr ker baqi ghar walon ko bhi , aur jitney log emaan laye hain unn ko bhi ( sath ley lo ) .  aur thoray hi say log thay jo unn kay sath emaan laye thay !

verses.text: aur nooh ney ( unn sabb say ) kaha kay :  iss kashti mein sawar hojao , iss ka chalna bhi Allah hi kay naam say hai , aur langar daalna bhi . yaqeen rakho kay mera perwerdigar boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: aur nooh ney ( unn sabb say ) kaha kay :  iss kashti mein sawar hojao , iss ka chalna bhi Allah hi kay naam say hai , aur langar daalna bhi . yaqeen rakho kay mera perwerdigar boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: aur woh kashti paharon jaisi mojon kay darmiyan chali jati thi . aur nooh ney apney uss betay ko jo sabb say alag tha , aawaz di kay :  betay ! humaray sath sawar hojao , aur kafiron kay sath naa raho .
verses.translation: aur woh kashti paharon jaisi mojon kay darmiyan chali jati thi . aur nooh ney apney uss betay ko jo sabb say alag tha , aawaz di kay :  betay ! humaray sath sawar hojao , aur kafiron kay sath naa raho .

verses.text: woh bola :  mein abhi kissi pahar ki panah ley lun ga jo mujhay paani say bacha ley ga .  nooh ney kaha :  aaj Allah kay hukum say koi kissi ko bachaney wala nahi hai , siwaye uss kay jiss per woh hi reham farmadey .  iss kay baad unn kay darmiyan moaj haeel hogaee , aur doobney walon mein woh bhi shamil huwa .
verses.translation: woh bola :  mein abhi kissi pahar ki panah ley lun ga jo mujhay paani say bacha ley ga .  nooh ney kaha :  aaj Allah kay hukum say koi kissi ko bachaney wala nahi hai , siwaye uss kay jiss per woh hi reham farmadey .  iss kay baad unn kay darmiyan moaj haeel hogaee , aur doobney walon mein woh bhi shamil huwa .

verses.text: aur hukum huwa kay :  aey zameen ! apna paani nigal ley , aur aey aasman ! thum jaa  chunacheh paani utar gaya , aur sara qissa chuka diya gaya .   kashti jodi pahar per aa-thehri ,   aur keh diya gaya kay :  barbadi hai uss qoam ki jo zalim ho !
verses.translation: aur hukum huwa kay :  aey zameen ! apna paani nigal ley , aur aey aasman ! thum jaa  chunacheh paani utar gaya , aur sara qissa chuka diya gaya .   kashti jodi pahar per aa-thehri ,   aur keh diya gaya kay :  barbadi hai uss qoam ki jo zalim ho !

verses.text: aur nooh ney apney perwerdigar ko pukara aur kaha kay :  aey meray perwerdigar ! mera beta meray ghar hi ka aik fard hai , aur beyshak tera wada sacha hai , aur tu saray hakimon say barh ker hakim hai !
verses.translation: aur nooh ney apney perwerdigar ko pukara aur kaha kay :  aey meray perwerdigar ! mera beta meray ghar hi ka aik fard hai , aur beyshak tera wada sacha hai , aur tu saray hakimon say barh ker hakim hai !

verses.text: Allah ney farmaya :  aey nooh ! yaqeen jano woh tumharay ghar walon mein say nahi hai . woh to napak amal ka palanda hai . lehaza mujh say aesi cheez naa maango jiss ki tumhen khabar nahi , mein tumhen naseehat kerta hun kay tum nadanon mein shamil naa ho .
verses.translation: Allah ney farmaya :  aey nooh ! yaqeen jano woh tumharay ghar walon mein say nahi hai . woh to napak amal ka palanda hai . lehaza mujh say aesi cheez naa maango jiss ki tumhen khabar nahi , mein tumhen naseehat kerta hun kay tum nadanon mein shamil naa ho .

verses.text: nooh ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! mein aap ki panah maangta hun iss baat say kay aaenda aap say woh cheez maangun jiss ka mujhay ilm nahi . aur agar aap ney meri maghfirat naa farmaee aur mujh per reham naa kiya to mein bhi unn logon  mein shamil hojaon ga jo barbad hogaye hain .
verses.translation: nooh ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! mein aap ki panah maangta hun iss baat say kay aaenda aap say woh cheez maangun jiss ka mujhay ilm nahi . aur agar aap ney meri maghfirat naa farmaee aur mujh per reham naa kiya to mein bhi unn logon  mein shamil hojaon ga jo barbad hogaye hain .

verses.text: farmaya gaya kay :  aey nooh ! abb ( kashti say ) utar jao , humari taraf say woh salamti aur barkaten ley ker jo tumharay liye bhi hain aur tumharay sath jitni qoamen hain , unn kay liye bhi ! aur kuch qoamen aesi hain jinn ko hum ( duniya mein ) lutf uthaney ka moaqa den gay , phir unn ko humari taraf say aik dardnak azab aa-pakray ga .
verses.translation: farmaya gaya kay :  aey nooh ! abb ( kashti say ) utar jao , humari taraf say woh salamti aur barkaten ley ker jo tumharay liye bhi hain aur tumharay sath jitni qoamen hain , unn kay liye bhi ! aur kuch qoamen aesi hain jinn ko hum ( duniya mein ) lutf uthaney ka moaqa den gay , phir unn ko humari taraf say aik dardnak azab aa-pakray ga .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh ghaib ki kuch baaten hain jo hum tumhen wahi kay zariye bata rahey hain . yeh baaten naa tum iss say pehlay jantay thay , naa tumhari qoam . lehaza sabar say kaam lo aur aakhri anjam muttaqiyo hi kay haq mein hoga .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh ghaib ki kuch baaten hain jo hum tumhen wahi kay zariye bata rahey hain . yeh baaten naa tum iss say pehlay jantay thay , naa tumhari qoam . lehaza sabar say kaam lo aur aakhri anjam muttaqiyo hi kay haq mein hoga .

verses.text: aur qoam-e-aad kay paas hum ney unn kay bhai Hood ko payghumber bana ker bheja .   unhon ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! Allah ki ibadat kero . uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi hai . tumhari haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay tum ney jhooti baaten tarash rakhi hain .
verses.translation: aur qoam-e-aad kay paas hum ney unn kay bhai Hood ko payghumber bana ker bheja .   unhon ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! Allah ki ibadat kero . uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi hai . tumhari haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay tum ney jhooti baaten tarash rakhi hain .

verses.text: aey meri qoam ! mein tum say iss ( tableegh ) per koi ujrat nahi maangta . mera ajar kissi aur ney nahi , uss zaat ney apney zimmay liya hai jiss ney mujhay peda kiya hai . kiya phir bhi tum aqal say kaam nahi letay-?
verses.translation: aey meri qoam ! mein tum say iss ( tableegh ) per koi ujrat nahi maangta . mera ajar kissi aur ney nahi , uss zaat ney apney zimmay liya hai jiss ney mujhay peda kiya hai . kiya phir bhi tum aqal say kaam nahi letay-?

verses.text: aey meri qoam ! apney perwerdigar say gunahon ki moaafi maango , phir uss ki taraf rujoo kero , woh tum per aasman say moosladhaar barishen barsaye ga ,   aur tumhari mojooda quooat mein mazeed quooat ka izafa keray ga , aur mujrim ban ker mun naa morro .
verses.translation: aey meri qoam ! apney perwerdigar say gunahon ki moaafi maango , phir uss ki taraf rujoo kero , woh tum per aasman say moosladhaar barishen barsaye ga ,   aur tumhari mojooda quooat mein mazeed quooat ka izafa keray ga , aur mujrim ban ker mun naa morro .

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  aey Hood ! tum humaray paas koi roshan daleel ley ker nahi aaye ,   aur hum apney khudaon ko sirf tumharay kehney say chorney walay nahi hain , aur naa hum tumhari baat per emaan laasaktay hain .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  aey Hood ! tum humaray paas koi roshan daleel ley ker nahi aaye ,   aur hum apney khudaon ko sirf tumharay kehney say chorney walay nahi hain , aur naa hum tumhari baat per emaan laasaktay hain .

verses.text: hum to iss kay siwa kuch aur nahi keh saktay kay humaray khudaon mein say kissi ney tumhen buri tarah jhapetay mein ley liya hai .    Hood ney kaha :  mein Allah ko gawah banata hun , aur tum bhi gawah raho kay tum Allah kay siwa jiss jiss ko uss ki khudai mein shareek mantay ho , mein uss say bari hun .
verses.translation: hum to iss kay siwa kuch aur nahi keh saktay kay humaray khudaon mein say kissi ney tumhen buri tarah jhapetay mein ley liya hai .    Hood ney kaha :  mein Allah ko gawah banata hun , aur tum bhi gawah raho kay tum Allah kay siwa jiss jiss ko uss ki khudai mein shareek mantay ho , mein uss say bari hun .

verses.text: abb tum sabb kay sabb milker meray khilaf chaalen chal lo , aur mujhay zara mohlat naa do .
verses.translation: abb tum sabb kay sabb milker meray khilaf chaalen chal lo , aur mujhay zara mohlat naa do .

verses.text: mein ney to Allah per bharosa ker rakha hai , jo mera bhi perwerdigar hai , aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar . zameen per chalney wala koi jandaar aisa nahi jiss ki choti uss kay qabazay mein naa ho . yaqeenan mera perwerdigar seedhay raastay per hai .
verses.translation: mein ney to Allah per bharosa ker rakha hai , jo mera bhi perwerdigar hai , aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar . zameen per chalney wala koi jandaar aisa nahi jiss ki choti uss kay qabazay mein naa ho . yaqeenan mera perwerdigar seedhay raastay per hai .

verses.text: phir bhi agar tum mun morrtay ho , to jo paygham dey ker mujhay tumharay paas bheja gaya tha , mein ney woh tumhen phoncha diya hai . aur ( tumharay kufr ki wajeh say ) mera perwerdigar tumhari jagah kissi aur qoam ko yahan basa dey ga , aur tum uss ka kuch naa bigaar sako gay . beyshak mera perwerdigar her cheez ki nigrani kerta hai .
verses.translation: phir bhi agar tum mun morrtay ho , to jo paygham dey ker mujhay tumharay paas bheja gaya tha , mein ney woh tumhen phoncha diya hai . aur ( tumharay kufr ki wajeh say ) mera perwerdigar tumhari jagah kissi aur qoam ko yahan basa dey ga , aur tum uss ka kuch naa bigaar sako gay . beyshak mera perwerdigar her cheez ki nigrani kerta hai .

verses.text: aur ( aakhir kaar ) jab humara hukum aagaya   to hum ney apni rehmat kay zariye Hood ko aur jo log unn kay sath emaan laye thay , unn ko bacha liya , aur unhen aik sakht azab say nijat dey di .
verses.translation: aur ( aakhir kaar ) jab humara hukum aagaya   to hum ney apni rehmat kay zariye Hood ko aur jo log unn kay sath emaan laye thay , unn ko bacha liya , aur unhen aik sakht azab say nijat dey di .

verses.text: yeh thay aad kay log jinhon ney apney perwerdigar ki nishaniyon ka inkar kiya , aur uss kay payghumberon ki nafarmani ki , aur her aesay shaks ka hukum maana jo perlay darjay ka jabir aur haq ka paka dushman tha !
verses.translation: yeh thay aad kay log jinhon ney apney perwerdigar ki nishaniyon ka inkar kiya , aur uss kay payghumberon ki nafarmani ki , aur her aesay shaks ka hukum maana jo perlay darjay ka jabir aur haq ka paka dushman tha !

verses.text: aur ( iss ka nateeja yeh huwa kay ) iss duniya mein bhi phitkaar unn kay peechay laga di gaee , aur qayamat kay din bhi . yaad rakho kay qoam-e-aad ney apney rab kay sath kufr ka moamla kiya tha ! yaad rakho kay barbadi aad hi ki hoi , jo Hood ki qoam thi !
verses.translation: aur ( iss ka nateeja yeh huwa kay ) iss duniya mein bhi phitkaar unn kay peechay laga di gaee , aur qayamat kay din bhi . yaad rakho kay qoam-e-aad ney apney rab kay sath kufr ka moamla kiya tha ! yaad rakho kay barbadi aad hi ki hoi , jo Hood ki qoam thi !

verses.text: aur qoam-e-samood kay paas hum ney unn kay bhai saleh ko payghumber bana ker bheja .   unhon ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! Allah ki ibadat kero . uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi hai . ussi ney tum ko zameen say peda kiya , aur uss mein tumhen abad kiya . lehaza uss say apney gunahon ki moaafi maango , phir uss ki taraf rujoo kero . yaqeen rakho kay mera rab ( tum say ) qareeb bhi hai , duayen qubool kernay wala bhi .
verses.translation: aur qoam-e-samood kay paas hum ney unn kay bhai saleh ko payghumber bana ker bheja .   unhon ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! Allah ki ibadat kero . uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi hai . ussi ney tum ko zameen say peda kiya , aur uss mein tumhen abad kiya . lehaza uss say apney gunahon ki moaafi maango , phir uss ki taraf rujoo kero . yaqeen rakho kay mera rab ( tum say ) qareeb bhi hai , duayen qubool kernay wala bhi .

verses.text: woh kehney lagay :  aey saleh ! iss say pehlay to tum humaray darmiyan iss tarah rahey ho kay tum say bari umeeden wabasta then .   jinn ( button ) ki ibadat humaray baap dada kertay aaye hain kiya tum hamen unn ki ibadat kernay say mana kertay ho-? jiss baat ki tum dawat dey rahey ho , uss kay baaray mein to hamen aisa shak hai jiss ney hamen iztirab mein daal diya hai .
verses.translation: woh kehney lagay :  aey saleh ! iss say pehlay to tum humaray darmiyan iss tarah rahey ho kay tum say bari umeeden wabasta then .   jinn ( button ) ki ibadat humaray baap dada kertay aaye hain kiya tum hamen unn ki ibadat kernay say mana kertay ho-? jiss baat ki tum dawat dey rahey ho , uss kay baaray mein to hamen aisa shak hai jiss ney hamen iztirab mein daal diya hai .

verses.text: saleh ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! zara mujhay yeh batao kay agar mein apney perwerdigar ki taraf say aai hoi aik roshan hidayat per qaeem hun , aur uss ney mujhay khaas apney paas say aik rehmat ( yani nabwooat ) ata farmaee hai , phir bhi agar mein uss ki nafarmani kerun to kon hai jo mujhay Allah ( ki pakar ) say bacha ley ? lehaza tum ( meray faraeez say rok ker ) barbadi mein mubtala kernay kay siwa mujhay aur kiya dey rahey ho-?
verses.translation: saleh ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! zara mujhay yeh batao kay agar mein apney perwerdigar ki taraf say aai hoi aik roshan hidayat per qaeem hun , aur uss ney mujhay khaas apney paas say aik rehmat ( yani nabwooat ) ata farmaee hai , phir bhi agar mein uss ki nafarmani kerun to kon hai jo mujhay Allah ( ki pakar ) say bacha ley ? lehaza tum ( meray faraeez say rok ker ) barbadi mein mubtala kernay kay siwa mujhay aur kiya dey rahey ho-?

verses.text: aur aey meri qoam ! yeh Allah ki oontni tumharay liye aik nishani ban ker aai hai . lehaza iss ko azad chorr do kay yeh Allah ki zameen mein khati phiray , aur iss ko buray iraday say choona bhi nahi , kahen aisa naa ho kay tumhen unqareeb aaney wala azab aa-pakray .
verses.translation: aur aey meri qoam ! yeh Allah ki oontni tumharay liye aik nishani ban ker aai hai . lehaza iss ko azad chorr do kay yeh Allah ki zameen mein khati phiray , aur iss ko buray iraday say choona bhi nahi , kahen aisa naa ho kay tumhen unqareeb aaney wala azab aa-pakray .

verses.text: phir huwa yeh kay unhon ney uss ko maar daala . chunacheh saleh ney kaha kay :  tum apney gharon mein teen din aur mazay kerlo ,   ( uss kay baad azab aaye ga , aur ) yeh aisa wada hai jissay koi jhoota nahi ker-sakta .
verses.translation: phir huwa yeh kay unhon ney uss ko maar daala . chunacheh saleh ney kaha kay :  tum apney gharon mein teen din aur mazay kerlo ,   ( uss kay baad azab aaye ga , aur ) yeh aisa wada hai jissay koi jhoota nahi ker-sakta .

verses.text: phir jab humara hukum aagaya to hum ney saleh ko aur unn kay sath jo emaan laye thay , unn ko apni khaas rehmat kay zariye nijat di , aur uss din ki ruswai say bacha liya . yaqeenan tumhara perwerdigar bari quooat ka , baray iqtidar ka malik hai .
verses.translation: phir jab humara hukum aagaya to hum ney saleh ko aur unn kay sath jo emaan laye thay , unn ko apni khaas rehmat kay zariye nijat di , aur uss din ki ruswai say bacha liya . yaqeenan tumhara perwerdigar bari quooat ka , baray iqtidar ka malik hai .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney zulm ka raasta apnaya tha , unn ko aik chinghaarr ney aa-pakra ,   jiss kay nateejay mein woh apney gharon mein iss tarah ondhay parray reh gaye .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney zulm ka raasta apnaya tha , unn ko aik chinghaarr ney aa-pakra ,   jiss kay nateejay mein woh apney gharon mein iss tarah ondhay parray reh gaye .

verses.text: jaisay kabhi wahan basay hi naa thay . yaad rakho kay samood ney apney rab kay sath kufr ka moamla kiya tha ! yaad rakho kay barbadi samood hi ki hoi .
verses.translation: jaisay kabhi wahan basay hi naa thay . yaad rakho kay samood ney apney rab kay sath kufr ka moamla kiya tha ! yaad rakho kay barbadi samood hi ki hoi .

verses.text: aur humaray farishtay ( insani shakal mein ) Ibrahim kay paas ( beta peda honey ki ) khushkhabri ley ker aaye .   unhon ney salam kaha , Ibrahim ney bhi salam kaha , phir Ibrahim ko kuch dair nahi guzri thi kay woh ( unn ki mehmani kay liye ) aik bhuna huwa bachrra ley aaye ,
verses.translation: aur humaray farishtay ( insani shakal mein ) Ibrahim kay paas ( beta peda honey ki ) khushkhabri ley ker aaye .   unhon ney salam kaha , Ibrahim ney bhi salam kaha , phir Ibrahim ko kuch dair nahi guzri thi kay woh ( unn ki mehmani kay liye ) aik bhuna huwa bachrra ley aaye ,

verses.text: magar jab dekha kay unn kay haath uss ( bachrray ) ki taraf nahi barh rahey , to woh unn say khatak gaye , aur unn ki taraf say dil mein khof mehsoos kiya .   farishton ney kaha :  dariye nahi , hamen ( aap ko betay ki khushkhabri sunaney aur ) loot ki qoam kay paas bheja gaya hai .
verses.translation: magar jab dekha kay unn kay haath uss ( bachrray ) ki taraf nahi barh rahey , to woh unn say khatak gaye , aur unn ki taraf say dil mein khof mehsoos kiya .   farishton ney kaha :  dariye nahi , hamen ( aap ko betay ki khushkhabri sunaney aur ) loot ki qoam kay paas bheja gaya hai .

verses.text: aur Ibrahim ki biwi kharri hoi then , woh hans parren ,   to hum ney unhen ( dobara ) Ishaq ki , aur Ishaq kay baad Yaqoob ki pedaeesh ki khushkhabri di .
verses.translation: aur Ibrahim ki biwi kharri hoi then , woh hans parren ,   to hum ney unhen ( dobara ) Ishaq ki , aur Ishaq kay baad Yaqoob ki pedaeesh ki khushkhabri di .

verses.text: woh kehney lagen :  haaye ! kiya mein iss halat mein baccha janun gi kay mein boorhi hun , aur yeh meray shohar hain jo khud burhapay ki halat mein hain-? waqaee yeh to bari ajeeb baat hai !
verses.translation: woh kehney lagen :  haaye ! kiya mein iss halat mein baccha janun gi kay mein boorhi hun , aur yeh meray shohar hain jo khud burhapay ki halat mein hain-? waqaee yeh to bari ajeeb baat hai !

verses.text: farishton ney kaha :  kiya aap Allah kay hukum per taajjub ker rahi hain-? aap jaisay muqaddas gharaney   per Allah ki rehmat aur barkaten hi barkaten hain . beyshak woh her tareef ka mustahiq , bari shaan wala hai .
verses.translation: farishton ney kaha :  kiya aap Allah kay hukum per taajjub ker rahi hain-? aap jaisay muqaddas gharaney   per Allah ki rehmat aur barkaten hi barkaten hain . beyshak woh her tareef ka mustahiq , bari shaan wala hai .

verses.text: phir jab Ibrahim say ghabrahat door hoi , aur unn ko khushkhabri mil gaee to unhon ney hum say loot ki qoam kay baaray mein ( naaz kay tor per ) jhagarrna shuroo kerdiya .
verses.translation: phir jab Ibrahim say ghabrahat door hoi , aur unn ko khushkhabri mil gaee to unhon ney hum say loot ki qoam kay baaray mein ( naaz kay tor per ) jhagarrna shuroo kerdiya .

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay Ibrahim baray burdbaar, ( Allah ki yaad mein ) bari aahen bharney walay ( aur ) her waqt hum say lo lagaye huye thay .
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay Ibrahim baray burdbaar, ( Allah ki yaad mein ) bari aahen bharney walay ( aur ) her waqt hum say lo lagaye huye thay .

verses.text: . ( hum ney unn say kaha : )  Ibrahim ! iss baat ko janey do . yaqeen kerlo kay tumharay rab ka hukum aa-chuka hai , aur inn logon  per aisa azab aa-ker rahey ga jiss ko koi peechay nahi loata sakta .
verses.translation: . ( hum ney unn say kaha : )  Ibrahim ! iss baat ko janey do . yaqeen kerlo kay tumharay rab ka hukum aa-chuka hai , aur inn logon  per aisa azab aa-ker rahey ga jiss ko koi peechay nahi loata sakta .

verses.text: aur jab humaray farishtay loot kay paas phonchay to woh unn ki wajeh say ghabraye , unn ka dil pareshan huwa aur woh kehney lagay kay :  aaj ka yeh din boht kathan hai .
verses.translation: aur jab humaray farishtay loot kay paas phonchay to woh unn ki wajeh say ghabraye , unn ka dil pareshan huwa aur woh kehney lagay kay :  aaj ka yeh din boht kathan hai .

verses.text: aur unn ki qoam kay log unn kay paas dorrtay huye aaye , aur iss say pehlay woh buray kaam kiya hi kertay thay . loot ney kaha :  aey meri qoam kay logo ! yeh meri betiyan mojood hain , yeh tumharay liye kahen ziyada pakeezah hain ,   iss liye Allah say daro aur meray mehmano kay moamlay mein mujhay ruswa naa kero . kiya tum mein koi aik bhi bhala aadmi nahi hai ?
verses.translation: aur unn ki qoam kay log unn kay paas dorrtay huye aaye , aur iss say pehlay woh buray kaam kiya hi kertay thay . loot ney kaha :  aey meri qoam kay logo ! yeh meri betiyan mojood hain , yeh tumharay liye kahen ziyada pakeezah hain ,   iss liye Allah say daro aur meray mehmano kay moamlay mein mujhay ruswa naa kero . kiya tum mein koi aik bhi bhala aadmi nahi hai ?

verses.text: kehney lagay :  tumhen maloom hai kay tumhari betiyon say hamen kuch matlab nahi , aur tum khoob jantay ho kay hum kiya chahtay hain-?
verses.translation: kehney lagay :  tumhen maloom hai kay tumhari betiyon say hamen kuch matlab nahi , aur tum khoob jantay ho kay hum kiya chahtay hain-?

verses.text: loot ney kaha :  kaash kay meray paas tumharay muqablay mein koi taqat hoti , ya mein kissi mazboot saharay ki panah ley sakta !
verses.translation: loot ney kaha :  kaash kay meray paas tumharay muqablay mein koi taqat hoti , ya mein kissi mazboot saharay ki panah ley sakta !

verses.text: . ( abb ) farishton ney ( loot say ) kaha :  aey loot ! hum tumharay perwerdigar kay bhejay huye farishtay hain . yeh ( kafir ) log hergiz tum tak rasai hasil nahi ker-saken gay . lehaza tum raat kay kissi hissay mein apney ghar walon ko ley ker basti say rawana hojao , aur tum mein say koi peechay murr ker bhi naa dekhay . haan magar tumhari biwi ( tumharay sath nahi jaye gi ) uss per bhi wohi museebat aaney wali hai jo aur logon  per aarahi hai . yaqeen rakho kay inn ( per azab nazil kernay ) kay liye subha ka waqt muqarrar hai . kiya subha bilkul nazdeek nahi aagae ?
verses.translation: . ( abb ) farishton ney ( loot say ) kaha :  aey loot ! hum tumharay perwerdigar kay bhejay huye farishtay hain . yeh ( kafir ) log hergiz tum tak rasai hasil nahi ker-saken gay . lehaza tum raat kay kissi hissay mein apney ghar walon ko ley ker basti say rawana hojao , aur tum mein say koi peechay murr ker bhi naa dekhay . haan magar tumhari biwi ( tumharay sath nahi jaye gi ) uss per bhi wohi museebat aaney wali hai jo aur logon  per aarahi hai . yaqeen rakho kay inn ( per azab nazil kernay ) kay liye subha ka waqt muqarrar hai . kiya subha bilkul nazdeek nahi aagae ?

verses.text: phir jab humara hukum aagaya to hum ney uss zameen kay oopper walay hissay ko neechay walay hissay mein tabdeel kerdiya ,   aur unn per pakki mitti kay teh bar teh pathar barsaye .
verses.translation: phir jab humara hukum aagaya to hum ney uss zameen kay oopper walay hissay ko neechay walay hissay mein tabdeel kerdiya ,   aur unn per pakki mitti kay teh bar teh pathar barsaye .

verses.text: jinn per tumharay rab ki taraf say nishan lagay huye thay . aur yeh basti ( makkah kay unn ) zalimon say kuch door nahi hai .
verses.translation: jinn per tumharay rab ki taraf say nishan lagay huye thay . aur yeh basti ( makkah kay unn ) zalimon say kuch door nahi hai .

verses.text: aur madiyan ki taraf hum ney inn/unn kay bhai shoaib ko payghumber bana ker bheja .   unhon ney ( unn say ) kaha kay :  aey meri qoam ! Allah ki ibadat kero . uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi hai . aur naap tol mein kami matt kiya kero . mein dekh raha hun kay tum log khushal ho ,   aur mujhay tum per aik aesay din kay azab ka khof hai jo tumhen chaaron taraf say gher ley ga .
verses.translation: aur madiyan ki taraf hum ney inn/unn kay bhai shoaib ko payghumber bana ker bheja .   unhon ney ( unn say ) kaha kay :  aey meri qoam ! Allah ki ibadat kero . uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi hai . aur naap tol mein kami matt kiya kero . mein dekh raha hun kay tum log khushal ho ,   aur mujhay tum per aik aesay din kay azab ka khof hai jo tumhen chaaron taraf say gher ley ga .

verses.text: aur aey meri qoam kay logo ! naap tol poora poora kiya kero , aur logon  ko unn ki cheezen ghata ker naa diya kero ,   aur zameen mein fasad phelatay matt phiro .
verses.translation: aur aey meri qoam kay logo ! naap tol poora poora kiya kero , aur logon  ko unn ki cheezen ghata ker naa diya kero ,   aur zameen mein fasad phelatay matt phiro .

verses.text: agar tum meri baat maano to ( logon  ka haq unn ko denay kay baad ) jo kuch Allah ka diya bach rahey , woh tumharay haq mein kahen behtar hai . aur ( agar naa maano to ) mein tum per pehra daar muqarrar nahi huwa hun .
