verses.translation: agar tum meri baat maano to ( logon  ka haq unn ko denay kay baad ) jo kuch Allah ka diya bach rahey , woh tumharay haq mein kahen behtar hai . aur ( agar naa maano to ) mein tum per pehra daar muqarrar nahi huwa hun .

verses.text: woh kehney lagay :  aey shoaib ! kiya tumhari namaz tumhen yeh hukum deti hai kay humaray baap dada jinn ki ibadat kertay aaye thay , hum unhen bhi chorr den , aur apney maal o dolat kay baaray mein jo kuch hum chahen , woh bhi naa keren ?   waqaee tum to baray aqal mand , naik chalan aadmi ho !
verses.translation: woh kehney lagay :  aey shoaib ! kiya tumhari namaz tumhen yeh hukum deti hai kay humaray baap dada jinn ki ibadat kertay aaye thay , hum unhen bhi chorr den , aur apney maal o dolat kay baaray mein jo kuch hum chahen , woh bhi naa keren ?   waqaee tum to baray aqal mand , naik chalan aadmi ho !

verses.text: shoaib ney kaha :  aey meri qoam kay logo ! zara mujhay yeh batao kay agar mein apney perwerdigar ki taraf say aik roshan daleel per qaeem hun , aur uss ney khaas apney paas say mujhay acha rizq ata farmaya hai   ( to phir mein tumharay ghalat tareeqay per kiyon chalun ? ) aur mera aisa koi irada nahi hai kay mein jiss baat say tumhen mana ker raha hun , tumharay peechay jaker wohi kaam khud kernay lagun . mera maqsad apni istataat ki hadd tak islaah kay siwa kuch nahi hai . aur mujhay jo kuch tofiq hoti hai , sirf Allah ki madad say hoti hai . ussi per mein ney bharosa ker rakha hai , aur ussi ki taraf mein ( her moamlay mein ) rujoo kerta hun .
verses.translation: shoaib ney kaha :  aey meri qoam kay logo ! zara mujhay yeh batao kay agar mein apney perwerdigar ki taraf say aik roshan daleel per qaeem hun , aur uss ney khaas apney paas say mujhay acha rizq ata farmaya hai   ( to phir mein tumharay ghalat tareeqay per kiyon chalun ? ) aur mera aisa koi irada nahi hai kay mein jiss baat say tumhen mana ker raha hun , tumharay peechay jaker wohi kaam khud kernay lagun . mera maqsad apni istataat ki hadd tak islaah kay siwa kuch nahi hai . aur mujhay jo kuch tofiq hoti hai , sirf Allah ki madad say hoti hai . ussi per mein ney bharosa ker rakha hai , aur ussi ki taraf mein ( her moamlay mein ) rujoo kerta hun .

verses.text: aur aey meri qoam ! meray sath zidd ka jo moamla tum ker rahey ho , woh kahen tumhen uss anjam tak naa phoncha dey kay tum per bhi wesi hi museebat nazil ho jaisi nooh ki qoam per ya Hood ki qoam per ya saleh ki qoam per nazil hochuki hai . aur loot ki qoam to tum say kuch door bhi nahi hai .
verses.translation: aur aey meri qoam ! meray sath zidd ka jo moamla tum ker rahey ho , woh kahen tumhen uss anjam tak naa phoncha dey kay tum per bhi wesi hi museebat nazil ho jaisi nooh ki qoam per ya Hood ki qoam per ya saleh ki qoam per nazil hochuki hai . aur loot ki qoam to tum say kuch door bhi nahi hai .

verses.text: tum apney rab say moaafi maango , phir ussi ki taraf rujoo kero . yaqeen rakho kay mera rab bara meharban , boht mohabbat kernay wala hai .
verses.translation: tum apney rab say moaafi maango , phir ussi ki taraf rujoo kero . yaqeen rakho kay mera rab bara meharban , boht mohabbat kernay wala hai .

verses.text: woh boley : aey shoaib ! tumhari boht si baaten to humari samjh hi mein nahi aaten , aur hum dekh rahey hein kay tum humarey darmiyan aik kamzor aadmi ho aur agar tumhara khandan na hota to hum tumhen pathar maar maar ker halak ker detay . hum per tumhara kuch zor nahi chalta .
verses.translation: woh boley : aey shoaib ! tumhari boht si baaten to humari samjh hi mein nahi aaten , aur hum dekh rahey hein kay tum humarey darmiyan aik kamzor aadmi ho aur agar tumhara khandan na hota to hum tumhen pathar maar maar ker halak ker detay . hum per tumhara kuch zor nahi chalta .

verses.text: shoaib ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! kiya tum per meray khandan ka dabao Allah say ziyada hai ? aur uss ko tum ney bilkul hi pus-e-pusht daal rakha hai ! yaqeen jano kay jo kuch tum ker rahey ho , mera perwerdigar uss sabb ka poora ehata kiye huye hai .
verses.translation: shoaib ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! kiya tum per meray khandan ka dabao Allah say ziyada hai ? aur uss ko tum ney bilkul hi pus-e-pusht daal rakha hai ! yaqeen jano kay jo kuch tum ker rahey ho , mera perwerdigar uss sabb ka poora ehata kiye huye hai .

verses.text: aur aey meri qoam ! tum apney haal per reh ker ( jo chahao ) amal kiye jao , mein bhi ( apney tareeqay kay mutabiq ) amal ker raha hun .   unqareeb tumhen pata chal jaye ga kay kiss per woh azab nazil hoga jo ussay ruswa ker kay rakh dey ga , aur kon hai jo jhoota hai ? aur tum bhi intizar kero , mein bhi tumharay sath intizar ker raha hun .
verses.translation: aur aey meri qoam ! tum apney haal per reh ker ( jo chahao ) amal kiye jao , mein bhi ( apney tareeqay kay mutabiq ) amal ker raha hun .   unqareeb tumhen pata chal jaye ga kay kiss per woh azab nazil hoga jo ussay ruswa ker kay rakh dey ga , aur kon hai jo jhoota hai ? aur tum bhi intizar kero , mein bhi tumharay sath intizar ker raha hun .

verses.text: aur ( aakhir kaar ) jab humara hukum aa-phoncha to hum ney shoaib ko aur unn kay sath jo emaan laye thay , unn ko apni khaas rehmat say bacha liya , aur jinn logon  ney zulm kiya tha unhen aik chinghaarr ney aa-pakra ,   aur woh apney gharon mein iss tarah ondhay mun giray reh gaye .
verses.translation: aur ( aakhir kaar ) jab humara hukum aa-phoncha to hum ney shoaib ko aur unn kay sath jo emaan laye thay , unn ko apni khaas rehmat say bacha liya , aur jinn logon  ney zulm kiya tha unhen aik chinghaarr ney aa-pakra ,   aur woh apney gharon mein iss tarah ondhay mun giray reh gaye .

verses.text: jaisay kabhi wahan basay hi naa thay . yaad rakho ! madiyan ki bhi wesi hi barbadi hoi jaisi barbadi samood ki hoi thi .
verses.translation: jaisay kabhi wahan basay hi naa thay . yaad rakho ! madiyan ki bhi wesi hi barbadi hoi jaisi barbadi samood ki hoi thi .

verses.text: aur hum ney musa ko apni nishaniyon aur roshan daleel kay sath payghumber bana ker .
verses.translation: aur hum ney musa ko apni nishaniyon aur roshan daleel kay sath payghumber bana ker .

verses.text: firon aur uss kay sardaron kay paas bheja , to unhon ney firon hi ki baat maani , halankay firon ki baat koi thikaney ki baat nahi thi .
verses.translation: firon aur uss kay sardaron kay paas bheja , to unhon ney firon hi ki baat maani , halankay firon ki baat koi thikaney ki baat nahi thi .

verses.text: woh qayamat kay din apni qoam kay aagay aagay hoga , aur unn sabb ko dozakh mein laa utaray ga . aur woh bad-tareen ghaatt hai jiss per koi utray .
verses.translation: woh qayamat kay din apni qoam kay aagay aagay hoga , aur unn sabb ko dozakh mein laa utaray ga . aur woh bad-tareen ghaatt hai jiss per koi utray .

verses.text: aur phitkaar iss duniya mein bhi unn kay peechay laga di gaee hai , aur qayamat kay din bhi . yeh bad-tareen sila hai jo kissi ko diya jaye .
verses.translation: aur phitkaar iss duniya mein bhi unn kay peechay laga di gaee hai , aur qayamat kay din bhi . yeh bad-tareen sila hai jo kissi ko diya jaye .

verses.text: yeh inn bastiyon kay kuch halaat hain jo hum tumhen suna rahey hain . inn mein say kuch ( bastiyan ) woh hain jo abhi apni jagah kharri hain ,   aur kuch katti hoi fasal ( ki tarah bey nishan ) ban chuki hain .
verses.translation: yeh inn bastiyon kay kuch halaat hain jo hum tumhen suna rahey hain . inn mein say kuch ( bastiyan ) woh hain jo abhi apni jagah kharri hain ,   aur kuch katti hoi fasal ( ki tarah bey nishan ) ban chuki hain .

verses.text: aur inn per hum ney koi zulm nahi kiya , balkay unhon ney khud apni janon per zulm kiya tha , jiss ka nateeja yeh huwa kay jab tumharay perwerdigar ka hukum aaya to jinn maboodon ko woh Allah kay bajaye pukara kertay thay , woh unn kay zara bhi kaam naa aaye , aur unhon ney inn-ko tabahi kay siwa aur kuch nahi diya .
verses.translation: aur inn per hum ney koi zulm nahi kiya , balkay unhon ney khud apni janon per zulm kiya tha , jiss ka nateeja yeh huwa kay jab tumharay perwerdigar ka hukum aaya to jinn maboodon ko woh Allah kay bajaye pukara kertay thay , woh unn kay zara bhi kaam naa aaye , aur unhon ney inn-ko tabahi kay siwa aur kuch nahi diya .

verses.text: aur jo bastiyan zalim hoti hain , tumhara rab jab unn ko girift mein leta hai to uss ki pakar aesi hi hoti hai . waqaee uss ki pakar bari dardnak , bari sakht hai .
verses.translation: aur jo bastiyan zalim hoti hain , tumhara rab jab unn ko girift mein leta hai to uss ki pakar aesi hi hoti hai . waqaee uss ki pakar bari dardnak , bari sakht hai .

verses.text: inn sari baaton mein uss shaks kay liye bari ibrat hai jo aakhirat kay azab say darta ho . woh aisa din hoga jiss kay liye tamam logon  ko ikattha kiya jaye ga , aur woh aisa din hoga jissay sabb kay sabb khuli aankhon dekhen gay .
verses.translation: inn sari baaton mein uss shaks kay liye bari ibrat hai jo aakhirat kay azab say darta ho . woh aisa din hoga jiss kay liye tamam logon  ko ikattha kiya jaye ga , aur woh aisa din hoga jissay sabb kay sabb khuli aankhon dekhen gay .

verses.text: hum ney ussay multawi kiya hai to bus aik gini chuni mauddat kay liye multawi kiya hai .
verses.translation: hum ney ussay multawi kiya hai to bus aik gini chuni mauddat kay liye multawi kiya hai .

verses.text: jab woh din aajaye ga to koi Allah ki ijazat kay baghair baat nahi ker-sakay ga . phir unn mein koi bad-haal hoga , aur koi khushal .
verses.translation: jab woh din aajaye ga to koi Allah ki ijazat kay baghair baat nahi ker-sakay ga . phir unn mein koi bad-haal hoga , aur koi khushal .

verses.text: chunacheh jo bad-haal hon gay woh dozakh mein hon gay , jahan unn ki cheekhney chilaney ki aawazen ayen gi .
verses.translation: chunacheh jo bad-haal hon gay woh dozakh mein hon gay , jahan unn ki cheekhney chilaney ki aawazen ayen gi .

verses.text: yeh uss mein hamesha hamesha rahen gay jab tak aasman aur zameen qaeem hain ,   illa yeh kay tumharay rab hi ko kuch aur manzoor ho .   yaqeenan tumhara rab jo irada kerlay , uss per achi tarah amal kerta hai .
verses.translation: yeh uss mein hamesha hamesha rahen gay jab tak aasman aur zameen qaeem hain ,   illa yeh kay tumharay rab hi ko kuch aur manzoor ho .   yaqeenan tumhara rab jo irada kerlay , uss per achi tarah amal kerta hai .

verses.text: aur jo log khushal hon gay woh jannat mein hon gay jiss mein woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay , jab tak aasman aur zameen qaeem hain , illa yeh kay tumharay rab hi ko kuch aur manzoor ho . yeh aik aesi ata hogi jo kabhi khatam honey mein nahi aaye gi .
verses.translation: aur jo log khushal hon gay woh jannat mein hon gay jiss mein woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay , jab tak aasman aur zameen qaeem hain , illa yeh kay tumharay rab hi ko kuch aur manzoor ho . yeh aik aesi ata hogi jo kabhi khatam honey mein nahi aaye gi .

verses.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh ( mushrikeen ) jinn ( button ) ki ibadat kertay hain , unn kay baaray mein zara bhi shak mein naa rehna . yeh to ussi tarah ibadat ker rahey hain jaisay inn kay baap daday pehlay hi ibadat kiya kertay thay , aur yaqeen rakho kay hum inn sabb ko inn ka hissa poora poora chuka den gay , jiss mein koi kami nahi ki jaye gi .
verses.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh ( mushrikeen ) jinn ( button ) ki ibadat kertay hain , unn kay baaray mein zara bhi shak mein naa rehna . yeh to ussi tarah ibadat ker rahey hain jaisay inn kay baap daday pehlay hi ibadat kiya kertay thay , aur yaqeen rakho kay hum inn sabb ko inn ka hissa poora poora chuka den gay , jiss mein koi kami nahi ki jaye gi .

verses.text: aur hum ney musa ko kitab di thi , to uss mein bhi ikhtilaf kiya gaya tha . aur agar tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik baat pehlay hi tey naa hochuki hoti ( kay inn ko poora azab aakhirat mein diya jaye ga ) to inn ka faisla ( yahin duniya mein ) hochuka hota . aur yeh log iss kay baaray mein ( abhi tak ) sakht qisam kay shak mein parray huye hain .
verses.translation: aur hum ney musa ko kitab di thi , to uss mein bhi ikhtilaf kiya gaya tha . aur agar tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik baat pehlay hi tey naa hochuki hoti ( kay inn ko poora azab aakhirat mein diya jaye ga ) to inn ka faisla ( yahin duniya mein ) hochuka hota . aur yeh log iss kay baaray mein ( abhi tak ) sakht qisam kay shak mein parray huye hain .

verses.text: aur yaqeen rakho kay sabb logon  ka moamla yehi hai kay tumhara perwerdigar unn kay aemal ka badla poora poora dey ga . yaqeenan woh unn kay tamam aemal say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: aur yaqeen rakho kay sabb logon  ka moamla yehi hai kay tumhara perwerdigar unn kay aemal ka badla poora poora dey ga . yaqeenan woh unn kay tamam aemal say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) jiss tarah tumhen hukum diya gaya hai , uss kay mutabiq tum bhi seedhay raastay per sabit qadam raho , aur woh log bhi jo tauba ker kay tumharay sath hain , aur hadd say aagay naa niklo . yaqeen rakho kay jo amal bhi tum kertay ho , woh ussay poori tarah dekhta hai .
verses.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) jiss tarah tumhen hukum diya gaya hai , uss kay mutabiq tum bhi seedhay raastay per sabit qadam raho , aur woh log bhi jo tauba ker kay tumharay sath hain , aur hadd say aagay naa niklo . yaqeen rakho kay jo amal bhi tum kertay ho , woh ussay poori tarah dekhta hai .

verses.text: aur ( musalmano ! ) inn zalim logon  ki taraf zara bhi naa jhukna , kabhi dozakh ki aag tumhen bhi aa-pakray , aur tumhen Allah ko chorr ker kissi qisam kay dost moyassar naa ayen , phir tumhari koi madad bhi naa keray .
verses.translation: aur ( musalmano ! ) inn zalim logon  ki taraf zara bhi naa jhukna , kabhi dozakh ki aag tumhen bhi aa-pakray , aur tumhen Allah ko chorr ker kissi qisam kay dost moyassar naa ayen , phir tumhari koi madad bhi naa keray .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) din kay dono saron per aur raat kay kuch hisson mein namaz qaeem kero .   yaqeenan naikiyan buraiyon ko mita deti hain .   yeh aik naseehat hai unn logon  kay liye jo naseehat maanen .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) din kay dono saron per aur raat kay kuch hisson mein namaz qaeem kero .   yaqeenan naikiyan buraiyon ko mita deti hain .   yeh aik naseehat hai unn logon  kay liye jo naseehat maanen .

verses.text: aur sabar say kaam lo , iss liye kay Allah naiki kernay walon ka ajar zaya nahi kerta .
verses.translation: aur sabar say kaam lo , iss liye kay Allah naiki kernay walon ka ajar zaya nahi kerta .

verses.text: tum say pehlay jo ummaten guzri hain , bhala unn mein aesay log kiyon naa huye jinn kay paas itni bachi khuchi samajh to hoti kay woh logon  ko zameen mein fasad machaney say roktay haan thoray say log thay jinn ko hum ney ( azab say ) nijat di thi . aur jo log zalim thay , woh jiss aesh o ishrat mein thay , ussi kay peechay lagay rahey , aur jaraeem ka irtikab kertay rahey .
verses.translation: tum say pehlay jo ummaten guzri hain , bhala unn mein aesay log kiyon naa huye jinn kay paas itni bachi khuchi samajh to hoti kay woh logon  ko zameen mein fasad machaney say roktay haan thoray say log thay jinn ko hum ney ( azab say ) nijat di thi . aur jo log zalim thay , woh jiss aesh o ishrat mein thay , ussi kay peechay lagay rahey , aur jaraeem ka irtikab kertay rahey .

verses.text: aur tumhara perwerdigar aisa nahi hai kay bastiyon per zulm ker kay unhen tabah ker dey jabkay unn kay bashinday sahih rawish per chal rahey hon .
verses.translation: aur tumhara perwerdigar aisa nahi hai kay bastiyon per zulm ker kay unhen tabah ker dey jabkay unn kay bashinday sahih rawish per chal rahey hon .

verses.text: aur agar tumhara perwerdigar chahta to tamam insanon ko aik hi tareeqay ka pero bana deta , ( magar kissi ko zabardasti kissi deen per majboor kerna hikmat ka taqaza nahi hai , iss liye enhen apney ikhtiyar say mukhtalif tareeqay apnaney ka moaqa diya gaya hai ) aur woh abb hamesha mukhtalif raaston per hi rahen gay .
verses.translation: aur agar tumhara perwerdigar chahta to tamam insanon ko aik hi tareeqay ka pero bana deta , ( magar kissi ko zabardasti kissi deen per majboor kerna hikmat ka taqaza nahi hai , iss liye enhen apney ikhtiyar say mukhtalif tareeqay apnaney ka moaqa diya gaya hai ) aur woh abb hamesha mukhtalif raaston per hi rahen gay .

verses.text: albatta jinn per tumhara perwerdigar reham farmaye ga , unn ki baat aur hai ( kay Allah unhen haq per qaeem rakhay ga ) aur issi ( imtihan ) kay liye uss ney inn ko peda kiya hai .   aur tumharay rab ki woh baat poori hogi jo uss ney kahi thi kay :  mein jahannum ko jinnaat aur insanon dono say bhar dun ga .
verses.translation: albatta jinn per tumhara perwerdigar reham farmaye ga , unn ki baat aur hai ( kay Allah unhen haq per qaeem rakhay ga ) aur issi ( imtihan ) kay liye uss ney inn ko peda kiya hai .   aur tumharay rab ki woh baat poori hogi jo uss ney kahi thi kay :  mein jahannum ko jinnaat aur insanon dono say bhar dun ga .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) guzishta payghumberon kay waqiyaat mein say woh saray waqiyaat hum tumhen suna rahey hain jinn say hum tumharay dil ko taqwiyat phonchayen , aur inn waqiyaat kay zimn mein tumharay paas jo baat aai hai , woh khud bhi haq hai , aur tamam mominon kay liye naseehat aur yaad-dahani bhi hai .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) guzishta payghumberon kay waqiyaat mein say woh saray waqiyaat hum tumhen suna rahey hain jinn say hum tumharay dil ko taqwiyat phonchayen , aur inn waqiyaat kay zimn mein tumharay paas jo baat aai hai , woh khud bhi haq hai , aur tamam mominon kay liye naseehat aur yaad-dahani bhi hai .

verses.text: aur jo log emaan nahi laarahey hain , unn say kaho kay :  tum apni mojooda halat per amal kiye jao , hum bhi ( apney tareeqay per ) amal ker rahey hain .
verses.translation: aur jo log emaan nahi laarahey hain , unn say kaho kay :  tum apni mojooda halat per amal kiye jao , hum bhi ( apney tareeqay per ) amal ker rahey hain .

verses.text: aur tum bhi ( Allah kay faislay ka ) intizar kero , hum bhi intizar kertay hain .
verses.translation: aur tum bhi ( Allah kay faislay ka ) intizar kero , hum bhi intizar kertay hain .

verses.text: aasmano aur zameen mein jitney posheeda bhed hain , woh sabb Allah kay ilm mein hain , aur ussi ki taraf saray moamlaat lotaye jayen gay . lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) uss ki ibadat kero , aur uss per bharosa rakho . aur tum log jo kuch kertay ho , tumhara perwerdigar uss say bey khabar nahi hai .
verses.translation: aasmano aur zameen mein jitney posheeda bhed hain , woh sabb Allah kay ilm mein hain , aur ussi ki taraf saray moamlaat lotaye jayen gay . lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) uss ki ibadat kero , aur uss per bharosa rakho . aur tum log jo kuch kertay ho , tumhara perwerdigar uss say bey khabar nahi hai .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: Alif-Laam-Raa .   yeh woh kitab hai jiss ki aayaton ko ( dalaeel say ) mazboot kiya gaya hai ,   phir aik aesi zaat ki taraf say unn ko tafseel kay sath biyan kiya gaya hai jo hikmat ki malik aur her baat say ba-khabar hai .
ayahs.translation: Alif-Laam-Raa .   yeh woh kitab hai jiss ki aayaton ko ( dalaeel say ) mazboot kiya gaya hai ,   phir aik aesi zaat ki taraf say unn ko tafseel kay sath biyan kiya gaya hai jo hikmat ki malik aur her baat say ba-khabar hai .

ayahs.text: . ( yeh kitab payghumber ko hukum deti hai kay woh logon  say yeh kahen ) kay :  Allah kay siwa kissi ki ibadat naa kero . mein uss ki taraf say tumhen aagah kernay wala aur khushkhabri sunaney wala hun .
ayahs.translation: . ( yeh kitab payghumber ko hukum deti hai kay woh logon  say yeh kahen ) kay :  Allah kay siwa kissi ki ibadat naa kero . mein uss ki taraf say tumhen aagah kernay wala aur khushkhabri sunaney wala hun .

ayahs.text: aur yeh ( hidayat deta ) kay :  apney perwerdigar say gunahon ki moaafi maango , phir uss ki taraf rujoo kero ,   woh tumhen aik muqarrar waqt tak ( zindagi say ) acha lutf uthaney ka moaqa dey ga , aur her uss shaks ko jiss ney ziyada amal kiya hoga , apni taraf say ziyada ajar dey ga . aur agar tum ney mun morra to mujhay tum per aik baray din kay azab ka andesha hai .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh ( hidayat deta ) kay :  apney perwerdigar say gunahon ki moaafi maango , phir uss ki taraf rujoo kero ,   woh tumhen aik muqarrar waqt tak ( zindagi say ) acha lutf uthaney ka moaqa dey ga , aur her uss shaks ko jiss ney ziyada amal kiya hoga , apni taraf say ziyada ajar dey ga . aur agar tum ney mun morra to mujhay tum per aik baray din kay azab ka andesha hai .

ayahs.text: Allah hi kay paas tumhen loat ker jana hai , aur woh her cheez ki poori qudrat rakhta hai
ayahs.translation: Allah hi kay paas tumhen loat ker jana hai , aur woh her cheez ki poori qudrat rakhta hai

ayahs.text: dekho yeh ( kafir ) log apney seenon ko uss say chupney kay liye dohra kerletay hain . yaad rakho jab yeh apney oopper kapray lapettay hain , Allah unn ki woh baaten bhi janta hai jo yeh chupatay hain , aur woh bhi jo yeh al-al-aelaan kertay hain .   yaqeenan Allah seenon mein chupi hoi baaton ka ( bhi ) poora poora ilm rakhta hai .
ayahs.translation: dekho yeh ( kafir ) log apney seenon ko uss say chupney kay liye dohra kerletay hain . yaad rakho jab yeh apney oopper kapray lapettay hain , Allah unn ki woh baaten bhi janta hai jo yeh chupatay hain , aur woh bhi jo yeh al-al-aelaan kertay hain .   yaqeenan Allah seenon mein chupi hoi baaton ka ( bhi ) poora poora ilm rakhta hai .

ayahs.text: aur zameen per chalney wala koi jandaar aisa nahi hai jiss ka rizq Allah ney apney zimmay naa ley rakha ho . woh uss kay mustaqil thikaney ko bhi janta hai , aur aarzi thikaney ko bhi . her baat aik wazeh kitab mein darj hai .
ayahs.translation: aur zameen per chalney wala koi jandaar aisa nahi hai jiss ka rizq Allah ney apney zimmay naa ley rakha ho . woh uss kay mustaqil thikaney ko bhi janta hai , aur aarzi thikaney ko bhi . her baat aik wazeh kitab mein darj hai .

ayahs.text: aur wohi hai jiss ney tamam aasmano aur zameen ko cheh din mein peda kiya . jabkay uss ka arsh paani per tha .   takay tumhen aazamaye kay amal kay aetbar say tum mein kon ziyada acha hai .   aur agar tum ( logon  say ) yeh kaho kay tumhen marney kay baad dobara zinda kiya jaye ga to jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh yeh kahen gay kay yeh khulay jadoo kay siwa kuch nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur wohi hai jiss ney tamam aasmano aur zameen ko cheh din mein peda kiya . jabkay uss ka arsh paani per tha .   takay tumhen aazamaye kay amal kay aetbar say tum mein kon ziyada acha hai .   aur agar tum ( logon  say ) yeh kaho kay tumhen marney kay baad dobara zinda kiya jaye ga to jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh yeh kahen gay kay yeh khulay jadoo kay siwa kuch nahi hai .

ayahs.text: aur agar hum inn logon  say kuch arsay kay liye azab ko moakhir kerden to woh yehi kehtay rahen gay kay :  aakhir kiss cheez ney iss ( azab ) ko rok rakha hai ?    aray jiss din woh azab aagaya , to woh inn say talaye nahi talay ga , aur jiss cheez ka yeh mazaq urra rahey hain , woh inn ko chaaron taraf say gher ley gi .
ayahs.translation: aur agar hum inn logon  say kuch arsay kay liye azab ko moakhir kerden to woh yehi kehtay rahen gay kay :  aakhir kiss cheez ney iss ( azab ) ko rok rakha hai ?    aray jiss din woh azab aagaya , to woh inn say talaye nahi talay ga , aur jiss cheez ka yeh mazaq urra rahey hain , woh inn ko chaaron taraf say gher ley gi .

ayahs.text: aur jab hum insan ko apni taraf say kissi rehmat ka maza chakha detay hain , phir woh uss say wapis ley letay hain to woh mayyus ( aur ) nashukra ban jata hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jab hum insan ko apni taraf say kissi rehmat ka maza chakha detay hain , phir woh uss say wapis ley letay hain to woh mayyus ( aur ) nashukra ban jata hai .

ayahs.text: aur agar ussay koi takleef phonchney kay baad hum ussay naimaton ka maza chakha den to woh kehta hai kay sari buraiyan mujh say door hogaeen . ( uss waqt ) woh itra ker shekhiyan bgharney lagta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur agar ussay koi takleef phonchney kay baad hum ussay naimaton ka maza chakha den to woh kehta hai kay sari buraiyan mujh say door hogaeen . ( uss waqt ) woh itra ker shekhiyan bgharney lagta hai .

ayahs.text: haan ! magar jo log sabar say kaam letay hain , aur naik amal kertay hain woh aesay nahi hain . unn ko maghfirat aur bara ajar naseeb hoga .
ayahs.translation: haan ! magar jo log sabar say kaam letay hain , aur naik amal kertay hain woh aesay nahi hain . unn ko maghfirat aur bara ajar naseeb hoga .

ayahs.text: phir ( aey payghumber ! ) jo wahi tum per nazil ki jarahi hai , kiya yeh mumkin hai kay tum uss ka koi hissa chorr betho-?   aur uss say tumhara dil tang hojaye-? kiyonkay yeh log kehtay hain kay :  inn ( Muhammad SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) per koi khazana kiyon nazil nahi huwa , ya koi farishta inn kay sath kiyon nahi aaya-?  tum to aik aagah kernay walay ho ! aur Allah hai jo her cheez ka mukammal ikhtiyar rakhta hai .
ayahs.translation: phir ( aey payghumber ! ) jo wahi tum per nazil ki jarahi hai , kiya yeh mumkin hai kay tum uss ka koi hissa chorr betho-?   aur uss say tumhara dil tang hojaye-? kiyonkay yeh log kehtay hain kay :  inn ( Muhammad SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) per koi khazana kiyon nazil nahi huwa , ya koi farishta inn kay sath kiyon nahi aaya-?  tum to aik aagah kernay walay ho ! aur Allah hai jo her cheez ka mukammal ikhtiyar rakhta hai .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya yeh log yun kehtay hain kay yeh wahi iss ( payghumber ) ney apni taraf say gharr li hai ? ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) keh do kay :  phir to tum bhi iss jaisi gharri hoi das suraten bana lao ,   aur ( iss kaam mein madad kay liye ) Allah kay siwa jiss kissi ko bula sako bula lo , agar tum sachay ho .
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya yeh log yun kehtay hain kay yeh wahi iss ( payghumber ) ney apni taraf say gharr li hai ? ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) keh do kay :  phir to tum bhi iss jaisi gharri hoi das suraten bana lao ,   aur ( iss kaam mein madad kay liye ) Allah kay siwa jiss kissi ko bula sako bula lo , agar tum sachay ho .

ayahs.text: iss kay baad agar yeh tumhari baat qubool naa keren to ( aey logo ! ) yaqeen kerlo kay yeh wahi sirf Allah kay ilm say utri hai , aur yeh kay Allah kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi hai . to kiya abb tum farmanbardaar bano gay-?
ayahs.translation: iss kay baad agar yeh tumhari baat qubool naa keren to ( aey logo ! ) yaqeen kerlo kay yeh wahi sirf Allah kay ilm say utri hai , aur yeh kay Allah kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi hai . to kiya abb tum farmanbardaar bano gay-?

ayahs.text: jo log ( sirf ) dunyawi zindagi aur uss ki sajj dhajj chahtay hain , hum unn kay aemal ka poora poora sila issi duniya mein bhugta den gay , aur yahan unn kay haq mein koi kami nahi hogi .
ayahs.translation: jo log ( sirf ) dunyawi zindagi aur uss ki sajj dhajj chahtay hain , hum unn kay aemal ka poora poora sila issi duniya mein bhugta den gay , aur yahan unn kay haq mein koi kami nahi hogi .

ayahs.text: yeh woh log hain jinn kay liye aakhirat mein dozakh kay siwa kuch nahi hai , aur jo kuch kaarguzari unhon ney ki thi , woh aakhirat mein beykaar hojaye gi , aur jo amal woh ker rahey hain , ( aakhirat kay lehaz say ) kal-adam hain .
ayahs.translation: yeh woh log hain jinn kay liye aakhirat mein dozakh kay siwa kuch nahi hai , aur jo kuch kaarguzari unhon ney ki thi , woh aakhirat mein beykaar hojaye gi , aur jo amal woh ker rahey hain , ( aakhirat kay lehaz say ) kal-adam hain .

ayahs.text: bhala batao kay woh shaks ( unn kay barabar kaisay hosakta hai ) jo apney rab ki taraf say aai hoi roshan hidayat ( yani Quran ) per qaeem ho , jiss kay peechay uss ki haqqaniyat ka aik saboot to khud ussi mein aaya hai ,   aur uss say pehlay musa ki kitab bhi ( uss ki haqqaniyat ka saboot hai ) jo logon  kay liye qabil-e-ittaba aur baees-e-rehmat thi . aesay log iss ( Quran per ) emaan rakhtay hain . aur inn girohon mein say jo shaks iss ka inkar keray , to dozakh hi uss ki tey shuda jagah hai . lehaza iss ( Quran ) kay baaray mein kisi shak mein naa parro . yaqeen rakho kay yeh haq hai jo tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aaya hai , lekin aksar log emaan nahi laarahey .
ayahs.translation: bhala batao kay woh shaks ( unn kay barabar kaisay hosakta hai ) jo apney rab ki taraf say aai hoi roshan hidayat ( yani Quran ) per qaeem ho , jiss kay peechay uss ki haqqaniyat ka aik saboot to khud ussi mein aaya hai ,   aur uss say pehlay musa ki kitab bhi ( uss ki haqqaniyat ka saboot hai ) jo logon  kay liye qabil-e-ittaba aur baees-e-rehmat thi . aesay log iss ( Quran per ) emaan rakhtay hain . aur inn girohon mein say jo shaks iss ka inkar keray , to dozakh hi uss ki tey shuda jagah hai . lehaza iss ( Quran ) kay baaray mein kisi shak mein naa parro . yaqeen rakho kay yeh haq hai jo tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aaya hai , lekin aksar log emaan nahi laarahey .

ayahs.text: aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay-? aesay logon  ki unn kay rab kay paas paishi hogi , aur gawahi denay walay kahen gay kay :  yeh hain woh log jinhon ney apney perwerdigar per jhooti baaten lagai then .    sabb log sunn len kay Allah ki lanat hai inn zalimon per .
ayahs.translation: aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay-? aesay logon  ki unn kay rab kay paas paishi hogi , aur gawahi denay walay kahen gay kay :  yeh hain woh log jinhon ney apney perwerdigar per jhooti baaten lagai then .    sabb log sunn len kay Allah ki lanat hai inn zalimon per .

ayahs.text: jo Allah kay raastay say doosron ko roktay thay , aur uss mein kaji talash kertay thay ,   aur aakhirat kay to woh bilkul hi munkir thay .
ayahs.translation: jo Allah kay raastay say doosron ko roktay thay , aur uss mein kaji talash kertay thay ,   aur aakhirat kay to woh bilkul hi munkir thay .

ayahs.text: aesay log rooaey zameen per kahen bhi Allah say bach ker nahi nikal saktay , aur Allah kay siwa enhen koi yaar-o-madadgaar moyassar nahi aa-saktay . unn ko dugna azab diya jaye ga .   yeh ( haq baat ko nafrat ki wajeh say ) naa sunn saktay thay , aur naa unn ko ( haq ) sujhai deta tha .
ayahs.translation: aesay log rooaey zameen per kahen bhi Allah say bach ker nahi nikal saktay , aur Allah kay siwa enhen koi yaar-o-madadgaar moyassar nahi aa-saktay . unn ko dugna azab diya jaye ga .   yeh ( haq baat ko nafrat ki wajeh say ) naa sunn saktay thay , aur naa unn ko ( haq ) sujhai deta tha .

ayahs.text: yeh woh log hain jinhon ney apni janon kay liye ghatay ka soda kerliya tha , aur jo mabood unhon ney gharr rakhay thay , unhen unn ka koi suragh nahi milay ga .
ayahs.translation: yeh woh log hain jinhon ney apni janon kay liye ghatay ka soda kerliya tha , aur jo mabood unhon ney gharr rakhay thay , unhen unn ka koi suragh nahi milay ga .

ayahs.text: la-mohala yehi log hain jo aakhirat mein sabb say ziyada nuqsan uthaney walay hain .
ayahs.translation: la-mohala yehi log hain jo aakhirat mein sabb say ziyada nuqsan uthaney walay hain .

ayahs.text: . ( doosri taraf ) jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , aur woh apney perwerdigar kay aagay jhuk ker mutmaeen hogaye hain , to woh jannat kay basney walay hain . woh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .
ayahs.translation: . ( doosri taraf ) jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , aur woh apney perwerdigar kay aagay jhuk ker mutmaeen hogaye hain , to woh jannat kay basney walay hain . woh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .

ayahs.text: inn do girohon ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik andha aur behra ho , aur doosra dekhta bhi ho , sunta bhi ho . kiya yeh dono apney halaat mein barabar hosaktay hain-? kiya phir bhi tum ibrat hasil nahi kertay ?
ayahs.translation: inn do girohon ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik andha aur behra ho , aur doosra dekhta bhi ho , sunta bhi ho . kiya yeh dono apney halaat mein barabar hosaktay hain-? kiya phir bhi tum ibrat hasil nahi kertay ?

ayahs.text: aur hum ney nooh ko unn ki qoam kay paas yeh paygham dey ker bheja kay :  mein tumhen iss baat say saaf saaf aagah kernay wala payghumber hun .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney nooh ko unn ki qoam kay paas yeh paygham dey ker bheja kay :  mein tumhen iss baat say saaf saaf aagah kernay wala payghumber hun .

ayahs.text: kay Allah kay siwa kissi aur ki ibadat naa kero . yaqeen jano mujhay tum per aik dukh denay walay din kay azab ka andesha hai .
ayahs.translation: kay Allah kay siwa kissi aur ki ibadat naa kero . yaqeen jano mujhay tum per aik dukh denay walay din kay azab ka andesha hai .

ayahs.text: iss per unn ki qoam kay woh sardar log jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kerliya tha , kehney lagay kay :  hamen to iss say ziyada ( tum mein ) koi baat nazar nahi aarahi kay tum hum jaisay hi aik insan ho . aur hum yeh bhi dekh rahey hain kay sirf woh log tumharay peechay lagay hain jo hum mein sabb say ziyada bey haisiyat hain , aur woh bhi satahi tor per raye qaeem kerkay . aur hamen tum mein koi aesi baat bhi dikhai nahi deti jiss ki wajeh say hum per tumhen koi fazilat hasil ho , balkay humara khayal to yeh hai kay tum sabb jhootay ho
ayahs.translation: iss per unn ki qoam kay woh sardar log jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kerliya tha , kehney lagay kay :  hamen to iss say ziyada ( tum mein ) koi baat nazar nahi aarahi kay tum hum jaisay hi aik insan ho . aur hum yeh bhi dekh rahey hain kay sirf woh log tumharay peechay lagay hain jo hum mein sabb say ziyada bey haisiyat hain , aur woh bhi satahi tor per raye qaeem kerkay . aur hamen tum mein koi aesi baat bhi dikhai nahi deti jiss ki wajeh say hum per tumhen koi fazilat hasil ho , balkay humara khayal to yeh hai kay tum sabb jhootay ho

ayahs.text: nooh ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! zara mujhay yeh batao kay agar mein apney perwerdigar ki taraf say aai hoi aik roshan hidayat per qaeem hun , aur uss ney mujhay khaas apney paas say aik rehmat ( yani nabwooat ) ata farmaee hai , phir bhi woh tumhen sujhai nahi dey rahi , to kiya hum uss ko tum per zabardasti musallat kerden jabkay tum ussay napasand kertay ho-?
ayahs.translation: nooh ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! zara mujhay yeh batao kay agar mein apney perwerdigar ki taraf say aai hoi aik roshan hidayat per qaeem hun , aur uss ney mujhay khaas apney paas say aik rehmat ( yani nabwooat ) ata farmaee hai , phir bhi woh tumhen sujhai nahi dey rahi , to kiya hum uss ko tum per zabardasti musallat kerden jabkay tum ussay napasand kertay ho-?

ayahs.text: aur aey meri qoam ! mein iss ( tableegh ) per tum say koi maal nahi maangta . mera ajar Allah kay siwa kissi aur ney zimmay nahi liya . aur jo log emaan laa-chukay hain , mein unn ko dhutkarney wala nahi hun . unn sabb ko apney rab say jaa milna hai . lekin mein to yeh dekh raha hun kay tum aesay log ho jo nadani ki baaten ker rahey ho .
ayahs.translation: aur aey meri qoam ! mein iss ( tableegh ) per tum say koi maal nahi maangta . mera ajar Allah kay siwa kissi aur ney zimmay nahi liya . aur jo log emaan laa-chukay hain , mein unn ko dhutkarney wala nahi hun . unn sabb ko apney rab say jaa milna hai . lekin mein to yeh dekh raha hun kay tum aesay log ho jo nadani ki baaten ker rahey ho .

ayahs.text: aur aey meri qoam ! agar mein inn logon  ko dhutkar dun to kon mujhay Allah ( ki pakar ) say bachaye ga-? kiya tum phir bhi dhiyan nahi do gay-?
ayahs.translation: aur aey meri qoam ! agar mein inn logon  ko dhutkar dun to kon mujhay Allah ( ki pakar ) say bachaye ga-? kiya tum phir bhi dhiyan nahi do gay-?

ayahs.text: aur mein tum say yeh nahi keh raha hun kay meray qabazay mein Allah kay khazaney hain , naa mein ghaib ki sari baaten janta hun , aur naa mein tum say yeh keh raha hun kay mein koi farishta hun .   aur jinn logon  ko tumhari nigahen haqeer samajhti hain , unn kay baaray mein bhi mein yeh nahi keh sakta kay Allah unhen kabhi koi bhalai ata nahi keray ga . unn kay dilon mein jo kuch hai , ussay Allah sabb say ziyada janta hai . agar mein unn kay baaray mein aesi baaten kahun to mera shumar yaqeenan zalimon mein hoga .

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha kay :  aey nooh ! tum hum say behas ker-chukay , aur boht behas ker-chukay . abb agar tum sachay ho to ley aao woh ( azab ) jiss ki dhamki hamen dey rahey ho .

ayahs.text: nooh ney kaha kay :  ussay to Allah hi tumharay paas ley kar aaye ga , agar chahye ga , aur tum ussay bey bus nahi ker-saktay .
ayahs.translation: nooh ney kaha kay :  ussay to Allah hi tumharay paas ley kar aaye ga , agar chahye ga , aur tum ussay bey bus nahi ker-saktay .

ayahs.text: agar mein tumhari khair khuwahi kerna chahaon to meri khair khuwahi uss soorat mein tumharay koi kaam nahi aa-sakti jab Allah hi ney ( tumhari zidd aur hatt dharami ki wajeh say ) tumhen gumrah kernay ka irada kerliya ho . wohi tumhara perwerdigar hai , aur ussi kay paas tumhen wapis ley jaya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: agar mein tumhari khair khuwahi kerna chahaon to meri khair khuwahi uss soorat mein tumharay koi kaam nahi aa-sakti jab Allah hi ney ( tumhari zidd aur hatt dharami ki wajeh say ) tumhen gumrah kernay ka irada kerliya ho . wohi tumhara perwerdigar hai , aur ussi kay paas tumhen wapis ley jaya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya ( arab kay yeh kafir ) log kehtay hain kay Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) ney yeh Quran apni taraf say gharr liya hai ? ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay :  agar mein ney issay gharra hoga to meray jurm ka wabal mujhi per hoga , aur jo jurm tum ker rahey ho , mein uss ka zimma daar nahi hun .
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya ( arab kay yeh kafir ) log kehtay hain kay Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) ney yeh Quran apni taraf say gharr liya hai ? ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay :  agar mein ney issay gharra hoga to meray jurm ka wabal mujhi per hoga , aur jo jurm tum ker rahey ho , mein uss ka zimma daar nahi hun .

ayahs.text: aur nooh kay paas wahi bheji gaee kay :  tumhari qoam mein say jo log abb tak emaan laa-chukay hain , unn kay siwa abb koi aur emaan nahi laye ga . lehaza jo harkaten yeh log kertay rahey hain , tum unn per sadma naa kero .
ayahs.translation: aur nooh kay paas wahi bheji gaee kay :  tumhari qoam mein say jo log abb tak emaan laa-chukay hain , unn kay siwa abb koi aur emaan nahi laye ga . lehaza jo harkaten yeh log kertay rahey hain , tum unn per sadma naa kero .

ayahs.text: aur humari nigrani mein aur humari wahi ki madad say kashti banao ,   aur jo log zalim ban chukay hain , unn kay baaray mein mujh say koi baat naa kerna . yeh abb gharq ho ker rahen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur humari nigrani mein aur humari wahi ki madad say kashti banao ,   aur jo log zalim ban chukay hain , unn kay baaray mein mujh say koi baat naa kerna . yeh abb gharq ho ker rahen gay .

ayahs.text: chunacheh woh kashti bananey lagay . aur jab bhi unn ki qoam kay kuch sardar unn kay paas say guzartay to unn ka mazaq uratay thay .   nooh ney kaha kay :  agar tum hum per hanstay ho to jaisay tum hans rahey ho , ussi tarah hum bhi tum per hanstay hain .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh woh kashti bananey lagay . aur jab bhi unn ki qoam kay kuch sardar unn kay paas say guzartay to unn ka mazaq uratay thay .   nooh ney kaha kay :  agar tum hum per hanstay ho to jaisay tum hans rahey ho , ussi tarah hum bhi tum per hanstay hain .

ayahs.text: unqareeb tumhen pata chal jaye ga kay kiss per woh azab aaraha hai jo ussay ruswa ker kay rakh dey ga , aur kiss per woh qehar nazil honey wala hai jo kabhi tall nahi sakay ga .
ayahs.translation: unqareeb tumhen pata chal jaye ga kay kiss per woh azab aaraha hai jo ussay ruswa ker kay rakh dey ga , aur kiss per woh qehar nazil honey wala hai jo kabhi tall nahi sakay ga .

ayahs.text: yahan tak kay jab humara hukum aagaya , aur tanoor ubal parra ,   to hum ney ( nooh say ) kaha kay :  iss kashti mein her qisam kay janweron mein say do do kay joray sawar kerlo ,   aur tumharay ghar walon mein say jinn kay baaray mein pehlay kaha jaa chuka hai ( kay woh kufr ki wajeh say gharq hon gay ) unn ko chorr ker baqi ghar walon ko bhi , aur jitney log emaan laye hain unn ko bhi ( sath ley lo ) .  aur thoray hi say log thay jo unn kay sath emaan laye thay !
ayahs.translation: yahan tak kay jab humara hukum aagaya , aur tanoor ubal parra ,   to hum ney ( nooh say ) kaha kay :  iss kashti mein her qisam kay janweron mein say do do kay joray sawar kerlo ,   aur tumharay ghar walon mein say jinn kay baaray mein pehlay kaha jaa chuka hai ( kay woh kufr ki wajeh say gharq hon gay ) unn ko chorr ker baqi ghar walon ko bhi , aur jitney log emaan laye hain unn ko bhi ( sath ley lo ) .  aur thoray hi say log thay jo unn kay sath emaan laye thay !

ayahs.text: aur nooh ney ( unn sabb say ) kaha kay :  iss kashti mein sawar hojao , iss ka chalna bhi Allah hi kay naam say hai , aur langar daalna bhi . yaqeen rakho kay mera perwerdigar boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: aur nooh ney ( unn sabb say ) kaha kay :  iss kashti mein sawar hojao , iss ka chalna bhi Allah hi kay naam say hai , aur langar daalna bhi . yaqeen rakho kay mera perwerdigar boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: aur woh kashti paharon jaisi mojon kay darmiyan chali jati thi . aur nooh ney apney uss betay ko jo sabb say alag tha , aawaz di kay :  betay ! humaray sath sawar hojao , aur kafiron kay sath naa raho .
ayahs.translation: aur woh kashti paharon jaisi mojon kay darmiyan chali jati thi . aur nooh ney apney uss betay ko jo sabb say alag tha , aawaz di kay :  betay ! humaray sath sawar hojao , aur kafiron kay sath naa raho .

ayahs.text: woh bola :  mein abhi kissi pahar ki panah ley lun ga jo mujhay paani say bacha ley ga .  nooh ney kaha :  aaj Allah kay hukum say koi kissi ko bachaney wala nahi hai , siwaye uss kay jiss per woh hi reham farmadey .  iss kay baad unn kay darmiyan moaj haeel hogaee , aur doobney walon mein woh bhi shamil huwa .
ayahs.translation: woh bola :  mein abhi kissi pahar ki panah ley lun ga jo mujhay paani say bacha ley ga .  nooh ney kaha :  aaj Allah kay hukum say koi kissi ko bachaney wala nahi hai , siwaye uss kay jiss per woh hi reham farmadey .  iss kay baad unn kay darmiyan moaj haeel hogaee , aur doobney walon mein woh bhi shamil huwa .

ayahs.text: aur hukum huwa kay :  aey zameen ! apna paani nigal ley , aur aey aasman ! thum jaa  chunacheh paani utar gaya , aur sara qissa chuka diya gaya .   kashti jodi pahar per aa-thehri ,   aur keh diya gaya kay :  barbadi hai uss qoam ki jo zalim ho !
ayahs.translation: aur hukum huwa kay :  aey zameen ! apna paani nigal ley , aur aey aasman ! thum jaa  chunacheh paani utar gaya , aur sara qissa chuka diya gaya .   kashti jodi pahar per aa-thehri ,   aur keh diya gaya kay :  barbadi hai uss qoam ki jo zalim ho !

ayahs.text: aur nooh ney apney perwerdigar ko pukara aur kaha kay :  aey meray perwerdigar ! mera beta meray ghar hi ka aik fard hai , aur beyshak tera wada sacha hai , aur tu saray hakimon say barh ker hakim hai !
ayahs.translation: aur nooh ney apney perwerdigar ko pukara aur kaha kay :  aey meray perwerdigar ! mera beta meray ghar hi ka aik fard hai , aur beyshak tera wada sacha hai , aur tu saray hakimon say barh ker hakim hai !

ayahs.text: Allah ney farmaya :  aey nooh ! yaqeen jano woh tumharay ghar walon mein say nahi hai . woh to napak amal ka palanda hai . lehaza mujh say aesi cheez naa maango jiss ki tumhen khabar nahi , mein tumhen naseehat kerta hun kay tum nadanon mein shamil naa ho .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney farmaya :  aey nooh ! yaqeen jano woh tumharay ghar walon mein say nahi hai . woh to napak amal ka palanda hai . lehaza mujh say aesi cheez naa maango jiss ki tumhen khabar nahi , mein tumhen naseehat kerta hun kay tum nadanon mein shamil naa ho .

ayahs.text: nooh ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! mein aap ki panah maangta hun iss baat say kay aaenda aap say woh cheez maangun jiss ka mujhay ilm nahi . aur agar aap ney meri maghfirat naa farmaee aur mujh per reham naa kiya to mein bhi unn logon  mein shamil hojaon ga jo barbad hogaye hain .
ayahs.translation: nooh ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! mein aap ki panah maangta hun iss baat say kay aaenda aap say woh cheez maangun jiss ka mujhay ilm nahi . aur agar aap ney meri maghfirat naa farmaee aur mujh per reham naa kiya to mein bhi unn logon  mein shamil hojaon ga jo barbad hogaye hain .

ayahs.text: farmaya gaya kay :  aey nooh ! abb ( kashti say ) utar jao , humari taraf say woh salamti aur barkaten ley ker jo tumharay liye bhi hain aur tumharay sath jitni qoamen hain , unn kay liye bhi ! aur kuch qoamen aesi hain jinn ko hum ( duniya mein ) lutf uthaney ka moaqa den gay , phir unn ko humari taraf say aik dardnak azab aa-pakray ga .
ayahs.translation: farmaya gaya kay :  aey nooh ! abb ( kashti say ) utar jao , humari taraf say woh salamti aur barkaten ley ker jo tumharay liye bhi hain aur tumharay sath jitni qoamen hain , unn kay liye bhi ! aur kuch qoamen aesi hain jinn ko hum ( duniya mein ) lutf uthaney ka moaqa den gay , phir unn ko humari taraf say aik dardnak azab aa-pakray ga .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh ghaib ki kuch baaten hain jo hum tumhen wahi kay zariye bata rahey hain . yeh baaten naa tum iss say pehlay jantay thay , naa tumhari qoam . lehaza sabar say kaam lo aur aakhri anjam muttaqiyo hi kay haq mein hoga .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh ghaib ki kuch baaten hain jo hum tumhen wahi kay zariye bata rahey hain . yeh baaten naa tum iss say pehlay jantay thay , naa tumhari qoam . lehaza sabar say kaam lo aur aakhri anjam muttaqiyo hi kay haq mein hoga .

ayahs.text: aur qoam-e-aad kay paas hum ney unn kay bhai Hood ko payghumber bana ker bheja .   unhon ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! Allah ki ibadat kero . uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi hai . tumhari haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay tum ney jhooti baaten tarash rakhi hain .
ayahs.translation: aur qoam-e-aad kay paas hum ney unn kay bhai Hood ko payghumber bana ker bheja .   unhon ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! Allah ki ibadat kero . uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi hai . tumhari haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay tum ney jhooti baaten tarash rakhi hain .

ayahs.text: aey meri qoam ! mein tum say iss ( tableegh ) per koi ujrat nahi maangta . mera ajar kissi aur ney nahi , uss zaat ney apney zimmay liya hai jiss ney mujhay peda kiya hai . kiya phir bhi tum aqal say kaam nahi letay-?
ayahs.translation: aey meri qoam ! mein tum say iss ( tableegh ) per koi ujrat nahi maangta . mera ajar kissi aur ney nahi , uss zaat ney apney zimmay liya hai jiss ney mujhay peda kiya hai . kiya phir bhi tum aqal say kaam nahi letay-?

ayahs.text: aey meri qoam ! apney perwerdigar say gunahon ki moaafi maango , phir uss ki taraf rujoo kero , woh tum per aasman say moosladhaar barishen barsaye ga ,   aur tumhari mojooda quooat mein mazeed quooat ka izafa keray ga , aur mujrim ban ker mun naa morro .
ayahs.translation: aey meri qoam ! apney perwerdigar say gunahon ki moaafi maango , phir uss ki taraf rujoo kero , woh tum per aasman say moosladhaar barishen barsaye ga ,   aur tumhari mojooda quooat mein mazeed quooat ka izafa keray ga , aur mujrim ban ker mun naa morro .

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha :  aey Hood ! tum humaray paas koi roshan daleel ley ker nahi aaye ,   aur hum apney khudaon ko sirf tumharay kehney say chorney walay nahi hain , aur naa hum tumhari baat per emaan laasaktay hain .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha :  aey Hood ! tum humaray paas koi roshan daleel ley ker nahi aaye ,   aur hum apney khudaon ko sirf tumharay kehney say chorney walay nahi hain , aur naa hum tumhari baat per emaan laasaktay hain .

ayahs.text: hum to iss kay siwa kuch aur nahi keh saktay kay humaray khudaon mein say kissi ney tumhen buri tarah jhapetay mein ley liya hai .    Hood ney kaha :  mein Allah ko gawah banata hun , aur tum bhi gawah raho kay tum Allah kay siwa jiss jiss ko uss ki khudai mein shareek mantay ho , mein uss say bari hun .
ayahs.translation: hum to iss kay siwa kuch aur nahi keh saktay kay humaray khudaon mein say kissi ney tumhen buri tarah jhapetay mein ley liya hai . ayahs.text: abb tum sabb kay sabb milker meray khilaf chaalen chal lo , aur mujhay zara mohlat naa do .
ayahs.translation: abb tum sabb kay sabb milker meray khilaf chaalen chal lo , aur mujhay zara mohlat naa do .

ayahs.text: mein ney to Allah per bharosa ker rakha hai , jo mera bhi perwerdigar hai , aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar . zameen per chalney wala koi jandaar aisa nahi jiss ki choti uss kay qabazay mein naa ho . yaqeenan mera perwerdigar seedhay raastay per hai .

ayahs.text: phir bhi agar tum mun morrtay ho , to jo paygham dey ker mujhay tumharay paas bheja gaya tha , mein ney woh tumhen phoncha diya hai . aur ( tumharay kufr ki wajeh say ) mera perwerdigar tumhari jagah kissi aur qoam ko yahan basa dey ga , aur tum uss ka kuch naa bigaar sako gay . beyshak mera perwerdigar her cheez ki nigrani kerta hai .

ayahs.text: yeh thay aad kay log jinhon ney apney perwerdigar ki nishaniyon ka inkar kiya , aur uss kay payghumberon ki nafarmani ki , aur her aesay shaks ka hukum maana jo perlay darjay ka jabir aur haq ka paka dushman tha !
