verses.text: kay  tum ney ( duniya mein ) jo sabar say kaam liya tha , uss ki badolat abb tum per salamti hi salamti nazil hogi , aur ( tumharay ) asli watan mein yeh tumhara behtareen anjam hai !
verses.translation: kay  tum ney ( duniya mein ) jo sabar say kaam liya tha , uss ki badolat abb tum per salamti hi salamti nazil hogi , aur ( tumharay ) asli watan mein yeh tumhara behtareen anjam hai !

verses.text: aur ( doosri taraf ) jo log Allah say kiye huye ehad ko mazbooti say baandhney kay baad torrtey hain , aur jinn rishton ko Allah ney jooray rakhney ka hukum diya hai ,unhen kaat daaltay hain , aur zameen mein fasad machatay hain , to aesay logon  kay hissay mein lanat aati hai , aur asli watan mein bura anjam inhi ka hai .
verses.translation: aur ( doosri taraf ) jo log Allah say kiye huye ehad ko mazbooti say baandhney kay baad torrtey hain , aur jinn rishton ko Allah ney jooray rakhney ka hukum diya hai ,unhen kaat daaltay hain , aur zameen mein fasad machatay hain , to aesay logon  kay hissay mein lanat aati hai , aur asli watan mein bura anjam inhi ka hai .

verses.text: Allah jiss kay liye chahta hai , rizq mein wusat ker deta hai , aur ( jiss kay liye chahta hai ) tangi ker deta hai .   yeh ( kafir ) log dunyawi zindagi per magan hain , halankay aakhirat kay muqablay mein dunyawi zindagi ki haisiyat uss say ziyada nahi kay woh mamooli si poonji hai .
verses.translation: Allah jiss kay liye chahta hai , rizq mein wusat ker deta hai , aur ( jiss kay liye chahta hai ) tangi ker deta hai .   yeh ( kafir ) log dunyawi zindagi per magan hain , halankay aakhirat kay muqablay mein dunyawi zindagi ki haisiyat uss say ziyada nahi kay woh mamooli si poonji hai .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh yeh kehtay hain kay inn per ( yani Muhammad SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam per ) inn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say koi nishani kiyon nahi utaari gaee-?   keh do kay :  Allah jiss ko chahta hai , gumrah ker deta hai , aur apney raastay per unhi ko lata hai jo uss ki taraf rujoo keren .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh yeh kehtay hain kay inn per ( yani Muhammad SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam per ) inn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say koi nishani kiyon nahi utaari gaee-?   keh do kay :  Allah jiss ko chahta hai , gumrah ker deta hai , aur apney raastay per unhi ko lata hai jo uss ki taraf rujoo keren .

verses.text: yeh woh log hain jo emaan laye hain , aur jinn kay dil Allah kay ziker say itminan hasil kertay hain . yaad rakho kay sirf Allah ka ziker hi woh cheez hai jiss say dilon ko itminan naseeb hota hai .
verses.translation: yeh woh log hain jo emaan laye hain , aur jinn kay dil Allah kay ziker say itminan hasil kertay hain . yaad rakho kay sirf Allah ka ziker hi woh cheez hai jiss say dilon ko itminan naseeb hota hai .

verses.text: . ( gharz ) jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn kay hissay mein khush haali bhi hai , aur behtareen anjam bhi .
verses.translation: . ( gharz ) jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn kay hissay mein khush haali bhi hai , aur behtareen anjam bhi .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! jiss tarah doosray Rasool bhejay gaye thay ) issi tarah hum ney tumhen aik aesi ummat mein Rasool bana ker bheja hai jiss say pehli boht si ummaten guzar chuki hain , takay tum inn kay samney woh kitab parh ker suna do jo hum ney wahi kay zariye tum per nazil ki hai , aur yeh log uss zaat ki nashukri ker rahey hain jo sabb per meharban hai . keh do kay :  woh mera paalney wala hai , uss kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi hai . ussi per mein ney bharosa ker rakha hai , aur ussi ki taraf mujhay loat ker jana hai .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! jiss tarah doosray Rasool bhejay gaye thay ) issi tarah hum ney tumhen aik aesi ummat mein Rasool bana ker bheja hai jiss say pehli boht si ummaten guzar chuki hain , takay tum inn kay samney woh kitab parh ker suna do jo hum ney wahi kay zariye tum per nazil ki hai , aur yeh log uss zaat ki nashukri ker rahey hain jo sabb per meharban hai . keh do kay :  woh mera paalney wala hai , uss kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi hai . ussi per mein ney bharosa ker rakha hai , aur ussi ki taraf mujhay loat ker jana hai .

verses.text: aur agar koi Quran aisa bhi utarta jiss kay zariye pahar apni jagah say hata diye jatay , ya uss ki badolat zameen shaqq kerdi jati ( aur uss say darya nikal parrtay ) ya uss kay nateejay mein murdon say baat kerli jati , ( tab bhi yeh log emaan naa latay ) .   haqeeqat to yeh hai kay tamam tarr ikhtiyar Allah ka hai . kiya phir bhi emaan walon ney yeh soch ker apna zehan farigh nahi kiya kay agar Allah chahta to saray hi insanon ko ( zabardasti ) raah per ley aata?   aur jinhon ney kufr apnaya hai , unn per to unn kay kartoot ki wajeh say hamesha koi naa koi kharr-kharaney wali museebat parrti rehti hai , ya unn ki basti kay qareeb kahen nazil hoti rehti hai , yahan tak kay ( aik din ) Allah ney jo wada ker rakha hai , woh aa-ker poora hojaye ga .   yaqeen rakho kay Allah waday ki khilaf warzi nahi kerta .
verses.translation: aur agar koi Quran aisa bhi utarta jiss kay zariye pahar apni jagah say hata diye jatay , ya uss ki badolat zameen shaqq kerdi jati ( aur uss say darya nikal parrtay ) ya uss kay nateejay mein murdon say baat kerli jati , ( tab bhi yeh log emaan naa latay ) .   haqeeqat to yeh hai kay tamam tarr ikhtiyar Allah ka hai . kiya phir bhi emaan walon ney yeh soch ker apna zehan farigh nahi kiya kay agar Allah chahta to saray hi insanon ko ( zabardasti ) raah per ley aata?   aur jinhon ney kufr apnaya hai , unn per to unn kay kartoot ki wajeh say hamesha koi naa koi kharr-kharaney wali museebat parrti rehti hai , ya unn ki basti kay qareeb kahen nazil hoti rehti hai , yahan tak kay ( aik din ) Allah ney jo wada ker rakha hai , woh aa-ker poora hojaye ga .   yaqeen rakho kay Allah waday ki khilaf warzi nahi kerta .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum say pehlay payghumberon ka bhi mazaq uraya gaya tha , aur aesay kafiron ko bhi mein ney mohlat di thi , magar kuch waqt kay baad mein ney unn ko girift mein ley liya , abb dekh lo kay mera azab kaisa tha-?
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum say pehlay payghumberon ka bhi mazaq uraya gaya tha , aur aesay kafiron ko bhi mein ney mohlat di thi , magar kuch waqt kay baad mein ney unn ko girift mein ley liya , abb dekh lo kay mera azab kaisa tha-?

verses.text: bhala batao kay aik taraf woh zaat hai jo her her shaks kay her her kaam ki nigrani ker rahi hai , aur doosri taraf inn logon  ney Allah kay sath shareek maaney huye hain-?   kaho kay :  zara unn ( khuda  kay shareekon ) kay naam to batao ( agar koi naam lo gay ) to kiya Allah ko kissi aesay wajood ki khabar do gay jiss ka duniya bhar mein Allah ko bhi pata nahi hai ? ya khaali zaban say aesay naam ley lo gay jinn kay peechay koi haqeeqat nahi-?    haqeeqat to yeh hai kay inn kafiron ko apni makkaraana baaten bari khoobsurat lagti hain , aur ( iss tarah ) inn ki hidayat kay raastay mein rukawat peda hogaee hai . aur jissay Allah gumrahi mein parra rehney dey , ussay koi raah per laney wala moyassar nahi aa-sakta .

verses.text: aesay logon  kay liye dunyawi zindagi mein bhi azab hai , aur yaqeenan aakhirat ka azab kahen ziyada bhari hoga , aur koi nahi hai jo enhen Allah ( kay azab ) say bacha sakay .
verses.translation: aesay logon  kay liye dunyawi zindagi mein bhi azab hai , aur yaqeenan aakhirat ka azab kahen ziyada bhari hoga , aur koi nahi hai jo enhen Allah ( kay azab ) say bacha sakay .

verses.text: . ( doosri taraf ) woh jannat jiss ka muttaqi logon  say wada kiya gaya hai , uss ka haal yeh hai kay uss kay neechay nehren behti hain ,uss kay phal bhi sada bahar hain , aur uss ki chaon bhi ! yeh anjam hai unn logon  ka jinhon ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya , jabkay kafiron ka anjam dozakh ki aag hai .
verses.translation: . ( doosri taraf ) woh jannat jiss ka muttaqi logon  say wada kiya gaya hai , uss ka haal yeh hai kay uss kay neechay nehren behti hain ,uss kay phal bhi sada bahar hain , aur uss ki chaon bhi ! yeh anjam hai unn logon  ka jinhon ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya , jabkay kafiron ka anjam dozakh ki aag hai .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jinn logon  ko hum ney kitab di hai , woh iss kalam say khush hotay hain jo tum per nazil kiya gaya hai . aur unhi girohon mein woh bhi hain jo iss ki baaz baaton ko manney say inkar kertay hain .   keh do kay :  mujhay to yeh hukum diya gaya hai kay mein Allah ki ibadat kerun , aur uss kay sath kissi ko khudai mein shareek naa maanun , issi baat ki mein dawat deta hun , aur ussi ( Allah ) ki taraf mujhay loat ker jana hai .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jinn logon  ko hum ney kitab di hai , woh iss kalam say khush hotay hain jo tum per nazil kiya gaya hai . aur unhi girohon mein woh bhi hain jo iss ki baaz baaton ko manney say inkar kertay hain .   keh do kay :  mujhay to yeh hukum diya gaya hai kay mein Allah ki ibadat kerun , aur uss kay sath kissi ko khudai mein shareek naa maanun , issi baat ki mein dawat deta hun , aur ussi ( Allah ) ki taraf mujhay loat ker jana hai .

verses.text: aur issi tarah hum ney iss ( Quran ) ko arbi zaban mein aik hukum nama bana ker nazil kiya hai .   aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tumharay paas jo ilm aa-chuka hai , agar uss kay baad bhi tum inn logon  ki khuwaishaat kay peechay chalay to Allah kay muqablay mein naa tumhara koi madadgaar hoga , naa koi bachaney wala .
verses.translation: aur issi tarah hum ney iss ( Quran ) ko arbi zaban mein aik hukum nama bana ker nazil kiya hai .   aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tumharay paas jo ilm aa-chuka hai , agar uss kay baad bhi tum inn logon  ki khuwaishaat kay peechay chalay to Allah kay muqablay mein naa tumhara koi madadgaar hoga , naa koi bachaney wala .

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney tum say pehlay bhi boht say Rasool bhejay hain , aur unhen biwi bacchay bhi ata farmaye hain , aur kissi Rasool ko yeh ikhtiyar nahi tha kay woh koi aik aayat bhi Allah kay hukum kay baghair lasakay . her zamaney kay liye alag kitab di gaee hai .
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney tum say pehlay bhi boht say Rasool bhejay hain , aur unhen biwi bacchay bhi ata farmaye hain , aur kissi Rasool ko yeh ikhtiyar nahi tha kay woh koi aik aayat bhi Allah kay hukum kay baghair lasakay . her zamaney kay liye alag kitab di gaee hai .

verses.text: Allah jiss ( hukum ) ko chahta hai , mansookh ker deta hai , aur ( jiss ko chahta hai ) baqi rakhta hai . aur tamam kitabon ki jo asal hai , woh ussi kay paas hai .
verses.translation: Allah jiss ( hukum ) ko chahta hai , mansookh ker deta hai , aur ( jiss ko chahta hai ) baqi rakhta hai . aur tamam kitabon ki jo asal hai , woh ussi kay paas hai .

verses.text: aur jiss baat ki dhamki hum inn ( kafiron ) ko detay hain , chahye uss ka koi hissa hum tumhen ( tumhari zindagi hi mein ) dikha den , ya ( uss say pehlay hi ) tumhen duniya say utha len , baharhal tumharay zimmay to sirf paygham phoncha dena hai , aur hisab lenay ki zimma daari humari hai .
verses.translation: aur jiss baat ki dhamki hum inn ( kafiron ) ko detay hain , chahye uss ka koi hissa hum tumhen ( tumhari zindagi hi mein ) dikha den , ya ( uss say pehlay hi ) tumhen duniya say utha len , baharhal tumharay zimmay to sirf paygham phoncha dena hai , aur hisab lenay ki zimma daari humari hai .

verses.text: kiya inn logon  ko yeh haqeeqat nazar nahi aai kay hum inn ki zameen ko chaaron taraf say ghatatay chalay aarahey hain-?   her hukum Allah deta hai . koi nahi hai jo uss kay hukum ko torr sakay , aur woh jald hisab lenay wala hai .
verses.translation: kiya inn logon  ko yeh haqeeqat nazar nahi aai kay hum inn ki zameen ko chaaron taraf say ghatatay chalay aarahey hain-?   her hukum Allah deta hai . koi nahi hai jo uss kay hukum ko torr sakay , aur woh jald hisab lenay wala hai .

verses.text: jo log inn say pehlay guzray hain , chaalen unhon ney bhi chali then , lekin chaal to tamam tarr Allah hi ki chalti hai . koi bhi shaks jo kuch kerta hai , sabb ussay maloom hai , aur kafiron ko unqareeb pata lagg jaye ga kay asli watan ka naik anjam kiss kay hissay mein aata hai .

ayahs.text: Alif-Laam-Meem-Raa .   yeh ( Allah ki ) kitab ki aayaten hain , aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jo kuch tum per tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say nazil kiya gaya hai , bar-haq hai , lekin aksar log emaan nahi laarahey .
ayahs.translation: Alif-Laam-Meem-Raa .   yeh ( Allah ki ) kitab ki aayaten hain , aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jo kuch tum per tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say nazil kiya gaya hai , bar-haq hai , lekin aksar log emaan nahi laarahey .

ayahs.text: Allah woh hai jiss ney aesay sutonon kay baghair aasmano ko buland kiya jo tumhen nazar aa-saken ,   phir uss ney arsh per istawa farmaya ,   aur sooraj aur chaand ko kaam per laga diya .   her cheez aik moyyan miyaad tak kay liye rawan dawan hai . wohi tamam kamon ki tadbeer kerta hai . wohi inn nishaniyon ko khol khol ker biyan kerta hai , takay tum iss baat ka yaqeen kerlo kay ( aik din ) tumhen apney perwerdigar say jaa milna hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah woh hai jiss ney aesay sutonon kay baghair aasmano ko buland kiya jo tumhen nazar aa-saken ,   phir uss ney arsh per istawa farmaya ,   aur sooraj aur chaand ko kaam per laga diya .   her cheez aik moyyan miyaad tak kay liye rawan dawan hai . wohi tamam kamon ki tadbeer kerta hai . wohi inn nishaniyon ko khol khol ker biyan kerta hai , takay tum iss baat ka yaqeen kerlo kay ( aik din ) tumhen apney perwerdigar say jaa milna hai .

ayahs.text: aur wohi zaat hai jiss ney yeh zameen phelai , uss mein pahar aur darya banaye , aur uss mein her qisam kay phalon kay do do jooray peda kiye .   woh din ko raat ki chadar urrha deta hai . haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn sari baaton mein unn logon  kay liye nishaniyan hain jo ghor-o-fiker keren .
ayahs.translation: aur wohi zaat hai jiss ney yeh zameen phelai , uss mein pahar aur darya banaye , aur uss mein her qisam kay phalon kay do do jooray peda kiye .   woh din ko raat ki chadar urrha deta hai . haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn sari baaton mein unn logon  kay liye nishaniyan hain jo ghor-o-fiker keren .

ayahs.text: aur zameen mein mukhtalif qatey hain jo paas paas waqaey huye hain ,   aur angoor kay baagh aur khetiyan aur khujoor kay darkht hain , jinn mein say kuch dohray taney walay hain , aur kuch ikehray taney walay . sabb aik hi paani say sairaab hotay hain , aur hum unn mein say kissi ko zaeeqay mein doosray per foqiyat dey detay hain .   yaqeenan inn sabb baaton mein unn logon  kay liye nishaniyan hain jo aqal say kaam len .
ayahs.translation: aur zameen mein mukhtalif qatey hain jo paas paas waqaey huye hain ,   aur angoor kay baagh aur khetiyan aur khujoor kay darkht hain , jinn mein say kuch dohray taney walay hain , aur kuch ikehray taney walay . sabb aik hi paani say sairaab hotay hain , aur hum unn mein say kissi ko zaeeqay mein doosray per foqiyat dey detay hain .   yaqeenan inn sabb baaton mein unn logon  kay liye nishaniyan hain jo aqal say kaam len .

ayahs.text: aur agar tumhen ( inn kafiron per ) taajjub hota hai to inn ka yeh kehna ( waqaee ) ajeeb hai kay : kiya jab hum mitti hojayen gay to kiya sach mooch hum naye siray say peda hon gay ?    yeh woh log hain jinhon ney apney rab ( ki qudrat ) ka inkar kiya hai , aur yehi woh log hain jinn kay galon mein toq parray huye hain ,   aur woh dozakh kay baasi hain . woh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur agar tumhen ( inn kafiron per ) taajjub hota hai to inn ka yeh kehna ( waqaee ) ajeeb hai kay : kiya jab hum mitti hojayen gay to kiya sach mooch hum naye siray say peda hon gay ?    yeh woh log hain jinhon ney apney rab ( ki qudrat ) ka inkar kiya hai , aur yehi woh log hain jinn kay galon mein toq parray huye hain ,   aur woh dozakh kay baasi hain . woh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .

ayahs.text: aur yeh log khushhali ( ki miyaad khatam honey ) say pehlay tum say bad-haali ki jaldi machaye huye hain ,   halankay inn say pehlay aesay azab kay waqiyaat guzar chukay hain jiss ney logon  ko ruswa ker daala tha . aur yeh haqeeqat hai kay logon  kay liye unn ki ziyadti kay bawajood tumharay rab ki zaat aik moaaf kernay wali zaat hai , aur yeh bhi haqeeqat hai kay uss ka azab bara sakht hai .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh log khushhali ( ki miyaad khatam honey ) say pehlay tum say bad-haali ki jaldi machaye huye hain ,   halankay inn say pehlay aesay azab kay waqiyaat guzar chukay hain jiss ney logon  ko ruswa ker daala tha . aur yeh haqeeqat hai kay logon  kay liye unn ki ziyadti kay bawajood tumharay rab ki zaat aik moaaf kernay wali zaat hai , aur yeh bhi haqeeqat hai kay uss ka azab bara sakht hai .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai woh kehtay hain kay :  bhala inn per ( yani aan-Hazrat SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam per ) inn kay rab ki taraf say koi moajza kiyon nahi utaara gaya-?    ( aey payghumber ! ) baat yeh hai kay tum to sirf khatray say hoshiyar kernay walay ho , aur her qoam kay liye koi naa koi aisa shaks huwa hai jo hidayat ka raasta dikhaye .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai woh kehtay hain kay :  bhala inn per ( yani aan-Hazrat SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam per ) inn kay rab ki taraf say koi moajza kiyon nahi utaara gaya-?    ( aey payghumber ! ) baat yeh hai kay tum to sirf khatray say hoshiyar kernay walay ho , aur her qoam kay liye koi naa koi aisa shaks huwa hai jo hidayat ka raasta dikhaye .

ayahs.text: jiss kissi mada ko jo hamal hota hai , Allah uss ko bhi janta hai , aur maon kay reham mein jo koi kami beshi hoti hai , uss ko bhi .   aur her cheez ka uss kay haan aik andaza muqarrar hai .
ayahs.translation: jiss kissi mada ko jo hamal hota hai , Allah uss ko bhi janta hai , aur maon kay reham mein jo koi kami beshi hoti hai , uss ko bhi .   aur her cheez ka uss kay haan aik andaza muqarrar hai .

ayahs.text: woh ghaeeb o hazir tamam baaton ka janney wala hai , uss ki zaat boht bari hai , uss ki shaan boht oonchi .
ayahs.translation: woh ghaeeb o hazir tamam baaton ka janney wala hai , uss ki zaat boht bari hai , uss ki shaan boht oonchi .

ayahs.text: tum mein say koi chupkay say baat keray ya zor say , koi raat kay waqt chupa huwa ho , ya din kay waqt chal phir raha ho , woh sabb ( Allah kay ilm kay lehaz say ) barabar hain .
ayahs.translation: tum mein say koi chupkay say baat keray ya zor say , koi raat kay waqt chupa huwa ho , ya din kay waqt chal phir raha ho , woh sabb ( Allah kay ilm kay lehaz say ) barabar hain .

ayahs.text: her shaks kay aagay aur peechay woh nigran ( farishtay ) muqarrar hain jo Allah kay hukum say baari baari uss ki hifazat kertay hain .   yaqeen jano kay Allah kissi qoam ki halat uss waqt tak nahi badlta jab tak woh khud apney halaat mein tabdeeli naa ley aaye .   aur jab Allah kissi qoam per koi aafat laney ka irada kerleta hai to uss ka taalna mumkin nahi , aur aesay logon  ka khud uss kay siwa koi rakhwala nahi hosakta .
ayahs.translation: her shaks kay aagay aur peechay woh nigran ( farishtay ) muqarrar hain jo Allah kay hukum say baari baari uss ki hifazat kertay hain .   yaqeen jano kay Allah kissi qoam ki halat uss waqt tak nahi badlta jab tak woh khud apney halaat mein tabdeeli naa ley aaye .   aur jab Allah kissi qoam per koi aafat laney ka irada kerleta hai to uss ka taalna mumkin nahi , aur aesay logon  ka khud uss kay siwa koi rakhwala nahi hosakta .

ayahs.text: wohi hai jo tumhen bijli ki chamak dikhlata hai jiss say tumhen ( uss kay girney ka ) darr bhi lagta hai , aur ( barish ki ) umeed bhi bandhti hai , aur wohi ( paani say ) laday huye badal uthata hai .
ayahs.translation: wohi hai jo tumhen bijli ki chamak dikhlata hai jiss say tumhen ( uss kay girney ka ) darr bhi lagta hai , aur ( barish ki ) umeed bhi bandhti hai , aur wohi ( paani say ) laday huye badal uthata hai .

ayahs.text: aur badalon ki garaj ussi ki tasbeeh aur hamd kerti hai ,   aur uss kay roab say farishtay bhi ( tasbeeh mein lagay huye hain ) aur wohi karrakti hoi bijliyan bhejta hai , phir jiss per chahta hai unhen museebat bana ker gira deta hai . aur inn ( kafiron ) ka haal yeh hai kay Allah hi kay baaray mein behasen ker rahey hain , halankay uss ki taqat bari zabardast hai .
ayahs.translation: aur badalon ki garaj ussi ki tasbeeh aur hamd kerti hai ,   aur uss kay roab say farishtay bhi ( tasbeeh mein lagay huye hain ) aur wohi karrakti hoi bijliyan bhejta hai , phir jiss per chahta hai unhen museebat bana ker gira deta hai . aur inn ( kafiron ) ka haal yeh hai kay Allah hi kay baaray mein behasen ker rahey hain , halankay uss ki taqat bari zabardast hai .

ayahs.text: wohi hai jiss say dua kerna bar-haq hai . aur uss ko chorr ker yeh log jinn ( deotaon ) ko pukartay hain , woh unn ki duaon ka koi jawab nahi detay , albatta unn ki misal uss shaks ki si hai jo paani ki taraf apney dono haath phela ker yeh chahye kay paani khud uss kay mun tak phonch jaye , halankay woh kabhi khud mun tak nahi phonch sakta . aur ( button say ) kafiron kay dua kernay ka nateeja iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay woh bhatakti hi phirti rahey .
ayahs.translation: wohi hai jiss say dua kerna bar-haq hai . aur uss ko chorr ker yeh log jinn ( deotaon ) ko pukartay hain , woh unn ki duaon ka koi jawab nahi detay , albatta unn ki misal uss shaks ki si hai jo paani ki taraf apney dono haath phela ker yeh chahye kay paani khud uss kay mun tak phonch jaye , halankay woh kabhi khud mun tak nahi phonch sakta . aur ( button say ) kafiron kay dua kernay ka nateeja iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay woh bhatakti hi phirti rahey .

ayahs.text: aur woh Allah hi hai jiss ko aasmano aur zameen ki sari makhlooqaat sajda kerti hain , kuch khushi say , kuch majboori say ,   aur unn kay saye bhi subha o shaam uss kay aagay sajda rez hotay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur woh Allah hi hai jiss ko aasmano aur zameen ki sari makhlooqaat sajda kerti hain , kuch khushi say , kuch majboori say ,   aur unn kay saye bhi subha o shaam uss kay aagay sajda rez hotay hain .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn kafiron say ) kaho kay :  woh kon hai jo aasmano aur zameen ki perwerish kerta hai-?  kaho kay :  woh Allah hai !  kaho kay :  kiya phir bhi tum ney uss ko chorr ker aesay kaarsaz bana liye hain jinhen khud apney aap ko bhi naa koi faeeda phonchaney ki qudrat hasil hai naa nuqsan phonchaney ki ?  kaho kay :  kiya andha aur dekhney wala barabar hosakta hai-? ya kiya andheriyan aur roshni aik jaisi hosakti hain-?  ya inn logon  ney Allah kay aesay shareek maaney huye hain jinhon ney koi cheez ussi tarah peda ki ho jaisay Allah peda kerta hai ,   aur iss wajeh say inn ko dono ki takhleeq aik jaisi maloom horahi ho-? ( agar koi uss ghalat fehmi mein mubtala hai to iss say ) keh do kay :  sirf Allah her cheez ka khaliq hai , aur woh tanha hi aisa hai kay uss ka iqtidar sabb per hawi hai .

ayahs.text: ussi ney aasman say paani barsaya jiss say nadi naalay apni apni bisaat kay mutabiq beh parray , phir paani kay relay ney phoolay huye jhaag ko oopper utha liya . aur issi qisam ka jhaag uss waqt bhi uthta hai jab log zewar ya bartan bananey kay liye dhaaton ko aag per tapatey hain . Allah haq aur batil ki misal issi tarah biyan ker raha hai kay ( dono qisam ka ) jo jhaag hota hai , woh to bahir gir ker zaya hojata hai , lekin woh cheez jo logon  kay liye faeeda mand hoti hai , woh zameen mein thehar jati hai .   issi qisam ki tamseelen hain jo Allah biyan kerta hai .
ayahs.translation: ussi ney aasman say paani barsaya jiss say nadi naalay apni apni bisaat kay mutabiq beh parray , phir paani kay relay ney phoolay huye jhaag ko oopper utha liya . aur issi qisam ka jhaag uss waqt bhi uthta hai jab log zewar ya bartan bananey kay liye dhaaton ko aag per tapatey hain . Allah haq aur batil ki misal issi tarah biyan ker raha hai kay ( dono qisam ka ) jo jhaag hota hai , woh to bahir gir ker zaya hojata hai , lekin woh cheez jo logon  kay liye faeeda mand hoti hai , woh zameen mein thehar jati hai .   issi qisam ki tamseelen hain jo Allah biyan kerta hai .

ayahs.text: bhalai unhi logon  kay hissay mein hai jinhon ney apney rab ka kehna maana hai , aur jinhon ney uss ka kehna nahi maana , agar unn kay paas duniya bhar ki sari cheezen bhi hon gi , balkay itni hi aur bhi , to woh ( qayamat kay din ) apni jaan bachaney kay liye woh sabb kuch denay ko tayyar hojayen gay . inn logon  kay hissay mein buri tarah ka hisab hai , aur inn ka thikana jahannum hai , aur woh boht bura thikana hai .
ayahs.translation: bhalai unhi logon  kay hissay mein hai jinhon ney apney rab ka kehna maana hai , aur jinhon ney uss ka kehna nahi maana , agar unn kay paas duniya bhar ki sari cheezen bhi hon gi , balkay itni hi aur bhi , to woh ( qayamat kay din ) apni jaan bachaney kay liye woh sabb kuch denay ko tayyar hojayen gay . inn logon  kay hissay mein buri tarah ka hisab hai , aur inn ka thikana jahannum hai , aur woh boht bura thikana hai .

ayahs.text: jo shaks yeh yaqeen rakhta ho kay tum per tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say jo kuch nazil huwa hai , bar-haq hai , bhala woh uss jaisa kaisay hosakta hai jo bilkul andha ho-? haqeeqat yeh hai kay naseehat to wohi log qubool kertay hain jo aqal o hosh rakhtay hon ,

ayahs.text: yani hamesha rehney kay liye woh baaghaat jinn mein woh khud bhi dakhil hon gay , aur unn kay baap dadon , biwiyon aur aulad mein say jo naik hon gay , woh bhi . aur ( unn kay istaqbal kay liye ) farishtay unn kay paas her darwazay say ( yeh kehtay huye ) dakhil hon gay
ayahs.translation: yani hamesha rehney kay liye woh baaghaat jinn mein woh khud bhi dakhil hon gay , aur unn kay baap dadon , biwiyon aur aulad mein say jo naik hon gay , woh bhi . aur ( unn kay istaqbal kay liye ) farishtay unn kay paas her darwazay say ( yeh kehtay huye ) dakhil hon gay

ayahs.text: kay  tum ney ( duniya mein ) jo sabar say kaam liya tha , uss ki badolat abb tum per salamti hi salamti nazil hogi , aur ( tumharay ) asli watan mein yeh tumhara behtareen anjam hai !
ayahs.translation: kay  tum ney ( duniya mein ) jo sabar say kaam liya tha , uss ki badolat abb tum per salamti hi salamti nazil hogi , aur ( tumharay ) asli watan mein yeh tumhara behtareen anjam hai !

ayahs.text: aur ( doosri taraf ) jo log Allah say kiye huye ehad ko mazbooti say baandhney kay baad torrtey hain , aur jinn rishton ko Allah ney jooray rakhney ka hukum diya hai ,unhen kaat daaltay hain , aur zameen mein fasad machatay hain , to aesay logon  kay hissay mein lanat aati hai , aur asli watan mein bura anjam inhi ka hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( doosri taraf ) jo log Allah say kiye huye ehad ko mazbooti say baandhney kay baad torrtey hain , aur jinn rishton ko Allah ney jooray rakhney ka hukum diya hai ,unhen kaat daaltay hain , aur zameen mein fasad machatay hain , to aesay logon  kay hissay mein lanat aati hai , aur asli watan mein bura anjam inhi ka hai .

ayahs.text: Allah jiss kay liye chahta hai , rizq mein wusat ker deta hai , aur ( jiss kay liye chahta hai ) tangi ker deta hai .   yeh ( kafir ) log dunyawi zindagi per magan hain , halankay aakhirat kay muqablay mein dunyawi zindagi ki haisiyat uss say ziyada nahi kay woh mamooli si poonji hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah jiss kay liye chahta hai , rizq mein wusat ker deta hai , aur ( jiss kay liye chahta hai ) tangi ker deta hai .   yeh ( kafir ) log dunyawi zindagi per magan hain , halankay aakhirat kay muqablay mein dunyawi zindagi ki haisiyat uss say ziyada nahi kay woh mamooli si poonji hai .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh yeh kehtay hain kay inn per ( yani Muhammad SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam per ) inn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say koi nishani kiyon nahi utaari gaee-?   keh do kay :  Allah jiss ko chahta hai , gumrah ker deta hai , aur apney raastay per unhi ko lata hai jo uss ki taraf rujoo keren .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh yeh kehtay hain kay inn per ( yani Muhammad SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam per ) inn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say koi nishani kiyon nahi utaari gaee-?   keh do kay :  Allah jiss ko chahta hai , gumrah ker deta hai , aur apney raastay per unhi ko lata hai jo uss ki taraf rujoo keren .

ayahs.text: yeh woh log hain jo emaan laye hain , aur jinn kay dil Allah kay ziker say itminan hasil kertay hain . yaad rakho kay sirf Allah ka ziker hi woh cheez hai jiss say dilon ko itminan naseeb hota hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh woh log hain jo emaan laye hain , aur jinn kay dil Allah kay ziker say itminan hasil kertay hain . yaad rakho kay sirf Allah ka ziker hi woh cheez hai jiss say dilon ko itminan naseeb hota hai .

ayahs.text: . ( gharz ) jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn kay hissay mein khush haali bhi hai , aur behtareen anjam bhi .
ayahs.translation: . ( gharz ) jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn kay hissay mein khush haali bhi hai , aur behtareen anjam bhi .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! jiss tarah doosray Rasool bhejay gaye thay ) issi tarah hum ney tumhen aik aesi ummat mein Rasool bana ker bheja hai jiss say pehli boht si ummaten guzar chuki hain , takay tum inn kay samney woh kitab parh ker suna do jo hum ney wahi kay zariye tum per nazil ki hai , aur yeh log uss zaat ki nashukri ker rahey hain jo sabb per meharban hai . keh do kay :  woh mera paalney wala hai , uss kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi hai . ussi per mein ney bharosa ker rakha hai , aur ussi ki taraf mujhay loat ker jana hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! jiss tarah doosray Rasool bhejay gaye thay ) issi tarah hum ney tumhen aik aesi ummat mein Rasool bana ker bheja hai jiss say pehli boht si ummaten guzar chuki hain , takay tum inn kay samney woh kitab parh ker suna do jo hum ney wahi kay zariye tum per nazil ki hai , aur yeh log uss zaat ki nashukri ker rahey hain jo sabb per meharban hai . keh do kay :  woh mera paalney wala hai , uss kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi hai . ussi per mein ney bharosa ker rakha hai , aur ussi ki taraf mujhay loat ker jana hai .

ayahs.text: aur agar koi Quran aisa bhi utarta jiss kay zariye pahar apni jagah say hata diye jatay , ya uss ki badolat zameen shaqq kerdi jati ( aur uss say darya nikal parrtay ) ya uss kay nateejay mein murdon say baat kerli jati , ( tab bhi yeh log emaan naa latay ) .   haqeeqat to yeh hai kay tamam tarr ikhtiyar Allah ka hai . kiya phir bhi emaan walon ney yeh soch ker apna zehan farigh nahi kiya kay agar Allah chahta to saray hi insanon ko ( zabardasti ) raah per ley aata?   aur jinhon ney kufr apnaya hai , unn per to unn kay kartoot ki wajeh say hamesha koi naa koi kharr-kharaney wali museebat parrti rehti hai , ya unn ki basti kay qareeb kahen nazil hoti rehti hai , yahan tak kay ( aik din ) Allah ney jo wada ker rakha hai , woh aa-ker poora hojaye ga .   yaqeen rakho kay Allah waday ki khilaf warzi nahi kerta .
ayahs.translation: aur agar koi Quran aisa bhi utarta jiss kay zariye pahar apni jagah say hata diye jatay , ya uss ki badolat zameen shaqq kerdi jati ( aur uss say darya nikal parrtay ) ya uss kay nateejay mein murdon say baat kerli jati , ( tab bhi yeh log emaan naa latay ) .   haqeeqat to yeh hai kay tamam tarr ikhtiyar Allah ka hai . kiya phir bhi emaan walon ney yeh soch ker apna zehan farigh nahi kiya kay agar Allah chahta to saray hi insanon ko ( zabardasti ) raah per ley aata?   aur jinhon ney kufr apnaya hai , unn per to unn kay kartoot ki wajeh say hamesha koi naa koi kharr-kharaney wali museebat parrti rehti hai , ya unn ki basti kay qareeb kahen nazil hoti rehti hai , yahan tak kay ( aik din ) Allah ney jo wada ker rakha hai , woh aa-ker poora hojaye ga .   yaqeen rakho kay Allah waday ki khilaf warzi nahi kerta .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum say pehlay payghumberon ka bhi mazaq uraya gaya tha , aur aesay kafiron ko bhi mein ney mohlat di thi , magar kuch waqt kay baad mein ney unn ko girift mein ley liya , abb dekh lo kay mera azab kaisa tha-?
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum say pehlay payghumberon ka bhi mazaq uraya gaya tha , aur aesay kafiron ko bhi mein ney mohlat di thi , magar kuch waqt kay baad mein ney unn ko girift mein ley liya , abb dekh lo kay mera azab kaisa tha-?

ayahs.text: bhala batao kay aik taraf woh zaat hai jo her her shaks kay her her kaam ki nigrani ker rahi hai , aur doosri taraf inn logon  ney Allah kay sath shareek maaney huye hain-?   kaho kay :  zara unn ( khuda  kay shareekon ) kay naam to batao ( agar koi naam lo gay ) to kiya Allah ko kissi aesay wajood ki khabar do gay jiss ka duniya bhar mein Allah ko bhi pata nahi hai ? ya khaali zaban say aesay naam ley lo gay jinn kay peechay koi haqeeqat nahi-?    haqeeqat to yeh hai kay inn kafiron ko apni makkaraana baaten bari khoobsurat lagti hain , aur ( iss tarah ) inn ki hidayat kay raastay mein rukawat peda hogaee hai . aur jissay Allah gumrahi mein parra rehney dey , ussay koi raah per laney wala moyassar nahi aa-sakta .
ayahs.translation: bhala batao kay aik taraf woh zaat hai jo her her shaks kay her her kaam ki nigrani ker rahi hai , aur doosri taraf inn logon  ney Allah kay sath shareek maaney huye hain-?   kaho kay :  zara unn ( khuda  kay shareekon ) kay naam to batao ( agar koi naam lo gay ) to kiya Allah ko kissi aesay wajood ki khabar do gay jiss ka duniya bhar mein Allah ko bhi pata nahi hai ? ya khaali zaban say aesay naam ley lo gay jinn kay peechay koi haqeeqat nahi-?    haqeeqat to yeh hai kay inn kafiron ko apni makkaraana baaten bari khoobsurat lagti hain , aur ( iss tarah ) inn ki hidayat kay raastay mein rukawat peda hogaee hai . aur jissay Allah gumrahi mein parra rehney dey , ussay koi raah per laney wala moyassar nahi aa-sakta .

ayahs.text: aesay logon  kay liye dunyawi zindagi mein bhi azab hai , aur yaqeenan aakhirat ka azab kahen ziyada bhari hoga , aur koi nahi hai jo enhen Allah ( kay azab ) say bacha sakay .
ayahs.translation: aesay logon  kay liye dunyawi zindagi mein bhi azab hai , aur yaqeenan aakhirat ka azab kahen ziyada bhari hoga , aur koi nahi hai jo enhen Allah ( kay azab ) say bacha sakay .

ayahs.text: . ( doosri taraf ) woh jannat jiss ka muttaqi logon  say wada kiya gaya hai , uss ka haal yeh hai kay uss kay neechay nehren behti hain ,uss kay phal bhi sada bahar hain , aur uss ki chaon bhi ! yeh anjam hai unn logon  ka jinhon ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya , jabkay kafiron ka anjam dozakh ki aag hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( doosri taraf ) woh jannat jiss ka muttaqi logon  say wada kiya gaya hai , uss ka haal yeh hai kay uss kay neechay nehren behti hain ,uss kay phal bhi sada bahar hain , aur uss ki chaon bhi ! yeh anjam hai unn logon  ka jinhon ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya , jabkay kafiron ka anjam dozakh ki aag hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jinn logon  ko hum ney kitab di hai , woh iss kalam say khush hotay hain jo tum per nazil kiya gaya hai . aur unhi girohon mein woh bhi hain jo iss ki baaz baaton ko manney say inkar kertay hain .   keh do kay :  mujhay to yeh hukum diya gaya hai kay mein Allah ki ibadat kerun , aur uss kay sath kissi ko khudai mein shareek naa maanun , issi baat ki mein dawat deta hun , aur ussi ( Allah ) ki taraf mujhay loat ker jana hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jinn logon  ko hum ney kitab di hai , woh iss kalam say khush hotay hain jo tum per nazil kiya gaya hai . aur unhi girohon mein woh bhi hain jo iss ki baaz baaton ko manney say inkar kertay hain .   keh do kay :  mujhay to yeh hukum diya gaya hai kay mein Allah ki ibadat kerun , aur uss kay sath kissi ko khudai mein shareek naa maanun , issi baat ki mein dawat deta hun , aur ussi ( Allah ) ki taraf mujhay loat ker jana hai .

ayahs.text: aur issi tarah hum ney iss ( Quran ) ko arbi zaban mein aik hukum nama bana ker nazil kiya hai .   aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tumharay paas jo ilm aa-chuka hai , agar uss kay baad bhi tum inn logon  ki khuwaishaat kay peechay chalay to Allah kay muqablay mein naa tumhara koi madadgaar hoga , naa koi bachaney wala .
ayahs.translation: aur issi tarah hum ney iss ( Quran ) ko arbi zaban mein aik hukum nama bana ker nazil kiya hai .   aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tumharay paas jo ilm aa-chuka hai , agar uss kay baad bhi tum inn logon  ki khuwaishaat kay peechay chalay to Allah kay muqablay mein naa tumhara koi madadgaar hoga , naa koi bachaney wala .

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney tum say pehlay bhi boht say Rasool bhejay hain , aur unhen biwi bacchay bhi ata farmaye hain , aur kissi Rasool ko yeh ikhtiyar nahi tha kay woh koi aik aayat bhi Allah kay hukum kay baghair lasakay . her zamaney kay liye alag kitab di gaee hai .
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney tum say pehlay bhi boht say Rasool bhejay hain , aur unhen biwi bacchay bhi ata farmaye hain , aur kissi Rasool ko yeh ikhtiyar nahi tha kay woh koi aik aayat bhi Allah kay hukum kay baghair lasakay . her zamaney kay liye alag kitab di gaee hai .

ayahs.text: Allah jiss ( hukum ) ko chahta hai , mansookh ker deta hai , aur ( jiss ko chahta hai ) baqi rakhta hai . aur tamam kitabon ki jo asal hai , woh ussi kay paas hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah jiss ( hukum ) ko chahta hai , mansookh ker deta hai , aur ( jiss ko chahta hai ) baqi rakhta hai . aur tamam kitabon ki jo asal hai , woh ussi kay paas hai .

ayahs.text: aur jiss baat ki dhamki hum inn ( kafiron ) ko detay hain , chahye uss ka koi hissa hum tumhen ( tumhari zindagi hi mein ) dikha den , ya ( uss say pehlay hi ) tumhen duniya say utha len , baharhal tumharay zimmay to sirf paygham phoncha dena hai , aur hisab lenay ki zimma daari humari hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jiss baat ki dhamki hum inn ( kafiron ) ko detay hain , chahye uss ka koi hissa hum tumhen ( tumhari zindagi hi mein ) dikha den , ya ( uss say pehlay hi ) tumhen duniya say utha len , baharhal tumharay zimmay to sirf paygham phoncha dena hai , aur hisab lenay ki zimma daari humari hai .

ayahs.text: kiya inn logon  ko yeh haqeeqat nazar nahi aai kay hum inn ki zameen ko chaaron taraf say ghatatay chalay aarahey hain-?   her hukum Allah deta hai . koi nahi hai jo uss kay hukum ko torr sakay , aur woh jald hisab lenay wala hai .
ayahs.translation: kiya inn logon  ko yeh haqeeqat nazar nahi aai kay hum inn ki zameen ko chaaron taraf say ghatatay chalay aarahey hain-?   her hukum Allah deta hai . koi nahi hai jo uss kay hukum ko torr sakay , aur woh jald hisab lenay wala hai .

ayahs.text: jo log inn say pehlay guzray hain , chaalen unhon ney bhi chali then , lekin chaal to tamam tarr Allah hi ki chalti hai . koi bhi shaks jo kuch kerta hai , sabb ussay maloom hai , aur kafiron ko unqareeb pata lagg jaye ga kay asli watan ka naik anjam kiss kay hissay mein aata hai .
ayahs.translation: jo log inn say pehlay guzray hain , chaalen unhon ney bhi chali then , lekin chaal to tamam tarr Allah hi ki chalti hai . koi bhi shaks jo kuch kerta hai , sabb ussay maloom hai , aur kafiron ko unqareeb pata lagg jaye ga kay asli watan ka naik anjam kiss kay hissay mein aata hai .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  tum payghumber nahi ho  keh do kay :  meray aur tumharay darmiyan gawahi kay liye Allah kafi hai , neez her woh shaks jiss kay paas kitab ka ilm hai !
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  tum payghumber nahi ho  keh do kay :  meray aur tumharay darmiyan gawahi kay liye Allah kafi hai , neez her woh shaks jiss kay paas kitab ka ilm hai !

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: Alif-Laam-Raa . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh aik kitab hai jo hum ney tum per nazil ki hai , takay tum logon  ko unn kay perwerdigar kay hukum say andheron say nikal ker roshni mein ley aao , yani uss zaat kay raastay ki taraf jiss ka iqtidar sabb per ghalib hai , ( aur ) jo her tareef ka mustahiq hai .
verses.translation: Alif-Laam-Raa . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh aik kitab hai jo hum ney tum per nazil ki hai , takay tum logon  ko unn kay perwerdigar kay hukum say andheron say nikal ker roshni mein ley aao , yani uss zaat kay raastay ki taraf jiss ka iqtidar sabb per ghalib hai , ( aur ) jo her tareef ka mustahiq hai .

verses.text: woh Allah kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , ussi ki milkiyat hai . aur afsos hai unn logon  per jo haq ka inkar kertay hain , kiyonkay unhen sakht azab honey wala hai .
verses.translation: woh Allah kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , ussi ki milkiyat hai . aur afsos hai unn logon  per jo haq ka inkar kertay hain , kiyonkay unhen sakht azab honey wala hai .

verses.text: woh log jo aakhirat kay muqablay mein duniya ki zindagi ko pasand kertay hain , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay per aaney say roktay hain , aur uss mein tairrah talash kertay rehtay hain !   woh perlay darjay ki gumrahi mein mubtala hain .
verses.translation: woh log jo aakhirat kay muqablay mein duniya ki zindagi ko pasand kertay hain , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay per aaney say roktay hain , aur uss mein tairrah talash kertay rehtay hain !   woh perlay darjay ki gumrahi mein mubtala hain .

verses.text: aur hum ney jab bhi koi Rasool bheja , khud uss ki qoam ki zaban mein bheja , takay woh unn kay samney haq ko achi tarah wazeh ker-sakay .   phir Allah jiss ko chahta hai , gumrah ker deta hai , aur jiss ko chahta hai , hidayat dey deta hai ,   aur wohi hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .
verses.translation: aur hum ney jab bhi koi Rasool bheja , khud uss ki qoam ki zaban mein bheja , takay woh unn kay samney haq ko achi tarah wazeh ker-sakay .   phir Allah jiss ko chahta hai , gumrah ker deta hai , aur jiss ko chahta hai , hidayat dey deta hai ,   aur wohi hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .

verses.text: aur hum ney musa ko apni nishaniyan dey ker bheja kay :  apni qoam ko andheron say nikal ker roshni mein lao , aur ( mukhtalif logon  ko ) Allah ney ( khushhali aur bad-haali kay ) jo din dikhaye hain ,   unn kay hawalay say unhen naseehat kero .  haqeeqat yeh hai kay her woh shaks jo sabar aur shukar ka khoogar ho , uss kay liye inn waqiyaat mein bari nishaniyan hain .
verses.translation: aur hum ney musa ko apni nishaniyan dey ker bheja kay :  apni qoam ko andheron say nikal ker roshni mein lao , aur ( mukhtalif logon  ko ) Allah ney ( khushhali aur bad-haali kay ) jo din dikhaye hain ,   unn kay hawalay say unhen naseehat kero .  haqeeqat yeh hai kay her woh shaks jo sabar aur shukar ka khoogar ho , uss kay liye inn waqiyaat mein bari nishaniyan hain .

verses.text: woh waqt yaad kero jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  Allah ney tum per jo inaam kiya hai , ussay yaad rakho kay uss ney tumhen firon kay logon  say nijat di , jo tumhen bad-tareen takleefen phonchatay thay , aur tumharay beton ko zibah ker daaltay , aur tumhari aurton ko zinda rakhtay thay , aur inn tamam waqiyaat mein tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say tumhara zabardast imtihan tha .
verses.translation: woh waqt yaad kero jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  Allah ney tum per jo inaam kiya hai , ussay yaad rakho kay uss ney tumhen firon kay logon  say nijat di , jo tumhen bad-tareen takleefen phonchatay thay , aur tumharay beton ko zibah ker daaltay , aur tumhari aurton ko zinda rakhtay thay , aur inn tamam waqiyaat mein tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say tumhara zabardast imtihan tha .

verses.text: aur woh waqt bhi jab tumharay perwerdigar ney aelaan farma diya tha kay agar tum ney waqaee shukar ada kiya to mein tumhen aur ziyada dun ga , aur agar tum ney nashukri ki to yaqeen jano , mera azab bara sakht hai .
verses.translation: aur woh waqt bhi jab tumharay perwerdigar ney aelaan farma diya tha kay agar tum ney waqaee shukar ada kiya to mein tumhen aur ziyada dun ga , aur agar tum ney nashukri ki to yaqeen jano , mera azab bara sakht hai .

verses.text: aur musa ney kaha tha kay :  agar tum aur zameen per basney walay tamam log bhi nashukri keren , to ( Allah ka koi nuqsan nahi , kiyonkay ) Allah bara bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef !
verses.translation: aur musa ney kaha tha kay :  agar tum aur zameen per basney walay tamam log bhi nashukri keren , to ( Allah ka koi nuqsan nahi , kiyonkay ) Allah bara bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef !

verses.text: . ( aey kuffaar-e-makkah ! ) kiya tumhen unn logon  ki khabar nahi phonchi jo tum say pehlay guzar chukay hain , qoam-e-nooh , aad , samood aur unn kay baad aaney wali qoamen jinhen Allah kay siwa koi nahi janta .   inn sabb kay paas unn kay Rasool khulay khulay dalaeel ley ker aaye , to unhon ney unn kay mun per apney haath rakh diye ,   aur kaha kay :  jo paygham tumhen dey ker bheja gaya hai , hum uss ko manney say inkar kertay hain , aur jiss baat ki tum hamen dawat dey rahey ho , uss kay baaray mein hamen bara bhari shak hai .

verses.text: jinn logon  ney apney rab kay sath kufr ki rawish ikhtiyar ki hai , unn ki halat yeh hai kay unn kay aemal uss raakh ki tarah hain jissay aandhi toofan walay din mein hawa tezi say urra ley jaye .   unhon ney jo kuch kamai ki hogi , uss mein say kuch unn kay haath nahi aaye ga . yehi to perlay darjay ki gumrahi hai .
verses.translation: jinn logon  ney apney rab kay sath kufr ki rawish ikhtiyar ki hai , unn ki halat yeh hai kay unn kay aemal uss raakh ki tarah hain jissay aandhi toofan walay din mein hawa tezi say urra ley jaye .   unhon ney jo kuch kamai ki hogi , uss mein say kuch unn kay haath nahi aaye ga . yehi to perlay darjay ki gumrahi hai .

verses.text: kiya tumhen yeh baat nazar nahi aati kay Allah ney aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq maqsad say peda kiya hai . agar woh chahye to tum sabb ko fana kerday , aur aik naee makhlooq wajood mein ley aaye .
verses.translation: kiya tumhen yeh baat nazar nahi aati kay Allah ney aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq maqsad say peda kiya hai . agar woh chahye to tum sabb ko fana kerday , aur aik naee makhlooq wajood mein ley aaye .

verses.text: aur yeh baat Allah kay liye kuch bhi mushkil nahi hai .
verses.translation: aur yeh baat Allah kay liye kuch bhi mushkil nahi hai .

verses.text: aur yeh sabb log Allah kay aagay paish hon gay . phir jo log ( duniya mein ) kamzor thay , woh barai bgharney walon say kahen gay kay :  hum to tumharay peechay chalney walay log thay , to kiya abb tum hamen Allah kay azab say kuch bacha lo gay-?  woh kahen gay :  agar Allah ney hamen hidayat di hoti to hum bhi tumhen hidayat dey detay . chahye hum cheekhen chilayen ya sabar keren , dono soorten humaray liye barabar hain , humaray liye chutkaray ka koi raasta nahi .
verses.translation: aur yeh sabb log Allah kay aagay paish hon gay . phir jo log ( duniya mein ) kamzor thay , woh barai bgharney walon say kahen gay kay :  hum to tumharay peechay chalney walay log thay , to kiya abb tum hamen Allah kay azab say kuch bacha lo gay-?  woh kahen gay :  agar Allah ney hamen hidayat di hoti to hum bhi tumhen hidayat dey detay . chahye hum cheekhen chilayen ya sabar keren , dono soorten humaray liye barabar hain , humaray liye chutkaray ka koi raasta nahi .

verses.text: aur jab her baat ka faisla hojaye ga to shetan ( apney manney walon say ) kahey ga :  haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah ney tum say sacha wada kiya tha , aur mein ney tum say wada kiya to uss ki khilaf warzi ki . aur mujhay tum per iss say ziyada koi ikhtiyar hasil nahi tha kay mein ney tumhen ( Allah ki nafarmani ki ) dawat di to tum ney meri baat maan li . lehaza abb mujhay malamat naa kero , balkay khud apney aap ko malamat kero . naa tumhari fariyad per mein tumhari madad ker-sakta hun , aur naa meri fariyad per tum meri madad ker-saktay ho . tum ney iss say pehlay mujhay Allah ka jo shareek maan liya tha , ( aaj ) mein ney uss ka inkar kerdiya hai .   jinn logon  ney yeh zulm kiya tha , unn kay hissay mein to abb dardnak azab hai .
verses.translation: aur jab her baat ka faisla hojaye ga to shetan ( apney manney walon say ) kahey ga :  haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah ney tum say sacha wada kiya tha , aur mein ney tum say wada kiya to uss ki khilaf warzi ki . aur mujhay tum per iss say ziyada koi ikhtiyar hasil nahi tha kay mein ney tumhen ( Allah ki nafarmani ki ) dawat di to tum ney meri baat maan li . lehaza abb mujhay malamat naa kero , balkay khud apney aap ko malamat kero . naa tumhari fariyad per mein tumhari madad ker-sakta hun , aur naa meri fariyad per tum meri madad ker-saktay ho . tum ney iss say pehlay mujhay Allah ka jo shareek maan liya tha , ( aaj ) mein ney uss ka inkar kerdiya hai .   jinn logon  ney yeh zulm kiya tha , unn kay hissay mein to abb dardnak azab hai .

verses.text: aur jo log emaan laye thay , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye thay , unhen aesay baaghaat mein dakhil kiya jaye ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , apney perwerdigar kay hukum say woh unn ( baaghon ) mein hamesha rahen gay . woh aapas mein aik doosray ka istaqbal salam say keren gay .
verses.translation: aur jo log emaan laye thay , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye thay , unhen aesay baaghaat mein dakhil kiya jaye ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , apney perwerdigar kay hukum say woh unn ( baaghon ) mein hamesha rahen gay . woh aapas mein aik doosray ka istaqbal salam say keren gay .

verses.text: kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay Allah ney kalma tayyaba ki kaisi misal biyan ki hai ? woh aik pakeezah darkht ki tarah hai jiss ki jarr ( zameen mein ) mazbooti say jami hoi hai , aur uss ki shaakhen aasman mein hain ,
verses.translation: kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay Allah ney kalma tayyaba ki kaisi misal biyan ki hai ? woh aik pakeezah darkht ki tarah hai jiss ki jarr ( zameen mein ) mazbooti say jami hoi hai , aur uss ki shaakhen aasman mein hain ,

verses.text: apney rab kay hukum say woh her aan phal deta hai .   Allah ( iss qisam ki ) misalen iss liye deta hai takay log naseehat hasil keren .
verses.translation: apney rab kay hukum say woh her aan phal deta hai .   Allah ( iss qisam ki ) misalen iss liye deta hai takay log naseehat hasil keren .

verses.text: aur napak kalmay ki misal aik kharab darkht ki tarah hai jissay zameen kay oopper hi oopper say ukhaar liya jaye , uss mein zara bhi jamao naa ho .
verses.translation: aur napak kalmay ki misal aik kharab darkht ki tarah hai jissay zameen kay oopper hi oopper say ukhaar liya jaye , uss mein zara bhi jamao naa ho .

verses.text: jo log emaan laye hain , Allah unn ko iss mazboot baat per duniya ki zindagi mein bhi jamao ata kerta hai , aur aakhirat mein bhi .   aur zalim logon  ko Allah bhatka deta hai , aur Allah ( apni hikmat kay mutabiq ) jo chahta hai kerta hai .
verses.translation: jo log emaan laye hain , Allah unn ko iss mazboot baat per duniya ki zindagi mein bhi jamao ata kerta hai , aur aakhirat mein bhi .   aur zalim logon  ko Allah bhatka deta hai , aur Allah ( apni hikmat kay mutabiq ) jo chahta hai kerta hai .

verses.text: kiya tum ney unn logon  ko nahi dekha jinhon ney Allah ki naimat ko kufr say badal daala , aur apni qoam ko tabahi kay ghar mein laa utaara
verses.translation: kiya tum ney unn logon  ko nahi dekha jinhon ney Allah ki naimat ko kufr say badal daala , aur apni qoam ko tabahi kay ghar mein laa utaara

verses.text: jiss ka naam jahannum hai ?   woh uss mein jalen gay , aur woh boht bura thikana hai .
verses.translation: jiss ka naam jahannum hai ?   woh uss mein jalen gay , aur woh boht bura thikana hai .

verses.text: aur unhon ney Allah kay sath ( uss ki khudai mein ) kuch shareek bana liye , takay logon  ko uss kay raastay say gumrah keren . unn say kaho kay :  ( thoray say ) mazay urra lo , kiyonkay aakhir kaar tumhen jana dozakh hi ki taraf hai .
verses.translation: aur unhon ney Allah kay sath ( uss ki khudai mein ) kuch shareek bana liye , takay logon  ko uss kay raastay say gumrah keren . unn say kaho kay :  ( thoray say ) mazay urra lo , kiyonkay aakhir kaar tumhen jana dozakh hi ki taraf hai .

verses.text: meray jo banday emaan laye hain , unn say keh do kay woh namaz qaeem keren , aur hum ney unn ko jo rizq diya hai uss mein say posheeda tor per bhi aur aelania bhi ( naiki kay kamon mein ) kharch keren , ( aur yeh kaam ) uss din kay aaney say pehlay pehlay ( kerlen ) jiss mein naa koi kharid-o-farokht hogi , naa koi dosti kaam aaye gi .
verses.translation: meray jo banday emaan laye hain , unn say keh do kay woh namaz qaeem keren , aur hum ney unn ko jo rizq diya hai uss mein say posheeda tor per bhi aur aelania bhi ( naiki kay kamon mein ) kharch keren , ( aur yeh kaam ) uss din kay aaney say pehlay pehlay ( kerlen ) jiss mein naa koi kharid-o-farokht hogi , naa koi dosti kaam aaye gi .

verses.text: Allah woh hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya , aur aasman say paani barsaya , phir uss kay zariye tumharay rizq kay liye phal ugaye , aur kashtiyon ko tumharay liye raam kerdiya , takay woh uss kay hukum say samandar mein chalen , aur daryaon ko bhi tumhari khidmat per laga diya .
verses.translation: Allah woh hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya , aur aasman say paani barsaya , phir uss kay zariye tumharay rizq kay liye phal ugaye , aur kashtiyon ko tumharay liye raam kerdiya , takay woh uss kay hukum say samandar mein chalen , aur daryaon ko bhi tumhari khidmat per laga diya .

verses.text: aur tumhari khatir sooraj aur chaand ko iss tarah kaam per lagaya kay woh musalsal safar mein hain , aur tumhari khatir raat aur din ko bhi kaam per lagaya .
verses.translation: aur tumhari khatir sooraj aur chaand ko iss tarah kaam per lagaya kay woh musalsal safar mein hain , aur tumhari khatir raat aur din ko bhi kaam per lagaya .

verses.text: aur tum ney jo kuch maanga , uss ney uss mein say ( jo tumharay liye munasib tha ) tumhen diya . aur agar tum Allah ki naimaton ko shumar kernay lago to shumar ( bhi ) nahi ker-saktay . haqeeqat yeh hai kay insan boht bey insaf , bara nashukra hai .
verses.translation: aur tum ney jo kuch maanga , uss ney uss mein say ( jo tumharay liye munasib tha ) tumhen diya . aur agar tum Allah ki naimaton ko shumar kernay lago to shumar ( bhi ) nahi ker-saktay . haqeeqat yeh hai kay insan boht bey insaf , bara nashukra hai .

verses.text: aur yaad kero woh waqt jab Ibrahim ney ( Allah taalaa say dua kertay huye ) kaha tha kay :  ya rab ! iss shehar ko pur aman bana dijiye ,   aur mujhay aur meray beton ko iss baat say bachaiye kay hum button ki parastish keren .
verses.translation: aur yaad kero woh waqt jab Ibrahim ney ( Allah taalaa say dua kertay huye ) kaha tha kay :  ya rab ! iss shehar ko pur aman bana dijiye ,   aur mujhay aur meray beton ko iss baat say bachaiye kay hum button ki parastish keren .

verses.text: meray perwerdigar ! inn button ney logon  ki bari tadaad ko gumrah kiya hai . lehaza jo koi meri raah per chalay , woh to mera hai , aur jo mera kehna naa maaney , to ( uss ka moamla mein aap per chorta hun ) aap boht bakhshney walay baray meharban hain .
verses.translation: meray perwerdigar ! inn button ney logon  ki bari tadaad ko gumrah kiya hai . lehaza jo koi meri raah per chalay , woh to mera hai , aur jo mera kehna naa maaney , to ( uss ka moamla mein aap per chorta hun ) aap boht bakhshney walay baray meharban hain .

verses.text: aey humaray perwerdigar ! mein ney apni kuch aulad ko aap kay hurmat walay ghar kay paas aik aesi wadi mein laa basaya hai jiss mein koi kheti nahi hoti . humaray perwerdigar ! ( yeh mein ney iss liye kiya ) takay yeh namaz qaeem keren , lehaza logon  kay dilon mein inn kay liye kashish peda ker-dijiye , aur inn ko phalon ka rizq ata farmaiye ,   takay woh shukar guzaar banen .
verses.translation: aey humaray perwerdigar ! mein ney apni kuch aulad ko aap kay hurmat walay ghar kay paas aik aesi wadi mein laa basaya hai jiss mein koi kheti nahi hoti . humaray perwerdigar ! ( yeh mein ney iss liye kiya ) takay yeh namaz qaeem keren , lehaza logon  kay dilon mein inn kay liye kashish peda ker-dijiye , aur inn ko phalon ka rizq ata farmaiye ,   takay woh shukar guzaar banen .

verses.text: aey humaray rab ! hum jo kaam chup ker kertay hain , woh bhi aap kay ilm mein hain , aur jo kaam aelania kertay hain , woh bhi . aur Allah say naa zameen ki koi cheez chupi hoi hai , naa aasman ki koi cheez .
verses.translation: aey humaray rab ! hum jo kaam chup ker kertay hain , woh bhi aap kay ilm mein hain , aur jo kaam aelania kertay hain , woh bhi . aur Allah say naa zameen ki koi cheez chupi hoi hai , naa aasman ki koi cheez .

verses.text: tamam tareefen Allah kay liye hain jiss ney mujhay burhapay mein Ismail aur Ishaq ( jaisay betay ) ata farmaye . beyshak mera rab bara duayen sunney wala hai .
verses.translation: tamam tareefen Allah kay liye hain jiss ney mujhay burhapay mein Ismail aur Ishaq ( jaisay betay ) ata farmaye . beyshak mera rab bara duayen sunney wala hai .

verses.text: ya rab ! mujhay bhi namaz qaeem kernay wala bana dijiye , aur meri aulad mein say bhi ( aesay log peda farmaiye jo namaz qaeem keren . ) aey humaray perwerdigar ! aur meri dua qubool farma-lijiye .
verses.translation: ya rab ! mujhay bhi namaz qaeem kernay wala bana dijiye , aur meri aulad mein say bhi ( aesay log peda farmaiye jo namaz qaeem keren . ) aey humaray perwerdigar ! aur meri dua qubool farma-lijiye .

verses.text: aey humaray perwerdigar ! jiss din hisab qaeem hoga , uss din meri bhi maghfirat farmaiye , meray walaiden ki bhi ,   aur unn sabb ki bhi jo emaan rakhtay hain .
verses.translation: aey humaray perwerdigar ! jiss din hisab qaeem hoga , uss din meri bhi maghfirat farmaiye , meray walaiden ki bhi ,   aur unn sabb ki bhi jo emaan rakhtay hain .

verses.text: aur yeh hergiz naa samajhna kay jo kuch yeh zalim ker rahey hain , Allah uss say ghafil hai .   woh to unn logon  ko uss din tak kay liye mohlat dey raha hai jiss mein aankhen phatti ki phatti reh jayen gi .
verses.translation: aur yeh hergiz naa samajhna kay jo kuch yeh zalim ker rahey hain , Allah uss say ghafil hai .   woh to unn logon  ko uss din tak kay liye mohlat dey raha hai jiss mein aankhen phatti ki phatti reh jayen gi .

verses.text: woh saron ko oopper uthaye dorr rahey hon gay , unn ki nigahen jhapakney ko wapis nahi ayen gi ,   aur unn kay dil ( bad-hawasi mein ) urray jarahey hon gay .
verses.translation: woh saron ko oopper uthaye dorr rahey hon gay , unn ki nigahen jhapakney ko wapis nahi ayen gi ,   aur unn kay dil ( bad-hawasi mein ) urray jarahey hon gay .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum logon  ko uss din say khabrdar kero jab azab unn per aan parray ga , to uss waqt yeh zalim kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen thori si mauddat kay liye aur mohlat dey dijiye takay hum aap ki dawat qubool kerlen , aur payghumberon ki perwi keren .  ( uss waqt unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  aray kiya tum logon  ney qasmen kha kha ker pehlay yeh nahi kaha tha kay tum per koi zawal nahi aa-sakta-?
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum logon  ko uss din say khabrdar kero jab azab unn per aan parray ga , to uss waqt yeh zalim kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen thori si mauddat kay liye aur mohlat dey dijiye takay hum aap ki dawat qubool kerlen , aur payghumberon ki perwi keren .  ( uss waqt unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  aray kiya tum logon  ney qasmen kha kha ker pehlay yeh nahi kaha tha kay tum per koi zawal nahi aa-sakta-?

verses.text: aur tum unn logon  ki bastiyon mein reh chukay thay jinhon ney apni janon per zulm kiya tha , aur yeh baat khul ker tumharay samney aa-chuki thi kay hum ney unn kay sath kaisa sulook kiya , aur hum ney tumhen misalen bhi di then .
verses.translation: aur tum unn logon  ki bastiyon mein reh chukay thay jinhon ney apni janon per zulm kiya tha , aur yeh baat khul ker tumharay samney aa-chuki thi kay hum ney unn kay sath kaisa sulook kiya , aur hum ney tumhen misalen bhi di then .

verses.text: aur woh log apni sari chaalen chal chukay thay , aur unn ki sari chaalon ka torr Allah kay paas tha , chahye inn/unn ki chaalen aesi kiyon naa hun jinn say pahar bhi apni jagah say hill jayen .
verses.translation: aur woh log apni sari chaalen chal chukay thay , aur unn ki sari chaalon ka torr Allah kay paas tha , chahye inn/unn ki chaalen aesi kiyon naa hun jinn say pahar bhi apni jagah say hill jayen .

verses.text: lehaza Allah kay baaray mein hergiz yeh khayal bhi dil mein naa lana kay uss ney apney payghumberon say jo wada ker rakha hai ,uss ki khilaf warzi keray ga . yaqeen rakho kay Allah apney iqtidar mein sabb per ghalib hai , ( aur ) intiqam lenay wala hai .
verses.translation: lehaza Allah kay baaray mein hergiz yeh khayal bhi dil mein naa lana kay uss ney apney payghumberon say jo wada ker rakha hai ,uss ki khilaf warzi keray ga . yaqeen rakho kay Allah apney iqtidar mein sabb per ghalib hai , ( aur ) intiqam lenay wala hai .

verses.text: uss din jab yeh zameen aik doosri zameen say badal di jaye gi , aur aasman bhi ( badal jayen gay ) aur sabb kay sabb khudaye wahid o qahaar kay samney paish hon gay .
verses.translation: uss din jab yeh zameen aik doosri zameen say badal di jaye gi , aur aasman bhi ( badal jayen gay ) aur sabb kay sabb khudaye wahid o qahaar kay samney paish hon gay .

verses.text: aur uss din tum mujrimon ko iss halat mein dekho gay kay woh zanjeeron mein jakray huye hon gay .
verses.translation: aur uss din tum mujrimon ko iss halat mein dekho gay kay woh zanjeeron mein jakray huye hon gay .

verses.text: unn kay qamees tarkol kay hon gay , aur aag unn kay chehron per chai hoi hogi ,
verses.translation: unn kay qamees tarkol kay hon gay , aur aag unn kay chehron per chai hoi hogi ,

verses.text: takay Allah her shaks ko uss kay kiye ka badla dey . yaqeenan Allah jald hisab chukaney wala hai .
verses.translation: takay Allah her shaks ko uss kay kiye ka badla dey . yaqeenan Allah jald hisab chukaney wala hai .

verses.text: yeh tamam logon  kay liye aik paygham hai , aur iss liye diya jaraha hai takay unhen iss kay zariye khabrdar kiya jaye , aur takay woh jaan len kay mabood-e-bar-haq bus aik hi hai , aur takay samajh rakhney walay naseehat hasil kerlen .
verses.translation: yeh tamam logon  kay liye aik paygham hai , aur iss liye diya jaraha hai takay unhen iss kay zariye khabrdar kiya jaye , aur takay woh jaan len kay mabood-e-bar-haq bus aik hi hai , aur takay samajh rakhney walay naseehat hasil kerlen .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: Alif-Laam-Raa . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh aik kitab hai jo hum ney tum per nazil ki hai , takay tum logon  ko unn kay perwerdigar kay hukum say andheron say nikal ker roshni mein ley aao , yani uss zaat kay raastay ki taraf jiss ka iqtidar sabb per ghalib hai , ( aur ) jo her tareef ka mustahiq hai .
ayahs.translation: Alif-Laam-Raa . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh aik kitab hai jo hum ney tum per nazil ki hai , takay tum logon  ko unn kay perwerdigar kay hukum say andheron say nikal ker roshni mein ley aao , yani uss zaat kay raastay ki taraf jiss ka iqtidar sabb per ghalib hai , ( aur ) jo her tareef ka mustahiq hai .

ayahs.text: woh Allah kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , ussi ki milkiyat hai . aur afsos hai unn logon  per jo haq ka inkar kertay hain , kiyonkay unhen sakht azab honey wala hai .
ayahs.translation: woh Allah kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , ussi ki milkiyat hai . aur afsos hai unn logon  per jo haq ka inkar kertay hain , kiyonkay unhen sakht azab honey wala hai .

ayahs.text: woh log jo aakhirat kay muqablay mein duniya ki zindagi ko pasand kertay hain , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay per aaney say roktay hain , aur uss mein tairrah talash kertay rehtay hain !   woh perlay darjay ki gumrahi mein mubtala hain .
ayahs.translation: woh log jo aakhirat kay muqablay mein duniya ki zindagi ko pasand kertay hain , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay per aaney say roktay hain , aur uss mein tairrah talash kertay rehtay hain !   woh perlay darjay ki gumrahi mein mubtala hain .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney jab bhi koi Rasool bheja , khud uss ki qoam ki zaban mein bheja , takay woh unn kay samney haq ko achi tarah wazeh ker-sakay .   phir Allah jiss ko chahta hai , gumrah ker deta hai , aur jiss ko chahta hai , hidayat dey deta hai ,   aur wohi hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney jab bhi koi Rasool bheja , khud uss ki qoam ki zaban mein bheja , takay woh unn kay samney haq ko achi tarah wazeh ker-sakay .   phir Allah jiss ko chahta hai , gumrah ker deta hai , aur jiss ko chahta hai , hidayat dey deta hai ,   aur wohi hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney musa ko apni nishaniyan dey ker bheja kay :  apni qoam ko andheron say nikal ker roshni mein lao , aur ( mukhtalif logon  ko ) Allah ney ( khushhali aur bad-haali kay ) jo din dikhaye hain ,   unn kay hawalay say unhen naseehat kero .  haqeeqat yeh hai kay her woh shaks jo sabar aur shukar ka khoogar ho , uss kay liye inn waqiyaat mein bari nishaniyan hain .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney musa ko apni nishaniyan dey ker bheja kay :  apni qoam ko andheron say nikal ker roshni mein lao , aur ( mukhtalif logon  ko ) Allah ney ( khushhali aur bad-haali kay ) jo din dikhaye hain ,   unn kay hawalay say unhen naseehat kero .  haqeeqat yeh hai kay her woh shaks jo sabar aur shukar ka khoogar ho , uss kay liye inn waqiyaat mein bari nishaniyan hain .

ayahs.text: woh waqt yaad kero jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  Allah ney tum per jo inaam kiya hai , ussay yaad rakho kay uss ney tumhen firon kay logon  say nijat di , jo tumhen bad-tareen takleefen phonchatay thay , aur tumharay beton ko zibah ker daaltay , aur tumhari aurton ko zinda rakhtay thay , aur inn tamam waqiyaat mein tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say tumhara zabardast imtihan tha .
ayahs.translation: woh waqt yaad kero jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  Allah ney tum per jo inaam kiya hai , ussay yaad rakho kay uss ney tumhen firon kay logon  say nijat di , jo tumhen bad-tareen takleefen phonchatay thay , aur tumharay beton ko zibah ker daaltay , aur tumhari aurton ko zinda rakhtay thay , aur inn tamam waqiyaat mein tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say tumhara zabardast imtihan tha .

ayahs.text: aur woh waqt bhi jab tumharay perwerdigar ney aelaan farma diya tha kay agar tum ney waqaee shukar ada kiya to mein tumhen aur ziyada dun ga , aur agar tum ney nashukri ki to yaqeen jano , mera azab bara sakht hai .
ayahs.translation: aur woh waqt bhi jab tumharay perwerdigar ney aelaan farma diya tha kay agar tum ney waqaee shukar ada kiya to mein tumhen aur ziyada dun ga , aur agar tum ney nashukri ki to yaqeen jano , mera azab bara sakht hai .

ayahs.text: aur musa ney kaha tha kay :  agar tum aur zameen per basney walay tamam log bhi nashukri keren , to ( Allah ka koi nuqsan nahi , kiyonkay ) Allah bara bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef !
ayahs.translation: aur musa ney kaha tha kay :  agar tum aur zameen per basney walay tamam log bhi nashukri keren , to ( Allah ka koi nuqsan nahi , kiyonkay ) Allah bara bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef !

ayahs.text: . ( aey kuffaar-e-makkah ! ) kiya tumhen unn logon  ki khabar nahi phonchi jo tum say pehlay guzar chukay hain , qoam-e-nooh , aad , samood aur unn kay baad aaney wali qoamen jinhen Allah kay siwa koi nahi janta .   inn sabb kay paas unn kay Rasool khulay khulay dalaeel ley ker aaye , to unhon ney unn kay mun per apney haath rakh diye ,   aur kaha kay :  jo paygham tumhen dey ker bheja gaya hai , hum uss ko manney say inkar kertay hain , aur jiss baat ki tum hamen dawat dey rahey ho , uss kay baaray mein hamen bara bhari shak hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey kuffaar-e-makkah ! ) kiya tumhen unn logon  ki khabar nahi phonchi jo tum say pehlay guzar chukay hain , qoam-e-nooh , aad , samood aur unn kay baad aaney wali qoamen jinhen Allah kay siwa koi nahi janta .   inn sabb kay paas unn kay Rasool khulay khulay dalaeel ley ker aaye , to unhon ney unn kay mun per apney haath rakh diye ,   aur kaha kay :  jo paygham tumhen dey ker bheja gaya hai , hum uss ko manney say inkar kertay hain , aur jiss baat ki tum hamen dawat dey rahey ho , uss kay baaray mein hamen bara bhari shak hai .

ayahs.text: unn kay payghumberon ney unn say kaha :  kiya Allah kay baaray mein shak hai jo saray aasmano aur zameen ka khaliq hai ? woh tumhen bula raha hai kay tumhari khatir tumharay gunah moaaf kerday , aur tumhen aik muqarrara mauddat tak mohlat dey .    unhon ney kaha kay :  tumhari haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch bhi nahi kay tum aesay hi insan jo jaisay hum hain . tum yeh chahtay ho kay humaray baap dada jinn ki ibadat kertay aaye hain unn say hamen rok do , lehaza koi saaf saaf moajza laaker dikhao .
ayahs.translation: unn kay payghumberon ney unn say kaha :  kiya Allah kay baaray mein shak hai jo saray aasmano aur zameen ka khaliq hai ? woh tumhen bula raha hai kay tumhari khatir tumharay gunah moaaf kerday , aur tumhen aik muqarrara mauddat tak mohlat dey .    unhon ney kaha kay :  tumhari haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch bhi nahi kay tum aesay hi insan jo jaisay hum hain . tum yeh chahtay ho kay humaray baap dada jinn ki ibadat kertay aaye hain unn say hamen rok do , lehaza koi saaf saaf moajza laaker dikhao .

ayahs.text: unn say unn kay payghumberon ney kaha :  hum waqaee tumharay hi jaisay insan hain , lekin Allah apney bandon mein say jiss per chahta hai khusoosi ehsan farma deta hai . aur yeh baat humaray ikhtiyar mein nahi hai kay hum Allah kay hukum kay baghair tumhen koi moajza laa dikhayen , aur mominon ko sirf Allah per bharosa rakhna chahiye .
ayahs.translation: unn say unn kay payghumberon ney kaha :  hum waqaee tumharay hi jaisay insan hain , lekin Allah apney bandon mein say jiss per chahta hai khusoosi ehsan farma deta hai . aur yeh baat humaray ikhtiyar mein nahi hai kay hum Allah kay hukum kay baghair tumhen koi moajza laa dikhayen , aur mominon ko sirf Allah per bharosa rakhna chahiye .

ayahs.text: aur aakhir hum kiyon Allah per bharosa naa rakhen , jabkay uss ney hamen unn raaston ki hidayat dey di hai jinn per hamen chalna hai ? aur tum ney hamen jo takleefen phonchai hain , unn per hum yaqeenan sabar keren gay , aur jinn logon  ko bharosa rakhna ho , unhen Allah hi per bharosa rakhna chahiye .
ayahs.translation: aur aakhir hum kiyon Allah per bharosa naa rakhen , jabkay uss ney hamen unn raaston ki hidayat dey di hai jinn per hamen chalna hai ? aur tum ney hamen jo takleefen phonchai hain , unn per hum yaqeenan sabar keren gay , aur jinn logon  ko bharosa rakhna ho , unhen Allah hi per bharosa rakhna chahiye .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya tha , unhon ney apney payghumberon say kaha kay :  hum tumhen apni sarzameen say nikal ker rahen gay , werna tumhen humaray deen mein wapis aana parray ga .  chunacheh unn kay perwerdigar ney unn per wahi bheji kay :  yaqeen rakho , hum inn zalimon ko halak kerden gay ,
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya tha , unhon ney apney payghumberon say kaha kay :  hum tumhen apni sarzameen say nikal ker rahen gay , werna tumhen humaray deen mein wapis aana parray ga .  chunacheh unn kay perwerdigar ney unn per wahi bheji kay :  yaqeen rakho , hum inn zalimon ko halak kerden gay ,

ayahs.text: aur unn kay baad yaqeenan tumhen zameen mein basayen gay . yeh hai her uss shaks ka sila jo meray samney kharra honey ka khof rakhta aur meri waeed say darta ho .
ayahs.translation: aur unn kay baad yaqeenan tumhen zameen mein basayen gay . yeh hai her uss shaks ka sila jo meray samney kharra honey ka khof rakhta aur meri waeed say darta ho .

ayahs.text: aur inn kafiron ney khud faisla maanga ,   aur ( nateeja yeh huwa kay ) her deengay maarney wala hatt dharam na-murad ho ker raha .
ayahs.translation: aur inn kafiron ney khud faisla maanga ,   aur ( nateeja yeh huwa kay ) her deengay maarney wala hatt dharam na-murad ho ker raha .

ayahs.text: uss kay aagay jahannum hai , aur ( wahan ) ussay peep ka paani pilaya jaye ga ,
ayahs.translation: uss kay aagay jahannum hai , aur ( wahan ) ussay peep ka paani pilaya jaye ga ,

ayahs.text: woh ussay ghoont ghoont ker kay piye ga , aur ussay aisa mehsoos hoga kay woh ussay halaq say utaar nahi sakay ga .   moat uss per her taraf say aarahi hogi , magar woh maray ga nahi ,   aur uss kay aagay ( hamesha ) aik aur sakht azab mojood hoga .
ayahs.translation: woh ussay ghoont ghoont ker kay piye ga , aur ussay aisa mehsoos hoga kay woh ussay halaq say utaar nahi sakay ga .   moat uss per her taraf say aarahi hogi , magar woh maray ga nahi ,   aur uss kay aagay ( hamesha ) aik aur sakht azab mojood hoga .

ayahs.text: jinn logon  ney apney rab kay sath kufr ki rawish ikhtiyar ki hai , unn ki halat yeh hai kay unn kay aemal uss raakh ki tarah hain jissay aandhi toofan walay din mein hawa tezi say urra ley jaye .   unhon ney jo kuch kamai ki hogi , uss mein say kuch unn kay haath nahi aaye ga . yehi to perlay darjay ki gumrahi hai .
ayahs.translation: jinn logon  ney apney rab kay sath kufr ki rawish ikhtiyar ki hai , unn ki halat yeh hai kay unn kay aemal uss raakh ki tarah hain jissay aandhi toofan walay din mein hawa tezi say urra ley jaye .   unhon ney jo kuch kamai ki hogi , uss mein say kuch unn kay haath nahi aaye ga . yehi to perlay darjay ki gumrahi hai .

ayahs.text: kiya tumhen yeh baat nazar nahi aati kay Allah ney aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq maqsad say peda kiya hai . agar woh chahye to tum sabb ko fana kerday , aur aik naee makhlooq wajood mein ley aaye .
ayahs.translation: kiya tumhen yeh baat nazar nahi aati kay Allah ney aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq maqsad say peda kiya hai . agar woh chahye to tum sabb ko fana kerday , aur aik naee makhlooq wajood mein ley aaye .

ayahs.text: aur yeh baat Allah kay liye kuch bhi mushkil nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh baat Allah kay liye kuch bhi mushkil nahi hai .

ayahs.text: aur yeh sabb log Allah kay aagay paish hon gay . phir jo log ( duniya mein ) kamzor thay , woh barai bgharney walon say kahen gay kay :  hum to tumharay peechay chalney walay log thay , to kiya abb tum hamen Allah kay azab say kuch bacha lo gay-?  woh kahen gay :  agar Allah ney hamen hidayat di hoti to hum bhi tumhen hidayat dey detay . chahye hum cheekhen chilayen ya sabar keren , dono soorten humaray liye barabar hain , humaray liye chutkaray ka koi raasta nahi .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh sabb log Allah kay aagay paish hon gay . phir jo log ( duniya mein ) kamzor thay , woh barai bgharney walon say kahen gay kay :  hum to tumharay peechay chalney walay log thay , to kiya abb tum hamen Allah kay azab say kuch bacha lo gay-?  woh kahen gay :  agar Allah ney hamen hidayat di hoti to hum bhi tumhen hidayat dey detay . chahye hum cheekhen chilayen ya sabar keren , dono soorten humaray liye barabar hain , humaray liye chutkaray ka koi raasta nahi .

ayahs.text: aur jab her baat ka faisla hojaye ga to shetan ( apney manney walon say ) kahey ga :  haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah ney tum say sacha wada kiya tha , aur mein ney tum say wada kiya to uss ki khilaf warzi ki . aur mujhay tum per iss say ziyada koi ikhtiyar hasil nahi tha kay mein ney tumhen ( Allah ki nafarmani ki ) dawat di to tum ney meri baat maan li . lehaza abb mujhay malamat naa kero , balkay khud apney aap ko malamat kero . naa tumhari fariyad per mein tumhari madad ker-sakta hun , aur naa meri fariyad per tum meri madad ker-saktay ho . tum ney iss say pehlay mujhay Allah ka jo shareek maan liya tha , ( aaj ) mein ney uss ka inkar kerdiya hai .   jinn logon  ney yeh zulm kiya tha , unn kay hissay mein to abb dardnak azab hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jab her baat ka faisla hojaye ga to shetan ( apney manney walon say ) kahey ga :  haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah ney tum say sacha wada kiya tha , aur mein ney tum say wada kiya to uss ki khilaf warzi ki . aur mujhay tum per iss say ziyada koi ikhtiyar hasil nahi tha kay mein ney tumhen ( Allah ki nafarmani ki ) dawat di to tum ney meri baat maan li . lehaza abb mujhay malamat naa kero , balkay khud apney aap ko malamat kero . naa tumhari fariyad per mein tumhari madad ker-sakta hun , aur naa meri fariyad per tum meri madad ker-saktay ho . tum ney iss say pehlay mujhay Allah ka jo shareek maan liya tha , ( aaj ) mein ney uss ka inkar kerdiya hai .   jinn logon  ney yeh zulm kiya tha , unn kay hissay mein to abb dardnak azab hai .

ayahs.text: aur jo log emaan laye thay , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye thay , unhen aesay baaghaat mein dakhil kiya jaye ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , apney perwerdigar kay hukum say woh unn ( baaghon ) mein hamesha rahen gay . woh aapas mein aik doosray ka istaqbal salam say keren gay .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log emaan laye thay , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye thay , unhen aesay baaghaat mein dakhil kiya jaye ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , apney perwerdigar kay hukum say woh unn ( baaghon ) mein hamesha rahen gay . woh aapas mein aik doosray ka istaqbal salam say keren gay .

ayahs.text: kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay Allah ney kalma tayyaba ki kaisi misal biyan ki hai ? woh aik pakeezah darkht ki tarah hai jiss ki jarr ( zameen mein ) mazbooti say jami hoi hai , aur uss ki shaakhen aasman mein hain ,
ayahs.translation: kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay Allah ney kalma tayyaba ki kaisi misal biyan ki hai ? woh aik pakeezah darkht ki tarah hai jiss ki jarr ( zameen mein ) mazbooti say jami hoi hai , aur uss ki shaakhen aasman mein hain ,

ayahs.text: apney rab kay hukum say woh her aan phal deta hai .   Allah ( iss qisam ki ) misalen iss liye deta hai takay log naseehat hasil keren .
ayahs.translation: apney rab kay hukum say woh her aan phal deta hai .   Allah ( iss qisam ki ) misalen iss liye deta hai takay log naseehat hasil keren .

ayahs.text: aur napak kalmay ki misal aik kharab darkht ki tarah hai jissay zameen kay oopper hi oopper say ukhaar liya jaye , uss mein zara bhi jamao naa ho .
ayahs.translation: aur napak kalmay ki misal aik kharab darkht ki tarah hai jissay zameen kay oopper hi oopper say ukhaar liya jaye , uss mein zara bhi jamao naa ho .

ayahs.text: jo log emaan laye hain , Allah unn ko iss mazboot baat per duniya ki zindagi mein bhi jamao ata kerta hai , aur aakhirat mein bhi .   aur zalim logon  ko Allah bhatka deta hai , aur Allah ( apni hikmat kay mutabiq ) jo chahta hai kerta hai .
ayahs.translation: jo log emaan laye hain , Allah unn ko iss mazboot baat per duniya ki zindagi mein bhi jamao ata kerta hai , aur aakhirat mein bhi .   aur zalim logon  ko Allah bhatka deta hai , aur Allah ( apni hikmat kay mutabiq ) jo chahta hai kerta hai .

ayahs.text: kiya tum ney unn logon  ko nahi dekha jinhon ney Allah ki naimat ko kufr say badal daala , aur apni qoam ko tabahi kay ghar mein laa utaara
ayahs.translation: kiya tum ney unn logon  ko nahi dekha jinhon ney Allah ki naimat ko kufr say badal daala , aur apni qoam ko tabahi kay ghar mein laa utaara

ayahs.text: jiss ka naam jahannum hai ?   woh uss mein jalen gay , aur woh boht bura thikana hai .
ayahs.translation: jiss ka naam jahannum hai ?   woh uss mein jalen gay , aur woh boht bura thikana hai .

ayahs.text: aur unhon ney Allah kay sath ( uss ki khudai mein ) kuch shareek bana liye , takay logon  ko uss kay raastay say gumrah keren . unn say kaho kay :  ( thoray say ) mazay urra lo , kiyonkay aakhir kaar tumhen jana dozakh hi ki taraf hai .
ayahs.translation: aur unhon ney Allah kay sath ( uss ki khudai mein ) kuch shareek bana liye , takay logon  ko uss kay raastay say gumrah keren . unn say kaho kay :  ( thoray say ) mazay urra lo , kiyonkay aakhir kaar tumhen jana dozakh hi ki taraf hai .

ayahs.text: meray jo banday emaan laye hain , unn say keh do kay woh namaz qaeem keren , aur hum ney unn ko jo rizq diya hai uss mein say posheeda tor per bhi aur aelania bhi ( naiki kay kamon mein ) kharch keren , ( aur yeh kaam ) uss din kay aaney say pehlay pehlay ( kerlen ) jiss mein naa koi kharid-o-farokht hogi , naa koi dosti kaam aaye gi .
