ayahs.translation: meray jo banday emaan laye hain , unn say keh do kay woh namaz qaeem keren , aur hum ney unn ko jo rizq diya hai uss mein say posheeda tor per bhi aur aelania bhi ( naiki kay kamon mein ) kharch keren , ( aur yeh kaam ) uss din kay aaney say pehlay pehlay ( kerlen ) jiss mein naa koi kharid-o-farokht hogi , naa koi dosti kaam aaye gi .

ayahs.text: Allah woh hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya , aur aasman say paani barsaya , phir uss kay zariye tumharay rizq kay liye phal ugaye , aur kashtiyon ko tumharay liye raam kerdiya , takay woh uss kay hukum say samandar mein chalen , aur daryaon ko bhi tumhari khidmat per laga diya .
ayahs.translation: Allah woh hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya , aur aasman say paani barsaya , phir uss kay zariye tumharay rizq kay liye phal ugaye , aur kashtiyon ko tumharay liye raam kerdiya , takay woh uss kay hukum say samandar mein chalen , aur daryaon ko bhi tumhari khidmat per laga diya .

ayahs.text: aur tumhari khatir sooraj aur chaand ko iss tarah kaam per lagaya kay woh musalsal safar mein hain , aur tumhari khatir raat aur din ko bhi kaam per lagaya .
ayahs.translation: aur tumhari khatir sooraj aur chaand ko iss tarah kaam per lagaya kay woh musalsal safar mein hain , aur tumhari khatir raat aur din ko bhi kaam per lagaya .

ayahs.text: aur tum ney jo kuch maanga , uss ney uss mein say ( jo tumharay liye munasib tha ) tumhen diya . aur agar tum Allah ki naimaton ko shumar kernay lago to shumar ( bhi ) nahi ker-saktay . haqeeqat yeh hai kay insan boht bey insaf , bara nashukra hai .
ayahs.translation: aur tum ney jo kuch maanga , uss ney uss mein say ( jo tumharay liye munasib tha ) tumhen diya . aur agar tum Allah ki naimaton ko shumar kernay lago to shumar ( bhi ) nahi ker-saktay . haqeeqat yeh hai kay insan boht bey insaf , bara nashukra hai .

ayahs.text: aur yaad kero woh waqt jab Ibrahim ney ( Allah taalaa say dua kertay huye ) kaha tha kay :  ya rab ! iss shehar ko pur aman bana dijiye ,   aur mujhay aur meray beton ko iss baat say bachaiye kay hum button ki parastish keren .
ayahs.translation: aur yaad kero woh waqt jab Ibrahim ney ( Allah taalaa say dua kertay huye ) kaha tha kay :  ya rab ! iss shehar ko pur aman bana dijiye ,   aur mujhay aur meray beton ko iss baat say bachaiye kay hum button ki parastish keren .

ayahs.text: meray perwerdigar ! inn button ney logon  ki bari tadaad ko gumrah kiya hai . lehaza jo koi meri raah per chalay , woh to mera hai , aur jo mera kehna naa maaney , to ( uss ka moamla mein aap per chorta hun ) aap boht bakhshney walay baray meharban hain .
ayahs.translation: meray perwerdigar ! inn button ney logon  ki bari tadaad ko gumrah kiya hai . lehaza jo koi meri raah per chalay , woh to mera hai , aur jo mera kehna naa maaney , to ( uss ka moamla mein aap per chorta hun ) aap boht bakhshney walay baray meharban hain .

ayahs.text: aey humaray perwerdigar ! mein ney apni kuch aulad ko aap kay hurmat walay ghar kay paas aik aesi wadi mein laa basaya hai jiss mein koi kheti nahi hoti . humaray perwerdigar ! ( yeh mein ney iss liye kiya ) takay yeh namaz qaeem keren , lehaza logon  kay dilon mein inn kay liye kashish peda ker-dijiye , aur inn ko phalon ka rizq ata farmaiye ,   takay woh shukar guzaar banen .
ayahs.translation: aey humaray perwerdigar ! mein ney apni kuch aulad ko aap kay hurmat walay ghar kay paas aik aesi wadi mein laa basaya hai jiss mein koi kheti nahi hoti . humaray perwerdigar ! ( yeh mein ney iss liye kiya ) takay yeh namaz qaeem keren , lehaza logon  kay dilon mein inn kay liye kashish peda ker-dijiye , aur inn ko phalon ka rizq ata farmaiye ,   takay woh shukar guzaar banen .

ayahs.text: aey humaray rab ! hum jo kaam chup ker kertay hain , woh bhi aap kay ilm mein hain , aur jo kaam aelania kertay hain , woh bhi . aur Allah say naa zameen ki koi cheez chupi hoi hai , naa aasman ki koi cheez .
ayahs.translation: aey humaray rab ! hum jo kaam chup ker kertay hain , woh bhi aap kay ilm mein hain , aur jo kaam aelania kertay hain , woh bhi . aur Allah say naa zameen ki koi cheez chupi hoi hai , naa aasman ki koi cheez .

ayahs.text: tamam tareefen Allah kay liye hain jiss ney mujhay burhapay mein Ismail aur Ishaq ( jaisay betay ) ata farmaye . beyshak mera rab bara duayen sunney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: tamam tareefen Allah kay liye hain jiss ney mujhay burhapay mein Ismail aur Ishaq ( jaisay betay ) ata farmaye . beyshak mera rab bara duayen sunney wala hai .

ayahs.text: ya rab ! mujhay bhi namaz qaeem kernay wala bana dijiye , aur meri aulad mein say bhi ( aesay log peda farmaiye jo namaz qaeem keren . ) aey humaray perwerdigar ! aur meri dua qubool farma-lijiye .
ayahs.translation: ya rab ! mujhay bhi namaz qaeem kernay wala bana dijiye , aur meri aulad mein say bhi ( aesay log peda farmaiye jo namaz qaeem keren . ) aey humaray perwerdigar ! aur meri dua qubool farma-lijiye .

ayahs.text: aey humaray perwerdigar ! jiss din hisab qaeem hoga , uss din meri bhi maghfirat farmaiye , meray walaiden ki bhi ,   aur unn sabb ki bhi jo emaan rakhtay hain .
ayahs.translation: aey humaray perwerdigar ! jiss din hisab qaeem hoga , uss din meri bhi maghfirat farmaiye , meray walaiden ki bhi ,   aur unn sabb ki bhi jo emaan rakhtay hain .

ayahs.text: aur yeh hergiz naa samajhna kay jo kuch yeh zalim ker rahey hain , Allah uss say ghafil hai .   woh to unn logon  ko uss din tak kay liye mohlat dey raha hai jiss mein aankhen phatti ki phatti reh jayen gi .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh hergiz naa samajhna kay jo kuch yeh zalim ker rahey hain , Allah uss say ghafil hai .   woh to unn logon  ko uss din tak kay liye mohlat dey raha hai jiss mein aankhen phatti ki phatti reh jayen gi .

ayahs.text: woh saron ko oopper uthaye dorr rahey hon gay , unn ki nigahen jhapakney ko wapis nahi ayen gi ,   aur unn kay dil ( bad-hawasi mein ) urray jarahey hon gay .
ayahs.translation: woh saron ko oopper uthaye dorr rahey hon gay , unn ki nigahen jhapakney ko wapis nahi ayen gi ,   aur unn kay dil ( bad-hawasi mein ) urray jarahey hon gay .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum logon  ko uss din say khabrdar kero jab azab unn per aan parray ga , to uss waqt yeh zalim kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen thori si mauddat kay liye aur mohlat dey dijiye takay hum aap ki dawat qubool kerlen , aur payghumberon ki perwi keren .  ( uss waqt unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  aray kiya tum logon  ney qasmen kha kha ker pehlay yeh nahi kaha tha kay tum per koi zawal nahi aa-sakta-?
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum logon  ko uss din say khabrdar kero jab azab unn per aan parray ga , to uss waqt yeh zalim kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen thori si mauddat kay liye aur mohlat dey dijiye takay hum aap ki dawat qubool kerlen , aur payghumberon ki perwi keren .  ( uss waqt unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  aray kiya tum logon  ney qasmen kha kha ker pehlay yeh nahi kaha tha kay tum per koi zawal nahi aa-sakta-?

ayahs.text: aur tum unn logon  ki bastiyon mein reh chukay thay jinhon ney apni janon per zulm kiya tha , aur yeh baat khul ker tumharay samney aa-chuki thi kay hum ney unn kay sath kaisa sulook kiya , aur hum ney tumhen misalen bhi di then .
ayahs.translation: aur tum unn logon  ki bastiyon mein reh chukay thay jinhon ney apni janon per zulm kiya tha , aur yeh baat khul ker tumharay samney aa-chuki thi kay hum ney unn kay sath kaisa sulook kiya , aur hum ney tumhen misalen bhi di then .

ayahs.text: aur woh log apni sari chaalen chal chukay thay , aur unn ki sari chaalon ka torr Allah kay paas tha , chahye inn/unn ki chaalen aesi kiyon naa hun jinn say pahar bhi apni jagah say hill jayen .
ayahs.translation: aur woh log apni sari chaalen chal chukay thay , aur unn ki sari chaalon ka torr Allah kay paas tha , chahye inn/unn ki chaalen aesi kiyon naa hun jinn say pahar bhi apni jagah say hill jayen .

ayahs.text: lehaza Allah kay baaray mein hergiz yeh khayal bhi dil mein naa lana kay uss ney apney payghumberon say jo wada ker rakha hai ,uss ki khilaf warzi keray ga . yaqeen rakho kay Allah apney iqtidar mein sabb per ghalib hai , ( aur ) intiqam lenay wala hai .
ayahs.translation: lehaza Allah kay baaray mein hergiz yeh khayal bhi dil mein naa lana kay uss ney apney payghumberon say jo wada ker rakha hai ,uss ki khilaf warzi keray ga . yaqeen rakho kay Allah apney iqtidar mein sabb per ghalib hai , ( aur ) intiqam lenay wala hai .

ayahs.text: uss din jab yeh zameen aik doosri zameen say badal di jaye gi , aur aasman bhi ( badal jayen gay ) aur sabb kay sabb khudaye wahid o qahaar kay samney paish hon gay .
ayahs.translation: uss din jab yeh zameen aik doosri zameen say badal di jaye gi , aur aasman bhi ( badal jayen gay ) aur sabb kay sabb khudaye wahid o qahaar kay samney paish hon gay .

ayahs.text: aur uss din tum mujrimon ko iss halat mein dekho gay kay woh zanjeeron mein jakray huye hon gay .
ayahs.translation: aur uss din tum mujrimon ko iss halat mein dekho gay kay woh zanjeeron mein jakray huye hon gay .

ayahs.text: unn kay qamees tarkol kay hon gay , aur aag unn kay chehron per chai hoi hogi ,
ayahs.translation: unn kay qamees tarkol kay hon gay , aur aag unn kay chehron per chai hoi hogi ,

ayahs.text: takay Allah her shaks ko uss kay kiye ka badla dey . yaqeenan Allah jald hisab chukaney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: takay Allah her shaks ko uss kay kiye ka badla dey . yaqeenan Allah jald hisab chukaney wala hai .

ayahs.text: yeh tamam logon  kay liye aik paygham hai , aur iss liye diya jaraha hai takay unhen iss kay zariye khabrdar kiya jaye , aur takay woh jaan len kay mabood-e-bar-haq bus aik hi hai , aur takay samajh rakhney walay naseehat hasil kerlen .
ayahs.translation: yeh tamam logon  kay liye aik paygham hai , aur iss liye diya jaraha hai takay unhen iss kay zariye khabrdar kiya jaye , aur takay woh jaan len kay mabood-e-bar-haq bus aik hi hai , aur takay samajh rakhney walay naseehat hasil kerlen .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: Alif-Laam-Raa . yeh ( Allah ki ) kitab aur roshan Quran ki aayaten hain .
verses.translation: Alif-Laam-Raa . yeh ( Allah ki ) kitab aur roshan Quran ki aayaten hain .

verses.text: aik waqt aaye ga jab yeh kafir log bari tamannayen keren gay kay kaash woh musalman hotay .
verses.translation: aik waqt aaye ga jab yeh kafir log bari tamannayen keren gay kay kaash woh musalman hotay .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) enhen inn ki halat per chorr do kay yeh khoob kha len , mazay urra len , aur khayali umeeden enhen ghaflat mein daalay rakhen ,   kiyonkay unqareeb enhen pata chal jaye ga ( kay haqeeqat kiya thi ) .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) enhen inn ki halat per chorr do kay yeh khoob kha len , mazay urra len , aur khayali umeeden enhen ghaflat mein daalay rakhen ,   kiyonkay unqareeb enhen pata chal jaye ga ( kay haqeeqat kiya thi ) .

verses.text: aur hum ney jiss kissi basti ko halak kiya tha , uss kay liye aik moyyan waqt likha huwa tha .
verses.translation: aur hum ney jiss kissi basti ko halak kiya tha , uss kay liye aik moyyan waqt likha huwa tha .

verses.text: koi qoam apney moyyan waqt say naa pehlay halak hoti hai , aur naa uss say aagay jasakti hai .
verses.translation: koi qoam apney moyyan waqt say naa pehlay halak hoti hai , aur naa uss say aagay jasakti hai .

verses.text: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  aey woh shaks jiss per yeh ziker ( yani Quran ) utaara gaya hai ! tum yaqeeni tor per majnoon ho .
verses.translation: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  aey woh shaks jiss per yeh ziker ( yani Quran ) utaara gaya hai ! tum yaqeeni tor per majnoon ho .

verses.text: agar tum waqaee sachay ho to humaray paas farishton ko kiyon nahi ley aatay-?
verses.translation: agar tum waqaee sachay ho to humaray paas farishton ko kiyon nahi ley aatay-?

verses.text: hum farishton ko utaartay hain to bar-haq faisla dey ker utaartay hain , aur aisa hota to unn ko mohlat bhi naa milti .
verses.translation: hum farishton ko utaartay hain to bar-haq faisla dey ker utaartay hain , aur aisa hota to unn ko mohlat bhi naa milti .

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh ziker ( yani Quran ) hum ney hi utaara hai , aur hum hi iss ki hifazat kernay walay hain .
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh ziker ( yani Quran ) hum ney hi utaara hai , aur hum hi iss ki hifazat kernay walay hain .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum tum say pehlay bhi pichli qoamon kay mukhtalif girohon mein apney payghumber bhej chukay hain .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum tum say pehlay bhi pichli qoamon kay mukhtalif girohon mein apney payghumber bhej chukay hain .

verses.text: aur unn kay paas koi Rasool aisa nahi aata tha jiss ka woh mazaq naa uratay hon .
verses.translation: aur unn kay paas koi Rasool aisa nahi aata tha jiss ka woh mazaq naa uratay hon .

verses.text: mujrim logon  kay dilon mein yeh baat   hum issi tarah dakhil kertay hain
verses.translation: mujrim logon  kay dilon mein yeh baat   hum issi tarah dakhil kertay hain

verses.text: kay who uss per emaan nahi latay . aur pichlay logon  ka bhi yehi tareeqa chala aaya hai .
verses.translation: kay who uss per emaan nahi latay . aur pichlay logon  ka bhi yehi tareeqa chala aaya hai .

verses.text: aur agar ( bil-farz ) hum unn kay liye aasman ka koi darwaza khol den , aur woh din ki roshni mein uss per charrhtay bhi chalay jayen ,
verses.translation: aur agar ( bil-farz ) hum unn kay liye aasman ka koi darwaza khol den , aur woh din ki roshni mein uss per charrhtay bhi chalay jayen ,

verses.text: tab bhi yehi kahen gay kay humari nazar bandi kerdi gaee hai , balkay hum log jadoo kay asar mein aaye huye hain .
verses.translation: tab bhi yehi kahen gay kay humari nazar bandi kerdi gaee hai , balkay hum log jadoo kay asar mein aaye huye hain .

verses.text: aur hum ney aasman mein boht say burj banaye hain ,   aur uss ko dekhney walon kay liye sajawat ata ki hai ,
verses.translation: aur hum ney aasman mein boht say burj banaye hain ,   aur uss ko dekhney walon kay liye sajawat ata ki hai ,

verses.text: aur ussay her mardood shetan say mehfooz rakha hai ,
verses.translation: aur ussay her mardood shetan say mehfooz rakha hai ,

verses.text: albatta jo koi chori say kuch sunney ki koshish keray to aik roshan shola uss ka peecha kerta hai .
verses.translation: albatta jo koi chori say kuch sunney ki koshish keray to aik roshan shola uss ka peecha kerta hai .

verses.text: aur zameen ko hum ney phela diya hai , aur uss ko jamaney kay liye uss mein pahar rakh diye hain ,   aur uss mein her qisam ki cheezen tawazun kay sath ugai hain .
verses.translation: aur zameen ko hum ney phela diya hai , aur uss ko jamaney kay liye uss mein pahar rakh diye hain ,   aur uss mein her qisam ki cheezen tawazun kay sath ugai hain .

verses.text: aur uss mein tumharay liye bhi rozi kay saman peda kiye hain , aur unn ( makhlooqaat ) kay liye bhi jinhen tum rizq nahi detay .
verses.translation: aur uss mein tumharay liye bhi rozi kay saman peda kiye hain , aur unn ( makhlooqaat ) kay liye bhi jinhen tum rizq nahi detay .

verses.text: aur koi ( zaroorat ki ) cheez aesi nahi hai jiss kay humaray paas khazaney mojood naa hon , magar hum uss ko aik moyyan miqdaar mein utaartay hain .
verses.translation: aur koi ( zaroorat ki ) cheez aesi nahi hai jiss kay humaray paas khazaney mojood naa hon , magar hum uss ko aik moyyan miqdaar mein utaartay hain .

verses.text: aur woh hawayen jo badalon ko paani say bhar deti hain , hum ney bheji hain , phir aasman say paani hum ney utaara hai , phir iss/uss say tumhen sairaab hum ney kiya hai , aur tumharay bus mein yeh nahi hai kay tum iss/uss ko zakheera ker kay rakh sako .
verses.translation: aur woh hawayen jo badalon ko paani say bhar deti hain , hum ney bheji hain , phir aasman say paani hum ney utaara hai , phir iss/uss say tumhen sairaab hum ney kiya hai , aur tumharay bus mein yeh nahi hai kay tum iss/uss ko zakheera ker kay rakh sako .

verses.text: hum hi zindagi detay hain , aur hum hi moat detay hain , aur hum hi sabb kay waris hain .
verses.translation: hum hi zindagi detay hain , aur hum hi moat detay hain , aur hum hi sabb kay waris hain .

verses.text: tum mein say jo aagay nikal gaye hain , unn ko bhi hum jantay hain , aur jo peechay reh gaye hain , unn say bhi hum waqif hain .
verses.translation: tum mein say jo aagay nikal gaye hain , unn ko bhi hum jantay hain , aur jo peechay reh gaye hain , unn say bhi hum waqif hain .

verses.text: aur yaqeen rakho kay tumhara perwerdigar hi hai jo inn/unn sabb ko hashar mein ikattha keray ga , beyshak uss ki hikmat bhi bari hai , uss ka ilm bhi bara .
verses.translation: aur yaqeen rakho kay tumhara perwerdigar hi hai jo inn/unn sabb ko hashar mein ikattha keray ga , beyshak uss ki hikmat bhi bari hai , uss ka ilm bhi bara .

verses.text: hum ney insan ko sarray huye garay ki khankhanati hoi mitti say peda kiya ,
verses.translation: hum ney insan ko sarray huye garay ki khankhanati hoi mitti say peda kiya ,

verses.text: aur jinnaat ko iss say pehlay hum ney lo ki aag say peda kiya tha .
verses.translation: aur jinnaat ko iss say pehlay hum ney lo ki aag say peda kiya tha .

verses.text: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab tumharay perwerdigar ney farishton say kaha tha kay :  mein garay ki khankhanati hoi mitti say aik bashar ko peda kernay wala hun .
verses.translation: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab tumharay perwerdigar ney farishton say kaha tha kay :  mein garay ki khankhanati hoi mitti say aik bashar ko peda kernay wala hun .

verses.text: lehaza jab mein uss ko poori tarah bana lun , aur uss mein apni rooh phoonk dun to tum sabb uss kay aagay sajday mein gir jana .
verses.translation: lehaza jab mein uss ko poori tarah bana lun , aur uss mein apni rooh phoonk dun to tum sabb uss kay aagay sajday mein gir jana .

verses.text: chunacheh saray kay saray farishton ney sajda kiya ,
verses.translation: chunacheh saray kay saray farishton ney sajda kiya ,

verses.text: siwaye iblees kay kay uss ney sajda kernay walon mein shamil honey say inkar kerdiya .
verses.translation: siwaye iblees kay kay uss ney sajda kernay walon mein shamil honey say inkar kerdiya .

verses.text: Allah ney kaha :  iblees ! tujhay kiya huwa kay tu sajda kernay walon mein shamil nahi huwa-?
verses.translation: Allah ney kaha :  iblees ! tujhay kiya huwa kay tu sajda kernay walon mein shamil nahi huwa-?

verses.text: uss ney kaha :  mein aisa ( gira huwa ) nahi hun kay aik aesay bashar ko sajda kerun jissay tu ney sarray huye garay ki khankhanati hoi mitti say peda kiya hai .
verses.translation: uss ney kaha :  mein aisa ( gira huwa ) nahi hun kay aik aesay bashar ko sajda kerun jissay tu ney sarray huye garay ki khankhanati hoi mitti say peda kiya hai .

verses.text: Allah ney kaha :  acha to yahan say nikal jaa , kiyonkay tu mardood hogaya hai ,
verses.translation: Allah ney kaha :  acha to yahan say nikal jaa , kiyonkay tu mardood hogaya hai ,

verses.text: aur tujh per qayamat kay din tak phitkaar parri rahey gi .
verses.translation: aur tujh per qayamat kay din tak phitkaar parri rahey gi .

verses.text: kehney laga :  ya rab ! phir mujhay uss din tak ( zinda rehney ki ) mohlat deydey jab log marney kay baad dobara zinda kiye jayen gay .
verses.translation: kehney laga :  ya rab ! phir mujhay uss din tak ( zinda rehney ki ) mohlat deydey jab log marney kay baad dobara zinda kiye jayen gay .

verses.text: Allah ney farmaya kay :  jaa phir tujhay mohlat ( to ) dey di gaee .
verses.translation: Allah ney farmaya kay :  jaa phir tujhay mohlat ( to ) dey di gaee .

verses.text: . ( magar ) aik aesi miyaad kay din tak jo hamen maloom hai .
verses.translation: . ( magar ) aik aesi miyaad kay din tak jo hamen maloom hai .

verses.text: kehney laga :  ya rab ! chunkay tu ney mujhay gumrah kiya hai , iss liye abb mein qasam khata hun kay inn insanon kay liye duniya mein dilkashi peda kerun ga ,   aur inn sabb ko gumrah ker kay rahun ga ,
verses.translation: kehney laga :  ya rab ! chunkay tu ney mujhay gumrah kiya hai , iss liye abb mein qasam khata hun kay inn insanon kay liye duniya mein dilkashi peda kerun ga ,   aur inn sabb ko gumrah ker kay rahun ga ,

verses.text: siwaye teray unn bandon kay jinhen tu ney unn mein say apney liye mukhlis bana liya ho .
verses.translation: siwaye teray unn bandon kay jinhen tu ney unn mein say apney liye mukhlis bana liya ho .

verses.text: Allah ney farmaya :  yeh hai woh seedha raasta jo mujh tak phonchta hai .
verses.translation: Allah ney farmaya :  yeh hai woh seedha raasta jo mujh tak phonchta hai .

verses.text: yaqeen rakh kay jo meray banday hain , unn per tera koi zor nahi chalay ga ,   siwaye unn gumrah logon  kay jo teray peechay chalen gay
verses.translation: yaqeen rakh kay jo meray banday hain , unn per tera koi zor nahi chalay ga ,   siwaye unn gumrah logon  kay jo teray peechay chalen gay

verses.text: aur jahannum aesay tamam logon  ka tey shuda thikana hai .
verses.translation: aur jahannum aesay tamam logon  ka tey shuda thikana hai .

verses.text: uss kay saat darwazay hain . her darwazay ( mein dakhlay ) kay liye unn ( dozakhiyon ka ) aik aik giroh baant diya gaya hai .
verses.translation: uss kay saat darwazay hain . her darwazay ( mein dakhlay ) kay liye unn ( dozakhiyon ka ) aik aik giroh baant diya gaya hai .

verses.text: . ( doosri taraf ) muttaqi log baaghaat aur chashmon kay darmiyan rahen gay .
verses.translation: . ( doosri taraf ) muttaqi log baaghaat aur chashmon kay darmiyan rahen gay .

verses.text: . ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay )  inn ( baaghaat ) mein salamti kay sath bey khof ho ker dakhil hojao .
verses.translation: . ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay )  inn ( baaghaat ) mein salamti kay sath bey khof ho ker dakhil hojao .

verses.text: unn kay seenon mein jo kuch ranjish hogi , ussay hum nikal phenken gay ,   woh bhai bhai ban ker aamney samney oonchi nishiston per bethay hon gay .
verses.translation: unn kay seenon mein jo kuch ranjish hogi , ussay hum nikal phenken gay ,   woh bhai bhai ban ker aamney samney oonchi nishiston per bethay hon gay .

verses.text: wahan naa koi thakan unn kay paas aaye gi , aur naa unn ko wahan say nikala jaye ga .
verses.translation: wahan naa koi thakan unn kay paas aaye gi , aur naa unn ko wahan say nikala jaye ga .

verses.text: meray bandon ko bata do kay mein hi boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hun .
verses.translation: meray bandon ko bata do kay mein hi boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hun .

verses.text: aur yeh bhi bata do kay mera azab hi dardnak azab hai .
verses.translation: aur yeh bhi bata do kay mera azab hi dardnak azab hai .

verses.text: aur enhen Ibrahim kay mehmano ka haal suna do ,
verses.translation: aur enhen Ibrahim kay mehmano ka haal suna do ,

verses.text: uss waqt ka haal jab woh unn kay paas phonchay , aur salam kiya . Ibrahim ney kaha kay :  hamen to tum say darr lagg raha hai .
verses.translation: uss waqt ka haal jab woh unn kay paas phonchay , aur salam kiya . Ibrahim ney kaha kay :  hamen to tum say darr lagg raha hai .

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  dariye nahi , hum to aap ko aik sahab ilm-e-larkay ( ki wiladat ) ki khushkhabri dey rahey hain .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  dariye nahi , hum to aap ko aik sahab ilm-e-larkay ( ki wiladat ) ki khushkhabri dey rahey hain .

verses.text: Ibrahim ney kaha :  kiya tum mujhay iss halat mein khushkhabri dey rahey ho jabkay mujh per burhapa chah chuka hai ? phir kiss buniyad per mujhay khushkhabri dey rahey ho-?
verses.translation: Ibrahim ney kaha :  kiya tum mujhay iss halat mein khushkhabri dey rahey ho jabkay mujh per burhapa chah chuka hai ? phir kiss buniyad per mujhay khushkhabri dey rahey ho-?

verses.text: woh bolay :  hum ney aap ko sachi khushkhabri di hai , lehaza aap unn logon  mein shamil naa hon jo naa umeed hojatay hain .
verses.translation: woh bolay :  hum ney aap ko sachi khushkhabri di hai , lehaza aap unn logon  mein shamil naa hon jo naa umeed hojatay hain .

verses.text: Ibrahim ney kaha :  apney perwerdigar ki rehmat say gumrahon kay siwa kon na-umeed hosakta hai ?
verses.translation: Ibrahim ney kaha :  apney perwerdigar ki rehmat say gumrahon kay siwa kon na-umeed hosakta hai ?

verses.text: . ( phir ) unhon ney poocha kay :  Allah kay bhejay huye farishto ! abb aap kay samney kiya mohim hai ?
verses.translation: . ( phir ) unhon ney poocha kay :  Allah kay bhejay huye farishto ! abb aap kay samney kiya mohim hai ?

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  hamen aik mujrim qoam ki taraf ( azab nazil kernay kay liye ) bheja gaya hai ,
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  hamen aik mujrim qoam ki taraf ( azab nazil kernay kay liye ) bheja gaya hai ,

verses.text: albatta loot kay ghar walay uss say mustasna hain , unn sabb ko hum bachlen gay ,
verses.translation: albatta loot kay ghar walay uss say mustasna hain , unn sabb ko hum bachlen gay ,

verses.text: siwaye unn ki biwi kay . hum ney yeh tey ker rakha hai kay woh unn logon  mein shamil rahey gi jo ( azab ka nishana banney kay liye ) peechay reh jayen gay .
verses.translation: siwaye unn ki biwi kay . hum ney yeh tey ker rakha hai kay woh unn logon  mein shamil rahey gi jo ( azab ka nishana banney kay liye ) peechay reh jayen gay .

verses.text: chunacheh jab yeh farishtay loot kay ghar walon kay paas phonchay .
verses.translation: chunacheh jab yeh farishtay loot kay ghar walon kay paas phonchay .

verses.text: to loot ney kaha :  aap log ajnabi maloom hotay hain .
verses.translation: to loot ney kaha :  aap log ajnabi maloom hotay hain .

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  nahi , balkay hum aap kay paas woh ( azab ) ley ker aaye hain jiss mein yeh log shak kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  nahi , balkay hum aap kay paas woh ( azab ) ley ker aaye hain jiss mein yeh log shak kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: hum aap kay paas atal faisla ley ker aaye hain , aur yaqeen rakhiye kay hum sachay hain .
verses.translation: hum aap kay paas atal faisla ley ker aaye hain , aur yaqeen rakhiye kay hum sachay hain .

verses.text: lehaza aap raat kay kissi hissay mein apney ghar walon ko ley ker nikal jaiye , aur aap khud unn kay peechay peechay chaliye ,   aur aap mein say koi peechay murr ker naa dekhay , aur wahin janey kay liye chaltay rahen jahan ka aap ko hukum diya jaraha hai .
verses.translation: lehaza aap raat kay kissi hissay mein apney ghar walon ko ley ker nikal jaiye , aur aap khud unn kay peechay peechay chaliye ,   aur aap mein say koi peechay murr ker naa dekhay , aur wahin janey kay liye chaltay rahen jahan ka aap ko hukum diya jaraha hai .

verses.text: aur ( iss tarah ) hum ney loot tak apna yeh faisla phoncha diya kay subha hotay hi inn logon  ki jarr kaat ker rakh di jaye gi .
verses.translation: aur ( iss tarah ) hum ney loot tak apna yeh faisla phoncha diya kay subha hotay hi inn logon  ki jarr kaat ker rakh di jaye gi .

verses.text: aur shehar walay khushi manatay huye ( loot kay paas ) aa-phonchay .
verses.translation: aur shehar walay khushi manatay huye ( loot kay paas ) aa-phonchay .

verses.text: loot ney ( unn say ) kaha kay :  yeh log meray mehman hain , lehaza mujhay ruswa naa kero ,
verses.translation: loot ney ( unn say ) kaha kay :  yeh log meray mehman hain , lehaza mujhay ruswa naa kero ,

verses.text: aur Allah say daro , aur mujhay zaleel naa kero .
verses.translation: aur Allah say daro , aur mujhay zaleel naa kero .

verses.text: kehney lagay :  kiya hum ney aap ko pehlay hi duniya jahan kay logon  ( ko mehman bananey ) say mana nahi ker rakha tha-?
verses.translation: kehney lagay :  kiya hum ney aap ko pehlay hi duniya jahan kay logon  ( ko mehman bananey ) say mana nahi ker rakha tha-?

verses.text: loot ney kaha :  agar tum meray kehney per amal kero to yeh meri betiyan ( jo tumharay nikah mein hain , tumharay paas ) mojood hi hain .
verses.translation: loot ney kaha :  agar tum meray kehney per amal kero to yeh meri betiyan ( jo tumharay nikah mein hain , tumharay paas ) mojood hi hain .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) tumhari zindagi ki qasam ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh log apni bad-masti mein andhay banay huye thay .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) tumhari zindagi ki qasam ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh log apni bad-masti mein andhay banay huye thay .

verses.text: chunacheh sooraj nikaltay hi unn ko chinghaarr ney aa-pakra ,
verses.translation: chunacheh sooraj nikaltay hi unn ko chinghaarr ney aa-pakra ,

verses.text: phir hum ney uss zameen ko tah o baala ker kay rakh diya , aur unn per pakki mitti kay pathron ki barish barsa di .
verses.translation: phir hum ney uss zameen ko tah o baala ker kay rakh diya , aur unn per pakki mitti kay pathron ki barish barsa di .

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay iss saray waqaey mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo ibrat ki nigah say dekhtay hon .
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay iss saray waqaey mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo ibrat ki nigah say dekhtay hon .

verses.text: aur yeh bastiyan aik aesay raastay per waqay hain jiss per log mustaqil chaltay rehtay hain .
verses.translation: aur yeh bastiyan aik aesay raastay per waqay hain jiss per log mustaqil chaltay rehtay hain .

verses.text: yaqeenan iss mein emaan walon kay liye bari ibrat hai .
verses.translation: yaqeenan iss mein emaan walon kay liye bari ibrat hai .

verses.text: aur aieka kay bashinday ( bhi ) baray zalim thay .
verses.translation: aur aieka kay bashinday ( bhi ) baray zalim thay .

verses.text: chunacheh hum ney unn say bhi intiqam liya . aur unn dono qoamon ki bastiyan khuli shahraah per waqay hain .
verses.translation: chunacheh hum ney unn say bhi intiqam liya . aur unn dono qoamon ki bastiyan khuli shahraah per waqay hain .

verses.text: aur hajar kay bashindon ney bhi payghumberon ko jhutlaya tha .
verses.translation: aur hajar kay bashindon ney bhi payghumberon ko jhutlaya tha .

verses.text: aur hum ney unn ko apni nishaniyan den to woh unn say mun morray rahey .
verses.translation: aur hum ney unn ko apni nishaniyan den to woh unn say mun morray rahey .

verses.text: aur woh paharon ko tarash tarash ker bey khof o khatar makan banaya kertay thay .
verses.translation: aur woh paharon ko tarash tarash ker bey khof o khatar makan banaya kertay thay .

verses.text: aakhir unhen subha subha aik chinghaarr ney aa-pakra .
verses.translation: aakhir unhen subha subha aik chinghaarr ney aa-pakra .

verses.text: aur nateeja yeh huwa kay jiss hunar say woh kamai kertay thay , woh unn kay kuch kaam naa aaya .
verses.translation: aur nateeja yeh huwa kay jiss hunar say woh kamai kertay thay , woh unn kay kuch kaam naa aaya .

verses.text: aur hum ney aasmano aur zameen ko aur unn kay darmiyan jo kuch hai uss ko kissi bar-haq maqsad kay baghair peda nahi kiya .   aur qayamat ki gharri aa-ker rahey gi . lehaza ( aey payghumber ! inn kafiron kay tarz-e-amal per ) khoobsurti kay sath darguzar say kaam lo .
verses.translation: aur hum ney aasmano aur zameen ko aur unn kay darmiyan jo kuch hai uss ko kissi bar-haq maqsad kay baghair peda nahi kiya .   aur qayamat ki gharri aa-ker rahey gi . lehaza ( aey payghumber ! inn kafiron kay tarz-e-amal per ) khoobsurti kay sath darguzar say kaam lo .

verses.text: yaqeen rakho kay tumhara rab hi sabb ko peda kernay wala , sabb kuch janney wala hai .
verses.translation: yaqeen rakho kay tumhara rab hi sabb ko peda kernay wala , sabb kuch janney wala hai .

verses.text: aur hum ney tumhen saat aesi aayaten dey rakhi hain jo baar baar parhi jati hain ,   aur azmat wala Quran ata kiya hai .
verses.translation: aur hum ney tumhen saat aesi aayaten dey rakhi hain jo baar baar parhi jati hain ,   aur azmat wala Quran ata kiya hai .

verses.text: aur tum unn cheezon ki taraf hergiz aankh utha ker bhi naa dekho jo hum ney inn ( kafiron ) mein say mukhtalif logon  ko mazay uraney kay liye dey rakhi hain , aur naa inn logon  per apna dil kurrhao , aur jo log emaan ley aaye hain , unn kay liye apni shafqat ka bazoo phela do .
verses.translation: aur tum unn cheezon ki taraf hergiz aankh utha ker bhi naa dekho jo hum ney inn ( kafiron ) mein say mukhtalif logon  ko mazay uraney kay liye dey rakhi hain , aur naa inn logon  per apna dil kurrhao , aur jo log emaan ley aaye hain , unn kay liye apni shafqat ka bazoo phela do .

verses.text: aur ( kufr kernay walon say ) keh do kay mein to bus khulay alfaz mein tanbeeh kernay wala hun .
verses.translation: aur ( kufr kernay walon say ) keh do kay mein to bus khulay alfaz mein tanbeeh kernay wala hun .

verses.text: . ( yeh tanbeeh Quran-e-azeem kay zariye ussi tarah nazil ki gaee hai ) jaisay hum ney unn tafarqa kernay walon per nazil ki thi .
verses.translation: . ( yeh tanbeeh Quran-e-azeem kay zariye ussi tarah nazil ki gaee hai ) jaisay hum ney unn tafarqa kernay walon per nazil ki thi .

verses.text: jinhon ney ( apni ) parhi janey wali kitab kay hissay bakhray kerliye thay .
verses.translation: jinhon ney ( apni ) parhi janey wali kitab kay hissay bakhray kerliye thay .

verses.text: chunacheh tumharay rab ki qasam ! hum aik aik ker kay unn sabb say poochen gay .
verses.translation: chunacheh tumharay rab ki qasam ! hum aik aik ker kay unn sabb say poochen gay .

verses.text: kay woh kiya kuch kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: kay woh kiya kuch kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: lehaza jiss baat ka tumhen hukum diya jaraha hai , ussay al-al-aelaan logon  ko suna do ,   aur jo log ( phir bhi ) shirk keren , unn ki perwa matt kero .
verses.translation: lehaza jiss baat ka tumhen hukum diya jaraha hai , ussay al-al-aelaan logon  ko suna do ,   aur jo log ( phir bhi ) shirk keren , unn ki perwa matt kero .

verses.text: yaqeen rakho kay hum tumhari taraf say unn logon  say nimatney kay liye kafi hain jo ( tumhara ) mazaq uratay hain ,
verses.translation: yaqeen rakho kay hum tumhari taraf say unn logon  say nimatney kay liye kafi hain jo ( tumhara ) mazaq uratay hain ,

verses.text: jinhon ney Allah kay sath koi aur mabood gharr rakha hai . chunacheh unqareeb unhen sabb pata chal jaye ga .
verses.translation: jinhon ney Allah kay sath koi aur mabood gharr rakha hai . chunacheh unqareeb unhen sabb pata chal jaye ga .

verses.text: yaqeenan hum jantay hain kay jo baaten yeh banatay hain , unn say tumhara dil tang hota hai .
verses.translation: yaqeenan hum jantay hain kay jo baaten yeh banatay hain , unn say tumhara dil tang hota hai .

verses.text: to ( iss ka ilaj yeh hai kay ) tum apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh kertay raho , aur sajda baja laney walon mein shamil raho .
verses.translation: to ( iss ka ilaj yeh hai kay ) tum apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh kertay raho , aur sajda baja laney walon mein shamil raho .

verses.text: aur apney perwerdigar ki ibadat kertay raho , yahan tak kay tum per woh cheez aajaye jiss ka aana yaqeeni hai .
verses.translation: aur apney perwerdigar ki ibadat kertay raho , yahan tak kay tum per woh cheez aajaye jiss ka aana yaqeeni hai .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: Alif-Laam-Raa . yeh ( Allah ki ) kitab aur roshan Quran ki aayaten hain .
ayahs.translation: Alif-Laam-Raa . yeh ( Allah ki ) kitab aur roshan Quran ki aayaten hain .

ayahs.text: aik waqt aaye ga jab yeh kafir log bari tamannayen keren gay kay kaash woh musalman hotay .
ayahs.translation: aik waqt aaye ga jab yeh kafir log bari tamannayen keren gay kay kaash woh musalman hotay .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) enhen inn ki halat per chorr do kay yeh khoob kha len , mazay urra len , aur khayali umeeden enhen ghaflat mein daalay rakhen ,   kiyonkay unqareeb enhen pata chal jaye ga ( kay haqeeqat kiya thi ) .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) enhen inn ki halat per chorr do kay yeh khoob kha len , mazay urra len , aur khayali umeeden enhen ghaflat mein daalay rakhen ,   kiyonkay unqareeb enhen pata chal jaye ga ( kay haqeeqat kiya thi ) .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney jiss kissi basti ko halak kiya tha , uss kay liye aik moyyan waqt likha huwa tha .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney jiss kissi basti ko halak kiya tha , uss kay liye aik moyyan waqt likha huwa tha .

ayahs.text: koi qoam apney moyyan waqt say naa pehlay halak hoti hai , aur naa uss say aagay jasakti hai .
ayahs.translation: koi qoam apney moyyan waqt say naa pehlay halak hoti hai , aur naa uss say aagay jasakti hai .

ayahs.text: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  aey woh shaks jiss per yeh ziker ( yani Quran ) utaara gaya hai ! tum yaqeeni tor per majnoon ho .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  aey woh shaks jiss per yeh ziker ( yani Quran ) utaara gaya hai ! tum yaqeeni tor per majnoon ho .

ayahs.text: agar tum waqaee sachay ho to humaray paas farishton ko kiyon nahi ley aatay-?
ayahs.translation: agar tum waqaee sachay ho to humaray paas farishton ko kiyon nahi ley aatay-?

ayahs.text: hum farishton ko utaartay hain to bar-haq faisla dey ker utaartay hain , aur aisa hota to unn ko mohlat bhi naa milti .
ayahs.translation: hum farishton ko utaartay hain to bar-haq faisla dey ker utaartay hain , aur aisa hota to unn ko mohlat bhi naa milti .

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh ziker ( yani Quran ) hum ney hi utaara hai , aur hum hi iss ki hifazat kernay walay hain .
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh ziker ( yani Quran ) hum ney hi utaara hai , aur hum hi iss ki hifazat kernay walay hain .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum tum say pehlay bhi pichli qoamon kay mukhtalif girohon mein apney payghumber bhej chukay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum tum say pehlay bhi pichli qoamon kay mukhtalif girohon mein apney payghumber bhej chukay hain .

ayahs.text: aur unn kay paas koi Rasool aisa nahi aata tha jiss ka woh mazaq naa uratay hon .
ayahs.translation: aur unn kay paas koi Rasool aisa nahi aata tha jiss ka woh mazaq naa uratay hon .

ayahs.text: mujrim logon  kay dilon mein yeh baat   hum issi tarah dakhil kertay hain
ayahs.translation: mujrim logon  kay dilon mein yeh baat   hum issi tarah dakhil kertay hain

ayahs.text: kay who uss per emaan nahi latay . aur pichlay logon  ka bhi yehi tareeqa chala aaya hai .
ayahs.translation: kay who uss per emaan nahi latay . aur pichlay logon  ka bhi yehi tareeqa chala aaya hai .

ayahs.text: aur agar ( bil-farz ) hum unn kay liye aasman ka koi darwaza khol den , aur woh din ki roshni mein uss per charrhtay bhi chalay jayen ,
ayahs.translation: aur agar ( bil-farz ) hum unn kay liye aasman ka koi darwaza khol den , aur woh din ki roshni mein uss per charrhtay bhi chalay jayen ,

ayahs.text: tab bhi yehi kahen gay kay humari nazar bandi kerdi gaee hai , balkay hum log jadoo kay asar mein aaye huye hain .
ayahs.translation: tab bhi yehi kahen gay kay humari nazar bandi kerdi gaee hai , balkay hum log jadoo kay asar mein aaye huye hain .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney aasman mein boht say burj banaye hain ,   aur uss ko dekhney walon kay liye sajawat ata ki hai ,
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney aasman mein boht say burj banaye hain ,   aur uss ko dekhney walon kay liye sajawat ata ki hai ,

ayahs.text: aur ussay her mardood shetan say mehfooz rakha hai ,
ayahs.translation: aur ussay her mardood shetan say mehfooz rakha hai ,

ayahs.text: albatta jo koi chori say kuch sunney ki koshish keray to aik roshan shola uss ka peecha kerta hai .
ayahs.translation: albatta jo koi chori say kuch sunney ki koshish keray to aik roshan shola uss ka peecha kerta hai .

ayahs.text: aur zameen ko hum ney phela diya hai , aur uss ko jamaney kay liye uss mein pahar rakh diye hain ,   aur uss mein her qisam ki cheezen tawazun kay sath ugai hain .
ayahs.translation: aur zameen ko hum ney phela diya hai , aur uss ko jamaney kay liye uss mein pahar rakh diye hain ,   aur uss mein her qisam ki cheezen tawazun kay sath ugai hain .

ayahs.text: aur uss mein tumharay liye bhi rozi kay saman peda kiye hain , aur unn ( makhlooqaat ) kay liye bhi jinhen tum rizq nahi detay .
ayahs.translation: aur uss mein tumharay liye bhi rozi kay saman peda kiye hain , aur unn ( makhlooqaat ) kay liye bhi jinhen tum rizq nahi detay .

ayahs.text: aur koi ( zaroorat ki ) cheez aesi nahi hai jiss kay humaray paas khazaney mojood naa hon , magar hum uss ko aik moyyan miqdaar mein utaartay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur koi ( zaroorat ki ) cheez aesi nahi hai jiss kay humaray paas khazaney mojood naa hon , magar hum uss ko aik moyyan miqdaar mein utaartay hain .

ayahs.text: aur woh hawayen jo badalon ko paani say bhar deti hain , hum ney bheji hain , phir aasman say paani hum ney utaara hai , phir iss/uss say tumhen sairaab hum ney kiya hai , aur tumharay bus mein yeh nahi hai kay tum iss/uss ko zakheera ker kay rakh sako .
ayahs.translation: aur woh hawayen jo badalon ko paani say bhar deti hain , hum ney bheji hain , phir aasman say paani hum ney utaara hai , phir iss/uss say tumhen sairaab hum ney kiya hai , aur tumharay bus mein yeh nahi hai kay tum iss/uss ko zakheera ker kay rakh sako .

ayahs.text: hum hi zindagi detay hain , aur hum hi moat detay hain , aur hum hi sabb kay waris hain .
ayahs.translation: hum hi zindagi detay hain , aur hum hi moat detay hain , aur hum hi sabb kay waris hain .

ayahs.text: tum mein say jo aagay nikal gaye hain , unn ko bhi hum jantay hain , aur jo peechay reh gaye hain , unn say bhi hum waqif hain .
ayahs.translation: tum mein say jo aagay nikal gaye hain , unn ko bhi hum jantay hain , aur jo peechay reh gaye hain , unn say bhi hum waqif hain .

ayahs.text: aur yaqeen rakho kay tumhara perwerdigar hi hai jo inn/unn sabb ko hashar mein ikattha keray ga , beyshak uss ki hikmat bhi bari hai , uss ka ilm bhi bara .
ayahs.translation: aur yaqeen rakho kay tumhara perwerdigar hi hai jo inn/unn sabb ko hashar mein ikattha keray ga , beyshak uss ki hikmat bhi bari hai , uss ka ilm bhi bara .

ayahs.text: hum ney insan ko sarray huye garay ki khankhanati hoi mitti say peda kiya ,
ayahs.translation: hum ney insan ko sarray huye garay ki khankhanati hoi mitti say peda kiya ,

ayahs.text: aur jinnaat ko iss say pehlay hum ney lo ki aag say peda kiya tha .
ayahs.translation: aur jinnaat ko iss say pehlay hum ney lo ki aag say peda kiya tha .

ayahs.text: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab tumharay perwerdigar ney farishton say kaha tha kay :  mein garay ki khankhanati hoi mitti say aik bashar ko peda kernay wala hun .
ayahs.translation: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab tumharay perwerdigar ney farishton say kaha tha kay :  mein garay ki khankhanati hoi mitti say aik bashar ko peda kernay wala hun .

ayahs.text: lehaza jab mein uss ko poori tarah bana lun , aur uss mein apni rooh phoonk dun to tum sabb uss kay aagay sajday mein gir jana .
ayahs.translation: lehaza jab mein uss ko poori tarah bana lun , aur uss mein apni rooh phoonk dun to tum sabb uss kay aagay sajday mein gir jana .

ayahs.text: chunacheh saray kay saray farishton ney sajda kiya ,
ayahs.translation: chunacheh saray kay saray farishton ney sajda kiya ,

ayahs.text: siwaye iblees kay kay uss ney sajda kernay walon mein shamil honey say inkar kerdiya .
ayahs.translation: siwaye iblees kay kay uss ney sajda kernay walon mein shamil honey say inkar kerdiya .

ayahs.text: Allah ney kaha :  iblees ! tujhay kiya huwa kay tu sajda kernay walon mein shamil nahi huwa-?
ayahs.translation: Allah ney kaha :  iblees ! tujhay kiya huwa kay tu sajda kernay walon mein shamil nahi huwa-?

ayahs.text: uss ney kaha :  mein aisa ( gira huwa ) nahi hun kay aik aesay bashar ko sajda kerun jissay tu ney sarray huye garay ki khankhanati hoi mitti say peda kiya hai .
ayahs.translation: uss ney kaha :  mein aisa ( gira huwa ) nahi hun kay aik aesay bashar ko sajda kerun jissay tu ney sarray huye garay ki khankhanati hoi mitti say peda kiya hai .

ayahs.text: Allah ney kaha :  acha to yahan say nikal jaa , kiyonkay tu mardood hogaya hai ,
ayahs.translation: Allah ney kaha :  acha to yahan say nikal jaa , kiyonkay tu mardood hogaya hai ,

ayahs.text: aur tujh per qayamat kay din tak phitkaar parri rahey gi .
ayahs.translation: aur tujh per qayamat kay din tak phitkaar parri rahey gi .

ayahs.text: kehney laga :  ya rab ! phir mujhay uss din tak ( zinda rehney ki ) mohlat deydey jab log marney kay baad dobara zinda kiye jayen gay .
ayahs.translation: kehney laga :  ya rab ! phir mujhay uss din tak ( zinda rehney ki ) mohlat deydey jab log marney kay baad dobara zinda kiye jayen gay .

ayahs.text: Allah ney farmaya kay :  jaa phir tujhay mohlat ( to ) dey di gaee .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney farmaya kay :  jaa phir tujhay mohlat ( to ) dey di gaee .

ayahs.text: . ( magar ) aik aesi miyaad kay din tak jo hamen maloom hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( magar ) aik aesi miyaad kay din tak jo hamen maloom hai .

ayahs.text: kehney laga :  ya rab ! chunkay tu ney mujhay gumrah kiya hai , iss liye abb mein qasam khata hun kay inn insanon kay liye duniya mein dilkashi peda kerun ga ,   aur inn sabb ko gumrah ker kay rahun ga ,
ayahs.translation: kehney laga :  ya rab ! chunkay tu ney mujhay gumrah kiya hai , iss liye abb mein qasam khata hun kay inn insanon kay liye duniya mein dilkashi peda kerun ga ,   aur inn sabb ko gumrah ker kay rahun ga ,

ayahs.text: siwaye teray unn bandon kay jinhen tu ney unn mein say apney liye mukhlis bana liya ho .
ayahs.translation: siwaye teray unn bandon kay jinhen tu ney unn mein say apney liye mukhlis bana liya ho .

ayahs.text: Allah ney farmaya :  yeh hai woh seedha raasta jo mujh tak phonchta hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney farmaya :  yeh hai woh seedha raasta jo mujh tak phonchta hai .

ayahs.text: yaqeen rakh kay jo meray banday hain , unn per tera koi zor nahi chalay ga ,   siwaye unn gumrah logon  kay jo teray peechay chalen gay
ayahs.translation: yaqeen rakh kay jo meray banday hain , unn per tera koi zor nahi chalay ga ,   siwaye unn gumrah logon  kay jo teray peechay chalen gay

ayahs.text: aur jahannum aesay tamam logon  ka tey shuda thikana hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jahannum aesay tamam logon  ka tey shuda thikana hai .

ayahs.text: uss kay saat darwazay hain . her darwazay ( mein dakhlay ) kay liye unn ( dozakhiyon ka ) aik aik giroh baant diya gaya hai .
ayahs.translation: uss kay saat darwazay hain . her darwazay ( mein dakhlay ) kay liye unn ( dozakhiyon ka ) aik aik giroh baant diya gaya hai .

ayahs.text: . ( doosri taraf ) muttaqi log baaghaat aur chashmon kay darmiyan rahen gay .
ayahs.translation: . ( doosri taraf ) muttaqi log baaghaat aur chashmon kay darmiyan rahen gay .

ayahs.text: . ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay )  inn ( baaghaat ) mein salamti kay sath bey khof ho ker dakhil hojao .
ayahs.translation: . ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay )  inn ( baaghaat ) mein salamti kay sath bey khof ho ker dakhil hojao .

ayahs.text: unn kay seenon mein jo kuch ranjish hogi , ussay hum nikal phenken gay ,   woh bhai bhai ban ker aamney samney oonchi nishiston per bethay hon gay .
ayahs.translation: unn kay seenon mein jo kuch ranjish hogi , ussay hum nikal phenken gay ,   woh bhai bhai ban ker aamney samney oonchi nishiston per bethay hon gay .

ayahs.text: wahan naa koi thakan unn kay paas aaye gi , aur naa unn ko wahan say nikala jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: wahan naa koi thakan unn kay paas aaye gi , aur naa unn ko wahan say nikala jaye ga .

ayahs.text: meray bandon ko bata do kay mein hi boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hun .
ayahs.translation: meray bandon ko bata do kay mein hi boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hun .

ayahs.text: aur yeh bhi bata do kay mera azab hi dardnak azab hai .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh bhi bata do kay mera azab hi dardnak azab hai .

ayahs.text: aur enhen Ibrahim kay mehmano ka haal suna do ,
ayahs.translation: aur enhen Ibrahim kay mehmano ka haal suna do ,

ayahs.text: uss waqt ka haal jab woh unn kay paas phonchay , aur salam kiya . Ibrahim ney kaha kay :  hamen to tum say darr lagg raha hai .
ayahs.translation: uss waqt ka haal jab woh unn kay paas phonchay , aur salam kiya . Ibrahim ney kaha kay :  hamen to tum say darr lagg raha hai .

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha :  dariye nahi , hum to aap ko aik sahab ilm-e-larkay ( ki wiladat ) ki khushkhabri dey rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha :  dariye nahi , hum to aap ko aik sahab ilm-e-larkay ( ki wiladat ) ki khushkhabri dey rahey hain .

ayahs.text: Ibrahim ney kaha :  kiya tum mujhay iss halat mein khushkhabri dey rahey ho jabkay mujh per burhapa chah chuka hai ? phir kiss buniyad per mujhay khushkhabri dey rahey ho-?
ayahs.translation: Ibrahim ney kaha :  kiya tum mujhay iss halat mein khushkhabri dey rahey ho jabkay mujh per burhapa chah chuka hai ? phir kiss buniyad per mujhay khushkhabri dey rahey ho-?

ayahs.text: woh bolay :  hum ney aap ko sachi khushkhabri di hai , lehaza aap unn logon  mein shamil naa hon jo naa umeed hojatay hain .
ayahs.translation: woh bolay :  hum ney aap ko sachi khushkhabri di hai , lehaza aap unn logon  mein shamil naa hon jo naa umeed hojatay hain .

ayahs.text: Ibrahim ney kaha :  apney perwerdigar ki rehmat say gumrahon kay siwa kon na-umeed hosakta hai ?
ayahs.translation: Ibrahim ney kaha :  apney perwerdigar ki rehmat say gumrahon kay siwa kon na-umeed hosakta hai ?

ayahs.text: . ( phir ) unhon ney poocha kay :  Allah kay bhejay huye farishto ! abb aap kay samney kiya mohim hai ?
ayahs.translation: . ( phir ) unhon ney poocha kay :  Allah kay bhejay huye farishto ! abb aap kay samney kiya mohim hai ?

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha :  hamen aik mujrim qoam ki taraf ( azab nazil kernay kay liye ) bheja gaya hai ,
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha :  hamen aik mujrim qoam ki taraf ( azab nazil kernay kay liye ) bheja gaya hai ,

ayahs.text: albatta loot kay ghar walay uss say mustasna hain , unn sabb ko hum bachlen gay ,
ayahs.translation: albatta loot kay ghar walay uss say mustasna hain , unn sabb ko hum bachlen gay ,

ayahs.text: siwaye unn ki biwi kay . hum ney yeh tey ker rakha hai kay woh unn logon  mein shamil rahey gi jo ( azab ka nishana banney kay liye ) peechay reh jayen gay .
ayahs.translation: siwaye unn ki biwi kay . hum ney yeh tey ker rakha hai kay woh unn logon  mein shamil rahey gi jo ( azab ka nishana banney kay liye ) peechay reh jayen gay .

ayahs.text: chunacheh jab yeh farishtay loot kay ghar walon kay paas phonchay .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh jab yeh farishtay loot kay ghar walon kay paas phonchay .

ayahs.text: to loot ney kaha :  aap log ajnabi maloom hotay hain .
ayahs.translation: to loot ney kaha :  aap log ajnabi maloom hotay hain .

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha :  nahi , balkay hum aap kay paas woh ( azab ) ley ker aaye hain jiss mein yeh log shak kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha :  nahi , balkay hum aap kay paas woh ( azab ) ley ker aaye hain jiss mein yeh log shak kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: hum aap kay paas atal faisla ley ker aaye hain , aur yaqeen rakhiye kay hum sachay hain .
ayahs.translation: hum aap kay paas atal faisla ley ker aaye hain , aur yaqeen rakhiye kay hum sachay hain .

ayahs.text: lehaza aap raat kay kissi hissay mein apney ghar walon ko ley ker nikal jaiye , aur aap khud unn kay peechay peechay chaliye ,   aur aap mein say koi peechay murr ker naa dekhay , aur wahin janey kay liye chaltay rahen jahan ka aap ko hukum diya jaraha hai .
ayahs.translation: lehaza aap raat kay kissi hissay mein apney ghar walon ko ley ker nikal jaiye , aur aap khud unn kay peechay peechay chaliye ,   aur aap mein say koi peechay murr ker naa dekhay , aur wahin janey kay liye chaltay rahen jahan ka aap ko hukum diya jaraha hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( iss tarah ) hum ney loot tak apna yeh faisla phoncha diya kay subha hotay hi inn logon  ki jarr kaat ker rakh di jaye gi .
ayahs.translation: aur ( iss tarah ) hum ney loot tak apna yeh faisla phoncha diya kay subha hotay hi inn logon  ki jarr kaat ker rakh di jaye gi .

ayahs.text: aur shehar walay khushi manatay huye ( loot kay paas ) aa-phonchay .
ayahs.translation: aur shehar walay khushi manatay huye ( loot kay paas ) aa-phonchay .

ayahs.text: loot ney ( unn say ) kaha kay :  yeh log meray mehman hain , lehaza mujhay ruswa naa kero ,
ayahs.translation: loot ney ( unn say ) kaha kay :  yeh log meray mehman hain , lehaza mujhay ruswa naa kero ,

ayahs.text: aur Allah say daro , aur mujhay zaleel naa kero .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah say daro , aur mujhay zaleel naa kero .

ayahs.text: kehney lagay :  kiya hum ney aap ko pehlay hi duniya jahan kay logon  ( ko mehman bananey ) say mana nahi ker rakha tha-?
ayahs.translation: kehney lagay :  kiya hum ney aap ko pehlay hi duniya jahan kay logon  ( ko mehman bananey ) say mana nahi ker rakha tha-?

ayahs.text: loot ney kaha :  agar tum meray kehney per amal kero to yeh meri betiyan ( jo tumharay nikah mein hain , tumharay paas ) mojood hi hain .
ayahs.translation: loot ney kaha :  agar tum meray kehney per amal kero to yeh meri betiyan ( jo tumharay nikah mein hain , tumharay paas ) mojood hi hain .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) tumhari zindagi ki qasam ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh log apni bad-masti mein andhay banay huye thay .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) tumhari zindagi ki qasam ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh log apni bad-masti mein andhay banay huye thay .

ayahs.text: chunacheh sooraj nikaltay hi unn ko chinghaarr ney aa-pakra ,
ayahs.translation: chunacheh sooraj nikaltay hi unn ko chinghaarr ney aa-pakra ,

ayahs.text: phir hum ney uss zameen ko tah o baala ker kay rakh diya , aur unn per pakki mitti kay pathron ki barish barsa di .
ayahs.translation: phir hum ney uss zameen ko tah o baala ker kay rakh diya , aur unn per pakki mitti kay pathron ki barish barsa di .

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay iss saray waqaey mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo ibrat ki nigah say dekhtay hon .
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay iss saray waqaey mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo ibrat ki nigah say dekhtay hon .

ayahs.text: aur yeh bastiyan aik aesay raastay per waqay hain jiss per log mustaqil chaltay rehtay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh bastiyan aik aesay raastay per waqay hain jiss per log mustaqil chaltay rehtay hain .

ayahs.text: yaqeenan iss mein emaan walon kay liye bari ibrat hai .
ayahs.translation: yaqeenan iss mein emaan walon kay liye bari ibrat hai .

ayahs.text: aur aieka kay bashinday ( bhi ) baray zalim thay .
ayahs.translation: aur aieka kay bashinday ( bhi ) baray zalim thay .

ayahs.text: chunacheh hum ney unn say bhi intiqam liya . aur unn dono qoamon ki bastiyan khuli shahraah per waqay hain .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh hum ney unn say bhi intiqam liya . aur unn dono qoamon ki bastiyan khuli shahraah per waqay hain .

ayahs.text: aur hajar kay bashindon ney bhi payghumberon ko jhutlaya tha .
ayahs.translation: aur hajar kay bashindon ney bhi payghumberon ko jhutlaya tha .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney unn ko apni nishaniyan den to woh unn say mun morray rahey .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney unn ko apni nishaniyan den to woh unn say mun morray rahey .

ayahs.text: aur woh paharon ko tarash tarash ker bey khof o khatar makan banaya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: aur woh paharon ko tarash tarash ker bey khof o khatar makan banaya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: aakhir unhen subha subha aik chinghaarr ney aa-pakra .
ayahs.translation: aakhir unhen subha subha aik chinghaarr ney aa-pakra .

ayahs.text: aur nateeja yeh huwa kay jiss hunar say woh kamai kertay thay , woh unn kay kuch kaam naa aaya .
ayahs.translation: aur nateeja yeh huwa kay jiss hunar say woh kamai kertay thay , woh unn kay kuch kaam naa aaya .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney aasmano aur zameen ko aur unn kay darmiyan jo kuch hai uss ko kissi bar-haq maqsad kay baghair peda nahi kiya .   aur qayamat ki gharri aa-ker rahey gi . lehaza ( aey payghumber ! inn kafiron kay tarz-e-amal per ) khoobsurti kay sath darguzar say kaam lo .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney aasmano aur zameen ko aur unn kay darmiyan jo kuch hai uss ko kissi bar-haq maqsad kay baghair peda nahi kiya .   aur qayamat ki gharri aa-ker rahey gi . lehaza ( aey payghumber ! inn kafiron kay tarz-e-amal per ) khoobsurti kay sath darguzar say kaam lo .

ayahs.text: yaqeen rakho kay tumhara rab hi sabb ko peda kernay wala , sabb kuch janney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: yaqeen rakho kay tumhara rab hi sabb ko peda kernay wala , sabb kuch janney wala hai .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney tumhen saat aesi aayaten dey rakhi hain jo baar baar parhi jati hain ,   aur azmat wala Quran ata kiya hai .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney tumhen saat aesi aayaten dey rakhi hain jo baar baar parhi jati hain ,   aur azmat wala Quran ata kiya hai .

ayahs.text: aur tum unn cheezon ki taraf hergiz aankh utha ker bhi naa dekho jo hum ney inn ( kafiron ) mein say mukhtalif logon  ko mazay uraney kay liye dey rakhi hain , aur naa inn logon  per apna dil kurrhao , aur jo log emaan ley aaye hain , unn kay liye apni shafqat ka bazoo phela do .
ayahs.translation: aur tum unn cheezon ki taraf hergiz aankh utha ker bhi naa dekho jo hum ney inn ( kafiron ) mein say mukhtalif logon  ko mazay uraney kay liye dey rakhi hain , aur naa inn logon  per apna dil kurrhao , aur jo log emaan ley aaye hain , unn kay liye apni shafqat ka bazoo phela do .

ayahs.text: aur ( kufr kernay walon say ) keh do kay mein to bus khulay alfaz mein tanbeeh kernay wala hun .
ayahs.translation: aur ( kufr kernay walon say ) keh do kay mein to bus khulay alfaz mein tanbeeh kernay wala hun .

ayahs.text: . ( yeh tanbeeh Quran-e-azeem kay zariye ussi tarah nazil ki gaee hai ) jaisay hum ney unn tafarqa kernay walon per nazil ki thi .
ayahs.translation: . ( yeh tanbeeh Quran-e-azeem kay zariye ussi tarah nazil ki gaee hai ) jaisay hum ney unn tafarqa kernay walon per nazil ki thi .

ayahs.text: jinhon ney ( apni ) parhi janey wali kitab kay hissay bakhray kerliye thay .
ayahs.translation: jinhon ney ( apni ) parhi janey wali kitab kay hissay bakhray kerliye thay .

ayahs.text: chunacheh tumharay rab ki qasam ! hum aik aik ker kay unn sabb say poochen gay .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh tumharay rab ki qasam ! hum aik aik ker kay unn sabb say poochen gay .

ayahs.text: kay woh kiya kuch kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: kay woh kiya kuch kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: lehaza jiss baat ka tumhen hukum diya jaraha hai , ussay al-al-aelaan logon  ko suna do ,   aur jo log ( phir bhi ) shirk keren , unn ki perwa matt kero .
ayahs.translation: lehaza jiss baat ka tumhen hukum diya jaraha hai , ussay al-al-aelaan logon  ko suna do ,   aur jo log ( phir bhi ) shirk keren , unn ki perwa matt kero .

ayahs.text: yaqeen rakho kay hum tumhari taraf say unn logon  say nimatney kay liye kafi hain jo ( tumhara ) mazaq uratay hain ,
ayahs.translation: yaqeen rakho kay hum tumhari taraf say unn logon  say nimatney kay liye kafi hain jo ( tumhara ) mazaq uratay hain ,

ayahs.text: jinhon ney Allah kay sath koi aur mabood gharr rakha hai . chunacheh unqareeb unhen sabb pata chal jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: jinhon ney Allah kay sath koi aur mabood gharr rakha hai . chunacheh unqareeb unhen sabb pata chal jaye ga .

ayahs.text: yaqeenan hum jantay hain kay jo baaten yeh banatay hain , unn say tumhara dil tang hota hai .
ayahs.translation: yaqeenan hum jantay hain kay jo baaten yeh banatay hain , unn say tumhara dil tang hota hai .

ayahs.text: to ( iss ka ilaj yeh hai kay ) tum apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh kertay raho , aur sajda baja laney walon mein shamil raho .
ayahs.translation: to ( iss ka ilaj yeh hai kay ) tum apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh kertay raho , aur sajda baja laney walon mein shamil raho .

ayahs.text: aur apney perwerdigar ki ibadat kertay raho , yahan tak kay tum per woh cheez aajaye jiss ka aana yaqeeni hai .
ayahs.translation: aur apney perwerdigar ki ibadat kertay raho , yahan tak kay tum per woh cheez aajaye jiss ka aana yaqeeni hai .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: Allah ka hukum aan phoncha hai , lehaza uss kay liye jaldi naa machao .   jo shirk yeh log ker rahey hain , woh uss say pak aur boht baala o bartar hai .
verses.translation: Allah ka hukum aan phoncha hai , lehaza uss kay liye jaldi naa machao .   jo shirk yeh log ker rahey hain , woh uss say pak aur boht baala o bartar hai .

verses.text: woh apney hukum say farishton ko apney bandon mein say jiss per chahta hai iss zindagi bakhshney wali wahi kay sath utaarta hai kay :  logon  ko aagah kerdo kay meray siwa koi mabood nahi hai , lehaza tum mujhi say daro , ( kissi aur say nahi )
verses.translation: woh apney hukum say farishton ko apney bandon mein say jiss per chahta hai iss zindagi bakhshney wali wahi kay sath utaarta hai kay :  logon  ko aagah kerdo kay meray siwa koi mabood nahi hai , lehaza tum mujhi say daro , ( kissi aur say nahi )

verses.text: uss ney aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq maqsad say peda kiya hai . jo shirk yeh log kertay hain , woh uss say boht baala o bartar hai .
verses.translation: uss ney aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq maqsad say peda kiya hai . jo shirk yeh log kertay hain , woh uss say boht baala o bartar hai .

verses.text: uss ney insan ko nutfay say peda kiya , phir dekhtay hi dekhtay woh khullam khula jhagray per aamada hogaya .
verses.translation: uss ney insan ko nutfay say peda kiya , phir dekhtay hi dekhtay woh khullam khula jhagray per aamada hogaya .

verses.text: aur chopaye ussi ney peda kiye jinn mein tumharay liye sardi say bachao ka saman hai ,   aur iss kay ilawa bhi boht say faeeday hain , aur unhi mein say tum khatay bhi ho .
verses.translation: aur chopaye ussi ney peda kiye jinn mein tumharay liye sardi say bachao ka saman hai ,   aur iss kay ilawa bhi boht say faeeday hain , aur unhi mein say tum khatay bhi ho .

verses.text: aur jab tum unhen shaam kay waqt ghar wapis latay ho , aur jab unhen subha ko charaney ley jatay ho to unn mein tumharay liye aik khushnuma manzar bhi hai .
verses.translation: aur jab tum unhen shaam kay waqt ghar wapis latay ho , aur jab unhen subha ko charaney ley jatay ho to unn mein tumharay liye aik khushnuma manzar bhi hai .

verses.text: aur yeh tumharay bojh laad ker aesay shehar tak ley jatay hain jahan tum jaan jokhon mein daalay baghair nahi phonch saktay thay . haqeeqat yeh hai kay tumhara perwerdigar boht shafiq , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: aur yeh tumharay bojh laad ker aesay shehar tak ley jatay hain jahan tum jaan jokhon mein daalay baghair nahi phonch saktay thay . haqeeqat yeh hai kay tumhara perwerdigar boht shafiq , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: aur ghorray , khachar aur gadhay ussi ney peda kiye hain takay tum unn per sawari kero , aur woh zeenat ka saman banen . aur woh boht si aesi cheezen peda kerta hai jinn ka tumhen ilm bhi nahi hai .
verses.translation: aur ghorray , khachar aur gadhay ussi ney peda kiye hain takay tum unn per sawari kero , aur woh zeenat ka saman banen . aur woh boht si aesi cheezen peda kerta hai jinn ka tumhen ilm bhi nahi hai .

verses.text: aur seedha raasta dikhaney ki zimma daari Allah ney li hai , aur boht say raastay tairrhay hain , aur agar woh chahta to tum sabb ko seedhay raastay per phoncha bhi deta .
verses.translation: aur seedha raasta dikhaney ki zimma daari Allah ney li hai , aur boht say raastay tairrhay hain , aur agar woh chahta to tum sabb ko seedhay raastay per phoncha bhi deta .

verses.text: wohi hai jiss ney aasman say paani barsaya jiss say tumhen peenay ki cheezen hasil hoti hain , aur ussi say woh darkht ugtay hain jinn mein tum maweshiyon ko charatay ho .
verses.translation: wohi hai jiss ney aasman say paani barsaya jiss say tumhen peenay ki cheezen hasil hoti hain , aur ussi say woh darkht ugtay hain jinn mein tum maweshiyon ko charatay ho .

verses.text: ussi say Allah tumharay liye khetiyan , zaitoon , khujoor kay darkht , angoor aur her qisam kay phal ugata hai .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn sabb baaton mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishani hai jo sochtay samajhtay hon .
verses.translation: ussi say Allah tumharay liye khetiyan , zaitoon , khujoor kay darkht , angoor aur her qisam kay phal ugata hai .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn sabb baaton mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishani hai jo sochtay samajhtay hon .

verses.text: aur uss ney din aur raat ko aur sooraj aur chaand ko tumhari khidmat per laga rakha hai , aur sitaray bhi uss kay hukum say kaam per lagay huye hain . yaqeenan inn baaton mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo aqal say kaam len .
verses.translation: aur uss ney din aur raat ko aur sooraj aur chaand ko tumhari khidmat per laga rakha hai , aur sitaray bhi uss kay hukum say kaam per lagay huye hain . yaqeenan inn baaton mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo aqal say kaam len .

verses.text: issi tarah woh sari rang ba-rang ki cheezen jo uss ney tumhari khatir zameen mein phela rakhi hain , woh bhi uss kay hukum say kaam per lagi hoi hain . beyshak inn sabb mein unn logon  kay liye nishani hai jo sabaq hasil keren .
verses.translation: issi tarah woh sari rang ba-rang ki cheezen jo uss ney tumhari khatir zameen mein phela rakhi hain , woh bhi uss kay hukum say kaam per lagi hoi hain . beyshak inn sabb mein unn logon  kay liye nishani hai jo sabaq hasil keren .

verses.text: aur wohi hai jiss ney samandar ko kaam per lagaya , takay tum uss say taza gosht khao ,   aur uss say woh zewraat nikalo jo tum pehantay ho .   aur tum dekhtay ho kay uss mein kashtiyan paani ko cheerti hoi chalti hain , takay tum Allah ka fazal talash kero , aur takay shukar guzaar bano .
verses.translation: aur wohi hai jiss ney samandar ko kaam per lagaya , takay tum uss say taza gosht khao ,   aur uss say woh zewraat nikalo jo tum pehantay ho .   aur tum dekhtay ho kay uss mein kashtiyan paani ko cheerti hoi chalti hain , takay tum Allah ka fazal talash kero , aur takay shukar guzaar bano .

verses.text: aur uss ney zameen mein paharon kay langar daal diye hain takay woh tum ko ley ker dagmagaye nahi ,   aur darya aur raastay banaye hain takay tum manzil-e-maqsood tak phonch sako .
verses.translation: aur uss ney zameen mein paharon kay langar daal diye hain takay woh tum ko ley ker dagmagaye nahi ,   aur darya aur raastay banaye hain takay tum manzil-e-maqsood tak phonch sako .

verses.text: aur ( raaston ki pehchan kay liye ) boht si alamaten banai hain . aur sitaron say bhi log raasta maloom kertay hain .
verses.translation: aur ( raaston ki pehchan kay liye ) boht si alamaten banai hain . aur sitaron say bhi log raasta maloom kertay hain .

verses.text: abb batao kay jo zaat ( yeh sari cheezen ) peda kerti hai , kiya woh unn kay barabar ho sakti hai jo kuch peda nahi kertay ? kiya phir bhi tum koi sabaq nahi letay ?
verses.translation: abb batao kay jo zaat ( yeh sari cheezen ) peda kerti hai , kiya woh unn kay barabar ho sakti hai jo kuch peda nahi kertay ? kiya phir bhi tum koi sabaq nahi letay ?

verses.text: aur agar tum Allah ki naimaton ko ginney lago , to unhen shumar nahi ker-saktay . haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: aur agar tum Allah ki naimaton ko ginney lago , to unhen shumar nahi ker-saktay . haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: aur Allah woh baaten bhi janta hai jo tum chup ker kertay ho , aur woh bhi jo tum al-al-aelaan kertay ho .
verses.translation: aur Allah woh baaten bhi janta hai jo tum chup ker kertay ho , aur woh bhi jo tum al-al-aelaan kertay ho .

verses.text: aur Allah taalaa ko chorr ker yeh log jinn ( deotaon ) ko pukartay hain , woh kuch bhi peda nahi kertay , woh to khud hi makhlooq hain .
verses.translation: aur Allah taalaa ko chorr ker yeh log jinn ( deotaon ) ko pukartay hain , woh kuch bhi peda nahi kertay , woh to khud hi makhlooq hain .

verses.text: woh bey jaan hain , unn mein zindagi nahi , aur unn ko iss baat ka bhi ehsas nahi hai kay inn logon  ko kab zinda ker kay uthaya jaye ga .
verses.translation: woh bey jaan hain , unn mein zindagi nahi , aur unn ko iss baat ka bhi ehsas nahi hai kay inn logon  ko kab zinda ker kay uthaya jaye ga .

verses.text: tumhara mabood to bus aik hi khuda hai . lehaza jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , unn kay dil mein inkar paywast hogaya hai , aur woh ghamand mein mubtala hain .
verses.translation: tumhara mabood to bus aik hi khuda hai . lehaza jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , unn kay dil mein inkar paywast hogaya hai , aur woh ghamand mein mubtala hain .

verses.text: zahir baat hai kay Allah woh baaten bhi janta hai jo woh chup ker kertay hain , aur woh bhi jo woh al-al-aelaan kertay hain . woh yaqeenan ghamand kernay walon ko pasand nahi kerta .
verses.translation: zahir baat hai kay Allah woh baaten bhi janta hai jo woh chup ker kertay hain , aur woh bhi jo woh al-al-aelaan kertay hain . woh yaqeenan ghamand kernay walon ko pasand nahi kerta .

verses.text: aur jab unn say kaha gaya kay :  tumharay rab ney kiya baat nazil ki hai ?  to unhon ney kaha kay :  guzray huye logon  kay afsaney !
verses.translation: aur jab unn say kaha gaya kay :  tumharay rab ney kiya baat nazil ki hai ?  to unhon ney kaha kay :  guzray huye logon  kay afsaney !

verses.text: . ( inn baaton ka ) nateeja yeh hai kay woh qayamat kay din khud apney ( gunahon ) kay pooray pooray bojh bhi apney oopper laaden gay , aur unn logon  kay bojh ka aik hissa bhi jinhen yeh kissi ilm kay baghair gumrah ker rahey hain .   yaad rakho kay boht bura bojh hai jo yeh laad rahey hain .
verses.translation: . ( inn baaton ka ) nateeja yeh hai kay woh qayamat kay din khud apney ( gunahon ) kay pooray pooray bojh bhi apney oopper laaden gay , aur unn logon  kay bojh ka aik hissa bhi jinhen yeh kissi ilm kay baghair gumrah ker rahey hain .   yaad rakho kay boht bura bojh hai jo yeh laad rahey hain .

verses.text: inn say pehlay kay logon  ney bhi makar kay mansoobay banaye thay . phir huwa yeh kay ( mansoobon ki ) jo imaraten unhon ney tameer ki then , Allah taalaa ney unhen jarr buniyad say ukhaar phenka , phir unn kay oopper say chat bhi unn per aagiri , aur unn per azab aesi jagah say aa-dhamka jiss ka unhen ehsas tak nahi tha .
verses.translation: inn say pehlay kay logon  ney bhi makar kay mansoobay banaye thay . phir huwa yeh kay ( mansoobon ki ) jo imaraten unhon ney tameer ki then , Allah taalaa ney unhen jarr buniyad say ukhaar phenka , phir unn kay oopper say chat bhi unn per aagiri , aur unn per azab aesi jagah say aa-dhamka jiss ka unhen ehsas tak nahi tha .

verses.text: phir qayamat kay din Allah unhen ruswa keray ga , aur unn say poochay ga kay :  kahan hain woh meray shareek jinn ki khatir tum ( musalmanon say ) jhagrra kiya kertay thay ?  jinn logon  ko ilm ata huwa hai , woh ( uss din ) kahen gay kay :  bari ruswai aur bad-haali musallat hai aaj unn kafiron per .
verses.translation: phir qayamat kay din Allah unhen ruswa keray ga , aur unn say poochay ga kay :  kahan hain woh meray shareek jinn ki khatir tum ( musalmanon say ) jhagrra kiya kertay thay ?  jinn logon  ko ilm ata huwa hai , woh ( uss din ) kahen gay kay :  bari ruswai aur bad-haali musallat hai aaj unn kafiron per .

verses.text: jinn ki roohen farishton ney iss halat mein qabz ken jab unhon ney apni janon per ( kufr ki wajeh say ) zulm ker rakha tha .    uss moaqa per kafir log bari farmanbardaari kay bol bolen gay kay hum to koi bura kaam nahi kertay thay . ( unn say kaha jaye ga : )  kaisay nahi kertay thay ?  Allah ko sabb maloom hai kay tum kiya kuch kertay rahey ho .
verses.translation: jinn ki roohen farishton ney iss halat mein qabz ken jab unhon ney apni janon per ( kufr ki wajeh say ) zulm ker rakha tha .    uss moaqa per kafir log bari farmanbardaari kay bol bolen gay kay hum to koi bura kaam nahi kertay thay . ( unn say kaha jaye ga : )  kaisay nahi kertay thay ?  Allah ko sabb maloom hai kay tum kiya kuch kertay rahey ho .

verses.text: lehaza abb hamesha jahannum mein rehney kay liye uss kay darwazon mein dakhil hojao , kiyonkay takabbur kernay walon ka yehi bura thikana hai .
verses.translation: lehaza abb hamesha jahannum mein rehney kay liye uss kay darwazon mein dakhil hojao , kiyonkay takabbur kernay walon ka yehi bura thikana hai .

verses.text: aur ( doosri taraf ) muttaqi logon  say poocha gaya kay :  tumharay perwerdigar ney kiya cheez nazil ki hai ?  to unhon ney kaha :  khair hi khair utaari hai .  ( iss tarah ) jinn logon  ney naiki ki rawish ikhtiyar ki hai , unn kay liye iss duniya mein bhi behtari hai , aur aakhirat ka ghar to hai hi sarapa behtari , yaqeenan muttaqiyo ka ghar behtareen hai ,
verses.translation: aur ( doosri taraf ) muttaqi logon  say poocha gaya kay :  tumharay perwerdigar ney kiya cheez nazil ki hai ?  to unhon ney kaha :  khair hi khair utaari hai .  ( iss tarah ) jinn logon  ney naiki ki rawish ikhtiyar ki hai , unn kay liye iss duniya mein bhi behtari hai , aur aakhirat ka ghar to hai hi sarapa behtari , yaqeenan muttaqiyo ka ghar behtareen hai ,

verses.text: hamesha hamesha basney kay liye woh baaghaat jinn mein woh dakhil hon gay , jinn kay neechay say nehren behti hon gi , aur wahan jo kuch woh chahen gay , unhen milay ga . muttaqi logon  ko Allah aisa hi sila deta hai .
verses.translation: hamesha hamesha basney kay liye woh baaghaat jinn mein woh dakhil hon gay , jinn kay neechay say nehren behti hon gi , aur wahan jo kuch woh chahen gay , unhen milay ga . muttaqi logon  ko Allah aisa hi sila deta hai .

verses.text: yeh woh log hain jinn ki roohen farishtay aesi halat mein qabz kertay hain kay woh pak saaf hotay hain . woh unn say kehtay hain kay :  salamti ho tum per ! jo amal tum kertay rahey ho , uss kay silay mein jannat mein dakhil hojao .
verses.translation: yeh woh log hain jinn ki roohen farishtay aesi halat mein qabz kertay hain kay woh pak saaf hotay hain . woh unn say kehtay hain kay :  salamti ho tum per ! jo amal tum kertay rahey ho , uss kay silay mein jannat mein dakhil hojao .

verses.text: yeh ( kafir ) log abb ( emaan laney kay liye ) iss kay siwa kiss baat kay muntazir hain kay inn kay paas farishtay aa-kharay hon , ya ( qayamat ya azab ki soorat mein ) tumharay perwerdigar ka hukum hi aajaye . jo ummaten inn say pehlay guzri hain , unhon ney bhi aisa hi kiya tha . aur Allah ney unn per koi zulm nahi kiya , lekin woh khud apni janon per zulm dahatay rahey thay .
verses.translation: yeh ( kafir ) log abb ( emaan laney kay liye ) iss kay siwa kiss baat kay muntazir hain kay inn kay paas farishtay aa-kharay hon , ya ( qayamat ya azab ki soorat mein ) tumharay perwerdigar ka hukum hi aajaye . jo ummaten inn say pehlay guzri hain , unhon ney bhi aisa hi kiya tha . aur Allah ney unn per koi zulm nahi kiya , lekin woh khud apni janon per zulm dahatay rahey thay .

verses.text: iss liye unn kay buray aemal ka wabal unn per parra , aur jiss cheez ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay , ussi ney unn ko aa-ker gher liya .
verses.translation: iss liye unn kay buray aemal ka wabal unn per parra , aur jiss cheez ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay , ussi ney unn ko aa-ker gher liya .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney shirk ikhtiyar kiya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  agar Allah chahta to hum uss kay siwa kissi aur cheez ki ibadat naa kertay , naa hum , naa humaray baap dada , aur naa hum uss kay ( hukum kay ) baghair koi cheez haram qarar detay .  jo ummaten inn say pehlay guzri hain , unhon ney bhi aisa hi kiya tha . lekin payghumberon ki zimma daari iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay woh saaf saaf tareeqay per paygham phoncha den .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney shirk ikhtiyar kiya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  agar Allah chahta to hum uss kay siwa kissi aur cheez ki ibadat naa kertay , naa hum , naa humaray baap dada , aur naa hum uss kay ( hukum kay ) baghair koi cheez haram qarar detay .  jo ummaten inn say pehlay guzri hain , unhon ney bhi aisa hi kiya tha . lekin payghumberon ki zimma daari iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay woh saaf saaf tareeqay per paygham phoncha den .

verses.text: aur waqiaa yeh hai kay hum ney her ummat mein koi naa koi payghumber iss hidayat kay sath bheja hai kay tum Allah ki ibadat kero , aur taghoot say ijtinab kero .   phir unn mein say kuch woh thay jinn ko Allah ney hidayat dey di aur kuch aesay thay jinn per gumrahi musallat hogaee . to zara zameen mein chal phir ker dekho kay ( payghumberon ko ) jhutlaney walon ka anjam kaisa huwa-?
verses.translation: aur waqiaa yeh hai kay hum ney her ummat mein koi naa koi payghumber iss hidayat kay sath bheja hai kay tum Allah ki ibadat kero , aur taghoot say ijtinab kero .   phir unn mein say kuch woh thay jinn ko Allah ney hidayat dey di aur kuch aesay thay jinn per gumrahi musallat hogaee . to zara zameen mein chal phir ker dekho kay ( payghumberon ko ) jhutlaney walon ka anjam kaisa huwa-?

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) agar tumhen yeh hirs hai kay yeh log hidayat per aajayen , to haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah jinn ko ( unn kay enaad ki wajeh say ) gumrah ker deta hai , unn ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata , aur aesay logon  ko kissi qisam kay madadgaar bhi moyassar nahi aatay .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) agar tumhen yeh hirs hai kay yeh log hidayat per aajayen , to haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah jinn ko ( unn kay enaad ki wajeh say ) gumrah ker deta hai , unn ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata , aur aesay logon  ko kissi qisam kay madadgaar bhi moyassar nahi aatay .

verses.text: aur inn logon  ney bara zor laga laga ker Allah ki qasmen khai hain kay jo log mar-jatay hain , Allah unn ko dobara zinda nahi keray ga . bhala kiyon nahi keray ga-? yeh to aik wada hai jissay sacha kernay ki zimma daari Allah ney ley rakhi hai , lekin aksar log jantay nahi hain .
verses.translation: aur inn logon  ney bara zor laga laga ker Allah ki qasmen khai hain kay jo log mar-jatay hain , Allah unn ko dobara zinda nahi keray ga . bhala kiyon nahi keray ga-? yeh to aik wada hai jissay sacha kernay ki zimma daari Allah ney ley rakhi hai , lekin aksar log jantay nahi hain .

verses.text: . ( dobara zinda kernay ka yeh wada Allah ney iss liye kiya hai ) takay woh logon  kay samney unn baaton ko achi tarah wazeh kerday jinn mein woh ikhtilaf ker rahey hain , aur takay kafir log jaan len kay woh jhootay thay .
verses.translation: . ( dobara zinda kernay ka yeh wada Allah ney iss liye kiya hai ) takay woh logon  kay samney unn baaton ko achi tarah wazeh kerday jinn mein woh ikhtilaf ker rahey hain , aur takay kafir log jaan len kay woh jhootay thay .

verses.text: aur jab hum kissi cheez ko peda kernay ka irada kertay hain to humari taraf say sirf itni baat hoti hai kay hum ussay kehtay hain :  hoja  bus woh hojati hai .
verses.translation: aur jab hum kissi cheez ko peda kernay ka irada kertay hain to humari taraf say sirf itni baat hoti hai kay hum ussay kehtay hain :  hoja  bus woh hojati hai .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney doosron kay zulm sehnay kay baad Allah ki khatir apna watan chorra hai , yaqeen rakho kay unhen hum duniya mein bhi achi tarah basayen gay , aur aakhirat ka ajar to yaqeenan sabb say bara hai . kaash kay yeh log jaan letay !
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney doosron kay zulm sehnay kay baad Allah ki khatir apna watan chorra hai , yaqeen rakho kay unhen hum duniya mein bhi achi tarah basayen gay , aur aakhirat ka ajar to yaqeenan sabb say bara hai . kaash kay yeh log jaan letay !

verses.text: yeh woh log hain jinhon ney sabar say kaam liya hai , aur jo apney perwerdigar per bharosa rakhtay hain .
verses.translation: yeh woh log hain jinhon ney sabar say kaam liya hai , aur jo apney perwerdigar per bharosa rakhtay hain .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum say pehlay bhi kissi aur ko nahi , insanon hi ko payghumber bana ker bheja tha jinn per hum wahi nazil kertay thay . ( aey munkiro ! ) abb agar tumhen iss baat ka ilm nahi hai to jo ilm walay hain unn say pooch lo .
