verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum say pehlay bhi kissi aur ko nahi , insanon hi ko payghumber bana ker bheja tha jinn per hum wahi nazil kertay thay . ( aey munkiro ! ) abb agar tumhen iss baat ka ilm nahi hai to jo ilm walay hain unn say pooch lo .

verses.text: unn payghumberon ko roshan dalaeel aur aasmani kitaben dey ker bheja gaya tha . aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum per bhi yeh Quran iss liye nazil kiya hai takay tum logon  kay samney unn baaton ki wazeh tashreeh ker do jo unn kay liye utaari gaee hain , aur takay woh ghor-o-fiker say kaam len .
verses.translation: unn payghumberon ko roshan dalaeel aur aasmani kitaben dey ker bheja gaya tha . aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum per bhi yeh Quran iss liye nazil kiya hai takay tum logon  kay samney unn baaton ki wazeh tashreeh ker do jo unn kay liye utaari gaee hain , aur takay woh ghor-o-fiker say kaam len .

verses.text: to kiya woh log jo buray buray mansoobay bana rahey hain iss baat say bilkul bey khof hogaye hain kay Allah unhen zameen mein dhansa dey , ya unn per azab aesi jagah say aa-parey kay unhen ehsas tak naa ho-?
verses.translation: to kiya woh log jo buray buray mansoobay bana rahey hain iss baat say bilkul bey khof hogaye hain kay Allah unhen zameen mein dhansa dey , ya unn per azab aesi jagah say aa-parey kay unhen ehsas tak naa ho-?

verses.text: ya unhen chaltay phirtay hi apni pakar mein ley ley , kiyonkay woh ussay aajiz nahi ker-saktay ,
verses.translation: ya unhen chaltay phirtay hi apni pakar mein ley ley , kiyonkay woh ussay aajiz nahi ker-saktay ,

verses.text: ya unhen iss tarah girift mein ley kay woh dheeray dheeray ghattey chalay jayen ?   kiyonkay tumhara perwerdigar bara shafiq , nihayat meharban hai .
verses.translation: ya unhen iss tarah girift mein ley kay woh dheeray dheeray ghattey chalay jayen ?   kiyonkay tumhara perwerdigar bara shafiq , nihayat meharban hai .

verses.text: kiya unhon ney nahi dekha kay Allah ney jo cheez bhi peda ki hai , uss kay saye Allah ko sajday kertay huye dayen aur bayen jhukay rehtay hain , aur woh sabb aajzi ka izhar ker rahey hotay hain-?
verses.translation: kiya unhon ney nahi dekha kay Allah ney jo cheez bhi peda ki hai , uss kay saye Allah ko sajday kertay huye dayen aur bayen jhukay rehtay hain , aur woh sabb aajzi ka izhar ker rahey hotay hain-?

verses.text: aur aasmano aur zameen mein jitney jandaar hain , woh aur saray farishtay Allah hi ko sajda kertay hain , aur woh zara takabbur nahi kertay .
verses.translation: aur aasmano aur zameen mein jitney jandaar hain , woh aur saray farishtay Allah hi ko sajda kertay hain , aur woh zara takabbur nahi kertay .

verses.text: woh apney uss perwerdigar say dartay hain jo unn kay oopper hai , aur wohi kaam kertay hain jiss ka unhen hukum diya jata hai .
verses.translation: woh apney uss perwerdigar say dartay hain jo unn kay oopper hai , aur wohi kaam kertay hain jiss ka unhen hukum diya jata hai .

verses.text: aur Allah ney farmaya hai kay :  do do mabood naa bana bethna . woh to bus aik hi mabood hai . iss liye bus mujhi say dara kero .
verses.translation: aur Allah ney farmaya hai kay :  do do mabood naa bana bethna . woh to bus aik hi mabood hai . iss liye bus mujhi say dara kero .

verses.text: aur aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , ussi ka hai , aur ussi ki itaat her haal mein lazim hai . kiya phir bhi tum Allah kay siwa auron say dartay ho-?
verses.translation: aur aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , ussi ka hai , aur ussi ki itaat her haal mein lazim hai . kiya phir bhi tum Allah kay siwa auron say dartay ho-?

verses.text: aur tum ko jo naimat bhi hasil hoti hai , woh Allah ki taraf say hoti hai , phir jab tumhen koi takleef phonchti hai to ussi say fariyaden kertay ho .
verses.translation: aur tum ko jo naimat bhi hasil hoti hai , woh Allah ki taraf say hoti hai , phir jab tumhen koi takleef phonchti hai to ussi say fariyaden kertay ho .

verses.text: uss kay baad jab woh tum say takleef door ker deta hai , to tum mein say aik giroh achanak apney perwerdigar kay sath shirk shuroo ker deta hai ,
verses.translation: uss kay baad jab woh tum say takleef door ker deta hai , to tum mein say aik giroh achanak apney perwerdigar kay sath shirk shuroo ker deta hai ,

verses.text: takay hum ney ussay jo naimat di thi uss ki nashukri keray . acha ! kuch aesh kerlo , phir unqareeb tumhen pata chal jaye ga .
verses.translation: takay hum ney ussay jo naimat di thi uss ki nashukri keray . acha ! kuch aesh kerlo , phir unqareeb tumhen pata chal jaye ga .

verses.text: aur hum ney jo rizq unhen diya hai , uss mein woh unn ( button ) ka hissa lagatay hain jinn ki haqeeqat khud unhen maloom nahi hai .   Allah ki qasam ! tum say zaroor baaz purs hogi kay tum kaisay bohtan baandha kertay thay .
verses.translation: aur hum ney jo rizq unhen diya hai , uss mein woh unn ( button ) ka hissa lagatay hain jinn ki haqeeqat khud unhen maloom nahi hai .   Allah ki qasam ! tum say zaroor baaz purs hogi kay tum kaisay bohtan baandha kertay thay .

verses.text: aur Allah kay liye to unhon ney betiyan gharr rakhi hain . subhan Allah ! aur khud apney liye woh ( betay chahtay hain ) jo apni khuwaish kay mutabiq hon !
verses.translation: aur Allah kay liye to unhon ney betiyan gharr rakhi hain . subhan Allah ! aur khud apney liye woh ( betay chahtay hain ) jo apni khuwaish kay mutabiq hon !

verses.text: aur jab unn mein say kissi ko beti ki ( pedaeesh ) ki khushkhabri di jati hai to uss ka chehra siyah parr-jata hai , aur woh dil hi dil mein kurrhta rehta hai .
verses.translation: aur jab unn mein say kissi ko beti ki ( pedaeesh ) ki khushkhabri di jati hai to uss ka chehra siyah parr-jata hai , aur woh dil hi dil mein kurrhta rehta hai .

verses.text: iss khushkhabri ko bura samajh ker logon  say chupta phirta hai , ( aur sochta hai kay ) zillat bardasht ker kay ussay apney paas rehney dey , ya ussay zameen mein gaarr dey . dekho unhon ney kitni buri baaten tey ker rakhi hain .
verses.translation: iss khushkhabri ko bura samajh ker logon  say chupta phirta hai , ( aur sochta hai kay ) zillat bardasht ker kay ussay apney paas rehney dey , ya ussay zameen mein gaarr dey . dekho unhon ney kitni buri baaten tey ker rakhi hain .

verses.text: buri buri baaten to unhi mein hain jo aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay . aur aalaa darjay ki sifaat sirf Allah ki hain , aur woh iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
verses.translation: buri buri baaten to unhi mein hain jo aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay . aur aalaa darjay ki sifaat sirf Allah ki hain , aur woh iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

verses.text: aur agar Allah logon  ko unn kay zulm ki wajeh say ( foran ) apni pakar mein leta to rooaey zameen per koi jandaar baqi naa chorta , lekin woh unn ko aik moyyan waqt tak mohlat deta hai . phir jab unn ka woh moyyan waqt aajaye ga to woh gharri bhar bhi uss say aagay peechay nahi hosaken gay .
verses.translation: aur agar Allah logon  ko unn kay zulm ki wajeh say ( foran ) apni pakar mein leta to rooaey zameen per koi jandaar baqi naa chorta , lekin woh unn ko aik moyyan waqt tak mohlat deta hai . phir jab unn ka woh moyyan waqt aajaye ga to woh gharri bhar bhi uss say aagay peechay nahi hosaken gay .

verses.text: aur unhon ney Allah kay liye woh cheezen gharr rakhi hain jinhen khud napasand kertay hain , phir bhi inn ki zabanen ( apni ) jhooti tareef kerti rehti hain kay sari bhalai inhi kay hissay mein hai . lazimi baat hai kay ( aesay ravaiyyey ki wajeh say ) inn kay hissay mein toh dozakh hai , aur enhen issi mein parra rehney diya jaye ga .
verses.translation: aur unhon ney Allah kay liye woh cheezen gharr rakhi hain jinhen khud napasand kertay hain , phir bhi inn ki zabanen ( apni ) jhooti tareef kerti rehti hain kay sari bhalai inhi kay hissay mein hai . lazimi baat hai kay ( aesay ravaiyyey ki wajeh say ) inn kay hissay mein toh dozakh hai , aur enhen issi mein parra rehney diya jaye ga .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) Allah ki qasam ! tum say pehlay jo ummaten guzri hain , hum ney unn kay paas payghumber bhejay thay , to shetan ney unn kay aemal ko khoob bana sanwaar ker unn kay samney paish kiya .   chunacheh wohi ( shetan ) aaj inn ka sarparast bana huwa hai , aur ( iss ki wajeh say ) unn kay liye dardnak azab tayyar hai .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) Allah ki qasam ! tum say pehlay jo ummaten guzri hain , hum ney unn kay paas payghumber bhejay thay , to shetan ney unn kay aemal ko khoob bana sanwaar ker unn kay samney paish kiya .   chunacheh wohi ( shetan ) aaj inn ka sarparast bana huwa hai , aur ( iss ki wajeh say ) unn kay liye dardnak azab tayyar hai .

verses.text: aur hum ney tum per yeh kitab issi liye utaari hai takay tum inn kay samney woh baaten khol khol ker biyan kerdo jinn mein enhon ney mukhtalif raastay apnaye huye hain , aur takay yeh emaan laney walon kay liye hidayat aur rehmat ka saman ho .
verses.translation: aur hum ney tum per yeh kitab issi liye utaari hai takay tum inn kay samney woh baaten khol khol ker biyan kerdo jinn mein enhon ney mukhtalif raastay apnaye huye hain , aur takay yeh emaan laney walon kay liye hidayat aur rehmat ka saman ho .

verses.text: aur Allah ney aasman say paani barsaya , aur zameen kay murda hojaney kay baad uss mein jaan daal di . yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye nishani hai jo baat suntay hain .
verses.translation: aur Allah ney aasman say paani barsaya , aur zameen kay murda hojaney kay baad uss mein jaan daal di . yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye nishani hai jo baat suntay hain .

verses.text: aur beyshak tumharay liye maweshiyon mein bhi sochney samajnay ka bara samaan hai .unn kay pet mein jo gobar aur khoon hai uss kay bech mein say hum tumhen aisa saaf suthra doodh peenay ko detay hain jo peenay walon kay liye khushgawar hota hai .
verses.translation: aur beyshak tumharay liye maweshiyon mein bhi sochney samajnay ka bara samaan hai .unn kay pet mein jo gobar aur khoon hai uss kay bech mein say hum tumhen aisa saaf suthra doodh peenay ko detay hain jo peenay walon kay liye khushgawar hota hai .

verses.text: aur khujoor kay phalon aur angooron say bhi ( hum tumhen aik mashroob ata kertay hain ) jiss say tum sharab bhi banatay ho , aur pakeezah rizq bhi .   beyshak iss mein bhi unn logon  kay liye nishani hai jo aqal say kaam letay hain .
verses.translation: aur khujoor kay phalon aur angooron say bhi ( hum tumhen aik mashroob ata kertay hain ) jiss say tum sharab bhi banatay ho , aur pakeezah rizq bhi .   beyshak iss mein bhi unn logon  kay liye nishani hai jo aqal say kaam letay hain .

verses.text: aur tumharay perwerdigar ney shehad ki makkhi kay dil mein yeh baat daal di kay :  tu paharon mein , aur darakhton mein aur log jo chatriyan uthatay hain , unn mein apney ghar bana .
verses.translation: aur tumharay perwerdigar ney shehad ki makkhi kay dil mein yeh baat daal di kay :  tu paharon mein , aur darakhton mein aur log jo chatriyan uthatay hain , unn mein apney ghar bana .

verses.text: phir her qisam kay phalon say apni khurak hasil ker , phir unn raaston per chal jo teray rab ney teray liye aasaan bana diye hain .  ( iss tarah ) iss makkhi kay pet say woh mukhtalif rangon wala mashroob nikalta hai jiss mein logon  kay liye shifa hai . yaqeenan inn sabb baaton mein unn logon  kay liye nishani hai jo sochtay samajhtay hon .
verses.translation: phir her qisam kay phalon say apni khurak hasil ker , phir unn raaston per chal jo teray rab ney teray liye aasaan bana diye hain .  ( iss tarah ) iss makkhi kay pet say woh mukhtalif rangon wala mashroob nikalta hai jiss mein logon  kay liye shifa hai . yaqeenan inn sabb baaton mein unn logon  kay liye nishani hai jo sochtay samajhtay hon .

verses.text: aur Allah ney tumhen peda kiya hai , phir woh tumhari rooh qabz kerta hai . aur tum mein say koi aisa hota hai jo umar kay sabb say nakara hissay tak phoncha diya jata hai , jiss mein phonch ker woh sabb kuch janney kay baad bhi kuch nahi janta .   beyshak Allah baray ilm wala , bari qudrat wala hai .
verses.translation: aur Allah ney tumhen peda kiya hai , phir woh tumhari rooh qabz kerta hai . aur tum mein say koi aisa hota hai jo umar kay sabb say nakara hissay tak phoncha diya jata hai , jiss mein phonch ker woh sabb kuch janney kay baad bhi kuch nahi janta .   beyshak Allah baray ilm wala , bari qudrat wala hai .

verses.text: aur Allah ney tum mein say kuch logon  ko rizq kay moamlay mein doosron per bartari dey rakhi hai . abb jinn logon  ko bartari di gaee hai , woh apna rizq apney ghulamon ko iss tarah nahi loata detay kay woh sabb barabar hojayen .   to kiya yeh log Allah ki naimat ka inkar kertay hain-?
verses.translation: aur Allah ney tum mein say kuch logon  ko rizq kay moamlay mein doosron per bartari dey rakhi hai . abb jinn logon  ko bartari di gaee hai , woh apna rizq apney ghulamon ko iss tarah nahi loata detay kay woh sabb barabar hojayen .   to kiya yeh log Allah ki naimat ka inkar kertay hain-?

verses.text: aur Allah ney tum hi mein say tumharay liye biwiyan banai hain , aur tumhari biwiyon say tumharay liye betay aur potay peda kiye hain , aur tumhen achi achi cheezon mein say rizq farham kiya hai . kiya phir bhi yeh log bey buniyad baaton per emaan latay aur Allah ki naimaton ki nashukri kertay hain-?
verses.translation: aur Allah ney tum hi mein say tumharay liye biwiyan banai hain , aur tumhari biwiyon say tumharay liye betay aur potay peda kiye hain , aur tumhen achi achi cheezon mein say rizq farham kiya hai . kiya phir bhi yeh log bey buniyad baaton per emaan latay aur Allah ki naimaton ki nashukri kertay hain-?

verses.text: aur yeh Allah ko chorr ker unn cheezon ki ibadat kertay hain jo unn ko aasmano aur zameen mein say kissi tarah ka rizq denay ka naa koi ikhtiyar rakhti hain , naa rakh sakti hain .
verses.translation: aur yeh Allah ko chorr ker unn cheezon ki ibadat kertay hain jo unn ko aasmano aur zameen mein say kissi tarah ka rizq denay ka naa koi ikhtiyar rakhti hain , naa rakh sakti hain .

verses.text: lehaza tum Allah kay liye misalen naa gharro .   beyshak Allah janta hai aur tum nahi jantay .
verses.translation: lehaza tum Allah kay liye misalen naa gharro .   beyshak Allah janta hai aur tum nahi jantay .

verses.text: Allah aik misal deta hai kay aik taraf aik ghulam hai jo kissi ki milkiyat mein hai , uss ko kissi cheez per koi ikhtiyar nahi , aur doosri taraf woh shaks hai jiss ko hum ney apney paas say umda rizq ata kiya hai , aur woh uss mein say posheeda tor per bhi aur khulay bandon bhi khoob kharch kerta hai . kiya yeh dono barabar hosaktay hain-? sari tareefen Allah ki hain , lekin inn mein say aksar log ( aesi saaf baat bhi ) nahi jantay .
verses.translation: Allah aik misal deta hai kay aik taraf aik ghulam hai jo kissi ki milkiyat mein hai , uss ko kissi cheez per koi ikhtiyar nahi , aur doosri taraf woh shaks hai jiss ko hum ney apney paas say umda rizq ata kiya hai , aur woh uss mein say posheeda tor per bhi aur khulay bandon bhi khoob kharch kerta hai . kiya yeh dono barabar hosaktay hain-? sari tareefen Allah ki hain , lekin inn mein say aksar log ( aesi saaf baat bhi ) nahi jantay .

verses.text: aur Allah aik aur misal deta hai kay do aadmi hain , unn mein say aik goonga hai jo koi kaam nahi ker-sakta , aur apney aaqa per bojh bana huwa hai , woh ussay jahan kahen bhejta hai , woh koi dhang ka kaam ker kay nahi lata , kiya aisa shaks uss doosray aadmi kay barabar hosakta hai jo doosron ko bhi aetidaal ka hukum deta hai , aur khud bhi seedhay raastay per qaeem hai ?
verses.translation: aur Allah aik aur misal deta hai kay do aadmi hain , unn mein say aik goonga hai jo koi kaam nahi ker-sakta , aur apney aaqa per bojh bana huwa hai , woh ussay jahan kahen bhejta hai , woh koi dhang ka kaam ker kay nahi lata , kiya aisa shaks uss doosray aadmi kay barabar hosakta hai jo doosron ko bhi aetidaal ka hukum deta hai , aur khud bhi seedhay raastay per qaeem hai ?

verses.text: aur aasmano aur zameen kay saray bhed Allah kay qabazay mein hain . aur qayamat ka moamla aankh jhapakney say ziyada nahi hoga , balkay uss say bhi jaldi . yaqeen rakho kay Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai .
verses.translation: aur aasmano aur zameen kay saray bhed Allah kay qabazay mein hain . aur qayamat ka moamla aankh jhapakney say ziyada nahi hoga , balkay uss say bhi jaldi . yaqeen rakho kay Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai .

verses.text: aur Allah ney tum ko tumhari maon kay pet say iss halat mein nikala kay tum kuch nahi jantay thay , aur tumharay liye kaan , aankhen aur dil peda kiye , takay tum shukar ada kero .
verses.translation: aur Allah ney tum ko tumhari maon kay pet say iss halat mein nikala kay tum kuch nahi jantay thay , aur tumharay liye kaan , aankhen aur dil peda kiye , takay tum shukar ada kero .

verses.text: kiya unhon ney parindon ko nahi dekha kay woh aasman ki fizza mein Allah kay hukum kay paband hain-? unhen Allah kay siwa koi aur thamay huye nahi hai . yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo emaan rakhtay hon .
verses.translation: kiya unhon ney parindon ko nahi dekha kay woh aasman ki fizza mein Allah kay hukum kay paband hain-? unhen Allah kay siwa koi aur thamay huye nahi hai . yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo emaan rakhtay hon .

verses.text: aur uss ney tumharay liye tumharay gharon ko sukoon ki jagah banaya , aur tumharay liye maweshiyon ki khalon say aesay ghar banaye jo tumhen safar per rawana hotay waqt aur kissi jagah thehrtay waqt halkay phulkay mehsoos hotay hain .   aur unn kay oon , unn kay royen aur unn kay baalon say ghareyloo saman aur aesi cheezen peda ken jo aik mauddat tak tumhen faeeda phonchati hain .
verses.translation: aur uss ney tumharay liye tumharay gharon ko sukoon ki jagah banaya , aur tumharay liye maweshiyon ki khalon say aesay ghar banaye jo tumhen safar per rawana hotay waqt aur kissi jagah thehrtay waqt halkay phulkay mehsoos hotay hain .   aur unn kay oon , unn kay royen aur unn kay baalon say ghareyloo saman aur aesi cheezen peda ken jo aik mauddat tak tumhen faeeda phonchati hain .

verses.text: aur Allah hi ney apni peda ki hoi cheezon say tumharay liye saye peda kiye , aur paharon mein tumharay liye panah gaahen banayen , aur tumharay liye aesay libas peda kiye jo tumhen garmi say bachatay hain , aur aesay libas jo tumhari jang mein tumhen mehfooz rakhtay hain .   iss tarah woh apni naimaton ko tum per mukammal kerta hai takay tum farmanbardaar bano .
verses.translation: aur Allah hi ney apni peda ki hoi cheezon say tumharay liye saye peda kiye , aur paharon mein tumharay liye panah gaahen banayen , aur tumharay liye aesay libas peda kiye jo tumhen garmi say bachatay hain , aur aesay libas jo tumhari jang mein tumhen mehfooz rakhtay hain .   iss tarah woh apni naimaton ko tum per mukammal kerta hai takay tum farmanbardaar bano .

verses.text: phir bhi agar yeh ( kafir ) mun morray rahen to ( aey payghumber ! ) tumhari zimma daari sirf itni hai kay wazeh tareeqay per paygham phoncha do .
verses.translation: phir bhi agar yeh ( kafir ) mun morray rahen to ( aey payghumber ! ) tumhari zimma daari sirf itni hai kay wazeh tareeqay per paygham phoncha do .

verses.text: yeh log Allah ki naimaton ko pehchantay hain , phir bhi inn ka inkar kertay hain , aur inn mein say aksar log nashukray hain .
verses.translation: yeh log Allah ki naimaton ko pehchantay hain , phir bhi inn ka inkar kertay hain , aur inn mein say aksar log nashukray hain .

verses.text: aur uss din ko yaad rakho jab hum her aik ummat mein say aik gawah kharra keren gay ,   phir jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya tha , unhen ( uzr paish kernay ki ) ijazat nahi di jaye gi , aur naa unn say yeh farmaeesh ki jaye gi kay woh tauba keren .
verses.translation: aur uss din ko yaad rakho jab hum her aik ummat mein say aik gawah kharra keren gay ,   phir jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya tha , unhen ( uzr paish kernay ki ) ijazat nahi di jaye gi , aur naa unn say yeh farmaeesh ki jaye gi kay woh tauba keren .

verses.text: aur jab yeh zalim azab ko aankhon say dekh len gay to naa inn/unn say uss azab ko halka kiya jaye ga , aur naa unn ko mohlat di jaye gi .
verses.translation: aur jab yeh zalim azab ko aankhon say dekh len gay to naa inn/unn say uss azab ko halka kiya jaye ga , aur naa unn ko mohlat di jaye gi .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney Allah kay sath shirk kiya tha , jab woh apney ( gharray huye ) shareekon ko dekhen gay to kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! yeh hain humaray ( banaye huye ) woh shareek jinn ko hum tujhay chorr ker pukara kertay thay .    uss moaqa per woh ( gharray huye shareek ) unn per baat phenk maaren gay kay :  tum bilkul jhootay ho .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney Allah kay sath shirk kiya tha , jab woh apney ( gharray huye ) shareekon ko dekhen gay to kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! yeh hain humaray ( banaye huye ) woh shareek jinn ko hum tujhay chorr ker pukara kertay thay .    uss moaqa per woh ( gharray huye shareek ) unn per baat phenk maaren gay kay :  tum bilkul jhootay ho .

verses.text: aur woh uss din Allah kay samney farmanbardaari kay bol bolney lagen gay , aur jo bohtan woh baandha kertay thay , uss ka unhen koi suragh nahi milay ga .
verses.translation: aur woh uss din Allah kay samney farmanbardaari kay bol bolney lagen gay , aur jo bohtan woh baandha kertay thay , uss ka unhen koi suragh nahi milay ga .

verses.text: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya tha , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roka tha , unn kay azab per hum mazeed azab ka izafa kertay rahen gay , kiyonkay woh fasad machaya kertay thay .
verses.translation: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya tha , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roka tha , unn kay azab per hum mazeed azab ka izafa kertay rahen gay , kiyonkay woh fasad machaya kertay thay .

verses.text: aur woh din bhi yaad rakho jab her ummat mein aik gawah unhi mein say kharra keren gay , aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum tumhen unn logon  kay khilaf gawahi denay kay liye layen gay . aur hum ney tum per yeh kitab utaar di hai takay woh her baat khol khol ker biyan kerday , aur musalmanon kay liye hidayat , rehmat aur khushkhabri ka saman ho .
verses.translation: aur woh din bhi yaad rakho jab her ummat mein aik gawah unhi mein say kharra keren gay , aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum tumhen unn logon  kay khilaf gawahi denay kay liye layen gay . aur hum ney tum per yeh kitab utaar di hai takay woh her baat khol khol ker biyan kerday , aur musalmanon kay liye hidayat , rehmat aur khushkhabri ka saman ho .

verses.text: beyshak Allah insaf ka , ehsan ka , aur rishta daaron ko ( unn kay huqooq ) denay ka hukum deta hai , aur bey hayai , badi aur zulm say rokta hai . woh tumhen naseehat kerta hai , takay tum naseehat qubool kero .
verses.translation: beyshak Allah insaf ka , ehsan ka , aur rishta daaron ko ( unn kay huqooq ) denay ka hukum deta hai , aur bey hayai , badi aur zulm say rokta hai . woh tumhen naseehat kerta hai , takay tum naseehat qubool kero .

verses.text: aur jab tum ney koi moahida kiya ho to Allah say kiye huye ehad ko poora kero , aur qasmon ko pukhta kernay kay baad unhen naa torro , jabkay tum apney oopper Allah ko gawah bana chukay ho . tum jo kuch kertay ho , yaqeenan Allah ussay janta hai .
verses.translation: aur jab tum ney koi moahida kiya ho to Allah say kiye huye ehad ko poora kero , aur qasmon ko pukhta kernay kay baad unhen naa torro , jabkay tum apney oopper Allah ko gawah bana chukay ho . tum jo kuch kertay ho , yaqeenan Allah ussay janta hai .

verses.text: aur jiss aurat ney apney soot ko mazbooti say kaatney kay baad ussay adher ker taar taar kerdiya tha ,tum uss jaisay naa ban jana   kay tum bhi apni qasmon ko ( torr ker ) aapas kay fasad ka zariya bananey lago , sirf iss liye kay kuch log doosron say ziyada faeeday hasil kerlen .   Allah iss kay zariye tumhari aazmaesh ker raha hai . aur qayamat kay din woh tumhen woh baaten zaroor khol ker bata dey ga jinn mein tum ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: aur jiss aurat ney apney soot ko mazbooti say kaatney kay baad ussay adher ker taar taar kerdiya tha ,tum uss jaisay naa ban jana   kay tum bhi apni qasmon ko ( torr ker ) aapas kay fasad ka zariya bananey lago , sirf iss liye kay kuch log doosron say ziyada faeeday hasil kerlen .   Allah iss kay zariye tumhari aazmaesh ker raha hai . aur qayamat kay din woh tumhen woh baaten zaroor khol ker bata dey ga jinn mein tum ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: aur agar Allah chahta to tum sabb ko aik hi ummat ( yani aik hi deen ka pero ) bana deta , lekin woh jiss ko chahta hai , ( uss ki zidd ki wajeh say ) gumrahi mein daal deta hai , aur jiss ko chahta hai , hidayat tak phoncha deta hai . aur tum jo amal bhi kertay thay uss kay baaray mein tum say zaroor baaz purs hogi .
verses.translation: aur agar Allah chahta to tum sabb ko aik hi ummat ( yani aik hi deen ka pero ) bana deta , lekin woh jiss ko chahta hai , ( uss ki zidd ki wajeh say ) gumrahi mein daal deta hai , aur jiss ko chahta hai , hidayat tak phoncha deta hai . aur tum jo amal bhi kertay thay uss kay baaray mein tum say zaroor baaz purs hogi .

verses.text: aur tum apni qasmon ko aapas mein fasad daalney ka zariya naa banao , jiss kay nateejay mein kissi ( aur ) ka paon jamney kay baad phisal jaye ,   phir tumhen ( uss ko ) Allah kay raastay say rokney ki wajeh say buri saza chakhni parray , aur tumhen ( aesi soorat mein ) bara azab hoga .
verses.translation: aur tum apni qasmon ko aapas mein fasad daalney ka zariya naa banao , jiss kay nateejay mein kissi ( aur ) ka paon jamney kay baad phisal jaye ,   phir tumhen ( uss ko ) Allah kay raastay say rokney ki wajeh say buri saza chakhni parray , aur tumhen ( aesi soorat mein ) bara azab hoga .

verses.text: aur Allah kay ehad ko thori si qeemat mein naa bech daalo . agar tum haqeeqat samjho to jo ( ajar ) Allah kay paas hai , woh tumharay liye kahen ziyada behtar hai .
verses.translation: aur Allah kay ehad ko thori si qeemat mein naa bech daalo . agar tum haqeeqat samjho to jo ( ajar ) Allah kay paas hai , woh tumharay liye kahen ziyada behtar hai .

verses.text: jo kuch tumharay paas hai woh sabb khatam hojaye ga , aur jo kuch Allah kay paas hai , woh baqi rehney wala hai . aur jinn logon  ney sabar say kaam liya hoga ,   hum unhen unn kay behtareen kamon kay mutabiq unn ka ajar zaroor ata keren gay .
verses.translation: jo kuch tumharay paas hai woh sabb khatam hojaye ga , aur jo kuch Allah kay paas hai , woh baqi rehney wala hai . aur jinn logon  ney sabar say kaam liya hoga ,   hum unhen unn kay behtareen kamon kay mutabiq unn ka ajar zaroor ata keren gay .

verses.text: jiss shaks ney bhi momin honey ki halat mein naik amal kiya hoga , chahye woh mard ho ya aurat , hum ussay pakeezah zindagi basar kerayen gay , aur aesay logon  ko unn kay behtareen aemal kay mutabiq unn ka ajar zaroor ata keren gay .
verses.translation: jiss shaks ney bhi momin honey ki halat mein naik amal kiya hoga , chahye woh mard ho ya aurat , hum ussay pakeezah zindagi basar kerayen gay , aur aesay logon  ko unn kay behtareen aemal kay mutabiq unn ka ajar zaroor ata keren gay .

verses.text: chunacheh jab tum Quran parhney lago to shetan mardood say Allah ki panah maang liya kero .
verses.translation: chunacheh jab tum Quran parhney lago to shetan mardood say Allah ki panah maang liya kero .

verses.text: uss ka bus aesay logon  per nahi chalta jo emaan laye hain , aur apney perwerdigar per bharosa rakhtay hain .
verses.translation: uss ka bus aesay logon  per nahi chalta jo emaan laye hain , aur apney perwerdigar per bharosa rakhtay hain .

verses.text: uss ka bus to unn logon  per chalta hai jo ussay dost banatay hain , aur Allah kay sath shirk ka irtikab kertay hain .
verses.translation: uss ka bus to unn logon  per chalta hai jo ussay dost banatay hain , aur Allah kay sath shirk ka irtikab kertay hain .

verses.text: aur jab hum aik aayat ko doosri aayat say badaltay hain   aur Allah hi behtar janta hai kay woh kiya nazil keray to yeh ( kafir ) kehtay hain kay :  tum to Allah per jhoot baandhney walay ho .  halankay unn mein say aksar log haqeeqat ka ilm nahi rakhtay .
verses.translation: aur jab hum aik aayat ko doosri aayat say badaltay hain   aur Allah hi behtar janta hai kay woh kiya nazil keray to yeh ( kafir ) kehtay hain kay :  tum to Allah per jhoot baandhney walay ho .  halankay unn mein say aksar log haqeeqat ka ilm nahi rakhtay .

verses.text: keh do kay :  yeh ( Quran-e-karim ) to rooh-ul-qudus ( yani jibraeel aleh-assalam ) tumharay rab ki taraf say theek theek ley ker aaye hain , takay woh emaan walon ko sabit qadam rakhay , aur musalmanon kay liye hidayat aur khushkhabri ka saman ho .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  yeh ( Quran-e-karim ) to rooh-ul-qudus ( yani jibraeel aleh-assalam ) tumharay rab ki taraf say theek theek ley ker aaye hain , takay woh emaan walon ko sabit qadam rakhay , aur musalmanon kay liye hidayat aur khushkhabri ka saman ho .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hamen maloom hai kay yeh log ( tumharay baaray mein ) yeh kehtay hain kay :  inn ko to aik insan sikhata parhata hai .  ( halankay ) jiss shaks ka yeh hawala dey rahey hain , uss ki zaban ajmi hai ,   aur yeh ( Quran ki zaban ) saaf arbi zaban hai .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hamen maloom hai kay yeh log ( tumharay baaray mein ) yeh kehtay hain kay :  inn ko to aik insan sikhata parhata hai .  ( halankay ) jiss shaks ka yeh hawala dey rahey hain , uss ki zaban ajmi hai ,   aur yeh ( Quran ki zaban ) saaf arbi zaban hai .

verses.text: jo log Allah ki aayaton per emaan nahi rakhtay , unn ko Allah hidayat per nahi lata , aur unn kay liye dardnak azab hai .
verses.translation: jo log Allah ki aayaton per emaan nahi rakhtay , unn ko Allah hidayat per nahi lata , aur unn kay liye dardnak azab hai .

verses.text: Allah per jhoot to ( payghumber nahi ) woh log baandhtay hain jo Allah ki aayaat per emaan nahi rakhtay , aur wohi haqeeqat mein jhootay hain .
verses.translation: Allah per jhoot to ( payghumber nahi ) woh log baandhtay hain jo Allah ki aayaat per emaan nahi rakhtay , aur wohi haqeeqat mein jhootay hain .

verses.text: jo shaks Allah per emaan laney kay baad uss kay sath kufr ka irtikab keray woh nahi jissay zabardasti ( kufr ka kalma kehney per ) majboor kerdiya gaya ho , jabkay uss ka dil emaan per mutmaeen ho , balkay woh shaks jiss ney apna seena kufr kay liye khol diya ho to aesay logon  per Allah ki taraf say ghazab nazil hoga ,   aur unn kay liye zabardast azab tayyar hai .
verses.translation: jo shaks Allah per emaan laney kay baad uss kay sath kufr ka irtikab keray woh nahi jissay zabardasti ( kufr ka kalma kehney per ) majboor kerdiya gaya ho , jabkay uss ka dil emaan per mutmaeen ho , balkay woh shaks jiss ney apna seena kufr kay liye khol diya ho to aesay logon  per Allah ki taraf say ghazab nazil hoga ,   aur unn kay liye zabardast azab tayyar hai .

verses.text: yeh iss liye kay aesay logon  ney duniya ki zindagi ko aakhirat kay muqablay mein ziyada mehboob samjha , aur iss liye kay Allah aesay nashukray logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchaya kerta .
verses.translation: yeh iss liye kay aesay logon  ney duniya ki zindagi ko aakhirat kay muqablay mein ziyada mehboob samjha , aur iss liye kay Allah aesay nashukray logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchaya kerta .

verses.text: yeh aesay log hain kay Allah ney inn kay dilon per , inn kay kanon per aur inn ki aankhon per mohar laga di hai , aur yehi log hain jo ( apney anjam say ) bilkul ghafil hain .
verses.translation: yeh aesay log hain kay Allah ney inn kay dilon per , inn kay kanon per aur inn ki aankhon per mohar laga di hai , aur yehi log hain jo ( apney anjam say ) bilkul ghafil hain .

verses.text: lazimi baat hai kay yehi log hain jo aakhirat mein sabb say ziyada nuqsan uthayen gay .
verses.translation: lazimi baat hai kay yehi log hain jo aakhirat mein sabb say ziyada nuqsan uthayen gay .

verses.text: phir yaqeen jano tumharay perwerdigar ka moamla yeh hai kay jinn logon  ney fitney mein mubtala honey kay baad hijrat ki , phir jihad kiya aur sabar say kaam liya to inn baaton kay baad tumhara perwerdigar yaqeenan boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: phir yaqeen jano tumharay perwerdigar ka moamla yeh hai kay jinn logon  ney fitney mein mubtala honey kay baad hijrat ki , phir jihad kiya aur sabar say kaam liya to inn baaton kay baad tumhara perwerdigar yaqeenan boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: yeh sabb kuch uss din hoga jab her shaks apney difaa ki baaten kerta huwa aaye ga , aur her her shaks ko uss kay saray aemal ka poora poora badla diya jaye ga , aur logon  per koi zulm nahi hoga .
verses.translation: yeh sabb kuch uss din hoga jab her shaks apney difaa ki baaten kerta huwa aaye ga , aur her her shaks ko uss kay saray aemal ka poora poora badla diya jaye ga , aur logon  per koi zulm nahi hoga .

verses.text: Allah aik basti ki misal deta hai jo bari pur aman aur mutmaeen thi , uss ka rizq uss ko her jagah say bari farawaani kay sath phonch raha tha , phir uss ney Allah ki naimaton ki nashukri shuroo kerdi , to Allah ney unn kay kartoot ki wajeh say unn ko yeh maza chakhaya kay bhook aur khof unn ka pehanna oarhna ban gaya .
verses.translation: Allah aik basti ki misal deta hai jo bari pur aman aur mutmaeen thi , uss ka rizq uss ko her jagah say bari farawaani kay sath phonch raha tha , phir uss ney Allah ki naimaton ki nashukri shuroo kerdi , to Allah ney unn kay kartoot ki wajeh say unn ko yeh maza chakhaya kay bhook aur khof unn ka pehanna oarhna ban gaya .

verses.text: aur unn kay paas unhi mein say aik payghumber aaya tha , magar unhon ney uss ko jhutlaya , chunacheh jab unhon ney zulm apna liya toh unn ko azab ney aa-pakra .
verses.translation: aur unn kay paas unhi mein say aik payghumber aaya tha , magar unhon ney uss ko jhutlaya , chunacheh jab unhon ney zulm apna liya toh unn ko azab ney aa-pakra .

verses.text: lehaza Allah ney jo halal pakeezah cheezen tumhen rizq kay tor per di hain , unhen khao ,   aur Allah ki naimaton ka shukar ada kero , agar tum waqaee ussi ki ibadat kertay ho .
verses.translation: lehaza Allah ney jo halal pakeezah cheezen tumhen rizq kay tor per di hain , unhen khao ,   aur Allah ki naimaton ka shukar ada kero , agar tum waqaee ussi ki ibadat kertay ho .

verses.text: uss ney to tumharay liye bus murdar , khoon , khinzeer ka gosht aur woh janwer haram kiya hai jiss per Allah kay siwa kissi aur ka naam pukara gaya ho . albatta jo shaks bhook say bilkul bey taab ho , lazzat hasil kernay kay liye naa khaye , aur ( zaroorat ki ) hadd say aagay naa barhay to Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: uss ney to tumharay liye bus murdar , khoon , khinzeer ka gosht aur woh janwer haram kiya hai jiss per Allah kay siwa kissi aur ka naam pukara gaya ho . albatta jo shaks bhook say bilkul bey taab ho , lazzat hasil kernay kay liye naa khaye , aur ( zaroorat ki ) hadd say aagay naa barhay to Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: aur jinn cheezon kay baaray mein tumhari zabanen jhooti baaten banati hain , unn kay baaray mein yeh matt kaha kero kay yeh cheez halal hai , aur yeh haram hai , kiyonkay iss ka matlab yeh hoga kay tum Allah per jhoota bohtan baandho gay . yaqeen jano kay jo log Allah per jhoota bohtan baandhtay hain , woh falah nahi paatay .
verses.translation: aur jinn cheezon kay baaray mein tumhari zabanen jhooti baaten banati hain , unn kay baaray mein yeh matt kaha kero kay yeh cheez halal hai , aur yeh haram hai , kiyonkay iss ka matlab yeh hoga kay tum Allah per jhoota bohtan baandho gay . yaqeen jano kay jo log Allah per jhoota bohtan baandhtay hain , woh falah nahi paatay .

verses.text: . ( duniya mein ) unhen jo aesh hasil hai , woh boht thora saa hai , aur unn kay liye dardnak azab tayyar hai .
verses.translation: . ( duniya mein ) unhen jo aesh hasil hai , woh boht thora saa hai , aur unn kay liye dardnak azab tayyar hai .

verses.text: aur yahudiyon kay liye hum ney woh cheezen haram ki then jinn ka tazkarah hum tum say pehlay hi ker-chukay hain .   aur hum ney unn per koi zulm nahi kiya , balkay woh khud apni janon per zulm dahatay rahey .
verses.translation: aur yahudiyon kay liye hum ney woh cheezen haram ki then jinn ka tazkarah hum tum say pehlay hi ker-chukay hain .   aur hum ney unn per koi zulm nahi kiya , balkay woh khud apni janon per zulm dahatay rahey .

verses.text: phir bhi tumhara rab aisa hai kay jinn logon  ney nadani mein burai ka irtikab kerliya , aur uss kay baad tauba kerli , aur apni islaah kerli to unn sabb baaton kay baad bhi tumhara perwerdigar boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: phir bhi tumhara rab aisa hai kay jinn logon  ney nadani mein burai ka irtikab kerliya , aur uss kay baad tauba kerli , aur apni islaah kerli to unn sabb baaton kay baad bhi tumhara perwerdigar boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: beyshak Ibrahim aesay peshwa thay jinhon ney her taraf say yaksoo ho ker Allah ki farmanbardaari ikhtiyar kerli thi , aur woh unn logon  mein say nahi thay jo Allah kay sath kissi ko shareek thehratay hain .
verses.translation: beyshak Ibrahim aesay peshwa thay jinhon ney her taraf say yaksoo ho ker Allah ki farmanbardaari ikhtiyar kerli thi , aur woh unn logon  mein say nahi thay jo Allah kay sath kissi ko shareek thehratay hain .

verses.text: woh Allah ki naimaton kay shukar guzaar thay . uss ney unhen chunn liya tha , aur unn ko seedhay raastay tak phoncha diya tha .
verses.translation: woh Allah ki naimaton kay shukar guzaar thay . uss ney unhen chunn liya tha , aur unn ko seedhay raastay tak phoncha diya tha .

verses.text: aur hum ney unn ko duniya mein bhi bhalai di thi , aur aakhirat mein to yaqeenan unn ka shumar sualeheen mein hai .
verses.translation: aur hum ney unn ko duniya mein bhi bhalai di thi , aur aakhirat mein to yaqeenan unn ka shumar sualeheen mein hai .

verses.text: phir ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum per bhi wahi kay zariye yeh hukum nazil kiya hai kay tum Ibrahim kay deen ki perwi kero jiss ney apna rukh Allah hi ki taraf kiya huwa tha , aur woh unn logon  mein say nahi thay jo Allah kay sath shirk kertay hain .
verses.translation: phir ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum per bhi wahi kay zariye yeh hukum nazil kiya hai kay tum Ibrahim kay deen ki perwi kero jiss ney apna rukh Allah hi ki taraf kiya huwa tha , aur woh unn logon  mein say nahi thay jo Allah kay sath shirk kertay hain .

verses.text: saneechar kay din kay ehkaam to unn logon  per lazim kiye gaye thay jinhon ney uss kay baaray mein ikhtilaf kiya tha ,   aur yaqeen rakho kay tumhara rab qayamat kay din inn/unn kay darmiyan unn tamam baaton ka faisla kerday ga jinn mein log ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: saneechar kay din kay ehkaam to unn logon  per lazim kiye gaye thay jinhon ney uss kay baaray mein ikhtilaf kiya tha ,   aur yaqeen rakho kay tumhara rab qayamat kay din inn/unn kay darmiyan unn tamam baaton ka faisla kerday ga jinn mein log ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: apney rab kay raastay ki taraf logon  ko hikmat kay sath aur khush asloobi say naseehat ker kay dawat do , aur ( agar behas ki noabat aaye to ) unn say behas bhi aesay tareeqay say kero jo behtareen ho . yaqeenan tumhara perwerdigar unn logon  ko bhi khoob janta hai jo uss kay raastay say bhatak gaye hain , aur unn say bhi khoob waqif hai jo raah-e-raast per qaeem hain .
verses.translation: apney rab kay raastay ki taraf logon  ko hikmat kay sath aur khush asloobi say naseehat ker kay dawat do , aur ( agar behas ki noabat aaye to ) unn say behas bhi aesay tareeqay say kero jo behtareen ho . yaqeenan tumhara perwerdigar unn logon  ko bhi khoob janta hai jo uss kay raastay say bhatak gaye hain , aur unn say bhi khoob waqif hai jo raah-e-raast per qaeem hain .

verses.text: aur agar tum log ( kissi kay zulm ka ) badla lo toh itna hi badla lo jitni ziyadti tumharay sath ki gaee thi . aur agar sabar hi kerlo toh yaqeenan yeh sabar kernay walon kay haq mein boht behtar hai .
verses.translation: aur agar tum log ( kissi kay zulm ka ) badla lo toh itna hi badla lo jitni ziyadti tumharay sath ki gaee thi . aur agar sabar hi kerlo toh yaqeenan yeh sabar kernay walon kay haq mein boht behtar hai .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum sabar say kaam lo , aur tumhara sabar Allah hi ki tofiq say hai . aur inn ( kafiron ) per sadma naa kero , aur jo makkariyan yeh log ker rahey hain , unn ki wajeh say tang dil naa ho .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum sabar say kaam lo , aur tumhara sabar Allah hi ki tofiq say hai . aur inn ( kafiron ) per sadma naa kero , aur jo makkariyan yeh log ker rahey hain , unn ki wajeh say tang dil naa ho .

verses.text: yaqeen rakho kay Allah unn logon  ka sathi hai jo taqwa ikhtiyar kertay hain , aur jo ehsan per amal paira hain .
verses.translation: yaqeen rakho kay Allah unn logon  ka sathi hai jo taqwa ikhtiyar kertay hain , aur jo ehsan per amal paira hain .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: Allah ka hukum aan phoncha hai , lehaza uss kay liye jaldi naa machao .   jo shirk yeh log ker rahey hain , woh uss say pak aur boht baala o bartar hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah ka hukum aan phoncha hai , lehaza uss kay liye jaldi naa machao .   jo shirk yeh log ker rahey hain , woh uss say pak aur boht baala o bartar hai .

ayahs.text: woh apney hukum say farishton ko apney bandon mein say jiss per chahta hai iss zindagi bakhshney wali wahi kay sath utaarta hai kay :  logon  ko aagah kerdo kay meray siwa koi mabood nahi hai , lehaza tum mujhi say daro , ( kissi aur say nahi )
ayahs.translation: woh apney hukum say farishton ko apney bandon mein say jiss per chahta hai iss zindagi bakhshney wali wahi kay sath utaarta hai kay :  logon  ko aagah kerdo kay meray siwa koi mabood nahi hai , lehaza tum mujhi say daro , ( kissi aur say nahi )

ayahs.text: uss ney aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq maqsad say peda kiya hai . jo shirk yeh log kertay hain , woh uss say boht baala o bartar hai .
ayahs.translation: uss ney aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq maqsad say peda kiya hai . jo shirk yeh log kertay hain , woh uss say boht baala o bartar hai .

ayahs.text: uss ney insan ko nutfay say peda kiya , phir dekhtay hi dekhtay woh khullam khula jhagray per aamada hogaya .
ayahs.translation: uss ney insan ko nutfay say peda kiya , phir dekhtay hi dekhtay woh khullam khula jhagray per aamada hogaya .

ayahs.text: aur chopaye ussi ney peda kiye jinn mein tumharay liye sardi say bachao ka saman hai ,   aur iss kay ilawa bhi boht say faeeday hain , aur unhi mein say tum khatay bhi ho .
ayahs.translation: aur chopaye ussi ney peda kiye jinn mein tumharay liye sardi say bachao ka saman hai ,   aur iss kay ilawa bhi boht say faeeday hain , aur unhi mein say tum khatay bhi ho .

ayahs.text: aur jab tum unhen shaam kay waqt ghar wapis latay ho , aur jab unhen subha ko charaney ley jatay ho to unn mein tumharay liye aik khushnuma manzar bhi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jab tum unhen shaam kay waqt ghar wapis latay ho , aur jab unhen subha ko charaney ley jatay ho to unn mein tumharay liye aik khushnuma manzar bhi hai .

ayahs.text: aur yeh tumharay bojh laad ker aesay shehar tak ley jatay hain jahan tum jaan jokhon mein daalay baghair nahi phonch saktay thay . haqeeqat yeh hai kay tumhara perwerdigar boht shafiq , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh tumharay bojh laad ker aesay shehar tak ley jatay hain jahan tum jaan jokhon mein daalay baghair nahi phonch saktay thay . haqeeqat yeh hai kay tumhara perwerdigar boht shafiq , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: aur ghorray , khachar aur gadhay ussi ney peda kiye hain takay tum unn per sawari kero , aur woh zeenat ka saman banen . aur woh boht si aesi cheezen peda kerta hai jinn ka tumhen ilm bhi nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ghorray , khachar aur gadhay ussi ney peda kiye hain takay tum unn per sawari kero , aur woh zeenat ka saman banen . aur woh boht si aesi cheezen peda kerta hai jinn ka tumhen ilm bhi nahi hai .

ayahs.text: aur seedha raasta dikhaney ki zimma daari Allah ney li hai , aur boht say raastay tairrhay hain , aur agar woh chahta to tum sabb ko seedhay raastay per phoncha bhi deta .
ayahs.translation: aur seedha raasta dikhaney ki zimma daari Allah ney li hai , aur boht say raastay tairrhay hain , aur agar woh chahta to tum sabb ko seedhay raastay per phoncha bhi deta .

ayahs.text: wohi hai jiss ney aasman say paani barsaya jiss say tumhen peenay ki cheezen hasil hoti hain , aur ussi say woh darkht ugtay hain jinn mein tum maweshiyon ko charatay ho .
ayahs.translation: wohi hai jiss ney aasman say paani barsaya jiss say tumhen peenay ki cheezen hasil hoti hain , aur ussi say woh darkht ugtay hain jinn mein tum maweshiyon ko charatay ho .

ayahs.text: ussi say Allah tumharay liye khetiyan , zaitoon , khujoor kay darkht , angoor aur her qisam kay phal ugata hai .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn sabb baaton mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishani hai jo sochtay samajhtay hon .
ayahs.translation: ussi say Allah tumharay liye khetiyan , zaitoon , khujoor kay darkht , angoor aur her qisam kay phal ugata hai .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn sabb baaton mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishani hai jo sochtay samajhtay hon .

ayahs.text: aur uss ney din aur raat ko aur sooraj aur chaand ko tumhari khidmat per laga rakha hai , aur sitaray bhi uss kay hukum say kaam per lagay huye hain . yaqeenan inn baaton mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo aqal say kaam len .
ayahs.translation: aur uss ney din aur raat ko aur sooraj aur chaand ko tumhari khidmat per laga rakha hai , aur sitaray bhi uss kay hukum say kaam per lagay huye hain . yaqeenan inn baaton mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo aqal say kaam len .

ayahs.text: issi tarah woh sari rang ba-rang ki cheezen jo uss ney tumhari khatir zameen mein phela rakhi hain , woh bhi uss kay hukum say kaam per lagi hoi hain . beyshak inn sabb mein unn logon  kay liye nishani hai jo sabaq hasil keren .
ayahs.translation: issi tarah woh sari rang ba-rang ki cheezen jo uss ney tumhari khatir zameen mein phela rakhi hain , woh bhi uss kay hukum say kaam per lagi hoi hain . beyshak inn sabb mein unn logon  kay liye nishani hai jo sabaq hasil keren .

ayahs.text: aur wohi hai jiss ney samandar ko kaam per lagaya , takay tum uss say taza gosht khao ,   aur uss say woh zewraat nikalo jo tum pehantay ho .   aur tum dekhtay ho kay uss mein kashtiyan paani ko cheerti hoi chalti hain , takay tum Allah ka fazal talash kero , aur takay shukar guzaar bano .
ayahs.translation: aur wohi hai jiss ney samandar ko kaam per lagaya , takay tum uss say taza gosht khao ,   aur uss say woh zewraat nikalo jo tum pehantay ho .   aur tum dekhtay ho kay uss mein kashtiyan paani ko cheerti hoi chalti hain , takay tum Allah ka fazal talash kero , aur takay shukar guzaar bano .

ayahs.text: aur uss ney zameen mein paharon kay langar daal diye hain takay woh tum ko ley ker dagmagaye nahi ,   aur darya aur raastay banaye hain takay tum manzil-e-maqsood tak phonch sako .
ayahs.translation: aur uss ney zameen mein paharon kay langar daal diye hain takay woh tum ko ley ker dagmagaye nahi ,   aur darya aur raastay banaye hain takay tum manzil-e-maqsood tak phonch sako .

ayahs.text: aur ( raaston ki pehchan kay liye ) boht si alamaten banai hain . aur sitaron say bhi log raasta maloom kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur ( raaston ki pehchan kay liye ) boht si alamaten banai hain . aur sitaron say bhi log raasta maloom kertay hain .

ayahs.text: abb batao kay jo zaat ( yeh sari cheezen ) peda kerti hai , kiya woh unn kay barabar ho sakti hai jo kuch peda nahi kertay ? kiya phir bhi tum koi sabaq nahi letay ?
ayahs.translation: abb batao kay jo zaat ( yeh sari cheezen ) peda kerti hai , kiya woh unn kay barabar ho sakti hai jo kuch peda nahi kertay ? kiya phir bhi tum koi sabaq nahi letay ?

ayahs.text: aur agar tum Allah ki naimaton ko ginney lago , to unhen shumar nahi ker-saktay . haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: aur agar tum Allah ki naimaton ko ginney lago , to unhen shumar nahi ker-saktay . haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: aur Allah woh baaten bhi janta hai jo tum chup ker kertay ho , aur woh bhi jo tum al-al-aelaan kertay ho .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah woh baaten bhi janta hai jo tum chup ker kertay ho , aur woh bhi jo tum al-al-aelaan kertay ho .

ayahs.text: aur Allah taalaa ko chorr ker yeh log jinn ( deotaon ) ko pukartay hain , woh kuch bhi peda nahi kertay , woh to khud hi makhlooq hain .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah taalaa ko chorr ker yeh log jinn ( deotaon ) ko pukartay hain , woh kuch bhi peda nahi kertay , woh to khud hi makhlooq hain .

ayahs.text: woh bey jaan hain , unn mein zindagi nahi , aur unn ko iss baat ka bhi ehsas nahi hai kay inn logon  ko kab zinda ker kay uthaya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: woh bey jaan hain , unn mein zindagi nahi , aur unn ko iss baat ka bhi ehsas nahi hai kay inn logon  ko kab zinda ker kay uthaya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: tumhara mabood to bus aik hi khuda hai . lehaza jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , unn kay dil mein inkar paywast hogaya hai , aur woh ghamand mein mubtala hain .
ayahs.translation: tumhara mabood to bus aik hi khuda hai . lehaza jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , unn kay dil mein inkar paywast hogaya hai , aur woh ghamand mein mubtala hain .

ayahs.text: zahir baat hai kay Allah woh baaten bhi janta hai jo woh chup ker kertay hain , aur woh bhi jo woh al-al-aelaan kertay hain . woh yaqeenan ghamand kernay walon ko pasand nahi kerta .
ayahs.translation: zahir baat hai kay Allah woh baaten bhi janta hai jo woh chup ker kertay hain , aur woh bhi jo woh al-al-aelaan kertay hain . woh yaqeenan ghamand kernay walon ko pasand nahi kerta .

ayahs.text: aur jab unn say kaha gaya kay :  tumharay rab ney kiya baat nazil ki hai ?  to unhon ney kaha kay :  guzray huye logon  kay afsaney !
ayahs.translation: aur jab unn say kaha gaya kay :  tumharay rab ney kiya baat nazil ki hai ?  to unhon ney kaha kay :  guzray huye logon  kay afsaney !

ayahs.text: . ( inn baaton ka ) nateeja yeh hai kay woh qayamat kay din khud apney ( gunahon ) kay pooray pooray bojh bhi apney oopper laaden gay , aur unn logon  kay bojh ka aik hissa bhi jinhen yeh kissi ilm kay baghair gumrah ker rahey hain .   yaad rakho kay boht bura bojh hai jo yeh laad rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: . ( inn baaton ka ) nateeja yeh hai kay woh qayamat kay din khud apney ( gunahon ) kay pooray pooray bojh bhi apney oopper laaden gay , aur unn logon  kay bojh ka aik hissa bhi jinhen yeh kissi ilm kay baghair gumrah ker rahey hain .   yaad rakho kay boht bura bojh hai jo yeh laad rahey hain .

ayahs.text: inn say pehlay kay logon  ney bhi makar kay mansoobay banaye thay . phir huwa yeh kay ( mansoobon ki ) jo imaraten unhon ney tameer ki then , Allah taalaa ney unhen jarr buniyad say ukhaar phenka , phir unn kay oopper say chat bhi unn per aagiri , aur unn per azab aesi jagah say aa-dhamka jiss ka unhen ehsas tak nahi tha .
ayahs.translation: inn say pehlay kay logon  ney bhi makar kay mansoobay banaye thay . phir huwa yeh kay ( mansoobon ki ) jo imaraten unhon ney tameer ki then , Allah taalaa ney unhen jarr buniyad say ukhaar phenka , phir unn kay oopper say chat bhi unn per aagiri , aur unn per azab aesi jagah say aa-dhamka jiss ka unhen ehsas tak nahi tha .

ayahs.text: phir qayamat kay din Allah unhen ruswa keray ga , aur unn say poochay ga kay :  kahan hain woh meray shareek jinn ki khatir tum ( musalmanon say ) jhagrra kiya kertay thay ?  jinn logon  ko ilm ata huwa hai , woh ( uss din ) kahen gay kay :  bari ruswai aur bad-haali musallat hai aaj unn kafiron per .
ayahs.translation: phir qayamat kay din Allah unhen ruswa keray ga , aur unn say poochay ga kay :  kahan hain woh meray shareek jinn ki khatir tum ( musalmanon say ) jhagrra kiya kertay thay ?  jinn logon  ko ilm ata huwa hai , woh ( uss din ) kahen gay kay :  bari ruswai aur bad-haali musallat hai aaj unn kafiron per .

ayahs.text: jinn ki roohen farishton ney iss halat mein qabz ken jab unhon ney apni janon per ( kufr ki wajeh say ) zulm ker rakha tha .    uss moaqa per kafir log bari farmanbardaari kay bol bolen gay kay hum to koi bura kaam nahi kertay thay . ( unn say kaha jaye ga : )  kaisay nahi kertay thay ?  Allah ko sabb maloom hai kay tum kiya kuch kertay rahey ho .
ayahs.translation: jinn ki roohen farishton ney iss halat mein qabz ken jab unhon ney apni janon per ( kufr ki wajeh say ) zulm ker rakha tha .    uss moaqa per kafir log bari farmanbardaari kay bol bolen gay kay hum to koi bura kaam nahi kertay thay . ( unn say kaha jaye ga : )  kaisay nahi kertay thay ?  Allah ko sabb maloom hai kay tum kiya kuch kertay rahey ho .

ayahs.text: lehaza abb hamesha jahannum mein rehney kay liye uss kay darwazon mein dakhil hojao , kiyonkay takabbur kernay walon ka yehi bura thikana hai .
ayahs.translation: lehaza abb hamesha jahannum mein rehney kay liye uss kay darwazon mein dakhil hojao , kiyonkay takabbur kernay walon ka yehi bura thikana hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( doosri taraf ) muttaqi logon  say poocha gaya kay :  tumharay perwerdigar ney kiya cheez nazil ki hai ?  to unhon ney kaha :  khair hi khair utaari hai .  ( iss tarah ) jinn logon  ney naiki ki rawish ikhtiyar ki hai , unn kay liye iss duniya mein bhi behtari hai , aur aakhirat ka ghar to hai hi sarapa behtari , yaqeenan muttaqiyo ka ghar behtareen hai ,
ayahs.translation: aur ( doosri taraf ) muttaqi logon  say poocha gaya kay :  tumharay perwerdigar ney kiya cheez nazil ki hai ?  to unhon ney kaha :  khair hi khair utaari hai .  ( iss tarah ) jinn logon  ney naiki ki rawish ikhtiyar ki hai , unn kay liye iss duniya mein bhi behtari hai , aur aakhirat ka ghar to hai hi sarapa behtari , yaqeenan muttaqiyo ka ghar behtareen hai ,

ayahs.text: hamesha hamesha basney kay liye woh baaghaat jinn mein woh dakhil hon gay , jinn kay neechay say nehren behti hon gi , aur wahan jo kuch woh chahen gay , unhen milay ga . muttaqi logon  ko Allah aisa hi sila deta hai .
ayahs.translation: hamesha hamesha basney kay liye woh baaghaat jinn mein woh dakhil hon gay , jinn kay neechay say nehren behti hon gi , aur wahan jo kuch woh chahen gay , unhen milay ga . muttaqi logon  ko Allah aisa hi sila deta hai .

ayahs.text: yeh woh log hain jinn ki roohen farishtay aesi halat mein qabz kertay hain kay woh pak saaf hotay hain . woh unn say kehtay hain kay :  salamti ho tum per ! jo amal tum kertay rahey ho , uss kay silay mein jannat mein dakhil hojao .
ayahs.translation: yeh woh log hain jinn ki roohen farishtay aesi halat mein qabz kertay hain kay woh pak saaf hotay hain . woh unn say kehtay hain kay :  salamti ho tum per ! jo amal tum kertay rahey ho , uss kay silay mein jannat mein dakhil hojao .

ayahs.text: yeh ( kafir ) log abb ( emaan laney kay liye ) iss kay siwa kiss baat kay muntazir hain kay inn kay paas farishtay aa-kharay hon , ya ( qayamat ya azab ki soorat mein ) tumharay perwerdigar ka hukum hi aajaye . jo ummaten inn say pehlay guzri hain , unhon ney bhi aisa hi kiya tha . aur Allah ney unn per koi zulm nahi kiya , lekin woh khud apni janon per zulm dahatay rahey thay .
ayahs.translation: yeh ( kafir ) log abb ( emaan laney kay liye ) iss kay siwa kiss baat kay muntazir hain kay inn kay paas farishtay aa-kharay hon , ya ( qayamat ya azab ki soorat mein ) tumharay perwerdigar ka hukum hi aajaye . jo ummaten inn say pehlay guzri hain , unhon ney bhi aisa hi kiya tha . aur Allah ney unn per koi zulm nahi kiya , lekin woh khud apni janon per zulm dahatay rahey thay .

ayahs.text: iss liye unn kay buray aemal ka wabal unn per parra , aur jiss cheez ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay , ussi ney unn ko aa-ker gher liya .
ayahs.translation: iss liye unn kay buray aemal ka wabal unn per parra , aur jiss cheez ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay , ussi ney unn ko aa-ker gher liya .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney shirk ikhtiyar kiya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  agar Allah chahta to hum uss kay siwa kissi aur cheez ki ibadat naa kertay , naa hum , naa humaray baap dada , aur naa hum uss kay ( hukum kay ) baghair koi cheez haram qarar detay .  jo ummaten inn say pehlay guzri hain , unhon ney bhi aisa hi kiya tha . lekin payghumberon ki zimma daari iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay woh saaf saaf tareeqay per paygham phoncha den .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney shirk ikhtiyar kiya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  agar Allah chahta to hum uss kay siwa kissi aur cheez ki ibadat naa kertay , naa hum , naa humaray baap dada , aur naa hum uss kay ( hukum kay ) baghair koi cheez haram qarar detay .  jo ummaten inn say pehlay guzri hain , unhon ney bhi aisa hi kiya tha . lekin payghumberon ki zimma daari iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay woh saaf saaf tareeqay per paygham phoncha den .

ayahs.text: aur waqiaa yeh hai kay hum ney her ummat mein koi naa koi payghumber iss hidayat kay sath bheja hai kay tum Allah ki ibadat kero , aur taghoot say ijtinab kero .   phir unn mein say kuch woh thay jinn ko Allah ney hidayat dey di aur kuch aesay thay jinn per gumrahi musallat hogaee . to zara zameen mein chal phir ker dekho kay ( payghumberon ko ) jhutlaney walon ka anjam kaisa huwa-?
ayahs.translation: aur waqiaa yeh hai kay hum ney her ummat mein koi naa koi payghumber iss hidayat kay sath bheja hai kay tum Allah ki ibadat kero , aur taghoot say ijtinab kero .   phir unn mein say kuch woh thay jinn ko Allah ney hidayat dey di aur kuch aesay thay jinn per gumrahi musallat hogaee . to zara zameen mein chal phir ker dekho kay ( payghumberon ko ) jhutlaney walon ka anjam kaisa huwa-?

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) agar tumhen yeh hirs hai kay yeh log hidayat per aajayen , to haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah jinn ko ( unn kay enaad ki wajeh say ) gumrah ker deta hai , unn ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata , aur aesay logon  ko kissi qisam kay madadgaar bhi moyassar nahi aatay .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) agar tumhen yeh hirs hai kay yeh log hidayat per aajayen , to haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah jinn ko ( unn kay enaad ki wajeh say ) gumrah ker deta hai , unn ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata , aur aesay logon  ko kissi qisam kay madadgaar bhi moyassar nahi aatay .

ayahs.text: aur inn logon  ney bara zor laga laga ker Allah ki qasmen khai hain kay jo log mar-jatay hain , Allah unn ko dobara zinda nahi keray ga . bhala kiyon nahi keray ga-? yeh to aik wada hai jissay sacha kernay ki zimma daari Allah ney ley rakhi hai , lekin aksar log jantay nahi hain .
ayahs.translation: aur inn logon  ney bara zor laga laga ker Allah ki qasmen khai hain kay jo log mar-jatay hain , Allah unn ko dobara zinda nahi keray ga . bhala kiyon nahi keray ga-? yeh to aik wada hai jissay sacha kernay ki zimma daari Allah ney ley rakhi hai , lekin aksar log jantay nahi hain .

ayahs.text: . ( dobara zinda kernay ka yeh wada Allah ney iss liye kiya hai ) takay woh logon  kay samney unn baaton ko achi tarah wazeh kerday jinn mein woh ikhtilaf ker rahey hain , aur takay kafir log jaan len kay woh jhootay thay .
ayahs.translation: . ( dobara zinda kernay ka yeh wada Allah ney iss liye kiya hai ) takay woh logon  kay samney unn baaton ko achi tarah wazeh kerday jinn mein woh ikhtilaf ker rahey hain , aur takay kafir log jaan len kay woh jhootay thay .

ayahs.text: aur jab hum kissi cheez ko peda kernay ka irada kertay hain to humari taraf say sirf itni baat hoti hai kay hum ussay kehtay hain :  hoja  bus woh hojati hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jab hum kissi cheez ko peda kernay ka irada kertay hain to humari taraf say sirf itni baat hoti hai kay hum ussay kehtay hain :  hoja  bus woh hojati hai .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney doosron kay zulm sehnay kay baad Allah ki khatir apna watan chorra hai , yaqeen rakho kay unhen hum duniya mein bhi achi tarah basayen gay , aur aakhirat ka ajar to yaqeenan sabb say bara hai . kaash kay yeh log jaan letay !
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney doosron kay zulm sehnay kay baad Allah ki khatir apna watan chorra hai , yaqeen rakho kay unhen hum duniya mein bhi achi tarah basayen gay , aur aakhirat ka ajar to yaqeenan sabb say bara hai . kaash kay yeh log jaan letay !

ayahs.text: yeh woh log hain jinhon ney sabar say kaam liya hai , aur jo apney perwerdigar per bharosa rakhtay hain .
ayahs.translation: yeh woh log hain jinhon ney sabar say kaam liya hai , aur jo apney perwerdigar per bharosa rakhtay hain .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum say pehlay bhi kissi aur ko nahi , insanon hi ko payghumber bana ker bheja tha jinn per hum wahi nazil kertay thay . ( aey munkiro ! ) abb agar tumhen iss baat ka ilm nahi hai to jo ilm walay hain unn say pooch lo .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum say pehlay bhi kissi aur ko nahi , insanon hi ko payghumber bana ker bheja tha jinn per hum wahi nazil kertay thay . ( aey munkiro ! ) abb agar tumhen iss baat ka ilm nahi hai to jo ilm walay hain unn say pooch lo .

ayahs.text: unn payghumberon ko roshan dalaeel aur aasmani kitaben dey ker bheja gaya tha . aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum per bhi yeh Quran iss liye nazil kiya hai takay tum logon  kay samney unn baaton ki wazeh tashreeh ker do jo unn kay liye utaari gaee hain , aur takay woh ghor-o-fiker say kaam len .
ayahs.translation: unn payghumberon ko roshan dalaeel aur aasmani kitaben dey ker bheja gaya tha . aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum per bhi yeh Quran iss liye nazil kiya hai takay tum logon  kay samney unn baaton ki wazeh tashreeh ker do jo unn kay liye utaari gaee hain , aur takay woh ghor-o-fiker say kaam len .

ayahs.text: to kiya woh log jo buray buray mansoobay bana rahey hain iss baat say bilkul bey khof hogaye hain kay Allah unhen zameen mein dhansa dey , ya unn per azab aesi jagah say aa-parey kay unhen ehsas tak naa ho-?
ayahs.translation: to kiya woh log jo buray buray mansoobay bana rahey hain iss baat say bilkul bey khof hogaye hain kay Allah unhen zameen mein dhansa dey , ya unn per azab aesi jagah say aa-parey kay unhen ehsas tak naa ho-?

ayahs.text: ya unhen chaltay phirtay hi apni pakar mein ley ley , kiyonkay woh ussay aajiz nahi ker-saktay ,
ayahs.translation: ya unhen chaltay phirtay hi apni pakar mein ley ley , kiyonkay woh ussay aajiz nahi ker-saktay ,

ayahs.text: ya unhen iss tarah girift mein ley kay woh dheeray dheeray ghattey chalay jayen ?   kiyonkay tumhara perwerdigar bara shafiq , nihayat meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: ya unhen iss tarah girift mein ley kay woh dheeray dheeray ghattey chalay jayen ?   kiyonkay tumhara perwerdigar bara shafiq , nihayat meharban hai .

ayahs.text: kiya unhon ney nahi dekha kay Allah ney jo cheez bhi peda ki hai , uss kay saye Allah ko sajday kertay huye dayen aur bayen jhukay rehtay hain , aur woh sabb aajzi ka izhar ker rahey hotay hain-?
ayahs.translation: kiya unhon ney nahi dekha kay Allah ney jo cheez bhi peda ki hai , uss kay saye Allah ko sajday kertay huye dayen aur bayen jhukay rehtay hain , aur woh sabb aajzi ka izhar ker rahey hotay hain-?

ayahs.text: aur aasmano aur zameen mein jitney jandaar hain , woh aur saray farishtay Allah hi ko sajda kertay hain , aur woh zara takabbur nahi kertay .
ayahs.translation: aur aasmano aur zameen mein jitney jandaar hain , woh aur saray farishtay Allah hi ko sajda kertay hain , aur woh zara takabbur nahi kertay .

ayahs.text: woh apney uss perwerdigar say dartay hain jo unn kay oopper hai , aur wohi kaam kertay hain jiss ka unhen hukum diya jata hai .
ayahs.translation: woh apney uss perwerdigar say dartay hain jo unn kay oopper hai , aur wohi kaam kertay hain jiss ka unhen hukum diya jata hai .

ayahs.text: aur Allah ney farmaya hai kay :  do do mabood naa bana bethna . woh to bus aik hi mabood hai . iss liye bus mujhi say dara kero .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah ney farmaya hai kay :  do do mabood naa bana bethna . woh to bus aik hi mabood hai . iss liye bus mujhi say dara kero .

ayahs.text: aur aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , ussi ka hai , aur ussi ki itaat her haal mein lazim hai . kiya phir bhi tum Allah kay siwa auron say dartay ho-?
ayahs.translation: aur aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , ussi ka hai , aur ussi ki itaat her haal mein lazim hai . kiya phir bhi tum Allah kay siwa auron say dartay ho-?

ayahs.text: aur tum ko jo naimat bhi hasil hoti hai , woh Allah ki taraf say hoti hai , phir jab tumhen koi takleef phonchti hai to ussi say fariyaden kertay ho .
ayahs.translation: aur tum ko jo naimat bhi hasil hoti hai , woh Allah ki taraf say hoti hai , phir jab tumhen koi takleef phonchti hai to ussi say fariyaden kertay ho .

ayahs.text: uss kay baad jab woh tum say takleef door ker deta hai , to tum mein say aik giroh achanak apney perwerdigar kay sath shirk shuroo ker deta hai ,
ayahs.translation: uss kay baad jab woh tum say takleef door ker deta hai , to tum mein say aik giroh achanak apney perwerdigar kay sath shirk shuroo ker deta hai ,

ayahs.text: takay hum ney ussay jo naimat di thi uss ki nashukri keray . acha ! kuch aesh kerlo , phir unqareeb tumhen pata chal jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: takay hum ney ussay jo naimat di thi uss ki nashukri keray . acha ! kuch aesh kerlo , phir unqareeb tumhen pata chal jaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney jo rizq unhen diya hai , uss mein woh unn ( button ) ka hissa lagatay hain jinn ki haqeeqat khud unhen maloom nahi hai .   Allah ki qasam ! tum say zaroor baaz purs hogi kay tum kaisay bohtan baandha kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney jo rizq unhen diya hai , uss mein woh unn ( button ) ka hissa lagatay hain jinn ki haqeeqat khud unhen maloom nahi hai .   Allah ki qasam ! tum say zaroor baaz purs hogi kay tum kaisay bohtan baandha kertay thay .

ayahs.text: aur Allah kay liye to unhon ney betiyan gharr rakhi hain . subhan Allah ! aur khud apney liye woh ( betay chahtay hain ) jo apni khuwaish kay mutabiq hon !
ayahs.translation: aur Allah kay liye to unhon ney betiyan gharr rakhi hain . subhan Allah ! aur khud apney liye woh ( betay chahtay hain ) jo apni khuwaish kay mutabiq hon !

ayahs.text: aur jab unn mein say kissi ko beti ki ( pedaeesh ) ki khushkhabri di jati hai to uss ka chehra siyah parr-jata hai , aur woh dil hi dil mein kurrhta rehta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jab unn mein say kissi ko beti ki ( pedaeesh ) ki khushkhabri di jati hai to uss ka chehra siyah parr-jata hai , aur woh dil hi dil mein kurrhta rehta hai .

ayahs.text: iss khushkhabri ko bura samajh ker logon  say chupta phirta hai , ( aur sochta hai kay ) zillat bardasht ker kay ussay apney paas rehney dey , ya ussay zameen mein gaarr dey . dekho unhon ney kitni buri baaten tey ker rakhi hain .
ayahs.translation: iss khushkhabri ko bura samajh ker logon  say chupta phirta hai , ( aur sochta hai kay ) zillat bardasht ker kay ussay apney paas rehney dey , ya ussay zameen mein gaarr dey . dekho unhon ney kitni buri baaten tey ker rakhi hain .

ayahs.text: buri buri baaten to unhi mein hain jo aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay . aur aalaa darjay ki sifaat sirf Allah ki hain , aur woh iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
ayahs.translation: buri buri baaten to unhi mein hain jo aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay . aur aalaa darjay ki sifaat sirf Allah ki hain , aur woh iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

ayahs.text: aur agar Allah logon  ko unn kay zulm ki wajeh say ( foran ) apni pakar mein leta to rooaey zameen per koi jandaar baqi naa chorta , lekin woh unn ko aik moyyan waqt tak mohlat deta hai . phir jab unn ka woh moyyan waqt aajaye ga to woh gharri bhar bhi uss say aagay peechay nahi hosaken gay .
ayahs.translation: aur agar Allah logon  ko unn kay zulm ki wajeh say ( foran ) apni pakar mein leta to rooaey zameen per koi jandaar baqi naa chorta , lekin woh unn ko aik moyyan waqt tak mohlat deta hai . phir jab unn ka woh moyyan waqt aajaye ga to woh gharri bhar bhi uss say aagay peechay nahi hosaken gay .

ayahs.text: aur unhon ney Allah kay liye woh cheezen gharr rakhi hain jinhen khud napasand kertay hain , phir bhi inn ki zabanen ( apni ) jhooti tareef kerti rehti hain kay sari bhalai inhi kay hissay mein hai . lazimi baat hai kay ( aesay ravaiyyey ki wajeh say ) inn kay hissay mein toh dozakh hai , aur enhen issi mein parra rehney diya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: aur unhon ney Allah kay liye woh cheezen gharr rakhi hain jinhen khud napasand kertay hain , phir bhi inn ki zabanen ( apni ) jhooti tareef kerti rehti hain kay sari bhalai inhi kay hissay mein hai . lazimi baat hai kay ( aesay ravaiyyey ki wajeh say ) inn kay hissay mein toh dozakh hai , aur enhen issi mein parra rehney diya jaye ga .

ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) Allah ki qasam ! tum say pehlay jo ummaten guzri hain , hum ney unn kay paas payghumber bhejay thay , to shetan ney unn kay aemal ko khoob bana sanwaar ker unn kay samney paish kiya .   chunacheh wohi ( shetan ) aaj inn ka sarparast bana huwa hai , aur ( iss ki wajeh say ) unn kay liye dardnak azab tayyar hai .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney tum per yeh kitab issi liye utaari hai takay tum inn kay samney woh baaten khol khol ker biyan kerdo jinn mein enhon ney mukhtalif raastay apnaye huye hain , aur takay yeh emaan laney walon kay liye hidayat aur rehmat ka saman ho .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney tum per yeh kitab issi liye utaari hai takay tum inn kay samney woh baaten khol khol ker biyan kerdo jinn mein enhon ney mukhtalif raastay apnaye huye hain , aur takay yeh emaan laney walon kay liye hidayat aur rehmat ka saman ho .

ayahs.text: aur Allah ney aasman say paani barsaya , aur zameen kay murda hojaney kay baad uss mein jaan daal di . yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye nishani hai jo baat suntay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah ney aasman say paani barsaya , aur zameen kay murda hojaney kay baad uss mein jaan daal di . yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye nishani hai jo baat suntay hain .

ayahs.text: aur beyshak tumharay liye maweshiyon mein bhi sochney samajnay ka bara samaan hai .unn kay pet mein jo gobar aur khoon hai uss kay bech mein say hum tumhen aisa saaf suthra doodh peenay ko detay hain jo peenay walon kay liye khushgawar hota hai .
ayahs.translation: aur beyshak tumharay liye maweshiyon mein bhi sochney samajnay ka bara samaan hai .unn kay pet mein jo gobar aur khoon hai uss kay bech mein say hum tumhen aisa saaf suthra doodh peenay ko detay hain jo peenay walon kay liye khushgawar hota hai .

ayahs.text: aur khujoor kay phalon aur angooron say bhi ( hum tumhen aik mashroob ata kertay hain ) jiss say tum sharab bhi banatay ho , aur pakeezah rizq bhi .   beyshak iss mein bhi unn logon  kay liye nishani hai jo aqal say kaam letay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur khujoor kay phalon aur angooron say bhi ( hum tumhen aik mashroob ata kertay hain ) jiss say tum sharab bhi banatay ho , aur pakeezah rizq bhi .   beyshak iss mein bhi unn logon  kay liye nishani hai jo aqal say kaam letay hain .

ayahs.text: aur tumharay perwerdigar ney shehad ki makkhi kay dil mein yeh baat daal di kay :  tu paharon mein , aur darakhton mein aur log jo chatriyan uthatay hain , unn mein apney ghar bana .
ayahs.translation: aur tumharay perwerdigar ney shehad ki makkhi kay dil mein yeh baat daal di kay :  tu paharon mein , aur darakhton mein aur log jo chatriyan uthatay hain , unn mein apney ghar bana .

ayahs.text: phir her qisam kay phalon say apni khurak hasil ker , phir unn raaston per chal jo teray rab ney teray liye aasaan bana diye hain .  ( iss tarah ) iss makkhi kay pet say woh mukhtalif rangon wala mashroob nikalta hai jiss mein logon  kay liye shifa hai . yaqeenan inn sabb baaton mein unn logon  kay liye nishani hai jo sochtay samajhtay hon .
ayahs.translation: phir her qisam kay phalon say apni khurak hasil ker , phir unn raaston per chal jo teray rab ney teray liye aasaan bana diye hain .  ( iss tarah ) iss makkhi kay pet say woh mukhtalif rangon wala mashroob nikalta hai jiss mein logon  kay liye shifa hai . yaqeenan inn sabb baaton mein unn logon  kay liye nishani hai jo sochtay samajhtay hon .

ayahs.text: aur Allah ney tumhen peda kiya hai , phir woh tumhari rooh qabz kerta hai . aur tum mein say koi aisa hota hai jo umar kay sabb say nakara hissay tak phoncha diya jata hai , jiss mein phonch ker woh sabb kuch janney kay baad bhi kuch nahi janta .   beyshak Allah baray ilm wala , bari qudrat wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah ney tumhen peda kiya hai , phir woh tumhari rooh qabz kerta hai . aur tum mein say koi aisa hota hai jo umar kay sabb say nakara hissay tak phoncha diya jata hai , jiss mein phonch ker woh sabb kuch janney kay baad bhi kuch nahi janta .   beyshak Allah baray ilm wala , bari qudrat wala hai .

ayahs.text: aur Allah ney tum mein say kuch logon  ko rizq kay moamlay mein doosron per bartari dey rakhi hai . abb jinn logon  ko bartari di gaee hai , woh apna rizq apney ghulamon ko iss tarah nahi loata detay kay woh sabb barabar hojayen .   to kiya yeh log Allah ki naimat ka inkar kertay hain-?
ayahs.translation: aur Allah ney tum mein say kuch logon  ko rizq kay moamlay mein doosron per bartari dey rakhi hai . abb jinn logon  ko bartari di gaee hai , woh apna rizq apney ghulamon ko iss tarah nahi loata detay kay woh sabb barabar hojayen .   to kiya yeh log Allah ki naimat ka inkar kertay hain-?

ayahs.text: aur Allah ney tum hi mein say tumharay liye biwiyan banai hain , aur tumhari biwiyon say tumharay liye betay aur potay peda kiye hain , aur tumhen achi achi cheezon mein say rizq farham kiya hai . kiya phir bhi yeh log bey buniyad baaton per emaan latay aur Allah ki naimaton ki nashukri kertay hain-?
ayahs.translation: aur Allah ney tum hi mein say tumharay liye biwiyan banai hain , aur tumhari biwiyon say tumharay liye betay aur potay peda kiye hain , aur tumhen achi achi cheezon mein say rizq farham kiya hai . kiya phir bhi yeh log bey buniyad baaton per emaan latay aur Allah ki naimaton ki nashukri kertay hain-?

ayahs.text: aur yeh Allah ko chorr ker unn cheezon ki ibadat kertay hain jo unn ko aasmano aur zameen mein say kissi tarah ka rizq denay ka naa koi ikhtiyar rakhti hain , naa rakh sakti hain .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh Allah ko chorr ker unn cheezon ki ibadat kertay hain jo unn ko aasmano aur zameen mein say kissi tarah ka rizq denay ka naa koi ikhtiyar rakhti hain , naa rakh sakti hain .

ayahs.text: lehaza tum Allah kay liye misalen naa gharro .   beyshak Allah janta hai aur tum nahi jantay .
ayahs.translation: lehaza tum Allah kay liye misalen naa gharro .   beyshak Allah janta hai aur tum nahi jantay .

ayahs.text: Allah aik misal deta hai kay aik taraf aik ghulam hai jo kissi ki milkiyat mein hai , uss ko kissi cheez per koi ikhtiyar nahi , aur doosri taraf woh shaks hai jiss ko hum ney apney paas say umda rizq ata kiya hai , aur woh uss mein say posheeda tor per bhi aur khulay bandon bhi khoob kharch kerta hai . kiya yeh dono barabar hosaktay hain-? sari tareefen Allah ki hain , lekin inn mein say aksar log ( aesi saaf baat bhi ) nahi jantay .
ayahs.translation: Allah aik misal deta hai kay aik taraf aik ghulam hai jo kissi ki milkiyat mein hai , uss ko kissi cheez per koi ikhtiyar nahi , aur doosri taraf woh shaks hai jiss ko hum ney apney paas say umda rizq ata kiya hai , aur woh uss mein say posheeda tor per bhi aur khulay bandon bhi khoob kharch kerta hai . kiya yeh dono barabar hosaktay hain-? sari tareefen Allah ki hain , lekin inn mein say aksar log ( aesi saaf baat bhi ) nahi jantay .

ayahs.text: aur Allah aik aur misal deta hai kay do aadmi hain , unn mein say aik goonga hai jo koi kaam nahi ker-sakta , aur apney aaqa per bojh bana huwa hai , woh ussay jahan kahen bhejta hai , woh koi dhang ka kaam ker kay nahi lata , kiya aisa shaks uss doosray aadmi kay barabar hosakta hai jo doosron ko bhi aetidaal ka hukum deta hai , aur khud bhi seedhay raastay per qaeem hai ?
ayahs.translation: aur Allah aik aur misal deta hai kay do aadmi hain , unn mein say aik goonga hai jo koi kaam nahi ker-sakta , aur apney aaqa per bojh bana huwa hai , woh ussay jahan kahen bhejta hai , woh koi dhang ka kaam ker kay nahi lata , kiya aisa shaks uss doosray aadmi kay barabar hosakta hai jo doosron ko bhi aetidaal ka hukum deta hai , aur khud bhi seedhay raastay per qaeem hai ?

ayahs.text: aur aasmano aur zameen kay saray bhed Allah kay qabazay mein hain . aur qayamat ka moamla aankh jhapakney say ziyada nahi hoga , balkay uss say bhi jaldi . yaqeen rakho kay Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur aasmano aur zameen kay saray bhed Allah kay qabazay mein hain . aur qayamat ka moamla aankh jhapakney say ziyada nahi hoga , balkay uss say bhi jaldi . yaqeen rakho kay Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai .

ayahs.text: aur Allah ney tum ko tumhari maon kay pet say iss halat mein nikala kay tum kuch nahi jantay thay , aur tumharay liye kaan , aankhen aur dil peda kiye , takay tum shukar ada kero .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah ney tum ko tumhari maon kay pet say iss halat mein nikala kay tum kuch nahi jantay thay , aur tumharay liye kaan , aankhen aur dil peda kiye , takay tum shukar ada kero .

ayahs.text: kiya unhon ney parindon ko nahi dekha kay woh aasman ki fizza mein Allah kay hukum kay paband hain-? unhen Allah kay siwa koi aur thamay huye nahi hai . yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo emaan rakhtay hon .
ayahs.translation: kiya unhon ney parindon ko nahi dekha kay woh aasman ki fizza mein Allah kay hukum kay paband hain-? unhen Allah kay siwa koi aur thamay huye nahi hai . yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo emaan rakhtay hon .

ayahs.text: aur uss ney tumharay liye tumharay gharon ko sukoon ki jagah banaya , aur tumharay liye maweshiyon ki khalon say aesay ghar banaye jo tumhen safar per rawana hotay waqt aur kissi jagah thehrtay waqt halkay phulkay mehsoos hotay hain .   aur unn kay oon , unn kay royen aur unn kay baalon say ghareyloo saman aur aesi cheezen peda ken jo aik mauddat tak tumhen faeeda phonchati hain .
ayahs.translation: aur uss ney tumharay liye tumharay gharon ko sukoon ki jagah banaya , aur tumharay liye maweshiyon ki khalon say aesay ghar banaye jo tumhen safar per rawana hotay waqt aur kissi jagah thehrtay waqt halkay phulkay mehsoos hotay hain .   aur unn kay oon , unn kay royen aur unn kay baalon say ghareyloo saman aur aesi cheezen peda ken jo aik mauddat tak tumhen faeeda phonchati hain .

ayahs.text: aur Allah hi ney apni peda ki hoi cheezon say tumharay liye saye peda kiye , aur paharon mein tumharay liye panah gaahen banayen , aur tumharay liye aesay libas peda kiye jo tumhen garmi say bachatay hain , aur aesay libas jo tumhari jang mein tumhen mehfooz rakhtay hain .   iss tarah woh apni naimaton ko tum per mukammal kerta hai takay tum farmanbardaar bano .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah hi ney apni peda ki hoi cheezon say tumharay liye saye peda kiye , aur paharon mein tumharay liye panah gaahen banayen , aur tumharay liye aesay libas peda kiye jo tumhen garmi say bachatay hain , aur aesay libas jo tumhari jang mein tumhen mehfooz rakhtay hain .   iss tarah woh apni naimaton ko tum per mukammal kerta hai takay tum farmanbardaar bano .

ayahs.text: phir bhi agar yeh ( kafir ) mun morray rahen to ( aey payghumber ! ) tumhari zimma daari sirf itni hai kay wazeh tareeqay per paygham phoncha do .
ayahs.translation: phir bhi agar yeh ( kafir ) mun morray rahen to ( aey payghumber ! ) tumhari zimma daari sirf itni hai kay wazeh tareeqay per paygham phoncha do .

ayahs.text: yeh log Allah ki naimaton ko pehchantay hain , phir bhi inn ka inkar kertay hain , aur inn mein say aksar log nashukray hain .
ayahs.translation: yeh log Allah ki naimaton ko pehchantay hain , phir bhi inn ka inkar kertay hain , aur inn mein say aksar log nashukray hain .
