ayahs.translation: jo shaks seedhi raah per chalta hai , to woh khud apney faeeday kay liye chalta hai , aur jo gumrahi ka raasta ikhtiyar kerta hai , woh apney hi nuqsan kay liye ikhtiyar kerta hai . aur koi bojh uthaney wala kissi doosray ka bojh nahi uthaye ga . aur hum kabhi kissi ko uss waqt tak saza nahi detay jab tak koi payghumber ( uss kay paas ) naa bhej den .

ayahs.text: aur jab hum kissi basti ko halak kernay ka irada kertay hain to uss kay khush haal logon  ko ( emaan aur itaat ka ) hukum detay hain , phir woh wahan nafarmaniyan kertay hain , to unn per baat poori hojati hai , chunacheh hum unhen tabah o barbad ker daaltay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jab hum kissi basti ko halak kernay ka irada kertay hain to uss kay khush haal logon  ko ( emaan aur itaat ka ) hukum detay hain , phir woh wahan nafarmaniyan kertay hain , to unn per baat poori hojati hai , chunacheh hum unhen tabah o barbad ker daaltay hain .

ayahs.text: aur kitni hi naslen hain jo hum ney nooh kay baad halak ken ! aur tumhara rab apney bandon kay gunahon say poori tarah ba-khabar hai , sabb kuch dekh raha hai .
ayahs.translation: aur kitni hi naslen hain jo hum ney nooh kay baad halak ken ! aur tumhara rab apney bandon kay gunahon say poori tarah ba-khabar hai , sabb kuch dekh raha hai .

ayahs.text: jo shaks duniya kay fori faeeday hi chahta hai to hum jiss kay liye chahtay hain , jitna chahtay hain , ussay yahin per jaldi dey detay hain ,   phir uss kay liye hum ney jahannum rakh chorri hai jiss mein woh zaleel o khuwar ho ker dakhil hoga .
ayahs.translation: jo shaks duniya kay fori faeeday hi chahta hai to hum jiss kay liye chahtay hain , jitna chahtay hain , ussay yahin per jaldi dey detay hain ,   phir uss kay liye hum ney jahannum rakh chorri hai jiss mein woh zaleel o khuwar ho ker dakhil hoga .

ayahs.text: aur jo shaks aakhirat ( ka faeeda ) chahye , aur uss kay liye wesi hi koshish keray jaisi uss kay liye kerni chahye , jabkay woh momin bhi ho , to aesay logon  ki koshish ki poori qadar daani ki jaye gi .
ayahs.translation: aur jo shaks aakhirat ( ka faeeda ) chahye , aur uss kay liye wesi hi koshish keray jaisi uss kay liye kerni chahye , jabkay woh momin bhi ho , to aesay logon  ki koshish ki poori qadar daani ki jaye gi .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) jahan tak ( duniya mein ) tumharay rab ki ata ka talluq hai , hum inn ko bhi uss say nawaztay hain , aur unn ko bhi .   aur ( duniya mein ) tumharay rab ki ata kissi kay liye band nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) jahan tak ( duniya mein ) tumharay rab ki ata ka talluq hai , hum inn ko bhi uss say nawaztay hain , aur unn ko bhi .   aur ( duniya mein ) tumharay rab ki ata kissi kay liye band nahi hai .

ayahs.text: dekho hum ney kiss tarah unn mein say aik ko doosray per fazilat dey rakhi hai .   aur yaqeen rakho kay aakhirat darjaat kay aetbar say bhi boht bari hai , aur fazilat kay aetbar say bhi kahen ziyada hai .
ayahs.translation: dekho hum ney kiss tarah unn mein say aik ko doosray per fazilat dey rakhi hai .   aur yaqeen rakho kay aakhirat darjaat kay aetbar say bhi boht bari hai , aur fazilat kay aetbar say bhi kahen ziyada hai .

ayahs.text: Allah kay sath kissi aur ko mabood naa banao , werna tum qabil-e-malamat ( aur ) bey-yaro-madadgaar ho ker beth raho gay .
ayahs.translation: Allah kay sath kissi aur ko mabood naa banao , werna tum qabil-e-malamat ( aur ) bey-yaro-madadgaar ho ker beth raho gay .

ayahs.text: aur tumharay perwerdigar ney yeh hukum diya hai kay uss kay siwa kissi ki ibadat naa kero , aur walaiden kay sath acha sulook kero . agar walaiden mein say koi aik ya dono tumharay paas burhapay ko phonch jayen to unhen uff tak naa kaho , aur naa unhen jhirko , balkay unn say izzat kay sath baat kiya kero ,
ayahs.translation: aur tumharay perwerdigar ney yeh hukum diya hai kay uss kay siwa kissi ki ibadat naa kero , aur walaiden kay sath acha sulook kero . agar walaiden mein say koi aik ya dono tumharay paas burhapay ko phonch jayen to unhen uff tak naa kaho , aur naa unhen jhirko , balkay unn say izzat kay sath baat kiya kero ,

ayahs.text: aur unn kay sath mohabbat ka bartao kertay huye unn kay samney apney aap ko inkisari say jhukao , aur yeh dua kero kay :  ya rab ! jiss tarah unhon ney meray bachpan mein mujhay paala hai , aap bhi unn kay sath rehmat ka moamla kijiye .
ayahs.translation: aur unn kay sath mohabbat ka bartao kertay huye unn kay samney apney aap ko inkisari say jhukao , aur yeh dua kero kay :  ya rab ! jiss tarah unhon ney meray bachpan mein mujhay paala hai , aap bhi unn kay sath rehmat ka moamla kijiye .

ayahs.text: tumhara rab khoob janta hai kay tumharay dilon mein kiya hai . agar tum naik ban jao , to woh unn logon  ki khatayen boht moaaf kerta hai jo kasrat say iss/uss ki taraf rujoo kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: tumhara rab khoob janta hai kay tumharay dilon mein kiya hai . agar tum naik ban jao , to woh unn logon  ki khatayen boht moaaf kerta hai jo kasrat say iss/uss ki taraf rujoo kertay hain .

ayahs.text: aur rishta daar ko uss ka haq do , aur miskeen aur musafir ko ( unn ka haq , ) aur apney maal ko beyhooda kamon mein naa urao .
ayahs.translation: aur rishta daar ko uss ka haq do , aur miskeen aur musafir ko ( unn ka haq , ) aur apney maal ko beyhooda kamon mein naa urao .

ayahs.text: yaqeen jano kay jo log beyhooda kamon mein maal uratay hain , woh shetan kay bhai hain , aur shetan apney perwerdigar ka bara nashukra hai .
ayahs.translation: yaqeen jano kay jo log beyhooda kamon mein maal uratay hain , woh shetan kay bhai hain , aur shetan apney perwerdigar ka bara nashukra hai .

ayahs.text: aur agar kabhi tumhen inn ( rishta daaron , miskeeno aur musfiron ) say iss liye mun pherna parray kay tumhen Allah ki mutawaqqay rehmat ka intizar ho   to aesay mein unn kay sath narmi say baat kerliya kero .
ayahs.translation: aur agar kabhi tumhen inn ( rishta daaron , miskeeno aur musfiron ) say iss liye mun pherna parray kay tumhen Allah ki mutawaqqay rehmat ka intizar ho   to aesay mein unn kay sath narmi say baat kerliya kero .

ayahs.text: aur naa to ( aesay kanjoos bano kay ) apney haath ko gardan say baandh ker rakho , aur naa ( aesay fuzool kharch kay ) haath ko bilkul hi khula chorr do jiss kay nateejay mein tumhen qabil-e-malamat aur qallash ho ker bethna parray .
ayahs.translation: aur naa to ( aesay kanjoos bano kay ) apney haath ko gardan say baandh ker rakho , aur naa ( aesay fuzool kharch kay ) haath ko bilkul hi khula chorr do jiss kay nateejay mein tumhen qabil-e-malamat aur qallash ho ker bethna parray .

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay tumhara rab jiss kay liye chahta hai rizq mein wusat ata farma deta hai , aur ( jiss kay liye chahta hai ) tangi peda ker deta hai . yaqeen rakho kay woh apney bandon kay halaat say achi tarah ba-khabar hai , unhen poori tarah dekh raha hai .
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay tumhara rab jiss kay liye chahta hai rizq mein wusat ata farma deta hai , aur ( jiss kay liye chahta hai ) tangi peda ker deta hai . yaqeen rakho kay woh apney bandon kay halaat say achi tarah ba-khabar hai , unhen poori tarah dekh raha hai .

ayahs.text: aur apni aulad ko muflisi kay khof say qatal naa kero .   hum unhen bhi rizq den gay , aur tumhen bhi . yaqeen jano kay unn ko qatal kerna bari bhari ghalati hai .
ayahs.translation: aur apni aulad ko muflisi kay khof say qatal naa kero .   hum unhen bhi rizq den gay , aur tumhen bhi . yaqeen jano kay unn ko qatal kerna bari bhari ghalati hai .

ayahs.text: aur zina kay paas bhi naa phatko . woh yaqeeni tor per bari bey hayai aur bey-raah-ravi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur zina kay paas bhi naa phatko . woh yaqeeni tor per bari bey hayai aur bey-raah-ravi hai .

ayahs.text: aur jiss jaan ko Allah ney hurmat ata ki hai , ussay qatal naa kero , illa yeh kay tumhen ( sharann ) uss ka haq phonchta ho .   aur jo shaks mazloomana tor per qatal hojaye to hum ney uss kay wali ko ( qisaas ka ) ikhtiyar diya hai . chunacheh uss per lazim hai kay woh qatal kernay mein hadd say tajawuz naa keray .   yaqeenan woh iss laeeq hai kay uss ki madad ki jaye .
ayahs.translation: aur jiss jaan ko Allah ney hurmat ata ki hai , ussay qatal naa kero , illa yeh kay tumhen ( sharann ) uss ka haq phonchta ho .   aur jo shaks mazloomana tor per qatal hojaye to hum ney uss kay wali ko ( qisaas ka ) ikhtiyar diya hai . chunacheh uss per lazim hai kay woh qatal kernay mein hadd say tajawuz naa keray .   yaqeenan woh iss laeeq hai kay uss ki madad ki jaye .

ayahs.text: aur yateem kay maal kay paas bhi naa phatko , magar aesay tareeqay say jo ( uss kay haq mein ) behtareen ho ,   yahan tak kay woh apni pukhtagi ko phonch jaye . aur ehad ko poora kero , yaqeen jano kay ehad kay baaray mein ( tumhari ) baaz purs honey wali hai .
ayahs.translation: aur yateem kay maal kay paas bhi naa phatko , magar aesay tareeqay say jo ( uss kay haq mein ) behtareen ho ,   yahan tak kay woh apni pukhtagi ko phonch jaye . aur ehad ko poora kero , yaqeen jano kay ehad kay baaray mein ( tumhari ) baaz purs honey wali hai .

ayahs.text: aur jab kissi ko koi cheez paymaney say naap ker do to poora napo , aur tolney kay liye sahih tarazoo istimal kero . yehi tareeqa durust hai , aur issi ka anjam behtar hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jab kissi ko koi cheez paymaney say naap ker do to poora napo , aur tolney kay liye sahih tarazoo istimal kero . yehi tareeqa durust hai , aur issi ka anjam behtar hai .

ayahs.text: aur jiss baat ka tumhen yaqeen naa ho , ( ussay sach samajh ker ) uss kay peechay matt parro .   yaqeen rakho kay kaan , aankh aur dil sabb kay baaray mein ( tum say ) sawal hoga .
ayahs.translation: aur jiss baat ka tumhen yaqeen naa ho , ( ussay sach samajh ker ) uss kay peechay matt parro .   yaqeen rakho kay kaan , aankh aur dil sabb kay baaray mein ( tum say ) sawal hoga .

ayahs.text: aur zameen per akarr ker matt chalo . naa tum zameen ko phaarr saktay ho , aur naa bulandi mein paharon ko phonch saktay ho .
ayahs.translation: aur zameen per akarr ker matt chalo . naa tum zameen ko phaarr saktay ho , aur naa bulandi mein paharon ko phonch saktay ho .

ayahs.text: yeh saray buray kaam aesay hain jo tumharay perwerdigar ko bilkul napasand hain .
ayahs.translation: yeh saray buray kaam aesay hain jo tumharay perwerdigar ko bilkul napasand hain .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh woh hikmat ki baaten hain jo tumharay perwerdigar ney tum per wahi kay zariye phonchai hain . aur ( aey insan ! ) Allah kay sath kissi aur ko mabood naa bana , werna tujhay malamat kerkay , dhakkay dey ker dozakh mein phenk diya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh woh hikmat ki baaten hain jo tumharay perwerdigar ney tum per wahi kay zariye phonchai hain . aur ( aey insan ! ) Allah kay sath kissi aur ko mabood naa bana , werna tujhay malamat kerkay , dhakkay dey ker dozakh mein phenk diya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya tumharay rab ney tumhen to betay denay kay liye chunn liya hai , aur khud apney liye farishton ko betiyan bana liya hai ?   haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum log bari sangeen baat keh rahey ho .
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya tumharay rab ney tumhen to betay denay kay liye chunn liya hai , aur khud apney liye farishton ko betiyan bana liya hai ?   haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum log bari sangeen baat keh rahey ho .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney iss Quran mein tarah tarah say wazahaten ki hain , takay log hosh mein ayen , magar yeh log hain kay iss say inn kay bidakney hi mein aur izafa horaha hai .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney iss Quran mein tarah tarah say wazahaten ki hain , takay log hosh mein ayen , magar yeh log hain kay iss say inn kay bidakney hi mein aur izafa horaha hai .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  agar Allah kay sath aur bhi khuda hotay jaisay kay yeh log kehtay hain to woh arsh walay ( haqeeqi khuda ) per charrhai kernay kay liye koi raasta peda kerletay .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  agar Allah kay sath aur bhi khuda hotay jaisay kay yeh log kehtay hain to woh arsh walay ( haqeeqi khuda ) per charrhai kernay kay liye koi raasta peda kerletay .

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo baaten yeh log banatay hain uss ki zaat unn say bilkul pak aur boht baala o bartar hai .
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo baaten yeh log banatay hain uss ki zaat unn say bilkul pak aur boht baala o bartar hai .

ayahs.text: saton aasman aur zameen aur unn ki sari makhlooqaat uss ki paki biyan kerti hain , aur koi cheez aesi nahi hai jo uss ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh naa ker rahi ho , lekin tum log unn ki tasbeeh ko samajhtay nahi ho .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh bara burdbaar , boht moaaf kernay wala hai .
ayahs.translation: saton aasman aur zameen aur unn ki sari makhlooqaat uss ki paki biyan kerti hain , aur koi cheez aesi nahi hai jo uss ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh naa ker rahi ho , lekin tum log unn ki tasbeeh ko samajhtay nahi ho .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh bara burdbaar , boht moaaf kernay wala hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab tum Quran parhtay ho to hum tumharay aur unn logon  kay darmiyan jo aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , aik aunn dekha perda haeel ker-detay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab tum Quran parhtay ho to hum tumharay aur unn logon  kay darmiyan jo aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , aik aunn dekha perda haeel ker-detay hain .

ayahs.text: aur hum unn kay dilon per aisa ghilaf charha detay hain kay woh ussay samajhtay nahi , aur unn kay kanon mein garani peda ker-detay hain . aur jab tum Quran mein tanha apney rab ka ziker kertay ho to yeh log nafrat kay aalam mein peeth pher ker chal detay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur hum unn kay dilon per aisa ghilaf charha detay hain kay woh ussay samajhtay nahi , aur unn kay kanon mein garani peda ker-detay hain . aur jab tum Quran mein tanha apney rab ka ziker kertay ho to yeh log nafrat kay aalam mein peeth pher ker chal detay hain .

ayahs.text: hamen khoob maloom hai kay jab yeh log tumhari baat kaan laga ker suntay hain to kiss liye suntay hain , aur jab yeh aapas mein sargoshiyan kertay hain ( to inn baaton ka bhi hamen poora ilm hai ) jab yeh zalim ( apni biradari kay musalmanon say ) yun kehtay hain kay :  tum to bus aik aesay aadmi kay peechay chal parray ho jiss per jadoo hogaya hai .
ayahs.translation: hamen khoob maloom hai kay jab yeh log tumhari baat kaan laga ker suntay hain to kiss liye suntay hain , aur jab yeh aapas mein sargoshiyan kertay hain ( to inn baaton ka bhi hamen poora ilm hai ) jab yeh zalim ( apni biradari kay musalmanon say ) yun kehtay hain kay :  tum to bus aik aesay aadmi kay peechay chal parray ho jiss per jadoo hogaya hai .

ayahs.text: dekho unhon ney tum per kaisi kaisi phabtiyan chust ki hain . yeh raah say bhatak chukay hain , chunacheh yeh raastay per nahi aa-saktay .
ayahs.translation: dekho unhon ney tum per kaisi kaisi phabtiyan chust ki hain . yeh raah say bhatak chukay hain , chunacheh yeh raastay per nahi aa-saktay .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kehtay hain kay :  kiya jab humara wajood haddiyon mein tabdeel ho ker choora choora hojaye ga to bhala kiya uss waqt hamen naye siray say peda ker kay uthaya jaye ga-?
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kehtay hain kay :  kiya jab humara wajood haddiyon mein tabdeel ho ker choora choora hojaye ga to bhala kiya uss waqt hamen naye siray say peda ker kay uthaya jaye ga-?

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  tum pathar ya loha bhi ban jao
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  tum pathar ya loha bhi ban jao

ayahs.text: ya koi aur aesi makhlooq ban jao jiss kay baaray mein tum dil mein sochtay ho kay ( uss ka zinda hona ) aur bhi mushkil hai , ( phir bhi tumhen zinda kerdiya jaye ga )  abb woh kahen gay kay :  kon hamen dobara zinda keray ga-?  keh do kay :  wohi zinda keray ga jiss ney tumhen pehli baar peda kiya tha .    phir woh tumharay samney sar halla halla ker kahen gay kay :  aisa kab hoga-?  keh dena kay :  kiya baeed hai kay woh waqt qareeb hi aagaya ho .
ayahs.translation: ya koi aur aesi makhlooq ban jao jiss kay baaray mein tum dil mein sochtay ho kay ( uss ka zinda hona ) aur bhi mushkil hai , ( phir bhi tumhen zinda kerdiya jaye ga )  abb woh kahen gay kay :  kon hamen dobara zinda keray ga-?  keh do kay :  wohi zinda keray ga jiss ney tumhen pehli baar peda kiya tha .    phir woh tumharay samney sar halla halla ker kahen gay kay :  aisa kab hoga-?  keh dena kay :  kiya baeed hai kay woh waqt qareeb hi aagaya ho .

ayahs.text: jiss din woh tumhen bulaye ga to tum iss/uss ki hamd kertay huye iss/uss kay hukum ki tameel kero gay , aur yeh samajh rahey ho gay kay tum bus thori si mauddat ( duniya mein ) rahey thay .
ayahs.translation: jiss din woh tumhen bulaye ga to tum iss/uss ki hamd kertay huye iss/uss kay hukum ki tameel kero gay , aur yeh samajh rahey ho gay kay tum bus thori si mauddat ( duniya mein ) rahey thay .

ayahs.text: meray ( momin ) bandon say keh do kay wohi baat kaha keren jo behtareen ho . dar-haqeeqat shetan logon  kay darmiyan fasad daalta hai . shetan yaqeeni tor per insan ka khula dushman hai .
ayahs.translation: meray ( momin ) bandon say keh do kay wohi baat kaha keren jo behtareen ho . dar-haqeeqat shetan logon  kay darmiyan fasad daalta hai . shetan yaqeeni tor per insan ka khula dushman hai .

ayahs.text: tumhara perwerdigar tumhen khoob janta hai . agar woh chahye toh tum per reham farma dey , aur chahye to tumhen azab deydey , aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen unn ki baaton ka zimma daar bana ker nahi bheja hai .
ayahs.translation: tumhara perwerdigar tumhen khoob janta hai . agar woh chahye toh tum per reham farma dey , aur chahye to tumhen azab deydey , aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen unn ki baaton ka zimma daar bana ker nahi bheja hai .

ayahs.text: aur tumhara perwerdigar unn sabb ko janta hai jo aasmano mein hain aur jo zameen mein hain . aur hum ney kuch nabiyon ko doosray nabiyon per fazilat di hai , aur hum ney dawood ko zaboor ata ki thi .
ayahs.translation: aur tumhara perwerdigar unn sabb ko janta hai jo aasmano mein hain aur jo zameen mein hain . aur hum ney kuch nabiyon ko doosray nabiyon per fazilat di hai , aur hum ney dawood ko zaboor ata ki thi .

ayahs.text: . ( jo log Allah kay ilawa doosray maboodon ko mantay hain , unn say ) keh do kay :  jinn ko tum ney Allah kay siwa mabood samajh rakha hai , unhen pukar ker dekho . hoga yeh kay naa woh tum say koi takleef door ker-saken gay , aur naa ussay tabdeel ker-saken gay .
ayahs.translation: . ( jo log Allah kay ilawa doosray maboodon ko mantay hain , unn say ) keh do kay :  jinn ko tum ney Allah kay siwa mabood samajh rakha hai , unhen pukar ker dekho . hoga yeh kay naa woh tum say koi takleef door ker-saken gay , aur naa ussay tabdeel ker-saken gay .

ayahs.text: jinn ko yeh log pukartay hain , woh toh khud apney perwerdigar tak phonchney ka waseela talash kertay hain kay unn mein say kon Allah kay ziyada qareeb hojaye , aur woh uss ki rehmat kay umeedwaar rehtay hain , aur uss kay azab say dartay hain .   yaqeenan tumharay rab ka azab hai hi aesi cheez jiss say dara jaye .
ayahs.translation: jinn ko yeh log pukartay hain , woh toh khud apney perwerdigar tak phonchney ka waseela talash kertay hain kay unn mein say kon Allah kay ziyada qareeb hojaye , aur woh uss ki rehmat kay umeedwaar rehtay hain , aur uss kay azab say dartay hain .   yaqeenan tumharay rab ka azab hai hi aesi cheez jiss say dara jaye .

ayahs.text: aur koi basti aesi nahi hai jissay hum roz-e-qayamat say pehlay halak naa keren , ya ussay sakht azab naa den . yeh baat ( taqdeer ki ) kitab mein likhi ja-chuki hai .
ayahs.translation: aur koi basti aesi nahi hai jissay hum roz-e-qayamat say pehlay halak naa keren , ya ussay sakht azab naa den . yeh baat ( taqdeer ki ) kitab mein likhi ja-chuki hai .

ayahs.text: aur hum ko nishaniyan ( yani kuffaar kay maangay huye moajzaat ) bhejney say kissi aur cheez ney nahi , balkay iss baat ney roka hai kay pichlay log aesi nishaniyon ko jhutla chukay hain .   aur hum ney qoam-e-samood ko oontni di thi jo aankhen kholney kay liye kafi thi , magar unhon ney uss kay sath zulm kiya . aur hum nishaniyan daraney hi kay liye bhejtay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ko nishaniyan ( yani kuffaar kay maangay huye moajzaat ) bhejney say kissi aur cheez ney nahi , balkay iss baat ney roka hai kay pichlay log aesi nishaniyon ko jhutla chukay hain .   aur hum ney qoam-e-samood ko oontni di thi jo aankhen kholney kay liye kafi thi , magar unhon ney uss kay sath zulm kiya . aur hum nishaniyan daraney hi kay liye bhejtay hain .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) woh waqt yaad kero jab hum ney tum say kaha tha kay tumhara perwerdigar ( apney ilm say ) tamam logon  ka ehata kiye huye hai .   aur hum ney jo nazara tumhen dikhaya hai ,uss ko hum ney ( kafir ) logon  kay liye bus aik fitna bana diya ,   neez uss darkht ko bhi jiss per Quran mein lanat aai hai . aur hum toh unn ko daratay rehtay hain , lekin iss say unn ki sakht sarkashi hi mein izafa horaha hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) woh waqt yaad kero jab hum ney tum say kaha tha kay tumhara perwerdigar ( apney ilm say ) tamam logon  ka ehata kiye huye hai .   aur hum ney jo nazara tumhen dikhaya hai ,uss ko hum ney ( kafir ) logon  kay liye bus aik fitna bana diya ,   neez uss darkht ko bhi jiss per Quran mein lanat aai hai . aur hum toh unn ko daratay rehtay hain , lekin iss say unn ki sakht sarkashi hi mein izafa horaha hai .

ayahs.text: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab hum ney farishton say kaha tha kay Adam ko sajda kero . chunacheh unhon ney sajda kiya , lekin iblees ney nahi kiya . uss ney kaha kay :  kiya mein uss ko sajda kerun jissay tu ney mitti say peda kiya hai-?
ayahs.translation: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab hum ney farishton say kaha tha kay Adam ko sajda kero . chunacheh unhon ney sajda kiya , lekin iblees ney nahi kiya . uss ney kaha kay :  kiya mein uss ko sajda kerun jissay tu ney mitti say peda kiya hai-?

ayahs.text: kehney laga :  bhala batao yeh hai woh makhlooq jissay tu ney meray muqablay mein izzat bakhshi hai ! agar tu ney mujhay qayamat kay din tak mohlat di toh mein iss ki aulad mein say thoray say logon  ko chorr ker baqi sabb kay jabron mein lagaam daalun ga .
ayahs.translation: kehney laga :  bhala batao yeh hai woh makhlooq jissay tu ney meray muqablay mein izzat bakhshi hai ! agar tu ney mujhay qayamat kay din tak mohlat di toh mein iss ki aulad mein say thoray say logon  ko chorr ker baqi sabb kay jabron mein lagaam daalun ga .

ayahs.text: Allah ney kaha :  jaa phir unn mein say jo teray peechay chalay ga to jahannum hi tum sabb ki saza hogi , mukammal aur bharpoor saza .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney kaha :  jaa phir unn mein say jo teray peechay chalay ga to jahannum hi tum sabb ki saza hogi , mukammal aur bharpoor saza .

ayahs.text: aur inn mein say jiss jiss per tera bus chalay , unhen apni aawaz say behka ley ,   aur inn per apney sawaron aur piyadon ki foaj charha laa ,   aur inn kay maal aur aulad mein apna hissa laga ley ,   aur unn say khoob waday kerlay aur ( haqeeqat yeh hai kay ) shetan unn say jo wada bhi kerta hai , woh dhokay kay siwa kuch nahi hota
ayahs.translation: aur inn mein say jiss jiss per tera bus chalay , unhen apni aawaz say behka ley ,   aur inn per apney sawaron aur piyadon ki foaj charha laa ,   aur inn kay maal aur aulad mein apna hissa laga ley ,   aur unn say khoob waday kerlay aur ( haqeeqat yeh hai kay ) shetan unn say jo wada bhi kerta hai , woh dhokay kay siwa kuch nahi hota

ayahs.text: yaqeen rakh kay jo meray banday hain , unn per tera koi bus nahi chalay ga ,   aur tera perwerdigar ( unn ki ) rakhwali kay liye kafi hai .
ayahs.translation: yaqeen rakh kay jo meray banday hain , unn per tera koi bus nahi chalay ga ,   aur tera perwerdigar ( unn ki ) rakhwali kay liye kafi hai .

ayahs.text: tumhara perwerdigar woh hai jo tumharay liye samandar mein kashtiyan ley chalta hai , takay tum uss ka fazal talash kero . yaqeenan woh tumharay sath bari rehmat ka moamla kernay wala hai .
ayahs.translation: tumhara perwerdigar woh hai jo tumharay liye samandar mein kashtiyan ley chalta hai , takay tum uss ka fazal talash kero . yaqeenan woh tumharay sath bari rehmat ka moamla kernay wala hai .

ayahs.text: aur jab samandar mein tumhen koi takleef phonchti hai , toh jinn ( deotaon ) ko tum pukara kertay ho , woh sabb ghaeeb hojatay hain , bus Allah hi Allah reh jata hai . phir jab Allah tumhen bacha ker khushki tak phoncha deta hai to tum mun morr letay ho . aur insan bara hi nashukra hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jab samandar mein tumhen koi takleef phonchti hai , toh jinn ( deotaon ) ko tum pukara kertay ho , woh sabb ghaeeb hojatay hain , bus Allah hi Allah reh jata hai . phir jab Allah tumhen bacha ker khushki tak phoncha deta hai to tum mun morr letay ho . aur insan bara hi nashukra hai .

ayahs.text: toh kiya tumhen iss baat ka koi darr nahi raha kay Allah tumhen khushki hi kay aik hissay mein dhansa dey , ya tum per pathar barsaney wali aandhi bhej dey , aur phir tumhen apna koi rakhwala naa milay ?
ayahs.translation: toh kiya tumhen iss baat ka koi darr nahi raha kay Allah tumhen khushki hi kay aik hissay mein dhansa dey , ya tum per pathar barsaney wali aandhi bhej dey , aur phir tumhen apna koi rakhwala naa milay ?

ayahs.text: aur kiya tum iss baat say bhi bey fiker hogaye ho kay woh tumhen dobara ussi ( samandar ) mein ley jaye , phir tum per hawa ka toofan bhej ker tumhari nashukri ki saza mein tumhen gharq ker daalay , phir tumhen koi naa milay jo iss moamlay mein humara peecha ker-sakay-?
ayahs.translation: aur kiya tum iss baat say bhi bey fiker hogaye ho kay woh tumhen dobara ussi ( samandar ) mein ley jaye , phir tum per hawa ka toofan bhej ker tumhari nashukri ki saza mein tumhen gharq ker daalay , phir tumhen koi naa milay jo iss moamlay mein humara peecha ker-sakay-?

ayahs.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney Adam ki aulad ko izzat bakhshi hai , aur unhen khushki aur samandar dono mein sawariyan mohaiyya ki hain , aur unn ko pakeezah cheezon ka rizq diya hai , aur unn ko apni boht si makhlooqaat per fazilat ata ki hai .
ayahs.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney Adam ki aulad ko izzat bakhshi hai , aur unhen khushki aur samandar dono mein sawariyan mohaiyya ki hain , aur unn ko pakeezah cheezon ka rizq diya hai , aur unn ko apni boht si makhlooqaat per fazilat ata ki hai .

ayahs.text: uss din ko yaad rakho jab hum tamam insanon ko unn kay aemal naamon kay sath bulain gay . phir jinhen unn ka aemal nama dahaney haath mein diya jaye ga , to woh apney aemal namay ko parhen gay , aur unn per resha barabar bhi zulm nahi hoga .
ayahs.translation: uss din ko yaad rakho jab hum tamam insanon ko unn kay aemal naamon kay sath bulain gay . phir jinhen unn ka aemal nama dahaney haath mein diya jaye ga , to woh apney aemal namay ko parhen gay , aur unn per resha barabar bhi zulm nahi hoga .

ayahs.text: aur jo shaks duniya mein andha bana raha , woh aakhirat mein bhi andha , balkay raastay say aur ziyada bhatka huwa rahey ga .
ayahs.translation: aur jo shaks duniya mein andha bana raha , woh aakhirat mein bhi andha , balkay raastay say aur ziyada bhatka huwa rahey ga .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jo wahi hum ney tumharay paas bheji hai , yeh ( kafir ) log tumhen fitney mein daal ker uss say hataney lagay thay , takay tum uss kay bajaye koi aur baat humaray naam per gharr ker paish kero , aur uss soorat mein yeh tumhen apna gehra dost bana letay .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jo wahi hum ney tumharay paas bheji hai , yeh ( kafir ) log tumhen fitney mein daal ker uss say hataney lagay thay , takay tum uss kay bajaye koi aur baat humaray naam per gharr ker paish kero , aur uss soorat mein yeh tumhen apna gehra dost bana letay .

ayahs.text: aur agar hum ney tumhen sabit qadam naa banaya hota to tum bhi unn ki taraf kuch kuch jhukney kay qareeb ja-phonchtay .
ayahs.translation: aur agar hum ney tumhen sabit qadam naa banaya hota to tum bhi unn ki taraf kuch kuch jhukney kay qareeb ja-phonchtay .

ayahs.text: aur agar aisa hojata to hum tumhen duniya mein bhi dugni saza detay , aur marney kay baad bhi dugni , phir tumhen humaray muqablay mein koi madadgaar naa milta .
ayahs.translation: aur agar aisa hojata to hum tumhen duniya mein bhi dugni saza detay , aur marney kay baad bhi dugni , phir tumhen humaray muqablay mein koi madadgaar naa milta .

ayahs.text: iss kay ilawa yeh log iss fiker mein bhi hain kay iss sarzameen ( makkah ) say tumharay qadam ukhaaren , takay tumhen yahan say nikal bahir keren . aur agar aisa huwa to yeh bhi tumharay baad ziyada dair yahan nahi thehar saken gay .
ayahs.translation: iss kay ilawa yeh log iss fiker mein bhi hain kay iss sarzameen ( makkah ) say tumharay qadam ukhaaren , takay tumhen yahan say nikal bahir keren . aur agar aisa huwa to yeh bhi tumharay baad ziyada dair yahan nahi thehar saken gay .

ayahs.text: yeh humara woh tareeq-e-kaar hai jo hum ney apney unn payghumberon kay sath ikhtiyar kiya tha jo hum ney tum say pehlay bhejay thay . aur tum humaray tareeqay mein koi tabdeeli nahi pao gay .
ayahs.translation: yeh humara woh tareeq-e-kaar hai jo hum ney apney unn payghumberon kay sath ikhtiyar kiya tha jo hum ney tum say pehlay bhejay thay . aur tum humaray tareeqay mein koi tabdeeli nahi pao gay .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) sooraj dhalney kay waqt say ley ker raat kay andheray tak namaz qaeem kero ,   aur fajar kay waqt Quran parhney ka ehtimam kero . yaad rakho kay fajar ki tilawat mein majmaa hazir hota hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) sooraj dhalney kay waqt say ley ker raat kay andheray tak namaz qaeem kero ,   aur fajar kay waqt Quran parhney ka ehtimam kero . yaad rakho kay fajar ki tilawat mein majmaa hazir hota hai .

ayahs.text: aur raat kay kuch hissay mein tahajjud parha kero jo tumharay liye aik izafi ibadat hai .   umeed hai kay tumhara perwerdigar tumhen maqam-e-mehmood tak phonchaye ga .
ayahs.translation: aur raat kay kuch hissay mein tahajjud parha kero jo tumharay liye aik izafi ibadat hai .   umeed hai kay tumhara perwerdigar tumhen maqam-e-mehmood tak phonchaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur yeh dua kero kay :  ya rab ! mujhay jahan dakhil farma achai kay sath dakhil farma , aur jahan say nikal achai kay sath nikal , aur mujhay khaas apney paas say aisa iqtidar ata farma jiss kay sath ( teri ) madad ho .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh dua kero kay :  ya rab ! mujhay jahan dakhil farma achai kay sath dakhil farma , aur jahan say nikal achai kay sath nikal , aur mujhay khaas apney paas say aisa iqtidar ata farma jiss kay sath ( teri ) madad ho .

ayahs.text: aur kaho kay :  haq aan phoncha , aur batil mitt gaya , aur yaqeenan batil aesi hi cheez hai jo mitney wali hai .
ayahs.translation: aur kaho kay :  haq aan phoncha , aur batil mitt gaya , aur yaqeenan batil aesi hi cheez hai jo mitney wali hai .

ayahs.text: aur hum woh Quran nazil ker rahey hain jo mominon kay liye shifa aur rehmat ka saman hai , albatta zalimon kay hissay mein uss say nuqsan kay siwa kissi aur cheez ka izafa nahi hota .
ayahs.translation: aur hum woh Quran nazil ker rahey hain jo mominon kay liye shifa aur rehmat ka saman hai , albatta zalimon kay hissay mein uss say nuqsan kay siwa kissi aur cheez ka izafa nahi hota .

ayahs.text: aur jab hum insan ko koi naimat detay hain to woh mun morr leta hai , aur pehlo badal leta hai , aur agar uss ko koi burai choo jaye to mayyus ho bethta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jab hum insan ko koi naimat detay hain to woh mun morr leta hai , aur pehlo badal leta hai , aur agar uss ko koi burai choo jaye to mayyus ho bethta hai .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  her shaks apney apney tareeqay per kaam ker-raha hai . abb Allah hi behtar janta hai kay kon ziyada sahih raasta per hai .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  her shaks apney apney tareeqay per kaam ker-raha hai . abb Allah hi behtar janta hai kay kon ziyada sahih raasta per hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh log tum say rooh kay baaray mein poochtay hain . keh do kay :  rooh meray perwerdigar kay hukum say ( bani ) hai . aur tumhen jo ilm diya gaya hai , woh bus thora hi saa ilm hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh log tum say rooh kay baaray mein poochtay hain . keh do kay :  rooh meray perwerdigar kay hukum say ( bani ) hai . aur tumhen jo ilm diya gaya hai , woh bus thora hi saa ilm hai .

ayahs.text: aur agar hum chahen to jo kuch wahi hum ney tumharay paas bheji hai , woh sari wapis ley jayen , phir tum ussay wapis laney kay liye humaray muqablay mein koi madadgaar bhi naa pao .
ayahs.translation: aur agar hum chahen to jo kuch wahi hum ney tumharay paas bheji hai , woh sari wapis ley jayen , phir tum ussay wapis laney kay liye humaray muqablay mein koi madadgaar bhi naa pao .

ayahs.text: lekin yeh to tumharay rab ki taraf say aik rehmat hai ( kay wahi ka silsila jari hai ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay tumharay rab ki taraf say tum per jo fazal horaha hai , woh bara azeem hai .
ayahs.translation: lekin yeh to tumharay rab ki taraf say aik rehmat hai ( kay wahi ka silsila jari hai ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay tumharay rab ki taraf say tum per jo fazal horaha hai , woh bara azeem hai .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  agar tamam insan aur jinnaat iss kaam per ikatthay bhi hojayen kay iss Quran jaisa kalam bana kerlay ayen , tab bhi woh iss jaisa nahi laasaken gay , chahye woh aik doosray ki kitni madad kerlen .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  agar tamam insan aur jinnaat iss kaam per ikatthay bhi hojayen kay iss Quran jaisa kalam bana kerlay ayen , tab bhi woh iss jaisa nahi laasaken gay , chahye woh aik doosray ki kitni madad kerlen .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney insanon ki bhalai kay liye iss Quran mein her qisam ki hikmat ki baaten tarah tarah say biyan ki hain , phir bhi aksar log inkar kay siwa kissi aur baat per razi nahi hain .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney insanon ki bhalai kay liye iss Quran mein her qisam ki hikmat ki baaten tarah tarah say biyan ki hain , phir bhi aksar log inkar kay siwa kissi aur baat per razi nahi hain .

ayahs.text: aur kehtay hain kay :  hum tum per uss waqt tak emaan nahi layen gay jab tak tum zameen ko phaarr ker humaray liye aik chashma naa nikal do ,
ayahs.translation: aur kehtay hain kay :  hum tum per uss waqt tak emaan nahi layen gay jab tak tum zameen ko phaarr ker humaray liye aik chashma naa nikal do ,

ayahs.text: ya phir tumharay liye khujooron aur angooron ka aik baagh peda hojaye , aur tum uss kay bech bech mein zameen ko phaarr ker nehren jari kerdo ,
ayahs.translation: ya phir tumharay liye khujooron aur angooron ka aik baagh peda hojaye , aur tum uss kay bech bech mein zameen ko phaarr ker nehren jari kerdo ,

ayahs.text: ya jaisay tum daway kertay ho , aasman kay tukrray tukrray ker kay ussay hum per gira do , ya phir Allah ko aur farishton ko humaray aamney samney ley aao ,
ayahs.translation: ya jaisay tum daway kertay ho , aasman kay tukrray tukrray ker kay ussay hum per gira do , ya phir Allah ko aur farishton ko humaray aamney samney ley aao ,

ayahs.text: ya phir tumharay liye aik soney ka ghar peda hojaye , ya tum aasman per charh jao , aur hum tumharay charrney ko bhi uss waqt tak nahi maanen gay jab tak tum hum per aesi kitab nazil naa kerdo jissay hum parh saken .  ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay :  subhan Allah ! mein to aik bashar hun jissay payghumber bana ker bheja gaya hai . iss say ziyada kuch nahi .
ayahs.translation: ya phir tumharay liye aik soney ka ghar peda hojaye , ya tum aasman per charh jao , aur hum tumharay charrney ko bhi uss waqt tak nahi maanen gay jab tak tum hum per aesi kitab nazil naa kerdo jissay hum parh saken .  ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay :  subhan Allah ! mein to aik bashar hun jissay payghumber bana ker bheja gaya hai . iss say ziyada kuch nahi .

ayahs.text: aur jab unn logon  kay paas hidayat ka paygham aaya to unn ko emaan laney say issi baat ney to roka kay woh kehtay thay :  kiya Allah ney aik bashar ko Rasool bana ker bheja hai ?
ayahs.translation: aur jab unn logon  kay paas hidayat ka paygham aaya to unn ko emaan laney say issi baat ney to roka kay woh kehtay thay :  kiya Allah ney aik bashar ko Rasool bana ker bheja hai ?

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  agar zameen mein farishtay hi itminan say chal phir rahey hotay to beyshak hum aasman say kissi farishtay ko Rasool bana ker inn/unn per utaar detay .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  agar zameen mein farishtay hi itminan say chal phir rahey hotay to beyshak hum aasman say kissi farishtay ko Rasool bana ker inn/unn per utaar detay .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  Allah meray aur tumharay darmiyan gawah banney kay liye kafi hai . beyshak woh apney bandon say poori tarah ba-khabar hai , sabb kuch dekh raha hai .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  Allah meray aur tumharay darmiyan gawah banney kay liye kafi hai . beyshak woh apney bandon say poori tarah ba-khabar hai , sabb kuch dekh raha hai .

ayahs.text: aur jissay Allah hidayat dey , wohi sahih raastay per hota hai , aur jinn logon  ko woh gumrahi mein mubtala kerday , to uss kay siwa tumhen unn kay koi madadgaar nahi mil saktay . aur hum unhen qayamat kay din mun kay ball iss tarah ikattha keren gay kay woh andhay , goongay aur behray hon gay . unn ka thikana jahannum hoga . jab kabhi uss ki aag dheemi honey lagay gi , hum ussay aur ziyada bharka den gay .
ayahs.translation: aur jissay Allah hidayat dey , wohi sahih raastay per hota hai , aur jinn logon  ko woh gumrahi mein mubtala kerday , to uss kay siwa tumhen unn kay koi madadgaar nahi mil saktay . aur hum unhen qayamat kay din mun kay ball iss tarah ikattha keren gay kay woh andhay , goongay aur behray hon gay . unn ka thikana jahannum hoga . jab kabhi uss ki aag dheemi honey lagay gi , hum ussay aur ziyada bharka den gay .

ayahs.text: yeh unn ki saza hai , kiyonkay unhon ney humari aayaton ka inkar kiya tha , aur yeh kaha tha kay :  kiya jab hum ( mar ker ) haddiyan hi haddiyan reh jayen gay , aur choora choora hojayen gay to kiya phir bhi hamen naye siray say zinda ker kay uthaya jaye ga-?
ayahs.translation: yeh unn ki saza hai , kiyonkay unhon ney humari aayaton ka inkar kiya tha , aur yeh kaha tha kay :  kiya jab hum ( mar ker ) haddiyan hi haddiyan reh jayen gay , aur choora choora hojayen gay to kiya phir bhi hamen naye siray say zinda ker kay uthaya jaye ga-?

ayahs.text: bhala kiya unhen itni si baat nahi soojhi kay woh Allah jiss ney saray aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya hai , woh iss baat per qadir hai kay inn jaisay aadmi phir say peda kerday-? aur uss ney inn kay liye aik aesi miyaad muqarrar ker rakhi hai jiss ( kay aaney ) mein zara bhi shak nahi hai . phir bhi yeh zalim inkar kay siwa kissi baat per razi nahi .
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya unhen itni si baat nahi soojhi kay woh Allah jiss ney saray aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya hai , woh iss baat per qadir hai kay inn jaisay aadmi phir say peda kerday-? aur uss ney inn kay liye aik aesi miyaad muqarrar ker rakhi hai jiss ( kay aaney ) mein zara bhi shak nahi hai . phir bhi yeh zalim inkar kay siwa kissi baat per razi nahi .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn kafiron say ) keh do kay :  agar meray perwerdigar ki rehmat kay khazaney kahen tumharay ikhtiyar mein hotay to tum kharch hojaney kay darr say zaroor haath rok letay ,   aur insan hai hi bara tang dil !
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn kafiron say ) keh do kay :  agar meray perwerdigar ki rehmat kay khazaney kahen tumharay ikhtiyar mein hotay to tum kharch hojaney kay darr say zaroor haath rok letay ,   aur insan hai hi bara tang dil !

ayahs.text: aur hum ney musa ko no  khuli khuli nishaniyan di then .   abb bano Israel say pooch lo kay jab woh inn logon  kay paas gaye to firon ney unn say kaha kay :  aey musa ! tumharay baaray mein mera to khayal yeh hai kay kissi ney tum per jadoo kerdiya hai .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney musa ko no  khuli khuli nishaniyan di then .   abb bano Israel say pooch lo kay jab woh inn logon  kay paas gaye to firon ney unn say kaha kay :  aey musa ! tumharay baaray mein mera to khayal yeh hai kay kissi ney tum per jadoo kerdiya hai .

ayahs.text: musa ney kaha :  tumhen khoob maloom hai kay yeh sari nishaniyan kissi aur ney nahi , aasmano aur zameen kay perwerdigar ney baseerat peda kernay kay liye nazil ki hain . aur aey firon ! tumharay baaray mein mera gumaan yeh hai kay tumhari barbadi aaney wali hai .
ayahs.translation: musa ney kaha :  tumhen khoob maloom hai kay yeh sari nishaniyan kissi aur ney nahi , aasmano aur zameen kay perwerdigar ney baseerat peda kernay kay liye nazil ki hain . aur aey firon ! tumharay baaray mein mera gumaan yeh hai kay tumhari barbadi aaney wali hai .

ayahs.text: phir firon ney yeh irada kiya tha kay inn sabb ( bano Israel ) ko uss sarzameen say ukhaar phenkay , lekin hum ney ussay aur jitney log uss kay sath thay , unn sabb ko gharq kerdiya ,
ayahs.translation: phir firon ney yeh irada kiya tha kay inn sabb ( bano Israel ) ko uss sarzameen say ukhaar phenkay , lekin hum ney ussay aur jitney log uss kay sath thay , unn sabb ko gharq kerdiya ,

ayahs.text: aur uss kay baad bano Israel say kaha kay :  tum zameen mein baso , phir jab aakhirat ka wada poora honey ka waqt aaye ga to hum tum sabb ko jama ker kay hazir kerden gay .
ayahs.translation: aur uss kay baad bano Israel say kaha kay :  tum zameen mein baso , phir jab aakhirat ka wada poora honey ka waqt aaye ga to hum tum sabb ko jama ker kay hazir kerden gay .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney iss Quran ko haq hi kay sath nazil kiya hai , aur haq hi kay sath yeh utra hai . aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen kissi aur kaam kay liye nahi , balkay sirf iss liye bheja hai kay tum ( farmanbardaaron ko ) khushkhabri do , aur ( nafarmano ko ) khabrdar kero .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney iss Quran ko haq hi kay sath nazil kiya hai , aur haq hi kay sath yeh utra hai . aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen kissi aur kaam kay liye nahi , balkay sirf iss liye bheja hai kay tum ( farmanbardaaron ko ) khushkhabri do , aur ( nafarmano ko ) khabrdar kero .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney Quran kay juda juda hissay banaye , takay tum ussay thehar thehar ker logon  kay samney parho , aur hum ney ussay thora thora ker kay utaara hai .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney Quran kay juda juda hissay banaye , takay tum ussay thehar thehar ker logon  kay samney parho , aur hum ney ussay thora thora ker kay utaara hai .

ayahs.text: . ( kafiron say ) keh do kay :  chahye tum iss per emaan lao , ya naa lao , jab yeh ( Quran ) unn logon  kay samney parha jata hai jinn ko iss say pehlay ilm diya gaya tha to woh thorriyon kay ball sajday mein gir-jatay hain .
ayahs.translation: . ( kafiron say ) keh do kay :  chahye tum iss per emaan lao , ya naa lao , jab yeh ( Quran ) unn logon  kay samney parha jata hai jinn ko iss say pehlay ilm diya gaya tha to woh thorriyon kay ball sajday mein gir-jatay hain .

ayahs.text: aur kehtay hain :  pak hai humara perwerdigar ! beyshak humaray perwerdigar ka wada to poora hi ho ker rehta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur kehtay hain :  pak hai humara perwerdigar ! beyshak humaray perwerdigar ka wada to poora hi ho ker rehta hai .

ayahs.text: aur woh rotay huye thorriyon kay ball gir-jatay hain , aur yeh ( Quran ) unn kay dilon ki aajzi ko aur barha deta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur woh rotay huye thorriyon kay ball gir-jatay hain , aur yeh ( Quran ) unn kay dilon ki aajzi ko aur barha deta hai .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  chahye tum Allah ko pukaro , ya rehman ko pukaro , jiss naam say bhi ( Allah ko ) pukaro gay ( aik hi baat hai ) kiyonkay tamam behtareen naam ussi kay hain .    aur tum apni namaz naa boht oonchi aawaz say parho , aur naa boht past aawaz say , balkay inn dono kay darmiyan ( moatadil ) raasta ikhtiyar kero .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  chahye tum Allah ko pukaro , ya rehman ko pukaro , jiss naam say bhi ( Allah ko ) pukaro gay ( aik hi baat hai ) kiyonkay tamam behtareen naam ussi kay hain .    aur tum apni namaz naa boht oonchi aawaz say parho , aur naa boht past aawaz say , balkay inn dono kay darmiyan ( moatadil ) raasta ikhtiyar kero .

ayahs.text: aur kaho kay :  tamam tareefen Allah ki hain jiss ney naa koi beta banaya , naa uss ki saltanat mein koi shareek hai , aur naa ussay aajzi say bachaney kay liye koi himayati darkar hai .   aur uss ki aesi barai biyan kero jaisi barai biyan kernay ka ussay haq hasil hai .
ayahs.translation: aur kaho kay :  tamam tareefen Allah ki hain jiss ney naa koi beta banaya , naa uss ki saltanat mein koi shareek hai , aur naa ussay aajzi say bachaney kay liye koi himayati darkar hai .   aur uss ki aesi barai biyan kero jaisi barai biyan kernay ka ussay haq hasil hai .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: tamam tareefen Allah ki hain jiss ney apney banday per kitab nazil ki , aur uss mein kissi qisam ki koi khaami nahi rakhi ,
verses.translation: tamam tareefen Allah ki hain jiss ney apney banday per kitab nazil ki , aur uss mein kissi qisam ki koi khaami nahi rakhi ,

verses.text: aik seedhi seedhi kitab jo uss ney iss liye nazil ki hai kay logon  ko apni taraf say aik sakht azab say aagah keray , aur jo momin naik amal kertay hain unn ko khushkhabri dey kay unn ko behtareen ajar milney wala hai ,
verses.translation: aik seedhi seedhi kitab jo uss ney iss liye nazil ki hai kay logon  ko apni taraf say aik sakht azab say aagah keray , aur jo momin naik amal kertay hain unn ko khushkhabri dey kay unn ko behtareen ajar milney wala hai ,

verses.text: jiss mein woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay ,
verses.translation: jiss mein woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay ,

verses.text: aur takay unn logon  ko mutanabeh keray jo yeh kehtay hain kay Allah ney koi beta bana rakha hai .
verses.translation: aur takay unn logon  ko mutanabeh keray jo yeh kehtay hain kay Allah ney koi beta bana rakha hai .

verses.text: iss baat ka koi ilmi saboot naa khud unn kay paas hai , naa unn kay baap dadon kay paas tha . bari sangeen baat hai jo unn kay mun say nikal rahi hai . jo kuch woh keh rahey hain , woh jhoot kay siwa kuch nahi .
verses.translation: iss baat ka koi ilmi saboot naa khud unn kay paas hai , naa unn kay baap dadon kay paas tha . bari sangeen baat hai jo unn kay mun say nikal rahi hai . jo kuch woh keh rahey hain , woh jhoot kay siwa kuch nahi .

verses.text: abb ( aey payghumber ! ) agar log ( Quran ki ) iss baat per emaan naa layen , to aisa lagta hai jaisay tum afsos ker ker kay unn kay peechay apni jaan ko ghula betho gay !
verses.translation: abb ( aey payghumber ! ) agar log ( Quran ki ) iss baat per emaan naa layen , to aisa lagta hai jaisay tum afsos ker ker kay unn kay peechay apni jaan ko ghula betho gay !

verses.text: yaqeen jano kay rooaey zameen per jitni cheezen hain hum ney unhen zameen ki sajawat ka zariya iss liye banaya hai takay logon  ko aazmayen kay unn mein kon ziyada acha amal kerta hai .
verses.translation: yaqeen jano kay rooaey zameen per jitni cheezen hain hum ney unhen zameen ki sajawat ka zariya iss liye banaya hai takay logon  ko aazmayen kay unn mein kon ziyada acha amal kerta hai .

verses.text: aur yeh bhi yaqeen rakho kay rooaey zameen per jo kuch hai , aik din hum ussay aik sapaat meydan bana den gay .
verses.translation: aur yeh bhi yaqeen rakho kay rooaey zameen per jo kuch hai , aik din hum ussay aik sapaat meydan bana den gay .

verses.text: kiya tumhara yeh khayal hai kay ghaar aur raqeem walay log   humari nishaniyon mein say kuch ( ziyada ) ajeeb cheez thay ?
verses.translation: kiya tumhara yeh khayal hai kay ghaar aur raqeem walay log   humari nishaniyon mein say kuch ( ziyada ) ajeeb cheez thay ?

verses.text: yeh uss waqt ka ziker hai jab unn nojawano ney ghaar mein panah li thi , aur ( Allah taalaa say dua kertay huye ) kaha tha kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum per khaas apney paas say rehmat nazil farmaiye , aur humari iss soorat-e-haal mein humaray liye bhalai ka raasta mohaiyya farma dijiye .
verses.translation: yeh uss waqt ka ziker hai jab unn nojawano ney ghaar mein panah li thi , aur ( Allah taalaa say dua kertay huye ) kaha tha kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum per khaas apney paas say rehmat nazil farmaiye , aur humari iss soorat-e-haal mein humaray liye bhalai ka raasta mohaiyya farma dijiye .

verses.text: chunacheh hum ney unn kay kanon ko thapki dey ker kaee saal tak unn ko ghaar mein sulaye rakha .
verses.translation: chunacheh hum ney unn kay kanon ko thapki dey ker kaee saal tak unn ko ghaar mein sulaye rakha .

verses.text: phir hum ney unn ko jagaya takay yeh dekhen kay unn kay do girohon mein say kon saa giroh apney soye rehney ki mauddat ka ziyada sahih shumar kerta hai .
verses.translation: phir hum ney unn ko jagaya takay yeh dekhen kay unn kay do girohon mein say kon saa giroh apney soye rehney ki mauddat ka ziyada sahih shumar kerta hai .

verses.text: hum tumharay samney unn ka waqiaa theek theek biyan kertay hain . yeh kuch nojawan thay jo apney perwerdigar per emaan laye thay , aur hum ney unn ko hidayat mein khoob taraqqi di thi ,
verses.translation: hum tumharay samney unn ka waqiaa theek theek biyan kertay hain . yeh kuch nojawan thay jo apney perwerdigar per emaan laye thay , aur hum ney unn ko hidayat mein khoob taraqqi di thi ,

verses.text: aur hum ney unn kay dil khoob mazboot kerdiye thay .   yeh uss waqt ka ziker hai jab woh uthay , aur unhon ney kaha kay :  humara perwerdigar woh hai jo tamam aasmano aur zameen ka malik hai . hum uss kay siwa kissi ko mabood bana ker hergiz nahi pukaren gay . agar hum aisa keren gay to hum yaqeenan intehai laghw baat kahen gay .
verses.translation: aur hum ney unn kay dil khoob mazboot kerdiye thay .   yeh uss waqt ka ziker hai jab woh uthay , aur unhon ney kaha kay :  humara perwerdigar woh hai jo tamam aasmano aur zameen ka malik hai . hum uss kay siwa kissi ko mabood bana ker hergiz nahi pukaren gay . agar hum aisa keren gay to hum yaqeenan intehai laghw baat kahen gay .

verses.text: yeh humari qoam kay log hain jinhon ney uss perwerdigar ko chorr ker doosray mabood bana rakhay hain . ( agar unn ka aqeedah sahih hai to ) woh apney maboodon kay saboot mein koi wazeh daleel kiyon paish nahi kertay ? bhala uss shaks say ziyada zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay-?
verses.translation: yeh humari qoam kay log hain jinhon ney uss perwerdigar ko chorr ker doosray mabood bana rakhay hain . ( agar unn ka aqeedah sahih hai to ) woh apney maboodon kay saboot mein koi wazeh daleel kiyon paish nahi kertay ? bhala uss shaks say ziyada zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay-?

verses.text: aur ( sathiyo ! ) jab tum ney unn logon  say bhi alehdgi ikhtiyar kerli hai , aur unn say bhi jinn ki yeh Allah ko chorr ker ibadat kertay hain , to chalo abb tum iss/uss ghaar mein panah ley lo ,   tumhara perwerdigar tumharay liye apna daman-e-rehmat phela dey ga , aur tumharay kaam mein aasani kay asbaab mohaiyya farmaye ga .
verses.translation: aur ( sathiyo ! ) jab tum ney unn logon  say bhi alehdgi ikhtiyar kerli hai , aur unn say bhi jinn ki yeh Allah ko chorr ker ibadat kertay hain , to chalo abb tum iss/uss ghaar mein panah ley lo ,   tumhara perwerdigar tumharay liye apna daman-e-rehmat phela dey ga , aur tumharay kaam mein aasani kay asbaab mohaiyya farmaye ga .

verses.text: aur ( woh ghaar aisa tha kay ) tum sooraj ko nikaltay waqt dekhtay to woh unn kay ghaar say dayen taraf hatt ker nikal jata , aur jab ghuroob hota to unn say bayen taraf katra ker chala jata ,   aur woh uss ghaar kay aik kushada hissay mein ( soye huye ) thay . yeh sabb kuch Allah ki nishaniyon mein say aik nishani hai .   jissay Allah hidayat deydey , wohi hidayat pata hai , aur jissay woh gumrah kerday , uss ka tumhen hergiz koi madadgaar nahi mil sakta jo ussay raastay per laye .
verses.translation: aur ( woh ghaar aisa tha kay ) tum sooraj ko nikaltay waqt dekhtay to woh unn kay ghaar say dayen taraf hatt ker nikal jata , aur jab ghuroob hota to unn say bayen taraf katra ker chala jata ,   aur woh uss ghaar kay aik kushada hissay mein ( soye huye ) thay . yeh sabb kuch Allah ki nishaniyon mein say aik nishani hai .   jissay Allah hidayat deydey , wohi hidayat pata hai , aur jissay woh gumrah kerday , uss ka tumhen hergiz koi madadgaar nahi mil sakta jo ussay raastay per laye .

verses.text: tum unhen ( dekh ker ) yeh samajhtay kay woh jaag rahey hain , halankay woh soye huye thay .   aur hum unn ko dayen aur bayen kerwat dilwatay rehtay thay , aur unn ka kutta dehleez per apney dono haath phelaye huye ( betha ) tha . agar tum unhen jhank ker dekhtay to unn say peeth pher ker bhag kharray hotay , aur tumharay andar unn ki dehshat samaa jati .
verses.translation: tum unhen ( dekh ker ) yeh samajhtay kay woh jaag rahey hain , halankay woh soye huye thay .   aur hum unn ko dayen aur bayen kerwat dilwatay rehtay thay , aur unn ka kutta dehleez per apney dono haath phelaye huye ( betha ) tha . agar tum unhen jhank ker dekhtay to unn say peeth pher ker bhag kharray hotay , aur tumharay andar unn ki dehshat samaa jati .

verses.text: aur ( jaisay hum ney unhen sulaya tha ) ussi tarah hum ney unhen utha diya , takay woh aapas mein aik doosray say pooch gich keren . unn mein say aik kehney walay ney kaha :  tum iss halat mein kitni dair rahey hogay-?  kuch logon  ney kaha :  hum aik din ya aik din say kuch kam ( neend mein ) rahey hon gay .  doosron ney kaha :  tumhara rab hi behtar janta hai kay tum kitni dair iss halat mein rahey ho . abb apney mein say kissi ko chaandi ka yeh sikka dey ker shehar ki taraf bhejo , woh jaker dekh bhaal keray kay iss kay kon say ilaqay mein ziyada pakeezah khana ( mil sakta ) hai .   phir tumharay paas wahan say kuch khaney ko ley aaye , aur ussay chahiye kay hoshiyari say kaam keray , aur kissi ko tumhari khabar naa honey dey .
verses.translation: aur ( jaisay hum ney unhen sulaya tha ) ussi tarah hum ney unhen utha diya , takay woh aapas mein aik doosray say pooch gich keren . unn mein say aik kehney walay ney kaha :  tum iss halat mein kitni dair rahey hogay-?  kuch logon  ney kaha :  hum aik din ya aik din say kuch kam ( neend mein ) rahey hon gay .  doosron ney kaha :  tumhara rab hi behtar janta hai kay tum kitni dair iss halat mein rahey ho . abb apney mein say kissi ko chaandi ka yeh sikka dey ker shehar ki taraf bhejo , woh jaker dekh bhaal keray kay iss kay kon say ilaqay mein ziyada pakeezah khana ( mil sakta ) hai .   phir tumharay paas wahan say kuch khaney ko ley aaye , aur ussay chahiye kay hoshiyari say kaam keray , aur kissi ko tumhari khabar naa honey dey .

verses.text: kiyonkay agar inn ( shehar kay ) logon  ko tumhari khabar mil gaee to yeh tumhen pathrao ker kay halak ker daalen gay , ya tumhen apney deen mein wapis aaney kay liye majboor keren gay , aur aisa huwa to tumhen kabhi falah nahi mil sakay gi .
verses.translation: kiyonkay agar inn ( shehar kay ) logon  ko tumhari khabar mil gaee to yeh tumhen pathrao ker kay halak ker daalen gay , ya tumhen apney deen mein wapis aaney kay liye majboor keren gay , aur aisa huwa to tumhen kabhi falah nahi mil sakay gi .

verses.text: aur yun hum ney unn ki khabar logon  tak phoncha di ,   takay woh yaqeen say jaan len kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , neez yeh kay qayamat ki gharri aaney wali hai ,   uss mein koi shak nahi . ( phir woh waqt bhi aaya ) jab log unn kay baaray mein aapas mein jhagarr rahey thay ,   chunacheh kuch logon  ney kaha kay inn per aik imarat bana do . inn ka rab hi inn kay moamlay ko behtar janta hai .   ( aakhir kaar ) jinn logon  ko unn kay moamlaat per ghalba hasil tha unhon ney kaha kay :  hum to inn kay oopper aik masjid zaroor banayen gay .
verses.translation: aur yun hum ney unn ki khabar logon  tak phoncha di ,   takay woh yaqeen say jaan len kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , neez yeh kay qayamat ki gharri aaney wali hai ,   uss mein koi shak nahi . ( phir woh waqt bhi aaya ) jab log unn kay baaray mein aapas mein jhagarr rahey thay ,   chunacheh kuch logon  ney kaha kay inn per aik imarat bana do . inn ka rab hi inn kay moamlay ko behtar janta hai .   ( aakhir kaar ) jinn logon  ko unn kay moamlaat per ghalba hasil tha unhon ney kaha kay :  hum to inn kay oopper aik masjid zaroor banayen gay .

verses.text: kuch log kahen gay kay woh teen aadmi thay , aur chotha unn ka kutta tha , aur kuch kahen gay kay woh paanch thay , aur chata unn ka kutta tha . yeh sabb atkal kay teer chalaney ki baaten hain . aur kuch kahen gay kay woh saat thay , aur aathwan unn ka kutta tha , keh do kay :  mera rab hi unn ki sahih tadaad ko janta hai . thoray say logon  kay siwa kissi ko unn ka poora ilm nahi .  lehaza unn kay baaray mein sarsari guftoogo say aagay barh ker koi behas naa kero , aur naa unn kay baaray mein kissi say pooch gich kero .
verses.translation: kuch log kahen gay kay woh teen aadmi thay , aur chotha unn ka kutta tha , aur kuch kahen gay kay woh paanch thay , aur chata unn ka kutta tha . yeh sabb atkal kay teer chalaney ki baaten hain . aur kuch kahen gay kay woh saat thay , aur aathwan unn ka kutta tha , keh do kay :  mera rab hi unn ki sahih tadaad ko janta hai . thoray say logon  kay siwa kissi ko unn ka poora ilm nahi .  lehaza unn kay baaray mein sarsari guftoogo say aagay barh ker koi behas naa kero , aur naa unn kay baaray mein kissi say pooch gich kero .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) kissi bhi kaam kay baaray mein kabhi yeh naa kaho kay mein yeh kaam kal kerlun ga ,
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) kissi bhi kaam kay baaray mein kabhi yeh naa kaho kay mein yeh kaam kal kerlun ga ,

verses.text: haan ( yeh kaho kay ) Allah chahye ga to ( kerlun ga ) .   aur jab kabhi bhool jao to apney rab ko yaad kerlo , aur kaho :  mujhay umeed hai kay mera rab kissi aesi baat ki taraf meri rehnumai kerday jo hidayat mein iss say bhi ziyada qareeb ho .
verses.translation: haan ( yeh kaho kay ) Allah chahye ga to ( kerlun ga ) .   aur jab kabhi bhool jao to apney rab ko yaad kerlo , aur kaho :  mujhay umeed hai kay mera rab kissi aesi baat ki taraf meri rehnumai kerday jo hidayat mein iss say bhi ziyada qareeb ho .

verses.text: aur woh ( ashaab-e-kahaf ) apney ghaar mein teen so saal aur mazeed no saal ( sotay ) rahey .
verses.translation: aur woh ( ashaab-e-kahaf ) apney ghaar mein teen so saal aur mazeed no saal ( sotay ) rahey .

verses.text: . ( agar koi uss mein behas keray to ) keh do kay Allah hi behtar janta hai kay woh kitni mauddat ( sotay ) rahey .   aasmano aur zameen kay saray bhed ussi kay ilm mein hain . woh kitna dekhney wala , aur kitna sunney wala hai ! uss kay siwa unn ka koi rakhwala nahi hai , aur woh apni hukoomat mein kissi ko shareek nahi kerta .
verses.translation: . ( agar koi uss mein behas keray to ) keh do kay Allah hi behtar janta hai kay woh kitni mauddat ( sotay ) rahey .   aasmano aur zameen kay saray bhed ussi kay ilm mein hain . woh kitna dekhney wala , aur kitna sunney wala hai ! uss kay siwa unn ka koi rakhwala nahi hai , aur woh apni hukoomat mein kissi ko shareek nahi kerta .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum per tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say wahi kay zariye jo kitab bheji gaee hai , ussay parh ker suna-do . koi nahi hai jo uss ki baaton ko badal sakay , aur ussay chorr ker tumhen hergiz koi panah ki jagah nahi mil sakti .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum per tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say wahi kay zariye jo kitab bheji gaee hai , ussay parh ker suna-do . koi nahi hai jo uss ki baaton ko badal sakay , aur ussay chorr ker tumhen hergiz koi panah ki jagah nahi mil sakti .

verses.text: aur apney aap ko istiaqamat say unn logon  kay sath sath rakho jo subha o shaam apney rab ko iss liye pukartay hain kay woh uss ki khushnoodi kay talabgaar hain .   aur tumhari aankhen dunyawi zindagi ki khoobsurti ki talash mein aesay logon  say hatney naa payen . aur kissi aesay shaks ka kehna naa maano jiss kay dil ko hum ney apni yaad say ghafil ker rakha hai , aur jo apni khuwaishaat kay peechay parra huwa hai , aur jiss ka moamla hadd say guzar chuka hai .
verses.translation: aur apney aap ko istiaqamat say unn logon  kay sath sath rakho jo subha o shaam apney rab ko iss liye pukartay hain kay woh uss ki khushnoodi kay talabgaar hain .   aur tumhari aankhen dunyawi zindagi ki khoobsurti ki talash mein aesay logon  say hatney naa payen . aur kissi aesay shaks ka kehna naa maano jiss kay dil ko hum ney apni yaad say ghafil ker rakha hai , aur jo apni khuwaishaat kay peechay parra huwa hai , aur jiss ka moamla hadd say guzar chuka hai .

verses.text: aur keh do kay :  haq to tumharay rab ki taraf say aa-chuka hai . abb jo chahye , emaan ley aaye , aur jo chahye kufr ikhtiyar keray .    hum ney beyshak ( aesay ) zalimon kay liye aag tayyar ker rakhi hai jiss ki qanaten unn ko gheray mein ley len gi , aur agar woh fariyad keren gay to unn ki fariyad ka jawab aesay paani say diya jaye ga jo tel ki talchat jaisa hoga , ( aur ) chehron ko bhoon ker rakh dey ga . kaisa bad-tareen paani , aur kaisi buri aaram gaah !
verses.translation: aur keh do kay :  haq to tumharay rab ki taraf say aa-chuka hai . abb jo chahye , emaan ley aaye , aur jo chahye kufr ikhtiyar keray .    hum ney beyshak ( aesay ) zalimon kay liye aag tayyar ker rakhi hai jiss ki qanaten unn ko gheray mein ley len gi , aur agar woh fariyad keren gay to unn ki fariyad ka jawab aesay paani say diya jaye ga jo tel ki talchat jaisa hoga , ( aur ) chehron ko bhoon ker rakh dey ga . kaisa bad-tareen paani , aur kaisi buri aaram gaah !

verses.text: albatta jo log emaan laye , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye , to yaqeenan hum aesay logon  kay ajar ko zaya nahi kertay jo achi tarah amal keren .
verses.translation: albatta jo log emaan laye , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye , to yaqeenan hum aesay logon  kay ajar ko zaya nahi kertay jo achi tarah amal keren .

verses.text: yeh woh log hain jinn kay liye hamesha rehney walay baaghaat hain , unn kay neechay say nehren behti hon gi . unn ko wahan soney kay kangganon say muzayyan kiya jaye ga , woh oonchi musnadon per takiya lagaye huye bareek aur dabeez resham kay sabz kapray pehnay hon gay . kitna behtareen ajar , aur kaisi haseen aaram gaah !
verses.translation: yeh woh log hain jinn kay liye hamesha rehney walay baaghaat hain , unn kay neechay say nehren behti hon gi . unn ko wahan soney kay kangganon say muzayyan kiya jaye ga , woh oonchi musnadon per takiya lagaye huye bareek aur dabeez resham kay sabz kapray pehnay hon gay . kitna behtareen ajar , aur kaisi haseen aaram gaah !

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn logon  kay samney unn do aadmiyon ki misal paish kero .   jinn mein say aik ko hum ney angooron kay do baagh dey rakhay thay , aur unn ko khujoor kay darakhton say ghera huwa tha , aur unn dono baaghon kay darmiyan kheti lagai hoi thi .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn logon  kay samney unn do aadmiyon ki misal paish kero .   jinn mein say aik ko hum ney angooron kay do baagh dey rakhay thay , aur unn ko khujoor kay darakhton say ghera huwa tha , aur unn dono baaghon kay darmiyan kheti lagai hoi thi .

verses.text: dono baagh poora poora phal detay thay , aur koi baagh phal denay mein koi kami nahi chorta tha , aur unn dono kay darmiyan hum ney aik nehar jari kerdi thi ,
verses.translation: dono baagh poora poora phal detay thay , aur koi baagh phal denay mein koi kami nahi chorta tha , aur unn dono kay darmiyan hum ney aik nehar jari kerdi thi ,

verses.text: aur uss shaks ko khoob dolat hasil hoi to woh apney sathi say baaten kertay huye kehney laga kay :  mera maal bhi tum say ziyada hai , aur mera jutha bhi tum say ziyada mazboot hai .
verses.translation: aur uss shaks ko khoob dolat hasil hoi to woh apney sathi say baaten kertay huye kehney laga kay :  mera maal bhi tum say ziyada hai , aur mera jutha bhi tum say ziyada mazboot hai .

verses.text: aur woh apni jaan per sitam dahata huwa apney baagh mein dakhil huwa . kehney laga :  mein nahi samajhta kay yeh baagh kabhi bhi tabah hoga ,
verses.translation: aur woh apni jaan per sitam dahata huwa apney baagh mein dakhil huwa . kehney laga :  mein nahi samajhta kay yeh baagh kabhi bhi tabah hoga ,

verses.text: aur mera khayal yeh hai kay qayamat kabhi nahi aaye gi . aur agar kabhi mujhay apney rab kay paas wapis bheja bhi gaya , tab bhi mujhay yaqeen hai kay mujhay iss say bhi achi jagah milay gi .
verses.translation: aur mera khayal yeh hai kay qayamat kabhi nahi aaye gi . aur agar kabhi mujhay apney rab kay paas wapis bheja bhi gaya , tab bhi mujhay yaqeen hai kay mujhay iss say bhi achi jagah milay gi .

verses.text: uss kay sathi ney uss say baaten kertay huye kaha :  kiya tum uss zaat kay sath kufr ka moamla ker rahey ho jiss ney tumhen mitti say , aur phir nutfay say peda kiya , phir tumhen aik bhala changa insan bana diya-?
verses.translation: uss kay sathi ney uss say baaten kertay huye kaha :  kiya tum uss zaat kay sath kufr ka moamla ker rahey ho jiss ney tumhen mitti say , aur phir nutfay say peda kiya , phir tumhen aik bhala changa insan bana diya-?

verses.text: jahan tak mera talluq hai , mein to yeh aqeedah rakhta hun kay Allah mera perwerdigar hai , aur mein apney perwerdigar kay sath kissi ko shareek nahi manta .
verses.translation: jahan tak mera talluq hai , mein to yeh aqeedah rakhta hun kay Allah mera perwerdigar hai , aur mein apney perwerdigar kay sath kissi ko shareek nahi manta .

verses.text: aur jab tum apney baagh mein dakhil horahey thay , uss waqt tum ney yeh kiyon nahi kaha kay MashaAllah la-quoowat illa Billah ! ( jo Allah chahta hai , wohi hota hai , Allah ki tofiq kay baghair kissi mein koi taqat nahi ) . agar tumhen yeh nazar aaraha hai kay meri dolat aur aulad tum say kam hai ,
verses.translation: aur jab tum apney baagh mein dakhil horahey thay , uss waqt tum ney yeh kiyon nahi kaha kay MashaAllah la-quoowat illa Billah ! ( jo Allah chahta hai , wohi hota hai , Allah ki tofiq kay baghair kissi mein koi taqat nahi ) . agar tumhen yeh nazar aaraha hai kay meri dolat aur aulad tum say kam hai ,

verses.text: to meray rab say kuch baeed nahi hai kay woh mujhay tumharay baagh say behtar cheez ata farmadey , aur tumharay iss baagh per koi aasmani aafat bhej dey , jiss say woh chikney meydan mein tabdeel ho ker reh jaye .
verses.translation: to meray rab say kuch baeed nahi hai kay woh mujhay tumharay baagh say behtar cheez ata farmadey , aur tumharay iss baagh per koi aasmani aafat bhej dey , jiss say woh chikney meydan mein tabdeel ho ker reh jaye .

verses.text: ya uss ka paani zameen mein utar jaye , phir tum ussay talash bhi naa ker-sako-? .
verses.translation: ya uss ka paani zameen mein utar jaye , phir tum ussay talash bhi naa ker-sako-? .

verses.text: aur ( phir huwa yeh kay ) uss ki sari dolat azab kay gheray mein aagae , aur subha hoi to iss halat mein kay uss ney baagh per jo kuch kharch kiya tha , woh uss per haath malta reh gaya , jabkay uss ka baagh apni tattiyon per gira parra tha , aur woh keh raha tha :  kaash ! mein ney apney rab kay sath kissi ko shareek naa maana hota .
verses.translation: aur ( phir huwa yeh kay ) uss ki sari dolat azab kay gheray mein aagae , aur subha hoi to iss halat mein kay uss ney baagh per jo kuch kharch kiya tha , woh uss per haath malta reh gaya , jabkay uss ka baagh apni tattiyon per gira parra tha , aur woh keh raha tha :  kaash ! mein ney apney rab kay sath kissi ko shareek naa maana hota .

verses.text: aur ussay koi aisa jutha moyassar naa aaya jo Allah ko chorr ker uss ki madad kerta , aur naa woh khud iss qabil tha kay apna difaa ker-sakay .
verses.translation: aur ussay koi aisa jutha moyassar naa aaya jo Allah ko chorr ker uss ki madad kerta , aur naa woh khud iss qabil tha kay apna difaa ker-sakay .

verses.text: aesay moaqa per ( aadmi ko pata chalta hai kay ) madad ka sara ikhtiyar sachay Allah ko hasil hai . wohi hai jo behtar sawab deta aur behtar anjam dikhata hai .
verses.translation: aesay moaqa per ( aadmi ko pata chalta hai kay ) madad ka sara ikhtiyar sachay Allah ko hasil hai . wohi hai jo behtar sawab deta aur behtar anjam dikhata hai .

verses.text: aur inn logon  say dunyawi zindagi ki yeh misal bhi biyan kerdo kay woh aesi hai jaisay hum ney aasman say paani barsaya , to uss say zameen ka sabza khoob ghana hogaya , phir woh aisa reza reza huwa kay ussay hawayen urra ley jati hain .   aur Allah her cheez per mukammal qudrat rakhta hai .
verses.translation: aur inn logon  say dunyawi zindagi ki yeh misal bhi biyan kerdo kay woh aesi hai jaisay hum ney aasman say paani barsaya , to uss say zameen ka sabza khoob ghana hogaya , phir woh aisa reza reza huwa kay ussay hawayen urra ley jati hain .   aur Allah her cheez per mukammal qudrat rakhta hai .

verses.text: maal aur aulad dunyawi zindagi ki zeenat hain , aur jo naikiyan payedaar rehney wali hain , woh tumharay rab kay nazdeek sawab kay aetbar say bhi behtar hain , aur umeed wabasta kernay kay liye bhi behtar .
verses.translation: maal aur aulad dunyawi zindagi ki zeenat hain , aur jo naikiyan payedaar rehney wali hain , woh tumharay rab kay nazdeek sawab kay aetbar say bhi behtar hain , aur umeed wabasta kernay kay liye bhi behtar .

verses.text: aur ( uss din ka dhiyan rakho ) jiss din hum paharon ko chalyen gay ,   aur tum zameen ko dekho gay kay woh khuli parri hai ,   aur hum inn sabb ko gher ker ikattha kerden gay , aur inn mein say kissi aik ko bhi nahi choren gay .
verses.translation: aur ( uss din ka dhiyan rakho ) jiss din hum paharon ko chalyen gay ,   aur tum zameen ko dekho gay kay woh khuli parri hai ,   aur hum inn sabb ko gher ker ikattha kerden gay , aur inn mein say kissi aik ko bhi nahi choren gay .

verses.text: aur sabb ko tumharay rab kay samney saff baandh ker paish kiya jaye ga . aakhir tum humaray paas ussi tarah aagaye jiss tarah hum ney tumhen pehli baar peda kiya tha . iss kay bar-aks tumhara dawa yeh tha kay hum tumharay liye ( yeh ) muqarrar waqt kabhi nahi layen gay .
verses.translation: aur sabb ko tumharay rab kay samney saff baandh ker paish kiya jaye ga . aakhir tum humaray paas ussi tarah aagaye jiss tarah hum ney tumhen pehli baar peda kiya tha . iss kay bar-aks tumhara dawa yeh tha kay hum tumharay liye ( yeh ) muqarrar waqt kabhi nahi layen gay .

verses.text: aur ( aemal ki ) kitab samney rakh di jaye gi , chunacheh tum mujrimon ko dekho gay kay woh uss kay mandrajaat say khof zada hain , aur keh rahey hain kay :  haaye humari barbadi ! yeh kaisi kitab hai jiss ney humara koi chota bara amal aisa nahi chorra jiss ka poora ehata naa kerliya ho .  aur woh apna sara kiya dhara apney samney mojood payen gay . aur tumhara perwerdigar kissi per koi zulm nahi keray ga .
verses.translation: aur ( aemal ki ) kitab samney rakh di jaye gi , chunacheh tum mujrimon ko dekho gay kay woh uss kay mandrajaat say khof zada hain , aur keh rahey hain kay :  haaye humari barbadi ! yeh kaisi kitab hai jiss ney humara koi chota bara amal aisa nahi chorra jiss ka poora ehata naa kerliya ho .  aur woh apna sara kiya dhara apney samney mojood payen gay . aur tumhara perwerdigar kissi per koi zulm nahi keray ga .

verses.text: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab hum ney farishton say kaha tha kay :  Adam kay aagay sajda kero .  chunacheh sabb ney sajda kiya , siwaye iblees kay .   woh jinnaat mein say tha , chunacheh uss ney apney rab kay hukum ki nafarmani ki . kiya phir bhi tum meray bajaye ussay aur uss ki zurriyat ko apna rakhwala banatay ho , halankay woh sabb tumharay dushman hain-? ( Allah taalaa ka ) kitna bura mutabadil hai jo zalimon ko mila hai !
verses.translation: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab hum ney farishton say kaha tha kay :  Adam kay aagay sajda kero .  chunacheh sabb ney sajda kiya , siwaye iblees kay .   woh jinnaat mein say tha , chunacheh uss ney apney rab kay hukum ki nafarmani ki . kiya phir bhi tum meray bajaye ussay aur uss ki zurriyat ko apna rakhwala banatay ho , halankay woh sabb tumharay dushman hain-? ( Allah taalaa ka ) kitna bura mutabadil hai jo zalimon ko mila hai !

verses.text: mein ney naa aasmano aur zameen ki takhleeq kay waqt unn ko hazir kiya tha , naa khud unn ko peda kertay waqt ,   aur mein aisa nahi hun kay gumrah kernay walon ko dast o bazoo banaon .
verses.translation: mein ney naa aasmano aur zameen ki takhleeq kay waqt unn ko hazir kiya tha , naa khud unn ko peda kertay waqt ,   aur mein aisa nahi hun kay gumrah kernay walon ko dast o bazoo banaon .

verses.text: aur uss din ka dhiyan kero jab Allah ( inn mushrikon say ) kahey ga kay :  zara pukaro unn ko jinhen tum ney meri khudai mein shareek samajh rakha tha !  chunacheh woh pukaren gay , lekin woh unn ko koi jawab nahi den gay , aur hum unn kay darmiyan aik mohlik aarr haeel kerden gay .
verses.translation: aur uss din ka dhiyan kero jab Allah ( inn mushrikon say ) kahey ga kay :  zara pukaro unn ko jinhen tum ney meri khudai mein shareek samajh rakha tha !  chunacheh woh pukaren gay , lekin woh unn ko koi jawab nahi den gay , aur hum unn kay darmiyan aik mohlik aarr haeel kerden gay .

verses.text: aur mujrim log aag ko dekhen gay to samajh jayen gay kay enhen issi mein girna hai , aur iss say bach nikalney ka koi raasta nahi payen gay .
verses.translation: aur mujrim log aag ko dekhen gay to samajh jayen gay kay enhen issi mein girna hai , aur iss say bach nikalney ka koi raasta nahi payen gay .

verses.text: aur hum ney logon  kay faeeday kay liye iss Quran mein tarah tarah say her qisam kay mazameen biyan kiye hain , aur insan hai kay jhagrra kernay mein her cheez say barh gaya hai .
verses.translation: aur hum ney logon  kay faeeday kay liye iss Quran mein tarah tarah say her qisam kay mazameen biyan kiye hain , aur insan hai kay jhagrra kernay mein her cheez say barh gaya hai .

verses.text: aur jab logon  kay paas hidayat aa-chuki to abb unhen emaan laney aur apney rab say moaafi maangney say iss ( mutalbay ) kay siwa koi aur cheez nahi rok rahi kay unn kay sath bhi pichlay logon  jaisay waqiyaat paish aajayen , ya azab unn kay bilkul samney aa-khara ho .
verses.translation: aur jab logon  kay paas hidayat aa-chuki to abb unhen emaan laney aur apney rab say moaafi maangney say iss ( mutalbay ) kay siwa koi aur cheez nahi rok rahi kay unn kay sath bhi pichlay logon  jaisay waqiyaat paish aajayen , ya azab unn kay bilkul samney aa-khara ho .

verses.text: aur hum payghumberon ko sirf iss liye bhejtay hain kay woh ( mominon ko ) khushkhabri den , aur ( kafiron ko azab say ) mutanabeh keren . aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh batil ka sahara ley ker jhagrra kertay hain , takay uss kay zariye haq ko dagmaga den , aur unhon ney meri aayaton ko aur unhen jo tanbeeh ki gaee thi uss ko mazaq bana rakha hai .
verses.translation: aur hum payghumberon ko sirf iss liye bhejtay hain kay woh ( mominon ko ) khushkhabri den , aur ( kafiron ko azab say ) mutanabeh keren . aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh batil ka sahara ley ker jhagrra kertay hain , takay uss kay zariye haq ko dagmaga den , aur unhon ney meri aayaton ko aur unhen jo tanbeeh ki gaee thi uss ko mazaq bana rakha hai .

verses.text: aur uss shaks say barh ker zalim kon hoga jissay uss kay rab ki aayaton kay hawalay say naseehat ki jaye , to woh unn say mun morr ley , aur apney haathon kay kartoot ko bhula bethay-? haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney ( unn logon  kay kartoot ki wajeh say ) unn kay dilon per ghilaf charha diye hain jinn ki wajeh say woh uss ( Quran ) ko nahi samajhtay , aur unn kay kanon mein daat laga di hai . aur agar tum unhen hidayat ki taraf bulao , tab bhi woh sahih raastay per hergiz nahi ayen gay .
verses.translation: aur uss shaks say barh ker zalim kon hoga jissay uss kay rab ki aayaton kay hawalay say naseehat ki jaye , to woh unn say mun morr ley , aur apney haathon kay kartoot ko bhula bethay-? haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney ( unn logon  kay kartoot ki wajeh say ) unn kay dilon per ghilaf charha diye hain jinn ki wajeh say woh uss ( Quran ) ko nahi samajhtay , aur unn kay kanon mein daat laga di hai . aur agar tum unhen hidayat ki taraf bulao , tab bhi woh sahih raastay per hergiz nahi ayen gay .

verses.text: aur tumhara perwerdigar boht bakhshney wala , bara rehmat wala hai . jo kamai enhon ney ki hai , agar woh uss ki wajeh say unhen pakarney per aata to unn ko jald hi azab dey deta , lekin unn kay liye aik waqt muqarrar hai , jiss say bachnay kay liye unhen koi panah gaah nahi milay gi .
verses.translation: aur tumhara perwerdigar boht bakhshney wala , bara rehmat wala hai . jo kamai enhon ney ki hai , agar woh uss ki wajeh say unhen pakarney per aata to unn ko jald hi azab dey deta , lekin unn kay liye aik waqt muqarrar hai , jiss say bachnay kay liye unhen koi panah gaah nahi milay gi .

verses.text: yeh sari bastiyan ( tumharay samney ) hain , jab enhon ney zulm ki rawish apnai to hum ney inn ko halak ker daala , aur inn ki halakat kay liye ( bhi ) hum ney aik waqt muqarrar kiya huwa tha .
verses.translation: yeh sari bastiyan ( tumharay samney ) hain , jab enhon ney zulm ki rawish apnai to hum ney inn ko halak ker daala , aur inn ki halakat kay liye ( bhi ) hum ney aik waqt muqarrar kiya huwa tha .

verses.text: aur ( uss waqt ka ziker suno ) jab musa ney apney nojawan ( shagrid ) say kaha tha kay :  mein uss waqt tak apna safar jari rakhun ga jab tak do samandaron kay sangham per naa phonch jaon , werna barson chalta rahun ga .
verses.translation: aur ( uss waqt ka ziker suno ) jab musa ney apney nojawan ( shagrid ) say kaha tha kay :  mein uss waqt tak apna safar jari rakhun ga jab tak do samandaron kay sangham per naa phonch jaon , werna barson chalta rahun ga .

verses.text: chunacheh jab woh unn kay sangham per phonchay to dono apni machli ko bhool gaye , aur uss ney samandar mein aik surang ki tarah ka raasta bana liya .
verses.translation: chunacheh jab woh unn kay sangham per phonchay to dono apni machli ko bhool gaye , aur uss ney samandar mein aik surang ki tarah ka raasta bana liya .

verses.text: phir jab dono aagay nikal gaye , to musa ney apney nojawan say kaha kay :  humara nashta lao , sachi baat yeh hai kay hamen iss safar mein bari thakawat laahaq hogaee hai .
verses.translation: phir jab dono aagay nikal gaye , to musa ney apney nojawan say kaha kay :  humara nashta lao , sachi baat yeh hai kay hamen iss safar mein bari thakawat laahaq hogaee hai .

verses.text: uss ney kaha :  bhala bataiye ! ( ajeeb qissa hogaya ) jab hum uss chatan per thehray thay to mein machli ( ka aap say ziker kerna ) bhool gaya . aur shetan kay siwa koi nahi hai jiss ney mujh say uss ka tazkarah kerna bhulaya ho . aur uss ( machli ) ney to baray ajeeb tareeqay per darya mein apni raah ley li thi .
verses.translation: uss ney kaha :  bhala bataiye ! ( ajeeb qissa hogaya ) jab hum uss chatan per thehray thay to mein machli ( ka aap say ziker kerna ) bhool gaya . aur shetan kay siwa koi nahi hai jiss ney mujh say uss ka tazkarah kerna bhulaya ho . aur uss ( machli ) ney to baray ajeeb tareeqay per darya mein apni raah ley li thi .

verses.text: musa ney kaha :  ussi/issi baat ki to hamen talash thi .    chunacheh dono apney qadmon kay nishan dekhtay huye wapis lotay .
verses.translation: musa ney kaha :  ussi/issi baat ki to hamen talash thi .    chunacheh dono apney qadmon kay nishan dekhtay huye wapis lotay .

verses.text: tab unhen humaray bandon mein say aik banda mila jiss ko hum ney apni khusoosi rehmat say nawaza tha , aur khaas apni taraf say aik ilm sikhaya tha .
verses.translation: tab unhen humaray bandon mein say aik banda mila jiss ko hum ney apni khusoosi rehmat say nawaza tha , aur khaas apni taraf say aik ilm sikhaya tha .

verses.text: musa ney unn say kaha :  kiya mein aap kay sath iss gharz say reh sakta hun kay aap ko bhalai ka jo ilm ata huwa hai , uss ka kuch hissa mujhay bhi sikha den-?
verses.translation: musa ney unn say kaha :  kiya mein aap kay sath iss gharz say reh sakta hun kay aap ko bhalai ka jo ilm ata huwa hai , uss ka kuch hissa mujhay bhi sikha den-?

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  mujhay yaqeen hai kay aap meray sath rehney per sabar nahi ker-saken gay .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  mujhay yaqeen hai kay aap meray sath rehney per sabar nahi ker-saken gay .
