verses.text: aur jinn baaton ki aap ko poori poori waqfiyat nahi hai , unn per aap sabar ker bhi kaisay saktay hain-?
verses.translation: aur jinn baaton ki aap ko poori poori waqfiyat nahi hai , unn per aap sabar ker bhi kaisay saktay hain-?

verses.text: musa ney kaha :  inn sha Allah aap mujhay sabir payen gay , aur mein aap kay kissi hukum ki khilaf warzi nahi kerun ga .
verses.translation: musa ney kaha :  inn sha Allah aap mujhay sabir payen gay , aur mein aap kay kissi hukum ki khilaf warzi nahi kerun ga .

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  acha ! agar aap meray sath chaltay hain to jab tak mein khud hi aap say kissi baat ka tazkarah shuroo naa kerun , aap mujh say kissi bhi cheez kay baaray mein sawal naa keren .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  acha ! agar aap meray sath chaltay hain to jab tak mein khud hi aap say kissi baat ka tazkarah shuroo naa kerun , aap mujh say kissi bhi cheez kay baaray mein sawal naa keren .

verses.text: chunacheh dono rawana hogaye , yahan tak kay jab dono aik kashti mein sawar huye to unn sahab ney kashti mein ched kerdiya .   musa bolay :  aray kiya aap ney iss mein ched kerdiya takay saray kashti walon ko dubo daalen-? yeh to aap ney bara khofnak kaam kiya .
verses.translation: chunacheh dono rawana hogaye , yahan tak kay jab dono aik kashti mein sawar huye to unn sahab ney kashti mein ched kerdiya .   musa bolay :  aray kiya aap ney iss mein ched kerdiya takay saray kashti walon ko dubo daalen-? yeh to aap ney bara khofnak kaam kiya .

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  kiya mein ney kaha nahi tha kay aap meray sath reh ker sabar nahi ker-saken gay-?
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  kiya mein ney kaha nahi tha kay aap meray sath reh ker sabar nahi ker-saken gay-?

verses.text: musa ney kaha :  mujh say jo bhool hogaee , uss per meri girift naa kijiye , aur meray kaam ko ziyada mushkil naa banaiye .
verses.translation: musa ney kaha :  mujh say jo bhool hogaee , uss per meri girift naa kijiye , aur meray kaam ko ziyada mushkil naa banaiye .

verses.text: woh dono phir rawana hogaye , yahan tak kay unn ki mulaqat aik larkay say hoi to unn sahab ney ussay qatal ker daala .   musa bol uthay :  aray kiya aap ney aik pakeezah jaan ko halak kerdiya , jabkay uss ney kissi ki jaan nahi li thi jiss ka badla uss say liya jaye-? yeh to aap ney boht hi bura kaam kiya !
verses.translation: woh dono phir rawana hogaye , yahan tak kay unn ki mulaqat aik larkay say hoi to unn sahab ney ussay qatal ker daala .   musa bol uthay :  aray kiya aap ney aik pakeezah jaan ko halak kerdiya , jabkay uss ney kissi ki jaan nahi li thi jiss ka badla uss say liya jaye-? yeh to aap ney boht hi bura kaam kiya !

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  kiya mein ney aap say nahi kaha tha kay aap meray sath rehney per sabar nahi ker-saken gay-?
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  kiya mein ney aap say nahi kaha tha kay aap meray sath rehney per sabar nahi ker-saken gay-?

verses.text: musa bolay :  agar abb mein aap say koi baat poochun toh aap mujhay apney sath naa rakhiye . yaqeenan aap meri taraf say uzr ki hadd ko phonch gaye hain .
verses.translation: musa bolay :  agar abb mein aap say koi baat poochun toh aap mujhay apney sath naa rakhiye . yaqeenan aap meri taraf say uzr ki hadd ko phonch gaye hain .

verses.text: chunacheh woh dono phir rawana hogaye , yahan tak kay jab aik basti walon kay paas phonchay toh uss kay bashindon say khana maanga toh unn logon  ney unn ki mehmani kernay say inkar kerdiya . phir unhen wahan aik deewar mili jo gira hi chahti thi , unn sahab ney ussay kharra kerdiya . musa ney kaha :  agar aap chahtay toh iss kaam per kuch ujrat ley letay .
verses.translation: chunacheh woh dono phir rawana hogaye , yahan tak kay jab aik basti walon kay paas phonchay toh uss kay bashindon say khana maanga toh unn logon  ney unn ki mehmani kernay say inkar kerdiya . phir unhen wahan aik deewar mili jo gira hi chahti thi , unn sahab ney ussay kharra kerdiya . musa ney kaha :  agar aap chahtay toh iss kaam per kuch ujrat ley letay .

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  lijiye meray aur aap kay darmiyan judai ka waqt aagaya . abb mein aap ko unn baaton ka maqsad bataye deta hun jinn per aap say sabar nahi hosaka .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  lijiye meray aur aap kay darmiyan judai ka waqt aagaya . abb mein aap ko unn baaton ka maqsad bataye deta hun jinn per aap say sabar nahi hosaka .

verses.text: jahan tak kashti ka talluq hai woh kuch gharib aadmiyon ki thi jo darya mein mazdoori kertay thay , mein ney chaha kay uss mein koi aeb peda kerdun , ( kiyonkay ) unn kay aagay aik badshah tha jo her ( achi ) kashti ko zabardasti cheen ker rakh liya kerta tha .
verses.translation: jahan tak kashti ka talluq hai woh kuch gharib aadmiyon ki thi jo darya mein mazdoori kertay thay , mein ney chaha kay uss mein koi aeb peda kerdun , ( kiyonkay ) unn kay aagay aik badshah tha jo her ( achi ) kashti ko zabardasti cheen ker rakh liya kerta tha .

verses.text: aur larkay ka moamla yeh tha kay uss kay maa baap momin thay , aur hamen iss baat ka andesha tha kay yeh larka unn dono ko sarkashi aur kufr mein naa phansa dey .
verses.translation: aur larkay ka moamla yeh tha kay uss kay maa baap momin thay , aur hamen iss baat ka andesha tha kay yeh larka unn dono ko sarkashi aur kufr mein naa phansa dey .

verses.text: chunacheh hum ney yeh chaha kay unn ka perwerdigar unhen uss larkay kay badlay aesi aulad dey jo pakeezgi mein bhi uss say behtar ho , aur hussn-e-sulook mein bhi uss say barhi hoi ho .
verses.translation: chunacheh hum ney yeh chaha kay unn ka perwerdigar unhen uss larkay kay badlay aesi aulad dey jo pakeezgi mein bhi uss say behtar ho , aur hussn-e-sulook mein bhi uss say barhi hoi ho .

verses.text: rahi yeh deewar , toh woh iss shehar mein rehney walay do yateem larkon ki thi , aur uss kay neechay unn ka aik khazana garra huwa tha , aur unn dono ka baap aik naik aadmi tha . iss liye aap kay perwerdigar ney yeh chaha kay yeh dono larkay apni jawani ki umar ko phonchen , aur apna khazana nikal len . yeh sabb kuch aap kay rab ki rehmat ki bana per huwa hai , aur mein ney koi kaam apni raye say nahi kiya . yeh tha maqsad unn baaton ka jinn per aap say sabar nahi hosaka .
verses.translation: rahi yeh deewar , toh woh iss shehar mein rehney walay do yateem larkon ki thi , aur uss kay neechay unn ka aik khazana garra huwa tha , aur unn dono ka baap aik naik aadmi tha . iss liye aap kay perwerdigar ney yeh chaha kay yeh dono larkay apni jawani ki umar ko phonchen , aur apna khazana nikal len . yeh sabb kuch aap kay rab ki rehmat ki bana per huwa hai , aur mein ney koi kaam apni raye say nahi kiya . yeh tha maqsad unn baaton ka jinn per aap say sabar nahi hosaka .

verses.text: aur yeh log tum say zulqarnain kay baaray mein poochtay hain .   keh do kay :  mein unn ka kuch haal tumhen parh ker sunata hun .
verses.translation: aur yeh log tum say zulqarnain kay baaray mein poochtay hain .   keh do kay :  mein unn ka kuch haal tumhen parh ker sunata hun .

verses.text: waqiaa yeh hai kay hum ney unn ko zameen mein iqtidar bakhsha tha , aur unhen her kaam kay wasaeel ata kiye thay .
verses.translation: waqiaa yeh hai kay hum ney unn ko zameen mein iqtidar bakhsha tha , aur unhen her kaam kay wasaeel ata kiye thay .

verses.text: jiss kay nateejay mein woh aik raastay kay peechay chal parray .
verses.translation: jiss kay nateejay mein woh aik raastay kay peechay chal parray .

verses.text: yahan tak kay jab woh sooraj kay doobney ki jagah phonchay , toh unhen dikhai diya kay woh aik daldal jaisay ( siyah ) chashmay mein doob raha hai ,   aur wahan unhen aik qoam mili . hum ney ( unn say ) kaha :  aey zulqarnain ! ( tumharay paas do raastay hain : ) ya toh inn logon  ko saza do , ya phir inn kay moamlay mein acha ravaiyya ikhtiyar kero .
verses.translation: yahan tak kay jab woh sooraj kay doobney ki jagah phonchay , toh unhen dikhai diya kay woh aik daldal jaisay ( siyah ) chashmay mein doob raha hai ,   aur wahan unhen aik qoam mili . hum ney ( unn say ) kaha :  aey zulqarnain ! ( tumharay paas do raastay hain : ) ya toh inn logon  ko saza do , ya phir inn kay moamlay mein acha ravaiyya ikhtiyar kero .

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  inn mein say jo koi zulm ka raasta ikhtiyar keray ga , ussay toh hum saza den gay , phir ussay apney rab kay paas phoncha diya jaye ga , aur woh ussay sakht azab dey ga .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  inn mein say jo koi zulm ka raasta ikhtiyar keray ga , ussay toh hum saza den gay , phir ussay apney rab kay paas phoncha diya jaye ga , aur woh ussay sakht azab dey ga .

verses.text: albatta jo koi emaan laye ga , aur naik amal keray ga , to woh badlay kay tor per achay anjam ka mustahiq hoga , aur hum bhi uss ko apna hukum detay waqt aasani ki baat kahen gay .
verses.translation: albatta jo koi emaan laye ga , aur naik amal keray ga , to woh badlay kay tor per achay anjam ka mustahiq hoga , aur hum bhi uss ko apna hukum detay waqt aasani ki baat kahen gay .

verses.text: iss kay baad woh aik aur raastay kay peechay chal parray .
verses.translation: iss kay baad woh aik aur raastay kay peechay chal parray .

verses.text: yahan tak kay jab woh sooraj kay tuloo hone ki jagah phonchay to unhon ney dekha kay woh aik aesi qoam per tuloo horaha hai jissay hum ney uss ( ki dhoop ) say bachnay kay liye koi oat mohaiyya nahi ki thi .
verses.translation: yahan tak kay jab woh sooraj kay tuloo hone ki jagah phonchay to unhon ney dekha kay woh aik aesi qoam per tuloo horaha hai jissay hum ney uss ( ki dhoop ) say bachnay kay liye koi oat mohaiyya nahi ki thi .

verses.text: waqiaa issi tarah huwa , aur zulqarnain kay paas jo kuch ( saz-o-saman ) tha , hamen uss ki poori poori khabar thi .
verses.translation: waqiaa issi tarah huwa , aur zulqarnain kay paas jo kuch ( saz-o-saman ) tha , hamen uss ki poori poori khabar thi .

verses.text: iss kay baad woh aik aur raastay kay peechay chal parray .
verses.translation: iss kay baad woh aik aur raastay kay peechay chal parray .

verses.text: yahan tak kay jab woh do paharon kay darmiyan phonchay to unhen unn paharon say pehlay kuch log milay jinn kay baaray mein aisa lagta tha kay woh koi baat nahi samajhtay .
verses.translation: yahan tak kay jab woh do paharon kay darmiyan phonchay to unhen unn paharon say pehlay kuch log milay jinn kay baaray mein aisa lagta tha kay woh koi baat nahi samajhtay .

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  aey zulqarnain ! yajooj aur majooj iss zameen mein fasad phelaney walay log hain . to kiya hum aap ko kuch maal ki paishkash ker-saktay hain , jiss kay badlay aap humaray aur inn kay darmiyan koi deewar bana den-?
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  aey zulqarnain ! yajooj aur majooj iss zameen mein fasad phelaney walay log hain . to kiya hum aap ko kuch maal ki paishkash ker-saktay hain , jiss kay badlay aap humaray aur inn kay darmiyan koi deewar bana den-?

verses.text: zulqarnain ney kaha :  Allah ney mujhay jo iqtidar ata farmaya hai , wohi ( meray liye ) behtar hai . lehaza tum log ( haath paon ki ) taqat say meri madad kero , to mein tumharay aur unn kay darmiyan aik mazboot deewar bana dun ga .
verses.translation: zulqarnain ney kaha :  Allah ney mujhay jo iqtidar ata farmaya hai , wohi ( meray liye ) behtar hai . lehaza tum log ( haath paon ki ) taqat say meri madad kero , to mein tumharay aur unn kay darmiyan aik mazboot deewar bana dun ga .

verses.text: mujhay lohey ki chadaren laado .  yahan tak kay jab unhon ney ( darmiyani khala ko paat ker ) dono pahari saron ko aik doosray say mila diya toh kaha kay :  abb aag dehkao    yahan tak kay jab uss ( deewar ) ko laal angara kerdiya to kaha kay :  pighla huwa tanba lao , abb mein uss per undelon ga .
verses.translation: mujhay lohey ki chadaren laado .  yahan tak kay jab unhon ney ( darmiyani khala ko paat ker ) dono pahari saron ko aik doosray say mila diya toh kaha kay :  abb aag dehkao    yahan tak kay jab uss ( deewar ) ko laal angara kerdiya to kaha kay :  pighla huwa tanba lao , abb mein uss per undelon ga .

verses.text: chunacheh ( woh deewar aesi ban gaee kay ) yajooj majooj naa uss per charrney ki taqat rakhtay thay , aur naa uss mein koi sorakh bana saktay thay .
verses.translation: chunacheh ( woh deewar aesi ban gaee kay ) yajooj majooj naa uss per charrney ki taqat rakhtay thay , aur naa uss mein koi sorakh bana saktay thay .

verses.text: zulqarnain ney kaha :  yeh meray rab ki rehmat hai ( kay uss ney aesi deewar bananey ki tofiq di ) phir meray rab ney jiss waqt ka wada kiya hai , jab woh waqt aaye ga toh woh iss ( deewar ) ko daha ker zameen kay barabar kerday ga ,   aur meray rab ka wada bilkul sacha hai .
verses.translation: zulqarnain ney kaha :  yeh meray rab ki rehmat hai ( kay uss ney aesi deewar bananey ki tofiq di ) phir meray rab ney jiss waqt ka wada kiya hai , jab woh waqt aaye ga toh woh iss ( deewar ) ko daha ker zameen kay barabar kerday ga ,   aur meray rab ka wada bilkul sacha hai .

verses.text: aur uss din hum unn ki yeh halat kerden gay kay woh mojon ki tarah aik doosray say takra rahey hon gay ,   aur soor phoonka jaye ga toh hum sabb ko aik sath jama kerlen gay .
verses.translation: aur uss din hum unn ki yeh halat kerden gay kay woh mojon ki tarah aik doosray say takra rahey hon gay ,   aur soor phoonka jaye ga toh hum sabb ko aik sath jama kerlen gay .

verses.text: aur uss din hum dozakh ko unn kafiron kay samney khuli aankhon ley ayen gay ,
verses.translation: aur uss din hum dozakh ko unn kafiron kay samney khuli aankhon ley ayen gay ,

verses.text: jinn ki aankhon per ( duniya mein ) meri naseehat ki taraf say perda parra huwa tha , aur jo sunney ki salahiyat nahi rakhtay thay .
verses.translation: jinn ki aankhon per ( duniya mein ) meri naseehat ki taraf say perda parra huwa tha , aur jo sunney ki salahiyat nahi rakhtay thay .

verses.text: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , kiya woh phir bhi yeh samajhtay hain kay mujhay chorr ker meray hi bandon ko apna rakhwala bana len gay-? yaqeen rakho kay hum ney aesay kafiron ki mehmani kay liye dozakh tayyar ker rakhi hai .
verses.translation: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , kiya woh phir bhi yeh samajhtay hain kay mujhay chorr ker meray hi bandon ko apna rakhwala bana len gay-? yaqeen rakho kay hum ney aesay kafiron ki mehmani kay liye dozakh tayyar ker rakhi hai .

verses.text: keh do kay :  kiya hum tumhen batayen kay kon log hain jo apney aemal mein sabb say ziyada nakam hain-?
verses.translation: keh do kay :  kiya hum tumhen batayen kay kon log hain jo apney aemal mein sabb say ziyada nakam hain-?

verses.text: yeh woh log hain kay dunyawi zindagi mein unn ki sari dorr dhoop seedhay raastay say bhatki rahi , aur woh samajhtay rahey kay woh boht acha kaam ker rahey hain .
verses.translation: yeh woh log hain kay dunyawi zindagi mein unn ki sari dorr dhoop seedhay raastay say bhatki rahi , aur woh samajhtay rahey kay woh boht acha kaam ker rahey hain .

verses.text: yeh wohi log hain jinhon ney apney malik ki aayaton ka aur uss kay samney paish honey ka inkar kiya , iss liye inn ka sara kiya dhara gharat hogaya , chunacheh qayamat kay din hum unn ka koi wazan shumar nahi keren gay .
verses.translation: yeh wohi log hain jinhon ney apney malik ki aayaton ka aur uss kay samney paish honey ka inkar kiya , iss liye inn ka sara kiya dhara gharat hogaya , chunacheh qayamat kay din hum unn ka koi wazan shumar nahi keren gay .

verses.text: yeh hai jahannum ki shakal mein unn ki saza , kiyonkay unhon ney kufr ki rawish ikhtiyar ki thi , aur meri aayaton aur meray payghumberon ka mazaq banaya tha .
verses.translation: yeh hai jahannum ki shakal mein unn ki saza , kiyonkay unhon ney kufr ki rawish ikhtiyar ki thi , aur meri aayaton aur meray payghumberon ka mazaq banaya tha .

verses.text: . ( doosri taraf ) jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ki mehmani kay liye beyshak firdous kay baagh hon gay ,
verses.translation: . ( doosri taraf ) jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ki mehmani kay liye beyshak firdous kay baagh hon gay ,

verses.text: jinn mein woh hamesha rahen gay , ( aur ) woh wahan say kahen aur jana nahi chahen gay .
verses.translation: jinn mein woh hamesha rahen gay , ( aur ) woh wahan say kahen aur jana nahi chahen gay .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! logon  say ) keh do kay :  agar meray rab ki baaten likhney kay liye samandar roshnai ban jaye , to meray rab ki baaten khatam nahi hon gi kay uss say pehlay samandar khatam hochuka hoga , chahye uss samandar ki kami poori kernay kay liye hum wesa hi aik aur samandar kiyon naa ley ayen .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! logon  say ) keh do kay :  agar meray rab ki baaten likhney kay liye samandar roshnai ban jaye , to meray rab ki baaten khatam nahi hon gi kay uss say pehlay samandar khatam hochuka hoga , chahye uss samandar ki kami poori kernay kay liye hum wesa hi aik aur samandar kiyon naa ley ayen .

verses.text: keh do kay :  mein to tumhi jaisa aik insan hun , ( albatta ) mujh per yeh wahi aati hai kay tum sabb ka khuda  bus aik khuda hai . lehaza jiss kissi ko apney malik say ja-milney ki umeed ho , ussay chahiye kay woh naik amal keray , aur apney malik ki ibadat mein kissi aur ko shareek naa thehraye .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: tamam tareefen Allah ki hain jiss ney apney banday per kitab nazil ki , aur uss mein kissi qisam ki koi khaami nahi rakhi ,
ayahs.translation: tamam tareefen Allah ki hain jiss ney apney banday per kitab nazil ki , aur uss mein kissi qisam ki koi khaami nahi rakhi ,

ayahs.text: aik seedhi seedhi kitab jo uss ney iss liye nazil ki hai kay logon  ko apni taraf say aik sakht azab say aagah keray , aur jo momin naik amal kertay hain unn ko khushkhabri dey kay unn ko behtareen ajar milney wala hai ,
ayahs.translation: aik seedhi seedhi kitab jo uss ney iss liye nazil ki hai kay logon  ko apni taraf say aik sakht azab say aagah keray , aur jo momin naik amal kertay hain unn ko khushkhabri dey kay unn ko behtareen ajar milney wala hai ,

ayahs.text: jiss mein woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay ,
ayahs.translation: jiss mein woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay ,

ayahs.text: aur takay unn logon  ko mutanabeh keray jo yeh kehtay hain kay Allah ney koi beta bana rakha hai .
ayahs.translation: aur takay unn logon  ko mutanabeh keray jo yeh kehtay hain kay Allah ney koi beta bana rakha hai .

ayahs.text: iss baat ka koi ilmi saboot naa khud unn kay paas hai , naa unn kay baap dadon kay paas tha . bari sangeen baat hai jo unn kay mun say nikal rahi hai . jo kuch woh keh rahey hain , woh jhoot kay siwa kuch nahi .
ayahs.translation: iss baat ka koi ilmi saboot naa khud unn kay paas hai , naa unn kay baap dadon kay paas tha . bari sangeen baat hai jo unn kay mun say nikal rahi hai . jo kuch woh keh rahey hain , woh jhoot kay siwa kuch nahi .

ayahs.text: abb ( aey payghumber ! ) agar log ( Quran ki ) iss baat per emaan naa layen , to aisa lagta hai jaisay tum afsos ker ker kay unn kay peechay apni jaan ko ghula betho gay !
ayahs.translation: abb ( aey payghumber ! ) agar log ( Quran ki ) iss baat per emaan naa layen , to aisa lagta hai jaisay tum afsos ker ker kay unn kay peechay apni jaan ko ghula betho gay !

ayahs.text: yaqeen jano kay rooaey zameen per jitni cheezen hain hum ney unhen zameen ki sajawat ka zariya iss liye banaya hai takay logon  ko aazmayen kay unn mein kon ziyada acha amal kerta hai .
ayahs.translation: yaqeen jano kay rooaey zameen per jitni cheezen hain hum ney unhen zameen ki sajawat ka zariya iss liye banaya hai takay logon  ko aazmayen kay unn mein kon ziyada acha amal kerta hai .

ayahs.text: aur yeh bhi yaqeen rakho kay rooaey zameen per jo kuch hai , aik din hum ussay aik sapaat meydan bana den gay .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh bhi yaqeen rakho kay rooaey zameen per jo kuch hai , aik din hum ussay aik sapaat meydan bana den gay .

ayahs.text: kiya tumhara yeh khayal hai kay ghaar aur raqeem walay log   humari nishaniyon mein say kuch ( ziyada ) ajeeb cheez thay ?
ayahs.translation: kiya tumhara yeh khayal hai kay ghaar aur raqeem walay log   humari nishaniyon mein say kuch ( ziyada ) ajeeb cheez thay ?

ayahs.text: yeh uss waqt ka ziker hai jab unn nojawano ney ghaar mein panah li thi , aur ( Allah taalaa say dua kertay huye ) kaha tha kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum per khaas apney paas say rehmat nazil farmaiye , aur humari iss soorat-e-haal mein humaray liye bhalai ka raasta mohaiyya farma dijiye .
ayahs.translation: yeh uss waqt ka ziker hai jab unn nojawano ney ghaar mein panah li thi , aur ( Allah taalaa say dua kertay huye ) kaha tha kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum per khaas apney paas say rehmat nazil farmaiye , aur humari iss soorat-e-haal mein humaray liye bhalai ka raasta mohaiyya farma dijiye .

ayahs.text: chunacheh hum ney unn kay kanon ko thapki dey ker kaee saal tak unn ko ghaar mein sulaye rakha .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh hum ney unn kay kanon ko thapki dey ker kaee saal tak unn ko ghaar mein sulaye rakha .

ayahs.text: phir hum ney unn ko jagaya takay yeh dekhen kay unn kay do girohon mein say kon saa giroh apney soye rehney ki mauddat ka ziyada sahih shumar kerta hai .
ayahs.translation: phir hum ney unn ko jagaya takay yeh dekhen kay unn kay do girohon mein say kon saa giroh apney soye rehney ki mauddat ka ziyada sahih shumar kerta hai .

ayahs.text: hum tumharay samney unn ka waqiaa theek theek biyan kertay hain . yeh kuch nojawan thay jo apney perwerdigar per emaan laye thay , aur hum ney unn ko hidayat mein khoob taraqqi di thi ,
ayahs.translation: hum tumharay samney unn ka waqiaa theek theek biyan kertay hain . yeh kuch nojawan thay jo apney perwerdigar per emaan laye thay , aur hum ney unn ko hidayat mein khoob taraqqi di thi ,

ayahs.text: aur hum ney unn kay dil khoob mazboot kerdiye thay .   yeh uss waqt ka ziker hai jab woh uthay , aur unhon ney kaha kay :  humara perwerdigar woh hai jo tamam aasmano aur zameen ka malik hai . hum uss kay siwa kissi ko mabood bana ker hergiz nahi pukaren gay . agar hum aisa keren gay to hum yaqeenan intehai laghw baat kahen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney unn kay dil khoob mazboot kerdiye thay .   yeh uss waqt ka ziker hai jab woh uthay , aur unhon ney kaha kay :  humara perwerdigar woh hai jo tamam aasmano aur zameen ka malik hai . hum uss kay siwa kissi ko mabood bana ker hergiz nahi pukaren gay . agar hum aisa keren gay to hum yaqeenan intehai laghw baat kahen gay .

ayahs.text: yeh humari qoam kay log hain jinhon ney uss perwerdigar ko chorr ker doosray mabood bana rakhay hain . ( agar unn ka aqeedah sahih hai to ) woh apney maboodon kay saboot mein koi wazeh daleel kiyon paish nahi kertay ? bhala uss shaks say ziyada zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay-?
ayahs.translation: yeh humari qoam kay log hain jinhon ney uss perwerdigar ko chorr ker doosray mabood bana rakhay hain . ( agar unn ka aqeedah sahih hai to ) woh apney maboodon kay saboot mein koi wazeh daleel kiyon paish nahi kertay ? bhala uss shaks say ziyada zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay-?

ayahs.text: aur ( sathiyo ! ) jab tum ney unn logon  say bhi alehdgi ikhtiyar kerli hai , aur unn say bhi jinn ki yeh Allah ko chorr ker ibadat kertay hain , to chalo abb tum iss/uss ghaar mein panah ley lo ,   tumhara perwerdigar tumharay liye apna daman-e-rehmat phela dey ga , aur tumharay kaam mein aasani kay asbaab mohaiyya farmaye ga .
ayahs.translation: aur ( sathiyo ! ) jab tum ney unn logon  say bhi alehdgi ikhtiyar kerli hai , aur unn say bhi jinn ki yeh Allah ko chorr ker ibadat kertay hain , to chalo abb tum iss/uss ghaar mein panah ley lo ,   tumhara perwerdigar tumharay liye apna daman-e-rehmat phela dey ga , aur tumharay kaam mein aasani kay asbaab mohaiyya farmaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur ( woh ghaar aisa tha kay ) tum sooraj ko nikaltay waqt dekhtay to woh unn kay ghaar say dayen taraf hatt ker nikal jata , aur jab ghuroob hota to unn say bayen taraf katra ker chala jata ,   aur woh uss ghaar kay aik kushada hissay mein ( soye huye ) thay . yeh sabb kuch Allah ki nishaniyon mein say aik nishani hai .   jissay Allah hidayat deydey , wohi hidayat pata hai , aur jissay woh gumrah kerday , uss ka tumhen hergiz koi madadgaar nahi mil sakta jo ussay raastay per laye .
ayahs.translation: aur ( woh ghaar aisa tha kay ) tum sooraj ko nikaltay waqt dekhtay to woh unn kay ghaar say dayen taraf hatt ker nikal jata , aur jab ghuroob hota to unn say bayen taraf katra ker chala jata ,   aur woh uss ghaar kay aik kushada hissay mein ( soye huye ) thay . yeh sabb kuch Allah ki nishaniyon mein say aik nishani hai .   jissay Allah hidayat deydey , wohi hidayat pata hai , aur jissay woh gumrah kerday , uss ka tumhen hergiz koi madadgaar nahi mil sakta jo ussay raastay per laye .

ayahs.text: tum unhen ( dekh ker ) yeh samajhtay kay woh jaag rahey hain , halankay woh soye huye thay .   aur hum unn ko dayen aur bayen kerwat dilwatay rehtay thay , aur unn ka kutta dehleez per apney dono haath phelaye huye ( betha ) tha . agar tum unhen jhank ker dekhtay to unn say peeth pher ker bhag kharray hotay , aur tumharay andar unn ki dehshat samaa jati .
ayahs.translation: tum unhen ( dekh ker ) yeh samajhtay kay woh jaag rahey hain , halankay woh soye huye thay .   aur hum unn ko dayen aur bayen kerwat dilwatay rehtay thay , aur unn ka kutta dehleez per apney dono haath phelaye huye ( betha ) tha . agar tum unhen jhank ker dekhtay to unn say peeth pher ker bhag kharray hotay , aur tumharay andar unn ki dehshat samaa jati .

ayahs.text: aur ( jaisay hum ney unhen sulaya tha ) ussi tarah hum ney unhen utha diya , takay woh aapas mein aik doosray say pooch gich keren . unn mein say aik kehney walay ney kaha :  tum iss halat mein kitni dair rahey hogay-?  kuch logon  ney kaha :  hum aik din ya aik din say kuch kam ( neend mein ) rahey hon gay .  doosron ney kaha :  tumhara rab hi behtar janta hai kay tum kitni dair iss halat mein rahey ho . abb apney mein say kissi ko chaandi ka yeh sikka dey ker shehar ki taraf bhejo , woh jaker dekh bhaal keray kay iss kay kon say ilaqay mein ziyada pakeezah khana ( mil sakta ) hai .   phir tumharay paas wahan say kuch khaney ko ley aaye , aur ussay chahiye kay hoshiyari say kaam keray , aur kissi ko tumhari khabar naa honey dey .
ayahs.translation: aur ( jaisay hum ney unhen sulaya tha ) ussi tarah hum ney unhen utha diya , takay woh aapas mein aik doosray say pooch gich keren . unn mein say aik kehney walay ney kaha :  tum iss halat mein kitni dair rahey hogay-?  kuch logon  ney kaha :  hum aik din ya aik din say kuch kam ( neend mein ) rahey hon gay .  doosron ney kaha :  tumhara rab hi behtar janta hai kay tum kitni dair iss halat mein rahey ho . abb apney mein say kissi ko chaandi ka yeh sikka dey ker shehar ki taraf bhejo , woh jaker dekh bhaal keray kay iss kay kon say ilaqay mein ziyada pakeezah khana ( mil sakta ) hai .   phir tumharay paas wahan say kuch khaney ko ley aaye , aur ussay chahiye kay hoshiyari say kaam keray , aur kissi ko tumhari khabar naa honey dey .

ayahs.text: kiyonkay agar inn ( shehar kay ) logon  ko tumhari khabar mil gaee to yeh tumhen pathrao ker kay halak ker daalen gay , ya tumhen apney deen mein wapis aaney kay liye majboor keren gay , aur aisa huwa to tumhen kabhi falah nahi mil sakay gi .
ayahs.translation: kiyonkay agar inn ( shehar kay ) logon  ko tumhari khabar mil gaee to yeh tumhen pathrao ker kay halak ker daalen gay , ya tumhen apney deen mein wapis aaney kay liye majboor keren gay , aur aisa huwa to tumhen kabhi falah nahi mil sakay gi .

ayahs.text: aur yun hum ney unn ki khabar logon  tak phoncha di ,   takay woh yaqeen say jaan len kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , neez yeh kay qayamat ki gharri aaney wali hai ,   uss mein koi shak nahi . ( phir woh waqt bhi aaya ) jab log unn kay baaray mein aapas mein jhagarr rahey thay ,   chunacheh kuch logon  ney kaha kay inn per aik imarat bana do . inn ka rab hi inn kay moamlay ko behtar janta hai .   ( aakhir kaar ) jinn logon  ko unn kay moamlaat per ghalba hasil tha unhon ney kaha kay :  hum to inn kay oopper aik masjid zaroor banayen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur yun hum ney unn ki khabar logon  tak phoncha di ,   takay woh yaqeen say jaan len kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , neez yeh kay qayamat ki gharri aaney wali hai ,   uss mein koi shak nahi . ( phir woh waqt bhi aaya ) jab log unn kay baaray mein aapas mein jhagarr rahey thay ,   chunacheh kuch logon  ney kaha kay inn per aik imarat bana do . inn ka rab hi inn kay moamlay ko behtar janta hai .   ( aakhir kaar ) jinn logon  ko unn kay moamlaat per ghalba hasil tha unhon ney kaha kay :  hum to inn kay oopper aik masjid zaroor banayen gay .

ayahs.text: kuch log kahen gay kay woh teen aadmi thay , aur chotha unn ka kutta tha , aur kuch kahen gay kay woh paanch thay , aur chata unn ka kutta tha . yeh sabb atkal kay teer chalaney ki baaten hain . aur kuch kahen gay kay woh saat thay , aur aathwan unn ka kutta tha , keh do kay :  mera rab hi unn ki sahih tadaad ko janta hai . thoray say logon  kay siwa kissi ko unn ka poora ilm nahi .  lehaza unn kay baaray mein sarsari guftoogo say aagay barh ker koi behas naa kero , aur naa unn kay baaray mein kissi say pooch gich kero .
ayahs.translation: kuch log kahen gay kay woh teen aadmi thay , aur chotha unn ka kutta tha , aur kuch kahen gay kay woh paanch thay , aur chata unn ka kutta tha . yeh sabb atkal kay teer chalaney ki baaten hain . aur kuch kahen gay kay woh saat thay , aur aathwan unn ka kutta tha , keh do kay :  mera rab hi unn ki sahih tadaad ko janta hai . thoray say logon  kay siwa kissi ko unn ka poora ilm nahi .  lehaza unn kay baaray mein sarsari guftoogo say aagay barh ker koi behas naa kero , aur naa unn kay baaray mein kissi say pooch gich kero .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) kissi bhi kaam kay baaray mein kabhi yeh naa kaho kay mein yeh kaam kal kerlun ga ,
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) kissi bhi kaam kay baaray mein kabhi yeh naa kaho kay mein yeh kaam kal kerlun ga ,

ayahs.text: haan ( yeh kaho kay ) Allah chahye ga to ( kerlun ga ) .   aur jab kabhi bhool jao to apney rab ko yaad kerlo , aur kaho :  mujhay umeed hai kay mera rab kissi aesi baat ki taraf meri rehnumai kerday jo hidayat mein iss say bhi ziyada qareeb ho .
ayahs.translation: haan ( yeh kaho kay ) Allah chahye ga to ( kerlun ga ) .   aur jab kabhi bhool jao to apney rab ko yaad kerlo , aur kaho :  mujhay umeed hai kay mera rab kissi aesi baat ki taraf meri rehnumai kerday jo hidayat mein iss say bhi ziyada qareeb ho .

ayahs.text: aur woh ( ashaab-e-kahaf ) apney ghaar mein teen so saal aur mazeed no saal ( sotay ) rahey .
ayahs.translation: aur woh ( ashaab-e-kahaf ) apney ghaar mein teen so saal aur mazeed no saal ( sotay ) rahey .

ayahs.text: . ( agar koi uss mein behas keray to ) keh do kay Allah hi behtar janta hai kay woh kitni mauddat ( sotay ) rahey .   aasmano aur zameen kay saray bhed ussi kay ilm mein hain . woh kitna dekhney wala , aur kitna sunney wala hai ! uss kay siwa unn ka koi rakhwala nahi hai , aur woh apni hukoomat mein kissi ko shareek nahi kerta .
ayahs.translation: . ( agar koi uss mein behas keray to ) keh do kay Allah hi behtar janta hai kay woh kitni mauddat ( sotay ) rahey .   aasmano aur zameen kay saray bhed ussi kay ilm mein hain . woh kitna dekhney wala , aur kitna sunney wala hai ! uss kay siwa unn ka koi rakhwala nahi hai , aur woh apni hukoomat mein kissi ko shareek nahi kerta .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum per tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say wahi kay zariye jo kitab bheji gaee hai , ussay parh ker suna-do . koi nahi hai jo uss ki baaton ko badal sakay , aur ussay chorr ker tumhen hergiz koi panah ki jagah nahi mil sakti .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum per tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say wahi kay zariye jo kitab bheji gaee hai , ussay parh ker suna-do . koi nahi hai jo uss ki baaton ko badal sakay , aur ussay chorr ker tumhen hergiz koi panah ki jagah nahi mil sakti .

ayahs.text: aur apney aap ko istiaqamat say unn logon  kay sath sath rakho jo subha o shaam apney rab ko iss liye pukartay hain kay woh uss ki khushnoodi kay talabgaar hain .   aur tumhari aankhen dunyawi zindagi ki khoobsurti ki talash mein aesay logon  say hatney naa payen . aur kissi aesay shaks ka kehna naa maano jiss kay dil ko hum ney apni yaad say ghafil ker rakha hai , aur jo apni khuwaishaat kay peechay parra huwa hai , aur jiss ka moamla hadd say guzar chuka hai .
ayahs.translation: aur apney aap ko istiaqamat say unn logon  kay sath sath rakho jo subha o shaam apney rab ko iss liye pukartay hain kay woh uss ki khushnoodi kay talabgaar hain .   aur tumhari aankhen dunyawi zindagi ki khoobsurti ki talash mein aesay logon  say hatney naa payen . aur kissi aesay shaks ka kehna naa maano jiss kay dil ko hum ney apni yaad say ghafil ker rakha hai , aur jo apni khuwaishaat kay peechay parra huwa hai , aur jiss ka moamla hadd say guzar chuka hai .

ayahs.text: aur keh do kay :  haq to tumharay rab ki taraf say aa-chuka hai . abb jo chahye , emaan ley aaye , aur jo chahye kufr ikhtiyar keray .    hum ney beyshak ( aesay ) zalimon kay liye aag tayyar ker rakhi hai jiss ki qanaten unn ko gheray mein ley len gi , aur agar woh fariyad keren gay to unn ki fariyad ka jawab aesay paani say diya jaye ga jo tel ki talchat jaisa hoga , ( aur ) chehron ko bhoon ker rakh dey ga . kaisa bad-tareen paani , aur kaisi buri aaram gaah !
ayahs.translation: aur keh do kay :  haq to tumharay rab ki taraf say aa-chuka hai . abb jo chahye , emaan ley aaye , aur jo chahye kufr ikhtiyar keray .    hum ney beyshak ( aesay ) zalimon kay liye aag tayyar ker rakhi hai jiss ki qanaten unn ko gheray mein ley len gi , aur agar woh fariyad keren gay to unn ki fariyad ka jawab aesay paani say diya jaye ga jo tel ki talchat jaisa hoga , ( aur ) chehron ko bhoon ker rakh dey ga . kaisa bad-tareen paani , aur kaisi buri aaram gaah !

ayahs.text: albatta jo log emaan laye , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye , to yaqeenan hum aesay logon  kay ajar ko zaya nahi kertay jo achi tarah amal keren .
ayahs.translation: albatta jo log emaan laye , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye , to yaqeenan hum aesay logon  kay ajar ko zaya nahi kertay jo achi tarah amal keren .

ayahs.text: yeh woh log hain jinn kay liye hamesha rehney walay baaghaat hain , unn kay neechay say nehren behti hon gi . unn ko wahan soney kay kangganon say muzayyan kiya jaye ga , woh oonchi musnadon per takiya lagaye huye bareek aur dabeez resham kay sabz kapray pehnay hon gay . kitna behtareen ajar , aur kaisi haseen aaram gaah !
ayahs.translation: yeh woh log hain jinn kay liye hamesha rehney walay baaghaat hain , unn kay neechay say nehren behti hon gi . unn ko wahan soney kay kangganon say muzayyan kiya jaye ga , woh oonchi musnadon per takiya lagaye huye bareek aur dabeez resham kay sabz kapray pehnay hon gay . kitna behtareen ajar , aur kaisi haseen aaram gaah !

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn logon  kay samney unn do aadmiyon ki misal paish kero .   jinn mein say aik ko hum ney angooron kay do baagh dey rakhay thay , aur unn ko khujoor kay darakhton say ghera huwa tha , aur unn dono baaghon kay darmiyan kheti lagai hoi thi .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn logon  kay samney unn do aadmiyon ki misal paish kero .   jinn mein say aik ko hum ney angooron kay do baagh dey rakhay thay , aur unn ko khujoor kay darakhton say ghera huwa tha , aur unn dono baaghon kay darmiyan kheti lagai hoi thi .

ayahs.text: dono baagh poora poora phal detay thay , aur koi baagh phal denay mein koi kami nahi chorta tha , aur unn dono kay darmiyan hum ney aik nehar jari kerdi thi ,
ayahs.translation: dono baagh poora poora phal detay thay , aur koi baagh phal denay mein koi kami nahi chorta tha , aur unn dono kay darmiyan hum ney aik nehar jari kerdi thi ,

ayahs.text: aur uss shaks ko khoob dolat hasil hoi to woh apney sathi say baaten kertay huye kehney laga kay :  mera maal bhi tum say ziyada hai , aur mera jutha bhi tum say ziyada mazboot hai .
ayahs.translation: aur uss shaks ko khoob dolat hasil hoi to woh apney sathi say baaten kertay huye kehney laga kay :  mera maal bhi tum say ziyada hai , aur mera jutha bhi tum say ziyada mazboot hai .

ayahs.text: aur woh apni jaan per sitam dahata huwa apney baagh mein dakhil huwa . kehney laga :  mein nahi samajhta kay yeh baagh kabhi bhi tabah hoga ,
ayahs.translation: aur woh apni jaan per sitam dahata huwa apney baagh mein dakhil huwa . kehney laga :  mein nahi samajhta kay yeh baagh kabhi bhi tabah hoga ,

ayahs.text: aur mera khayal yeh hai kay qayamat kabhi nahi aaye gi . aur agar kabhi mujhay apney rab kay paas wapis bheja bhi gaya , tab bhi mujhay yaqeen hai kay mujhay iss say bhi achi jagah milay gi .
ayahs.translation: aur mera khayal yeh hai kay qayamat kabhi nahi aaye gi . aur agar kabhi mujhay apney rab kay paas wapis bheja bhi gaya , tab bhi mujhay yaqeen hai kay mujhay iss say bhi achi jagah milay gi .

ayahs.text: uss kay sathi ney uss say baaten kertay huye kaha :  kiya tum uss zaat kay sath kufr ka moamla ker rahey ho jiss ney tumhen mitti say , aur phir nutfay say peda kiya , phir tumhen aik bhala changa insan bana diya-?
ayahs.translation: uss kay sathi ney uss say baaten kertay huye kaha :  kiya tum uss zaat kay sath kufr ka moamla ker rahey ho jiss ney tumhen mitti say , aur phir nutfay say peda kiya , phir tumhen aik bhala changa insan bana diya-?

ayahs.text: jahan tak mera talluq hai , mein to yeh aqeedah rakhta hun kay Allah mera perwerdigar hai , aur mein apney perwerdigar kay sath kissi ko shareek nahi manta .
ayahs.translation: jahan tak mera talluq hai , mein to yeh aqeedah rakhta hun kay Allah mera perwerdigar hai , aur mein apney perwerdigar kay sath kissi ko shareek nahi manta .

ayahs.text: aur jab tum apney baagh mein dakhil horahey thay , uss waqt tum ney yeh kiyon nahi kaha kay MashaAllah la-quoowat illa Billah ! ( jo Allah chahta hai , wohi hota hai , Allah ki tofiq kay baghair kissi mein koi taqat nahi ) . agar tumhen yeh nazar aaraha hai kay meri dolat aur aulad tum say kam hai ,
ayahs.translation: aur jab tum apney baagh mein dakhil horahey thay , uss waqt tum ney yeh kiyon nahi kaha kay MashaAllah la-quoowat illa Billah ! ( jo Allah chahta hai , wohi hota hai , Allah ki tofiq kay baghair kissi mein koi taqat nahi ) . agar tumhen yeh nazar aaraha hai kay meri dolat aur aulad tum say kam hai ,

ayahs.text: to meray rab say kuch baeed nahi hai kay woh mujhay tumharay baagh say behtar cheez ata farmadey , aur tumharay iss baagh per koi aasmani aafat bhej dey , jiss say woh chikney meydan mein tabdeel ho ker reh jaye .
ayahs.translation: to meray rab say kuch baeed nahi hai kay woh mujhay tumharay baagh say behtar cheez ata farmadey , aur tumharay iss baagh per koi aasmani aafat bhej dey , jiss say woh chikney meydan mein tabdeel ho ker reh jaye .

ayahs.text: ya uss ka paani zameen mein utar jaye , phir tum ussay talash bhi naa ker-sako-? .
ayahs.translation: ya uss ka paani zameen mein utar jaye , phir tum ussay talash bhi naa ker-sako-? .

ayahs.text: aur ( phir huwa yeh kay ) uss ki sari dolat azab kay gheray mein aagae , aur subha hoi to iss halat mein kay uss ney baagh per jo kuch kharch kiya tha , woh uss per haath malta reh gaya , jabkay uss ka baagh apni tattiyon per gira parra tha , aur woh keh raha tha :  kaash ! mein ney apney rab kay sath kissi ko shareek naa maana hota .
ayahs.translation: aur ( phir huwa yeh kay ) uss ki sari dolat azab kay gheray mein aagae , aur subha hoi to iss halat mein kay uss ney baagh per jo kuch kharch kiya tha , woh uss per haath malta reh gaya , jabkay uss ka baagh apni tattiyon per gira parra tha , aur woh keh raha tha :  kaash ! mein ney apney rab kay sath kissi ko shareek naa maana hota .

ayahs.text: aur ussay koi aisa jutha moyassar naa aaya jo Allah ko chorr ker uss ki madad kerta , aur naa woh khud iss qabil tha kay apna difaa ker-sakay .
ayahs.translation: aur ussay koi aisa jutha moyassar naa aaya jo Allah ko chorr ker uss ki madad kerta , aur naa woh khud iss qabil tha kay apna difaa ker-sakay .

ayahs.text: aesay moaqa per ( aadmi ko pata chalta hai kay ) madad ka sara ikhtiyar sachay Allah ko hasil hai . wohi hai jo behtar sawab deta aur behtar anjam dikhata hai .
ayahs.translation: aesay moaqa per ( aadmi ko pata chalta hai kay ) madad ka sara ikhtiyar sachay Allah ko hasil hai . wohi hai jo behtar sawab deta aur behtar anjam dikhata hai .

ayahs.text: aur inn logon  say dunyawi zindagi ki yeh misal bhi biyan kerdo kay woh aesi hai jaisay hum ney aasman say paani barsaya , to uss say zameen ka sabza khoob ghana hogaya , phir woh aisa reza reza huwa kay ussay hawayen urra ley jati hain .   aur Allah her cheez per mukammal qudrat rakhta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur inn logon  say dunyawi zindagi ki yeh misal bhi biyan kerdo kay woh aesi hai jaisay hum ney aasman say paani barsaya , to uss say zameen ka sabza khoob ghana hogaya , phir woh aisa reza reza huwa kay ussay hawayen urra ley jati hain .   aur Allah her cheez per mukammal qudrat rakhta hai .

ayahs.text: maal aur aulad dunyawi zindagi ki zeenat hain , aur jo naikiyan payedaar rehney wali hain , woh tumharay rab kay nazdeek sawab kay aetbar say bhi behtar hain , aur umeed wabasta kernay kay liye bhi behtar .
ayahs.translation: maal aur aulad dunyawi zindagi ki zeenat hain , aur jo naikiyan payedaar rehney wali hain , woh tumharay rab kay nazdeek sawab kay aetbar say bhi behtar hain , aur umeed wabasta kernay kay liye bhi behtar .

ayahs.text: aur ( uss din ka dhiyan rakho ) jiss din hum paharon ko chalyen gay ,   aur tum zameen ko dekho gay kay woh khuli parri hai ,   aur hum inn sabb ko gher ker ikattha kerden gay , aur inn mein say kissi aik ko bhi nahi choren gay .
ayahs.translation: aur ( uss din ka dhiyan rakho ) jiss din hum paharon ko chalyen gay ,   aur tum zameen ko dekho gay kay woh khuli parri hai ,   aur hum inn sabb ko gher ker ikattha kerden gay , aur inn mein say kissi aik ko bhi nahi choren gay .

ayahs.text: aur sabb ko tumharay rab kay samney saff baandh ker paish kiya jaye ga . aakhir tum humaray paas ussi tarah aagaye jiss tarah hum ney tumhen pehli baar peda kiya tha . iss kay bar-aks tumhara dawa yeh tha kay hum tumharay liye ( yeh ) muqarrar waqt kabhi nahi layen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur sabb ko tumharay rab kay samney saff baandh ker paish kiya jaye ga . aakhir tum humaray paas ussi tarah aagaye jiss tarah hum ney tumhen pehli baar peda kiya tha . iss kay bar-aks tumhara dawa yeh tha kay hum tumharay liye ( yeh ) muqarrar waqt kabhi nahi layen gay .

ayahs.text: aur ( aemal ki ) kitab samney rakh di jaye gi , chunacheh tum mujrimon ko dekho gay kay woh uss kay mandrajaat say khof zada hain , aur keh rahey hain kay :  haaye humari barbadi ! yeh kaisi kitab hai jiss ney humara koi chota bara amal aisa nahi chorra jiss ka poora ehata naa kerliya ho .  aur woh apna sara kiya dhara apney samney mojood payen gay . aur tumhara perwerdigar kissi per koi zulm nahi keray ga .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aemal ki ) kitab samney rakh di jaye gi , chunacheh tum mujrimon ko dekho gay kay woh uss kay mandrajaat say khof zada hain , aur keh rahey hain kay :  haaye humari barbadi ! yeh kaisi kitab hai jiss ney humara koi chota bara amal aisa nahi chorra jiss ka poora ehata naa kerliya ho .  aur woh apna sara kiya dhara apney samney mojood payen gay . aur tumhara perwerdigar kissi per koi zulm nahi keray ga .

ayahs.text: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab hum ney farishton say kaha tha kay :  Adam kay aagay sajda kero .  chunacheh sabb ney sajda kiya , siwaye iblees kay .   woh jinnaat mein say tha , chunacheh uss ney apney rab kay hukum ki nafarmani ki . kiya phir bhi tum meray bajaye ussay aur uss ki zurriyat ko apna rakhwala banatay ho , halankay woh sabb tumharay dushman hain-? ( Allah taalaa ka ) kitna bura mutabadil hai jo zalimon ko mila hai !
ayahs.translation: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab hum ney farishton say kaha tha kay :  Adam kay aagay sajda kero .  chunacheh sabb ney sajda kiya , siwaye iblees kay .   woh jinnaat mein say tha , chunacheh uss ney apney rab kay hukum ki nafarmani ki . kiya phir bhi tum meray bajaye ussay aur uss ki zurriyat ko apna rakhwala banatay ho , halankay woh sabb tumharay dushman hain-? ( Allah taalaa ka ) kitna bura mutabadil hai jo zalimon ko mila hai !

ayahs.text: mein ney naa aasmano aur zameen ki takhleeq kay waqt unn ko hazir kiya tha , naa khud unn ko peda kertay waqt ,   aur mein aisa nahi hun kay gumrah kernay walon ko dast o bazoo banaon .
ayahs.translation: mein ney naa aasmano aur zameen ki takhleeq kay waqt unn ko hazir kiya tha , naa khud unn ko peda kertay waqt ,   aur mein aisa nahi hun kay gumrah kernay walon ko dast o bazoo banaon .

ayahs.text: aur uss din ka dhiyan kero jab Allah ( inn mushrikon say ) kahey ga kay :  zara pukaro unn ko jinhen tum ney meri khudai mein shareek samajh rakha tha !  chunacheh woh pukaren gay , lekin woh unn ko koi jawab nahi den gay , aur hum unn kay darmiyan aik mohlik aarr haeel kerden gay .
ayahs.translation: aur uss din ka dhiyan kero jab Allah ( inn mushrikon say ) kahey ga kay :  zara pukaro unn ko jinhen tum ney meri khudai mein shareek samajh rakha tha !  chunacheh woh pukaren gay , lekin woh unn ko koi jawab nahi den gay , aur hum unn kay darmiyan aik mohlik aarr haeel kerden gay .

ayahs.text: aur mujrim log aag ko dekhen gay to samajh jayen gay kay enhen issi mein girna hai , aur iss say bach nikalney ka koi raasta nahi payen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur mujrim log aag ko dekhen gay to samajh jayen gay kay enhen issi mein girna hai , aur iss say bach nikalney ka koi raasta nahi payen gay .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney logon  kay faeeday kay liye iss Quran mein tarah tarah say her qisam kay mazameen biyan kiye hain , aur insan hai kay jhagrra kernay mein her cheez say barh gaya hai .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney logon  kay faeeday kay liye iss Quran mein tarah tarah say her qisam kay mazameen biyan kiye hain , aur insan hai kay jhagrra kernay mein her cheez say barh gaya hai .

ayahs.text: aur jab logon  kay paas hidayat aa-chuki to abb unhen emaan laney aur apney rab say moaafi maangney say iss ( mutalbay ) kay siwa koi aur cheez nahi rok rahi kay unn kay sath bhi pichlay logon  jaisay waqiyaat paish aajayen , ya azab unn kay bilkul samney aa-khara ho .
ayahs.translation: aur jab logon  kay paas hidayat aa-chuki to abb unhen emaan laney aur apney rab say moaafi maangney say iss ( mutalbay ) kay siwa koi aur cheez nahi rok rahi kay unn kay sath bhi pichlay logon  jaisay waqiyaat paish aajayen , ya azab unn kay bilkul samney aa-khara ho .

ayahs.text: aur hum payghumberon ko sirf iss liye bhejtay hain kay woh ( mominon ko ) khushkhabri den , aur ( kafiron ko azab say ) mutanabeh keren . aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh batil ka sahara ley ker jhagrra kertay hain , takay uss kay zariye haq ko dagmaga den , aur unhon ney meri aayaton ko aur unhen jo tanbeeh ki gaee thi uss ko mazaq bana rakha hai .
ayahs.translation: aur hum payghumberon ko sirf iss liye bhejtay hain kay woh ( mominon ko ) khushkhabri den , aur ( kafiron ko azab say ) mutanabeh keren . aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh batil ka sahara ley ker jhagrra kertay hain , takay uss kay zariye haq ko dagmaga den , aur unhon ney meri aayaton ko aur unhen jo tanbeeh ki gaee thi uss ko mazaq bana rakha hai .

ayahs.text: aur uss shaks say barh ker zalim kon hoga jissay uss kay rab ki aayaton kay hawalay say naseehat ki jaye , to woh unn say mun morr ley , aur apney haathon kay kartoot ko bhula bethay-? haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney ( unn logon  kay kartoot ki wajeh say ) unn kay dilon per ghilaf charha diye hain jinn ki wajeh say woh uss ( Quran ) ko nahi samajhtay , aur unn kay kanon mein daat laga di hai . aur agar tum unhen hidayat ki taraf bulao , tab bhi woh sahih raastay per hergiz nahi ayen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur uss shaks say barh ker zalim kon hoga jissay uss kay rab ki aayaton kay hawalay say naseehat ki jaye , to woh unn say mun morr ley , aur apney haathon kay kartoot ko bhula bethay-? haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney ( unn logon  kay kartoot ki wajeh say ) unn kay dilon per ghilaf charha diye hain jinn ki wajeh say woh uss ( Quran ) ko nahi samajhtay , aur unn kay kanon mein daat laga di hai . aur agar tum unhen hidayat ki taraf bulao , tab bhi woh sahih raastay per hergiz nahi ayen gay .

ayahs.text: aur tumhara perwerdigar boht bakhshney wala , bara rehmat wala hai . jo kamai enhon ney ki hai , agar woh uss ki wajeh say unhen pakarney per aata to unn ko jald hi azab dey deta , lekin unn kay liye aik waqt muqarrar hai , jiss say bachnay kay liye unhen koi panah gaah nahi milay gi .
ayahs.translation: aur tumhara perwerdigar boht bakhshney wala , bara rehmat wala hai . jo kamai enhon ney ki hai , agar woh uss ki wajeh say unhen pakarney per aata to unn ko jald hi azab dey deta , lekin unn kay liye aik waqt muqarrar hai , jiss say bachnay kay liye unhen koi panah gaah nahi milay gi .

ayahs.text: yeh sari bastiyan ( tumharay samney ) hain , jab enhon ney zulm ki rawish apnai to hum ney inn ko halak ker daala , aur inn ki halakat kay liye ( bhi ) hum ney aik waqt muqarrar kiya huwa tha .
ayahs.translation: yeh sari bastiyan ( tumharay samney ) hain , jab enhon ney zulm ki rawish apnai to hum ney inn ko halak ker daala , aur inn ki halakat kay liye ( bhi ) hum ney aik waqt muqarrar kiya huwa tha .

ayahs.text: aur ( uss waqt ka ziker suno ) jab musa ney apney nojawan ( shagrid ) say kaha tha kay :  mein uss waqt tak apna safar jari rakhun ga jab tak do samandaron kay sangham per naa phonch jaon , werna barson chalta rahun ga .
ayahs.translation: aur ( uss waqt ka ziker suno ) jab musa ney apney nojawan ( shagrid ) say kaha tha kay :  mein uss waqt tak apna safar jari rakhun ga jab tak do samandaron kay sangham per naa phonch jaon , werna barson chalta rahun ga .

ayahs.text: chunacheh jab woh unn kay sangham per phonchay to dono apni machli ko bhool gaye , aur uss ney samandar mein aik surang ki tarah ka raasta bana liya .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh jab woh unn kay sangham per phonchay to dono apni machli ko bhool gaye , aur uss ney samandar mein aik surang ki tarah ka raasta bana liya .

ayahs.text: phir jab dono aagay nikal gaye , to musa ney apney nojawan say kaha kay :  humara nashta lao , sachi baat yeh hai kay hamen iss safar mein bari thakawat laahaq hogaee hai .
ayahs.translation: phir jab dono aagay nikal gaye , to musa ney apney nojawan say kaha kay :  humara nashta lao , sachi baat yeh hai kay hamen iss safar mein bari thakawat laahaq hogaee hai .

ayahs.text: uss ney kaha :  bhala bataiye ! ( ajeeb qissa hogaya ) jab hum uss chatan per thehray thay to mein machli ( ka aap say ziker kerna ) bhool gaya . aur shetan kay siwa koi nahi hai jiss ney mujh say uss ka tazkarah kerna bhulaya ho . aur uss ( machli ) ney to baray ajeeb tareeqay per darya mein apni raah ley li thi .
ayahs.translation: uss ney kaha :  bhala bataiye ! ( ajeeb qissa hogaya ) jab hum uss chatan per thehray thay to mein machli ( ka aap say ziker kerna ) bhool gaya . aur shetan kay siwa koi nahi hai jiss ney mujh say uss ka tazkarah kerna bhulaya ho . aur uss ( machli ) ney to baray ajeeb tareeqay per darya mein apni raah ley li thi .

ayahs.text: musa ney kaha :  ussi/issi baat ki to hamen talash thi .    chunacheh dono apney qadmon kay nishan dekhtay huye wapis lotay .
ayahs.translation: musa ney kaha :  ussi/issi baat ki to hamen talash thi .    chunacheh dono apney qadmon kay nishan dekhtay huye wapis lotay .

ayahs.text: tab unhen humaray bandon mein say aik banda mila jiss ko hum ney apni khusoosi rehmat say nawaza tha , aur khaas apni taraf say aik ilm sikhaya tha .
ayahs.translation: tab unhen humaray bandon mein say aik banda mila jiss ko hum ney apni khusoosi rehmat say nawaza tha , aur khaas apni taraf say aik ilm sikhaya tha .

ayahs.text: musa ney unn say kaha :  kiya mein aap kay sath iss gharz say reh sakta hun kay aap ko bhalai ka jo ilm ata huwa hai , uss ka kuch hissa mujhay bhi sikha den-?
ayahs.translation: musa ney unn say kaha :  kiya mein aap kay sath iss gharz say reh sakta hun kay aap ko bhalai ka jo ilm ata huwa hai , uss ka kuch hissa mujhay bhi sikha den-?

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha :  mujhay yaqeen hai kay aap meray sath rehney per sabar nahi ker-saken gay .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha :  mujhay yaqeen hai kay aap meray sath rehney per sabar nahi ker-saken gay .

ayahs.text: aur jinn baaton ki aap ko poori poori waqfiyat nahi hai , unn per aap sabar ker bhi kaisay saktay hain-?
ayahs.translation: aur jinn baaton ki aap ko poori poori waqfiyat nahi hai , unn per aap sabar ker bhi kaisay saktay hain-?

ayahs.text: musa ney kaha :  inn sha Allah aap mujhay sabir payen gay , aur mein aap kay kissi hukum ki khilaf warzi nahi kerun ga .
ayahs.translation: musa ney kaha :  inn sha Allah aap mujhay sabir payen gay , aur mein aap kay kissi hukum ki khilaf warzi nahi kerun ga .

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha :  acha ! agar aap meray sath chaltay hain to jab tak mein khud hi aap say kissi baat ka tazkarah shuroo naa kerun , aap mujh say kissi bhi cheez kay baaray mein sawal naa keren .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha :  acha ! agar aap meray sath chaltay hain to jab tak mein khud hi aap say kissi baat ka tazkarah shuroo naa kerun , aap mujh say kissi bhi cheez kay baaray mein sawal naa keren .

ayahs.text: chunacheh dono rawana hogaye , yahan tak kay jab dono aik kashti mein sawar huye to unn sahab ney kashti mein ched kerdiya .   musa bolay :  aray kiya aap ney iss mein ched kerdiya takay saray kashti walon ko dubo daalen-? yeh to aap ney bara khofnak kaam kiya .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh dono rawana hogaye , yahan tak kay jab dono aik kashti mein sawar huye to unn sahab ney kashti mein ched kerdiya .   musa bolay :  aray kiya aap ney iss mein ched kerdiya takay saray kashti walon ko dubo daalen-? yeh to aap ney bara khofnak kaam kiya .

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha :  kiya mein ney kaha nahi tha kay aap meray sath reh ker sabar nahi ker-saken gay-?
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha :  kiya mein ney kaha nahi tha kay aap meray sath reh ker sabar nahi ker-saken gay-?

ayahs.text: musa ney kaha :  mujh say jo bhool hogaee , uss per meri girift naa kijiye , aur meray kaam ko ziyada mushkil naa banaiye .
ayahs.translation: musa ney kaha :  mujh say jo bhool hogaee , uss per meri girift naa kijiye , aur meray kaam ko ziyada mushkil naa banaiye .

ayahs.text: woh dono phir rawana hogaye , yahan tak kay unn ki mulaqat aik larkay say hoi to unn sahab ney ussay qatal ker daala .   musa bol uthay :  aray kiya aap ney aik pakeezah jaan ko halak kerdiya , jabkay uss ney kissi ki jaan nahi li thi jiss ka badla uss say liya jaye-? yeh to aap ney boht hi bura kaam kiya !
ayahs.translation: woh dono phir rawana hogaye , yahan tak kay unn ki mulaqat aik larkay say hoi to unn sahab ney ussay qatal ker daala .   musa bol uthay :  aray kiya aap ney aik pakeezah jaan ko halak kerdiya , jabkay uss ney kissi ki jaan nahi li thi jiss ka badla uss say liya jaye-? yeh to aap ney boht hi bura kaam kiya !

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha :  kiya mein ney aap say nahi kaha tha kay aap meray sath rehney per sabar nahi ker-saken gay-?
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha :  kiya mein ney aap say nahi kaha tha kay aap meray sath rehney per sabar nahi ker-saken gay-?

ayahs.text: musa bolay :  agar abb mein aap say koi baat poochun toh aap mujhay apney sath naa rakhiye . yaqeenan aap meri taraf say uzr ki hadd ko phonch gaye hain .
ayahs.translation: musa bolay :  agar abb mein aap say koi baat poochun toh aap mujhay apney sath naa rakhiye . yaqeenan aap meri taraf say uzr ki hadd ko phonch gaye hain .

ayahs.text: chunacheh woh dono phir rawana hogaye , yahan tak kay jab aik basti walon kay paas phonchay toh uss kay bashindon say khana maanga toh unn logon  ney unn ki mehmani kernay say inkar kerdiya . phir unhen wahan aik deewar mili jo gira hi chahti thi , unn sahab ney ussay kharra kerdiya . musa ney kaha :  agar aap chahtay toh iss kaam per kuch ujrat ley letay .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh woh dono phir rawana hogaye , yahan tak kay jab aik basti walon kay paas phonchay toh uss kay bashindon say khana maanga toh unn logon  ney unn ki mehmani kernay say inkar kerdiya . phir unhen wahan aik deewar mili jo gira hi chahti thi , unn sahab ney ussay kharra kerdiya . musa ney kaha :  agar aap chahtay toh iss kaam per kuch ujrat ley letay .

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha :  lijiye meray aur aap kay darmiyan judai ka waqt aagaya . abb mein aap ko unn baaton ka maqsad bataye deta hun jinn per aap say sabar nahi hosaka .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha :  lijiye meray aur aap kay darmiyan judai ka waqt aagaya . abb mein aap ko unn baaton ka maqsad bataye deta hun jinn per aap say sabar nahi hosaka .

ayahs.text: jahan tak kashti ka talluq hai woh kuch gharib aadmiyon ki thi jo darya mein mazdoori kertay thay , mein ney chaha kay uss mein koi aeb peda kerdun , ( kiyonkay ) unn kay aagay aik badshah tha jo her ( achi ) kashti ko zabardasti cheen ker rakh liya kerta tha .
ayahs.translation: jahan tak kashti ka talluq hai woh kuch gharib aadmiyon ki thi jo darya mein mazdoori kertay thay , mein ney chaha kay uss mein koi aeb peda kerdun , ( kiyonkay ) unn kay aagay aik badshah tha jo her ( achi ) kashti ko zabardasti cheen ker rakh liya kerta tha .

ayahs.text: aur larkay ka moamla yeh tha kay uss kay maa baap momin thay , aur hamen iss baat ka andesha tha kay yeh larka unn dono ko sarkashi aur kufr mein naa phansa dey .
ayahs.translation: aur larkay ka moamla yeh tha kay uss kay maa baap momin thay , aur hamen iss baat ka andesha tha kay yeh larka unn dono ko sarkashi aur kufr mein naa phansa dey .

ayahs.text: chunacheh hum ney yeh chaha kay unn ka perwerdigar unhen uss larkay kay badlay aesi aulad dey jo pakeezgi mein bhi uss say behtar ho , aur hussn-e-sulook mein bhi uss say barhi hoi ho .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh hum ney yeh chaha kay unn ka perwerdigar unhen uss larkay kay badlay aesi aulad dey jo pakeezgi mein bhi uss say behtar ho , aur hussn-e-sulook mein bhi uss say barhi hoi ho .

ayahs.text: rahi yeh deewar , toh woh iss shehar mein rehney walay do yateem larkon ki thi , aur uss kay neechay unn ka aik khazana garra huwa tha , aur unn dono ka baap aik naik aadmi tha . iss liye aap kay perwerdigar ney yeh chaha kay yeh dono larkay apni jawani ki umar ko phonchen , aur apna khazana nikal len . yeh sabb kuch aap kay rab ki rehmat ki bana per huwa hai , aur mein ney koi kaam apni raye say nahi kiya . yeh tha maqsad unn baaton ka jinn per aap say sabar nahi hosaka .
ayahs.translation: rahi yeh deewar , toh woh iss shehar mein rehney walay do yateem larkon ki thi , aur uss kay neechay unn ka aik khazana garra huwa tha , aur unn dono ka baap aik naik aadmi tha . iss liye aap kay perwerdigar ney yeh chaha kay yeh dono larkay apni jawani ki umar ko phonchen , aur apna khazana nikal len . yeh sabb kuch aap kay rab ki rehmat ki bana per huwa hai , aur mein ney koi kaam apni raye say nahi kiya . yeh tha maqsad unn baaton ka jinn per aap say sabar nahi hosaka .

ayahs.text: aur yeh log tum say zulqarnain kay baaray mein poochtay hain .   keh do kay :  mein unn ka kuch haal tumhen parh ker sunata hun .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh log tum say zulqarnain kay baaray mein poochtay hain .   keh do kay :  mein unn ka kuch haal tumhen parh ker sunata hun .

ayahs.text: waqiaa yeh hai kay hum ney unn ko zameen mein iqtidar bakhsha tha , aur unhen her kaam kay wasaeel ata kiye thay .
ayahs.translation: waqiaa yeh hai kay hum ney unn ko zameen mein iqtidar bakhsha tha , aur unhen her kaam kay wasaeel ata kiye thay .

ayahs.text: jiss kay nateejay mein woh aik raastay kay peechay chal parray .
ayahs.translation: jiss kay nateejay mein woh aik raastay kay peechay chal parray .

ayahs.text: yahan tak kay jab woh sooraj kay doobney ki jagah phonchay , toh unhen dikhai diya kay woh aik daldal jaisay ( siyah ) chashmay mein doob raha hai ,   aur wahan unhen aik qoam mili . hum ney ( unn say ) kaha :  aey zulqarnain ! ( tumharay paas do raastay hain : ) ya toh inn logon  ko saza do , ya phir inn kay moamlay mein acha ravaiyya ikhtiyar kero .
ayahs.translation: yahan tak kay jab woh sooraj kay doobney ki jagah phonchay , toh unhen dikhai diya kay woh aik daldal jaisay ( siyah ) chashmay mein doob raha hai ,   aur wahan unhen aik qoam mili . hum ney ( unn say ) kaha :  aey zulqarnain ! ( tumharay paas do raastay hain : ) ya toh inn logon  ko saza do , ya phir inn kay moamlay mein acha ravaiyya ikhtiyar kero .

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha :  inn mein say jo koi zulm ka raasta ikhtiyar keray ga , ussay toh hum saza den gay , phir ussay apney rab kay paas phoncha diya jaye ga , aur woh ussay sakht azab dey ga .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha :  inn mein say jo koi zulm ka raasta ikhtiyar keray ga , ussay toh hum saza den gay , phir ussay apney rab kay paas phoncha diya jaye ga , aur woh ussay sakht azab dey ga .

ayahs.text: albatta jo koi emaan laye ga , aur naik amal keray ga , to woh badlay kay tor per achay anjam ka mustahiq hoga , aur hum bhi uss ko apna hukum detay waqt aasani ki baat kahen gay .
ayahs.translation: albatta jo koi emaan laye ga , aur naik amal keray ga , to woh badlay kay tor per achay anjam ka mustahiq hoga , aur hum bhi uss ko apna hukum detay waqt aasani ki baat kahen gay .

ayahs.text: iss kay baad woh aik aur raastay kay peechay chal parray .
ayahs.translation: iss kay baad woh aik aur raastay kay peechay chal parray .

ayahs.text: yahan tak kay jab woh sooraj kay tuloo hone ki jagah phonchay to unhon ney dekha kay woh aik aesi qoam per tuloo horaha hai jissay hum ney uss ( ki dhoop ) say bachnay kay liye koi oat mohaiyya nahi ki thi .
ayahs.translation: yahan tak kay jab woh sooraj kay tuloo hone ki jagah phonchay to unhon ney dekha kay woh aik aesi qoam per tuloo horaha hai jissay hum ney uss ( ki dhoop ) say bachnay kay liye koi oat mohaiyya nahi ki thi .

ayahs.text: waqiaa issi tarah huwa , aur zulqarnain kay paas jo kuch ( saz-o-saman ) tha , hamen uss ki poori poori khabar thi .
ayahs.translation: waqiaa issi tarah huwa , aur zulqarnain kay paas jo kuch ( saz-o-saman ) tha , hamen uss ki poori poori khabar thi .

ayahs.text: iss kay baad woh aik aur raastay kay peechay chal parray .
ayahs.translation: iss kay baad woh aik aur raastay kay peechay chal parray .

ayahs.text: yahan tak kay jab woh do paharon kay darmiyan phonchay to unhen unn paharon say pehlay kuch log milay jinn kay baaray mein aisa lagta tha kay woh koi baat nahi samajhtay .
ayahs.translation: yahan tak kay jab woh do paharon kay darmiyan phonchay to unhen unn paharon say pehlay kuch log milay jinn kay baaray mein aisa lagta tha kay woh koi baat nahi samajhtay .

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha :  aey zulqarnain ! yajooj aur majooj iss zameen mein fasad phelaney walay log hain . to kiya hum aap ko kuch maal ki paishkash ker-saktay hain , jiss kay badlay aap humaray aur inn kay darmiyan koi deewar bana den-?
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha :  aey zulqarnain ! yajooj aur majooj iss zameen mein fasad phelaney walay log hain . to kiya hum aap ko kuch maal ki paishkash ker-saktay hain , jiss kay badlay aap humaray aur inn kay darmiyan koi deewar bana den-?

ayahs.text: zulqarnain ney kaha :  Allah ney mujhay jo iqtidar ata farmaya hai , wohi ( meray liye ) behtar hai . lehaza tum log ( haath paon ki ) taqat say meri madad kero , to mein tumharay aur unn kay darmiyan aik mazboot deewar bana dun ga .
ayahs.translation: zulqarnain ney kaha :  Allah ney mujhay jo iqtidar ata farmaya hai , wohi ( meray liye ) behtar hai . lehaza tum log ( haath paon ki ) taqat say meri madad kero , to mein tumharay aur unn kay darmiyan aik mazboot deewar bana dun ga .

ayahs.text: mujhay lohey ki chadaren laado .  yahan tak kay jab unhon ney ( darmiyani khala ko paat ker ) dono pahari saron ko aik doosray say mila diya toh kaha kay :  abb aag dehkao    yahan tak kay jab uss ( deewar ) ko laal angara kerdiya to kaha kay :  pighla huwa tanba lao , abb mein uss per undelon ga .
ayahs.translation: mujhay lohey ki chadaren laado .  yahan tak kay jab unhon ney ( darmiyani khala ko paat ker ) dono pahari saron ko aik doosray say mila diya toh kaha kay :  abb aag dehkao    yahan tak kay jab uss ( deewar ) ko laal angara kerdiya to kaha kay :  pighla huwa tanba lao , abb mein uss per undelon ga .

ayahs.text: chunacheh ( woh deewar aesi ban gaee kay ) yajooj majooj naa uss per charrney ki taqat rakhtay thay , aur naa uss mein koi sorakh bana saktay thay .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh ( woh deewar aesi ban gaee kay ) yajooj majooj naa uss per charrney ki taqat rakhtay thay , aur naa uss mein koi sorakh bana saktay thay .

ayahs.text: zulqarnain ney kaha :  yeh meray rab ki rehmat hai ( kay uss ney aesi deewar bananey ki tofiq di ) phir meray rab ney jiss waqt ka wada kiya hai , jab woh waqt aaye ga toh woh iss ( deewar ) ko daha ker zameen kay barabar kerday ga ,   aur meray rab ka wada bilkul sacha hai .
ayahs.translation: zulqarnain ney kaha :  yeh meray rab ki rehmat hai ( kay uss ney aesi deewar bananey ki tofiq di ) phir meray rab ney jiss waqt ka wada kiya hai , jab woh waqt aaye ga toh woh iss ( deewar ) ko daha ker zameen kay barabar kerday ga ,   aur meray rab ka wada bilkul sacha hai .

ayahs.text: aur uss din hum unn ki yeh halat kerden gay kay woh mojon ki tarah aik doosray say takra rahey hon gay ,   aur soor phoonka jaye ga toh hum sabb ko aik sath jama kerlen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur uss din hum unn ki yeh halat kerden gay kay woh mojon ki tarah aik doosray say takra rahey hon gay ,   aur soor phoonka jaye ga toh hum sabb ko aik sath jama kerlen gay .

ayahs.text: aur uss din hum dozakh ko unn kafiron kay samney khuli aankhon ley ayen gay ,
ayahs.translation: aur uss din hum dozakh ko unn kafiron kay samney khuli aankhon ley ayen gay ,

ayahs.text: jinn ki aankhon per ( duniya mein ) meri naseehat ki taraf say perda parra huwa tha , aur jo sunney ki salahiyat nahi rakhtay thay .
ayahs.translation: jinn ki aankhon per ( duniya mein ) meri naseehat ki taraf say perda parra huwa tha , aur jo sunney ki salahiyat nahi rakhtay thay .

ayahs.text: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , kiya woh phir bhi yeh samajhtay hain kay mujhay chorr ker meray hi bandon ko apna rakhwala bana len gay-? yaqeen rakho kay hum ney aesay kafiron ki mehmani kay liye dozakh tayyar ker rakhi hai .
ayahs.translation: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , kiya woh phir bhi yeh samajhtay hain kay mujhay chorr ker meray hi bandon ko apna rakhwala bana len gay-? yaqeen rakho kay hum ney aesay kafiron ki mehmani kay liye dozakh tayyar ker rakhi hai .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  kiya hum tumhen batayen kay kon log hain jo apney aemal mein sabb say ziyada nakam hain-?
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  kiya hum tumhen batayen kay kon log hain jo apney aemal mein sabb say ziyada nakam hain-?

ayahs.text: yeh woh log hain kay dunyawi zindagi mein unn ki sari dorr dhoop seedhay raastay say bhatki rahi , aur woh samajhtay rahey kay woh boht acha kaam ker rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: yeh woh log hain kay dunyawi zindagi mein unn ki sari dorr dhoop seedhay raastay say bhatki rahi , aur woh samajhtay rahey kay woh boht acha kaam ker rahey hain .

ayahs.text: yeh wohi log hain jinhon ney apney malik ki aayaton ka aur uss kay samney paish honey ka inkar kiya , iss liye inn ka sara kiya dhara gharat hogaya , chunacheh qayamat kay din hum unn ka koi wazan shumar nahi keren gay .
ayahs.translation: yeh wohi log hain jinhon ney apney malik ki aayaton ka aur uss kay samney paish honey ka inkar kiya , iss liye inn ka sara kiya dhara gharat hogaya , chunacheh qayamat kay din hum unn ka koi wazan shumar nahi keren gay .

ayahs.text: yeh hai jahannum ki shakal mein unn ki saza , kiyonkay unhon ney kufr ki rawish ikhtiyar ki thi , aur meri aayaton aur meray payghumberon ka mazaq banaya tha .
ayahs.translation: yeh hai jahannum ki shakal mein unn ki saza , kiyonkay unhon ney kufr ki rawish ikhtiyar ki thi , aur meri aayaton aur meray payghumberon ka mazaq banaya tha .

ayahs.text: . ( doosri taraf ) jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ki mehmani kay liye beyshak firdous kay baagh hon gay ,
ayahs.translation: . ( doosri taraf ) jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ki mehmani kay liye beyshak firdous kay baagh hon gay ,

ayahs.text: jinn mein woh hamesha rahen gay , ( aur ) woh wahan say kahen aur jana nahi chahen gay .
ayahs.translation: jinn mein woh hamesha rahen gay , ( aur ) woh wahan say kahen aur jana nahi chahen gay .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! logon  say ) keh do kay :  agar meray rab ki baaten likhney kay liye samandar roshnai ban jaye , to meray rab ki baaten khatam nahi hon gi kay uss say pehlay samandar khatam hochuka hoga , chahye uss samandar ki kami poori kernay kay liye hum wesa hi aik aur samandar kiyon naa ley ayen .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! logon  say ) keh do kay :  agar meray rab ki baaten likhney kay liye samandar roshnai ban jaye , to meray rab ki baaten khatam nahi hon gi kay uss say pehlay samandar khatam hochuka hoga , chahye uss samandar ki kami poori kernay kay liye hum wesa hi aik aur samandar kiyon naa ley ayen .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  mein to tumhi jaisa aik insan hun , ( albatta ) mujh per yeh wahi aati hai kay tum sabb ka khuda  bus aik khuda hai . lehaza jiss kissi ko apney malik say ja-milney ki umeed ho , ussay chahiye kay woh naik amal keray , aur apney malik ki ibadat mein kissi aur ko shareek naa thehraye .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  mein to tumhi jaisa aik insan hun , ( albatta ) mujh per yeh wahi aati hai kay tum sabb ka khuda  bus aik khuda hai . lehaza jiss kissi ko apney malik say ja-milney ki umeed ho , ussay chahiye kay woh naik amal keray , aur apney malik ki ibadat mein kissi aur ko shareek naa thehraye .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: Kaaf-Haa-Yaa-Aen-Suad
verses.translation: Kaaf-Haa-Yaa-Aen-Suad

verses.text: yeh tazkarah hai uss rehmat ka jo tumharay perwerdigar ney apney banday zakriya per ki thi .
verses.translation: yeh tazkarah hai uss rehmat ka jo tumharay perwerdigar ney apney banday zakriya per ki thi .

verses.text: yeh uss waqt ki baat hai jab unhon ney apney perwerdigar ko aahista aahista aawaz say pukara tha .
verses.translation: yeh uss waqt ki baat hai jab unhon ney apney perwerdigar ko aahista aahista aawaz say pukara tha .

verses.text: unhon ney kaha tha kay :  meray perwerdigar ! meri haddiyan tak kamzor parr-gai hain , aur sar burhapay ki safedi say bharak utha hai , aur meray perwerdigar ! mein aap say dua maang ker kabhi na-murad nahi huwa .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha tha kay :  meray perwerdigar ! meri haddiyan tak kamzor parr-gai hain , aur sar burhapay ki safedi say bharak utha hai , aur meray perwerdigar ! mein aap say dua maang ker kabhi na-murad nahi huwa .

verses.text: aur mujhay apney baad apney chachazaad bhaiyon ka andesha laga huwa hai ,   aur meri biwi baanjh hai , lehaza aap khaas apney paas say mujhay aik aisa waris ata ker-dijiye
verses.translation: aur mujhay apney baad apney chachazaad bhaiyon ka andesha laga huwa hai ,   aur meri biwi baanjh hai , lehaza aap khaas apney paas say mujhay aik aisa waris ata ker-dijiye

verses.text: jo mera bhi waris ho , aur Yaqoob ( aleh-assalam ) ki aulad say bhi meeras paye .   aur ya rab ! ussay aisa banaiye jo ( khud aap ka ) pasandeeda ho .
verses.translation: jo mera bhi waris ho , aur Yaqoob ( aleh-assalam ) ki aulad say bhi meeras paye .   aur ya rab ! ussay aisa banaiye jo ( khud aap ka ) pasandeeda ho .

verses.text: . ( aawaz aai kay : )  aey zakriya ! hum tumhen aik aesay larkay ki khushkhabri detay hain jiss ka naam Yahya hoga . iss say pehlay hum ney iss kay naam ka koi aur shaks peda nahi kiya .
verses.translation: . ( aawaz aai kay : )  aey zakriya ! hum tumhen aik aesay larkay ki khushkhabri detay hain jiss ka naam Yahya hoga . iss say pehlay hum ney iss kay naam ka koi aur shaks peda nahi kiya .

verses.text: zakriya ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! meray yahan larka kiss tarah peda hoga jabkay meri biwi baanjh hai , aur mein burhapay say iss haal ko phonch gaya hun kay mera jism sookh chuka hai !
verses.translation: zakriya ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! meray yahan larka kiss tarah peda hoga jabkay meri biwi baanjh hai , aur mein burhapay say iss haal ko phonch gaya hun kay mera jism sookh chuka hai !

verses.text: kaha :  haan ! aisa hi hoga . tumharay rab ney farmaya hai kay yeh to meray liye mamooli baat hai . aur iss say pehlay mein ney tumhen peda kiya tha jab tum kuch bhi nahi thay .
verses.translation: kaha :  haan ! aisa hi hoga . tumharay rab ney farmaya hai kay yeh to meray liye mamooli baat hai . aur iss say pehlay mein ney tumhen peda kiya tha jab tum kuch bhi nahi thay .

verses.text: zakriya ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! meray liye koi nishani muqarrar farma dijiye .    farmaya :  tumhari nishani yeh hai kay tum sehat mand honey kay bawajood teen raat tak logon  say baat nahi ker-sako gay .
verses.translation: zakriya ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! meray liye koi nishani muqarrar farma dijiye .    farmaya :  tumhari nishani yeh hai kay tum sehat mand honey kay bawajood teen raat tak logon  say baat nahi ker-sako gay .

verses.text: chunacheh woh ibadat gaah say nikal ker apni qoam kay samney aaye , aur unn ko isharay say hidayat di kay tum log subha o shaam Allah ki tasbeeh kiya kero .
verses.translation: chunacheh woh ibadat gaah say nikal ker apni qoam kay samney aaye , aur unn ko isharay say hidayat di kay tum log subha o shaam Allah ki tasbeeh kiya kero .

verses.text: . ( phir jab Yahya peda ho ker baray hogaye to hum ney unn say farmaya : )  aey Yahya ! kitab ko mazbooti say thaam lo .    aur hum ney bachpan hi mein unn ko danai bhi ata kerdi thi ,
verses.translation: . ( phir jab Yahya peda ho ker baray hogaye to hum ney unn say farmaya : )  aey Yahya ! kitab ko mazbooti say thaam lo .    aur hum ney bachpan hi mein unn ko danai bhi ata kerdi thi ,

verses.text: aur khaas apney paas say naram dili aur pakeezgi bhi . aur woh baray perhezgar thay ,
verses.translation: aur khaas apney paas say naram dili aur pakeezgi bhi . aur woh baray perhezgar thay ,

verses.text: aur apney walaiden kay khidmat guzaar ! naa woh sarkash thay , naa nafarman .
verses.translation: aur apney walaiden kay khidmat guzaar ! naa woh sarkash thay , naa nafarman .

verses.text: aur ( Allah taalaa ki taraf say ) salam hai unn per uss din bhi jiss roz woh peda huye , uss din bhi jiss roz unhen moat aaye gi , aur uss din bhi jiss roz unhen zinda ker kay dobara uthaya jaye ga .
verses.translation: aur ( Allah taalaa ki taraf say ) salam hai unn per uss din bhi jiss roz woh peda huye , uss din bhi jiss roz unhen moat aaye gi , aur uss din bhi jiss roz unhen zinda ker kay dobara uthaya jaye ga .

verses.text: aur iss kitab mein maryam ka bhi tazkarah kero . uss waqt ka tazkarah jab woh apney ghar walon say alehda ho ker uss jagah chali gaeen jo mashriq ki taraf waqay thi .
verses.translation: aur iss kitab mein maryam ka bhi tazkarah kero . uss waqt ka tazkarah jab woh apney ghar walon say alehda ho ker uss jagah chali gaeen jo mashriq ki taraf waqay thi .

verses.text: phir unhon ney unn logon  kay aur apney darmiyan aik perda daal liya .   iss moaqa per hum ney unn kay paas apni rooh ( yani aik farishtay ) ko bheja jo unn kay samney aik mukammal insan ki shakal mein zahir huwa .
verses.translation: phir unhon ney unn logon  kay aur apney darmiyan aik perda daal liya .   iss moaqa per hum ney unn kay paas apni rooh ( yani aik farishtay ) ko bheja jo unn kay samney aik mukammal insan ki shakal mein zahir huwa .

verses.text: maryam ney kaha :  mein tum say khudaye rehman ki panah maangti hun . agar tum mein khuda ka khof hai ( to yahan say hatt jao )
verses.translation: maryam ney kaha :  mein tum say khudaye rehman ki panah maangti hun . agar tum mein khuda ka khof hai ( to yahan say hatt jao )

verses.text: farishtay ney kaha :  mein to tumharay rab ka bheja huwa ( farishta ) hun ( aur iss liye aaya hun ) takay tumhen aik pakeezah larka dun .
verses.translation: farishtay ney kaha :  mein to tumharay rab ka bheja huwa ( farishta ) hun ( aur iss liye aaya hun ) takay tumhen aik pakeezah larka dun .

verses.text: maryam ney kaha :  meray larka kaisay hojaye ga , jabkay mujhay kissi bashar ney chooa tak nahi hai , aur naa mein koi bad-kaar aurat hun-?
verses.translation: maryam ney kaha :  meray larka kaisay hojaye ga , jabkay mujhay kissi bashar ney chooa tak nahi hai , aur naa mein koi bad-kaar aurat hun-?

verses.text: farishtay ney kaha :  aesay hi hojaye ga . tumharay rab ney farmaya hai kay :  yeh meray liye aik mamooli baat hai . aur hum yeh kaam iss liye keren gay takay uss larkay ko logon  kay liye ( apni qudrat ki ) aik nishani banayen , aur apni taraf say rehmat ka muzahira keren .   aur yeh baat poori tarah tey hochuki hai .
verses.translation: farishtay ney kaha :  aesay hi hojaye ga . tumharay rab ney farmaya hai kay :  yeh meray liye aik mamooli baat hai . aur hum yeh kaam iss liye keren gay takay uss larkay ko logon  kay liye ( apni qudrat ki ) aik nishani banayen , aur apni taraf say rehmat ka muzahira keren .   aur yeh baat poori tarah tey hochuki hai .

verses.text: phir huwa yeh kay maryam ko uss bacchay ka hamal thehar gaya , ( aur jab wiladat ka waqt qareeb aaya ) to woh uss ko ley ker logon  say alag aik door maqam per chali gaeen .
verses.translation: phir huwa yeh kay maryam ko uss bacchay ka hamal thehar gaya , ( aur jab wiladat ka waqt qareeb aaya ) to woh uss ko ley ker logon  say alag aik door maqam per chali gaeen .

verses.text: phir zachgi kay dard ney unhen aik khujoor kay darkht kay paas phoncha diya . woh kehney lagen :  kaash kay mein iss say pehlay hi mar-gaee hoti , aur mar ker bhooli basri hojati !
verses.translation: phir zachgi kay dard ney unhen aik khujoor kay darkht kay paas phoncha diya . woh kehney lagen :  kaash kay mein iss say pehlay hi mar-gaee hoti , aur mar ker bhooli basri hojati !

verses.text: phir farishtay ney unn kay neechay aik jagah say unhen aawaz di kay :  ghum naa kero , tumharay rab ney tumharay neechay aik chashma peda kerdiya hai .
verses.translation: phir farishtay ney unn kay neechay aik jagah say unhen aawaz di kay :  ghum naa kero , tumharay rab ney tumharay neechay aik chashma peda kerdiya hai .

verses.text: aur khujoor kay taney ko apni taraf hilao , uss mein say pakki hoi taza khujooren tum per jharen gi .
verses.translation: aur khujoor kay taney ko apni taraf hilao , uss mein say pakki hoi taza khujooren tum per jharen gi .

verses.text: abb khao , aur piyo , aur aankhen thandi rakho .   aur agar logon  mein say kissi ko aata dekho to ( isharay say ) keh dena kay :  aaj mein ney khudaye rehman kay liye aik rozay ki mannat maani hai , iss liye mein kissi bhi insan say baat nahi kerun gi .
verses.translation: abb khao , aur piyo , aur aankhen thandi rakho .   aur agar logon  mein say kissi ko aata dekho to ( isharay say ) keh dena kay :  aaj mein ney khudaye rehman kay liye aik rozay ki mannat maani hai , iss liye mein kissi bhi insan say baat nahi kerun gi .

verses.text: phir woh uss bacchay ko uthaye huye apni qoam kay paas ayen .   woh kehney lagay kay :  maryam ! tum ney to bara ghazab daha diya .
verses.translation: phir woh uss bacchay ko uthaye huye apni qoam kay paas ayen .   woh kehney lagay kay :  maryam ! tum ney to bara ghazab daha diya .

verses.text: aey Haroon ki behan !   naa to tumhara baap koi bura aadmi tha , naa tumhari maa koi bad-kaar aurat thi !
