verses.translation: aey Haroon ki behan !   naa to tumhara baap koi bura aadmi tha , naa tumhari maa koi bad-kaar aurat thi !

verses.text: iss per maryam ney uss bacchay ki taraf ishara kiya . logon  ney kaha :  bhala hum iss say kaisay baat keren jo abhi paalney mein parra huwa baccha hai-?
verses.translation: iss per maryam ney uss bacchay ki taraf ishara kiya . logon  ney kaha :  bhala hum iss say kaisay baat keren jo abhi paalney mein parra huwa baccha hai-?

verses.text: . ( iss per ) baccha bol utha kay :  mein Allah ka banda hun . uss ney mujhay kitab di hai , aur nabi banaya hai ,
verses.translation: . ( iss per ) baccha bol utha kay :  mein Allah ka banda hun . uss ney mujhay kitab di hai , aur nabi banaya hai ,

verses.text: aur jahan bhi mein rahun , mujhay ba-barkat banaya hai , aur jab tak zinda rahun , mujhay namaz aur zakat ka hukum diya hai ,
verses.translation: aur jahan bhi mein rahun , mujhay ba-barkat banaya hai , aur jab tak zinda rahun , mujhay namaz aur zakat ka hukum diya hai ,

verses.text: aur mujhay apni walida ka farmanbardaar banaya hai , aur mujhay sarkash aur sang dil nahi banaya .
verses.translation: aur mujhay apni walida ka farmanbardaar banaya hai , aur mujhay sarkash aur sang dil nahi banaya .

verses.text: aur ( Allah tala ki taraf say ) salamti hai mujh per uss din bhi jab mein peda huwa , aur uss din bhi jiss din mein marun ga , aur uss din bhi jab mujhay dobara zinda ker kay uthaya jaye ga .
verses.translation: aur ( Allah tala ki taraf say ) salamti hai mujh per uss din bhi jab mein peda huwa , aur uss din bhi jiss din mein marun ga , aur uss din bhi jab mujhay dobara zinda ker kay uthaya jaye ga .

verses.text: yeh hain essa bin maryam ! inn ( ki haqeeqat ) kay baaray mein sachi baat yeh hai jiss mein log jhagarr rahey hain .
verses.translation: yeh hain essa bin maryam ! inn ( ki haqeeqat ) kay baaray mein sachi baat yeh hai jiss mein log jhagarr rahey hain .

verses.text: Allah ki yeh shaan nahi hai kay woh koi beta banaye , uss ki zaat pak hai . jab woh kissi baat ka faisla kerleta hai to bus uss say yeh kehta hai kay :  hoja  chunacheh who ho jati hai .
verses.translation: Allah ki yeh shaan nahi hai kay woh koi beta banaye , uss ki zaat pak hai . jab woh kissi baat ka faisla kerleta hai to bus uss say yeh kehta hai kay :  hoja  chunacheh who ho jati hai .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! logon  say keh do kay : ) yaqeenan Allah mera bhi perwerdigar hai , aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar , iss liye uss ki ibadat kero . yehi seedha raasta hai .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! logon  say keh do kay : ) yaqeenan Allah mera bhi perwerdigar hai , aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar , iss liye uss ki ibadat kero . yehi seedha raasta hai .

verses.text: phir bhi unn mein say mukhtalif girohon ney ikhtilaf daal diya hai , chunacheh jiss din yeh aik zabardast din ka mushaeeda keren gay , uss din unn ki bari tabahi hogi jinhon ney kufr ka irtikab kiya hai .
verses.translation: phir bhi unn mein say mukhtalif girohon ney ikhtilaf daal diya hai , chunacheh jiss din yeh aik zabardast din ka mushaeeda keren gay , uss din unn ki bari tabahi hogi jinhon ney kufr ka irtikab kiya hai .

verses.text: jiss roz yeh humaray paas ayen gay , uss din yeh kitney sunney walay aur dekhney walay ban jayen gay ! lekin yeh zalim aaj khuli gumrahi mein parray huye hain .
verses.translation: jiss roz yeh humaray paas ayen gay , uss din yeh kitney sunney walay aur dekhney walay ban jayen gay ! lekin yeh zalim aaj khuli gumrahi mein parray huye hain .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn ko uss pachtaway kay din say daraiye jab her baat ka aakhri faisla hojaye ga , jabkay yeh log ( iss waqt ) ghaflat mein hain , aur emaan nahi laarahey .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn ko uss pachtaway kay din say daraiye jab her baat ka aakhri faisla hojaye ga , jabkay yeh log ( iss waqt ) ghaflat mein hain , aur emaan nahi laarahey .

verses.text: yaqeen jano kay zameen aur iss/uss per saray rehney walon kay waris hum hi hon gay , aur humari taraf hi inn/unn sabb ko lotaya jaye ga .
verses.translation: yaqeen jano kay zameen aur iss/uss per saray rehney walon kay waris hum hi hon gay , aur humari taraf hi inn/unn sabb ko lotaya jaye ga .

verses.text: aur iss kitab mein Ibrahim ka bhi tazkarah kero . beyshak woh sachai kay khoogar nabi thay .
verses.translation: aur iss kitab mein Ibrahim ka bhi tazkarah kero . beyshak woh sachai kay khoogar nabi thay .

verses.text: yaad kero jab unhon ney apney baap say kaha tha kay :  abba jaan ! aap aesi cheezon ki kiyon ibadat kertay hain jo naa sunti hain , naa dekhti hain , aur naa aap ka koi kaam ker-sakti hain-?
verses.translation: yaad kero jab unhon ney apney baap say kaha tha kay :  abba jaan ! aap aesi cheezon ki kiyon ibadat kertay hain jo naa sunti hain , naa dekhti hain , aur naa aap ka koi kaam ker-sakti hain-?

verses.text: abba jaan ! meray paas aik aisa ilm aaya hai jo aap kay paas nahi aaya , iss liye meri baat maan lijiye , mein aap ko seedha raasta batla dun ga .
verses.translation: abba jaan ! meray paas aik aisa ilm aaya hai jo aap kay paas nahi aaya , iss liye meri baat maan lijiye , mein aap ko seedha raasta batla dun ga .

verses.text: abba jaan ! shetan ki ibadat naa kijiye .   yaqeen janiye kay shetan khudaye rehman ka nafarman hai .
verses.translation: abba jaan ! shetan ki ibadat naa kijiye .   yaqeen janiye kay shetan khudaye rehman ka nafarman hai .

verses.text: abba jaan ! mujhay andesha hai kay khudaye rehman ki taraf say aap ko koi azab naa aa-pakray , jiss kay nateejay mein aap shetan kay sathi ban ker reh jayen .
verses.translation: abba jaan ! mujhay andesha hai kay khudaye rehman ki taraf say aap ko koi azab naa aa-pakray , jiss kay nateejay mein aap shetan kay sathi ban ker reh jayen .

verses.text: unn kay baap ney kaha :  Ibrahim ! kiya tum meray khudaon say beyzar ho-? yaad rakho , agar tum baaz naa aaye to mein tum per pathar barsaon ga , aur abb tum hamesha kay liye mujh say door hojao .
verses.translation: unn kay baap ney kaha :  Ibrahim ! kiya tum meray khudaon say beyzar ho-? yaad rakho , agar tum baaz naa aaye to mein tum per pathar barsaon ga , aur abb tum hamesha kay liye mujh say door hojao .

verses.text: Ibrahim ney kaha :  mein aap ko ( rukhsat ka ) salam kerta hun .   mein apney perwerdigar say aap ki bakhshish ki dua kerun ga .   beyshak woh mujh per boht meharban hai .
verses.translation: Ibrahim ney kaha :  mein aap ko ( rukhsat ka ) salam kerta hun .   mein apney perwerdigar say aap ki bakhshish ki dua kerun ga .   beyshak woh mujh per boht meharban hai .

verses.text: aur mein aap logon  say bhi alag hota hun , aur Allah ko chorr ker aap log jinn jinn ki ibadat kertay hain , unn say bhi , aur mein apney perwerdigar ko pukarta rahun ga . mujhay poori umeed hai kay apney rab ko pukar ker mein na-murad nahi rahun ga .
verses.translation: aur mein aap logon  say bhi alag hota hun , aur Allah ko chorr ker aap log jinn jinn ki ibadat kertay hain , unn say bhi , aur mein apney perwerdigar ko pukarta rahun ga . mujhay poori umeed hai kay apney rab ko pukar ker mein na-murad nahi rahun ga .

verses.text: chunacheh jab woh unn say aur unn ( button ) say alag hogaye jinhen woh Allah kay bajaye pukara kertay thay , to hum ney unhen Ishaq aur Yaqoob ( jaisi aulad ) bakhshi, aur unn mein say her aik ko nabi banaya .
verses.translation: chunacheh jab woh unn say aur unn ( button ) say alag hogaye jinhen woh Allah kay bajaye pukara kertay thay , to hum ney unhen Ishaq aur Yaqoob ( jaisi aulad ) bakhshi, aur unn mein say her aik ko nabi banaya .

verses.text: aur unn ko apni rehmat say nawaza , aur unhen oonchay darjay ki naik naami ata ki .
verses.translation: aur unn ko apni rehmat say nawaza , aur unhen oonchay darjay ki naik naami ata ki .

verses.text: aur iss kitab mein musa ka bhi tazkarah kero . beyshak woh Allah kay chunay huye banday thay , aur Rasool aur nabi thay .
verses.translation: aur iss kitab mein musa ka bhi tazkarah kero . beyshak woh Allah kay chunay huye banday thay , aur Rasool aur nabi thay .

verses.text: hum ney unhen koh-e-toor ki dayen janib say pukara , aur unhen apna raz daar bana ker apna qurb ata kiya .
verses.translation: hum ney unhen koh-e-toor ki dayen janib say pukara , aur unhen apna raz daar bana ker apna qurb ata kiya .

verses.text: aur hum ney unn kay bhai Haroon ko nabi bana ker apni rehmat say unhen ( aik madadgaar ) ata kiya .
verses.translation: aur hum ney unn kay bhai Haroon ko nabi bana ker apni rehmat say unhen ( aik madadgaar ) ata kiya .

verses.text: aur iss kitab mein Ismail ka bhi tazkarah kero . beyshak woh waday kay sachay thay ,   aur Rasool aur nabi thay .
verses.translation: aur iss kitab mein Ismail ka bhi tazkarah kero . beyshak woh waday kay sachay thay ,   aur Rasool aur nabi thay .

verses.text: aur woh apney ghar walon ko bhi namaz aur zakat ka hukum diya kertay thay , aur apney perwerdigar kay nazdeek pasandeeda thay .
verses.translation: aur woh apney ghar walon ko bhi namaz aur zakat ka hukum diya kertay thay , aur apney perwerdigar kay nazdeek pasandeeda thay .

verses.text: aur iss kitab mein Idrees ka bhi tazkarah kero . beyshak woh sachai kay khoogar nabi thay .
verses.translation: aur iss kitab mein Idrees ka bhi tazkarah kero . beyshak woh sachai kay khoogar nabi thay .

verses.text: aur hum ney unhen rafat dey ker aik buland maqam tak phoncha diya tha .
verses.translation: aur hum ney unhen rafat dey ker aik buland maqam tak phoncha diya tha .

verses.text: Adam ki aulad mein say yeh woh nabi hain jinn per Allah ney inaam farmaya , aur inn mein say kuch unn logon  ki aulad mein say hain jinn ko hum ney nooh kay sath ( kashti mein ) sawar kiya tha , aur kuch Ibrahim aur Israel ( Yaqoob aleh-assalam ) ki aulad mein say hain . aur yeh sabb unn logon  mein say hain jinn ko hum ney hidayat di , aur ( apney deen kay liye ) muntakhib kiya . jab unn kay samney khudaye rehman ki aayaton ki tilawat ki jati toh yeh rotay huye sajday mein gir jatay thay .
verses.translation: Adam ki aulad mein say yeh woh nabi hain jinn per Allah ney inaam farmaya , aur inn mein say kuch unn logon  ki aulad mein say hain jinn ko hum ney nooh kay sath ( kashti mein ) sawar kiya tha , aur kuch Ibrahim aur Israel ( Yaqoob aleh-assalam ) ki aulad mein say hain . aur yeh sabb unn logon  mein say hain jinn ko hum ney hidayat di , aur ( apney deen kay liye ) muntakhib kiya . jab unn kay samney khudaye rehman ki aayaton ki tilawat ki jati toh yeh rotay huye sajday mein gir jatay thay .

verses.text: phir inn kay baad aesay log inn ki jagah aaye jinhon ney namazon ko barbad kiya , aur apni nafsani khuwaishaat kay peechay chalay . chunacheh inn ki gumrahi boht jald inn kay samney aajaye gi .
verses.translation: phir inn kay baad aesay log inn ki jagah aaye jinhon ney namazon ko barbad kiya , aur apni nafsani khuwaishaat kay peechay chalay . chunacheh inn ki gumrahi boht jald inn kay samney aajaye gi .

verses.text: albatta jinn logon  ney tauba kerli , aur emaan ley aaye , aur naik amal kiye , to aesay log jannat mein dakhil hon gay , aur unn per zara bhi zulm nahi hoga .
verses.translation: albatta jinn logon  ney tauba kerli , aur emaan ley aaye , aur naik amal kiye , to aesay log jannat mein dakhil hon gay , aur unn per zara bhi zulm nahi hoga .

verses.text: . ( unn ka dakhila ) aesay hamesha baqi rehney walay baaghaat mein ( hoga ) jinn ka khudaye rehman ney apney bandon say unn kay dekhay baghair wada ker rakha hai . yaqeenan uss ka wada aisa hai kay yeh uss tak zaroor phonchen gay .
verses.translation: . ( unn ka dakhila ) aesay hamesha baqi rehney walay baaghaat mein ( hoga ) jinn ka khudaye rehman ney apney bandon say unn kay dekhay baghair wada ker rakha hai . yaqeenan uss ka wada aisa hai kay yeh uss tak zaroor phonchen gay .

verses.text: woh uss mein salamti ki baaton kay siwa koi laghw baat nahi sunen gay . aur wahan unn ka rizq unhen subha o shaam mila keray ga .
verses.translation: woh uss mein salamti ki baaton kay siwa koi laghw baat nahi sunen gay . aur wahan unn ka rizq unhen subha o shaam mila keray ga .

verses.text: yeh hai woh jannat jiss ka waris hum apney bandon mein say uss ko banayen gay jo muttaqi ho .
verses.translation: yeh hai woh jannat jiss ka waris hum apney bandon mein say uss ko banayen gay jo muttaqi ho .

verses.text: aur ( farishtay tum say yeh kehtay hain kay ) hum aap kay rab kay hukum kay baghair utar ker nahi aatay .   jo kuch humaray aagay hai , aur jo kuch humaray peechay hai , aur jo kuch inn kay darmiyan hai , woh sabb ussi ki milkiyat hai . aur tumhara rab aisa nahi hai jo bhool jaya keray .
verses.translation: aur ( farishtay tum say yeh kehtay hain kay ) hum aap kay rab kay hukum kay baghair utar ker nahi aatay .   jo kuch humaray aagay hai , aur jo kuch humaray peechay hai , aur jo kuch inn kay darmiyan hai , woh sabb ussi ki milkiyat hai . aur tumhara rab aisa nahi hai jo bhool jaya keray .

verses.text: woh aasmano aur zameen ka bhi malik hai , aur jo makhlooqaat unn kay darmiyan hain , unn ka bhi . lehaza tum uss ki ibadat kero , aur uss ki ibadat per jamay raho . kiya tumharay ilm mein koi aur hai jo uss jaisi sifaat rakhta ho-?
verses.translation: woh aasmano aur zameen ka bhi malik hai , aur jo makhlooqaat unn kay darmiyan hain , unn ka bhi . lehaza tum uss ki ibadat kero , aur uss ki ibadat per jamay raho . kiya tumharay ilm mein koi aur hai jo uss jaisi sifaat rakhta ho-?

verses.text: aur ( kafir ) insan yeh kehta hai kay :  jab mein mar-chuka hun ga to kiya waqaee uss waqt mujhay zinda ker kay nikala jaye ga-?
verses.translation: aur ( kafir ) insan yeh kehta hai kay :  jab mein mar-chuka hun ga to kiya waqaee uss waqt mujhay zinda ker kay nikala jaye ga-?

verses.text: kiya iss insan ko yeh baat yaad nahi aati kay hum ney ussay shuroo mein uss waqt peda kiya tha jab woh kuch bhi nahi tha-?
verses.translation: kiya iss insan ko yeh baat yaad nahi aati kay hum ney ussay shuroo mein uss waqt peda kiya tha jab woh kuch bhi nahi tha-?

verses.text: to qasam hai tumharay perwerdigar ki ! hum inn ko aur inn kay sath saray shetanon ko zaroor ikattha keren gay ,   phir inn ko dozakh kay gird iss tarah ley ker ayen gay kay yeh sabb ghuttnon kay ball giray huye hon gay .
verses.translation: to qasam hai tumharay perwerdigar ki ! hum inn ko aur inn kay sath saray shetanon ko zaroor ikattha keren gay ,   phir inn ko dozakh kay gird iss tarah ley ker ayen gay kay yeh sabb ghuttnon kay ball giray huye hon gay .

verses.text: phir inn kay her giroh mein say unn logon  ko kheench nikalen gay jo khudaye rehman kay sath sarkashi kernay mein ziyada sakht thay .
verses.translation: phir inn kay her giroh mein say unn logon  ko kheench nikalen gay jo khudaye rehman kay sath sarkashi kernay mein ziyada sakht thay .

verses.text: phir yeh baat hum hi khoob jantay hain kay woh kon log hain jo sabb say pehlay iss dozakh mein jhonkay janey kay ziyada mustahiq hain .
verses.translation: phir yeh baat hum hi khoob jantay hain kay woh kon log hain jo sabb say pehlay iss dozakh mein jhonkay janey kay ziyada mustahiq hain .

verses.text: aur tum mein say koi nahi hai jiss ka iss ( dozakh ) per guzar naa ho .   iss baat ka tumharay perwerdigar ney hatmi tor per zimma ley rakha hai .
verses.translation: aur tum mein say koi nahi hai jiss ka iss ( dozakh ) per guzar naa ho .   iss baat ka tumharay perwerdigar ney hatmi tor per zimma ley rakha hai .

verses.text: phir jinn logon  ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya hai , unhen toh hum nijat dey den gay , aur jo zalim hain , unhen iss halat mein chorr den gay kay woh iss ( dozakh mein ) ghuttnon kay ball parray hon gay .
verses.translation: phir jinn logon  ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya hai , unhen toh hum nijat dey den gay , aur jo zalim hain , unhen iss halat mein chorr den gay kay woh iss ( dozakh mein ) ghuttnon kay ball parray hon gay .

verses.text: aur jab unn kay samney humari khuli khuli aayaten tilawat ki jati hain , toh kafir log mominon say kehtay hain kay :  batao , hum dono fareeqon mein say kiss ka maqam ziyada behtar hai , aur kiss ki majlis ziyada achi hai ?
verses.translation: aur jab unn kay samney humari khuli khuli aayaten tilawat ki jati hain , toh kafir log mominon say kehtay hain kay :  batao , hum dono fareeqon mein say kiss ka maqam ziyada behtar hai , aur kiss ki majlis ziyada achi hai ?

verses.text: aur ( yeh nahi dekhtay kay ) inn say pehlay hum kitni naslen halak ker-chukay hain , jo apney saz-o-saman aur zahiri aan baan mein inn say kahen behtar then .
verses.translation: aur ( yeh nahi dekhtay kay ) inn say pehlay hum kitni naslen halak ker-chukay hain , jo apney saz-o-saman aur zahiri aan baan mein inn say kahen behtar then .

verses.text: keh do kay :  jo log gumrahi mein jaa parren toh unn kay liye munasib yehi hai kay khudaye rehman unhen khoob dheel deta rahey .  yahan tak kay jab yeh log woh cheez khud dekh len gay jiss say enhen daraya jaraha hai , chahye woh ( iss duniya ka ) azab ho , ya qayamat , to uss waqt enhen pata chalay ga kay bad-tareen maqam kiss ka tha , aur lashkar kiss ka ziyada kamzor tha .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  jo log gumrahi mein jaa parren toh unn kay liye munasib yehi hai kay khudaye rehman unhen khoob dheel deta rahey .  yahan tak kay jab yeh log woh cheez khud dekh len gay jiss say enhen daraya jaraha hai , chahye woh ( iss duniya ka ) azab ho , ya qayamat , to uss waqt enhen pata chalay ga kay bad-tareen maqam kiss ka tha , aur lashkar kiss ka ziyada kamzor tha .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney seedha raasta ikhtiyar kerliya hai , Allah unn ko hidayat mein aur taraqqi deta hai . aur jo naik amal baqi rehney walay hain , unn ka badla bhi tumharay perwerdigar kay yahan behtar milay ga , aur unn ka ( majmooi ) anjam bhi behtar hoga .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney seedha raasta ikhtiyar kerliya hai , Allah unn ko hidayat mein aur taraqqi deta hai . aur jo naik amal baqi rehney walay hain , unn ka badla bhi tumharay perwerdigar kay yahan behtar milay ga , aur unn ka ( majmooi ) anjam bhi behtar hoga .

verses.text: bhala tum ney uss shaks ko bhi dekha jiss ney humari aayaton ko manney say inkar kiya hai, aur yeh kaha hai kay :  mujhay maal aur aulad ( aakhirat mein bhi ) zaroor milen gay .
verses.translation: bhala tum ney uss shaks ko bhi dekha jiss ney humari aayaton ko manney say inkar kiya hai, aur yeh kaha hai kay :  mujhay maal aur aulad ( aakhirat mein bhi ) zaroor milen gay .

verses.text: kiya uss ney aalam-e-ghaib mein jhank ker dekh liya hai , ya uss ney khudaye rehman say koi ehad ley rakha hai-?
verses.translation: kiya uss ney aalam-e-ghaib mein jhank ker dekh liya hai , ya uss ney khudaye rehman say koi ehad ley rakha hai-?

verses.text: hergiz nahi ! jo kuch yeh keh raha hai , hum ussay bhi likh rakhen gay , aur uss kay azab mein aur izafa kerden gay .
verses.translation: hergiz nahi ! jo kuch yeh keh raha hai , hum ussay bhi likh rakhen gay , aur uss kay azab mein aur izafa kerden gay .

verses.text: aur jiss ( maal aur aulad ) ka yeh hawala dey raha hai , uss kay waris hum hon gay , aur yeh humaray paas tan e tanha aaye ga .
verses.translation: aur jiss ( maal aur aulad ) ka yeh hawala dey raha hai , uss kay waris hum hon gay , aur yeh humaray paas tan e tanha aaye ga .

verses.text: aur unn logon  ney Allah kay siwa doosray mabood iss liye bana rakhay hain takay woh inn ki pusht panahi keren .
verses.translation: aur unn logon  ney Allah kay siwa doosray mabood iss liye bana rakhay hain takay woh inn ki pusht panahi keren .

verses.text: yeh sabb ghalat baat hai ! woh toh inn ki ibadat hi ka inkar kerden gay , aur ultay inn kay mukhalif hojayen gay .
verses.translation: yeh sabb ghalat baat hai ! woh toh inn ki ibadat hi ka inkar kerden gay , aur ultay inn kay mukhalif hojayen gay .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya tumhen yeh maloom nahi hai kay hum ney kafiron per shayateen chorr rakhay hain jo enhen barabar uksatey rehtay hain-?
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya tumhen yeh maloom nahi hai kay hum ney kafiron per shayateen chorr rakhay hain jo enhen barabar uksatey rehtay hain-?

verses.text: lehaza tum inn kay moamlay mein jaldi naa kero . hum toh inn kay liye ginti ginn rahey hain .
verses.translation: lehaza tum inn kay moamlay mein jaldi naa kero . hum toh inn kay liye ginti ginn rahey hain .

verses.text: . ( uss din ko naa bhoolo ) jiss din hum saray muttaqi logon  ko mehman bana ker khudaye rehman kay paas jama keren gay ,
verses.translation: . ( uss din ko naa bhoolo ) jiss din hum saray muttaqi logon  ko mehman bana ker khudaye rehman kay paas jama keren gay ,

verses.text: aur mujrimon ko piyasay janweron ki tarah hanka ker dozakh ki taraf ley jayen gay .
verses.translation: aur mujrimon ko piyasay janweron ki tarah hanka ker dozakh ki taraf ley jayen gay .

verses.text: logon  ko kissi ki sifarish kernay ka ikhtiyar bhi nahi hoga , siwaye unn logon  kay jinhon ney khudaye rehman say koi ijazat hasil kerli ho .
verses.translation: logon  ko kissi ki sifarish kernay ka ikhtiyar bhi nahi hoga , siwaye unn logon  kay jinhon ney khudaye rehman say koi ijazat hasil kerli ho .

verses.text: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay khudaye rehman ki koi aulad hai !
verses.translation: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay khudaye rehman ki koi aulad hai !

verses.text: . ( aesi baat kehney walo ! ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum ney bari sangeen harkat ki hai .
verses.translation: . ( aesi baat kehney walo ! ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum ney bari sangeen harkat ki hai .

verses.text: kuch baeed nahi kay iss ki wajeh say aasman phatt parren , zameen shaqq hojaye aur pahar toot ker gir parren .
verses.translation: kuch baeed nahi kay iss ki wajeh say aasman phatt parren , zameen shaqq hojaye aur pahar toot ker gir parren .

verses.text: kay inn logon  ney khudaye rehman kay liye aulad honey ka dawa kiya hai .
verses.translation: kay inn logon  ney khudaye rehman kay liye aulad honey ka dawa kiya hai .

verses.text: halankay khudaye rehman ki yeh shaan nahi hai kay uss ki koi aulad ho .
verses.translation: halankay khudaye rehman ki yeh shaan nahi hai kay uss ki koi aulad ho .

verses.text: aasmano aur zameen mein jitney log hain , unn mein say koi aisa nahi hai jo khudaye rehman kay huzoor banda ban ker naa aaye .
verses.translation: aasmano aur zameen mein jitney log hain , unn mein say koi aisa nahi hai jo khudaye rehman kay huzoor banda ban ker naa aaye .

verses.text: yaqeen rakho kay uss ney sabb ka ehata ker rakha hai aur unhen khoob achi tarah gin rakha hai .
verses.translation: yaqeen rakho kay uss ney sabb ka ehata ker rakha hai aur unhen khoob achi tarah gin rakha hai .

verses.text: aur qayamat kay din unn mein say aik aik shaks uss kay paas akela aaye ga .
verses.translation: aur qayamat kay din unn mein say aik aik shaks uss kay paas akela aaye ga .

verses.text: . ( haan ) beyshak jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , khudaye rehman unn kay liye dilon mein mohabbat peda kerday ga .
verses.translation: . ( haan ) beyshak jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , khudaye rehman unn kay liye dilon mein mohabbat peda kerday ga .

verses.text: chunacheh ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney iss Quran ko tumhari zaban mein aasaan bana diya hai takay tum iss kay zariye muttaqi logon  ko khushkhabri do , aur issi kay zariye unn logon  ko darao jo zidd ki wajeh say jhagray per aamada hain .
verses.translation: chunacheh ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney iss Quran ko tumhari zaban mein aasaan bana diya hai takay tum iss kay zariye muttaqi logon  ko khushkhabri do , aur issi kay zariye unn logon  ko darao jo zidd ki wajeh say jhagray per aamada hain .

verses.text: inn say pehlay hum kitni hi qoamon ko halak ker-chukay hain . kiya tumhen tatolney say bhi unn mein say kissi ka pata milta hai , ya unn mein say kissi ki bhanak bhi tumhen sunai deti hai-?
verses.translation: inn say pehlay hum kitni hi qoamon ko halak ker-chukay hain . kiya tumhen tatolney say bhi unn mein say kissi ka pata milta hai , ya unn mein say kissi ki bhanak bhi tumhen sunai deti hai-?

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: Kaaf-Haa-Yaa-Aen-Suad
ayahs.translation: Kaaf-Haa-Yaa-Aen-Suad

ayahs.text: yeh tazkarah hai uss rehmat ka jo tumharay perwerdigar ney apney banday zakriya per ki thi .
ayahs.translation: yeh tazkarah hai uss rehmat ka jo tumharay perwerdigar ney apney banday zakriya per ki thi .

ayahs.text: yeh uss waqt ki baat hai jab unhon ney apney perwerdigar ko aahista aahista aawaz say pukara tha .
ayahs.translation: yeh uss waqt ki baat hai jab unhon ney apney perwerdigar ko aahista aahista aawaz say pukara tha .

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha tha kay :  meray perwerdigar ! meri haddiyan tak kamzor parr-gai hain , aur sar burhapay ki safedi say bharak utha hai , aur meray perwerdigar ! mein aap say dua maang ker kabhi na-murad nahi huwa .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha tha kay :  meray perwerdigar ! meri haddiyan tak kamzor parr-gai hain , aur sar burhapay ki safedi say bharak utha hai , aur meray perwerdigar ! mein aap say dua maang ker kabhi na-murad nahi huwa .

ayahs.text: aur mujhay apney baad apney chachazaad bhaiyon ka andesha laga huwa hai ,   aur meri biwi baanjh hai , lehaza aap khaas apney paas say mujhay aik aisa waris ata ker-dijiye
ayahs.translation: aur mujhay apney baad apney chachazaad bhaiyon ka andesha laga huwa hai ,   aur meri biwi baanjh hai , lehaza aap khaas apney paas say mujhay aik aisa waris ata ker-dijiye

ayahs.text: jo mera bhi waris ho , aur Yaqoob ( aleh-assalam ) ki aulad say bhi meeras paye .   aur ya rab ! ussay aisa banaiye jo ( khud aap ka ) pasandeeda ho .
ayahs.translation: jo mera bhi waris ho , aur Yaqoob ( aleh-assalam ) ki aulad say bhi meeras paye .   aur ya rab ! ussay aisa banaiye jo ( khud aap ka ) pasandeeda ho .

ayahs.text: . ( aawaz aai kay : )  aey zakriya ! hum tumhen aik aesay larkay ki khushkhabri detay hain jiss ka naam Yahya hoga . iss say pehlay hum ney iss kay naam ka koi aur shaks peda nahi kiya .
ayahs.translation: . ( aawaz aai kay : )  aey zakriya ! hum tumhen aik aesay larkay ki khushkhabri detay hain jiss ka naam Yahya hoga . iss say pehlay hum ney iss kay naam ka koi aur shaks peda nahi kiya .

ayahs.text: zakriya ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! meray yahan larka kiss tarah peda hoga jabkay meri biwi baanjh hai , aur mein burhapay say iss haal ko phonch gaya hun kay mera jism sookh chuka hai !
ayahs.translation: zakriya ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! meray yahan larka kiss tarah peda hoga jabkay meri biwi baanjh hai , aur mein burhapay say iss haal ko phonch gaya hun kay mera jism sookh chuka hai !

ayahs.text: kaha :  haan ! aisa hi hoga . tumharay rab ney farmaya hai kay yeh to meray liye mamooli baat hai . aur iss say pehlay mein ney tumhen peda kiya tha jab tum kuch bhi nahi thay .
ayahs.translation: kaha :  haan ! aisa hi hoga . tumharay rab ney farmaya hai kay yeh to meray liye mamooli baat hai . aur iss say pehlay mein ney tumhen peda kiya tha jab tum kuch bhi nahi thay .

ayahs.text: zakriya ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! meray liye koi nishani muqarrar farma dijiye .    farmaya :  tumhari nishani yeh hai kay tum sehat mand honey kay bawajood teen raat tak logon  say baat nahi ker-sako gay .
ayahs.translation: zakriya ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! meray liye koi nishani muqarrar farma dijiye .    farmaya :  tumhari nishani yeh hai kay tum sehat mand honey kay bawajood teen raat tak logon  say baat nahi ker-sako gay .

ayahs.text: chunacheh woh ibadat gaah say nikal ker apni qoam kay samney aaye , aur unn ko isharay say hidayat di kay tum log subha o shaam Allah ki tasbeeh kiya kero .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh woh ibadat gaah say nikal ker apni qoam kay samney aaye , aur unn ko isharay say hidayat di kay tum log subha o shaam Allah ki tasbeeh kiya kero .

ayahs.text: . ( phir jab Yahya peda ho ker baray hogaye to hum ney unn say farmaya : )  aey Yahya ! kitab ko mazbooti say thaam lo .    aur hum ney bachpan hi mein unn ko danai bhi ata kerdi thi ,
ayahs.translation: . ( phir jab Yahya peda ho ker baray hogaye to hum ney unn say farmaya : )  aey Yahya ! kitab ko mazbooti say thaam lo .    aur hum ney bachpan hi mein unn ko danai bhi ata kerdi thi ,

ayahs.text: aur khaas apney paas say naram dili aur pakeezgi bhi . aur woh baray perhezgar thay ,
ayahs.translation: aur khaas apney paas say naram dili aur pakeezgi bhi . aur woh baray perhezgar thay ,

ayahs.text: aur apney walaiden kay khidmat guzaar ! naa woh sarkash thay , naa nafarman .
ayahs.translation: aur apney walaiden kay khidmat guzaar ! naa woh sarkash thay , naa nafarman .

ayahs.text: aur ( Allah taalaa ki taraf say ) salam hai unn per uss din bhi jiss roz woh peda huye , uss din bhi jiss roz unhen moat aaye gi , aur uss din bhi jiss roz unhen zinda ker kay dobara uthaya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: aur ( Allah taalaa ki taraf say ) salam hai unn per uss din bhi jiss roz woh peda huye , uss din bhi jiss roz unhen moat aaye gi , aur uss din bhi jiss roz unhen zinda ker kay dobara uthaya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur iss kitab mein maryam ka bhi tazkarah kero . uss waqt ka tazkarah jab woh apney ghar walon say alehda ho ker uss jagah chali gaeen jo mashriq ki taraf waqay thi .
ayahs.translation: aur iss kitab mein maryam ka bhi tazkarah kero . uss waqt ka tazkarah jab woh apney ghar walon say alehda ho ker uss jagah chali gaeen jo mashriq ki taraf waqay thi .

ayahs.text: phir unhon ney unn logon  kay aur apney darmiyan aik perda daal liya .   iss moaqa per hum ney unn kay paas apni rooh ( yani aik farishtay ) ko bheja jo unn kay samney aik mukammal insan ki shakal mein zahir huwa .
ayahs.translation: phir unhon ney unn logon  kay aur apney darmiyan aik perda daal liya .   iss moaqa per hum ney unn kay paas apni rooh ( yani aik farishtay ) ko bheja jo unn kay samney aik mukammal insan ki shakal mein zahir huwa .

ayahs.text: maryam ney kaha :  mein tum say khudaye rehman ki panah maangti hun . agar tum mein khuda ka khof hai ( to yahan say hatt jao )
ayahs.translation: maryam ney kaha :  mein tum say khudaye rehman ki panah maangti hun . agar tum mein khuda ka khof hai ( to yahan say hatt jao )

ayahs.text: farishtay ney kaha :  mein to tumharay rab ka bheja huwa ( farishta ) hun ( aur iss liye aaya hun ) takay tumhen aik pakeezah larka dun .
ayahs.translation: farishtay ney kaha :  mein to tumharay rab ka bheja huwa ( farishta ) hun ( aur iss liye aaya hun ) takay tumhen aik pakeezah larka dun .

ayahs.text: maryam ney kaha :  meray larka kaisay hojaye ga , jabkay mujhay kissi bashar ney chooa tak nahi hai , aur naa mein koi bad-kaar aurat hun-?
ayahs.translation: maryam ney kaha :  meray larka kaisay hojaye ga , jabkay mujhay kissi bashar ney chooa tak nahi hai , aur naa mein koi bad-kaar aurat hun-?

ayahs.text: farishtay ney kaha :  aesay hi hojaye ga . tumharay rab ney farmaya hai kay :  yeh meray liye aik mamooli baat hai . aur hum yeh kaam iss liye keren gay takay uss larkay ko logon  kay liye ( apni qudrat ki ) aik nishani banayen , aur apni taraf say rehmat ka muzahira keren .   aur yeh baat poori tarah tey hochuki hai .
ayahs.translation: farishtay ney kaha :  aesay hi hojaye ga . tumharay rab ney farmaya hai kay :  yeh meray liye aik mamooli baat hai . aur hum yeh kaam iss liye keren gay takay uss larkay ko logon  kay liye ( apni qudrat ki ) aik nishani banayen , aur apni taraf say rehmat ka muzahira keren .   aur yeh baat poori tarah tey hochuki hai .

ayahs.text: phir huwa yeh kay maryam ko uss bacchay ka hamal thehar gaya , ( aur jab wiladat ka waqt qareeb aaya ) to woh uss ko ley ker logon  say alag aik door maqam per chali gaeen .
ayahs.translation: phir huwa yeh kay maryam ko uss bacchay ka hamal thehar gaya , ( aur jab wiladat ka waqt qareeb aaya ) to woh uss ko ley ker logon  say alag aik door maqam per chali gaeen .

ayahs.text: phir zachgi kay dard ney unhen aik khujoor kay darkht kay paas phoncha diya . woh kehney lagen :  kaash kay mein iss say pehlay hi mar-gaee hoti , aur mar ker bhooli basri hojati !
ayahs.translation: phir zachgi kay dard ney unhen aik khujoor kay darkht kay paas phoncha diya . woh kehney lagen :  kaash kay mein iss say pehlay hi mar-gaee hoti , aur mar ker bhooli basri hojati !

ayahs.text: phir farishtay ney unn kay neechay aik jagah say unhen aawaz di kay :  ghum naa kero , tumharay rab ney tumharay neechay aik chashma peda kerdiya hai .
ayahs.translation: phir farishtay ney unn kay neechay aik jagah say unhen aawaz di kay :  ghum naa kero , tumharay rab ney tumharay neechay aik chashma peda kerdiya hai .

ayahs.text: aur khujoor kay taney ko apni taraf hilao , uss mein say pakki hoi taza khujooren tum per jharen gi .
ayahs.translation: aur khujoor kay taney ko apni taraf hilao , uss mein say pakki hoi taza khujooren tum per jharen gi .

ayahs.text: abb khao , aur piyo , aur aankhen thandi rakho .   aur agar logon  mein say kissi ko aata dekho to ( isharay say ) keh dena kay :  aaj mein ney khudaye rehman kay liye aik rozay ki mannat maani hai , iss liye mein kissi bhi insan say baat nahi kerun gi .
ayahs.translation: abb khao , aur piyo , aur aankhen thandi rakho .   aur agar logon  mein say kissi ko aata dekho to ( isharay say ) keh dena kay :  aaj mein ney khudaye rehman kay liye aik rozay ki mannat maani hai , iss liye mein kissi bhi insan say baat nahi kerun gi .

ayahs.text: phir woh uss bacchay ko uthaye huye apni qoam kay paas ayen .   woh kehney lagay kay :  maryam ! tum ney to bara ghazab daha diya .
ayahs.translation: phir woh uss bacchay ko uthaye huye apni qoam kay paas ayen .   woh kehney lagay kay :  maryam ! tum ney to bara ghazab daha diya .

ayahs.text: aey Haroon ki behan !   naa to tumhara baap koi bura aadmi tha , naa tumhari maa koi bad-kaar aurat thi !
ayahs.translation: aey Haroon ki behan !   naa to tumhara baap koi bura aadmi tha , naa tumhari maa koi bad-kaar aurat thi !

ayahs.text: iss per maryam ney uss bacchay ki taraf ishara kiya . logon  ney kaha :  bhala hum iss say kaisay baat keren jo abhi paalney mein parra huwa baccha hai-?
ayahs.translation: iss per maryam ney uss bacchay ki taraf ishara kiya . logon  ney kaha :  bhala hum iss say kaisay baat keren jo abhi paalney mein parra huwa baccha hai-?

ayahs.text: . ( iss per ) baccha bol utha kay :  mein Allah ka banda hun . uss ney mujhay kitab di hai , aur nabi banaya hai ,
ayahs.translation: . ( iss per ) baccha bol utha kay :  mein Allah ka banda hun . uss ney mujhay kitab di hai , aur nabi banaya hai ,

ayahs.text: aur jahan bhi mein rahun , mujhay ba-barkat banaya hai , aur jab tak zinda rahun , mujhay namaz aur zakat ka hukum diya hai ,
ayahs.translation: aur jahan bhi mein rahun , mujhay ba-barkat banaya hai , aur jab tak zinda rahun , mujhay namaz aur zakat ka hukum diya hai ,

ayahs.text: aur mujhay apni walida ka farmanbardaar banaya hai , aur mujhay sarkash aur sang dil nahi banaya .
ayahs.translation: aur mujhay apni walida ka farmanbardaar banaya hai , aur mujhay sarkash aur sang dil nahi banaya .

ayahs.text: aur ( Allah tala ki taraf say ) salamti hai mujh per uss din bhi jab mein peda huwa , aur uss din bhi jiss din mein marun ga , aur uss din bhi jab mujhay dobara zinda ker kay uthaya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: aur ( Allah tala ki taraf say ) salamti hai mujh per uss din bhi jab mein peda huwa , aur uss din bhi jiss din mein marun ga , aur uss din bhi jab mujhay dobara zinda ker kay uthaya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: yeh hain essa bin maryam ! inn ( ki haqeeqat ) kay baaray mein sachi baat yeh hai jiss mein log jhagarr rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: yeh hain essa bin maryam ! inn ( ki haqeeqat ) kay baaray mein sachi baat yeh hai jiss mein log jhagarr rahey hain .

ayahs.text: Allah ki yeh shaan nahi hai kay woh koi beta banaye , uss ki zaat pak hai . jab woh kissi baat ka faisla kerleta hai to bus uss say yeh kehta hai kay :  hoja  chunacheh who ho jati hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah ki yeh shaan nahi hai kay woh koi beta banaye , uss ki zaat pak hai . jab woh kissi baat ka faisla kerleta hai to bus uss say yeh kehta hai kay :  hoja  chunacheh who ho jati hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! logon  say keh do kay : ) yaqeenan Allah mera bhi perwerdigar hai , aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar , iss liye uss ki ibadat kero . yehi seedha raasta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! logon  say keh do kay : ) yaqeenan Allah mera bhi perwerdigar hai , aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar , iss liye uss ki ibadat kero . yehi seedha raasta hai .

ayahs.text: phir bhi unn mein say mukhtalif girohon ney ikhtilaf daal diya hai , chunacheh jiss din yeh aik zabardast din ka mushaeeda keren gay , uss din unn ki bari tabahi hogi jinhon ney kufr ka irtikab kiya hai .
ayahs.translation: phir bhi unn mein say mukhtalif girohon ney ikhtilaf daal diya hai , chunacheh jiss din yeh aik zabardast din ka mushaeeda keren gay , uss din unn ki bari tabahi hogi jinhon ney kufr ka irtikab kiya hai .

ayahs.text: jiss roz yeh humaray paas ayen gay , uss din yeh kitney sunney walay aur dekhney walay ban jayen gay ! lekin yeh zalim aaj khuli gumrahi mein parray huye hain .
ayahs.translation: jiss roz yeh humaray paas ayen gay , uss din yeh kitney sunney walay aur dekhney walay ban jayen gay ! lekin yeh zalim aaj khuli gumrahi mein parray huye hain .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn ko uss pachtaway kay din say daraiye jab her baat ka aakhri faisla hojaye ga , jabkay yeh log ( iss waqt ) ghaflat mein hain , aur emaan nahi laarahey .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn ko uss pachtaway kay din say daraiye jab her baat ka aakhri faisla hojaye ga , jabkay yeh log ( iss waqt ) ghaflat mein hain , aur emaan nahi laarahey .

ayahs.text: yaqeen jano kay zameen aur iss/uss per saray rehney walon kay waris hum hi hon gay , aur humari taraf hi inn/unn sabb ko lotaya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: yaqeen jano kay zameen aur iss/uss per saray rehney walon kay waris hum hi hon gay , aur humari taraf hi inn/unn sabb ko lotaya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur iss kitab mein Ibrahim ka bhi tazkarah kero . beyshak woh sachai kay khoogar nabi thay .
ayahs.translation: aur iss kitab mein Ibrahim ka bhi tazkarah kero . beyshak woh sachai kay khoogar nabi thay .

ayahs.text: yaad kero jab unhon ney apney baap say kaha tha kay :  abba jaan ! aap aesi cheezon ki kiyon ibadat kertay hain jo naa sunti hain , naa dekhti hain , aur naa aap ka koi kaam ker-sakti hain-?
ayahs.translation: yaad kero jab unhon ney apney baap say kaha tha kay :  abba jaan ! aap aesi cheezon ki kiyon ibadat kertay hain jo naa sunti hain , naa dekhti hain , aur naa aap ka koi kaam ker-sakti hain-?

ayahs.text: abba jaan ! meray paas aik aisa ilm aaya hai jo aap kay paas nahi aaya , iss liye meri baat maan lijiye , mein aap ko seedha raasta batla dun ga .
ayahs.translation: abba jaan ! meray paas aik aisa ilm aaya hai jo aap kay paas nahi aaya , iss liye meri baat maan lijiye , mein aap ko seedha raasta batla dun ga .

ayahs.text: abba jaan ! shetan ki ibadat naa kijiye .   yaqeen janiye kay shetan khudaye rehman ka nafarman hai .
ayahs.translation: abba jaan ! shetan ki ibadat naa kijiye .   yaqeen janiye kay shetan khudaye rehman ka nafarman hai .

ayahs.text: abba jaan ! mujhay andesha hai kay khudaye rehman ki taraf say aap ko koi azab naa aa-pakray , jiss kay nateejay mein aap shetan kay sathi ban ker reh jayen .
ayahs.translation: abba jaan ! mujhay andesha hai kay khudaye rehman ki taraf say aap ko koi azab naa aa-pakray , jiss kay nateejay mein aap shetan kay sathi ban ker reh jayen .

ayahs.text: unn kay baap ney kaha :  Ibrahim ! kiya tum meray khudaon say beyzar ho-? yaad rakho , agar tum baaz naa aaye to mein tum per pathar barsaon ga , aur abb tum hamesha kay liye mujh say door hojao .
ayahs.translation: unn kay baap ney kaha :  Ibrahim ! kiya tum meray khudaon say beyzar ho-? yaad rakho , agar tum baaz naa aaye to mein tum per pathar barsaon ga , aur abb tum hamesha kay liye mujh say door hojao .

ayahs.text: Ibrahim ney kaha :  mein aap ko ( rukhsat ka ) salam kerta hun .   mein apney perwerdigar say aap ki bakhshish ki dua kerun ga .   beyshak woh mujh per boht meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: Ibrahim ney kaha :  mein aap ko ( rukhsat ka ) salam kerta hun .   mein apney perwerdigar say aap ki bakhshish ki dua kerun ga .   beyshak woh mujh per boht meharban hai .

ayahs.text: aur mein aap logon  say bhi alag hota hun , aur Allah ko chorr ker aap log jinn jinn ki ibadat kertay hain , unn say bhi , aur mein apney perwerdigar ko pukarta rahun ga . mujhay poori umeed hai kay apney rab ko pukar ker mein na-murad nahi rahun ga .
ayahs.translation: aur mein aap logon  say bhi alag hota hun , aur Allah ko chorr ker aap log jinn jinn ki ibadat kertay hain , unn say bhi , aur mein apney perwerdigar ko pukarta rahun ga . mujhay poori umeed hai kay apney rab ko pukar ker mein na-murad nahi rahun ga .

ayahs.text: chunacheh jab woh unn say aur unn ( button ) say alag hogaye jinhen woh Allah kay bajaye pukara kertay thay , to hum ney unhen Ishaq aur Yaqoob ( jaisi aulad ) bakhshi, aur unn mein say her aik ko nabi banaya .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh jab woh unn say aur unn ( button ) say alag hogaye jinhen woh Allah kay bajaye pukara kertay thay , to hum ney unhen Ishaq aur Yaqoob ( jaisi aulad ) bakhshi, aur unn mein say her aik ko nabi banaya .

ayahs.text: aur unn ko apni rehmat say nawaza , aur unhen oonchay darjay ki naik naami ata ki .
ayahs.translation: aur unn ko apni rehmat say nawaza , aur unhen oonchay darjay ki naik naami ata ki .

ayahs.text: aur iss kitab mein musa ka bhi tazkarah kero . beyshak woh Allah kay chunay huye banday thay , aur Rasool aur nabi thay .
ayahs.translation: aur iss kitab mein musa ka bhi tazkarah kero . beyshak woh Allah kay chunay huye banday thay , aur Rasool aur nabi thay .

ayahs.text: hum ney unhen koh-e-toor ki dayen janib say pukara , aur unhen apna raz daar bana ker apna qurb ata kiya .
ayahs.translation: hum ney unhen koh-e-toor ki dayen janib say pukara , aur unhen apna raz daar bana ker apna qurb ata kiya .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney unn kay bhai Haroon ko nabi bana ker apni rehmat say unhen ( aik madadgaar ) ata kiya .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney unn kay bhai Haroon ko nabi bana ker apni rehmat say unhen ( aik madadgaar ) ata kiya .

ayahs.text: aur iss kitab mein Ismail ka bhi tazkarah kero . beyshak woh waday kay sachay thay ,   aur Rasool aur nabi thay .
ayahs.translation: aur iss kitab mein Ismail ka bhi tazkarah kero . beyshak woh waday kay sachay thay ,   aur Rasool aur nabi thay .

ayahs.text: aur woh apney ghar walon ko bhi namaz aur zakat ka hukum diya kertay thay , aur apney perwerdigar kay nazdeek pasandeeda thay .
ayahs.translation: aur woh apney ghar walon ko bhi namaz aur zakat ka hukum diya kertay thay , aur apney perwerdigar kay nazdeek pasandeeda thay .

ayahs.text: aur iss kitab mein Idrees ka bhi tazkarah kero . beyshak woh sachai kay khoogar nabi thay .
ayahs.translation: aur iss kitab mein Idrees ka bhi tazkarah kero . beyshak woh sachai kay khoogar nabi thay .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney unhen rafat dey ker aik buland maqam tak phoncha diya tha .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney unhen rafat dey ker aik buland maqam tak phoncha diya tha .

ayahs.text: Adam ki aulad mein say yeh woh nabi hain jinn per Allah ney inaam farmaya , aur inn mein say kuch unn logon  ki aulad mein say hain jinn ko hum ney nooh kay sath ( kashti mein ) sawar kiya tha , aur kuch Ibrahim aur Israel ( Yaqoob aleh-assalam ) ki aulad mein say hain . aur yeh sabb unn logon  mein say hain jinn ko hum ney hidayat di , aur ( apney deen kay liye ) muntakhib kiya . jab unn kay samney khudaye rehman ki aayaton ki tilawat ki jati toh yeh rotay huye sajday mein gir jatay thay .
ayahs.translation: Adam ki aulad mein say yeh woh nabi hain jinn per Allah ney inaam farmaya , aur inn mein say kuch unn logon  ki aulad mein say hain jinn ko hum ney nooh kay sath ( kashti mein ) sawar kiya tha , aur kuch Ibrahim aur Israel ( Yaqoob aleh-assalam ) ki aulad mein say hain . aur yeh sabb unn logon  mein say hain jinn ko hum ney hidayat di , aur ( apney deen kay liye ) muntakhib kiya . jab unn kay samney khudaye rehman ki aayaton ki tilawat ki jati toh yeh rotay huye sajday mein gir jatay thay .

ayahs.text: phir inn kay baad aesay log inn ki jagah aaye jinhon ney namazon ko barbad kiya , aur apni nafsani khuwaishaat kay peechay chalay . chunacheh inn ki gumrahi boht jald inn kay samney aajaye gi .
ayahs.translation: phir inn kay baad aesay log inn ki jagah aaye jinhon ney namazon ko barbad kiya , aur apni nafsani khuwaishaat kay peechay chalay . chunacheh inn ki gumrahi boht jald inn kay samney aajaye gi .

ayahs.text: albatta jinn logon  ney tauba kerli , aur emaan ley aaye , aur naik amal kiye , to aesay log jannat mein dakhil hon gay , aur unn per zara bhi zulm nahi hoga .
ayahs.translation: albatta jinn logon  ney tauba kerli , aur emaan ley aaye , aur naik amal kiye , to aesay log jannat mein dakhil hon gay , aur unn per zara bhi zulm nahi hoga .

ayahs.text: . ( unn ka dakhila ) aesay hamesha baqi rehney walay baaghaat mein ( hoga ) jinn ka khudaye rehman ney apney bandon say unn kay dekhay baghair wada ker rakha hai . yaqeenan uss ka wada aisa hai kay yeh uss tak zaroor phonchen gay .
ayahs.translation: . ( unn ka dakhila ) aesay hamesha baqi rehney walay baaghaat mein ( hoga ) jinn ka khudaye rehman ney apney bandon say unn kay dekhay baghair wada ker rakha hai . yaqeenan uss ka wada aisa hai kay yeh uss tak zaroor phonchen gay .

ayahs.text: woh uss mein salamti ki baaton kay siwa koi laghw baat nahi sunen gay . aur wahan unn ka rizq unhen subha o shaam mila keray ga .
ayahs.translation: woh uss mein salamti ki baaton kay siwa koi laghw baat nahi sunen gay . aur wahan unn ka rizq unhen subha o shaam mila keray ga .

ayahs.text: yeh hai woh jannat jiss ka waris hum apney bandon mein say uss ko banayen gay jo muttaqi ho .
ayahs.translation: yeh hai woh jannat jiss ka waris hum apney bandon mein say uss ko banayen gay jo muttaqi ho .

ayahs.text: aur ( farishtay tum say yeh kehtay hain kay ) hum aap kay rab kay hukum kay baghair utar ker nahi aatay .   jo kuch humaray aagay hai , aur jo kuch humaray peechay hai , aur jo kuch inn kay darmiyan hai , woh sabb ussi ki milkiyat hai . aur tumhara rab aisa nahi hai jo bhool jaya keray .
ayahs.translation: aur ( farishtay tum say yeh kehtay hain kay ) hum aap kay rab kay hukum kay baghair utar ker nahi aatay .   jo kuch humaray aagay hai , aur jo kuch humaray peechay hai , aur jo kuch inn kay darmiyan hai , woh sabb ussi ki milkiyat hai . aur tumhara rab aisa nahi hai jo bhool jaya keray .

ayahs.text: woh aasmano aur zameen ka bhi malik hai , aur jo makhlooqaat unn kay darmiyan hain , unn ka bhi . lehaza tum uss ki ibadat kero , aur uss ki ibadat per jamay raho . kiya tumharay ilm mein koi aur hai jo uss jaisi sifaat rakhta ho-?
ayahs.translation: woh aasmano aur zameen ka bhi malik hai , aur jo makhlooqaat unn kay darmiyan hain , unn ka bhi . lehaza tum uss ki ibadat kero , aur uss ki ibadat per jamay raho . kiya tumharay ilm mein koi aur hai jo uss jaisi sifaat rakhta ho-?

ayahs.text: aur ( kafir ) insan yeh kehta hai kay :  jab mein mar-chuka hun ga to kiya waqaee uss waqt mujhay zinda ker kay nikala jaye ga-?
ayahs.translation: aur ( kafir ) insan yeh kehta hai kay :  jab mein mar-chuka hun ga to kiya waqaee uss waqt mujhay zinda ker kay nikala jaye ga-?

ayahs.text: kiya iss insan ko yeh baat yaad nahi aati kay hum ney ussay shuroo mein uss waqt peda kiya tha jab woh kuch bhi nahi tha-?
ayahs.translation: kiya iss insan ko yeh baat yaad nahi aati kay hum ney ussay shuroo mein uss waqt peda kiya tha jab woh kuch bhi nahi tha-?

ayahs.text: to qasam hai tumharay perwerdigar ki ! hum inn ko aur inn kay sath saray shetanon ko zaroor ikattha keren gay ,   phir inn ko dozakh kay gird iss tarah ley ker ayen gay kay yeh sabb ghuttnon kay ball giray huye hon gay .
ayahs.translation: to qasam hai tumharay perwerdigar ki ! hum inn ko aur inn kay sath saray shetanon ko zaroor ikattha keren gay ,   phir inn ko dozakh kay gird iss tarah ley ker ayen gay kay yeh sabb ghuttnon kay ball giray huye hon gay .

ayahs.text: phir inn kay her giroh mein say unn logon  ko kheench nikalen gay jo khudaye rehman kay sath sarkashi kernay mein ziyada sakht thay .
ayahs.translation: phir inn kay her giroh mein say unn logon  ko kheench nikalen gay jo khudaye rehman kay sath sarkashi kernay mein ziyada sakht thay .

ayahs.text: phir yeh baat hum hi khoob jantay hain kay woh kon log hain jo sabb say pehlay iss dozakh mein jhonkay janey kay ziyada mustahiq hain .
ayahs.translation: phir yeh baat hum hi khoob jantay hain kay woh kon log hain jo sabb say pehlay iss dozakh mein jhonkay janey kay ziyada mustahiq hain .

ayahs.text: aur tum mein say koi nahi hai jiss ka iss ( dozakh ) per guzar naa ho .   iss baat ka tumharay perwerdigar ney hatmi tor per zimma ley rakha hai .
ayahs.translation: aur tum mein say koi nahi hai jiss ka iss ( dozakh ) per guzar naa ho .   iss baat ka tumharay perwerdigar ney hatmi tor per zimma ley rakha hai .

ayahs.text: phir jinn logon  ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya hai , unhen toh hum nijat dey den gay , aur jo zalim hain , unhen iss halat mein chorr den gay kay woh iss ( dozakh mein ) ghuttnon kay ball parray hon gay .
ayahs.translation: phir jinn logon  ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya hai , unhen toh hum nijat dey den gay , aur jo zalim hain , unhen iss halat mein chorr den gay kay woh iss ( dozakh mein ) ghuttnon kay ball parray hon gay .

ayahs.text: aur jab unn kay samney humari khuli khuli aayaten tilawat ki jati hain , toh kafir log mominon say kehtay hain kay :  batao , hum dono fareeqon mein say kiss ka maqam ziyada behtar hai , aur kiss ki majlis ziyada achi hai ?
ayahs.translation: aur jab unn kay samney humari khuli khuli aayaten tilawat ki jati hain , toh kafir log mominon say kehtay hain kay :  batao , hum dono fareeqon mein say kiss ka maqam ziyada behtar hai , aur kiss ki majlis ziyada achi hai ?

ayahs.text: aur ( yeh nahi dekhtay kay ) inn say pehlay hum kitni naslen halak ker-chukay hain , jo apney saz-o-saman aur zahiri aan baan mein inn say kahen behtar then .
ayahs.translation: aur ( yeh nahi dekhtay kay ) inn say pehlay hum kitni naslen halak ker-chukay hain , jo apney saz-o-saman aur zahiri aan baan mein inn say kahen behtar then .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  jo log gumrahi mein jaa parren toh unn kay liye munasib yehi hai kay khudaye rehman unhen khoob dheel deta rahey .  yahan tak kay jab yeh log woh cheez khud dekh len gay jiss say enhen daraya jaraha hai , chahye woh ( iss duniya ka ) azab ho , ya qayamat , to uss waqt enhen pata chalay ga kay bad-tareen maqam kiss ka tha , aur lashkar kiss ka ziyada kamzor tha .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  jo log gumrahi mein jaa parren toh unn kay liye munasib yehi hai kay khudaye rehman unhen khoob dheel deta rahey .  yahan tak kay jab yeh log woh cheez khud dekh len gay jiss say enhen daraya jaraha hai , chahye woh ( iss duniya ka ) azab ho , ya qayamat , to uss waqt enhen pata chalay ga kay bad-tareen maqam kiss ka tha , aur lashkar kiss ka ziyada kamzor tha .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney seedha raasta ikhtiyar kerliya hai , Allah unn ko hidayat mein aur taraqqi deta hai . aur jo naik amal baqi rehney walay hain , unn ka badla bhi tumharay perwerdigar kay yahan behtar milay ga , aur unn ka ( majmooi ) anjam bhi behtar hoga .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney seedha raasta ikhtiyar kerliya hai , Allah unn ko hidayat mein aur taraqqi deta hai . aur jo naik amal baqi rehney walay hain , unn ka badla bhi tumharay perwerdigar kay yahan behtar milay ga , aur unn ka ( majmooi ) anjam bhi behtar hoga .

ayahs.text: bhala tum ney uss shaks ko bhi dekha jiss ney humari aayaton ko manney say inkar kiya hai, aur yeh kaha hai kay :  mujhay maal aur aulad ( aakhirat mein bhi ) zaroor milen gay .
ayahs.translation: bhala tum ney uss shaks ko bhi dekha jiss ney humari aayaton ko manney say inkar kiya hai, aur yeh kaha hai kay :  mujhay maal aur aulad ( aakhirat mein bhi ) zaroor milen gay .

ayahs.text: kiya uss ney aalam-e-ghaib mein jhank ker dekh liya hai , ya uss ney khudaye rehman say koi ehad ley rakha hai-?
ayahs.translation: kiya uss ney aalam-e-ghaib mein jhank ker dekh liya hai , ya uss ney khudaye rehman say koi ehad ley rakha hai-?

ayahs.text: hergiz nahi ! jo kuch yeh keh raha hai , hum ussay bhi likh rakhen gay , aur uss kay azab mein aur izafa kerden gay .
ayahs.translation: hergiz nahi ! jo kuch yeh keh raha hai , hum ussay bhi likh rakhen gay , aur uss kay azab mein aur izafa kerden gay .

ayahs.text: aur jiss ( maal aur aulad ) ka yeh hawala dey raha hai , uss kay waris hum hon gay , aur yeh humaray paas tan e tanha aaye ga .
ayahs.translation: aur jiss ( maal aur aulad ) ka yeh hawala dey raha hai , uss kay waris hum hon gay , aur yeh humaray paas tan e tanha aaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur unn logon  ney Allah kay siwa doosray mabood iss liye bana rakhay hain takay woh inn ki pusht panahi keren .
ayahs.translation: aur unn logon  ney Allah kay siwa doosray mabood iss liye bana rakhay hain takay woh inn ki pusht panahi keren .

ayahs.text: yeh sabb ghalat baat hai ! woh toh inn ki ibadat hi ka inkar kerden gay , aur ultay inn kay mukhalif hojayen gay .
ayahs.translation: yeh sabb ghalat baat hai ! woh toh inn ki ibadat hi ka inkar kerden gay , aur ultay inn kay mukhalif hojayen gay .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya tumhen yeh maloom nahi hai kay hum ney kafiron per shayateen chorr rakhay hain jo enhen barabar uksatey rehtay hain-?
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya tumhen yeh maloom nahi hai kay hum ney kafiron per shayateen chorr rakhay hain jo enhen barabar uksatey rehtay hain-?

ayahs.text: lehaza tum inn kay moamlay mein jaldi naa kero . hum toh inn kay liye ginti ginn rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: lehaza tum inn kay moamlay mein jaldi naa kero . hum toh inn kay liye ginti ginn rahey hain .

ayahs.text: . ( uss din ko naa bhoolo ) jiss din hum saray muttaqi logon  ko mehman bana ker khudaye rehman kay paas jama keren gay ,
ayahs.translation: . ( uss din ko naa bhoolo ) jiss din hum saray muttaqi logon  ko mehman bana ker khudaye rehman kay paas jama keren gay ,

ayahs.text: aur mujrimon ko piyasay janweron ki tarah hanka ker dozakh ki taraf ley jayen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur mujrimon ko piyasay janweron ki tarah hanka ker dozakh ki taraf ley jayen gay .

ayahs.text: logon  ko kissi ki sifarish kernay ka ikhtiyar bhi nahi hoga , siwaye unn logon  kay jinhon ney khudaye rehman say koi ijazat hasil kerli ho .
ayahs.translation: logon  ko kissi ki sifarish kernay ka ikhtiyar bhi nahi hoga , siwaye unn logon  kay jinhon ney khudaye rehman say koi ijazat hasil kerli ho .

ayahs.text: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay khudaye rehman ki koi aulad hai !
ayahs.translation: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay khudaye rehman ki koi aulad hai !

ayahs.text: . ( aesi baat kehney walo ! ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum ney bari sangeen harkat ki hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( aesi baat kehney walo ! ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum ney bari sangeen harkat ki hai .

ayahs.text: kuch baeed nahi kay iss ki wajeh say aasman phatt parren , zameen shaqq hojaye aur pahar toot ker gir parren .
ayahs.translation: kuch baeed nahi kay iss ki wajeh say aasman phatt parren , zameen shaqq hojaye aur pahar toot ker gir parren .

ayahs.text: kay inn logon  ney khudaye rehman kay liye aulad honey ka dawa kiya hai .
ayahs.translation: kay inn logon  ney khudaye rehman kay liye aulad honey ka dawa kiya hai .

ayahs.text: halankay khudaye rehman ki yeh shaan nahi hai kay uss ki koi aulad ho .
ayahs.translation: halankay khudaye rehman ki yeh shaan nahi hai kay uss ki koi aulad ho .

ayahs.text: aasmano aur zameen mein jitney log hain , unn mein say koi aisa nahi hai jo khudaye rehman kay huzoor banda ban ker naa aaye .
ayahs.translation: aasmano aur zameen mein jitney log hain , unn mein say koi aisa nahi hai jo khudaye rehman kay huzoor banda ban ker naa aaye .

ayahs.text: yaqeen rakho kay uss ney sabb ka ehata ker rakha hai aur unhen khoob achi tarah gin rakha hai .
ayahs.translation: yaqeen rakho kay uss ney sabb ka ehata ker rakha hai aur unhen khoob achi tarah gin rakha hai .

ayahs.text: aur qayamat kay din unn mein say aik aik shaks uss kay paas akela aaye ga .
ayahs.translation: aur qayamat kay din unn mein say aik aik shaks uss kay paas akela aaye ga .

ayahs.text: . ( haan ) beyshak jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , khudaye rehman unn kay liye dilon mein mohabbat peda kerday ga .
ayahs.translation: . ( haan ) beyshak jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , khudaye rehman unn kay liye dilon mein mohabbat peda kerday ga .

ayahs.text: chunacheh ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney iss Quran ko tumhari zaban mein aasaan bana diya hai takay tum iss kay zariye muttaqi logon  ko khushkhabri do , aur issi kay zariye unn logon  ko darao jo zidd ki wajeh say jhagray per aamada hain .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney iss Quran ko tumhari zaban mein aasaan bana diya hai takay tum iss kay zariye muttaqi logon  ko khushkhabri do , aur issi kay zariye unn logon  ko darao jo zidd ki wajeh say jhagray per aamada hain .

ayahs.text: inn say pehlay hum kitni hi qoamon ko halak ker-chukay hain . kiya tumhen tatolney say bhi unn mein say kissi ka pata milta hai , ya unn mein say kissi ki bhanak bhi tumhen sunai deti hai-?
ayahs.translation: inn say pehlay hum kitni hi qoamon ko halak ker-chukay hain . kiya tumhen tatolney say bhi unn mein say kissi ka pata milta hai , ya unn mein say kissi ki bhanak bhi tumhen sunai deti hai-?

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: tua-haa   .
verses.translation: tua-haa   .

verses.text: hum ney tum per Quran iss liye nazil nahi kiya kay tum takleef uthao .
verses.translation: hum ney tum per Quran iss liye nazil nahi kiya kay tum takleef uthao .

verses.text: albatta yeh uss shaks kay liye aik naseehat hai jo darta ho .
verses.translation: albatta yeh uss shaks kay liye aik naseehat hai jo darta ho .

verses.text: issay uss zaat ki taraf say thora thora ker kay nazil kiya jaraha hai jiss ney zameen aur oonchay oonchay aasman peda kiye hain .
verses.translation: issay uss zaat ki taraf say thora thora ker kay nazil kiya jaraha hai jiss ney zameen aur oonchay oonchay aasman peda kiye hain .

verses.text: woh bari rehmat wala arsh per istawa farmaye huye hai .
verses.translation: woh bari rehmat wala arsh per istawa farmaye huye hai .

verses.text: aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , aur unn kay darmiyan jo kuch hai , woh sabb bhi ussi ki milkiyat hai , aur zameen ki tehon kay neechay jo kuch hai woh bhi .
verses.translation: aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , aur unn kay darmiyan jo kuch hai , woh sabb bhi ussi ki milkiyat hai , aur zameen ki tehon kay neechay jo kuch hai woh bhi .

verses.text: agar tum koi baat buland aawaz say kaho ( ya aahista ) , to woh chupkay say kahi hoi baaton ko , balkay aur ziyada chupi hoi baaton ko bhi janta hai .
verses.translation: agar tum koi baat buland aawaz say kaho ( ya aahista ) , to woh chupkay say kahi hoi baaton ko , balkay aur ziyada chupi hoi baaton ko bhi janta hai .

verses.text: Allah woh hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . ussi kay achay achay naam hain .
verses.translation: Allah woh hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . ussi kay achay achay naam hain .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya tum tak musa ka waqiaa phoncha hai-?
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya tum tak musa ka waqiaa phoncha hai-?

verses.text: yeh uss waqt ki baat hai jab unn ko aik aag nazar aai to unhon ney apney ghar walon say kaha :  tum yahin thehrao , mein ney aik aag dekhi hai . shayad mein uss mein say koi shola tumharay paas ley aaon , ya uss aag kay paas mujhay raastay ka pata mil jaye .
verses.translation: yeh uss waqt ki baat hai jab unn ko aik aag nazar aai to unhon ney apney ghar walon say kaha :  tum yahin thehrao , mein ney aik aag dekhi hai . shayad mein uss mein say koi shola tumharay paas ley aaon , ya uss aag kay paas mujhay raastay ka pata mil jaye .

verses.text: chunacheh jab woh aag kay paas phonchay to unhen aawaz di gaee kay :  aey musa !
verses.translation: chunacheh jab woh aag kay paas phonchay to unhen aawaz di gaee kay :  aey musa !

verses.text: yaqeen say jaan lo kay mein hi tumhara rab hun .   abb tum apney jootay utaar do . tum iss waqt toowa ki muqaddas wadi mein ho .
verses.translation: yaqeen say jaan lo kay mein hi tumhara rab hun .   abb tum apney jootay utaar do . tum iss waqt toowa ki muqaddas wadi mein ho .

verses.text: aur mein ney tumhen ( nabwooat kay liye ) muntakhib kiya hai . lehaza jo baat wahi kay zariye kahi jarahi hai , ussay ghor say suno .
verses.translation: aur mein ney tumhen ( nabwooat kay liye ) muntakhib kiya hai . lehaza jo baat wahi kay zariye kahi jarahi hai , ussay ghor say suno .

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay mein hi Allah hun . meray siwa koi mabood nahi hai , iss liye meri ibadat kero , aur mujhay yaad rakhney kay liye namaz qaeem kero .
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay mein hi Allah hun . meray siwa koi mabood nahi hai , iss liye meri ibadat kero , aur mujhay yaad rakhney kay liye namaz qaeem kero .

verses.text: yaqeen rakho kay qayamat ki gharri aaney wali hai . mein uss ( kay waqt ) ko khufiya rakhna chahta hun , takay her shaks ko uss kay kiye ka badla milay .
verses.translation: yaqeen rakho kay qayamat ki gharri aaney wali hai . mein uss ( kay waqt ) ko khufiya rakhna chahta hun , takay her shaks ko uss kay kiye ka badla milay .

verses.text: lehaza koi essa shaks tumhen iss say hergiz ghafil naa kernay paye jo iss per emaan naa rakhta ho . aur apni khuwaishaat kay peechay chalta ho , werna tum halakat mein parr-jao gay .
verses.translation: lehaza koi essa shaks tumhen iss say hergiz ghafil naa kernay paye jo iss per emaan naa rakhta ho . aur apni khuwaishaat kay peechay chalta ho , werna tum halakat mein parr-jao gay .

verses.text: aur musa ! yeh tumharay dayen haath mein kiya hai-?
verses.translation: aur musa ! yeh tumharay dayen haath mein kiya hai-?

verses.text: musa ney kaha :  yeh meri laathi hai . mein iss ka sahara leta hun , aur iss say apni bakriyon per ( darkht say ) pattay jharrta hun , aur iss say meri doosri zarooriyaat bhi poori hoti hain .
verses.translation: musa ney kaha :  yeh meri laathi hai . mein iss ka sahara leta hun , aur iss say apni bakriyon per ( darkht say ) pattay jharrta hun , aur iss say meri doosri zarooriyaat bhi poori hoti hain .

verses.text: farmaya :  musa ! issay neechay phenk do
verses.translation: farmaya :  musa ! issay neechay phenk do

verses.text: chunacheh unhon ney ussay phenk diya . bus phir kiya tha ! woh achanak aik dorrta huwa saanp ban gaee .
verses.translation: chunacheh unhon ney ussay phenk diya . bus phir kiya tha ! woh achanak aik dorrta huwa saanp ban gaee .

verses.text: Allah ney farmaya :  issay pakar lo , aur daro nahi . hum abhi issay iss ki pichli halat per loata den gay .
verses.translation: Allah ney farmaya :  issay pakar lo , aur daro nahi . hum abhi issay iss ki pichli halat per loata den gay .

verses.text: aur apney haath ko apni baghal mein dabao , woh kissi beemari kay baghair safaid ho ker niklay ga .   yeh ( tumhari nabwooat ki ) aik aur nishani hogi .
verses.translation: aur apney haath ko apni baghal mein dabao , woh kissi beemari kay baghair safaid ho ker niklay ga .   yeh ( tumhari nabwooat ki ) aik aur nishani hogi .

verses.text: . ( yeh hum iss liye ker rahey hain ) takay apni bari nishaniyon mein say kuch tumhen dikhayen .
verses.translation: . ( yeh hum iss liye ker rahey hain ) takay apni bari nishaniyon mein say kuch tumhen dikhayen .

verses.text: . ( abb ) firon kay paas jao . woh sarkashi mein hadd say nikal gaya hai .
verses.translation: . ( abb ) firon kay paas jao . woh sarkashi mein hadd say nikal gaya hai .

verses.text: musa ney kaha :  perwerdigar ! meri khatir mera seena khol dijiye ,
verses.translation: musa ney kaha :  perwerdigar ! meri khatir mera seena khol dijiye ,

verses.text: aur meray liye mera kaam aasaan bana dijiye ,
verses.translation: aur meray liye mera kaam aasaan bana dijiye ,

verses.text: aur meri zaban mein jo girah hai , ussay door ker-dijiye ,
verses.translation: aur meri zaban mein jo girah hai , ussay door ker-dijiye ,

verses.text: takay log meri baat samajh saken .
verses.translation: takay log meri baat samajh saken .

verses.text: aur meray liye meray khandan hi kay aik fard ko madadgaar muqarrar ker-dijiye ,
verses.translation: aur meray liye meray khandan hi kay aik fard ko madadgaar muqarrar ker-dijiye ,

verses.text: yani Haroon ko jo meray bhai hain !
verses.translation: yani Haroon ko jo meray bhai hain !

verses.text: unn kay zariye meri taqat mazboot ker-dijiye ,
verses.translation: unn kay zariye meri taqat mazboot ker-dijiye ,

verses.text: aur unn ko mera shareek-e-kaar bana dijiye ,
verses.translation: aur unn ko mera shareek-e-kaar bana dijiye ,

verses.text: takay hum kasrat say aap ki tasbeeh keren ,
verses.translation: takay hum kasrat say aap ki tasbeeh keren ,

verses.text: aur kasrat say aap ka ziker keren .
verses.translation: aur kasrat say aap ka ziker keren .

verses.text: beyshak aap hamen achi tarah dekhney walay hain .
verses.translation: beyshak aap hamen achi tarah dekhney walay hain .

verses.text: Allah ney farmaya :  musa ! tum ney jo kuch maanga hai , tumhen dey diya gaya ,
verses.translation: Allah ney farmaya :  musa ! tum ney jo kuch maanga hai , tumhen dey diya gaya ,

verses.text: aur hum ney tum per aik aur martaba bhi ehsan kiya tha ,
verses.translation: aur hum ney tum per aik aur martaba bhi ehsan kiya tha ,

verses.text: jab hum ney tumhari maa say wahi kay zariye woh baat kahi thi jo abb wahi kay zariye ( tumhen ) batai jarahi hai .
verses.translation: jab hum ney tumhari maa say wahi kay zariye woh baat kahi thi jo abb wahi kay zariye ( tumhen ) batai jarahi hai .

verses.text: kay iss ( bacchay ) ko sandooq mein rakho , phir iss sandooq ko darya mein daal do .   phir darya ko chorr do kay woh ussay sahil kay paas laaker daal dey , jiss kay nateejay mein aik aisa shaks uss ( bacchay ) ko utha ley ga jo mera bhi dushman hoga , aur iss ka bhi dushman .   aur mein ney apni taraf say tum per aik mehboobiyat nazil kerdi thi ,   aur yeh sabb iss liye kiya tha takay tum meri nigrani mein perwerish pao .
verses.translation: kay iss ( bacchay ) ko sandooq mein rakho , phir iss sandooq ko darya mein daal do .   phir darya ko chorr do kay woh ussay sahil kay paas laaker daal dey , jiss kay nateejay mein aik aisa shaks uss ( bacchay ) ko utha ley ga jo mera bhi dushman hoga , aur iss ka bhi dushman .   aur mein ney apni taraf say tum per aik mehboobiyat nazil kerdi thi ,   aur yeh sabb iss liye kiya tha takay tum meri nigrani mein perwerish pao .

verses.text: uss waqt ka tasawwur kero jab tumhari behan ghar say chalti hai , aur ( firon kay kaarindon say ) yeh kehti hai kay :  kiya mein tumhen uss ( aurat ) ka pata bataon jo iss ( bacchay ) ko paalay-?    iss tarah hum ney tumhen tumhari maa kay paas loata diya , takay uss ki aankh thandi rahey , aur woh ghumgeen naa ho . aur tum ney aik shaks ko maar daala tha ,   phir hum ney tumhen uss ghuttan say nijat di , aur tumhen kaee aazmaeshon say guzaara .   phir tum kaee saal madiyan walon mein rahey , uss kay baad aey musa ! tum aik aesay waqt per yahan aaye ho jo pehlay say muqaddar tha ,
verses.translation: uss waqt ka tasawwur kero jab tumhari behan ghar say chalti hai , aur ( firon kay kaarindon say ) yeh kehti hai kay :  kiya mein tumhen uss ( aurat ) ka pata bataon jo iss ( bacchay ) ko paalay-?    iss tarah hum ney tumhen tumhari maa kay paas loata diya , takay uss ki aankh thandi rahey , aur woh ghumgeen naa ho . aur tum ney aik shaks ko maar daala tha ,   phir hum ney tumhen uss ghuttan say nijat di , aur tumhen kaee aazmaeshon say guzaara .   phir tum kaee saal madiyan walon mein rahey , uss kay baad aey musa ! tum aik aesay waqt per yahan aaye ho jo pehlay say muqaddar tha ,

verses.text: aur mein ney tumhen khaas apney liye banaya hai .
verses.translation: aur mein ney tumhen khaas apney liye banaya hai .

verses.text: tum aur tumhara bhai dono meri nishaniyan ley ker jao , aur mera ziker kernay mein susti naa kerna .
verses.translation: tum aur tumhara bhai dono meri nishaniyan ley ker jao , aur mera ziker kernay mein susti naa kerna .

verses.text: dono firon kay paas jao . woh hadd say aagay nikal chuka hai .
verses.translation: dono firon kay paas jao . woh hadd say aagay nikal chuka hai .

verses.text: jaker dono uss say narmi say baat kerna , shayad woh naseehat qubool keray , ya ( Allah say ) darr jaye .
verses.translation: jaker dono uss say narmi say baat kerna , shayad woh naseehat qubool keray , ya ( Allah say ) darr jaye .

verses.text: dono ney kaha :  humaray perwerdigar ! hamen andesha hai kay kahen woh hum per ziyadti naa keray , ya kahen sarkashi per aamada naa hojaye .
verses.translation: dono ney kaha :  humaray perwerdigar ! hamen andesha hai kay kahen woh hum per ziyadti naa keray , ya kahen sarkashi per aamada naa hojaye .

verses.text: Allah ney farmaya :  daro nahi , mein tumharay sath hun , sunn bhi raha hun , aur dekh bhi raha hun .
verses.translation: Allah ney farmaya :  daro nahi , mein tumharay sath hun , sunn bhi raha hun , aur dekh bhi raha hun .

verses.text: abb uss kay paas jao , aur kaho kay hum dono tumharay rab kay payghumber hain , iss liye bani Israel ko humaray sath bhej do , aur unhen takleefen naa phonchao , hum tumharay paas tumharay rab ki taraf say nishani ley ker aaye hain , aur salamti ussi kay liye hai jo hidayat ki perwi keray .
verses.translation: abb uss kay paas jao , aur kaho kay hum dono tumharay rab kay payghumber hain , iss liye bani Israel ko humaray sath bhej do , aur unhen takleefen naa phonchao , hum tumharay paas tumharay rab ki taraf say nishani ley ker aaye hain , aur salamti ussi kay liye hai jo hidayat ki perwi keray .

verses.text: hum per yeh wahi nazil ki gaee hai kay azab uss ko hoga jo ( haq ko ) jhutlaye , aur mun morray .
verses.translation: hum per yeh wahi nazil ki gaee hai kay azab uss ko hoga jo ( haq ko ) jhutlaye , aur mun morray .

verses.text: . ( yeh sari baaten sunn ker ) firon ney kaha :  musa ! tum dono ka rab kon ?
verses.translation: . ( yeh sari baaten sunn ker ) firon ney kaha :  musa ! tum dono ka rab kon ?

verses.text: musa ney kaha :  humara rab woh hai jiss ney her cheez ko woh banawat ata ki jo uss kay munasib thi , phir ( uss ki ) rehnumai bhi farmaee .
verses.translation: musa ney kaha :  humara rab woh hai jiss ney her cheez ko woh banawat ata ki jo uss kay munasib thi , phir ( uss ki ) rehnumai bhi farmaee .

verses.text: firon bola :  acha phir unn qoamon ka kiya moamla huwa jo pehlay guzar chuki hain-?
verses.translation: firon bola :  acha phir unn qoamon ka kiya moamla huwa jo pehlay guzar chuki hain-?

verses.text: musa ney kaha :  unn ka ilm meray rab kay paas aik kitab mein mehfooz hai . meray rab ko naa koi ghalati lagti hai , naa woh bhoolta hai .
verses.translation: musa ney kaha :  unn ka ilm meray rab kay paas aik kitab mein mehfooz hai . meray rab ko naa koi ghalati lagti hai , naa woh bhoolta hai .

verses.text: yeh woh zaat hai jiss ney zameen ko tumharay liye farsh bana diya , aur uss mein tumharay liye raastay banaye , aur aasman say paani barsaya , phir hum ney uss kay zariye tarah tarah ki mukhtalif nabataat nikalen .
verses.translation: yeh woh zaat hai jiss ney zameen ko tumharay liye farsh bana diya , aur uss mein tumharay liye raastay banaye , aur aasman say paani barsaya , phir hum ney uss kay zariye tarah tarah ki mukhtalif nabataat nikalen .

verses.text: khud bhi khao , aur apney maweshiyon ko bhi charao . yaqeenan inn/unn sabb baaton mein aqal walon kay liye bari nishaniyan hain .
verses.translation: khud bhi khao , aur apney maweshiyon ko bhi charao . yaqeenan inn/unn sabb baaton mein aqal walon kay liye bari nishaniyan hain .

verses.text: issi zameen say hum ney tumhen peda kiya tha , issi mein hum tumhen wapis ley jayen gay , aur issi say aik martaba phir tumhen nikal layen gay .
verses.translation: issi zameen say hum ney tumhen peda kiya tha , issi mein hum tumhen wapis ley jayen gay , aur issi say aik martaba phir tumhen nikal layen gay .

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney uss ( firon ) ko apni sari nishaniyan dikhayen , magar woh jhutlata hi raha , aur maan ker nahi diya .
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney uss ( firon ) ko apni sari nishaniyan dikhayen , magar woh jhutlata hi raha , aur maan ker nahi diya .

verses.text: kehney laga :  musa ! kiya tum iss liye aaye ho kay apney jadoo kay zariye hamen apni zameen say nikal bahir kero-?
verses.translation: kehney laga :  musa ! kiya tum iss liye aaye ho kay apney jadoo kay zariye hamen apni zameen say nikal bahir kero-?

verses.text: acha to hum bhi tumharay samney aisa hi jadoo laa ker rahen gay . abb tum kissi khulay meydan mein humaray aur apney darmiyan muqablay ka aisa waqt tey kerlo jiss ki khilaf warzi naa hum keren , naa tum kero .
verses.translation: acha to hum bhi tumharay samney aisa hi jadoo laa ker rahen gay . abb tum kissi khulay meydan mein humaray aur apney darmiyan muqablay ka aisa waqt tey kerlo jiss ki khilaf warzi naa hum keren , naa tum kero .

verses.text: musa ney kaha :  tum say woh din tey hai jiss mein jashan manaya jata hai .   aur yeh bhi tey hai kay din charrhay hi logon  ko jama kerliya jaye .
verses.translation: musa ney kaha :  tum say woh din tey hai jiss mein jashan manaya jata hai .   aur yeh bhi tey hai kay din charrhay hi logon  ko jama kerliya jaye .

verses.text: chunacheh firon ( apni jagah ) wapis chala gaya , aur uss ney apni sari tadbeeren ikhatti ken , phir ( muqablay kay liye ) aagaya .
verses.translation: chunacheh firon ( apni jagah ) wapis chala gaya , aur uss ney apni sari tadbeeren ikhatti ken , phir ( muqablay kay liye ) aagaya .

verses.text: musa ney unn ( jadoogaron say ) kaha :  afsos hai tum per ! Allah per bohtan naa baandho ,   werna woh aik sakht azab say tumhen malya mait kerday ga , aur jo koi bohtan baandhta hai , na-murad hota hai .
verses.translation: musa ney unn ( jadoogaron say ) kaha :  afsos hai tum per ! Allah per bohtan naa baandho ,   werna woh aik sakht azab say tumhen malya mait kerday ga , aur jo koi bohtan baandhta hai , na-murad hota hai .

verses.text: iss per unn kay darmiyan apni raye qaeem kernay mein ikhtilaf hogaya , aur woh chupkay chupkay sargoshiyan kernay lagay .
verses.translation: iss per unn kay darmiyan apni raye qaeem kernay mein ikhtilaf hogaya , aur woh chupkay chupkay sargoshiyan kernay lagay .

verses.text: . ( aakhir kaar ) unhon ney kaha kay :  yaqeeni tor per yeh dono ( yani musa aur Haroon ) jadoogar hain jo yeh chahtay hain kay apney jadoo kay zor per tum logon  ko tumhari sarzameen say nikal bahir keren , aur tumharay behtareen ( deeni ) tareeqay ka khatima hi ker daalen .
verses.translation: . ( aakhir kaar ) unhon ney kaha kay :  yaqeeni tor per yeh dono ( yani musa aur Haroon ) jadoogar hain jo yeh chahtay hain kay apney jadoo kay zor per tum logon  ko tumhari sarzameen say nikal bahir keren , aur tumharay behtareen ( deeni ) tareeqay ka khatima hi ker daalen .

verses.text: lehaza apni sari tadbeeren pukhta kerlo , phir saff baandh ker aao , aur yaqeen rakho kay aaj jo ghalib aajaye ga , falah ussi ko hasil hogi .
verses.translation: lehaza apni sari tadbeeren pukhta kerlo , phir saff baandh ker aao , aur yaqeen rakho kay aaj jo ghalib aajaye ga , falah ussi ko hasil hogi .

verses.text: jadoogar bolay :  musa ! ya to tum ( apni laathi pehlay ) daal do , ya phir hum daalney mein pehal keren ?
verses.translation: jadoogar bolay :  musa ! ya to tum ( apni laathi pehlay ) daal do , ya phir hum daalney mein pehal keren ?

verses.text: musa ney kaha :  nahi , tum hi daalo  bus phir achanak unn ki ( daali hoi ) rassiyan aur lathiyan unn kay jadoo kay nateejay mein musa ko aesi mehsoos honey lagen jaisay dorr rahi hain .
verses.translation: musa ney kaha :  nahi , tum hi daalo  bus phir achanak unn ki ( daali hoi ) rassiyan aur lathiyan unn kay jadoo kay nateejay mein musa ko aesi mehsoos honey lagen jaisay dorr rahi hain .

verses.text: iss per musa ko apney dil mein kuch khof mehsoos huwa .
verses.translation: iss per musa ko apney dil mein kuch khof mehsoos huwa .

verses.text: hum ney kaha :  daro nahi , yaqeen rakho tum hi tum sarbuland raho gay .
verses.translation: hum ney kaha :  daro nahi , yaqeen rakho tum hi tum sarbuland raho gay .

verses.text: aur jo ( laathi ) tumharay dayen haath mein hai , ussay ( zameen per ) daal do , inn logon  ney jo karigari ki hai , woh uss sabb ko nigal jaye gi . unn ki sari karigari aik jadoogar kay kartab kay siwa kuch nahi , aur jadoogar chahye kahen chala jaye , ussay falah naseeb nahi hoti .
verses.translation: aur jo ( laathi ) tumharay dayen haath mein hai , ussay ( zameen per ) daal do , inn logon  ney jo karigari ki hai , woh uss sabb ko nigal jaye gi . unn ki sari karigari aik jadoogar kay kartab kay siwa kuch nahi , aur jadoogar chahye kahen chala jaye , ussay falah naseeb nahi hoti .

verses.text: chunacheh ( yehi huwa aur ) saray jadoogar sajday mein gira diye gaye .   kehney lagay kay :  hum Haroon aur musa kay rab per emaan ley aaye .
verses.translation: chunacheh ( yehi huwa aur ) saray jadoogar sajday mein gira diye gaye .   kehney lagay kay :  hum Haroon aur musa kay rab per emaan ley aaye .

verses.text: firon bola :  tum inn per meray ijazat denay say pehlay hi emaan ley aaye . mujhay yaqeen hai kay yeh ( musa ) tum sabb ka sarghana hai jiss ney tumhen jadoo sikhlaya hai . abb mein ney bhi paka irada kerliya hai kay tumharay haath paon mukhalif samton say kaatun ga , aur tumhen khujoor kay tanon per sooli charhaon ga . aur tumhen yaqeenan pata lagg jaye ga kay hum dono mein say kiss ka azab ziyada sakht aur dairpa hai .
verses.translation: firon bola :  tum inn per meray ijazat denay say pehlay hi emaan ley aaye . mujhay yaqeen hai kay yeh ( musa ) tum sabb ka sarghana hai jiss ney tumhen jadoo sikhlaya hai . abb mein ney bhi paka irada kerliya hai kay tumharay haath paon mukhalif samton say kaatun ga , aur tumhen khujoor kay tanon per sooli charhaon ga . aur tumhen yaqeenan pata lagg jaye ga kay hum dono mein say kiss ka azab ziyada sakht aur dairpa hai .

verses.text: jadoogaron ney kaha :  qasam uss zaat ki jiss ney hamen peda kiya hai ! humaray samney jo roshan nishaniyan aagae hain , unn per hum tumhen hergiz tarjeeh nahi dey saktay . abb tumhen jo kuch kerna ho , kerlo . tum jo kuch bhi kero gay , issi dunyawi zindagi kay liye hoga .
verses.translation: jadoogaron ney kaha :  qasam uss zaat ki jiss ney hamen peda kiya hai ! humaray samney jo roshan nishaniyan aagae hain , unn per hum tumhen hergiz tarjeeh nahi dey saktay . abb tumhen jo kuch kerna ho , kerlo . tum jo kuch bhi kero gay , issi dunyawi zindagi kay liye hoga .

verses.text: hum to apney rab per emaan laa-chukay hain , takay woh humaray gunahon ko bhi bakhsh dey , aur jadoo kay uss kaam ko bhi jiss per tum ney hamen majboor kiya .   aur Allah hi sabb say acha aur hamesha baqi rehney wala hai .
verses.translation: hum to apney rab per emaan laa-chukay hain , takay woh humaray gunahon ko bhi bakhsh dey , aur jadoo kay uss kaam ko bhi jiss per tum ney hamen majboor kiya .   aur Allah hi sabb say acha aur hamesha baqi rehney wala hai .

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo shaks apney perwerdigar kay paas mujrim ban ker aaye ga , uss kay liye jahannum hai jiss mein naa woh maray ga aur naa jiye ga .
