verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo shaks apney perwerdigar kay paas mujrim ban ker aaye ga , uss kay liye jahannum hai jiss mein naa woh maray ga aur naa jiye ga .

verses.text: aur jo shaks uss kay paas momin ban ker aaye ga jiss ney naik amal bhi kiye hon gay , to aesay hi logon  kay liye buland darjaat hain ,
verses.translation: aur jo shaks uss kay paas momin ban ker aaye ga jiss ney naik amal bhi kiye hon gay , to aesay hi logon  kay liye buland darjaat hain ,

verses.text: woh hamesha rehney walay baaghaat jinn kay neechay say nehren behti hon gi , jinn mein woh hamesha rahen gay ! aur yeh sila hai uss ka jiss ney pakeezgi ikhtiyar ki .
verses.translation: woh hamesha rehney walay baaghaat jinn kay neechay say nehren behti hon gi , jinn mein woh hamesha rahen gay ! aur yeh sila hai uss ka jiss ney pakeezgi ikhtiyar ki .

verses.text: aur hum ney musa per wahi bheji kay :  tum meray bandon ko ley ker raaton raat rawana hojao ,   phir unn kay liye samandar mein aik khushk raasta iss tarah nikal lena kay naa tumhen ( dushman kay ) aa-pakarney ka andesha rahey , aur naa koi aur khof ho .
verses.translation: aur hum ney musa per wahi bheji kay :  tum meray bandon ko ley ker raaton raat rawana hojao ,   phir unn kay liye samandar mein aik khushk raasta iss tarah nikal lena kay naa tumhen ( dushman kay ) aa-pakarney ka andesha rahey , aur naa koi aur khof ho .

verses.text: chunacheh firon ney apney lashkaron samet unn ka peecha kiya to samandar ki jiss ( khofnak ) cheez ney unhen dhaanpa , woh unhen dhaanp ker hi rahi .
verses.translation: chunacheh firon ney apney lashkaron samet unn ka peecha kiya to samandar ki jiss ( khofnak ) cheez ney unhen dhaanpa , woh unhen dhaanp ker hi rahi .

verses.text: aur firon ney apni qoam ko buray raastay per lagaya , aur unhen sahih raasta naa dikhaya .
verses.translation: aur firon ney apni qoam ko buray raastay per lagaya , aur unhen sahih raasta naa dikhaya .

verses.text: aey bani Israel ! hum ney tumhen tumharay dushman say nijat di , aur tum say koh-e-toor kay dayen janib aaney ka wada thehraya , aur tum per mann-o-salwa nazil kiya .
verses.translation: aey bani Israel ! hum ney tumhen tumharay dushman say nijat di , aur tum say koh-e-toor kay dayen janib aaney ka wada thehraya , aur tum per mann-o-salwa nazil kiya .

verses.text: jo pakeezah rizq hum ney tumhen ata kiya hai , uss mein say khao , aur uss mein sarkashi naa kero jiss kay nateejay mein tum per mera ghazab nazil hojaye . aur jiss kissi per mera ghazab nazil hojata hai , woh tabahi mein gir ker rehta hai .
verses.translation: jo pakeezah rizq hum ney tumhen ata kiya hai , uss mein say khao , aur uss mein sarkashi naa kero jiss kay nateejay mein tum per mera ghazab nazil hojaye . aur jiss kissi per mera ghazab nazil hojata hai , woh tabahi mein gir ker rehta hai .

verses.text: aur yeh bhi haqeeqat hai kay jo shaks tauba keray , emaan laye , aur naik amal keray , phir seedhay raastay per qaeem rahey to mein uss kay liye boht bakhshney wala hun .
verses.translation: aur yeh bhi haqeeqat hai kay jo shaks tauba keray , emaan laye , aur naik amal keray , phir seedhay raastay per qaeem rahey to mein uss kay liye boht bakhshney wala hun .

verses.text: aur ( jab musa koh-e-toor per apney logon  say pehlay chalay aaye to Allah ney unn say kaha : )  musa ! tum apni qoam say pehlay jaldi kiyon aagaye ?
verses.translation: aur ( jab musa koh-e-toor per apney logon  say pehlay chalay aaye to Allah ney unn say kaha : )  musa ! tum apni qoam say pehlay jaldi kiyon aagaye ?

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  woh meray peechay peechay aaya hi chahtay hain , aur perwerdigar ! mein aap kay paas iss liye jaldi aagaya takay aap khush hon .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  woh meray peechay peechay aaya hi chahtay hain , aur perwerdigar ! mein aap kay paas iss liye jaldi aagaya takay aap khush hon .

verses.text: Allah ney farmaya :  phir tumharay aaney kay baad hum ney tumhari qoam ko fitney mein mubtala kerdiya hai , aur unhen saamri ney gumrah ker daala hai .
verses.translation: Allah ney farmaya :  phir tumharay aaney kay baad hum ney tumhari qoam ko fitney mein mubtala kerdiya hai , aur unhen saamri ney gumrah ker daala hai .

verses.text: chunacheh musa ghum o ghussay mein bharay huye apni qoam kay paas wapis lotay . kehney lagay :  meri qoam kay logo ! kiya tumharay perwerdigar ney tum say aik acha wada nahi kiya tha-?   to kiya tum per koi boht lambi mauddat guzar gaee thi ,   ya tum chahtay hi yeh thay kay tum per tumharay rab ka ghazab nazil hojaye , aur iss wajeh say tum ney mujh say wada khilafi ki-?
verses.translation: chunacheh musa ghum o ghussay mein bharay huye apni qoam kay paas wapis lotay . kehney lagay :  meri qoam kay logo ! kiya tumharay perwerdigar ney tum say aik acha wada nahi kiya tha-?   to kiya tum per koi boht lambi mauddat guzar gaee thi ,   ya tum chahtay hi yeh thay kay tum per tumharay rab ka ghazab nazil hojaye , aur iss wajeh say tum ney mujh say wada khilafi ki-?

verses.text: kehney lagay :  hum ney apney ikhtiyar say aap kay waday ki khilaf warzi nahi ki , balkay huwa yeh kay hum per logon  kay zewraat kay bojh laday huye thay , iss liye hum ney unhen phenk diya ,   phir issi tarah saamri ney kuch daala
verses.translation: kehney lagay :  hum ney apney ikhtiyar say aap kay waday ki khilaf warzi nahi ki , balkay huwa yeh kay hum per logon  kay zewraat kay bojh laday huye thay , iss liye hum ney unhen phenk diya ,   phir issi tarah saamri ney kuch daala

verses.text: aur logon  kay samney aik bachrra bana ker nikal liya , aik jism tha jiss mein say aawaz nikalti thi . log kehney lagay kay :  yeh tumhara mabood hai , aur musa ka bhi mabood hai , magar musa bhool gaye hain .
verses.translation: aur logon  kay samney aik bachrra bana ker nikal liya , aik jism tha jiss mein say aawaz nikalti thi . log kehney lagay kay :  yeh tumhara mabood hai , aur musa ka bhi mabood hai , magar musa bhool gaye hain .

verses.text: bhala kiya unhen yeh nazar nahi aaraha tha kay woh naa unn ki baat ka jawab deta tha aur naa unn ko koi nuqsan ya nafaa phoncha sakta tha-?
verses.translation: bhala kiya unhen yeh nazar nahi aaraha tha kay woh naa unn ki baat ka jawab deta tha aur naa unn ko koi nuqsan ya nafaa phoncha sakta tha-?

verses.text: aur Haroon ney unn say pehlay hi kaha tha kay :  meri qoam kay logo ! tum iss ( bachrray ) ki wajeh say fitney mein mubtala hogaye ho , aur haqeeqat mein tumhara rab to rehman hai , iss liye tum meray peechay chalo aur meri baat maano .
verses.translation: aur Haroon ney unn say pehlay hi kaha tha kay :  meri qoam kay logo ! tum iss ( bachrray ) ki wajeh say fitney mein mubtala hogaye ho , aur haqeeqat mein tumhara rab to rehman hai , iss liye tum meray peechay chalo aur meri baat maano .

verses.text: woh kehney lagay kay :  jab tak musa wapis naa aajayen , hum to issi ki ibadat per jamay rahen gay .
verses.translation: woh kehney lagay kay :  jab tak musa wapis naa aajayen , hum to issi ki ibadat per jamay rahen gay .

verses.text: musa ney ( wapis aa-ker ) kaha :  Haroon ! jab tum ney dekh liya tha kay yeh log gumrah hogaye hain to tumhen kiss cheez ney roka tha
verses.translation: musa ney ( wapis aa-ker ) kaha :  Haroon ! jab tum ney dekh liya tha kay yeh log gumrah hogaye hain to tumhen kiss cheez ney roka tha

verses.text: kay tum meray peechay chalay aatay-? bhala kiya tum ney meri baat ki khilaf warzi ki-?
verses.translation: kay tum meray peechay chalay aatay-? bhala kiya tum ney meri baat ki khilaf warzi ki-?

verses.text: Haroon ney kaha :  meray maa kay betay ! meri daarhi naa pakro , aur naa mera sar . haqeeqat mein mujhay yeh andesha tha kay tum yeh kaho gay kay tum ney bani Israel mein tafarqa daal diya , aur meri baat ka paas nahi kiya .
verses.translation: Haroon ney kaha :  meray maa kay betay ! meri daarhi naa pakro , aur naa mera sar . haqeeqat mein mujhay yeh andesha tha kay tum yeh kaho gay kay tum ney bani Israel mein tafarqa daal diya , aur meri baat ka paas nahi kiya .

verses.text: musa ney kaha :  acha to saamri ! tujhay kiya huwa tha-?
verses.translation: musa ney kaha :  acha to saamri ! tujhay kiya huwa tha-?

verses.text: woh bola :  mein ney aik aesi cheez dekh li thi jo doosron ko nazar nahi aai thi . iss liye mein ney Rasool kay naqsh-e-qadam say aik mutthi uthali , aur ussay ( bachrray per ) daal diya .   aur meray dil ney mujhay kuch aisa hi sujhaya.
verses.translation: woh bola :  mein ney aik aesi cheez dekh li thi jo doosron ko nazar nahi aai thi . iss liye mein ney Rasool kay naqsh-e-qadam say aik mutthi uthali , aur ussay ( bachrray per ) daal diya .   aur meray dil ney mujhay kuch aisa hi sujhaya.

verses.text: musa ney kaha :  acha to jaa , abb zindagi bhar tera kaam yeh hoga kay tu logon  say yeh kaha keray ga kay mujhay naa choona .   aur ( iss kay ilawa ) teray liye aik waday ka waqt muqarrar hai jo tujh say talaya nahi jasakta .   aur dekh apney iss ( jhootay ) mabood ko jiss per tu jama betha tha ! hum issay jala daalen gay , aur phir iss ( ki raakh ) ko choora choora ker kay samandar mein bikhair den gay .
verses.translation: musa ney kaha :  acha to jaa , abb zindagi bhar tera kaam yeh hoga kay tu logon  say yeh kaha keray ga kay mujhay naa choona .   aur ( iss kay ilawa ) teray liye aik waday ka waqt muqarrar hai jo tujh say talaya nahi jasakta .   aur dekh apney iss ( jhootay ) mabood ko jiss per tu jama betha tha ! hum issay jala daalen gay , aur phir iss ( ki raakh ) ko choora choora ker kay samandar mein bikhair den gay .

verses.text: haqeeqat mein tum sabb ka mabood to bus aik hi Allah hai , jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . uss ka ilm her cheez ka ehata kiye huye hai .
verses.translation: haqeeqat mein tum sabb ka mabood to bus aik hi Allah hai , jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . uss ka ilm her cheez ka ehata kiye huye hai .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) mazi mein jo halaat guzray hain unn mein say kuch waqiyaat hum issi tarah tum ko sunatay hain , aur hum ney tumhen khaas apney paas say aik naseehat nama ata kiya hai .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) mazi mein jo halaat guzray hain unn mein say kuch waqiyaat hum issi tarah tum ko sunatay hain , aur hum ney tumhen khaas apney paas say aik naseehat nama ata kiya hai .

verses.text: jo log uss say mun morren gay , to woh qayamat kay din bara bhari bojh laadey hon gay ,
verses.translation: jo log uss say mun morren gay , to woh qayamat kay din bara bhari bojh laadey hon gay ,

verses.text: jiss ( kay azab ) mein woh hamesha rahen gay , aur qayamat kay din unn kay liye yeh bad-tareen bojh hoga ,
verses.translation: jiss ( kay azab ) mein woh hamesha rahen gay , aur qayamat kay din unn kay liye yeh bad-tareen bojh hoga ,

verses.text: jiss din soor phoonka jaye ga , aur uss din hum saray mujrimon ko gher ker iss tarah jama keren gay kay woh neelay parray hon gay ,
verses.translation: jiss din soor phoonka jaye ga , aur uss din hum saray mujrimon ko gher ker iss tarah jama keren gay kay woh neelay parray hon gay ,

verses.text: aapas mein sargoshiyan ker rahey hon gay kay tum ( qabron mein yaa duniya mein ) das din say ziyada nahi thehray .
verses.translation: aapas mein sargoshiyan ker rahey hon gay kay tum ( qabron mein yaa duniya mein ) das din say ziyada nahi thehray .

verses.text: jiss baaray mein woh baaten keren gay uss ki haqeeqat hamen khoob maloom hai ,   jabkay unn mein say jiss ka tareeqa sabb say behtar hoga , woh kahey ga kay tum aik din say ziyada nahi thehray .
verses.translation: jiss baaray mein woh baaten keren gay uss ki haqeeqat hamen khoob maloom hai ,   jabkay unn mein say jiss ka tareeqa sabb say behtar hoga , woh kahey ga kay tum aik din say ziyada nahi thehray .

verses.text: aur log tum say paharon kay baaray mein poochtay hain ( kay qayamat mein inn ka kiya banay ga-? ) jawab mein keh do kay mera perwerdigar inn ko dhool ki tarah urra dey ga .
verses.translation: aur log tum say paharon kay baaray mein poochtay hain ( kay qayamat mein inn ka kiya banay ga-? ) jawab mein keh do kay mera perwerdigar inn ko dhool ki tarah urra dey ga .

verses.text: aur zameen ko aisa humwaar chatiyal meydan bana ker choray ga .
verses.translation: aur zameen ko aisa humwaar chatiyal meydan bana ker choray ga .

verses.text: kay uss mein tumhen naa koi ball nazar aaye ga , naa koi ubhaar .
verses.translation: kay uss mein tumhen naa koi ball nazar aaye ga , naa koi ubhaar .

verses.text: uss din sabb kay sabb munadi kay peechay iss tarah chalay ayen gay kay uss kay samney koi tairrah nahi dikha saken gay . aur khudaye rehman kay aagay tamam aawazen dabb ker reh jayen gi , chunacheh tumhen paon ki sarsarahat kay siwa kuch sunai nahi dey ga .
verses.translation: uss din sabb kay sabb munadi kay peechay iss tarah chalay ayen gay kay uss kay samney koi tairrah nahi dikha saken gay . aur khudaye rehman kay aagay tamam aawazen dabb ker reh jayen gi , chunacheh tumhen paon ki sarsarahat kay siwa kuch sunai nahi dey ga .

verses.text: uss din kissi ki sifarish kaam nahi aaye gi , siwaye uss shaks ( ki sifarish ) kay jissay khudaye rehman ney ijazat dey di ho , aur jiss kay bolney per woh razi ho .
verses.translation: uss din kissi ki sifarish kaam nahi aaye gi , siwaye uss shaks ( ki sifarish ) kay jissay khudaye rehman ney ijazat dey di ho , aur jiss kay bolney per woh razi ho .

verses.text: woh logon  ki sari agli pichli baaton ko janta hai , aur woh uss kay ilm ka ehata nahi ker-saktay .
verses.translation: woh logon  ki sari agli pichli baaton ko janta hai , aur woh uss kay ilm ka ehata nahi ker-saktay .

verses.text: aur saray kay saray chehray haee o qayyum kay aagay jhukay hon gay , aur jo koi zulm ka bojh laad ker laya hoga na-murad hoga .
verses.translation: aur saray kay saray chehray haee o qayyum kay aagay jhukay hon gay , aur jo koi zulm ka bojh laad ker laya hoga na-murad hoga .

verses.text: aur jiss ney naik amal kiye hon gay , jabkay woh momin bhi ho , to ussay naa kissi ziyadti ka andesha hoga , naa kissi haq talfi ka .
verses.translation: aur jiss ney naik amal kiye hon gay , jabkay woh momin bhi ho , to ussay naa kissi ziyadti ka andesha hoga , naa kissi haq talfi ka .

verses.text: aur hum ney issi tarah yeh wahi aik arbi Quran ki shakal mein nazil ki hai , aur iss mein tanbeehaat ko tarah tarah say biyan kiya hai , takay log perhezgari ikhtiyar keren , ya yeh Quran unn mein kuch soch samajh peda keray .
verses.translation: aur hum ney issi tarah yeh wahi aik arbi Quran ki shakal mein nazil ki hai , aur iss mein tanbeehaat ko tarah tarah say biyan kiya hai , takay log perhezgari ikhtiyar keren , ya yeh Quran unn mein kuch soch samajh peda keray .

verses.text: aesi hi oonchi shaan hai Allah ki , jo saltanat ka haqeeqi malik hai ! aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab Quran wahi kay zariye nazil horaha ho to uss kay mukammal honey say pehlay Quran parhney mein jaldi naa kiya kero ,   aur yeh dua kertay raha kero kay :  meray perwerdigar ! mujhay ilm mein aur taraqqi ata farma .
verses.translation: aesi hi oonchi shaan hai Allah ki , jo saltanat ka haqeeqi malik hai ! aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab Quran wahi kay zariye nazil horaha ho to uss kay mukammal honey say pehlay Quran parhney mein jaldi naa kiya kero ,   aur yeh dua kertay raha kero kay :  meray perwerdigar ! mujhay ilm mein aur taraqqi ata farma .

verses.text: aur hum ney iss say pehlay Adam ko aik baat ki takeed ki thi , phir unn say bhool hogaee , aur hum ney unn mein azam nahi paya .
verses.translation: aur hum ney iss say pehlay Adam ko aik baat ki takeed ki thi , phir unn say bhool hogaee , aur hum ney unn mein azam nahi paya .

verses.text: yaad kero woh waqt jab hum ney farishton say kaha tha kay Adam ko sajda kero , chunacheh sabb ney sajda kiya , albatta iblees tha jiss ney inkar kiya .
verses.translation: yaad kero woh waqt jab hum ney farishton say kaha tha kay Adam ko sajda kero , chunacheh sabb ney sajda kiya , albatta iblees tha jiss ney inkar kiya .

verses.text: chunacheh hum ney kaha kay :  aey Adam ! yeh tumhara aur tumhari biwi ka dushman hai , lehaza aisa naa ho kay yeh tum dono ko jannat say niklwa dey , aur tum mushaqqat mein parr-jao .
verses.translation: chunacheh hum ney kaha kay :  aey Adam ! yeh tumhara aur tumhari biwi ka dushman hai , lehaza aisa naa ho kay yeh tum dono ko jannat say niklwa dey , aur tum mushaqqat mein parr-jao .

verses.text: yahan to tumhen yeh faeeda hai kay naa tum bhookay hogay , naa nangay ,
verses.translation: yahan to tumhen yeh faeeda hai kay naa tum bhookay hogay , naa nangay ,

verses.text: aur naa yahan piyasay raho gay , naa dhoop mein tapo gay .
verses.translation: aur naa yahan piyasay raho gay , naa dhoop mein tapo gay .

verses.text: phir shetan ney unn kay dil mein waswasa daala . kehney laga :  aey Adam ! kiya mein tumhen aik aisa darkht bataon jiss say jaodaani zindagi aur woh badshahi hasil hojati hai jo kabhi purani nahi parrti-?
verses.translation: phir shetan ney unn kay dil mein waswasa daala . kehney laga :  aey Adam ! kiya mein tumhen aik aisa darkht bataon jiss say jaodaani zindagi aur woh badshahi hasil hojati hai jo kabhi purani nahi parrti-?

verses.text: chunacheh unn dono ney uss darkht mein say kuch khaliya jiss say unn dono kay sharam kay maqamaat unn kay samney khul gaye , aur woh dono jannat kay patton ko apney oopper ganthnay lagay . aur ( iss tarah ) Adam ney apney rab ka kaha taala , aur bhatak gaye .
verses.translation: chunacheh unn dono ney uss darkht mein say kuch khaliya jiss say unn dono kay sharam kay maqamaat unn kay samney khul gaye , aur woh dono jannat kay patton ko apney oopper ganthnay lagay . aur ( iss tarah ) Adam ney apney rab ka kaha taala , aur bhatak gaye .

verses.text: phir unn kay rab ney unhen chunn liya , chunacheh unn ki tauba qubool farmaee , aur unhen hidayat ata farmaee .
verses.translation: phir unn kay rab ney unhen chunn liya , chunacheh unn ki tauba qubool farmaee , aur unhen hidayat ata farmaee .

verses.text: Allah ney farmaya :  tum dono kay dono yahan say neechay utar jao , tum aik doosray kay dushman hogay .   phir agar tumhen meri taraf say koi hidayat phonchay , to jo koi meri hidayat ki perwi keray ga , woh naa gumrah hoga , aur naa kissi mushkil mein girftaar hoga .
verses.translation: Allah ney farmaya :  tum dono kay dono yahan say neechay utar jao , tum aik doosray kay dushman hogay .   phir agar tumhen meri taraf say koi hidayat phonchay , to jo koi meri hidayat ki perwi keray ga , woh naa gumrah hoga , aur naa kissi mushkil mein girftaar hoga .

verses.text: aur jo meri naseehat say mun morray ga to uss ko bari tang zindagi milay gi , aur qayamat kay din hum ussay andha ker kay uthayen gay .
verses.translation: aur jo meri naseehat say mun morray ga to uss ko bari tang zindagi milay gi , aur qayamat kay din hum ussay andha ker kay uthayen gay .

verses.text: woh kahey ga kay :  ya rab ! tu ney mujhay andha ker kay kiyon uthaya , halankay mein to aankhon wala tha-?
verses.translation: woh kahey ga kay :  ya rab ! tu ney mujhay andha ker kay kiyon uthaya , halankay mein to aankhon wala tha-?

verses.text: Allah kahey ga :  issi tarah humari aayaten teray paas aai then , magar tu ney unhen bhula diya . aur aaj ussi tarah tujhay bhula diya jaye ga .
verses.translation: Allah kahey ga :  issi tarah humari aayaten teray paas aai then , magar tu ney unhen bhula diya . aur aaj ussi tarah tujhay bhula diya jaye ga .

verses.text: aur jo shaks hadd say guzar jata hai , aur apney perwerdigar ki nishaniyon per emaan nahi lata , ussay hum issi tarah saza detay hain , aur aakhirat ka azab waqaee ziyada sakht aur ziyada dair rehney wala hai .
verses.translation: aur jo shaks hadd say guzar jata hai , aur apney perwerdigar ki nishaniyon per emaan nahi lata , ussay hum issi tarah saza detay hain , aur aakhirat ka azab waqaee ziyada sakht aur ziyada dair rehney wala hai .

verses.text: phir kiya inn logon  ko iss baat ney bhi koi hidayat ka sabaq nahi diya kay inn say pehlay kitni naslen then jinhen hum ney halak kerdiya , jinn ki bastiyon mein yeh log chaltay phirtay bhi hain-? yaqeenan jinn logon  kay paas aqal hai , unn kay liye iss baat mein ibrat kay baray saman hain .
verses.translation: phir kiya inn logon  ko iss baat ney bhi koi hidayat ka sabaq nahi diya kay inn say pehlay kitni naslen then jinhen hum ney halak kerdiya , jinn ki bastiyon mein yeh log chaltay phirtay bhi hain-? yaqeenan jinn logon  kay paas aqal hai , unn kay liye iss baat mein ibrat kay baray saman hain .

verses.text: aur agar tumharay rab ki taraf say aik baat pehlay hi tey naa kerdi gaee hoti , aur ( uss kay nateejay mein azab ki ) aik miyaad muqarrar naa hoti , to lazimi tor per azab ( unn ko ) chimat chuka hota .
verses.translation: aur agar tumharay rab ki taraf say aik baat pehlay hi tey naa kerdi gaee hoti , aur ( uss kay nateejay mein azab ki ) aik miyaad muqarrar naa hoti , to lazimi tor per azab ( unn ko ) chimat chuka hota .

verses.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh log jo baaten kertay hain , tum inn per sabar kero , aur sooraj nikalney say pehlay aur uss kay ghuroob hone say pehlay apney rab ki tasbeeh aur hamd kertay raho , aur raat kay oqaat mein bhi tasbeeh kero , aur din kay kinaron mein bhi , takay tum khush hojao .
verses.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh log jo baaten kertay hain , tum inn per sabar kero , aur sooraj nikalney say pehlay aur uss kay ghuroob hone say pehlay apney rab ki tasbeeh aur hamd kertay raho , aur raat kay oqaat mein bhi tasbeeh kero , aur din kay kinaron mein bhi , takay tum khush hojao .

verses.text: aur dunyawi zindagi ki uss bahar ki taraf aankhen utha ker bhi naa dekho jo hum ney inn ( kafiron ) mein say mukhtalif logon  ko mazay uraney kay liye dey rakhi hai , takay hum inn ko uss kay zariye aazmayen . aur tumharay rab ka rizq sabb say behtar aur sabb say ziyada dairpa hai .
verses.translation: aur dunyawi zindagi ki uss bahar ki taraf aankhen utha ker bhi naa dekho jo hum ney inn ( kafiron ) mein say mukhtalif logon  ko mazay uraney kay liye dey rakhi hai , takay hum inn ko uss kay zariye aazmayen . aur tumharay rab ka rizq sabb say behtar aur sabb say ziyada dairpa hai .

verses.text: aur apney ghar walon ko namaz ka hukum do , aur khud bhi uss per sabit qadam raho . hum tum say rizq nahi chahtay ,   rizq to hum tumhen den gay . aur behtar anjam taqwa hi ka hai .
verses.translation: aur apney ghar walon ko namaz ka hukum do , aur khud bhi uss per sabit qadam raho . hum tum say rizq nahi chahtay ,   rizq to hum tumhen den gay . aur behtar anjam taqwa hi ka hai .

verses.text: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  yeh ( nabi ) humaray paas apney rab ki taraf say koi nishani kiyon nahi ley aatay-?  bhala kiya inn kay paas pichlay ( aasmani ) saheefon kay mazameen ki gawahi nahi aagae ?
verses.translation: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  yeh ( nabi ) humaray paas apney rab ki taraf say koi nishani kiyon nahi ley aatay-?  bhala kiya inn kay paas pichlay ( aasmani ) saheefon kay mazameen ki gawahi nahi aagae ?

verses.text: aur agar hum enhen iss ( Quran ) say pehlay inn ko kissi azab say halak ker-detay to yeh log kehtay kay :  humaray perwerdigar ! aap ney humaray paas koi payghumber kiyon nahi bheja , takay hum zaleel aur ruswa honey say pehlay aap ki aayaton ki perwi kertay-?
verses.translation: aur agar hum enhen iss ( Quran ) say pehlay inn ko kissi azab say halak ker-detay to yeh log kehtay kay :  humaray perwerdigar ! aap ney humaray paas koi payghumber kiyon nahi bheja , takay hum zaleel aur ruswa honey say pehlay aap ki aayaton ki perwi kertay-?

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) keh do kay :  ( hum ) sabb intizar ker rahey hain , lehaza tum bhi intizar kero    kiyonkay unqareeb tumhen pata chal jaye ga kay seedhay raastay walay log kon hain , aur kon hain jo hidayat paagaye hain-?
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) keh do kay :  ( hum ) sabb intizar ker rahey hain , lehaza tum bhi intizar kero    kiyonkay unqareeb tumhen pata chal jaye ga kay seedhay raastay walay log kon hain , aur kon hain jo hidayat paagaye hain-?

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: tua-haa   .
ayahs.translation: tua-haa   .

ayahs.text: hum ney tum per Quran iss liye nazil nahi kiya kay tum takleef uthao .
ayahs.translation: hum ney tum per Quran iss liye nazil nahi kiya kay tum takleef uthao .

ayahs.text: albatta yeh uss shaks kay liye aik naseehat hai jo darta ho .
ayahs.translation: albatta yeh uss shaks kay liye aik naseehat hai jo darta ho .

ayahs.text: issay uss zaat ki taraf say thora thora ker kay nazil kiya jaraha hai jiss ney zameen aur oonchay oonchay aasman peda kiye hain .
ayahs.translation: issay uss zaat ki taraf say thora thora ker kay nazil kiya jaraha hai jiss ney zameen aur oonchay oonchay aasman peda kiye hain .

ayahs.text: woh bari rehmat wala arsh per istawa farmaye huye hai .
ayahs.translation: woh bari rehmat wala arsh per istawa farmaye huye hai .

ayahs.text: aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , aur unn kay darmiyan jo kuch hai , woh sabb bhi ussi ki milkiyat hai , aur zameen ki tehon kay neechay jo kuch hai woh bhi .
ayahs.translation: aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , aur unn kay darmiyan jo kuch hai , woh sabb bhi ussi ki milkiyat hai , aur zameen ki tehon kay neechay jo kuch hai woh bhi .

ayahs.text: agar tum koi baat buland aawaz say kaho ( ya aahista ) , to woh chupkay say kahi hoi baaton ko , balkay aur ziyada chupi hoi baaton ko bhi janta hai .
ayahs.translation: agar tum koi baat buland aawaz say kaho ( ya aahista ) , to woh chupkay say kahi hoi baaton ko , balkay aur ziyada chupi hoi baaton ko bhi janta hai .

ayahs.text: Allah woh hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . ussi kay achay achay naam hain .
ayahs.translation: Allah woh hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . ussi kay achay achay naam hain .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya tum tak musa ka waqiaa phoncha hai-?
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya tum tak musa ka waqiaa phoncha hai-?

ayahs.text: yeh uss waqt ki baat hai jab unn ko aik aag nazar aai to unhon ney apney ghar walon say kaha :  tum yahin thehrao , mein ney aik aag dekhi hai . shayad mein uss mein say koi shola tumharay paas ley aaon , ya uss aag kay paas mujhay raastay ka pata mil jaye .
ayahs.translation: yeh uss waqt ki baat hai jab unn ko aik aag nazar aai to unhon ney apney ghar walon say kaha :  tum yahin thehrao , mein ney aik aag dekhi hai . shayad mein uss mein say koi shola tumharay paas ley aaon , ya uss aag kay paas mujhay raastay ka pata mil jaye .

ayahs.text: chunacheh jab woh aag kay paas phonchay to unhen aawaz di gaee kay :  aey musa !
ayahs.translation: chunacheh jab woh aag kay paas phonchay to unhen aawaz di gaee kay :  aey musa !

ayahs.text: yaqeen say jaan lo kay mein hi tumhara rab hun .   abb tum apney jootay utaar do . tum iss waqt toowa ki muqaddas wadi mein ho .
ayahs.translation: yaqeen say jaan lo kay mein hi tumhara rab hun .   abb tum apney jootay utaar do . tum iss waqt toowa ki muqaddas wadi mein ho .

ayahs.text: aur mein ney tumhen ( nabwooat kay liye ) muntakhib kiya hai . lehaza jo baat wahi kay zariye kahi jarahi hai , ussay ghor say suno .
ayahs.translation: aur mein ney tumhen ( nabwooat kay liye ) muntakhib kiya hai . lehaza jo baat wahi kay zariye kahi jarahi hai , ussay ghor say suno .

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay mein hi Allah hun . meray siwa koi mabood nahi hai , iss liye meri ibadat kero , aur mujhay yaad rakhney kay liye namaz qaeem kero .
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay mein hi Allah hun . meray siwa koi mabood nahi hai , iss liye meri ibadat kero , aur mujhay yaad rakhney kay liye namaz qaeem kero .

ayahs.text: yaqeen rakho kay qayamat ki gharri aaney wali hai . mein uss ( kay waqt ) ko khufiya rakhna chahta hun , takay her shaks ko uss kay kiye ka badla milay .
ayahs.translation: yaqeen rakho kay qayamat ki gharri aaney wali hai . mein uss ( kay waqt ) ko khufiya rakhna chahta hun , takay her shaks ko uss kay kiye ka badla milay .

ayahs.text: lehaza koi essa shaks tumhen iss say hergiz ghafil naa kernay paye jo iss per emaan naa rakhta ho . aur apni khuwaishaat kay peechay chalta ho , werna tum halakat mein parr-jao gay .
ayahs.translation: lehaza koi essa shaks tumhen iss say hergiz ghafil naa kernay paye jo iss per emaan naa rakhta ho . aur apni khuwaishaat kay peechay chalta ho , werna tum halakat mein parr-jao gay .

ayahs.text: aur musa ! yeh tumharay dayen haath mein kiya hai-?
ayahs.translation: aur musa ! yeh tumharay dayen haath mein kiya hai-?

ayahs.text: musa ney kaha :  yeh meri laathi hai . mein iss ka sahara leta hun , aur iss say apni bakriyon per ( darkht say ) pattay jharrta hun , aur iss say meri doosri zarooriyaat bhi poori hoti hain .
ayahs.translation: musa ney kaha :  yeh meri laathi hai . mein iss ka sahara leta hun , aur iss say apni bakriyon per ( darkht say ) pattay jharrta hun , aur iss say meri doosri zarooriyaat bhi poori hoti hain .

ayahs.text: farmaya :  musa ! issay neechay phenk do
ayahs.translation: farmaya :  musa ! issay neechay phenk do

ayahs.text: chunacheh unhon ney ussay phenk diya . bus phir kiya tha ! woh achanak aik dorrta huwa saanp ban gaee .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh unhon ney ussay phenk diya . bus phir kiya tha ! woh achanak aik dorrta huwa saanp ban gaee .

ayahs.text: Allah ney farmaya :  issay pakar lo , aur daro nahi . hum abhi issay iss ki pichli halat per loata den gay .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney farmaya :  issay pakar lo , aur daro nahi . hum abhi issay iss ki pichli halat per loata den gay .

ayahs.text: aur apney haath ko apni baghal mein dabao , woh kissi beemari kay baghair safaid ho ker niklay ga .   yeh ( tumhari nabwooat ki ) aik aur nishani hogi .
ayahs.translation: aur apney haath ko apni baghal mein dabao , woh kissi beemari kay baghair safaid ho ker niklay ga .   yeh ( tumhari nabwooat ki ) aik aur nishani hogi .

ayahs.text: . ( yeh hum iss liye ker rahey hain ) takay apni bari nishaniyon mein say kuch tumhen dikhayen .
ayahs.translation: . ( yeh hum iss liye ker rahey hain ) takay apni bari nishaniyon mein say kuch tumhen dikhayen .

ayahs.text: . ( abb ) firon kay paas jao . woh sarkashi mein hadd say nikal gaya hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( abb ) firon kay paas jao . woh sarkashi mein hadd say nikal gaya hai .

ayahs.text: musa ney kaha :  perwerdigar ! meri khatir mera seena khol dijiye ,
ayahs.translation: musa ney kaha :  perwerdigar ! meri khatir mera seena khol dijiye ,

ayahs.text: aur meray liye mera kaam aasaan bana dijiye ,
ayahs.translation: aur meray liye mera kaam aasaan bana dijiye ,

ayahs.text: aur meri zaban mein jo girah hai , ussay door ker-dijiye ,
ayahs.translation: aur meri zaban mein jo girah hai , ussay door ker-dijiye ,

ayahs.text: takay log meri baat samajh saken .
ayahs.translation: takay log meri baat samajh saken .

ayahs.text: aur meray liye meray khandan hi kay aik fard ko madadgaar muqarrar ker-dijiye ,
ayahs.translation: aur meray liye meray khandan hi kay aik fard ko madadgaar muqarrar ker-dijiye ,

ayahs.text: yani Haroon ko jo meray bhai hain !
ayahs.translation: yani Haroon ko jo meray bhai hain !

ayahs.text: unn kay zariye meri taqat mazboot ker-dijiye ,
ayahs.translation: unn kay zariye meri taqat mazboot ker-dijiye ,

ayahs.text: aur unn ko mera shareek-e-kaar bana dijiye ,
ayahs.translation: aur unn ko mera shareek-e-kaar bana dijiye ,

ayahs.text: takay hum kasrat say aap ki tasbeeh keren ,
ayahs.translation: takay hum kasrat say aap ki tasbeeh keren ,

ayahs.text: aur kasrat say aap ka ziker keren .
ayahs.translation: aur kasrat say aap ka ziker keren .

ayahs.text: beyshak aap hamen achi tarah dekhney walay hain .
ayahs.translation: beyshak aap hamen achi tarah dekhney walay hain .

ayahs.text: Allah ney farmaya :  musa ! tum ney jo kuch maanga hai , tumhen dey diya gaya ,
ayahs.translation: Allah ney farmaya :  musa ! tum ney jo kuch maanga hai , tumhen dey diya gaya ,

ayahs.text: aur hum ney tum per aik aur martaba bhi ehsan kiya tha ,
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney tum per aik aur martaba bhi ehsan kiya tha ,

ayahs.text: jab hum ney tumhari maa say wahi kay zariye woh baat kahi thi jo abb wahi kay zariye ( tumhen ) batai jarahi hai .
ayahs.translation: jab hum ney tumhari maa say wahi kay zariye woh baat kahi thi jo abb wahi kay zariye ( tumhen ) batai jarahi hai .

ayahs.text: kay iss ( bacchay ) ko sandooq mein rakho , phir iss sandooq ko darya mein daal do .   phir darya ko chorr do kay woh ussay sahil kay paas laaker daal dey , jiss kay nateejay mein aik aisa shaks uss ( bacchay ) ko utha ley ga jo mera bhi dushman hoga , aur iss ka bhi dushman .   aur mein ney apni taraf say tum per aik mehboobiyat nazil kerdi thi ,   aur yeh sabb iss liye kiya tha takay tum meri nigrani mein perwerish pao .
ayahs.translation: kay iss ( bacchay ) ko sandooq mein rakho , phir iss sandooq ko darya mein daal do .   phir darya ko chorr do kay woh ussay sahil kay paas laaker daal dey , jiss kay nateejay mein aik aisa shaks uss ( bacchay ) ko utha ley ga jo mera bhi dushman hoga , aur iss ka bhi dushman .   aur mein ney apni taraf say tum per aik mehboobiyat nazil kerdi thi ,   aur yeh sabb iss liye kiya tha takay tum meri nigrani mein perwerish pao .

ayahs.text: uss waqt ka tasawwur kero jab tumhari behan ghar say chalti hai , aur ( firon kay kaarindon say ) yeh kehti hai kay :  kiya mein tumhen uss ( aurat ) ka pata bataon jo iss ( bacchay ) ko paalay-?    iss tarah hum ney tumhen tumhari maa kay paas loata diya , takay uss ki aankh thandi rahey , aur woh ghumgeen naa ho . aur tum ney aik shaks ko maar daala tha ,   phir hum ney tumhen uss ghuttan say nijat di , aur tumhen kaee aazmaeshon say guzaara .   phir tum kaee saal madiyan walon mein rahey , uss kay baad aey musa ! tum aik aesay waqt per yahan aaye ho jo pehlay say muqaddar tha ,
ayahs.translation: uss waqt ka tasawwur kero jab tumhari behan ghar say chalti hai , aur ( firon kay kaarindon say ) yeh kehti hai kay :  kiya mein tumhen uss ( aurat ) ka pata bataon jo iss ( bacchay ) ko paalay-?    iss tarah hum ney tumhen tumhari maa kay paas loata diya , takay uss ki aankh thandi rahey , aur woh ghumgeen naa ho . aur tum ney aik shaks ko maar daala tha ,   phir hum ney tumhen uss ghuttan say nijat di , aur tumhen kaee aazmaeshon say guzaara .   phir tum kaee saal madiyan walon mein rahey , uss kay baad aey musa ! tum aik aesay waqt per yahan aaye ho jo pehlay say muqaddar tha ,

ayahs.text: aur mein ney tumhen khaas apney liye banaya hai .
ayahs.translation: aur mein ney tumhen khaas apney liye banaya hai .

ayahs.text: tum aur tumhara bhai dono meri nishaniyan ley ker jao , aur mera ziker kernay mein susti naa kerna .
ayahs.translation: tum aur tumhara bhai dono meri nishaniyan ley ker jao , aur mera ziker kernay mein susti naa kerna .

ayahs.text: dono firon kay paas jao . woh hadd say aagay nikal chuka hai .
ayahs.translation: dono firon kay paas jao . woh hadd say aagay nikal chuka hai .

ayahs.text: jaker dono uss say narmi say baat kerna , shayad woh naseehat qubool keray , ya ( Allah say ) darr jaye .
ayahs.translation: jaker dono uss say narmi say baat kerna , shayad woh naseehat qubool keray , ya ( Allah say ) darr jaye .

ayahs.text: dono ney kaha :  humaray perwerdigar ! hamen andesha hai kay kahen woh hum per ziyadti naa keray , ya kahen sarkashi per aamada naa hojaye .
ayahs.translation: dono ney kaha :  humaray perwerdigar ! hamen andesha hai kay kahen woh hum per ziyadti naa keray , ya kahen sarkashi per aamada naa hojaye .

ayahs.text: Allah ney farmaya :  daro nahi , mein tumharay sath hun , sunn bhi raha hun , aur dekh bhi raha hun .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney farmaya :  daro nahi , mein tumharay sath hun , sunn bhi raha hun , aur dekh bhi raha hun .

ayahs.text: abb uss kay paas jao , aur kaho kay hum dono tumharay rab kay payghumber hain , iss liye bani Israel ko humaray sath bhej do , aur unhen takleefen naa phonchao , hum tumharay paas tumharay rab ki taraf say nishani ley ker aaye hain , aur salamti ussi kay liye hai jo hidayat ki perwi keray .
ayahs.translation: abb uss kay paas jao , aur kaho kay hum dono tumharay rab kay payghumber hain , iss liye bani Israel ko humaray sath bhej do , aur unhen takleefen naa phonchao , hum tumharay paas tumharay rab ki taraf say nishani ley ker aaye hain , aur salamti ussi kay liye hai jo hidayat ki perwi keray .

ayahs.text: hum per yeh wahi nazil ki gaee hai kay azab uss ko hoga jo ( haq ko ) jhutlaye , aur mun morray .
ayahs.translation: hum per yeh wahi nazil ki gaee hai kay azab uss ko hoga jo ( haq ko ) jhutlaye , aur mun morray .

ayahs.text: . ( yeh sari baaten sunn ker ) firon ney kaha :  musa ! tum dono ka rab kon ?
ayahs.translation: . ( yeh sari baaten sunn ker ) firon ney kaha :  musa ! tum dono ka rab kon ?

ayahs.text: musa ney kaha :  humara rab woh hai jiss ney her cheez ko woh banawat ata ki jo uss kay munasib thi , phir ( uss ki ) rehnumai bhi farmaee .
ayahs.translation: musa ney kaha :  humara rab woh hai jiss ney her cheez ko woh banawat ata ki jo uss kay munasib thi , phir ( uss ki ) rehnumai bhi farmaee .

ayahs.text: firon bola :  acha phir unn qoamon ka kiya moamla huwa jo pehlay guzar chuki hain-?
ayahs.translation: firon bola :  acha phir unn qoamon ka kiya moamla huwa jo pehlay guzar chuki hain-?

ayahs.text: musa ney kaha :  unn ka ilm meray rab kay paas aik kitab mein mehfooz hai . meray rab ko naa koi ghalati lagti hai , naa woh bhoolta hai .
ayahs.translation: musa ney kaha :  unn ka ilm meray rab kay paas aik kitab mein mehfooz hai . meray rab ko naa koi ghalati lagti hai , naa woh bhoolta hai .

ayahs.text: yeh woh zaat hai jiss ney zameen ko tumharay liye farsh bana diya , aur uss mein tumharay liye raastay banaye , aur aasman say paani barsaya , phir hum ney uss kay zariye tarah tarah ki mukhtalif nabataat nikalen .
ayahs.translation: yeh woh zaat hai jiss ney zameen ko tumharay liye farsh bana diya , aur uss mein tumharay liye raastay banaye , aur aasman say paani barsaya , phir hum ney uss kay zariye tarah tarah ki mukhtalif nabataat nikalen .

ayahs.text: khud bhi khao , aur apney maweshiyon ko bhi charao . yaqeenan inn/unn sabb baaton mein aqal walon kay liye bari nishaniyan hain .
ayahs.translation: khud bhi khao , aur apney maweshiyon ko bhi charao . yaqeenan inn/unn sabb baaton mein aqal walon kay liye bari nishaniyan hain .

ayahs.text: issi zameen say hum ney tumhen peda kiya tha , issi mein hum tumhen wapis ley jayen gay , aur issi say aik martaba phir tumhen nikal layen gay .
ayahs.translation: issi zameen say hum ney tumhen peda kiya tha , issi mein hum tumhen wapis ley jayen gay , aur issi say aik martaba phir tumhen nikal layen gay .

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney uss ( firon ) ko apni sari nishaniyan dikhayen , magar woh jhutlata hi raha , aur maan ker nahi diya .
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney uss ( firon ) ko apni sari nishaniyan dikhayen , magar woh jhutlata hi raha , aur maan ker nahi diya .

ayahs.text: kehney laga :  musa ! kiya tum iss liye aaye ho kay apney jadoo kay zariye hamen apni zameen say nikal bahir kero-?
ayahs.translation: kehney laga :  musa ! kiya tum iss liye aaye ho kay apney jadoo kay zariye hamen apni zameen say nikal bahir kero-?

ayahs.text: acha to hum bhi tumharay samney aisa hi jadoo laa ker rahen gay . abb tum kissi khulay meydan mein humaray aur apney darmiyan muqablay ka aisa waqt tey kerlo jiss ki khilaf warzi naa hum keren , naa tum kero .
ayahs.translation: acha to hum bhi tumharay samney aisa hi jadoo laa ker rahen gay . abb tum kissi khulay meydan mein humaray aur apney darmiyan muqablay ka aisa waqt tey kerlo jiss ki khilaf warzi naa hum keren , naa tum kero .

ayahs.text: musa ney kaha :  tum say woh din tey hai jiss mein jashan manaya jata hai .   aur yeh bhi tey hai kay din charrhay hi logon  ko jama kerliya jaye .
ayahs.translation: musa ney kaha :  tum say woh din tey hai jiss mein jashan manaya jata hai .   aur yeh bhi tey hai kay din charrhay hi logon  ko jama kerliya jaye .

ayahs.text: chunacheh firon ( apni jagah ) wapis chala gaya , aur uss ney apni sari tadbeeren ikhatti ken , phir ( muqablay kay liye ) aagaya .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh firon ( apni jagah ) wapis chala gaya , aur uss ney apni sari tadbeeren ikhatti ken , phir ( muqablay kay liye ) aagaya .

ayahs.text: musa ney unn ( jadoogaron say ) kaha :  afsos hai tum per ! Allah per bohtan naa baandho ,   werna woh aik sakht azab say tumhen malya mait kerday ga , aur jo koi bohtan baandhta hai , na-murad hota hai .
ayahs.translation: musa ney unn ( jadoogaron say ) kaha :  afsos hai tum per ! Allah per bohtan naa baandho ,   werna woh aik sakht azab say tumhen malya mait kerday ga , aur jo koi bohtan baandhta hai , na-murad hota hai .

ayahs.text: iss per unn kay darmiyan apni raye qaeem kernay mein ikhtilaf hogaya , aur woh chupkay chupkay sargoshiyan kernay lagay .
ayahs.translation: iss per unn kay darmiyan apni raye qaeem kernay mein ikhtilaf hogaya , aur woh chupkay chupkay sargoshiyan kernay lagay .

ayahs.text: . ( aakhir kaar ) unhon ney kaha kay :  yaqeeni tor per yeh dono ( yani musa aur Haroon ) jadoogar hain jo yeh chahtay hain kay apney jadoo kay zor per tum logon  ko tumhari sarzameen say nikal bahir keren , aur tumharay behtareen ( deeni ) tareeqay ka khatima hi ker daalen .
ayahs.translation: . ( aakhir kaar ) unhon ney kaha kay :  yaqeeni tor per yeh dono ( yani musa aur Haroon ) jadoogar hain jo yeh chahtay hain kay apney jadoo kay zor per tum logon  ko tumhari sarzameen say nikal bahir keren , aur tumharay behtareen ( deeni ) tareeqay ka khatima hi ker daalen .

ayahs.text: lehaza apni sari tadbeeren pukhta kerlo , phir saff baandh ker aao , aur yaqeen rakho kay aaj jo ghalib aajaye ga , falah ussi ko hasil hogi .
ayahs.translation: lehaza apni sari tadbeeren pukhta kerlo , phir saff baandh ker aao , aur yaqeen rakho kay aaj jo ghalib aajaye ga , falah ussi ko hasil hogi .

ayahs.text: jadoogar bolay :  musa ! ya to tum ( apni laathi pehlay ) daal do , ya phir hum daalney mein pehal keren ?
ayahs.translation: jadoogar bolay :  musa ! ya to tum ( apni laathi pehlay ) daal do , ya phir hum daalney mein pehal keren ?

ayahs.text: musa ney kaha :  nahi , tum hi daalo  bus phir achanak unn ki ( daali hoi ) rassiyan aur lathiyan unn kay jadoo kay nateejay mein musa ko aesi mehsoos honey lagen jaisay dorr rahi hain .
ayahs.translation: musa ney kaha :  nahi , tum hi daalo  bus phir achanak unn ki ( daali hoi ) rassiyan aur lathiyan unn kay jadoo kay nateejay mein musa ko aesi mehsoos honey lagen jaisay dorr rahi hain .

ayahs.text: iss per musa ko apney dil mein kuch khof mehsoos huwa .
ayahs.translation: iss per musa ko apney dil mein kuch khof mehsoos huwa .

ayahs.text: hum ney kaha :  daro nahi , yaqeen rakho tum hi tum sarbuland raho gay .
ayahs.translation: hum ney kaha :  daro nahi , yaqeen rakho tum hi tum sarbuland raho gay .

ayahs.text: aur jo ( laathi ) tumharay dayen haath mein hai , ussay ( zameen per ) daal do , inn logon  ney jo karigari ki hai , woh uss sabb ko nigal jaye gi . unn ki sari karigari aik jadoogar kay kartab kay siwa kuch nahi , aur jadoogar chahye kahen chala jaye , ussay falah naseeb nahi hoti .
ayahs.translation: aur jo ( laathi ) tumharay dayen haath mein hai , ussay ( zameen per ) daal do , inn logon  ney jo karigari ki hai , woh uss sabb ko nigal jaye gi . unn ki sari karigari aik jadoogar kay kartab kay siwa kuch nahi , aur jadoogar chahye kahen chala jaye , ussay falah naseeb nahi hoti .

ayahs.text: chunacheh ( yehi huwa aur ) saray jadoogar sajday mein gira diye gaye .   kehney lagay kay :  hum Haroon aur musa kay rab per emaan ley aaye .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh ( yehi huwa aur ) saray jadoogar sajday mein gira diye gaye .   kehney lagay kay :  hum Haroon aur musa kay rab per emaan ley aaye .

ayahs.text: firon bola :  tum inn per meray ijazat denay say pehlay hi emaan ley aaye . mujhay yaqeen hai kay yeh ( musa ) tum sabb ka sarghana hai jiss ney tumhen jadoo sikhlaya hai . abb mein ney bhi paka irada kerliya hai kay tumharay haath paon mukhalif samton say kaatun ga , aur tumhen khujoor kay tanon per sooli charhaon ga . aur tumhen yaqeenan pata lagg jaye ga kay hum dono mein say kiss ka azab ziyada sakht aur dairpa hai .
ayahs.translation: firon bola :  tum inn per meray ijazat denay say pehlay hi emaan ley aaye . mujhay yaqeen hai kay yeh ( musa ) tum sabb ka sarghana hai jiss ney tumhen jadoo sikhlaya hai . abb mein ney bhi paka irada kerliya hai kay tumharay haath paon mukhalif samton say kaatun ga , aur tumhen khujoor kay tanon per sooli charhaon ga . aur tumhen yaqeenan pata lagg jaye ga kay hum dono mein say kiss ka azab ziyada sakht aur dairpa hai .

ayahs.text: jadoogaron ney kaha :  qasam uss zaat ki jiss ney hamen peda kiya hai ! humaray samney jo roshan nishaniyan aagae hain , unn per hum tumhen hergiz tarjeeh nahi dey saktay . abb tumhen jo kuch kerna ho , kerlo . tum jo kuch bhi kero gay , issi dunyawi zindagi kay liye hoga .
ayahs.translation: jadoogaron ney kaha :  qasam uss zaat ki jiss ney hamen peda kiya hai ! humaray samney jo roshan nishaniyan aagae hain , unn per hum tumhen hergiz tarjeeh nahi dey saktay . abb tumhen jo kuch kerna ho , kerlo . tum jo kuch bhi kero gay , issi dunyawi zindagi kay liye hoga .

ayahs.text: hum to apney rab per emaan laa-chukay hain , takay woh humaray gunahon ko bhi bakhsh dey , aur jadoo kay uss kaam ko bhi jiss per tum ney hamen majboor kiya .   aur Allah hi sabb say acha aur hamesha baqi rehney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: hum to apney rab per emaan laa-chukay hain , takay woh humaray gunahon ko bhi bakhsh dey , aur jadoo kay uss kaam ko bhi jiss per tum ney hamen majboor kiya .   aur Allah hi sabb say acha aur hamesha baqi rehney wala hai .

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo shaks apney perwerdigar kay paas mujrim ban ker aaye ga , uss kay liye jahannum hai jiss mein naa woh maray ga aur naa jiye ga .
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo shaks apney perwerdigar kay paas mujrim ban ker aaye ga , uss kay liye jahannum hai jiss mein naa woh maray ga aur naa jiye ga .

ayahs.text: aur jo shaks uss kay paas momin ban ker aaye ga jiss ney naik amal bhi kiye hon gay , to aesay hi logon  kay liye buland darjaat hain ,
ayahs.translation: aur jo shaks uss kay paas momin ban ker aaye ga jiss ney naik amal bhi kiye hon gay , to aesay hi logon  kay liye buland darjaat hain ,

ayahs.text: woh hamesha rehney walay baaghaat jinn kay neechay say nehren behti hon gi , jinn mein woh hamesha rahen gay ! aur yeh sila hai uss ka jiss ney pakeezgi ikhtiyar ki .
ayahs.translation: woh hamesha rehney walay baaghaat jinn kay neechay say nehren behti hon gi , jinn mein woh hamesha rahen gay ! aur yeh sila hai uss ka jiss ney pakeezgi ikhtiyar ki .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney musa per wahi bheji kay :  tum meray bandon ko ley ker raaton raat rawana hojao ,   phir unn kay liye samandar mein aik khushk raasta iss tarah nikal lena kay naa tumhen ( dushman kay ) aa-pakarney ka andesha rahey , aur naa koi aur khof ho .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney musa per wahi bheji kay :  tum meray bandon ko ley ker raaton raat rawana hojao ,   phir unn kay liye samandar mein aik khushk raasta iss tarah nikal lena kay naa tumhen ( dushman kay ) aa-pakarney ka andesha rahey , aur naa koi aur khof ho .

ayahs.text: chunacheh firon ney apney lashkaron samet unn ka peecha kiya to samandar ki jiss ( khofnak ) cheez ney unhen dhaanpa , woh unhen dhaanp ker hi rahi .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh firon ney apney lashkaron samet unn ka peecha kiya to samandar ki jiss ( khofnak ) cheez ney unhen dhaanpa , woh unhen dhaanp ker hi rahi .

ayahs.text: aur firon ney apni qoam ko buray raastay per lagaya , aur unhen sahih raasta naa dikhaya .
ayahs.translation: aur firon ney apni qoam ko buray raastay per lagaya , aur unhen sahih raasta naa dikhaya .

ayahs.text: aey bani Israel ! hum ney tumhen tumharay dushman say nijat di , aur tum say koh-e-toor kay dayen janib aaney ka wada thehraya , aur tum per mann-o-salwa nazil kiya .
ayahs.translation: aey bani Israel ! hum ney tumhen tumharay dushman say nijat di , aur tum say koh-e-toor kay dayen janib aaney ka wada thehraya , aur tum per mann-o-salwa nazil kiya .

ayahs.text: jo pakeezah rizq hum ney tumhen ata kiya hai , uss mein say khao , aur uss mein sarkashi naa kero jiss kay nateejay mein tum per mera ghazab nazil hojaye . aur jiss kissi per mera ghazab nazil hojata hai , woh tabahi mein gir ker rehta hai .
ayahs.translation: jo pakeezah rizq hum ney tumhen ata kiya hai , uss mein say khao , aur uss mein sarkashi naa kero jiss kay nateejay mein tum per mera ghazab nazil hojaye . aur jiss kissi per mera ghazab nazil hojata hai , woh tabahi mein gir ker rehta hai .

ayahs.text: aur yeh bhi haqeeqat hai kay jo shaks tauba keray , emaan laye , aur naik amal keray , phir seedhay raastay per qaeem rahey to mein uss kay liye boht bakhshney wala hun .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh bhi haqeeqat hai kay jo shaks tauba keray , emaan laye , aur naik amal keray , phir seedhay raastay per qaeem rahey to mein uss kay liye boht bakhshney wala hun .

ayahs.text: aur ( jab musa koh-e-toor per apney logon  say pehlay chalay aaye to Allah ney unn say kaha : )  musa ! tum apni qoam say pehlay jaldi kiyon aagaye ?
ayahs.translation: aur ( jab musa koh-e-toor per apney logon  say pehlay chalay aaye to Allah ney unn say kaha : )  musa ! tum apni qoam say pehlay jaldi kiyon aagaye ?

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha :  woh meray peechay peechay aaya hi chahtay hain , aur perwerdigar ! mein aap kay paas iss liye jaldi aagaya takay aap khush hon .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha :  woh meray peechay peechay aaya hi chahtay hain , aur perwerdigar ! mein aap kay paas iss liye jaldi aagaya takay aap khush hon .

ayahs.text: Allah ney farmaya :  phir tumharay aaney kay baad hum ney tumhari qoam ko fitney mein mubtala kerdiya hai , aur unhen saamri ney gumrah ker daala hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney farmaya :  phir tumharay aaney kay baad hum ney tumhari qoam ko fitney mein mubtala kerdiya hai , aur unhen saamri ney gumrah ker daala hai .

ayahs.text: chunacheh musa ghum o ghussay mein bharay huye apni qoam kay paas wapis lotay . kehney lagay :  meri qoam kay logo ! kiya tumharay perwerdigar ney tum say aik acha wada nahi kiya tha-?   to kiya tum per koi boht lambi mauddat guzar gaee thi ,   ya tum chahtay hi yeh thay kay tum per tumharay rab ka ghazab nazil hojaye , aur iss wajeh say tum ney mujh say wada khilafi ki-?
ayahs.translation: chunacheh musa ghum o ghussay mein bharay huye apni qoam kay paas wapis lotay . kehney lagay :  meri qoam kay logo ! kiya tumharay perwerdigar ney tum say aik acha wada nahi kiya tha-?   to kiya tum per koi boht lambi mauddat guzar gaee thi ,   ya tum chahtay hi yeh thay kay tum per tumharay rab ka ghazab nazil hojaye , aur iss wajeh say tum ney mujh say wada khilafi ki-?

ayahs.text: kehney lagay :  hum ney apney ikhtiyar say aap kay waday ki khilaf warzi nahi ki , balkay huwa yeh kay hum per logon  kay zewraat kay bojh laday huye thay , iss liye hum ney unhen phenk diya ,   phir issi tarah saamri ney kuch daala
ayahs.translation: kehney lagay :  hum ney apney ikhtiyar say aap kay waday ki khilaf warzi nahi ki , balkay huwa yeh kay hum per logon  kay zewraat kay bojh laday huye thay , iss liye hum ney unhen phenk diya ,   phir issi tarah saamri ney kuch daala

ayahs.text: aur logon  kay samney aik bachrra bana ker nikal liya , aik jism tha jiss mein say aawaz nikalti thi . log kehney lagay kay :  yeh tumhara mabood hai , aur musa ka bhi mabood hai , magar musa bhool gaye hain .
ayahs.translation: aur logon  kay samney aik bachrra bana ker nikal liya , aik jism tha jiss mein say aawaz nikalti thi . log kehney lagay kay :  yeh tumhara mabood hai , aur musa ka bhi mabood hai , magar musa bhool gaye hain .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya unhen yeh nazar nahi aaraha tha kay woh naa unn ki baat ka jawab deta tha aur naa unn ko koi nuqsan ya nafaa phoncha sakta tha-?
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya unhen yeh nazar nahi aaraha tha kay woh naa unn ki baat ka jawab deta tha aur naa unn ko koi nuqsan ya nafaa phoncha sakta tha-?

ayahs.text: aur Haroon ney unn say pehlay hi kaha tha kay :  meri qoam kay logo ! tum iss ( bachrray ) ki wajeh say fitney mein mubtala hogaye ho , aur haqeeqat mein tumhara rab to rehman hai , iss liye tum meray peechay chalo aur meri baat maano .
ayahs.translation: aur Haroon ney unn say pehlay hi kaha tha kay :  meri qoam kay logo ! tum iss ( bachrray ) ki wajeh say fitney mein mubtala hogaye ho , aur haqeeqat mein tumhara rab to rehman hai , iss liye tum meray peechay chalo aur meri baat maano .

ayahs.text: woh kehney lagay kay :  jab tak musa wapis naa aajayen , hum to issi ki ibadat per jamay rahen gay .
ayahs.translation: woh kehney lagay kay :  jab tak musa wapis naa aajayen , hum to issi ki ibadat per jamay rahen gay .

ayahs.text: musa ney ( wapis aa-ker ) kaha :  Haroon ! jab tum ney dekh liya tha kay yeh log gumrah hogaye hain to tumhen kiss cheez ney roka tha
ayahs.translation: musa ney ( wapis aa-ker ) kaha :  Haroon ! jab tum ney dekh liya tha kay yeh log gumrah hogaye hain to tumhen kiss cheez ney roka tha

ayahs.text: kay tum meray peechay chalay aatay-? bhala kiya tum ney meri baat ki khilaf warzi ki-?
ayahs.translation: kay tum meray peechay chalay aatay-? bhala kiya tum ney meri baat ki khilaf warzi ki-?

ayahs.text: Haroon ney kaha :  meray maa kay betay ! meri daarhi naa pakro , aur naa mera sar . haqeeqat mein mujhay yeh andesha tha kay tum yeh kaho gay kay tum ney bani Israel mein tafarqa daal diya , aur meri baat ka paas nahi kiya .
ayahs.translation: Haroon ney kaha :  meray maa kay betay ! meri daarhi naa pakro , aur naa mera sar . haqeeqat mein mujhay yeh andesha tha kay tum yeh kaho gay kay tum ney bani Israel mein tafarqa daal diya , aur meri baat ka paas nahi kiya .

ayahs.text: musa ney kaha :  acha to saamri ! tujhay kiya huwa tha-?
ayahs.translation: musa ney kaha :  acha to saamri ! tujhay kiya huwa tha-?

ayahs.text: woh bola :  mein ney aik aesi cheez dekh li thi jo doosron ko nazar nahi aai thi . iss liye mein ney Rasool kay naqsh-e-qadam say aik mutthi uthali , aur ussay ( bachrray per ) daal diya .   aur meray dil ney mujhay kuch aisa hi sujhaya.
ayahs.translation: woh bola :  mein ney aik aesi cheez dekh li thi jo doosron ko nazar nahi aai thi . iss liye mein ney Rasool kay naqsh-e-qadam say aik mutthi uthali , aur ussay ( bachrray per ) daal diya .   aur meray dil ney mujhay kuch aisa hi sujhaya.

ayahs.text: musa ney kaha :  acha to jaa , abb zindagi bhar tera kaam yeh hoga kay tu logon  say yeh kaha keray ga kay mujhay naa choona .   aur ( iss kay ilawa ) teray liye aik waday ka waqt muqarrar hai jo tujh say talaya nahi jasakta .   aur dekh apney iss ( jhootay ) mabood ko jiss per tu jama betha tha ! hum issay jala daalen gay , aur phir iss ( ki raakh ) ko choora choora ker kay samandar mein bikhair den gay .
ayahs.translation: musa ney kaha :  acha to jaa , abb zindagi bhar tera kaam yeh hoga kay tu logon  say yeh kaha keray ga kay mujhay naa choona .   aur ( iss kay ilawa ) teray liye aik waday ka waqt muqarrar hai jo tujh say talaya nahi jasakta .   aur dekh apney iss ( jhootay ) mabood ko jiss per tu jama betha tha ! hum issay jala daalen gay , aur phir iss ( ki raakh ) ko choora choora ker kay samandar mein bikhair den gay .

ayahs.text: haqeeqat mein tum sabb ka mabood to bus aik hi Allah hai , jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . uss ka ilm her cheez ka ehata kiye huye hai .
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat mein tum sabb ka mabood to bus aik hi Allah hai , jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . uss ka ilm her cheez ka ehata kiye huye hai .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) mazi mein jo halaat guzray hain unn mein say kuch waqiyaat hum issi tarah tum ko sunatay hain , aur hum ney tumhen khaas apney paas say aik naseehat nama ata kiya hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) mazi mein jo halaat guzray hain unn mein say kuch waqiyaat hum issi tarah tum ko sunatay hain , aur hum ney tumhen khaas apney paas say aik naseehat nama ata kiya hai .

ayahs.text: jo log uss say mun morren gay , to woh qayamat kay din bara bhari bojh laadey hon gay ,
ayahs.translation: jo log uss say mun morren gay , to woh qayamat kay din bara bhari bojh laadey hon gay ,

ayahs.text: jiss ( kay azab ) mein woh hamesha rahen gay , aur qayamat kay din unn kay liye yeh bad-tareen bojh hoga ,
ayahs.translation: jiss ( kay azab ) mein woh hamesha rahen gay , aur qayamat kay din unn kay liye yeh bad-tareen bojh hoga ,

ayahs.text: jiss din soor phoonka jaye ga , aur uss din hum saray mujrimon ko gher ker iss tarah jama keren gay kay woh neelay parray hon gay ,
ayahs.translation: jiss din soor phoonka jaye ga , aur uss din hum saray mujrimon ko gher ker iss tarah jama keren gay kay woh neelay parray hon gay ,

ayahs.text: aapas mein sargoshiyan ker rahey hon gay kay tum ( qabron mein yaa duniya mein ) das din say ziyada nahi thehray .
ayahs.translation: aapas mein sargoshiyan ker rahey hon gay kay tum ( qabron mein yaa duniya mein ) das din say ziyada nahi thehray .

ayahs.text: jiss baaray mein woh baaten keren gay uss ki haqeeqat hamen khoob maloom hai ,   jabkay unn mein say jiss ka tareeqa sabb say behtar hoga , woh kahey ga kay tum aik din say ziyada nahi thehray .
ayahs.translation: jiss baaray mein woh baaten keren gay uss ki haqeeqat hamen khoob maloom hai ,   jabkay unn mein say jiss ka tareeqa sabb say behtar hoga , woh kahey ga kay tum aik din say ziyada nahi thehray .

ayahs.text: aur log tum say paharon kay baaray mein poochtay hain ( kay qayamat mein inn ka kiya banay ga-? ) jawab mein keh do kay mera perwerdigar inn ko dhool ki tarah urra dey ga .
ayahs.translation: aur log tum say paharon kay baaray mein poochtay hain ( kay qayamat mein inn ka kiya banay ga-? ) jawab mein keh do kay mera perwerdigar inn ko dhool ki tarah urra dey ga .

ayahs.text: aur zameen ko aisa humwaar chatiyal meydan bana ker choray ga .
ayahs.translation: aur zameen ko aisa humwaar chatiyal meydan bana ker choray ga .

ayahs.text: kay uss mein tumhen naa koi ball nazar aaye ga , naa koi ubhaar .
ayahs.translation: kay uss mein tumhen naa koi ball nazar aaye ga , naa koi ubhaar .

ayahs.text: uss din sabb kay sabb munadi kay peechay iss tarah chalay ayen gay kay uss kay samney koi tairrah nahi dikha saken gay . aur khudaye rehman kay aagay tamam aawazen dabb ker reh jayen gi , chunacheh tumhen paon ki sarsarahat kay siwa kuch sunai nahi dey ga .
ayahs.translation: uss din sabb kay sabb munadi kay peechay iss tarah chalay ayen gay kay uss kay samney koi tairrah nahi dikha saken gay . aur khudaye rehman kay aagay tamam aawazen dabb ker reh jayen gi , chunacheh tumhen paon ki sarsarahat kay siwa kuch sunai nahi dey ga .

ayahs.text: uss din kissi ki sifarish kaam nahi aaye gi , siwaye uss shaks ( ki sifarish ) kay jissay khudaye rehman ney ijazat dey di ho , aur jiss kay bolney per woh razi ho .
ayahs.translation: uss din kissi ki sifarish kaam nahi aaye gi , siwaye uss shaks ( ki sifarish ) kay jissay khudaye rehman ney ijazat dey di ho , aur jiss kay bolney per woh razi ho .

ayahs.text: woh logon  ki sari agli pichli baaton ko janta hai , aur woh uss kay ilm ka ehata nahi ker-saktay .
ayahs.translation: woh logon  ki sari agli pichli baaton ko janta hai , aur woh uss kay ilm ka ehata nahi ker-saktay .

ayahs.text: aur saray kay saray chehray haee o qayyum kay aagay jhukay hon gay , aur jo koi zulm ka bojh laad ker laya hoga na-murad hoga .
ayahs.translation: aur saray kay saray chehray haee o qayyum kay aagay jhukay hon gay , aur jo koi zulm ka bojh laad ker laya hoga na-murad hoga .

ayahs.text: aur jiss ney naik amal kiye hon gay , jabkay woh momin bhi ho , to ussay naa kissi ziyadti ka andesha hoga , naa kissi haq talfi ka .
ayahs.translation: aur jiss ney naik amal kiye hon gay , jabkay woh momin bhi ho , to ussay naa kissi ziyadti ka andesha hoga , naa kissi haq talfi ka .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney issi tarah yeh wahi aik arbi Quran ki shakal mein nazil ki hai , aur iss mein tanbeehaat ko tarah tarah say biyan kiya hai , takay log perhezgari ikhtiyar keren , ya yeh Quran unn mein kuch soch samajh peda keray .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney issi tarah yeh wahi aik arbi Quran ki shakal mein nazil ki hai , aur iss mein tanbeehaat ko tarah tarah say biyan kiya hai , takay log perhezgari ikhtiyar keren , ya yeh Quran unn mein kuch soch samajh peda keray .

ayahs.text: aesi hi oonchi shaan hai Allah ki , jo saltanat ka haqeeqi malik hai ! aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab Quran wahi kay zariye nazil horaha ho to uss kay mukammal honey say pehlay Quran parhney mein jaldi naa kiya kero ,   aur yeh dua kertay raha kero kay :  meray perwerdigar ! mujhay ilm mein aur taraqqi ata farma .
ayahs.translation: aesi hi oonchi shaan hai Allah ki , jo saltanat ka haqeeqi malik hai ! aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab Quran wahi kay zariye nazil horaha ho to uss kay mukammal honey say pehlay Quran parhney mein jaldi naa kiya kero ,   aur yeh dua kertay raha kero kay :  meray perwerdigar ! mujhay ilm mein aur taraqqi ata farma .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney iss say pehlay Adam ko aik baat ki takeed ki thi , phir unn say bhool hogaee , aur hum ney unn mein azam nahi paya .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney iss say pehlay Adam ko aik baat ki takeed ki thi , phir unn say bhool hogaee , aur hum ney unn mein azam nahi paya .

ayahs.text: yaad kero woh waqt jab hum ney farishton say kaha tha kay Adam ko sajda kero , chunacheh sabb ney sajda kiya , albatta iblees tha jiss ney inkar kiya .
ayahs.translation: yaad kero woh waqt jab hum ney farishton say kaha tha kay Adam ko sajda kero , chunacheh sabb ney sajda kiya , albatta iblees tha jiss ney inkar kiya .

ayahs.text: chunacheh hum ney kaha kay :  aey Adam ! yeh tumhara aur tumhari biwi ka dushman hai , lehaza aisa naa ho kay yeh tum dono ko jannat say niklwa dey , aur tum mushaqqat mein parr-jao .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh hum ney kaha kay :  aey Adam ! yeh tumhara aur tumhari biwi ka dushman hai , lehaza aisa naa ho kay yeh tum dono ko jannat say niklwa dey , aur tum mushaqqat mein parr-jao .

ayahs.text: yahan to tumhen yeh faeeda hai kay naa tum bhookay hogay , naa nangay ,
ayahs.translation: yahan to tumhen yeh faeeda hai kay naa tum bhookay hogay , naa nangay ,

ayahs.text: aur naa yahan piyasay raho gay , naa dhoop mein tapo gay .
ayahs.translation: aur naa yahan piyasay raho gay , naa dhoop mein tapo gay .

ayahs.text: phir shetan ney unn kay dil mein waswasa daala . kehney laga :  aey Adam ! kiya mein tumhen aik aisa darkht bataon jiss say jaodaani zindagi aur woh badshahi hasil hojati hai jo kabhi purani nahi parrti-?
ayahs.translation: phir shetan ney unn kay dil mein waswasa daala . kehney laga :  aey Adam ! kiya mein tumhen aik aisa darkht bataon jiss say jaodaani zindagi aur woh badshahi hasil hojati hai jo kabhi purani nahi parrti-?

ayahs.text: chunacheh unn dono ney uss darkht mein say kuch khaliya jiss say unn dono kay sharam kay maqamaat unn kay samney khul gaye , aur woh dono jannat kay patton ko apney oopper ganthnay lagay . aur ( iss tarah ) Adam ney apney rab ka kaha taala , aur bhatak gaye .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh unn dono ney uss darkht mein say kuch khaliya jiss say unn dono kay sharam kay maqamaat unn kay samney khul gaye , aur woh dono jannat kay patton ko apney oopper ganthnay lagay . aur ( iss tarah ) Adam ney apney rab ka kaha taala , aur bhatak gaye .

ayahs.text: phir unn kay rab ney unhen chunn liya , chunacheh unn ki tauba qubool farmaee , aur unhen hidayat ata farmaee .
ayahs.translation: phir unn kay rab ney unhen chunn liya , chunacheh unn ki tauba qubool farmaee , aur unhen hidayat ata farmaee .

ayahs.text: Allah ney farmaya :  tum dono kay dono yahan say neechay utar jao , tum aik doosray kay dushman hogay .   phir agar tumhen meri taraf say koi hidayat phonchay , to jo koi meri hidayat ki perwi keray ga , woh naa gumrah hoga , aur naa kissi mushkil mein girftaar hoga .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney farmaya :  tum dono kay dono yahan say neechay utar jao , tum aik doosray kay dushman hogay .   phir agar tumhen meri taraf say koi hidayat phonchay , to jo koi meri hidayat ki perwi keray ga , woh naa gumrah hoga , aur naa kissi mushkil mein girftaar hoga .

ayahs.text: aur jo meri naseehat say mun morray ga to uss ko bari tang zindagi milay gi , aur qayamat kay din hum ussay andha ker kay uthayen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur jo meri naseehat say mun morray ga to uss ko bari tang zindagi milay gi , aur qayamat kay din hum ussay andha ker kay uthayen gay .

ayahs.text: woh kahey ga kay :  ya rab ! tu ney mujhay andha ker kay kiyon uthaya , halankay mein to aankhon wala tha-?
ayahs.translation: woh kahey ga kay :  ya rab ! tu ney mujhay andha ker kay kiyon uthaya , halankay mein to aankhon wala tha-?

ayahs.text: Allah kahey ga :  issi tarah humari aayaten teray paas aai then , magar tu ney unhen bhula diya . aur aaj ussi tarah tujhay bhula diya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: Allah kahey ga :  issi tarah humari aayaten teray paas aai then , magar tu ney unhen bhula diya . aur aaj ussi tarah tujhay bhula diya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur jo shaks hadd say guzar jata hai , aur apney perwerdigar ki nishaniyon per emaan nahi lata , ussay hum issi tarah saza detay hain , aur aakhirat ka azab waqaee ziyada sakht aur ziyada dair rehney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jo shaks hadd say guzar jata hai , aur apney perwerdigar ki nishaniyon per emaan nahi lata , ussay hum issi tarah saza detay hain , aur aakhirat ka azab waqaee ziyada sakht aur ziyada dair rehney wala hai .

ayahs.text: phir kiya inn logon  ko iss baat ney bhi koi hidayat ka sabaq nahi diya kay inn say pehlay kitni naslen then jinhen hum ney halak kerdiya , jinn ki bastiyon mein yeh log chaltay phirtay bhi hain-? yaqeenan jinn logon  kay paas aqal hai , unn kay liye iss baat mein ibrat kay baray saman hain .
ayahs.translation: phir kiya inn logon  ko iss baat ney bhi koi hidayat ka sabaq nahi diya kay inn say pehlay kitni naslen then jinhen hum ney halak kerdiya , jinn ki bastiyon mein yeh log chaltay phirtay bhi hain-? yaqeenan jinn logon  kay paas aqal hai , unn kay liye iss baat mein ibrat kay baray saman hain .

ayahs.text: aur agar tumharay rab ki taraf say aik baat pehlay hi tey naa kerdi gaee hoti , aur ( uss kay nateejay mein azab ki ) aik miyaad muqarrar naa hoti , to lazimi tor per azab ( unn ko ) chimat chuka hota .
ayahs.translation: aur agar tumharay rab ki taraf say aik baat pehlay hi tey naa kerdi gaee hoti , aur ( uss kay nateejay mein azab ki ) aik miyaad muqarrar naa hoti , to lazimi tor per azab ( unn ko ) chimat chuka hota .

ayahs.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh log jo baaten kertay hain , tum inn per sabar kero , aur sooraj nikalney say pehlay aur uss kay ghuroob hone say pehlay apney rab ki tasbeeh aur hamd kertay raho , aur raat kay oqaat mein bhi tasbeeh kero , aur din kay kinaron mein bhi , takay tum khush hojao .
ayahs.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh log jo baaten kertay hain , tum inn per sabar kero , aur sooraj nikalney say pehlay aur uss kay ghuroob hone say pehlay apney rab ki tasbeeh aur hamd kertay raho , aur raat kay oqaat mein bhi tasbeeh kero , aur din kay kinaron mein bhi , takay tum khush hojao .

ayahs.text: aur dunyawi zindagi ki uss bahar ki taraf aankhen utha ker bhi naa dekho jo hum ney inn ( kafiron ) mein say mukhtalif logon  ko mazay uraney kay liye dey rakhi hai , takay hum inn ko uss kay zariye aazmayen . aur tumharay rab ka rizq sabb say behtar aur sabb say ziyada dairpa hai .
ayahs.translation: aur dunyawi zindagi ki uss bahar ki taraf aankhen utha ker bhi naa dekho jo hum ney inn ( kafiron ) mein say mukhtalif logon  ko mazay uraney kay liye dey rakhi hai , takay hum inn ko uss kay zariye aazmayen . aur tumharay rab ka rizq sabb say behtar aur sabb say ziyada dairpa hai .

ayahs.text: aur apney ghar walon ko namaz ka hukum do , aur khud bhi uss per sabit qadam raho . hum tum say rizq nahi chahtay ,   rizq to hum tumhen den gay . aur behtar anjam taqwa hi ka hai .
ayahs.translation: aur apney ghar walon ko namaz ka hukum do , aur khud bhi uss per sabit qadam raho . hum tum say rizq nahi chahtay ,   rizq to hum tumhen den gay . aur behtar anjam taqwa hi ka hai .

ayahs.text: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  yeh ( nabi ) humaray paas apney rab ki taraf say koi nishani kiyon nahi ley aatay-?  bhala kiya inn kay paas pichlay ( aasmani ) saheefon kay mazameen ki gawahi nahi aagae ?
ayahs.translation: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  yeh ( nabi ) humaray paas apney rab ki taraf say koi nishani kiyon nahi ley aatay-?  bhala kiya inn kay paas pichlay ( aasmani ) saheefon kay mazameen ki gawahi nahi aagae ?

ayahs.text: aur agar hum enhen iss ( Quran ) say pehlay inn ko kissi azab say halak ker-detay to yeh log kehtay kay :  humaray perwerdigar ! aap ney humaray paas koi payghumber kiyon nahi bheja , takay hum zaleel aur ruswa honey say pehlay aap ki aayaton ki perwi kertay-?
ayahs.translation: aur agar hum enhen iss ( Quran ) say pehlay inn ko kissi azab say halak ker-detay to yeh log kehtay kay :  humaray perwerdigar ! aap ney humaray paas koi payghumber kiyon nahi bheja , takay hum zaleel aur ruswa honey say pehlay aap ki aayaton ki perwi kertay-?

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) keh do kay :  ( hum ) sabb intizar ker rahey hain , lehaza tum bhi intizar kero    kiyonkay unqareeb tumhen pata chal jaye ga kay seedhay raastay walay log kon hain , aur kon hain jo hidayat paagaye hain-?
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) keh do kay :  ( hum ) sabb intizar ker rahey hain , lehaza tum bhi intizar kero    kiyonkay unqareeb tumhen pata chal jaye ga kay seedhay raastay walay log kon hain , aur kon hain jo hidayat paagaye hain-?

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: logon  kay liye unn kay hisab ka waqt qareeb aa-phoncha hai , aur woh hain kay ghaflat ki halat mein mun pheray huye hain !
verses.translation: logon  kay liye unn kay hisab ka waqt qareeb aa-phoncha hai , aur woh hain kay ghaflat ki halat mein mun pheray huye hain !

verses.text: jab kabhi unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say naseehat ki koi naee baat unn kay paas aati hai to woh ussay mazaq bana bana ker iss halat mein suntay hain .
verses.translation: jab kabhi unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say naseehat ki koi naee baat unn kay paas aati hai to woh ussay mazaq bana bana ker iss halat mein suntay hain .

verses.text: kay unn kay dil fuzooliyaat mein munhamik hotay hain . aur yeh zalim chupkay chupkay ( aik doosray say ) sargoshi kertay hain kay :  yeh shaks ( yani Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) tumhi jaisa aik insan nahi to aur kiya hai-? kiya phir bhi tum soojhtay boojhtay jadoo ki baat sunney jao gay-?
verses.translation: kay unn kay dil fuzooliyaat mein munhamik hotay hain . aur yeh zalim chupkay chupkay ( aik doosray say ) sargoshi kertay hain kay :  yeh shaks ( yani Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) tumhi jaisa aik insan nahi to aur kiya hai-? kiya phir bhi tum soojhtay boojhtay jadoo ki baat sunney jao gay-?

verses.text: payghumber ney ( jawab mein ) kaha kay :  aasman aur zameen mein jo kuch kaha jata hai , mera perwerdigar uss sabb ko janta hai . woh her baat sunta hai , her cheez say ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: payghumber ney ( jawab mein ) kaha kay :  aasman aur zameen mein jo kuch kaha jata hai , mera perwerdigar uss sabb ko janta hai . woh her baat sunta hai , her cheez say ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: yehi nahi balkay inn logon  ney yeh bhi kaha kay :  yeh ( Quran ) bey jorr khuwabon ka majmooa hai , balkay yeh inn sahab ney khud gharr liya hai , balkay yeh aik shaeer hain . bhala yeh humaray samney koi nishani to ley ayen jaisay pichlay payghumber ( nishaniyon kay sath ) bhejay gaye thay !
verses.translation: yehi nahi balkay inn logon  ney yeh bhi kaha kay :  yeh ( Quran ) bey jorr khuwabon ka majmooa hai , balkay yeh inn sahab ney khud gharr liya hai , balkay yeh aik shaeer hain . bhala yeh humaray samney koi nishani to ley ayen jaisay pichlay payghumber ( nishaniyon kay sath ) bhejay gaye thay !

verses.text: halankay inn say pehlay jiss kissi basti ko hum ney halak kiya , woh emaan nahi laee , abb kiya yeh log emaan ley ayen gay-?
verses.translation: halankay inn say pehlay jiss kissi basti ko hum ney halak kiya , woh emaan nahi laee , abb kiya yeh log emaan ley ayen gay-?

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum say pehlay kissi aur ko nahi , aadmiyon hi ko Rasool bana ker bheja tha jinn per hum wahi nazil kertay thay . lehaza ( kafiron say kaho kay ) agar tumhen khud ilm nahi hai to naseehat ka ilm rakhney walon say pooch lo .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum say pehlay kissi aur ko nahi , aadmiyon hi ko Rasool bana ker bheja tha jinn per hum wahi nazil kertay thay . lehaza ( kafiron say kaho kay ) agar tumhen khud ilm nahi hai to naseehat ka ilm rakhney walon say pooch lo .

verses.text: aur hum ney unn ( Rasoolon ) ko aesay jism bana ker peda nahi kerdiya tha kay woh khana naa khatay hon , aur naa woh aesay thay kay hamesha zinda rahen .
verses.translation: aur hum ney unn ( Rasoolon ) ko aesay jism bana ker peda nahi kerdiya tha kay woh khana naa khatay hon , aur naa woh aesay thay kay hamesha zinda rahen .

verses.text: phir hum ney unn say jo wada kiya tha , ussay sacha ker dikhaya kay unn ko bhi bacha liya , aur ( unn kay ilawa ) jinn ko hum ney chaha unn ko bhi , aur jo log hadd say guzar chukay thay , unhen halak kerdiya .
verses.translation: phir hum ney unn say jo wada kiya tha , ussay sacha ker dikhaya kay unn ko bhi bacha liya , aur ( unn kay ilawa ) jinn ko hum ney chaha unn ko bhi , aur jo log hadd say guzar chukay thay , unhen halak kerdiya .

verses.text: . ( abb ) hum ney tumharay paas aik aesi kitab utaari hai jiss mein tumharay liye naseehat hai .   kiya phir bhi tum nahi samajhtay-?
verses.translation: . ( abb ) hum ney tumharay paas aik aesi kitab utaari hai jiss mein tumharay liye naseehat hai .   kiya phir bhi tum nahi samajhtay-?

verses.text: aur hum ney kitni bastiyon ko pees daala jo zalim then aur unn kay baad hum ney doosri naslen peda ken .
verses.translation: aur hum ney kitni bastiyon ko pees daala jo zalim then aur unn kay baad hum ney doosri naslen peda ken .

verses.text: chunacheh jab unhon ney humaray azab ki aahat pai to woh aik dum wahan say bhagney lagay .
verses.translation: chunacheh jab unhon ney humaray azab ki aahat pai to woh aik dum wahan say bhagney lagay .

verses.text: . ( unn say kaha gaya : )  bhago matt , aur wapis jao apney unhi makanaat aur ussi aesh o ishrat kay saman ki taraf jiss kay mazay tum loot rahey thay , shayad tum say kuch poocha jaye .
verses.translation: . ( unn say kaha gaya : )  bhago matt , aur wapis jao apney unhi makanaat aur ussi aesh o ishrat kay saman ki taraf jiss kay mazay tum loot rahey thay , shayad tum say kuch poocha jaye .

verses.text: woh kehney lagay :  haaye humari kam bakhti ! sachi baat yeh hai kay hum log hi zalim thay .
verses.translation: woh kehney lagay :  haaye humari kam bakhti ! sachi baat yeh hai kay hum log hi zalim thay .

verses.text: unn ki yehi pukar jari rahi yahan tak kay hum ney unn ko aik katti hoi kheti , aik bujhi hoi aag bana ker rakh diya .
verses.translation: unn ki yehi pukar jari rahi yahan tak kay hum ney unn ko aik katti hoi kheti , aik bujhi hoi aag bana ker rakh diya .

verses.text: aur hum ney aasman , zameen aur jo kuch unn kay darmiyan hai , uss ko iss liye peda nahi kiya kay hum koi khel kerna chahtay hon .
verses.translation: aur hum ney aasman , zameen aur jo kuch unn kay darmiyan hai , uss ko iss liye peda nahi kiya kay hum koi khel kerna chahtay hon .

verses.text: agar hamen koi khel banana hota to hum khud apney paas say bana letay , agar hamen aisa kerna hi hota .
verses.translation: agar hamen koi khel banana hota to hum khud apney paas say bana letay , agar hamen aisa kerna hi hota .

verses.text: balkay hum to haq baat ko batil per kheench maartay hain , jo uss ka sar torr daalta hai , aur woh aik dum malya mait hojata hai .   aur jo baaten tum bana rahey ho , unn ki wajeh say kharabi tumhari hi hai .
verses.translation: balkay hum to haq baat ko batil per kheench maartay hain , jo uss ka sar torr daalta hai , aur woh aik dum malya mait hojata hai .   aur jo baaten tum bana rahey ho , unn ki wajeh say kharabi tumhari hi hai .

verses.text: aur aasmano aur zameen mein jo log bhi hain , Allah kay hain . aur jo ( farishtay ) Allah kay paas hain , woh naa uss ki ibadat say sarkashi kertay hain , naa thaktay hain .
verses.translation: aur aasmano aur zameen mein jo log bhi hain , Allah kay hain . aur jo ( farishtay ) Allah kay paas hain , woh naa uss ki ibadat say sarkashi kertay hain , naa thaktay hain .

verses.text: woh raat din uss ki tasbeeh kertay rehtay hain , aur sust nahi parrtay .
verses.translation: woh raat din uss ki tasbeeh kertay rehtay hain , aur sust nahi parrtay .

verses.text: bhala kiya inn logon  ney zameen mein say aesay khuda bana rakhay hain jo naee zindagi detay hain-?
verses.translation: bhala kiya inn logon  ney zameen mein say aesay khuda bana rakhay hain jo naee zindagi detay hain-?

verses.text: agar aasman aur zameen mein Allah kay siwa doosray khuda hotay to dono darham barham hojatay .   lehaza arsh ka malik Allah unn baaton say bilkul pak hai jo yeh log banaya kertay hain .
verses.translation: agar aasman aur zameen mein Allah kay siwa doosray khuda hotay to dono darham barham hojatay .   lehaza arsh ka malik Allah unn baaton say bilkul pak hai jo yeh log banaya kertay hain .

verses.text: woh jo kuch kerta hai , uss ka kissi ko jawab deh nahi hai , aur inn sabb ko jawab dahi kerni hogi .
verses.translation: woh jo kuch kerta hai , uss ka kissi ko jawab deh nahi hai , aur inn sabb ko jawab dahi kerni hogi .

verses.text: bhala kiya ussay chorr ker unhon ney doosray khuda bana rakhay hain-? ( aey payghumber ! ) inn say kaho kay :  lao apni daleel !  yeh ( Quran ) bhi mojood hai jiss mein meray sath walon kay liye naseehat hai , aur woh ( kitaben ) bhi mojood hain jinn mein mujh say pehlay logon  kay liye naseehat thi .   lekin waqiaa yeh hai kay inn mein say aksar log haq baat ka yaqeen nahi kertay , iss liye mun morray huye hain .
verses.translation: bhala kiya ussay chorr ker unhon ney doosray khuda bana rakhay hain-? ( aey payghumber ! ) inn say kaho kay :  lao apni daleel !  yeh ( Quran ) bhi mojood hai jiss mein meray sath walon kay liye naseehat hai , aur woh ( kitaben ) bhi mojood hain jinn mein mujh say pehlay logon  kay liye naseehat thi .   lekin waqiaa yeh hai kay inn mein say aksar log haq baat ka yaqeen nahi kertay , iss liye mun morray huye hain .

verses.text: aur tum say pehlay hum ney koi aisa Rasool nahi bheja jiss per hum ney yeh wahi nazil naa ki ho kay :  meray siwa koi khuda nahi hai , lehaza meri ibadat kero .
verses.translation: aur tum say pehlay hum ney koi aisa Rasool nahi bheja jiss per hum ney yeh wahi nazil naa ki ho kay :  meray siwa koi khuda nahi hai , lehaza meri ibadat kero .

verses.text: yeh log kehtay hain kay :  khudaye rehman ( farishton ki shakal mein ) aulad rakhta hai .    subhan Allah ! balkay ( farishtay to Allah kay ) banday hain jinhen izzat bakhshi gaee hai .
verses.translation: yeh log kehtay hain kay :  khudaye rehman ( farishton ki shakal mein ) aulad rakhta hai .    subhan Allah ! balkay ( farishtay to Allah kay ) banday hain jinhen izzat bakhshi gaee hai .

verses.text: woh uss say aagay barh ker koi baat nahi kertay , aur woh ussi kay hukum per amal kertay hain .
verses.translation: woh uss say aagay barh ker koi baat nahi kertay , aur woh ussi kay hukum per amal kertay hain .
