verses.text: woh unn ki tamam agli pichli baaton ko janta hai , aur woh kissi ki sifarish nahi ker-saktay , siwaye uss kay jiss kay liye Allah ki marzi ho , aur woh uss kay khof say sehmay rehtay hain .
verses.translation: woh unn ki tamam agli pichli baaton ko janta hai , aur woh kissi ki sifarish nahi ker-saktay , siwaye uss kay jiss kay liye Allah ki marzi ho , aur woh uss kay khof say sehmay rehtay hain .

verses.text: aur agar unn mein say koi ( bil-farz ) yeh kahey kay :  Allah kay ilawa mein bhi mabood hun  to uss ko hum jahannum ki saza den gay . aesay zalimon ko hum aesi hi saza detay hain .
verses.translation: aur agar unn mein say koi ( bil-farz ) yeh kahey kay :  Allah kay ilawa mein bhi mabood hun  to uss ko hum jahannum ki saza den gay . aesay zalimon ko hum aesi hi saza detay hain .

verses.text: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , kiya unhen yeh maloom nahi hai kay saray aasman aur zameen band thay , phir hum ney unhen khol diya ,   aur paani say her jandaar cheez peda ki hai ?   kiya phir bhi yeh emaan nahi layen gay-?
verses.translation: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , kiya unhen yeh maloom nahi hai kay saray aasman aur zameen band thay , phir hum ney unhen khol diya ,   aur paani say her jandaar cheez peda ki hai ?   kiya phir bhi yeh emaan nahi layen gay-?

verses.text: aur hum ney zameen mein jamay huye pahar peda kiye hain , takay woh unhen ley ker hilney naa paye ,   aur uss mein hum ney chorray chorray raastay banaye hain , takay woh manzil tak phonch saken .
verses.translation: aur hum ney zameen mein jamay huye pahar peda kiye hain , takay woh unhen ley ker hilney naa paye ,   aur uss mein hum ney chorray chorray raastay banaye hain , takay woh manzil tak phonch saken .

verses.text: aur hum ney aasman ko aik mehfooz chat bana diya hai ,   aur yeh log hain kay uss ki nishaniyon say mun morray huye hain .
verses.translation: aur hum ney aasman ko aik mehfooz chat bana diya hai ,   aur yeh log hain kay uss ki nishaniyon say mun morray huye hain .

verses.text: aur wohi ( Allah ) hai jiss ney raat aur din aur sooraj aur chaand peda kiye . sabb kissi naa kissi madaar mein ter rahey hain .
verses.translation: aur wohi ( Allah ) hai jiss ney raat aur din aur sooraj aur chaand peda kiye . sabb kissi naa kissi madaar mein ter rahey hain .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum say pehlay bhi hamesha zinda rehna hum ney kissi fard bashar kay liye tey nahi kiya .   chunacheh agar tumhara intiqal hogaya to kiya yeh log aesay hain jo hamesha zinda rahen-?
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum say pehlay bhi hamesha zinda rehna hum ney kissi fard bashar kay liye tey nahi kiya .   chunacheh agar tumhara intiqal hogaya to kiya yeh log aesay hain jo hamesha zinda rahen-?

verses.text: her jaan daar ko moat ka maza chakhna hai . aur hum tumhen aazmaney kay liye buri bhali halaton mein mubtala kertay hain , aur tum sabb humaray paas hi loata ker laye jao gay .
verses.translation: her jaan daar ko moat ka maza chakhna hai . aur hum tumhen aazmaney kay liye buri bhali halaton mein mubtala kertay hain , aur tum sabb humaray paas hi loata ker laye jao gay .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna rakha hai , woh jab tumhen dekhtay hain to iss kay siwa unn ka koi kaam nahi hota kay woh tumhara mazaq bananey lagtay hain ( aur kehtay hain : )  kiya yehi sahab hain jo tumharay khudaon ka ziker kiya kertay hain-? ( yani yeh kehtay hain kay inn ki koi haqeeqat nahi )  halankay inn ( kafiron ) ki apni halat yeh hai kay woh khudaye rehman hi ka ziker kernay say inkar kiye bethay hain !
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna rakha hai , woh jab tumhen dekhtay hain to iss kay siwa unn ka koi kaam nahi hota kay woh tumhara mazaq bananey lagtay hain ( aur kehtay hain : )  kiya yehi sahab hain jo tumharay khudaon ka ziker kiya kertay hain-? ( yani yeh kehtay hain kay inn ki koi haqeeqat nahi )  halankay inn ( kafiron ) ki apni halat yeh hai kay woh khudaye rehman hi ka ziker kernay say inkar kiye bethay hain !

verses.text: insan jald bazi ki khaslat ley ker peda huwa hai . mein unqareeb tumhen apni nishaniyan dikhla dun ga , lehaza tum mujh say jaldi matt machao .
verses.translation: insan jald bazi ki khaslat ley ker peda huwa hai . mein unqareeb tumhen apni nishaniyan dikhla dun ga , lehaza tum mujh say jaldi matt machao .

verses.text: aur yeh log ( musalmanon say ) kehtay hain kay :  agar tum sachay ho to aakhir yeh ( azab ki ) dhamki kab poori hogi-?
verses.translation: aur yeh log ( musalmanon say ) kehtay hain kay :  agar tum sachay ho to aakhir yeh ( azab ki ) dhamki kab poori hogi-?

verses.text: kaash inn kafiron ko uss waqt ki kuch khabar lagg jati jab yeh naa apney chehron say aag ko door ker-saken gay , aur naa apni pushton say , aur naa inn ko koi madad moyassar aaye gi .
verses.translation: kaash inn kafiron ko uss waqt ki kuch khabar lagg jati jab yeh naa apney chehron say aag ko door ker-saken gay , aur naa apni pushton say , aur naa inn ko koi madad moyassar aaye gi .

verses.text: balkay woh ( aag ) unn kay paas aik dum aa-dhamkay gi , aur unn kay hosh o hawaas gumm ker kay rakh dey gi , phir naa yeh ussay peechay hata saken gay , aur naa unhen koi mohlat di jaye gi .
verses.translation: balkay woh ( aag ) unn kay paas aik dum aa-dhamkay gi , aur unn kay hosh o hawaas gumm ker kay rakh dey gi , phir naa yeh ussay peechay hata saken gay , aur naa unhen koi mohlat di jaye gi .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum say pehlay bhi payghumberon ka mazaq uraya gaya tha , phir unn ka mazaq bananey walon ko ussi cheez ney aa-ghera jiss ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum say pehlay bhi payghumberon ka mazaq uraya gaya tha , phir unn ka mazaq bananey walon ko ussi cheez ney aa-ghera jiss ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay .

verses.text: keh do kay :  kon hai jo raat mein aur din mein khudaye rehman ( kay azab say ) say tumhara bachao keray-?  magar woh hain kay apney perwerdigar kay ziker say mun morray huye hain .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  kon hai jo raat mein aur din mein khudaye rehman ( kay azab say ) say tumhara bachao keray-?  magar woh hain kay apney perwerdigar kay ziker say mun morray huye hain .

verses.text: bhala kiya inn kay paas humaray siwa koi aesay khuda hain jo inn ki hifazat kertay hon-? woh to khud apni madad nahi ker-saktay , aur naa humaray muqablay mein koi unn ka sath dey sakta hai .
verses.translation: bhala kiya inn kay paas humaray siwa koi aesay khuda hain jo inn ki hifazat kertay hon-? woh to khud apni madad nahi ker-saktay , aur naa humaray muqablay mein koi unn ka sath dey sakta hai .

verses.text: balkay moamla yeh hai kay hum ney inn ko aur inn kay AabaoAjdaad ko saman-e-aesh ata kiya , yahan tak kay ( issi halat mein ) unn per aik umar guzar gaee .   bhala kiya unhen yeh nazar nahi aata kay hum zameen ko uss kay mukhtalif kinaron say ghatatay chalay aarahey hain .   phir kiya woh ghalib aajayen gay-?
verses.translation: balkay moamla yeh hai kay hum ney inn ko aur inn kay AabaoAjdaad ko saman-e-aesh ata kiya , yahan tak kay ( issi halat mein ) unn per aik umar guzar gaee .   bhala kiya unhen yeh nazar nahi aata kay hum zameen ko uss kay mukhtalif kinaron say ghatatay chalay aarahey hain .   phir kiya woh ghalib aajayen gay-?

verses.text: keh do kay :  mein to tumhen wahi kay zariye darata hun  lekin behray log aesay hain kay jab unhen daraya jata hai to woh koi pukar nahi suntay .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  mein to tumhen wahi kay zariye darata hun  lekin behray log aesay hain kay jab unhen daraya jata hai to woh koi pukar nahi suntay .

verses.text: aur agar tumharay perwerdigar kay azab ka aik jhonka bhi unhen choo jaye to yeh keh uthen gay kay :  haaye humari kam bakhti ! waqaee hum log zalim thay .
verses.translation: aur agar tumharay perwerdigar kay azab ka aik jhonka bhi unhen choo jaye to yeh keh uthen gay kay :  haaye humari kam bakhti ! waqaee hum log zalim thay .

verses.text: aur hum qayamat kay din aesi tarazooyen laa rakhen gay jo sarapa insaf hon gi ,   chunacheh kissi per koi zulm nahi hoga . aur agar koi amal raai kay daney kay barabar bhi hoga , to hum ussay samney ley ayen gay . aur hisab lenay kay liye hum kafi hain .
verses.translation: aur hum qayamat kay din aesi tarazooyen laa rakhen gay jo sarapa insaf hon gi ,   chunacheh kissi per koi zulm nahi hoga . aur agar koi amal raai kay daney kay barabar bhi hoga , to hum ussay samney ley ayen gay . aur hisab lenay kay liye hum kafi hain .

verses.text: aur hum ney musa aur Haroon ko haq o batil ka aik mayaar ( hidayat ki ) aik roshni aur unn muttaqi logon  kay liye naseehat ka saman ata kiya tha .
verses.translation: aur hum ney musa aur Haroon ko haq o batil ka aik mayaar ( hidayat ki ) aik roshni aur unn muttaqi logon  kay liye naseehat ka saman ata kiya tha .

verses.text: jo dekhtay baghair apney perwerdigar say daren , aur jinn ko qayamat ki gharri ka khof laga huwa ho .
verses.translation: jo dekhtay baghair apney perwerdigar say daren , aur jinn ko qayamat ki gharri ka khof laga huwa ho .

verses.text: aur abb yeh ( Quran ) barkaton wala paygham naseehat hai jo hum ney nazil kiya hai . kiya phir bhi tum issay manney say inkar kertay ho-?
verses.translation: aur abb yeh ( Quran ) barkaton wala paygham naseehat hai jo hum ney nazil kiya hai . kiya phir bhi tum issay manney say inkar kertay ho-?

verses.text: aur iss say pehlay hum ney Ibrahim ko woh samajh boojh ata ki thi jo unn kay laeeq thi , aur hum unhen khoob jantay thay .
verses.translation: aur iss say pehlay hum ney Ibrahim ko woh samajh boojh ata ki thi jo unn kay laeeq thi , aur hum unhen khoob jantay thay .

verses.text: woh waqt yaad kero jab unhon ney apney baap aur apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  yeh kiya moorten hain jinn kay aagay tum dharna diye bethay ho-?
verses.translation: woh waqt yaad kero jab unhon ney apney baap aur apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  yeh kiya moorten hain jinn kay aagay tum dharna diye bethay ho-?

verses.text: woh bolay kay :  hum ney apney baap dadon ko inn ki ibadat kertay huye paya hai .
verses.translation: woh bolay kay :  hum ney apney baap dadon ko inn ki ibadat kertay huye paya hai .

verses.text: Ibrahim ney kaha :  haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum bhi aur tumharay baap daday bhi khuli gumrahi mein mubtala rahey ho .
verses.translation: Ibrahim ney kaha :  haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum bhi aur tumharay baap daday bhi khuli gumrahi mein mubtala rahey ho .

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  kiya tum hum say sach mooch ki baat ker rahey ho , ya dil lagi ker rahey ho-?
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  kiya tum hum say sach mooch ki baat ker rahey ho , ya dil lagi ker rahey ho-?

verses.text: Ibrahim ney kaha :  nahi , balkay tumhara perwerdigar woh hai jo tamam aasmano aur zameen ka malik hai , jiss ney yeh sari cheezen peda ki hain , aur logo ! mein iss baat per gawahi deta hun .
verses.translation: Ibrahim ney kaha :  nahi , balkay tumhara perwerdigar woh hai jo tamam aasmano aur zameen ka malik hai , jiss ney yeh sari cheezen peda ki hain , aur logo ! mein iss baat per gawahi deta hun .

verses.text: aur Allah ki qasam ! jab tum peeth pher ker chalay jao gay to mein tumharay button kay sath aik ( aisa ) kaam kerun ga ( jiss say unn ki haqeeqat khul jaye gi ) .
verses.translation: aur Allah ki qasam ! jab tum peeth pher ker chalay jao gay to mein tumharay button kay sath aik ( aisa ) kaam kerun ga ( jiss say unn ki haqeeqat khul jaye gi ) .

verses.text: chunacheh Ibrahim ney unn kay baray butt kay siwa saray button ko tukrray tukrray kerdiya , takay woh log unn ki taraf rujoo keren .
verses.translation: chunacheh Ibrahim ney unn kay baray butt kay siwa saray button ko tukrray tukrray kerdiya , takay woh log unn ki taraf rujoo keren .

verses.text: woh kehney lagay kay :  humaray khudaon kay sath yeh harkat kiss ney ki hai-? woh koi bara hi zalim tha .
verses.translation: woh kehney lagay kay :  humaray khudaon kay sath yeh harkat kiss ney ki hai-? woh koi bara hi zalim tha .

verses.text: kuch logon  ney kaha :  hum ney aik nojawan ko suna hai kay woh inn button kay baaray mein baaten banaya kerta hai , ussay Ibrahim kehtay hain .
verses.translation: kuch logon  ney kaha :  hum ney aik nojawan ko suna hai kay woh inn button kay baaray mein baaten banaya kerta hai , ussay Ibrahim kehtay hain .

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  to phir uss ko sabb logon  kay samney ley ker aao , takay sabb gawah ban jayen .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  to phir uss ko sabb logon  kay samney ley ker aao , takay sabb gawah ban jayen .

verses.text: . ( phir jab Ibrahim ko laya gaya to ) woh bolay :  Ibrahim ! kiya humaray khudaon kay sath yeh harkat tum hi ney ki hai-?
verses.translation: . ( phir jab Ibrahim ko laya gaya to ) woh bolay :  Ibrahim ! kiya humaray khudaon kay sath yeh harkat tum hi ney ki hai-?

verses.text: Ibrahim ney kaha :  nahi , balkay yeh harkat unn kay iss baray sardar ney ki hai , abb inhi button say pooch lo , agar yeh boltay hon .
verses.translation: Ibrahim ney kaha :  nahi , balkay yeh harkat unn kay iss baray sardar ney ki hai , abb inhi button say pooch lo , agar yeh boltay hon .

verses.text: iss per woh log apney dil mein kuch sochney lagay , aur ( apney aap say ) kehney lagay kay :  sachi baat to yehi hai kay tum khud zalim ho .
verses.translation: iss per woh log apney dil mein kuch sochney lagay , aur ( apney aap say ) kehney lagay kay :  sachi baat to yehi hai kay tum khud zalim ho .

verses.text: phir unhon ney apney sar jhuka liye , aur kaha :  tumhen to maloom hi hai kay yeh boltay nahi hain .
verses.translation: phir unhon ney apney sar jhuka liye , aur kaha :  tumhen to maloom hi hai kay yeh boltay nahi hain .

verses.text: Ibrahim ney kaha :  bhala batao kay kiya tum Allah ko chorr ker aesi cheezon ki ibadat ker rahey ho jo tumhen naa kuch faeeda phonchati hain naa nuqsan-?
verses.translation: Ibrahim ney kaha :  bhala batao kay kiya tum Allah ko chorr ker aesi cheezon ki ibadat ker rahey ho jo tumhen naa kuch faeeda phonchati hain naa nuqsan-?

verses.text: tuff hai tum per bhi , aur unn per bhi jinn ki tum Allah ko chorr ker ibadat kertay ho . bhala kiya tumhen itni samajh nahi-?
verses.translation: tuff hai tum per bhi , aur unn per bhi jinn ki tum Allah ko chorr ker ibadat kertay ho . bhala kiya tumhen itni samajh nahi-?

verses.text: woh ( aik doosray say ) kehney lagay :  aag mein jala daalo iss shaks ko , aur apney khudaon ki madad kero , agar tum mein kuch kernay ka dum kham hai .
verses.translation: woh ( aik doosray say ) kehney lagay :  aag mein jala daalo iss shaks ko , aur apney khudaon ki madad kero , agar tum mein kuch kernay ka dum kham hai .

verses.text: . ( chunacheh unhon ney Ibrahim ko aag mein daal diya , aur ) hum ney kaha :  aey aag ! thandi hoja , aur Ibrahim kay liye salamti ban jaa .
verses.translation: . ( chunacheh unhon ney Ibrahim ko aag mein daal diya , aur ) hum ney kaha :  aey aag ! thandi hoja , aur Ibrahim kay liye salamti ban jaa .

verses.text: unn logon  ney Ibrahim kay liye burai ka mansooba banaya tha , magar nateeja yeh huwa kay hum ney unhi ko buri tarah nakam kerdiya .
verses.translation: unn logon  ney Ibrahim kay liye burai ka mansooba banaya tha , magar nateeja yeh huwa kay hum ney unhi ko buri tarah nakam kerdiya .

verses.text: aur hum unhen aur loot ko bacha ker uss sarzameen ki taraf ley gaye jiss mein hum ney duniya jahan kay logon  kay liye barkaten rakhi hain .
verses.translation: aur hum unhen aur loot ko bacha ker uss sarzameen ki taraf ley gaye jiss mein hum ney duniya jahan kay logon  kay liye barkaten rakhi hain .

verses.text: aur hum ney unn ko inaam kay tor per Ishaq aur Yaqoob ata kiye . aur unn mein say her aik ko hum ney naik banaya .
verses.translation: aur hum ney unn ko inaam kay tor per Ishaq aur Yaqoob ata kiye . aur unn mein say her aik ko hum ney naik banaya .

verses.text: aur unn sabb ko hum ney peshwa banaya jo humaray hukum say logon  ki rehnumai kertay thay , aur hum ney wahi kay zariye unhen naikiyan kernay , namaz qaeem kernay aur zakat ada kernay ki takeed ki thi , aur woh humaray ibadat guzaar thay .
verses.translation: aur unn sabb ko hum ney peshwa banaya jo humaray hukum say logon  ki rehnumai kertay thay , aur hum ney wahi kay zariye unhen naikiyan kernay , namaz qaeem kernay aur zakat ada kernay ki takeed ki thi , aur woh humaray ibadat guzaar thay .

verses.text: aur loot ko hum ney hikmat aur ilm ata kiya , aur unhen uss basti say nijat di jo ganday kaam kerti thi .   haqeeqat mein woh boht burai wali nafarman qoam thi .
verses.translation: aur loot ko hum ney hikmat aur ilm ata kiya , aur unhen uss basti say nijat di jo ganday kaam kerti thi .   haqeeqat mein woh boht burai wali nafarman qoam thi .

verses.text: aur loot ko hum ney apni rehmat mein dakhil kerliya , woh yaqeenan naik logon  mein say thay .
verses.translation: aur loot ko hum ney apni rehmat mein dakhil kerliya , woh yaqeenan naik logon  mein say thay .

verses.text: aur nooh ko bhi ( hum ney hikmat aur ilm ata kiya ) , woh waqt yaad kero jab uss waqaey say pehlay unhon ney hamen pukara , to hum ney unn ki dua qubool ki , aur unn ko aur unn kay sathiyon ko bari bhari museebat say bacha liya .
verses.translation: aur nooh ko bhi ( hum ney hikmat aur ilm ata kiya ) , woh waqt yaad kero jab uss waqaey say pehlay unhon ney hamen pukara , to hum ney unn ki dua qubool ki , aur unn ko aur unn kay sathiyon ko bari bhari museebat say bacha liya .

verses.text: aur jiss qoam ney humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya tha , uss kay muqablay mein unn ki madad ki . haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh boht buray log thay , iss liye hum ney unn sabb ko gharq kerdiya .
verses.translation: aur jiss qoam ney humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya tha , uss kay muqablay mein unn ki madad ki . haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh boht buray log thay , iss liye hum ney unn sabb ko gharq kerdiya .

verses.text: aur dawood aur suleman ( ko bhi hum ney hikmat aur ilm ata kiya tha ) jab woh dono aik khet kay jhagray ka faisla ker rahey thay , kiyonkay kuch logon  ki bakriyan raat kay waqt uss khet mein jaa ghusi then ,   aur unn logon  kay baaray mein jo faisla huwa ussay hum khud dekh rahey thay .
verses.translation: aur dawood aur suleman ( ko bhi hum ney hikmat aur ilm ata kiya tha ) jab woh dono aik khet kay jhagray ka faisla ker rahey thay , kiyonkay kuch logon  ki bakriyan raat kay waqt uss khet mein jaa ghusi then ,   aur unn logon  kay baaray mein jo faisla huwa ussay hum khud dekh rahey thay .

verses.text: chunacheh uss faislay ki samajh hum ney suleman ko dey di , aur ( wesay ) hum ney dono hi ko hikmat aur ilm ata kiya tha .   aur hum ney dawood kay sath paharon ko tabey daar bana diya tha kay woh parindon ko sath ley ker tasbeeh keren ,   aur yeh saray kaam kernay walay hum thay .
verses.translation: chunacheh uss faislay ki samajh hum ney suleman ko dey di , aur ( wesay ) hum ney dono hi ko hikmat aur ilm ata kiya tha .   aur hum ney dawood kay sath paharon ko tabey daar bana diya tha kay woh parindon ko sath ley ker tasbeeh keren ,   aur yeh saray kaam kernay walay hum thay .

verses.text: aur hum ney unhen tumharay faeeday kay liye aik jangi libas ( yani zirah ) bananey ki sanat sikhai takay woh tumhen larraee mein aik doosray ki zadd say bachaye .   abb batao kay kiya tum shukar guzaar ho-?
verses.translation: aur hum ney unhen tumharay faeeday kay liye aik jangi libas ( yani zirah ) bananey ki sanat sikhai takay woh tumhen larraee mein aik doosray ki zadd say bachaye .   abb batao kay kiya tum shukar guzaar ho-?

verses.text: aur hum ney tez chalti hoi hawa ko suleman kay tabey kerdiya tha jo unn kay hukum say uss sarzameen ki taraf chalti thi jiss mein hum ney barkaten rakhi hain .   aur hamen her her baat ka poora poora ilm hai .
verses.translation: aur hum ney tez chalti hoi hawa ko suleman kay tabey kerdiya tha jo unn kay hukum say uss sarzameen ki taraf chalti thi jiss mein hum ney barkaten rakhi hain .   aur hamen her her baat ka poora poora ilm hai .

verses.text: aur kuch aesay shareer jinnaat bhi hum ney unn kay tabey kerdiye thay jo unn ki khatir paani mein ghotay lagatay thay ,   aur uss kay siwa aur bhi kaam kertay thay . aur unn sabb ki dekh bhaal kernay walay hum thay .
verses.translation: aur kuch aesay shareer jinnaat bhi hum ney unn kay tabey kerdiye thay jo unn ki khatir paani mein ghotay lagatay thay ,   aur uss kay siwa aur bhi kaam kertay thay . aur unn sabb ki dekh bhaal kernay walay hum thay .

verses.text: aur Ayub ko dekho ! jab unhon ney apney perwerdigar ko pukara kay :  mujhay yeh takleef lagg gaee hai , aur tu saray reham kernay walon say barh ker reham kernay wala hai .
verses.translation: aur Ayub ko dekho ! jab unhon ney apney perwerdigar ko pukara kay :  mujhay yeh takleef lagg gaee hai , aur tu saray reham kernay walon say barh ker reham kernay wala hai .

verses.text: phir hum ney unn ki dua qubool ki , aur unhen jo takleef laahaq thi , ussay door kerdiya , aur unn ko unn kay ghar walay bhi diye , aur inn/unn kay sath itney hi log aur bhi ,   takay humari taraf say rehmat ka muzahira ho , aur ibadat kernay walon ko aik yaadgaar sabaq milay .
verses.translation: phir hum ney unn ki dua qubool ki , aur unhen jo takleef laahaq thi , ussay door kerdiya , aur unn ko unn kay ghar walay bhi diye , aur inn/unn kay sath itney hi log aur bhi ,   takay humari taraf say rehmat ka muzahira ho , aur ibadat kernay walon ko aik yaadgaar sabaq milay .

verses.text: aur Ismail aur Idrees aur zulkifil ko dekho ! yeh sabb sabar kernay walon mein say thay .
verses.translation: aur Ismail aur Idrees aur zulkifil ko dekho ! yeh sabb sabar kernay walon mein say thay .

verses.text: aur unn ko hum ney apni rehmat mein dakhil kerliya tha . yaqeenan unn ka shumar naik logon  mein hai .
verses.translation: aur unn ko hum ney apni rehmat mein dakhil kerliya tha . yaqeenan unn ka shumar naik logon  mein hai .

verses.text: aur machli walay ( payghumber yani Younus aleh-assalam ) ko dekho ! jab woh khafa ho ker chal kharray huye thay , aur yeh samjhay thay kay hum unn ki koi pakar nahi keren gay . phir unhon ney andheriyon mein say aawaz lagai kay :  ( ya Allah ! ) teray siwa koi mabood nahi , to her aeb say pak hai . beyshak mein qusoor waar hun .
verses.translation: aur machli walay ( payghumber yani Younus aleh-assalam ) ko dekho ! jab woh khafa ho ker chal kharray huye thay , aur yeh samjhay thay kay hum unn ki koi pakar nahi keren gay . phir unhon ney andheriyon mein say aawaz lagai kay :  ( ya Allah ! ) teray siwa koi mabood nahi , to her aeb say pak hai . beyshak mein qusoor waar hun .

verses.text: iss per hum ney unn ki dua qubool ki , aur unhen ghuttan say nijat ata ki . aur issi tarah hum emaan rakhney walon ko nijat detay hain .
verses.translation: iss per hum ney unn ki dua qubool ki , aur unhen ghuttan say nijat ata ki . aur issi tarah hum emaan rakhney walon ko nijat detay hain .

verses.text: aur zakriya ko dekho ! jab unhon ney apney perwerdigar ko pukara tha kay :  ya rab ! mujhay akela naa choriye , aur aap sabb say behtar waris hain .
verses.translation: aur zakriya ko dekho ! jab unhon ney apney perwerdigar ko pukara tha kay :  ya rab ! mujhay akela naa choriye , aur aap sabb say behtar waris hain .

verses.text: chunacheh hum ney unn ki dua qubool ki , aur unn ko Yahya ( jaisa beta ) ata kiya , aur unn ki khatir unn ki biwi ko acha kerdiya .   yaqeenan yeh log bhalai kay kamon mein tezi dikhatay thay , aur hamen shoq aur roab kay aalam mein pukara kertay thay , aur unn kay dil humaray aagay jhukay huye thay .
verses.translation: chunacheh hum ney unn ki dua qubool ki , aur unn ko Yahya ( jaisa beta ) ata kiya , aur unn ki khatir unn ki biwi ko acha kerdiya .   yaqeenan yeh log bhalai kay kamon mein tezi dikhatay thay , aur hamen shoq aur roab kay aalam mein pukara kertay thay , aur unn kay dil humaray aagay jhukay huye thay .

verses.text: aur uss khatoon ko dekho jiss ney apni asmat ki hifazat ki thi , phir hum ney uss kay andar apni rooh phoonki , aur unhen aur unn kay betay ko duniya jahan kay logon  kay liye aik nishani bana diya .
verses.translation: aur uss khatoon ko dekho jiss ney apni asmat ki hifazat ki thi , phir hum ney uss kay andar apni rooh phoonki , aur unhen aur unn kay betay ko duniya jahan kay logon  kay liye aik nishani bana diya .

verses.text: . ( logo ! ) yaqeen rakho kay yeh ( deen jiss ki yeh tamam anbiya dawat detay rahey hain ) tumhara deen hai jo aik hi deen hai , aur mein tumhara perwerdigar hun , lehaza tum meri ibadat kero .
verses.translation: . ( logo ! ) yaqeen rakho kay yeh ( deen jiss ki yeh tamam anbiya dawat detay rahey hain ) tumhara deen hai jo aik hi deen hai , aur mein tumhara perwerdigar hun , lehaza tum meri ibadat kero .

verses.text: aur logon  ney apney deen ko aapas mein tukrray tukrray ker kay baant liya , ( magar ) sabb humaray paas loat ker aaney walay hain .
verses.translation: aur logon  ney apney deen ko aapas mein tukrray tukrray ker kay baant liya , ( magar ) sabb humaray paas loat ker aaney walay hain .

verses.text: phir jo momin ban ker naik amal keray ga to uss ki koshish ki na-qadri nahi hogi , aur hum uss koshish ko likhtay jatay hain .
verses.translation: phir jo momin ban ker naik amal keray ga to uss ki koshish ki na-qadri nahi hogi , aur hum uss koshish ko likhtay jatay hain .

verses.text: aur jiss kissi basti ( kay logon  ) ko hum ney halak kiya hai , uss kay liye na-mumkin hai kay woh palat ker ( duniya mein ) aajayen ,
verses.translation: aur jiss kissi basti ( kay logon  ) ko hum ney halak kiya hai , uss kay liye na-mumkin hai kay woh palat ker ( duniya mein ) aajayen ,

verses.text: yahan tak kay jab yajooj aur majooj ko khol diya jaye ga , aur woh her bulandi say phisaltay nazar ayen gay ,
verses.translation: yahan tak kay jab yajooj aur majooj ko khol diya jaye ga , aur woh her bulandi say phisaltay nazar ayen gay ,

verses.text: aur sacha wada poora honey ka waqt qareeb aajaye ga to achanak halat yeh hogi kay jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya tha unn ki aankhen phatti ki phatti reh jayen gi , ( aur woh kahen gay kay : )  haaye humari kam bakhti ! hum iss cheez say bilkul hi ghaflat mein thay , balkay hum ney baray sitam dahaye thay .
verses.translation: aur sacha wada poora honey ka waqt qareeb aajaye ga to achanak halat yeh hogi kay jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya tha unn ki aankhen phatti ki phatti reh jayen gi , ( aur woh kahen gay kay : )  haaye humari kam bakhti ! hum iss cheez say bilkul hi ghaflat mein thay , balkay hum ney baray sitam dahaye thay .

verses.text: . ( aey shirk kernay walo ! ) yaqeen rakho kay tum aur jinn ki tum Allah ko chorr ker ibadat kertay ho , woh sabb jahannum ka endhan hain .   tumhen ussi jahannum mein jaa utarna hai .
verses.translation: . ( aey shirk kernay walo ! ) yaqeen rakho kay tum aur jinn ki tum Allah ko chorr ker ibadat kertay ho , woh sabb jahannum ka endhan hain .   tumhen ussi jahannum mein jaa utarna hai .

verses.text: agar yeh waqaee khuda hotay to uss ( jahannum ) mein naa jatay . aur sabb kay sabb uss mein hamesha rahen gay .
verses.translation: agar yeh waqaee khuda hotay to uss ( jahannum ) mein naa jatay . aur sabb kay sabb uss mein hamesha rahen gay .

verses.text: wahan unn ki cheekhen niklen gi , aur wahan woh kuch sunn nahi saken gay .
verses.translation: wahan unn ki cheekhen niklen gi , aur wahan woh kuch sunn nahi saken gay .

verses.text: . ( albatta ) jinn logon  kay liye humari taraf say bhalai pehlay say likhi ja-chuki hai , ( yani naik momin ) unn ko uss jahannum say door rakha jaye ga .
verses.translation: . ( albatta ) jinn logon  kay liye humari taraf say bhalai pehlay say likhi ja-chuki hai , ( yani naik momin ) unn ko uss jahannum say door rakha jaye ga .

verses.text: woh uss ki sarsarahat bhi nahi sunen gay , aur woh hamesha hamesha apni mann pasand cheezon kay darmiyan rahen gay .
verses.translation: woh uss ki sarsarahat bhi nahi sunen gay , aur woh hamesha hamesha apni mann pasand cheezon kay darmiyan rahen gay .

verses.text: unn ko woh ( qayamat ki ) sabb say bari pareshani ghumgeen nahi keray gi , aur farishtay unn ka ( yeh keh ker ) istaqbal keren gay ( kay : )  yeh tumhara woh din hai jiss ka tum say wada kiya jata tha .
verses.translation: unn ko woh ( qayamat ki ) sabb say bari pareshani ghumgeen nahi keray gi , aur farishtay unn ka ( yeh keh ker ) istaqbal keren gay ( kay : )  yeh tumhara woh din hai jiss ka tum say wada kiya jata tha .

verses.text: uss din ( ka dhiyan rakho ) jab hum aasman ko iss tarah lapet den gay jaisay kaghazon kay toomaar mein tehreeren lapet di jati hain . jiss tarah hum ney pehli baar takhleeq ki ibtida ki thi , issi tarah hum ussay dobara peda kerden gay . yeh aik wada hai jissay poora kernay ka hum ney zimma liya hai . hamen yaqeenan yeh kaam kerna hai .
verses.translation: uss din ( ka dhiyan rakho ) jab hum aasman ko iss tarah lapet den gay jaisay kaghazon kay toomaar mein tehreeren lapet di jati hain . jiss tarah hum ney pehli baar takhleeq ki ibtida ki thi , issi tarah hum ussay dobara peda kerden gay . yeh aik wada hai jissay poora kernay ka hum ney zimma liya hai . hamen yaqeenan yeh kaam kerna hai .

verses.text: aur hum ney zaboor mein naseehat kay baad yeh likh diya tha kay zameen kay waris meray naik banday hon gay .
verses.translation: aur hum ney zaboor mein naseehat kay baad yeh likh diya tha kay zameen kay waris meray naik banday hon gay .

verses.text: beyshak iss ( Quran ) mein ibadat guzaar logon  kay liye kafi paygham hai .
verses.translation: beyshak iss ( Quran ) mein ibadat guzaar logon  kay liye kafi paygham hai .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen saray jahano kay liye rehmat hi rehmat bana ker bheja hai .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen saray jahano kay liye rehmat hi rehmat bana ker bheja hai .

verses.text: keh do kay :  mujh per to yehi wahi aati hai kay tumhara khuda bus aik hi khuda hai . to kiya tum itaat qubool kertay ho-?
verses.translation: keh do kay :  mujh per to yehi wahi aati hai kay tumhara khuda bus aik hi khuda hai . to kiya tum itaat qubool kertay ho-?

verses.text: phir bhi agar yeh log mun morren to keh do kay :  mein ney tumhen al-al-aelaan khabrdar kerdiya hai . aur mujhay yeh maloom nahi hai kay jiss ( saza ) ka tum say wada kiya jaraha hai , woh qareeb hai ya door .
verses.translation: phir bhi agar yeh log mun morren to keh do kay :  mein ney tumhen al-al-aelaan khabrdar kerdiya hai . aur mujhay yeh maloom nahi hai kay jiss ( saza ) ka tum say wada kiya jaraha hai , woh qareeb hai ya door .

verses.text: beyshak Allah woh baaten bhi janta hai jo buland aawaz say kahi jati hain , aur woh baaten bhi janta hai jo tum chupatay ho .
verses.translation: beyshak Allah woh baaten bhi janta hai jo buland aawaz say kahi jati hain , aur woh baaten bhi janta hai jo tum chupatay ho .

verses.text: aur mein nahi janta shayad ( saza mein ) yeh ( takheer ) tumharay liye aik aazmaesh hai , aur kissi khaas waqt tak kay liye mazay kernay ka moaqa dena hai .
verses.translation: aur mein nahi janta shayad ( saza mein ) yeh ( takheer ) tumharay liye aik aazmaesh hai , aur kissi khaas waqt tak kay liye mazay kernay ka moaqa dena hai .

verses.text: . ( aakhir-kaar ) payghumber ney kaha kay :  aey meray perwerdigar ! haq ka faisla ker-dijiye , aur humara perwerdigar barri rehmat wala hai , aur jo baaten tum banatay ho , unn kay muqablay mein ussi ki madad darkar hai .
verses.translation: . ( aakhir-kaar ) payghumber ney kaha kay :  aey meray perwerdigar ! haq ka faisla ker-dijiye , aur humara perwerdigar barri rehmat wala hai , aur jo baaten tum banatay ho , unn kay muqablay mein ussi ki madad darkar hai .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: logon  kay liye unn kay hisab ka waqt qareeb aa-phoncha hai , aur woh hain kay ghaflat ki halat mein mun pheray huye hain !
ayahs.translation: logon  kay liye unn kay hisab ka waqt qareeb aa-phoncha hai , aur woh hain kay ghaflat ki halat mein mun pheray huye hain !

ayahs.text: jab kabhi unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say naseehat ki koi naee baat unn kay paas aati hai to woh ussay mazaq bana bana ker iss halat mein suntay hain .
ayahs.translation: jab kabhi unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say naseehat ki koi naee baat unn kay paas aati hai to woh ussay mazaq bana bana ker iss halat mein suntay hain .

ayahs.text: kay unn kay dil fuzooliyaat mein munhamik hotay hain . aur yeh zalim chupkay chupkay ( aik doosray say ) sargoshi kertay hain kay :  yeh shaks ( yani Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) tumhi jaisa aik insan nahi to aur kiya hai-? kiya phir bhi tum soojhtay boojhtay jadoo ki baat sunney jao gay-?
ayahs.translation: kay unn kay dil fuzooliyaat mein munhamik hotay hain . aur yeh zalim chupkay chupkay ( aik doosray say ) sargoshi kertay hain kay :  yeh shaks ( yani Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) tumhi jaisa aik insan nahi to aur kiya hai-? kiya phir bhi tum soojhtay boojhtay jadoo ki baat sunney jao gay-?

ayahs.text: payghumber ney ( jawab mein ) kaha kay :  aasman aur zameen mein jo kuch kaha jata hai , mera perwerdigar uss sabb ko janta hai . woh her baat sunta hai , her cheez say ba-khabar hai .
ayahs.translation: payghumber ney ( jawab mein ) kaha kay :  aasman aur zameen mein jo kuch kaha jata hai , mera perwerdigar uss sabb ko janta hai . woh her baat sunta hai , her cheez say ba-khabar hai .

ayahs.text: yehi nahi balkay inn logon  ney yeh bhi kaha kay :  yeh ( Quran ) bey jorr khuwabon ka majmooa hai , balkay yeh inn sahab ney khud gharr liya hai , balkay yeh aik shaeer hain . bhala yeh humaray samney koi nishani to ley ayen jaisay pichlay payghumber ( nishaniyon kay sath ) bhejay gaye thay !
ayahs.translation: yehi nahi balkay inn logon  ney yeh bhi kaha kay :  yeh ( Quran ) bey jorr khuwabon ka majmooa hai , balkay yeh inn sahab ney khud gharr liya hai , balkay yeh aik shaeer hain . bhala yeh humaray samney koi nishani to ley ayen jaisay pichlay payghumber ( nishaniyon kay sath ) bhejay gaye thay !

ayahs.text: halankay inn say pehlay jiss kissi basti ko hum ney halak kiya , woh emaan nahi laee , abb kiya yeh log emaan ley ayen gay-?
ayahs.translation: halankay inn say pehlay jiss kissi basti ko hum ney halak kiya , woh emaan nahi laee , abb kiya yeh log emaan ley ayen gay-?

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum say pehlay kissi aur ko nahi , aadmiyon hi ko Rasool bana ker bheja tha jinn per hum wahi nazil kertay thay . lehaza ( kafiron say kaho kay ) agar tumhen khud ilm nahi hai to naseehat ka ilm rakhney walon say pooch lo .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum say pehlay kissi aur ko nahi , aadmiyon hi ko Rasool bana ker bheja tha jinn per hum wahi nazil kertay thay . lehaza ( kafiron say kaho kay ) agar tumhen khud ilm nahi hai to naseehat ka ilm rakhney walon say pooch lo .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney unn ( Rasoolon ) ko aesay jism bana ker peda nahi kerdiya tha kay woh khana naa khatay hon , aur naa woh aesay thay kay hamesha zinda rahen .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney unn ( Rasoolon ) ko aesay jism bana ker peda nahi kerdiya tha kay woh khana naa khatay hon , aur naa woh aesay thay kay hamesha zinda rahen .

ayahs.text: phir hum ney unn say jo wada kiya tha , ussay sacha ker dikhaya kay unn ko bhi bacha liya , aur ( unn kay ilawa ) jinn ko hum ney chaha unn ko bhi , aur jo log hadd say guzar chukay thay , unhen halak kerdiya .
ayahs.translation: phir hum ney unn say jo wada kiya tha , ussay sacha ker dikhaya kay unn ko bhi bacha liya , aur ( unn kay ilawa ) jinn ko hum ney chaha unn ko bhi , aur jo log hadd say guzar chukay thay , unhen halak kerdiya .

ayahs.text: . ( abb ) hum ney tumharay paas aik aesi kitab utaari hai jiss mein tumharay liye naseehat hai .   kiya phir bhi tum nahi samajhtay-?
ayahs.translation: . ( abb ) hum ney tumharay paas aik aesi kitab utaari hai jiss mein tumharay liye naseehat hai .   kiya phir bhi tum nahi samajhtay-?

ayahs.text: aur hum ney kitni bastiyon ko pees daala jo zalim then aur unn kay baad hum ney doosri naslen peda ken .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney kitni bastiyon ko pees daala jo zalim then aur unn kay baad hum ney doosri naslen peda ken .

ayahs.text: chunacheh jab unhon ney humaray azab ki aahat pai to woh aik dum wahan say bhagney lagay .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh jab unhon ney humaray azab ki aahat pai to woh aik dum wahan say bhagney lagay .

ayahs.text: . ( unn say kaha gaya : )  bhago matt , aur wapis jao apney unhi makanaat aur ussi aesh o ishrat kay saman ki taraf jiss kay mazay tum loot rahey thay , shayad tum say kuch poocha jaye .
ayahs.translation: . ( unn say kaha gaya : )  bhago matt , aur wapis jao apney unhi makanaat aur ussi aesh o ishrat kay saman ki taraf jiss kay mazay tum loot rahey thay , shayad tum say kuch poocha jaye .

ayahs.text: woh kehney lagay :  haaye humari kam bakhti ! sachi baat yeh hai kay hum log hi zalim thay .
ayahs.translation: woh kehney lagay :  haaye humari kam bakhti ! sachi baat yeh hai kay hum log hi zalim thay .

ayahs.text: unn ki yehi pukar jari rahi yahan tak kay hum ney unn ko aik katti hoi kheti , aik bujhi hoi aag bana ker rakh diya .
ayahs.translation: unn ki yehi pukar jari rahi yahan tak kay hum ney unn ko aik katti hoi kheti , aik bujhi hoi aag bana ker rakh diya .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney aasman , zameen aur jo kuch unn kay darmiyan hai , uss ko iss liye peda nahi kiya kay hum koi khel kerna chahtay hon .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney aasman , zameen aur jo kuch unn kay darmiyan hai , uss ko iss liye peda nahi kiya kay hum koi khel kerna chahtay hon .

ayahs.text: agar hamen koi khel banana hota to hum khud apney paas say bana letay , agar hamen aisa kerna hi hota .
ayahs.translation: agar hamen koi khel banana hota to hum khud apney paas say bana letay , agar hamen aisa kerna hi hota .

ayahs.text: balkay hum to haq baat ko batil per kheench maartay hain , jo uss ka sar torr daalta hai , aur woh aik dum malya mait hojata hai .   aur jo baaten tum bana rahey ho , unn ki wajeh say kharabi tumhari hi hai .
ayahs.translation: balkay hum to haq baat ko batil per kheench maartay hain , jo uss ka sar torr daalta hai , aur woh aik dum malya mait hojata hai .   aur jo baaten tum bana rahey ho , unn ki wajeh say kharabi tumhari hi hai .

ayahs.text: aur aasmano aur zameen mein jo log bhi hain , Allah kay hain . aur jo ( farishtay ) Allah kay paas hain , woh naa uss ki ibadat say sarkashi kertay hain , naa thaktay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur aasmano aur zameen mein jo log bhi hain , Allah kay hain . aur jo ( farishtay ) Allah kay paas hain , woh naa uss ki ibadat say sarkashi kertay hain , naa thaktay hain .

ayahs.text: woh raat din uss ki tasbeeh kertay rehtay hain , aur sust nahi parrtay .
ayahs.translation: woh raat din uss ki tasbeeh kertay rehtay hain , aur sust nahi parrtay .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya inn logon  ney zameen mein say aesay khuda bana rakhay hain jo naee zindagi detay hain-?
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya inn logon  ney zameen mein say aesay khuda bana rakhay hain jo naee zindagi detay hain-?

ayahs.text: agar aasman aur zameen mein Allah kay siwa doosray khuda hotay to dono darham barham hojatay .   lehaza arsh ka malik Allah unn baaton say bilkul pak hai jo yeh log banaya kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: agar aasman aur zameen mein Allah kay siwa doosray khuda hotay to dono darham barham hojatay .   lehaza arsh ka malik Allah unn baaton say bilkul pak hai jo yeh log banaya kertay hain .

ayahs.text: woh jo kuch kerta hai , uss ka kissi ko jawab deh nahi hai , aur inn sabb ko jawab dahi kerni hogi .
ayahs.translation: woh jo kuch kerta hai , uss ka kissi ko jawab deh nahi hai , aur inn sabb ko jawab dahi kerni hogi .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya ussay chorr ker unhon ney doosray khuda bana rakhay hain-? ( aey payghumber ! ) inn say kaho kay :  lao apni daleel !  yeh ( Quran ) bhi mojood hai jiss mein meray sath walon kay liye naseehat hai , aur woh ( kitaben ) bhi mojood hain jinn mein mujh say pehlay logon  kay liye naseehat thi .   lekin waqiaa yeh hai kay inn mein say aksar log haq baat ka yaqeen nahi kertay , iss liye mun morray huye hain .
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya ussay chorr ker unhon ney doosray khuda bana rakhay hain-? ( aey payghumber ! ) inn say kaho kay :  lao apni daleel !  yeh ( Quran ) bhi mojood hai jiss mein meray sath walon kay liye naseehat hai , aur woh ( kitaben ) bhi mojood hain jinn mein mujh say pehlay logon  kay liye naseehat thi .   lekin waqiaa yeh hai kay inn mein say aksar log haq baat ka yaqeen nahi kertay , iss liye mun morray huye hain .

ayahs.text: aur tum say pehlay hum ney koi aisa Rasool nahi bheja jiss per hum ney yeh wahi nazil naa ki ho kay :  meray siwa koi khuda nahi hai , lehaza meri ibadat kero .
ayahs.translation: aur tum say pehlay hum ney koi aisa Rasool nahi bheja jiss per hum ney yeh wahi nazil naa ki ho kay :  meray siwa koi khuda nahi hai , lehaza meri ibadat kero .

ayahs.text: yeh log kehtay hain kay :  khudaye rehman ( farishton ki shakal mein ) aulad rakhta hai .    subhan Allah ! balkay ( farishtay to Allah kay ) banday hain jinhen izzat bakhshi gaee hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh log kehtay hain kay :  khudaye rehman ( farishton ki shakal mein ) aulad rakhta hai .    subhan Allah ! balkay ( farishtay to Allah kay ) banday hain jinhen izzat bakhshi gaee hai .

ayahs.text: woh uss say aagay barh ker koi baat nahi kertay , aur woh ussi kay hukum per amal kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: woh uss say aagay barh ker koi baat nahi kertay , aur woh ussi kay hukum per amal kertay hain .

ayahs.text: woh unn ki tamam agli pichli baaton ko janta hai , aur woh kissi ki sifarish nahi ker-saktay , siwaye uss kay jiss kay liye Allah ki marzi ho , aur woh uss kay khof say sehmay rehtay hain .
ayahs.translation: woh unn ki tamam agli pichli baaton ko janta hai , aur woh kissi ki sifarish nahi ker-saktay , siwaye uss kay jiss kay liye Allah ki marzi ho , aur woh uss kay khof say sehmay rehtay hain .

ayahs.text: aur agar unn mein say koi ( bil-farz ) yeh kahey kay :  Allah kay ilawa mein bhi mabood hun  to uss ko hum jahannum ki saza den gay . aesay zalimon ko hum aesi hi saza detay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur agar unn mein say koi ( bil-farz ) yeh kahey kay :  Allah kay ilawa mein bhi mabood hun  to uss ko hum jahannum ki saza den gay . aesay zalimon ko hum aesi hi saza detay hain .

ayahs.text: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , kiya unhen yeh maloom nahi hai kay saray aasman aur zameen band thay , phir hum ney unhen khol diya ,   aur paani say her jandaar cheez peda ki hai ?   kiya phir bhi yeh emaan nahi layen gay-?
ayahs.translation: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , kiya unhen yeh maloom nahi hai kay saray aasman aur zameen band thay , phir hum ney unhen khol diya ,   aur paani say her jandaar cheez peda ki hai ?   kiya phir bhi yeh emaan nahi layen gay-?

ayahs.text: aur hum ney zameen mein jamay huye pahar peda kiye hain , takay woh unhen ley ker hilney naa paye ,   aur uss mein hum ney chorray chorray raastay banaye hain , takay woh manzil tak phonch saken .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney zameen mein jamay huye pahar peda kiye hain , takay woh unhen ley ker hilney naa paye ,   aur uss mein hum ney chorray chorray raastay banaye hain , takay woh manzil tak phonch saken .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney aasman ko aik mehfooz chat bana diya hai ,   aur yeh log hain kay uss ki nishaniyon say mun morray huye hain .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney aasman ko aik mehfooz chat bana diya hai ,   aur yeh log hain kay uss ki nishaniyon say mun morray huye hain .

ayahs.text: aur wohi ( Allah ) hai jiss ney raat aur din aur sooraj aur chaand peda kiye . sabb kissi naa kissi madaar mein ter rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: aur wohi ( Allah ) hai jiss ney raat aur din aur sooraj aur chaand peda kiye . sabb kissi naa kissi madaar mein ter rahey hain .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum say pehlay bhi hamesha zinda rehna hum ney kissi fard bashar kay liye tey nahi kiya .   chunacheh agar tumhara intiqal hogaya to kiya yeh log aesay hain jo hamesha zinda rahen-?
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum say pehlay bhi hamesha zinda rehna hum ney kissi fard bashar kay liye tey nahi kiya .   chunacheh agar tumhara intiqal hogaya to kiya yeh log aesay hain jo hamesha zinda rahen-?

ayahs.text: her jaan daar ko moat ka maza chakhna hai . aur hum tumhen aazmaney kay liye buri bhali halaton mein mubtala kertay hain , aur tum sabb humaray paas hi loata ker laye jao gay .
ayahs.translation: her jaan daar ko moat ka maza chakhna hai . aur hum tumhen aazmaney kay liye buri bhali halaton mein mubtala kertay hain , aur tum sabb humaray paas hi loata ker laye jao gay .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna rakha hai , woh jab tumhen dekhtay hain to iss kay siwa unn ka koi kaam nahi hota kay woh tumhara mazaq bananey lagtay hain ( aur kehtay hain : )  kiya yehi sahab hain jo tumharay khudaon ka ziker kiya kertay hain-? ( yani yeh kehtay hain kay inn ki koi haqeeqat nahi )  halankay inn ( kafiron ) ki apni halat yeh hai kay woh khudaye rehman hi ka ziker kernay say inkar kiye bethay hain !
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna rakha hai , woh jab tumhen dekhtay hain to iss kay siwa unn ka koi kaam nahi hota kay woh tumhara mazaq bananey lagtay hain ( aur kehtay hain : )  kiya yehi sahab hain jo tumharay khudaon ka ziker kiya kertay hain-? ( yani yeh kehtay hain kay inn ki koi haqeeqat nahi )  halankay inn ( kafiron ) ki apni halat yeh hai kay woh khudaye rehman hi ka ziker kernay say inkar kiye bethay hain !

ayahs.text: insan jald bazi ki khaslat ley ker peda huwa hai . mein unqareeb tumhen apni nishaniyan dikhla dun ga , lehaza tum mujh say jaldi matt machao .
ayahs.translation: insan jald bazi ki khaslat ley ker peda huwa hai . mein unqareeb tumhen apni nishaniyan dikhla dun ga , lehaza tum mujh say jaldi matt machao .

ayahs.text: aur yeh log ( musalmanon say ) kehtay hain kay :  agar tum sachay ho to aakhir yeh ( azab ki ) dhamki kab poori hogi-?
ayahs.translation: aur yeh log ( musalmanon say ) kehtay hain kay :  agar tum sachay ho to aakhir yeh ( azab ki ) dhamki kab poori hogi-?

ayahs.text: kaash inn kafiron ko uss waqt ki kuch khabar lagg jati jab yeh naa apney chehron say aag ko door ker-saken gay , aur naa apni pushton say , aur naa inn ko koi madad moyassar aaye gi .
ayahs.translation: kaash inn kafiron ko uss waqt ki kuch khabar lagg jati jab yeh naa apney chehron say aag ko door ker-saken gay , aur naa apni pushton say , aur naa inn ko koi madad moyassar aaye gi .

ayahs.text: balkay woh ( aag ) unn kay paas aik dum aa-dhamkay gi , aur unn kay hosh o hawaas gumm ker kay rakh dey gi , phir naa yeh ussay peechay hata saken gay , aur naa unhen koi mohlat di jaye gi .
ayahs.translation: balkay woh ( aag ) unn kay paas aik dum aa-dhamkay gi , aur unn kay hosh o hawaas gumm ker kay rakh dey gi , phir naa yeh ussay peechay hata saken gay , aur naa unhen koi mohlat di jaye gi .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum say pehlay bhi payghumberon ka mazaq uraya gaya tha , phir unn ka mazaq bananey walon ko ussi cheez ney aa-ghera jiss ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum say pehlay bhi payghumberon ka mazaq uraya gaya tha , phir unn ka mazaq bananey walon ko ussi cheez ney aa-ghera jiss ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  kon hai jo raat mein aur din mein khudaye rehman ( kay azab say ) say tumhara bachao keray-?  magar woh hain kay apney perwerdigar kay ziker say mun morray huye hain .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  kon hai jo raat mein aur din mein khudaye rehman ( kay azab say ) say tumhara bachao keray-?  magar woh hain kay apney perwerdigar kay ziker say mun morray huye hain .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya inn kay paas humaray siwa koi aesay khuda hain jo inn ki hifazat kertay hon-? woh to khud apni madad nahi ker-saktay , aur naa humaray muqablay mein koi unn ka sath dey sakta hai .
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya inn kay paas humaray siwa koi aesay khuda hain jo inn ki hifazat kertay hon-? woh to khud apni madad nahi ker-saktay , aur naa humaray muqablay mein koi unn ka sath dey sakta hai .

ayahs.text: balkay moamla yeh hai kay hum ney inn ko aur inn kay AabaoAjdaad ko saman-e-aesh ata kiya , yahan tak kay ( issi halat mein ) unn per aik umar guzar gaee .   bhala kiya unhen yeh nazar nahi aata kay hum zameen ko uss kay mukhtalif kinaron say ghatatay chalay aarahey hain .   phir kiya woh ghalib aajayen gay-?
ayahs.translation: balkay moamla yeh hai kay hum ney inn ko aur inn kay AabaoAjdaad ko saman-e-aesh ata kiya , yahan tak kay ( issi halat mein ) unn per aik umar guzar gaee .   bhala kiya unhen yeh nazar nahi aata kay hum zameen ko uss kay mukhtalif kinaron say ghatatay chalay aarahey hain .   phir kiya woh ghalib aajayen gay-?

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  mein to tumhen wahi kay zariye darata hun  lekin behray log aesay hain kay jab unhen daraya jata hai to woh koi pukar nahi suntay .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  mein to tumhen wahi kay zariye darata hun  lekin behray log aesay hain kay jab unhen daraya jata hai to woh koi pukar nahi suntay .

ayahs.text: aur agar tumharay perwerdigar kay azab ka aik jhonka bhi unhen choo jaye to yeh keh uthen gay kay :  haaye humari kam bakhti ! waqaee hum log zalim thay .
ayahs.translation: aur agar tumharay perwerdigar kay azab ka aik jhonka bhi unhen choo jaye to yeh keh uthen gay kay :  haaye humari kam bakhti ! waqaee hum log zalim thay .

ayahs.text: aur hum qayamat kay din aesi tarazooyen laa rakhen gay jo sarapa insaf hon gi ,   chunacheh kissi per koi zulm nahi hoga . aur agar koi amal raai kay daney kay barabar bhi hoga , to hum ussay samney ley ayen gay . aur hisab lenay kay liye hum kafi hain .
ayahs.translation: aur hum qayamat kay din aesi tarazooyen laa rakhen gay jo sarapa insaf hon gi ,   chunacheh kissi per koi zulm nahi hoga . aur agar koi amal raai kay daney kay barabar bhi hoga , to hum ussay samney ley ayen gay . aur hisab lenay kay liye hum kafi hain .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney musa aur Haroon ko haq o batil ka aik mayaar ( hidayat ki ) aik roshni aur unn muttaqi logon  kay liye naseehat ka saman ata kiya tha .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney musa aur Haroon ko haq o batil ka aik mayaar ( hidayat ki ) aik roshni aur unn muttaqi logon  kay liye naseehat ka saman ata kiya tha .

ayahs.text: jo dekhtay baghair apney perwerdigar say daren , aur jinn ko qayamat ki gharri ka khof laga huwa ho .
ayahs.translation: jo dekhtay baghair apney perwerdigar say daren , aur jinn ko qayamat ki gharri ka khof laga huwa ho .

ayahs.text: aur abb yeh ( Quran ) barkaton wala paygham naseehat hai jo hum ney nazil kiya hai . kiya phir bhi tum issay manney say inkar kertay ho-?
ayahs.translation: aur abb yeh ( Quran ) barkaton wala paygham naseehat hai jo hum ney nazil kiya hai . kiya phir bhi tum issay manney say inkar kertay ho-?

ayahs.text: aur iss say pehlay hum ney Ibrahim ko woh samajh boojh ata ki thi jo unn kay laeeq thi , aur hum unhen khoob jantay thay .
ayahs.translation: aur iss say pehlay hum ney Ibrahim ko woh samajh boojh ata ki thi jo unn kay laeeq thi , aur hum unhen khoob jantay thay .

ayahs.text: woh waqt yaad kero jab unhon ney apney baap aur apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  yeh kiya moorten hain jinn kay aagay tum dharna diye bethay ho-?
ayahs.translation: woh waqt yaad kero jab unhon ney apney baap aur apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  yeh kiya moorten hain jinn kay aagay tum dharna diye bethay ho-?

ayahs.text: woh bolay kay :  hum ney apney baap dadon ko inn ki ibadat kertay huye paya hai .
ayahs.translation: woh bolay kay :  hum ney apney baap dadon ko inn ki ibadat kertay huye paya hai .

ayahs.text: Ibrahim ney kaha :  haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum bhi aur tumharay baap daday bhi khuli gumrahi mein mubtala rahey ho .
ayahs.translation: Ibrahim ney kaha :  haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum bhi aur tumharay baap daday bhi khuli gumrahi mein mubtala rahey ho .

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha :  kiya tum hum say sach mooch ki baat ker rahey ho , ya dil lagi ker rahey ho-?
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha :  kiya tum hum say sach mooch ki baat ker rahey ho , ya dil lagi ker rahey ho-?

ayahs.text: Ibrahim ney kaha :  nahi , balkay tumhara perwerdigar woh hai jo tamam aasmano aur zameen ka malik hai , jiss ney yeh sari cheezen peda ki hain , aur logo ! mein iss baat per gawahi deta hun .
ayahs.translation: Ibrahim ney kaha :  nahi , balkay tumhara perwerdigar woh hai jo tamam aasmano aur zameen ka malik hai , jiss ney yeh sari cheezen peda ki hain , aur logo ! mein iss baat per gawahi deta hun .

ayahs.text: aur Allah ki qasam ! jab tum peeth pher ker chalay jao gay to mein tumharay button kay sath aik ( aisa ) kaam kerun ga ( jiss say unn ki haqeeqat khul jaye gi ) .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah ki qasam ! jab tum peeth pher ker chalay jao gay to mein tumharay button kay sath aik ( aisa ) kaam kerun ga ( jiss say unn ki haqeeqat khul jaye gi ) .

ayahs.text: chunacheh Ibrahim ney unn kay baray butt kay siwa saray button ko tukrray tukrray kerdiya , takay woh log unn ki taraf rujoo keren .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh Ibrahim ney unn kay baray butt kay siwa saray button ko tukrray tukrray kerdiya , takay woh log unn ki taraf rujoo keren .

ayahs.text: woh kehney lagay kay :  humaray khudaon kay sath yeh harkat kiss ney ki hai-? woh koi bara hi zalim tha .
ayahs.translation: woh kehney lagay kay :  humaray khudaon kay sath yeh harkat kiss ney ki hai-? woh koi bara hi zalim tha .

ayahs.text: kuch logon  ney kaha :  hum ney aik nojawan ko suna hai kay woh inn button kay baaray mein baaten banaya kerta hai , ussay Ibrahim kehtay hain .
ayahs.translation: kuch logon  ney kaha :  hum ney aik nojawan ko suna hai kay woh inn button kay baaray mein baaten banaya kerta hai , ussay Ibrahim kehtay hain .

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha :  to phir uss ko sabb logon  kay samney ley ker aao , takay sabb gawah ban jayen .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha :  to phir uss ko sabb logon  kay samney ley ker aao , takay sabb gawah ban jayen .

ayahs.text: . ( phir jab Ibrahim ko laya gaya to ) woh bolay :  Ibrahim ! kiya humaray khudaon kay sath yeh harkat tum hi ney ki hai-?
ayahs.translation: . ( phir jab Ibrahim ko laya gaya to ) woh bolay :  Ibrahim ! kiya humaray khudaon kay sath yeh harkat tum hi ney ki hai-?

ayahs.text: Ibrahim ney kaha :  nahi , balkay yeh harkat unn kay iss baray sardar ney ki hai , abb inhi button say pooch lo , agar yeh boltay hon .
ayahs.translation: Ibrahim ney kaha :  nahi , balkay yeh harkat unn kay iss baray sardar ney ki hai , abb inhi button say pooch lo , agar yeh boltay hon .

ayahs.text: iss per woh log apney dil mein kuch sochney lagay , aur ( apney aap say ) kehney lagay kay :  sachi baat to yehi hai kay tum khud zalim ho .
ayahs.translation: iss per woh log apney dil mein kuch sochney lagay , aur ( apney aap say ) kehney lagay kay :  sachi baat to yehi hai kay tum khud zalim ho .

ayahs.text: phir unhon ney apney sar jhuka liye , aur kaha :  tumhen to maloom hi hai kay yeh boltay nahi hain .
ayahs.translation: phir unhon ney apney sar jhuka liye , aur kaha :  tumhen to maloom hi hai kay yeh boltay nahi hain .

ayahs.text: Ibrahim ney kaha :  bhala batao kay kiya tum Allah ko chorr ker aesi cheezon ki ibadat ker rahey ho jo tumhen naa kuch faeeda phonchati hain naa nuqsan-?
ayahs.translation: Ibrahim ney kaha :  bhala batao kay kiya tum Allah ko chorr ker aesi cheezon ki ibadat ker rahey ho jo tumhen naa kuch faeeda phonchati hain naa nuqsan-?

ayahs.text: tuff hai tum per bhi , aur unn per bhi jinn ki tum Allah ko chorr ker ibadat kertay ho . bhala kiya tumhen itni samajh nahi-?
ayahs.translation: tuff hai tum per bhi , aur unn per bhi jinn ki tum Allah ko chorr ker ibadat kertay ho . bhala kiya tumhen itni samajh nahi-?

ayahs.text: woh ( aik doosray say ) kehney lagay :  aag mein jala daalo iss shaks ko , aur apney khudaon ki madad kero , agar tum mein kuch kernay ka dum kham hai .
ayahs.translation: woh ( aik doosray say ) kehney lagay :  aag mein jala daalo iss shaks ko , aur apney khudaon ki madad kero , agar tum mein kuch kernay ka dum kham hai .

ayahs.text: . ( chunacheh unhon ney Ibrahim ko aag mein daal diya , aur ) hum ney kaha :  aey aag ! thandi hoja , aur Ibrahim kay liye salamti ban jaa .
ayahs.translation: . ( chunacheh unhon ney Ibrahim ko aag mein daal diya , aur ) hum ney kaha :  aey aag ! thandi hoja , aur Ibrahim kay liye salamti ban jaa .

ayahs.text: unn logon  ney Ibrahim kay liye burai ka mansooba banaya tha , magar nateeja yeh huwa kay hum ney unhi ko buri tarah nakam kerdiya .
ayahs.translation: unn logon  ney Ibrahim kay liye burai ka mansooba banaya tha , magar nateeja yeh huwa kay hum ney unhi ko buri tarah nakam kerdiya .

ayahs.text: aur hum unhen aur loot ko bacha ker uss sarzameen ki taraf ley gaye jiss mein hum ney duniya jahan kay logon  kay liye barkaten rakhi hain .
ayahs.translation: aur hum unhen aur loot ko bacha ker uss sarzameen ki taraf ley gaye jiss mein hum ney duniya jahan kay logon  kay liye barkaten rakhi hain .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney unn ko inaam kay tor per Ishaq aur Yaqoob ata kiye . aur unn mein say her aik ko hum ney naik banaya .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney unn ko inaam kay tor per Ishaq aur Yaqoob ata kiye . aur unn mein say her aik ko hum ney naik banaya .

ayahs.text: aur unn sabb ko hum ney peshwa banaya jo humaray hukum say logon  ki rehnumai kertay thay , aur hum ney wahi kay zariye unhen naikiyan kernay , namaz qaeem kernay aur zakat ada kernay ki takeed ki thi , aur woh humaray ibadat guzaar thay .
ayahs.translation: aur unn sabb ko hum ney peshwa banaya jo humaray hukum say logon  ki rehnumai kertay thay , aur hum ney wahi kay zariye unhen naikiyan kernay , namaz qaeem kernay aur zakat ada kernay ki takeed ki thi , aur woh humaray ibadat guzaar thay .

ayahs.text: aur loot ko hum ney hikmat aur ilm ata kiya , aur unhen uss basti say nijat di jo ganday kaam kerti thi .   haqeeqat mein woh boht burai wali nafarman qoam thi .
ayahs.translation: aur loot ko hum ney hikmat aur ilm ata kiya , aur unhen uss basti say nijat di jo ganday kaam kerti thi .   haqeeqat mein woh boht burai wali nafarman qoam thi .

ayahs.text: aur loot ko hum ney apni rehmat mein dakhil kerliya , woh yaqeenan naik logon  mein say thay .
ayahs.translation: aur loot ko hum ney apni rehmat mein dakhil kerliya , woh yaqeenan naik logon  mein say thay .

ayahs.text: aur nooh ko bhi ( hum ney hikmat aur ilm ata kiya ) , woh waqt yaad kero jab uss waqaey say pehlay unhon ney hamen pukara , to hum ney unn ki dua qubool ki , aur unn ko aur unn kay sathiyon ko bari bhari museebat say bacha liya .
ayahs.translation: aur nooh ko bhi ( hum ney hikmat aur ilm ata kiya ) , woh waqt yaad kero jab uss waqaey say pehlay unhon ney hamen pukara , to hum ney unn ki dua qubool ki , aur unn ko aur unn kay sathiyon ko bari bhari museebat say bacha liya .

ayahs.text: aur jiss qoam ney humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya tha , uss kay muqablay mein unn ki madad ki . haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh boht buray log thay , iss liye hum ney unn sabb ko gharq kerdiya .
ayahs.translation: aur jiss qoam ney humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya tha , uss kay muqablay mein unn ki madad ki . haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh boht buray log thay , iss liye hum ney unn sabb ko gharq kerdiya .

ayahs.text: aur dawood aur suleman ( ko bhi hum ney hikmat aur ilm ata kiya tha ) jab woh dono aik khet kay jhagray ka faisla ker rahey thay , kiyonkay kuch logon  ki bakriyan raat kay waqt uss khet mein jaa ghusi then ,   aur unn logon  kay baaray mein jo faisla huwa ussay hum khud dekh rahey thay .
ayahs.translation: aur dawood aur suleman ( ko bhi hum ney hikmat aur ilm ata kiya tha ) jab woh dono aik khet kay jhagray ka faisla ker rahey thay , kiyonkay kuch logon  ki bakriyan raat kay waqt uss khet mein jaa ghusi then ,   aur unn logon  kay baaray mein jo faisla huwa ussay hum khud dekh rahey thay .

ayahs.text: chunacheh uss faislay ki samajh hum ney suleman ko dey di , aur ( wesay ) hum ney dono hi ko hikmat aur ilm ata kiya tha .   aur hum ney dawood kay sath paharon ko tabey daar bana diya tha kay woh parindon ko sath ley ker tasbeeh keren ,   aur yeh saray kaam kernay walay hum thay .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh uss faislay ki samajh hum ney suleman ko dey di , aur ( wesay ) hum ney dono hi ko hikmat aur ilm ata kiya tha .   aur hum ney dawood kay sath paharon ko tabey daar bana diya tha kay woh parindon ko sath ley ker tasbeeh keren ,   aur yeh saray kaam kernay walay hum thay .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney unhen tumharay faeeday kay liye aik jangi libas ( yani zirah ) bananey ki sanat sikhai takay woh tumhen larraee mein aik doosray ki zadd say bachaye .   abb batao kay kiya tum shukar guzaar ho-?
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney unhen tumharay faeeday kay liye aik jangi libas ( yani zirah ) bananey ki sanat sikhai takay woh tumhen larraee mein aik doosray ki zadd say bachaye .   abb batao kay kiya tum shukar guzaar ho-?

ayahs.text: aur hum ney tez chalti hoi hawa ko suleman kay tabey kerdiya tha jo unn kay hukum say uss sarzameen ki taraf chalti thi jiss mein hum ney barkaten rakhi hain .   aur hamen her her baat ka poora poora ilm hai .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney tez chalti hoi hawa ko suleman kay tabey kerdiya tha jo unn kay hukum say uss sarzameen ki taraf chalti thi jiss mein hum ney barkaten rakhi hain .   aur hamen her her baat ka poora poora ilm hai .

ayahs.text: aur kuch aesay shareer jinnaat bhi hum ney unn kay tabey kerdiye thay jo unn ki khatir paani mein ghotay lagatay thay ,   aur uss kay siwa aur bhi kaam kertay thay . aur unn sabb ki dekh bhaal kernay walay hum thay .
ayahs.translation: aur kuch aesay shareer jinnaat bhi hum ney unn kay tabey kerdiye thay jo unn ki khatir paani mein ghotay lagatay thay ,   aur uss kay siwa aur bhi kaam kertay thay . aur unn sabb ki dekh bhaal kernay walay hum thay .

ayahs.text: aur Ayub ko dekho ! jab unhon ney apney perwerdigar ko pukara kay :  mujhay yeh takleef lagg gaee hai , aur tu saray reham kernay walon say barh ker reham kernay wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur Ayub ko dekho ! jab unhon ney apney perwerdigar ko pukara kay :  mujhay yeh takleef lagg gaee hai , aur tu saray reham kernay walon say barh ker reham kernay wala hai .

ayahs.text: phir hum ney unn ki dua qubool ki , aur unhen jo takleef laahaq thi , ussay door kerdiya , aur unn ko unn kay ghar walay bhi diye , aur inn/unn kay sath itney hi log aur bhi ,   takay humari taraf say rehmat ka muzahira ho , aur ibadat kernay walon ko aik yaadgaar sabaq milay .
ayahs.translation: phir hum ney unn ki dua qubool ki , aur unhen jo takleef laahaq thi , ussay door kerdiya , aur unn ko unn kay ghar walay bhi diye , aur inn/unn kay sath itney hi log aur bhi ,   takay humari taraf say rehmat ka muzahira ho , aur ibadat kernay walon ko aik yaadgaar sabaq milay .

ayahs.text: aur Ismail aur Idrees aur zulkifil ko dekho ! yeh sabb sabar kernay walon mein say thay .
ayahs.translation: aur Ismail aur Idrees aur zulkifil ko dekho ! yeh sabb sabar kernay walon mein say thay .

ayahs.text: aur unn ko hum ney apni rehmat mein dakhil kerliya tha . yaqeenan unn ka shumar naik logon  mein hai .
ayahs.translation: aur unn ko hum ney apni rehmat mein dakhil kerliya tha . yaqeenan unn ka shumar naik logon  mein hai .

ayahs.text: aur machli walay ( payghumber yani Younus aleh-assalam ) ko dekho ! jab woh khafa ho ker chal kharray huye thay , aur yeh samjhay thay kay hum unn ki koi pakar nahi keren gay . phir unhon ney andheriyon mein say aawaz lagai kay :  ( ya Allah ! ) teray siwa koi mabood nahi , to her aeb say pak hai . beyshak mein qusoor waar hun .
ayahs.translation: aur machli walay ( payghumber yani Younus aleh-assalam ) ko dekho ! jab woh khafa ho ker chal kharray huye thay , aur yeh samjhay thay kay hum unn ki koi pakar nahi keren gay . phir unhon ney andheriyon mein say aawaz lagai kay :  ( ya Allah ! ) teray siwa koi mabood nahi , to her aeb say pak hai . beyshak mein qusoor waar hun .

ayahs.text: iss per hum ney unn ki dua qubool ki , aur unhen ghuttan say nijat ata ki . aur issi tarah hum emaan rakhney walon ko nijat detay hain .
ayahs.translation: iss per hum ney unn ki dua qubool ki , aur unhen ghuttan say nijat ata ki . aur issi tarah hum emaan rakhney walon ko nijat detay hain .

ayahs.text: aur zakriya ko dekho ! jab unhon ney apney perwerdigar ko pukara tha kay :  ya rab ! mujhay akela naa choriye , aur aap sabb say behtar waris hain .
ayahs.translation: aur zakriya ko dekho ! jab unhon ney apney perwerdigar ko pukara tha kay :  ya rab ! mujhay akela naa choriye , aur aap sabb say behtar waris hain .

ayahs.text: chunacheh hum ney unn ki dua qubool ki , aur unn ko Yahya ( jaisa beta ) ata kiya , aur unn ki khatir unn ki biwi ko acha kerdiya .   yaqeenan yeh log bhalai kay kamon mein tezi dikhatay thay , aur hamen shoq aur roab kay aalam mein pukara kertay thay , aur unn kay dil humaray aagay jhukay huye thay .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh hum ney unn ki dua qubool ki , aur unn ko Yahya ( jaisa beta ) ata kiya , aur unn ki khatir unn ki biwi ko acha kerdiya .   yaqeenan yeh log bhalai kay kamon mein tezi dikhatay thay , aur hamen shoq aur roab kay aalam mein pukara kertay thay , aur unn kay dil humaray aagay jhukay huye thay .

ayahs.text: aur uss khatoon ko dekho jiss ney apni asmat ki hifazat ki thi , phir hum ney uss kay andar apni rooh phoonki , aur unhen aur unn kay betay ko duniya jahan kay logon  kay liye aik nishani bana diya .
ayahs.translation: aur uss khatoon ko dekho jiss ney apni asmat ki hifazat ki thi , phir hum ney uss kay andar apni rooh phoonki , aur unhen aur unn kay betay ko duniya jahan kay logon  kay liye aik nishani bana diya .

ayahs.text: . ( logo ! ) yaqeen rakho kay yeh ( deen jiss ki yeh tamam anbiya dawat detay rahey hain ) tumhara deen hai jo aik hi deen hai , aur mein tumhara perwerdigar hun , lehaza tum meri ibadat kero .
ayahs.translation: . ( logo ! ) yaqeen rakho kay yeh ( deen jiss ki yeh tamam anbiya dawat detay rahey hain ) tumhara deen hai jo aik hi deen hai , aur mein tumhara perwerdigar hun , lehaza tum meri ibadat kero .

ayahs.text: aur logon  ney apney deen ko aapas mein tukrray tukrray ker kay baant liya , ( magar ) sabb humaray paas loat ker aaney walay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur logon  ney apney deen ko aapas mein tukrray tukrray ker kay baant liya , ( magar ) sabb humaray paas loat ker aaney walay hain .

ayahs.text: phir jo momin ban ker naik amal keray ga to uss ki koshish ki na-qadri nahi hogi , aur hum uss koshish ko likhtay jatay hain .
ayahs.translation: phir jo momin ban ker naik amal keray ga to uss ki koshish ki na-qadri nahi hogi , aur hum uss koshish ko likhtay jatay hain .

ayahs.text: aur jiss kissi basti ( kay logon  ) ko hum ney halak kiya hai , uss kay liye na-mumkin hai kay woh palat ker ( duniya mein ) aajayen ,
ayahs.translation: aur jiss kissi basti ( kay logon  ) ko hum ney halak kiya hai , uss kay liye na-mumkin hai kay woh palat ker ( duniya mein ) aajayen ,

ayahs.text: yahan tak kay jab yajooj aur majooj ko khol diya jaye ga , aur woh her bulandi say phisaltay nazar ayen gay ,
ayahs.translation: yahan tak kay jab yajooj aur majooj ko khol diya jaye ga , aur woh her bulandi say phisaltay nazar ayen gay ,

ayahs.text: aur sacha wada poora honey ka waqt qareeb aajaye ga to achanak halat yeh hogi kay jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya tha unn ki aankhen phatti ki phatti reh jayen gi , ( aur woh kahen gay kay : )  haaye humari kam bakhti ! hum iss cheez say bilkul hi ghaflat mein thay , balkay hum ney baray sitam dahaye thay .
ayahs.translation: aur sacha wada poora honey ka waqt qareeb aajaye ga to achanak halat yeh hogi kay jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya tha unn ki aankhen phatti ki phatti reh jayen gi , ( aur woh kahen gay kay : )  haaye humari kam bakhti ! hum iss cheez say bilkul hi ghaflat mein thay , balkay hum ney baray sitam dahaye thay .

ayahs.text: . ( aey shirk kernay walo ! ) yaqeen rakho kay tum aur jinn ki tum Allah ko chorr ker ibadat kertay ho , woh sabb jahannum ka endhan hain .   tumhen ussi jahannum mein jaa utarna hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey shirk kernay walo ! ) yaqeen rakho kay tum aur jinn ki tum Allah ko chorr ker ibadat kertay ho , woh sabb jahannum ka endhan hain .   tumhen ussi jahannum mein jaa utarna hai .

ayahs.text: agar yeh waqaee khuda hotay to uss ( jahannum ) mein naa jatay . aur sabb kay sabb uss mein hamesha rahen gay .
ayahs.translation: agar yeh waqaee khuda hotay to uss ( jahannum ) mein naa jatay . aur sabb kay sabb uss mein hamesha rahen gay .

ayahs.text: wahan unn ki cheekhen niklen gi , aur wahan woh kuch sunn nahi saken gay .
ayahs.translation: wahan unn ki cheekhen niklen gi , aur wahan woh kuch sunn nahi saken gay .

ayahs.text: . ( albatta ) jinn logon  kay liye humari taraf say bhalai pehlay say likhi ja-chuki hai , ( yani naik momin ) unn ko uss jahannum say door rakha jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: . ( albatta ) jinn logon  kay liye humari taraf say bhalai pehlay say likhi ja-chuki hai , ( yani naik momin ) unn ko uss jahannum say door rakha jaye ga .

ayahs.text: woh uss ki sarsarahat bhi nahi sunen gay , aur woh hamesha hamesha apni mann pasand cheezon kay darmiyan rahen gay .
ayahs.translation: woh uss ki sarsarahat bhi nahi sunen gay , aur woh hamesha hamesha apni mann pasand cheezon kay darmiyan rahen gay .

ayahs.text: unn ko woh ( qayamat ki ) sabb say bari pareshani ghumgeen nahi keray gi , aur farishtay unn ka ( yeh keh ker ) istaqbal keren gay ( kay : )  yeh tumhara woh din hai jiss ka tum say wada kiya jata tha .
ayahs.translation: unn ko woh ( qayamat ki ) sabb say bari pareshani ghumgeen nahi keray gi , aur farishtay unn ka ( yeh keh ker ) istaqbal keren gay ( kay : )  yeh tumhara woh din hai jiss ka tum say wada kiya jata tha .

ayahs.text: uss din ( ka dhiyan rakho ) jab hum aasman ko iss tarah lapet den gay jaisay kaghazon kay toomaar mein tehreeren lapet di jati hain . jiss tarah hum ney pehli baar takhleeq ki ibtida ki thi , issi tarah hum ussay dobara peda kerden gay . yeh aik wada hai jissay poora kernay ka hum ney zimma liya hai . hamen yaqeenan yeh kaam kerna hai .
ayahs.translation: uss din ( ka dhiyan rakho ) jab hum aasman ko iss tarah lapet den gay jaisay kaghazon kay toomaar mein tehreeren lapet di jati hain . jiss tarah hum ney pehli baar takhleeq ki ibtida ki thi , issi tarah hum ussay dobara peda kerden gay . yeh aik wada hai jissay poora kernay ka hum ney zimma liya hai . hamen yaqeenan yeh kaam kerna hai .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney zaboor mein naseehat kay baad yeh likh diya tha kay zameen kay waris meray naik banday hon gay .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney zaboor mein naseehat kay baad yeh likh diya tha kay zameen kay waris meray naik banday hon gay .

ayahs.text: beyshak iss ( Quran ) mein ibadat guzaar logon  kay liye kafi paygham hai .
ayahs.translation: beyshak iss ( Quran ) mein ibadat guzaar logon  kay liye kafi paygham hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen saray jahano kay liye rehmat hi rehmat bana ker bheja hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen saray jahano kay liye rehmat hi rehmat bana ker bheja hai .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  mujh per to yehi wahi aati hai kay tumhara khuda bus aik hi khuda hai . to kiya tum itaat qubool kertay ho-?
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  mujh per to yehi wahi aati hai kay tumhara khuda bus aik hi khuda hai . to kiya tum itaat qubool kertay ho-?

ayahs.text: phir bhi agar yeh log mun morren to keh do kay :  mein ney tumhen al-al-aelaan khabrdar kerdiya hai . aur mujhay yeh maloom nahi hai kay jiss ( saza ) ka tum say wada kiya jaraha hai , woh qareeb hai ya door .
ayahs.translation: phir bhi agar yeh log mun morren to keh do kay :  mein ney tumhen al-al-aelaan khabrdar kerdiya hai . aur mujhay yeh maloom nahi hai kay jiss ( saza ) ka tum say wada kiya jaraha hai , woh qareeb hai ya door .

ayahs.text: beyshak Allah woh baaten bhi janta hai jo buland aawaz say kahi jati hain , aur woh baaten bhi janta hai jo tum chupatay ho .
ayahs.translation: beyshak Allah woh baaten bhi janta hai jo buland aawaz say kahi jati hain , aur woh baaten bhi janta hai jo tum chupatay ho .

ayahs.text: aur mein nahi janta shayad ( saza mein ) yeh ( takheer ) tumharay liye aik aazmaesh hai , aur kissi khaas waqt tak kay liye mazay kernay ka moaqa dena hai .
ayahs.translation: aur mein nahi janta shayad ( saza mein ) yeh ( takheer ) tumharay liye aik aazmaesh hai , aur kissi khaas waqt tak kay liye mazay kernay ka moaqa dena hai .

ayahs.text: . ( aakhir-kaar ) payghumber ney kaha kay :  aey meray perwerdigar ! haq ka faisla ker-dijiye , aur humara perwerdigar barri rehmat wala hai , aur jo baaten tum banatay ho , unn kay muqablay mein ussi ki madad darkar hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( aakhir-kaar ) payghumber ney kaha kay :  aey meray perwerdigar ! haq ka faisla ker-dijiye , aur humara perwerdigar barri rehmat wala hai , aur jo baaten tum banatay ho , unn kay muqablay mein ussi ki madad darkar hai .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: aey logo ! apney perwerdigar ( kay ghazab ) say daro . yaqeen jano kay qayamat ka bhonchal bari zabardast cheez hai .
verses.translation: aey logo ! apney perwerdigar ( kay ghazab ) say daro . yaqeen jano kay qayamat ka bhonchal bari zabardast cheez hai .

verses.text: jiss din woh tumhen nazar aajaye ga , uss din her doodh pilaney wali uss bacchay ( tak ) ko bhool bethay gi , jiss ko uss ney doodh pilaya , aur her hamal wali apna hamal gira bethay gi , aur log tumhen yun nazar ayen gay kay woh nashay mein bad-hawas hain , halankay woh nashay mein nahi hon gay , balkay Allah ka azab bara sakht hoga .
verses.translation: jiss din woh tumhen nazar aajaye ga , uss din her doodh pilaney wali uss bacchay ( tak ) ko bhool bethay gi , jiss ko uss ney doodh pilaya , aur her hamal wali apna hamal gira bethay gi , aur log tumhen yun nazar ayen gay kay woh nashay mein bad-hawas hain , halankay woh nashay mein nahi hon gay , balkay Allah ka azab bara sakht hoga .

verses.text: aur logon  mein kuch aesay hain jo Allah kay baaray mein bey janey boojhay jhagray kertay hain , aur uss sarkash shetan kay peechay chal kharray hotay hain .
verses.translation: aur logon  mein kuch aesay hain jo Allah kay baaray mein bey janey boojhay jhagray kertay hain , aur uss sarkash shetan kay peechay chal kharray hotay hain .

verses.text: jiss kay muqaddar mein yeh likh diya gaya hai kay jo koi ussay dost banaye ga , to woh uss ko gumrah keray ga , aur ussay bharakti dozakh kay azab ki taraf ley jaye ga .
verses.translation: jiss kay muqaddar mein yeh likh diya gaya hai kay jo koi ussay dost banaye ga , to woh uss ko gumrah keray ga , aur ussay bharakti dozakh kay azab ki taraf ley jaye ga .

verses.text: aey logo ! agar tumhen dobara zinda honey kay baaray mein kuch shak hai to ( zara socho kay ) hum ney tumhen mitti say peda kiya ,   phir nutfay say , phir aik jamay huye khoon say , phir aik gosht kay loathray say jo ( kabhi ) poora ban jata hai , aur ( kabhi ) poora nahi banta ,   takay hum tumharay liye ( tumhari ) haqeeqat khol ker bata den , aur hum ( tumhen ) maon kay pet mein jab tak chahtay hain , aik mutayyan mauddat tak thehraye rakhtay hain , phir tumhen aik bacchay ki shakal mein bahir latay hain , phir ( tumhen paaltay hain ) takay tum apni bharpoor umar tak phonch jao , aur tum mein say baaz woh hain jo ( pehlay hi ) duniya say utha liye jatay hain , aur tumhi mein say baaz woh hotay hain jinn ko bad-tareen umar ( yani intehai burhapay ) tak loata diya jata hai , yahan tak kay woh sabb kuch janney kay baad bhi kuch nahi jantay .   aur tum dekhtay ho kay zameen murjhai hoi parri hai , phir jab hum uss per paani barsatay hain to woh harkat mein aati hai , uss mein barhotry hoti hai , aur woh her qisam ki khushnuma cheezen ugati hai .
verses.translation: aey logo ! agar tumhen dobara zinda honey kay baaray mein kuch shak hai to ( zara socho kay ) hum ney tumhen mitti say peda kiya ,   phir nutfay say , phir aik jamay huye khoon say , phir aik gosht kay loathray say jo ( kabhi ) poora ban jata hai , aur ( kabhi ) poora nahi banta ,   takay hum tumharay liye ( tumhari ) haqeeqat khol ker bata den , aur hum ( tumhen ) maon kay pet mein jab tak chahtay hain , aik mutayyan mauddat tak thehraye rakhtay hain , phir tumhen aik bacchay ki shakal mein bahir latay hain , phir ( tumhen paaltay hain ) takay tum apni bharpoor umar tak phonch jao , aur tum mein say baaz woh hain jo ( pehlay hi ) duniya say utha liye jatay hain , aur tumhi mein say baaz woh hotay hain jinn ko bad-tareen umar ( yani intehai burhapay ) tak loata diya jata hai , yahan tak kay woh sabb kuch janney kay baad bhi kuch nahi jantay .   aur tum dekhtay ho kay zameen murjhai hoi parri hai , phir jab hum uss per paani barsatay hain to woh harkat mein aati hai , uss mein barhotry hoti hai , aur woh her qisam ki khushnuma cheezen ugati hai .

verses.text: yeh sabb kuch iss wajeh say hai kay Allah hi ka wajood bar-haq hai ,   aur wohi bey janon mein jaan daalta hai , aur woh her cheez per mukammal qudrat rakhta hai ,
verses.translation: yeh sabb kuch iss wajeh say hai kay Allah hi ka wajood bar-haq hai ,   aur wohi bey janon mein jaan daalta hai , aur woh her cheez per mukammal qudrat rakhta hai ,

verses.text: aur iss liye kay qayamat ki gharri aaney wali hai , jiss mein koi shak nahi hai , aur iss liye kay Allah unn sabb logon  ko dobara zinda keray ga jo qabron mein hain .
verses.translation: aur iss liye kay qayamat ki gharri aaney wali hai , jiss mein koi shak nahi hai , aur iss liye kay Allah unn sabb logon  ko dobara zinda keray ga jo qabron mein hain .

verses.text: aur logon  mein kuch aesay hain jo Allah kay baaray mein jhagray kertay hain , halankay unn kay paas naa koi ilm hai , naa hidayat , aur naa koi roshni denay wali kitab .
verses.translation: aur logon  mein kuch aesay hain jo Allah kay baaray mein jhagray kertay hain , halankay unn kay paas naa koi ilm hai , naa hidayat , aur naa koi roshni denay wali kitab .

verses.text: woh takabbur say apna pehlo akarraye huye hain , takay doosron ko bhi Allah kay raastay say gumrah keren . aesay hi shaks kay liye duniya mein ruswai hai , aur qayamat kay din hum ussay jalti hoi aag ka maza chakhayen gay .
verses.translation: woh takabbur say apna pehlo akarraye huye hain , takay doosron ko bhi Allah kay raastay say gumrah keren . aesay hi shaks kay liye duniya mein ruswai hai , aur qayamat kay din hum ussay jalti hoi aag ka maza chakhayen gay .

verses.text: . ( kay ) yeh sabb kuch teray uss kartoot ka badla hai jo tu ney apney haathon say aagay bheja tha , aur yeh baat tey hai kay Allah bandon per zulm dhaaney wala nahi hai .
verses.translation: . ( kay ) yeh sabb kuch teray uss kartoot ka badla hai jo tu ney apney haathon say aagay bheja tha , aur yeh baat tey hai kay Allah bandon per zulm dhaaney wala nahi hai .

verses.text: aur logon  mein woh shaks bhi hai jo aik kinaray per reh ker Allah ki ibadat kerta hai . chunacheh agar ussay ( duniya mein ) koi faeeda phonch gaya to woh uss say mutmaeen hojata hai , aur agar ussay koi aazmaesh paish aagae to woh mun morr ker ( phir kufr ki taraf ) chal deta hai .   aesay shaks ney duniya bhi khoi , aur aakhirat bhi . yehi to khula huwa ghaata hai .
verses.translation: aur logon  mein woh shaks bhi hai jo aik kinaray per reh ker Allah ki ibadat kerta hai . chunacheh agar ussay ( duniya mein ) koi faeeda phonch gaya to woh uss say mutmaeen hojata hai , aur agar ussay koi aazmaesh paish aagae to woh mun morr ker ( phir kufr ki taraf ) chal deta hai .   aesay shaks ney duniya bhi khoi , aur aakhirat bhi . yehi to khula huwa ghaata hai .
