verses.translation: aur hum ney nooh ko unn ki qoam kay paas bheja tha , chunacheh unhon ney ( qoam say ) kaha kay :  meri qoam kay logo ! Allah ki ibadat kero , uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi hai . bhala kiya tum dartay nahi ho-?

verses.text: iss per unn ki qoam kay kafir sardaron ney ( aik doosray say ) kaha :  iss shaks ki iss kay siwa koi haqeeqat nahi kay yeh tumhi jaisa aik insan hai jo tum per apni bartari jamana chahta hai , aur agar Allah chahta to farishtay nazil ker deta . yeh baat to hum ney apney pichlay baap dadon mein kabhi nahi suni .
verses.translation: iss per unn ki qoam kay kafir sardaron ney ( aik doosray say ) kaha :  iss shaks ki iss kay siwa koi haqeeqat nahi kay yeh tumhi jaisa aik insan hai jo tum per apni bartari jamana chahta hai , aur agar Allah chahta to farishtay nazil ker deta . yeh baat to hum ney apney pichlay baap dadon mein kabhi nahi suni .

verses.text: . ( raha yeh shaks , to ) yeh aur kuch nahi , aik aisa aadmi hai jissay junoon laahaq hogaya hai , iss liye kuch waqt tak iss ka intizar ker kay dekh lo ( kay shayad apney hawaas mein aajaye )
verses.translation: . ( raha yeh shaks , to ) yeh aur kuch nahi , aik aisa aadmi hai jissay junoon laahaq hogaya hai , iss liye kuch waqt tak iss ka intizar ker kay dekh lo ( kay shayad apney hawaas mein aajaye )

verses.text: nooh ney kaha :  ya rab ! inn logon  ney mujhay jiss tarah jhoota banaya hai , uss per to hi meri madad farma .
verses.translation: nooh ney kaha :  ya rab ! inn logon  ney mujhay jiss tarah jhoota banaya hai , uss per to hi meri madad farma .

verses.text: chunacheh hum ney unn kay paas wahi bheji kay :  tum humari nigrani mein aur humari wahi kay mutabiq kashti banao . phir jab humara hukum aajaye , aur tanoor ubal parray ,   to her qisam kay janweron mein say aik aik jorra ley ker ussay bhi uss kashti mein sawar ker lena ,   aur apney ghar walon ko bhi , siwaye unn kay jinn kay khilaf pehlay hi hukum sadir hochuka hai .   aur inn zalimon kay baaray mein mujh say koi baat naa kerna , yeh baat tey hai kay yeh sabb gharq kiye jayen gay .
verses.translation: chunacheh hum ney unn kay paas wahi bheji kay :  tum humari nigrani mein aur humari wahi kay mutabiq kashti banao . phir jab humara hukum aajaye , aur tanoor ubal parray ,   to her qisam kay janweron mein say aik aik jorra ley ker ussay bhi uss kashti mein sawar ker lena ,   aur apney ghar walon ko bhi , siwaye unn kay jinn kay khilaf pehlay hi hukum sadir hochuka hai .   aur inn zalimon kay baaray mein mujh say koi baat naa kerna , yeh baat tey hai kay yeh sabb gharq kiye jayen gay .

verses.text: phir jab tum aur tumharay sathi kashti mein theek theek beth chuken , to kehna :  shukar hai Allah ka jiss ney hamen zalim logon  say nijat ata farmaee .
verses.translation: phir jab tum aur tumharay sathi kashti mein theek theek beth chuken , to kehna :  shukar hai Allah ka jiss ney hamen zalim logon  say nijat ata farmaee .

verses.text: aur kehna :  ya-Rab ! mujhay aisa utarna naseeb ker jo barkat wala ho , aur tu behtareen utaarney wala hai .
verses.translation: aur kehna :  ya-Rab ! mujhay aisa utarna naseeb ker jo barkat wala ho , aur tu behtareen utaarney wala hai .

verses.text: iss saray waqaey mein bari nishaniyan hain , aur yaqeeni baat hai kay hamen aazmaesh to kerni hi kerni thi .
verses.translation: iss saray waqaey mein bari nishaniyan hain , aur yaqeeni baat hai kay hamen aazmaesh to kerni hi kerni thi .

verses.text: phir unn kay baad hum ney doosri naslen peda ken ,
verses.translation: phir unn kay baad hum ney doosri naslen peda ken ,

verses.text: aur unn kay darmiyan unhi mein kay aik shaks ko Rasool bana ker bheja .   ( jiss ney kaha ) kay :  Allah ki ibadat kero , uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi hai . bhala kiya tum dartay nahi ho-?
verses.translation: aur unn kay darmiyan unhi mein kay aik shaks ko Rasool bana ker bheja .   ( jiss ney kaha ) kay :  Allah ki ibadat kero , uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi hai . bhala kiya tum dartay nahi ho-?

verses.text: unn ki qoam kay woh sardar jinhon ney kufr apna rakha tha , aur jinhon ney aakhirat ka samna kernay ko jhutlaya tha , aur jinn ko hum ney dunyawi zindagi mein khoob aesh dey rakha tha , unhon ney ( aik doosray say ) kaha :  iss shaks ki haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch nahi hai kay yeh tumhi jaisa aik insan hai . jo cheez tum khatay ho , yeh bhi khata hai , aur jo tum peetay ho , yeh bhi peeta hai .
verses.translation: unn ki qoam kay woh sardar jinhon ney kufr apna rakha tha , aur jinhon ney aakhirat ka samna kernay ko jhutlaya tha , aur jinn ko hum ney dunyawi zindagi mein khoob aesh dey rakha tha , unhon ney ( aik doosray say ) kaha :  iss shaks ki haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch nahi hai kay yeh tumhi jaisa aik insan hai . jo cheez tum khatay ho , yeh bhi khata hai , aur jo tum peetay ho , yeh bhi peeta hai .

verses.text: aur agar kahen tum ney apney hi jaisay aik insan ki farmanbardaari qubool kerli to tum baray hi ghatay ka soda kero gay .
verses.translation: aur agar kahen tum ney apney hi jaisay aik insan ki farmanbardaari qubool kerli to tum baray hi ghatay ka soda kero gay .

verses.text: bhala batao yeh shaks tumhen darata hai kay jab tum mar-jao gay , aur mitti aur haddiyon mein tabdeel hojao gay , to tumhen dobara zameen say nikala jaye ga-?
verses.translation: bhala batao yeh shaks tumhen darata hai kay jab tum mar-jao gay , aur mitti aur haddiyon mein tabdeel hojao gay , to tumhen dobara zameen say nikala jaye ga-?

verses.text: jiss baat say tumhen daraya jaraha hai , woh to boht hi baeed baat hai , samajh say bilkul hi door !
verses.translation: jiss baat say tumhen daraya jaraha hai , woh to boht hi baeed baat hai , samajh say bilkul hi door !

verses.text: zindagi to humari iss dunyawi zindagi kay siwa koi aur nahi hai , ( yahin ) hum martay aur jeetay hain , aur hamen dobara zinda nahi kiya jasakta .
verses.translation: zindagi to humari iss dunyawi zindagi kay siwa koi aur nahi hai , ( yahin ) hum martay aur jeetay hain , aur hamen dobara zinda nahi kiya jasakta .

verses.text: . ( raha yeh shaks , to ) yeh aur kuch nahi , aik aisa aadmi hai jiss ney Allah per jhoota bohtan gharra hai , aur hum iss per emaan laney walay nahi hain .
verses.translation: . ( raha yeh shaks , to ) yeh aur kuch nahi , aik aisa aadmi hai jiss ney Allah per jhoota bohtan gharra hai , aur hum iss per emaan laney walay nahi hain .

verses.text: payghumber ney kaha :  ya rab ! inn logon  ney mujhay jiss tarah jhoota banaya hai , uss per tu hi meri madad farma .
verses.translation: payghumber ney kaha :  ya rab ! inn logon  ney mujhay jiss tarah jhoota banaya hai , uss per tu hi meri madad farma .

verses.text: Allah ney farmaya :  abb thori hi dair ki baat hai kay yeh log pachtatay reh jayen gay .
verses.translation: Allah ney farmaya :  abb thori hi dair ki baat hai kay yeh log pachtatay reh jayen gay .

verses.text: chunacheh iss sachay waday kay mutabiq unn ko aik chinghaarr ney aa-pakra aur hum ney unhen koorra karkat bana ker rakh diya . phitkaar hai aesay zalim logon  per !
verses.translation: chunacheh iss sachay waday kay mutabiq unn ko aik chinghaarr ney aa-pakra aur hum ney unhen koorra karkat bana ker rakh diya . phitkaar hai aesay zalim logon  per !

verses.text: iss kay baad hum ney doosri naslen peda ken .
verses.translation: iss kay baad hum ney doosri naslen peda ken .

verses.text: koi ummat naa apney moyyan waqt say pehlay jasakti hai , naa uss kay baad thehar sakti hai .
verses.translation: koi ummat naa apney moyyan waqt say pehlay jasakti hai , naa uss kay baad thehar sakti hai .

verses.text: phir hum ney pey-dar-pay apney payghumber bhejay , jab bhi kissi qoam kay paas uss ka payghumber aata to woh ussay jhutlatay , chunacheh hum ney bhi aik kay baad aik ( ko halak kernay ) ka silsila baandh diya , aur unhen qissa kahaniyan bana daala . phitkaar hai unn logon  per jo emaan nahi latay !
verses.translation: phir hum ney pey-dar-pay apney payghumber bhejay , jab bhi kissi qoam kay paas uss ka payghumber aata to woh ussay jhutlatay , chunacheh hum ney bhi aik kay baad aik ( ko halak kernay ) ka silsila baandh diya , aur unhen qissa kahaniyan bana daala . phitkaar hai unn logon  per jo emaan nahi latay !

verses.text: phir hum ney musa aur unn kay bhai Haroon ko apni nishaniyon aur wazeh saboot kay sath
verses.translation: phir hum ney musa aur unn kay bhai Haroon ko apni nishaniyon aur wazeh saboot kay sath

verses.text: firon aur uss kay sardaron kay paas bheja to unhon ney ghamand ka muzahira kiya , aur woh baray takabbur walay log thay .
verses.translation: firon aur uss kay sardaron kay paas bheja to unhon ney ghamand ka muzahira kiya , aur woh baray takabbur walay log thay .

verses.text: chunacheh kehney lagay :  kiya hum apney jaisay do aadmiyon per emaan ley ayen , halankay unn ki qoam humari ghulami ker rahi hai ?
verses.translation: chunacheh kehney lagay :  kiya hum apney jaisay do aadmiyon per emaan ley ayen , halankay unn ki qoam humari ghulami ker rahi hai ?

verses.text: iss tarah unhon ney unn dono ko jhutlaya , aur aakhir kaar woh bhi unn logon  say jaa milay jinhen halak kiya gaya tha .
verses.translation: iss tarah unhon ney unn dono ko jhutlaya , aur aakhir kaar woh bhi unn logon  say jaa milay jinhen halak kiya gaya tha .

verses.text: aur musa ko hum ney kitab ata farmaee , takay unn kay log rehnumai hasil keren .
verses.translation: aur musa ko hum ney kitab ata farmaee , takay unn kay log rehnumai hasil keren .

verses.text: aur maryam kay betay ( essa aleh-assalam ) ko aur unn ki maa ko hum ney aik nishani banaya , aur unn dono ko aik aesi bulandi per panah di jo aik pursukoon jagah thi , aur jahan saaf suthra paani behta tha .
verses.translation: aur maryam kay betay ( essa aleh-assalam ) ko aur unn ki maa ko hum ney aik nishani banaya , aur unn dono ko aik aesi bulandi per panah di jo aik pursukoon jagah thi , aur jahan saaf suthra paani behta tha .

verses.text: aey payghumbero ! pakeezah cheezon mein say ( jo chahao ) khao aur naik amal kero . yaqeen rakho kay jo kuch tum kertay ho , mujhay uss ka poora poora ilm hai .
verses.translation: aey payghumbero ! pakeezah cheezon mein say ( jo chahao ) khao aur naik amal kero . yaqeen rakho kay jo kuch tum kertay ho , mujhay uss ka poora poora ilm hai .

verses.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay yehi tumhara deen hai , ( sabb kay liye ) aik hi deen ! aur mein tumhara perwerdigar hun , iss liye dil mein ( sirf ) mera roab rakho .
verses.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay yehi tumhara deen hai , ( sabb kay liye ) aik hi deen ! aur mein tumhara perwerdigar hun , iss liye dil mein ( sirf ) mera roab rakho .

verses.text: phir huwa yeh kay logon  ney apney deen mein baham phoot daal ker firqay bana liye . her giroh ney apney khayal mein jo tareeqa ikhtiyar kerliya hai , ussi per magan hai .
verses.translation: phir huwa yeh kay logon  ney apney deen mein baham phoot daal ker firqay bana liye . her giroh ney apney khayal mein jo tareeqa ikhtiyar kerliya hai , ussi per magan hai .

verses.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) inn ko aik khaas waqt tak apni jihalat mein dooba rehney do .
verses.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) inn ko aik khaas waqt tak apni jihalat mein dooba rehney do .

verses.text: kiya yeh log iss khayal mein hain kay hum inn ko jo dolat aur aulad diye jarahey hain ,
verses.translation: kiya yeh log iss khayal mein hain kay hum inn ko jo dolat aur aulad diye jarahey hain ,

verses.text: to unn ko bhalaiyan phonchaney mein jaldi dikha rahey hain-?   nahi , balkay inn ko haqeeqat ka shaoor nahi hai .
verses.translation: to unn ko bhalaiyan phonchaney mein jaldi dikha rahey hain-?   nahi , balkay inn ko haqeeqat ka shaoor nahi hai .

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log apney perwerdigar kay roab say daray rehtay hain ,
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log apney perwerdigar kay roab say daray rehtay hain ,

verses.text: aur jo apney perwerdigar ki aayaton per emaan latay hain ,
verses.translation: aur jo apney perwerdigar ki aayaton per emaan latay hain ,

verses.text: aur jo apney perwerdigar kay sath kissi ko shareek nahi mantay ,
verses.translation: aur jo apney perwerdigar kay sath kissi ko shareek nahi mantay ,

verses.text: aur woh jo amal bhi kertay hain , ussay kertay waqt unn kay dil iss baat say sehmay hotay hain kay unhen apney perwerdigar kay paas wapis jana hai ,
verses.translation: aur woh jo amal bhi kertay hain , ussay kertay waqt unn kay dil iss baat say sehmay hotay hain kay unhen apney perwerdigar kay paas wapis jana hai ,

verses.text: woh hain jo bhalaiyan hasil kernay mein jaldi dikha rahey hain , aur woh hain jo unn ki taraf tezi say aagay barh rahey hain .
verses.translation: woh hain jo bhalaiyan hasil kernay mein jaldi dikha rahey hain , aur woh hain jo unn ki taraf tezi say aagay barh rahey hain .

verses.text: aur hum kissi shaks ko uss ki taqat say ziyada kissi kaam ki zimma daari nahi detay , aur humaray paas aik kitab hai jo ( sabb ka haal ) theek theek bol dey gi , aur unn per koi zulm nahi hoga .
verses.translation: aur hum kissi shaks ko uss ki taqat say ziyada kissi kaam ki zimma daari nahi detay , aur humaray paas aik kitab hai jo ( sabb ka haal ) theek theek bol dey gi , aur unn per koi zulm nahi hoga .

verses.text: lekin unn kay dil iss baat say ghaflat mein doobay huye hain , aur iss kay ilawa unn ki aur bhi kaarastaniyan hain jo woh kertay rehtay hain .
verses.translation: lekin unn kay dil iss baat say ghaflat mein doobay huye hain , aur iss kay ilawa unn ki aur bhi kaarastaniyan hain jo woh kertay rehtay hain .

verses.text: yahan tak kay jab hum unn kay dolat mand logon  ko azab mein pakar len gay to woh aik dum bilbila uthen gay .
verses.translation: yahan tak kay jab hum unn kay dolat mand logon  ko azab mein pakar len gay to woh aik dum bilbila uthen gay .

verses.text: aaj bilbilao nahi , humari taraf say tumhen koi madad nahi milay gi .
verses.translation: aaj bilbilao nahi , humari taraf say tumhen koi madad nahi milay gi .

verses.text: meri aayaten tum ko parh ker sunai jati then , to tum ultay paon murr jatay thay ,
verses.translation: meri aayaten tum ko parh ker sunai jati then , to tum ultay paon murr jatay thay ,

verses.text: baray ghuroor say iss ( Quran ) kay baaray mein raat ko majlisen jama ker beyhooda baaten kertay thay .
verses.translation: baray ghuroor say iss ( Quran ) kay baaray mein raat ko majlisen jama ker beyhooda baaten kertay thay .

verses.text: bhala kiya inn logon  ney iss kalam per ghor nahi kiya , ya inn kay paas koi aesi cheez aagae hai jo inn kay pichlay baap dadon kay paas nahi aai thi ?
verses.translation: bhala kiya inn logon  ney iss kalam per ghor nahi kiya , ya inn kay paas koi aesi cheez aagae hai jo inn kay pichlay baap dadon kay paas nahi aai thi ?

verses.text: ya yeh apney payghumber ko ( pehlay say ) jantay hi nahi thay , iss wajeh say unn ka inkar ker rahey hain-?
verses.translation: ya yeh apney payghumber ko ( pehlay say ) jantay hi nahi thay , iss wajeh say unn ka inkar ker rahey hain-?

verses.text: ya unn ka kehna hai kay inn ( payghumber ) ko junoon laahaq hogaya hai ? nahi , balkay ( asal wajeh yeh hai kay ) yeh payghumber inn kay paas haq ley ker aaye hain , aur inn mein say aksar log haq ko pasand nahi kertay .
verses.translation: ya unn ka kehna hai kay inn ( payghumber ) ko junoon laahaq hogaya hai ? nahi , balkay ( asal wajeh yeh hai kay ) yeh payghumber inn kay paas haq ley ker aaye hain , aur inn mein say aksar log haq ko pasand nahi kertay .

verses.text: aur agar haq inn ki khuwaishaat kay tabey hojata to aasman aur zameen aur unn mein basney walay sabb barbad hojatay . nahi , balkay hum unn kay paas khud unn kay liye naseehat ka saman ley ker aaye hain , aur woh hain kay khud apni naseehat say mun morray huye hain .
verses.translation: aur agar haq inn ki khuwaishaat kay tabey hojata to aasman aur zameen aur unn mein basney walay sabb barbad hojatay . nahi , balkay hum unn kay paas khud unn kay liye naseehat ka saman ley ker aaye hain , aur woh hain kay khud apni naseehat say mun morray huye hain .

verses.text: ya ( inn kay inkar ki wajeh yeh hai kay ) tum inn say koi moawza maang rahey ho-? to ( yeh baat bhi ghalat hai , iss liye kay ) tumharay perwerdigar ka diya huwa moawza ( tumharay liye ) kahen behtar hai , aur woh behtareen rizq denay wala hai .
verses.translation: ya ( inn kay inkar ki wajeh yeh hai kay ) tum inn say koi moawza maang rahey ho-? to ( yeh baat bhi ghalat hai , iss liye kay ) tumharay perwerdigar ka diya huwa moawza ( tumharay liye ) kahen behtar hai , aur woh behtareen rizq denay wala hai .

verses.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum to unhen seedhay raastay ki taraf bula rahey ho ,
verses.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum to unhen seedhay raastay ki taraf bula rahey ho ,

verses.text: aur jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , woh raastay say bilkul hatay huye hain .
verses.translation: aur jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , woh raastay say bilkul hatay huye hain .

verses.text: aur agar hum inn per reham keren aur uss takleef ko door kerden jiss mein yeh mubtala hain tab bhi yeh bhataktay huye apni sarkashi per array rahen gay .
verses.translation: aur agar hum inn per reham keren aur uss takleef ko door kerden jiss mein yeh mubtala hain tab bhi yeh bhataktay huye apni sarkashi per array rahen gay .

verses.text: waqiaa yeh hai kay hum ney inn ko ( aik martaba ) azab mein pakra tha , to uss waqt bhi yeh log apney perwerdigar kay samney nahi jhukay . aur yeh to aajzi ki rawish ikhtiyar kertay hi nahi hain .
verses.translation: waqiaa yeh hai kay hum ney inn ko ( aik martaba ) azab mein pakra tha , to uss waqt bhi yeh log apney perwerdigar kay samney nahi jhukay . aur yeh to aajzi ki rawish ikhtiyar kertay hi nahi hain .

verses.text: yahan tak kay jab hum inn per sakht azab wala darwaza khol den gay , to yeh aik dum uss mein mayyus ho ker reh jayen gay .
verses.translation: yahan tak kay jab hum inn per sakht azab wala darwaza khol den gay , to yeh aik dum uss mein mayyus ho ker reh jayen gay .

verses.text: woh Allah hi to hai jiss ney tumharay liye kaan aur aankhen aur dil peda kiye . ( magar ) tum log boht kam shukar ada kertay ho .
verses.translation: woh Allah hi to hai jiss ney tumharay liye kaan aur aankhen aur dil peda kiye . ( magar ) tum log boht kam shukar ada kertay ho .

verses.text: aur wohi hai jiss ney tumhen zameen mein phelaya , aur ussi ki taraf tumhen ikattha ker kay ley jaya jaye ga .
verses.translation: aur wohi hai jiss ney tumhen zameen mein phelaya , aur ussi ki taraf tumhen ikattha ker kay ley jaya jaye ga .

verses.text: aur wohi hai jo zindagi aur moat deta hai , aur ussi kay qabazay mein raat aur din ki tabeedilyan hain . kiya phir bhi tum aqal say kaam nahi letay-?
verses.translation: aur wohi hai jo zindagi aur moat deta hai , aur ussi kay qabazay mein raat aur din ki tabeedilyan hain . kiya phir bhi tum aqal say kaam nahi letay-?

verses.text: iss kay bajaye yeh log bhi wesi hi baaten kertay hain jaisi pichlay logon  ney ki then .
verses.translation: iss kay bajaye yeh log bhi wesi hi baaten kertay hain jaisi pichlay logon  ney ki then .

verses.text: kehtay hain kay :  kiya jab hum mar-jayen gay aur mitti aur haddiyon mein tabdeel hojayen gay , to kiya waqaee hamen dobara zinda ker kay uthaya jaye ga-?
verses.translation: kehtay hain kay :  kiya jab hum mar-jayen gay aur mitti aur haddiyon mein tabdeel hojayen gay , to kiya waqaee hamen dobara zinda ker kay uthaya jaye ga-?

verses.text: yeh woh yaqeen dahani hai jo hum say bhi ki gaee hai , aur iss say pehlay humaray baap dadon say bhi ki gaee thi . iss ki koi haqeeqat iss kay siwa nahi kay yeh pichlay logon  kay banaye huye afsaney hain .
verses.translation: yeh woh yaqeen dahani hai jo hum say bhi ki gaee hai , aur iss say pehlay humaray baap dadon say bhi ki gaee thi . iss ki koi haqeeqat iss kay siwa nahi kay yeh pichlay logon  kay banaye huye afsaney hain .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! zara inn say ) kaho kay :  yeh sari zameen aur iss mein basney walay kiss ki milkiyat hain-? batao agar jantay ho .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! zara inn say ) kaho kay :  yeh sari zameen aur iss mein basney walay kiss ki milkiyat hain-? batao agar jantay ho .

verses.text: woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay :  yeh sabb kuch Allah ka hai .    kaho kay :  kiya phir bhi tum sabaq nahi letay-?
verses.translation: woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay :  yeh sabb kuch Allah ka hai .    kaho kay :  kiya phir bhi tum sabaq nahi letay-?

verses.text: kaho kay :  saat aasmano ka malik aur aali shaan arsh ka malik kon hai ?
verses.translation: kaho kay :  saat aasmano ka malik aur aali shaan arsh ka malik kon hai ?

verses.text: woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay :  yeh sabb kuch Allah ka hai .  kaho kay :  kiya phir bhi tum Allah say nahi dartay-?
verses.translation: woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay :  yeh sabb kuch Allah ka hai .  kaho kay :  kiya phir bhi tum Allah say nahi dartay-?

verses.text: kaho kay :  kon hai jiss kay haath mein her cheez ka mukammal ikhtiyar hai , aur jo panah deta hai , aur uss kay muqablay mein koi kissi ko panah nahi dey sakta-? batao agar jantay ho .
verses.translation: kaho kay :  kon hai jiss kay haath mein her cheez ka mukammal ikhtiyar hai , aur jo panah deta hai , aur uss kay muqablay mein koi kissi ko panah nahi dey sakta-? batao agar jantay ho .

verses.text: woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay :  sara ikhtiyar Allah ka hai .  kaho kay :  phir kahan say tum per koi jadoo chal jata hai ?
verses.translation: woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay :  sara ikhtiyar Allah ka hai .  kaho kay :  phir kahan say tum per koi jadoo chal jata hai ?

verses.text: nahi ( yeh afsaney nahi ) balkay hum ney unhen haq baat phonchai hai , aur yeh log yaqeenan jhootay hain .
verses.translation: nahi ( yeh afsaney nahi ) balkay hum ney unhen haq baat phonchai hai , aur yeh log yaqeenan jhootay hain .

verses.text: naa to Allah ney koi beta banaya hai , aur naa uss kay sath koi aur khuda hai . agar aisa hota to her khuda apni makhlooq ko ley ker alag hojata , aur phir woh aik doosray per charrhai ker-detay .   pak hai Allah unn baaton say jo yeh log banatay hain ,
verses.translation: naa to Allah ney koi beta banaya hai , aur naa uss kay sath koi aur khuda hai . agar aisa hota to her khuda apni makhlooq ko ley ker alag hojata , aur phir woh aik doosray per charrhai ker-detay .   pak hai Allah unn baaton say jo yeh log banatay hain ,

verses.text: woh Allah jissay tamam chupi aur khuli baaton ka mukammal ilm hai . lehaza woh inn kay shirk say boht buland o baala hai .
verses.translation: woh Allah jissay tamam chupi aur khuli baaton ka mukammal ilm hai . lehaza woh inn kay shirk say boht buland o baala hai .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) dua kero kay :  meray perwerdigar ! jiss azab ki dhamki inn ( kafiron ) ko di jarahi hai , agar aap ussay meri aankhon kay samney ley ayen ,
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) dua kero kay :  meray perwerdigar ! jiss azab ki dhamki inn ( kafiron ) ko di jarahi hai , agar aap ussay meri aankhon kay samney ley ayen ,

verses.text: to aey meray perwerdigar ! mujhay inn zalim logon  kay sath shamil naa kijiye ga .
verses.translation: to aey meray perwerdigar ! mujhay inn zalim logon  kay sath shamil naa kijiye ga .

verses.text: aur yaqeen jano kay hum jiss cheez ki enhen dhamki dey rahey hain , ussay tumhari aankhon kay samney laney per poori tarah qadir hain .
verses.translation: aur yaqeen jano kay hum jiss cheez ki enhen dhamki dey rahey hain , ussay tumhari aankhon kay samney laney per poori tarah qadir hain .

verses.text: . ( lekin jab tak woh waqt naa aaye ) tum burai ka dafiya aesay tareeqay say kertay raho jo behtareen ho .   jo baaten yeh log banatay hain , hum khoob jantay hain .
verses.translation: . ( lekin jab tak woh waqt naa aaye ) tum burai ka dafiya aesay tareeqay say kertay raho jo behtareen ho .   jo baaten yeh log banatay hain , hum khoob jantay hain .

verses.text: aur dua kero kay :  meray perwerdigar ! mein shetan kay lagaye huye charkon say aap ki panah maangta hun ,
verses.translation: aur dua kero kay :  meray perwerdigar ! mein shetan kay lagaye huye charkon say aap ki panah maangta hun ,

verses.text: aur meray perwerdigar ! mein unn kay apney qareeb aaney say bhi aap ki panah maangta hun .
verses.translation: aur meray perwerdigar ! mein unn kay apney qareeb aaney say bhi aap ki panah maangta hun .

verses.text: yahan tak kay jab unn mein say kissi per moat aa-khari hogi to woh kahey ga kay :  meray perwerdigar ! mujhay wapis bhej dijiye ,
verses.translation: yahan tak kay jab unn mein say kissi per moat aa-khari hogi to woh kahey ga kay :  meray perwerdigar ! mujhay wapis bhej dijiye ,

verses.text: takay jiss duniya ko mein chorr aaya hun , uss mein jaker naik amal kerun .  hergiz nahi ! yeh to aik baat hi baat hai jo woh zaban say keh raha hai , aur inn ( marney walon ) kay samney aalam e barzakh ki aarr hai .   jo uss waqt tak qaeem rahey gi jab tak unn ko dobara zinda ker kay uthaya jaye .
verses.translation: takay jiss duniya ko mein chorr aaya hun , uss mein jaker naik amal kerun .  hergiz nahi ! yeh to aik baat hi baat hai jo woh zaban say keh raha hai , aur inn ( marney walon ) kay samney aalam e barzakh ki aarr hai .   jo uss waqt tak qaeem rahey gi jab tak unn ko dobara zinda ker kay uthaya jaye .

verses.text: phir jab soor phoonka jaye ga to uss din naa unn kay darmiyan rishtay natay baqi rahen gay , aur naa koi kissi ko poochay ga .
verses.translation: phir jab soor phoonka jaye ga to uss din naa unn kay darmiyan rishtay natay baqi rahen gay , aur naa koi kissi ko poochay ga .

verses.text: uss waqt jinn kay palray bhari niklay , to wohi hon gay jo falah payen gay ,
verses.translation: uss waqt jinn kay palray bhari niklay , to wohi hon gay jo falah payen gay ,

verses.text: aur jinn kay palray halkay parr-gaye , to yeh woh log hon gay jinhon ney apney liye ghatay ka soda kiya tha , woh dozakh mein hamesha hamesha rahen gay .
verses.translation: aur jinn kay palray halkay parr-gaye , to yeh woh log hon gay jinhon ney apney liye ghatay ka soda kiya tha , woh dozakh mein hamesha hamesha rahen gay .

verses.text: aag unn kay chehron ko jhulas daalay gi , aur uss mein unn ki soorten bigar jayen gi .
verses.translation: aag unn kay chehron ko jhulas daalay gi , aur uss mein unn ki soorten bigar jayen gi .

verses.text: . ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  kiya meri aayaten tumhen parh ker sunai nahi jati then-? aur tum unn ko jhutlaya kertay thay .
verses.translation: . ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  kiya meri aayaten tumhen parh ker sunai nahi jati then-? aur tum unn ko jhutlaya kertay thay .

verses.text: woh kahen gay :  humaray perwerdigar ! hum per humari bad-bakhti chah gaee thi , aur hum gumrah log thay .
verses.translation: woh kahen gay :  humaray perwerdigar ! hum per humari bad-bakhti chah gaee thi , aur hum gumrah log thay .

verses.text: humaray perwerdigar ! hamen yahan say bahir nikal dijiye , phir agar hum dobara wohi kaam keren to beyshak hum zalim hon gay .
verses.translation: humaray perwerdigar ! hamen yahan say bahir nikal dijiye , phir agar hum dobara wohi kaam keren to beyshak hum zalim hon gay .

verses.text: Allah farmaye ga :  issi ( dozakh ) mein zaleel ho ker parray raho , aur mujh say baat bhi naa kero .
verses.translation: Allah farmaye ga :  issi ( dozakh ) mein zaleel ho ker parray raho , aur mujh say baat bhi naa kero .

verses.text: meray bandon mein say aik jamat yeh dua kerti thi kay : aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum emaan ley aaye hain , pus hamen bakhsh dijiye , aur hum per reham farmaiye , aur aap sabb reham kernay walon say barh ker reham farmaney walay hain .
verses.translation: meray bandon mein say aik jamat yeh dua kerti thi kay : aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum emaan ley aaye hain , pus hamen bakhsh dijiye , aur hum per reham farmaiye , aur aap sabb reham kernay walon say barh ker reham farmaney walay hain .

verses.text: to tum ney unn logon  ka mazaq banaya tha . yahan tak kay unn hi ( kay sath cher-chaar ) ney tumhen meri yaad tak say ghafil kerdiya , aur tum unn ki hansi uratay rahey .
verses.translation: to tum ney unn logon  ka mazaq banaya tha . yahan tak kay unn hi ( kay sath cher-chaar ) ney tumhen meri yaad tak say ghafil kerdiya , aur tum unn ki hansi uratay rahey .

verses.text: unhon ney jiss tarah sabar say kaam liya tha , aaj mein ney unhen uss ka yeh badla diya hai kay unhon ney apni murad paali hai .
verses.translation: unhon ney jiss tarah sabar say kaam liya tha , aaj mein ney unhen uss ka yeh badla diya hai kay unhon ney apni murad paali hai .

verses.text: . ( phir ) Allah ( inn dozakhiyon say ) farmaye ga :  tum zameen mein ginti kay kitney saal rahey-?
verses.translation: . ( phir ) Allah ( inn dozakhiyon say ) farmaye ga :  tum zameen mein ginti kay kitney saal rahey-?

verses.text: woh kahen gay kay :  hum aik din ya aik din say bhi kam rahey hon gay .   ( hamen poori tarah yaad nahi ) iss liye jinhon ney ( waqt ki ) ginti ki ho , unn say pooch lijiye .
verses.translation: woh kahen gay kay :  hum aik din ya aik din say bhi kam rahey hon gay .   ( hamen poori tarah yaad nahi ) iss liye jinhon ney ( waqt ki ) ginti ki ho , unn say pooch lijiye .

verses.text: Allah farmaye ga :  tum thori mauddat say ziyada nahi rahey . kiya khoob hota agar yeh baat tum ney ( uss waqt ) samajh li hoti !
verses.translation: Allah farmaye ga :  tum thori mauddat say ziyada nahi rahey . kiya khoob hota agar yeh baat tum ney ( uss waqt ) samajh li hoti !

verses.text: bhala kiya tum yeh samjhay bethay thay kay hum ney tumhen yunhi bey maqsad peda kerdiya ,   aur tumhen wapis humaray paas nahi laya jaye ga-?
verses.translation: bhala kiya tum yeh samjhay bethay thay kay hum ney tumhen yunhi bey maqsad peda kerdiya ,   aur tumhen wapis humaray paas nahi laya jaye ga-?

verses.text: gharz boht oonchi shaan hai Allah ki jo sahih maani mein badshah hai ! uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi , woh izzat walay arsh ka malik hai .
verses.translation: gharz boht oonchi shaan hai Allah ki jo sahih maani mein badshah hai ! uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi , woh izzat walay arsh ka malik hai .

verses.text: aur jo shaks Allah kay sath kissi aur khuda ko pukaray , jiss per uss kay paas kissi qisam ki koi daleel nahi , to uss ka hisab uss kay perwerdigar kay paas hai . yaqeen jano kay kafir log falah nahi paaskatay .
verses.translation: aur jo shaks Allah kay sath kissi aur khuda ko pukaray , jiss per uss kay paas kissi qisam ki koi daleel nahi , to uss ka hisab uss kay perwerdigar kay paas hai . yaqeen jano kay kafir log falah nahi paaskatay .

verses.text: aur tum ( aey payghumber ) yeh kaho kay :  meray perwerdigar ! humari khatayen bakhsh dey , aur reham farmadey , tu saray reham kernay walon say barh ker reham kernay wala hai .
verses.translation: aur tum ( aey payghumber ) yeh kaho kay :  meray perwerdigar ! humari khatayen bakhsh dey , aur reham farmadey , tu saray reham kernay walon say barh ker reham kernay wala hai .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: unn emaan walon ney yaqeenan falah paali hai .
ayahs.translation: unn emaan walon ney yaqeenan falah paali hai .

ayahs.text: jo apni namaz mein dil say jhukney walay hain ,
ayahs.translation: jo apni namaz mein dil say jhukney walay hain ,

ayahs.text: aur jo laghw cheezon say mun morray huye hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jo laghw cheezon say mun morray huye hain .

ayahs.text: aur jo zakat per amal kernay walay hain ,
ayahs.translation: aur jo zakat per amal kernay walay hain ,

ayahs.text: aur jo apni sharmgahon ki ( aur sabb say ) hifazat kertay hain ,
ayahs.translation: aur jo apni sharmgahon ki ( aur sabb say ) hifazat kertay hain ,

ayahs.text: siwaye apni biwiyon aur unn kaneezon kay jo unn ki milkiyat mein aa-chuki hon ,   kiyonkay aesay log qabil-e-malamat nahi hain ,
ayahs.translation: siwaye apni biwiyon aur unn kaneezon kay jo unn ki milkiyat mein aa-chuki hon ,   kiyonkay aesay log qabil-e-malamat nahi hain ,

ayahs.text: haan jo iss kay ilawa koi aur tareeqa ikhtiyar kerna chahen to aesay log hadd say guzray huye hain .
ayahs.translation: haan jo iss kay ilawa koi aur tareeqa ikhtiyar kerna chahen to aesay log hadd say guzray huye hain .

ayahs.text: aur woh jo apni amanton aur apney ehad ka paas rakhney walay hain ,
ayahs.translation: aur woh jo apni amanton aur apney ehad ka paas rakhney walay hain ,

ayahs.text: aur jo apni namazon ki poori nigrani rakhtay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jo apni namazon ki poori nigrani rakhtay hain .

ayahs.text: yeh hain woh waris .
ayahs.translation: yeh hain woh waris .

ayahs.text: jinhen jannat-ul-Firdous ki meeras milay gi .   yeh uss mein hamesha hamesha rahen gay .
ayahs.translation: jinhen jannat-ul-Firdous ki meeras milay gi .   yeh uss mein hamesha hamesha rahen gay .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney insan ko mitti kay satt say peda kiya ,
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney insan ko mitti kay satt say peda kiya ,

ayahs.text: phir hum ney ussay tapki hoi boond ki shakal mein aik mehfooz jagah per rakha ,
ayahs.translation: phir hum ney ussay tapki hoi boond ki shakal mein aik mehfooz jagah per rakha ,

ayahs.text: phir hum ney uss boond ko jamay huye khoon ki shakal dey di , phir uss jamay huye khoon ko aik loathra bana diya , phir uss loathray ko haddiyon mein tabdeel kerdiya , phir haddiyon ko gosht ka libas pehnaya , phir ussay aesi uthaan di kay woh aik doosri hi makhlooq ban ker kharra hogaya . gharz bari shaan hai Allah ki jo saray karigaron say barh ker karigar hai !
ayahs.translation: phir hum ney uss boond ko jamay huye khoon ki shakal dey di , phir uss jamay huye khoon ko aik loathra bana diya , phir uss loathray ko haddiyon mein tabdeel kerdiya , phir haddiyon ko gosht ka libas pehnaya , phir ussay aesi uthaan di kay woh aik doosri hi makhlooq ban ker kharra hogaya . gharz bari shaan hai Allah ki jo saray karigaron say barh ker karigar hai !

ayahs.text: phir iss sabb kay baad tumhen yaqeenan moat aaney wali hai ,
ayahs.translation: phir iss sabb kay baad tumhen yaqeenan moat aaney wali hai ,

ayahs.text: phir qayamat kay din tumhen yaqeenan dobara zinda kiya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: phir qayamat kay din tumhen yaqeenan dobara zinda kiya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney tumharay oopper saat teh bar teh raastay peda kiye hain , aur hum makhlooq say ghafil nahi hain .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney tumharay oopper saat teh bar teh raastay peda kiye hain , aur hum makhlooq say ghafil nahi hain .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney aasman say theek andazay kay mutabiq paani utaara , phir ussay zameen mein thehra diya ,   aur yaqeen rakho , hum ussay ghaeeb ker-denay per bhi qadir hain .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney aasman say theek andazay kay mutabiq paani utaara , phir ussay zameen mein thehra diya ,   aur yaqeen rakho , hum ussay ghaeeb ker-denay per bhi qadir hain .

ayahs.text: phir hum ney uss say tumharay liye khujooron aur angooron kay baaghaat peda kiye jinn say tumhen boht say meway hasil hotay hain , aur unhi mein say tum khatay ho .
ayahs.translation: phir hum ney uss say tumharay liye khujooron aur angooron kay baaghaat peda kiye jinn say tumhen boht say meway hasil hotay hain , aur unhi mein say tum khatay ho .

ayahs.text: aur woh darkht bhi peda kiya jo toor-e-seena say nikalta hai ,   jo apney sath tel ley ker aur khaney walon kay liye salan ley ker ugta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur woh darkht bhi peda kiya jo toor-e-seena say nikalta hai ,   jo apney sath tel ley ker aur khaney walon kay liye salan ley ker ugta hai .

ayahs.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay tumharay liye maweshiyon mein bari naseehat ka saman hai . jo ( doodh ) unn kay pet mein hai , uss say hum tumhen sairaab kertay hain , aur unn mein tumharay liye boht say fawaeed hain , aur unhi say tum ghiza bhi hasil kertay ho .
ayahs.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay tumharay liye maweshiyon mein bari naseehat ka saman hai . jo ( doodh ) unn kay pet mein hai , uss say hum tumhen sairaab kertay hain , aur unn mein tumharay liye boht say fawaeed hain , aur unhi say tum ghiza bhi hasil kertay ho .

ayahs.text: aur unhi per aur kashtiyon per tumhen sawar bhi kiya jata hai .
ayahs.translation: aur unhi per aur kashtiyon per tumhen sawar bhi kiya jata hai .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney nooh ko unn ki qoam kay paas bheja tha , chunacheh unhon ney ( qoam say ) kaha kay :  meri qoam kay logo ! Allah ki ibadat kero , uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi hai . bhala kiya tum dartay nahi ho-?
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney nooh ko unn ki qoam kay paas bheja tha , chunacheh unhon ney ( qoam say ) kaha kay :  meri qoam kay logo ! Allah ki ibadat kero , uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi hai . bhala kiya tum dartay nahi ho-?

ayahs.text: iss per unn ki qoam kay kafir sardaron ney ( aik doosray say ) kaha :  iss shaks ki iss kay siwa koi haqeeqat nahi kay yeh tumhi jaisa aik insan hai jo tum per apni bartari jamana chahta hai , aur agar Allah chahta to farishtay nazil ker deta . yeh baat to hum ney apney pichlay baap dadon mein kabhi nahi suni .
ayahs.translation: iss per unn ki qoam kay kafir sardaron ney ( aik doosray say ) kaha :  iss shaks ki iss kay siwa koi haqeeqat nahi kay yeh tumhi jaisa aik insan hai jo tum per apni bartari jamana chahta hai , aur agar Allah chahta to farishtay nazil ker deta . yeh baat to hum ney apney pichlay baap dadon mein kabhi nahi suni .

ayahs.text: . ( raha yeh shaks , to ) yeh aur kuch nahi , aik aisa aadmi hai jissay junoon laahaq hogaya hai , iss liye kuch waqt tak iss ka intizar ker kay dekh lo ( kay shayad apney hawaas mein aajaye )
ayahs.translation: . ( raha yeh shaks , to ) yeh aur kuch nahi , aik aisa aadmi hai jissay junoon laahaq hogaya hai , iss liye kuch waqt tak iss ka intizar ker kay dekh lo ( kay shayad apney hawaas mein aajaye )

ayahs.text: nooh ney kaha :  ya rab ! inn logon  ney mujhay jiss tarah jhoota banaya hai , uss per to hi meri madad farma .
ayahs.translation: nooh ney kaha :  ya rab ! inn logon  ney mujhay jiss tarah jhoota banaya hai , uss per to hi meri madad farma .

ayahs.text: chunacheh hum ney unn kay paas wahi bheji kay :  tum humari nigrani mein aur humari wahi kay mutabiq kashti banao . phir jab humara hukum aajaye , aur tanoor ubal parray ,   to her qisam kay janweron mein say aik aik jorra ley ker ussay bhi uss kashti mein sawar ker lena ,   aur apney ghar walon ko bhi , siwaye unn kay jinn kay khilaf pehlay hi hukum sadir hochuka hai .   aur inn zalimon kay baaray mein mujh say koi baat naa kerna , yeh baat tey hai kay yeh sabb gharq kiye jayen gay .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh hum ney unn kay paas wahi bheji kay :  tum humari nigrani mein aur humari wahi kay mutabiq kashti banao . phir jab humara hukum aajaye , aur tanoor ubal parray ,   to her qisam kay janweron mein say aik aik jorra ley ker ussay bhi uss kashti mein sawar ker lena ,   aur apney ghar walon ko bhi , siwaye unn kay jinn kay khilaf pehlay hi hukum sadir hochuka hai .   aur inn zalimon kay baaray mein mujh say koi baat naa kerna , yeh baat tey hai kay yeh sabb gharq kiye jayen gay .

ayahs.text: phir jab tum aur tumharay sathi kashti mein theek theek beth chuken , to kehna :  shukar hai Allah ka jiss ney hamen zalim logon  say nijat ata farmaee .
ayahs.translation: phir jab tum aur tumharay sathi kashti mein theek theek beth chuken , to kehna :  shukar hai Allah ka jiss ney hamen zalim logon  say nijat ata farmaee .

ayahs.text: aur kehna :  ya-Rab ! mujhay aisa utarna naseeb ker jo barkat wala ho , aur tu behtareen utaarney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur kehna :  ya-Rab ! mujhay aisa utarna naseeb ker jo barkat wala ho , aur tu behtareen utaarney wala hai .

ayahs.text: iss saray waqaey mein bari nishaniyan hain , aur yaqeeni baat hai kay hamen aazmaesh to kerni hi kerni thi .
ayahs.translation: iss saray waqaey mein bari nishaniyan hain , aur yaqeeni baat hai kay hamen aazmaesh to kerni hi kerni thi .

ayahs.text: phir unn kay baad hum ney doosri naslen peda ken ,
ayahs.translation: phir unn kay baad hum ney doosri naslen peda ken ,

ayahs.text: aur unn kay darmiyan unhi mein kay aik shaks ko Rasool bana ker bheja .   ( jiss ney kaha ) kay :  Allah ki ibadat kero , uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi hai . bhala kiya tum dartay nahi ho-?
ayahs.translation: aur unn kay darmiyan unhi mein kay aik shaks ko Rasool bana ker bheja .   ( jiss ney kaha ) kay :  Allah ki ibadat kero , uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi hai . bhala kiya tum dartay nahi ho-?

ayahs.text: unn ki qoam kay woh sardar jinhon ney kufr apna rakha tha , aur jinhon ney aakhirat ka samna kernay ko jhutlaya tha , aur jinn ko hum ney dunyawi zindagi mein khoob aesh dey rakha tha , unhon ney ( aik doosray say ) kaha :  iss shaks ki haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch nahi hai kay yeh tumhi jaisa aik insan hai . jo cheez tum khatay ho , yeh bhi khata hai , aur jo tum peetay ho , yeh bhi peeta hai .
ayahs.translation: unn ki qoam kay woh sardar jinhon ney kufr apna rakha tha , aur jinhon ney aakhirat ka samna kernay ko jhutlaya tha , aur jinn ko hum ney dunyawi zindagi mein khoob aesh dey rakha tha , unhon ney ( aik doosray say ) kaha :  iss shaks ki haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch nahi hai kay yeh tumhi jaisa aik insan hai . jo cheez tum khatay ho , yeh bhi khata hai , aur jo tum peetay ho , yeh bhi peeta hai .

ayahs.text: aur agar kahen tum ney apney hi jaisay aik insan ki farmanbardaari qubool kerli to tum baray hi ghatay ka soda kero gay .
ayahs.translation: aur agar kahen tum ney apney hi jaisay aik insan ki farmanbardaari qubool kerli to tum baray hi ghatay ka soda kero gay .

ayahs.text: bhala batao yeh shaks tumhen darata hai kay jab tum mar-jao gay , aur mitti aur haddiyon mein tabdeel hojao gay , to tumhen dobara zameen say nikala jaye ga-?
ayahs.translation: bhala batao yeh shaks tumhen darata hai kay jab tum mar-jao gay , aur mitti aur haddiyon mein tabdeel hojao gay , to tumhen dobara zameen say nikala jaye ga-?
