ayahs.translation: iss kay baad hum ney doosri naslen peda ken .

ayahs.text: koi ummat naa apney moyyan waqt say pehlay jasakti hai , naa uss kay baad thehar sakti hai .
ayahs.translation: koi ummat naa apney moyyan waqt say pehlay jasakti hai , naa uss kay baad thehar sakti hai .

ayahs.text: phir hum ney pey-dar-pay apney payghumber bhejay , jab bhi kissi qoam kay paas uss ka payghumber aata to woh ussay jhutlatay , chunacheh hum ney bhi aik kay baad aik ( ko halak kernay ) ka silsila baandh diya , aur unhen qissa kahaniyan bana daala . phitkaar hai unn logon  per jo emaan nahi latay !
ayahs.translation: phir hum ney pey-dar-pay apney payghumber bhejay , jab bhi kissi qoam kay paas uss ka payghumber aata to woh ussay jhutlatay , chunacheh hum ney bhi aik kay baad aik ( ko halak kernay ) ka silsila baandh diya , aur unhen qissa kahaniyan bana daala . phitkaar hai unn logon  per jo emaan nahi latay !

ayahs.text: phir hum ney musa aur unn kay bhai Haroon ko apni nishaniyon aur wazeh saboot kay sath
ayahs.translation: phir hum ney musa aur unn kay bhai Haroon ko apni nishaniyon aur wazeh saboot kay sath

ayahs.text: firon aur uss kay sardaron kay paas bheja to unhon ney ghamand ka muzahira kiya , aur woh baray takabbur walay log thay .
ayahs.translation: firon aur uss kay sardaron kay paas bheja to unhon ney ghamand ka muzahira kiya , aur woh baray takabbur walay log thay .

ayahs.text: chunacheh kehney lagay :  kiya hum apney jaisay do aadmiyon per emaan ley ayen , halankay unn ki qoam humari ghulami ker rahi hai ?
ayahs.translation: chunacheh kehney lagay :  kiya hum apney jaisay do aadmiyon per emaan ley ayen , halankay unn ki qoam humari ghulami ker rahi hai ?

ayahs.text: iss tarah unhon ney unn dono ko jhutlaya , aur aakhir kaar woh bhi unn logon  say jaa milay jinhen halak kiya gaya tha .
ayahs.translation: iss tarah unhon ney unn dono ko jhutlaya , aur aakhir kaar woh bhi unn logon  say jaa milay jinhen halak kiya gaya tha .

ayahs.text: aur musa ko hum ney kitab ata farmaee , takay unn kay log rehnumai hasil keren .
ayahs.translation: aur musa ko hum ney kitab ata farmaee , takay unn kay log rehnumai hasil keren .

ayahs.text: aur maryam kay betay ( essa aleh-assalam ) ko aur unn ki maa ko hum ney aik nishani banaya , aur unn dono ko aik aesi bulandi per panah di jo aik pursukoon jagah thi , aur jahan saaf suthra paani behta tha .
ayahs.translation: aur maryam kay betay ( essa aleh-assalam ) ko aur unn ki maa ko hum ney aik nishani banaya , aur unn dono ko aik aesi bulandi per panah di jo aik pursukoon jagah thi , aur jahan saaf suthra paani behta tha .

ayahs.text: aey payghumbero ! pakeezah cheezon mein say ( jo chahao ) khao aur naik amal kero . yaqeen rakho kay jo kuch tum kertay ho , mujhay uss ka poora poora ilm hai .
ayahs.translation: aey payghumbero ! pakeezah cheezon mein say ( jo chahao ) khao aur naik amal kero . yaqeen rakho kay jo kuch tum kertay ho , mujhay uss ka poora poora ilm hai .

ayahs.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay yehi tumhara deen hai , ( sabb kay liye ) aik hi deen ! aur mein tumhara perwerdigar hun , iss liye dil mein ( sirf ) mera roab rakho .
ayahs.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay yehi tumhara deen hai , ( sabb kay liye ) aik hi deen ! aur mein tumhara perwerdigar hun , iss liye dil mein ( sirf ) mera roab rakho .

ayahs.text: phir huwa yeh kay logon  ney apney deen mein baham phoot daal ker firqay bana liye . her giroh ney apney khayal mein jo tareeqa ikhtiyar kerliya hai , ussi per magan hai .
ayahs.translation: phir huwa yeh kay logon  ney apney deen mein baham phoot daal ker firqay bana liye . her giroh ney apney khayal mein jo tareeqa ikhtiyar kerliya hai , ussi per magan hai .

ayahs.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) inn ko aik khaas waqt tak apni jihalat mein dooba rehney do .
ayahs.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) inn ko aik khaas waqt tak apni jihalat mein dooba rehney do .

ayahs.text: kiya yeh log iss khayal mein hain kay hum inn ko jo dolat aur aulad diye jarahey hain ,
ayahs.translation: kiya yeh log iss khayal mein hain kay hum inn ko jo dolat aur aulad diye jarahey hain ,

ayahs.text: to unn ko bhalaiyan phonchaney mein jaldi dikha rahey hain-?   nahi , balkay inn ko haqeeqat ka shaoor nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: to unn ko bhalaiyan phonchaney mein jaldi dikha rahey hain-?   nahi , balkay inn ko haqeeqat ka shaoor nahi hai .

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log apney perwerdigar kay roab say daray rehtay hain ,
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log apney perwerdigar kay roab say daray rehtay hain ,

ayahs.text: aur jo apney perwerdigar ki aayaton per emaan latay hain ,
ayahs.translation: aur jo apney perwerdigar ki aayaton per emaan latay hain ,

ayahs.text: aur jo apney perwerdigar kay sath kissi ko shareek nahi mantay ,
ayahs.translation: aur jo apney perwerdigar kay sath kissi ko shareek nahi mantay ,

ayahs.text: aur woh jo amal bhi kertay hain , ussay kertay waqt unn kay dil iss baat say sehmay hotay hain kay unhen apney perwerdigar kay paas wapis jana hai ,
ayahs.translation: aur woh jo amal bhi kertay hain , ussay kertay waqt unn kay dil iss baat say sehmay hotay hain kay unhen apney perwerdigar kay paas wapis jana hai ,

ayahs.text: woh hain jo bhalaiyan hasil kernay mein jaldi dikha rahey hain , aur woh hain jo unn ki taraf tezi say aagay barh rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: woh hain jo bhalaiyan hasil kernay mein jaldi dikha rahey hain , aur woh hain jo unn ki taraf tezi say aagay barh rahey hain .

ayahs.text: aur hum kissi shaks ko uss ki taqat say ziyada kissi kaam ki zimma daari nahi detay , aur humaray paas aik kitab hai jo ( sabb ka haal ) theek theek bol dey gi , aur unn per koi zulm nahi hoga .
ayahs.translation: aur hum kissi shaks ko uss ki taqat say ziyada kissi kaam ki zimma daari nahi detay , aur humaray paas aik kitab hai jo ( sabb ka haal ) theek theek bol dey gi , aur unn per koi zulm nahi hoga .

ayahs.text: lekin unn kay dil iss baat say ghaflat mein doobay huye hain , aur iss kay ilawa unn ki aur bhi kaarastaniyan hain jo woh kertay rehtay hain .
ayahs.translation: lekin unn kay dil iss baat say ghaflat mein doobay huye hain , aur iss kay ilawa unn ki aur bhi kaarastaniyan hain jo woh kertay rehtay hain .

ayahs.text: yahan tak kay jab hum unn kay dolat mand logon  ko azab mein pakar len gay to woh aik dum bilbila uthen gay .
ayahs.translation: yahan tak kay jab hum unn kay dolat mand logon  ko azab mein pakar len gay to woh aik dum bilbila uthen gay .

ayahs.text: aaj bilbilao nahi , humari taraf say tumhen koi madad nahi milay gi .
ayahs.translation: aaj bilbilao nahi , humari taraf say tumhen koi madad nahi milay gi .

ayahs.text: meri aayaten tum ko parh ker sunai jati then , to tum ultay paon murr jatay thay ,
ayahs.translation: meri aayaten tum ko parh ker sunai jati then , to tum ultay paon murr jatay thay ,

ayahs.text: baray ghuroor say iss ( Quran ) kay baaray mein raat ko majlisen jama ker beyhooda baaten kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: baray ghuroor say iss ( Quran ) kay baaray mein raat ko majlisen jama ker beyhooda baaten kertay thay .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya inn logon  ney iss kalam per ghor nahi kiya , ya inn kay paas koi aesi cheez aagae hai jo inn kay pichlay baap dadon kay paas nahi aai thi ?
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya inn logon  ney iss kalam per ghor nahi kiya , ya inn kay paas koi aesi cheez aagae hai jo inn kay pichlay baap dadon kay paas nahi aai thi ?

ayahs.text: ya yeh apney payghumber ko ( pehlay say ) jantay hi nahi thay , iss wajeh say unn ka inkar ker rahey hain-?
ayahs.translation: ya yeh apney payghumber ko ( pehlay say ) jantay hi nahi thay , iss wajeh say unn ka inkar ker rahey hain-?

ayahs.text: ya unn ka kehna hai kay inn ( payghumber ) ko junoon laahaq hogaya hai ? nahi , balkay ( asal wajeh yeh hai kay ) yeh payghumber inn kay paas haq ley ker aaye hain , aur inn mein say aksar log haq ko pasand nahi kertay .
ayahs.translation: ya unn ka kehna hai kay inn ( payghumber ) ko junoon laahaq hogaya hai ? nahi , balkay ( asal wajeh yeh hai kay ) yeh payghumber inn kay paas haq ley ker aaye hain , aur inn mein say aksar log haq ko pasand nahi kertay .

ayahs.text: aur agar haq inn ki khuwaishaat kay tabey hojata to aasman aur zameen aur unn mein basney walay sabb barbad hojatay . nahi , balkay hum unn kay paas khud unn kay liye naseehat ka saman ley ker aaye hain , aur woh hain kay khud apni naseehat say mun morray huye hain .
ayahs.translation: aur agar haq inn ki khuwaishaat kay tabey hojata to aasman aur zameen aur unn mein basney walay sabb barbad hojatay . nahi , balkay hum unn kay paas khud unn kay liye naseehat ka saman ley ker aaye hain , aur woh hain kay khud apni naseehat say mun morray huye hain .

ayahs.text: ya ( inn kay inkar ki wajeh yeh hai kay ) tum inn say koi moawza maang rahey ho-? to ( yeh baat bhi ghalat hai , iss liye kay ) tumharay perwerdigar ka diya huwa moawza ( tumharay liye ) kahen behtar hai , aur woh behtareen rizq denay wala hai .
ayahs.translation: ya ( inn kay inkar ki wajeh yeh hai kay ) tum inn say koi moawza maang rahey ho-? to ( yeh baat bhi ghalat hai , iss liye kay ) tumharay perwerdigar ka diya huwa moawza ( tumharay liye ) kahen behtar hai , aur woh behtareen rizq denay wala hai .

ayahs.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum to unhen seedhay raastay ki taraf bula rahey ho ,
ayahs.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum to unhen seedhay raastay ki taraf bula rahey ho ,

ayahs.text: aur jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , woh raastay say bilkul hatay huye hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , woh raastay say bilkul hatay huye hain .

ayahs.text: aur agar hum inn per reham keren aur uss takleef ko door kerden jiss mein yeh mubtala hain tab bhi yeh bhataktay huye apni sarkashi per array rahen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur agar hum inn per reham keren aur uss takleef ko door kerden jiss mein yeh mubtala hain tab bhi yeh bhataktay huye apni sarkashi per array rahen gay .

ayahs.text: waqiaa yeh hai kay hum ney inn ko ( aik martaba ) azab mein pakra tha , to uss waqt bhi yeh log apney perwerdigar kay samney nahi jhukay . aur yeh to aajzi ki rawish ikhtiyar kertay hi nahi hain .
ayahs.translation: waqiaa yeh hai kay hum ney inn ko ( aik martaba ) azab mein pakra tha , to uss waqt bhi yeh log apney perwerdigar kay samney nahi jhukay . aur yeh to aajzi ki rawish ikhtiyar kertay hi nahi hain .

ayahs.text: yahan tak kay jab hum inn per sakht azab wala darwaza khol den gay , to yeh aik dum uss mein mayyus ho ker reh jayen gay .
ayahs.translation: yahan tak kay jab hum inn per sakht azab wala darwaza khol den gay , to yeh aik dum uss mein mayyus ho ker reh jayen gay .

ayahs.text: woh Allah hi to hai jiss ney tumharay liye kaan aur aankhen aur dil peda kiye . ( magar ) tum log boht kam shukar ada kertay ho .
ayahs.translation: woh Allah hi to hai jiss ney tumharay liye kaan aur aankhen aur dil peda kiye . ( magar ) tum log boht kam shukar ada kertay ho .

ayahs.text: aur wohi hai jiss ney tumhen zameen mein phelaya , aur ussi ki taraf tumhen ikattha ker kay ley jaya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: aur wohi hai jiss ney tumhen zameen mein phelaya , aur ussi ki taraf tumhen ikattha ker kay ley jaya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur wohi hai jo zindagi aur moat deta hai , aur ussi kay qabazay mein raat aur din ki tabeedilyan hain . kiya phir bhi tum aqal say kaam nahi letay-?
ayahs.translation: aur wohi hai jo zindagi aur moat deta hai , aur ussi kay qabazay mein raat aur din ki tabeedilyan hain . kiya phir bhi tum aqal say kaam nahi letay-?

ayahs.text: iss kay bajaye yeh log bhi wesi hi baaten kertay hain jaisi pichlay logon  ney ki then .
ayahs.translation: iss kay bajaye yeh log bhi wesi hi baaten kertay hain jaisi pichlay logon  ney ki then .

ayahs.text: kehtay hain kay :  kiya jab hum mar-jayen gay aur mitti aur haddiyon mein tabdeel hojayen gay , to kiya waqaee hamen dobara zinda ker kay uthaya jaye ga-?
ayahs.translation: kehtay hain kay :  kiya jab hum mar-jayen gay aur mitti aur haddiyon mein tabdeel hojayen gay , to kiya waqaee hamen dobara zinda ker kay uthaya jaye ga-?

ayahs.text: yeh woh yaqeen dahani hai jo hum say bhi ki gaee hai , aur iss say pehlay humaray baap dadon say bhi ki gaee thi . iss ki koi haqeeqat iss kay siwa nahi kay yeh pichlay logon  kay banaye huye afsaney hain .
ayahs.translation: yeh woh yaqeen dahani hai jo hum say bhi ki gaee hai , aur iss say pehlay humaray baap dadon say bhi ki gaee thi . iss ki koi haqeeqat iss kay siwa nahi kay yeh pichlay logon  kay banaye huye afsaney hain .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! zara inn say ) kaho kay :  yeh sari zameen aur iss mein basney walay kiss ki milkiyat hain-? batao agar jantay ho .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! zara inn say ) kaho kay :  yeh sari zameen aur iss mein basney walay kiss ki milkiyat hain-? batao agar jantay ho .

ayahs.text: woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay :  yeh sabb kuch Allah ka hai .    kaho kay :  kiya phir bhi tum sabaq nahi letay-?
ayahs.translation: woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay :  yeh sabb kuch Allah ka hai .    kaho kay :  kiya phir bhi tum sabaq nahi letay-?

ayahs.text: kaho kay :  saat aasmano ka malik aur aali shaan arsh ka malik kon hai ?
ayahs.translation: kaho kay :  saat aasmano ka malik aur aali shaan arsh ka malik kon hai ?

ayahs.text: woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay :  yeh sabb kuch Allah ka hai .  kaho kay :  kiya phir bhi tum Allah say nahi dartay-?
ayahs.translation: woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay :  yeh sabb kuch Allah ka hai .  kaho kay :  kiya phir bhi tum Allah say nahi dartay-?

ayahs.text: kaho kay :  kon hai jiss kay haath mein her cheez ka mukammal ikhtiyar hai , aur jo panah deta hai , aur uss kay muqablay mein koi kissi ko panah nahi dey sakta-? batao agar jantay ho .
ayahs.translation: kaho kay :  kon hai jiss kay haath mein her cheez ka mukammal ikhtiyar hai , aur jo panah deta hai , aur uss kay muqablay mein koi kissi ko panah nahi dey sakta-? batao agar jantay ho .

ayahs.text: woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay :  sara ikhtiyar Allah ka hai .  kaho kay :  phir kahan say tum per koi jadoo chal jata hai ?
ayahs.translation: woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay :  sara ikhtiyar Allah ka hai .  kaho kay :  phir kahan say tum per koi jadoo chal jata hai ?

ayahs.text: nahi ( yeh afsaney nahi ) balkay hum ney unhen haq baat phonchai hai , aur yeh log yaqeenan jhootay hain .
ayahs.translation: nahi ( yeh afsaney nahi ) balkay hum ney unhen haq baat phonchai hai , aur yeh log yaqeenan jhootay hain .

ayahs.text: naa to Allah ney koi beta banaya hai , aur naa uss kay sath koi aur khuda hai . agar aisa hota to her khuda apni makhlooq ko ley ker alag hojata , aur phir woh aik doosray per charrhai ker-detay .   pak hai Allah unn baaton say jo yeh log banatay hain ,
ayahs.translation: naa to Allah ney koi beta banaya hai , aur naa uss kay sath koi aur khuda hai . agar aisa hota to her khuda apni makhlooq ko ley ker alag hojata , aur phir woh aik doosray per charrhai ker-detay .   pak hai Allah unn baaton say jo yeh log banatay hain ,

ayahs.text: woh Allah jissay tamam chupi aur khuli baaton ka mukammal ilm hai . lehaza woh inn kay shirk say boht buland o baala hai .
ayahs.translation: woh Allah jissay tamam chupi aur khuli baaton ka mukammal ilm hai . lehaza woh inn kay shirk say boht buland o baala hai .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) dua kero kay :  meray perwerdigar ! jiss azab ki dhamki inn ( kafiron ) ko di jarahi hai , agar aap ussay meri aankhon kay samney ley ayen ,
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) dua kero kay :  meray perwerdigar ! jiss azab ki dhamki inn ( kafiron ) ko di jarahi hai , agar aap ussay meri aankhon kay samney ley ayen ,

ayahs.text: to aey meray perwerdigar ! mujhay inn zalim logon  kay sath shamil naa kijiye ga .
ayahs.translation: to aey meray perwerdigar ! mujhay inn zalim logon  kay sath shamil naa kijiye ga .

ayahs.text: aur yaqeen jano kay hum jiss cheez ki enhen dhamki dey rahey hain , ussay tumhari aankhon kay samney laney per poori tarah qadir hain .
ayahs.translation: aur yaqeen jano kay hum jiss cheez ki enhen dhamki dey rahey hain , ussay tumhari aankhon kay samney laney per poori tarah qadir hain .

ayahs.text: . ( lekin jab tak woh waqt naa aaye ) tum burai ka dafiya aesay tareeqay say kertay raho jo behtareen ho .   jo baaten yeh log banatay hain , hum khoob jantay hain .
ayahs.translation: . ( lekin jab tak woh waqt naa aaye ) tum burai ka dafiya aesay tareeqay say kertay raho jo behtareen ho .   jo baaten yeh log banatay hain , hum khoob jantay hain .

ayahs.text: aur dua kero kay :  meray perwerdigar ! mein shetan kay lagaye huye charkon say aap ki panah maangta hun ,
ayahs.translation: aur dua kero kay :  meray perwerdigar ! mein shetan kay lagaye huye charkon say aap ki panah maangta hun ,

ayahs.text: aur meray perwerdigar ! mein unn kay apney qareeb aaney say bhi aap ki panah maangta hun .
ayahs.translation: aur meray perwerdigar ! mein unn kay apney qareeb aaney say bhi aap ki panah maangta hun .

ayahs.text: yahan tak kay jab unn mein say kissi per moat aa-khari hogi to woh kahey ga kay :  meray perwerdigar ! mujhay wapis bhej dijiye ,
ayahs.translation: yahan tak kay jab unn mein say kissi per moat aa-khari hogi to woh kahey ga kay :  meray perwerdigar ! mujhay wapis bhej dijiye ,

ayahs.text: takay jiss duniya ko mein chorr aaya hun , uss mein jaker naik amal kerun .  hergiz nahi ! yeh to aik baat hi baat hai jo woh zaban say keh raha hai , aur inn ( marney walon ) kay samney aalam e barzakh ki aarr hai .   jo uss waqt tak qaeem rahey gi jab tak unn ko dobara zinda ker kay uthaya jaye .
ayahs.translation: takay jiss duniya ko mein chorr aaya hun , uss mein jaker naik amal kerun .  hergiz nahi ! yeh to aik baat hi baat hai jo woh zaban say keh raha hai , aur inn ( marney walon ) kay samney aalam e barzakh ki aarr hai .   jo uss waqt tak qaeem rahey gi jab tak unn ko dobara zinda ker kay uthaya jaye .

ayahs.text: phir jab soor phoonka jaye ga to uss din naa unn kay darmiyan rishtay natay baqi rahen gay , aur naa koi kissi ko poochay ga .
ayahs.translation: phir jab soor phoonka jaye ga to uss din naa unn kay darmiyan rishtay natay baqi rahen gay , aur naa koi kissi ko poochay ga .

ayahs.text: uss waqt jinn kay palray bhari niklay , to wohi hon gay jo falah payen gay ,
ayahs.translation: uss waqt jinn kay palray bhari niklay , to wohi hon gay jo falah payen gay ,

ayahs.text: aur jinn kay palray halkay parr-gaye , to yeh woh log hon gay jinhon ney apney liye ghatay ka soda kiya tha , woh dozakh mein hamesha hamesha rahen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn kay palray halkay parr-gaye , to yeh woh log hon gay jinhon ney apney liye ghatay ka soda kiya tha , woh dozakh mein hamesha hamesha rahen gay .

ayahs.text: aag unn kay chehron ko jhulas daalay gi , aur uss mein unn ki soorten bigar jayen gi .
ayahs.translation: aag unn kay chehron ko jhulas daalay gi , aur uss mein unn ki soorten bigar jayen gi .

ayahs.text: . ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  kiya meri aayaten tumhen parh ker sunai nahi jati then-? aur tum unn ko jhutlaya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: . ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  kiya meri aayaten tumhen parh ker sunai nahi jati then-? aur tum unn ko jhutlaya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: woh kahen gay :  humaray perwerdigar ! hum per humari bad-bakhti chah gaee thi , aur hum gumrah log thay .
ayahs.translation: woh kahen gay :  humaray perwerdigar ! hum per humari bad-bakhti chah gaee thi , aur hum gumrah log thay .

ayahs.text: humaray perwerdigar ! hamen yahan say bahir nikal dijiye , phir agar hum dobara wohi kaam keren to beyshak hum zalim hon gay .
ayahs.translation: humaray perwerdigar ! hamen yahan say bahir nikal dijiye , phir agar hum dobara wohi kaam keren to beyshak hum zalim hon gay .

ayahs.text: Allah farmaye ga :  issi ( dozakh ) mein zaleel ho ker parray raho , aur mujh say baat bhi naa kero .
ayahs.translation: Allah farmaye ga :  issi ( dozakh ) mein zaleel ho ker parray raho , aur mujh say baat bhi naa kero .

ayahs.text: meray bandon mein say aik jamat yeh dua kerti thi kay : aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum emaan ley aaye hain , pus hamen bakhsh dijiye , aur hum per reham farmaiye , aur aap sabb reham kernay walon say barh ker reham farmaney walay hain .
ayahs.translation: meray bandon mein say aik jamat yeh dua kerti thi kay : aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum emaan ley aaye hain , pus hamen bakhsh dijiye , aur hum per reham farmaiye , aur aap sabb reham kernay walon say barh ker reham farmaney walay hain .

ayahs.text: to tum ney unn logon  ka mazaq banaya tha . yahan tak kay unn hi ( kay sath cher-chaar ) ney tumhen meri yaad tak say ghafil kerdiya , aur tum unn ki hansi uratay rahey .
ayahs.translation: to tum ney unn logon  ka mazaq banaya tha . yahan tak kay unn hi ( kay sath cher-chaar ) ney tumhen meri yaad tak say ghafil kerdiya , aur tum unn ki hansi uratay rahey .

ayahs.text: unhon ney jiss tarah sabar say kaam liya tha , aaj mein ney unhen uss ka yeh badla diya hai kay unhon ney apni murad paali hai .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney jiss tarah sabar say kaam liya tha , aaj mein ney unhen uss ka yeh badla diya hai kay unhon ney apni murad paali hai .

ayahs.text: . ( phir ) Allah ( inn dozakhiyon say ) farmaye ga :  tum zameen mein ginti kay kitney saal rahey-?
ayahs.translation: . ( phir ) Allah ( inn dozakhiyon say ) farmaye ga :  tum zameen mein ginti kay kitney saal rahey-?

ayahs.text: woh kahen gay kay :  hum aik din ya aik din say bhi kam rahey hon gay .   ( hamen poori tarah yaad nahi ) iss liye jinhon ney ( waqt ki ) ginti ki ho , unn say pooch lijiye .
ayahs.translation: woh kahen gay kay :  hum aik din ya aik din say bhi kam rahey hon gay .   ( hamen poori tarah yaad nahi ) iss liye jinhon ney ( waqt ki ) ginti ki ho , unn say pooch lijiye .

ayahs.text: Allah farmaye ga :  tum thori mauddat say ziyada nahi rahey . kiya khoob hota agar yeh baat tum ney ( uss waqt ) samajh li hoti !
ayahs.translation: Allah farmaye ga :  tum thori mauddat say ziyada nahi rahey . kiya khoob hota agar yeh baat tum ney ( uss waqt ) samajh li hoti !

ayahs.text: bhala kiya tum yeh samjhay bethay thay kay hum ney tumhen yunhi bey maqsad peda kerdiya ,   aur tumhen wapis humaray paas nahi laya jaye ga-?
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya tum yeh samjhay bethay thay kay hum ney tumhen yunhi bey maqsad peda kerdiya ,   aur tumhen wapis humaray paas nahi laya jaye ga-?

ayahs.text: gharz boht oonchi shaan hai Allah ki jo sahih maani mein badshah hai ! uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi , woh izzat walay arsh ka malik hai .
ayahs.translation: gharz boht oonchi shaan hai Allah ki jo sahih maani mein badshah hai ! uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi , woh izzat walay arsh ka malik hai .

ayahs.text: aur jo shaks Allah kay sath kissi aur khuda ko pukaray , jiss per uss kay paas kissi qisam ki koi daleel nahi , to uss ka hisab uss kay perwerdigar kay paas hai . yaqeen jano kay kafir log falah nahi paaskatay .
ayahs.translation: aur jo shaks Allah kay sath kissi aur khuda ko pukaray , jiss per uss kay paas kissi qisam ki koi daleel nahi , to uss ka hisab uss kay perwerdigar kay paas hai . yaqeen jano kay kafir log falah nahi paaskatay .

ayahs.text: aur tum ( aey payghumber ) yeh kaho kay :  meray perwerdigar ! humari khatayen bakhsh dey , aur reham farmadey , tu saray reham kernay walon say barh ker reham kernay wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur tum ( aey payghumber ) yeh kaho kay :  meray perwerdigar ! humari khatayen bakhsh dey , aur reham farmadey , tu saray reham kernay walon say barh ker reham kernay wala hai .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: yeh aik surat hai jo hum ney nazil ki hai , aur jiss ( kay ehkaam ) ko hum ney farz kiya hai , aur iss mein khuli khuli aayaten nazil ki hain , takay tum naseehat hasil kero .
verses.translation: yeh aik surat hai jo hum ney nazil ki hai , aur jiss ( kay ehkaam ) ko hum ney farz kiya hai , aur iss mein khuli khuli aayaten nazil ki hain , takay tum naseehat hasil kero .

verses.text: zina kernay wali aurat aur zina kernay walay mard dono ko so so korray lagao ,   aur agar tum Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan rakhtay ho , to Allah kay deen kay moamlay mein unn per taras khaney ka koi jazbah tum per ghalib naa aaye . aur yeh bhi chahiye kay mominon ka aik majmaa unn ki saza ko khuli aankhon dekhay .
verses.translation: zina kernay wali aurat aur zina kernay walay mard dono ko so so korray lagao ,   aur agar tum Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan rakhtay ho , to Allah kay deen kay moamlay mein unn per taras khaney ka koi jazbah tum per ghalib naa aaye . aur yeh bhi chahiye kay mominon ka aik majmaa unn ki saza ko khuli aankhon dekhay .

verses.text: zaani mard nikah kerta hai to zina kaar ya mushrik aurat hi say nikah kerta hai , aur zina kaar aurat say nikah kerta hai to wohi mard jo khud zaani ho , ya mushrik ho ,   aur yeh baat mominon kay liye haram kerdi gaee hai .
verses.translation: zaani mard nikah kerta hai to zina kaar ya mushrik aurat hi say nikah kerta hai , aur zina kaar aurat say nikah kerta hai to wohi mard jo khud zaani ho , ya mushrik ho ,   aur yeh baat mominon kay liye haram kerdi gaee hai .

verses.text: aur jo log pak daman aurton per tohmat lagayen , phir chaar gawah ley ker naa ayen , to unn ko assi korray lagao ,   aur unn ki gawahi kabhi qubool naa kero ,   aur woh khud fasiq hain .
verses.translation: aur jo log pak daman aurton per tohmat lagayen , phir chaar gawah ley ker naa ayen , to unn ko assi korray lagao ,   aur unn ki gawahi kabhi qubool naa kero ,   aur woh khud fasiq hain .

verses.text: haan jo log iss kay baad tauba kerlen , aur ( apni ) islaah kerlen , to Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara reham kernay wala hai .
verses.translation: haan jo log iss kay baad tauba kerlen , aur ( apni ) islaah kerlen , to Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara reham kernay wala hai .

verses.text: aur jo log apni biwiyon per tohmat lagayen ,   aur khud apney siwa unn kay paas koi aur gawah naa hon to aesay kissi shaks ko jo gawahi deni hogi woh yeh hai kay woh chaar martaba Allah ki qasam kha ker yeh biyan dey kay woh ( biwi per lagaye huye ilzam mein ) yaqeenan sacha hai .
verses.translation: aur jo log apni biwiyon per tohmat lagayen ,   aur khud apney siwa unn kay paas koi aur gawah naa hon to aesay kissi shaks ko jo gawahi deni hogi woh yeh hai kay woh chaar martaba Allah ki qasam kha ker yeh biyan dey kay woh ( biwi per lagaye huye ilzam mein ) yaqeenan sacha hai .

verses.text: aur paanchwen martaba yeh kahey kay :  agar mein ( apney ilzam mein ) jhoota hun to mujh per Allah ki lanat ho .
verses.translation: aur paanchwen martaba yeh kahey kay :  agar mein ( apney ilzam mein ) jhoota hun to mujh per Allah ki lanat ho .

verses.text: aur aurat say ( zina ki ) saza door kernay ka raasta yeh hai kay woh chaar martaba Allah ki qasam kha ker yeh gawahi dey kay uss ka shohar ( iss ilzam mein ) jhoota hai .
verses.translation: aur aurat say ( zina ki ) saza door kernay ka raasta yeh hai kay woh chaar martaba Allah ki qasam kha ker yeh gawahi dey kay uss ka shohar ( iss ilzam mein ) jhoota hai .

verses.text: aur paanchwen martaba yeh kahey kay :  agar woh sacha ho to mujh per Allah ka ghazab nazil ho .
verses.translation: aur paanchwen martaba yeh kahey kay :  agar woh sacha ho to mujh per Allah ka ghazab nazil ho .

verses.text: aur agar tum per Allah ka fazal aur uss ki rehmat naa hoti aur yeh baat naa hoti kay Allah kasrat say tauba qubool kernay wala , hikmat wala hai ( to khud soch lo kay tumhara kiya banta-? ) .
verses.translation: aur agar tum per Allah ka fazal aur uss ki rehmat naa hoti aur yeh baat naa hoti kay Allah kasrat say tauba qubool kernay wala , hikmat wala hai ( to khud soch lo kay tumhara kiya banta-? ) .

verses.text: yaqeen jano kay jo log yeh jhooti tohmat gharr ker laye hain , woh tumharay andar hi ka aik tola hai .   tum iss baat ko apney liye bura naa samjho , balkay yeh tumharay liye behtar hi behtar hai .   inn logon  mein say her aik kay hissay mein apney kiye ka gunah aaya hai . aur inn mein say jiss shaks ney iss ( bohtan ) ka bara hissa apney sar liya hai , uss kay liye to zabardast azab hai .
verses.translation: yaqeen jano kay jo log yeh jhooti tohmat gharr ker laye hain , woh tumharay andar hi ka aik tola hai .   tum iss baat ko apney liye bura naa samjho , balkay yeh tumharay liye behtar hi behtar hai .   inn logon  mein say her aik kay hissay mein apney kiye ka gunah aaya hai . aur inn mein say jiss shaks ney iss ( bohtan ) ka bara hissa apney sar liya hai , uss kay liye to zabardast azab hai .

verses.text: jiss waqt tum logon  ney yeh baat suni thi to aisa kiyon naa huwa kay momin mard bhi aur momin aurten bhi apney baaray mein naik gumaan rakhtay aur keh detay kay yeh khullam khula jhoot hai-?
verses.translation: jiss waqt tum logon  ney yeh baat suni thi to aisa kiyon naa huwa kay momin mard bhi aur momin aurten bhi apney baaray mein naik gumaan rakhtay aur keh detay kay yeh khullam khula jhoot hai-?

verses.text: woh ( bohtan laganey walay ) iss baat per chaar gawah kiyon nahi ley aaye-? abb jabkay woh gawah nahi laye to Allah kay nazdeek wohi jhootay hain .
verses.translation: woh ( bohtan laganey walay ) iss baat per chaar gawah kiyon nahi ley aaye-? abb jabkay woh gawah nahi laye to Allah kay nazdeek wohi jhootay hain .

verses.text: aur agar tum per duniya aur aakhirat mein Allah ka fazal aur uss ki rehmat naa hoti to jinn baaton mein tum parr-gaye thay , unn ki wajeh say tum per uss waqt sakht azab aa-parta ,
verses.translation: aur agar tum per duniya aur aakhirat mein Allah ka fazal aur uss ki rehmat naa hoti to jinn baaton mein tum parr-gaye thay , unn ki wajeh say tum per uss waqt sakht azab aa-parta ,

verses.text: jab tum apni zabanon say iss baat ko aik doosray say naqal ker rahey thay ,   aur apney mun say woh baat keh rahey thay jiss ka tumhen koi ilm nahi tha , aur tum iss baat ko mamooli samajh rahey thay , halankay Allah kay nazdeek woh bari sangeen baat thi .
verses.translation: jab tum apni zabanon say iss baat ko aik doosray say naqal ker rahey thay ,   aur apney mun say woh baat keh rahey thay jiss ka tumhen koi ilm nahi tha , aur tum iss baat ko mamooli samajh rahey thay , halankay Allah kay nazdeek woh bari sangeen baat thi .

verses.text: aur jiss waqt tum ney yeh baat suni thi , ussi waqt tum ney yeh kiyon nahi kaha kay :  hamen koi haq nahi phonchta kay hum yeh baat mun say nikalen , ya Allah ! aap ki zaat her aeb say pak hai , yeh to bara zabardast bohtan hai .
verses.translation: aur jiss waqt tum ney yeh baat suni thi , ussi waqt tum ney yeh kiyon nahi kaha kay :  hamen koi haq nahi phonchta kay hum yeh baat mun say nikalen , ya Allah ! aap ki zaat her aeb say pak hai , yeh to bara zabardast bohtan hai .

verses.text: Allah tumhen naseehat kerta hai kay phir kabhi aisa naa kerna , agar waqaee tum momin ho .
verses.translation: Allah tumhen naseehat kerta hai kay phir kabhi aisa naa kerna , agar waqaee tum momin ho .

verses.text: aur Allah tumharay samney hidayat ki baaten saaf saaf biyan ker-raha hai . aur Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
verses.translation: aur Allah tumharay samney hidayat ki baaten saaf saaf biyan ker-raha hai . aur Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

verses.text: yaad rakho kay jo log yeh chahtay hain kay emaan walon mein bey hayai phelay , unn kay liye duniya aur aakhirat mein dardnak azab hai , aur Allah janta hai , aur tum nahi jantay .
verses.translation: yaad rakho kay jo log yeh chahtay hain kay emaan walon mein bey hayai phelay , unn kay liye duniya aur aakhirat mein dardnak azab hai , aur Allah janta hai , aur tum nahi jantay .

verses.text: aur agar yeh baat naa hoti kay Allah ka fazal aur uss ki rehmat tumharay shamil-e-haal hai , aur Allah bara shafiq , bara meharban hai ( to tum bhi naa bachtay )
verses.translation: aur agar yeh baat naa hoti kay Allah ka fazal aur uss ki rehmat tumharay shamil-e-haal hai , aur Allah bara shafiq , bara meharban hai ( to tum bhi naa bachtay )

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! tum shetan kay peechay naa chalo , aur agar koi shaks shetan kay peechay chalay , to shetan to hamesha bey hayai aur badi ki talqeen keray ga . aur agar tum per Allah ka fazal aur rehmat naa hoti to tum mein say koi bhi kabhi pak saaf naa hota , lekin Allah jiss ko chahta hai , pak saaf ker deta hai . aur Allah her baat sunta , her cheez janta hai .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! tum shetan kay peechay naa chalo , aur agar koi shaks shetan kay peechay chalay , to shetan to hamesha bey hayai aur badi ki talqeen keray ga . aur agar tum per Allah ka fazal aur rehmat naa hoti to tum mein say koi bhi kabhi pak saaf naa hota , lekin Allah jiss ko chahta hai , pak saaf ker deta hai . aur Allah her baat sunta , her cheez janta hai .

verses.text: aur tum mein say jo log ehal-e-khair hain aur maali wusat rakhtay hain , woh aesi qasam naa khayen kay woh rishta daaron , miskeeno aur Allah kay raastay mein hijrat kernay walon ko kuch nahi den gay ,   aur unhen chahiye kay moaafi aur darguzar say kaam len . kiya tumhen yeh pasand nahi hai kay Allah tumhari khatayen bakhsh dey-? aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: aur tum mein say jo log ehal-e-khair hain aur maali wusat rakhtay hain , woh aesi qasam naa khayen kay woh rishta daaron , miskeeno aur Allah kay raastay mein hijrat kernay walon ko kuch nahi den gay ,   aur unhen chahiye kay moaafi aur darguzar say kaam len . kiya tumhen yeh pasand nahi hai kay Allah tumhari khatayen bakhsh dey-? aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: yaad rakho kay jo log pak daman bholi bhaali musalman aurton per tohmat lagatay hain , unn per duniya aur aakhirat mein phitkaar parr-chuki hai , aur unn ko uss din zabardast azab hoga .
verses.translation: yaad rakho kay jo log pak daman bholi bhaali musalman aurton per tohmat lagatay hain , unn per duniya aur aakhirat mein phitkaar parr-chuki hai , aur unn ko uss din zabardast azab hoga .

verses.text: jiss din khud unn ki zabanen , unn kay haath aur unn kay paon unn kay khilaf uss kartoot ki gawahi den gay jo woh kertay rahey hain .
verses.translation: jiss din khud unn ki zabanen , unn kay haath aur unn kay paon unn kay khilaf uss kartoot ki gawahi den gay jo woh kertay rahey hain .

verses.text: uss din Allah unn ko woh badla poora poora deydey ga jiss kay woh mustahiq hain , aur unn ko pata chal jaye ga kay Allah hi haq hai , aur wohi sari baat khol denay wala hai .
verses.translation: uss din Allah unn ko woh badla poora poora deydey ga jiss kay woh mustahiq hain , aur unn ko pata chal jaye ga kay Allah hi haq hai , aur wohi sari baat khol denay wala hai .

verses.text: gandi aurten ganday mardon kay laeeq hain , aur ganday mard gandi aurton kay laeeq . aur pakbaaz aurten pakbaaz mardon kay laeeq hain , aur pakbaaz mard pakbaaz aurton kay laeeq .   yeh ( pakbaaz mard aur aurten ) unn baaton say bilkul mubarra hain jo yeh log bana rahey hain . unn ( pakbaazon ) kay hissay mein to maghfirat hai aur ba-izzat rizq .
verses.translation: gandi aurten ganday mardon kay laeeq hain , aur ganday mard gandi aurton kay laeeq . aur pakbaaz aurten pakbaaz mardon kay laeeq hain , aur pakbaaz mard pakbaaz aurton kay laeeq .   yeh ( pakbaaz mard aur aurten ) unn baaton say bilkul mubarra hain jo yeh log bana rahey hain . unn ( pakbaazon ) kay hissay mein to maghfirat hai aur ba-izzat rizq .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! apney gharon kay siwa doosray gharon mein uss waqt tak dakhil naa ho jab tak ijazat naa ley lo , aur unn mein basney walon ko salam naa kerlo .   yehi tareeqa tumharay liye behtar hai , umeed hai kay tum khayal rakho gay .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! apney gharon kay siwa doosray gharon mein uss waqt tak dakhil naa ho jab tak ijazat naa ley lo , aur unn mein basney walon ko salam naa kerlo .   yehi tareeqa tumharay liye behtar hai , umeed hai kay tum khayal rakho gay .

verses.text: aur agar tum unn gharon mein kissi ko naa pao tab bhi unn mein uss waqt tak dakhil naa ho jab tak tumhen ijazat naa dey di jaye .   aur agar tum say kaha jaye kay :  wapis chalay jao  to wapis chalay jao . yehi tumharay liye pakeezah tareen tareeqa hai , aur tum jo amal bhi kertay ho , Allah ko uss ka poora poora ilm hai .
verses.translation: aur agar tum unn gharon mein kissi ko naa pao tab bhi unn mein uss waqt tak dakhil naa ho jab tak tumhen ijazat naa dey di jaye .   aur agar tum say kaha jaye kay :  wapis chalay jao  to wapis chalay jao . yehi tumharay liye pakeezah tareen tareeqa hai , aur tum jo amal bhi kertay ho , Allah ko uss ka poora poora ilm hai .

verses.text: tumharay liye iss mein koi gunah nahi hai kay tum aesay gharon mein ( ijazat liye baghair ) dakhil ho jinn mein koi rehta naa ho , aur unn say tumhen faeeda uthaney ka haq ho .   aur tum jo kaam aelania kertay ho , aur jo chup ker kertay ho , Allah unn sabb ko janta hai .
verses.translation: tumharay liye iss mein koi gunah nahi hai kay tum aesay gharon mein ( ijazat liye baghair ) dakhil ho jinn mein koi rehta naa ho , aur unn say tumhen faeeda uthaney ka haq ho .   aur tum jo kaam aelania kertay ho , aur jo chup ker kertay ho , Allah unn sabb ko janta hai .

verses.text: momin mardon say keh do kay woh apni nigahen neechi rakhen , aur apni sharmgahon ki hifazat keren . yehi unn kay liye pakeezah tareen tareeqa hai . woh jo kaarwaiyan kertay hain , Allah unn sabb say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: momin mardon say keh do kay woh apni nigahen neechi rakhen , aur apni sharmgahon ki hifazat keren . yehi unn kay liye pakeezah tareen tareeqa hai . woh jo kaarwaiyan kertay hain , Allah unn sabb say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: aur momin aurton say keh do kay woh apni nigahen neechi rakhen , aur apni sharmgahon ki hifazat keren , aur apni sajawat ko kissi per zahir naa keren , siwaye uss kay jo khud hi zahir hojaye ,   aur apni oarhniyon kay aanchal apney giraybanon per daal liya keren , aur apni sajawat aur kissi per zahir naa keren ,   siwaye apney shohron kay , ya apney baap , ya apney shohron kay baap kay , ya apney beton ya apney shohron kay beton kay , ya apney bhaiyon ya apney bhaiyon kay beton , ya apni behnon kay beton kay , ya apni aurton kay ,   ya unn kay jo apney haathon ki milkiyat mein hain ,   ya unn khidmat guzaron kay jinn kay dil mein koi ( jinsi ) taqaza nahi hota ,   ya unn bacchon kay jo abhi aurton kay chupay huye hisson say aashna nahi huye .   aur musalman aurton ko chahiye kay woh apney paon zameen per iss tarah naa maaren kay unhon ney jo zeenat chupa rakhi hai woh maloom hojaye .   aur aey momino ! tum sabb Allah kay samney tauba kero , takay tumhen falah naseeb ho .
verses.translation: aur momin aurton say keh do kay woh apni nigahen neechi rakhen , aur apni sharmgahon ki hifazat keren , aur apni sajawat ko kissi per zahir naa keren , siwaye uss kay jo khud hi zahir hojaye ,   aur apni oarhniyon kay aanchal apney giraybanon per daal liya keren , aur apni sajawat aur kissi per zahir naa keren ,   siwaye apney shohron kay , ya apney baap , ya apney shohron kay baap kay , ya apney beton ya apney shohron kay beton kay , ya apney bhaiyon ya apney bhaiyon kay beton , ya apni behnon kay beton kay , ya apni aurton kay ,   ya unn kay jo apney haathon ki milkiyat mein hain ,   ya unn khidmat guzaron kay jinn kay dil mein koi ( jinsi ) taqaza nahi hota ,   ya unn bacchon kay jo abhi aurton kay chupay huye hisson say aashna nahi huye .   aur musalman aurton ko chahiye kay woh apney paon zameen per iss tarah naa maaren kay unhon ney jo zeenat chupa rakhi hai woh maloom hojaye .   aur aey momino ! tum sabb Allah kay samney tauba kero , takay tumhen falah naseeb ho .

verses.text: tum mein say jinn ( mardon ya aurton ) ka uss waqt nikah naa ho , unn ka bhi nikah kerao , aur tumharay ghulamon aur baandiyon mein say jo nikah kay qabil hon , unn ka bhi . agar woh tang dast hon to Allah apney fazal say unhen bey niaz kerday ga .   aur Allah boht wusat wala hai , sabb kuch janta hai .
verses.translation: tum mein say jinn ( mardon ya aurton ) ka uss waqt nikah naa ho , unn ka bhi nikah kerao , aur tumharay ghulamon aur baandiyon mein say jo nikah kay qabil hon , unn ka bhi . agar woh tang dast hon to Allah apney fazal say unhen bey niaz kerday ga .   aur Allah boht wusat wala hai , sabb kuch janta hai .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ko nikah kay mawaqeh moyassar naa hon , woh pak damani kay sath rahen , yahan tak kay Allah apney fazal say unhen bey niaz kerday . aur tumhari milkiyat kay ghulam baandiyon mein say jo makatibat ka moahida kerna chahen , agar unn mein bhalai dekho to unn say makatibat ka moahida kerliya kero ,   aur ( musalmano ! ) Allah ney tumhen jo maal dey rakha hai , uss mein say aesay ghulam baandiyon ko bhi diya kero , aur apni baandiyon ko dunyawi zindagi ka saz-o-saman hasil kernay kay liye bad-kaari per majboor naa kero jabkay woh pak damani chahti hon .   aur jo koi unhen majboor keray ga to unn ko majboor kernay kay baad Allah ( unn baandiyon ko ) boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ko nikah kay mawaqeh moyassar naa hon , woh pak damani kay sath rahen , yahan tak kay Allah apney fazal say unhen bey niaz kerday . aur tumhari milkiyat kay ghulam baandiyon mein say jo makatibat ka moahida kerna chahen , agar unn mein bhalai dekho to unn say makatibat ka moahida kerliya kero ,   aur ( musalmano ! ) Allah ney tumhen jo maal dey rakha hai , uss mein say aesay ghulam baandiyon ko bhi diya kero , aur apni baandiyon ko dunyawi zindagi ka saz-o-saman hasil kernay kay liye bad-kaari per majboor naa kero jabkay woh pak damani chahti hon .   aur jo koi unhen majboor keray ga to unn ko majboor kernay kay baad Allah ( unn baandiyon ko ) boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: aur hum ney woh aayaten bhi utaar ker tum tak phoncha di hain jo her baat ko wazeh kernay wali hain , aur unn logon  ki misalen bhi jo tum say pehlay guzar chukay hain , aur woh naseehat bhi jo Allah say darney walon kay liye kaar-aamad hai .
verses.translation: aur hum ney woh aayaten bhi utaar ker tum tak phoncha di hain jo her baat ko wazeh kernay wali hain , aur unn logon  ki misalen bhi jo tum say pehlay guzar chukay hain , aur woh naseehat bhi jo Allah say darney walon kay liye kaar-aamad hai .

verses.text: Allah tamam aasmano aur zameen ka noor hai .   uss kay noor ki misal kuch yun hai jaisay aik taaq ho jiss mein chiragh rakha ho ,   chiragh aik sheeshay mein ho , sheesha aisa ho jaisay aik sitara , moti ki tarah chamakta huwa ! woh chiragh aesay barkat walay darkht yani zaitoon say roshan kiya jaye jo naa ( sirf ) mashriqi ho naa ( sirf ) maghribi ,   aisa lagta ho kay uss ka tel khud hi roshni deydey ga , chahye ussay aag bhi naa lagay .   noor balaye noor ! Allah apney noor tak jissay chahta hai , phoncha deta hai , aur Allah logon  kay faeeday kay liye tamseelen biyan kerta hai , aur Allah her cheez ko khoob janney wala hai .
verses.translation: Allah tamam aasmano aur zameen ka noor hai .   uss kay noor ki misal kuch yun hai jaisay aik taaq ho jiss mein chiragh rakha ho ,   chiragh aik sheeshay mein ho , sheesha aisa ho jaisay aik sitara , moti ki tarah chamakta huwa ! woh chiragh aesay barkat walay darkht yani zaitoon say roshan kiya jaye jo naa ( sirf ) mashriqi ho naa ( sirf ) maghribi ,   aisa lagta ho kay uss ka tel khud hi roshni deydey ga , chahye ussay aag bhi naa lagay .   noor balaye noor ! Allah apney noor tak jissay chahta hai , phoncha deta hai , aur Allah logon  kay faeeday kay liye tamseelen biyan kerta hai , aur Allah her cheez ko khoob janney wala hai .

verses.text: jinn gharon kay baaray mein Allah ney yeh hukum diya hai kay unn ko buland maqam diya jaye , aur unn mein uss ka naam ley ker ziker kiya jaye , unn mein subha o shaam woh log uski tasbeeh kertay hain
verses.translation: jinn gharon kay baaray mein Allah ney yeh hukum diya hai kay unn ko buland maqam diya jaye , aur unn mein uss ka naam ley ker ziker kiya jaye , unn mein subha o shaam woh log uski tasbeeh kertay hain

verses.text: jinhen koi tijarat ya koi kharid-o-farokht naa Allah ki yaad say ghafil kerti hai naa namaz qaeem kernay say aur naa zakat denay say .   woh uss din say dartay rehtay hain jiss mein dil aur nigahen ulat palat ker reh jayen gi .
verses.translation: jinhen koi tijarat ya koi kharid-o-farokht naa Allah ki yaad say ghafil kerti hai naa namaz qaeem kernay say aur naa zakat denay say .   woh uss din say dartay rehtay hain jiss mein dil aur nigahen ulat palat ker reh jayen gi .

verses.text: nateeja yeh hai kay Allah inn logon  ko inn kay aemal ka behtareen badla dey ga , aur apney fazal say mazeed kuch aur bhi dey ga ,   aur Allah jiss ko chahta hai , bey hisab deta hai .
verses.translation: nateeja yeh hai kay Allah inn logon  ko inn kay aemal ka behtareen badla dey ga , aur apney fazal say mazeed kuch aur bhi dey ga ,   aur Allah jiss ko chahta hai , bey hisab deta hai .

verses.text: aur ( doosri taraf ) jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay aemal ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik chatiyal sehra mein aik sarab ho jissay piyasa aadmi paani samajh bethta hai, yahan tak kay jab uss kay paas phonchta hai to maloom hota hai kay woh kuch bhi nahi tha ,   aur uss kay paas Allah ko pata hai , chunacheh Allah uss ka poora poora hisab chuka deta hai .   aur Allah boht jaldi hisab ley leta hai .
verses.translation: aur ( doosri taraf ) jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay aemal ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik chatiyal sehra mein aik sarab ho jissay piyasa aadmi paani samajh bethta hai, yahan tak kay jab uss kay paas phonchta hai to maloom hota hai kay woh kuch bhi nahi tha ,   aur uss kay paas Allah ko pata hai , chunacheh Allah uss ka poora poora hisab chuka deta hai .   aur Allah boht jaldi hisab ley leta hai .

verses.text: ya phir unn ( aemal ) ki misal aesi hai jaisay kissi gehray samandar mein phelay huye andheray , kay samandar ko aik moaj ney dhaanp rakha ho , jiss kay oopper aik aur moaj ho , aur uss kay oopper badal , gharz oopper talay andheray hi andheray ! agar koi apna hath bahir nikalay to ussay bhi naa dekh paye .   aur jiss shaks ko Allah hi noor ata naa keray , uss kay naseeb mein koi noor nahi .
verses.translation: ya phir unn ( aemal ) ki misal aesi hai jaisay kissi gehray samandar mein phelay huye andheray , kay samandar ko aik moaj ney dhaanp rakha ho , jiss kay oopper aik aur moaj ho , aur uss kay oopper badal , gharz oopper talay andheray hi andheray ! agar koi apna hath bahir nikalay to ussay bhi naa dekh paye .   aur jiss shaks ko Allah hi noor ata naa keray , uss kay naseeb mein koi noor nahi .

verses.text: kiya tum ney dekha nahi kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo bhi , hain Allah hi ki tasbeeh kertay hain , aur woh perinday bhi jo per phelaye huye urtay hain . her aik ko apni namaz aur apni tasbeeh ka tareeqa maloom hai .   aur Allah unn kay saray kamon say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: kiya tum ney dekha nahi kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo bhi , hain Allah hi ki tasbeeh kertay hain , aur woh perinday bhi jo per phelaye huye urtay hain . her aik ko apni namaz aur apni tasbeeh ka tareeqa maloom hai .   aur Allah unn kay saray kamon say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: aur aasmano aur zameen ki badshahi Allah hi kay liye hai , aur Allah hi ki taraf ( sabb ko ) loat ker jana hai .
verses.translation: aur aasmano aur zameen ki badshahi Allah hi kay liye hai , aur Allah hi ki taraf ( sabb ko ) loat ker jana hai .

verses.text: kiya tum ney dekha nahi kay Allah badalon ko hankata hai , phir unn ko aik doosray say jorr deta hai , phir unhen teh bar teh ghata mein tabdeel ker deta hai , phir tum dekhtay ho kay barish uss kay darmiyan say baras rahi hai . aur aasman mein ( badalon ki shakal mein ) jo pahar kay pahar hotay hain , Allah unn say olay barsata hai , phir jiss kay liye chahta hai , unn ko museebat bana deta hai , aur jiss say chahta hai , unn ka rukh pher deta hai . aisa lagta hai kay uss ki bijli ki chamak aankhon ki beenai uchak ley jaye gi .
verses.translation: kiya tum ney dekha nahi kay Allah badalon ko hankata hai , phir unn ko aik doosray say jorr deta hai , phir unhen teh bar teh ghata mein tabdeel ker deta hai , phir tum dekhtay ho kay barish uss kay darmiyan say baras rahi hai . aur aasman mein ( badalon ki shakal mein ) jo pahar kay pahar hotay hain , Allah unn say olay barsata hai , phir jiss kay liye chahta hai , unn ko museebat bana deta hai , aur jiss say chahta hai , unn ka rukh pher deta hai . aisa lagta hai kay uss ki bijli ki chamak aankhon ki beenai uchak ley jaye gi .

verses.text: wohi Allah raat aur din ka ulat pher kerta hai . yaqeenan inn sabb baaton mein unn logon  kay liye naseehat ka saman hai jinn kay paas dekhney wali aankhen hain .
verses.translation: wohi Allah raat aur din ka ulat pher kerta hai . yaqeenan inn sabb baaton mein unn logon  kay liye naseehat ka saman hai jinn kay paas dekhney wali aankhen hain .

verses.text: aur Allah ney zameen per chalney walay her jandaar ko paani say peda kiya hai . phir unn mein say kuch woh hain jo apney pet kay ball chaltay hain , kuch woh hain jo do paon per chaltay hain , aur kuch woh hain jo chaar ( paon ) per chaltay hain . Allah jo chahta hai peda kerta hai . yaqeenan Allah her baat per qudrat rakhta hai .
verses.translation: aur Allah ney zameen per chalney walay her jandaar ko paani say peda kiya hai . phir unn mein say kuch woh hain jo apney pet kay ball chaltay hain , kuch woh hain jo do paon per chaltay hain , aur kuch woh hain jo chaar ( paon ) per chaltay hain . Allah jo chahta hai peda kerta hai . yaqeenan Allah her baat per qudrat rakhta hai .

verses.text: beyshak hum ney woh aayaten nazil ki hain jo haqeeqat ko khol khol ker biyan kernay wali hain , aur Allah jiss ko chahta hai , seedhay raastay tak phoncha deta hai .
verses.translation: beyshak hum ney woh aayaten nazil ki hain jo haqeeqat ko khol khol ker biyan kernay wali hain , aur Allah jiss ko chahta hai , seedhay raastay tak phoncha deta hai .

verses.text: aur yeh ( munafiq ) log kehtay hain kay hum Allah per aur Rasool per emaan ley aaye hain aur hum farmanbardaar hogaye hain , phir inn mein say aik giroh uss kay baad bhi mun morr leta hai . yeh log ( haqeeqat mein ) momin nahi hain .
verses.translation: aur yeh ( munafiq ) log kehtay hain kay hum Allah per aur Rasool per emaan ley aaye hain aur hum farmanbardaar hogaye hain , phir inn mein say aik giroh uss kay baad bhi mun morr leta hai . yeh log ( haqeeqat mein ) momin nahi hain .

verses.text: aur jab unhen Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki taraf bulaya jata hai takay Rasool unn kay darmiyan faisla keren to unn mein say kuch log aik dum rukh pher letay hain .
verses.translation: aur jab unhen Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki taraf bulaya jata hai takay Rasool unn kay darmiyan faisla keren to unn mein say kuch log aik dum rukh pher letay hain .

verses.text: aur agar khud unhen haq wasool kerna ho to woh baray farmanbardaar ban ker Rasool kay paas chalay aatay hain .
verses.translation: aur agar khud unhen haq wasool kerna ho to woh baray farmanbardaar ban ker Rasool kay paas chalay aatay hain .

verses.text: kiya inn kay dilon mein koi rog hai , ya yeh shak mein parray huye hain , ya enhen yeh andesha hai kay Allah aur uss ka Rasool unn per zulm dahaye ga-? nahi , balkay zulm dhaaney walay to khud yeh log hain .
verses.translation: kiya inn kay dilon mein koi rog hai , ya yeh shak mein parray huye hain , ya enhen yeh andesha hai kay Allah aur uss ka Rasool unn per zulm dahaye ga-? nahi , balkay zulm dhaaney walay to khud yeh log hain .

verses.text: mominon ki baat to yeh hoti hai kay jab unhen Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki taraf bulaya jata hai takay Rasool unn kay darmiyan faisla keren to woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  hum ney ( hukum ) sunn liya , aur maan liya  aur aesay hi log hain jo falah paaney walay hain .
verses.translation: mominon ki baat to yeh hoti hai kay jab unhen Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki taraf bulaya jata hai takay Rasool unn kay darmiyan faisla keren to woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  hum ney ( hukum ) sunn liya , aur maan liya  aur aesay hi log hain jo falah paaney walay hain .

verses.text: aur jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki farmanbardaari keren , Allah say daren , aur uss ki nafarmani say bachen , to wohi log kamiyab hain .
verses.translation: aur jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki farmanbardaari keren , Allah say daren , aur uss ki nafarmani say bachen , to wohi log kamiyab hain .

verses.text: aur yeh ( munafiq log ) baray zoron say Allah ki qasmen khatay hain kay agar ( aey payghumber ! ) tum unhen hukum do gay to yeh nikal kharray hon gay . ( unn say ) kaho kay :  qasmen naa khao . ( tumhari ) farmanbardaari ka sabb ko pata hai .   yaqeen jano kay tum jo kuch kertay ho Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: aur yeh ( munafiq log ) baray zoron say Allah ki qasmen khatay hain kay agar ( aey payghumber ! ) tum unhen hukum do gay to yeh nikal kharray hon gay . ( unn say ) kaho kay :  qasmen naa khao . ( tumhari ) farmanbardaari ka sabb ko pata hai .   yaqeen jano kay tum jo kuch kertay ho Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: . ( unn say ) kaho kay :  Allah ka hukum maano , aur Rasool kay farmanbardaar bano , phir bhi agar tum ney mun pheray rakha to Rasool per to itna hi bojh hai jiss ki zimma daari unn per daali gaee hai , aur jo bojh tum per daala gaya hai , uss kay zimma daar tum khud ho . agar tum unn ki farmanbardaari kero gay to hidayat paajao gay , aur Rasool ka farz iss say ziyada nahi hai kay woh saaf saaf baat phoncha den .

verses.text: tum mein say jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn say Allah ney wada kiya hai kay woh unhen zaroor zameen mein apna khalifa banaye ga , jiss tarah unn say pehlay logon  ko banaya tha , aur unn kay liye uss deen ko zaroor iqtidar bakhshay ga jissay unn kay liye pasand kiya hai , aur unn ko jo khof laahaq raha hai , uss kay badlay unhen zaroor aman ata keray ga . ( bus ) woh meri ibadat keren , meray sath kissi cheez ko shareek naa thehrayen . aur jo log iss kay baad bhi nashukri keren gay to aesay log nafarman hon gay .

verses.translation: aur namaz qaeem kero , aur zakat ada kero , aur Rasool ki farmanbardaari kero , takay tumharay sath rehmat ka bartao kiya jaye .

verses.text: yeh hergiz naa samajhna kay jinn logon  ney kufr ka raasta apna liya hai , woh zameen mein ( kahen bhag ker hamen ) bey bus kerden gay . unn ka thikana dozakh hai , aur yaqeenan woh boht hi bura thikana hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! jo ghulam londiyan tumhari milkiyat mein hain , aur tum mein say jo bacchay abhi buloog tak nahi phonchay , unn ko chahiye kay woh teen oqaat mein ( tumharay paas aaney kay liye ) tum say ijazat liya keren . namaz-e-fajar say pehlay , aur jab tum dophare kay waqt apney kapray utaar ker rakha kertay ho , aur namaz-e-esha kay baad .   yeh teen waqt tumharay perday kay oqaat hain . inn oqaat kay ilawa naa tum per koi tangi hai , naa unn per . unn ka bhi tumharay paas aana jana laga rehta hai , tumhara bhi aik doosray kay paas . Allah issi tarah aayaton ko tumharay samney khol khol ker biyan kerta hai , aur Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

verses.text: aur jab tumharay bacchay buloog ko phonch jayen , to woh bhi ussi tarah ijazat liya keren jaisay unn say pehlay baligh honey walay ijazat letay rahey hain . Allah issi tarah apni aayaten khol khol ker tumharay samney biyan kerta hai , aur Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

Allah issi tarah apni aayaten khol khol ker tumharay samney biyan kerta hai , aur Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

verses.text: aur jinn bari boorhi aurton ko nikah ki koi tawaqqo naa rahi ho , unn kay liye iss mein koi gunah nahi hai kay woh apney ( zaeed ) kapray , ( maslan chadaren , na-mehramon kay samney ) utaar ker rakh den , ba-shartey-kay zeenat ki numaish naa keren ,   aur agar woh ehtiyat hi rakhen to unn kay liye aur ziyada behtar hai . aur Allah sabb kuch sunta , her baat janta hai .

verses.text: naa kissi na-beena kay liye iss mein koi gunah hai , naa kissi paon say maazoor shaks kay liye koi gunah hai , naa kissi beemar shaks kay liye koi gunah hai , aur naa khud tumharay liye kay tum apney gharon say kuch khalo ,   ya apney baap dada kay gharon say , ya apni maon kay gharon say , ya apney bhaiyon kay gharon say ,   ya apni behnon kay gharon say , ya apney chachaon kay gharon say , ya apni phoopiyon kay gharon say , ya apney mamooan kay gharon say , ya apni khalaon kay gharon say , ya unn gharon say jinn ki chabiyan tumharay ikhtiyar mein hon .   ya apney doston kay gharon say . iss mein bhi tumharay liye koi gunah nahi hai kay sabb milker khao , ya alag alag . chunacheh jab tum gharon mein dakhil ho to apney logon  ko salam kiya kero , kay yeh mulaqat ki woh ba-barkat pakeezah dua hai jo Allah ki taraf say aai hai . Allah issi tarah aayaton ko tumharay samney khol khol ker biyan kerta hai , takay tum samajh jao .
