Allah issi tarah aayaton ko tumharay samney khol khol ker biyan kerta hai , takay tum samajh jao .

verses.text: momin to woh log hain jo Allah aur uss kay Rasool ko dil say mantay hain , aur jab Rasool kay sath kissi ijtimaee kaam mein shareek hotay hain to unn say ijazat liye baghair kahen nahi jatay .   ( aey payghumber ! ) jo log tum say ijazat letay hain , yehi woh log hain jo Allah aur uss kay Rasool ko dil say mantay hain . chunacheh jab woh apney kissi kaam kay liye tum say ijazat maangen to unn mein say jinn ko chahao , ijazat dey diya kero , aur unn kay liye Allah say maghfirat ki dua kiya kero . yaqeenan Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: momin to woh log hain jo Allah aur uss kay Rasool ko dil say mantay hain , aur jab Rasool kay sath kissi ijtimaee kaam mein shareek hotay hain to unn say ijazat liye baghair kahen nahi jatay .   ( aey payghumber ! ) jo log tum say ijazat letay hain , yehi woh log hain jo Allah aur uss kay Rasool ko dil say mantay hain . chunacheh jab woh apney kissi kaam kay liye tum say ijazat maangen to unn mein say jinn ko chahao , ijazat dey diya kero , aur unn kay liye Allah say maghfirat ki dua kiya kero . yaqeenan Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: . ( aey logo ! ) apney darmiyan Rasool kay bulaney ko aisa ( mamooli ) naa samjho jaisay tum aapas mein aik doosray ko bula liya kertay ho .   Allah tum mein say unn logon  ko khoob janta hai jo aik doosray ki aarr ley ker chupkay say khisak jatay hain . lehaza jo log uss kay hukum ki khilaf warzi kertay hain , unn ko iss baat say darna chahiye kay kahen unn per koi aafat naa aa-parey , ya unhen koi dardnak azab naa aa-pakray .
verses.translation: . ( aey logo ! ) apney darmiyan Rasool kay bulaney ko aisa ( mamooli ) naa samjho jaisay tum aapas mein aik doosray ko bula liya kertay ho .   Allah tum mein say unn logon  ko khoob janta hai jo aik doosray ki aarr ley ker chupkay say khisak jatay hain . lehaza jo log uss kay hukum ki khilaf warzi kertay hain , unn ko iss baat say darna chahiye kay kahen unn per koi aafat naa aa-parey , ya unhen koi dardnak azab naa aa-pakray .

verses.text: yaad rakho kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai Allah hi ka hai . tum jiss halat per bhi ho , Allah ussay khoob janta hai , aur jiss din sabb ko uss kay paas lotaya jaye ga , uss din woh unn ko batadey ga kay unhon ney kiya amal kiya tha , aur Allah ko her baat ka poora poora ilm hai .
verses.translation: yaad rakho kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai Allah hi ka hai . tum jiss halat per bhi ho , Allah ussay khoob janta hai , aur jiss din sabb ko uss kay paas lotaya jaye ga , uss din woh unn ko batadey ga kay unhon ney kiya amal kiya tha , aur Allah ko her baat ka poora poora ilm hai .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: yeh aik surat hai jo hum ney nazil ki hai , aur jiss ( kay ehkaam ) ko hum ney farz kiya hai , aur iss mein khuli khuli aayaten nazil ki hain , takay tum naseehat hasil kero .
ayahs.translation: yeh aik surat hai jo hum ney nazil ki hai , aur jiss ( kay ehkaam ) ko hum ney farz kiya hai , aur iss mein khuli khuli aayaten nazil ki hain , takay tum naseehat hasil kero .

ayahs.text: zina kernay wali aurat aur zina kernay walay mard dono ko so so korray lagao ,   aur agar tum Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan rakhtay ho , to Allah kay deen kay moamlay mein unn per taras khaney ka koi jazbah tum per ghalib naa aaye . aur yeh bhi chahiye kay mominon ka aik majmaa unn ki saza ko khuli aankhon dekhay .
ayahs.translation: zina kernay wali aurat aur zina kernay walay mard dono ko so so korray lagao ,   aur agar tum Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan rakhtay ho , to Allah kay deen kay moamlay mein unn per taras khaney ka koi jazbah tum per ghalib naa aaye . aur yeh bhi chahiye kay mominon ka aik majmaa unn ki saza ko khuli aankhon dekhay .

ayahs.text: zaani mard nikah kerta hai to zina kaar ya mushrik aurat hi say nikah kerta hai , aur zina kaar aurat say nikah kerta hai to wohi mard jo khud zaani ho , ya mushrik ho ,   aur yeh baat mominon kay liye haram kerdi gaee hai .
ayahs.translation: zaani mard nikah kerta hai to zina kaar ya mushrik aurat hi say nikah kerta hai , aur zina kaar aurat say nikah kerta hai to wohi mard jo khud zaani ho , ya mushrik ho ,   aur yeh baat mominon kay liye haram kerdi gaee hai .

ayahs.text: aur jo log pak daman aurton per tohmat lagayen , phir chaar gawah ley ker naa ayen , to unn ko assi korray lagao ,   aur unn ki gawahi kabhi qubool naa kero ,   aur woh khud fasiq hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log pak daman aurton per tohmat lagayen , phir chaar gawah ley ker naa ayen , to unn ko assi korray lagao ,   aur unn ki gawahi kabhi qubool naa kero ,   aur woh khud fasiq hain .

ayahs.text: haan jo log iss kay baad tauba kerlen , aur ( apni ) islaah kerlen , to Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara reham kernay wala hai .
ayahs.translation: haan jo log iss kay baad tauba kerlen , aur ( apni ) islaah kerlen , to Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara reham kernay wala hai .

ayahs.text: aur jo log apni biwiyon per tohmat lagayen ,   aur khud apney siwa unn kay paas koi aur gawah naa hon to aesay kissi shaks ko jo gawahi deni hogi woh yeh hai kay woh chaar martaba Allah ki qasam kha ker yeh biyan dey kay woh ( biwi per lagaye huye ilzam mein ) yaqeenan sacha hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log apni biwiyon per tohmat lagayen ,   aur khud apney siwa unn kay paas koi aur gawah naa hon to aesay kissi shaks ko jo gawahi deni hogi woh yeh hai kay woh chaar martaba Allah ki qasam kha ker yeh biyan dey kay woh ( biwi per lagaye huye ilzam mein ) yaqeenan sacha hai .

ayahs.text: aur paanchwen martaba yeh kahey kay :  agar mein ( apney ilzam mein ) jhoota hun to mujh per Allah ki lanat ho .
ayahs.translation: aur paanchwen martaba yeh kahey kay :  agar mein ( apney ilzam mein ) jhoota hun to mujh per Allah ki lanat ho .

ayahs.text: aur aurat say ( zina ki ) saza door kernay ka raasta yeh hai kay woh chaar martaba Allah ki qasam kha ker yeh gawahi dey kay uss ka shohar ( iss ilzam mein ) jhoota hai .
ayahs.translation: aur aurat say ( zina ki ) saza door kernay ka raasta yeh hai kay woh chaar martaba Allah ki qasam kha ker yeh gawahi dey kay uss ka shohar ( iss ilzam mein ) jhoota hai .

ayahs.text: aur paanchwen martaba yeh kahey kay :  agar woh sacha ho to mujh per Allah ka ghazab nazil ho .
ayahs.translation: aur paanchwen martaba yeh kahey kay :  agar woh sacha ho to mujh per Allah ka ghazab nazil ho .

ayahs.text: aur agar tum per Allah ka fazal aur uss ki rehmat naa hoti aur yeh baat naa hoti kay Allah kasrat say tauba qubool kernay wala , hikmat wala hai ( to khud soch lo kay tumhara kiya banta-? ) .
ayahs.translation: aur agar tum per Allah ka fazal aur uss ki rehmat naa hoti aur yeh baat naa hoti kay Allah kasrat say tauba qubool kernay wala , hikmat wala hai ( to khud soch lo kay tumhara kiya banta-? ) .

ayahs.text: yaqeen jano kay jo log yeh jhooti tohmat gharr ker laye hain , woh tumharay andar hi ka aik tola hai .   tum iss baat ko apney liye bura naa samjho , balkay yeh tumharay liye behtar hi behtar hai .   inn logon  mein say her aik kay hissay mein apney kiye ka gunah aaya hai . aur inn mein say jiss shaks ney iss ( bohtan ) ka bara hissa apney sar liya hai , uss kay liye to zabardast azab hai .
ayahs.translation: yaqeen jano kay jo log yeh jhooti tohmat gharr ker laye hain , woh tumharay andar hi ka aik tola hai .   tum iss baat ko apney liye bura naa samjho , balkay yeh tumharay liye behtar hi behtar hai .   inn logon  mein say her aik kay hissay mein apney kiye ka gunah aaya hai . aur inn mein say jiss shaks ney iss ( bohtan ) ka bara hissa apney sar liya hai , uss kay liye to zabardast azab hai .

ayahs.text: jiss waqt tum logon  ney yeh baat suni thi to aisa kiyon naa huwa kay momin mard bhi aur momin aurten bhi apney baaray mein naik gumaan rakhtay aur keh detay kay yeh khullam khula jhoot hai-?
ayahs.translation: jiss waqt tum logon  ney yeh baat suni thi to aisa kiyon naa huwa kay momin mard bhi aur momin aurten bhi apney baaray mein naik gumaan rakhtay aur keh detay kay yeh khullam khula jhoot hai-?

ayahs.text: woh ( bohtan laganey walay ) iss baat per chaar gawah kiyon nahi ley aaye-? abb jabkay woh gawah nahi laye to Allah kay nazdeek wohi jhootay hain .
ayahs.translation: woh ( bohtan laganey walay ) iss baat per chaar gawah kiyon nahi ley aaye-? abb jabkay woh gawah nahi laye to Allah kay nazdeek wohi jhootay hain .

ayahs.text: aur agar tum per duniya aur aakhirat mein Allah ka fazal aur uss ki rehmat naa hoti to jinn baaton mein tum parr-gaye thay , unn ki wajeh say tum per uss waqt sakht azab aa-parta ,
ayahs.translation: aur agar tum per duniya aur aakhirat mein Allah ka fazal aur uss ki rehmat naa hoti to jinn baaton mein tum parr-gaye thay , unn ki wajeh say tum per uss waqt sakht azab aa-parta ,

ayahs.text: jab tum apni zabanon say iss baat ko aik doosray say naqal ker rahey thay ,   aur apney mun say woh baat keh rahey thay jiss ka tumhen koi ilm nahi tha , aur tum iss baat ko mamooli samajh rahey thay , halankay Allah kay nazdeek woh bari sangeen baat thi .
ayahs.translation: jab tum apni zabanon say iss baat ko aik doosray say naqal ker rahey thay ,   aur apney mun say woh baat keh rahey thay jiss ka tumhen koi ilm nahi tha , aur tum iss baat ko mamooli samajh rahey thay , halankay Allah kay nazdeek woh bari sangeen baat thi .

ayahs.text: aur jiss waqt tum ney yeh baat suni thi , ussi waqt tum ney yeh kiyon nahi kaha kay :  hamen koi haq nahi phonchta kay hum yeh baat mun say nikalen , ya Allah ! aap ki zaat her aeb say pak hai , yeh to bara zabardast bohtan hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jiss waqt tum ney yeh baat suni thi , ussi waqt tum ney yeh kiyon nahi kaha kay :  hamen koi haq nahi phonchta kay hum yeh baat mun say nikalen , ya Allah ! aap ki zaat her aeb say pak hai , yeh to bara zabardast bohtan hai .

ayahs.text: Allah tumhen naseehat kerta hai kay phir kabhi aisa naa kerna , agar waqaee tum momin ho .
ayahs.translation: Allah tumhen naseehat kerta hai kay phir kabhi aisa naa kerna , agar waqaee tum momin ho .

ayahs.text: aur Allah tumharay samney hidayat ki baaten saaf saaf biyan ker-raha hai . aur Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah tumharay samney hidayat ki baaten saaf saaf biyan ker-raha hai . aur Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

ayahs.text: yaad rakho kay jo log yeh chahtay hain kay emaan walon mein bey hayai phelay , unn kay liye duniya aur aakhirat mein dardnak azab hai , aur Allah janta hai , aur tum nahi jantay .
ayahs.translation: yaad rakho kay jo log yeh chahtay hain kay emaan walon mein bey hayai phelay , unn kay liye duniya aur aakhirat mein dardnak azab hai , aur Allah janta hai , aur tum nahi jantay .

ayahs.text: aur agar yeh baat naa hoti kay Allah ka fazal aur uss ki rehmat tumharay shamil-e-haal hai , aur Allah bara shafiq , bara meharban hai ( to tum bhi naa bachtay )
ayahs.translation: aur agar yeh baat naa hoti kay Allah ka fazal aur uss ki rehmat tumharay shamil-e-haal hai , aur Allah bara shafiq , bara meharban hai ( to tum bhi naa bachtay )

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! tum shetan kay peechay naa chalo , aur agar koi shaks shetan kay peechay chalay , to shetan to hamesha bey hayai aur badi ki talqeen keray ga . aur agar tum per Allah ka fazal aur rehmat naa hoti to tum mein say koi bhi kabhi pak saaf naa hota , lekin Allah jiss ko chahta hai , pak saaf ker deta hai . aur Allah her baat sunta , her cheez janta hai .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! tum shetan kay peechay naa chalo , aur agar koi shaks shetan kay peechay chalay , to shetan to hamesha bey hayai aur badi ki talqeen keray ga . aur agar tum per Allah ka fazal aur rehmat naa hoti to tum mein say koi bhi kabhi pak saaf naa hota , lekin Allah jiss ko chahta hai , pak saaf ker deta hai . aur Allah her baat sunta , her cheez janta hai .

ayahs.text: aur tum mein say jo log ehal-e-khair hain aur maali wusat rakhtay hain , woh aesi qasam naa khayen kay woh rishta daaron , miskeeno aur Allah kay raastay mein hijrat kernay walon ko kuch nahi den gay ,   aur unhen chahiye kay moaafi aur darguzar say kaam len . kiya tumhen yeh pasand nahi hai kay Allah tumhari khatayen bakhsh dey-? aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: aur tum mein say jo log ehal-e-khair hain aur maali wusat rakhtay hain , woh aesi qasam naa khayen kay woh rishta daaron , miskeeno aur Allah kay raastay mein hijrat kernay walon ko kuch nahi den gay ,   aur unhen chahiye kay moaafi aur darguzar say kaam len . kiya tumhen yeh pasand nahi hai kay Allah tumhari khatayen bakhsh dey-? aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: yaad rakho kay jo log pak daman bholi bhaali musalman aurton per tohmat lagatay hain , unn per duniya aur aakhirat mein phitkaar parr-chuki hai , aur unn ko uss din zabardast azab hoga .
ayahs.translation: yaad rakho kay jo log pak daman bholi bhaali musalman aurton per tohmat lagatay hain , unn per duniya aur aakhirat mein phitkaar parr-chuki hai , aur unn ko uss din zabardast azab hoga .

ayahs.text: jiss din khud unn ki zabanen , unn kay haath aur unn kay paon unn kay khilaf uss kartoot ki gawahi den gay jo woh kertay rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: jiss din khud unn ki zabanen , unn kay haath aur unn kay paon unn kay khilaf uss kartoot ki gawahi den gay jo woh kertay rahey hain .

ayahs.text: uss din Allah unn ko woh badla poora poora deydey ga jiss kay woh mustahiq hain , aur unn ko pata chal jaye ga kay Allah hi haq hai , aur wohi sari baat khol denay wala hai .
ayahs.translation: uss din Allah unn ko woh badla poora poora deydey ga jiss kay woh mustahiq hain , aur unn ko pata chal jaye ga kay Allah hi haq hai , aur wohi sari baat khol denay wala hai .

ayahs.text: gandi aurten ganday mardon kay laeeq hain , aur ganday mard gandi aurton kay laeeq . aur pakbaaz aurten pakbaaz mardon kay laeeq hain , aur pakbaaz mard pakbaaz aurton kay laeeq .   yeh ( pakbaaz mard aur aurten ) unn baaton say bilkul mubarra hain jo yeh log bana rahey hain . unn ( pakbaazon ) kay hissay mein to maghfirat hai aur ba-izzat rizq .
ayahs.translation: gandi aurten ganday mardon kay laeeq hain , aur ganday mard gandi aurton kay laeeq . aur pakbaaz aurten pakbaaz mardon kay laeeq hain , aur pakbaaz mard pakbaaz aurton kay laeeq .   yeh ( pakbaaz mard aur aurten ) unn baaton say bilkul mubarra hain jo yeh log bana rahey hain . unn ( pakbaazon ) kay hissay mein to maghfirat hai aur ba-izzat rizq .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! apney gharon kay siwa doosray gharon mein uss waqt tak dakhil naa ho jab tak ijazat naa ley lo , aur unn mein basney walon ko salam naa kerlo .   yehi tareeqa tumharay liye behtar hai , umeed hai kay tum khayal rakho gay .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! apney gharon kay siwa doosray gharon mein uss waqt tak dakhil naa ho jab tak ijazat naa ley lo , aur unn mein basney walon ko salam naa kerlo .   yehi tareeqa tumharay liye behtar hai , umeed hai kay tum khayal rakho gay .

ayahs.text: aur agar tum unn gharon mein kissi ko naa pao tab bhi unn mein uss waqt tak dakhil naa ho jab tak tumhen ijazat naa dey di jaye .   aur agar tum say kaha jaye kay :  wapis chalay jao  to wapis chalay jao . yehi tumharay liye pakeezah tareen tareeqa hai , aur tum jo amal bhi kertay ho , Allah ko uss ka poora poora ilm hai .
ayahs.translation: aur agar tum unn gharon mein kissi ko naa pao tab bhi unn mein uss waqt tak dakhil naa ho jab tak tumhen ijazat naa dey di jaye .   aur agar tum say kaha jaye kay :  wapis chalay jao  to wapis chalay jao . yehi tumharay liye pakeezah tareen tareeqa hai , aur tum jo amal bhi kertay ho , Allah ko uss ka poora poora ilm hai .

ayahs.text: tumharay liye iss mein koi gunah nahi hai kay tum aesay gharon mein ( ijazat liye baghair ) dakhil ho jinn mein koi rehta naa ho , aur unn say tumhen faeeda uthaney ka haq ho .   aur tum jo kaam aelania kertay ho , aur jo chup ker kertay ho , Allah unn sabb ko janta hai .
ayahs.translation: tumharay liye iss mein koi gunah nahi hai kay tum aesay gharon mein ( ijazat liye baghair ) dakhil ho jinn mein koi rehta naa ho , aur unn say tumhen faeeda uthaney ka haq ho .   aur tum jo kaam aelania kertay ho , aur jo chup ker kertay ho , Allah unn sabb ko janta hai .

ayahs.text: momin mardon say keh do kay woh apni nigahen neechi rakhen , aur apni sharmgahon ki hifazat keren . yehi unn kay liye pakeezah tareen tareeqa hai . woh jo kaarwaiyan kertay hain , Allah unn sabb say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
ayahs.translation: momin mardon say keh do kay woh apni nigahen neechi rakhen , aur apni sharmgahon ki hifazat keren . yehi unn kay liye pakeezah tareen tareeqa hai . woh jo kaarwaiyan kertay hain , Allah unn sabb say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

ayahs.text: aur momin aurton say keh do kay woh apni nigahen neechi rakhen , aur apni sharmgahon ki hifazat keren , aur apni sajawat ko kissi per zahir naa keren , siwaye uss kay jo khud hi zahir hojaye ,   aur apni oarhniyon kay aanchal apney giraybanon per daal liya keren , aur apni sajawat aur kissi per zahir naa keren ,   siwaye apney shohron kay , ya apney baap , ya apney shohron kay baap kay , ya apney beton ya apney shohron kay beton kay , ya apney bhaiyon ya apney bhaiyon kay beton , ya apni behnon kay beton kay , ya apni aurton kay ,   ya unn kay jo apney haathon ki milkiyat mein hain ,   ya unn khidmat guzaron kay jinn kay dil mein koi ( jinsi ) taqaza nahi hota ,   ya unn bacchon kay jo abhi aurton kay chupay huye hisson say aashna nahi huye .   aur musalman aurton ko chahiye kay woh apney paon zameen per iss tarah naa maaren kay unhon ney jo zeenat chupa rakhi hai woh maloom hojaye .   aur aey momino ! tum sabb Allah kay samney tauba kero , takay tumhen falah naseeb ho .
ayahs.translation: aur momin aurton say keh do kay woh apni nigahen neechi rakhen , aur apni sharmgahon ki hifazat keren , aur apni sajawat ko kissi per zahir naa keren , siwaye uss kay jo khud hi zahir hojaye ,   aur apni oarhniyon kay aanchal apney giraybanon per daal liya keren , aur apni sajawat aur kissi per zahir naa keren ,   siwaye apney shohron kay , ya apney baap , ya apney shohron kay baap kay , ya apney beton ya apney shohron kay beton kay , ya apney bhaiyon ya apney bhaiyon kay beton , ya apni behnon kay beton kay , ya apni aurton kay ,   ya unn kay jo apney haathon ki milkiyat mein hain ,   ya unn khidmat guzaron kay jinn kay dil mein koi ( jinsi ) taqaza nahi hota ,   ya unn bacchon kay jo abhi aurton kay chupay huye hisson say aashna nahi huye .   aur musalman aurton ko chahiye kay woh apney paon zameen per iss tarah naa maaren kay unhon ney jo zeenat chupa rakhi hai woh maloom hojaye .   aur aey momino ! tum sabb Allah kay samney tauba kero , takay tumhen falah naseeb ho .

ayahs.text: tum mein say jinn ( mardon ya aurton ) ka uss waqt nikah naa ho , unn ka bhi nikah kerao , aur tumharay ghulamon aur baandiyon mein say jo nikah kay qabil hon , unn ka bhi . agar woh tang dast hon to Allah apney fazal say unhen bey niaz kerday ga .   aur Allah boht wusat wala hai , sabb kuch janta hai .
ayahs.translation: tum mein say jinn ( mardon ya aurton ) ka uss waqt nikah naa ho , unn ka bhi nikah kerao , aur tumharay ghulamon aur baandiyon mein say jo nikah kay qabil hon , unn ka bhi . agar woh tang dast hon to Allah apney fazal say unhen bey niaz kerday ga .   aur Allah boht wusat wala hai , sabb kuch janta hai .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ko nikah kay mawaqeh moyassar naa hon , woh pak damani kay sath rahen , yahan tak kay Allah apney fazal say unhen bey niaz kerday . aur tumhari milkiyat kay ghulam baandiyon mein say jo makatibat ka moahida kerna chahen , agar unn mein bhalai dekho to unn say makatibat ka moahida kerliya kero ,   aur ( musalmano ! ) Allah ney tumhen jo maal dey rakha hai , uss mein say aesay ghulam baandiyon ko bhi diya kero , aur apni baandiyon ko dunyawi zindagi ka saz-o-saman hasil kernay kay liye bad-kaari per majboor naa kero jabkay woh pak damani chahti hon .   aur jo koi unhen majboor keray ga to unn ko majboor kernay kay baad Allah ( unn baandiyon ko ) boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ko nikah kay mawaqeh moyassar naa hon , woh pak damani kay sath rahen , yahan tak kay Allah apney fazal say unhen bey niaz kerday . aur tumhari milkiyat kay ghulam baandiyon mein say jo makatibat ka moahida kerna chahen , agar unn mein bhalai dekho to unn say makatibat ka moahida kerliya kero ,   aur ( musalmano ! ) Allah ney tumhen jo maal dey rakha hai , uss mein say aesay ghulam baandiyon ko bhi diya kero , aur apni baandiyon ko dunyawi zindagi ka saz-o-saman hasil kernay kay liye bad-kaari per majboor naa kero jabkay woh pak damani chahti hon .   aur jo koi unhen majboor keray ga to unn ko majboor kernay kay baad Allah ( unn baandiyon ko ) boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney woh aayaten bhi utaar ker tum tak phoncha di hain jo her baat ko wazeh kernay wali hain , aur unn logon  ki misalen bhi jo tum say pehlay guzar chukay hain , aur woh naseehat bhi jo Allah say darney walon kay liye kaar-aamad hai .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney woh aayaten bhi utaar ker tum tak phoncha di hain jo her baat ko wazeh kernay wali hain , aur unn logon  ki misalen bhi jo tum say pehlay guzar chukay hain , aur woh naseehat bhi jo Allah say darney walon kay liye kaar-aamad hai .

ayahs.text: Allah tamam aasmano aur zameen ka noor hai .   uss kay noor ki misal kuch yun hai jaisay aik taaq ho jiss mein chiragh rakha ho ,   chiragh aik sheeshay mein ho , sheesha aisa ho jaisay aik sitara , moti ki tarah chamakta huwa ! woh chiragh aesay barkat walay darkht yani zaitoon say roshan kiya jaye jo naa ( sirf ) mashriqi ho naa ( sirf ) maghribi ,   aisa lagta ho kay uss ka tel khud hi roshni deydey ga , chahye ussay aag bhi naa lagay .   noor balaye noor ! Allah apney noor tak jissay chahta hai , phoncha deta hai , aur Allah logon  kay faeeday kay liye tamseelen biyan kerta hai , aur Allah her cheez ko khoob janney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah tamam aasmano aur zameen ka noor hai .   uss kay noor ki misal kuch yun hai jaisay aik taaq ho jiss mein chiragh rakha ho ,   chiragh aik sheeshay mein ho , sheesha aisa ho jaisay aik sitara , moti ki tarah chamakta huwa ! woh chiragh aesay barkat walay darkht yani zaitoon say roshan kiya jaye jo naa ( sirf ) mashriqi ho naa ( sirf ) maghribi ,   aisa lagta ho kay uss ka tel khud hi roshni deydey ga , chahye ussay aag bhi naa lagay .   noor balaye noor ! Allah apney noor tak jissay chahta hai , phoncha deta hai , aur Allah logon  kay faeeday kay liye tamseelen biyan kerta hai , aur Allah her cheez ko khoob janney wala hai .

ayahs.text: jinn gharon kay baaray mein Allah ney yeh hukum diya hai kay unn ko buland maqam diya jaye , aur unn mein uss ka naam ley ker ziker kiya jaye , unn mein subha o shaam woh log uski tasbeeh kertay hain
ayahs.translation: jinn gharon kay baaray mein Allah ney yeh hukum diya hai kay unn ko buland maqam diya jaye , aur unn mein uss ka naam ley ker ziker kiya jaye , unn mein subha o shaam woh log uski tasbeeh kertay hain

ayahs.text: jinhen koi tijarat ya koi kharid-o-farokht naa Allah ki yaad say ghafil kerti hai naa namaz qaeem kernay say aur naa zakat denay say .   woh uss din say dartay rehtay hain jiss mein dil aur nigahen ulat palat ker reh jayen gi .
ayahs.translation: jinhen koi tijarat ya koi kharid-o-farokht naa Allah ki yaad say ghafil kerti hai naa namaz qaeem kernay say aur naa zakat denay say .   woh uss din say dartay rehtay hain jiss mein dil aur nigahen ulat palat ker reh jayen gi .

ayahs.text: nateeja yeh hai kay Allah inn logon  ko inn kay aemal ka behtareen badla dey ga , aur apney fazal say mazeed kuch aur bhi dey ga ,   aur Allah jiss ko chahta hai , bey hisab deta hai .
ayahs.translation: nateeja yeh hai kay Allah inn logon  ko inn kay aemal ka behtareen badla dey ga , aur apney fazal say mazeed kuch aur bhi dey ga ,   aur Allah jiss ko chahta hai , bey hisab deta hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( doosri taraf ) jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay aemal ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik chatiyal sehra mein aik sarab ho jissay piyasa aadmi paani samajh bethta hai, yahan tak kay jab uss kay paas phonchta hai to maloom hota hai kay woh kuch bhi nahi tha ,   aur uss kay paas Allah ko pata hai , chunacheh Allah uss ka poora poora hisab chuka deta hai .   aur Allah boht jaldi hisab ley leta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( doosri taraf ) jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay aemal ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik chatiyal sehra mein aik sarab ho jissay piyasa aadmi paani samajh bethta hai, yahan tak kay jab uss kay paas phonchta hai to maloom hota hai kay woh kuch bhi nahi tha ,   aur uss kay paas Allah ko pata hai , chunacheh Allah uss ka poora poora hisab chuka deta hai .   aur Allah boht jaldi hisab ley leta hai .

ayahs.text: ya phir unn ( aemal ) ki misal aesi hai jaisay kissi gehray samandar mein phelay huye andheray , kay samandar ko aik moaj ney dhaanp rakha ho , jiss kay oopper aik aur moaj ho , aur uss kay oopper badal , gharz oopper talay andheray hi andheray ! agar koi apna hath bahir nikalay to ussay bhi naa dekh paye .   aur jiss shaks ko Allah hi noor ata naa keray , uss kay naseeb mein koi noor nahi .
ayahs.translation: ya phir unn ( aemal ) ki misal aesi hai jaisay kissi gehray samandar mein phelay huye andheray , kay samandar ko aik moaj ney dhaanp rakha ho , jiss kay oopper aik aur moaj ho , aur uss kay oopper badal , gharz oopper talay andheray hi andheray ! agar koi apna hath bahir nikalay to ussay bhi naa dekh paye .   aur jiss shaks ko Allah hi noor ata naa keray , uss kay naseeb mein koi noor nahi .

ayahs.text: kiya tum ney dekha nahi kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo bhi , hain Allah hi ki tasbeeh kertay hain , aur woh perinday bhi jo per phelaye huye urtay hain . her aik ko apni namaz aur apni tasbeeh ka tareeqa maloom hai .   aur Allah unn kay saray kamon say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
ayahs.translation: kiya tum ney dekha nahi kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo bhi , hain Allah hi ki tasbeeh kertay hain , aur woh perinday bhi jo per phelaye huye urtay hain . her aik ko apni namaz aur apni tasbeeh ka tareeqa maloom hai .   aur Allah unn kay saray kamon say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

ayahs.text: aur aasmano aur zameen ki badshahi Allah hi kay liye hai , aur Allah hi ki taraf ( sabb ko ) loat ker jana hai .
ayahs.translation: aur aasmano aur zameen ki badshahi Allah hi kay liye hai , aur Allah hi ki taraf ( sabb ko ) loat ker jana hai .

ayahs.text: kiya tum ney dekha nahi kay Allah badalon ko hankata hai , phir unn ko aik doosray say jorr deta hai , phir unhen teh bar teh ghata mein tabdeel ker deta hai , phir tum dekhtay ho kay barish uss kay darmiyan say baras rahi hai . aur aasman mein ( badalon ki shakal mein ) jo pahar kay pahar hotay hain , Allah unn say olay barsata hai , phir jiss kay liye chahta hai , unn ko museebat bana deta hai , aur jiss say chahta hai , unn ka rukh pher deta hai . aisa lagta hai kay uss ki bijli ki chamak aankhon ki beenai uchak ley jaye gi .
ayahs.translation: kiya tum ney dekha nahi kay Allah badalon ko hankata hai , phir unn ko aik doosray say jorr deta hai , phir unhen teh bar teh ghata mein tabdeel ker deta hai , phir tum dekhtay ho kay barish uss kay darmiyan say baras rahi hai . aur aasman mein ( badalon ki shakal mein ) jo pahar kay pahar hotay hain , Allah unn say olay barsata hai , phir jiss kay liye chahta hai , unn ko museebat bana deta hai , aur jiss say chahta hai , unn ka rukh pher deta hai . aisa lagta hai kay uss ki bijli ki chamak aankhon ki beenai uchak ley jaye gi .

ayahs.text: wohi Allah raat aur din ka ulat pher kerta hai . yaqeenan inn sabb baaton mein unn logon  kay liye naseehat ka saman hai jinn kay paas dekhney wali aankhen hain .
ayahs.translation: wohi Allah raat aur din ka ulat pher kerta hai . yaqeenan inn sabb baaton mein unn logon  kay liye naseehat ka saman hai jinn kay paas dekhney wali aankhen hain .

ayahs.text: aur Allah ney zameen per chalney walay her jandaar ko paani say peda kiya hai . phir unn mein say kuch woh hain jo apney pet kay ball chaltay hain , kuch woh hain jo do paon per chaltay hain , aur kuch woh hain jo chaar ( paon ) per chaltay hain . Allah jo chahta hai peda kerta hai . yaqeenan Allah her baat per qudrat rakhta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah ney zameen per chalney walay her jandaar ko paani say peda kiya hai . phir unn mein say kuch woh hain jo apney pet kay ball chaltay hain , kuch woh hain jo do paon per chaltay hain , aur kuch woh hain jo chaar ( paon ) per chaltay hain . Allah jo chahta hai peda kerta hai . yaqeenan Allah her baat per qudrat rakhta hai .

ayahs.text: beyshak hum ney woh aayaten nazil ki hain jo haqeeqat ko khol khol ker biyan kernay wali hain , aur Allah jiss ko chahta hai , seedhay raastay tak phoncha deta hai .
ayahs.translation: beyshak hum ney woh aayaten nazil ki hain jo haqeeqat ko khol khol ker biyan kernay wali hain , aur Allah jiss ko chahta hai , seedhay raastay tak phoncha deta hai .

ayahs.text: aur yeh ( munafiq ) log kehtay hain kay hum Allah per aur Rasool per emaan ley aaye hain aur hum farmanbardaar hogaye hain , phir inn mein say aik giroh uss kay baad bhi mun morr leta hai . yeh log ( haqeeqat mein ) momin nahi hain .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh ( munafiq ) log kehtay hain kay hum Allah per aur Rasool per emaan ley aaye hain aur hum farmanbardaar hogaye hain , phir inn mein say aik giroh uss kay baad bhi mun morr leta hai . yeh log ( haqeeqat mein ) momin nahi hain .

ayahs.text: aur jab unhen Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki taraf bulaya jata hai takay Rasool unn kay darmiyan faisla keren to unn mein say kuch log aik dum rukh pher letay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jab unhen Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki taraf bulaya jata hai takay Rasool unn kay darmiyan faisla keren to unn mein say kuch log aik dum rukh pher letay hain .

ayahs.text: aur agar khud unhen haq wasool kerna ho to woh baray farmanbardaar ban ker Rasool kay paas chalay aatay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur agar khud unhen haq wasool kerna ho to woh baray farmanbardaar ban ker Rasool kay paas chalay aatay hain .

ayahs.text: kiya inn kay dilon mein koi rog hai , ya yeh shak mein parray huye hain , ya enhen yeh andesha hai kay Allah aur uss ka Rasool unn per zulm dahaye ga-? nahi , balkay zulm dhaaney walay to khud yeh log hain .
ayahs.translation: kiya inn kay dilon mein koi rog hai , ya yeh shak mein parray huye hain , ya enhen yeh andesha hai kay Allah aur uss ka Rasool unn per zulm dahaye ga-? nahi , balkay zulm dhaaney walay to khud yeh log hain .

ayahs.text: mominon ki baat to yeh hoti hai kay jab unhen Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki taraf bulaya jata hai takay Rasool unn kay darmiyan faisla keren to woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  hum ney ( hukum ) sunn liya , aur maan liya  aur aesay hi log hain jo falah paaney walay hain .
ayahs.translation: mominon ki baat to yeh hoti hai kay jab unhen Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki taraf bulaya jata hai takay Rasool unn kay darmiyan faisla keren to woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  hum ney ( hukum ) sunn liya , aur maan liya  aur aesay hi log hain jo falah paaney walay hain .

ayahs.text: aur jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki farmanbardaari keren , Allah say daren , aur uss ki nafarmani say bachen , to wohi log kamiyab hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki farmanbardaari keren , Allah say daren , aur uss ki nafarmani say bachen , to wohi log kamiyab hain .

ayahs.text: aur yeh ( munafiq log ) baray zoron say Allah ki qasmen khatay hain kay agar ( aey payghumber ! ) tum unhen hukum do gay to yeh nikal kharray hon gay . ( unn say ) kaho kay :  qasmen naa khao . ( tumhari ) farmanbardaari ka sabb ko pata hai .   yaqeen jano kay tum jo kuch kertay ho Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh ( munafiq log ) baray zoron say Allah ki qasmen khatay hain kay agar ( aey payghumber ! ) tum unhen hukum do gay to yeh nikal kharray hon gay . ( unn say ) kaho kay :  qasmen naa khao . ( tumhari ) farmanbardaari ka sabb ko pata hai .   yaqeen jano kay tum jo kuch kertay ho Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

ayahs.text: . ( unn say ) kaho kay :  Allah ka hukum maano , aur Rasool kay farmanbardaar bano , phir bhi agar tum ney mun pheray rakha to Rasool per to itna hi bojh hai jiss ki zimma daari unn per daali gaee hai , aur jo bojh tum per daala gaya hai , uss kay zimma daar tum khud ho . agar tum unn ki farmanbardaari kero gay to hidayat paajao gay , aur Rasool ka farz iss say ziyada nahi hai kay woh saaf saaf baat phoncha den .
ayahs.translation: . ( unn say ) kaho kay :  Allah ka hukum maano , aur Rasool kay farmanbardaar bano , phir bhi agar tum ney mun pheray rakha to Rasool per to itna hi bojh hai jiss ki zimma daari unn per daali gaee hai , aur jo bojh tum per daala gaya hai , uss kay zimma daar tum khud ho . agar tum unn ki farmanbardaari kero gay to hidayat paajao gay , aur Rasool ka farz iss say ziyada nahi hai kay woh saaf saaf baat phoncha den .

ayahs.text: tum mein say jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn say Allah ney wada kiya hai kay woh unhen zaroor zameen mein apna khalifa banaye ga , jiss tarah unn say pehlay logon  ko banaya tha , aur unn kay liye uss deen ko zaroor iqtidar bakhshay ga jissay unn kay liye pasand kiya hai , aur unn ko jo khof laahaq raha hai , uss kay badlay unhen zaroor aman ata keray ga . ( bus ) woh meri ibadat keren , meray sath kissi cheez ko shareek naa thehrayen . aur jo log iss kay baad bhi nashukri keren gay to aesay log nafarman hon gay .
ayahs.translation: tum mein say jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn say Allah ney wada kiya hai kay woh unhen zaroor zameen mein apna khalifa banaye ga , jiss tarah unn say pehlay logon  ko banaya tha , aur unn kay liye uss deen ko zaroor iqtidar bakhshay ga jissay unn kay liye pasand kiya hai , aur unn ko jo khof laahaq raha hai , uss kay badlay unhen zaroor aman ata keray ga . ( bus ) woh meri ibadat keren , meray sath kissi cheez ko shareek naa thehrayen . aur jo log iss kay baad bhi nashukri keren gay to aesay log nafarman hon gay .

ayahs.text: aur namaz qaeem kero , aur zakat ada kero , aur Rasool ki farmanbardaari kero , takay tumharay sath rehmat ka bartao kiya jaye .
ayahs.translation: aur namaz qaeem kero , aur zakat ada kero , aur Rasool ki farmanbardaari kero , takay tumharay sath rehmat ka bartao kiya jaye .

ayahs.text: yeh hergiz naa samajhna kay jinn logon  ney kufr ka raasta apna liya hai , woh zameen mein ( kahen bhag ker hamen ) bey bus kerden gay . unn ka thikana dozakh hai , aur yaqeenan woh boht hi bura thikana hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh hergiz naa samajhna kay jinn logon  ney kufr ka raasta apna liya hai , woh zameen mein ( kahen bhag ker hamen ) bey bus kerden gay . unn ka thikana dozakh hai , aur yaqeenan woh boht hi bura thikana hai .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! jo ghulam londiyan tumhari milkiyat mein hain , aur tum mein say jo bacchay abhi buloog tak nahi phonchay , unn ko chahiye kay woh teen oqaat mein ( tumharay paas aaney kay liye ) tum say ijazat liya keren . namaz-e-fajar say pehlay , aur jab tum dophare kay waqt apney kapray utaar ker rakha kertay ho , aur namaz-e-esha kay baad .   yeh teen waqt tumharay perday kay oqaat hain . inn oqaat kay ilawa naa tum per koi tangi hai , naa unn per . unn ka bhi tumharay paas aana jana laga rehta hai , tumhara bhi aik doosray kay paas . Allah issi tarah aayaton ko tumharay samney khol khol ker biyan kerta hai , aur Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! jo ghulam londiyan tumhari milkiyat mein hain , aur tum mein say jo bacchay abhi buloog tak nahi phonchay , unn ko chahiye kay woh teen oqaat mein ( tumharay paas aaney kay liye ) tum say ijazat liya keren . namaz-e-fajar say pehlay , aur jab tum dophare kay waqt apney kapray utaar ker rakha kertay ho , aur namaz-e-esha kay baad .   yeh teen waqt tumharay perday kay oqaat hain . inn oqaat kay ilawa naa tum per koi tangi hai , naa unn per . unn ka bhi tumharay paas aana jana laga rehta hai , tumhara bhi aik doosray kay paas . Allah issi tarah aayaton ko tumharay samney khol khol ker biyan kerta hai , aur Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

ayahs.text: aur jab tumharay bacchay buloog ko phonch jayen , to woh bhi ussi tarah ijazat liya keren jaisay unn say pehlay baligh honey walay ijazat letay rahey hain . Allah issi tarah apni aayaten khol khol ker tumharay samney biyan kerta hai , aur Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
ayahs.translation: aur jab tumharay bacchay buloog ko phonch jayen , to woh bhi ussi tarah ijazat liya keren jaisay unn say pehlay baligh honey walay ijazat letay rahey hain . Allah issi tarah apni aayaten khol khol ker tumharay samney biyan kerta hai , aur Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

ayahs.text: aur jinn bari boorhi aurton ko nikah ki koi tawaqqo naa rahi ho , unn kay liye iss mein koi gunah nahi hai kay woh apney ( zaeed ) kapray , ( maslan chadaren , na-mehramon kay samney ) utaar ker rakh den , ba-shartey-kay zeenat ki numaish naa keren ,   aur agar woh ehtiyat hi rakhen to unn kay liye aur ziyada behtar hai . aur Allah sabb kuch sunta , her baat janta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn bari boorhi aurton ko nikah ki koi tawaqqo naa rahi ho , unn kay liye iss mein koi gunah nahi hai kay woh apney ( zaeed ) kapray , ( maslan chadaren , na-mehramon kay samney ) utaar ker rakh den , ba-shartey-kay zeenat ki numaish naa keren ,   aur agar woh ehtiyat hi rakhen to unn kay liye aur ziyada behtar hai . aur Allah sabb kuch sunta , her baat janta hai .

ayahs.text: naa kissi na-beena kay liye iss mein koi gunah hai , naa kissi paon say maazoor shaks kay liye koi gunah hai , naa kissi beemar shaks kay liye koi gunah hai , aur naa khud tumharay liye kay tum apney gharon say kuch khalo ,   ya apney baap dada kay gharon say , ya apni maon kay gharon say , ya apney bhaiyon kay gharon say ,   ya apni behnon kay gharon say , ya apney chachaon kay gharon say , ya apni phoopiyon kay gharon say , ya apney mamooan kay gharon say , ya apni khalaon kay gharon say , ya unn gharon say jinn ki chabiyan tumharay ikhtiyar mein hon .   ya apney doston kay gharon say . iss mein bhi tumharay liye koi gunah nahi hai kay sabb milker khao , ya alag alag . chunacheh jab tum gharon mein dakhil ho to apney logon  ko salam kiya kero , kay yeh mulaqat ki woh ba-barkat pakeezah dua hai jo Allah ki taraf say aai hai . Allah issi tarah aayaton ko tumharay samney khol khol ker biyan kerta hai , takay tum samajh jao .

Allah issi tarah aayaton ko tumharay samney khol khol ker biyan kerta hai , takay tum samajh jao .

ayahs.text: momin to woh log hain jo Allah aur uss kay Rasool ko dil say mantay hain , aur jab Rasool kay sath kissi ijtimaee kaam mein shareek hotay hain to unn say ijazat liye baghair kahen nahi jatay .   ( aey payghumber ! ) jo log tum say ijazat letay hain , yehi woh log hain jo Allah aur uss kay Rasool ko dil say mantay hain . chunacheh jab woh apney kissi kaam kay liye tum say ijazat maangen to unn mein say jinn ko chahao , ijazat dey diya kero , aur unn kay liye Allah say maghfirat ki dua kiya kero . yaqeenan Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: momin to woh log hain jo Allah aur uss kay Rasool ko dil say mantay hain , aur jab Rasool kay sath kissi ijtimaee kaam mein shareek hotay hain to unn say ijazat liye baghair kahen nahi jatay .   ( aey payghumber ! ) jo log tum say ijazat letay hain , yehi woh log hain jo Allah aur uss kay Rasool ko dil say mantay hain . chunacheh jab woh apney kissi kaam kay liye tum say ijazat maangen to unn mein say jinn ko chahao , ijazat dey diya kero , aur unn kay liye Allah say maghfirat ki dua kiya kero . yaqeenan Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: . ( aey logo ! ) apney darmiyan Rasool kay bulaney ko aisa ( mamooli ) naa samjho jaisay tum aapas mein aik doosray ko bula liya kertay ho .   Allah tum mein say unn logon  ko khoob janta hai jo aik doosray ki aarr ley ker chupkay say khisak jatay hain . lehaza jo log uss kay hukum ki khilaf warzi kertay hain , unn ko iss baat say darna chahiye kay kahen unn per koi aafat naa aa-parey , ya unhen koi dardnak azab naa aa-pakray .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey logo ! ) apney darmiyan Rasool kay bulaney ko aisa ( mamooli ) naa samjho jaisay tum aapas mein aik doosray ko bula liya kertay ho .   Allah tum mein say unn logon  ko khoob janta hai jo aik doosray ki aarr ley ker chupkay say khisak jatay hain . lehaza jo log uss kay hukum ki khilaf warzi kertay hain , unn ko iss baat say darna chahiye kay kahen unn per koi aafat naa aa-parey , ya unhen koi dardnak azab naa aa-pakray .

ayahs.text: yaad rakho kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai Allah hi ka hai . tum jiss halat per bhi ho , Allah ussay khoob janta hai , aur jiss din sabb ko uss kay paas lotaya jaye ga , uss din woh unn ko batadey ga kay unhon ney kiya amal kiya tha , aur Allah ko her baat ka poora poora ilm hai .
ayahs.translation: yaad rakho kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai Allah hi ka hai . tum jiss halat per bhi ho , Allah ussay khoob janta hai , aur jiss din sabb ko uss kay paas lotaya jaye ga , uss din woh unn ko batadey ga kay unhon ney kiya amal kiya tha , aur Allah ko her baat ka poora poora ilm hai .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: bari shaan hai uss zaat ki jiss ney apney banday per haq o batil ka faisla ker-denay wali yeh kitab nazil ki , takay woh duniya jahan kay logon  ko khabrdar kerday .
verses.translation: bari shaan hai uss zaat ki jiss ney apney banday per haq o batil ka faisla ker-denay wali yeh kitab nazil ki , takay woh duniya jahan kay logon  ko khabrdar kerday .

verses.text: woh zaat jo aasmano aur zameen ki badshahat ki tanha malik hai aur jiss ney naa to koi beta banaya hai , aur naa uss ki badshahat mein koi shareek hai , aur jiss ney her cheez ko peda ker kay uss ko aik napa tula andaz ata kiya hai .
verses.translation: woh zaat jo aasmano aur zameen ki badshahat ki tanha malik hai aur jiss ney naa to koi beta banaya hai , aur naa uss ki badshahat mein koi shareek hai , aur jiss ney her cheez ko peda ker kay uss ko aik napa tula andaz ata kiya hai .

verses.text: aur logon  ney ussay chorr ker aesay khuda bana rakhay hain jo kuch peda nahi kertay , balkay khud peda kiye jatay hain , aur jinn ka khud apney nuqsan ya faeeday per bhi koi bus nahi chalta , aur naa kissi ka marna ya jeena unn kay ikhtiyar mein hai , naa kissi ko dobara zinda kerna .
verses.translation: aur logon  ney ussay chorr ker aesay khuda bana rakhay hain jo kuch peda nahi kertay , balkay khud peda kiye jatay hain , aur jinn ka khud apney nuqsan ya faeeday per bhi koi bus nahi chalta , aur naa kissi ka marna ya jeena unn kay ikhtiyar mein hai , naa kissi ko dobara zinda kerna .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  yeh ( Quran ) to kuch bhi nahi , bus aik mann gharrat cheez hai jo iss shaks ney gharr li hai , aur iss kaam mein kuch aur log bhi uss kay madadgaar banay hain .    iss tarah ( yeh baat keh ker ) yeh log baray zulm aur khulay jhoot per utar aaye hain .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  yeh ( Quran ) to kuch bhi nahi , bus aik mann gharrat cheez hai jo iss shaks ney gharr li hai , aur iss kaam mein kuch aur log bhi uss kay madadgaar banay hain .    iss tarah ( yeh baat keh ker ) yeh log baray zulm aur khulay jhoot per utar aaye hain .

verses.text: aur kehtay hain kay :  yeh to pichlay logon  ki likhi hoi kahaniyan hain jo iss shaks ney likhwali hain , aur subha o shaam wohi iss kay samney parh ker sunai jati hain .
verses.translation: aur kehtay hain kay :  yeh to pichlay logon  ki likhi hoi kahaniyan hain jo iss shaks ney likhwali hain , aur subha o shaam wohi iss kay samney parh ker sunai jati hain .

verses.text: keh do kay :  yeh kalam to uss ( Allah ) ney nazil kiya hai jo her bhed ko poori tarah janta hai , aasmano mein bhi , zameen mein bhi . beyshak woh boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  yeh kalam to uss ( Allah ) ney nazil kiya hai jo her bhed ko poori tarah janta hai , aasmano mein bhi , zameen mein bhi . beyshak woh boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: aur yeh kehtay hain kay :  yeh kaisa Rasool hai jo khana bhi khata hai , aur bazaron mein bhi chalta phirta hai ? iss kay paas koi farishta kiyon nahi bheja gaya jo iss kay sath reh ker logon  ko darata-?
verses.translation: aur yeh kehtay hain kay :  yeh kaisa Rasool hai jo khana bhi khata hai , aur bazaron mein bhi chalta phirta hai ? iss kay paas koi farishta kiyon nahi bheja gaya jo iss kay sath reh ker logon  ko darata-?

verses.text: ya iss kay oopper koi khazana hi aa-parta , ya iss kay paas koi baagh hota jiss mein say yeh khaya kerta .  aur yeh zalim ( musalmanon say ) kehtay hain kay :  tum jiss kay peechay chal rahey ho , woh aur kuch nahi , bus aik shaks hai jiss per jadoo hogaya hai .
verses.translation: ya iss kay oopper koi khazana hi aa-parta , ya iss kay paas koi baagh hota jiss mein say yeh khaya kerta .  aur yeh zalim ( musalmanon say ) kehtay hain kay :  tum jiss kay peechay chal rahey ho , woh aur kuch nahi , bus aik shaks hai jiss per jadoo hogaya hai .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) dekho inn logon  ney tumharay baaray mein kaisi kaisi baaten banai hain , chunacheh aesay bhatkay hain kay raastay per aana inn kay bus say bahir hai .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) dekho inn logon  ney tumharay baaray mein kaisi kaisi baaten banai hain , chunacheh aesay bhatkay hain kay raastay per aana inn kay bus say bahir hai .

verses.text: bari shaan hai uss ( Allah ) ki jo agar chahye to tumhen inn sabb say kahen behtar cheez , ( aik baagh kay bajaye ) boht say baaghaat deydey jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon , aur tumhen boht say mehalaat ka malik bana dey .
verses.translation: bari shaan hai uss ( Allah ) ki jo agar chahye to tumhen inn sabb say kahen behtar cheez , ( aik baagh kay bajaye ) boht say baaghaat deydey jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon , aur tumhen boht say mehalaat ka malik bana dey .

verses.text: asal haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn logon  ney qayamat ki gharri ko jhutlaya huwa hai ,   aur jo koi qayamat ki gharri ko jhutlaye , uss kay liye hum ney bharakti hoi aag tayyar ker rakhi hai .
verses.translation: asal haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn logon  ney qayamat ki gharri ko jhutlaya huwa hai ,   aur jo koi qayamat ki gharri ko jhutlaye , uss kay liye hum ney bharakti hoi aag tayyar ker rakhi hai .

verses.text: jab woh unn ko door say dekhay gi to yeh log uss kay bipharney aur phunkarney ki aawazen sunen gay .
verses.translation: jab woh unn ko door say dekhay gi to yeh log uss kay bipharney aur phunkarney ki aawazen sunen gay .

verses.text: aur jab inn ko achi tarah baandh ker uss ki aik tang jagah mein phenka jaye ga to wahan yeh moat ko aawaz dey ker pukaren gay .
verses.translation: aur jab inn ko achi tarah baandh ker uss ki aik tang jagah mein phenka jaye ga to wahan yeh moat ko aawaz dey ker pukaren gay .

verses.text: . ( uss waqt inn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  aaj tum moat ko sirf aik baar naa pukaro , balkay baar baar moat ko pukartay hi raho .
verses.translation: . ( uss waqt inn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  aaj tum moat ko sirf aik baar naa pukaro , balkay baar baar moat ko pukartay hi raho .

verses.text: kaho kay yeh anjam behtar hai ya hamesha rehney wali jannat , jiss ka wada muttaqi logon  say kiya gaya hai-? woh unn kay liye inaam hogi , aur unn ka aakhri anjam .
verses.translation: kaho kay yeh anjam behtar hai ya hamesha rehney wali jannat , jiss ka wada muttaqi logon  say kiya gaya hai-? woh unn kay liye inaam hogi , aur unn ka aakhri anjam .

verses.text: wahan unhen hamesha hamesha bastay huye her woh cheez milay gi jo woh chahen gay . yeh woh zimma daraana wada hai jo tumharay rab ney apney oopper lazim kerliya hai .
verses.translation: wahan unhen hamesha hamesha bastay huye her woh cheez milay gi jo woh chahen gay . yeh woh zimma daraana wada hai jo tumharay rab ney apney oopper lazim kerliya hai .

verses.text: aur woh din ( enhen yaad dilao ) jab Allah inn ( kafiron ) ko bhi hashar mein jama keray ga aur unn ( maboodon ) ko bhi jinn ki yeh khuda ko chorr ker ibadat kertay thay , aur ( inn kay maboodon say ) kahey ga kay :  kiya tum ney meray inn bandon ko behkaya tha , ya yeh raastay say khud bhatkay thay-?
verses.translation: aur woh din ( enhen yaad dilao ) jab Allah inn ( kafiron ) ko bhi hashar mein jama keray ga aur unn ( maboodon ) ko bhi jinn ki yeh khuda ko chorr ker ibadat kertay thay , aur ( inn kay maboodon say ) kahey ga kay :  kiya tum ney meray inn bandon ko behkaya tha , ya yeh raastay say khud bhatkay thay-?

verses.text: woh kahen gay kay :  aap ki zaat her aeb say pak hai . humari majal nahi thi kay hum aap ko chorr ker doosray rakhwalon kay qaeel hon ,   lekin huwa yeh kay aap ney inn ko aur inn kay baap dadon ko duniya ka saz-o-saman diya , yahan tak kay jo baat yaad rakhni thi , yeh ussay bhula bethay , aur ( iss tarah ) yeh khud barbad ho ker rahey .
verses.translation: woh kahen gay kay :  aap ki zaat her aeb say pak hai . humari majal nahi thi kay hum aap ko chorr ker doosray rakhwalon kay qaeel hon ,   lekin huwa yeh kay aap ney inn ko aur inn kay baap dadon ko duniya ka saz-o-saman diya , yahan tak kay jo baat yaad rakhni thi , yeh ussay bhula bethay , aur ( iss tarah ) yeh khud barbad ho ker rahey .

verses.text: lo , ( aey kafiro ! ) enhon ney to tumhari woh sari baaten jhutla den jo tum kaha kertay ho . abb naa ( azab ko ) taalna tumharay bus mein hai , naa koi madad hasil kerna . aur tum mein say jo koi zulm ka murtakib hai , hum ussay baray bhari azab ka maza chakhayen gay .
verses.translation: lo , ( aey kafiro ! ) enhon ney to tumhari woh sari baaten jhutla den jo tum kaha kertay ho . abb naa ( azab ko ) taalna tumharay bus mein hai , naa koi madad hasil kerna . aur tum mein say jo koi zulm ka murtakib hai , hum ussay baray bhari azab ka maza chakhayen gay .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum say pehlay jitney payghumber bhejay , woh sabb aesay thay kay khana bhi khatay thay , aur bazaron mein bhi chaltay phirtay thay , aur hum ney tum logon  ko aik doosray ki aazmaesh ka zariya banaya hai . batao kiya sabar kero gay-?   aur tumhara perwerdigar her baat dekh raha hai .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum say pehlay jitney payghumber bhejay , woh sabb aesay thay kay khana bhi khatay thay , aur bazaron mein bhi chaltay phirtay thay , aur hum ney tum logon  ko aik doosray ki aazmaesh ka zariya banaya hai . batao kiya sabar kero gay-?   aur tumhara perwerdigar her baat dekh raha hai .

verses.text: jinn logon  ko yeh tawaqqo hi nahi hai kay woh ( kissi waqt ) hum say aa-milen gay , woh yun kehtay hain kay :  hum per farishtay kiyon nahi utaray jatay-? ya phir aisa kiyon nahi hota kay hum khud apney perwerdigar ko dekh len-?  haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh apney dilon mein apney aap ko boht bara samjhay huye hain ,   aur enhon ney bari sarkashi ikhtiyar ki hoi hai .
verses.translation: jinn logon  ko yeh tawaqqo hi nahi hai kay woh ( kissi waqt ) hum say aa-milen gay , woh yun kehtay hain kay :  hum per farishtay kiyon nahi utaray jatay-? ya phir aisa kiyon nahi hota kay hum khud apney perwerdigar ko dekh len-?  haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh apney dilon mein apney aap ko boht bara samjhay huye hain ,   aur enhon ney bari sarkashi ikhtiyar ki hoi hai .

verses.text: jiss din inn ko farishtay nazar aagaye , uss din inn mujrimon kay liye koi khushi ka moaqa nahi hoga , balkay yeh kehtay phiren gay kay khudaya ! hamen aesi panah dey kay yeh hum say door hojayen .
verses.translation: jiss din inn ko farishtay nazar aagaye , uss din inn mujrimon kay liye koi khushi ka moaqa nahi hoga , balkay yeh kehtay phiren gay kay khudaya ! hamen aesi panah dey kay yeh hum say door hojayen .

verses.text: aur enhon ney ( duniya mein ) jo amal kiye hain , hum unn ka faisla kernay per ayen gay to enhen fizza mein bikhray huye gard o ghubar ( ki tarah bey qeemat ) bana den gay .
verses.translation: aur enhon ney ( duniya mein ) jo amal kiye hain , hum unn ka faisla kernay per ayen gay to enhen fizza mein bikhray huye gard o ghubar ( ki tarah bey qeemat ) bana den gay .

verses.text: uss din jannati log hon gay jinn ka mustaqar bhi behtareen hoga , aur aaram gaah bhi khoob hogi .
verses.translation: uss din jannati log hon gay jinn ka mustaqar bhi behtareen hoga , aur aaram gaah bhi khoob hogi .

verses.text: aur jiss din aasman phatt ker aik badal ko raah dey ga , aur farishtay iss tarah utaray jayen gay kay unn ka taar bandh jaye ga .
verses.translation: aur jiss din aasman phatt ker aik badal ko raah dey ga , aur farishtay iss tarah utaray jayen gay kay unn ka taar bandh jaye ga .

verses.text: uss din sahih maani mein badshahi khudaye rehman ki hogi , aur woh din kafiron per boht sakht hoga .
verses.translation: uss din sahih maani mein badshahi khudaye rehman ki hogi , aur woh din kafiron per boht sakht hoga .

verses.text: aur jiss din zalim insan ( hasrat say ) apney haathon ko kaat khaye ga , aur kahey ga :  kaash mein ney payghumber ki hamraahi ikhtiyar kerli hoti !
verses.translation: aur jiss din zalim insan ( hasrat say ) apney haathon ko kaat khaye ga , aur kahey ga :  kaash mein ney payghumber ki hamraahi ikhtiyar kerli hoti !

verses.text: haaye meri barbadi ! kaash mein ney falan shaks ko dost naa banaya hota !
verses.translation: haaye meri barbadi ! kaash mein ney falan shaks ko dost naa banaya hota !

verses.text: meray paas naseehat aa-chuki thi , magar iss ( dost ) ney mujhay uss say bhatka diya .  aur shetan to hai hi aisa kay waqt parrney per insan ko bey kass chorr jata hai .
verses.translation: meray paas naseehat aa-chuki thi , magar iss ( dost ) ney mujhay uss say bhatka diya .  aur shetan to hai hi aisa kay waqt parrney per insan ko bey kass chorr jata hai .

verses.text: aur Rasool ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) kahen gay kay :  ya rab ! meri qoam iss Quran ko bilkul chorr bethi thi .
verses.translation: aur Rasool ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) kahen gay kay :  ya rab ! meri qoam iss Quran ko bilkul chorr bethi thi .

verses.text: aur hum ney issi tarah mujrim logon  ko her nabi ka dushman banaya hai .   aur tumhara perwerdigar hidayat denay aur madad kernay kay liye kafi hai .
verses.translation: aur hum ney issi tarah mujrim logon  ko her nabi ka dushman banaya hai .   aur tumhara perwerdigar hidayat denay aur madad kernay kay liye kafi hai .

verses.text: aur yeh kafir log kehtay hain kay :  inn per sara Quran aik hi dafa mein kiyon nazil nahi kerdiya gaya-?  ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney aisa iss liye kiya hai takay iss kay zariye tumhara dil mazboot rakhen ,   aur hum ney issay thehar thehar ker parhwaya hai .
verses.translation: aur yeh kafir log kehtay hain kay :  inn per sara Quran aik hi dafa mein kiyon nazil nahi kerdiya gaya-?  ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney aisa iss liye kiya hai takay iss kay zariye tumhara dil mazboot rakhen ,   aur hum ney issay thehar thehar ker parhwaya hai .

verses.text: aur jab kabhi yeh log tumharay paas koi anokhi baat ley ker aatay hain , hum tumhen ( uss ka ) theek theek jawab aur ziyada wazahat kay sath ata ker-detay hain .
verses.translation: aur jab kabhi yeh log tumharay paas koi anokhi baat ley ker aatay hain , hum tumhen ( uss ka ) theek theek jawab aur ziyada wazahat kay sath ata ker-detay hain .

verses.text: jinn logon  ko gher ker mun kay ball dozakh ki taraf ley jaya jaye ga , woh bad-tareen maqam per hain , aur unn ka raasta bad-tareen gumrahi ka raasta hai .
verses.translation: jinn logon  ko gher ker mun kay ball dozakh ki taraf ley jaya jaye ga , woh bad-tareen maqam per hain , aur unn ka raasta bad-tareen gumrahi ka raasta hai .

verses.text: beyshak hum ney musa ko kitab di thi , aur unn kay sath unn kay bhai Haroon ko madadgaar kay tor per muqarrar kiya tha .
verses.translation: beyshak hum ney musa ko kitab di thi , aur unn kay sath unn kay bhai Haroon ko madadgaar kay tor per muqarrar kiya tha .

verses.text: chunacheh hum ney kaha tha kay :  tum dono unn logon  kay paas jao jinhon ney humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya hai .  aakhir nateeja yeh huwa kay hum ney unn ko tabah ker kay neest o na-bood kerdiya .
verses.translation: chunacheh hum ney kaha tha kay :  tum dono unn logon  kay paas jao jinhon ney humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya hai .  aakhir nateeja yeh huwa kay hum ney unn ko tabah ker kay neest o na-bood kerdiya .

verses.text: aur nooh ki qoam ney jab payghumberon ko jhutlaya to hum ney unhen gharq kerdiya , aur unn ko logon  kay liye ibrat ka saman bana diya . aur hum ney unn zalimon kay liye aik dardnak azab tayyar ker rakha hai .
verses.translation: aur nooh ki qoam ney jab payghumberon ko jhutlaya to hum ney unhen gharq kerdiya , aur unn ko logon  kay liye ibrat ka saman bana diya . aur hum ney unn zalimon kay liye aik dardnak azab tayyar ker rakha hai .

verses.text: issi tarah hum ney aad o samood aur ashaab-ur-Rass   ko aur unn kay darmiyan boht si naslon ko tabah kiya .
verses.translation: issi tarah hum ney aad o samood aur ashaab-ur-Rass   ko aur unn kay darmiyan boht si naslon ko tabah kiya .

verses.text: unn mein say her aik ko samjhaney kay liye hum ney misalen den , aur ( jab woh naa maaney to ) her aik ko hum ney pees ker rakh diya .
verses.translation: unn mein say her aik ko samjhaney kay liye hum ney misalen den , aur ( jab woh naa maaney to ) her aik ko hum ney pees ker rakh diya .

verses.text: aur yeh ( kuffaar-e-makkah ) uss basti say ho ker guzartay rahey hain jiss per buri tarah ( pathraon ki ) barish barsai gaee thi .   bhala kiya yeh uss basti ko dekhtay nahi rahey-? ( phir bhi enhen ibrat nahi hoi ) balkay inn kay dil mein doosri zindagi ka andesha tak peda nahi huwa .
verses.translation: aur yeh ( kuffaar-e-makkah ) uss basti say ho ker guzartay rahey hain jiss per buri tarah ( pathraon ki ) barish barsai gaee thi .   bhala kiya yeh uss basti ko dekhtay nahi rahey-? ( phir bhi enhen ibrat nahi hoi ) balkay inn kay dil mein doosri zindagi ka andesha tak peda nahi huwa .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab yeh log tumhen dekhtay hain to inn ka koi kaam iss kay siwa nahi hota kay yeh tumhara mazaq banatay hain kay :  kiya yehi woh sahab hain jinhen Allah ney payghumber bana ker bheja hai ?
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab yeh log tumhen dekhtay hain to inn ka koi kaam iss kay siwa nahi hota kay yeh tumhara mazaq banatay hain kay :  kiya yehi woh sahab hain jinhen Allah ney payghumber bana ker bheja hai ?

verses.text: agar hum apney khudaon ( ki aqeedat ) per mazbooti say jamay naa rehtay to inn sahab ney to hamen unn say bhatkaney mein koi kasar nahi chorri thi .  ( jo log yeh baaten keh rahey hain ) jab unhen azab aankhon say nazar aajaye ga tab unhen pata chalay ga kay kon raastay say bilkul bhatka huwa tha-?
verses.translation: agar hum apney khudaon ( ki aqeedat ) per mazbooti say jamay naa rehtay to inn sahab ney to hamen unn say bhatkaney mein koi kasar nahi chorri thi .  ( jo log yeh baaten keh rahey hain ) jab unhen azab aankhon say nazar aajaye ga tab unhen pata chalay ga kay kon raastay say bilkul bhatka huwa tha-?

verses.text: bhala batao jiss shaks ney apna khuda apni nafsani khuwaish ko bana liya ho , to ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya tum uss ki zimma daari ley saktay ho-?
verses.translation: bhala batao jiss shaks ney apna khuda apni nafsani khuwaish ko bana liya ho , to ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya tum uss ki zimma daari ley saktay ho-?

verses.text: ya tumhara khayal yeh hai kay inn mein say aksar log suntay ya samajhtay hain-? nahi ! inn ki misal to bus chaar paon kay janweron ki si hai , balkay yeh unn say ziyada raah say bhatkay huye hain .
verses.translation: ya tumhara khayal yeh hai kay inn mein say aksar log suntay ya samajhtay hain-? nahi ! inn ki misal to bus chaar paon kay janweron ki si hai , balkay yeh unn say ziyada raah say bhatkay huye hain .

verses.text: kiya tum ney apney perwerdigar ( ki qudrat ) ko nahi dekha kay woh kiss tarah saye ko phelata hai-? aur agar woh chahta to ussay aik jagah thehra deta . phir hum ney sooraj ko uss kay liye rehnuma bana diya hai .
verses.translation: kiya tum ney apney perwerdigar ( ki qudrat ) ko nahi dekha kay woh kiss tarah saye ko phelata hai-? aur agar woh chahta to ussay aik jagah thehra deta . phir hum ney sooraj ko uss kay liye rehnuma bana diya hai .

verses.text: phir hum ussay thora thora ker kay apni taraf samett letay hain .
verses.translation: phir hum ussay thora thora ker kay apni taraf samett letay hain .

verses.text: aur wohi hai jiss ney tumharay liye raat ko libas banaya , aur neend ko sarapa sukoon , aur din ko dobara uth kharray honey ka zariya bana diya .
verses.translation: aur wohi hai jiss ney tumharay liye raat ko libas banaya , aur neend ko sarapa sukoon , aur din ko dobara uth kharray honey ka zariya bana diya .

verses.text: aur wohi hai jiss ney apni rehmat ( yani barish ) say pehlay hawayen bhejen jo ( barish ki ) khushkhabri ley ker aati hain , aur hum ney hi aasman say pakeezah paani utaara hai ,
verses.translation: aur wohi hai jiss ney apni rehmat ( yani barish ) say pehlay hawayen bhejen jo ( barish ki ) khushkhabri ley ker aati hain , aur hum ney hi aasman say pakeezah paani utaara hai ,

verses.text: takay hum uss kay zariye murda zameen ko zindagi bakhshen , aur apni makhlooq mein say boht say maweshiyon aur insanon ko uss say sairaab keren .
verses.translation: takay hum uss kay zariye murda zameen ko zindagi bakhshen , aur apni makhlooq mein say boht say maweshiyon aur insanon ko uss say sairaab keren .

verses.text: aur hum ney logon  kay faeeday kay liye uss ( paani ) ki ulat pher ker rakhi hai ,   takay woh sabaq hasil keren . lekin aksar log nashukri kay siwa her baat say inkari hain .
verses.translation: aur hum ney logon  kay faeeday kay liye uss ( paani ) ki ulat pher ker rakhi hai ,   takay woh sabaq hasil keren . lekin aksar log nashukri kay siwa her baat say inkari hain .

verses.text: aur agar hum chahtay to her basti mein aik alag aagah kernay wala ( payghumber ) bhej detay .
verses.translation: aur agar hum chahtay to her basti mein aik alag aagah kernay wala ( payghumber ) bhej detay .

verses.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn kafiron ka kehna naa maano , aur iss Quran kay zariye unn kay khilaf poori quooat say jidojehad kero .
verses.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn kafiron ka kehna naa maano , aur iss Quran kay zariye unn kay khilaf poori quooat say jidojehad kero .

verses.text: aur wohi hai jiss ney do daryaon ko iss tarah mila ker chalaya hai kay aik meetha hai jiss say taskeen milti hai , aur aik namkeen hai , sakht karrwa . aur inn dono kay darmiyan aik aarr aur aesi rukawat haeel kerdi hai jiss ko ( dono mein say ) koi uboor nahi ker-sakta .
verses.translation: aur wohi hai jiss ney do daryaon ko iss tarah mila ker chalaya hai kay aik meetha hai jiss say taskeen milti hai , aur aik namkeen hai , sakht karrwa . aur inn dono kay darmiyan aik aarr aur aesi rukawat haeel kerdi hai jiss ko ( dono mein say ) koi uboor nahi ker-sakta .

verses.text: aur wohi hai jiss ney paani say insan ko peda kiya , phir uss ko nasbi aur susrali rishtay ata kiye , aur tumhara perwerdigar bari qudrat wala hai .
verses.translation: aur wohi hai jiss ney paani say insan ko peda kiya , phir uss ko nasbi aur susrali rishtay ata kiye , aur tumhara perwerdigar bari qudrat wala hai .

verses.text: aur yeh log hain kay Allah ko chorr ker aesi cheezon ki ibadat ker rahey hain jo naa inn ko koi faeeda phonchati hain , naa nuqsan . aur kafir insan ney apney perwerdigar hi ki mukhalifat per kamar baandh rakhi hai .
verses.translation: aur yeh log hain kay Allah ko chorr ker aesi cheezon ki ibadat ker rahey hain jo naa inn ko koi faeeda phonchati hain , naa nuqsan . aur kafir insan ney apney perwerdigar hi ki mukhalifat per kamar baandh rakhi hai .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen kissi aur kaam kay liye nahi , balkay iss liye bheja hai kay tum logon  ko khushkhabri do , aur khabrdar kero .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen kissi aur kaam kay liye nahi , balkay iss liye bheja hai kay tum logon  ko khushkhabri do , aur khabrdar kero .

verses.text: keh do kay :  mein iss kaam per tum say koi ujrat nahi maangta , haan jo shaks yeh chahye kay apney rab tak phonchney ka raasta ikhtiyar kerlay ( to yehi meri ujrat hai )
verses.translation: keh do kay :  mein iss kaam per tum say koi ujrat nahi maangta , haan jo shaks yeh chahye kay apney rab tak phonchney ka raasta ikhtiyar kerlay ( to yehi meri ujrat hai )

verses.text: aur tum uss zaat per bharosa rakho jo zinda hai , jissay kabhi moat nahi aaye gi , aur ussi ki hamd kay sath tasbeeh kertay raho , aur woh apney bandon kay gunahon ki khabar rakhney kay liye kafi hai .
verses.translation: aur tum uss zaat per bharosa rakho jo zinda hai , jissay kabhi moat nahi aaye gi , aur ussi ki hamd kay sath tasbeeh kertay raho , aur woh apney bandon kay gunahon ki khabar rakhney kay liye kafi hai .

verses.text: woh zaat jiss ney cheh din mein saray aasman aur zameen aur unn kay darmiyan ki cheezen peda ken, phir uss ney arsh per istawa farmaya ,   woh rehman hai , iss liye uss ki shaan kissi janney walay say poocho .
verses.translation: woh zaat jiss ney cheh din mein saray aasman aur zameen aur unn kay darmiyan ki cheezen peda ken, phir uss ney arsh per istawa farmaya ,   woh rehman hai , iss liye uss ki shaan kissi janney walay say poocho .

verses.text: aur jab inn logon  say kaha jata hai kay rehman ko sajda kero to yeh kehtay hain kay :  rehman kiya hota hai-? kiya jissay bhi tum keh do , hum ussay sajda kiya keren-?    aur iss baat say woh aur ziyada bidakney lagtay hain .
verses.translation: aur jab inn logon  say kaha jata hai kay rehman ko sajda kero to yeh kehtay hain kay :  rehman kiya hota hai-? kiya jissay bhi tum keh do , hum ussay sajda kiya keren-?    aur iss baat say woh aur ziyada bidakney lagtay hain .

verses.text: bari shaan hai uss ki jiss ney aasman mein burj banaye .   aur uss mein aik roshan chiragh aur noor phelaney wala chaand peda kiya .
verses.translation: bari shaan hai uss ki jiss ney aasman mein burj banaye .   aur uss mein aik roshan chiragh aur noor phelaney wala chaand peda kiya .

verses.text: aur wohi hai jiss ney raat aur din ko aisa banaya kay woh aik doosray kay peechay chalay aatay hain , ( magar yeh sari baaten ) uss shaks kay liye ( kaar-aamad hain ) jo naseehat hasil kernay ka irada rakhta ho ya shukar baja lana chahta ho .
verses.translation: aur wohi hai jiss ney raat aur din ko aisa banaya kay woh aik doosray kay peechay chalay aatay hain , ( magar yeh sari baaten ) uss shaks kay liye ( kaar-aamad hain ) jo naseehat hasil kernay ka irada rakhta ho ya shukar baja lana chahta ho .

verses.text: aur rehman kay banday woh hain jo zameen per aajzi say chaltay hain , aur jab jahil log unn say ( jahilana ) khitab kertay hain to woh salamti ki baat kehtay hain .
verses.translation: aur rehman kay banday woh hain jo zameen per aajzi say chaltay hain , aur jab jahil log unn say ( jahilana ) khitab kertay hain to woh salamti ki baat kehtay hain .

verses.text: aur jo raaten iss tarah guzaartay hain kay apney perwerdigar kay aagay ( kabhi ) sajday mein hotay hain , aur ( kabhi ) qayam mein .
verses.translation: aur jo raaten iss tarah guzaartay hain kay apney perwerdigar kay aagay ( kabhi ) sajday mein hotay hain , aur ( kabhi ) qayam mein .

verses.text: aur jo yeh kehtay hain kay :  humaray perwerdigar ! jahannum kay azab ko hum say door rakhiye . haqeeqat yeh hai kay uss ka azab woh tabahi hai jo chimat ker reh jati hai .
verses.translation: aur jo yeh kehtay hain kay :  humaray perwerdigar ! jahannum kay azab ko hum say door rakhiye . haqeeqat yeh hai kay uss ka azab woh tabahi hai jo chimat ker reh jati hai .

verses.text: yaqeenan woh kissi ka mustaqar aur qayam gaah banney kay liye bad-tareen jagah hai .
verses.translation: yaqeenan woh kissi ka mustaqar aur qayam gaah banney kay liye bad-tareen jagah hai .

verses.text: aur jo kharch kertay hain to naa fuzool kharchi kertay hain , naa tangi kertay hain , balkay unn ka tareeqa iss ( ifraat o tafreet ) kay darmiyan aetidaal ka tareeqa hai .
verses.translation: aur jo kharch kertay hain to naa fuzool kharchi kertay hain , naa tangi kertay hain , balkay unn ka tareeqa iss ( ifraat o tafreet ) kay darmiyan aetidaal ka tareeqa hai .

verses.text: aur jo Allah kay sath kissi bhi doosray mabood ki ibadat nahi kertay , aur jiss jaan ko Allah ney hurmat bakhshi hai , ussay nahaq qatal nahi kertay , aur naa woh zina kertay hain . aur jo shaks bhi yeh kaam keray ga , ussay apney gunah kay wabal ka samna kerna parray ga .
verses.translation: aur jo Allah kay sath kissi bhi doosray mabood ki ibadat nahi kertay , aur jiss jaan ko Allah ney hurmat bakhshi hai , ussay nahaq qatal nahi kertay , aur naa woh zina kertay hain . aur jo shaks bhi yeh kaam keray ga , ussay apney gunah kay wabal ka samna kerna parray ga .

verses.text: qayamat kay din uss ka azab barha barha ker dugna kerdiya jaye ga , aur woh zaleel ho ker uss azab mein hamesha hamesha rahey ga .
verses.translation: qayamat kay din uss ka azab barha barha ker dugna kerdiya jaye ga , aur woh zaleel ho ker uss azab mein hamesha hamesha rahey ga .

verses.text: haan magar jo koi tauba kerlay , emaan ley aaye , aur naik amal keray to Allah aesay logon  ki buraiyon ko naikiyon mein tabdeel kerday ga ,   aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: haan magar jo koi tauba kerlay , emaan ley aaye , aur naik amal keray to Allah aesay logon  ki buraiyon ko naikiyon mein tabdeel kerday ga ,   aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: aur jo koi tauba kerta aur naik amal kerta hai to woh dar-haqeeqat Allah ki taraf theek theek loat aata hai .
verses.translation: aur jo koi tauba kerta aur naik amal kerta hai to woh dar-haqeeqat Allah ki taraf theek theek loat aata hai .

verses.text: aur ( rehman kay banday woh hain ) jo nahaq kamon mein shamil nahi hotay ,   aur jab kissi laghw cheez kay paas say guzartay hain to waqar kay sath guzar jatay hain .
verses.translation: aur ( rehman kay banday woh hain ) jo nahaq kamon mein shamil nahi hotay ,   aur jab kissi laghw cheez kay paas say guzartay hain to waqar kay sath guzar jatay hain .

verses.text: aur jab unhen apney rab ki aayaat kay zariye naseehat ki jati hai to woh unn per behray aur andhay ban ker nahi girtay .
verses.translation: aur jab unhen apney rab ki aayaat kay zariye naseehat ki jati hai to woh unn per behray aur andhay ban ker nahi girtay .

verses.text: aur jo ( dua kertay huye ) kehtay hain kay :  humaray perwerdigar ! hamen apni biwi bacchon say aankhon ki thandak ata farma , aur hamen perhezgaron ka sarbarah bana dey .
verses.translation: aur jo ( dua kertay huye ) kehtay hain kay :  humaray perwerdigar ! hamen apni biwi bacchon say aankhon ki thandak ata farma , aur hamen perhezgaron ka sarbarah bana dey .

verses.text: yeh log hain jinhen unn kay sabar kay badlay jannat kay bala-khaney ata hon gay , aur wahan duaon aur salam say unn ka istaqbal kiya jaye ga .
verses.translation: yeh log hain jinhen unn kay sabar kay badlay jannat kay bala-khaney ata hon gay , aur wahan duaon aur salam say unn ka istaqbal kiya jaye ga .

verses.text: woh wahan hamesha zinda rahen gay . kissi ka mustaqar aur qayam gaah banney kay liye woh behtareen jagah hai .
verses.translation: woh wahan hamesha zinda rahen gay . kissi ka mustaqar aur qayam gaah banney kay liye woh behtareen jagah hai .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! logon  say ) keh do kay :  meray perwerdigar ko tumhari zara bhi perwa naa hoti , agar tum uss ko naa pukartay .   abb jabkay ( aey kafiro ! ) tum ney haq ko jhutla diya hai to yeh jhutlana tumharay galay parr ker rahey ga .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! logon  say ) keh do kay :  meray perwerdigar ko tumhari zara bhi perwa naa hoti , agar tum uss ko naa pukartay .   abb jabkay ( aey kafiro ! ) tum ney haq ko jhutla diya hai to yeh jhutlana tumharay galay parr ker rahey ga .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: bari shaan hai uss zaat ki jiss ney apney banday per haq o batil ka faisla ker-denay wali yeh kitab nazil ki , takay woh duniya jahan kay logon  ko khabrdar kerday .
ayahs.translation: bari shaan hai uss zaat ki jiss ney apney banday per haq o batil ka faisla ker-denay wali yeh kitab nazil ki , takay woh duniya jahan kay logon  ko khabrdar kerday .

ayahs.text: woh zaat jo aasmano aur zameen ki badshahat ki tanha malik hai aur jiss ney naa to koi beta banaya hai , aur naa uss ki badshahat mein koi shareek hai , aur jiss ney her cheez ko peda ker kay uss ko aik napa tula andaz ata kiya hai .
ayahs.translation: woh zaat jo aasmano aur zameen ki badshahat ki tanha malik hai aur jiss ney naa to koi beta banaya hai , aur naa uss ki badshahat mein koi shareek hai , aur jiss ney her cheez ko peda ker kay uss ko aik napa tula andaz ata kiya hai .

ayahs.text: aur logon  ney ussay chorr ker aesay khuda bana rakhay hain jo kuch peda nahi kertay , balkay khud peda kiye jatay hain , aur jinn ka khud apney nuqsan ya faeeday per bhi koi bus nahi chalta , aur naa kissi ka marna ya jeena unn kay ikhtiyar mein hai , naa kissi ko dobara zinda kerna .
ayahs.translation: aur logon  ney ussay chorr ker aesay khuda bana rakhay hain jo kuch peda nahi kertay , balkay khud peda kiye jatay hain , aur jinn ka khud apney nuqsan ya faeeday per bhi koi bus nahi chalta , aur naa kissi ka marna ya jeena unn kay ikhtiyar mein hai , naa kissi ko dobara zinda kerna .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  yeh ( Quran ) to kuch bhi nahi , bus aik mann gharrat cheez hai jo iss shaks ney gharr li hai , aur iss kaam mein kuch aur log bhi uss kay madadgaar banay hain .    iss tarah ( yeh baat keh ker ) yeh log baray zulm aur khulay jhoot per utar aaye hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  yeh ( Quran ) to kuch bhi nahi , bus aik mann gharrat cheez hai jo iss shaks ney gharr li hai , aur iss kaam mein kuch aur log bhi uss kay madadgaar banay hain .    iss tarah ( yeh baat keh ker ) yeh log baray zulm aur khulay jhoot per utar aaye hain .

ayahs.text: aur kehtay hain kay :  yeh to pichlay logon  ki likhi hoi kahaniyan hain jo iss shaks ney likhwali hain , aur subha o shaam wohi iss kay samney parh ker sunai jati hain .
ayahs.translation: aur kehtay hain kay :  yeh to pichlay logon  ki likhi hoi kahaniyan hain jo iss shaks ney likhwali hain , aur subha o shaam wohi iss kay samney parh ker sunai jati hain .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  yeh kalam to uss ( Allah ) ney nazil kiya hai jo her bhed ko poori tarah janta hai , aasmano mein bhi , zameen mein bhi . beyshak woh boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  yeh kalam to uss ( Allah ) ney nazil kiya hai jo her bhed ko poori tarah janta hai , aasmano mein bhi , zameen mein bhi . beyshak woh boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kehtay hain kay :  yeh kaisa Rasool hai jo khana bhi khata hai , aur bazaron mein bhi chalta phirta hai ? iss kay paas koi farishta kiyon nahi bheja gaya jo iss kay sath reh ker logon  ko darata-?
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kehtay hain kay :  yeh kaisa Rasool hai jo khana bhi khata hai , aur bazaron mein bhi chalta phirta hai ? iss kay paas koi farishta kiyon nahi bheja gaya jo iss kay sath reh ker logon  ko darata-?

ayahs.text: ya iss kay oopper koi khazana hi aa-parta , ya iss kay paas koi baagh hota jiss mein say yeh khaya kerta .  aur yeh zalim ( musalmanon say ) kehtay hain kay :  tum jiss kay peechay chal rahey ho , woh aur kuch nahi , bus aik shaks hai jiss per jadoo hogaya hai .
ayahs.translation: ya iss kay oopper koi khazana hi aa-parta , ya iss kay paas koi baagh hota jiss mein say yeh khaya kerta .  aur yeh zalim ( musalmanon say ) kehtay hain kay :  tum jiss kay peechay chal rahey ho , woh aur kuch nahi , bus aik shaks hai jiss per jadoo hogaya hai .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) dekho inn logon  ney tumharay baaray mein kaisi kaisi baaten banai hain , chunacheh aesay bhatkay hain kay raastay per aana inn kay bus say bahir hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) dekho inn logon  ney tumharay baaray mein kaisi kaisi baaten banai hain , chunacheh aesay bhatkay hain kay raastay per aana inn kay bus say bahir hai .

ayahs.text: bari shaan hai uss ( Allah ) ki jo agar chahye to tumhen inn sabb say kahen behtar cheez , ( aik baagh kay bajaye ) boht say baaghaat deydey jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon , aur tumhen boht say mehalaat ka malik bana dey .
ayahs.translation: bari shaan hai uss ( Allah ) ki jo agar chahye to tumhen inn sabb say kahen behtar cheez , ( aik baagh kay bajaye ) boht say baaghaat deydey jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon , aur tumhen boht say mehalaat ka malik bana dey .

ayahs.text: asal haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn logon  ney qayamat ki gharri ko jhutlaya huwa hai ,   aur jo koi qayamat ki gharri ko jhutlaye , uss kay liye hum ney bharakti hoi aag tayyar ker rakhi hai .
ayahs.translation: asal haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn logon  ney qayamat ki gharri ko jhutlaya huwa hai ,   aur jo koi qayamat ki gharri ko jhutlaye , uss kay liye hum ney bharakti hoi aag tayyar ker rakhi hai .

ayahs.text: jab woh unn ko door say dekhay gi to yeh log uss kay bipharney aur phunkarney ki aawazen sunen gay .
ayahs.translation: jab woh unn ko door say dekhay gi to yeh log uss kay bipharney aur phunkarney ki aawazen sunen gay .

ayahs.text: aur jab inn ko achi tarah baandh ker uss ki aik tang jagah mein phenka jaye ga to wahan yeh moat ko aawaz dey ker pukaren gay .
ayahs.translation: aur jab inn ko achi tarah baandh ker uss ki aik tang jagah mein phenka jaye ga to wahan yeh moat ko aawaz dey ker pukaren gay .

ayahs.text: . ( uss waqt inn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  aaj tum moat ko sirf aik baar naa pukaro , balkay baar baar moat ko pukartay hi raho .
ayahs.translation: . ( uss waqt inn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  aaj tum moat ko sirf aik baar naa pukaro , balkay baar baar moat ko pukartay hi raho .

ayahs.text: kaho kay yeh anjam behtar hai ya hamesha rehney wali jannat , jiss ka wada muttaqi logon  say kiya gaya hai-? woh unn kay liye inaam hogi , aur unn ka aakhri anjam .
ayahs.translation: kaho kay yeh anjam behtar hai ya hamesha rehney wali jannat , jiss ka wada muttaqi logon  say kiya gaya hai-? woh unn kay liye inaam hogi , aur unn ka aakhri anjam .

ayahs.text: wahan unhen hamesha hamesha bastay huye her woh cheez milay gi jo woh chahen gay . yeh woh zimma daraana wada hai jo tumharay rab ney apney oopper lazim kerliya hai .
ayahs.translation: wahan unhen hamesha hamesha bastay huye her woh cheez milay gi jo woh chahen gay . yeh woh zimma daraana wada hai jo tumharay rab ney apney oopper lazim kerliya hai .

ayahs.text: aur woh din ( enhen yaad dilao ) jab Allah inn ( kafiron ) ko bhi hashar mein jama keray ga aur unn ( maboodon ) ko bhi jinn ki yeh khuda ko chorr ker ibadat kertay thay , aur ( inn kay maboodon say ) kahey ga kay :  kiya tum ney meray inn bandon ko behkaya tha , ya yeh raastay say khud bhatkay thay-?
