ayahs.translation: aur woh din ( enhen yaad dilao ) jab Allah inn ( kafiron ) ko bhi hashar mein jama keray ga aur unn ( maboodon ) ko bhi jinn ki yeh khuda ko chorr ker ibadat kertay thay , aur ( inn kay maboodon say ) kahey ga kay :  kiya tum ney meray inn bandon ko behkaya tha , ya yeh raastay say khud bhatkay thay-?

ayahs.text: woh kahen gay kay :  aap ki zaat her aeb say pak hai . humari majal nahi thi kay hum aap ko chorr ker doosray rakhwalon kay qaeel hon ,   lekin huwa yeh kay aap ney inn ko aur inn kay baap dadon ko duniya ka saz-o-saman diya , yahan tak kay jo baat yaad rakhni thi , yeh ussay bhula bethay , aur ( iss tarah ) yeh khud barbad ho ker rahey .
ayahs.translation: woh kahen gay kay :  aap ki zaat her aeb say pak hai . humari majal nahi thi kay hum aap ko chorr ker doosray rakhwalon kay qaeel hon ,   lekin huwa yeh kay aap ney inn ko aur inn kay baap dadon ko duniya ka saz-o-saman diya , yahan tak kay jo baat yaad rakhni thi , yeh ussay bhula bethay , aur ( iss tarah ) yeh khud barbad ho ker rahey .

ayahs.text: lo , ( aey kafiro ! ) enhon ney to tumhari woh sari baaten jhutla den jo tum kaha kertay ho . abb naa ( azab ko ) taalna tumharay bus mein hai , naa koi madad hasil kerna . aur tum mein say jo koi zulm ka murtakib hai , hum ussay baray bhari azab ka maza chakhayen gay .
ayahs.translation: lo , ( aey kafiro ! ) enhon ney to tumhari woh sari baaten jhutla den jo tum kaha kertay ho . abb naa ( azab ko ) taalna tumharay bus mein hai , naa koi madad hasil kerna . aur tum mein say jo koi zulm ka murtakib hai , hum ussay baray bhari azab ka maza chakhayen gay .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum say pehlay jitney payghumber bhejay , woh sabb aesay thay kay khana bhi khatay thay , aur bazaron mein bhi chaltay phirtay thay , aur hum ney tum logon  ko aik doosray ki aazmaesh ka zariya banaya hai . batao kiya sabar kero gay-?   aur tumhara perwerdigar her baat dekh raha hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum say pehlay jitney payghumber bhejay , woh sabb aesay thay kay khana bhi khatay thay , aur bazaron mein bhi chaltay phirtay thay , aur hum ney tum logon  ko aik doosray ki aazmaesh ka zariya banaya hai . batao kiya sabar kero gay-?   aur tumhara perwerdigar her baat dekh raha hai .

ayahs.text: jinn logon  ko yeh tawaqqo hi nahi hai kay woh ( kissi waqt ) hum say aa-milen gay , woh yun kehtay hain kay :  hum per farishtay kiyon nahi utaray jatay-? ya phir aisa kiyon nahi hota kay hum khud apney perwerdigar ko dekh len-?  haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh apney dilon mein apney aap ko boht bara samjhay huye hain ,   aur enhon ney bari sarkashi ikhtiyar ki hoi hai .
ayahs.translation: jinn logon  ko yeh tawaqqo hi nahi hai kay woh ( kissi waqt ) hum say aa-milen gay , woh yun kehtay hain kay :  hum per farishtay kiyon nahi utaray jatay-? ya phir aisa kiyon nahi hota kay hum khud apney perwerdigar ko dekh len-?  haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh apney dilon mein apney aap ko boht bara samjhay huye hain ,   aur enhon ney bari sarkashi ikhtiyar ki hoi hai .

ayahs.text: jiss din inn ko farishtay nazar aagaye , uss din inn mujrimon kay liye koi khushi ka moaqa nahi hoga , balkay yeh kehtay phiren gay kay khudaya ! hamen aesi panah dey kay yeh hum say door hojayen .
ayahs.translation: jiss din inn ko farishtay nazar aagaye , uss din inn mujrimon kay liye koi khushi ka moaqa nahi hoga , balkay yeh kehtay phiren gay kay khudaya ! hamen aesi panah dey kay yeh hum say door hojayen .

ayahs.text: aur enhon ney ( duniya mein ) jo amal kiye hain , hum unn ka faisla kernay per ayen gay to enhen fizza mein bikhray huye gard o ghubar ( ki tarah bey qeemat ) bana den gay .
ayahs.translation: aur enhon ney ( duniya mein ) jo amal kiye hain , hum unn ka faisla kernay per ayen gay to enhen fizza mein bikhray huye gard o ghubar ( ki tarah bey qeemat ) bana den gay .

ayahs.text: uss din jannati log hon gay jinn ka mustaqar bhi behtareen hoga , aur aaram gaah bhi khoob hogi .
ayahs.translation: uss din jannati log hon gay jinn ka mustaqar bhi behtareen hoga , aur aaram gaah bhi khoob hogi .

ayahs.text: aur jiss din aasman phatt ker aik badal ko raah dey ga , aur farishtay iss tarah utaray jayen gay kay unn ka taar bandh jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: aur jiss din aasman phatt ker aik badal ko raah dey ga , aur farishtay iss tarah utaray jayen gay kay unn ka taar bandh jaye ga .

ayahs.text: uss din sahih maani mein badshahi khudaye rehman ki hogi , aur woh din kafiron per boht sakht hoga .
ayahs.translation: uss din sahih maani mein badshahi khudaye rehman ki hogi , aur woh din kafiron per boht sakht hoga .

ayahs.text: aur jiss din zalim insan ( hasrat say ) apney haathon ko kaat khaye ga , aur kahey ga :  kaash mein ney payghumber ki hamraahi ikhtiyar kerli hoti !
ayahs.translation: aur jiss din zalim insan ( hasrat say ) apney haathon ko kaat khaye ga , aur kahey ga :  kaash mein ney payghumber ki hamraahi ikhtiyar kerli hoti !

ayahs.text: haaye meri barbadi ! kaash mein ney falan shaks ko dost naa banaya hota !
ayahs.translation: haaye meri barbadi ! kaash mein ney falan shaks ko dost naa banaya hota !

ayahs.text: meray paas naseehat aa-chuki thi , magar iss ( dost ) ney mujhay uss say bhatka diya .  aur shetan to hai hi aisa kay waqt parrney per insan ko bey kass chorr jata hai .
ayahs.translation: meray paas naseehat aa-chuki thi , magar iss ( dost ) ney mujhay uss say bhatka diya .  aur shetan to hai hi aisa kay waqt parrney per insan ko bey kass chorr jata hai .

ayahs.text: aur Rasool ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) kahen gay kay :  ya rab ! meri qoam iss Quran ko bilkul chorr bethi thi .
ayahs.translation: aur Rasool ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) kahen gay kay :  ya rab ! meri qoam iss Quran ko bilkul chorr bethi thi .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney issi tarah mujrim logon  ko her nabi ka dushman banaya hai .   aur tumhara perwerdigar hidayat denay aur madad kernay kay liye kafi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney issi tarah mujrim logon  ko her nabi ka dushman banaya hai .   aur tumhara perwerdigar hidayat denay aur madad kernay kay liye kafi hai .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kafir log kehtay hain kay :  inn per sara Quran aik hi dafa mein kiyon nazil nahi kerdiya gaya-?  ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney aisa iss liye kiya hai takay iss kay zariye tumhara dil mazboot rakhen ,   aur hum ney issay thehar thehar ker parhwaya hai .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kafir log kehtay hain kay :  inn per sara Quran aik hi dafa mein kiyon nazil nahi kerdiya gaya-?  ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney aisa iss liye kiya hai takay iss kay zariye tumhara dil mazboot rakhen ,   aur hum ney issay thehar thehar ker parhwaya hai .

ayahs.text: aur jab kabhi yeh log tumharay paas koi anokhi baat ley ker aatay hain , hum tumhen ( uss ka ) theek theek jawab aur ziyada wazahat kay sath ata ker-detay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jab kabhi yeh log tumharay paas koi anokhi baat ley ker aatay hain , hum tumhen ( uss ka ) theek theek jawab aur ziyada wazahat kay sath ata ker-detay hain .

ayahs.text: jinn logon  ko gher ker mun kay ball dozakh ki taraf ley jaya jaye ga , woh bad-tareen maqam per hain , aur unn ka raasta bad-tareen gumrahi ka raasta hai .
ayahs.translation: jinn logon  ko gher ker mun kay ball dozakh ki taraf ley jaya jaye ga , woh bad-tareen maqam per hain , aur unn ka raasta bad-tareen gumrahi ka raasta hai .

ayahs.text: beyshak hum ney musa ko kitab di thi , aur unn kay sath unn kay bhai Haroon ko madadgaar kay tor per muqarrar kiya tha .
ayahs.translation: beyshak hum ney musa ko kitab di thi , aur unn kay sath unn kay bhai Haroon ko madadgaar kay tor per muqarrar kiya tha .

ayahs.text: chunacheh hum ney kaha tha kay :  tum dono unn logon  kay paas jao jinhon ney humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya hai .  aakhir nateeja yeh huwa kay hum ney unn ko tabah ker kay neest o na-bood kerdiya .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh hum ney kaha tha kay :  tum dono unn logon  kay paas jao jinhon ney humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya hai .  aakhir nateeja yeh huwa kay hum ney unn ko tabah ker kay neest o na-bood kerdiya .

ayahs.text: aur nooh ki qoam ney jab payghumberon ko jhutlaya to hum ney unhen gharq kerdiya , aur unn ko logon  kay liye ibrat ka saman bana diya . aur hum ney unn zalimon kay liye aik dardnak azab tayyar ker rakha hai .
ayahs.translation: aur nooh ki qoam ney jab payghumberon ko jhutlaya to hum ney unhen gharq kerdiya , aur unn ko logon  kay liye ibrat ka saman bana diya . aur hum ney unn zalimon kay liye aik dardnak azab tayyar ker rakha hai .

ayahs.text: issi tarah hum ney aad o samood aur ashaab-ur-Rass   ko aur unn kay darmiyan boht si naslon ko tabah kiya .
ayahs.translation: issi tarah hum ney aad o samood aur ashaab-ur-Rass   ko aur unn kay darmiyan boht si naslon ko tabah kiya .

ayahs.text: unn mein say her aik ko samjhaney kay liye hum ney misalen den , aur ( jab woh naa maaney to ) her aik ko hum ney pees ker rakh diya .
ayahs.translation: unn mein say her aik ko samjhaney kay liye hum ney misalen den , aur ( jab woh naa maaney to ) her aik ko hum ney pees ker rakh diya .

ayahs.text: aur yeh ( kuffaar-e-makkah ) uss basti say ho ker guzartay rahey hain jiss per buri tarah ( pathraon ki ) barish barsai gaee thi .   bhala kiya yeh uss basti ko dekhtay nahi rahey-? ( phir bhi enhen ibrat nahi hoi ) balkay inn kay dil mein doosri zindagi ka andesha tak peda nahi huwa .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh ( kuffaar-e-makkah ) uss basti say ho ker guzartay rahey hain jiss per buri tarah ( pathraon ki ) barish barsai gaee thi .   bhala kiya yeh uss basti ko dekhtay nahi rahey-? ( phir bhi enhen ibrat nahi hoi ) balkay inn kay dil mein doosri zindagi ka andesha tak peda nahi huwa .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab yeh log tumhen dekhtay hain to inn ka koi kaam iss kay siwa nahi hota kay yeh tumhara mazaq banatay hain kay :  kiya yehi woh sahab hain jinhen Allah ney payghumber bana ker bheja hai ?
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab yeh log tumhen dekhtay hain to inn ka koi kaam iss kay siwa nahi hota kay yeh tumhara mazaq banatay hain kay :  kiya yehi woh sahab hain jinhen Allah ney payghumber bana ker bheja hai ?

ayahs.text: agar hum apney khudaon ( ki aqeedat ) per mazbooti say jamay naa rehtay to inn sahab ney to hamen unn say bhatkaney mein koi kasar nahi chorri thi .  ( jo log yeh baaten keh rahey hain ) jab unhen azab aankhon say nazar aajaye ga tab unhen pata chalay ga kay kon raastay say bilkul bhatka huwa tha-?
ayahs.translation: agar hum apney khudaon ( ki aqeedat ) per mazbooti say jamay naa rehtay to inn sahab ney to hamen unn say bhatkaney mein koi kasar nahi chorri thi .  ( jo log yeh baaten keh rahey hain ) jab unhen azab aankhon say nazar aajaye ga tab unhen pata chalay ga kay kon raastay say bilkul bhatka huwa tha-?

ayahs.text: bhala batao jiss shaks ney apna khuda apni nafsani khuwaish ko bana liya ho , to ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya tum uss ki zimma daari ley saktay ho-?
ayahs.translation: bhala batao jiss shaks ney apna khuda apni nafsani khuwaish ko bana liya ho , to ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya tum uss ki zimma daari ley saktay ho-?

ayahs.text: ya tumhara khayal yeh hai kay inn mein say aksar log suntay ya samajhtay hain-? nahi ! inn ki misal to bus chaar paon kay janweron ki si hai , balkay yeh unn say ziyada raah say bhatkay huye hain .
ayahs.translation: ya tumhara khayal yeh hai kay inn mein say aksar log suntay ya samajhtay hain-? nahi ! inn ki misal to bus chaar paon kay janweron ki si hai , balkay yeh unn say ziyada raah say bhatkay huye hain .

ayahs.text: kiya tum ney apney perwerdigar ( ki qudrat ) ko nahi dekha kay woh kiss tarah saye ko phelata hai-? aur agar woh chahta to ussay aik jagah thehra deta . phir hum ney sooraj ko uss kay liye rehnuma bana diya hai .
ayahs.translation: kiya tum ney apney perwerdigar ( ki qudrat ) ko nahi dekha kay woh kiss tarah saye ko phelata hai-? aur agar woh chahta to ussay aik jagah thehra deta . phir hum ney sooraj ko uss kay liye rehnuma bana diya hai .

ayahs.text: phir hum ussay thora thora ker kay apni taraf samett letay hain .
ayahs.translation: phir hum ussay thora thora ker kay apni taraf samett letay hain .

ayahs.text: aur wohi hai jiss ney tumharay liye raat ko libas banaya , aur neend ko sarapa sukoon , aur din ko dobara uth kharray honey ka zariya bana diya .
ayahs.translation: aur wohi hai jiss ney tumharay liye raat ko libas banaya , aur neend ko sarapa sukoon , aur din ko dobara uth kharray honey ka zariya bana diya .

ayahs.text: aur wohi hai jiss ney apni rehmat ( yani barish ) say pehlay hawayen bhejen jo ( barish ki ) khushkhabri ley ker aati hain , aur hum ney hi aasman say pakeezah paani utaara hai ,
ayahs.translation: aur wohi hai jiss ney apni rehmat ( yani barish ) say pehlay hawayen bhejen jo ( barish ki ) khushkhabri ley ker aati hain , aur hum ney hi aasman say pakeezah paani utaara hai ,

ayahs.text: takay hum uss kay zariye murda zameen ko zindagi bakhshen , aur apni makhlooq mein say boht say maweshiyon aur insanon ko uss say sairaab keren .
ayahs.translation: takay hum uss kay zariye murda zameen ko zindagi bakhshen , aur apni makhlooq mein say boht say maweshiyon aur insanon ko uss say sairaab keren .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney logon  kay faeeday kay liye uss ( paani ) ki ulat pher ker rakhi hai ,   takay woh sabaq hasil keren . lekin aksar log nashukri kay siwa her baat say inkari hain .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney logon  kay faeeday kay liye uss ( paani ) ki ulat pher ker rakhi hai ,   takay woh sabaq hasil keren . lekin aksar log nashukri kay siwa her baat say inkari hain .

ayahs.text: aur agar hum chahtay to her basti mein aik alag aagah kernay wala ( payghumber ) bhej detay .
ayahs.translation: aur agar hum chahtay to her basti mein aik alag aagah kernay wala ( payghumber ) bhej detay .

ayahs.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn kafiron ka kehna naa maano , aur iss Quran kay zariye unn kay khilaf poori quooat say jidojehad kero .
ayahs.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn kafiron ka kehna naa maano , aur iss Quran kay zariye unn kay khilaf poori quooat say jidojehad kero .

ayahs.text: aur wohi hai jiss ney do daryaon ko iss tarah mila ker chalaya hai kay aik meetha hai jiss say taskeen milti hai , aur aik namkeen hai , sakht karrwa . aur inn dono kay darmiyan aik aarr aur aesi rukawat haeel kerdi hai jiss ko ( dono mein say ) koi uboor nahi ker-sakta .
ayahs.translation: aur wohi hai jiss ney do daryaon ko iss tarah mila ker chalaya hai kay aik meetha hai jiss say taskeen milti hai , aur aik namkeen hai , sakht karrwa . aur inn dono kay darmiyan aik aarr aur aesi rukawat haeel kerdi hai jiss ko ( dono mein say ) koi uboor nahi ker-sakta .

ayahs.text: aur wohi hai jiss ney paani say insan ko peda kiya , phir uss ko nasbi aur susrali rishtay ata kiye , aur tumhara perwerdigar bari qudrat wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur wohi hai jiss ney paani say insan ko peda kiya , phir uss ko nasbi aur susrali rishtay ata kiye , aur tumhara perwerdigar bari qudrat wala hai .

ayahs.text: aur yeh log hain kay Allah ko chorr ker aesi cheezon ki ibadat ker rahey hain jo naa inn ko koi faeeda phonchati hain , naa nuqsan . aur kafir insan ney apney perwerdigar hi ki mukhalifat per kamar baandh rakhi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh log hain kay Allah ko chorr ker aesi cheezon ki ibadat ker rahey hain jo naa inn ko koi faeeda phonchati hain , naa nuqsan . aur kafir insan ney apney perwerdigar hi ki mukhalifat per kamar baandh rakhi hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen kissi aur kaam kay liye nahi , balkay iss liye bheja hai kay tum logon  ko khushkhabri do , aur khabrdar kero .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen kissi aur kaam kay liye nahi , balkay iss liye bheja hai kay tum logon  ko khushkhabri do , aur khabrdar kero .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  mein iss kaam per tum say koi ujrat nahi maangta , haan jo shaks yeh chahye kay apney rab tak phonchney ka raasta ikhtiyar kerlay ( to yehi meri ujrat hai )
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  mein iss kaam per tum say koi ujrat nahi maangta , haan jo shaks yeh chahye kay apney rab tak phonchney ka raasta ikhtiyar kerlay ( to yehi meri ujrat hai )

ayahs.text: aur tum uss zaat per bharosa rakho jo zinda hai , jissay kabhi moat nahi aaye gi , aur ussi ki hamd kay sath tasbeeh kertay raho , aur woh apney bandon kay gunahon ki khabar rakhney kay liye kafi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur tum uss zaat per bharosa rakho jo zinda hai , jissay kabhi moat nahi aaye gi , aur ussi ki hamd kay sath tasbeeh kertay raho , aur woh apney bandon kay gunahon ki khabar rakhney kay liye kafi hai .

ayahs.text: woh zaat jiss ney cheh din mein saray aasman aur zameen aur unn kay darmiyan ki cheezen peda ken, phir uss ney arsh per istawa farmaya ,   woh rehman hai , iss liye uss ki shaan kissi janney walay say poocho .
ayahs.translation: woh zaat jiss ney cheh din mein saray aasman aur zameen aur unn kay darmiyan ki cheezen peda ken, phir uss ney arsh per istawa farmaya ,   woh rehman hai , iss liye uss ki shaan kissi janney walay say poocho .

ayahs.text: aur jab inn logon  say kaha jata hai kay rehman ko sajda kero to yeh kehtay hain kay :  rehman kiya hota hai-? kiya jissay bhi tum keh do , hum ussay sajda kiya keren-?    aur iss baat say woh aur ziyada bidakney lagtay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jab inn logon  say kaha jata hai kay rehman ko sajda kero to yeh kehtay hain kay :  rehman kiya hota hai-? kiya jissay bhi tum keh do , hum ussay sajda kiya keren-?    aur iss baat say woh aur ziyada bidakney lagtay hain .

ayahs.text: bari shaan hai uss ki jiss ney aasman mein burj banaye .   aur uss mein aik roshan chiragh aur noor phelaney wala chaand peda kiya .
ayahs.translation: bari shaan hai uss ki jiss ney aasman mein burj banaye .   aur uss mein aik roshan chiragh aur noor phelaney wala chaand peda kiya .

ayahs.text: aur wohi hai jiss ney raat aur din ko aisa banaya kay woh aik doosray kay peechay chalay aatay hain , ( magar yeh sari baaten ) uss shaks kay liye ( kaar-aamad hain ) jo naseehat hasil kernay ka irada rakhta ho ya shukar baja lana chahta ho .
ayahs.translation: aur wohi hai jiss ney raat aur din ko aisa banaya kay woh aik doosray kay peechay chalay aatay hain , ( magar yeh sari baaten ) uss shaks kay liye ( kaar-aamad hain ) jo naseehat hasil kernay ka irada rakhta ho ya shukar baja lana chahta ho .

ayahs.text: aur rehman kay banday woh hain jo zameen per aajzi say chaltay hain , aur jab jahil log unn say ( jahilana ) khitab kertay hain to woh salamti ki baat kehtay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur rehman kay banday woh hain jo zameen per aajzi say chaltay hain , aur jab jahil log unn say ( jahilana ) khitab kertay hain to woh salamti ki baat kehtay hain .

ayahs.text: aur jo raaten iss tarah guzaartay hain kay apney perwerdigar kay aagay ( kabhi ) sajday mein hotay hain , aur ( kabhi ) qayam mein .
ayahs.translation: aur jo raaten iss tarah guzaartay hain kay apney perwerdigar kay aagay ( kabhi ) sajday mein hotay hain , aur ( kabhi ) qayam mein .

ayahs.text: aur jo yeh kehtay hain kay :  humaray perwerdigar ! jahannum kay azab ko hum say door rakhiye . haqeeqat yeh hai kay uss ka azab woh tabahi hai jo chimat ker reh jati hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jo yeh kehtay hain kay :  humaray perwerdigar ! jahannum kay azab ko hum say door rakhiye . haqeeqat yeh hai kay uss ka azab woh tabahi hai jo chimat ker reh jati hai .

ayahs.text: yaqeenan woh kissi ka mustaqar aur qayam gaah banney kay liye bad-tareen jagah hai .
ayahs.translation: yaqeenan woh kissi ka mustaqar aur qayam gaah banney kay liye bad-tareen jagah hai .

ayahs.text: aur jo kharch kertay hain to naa fuzool kharchi kertay hain , naa tangi kertay hain , balkay unn ka tareeqa iss ( ifraat o tafreet ) kay darmiyan aetidaal ka tareeqa hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jo kharch kertay hain to naa fuzool kharchi kertay hain , naa tangi kertay hain , balkay unn ka tareeqa iss ( ifraat o tafreet ) kay darmiyan aetidaal ka tareeqa hai .

ayahs.text: aur jo Allah kay sath kissi bhi doosray mabood ki ibadat nahi kertay , aur jiss jaan ko Allah ney hurmat bakhshi hai , ussay nahaq qatal nahi kertay , aur naa woh zina kertay hain . aur jo shaks bhi yeh kaam keray ga , ussay apney gunah kay wabal ka samna kerna parray ga .
ayahs.translation: aur jo Allah kay sath kissi bhi doosray mabood ki ibadat nahi kertay , aur jiss jaan ko Allah ney hurmat bakhshi hai , ussay nahaq qatal nahi kertay , aur naa woh zina kertay hain . aur jo shaks bhi yeh kaam keray ga , ussay apney gunah kay wabal ka samna kerna parray ga .

ayahs.text: qayamat kay din uss ka azab barha barha ker dugna kerdiya jaye ga , aur woh zaleel ho ker uss azab mein hamesha hamesha rahey ga .
ayahs.translation: qayamat kay din uss ka azab barha barha ker dugna kerdiya jaye ga , aur woh zaleel ho ker uss azab mein hamesha hamesha rahey ga .

ayahs.text: haan magar jo koi tauba kerlay , emaan ley aaye , aur naik amal keray to Allah aesay logon  ki buraiyon ko naikiyon mein tabdeel kerday ga ,   aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: haan magar jo koi tauba kerlay , emaan ley aaye , aur naik amal keray to Allah aesay logon  ki buraiyon ko naikiyon mein tabdeel kerday ga ,   aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: aur jo koi tauba kerta aur naik amal kerta hai to woh dar-haqeeqat Allah ki taraf theek theek loat aata hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jo koi tauba kerta aur naik amal kerta hai to woh dar-haqeeqat Allah ki taraf theek theek loat aata hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( rehman kay banday woh hain ) jo nahaq kamon mein shamil nahi hotay ,   aur jab kissi laghw cheez kay paas say guzartay hain to waqar kay sath guzar jatay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur ( rehman kay banday woh hain ) jo nahaq kamon mein shamil nahi hotay ,   aur jab kissi laghw cheez kay paas say guzartay hain to waqar kay sath guzar jatay hain .

ayahs.text: aur jab unhen apney rab ki aayaat kay zariye naseehat ki jati hai to woh unn per behray aur andhay ban ker nahi girtay .
ayahs.translation: aur jab unhen apney rab ki aayaat kay zariye naseehat ki jati hai to woh unn per behray aur andhay ban ker nahi girtay .

ayahs.text: aur jo ( dua kertay huye ) kehtay hain kay :  humaray perwerdigar ! hamen apni biwi bacchon say aankhon ki thandak ata farma , aur hamen perhezgaron ka sarbarah bana dey .
ayahs.translation: aur jo ( dua kertay huye ) kehtay hain kay :  humaray perwerdigar ! hamen apni biwi bacchon say aankhon ki thandak ata farma , aur hamen perhezgaron ka sarbarah bana dey .

ayahs.text: yeh log hain jinhen unn kay sabar kay badlay jannat kay bala-khaney ata hon gay , aur wahan duaon aur salam say unn ka istaqbal kiya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: yeh log hain jinhen unn kay sabar kay badlay jannat kay bala-khaney ata hon gay , aur wahan duaon aur salam say unn ka istaqbal kiya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: woh wahan hamesha zinda rahen gay . kissi ka mustaqar aur qayam gaah banney kay liye woh behtareen jagah hai .
ayahs.translation: woh wahan hamesha zinda rahen gay . kissi ka mustaqar aur qayam gaah banney kay liye woh behtareen jagah hai .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! logon  say ) keh do kay :  meray perwerdigar ko tumhari zara bhi perwa naa hoti , agar tum uss ko naa pukartay .   abb jabkay ( aey kafiro ! ) tum ney haq ko jhutla diya hai to yeh jhutlana tumharay galay parr ker rahey ga .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! logon  say ) keh do kay :  meray perwerdigar ko tumhari zara bhi perwa naa hoti , agar tum uss ko naa pukartay .   abb jabkay ( aey kafiro ! ) tum ney haq ko jhutla diya hai to yeh jhutlana tumharay galay parr ker rahey ga .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: Tua-Seen-Meem
verses.translation: Tua-Seen-Meem

verses.text: yeh uss kitab ki aayaten hain jo haq ko wazeh kernay wali hai .
verses.translation: yeh uss kitab ki aayaten hain jo haq ko wazeh kernay wali hai .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) shayad tum iss ghum mein apni jaan halak kiye jarahey ho kay yeh log emaan ( kiyon ) nahi latay !
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) shayad tum iss ghum mein apni jaan halak kiye jarahey ho kay yeh log emaan ( kiyon ) nahi latay !

verses.text: agar hum chahen to inn/unn per aasman say koi aesi nishani utaar den kay uss kay aagay inn ki gardanen jhuk ker reh jayen .
verses.translation: agar hum chahen to inn/unn per aasman say koi aesi nishani utaar den kay uss kay aagay inn ki gardanen jhuk ker reh jayen .

verses.text: . ( inn ka haal to yeh hai kay ) inn kay paas khudaye rehman ki taraf say jo koi naee naseehat aati hai , yeh uss say mun morr letay hain .
verses.translation: . ( inn ka haal to yeh hai kay ) inn kay paas khudaye rehman ki taraf say jo koi naee naseehat aati hai , yeh uss say mun morr letay hain .

verses.text: iss tarah unhon ney haq ko jhutla diya hai . chunacheh yeh log jinn baaton ka mazaq uratay rahey hain , abb unqareeb unn kay theek theek haqaeeq inn kay samney aajayen gay .
verses.translation: iss tarah unhon ney haq ko jhutla diya hai . chunacheh yeh log jinn baaton ka mazaq uratay rahey hain , abb unqareeb unn kay theek theek haqaeeq inn kay samney aajayen gay .

verses.text: aur kiya unhon ney zameen ko nahi dekha kay hum ney iss mein her nafees qisam ki kitni cheezen ugai hain-?
verses.translation: aur kiya unhon ney zameen ko nahi dekha kay hum ney iss mein her nafees qisam ki kitni cheezen ugai hain-?

verses.text: yaqeenan inn sabb cheezon mein ibrat ka bara saman hai , phir bhi inn mein say aksar log emaan nahi latay ,
verses.translation: yaqeenan inn sabb cheezon mein ibrat ka bara saman hai , phir bhi inn mein say aksar log emaan nahi latay ,

verses.text: aur yaqeen rakho kay tumhara perwerdigar sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , boht meharban bhi .
verses.translation: aur yaqeen rakho kay tumhara perwerdigar sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , boht meharban bhi .

verses.text: aur uss waqt ka haal suno jab tumharay perwerdigar ney musa ko aawaz dey ker kaha tha kay :  uss zalim qoam kay paas jao ,
verses.translation: aur uss waqt ka haal suno jab tumharay perwerdigar ney musa ko aawaz dey ker kaha tha kay :  uss zalim qoam kay paas jao ,

verses.text: yani firon ki qoam kay paas . kiya unn kay dil mein khuda ka khof nahi hai ?
verses.translation: yani firon ki qoam kay paas . kiya unn kay dil mein khuda ka khof nahi hai ?

verses.text: musa ney kaha kay :  meray perwerdigar ! mujhay darr hai kay woh mujhay jhoota banayen gay .
verses.translation: musa ney kaha kay :  meray perwerdigar ! mujhay darr hai kay woh mujhay jhoota banayen gay .

verses.text: aur mera dil tang honey lagta hai , aur meri zaban nahi chalti . iss liye aap Haroon ko bhi ( nabwooat ka ) paygham bhej dijiye .
verses.translation: aur mera dil tang honey lagta hai , aur meri zaban nahi chalti . iss liye aap Haroon ko bhi ( nabwooat ka ) paygham bhej dijiye .

verses.text: aur meray khilaf inn logon  ney aik jurm bhi aaeed ker rakha hai ,   jiss ki wajeh say mujhay darr hai kay woh mujhay qatal naa ker daalen .
verses.translation: aur meray khilaf inn logon  ney aik jurm bhi aaeed ker rakha hai ,   jiss ki wajeh say mujhay darr hai kay woh mujhay qatal naa ker daalen .

verses.text: Allah ney farmaya kay :  hergiz nahi ! tum dono humari nishaniyan ley ker jao . yaqeen rakho kay hum tumharay sath hain , sari baaten suntay rahen gay .
verses.translation: Allah ney farmaya kay :  hergiz nahi ! tum dono humari nishaniyan ley ker jao . yaqeen rakho kay hum tumharay sath hain , sari baaten suntay rahen gay .

verses.text: abb tum dono firon kay paas jao , aur kaho kay :  hum dono Rabb-ul-Aalameen kay payghumber hain
verses.translation: abb tum dono firon kay paas jao , aur kaho kay :  hum dono Rabb-ul-Aalameen kay payghumber hain

verses.text: . ( aur yeh paygham laye hain ) kay tum bano Israel ko humaray sath bhej do .
verses.translation: . ( aur yeh paygham laye hain ) kay tum bano Israel ko humaray sath bhej do .

verses.text: firon ney ( jawab mein musa ( aleh-assalam ) say ) kaha :  kiya hum ney tumhen uss waqt apney paas rakh ker nahi paala tha jab tum bilkul bacchay thay ?   aur tum ney apni umar kay boht say saal humaray yahan reh ker guzaray ,
verses.translation: firon ney ( jawab mein musa ( aleh-assalam ) say ) kaha :  kiya hum ney tumhen uss waqt apney paas rakh ker nahi paala tha jab tum bilkul bacchay thay ?   aur tum ney apni umar kay boht say saal humaray yahan reh ker guzaray ,

verses.text: aur jo harkat tum ney ki thi woh bhi ker guzray ,   aur tum baray nashukray aadmi ho .
verses.translation: aur jo harkat tum ney ki thi woh bhi ker guzray ,   aur tum baray nashukray aadmi ho .

verses.text: musa ney kaha :  uss waqt woh kaam mein aesi halat mein ker guzra tha kay mujhay pata nahi tha .
verses.translation: musa ney kaha :  uss waqt woh kaam mein aesi halat mein ker guzra tha kay mujhay pata nahi tha .

verses.text: chunacheh jab mujhay tum logon  say khof huwa to mein tumharay paas say farar hogaya , phir Allah ney mujhay hikmat ata farmaee , aur payghumberon mein shamil farma diya .
verses.translation: chunacheh jab mujhay tum logon  say khof huwa to mein tumharay paas say farar hogaya , phir Allah ney mujhay hikmat ata farmaee , aur payghumberon mein shamil farma diya .

verses.text: aur woh ehsan jo tum mujh per rakh rahey ho , ( uss ki haqeeqat ) yeh hai kay tum ney saray bano Israel ko ghulam bana rakha hai .
verses.translation: aur woh ehsan jo tum mujh per rakh rahey ho , ( uss ki haqeeqat ) yeh hai kay tum ney saray bano Israel ko ghulam bana rakha hai .

verses.text: firon ney kaha :  aur yeh Rabb-ul-Aalameen kiya cheez hai-?
verses.translation: firon ney kaha :  aur yeh Rabb-ul-Aalameen kiya cheez hai-?

verses.text: musa ney kaha :  woh saray aasmano aur zameen ka , aur unn sari cheezon ka perwerdigar hai jo unn kay darmiyan pai jati hain , agar tum ko waqaee yaqeen kerna ho .
verses.translation: musa ney kaha :  woh saray aasmano aur zameen ka , aur unn sari cheezon ka perwerdigar hai jo unn kay darmiyan pai jati hain , agar tum ko waqaee yaqeen kerna ho .

verses.text: firon ney apney ird-gird kay logon  say kaha :  sunn rahey ho kay nahi-?
verses.translation: firon ney apney ird-gird kay logon  say kaha :  sunn rahey ho kay nahi-?

verses.text: musa ney kaha :  woh tumhara bhi perwerdigar hai , aur tumharay pichlay baap dadon ka bhi .
verses.translation: musa ney kaha :  woh tumhara bhi perwerdigar hai , aur tumharay pichlay baap dadon ka bhi .

verses.text: firon bola :  tumhara yeh payghumber jo tumharay paas bheja gaya hai , yeh to bilkul hi deewana hai .
verses.translation: firon bola :  tumhara yeh payghumber jo tumharay paas bheja gaya hai , yeh to bilkul hi deewana hai .

verses.text: musa ney kaha :  woh mashriq o maghrib ka bhi perwerdigar hai , aur unn kay darmiyan sari cheezon ka bhi , agar tum aqal say kaam lo .
verses.translation: musa ney kaha :  woh mashriq o maghrib ka bhi perwerdigar hai , aur unn kay darmiyan sari cheezon ka bhi , agar tum aqal say kaam lo .

verses.text: kehney laga :  yaad rakho , agar tum ney meray siwa kissi aur ko mabood maana to mein tumhen zaroor unn logon  mein shamil kerdun ga jo jail khaney mein parray huye hain .
verses.translation: kehney laga :  yaad rakho , agar tum ney meray siwa kissi aur ko mabood maana to mein tumhen zaroor unn logon  mein shamil kerdun ga jo jail khaney mein parray huye hain .

verses.text: musa bolay :  aur agar mein tumhen koi aesi cheez laa dikhaon jo haq ko wazeh ker dey , phir-?
verses.translation: musa bolay :  aur agar mein tumhen koi aesi cheez laa dikhaon jo haq ko wazeh ker dey , phir-?

verses.text: firon ney kaha :  acha , agar waqaee sachay ho to ley aao woh cheez .
verses.translation: firon ney kaha :  acha , agar waqaee sachay ho to ley aao woh cheez .

verses.text: chunacheh musa ney apna assa phenka , aur dekhtay hi dekhtay woh khula huwa azdaha ban gaya ,
verses.translation: chunacheh musa ney apna assa phenka , aur dekhtay hi dekhtay woh khula huwa azdaha ban gaya ,

verses.text: aur unhon ney apna haath ( baghal mein say ) kheench ker nikala to pal bhar mein woh sabb dekhney walon kay samney safaid hogaya .
verses.translation: aur unhon ney apna haath ( baghal mein say ) kheench ker nikala to pal bhar mein woh sabb dekhney walon kay samney safaid hogaya .

verses.text: firon ney apney irdgird kay sardaron say kaha :  yaqeenan yeh koi mahir jadoogar hai .
verses.translation: firon ney apney irdgird kay sardaron say kaha :  yaqeenan yeh koi mahir jadoogar hai .

verses.text: yeh chahta hai kay apney jadoo kay zariye tumhen tumhari sarzameen say nikal bahir keray . abb batao tumhari kiya raye hai ?
verses.translation: yeh chahta hai kay apney jadoo kay zariye tumhen tumhari sarzameen say nikal bahir keray . abb batao tumhari kiya raye hai ?

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  inn ko aur inn kay bhai ko kuch mohlat dijiye , aur tamam shehron mein herkaray bhej dijiye .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  inn ko aur inn kay bhai ko kuch mohlat dijiye , aur tamam shehron mein herkaray bhej dijiye .

verses.text: jo har mahir jadoogar ko aap kay paas ley ayen ( aur inn jadoogaron ka muqabla keren )
verses.translation: jo har mahir jadoogar ko aap kay paas ley ayen ( aur inn jadoogaron ka muqabla keren )

verses.text: chunacheh aik din muqarrara waqt per saray jadoogar jama kerliye gaye .
verses.translation: chunacheh aik din muqarrara waqt per saray jadoogar jama kerliye gaye .

verses.text: aur logon  say kaha gaya kay :  kiya tum log jama horahey ho-?
verses.translation: aur logon  say kaha gaya kay :  kiya tum log jama horahey ho-?

verses.text: shayad agar yeh jadoogar hi ghalib aagaye to hum inhi kay raastay per chalen .
verses.translation: shayad agar yeh jadoogar hi ghalib aagaye to hum inhi kay raastay per chalen .

verses.text: phir jab jadoogar aaye to unhon ney firon say kaha :  yeh baat to yaqeeni hai naa kay agar hum ghalib aagaye to hamen koi inaam milay ga-?
verses.translation: phir jab jadoogar aaye to unhon ney firon say kaha :  yeh baat to yaqeeni hai naa kay agar hum ghalib aagaye to hamen koi inaam milay ga-?

verses.text: firon ney kaha :  haan haan , aur tumhen uss soorat mein muqarrab logon  mein bhi zaroor shamil kerliya jaye ga .
verses.translation: firon ney kaha :  haan haan , aur tumhen uss soorat mein muqarrab logon  mein bhi zaroor shamil kerliya jaye ga .

verses.text: musa ney unn jadoogaron say kaha :  jo kuch tumhen phenkna hai , phenko .
verses.translation: musa ney unn jadoogaron say kaha :  jo kuch tumhen phenkna hai , phenko .

verses.text: iss per unn jadoogaron ney apni rassiyan aur lathiyan zameen per daal den ,   aur kaha kay :  firon ki izzat ki qasam ! hum hi hum ghalib ayen gay .
verses.translation: iss per unn jadoogaron ney apni rassiyan aur lathiyan zameen per daal den ,   aur kaha kay :  firon ki izzat ki qasam ! hum hi hum ghalib ayen gay .

verses.text: abb musa ney apna asaa zameen per daala to achanak uss ney ( azdaha ban ker ) uss tamashay ko nigalna shuroo kerdiya jo woh jhoot moott bana rahey thay .
verses.translation: abb musa ney apna asaa zameen per daala to achanak uss ney ( azdaha ban ker ) uss tamashay ko nigalna shuroo kerdiya jo woh jhoot moott bana rahey thay .

verses.text: bus phir woh jadoogar sajday mein gira diye gaye .
verses.translation: bus phir woh jadoogar sajday mein gira diye gaye .

verses.text: kehney lagay kay :  hum Rabb-ul-Aalameen per emaan ley aaye ,
verses.translation: kehney lagay kay :  hum Rabb-ul-Aalameen per emaan ley aaye ,

verses.text: jo musa aur Haroon ka perwerdigar hai .
verses.translation: jo musa aur Haroon ka perwerdigar hai .

verses.text: firon bola :  tum meray ijazat denay say pehlay hi musa per emaan ley aaye . sabit huwa kay yeh tum sabb ka sarghana hai jiss ney tumhen jadoo sikhaya hai . acha abhi tumhen pata chal jaye ga . mein tum sabb kay aik taraf kay haath aur doosri taraf kay paon katwaon ga , aur tum sabb ko sooli per latka dun ga .
verses.translation: firon bola :  tum meray ijazat denay say pehlay hi musa per emaan ley aaye . sabit huwa kay yeh tum sabb ka sarghana hai jiss ney tumhen jadoo sikhaya hai . acha abhi tumhen pata chal jaye ga . mein tum sabb kay aik taraf kay haath aur doosri taraf kay paon katwaon ga , aur tum sabb ko sooli per latka dun ga .

verses.text: jadoogaron ney kaha :  humara kuch nahi bigrey ga , hamen yaqeen hai kay hum loat ker apney perwerdigar kay paas chalay jayen gay .
verses.translation: jadoogaron ney kaha :  humara kuch nahi bigrey ga , hamen yaqeen hai kay hum loat ker apney perwerdigar kay paas chalay jayen gay .

verses.text: hum to shoq say umeed lagaye huye hain kay humara perwerdigar iss wajeh say humari khatayen bakhsh dey ga kay hum sabb say pehlay emaan laye thay .
verses.translation: hum to shoq say umeed lagaye huye hain kay humara perwerdigar iss wajeh say humari khatayen bakhsh dey ga kay hum sabb say pehlay emaan laye thay .

verses.text: aur hum ney musa kay paas wahi bheji kay :  meray bandon ko ley ker raaton raat rawana hojao , tumhara peecha yaqeenan kiya jaye ga .
verses.translation: aur hum ney musa kay paas wahi bheji kay :  meray bandon ko ley ker raaton raat rawana hojao , tumhara peecha yaqeenan kiya jaye ga .

verses.text: iss per firon ney shehron mein herkaray bhej diye
verses.translation: iss per firon ney shehron mein herkaray bhej diye

verses.text: . ( aur yeh kehla bheja kay : )  yeh ( bani Israel ) aik choti si toli kay thoray say log hain .
verses.translation: . ( aur yeh kehla bheja kay : )  yeh ( bani Israel ) aik choti si toli kay thoray say log hain .

verses.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay enhon ney humaray dil jalaye huye hain ,
verses.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay enhon ney humaray dil jalaye huye hain ,

verses.text: aur hum sabb ehtiyati tadbeeren kiye huye hain ( lehaza sabb milker inn ka taaqqub kero )
verses.translation: aur hum sabb ehtiyati tadbeeren kiye huye hain ( lehaza sabb milker inn ka taaqqub kero )

verses.text: iss tarah hum unhen bahir nikal laye baaghon aur chashmon say bhi .
verses.translation: iss tarah hum unhen bahir nikal laye baaghon aur chashmon say bhi .

verses.text: aur khazanon aur ba-izzat maqamaat say bhi .
verses.translation: aur khazanon aur ba-izzat maqamaat say bhi .

verses.text: inn ka moamla to issi tarah huwa , aur ( doosri taraf ) unn cheezon ka waris hum ney bani Israel ko bana diya .
verses.translation: inn ka moamla to issi tarah huwa , aur ( doosri taraf ) unn cheezon ka waris hum ney bani Israel ko bana diya .

verses.text: gharz huwa yeh kay yeh sabb log sooraj nikaltay hi unn ka peecha kernay nikal kharray huye .
verses.translation: gharz huwa yeh kay yeh sabb log sooraj nikaltay hi unn ka peecha kernay nikal kharray huye .

verses.text: phir jab dono jathay aik doosray ko nazar aaney lagay to musa kay sathiyon ney kaha kay :  abb to pakki baat hai kay hum pakar hi liye gaye .
verses.translation: phir jab dono jathay aik doosray ko nazar aaney lagay to musa kay sathiyon ney kaha kay :  abb to pakki baat hai kay hum pakar hi liye gaye .

verses.text: musa ney kaha :  hergiz nahi , meray sath yaqeeni tor say mera perwerdigar hai , woh mujhay raasta bataye ga .
verses.translation: musa ney kaha :  hergiz nahi , meray sath yaqeeni tor say mera perwerdigar hai , woh mujhay raasta bataye ga .

verses.text: chunacheh hum ney musa kay paas wahi bheji kay apni laathi samandar per maaro . bus phir samandar phatt gaya , aur her hissa aik baray pahar ki tarah kharra hogaya .
verses.translation: chunacheh hum ney musa kay paas wahi bheji kay apni laathi samandar per maaro . bus phir samandar phatt gaya , aur her hissa aik baray pahar ki tarah kharra hogaya .

verses.text: aur doosray fareeq ko bhi hum uss jagah kay nazdeek ley aaye .
verses.translation: aur doosray fareeq ko bhi hum uss jagah kay nazdeek ley aaye .

verses.text: aur musa aur unn kay tamam sathiyon ko hum ney bachaliya ,
verses.translation: aur musa aur unn kay tamam sathiyon ko hum ney bachaliya ,

verses.text: phir doosron ko gharq ker daala .
verses.translation: phir doosron ko gharq ker daala .

verses.text: yaqeenan iss saray waqaey mein ibrat ka bara saman hai , phir bhi inn mein say aksar log emaan nahi latay ,
verses.translation: yaqeenan iss saray waqaey mein ibrat ka bara saman hai , phir bhi inn mein say aksar log emaan nahi latay ,

verses.text: aur yaqeen rakho kay tumhara perwerdigar sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , bara meharban bhi .
verses.translation: aur yaqeen rakho kay tumhara perwerdigar sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , bara meharban bhi .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn ko Ibrahim ka waqiaa sunao ,
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn ko Ibrahim ka waqiaa sunao ,

verses.text: jab unhon ney apney baap aur apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  tum kiss cheez ki ibadat kertay ho-?
verses.translation: jab unhon ney apney baap aur apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  tum kiss cheez ki ibadat kertay ho-?

verses.text: unhon ney kaha kay :  hum button ki ibadat kertay hain , aur unhi kay aagay dharna diye rehtay hain .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha kay :  hum button ki ibadat kertay hain , aur unhi kay aagay dharna diye rehtay hain .

verses.text: Ibrahim ney kaha :  jab tum unn ko pukartay ho to kiya yeh tumhari baat suntay hain-?
verses.translation: Ibrahim ney kaha :  jab tum unn ko pukartay ho to kiya yeh tumhari baat suntay hain-?

verses.text: ya tumhen koi faeeda ya nuqsan phonchatay hain-?
verses.translation: ya tumhen koi faeeda ya nuqsan phonchatay hain-?

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  asal baat yeh hai kay hum ney apney baap dadon ko aisa hi kertay huye paya hai .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  asal baat yeh hai kay hum ney apney baap dadon ko aisa hi kertay huye paya hai .

verses.text: Ibrahim ney kaha :  bhala kabhi tum ney inn cheezon ko ghor say dekha bhi jinn ki tum ibadat kertay rahey ho-?
verses.translation: Ibrahim ney kaha :  bhala kabhi tum ney inn cheezon ko ghor say dekha bhi jinn ki tum ibadat kertay rahey ho-?

verses.text: tum bhi aur tumharay puraney baap daday bhi !
verses.translation: tum bhi aur tumharay puraney baap daday bhi !

verses.text: meray liye to yeh sabb dushman hain , siwaye aik Rabb-ul-Aalameen kay
verses.translation: meray liye to yeh sabb dushman hain , siwaye aik Rabb-ul-Aalameen kay

verses.text: poora poora naap diya kero , aur unn logon  mein say naa bano jo doosron ko ghatay mein daaltay hain .
verses.translation: poora poora naap diya kero , aur unn logon  mein say naa bano jo doosron ko ghatay mein daaltay hain .

verses.text: aur seedhi tarazoo say tola kero ,
verses.translation: aur seedhi tarazoo say tola kero ,

verses.text: aur logon  ko unn ki cheezen ghata ker naa diya kero , aur zameen mein fasad machatay matt phiro .
verses.translation: aur logon  ko unn ki cheezen ghata ker naa diya kero , aur zameen mein fasad machatay matt phiro .

verses.text: aur uss zaat say daro jiss ney tumhen bhi peda kiya hai , aur pichli khalqat ko bhi .
verses.translation: aur uss zaat say daro jiss ney tumhen bhi peda kiya hai , aur pichli khalqat ko bhi .

verses.text: kehney lagay :  tum per to kissi ney bara bhari jadoo kerdiya hai ,
verses.translation: kehney lagay :  tum per to kissi ney bara bhari jadoo kerdiya hai ,

verses.text: tumhari haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch bhi nahi kay tum hum jaisay hi aik insan ho , aur hum tumhen pooray yaqeen kay sath jhoota samajhtay hain .
verses.translation: tumhari haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch bhi nahi kay tum hum jaisay hi aik insan ho , aur hum tumhen pooray yaqeen kay sath jhoota samajhtay hain .

verses.text: lehaza agar tum sachay ho to hum per aasman ka koi tukrra gira do .
verses.translation: lehaza agar tum sachay ho to hum per aasman ka koi tukrra gira do .

verses.translation: shoaib ney kaha :  mera perwerdigar khoob janta hai kay tum kiya ker-rahey ho .

verses.translation: gharz unn logon  ney shoaib ko jhutlaya jiss ka nateeja yeh huwa kay unhen sayeban walay din kay azab ney aa-pakra .   beyshak woh aik zabardast din ka azab tha .

verses.translation: aur yaqeen rakho kay tumhara perwerdigar sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , bara meharban bhi .

verses.translation: beyshak yeh Quran Rabb-ul-Aalameen ka nazil kiya huwa hai .

verses.text: amanat daar farishta issay ley ker utra hai
verses.translation: amanat daar farishta issay ley ker utra hai

verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) tumharay qalb per utra hai takay tum unn ( payghumberon ) mein shamil hojao jo logon  ko khabrdar kertay hain ,

verses.translation: aesi arbi zaban mein utra hai jo paygham ko wazeh ker-denay wali hai .

verses.translation: aur iss ( Quran ) ka tazkarah pichli ( aasmani ) kitabon mein bhi mojood hai .

verses.translation: bhala kiya inn logon  kay liye yeh koi daleel nahi hai kay bano Israel kay ulama iss say waqif hain-?

verses.translation: aur agar hum yeh kitab ajmi logon  mein say kissi per nazil ker-detay ,

verses.text: aur woh inn kay samney parh bhi deta to yeh log tab bhi uss per emaan naa latay .
verses.translation: aur woh inn kay samney parh bhi deta to yeh log tab bhi uss per emaan naa latay .

verses.text: mujrimon kay dilon mein to hum ney iss ko issi tarah dakhil kiya hai ,
verses.translation: mujrimon kay dilon mein to hum ney iss ko issi tarah dakhil kiya hai ,

verses.translation: aur woh unn kay paas iss tarah achanak aa-khara ho kay inn ko pata bhi naa chalay ,

verses.text: phir yeh keh uthen kay kiya hamen kuch mohlat mil sakti hai ?
verses.translation: phir yeh keh uthen kay kiya hamen kuch mohlat mil sakti hai ?

verses.text: to kiya yeh log humaray azab kay liye jaldi macha rahey hain-?
verses.translation: to kiya yeh log humaray azab kay liye jaldi macha rahey hain-?

verses.text: bhala batao agar hum kaee saal tak enhen aesh ka saman mohaiyya kertay rahen ,
verses.translation: bhala batao agar hum kaee saal tak enhen aesh ka saman mohaiyya kertay rahen ,

verses.text: phir woh ( azab ) inn kay oopper aa-khara ho jiss say enhen daraya jaraha hai .
verses.translation: phir woh ( azab ) inn kay oopper aa-khara ho jiss say enhen daraya jaraha hai .

verses.text: to aesh ka jo saman inn ko diya jata raha woh enhen ( azab kay waqt ) kiya faeeda phoncha sakta hai ?
verses.translation: to aesh ka jo saman inn ko diya jata raha woh enhen ( azab kay waqt ) kiya faeeda phoncha sakta hai ?

verses.text: aur hum ney kissi basti ko iss kay baghair halak nahi kiya kay ( pehlay ) uss kay liye khabrdar kernay walay mojood thay ,
verses.translation: aur hum ney kissi basti ko iss kay baghair halak nahi kiya kay ( pehlay ) uss kay liye khabrdar kernay walay mojood thay ,

verses.text: takay woh naseehat keren , aur hum aesay to nahi hain kay zulm keren .
verses.translation: takay woh naseehat keren , aur hum aesay to nahi hain kay zulm keren .

verses.text: aur iss Quran ko shayateen ley ker nahi utray ,
verses.translation: aur iss Quran ko shayateen ley ker nahi utray ,

verses.translation: naa yeh Quran unn kay matlab ka hai , aur naa woh aisa ker-saktay hain ,

verses.text: unhen to ( wahi kay ) sunney say bhi rok diya gaya hai .
verses.translation: unhen to ( wahi kay ) sunney say bhi rok diya gaya hai .

verses.text: lehaza Allah kay sath koi mabood naa maano , kabhi tum bhi unn logon  mein shamil hojao jinhen azab hoga .
verses.translation: lehaza Allah kay sath koi mabood naa maano , kabhi tum bhi unn logon  mein shamil hojao jinhen azab hoga .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum apney qareeb tareen khandan ko khabrdar kero ,
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum apney qareeb tareen khandan ko khabrdar kero ,

verses.translation: aur agar woh tumhari nafarmani keren to keh do kay :  jo kuch tum ker rahey ho , uss say mera koi talluq nahi .

verses.text: aur uss ( Allah ) per bharosa rakho jo bara iqtidar wala , boht meharban hai .
verses.translation: aur uss ( Allah ) per bharosa rakho jo bara iqtidar wala , boht meharban hai .

verses.translation: jo tumhen uss waqt bhi dekhta hai jab tum ( ibadat kay liye ) kharray hotay ho ,

verses.translation: aur sajda kernay walon kay darmiyan tumhari aamd-o-raft ko bhi dekhta hai ,

verses.translation: yaqeen rakho kay wohi hai jo her baat sunta her cheez janta hai

verses.translation: woh suni sunai baat laa daaltay hain ,   aur unn mein say aksar jhootay hotay hain .

verses.text: rahey shaeer log , to unn kay peechay to bey raah log chaltay hain .
verses.translation: rahey shaeer log , to unn kay peechay to bey raah log chaltay hain .

verses.translation: kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay woh her wadi mein bhataktay phirtay hain-?

verses.text: aur yeh kay woh aesi baaten kehtay hain jo kertay nahi hain ,
verses.translation: aur yeh kay woh aesi baaten kehtay hain jo kertay nahi hain ,

ayahs.translation: . ( aur yeh paygham laye hain ) kay tum bano Israel ko humaray sath bhej do .

ayahs.translation: firon ney ( jawab mein musa ( aleh-assalam ) say ) kaha :  kiya hum ney tumhen uss waqt apney paas rakh ker nahi paala tha jab tum bilkul bacchay thay ?   aur tum ney apni umar kay boht say saal humaray yahan reh ker guzaray ,

ayahs.translation: aur jo harkat tum ney ki thi woh bhi ker guzray ,   aur tum baray nashukray aadmi ho .

ayahs.translation: musa ney kaha :  uss waqt woh kaam mein aesi halat mein ker guzra tha kay mujhay pata nahi tha .

ayahs.translation: aur woh ehsan jo tum mujh per rakh rahey ho , ( uss ki haqeeqat ) yeh hai kay tum ney saray bano Israel ko ghulam bana rakha hai .

ayahs.translation: firon ney kaha :  aur yeh Rabb-ul-Aalameen kiya cheez hai-?

ayahs.text: musa ney kaha :  woh saray aasmano aur zameen ka , aur unn sari cheezon ka perwerdigar hai jo unn kay darmiyan pai jati hain , agar tum ko waqaee yaqeen kerna ho .
ayahs.translation: musa ney kaha :  woh saray aasmano aur zameen ka , aur unn sari cheezon ka perwerdigar hai jo unn kay darmiyan pai jati hain , agar tum ko waqaee yaqeen kerna ho .

ayahs.translation: firon ney apney ird-gird kay logon  say kaha :  sunn rahey ho kay nahi-?

ayahs.text: musa ney kaha :  woh tumhara bhi perwerdigar hai , aur tumharay pichlay baap dadon ka bhi .
ayahs.translation: musa ney kaha :  woh tumhara bhi perwerdigar hai , aur tumharay pichlay baap dadon ka bhi .

ayahs.translation: firon bola :  tumhara yeh payghumber jo tumharay paas bheja gaya hai , yeh to bilkul hi deewana hai .

ayahs.translation: musa ney kaha :  woh mashriq o maghrib ka bhi perwerdigar hai , aur unn kay darmiyan sari cheezon ka bhi , agar tum aqal say kaam lo .

ayahs.translation: kehney laga :  yaad rakho , agar tum ney meray siwa kissi aur ko mabood maana to mein tumhen zaroor unn logon  mein shamil kerdun ga jo jail khaney mein parray huye hain .

ayahs.translation: musa bolay :  aur agar mein tumhen koi aesi cheez laa dikhaon jo haq ko wazeh ker dey , phir-?

verses.text: yehi woh log hain jinn kay liye bura azab hai , aur wohi hain jo aakhirat mein sabb say ziyada nuqsan uthaney walay hain .
verses.translation: yehi woh log hain jinn kay liye bura azab hai , aur wohi hain jo aakhirat mein sabb say ziyada nuqsan uthaney walay hain .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) bila shubha tumhen yeh Quran uss ( Allah ) ki taraf say ata kiya jaraha hai jo hikmat ka bhi malik hai , ilm ka bhi malik .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) bila shubha tumhen yeh Quran uss ( Allah ) ki taraf say ata kiya jaraha hai jo hikmat ka bhi malik hai , ilm ka bhi malik .

verses.text: uss waqt ko yaad kero jab musa ney apney ghar walon say kaha tha kay :  mujhay aik aag nazar aai hai . mein abhi tumharay paas wahan say koi khabar ley ker aata hun , ya phir tumharay paas aag ka koi shola utha kerlay aaon ga , takay tum aag say garmi hasil ker-sako .
verses.translation: uss waqt ko yaad kero jab musa ney apney ghar walon say kaha tha kay :  mujhay aik aag nazar aai hai . mein abhi tumharay paas wahan say koi khabar ley ker aata hun , ya phir tumharay paas aag ka koi shola utha kerlay aaon ga , takay tum aag say garmi hasil ker-sako .

verses.text: chunacheh jab woh uss aag kay paas phonchay to unhen aawaz di gaee kay :  barkat ho unn per bhi jo iss aag kay andar hain , aur uss per bhi jo iss kay aas paas hai ,   aur pak hai Allah jo saray jahano ka perwerdigar hai .
verses.translation: chunacheh jab woh uss aag kay paas phonchay to unhen aawaz di gaee kay :  barkat ho unn per bhi jo iss aag kay andar hain , aur uss per bhi jo iss kay aas paas hai ,   aur pak hai Allah jo saray jahano ka perwerdigar hai .

verses.text: aey musa !  baat yeh hai kay mein Allah hun , baray iqtidar wala , bari hikmat wala ,

verses.text: aur zara apni laathi ko neechay phenko .  phir jab unhon ney laathi ko dekha kay woh iss tarah harkat ker rahi hai jaisay woh koi saanp ho to woh peeth pher ker bhagay , aur peechay murr ker bhi naa dekha . ( irshad huwa )  musa ! daro nahi , jinn ko payghumber banaya jata hai , unn ko meray huzoor koi andesha nahi hota ,

verses.translation: illa yeh kay kissi ney koi ziyadti ki ho .   phir woh burai kay baad ussay badal ker achay kaam kerlay , to mein boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hun .

verses.text: aur apna haath apney giraybaan mein dakhil kero , to woh kissi beemari kay baghair safaid ho ker niklay ga . yeh dono baaten unn no nishaniyon mein say hain jo firon aur uss ki qoam ki taraf ( tumharay zariye ) bheji jarahi hain .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh nafarman log hain .
verses.translation: aur apna haath apney giraybaan mein dakhil kero , to woh kissi beemari kay baghair safaid ho ker niklay ga . yeh dono baaten unn no nishaniyon mein say hain jo firon aur uss ki qoam ki taraf ( tumharay zariye ) bheji jarahi hain .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh nafarman log hain .

verses.text: phir huwa yeh kay jab unn kay paas humari nishaniyan iss tarah phonchen kay woh aankhen kholney wali then , to unhon ney kaha kay :  yeh to khula huwa jadoo hai .
verses.translation: phir huwa yeh kay jab unn kay paas humari nishaniyan iss tarah phonchen kay woh aankhen kholney wali then , to unhon ney kaha kay :  yeh to khula huwa jadoo hai .

verses.text: aur agar-cheh unn kay dilon ko unn ( ki sachai ) ka yaqeen hochuka tha , magar unhon ney zulm aur takabbur ki wajeh say unn ka inkar kiya . abb dekh lo kay unn fasad machaney walon ka anjam kaisa huwa-?
verses.translation: aur agar-cheh unn kay dilon ko unn ( ki sachai ) ka yaqeen hochuka tha , magar unhon ney zulm aur takabbur ki wajeh say unn ka inkar kiya . abb dekh lo kay unn fasad machaney walon ka anjam kaisa huwa-?

verses.text: aur hum ney dawood aur suleman ko ilm ata kiya . aur unhon ney kaha :  tamam tareefen Allah ki hain jiss ney hamen apney boht say momin bandon per fazilat ata farmaee hai .
verses.translation: aur hum ney dawood aur suleman ko ilm ata kiya . aur unhon ney kaha :  tamam tareefen Allah ki hain jiss ney hamen apney boht say momin bandon per fazilat ata farmaee hai .

verses.text: aur suleman ko dawood ki virasat mili ,   aur unhon ney kaha :  aey logo ! hamen parindon ki boli sikhai gaee hai ,   aur hamen her ( zaroorat ki ) cheez ata ki gaee hai . yaqeenan yeh ( Allah taalaa ka ) khula huwa fazal hai .
verses.translation: aur suleman ko dawood ki virasat mili ,   aur unhon ney kaha :  aey logo ! hamen parindon ki boli sikhai gaee hai ,   aur hamen her ( zaroorat ki ) cheez ata ki gaee hai . yaqeenan yeh ( Allah taalaa ka ) khula huwa fazal hai .

verses.text: aur suleman kay liye unn kay saray lashkar jama kerdiye gaye thay jo jinnaat , insanon aur parindon per mushtamil thay , chunacheh unhen qaboo mein rakha jata tha .
verses.translation: aur suleman kay liye unn kay saray lashkar jama kerdiye gaye thay jo jinnaat , insanon aur parindon per mushtamil thay , chunacheh unhen qaboo mein rakha jata tha .

verses.text: yahan tak kay aik din jab yeh sabb chewntiyon ki wadi mein phonchay to aik chewnti ney kaha :  chewntiyo ! apney apney gharon mein ghuss jao , kahen aisa naa ho kay suleman aur unn ka lashkar tumhen pees daalay , aur unhen pata bhi naa chalay .
verses.translation: yahan tak kay aik din jab yeh sabb chewntiyon ki wadi mein phonchay to aik chewnti ney kaha :  chewntiyo ! apney apney gharon mein ghuss jao , kahen aisa naa ho kay suleman aur unn ka lashkar tumhen pees daalay , aur unhen pata bhi naa chalay .

verses.text: uss ki baat per suleman muskura ker hansay , aur kehney lagay :  meray perwerdigar ! mujhay iss baat ka paband bana dijiye kay mein  aap ki unn naimaton ka shukar ada kerun jo aap ney mujhay aur meray walaiden ko ata farmaee hain , aur woh naik amal kerun jo aap ko pasand ho , aur apni rehmat say mujhay apney naik bandon mein shamil farma-lijiye .
verses.translation: uss ki baat per suleman muskura ker hansay , aur kehney lagay :  meray perwerdigar ! mujhay iss baat ka paband bana dijiye kay mein  aap ki unn naimaton ka shukar ada kerun jo aap ney mujhay aur meray walaiden ko ata farmaee hain , aur woh naik amal kerun jo aap ko pasand ho , aur apni rehmat say mujhay apney naik bandon mein shamil farma-lijiye .

verses.text: aur unhon ney ( aik martaba ) parindon ki haziri li to kaha :  kiya baat hai , mujhay hudhud nazar nahi aaraha , kiya woh kahen ghaeeb hogaya hai-?
verses.translation: aur unhon ney ( aik martaba ) parindon ki haziri li to kaha :  kiya baat hai , mujhay hudhud nazar nahi aaraha , kiya woh kahen ghaeeb hogaya hai-?

verses.text: mein ussay sakht saza dun ga , ya ussay zibah ker daalun ga , illa yeh kay woh meray samney koi wazeh wajeh paish keray .
verses.translation: mein ussay sakht saza dun ga , ya ussay zibah ker daalun ga , illa yeh kay woh meray samney koi wazeh wajeh paish keray .

verses.text: phir hudhud ney ziyada dair nahi lagai aur ( aa-ker ) kaha kay :  mein ney aesi maloomaat hasil ki hain jinn ka aap ko ilm nahi hai , aur mein mulk e saba say aap kay paas aik yaqeeni khabar ley ker aaya hun .
verses.translation: phir hudhud ney ziyada dair nahi lagai aur ( aa-ker ) kaha kay :  mein ney aesi maloomaat hasil ki hain jinn ka aap ko ilm nahi hai , aur mein mulk e saba say aap kay paas aik yaqeeni khabar ley ker aaya hun .

verses.text: mein ney wahan aik aurat ko paya jo unn logon  per badshahat ker rahi hai , aur uss ko her tarah ka saz-o-saman diya gaya hai , aur uss ka aik shandaar takht bhi hai .
verses.translation: mein ney wahan aik aurat ko paya jo unn logon  per badshahat ker rahi hai , aur uss ko her tarah ka saz-o-saman diya gaya hai , aur uss ka aik shandaar takht bhi hai .

verses.text: mein ney uss aurat aur uss ki qoam ko paya hai kay woh Allah ko chorr ker sooraj kay aagay sajday kertay hain , aur shetan ney unn ko yeh sujha diya hai kay unn kay aemal boht achay hain , chunacheh uss ney unhen sahih raastay say rok rakha hai aur iss tarah woh hidayat say itney door hain
verses.translation: mein ney uss aurat aur uss ki qoam ko paya hai kay woh Allah ko chorr ker sooraj kay aagay sajday kertay hain , aur shetan ney unn ko yeh sujha diya hai kay unn kay aemal boht achay hain , chunacheh uss ney unhen sahih raastay say rok rakha hai aur iss tarah woh hidayat say itney door hain

verses.text: kay Allah ko sajda nahi kertay jo aasmano aur zameen ki chupi hoi cheezon ko bahir nikal lata hai , aur tum jo kuch chupao , aur jo kuch zahir kero , sabb ko janta hai .
verses.translation: kay Allah ko sajda nahi kertay jo aasmano aur zameen ki chupi hoi cheezon ko bahir nikal lata hai , aur tum jo kuch chupao , aur jo kuch zahir kero , sabb ko janta hai .

verses.translation: suleman ney kaha :  hum abhi dekh letay hain kay tum ney sach kaha hai ya jhoot bolney walon mein tum bhi shamil hogaye ho .

verses.text: mera yeh khat ley ker jao aur unn kay paas daal dena , phir alag hatt jana , aur dekhna kay woh jawab mein kiya kertay hain .
verses.translation: mera yeh khat ley ker jao aur unn kay paas daal dena , phir alag hatt jana , aur dekhna kay woh jawab mein kiya kertay hain .

verses.text: . ( uss mein likha hai ) kay :  meray muqablay mein sarkashi naa kero , aur meray paas tabey daar ban ker chalay aao .
verses.translation: . ( uss mein likha hai ) kay :  meray muqablay mein sarkashi naa kero , aur meray paas tabey daar ban ker chalay aao .

verses.text: malka ney kaha :  qoam kay sardaro ! jo masla meray samney aaya hai , uss mein mujhay faisla kunn mashwara do . mein kissi maslay ka hatmi faisla uss waqt tak nahi kerti jab tak tum meray paas mojood naa ho .
verses.translation: malka ney kaha :  qoam kay sardaro ! jo masla meray samney aaya hai , uss mein mujhay faisla kunn mashwara do . mein kissi maslay ka hatmi faisla uss waqt tak nahi kerti jab tak tum meray paas mojood naa ho .

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  hum taqatwar aur datt ker larrney walay log hain , aagay moamla aap kay supurd hai , abb aap dekh len kay kiya hukum deti hain .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  hum taqatwar aur datt ker larrney walay log hain , aagay moamla aap kay supurd hai , abb aap dekh len kay kiya hukum deti hain .

verses.text: malka boli :  haqeeqat yeh hai kay badshah log jab kissi basti mein ghuss aatay hain to ussay kharab ker daaltay hain , aur uss kay ba-izzat bashindon ko zaleel ker kay chortay hain , aur yehi kuch yeh log bhi keren gay .
verses.translation: malka boli :  haqeeqat yeh hai kay badshah log jab kissi basti mein ghuss aatay hain to ussay kharab ker daaltay hain , aur uss kay ba-izzat bashindon ko zaleel ker kay chortay hain , aur yehi kuch yeh log bhi keren gay .

verses.text: aur mein unn kay paas aik tohfa bhejti hun , phir dekhun gi kay aelchi kiya jawab ley ker wapis aatay hain-?
verses.translation: aur mein unn kay paas aik tohfa bhejti hun , phir dekhun gi kay aelchi kiya jawab ley ker wapis aatay hain-?

verses.text: chunacheh jab aelchi suleman kay paas phoncha to unhon ney kaha :  kiya tum maal say meri imdad kerna chahtay ho-? iss ka jawab yeh hai kay Allah ney jo kuch mujhay diya hai , woh uss say kahen behtar hai jo tumhen diya hai , albatta tum hi log apney tohfay per khush hotay ho .
verses.translation: chunacheh jab aelchi suleman kay paas phoncha to unhon ney kaha :  kiya tum maal say meri imdad kerna chahtay ho-? iss ka jawab yeh hai kay Allah ney jo kuch mujhay diya hai , woh uss say kahen behtar hai jo tumhen diya hai , albatta tum hi log apney tohfay per khush hotay ho .

verses.text: unn kay paas wapis jao , kiyonkay abb hum unn kay paas aesay lashkar ley ker phonchen gay jinn kay muqablay ki unn mein taab nahi hogi , aur unhen wahan say iss tarah nikalen gay kay woh zaleel hon gay , aur matehat ban ker rahen gay .
verses.translation: unn kay paas wapis jao , kiyonkay abb hum unn kay paas aesay lashkar ley ker phonchen gay jinn kay muqablay ki unn mein taab nahi hogi , aur unhen wahan say iss tarah nikalen gay kay woh zaleel hon gay , aur matehat ban ker rahen gay .

verses.text: suleman ney kaha :  aey ehal-e-darbar ! tum mein say kon hai jo uss aurat ka takht unn kay tabey daar ban ker aaney say pehlay hi meray paas ley aaye-?
verses.translation: suleman ney kaha :  aey ehal-e-darbar ! tum mein say kon hai jo uss aurat ka takht unn kay tabey daar ban ker aaney say pehlay hi meray paas ley aaye-?

verses.text: aik qawi haikal jinn ney kaha :  aap apni jagah say uthay bhi naa hon gay kay mein uss say pehlay hi ussay aap kay paas ley aaon ga , aur yaqeen rakhiye kay mein iss kaam ki poori taqat rakhta hun , ( aur ) amanat daar bhi hun .
verses.translation: aik qawi haikal jinn ney kaha :  aap apni jagah say uthay bhi naa hon gay kay mein uss say pehlay hi ussay aap kay paas ley aaon ga , aur yaqeen rakhiye kay mein iss kaam ki poori taqat rakhta hun , ( aur ) amanat daar bhi hun .

verses.text: jiss kay paas kitab ka ilm tha , woh bol utha :  mein aap ki aankh jhapakney say pehlay hi ussay aap kay paas ley aata hun .    chunacheh jab suleman ney woh takht apney paas rakha huwa dekha to kaha :  yeh meray perwerdigar ka fazal hai , takay woh mujhay aazamaye kay mein shukar kerta hun ya nashukri-? aur jo koi shukar kerta hai to woh apney hi faeeday kay liye shukar kerta hai , aur agar koi nashukri keray to mera perwerdigar bey niaz hai , karim hai .
verses.translation: jiss kay paas kitab ka ilm tha , woh bol utha :  mein aap ki aankh jhapakney say pehlay hi ussay aap kay paas ley aata hun .    chunacheh jab suleman ney woh takht apney paas rakha huwa dekha to kaha :  yeh meray perwerdigar ka fazal hai , takay woh mujhay aazamaye kay mein shukar kerta hun ya nashukri-? aur jo koi shukar kerta hai to woh apney hi faeeday kay liye shukar kerta hai , aur agar koi nashukri keray to mera perwerdigar bey niaz hai , karim hai .

verses.text: suleman ney ( apney khuddaam say ) kaha kay :  iss malka kay takht ko iss kay liye ajnabi bana do ,   dekhen woh issay pehchanti hai , ya woh unn logon  mein say hai jo haqeeqat tak nahi phonchtay-?
verses.translation: suleman ney ( apney khuddaam say ) kaha kay :  iss malka kay takht ko iss kay liye ajnabi bana do ,   dekhen woh issay pehchanti hai , ya woh unn logon  mein say hai jo haqeeqat tak nahi phonchtay-?

verses.text: gharz jab woh aai to uss say poocha gaya :  kiya tumhara takht aisa hi hai-?  kehney lagi :  aisa lagta hai kay yeh to bilkul wohi hai .   hamen to iss say pehlay hi ( aap ki sachai ka ) ilm ata hogaya tha , aur hum sar jhuka chukay thay .
verses.translation: gharz jab woh aai to uss say poocha gaya :  kiya tumhara takht aisa hi hai-?  kehney lagi :  aisa lagta hai kay yeh to bilkul wohi hai .   hamen to iss say pehlay hi ( aap ki sachai ka ) ilm ata hogaya tha , aur hum sar jhuka chukay thay .

verses.text: aur ( abb tak ) uss ko ( emaan laney say ) iss baat ney rok rakha tha kay woh Allah kay bajaye doosron ki ibadat kerti thi , aakhir woh aik kafir qoam say talluq rakhti thi .
verses.translation: aur ( abb tak ) uss ko ( emaan laney say ) iss baat ney rok rakha tha kay woh Allah kay bajaye doosron ki ibadat kerti thi , aakhir woh aik kafir qoam say talluq rakhti thi .

verses.text: uss say kaha gaya kay :  iss mehal mein dakhil hojao    uss ney jo dekha to yeh samjhi kay yeh paani hai , iss liye uss ney ( paeenchay charha ker ) apni pindliyan khol den . suleman ney kaha kay :  yeh to mehal hai jo shishon ki wajeh say shaffaaf nazar aaraha hai .  malka bol uthi :  meray perwerdigar ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay mein ney ( abb tak ) apni jaan per zulm kiya hai , aur abb mein ney suleman kay sath Allah Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki farmanbardaari qubool kerli hai .
verses.translation: uss say kaha gaya kay :  iss mehal mein dakhil hojao    uss ney jo dekha to yeh samjhi kay yeh paani hai , iss liye uss ney ( paeenchay charha ker ) apni pindliyan khol den . suleman ney kaha kay :  yeh to mehal hai jo shishon ki wajeh say shaffaaf nazar aaraha hai .  malka bol uthi :  meray perwerdigar ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay mein ney ( abb tak ) apni jaan per zulm kiya hai , aur abb mein ney suleman kay sath Allah Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki farmanbardaari qubool kerli hai .

verses.text: aur hum ney qoam-e-samood kay paas unn kay bhai saleh ko yeh paygham dey ker bheja kay tum Allah ki ibadat kero ,   to achanak woh do giroh ban gaye jo aapas mein jhagarrney lagay .
verses.translation: aur hum ney qoam-e-samood kay paas unn kay bhai saleh ko yeh paygham dey ker bheja kay tum Allah ki ibadat kero ,   to achanak woh do giroh ban gaye jo aapas mein jhagarrney lagay .

verses.text: saleh ney kaha :  meri qoam kay logo ! achai say pehlay burai ko kiyon jaldi maangtay ho .   tum Allah say moaafi kiyon nahi maangtay takay tum per reham farmaya jaye-?
verses.translation: saleh ney kaha :  meri qoam kay logo ! achai say pehlay burai ko kiyon jaldi maangtay ho .   tum Allah say moaafi kiyon nahi maangtay takay tum per reham farmaya jaye-?

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  hum ney to tum say aur tumharay sathiyon say bura shagoon liya hai .    saleh ney kaha :  tumhara shagoon to Allah kay qabazay mein hai , albatta tum logon  ki aazmaesh horahi hai .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  hum ney to tum say aur tumharay sathiyon say bura shagoon liya hai .    saleh ney kaha :  tumhara shagoon to Allah kay qabazay mein hai , albatta tum logon  ki aazmaesh horahi hai .

verses.text: aur shehar mein no aadmi aesay thay jo zameen mein fasad machatay thay , aur islaah ka kaam nahi kertay thay .
verses.translation: aur shehar mein no aadmi aesay thay jo zameen mein fasad machatay thay , aur islaah ka kaam nahi kertay thay .

verses.text: unhon ney ( aapas mein aik doosray say ) kaha :  sabb milker Allah ki qasam khao kay hum saleh aur uss kay ghar walon per raat kay waqt hamla keren gay , phir uss kay waris say keh den gay kay hum unn ghar walon ki halakat kay waqt mojood hi naa thay , aur yaqeen jano hum bilkul sachay hain .
verses.translation: unhon ney ( aapas mein aik doosray say ) kaha :  sabb milker Allah ki qasam khao kay hum saleh aur uss kay ghar walon per raat kay waqt hamla keren gay , phir uss kay waris say keh den gay kay hum unn ghar walon ki halakat kay waqt mojood hi naa thay , aur yaqeen jano hum bilkul sachay hain .

verses.text: unhon ney yeh chaal chali , aur hum ney bhi aik chaal iss tarah chali kay unn ko pata bhi naa lagg saka .
verses.translation: unhon ney yeh chaal chali , aur hum ney bhi aik chaal iss tarah chali kay unn ko pata bhi naa lagg saka .

verses.text: abb dekho kay unn ki chaal bazi ka anjam kaisa huwa kay hum ney unhen aur unn ki sari qoam ko tabah ker kay rakh diya .
verses.translation: abb dekho kay unn ki chaal bazi ka anjam kaisa huwa kay hum ney unhen aur unn ki sari qoam ko tabah ker kay rakh diya .

verses.text: chunacheh woh rahey unn kay ghar jo unn kay zulm ki wajeh say weeran parray hain !   yaqeenan iss waqaey mein unn logon  kay liye ibrat ka saman hai jo ilm say kaam letay hain .
verses.translation: chunacheh woh rahey unn kay ghar jo unn kay zulm ki wajeh say weeran parray hain !   yaqeenan iss waqaey mein unn logon  kay liye ibrat ka saman hai jo ilm say kaam letay hain .

verses.text: aur jo log emaan laye thay , aur taqwa ikhtiyar kiye huye thay , unn sabb ko hum ney bacha liya .
verses.translation: aur jo log emaan laye thay , aur taqwa ikhtiyar kiye huye thay , unn sabb ko hum ney bacha liya .

verses.text: aur hum ney loot ko payghumber bana ker bheja jabkay unhon ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  kiya tum khuli aankhon dekhtay huye bhi bey hayai ka yeh kaam kertay ho-?
verses.translation: aur hum ney loot ko payghumber bana ker bheja jabkay unhon ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  kiya tum khuli aankhon dekhtay huye bhi bey hayai ka yeh kaam kertay ho-?

verses.text: kiya yeh koi yaqeen kernay ki baat hai kay tum apni jinsi khuwaish kay liye aurton ko chorr ker mardon kay paas jatay ho-? haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum bari jihalat kay kaam kernay walay log ho .
verses.translation: kiya yeh koi yaqeen kernay ki baat hai kay tum apni jinsi khuwaish kay liye aurton ko chorr ker mardon kay paas jatay ho-? haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum bari jihalat kay kaam kernay walay log ho .

verses.text: iss per yeh kehney kay siwa unn ki qoam ka koi jawab nahi tha kay :  loot kay ghar walon ko apni basti say nikal bahir kero , yeh baray pakbaaz bantay hain .
verses.translation: iss per yeh kehney kay siwa unn ki qoam ka koi jawab nahi tha kay :  loot kay ghar walon ko apni basti say nikal bahir kero , yeh baray pakbaaz bantay hain .

verses.text: phir huwa yeh kay hum ney loot aur uss kay ghar walon ko bacha liya , siwaye unn ki biwi kay jiss kay baaray mein hum ney yeh tey kerdiya tha kay woh peechay reh janey walon mein shamil rahey gi .
verses.translation: phir huwa yeh kay hum ney loot aur uss kay ghar walon ko bacha liya , siwaye unn ki biwi kay jiss kay baaray mein hum ney yeh tey kerdiya tha kay woh peechay reh janey walon mein shamil rahey gi .

verses.text: aur hum ney unn per aik zabardast barish barsai , chunacheh boht buri barish thi jo unn logon  per barsi jinhen pehlay say khabrdar kerdiya gaya tha .
verses.translation: aur hum ney unn per aik zabardast barish barsai , chunacheh boht buri barish thi jo unn logon  per barsi jinhen pehlay say khabrdar kerdiya gaya tha .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) kaho :  tamam tareefen Allah kay liye hain , aur salam ho uss kay unn bandon per jinn ko uss ney muntakhib farmaya hai !   batao kiya Allah behtar hai ya woh jinn ko inn logon  ney Allah ki khudai mein shareek bana rakha hai ?
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) kaho :  tamam tareefen Allah kay liye hain , aur salam ho uss kay unn bandon per jinn ko uss ney muntakhib farmaya hai !   batao kiya Allah behtar hai ya woh jinn ko inn logon  ney Allah ki khudai mein shareek bana rakha hai ?

verses.text: bhala woh kon hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya , aur tumharay liye aasman say paani utaara-? phir hum ney uss paani say ba-ronaq baagh ugaye , tumharay bus mein nahi tha kay tum unn kay darakhton ko uga saktay . kiya ( phir bhi tum kehtay ho kay ) Allah kay sath koi aur khuda hai-?   nahi ! balkay inn logon  ney raastay say mun morr rakha hai .
verses.translation: bhala woh kon hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya , aur tumharay liye aasman say paani utaara-? phir hum ney uss paani say ba-ronaq baagh ugaye , tumharay bus mein nahi tha kay tum unn kay darakhton ko uga saktay . kiya ( phir bhi tum kehtay ho kay ) Allah kay sath koi aur khuda hai-?   nahi ! balkay inn logon  ney raastay say mun morr rakha hai .

verses.text: bhala woh kon hai jiss ney zameen ko qarar ki jagah banaya , aur uss kay bech bech mein darya peda kiye , aur uss ( ko thehraney ) kay liye ( paharon ki ) meekhen gaarr den , aur do samandaron kay darmiyan aik aarr rakh di-?   kiya ( phir bhi tum kehtay ho kay ) Allah kay sath koi aur khuda hai-? nahi ! balkay unn mein say aksar log haqeeqat say na-waqif hain .
verses.translation: bhala woh kon hai jiss ney zameen ko qarar ki jagah banaya , aur uss kay bech bech mein darya peda kiye , aur uss ( ko thehraney ) kay liye ( paharon ki ) meekhen gaarr den , aur do samandaron kay darmiyan aik aarr rakh di-?   kiya ( phir bhi tum kehtay ho kay ) Allah kay sath koi aur khuda hai-? nahi ! balkay unn mein say aksar log haqeeqat say na-waqif hain .

verses.text: bhala woh kon hai kay jab koi bey qarar ussay pukarta hai to woh uss ki dua qubool kerta hai , aur takleef door ker deta hai , aur jo tumhen zameen ka khalifa banata hai-? kiya ( phir bhi tum kehtay ho kay ) Allah kay sath koi aur khuda hai ? nahi ! balkay tum boht kam naseehat qubool kertay ho .
verses.translation: bhala woh kon hai kay jab koi bey qarar ussay pukarta hai to woh uss ki dua qubool kerta hai , aur takleef door ker deta hai , aur jo tumhen zameen ka khalifa banata hai-? kiya ( phir bhi tum kehtay ho kay ) Allah kay sath koi aur khuda hai ? nahi ! balkay tum boht kam naseehat qubool kertay ho .

verses.text: bhala woh kon hai jo khushki aur samandar kay andheron mein tumhen raasta dikhata hai , aur jo apni rehmat ( ki barish ) say pehlay hawayen bhejta hai jo tumhen ( barish ki ) khushkhabri deti hain-? kiya ( phir bhi tum kehtay ho kay ) Allah kay sath koi aur khuda hai-? ( nahi ! balkay ) Allah uss shirk say boht baala o bartar hai jiss ka irtikab yeh log ker rahey hain .
verses.translation: bhala woh kon hai jo khushki aur samandar kay andheron mein tumhen raasta dikhata hai , aur jo apni rehmat ( ki barish ) say pehlay hawayen bhejta hai jo tumhen ( barish ki ) khushkhabri deti hain-? kiya ( phir bhi tum kehtay ho kay ) Allah kay sath koi aur khuda hai-? ( nahi ! balkay ) Allah uss shirk say boht baala o bartar hai jiss ka irtikab yeh log ker rahey hain .

verses.text: bhala woh kon hai jiss ney sari makhlooq ko pehli baar peda kiya , phir woh uss ko dobara peda keray ga , aur jo tumhen aasman aur zameen say rizq farham kerta hai-? kiya ( phir bhi tum kehtay ho kay ) Allah kay sath koi aur khuda hai-? kaho :  lao apni koi daleel , agar tum sachay ho .
verses.translation: bhala woh kon hai jiss ney sari makhlooq ko pehli baar peda kiya , phir woh uss ko dobara peda keray ga , aur jo tumhen aasman aur zameen say rizq farham kerta hai-? kiya ( phir bhi tum kehtay ho kay ) Allah kay sath koi aur khuda hai-? kaho :  lao apni koi daleel , agar tum sachay ho .

verses.text: keh do kay :  Allah kay siwa aasmano aur zameen mein kissi ko bhi ghaib ka ilm nahi hai ,   aur logon  ko yeh bhi pata nahi hai kay unhen kab dobara zinda kiya jaye ga .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  Allah kay siwa aasmano aur zameen mein kissi ko bhi ghaib ka ilm nahi hai ,   aur logon  ko yeh bhi pata nahi hai kay unhen kab dobara zinda kiya jaye ga .

verses.text: balkay aakhirat kay baaray mein inn ( kafiron ) ka ilm bey bus ho ker reh gaya hai , balkay woh uss kay baaray mein shak mein mubtala hain , balkay uss say andhay hochukay hain .
verses.translation: balkay aakhirat kay baaray mein inn ( kafiron ) ka ilm bey bus ho ker reh gaya hai , balkay woh uss kay baaray mein shak mein mubtala hain , balkay uss say andhay hochukay hain .

verses.text: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  kiya jab hum aur humaray baap daday mitti hochukay hon gay to kiya uss waqt waqaee hamen ( qabron say ) nikala jaye ga-?
verses.translation: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  kiya jab hum aur humaray baap daday mitti hochukay hon gay to kiya uss waqt waqaee hamen ( qabron say ) nikala jaye ga-?

verses.text: hum say aur humaray baap dadon say iss qisam kay waday pehlay bhi kiye gaye thay , ( lekin ) inn ki haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay yeh qissa kahaniyan hain jo puraney zamaney kay logon  say naqal hoti chali aarahi hain .
verses.translation: hum say aur humaray baap dadon say iss qisam kay waday pehlay bhi kiye gaye thay , ( lekin ) inn ki haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay yeh qissa kahaniyan hain jo puraney zamaney kay logon  say naqal hoti chali aarahi hain .

verses.text: kaho kay :  zara zameen mein safar ker kay dekho kay mujrimon ka anjam kaisa huwa hai .
verses.translation: kaho kay :  zara zameen mein safar ker kay dekho kay mujrimon ka anjam kaisa huwa hai .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn logon  per ghum naa kero , aur yeh jiss makkaari ka muzahira ker rahey hain , unn ki wajeh say ghuttan mehsoos naa kero .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn logon  per ghum naa kero , aur yeh jiss makkaari ka muzahira ker rahey hain , unn ki wajeh say ghuttan mehsoos naa kero .

verses.text: yeh ( tum say ) yun kehtay hain kay :  yeh wada kab poora hoga , agar tum sachay ho-?
verses.translation: yeh ( tum say ) yun kehtay hain kay :  yeh wada kab poora hoga , agar tum sachay ho-?

verses.text: keh do kay :  kuch baeed nahi hai kay jiss azab ki tum jaldi macha rahey ho , uss ka kuch hissa tumharay bilkul paas aa-laga ho .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  kuch baeed nahi hai kay jiss azab ki tum jaldi macha rahey ho , uss ka kuch hissa tumharay bilkul paas aa-laga ho .

verses.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay tumhara perwerdigar logon  per boht fazal kernay wala hai , lekin unn mein say aksar log shukar nahi kertay .
verses.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay tumhara perwerdigar logon  per boht fazal kernay wala hai , lekin unn mein say aksar log shukar nahi kertay .

verses.text: aur yaqeen rakho kay tumhara perwerdigar woh sari baaten bhi janta hai jo inn kay seenay chupaye huye hain , aur woh baaten bhi jo woh aelania kertay hain .
verses.translation: aur yaqeen rakho kay tumhara perwerdigar woh sari baaten bhi janta hai jo inn kay seenay chupaye huye hain , aur woh baaten bhi jo woh aelania kertay hain .

verses.text: aur aasman aur zameen ki koi posheeda cheez aesi nahi hai jo aik wazeh kitab mein darj naa ho .
verses.translation: aur aasman aur zameen ki koi posheeda cheez aesi nahi hai jo aik wazeh kitab mein darj naa ho .

verses.text: waqiaa yeh hai kay yeh Quran bano Israel kay samney aksar unn baaton ki haqeeqat wazeh kerta hai jinn mein woh ikhtilaf kertay hain .
verses.translation: waqiaa yeh hai kay yeh Quran bano Israel kay samney aksar unn baaton ki haqeeqat wazeh kerta hai jinn mein woh ikhtilaf kertay hain .
