verses.text: aur yaqeenan yeh emaan laney walon kay liye hidayat aur rehmat hai .
verses.translation: aur yaqeenan yeh emaan laney walon kay liye hidayat aur rehmat hai .

verses.text: aur tumhara perwerdigar yaqeenan unn kay darmiyan apney hukum say faisla keray ga , aur woh bara iqtidar wala , bara ilm wala hai .
verses.translation: aur tumhara perwerdigar yaqeenan unn kay darmiyan apney hukum say faisla keray ga , aur woh bara iqtidar wala , bara ilm wala hai .

verses.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum Allah per bharosa rakho . yaqeenan tum khulay khulay haq per ho .
verses.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum Allah per bharosa rakho . yaqeenan tum khulay khulay haq per ho .

verses.text: yaad rakho kay tum murdon ko apni baat nahi suna saktay , aur naa tum behron ko apni pukar suna saktay ho , jab woh peeth pher ker chal kharray hon .
verses.translation: yaad rakho kay tum murdon ko apni baat nahi suna saktay , aur naa tum behron ko apni pukar suna saktay ho , jab woh peeth pher ker chal kharray hon .

verses.text: aur naa tum andhon ko unn ki gumrahi say bacha ker raastay per laasaktay ho . tum to unhi logon  ko apni baat suna saktay ho jo humari aayaton per emaan layen , phir wohi log farmanbardaar hon gay .
verses.translation: aur naa tum andhon ko unn ki gumrahi say bacha ker raastay per laasaktay ho . tum to unhi logon  ko apni baat suna saktay ho jo humari aayaton per emaan layen , phir wohi log farmanbardaar hon gay .

verses.text: aur jab humari baat poori honey ka waqt inn logon  per aa-phonchay ga to hum inn kay liye zameen say aik janwer nikalen gay jo inn say baat keray ga kay log humari aayaton per yaqeen nahi rakhtay thay .
verses.translation: aur jab humari baat poori honey ka waqt inn logon  per aa-phonchay ga to hum inn kay liye zameen say aik janwer nikalen gay jo inn say baat keray ga kay log humari aayaton per yaqeen nahi rakhtay thay .

verses.text: aur uss din ko naa bhoolo jab hum her ummat mein say unn logon  ki poori foaj ko gher layen gay jo humari aayaton ko jhutlaya kertay thay , phir unn ki jamat bandi ki jaye gi .
verses.translation: aur uss din ko naa bhoolo jab hum her ummat mein say unn logon  ki poori foaj ko gher layen gay jo humari aayaton ko jhutlaya kertay thay , phir unn ki jamat bandi ki jaye gi .

verses.text: yahan tak kay jab sabb aajayen gay to Allah kahey ga kay :  kiya tum ney meri aayaton ko poori tarah samjhay baghair hi jhutla diya tha , ya kiya kertay rahey thay-?
verses.translation: yahan tak kay jab sabb aajayen gay to Allah kahey ga kay :  kiya tum ney meri aayaton ko poori tarah samjhay baghair hi jhutla diya tha , ya kiya kertay rahey thay-?

verses.text: aur unhon ney jo zulm kiya tha , uss ki wajeh say unn per azab ki baat poori hojaye gi , chunacheh woh kuch bol nahi saken gay .
verses.translation: aur unhon ney jo zulm kiya tha , uss ki wajeh say unn per azab ki baat poori hojaye gi , chunacheh woh kuch bol nahi saken gay .

verses.text: kiya unhon ney dekha nahi kay hum ney raat iss liye banai hai kay woh uss mein sukoon hasil keren , aur din iss tarah banaya hai kay uss mein cheezen dikhai den-? yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo emaan latay hain .
verses.translation: kiya unhon ney dekha nahi kay hum ney raat iss liye banai hai kay woh uss mein sukoon hasil keren , aur din iss tarah banaya hai kay uss mein cheezen dikhai den-? yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo emaan latay hain .

verses.text: aur jiss din soor phoonka jaye ga , to aasmano aur zameen kay sabb rehney walay ghabra uthen gay , siwaye unn kay jinhen Allah chahye ga ,   aur sabb uss kay paas jhukay huye hazir hon gay .
verses.translation: aur jiss din soor phoonka jaye ga , to aasmano aur zameen kay sabb rehney walay ghabra uthen gay , siwaye unn kay jinhen Allah chahye ga ,   aur sabb uss kay paas jhukay huye hazir hon gay .

verses.text: tum ( aaj ) paharon ko dekhtay ho to samajhtay ho kay yeh apni jagah jamay huye hain , halankay ( uss waqt ) woh iss tarah phir rahey hon gay jaisay badal phirtay hain . yeh sabb Allah ki karigari hai jiss ney her cheez ko mustehkam tareeqay say banaya hai . yaqeenan ussay poori khabar hai kay tum kiya kaam kertay ho .
verses.translation: tum ( aaj ) paharon ko dekhtay ho to samajhtay ho kay yeh apni jagah jamay huye hain , halankay ( uss waqt ) woh iss tarah phir rahey hon gay jaisay badal phirtay hain . yeh sabb Allah ki karigari hai jiss ney her cheez ko mustehkam tareeqay say banaya hai . yaqeenan ussay poori khabar hai kay tum kiya kaam kertay ho .

verses.text: jo koi naiki ley ker aaye ga ussay uss say behtar badla milay ga ,   aur aesay log uss din her qisam ki ghabrahat say mehfooz hon gay .
verses.translation: jo koi naiki ley ker aaye ga ussay uss say behtar badla milay ga ,   aur aesay log uss din her qisam ki ghabrahat say mehfooz hon gay .

verses.text: aur jo koi burai ley ker aaye ga to aesay logon  ko mun kay ball aag mein daal diya jaye ga . tumhen kissi aur baat ki nahi , unhi aemal ki saza di jaye gi jo tum kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: aur jo koi burai ley ker aaye ga to aesay logon  ko mun kay ball aag mein daal diya jaye ga . tumhen kissi aur baat ki nahi , unhi aemal ki saza di jaye gi jo tum kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say keh do kay : )  mujhay to yehi hukum mila hai kay mein iss shehar kay rab ki ibadat kerun jiss ney iss shehar ko hurmat bakhshi hai , aur her cheez ka malik wohi hai , aur mujhay yeh hukum mila hai kay mein farmanbardaaron mein shamil rahun .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say keh do kay : )  mujhay to yehi hukum mila hai kay mein iss shehar kay rab ki ibadat kerun jiss ney iss shehar ko hurmat bakhshi hai , aur her cheez ka malik wohi hai , aur mujhay yeh hukum mila hai kay mein farmanbardaaron mein shamil rahun .

verses.text: aur yeh kay mein Quran ki tilawat kerun .  abb jo shaks hidayat kay raastay per aaye , woh apney hi faeeday kay liye raastay per aaye ga , aur jo gumrahi ikhtiyar keray , to keh dena kay :  mein to bus unn logon  mein say hon jo khabrdar kertay hain .
verses.translation: aur yeh kay mein Quran ki tilawat kerun .  abb jo shaks hidayat kay raastay per aaye , woh apney hi faeeday kay liye raastay per aaye ga , aur jo gumrahi ikhtiyar keray , to keh dena kay :  mein to bus unn logon  mein say hon jo khabrdar kertay hain .

verses.text: aur keh do kay :  tamam tareefen Allah ki hain , woh tumhen apni nishaniyan dikhaye ga , phir tum unhen pehchan bhi lo gay .   aur tumhara perwerdigar tumharay kamon say bey khabar nahi hai .
verses.translation: aur keh do kay :  tamam tareefen Allah ki hain , woh tumhen apni nishaniyan dikhaye ga , phir tum unhen pehchan bhi lo gay .   aur tumhara perwerdigar tumharay kamon say bey khabar nahi hai .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: Tua-Seen . yeh Quran ki aur aik aesi kitab ki aayaten hein jo haqeeqat khol denay wali hai ,
ayahs.translation: Tua-Seen . yeh Quran ki aur aik aesi kitab ki aayaten hein jo haqeeqat khol denay wali hai ,

ayahs.text: yeh unn mominon kay liye sarapa hidayat aur khushkhabri ban ker aai hai
ayahs.translation: yeh unn mominon kay liye sarapa hidayat aur khushkhabri ban ker aai hai

ayahs.text: jo namaz qaeem kertay hain , aur zakat ada kertay hain . aur wohi hain jo aakhirat per yaqeen rakhtay hain .
ayahs.translation: jo namaz qaeem kertay hain , aur zakat ada kertay hain . aur wohi hain jo aakhirat per yaqeen rakhtay hain .

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , hum ney unn kay aemal ko unn ki nazron mein khushnuma bana diya hai ,   iss liye woh bhataktay phir rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , hum ney unn kay aemal ko unn ki nazron mein khushnuma bana diya hai ,   iss liye woh bhataktay phir rahey hain .

ayahs.text: yehi woh log hain jinn kay liye bura azab hai , aur wohi hain jo aakhirat mein sabb say ziyada nuqsan uthaney walay hain .
ayahs.translation: yehi woh log hain jinn kay liye bura azab hai , aur wohi hain jo aakhirat mein sabb say ziyada nuqsan uthaney walay hain .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) bila shubha tumhen yeh Quran uss ( Allah ) ki taraf say ata kiya jaraha hai jo hikmat ka bhi malik hai , ilm ka bhi malik .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) bila shubha tumhen yeh Quran uss ( Allah ) ki taraf say ata kiya jaraha hai jo hikmat ka bhi malik hai , ilm ka bhi malik .

ayahs.text: uss waqt ko yaad kero jab musa ney apney ghar walon say kaha tha kay :  mujhay aik aag nazar aai hai . mein abhi tumharay paas wahan say koi khabar ley ker aata hun , ya phir tumharay paas aag ka koi shola utha kerlay aaon ga , takay tum aag say garmi hasil ker-sako .
ayahs.translation: uss waqt ko yaad kero jab musa ney apney ghar walon say kaha tha kay :  mujhay aik aag nazar aai hai . mein abhi tumharay paas wahan say koi khabar ley ker aata hun , ya phir tumharay paas aag ka koi shola utha kerlay aaon ga , takay tum aag say garmi hasil ker-sako .

ayahs.text: chunacheh jab woh uss aag kay paas phonchay to unhen aawaz di gaee kay :  barkat ho unn per bhi jo iss aag kay andar hain , aur uss per bhi jo iss kay aas paas hai ,   aur pak hai Allah jo saray jahano ka perwerdigar hai .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh jab woh uss aag kay paas phonchay to unhen aawaz di gaee kay :  barkat ho unn per bhi jo iss aag kay andar hain , aur uss per bhi jo iss kay aas paas hai ,   aur pak hai Allah jo saray jahano ka perwerdigar hai .

ayahs.text: aey musa !  baat yeh hai kay mein Allah hun , baray iqtidar wala , bari hikmat wala ,
ayahs.translation: aey musa !  baat yeh hai kay mein Allah hun , baray iqtidar wala , bari hikmat wala ,

ayahs.text: aur zara apni laathi ko neechay phenko .  phir jab unhon ney laathi ko dekha kay woh iss tarah harkat ker rahi hai jaisay woh koi saanp ho to woh peeth pher ker bhagay , aur peechay murr ker bhi naa dekha . ( irshad huwa )  musa ! daro nahi , jinn ko payghumber banaya jata hai , unn ko meray huzoor koi andesha nahi hota ,
ayahs.translation: aur zara apni laathi ko neechay phenko .  phir jab unhon ney laathi ko dekha kay woh iss tarah harkat ker rahi hai jaisay woh koi saanp ho to woh peeth pher ker bhagay , aur peechay murr ker bhi naa dekha . ( irshad huwa )  musa ! daro nahi , jinn ko payghumber banaya jata hai , unn ko meray huzoor koi andesha nahi hota ,

ayahs.text: illa yeh kay kissi ney koi ziyadti ki ho .   phir woh burai kay baad ussay badal ker achay kaam kerlay , to mein boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hun .
ayahs.translation: illa yeh kay kissi ney koi ziyadti ki ho .   phir woh burai kay baad ussay badal ker achay kaam kerlay , to mein boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hun .

ayahs.text: aur apna haath apney giraybaan mein dakhil kero , to woh kissi beemari kay baghair safaid ho ker niklay ga . yeh dono baaten unn no nishaniyon mein say hain jo firon aur uss ki qoam ki taraf ( tumharay zariye ) bheji jarahi hain .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh nafarman log hain .
ayahs.translation: aur apna haath apney giraybaan mein dakhil kero , to woh kissi beemari kay baghair safaid ho ker niklay ga . yeh dono baaten unn no nishaniyon mein say hain jo firon aur uss ki qoam ki taraf ( tumharay zariye ) bheji jarahi hain .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh nafarman log hain .

ayahs.text: phir huwa yeh kay jab unn kay paas humari nishaniyan iss tarah phonchen kay woh aankhen kholney wali then , to unhon ney kaha kay :  yeh to khula huwa jadoo hai .
ayahs.translation: phir huwa yeh kay jab unn kay paas humari nishaniyan iss tarah phonchen kay woh aankhen kholney wali then , to unhon ney kaha kay :  yeh to khula huwa jadoo hai .

ayahs.text: aur agar-cheh unn kay dilon ko unn ( ki sachai ) ka yaqeen hochuka tha , magar unhon ney zulm aur takabbur ki wajeh say unn ka inkar kiya . abb dekh lo kay unn fasad machaney walon ka anjam kaisa huwa-?
ayahs.translation: aur agar-cheh unn kay dilon ko unn ( ki sachai ) ka yaqeen hochuka tha , magar unhon ney zulm aur takabbur ki wajeh say unn ka inkar kiya . abb dekh lo kay unn fasad machaney walon ka anjam kaisa huwa-?

ayahs.text: aur hum ney dawood aur suleman ko ilm ata kiya . aur unhon ney kaha :  tamam tareefen Allah ki hain jiss ney hamen apney boht say momin bandon per fazilat ata farmaee hai .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney dawood aur suleman ko ilm ata kiya . aur unhon ney kaha :  tamam tareefen Allah ki hain jiss ney hamen apney boht say momin bandon per fazilat ata farmaee hai .

ayahs.text: aur suleman ko dawood ki virasat mili ,   aur unhon ney kaha :  aey logo ! hamen parindon ki boli sikhai gaee hai ,   aur hamen her ( zaroorat ki ) cheez ata ki gaee hai . yaqeenan yeh ( Allah taalaa ka ) khula huwa fazal hai .
ayahs.translation: aur suleman ko dawood ki virasat mili ,   aur unhon ney kaha :  aey logo ! hamen parindon ki boli sikhai gaee hai ,   aur hamen her ( zaroorat ki ) cheez ata ki gaee hai . yaqeenan yeh ( Allah taalaa ka ) khula huwa fazal hai .

ayahs.text: aur suleman kay liye unn kay saray lashkar jama kerdiye gaye thay jo jinnaat , insanon aur parindon per mushtamil thay , chunacheh unhen qaboo mein rakha jata tha .
ayahs.translation: aur suleman kay liye unn kay saray lashkar jama kerdiye gaye thay jo jinnaat , insanon aur parindon per mushtamil thay , chunacheh unhen qaboo mein rakha jata tha .

ayahs.text: yahan tak kay aik din jab yeh sabb chewntiyon ki wadi mein phonchay to aik chewnti ney kaha :  chewntiyo ! apney apney gharon mein ghuss jao , kahen aisa naa ho kay suleman aur unn ka lashkar tumhen pees daalay , aur unhen pata bhi naa chalay .
ayahs.translation: yahan tak kay aik din jab yeh sabb chewntiyon ki wadi mein phonchay to aik chewnti ney kaha :  chewntiyo ! apney apney gharon mein ghuss jao , kahen aisa naa ho kay suleman aur unn ka lashkar tumhen pees daalay , aur unhen pata bhi naa chalay .

ayahs.text: uss ki baat per suleman muskura ker hansay , aur kehney lagay :  meray perwerdigar ! mujhay iss baat ka paband bana dijiye kay mein  aap ki unn naimaton ka shukar ada kerun jo aap ney mujhay aur meray walaiden ko ata farmaee hain , aur woh naik amal kerun jo aap ko pasand ho , aur apni rehmat say mujhay apney naik bandon mein shamil farma-lijiye .
ayahs.translation: uss ki baat per suleman muskura ker hansay , aur kehney lagay :  meray perwerdigar ! mujhay iss baat ka paband bana dijiye kay mein  aap ki unn naimaton ka shukar ada kerun jo aap ney mujhay aur meray walaiden ko ata farmaee hain , aur woh naik amal kerun jo aap ko pasand ho , aur apni rehmat say mujhay apney naik bandon mein shamil farma-lijiye .

ayahs.text: aur unhon ney ( aik martaba ) parindon ki haziri li to kaha :  kiya baat hai , mujhay hudhud nazar nahi aaraha , kiya woh kahen ghaeeb hogaya hai-?
ayahs.translation: aur unhon ney ( aik martaba ) parindon ki haziri li to kaha :  kiya baat hai , mujhay hudhud nazar nahi aaraha , kiya woh kahen ghaeeb hogaya hai-?

ayahs.text: mein ussay sakht saza dun ga , ya ussay zibah ker daalun ga , illa yeh kay woh meray samney koi wazeh wajeh paish keray .
ayahs.translation: mein ussay sakht saza dun ga , ya ussay zibah ker daalun ga , illa yeh kay woh meray samney koi wazeh wajeh paish keray .

ayahs.text: phir hudhud ney ziyada dair nahi lagai aur ( aa-ker ) kaha kay :  mein ney aesi maloomaat hasil ki hain jinn ka aap ko ilm nahi hai , aur mein mulk e saba say aap kay paas aik yaqeeni khabar ley ker aaya hun .
ayahs.translation: phir hudhud ney ziyada dair nahi lagai aur ( aa-ker ) kaha kay :  mein ney aesi maloomaat hasil ki hain jinn ka aap ko ilm nahi hai , aur mein mulk e saba say aap kay paas aik yaqeeni khabar ley ker aaya hun .

ayahs.text: mein ney wahan aik aurat ko paya jo unn logon  per badshahat ker rahi hai , aur uss ko her tarah ka saz-o-saman diya gaya hai , aur uss ka aik shandaar takht bhi hai .
ayahs.translation: mein ney wahan aik aurat ko paya jo unn logon  per badshahat ker rahi hai , aur uss ko her tarah ka saz-o-saman diya gaya hai , aur uss ka aik shandaar takht bhi hai .

ayahs.text: mein ney uss aurat aur uss ki qoam ko paya hai kay woh Allah ko chorr ker sooraj kay aagay sajday kertay hain , aur shetan ney unn ko yeh sujha diya hai kay unn kay aemal boht achay hain , chunacheh uss ney unhen sahih raastay say rok rakha hai aur iss tarah woh hidayat say itney door hain
ayahs.translation: mein ney uss aurat aur uss ki qoam ko paya hai kay woh Allah ko chorr ker sooraj kay aagay sajday kertay hain , aur shetan ney unn ko yeh sujha diya hai kay unn kay aemal boht achay hain , chunacheh uss ney unhen sahih raastay say rok rakha hai aur iss tarah woh hidayat say itney door hain

ayahs.text: kay Allah ko sajda nahi kertay jo aasmano aur zameen ki chupi hoi cheezon ko bahir nikal lata hai , aur tum jo kuch chupao , aur jo kuch zahir kero , sabb ko janta hai .
ayahs.translation: kay Allah ko sajda nahi kertay jo aasmano aur zameen ki chupi hoi cheezon ko bahir nikal lata hai , aur tum jo kuch chupao , aur jo kuch zahir kero , sabb ko janta hai .

ayahs.text: Allah to woh hai jiss kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi , ( aur ) jo arsh-e-azeem ka malik hai .  (  ?  )
ayahs.translation: Allah to woh hai jiss kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi , ( aur ) jo arsh-e-azeem ka malik hai .  (  ?  )

ayahs.text: suleman ney kaha :  hum abhi dekh letay hain kay tum ney sach kaha hai ya jhoot bolney walon mein tum bhi shamil hogaye ho .
ayahs.translation: suleman ney kaha :  hum abhi dekh letay hain kay tum ney sach kaha hai ya jhoot bolney walon mein tum bhi shamil hogaye ho .

ayahs.text: mera yeh khat ley ker jao aur unn kay paas daal dena , phir alag hatt jana , aur dekhna kay woh jawab mein kiya kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: mera yeh khat ley ker jao aur unn kay paas daal dena , phir alag hatt jana , aur dekhna kay woh jawab mein kiya kertay hain .

ayahs.text: . ( chunacheh hudhud ney aisa hi kiya aur ) malka ney ( apney darbariyon say ) kaha :  qoam kay sardaro ! meray samney aik ba-waqar khat daala gaya hai ,
ayahs.translation: . ( chunacheh hudhud ney aisa hi kiya aur ) malka ney ( apney darbariyon say ) kaha :  qoam kay sardaro ! meray samney aik ba-waqar khat daala gaya hai ,

ayahs.text: woh suleman ki taraf say aaya hai , aur woh Allah kay naam say shuroo kiya gaya hai jo rehman o raheem hai ,
ayahs.translation: woh suleman ki taraf say aaya hai , aur woh Allah kay naam say shuroo kiya gaya hai jo rehman o raheem hai ,

ayahs.text: . ( uss mein likha hai ) kay :  meray muqablay mein sarkashi naa kero , aur meray paas tabey daar ban ker chalay aao .
ayahs.translation: . ( uss mein likha hai ) kay :  meray muqablay mein sarkashi naa kero , aur meray paas tabey daar ban ker chalay aao .

ayahs.text: malka ney kaha :  qoam kay sardaro ! jo masla meray samney aaya hai , uss mein mujhay faisla kunn mashwara do . mein kissi maslay ka hatmi faisla uss waqt tak nahi kerti jab tak tum meray paas mojood naa ho .
ayahs.translation: malka ney kaha :  qoam kay sardaro ! jo masla meray samney aaya hai , uss mein mujhay faisla kunn mashwara do . mein kissi maslay ka hatmi faisla uss waqt tak nahi kerti jab tak tum meray paas mojood naa ho .

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha :  hum taqatwar aur datt ker larrney walay log hain , aagay moamla aap kay supurd hai , abb aap dekh len kay kiya hukum deti hain .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha :  hum taqatwar aur datt ker larrney walay log hain , aagay moamla aap kay supurd hai , abb aap dekh len kay kiya hukum deti hain .

ayahs.text: malka boli :  haqeeqat yeh hai kay badshah log jab kissi basti mein ghuss aatay hain to ussay kharab ker daaltay hain , aur uss kay ba-izzat bashindon ko zaleel ker kay chortay hain , aur yehi kuch yeh log bhi keren gay .
ayahs.translation: malka boli :  haqeeqat yeh hai kay badshah log jab kissi basti mein ghuss aatay hain to ussay kharab ker daaltay hain , aur uss kay ba-izzat bashindon ko zaleel ker kay chortay hain , aur yehi kuch yeh log bhi keren gay .

ayahs.text: aur mein unn kay paas aik tohfa bhejti hun , phir dekhun gi kay aelchi kiya jawab ley ker wapis aatay hain-?
ayahs.translation: aur mein unn kay paas aik tohfa bhejti hun , phir dekhun gi kay aelchi kiya jawab ley ker wapis aatay hain-?

ayahs.text: chunacheh jab aelchi suleman kay paas phoncha to unhon ney kaha :  kiya tum maal say meri imdad kerna chahtay ho-? iss ka jawab yeh hai kay Allah ney jo kuch mujhay diya hai , woh uss say kahen behtar hai jo tumhen diya hai , albatta tum hi log apney tohfay per khush hotay ho .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh jab aelchi suleman kay paas phoncha to unhon ney kaha :  kiya tum maal say meri imdad kerna chahtay ho-? iss ka jawab yeh hai kay Allah ney jo kuch mujhay diya hai , woh uss say kahen behtar hai jo tumhen diya hai , albatta tum hi log apney tohfay per khush hotay ho .

ayahs.text: unn kay paas wapis jao , kiyonkay abb hum unn kay paas aesay lashkar ley ker phonchen gay jinn kay muqablay ki unn mein taab nahi hogi , aur unhen wahan say iss tarah nikalen gay kay woh zaleel hon gay , aur matehat ban ker rahen gay .
ayahs.translation: unn kay paas wapis jao , kiyonkay abb hum unn kay paas aesay lashkar ley ker phonchen gay jinn kay muqablay ki unn mein taab nahi hogi , aur unhen wahan say iss tarah nikalen gay kay woh zaleel hon gay , aur matehat ban ker rahen gay .

ayahs.text: suleman ney kaha :  aey ehal-e-darbar ! tum mein say kon hai jo uss aurat ka takht unn kay tabey daar ban ker aaney say pehlay hi meray paas ley aaye-?
ayahs.translation: suleman ney kaha :  aey ehal-e-darbar ! tum mein say kon hai jo uss aurat ka takht unn kay tabey daar ban ker aaney say pehlay hi meray paas ley aaye-?

ayahs.text: aik qawi haikal jinn ney kaha :  aap apni jagah say uthay bhi naa hon gay kay mein uss say pehlay hi ussay aap kay paas ley aaon ga , aur yaqeen rakhiye kay mein iss kaam ki poori taqat rakhta hun , ( aur ) amanat daar bhi hun .
ayahs.translation: aik qawi haikal jinn ney kaha :  aap apni jagah say uthay bhi naa hon gay kay mein uss say pehlay hi ussay aap kay paas ley aaon ga , aur yaqeen rakhiye kay mein iss kaam ki poori taqat rakhta hun , ( aur ) amanat daar bhi hun .

ayahs.text: jiss kay paas kitab ka ilm tha , woh bol utha :  mein aap ki aankh jhapakney say pehlay hi ussay aap kay paas ley aata hun .    chunacheh jab suleman ney woh takht apney paas rakha huwa dekha to kaha :  yeh meray perwerdigar ka fazal hai , takay woh mujhay aazamaye kay mein shukar kerta hun ya nashukri-? aur jo koi shukar kerta hai to woh apney hi faeeday kay liye shukar kerta hai , aur agar koi nashukri keray to mera perwerdigar bey niaz hai , karim hai .
ayahs.translation: jiss kay paas kitab ka ilm tha , woh bol utha :  mein aap ki aankh jhapakney say pehlay hi ussay aap kay paas ley aata hun .    chunacheh jab suleman ney woh takht apney paas rakha huwa dekha to kaha :  yeh meray perwerdigar ka fazal hai , takay woh mujhay aazamaye kay mein shukar kerta hun ya nashukri-? aur jo koi shukar kerta hai to woh apney hi faeeday kay liye shukar kerta hai , aur agar koi nashukri keray to mera perwerdigar bey niaz hai , karim hai .

ayahs.text: suleman ney ( apney khuddaam say ) kaha kay :  iss malka kay takht ko iss kay liye ajnabi bana do ,   dekhen woh issay pehchanti hai , ya woh unn logon  mein say hai jo haqeeqat tak nahi phonchtay-?
ayahs.translation: suleman ney ( apney khuddaam say ) kaha kay :  iss malka kay takht ko iss kay liye ajnabi bana do ,   dekhen woh issay pehchanti hai , ya woh unn logon  mein say hai jo haqeeqat tak nahi phonchtay-?

ayahs.text: gharz jab woh aai to uss say poocha gaya :  kiya tumhara takht aisa hi hai-?  kehney lagi :  aisa lagta hai kay yeh to bilkul wohi hai .   hamen to iss say pehlay hi ( aap ki sachai ka ) ilm ata hogaya tha , aur hum sar jhuka chukay thay .
ayahs.translation: gharz jab woh aai to uss say poocha gaya :  kiya tumhara takht aisa hi hai-?  kehney lagi :  aisa lagta hai kay yeh to bilkul wohi hai .   hamen to iss say pehlay hi ( aap ki sachai ka ) ilm ata hogaya tha , aur hum sar jhuka chukay thay .

ayahs.text: aur ( abb tak ) uss ko ( emaan laney say ) iss baat ney rok rakha tha kay woh Allah kay bajaye doosron ki ibadat kerti thi , aakhir woh aik kafir qoam say talluq rakhti thi .
ayahs.translation: aur ( abb tak ) uss ko ( emaan laney say ) iss baat ney rok rakha tha kay woh Allah kay bajaye doosron ki ibadat kerti thi , aakhir woh aik kafir qoam say talluq rakhti thi .

ayahs.text: uss say kaha gaya kay :  iss mehal mein dakhil hojao    uss ney jo dekha to yeh samjhi kay yeh paani hai , iss liye uss ney ( paeenchay charha ker ) apni pindliyan khol den . suleman ney kaha kay :  yeh to mehal hai jo shishon ki wajeh say shaffaaf nazar aaraha hai .  malka bol uthi :  meray perwerdigar ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay mein ney ( abb tak ) apni jaan per zulm kiya hai , aur abb mein ney suleman kay sath Allah Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki farmanbardaari qubool kerli hai .
ayahs.translation: uss say kaha gaya kay :  iss mehal mein dakhil hojao    uss ney jo dekha to yeh samjhi kay yeh paani hai , iss liye uss ney ( paeenchay charha ker ) apni pindliyan khol den . suleman ney kaha kay :  yeh to mehal hai jo shishon ki wajeh say shaffaaf nazar aaraha hai .  malka bol uthi :  meray perwerdigar ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay mein ney ( abb tak ) apni jaan per zulm kiya hai , aur abb mein ney suleman kay sath Allah Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki farmanbardaari qubool kerli hai .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney qoam-e-samood kay paas unn kay bhai saleh ko yeh paygham dey ker bheja kay tum Allah ki ibadat kero ,   to achanak woh do giroh ban gaye jo aapas mein jhagarrney lagay .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney qoam-e-samood kay paas unn kay bhai saleh ko yeh paygham dey ker bheja kay tum Allah ki ibadat kero ,   to achanak woh do giroh ban gaye jo aapas mein jhagarrney lagay .

ayahs.text: saleh ney kaha :  meri qoam kay logo ! achai say pehlay burai ko kiyon jaldi maangtay ho .   tum Allah say moaafi kiyon nahi maangtay takay tum per reham farmaya jaye-?
ayahs.translation: saleh ney kaha :  meri qoam kay logo ! achai say pehlay burai ko kiyon jaldi maangtay ho .   tum Allah say moaafi kiyon nahi maangtay takay tum per reham farmaya jaye-?

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha :  hum ney to tum say aur tumharay sathiyon say bura shagoon liya hai .    saleh ney kaha :  tumhara shagoon to Allah kay qabazay mein hai , albatta tum logon  ki aazmaesh horahi hai .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha :  hum ney to tum say aur tumharay sathiyon say bura shagoon liya hai .    saleh ney kaha :  tumhara shagoon to Allah kay qabazay mein hai , albatta tum logon  ki aazmaesh horahi hai .

ayahs.text: aur shehar mein no aadmi aesay thay jo zameen mein fasad machatay thay , aur islaah ka kaam nahi kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: aur shehar mein no aadmi aesay thay jo zameen mein fasad machatay thay , aur islaah ka kaam nahi kertay thay .

ayahs.text: unhon ney ( aapas mein aik doosray say ) kaha :  sabb milker Allah ki qasam khao kay hum saleh aur uss kay ghar walon per raat kay waqt hamla keren gay , phir uss kay waris say keh den gay kay hum unn ghar walon ki halakat kay waqt mojood hi naa thay , aur yaqeen jano hum bilkul sachay hain .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney ( aapas mein aik doosray say ) kaha :  sabb milker Allah ki qasam khao kay hum saleh aur uss kay ghar walon per raat kay waqt hamla keren gay , phir uss kay waris say keh den gay kay hum unn ghar walon ki halakat kay waqt mojood hi naa thay , aur yaqeen jano hum bilkul sachay hain .

ayahs.text: unhon ney yeh chaal chali , aur hum ney bhi aik chaal iss tarah chali kay unn ko pata bhi naa lagg saka .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney yeh chaal chali , aur hum ney bhi aik chaal iss tarah chali kay unn ko pata bhi naa lagg saka .

ayahs.text: abb dekho kay unn ki chaal bazi ka anjam kaisa huwa kay hum ney unhen aur unn ki sari qoam ko tabah ker kay rakh diya .
ayahs.translation: abb dekho kay unn ki chaal bazi ka anjam kaisa huwa kay hum ney unhen aur unn ki sari qoam ko tabah ker kay rakh diya .

ayahs.text: chunacheh woh rahey unn kay ghar jo unn kay zulm ki wajeh say weeran parray hain !   yaqeenan iss waqaey mein unn logon  kay liye ibrat ka saman hai jo ilm say kaam letay hain .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh woh rahey unn kay ghar jo unn kay zulm ki wajeh say weeran parray hain !   yaqeenan iss waqaey mein unn logon  kay liye ibrat ka saman hai jo ilm say kaam letay hain .

ayahs.text: aur jo log emaan laye thay , aur taqwa ikhtiyar kiye huye thay , unn sabb ko hum ney bacha liya .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log emaan laye thay , aur taqwa ikhtiyar kiye huye thay , unn sabb ko hum ney bacha liya .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney loot ko payghumber bana ker bheja jabkay unhon ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  kiya tum khuli aankhon dekhtay huye bhi bey hayai ka yeh kaam kertay ho-?
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney loot ko payghumber bana ker bheja jabkay unhon ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  kiya tum khuli aankhon dekhtay huye bhi bey hayai ka yeh kaam kertay ho-?

ayahs.text: kiya yeh koi yaqeen kernay ki baat hai kay tum apni jinsi khuwaish kay liye aurton ko chorr ker mardon kay paas jatay ho-? haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum bari jihalat kay kaam kernay walay log ho .
ayahs.translation: kiya yeh koi yaqeen kernay ki baat hai kay tum apni jinsi khuwaish kay liye aurton ko chorr ker mardon kay paas jatay ho-? haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum bari jihalat kay kaam kernay walay log ho .

ayahs.text: iss per yeh kehney kay siwa unn ki qoam ka koi jawab nahi tha kay :  loot kay ghar walon ko apni basti say nikal bahir kero , yeh baray pakbaaz bantay hain .
ayahs.translation: iss per yeh kehney kay siwa unn ki qoam ka koi jawab nahi tha kay :  loot kay ghar walon ko apni basti say nikal bahir kero , yeh baray pakbaaz bantay hain .

ayahs.text: phir huwa yeh kay hum ney loot aur uss kay ghar walon ko bacha liya , siwaye unn ki biwi kay jiss kay baaray mein hum ney yeh tey kerdiya tha kay woh peechay reh janey walon mein shamil rahey gi .
ayahs.translation: phir huwa yeh kay hum ney loot aur uss kay ghar walon ko bacha liya , siwaye unn ki biwi kay jiss kay baaray mein hum ney yeh tey kerdiya tha kay woh peechay reh janey walon mein shamil rahey gi .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney unn per aik zabardast barish barsai , chunacheh boht buri barish thi jo unn logon  per barsi jinhen pehlay say khabrdar kerdiya gaya tha .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney unn per aik zabardast barish barsai , chunacheh boht buri barish thi jo unn logon  per barsi jinhen pehlay say khabrdar kerdiya gaya tha .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) kaho :  tamam tareefen Allah kay liye hain , aur salam ho uss kay unn bandon per jinn ko uss ney muntakhib farmaya hai !   batao kiya Allah behtar hai ya woh jinn ko inn logon  ney Allah ki khudai mein shareek bana rakha hai ?
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) kaho :  tamam tareefen Allah kay liye hain , aur salam ho uss kay unn bandon per jinn ko uss ney muntakhib farmaya hai !   batao kiya Allah behtar hai ya woh jinn ko inn logon  ney Allah ki khudai mein shareek bana rakha hai ?

ayahs.text: bhala woh kon hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya , aur tumharay liye aasman say paani utaara-? phir hum ney uss paani say ba-ronaq baagh ugaye , tumharay bus mein nahi tha kay tum unn kay darakhton ko uga saktay . kiya ( phir bhi tum kehtay ho kay ) Allah kay sath koi aur khuda hai-?   nahi ! balkay inn logon  ney raastay say mun morr rakha hai .
ayahs.translation: bhala woh kon hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya , aur tumharay liye aasman say paani utaara-? phir hum ney uss paani say ba-ronaq baagh ugaye , tumharay bus mein nahi tha kay tum unn kay darakhton ko uga saktay . kiya ( phir bhi tum kehtay ho kay ) Allah kay sath koi aur khuda hai-?   nahi ! balkay inn logon  ney raastay say mun morr rakha hai .

ayahs.text: bhala woh kon hai jiss ney zameen ko qarar ki jagah banaya , aur uss kay bech bech mein darya peda kiye , aur uss ( ko thehraney ) kay liye ( paharon ki ) meekhen gaarr den , aur do samandaron kay darmiyan aik aarr rakh di-?   kiya ( phir bhi tum kehtay ho kay ) Allah kay sath koi aur khuda hai-? nahi ! balkay unn mein say aksar log haqeeqat say na-waqif hain .
ayahs.translation: bhala woh kon hai jiss ney zameen ko qarar ki jagah banaya , aur uss kay bech bech mein darya peda kiye , aur uss ( ko thehraney ) kay liye ( paharon ki ) meekhen gaarr den , aur do samandaron kay darmiyan aik aarr rakh di-?   kiya ( phir bhi tum kehtay ho kay ) Allah kay sath koi aur khuda hai-? nahi ! balkay unn mein say aksar log haqeeqat say na-waqif hain .

ayahs.text: bhala woh kon hai kay jab koi bey qarar ussay pukarta hai to woh uss ki dua qubool kerta hai , aur takleef door ker deta hai , aur jo tumhen zameen ka khalifa banata hai-? kiya ( phir bhi tum kehtay ho kay ) Allah kay sath koi aur khuda hai ? nahi ! balkay tum boht kam naseehat qubool kertay ho .
ayahs.translation: bhala woh kon hai kay jab koi bey qarar ussay pukarta hai to woh uss ki dua qubool kerta hai , aur takleef door ker deta hai , aur jo tumhen zameen ka khalifa banata hai-? kiya ( phir bhi tum kehtay ho kay ) Allah kay sath koi aur khuda hai ? nahi ! balkay tum boht kam naseehat qubool kertay ho .

ayahs.text: bhala woh kon hai jo khushki aur samandar kay andheron mein tumhen raasta dikhata hai , aur jo apni rehmat ( ki barish ) say pehlay hawayen bhejta hai jo tumhen ( barish ki ) khushkhabri deti hain-? kiya ( phir bhi tum kehtay ho kay ) Allah kay sath koi aur khuda hai-? ( nahi ! balkay ) Allah uss shirk say boht baala o bartar hai jiss ka irtikab yeh log ker rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: bhala woh kon hai jo khushki aur samandar kay andheron mein tumhen raasta dikhata hai , aur jo apni rehmat ( ki barish ) say pehlay hawayen bhejta hai jo tumhen ( barish ki ) khushkhabri deti hain-? kiya ( phir bhi tum kehtay ho kay ) Allah kay sath koi aur khuda hai-? ( nahi ! balkay ) Allah uss shirk say boht baala o bartar hai jiss ka irtikab yeh log ker rahey hain .

ayahs.text: bhala woh kon hai jiss ney sari makhlooq ko pehli baar peda kiya , phir woh uss ko dobara peda keray ga , aur jo tumhen aasman aur zameen say rizq farham kerta hai-? kiya ( phir bhi tum kehtay ho kay ) Allah kay sath koi aur khuda hai-? kaho :  lao apni koi daleel , agar tum sachay ho .
ayahs.translation: bhala woh kon hai jiss ney sari makhlooq ko pehli baar peda kiya , phir woh uss ko dobara peda keray ga , aur jo tumhen aasman aur zameen say rizq farham kerta hai-? kiya ( phir bhi tum kehtay ho kay ) Allah kay sath koi aur khuda hai-? kaho :  lao apni koi daleel , agar tum sachay ho .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  Allah kay siwa aasmano aur zameen mein kissi ko bhi ghaib ka ilm nahi hai ,   aur logon  ko yeh bhi pata nahi hai kay unhen kab dobara zinda kiya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  Allah kay siwa aasmano aur zameen mein kissi ko bhi ghaib ka ilm nahi hai ,   aur logon  ko yeh bhi pata nahi hai kay unhen kab dobara zinda kiya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: balkay aakhirat kay baaray mein inn ( kafiron ) ka ilm bey bus ho ker reh gaya hai , balkay woh uss kay baaray mein shak mein mubtala hain , balkay uss say andhay hochukay hain .
ayahs.translation: balkay aakhirat kay baaray mein inn ( kafiron ) ka ilm bey bus ho ker reh gaya hai , balkay woh uss kay baaray mein shak mein mubtala hain , balkay uss say andhay hochukay hain .

ayahs.text: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  kiya jab hum aur humaray baap daday mitti hochukay hon gay to kiya uss waqt waqaee hamen ( qabron say ) nikala jaye ga-?
ayahs.translation: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  kiya jab hum aur humaray baap daday mitti hochukay hon gay to kiya uss waqt waqaee hamen ( qabron say ) nikala jaye ga-?

ayahs.text: hum say aur humaray baap dadon say iss qisam kay waday pehlay bhi kiye gaye thay , ( lekin ) inn ki haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay yeh qissa kahaniyan hain jo puraney zamaney kay logon  say naqal hoti chali aarahi hain .
ayahs.translation: hum say aur humaray baap dadon say iss qisam kay waday pehlay bhi kiye gaye thay , ( lekin ) inn ki haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay yeh qissa kahaniyan hain jo puraney zamaney kay logon  say naqal hoti chali aarahi hain .

ayahs.text: kaho kay :  zara zameen mein safar ker kay dekho kay mujrimon ka anjam kaisa huwa hai .
ayahs.translation: kaho kay :  zara zameen mein safar ker kay dekho kay mujrimon ka anjam kaisa huwa hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn logon  per ghum naa kero , aur yeh jiss makkaari ka muzahira ker rahey hain , unn ki wajeh say ghuttan mehsoos naa kero .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn logon  per ghum naa kero , aur yeh jiss makkaari ka muzahira ker rahey hain , unn ki wajeh say ghuttan mehsoos naa kero .

ayahs.text: yeh ( tum say ) yun kehtay hain kay :  yeh wada kab poora hoga , agar tum sachay ho-?
ayahs.translation: yeh ( tum say ) yun kehtay hain kay :  yeh wada kab poora hoga , agar tum sachay ho-?

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  kuch baeed nahi hai kay jiss azab ki tum jaldi macha rahey ho , uss ka kuch hissa tumharay bilkul paas aa-laga ho .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  kuch baeed nahi hai kay jiss azab ki tum jaldi macha rahey ho , uss ka kuch hissa tumharay bilkul paas aa-laga ho .

ayahs.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay tumhara perwerdigar logon  per boht fazal kernay wala hai , lekin unn mein say aksar log shukar nahi kertay .
ayahs.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay tumhara perwerdigar logon  per boht fazal kernay wala hai , lekin unn mein say aksar log shukar nahi kertay .

ayahs.text: aur yaqeen rakho kay tumhara perwerdigar woh sari baaten bhi janta hai jo inn kay seenay chupaye huye hain , aur woh baaten bhi jo woh aelania kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur yaqeen rakho kay tumhara perwerdigar woh sari baaten bhi janta hai jo inn kay seenay chupaye huye hain , aur woh baaten bhi jo woh aelania kertay hain .

ayahs.text: aur aasman aur zameen ki koi posheeda cheez aesi nahi hai jo aik wazeh kitab mein darj naa ho .
ayahs.translation: aur aasman aur zameen ki koi posheeda cheez aesi nahi hai jo aik wazeh kitab mein darj naa ho .

ayahs.text: waqiaa yeh hai kay yeh Quran bano Israel kay samney aksar unn baaton ki haqeeqat wazeh kerta hai jinn mein woh ikhtilaf kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: waqiaa yeh hai kay yeh Quran bano Israel kay samney aksar unn baaton ki haqeeqat wazeh kerta hai jinn mein woh ikhtilaf kertay hain .

ayahs.text: aur yaqeenan yeh emaan laney walon kay liye hidayat aur rehmat hai .
ayahs.translation: aur yaqeenan yeh emaan laney walon kay liye hidayat aur rehmat hai .

ayahs.text: aur tumhara perwerdigar yaqeenan unn kay darmiyan apney hukum say faisla keray ga , aur woh bara iqtidar wala , bara ilm wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur tumhara perwerdigar yaqeenan unn kay darmiyan apney hukum say faisla keray ga , aur woh bara iqtidar wala , bara ilm wala hai .

ayahs.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum Allah per bharosa rakho . yaqeenan tum khulay khulay haq per ho .
ayahs.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum Allah per bharosa rakho . yaqeenan tum khulay khulay haq per ho .

ayahs.text: yaad rakho kay tum murdon ko apni baat nahi suna saktay , aur naa tum behron ko apni pukar suna saktay ho , jab woh peeth pher ker chal kharray hon .
ayahs.translation: yaad rakho kay tum murdon ko apni baat nahi suna saktay , aur naa tum behron ko apni pukar suna saktay ho , jab woh peeth pher ker chal kharray hon .

ayahs.text: aur naa tum andhon ko unn ki gumrahi say bacha ker raastay per laasaktay ho . tum to unhi logon  ko apni baat suna saktay ho jo humari aayaton per emaan layen , phir wohi log farmanbardaar hon gay .
ayahs.translation: aur naa tum andhon ko unn ki gumrahi say bacha ker raastay per laasaktay ho . tum to unhi logon  ko apni baat suna saktay ho jo humari aayaton per emaan layen , phir wohi log farmanbardaar hon gay .

ayahs.text: aur jab humari baat poori honey ka waqt inn logon  per aa-phonchay ga to hum inn kay liye zameen say aik janwer nikalen gay jo inn say baat keray ga kay log humari aayaton per yaqeen nahi rakhtay thay .
ayahs.translation: aur jab humari baat poori honey ka waqt inn logon  per aa-phonchay ga to hum inn kay liye zameen say aik janwer nikalen gay jo inn say baat keray ga kay log humari aayaton per yaqeen nahi rakhtay thay .

ayahs.text: aur uss din ko naa bhoolo jab hum her ummat mein say unn logon  ki poori foaj ko gher layen gay jo humari aayaton ko jhutlaya kertay thay , phir unn ki jamat bandi ki jaye gi .
ayahs.translation: aur uss din ko naa bhoolo jab hum her ummat mein say unn logon  ki poori foaj ko gher layen gay jo humari aayaton ko jhutlaya kertay thay , phir unn ki jamat bandi ki jaye gi .

ayahs.text: yahan tak kay jab sabb aajayen gay to Allah kahey ga kay :  kiya tum ney meri aayaton ko poori tarah samjhay baghair hi jhutla diya tha , ya kiya kertay rahey thay-?
ayahs.translation: yahan tak kay jab sabb aajayen gay to Allah kahey ga kay :  kiya tum ney meri aayaton ko poori tarah samjhay baghair hi jhutla diya tha , ya kiya kertay rahey thay-?

ayahs.text: aur unhon ney jo zulm kiya tha , uss ki wajeh say unn per azab ki baat poori hojaye gi , chunacheh woh kuch bol nahi saken gay .
ayahs.translation: aur unhon ney jo zulm kiya tha , uss ki wajeh say unn per azab ki baat poori hojaye gi , chunacheh woh kuch bol nahi saken gay .

ayahs.text: kiya unhon ney dekha nahi kay hum ney raat iss liye banai hai kay woh uss mein sukoon hasil keren , aur din iss tarah banaya hai kay uss mein cheezen dikhai den-? yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo emaan latay hain .
ayahs.translation: kiya unhon ney dekha nahi kay hum ney raat iss liye banai hai kay woh uss mein sukoon hasil keren , aur din iss tarah banaya hai kay uss mein cheezen dikhai den-? yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo emaan latay hain .

ayahs.text: aur jiss din soor phoonka jaye ga , to aasmano aur zameen kay sabb rehney walay ghabra uthen gay , siwaye unn kay jinhen Allah chahye ga ,   aur sabb uss kay paas jhukay huye hazir hon gay .
ayahs.translation: aur jiss din soor phoonka jaye ga , to aasmano aur zameen kay sabb rehney walay ghabra uthen gay , siwaye unn kay jinhen Allah chahye ga ,   aur sabb uss kay paas jhukay huye hazir hon gay .

ayahs.text: tum ( aaj ) paharon ko dekhtay ho to samajhtay ho kay yeh apni jagah jamay huye hain , halankay ( uss waqt ) woh iss tarah phir rahey hon gay jaisay badal phirtay hain . yeh sabb Allah ki karigari hai jiss ney her cheez ko mustehkam tareeqay say banaya hai . yaqeenan ussay poori khabar hai kay tum kiya kaam kertay ho .
ayahs.translation: tum ( aaj ) paharon ko dekhtay ho to samajhtay ho kay yeh apni jagah jamay huye hain , halankay ( uss waqt ) woh iss tarah phir rahey hon gay jaisay badal phirtay hain . yeh sabb Allah ki karigari hai jiss ney her cheez ko mustehkam tareeqay say banaya hai . yaqeenan ussay poori khabar hai kay tum kiya kaam kertay ho .

ayahs.text: jo koi naiki ley ker aaye ga ussay uss say behtar badla milay ga ,   aur aesay log uss din her qisam ki ghabrahat say mehfooz hon gay .
ayahs.translation: jo koi naiki ley ker aaye ga ussay uss say behtar badla milay ga ,   aur aesay log uss din her qisam ki ghabrahat say mehfooz hon gay .

ayahs.text: aur jo koi burai ley ker aaye ga to aesay logon  ko mun kay ball aag mein daal diya jaye ga . tumhen kissi aur baat ki nahi , unhi aemal ki saza di jaye gi jo tum kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: aur jo koi burai ley ker aaye ga to aesay logon  ko mun kay ball aag mein daal diya jaye ga . tumhen kissi aur baat ki nahi , unhi aemal ki saza di jaye gi jo tum kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say keh do kay : )  mujhay to yehi hukum mila hai kay mein iss shehar kay rab ki ibadat kerun jiss ney iss shehar ko hurmat bakhshi hai , aur her cheez ka malik wohi hai , aur mujhay yeh hukum mila hai kay mein farmanbardaaron mein shamil rahun .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say keh do kay : )  mujhay to yehi hukum mila hai kay mein iss shehar kay rab ki ibadat kerun jiss ney iss shehar ko hurmat bakhshi hai , aur her cheez ka malik wohi hai , aur mujhay yeh hukum mila hai kay mein farmanbardaaron mein shamil rahun .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kay mein Quran ki tilawat kerun .  abb jo shaks hidayat kay raastay per aaye , woh apney hi faeeday kay liye raastay per aaye ga , aur jo gumrahi ikhtiyar keray , to keh dena kay :  mein to bus unn logon  mein say hon jo khabrdar kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kay mein Quran ki tilawat kerun .  abb jo shaks hidayat kay raastay per aaye , woh apney hi faeeday kay liye raastay per aaye ga , aur jo gumrahi ikhtiyar keray , to keh dena kay :  mein to bus unn logon  mein say hon jo khabrdar kertay hain .

ayahs.text: aur keh do kay :  tamam tareefen Allah ki hain , woh tumhen apni nishaniyan dikhaye ga , phir tum unhen pehchan bhi lo gay .   aur tumhara perwerdigar tumharay kamon say bey khabar nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur keh do kay :  tamam tareefen Allah ki hain , woh tumhen apni nishaniyan dikhaye ga , phir tum unhen pehchan bhi lo gay .   aur tumhara perwerdigar tumharay kamon say bey khabar nahi hai .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: Tua-Seen-Meem .
verses.translation: Tua-Seen-Meem .

verses.text: yeh uss kitab ki aayaten hain jo haqeeqat wazeh kernay wali hai .
verses.translation: yeh uss kitab ki aayaten hain jo haqeeqat wazeh kernay wali hai .

verses.text: hum emaan walay logon  kay faeeday kay liye tumhen musa aur firon kay kuch halaat theek theek parh ker sunatay hain .
verses.translation: hum emaan walay logon  kay faeeday kay liye tumhen musa aur firon kay kuch halaat theek theek parh ker sunatay hain .

verses.text: waqiaa yeh hai kay firon ney zameen mein sarkashi ikhtiyar ker rakhi thi , aur uss ney wahan kay bashindon ko alag alag girohon mein taqseem kerdiya tha jinn mein say aik giroh ko uss ney itna daba ker rakha huwa tha kay unn kay beton ko zibah ker deta ,   aur unn ki aurton ko zinda chorr deta tha . haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh unn logon  mein say tha jo fasad phelaya kertay hain .
verses.translation: waqiaa yeh hai kay firon ney zameen mein sarkashi ikhtiyar ker rakhi thi , aur uss ney wahan kay bashindon ko alag alag girohon mein taqseem kerdiya tha jinn mein say aik giroh ko uss ney itna daba ker rakha huwa tha kay unn kay beton ko zibah ker deta ,   aur unn ki aurton ko zinda chorr deta tha . haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh unn logon  mein say tha jo fasad phelaya kertay hain .

verses.text: aur hum yeh chahtay thay kay jinn logon  ko zameen mein daba ker rakha gaya hai , unn per ehsan keren , unn ko peshwa banayen , unhi ko ( mulk o maal ka ) waris bana den ,
verses.translation: aur hum yeh chahtay thay kay jinn logon  ko zameen mein daba ker rakha gaya hai , unn per ehsan keren , unn ko peshwa banayen , unhi ko ( mulk o maal ka ) waris bana den ,

verses.text: aur unhen zameen mein iqtidar ata kren , aur firon , hamaan aur unn kay lashkaron ko wohi kuch dikha den jiss say bachao ki woh tadbeeren ker rahey thay .
verses.translation: aur unhen zameen mein iqtidar ata kren , aur firon , hamaan aur unn kay lashkaron ko wohi kuch dikha den jiss say bachao ki woh tadbeeren ker rahey thay .

verses.text: aur hum ney musa ki walida ko ilhaam kiya kay :  tum iss ( bacchay ) ko doodh pilao , phir jab tumhen iss kay baaray mein koi khatra ho to issay darya mein daal dena , aur darna nahi , aur naa sadma kerna , yaqeen rakho hum ussay wapis tumharay paas phoncha ker rahen gay , aur uss ko payghumberon mein say aik payghumber banayen gay .
verses.translation: aur hum ney musa ki walida ko ilhaam kiya kay :  tum iss ( bacchay ) ko doodh pilao , phir jab tumhen iss kay baaray mein koi khatra ho to issay darya mein daal dena , aur darna nahi , aur naa sadma kerna , yaqeen rakho hum ussay wapis tumharay paas phoncha ker rahen gay , aur uss ko payghumberon mein say aik payghumber banayen gay .

verses.text: iss tarah firon kay logon  ney uss bacchay ( yani hazrat musa aleh-assalam ) ko utha liya , takay aakhir kaar woh unn kay liye dushman aur ghum ka zariya banay . beyshak firon , hamaan aur unn kay lashkar baray khatakaar thay .
verses.translation: iss tarah firon kay logon  ney uss bacchay ( yani hazrat musa aleh-assalam ) ko utha liya , takay aakhir kaar woh unn kay liye dushman aur ghum ka zariya banay . beyshak firon , hamaan aur unn kay lashkar baray khatakaar thay .

verses.text: aur firon ki biwi ney ( firon say ) kaha kay :  yeh baccha meri aur tumhari aankhon ki thandak hai . issay qatal naa kero , kuch baeed nahi kay yeh hamen faeeda phonchaye , ya hum issay beta bana len .  aur ( yeh faisla kertay waqt ) unhen anjam ka pata nahi tha .
verses.translation: aur firon ki biwi ney ( firon say ) kaha kay :  yeh baccha meri aur tumhari aankhon ki thandak hai . issay qatal naa kero , kuch baeed nahi kay yeh hamen faeeda phonchaye , ya hum issay beta bana len .  aur ( yeh faisla kertay waqt ) unhen anjam ka pata nahi tha .

verses.text: udhar musa ki walida ka dil bey qarar tha . qareeb tha kay woh yeh sara raz khol deyten , agar hum ney unn kay dil ko sanbhala naa hota , takay woh ( humaray waday per ) yaqeen kiye rahen .
verses.translation: udhar musa ki walida ka dil bey qarar tha . qareeb tha kay woh yeh sara raz khol deyten , agar hum ney unn kay dil ko sanbhala naa hota , takay woh ( humaray waday per ) yaqeen kiye rahen .

verses.text: aur unhon ney musa ki behan say kaha kay :  iss bacchay ka kuch suragh lagao .  chunacheh uss ney bacchay ko door say iss tarah dekha kay unn logon  ko pata nahi chala .
verses.translation: aur unhon ney musa ki behan say kaha kay :  iss bacchay ka kuch suragh lagao .  chunacheh uss ney bacchay ko door say iss tarah dekha kay unn logon  ko pata nahi chala .

verses.text: aur hum ney musa per pehlay hi say yeh bandish laga di thi kay woh doodh pilaney waliyan unhen doodh naa pila-saken , iss liye unn ki behan ney kaha :  kiya mein tumhen aesay ghar ka pata bataon jiss kay log tumharay liye iss bacchay ki perwerish keren , aur iss kay khair khuwa rahen-?
verses.translation: aur hum ney musa per pehlay hi say yeh bandish laga di thi kay woh doodh pilaney waliyan unhen doodh naa pila-saken , iss liye unn ki behan ney kaha :  kiya mein tumhen aesay ghar ka pata bataon jiss kay log tumharay liye iss bacchay ki perwerish keren , aur iss kay khair khuwa rahen-?

verses.text: iss tarah hum ney musa ko unn ki maa kay paas loata diya , takay unn ki aankh thandi rahey , aur woh ghumgeen naa hon , aur takay unhen achi tarah maloom hojaye kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , lekin aksar log nahi jantay .
verses.translation: iss tarah hum ney musa ko unn ki maa kay paas loata diya , takay unn ki aankh thandi rahey , aur woh ghumgeen naa hon , aur takay unhen achi tarah maloom hojaye kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , lekin aksar log nahi jantay .

verses.text: aur jab musa apni bharpoor tawanai ko phonchay aur pooray jawan hogaye to hum ney unhen hikmat aur ilm say nawaza , aur naik logon  ko hum yun hi sila diya kertay hain .
verses.translation: aur jab musa apni bharpoor tawanai ko phonchay aur pooray jawan hogaye to hum ney unhen hikmat aur ilm say nawaza , aur naik logon  ko hum yun hi sila diya kertay hain .

verses.text: aur ( aik din ) woh shehar mein aesay waqt dakhil huye jab uss kay bashinday ghaflat mein thay ,   to unhon ney dekha kay wahan do aadmi larr rahey hain , aik to unn ki apni biradari ka tha , aur doosra unn ki dushman qoam ka . abb jo shaks unn ki biradari ka tha , uss ney unhen unn ki dushman qoam kay aadmi kay muqablay mein madad kay liye pukara , iss per musa ney uss ko aik mukka maara jiss ney uss ka kaam tamam kerdiya .   ( phir ) unhon ney ( pachta ker ) kaha kay :  yeh to koi shetan ki kaarawai hai . haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh aik khula dushman hai jo ghalat raastay per daal deta hai .
verses.translation: aur ( aik din ) woh shehar mein aesay waqt dakhil huye jab uss kay bashinday ghaflat mein thay ,   to unhon ney dekha kay wahan do aadmi larr rahey hain , aik to unn ki apni biradari ka tha , aur doosra unn ki dushman qoam ka . abb jo shaks unn ki biradari ka tha , uss ney unhen unn ki dushman qoam kay aadmi kay muqablay mein madad kay liye pukara , iss per musa ney uss ko aik mukka maara jiss ney uss ka kaam tamam kerdiya .   ( phir ) unhon ney ( pachta ker ) kaha kay :  yeh to koi shetan ki kaarawai hai . haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh aik khula dushman hai jo ghalat raastay per daal deta hai .

verses.text: kehney lagay :  meray perwerdigar ! mein ney apni jaan per zulm kerliya , aap mujhay moaaf farma-dijiye .    chunacheh Allah ney unhen moaaf kerdiya . yaqeenan wohi hai jo boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: kehney lagay :  meray perwerdigar ! mein ney apni jaan per zulm kerliya , aap mujhay moaaf farma-dijiye .    chunacheh Allah ney unhen moaaf kerdiya . yaqeenan wohi hai jo boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: musa ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! aap ney jo mujh per inaam kiya hai , to mein aaenda kabhi mujrimon ka madadgaar nahi banon ga .
verses.translation: musa ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! aap ney jo mujh per inaam kiya hai , to mein aaenda kabhi mujrimon ka madadgaar nahi banon ga .

verses.text: phir subha kay waqt woh shehar mein dartay dartay halaat ka jaeza ley rahey thay , itney mein dekha kay jiss shaks ney kal unn say madad maangi thi , woh phir unhen fariyad kay liye pukar raha hai . musa ney uss say kaha kay :  maloom huwa kay tum to khullam khula shareer aadmi ho .
verses.translation: phir subha kay waqt woh shehar mein dartay dartay halaat ka jaeza ley rahey thay , itney mein dekha kay jiss shaks ney kal unn say madad maangi thi , woh phir unhen fariyad kay liye pukar raha hai . musa ney uss say kaha kay :  maloom huwa kay tum to khullam khula shareer aadmi ho .

verses.text: phir jab unhon ney uss shaks ko pakarney ka irada kiya jo inn dono ka dushman tha to uss ( israeeli ) ney kaha :  musa ! kiya tum mujhay bhi ussi tarah qatal kerna chahtay ho jaisay tum ney kal aik aadmi ko qatal kerdiya tha-?   tumhara maqsad iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay tum zameen mein apni zabardasti jamao , aur tum musleh banna nahi chahtay .
verses.translation: phir jab unhon ney uss shaks ko pakarney ka irada kiya jo inn dono ka dushman tha to uss ( israeeli ) ney kaha :  musa ! kiya tum mujhay bhi ussi tarah qatal kerna chahtay ho jaisay tum ney kal aik aadmi ko qatal kerdiya tha-?   tumhara maqsad iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay tum zameen mein apni zabardasti jamao , aur tum musleh banna nahi chahtay .

verses.text: aur ( uss kay baad yeh huwa kay ) shehar kay bilkul door daraz ilaqay say aik shaks dorrta huwa aaya , uss ney kaha kay :  musa ! sardar log tumharay baaray mein mashwaray ker rahey hain kay tumhen qatal ker daalen , iss liye tum yahan say nikal jao , yaqeen rakho mein tumharay khair khuwahon mein say hon .
verses.translation: aur ( uss kay baad yeh huwa kay ) shehar kay bilkul door daraz ilaqay say aik shaks dorrta huwa aaya , uss ney kaha kay :  musa ! sardar log tumharay baaray mein mashwaray ker rahey hain kay tumhen qatal ker daalen , iss liye tum yahan say nikal jao , yaqeen rakho mein tumharay khair khuwahon mein say hon .

verses.text: chunacheh musa dartay dartay , halaat ka jaeza letay shehar say nikal kharray huye . kehney lagay :  meray perwerdigar ! mujhay zalim logon  say bacha ley .
verses.translation: chunacheh musa dartay dartay , halaat ka jaeza letay shehar say nikal kharray huye . kehney lagay :  meray perwerdigar ! mujhay zalim logon  say bacha ley .

verses.text: aur jab unhon ney madiyan ki taraf rukh kiya to kaha kay :  mujhay poori umeed hai kay mera perwerdigar mujhay seedhay raastay per daal dey ga .
verses.translation: aur jab unhon ney madiyan ki taraf rukh kiya to kaha kay :  mujhay poori umeed hai kay mera perwerdigar mujhay seedhay raastay per daal dey ga .

verses.text: aur jab woh madiyan kay kunaen per phonchay to dekha kay uss per aesay logon  ka aik majmaa hai jo apney janweron ko paani pila rahey hain , aur dekha kay unn say pehlay do aurten hain jo apney janweron ko rokay kharri hain . musa ney unn say kaha :  tum kiya chahti ho-?  unn dono ney kaha :  hum apney janweron ko uss waqt tak paani nahi pila sakten jab tak saray charwahey paani pila ker nahi nikal nahi jatay , aur humaray walid boht boorhay aadmi hain .
verses.translation: aur jab woh madiyan kay kunaen per phonchay to dekha kay uss per aesay logon  ka aik majmaa hai jo apney janweron ko paani pila rahey hain , aur dekha kay unn say pehlay do aurten hain jo apney janweron ko rokay kharri hain . musa ney unn say kaha :  tum kiya chahti ho-?  unn dono ney kaha :  hum apney janweron ko uss waqt tak paani nahi pila sakten jab tak saray charwahey paani pila ker nahi nikal nahi jatay , aur humaray walid boht boorhay aadmi hain .

verses.text: iss per musa ney unn ki khatir unn kay janweron ko paani pila diya ,   phir murr ker aik saye ki jagah chalay gaye , aur kehney lagay :  meray perwerdigar ! jo koi behtari to mujh per oopper say nazil kerday , mein uss ka mohtaj hun .
verses.translation: iss per musa ney unn ki khatir unn kay janweron ko paani pila diya ,   phir murr ker aik saye ki jagah chalay gaye , aur kehney lagay :  meray perwerdigar ! jo koi behtari to mujh per oopper say nazil kerday , mein uss ka mohtaj hun .

verses.text: thori dair baad unn dono aurton mein say aik unn kay paas sharam o haya kay sath chalti hoi aai ,   kehney lagi :  meray walid aap ko bula rahey hain , takay aap ko iss baat ka inaam den kay aap ney humari khatir janweron ko paani pilaya hai .    chunacheh jab woh aurton kay walid kay paas phonchay aur unn ko sari sarghuzisht sunai , to unhon ney kaha :  koi andesha naa kero , tum zalim logon  say bach aaye ho .
verses.translation: thori dair baad unn dono aurton mein say aik unn kay paas sharam o haya kay sath chalti hoi aai ,   kehney lagi :  meray walid aap ko bula rahey hain , takay aap ko iss baat ka inaam den kay aap ney humari khatir janweron ko paani pilaya hai .    chunacheh jab woh aurton kay walid kay paas phonchay aur unn ko sari sarghuzisht sunai , to unhon ney kaha :  koi andesha naa kero , tum zalim logon  say bach aaye ho .

verses.text: unn dono aurton mein say aik ney kaha :  abba jaan ! aap inn ko ujrat per koi kaam dey dijiye . aap kissi say ujrat per kaam len to iss kay liye behtareen shaks woh hai jo taqatwar bhi ho , amanat daar bhi .
verses.translation: unn dono aurton mein say aik ney kaha :  abba jaan ! aap inn ko ujrat per koi kaam dey dijiye . aap kissi say ujrat per kaam len to iss kay liye behtareen shaks woh hai jo taqatwar bhi ho , amanat daar bhi .

verses.text: unn kay baap ney kaha :  mein chahta hun kay apni inn do larkiyon mein say aik say tumhara nikah kerdun , ba-shartey-kay tum aath saal tak ujrat per meray paas kaam kero ,   phir agar tum das saal pooray kerdo to yeh tumhara apna faisla hoga . aur mera koi irada nahi hai kay tum per mushaqqat daalun , inn sha Allah tum mujhay unn logon  mein say pao gay jo bhalai ka moamla kertay hain .
verses.translation: unn kay baap ney kaha :  mein chahta hun kay apni inn do larkiyon mein say aik say tumhara nikah kerdun , ba-shartey-kay tum aath saal tak ujrat per meray paas kaam kero ,   phir agar tum das saal pooray kerdo to yeh tumhara apna faisla hoga . aur mera koi irada nahi hai kay tum per mushaqqat daalun , inn sha Allah tum mujhay unn logon  mein say pao gay jo bhalai ka moamla kertay hain .

verses.text: musa ney kaha :  yeh baat meray aur aap kay darmiyan tey hogaee . dono muddaton mein say jo bhi mein poori kerdun , to mujh per koi ziyadti naa hogi , aur jo baat hum ker rahey hain , Allah uss ka rakhwala hai .
verses.translation: musa ney kaha :  yeh baat meray aur aap kay darmiyan tey hogaee . dono muddaton mein say jo bhi mein poori kerdun , to mujh per koi ziyadti naa hogi , aur jo baat hum ker rahey hain , Allah uss ka rakhwala hai .

verses.text: phir jab musa ney woh mauddat poori kerli , aur apni ehliya ko ley ker chalay   to unhon ney koh-e-toor ki taraf say aik aag dekhi . unhon ney apney ghar walon say kaha :  thehrao ! mein ney aik aag dekhi hai , shayad mein wahan say tumharay paas koi khabar ley aaon , ya aag ka koi angara utha laon , takay tum garmaee hasil ker-sako .
verses.translation: phir jab musa ney woh mauddat poori kerli , aur apni ehliya ko ley ker chalay   to unhon ney koh-e-toor ki taraf say aik aag dekhi . unhon ney apney ghar walon say kaha :  thehrao ! mein ney aik aag dekhi hai , shayad mein wahan say tumharay paas koi khabar ley aaon , ya aag ka koi angara utha laon , takay tum garmaee hasil ker-sako .

verses.text: chunacheh jab woh uss aag kay paas phonchay to dayen wadi kay kinaray per jo barkat walay ilaqay mein waqay thi , aik darkht say aawaz aai kay :  aey musa ! mein hi Allah hun , tamam jahano ka perwerdigar !
verses.translation: chunacheh jab woh uss aag kay paas phonchay to dayen wadi kay kinaray per jo barkat walay ilaqay mein waqay thi , aik darkht say aawaz aai kay :  aey musa ! mein hi Allah hun , tamam jahano ka perwerdigar !

verses.text: aur yeh kay :  apni laathi neechay daal do .  phir huwa yeh kay jab unhon ney uss laathi ko dekha kay woh iss tarah harkat ker rahi hai jaisay woh saanp ho , to woh peeth pher ker bhagay , aur murr ker bhi naa dekha .   ( unn say kaha gaya : )  musa ! samney aao , aur daro nahi , tum bilkul mehfooz ho .
verses.translation: aur yeh kay :  apni laathi neechay daal do .  phir huwa yeh kay jab unhon ney uss laathi ko dekha kay woh iss tarah harkat ker rahi hai jaisay woh saanp ho , to woh peeth pher ker bhagay , aur murr ker bhi naa dekha .   ( unn say kaha gaya : )  musa ! samney aao , aur daro nahi , tum bilkul mehfooz ho .

verses.text: apna haath apney giraybaan mein daalo , woh kissi beemari kay baghair chamakta huwa niklay ga , aur darr door kernay kay liye apna bazoo apney jism say lipta lena .   abb yeh do zabardast daleelen hain jo tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say firon aur uss kay darbariyon kay paas bheji jarahi hain . woh baray nafarman log hain .
verses.translation: apna haath apney giraybaan mein daalo , woh kissi beemari kay baghair chamakta huwa niklay ga , aur darr door kernay kay liye apna bazoo apney jism say lipta lena .   abb yeh do zabardast daleelen hain jo tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say firon aur uss kay darbariyon kay paas bheji jarahi hain . woh baray nafarman log hain .

verses.text: musa ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! mein ney unn ka aik aadmi qatal kerdiya tha , iss liye mujhay darr hai kay woh mujhay qatal naa kerden .
verses.translation: musa ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! mein ney unn ka aik aadmi qatal kerdiya tha , iss liye mujhay darr hai kay woh mujhay qatal naa kerden .

verses.text: aur meray bhai Haroon ki zaban mujh say ziyada saaf hai ,   iss liye unn ko bhi meray sath madadgaar bana ker bhej dijiye kay woh meri taeed keren . mujhay andesha hai kay woh log mujhay jhutlayen gay .
verses.translation: aur meray bhai Haroon ki zaban mujh say ziyada saaf hai ,   iss liye unn ko bhi meray sath madadgaar bana ker bhej dijiye kay woh meri taeed keren . mujhay andesha hai kay woh log mujhay jhutlayen gay .

verses.text: irshad huwa :  hum tumharay bhai kay zariye tumharay haath mazboot kiye detay hain , aur tum dono ko aisa dabdaba ata ker-detay hain kay unn ko humari nishaniyon ki barkat say tum per dastaras hasil nahi hogi , tum aur tumharay perokaar hi ghalib raho gay .
verses.translation: irshad huwa :  hum tumharay bhai kay zariye tumharay haath mazboot kiye detay hain , aur tum dono ko aisa dabdaba ata ker-detay hain kay unn ko humari nishaniyon ki barkat say tum per dastaras hasil nahi hogi , tum aur tumharay perokaar hi ghalib raho gay .

verses.text: chunacheh jab musa unn kay paas humari khuli hoi nishaniyan ley ker phonchay to unhon ney kaha :  yeh kuch nahi , bus banwati jadoo hai , aur hum ney yeh baat apney pichlay baap dadon mein nahi suni .
verses.translation: chunacheh jab musa unn kay paas humari khuli hoi nishaniyan ley ker phonchay to unhon ney kaha :  yeh kuch nahi , bus banwati jadoo hai , aur hum ney yeh baat apney pichlay baap dadon mein nahi suni .

verses.text: aur musa ney kaha :  mera perwerdigar khoob janta hai kay kon uss kay paas say hidayat ley ker aaya hai , aur aakhir kaar behtar thikana kiss kay haath aaye ga ,   yeh yaqeeni baat hai kay zalim log falah nahi payen gay .
verses.translation: aur musa ney kaha :  mera perwerdigar khoob janta hai kay kon uss kay paas say hidayat ley ker aaya hai , aur aakhir kaar behtar thikana kiss kay haath aaye ga ,   yeh yaqeeni baat hai kay zalim log falah nahi payen gay .

verses.text: aur firon bola :  aey darbar walo ! mein to apney siwa tumharay kissi aur khuda say waqif nahi hun . hamaan ! tum aisa kero kay meray liye garay ko aag dey ker pakwao , aur meray liye aik oonchi imarat banao , takay mein uss per say musa kay khuda ko jhank ker dekhun ,   aur mein to pooray yaqeen kay sath yeh samajhta hun kay yeh shaks jhoota hai .
verses.translation: aur firon bola :  aey darbar walo ! mein to apney siwa tumharay kissi aur khuda say waqif nahi hun . hamaan ! tum aisa kero kay meray liye garay ko aag dey ker pakwao , aur meray liye aik oonchi imarat banao , takay mein uss per say musa kay khuda ko jhank ker dekhun ,   aur mein to pooray yaqeen kay sath yeh samajhta hun kay yeh shaks jhoota hai .

verses.text: gharz yeh kay uss ney aur uss kay lashkaron ney zameen mein nahaq ghamand kiya , aur yeh samajh bethay kay unhen humaray paas wapis nahi laya jaye ga .
verses.translation: gharz yeh kay uss ney aur uss kay lashkaron ney zameen mein nahaq ghamand kiya , aur yeh samajh bethay kay unhen humaray paas wapis nahi laya jaye ga .

verses.text: iss liye hum ney uss ko aur uss kay lashkaron ko pakar mein ley ker samandar mein phenk diya . abb dekh lo kay zalimon ka anjam kaisa huwa .
verses.translation: iss liye hum ney uss ko aur uss kay lashkaron ko pakar mein ley ker samandar mein phenk diya . abb dekh lo kay zalimon ka anjam kaisa huwa .

verses.text: hum ney unhen quaid banaya tha jo logon  ko dozakh ki taraf bulatay thay , aur qayamat kay din unn ko kissi ki madad nahi phonchay gi .
verses.translation: hum ney unhen quaid banaya tha jo logon  ko dozakh ki taraf bulatay thay , aur qayamat kay din unn ko kissi ki madad nahi phonchay gi .

verses.text: duniya mein hum ney lanat unn kay peechay laga di hai , aur qayamat kay din woh unn logon  mein shamil hon gay jinn ki buri halat honey wali hai .
verses.translation: duniya mein hum ney lanat unn kay peechay laga di hai , aur qayamat kay din woh unn logon  mein shamil hon gay jinn ki buri halat honey wali hai .

verses.text: hum ney pichli ummaton ko halak kernay kay baad musa ko aesi kitab di thi jo logon  kay liye baseerat ki baaton per mushtamil , aur sarapa hidayat o rehmat thi , takay woh naseehat hasil keren .
verses.translation: hum ney pichli ummaton ko halak kernay kay baad musa ko aesi kitab di thi jo logon  kay liye baseerat ki baaton per mushtamil , aur sarapa hidayat o rehmat thi , takay woh naseehat hasil keren .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum uss waqt ( koh-e-toor ki ) maghribi janib mojood nahi thay jab hum ney musa ko ehkaam supurd kiye thay ,   aur naa tum unn logon  mein say thay jo uss ka mushaeeda ker rahey hon .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum uss waqt ( koh-e-toor ki ) maghribi janib mojood nahi thay jab hum ney musa ko ehkaam supurd kiye thay ,   aur naa tum unn logon  mein say thay jo uss ka mushaeeda ker rahey hon .

verses.text: balkay unn kay baad hum ney boht si naslen peda ken , jinn per taweel zamana guzar gaya aur tum madiyan kay basney walon kay darmiyan bhi muqeem nahi thay kay unn ko humari aayaten parh ker sunatay ho , balkay ( tumhen ) Rasool bananey walay hum hain ,
verses.translation: balkay unn kay baad hum ney boht si naslen peda ken , jinn per taweel zamana guzar gaya aur tum madiyan kay basney walon kay darmiyan bhi muqeem nahi thay kay unn ko humari aayaten parh ker sunatay ho , balkay ( tumhen ) Rasool bananey walay hum hain ,

verses.text: aur naa tum uss waqt toor kay kinaray mojood thay jab hum ney ( musa ko ) pukara tha , balkay yeh tumharay rab ki rehmat hai ( kay tumhen wahi kay zariye yeh baaten batai jarahi hain ) takay tum uss qoam ko khabrdar kero jiss kay paas tum say pehlay koi khabrdar kernay wala nahi aaya , shayad woh naseehat qubool kerlen .
verses.translation: aur naa tum uss waqt toor kay kinaray mojood thay jab hum ney ( musa ko ) pukara tha , balkay yeh tumharay rab ki rehmat hai ( kay tumhen wahi kay zariye yeh baaten batai jarahi hain ) takay tum uss qoam ko khabrdar kero jiss kay paas tum say pehlay koi khabrdar kernay wala nahi aaya , shayad woh naseehat qubool kerlen .

verses.text: aur takay jab unn logon  per unn kay haathon kay kartoot ki wajeh say koi museebat aaye to woh yeh naa keh saken kay :  humaray perwerdigar ! aap ney humaray paas koi Rasool kiyon nahi bheja kay hum aap ki aayaton ki perwi kertay aur emaan walon mein hum bhi shamil hojatay-?
verses.translation: aur takay jab unn logon  per unn kay haathon kay kartoot ki wajeh say koi museebat aaye to woh yeh naa keh saken kay :  humaray perwerdigar ! aap ney humaray paas koi Rasool kiyon nahi bheja kay hum aap ki aayaton ki perwi kertay aur emaan walon mein hum bhi shamil hojatay-?

verses.text: phir jab unn kay paas humari taraf say haq aagaya to kehney lagay kay :  iss payghumber ko uss jaisi cheez kiyon nahi di gaee jaisi musa ( aleh-assalam ) ko di gaee thi-?    halankay jo cheez musa ko di gaee thi , kiya unhon ney pehlay hi uss ka inkar nahi kerdiya tha-? unhon ney kaha tha kay :  yeh dono jadoo hain jo aik doosray ki taeed kertay hain , aur unhon ney kaha kay  hum inn mein say her aik kay munkir hain .
verses.translation: phir jab unn kay paas humari taraf say haq aagaya to kehney lagay kay :  iss payghumber ko uss jaisi cheez kiyon nahi di gaee jaisi musa ( aleh-assalam ) ko di gaee thi-?    halankay jo cheez musa ko di gaee thi , kiya unhon ney pehlay hi uss ka inkar nahi kerdiya tha-? unhon ney kaha tha kay :  yeh dono jadoo hain jo aik doosray ki taeed kertay hain , aur unhon ney kaha kay  hum inn mein say her aik kay munkir hain .

verses.text: . ( inn say ) kaho :  acha , agar tum sachay ho to Allah kay paas say koi aur aesi kitab ley aao jo inn dono say ziyada hidayat per mushtamil ho , mein uss ki ittaba kerlun ga .
verses.translation: . ( inn say ) kaho :  acha , agar tum sachay ho to Allah kay paas say koi aur aesi kitab ley aao jo inn dono say ziyada hidayat per mushtamil ho , mein uss ki ittaba kerlun ga .

verses.text: phir agar yeh tumhari farmaeesh poori naa keren , to samajh lo kay dar-haqeeqat yeh log apni khuwaishaat kay peechay chal rahey hain . aur uss say ziyada gumrah kon hoga jo Allah ki taraf say aai hoi hidayat kay baghair bus apni khuwaish kay peechay chalay-? beyshak Allah zalim logon  ko hidayat nahi deta .
verses.translation: phir agar yeh tumhari farmaeesh poori naa keren , to samajh lo kay dar-haqeeqat yeh log apni khuwaishaat kay peechay chal rahey hain . aur uss say ziyada gumrah kon hoga jo Allah ki taraf say aai hoi hidayat kay baghair bus apni khuwaish kay peechay chalay-? beyshak Allah zalim logon  ko hidayat nahi deta .

verses.text: aur waqiaa yeh hai kay hum inn kay faeeday kay liye aik kay baad aik ( naseehat ki ) baat bhejtay rahey hain ,   takay woh mutanabeh hon .
verses.translation: aur waqiaa yeh hai kay hum inn kay faeeday kay liye aik kay baad aik ( naseehat ki ) baat bhejtay rahey hain ,   takay woh mutanabeh hon .

verses.text: jinn ko hum ney Quran say pehlay aasmani kitaben di hain , woh iss ( Quran ) per emaan latay hain ,
verses.translation: jinn ko hum ney Quran say pehlay aasmani kitaben di hain , woh iss ( Quran ) per emaan latay hain ,

verses.text: aur jab woh unn ko parh ker sunaya jata hai to kehtay hain kay :  hum iss per emaan laye , yaqeenan yeh bar-haq kalam hai jo humaray perwerdigar ki taraf say aaya hai . hum to iss say pehlay bhi issay mantay thay .
verses.translation: aur jab woh unn ko parh ker sunaya jata hai to kehtay hain kay :  hum iss per emaan laye , yaqeenan yeh bar-haq kalam hai jo humaray perwerdigar ki taraf say aaya hai . hum to iss say pehlay bhi issay mantay thay .

verses.text: aesay logon  ko unn ka sawab dohra diya jaye ga , kiyonkay unhon ney sabar say kaam liya   aur woh naiki say burai ka dafiya kertay hain ,   aur hum ney jo kuch unn ko diya hai , uss mein say ( Allah kay raastay mein ) kharch kertay hain .
verses.translation: aesay logon  ko unn ka sawab dohra diya jaye ga , kiyonkay unhon ney sabar say kaam liya   aur woh naiki say burai ka dafiya kertay hain ,   aur hum ney jo kuch unn ko diya hai , uss mein say ( Allah kay raastay mein ) kharch kertay hain .

verses.text: aur jab woh koi beyhooda baat suntay hain to ussay taal jatay hain , aur kehtay hain kay :  humaray liye humaray aemal hain , aur tumharay liye tumharay aemal . hum tumhen salam kertay hain .   hum nadan logon  say ulajhna nahi chahtay .
verses.translation: aur jab woh koi beyhooda baat suntay hain to ussay taal jatay hain , aur kehtay hain kay :  humaray liye humaray aemal hain , aur tumharay liye tumharay aemal . hum tumhen salam kertay hain .   hum nadan logon  say ulajhna nahi chahtay .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum jiss ko khud chahao hidayat tak nahi phoncha saktay , balkay Allah jiss ko chahta hai hidayat tak phoncha deta hai , aur hidayat qubool kernay walon ko wohi khoob janta hai .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum jiss ko khud chahao hidayat tak nahi phoncha saktay , balkay Allah jiss ko chahta hai hidayat tak phoncha deta hai , aur hidayat qubool kernay walon ko wohi khoob janta hai .

verses.text: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  agar hum aap kay sath hidayat ki perwi keren gay to hamen apni zameen say koi uchak kerlay jaye ga .    bhala kiya hum ney inn ko uss haram mein jagah nahi dey rakhi jo itna pur aman hai kay her qisam kay phal uss ki taraf khinchay chalay aatay hain , jo khaas humari taraf say diya huwa rizq hai-? lekin unn mein say aksar log nahi jantay .
verses.translation: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  agar hum aap kay sath hidayat ki perwi keren gay to hamen apni zameen say koi uchak kerlay jaye ga .    bhala kiya hum ney inn ko uss haram mein jagah nahi dey rakhi jo itna pur aman hai kay her qisam kay phal uss ki taraf khinchay chalay aatay hain , jo khaas humari taraf say diya huwa rizq hai-? lekin unn mein say aksar log nahi jantay .

verses.text: aur kitni hi bastiyan woh hain jo apni maeeshat per itrati then , hum ney unn ko tabah ker daala , abb woh unn ki rehaeesh gaahen tumharay samney hain , jo unn kay baad thoray arsay ko chorr ker kabhi abad hi naa hosaken , aur hum hi thay jo unn kay waris banay .
verses.translation: aur kitni hi bastiyan woh hain jo apni maeeshat per itrati then , hum ney unn ko tabah ker daala , abb woh unn ki rehaeesh gaahen tumharay samney hain , jo unn kay baad thoray arsay ko chorr ker kabhi abad hi naa hosaken , aur hum hi thay jo unn kay waris banay .

verses.text: aur tumhara perwerdigar aisa nahi hai kay woh bastiyan yunhi halak ker daalay jab tak uss ney unn bastiyon kay markazi maqam per koi Rasool naa bheja ho jo unn ko humari aayaten parh ker sunaye , aur hum bastiyon ko uss waqt tak halak kernay walay nahi hain jab tak unn kay bashinday zalim naa ban jayen .
verses.translation: aur tumhara perwerdigar aisa nahi hai kay woh bastiyan yunhi halak ker daalay jab tak uss ney unn bastiyon kay markazi maqam per koi Rasool naa bheja ho jo unn ko humari aayaten parh ker sunaye , aur hum bastiyon ko uss waqt tak halak kernay walay nahi hain jab tak unn kay bashinday zalim naa ban jayen .

verses.text: aur tum ko jo kuch bhi diya gaya hai , woh dunyawi zindagi ki poonji aur uss ki sajawat hai aur jo kuch Allah kay paas hai , woh kahen ziyada behtar aur kahen ziyada payedaar hai . kiya phir bhi tum aqal say kaam nahi letay-?
verses.translation: aur tum ko jo kuch bhi diya gaya hai , woh dunyawi zindagi ki poonji aur uss ki sajawat hai aur jo kuch Allah kay paas hai , woh kahen ziyada behtar aur kahen ziyada payedaar hai . kiya phir bhi tum aqal say kaam nahi letay-?

verses.text: bhala batao kay jiss shaks say hum ney acha saa wada ker rakha hai , aur woh uss waday ko paa-ker rahey ga , kiya woh uss jaisa hosakta hai jissay hum ney dunyawi zindagi ki poonji kay kuch mazay dey diye hain , phir woh unn logon  mein shamil honey wala hai jo qayamat kay din dhar liye jayen gay-?
verses.translation: bhala batao kay jiss shaks say hum ney acha saa wada ker rakha hai , aur woh uss waday ko paa-ker rahey ga , kiya woh uss jaisa hosakta hai jissay hum ney dunyawi zindagi ki poonji kay kuch mazay dey diye hain , phir woh unn logon  mein shamil honey wala hai jo qayamat kay din dhar liye jayen gay-?

verses.text: aur woh din ( kabhi naa bhoolo ) jab Allah unn logon  ko pukaray ga aur kahey ga :  kahan hain ( khudai mein ) meray woh shareek jinn ka tum dawa kiya kertay thay-?
verses.translation: aur woh din ( kabhi naa bhoolo ) jab Allah unn logon  ko pukaray ga aur kahey ga :  kahan hain ( khudai mein ) meray woh shareek jinn ka tum dawa kiya kertay thay-?

verses.text: jinn kay khilaf ( Allah ki ) baat poori hochuki hogi ,   woh kahen gay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! yeh log jinn ko hum ney gumrah kiya tha , hum ney inn ko ussi tarah gumrah kiya jaisay hum khud gumrah huye .   hum aap kay samney inn say dast bardar hotay hain , yeh humari ibadat nahi kertay thay .
verses.translation: jinn kay khilaf ( Allah ki ) baat poori hochuki hogi ,   woh kahen gay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! yeh log jinn ko hum ney gumrah kiya tha , hum ney inn ko ussi tarah gumrah kiya jaisay hum khud gumrah huye .   hum aap kay samney inn say dast bardar hotay hain , yeh humari ibadat nahi kertay thay .

verses.text: aur ( unn kafiron say ) kaha jaye ga kay :  pukaro unn ko jinhen tum ney Allah ka shareek bana rakha tha !  chunacheh woh unn ko pukaren gay , magar woh unn ko jawab nahi den gay , aur yeh azab aankhon say dekh len gay . kaash yeh aesay hotay kay hidayat ko qubool kerletay !
verses.translation: aur ( unn kafiron say ) kaha jaye ga kay :  pukaro unn ko jinhen tum ney Allah ka shareek bana rakha tha !  chunacheh woh unn ko pukaren gay , magar woh unn ko jawab nahi den gay , aur yeh azab aankhon say dekh len gay . kaash yeh aesay hotay kay hidayat ko qubool kerletay !

verses.text: aur woh din ( bhi hergiz naa bhoolo ) jab Allah unn ko pukaray ga , aur kahey ga :  tum ney payghumberon ko kiya jawab diya tha-?
verses.translation: aur woh din ( bhi hergiz naa bhoolo ) jab Allah unn ko pukaray ga , aur kahey ga :  tum ney payghumberon ko kiya jawab diya tha-?

verses.text: iss per sari baaten ( jo yeh banaya kertay hain ) iss/uss din bey nishan hochuki hon gi , chunacheh woh aapas mein aik doosray say kuch pooch bhi nahi saken gay .
verses.translation: iss per sari baaten ( jo yeh banaya kertay hain ) iss/uss din bey nishan hochuki hon gi , chunacheh woh aapas mein aik doosray say kuch pooch bhi nahi saken gay .

verses.text: albatta jinn logon  ney tauba kerli , aur emaan ley aaye , aur naik amal kiye , to poori umeed hai kay woh unn logon  mein shamil hon gay jinhen falah hasil hogi .
verses.translation: albatta jinn logon  ney tauba kerli , aur emaan ley aaye , aur naik amal kiye , to poori umeed hai kay woh unn logon  mein shamil hon gay jinhen falah hasil hogi .

verses.text: aur tumhara perwerdigar jo chahta hai peda kerta hai , aur ( jo chahta hai ) pasand kerta hai . unn ko koi ikhtiyar nahi hai .   Allah unn kay shirk say pak aur boht baala o bartar hai .
