verses.translation: bhala kiya inn/unn kay liye yeh ( nishani ) kafi nahi hai kay hum ney tum per kitab utaari hai jo inn/unn ko parh ker sunai jarahi hai-? yaqeenan iss/uss mein inn/unn logon  kay liye bari rehmat aur naseehat hai jo manney walay hon .

verses.text: keh do kay :  meray aur tumharay darmiyan gawahi denay kay liye Allah kafi hai , ussay unn tamam cheezon ka ilm hai jo aasmano aur zameen mein mojood hain . aur jo log batil per emaan laye hain , aur Allah ka inkar kiya hai , wohi hain jo sakht nuqsan uthaney walay hain .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  meray aur tumharay darmiyan gawahi denay kay liye Allah kafi hai , ussay unn tamam cheezon ka ilm hai jo aasmano aur zameen mein mojood hain . aur jo log batil per emaan laye hain , aur Allah ka inkar kiya hai , wohi hain jo sakht nuqsan uthaney walay hain .

verses.text: aur yeh log tum say azab ki jaldi macha rahey hain . agar ( azab ka ) aik moyyan waqt naa hota to inn per zaroor azab aajata , aur woh aaye ga zaroor ( magar ) itna achanak kay inn ko pata bhi nahi chalay ga .
verses.translation: aur yeh log tum say azab ki jaldi macha rahey hain . agar ( azab ka ) aik moyyan waqt naa hota to inn per zaroor azab aajata , aur woh aaye ga zaroor ( magar ) itna achanak kay inn ko pata bhi nahi chalay ga .

verses.text: yeh tum say azab ki jaldi macha rahey hain , aur yaqeenan jahannum kafiron ko gheray mein ley ley gi ,
verses.translation: yeh tum say azab ki jaldi macha rahey hain , aur yaqeenan jahannum kafiron ko gheray mein ley ley gi ,

verses.text: uss din jab azab unn per oopper say bhi chah jaye ga , aur inn kay paon kay neechay say bhi , aur kahey ga kay :  chakho unn kamon ka maza jo tum kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: uss din jab azab unn per oopper say bhi chah jaye ga , aur inn kay paon kay neechay say bhi , aur kahey ga kay :  chakho unn kamon ka maza jo tum kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: aey meray bando jo emaan laa-chukay ho ! yaqeen jano meri zameen boht wasee hai , lehaza khalis meri ibadat kero .
verses.translation: aey meray bando jo emaan laa-chukay ho ! yaqeen jano meri zameen boht wasee hai , lehaza khalis meri ibadat kero .

verses.text: her mutanaffas ko moat ka zaiqa chakhna hai , phir humari hi taraf tum sabb ko wapis laya jaye ga .
verses.translation: her mutanaffas ko moat ka zaiqa chakhna hai , phir humari hi taraf tum sabb ko wapis laya jaye ga .

verses.text: aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ko hum zaroor jannat kay aesay bala-khano mein abad keren gay jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jahan woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay . behtareen ajar hai inn amal kernay walon ka ,
verses.translation: aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ko hum zaroor jannat kay aesay bala-khano mein abad keren gay jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jahan woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay . behtareen ajar hai inn amal kernay walon ka ,

verses.text: jinhon ney sabar say kaam liya , aur jo apney perwerdigar per bharosa kertay hain .
verses.translation: jinhon ney sabar say kaam liya , aur jo apney perwerdigar per bharosa kertay hain .

verses.text: aur kitney janwer hain jo apna rizq uthaye nahi phirtay ! Allah unhen bhi rizq deta hai , aur tumhen bhi ,   aur wohi hai jo her baat sunta , her cheez janta hai .
verses.translation: aur kitney janwer hain jo apna rizq uthaye nahi phirtay ! Allah unhen bhi rizq deta hai , aur tumhen bhi ,   aur wohi hai jo her baat sunta , her cheez janta hai .

verses.text: aur agar tum unn say poocho kay :  kon hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya , aur sooraj aur chaand ko kaam per lagaya-?  to woh zaroor yeh kahen gay kay :  Allah !  phir aakhir yeh log kahan say ondhay chal parrtay hain-?
verses.translation: aur agar tum unn say poocho kay :  kon hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya , aur sooraj aur chaand ko kaam per lagaya-?  to woh zaroor yeh kahen gay kay :  Allah !  phir aakhir yeh log kahan say ondhay chal parrtay hain-?

verses.text: Allah apney bandon mein say jiss kay liye chahta hai , rizq mein kushadgi ker deta hai , aur jiss kay liye chahta hai , tangi ker deta hai , yaqeenan Allah her cheez ka mukammal ilm rakhta hai .
verses.translation: Allah apney bandon mein say jiss kay liye chahta hai , rizq mein kushadgi ker deta hai , aur jiss kay liye chahta hai , tangi ker deta hai , yaqeenan Allah her cheez ka mukammal ilm rakhta hai .

verses.text: aur agar tum inn say poocho kay :  kon hai jiss ney aasman say paani barsaya , phir uss kay zariye zameen kay murda honey kay baad ussay zindagi baskshi-?  to woh zaroor yeh kahen gay kay :  Allah !  kaho :  Alhamdulillah !    lekin unn mein say aksar log aqal say kaam nahi letay .
verses.translation: aur agar tum inn say poocho kay :  kon hai jiss ney aasman say paani barsaya , phir uss kay zariye zameen kay murda honey kay baad ussay zindagi baskshi-?  to woh zaroor yeh kahen gay kay :  Allah !  kaho :  Alhamdulillah !    lekin unn mein say aksar log aqal say kaam nahi letay .

verses.text: aur yeh dunyawi zindagi khel kood kay siwa kuch bhi nahi ,   aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay daar-e-aakhirat hi asal zindagi hai , agar yeh log jantay hotay !
verses.translation: aur yeh dunyawi zindagi khel kood kay siwa kuch bhi nahi ,   aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay daar-e-aakhirat hi asal zindagi hai , agar yeh log jantay hotay !

verses.text: chunacheh jab yeh kashti mein sawar hotay hain to Allah ko iss tarah pukartay hain kay unn ka aetiqaad khalis ussi per hota hai .   phir jab woh unhen bacha ker khushki per ley aata hai to foran shirk kernay lagtay hain .
verses.translation: chunacheh jab yeh kashti mein sawar hotay hain to Allah ko iss tarah pukartay hain kay unn ka aetiqaad khalis ussi per hota hai .   phir jab woh unhen bacha ker khushki per ley aata hai to foran shirk kernay lagtay hain .

verses.text: kerlen yeh log nashukri uss naimat ki jo hum ney unn ko di hai , aur uralen kuch mazay ! phir woh waqt door nahi jab enhen sabb pata chal jaye ga .
verses.translation: kerlen yeh log nashukri uss naimat ki jo hum ney unn ko di hai , aur uralen kuch mazay ! phir woh waqt door nahi jab enhen sabb pata chal jaye ga .

verses.text: bhala kiya enhon ney yeh nahi dekha kay hum ney ( inn kay shehar ko ) aik pur-aman haram bana diya hai , jabkay inn kay ird-gird logon  ka haal yeh hai kay unhen uchak liya jata hai .   kiya phir bhi yeh batil per emaan latay hain , aur Allah ki naimat ki nashukri kertay hain-?
verses.translation: bhala kiya enhon ney yeh nahi dekha kay hum ney ( inn kay shehar ko ) aik pur-aman haram bana diya hai , jabkay inn kay ird-gird logon  ka haal yeh hai kay unhen uchak liya jata hai .   kiya phir bhi yeh batil per emaan latay hain , aur Allah ki naimat ki nashukri kertay hain-?

verses.text: aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoota bohtan baandhay , ya jab uss kay paas haq ki baat phonchay to woh ussay jhutlaye-? kiya jahannum mein ( aesay ) kafiron ka thikana nahi hoga-?
verses.translation: aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoota bohtan baandhay , ya jab uss kay paas haq ki baat phonchay to woh ussay jhutlaye-? kiya jahannum mein ( aesay ) kafiron ka thikana nahi hoga-?

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney humari khatir koshish ki hai , hum unhen zaroor bil-zaroor apney raaston per phonchayen gay ,   aur yaqeenan Allah naiki kernay walon kay sath hai .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney humari khatir koshish ki hai , hum unhen zaroor bil-zaroor apney raaston per phonchayen gay ,   aur yaqeenan Allah naiki kernay walon kay sath hai .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: Alif-Laam-Meem .
ayahs.translation: Alif-Laam-Meem .

ayahs.text: kiya logon  ney yeh samajh rakha hai kay unhen yunhi chorr diya jaye ga kay bus woh yeh keh den kay :  hum emaan ley aaye  aur unn ko aazmaya naa jaye-?
ayahs.translation: kiya logon  ney yeh samajh rakha hai kay unhen yunhi chorr diya jaye ga kay bus woh yeh keh den kay :  hum emaan ley aaye  aur unn ko aazmaya naa jaye-?

ayahs.text: halankay hum ney unn sabb ki aazmaesh ki hai jo unn say pehlay guzar chukay hain . lehaza Allah zaroor maloom ker kay rahey ga kay kon log hain jinhon ney sachai say kaam liya hai , aur woh yeh bhi maloom ker kay rahey ga kay kon log jhootay hain .
ayahs.translation: halankay hum ney unn sabb ki aazmaesh ki hai jo unn say pehlay guzar chukay hain . lehaza Allah zaroor maloom ker kay rahey ga kay kon log hain jinhon ney sachai say kaam liya hai , aur woh yeh bhi maloom ker kay rahey ga kay kon log jhootay hain .

ayahs.text: jinn logon  ney buray buray kaam kiye hain , kiya woh yeh samajhtay hain kay woh hum say bazi ley jayen gay-? boht bura andaza hai jo woh laga rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: jinn logon  ney buray buray kaam kiye hain , kiya woh yeh samajhtay hain kay woh hum say bazi ley jayen gay-? boht bura andaza hai jo woh laga rahey hain .

ayahs.text: jo shaks Allah say ja-milney ki umeed rakhta ho , ussay yaqeen rakhna chahiye kay Allah ki muqarrar ki hoi miyaad zaroor aa-ker rahey gi , aur wohi hai jo her baat sunta , her cheez janta hai .
ayahs.translation: jo shaks Allah say ja-milney ki umeed rakhta ho , ussay yaqeen rakhna chahiye kay Allah ki muqarrar ki hoi miyaad zaroor aa-ker rahey gi , aur wohi hai jo her baat sunta , her cheez janta hai .

ayahs.text: aur jo shaks bhi humaray raastay mein mehnat uthata hai , woh apney hi faeeday kay liye mehnat uthata hai .   yaqeenan Allah tamam duniya jahan kay logon  say bey niaz hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jo shaks bhi humaray raastay mein mehnat uthata hai , woh apney hi faeeday kay liye mehnat uthata hai .   yaqeenan Allah tamam duniya jahan kay logon  say bey niaz hai .

ayahs.text: aur jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , hum unn ki khataon ko zaroor unn say jhaarr den gay , aur jo amal woh kertay rahey hain , unn ka behtareen badla unhen zaroor den gay .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , hum unn ki khataon ko zaroor unn say jhaarr den gay , aur jo amal woh kertay rahey hain , unn ka behtareen badla unhen zaroor den gay .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney insan ko hukum diya hai kay woh apney walaiden kay sath acha sulook keray . aur agar woh tum per zor daalen kay tum meray sath kissi aesay ( mabood ) ko shareek thehrao jiss kay baaray mein tumharay paas koi daleel nahi hai to unn ka kehna matt maano .   meri hi taraf tum sabb ko loat ker aana hai , uss waqt mein tumhen bataon ga kay tum kiya kertay rahey ho .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney insan ko hukum diya hai kay woh apney walaiden kay sath acha sulook keray . aur agar woh tum per zor daalen kay tum meray sath kissi aesay ( mabood ) ko shareek thehrao jiss kay baaray mein tumharay paas koi daleel nahi hai to unn ka kehna matt maano .   meri hi taraf tum sabb ko loat ker aana hai , uss waqt mein tumhen bataon ga kay tum kiya kertay rahey ho .

ayahs.text: aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , hum unhen zaroor naik logon  mein shamil keren gay .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , hum unhen zaroor naik logon  mein shamil keren gay .

ayahs.text: aur kuch log aesay hain kay woh keh detay hain kay :  hum Allah per emaan ley aaye hain  phir jab unn ko Allah kay raastay mein koi takleef phonchai jati hai to woh logon  ki phonchai hoi takleef ko aisa samajhtay hain jaisa Allah ka azab .   aur agar kabhi tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say koi madad unn ( musalmanon ) kay paas aagae hai to woh zaroor yeh kahen gay kay :  hum to tumharay sath thay .    bhala kiya Allah ko woh baaten achi tarah maloom nahi hain jo saray duniya jahan kay logon  kay seenon mein chupi hain-?
ayahs.translation: aur kuch log aesay hain kay woh keh detay hain kay :  hum Allah per emaan ley aaye hain  phir jab unn ko Allah kay raastay mein koi takleef phonchai jati hai to woh logon  ki phonchai hoi takleef ko aisa samajhtay hain jaisa Allah ka azab .   aur agar kabhi tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say koi madad unn ( musalmanon ) kay paas aagae hai to woh zaroor yeh kahen gay kay :  hum to tumharay sath thay .    bhala kiya Allah ko woh baaten achi tarah maloom nahi hain jo saray duniya jahan kay logon  kay seenon mein chupi hain-?

ayahs.text: aur Allah taalaa zaroor maloom ker kay rahey ga kay kon log emaan laye hain , aur woh zaroor maloom ker kay rahey ga kay kon log munafiq hain .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah taalaa zaroor maloom ker kay rahey ga kay kon log emaan laye hain , aur woh zaroor maloom ker kay rahey ga kay kon log munafiq hain .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unhon ney emaan walon say kaha kay :  humaray raastay kay peechay chalo to hum tumhari khataon ka bojh uthalen gay  , halankay woh unn ki khataon ka zara bhi bojh nahi utha saktay , aur yeh log yaqeenan bilkul jhootay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unhon ney emaan walon say kaha kay :  humaray raastay kay peechay chalo to hum tumhari khataon ka bojh uthalen gay  , halankay woh unn ki khataon ka zara bhi bojh nahi utha saktay , aur yeh log yaqeenan bilkul jhootay hain .

ayahs.text: aur woh apney gunahon kay bojh bhi zaroor uthayen gay , aur apney bojh kay sath kuch aur bojh bhi .   aur yeh log jitney jhoot gharra kertay thay , qayamat kay din inn say unn sabb ki baaz purs zaroor ki jaye gi .
ayahs.translation: aur woh apney gunahon kay bojh bhi zaroor uthayen gay , aur apney bojh kay sath kuch aur bojh bhi .   aur yeh log jitney jhoot gharra kertay thay , qayamat kay din inn say unn sabb ki baaz purs zaroor ki jaye gi .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney nooh ko unn ki qoam kay paas bheja tha , chunacheh pachas kam aik hazar saal tak woh unn kay darmiyan rahey , phir unn ko toofan ney aa-pakra , aur woh zalim log thay .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney nooh ko unn ki qoam kay paas bheja tha , chunacheh pachas kam aik hazar saal tak woh unn kay darmiyan rahey , phir unn ko toofan ney aa-pakra , aur woh zalim log thay .

ayahs.text: phir hum ney nooh ko aur kashti walon ko bacha liya , aur hum ney uss ko duniya jahan walon kay liye aik ibrat bana diya .
ayahs.translation: phir hum ney nooh ko aur kashti walon ko bacha liya , aur hum ney uss ko duniya jahan walon kay liye aik ibrat bana diya .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney Ibrahim ko bheja jabkay unhon ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  Allah ki ibadat kero , aur uss say daro yehi baat tumharay liye behtar hai , agar tum samajh say kaam lo .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney Ibrahim ko bheja jabkay unhon ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  Allah ki ibadat kero , aur uss say daro yehi baat tumharay liye behtar hai , agar tum samajh say kaam lo .

ayahs.text: jo kuch tum kertay ho woh yeh hai kay Allah ko chorr ker tum button ko poojtay ho , aur jhooti baaten gharrtay ho . yaqeen jano kay Allah ko chorr ker jinn jinn ki tum ibadat kertay ho , woh tumhen rizq denay ka koi ikhtiyar nahi rakhtay , iss liye rizq Allah kay paas talash kero , aur uss ki ibadat kero , aur uss ka shukar ada kero . ussi kay paas tumhen wapis lotaya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: jo kuch tum kertay ho woh yeh hai kay Allah ko chorr ker tum button ko poojtay ho , aur jhooti baaten gharrtay ho . yaqeen jano kay Allah ko chorr ker jinn jinn ki tum ibadat kertay ho , woh tumhen rizq denay ka koi ikhtiyar nahi rakhtay , iss liye rizq Allah kay paas talash kero , aur uss ki ibadat kero , aur uss ka shukar ada kero . ussi kay paas tumhen wapis lotaya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur agar tum mujhay jhutla rahey ho to tum say pehlay boht si qoamen jhutlaney ki rawish ikhtiyar ker-chuki hain , aur Rasool per iss kay siwa koi zimma daari nahi hoti kay woh saaf saaf baat phoncha dey .
ayahs.translation: aur agar tum mujhay jhutla rahey ho to tum say pehlay boht si qoamen jhutlaney ki rawish ikhtiyar ker-chuki hain , aur Rasool per iss kay siwa koi zimma daari nahi hoti kay woh saaf saaf baat phoncha dey .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya inn logon  ney yeh nahi dekha kay Allah kiss tarah makhlooq ko shuroo mein peda kerta hai ? phir wohi ussay dobara peda keray ga , yeh kaam to Allah kay liye boht aasaan hai .
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya inn logon  ney yeh nahi dekha kay Allah kiss tarah makhlooq ko shuroo mein peda kerta hai ? phir wohi ussay dobara peda keray ga , yeh kaam to Allah kay liye boht aasaan hai .

ayahs.text: kaho kay :  zara zameen mein chal phir ker dekho kay Allah ney kiss tarah makhlooq ko shuroo mein peda kiya , phir Allah hi aakhirat wali makhlooq ko bhi utha kharra keray ga . yaqeenan Allah her cheez per qadir hai .
ayahs.translation: kaho kay :  zara zameen mein chal phir ker dekho kay Allah ney kiss tarah makhlooq ko shuroo mein peda kiya , phir Allah hi aakhirat wali makhlooq ko bhi utha kharra keray ga . yaqeenan Allah her cheez per qadir hai .

ayahs.text: woh jiss ko chahye ga , saza dey ga , aur jiss per chahye ga reham keray ga , aur ussi ki taraf tum sabb ko palta kerlay jaya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: woh jiss ko chahye ga , saza dey ga , aur jiss per chahye ga reham keray ga , aur ussi ki taraf tum sabb ko palta kerlay jaya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur tum naa zameen mein ( Allah ko ) aajiz ker-saktay ho , aur naa aasman mein , aur Allah kay siwa tumhara naa koi rakhwala hai , aur naa koi madadgaar .
ayahs.translation: aur tum naa zameen mein ( Allah ko ) aajiz ker-saktay ho , aur naa aasman mein , aur Allah kay siwa tumhara naa koi rakhwala hai , aur naa koi madadgaar .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney Allah ki aayaton ka aur uss say ja-milney ka inkar kiya hai , woh meri rehmat say mayyus hochukay hain , aur unn kay liye dukh denay wala azab hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney Allah ki aayaton ka aur uss say ja-milney ka inkar kiya hai , woh meri rehmat say mayyus hochukay hain , aur unn kay liye dukh denay wala azab hai .

ayahs.text: gharz Ibrahim ki qoam ka jawab iss kay siwa kuch nahi tha kay unhon ney kaha :  qatal ker daalo iss ko ya jala daalo issay !  phir Allah ney Ibrahim ko aag say bachaya . yaqeenan iss waqaey mein unn logon  kay liye bari ibraten hain jo emaan latay hain .
ayahs.translation: gharz Ibrahim ki qoam ka jawab iss kay siwa kuch nahi tha kay unhon ney kaha :  qatal ker daalo iss ko ya jala daalo issay !  phir Allah ney Ibrahim ko aag say bachaya . yaqeenan iss waqaey mein unn logon  kay liye bari ibraten hain jo emaan latay hain .

ayahs.text: aur Ibrahim ney yeh bhi kaha kay :  tum ney Allah ko chorr ker button ko ( khuda ) maana huwa hai , jiss kay zariye dunyawi zindagi mein tumhari aapas ki dosti qaeem hai .   phir qayamat kay din tum aik doosray ka inkar kero gay , aur aik doosray per lanat bhejo gay , aur tumhara thikana dozakh hoga , aur tumhen kissi bhi tarah kay madadgaar moyassar nahi hon gay .
ayahs.translation: aur Ibrahim ney yeh bhi kaha kay :  tum ney Allah ko chorr ker button ko ( khuda ) maana huwa hai , jiss kay zariye dunyawi zindagi mein tumhari aapas ki dosti qaeem hai .   phir qayamat kay din tum aik doosray ka inkar kero gay , aur aik doosray per lanat bhejo gay , aur tumhara thikana dozakh hoga , aur tumhen kissi bhi tarah kay madadgaar moyassar nahi hon gay .

ayahs.text: phir loot unn per emaan laye ,   aur Ibrahim ney kaha kay :  mein apney perwerdigar ki taraf hijrat ker kay jaraha hun ,   wohi hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil .
ayahs.translation: phir loot unn per emaan laye ,   aur Ibrahim ney kaha kay :  mein apney perwerdigar ki taraf hijrat ker kay jaraha hun ,   wohi hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney unhen Ishaq aur Yaqoob ( jaisay betay ) ata farmaye , aur unn ki aulad mein nabwooat aur kitab ka silsila jari rakha , aur unn ka ajar hum ney unhen duniya mein ( bhi ) diya aur yaqeenan aakhirat mein unn ka shumar sualeheen mein hoga .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney unhen Ishaq aur Yaqoob ( jaisay betay ) ata farmaye , aur unn ki aulad mein nabwooat aur kitab ka silsila jari rakha , aur unn ka ajar hum ney unhen duniya mein ( bhi ) diya aur yaqeenan aakhirat mein unn ka shumar sualeheen mein hoga .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney loot ko bheja jabkay uss ney apni qoam say kaha :  haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum aesi bey hayai ka kaam kertay ho jo tum say pehlay duniya jahan walon mein say kissi ney nahi kiya .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney loot ko bheja jabkay uss ney apni qoam say kaha :  haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum aesi bey hayai ka kaam kertay ho jo tum say pehlay duniya jahan walon mein say kissi ney nahi kiya .

ayahs.text: kiya tum mardon kay paas jatay ho ,   aur raaston mein daakay daaltay ho , aur apni bhari majlis mein badi ka irtikab kertay ho-?  phir unn ki qoam kay logon  kay paas iss kay siwa koi jawab nahi tha kay unhon ney kaha :  ley aao hum per Allah ka azab agar tum sachay ho !
ayahs.translation: kiya tum mardon kay paas jatay ho ,   aur raaston mein daakay daaltay ho , aur apni bhari majlis mein badi ka irtikab kertay ho-?  phir unn ki qoam kay logon  kay paas iss kay siwa koi jawab nahi tha kay unhon ney kaha :  ley aao hum per Allah ka azab agar tum sachay ho !

ayahs.text: loot ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! inn mufsid logon  kay muqablay mein meri madad farmaiye .
ayahs.translation: loot ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! inn mufsid logon  kay muqablay mein meri madad farmaiye .

ayahs.text: aur jab humaray bhejay huye farishtay Ibrahim kay paas ( unn kay beta honey ki ) khushkhabri ley ker phonchay ,   to unhon ney kaha kay :  hum iss basti walon ko halak kernay walay hain . haqeeqat yeh hai kay iss kay bashinday baray zalim banay huye hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jab humaray bhejay huye farishtay Ibrahim kay paas ( unn kay beta honey ki ) khushkhabri ley ker phonchay ,   to unhon ney kaha kay :  hum iss basti walon ko halak kernay walay hain . haqeeqat yeh hai kay iss kay bashinday baray zalim banay huye hain .

ayahs.text: Ibrahim ney kaha :  iss basti mein to loot mojood hain .  farishton ney kaha :  hamen khoob maloom hai kay uss mein kon hai . hum unhen aur unn kay mutallaqeen ko zaroor bacha len gay , siwaye unn ki biwi kay kay woh unn logon  mein shamil rahey gi jo peechay reh jayen gay .
ayahs.translation: Ibrahim ney kaha :  iss basti mein to loot mojood hain .  farishton ney kaha :  hamen khoob maloom hai kay uss mein kon hai . hum unhen aur unn kay mutallaqeen ko zaroor bacha len gay , siwaye unn ki biwi kay kay woh unn logon  mein shamil rahey gi jo peechay reh jayen gay .

ayahs.text: aur jab humaray bhejay huye farishtay loot kay paas phonchay to loot unn ki wajeh say sakht pareshan huye , aur unn ki wajeh say unn ka dil tang honey laga . unn farishton ney kaha :  aap naa dariye , aur naa ghum kijiye . hum aap ko aur aap kay mutallaqeen ko bachlen gay , siwaye aap ki biwi kay jo peechay reh janey walon mein shamil rahey gi .
ayahs.translation: aur jab humaray bhejay huye farishtay loot kay paas phonchay to loot unn ki wajeh say sakht pareshan huye , aur unn ki wajeh say unn ka dil tang honey laga . unn farishton ney kaha :  aap naa dariye , aur naa ghum kijiye . hum aap ko aur aap kay mutallaqeen ko bachlen gay , siwaye aap ki biwi kay jo peechay reh janey walon mein shamil rahey gi .

ayahs.text: iss basti kay bashinday jo bad-kaariyan kertay rahey hain , unn ki wajeh say hum unn per aasman say azab nazil kernay walay hain .
ayahs.translation: iss basti kay bashinday jo bad-kaariyan kertay rahey hain , unn ki wajeh say hum unn per aasman say azab nazil kernay walay hain .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney iss basti ki kuch khuli nishani unn logon  kay liye chorr di hai jo samajh say kaam len .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney iss basti ki kuch khuli nishani unn logon  kay liye chorr di hai jo samajh say kaam len .

ayahs.text: aur madiyan ki taraf hum ney unn kay bhai shoaib ko bheja . chunacheh unhon ney kaha :  meri qoam kay logo ! Allah ki ibadat kero , aur aakhirat walay din ki umeed rakho , aur zameen mein fasad phelatay matt phiro .
ayahs.translation: aur madiyan ki taraf hum ney unn kay bhai shoaib ko bheja . chunacheh unhon ney kaha :  meri qoam kay logo ! Allah ki ibadat kero , aur aakhirat walay din ki umeed rakho , aur zameen mein fasad phelatay matt phiro .

ayahs.text: phir huwa yeh kay unn logon  ney shoaib ko jhutlaya , chunacheh zalzalay ney unn ko aa-pakra , aur woh apney ghar mein ondhay parray reh gaye .
ayahs.translation: phir huwa yeh kay unn logon  ney shoaib ko jhutlaya , chunacheh zalzalay ney unn ko aa-pakra , aur woh apney ghar mein ondhay parray reh gaye .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney aad aur samood ko bhi halak kiya , aur unn ki tabahi tum per unn kay gharon say wazeh hochuki hai .   aur shetan ney unn kay aemal ko unn ki nigahon mein khushnuma bana ker unhen raah-e-raast say rok diya tha , halankay woh soojh boojh kay log thay .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney aad aur samood ko bhi halak kiya , aur unn ki tabahi tum per unn kay gharon say wazeh hochuki hai .   aur shetan ney unn kay aemal ko unn ki nigahon mein khushnuma bana ker unhen raah-e-raast say rok diya tha , halankay woh soojh boojh kay log thay .

ayahs.text: aur qaroon , firon aur hamaan ko bhi hum ney halak kiya .   musa unn kay paas roshan daleelen ley ker aaye thay , magar unhon ney zameen mein takabbur say kaam liya , aur woh ( hum say ) jeet naa sakay .
ayahs.translation: aur qaroon , firon aur hamaan ko bhi hum ney halak kiya .   musa unn kay paas roshan daleelen ley ker aaye thay , magar unhon ney zameen mein takabbur say kaam liya , aur woh ( hum say ) jeet naa sakay .

ayahs.text: hum ney unn sabb ko unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say pakar mein liya , chunacheh unn mein say kuch woh thay jinn per hum ney pathrao kernay wali hawa bheji ,   aur kuch woh thay jinn ko aik chinghaarr ney aa-pakra ,   aur kuch woh thay jinn ko hum ney zameen mein dhansa diya ,   aur kuch woh jinhen hum ney paani mein gharq kerdiya .   aur Allah aisa nahi tha kay unn per zulm kerta , lekin yeh log khud apni janon per zulm kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: hum ney unn sabb ko unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say pakar mein liya , chunacheh unn mein say kuch woh thay jinn per hum ney pathrao kernay wali hawa bheji ,   aur kuch woh thay jinn ko aik chinghaarr ney aa-pakra ,   aur kuch woh thay jinn ko hum ney zameen mein dhansa diya ,   aur kuch woh jinhen hum ney paani mein gharq kerdiya .   aur Allah aisa nahi tha kay unn per zulm kerta , lekin yeh log khud apni janon per zulm kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: jinn logon  ney Allah ko chorr ker doosray rakhwalay bana rakhay hain , unn ki misal makri ki si hai jiss ney koi ghar bana liya ho . aur khuli baat hai kay tamam gharon mein sabb say kamzor ghar makri ka hota hai . kaash kay yeh log jantay !
ayahs.translation: jinn logon  ney Allah ko chorr ker doosray rakhwalay bana rakhay hain , unn ki misal makri ki si hai jiss ney koi ghar bana liya ho . aur khuli baat hai kay tamam gharon mein sabb say kamzor ghar makri ka hota hai . kaash kay yeh log jantay !

ayahs.text: yeh log Allah ko chorr ker jiss jiss cheez ko pukartay hain Allah ussay khoob janta hai , aur woh iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
ayahs.translation: yeh log Allah ko chorr ker jiss jiss cheez ko pukartay hain Allah ussay khoob janta hai , aur woh iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

ayahs.text: hum yeh misalen logon  kay faeeday kay liye detay hain , aur unhen samajhtay wohi hain jo ilm walay hain .
ayahs.translation: hum yeh misalen logon  kay faeeday kay liye detay hain , aur unhen samajhtay wohi hain jo ilm walay hain .

ayahs.text: Allah ney aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq ( maqsad kay liye ) peda kiya hai .   dar-haqeeqat iss mein emaan walon kay liye bari nishani hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq ( maqsad kay liye ) peda kiya hai .   dar-haqeeqat iss mein emaan walon kay liye bari nishani hai .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) jo kitab tumharay paas wahi kay zariye bheji gaee hai , uss ki tilawat kero , aur namaz qaeem kero . beyshak namaz bey hayai aur buray kamon say rokti hai ,   aur Allah ka ziker sabb say bari cheez hai . aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah uss sabb ko janta hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) jo kitab tumharay paas wahi kay zariye bheji gaee hai , uss ki tilawat kero , aur namaz qaeem kero . beyshak namaz bey hayai aur buray kamon say rokti hai ,   aur Allah ka ziker sabb say bari cheez hai . aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah uss sabb ko janta hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( musalmano ! ) ehal-e-kitab say behas naa kero , magar aesay tareeqay say jo behtareen ho , albatta unn mein say jo ziyadti keren , unn ki baat aur hai   aur ( unn say ) yeh kaho kay :  hum uss kitab per bhi emaan laye hain jo hum per nazil ki gaee hai , aur uss per bhi jo tum per nazil ki gaee thi , aur humara khuda aur tumhara khuda aik hai , aur hum ussi kay farmanbardaar hain .
ayahs.translation: aur ( musalmano ! ) ehal-e-kitab say behas naa kero , magar aesay tareeqay say jo behtareen ho , albatta unn mein say jo ziyadti keren , unn ki baat aur hai   aur ( unn say ) yeh kaho kay :  hum uss kitab per bhi emaan laye hain jo hum per nazil ki gaee hai , aur uss per bhi jo tum per nazil ki gaee thi , aur humara khuda aur tumhara khuda aik hai , aur hum ussi kay farmanbardaar hain .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) issi tarah hum ney tum per kitab nazil ki hai , iss liye jinn logon  ko hum ney kitab di hai , woh iss per emaan latay hain , aur inn ( butt paraston ) mein say bhi kuch log hain jo iss per emaan laarahey hain , aur humari aayaton ka inkar sirf wohi log kertay hain jo kafir hain .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) issi tarah hum ney tum per kitab nazil ki hai , iss liye jinn logon  ko hum ney kitab di hai , woh iss per emaan latay hain , aur inn ( butt paraston ) mein say bhi kuch log hain jo iss per emaan laarahey hain , aur humari aayaton ka inkar sirf wohi log kertay hain jo kafir hain .

ayahs.text: aur tum iss say pehlay naa koi kitab parhtay thay , aur naa koi kitab apney haath say likhtay thay . agar aisa hota to batil walay meen meekh nikal saktay thay .
ayahs.translation: aur tum iss say pehlay naa koi kitab parhtay thay , aur naa koi kitab apney haath say likhtay thay . agar aisa hota to batil walay meen meekh nikal saktay thay .

ayahs.text: haqeeqat to yeh hai kay yeh Quran aesi nishaniyon ka majmooa hai jo unn logon  kay seenon mein bilkul wazeh hain jinhen ilm ata kiya gaya hai , aur humari aayaton ka inkar sirf wohi log kertay hain jo zalim hain .
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat to yeh hai kay yeh Quran aesi nishaniyon ka majmooa hai jo unn logon  kay seenon mein bilkul wazeh hain jinhen ilm ata kiya gaya hai , aur humari aayaton ka inkar sirf wohi log kertay hain jo zalim hain .

ayahs.text: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  inn ( payghumber SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) per inn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say nishaniyan kiyon nahi utaari gaeen-?    ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) keh do kay :  nishaniyan sirf Allah kay paas hain , aur mein to aik wazeh tor per khabrdar kernay wala hun .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  inn ( payghumber SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) per inn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say nishaniyan kiyon nahi utaari gaeen-?    ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) keh do kay :  nishaniyan sirf Allah kay paas hain , aur mein to aik wazeh tor per khabrdar kernay wala hun .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya inn/unn kay liye yeh ( nishani ) kafi nahi hai kay hum ney tum per kitab utaari hai jo inn/unn ko parh ker sunai jarahi hai-? yaqeenan iss/uss mein inn/unn logon  kay liye bari rehmat aur naseehat hai jo manney walay hon .
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya inn/unn kay liye yeh ( nishani ) kafi nahi hai kay hum ney tum per kitab utaari hai jo inn/unn ko parh ker sunai jarahi hai-? yaqeenan iss/uss mein inn/unn logon  kay liye bari rehmat aur naseehat hai jo manney walay hon .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  meray aur tumharay darmiyan gawahi denay kay liye Allah kafi hai , ussay unn tamam cheezon ka ilm hai jo aasmano aur zameen mein mojood hain . aur jo log batil per emaan laye hain , aur Allah ka inkar kiya hai , wohi hain jo sakht nuqsan uthaney walay hain .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  meray aur tumharay darmiyan gawahi denay kay liye Allah kafi hai , ussay unn tamam cheezon ka ilm hai jo aasmano aur zameen mein mojood hain . aur jo log batil per emaan laye hain , aur Allah ka inkar kiya hai , wohi hain jo sakht nuqsan uthaney walay hain .

ayahs.text: aur yeh log tum say azab ki jaldi macha rahey hain . agar ( azab ka ) aik moyyan waqt naa hota to inn per zaroor azab aajata , aur woh aaye ga zaroor ( magar ) itna achanak kay inn ko pata bhi nahi chalay ga .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh log tum say azab ki jaldi macha rahey hain . agar ( azab ka ) aik moyyan waqt naa hota to inn per zaroor azab aajata , aur woh aaye ga zaroor ( magar ) itna achanak kay inn ko pata bhi nahi chalay ga .

ayahs.text: yeh tum say azab ki jaldi macha rahey hain , aur yaqeenan jahannum kafiron ko gheray mein ley ley gi ,
ayahs.translation: yeh tum say azab ki jaldi macha rahey hain , aur yaqeenan jahannum kafiron ko gheray mein ley ley gi ,

ayahs.text: uss din jab azab unn per oopper say bhi chah jaye ga , aur inn kay paon kay neechay say bhi , aur kahey ga kay :  chakho unn kamon ka maza jo tum kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: uss din jab azab unn per oopper say bhi chah jaye ga , aur inn kay paon kay neechay say bhi , aur kahey ga kay :  chakho unn kamon ka maza jo tum kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: aey meray bando jo emaan laa-chukay ho ! yaqeen jano meri zameen boht wasee hai , lehaza khalis meri ibadat kero .
ayahs.translation: aey meray bando jo emaan laa-chukay ho ! yaqeen jano meri zameen boht wasee hai , lehaza khalis meri ibadat kero .

ayahs.text: her mutanaffas ko moat ka zaiqa chakhna hai , phir humari hi taraf tum sabb ko wapis laya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: her mutanaffas ko moat ka zaiqa chakhna hai , phir humari hi taraf tum sabb ko wapis laya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ko hum zaroor jannat kay aesay bala-khano mein abad keren gay jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jahan woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay . behtareen ajar hai inn amal kernay walon ka ,
ayahs.translation: aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ko hum zaroor jannat kay aesay bala-khano mein abad keren gay jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jahan woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay . behtareen ajar hai inn amal kernay walon ka ,

ayahs.text: jinhon ney sabar say kaam liya , aur jo apney perwerdigar per bharosa kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: jinhon ney sabar say kaam liya , aur jo apney perwerdigar per bharosa kertay hain .

ayahs.text: aur kitney janwer hain jo apna rizq uthaye nahi phirtay ! Allah unhen bhi rizq deta hai , aur tumhen bhi ,   aur wohi hai jo her baat sunta , her cheez janta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur kitney janwer hain jo apna rizq uthaye nahi phirtay ! Allah unhen bhi rizq deta hai , aur tumhen bhi ,   aur wohi hai jo her baat sunta , her cheez janta hai .

ayahs.text: aur agar tum unn say poocho kay :  kon hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya , aur sooraj aur chaand ko kaam per lagaya-?  to woh zaroor yeh kahen gay kay :  Allah !  phir aakhir yeh log kahan say ondhay chal parrtay hain-?
ayahs.translation: aur agar tum unn say poocho kay :  kon hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya , aur sooraj aur chaand ko kaam per lagaya-?  to woh zaroor yeh kahen gay kay :  Allah !  phir aakhir yeh log kahan say ondhay chal parrtay hain-?

ayahs.text: Allah apney bandon mein say jiss kay liye chahta hai , rizq mein kushadgi ker deta hai , aur jiss kay liye chahta hai , tangi ker deta hai , yaqeenan Allah her cheez ka mukammal ilm rakhta hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah apney bandon mein say jiss kay liye chahta hai , rizq mein kushadgi ker deta hai , aur jiss kay liye chahta hai , tangi ker deta hai , yaqeenan Allah her cheez ka mukammal ilm rakhta hai .

ayahs.text: aur agar tum inn say poocho kay :  kon hai jiss ney aasman say paani barsaya , phir uss kay zariye zameen kay murda honey kay baad ussay zindagi baskshi-?  to woh zaroor yeh kahen gay kay :  Allah !  kaho :  Alhamdulillah !    lekin unn mein say aksar log aqal say kaam nahi letay .
ayahs.translation: aur agar tum inn say poocho kay :  kon hai jiss ney aasman say paani barsaya , phir uss kay zariye zameen kay murda honey kay baad ussay zindagi baskshi-?  to woh zaroor yeh kahen gay kay :  Allah !  kaho :  Alhamdulillah !    lekin unn mein say aksar log aqal say kaam nahi letay .

ayahs.text: aur yeh dunyawi zindagi khel kood kay siwa kuch bhi nahi ,   aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay daar-e-aakhirat hi asal zindagi hai , agar yeh log jantay hotay !
ayahs.translation: aur yeh dunyawi zindagi khel kood kay siwa kuch bhi nahi ,   aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay daar-e-aakhirat hi asal zindagi hai , agar yeh log jantay hotay !

ayahs.text: chunacheh jab yeh kashti mein sawar hotay hain to Allah ko iss tarah pukartay hain kay unn ka aetiqaad khalis ussi per hota hai .   phir jab woh unhen bacha ker khushki per ley aata hai to foran shirk kernay lagtay hain .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh jab yeh kashti mein sawar hotay hain to Allah ko iss tarah pukartay hain kay unn ka aetiqaad khalis ussi per hota hai .   phir jab woh unhen bacha ker khushki per ley aata hai to foran shirk kernay lagtay hain .

ayahs.text: kerlen yeh log nashukri uss naimat ki jo hum ney unn ko di hai , aur uralen kuch mazay ! phir woh waqt door nahi jab enhen sabb pata chal jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: kerlen yeh log nashukri uss naimat ki jo hum ney unn ko di hai , aur uralen kuch mazay ! phir woh waqt door nahi jab enhen sabb pata chal jaye ga .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya enhon ney yeh nahi dekha kay hum ney ( inn kay shehar ko ) aik pur-aman haram bana diya hai , jabkay inn kay ird-gird logon  ka haal yeh hai kay unhen uchak liya jata hai .   kiya phir bhi yeh batil per emaan latay hain , aur Allah ki naimat ki nashukri kertay hain-?
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya enhon ney yeh nahi dekha kay hum ney ( inn kay shehar ko ) aik pur-aman haram bana diya hai , jabkay inn kay ird-gird logon  ka haal yeh hai kay unhen uchak liya jata hai .   kiya phir bhi yeh batil per emaan latay hain , aur Allah ki naimat ki nashukri kertay hain-?

ayahs.text: aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoota bohtan baandhay , ya jab uss kay paas haq ki baat phonchay to woh ussay jhutlaye-? kiya jahannum mein ( aesay ) kafiron ka thikana nahi hoga-?
ayahs.translation: aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoota bohtan baandhay , ya jab uss kay paas haq ki baat phonchay to woh ussay jhutlaye-? kiya jahannum mein ( aesay ) kafiron ka thikana nahi hoga-?

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney humari khatir koshish ki hai , hum unhen zaroor bil-zaroor apney raaston per phonchayen gay ,   aur yaqeenan Allah naiki kernay walon kay sath hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney humari khatir koshish ki hai , hum unhen zaroor bil-zaroor apney raaston per phonchayen gay ,   aur yaqeenan Allah naiki kernay walon kay sath hai .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: Alif-Laam-Meem
verses.translation: Alif-Laam-Meem

verses.text: romi log qareeb ki sarzameen mein maghloob hogaye hain ,
verses.translation: romi log qareeb ki sarzameen mein maghloob hogaye hain ,

verses.text: aur woh apney maghloob honey kay baad unqareeb ghalib aajayen gay .
verses.translation: aur woh apney maghloob honey kay baad unqareeb ghalib aajayen gay .

verses.text: chand hi salon mein ! sara ikhtiyar Allah hi ka hai , pehlay bhi aur baad mein bhi . aur uss din emaan walay Allah ki di hoi fatah say khush hon gay .
verses.translation: chand hi salon mein ! sara ikhtiyar Allah hi ka hai , pehlay bhi aur baad mein bhi . aur uss din emaan walay Allah ki di hoi fatah say khush hon gay .

verses.text: woh jiss ko chahta hai , fatah deta hai , aur wohi sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , bara meharban bhi .
verses.translation: woh jiss ko chahta hai , fatah deta hai , aur wohi sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , bara meharban bhi .

verses.text: yeh Allah ka kiya huwa wada hai . Allah apney waday kay khilaf nahi kerta , lekin aksar log nahi jantay .
verses.translation: yeh Allah ka kiya huwa wada hai . Allah apney waday kay khilaf nahi kerta , lekin aksar log nahi jantay .

verses.text: woh dunyawi zindagi kay sirf zahiri rukh ko jantay hain , aur aakhirat kay baaray mein unn ka haal yeh hai kay woh uss say bilkul ghafil hain .
verses.translation: woh dunyawi zindagi kay sirf zahiri rukh ko jantay hain , aur aakhirat kay baaray mein unn ka haal yeh hai kay woh uss say bilkul ghafil hain .

verses.text: bhala kiya enhon ney apney dilon mein ghor nahi kiya-? Allah ney aasmano aur zameen ko aur unn kay darmiyan pai janey wali cheezon ko baghair kissi bar-haq maqsad kay aur koi miyaad muqarrar kiye baghair peda nahi kerdiya    aur boht say log hain kay apney perwerdigar say jaa milney kay munkir hain .
verses.translation: bhala kiya enhon ney apney dilon mein ghor nahi kiya-? Allah ney aasmano aur zameen ko aur unn kay darmiyan pai janey wali cheezon ko baghair kissi bar-haq maqsad kay aur koi miyaad muqarrar kiye baghair peda nahi kerdiya    aur boht say log hain kay apney perwerdigar say jaa milney kay munkir hain .

verses.text: kiya yeh log zameen mein chalay phiray nahi hain , takay woh yeh dekhtay kay unn say pehlay jo log thay , unn ka anjam kaisa huwa-? woh taqat mein inn say ziyada mazboot thay , aur unhon ney zameen ko bhi jota tha , aur jitna inn logon  ney ussay abad kiya hai , uss say ziyada unhon ney uss ko abad kiya tha , aur unn kay paas unn kay payghumber khulay khulay dalaeel ley ker aaye thay ! chunacheh Allah to aisa nahi tha kay unn per zulm keray , lekin woh khud apni janon per zulm kertay rahey .
verses.translation: kiya yeh log zameen mein chalay phiray nahi hain , takay woh yeh dekhtay kay unn say pehlay jo log thay , unn ka anjam kaisa huwa-? woh taqat mein inn say ziyada mazboot thay , aur unhon ney zameen ko bhi jota tha , aur jitna inn logon  ney ussay abad kiya hai , uss say ziyada unhon ney uss ko abad kiya tha , aur unn kay paas unn kay payghumber khulay khulay dalaeel ley ker aaye thay ! chunacheh Allah to aisa nahi tha kay unn per zulm keray , lekin woh khud apni janon per zulm kertay rahey .

verses.text: phir jinn logon  ney burai ki thi , unn ka anjam bhi bura hi huwa , kiyonkay unhon ney Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlaya tha , aur woh unn ka mazaq uraya kertay thay .
verses.translation: phir jinn logon  ney burai ki thi , unn ka anjam bhi bura hi huwa , kiyonkay unhon ney Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlaya tha , aur woh unn ka mazaq uraya kertay thay .

verses.text: Allah hi makhlooq ki ibtida kerta hai , aur wohi uss ko dobara peda keray ga ,   phir tum sabb uss kay paas wapis bula liye jao gay .
verses.translation: Allah hi makhlooq ki ibtida kerta hai , aur wohi uss ko dobara peda keray ga ,   phir tum sabb uss kay paas wapis bula liye jao gay .

verses.text: aur jiss din qayamat barpa hogi , uss roz mujrim log na-umeed hojayen gay .
verses.translation: aur jiss din qayamat barpa hogi , uss roz mujrim log na-umeed hojayen gay .

verses.text: aur unhon ney jinn ko Allah ka shareek maan rakha tha , unn mein say koi unn ka sirfarishi nahi hoga , aur khud yeh log apney maaney huye shareekon say munkir hojayen gay .
verses.translation: aur unhon ney jinn ko Allah ka shareek maan rakha tha , unn mein say koi unn ka sirfarishi nahi hoga , aur khud yeh log apney maaney huye shareekon say munkir hojayen gay .

verses.text: aur jiss din qayamat barpa hogi , uss roz log mukhtalif qismon mein butt jayen gay .
verses.translation: aur jiss din qayamat barpa hogi , uss roz log mukhtalif qismon mein butt jayen gay .

verses.text: chunacheh jo log emaan laye thay , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye thay , unn ko to jannat mein aesi khushiyan di jayen gi jo unn kay chehron say phooti parr rahi hon gi .
verses.translation: chunacheh jo log emaan laye thay , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye thay , unn ko to jannat mein aesi khushiyan di jayen gi jo unn kay chehron say phooti parr rahi hon gi .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya tha aur humari aayaton ko aur aakhirat ka samna kernay ko jhutlaya tha , to aesay logon  ko azab mein dhar liya jaye ga .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya tha aur humari aayaton ko aur aakhirat ka samna kernay ko jhutlaya tha , to aesay logon  ko azab mein dhar liya jaye ga .

verses.text: lehaza Allah ki tasbeeh kero uss waqt bhi jab tumharay paas shaam aati hai , aur uss waqt bhi jab tum per subha tuloo hoti hai ,
verses.translation: lehaza Allah ki tasbeeh kero uss waqt bhi jab tumharay paas shaam aati hai , aur uss waqt bhi jab tum per subha tuloo hoti hai ,

verses.text: aur ussi ki hamd hoti hai aasmano mein bhi aur zameen mein bhi aur sooraj dhalney kay waqt bhi ( uss ki tasbeeh kero ) aur uss waqt bhi jab tum per zohar ka waqt aata hai .
verses.translation: aur ussi ki hamd hoti hai aasmano mein bhi aur zameen mein bhi aur sooraj dhalney kay waqt bhi ( uss ki tasbeeh kero ) aur uss waqt bhi jab tum per zohar ka waqt aata hai .

verses.text: woh jandaar ko bey jaan say nikal lata hai , aur bey jaan ko jandaar say nikal leta hai ,   aur woh zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad zindagi bakhshta hai . aur issi tarah tum ko ( qabron say ) nikal liya jaye ga .
verses.translation: woh jandaar ko bey jaan say nikal lata hai , aur bey jaan ko jandaar say nikal leta hai ,   aur woh zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad zindagi bakhshta hai . aur issi tarah tum ko ( qabron say ) nikal liya jaye ga .

verses.text: aur uss ki ( qudrat ki ) aik nishani yeh hai kay uss ney tum ko mitti say peda kiya , phir tum dekhtay hi dekhtay insan ban ker ( zameen mein ) phelay parray ho .
verses.translation: aur uss ki ( qudrat ki ) aik nishani yeh hai kay uss ney tum ko mitti say peda kiya , phir tum dekhtay hi dekhtay insan ban ker ( zameen mein ) phelay parray ho .

verses.text: aur uss ki aik nishani yeh hai kay uss ney tumharay liye tum hi mein say biwiyan peda ken , takay tum unn kay paas jaker sukoon hasil kero , aur tumharay darmiyan mohabbat aur rehmat kay jazbaat rakh diye .   yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo ghor-o-fiker say kaam letay hain .
verses.translation: aur uss ki aik nishani yeh hai kay uss ney tumharay liye tum hi mein say biwiyan peda ken , takay tum unn kay paas jaker sukoon hasil kero , aur tumharay darmiyan mohabbat aur rehmat kay jazbaat rakh diye .   yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo ghor-o-fiker say kaam letay hain .

verses.text: aur uss ki nishaniyon ka aik hissa aasmano aur zameen ki pedaeesh aur tumhari zabanon aur rangon ka ikhtilaf bhi hai . yaqeenan iss mein danish mandon kay liye bari nishaniyan hain .
verses.translation: aur uss ki nishaniyon ka aik hissa aasmano aur zameen ki pedaeesh aur tumhari zabanon aur rangon ka ikhtilaf bhi hai . yaqeenan iss mein danish mandon kay liye bari nishaniyan hain .

verses.text: aur uss ki nishaniyon ka aik hissa tumhara raat aur din kay waqt sona aur Allah ka fazal talash kerna hai .   yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo baat suntay hon .
verses.translation: aur uss ki nishaniyon ka aik hissa tumhara raat aur din kay waqt sona aur Allah ka fazal talash kerna hai .   yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo baat suntay hon .

verses.text: aur uss ki aik nishani yeh hai kay woh tumhen bijli ki chamak dikhata hai jiss say darr bhi lagta hai , aur umeed bhi hoti hai ,   aur aasman say paani barsata hai , jiss kay zariye woh zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad zindagi bakhshta hai . yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo aqal say kaam letay hain .
verses.translation: aur uss ki aik nishani yeh hai kay woh tumhen bijli ki chamak dikhata hai jiss say darr bhi lagta hai , aur umeed bhi hoti hai ,   aur aasman say paani barsata hai , jiss kay zariye woh zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad zindagi bakhshta hai . yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo aqal say kaam letay hain .

verses.text: aur uss ki aik nishani yeh hai kay aasman aur zameen uss kay hukum say qaeem hain . phir jab woh aik pukar dey ker tumhen zameen say bulaye ga to tum foran nikal parro gay .
verses.translation: aur uss ki aik nishani yeh hai kay aasman aur zameen uss kay hukum say qaeem hain . phir jab woh aik pukar dey ker tumhen zameen say bulaye ga to tum foran nikal parro gay .

verses.text: aur aasmano aur zameen mein jo bhi hain sabb ussi ki milkiyat hain . sabb ussi kay hukum kay tabey hain
verses.translation: aur aasmano aur zameen mein jo bhi hain sabb ussi ki milkiyat hain . sabb ussi kay hukum kay tabey hain

verses.text: aur wohi hai jo makhlooq ki ibtida kerta hai , phir ussay dobara peda keray ga , aur yeh kaam uss kay liye boht aasaan hai . aur ussi ki sabb say oonchi shaan hai , aasmano mein bhi aur zameen mein bhi , aur wohi hai jo iqtidar wala bhi hai , hikmat wala bhi .
verses.translation: aur wohi hai jo makhlooq ki ibtida kerta hai , phir ussay dobara peda keray ga , aur yeh kaam uss kay liye boht aasaan hai . aur ussi ki sabb say oonchi shaan hai , aasmano mein bhi aur zameen mein bhi , aur wohi hai jo iqtidar wala bhi hai , hikmat wala bhi .

verses.text: woh tumhen khud tumharay andar say aik misal deta hai . hum ney jo rizq tumhen diya hai , kiya tumharay ghulamon mein say koi uss mein tumhara shareek hai kay uss rizq mein tumhara darja unn kay barabar ho ( aur ) tum unn ghulamon say wesay hi dartay ho jaisay aapas mein aik doosray say dartay ho-?   hum issi tarah dalaeel unn logon  kay liye khol khol ker biyan kertay hain jo aqal say kaam len .
verses.translation: woh tumhen khud tumharay andar say aik misal deta hai . hum ney jo rizq tumhen diya hai , kiya tumharay ghulamon mein say koi uss mein tumhara shareek hai kay uss rizq mein tumhara darja unn kay barabar ho ( aur ) tum unn ghulamon say wesay hi dartay ho jaisay aapas mein aik doosray say dartay ho-?   hum issi tarah dalaeel unn logon  kay liye khol khol ker biyan kertay hain jo aqal say kaam len .

verses.text: lekin zalim log kissi ilm kay baghair apni khuwaishaat kay peechay chal parray hain . abb uss shaks ko kon hidayat dey sakta hai jissay Allah ney gumrah kerdiya ho ,   aur aesay logon  ka koi madadgaar nahi hoga .
verses.translation: lekin zalim log kissi ilm kay baghair apni khuwaishaat kay peechay chal parray hain . abb uss shaks ko kon hidayat dey sakta hai jissay Allah ney gumrah kerdiya ho ,   aur aesay logon  ka koi madadgaar nahi hoga .

verses.text: lehaza tum yak soo ho ker apna rukh iss deen ki taraf qaeem rakho . Allah ki banai hoi uss fitrat per chalo jiss per uss ney tamam logon  ko peda kiya hai   Allah ki takhleeq mein koi tabdeeli nahi laee jasakti ,   yehi bilkul seedha raasta hai , lekin aksar log nahi jantay
verses.translation: lehaza tum yak soo ho ker apna rukh iss deen ki taraf qaeem rakho . Allah ki banai hoi uss fitrat per chalo jiss per uss ney tamam logon  ko peda kiya hai   Allah ki takhleeq mein koi tabdeeli nahi laee jasakti ,   yehi bilkul seedha raasta hai , lekin aksar log nahi jantay

verses.text: . ( fitrat ki perwi ) iss tarah ( kero ) kay tum ney ussi ( Allah ) say lo laga rakhi ho , aur uss say dartay raho , aur namaz qaeem kero , aur unn logon  kay sath shamil naa ho jo shirk ka irtikab kertay hain ,
verses.translation: . ( fitrat ki perwi ) iss tarah ( kero ) kay tum ney ussi ( Allah ) say lo laga rakhi ho , aur uss say dartay raho , aur namaz qaeem kero , aur unn logon  kay sath shamil naa ho jo shirk ka irtikab kertay hain ,

verses.text: woh jinhon ney apney deen ko tukrray tukrray kerliya , aur mukhtalif firqon mein butt gaye . her giroh apney apney tareeqay per magan hai .
verses.translation: woh jinhon ney apney deen ko tukrray tukrray kerliya , aur mukhtalif firqon mein butt gaye . her giroh apney apney tareeqay per magan hai .

verses.text: aur jab logon  ko koi takleef choo jati hai to woh apney perwerdigar say lo laga ker ussi ko pukartay hain , phir jab woh apni taraf say unhen kissi rehmat ka zaiqa chakha deta hai , to unn mein say kuch log yakayak apney perwerdigar kay sath shirk kernay lagtay hain ,
verses.translation: aur jab logon  ko koi takleef choo jati hai to woh apney perwerdigar say lo laga ker ussi ko pukartay hain , phir jab woh apni taraf say unhen kissi rehmat ka zaiqa chakha deta hai , to unn mein say kuch log yakayak apney perwerdigar kay sath shirk kernay lagtay hain ,

verses.text: takay hum ney unhen jo kuch diya tha , uss ki nashukri keren . acha ! kuch mazay urra lo , phir woh waqt door nahi jab tumhen sabb pata chal jaye ga .
verses.translation: takay hum ney unhen jo kuch diya tha , uss ki nashukri keren . acha ! kuch mazay urra lo , phir woh waqt door nahi jab tumhen sabb pata chal jaye ga .

verses.text: bhala kiya hum ney unn per koi aesi daleel nazil ki hai jo uss shirk ka irtikab kernay ko kehti ho jo yeh Allah kay sath kertay rahey hain-?
verses.translation: bhala kiya hum ney unn per koi aesi daleel nazil ki hai jo uss shirk ka irtikab kernay ko kehti ho jo yeh Allah kay sath kertay rahey hain-?

verses.text: aur jab hum logon  ko rehmat ka maza chakhatay hain to woh iss/uss per itra jatay hain , aur agar unhen khud apney haathon kay kartoot ki wajeh say koi burai phonch jaye to zara si dair mein woh mayyus honey lagtay hain .
verses.translation: aur jab hum logon  ko rehmat ka maza chakhatay hain to woh iss/uss per itra jatay hain , aur agar unhen khud apney haathon kay kartoot ki wajeh say koi burai phonch jaye to zara si dair mein woh mayyus honey lagtay hain .

verses.text: kiya unhon ney yeh nahi dekha kay Allah jiss kay liye chahta hai rizq kushada ker deta hai , aur ( jiss kay liye chahye ) tang ker deta hai .   iss mein yaqeenan unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo emaan layen .
verses.translation: kiya unhon ney yeh nahi dekha kay Allah jiss kay liye chahta hai rizq kushada ker deta hai , aur ( jiss kay liye chahye ) tang ker deta hai .   iss mein yaqeenan unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo emaan layen .

verses.text: lehaza tum rishta daar ko uss ka haq do , aur miskeen aur musafir ko bhi .   jo log Allah ki khushnoodi chahtay hain , unn kay liye yeh behtar hai , aur wohi hain jo falah paaney walay hain .
verses.translation: lehaza tum rishta daar ko uss ka haq do , aur miskeen aur musafir ko bhi .   jo log Allah ki khushnoodi chahtay hain , unn kay liye yeh behtar hai , aur wohi hain jo falah paaney walay hain .

verses.text: aur yeh jo tum sood detay ho takay woh logon  kay maal mein shamil ho ker barh jaye to woh Allah kay nazdeek barhta nahi hai ,   aur jo zakat tum Allah ki khushnoodi hasil kernay kay iraday say detay ho , to jo log bhi aisa kertay hain woh hain jo ( apney maal ko ) kaee guna barha letay hain .
verses.translation: aur yeh jo tum sood detay ho takay woh logon  kay maal mein shamil ho ker barh jaye to woh Allah kay nazdeek barhta nahi hai ,   aur jo zakat tum Allah ki khushnoodi hasil kernay kay iraday say detay ho , to jo log bhi aisa kertay hain woh hain jo ( apney maal ko ) kaee guna barha letay hain .

verses.text: Allah woh hai jiss ney tumhen peda kiya , phir uss ney tumhen rizq diya , phir woh tumhen moat deta hai , phir tumhen zinda keray ga . jinn ko tum ney Allah ka shareek maana huwa hai , kiya unn mein say koi hai jo inn mein say koi kaam kerta ho-? pak hai woh aur boht baala o bartar uss shirk say jiss ka irtikab yeh log kertay hain .
verses.translation: Allah woh hai jiss ney tumhen peda kiya , phir uss ney tumhen rizq diya , phir woh tumhen moat deta hai , phir tumhen zinda keray ga . jinn ko tum ney Allah ka shareek maana huwa hai , kiya unn mein say koi hai jo inn mein say koi kaam kerta ho-? pak hai woh aur boht baala o bartar uss shirk say jiss ka irtikab yeh log kertay hain .

verses.text: logon  ney apney haathon jo kamai ki , uss ki wajeh say khushki aur tari mein fasad phela ,   takay unhon ney jo kaam kiye hain Allah unn mein say kuch ka maza unhen chakhaye , shayad woh baaz aajayen .
verses.translation: logon  ney apney haathon jo kamai ki , uss ki wajeh say khushki aur tari mein fasad phela ,   takay unhon ney jo kaam kiye hain Allah unn mein say kuch ka maza unhen chakhaye , shayad woh baaz aajayen .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho kay :  zameen mein chal phir ker dekho kay jo log pehlay guzray hain , unn ka kaisa anjam huwa . unn mein say aksar mushrik thay .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho kay :  zameen mein chal phir ker dekho kay jo log pehlay guzray hain , unn ka kaisa anjam huwa . unn mein say aksar mushrik thay .

verses.text: lehaza tum apna rukh sahih deen ki taraf qaeem rakho , qabal iss kay kay woh din aaye jiss kay talney ka Allah ki taraf say koi imkan nahi hai . uss din log alag alag hojayen gay .
verses.translation: lehaza tum apna rukh sahih deen ki taraf qaeem rakho , qabal iss kay kay woh din aaye jiss kay talney ka Allah ki taraf say koi imkan nahi hai . uss din log alag alag hojayen gay .

verses.text: jiss ney kufr kiya hai , uss ka kufr ussi per parray ga , aur jinn logon  ney naik amal kiya hai , woh apney liye hi raasta bana rahey hain ,
verses.translation: jiss ney kufr kiya hai , uss ka kufr ussi per parray ga , aur jinn logon  ney naik amal kiya hai , woh apney liye hi raasta bana rahey hain ,

verses.text: nateeja yeh kay Allah unn logon  ko apney fazal say jaza dey ga jo emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain . yaqeenan Allah kafiron ko pasand nahi kerta .
verses.translation: nateeja yeh kay Allah unn logon  ko apney fazal say jaza dey ga jo emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain . yaqeenan Allah kafiron ko pasand nahi kerta .

verses.text: aur uss ( Allah ki qudrat ) ki aik nishani yeh hai kay woh hawayen bhejta hai jo ( barish ki ) khushkhabri ley ker aati hain , aur iss liye bhejta hai takay tumhen apni rehmat ka kuch maza chakhaye , aur takay kashtiyan uss kay hukum say paani mein chalen , aur tum uss ka fazal talash kero ,   aur shukar ada kero .
verses.translation: aur uss ( Allah ki qudrat ) ki aik nishani yeh hai kay woh hawayen bhejta hai jo ( barish ki ) khushkhabri ley ker aati hain , aur iss liye bhejta hai takay tumhen apni rehmat ka kuch maza chakhaye , aur takay kashtiyan uss kay hukum say paani mein chalen , aur tum uss ka fazal talash kero ,   aur shukar ada kero .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum say pehlay bhi boht say payghumber unn ki qoamon kay paas bhejay , chunacheh woh unn kay paas khulay khulay dalaeel ley ker aaye . phir jinhon ney jaraeem ka irtikab kiya tha , hum ney unn say intiqam liya , aur hum ney yeh zimma daari li thi kay emaan walon ki madad keren .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum say pehlay bhi boht say payghumber unn ki qoamon kay paas bhejay , chunacheh woh unn kay paas khulay khulay dalaeel ley ker aaye . phir jinhon ney jaraeem ka irtikab kiya tha , hum ney unn say intiqam liya , aur hum ney yeh zimma daari li thi kay emaan walon ki madad keren .

verses.text: Allah hi woh hai jo hawayen bhejta hai , chunacheh woh badal ko uthati hain , phir woh uss ( badal ) ko jiss tarah chahta hai , aasman mein phela deta hai , aur ussay kaee tehon ( wali ghata ) mein tabdeel ker deta hai . tab tum dekhtay ho kay uss kay darmiyan say barish baras rahi hai . chunacheh jab woh apney bandon mein say jinn ko chahta hai , woh barish phonchata hai to woh achanak khushi mananey lagtay hain ,
verses.translation: Allah hi woh hai jo hawayen bhejta hai , chunacheh woh badal ko uthati hain , phir woh uss ( badal ) ko jiss tarah chahta hai , aasman mein phela deta hai , aur ussay kaee tehon ( wali ghata ) mein tabdeel ker deta hai . tab tum dekhtay ho kay uss kay darmiyan say barish baras rahi hai . chunacheh jab woh apney bandon mein say jinn ko chahta hai , woh barish phonchata hai to woh achanak khushi mananey lagtay hain ,

verses.text: halankay iss say pehlay jab tak unn per barish nahi barsai gaee thi , woh na-umeed horahey thay .
verses.translation: halankay iss say pehlay jab tak unn per barish nahi barsai gaee thi , woh na-umeed horahey thay .

verses.text: abb zara Allah ki rehmat kay asraat dekho kay woh zameen ko uss kay murda honey kay baad kiss tarah zindagi bakhshta hai ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh murdon ko zinda kernay wala hai , aur woh her cheez per poori tarah qadir hai .
verses.translation: abb zara Allah ki rehmat kay asraat dekho kay woh zameen ko uss kay murda honey kay baad kiss tarah zindagi bakhshta hai ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh murdon ko zinda kernay wala hai , aur woh her cheez per poori tarah qadir hai .

verses.text: aur agar hum ( nuqsan deh ) hawa chala den   jiss kay nateejay mein woh apney khet ko peela parra huwa dekhen to uss kay baad yeh nashukri kernay lagen .
verses.translation: aur agar hum ( nuqsan deh ) hawa chala den   jiss kay nateejay mein woh apney khet ko peela parra huwa dekhen to uss kay baad yeh nashukri kernay lagen .

verses.text: gharz ( aey payghumber ! ) tum murdon ko apni baat nahi suna saktay , aur naa behron ko apni pukar suna saktay ho jab woh peeth pher ker jarahey hon ,
verses.translation: gharz ( aey payghumber ! ) tum murdon ko apni baat nahi suna saktay , aur naa behron ko apni pukar suna saktay ho jab woh peeth pher ker jarahey hon ,

verses.text: aur naa tum andhon ko unn ki gumrahi say nikal ker raastay per daal saktay ho .   tum to unhi logon  ko apni baat suna saktay ho jo humari aayaton per emaan layen , phir farmanbardaar ban jayen .
verses.translation: aur naa tum andhon ko unn ki gumrahi say nikal ker raastay per daal saktay ho .   tum to unhi logon  ko apni baat suna saktay ho jo humari aayaton per emaan layen , phir farmanbardaar ban jayen .

verses.text: Allah woh hai jiss ney tumhari takhleeq ki ibtida kamzori say ki , phir kamzori kay baad taqat ata farmaee , phir taqat kay baad ( dobara ) kamzori aur burhapa taari kerdiya . woh jo chahta hai , peda kerta hai , aur wohi hai jiss ka ilm bhi kamil hai , qudrat bhi kamil .
verses.translation: Allah woh hai jiss ney tumhari takhleeq ki ibtida kamzori say ki , phir kamzori kay baad taqat ata farmaee , phir taqat kay baad ( dobara ) kamzori aur burhapa taari kerdiya . woh jo chahta hai , peda kerta hai , aur wohi hai jiss ka ilm bhi kamil hai , qudrat bhi kamil .

verses.text: aur jiss din qayamat barpa hogi , uss din mujrim log qasam kha len gay kay woh ( barzakh mein ) aik gharri say ziyada nahi rahey . issi tarah ( duniya mein bhi ) woh ondhay chala kertay thay .
verses.translation: aur jiss din qayamat barpa hogi , uss din mujrim log qasam kha len gay kay woh ( barzakh mein ) aik gharri say ziyada nahi rahey . issi tarah ( duniya mein bhi ) woh ondhay chala kertay thay .

verses.text: jinn logon  ko ilm aur emaan ata kiya gaya hai , woh kahen gay kay :  tum Allah ki likhi hoi taqdeer kay mutabiq hashar kay din tak ( barzakh mein ) parray rahey ho . abb yeh wohi hashar ka din hai , lekin tum log yaqeen nahi kertay thay .
verses.translation: jinn logon  ko ilm aur emaan ata kiya gaya hai , woh kahen gay kay :  tum Allah ki likhi hoi taqdeer kay mutabiq hashar kay din tak ( barzakh mein ) parray rahey ho . abb yeh wohi hashar ka din hai , lekin tum log yaqeen nahi kertay thay .

verses.text: chunacheh jinn logon  ney zulm ki raah apnai thi , uss din unn ki maazrat unhen koi faeeda nahi phonchaye gi , aur naa unn say yeh kaha jaye ga kay Allah ki narazi door kero .
verses.translation: chunacheh jinn logon  ney zulm ki raah apnai thi , uss din unn ki maazrat unhen koi faeeda nahi phonchaye gi , aur naa unn say yeh kaha jaye ga kay Allah ki narazi door kero .

verses.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney uss Quran mein logon  ( ko samjhaney ) ki khatir her qisam ki baaten biyan ki hain . aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn ka haal yeh hai kay tum inn kay paas koi bhi nishani ley aao , yeh kafir log phir bhi yehi kahen gay kay tum kuch bhi nahi , bilkul ghalat kaar ho .
verses.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney uss Quran mein logon  ( ko samjhaney ) ki khatir her qisam ki baaten biyan ki hain . aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn ka haal yeh hai kay tum inn kay paas koi bhi nishani ley aao , yeh kafir log phir bhi yehi kahen gay kay tum kuch bhi nahi , bilkul ghalat kaar ho .

verses.text: Allah issi tarah unn logon  kay dilon per thappa laga deta hai jo samajh say kaam nahi letay .
verses.translation: Allah issi tarah unn logon  kay dilon per thappa laga deta hai jo samajh say kaam nahi letay .

verses.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum sabar say kaam lo , yaqeen jano Allah ka wada sacha hai , aur aisa hergiz naa hona chahiye kay jo log yaqeen nahi kertay , unn ki wajeh say tum dhelay parr-jao .
verses.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum sabar say kaam lo , yaqeen jano Allah ka wada sacha hai , aur aisa hergiz naa hona chahiye kay jo log yaqeen nahi kertay , unn ki wajeh say tum dhelay parr-jao .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: Alif-Laam-Meem
ayahs.translation: Alif-Laam-Meem

ayahs.text: romi log qareeb ki sarzameen mein maghloob hogaye hain ,
ayahs.translation: romi log qareeb ki sarzameen mein maghloob hogaye hain ,

ayahs.text: aur woh apney maghloob honey kay baad unqareeb ghalib aajayen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur woh apney maghloob honey kay baad unqareeb ghalib aajayen gay .

ayahs.text: chand hi salon mein ! sara ikhtiyar Allah hi ka hai , pehlay bhi aur baad mein bhi . aur uss din emaan walay Allah ki di hoi fatah say khush hon gay .
ayahs.translation: chand hi salon mein ! sara ikhtiyar Allah hi ka hai , pehlay bhi aur baad mein bhi . aur uss din emaan walay Allah ki di hoi fatah say khush hon gay .

ayahs.text: woh jiss ko chahta hai , fatah deta hai , aur wohi sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , bara meharban bhi .
ayahs.translation: woh jiss ko chahta hai , fatah deta hai , aur wohi sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , bara meharban bhi .

ayahs.text: yeh Allah ka kiya huwa wada hai . Allah apney waday kay khilaf nahi kerta , lekin aksar log nahi jantay .
ayahs.translation: yeh Allah ka kiya huwa wada hai . Allah apney waday kay khilaf nahi kerta , lekin aksar log nahi jantay .

ayahs.text: woh dunyawi zindagi kay sirf zahiri rukh ko jantay hain , aur aakhirat kay baaray mein unn ka haal yeh hai kay woh uss say bilkul ghafil hain .
ayahs.translation: woh dunyawi zindagi kay sirf zahiri rukh ko jantay hain , aur aakhirat kay baaray mein unn ka haal yeh hai kay woh uss say bilkul ghafil hain .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya enhon ney apney dilon mein ghor nahi kiya-? Allah ney aasmano aur zameen ko aur unn kay darmiyan pai janey wali cheezon ko baghair kissi bar-haq maqsad kay aur koi miyaad muqarrar kiye baghair peda nahi kerdiya    aur boht say log hain kay apney perwerdigar say jaa milney kay munkir hain .
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya enhon ney apney dilon mein ghor nahi kiya-? Allah ney aasmano aur zameen ko aur unn kay darmiyan pai janey wali cheezon ko baghair kissi bar-haq maqsad kay aur koi miyaad muqarrar kiye baghair peda nahi kerdiya    aur boht say log hain kay apney perwerdigar say jaa milney kay munkir hain .

ayahs.text: kiya yeh log zameen mein chalay phiray nahi hain , takay woh yeh dekhtay kay unn say pehlay jo log thay , unn ka anjam kaisa huwa-? woh taqat mein inn say ziyada mazboot thay , aur unhon ney zameen ko bhi jota tha , aur jitna inn logon  ney ussay abad kiya hai , uss say ziyada unhon ney uss ko abad kiya tha , aur unn kay paas unn kay payghumber khulay khulay dalaeel ley ker aaye thay ! chunacheh Allah to aisa nahi tha kay unn per zulm keray , lekin woh khud apni janon per zulm kertay rahey .
ayahs.translation: kiya yeh log zameen mein chalay phiray nahi hain , takay woh yeh dekhtay kay unn say pehlay jo log thay , unn ka anjam kaisa huwa-? woh taqat mein inn say ziyada mazboot thay , aur unhon ney zameen ko bhi jota tha , aur jitna inn logon  ney ussay abad kiya hai , uss say ziyada unhon ney uss ko abad kiya tha , aur unn kay paas unn kay payghumber khulay khulay dalaeel ley ker aaye thay ! chunacheh Allah to aisa nahi tha kay unn per zulm keray , lekin woh khud apni janon per zulm kertay rahey .

ayahs.text: phir jinn logon  ney burai ki thi , unn ka anjam bhi bura hi huwa , kiyonkay unhon ney Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlaya tha , aur woh unn ka mazaq uraya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: phir jinn logon  ney burai ki thi , unn ka anjam bhi bura hi huwa , kiyonkay unhon ney Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlaya tha , aur woh unn ka mazaq uraya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: Allah hi makhlooq ki ibtida kerta hai , aur wohi uss ko dobara peda keray ga ,   phir tum sabb uss kay paas wapis bula liye jao gay .
ayahs.translation: Allah hi makhlooq ki ibtida kerta hai , aur wohi uss ko dobara peda keray ga ,   phir tum sabb uss kay paas wapis bula liye jao gay .

ayahs.text: aur jiss din qayamat barpa hogi , uss roz mujrim log na-umeed hojayen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur jiss din qayamat barpa hogi , uss roz mujrim log na-umeed hojayen gay .

ayahs.text: aur unhon ney jinn ko Allah ka shareek maan rakha tha , unn mein say koi unn ka sirfarishi nahi hoga , aur khud yeh log apney maaney huye shareekon say munkir hojayen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur unhon ney jinn ko Allah ka shareek maan rakha tha , unn mein say koi unn ka sirfarishi nahi hoga , aur khud yeh log apney maaney huye shareekon say munkir hojayen gay .

ayahs.text: aur jiss din qayamat barpa hogi , uss roz log mukhtalif qismon mein butt jayen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur jiss din qayamat barpa hogi , uss roz log mukhtalif qismon mein butt jayen gay .

ayahs.text: chunacheh jo log emaan laye thay , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye thay , unn ko to jannat mein aesi khushiyan di jayen gi jo unn kay chehron say phooti parr rahi hon gi .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh jo log emaan laye thay , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye thay , unn ko to jannat mein aesi khushiyan di jayen gi jo unn kay chehron say phooti parr rahi hon gi .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya tha aur humari aayaton ko aur aakhirat ka samna kernay ko jhutlaya tha , to aesay logon  ko azab mein dhar liya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya tha aur humari aayaton ko aur aakhirat ka samna kernay ko jhutlaya tha , to aesay logon  ko azab mein dhar liya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: lehaza Allah ki tasbeeh kero uss waqt bhi jab tumharay paas shaam aati hai , aur uss waqt bhi jab tum per subha tuloo hoti hai ,
ayahs.translation: lehaza Allah ki tasbeeh kero uss waqt bhi jab tumharay paas shaam aati hai , aur uss waqt bhi jab tum per subha tuloo hoti hai ,

ayahs.text: aur ussi ki hamd hoti hai aasmano mein bhi aur zameen mein bhi aur sooraj dhalney kay waqt bhi ( uss ki tasbeeh kero ) aur uss waqt bhi jab tum per zohar ka waqt aata hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ussi ki hamd hoti hai aasmano mein bhi aur zameen mein bhi aur sooraj dhalney kay waqt bhi ( uss ki tasbeeh kero ) aur uss waqt bhi jab tum per zohar ka waqt aata hai .

ayahs.text: woh jandaar ko bey jaan say nikal lata hai , aur bey jaan ko jandaar say nikal leta hai ,   aur woh zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad zindagi bakhshta hai . aur issi tarah tum ko ( qabron say ) nikal liya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: woh jandaar ko bey jaan say nikal lata hai , aur bey jaan ko jandaar say nikal leta hai ,   aur woh zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad zindagi bakhshta hai . aur issi tarah tum ko ( qabron say ) nikal liya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur uss ki ( qudrat ki ) aik nishani yeh hai kay uss ney tum ko mitti say peda kiya , phir tum dekhtay hi dekhtay insan ban ker ( zameen mein ) phelay parray ho .
ayahs.translation: aur uss ki ( qudrat ki ) aik nishani yeh hai kay uss ney tum ko mitti say peda kiya , phir tum dekhtay hi dekhtay insan ban ker ( zameen mein ) phelay parray ho .

ayahs.text: aur uss ki aik nishani yeh hai kay uss ney tumharay liye tum hi mein say biwiyan peda ken , takay tum unn kay paas jaker sukoon hasil kero , aur tumharay darmiyan mohabbat aur rehmat kay jazbaat rakh diye .   yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo ghor-o-fiker say kaam letay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur uss ki aik nishani yeh hai kay uss ney tumharay liye tum hi mein say biwiyan peda ken , takay tum unn kay paas jaker sukoon hasil kero , aur tumharay darmiyan mohabbat aur rehmat kay jazbaat rakh diye .   yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo ghor-o-fiker say kaam letay hain .

ayahs.text: aur uss ki nishaniyon ka aik hissa aasmano aur zameen ki pedaeesh aur tumhari zabanon aur rangon ka ikhtilaf bhi hai . yaqeenan iss mein danish mandon kay liye bari nishaniyan hain .
ayahs.translation: aur uss ki nishaniyon ka aik hissa aasmano aur zameen ki pedaeesh aur tumhari zabanon aur rangon ka ikhtilaf bhi hai . yaqeenan iss mein danish mandon kay liye bari nishaniyan hain .

ayahs.text: aur uss ki nishaniyon ka aik hissa tumhara raat aur din kay waqt sona aur Allah ka fazal talash kerna hai .   yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo baat suntay hon .
ayahs.translation: aur uss ki nishaniyon ka aik hissa tumhara raat aur din kay waqt sona aur Allah ka fazal talash kerna hai .   yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo baat suntay hon .

ayahs.text: aur uss ki aik nishani yeh hai kay woh tumhen bijli ki chamak dikhata hai jiss say darr bhi lagta hai , aur umeed bhi hoti hai ,   aur aasman say paani barsata hai , jiss kay zariye woh zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad zindagi bakhshta hai . yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo aqal say kaam letay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur uss ki aik nishani yeh hai kay woh tumhen bijli ki chamak dikhata hai jiss say darr bhi lagta hai , aur umeed bhi hoti hai ,   aur aasman say paani barsata hai , jiss kay zariye woh zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad zindagi bakhshta hai . yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo aqal say kaam letay hain .

ayahs.text: aur uss ki aik nishani yeh hai kay aasman aur zameen uss kay hukum say qaeem hain . phir jab woh aik pukar dey ker tumhen zameen say bulaye ga to tum foran nikal parro gay .
ayahs.translation: aur uss ki aik nishani yeh hai kay aasman aur zameen uss kay hukum say qaeem hain . phir jab woh aik pukar dey ker tumhen zameen say bulaye ga to tum foran nikal parro gay .

ayahs.text: aur aasmano aur zameen mein jo bhi hain sabb ussi ki milkiyat hain . sabb ussi kay hukum kay tabey hain
ayahs.translation: aur aasmano aur zameen mein jo bhi hain sabb ussi ki milkiyat hain . sabb ussi kay hukum kay tabey hain

ayahs.text: aur wohi hai jo makhlooq ki ibtida kerta hai , phir ussay dobara peda keray ga , aur yeh kaam uss kay liye boht aasaan hai . aur ussi ki sabb say oonchi shaan hai , aasmano mein bhi aur zameen mein bhi , aur wohi hai jo iqtidar wala bhi hai , hikmat wala bhi .
ayahs.translation: aur wohi hai jo makhlooq ki ibtida kerta hai , phir ussay dobara peda keray ga , aur yeh kaam uss kay liye boht aasaan hai . aur ussi ki sabb say oonchi shaan hai , aasmano mein bhi aur zameen mein bhi , aur wohi hai jo iqtidar wala bhi hai , hikmat wala bhi .

ayahs.text: woh tumhen khud tumharay andar say aik misal deta hai . hum ney jo rizq tumhen diya hai , kiya tumharay ghulamon mein say koi uss mein tumhara shareek hai kay uss rizq mein tumhara darja unn kay barabar ho ( aur ) tum unn ghulamon say wesay hi dartay ho jaisay aapas mein aik doosray say dartay ho-?   hum issi tarah dalaeel unn logon  kay liye khol khol ker biyan kertay hain jo aqal say kaam len .
ayahs.translation: woh tumhen khud tumharay andar say aik misal deta hai . hum ney jo rizq tumhen diya hai , kiya tumharay ghulamon mein say koi uss mein tumhara shareek hai kay uss rizq mein tumhara darja unn kay barabar ho ( aur ) tum unn ghulamon say wesay hi dartay ho jaisay aapas mein aik doosray say dartay ho-?   hum issi tarah dalaeel unn logon  kay liye khol khol ker biyan kertay hain jo aqal say kaam len .

ayahs.text: lekin zalim log kissi ilm kay baghair apni khuwaishaat kay peechay chal parray hain . abb uss shaks ko kon hidayat dey sakta hai jissay Allah ney gumrah kerdiya ho ,   aur aesay logon  ka koi madadgaar nahi hoga .
ayahs.translation: lekin zalim log kissi ilm kay baghair apni khuwaishaat kay peechay chal parray hain . abb uss shaks ko kon hidayat dey sakta hai jissay Allah ney gumrah kerdiya ho ,   aur aesay logon  ka koi madadgaar nahi hoga .

ayahs.text: lehaza tum yak soo ho ker apna rukh iss deen ki taraf qaeem rakho . Allah ki banai hoi uss fitrat per chalo jiss per uss ney tamam logon  ko peda kiya hai   Allah ki takhleeq mein koi tabdeeli nahi laee jasakti ,   yehi bilkul seedha raasta hai , lekin aksar log nahi jantay
ayahs.translation: lehaza tum yak soo ho ker apna rukh iss deen ki taraf qaeem rakho . Allah ki banai hoi uss fitrat per chalo jiss per uss ney tamam logon  ko peda kiya hai   Allah ki takhleeq mein koi tabdeeli nahi laee jasakti ,   yehi bilkul seedha raasta hai , lekin aksar log nahi jantay

ayahs.text: . ( fitrat ki perwi ) iss tarah ( kero ) kay tum ney ussi ( Allah ) say lo laga rakhi ho , aur uss say dartay raho , aur namaz qaeem kero , aur unn logon  kay sath shamil naa ho jo shirk ka irtikab kertay hain ,
ayahs.translation: . ( fitrat ki perwi ) iss tarah ( kero ) kay tum ney ussi ( Allah ) say lo laga rakhi ho , aur uss say dartay raho , aur namaz qaeem kero , aur unn logon  kay sath shamil naa ho jo shirk ka irtikab kertay hain ,

ayahs.text: woh jinhon ney apney deen ko tukrray tukrray kerliya , aur mukhtalif firqon mein butt gaye . her giroh apney apney tareeqay per magan hai .
ayahs.translation: woh jinhon ney apney deen ko tukrray tukrray kerliya , aur mukhtalif firqon mein butt gaye . her giroh apney apney tareeqay per magan hai .

ayahs.text: aur jab logon  ko koi takleef choo jati hai to woh apney perwerdigar say lo laga ker ussi ko pukartay hain , phir jab woh apni taraf say unhen kissi rehmat ka zaiqa chakha deta hai , to unn mein say kuch log yakayak apney perwerdigar kay sath shirk kernay lagtay hain ,
ayahs.translation: aur jab logon  ko koi takleef choo jati hai to woh apney perwerdigar say lo laga ker ussi ko pukartay hain , phir jab woh apni taraf say unhen kissi rehmat ka zaiqa chakha deta hai , to unn mein say kuch log yakayak apney perwerdigar kay sath shirk kernay lagtay hain ,

ayahs.text: takay hum ney unhen jo kuch diya tha , uss ki nashukri keren . acha ! kuch mazay urra lo , phir woh waqt door nahi jab tumhen sabb pata chal jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: takay hum ney unhen jo kuch diya tha , uss ki nashukri keren . acha ! kuch mazay urra lo , phir woh waqt door nahi jab tumhen sabb pata chal jaye ga .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya hum ney unn per koi aesi daleel nazil ki hai jo uss shirk ka irtikab kernay ko kehti ho jo yeh Allah kay sath kertay rahey hain-?
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya hum ney unn per koi aesi daleel nazil ki hai jo uss shirk ka irtikab kernay ko kehti ho jo yeh Allah kay sath kertay rahey hain-?

ayahs.text: aur jab hum logon  ko rehmat ka maza chakhatay hain to woh iss/uss per itra jatay hain , aur agar unhen khud apney haathon kay kartoot ki wajeh say koi burai phonch jaye to zara si dair mein woh mayyus honey lagtay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jab hum logon  ko rehmat ka maza chakhatay hain to woh iss/uss per itra jatay hain , aur agar unhen khud apney haathon kay kartoot ki wajeh say koi burai phonch jaye to zara si dair mein woh mayyus honey lagtay hain .
