ayahs.text: kiya unhon ney yeh nahi dekha kay Allah jiss kay liye chahta hai rizq kushada ker deta hai , aur ( jiss kay liye chahye ) tang ker deta hai .   iss mein yaqeenan unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo emaan layen .
ayahs.translation: kiya unhon ney yeh nahi dekha kay Allah jiss kay liye chahta hai rizq kushada ker deta hai , aur ( jiss kay liye chahye ) tang ker deta hai .   iss mein yaqeenan unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo emaan layen .

ayahs.text: lehaza tum rishta daar ko uss ka haq do , aur miskeen aur musafir ko bhi .   jo log Allah ki khushnoodi chahtay hain , unn kay liye yeh behtar hai , aur wohi hain jo falah paaney walay hain .
ayahs.translation: lehaza tum rishta daar ko uss ka haq do , aur miskeen aur musafir ko bhi .   jo log Allah ki khushnoodi chahtay hain , unn kay liye yeh behtar hai , aur wohi hain jo falah paaney walay hain .

ayahs.text: aur yeh jo tum sood detay ho takay woh logon  kay maal mein shamil ho ker barh jaye to woh Allah kay nazdeek barhta nahi hai ,   aur jo zakat tum Allah ki khushnoodi hasil kernay kay iraday say detay ho , to jo log bhi aisa kertay hain woh hain jo ( apney maal ko ) kaee guna barha letay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh jo tum sood detay ho takay woh logon  kay maal mein shamil ho ker barh jaye to woh Allah kay nazdeek barhta nahi hai ,   aur jo zakat tum Allah ki khushnoodi hasil kernay kay iraday say detay ho , to jo log bhi aisa kertay hain woh hain jo ( apney maal ko ) kaee guna barha letay hain .

ayahs.text: Allah woh hai jiss ney tumhen peda kiya , phir uss ney tumhen rizq diya , phir woh tumhen moat deta hai , phir tumhen zinda keray ga . jinn ko tum ney Allah ka shareek maana huwa hai , kiya unn mein say koi hai jo inn mein say koi kaam kerta ho-? pak hai woh aur boht baala o bartar uss shirk say jiss ka irtikab yeh log kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: Allah woh hai jiss ney tumhen peda kiya , phir uss ney tumhen rizq diya , phir woh tumhen moat deta hai , phir tumhen zinda keray ga . jinn ko tum ney Allah ka shareek maana huwa hai , kiya unn mein say koi hai jo inn mein say koi kaam kerta ho-? pak hai woh aur boht baala o bartar uss shirk say jiss ka irtikab yeh log kertay hain .

ayahs.text: logon  ney apney haathon jo kamai ki , uss ki wajeh say khushki aur tari mein fasad phela ,   takay unhon ney jo kaam kiye hain Allah unn mein say kuch ka maza unhen chakhaye , shayad woh baaz aajayen .
ayahs.translation: logon  ney apney haathon jo kamai ki , uss ki wajeh say khushki aur tari mein fasad phela ,   takay unhon ney jo kaam kiye hain Allah unn mein say kuch ka maza unhen chakhaye , shayad woh baaz aajayen .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho kay :  zameen mein chal phir ker dekho kay jo log pehlay guzray hain , unn ka kaisa anjam huwa . unn mein say aksar mushrik thay .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho kay :  zameen mein chal phir ker dekho kay jo log pehlay guzray hain , unn ka kaisa anjam huwa . unn mein say aksar mushrik thay .

ayahs.text: lehaza tum apna rukh sahih deen ki taraf qaeem rakho , qabal iss kay kay woh din aaye jiss kay talney ka Allah ki taraf say koi imkan nahi hai . uss din log alag alag hojayen gay .
ayahs.translation: lehaza tum apna rukh sahih deen ki taraf qaeem rakho , qabal iss kay kay woh din aaye jiss kay talney ka Allah ki taraf say koi imkan nahi hai . uss din log alag alag hojayen gay .

ayahs.text: jiss ney kufr kiya hai , uss ka kufr ussi per parray ga , aur jinn logon  ney naik amal kiya hai , woh apney liye hi raasta bana rahey hain ,
ayahs.translation: jiss ney kufr kiya hai , uss ka kufr ussi per parray ga , aur jinn logon  ney naik amal kiya hai , woh apney liye hi raasta bana rahey hain ,

ayahs.text: nateeja yeh kay Allah unn logon  ko apney fazal say jaza dey ga jo emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain . yaqeenan Allah kafiron ko pasand nahi kerta .
ayahs.translation: nateeja yeh kay Allah unn logon  ko apney fazal say jaza dey ga jo emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain . yaqeenan Allah kafiron ko pasand nahi kerta .

ayahs.text: aur uss ( Allah ki qudrat ) ki aik nishani yeh hai kay woh hawayen bhejta hai jo ( barish ki ) khushkhabri ley ker aati hain , aur iss liye bhejta hai takay tumhen apni rehmat ka kuch maza chakhaye , aur takay kashtiyan uss kay hukum say paani mein chalen , aur tum uss ka fazal talash kero ,   aur shukar ada kero .
ayahs.translation: aur uss ( Allah ki qudrat ) ki aik nishani yeh hai kay woh hawayen bhejta hai jo ( barish ki ) khushkhabri ley ker aati hain , aur iss liye bhejta hai takay tumhen apni rehmat ka kuch maza chakhaye , aur takay kashtiyan uss kay hukum say paani mein chalen , aur tum uss ka fazal talash kero ,   aur shukar ada kero .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum say pehlay bhi boht say payghumber unn ki qoamon kay paas bhejay , chunacheh woh unn kay paas khulay khulay dalaeel ley ker aaye . phir jinhon ney jaraeem ka irtikab kiya tha , hum ney unn say intiqam liya , aur hum ney yeh zimma daari li thi kay emaan walon ki madad keren .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum say pehlay bhi boht say payghumber unn ki qoamon kay paas bhejay , chunacheh woh unn kay paas khulay khulay dalaeel ley ker aaye . phir jinhon ney jaraeem ka irtikab kiya tha , hum ney unn say intiqam liya , aur hum ney yeh zimma daari li thi kay emaan walon ki madad keren .

ayahs.text: Allah hi woh hai jo hawayen bhejta hai , chunacheh woh badal ko uthati hain , phir woh uss ( badal ) ko jiss tarah chahta hai , aasman mein phela deta hai , aur ussay kaee tehon ( wali ghata ) mein tabdeel ker deta hai . tab tum dekhtay ho kay uss kay darmiyan say barish baras rahi hai . chunacheh jab woh apney bandon mein say jinn ko chahta hai , woh barish phonchata hai to woh achanak khushi mananey lagtay hain ,
ayahs.translation: Allah hi woh hai jo hawayen bhejta hai , chunacheh woh badal ko uthati hain , phir woh uss ( badal ) ko jiss tarah chahta hai , aasman mein phela deta hai , aur ussay kaee tehon ( wali ghata ) mein tabdeel ker deta hai . tab tum dekhtay ho kay uss kay darmiyan say barish baras rahi hai . chunacheh jab woh apney bandon mein say jinn ko chahta hai , woh barish phonchata hai to woh achanak khushi mananey lagtay hain ,

ayahs.text: halankay iss say pehlay jab tak unn per barish nahi barsai gaee thi , woh na-umeed horahey thay .
ayahs.translation: halankay iss say pehlay jab tak unn per barish nahi barsai gaee thi , woh na-umeed horahey thay .

ayahs.text: abb zara Allah ki rehmat kay asraat dekho kay woh zameen ko uss kay murda honey kay baad kiss tarah zindagi bakhshta hai ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh murdon ko zinda kernay wala hai , aur woh her cheez per poori tarah qadir hai .
ayahs.translation: abb zara Allah ki rehmat kay asraat dekho kay woh zameen ko uss kay murda honey kay baad kiss tarah zindagi bakhshta hai ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh murdon ko zinda kernay wala hai , aur woh her cheez per poori tarah qadir hai .

ayahs.text: aur agar hum ( nuqsan deh ) hawa chala den   jiss kay nateejay mein woh apney khet ko peela parra huwa dekhen to uss kay baad yeh nashukri kernay lagen .
ayahs.translation: aur agar hum ( nuqsan deh ) hawa chala den   jiss kay nateejay mein woh apney khet ko peela parra huwa dekhen to uss kay baad yeh nashukri kernay lagen .

ayahs.text: gharz ( aey payghumber ! ) tum murdon ko apni baat nahi suna saktay , aur naa behron ko apni pukar suna saktay ho jab woh peeth pher ker jarahey hon ,
ayahs.translation: gharz ( aey payghumber ! ) tum murdon ko apni baat nahi suna saktay , aur naa behron ko apni pukar suna saktay ho jab woh peeth pher ker jarahey hon ,

ayahs.text: aur naa tum andhon ko unn ki gumrahi say nikal ker raastay per daal saktay ho .   tum to unhi logon  ko apni baat suna saktay ho jo humari aayaton per emaan layen , phir farmanbardaar ban jayen .
ayahs.translation: aur naa tum andhon ko unn ki gumrahi say nikal ker raastay per daal saktay ho .   tum to unhi logon  ko apni baat suna saktay ho jo humari aayaton per emaan layen , phir farmanbardaar ban jayen .

ayahs.text: Allah woh hai jiss ney tumhari takhleeq ki ibtida kamzori say ki , phir kamzori kay baad taqat ata farmaee , phir taqat kay baad ( dobara ) kamzori aur burhapa taari kerdiya . woh jo chahta hai , peda kerta hai , aur wohi hai jiss ka ilm bhi kamil hai , qudrat bhi kamil .
ayahs.translation: Allah woh hai jiss ney tumhari takhleeq ki ibtida kamzori say ki , phir kamzori kay baad taqat ata farmaee , phir taqat kay baad ( dobara ) kamzori aur burhapa taari kerdiya . woh jo chahta hai , peda kerta hai , aur wohi hai jiss ka ilm bhi kamil hai , qudrat bhi kamil .

ayahs.text: aur jiss din qayamat barpa hogi , uss din mujrim log qasam kha len gay kay woh ( barzakh mein ) aik gharri say ziyada nahi rahey . issi tarah ( duniya mein bhi ) woh ondhay chala kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: aur jiss din qayamat barpa hogi , uss din mujrim log qasam kha len gay kay woh ( barzakh mein ) aik gharri say ziyada nahi rahey . issi tarah ( duniya mein bhi ) woh ondhay chala kertay thay .

ayahs.text: jinn logon  ko ilm aur emaan ata kiya gaya hai , woh kahen gay kay :  tum Allah ki likhi hoi taqdeer kay mutabiq hashar kay din tak ( barzakh mein ) parray rahey ho . abb yeh wohi hashar ka din hai , lekin tum log yaqeen nahi kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: jinn logon  ko ilm aur emaan ata kiya gaya hai , woh kahen gay kay :  tum Allah ki likhi hoi taqdeer kay mutabiq hashar kay din tak ( barzakh mein ) parray rahey ho . abb yeh wohi hashar ka din hai , lekin tum log yaqeen nahi kertay thay .

ayahs.text: chunacheh jinn logon  ney zulm ki raah apnai thi , uss din unn ki maazrat unhen koi faeeda nahi phonchaye gi , aur naa unn say yeh kaha jaye ga kay Allah ki narazi door kero .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh jinn logon  ney zulm ki raah apnai thi , uss din unn ki maazrat unhen koi faeeda nahi phonchaye gi , aur naa unn say yeh kaha jaye ga kay Allah ki narazi door kero .

ayahs.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney uss Quran mein logon  ( ko samjhaney ) ki khatir her qisam ki baaten biyan ki hain . aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn ka haal yeh hai kay tum inn kay paas koi bhi nishani ley aao , yeh kafir log phir bhi yehi kahen gay kay tum kuch bhi nahi , bilkul ghalat kaar ho .
ayahs.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney uss Quran mein logon  ( ko samjhaney ) ki khatir her qisam ki baaten biyan ki hain . aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn ka haal yeh hai kay tum inn kay paas koi bhi nishani ley aao , yeh kafir log phir bhi yehi kahen gay kay tum kuch bhi nahi , bilkul ghalat kaar ho .

ayahs.text: Allah issi tarah unn logon  kay dilon per thappa laga deta hai jo samajh say kaam nahi letay .
ayahs.translation: Allah issi tarah unn logon  kay dilon per thappa laga deta hai jo samajh say kaam nahi letay .

ayahs.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum sabar say kaam lo , yaqeen jano Allah ka wada sacha hai , aur aisa hergiz naa hona chahiye kay jo log yaqeen nahi kertay , unn ki wajeh say tum dhelay parr-jao .
ayahs.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum sabar say kaam lo , yaqeen jano Allah ka wada sacha hai , aur aisa hergiz naa hona chahiye kay jo log yaqeen nahi kertay , unn ki wajeh say tum dhelay parr-jao .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: Alif-Laam-Meem .
verses.translation: Alif-Laam-Meem .

verses.text: yeh uss hikmat wali kitab ki aayaten hain ,
verses.translation: yeh uss hikmat wali kitab ki aayaten hain ,

verses.text: jo naik logon  kay liye hidayat aur rehmat ban ker aai hai ,
verses.translation: jo naik logon  kay liye hidayat aur rehmat ban ker aai hai ,

verses.text: woh naik log jo namaz qaeem kertay hain , aur zakat ada-kertay hain , aur aakhirat ka poora yaqeen rakhtay hain .
verses.translation: woh naik log jo namaz qaeem kertay hain , aur zakat ada-kertay hain , aur aakhirat ka poora yaqeen rakhtay hain .

verses.text: wohi hain jo apney perwerdigar ki taraf say seedhay raastay per hain , aur wohi hain jo falah paaney walay hain .
verses.translation: wohi hain jo apney perwerdigar ki taraf say seedhay raastay per hain , aur wohi hain jo falah paaney walay hain .

verses.text: aur kuch log woh hain jo Allah say ghafil kernay wali baaton kay khareedaar bantay hain ,   takay unn kay zariye logon  ko bey samjhay boojhay Allah kay raastay say bhatkayen , aur uss ka mazaq urayen . inn logon  ko woh azab hoga jo zaleel ker kay rakh dey ga .
verses.translation: aur kuch log woh hain jo Allah say ghafil kernay wali baaton kay khareedaar bantay hain ,   takay unn kay zariye logon  ko bey samjhay boojhay Allah kay raastay say bhatkayen , aur uss ka mazaq urayen . inn logon  ko woh azab hoga jo zaleel ker kay rakh dey ga .

verses.text: aur jab aesay shaks kay samney humari aayaten parh ker sunai jati hain to woh pooray takabbur kay sath mun morr leta hai , jaisay unhen suna hi nahi , goya uss kay dono kanon mein behra-pann hai . lehaza uss ko aik dukh denay walay azab ki khushkhabri suna do .
verses.translation: aur jab aesay shaks kay samney humari aayaten parh ker sunai jati hain to woh pooray takabbur kay sath mun morr leta hai , jaisay unhen suna hi nahi , goya uss kay dono kanon mein behra-pann hai . lehaza uss ko aik dukh denay walay azab ki khushkhabri suna do .

verses.text: albatta jo log emaan ley aaye , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye unn kay liye naimaton kay baaghaat hain ,
verses.translation: albatta jo log emaan ley aaye , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye unn kay liye naimaton kay baaghaat hain ,

verses.text: jinn mein woh hamesha rahen gay . yeh Allah ka sacha wada hai , aur woh iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
verses.translation: jinn mein woh hamesha rahen gay . yeh Allah ka sacha wada hai , aur woh iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

verses.text: uss ney aasmano ko aesay sutonon kay baghair peda kiya jo tumhen nazar aa-saken ,   aur zameen mein paharon kay langar daal diye hain , takay woh tumhen ley ker dagmagaye nahi ,   aur uss mein her qisam kay janwer phela diye hain . aur hum ney aasman say paani barsaya , phir uss ( zameen ) mein her qabil-e-qadar qisam ki nabataat ugayen .
verses.translation: uss ney aasmano ko aesay sutonon kay baghair peda kiya jo tumhen nazar aa-saken ,   aur zameen mein paharon kay langar daal diye hain , takay woh tumhen ley ker dagmagaye nahi ,   aur uss mein her qisam kay janwer phela diye hain . aur hum ney aasman say paani barsaya , phir uss ( zameen ) mein her qabil-e-qadar qisam ki nabataat ugayen .

verses.text: yeh hai Allah ki takhleeq ! abb zara mujhay dikhao kay Allah kay siwa kissi ney kiya peda kiya-? baat darasal yeh hai kay yeh zalim log khuli gumrahi mein mubtala hain .
verses.translation: yeh hai Allah ki takhleeq ! abb zara mujhay dikhao kay Allah kay siwa kissi ney kiya peda kiya-? baat darasal yeh hai kay yeh zalim log khuli gumrahi mein mubtala hain .

verses.text: aur hum ney luqman ko danai ata ki thi ,   ( aur unn say kaha tha ) kay Allah ka shukar kertay raho .   aur jo koi Allah ka shukar ada-kerta hai , woh khud apney faeeday kay liye shukar kerta hai , aur agar koi nashukri keray to Allah bara bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef !
verses.translation: aur hum ney luqman ko danai ata ki thi ,   ( aur unn say kaha tha ) kay Allah ka shukar kertay raho .   aur jo koi Allah ka shukar ada-kerta hai , woh khud apney faeeday kay liye shukar kerta hai , aur agar koi nashukri keray to Allah bara bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef !

verses.text: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab luqman ney apney betay ko naseehat kertay huye kaha tha kay :  meray betay ! Allah kay sath shirk naa kerna . yaqeen jano shirk bara bhari zulm hai .

verses.text: aur hum ney insan ko apney walaiden kay baaray mein yeh takeed ki hai ( kiyonkay ) uss ki maa ney ussay kamzori per kamzori bardasht ker kay pet mein rakha , aur do saal mein uss ka doodh chootta hai kay tum mera shukar ada kero , aur apney maa baap ka .   meray paas hi ( tumhen ) loat ker aana hai .
verses.translation: aur hum ney insan ko apney walaiden kay baaray mein yeh takeed ki hai ( kiyonkay ) uss ki maa ney ussay kamzori per kamzori bardasht ker kay pet mein rakha , aur do saal mein uss ka doodh chootta hai kay tum mera shukar ada kero , aur apney maa baap ka .   meray paas hi ( tumhen ) loat ker aana hai .

verses.text: aur agar woh tum per yeh zor daalen kay tum meray sath kissi ko ( khudai mein ) shareek qarar do jiss ki tumharay paas koi daleel nahi to unn ki baat matt maano , aur duniya mein unn kay sath bhalai say raho ,   aur aesay shaks ka raasta apnao jiss ney mujh say lo laga rakhi ho .   phir tum sabb ko meray paas loat ker aana hai , uss waqt mein tumhen bataon ga kay tum kiya kertay rahey ho .
verses.translation: aur agar woh tum per yeh zor daalen kay tum meray sath kissi ko ( khudai mein ) shareek qarar do jiss ki tumharay paas koi daleel nahi to unn ki baat matt maano , aur duniya mein unn kay sath bhalai say raho ,   aur aesay shaks ka raasta apnao jiss ney mujh say lo laga rakhi ho .   phir tum sabb ko meray paas loat ker aana hai , uss waqt mein tumhen bataon ga kay tum kiya kertay rahey ho .

verses.text: . ( luqman ney yeh bhi kaha : )  beta ! agar koi cheez raai kay daney kay barabar bhi ho , aur woh kissi chatan mein ho , ya aasmano mein ya zameen mein , tab bhi Allah ussay hazir kerday ga . yaqeen jano Allah bara bareek-been , boht ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: . ( luqman ney yeh bhi kaha : )  beta ! agar koi cheez raai kay daney kay barabar bhi ho , aur woh kissi chatan mein ho , ya aasmano mein ya zameen mein , tab bhi Allah ussay hazir kerday ga . yaqeen jano Allah bara bareek-been , boht ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: beta ! namaz qaeem kero , aur logon  ko naiki ki talqeen kero , aur burai say roko , aur tumhen jo takleef paish aaye , uss per sabar kero . beyshak yeh bari himmat ka kaam hai .
verses.translation: beta ! namaz qaeem kero , aur logon  ko naiki ki talqeen kero , aur burai say roko , aur tumhen jo takleef paish aaye , uss per sabar kero . beyshak yeh bari himmat ka kaam hai .

verses.text: aur logon  kay samney ( ghuroor say ) apney gaal matt phulao , aur zameen per itratay huye matt chalo . yaqeen jano Allah kissi itraney walay shekhi baaz ko pasand nahi kerta .
verses.translation: aur logon  kay samney ( ghuroor say ) apney gaal matt phulao , aur zameen per itratay huye matt chalo . yaqeen jano Allah kissi itraney walay shekhi baaz ko pasand nahi kerta .

verses.text: aur apni chaal mein aetidaal ikhtiyar kero ,   aur apni aawaz aahista rakho .   beyshak sabb say buri aawaz gadhon ki aawaz hai .
verses.translation: aur apni chaal mein aetidaal ikhtiyar kero ,   aur apni aawaz aahista rakho .   beyshak sabb say buri aawaz gadhon ki aawaz hai .

verses.text: kiya tum logon  ney yeh nahi dekha kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , ussay Allah ney tumharay kaam mein laga rakha hai ,   aur tum per apni zahiri aur batni naimaten poori poori nichawar ki hain-? phir bhi insanon mein say kuch log hain jo Allah kay baaray mein behasen kertay hain , jabkay unn kay paas naa koi ilm hai , naa hidayat hai , aur naa koi aesi kitab hai jo roshni dikhaye .
verses.translation: kiya tum logon  ney yeh nahi dekha kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , ussay Allah ney tumharay kaam mein laga rakha hai ,   aur tum per apni zahiri aur batni naimaten poori poori nichawar ki hain-? phir bhi insanon mein say kuch log hain jo Allah kay baaray mein behasen kertay hain , jabkay unn kay paas naa koi ilm hai , naa hidayat hai , aur naa koi aesi kitab hai jo roshni dikhaye .

verses.text: aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay :  uss cheez ki ittaba kero jo Allah ney utaari hai  to woh kehtay hain :  nahi , balkay hum to uss tareeqay kay peechay chalen gay jiss per hum ney apney baap dadon ko paya hai .  bhala agar shetan unn ( baap dadon ) ko bharakti aag kay azab ki taraf bulata raha ho , kiya tab bhi ( woh unhi kay peechay chalen gay-? )
verses.translation: aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay :  uss cheez ki ittaba kero jo Allah ney utaari hai  to woh kehtay hain :  nahi , balkay hum to uss tareeqay kay peechay chalen gay jiss per hum ney apney baap dadon ko paya hai .  bhala agar shetan unn ( baap dadon ) ko bharakti aag kay azab ki taraf bulata raha ho , kiya tab bhi ( woh unhi kay peechay chalen gay-? )

verses.text: aur jo shaks farmanbardaar ban ker apna rukh Allah ki taraf kerday , aur naik amal kernay wala ho , to uss ney yaqeenan bara mazboot kunda thaam liya . aur tamam kamon ka aakhri anjam Allah hi kay hawalay hai .
verses.translation: aur jo shaks farmanbardaar ban ker apna rukh Allah ki taraf kerday , aur naik amal kernay wala ho , to uss ney yaqeenan bara mazboot kunda thaam liya . aur tamam kamon ka aakhri anjam Allah hi kay hawalay hai .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jiss kissi ney kufr apna liya hai , tumhen uss ka kufr sadmay mein naa daalay . aakhir unhen humaray paas hi to loattna hai , phir hum unhen batayen gay kay unhon ney kiya kiya hai ? yaqeenan Allah seenon mein chupi hoi baaton ko bhi khoob janta hai .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jiss kissi ney kufr apna liya hai , tumhen uss ka kufr sadmay mein naa daalay . aakhir unhen humaray paas hi to loattna hai , phir hum unhen batayen gay kay unhon ney kiya kiya hai ? yaqeenan Allah seenon mein chupi hoi baaton ko bhi khoob janta hai .

verses.text: hum unhen kuch mazay uraney ka moaqa dey rahey hain , phir hum unhen aik sakht azab ki taraf kheench kerlay jayen gay .
verses.translation: hum unhen kuch mazay uraney ka moaqa dey rahey hain , phir hum unhen aik sakht azab ki taraf kheench kerlay jayen gay .

verses.text: aur agar tum unn say poocho kay woh kon hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya hai ? to woh zaroor yeh kahen gay kay :  Allah !  kaho :  Alhamdulillah !  iss kay bawajood unn mein say aksar log samajh say kaam nahi letay .
verses.translation: aur agar tum unn say poocho kay woh kon hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya hai ? to woh zaroor yeh kahen gay kay :  Allah !  kaho :  Alhamdulillah !  iss kay bawajood unn mein say aksar log samajh say kaam nahi letay .

verses.text: Allah hi ka hai jo kuch aasmano aur zameen mein hai , beyshak Allah hi hai jo sabb say bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef .
verses.translation: Allah hi ka hai jo kuch aasmano aur zameen mein hai , beyshak Allah hi hai jo sabb say bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef .

verses.text: aur zameen mein jitney darkht hain , agar woh qalam ban jayen , aur yeh jo samandar hai , uss kay ilawa saat samandar uss kay sath aur mil jayen , ( aur woh roshnai ban ker Allah ki sifaat likhen ) tab bhi Allah ki baaten khatam nahi hon gi . haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
verses.translation: aur zameen mein jitney darkht hain , agar woh qalam ban jayen , aur yeh jo samandar hai , uss kay ilawa saat samandar uss kay sath aur mil jayen , ( aur woh roshnai ban ker Allah ki sifaat likhen ) tab bhi Allah ki baaten khatam nahi hon gi . haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

verses.text: tum sabb ko peda kerna aur dobara zinda kerna ( Allah kay liye ) aisa hi hai jaisay aik insan ko ( peda kerna aur dobara zinda kerna ) yaqeenan Allah her baat sunta , her cheez dekhta hai .
verses.translation: tum sabb ko peda kerna aur dobara zinda kerna ( Allah kay liye ) aisa hi hai jaisay aik insan ko ( peda kerna aur dobara zinda kerna ) yaqeenan Allah her baat sunta , her cheez dekhta hai .

verses.text: kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay Allah raat ko din mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur din ko raat mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur uss ney sooraj aur chaand ko kaam mein laga rakha hai kay her aik kissi mutayyan miyaad tak rawan dawan hai , aur ( kiya tumhen yeh maloom nahi ) kay Allah poori tarah ba-khabar hai kay tum kiya kertay ho-?
verses.translation: kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay Allah raat ko din mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur din ko raat mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur uss ney sooraj aur chaand ko kaam mein laga rakha hai kay her aik kissi mutayyan miyaad tak rawan dawan hai , aur ( kiya tumhen yeh maloom nahi ) kay Allah poori tarah ba-khabar hai kay tum kiya kertay ho-?

verses.text: yeh sabb kuch iss liye hai kay Allah hi ka wajood sacha hai , aur iss/uss kay siwa jinn ( maboodon ) ko yeh ( mushrik ) pukartay hain , woh bey buniyad hain , aur Allah hi woh hai jiss ki shaan boht oonchi hai , jiss ki zaat boht bari .
verses.translation: yeh sabb kuch iss liye hai kay Allah hi ka wajood sacha hai , aur iss/uss kay siwa jinn ( maboodon ) ko yeh ( mushrik ) pukartay hain , woh bey buniyad hain , aur Allah hi woh hai jiss ki shaan boht oonchi hai , jiss ki zaat boht bari .

verses.text: kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay kashtiyan samandar mein Allah ki meharbani say chalti hain , takay woh tumhen apni kuch nishaniyan dikhaye-? yaqeenan iss mein her uss shaks kay liye boht si nishaniyan hain jo sabar ka paka , aalaa darjay ka shukar guzaar ho .
verses.translation: kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay kashtiyan samandar mein Allah ki meharbani say chalti hain , takay woh tumhen apni kuch nishaniyan dikhaye-? yaqeenan iss mein her uss shaks kay liye boht si nishaniyan hain jo sabar ka paka , aalaa darjay ka shukar guzaar ho .

verses.text: aur jab mojen sayebanon ki tarah unn per charh aati hain to woh Allah ko iss tarah pukartay hain kay uss waqt unn ka aetiqaad khalis ussi per hota hai . phir jab woh unn ko bacha ker khushki per ley aata hai to unn mein say kuch hain jo raah-e-raast per rehtay hain ( baqi phir shirk kernay lagtay hain ) aur humari aayaton ka inkar wohi shaks kerta hai jo paka bad-ehad , perlay darjay ka nashukra ho .
verses.translation: aur jab mojen sayebanon ki tarah unn per charh aati hain to woh Allah ko iss tarah pukartay hain kay uss waqt unn ka aetiqaad khalis ussi per hota hai . phir jab woh unn ko bacha ker khushki per ley aata hai to unn mein say kuch hain jo raah-e-raast per rehtay hain ( baqi phir shirk kernay lagtay hain ) aur humari aayaton ka inkar wohi shaks kerta hai jo paka bad-ehad , perlay darjay ka nashukra ho .

verses.text: aey logo ! apney perwerdigar ( ki narazi ) say bacho , aur daro uss din say jab koi baap apney betay kay kaam nahi aaye ga , aur naa kissi betay ki yeh majal hogi kay woh apney baap kay zara bhi kaam aajaye . yaqeen jano kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , iss liye aisa hergiz naa honey paye kay yeh dunyawi zindagi tumhen dhokay mein daal dey , aur aisa hergiz naa honey paye kay woh ( shetan ) tumhen Allah kay moamlay mein dhokay mein daal dey jo sabb say bara dhoka baaz hai .
verses.translation: aey logo ! apney perwerdigar ( ki narazi ) say bacho , aur daro uss din say jab koi baap apney betay kay kaam nahi aaye ga , aur naa kissi betay ki yeh majal hogi kay woh apney baap kay zara bhi kaam aajaye . yaqeen jano kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , iss liye aisa hergiz naa honey paye kay yeh dunyawi zindagi tumhen dhokay mein daal dey , aur aisa hergiz naa honey paye kay woh ( shetan ) tumhen Allah kay moamlay mein dhokay mein daal dey jo sabb say bara dhoka baaz hai .

verses.text: yaqeenan ( qayamat ki ) gharri ka ilm Allah hi kay paas hai , wohi barish barsata hai , aur wohi janta hai kay maon kay pet mein kiya hai , aur kissi mutanaffas ko yeh pata nahi hai kay woh kal kiya kamaye ga , aur naa kissi mutanaffas ko yeh pata hai kay konsi zameen mein ussay moat aaye gi . beyshak Allah her cheez ka mukammal ilm rakhney wala , her baat say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: yaqeenan ( qayamat ki ) gharri ka ilm Allah hi kay paas hai , wohi barish barsata hai , aur wohi janta hai kay maon kay pet mein kiya hai , aur kissi mutanaffas ko yeh pata nahi hai kay woh kal kiya kamaye ga , aur naa kissi mutanaffas ko yeh pata hai kay konsi zameen mein ussay moat aaye gi . beyshak Allah her cheez ka mukammal ilm rakhney wala , her baat say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: kiya tum logon  ney yeh nahi dekha kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , ussay Allah ney tumharay kaam mein laga rakha hai ,   aur tum per apni zahiri aur batni naimaten poori poori nichawar ki hain-? phir bhi insanon mein say kuch log hain jo Allah kay baaray mein behasen kertay hain , jabkay unn kay paas naa koi ilm hai , naa hidayat hai , aur naa koi aesi kitab hai jo roshni dikhaye .
ayahs.translation: kiya tum logon  ney yeh nahi dekha kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , ussay Allah ney tumharay kaam mein laga rakha hai ,   aur tum per apni zahiri aur batni naimaten poori poori nichawar ki hain-? phir bhi insanon mein say kuch log hain jo Allah kay baaray mein behasen kertay hain , jabkay unn kay paas naa koi ilm hai , naa hidayat hai , aur naa koi aesi kitab hai jo roshni dikhaye .

ayahs.text: aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay :  uss cheez ki ittaba kero jo Allah ney utaari hai  to woh kehtay hain :  nahi , balkay hum to uss tareeqay kay peechay chalen gay jiss per hum ney apney baap dadon ko paya hai .  bhala agar shetan unn ( baap dadon ) ko bharakti aag kay azab ki taraf bulata raha ho , kiya tab bhi ( woh unhi kay peechay chalen gay-? )
ayahs.translation: aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay :  uss cheez ki ittaba kero jo Allah ney utaari hai  to woh kehtay hain :  nahi , balkay hum to uss tareeqay kay peechay chalen gay jiss per hum ney apney baap dadon ko paya hai .  bhala agar shetan unn ( baap dadon ) ko bharakti aag kay azab ki taraf bulata raha ho , kiya tab bhi ( woh unhi kay peechay chalen gay-? )

ayahs.text: aur jo shaks farmanbardaar ban ker apna rukh Allah ki taraf kerday , aur naik amal kernay wala ho , to uss ney yaqeenan bara mazboot kunda thaam liya . aur tamam kamon ka aakhri anjam Allah hi kay hawalay hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jo shaks farmanbardaar ban ker apna rukh Allah ki taraf kerday , aur naik amal kernay wala ho , to uss ney yaqeenan bara mazboot kunda thaam liya . aur tamam kamon ka aakhri anjam Allah hi kay hawalay hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jiss kissi ney kufr apna liya hai , tumhen uss ka kufr sadmay mein naa daalay . aakhir unhen humaray paas hi to loattna hai , phir hum unhen batayen gay kay unhon ney kiya kiya hai ? yaqeenan Allah seenon mein chupi hoi baaton ko bhi khoob janta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jiss kissi ney kufr apna liya hai , tumhen uss ka kufr sadmay mein naa daalay . aakhir unhen humaray paas hi to loattna hai , phir hum unhen batayen gay kay unhon ney kiya kiya hai ? yaqeenan Allah seenon mein chupi hoi baaton ko bhi khoob janta hai .

ayahs.text: hum unhen kuch mazay uraney ka moaqa dey rahey hain , phir hum unhen aik sakht azab ki taraf kheench kerlay jayen gay .
ayahs.translation: hum unhen kuch mazay uraney ka moaqa dey rahey hain , phir hum unhen aik sakht azab ki taraf kheench kerlay jayen gay .

ayahs.text: aur agar tum unn say poocho kay woh kon hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya hai ? to woh zaroor yeh kahen gay kay :  Allah !  kaho :  Alhamdulillah !  iss kay bawajood unn mein say aksar log samajh say kaam nahi letay .
ayahs.translation: aur agar tum unn say poocho kay woh kon hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya hai ? to woh zaroor yeh kahen gay kay :  Allah !  kaho :  Alhamdulillah !  iss kay bawajood unn mein say aksar log samajh say kaam nahi letay .

ayahs.text: Allah hi ka hai jo kuch aasmano aur zameen mein hai , beyshak Allah hi hai jo sabb say bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef .
ayahs.translation: Allah hi ka hai jo kuch aasmano aur zameen mein hai , beyshak Allah hi hai jo sabb say bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef .

ayahs.text: aur zameen mein jitney darkht hain , agar woh qalam ban jayen , aur yeh jo samandar hai , uss kay ilawa saat samandar uss kay sath aur mil jayen , ( aur woh roshnai ban ker Allah ki sifaat likhen ) tab bhi Allah ki baaten khatam nahi hon gi . haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
ayahs.translation: aur zameen mein jitney darkht hain , agar woh qalam ban jayen , aur yeh jo samandar hai , uss kay ilawa saat samandar uss kay sath aur mil jayen , ( aur woh roshnai ban ker Allah ki sifaat likhen ) tab bhi Allah ki baaten khatam nahi hon gi . haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

ayahs.text: tum sabb ko peda kerna aur dobara zinda kerna ( Allah kay liye ) aisa hi hai jaisay aik insan ko ( peda kerna aur dobara zinda kerna ) yaqeenan Allah her baat sunta , her cheez dekhta hai .
ayahs.translation: tum sabb ko peda kerna aur dobara zinda kerna ( Allah kay liye ) aisa hi hai jaisay aik insan ko ( peda kerna aur dobara zinda kerna ) yaqeenan Allah her baat sunta , her cheez dekhta hai .

ayahs.text: kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay Allah raat ko din mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur din ko raat mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur uss ney sooraj aur chaand ko kaam mein laga rakha hai kay her aik kissi mutayyan miyaad tak rawan dawan hai , aur ( kiya tumhen yeh maloom nahi ) kay Allah poori tarah ba-khabar hai kay tum kiya kertay ho-?
ayahs.translation: kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay Allah raat ko din mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur din ko raat mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur uss ney sooraj aur chaand ko kaam mein laga rakha hai kay her aik kissi mutayyan miyaad tak rawan dawan hai , aur ( kiya tumhen yeh maloom nahi ) kay Allah poori tarah ba-khabar hai kay tum kiya kertay ho-?

ayahs.text: yeh sabb kuch iss liye hai kay Allah hi ka wajood sacha hai , aur iss/uss kay siwa jinn ( maboodon ) ko yeh ( mushrik ) pukartay hain , woh bey buniyad hain , aur Allah hi woh hai jiss ki shaan boht oonchi hai , jiss ki zaat boht bari .
ayahs.translation: yeh sabb kuch iss liye hai kay Allah hi ka wajood sacha hai , aur iss/uss kay siwa jinn ( maboodon ) ko yeh ( mushrik ) pukartay hain , woh bey buniyad hain , aur Allah hi woh hai jiss ki shaan boht oonchi hai , jiss ki zaat boht bari .

ayahs.text: kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay kashtiyan samandar mein Allah ki meharbani say chalti hain , takay woh tumhen apni kuch nishaniyan dikhaye-? yaqeenan iss mein her uss shaks kay liye boht si nishaniyan hain jo sabar ka paka , aalaa darjay ka shukar guzaar ho .
ayahs.translation: kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay kashtiyan samandar mein Allah ki meharbani say chalti hain , takay woh tumhen apni kuch nishaniyan dikhaye-? yaqeenan iss mein her uss shaks kay liye boht si nishaniyan hain jo sabar ka paka , aalaa darjay ka shukar guzaar ho .

ayahs.text: aur jab mojen sayebanon ki tarah unn per charh aati hain to woh Allah ko iss tarah pukartay hain kay uss waqt unn ka aetiqaad khalis ussi per hota hai . phir jab woh unn ko bacha ker khushki per ley aata hai to unn mein say kuch hain jo raah-e-raast per rehtay hain ( baqi phir shirk kernay lagtay hain ) aur humari aayaton ka inkar wohi shaks kerta hai jo paka bad-ehad , perlay darjay ka nashukra ho .
ayahs.translation: aur jab mojen sayebanon ki tarah unn per charh aati hain to woh Allah ko iss tarah pukartay hain kay uss waqt unn ka aetiqaad khalis ussi per hota hai . phir jab woh unn ko bacha ker khushki per ley aata hai to unn mein say kuch hain jo raah-e-raast per rehtay hain ( baqi phir shirk kernay lagtay hain ) aur humari aayaton ka inkar wohi shaks kerta hai jo paka bad-ehad , perlay darjay ka nashukra ho .

ayahs.text: aey logo ! apney perwerdigar ( ki narazi ) say bacho , aur daro uss din say jab koi baap apney betay kay kaam nahi aaye ga , aur naa kissi betay ki yeh majal hogi kay woh apney baap kay zara bhi kaam aajaye . yaqeen jano kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , iss liye aisa hergiz naa honey paye kay yeh dunyawi zindagi tumhen dhokay mein daal dey , aur aisa hergiz naa honey paye kay woh ( shetan ) tumhen Allah kay moamlay mein dhokay mein daal dey jo sabb say bara dhoka baaz hai .
ayahs.translation: aey logo ! apney perwerdigar ( ki narazi ) say bacho , aur daro uss din say jab koi baap apney betay kay kaam nahi aaye ga , aur naa kissi betay ki yeh majal hogi kay woh apney baap kay zara bhi kaam aajaye . yaqeen jano kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , iss liye aisa hergiz naa honey paye kay yeh dunyawi zindagi tumhen dhokay mein daal dey , aur aisa hergiz naa honey paye kay woh ( shetan ) tumhen Allah kay moamlay mein dhokay mein daal dey jo sabb say bara dhoka baaz hai .

ayahs.text: yaqeenan ( qayamat ki ) gharri ka ilm Allah hi kay paas hai , wohi barish barsata hai , aur wohi janta hai kay maon kay pet mein kiya hai , aur kissi mutanaffas ko yeh pata nahi hai kay woh kal kiya kamaye ga , aur naa kissi mutanaffas ko yeh pata hai kay konsi zameen mein ussay moat aaye gi . beyshak Allah her cheez ka mukammal ilm rakhney wala , her baat say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
ayahs.translation: yaqeenan ( qayamat ki ) gharri ka ilm Allah hi kay paas hai , wohi barish barsata hai , aur wohi janta hai kay maon kay pet mein kiya hai , aur kissi mutanaffas ko yeh pata nahi hai kay woh kal kiya kamaye ga , aur naa kissi mutanaffas ko yeh pata hai kay konsi zameen mein ussay moat aaye gi . beyshak Allah her cheez ka mukammal ilm rakhney wala , her baat say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: Alif-Laam-Meem
verses.translation: Alif-Laam-Meem

verses.text: Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki taraf say yeh aik aesi kitab utaari jarahi hai jiss mein koi shak ki baat nahi hai .
verses.translation: Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki taraf say yeh aik aesi kitab utaari jarahi hai jiss mein koi shak ki baat nahi hai .

verses.text: kiya log yeh keh rahey hain kay payghumber ney issay khud gharr liya hai ? nahi ! ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh to woh haq hai jo tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say iss liye aaya hai kay tum iss kay zariye unn logon  ko khabrdar kero jinn kay paas tum say pehlay koi khabrdar kernay wala nahi aaya ,   takay woh sahih raastay per aajayen .
verses.translation: kiya log yeh keh rahey hain kay payghumber ney issay khud gharr liya hai ? nahi ! ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh to woh haq hai jo tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say iss liye aaya hai kay tum iss kay zariye unn logon  ko khabrdar kero jinn kay paas tum say pehlay koi khabrdar kernay wala nahi aaya ,   takay woh sahih raastay per aajayen .

verses.text: Allah woh hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko aur unn kay darmiyan sari cheezon ko cheh din mein peda kiya , phir uss ney arsh per istawa farmaya .   uss kay siwa naa tumhara koi rakhwala hai , naa koi sirfarishi .   kiya phir bhi tum kissi naseehat per dhiyan nahi detay-?
verses.translation: Allah woh hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko aur unn kay darmiyan sari cheezon ko cheh din mein peda kiya , phir uss ney arsh per istawa farmaya .   uss kay siwa naa tumhara koi rakhwala hai , naa koi sirfarishi .   kiya phir bhi tum kissi naseehat per dhiyan nahi detay-?

verses.text: woh aasman say ley ker zameen tak her kaam ka intizam khud kerta hai , phir woh kaam aik aesay din mein uss kay paas oopper phonch jata hai jiss ki miqdaar tumhari ginti kay hisab say aik hazar saal hoti hai .
verses.translation: woh aasman say ley ker zameen tak her kaam ka intizam khud kerta hai , phir woh kaam aik aesay din mein uss kay paas oopper phonch jata hai jiss ki miqdaar tumhari ginti kay hisab say aik hazar saal hoti hai .

verses.text: woh her chupi aur khuli cheez ka janney wala hai , jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki rehmat bhi kamil .
verses.translation: woh her chupi aur khuli cheez ka janney wala hai , jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki rehmat bhi kamil .

verses.text: uss ney jo cheez bhi peda ki , ussay khoob banaya , aur insan ki takhleeq ki ibtida garay say ki .
verses.translation: uss ney jo cheez bhi peda ki , ussay khoob banaya , aur insan ki takhleeq ki ibtida garay say ki .

verses.text: phir uss ki nasal aik nichoray huye haqeer paani say chalai .
verses.translation: phir uss ki nasal aik nichoray huye haqeer paani say chalai .

verses.text: phir ussay theek thaak ker kay uss mein apni rooh phoonki , aur ( insano ! ) tumharay liye kaan , aankhen aur dil peda kiye . tum log shukar thora hi kertay ho .
verses.translation: phir ussay theek thaak ker kay uss mein apni rooh phoonki , aur ( insano ! ) tumharay liye kaan , aankhen aur dil peda kiye . tum log shukar thora hi kertay ho .

verses.text: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  kiya jab hum zameen mein rull ker kho jayen gay , to kiya uss waqt hum kissi naye janam mein peda hon gay ?  baat darasal yeh hai kay yeh log apney perwerdigar say ja-milney ka inkar kertay hain .
verses.translation: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  kiya jab hum zameen mein rull ker kho jayen gay , to kiya uss waqt hum kissi naye janam mein peda hon gay ?  baat darasal yeh hai kay yeh log apney perwerdigar say ja-milney ka inkar kertay hain .

verses.text: keh do kay :  tumhen moat ka woh farishta poora poora wasool kerlay ga jo tum per muqarrar kiya gaya hai , phir tumhen wapis tumharay perwerdigar kay paas ley jaya jaye ga .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  tumhen moat ka woh farishta poora poora wasool kerlay ga jo tum per muqarrar kiya gaya hai , phir tumhen wapis tumharay perwerdigar kay paas ley jaya jaye ga .

verses.text: aur kaash tum woh manzar dekho jab yeh mujrim log apney rab kay samney sar jhukaye huye ( kharray ) hon gay , ( keh rahey hon gay kay : )  humaray perwerdigar ! humari aankhen aur humaray kaan khul gaye , iss liye hamen ( duniya mein ) dobara bhej dijiye , takay hum naik amal keren . hamen achi tarah yaqeen aa-chuka hai .
verses.translation: aur kaash tum woh manzar dekho jab yeh mujrim log apney rab kay samney sar jhukaye huye ( kharray ) hon gay , ( keh rahey hon gay kay : )  humaray perwerdigar ! humari aankhen aur humaray kaan khul gaye , iss liye hamen ( duniya mein ) dobara bhej dijiye , takay hum naik amal keren . hamen achi tarah yaqeen aa-chuka hai .

verses.text: aur agar hum chahtay to her shaks ko ( pehlay hi ) uss ki hidayat dey detay , lekin woh baat jo meri taraf say kahi gaee thi , tey hochuki hai kay :  mein jahannum ko jinnaat aur insanon sabb say zaroor bhar dun ga .
verses.translation: aur agar hum chahtay to her shaks ko ( pehlay hi ) uss ki hidayat dey detay , lekin woh baat jo meri taraf say kahi gaee thi , tey hochuki hai kay :  mein jahannum ko jinnaat aur insanon sabb say zaroor bhar dun ga .

verses.text: abb ( jahannum ka ) maza chakho kiyonkay tum ney apney iss din ka samna kernay ko bhula daala tha . hum ney ( bhi ) tumhen bhula diya hai . jo kuch tum kertay rahey ho , uss kay badlay abb hamesha kay azab ka maza chakhtay raho .
verses.translation: abb ( jahannum ka ) maza chakho kiyonkay tum ney apney iss din ka samna kernay ko bhula daala tha . hum ney ( bhi ) tumhen bhula diya hai . jo kuch tum kertay rahey ho , uss kay badlay abb hamesha kay azab ka maza chakhtay raho .

verses.text: humari aayaton per to woh log emaan latay hain jinn ka haal yeh hai kay jab unhen inn aayaton kay zariye naseehat ki jati hai to woh sajday mein gir parrtay hain , aur apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh kertay hain , aur woh takabbur nahi kertay .
verses.translation: humari aayaton per to woh log emaan latay hain jinn ka haal yeh hai kay jab unhen inn aayaton kay zariye naseehat ki jati hai to woh sajday mein gir parrtay hain , aur apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh kertay hain , aur woh takabbur nahi kertay .

verses.text: unn kay pehlo ( raat kay waqt ) apney bistaron say juda hotay hain   woh apney perwerdigar ko darr aur umeed ( kay milay jazbaat ) kay sath pukar rahey hotay hain ,   aur hum ney unn ko jo rizq diya hai , woh uss mein say ( naiki kay kamon mein ) kharch kertay hain .
verses.translation: unn kay pehlo ( raat kay waqt ) apney bistaron say juda hotay hain   woh apney perwerdigar ko darr aur umeed ( kay milay jazbaat ) kay sath pukar rahey hotay hain ,   aur hum ney unn ko jo rizq diya hai , woh uss mein say ( naiki kay kamon mein ) kharch kertay hain .

verses.text: chunacheh kissi mutanaffas ko kuch pata nahi hai kay aesay logon  kay liye aankhon ki thandak ka kiya saman unn kay aemal kay badlay mein chupa ker rakha gaya hai .
verses.translation: chunacheh kissi mutanaffas ko kuch pata nahi hai kay aesay logon  kay liye aankhon ki thandak ka kiya saman unn kay aemal kay badlay mein chupa ker rakha gaya hai .

verses.text: bhala batao kay jo shaks momin ho , kiya woh uss shaks kay barabar hojaye jo fasiq hai-? ( zahir hai kay ) woh barabar nahi hosaktay .
verses.translation: bhala batao kay jo shaks momin ho , kiya woh uss shaks kay barabar hojaye jo fasiq hai-? ( zahir hai kay ) woh barabar nahi hosaktay .

verses.text: chunacheh jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn kay liye mustaqil qayam kay baaghaat hain jo unn ko pehli mehmani hi kay tor per dey diye jayen gay , unn aemal kay silay mein jo woh kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: chunacheh jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn kay liye mustaqil qayam kay baaghaat hain jo unn ko pehli mehmani hi kay tor per dey diye jayen gay , unn aemal kay silay mein jo woh kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: rahey woh log jinhon ney nafarmani ki hai , to unn kay mustaqil qayam ki jagah jahannum hai . jab bhi woh uss say nikalna chahen gay , unhen wahin wapis loata diya jaye ga , aur unn say kaha jaye ga kay :  aag kay jiss azab ko tum jhutlaya kertay thay uss ka maza chakho .
verses.translation: rahey woh log jinhon ney nafarmani ki hai , to unn kay mustaqil qayam ki jagah jahannum hai . jab bhi woh uss say nikalna chahen gay , unhen wahin wapis loata diya jaye ga , aur unn say kaha jaye ga kay :  aag kay jiss azab ko tum jhutlaya kertay thay uss ka maza chakho .

verses.text: aur uss baray azab say pehlay bhi hum unhen kam darjay kay azab ka maza bhi zaroor chakhayen gay ,   shayad yeh baaz aajayen .
verses.translation: aur uss baray azab say pehlay bhi hum unhen kam darjay kay azab ka maza bhi zaroor chakhayen gay ,   shayad yeh baaz aajayen .

verses.text: aur uss say bara zalim kon hoga jiss ko apney perwerdigar ki aayaton kay zariye naseehat ki gaee , to uss ney unn say mun morr liya . hum yaqeenan aesay mujrimon say badla ley ker rahen gay .
verses.translation: aur uss say bara zalim kon hoga jiss ko apney perwerdigar ki aayaton kay zariye naseehat ki gaee , to uss ney unn say mun morr liya . hum yaqeenan aesay mujrimon say badla ley ker rahen gay .

verses.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney musa ko kitab di thi , lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum uss kay milney kay baaray mein kissi shak mein naa raho ,   aur hum ney uss kitab ko bano Israel kay liye hidayat banaya tha ,
verses.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney musa ko kitab di thi , lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum uss kay milney kay baaray mein kissi shak mein naa raho ,   aur hum ney uss kitab ko bano Israel kay liye hidayat banaya tha ,

verses.text: aur hum ney unn mein say kuch logon  ko , jab unhon ney sabar kiya , aesay peshwa bana diya jo humaray hukum say logon  ki rehnumai kertay thay , aur woh humari aayaton per yaqeen rakhtay thay .
verses.translation: aur hum ney unn mein say kuch logon  ko , jab unhon ney sabar kiya , aesay peshwa bana diya jo humaray hukum say logon  ki rehnumai kertay thay , aur woh humari aayaton per yaqeen rakhtay thay .

verses.text: yaqeenan tumhara perwerdigar hi qayamat kay din unn kay darmiyan unn baaton ka faisla keray ga jinn mein woh ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: yaqeenan tumhara perwerdigar hi qayamat kay din unn kay darmiyan unn baaton ka faisla keray ga jinn mein woh ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: aur kiya unn ( kafiron ) ko iss baat say koi hidayat nahi mili kay inn say pehlay kitni qoamon ko hum halak ker-chukay hain jinn kay gharon mein yeh khud chaltay phirtay hain-?   yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain . to kiya yeh log suntay nahi hain-?
verses.translation: aur kiya unn ( kafiron ) ko iss baat say koi hidayat nahi mili kay inn say pehlay kitni qoamon ko hum halak ker-chukay hain jinn kay gharon mein yeh khud chaltay phirtay hain-?   yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain . to kiya yeh log suntay nahi hain-?

verses.text: aur kiya enhon ney nahi dekha kay hum paani ko kheench ker khushk zameen ki taraf ley jatay hain , phir uss say woh kheti nikaltay hain jiss say unn kay chopaye bhi khatay hain , aur woh khud bhi . to kiya enhen kuch sujhai nahi deta-?
verses.translation: aur kiya enhon ney nahi dekha kay hum paani ko kheench ker khushk zameen ki taraf ley jatay hain , phir uss say woh kheti nikaltay hain jiss say unn kay chopaye bhi khatay hain , aur woh khud bhi . to kiya enhen kuch sujhai nahi deta-?

verses.translation: aur woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  agar tum sachay ho to yeh faisla kab hoga-?

verses.translation: keh do kay :  jiss din faisla hoga , uss din kafiron ko unn ka emaan lana kuch faeeda nahi dey ga , aur naa unhen koi mohlat di jaye gi .

verses.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn logon  ki perwa naa kero , aur intizar kero . yeh bhi intizar ker rahey hain .

ayahs.text: Alif-Laam-Meem
ayahs.translation: Alif-Laam-Meem

ayahs.text: Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki taraf say yeh aik aesi kitab utaari jarahi hai jiss mein koi shak ki baat nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki taraf say yeh aik aesi kitab utaari jarahi hai jiss mein koi shak ki baat nahi hai .

ayahs.text: kiya log yeh keh rahey hain kay payghumber ney issay khud gharr liya hai ? nahi ! ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh to woh haq hai jo tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say iss liye aaya hai kay tum iss kay zariye unn logon  ko khabrdar kero jinn kay paas tum say pehlay koi khabrdar kernay wala nahi aaya ,   takay woh sahih raastay per aajayen .
ayahs.translation: kiya log yeh keh rahey hain kay payghumber ney issay khud gharr liya hai ? nahi ! ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh to woh haq hai jo tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say iss liye aaya hai kay tum iss kay zariye unn logon  ko khabrdar kero jinn kay paas tum say pehlay koi khabrdar kernay wala nahi aaya ,   takay woh sahih raastay per aajayen .

ayahs.text: Allah woh hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko aur unn kay darmiyan sari cheezon ko cheh din mein peda kiya , phir uss ney arsh per istawa farmaya .   uss kay siwa naa tumhara koi rakhwala hai , naa koi sirfarishi .   kiya phir bhi tum kissi naseehat per dhiyan nahi detay-?
ayahs.translation: Allah woh hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko aur unn kay darmiyan sari cheezon ko cheh din mein peda kiya , phir uss ney arsh per istawa farmaya .   uss kay siwa naa tumhara koi rakhwala hai , naa koi sirfarishi .   kiya phir bhi tum kissi naseehat per dhiyan nahi detay-?

ayahs.text: woh aasman say ley ker zameen tak her kaam ka intizam khud kerta hai , phir woh kaam aik aesay din mein uss kay paas oopper phonch jata hai jiss ki miqdaar tumhari ginti kay hisab say aik hazar saal hoti hai .
ayahs.translation: woh aasman say ley ker zameen tak her kaam ka intizam khud kerta hai , phir woh kaam aik aesay din mein uss kay paas oopper phonch jata hai jiss ki miqdaar tumhari ginti kay hisab say aik hazar saal hoti hai .

ayahs.text: woh her chupi aur khuli cheez ka janney wala hai , jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki rehmat bhi kamil .
ayahs.translation: woh her chupi aur khuli cheez ka janney wala hai , jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki rehmat bhi kamil .

ayahs.text: uss ney jo cheez bhi peda ki , ussay khoob banaya , aur insan ki takhleeq ki ibtida garay say ki .
ayahs.translation: uss ney jo cheez bhi peda ki , ussay khoob banaya , aur insan ki takhleeq ki ibtida garay say ki .

ayahs.text: phir uss ki nasal aik nichoray huye haqeer paani say chalai .
ayahs.translation: phir uss ki nasal aik nichoray huye haqeer paani say chalai .

ayahs.text: phir ussay theek thaak ker kay uss mein apni rooh phoonki , aur ( insano ! ) tumharay liye kaan , aankhen aur dil peda kiye . tum log shukar thora hi kertay ho .
ayahs.translation: phir ussay theek thaak ker kay uss mein apni rooh phoonki , aur ( insano ! ) tumharay liye kaan , aankhen aur dil peda kiye . tum log shukar thora hi kertay ho .

ayahs.text: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  kiya jab hum zameen mein rull ker kho jayen gay , to kiya uss waqt hum kissi naye janam mein peda hon gay ?  baat darasal yeh hai kay yeh log apney perwerdigar say ja-milney ka inkar kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  kiya jab hum zameen mein rull ker kho jayen gay , to kiya uss waqt hum kissi naye janam mein peda hon gay ?  baat darasal yeh hai kay yeh log apney perwerdigar say ja-milney ka inkar kertay hain .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  tumhen moat ka woh farishta poora poora wasool kerlay ga jo tum per muqarrar kiya gaya hai , phir tumhen wapis tumharay perwerdigar kay paas ley jaya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  tumhen moat ka woh farishta poora poora wasool kerlay ga jo tum per muqarrar kiya gaya hai , phir tumhen wapis tumharay perwerdigar kay paas ley jaya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur kaash tum woh manzar dekho jab yeh mujrim log apney rab kay samney sar jhukaye huye ( kharray ) hon gay , ( keh rahey hon gay kay : )  humaray perwerdigar ! humari aankhen aur humaray kaan khul gaye , iss liye hamen ( duniya mein ) dobara bhej dijiye , takay hum naik amal keren . hamen achi tarah yaqeen aa-chuka hai .
ayahs.translation: aur kaash tum woh manzar dekho jab yeh mujrim log apney rab kay samney sar jhukaye huye ( kharray ) hon gay , ( keh rahey hon gay kay : )  humaray perwerdigar ! humari aankhen aur humaray kaan khul gaye , iss liye hamen ( duniya mein ) dobara bhej dijiye , takay hum naik amal keren . hamen achi tarah yaqeen aa-chuka hai .

ayahs.text: aur agar hum chahtay to her shaks ko ( pehlay hi ) uss ki hidayat dey detay , lekin woh baat jo meri taraf say kahi gaee thi , tey hochuki hai kay :  mein jahannum ko jinnaat aur insanon sabb say zaroor bhar dun ga .
ayahs.translation: aur agar hum chahtay to her shaks ko ( pehlay hi ) uss ki hidayat dey detay , lekin woh baat jo meri taraf say kahi gaee thi , tey hochuki hai kay :  mein jahannum ko jinnaat aur insanon sabb say zaroor bhar dun ga .

ayahs.text: abb ( jahannum ka ) maza chakho kiyonkay tum ney apney iss din ka samna kernay ko bhula daala tha . hum ney ( bhi ) tumhen bhula diya hai . jo kuch tum kertay rahey ho , uss kay badlay abb hamesha kay azab ka maza chakhtay raho .
ayahs.translation: abb ( jahannum ka ) maza chakho kiyonkay tum ney apney iss din ka samna kernay ko bhula daala tha . hum ney ( bhi ) tumhen bhula diya hai . jo kuch tum kertay rahey ho , uss kay badlay abb hamesha kay azab ka maza chakhtay raho .

ayahs.text: humari aayaton per to woh log emaan latay hain jinn ka haal yeh hai kay jab unhen inn aayaton kay zariye naseehat ki jati hai to woh sajday mein gir parrtay hain , aur apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh kertay hain , aur woh takabbur nahi kertay .
ayahs.translation: humari aayaton per to woh log emaan latay hain jinn ka haal yeh hai kay jab unhen inn aayaton kay zariye naseehat ki jati hai to woh sajday mein gir parrtay hain , aur apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh kertay hain , aur woh takabbur nahi kertay .

ayahs.text: unn kay pehlo ( raat kay waqt ) apney bistaron say juda hotay hain   woh apney perwerdigar ko darr aur umeed ( kay milay jazbaat ) kay sath pukar rahey hotay hain ,   aur hum ney unn ko jo rizq diya hai , woh uss mein say ( naiki kay kamon mein ) kharch kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: unn kay pehlo ( raat kay waqt ) apney bistaron say juda hotay hain   woh apney perwerdigar ko darr aur umeed ( kay milay jazbaat ) kay sath pukar rahey hotay hain ,   aur hum ney unn ko jo rizq diya hai , woh uss mein say ( naiki kay kamon mein ) kharch kertay hain .

ayahs.text: chunacheh kissi mutanaffas ko kuch pata nahi hai kay aesay logon  kay liye aankhon ki thandak ka kiya saman unn kay aemal kay badlay mein chupa ker rakha gaya hai .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh kissi mutanaffas ko kuch pata nahi hai kay aesay logon  kay liye aankhon ki thandak ka kiya saman unn kay aemal kay badlay mein chupa ker rakha gaya hai .

ayahs.text: bhala batao kay jo shaks momin ho , kiya woh uss shaks kay barabar hojaye jo fasiq hai-? ( zahir hai kay ) woh barabar nahi hosaktay .
ayahs.translation: bhala batao kay jo shaks momin ho , kiya woh uss shaks kay barabar hojaye jo fasiq hai-? ( zahir hai kay ) woh barabar nahi hosaktay .

ayahs.text: chunacheh jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn kay liye mustaqil qayam kay baaghaat hain jo unn ko pehli mehmani hi kay tor per dey diye jayen gay , unn aemal kay silay mein jo woh kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn kay liye mustaqil qayam kay baaghaat hain jo unn ko pehli mehmani hi kay tor per dey diye jayen gay , unn aemal kay silay mein jo woh kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: rahey woh log jinhon ney nafarmani ki hai , to unn kay mustaqil qayam ki jagah jahannum hai . jab bhi woh uss say nikalna chahen gay , unhen wahin wapis loata diya jaye ga , aur unn say kaha jaye ga kay :  aag kay jiss azab ko tum jhutlaya kertay thay uss ka maza chakho .
ayahs.translation: rahey woh log jinhon ney nafarmani ki hai , to unn kay mustaqil qayam ki jagah jahannum hai . jab bhi woh uss say nikalna chahen gay , unhen wahin wapis loata diya jaye ga , aur unn say kaha jaye ga kay :  aag kay jiss azab ko tum jhutlaya kertay thay uss ka maza chakho .

ayahs.text: aur uss baray azab say pehlay bhi hum unhen kam darjay kay azab ka maza bhi zaroor chakhayen gay ,   shayad yeh baaz aajayen .
ayahs.translation: aur uss baray azab say pehlay bhi hum unhen kam darjay kay azab ka maza bhi zaroor chakhayen gay ,   shayad yeh baaz aajayen .

ayahs.text: aur uss say bara zalim kon hoga jiss ko apney perwerdigar ki aayaton kay zariye naseehat ki gaee , to uss ney unn say mun morr liya . hum yaqeenan aesay mujrimon say badla ley ker rahen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur uss say bara zalim kon hoga jiss ko apney perwerdigar ki aayaton kay zariye naseehat ki gaee , to uss ney unn say mun morr liya . hum yaqeenan aesay mujrimon say badla ley ker rahen gay .

ayahs.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney musa ko kitab di thi , lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum uss kay milney kay baaray mein kissi shak mein naa raho ,   aur hum ney uss kitab ko bano Israel kay liye hidayat banaya tha ,
ayahs.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney musa ko kitab di thi , lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum uss kay milney kay baaray mein kissi shak mein naa raho ,   aur hum ney uss kitab ko bano Israel kay liye hidayat banaya tha ,

ayahs.text: aur hum ney unn mein say kuch logon  ko , jab unhon ney sabar kiya , aesay peshwa bana diya jo humaray hukum say logon  ki rehnumai kertay thay , aur woh humari aayaton per yaqeen rakhtay thay .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney unn mein say kuch logon  ko , jab unhon ney sabar kiya , aesay peshwa bana diya jo humaray hukum say logon  ki rehnumai kertay thay , aur woh humari aayaton per yaqeen rakhtay thay .

ayahs.text: yaqeenan tumhara perwerdigar hi qayamat kay din unn kay darmiyan unn baaton ka faisla keray ga jinn mein woh ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: yaqeenan tumhara perwerdigar hi qayamat kay din unn kay darmiyan unn baaton ka faisla keray ga jinn mein woh ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: aur kiya unn ( kafiron ) ko iss baat say koi hidayat nahi mili kay inn say pehlay kitni qoamon ko hum halak ker-chukay hain jinn kay gharon mein yeh khud chaltay phirtay hain-?   yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain . to kiya yeh log suntay nahi hain-?
ayahs.translation: aur kiya unn ( kafiron ) ko iss baat say koi hidayat nahi mili kay inn say pehlay kitni qoamon ko hum halak ker-chukay hain jinn kay gharon mein yeh khud chaltay phirtay hain-?   yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain . to kiya yeh log suntay nahi hain-?

ayahs.translation: aur kiya enhon ney nahi dekha kay hum paani ko kheench ker khushk zameen ki taraf ley jatay hain , phir uss say woh kheti nikaltay hain jiss say unn kay chopaye bhi khatay hain , aur woh khud bhi . to kiya enhen kuch sujhai nahi deta-?

ayahs.text: aur woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  agar tum sachay ho to yeh faisla kab hoga-?
ayahs.translation: aur woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  agar tum sachay ho to yeh faisla kab hoga-?

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  jiss din faisla hoga , uss din kafiron ko unn ka emaan lana kuch faeeda nahi dey ga , aur naa unhen koi mohlat di jaye gi .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  jiss din faisla hoga , uss din kafiron ko unn ka emaan lana kuch faeeda nahi dey ga , aur naa unhen koi mohlat di jaye gi .

ayahs.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn logon  ki perwa naa kero , aur intizar kero . yeh bhi intizar ker rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn logon  ki perwa naa kero , aur intizar kero . yeh bhi intizar ker rahey hain .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: aey nabi ! Allah say dartay raho , aur kafiron aur munafiqon ka kehna matt maano .   beyshak Allah boht ilm wala , bara hikmat wala hai .
verses.translation: aey nabi ! Allah say dartay raho , aur kafiron aur munafiqon ka kehna matt maano .   beyshak Allah boht ilm wala , bara hikmat wala hai .

verses.text: aur tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say tum per jo wahi bheji jarahi hai uss ki perwi kero , tum jo kuch kertay ho , Allah yaqeeni tor per uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: aur tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say tum per jo wahi bheji jarahi hai uss ki perwi kero , tum jo kuch kertay ho , Allah yaqeeni tor per uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: aur Allah per bharosa rakho , aur kaam bananey kay liye Allah bilkul kafi hai .
verses.translation: aur Allah per bharosa rakho , aur kaam bananey kay liye Allah bilkul kafi hai .

verses.text: Allah ney kissi bhi shaks kay seenay mein do dil peda nahi kiye ,   aur tum apni jinn biwiyon ko maa ki pusht say tashbeeh de detay ho , unn ko tumhari maa nahi banaya ,   aur naa tumharay mun bolay beton ko tumhara haqeeqi beta qarar diya hai . yeh to baaten hi baaten hain jo tum apney mun say keh detay ho , aur Allah wohi baat kehta hai jo haq ho , aur wohi sahih raasta batlata hai .
verses.translation: Allah ney kissi bhi shaks kay seenay mein do dil peda nahi kiye ,   aur tum apni jinn biwiyon ko maa ki pusht say tashbeeh de detay ho , unn ko tumhari maa nahi banaya ,   aur naa tumharay mun bolay beton ko tumhara haqeeqi beta qarar diya hai . yeh to baaten hi baaten hain jo tum apney mun say keh detay ho , aur Allah wohi baat kehta hai jo haq ho , aur wohi sahih raasta batlata hai .

verses.text: tum inn ( mun bolay beton ) ko inn kay apney baapon kay naam say pukara kero .   yehi tareeqa Allah kay nazdeek pooray insaf ka hai . aur agar tumhen unn kay baap maloom naa hon , to woh tumharay deeni bhai aur tumharay dost hain .   aur tum say jo ghalati hojaye uss ki wajeh say tum per koi gunah nahi hoga , albatta jo baat tum apney dilon say jaan boojh ker kero , ( uss per gunah hai . ) beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: tum inn ( mun bolay beton ) ko inn kay apney baapon kay naam say pukara kero .   yehi tareeqa Allah kay nazdeek pooray insaf ka hai . aur agar tumhen unn kay baap maloom naa hon , to woh tumharay deeni bhai aur tumharay dost hain .   aur tum say jo ghalati hojaye uss ki wajeh say tum per koi gunah nahi hoga , albatta jo baat tum apney dilon say jaan boojh ker kero , ( uss per gunah hai . ) beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: emaan walon kay liye yeh nabi unn ki apni janon say bhi ziyada qareeb tarr hain , aur inn ki biwiyan unn ki mayen hain . iss kay bawajood Allah ki kitab kay mutabiq pet kay rishta daar doosray mominon aur mohajreen kay muqablay mein aik doosray per ( meeras kay moamlay mein ) ziyada haq rakhtay hain ,   illa yeh kay tum apney doston ( kay haq mein koi wasiyyat ker kay unn ) kay sath koi naiki kerlo . yeh baat kitab mein likhi hoi hai .
verses.translation: emaan walon kay liye yeh nabi unn ki apni janon say bhi ziyada qareeb tarr hain , aur inn ki biwiyan unn ki mayen hain . iss kay bawajood Allah ki kitab kay mutabiq pet kay rishta daar doosray mominon aur mohajreen kay muqablay mein aik doosray per ( meeras kay moamlay mein ) ziyada haq rakhtay hain ,   illa yeh kay tum apney doston ( kay haq mein koi wasiyyat ker kay unn ) kay sath koi naiki kerlo . yeh baat kitab mein likhi hoi hai .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) woh waqt yaad rakho jab hum ney tamam nabiyon say ehad liya tha , aur tum say bhi , aur nooh aur Ibrahim aur musa aur essa ibn-e-maryam say bhi . aur hum ney unn say nihayat pukhta ehad liya tha .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) woh waqt yaad rakho jab hum ney tamam nabiyon say ehad liya tha , aur tum say bhi , aur nooh aur Ibrahim aur musa aur essa ibn-e-maryam say bhi . aur hum ney unn say nihayat pukhta ehad liya tha .

verses.text: takay Allah sachay logon  say unn ki sachai kay baaray mein poochay .   aur uss ney kafiron kay liye to aik dardnak azab tayyar ker rakha hai .
verses.translation: takay Allah sachay logon  say unn ki sachai kay baaray mein poochay .   aur uss ney kafiron kay liye to aik dardnak azab tayyar ker rakha hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! yaad kero Allah ney uss waqt tum per kaisa inaam kiya jab tum per boht say lashkar charh aaye thay , phir hum ney unn per aik aandhi bhi bheji , aur aesay lashkar bhi jo tumhen nazar nahi aatay thay .   aur tum jo kuch ker rahey thay , Allah uss ko dekh raha tha .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! yaad kero Allah ney uss waqt tum per kaisa inaam kiya jab tum per boht say lashkar charh aaye thay , phir hum ney unn per aik aandhi bhi bheji , aur aesay lashkar bhi jo tumhen nazar nahi aatay thay .   aur tum jo kuch ker rahey thay , Allah uss ko dekh raha tha .

verses.text: yaad kero jab woh tum per tumharay oopper say bhi charh aaye thay aur tumharay neechay say bhi ,   aur jab aankhen pathra gaee then , aur kalejay mun ko aagaye thay , aur tum Allah kay baaray mein tarah tarah ki baaten sochney lagay thay .
verses.translation: yaad kero jab woh tum per tumharay oopper say bhi charh aaye thay aur tumharay neechay say bhi ,   aur jab aankhen pathra gaee then , aur kalejay mun ko aagaye thay , aur tum Allah kay baaray mein tarah tarah ki baaten sochney lagay thay .

verses.text: uss moaqa per emaan walon ki bari aazmaesh hoi , aur unhen aik sakht bhonchal mein daal ker hella daala gaya .
verses.translation: uss moaqa per emaan walon ki bari aazmaesh hoi , aur unhen aik sakht bhonchal mein daal ker hella daala gaya .

verses.text: aur yaad kero jab munafiqeen aur woh log jinn kay dilon mein rog hai , yeh keh rahey thay kay :  Allah aur uss kay Rasool ney hum say jo wada kiya hai , woh dhokay kay siwa kuch nahi .
verses.translation: aur yaad kero jab munafiqeen aur woh log jinn kay dilon mein rog hai , yeh keh rahey thay kay :  Allah aur uss kay Rasool ney hum say jo wada kiya hai , woh dhokay kay siwa kuch nahi .

verses.text: aur jab unhi mein say kuch logon  ney kaha tha kay :  yasrab kay logo ! tumharay liye yahan thehrney ka koi moaqa nahi hai , bus wapis loat jao .  aur unhi mein say kuch log nabi say yeh keh ker ( ghar janey ki ) ijazat maang rahey thay kay :  humaray ghar ghair mehfooz hain    halankay woh ghair mehfooz nahi thay , balkay unn ka maqsad sirf yeh tha kay ( kissi tarah ) bhag kharray hon .
verses.translation: aur jab unhi mein say kuch logon  ney kaha tha kay :  yasrab kay logo ! tumharay liye yahan thehrney ka koi moaqa nahi hai , bus wapis loat jao .  aur unhi mein say kuch log nabi say yeh keh ker ( ghar janey ki ) ijazat maang rahey thay kay :  humaray ghar ghair mehfooz hain    halankay woh ghair mehfooz nahi thay , balkay unn ka maqsad sirf yeh tha kay ( kissi tarah ) bhag kharray hon .

verses.text: aur agar dushman madiney mein chaaron taraf say aa-ghusay , phir unn say fasad mein shamil honey ko kaha jaye to yeh uss mein zaroor shamil hojayen gay , aur ( uss waqt ) gharon mein thoray hi thehren gay .
verses.translation: aur agar dushman madiney mein chaaron taraf say aa-ghusay , phir unn say fasad mein shamil honey ko kaha jaye to yeh uss mein zaroor shamil hojayen gay , aur ( uss waqt ) gharon mein thoray hi thehren gay .

verses.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay enhon ney Allah say pehlay yeh ehad ker rakha tha kay woh peeth pher ker nahi jayen gay . aur Allah say kiye huye ehad ki baaz purs zaroor ho ker rahey gi .
verses.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay enhon ney Allah say pehlay yeh ehad ker rakha tha kay woh peeth pher ker nahi jayen gay . aur Allah say kiye huye ehad ki baaz purs zaroor ho ker rahey gi .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) keh do kay :  agar tum moat say ya qatal say bhag bhi jao to yeh bhagna tumhen koi faeeda nahi dey ga , aur uss soorat mein tumhen ( zindagi ka ) lutf uthaney ka jo moaqa diya jaye ga , woh thora hi saa hoga .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) keh do kay :  agar tum moat say ya qatal say bhag bhi jao to yeh bhagna tumhen koi faeeda nahi dey ga , aur uss soorat mein tumhen ( zindagi ka ) lutf uthaney ka jo moaqa diya jaye ga , woh thora hi saa hoga .

verses.text: kaho kay :  kon hai jo tumhen Allah say bacha sakay , agar woh tumhen koi burai phonchaney ka irada kerlay , ya ( woh kon hai jo uss ki rehmat ko rok sakay , ) agar woh tum per rehmat kernay ka irada kerlay-?  aur Allah kay siwa inn logon  ko naa koi rakhwala mil sakta hai , naa koi madadgaar .
verses.translation: kaho kay :  kon hai jo tumhen Allah say bacha sakay , agar woh tumhen koi burai phonchaney ka irada kerlay , ya ( woh kon hai jo uss ki rehmat ko rok sakay , ) agar woh tum per rehmat kernay ka irada kerlay-?  aur Allah kay siwa inn logon  ko naa koi rakhwala mil sakta hai , naa koi madadgaar .

verses.text: Allah tum mein say unn logon  ko khoob janta hai jo ( jihad mein ) rukawat daaltay hain , aur apney bhaiyon say kehtay hain kay :  humaray paas chalay aao    aur khud larraee mein aatay nahi , aur aatay hain to boht kam .
verses.translation: Allah tum mein say unn logon  ko khoob janta hai jo ( jihad mein ) rukawat daaltay hain , aur apney bhaiyon say kehtay hain kay :  humaray paas chalay aao    aur khud larraee mein aatay nahi , aur aatay hain to boht kam .

verses.text: . ( aur woh bhi ) tumharay sath lalach rakhtay huye .   chunacheh jab khatray ka moaqa aajata hai to woh tumhari taraf chakrai hoi aankhon say iss tarah dekhtay hain jaisay kissi per moat ki ghashi taari horahi ho . phir jab khatra door hojata hai to tumharay samney maal ki hirs mein tez tez zabanen chalatay hain .   yeh log hergiz emaan nahi laye hain , iss liye Allah ney inn kay aemal zaya kerdiye hain . aur yeh baat Allah kay liye boht aasaan hai .
verses.translation: . ( aur woh bhi ) tumharay sath lalach rakhtay huye .   chunacheh jab khatray ka moaqa aajata hai to woh tumhari taraf chakrai hoi aankhon say iss tarah dekhtay hain jaisay kissi per moat ki ghashi taari horahi ho . phir jab khatra door hojata hai to tumharay samney maal ki hirs mein tez tez zabanen chalatay hain .   yeh log hergiz emaan nahi laye hain , iss liye Allah ney inn kay aemal zaya kerdiye hain . aur yeh baat Allah kay liye boht aasaan hai .

verses.text: woh yeh samajh rahey hain kay ( dushmanon kay ) lashkar abhi gaye nahi hain . aur agar woh lashkar ( dobara ) aajayen to inn ki khuwaish yeh hogi kay woh dehaat mein jaker rahen , ( aur wahin bethay huye ) tumhari khabren maloom kertay rahen . aur agar tumharay darmiyan rahey bhi to larraee mein thora hi hissa len gay .
verses.translation: woh yeh samajh rahey hain kay ( dushmanon kay ) lashkar abhi gaye nahi hain . aur agar woh lashkar ( dobara ) aajayen to inn ki khuwaish yeh hogi kay woh dehaat mein jaker rahen , ( aur wahin bethay huye ) tumhari khabren maloom kertay rahen . aur agar tumharay darmiyan rahey bhi to larraee mein thora hi hissa len gay .

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay tumharay liye Rasool Allah ki zaat mein aik behtareen namoona hai , her uss shaks kay liye jo Allah say aur yoam-e-aakhirat say umeed rakhta ho , aur kasrat say Allah ka ziker kerta ho .
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay tumharay liye Rasool Allah ki zaat mein aik behtareen namoona hai , her uss shaks kay liye jo Allah say aur yoam-e-aakhirat say umeed rakhta ho , aur kasrat say Allah ka ziker kerta ho .

verses.text: aur jo log emaan rakhtay hain , jab unhon ney ( dushman kay ) lashkaron ko dekha tha to unhon ney yeh kaha tha kay :  yeh wohi baat hai jiss ka wada Allah aur uss kay Rasool ney hum say kiya tha , aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ney sach kaha tha .  aur iss waqaey ney unn kay emaan aur tabey daari kay jazbay mein aur izafa kerdiya tha .
verses.translation: aur jo log emaan rakhtay hain , jab unhon ney ( dushman kay ) lashkaron ko dekha tha to unhon ney yeh kaha tha kay :  yeh wohi baat hai jiss ka wada Allah aur uss kay Rasool ney hum say kiya tha , aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ney sach kaha tha .  aur iss waqaey ney unn kay emaan aur tabey daari kay jazbay mein aur izafa kerdiya tha .

verses.text: inhi emaan walon mein woh log bhi hain jinhon ney Allah say jo ehad kiya tha , ussay sacha ker dikhaya . phir unn mein say kuch woh hain jinhon ney apna nazrana poora kerdiya , aur kuch woh hain jo abhi intizar mein hain ,   aur unhon ney ( apney iradon mein ) zara si bhi tabdeeli nahi ki .
verses.translation: inhi emaan walon mein woh log bhi hain jinhon ney Allah say jo ehad kiya tha , ussay sacha ker dikhaya . phir unn mein say kuch woh hain jinhon ney apna nazrana poora kerdiya , aur kuch woh hain jo abhi intizar mein hain ,   aur unhon ney ( apney iradon mein ) zara si bhi tabdeeli nahi ki .

verses.text: . ( yeh waqiaa iss liye huwa ) takay Allah sachon ko unn ki sachai ka inaam dey , aur munafiqon ko agar chahye to azab dey , ya unn ki tauba qubool kerlay .   Allah yaqeenan boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: . ( yeh waqiaa iss liye huwa ) takay Allah sachon ko unn ki sachai ka inaam dey , aur munafiqon ko agar chahye to azab dey , ya unn ki tauba qubool kerlay .   Allah yaqeenan boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: aur jo log kafir thay , Allah ney unhen unn kay saray ghaiz o ghazab kay sath iss tarah puspa kerdiya kay woh koi faeeda hasil naa ker-sakay . aur mominon ki taraf say larraee kay liye Allah khud kafi hogaya . aur Allah bari quooat ka , baray iqtidar ka malik hai .
verses.translation: aur jo log kafir thay , Allah ney unhen unn kay saray ghaiz o ghazab kay sath iss tarah puspa kerdiya kay woh koi faeeda hasil naa ker-sakay . aur mominon ki taraf say larraee kay liye Allah khud kafi hogaya . aur Allah bari quooat ka , baray iqtidar ka malik hai .

verses.text: aur jinn ehal-e-kitab ney inn ( dushmanon ) ki madad ki thi , unhen Allah unn kay qalon say neechay utaar laya ,   aur unn kay dilon mein aisa roab daal diya kay ( aey musalmano ! ) unn mein say kuch ko tum qatal ker rahey thay , aur kuch ko qedi bana rahey thay .
verses.translation: aur jinn ehal-e-kitab ney inn ( dushmanon ) ki madad ki thi , unhen Allah unn kay qalon say neechay utaar laya ,   aur unn kay dilon mein aisa roab daal diya kay ( aey musalmano ! ) unn mein say kuch ko tum qatal ker rahey thay , aur kuch ko qedi bana rahey thay .

verses.text: aur Allah ney tumhen unn ki zameen ka , unn kay gharon ka aur unn ki dolat ka waris bana diya , aur aik aesi zameen ka bhi jiss tak abhi tumharay qadam nahi phonchay   aur Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai .
verses.translation: aur Allah ney tumhen unn ki zameen ka , unn kay gharon ka aur unn ki dolat ka waris bana diya , aur aik aesi zameen ka bhi jiss tak abhi tumharay qadam nahi phonchay   aur Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai .

verses.text: aey nabi ! apni biwiyon say kaho kay :  agar tum dunyawi zindagi aur uss ki zeenat chahti ho to aao , mein tumhen kuch tohfay dey ker khoobsurti kay sath rukhsat kerdun .
verses.translation: aey nabi ! apni biwiyon say kaho kay :  agar tum dunyawi zindagi aur uss ki zeenat chahti ho to aao , mein tumhen kuch tohfay dey ker khoobsurti kay sath rukhsat kerdun .

verses.text: aur agar tum Allah aur uss kay Rasool aur aalam-e-aakhirat ki talabgaar ho , to yaqeen jano Allah ney tum mein say naik khawateen kay liye shandaar inaam tayyar ker rakha hai .
verses.translation: aur agar tum Allah aur uss kay Rasool aur aalam-e-aakhirat ki talabgaar ho , to yaqeen jano Allah ney tum mein say naik khawateen kay liye shandaar inaam tayyar ker rakha hai .

verses.text: aey nabi ki biwiyo ! tum mein say jo koi kissi khuli beyhoodgi ka irtikab keray gi , uss ka azab barha ker do guna kerdiya jaye ga , aur Allah kay liye aisa kerna boht aasaan hai .
verses.translation: aey nabi ki biwiyo ! tum mein say jo koi kissi khuli beyhoodgi ka irtikab keray gi , uss ka azab barha ker do guna kerdiya jaye ga , aur Allah kay liye aisa kerna boht aasaan hai .

verses.text: aur tum mein say jo koi Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki tabey daar rahey gi , aur naik amal keray gi , ussay hum uss ka sawab bhi do guna den gay , aur uss kay liye hum ney ba-izzat rizq tayyar ker rakha hai .
verses.translation: aur tum mein say jo koi Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki tabey daar rahey gi , aur naik amal keray gi , ussay hum uss ka sawab bhi do guna den gay , aur uss kay liye hum ney ba-izzat rizq tayyar ker rakha hai .

verses.text: aey nabi ki biwiyo ! agar tum taqwa ikhtiyar kero to tum aam aurton ki tarah nahi ho .   lehaza tum nazakat kay sath baat matt kiya kero , kabhi koi aisa shaks beyja lalach kernay lagay jiss kay dil mein rog hota hai , aur baat woh kaho jo bhalai wali ho .
verses.translation: aey nabi ki biwiyo ! agar tum taqwa ikhtiyar kero to tum aam aurton ki tarah nahi ho .   lehaza tum nazakat kay sath baat matt kiya kero , kabhi koi aisa shaks beyja lalach kernay lagay jiss kay dil mein rog hota hai , aur baat woh kaho jo bhalai wali ho .

verses.text: aur apney gharon mein qarar kay sath raho ,   aur ( ghair mardon ko ) banao singhaar dikhati naa phiro , jaisa kay pehli jahiliyat mein dikhaya jata tha ,   aur namaz qaeem kero , aur zakat ada kero , aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki farmanbardaari kero . aey nabi kay ahl-e-bait ! yani ( ghar walo )   Allah to yeh chahta hai kay tum say gandagi ko door rakhay , aur tumhen aesi pakeezgi ata keray jo her tarah mukammal ho .
verses.translation: aur apney gharon mein qarar kay sath raho ,   aur ( ghair mardon ko ) banao singhaar dikhati naa phiro , jaisa kay pehli jahiliyat mein dikhaya jata tha ,   aur namaz qaeem kero , aur zakat ada kero , aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki farmanbardaari kero . aey nabi kay ahl-e-bait ! yani ( ghar walo )   Allah to yeh chahta hai kay tum say gandagi ko door rakhay , aur tumhen aesi pakeezgi ata keray jo her tarah mukammal ho .

verses.text: aur tumharay gharon mein Allah ki jo aayaten aur hikmat ki jo baaten sunai jati hain , unn ko yaad rakho . yaqeen jano Allah boht bareek-been aur her baat say ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: aur tumharay gharon mein Allah ki jo aayaten aur hikmat ki jo baaten sunai jati hain , unn ko yaad rakho . yaqeen jano Allah boht bareek-been aur her baat say ba-khabar hai .
