verses.text: beyshak farmanbardaar mard hon ya farmanbardaar aurten ,   momin mard hon ya momin aurten , ibadat guzaar mard hon ya ibadat guzaar aurten , sachay mard hon ya sachi aurten , sabir mard hon ya sabir aurten , dil say jhukney walay mard hon ya dil say jhukney wali aurten ,   sadqa kernay walay mard hon ya sadqa kernay wali aurten , roza daar mard hon ya roza daar aurten , apni sharmgahon ki hifazat kernay walay mard hon ya hifazat kernay wali aurten , aur Allah ka kasrat say ziker kernay walay mard hon ya ziker kernay wali aurten , inn sabb kay liye Allah ney maghfirat aur shandaar ajar tayyar ker rakha hai .
verses.translation: beyshak farmanbardaar mard hon ya farmanbardaar aurten ,   momin mard hon ya momin aurten , ibadat guzaar mard hon ya ibadat guzaar aurten , sachay mard hon ya sachi aurten , sabir mard hon ya sabir aurten , dil say jhukney walay mard hon ya dil say jhukney wali aurten ,   sadqa kernay walay mard hon ya sadqa kernay wali aurten , roza daar mard hon ya roza daar aurten , apni sharmgahon ki hifazat kernay walay mard hon ya hifazat kernay wali aurten , aur Allah ka kasrat say ziker kernay walay mard hon ya ziker kernay wali aurten , inn sabb kay liye Allah ney maghfirat aur shandaar ajar tayyar ker rakha hai .

verses.text: aur jab Allah aur uss ka Rasool kissi baat ka hatmi faisla kerden to naa kissi momin mard kay liye yeh gunjaeesh hai naa kissi momin aurat kay liye kay unn ko apney moamlay mein koi ikhtiyar baqi rahey .   aur jiss kissi ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki nafarmani ki , woh khuli gumrahi mein parr-gaya .
verses.translation: aur jab Allah aur uss ka Rasool kissi baat ka hatmi faisla kerden to naa kissi momin mard kay liye yeh gunjaeesh hai naa kissi momin aurat kay liye kay unn ko apney moamlay mein koi ikhtiyar baqi rahey .   aur jiss kissi ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki nafarmani ki , woh khuli gumrahi mein parr-gaya .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) yaad kero jab tum uss shaks say jiss per Allah ney bhi ehsan kiya tha , aur tum ney bhi ehsan kiya tha ,   yeh keh rahey thay kay :  apni biwi ko apney nikah mein rehney do , aur Allah say daro    aur tum apney dil mein woh baat chupaye huye thay jissay Allah khol denay wala tha ,   aur tum logon  say dartay thay , halankay Allah iss baat ka ziyada haq daar hai kay tum uss say daro . phir jab zaid ney apni biwi say talluq khatam kerliya to hum ney uss say tumhara nikah keradiya , takay musalmanon kay liye apney mun bolay beton ki biwiyon ( say nikah kernay ) mein uss waqt koi tangi naa rahey jab unhon ney apni biwiyon say talluq khatam kerliya ho . aur Allah ney jo hukum diya tha , uss per amal to ho ker rehna hi tha .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) yaad kero jab tum uss shaks say jiss per Allah ney bhi ehsan kiya tha , aur tum ney bhi ehsan kiya tha ,   yeh keh rahey thay kay :  apni biwi ko apney nikah mein rehney do , aur Allah say daro    aur tum apney dil mein woh baat chupaye huye thay jissay Allah khol denay wala tha ,   aur tum logon  say dartay thay , halankay Allah iss baat ka ziyada haq daar hai kay tum uss say daro . phir jab zaid ney apni biwi say talluq khatam kerliya to hum ney uss say tumhara nikah keradiya , takay musalmanon kay liye apney mun bolay beton ki biwiyon ( say nikah kernay ) mein uss waqt koi tangi naa rahey jab unhon ney apni biwiyon say talluq khatam kerliya ho . aur Allah ney jo hukum diya tha , uss per amal to ho ker rehna hi tha .

verses.text: nabi kay liye uss kaam mein aetraz ki koi baat nahi hoti jo Allah ney uss kay liye tey kerdiya ho . yehi Allah ki woh sunnat hai jiss per unn ( anbiya ) kay moamlay mein bhi amal hota aaya hai jo pehlay guzar chukay hain . aur Allah ka faisla napa tula muqaddar hota hai .
verses.translation: nabi kay liye uss kaam mein aetraz ki koi baat nahi hoti jo Allah ney uss kay liye tey kerdiya ho . yehi Allah ki woh sunnat hai jiss per unn ( anbiya ) kay moamlay mein bhi amal hota aaya hai jo pehlay guzar chukay hain . aur Allah ka faisla napa tula muqaddar hota hai .

verses.text: payghumber woh log hain jo Allah kay bhejay huye ehkaam ko logon  tak phonchatay hain , aur ussi say dartay hain , aur Allah kay siwa kissi say nahi dartay . aur hisab lenay kay liye Allah ko kissi ki zaroorat nahi .
verses.translation: payghumber woh log hain jo Allah kay bhejay huye ehkaam ko logon  tak phonchatay hain , aur ussi say dartay hain , aur Allah kay siwa kissi say nahi dartay . aur hisab lenay kay liye Allah ko kissi ki zaroorat nahi .

verses.text: . ( musalmano ! ) Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) tum mardon mein say kissi kay baap nahi hain , lekin woh Allah kay Rasool hain , aur tamam nabiyon mein sabb say aakhri nabi hain .   aur Allah her baat ko khoob janney wala hai .
verses.translation: . ( musalmano ! ) Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) tum mardon mein say kissi kay baap nahi hain , lekin woh Allah kay Rasool hain , aur tamam nabiyon mein sabb say aakhri nabi hain .   aur Allah her baat ko khoob janney wala hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah ko khoob kasrat say yaad kiya kero ,
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah ko khoob kasrat say yaad kiya kero ,

verses.text: aur subha o shaam uss ki tasbeeh kero .
verses.translation: aur subha o shaam uss ki tasbeeh kero .

verses.text: wohi hai jo khud bhi tum per rehmat bhejta hai , aur uss kay farishtay bhi , takay woh tumhen andheron say nikal ker roshni mein ley aaye , aur woh mominon per boht meharban hai .
verses.translation: wohi hai jo khud bhi tum per rehmat bhejta hai , aur uss kay farishtay bhi , takay woh tumhen andheron say nikal ker roshni mein ley aaye , aur woh mominon per boht meharban hai .

verses.text: jiss din momin log Allah say milen gay uss din unn ka istaqbal salam say hoga , aur Allah ney unn kay liye ba-izzat inaam tayyar ker rakha hai .
verses.translation: jiss din momin log Allah say milen gay uss din unn ka istaqbal salam say hoga , aur Allah ney unn kay liye ba-izzat inaam tayyar ker rakha hai .

verses.text: aey nabi ! beyshak hum ney tumhen aisa bana ker bheja hai kay tum gawahi denay walay , khushkhabri sunaney walay aur khabrdar kernay walay ho ,
verses.translation: aey nabi ! beyshak hum ney tumhen aisa bana ker bheja hai kay tum gawahi denay walay , khushkhabri sunaney walay aur khabrdar kernay walay ho ,

verses.text: aur Allah kay hukum say logon  ko Allah ki taraf bulaney walay , aur roshni phelaney walay chiragh ho .
verses.translation: aur Allah kay hukum say logon  ko Allah ki taraf bulaney walay , aur roshni phelaney walay chiragh ho .

verses.text: tum mominon ko khushkhabri suna do kay unn per Allah ki taraf say bara fazal honey wala hai ,
verses.translation: tum mominon ko khushkhabri suna do kay unn per Allah ki taraf say bara fazal honey wala hai ,

verses.text: aur kafiron aur munafiqon ki baat naa maano , aur unn ki taraf say jo takleef phonchay , uss ki perwa naa kero , aur Allah per bharosa kiye raho , aur Allah rakhwala banney kay liye kafi hai .
verses.translation: aur kafiron aur munafiqon ki baat naa maano , aur unn ki taraf say jo takleef phonchay , uss ki perwa naa kero , aur Allah per bharosa kiye raho , aur Allah rakhwala banney kay liye kafi hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! jab tum ney momin aurton say nikah kiya ho , phir tum ney unhen chooney say pehlay hi talaq dey di ho , to unn kay zimmay tumhari koi iddat wajib nahi hai jiss ki ginti tumhen shumar kerni ho .   lehaza unhen kuch tohfa dey do ,   aur unhen khoobsurti say rukhsat kerdo .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! jab tum ney momin aurton say nikah kiya ho , phir tum ney unhen chooney say pehlay hi talaq dey di ho , to unn kay zimmay tumhari koi iddat wajib nahi hai jiss ki ginti tumhen shumar kerni ho .   lehaza unhen kuch tohfa dey do ,   aur unhen khoobsurti say rukhsat kerdo .

verses.text: aey nabi ! hum ney tumharay liye tumhari woh biwiyan halal kerdi hain jinn ko tum ney unn ka mehar ada kerdiya hai .   neez Allah ney ghaneemat ka jo maal tumhen ata kiya hai , uss mein say jo kaneezen tumhari milkiyat mein aa-chuki hain woh bhi ( tumharay liye halal hain ) aur tumhari woh chacha ki betiyan aur phoopiyon ki betiyan aur mamoo ki betiyan aur khalaon ki betiyan bhi jinhon ney tumharay sath hijrat ki hai ,   neez koi musalman aurat jiss ney mehar kay baghair nabi ko apney aap ( say nikah kernay ) ki paishkash ki ho ,   ba-shartey-kay nabi uss say nikah kerna chahye . yeh saray ehkaam khaas tumharay liye hain , doosray mominon kay liye nahi . hamen woh ehkaam khoob maloom hain jo hum ney unn ki biwiyon aur kaneezon kay baaray mein unn per aaeed kiye hain , ( aur tumhen unn say mustasna kiya hai ) takay tum per koi tangi naa rahey , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: aey nabi ! hum ney tumharay liye tumhari woh biwiyan halal kerdi hain jinn ko tum ney unn ka mehar ada kerdiya hai .   neez Allah ney ghaneemat ka jo maal tumhen ata kiya hai , uss mein say jo kaneezen tumhari milkiyat mein aa-chuki hain woh bhi ( tumharay liye halal hain ) aur tumhari woh chacha ki betiyan aur phoopiyon ki betiyan aur mamoo ki betiyan aur khalaon ki betiyan bhi jinhon ney tumharay sath hijrat ki hai ,   neez koi musalman aurat jiss ney mehar kay baghair nabi ko apney aap ( say nikah kernay ) ki paishkash ki ho ,   ba-shartey-kay nabi uss say nikah kerna chahye . yeh saray ehkaam khaas tumharay liye hain , doosray mominon kay liye nahi . hamen woh ehkaam khoob maloom hain jo hum ney unn ki biwiyon aur kaneezon kay baaray mein unn per aaeed kiye hain , ( aur tumhen unn say mustasna kiya hai ) takay tum per koi tangi naa rahey , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala bara meharban hai .

verses.text: unn biwiyon mein say tum jiss ki baari chahao multawi kerdo , aur jiss ko chahao , apney paas rakho , aur jinn ko tum ney alag kerdiya ho unn mein say agar kissi ko wapis bulana chahao to uss mein bhi tumharay liye koi gunah nahi hai .   iss tareeqay mein iss baat ki ziyada tawaqqo hai kay unn sabb ki aankhen thandi rahen gi , aur unhen ranj nahi hoga , aur tum unhen jo kuch dey do gay , uss per woh sabb ki sabb razi rahen gi .   aur Allah unn sabb baaton ko janta hai jo tumharay dilon mein hain , aur Allah ilm aur hilm ka malik hai .
verses.translation: unn biwiyon mein say tum jiss ki baari chahao multawi kerdo , aur jiss ko chahao , apney paas rakho , aur jinn ko tum ney alag kerdiya ho unn mein say agar kissi ko wapis bulana chahao to uss mein bhi tumharay liye koi gunah nahi hai .   iss tareeqay mein iss baat ki ziyada tawaqqo hai kay unn sabb ki aankhen thandi rahen gi , aur unhen ranj nahi hoga , aur tum unhen jo kuch dey do gay , uss per woh sabb ki sabb razi rahen gi .   aur Allah unn sabb baaton ko janta hai jo tumharay dilon mein hain , aur Allah ilm aur hilm ka malik hai .

verses.text: iss kay baad doosri aurten tumharay liye halal nahi hain , aur naa yeh jaeez hai kay tum unn kay badlay koi doosri biwiyan ley aao , chahye unn ki khoobi tumhen pasand aai ho ,   albatta jo kaneezen tumhari milkiyat mein hon , ( woh tumharay liye halal hain , ) aur Allah her cheez ki poori nigrani kernay wala hai .
verses.translation: iss kay baad doosri aurten tumharay liye halal nahi hain , aur naa yeh jaeez hai kay tum unn kay badlay koi doosri biwiyan ley aao , chahye unn ki khoobi tumhen pasand aai ho ,   albatta jo kaneezen tumhari milkiyat mein hon , ( woh tumharay liye halal hain , ) aur Allah her cheez ki poori nigrani kernay wala hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! nabi kay gharon mein ( bila ijazat ) dakhil naa ho , illa yeh kay tumhen khaney per aaney ki ijazat dey di jaye , woh bhi iss tarah kay tum uss khaney ki tayyari kay intizar mein naa bethay raho , lekin jab tumhen dawat di jaye to jao , phir jab khana kha chuko to apni apni raah lo , aur baaton mein ji laga ker naa betho .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay iss baat say nabi ko takleef phonchti hai , aur woh tum say ( kehtay huye ) sharmatay hain , aur Allah haq baat mein kissi say nahi sharmata . aur jab tumhen nabi ki biwiyon say kuch maangna ho to perday kay peechay say maango .   yeh tareeqa tumharay dilon ko bhi aur unn kay dilon ko bhi ziyada pakeezah rakhney ka zariya hoga . aur tumharay liye jaeez nahi hai kay tum Allah kay Rasool ko takleef phonchao , aur naa yeh jaeez hai kay unn kay baad unn ki biwiyon say kabhi bhi nikah kero . yeh Allah kay nazdeek bari sangeen baat hai .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! nabi kay gharon mein ( bila ijazat ) dakhil naa ho , illa yeh kay tumhen khaney per aaney ki ijazat dey di jaye , woh bhi iss tarah kay tum uss khaney ki tayyari kay intizar mein naa bethay raho , lekin jab tumhen dawat di jaye to jao , phir jab khana kha chuko to apni apni raah lo , aur baaton mein ji laga ker naa betho .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay iss baat say nabi ko takleef phonchti hai , aur woh tum say ( kehtay huye ) sharmatay hain , aur Allah haq baat mein kissi say nahi sharmata . aur jab tumhen nabi ki biwiyon say kuch maangna ho to perday kay peechay say maango .   yeh tareeqa tumharay dilon ko bhi aur unn kay dilon ko bhi ziyada pakeezah rakhney ka zariya hoga . aur tumharay liye jaeez nahi hai kay tum Allah kay Rasool ko takleef phonchao , aur naa yeh jaeez hai kay unn kay baad unn ki biwiyon say kabhi bhi nikah kero . yeh Allah kay nazdeek bari sangeen baat hai .

verses.text: chahye tum koi baat zahir kero , ya ussay chupao , Allah her cheez ka poora poora ilm rakhney wala hai .
verses.translation: chahye tum koi baat zahir kero , ya ussay chupao , Allah her cheez ka poora poora ilm rakhney wala hai .

verses.text: nabi ki biwiyon kay liye apney apney baap ( kay samney bey perda aaney ) mein koi gunah nahi hai , naa apney beton kay , naa apney bhaiyon kay , naa apney bhateejon kay , naa apney bhanjon kay , aur naa apni aurton kay ,   aur naa apni kaneezon kay ( samney aaney mein koi gunah hai . ) aur ( aey khawateen ! ) tum Allah say darti raho . yaqeen jano kay Allah her baat ka mushaeeda kernay wala hai .
verses.translation: nabi ki biwiyon kay liye apney apney baap ( kay samney bey perda aaney ) mein koi gunah nahi hai , naa apney beton kay , naa apney bhaiyon kay , naa apney bhateejon kay , naa apney bhanjon kay , aur naa apni aurton kay ,   aur naa apni kaneezon kay ( samney aaney mein koi gunah hai . ) aur ( aey khawateen ! ) tum Allah say darti raho . yaqeen jano kay Allah her baat ka mushaeeda kernay wala hai .

verses.text: beyshak Allah aur uss kay farishtay nabi per durood bhejtay hain . aey emaan walo ! tum bhi unn per durood bhejo , aur khoob salam bheja kero .
verses.translation: beyshak Allah aur uss kay farishtay nabi per durood bhejtay hain . aey emaan walo ! tum bhi unn per durood bhejo , aur khoob salam bheja kero .

verses.text: jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool ko takleef phonchatay hain , Allah ney duniya aur aakhirat mein unn per lanat ki hai , aur unn kay liye aisa azab tayyar ker rakha hai jo zaleel ker kay rakh dey ga .
verses.translation: jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool ko takleef phonchatay hain , Allah ney duniya aur aakhirat mein unn per lanat ki hai , aur unn kay liye aisa azab tayyar ker rakha hai jo zaleel ker kay rakh dey ga .

verses.text: aur jo log momin mardon aur momin aurton ko unn kay kissi jurm kay baghair takleef phonchatay hain , unhon ney bohtan tarazi aur khulay gunah ka bojh apney oopper laad liya hai .
verses.translation: aur jo log momin mardon aur momin aurton ko unn kay kissi jurm kay baghair takleef phonchatay hain , unhon ney bohtan tarazi aur khulay gunah ka bojh apney oopper laad liya hai .

verses.text: aey nabi ! tum apni biwiyon , apni betiyon aur musalmanon ki aurton say keh do kay woh apni chadaren apney ( mun kay ) oopper jhuka liya keren .   iss tareeqay mein iss baat ki ziyada tawaqqo hai kay woh pehchan li jayen gi , to unn ko sataya nahi jaye ga .   aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: aey nabi ! tum apni biwiyon , apni betiyon aur musalmanon ki aurton say keh do kay woh apni chadaren apney ( mun kay ) oopper jhuka liya keren .   iss tareeqay mein iss baat ki ziyada tawaqqo hai kay woh pehchan li jayen gi , to unn ko sataya nahi jaye ga .   aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: agar woh log baaz naa aaye jo munafiq hain , jinn kay dilon mein rog hai aur jo shehar mein shar-angez afwahen phelatay hain , to hum zaroor aisa keren gay kay tum unn kay khilaf uth kharray hogay , phir woh uss shehar mein tumharay sath nahi reh saken gay , albatta thoray din
verses.translation: agar woh log baaz naa aaye jo munafiq hain , jinn kay dilon mein rog hai aur jo shehar mein shar-angez afwahen phelatay hain , to hum zaroor aisa keren gay kay tum unn kay khilaf uth kharray hogay , phir woh uss shehar mein tumharay sath nahi reh saken gay , albatta thoray din

verses.text: jinn mein woh phitkaray huye hon gay . ( phir ) jahan kahen milen gay , pakar liye jayen gay , aur unhen aik aik ker kay qatal kerdiya jaye ga .
verses.translation: jinn mein woh phitkaray huye hon gay . ( phir ) jahan kahen milen gay , pakar liye jayen gay , aur unhen aik aik ker kay qatal kerdiya jaye ga .

verses.text: yeh Allah ka woh mamool hai jiss per unn logon  kay moamlay mein bhi amal hota raha hai jo pehlay guzar chukay hain . aur tum Allah kay mamool mein koi tabdeeli hergiz nahi pao gay .
verses.translation: yeh Allah ka woh mamool hai jiss per unn logon  kay moamlay mein bhi amal hota raha hai jo pehlay guzar chukay hain . aur tum Allah kay mamool mein koi tabdeeli hergiz nahi pao gay .

verses.text: log tum say qayamat kay baaray mein poochtay hain . keh do kay uss ka ilm to Allah hi kay paas hai . aur tumhen kiya pata shayad qayamat qareeb hi aagae ho .
verses.translation: log tum say qayamat kay baaray mein poochtay hain . keh do kay uss ka ilm to Allah hi kay paas hai . aur tumhen kiya pata shayad qayamat qareeb hi aagae ho .

verses.text: iss mein koi shak nahi kay Allah ney kafiron ko rehmat say door kerdiya hai , aur unn kay liye bharakti hoi aag tayyar ki hai ,
verses.translation: iss mein koi shak nahi kay Allah ney kafiron ko rehmat say door kerdiya hai , aur unn kay liye bharakti hoi aag tayyar ki hai ,

verses.text: jiss mein woh hamesha iss tarah rahen gay kay unhen naa koi himayati mil sakay ga , aur naa koi madadgaar .
verses.translation: jiss mein woh hamesha iss tarah rahen gay kay unhen naa koi himayati mil sakay ga , aur naa koi madadgaar .

verses.text: jiss din unn kay chehron ko aag mein ulta palta jaye ga , woh kahen gay kay :  aey kaash ! hum ney Allah ki itaat kerli hoti , aur Rasool ka kehna maan liya hota !
verses.translation: jiss din unn kay chehron ko aag mein ulta palta jaye ga , woh kahen gay kay :  aey kaash ! hum ney Allah ki itaat kerli hoti , aur Rasool ka kehna maan liya hota !

verses.text: aur kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney apney sardaron aur apney baron ka kehna maana , aur unhon ney hamen raastay say bhatka diya .
verses.translation: aur kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney apney sardaron aur apney baron ka kehna maana , aur unhon ney hamen raastay say bhatka diya .

verses.text: aey humaray perwerdigar ! unn ko dugna azab dey , aur unn per aesi lanat ker jo bari bhari lanat ho .
verses.translation: aey humaray perwerdigar ! unn ko dugna azab dey , aur unn per aesi lanat ker jo bari bhari lanat ho .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! unn logon  ki tarah naa ban jana jinhon ney musa ko sataya tha , phir Allah ney unn ko unn baaton say bari kerdiya jo unn logon  ney banai then .   aur woh Allah kay nazdeek baray rutbay walay thay .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! unn logon  ki tarah naa ban jana jinhon ney musa ko sataya tha , phir Allah ney unn ko unn baaton say bari kerdiya jo unn logon  ney banai then .   aur woh Allah kay nazdeek baray rutbay walay thay .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah say daro , aur seedhi sachi baat kaha kero ,
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah say daro , aur seedhi sachi baat kaha kero ,

verses.text: Allah tumharay faeeday kay liye tumharay kaam sanwaar dey ga , aur tumharay gunahon ki maghfirat kerday ga . aur jo shaks Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki itaat keray , uss ney woh kamiyabi hasil kerli jo zabardast kamiyabi hai .
verses.translation: Allah tumharay faeeday kay liye tumharay kaam sanwaar dey ga , aur tumharay gunahon ki maghfirat kerday ga . aur jo shaks Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki itaat keray , uss ney woh kamiyabi hasil kerli jo zabardast kamiyabi hai .

verses.text: hum ney yeh amanat aasmano aur zameen aur paharon per paish ki , to unhon ney uss kay uthaney say inkar kiya , aur uss say darr gaye , aur insan ney uss ka bojh utha liya .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh bara zalim , bara nadan hai .
verses.translation: hum ney yeh amanat aasmano aur zameen aur paharon per paish ki , to unhon ney uss kay uthaney say inkar kiya , aur uss say darr gaye , aur insan ney uss ka bojh utha liya .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh bara zalim , bara nadan hai .

verses.text: nateeja yeh hai kay Allah munafiq mardon aur munafiq aurton ko , neez mushrik mardon aur mushrik aurton ko azab dey ga , aur momin mardon aur momin aurton per rehmat kay sath tawajjah farmaye ga . aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: nateeja yeh hai kay Allah munafiq mardon aur munafiq aurton ko , neez mushrik mardon aur mushrik aurton ko azab dey ga , aur momin mardon aur momin aurton per rehmat kay sath tawajjah farmaye ga . aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: aey nabi ! Allah say dartay raho , aur kafiron aur munafiqon ka kehna matt maano .   beyshak Allah boht ilm wala , bara hikmat wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aey nabi ! Allah say dartay raho , aur kafiron aur munafiqon ka kehna matt maano .   beyshak Allah boht ilm wala , bara hikmat wala hai .

ayahs.text: aur tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say tum per jo wahi bheji jarahi hai uss ki perwi kero , tum jo kuch kertay ho , Allah yaqeeni tor per uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
ayahs.translation: aur tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say tum per jo wahi bheji jarahi hai uss ki perwi kero , tum jo kuch kertay ho , Allah yaqeeni tor per uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

ayahs.text: aur Allah per bharosa rakho , aur kaam bananey kay liye Allah bilkul kafi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah per bharosa rakho , aur kaam bananey kay liye Allah bilkul kafi hai .

ayahs.text: Allah ney kissi bhi shaks kay seenay mein do dil peda nahi kiye ,   aur tum apni jinn biwiyon ko maa ki pusht say tashbeeh de detay ho , unn ko tumhari maa nahi banaya ,   aur naa tumharay mun bolay beton ko tumhara haqeeqi beta qarar diya hai . yeh to baaten hi baaten hain jo tum apney mun say keh detay ho , aur Allah wohi baat kehta hai jo haq ho , aur wohi sahih raasta batlata hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney kissi bhi shaks kay seenay mein do dil peda nahi kiye ,   aur tum apni jinn biwiyon ko maa ki pusht say tashbeeh de detay ho , unn ko tumhari maa nahi banaya ,   aur naa tumharay mun bolay beton ko tumhara haqeeqi beta qarar diya hai . yeh to baaten hi baaten hain jo tum apney mun say keh detay ho , aur Allah wohi baat kehta hai jo haq ho , aur wohi sahih raasta batlata hai .

ayahs.text: tum inn ( mun bolay beton ) ko inn kay apney baapon kay naam say pukara kero .   yehi tareeqa Allah kay nazdeek pooray insaf ka hai . aur agar tumhen unn kay baap maloom naa hon , to woh tumharay deeni bhai aur tumharay dost hain .   aur tum say jo ghalati hojaye uss ki wajeh say tum per koi gunah nahi hoga , albatta jo baat tum apney dilon say jaan boojh ker kero , ( uss per gunah hai . ) beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: tum inn ( mun bolay beton ) ko inn kay apney baapon kay naam say pukara kero .   yehi tareeqa Allah kay nazdeek pooray insaf ka hai . aur agar tumhen unn kay baap maloom naa hon , to woh tumharay deeni bhai aur tumharay dost hain .   aur tum say jo ghalati hojaye uss ki wajeh say tum per koi gunah nahi hoga , albatta jo baat tum apney dilon say jaan boojh ker kero , ( uss per gunah hai . ) beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: emaan walon kay liye yeh nabi unn ki apni janon say bhi ziyada qareeb tarr hain , aur inn ki biwiyan unn ki mayen hain . iss kay bawajood Allah ki kitab kay mutabiq pet kay rishta daar doosray mominon aur mohajreen kay muqablay mein aik doosray per ( meeras kay moamlay mein ) ziyada haq rakhtay hain ,   illa yeh kay tum apney doston ( kay haq mein koi wasiyyat ker kay unn ) kay sath koi naiki kerlo . yeh baat kitab mein likhi hoi hai .
ayahs.translation: emaan walon kay liye yeh nabi unn ki apni janon say bhi ziyada qareeb tarr hain , aur inn ki biwiyan unn ki mayen hain . iss kay bawajood Allah ki kitab kay mutabiq pet kay rishta daar doosray mominon aur mohajreen kay muqablay mein aik doosray per ( meeras kay moamlay mein ) ziyada haq rakhtay hain ,   illa yeh kay tum apney doston ( kay haq mein koi wasiyyat ker kay unn ) kay sath koi naiki kerlo . yeh baat kitab mein likhi hoi hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) woh waqt yaad rakho jab hum ney tamam nabiyon say ehad liya tha , aur tum say bhi , aur nooh aur Ibrahim aur musa aur essa ibn-e-maryam say bhi . aur hum ney unn say nihayat pukhta ehad liya tha .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) woh waqt yaad rakho jab hum ney tamam nabiyon say ehad liya tha , aur tum say bhi , aur nooh aur Ibrahim aur musa aur essa ibn-e-maryam say bhi . aur hum ney unn say nihayat pukhta ehad liya tha .

ayahs.text: takay Allah sachay logon  say unn ki sachai kay baaray mein poochay .   aur uss ney kafiron kay liye to aik dardnak azab tayyar ker rakha hai .
ayahs.translation: takay Allah sachay logon  say unn ki sachai kay baaray mein poochay .   aur uss ney kafiron kay liye to aik dardnak azab tayyar ker rakha hai .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! yaad kero Allah ney uss waqt tum per kaisa inaam kiya jab tum per boht say lashkar charh aaye thay , phir hum ney unn per aik aandhi bhi bheji , aur aesay lashkar bhi jo tumhen nazar nahi aatay thay .   aur tum jo kuch ker rahey thay , Allah uss ko dekh raha tha .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! yaad kero Allah ney uss waqt tum per kaisa inaam kiya jab tum per boht say lashkar charh aaye thay , phir hum ney unn per aik aandhi bhi bheji , aur aesay lashkar bhi jo tumhen nazar nahi aatay thay .   aur tum jo kuch ker rahey thay , Allah uss ko dekh raha tha .

ayahs.text: yaad kero jab woh tum per tumharay oopper say bhi charh aaye thay aur tumharay neechay say bhi ,   aur jab aankhen pathra gaee then , aur kalejay mun ko aagaye thay , aur tum Allah kay baaray mein tarah tarah ki baaten sochney lagay thay .
ayahs.translation: yaad kero jab woh tum per tumharay oopper say bhi charh aaye thay aur tumharay neechay say bhi ,   aur jab aankhen pathra gaee then , aur kalejay mun ko aagaye thay , aur tum Allah kay baaray mein tarah tarah ki baaten sochney lagay thay .

ayahs.text: uss moaqa per emaan walon ki bari aazmaesh hoi , aur unhen aik sakht bhonchal mein daal ker hella daala gaya .
ayahs.translation: uss moaqa per emaan walon ki bari aazmaesh hoi , aur unhen aik sakht bhonchal mein daal ker hella daala gaya .

ayahs.text: aur yaad kero jab munafiqeen aur woh log jinn kay dilon mein rog hai , yeh keh rahey thay kay :  Allah aur uss kay Rasool ney hum say jo wada kiya hai , woh dhokay kay siwa kuch nahi .
ayahs.translation: aur yaad kero jab munafiqeen aur woh log jinn kay dilon mein rog hai , yeh keh rahey thay kay :  Allah aur uss kay Rasool ney hum say jo wada kiya hai , woh dhokay kay siwa kuch nahi .

ayahs.text: aur jab unhi mein say kuch logon  ney kaha tha kay :  yasrab kay logo ! tumharay liye yahan thehrney ka koi moaqa nahi hai , bus wapis loat jao .  aur unhi mein say kuch log nabi say yeh keh ker ( ghar janey ki ) ijazat maang rahey thay kay :  humaray ghar ghair mehfooz hain    halankay woh ghair mehfooz nahi thay , balkay unn ka maqsad sirf yeh tha kay ( kissi tarah ) bhag kharray hon .
ayahs.translation: aur jab unhi mein say kuch logon  ney kaha tha kay :  yasrab kay logo ! tumharay liye yahan thehrney ka koi moaqa nahi hai , bus wapis loat jao .  aur unhi mein say kuch log nabi say yeh keh ker ( ghar janey ki ) ijazat maang rahey thay kay :  humaray ghar ghair mehfooz hain    halankay woh ghair mehfooz nahi thay , balkay unn ka maqsad sirf yeh tha kay ( kissi tarah ) bhag kharray hon .

ayahs.text: aur agar dushman madiney mein chaaron taraf say aa-ghusay , phir unn say fasad mein shamil honey ko kaha jaye to yeh uss mein zaroor shamil hojayen gay , aur ( uss waqt ) gharon mein thoray hi thehren gay .
ayahs.translation: aur agar dushman madiney mein chaaron taraf say aa-ghusay , phir unn say fasad mein shamil honey ko kaha jaye to yeh uss mein zaroor shamil hojayen gay , aur ( uss waqt ) gharon mein thoray hi thehren gay .

ayahs.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay enhon ney Allah say pehlay yeh ehad ker rakha tha kay woh peeth pher ker nahi jayen gay . aur Allah say kiye huye ehad ki baaz purs zaroor ho ker rahey gi .
ayahs.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay enhon ney Allah say pehlay yeh ehad ker rakha tha kay woh peeth pher ker nahi jayen gay . aur Allah say kiye huye ehad ki baaz purs zaroor ho ker rahey gi .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) keh do kay :  agar tum moat say ya qatal say bhag bhi jao to yeh bhagna tumhen koi faeeda nahi dey ga , aur uss soorat mein tumhen ( zindagi ka ) lutf uthaney ka jo moaqa diya jaye ga , woh thora hi saa hoga .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) keh do kay :  agar tum moat say ya qatal say bhag bhi jao to yeh bhagna tumhen koi faeeda nahi dey ga , aur uss soorat mein tumhen ( zindagi ka ) lutf uthaney ka jo moaqa diya jaye ga , woh thora hi saa hoga .

ayahs.text: kaho kay :  kon hai jo tumhen Allah say bacha sakay , agar woh tumhen koi burai phonchaney ka irada kerlay , ya ( woh kon hai jo uss ki rehmat ko rok sakay , ) agar woh tum per rehmat kernay ka irada kerlay-?  aur Allah kay siwa inn logon  ko naa koi rakhwala mil sakta hai , naa koi madadgaar .
ayahs.translation: kaho kay :  kon hai jo tumhen Allah say bacha sakay , agar woh tumhen koi burai phonchaney ka irada kerlay , ya ( woh kon hai jo uss ki rehmat ko rok sakay , ) agar woh tum per rehmat kernay ka irada kerlay-?  aur Allah kay siwa inn logon  ko naa koi rakhwala mil sakta hai , naa koi madadgaar .

ayahs.text: Allah tum mein say unn logon  ko khoob janta hai jo ( jihad mein ) rukawat daaltay hain , aur apney bhaiyon say kehtay hain kay :  humaray paas chalay aao    aur khud larraee mein aatay nahi , aur aatay hain to boht kam .
ayahs.translation: Allah tum mein say unn logon  ko khoob janta hai jo ( jihad mein ) rukawat daaltay hain , aur apney bhaiyon say kehtay hain kay :  humaray paas chalay aao    aur khud larraee mein aatay nahi , aur aatay hain to boht kam .

ayahs.text: . ( aur woh bhi ) tumharay sath lalach rakhtay huye .   chunacheh jab khatray ka moaqa aajata hai to woh tumhari taraf chakrai hoi aankhon say iss tarah dekhtay hain jaisay kissi per moat ki ghashi taari horahi ho . phir jab khatra door hojata hai to tumharay samney maal ki hirs mein tez tez zabanen chalatay hain .   yeh log hergiz emaan nahi laye hain , iss liye Allah ney inn kay aemal zaya kerdiye hain . aur yeh baat Allah kay liye boht aasaan hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( aur woh bhi ) tumharay sath lalach rakhtay huye .   chunacheh jab khatray ka moaqa aajata hai to woh tumhari taraf chakrai hoi aankhon say iss tarah dekhtay hain jaisay kissi per moat ki ghashi taari horahi ho . phir jab khatra door hojata hai to tumharay samney maal ki hirs mein tez tez zabanen chalatay hain .   yeh log hergiz emaan nahi laye hain , iss liye Allah ney inn kay aemal zaya kerdiye hain . aur yeh baat Allah kay liye boht aasaan hai .

ayahs.text: woh yeh samajh rahey hain kay ( dushmanon kay ) lashkar abhi gaye nahi hain . aur agar woh lashkar ( dobara ) aajayen to inn ki khuwaish yeh hogi kay woh dehaat mein jaker rahen , ( aur wahin bethay huye ) tumhari khabren maloom kertay rahen . aur agar tumharay darmiyan rahey bhi to larraee mein thora hi hissa len gay .
ayahs.translation: woh yeh samajh rahey hain kay ( dushmanon kay ) lashkar abhi gaye nahi hain . aur agar woh lashkar ( dobara ) aajayen to inn ki khuwaish yeh hogi kay woh dehaat mein jaker rahen , ( aur wahin bethay huye ) tumhari khabren maloom kertay rahen . aur agar tumharay darmiyan rahey bhi to larraee mein thora hi hissa len gay .

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay tumharay liye Rasool Allah ki zaat mein aik behtareen namoona hai , her uss shaks kay liye jo Allah say aur yoam-e-aakhirat say umeed rakhta ho , aur kasrat say Allah ka ziker kerta ho .
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay tumharay liye Rasool Allah ki zaat mein aik behtareen namoona hai , her uss shaks kay liye jo Allah say aur yoam-e-aakhirat say umeed rakhta ho , aur kasrat say Allah ka ziker kerta ho .

ayahs.text: aur jo log emaan rakhtay hain , jab unhon ney ( dushman kay ) lashkaron ko dekha tha to unhon ney yeh kaha tha kay :  yeh wohi baat hai jiss ka wada Allah aur uss kay Rasool ney hum say kiya tha , aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ney sach kaha tha .  aur iss waqaey ney unn kay emaan aur tabey daari kay jazbay mein aur izafa kerdiya tha .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log emaan rakhtay hain , jab unhon ney ( dushman kay ) lashkaron ko dekha tha to unhon ney yeh kaha tha kay :  yeh wohi baat hai jiss ka wada Allah aur uss kay Rasool ney hum say kiya tha , aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ney sach kaha tha .  aur iss waqaey ney unn kay emaan aur tabey daari kay jazbay mein aur izafa kerdiya tha .

ayahs.text: inhi emaan walon mein woh log bhi hain jinhon ney Allah say jo ehad kiya tha , ussay sacha ker dikhaya . phir unn mein say kuch woh hain jinhon ney apna nazrana poora kerdiya , aur kuch woh hain jo abhi intizar mein hain ,   aur unhon ney ( apney iradon mein ) zara si bhi tabdeeli nahi ki .
ayahs.translation: inhi emaan walon mein woh log bhi hain jinhon ney Allah say jo ehad kiya tha , ussay sacha ker dikhaya . phir unn mein say kuch woh hain jinhon ney apna nazrana poora kerdiya , aur kuch woh hain jo abhi intizar mein hain ,   aur unhon ney ( apney iradon mein ) zara si bhi tabdeeli nahi ki .

ayahs.text: . ( yeh waqiaa iss liye huwa ) takay Allah sachon ko unn ki sachai ka inaam dey , aur munafiqon ko agar chahye to azab dey , ya unn ki tauba qubool kerlay .   Allah yaqeenan boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( yeh waqiaa iss liye huwa ) takay Allah sachon ko unn ki sachai ka inaam dey , aur munafiqon ko agar chahye to azab dey , ya unn ki tauba qubool kerlay .   Allah yaqeenan boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: aur jo log kafir thay , Allah ney unhen unn kay saray ghaiz o ghazab kay sath iss tarah puspa kerdiya kay woh koi faeeda hasil naa ker-sakay . aur mominon ki taraf say larraee kay liye Allah khud kafi hogaya . aur Allah bari quooat ka , baray iqtidar ka malik hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log kafir thay , Allah ney unhen unn kay saray ghaiz o ghazab kay sath iss tarah puspa kerdiya kay woh koi faeeda hasil naa ker-sakay . aur mominon ki taraf say larraee kay liye Allah khud kafi hogaya . aur Allah bari quooat ka , baray iqtidar ka malik hai .

ayahs.text: aur jinn ehal-e-kitab ney inn ( dushmanon ) ki madad ki thi , unhen Allah unn kay qalon say neechay utaar laya ,   aur unn kay dilon mein aisa roab daal diya kay ( aey musalmano ! ) unn mein say kuch ko tum qatal ker rahey thay , aur kuch ko qedi bana rahey thay .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn ehal-e-kitab ney inn ( dushmanon ) ki madad ki thi , unhen Allah unn kay qalon say neechay utaar laya ,   aur unn kay dilon mein aisa roab daal diya kay ( aey musalmano ! ) unn mein say kuch ko tum qatal ker rahey thay , aur kuch ko qedi bana rahey thay .

ayahs.text: aur Allah ney tumhen unn ki zameen ka , unn kay gharon ka aur unn ki dolat ka waris bana diya , aur aik aesi zameen ka bhi jiss tak abhi tumharay qadam nahi phonchay   aur Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah ney tumhen unn ki zameen ka , unn kay gharon ka aur unn ki dolat ka waris bana diya , aur aik aesi zameen ka bhi jiss tak abhi tumharay qadam nahi phonchay   aur Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai .

ayahs.text: aey nabi ! apni biwiyon say kaho kay :  agar tum dunyawi zindagi aur uss ki zeenat chahti ho to aao , mein tumhen kuch tohfay dey ker khoobsurti kay sath rukhsat kerdun .
ayahs.translation: aey nabi ! apni biwiyon say kaho kay :  agar tum dunyawi zindagi aur uss ki zeenat chahti ho to aao , mein tumhen kuch tohfay dey ker khoobsurti kay sath rukhsat kerdun .

ayahs.text: aur agar tum Allah aur uss kay Rasool aur aalam-e-aakhirat ki talabgaar ho , to yaqeen jano Allah ney tum mein say naik khawateen kay liye shandaar inaam tayyar ker rakha hai .
ayahs.translation: aur agar tum Allah aur uss kay Rasool aur aalam-e-aakhirat ki talabgaar ho , to yaqeen jano Allah ney tum mein say naik khawateen kay liye shandaar inaam tayyar ker rakha hai .

ayahs.text: aey nabi ki biwiyo ! tum mein say jo koi kissi khuli beyhoodgi ka irtikab keray gi , uss ka azab barha ker do guna kerdiya jaye ga , aur Allah kay liye aisa kerna boht aasaan hai .
ayahs.translation: aey nabi ki biwiyo ! tum mein say jo koi kissi khuli beyhoodgi ka irtikab keray gi , uss ka azab barha ker do guna kerdiya jaye ga , aur Allah kay liye aisa kerna boht aasaan hai .

ayahs.text: aur tum mein say jo koi Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki tabey daar rahey gi , aur naik amal keray gi , ussay hum uss ka sawab bhi do guna den gay , aur uss kay liye hum ney ba-izzat rizq tayyar ker rakha hai .
ayahs.translation: aur tum mein say jo koi Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki tabey daar rahey gi , aur naik amal keray gi , ussay hum uss ka sawab bhi do guna den gay , aur uss kay liye hum ney ba-izzat rizq tayyar ker rakha hai .

ayahs.text: aey nabi ki biwiyo ! agar tum taqwa ikhtiyar kero to tum aam aurton ki tarah nahi ho .   lehaza tum nazakat kay sath baat matt kiya kero , kabhi koi aisa shaks beyja lalach kernay lagay jiss kay dil mein rog hota hai , aur baat woh kaho jo bhalai wali ho .
ayahs.translation: aey nabi ki biwiyo ! agar tum taqwa ikhtiyar kero to tum aam aurton ki tarah nahi ho .   lehaza tum nazakat kay sath baat matt kiya kero , kabhi koi aisa shaks beyja lalach kernay lagay jiss kay dil mein rog hota hai , aur baat woh kaho jo bhalai wali ho .

ayahs.text: aur apney gharon mein qarar kay sath raho ,   aur ( ghair mardon ko ) banao singhaar dikhati naa phiro , jaisa kay pehli jahiliyat mein dikhaya jata tha ,   aur namaz qaeem kero , aur zakat ada kero , aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki farmanbardaari kero . aey nabi kay ahl-e-bait ! yani ( ghar walo )   Allah to yeh chahta hai kay tum say gandagi ko door rakhay , aur tumhen aesi pakeezgi ata keray jo her tarah mukammal ho .
ayahs.translation: aur apney gharon mein qarar kay sath raho ,   aur ( ghair mardon ko ) banao singhaar dikhati naa phiro , jaisa kay pehli jahiliyat mein dikhaya jata tha ,   aur namaz qaeem kero , aur zakat ada kero , aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki farmanbardaari kero . aey nabi kay ahl-e-bait ! yani ( ghar walo )   Allah to yeh chahta hai kay tum say gandagi ko door rakhay , aur tumhen aesi pakeezgi ata keray jo her tarah mukammal ho .

ayahs.text: aur tumharay gharon mein Allah ki jo aayaten aur hikmat ki jo baaten sunai jati hain , unn ko yaad rakho . yaqeen jano Allah boht bareek-been aur her baat say ba-khabar hai .
ayahs.translation: aur tumharay gharon mein Allah ki jo aayaten aur hikmat ki jo baaten sunai jati hain , unn ko yaad rakho . yaqeen jano Allah boht bareek-been aur her baat say ba-khabar hai .

ayahs.text: beyshak farmanbardaar mard hon ya farmanbardaar aurten ,   momin mard hon ya momin aurten , ibadat guzaar mard hon ya ibadat guzaar aurten , sachay mard hon ya sachi aurten , sabir mard hon ya sabir aurten , dil say jhukney walay mard hon ya dil say jhukney wali aurten ,   sadqa kernay walay mard hon ya sadqa kernay wali aurten , roza daar mard hon ya roza daar aurten , apni sharmgahon ki hifazat kernay walay mard hon ya hifazat kernay wali aurten , aur Allah ka kasrat say ziker kernay walay mard hon ya ziker kernay wali aurten , inn sabb kay liye Allah ney maghfirat aur shandaar ajar tayyar ker rakha hai .
ayahs.translation: beyshak farmanbardaar mard hon ya farmanbardaar aurten ,   momin mard hon ya momin aurten , ibadat guzaar mard hon ya ibadat guzaar aurten , sachay mard hon ya sachi aurten , sabir mard hon ya sabir aurten , dil say jhukney walay mard hon ya dil say jhukney wali aurten ,   sadqa kernay walay mard hon ya sadqa kernay wali aurten , roza daar mard hon ya roza daar aurten , apni sharmgahon ki hifazat kernay walay mard hon ya hifazat kernay wali aurten , aur Allah ka kasrat say ziker kernay walay mard hon ya ziker kernay wali aurten , inn sabb kay liye Allah ney maghfirat aur shandaar ajar tayyar ker rakha hai .

ayahs.text: aur jab Allah aur uss ka Rasool kissi baat ka hatmi faisla kerden to naa kissi momin mard kay liye yeh gunjaeesh hai naa kissi momin aurat kay liye kay unn ko apney moamlay mein koi ikhtiyar baqi rahey .   aur jiss kissi ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki nafarmani ki , woh khuli gumrahi mein parr-gaya .
ayahs.translation: aur jab Allah aur uss ka Rasool kissi baat ka hatmi faisla kerden to naa kissi momin mard kay liye yeh gunjaeesh hai naa kissi momin aurat kay liye kay unn ko apney moamlay mein koi ikhtiyar baqi rahey .   aur jiss kissi ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki nafarmani ki , woh khuli gumrahi mein parr-gaya .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) yaad kero jab tum uss shaks say jiss per Allah ney bhi ehsan kiya tha , aur tum ney bhi ehsan kiya tha ,   yeh keh rahey thay kay :  apni biwi ko apney nikah mein rehney do , aur Allah say daro    aur tum apney dil mein woh baat chupaye huye thay jissay Allah khol denay wala tha ,   aur tum logon  say dartay thay , halankay Allah iss baat ka ziyada haq daar hai kay tum uss say daro . phir jab zaid ney apni biwi say talluq khatam kerliya to hum ney uss say tumhara nikah keradiya , takay musalmanon kay liye apney mun bolay beton ki biwiyon ( say nikah kernay ) mein uss waqt koi tangi naa rahey jab unhon ney apni biwiyon say talluq khatam kerliya ho . aur Allah ney jo hukum diya tha , uss per amal to ho ker rehna hi tha .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) yaad kero jab tum uss shaks say jiss per Allah ney bhi ehsan kiya tha , aur tum ney bhi ehsan kiya tha ,   yeh keh rahey thay kay :  apni biwi ko apney nikah mein rehney do , aur Allah say daro    aur tum apney dil mein woh baat chupaye huye thay jissay Allah khol denay wala tha ,   aur tum logon  say dartay thay , halankay Allah iss baat ka ziyada haq daar hai kay tum uss say daro . phir jab zaid ney apni biwi say talluq khatam kerliya to hum ney uss say tumhara nikah keradiya , takay musalmanon kay liye apney mun bolay beton ki biwiyon ( say nikah kernay ) mein uss waqt koi tangi naa rahey jab unhon ney apni biwiyon say talluq khatam kerliya ho . aur Allah ney jo hukum diya tha , uss per amal to ho ker rehna hi tha .

ayahs.text: nabi kay liye uss kaam mein aetraz ki koi baat nahi hoti jo Allah ney uss kay liye tey kerdiya ho . yehi Allah ki woh sunnat hai jiss per unn ( anbiya ) kay moamlay mein bhi amal hota aaya hai jo pehlay guzar chukay hain . aur Allah ka faisla napa tula muqaddar hota hai .
ayahs.translation: nabi kay liye uss kaam mein aetraz ki koi baat nahi hoti jo Allah ney uss kay liye tey kerdiya ho . yehi Allah ki woh sunnat hai jiss per unn ( anbiya ) kay moamlay mein bhi amal hota aaya hai jo pehlay guzar chukay hain . aur Allah ka faisla napa tula muqaddar hota hai .

ayahs.text: payghumber woh log hain jo Allah kay bhejay huye ehkaam ko logon  tak phonchatay hain , aur ussi say dartay hain , aur Allah kay siwa kissi say nahi dartay . aur hisab lenay kay liye Allah ko kissi ki zaroorat nahi .
ayahs.translation: payghumber woh log hain jo Allah kay bhejay huye ehkaam ko logon  tak phonchatay hain , aur ussi say dartay hain , aur Allah kay siwa kissi say nahi dartay . aur hisab lenay kay liye Allah ko kissi ki zaroorat nahi .

ayahs.text: . ( musalmano ! ) Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) tum mardon mein say kissi kay baap nahi hain , lekin woh Allah kay Rasool hain , aur tamam nabiyon mein sabb say aakhri nabi hain .   aur Allah her baat ko khoob janney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( musalmano ! ) Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) tum mardon mein say kissi kay baap nahi hain , lekin woh Allah kay Rasool hain , aur tamam nabiyon mein sabb say aakhri nabi hain .   aur Allah her baat ko khoob janney wala hai .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah ko khoob kasrat say yaad kiya kero ,
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah ko khoob kasrat say yaad kiya kero ,

ayahs.text: aur subha o shaam uss ki tasbeeh kero .
ayahs.translation: aur subha o shaam uss ki tasbeeh kero .

ayahs.text: wohi hai jo khud bhi tum per rehmat bhejta hai , aur uss kay farishtay bhi , takay woh tumhen andheron say nikal ker roshni mein ley aaye , aur woh mominon per boht meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: wohi hai jo khud bhi tum per rehmat bhejta hai , aur uss kay farishtay bhi , takay woh tumhen andheron say nikal ker roshni mein ley aaye , aur woh mominon per boht meharban hai .

ayahs.text: jiss din momin log Allah say milen gay uss din unn ka istaqbal salam say hoga , aur Allah ney unn kay liye ba-izzat inaam tayyar ker rakha hai .
ayahs.translation: jiss din momin log Allah say milen gay uss din unn ka istaqbal salam say hoga , aur Allah ney unn kay liye ba-izzat inaam tayyar ker rakha hai .

ayahs.text: aey nabi ! beyshak hum ney tumhen aisa bana ker bheja hai kay tum gawahi denay walay , khushkhabri sunaney walay aur khabrdar kernay walay ho ,
ayahs.translation: aey nabi ! beyshak hum ney tumhen aisa bana ker bheja hai kay tum gawahi denay walay , khushkhabri sunaney walay aur khabrdar kernay walay ho ,

ayahs.text: aur Allah kay hukum say logon  ko Allah ki taraf bulaney walay , aur roshni phelaney walay chiragh ho .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah kay hukum say logon  ko Allah ki taraf bulaney walay , aur roshni phelaney walay chiragh ho .

ayahs.text: tum mominon ko khushkhabri suna do kay unn per Allah ki taraf say bara fazal honey wala hai ,
ayahs.translation: tum mominon ko khushkhabri suna do kay unn per Allah ki taraf say bara fazal honey wala hai ,

ayahs.text: aur kafiron aur munafiqon ki baat naa maano , aur unn ki taraf say jo takleef phonchay , uss ki perwa naa kero , aur Allah per bharosa kiye raho , aur Allah rakhwala banney kay liye kafi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur kafiron aur munafiqon ki baat naa maano , aur unn ki taraf say jo takleef phonchay , uss ki perwa naa kero , aur Allah per bharosa kiye raho , aur Allah rakhwala banney kay liye kafi hai .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! jab tum ney momin aurton say nikah kiya ho , phir tum ney unhen chooney say pehlay hi talaq dey di ho , to unn kay zimmay tumhari koi iddat wajib nahi hai jiss ki ginti tumhen shumar kerni ho .   lehaza unhen kuch tohfa dey do ,   aur unhen khoobsurti say rukhsat kerdo .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! jab tum ney momin aurton say nikah kiya ho , phir tum ney unhen chooney say pehlay hi talaq dey di ho , to unn kay zimmay tumhari koi iddat wajib nahi hai jiss ki ginti tumhen shumar kerni ho .   lehaza unhen kuch tohfa dey do ,   aur unhen khoobsurti say rukhsat kerdo .

ayahs.text: aey nabi ! hum ney tumharay liye tumhari woh biwiyan halal kerdi hain jinn ko tum ney unn ka mehar ada kerdiya hai .   neez Allah ney ghaneemat ka jo maal tumhen ata kiya hai , uss mein say jo kaneezen tumhari milkiyat mein aa-chuki hain woh bhi ( tumharay liye halal hain ) aur tumhari woh chacha ki betiyan aur phoopiyon ki betiyan aur mamoo ki betiyan aur khalaon ki betiyan bhi jinhon ney tumharay sath hijrat ki hai ,   neez koi musalman aurat jiss ney mehar kay baghair nabi ko apney aap ( say nikah kernay ) ki paishkash ki ho ,   ba-shartey-kay nabi uss say nikah kerna chahye . yeh saray ehkaam khaas tumharay liye hain , doosray mominon kay liye nahi . hamen woh ehkaam khoob maloom hain jo hum ney unn ki biwiyon aur kaneezon kay baaray mein unn per aaeed kiye hain , ( aur tumhen unn say mustasna kiya hai ) takay tum per koi tangi naa rahey , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: aey nabi ! hum ney tumharay liye tumhari woh biwiyan halal kerdi hain jinn ko tum ney unn ka mehar ada kerdiya hai .   neez Allah ney ghaneemat ka jo maal tumhen ata kiya hai , uss mein say jo kaneezen tumhari milkiyat mein aa-chuki hain woh bhi ( tumharay liye halal hain ) aur tumhari woh chacha ki betiyan aur phoopiyon ki betiyan aur mamoo ki betiyan aur khalaon ki betiyan bhi jinhon ney tumharay sath hijrat ki hai ,   neez koi musalman aurat jiss ney mehar kay baghair nabi ko apney aap ( say nikah kernay ) ki paishkash ki ho ,   ba-shartey-kay nabi uss say nikah kerna chahye . yeh saray ehkaam khaas tumharay liye hain , doosray mominon kay liye nahi . hamen woh ehkaam khoob maloom hain jo hum ney unn ki biwiyon aur kaneezon kay baaray mein unn per aaeed kiye hain , ( aur tumhen unn say mustasna kiya hai ) takay tum per koi tangi naa rahey , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: unn biwiyon mein say tum jiss ki baari chahao multawi kerdo , aur jiss ko chahao , apney paas rakho , aur jinn ko tum ney alag kerdiya ho unn mein say agar kissi ko wapis bulana chahao to uss mein bhi tumharay liye koi gunah nahi hai .   iss tareeqay mein iss baat ki ziyada tawaqqo hai kay unn sabb ki aankhen thandi rahen gi , aur unhen ranj nahi hoga , aur tum unhen jo kuch dey do gay , uss per woh sabb ki sabb razi rahen gi .   aur Allah unn sabb baaton ko janta hai jo tumharay dilon mein hain , aur Allah ilm aur hilm ka malik hai .
ayahs.translation: unn biwiyon mein say tum jiss ki baari chahao multawi kerdo , aur jiss ko chahao , apney paas rakho , aur jinn ko tum ney alag kerdiya ho unn mein say agar kissi ko wapis bulana chahao to uss mein bhi tumharay liye koi gunah nahi hai .   iss tareeqay mein iss baat ki ziyada tawaqqo hai kay unn sabb ki aankhen thandi rahen gi , aur unhen ranj nahi hoga , aur tum unhen jo kuch dey do gay , uss per woh sabb ki sabb razi rahen gi .   aur Allah unn sabb baaton ko janta hai jo tumharay dilon mein hain , aur Allah ilm aur hilm ka malik hai .

ayahs.text: iss kay baad doosri aurten tumharay liye halal nahi hain , aur naa yeh jaeez hai kay tum unn kay badlay koi doosri biwiyan ley aao , chahye unn ki khoobi tumhen pasand aai ho ,   albatta jo kaneezen tumhari milkiyat mein hon , ( woh tumharay liye halal hain , ) aur Allah her cheez ki poori nigrani kernay wala hai .
ayahs.translation: iss kay baad doosri aurten tumharay liye halal nahi hain , aur naa yeh jaeez hai kay tum unn kay badlay koi doosri biwiyan ley aao , chahye unn ki khoobi tumhen pasand aai ho ,   albatta jo kaneezen tumhari milkiyat mein hon , ( woh tumharay liye halal hain , ) aur Allah her cheez ki poori nigrani kernay wala hai .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! nabi kay gharon mein ( bila ijazat ) dakhil naa ho , illa yeh kay tumhen khaney per aaney ki ijazat dey di jaye , woh bhi iss tarah kay tum uss khaney ki tayyari kay intizar mein naa bethay raho , lekin jab tumhen dawat di jaye to jao , phir jab khana kha chuko to apni apni raah lo , aur baaton mein ji laga ker naa betho .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay iss baat say nabi ko takleef phonchti hai , aur woh tum say ( kehtay huye ) sharmatay hain , aur Allah haq baat mein kissi say nahi sharmata . aur jab tumhen nabi ki biwiyon say kuch maangna ho to perday kay peechay say maango .   yeh tareeqa tumharay dilon ko bhi aur unn kay dilon ko bhi ziyada pakeezah rakhney ka zariya hoga . aur tumharay liye jaeez nahi hai kay tum Allah kay Rasool ko takleef phonchao , aur naa yeh jaeez hai kay unn kay baad unn ki biwiyon say kabhi bhi nikah kero . yeh Allah kay nazdeek bari sangeen baat hai .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! nabi kay gharon mein ( bila ijazat ) dakhil naa ho , illa yeh kay tumhen khaney per aaney ki ijazat dey di jaye , woh bhi iss tarah kay tum uss khaney ki tayyari kay intizar mein naa bethay raho , lekin jab tumhen dawat di jaye to jao , phir jab khana kha chuko to apni apni raah lo , aur baaton mein ji laga ker naa betho .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay iss baat say nabi ko takleef phonchti hai , aur woh tum say ( kehtay huye ) sharmatay hain , aur Allah haq baat mein kissi say nahi sharmata . aur jab tumhen nabi ki biwiyon say kuch maangna ho to perday kay peechay say maango .   yeh tareeqa tumharay dilon ko bhi aur unn kay dilon ko bhi ziyada pakeezah rakhney ka zariya hoga . aur tumharay liye jaeez nahi hai kay tum Allah kay Rasool ko takleef phonchao , aur naa yeh jaeez hai kay unn kay baad unn ki biwiyon say kabhi bhi nikah kero . yeh Allah kay nazdeek bari sangeen baat hai .

ayahs.text: chahye tum koi baat zahir kero , ya ussay chupao , Allah her cheez ka poora poora ilm rakhney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: chahye tum koi baat zahir kero , ya ussay chupao , Allah her cheez ka poora poora ilm rakhney wala hai .

ayahs.text: nabi ki biwiyon kay liye apney apney baap ( kay samney bey perda aaney ) mein koi gunah nahi hai , naa apney beton kay , naa apney bhaiyon kay , naa apney bhateejon kay , naa apney bhanjon kay , aur naa apni aurton kay ,   aur naa apni kaneezon kay ( samney aaney mein koi gunah hai . ) aur ( aey khawateen ! ) tum Allah say darti raho . yaqeen jano kay Allah her baat ka mushaeeda kernay wala hai .
ayahs.translation: nabi ki biwiyon kay liye apney apney baap ( kay samney bey perda aaney ) mein koi gunah nahi hai , naa apney beton kay , naa apney bhaiyon kay , naa apney bhateejon kay , naa apney bhanjon kay , aur naa apni aurton kay ,   aur naa apni kaneezon kay ( samney aaney mein koi gunah hai . ) aur ( aey khawateen ! ) tum Allah say darti raho . yaqeen jano kay Allah her baat ka mushaeeda kernay wala hai .

ayahs.text: beyshak Allah aur uss kay farishtay nabi per durood bhejtay hain . aey emaan walo ! tum bhi unn per durood bhejo , aur khoob salam bheja kero .
ayahs.translation: beyshak Allah aur uss kay farishtay nabi per durood bhejtay hain . aey emaan walo ! tum bhi unn per durood bhejo , aur khoob salam bheja kero .

ayahs.text: jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool ko takleef phonchatay hain , Allah ney duniya aur aakhirat mein unn per lanat ki hai , aur unn kay liye aisa azab tayyar ker rakha hai jo zaleel ker kay rakh dey ga .
ayahs.translation: jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool ko takleef phonchatay hain , Allah ney duniya aur aakhirat mein unn per lanat ki hai , aur unn kay liye aisa azab tayyar ker rakha hai jo zaleel ker kay rakh dey ga .

ayahs.text: aur jo log momin mardon aur momin aurton ko unn kay kissi jurm kay baghair takleef phonchatay hain , unhon ney bohtan tarazi aur khulay gunah ka bojh apney oopper laad liya hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log momin mardon aur momin aurton ko unn kay kissi jurm kay baghair takleef phonchatay hain , unhon ney bohtan tarazi aur khulay gunah ka bojh apney oopper laad liya hai .

ayahs.text: aey nabi ! tum apni biwiyon , apni betiyon aur musalmanon ki aurton say keh do kay woh apni chadaren apney ( mun kay ) oopper jhuka liya keren .   iss tareeqay mein iss baat ki ziyada tawaqqo hai kay woh pehchan li jayen gi , to unn ko sataya nahi jaye ga .   aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: aey nabi ! tum apni biwiyon , apni betiyon aur musalmanon ki aurton say keh do kay woh apni chadaren apney ( mun kay ) oopper jhuka liya keren .   iss tareeqay mein iss baat ki ziyada tawaqqo hai kay woh pehchan li jayen gi , to unn ko sataya nahi jaye ga .   aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: agar woh log baaz naa aaye jo munafiq hain , jinn kay dilon mein rog hai aur jo shehar mein shar-angez afwahen phelatay hain , to hum zaroor aisa keren gay kay tum unn kay khilaf uth kharray hogay , phir woh uss shehar mein tumharay sath nahi reh saken gay , albatta thoray din
ayahs.translation: agar woh log baaz naa aaye jo munafiq hain , jinn kay dilon mein rog hai aur jo shehar mein shar-angez afwahen phelatay hain , to hum zaroor aisa keren gay kay tum unn kay khilaf uth kharray hogay , phir woh uss shehar mein tumharay sath nahi reh saken gay , albatta thoray din

ayahs.text: jinn mein woh phitkaray huye hon gay . ( phir ) jahan kahen milen gay , pakar liye jayen gay , aur unhen aik aik ker kay qatal kerdiya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: jinn mein woh phitkaray huye hon gay . ( phir ) jahan kahen milen gay , pakar liye jayen gay , aur unhen aik aik ker kay qatal kerdiya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: yeh Allah ka woh mamool hai jiss per unn logon  kay moamlay mein bhi amal hota raha hai jo pehlay guzar chukay hain . aur tum Allah kay mamool mein koi tabdeeli hergiz nahi pao gay .
ayahs.translation: yeh Allah ka woh mamool hai jiss per unn logon  kay moamlay mein bhi amal hota raha hai jo pehlay guzar chukay hain . aur tum Allah kay mamool mein koi tabdeeli hergiz nahi pao gay .

ayahs.text: log tum say qayamat kay baaray mein poochtay hain . keh do kay uss ka ilm to Allah hi kay paas hai . aur tumhen kiya pata shayad qayamat qareeb hi aagae ho .
ayahs.translation: log tum say qayamat kay baaray mein poochtay hain . keh do kay uss ka ilm to Allah hi kay paas hai . aur tumhen kiya pata shayad qayamat qareeb hi aagae ho .

ayahs.text: iss mein koi shak nahi kay Allah ney kafiron ko rehmat say door kerdiya hai , aur unn kay liye bharakti hoi aag tayyar ki hai ,
ayahs.translation: iss mein koi shak nahi kay Allah ney kafiron ko rehmat say door kerdiya hai , aur unn kay liye bharakti hoi aag tayyar ki hai ,

ayahs.text: jiss mein woh hamesha iss tarah rahen gay kay unhen naa koi himayati mil sakay ga , aur naa koi madadgaar .
ayahs.translation: jiss mein woh hamesha iss tarah rahen gay kay unhen naa koi himayati mil sakay ga , aur naa koi madadgaar .

ayahs.text: jiss din unn kay chehron ko aag mein ulta palta jaye ga , woh kahen gay kay :  aey kaash ! hum ney Allah ki itaat kerli hoti , aur Rasool ka kehna maan liya hota !
ayahs.translation: jiss din unn kay chehron ko aag mein ulta palta jaye ga , woh kahen gay kay :  aey kaash ! hum ney Allah ki itaat kerli hoti , aur Rasool ka kehna maan liya hota !

ayahs.text: aur kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney apney sardaron aur apney baron ka kehna maana , aur unhon ney hamen raastay say bhatka diya .
ayahs.translation: aur kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney apney sardaron aur apney baron ka kehna maana , aur unhon ney hamen raastay say bhatka diya .

ayahs.text: aey humaray perwerdigar ! unn ko dugna azab dey , aur unn per aesi lanat ker jo bari bhari lanat ho .
ayahs.translation: aey humaray perwerdigar ! unn ko dugna azab dey , aur unn per aesi lanat ker jo bari bhari lanat ho .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! unn logon  ki tarah naa ban jana jinhon ney musa ko sataya tha , phir Allah ney unn ko unn baaton say bari kerdiya jo unn logon  ney banai then .   aur woh Allah kay nazdeek baray rutbay walay thay .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! unn logon  ki tarah naa ban jana jinhon ney musa ko sataya tha , phir Allah ney unn ko unn baaton say bari kerdiya jo unn logon  ney banai then .   aur woh Allah kay nazdeek baray rutbay walay thay .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah say daro , aur seedhi sachi baat kaha kero ,
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah say daro , aur seedhi sachi baat kaha kero ,

ayahs.text: Allah tumharay faeeday kay liye tumharay kaam sanwaar dey ga , aur tumharay gunahon ki maghfirat kerday ga . aur jo shaks Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki itaat keray , uss ney woh kamiyabi hasil kerli jo zabardast kamiyabi hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah tumharay faeeday kay liye tumharay kaam sanwaar dey ga , aur tumharay gunahon ki maghfirat kerday ga . aur jo shaks Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki itaat keray , uss ney woh kamiyabi hasil kerli jo zabardast kamiyabi hai .

ayahs.text: hum ney yeh amanat aasmano aur zameen aur paharon per paish ki , to unhon ney uss kay uthaney say inkar kiya , aur uss say darr gaye , aur insan ney uss ka bojh utha liya .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh bara zalim , bara nadan hai .
ayahs.translation: hum ney yeh amanat aasmano aur zameen aur paharon per paish ki , to unhon ney uss kay uthaney say inkar kiya , aur uss say darr gaye , aur insan ney uss ka bojh utha liya .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh bara zalim , bara nadan hai .

ayahs.text: nateeja yeh hai kay Allah munafiq mardon aur munafiq aurton ko , neez mushrik mardon aur mushrik aurton ko azab dey ga , aur momin mardon aur momin aurton per rehmat kay sath tawajjah farmaye ga . aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: nateeja yeh hai kay Allah munafiq mardon aur munafiq aurton ko , neez mushrik mardon aur mushrik aurton ko azab dey ga , aur momin mardon aur momin aurton per rehmat kay sath tawajjah farmaye ga . aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: tamam tarr tareef uss Allah ki hai jiss ki sift yeh hai kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , sabb ussi ka hai , aur aakhirat mein bhi tareef ussi ki hai , aur wohi hai jo hikmat ka malik hai , mukammal tor per ba-khabar !
verses.translation: tamam tarr tareef uss Allah ki hai jiss ki sift yeh hai kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , sabb ussi ka hai , aur aakhirat mein bhi tareef ussi ki hai , aur wohi hai jo hikmat ka malik hai , mukammal tor per ba-khabar !

verses.text: woh unn cheezon ko bhi janta hai jo zameen kay andar jati hain , aur unn ko bhi jo uss say bahir nikalti hain , unn ko bhi jo aasman say utarti hain , aur unn ko bhi jo uss mein charrti hain , aur wohi hai jo bara meharban hai , boht bakhshney wala hai .
verses.translation: woh unn cheezon ko bhi janta hai jo zameen kay andar jati hain , aur unn ko bhi jo uss say bahir nikalti hain , unn ko bhi jo aasman say utarti hain , aur unn ko bhi jo uss mein charrti hain , aur wohi hai jo bara meharban hai , boht bakhshney wala hai .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  hum per qayamat nahi aaye gi  keh do :  kiyon nahi aaye gi ? meray aalam-ul-ghaib perwerdigar ki qasam ! woh tum per zaroor aa-ker rahey gi . koi zarra barabar cheez uss ki nazar say door nahi hoti ,   naa aasmano mein , naa zameen mein , aur naa uss say choti koi cheez aesi hai naa bari jo aik khuli kitab ( yani loah-e-mehfooz ) mein darj naa ho .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  hum per qayamat nahi aaye gi  keh do :  kiyon nahi aaye gi ? meray aalam-ul-ghaib perwerdigar ki qasam ! woh tum per zaroor aa-ker rahey gi . koi zarra barabar cheez uss ki nazar say door nahi hoti ,   naa aasmano mein , naa zameen mein , aur naa uss say choti koi cheez aesi hai naa bari jo aik khuli kitab ( yani loah-e-mehfooz ) mein darj naa ho .

verses.text: . ( aur qayamat iss liye aaye gi ) takay jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , Allah unn ko inaam dey . aesay logon  kay liye maghfirat hai , aur ba-izzat rizq .
verses.translation: . ( aur qayamat iss liye aaye gi ) takay jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , Allah unn ko inaam dey . aesay logon  kay liye maghfirat hai , aur ba-izzat rizq .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney humari aayaton kay baaray mein yeh koshish ki hai kay unhen nakam banayen , unn kay liye bala ka dardnak azab hai .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney humari aayaton kay baaray mein yeh koshish ki hai kay unhen nakam banayen , unn kay liye bala ka dardnak azab hai .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jinn logon  ko ilm ata huwa hai , woh khoob samajhtay hain kay tum per tumharay rab ki taraf say jo kuch nazil kiya gaya hai , woh haq hai , aur uss ( Allah ) ka raasta dikhata hai jo iqtidar ka malik bhi hai , her tareef ka mustahiq bhi .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jinn logon  ko ilm ata huwa hai , woh khoob samajhtay hain kay tum per tumharay rab ki taraf say jo kuch nazil kiya gaya hai , woh haq hai , aur uss ( Allah ) ka raasta dikhata hai jo iqtidar ka malik bhi hai , her tareef ka mustahiq bhi .

verses.text: aur yeh kafir log ( aik doosray say ) kehney lagay :  kiya hum tumhen aik aesay shaks ka pata batayen jo tumhen yeh khabar deta hai kay jab tum ( mar ker ) bilkul reza reza hochuko gay uss waqt tum aik naye janam mein aao gay ?
verses.translation: aur yeh kafir log ( aik doosray say ) kehney lagay :  kiya hum tumhen aik aesay shaks ka pata batayen jo tumhen yeh khabar deta hai kay jab tum ( mar ker ) bilkul reza reza hochuko gay uss waqt tum aik naye janam mein aao gay ?

verses.text: pata nahi uss shaks ney Allah per jhoot baandha hai , ya ussay kissi tarah ka junoon laahaq hai ?  nahi ! balkay haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay woh khud azab mein aur perlay darjay ki gumrahi mein mubtala hain .
verses.translation: pata nahi uss shaks ney Allah per jhoot baandha hai , ya ussay kissi tarah ka junoon laahaq hai ?  nahi ! balkay haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay woh khud azab mein aur perlay darjay ki gumrahi mein mubtala hain .

verses.text: bhala kiya inn logon  ney uss aasman o zameen ko nahi dekha jo unn kay aagay bhi mojood hain , aur unn kay peechay bhi . agar hum chahen to unn ko zameen mein dhansa den , ya aasman kay kuch tukrray unn per gira den . haqeeqat yeh hai kay iss mein her uss banday kay liye aik nishani hai jo Allah ki taraf rujoo kernay wala ho .
verses.translation: bhala kiya inn logon  ney uss aasman o zameen ko nahi dekha jo unn kay aagay bhi mojood hain , aur unn kay peechay bhi . agar hum chahen to unn ko zameen mein dhansa den , ya aasman kay kuch tukrray unn per gira den . haqeeqat yeh hai kay iss mein her uss banday kay liye aik nishani hai jo Allah ki taraf rujoo kernay wala ho .

verses.text: aur waqiaa yeh hai kay hum ney dawood ko khaas apney paas say fazal ata kiya tha .  aey paharo ! tum bhi tasbeeh mein unn kay sath hum aawaz ban jao , aur aey parindon ! tum bhi .  aur hum ney unn kay liye lohey ko naram ker diya tha ,
verses.translation: aur waqiaa yeh hai kay hum ney dawood ko khaas apney paas say fazal ata kiya tha .  aey paharo ! tum bhi tasbeeh mein unn kay sath hum aawaz ban jao , aur aey parindon ! tum bhi .  aur hum ney unn kay liye lohey ko naram ker diya tha ,

verses.text: kay :  poori poori zirhen banao , aur karriyan jorrney mein tawazun say kaam lo ,   aur tum sabb log naik amal kero . tum jo amal bhi kertay ho , mein ussay dekh raha hun .
verses.translation: kay :  poori poori zirhen banao , aur karriyan jorrney mein tawazun say kaam lo ,   aur tum sabb log naik amal kero . tum jo amal bhi kertay ho , mein ussay dekh raha hun .

verses.text: aur suleman kay liye hum ney hawa ko tabey bana diya tha . uss ka subha ka safar bhi aik maheenay ki musafat ka hota tha , aur shaam ka safar bhi aik maheenay ki musafat ka .   aur hum ney unn kay liye tanbay ka chashma baha diya tha .   aur jinnaat mein say kuch woh thay jo apney perwerdigar kay hukum say unn kay aagay kaam kertay thay ,   aur ( hum ney unn per yeh baat wazeh kerdi thi kay ) unn mein say jo koi humaray hukum say hatt ker tairrah raasta ikhtiyar keray ga , ussay hum bharakti hoi aag ka maza chakhayen gay .
verses.translation: aur suleman kay liye hum ney hawa ko tabey bana diya tha . uss ka subha ka safar bhi aik maheenay ki musafat ka hota tha , aur shaam ka safar bhi aik maheenay ki musafat ka .   aur hum ney unn kay liye tanbay ka chashma baha diya tha .   aur jinnaat mein say kuch woh thay jo apney perwerdigar kay hukum say unn kay aagay kaam kertay thay ,   aur ( hum ney unn per yeh baat wazeh kerdi thi kay ) unn mein say jo koi humaray hukum say hatt ker tairrah raasta ikhtiyar keray ga , ussay hum bharakti hoi aag ka maza chakhayen gay .

verses.text: woh jinnaat suleman kay liye jo woh chahtay bana diya kertay thay : oonchi oonchi imaraten , tasweeren ,   hoz jaisay baray baray lagan aur zameen mein jami hoi degen ! :  aey dawood kay khandan walo ! tum aesay amal kiya kero jinn say shukar zahir ho . aur meray bandon mein kam log hain jo shukar guzar hon .
verses.translation: woh jinnaat suleman kay liye jo woh chahtay bana diya kertay thay : oonchi oonchi imaraten , tasweeren ,   hoz jaisay baray baray lagan aur zameen mein jami hoi degen ! :  aey dawood kay khandan walo ! tum aesay amal kiya kero jinn say shukar zahir ho . aur meray bandon mein kam log hain jo shukar guzar hon .

verses.text: phir jab hum ney suleman ki moat ka faisla kiya to unn jinnaat ko unn ki moat ka pata kissi aur ney nahi balkay zameen kay keeray ney diya jo unn kay asaa ko kha raha tha .   chunacheh jab woh gir parray to jinnaat ko maloom huwa kay agar woh ghaib ka ilm jantay hotay to iss zillat wali takleef mein mubtala naa rehtay .
verses.translation: phir jab hum ney suleman ki moat ka faisla kiya to unn jinnaat ko unn ki moat ka pata kissi aur ney nahi balkay zameen kay keeray ney diya jo unn kay asaa ko kha raha tha .   chunacheh jab woh gir parray to jinnaat ko maloom huwa kay agar woh ghaib ka ilm jantay hotay to iss zillat wali takleef mein mubtala naa rehtay .

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay qoam-e-saba kay liye khud uss jagah aik nishani mojood thi jahan woh raha kertay thay ,   dayen aur bayen dono taraf baaghon kay do silsilay thay ! :  apney perwerdigar ka diya huwa rizq khao , aur uss ka shukar baja lao , aik to shehar behtareen , doosray perwerdigar bakhshney wala !
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay qoam-e-saba kay liye khud uss jagah aik nishani mojood thi jahan woh raha kertay thay ,   dayen aur bayen dono taraf baaghon kay do silsilay thay ! :  apney perwerdigar ka diya huwa rizq khao , aur uss ka shukar baja lao , aik to shehar behtareen , doosray perwerdigar bakhshney wala !

verses.text: phir bhi unhon ney ( hidayat say ) mun morr liya , iss liye hum ney unn per band wala saylaab chorr diya , aur unn kay dono taraf kay baaghon ko aesay do baaghon mein tabdeel kerdiya jo bad-maza phalon , jahao kay darakhton aur thori si bairiyon per mushtamil thay .
verses.translation: phir bhi unhon ney ( hidayat say ) mun morr liya , iss liye hum ney unn per band wala saylaab chorr diya , aur unn kay dono taraf kay baaghon ko aesay do baaghon mein tabdeel kerdiya jo bad-maza phalon , jahao kay darakhton aur thori si bairiyon per mushtamil thay .

verses.text: yeh saza hum ney unn ko iss liye di kay unhon ney nashukri ki rawish ikhtiyar ki thi , aur aesi saza hum kissi aur ko nahi , baray baray nashukron hi ko diya kertay hain .
verses.translation: yeh saza hum ney unn ko iss liye di kay unhon ney nashukri ki rawish ikhtiyar ki thi , aur aesi saza hum kissi aur ko nahi , baray baray nashukron hi ko diya kertay hain .

verses.text: aur hum ney unn kay aur unn bastiyon kay darmiyan jinn per hum ney barkaten nazil ki hain ,   aesi bastiyan basa rakhi then jo door say nazar aati then , aur unn mein safar ko napay tulay marhalon mein baant diya tha   ( aur kaha tha kay )  inn ( bastiyon ) kay darmiyan raaten hon ya din , aman o aman kay sath safar kero
verses.translation: aur hum ney unn kay aur unn bastiyon kay darmiyan jinn per hum ney barkaten nazil ki hain ,   aesi bastiyan basa rakhi then jo door say nazar aati then , aur unn mein safar ko napay tulay marhalon mein baant diya tha   ( aur kaha tha kay )  inn ( bastiyon ) kay darmiyan raaten hon ya din , aman o aman kay sath safar kero

verses.text: iss per woh kehney lagay kay :  humaray perwerdigar ! humaray safar ki manzilon kay darmiyan door door kay faslay peda kerday  aur yun unhon ney apni janon per sitam dhaaya , jiss kay nateejay mein hum ney unhen afsana hi afsana bana diya , aur unhen tukrray tukrray ker kay bilkul tittar-bittar kerdiya .   yaqeenan iss waqaey mein her uss shaks kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo sabar o shukar ka khoogar ho .
verses.translation: iss per woh kehney lagay kay :  humaray perwerdigar ! humaray safar ki manzilon kay darmiyan door door kay faslay peda kerday  aur yun unhon ney apni janon per sitam dhaaya , jiss kay nateejay mein hum ney unhen afsana hi afsana bana diya , aur unhen tukrray tukrray ker kay bilkul tittar-bittar kerdiya .   yaqeenan iss waqaey mein her uss shaks kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo sabar o shukar ka khoogar ho .

verses.text: aur waqaee inn logon  kay baaray mein iblees ney apna khayal durust paya ,   chunacheh yeh ussi kay peechay chal parray , siwaye uss giroh kay jo momin tha .
verses.translation: aur waqaee inn logon  kay baaray mein iblees ney apna khayal durust paya ,   chunacheh yeh ussi kay peechay chal parray , siwaye uss giroh kay jo momin tha .

verses.text: aur iblees ko unn per koi tasallut nahi tha , albatta hum ( ney uss ko behkaney ki salahiyat iss liye di thi kay ) hum yeh dekhna chahtay thay kay kon hai jo aakhirat per emaan lata hai , aur kon hai jo uss kay baaray mein shak mein parra huwa hai .   aur tumhara perwerdigar her cheez per nigran hai .
verses.translation: aur iblees ko unn per koi tasallut nahi tha , albatta hum ( ney uss ko behkaney ki salahiyat iss liye di thi kay ) hum yeh dekhna chahtay thay kay kon hai jo aakhirat per emaan lata hai , aur kon hai jo uss kay baaray mein shak mein parra huwa hai .   aur tumhara perwerdigar her cheez per nigran hai .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn kafiron say ) kaho kay :  pukaro unn ko jinhen tum ney Allah kay siwa khuda samjha huwa hai . woh aasmano aur zameen mein zarra barabar kissi cheez kay malik nahi hain , naa unn ko aasman o zameen kay moamlaat mein ( Allah kay sath ) koi shirkat hasil hai , aur naa unn mein say koi Allah ka madadgaar hai .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn kafiron say ) kaho kay :  pukaro unn ko jinhen tum ney Allah kay siwa khuda samjha huwa hai . woh aasmano aur zameen mein zarra barabar kissi cheez kay malik nahi hain , naa unn ko aasman o zameen kay moamlaat mein ( Allah kay sath ) koi shirkat hasil hai , aur naa unn mein say koi Allah ka madadgaar hai .

verses.text: aur Allah kay samney koi sifarish kaar-aamad nahi hai , siwaye uss shaks kay jiss kay liye khud uss ney ( sifarish ki ) ijazat dey di ho , yahan tak kay jab unn kay dilon say ghabrahat door kerdi jati hai to woh kehtay hain kay :  tumharay rab ney kiya farmaya-? woh jawab detay hain kay :  haq baat irshad farmaee , aur wohi hai jo bara aalishaan hai .
verses.translation: aur Allah kay samney koi sifarish kaar-aamad nahi hai , siwaye uss shaks kay jiss kay liye khud uss ney ( sifarish ki ) ijazat dey di ho , yahan tak kay jab unn kay dilon say ghabrahat door kerdi jati hai to woh kehtay hain kay :  tumharay rab ney kiya farmaya-? woh jawab detay hain kay :  haq baat irshad farmaee , aur wohi hai jo bara aalishaan hai .

verses.text: kaho kay :  kon hai jo tumhen aasmano say aur zameen say rizq deta hai ?  kaho :  woh Allah hai ! aur hum hon ya tum , ya to hidayat per hain , ya khuli gumrahi mein mubtala hain .
verses.translation: kaho kay :  kon hai jo tumhen aasmano say aur zameen say rizq deta hai ?  kaho :  woh Allah hai ! aur hum hon ya tum , ya to hidayat per hain , ya khuli gumrahi mein mubtala hain .

verses.text: kaho kay :  hum ney jo jurm kiya ho , uss kay baaray mein tum say nahi poocha jaye ga , aur tum jo amal kertay ho , uss kay baaray mein hum say sawal nahi hoga .
verses.translation: kaho kay :  hum ney jo jurm kiya ho , uss kay baaray mein tum say nahi poocha jaye ga , aur tum jo amal kertay ho , uss kay baaray mein hum say sawal nahi hoga .

verses.text: kaho kay :  humara perwerdigar hum sabb ko jama keray ga , phir humaray darmiyan bar-haq faisla keray ga , aur wohi hai jo khoob faislay kernay wala , mukammal ilm ka malik hai .
verses.translation: kaho kay :  humara perwerdigar hum sabb ko jama keray ga , phir humaray darmiyan bar-haq faisla keray ga , aur wohi hai jo khoob faislay kernay wala , mukammal ilm ka malik hai .

verses.text: kaho kay :  zara mujhay dikhao woh kon hain jinhen tum ney shareek bana ker Allah say jorr rakha hai . hergiz nahi ! ( uss ka koi shareek nahi hai ) balkay woh Allah hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .
verses.translation: kaho kay :  zara mujhay dikhao woh kon hain jinhen tum ney shareek bana ker Allah say jorr rakha hai . hergiz nahi ! ( uss ka koi shareek nahi hai ) balkay woh Allah hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen saray hi insanon kay liye aisa Rasool bana ker bheja hai jo khushkhabri bhi sunaye , aur khabrdar bhi keray , lekin aksar log samajh nahi rahey hain .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen saray hi insanon kay liye aisa Rasool bana ker bheja hai jo khushkhabri bhi sunaye , aur khabrdar bhi keray , lekin aksar log samajh nahi rahey hain .

verses.text: aur ( tum say ) kehtay hain kay :  agar tum sachay ho to yeh ( qayamat ka ) wada kab poora hoga-?
verses.translation: aur ( tum say ) kehtay hain kay :  agar tum sachay ho to yeh ( qayamat ka ) wada kab poora hoga-?

verses.text: keh do kay :  tumharay liye aik aesay din ki miyaad muqarrar hai jiss say tum gharri barabar naa peechay hatt saktay ho , naa aagay jasaktay ho .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  tumharay liye aik aesay din ki miyaad muqarrar hai jiss say tum gharri barabar naa peechay hatt saktay ho , naa aagay jasaktay ho .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  hum naa to iss Quran per kabhi emaan layen gay , aur naa unn ( aasmani kitabon ) per jo iss say pehlay hoi hain .  aur agar tum uss waqt ka manzar dekho jab yeh zalim log apney perwerdigar kay samney kharray kiye jayen gay , to yeh aik doosray per baat daal rahey hon gay . jinn logon  ko ( duniya mein ) kamzor samjha gaya tha woh unn say kahen gay jo baray banay huye thay kay :  agar tum naa hotay to hum zaroor momin ban jatay .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  hum naa to iss Quran per kabhi emaan layen gay , aur naa unn ( aasmani kitabon ) per jo iss say pehlay hoi hain .  aur agar tum uss waqt ka manzar dekho jab yeh zalim log apney perwerdigar kay samney kharray kiye jayen gay , to yeh aik doosray per baat daal rahey hon gay . jinn logon  ko ( duniya mein ) kamzor samjha gaya tha woh unn say kahen gay jo baray banay huye thay kay :  agar tum naa hotay to hum zaroor momin ban jatay .

verses.text: jo baray banay huye thay , unn say kahen gay jinhen kamzor samjha gaya tha kay :  kiya hum ney tumhen hidayat say roka tha jabkay woh tumharay paas aa-chuki thi ? asal baat yeh hai kay tum khud mujrim thay .
verses.translation: jo baray banay huye thay , unn say kahen gay jinhen kamzor samjha gaya tha kay :  kiya hum ney tumhen hidayat say roka tha jabkay woh tumharay paas aa-chuki thi ? asal baat yeh hai kay tum khud mujrim thay .

verses.text: aur jinhen kamzor samjha gaya tha woh unn say kahen gay jo baray banay huye thay kay :  nahi , yeh tumhari raat din ki makkaari hi to thi ( jiss ney hamen roka tha ) jab tum hamen takeed kertay thay kay hum Allah say kufr ka moamla keren , aur uss kay sath ( doosron ko ) shareek maanen .  aur yeh sabb jab azab ko dekh len gay to apna pachtawa chupa rahey hon gay .   aur jinn jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya tha , hum unn sabb kay galon mein toq daal den gay . unn ko kissi aur baat ka nahi , unhi aemal ka badla diya jaye ga jo woh kiya kertay thay .
