verses.translation: aur jinhen kamzor samjha gaya tha woh unn say kahen gay jo baray banay huye thay kay :  nahi , yeh tumhari raat din ki makkaari hi to thi ( jiss ney hamen roka tha ) jab tum hamen takeed kertay thay kay hum Allah say kufr ka moamla keren , aur uss kay sath ( doosron ko ) shareek maanen .  aur yeh sabb jab azab ko dekh len gay to apna pachtawa chupa rahey hon gay .   aur jinn jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya tha , hum unn sabb kay galon mein toq daal den gay . unn ko kissi aur baat ka nahi , unhi aemal ka badla diya jaye ga jo woh kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: aur jiss kissi basti mein hum ney koi khabrdar kernay wala payghumber bheja , uss kay khush haal logon  ney yehi kaha kay :  jiss paygham kay sath tumhen bheja gaya hai , hum uss ko manney say inkar kertay hain .
verses.translation: aur jiss kissi basti mein hum ney koi khabrdar kernay wala payghumber bheja , uss kay khush haal logon  ney yehi kaha kay :  jiss paygham kay sath tumhen bheja gaya hai , hum uss ko manney say inkar kertay hain .

verses.text: aur kaha kay :  hum maal aur aulad mein tum say ziyada hain aur hamen azab honey wala nahi hai .
verses.translation: aur kaha kay :  hum maal aur aulad mein tum say ziyada hain aur hamen azab honey wala nahi hai .

verses.text: keh do kay :  mera perwerdigar jiss kay liye chahta hai , rizq ki farawaani ker deta hai , aur ( jiss kay liye chahta hai ) tangi ker deta hai , lekin aksar log iss baat ko samajhtay nahi hain .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  mera perwerdigar jiss kay liye chahta hai , rizq ki farawaani ker deta hai , aur ( jiss kay liye chahta hai ) tangi ker deta hai , lekin aksar log iss baat ko samajhtay nahi hain .

verses.text: aur naa tumharay maal tumhen humarey huzoor koi qurb ata kertay hain aur naa tumhari aulad . haan magar jo emaan laye aur naik amal keray to aesay logon  ko unn kay amal ka dohra sawab milay ga , aur woh ( jannat kay ) bala-khanon mein chain keren gay .
verses.translation: aur naa tumharay maal tumhen humarey huzoor koi qurb ata kertay hain aur naa tumhari aulad . haan magar jo emaan laye aur naik amal keray to aesay logon  ko unn kay amal ka dohra sawab milay ga , aur woh ( jannat kay ) bala-khanon mein chain keren gay .

verses.text: aur jo log humari aayaton kay baaray mein yeh koshish kertay hain kay unn ko nakam banayen , unn ko azab mein dhar liya jaye ga .
verses.translation: aur jo log humari aayaton kay baaray mein yeh koshish kertay hain kay unn ko nakam banayen , unn ko azab mein dhar liya jaye ga .

verses.text: keh do kay :  mera perwerdigar apney bandon mein say jiss kay liye chahta hai rizq ki farawaani ker deta hai , aur ( jiss kay liye chahta hai ) tangi ker deta hai . aur tum jo cheez bhi kharch kertay ho , woh uss ki jagah aur cheez dey deta hai , aur wohi sabb say behtar rizq denay wala hai .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  mera perwerdigar apney bandon mein say jiss kay liye chahta hai rizq ki farawaani ker deta hai , aur ( jiss kay liye chahta hai ) tangi ker deta hai . aur tum jo cheez bhi kharch kertay ho , woh uss ki jagah aur cheez dey deta hai , aur wohi sabb say behtar rizq denay wala hai .

verses.text: aur woh din naa bhoolo jab Allah inn sabb ko jama keray ga , phir farishton say kahey ga kay :  kiya yeh log waqaee tumhari ibadat kiya kertay thay ?
verses.translation: aur woh din naa bhoolo jab Allah inn sabb ko jama keray ga , phir farishton say kahey ga kay :  kiya yeh log waqaee tumhari ibadat kiya kertay thay ?

verses.text: woh kahen gay kay :  hum to aap ki zaat ki paki biyan kertay hain , humara talluq aap say hai , inn logon  say nahi . darasal yeh to jinnaat ki ibadat kiya kertay thay .   unn mein say aksar log unhi kay moataqid thay .
verses.translation: woh kahen gay kay :  hum to aap ki zaat ki paki biyan kertay hain , humara talluq aap say hai , inn logon  say nahi . darasal yeh to jinnaat ki ibadat kiya kertay thay .   unn mein say aksar log unhi kay moataqid thay .

verses.text: lehaza aaj tum mein say koi naa kissi ko koi faeeda phonchaney ka ikhtiyar rakhta hai , naa nuqsan phonchaney ka . aur jinn logon  ney zulm ki rawish ikhtiyar ki thi , unn say hum kahen gay kay :  uss aag ka maza chakho jiss ko tum jhutlaya kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: lehaza aaj tum mein say koi naa kissi ko koi faeeda phonchaney ka ikhtiyar rakhta hai , naa nuqsan phonchaney ka . aur jinn logon  ney zulm ki rawish ikhtiyar ki thi , unn say hum kahen gay kay :  uss aag ka maza chakho jiss ko tum jhutlaya kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: aur jab humari aayaten jo mukammal wazahat ki hamil hain unn ko parh ker sunai jati hain to yeh ( humaray payghumber kay baaray mein ) kehtay hain kay :  kuch nahi , yeh shaks bus yeh chahta hai kay tum logon  ko unn maboodon say bargushta kerday jinhen tumharay baap daday poojtay aaye hain .  aur kehtay hain kay :  yeh ( Quran ) kuch bhi nahi , aik mann gharrat jhoot hai .  aur jab inn kafiron kay paas haq ka paygham aaya to unhon ney uss kay baaray mein yeh kaha kay :  yeh to aik khulay jadoo kay siwa kuch nahi hai .
verses.translation: aur jab humari aayaten jo mukammal wazahat ki hamil hain unn ko parh ker sunai jati hain to yeh ( humaray payghumber kay baaray mein ) kehtay hain kay :  kuch nahi , yeh shaks bus yeh chahta hai kay tum logon  ko unn maboodon say bargushta kerday jinhen tumharay baap daday poojtay aaye hain .  aur kehtay hain kay :  yeh ( Quran ) kuch bhi nahi , aik mann gharrat jhoot hai .  aur jab inn kafiron kay paas haq ka paygham aaya to unhon ney uss kay baaray mein yeh kaha kay :  yeh to aik khulay jadoo kay siwa kuch nahi hai .

verses.text: halankay hum ney enhen pehlay naa aesi kitaben di then jo yeh parhtay parhatay hon , aur naa ( aey payghumber ! ) tum say pehlay hum ney inn kay paas koi khabrdar kernay wala ( nabi ) bheja tha .
verses.translation: halankay hum ney enhen pehlay naa aesi kitaben di then jo yeh parhtay parhatay hon , aur naa ( aey payghumber ! ) tum say pehlay hum ney inn kay paas koi khabrdar kernay wala ( nabi ) bheja tha .

verses.text: aur inn say pehlay logon  ney bhi ( payghumberon ) ko jhutlaya tha , aur yeh ( arab kay mushrikeen ) to uss saz-o-saman kay daswen hissay ko bhi nahi phonchay hain jo hum ney unn ( pehlay logon  ) ko dey rakha tha , phir bhi unhon ney meray payghumberon ko jhutlaya , to ( dekh lo kay ) meri di hoi saza kaisi ( sakht ) thi !
verses.translation: aur inn say pehlay logon  ney bhi ( payghumberon ) ko jhutlaya tha , aur yeh ( arab kay mushrikeen ) to uss saz-o-saman kay daswen hissay ko bhi nahi phonchay hain jo hum ney unn ( pehlay logon  ) ko dey rakha tha , phir bhi unhon ney meray payghumberon ko jhutlaya , to ( dekh lo kay ) meri di hoi saza kaisi ( sakht ) thi !
