verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! tumhen unn ki halat ajeeb nazar aaye gi ) agar tum woh manzar dekho jab yeh ghabraye phirtay hon gay , aur bhag nikalney ka koi raasta nahi hoga , aur unhen qareeb hi say pakar liya jaye ga .

verses.text: aur ( uss waqt ) yeh kahen gay kay :  hum iss per emaan ley aaye hain  , halankay itni door jagah say unn ko koi cheez kaisay haath aa-sakti hai ?
verses.translation: aur ( uss waqt ) yeh kahen gay kay :  hum iss per emaan ley aaye hain  , halankay itni door jagah say unn ko koi cheez kaisay haath aa-sakti hai ?

verses.text: jabkay unhon ney pehlay iss ka inkar kiya tha , aur door door say atkal pacho teer phenka kertay thay .
verses.translation: jabkay unhon ney pehlay iss ka inkar kiya tha , aur door door say atkal pacho teer phenka kertay thay .

verses.text: aur uss waqt yeh jiss ( emaan ) ki aarzoo keren gay , uss kay aur inn kay darmiyan aik aarr kerdi jaye gi , jaisa kay inn jaisay jo log inn say pehlay huye hain , unn kay sath bhi yehi moamla hoga . haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh sabb aesay shak mein parray huye thay jiss ney enhen dhokay mein daal rakha tha .
verses.translation: aur uss waqt yeh jiss ( emaan ) ki aarzoo keren gay , uss kay aur inn kay darmiyan aik aarr kerdi jaye gi , jaisa kay inn jaisay jo log inn say pehlay huye hain , unn kay sath bhi yehi moamla hoga . haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh sabb aesay shak mein parray huye thay jiss ney enhen dhokay mein daal rakha tha .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: tamam tarr tareef uss Allah ki hai jiss ki sift yeh hai kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , sabb ussi ka hai , aur aakhirat mein bhi tareef ussi ki hai , aur wohi hai jo hikmat ka malik hai , mukammal tor per ba-khabar !
ayahs.translation: tamam tarr tareef uss Allah ki hai jiss ki sift yeh hai kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , sabb ussi ka hai , aur aakhirat mein bhi tareef ussi ki hai , aur wohi hai jo hikmat ka malik hai , mukammal tor per ba-khabar !

ayahs.text: woh unn cheezon ko bhi janta hai jo zameen kay andar jati hain , aur unn ko bhi jo uss say bahir nikalti hain , unn ko bhi jo aasman say utarti hain , aur unn ko bhi jo uss mein charrti hain , aur wohi hai jo bara meharban hai , boht bakhshney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: woh unn cheezon ko bhi janta hai jo zameen kay andar jati hain , aur unn ko bhi jo uss say bahir nikalti hain , unn ko bhi jo aasman say utarti hain , aur unn ko bhi jo uss mein charrti hain , aur wohi hai jo bara meharban hai , boht bakhshney wala hai .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  hum per qayamat nahi aaye gi  keh do :  kiyon nahi aaye gi ? meray aalam-ul-ghaib perwerdigar ki qasam ! woh tum per zaroor aa-ker rahey gi . koi zarra barabar cheez uss ki nazar say door nahi hoti ,   naa aasmano mein , naa zameen mein , aur naa uss say choti koi cheez aesi hai naa bari jo aik khuli kitab ( yani loah-e-mehfooz ) mein darj naa ho .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  hum per qayamat nahi aaye gi  keh do :  kiyon nahi aaye gi ? meray aalam-ul-ghaib perwerdigar ki qasam ! woh tum per zaroor aa-ker rahey gi . koi zarra barabar cheez uss ki nazar say door nahi hoti ,   naa aasmano mein , naa zameen mein , aur naa uss say choti koi cheez aesi hai naa bari jo aik khuli kitab ( yani loah-e-mehfooz ) mein darj naa ho .

ayahs.text: . ( aur qayamat iss liye aaye gi ) takay jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , Allah unn ko inaam dey . aesay logon  kay liye maghfirat hai , aur ba-izzat rizq .
ayahs.translation: . ( aur qayamat iss liye aaye gi ) takay jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , Allah unn ko inaam dey . aesay logon  kay liye maghfirat hai , aur ba-izzat rizq .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney humari aayaton kay baaray mein yeh koshish ki hai kay unhen nakam banayen , unn kay liye bala ka dardnak azab hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney humari aayaton kay baaray mein yeh koshish ki hai kay unhen nakam banayen , unn kay liye bala ka dardnak azab hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jinn logon  ko ilm ata huwa hai , woh khoob samajhtay hain kay tum per tumharay rab ki taraf say jo kuch nazil kiya gaya hai , woh haq hai , aur uss ( Allah ) ka raasta dikhata hai jo iqtidar ka malik bhi hai , her tareef ka mustahiq bhi .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jinn logon  ko ilm ata huwa hai , woh khoob samajhtay hain kay tum per tumharay rab ki taraf say jo kuch nazil kiya gaya hai , woh haq hai , aur uss ( Allah ) ka raasta dikhata hai jo iqtidar ka malik bhi hai , her tareef ka mustahiq bhi .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kafir log ( aik doosray say ) kehney lagay :  kiya hum tumhen aik aesay shaks ka pata batayen jo tumhen yeh khabar deta hai kay jab tum ( mar ker ) bilkul reza reza hochuko gay uss waqt tum aik naye janam mein aao gay ?
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kafir log ( aik doosray say ) kehney lagay :  kiya hum tumhen aik aesay shaks ka pata batayen jo tumhen yeh khabar deta hai kay jab tum ( mar ker ) bilkul reza reza hochuko gay uss waqt tum aik naye janam mein aao gay ?

ayahs.text: pata nahi uss shaks ney Allah per jhoot baandha hai , ya ussay kissi tarah ka junoon laahaq hai ?  nahi ! balkay haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay woh khud azab mein aur perlay darjay ki gumrahi mein mubtala hain .
ayahs.translation: pata nahi uss shaks ney Allah per jhoot baandha hai , ya ussay kissi tarah ka junoon laahaq hai ?  nahi ! balkay haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay woh khud azab mein aur perlay darjay ki gumrahi mein mubtala hain .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya inn logon  ney uss aasman o zameen ko nahi dekha jo unn kay aagay bhi mojood hain , aur unn kay peechay bhi . agar hum chahen to unn ko zameen mein dhansa den , ya aasman kay kuch tukrray unn per gira den . haqeeqat yeh hai kay iss mein her uss banday kay liye aik nishani hai jo Allah ki taraf rujoo kernay wala ho .
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya inn logon  ney uss aasman o zameen ko nahi dekha jo unn kay aagay bhi mojood hain , aur unn kay peechay bhi . agar hum chahen to unn ko zameen mein dhansa den , ya aasman kay kuch tukrray unn per gira den . haqeeqat yeh hai kay iss mein her uss banday kay liye aik nishani hai jo Allah ki taraf rujoo kernay wala ho .

ayahs.text: aur waqiaa yeh hai kay hum ney dawood ko khaas apney paas say fazal ata kiya tha .  aey paharo ! tum bhi tasbeeh mein unn kay sath hum aawaz ban jao , aur aey parindon ! tum bhi .  aur hum ney unn kay liye lohey ko naram ker diya tha ,
ayahs.translation: aur waqiaa yeh hai kay hum ney dawood ko khaas apney paas say fazal ata kiya tha .  aey paharo ! tum bhi tasbeeh mein unn kay sath hum aawaz ban jao , aur aey parindon ! tum bhi .  aur hum ney unn kay liye lohey ko naram ker diya tha ,

ayahs.text: kay :  poori poori zirhen banao , aur karriyan jorrney mein tawazun say kaam lo ,   aur tum sabb log naik amal kero . tum jo amal bhi kertay ho , mein ussay dekh raha hun .
ayahs.translation: kay :  poori poori zirhen banao , aur karriyan jorrney mein tawazun say kaam lo ,   aur tum sabb log naik amal kero . tum jo amal bhi kertay ho , mein ussay dekh raha hun .

ayahs.text: aur suleman kay liye hum ney hawa ko tabey bana diya tha . uss ka subha ka safar bhi aik maheenay ki musafat ka hota tha , aur shaam ka safar bhi aik maheenay ki musafat ka .   aur hum ney unn kay liye tanbay ka chashma baha diya tha .   aur jinnaat mein say kuch woh thay jo apney perwerdigar kay hukum say unn kay aagay kaam kertay thay ,   aur ( hum ney unn per yeh baat wazeh kerdi thi kay ) unn mein say jo koi humaray hukum say hatt ker tairrah raasta ikhtiyar keray ga , ussay hum bharakti hoi aag ka maza chakhayen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur suleman kay liye hum ney hawa ko tabey bana diya tha . uss ka subha ka safar bhi aik maheenay ki musafat ka hota tha , aur shaam ka safar bhi aik maheenay ki musafat ka .   aur hum ney unn kay liye tanbay ka chashma baha diya tha .   aur jinnaat mein say kuch woh thay jo apney perwerdigar kay hukum say unn kay aagay kaam kertay thay ,   aur ( hum ney unn per yeh baat wazeh kerdi thi kay ) unn mein say jo koi humaray hukum say hatt ker tairrah raasta ikhtiyar keray ga , ussay hum bharakti hoi aag ka maza chakhayen gay .

ayahs.text: woh jinnaat suleman kay liye jo woh chahtay bana diya kertay thay : oonchi oonchi imaraten , tasweeren ,   hoz jaisay baray baray lagan aur zameen mein jami hoi degen ! :  aey dawood kay khandan walo ! tum aesay amal kiya kero jinn say shukar zahir ho . aur meray bandon mein kam log hain jo shukar guzar hon .
ayahs.translation: woh jinnaat suleman kay liye jo woh chahtay bana diya kertay thay : oonchi oonchi imaraten , tasweeren ,   hoz jaisay baray baray lagan aur zameen mein jami hoi degen ! :  aey dawood kay khandan walo ! tum aesay amal kiya kero jinn say shukar zahir ho . aur meray bandon mein kam log hain jo shukar guzar hon .

ayahs.text: phir jab hum ney suleman ki moat ka faisla kiya to unn jinnaat ko unn ki moat ka pata kissi aur ney nahi balkay zameen kay keeray ney diya jo unn kay asaa ko kha raha tha .   chunacheh jab woh gir parray to jinnaat ko maloom huwa kay agar woh ghaib ka ilm jantay hotay to iss zillat wali takleef mein mubtala naa rehtay .
ayahs.translation: phir jab hum ney suleman ki moat ka faisla kiya to unn jinnaat ko unn ki moat ka pata kissi aur ney nahi balkay zameen kay keeray ney diya jo unn kay asaa ko kha raha tha .   chunacheh jab woh gir parray to jinnaat ko maloom huwa kay agar woh ghaib ka ilm jantay hotay to iss zillat wali takleef mein mubtala naa rehtay .

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay qoam-e-saba kay liye khud uss jagah aik nishani mojood thi jahan woh raha kertay thay ,   dayen aur bayen dono taraf baaghon kay do silsilay thay ! :  apney perwerdigar ka diya huwa rizq khao , aur uss ka shukar baja lao , aik to shehar behtareen , doosray perwerdigar bakhshney wala !
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay qoam-e-saba kay liye khud uss jagah aik nishani mojood thi jahan woh raha kertay thay ,   dayen aur bayen dono taraf baaghon kay do silsilay thay ! :  apney perwerdigar ka diya huwa rizq khao , aur uss ka shukar baja lao , aik to shehar behtareen , doosray perwerdigar bakhshney wala !

ayahs.text: phir bhi unhon ney ( hidayat say ) mun morr liya , iss liye hum ney unn per band wala saylaab chorr diya , aur unn kay dono taraf kay baaghon ko aesay do baaghon mein tabdeel kerdiya jo bad-maza phalon , jahao kay darakhton aur thori si bairiyon per mushtamil thay .
ayahs.translation: phir bhi unhon ney ( hidayat say ) mun morr liya , iss liye hum ney unn per band wala saylaab chorr diya , aur unn kay dono taraf kay baaghon ko aesay do baaghon mein tabdeel kerdiya jo bad-maza phalon , jahao kay darakhton aur thori si bairiyon per mushtamil thay .

ayahs.text: yeh saza hum ney unn ko iss liye di kay unhon ney nashukri ki rawish ikhtiyar ki thi , aur aesi saza hum kissi aur ko nahi , baray baray nashukron hi ko diya kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: yeh saza hum ney unn ko iss liye di kay unhon ney nashukri ki rawish ikhtiyar ki thi , aur aesi saza hum kissi aur ko nahi , baray baray nashukron hi ko diya kertay hain .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney unn kay aur unn bastiyon kay darmiyan jinn per hum ney barkaten nazil ki hain ,   aesi bastiyan basa rakhi then jo door say nazar aati then , aur unn mein safar ko napay tulay marhalon mein baant diya tha   ( aur kaha tha kay )  inn ( bastiyon ) kay darmiyan raaten hon ya din , aman o aman kay sath safar kero
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney unn kay aur unn bastiyon kay darmiyan jinn per hum ney barkaten nazil ki hain ,   aesi bastiyan basa rakhi then jo door say nazar aati then , aur unn mein safar ko napay tulay marhalon mein baant diya tha   ( aur kaha tha kay )  inn ( bastiyon ) kay darmiyan raaten hon ya din , aman o aman kay sath safar kero

ayahs.text: iss per woh kehney lagay kay :  humaray perwerdigar ! humaray safar ki manzilon kay darmiyan door door kay faslay peda kerday  aur yun unhon ney apni janon per sitam dhaaya , jiss kay nateejay mein hum ney unhen afsana hi afsana bana diya , aur unhen tukrray tukrray ker kay bilkul tittar-bittar kerdiya .   yaqeenan iss waqaey mein her uss shaks kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo sabar o shukar ka khoogar ho .
ayahs.translation: iss per woh kehney lagay kay :  humaray perwerdigar ! humaray safar ki manzilon kay darmiyan door door kay faslay peda kerday  aur yun unhon ney apni janon per sitam dhaaya , jiss kay nateejay mein hum ney unhen afsana hi afsana bana diya , aur unhen tukrray tukrray ker kay bilkul tittar-bittar kerdiya .   yaqeenan iss waqaey mein her uss shaks kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo sabar o shukar ka khoogar ho .

ayahs.text: aur waqaee inn logon  kay baaray mein iblees ney apna khayal durust paya ,   chunacheh yeh ussi kay peechay chal parray , siwaye uss giroh kay jo momin tha .
ayahs.translation: aur waqaee inn logon  kay baaray mein iblees ney apna khayal durust paya ,   chunacheh yeh ussi kay peechay chal parray , siwaye uss giroh kay jo momin tha .

ayahs.text: aur iblees ko unn per koi tasallut nahi tha , albatta hum ( ney uss ko behkaney ki salahiyat iss liye di thi kay ) hum yeh dekhna chahtay thay kay kon hai jo aakhirat per emaan lata hai , aur kon hai jo uss kay baaray mein shak mein parra huwa hai .   aur tumhara perwerdigar her cheez per nigran hai .
ayahs.translation: aur iblees ko unn per koi tasallut nahi tha , albatta hum ( ney uss ko behkaney ki salahiyat iss liye di thi kay ) hum yeh dekhna chahtay thay kay kon hai jo aakhirat per emaan lata hai , aur kon hai jo uss kay baaray mein shak mein parra huwa hai .   aur tumhara perwerdigar her cheez per nigran hai .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn kafiron say ) kaho kay :  pukaro unn ko jinhen tum ney Allah kay siwa khuda samjha huwa hai . woh aasmano aur zameen mein zarra barabar kissi cheez kay malik nahi hain , naa unn ko aasman o zameen kay moamlaat mein ( Allah kay sath ) koi shirkat hasil hai , aur naa unn mein say koi Allah ka madadgaar hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn kafiron say ) kaho kay :  pukaro unn ko jinhen tum ney Allah kay siwa khuda samjha huwa hai . woh aasmano aur zameen mein zarra barabar kissi cheez kay malik nahi hain , naa unn ko aasman o zameen kay moamlaat mein ( Allah kay sath ) koi shirkat hasil hai , aur naa unn mein say koi Allah ka madadgaar hai .

ayahs.text: aur Allah kay samney koi sifarish kaar-aamad nahi hai , siwaye uss shaks kay jiss kay liye khud uss ney ( sifarish ki ) ijazat dey di ho , yahan tak kay jab unn kay dilon say ghabrahat door kerdi jati hai to woh kehtay hain kay :  tumharay rab ney kiya farmaya-? woh jawab detay hain kay :  haq baat irshad farmaee , aur wohi hai jo bara aalishaan hai .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah kay samney koi sifarish kaar-aamad nahi hai , siwaye uss shaks kay jiss kay liye khud uss ney ( sifarish ki ) ijazat dey di ho , yahan tak kay jab unn kay dilon say ghabrahat door kerdi jati hai to woh kehtay hain kay :  tumharay rab ney kiya farmaya-? woh jawab detay hain kay :  haq baat irshad farmaee , aur wohi hai jo bara aalishaan hai .

ayahs.text: kaho kay :  kon hai jo tumhen aasmano say aur zameen say rizq deta hai ?  kaho :  woh Allah hai ! aur hum hon ya tum , ya to hidayat per hain , ya khuli gumrahi mein mubtala hain .
ayahs.translation: kaho kay :  kon hai jo tumhen aasmano say aur zameen say rizq deta hai ?  kaho :  woh Allah hai ! aur hum hon ya tum , ya to hidayat per hain , ya khuli gumrahi mein mubtala hain .

ayahs.text: kaho kay :  hum ney jo jurm kiya ho , uss kay baaray mein tum say nahi poocha jaye ga , aur tum jo amal kertay ho , uss kay baaray mein hum say sawal nahi hoga .
ayahs.translation: kaho kay :  hum ney jo jurm kiya ho , uss kay baaray mein tum say nahi poocha jaye ga , aur tum jo amal kertay ho , uss kay baaray mein hum say sawal nahi hoga .

ayahs.text: kaho kay :  humara perwerdigar hum sabb ko jama keray ga , phir humaray darmiyan bar-haq faisla keray ga , aur wohi hai jo khoob faislay kernay wala , mukammal ilm ka malik hai .
ayahs.translation: kaho kay :  humara perwerdigar hum sabb ko jama keray ga , phir humaray darmiyan bar-haq faisla keray ga , aur wohi hai jo khoob faislay kernay wala , mukammal ilm ka malik hai .

ayahs.text: kaho kay :  zara mujhay dikhao woh kon hain jinhen tum ney shareek bana ker Allah say jorr rakha hai . hergiz nahi ! ( uss ka koi shareek nahi hai ) balkay woh Allah hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .
ayahs.translation: kaho kay :  zara mujhay dikhao woh kon hain jinhen tum ney shareek bana ker Allah say jorr rakha hai . hergiz nahi ! ( uss ka koi shareek nahi hai ) balkay woh Allah hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen saray hi insanon kay liye aisa Rasool bana ker bheja hai jo khushkhabri bhi sunaye , aur khabrdar bhi keray , lekin aksar log samajh nahi rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen saray hi insanon kay liye aisa Rasool bana ker bheja hai jo khushkhabri bhi sunaye , aur khabrdar bhi keray , lekin aksar log samajh nahi rahey hain .

ayahs.text: aur ( tum say ) kehtay hain kay :  agar tum sachay ho to yeh ( qayamat ka ) wada kab poora hoga-?
ayahs.translation: aur ( tum say ) kehtay hain kay :  agar tum sachay ho to yeh ( qayamat ka ) wada kab poora hoga-?

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  tumharay liye aik aesay din ki miyaad muqarrar hai jiss say tum gharri barabar naa peechay hatt saktay ho , naa aagay jasaktay ho .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  tumharay liye aik aesay din ki miyaad muqarrar hai jiss say tum gharri barabar naa peechay hatt saktay ho , naa aagay jasaktay ho .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  hum naa to iss Quran per kabhi emaan layen gay , aur naa unn ( aasmani kitabon ) per jo iss say pehlay hoi hain .  aur agar tum uss waqt ka manzar dekho jab yeh zalim log apney perwerdigar kay samney kharray kiye jayen gay , to yeh aik doosray per baat daal rahey hon gay . jinn logon  ko ( duniya mein ) kamzor samjha gaya tha woh unn say kahen gay jo baray banay huye thay kay :  agar tum naa hotay to hum zaroor momin ban jatay .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  hum naa to iss Quran per kabhi emaan layen gay , aur naa unn ( aasmani kitabon ) per jo iss say pehlay hoi hain .  aur agar tum uss waqt ka manzar dekho jab yeh zalim log apney perwerdigar kay samney kharray kiye jayen gay , to yeh aik doosray per baat daal rahey hon gay . jinn logon  ko ( duniya mein ) kamzor samjha gaya tha woh unn say kahen gay jo baray banay huye thay kay :  agar tum naa hotay to hum zaroor momin ban jatay .

ayahs.text: jo baray banay huye thay , unn say kahen gay jinhen kamzor samjha gaya tha kay :  kiya hum ney tumhen hidayat say roka tha jabkay woh tumharay paas aa-chuki thi ? asal baat yeh hai kay tum khud mujrim thay .
ayahs.translation: jo baray banay huye thay , unn say kahen gay jinhen kamzor samjha gaya tha kay :  kiya hum ney tumhen hidayat say roka tha jabkay woh tumharay paas aa-chuki thi ? asal baat yeh hai kay tum khud mujrim thay .

ayahs.text: aur jinhen kamzor samjha gaya tha woh unn say kahen gay jo baray banay huye thay kay :  nahi , yeh tumhari raat din ki makkaari hi to thi ( jiss ney hamen roka tha ) jab tum hamen takeed kertay thay kay hum Allah say kufr ka moamla keren , aur uss kay sath ( doosron ko ) shareek maanen .  aur yeh sabb jab azab ko dekh len gay to apna pachtawa chupa rahey hon gay .   aur jinn jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya tha , hum unn sabb kay galon mein toq daal den gay . unn ko kissi aur baat ka nahi , unhi aemal ka badla diya jaye ga jo woh kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: aur jinhen kamzor samjha gaya tha woh unn say kahen gay jo baray banay huye thay kay :  nahi , yeh tumhari raat din ki makkaari hi to thi ( jiss ney hamen roka tha ) jab tum hamen takeed kertay thay kay hum Allah say kufr ka moamla keren , aur uss kay sath ( doosron ko ) shareek maanen .  aur yeh sabb jab azab ko dekh len gay to apna pachtawa chupa rahey hon gay .   aur jinn jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya tha , hum unn sabb kay galon mein toq daal den gay . unn ko kissi aur baat ka nahi , unhi aemal ka badla diya jaye ga jo woh kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: aur jiss kissi basti mein hum ney koi khabrdar kernay wala payghumber bheja , uss kay khush haal logon  ney yehi kaha kay :  jiss paygham kay sath tumhen bheja gaya hai , hum uss ko manney say inkar kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jiss kissi basti mein hum ney koi khabrdar kernay wala payghumber bheja , uss kay khush haal logon  ney yehi kaha kay :  jiss paygham kay sath tumhen bheja gaya hai , hum uss ko manney say inkar kertay hain .

ayahs.text: aur kaha kay :  hum maal aur aulad mein tum say ziyada hain aur hamen azab honey wala nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur kaha kay :  hum maal aur aulad mein tum say ziyada hain aur hamen azab honey wala nahi hai .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  mera perwerdigar jiss kay liye chahta hai , rizq ki farawaani ker deta hai , aur ( jiss kay liye chahta hai ) tangi ker deta hai , lekin aksar log iss baat ko samajhtay nahi hain .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  mera perwerdigar jiss kay liye chahta hai , rizq ki farawaani ker deta hai , aur ( jiss kay liye chahta hai ) tangi ker deta hai , lekin aksar log iss baat ko samajhtay nahi hain .

ayahs.text: aur naa tumharay maal tumhen humarey huzoor koi qurb ata kertay hain aur naa tumhari aulad . haan magar jo emaan laye aur naik amal keray to aesay logon  ko unn kay amal ka dohra sawab milay ga , aur woh ( jannat kay ) bala-khanon mein chain keren gay .
ayahs.translation: aur naa tumharay maal tumhen humarey huzoor koi qurb ata kertay hain aur naa tumhari aulad . haan magar jo emaan laye aur naik amal keray to aesay logon  ko unn kay amal ka dohra sawab milay ga , aur woh ( jannat kay ) bala-khanon mein chain keren gay .

ayahs.text: aur jo log humari aayaton kay baaray mein yeh koshish kertay hain kay unn ko nakam banayen , unn ko azab mein dhar liya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log humari aayaton kay baaray mein yeh koshish kertay hain kay unn ko nakam banayen , unn ko azab mein dhar liya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  mera perwerdigar apney bandon mein say jiss kay liye chahta hai rizq ki farawaani ker deta hai , aur ( jiss kay liye chahta hai ) tangi ker deta hai . aur tum jo cheez bhi kharch kertay ho , woh uss ki jagah aur cheez dey deta hai , aur wohi sabb say behtar rizq denay wala hai .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  mera perwerdigar apney bandon mein say jiss kay liye chahta hai rizq ki farawaani ker deta hai , aur ( jiss kay liye chahta hai ) tangi ker deta hai . aur tum jo cheez bhi kharch kertay ho , woh uss ki jagah aur cheez dey deta hai , aur wohi sabb say behtar rizq denay wala hai .

ayahs.text: aur woh din naa bhoolo jab Allah inn sabb ko jama keray ga , phir farishton say kahey ga kay :  kiya yeh log waqaee tumhari ibadat kiya kertay thay ?
ayahs.translation: aur woh din naa bhoolo jab Allah inn sabb ko jama keray ga , phir farishton say kahey ga kay :  kiya yeh log waqaee tumhari ibadat kiya kertay thay ?

ayahs.text: woh kahen gay kay :  hum to aap ki zaat ki paki biyan kertay hain , humara talluq aap say hai , inn logon  say nahi . darasal yeh to jinnaat ki ibadat kiya kertay thay .   unn mein say aksar log unhi kay moataqid thay .
ayahs.translation: woh kahen gay kay :  hum to aap ki zaat ki paki biyan kertay hain , humara talluq aap say hai , inn logon  say nahi . darasal yeh to jinnaat ki ibadat kiya kertay thay .   unn mein say aksar log unhi kay moataqid thay .

ayahs.text: lehaza aaj tum mein say koi naa kissi ko koi faeeda phonchaney ka ikhtiyar rakhta hai , naa nuqsan phonchaney ka . aur jinn logon  ney zulm ki rawish ikhtiyar ki thi , unn say hum kahen gay kay :  uss aag ka maza chakho jiss ko tum jhutlaya kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: lehaza aaj tum mein say koi naa kissi ko koi faeeda phonchaney ka ikhtiyar rakhta hai , naa nuqsan phonchaney ka . aur jinn logon  ney zulm ki rawish ikhtiyar ki thi , unn say hum kahen gay kay :  uss aag ka maza chakho jiss ko tum jhutlaya kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: aur jab humari aayaten jo mukammal wazahat ki hamil hain unn ko parh ker sunai jati hain to yeh ( humaray payghumber kay baaray mein ) kehtay hain kay :  kuch nahi , yeh shaks bus yeh chahta hai kay tum logon  ko unn maboodon say bargushta kerday jinhen tumharay baap daday poojtay aaye hain .  aur kehtay hain kay :  yeh ( Quran ) kuch bhi nahi , aik mann gharrat jhoot hai .  aur jab inn kafiron kay paas haq ka paygham aaya to unhon ney uss kay baaray mein yeh kaha kay :  yeh to aik khulay jadoo kay siwa kuch nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jab humari aayaten jo mukammal wazahat ki hamil hain unn ko parh ker sunai jati hain to yeh ( humaray payghumber kay baaray mein ) kehtay hain kay :  kuch nahi , yeh shaks bus yeh chahta hai kay tum logon  ko unn maboodon say bargushta kerday jinhen tumharay baap daday poojtay aaye hain .  aur kehtay hain kay :  yeh ( Quran ) kuch bhi nahi , aik mann gharrat jhoot hai .  aur jab inn kafiron kay paas haq ka paygham aaya to unhon ney uss kay baaray mein yeh kaha kay :  yeh to aik khulay jadoo kay siwa kuch nahi hai .

ayahs.text: halankay hum ney enhen pehlay naa aesi kitaben di then jo yeh parhtay parhatay hon , aur naa ( aey payghumber ! ) tum say pehlay hum ney inn kay paas koi khabrdar kernay wala ( nabi ) bheja tha .
ayahs.translation: halankay hum ney enhen pehlay naa aesi kitaben di then jo yeh parhtay parhatay hon , aur naa ( aey payghumber ! ) tum say pehlay hum ney inn kay paas koi khabrdar kernay wala ( nabi ) bheja tha .

ayahs.text: aur inn say pehlay logon  ney bhi ( payghumberon ) ko jhutlaya tha , aur yeh ( arab kay mushrikeen ) to uss saz-o-saman kay daswen hissay ko bhi nahi phonchay hain jo hum ney unn ( pehlay logon  ) ko dey rakha tha , phir bhi unhon ney meray payghumberon ko jhutlaya , to ( dekh lo kay ) meri di hoi saza kaisi ( sakht ) thi !
ayahs.translation: aur inn say pehlay logon  ney bhi ( payghumberon ) ko jhutlaya tha , aur yeh ( arab kay mushrikeen ) to uss saz-o-saman kay daswen hissay ko bhi nahi phonchay hain jo hum ney unn ( pehlay logon  ) ko dey rakha tha , phir bhi unhon ney meray payghumberon ko jhutlaya , to ( dekh lo kay ) meri di hoi saza kaisi ( sakht ) thi !

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) inn say kaho kay :  mein tumhen sirf aik baat ki naseehat kerta hun , aur woh yeh kay tum chahye do do mil ker aur chahye akelay akelay Allah ki khatir uth kharray ho ,   phir ( insaf say ) socho ( to foran samajh mein aajaye ga kay ) tumharay iss sathi ( yani Muhammad SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) mein junoon ki koi baat bhi to nahi hai . woh to aik sakht azab kay aaney say pehlay tumhen khabrdar ker-rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) inn say kaho kay :  mein tumhen sirf aik baat ki naseehat kerta hun , aur woh yeh kay tum chahye do do mil ker aur chahye akelay akelay Allah ki khatir uth kharray ho ,   phir ( insaf say ) socho ( to foran samajh mein aajaye ga kay ) tumharay iss sathi ( yani Muhammad SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) mein junoon ki koi baat bhi to nahi hai . woh to aik sakht azab kay aaney say pehlay tumhen khabrdar ker-rahey hain .

ayahs.text: kaho :  mein ney agar iss baat per tum say koi ujrat maangi ho to woh tumhari hai . mera ajar to Allah kay siwa kissi kay zimmay nahi hai , aur woh her cheez ka mushaeeda kernay wala hai .
ayahs.translation: kaho :  mein ney agar iss baat per tum say koi ujrat maangi ho to woh tumhari hai . mera ajar to Allah kay siwa kissi kay zimmay nahi hai , aur woh her cheez ka mushaeeda kernay wala hai .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  mera perwerdigar haq ko oopper say bhej raha hai ,   woh ghaib ki sari baaton ko khoob janney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  mera perwerdigar haq ko oopper say bhej raha hai ,   woh ghaib ki sari baaton ko khoob janney wala hai .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  haq aa-chuka hai , aur batil mein naa kuch shuroo kernay ka dum hai , naa dobara kernay ka .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  haq aa-chuka hai , aur batil mein naa kuch shuroo kernay ka dum hai , naa dobara kernay ka .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  agar mein raastay say bhatka hun to meray bhatakney ka nuqsan mujhi ko hoga , aur agar mein ney seedha raasta paaliya hai to yeh uss wahi ki badolat hai jo mera rab mujh per nazil ker raha hai . woh yaqeenan sabb kuch sunney wala , her aik say qareeb hai .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  agar mein raastay say bhatka hun to meray bhatakney ka nuqsan mujhi ko hoga , aur agar mein ney seedha raasta paaliya hai to yeh uss wahi ki badolat hai jo mera rab mujh per nazil ker raha hai . woh yaqeenan sabb kuch sunney wala , her aik say qareeb hai .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! tumhen unn ki halat ajeeb nazar aaye gi ) agar tum woh manzar dekho jab yeh ghabraye phirtay hon gay , aur bhag nikalney ka koi raasta nahi hoga , aur unhen qareeb hi say pakar liya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! tumhen unn ki halat ajeeb nazar aaye gi ) agar tum woh manzar dekho jab yeh ghabraye phirtay hon gay , aur bhag nikalney ka koi raasta nahi hoga , aur unhen qareeb hi say pakar liya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur ( uss waqt ) yeh kahen gay kay :  hum iss per emaan ley aaye hain  , halankay itni door jagah say unn ko koi cheez kaisay haath aa-sakti hai ?
ayahs.translation: aur ( uss waqt ) yeh kahen gay kay :  hum iss per emaan ley aaye hain  , halankay itni door jagah say unn ko koi cheez kaisay haath aa-sakti hai ?

ayahs.text: jabkay unhon ney pehlay iss ka inkar kiya tha , aur door door say atkal pacho teer phenka kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: jabkay unhon ney pehlay iss ka inkar kiya tha , aur door door say atkal pacho teer phenka kertay thay .

ayahs.text: aur uss waqt yeh jiss ( emaan ) ki aarzoo keren gay , uss kay aur inn kay darmiyan aik aarr kerdi jaye gi , jaisa kay inn jaisay jo log inn say pehlay huye hain , unn kay sath bhi yehi moamla hoga . haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh sabb aesay shak mein parray huye thay jiss ney enhen dhokay mein daal rakha tha .
ayahs.translation: aur uss waqt yeh jiss ( emaan ) ki aarzoo keren gay , uss kay aur inn kay darmiyan aik aarr kerdi jaye gi , jaisa kay inn jaisay jo log inn say pehlay huye hain , unn kay sath bhi yehi moamla hoga . haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh sabb aesay shak mein parray huye thay jiss ney enhen dhokay mein daal rakha tha .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: tamam tarr tareef Allah ki hai jo aasmano aur zameen ka peda kernay wala hai , jiss ney unn farishton ko paygham ley janey kay liye muqarrar kiya hai , jo do do , teen teen aur chaar chaar peron walay hain . woh pedaeesh mein jitna chahta hai izafa ker deta hai .   beyshak Allah her cheez ki qudrat rakhney wala hai .
verses.translation: tamam tarr tareef Allah ki hai jo aasmano aur zameen ka peda kernay wala hai , jiss ney unn farishton ko paygham ley janey kay liye muqarrar kiya hai , jo do do , teen teen aur chaar chaar peron walay hain . woh pedaeesh mein jitna chahta hai izafa ker deta hai .   beyshak Allah her cheez ki qudrat rakhney wala hai .

verses.text: jiss rehmat ko Allah logon  kay liye khol dey , koi nahi hai jo ussay rok sakay , aur jissay woh rok ley to koi nahi hai jo uss kay baad ussay churra sakay . aur wohi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
verses.translation: jiss rehmat ko Allah logon  kay liye khol dey , koi nahi hai jo ussay rok sakay , aur jissay woh rok ley to koi nahi hai jo uss kay baad ussay churra sakay . aur wohi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

verses.text: aey logo ! yaad kero unn naimaton ko jo Allah ney tum per nazil ki hain . kiya Allah kay siwa koi aur khaliq hai jo tumhen aasman aur zameen say rizq deta ho-? uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . phir aakhir tum kahan ondhay chalay jarahey ho-?
verses.translation: aey logo ! yaad kero unn naimaton ko jo Allah ney tum per nazil ki hain . kiya Allah kay siwa koi aur khaliq hai jo tumhen aasman aur zameen say rizq deta ho-? uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . phir aakhir tum kahan ondhay chalay jarahey ho-?

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) agar yeh log tumhen jhutla rahey hain to tum say pehlay bhi payghumberon ko jhutlaya gaya hai . aur tamam moamlaat aakhir kaar Allah hi ki taraf lotaye jayen gay .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) agar yeh log tumhen jhutla rahey hain to tum say pehlay bhi payghumberon ko jhutlaya gaya hai . aur tamam moamlaat aakhir kaar Allah hi ki taraf lotaye jayen gay .

verses.text: aey logo ! yaqeen jano kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , lehaza tumhen yeh dunyawi zindagi hergiz dhokay mein naa daalay , aur naa Allah kay moamlay mein tumhen woh ( shetan ) dhokay mein daalney paye jo bara dhokay baaz hai .
verses.translation: aey logo ! yaqeen jano kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , lehaza tumhen yeh dunyawi zindagi hergiz dhokay mein naa daalay , aur naa Allah kay moamlay mein tumhen woh ( shetan ) dhokay mein daalney paye jo bara dhokay baaz hai .

verses.text: yaqeen jano kay shetan tumhara dushman hai , iss liye uss ko dushman hi samajhtay raho . woh to apney manney walon ko jo dawat deta hai , woh iss liye deta hai takay woh dozakh kay baasi ban jayen .
verses.translation: yaqeen jano kay shetan tumhara dushman hai , iss liye uss ko dushman hi samajhtay raho . woh to apney manney walon ko jo dawat deta hai , woh iss liye deta hai takay woh dozakh kay baasi ban jayen .

verses.text: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay liye shadeed azab hai , aur jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn kay liye maghfirat hai , aur bara ajar !
verses.translation: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay liye shadeed azab hai , aur jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn kay liye maghfirat hai , aur bara ajar !

verses.text: bhala batao kay jiss shaks ki nazron mein uss ki bad-amli hi khushnuma bana ker paish ki gaee ho , jiss ki bana per woh uss bad-amli ko acha samajhta ho , ( woh naik aadmi kay barabar kaisay hosakta hai-? ) kiyonkay Allah jiss ko chahta hai , raastay say bhatka deta hai , aur jiss ko chahta hai theek raastay per phoncha deta hai .   lehaza ( aey payghumber ) aisa naa ho kay inn ( kafiron ) per afsos kay maaray tumhari jaan hi jati rahey . yaqeen rakho kay jo kuch yeh ker rahey hain , Allah ussay khoob janta hai .
verses.translation: bhala batao kay jiss shaks ki nazron mein uss ki bad-amli hi khushnuma bana ker paish ki gaee ho , jiss ki bana per woh uss bad-amli ko acha samajhta ho , ( woh naik aadmi kay barabar kaisay hosakta hai-? ) kiyonkay Allah jiss ko chahta hai , raastay say bhatka deta hai , aur jiss ko chahta hai theek raastay per phoncha deta hai .   lehaza ( aey payghumber ) aisa naa ho kay inn ( kafiron ) per afsos kay maaray tumhari jaan hi jati rahey . yaqeen rakho kay jo kuch yeh ker rahey hain , Allah ussay khoob janta hai .

verses.text: aur Allah hi hai jo hawayen bhejta hai , phir woh badalon ko uthati hain , phir hum unhen hanka ker aik aesay shehar ki taraf ley jatay hain jo ( qehat say ) murda hochuka hota hai , phir hum uss ( barish ) kay zariye murda zameen ko naee zindagi ata kertay hain . bus issi tarah insanon ki doosri zindagi hogi .
verses.translation: aur Allah hi hai jo hawayen bhejta hai , phir woh badalon ko uthati hain , phir hum unhen hanka ker aik aesay shehar ki taraf ley jatay hain jo ( qehat say ) murda hochuka hota hai , phir hum uss ( barish ) kay zariye murda zameen ko naee zindagi ata kertay hain . bus issi tarah insanon ki doosri zindagi hogi .

verses.text: jo shaks izzat hasil kerna chahta ho , to tamam tarr izzat Allah kay qabazay mein hai . pakeezah kalma ussi ki taraf charrta hai , aur naik amal uss ko oopper uthata hai .   aur jo log buri buri makkariyan ker rahey hain , unn ko sakht azab hoga , aur unn ki makkaari hi hai jo malya mait hojaye gi .
verses.translation: jo shaks izzat hasil kerna chahta ho , to tamam tarr izzat Allah kay qabazay mein hai . pakeezah kalma ussi ki taraf charrta hai , aur naik amal uss ko oopper uthata hai .   aur jo log buri buri makkariyan ker rahey hain , unn ko sakht azab hoga , aur unn ki makkaari hi hai jo malya mait hojaye gi .

verses.text: aur Allah ney tumhen mitti say peda kiya , phir nutfay say , phir tumhen jooray jooray bana diya . aur kissi mada ko jo koi hamal hota hai , aur jo kuch woh janti hai , woh sabb Allah kay ilm say hota hai . aur kissi umar raseedah ko jitni umar di jati hai , aur uss ki umar mein jo koi kami hoti hai , woh sabb aik kitab mein darj hai .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh sabb kuch Allah kay liye boht aasaan hai .
verses.translation: aur Allah ney tumhen mitti say peda kiya , phir nutfay say , phir tumhen jooray jooray bana diya . aur kissi mada ko jo koi hamal hota hai , aur jo kuch woh janti hai , woh sabb Allah kay ilm say hota hai . aur kissi umar raseedah ko jitni umar di jati hai , aur uss ki umar mein jo koi kami hoti hai , woh sabb aik kitab mein darj hai .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh sabb kuch Allah kay liye boht aasaan hai .

verses.text: aur do darya barabar nahi hotay . aik aisa meetha hai kay uss say piyas bujhti hai , jo peenay mein khushgawar hai , aur doosra karrwa namkeen . aur her aik say tum ( machliyon ka ) taza gosht khatay ho , aur woh zewar nikaltay ho jo tumharay pehanney kay kaam aata hai . aur tum kashtiyon ko dekhtay ho kay woh uss ( darya ) mein paani ko phaarti hoi chalti hain , takay tum Allah ka fazal talash kero ,   aur takay shukar guzaar bano .
verses.translation: aur do darya barabar nahi hotay . aik aisa meetha hai kay uss say piyas bujhti hai , jo peenay mein khushgawar hai , aur doosra karrwa namkeen . aur her aik say tum ( machliyon ka ) taza gosht khatay ho , aur woh zewar nikaltay ho jo tumharay pehanney kay kaam aata hai . aur tum kashtiyon ko dekhtay ho kay woh uss ( darya ) mein paani ko phaarti hoi chalti hain , takay tum Allah ka fazal talash kero ,   aur takay shukar guzaar bano .

verses.text: woh raat ko din mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur din ko raat mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur uss ney sooraj aur chaand ko kaam per laga diya hai . ( inn mein say ) her aik kissi muqarrara miyaad tak kay liye rawan dawan hai . yeh hai Allah jo tumhara perwerdigar hai , sari badshahi ussi ki hai . aur ussay chorr ker jinn ( jhootay khudaon ) ko tum pukartay ho , woh khujoor ki guthli kay chilkay kay barabar bhi koi ikhtiyar nahi rakhtay .
verses.translation: woh raat ko din mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur din ko raat mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur uss ney sooraj aur chaand ko kaam per laga diya hai . ( inn mein say ) her aik kissi muqarrara miyaad tak kay liye rawan dawan hai . yeh hai Allah jo tumhara perwerdigar hai , sari badshahi ussi ki hai . aur ussay chorr ker jinn ( jhootay khudaon ) ko tum pukartay ho , woh khujoor ki guthli kay chilkay kay barabar bhi koi ikhtiyar nahi rakhtay .

verses.text: agar tum unn ko pukaro gay to woh tumhari pukar sunen gay hi nahi , aur agar sunn bhi len to tumhen koi jawab nahi dey saken gay . aur qayamat kay din woh khud tumharay shirk ki tardeed keren gay . aur jiss zaat ko tamam baaton ki mukammal khabar hai , uss kay barabar tumhen koi aur sahih baat nahi bataye ga .
verses.translation: agar tum unn ko pukaro gay to woh tumhari pukar sunen gay hi nahi , aur agar sunn bhi len to tumhen koi jawab nahi dey saken gay . aur qayamat kay din woh khud tumharay shirk ki tardeed keren gay . aur jiss zaat ko tamam baaton ki mukammal khabar hai , uss kay barabar tumhen koi aur sahih baat nahi bataye ga .

verses.text: aey logo ! tum sabb Allah kay mohtaj ho , aur Allah bey niaz hai , her tareef ka bazaat-e-khud mustahiq .
verses.translation: aey logo ! tum sabb Allah kay mohtaj ho , aur Allah bey niaz hai , her tareef ka bazaat-e-khud mustahiq .

verses.text: agar woh chahye to tum sabb ko fana kerday , aur aik naee makhlooq wajood mein ley aaye .
verses.translation: agar woh chahye to tum sabb ko fana kerday , aur aik naee makhlooq wajood mein ley aaye .

verses.text: aur yeh kaam Allah kay liye kuch bhi mushkil nahi hai .
verses.translation: aur yeh kaam Allah kay liye kuch bhi mushkil nahi hai .

verses.text: aur koi bojh uthaney wala kissi doosray ka bojh nahi uthaye ga , aur jiss kissi per bara bojh lada huwa ho , woh agar kissi aur ko uss kay uthaney ki dawat dey ga to uss mein say kuch bhi uthaya nahi jaye ga , chahye woh ( jissay bojh uthaney ki dawat di gaee thi ) koi qareebi rishta daar hi kiyon naa ho . ( aey payghumber ! ) tum unhi logon  ko khabrdar ker-saktay ho jo apney perwerdigar ko dekhay baghair uss say dartay hon , aur jinhon ney namaz qaeem ki ho . aur jo shaks pak hota hai , woh apney hi faeeday kay liye pak hota hai . aur aakhir-kaar sabb ko Allah hi ki taraf loat ker jana hai .
verses.translation: aur koi bojh uthaney wala kissi doosray ka bojh nahi uthaye ga , aur jiss kissi per bara bojh lada huwa ho , woh agar kissi aur ko uss kay uthaney ki dawat dey ga to uss mein say kuch bhi uthaya nahi jaye ga , chahye woh ( jissay bojh uthaney ki dawat di gaee thi ) koi qareebi rishta daar hi kiyon naa ho . ( aey payghumber ! ) tum unhi logon  ko khabrdar ker-saktay ho jo apney perwerdigar ko dekhay baghair uss say dartay hon , aur jinhon ney namaz qaeem ki ho . aur jo shaks pak hota hai , woh apney hi faeeday kay liye pak hota hai . aur aakhir-kaar sabb ko Allah hi ki taraf loat ker jana hai .

verses.text: aur andha aur dekhney wala barabar nahi hosaktay .
verses.translation: aur andha aur dekhney wala barabar nahi hosaktay .

verses.text: aur naa andheray aur roshni
verses.translation: aur naa andheray aur roshni

verses.text: aur naa saya aur dhoop
verses.translation: aur naa saya aur dhoop

verses.text: aur zinda log aur murday barabar nahi hosaktay , aur Allah to jiss ko chahta hai , baat suna deta hai , aur tum unn ko baat nahi suna saktay jo qabron mein parray hain .
verses.translation: aur zinda log aur murday barabar nahi hosaktay , aur Allah to jiss ko chahta hai , baat suna deta hai , aur tum unn ko baat nahi suna saktay jo qabron mein parray hain .

verses.text: tum to bus aik khabrdar kernay walay ho .
verses.translation: tum to bus aik khabrdar kernay walay ho .

verses.text: hum ney tumhen haq baat dey ker iss tarah bheja hai kay tum khushkhabri do , aur khabrdar kero . aur koi ummat aesi nahi hai jiss mein koi khabar daar kernay wala naa aaya ho .
verses.translation: hum ney tumhen haq baat dey ker iss tarah bheja hai kay tum khushkhabri do , aur khabrdar kero . aur koi ummat aesi nahi hai jiss mein koi khabar daar kernay wala naa aaya ho .

verses.text: aur agar yeh log tumhen jhutla rahey hain to jo ( kafir ) inn say pehlay thay , unhon ney bhi ( Rasoolon ko ) jhutlaya tha . unn kay payghumber unn kay paas khuli khuli nishaniyan ley ker , saheefay ley ker aur roshni phelaney wali kitab ley ker aaye thay .
verses.translation: aur agar yeh log tumhen jhutla rahey hain to jo ( kafir ) inn say pehlay thay , unhon ney bhi ( Rasoolon ko ) jhutlaya tha . unn kay payghumber unn kay paas khuli khuli nishaniyan ley ker , saheefay ley ker aur roshni phelaney wali kitab ley ker aaye thay .

verses.text: phir jinn logon  ney inkar ki rawish apnai thi , mein ney unhen pakar mein ley liya . abb dekho kay meri saza kaisi ( holnaak ) thi !
verses.translation: phir jinn logon  ney inkar ki rawish apnai thi , mein ney unhen pakar mein ley liya . abb dekho kay meri saza kaisi ( holnaak ) thi !

verses.text: kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay Allah ney aasman say paani utaara , phir hum ney uss kay zariye rang ba-rang kay phal ugaye-? aur paharon mein bhi aesay tukrray hain jo rang ba-rang kay safaid aur surkh hain , aur kalay siyah bhi .
verses.translation: kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay Allah ney aasman say paani utaara , phir hum ney uss kay zariye rang ba-rang kay phal ugaye-? aur paharon mein bhi aesay tukrray hain jo rang ba-rang kay safaid aur surkh hain , aur kalay siyah bhi .

verses.text: aur insanon aur janweron aur chopayo mein bhi aesay hain jinn kay rang mukhtalif hain . Allah say uss kay bandon mein say wohi dartay hain jo ilm rakhney walay hain .   yaqeenan Allah sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , boht bakhshney wala bhi .
verses.translation: aur insanon aur janweron aur chopayo mein bhi aesay hain jinn kay rang mukhtalif hain . Allah say uss kay bandon mein say wohi dartay hain jo ilm rakhney walay hain .   yaqeenan Allah sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , boht bakhshney wala bhi .

verses.text: jo log Allah ki kitab ki tilawat kertay hain , aur jinhon ney namaz ki pabandi ker rakhi hai , aur hum ney unhen jo rizq diya hai , uss mein say woh ( naik kamon mein ) khufiya aur aelania kharch kertay hain , woh aesi tijarat kay umeedwaar hain jo kabhi nuqsan nahi uthaye gi .
verses.translation: jo log Allah ki kitab ki tilawat kertay hain , aur jinhon ney namaz ki pabandi ker rakhi hai , aur hum ney unhen jo rizq diya hai , uss mein say woh ( naik kamon mein ) khufiya aur aelania kharch kertay hain , woh aesi tijarat kay umeedwaar hain jo kabhi nuqsan nahi uthaye gi .

verses.text: takay Allah unn kay pooray ajar unn ko deydey , aur apney fazal say aur ziyada bhi dey . yaqeenan woh boht bakhshney wala , bara qadar daan hai .
verses.translation: takay Allah unn kay pooray ajar unn ko deydey , aur apney fazal say aur ziyada bhi dey . yaqeenan woh boht bakhshney wala , bara qadar daan hai .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumharay paas wahi kay zariye jo kitab bheji hai , woh sachi hai jo apney say pehli kitabon ki tasdeeq kerti hoi aai hai . yaqeenan Allah apney bandon say poori tarah ba-khabar , her cheez ko dekhney wala hai .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumharay paas wahi kay zariye jo kitab bheji hai , woh sachi hai jo apney say pehli kitabon ki tasdeeq kerti hoi aai hai . yaqeenan Allah apney bandon say poori tarah ba-khabar , her cheez ko dekhney wala hai .

verses.text: phir hum ney iss kitab ka waris apney bandon mein say unn ko banaya jinhen hum ney chunn liya tha .   phir unn mein say kuch woh hain jo apni jaan per zulm kernay walay hain , aur unhi mein say kuch aesay hain jo darmiyaney darjay kay hain , aur kuch woh hain jo Allah ki tofiq say naikiyon mein barhay chalay jatay hain . aur yeh ( Allah ka ) boht bara fazal hai .
verses.translation: phir hum ney iss kitab ka waris apney bandon mein say unn ko banaya jinhen hum ney chunn liya tha .   phir unn mein say kuch woh hain jo apni jaan per zulm kernay walay hain , aur unhi mein say kuch aesay hain jo darmiyaney darjay kay hain , aur kuch woh hain jo Allah ki tofiq say naikiyon mein barhay chalay jatay hain . aur yeh ( Allah ka ) boht bara fazal hai .

verses.text: hamesha basney kay baaghaat hain jinn mein woh log dakhil hon gay , wahan unn ko soney kay kangganon aur motiyon say aarasta kiya jaye ga , aur unn ka libas wahan per resham hoga .
verses.translation: hamesha basney kay baaghaat hain jinn mein woh log dakhil hon gay , wahan unn ko soney kay kangganon aur motiyon say aarasta kiya jaye ga , aur unn ka libas wahan per resham hoga .

verses.text: aur woh kahen gay kay :  tamam tarr tareef Allah ki hai jiss ney hum say her ghum door kerdiya . beyshak humara perwerdigar boht bakhshney wala , bara qadardaan hai ,
verses.translation: aur woh kahen gay kay :  tamam tarr tareef Allah ki hai jiss ney hum say her ghum door kerdiya . beyshak humara perwerdigar boht bakhshney wala , bara qadardaan hai ,

verses.text: jiss ney apney fazal say hum ko abadi thikaney kay ghar mein laa utaara hai jiss mein naa hamen kabhi koi kulfat choo-ker guzray gi , aur naa kabhi koi thakan paish aaye gi .
verses.translation: jiss ney apney fazal say hum ko abadi thikaney kay ghar mein laa utaara hai jiss mein naa hamen kabhi koi kulfat choo-ker guzray gi , aur naa kabhi koi thakan paish aaye gi .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr ki rawish apna li hai , unn kay liye dozakh ki aag hai . naa to unn ka kaam tamam kiya jaye ga kay woh mar hi jayen , aur naa unn say dozakh ka azab halka kiya jaye ga . her nashukray kafir ko hum aesi hi saza detay hain .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr ki rawish apna li hai , unn kay liye dozakh ki aag hai . naa to unn ka kaam tamam kiya jaye ga kay woh mar hi jayen , aur naa unn say dozakh ka azab halka kiya jaye ga . her nashukray kafir ko hum aesi hi saza detay hain .

verses.text: aur woh uss dozakh mein cheekh pukar machayen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen bahir nikal dey takay hum jo kaam pehlay kiya kertay thay , unhen chorr ker naik amal keren .  ( unn say jawab mein kaha jaye ga kay : )  bhala kiya hum ney tumhen itni umar nahi di thi kay jiss kissi ko uss mein sochna samajhna hota , woh samajh leta-? aur tumharay paas khabrdar kernay wala bhi aaya tha .   abb maza chakho , kiyonkay koi nahi hai jo aesay zalimon ka madadgaar banay .
verses.translation: aur woh uss dozakh mein cheekh pukar machayen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen bahir nikal dey takay hum jo kaam pehlay kiya kertay thay , unhen chorr ker naik amal keren .  ( unn say jawab mein kaha jaye ga kay : )  bhala kiya hum ney tumhen itni umar nahi di thi kay jiss kissi ko uss mein sochna samajhna hota , woh samajh leta-? aur tumharay paas khabrdar kernay wala bhi aaya tha .   abb maza chakho , kiyonkay koi nahi hai jo aesay zalimon ka madadgaar banay .

verses.text: beyshak Allah aasmano aur zameen ki posheeda cheezon ka ilm rakhta hai . beyshak woh seenon mein chupi hoi baaton ko khoob janta hai .
verses.translation: beyshak Allah aasmano aur zameen ki posheeda cheezon ka ilm rakhta hai . beyshak woh seenon mein chupi hoi baaton ko khoob janta hai .

verses.text: wohi hai jiss ney tumhen zameen mein ( pichlay logon  ka ) janasheen banaya . abb jo shaks kufr keray ga to uss ka kufr ussi per parray ga . aur kafiron kay liye unn ka kufr unn kay perwerdigar kay paas ghazab kay siwa kissi aur cheez mein izafa nahi kerta , aur kafiron ko unn kay kufr say khasaray kay siwa kissi cheez mein taraqqi hasil nahi hoti .
verses.translation: wohi hai jiss ney tumhen zameen mein ( pichlay logon  ka ) janasheen banaya . abb jo shaks kufr keray ga to uss ka kufr ussi per parray ga . aur kafiron kay liye unn ka kufr unn kay perwerdigar kay paas ghazab kay siwa kissi aur cheez mein izafa nahi kerta , aur kafiron ko unn kay kufr say khasaray kay siwa kissi cheez mein taraqqi hasil nahi hoti .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) inn say kaho kay :  bhala batao tum Allah ko chorr ker apney jinn mann gharrat shareekon ko pooja kertay ho , zara mujhay dikhao kay unhon ney zameen ka konsa hissa peda kiya hai ? ya aasmano ( ki pedaeesh mein ) unn ki konsi shirkat hai ?  ya phir hum ney unhen koi kitab dey rakhi hai jiss ki kissi wazeh hidayat per yeh log qaeem hain-?   nahi , balkay yeh zalim log aik doosray ko khalis dhokay ki yaqeen dahani kertay aaye hain .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) inn say kaho kay :  bhala batao tum Allah ko chorr ker apney jinn mann gharrat shareekon ko pooja kertay ho , zara mujhay dikhao kay unhon ney zameen ka konsa hissa peda kiya hai ? ya aasmano ( ki pedaeesh mein ) unn ki konsi shirkat hai ?  ya phir hum ney unhen koi kitab dey rakhi hai jiss ki kissi wazeh hidayat per yeh log qaeem hain-?   nahi , balkay yeh zalim log aik doosray ko khalis dhokay ki yaqeen dahani kertay aaye hain .

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah ney aasmano aur zameen ko thaam rakha hai kay woh apni jagah say talen nahi . aur agar woh tall jayen to uss kay siwa koi nahi hai jo unhen thaam sakay . yaqeenan Allah bara burdbaar, boht bakhshney wala hai .
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah ney aasmano aur zameen ko thaam rakha hai kay woh apni jagah say talen nahi . aur agar woh tall jayen to uss kay siwa koi nahi hai jo unhen thaam sakay . yaqeenan Allah bara burdbaar, boht bakhshney wala hai .

verses.text: aur enhon ney pehlay baray zoron mein Allah ki qasmen khai then kay agar inn kay paas koi khabrdar kernay wala ( payghumber ) aaya to woh her doosri ummat say ziyada hidayat qubool kernay walay hon gay .   magar jab unn kay paas aik khabrdar kernay wala aagaya to uss kay aaney say unn ki halat mein aur koi taraqqi nahi hoi , siwaye iss kay kay yeh ( haq kay raastay say ) aur ziyada bhagney lagay ,
verses.translation: aur enhon ney pehlay baray zoron mein Allah ki qasmen khai then kay agar inn kay paas koi khabrdar kernay wala ( payghumber ) aaya to woh her doosri ummat say ziyada hidayat qubool kernay walay hon gay .   magar jab unn kay paas aik khabrdar kernay wala aagaya to uss kay aaney say unn ki halat mein aur koi taraqqi nahi hoi , siwaye iss kay kay yeh ( haq kay raastay say ) aur ziyada bhagney lagay ,

verses.text: iss liye kay enhen zameen mein apni barai ka ghamand tha , aur enhon ney ( haq ki mukhalifat mein ) buri buri chaalen chalni shuroo kerden . halankay buri chaalen kissi aur ko nahi , khud apney chalney walon hi ko gheray mein ley leti hain .   abb yeh log uss dastoor kay siwa kiss baat kay muntazir hain jiss per pichlay logon  kay sath amal hota aaya hai ?   ( agar yeh baat hai ) to tum Allah kay tey shuda dastoor mein kabhi koi tabdeeli nahi pao gay , aur naa tum Allah kay tey shuda dastoor ko kabhi talta huwa pao gay .
verses.translation: iss liye kay enhen zameen mein apni barai ka ghamand tha , aur enhon ney ( haq ki mukhalifat mein ) buri buri chaalen chalni shuroo kerden . halankay buri chaalen kissi aur ko nahi , khud apney chalney walon hi ko gheray mein ley leti hain .   abb yeh log uss dastoor kay siwa kiss baat kay muntazir hain jiss per pichlay logon  kay sath amal hota aaya hai ?   ( agar yeh baat hai ) to tum Allah kay tey shuda dastoor mein kabhi koi tabdeeli nahi pao gay , aur naa tum Allah kay tey shuda dastoor ko kabhi talta huwa pao gay .

verses.text: aur kiya inn logon  ney zameen mein kabhi safar nahi kiya jiss say woh yeh dekhtay kay jo log inn say pehlay guzray hain , unn ka anjam kaisa huwa , jabkay woh taqat mein inn say boht ziyada mazboot thay ? aur Allah aisa nahi hai kay aasmano ya zameen ki koi cheez ussay aajiz ker-sakay . beyshak woh ilm ka bhi malik hai , qudrat ka bhi malik .
verses.translation: aur kiya inn logon  ney zameen mein kabhi safar nahi kiya jiss say woh yeh dekhtay kay jo log inn say pehlay guzray hain , unn ka anjam kaisa huwa , jabkay woh taqat mein inn say boht ziyada mazboot thay ? aur Allah aisa nahi hai kay aasmano ya zameen ki koi cheez ussay aajiz ker-sakay . beyshak woh ilm ka bhi malik hai , qudrat ka bhi malik .

verses.text: aur agar Allah logon  kay her kartoot per unn ki pakar kernay lagta to iss zameen ki pusht per kissi chalney walay ko naa chorta , lekin woh aik moyyan mauddat tak kay liye unn ko mohlat dey raha hai . phir jab unn ka muqarrara waqt aajaye ga , to Allah apney bandon ko khud dekh ley ga .
verses.translation: aur agar Allah logon  kay her kartoot per unn ki pakar kernay lagta to iss zameen ki pusht per kissi chalney walay ko naa chorta , lekin woh aik moyyan mauddat tak kay liye unn ko mohlat dey raha hai . phir jab unn ka muqarrara waqt aajaye ga , to Allah apney bandon ko khud dekh ley ga .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: tamam tarr tareef Allah ki hai jo aasmano aur zameen ka peda kernay wala hai , jiss ney unn farishton ko paygham ley janey kay liye muqarrar kiya hai , jo do do , teen teen aur chaar chaar peron walay hain . woh pedaeesh mein jitna chahta hai izafa ker deta hai .   beyshak Allah her cheez ki qudrat rakhney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: tamam tarr tareef Allah ki hai jo aasmano aur zameen ka peda kernay wala hai , jiss ney unn farishton ko paygham ley janey kay liye muqarrar kiya hai , jo do do , teen teen aur chaar chaar peron walay hain . woh pedaeesh mein jitna chahta hai izafa ker deta hai .   beyshak Allah her cheez ki qudrat rakhney wala hai .

ayahs.text: jiss rehmat ko Allah logon  kay liye khol dey , koi nahi hai jo ussay rok sakay , aur jissay woh rok ley to koi nahi hai jo uss kay baad ussay churra sakay . aur wohi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
ayahs.translation: jiss rehmat ko Allah logon  kay liye khol dey , koi nahi hai jo ussay rok sakay , aur jissay woh rok ley to koi nahi hai jo uss kay baad ussay churra sakay . aur wohi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

ayahs.text: aey logo ! yaad kero unn naimaton ko jo Allah ney tum per nazil ki hain . kiya Allah kay siwa koi aur khaliq hai jo tumhen aasman aur zameen say rizq deta ho-? uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . phir aakhir tum kahan ondhay chalay jarahey ho-?
ayahs.translation: aey logo ! yaad kero unn naimaton ko jo Allah ney tum per nazil ki hain . kiya Allah kay siwa koi aur khaliq hai jo tumhen aasman aur zameen say rizq deta ho-? uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . phir aakhir tum kahan ondhay chalay jarahey ho-?

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) agar yeh log tumhen jhutla rahey hain to tum say pehlay bhi payghumberon ko jhutlaya gaya hai . aur tamam moamlaat aakhir kaar Allah hi ki taraf lotaye jayen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) agar yeh log tumhen jhutla rahey hain to tum say pehlay bhi payghumberon ko jhutlaya gaya hai . aur tamam moamlaat aakhir kaar Allah hi ki taraf lotaye jayen gay .

ayahs.text: aey logo ! yaqeen jano kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , lehaza tumhen yeh dunyawi zindagi hergiz dhokay mein naa daalay , aur naa Allah kay moamlay mein tumhen woh ( shetan ) dhokay mein daalney paye jo bara dhokay baaz hai .
ayahs.translation: aey logo ! yaqeen jano kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , lehaza tumhen yeh dunyawi zindagi hergiz dhokay mein naa daalay , aur naa Allah kay moamlay mein tumhen woh ( shetan ) dhokay mein daalney paye jo bara dhokay baaz hai .

ayahs.text: yaqeen jano kay shetan tumhara dushman hai , iss liye uss ko dushman hi samajhtay raho . woh to apney manney walon ko jo dawat deta hai , woh iss liye deta hai takay woh dozakh kay baasi ban jayen .
ayahs.translation: yaqeen jano kay shetan tumhara dushman hai , iss liye uss ko dushman hi samajhtay raho . woh to apney manney walon ko jo dawat deta hai , woh iss liye deta hai takay woh dozakh kay baasi ban jayen .

ayahs.text: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay liye shadeed azab hai , aur jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn kay liye maghfirat hai , aur bara ajar !
ayahs.translation: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay liye shadeed azab hai , aur jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn kay liye maghfirat hai , aur bara ajar !

ayahs.text: bhala batao kay jiss shaks ki nazron mein uss ki bad-amli hi khushnuma bana ker paish ki gaee ho , jiss ki bana per woh uss bad-amli ko acha samajhta ho , ( woh naik aadmi kay barabar kaisay hosakta hai-? ) kiyonkay Allah jiss ko chahta hai , raastay say bhatka deta hai , aur jiss ko chahta hai theek raastay per phoncha deta hai .   lehaza ( aey payghumber ) aisa naa ho kay inn ( kafiron ) per afsos kay maaray tumhari jaan hi jati rahey . yaqeen rakho kay jo kuch yeh ker rahey hain , Allah ussay khoob janta hai .
ayahs.translation: bhala batao kay jiss shaks ki nazron mein uss ki bad-amli hi khushnuma bana ker paish ki gaee ho , jiss ki bana per woh uss bad-amli ko acha samajhta ho , ( woh naik aadmi kay barabar kaisay hosakta hai-? ) kiyonkay Allah jiss ko chahta hai , raastay say bhatka deta hai , aur jiss ko chahta hai theek raastay per phoncha deta hai .   lehaza ( aey payghumber ) aisa naa ho kay inn ( kafiron ) per afsos kay maaray tumhari jaan hi jati rahey . yaqeen rakho kay jo kuch yeh ker rahey hain , Allah ussay khoob janta hai .

ayahs.text: aur Allah hi hai jo hawayen bhejta hai , phir woh badalon ko uthati hain , phir hum unhen hanka ker aik aesay shehar ki taraf ley jatay hain jo ( qehat say ) murda hochuka hota hai , phir hum uss ( barish ) kay zariye murda zameen ko naee zindagi ata kertay hain . bus issi tarah insanon ki doosri zindagi hogi .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah hi hai jo hawayen bhejta hai , phir woh badalon ko uthati hain , phir hum unhen hanka ker aik aesay shehar ki taraf ley jatay hain jo ( qehat say ) murda hochuka hota hai , phir hum uss ( barish ) kay zariye murda zameen ko naee zindagi ata kertay hain . bus issi tarah insanon ki doosri zindagi hogi .

ayahs.text: jo shaks izzat hasil kerna chahta ho , to tamam tarr izzat Allah kay qabazay mein hai . pakeezah kalma ussi ki taraf charrta hai , aur naik amal uss ko oopper uthata hai .   aur jo log buri buri makkariyan ker rahey hain , unn ko sakht azab hoga , aur unn ki makkaari hi hai jo malya mait hojaye gi .
ayahs.translation: jo shaks izzat hasil kerna chahta ho , to tamam tarr izzat Allah kay qabazay mein hai . pakeezah kalma ussi ki taraf charrta hai , aur naik amal uss ko oopper uthata hai .   aur jo log buri buri makkariyan ker rahey hain , unn ko sakht azab hoga , aur unn ki makkaari hi hai jo malya mait hojaye gi .

ayahs.text: aur Allah ney tumhen mitti say peda kiya , phir nutfay say , phir tumhen jooray jooray bana diya . aur kissi mada ko jo koi hamal hota hai , aur jo kuch woh janti hai , woh sabb Allah kay ilm say hota hai . aur kissi umar raseedah ko jitni umar di jati hai , aur uss ki umar mein jo koi kami hoti hai , woh sabb aik kitab mein darj hai .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh sabb kuch Allah kay liye boht aasaan hai .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah ney tumhen mitti say peda kiya , phir nutfay say , phir tumhen jooray jooray bana diya . aur kissi mada ko jo koi hamal hota hai , aur jo kuch woh janti hai , woh sabb Allah kay ilm say hota hai . aur kissi umar raseedah ko jitni umar di jati hai , aur uss ki umar mein jo koi kami hoti hai , woh sabb aik kitab mein darj hai .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh sabb kuch Allah kay liye boht aasaan hai .

ayahs.text: aur do darya barabar nahi hotay . aik aisa meetha hai kay uss say piyas bujhti hai , jo peenay mein khushgawar hai , aur doosra karrwa namkeen . aur her aik say tum ( machliyon ka ) taza gosht khatay ho , aur woh zewar nikaltay ho jo tumharay pehanney kay kaam aata hai . aur tum kashtiyon ko dekhtay ho kay woh uss ( darya ) mein paani ko phaarti hoi chalti hain , takay tum Allah ka fazal talash kero ,   aur takay shukar guzaar bano .
ayahs.translation: aur do darya barabar nahi hotay . aik aisa meetha hai kay uss say piyas bujhti hai , jo peenay mein khushgawar hai , aur doosra karrwa namkeen . aur her aik say tum ( machliyon ka ) taza gosht khatay ho , aur woh zewar nikaltay ho jo tumharay pehanney kay kaam aata hai . aur tum kashtiyon ko dekhtay ho kay woh uss ( darya ) mein paani ko phaarti hoi chalti hain , takay tum Allah ka fazal talash kero ,   aur takay shukar guzaar bano .

ayahs.text: woh raat ko din mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur din ko raat mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur uss ney sooraj aur chaand ko kaam per laga diya hai . ( inn mein say ) her aik kissi muqarrara miyaad tak kay liye rawan dawan hai . yeh hai Allah jo tumhara perwerdigar hai , sari badshahi ussi ki hai . aur ussay chorr ker jinn ( jhootay khudaon ) ko tum pukartay ho , woh khujoor ki guthli kay chilkay kay barabar bhi koi ikhtiyar nahi rakhtay .
ayahs.translation: woh raat ko din mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur din ko raat mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur uss ney sooraj aur chaand ko kaam per laga diya hai . ( inn mein say ) her aik kissi muqarrara miyaad tak kay liye rawan dawan hai . yeh hai Allah jo tumhara perwerdigar hai , sari badshahi ussi ki hai . aur ussay chorr ker jinn ( jhootay khudaon ) ko tum pukartay ho , woh khujoor ki guthli kay chilkay kay barabar bhi koi ikhtiyar nahi rakhtay .

ayahs.text: agar tum unn ko pukaro gay to woh tumhari pukar sunen gay hi nahi , aur agar sunn bhi len to tumhen koi jawab nahi dey saken gay . aur qayamat kay din woh khud tumharay shirk ki tardeed keren gay . aur jiss zaat ko tamam baaton ki mukammal khabar hai , uss kay barabar tumhen koi aur sahih baat nahi bataye ga .
ayahs.translation: agar tum unn ko pukaro gay to woh tumhari pukar sunen gay hi nahi , aur agar sunn bhi len to tumhen koi jawab nahi dey saken gay . aur qayamat kay din woh khud tumharay shirk ki tardeed keren gay . aur jiss zaat ko tamam baaton ki mukammal khabar hai , uss kay barabar tumhen koi aur sahih baat nahi bataye ga .

ayahs.text: aey logo ! tum sabb Allah kay mohtaj ho , aur Allah bey niaz hai , her tareef ka bazaat-e-khud mustahiq .
ayahs.translation: aey logo ! tum sabb Allah kay mohtaj ho , aur Allah bey niaz hai , her tareef ka bazaat-e-khud mustahiq .

ayahs.text: agar woh chahye to tum sabb ko fana kerday , aur aik naee makhlooq wajood mein ley aaye .
ayahs.translation: agar woh chahye to tum sabb ko fana kerday , aur aik naee makhlooq wajood mein ley aaye .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kaam Allah kay liye kuch bhi mushkil nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kaam Allah kay liye kuch bhi mushkil nahi hai .

ayahs.text: aur koi bojh uthaney wala kissi doosray ka bojh nahi uthaye ga , aur jiss kissi per bara bojh lada huwa ho , woh agar kissi aur ko uss kay uthaney ki dawat dey ga to uss mein say kuch bhi uthaya nahi jaye ga , chahye woh ( jissay bojh uthaney ki dawat di gaee thi ) koi qareebi rishta daar hi kiyon naa ho . ( aey payghumber ! ) tum unhi logon  ko khabrdar ker-saktay ho jo apney perwerdigar ko dekhay baghair uss say dartay hon , aur jinhon ney namaz qaeem ki ho . aur jo shaks pak hota hai , woh apney hi faeeday kay liye pak hota hai . aur aakhir-kaar sabb ko Allah hi ki taraf loat ker jana hai .
ayahs.translation: aur koi bojh uthaney wala kissi doosray ka bojh nahi uthaye ga , aur jiss kissi per bara bojh lada huwa ho , woh agar kissi aur ko uss kay uthaney ki dawat dey ga to uss mein say kuch bhi uthaya nahi jaye ga , chahye woh ( jissay bojh uthaney ki dawat di gaee thi ) koi qareebi rishta daar hi kiyon naa ho . ( aey payghumber ! ) tum unhi logon  ko khabrdar ker-saktay ho jo apney perwerdigar ko dekhay baghair uss say dartay hon , aur jinhon ney namaz qaeem ki ho . aur jo shaks pak hota hai , woh apney hi faeeday kay liye pak hota hai . aur aakhir-kaar sabb ko Allah hi ki taraf loat ker jana hai .

ayahs.text: aur andha aur dekhney wala barabar nahi hosaktay .
ayahs.translation: aur andha aur dekhney wala barabar nahi hosaktay .

ayahs.text: aur naa andheray aur roshni
ayahs.translation: aur naa andheray aur roshni

ayahs.text: aur naa saya aur dhoop
ayahs.translation: aur naa saya aur dhoop

ayahs.text: aur zinda log aur murday barabar nahi hosaktay , aur Allah to jiss ko chahta hai , baat suna deta hai , aur tum unn ko baat nahi suna saktay jo qabron mein parray hain .
ayahs.translation: aur zinda log aur murday barabar nahi hosaktay , aur Allah to jiss ko chahta hai , baat suna deta hai , aur tum unn ko baat nahi suna saktay jo qabron mein parray hain .

ayahs.text: tum to bus aik khabrdar kernay walay ho .
ayahs.translation: tum to bus aik khabrdar kernay walay ho .

ayahs.text: hum ney tumhen haq baat dey ker iss tarah bheja hai kay tum khushkhabri do , aur khabrdar kero . aur koi ummat aesi nahi hai jiss mein koi khabar daar kernay wala naa aaya ho .
ayahs.translation: hum ney tumhen haq baat dey ker iss tarah bheja hai kay tum khushkhabri do , aur khabrdar kero . aur koi ummat aesi nahi hai jiss mein koi khabar daar kernay wala naa aaya ho .

ayahs.text: aur agar yeh log tumhen jhutla rahey hain to jo ( kafir ) inn say pehlay thay , unhon ney bhi ( Rasoolon ko ) jhutlaya tha . unn kay payghumber unn kay paas khuli khuli nishaniyan ley ker , saheefay ley ker aur roshni phelaney wali kitab ley ker aaye thay .
ayahs.translation: aur agar yeh log tumhen jhutla rahey hain to jo ( kafir ) inn say pehlay thay , unhon ney bhi ( Rasoolon ko ) jhutlaya tha . unn kay payghumber unn kay paas khuli khuli nishaniyan ley ker , saheefay ley ker aur roshni phelaney wali kitab ley ker aaye thay .

ayahs.text: phir jinn logon  ney inkar ki rawish apnai thi , mein ney unhen pakar mein ley liya . abb dekho kay meri saza kaisi ( holnaak ) thi !
ayahs.translation: phir jinn logon  ney inkar ki rawish apnai thi , mein ney unhen pakar mein ley liya . abb dekho kay meri saza kaisi ( holnaak ) thi !

ayahs.text: kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay Allah ney aasman say paani utaara , phir hum ney uss kay zariye rang ba-rang kay phal ugaye-? aur paharon mein bhi aesay tukrray hain jo rang ba-rang kay safaid aur surkh hain , aur kalay siyah bhi .
ayahs.translation: kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay Allah ney aasman say paani utaara , phir hum ney uss kay zariye rang ba-rang kay phal ugaye-? aur paharon mein bhi aesay tukrray hain jo rang ba-rang kay safaid aur surkh hain , aur kalay siyah bhi .

ayahs.text: aur insanon aur janweron aur chopayo mein bhi aesay hain jinn kay rang mukhtalif hain . Allah say uss kay bandon mein say wohi dartay hain jo ilm rakhney walay hain .   yaqeenan Allah sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , boht bakhshney wala bhi .
ayahs.translation: aur insanon aur janweron aur chopayo mein bhi aesay hain jinn kay rang mukhtalif hain . Allah say uss kay bandon mein say wohi dartay hain jo ilm rakhney walay hain .   yaqeenan Allah sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , boht bakhshney wala bhi .

ayahs.text: jo log Allah ki kitab ki tilawat kertay hain , aur jinhon ney namaz ki pabandi ker rakhi hai , aur hum ney unhen jo rizq diya hai , uss mein say woh ( naik kamon mein ) khufiya aur aelania kharch kertay hain , woh aesi tijarat kay umeedwaar hain jo kabhi nuqsan nahi uthaye gi .
ayahs.translation: jo log Allah ki kitab ki tilawat kertay hain , aur jinhon ney namaz ki pabandi ker rakhi hai , aur hum ney unhen jo rizq diya hai , uss mein say woh ( naik kamon mein ) khufiya aur aelania kharch kertay hain , woh aesi tijarat kay umeedwaar hain jo kabhi nuqsan nahi uthaye gi .

ayahs.text: takay Allah unn kay pooray ajar unn ko deydey , aur apney fazal say aur ziyada bhi dey . yaqeenan woh boht bakhshney wala , bara qadar daan hai .
ayahs.translation: takay Allah unn kay pooray ajar unn ko deydey , aur apney fazal say aur ziyada bhi dey . yaqeenan woh boht bakhshney wala , bara qadar daan hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumharay paas wahi kay zariye jo kitab bheji hai , woh sachi hai jo apney say pehli kitabon ki tasdeeq kerti hoi aai hai . yaqeenan Allah apney bandon say poori tarah ba-khabar , her cheez ko dekhney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumharay paas wahi kay zariye jo kitab bheji hai , woh sachi hai jo apney say pehli kitabon ki tasdeeq kerti hoi aai hai . yaqeenan Allah apney bandon say poori tarah ba-khabar , her cheez ko dekhney wala hai .

ayahs.text: phir hum ney iss kitab ka waris apney bandon mein say unn ko banaya jinhen hum ney chunn liya tha .   phir unn mein say kuch woh hain jo apni jaan per zulm kernay walay hain , aur unhi mein say kuch aesay hain jo darmiyaney darjay kay hain , aur kuch woh hain jo Allah ki tofiq say naikiyon mein barhay chalay jatay hain . aur yeh ( Allah ka ) boht bara fazal hai .
ayahs.translation: phir hum ney iss kitab ka waris apney bandon mein say unn ko banaya jinhen hum ney chunn liya tha .   phir unn mein say kuch woh hain jo apni jaan per zulm kernay walay hain , aur unhi mein say kuch aesay hain jo darmiyaney darjay kay hain , aur kuch woh hain jo Allah ki tofiq say naikiyon mein barhay chalay jatay hain . aur yeh ( Allah ka ) boht bara fazal hai .

ayahs.text: hamesha basney kay baaghaat hain jinn mein woh log dakhil hon gay , wahan unn ko soney kay kangganon aur motiyon say aarasta kiya jaye ga , aur unn ka libas wahan per resham hoga .
ayahs.translation: hamesha basney kay baaghaat hain jinn mein woh log dakhil hon gay , wahan unn ko soney kay kangganon aur motiyon say aarasta kiya jaye ga , aur unn ka libas wahan per resham hoga .

ayahs.text: aur woh kahen gay kay :  tamam tarr tareef Allah ki hai jiss ney hum say her ghum door kerdiya . beyshak humara perwerdigar boht bakhshney wala , bara qadardaan hai ,
ayahs.translation: aur woh kahen gay kay :  tamam tarr tareef Allah ki hai jiss ney hum say her ghum door kerdiya . beyshak humara perwerdigar boht bakhshney wala , bara qadardaan hai ,

ayahs.text: jiss ney apney fazal say hum ko abadi thikaney kay ghar mein laa utaara hai jiss mein naa hamen kabhi koi kulfat choo-ker guzray gi , aur naa kabhi koi thakan paish aaye gi .
ayahs.translation: jiss ney apney fazal say hum ko abadi thikaney kay ghar mein laa utaara hai jiss mein naa hamen kabhi koi kulfat choo-ker guzray gi , aur naa kabhi koi thakan paish aaye gi .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr ki rawish apna li hai , unn kay liye dozakh ki aag hai . naa to unn ka kaam tamam kiya jaye ga kay woh mar hi jayen , aur naa unn say dozakh ka azab halka kiya jaye ga . her nashukray kafir ko hum aesi hi saza detay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr ki rawish apna li hai , unn kay liye dozakh ki aag hai . naa to unn ka kaam tamam kiya jaye ga kay woh mar hi jayen , aur naa unn say dozakh ka azab halka kiya jaye ga . her nashukray kafir ko hum aesi hi saza detay hain .

ayahs.text: aur woh uss dozakh mein cheekh pukar machayen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen bahir nikal dey takay hum jo kaam pehlay kiya kertay thay , unhen chorr ker naik amal keren .  ( unn say jawab mein kaha jaye ga kay : )  bhala kiya hum ney tumhen itni umar nahi di thi kay jiss kissi ko uss mein sochna samajhna hota , woh samajh leta-? aur tumharay paas khabrdar kernay wala bhi aaya tha .   abb maza chakho , kiyonkay koi nahi hai jo aesay zalimon ka madadgaar banay .
ayahs.translation: aur woh uss dozakh mein cheekh pukar machayen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen bahir nikal dey takay hum jo kaam pehlay kiya kertay thay , unhen chorr ker naik amal keren .  ( unn say jawab mein kaha jaye ga kay : )  bhala kiya hum ney tumhen itni umar nahi di thi kay jiss kissi ko uss mein sochna samajhna hota , woh samajh leta-? aur tumharay paas khabrdar kernay wala bhi aaya tha .   abb maza chakho , kiyonkay koi nahi hai jo aesay zalimon ka madadgaar banay .

ayahs.text: beyshak Allah aasmano aur zameen ki posheeda cheezon ka ilm rakhta hai . beyshak woh seenon mein chupi hoi baaton ko khoob janta hai .
ayahs.translation: beyshak Allah aasmano aur zameen ki posheeda cheezon ka ilm rakhta hai . beyshak woh seenon mein chupi hoi baaton ko khoob janta hai .

ayahs.text: wohi hai jiss ney tumhen zameen mein ( pichlay logon  ka ) janasheen banaya . abb jo shaks kufr keray ga to uss ka kufr ussi per parray ga . aur kafiron kay liye unn ka kufr unn kay perwerdigar kay paas ghazab kay siwa kissi aur cheez mein izafa nahi kerta , aur kafiron ko unn kay kufr say khasaray kay siwa kissi cheez mein taraqqi hasil nahi hoti .
ayahs.translation: wohi hai jiss ney tumhen zameen mein ( pichlay logon  ka ) janasheen banaya . abb jo shaks kufr keray ga to uss ka kufr ussi per parray ga . aur kafiron kay liye unn ka kufr unn kay perwerdigar kay paas ghazab kay siwa kissi aur cheez mein izafa nahi kerta , aur kafiron ko unn kay kufr say khasaray kay siwa kissi cheez mein taraqqi hasil nahi hoti .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) inn say kaho kay :  bhala batao tum Allah ko chorr ker apney jinn mann gharrat shareekon ko pooja kertay ho , zara mujhay dikhao kay unhon ney zameen ka konsa hissa peda kiya hai ? ya aasmano ( ki pedaeesh mein ) unn ki konsi shirkat hai ?  ya phir hum ney unhen koi kitab dey rakhi hai jiss ki kissi wazeh hidayat per yeh log qaeem hain-?   nahi , balkay yeh zalim log aik doosray ko khalis dhokay ki yaqeen dahani kertay aaye hain .

ayahs.text: aur enhon ney pehlay baray zoron mein Allah ki qasmen khai then kay agar inn kay paas koi khabrdar kernay wala ( payghumber ) aaya to woh her doosri ummat say ziyada hidayat qubool kernay walay hon gay .   magar jab unn kay paas aik khabrdar kernay wala aagaya to uss kay aaney say unn ki halat mein aur koi taraqqi nahi hoi , siwaye iss kay kay yeh ( haq kay raastay say ) aur ziyada bhagney lagay ,
ayahs.translation: aur enhon ney pehlay baray zoron mein Allah ki qasmen khai then kay agar inn kay paas koi khabrdar kernay wala ( payghumber ) aaya to woh her doosri ummat say ziyada hidayat qubool kernay walay hon gay .   magar jab unn kay paas aik khabrdar kernay wala aagaya to uss kay aaney say unn ki halat mein aur koi taraqqi nahi hoi , siwaye iss kay kay yeh ( haq kay raastay say ) aur ziyada bhagney lagay ,

ayahs.text: iss liye kay enhen zameen mein apni barai ka ghamand tha , aur enhon ney ( haq ki mukhalifat mein ) buri buri chaalen chalni shuroo kerden . halankay buri chaalen kissi aur ko nahi , khud apney chalney walon hi ko gheray mein ley leti hain .   abb yeh log uss dastoor kay siwa kiss baat kay muntazir hain jiss per pichlay logon  kay sath amal hota aaya hai ?   ( agar yeh baat hai ) to tum Allah kay tey shuda dastoor mein kabhi koi tabdeeli nahi pao gay , aur naa tum Allah kay tey shuda dastoor ko kabhi talta huwa pao gay .
ayahs.translation: iss liye kay enhen zameen mein apni barai ka ghamand tha , aur enhon ney ( haq ki mukhalifat mein ) buri buri chaalen chalni shuroo kerden . halankay buri chaalen kissi aur ko nahi , khud apney chalney walon hi ko gheray mein ley leti hain .   abb yeh log uss dastoor kay siwa kiss baat kay muntazir hain jiss per pichlay logon  kay sath amal hota aaya hai ? ayahs.text: aur kiya inn logon  ney zameen mein kabhi safar nahi kiya jiss say woh yeh dekhtay kay jo log inn say pehlay guzray hain , unn ka anjam kaisa huwa , jabkay woh taqat mein inn say boht ziyada mazboot thay ? aur Allah aisa nahi hai kay aasmano ya zameen ki koi cheez ussay aajiz ker-sakay . beyshak woh ilm ka bhi malik hai , qudrat ka bhi malik .
ayahs.translation: aur kiya inn logon  ney zameen mein kabhi safar nahi kiya jiss say woh yeh dekhtay kay jo log inn say pehlay guzray hain , unn ka anjam kaisa huwa , jabkay woh taqat mein inn say boht ziyada mazboot thay ? aur Allah aisa nahi hai kay aasmano ya zameen ki koi cheez ussay aajiz ker-sakay . beyshak woh ilm ka bhi malik hai , qudrat ka bhi malik .

ayahs.text: aur agar Allah logon  kay her kartoot per unn ki pakar kernay lagta to iss zameen ki pusht per kissi chalney walay ko naa chorta , lekin woh aik moyyan mauddat tak kay liye unn ko mohlat dey raha hai . phir jab unn ka muqarrara waqt aajaye ga , to Allah apney bandon ko khud dekh ley ga .
