verses.text: takay tum unn logon  ko khabrdar kero jinn kay baap dadon ko pehlay khabrdar nahi kiya gaya tha ,   iss liye woh ghaflat mein parray huye hain .
verses.translation: takay tum unn logon  ko khabrdar kero jinn kay baap dadon ko pehlay khabrdar nahi kiya gaya tha ,   iss liye woh ghaflat mein parray huye hain .

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay unn mein say aksar logon  kay baaray mein baat poori hochuki hai ,   iss liye woh emaan nahi latay .
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay unn mein say aksar logon  kay baaray mein baat poori hochuki hai ,   iss liye woh emaan nahi latay .

verses.text: hum ney unn kay galon mein toq daal rakhay hain , jo thorriyon tak phonchay huye hain , aur iss wajeh say unn kay sar oopper ko uthay reh gaye hain .
verses.translation: hum ney unn kay galon mein toq daal rakhay hain , jo thorriyon tak phonchay huye hain , aur iss wajeh say unn kay sar oopper ko uthay reh gaye hain .

verses.text: aur hum ney aik aarr unn kay aagay kharri kerdi hai , aur aik aarr unn kay peechay kharri kerdi hai , aur iss tarah unhen her taraf say dhaank liya hai jiss kay nateejay mein unhen kuch sujhai nahi deta .
verses.translation: aur hum ney aik aarr unn kay aagay kharri kerdi hai , aur aik aarr unn kay peechay kharri kerdi hai , aur iss tarah unhen her taraf say dhaank liya hai jiss kay nateejay mein unhen kuch sujhai nahi deta .

verses.text: aur unn kay liye dono baaten barabar hain , chahye tum unhen khabrdar kero , ya khabrdar naa kero , woh emaan nahi layen gay .
verses.translation: aur unn kay liye dono baaten barabar hain , chahye tum unhen khabrdar kero , ya khabrdar naa kero , woh emaan nahi layen gay .

verses.text: tum to sirf aesay shaks ko khabrdar ker-saktay ho jo naseehat per chalay , aur khudaye rehman ko dekhay baghair uss say daray . chunacheh aesay shaks ko tum maghfirat aur ba-izzat ajar ki khushkhabri suna do .
verses.translation: tum to sirf aesay shaks ko khabrdar ker-saktay ho jo naseehat per chalay , aur khudaye rehman ko dekhay baghair uss say daray . chunacheh aesay shaks ko tum maghfirat aur ba-izzat ajar ki khushkhabri suna do .

verses.text: yaqeenan hum hi murdon ko zinda keren gay , aur jo kuch amal unhon ney aagay bhejay hain , hum unn ko bhi likhtay jatay hain , aur unn kay kamon kay jo asraat hain unn ko bhi .   aur hum ney aik wazeh kitab mein her her cheez ka poora ehata ker rakha hai .
verses.translation: yaqeenan hum hi murdon ko zinda keren gay , aur jo kuch amal unhon ney aagay bhejay hain , hum unn ko bhi likhtay jatay hain , aur unn kay kamon kay jo asraat hain unn ko bhi .   aur hum ney aik wazeh kitab mein her her cheez ka poora ehata ker rakha hai .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn kay samney aik basti walon ki misal paish kero , jab unn kay paas Rasool aaye thay .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn kay samney aik basti walon ki misal paish kero , jab unn kay paas Rasool aaye thay .

verses.text: jab hum ney unn kay paas ( shuroo mein ) do Rasool bhejay , to unhon ney dono ko jhutla diya , phir hum ney aik teesray kay zariye unn ki taeed ki , aur unn sabb ney kaha kay :  yaqeen jano hamen tumharay paas Rasool bana ker bheja gaya hai .
verses.translation: jab hum ney unn kay paas ( shuroo mein ) do Rasool bhejay , to unhon ney dono ko jhutla diya , phir hum ney aik teesray kay zariye unn ki taeed ki , aur unn sabb ney kaha kay :  yaqeen jano hamen tumharay paas Rasool bana ker bheja gaya hai .

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  tumhari haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch bhi nahi kay tum hum jaisay hi aadmi ho . aur khudaye rehman ney koi cheez nazil nahi ki hai , aur tum sarasar jhoot bol rahey ho .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  tumhari haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch bhi nahi kay tum hum jaisay hi aadmi ho . aur khudaye rehman ney koi cheez nazil nahi ki hai , aur tum sarasar jhoot bol rahey ho .

verses.text: unn ( Rasoolon ) ney kaha :  humara perwerdigar khoob janta hai kay hamen waqaee tumharay paas Rasool bana ker bheja gaya hai .
verses.translation: unn ( Rasoolon ) ney kaha :  humara perwerdigar khoob janta hai kay hamen waqaee tumharay paas Rasool bana ker bheja gaya hai .

verses.text: aur humari zimma daari iss say ziyada nahi hai kay saaf saaf paygham phoncha den .
verses.translation: aur humari zimma daari iss say ziyada nahi hai kay saaf saaf paygham phoncha den .

verses.text: basti walon ney kaha :  hum ney to tumharay andar nahoosat mehsoos ki hai .   yaqeen jano agar tum baaz naa aaye to hum tum per pathar barsayen gay , aur humaray haathon tumhen bari dardnak saza milay gi .
verses.translation: basti walon ney kaha :  hum ney to tumharay andar nahoosat mehsoos ki hai .   yaqeen jano agar tum baaz naa aaye to hum tum per pathar barsayen gay , aur humaray haathon tumhen bari dardnak saza milay gi .

verses.text: Rasoolon ney kaha :  tumhari nahoosat khud tumharay sath lagi hoi hai .   kiya yeh baaten iss liye ker rahey ho kay tumhen naseehat ki baat phonchai gaee hai ? asal baat yeh hai kay tum khud hadd say guzray huye log ho .
verses.translation: Rasoolon ney kaha :  tumhari nahoosat khud tumharay sath lagi hoi hai .   kiya yeh baaten iss liye ker rahey ho kay tumhen naseehat ki baat phonchai gaee hai ? asal baat yeh hai kay tum khud hadd say guzray huye log ho .

verses.text: aur shehar kay perlay ilaqay say aik shaks dorrta huwa aaya .   uss ney kaha :  aey meri qoam kay logo ! inn Rasoolon ka kehna maan lo ,
verses.translation: aur shehar kay perlay ilaqay say aik shaks dorrta huwa aaya .   uss ney kaha :  aey meri qoam kay logo ! inn Rasoolon ka kehna maan lo ,

verses.text: inn logon  ka kehna maan lo jo tum say koi ujrat nahi maang rahey , aur woh sahih raastay per hain .
verses.translation: inn logon  ka kehna maan lo jo tum say koi ujrat nahi maang rahey , aur woh sahih raastay per hain .

verses.text: aur bhala mein uss zaat ki ibadat kiyon naa kerun jiss ney mujhay peda kiya hai ? aur ussi ki taraf tum sabb ko wapis bheja jaye ga .
verses.translation: aur bhala mein uss zaat ki ibadat kiyon naa kerun jiss ney mujhay peda kiya hai ? aur ussi ki taraf tum sabb ko wapis bheja jaye ga .

verses.text: bhala kiya ussay chorr ker mein aeson ko mabood maanun kay agar khudaye rehman mujhay koi nuqsan phonchaney ka irada kerlay to unn ki sifarish meray kissi kaam naa aaye , aur naa woh mujhay churra saken-?
verses.translation: bhala kiya ussay chorr ker mein aeson ko mabood maanun kay agar khudaye rehman mujhay koi nuqsan phonchaney ka irada kerlay to unn ki sifarish meray kissi kaam naa aaye , aur naa woh mujhay churra saken-?

verses.text: agar mein aisa kerun ga to yaqeenan mein khuli gumrahi mein mubtala hojaon ga .
verses.translation: agar mein aisa kerun ga to yaqeenan mein khuli gumrahi mein mubtala hojaon ga .

verses.text: mein to tumharay perwerdigar per emaan laa-chuka . abb tum bhi meri baat sunn lo .
verses.translation: mein to tumharay perwerdigar per emaan laa-chuka . abb tum bhi meri baat sunn lo .

verses.text: . ( aakhir kaar basti walon ney uss ko qatal kerdiya ,   aur Allah taalaa ki taraf say uss say ) kaha gaya kay :  jannat mein dakhil hojao .    uss ney ( jannat ki naimaten dekh ker ) kaha kay :  kaash ! meri qoam ko maloom hojaye
verses.translation: . ( aakhir kaar basti walon ney uss ko qatal kerdiya ,   aur Allah taalaa ki taraf say uss say ) kaha gaya kay :  jannat mein dakhil hojao .    uss ney ( jannat ki naimaten dekh ker ) kaha kay :  kaash ! meri qoam ko maloom hojaye

verses.text: kay meray perwerdigar ney kiss tarah meri bakhshish ki hai , aur mujhay ba-izzat logon  mein shamil kiya hai !
verses.translation: kay meray perwerdigar ney kiss tarah meri bakhshish ki hai , aur mujhay ba-izzat logon  mein shamil kiya hai !

verses.text: aur uss shaks kay baad hum ney uss ki qoam per aasman say koi lashkar nahi utaara , aur naa hamen utaarney ki zaroorat thi .
verses.translation: aur uss shaks kay baad hum ney uss ki qoam per aasman say koi lashkar nahi utaara , aur naa hamen utaarney ki zaroorat thi .

verses.text: woh to bus aik hi chinghaarr thi jiss say woh aik dum bujh ker reh gaye .
verses.translation: woh to bus aik hi chinghaarr thi jiss say woh aik dum bujh ker reh gaye .

verses.text: afsos hai aesay bandon kay haal per ! unn kay paas koi Rasool aisa nahi aaya jiss ka woh mazaq naa uratay rahey hon .
verses.translation: afsos hai aesay bandon kay haal per ! unn kay paas koi Rasool aisa nahi aaya jiss ka woh mazaq naa uratay rahey hon .

verses.text: kiya unhon ney nahi dekha kay unn say pehlay hum kitni qoamon ko iss tarah halak ker-chukay hain kay woh unn kay paas loat ker nahi aatay ?
verses.translation: kiya unhon ney nahi dekha kay unn say pehlay hum kitni qoamon ko iss tarah halak ker-chukay hain kay woh unn kay paas loat ker nahi aatay ?

verses.text: aur yeh jitney log hain , inn sabhi ko ikattha ker kay humaray samney hazir kiya jaye ga .
verses.translation: aur yeh jitney log hain , inn sabhi ko ikattha ker kay humaray samney hazir kiya jaye ga .

verses.text: aur inn kay liye aik nishani woh zameen hai jo murda parri hoi thi . hum ney ussay zindagi ata ki , aur uss say ghalla nikala , jiss ki khurak yeh khatay hain .
verses.translation: aur inn kay liye aik nishani woh zameen hai jo murda parri hoi thi . hum ney ussay zindagi ata ki , aur uss say ghalla nikala , jiss ki khurak yeh khatay hain .

verses.text: aur hum ney uss zameen mein khajooron aur angooron kay baagh peda kiye , aur aisa intizam kiya kay uss mein say paani kay chashmay phoot niklay ,
verses.translation: aur hum ney uss zameen mein khajooron aur angooron kay baagh peda kiye , aur aisa intizam kiya kay uss mein say paani kay chashmay phoot niklay ,

verses.text: takay yeh uss ki pedawaar mein say khayen , halankay uss ko inn kay haathon ney nahi banaya tha .   kiya phir bhi yeh shukar ada nahi keren gay ?
verses.translation: takay yeh uss ki pedawaar mein say khayen , halankay uss ko inn kay haathon ney nahi banaya tha .   kiya phir bhi yeh shukar ada nahi keren gay ?

verses.text: pak hai woh zaat jiss ney her cheez kay jooray jooray peda kiye hain , uss pedawaar kay bhi jo zameen ugati hai , aur khud inn insanon kay bhi , aur unn cheezon kay bhi jinhen yeh log ( abhi ) jantay tak nahi hain .
verses.translation: pak hai woh zaat jiss ney her cheez kay jooray jooray peda kiye hain , uss pedawaar kay bhi jo zameen ugati hai , aur khud inn insanon kay bhi , aur unn cheezon kay bhi jinhen yeh log ( abhi ) jantay tak nahi hain .

verses.text: aur inn kay liye aik aur nishani raat hai . hum uss per say din ka chilka utaar letay hain to woh yakayak andheray mein reh jatay hain .
verses.translation: aur inn kay liye aik aur nishani raat hai . hum uss per say din ka chilka utaar letay hain to woh yakayak andheray mein reh jatay hain .

verses.text: aur sooraj apney thikaney ki taraf chala jaraha hai . yeh sabb uss zaat ka muqarrar kiya huwa nizam hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ka ilm bhi kamil .
verses.translation: aur sooraj apney thikaney ki taraf chala jaraha hai . yeh sabb uss zaat ka muqarrar kiya huwa nizam hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ka ilm bhi kamil .

verses.text: aur chaand hai kay hum ney uss ki manzilen naap tol ker muqarrar kerdi hain , yahan tak kay woh jab ( unn manzilon kay doray say ) loat ker aata hai to khajoor ki purani tehni ki tarah ( patla ) ho ker reh jata hai .
verses.translation: aur chaand hai kay hum ney uss ki manzilen naap tol ker muqarrar kerdi hain , yahan tak kay woh jab ( unn manzilon kay doray say ) loat ker aata hai to khajoor ki purani tehni ki tarah ( patla ) ho ker reh jata hai .

verses.text: naa to sooraj ki yeh majal hai kay woh chaand ko ja-pakray ,   aur naa raat din say aagay nikal sakti hai . aur yeh sabb apney apney madaar mein ter rahey hain .
verses.translation: naa to sooraj ki yeh majal hai kay woh chaand ko ja-pakray ,   aur naa raat din say aagay nikal sakti hai . aur yeh sabb apney apney madaar mein ter rahey hain .

verses.text: aur inn kay liye aik aur nishani yeh hai kay hum ney inn ki aulad ko bhari hoi kashti mein sawar kiya ,
verses.translation: aur inn kay liye aik aur nishani yeh hai kay hum ney inn ki aulad ko bhari hoi kashti mein sawar kiya ,

verses.text: aur hum ney inn kay liye ussi jaisi aur cheezen bhi peda ken jinn per yeh sawari kertay hain .
verses.translation: aur hum ney inn kay liye ussi jaisi aur cheezen bhi peda ken jinn per yeh sawari kertay hain .

verses.text: aur agar hum chahen to enhen gharq ker daalen , jiss kay baad naa to koi inn ki fariyad ko phonchay , aur naa unn ki jaan bachai jasakay .
verses.translation: aur agar hum chahen to enhen gharq ker daalen , jiss kay baad naa to koi inn ki fariyad ko phonchay , aur naa unn ki jaan bachai jasakay .

verses.text: lekin yeh sabb humari taraf say aik rehmat hai , aur aik moyyan waqt tak ( zindagi ka ) maza uthaney ka moaqa hai ( jo enhen diya jaraha hai ) .
verses.translation: lekin yeh sabb humari taraf say aik rehmat hai , aur aik moyyan waqt tak ( zindagi ka ) maza uthaney ka moaqa hai ( jo enhen diya jaraha hai ) .

verses.text: aur jab inn say kaha jata hai kay :  bacho uss ( azab ) say jo tumharay samney hai , aur jo tumharay ( marney kay ) baad aaye ga , takay tum per reham kiya jaye .  ( to woh zara kaan nahi dhartay )
verses.translation: aur jab inn say kaha jata hai kay :  bacho uss ( azab ) say jo tumharay samney hai , aur jo tumharay ( marney kay ) baad aaye ga , takay tum per reham kiya jaye .  ( to woh zara kaan nahi dhartay )

verses.text: aur unn kay perwerdigar ki nishaniyon mein say koi nishani aesi nahi aati jiss say woh mun naa morr letay hon .
verses.translation: aur unn kay perwerdigar ki nishaniyon mein say koi nishani aesi nahi aati jiss say woh mun naa morr letay hon .

verses.text: aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay :  Allah ney tumhen jo rizq diya hai , uss mein say ( ghareebon per bhi ) kharch kero  , to yeh kafir log musalmanon say kehtay hain kay :  kiya hum unn logon  ko khana khilayen jinhen agar Allah chahta to khud khila deta ? ( musalmano ! ) tumhari haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch bhi nahi kay tum khuli gumrahi mein parray huye ho .
verses.translation: aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay :  Allah ney tumhen jo rizq diya hai , uss mein say ( ghareebon per bhi ) kharch kero  , to yeh kafir log musalmanon say kehtay hain kay :  kiya hum unn logon  ko khana khilayen jinhen agar Allah chahta to khud khila deta ? ( musalmano ! ) tumhari haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch bhi nahi kay tum khuli gumrahi mein parray huye ho .

verses.text: aur kehtay hain kay :  yeh ( qayamat ka ) wada kab poora hoga-? ( musalmano ! ) batao , agar tum sachay ho .
verses.translation: aur kehtay hain kay :  yeh ( qayamat ka ) wada kab poora hoga-? ( musalmano ! ) batao , agar tum sachay ho .

verses.text: . ( darasal ) yeh log bus aik chinghaarr ka intizar ker rahey hain jo inn ki hujjat bazi kay aen darmiyan enhen aa-pakray gi ,
verses.translation: . ( darasal ) yeh log bus aik chinghaarr ka intizar ker rahey hain jo inn ki hujjat bazi kay aen darmiyan enhen aa-pakray gi ,

verses.text: phir naa yeh koi wasiyyat ker-saken gay , aur naa apney ghar walon kay paas loat ker jasaken gay .
verses.translation: phir naa yeh koi wasiyyat ker-saken gay , aur naa apney ghar walon kay paas loat ker jasaken gay .

verses.text: aur soor phoonka jaye ga to yakayak yeh apni qabron say nikal ker apney perwerdigar ki taraf tezi say rawana hojayen gay .
verses.translation: aur soor phoonka jaye ga to yakayak yeh apni qabron say nikal ker apney perwerdigar ki taraf tezi say rawana hojayen gay .

verses.text: kahen gay kay :  haaye humari kam bakhti ! hamen kiss ney humaray marqad say utha kharra kiya hai ?  ( jawab milay ga kay ) :  yeh wohi cheez hai jiss ka khudaye rehman ney wada kiya tha , aur payghumberon ney sachi baat kahi thi .
verses.translation: kahen gay kay :  haaye humari kam bakhti ! hamen kiss ney humaray marqad say utha kharra kiya hai ?  ( jawab milay ga kay ) :  yeh wohi cheez hai jiss ka khudaye rehman ney wada kiya tha , aur payghumberon ney sachi baat kahi thi .

verses.text: aur kuch nahi , bus aik zor ki aawaz hogi , jiss kay baad yeh sabb kay sabb humaray samney hazir kerdiye jayen gay .
verses.translation: aur kuch nahi , bus aik zor ki aawaz hogi , jiss kay baad yeh sabb kay sabb humaray samney hazir kerdiye jayen gay .

verses.text: chunacheh uss din kissi shaks per koi zulm nahi hoga , aur tumhen kissi aur cheez ka nahi , balkay unhi kamon ka badla milay ga jo tum kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: chunacheh uss din kissi shaks per koi zulm nahi hoga , aur tumhen kissi aur cheez ka nahi , balkay unhi kamon ka badla milay ga jo tum kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: jannat walay log uss din yaqeenan apney mashghalay mein magan hon gay ,
verses.translation: jannat walay log uss din yaqeenan apney mashghalay mein magan hon gay ,

verses.text: woh aur unn ki biwiyan ghaney sayon mein aaram deh nishiston per tek lagaye huye hon gay .
verses.translation: woh aur unn ki biwiyan ghaney sayon mein aaram deh nishiston per tek lagaye huye hon gay .

verses.text: wahan unn kay liye meway hon gay , aur unhen her woh cheez milay gi jo woh mangwayen gay .
verses.translation: wahan unn kay liye meway hon gay , aur unhen her woh cheez milay gi jo woh mangwayen gay .

verses.text: rehmat walay perwerdigar ki taraf say unhen salam kaha jaye ga .
verses.translation: rehmat walay perwerdigar ki taraf say unhen salam kaha jaye ga .

verses.text: . ( aur kafiron say kaha jaye ga kay : )  aey mujrimo ! aaj tum ( mominon say ) alag hojao .
verses.translation: . ( aur kafiron say kaha jaye ga kay : )  aey mujrimo ! aaj tum ( mominon say ) alag hojao .

verses.text: aey Adam kay beto ! kiya mein ney tumhen yeh takeed nahi kerdi thi kay tum shetan ki ibadat naa kerna , woh tumhara khula dushman hai ,
verses.translation: aey Adam kay beto ! kiya mein ney tumhen yeh takeed nahi kerdi thi kay tum shetan ki ibadat naa kerna , woh tumhara khula dushman hai ,

verses.text: aur yeh kay tum meri ibadat kerna . yehi seedha raasta hai .
verses.translation: aur yeh kay tum meri ibadat kerna . yehi seedha raasta hai .

verses.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay shetan ney tum mein say aik bari khilqat ko gumrah ker daala . to kiya tum samajhtay nahi thay ?
verses.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay shetan ney tum mein say aik bari khilqat ko gumrah ker daala . to kiya tum samajhtay nahi thay ?

verses.text: yeh hai woh jahannum jiss say tumhen daraya jata tha !
verses.translation: yeh hai woh jahannum jiss say tumhen daraya jata tha !

verses.text: aaj iss mein dakhil hojao , kiyonkay tum kufr kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: aaj iss mein dakhil hojao , kiyonkay tum kufr kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: aaj kay din hum unn kay mun per mohar lagaden gay , aur unn kay haath hum say baat keren gay , aur unn kay paon gawahi den gay kay woh kiya kamai kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: aaj kay din hum unn kay mun per mohar lagaden gay , aur unn kay haath hum say baat keren gay , aur unn kay paon gawahi den gay kay woh kiya kamai kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: aur agar hum chahen to ( yahin duniya mein ) unn ki aankhen malya mait kerden , phir yeh raastay ( ki talash ) mein bhagay phiren , lekin enhen kahan kuch sujhai dey ga ?
verses.translation: aur agar hum chahen to ( yahin duniya mein ) unn ki aankhen malya mait kerden , phir yeh raastay ( ki talash ) mein bhagay phiren , lekin enhen kahan kuch sujhai dey ga ?

verses.text: aur agar hum chahen to inn ki apni jagah per bethay bethay inn ki soorten iss tarah maskh kerden kay yeh naa aagay barh saken , aur naa peechay loat saken .
verses.translation: aur agar hum chahen to inn ki apni jagah per bethay bethay inn ki soorten iss tarah maskh kerden kay yeh naa aagay barh saken , aur naa peechay loat saken .

verses.text: aur hum jiss shaks ko lambi umar detay hain , ussay takhleeqi aetbar say ulat hi detay hain .   kiya phir bhi unhen aqal nahi aati-?
verses.translation: aur hum jiss shaks ko lambi umar detay hain , ussay takhleeqi aetbar say ulat hi detay hain .   kiya phir bhi unhen aqal nahi aati-?

verses.text: aur hum ney ( apney ) inn ( payghumber ) ko naa shaeeri sikhai hai , aur naa woh inn kay shayaan-e-shaan hai .   yeh to bus aik naseehat ki baat hai , aur aisa Quran jo haqeeqat ko khol khol ker biyan kerta hai ,
verses.translation: aur hum ney ( apney ) inn ( payghumber ) ko naa shaeeri sikhai hai , aur naa woh inn kay shayaan-e-shaan hai .   yeh to bus aik naseehat ki baat hai , aur aisa Quran jo haqeeqat ko khol khol ker biyan kerta hai ,

verses.text: takay her uss shaks ko khabrdar keray jo zinda ho ,   aur takay kufr kernay walon per hujjat poori hojaye .
verses.translation: takay her uss shaks ko khabrdar keray jo zinda ho ,   aur takay kufr kernay walon per hujjat poori hojaye .

verses.text: aur kiya unhon ney yeh nahi dekha kay hum ney apney haathon ki banai hoi cheezon mein say unn kay liye maweshi peda kiye , aur yeh unn kay malik banay huye hain-?
verses.translation: aur kiya unhon ney yeh nahi dekha kay hum ney apney haathon ki banai hoi cheezon mein say unn kay liye maweshi peda kiye , aur yeh unn kay malik banay huye hain-?

verses.text: aur hum ney inn maweshiyon ko unn kay qaboo mein dey diya hai , chunacheh inn mein say kuch woh hain jo inn ki sawari banay huye hain , aur kuch woh hain jinhen yeh khatay hain .
verses.translation: aur hum ney inn maweshiyon ko unn kay qaboo mein dey diya hai , chunacheh inn mein say kuch woh hain jo inn ki sawari banay huye hain , aur kuch woh hain jinhen yeh khatay hain .

verses.text: neez inn ko inn maweshiyon say aur bhi fawaeed hasil hotay hain , aur peenay ki cheezen milti hain . kiya phir bhi yeh shukar nahi baja layen gay ?
verses.translation: neez inn ko inn maweshiyon say aur bhi fawaeed hasil hotay hain , aur peenay ki cheezen milti hain . kiya phir bhi yeh shukar nahi baja layen gay ?

verses.text: aur enhon ney Allah ko chorr ker iss umeed per doosray khuda bana rakhay hain kay enhen ( unn say ) madad milay ,
verses.translation: aur enhon ney Allah ko chorr ker iss umeed per doosray khuda bana rakhay hain kay enhen ( unn say ) madad milay ,

verses.text: . ( halankay ) unn mein yeh taqat hi nahi hai kay inn ki madad ker-saken , balkay woh inn kay liye aik aisa ( mukhalif ) lashkar banen gay jissay ( qayamat mein inn kay samney ) hazir kerliya jaye ga .
verses.translation: . ( halankay ) unn mein yeh taqat hi nahi hai kay inn ki madad ker-saken , balkay woh inn kay liye aik aisa ( mukhalif ) lashkar banen gay jissay ( qayamat mein inn kay samney ) hazir kerliya jaye ga .

verses.text: gharz ( aey payghumber ! ) inn ki baaten tumhen ranjeedah naa keren . yaqeen jano hamen sabb maloom hai kay yeh kiya kuch chupatay , aur kiya kuch zahir kertay hain .
verses.translation: gharz ( aey payghumber ! ) inn ki baaten tumhen ranjeedah naa keren . yaqeen jano hamen sabb maloom hai kay yeh kiya kuch chupatay , aur kiya kuch zahir kertay hain .

verses.text: aur kiya insan ney yeh nahi dekha kay hum ney ussay nutfay say peda kiya tha-? phir achanak woh khullam khula jhagrra kernay wala ban gaya .
verses.translation: aur kiya insan ney yeh nahi dekha kay hum ney ussay nutfay say peda kiya tha-? phir achanak woh khullam khula jhagrra kernay wala ban gaya .

verses.text: humaray baaray mein to woh baaten banata hai , aur khud apni pedaeesh ko bhula betha hai . kehta hai kay :  inn haddiyon ko kon zindagi dey ga jabkay woh gal chuki hon gi ?
verses.translation: humaray baaray mein to woh baaten banata hai , aur khud apni pedaeesh ko bhula betha hai . kehta hai kay :  inn haddiyon ko kon zindagi dey ga jabkay woh gal chuki hon gi ?

verses.text: keh do kay :  inn ko wohi zindagi dey ga jiss ney enhen pehli baar peda kiya tha , aur woh peda kernay ka her kaam janta hai ,
verses.translation: keh do kay :  inn ko wohi zindagi dey ga jiss ney enhen pehli baar peda kiya tha , aur woh peda kernay ka her kaam janta hai ,

verses.text: wohi hai jiss ney tumharay liye sarsabz darkht say aag peda kerdi hai ,   phir tum zara si dair mein uss say sulganey ka kaam ley letay ho .
verses.translation: wohi hai jiss ney tumharay liye sarsabz darkht say aag peda kerdi hai ,   phir tum zara si dair mein uss say sulganey ka kaam ley letay ho .

verses.text: bhala jiss zaat ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya hai , kiya woh iss baat per qadir nahi hai kay inn jaison ko ( dobara ) peda ker-sakay ? kiyon nahi-? jabkay woh sabb kuch peda kernay ki poori maharat rakhta hai !
verses.translation: bhala jiss zaat ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya hai , kiya woh iss baat per qadir nahi hai kay inn jaison ko ( dobara ) peda ker-sakay ? kiyon nahi-? jabkay woh sabb kuch peda kernay ki poori maharat rakhta hai !

verses.text: uss ka moamla to yeh hai kay jab woh kissi cheez ka irada kerlay to sirf itna kehta hai kay :  hoja  bus woh hojati hai .
verses.translation: uss ka moamla to yeh hai kay jab woh kissi cheez ka irada kerlay to sirf itna kehta hai kay :  hoja  bus woh hojati hai .

verses.text: gharz pak hai woh zaat jiss kay haath mein her cheez ki hukoomat hai , aur ussi ki taraf tum sabb ko aakhir kaar ley jaya jaye ga .
verses.translation: gharz pak hai woh zaat jiss kay haath mein her cheez ki hukoomat hai , aur ussi ki taraf tum sabb ko aakhir kaar ley jaya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: Ya-Seen !
ayahs.translation: Ya-Seen !

ayahs.text: hikmat bharay Quran ki qasam !
ayahs.translation: hikmat bharay Quran ki qasam !

ayahs.text: tum yaqeenan payghumberon mein say ho
ayahs.translation: tum yaqeenan payghumberon mein say ho

ayahs.text: bilkul seedhay raastay per !
ayahs.translation: bilkul seedhay raastay per !

ayahs.text: yeh Quran uss zaat ki taraf say utaara jaraha hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki rehmat bhi kamil ,
ayahs.translation: yeh Quran uss zaat ki taraf say utaara jaraha hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki rehmat bhi kamil ,

ayahs.text: takay tum unn logon  ko khabrdar kero jinn kay baap dadon ko pehlay khabrdar nahi kiya gaya tha ,   iss liye woh ghaflat mein parray huye hain .
ayahs.translation: takay tum unn logon  ko khabrdar kero jinn kay baap dadon ko pehlay khabrdar nahi kiya gaya tha ,   iss liye woh ghaflat mein parray huye hain .

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay unn mein say aksar logon  kay baaray mein baat poori hochuki hai ,   iss liye woh emaan nahi latay .
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay unn mein say aksar logon  kay baaray mein baat poori hochuki hai ,   iss liye woh emaan nahi latay .

ayahs.text: hum ney unn kay galon mein toq daal rakhay hain , jo thorriyon tak phonchay huye hain , aur iss wajeh say unn kay sar oopper ko uthay reh gaye hain .
ayahs.translation: hum ney unn kay galon mein toq daal rakhay hain , jo thorriyon tak phonchay huye hain , aur iss wajeh say unn kay sar oopper ko uthay reh gaye hain .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney aik aarr unn kay aagay kharri kerdi hai , aur aik aarr unn kay peechay kharri kerdi hai , aur iss tarah unhen her taraf say dhaank liya hai jiss kay nateejay mein unhen kuch sujhai nahi deta .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney aik aarr unn kay aagay kharri kerdi hai , aur aik aarr unn kay peechay kharri kerdi hai , aur iss tarah unhen her taraf say dhaank liya hai jiss kay nateejay mein unhen kuch sujhai nahi deta .

ayahs.text: aur unn kay liye dono baaten barabar hain , chahye tum unhen khabrdar kero , ya khabrdar naa kero , woh emaan nahi layen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur unn kay liye dono baaten barabar hain , chahye tum unhen khabrdar kero , ya khabrdar naa kero , woh emaan nahi layen gay .

ayahs.text: tum to sirf aesay shaks ko khabrdar ker-saktay ho jo naseehat per chalay , aur khudaye rehman ko dekhay baghair uss say daray . chunacheh aesay shaks ko tum maghfirat aur ba-izzat ajar ki khushkhabri suna do .
ayahs.translation: tum to sirf aesay shaks ko khabrdar ker-saktay ho jo naseehat per chalay , aur khudaye rehman ko dekhay baghair uss say daray . chunacheh aesay shaks ko tum maghfirat aur ba-izzat ajar ki khushkhabri suna do .

ayahs.text: yaqeenan hum hi murdon ko zinda keren gay , aur jo kuch amal unhon ney aagay bhejay hain , hum unn ko bhi likhtay jatay hain , aur unn kay kamon kay jo asraat hain unn ko bhi .   aur hum ney aik wazeh kitab mein her her cheez ka poora ehata ker rakha hai .
ayahs.translation: yaqeenan hum hi murdon ko zinda keren gay , aur jo kuch amal unhon ney aagay bhejay hain , hum unn ko bhi likhtay jatay hain , aur unn kay kamon kay jo asraat hain unn ko bhi .   aur hum ney aik wazeh kitab mein her her cheez ka poora ehata ker rakha hai .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn kay samney aik basti walon ki misal paish kero , jab unn kay paas Rasool aaye thay .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn kay samney aik basti walon ki misal paish kero , jab unn kay paas Rasool aaye thay .

ayahs.text: jab hum ney unn kay paas ( shuroo mein ) do Rasool bhejay , to unhon ney dono ko jhutla diya , phir hum ney aik teesray kay zariye unn ki taeed ki , aur unn sabb ney kaha kay :  yaqeen jano hamen tumharay paas Rasool bana ker bheja gaya hai .
ayahs.translation: jab hum ney unn kay paas ( shuroo mein ) do Rasool bhejay , to unhon ney dono ko jhutla diya , phir hum ney aik teesray kay zariye unn ki taeed ki , aur unn sabb ney kaha kay :  yaqeen jano hamen tumharay paas Rasool bana ker bheja gaya hai .

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha :  tumhari haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch bhi nahi kay tum hum jaisay hi aadmi ho . aur khudaye rehman ney koi cheez nazil nahi ki hai , aur tum sarasar jhoot bol rahey ho .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha :  tumhari haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch bhi nahi kay tum hum jaisay hi aadmi ho . aur khudaye rehman ney koi cheez nazil nahi ki hai , aur tum sarasar jhoot bol rahey ho .

ayahs.text: unn ( Rasoolon ) ney kaha :  humara perwerdigar khoob janta hai kay hamen waqaee tumharay paas Rasool bana ker bheja gaya hai .
ayahs.translation: unn ( Rasoolon ) ney kaha :  humara perwerdigar khoob janta hai kay hamen waqaee tumharay paas Rasool bana ker bheja gaya hai .

ayahs.text: aur humari zimma daari iss say ziyada nahi hai kay saaf saaf paygham phoncha den .
ayahs.translation: aur humari zimma daari iss say ziyada nahi hai kay saaf saaf paygham phoncha den .

ayahs.text: basti walon ney kaha :  hum ney to tumharay andar nahoosat mehsoos ki hai .   yaqeen jano agar tum baaz naa aaye to hum tum per pathar barsayen gay , aur humaray haathon tumhen bari dardnak saza milay gi .
ayahs.translation: basti walon ney kaha :  hum ney to tumharay andar nahoosat mehsoos ki hai .   yaqeen jano agar tum baaz naa aaye to hum tum per pathar barsayen gay , aur humaray haathon tumhen bari dardnak saza milay gi .

ayahs.text: Rasoolon ney kaha :  tumhari nahoosat khud tumharay sath lagi hoi hai .   kiya yeh baaten iss liye ker rahey ho kay tumhen naseehat ki baat phonchai gaee hai ? asal baat yeh hai kay tum khud hadd say guzray huye log ho .
ayahs.translation: Rasoolon ney kaha :  tumhari nahoosat khud tumharay sath lagi hoi hai .   kiya yeh baaten iss liye ker rahey ho kay tumhen naseehat ki baat phonchai gaee hai ? asal baat yeh hai kay tum khud hadd say guzray huye log ho .

ayahs.text: aur shehar kay perlay ilaqay say aik shaks dorrta huwa aaya .   uss ney kaha :  aey meri qoam kay logo ! inn Rasoolon ka kehna maan lo ,
ayahs.translation: aur shehar kay perlay ilaqay say aik shaks dorrta huwa aaya .   uss ney kaha :  aey meri qoam kay logo ! inn Rasoolon ka kehna maan lo ,

ayahs.text: inn logon  ka kehna maan lo jo tum say koi ujrat nahi maang rahey , aur woh sahih raastay per hain .
ayahs.translation: inn logon  ka kehna maan lo jo tum say koi ujrat nahi maang rahey , aur woh sahih raastay per hain .

ayahs.text: aur bhala mein uss zaat ki ibadat kiyon naa kerun jiss ney mujhay peda kiya hai ? aur ussi ki taraf tum sabb ko wapis bheja jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: aur bhala mein uss zaat ki ibadat kiyon naa kerun jiss ney mujhay peda kiya hai ? aur ussi ki taraf tum sabb ko wapis bheja jaye ga .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya ussay chorr ker mein aeson ko mabood maanun kay agar khudaye rehman mujhay koi nuqsan phonchaney ka irada kerlay to unn ki sifarish meray kissi kaam naa aaye , aur naa woh mujhay churra saken-?
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya ussay chorr ker mein aeson ko mabood maanun kay agar khudaye rehman mujhay koi nuqsan phonchaney ka irada kerlay to unn ki sifarish meray kissi kaam naa aaye , aur naa woh mujhay churra saken-?

ayahs.text: agar mein aisa kerun ga to yaqeenan mein khuli gumrahi mein mubtala hojaon ga .
ayahs.translation: agar mein aisa kerun ga to yaqeenan mein khuli gumrahi mein mubtala hojaon ga .

ayahs.text: mein to tumharay perwerdigar per emaan laa-chuka . abb tum bhi meri baat sunn lo .
ayahs.translation: mein to tumharay perwerdigar per emaan laa-chuka . abb tum bhi meri baat sunn lo .

ayahs.text: . ( aakhir kaar basti walon ney uss ko qatal kerdiya ,   aur Allah taalaa ki taraf say uss say ) kaha gaya kay :  jannat mein dakhil hojao .    uss ney ( jannat ki naimaten dekh ker ) kaha kay :  kaash ! meri qoam ko maloom hojaye
ayahs.translation: . ( aakhir kaar basti walon ney uss ko qatal kerdiya ,   aur Allah taalaa ki taraf say uss say ) kaha gaya kay :  jannat mein dakhil hojao .    uss ney ( jannat ki naimaten dekh ker ) kaha kay :  kaash ! meri qoam ko maloom hojaye

ayahs.text: kay meray perwerdigar ney kiss tarah meri bakhshish ki hai , aur mujhay ba-izzat logon  mein shamil kiya hai !
ayahs.translation: kay meray perwerdigar ney kiss tarah meri bakhshish ki hai , aur mujhay ba-izzat logon  mein shamil kiya hai !

ayahs.text: aur uss shaks kay baad hum ney uss ki qoam per aasman say koi lashkar nahi utaara , aur naa hamen utaarney ki zaroorat thi .
ayahs.translation: aur uss shaks kay baad hum ney uss ki qoam per aasman say koi lashkar nahi utaara , aur naa hamen utaarney ki zaroorat thi .

ayahs.text: woh to bus aik hi chinghaarr thi jiss say woh aik dum bujh ker reh gaye .
ayahs.translation: woh to bus aik hi chinghaarr thi jiss say woh aik dum bujh ker reh gaye .

ayahs.text: afsos hai aesay bandon kay haal per ! unn kay paas koi Rasool aisa nahi aaya jiss ka woh mazaq naa uratay rahey hon .
ayahs.translation: afsos hai aesay bandon kay haal per ! unn kay paas koi Rasool aisa nahi aaya jiss ka woh mazaq naa uratay rahey hon .

ayahs.text: kiya unhon ney nahi dekha kay unn say pehlay hum kitni qoamon ko iss tarah halak ker-chukay hain kay woh unn kay paas loat ker nahi aatay ?
ayahs.translation: kiya unhon ney nahi dekha kay unn say pehlay hum kitni qoamon ko iss tarah halak ker-chukay hain kay woh unn kay paas loat ker nahi aatay ?

ayahs.text: aur yeh jitney log hain , inn sabhi ko ikattha ker kay humaray samney hazir kiya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh jitney log hain , inn sabhi ko ikattha ker kay humaray samney hazir kiya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur inn kay liye aik nishani woh zameen hai jo murda parri hoi thi . hum ney ussay zindagi ata ki , aur uss say ghalla nikala , jiss ki khurak yeh khatay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur inn kay liye aik nishani woh zameen hai jo murda parri hoi thi . hum ney ussay zindagi ata ki , aur uss say ghalla nikala , jiss ki khurak yeh khatay hain .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney uss zameen mein khajooron aur angooron kay baagh peda kiye , aur aisa intizam kiya kay uss mein say paani kay chashmay phoot niklay ,
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney uss zameen mein khajooron aur angooron kay baagh peda kiye , aur aisa intizam kiya kay uss mein say paani kay chashmay phoot niklay ,

ayahs.text: takay yeh uss ki pedawaar mein say khayen , halankay uss ko inn kay haathon ney nahi banaya tha .   kiya phir bhi yeh shukar ada nahi keren gay ?
ayahs.translation: takay yeh uss ki pedawaar mein say khayen , halankay uss ko inn kay haathon ney nahi banaya tha .   kiya phir bhi yeh shukar ada nahi keren gay ?

ayahs.text: pak hai woh zaat jiss ney her cheez kay jooray jooray peda kiye hain , uss pedawaar kay bhi jo zameen ugati hai , aur khud inn insanon kay bhi , aur unn cheezon kay bhi jinhen yeh log ( abhi ) jantay tak nahi hain .
ayahs.translation: pak hai woh zaat jiss ney her cheez kay jooray jooray peda kiye hain , uss pedawaar kay bhi jo zameen ugati hai , aur khud inn insanon kay bhi , aur unn cheezon kay bhi jinhen yeh log ( abhi ) jantay tak nahi hain .

ayahs.text: aur inn kay liye aik aur nishani raat hai . hum uss per say din ka chilka utaar letay hain to woh yakayak andheray mein reh jatay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur inn kay liye aik aur nishani raat hai . hum uss per say din ka chilka utaar letay hain to woh yakayak andheray mein reh jatay hain .

ayahs.text: aur sooraj apney thikaney ki taraf chala jaraha hai . yeh sabb uss zaat ka muqarrar kiya huwa nizam hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ka ilm bhi kamil .
ayahs.translation: aur sooraj apney thikaney ki taraf chala jaraha hai . yeh sabb uss zaat ka muqarrar kiya huwa nizam hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ka ilm bhi kamil .

ayahs.text: aur chaand hai kay hum ney uss ki manzilen naap tol ker muqarrar kerdi hain , yahan tak kay woh jab ( unn manzilon kay doray say ) loat ker aata hai to khajoor ki purani tehni ki tarah ( patla ) ho ker reh jata hai .
ayahs.translation: aur chaand hai kay hum ney uss ki manzilen naap tol ker muqarrar kerdi hain , yahan tak kay woh jab ( unn manzilon kay doray say ) loat ker aata hai to khajoor ki purani tehni ki tarah ( patla ) ho ker reh jata hai .

ayahs.text: naa to sooraj ki yeh majal hai kay woh chaand ko ja-pakray ,   aur naa raat din say aagay nikal sakti hai . aur yeh sabb apney apney madaar mein ter rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: naa to sooraj ki yeh majal hai kay woh chaand ko ja-pakray ,   aur naa raat din say aagay nikal sakti hai . aur yeh sabb apney apney madaar mein ter rahey hain .

ayahs.text: aur inn kay liye aik aur nishani yeh hai kay hum ney inn ki aulad ko bhari hoi kashti mein sawar kiya ,
ayahs.translation: aur inn kay liye aik aur nishani yeh hai kay hum ney inn ki aulad ko bhari hoi kashti mein sawar kiya ,

ayahs.text: aur hum ney inn kay liye ussi jaisi aur cheezen bhi peda ken jinn per yeh sawari kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney inn kay liye ussi jaisi aur cheezen bhi peda ken jinn per yeh sawari kertay hain .

ayahs.text: aur agar hum chahen to enhen gharq ker daalen , jiss kay baad naa to koi inn ki fariyad ko phonchay , aur naa unn ki jaan bachai jasakay .
ayahs.translation: aur agar hum chahen to enhen gharq ker daalen , jiss kay baad naa to koi inn ki fariyad ko phonchay , aur naa unn ki jaan bachai jasakay .

ayahs.text: lekin yeh sabb humari taraf say aik rehmat hai , aur aik moyyan waqt tak ( zindagi ka ) maza uthaney ka moaqa hai ( jo enhen diya jaraha hai ) .
ayahs.translation: lekin yeh sabb humari taraf say aik rehmat hai , aur aik moyyan waqt tak ( zindagi ka ) maza uthaney ka moaqa hai ( jo enhen diya jaraha hai ) .

ayahs.text: aur jab inn say kaha jata hai kay :  bacho uss ( azab ) say jo tumharay samney hai , aur jo tumharay ( marney kay ) baad aaye ga , takay tum per reham kiya jaye .  ( to woh zara kaan nahi dhartay )
ayahs.translation: aur jab inn say kaha jata hai kay :  bacho uss ( azab ) say jo tumharay samney hai , aur jo tumharay ( marney kay ) baad aaye ga , takay tum per reham kiya jaye .  ( to woh zara kaan nahi dhartay )

ayahs.text: aur unn kay perwerdigar ki nishaniyon mein say koi nishani aesi nahi aati jiss say woh mun naa morr letay hon .
ayahs.translation: aur unn kay perwerdigar ki nishaniyon mein say koi nishani aesi nahi aati jiss say woh mun naa morr letay hon .

ayahs.text: aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay :  Allah ney tumhen jo rizq diya hai , uss mein say ( ghareebon per bhi ) kharch kero  , to yeh kafir log musalmanon say kehtay hain kay :  kiya hum unn logon  ko khana khilayen jinhen agar Allah chahta to khud khila deta ? ( musalmano ! ) tumhari haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch bhi nahi kay tum khuli gumrahi mein parray huye ho .
ayahs.translation: aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay :  Allah ney tumhen jo rizq diya hai , uss mein say ( ghareebon per bhi ) kharch kero  , to yeh kafir log musalmanon say kehtay hain kay :  kiya hum unn logon  ko khana khilayen jinhen agar Allah chahta to khud khila deta ? ( musalmano ! ) tumhari haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch bhi nahi kay tum khuli gumrahi mein parray huye ho .

ayahs.text: aur kehtay hain kay :  yeh ( qayamat ka ) wada kab poora hoga-? ( musalmano ! ) batao , agar tum sachay ho .
ayahs.translation: aur kehtay hain kay :  yeh ( qayamat ka ) wada kab poora hoga-? ( musalmano ! ) batao , agar tum sachay ho .

ayahs.text: . ( darasal ) yeh log bus aik chinghaarr ka intizar ker rahey hain jo inn ki hujjat bazi kay aen darmiyan enhen aa-pakray gi ,
ayahs.translation: . ( darasal ) yeh log bus aik chinghaarr ka intizar ker rahey hain jo inn ki hujjat bazi kay aen darmiyan enhen aa-pakray gi ,

ayahs.text: phir naa yeh koi wasiyyat ker-saken gay , aur naa apney ghar walon kay paas loat ker jasaken gay .

verses.text: jab woh dawood kay paas phonchay to dawood unn say ghabra gaye . unhon ney kaha :  dariye nahi , hum aik jhagray kay do fareeq hain , hum mein say aik ney doosray kay sath ziyadti ki hai . abb aap humaray darmiyan theek theek faisla ker-dijiye , aur ziyadti naa kijiye , aur hamen theek theek raasta bata dijiye .
verses.translation: jab woh dawood kay paas phonchay to dawood unn say ghabra gaye . unhon ney kaha :  dariye nahi , hum aik jhagray kay do fareeq hain , hum mein say aik ney doosray kay sath ziyadti ki hai . abb aap humaray darmiyan theek theek faisla ker-dijiye , aur ziyadti naa kijiye , aur hamen theek theek raasta bata dijiye .

verses.text: yeh mera bhai hai . iss kay paas ninnanway dunbiyan hain , aur meray paas aik hi dunbi hai , abb yeh kehta hai kay woh bhi meray hawalay kero , aur iss ney zor-e-biyan say mujhay daba liya hai .
verses.translation: yeh mera bhai hai . iss kay paas ninnanway dunbiyan hain , aur meray paas aik hi dunbi hai , abb yeh kehta hai kay woh bhi meray hawalay kero , aur iss ney zor-e-biyan say mujhay daba liya hai .

verses.text: dawood ney kaha :  iss ney apni dunbiyon mein shamil kernay kay liye tumhari dunbi ka jo mutalba kiya hai , uss mein yaqeenan tum per zulm kiya hai . aur boht say log jinn kay darmiyan shirkat hoti hai , woh aik doosray kay sath ziyadti kertay hain , siwaye unn kay jo emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , aur woh boht kam hain .  aur dawood ko khayal aaya kay hum ney darasal unn ki aazmaesh ki hai , iss liye unhon ney apney perwerdigar say moaafi maangi , jhuk ker sajday mein gir gaye , aur Allah say lo lagai .
verses.translation: dawood ney kaha :  iss ney apni dunbiyon mein shamil kernay kay liye tumhari dunbi ka jo mutalba kiya hai , uss mein yaqeenan tum per zulm kiya hai . aur boht say log jinn kay darmiyan shirkat hoti hai , woh aik doosray kay sath ziyadti kertay hain , siwaye unn kay jo emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , aur woh boht kam hain .  aur dawood ko khayal aaya kay hum ney darasal unn ki aazmaesh ki hai , iss liye unhon ney apney perwerdigar say moaafi maangi , jhuk ker sajday mein gir gaye , aur Allah say lo lagai .

verses.text: chunacheh hum ney uss moamlay mein unhen moaafi dey di . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay unn ko humaray paas khaas taqarrub hasil hai , aur behtareen thikana !
verses.translation: chunacheh hum ney uss moamlay mein unhen moaafi dey di . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay unn ko humaray paas khaas taqarrub hasil hai , aur behtareen thikana !

verses.text: aey dawood ! hum ney tumhen zameen mein khalifa banaya hai , lehaza tum logon  kay darmiyan bar-haq faislay kero , aur nafsani khuwaish kay peechay naa chalo , werna woh tumhen Allah kay raastay say bhatka dey gi . yaqeen rakho kay jo log Allah kay raastay say bhatak jatay hain , unn kay liye sakht azab hai , kiyonkay unhon ney hisab kay din ko bhula diya tha .
verses.translation: aey dawood ! hum ney tumhen zameen mein khalifa banaya hai , lehaza tum logon  kay darmiyan bar-haq faislay kero , aur nafsani khuwaish kay peechay naa chalo , werna woh tumhen Allah kay raastay say bhatka dey gi . yaqeen rakho kay jo log Allah kay raastay say bhatak jatay hain , unn kay liye sakht azab hai , kiyonkay unhon ney hisab kay din ko bhula diya tha .

verses.text: aur hum ney aasman o zameen aur unn kay darmiyan jo cheezen hain unn ko fuzool hi peda nahi kerdiya . yeh to unn logon  ka gumaan hai jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kerliya hai , chunacheh unn kafiron kay liye dozakh ki shakal mein bari tabahi hai .
verses.translation: aur hum ney aasman o zameen aur unn kay darmiyan jo cheezen hain unn ko fuzool hi peda nahi kerdiya . yeh to unn logon  ka gumaan hai jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kerliya hai , chunacheh unn kafiron kay liye dozakh ki shakal mein bari tabahi hai .

verses.text: jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , kiya hum unn ko aesay logon  kay barabar kerden gay jo zameen mein fasad machatay hain-? ya hum perhezgaron ko bad-kaaron kay barabar kerden gay-?
verses.translation: jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , kiya hum unn ko aesay logon  kay barabar kerden gay jo zameen mein fasad machatay hain-? ya hum perhezgaron ko bad-kaaron kay barabar kerden gay-?

verses.translation: . ( iss per unhon ney kaha : )  inn ko meray paas wapis ley aao , chunacheh woh ( unn ki ) pindliyon aur gardanon per haath pherney lagay .

verses.translation: aur yeh bhi waqiaa hai kay hum ney suleman ki aik aazmaesh ki thi , aur unn ki kursi per aik dharr laa ker daal diya tha ,   phir unhon ney ( Allah say ) rujoo kiya ,

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh jo kuch kehtay hain , uss per sabar kero , aur humaray banday dawood ( aleh-assalam ) ko yaad kero jo baray taqatwar thay .   woh beyshak Allah say boht lo lagaye huye thay .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh jo kuch kehtay hain , uss per sabar kero , aur humaray banday dawood ( aleh-assalam ) ko yaad kero jo baray taqatwar thay .   woh beyshak Allah say boht lo lagaye huye thay .

ayahs.text: hum ney paharon ko iss kaam per laga diya tha kay woh shaam kay waqt aur sooraj kay nikaltay waqt unn kay sath tasbeeh kiya keren .

ayahs.text: aur parindon ko bhi , jinhen ikattha kerliya jata tha . yeh sabb unn kay sath mil ker Allah ka khoob ziker kertay thay .

ayahs.translation: aur hum ney unn ki saltanat ko istehkaam bakhsha tha , aur unhen danai aur faisla kunn guftoogo ka saliqa ata kiya tha .

ayahs.translation: aur kiya tumhen unn muqadma walon ki khabar phonchi hai jab woh deewar per charh ker ibadat gaah mein ghuss aaye thay-?

ayahs.text: jab woh dawood kay paas phonchay to dawood unn say ghabra gaye . unhon ney kaha :  dariye nahi , hum aik jhagray kay do fareeq hain , hum mein say aik ney doosray kay sath ziyadti ki hai . abb aap humaray darmiyan theek theek faisla ker-dijiye , aur ziyadti naa kijiye , aur hamen theek theek raasta bata dijiye .
ayahs.translation: jab woh dawood kay paas phonchay to dawood unn say ghabra gaye . unhon ney kaha :  dariye nahi , hum aik jhagray kay do fareeq hain , hum mein say aik ney doosray kay sath ziyadti ki hai . abb aap humaray darmiyan theek theek faisla ker-dijiye , aur ziyadti naa kijiye , aur hamen theek theek raasta bata dijiye .

ayahs.text: yeh mera bhai hai . iss kay paas ninnanway dunbiyan hain , aur meray paas aik hi dunbi hai , abb yeh kehta hai kay woh bhi meray hawalay kero , aur iss ney zor-e-biyan say mujhay daba liya hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh mera bhai hai . iss kay paas ninnanway dunbiyan hain , aur meray paas aik hi dunbi hai , abb yeh kehta hai kay woh bhi meray hawalay kero , aur iss ney zor-e-biyan say mujhay daba liya hai .

ayahs.text: dawood ney kaha :  iss ney apni dunbiyon mein shamil kernay kay liye tumhari dunbi ka jo mutalba kiya hai , uss mein yaqeenan tum per zulm kiya hai . aur boht say log jinn kay darmiyan shirkat hoti hai , woh aik doosray kay sath ziyadti kertay hain , siwaye unn kay jo emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , aur woh boht kam hain .  aur dawood ko khayal aaya kay hum ney darasal unn ki aazmaesh ki hai , iss liye unhon ney apney perwerdigar say moaafi maangi , jhuk ker sajday mein gir gaye , aur Allah say lo lagai .
ayahs.translation: dawood ney kaha :  iss ney apni dunbiyon mein shamil kernay kay liye tumhari dunbi ka jo mutalba kiya hai , uss mein yaqeenan tum per zulm kiya hai . aur boht say log jinn kay darmiyan shirkat hoti hai , woh aik doosray kay sath ziyadti kertay hain , siwaye unn kay jo emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , aur woh boht kam hain .  aur dawood ko khayal aaya kay hum ney darasal unn ki aazmaesh ki hai , iss liye unhon ney apney perwerdigar say moaafi maangi , jhuk ker sajday mein gir gaye , aur Allah say lo lagai .

ayahs.text: chunacheh hum ney uss moamlay mein unhen moaafi dey di . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay unn ko humaray paas khaas taqarrub hasil hai , aur behtareen thikana !
ayahs.translation: chunacheh hum ney uss moamlay mein unhen moaafi dey di . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay unn ko humaray paas khaas taqarrub hasil hai , aur behtareen thikana !

ayahs.text: aey dawood ! hum ney tumhen zameen mein khalifa banaya hai , lehaza tum logon  kay darmiyan bar-haq faislay kero , aur nafsani khuwaish kay peechay naa chalo , werna woh tumhen Allah kay raastay say bhatka dey gi . yaqeen rakho kay jo log Allah kay raastay say bhatak jatay hain , unn kay liye sakht azab hai , kiyonkay unhon ney hisab kay din ko bhula diya tha .
ayahs.translation: aey dawood ! hum ney tumhen zameen mein khalifa banaya hai , lehaza tum logon  kay darmiyan bar-haq faislay kero , aur nafsani khuwaish kay peechay naa chalo , werna woh tumhen Allah kay raastay say bhatka dey gi . yaqeen rakho kay jo log Allah kay raastay say bhatak jatay hain , unn kay liye sakht azab hai , kiyonkay unhon ney hisab kay din ko bhula diya tha .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney aasman o zameen aur unn kay darmiyan jo cheezen hain unn ko fuzool hi peda nahi kerdiya . yeh to unn logon  ka gumaan hai jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kerliya hai , chunacheh unn kafiron kay liye dozakh ki shakal mein bari tabahi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney aasman o zameen aur unn kay darmiyan jo cheezen hain unn ko fuzool hi peda nahi kerdiya . yeh to unn logon  ka gumaan hai jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kerliya hai , chunacheh unn kafiron kay liye dozakh ki shakal mein bari tabahi hai .

ayahs.text: jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , kiya hum unn ko aesay logon  kay barabar kerden gay jo zameen mein fasad machatay hain-? ya hum perhezgaron ko bad-kaaron kay barabar kerden gay-?

ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh aik ba-barkat kitab hai jo hum ney tum per iss liye utaari hai kay log iss ki aayaton per ghor-o-fiker keren , aur takay aqal rakhney walay naseehat hasil keren .

ayahs.translation: . ( iss per unhon ney kaha : )  inn ko meray paas wapis ley aao , chunacheh woh ( unn ki ) pindliyon aur gardanon per haath pherney lagay .

ayahs.text: aur yeh bhi waqiaa hai kay hum ney suleman ki aik aazmaesh ki thi , aur unn ki kursi per aik dharr laa ker daal diya tha ,   phir unhon ney ( Allah say ) rujoo kiya ,
ayahs.translation: aur yeh bhi waqiaa hai kay hum ney suleman ki aik aazmaesh ki thi , aur unn ki kursi per aik dharr laa ker daal diya tha ,   phir unhon ney ( Allah say ) rujoo kiya ,

ayahs.text: . ( aur unn say kaha tha kay : )  yeh humara atiya hai , abb tumhen ikhtiyar hai kay ehsan ker kay kissi ko kuch do , ya apney paas rakho , tum per kissi hisab ki zimma daari nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( aur unn say kaha tha kay : )  yeh humara atiya hai , abb tumhen ikhtiyar hai kay ehsan ker kay kissi ko kuch do , ya apney paas rakho , tum per kissi hisab ki zimma daari nahi hai .

ayahs.translation: . ( hum ney unn say kaha : )  apna paon zameen per maaro , lo ! yeh thanda paani hai nahaney kay liye bhi , aur peenay kay liye bhi .

ayahs.text: aur ( iss tarah ) hum ney unhen unn kay ghar walay bhi ata kerdiye , aur unn kay sath utney hi aur bhi .   takay unn per humari rehmat ho , aur aqal walon kay liye aik yaadgaar naseehat .
ayahs.translation: aur ( iss tarah ) hum ney unhen unn kay ghar walay bhi ata kerdiye , aur unn kay sath utney hi aur bhi .   takay unn per humari rehmat ho , aur aqal walon kay liye aik yaadgaar naseehat .

ayahs.text: aur ( hum ney unn say yeh bhi kaha kay : )  apney haath mein tinkon ka aik muttha lo , aur uss say maar do , aur apni qasam matt torro .    haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney unhen bara sabar kernay wala paya , woh behtareen banday thay , waqaee woh Allah say khoob lo lagaye huye thay .
ayahs.translation: aur ( hum ney unn say yeh bhi kaha kay : )  apney haath mein tinkon ka aik muttha lo , aur uss say maar do , aur apni qasam matt torro .    haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney unhen bara sabar kernay wala paya , woh behtareen banday thay , waqaee woh Allah say khoob lo lagaye huye thay .

ayahs.text: aur humaray bandon Ibrahim , Ishaq aur Yaqoob ko yaad kero jo ( naik amal kernay walay ) haath aur ( dekhney wali ) aankhen rakhtay thay .
ayahs.translation: aur humaray bandon Ibrahim , Ishaq aur Yaqoob ko yaad kero jo ( naik amal kernay walay ) haath aur ( dekhney wali ) aankhen rakhtay thay .

ayahs.text: hum ney unhen aik khaas wasf kay liye chunn liya tha , jo ( aakhirat kay ) haqeeqi ghar ki yaad thi .
ayahs.translation: hum ney unhen aik khaas wasf kay liye chunn liya tha , jo ( aakhirat kay ) haqeeqi ghar ki yaad thi .

ayahs.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay humaray nazdeek woh chunay huye behtareen logon  mein say thay .
ayahs.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay humaray nazdeek woh chunay huye behtareen logon  mein say thay .

ayahs.text: aur Ismail aur Al-Yasaa aur zulkifil   ko yaad kero . aur yeh sabb behtareen logon  mein say thay .
ayahs.translation: aur Ismail aur Al-Yasaa aur zulkifil   ko yaad kero . aur yeh sabb behtareen logon  mein say thay .

ayahs.text: yeh sabb kuch aik naseehat ka paygham hai , aur yaqeen jano kay jo log taqwa ikhtiyar kertay hain , aakhri thikaney ki behtari unhi kay hissay mein aaye gi ,
ayahs.translation: yeh sabb kuch aik naseehat ka paygham hai , aur yaqeen jano kay jo log taqwa ikhtiyar kertay hain , aakhri thikaney ki behtari unhi kay hissay mein aaye gi ,

ayahs.text: yani hamesha basay rehney kay liye jannaten jinn kay darwazay unn kay liye poori tarah khulay hon gay !
ayahs.translation: yani hamesha basay rehney kay liye jannaten jinn kay darwazay unn kay liye poori tarah khulay hon gay !

ayahs.text: jahan woh takiya lagaye huye boht say meway aur mashroobat mangwa rahey hon gay ,
ayahs.translation: jahan woh takiya lagaye huye boht say meway aur mashroobat mangwa rahey hon gay ,

ayahs.text: aur unn kay paas woh hum umar khawateen hon gi jinn ki nigahen ( apney shohron per ) markooz hon gi .
ayahs.translation: aur unn kay paas woh hum umar khawateen hon gi jinn ki nigahen ( apney shohron per ) markooz hon gi .

ayahs.text: yeh hai woh ( naimaton say bharpoor zindagi ) jiss ka tum say roz-e-hisab mein wada kiya gaya hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh hai woh ( naimaton say bharpoor zindagi ) jiss ka tum say roz-e-hisab mein wada kiya gaya hai .

ayahs.text: beyshak yeh humari ata hai jo kabhi khatam honey wali nahi .
ayahs.translation: beyshak yeh humari ata hai jo kabhi khatam honey wali nahi .

ayahs.text: aik taraf to yeh hai , aur ( doosri taraf ) jinn logon  ney sarkashi ikhtiyar ki hai , yaqeen jano , unn ka aakhri thikana boht bura hoga ,
ayahs.translation: aik taraf to yeh hai , aur ( doosri taraf ) jinn logon  ney sarkashi ikhtiyar ki hai , yaqeen jano , unn ka aakhri thikana boht bura hoga ,

ayahs.text: yani dozakh jiss mein woh dakhil hon gay ! phir woh unn ka bad-tareen bistar banay gi .
ayahs.translation: yani dozakh jiss mein woh dakhil hon gay ! phir woh unn ka bad-tareen bistar banay gi .

ayahs.text: yeh hai kholta huwa paani aur peep ! abb woh iss ka maza chaken ,
ayahs.translation: yeh hai kholta huwa paani aur peep ! abb woh iss ka maza chaken ,

ayahs.text: aur unn tarah tarah ki cheezon ka jo issi jaisi ( takleef deh ) hon gi .
ayahs.translation: aur unn tarah tarah ki cheezon ka jo issi jaisi ( takleef deh ) hon gi .

ayahs.text: . ( jab woh apney perokaaron ko aata dekhen gay to aik doosray say kahen gay : )  yeh aik aur lashkar hai jo tumharay sath ghusa chala aaraha hai , phitkaar ho inn per , yeh sabb aag mein jalney walay hain .
ayahs.translation: . ( jab woh apney perokaaron ko aata dekhen gay to aik doosray say kahen gay : )  yeh aik aur lashkar hai jo tumharay sath ghusa chala aaraha hai , phitkaar ho inn per , yeh sabb aag mein jalney walay hain .

ayahs.text: woh ( aaney walay ) kahen gay :  nahi , balkay phitkaar tum per ho , tum hi to yeh museebat humaray aagay laye ho , abb to yehi bad-tareen jagah hai jiss mein rehna hoga .
ayahs.translation: woh ( aaney walay ) kahen gay :  nahi , balkay phitkaar tum per ho , tum hi to yeh museebat humaray aagay laye ho , abb to yehi bad-tareen jagah hai jiss mein rehna hoga .

ayahs.text: . ( phir woh Allah taalaa say kahen gay kay : )  aey humaray perwerdigar ! jo shaks bhi yeh museebat humaray aagay laya hai , ussay dozakh mein dugna azab dijiye .
ayahs.translation: . ( phir woh Allah taalaa say kahen gay kay : )  aey humaray perwerdigar ! jo shaks bhi yeh museebat humaray aagay laya hai , ussay dozakh mein dugna azab dijiye .

ayahs.text: aur woh ( aik doosray say ) kahen gay :  kiya baat hai kay hamen woh log ( yahan dozakh mein ) nazar nahi aarahey jinhen hum buray logon  mein shumar kertay thay ?
ayahs.translation: aur woh ( aik doosray say ) kahen gay :  kiya baat hai kay hamen woh log ( yahan dozakh mein ) nazar nahi aarahey jinhen hum buray logon  mein shumar kertay thay ?

ayahs.text: kiya hum ney unn ka ( nahaq ) mazaq uraya tha , ya unhen dekhney say nigahon ko ghalati lagg rahi hai-?
ayahs.translation: kiya hum ney unn ka ( nahaq ) mazaq uraya tha , ya unhen dekhney say nigahon ko ghalati lagg rahi hai-?

ayahs.text: . yaqeenan dozakhiyon kay aapas mein jhagarrney ki yeh sari baaten bilkul sachi hain jo ho ker rahen gi .
ayahs.translation: . yaqeenan dozakhiyon kay aapas mein jhagarrney ki yeh sari baaten bilkul sachi hain jo ho ker rahen gi .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay :  mein to aik khabrdar kernay wala hun , aur uss Allah kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi jo aik hai , jo sabb per ghalib hai ,
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay :  mein to aik khabrdar kernay wala hun , aur uss Allah kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi jo aik hai , jo sabb per ghalib hai ,

ayahs.text: jo tamam aasmano aur zameen aur unn kay darmiyan her cheez ka malik hai , jiss ka iqtidar sabb per chaya huwa hai , jo boht bakhshney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: jo tamam aasmano aur zameen aur unn kay darmiyan her cheez ka malik hai , jiss ka iqtidar sabb per chaya huwa hai , jo boht bakhshney wala hai .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  yeh aik azeem haqeeqat ka izhar hai ,
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  yeh aik azeem haqeeqat ka izhar hai ,

ayahs.text: jiss say tum mun morray huye ho ,
ayahs.translation: jiss say tum mun morray huye ho ,

ayahs.text: mujhay aalam-e-baala ki baaton ka kuch ilm nahi tha jab woh ( farishtay ) sawal jawab ker rahey thay .
ayahs.translation: mujhay aalam-e-baala ki baaton ka kuch ilm nahi tha jab woh ( farishtay ) sawal jawab ker rahey thay .

ayahs.text: meray paas wahi sirf iss liye aati hai kay mein saaf saaf khabrdar kernay wala hun .
ayahs.translation: meray paas wahi sirf iss liye aati hai kay mein saaf saaf khabrdar kernay wala hun .

ayahs.text: yaad kero jab tumharay perwerdigar ney farishton say kaha kay mein garay say aik insan peda kernay wala hun ,
ayahs.translation: yaad kero jab tumharay perwerdigar ney farishton say kaha kay mein garay say aik insan peda kernay wala hun ,

ayahs.text: chunacheh jab mein ussay poori tarah bana dun aur uss mein apni rooh phoonk dun to tum uss kay aagay sajday mein gir jana .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh jab mein ussay poori tarah bana dun aur uss mein apni rooh phoonk dun to tum uss kay aagay sajday mein gir jana .

ayahs.text: phir huwa yeh kay saray kay saray farishton ney to sajda kiya ,
ayahs.translation: phir huwa yeh kay saray kay saray farishton ney to sajda kiya ,

ayahs.text: albatta iblees ney naa kiya , uss ney takabbur say kaam liya , aur kafiron mein shamil hogaya .
ayahs.translation: albatta iblees ney naa kiya , uss ney takabbur say kaam liya , aur kafiron mein shamil hogaya .

ayahs.text: Allah ney kaha :  iblees ! jiss ko mein ney apney haathon say peda kiya , uss ko sajda kernay say tujhay kiss cheez ney roka hai-? kiya tu ney takabbur say kaam liya hai , ya tu koi boht oonchi hastiyon mein say hai ?
ayahs.translation: Allah ney kaha :  iblees ! jiss ko mein ney apney haathon say peda kiya , uss ko sajda kernay say tujhay kiss cheez ney roka hai-? kiya tu ney takabbur say kaam liya hai , ya tu koi boht oonchi hastiyon mein say hai ?

ayahs.text: kehney laga :  mein iss ( Adam ) say behtar hun . tu ney mujhay aag say peda kiya hai , aur iss ko garay say peda kiya hai .
ayahs.translation: kehney laga :  mein iss ( Adam ) say behtar hun . tu ney mujhay aag say peda kiya hai , aur iss ko garay say peda kiya hai .

ayahs.text: Allah ney farmaya kay :  acha to nikal jaa yahan say ! kiyonkay tu mardood hai ,
ayahs.translation: Allah ney farmaya kay :  acha to nikal jaa yahan say ! kiyonkay tu mardood hai ,

ayahs.text: aur yaqeen jaan qayamat kay din tak tujh per meri phitkaar rahey gi .
ayahs.translation: aur yaqeen jaan qayamat kay din tak tujh per meri phitkaar rahey gi .

ayahs.text: uss ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! phir tu mujhay uss din tak kay liye ( jeenay ki ) mohlat deydey jiss din logon  ko dobara zinda kiya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: uss ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! phir tu mujhay uss din tak kay liye ( jeenay ki ) mohlat deydey jiss din logon  ko dobara zinda kiya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: Allah ney farmaya :  chal , tujhay unn logon  mein shamil kerliya gaya hai jinhen mohlat di jaye gi ,
ayahs.translation: Allah ney farmaya :  chal , tujhay unn logon  mein shamil kerliya gaya hai jinhen mohlat di jaye gi ,

ayahs.text: . ( lekin ) aik mutayyan waqt kay din tak .
ayahs.translation: . ( lekin ) aik mutayyan waqt kay din tak .

ayahs.text: kehney laga :  bus to mein teri izzat ki qasam khata hun kay mein inn sabb ko behkaon ga ,
ayahs.translation: kehney laga :  bus to mein teri izzat ki qasam khata hun kay mein inn sabb ko behkaon ga ,

ayahs.text: siwaye teray barguzida bandon kay .
ayahs.translation: siwaye teray barguzida bandon kay .

ayahs.text: Allah ney farmaya :  to phir sachi baat yeh hai , aur mein sachi baat hi kaha kerta hun ,
ayahs.translation: Allah ney farmaya :  to phir sachi baat yeh hai , aur mein sachi baat hi kaha kerta hun ,

ayahs.text: kay mein tujh say aur unn sabb say jo unn mein say teray peechay chalen gay , jahannum ko bhar ker rahun ga .
ayahs.translation: kay mein tujh say aur unn sabb say jo unn mein say teray peechay chalen gay , jahannum ko bhar ker rahun ga .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! logon  say ) keh do kay :  mein tum say iss ( Islam ki dawat ) per koi ujrat nahi maangta , aur naa mein banwati logon  mein say hun .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! logon  say ) keh do kay :  mein tum say iss ( Islam ki dawat ) per koi ujrat nahi maangta , aur naa mein banwati logon  mein say hun .

ayahs.text: yeh to duniya jahan kay logon  kay liye bus aik naseehat hai ,
ayahs.translation: yeh to duniya jahan kay logon  kay liye bus aik naseehat hai ,

ayahs.text: aur thoray say waqt kay baad tumhen iss ka haal maloom hojaye ga .
ayahs.translation: aur thoray say waqt kay baad tumhen iss ka haal maloom hojaye ga .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai .
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai .

verses.text: yeh kitab Allah ki taraf say nazil ki jarahi hai , jo baray iqtidar ka malik hai , boht hikmat wala .
verses.translation: yeh kitab Allah ki taraf say nazil ki jarahi hai , jo baray iqtidar ka malik hai , boht hikmat wala .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) beyshak yeh kitab hum ney tum per bar-haq nazil ki hai , iss liye Allah ki iss tarah ibadat kero kay bandagi khalis ussi kay liye ho .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) beyshak yeh kitab hum ney tum per bar-haq nazil ki hai , iss liye Allah ki iss tarah ibadat kero kay bandagi khalis ussi kay liye ho .

verses.text: yaad rakho kay khalis bandagi Allah hi ka haq hai . aur jinn logon  ney uss kay bajaye doosray rakhwalay bana liye hain ( yeh keh ker kay : )  hum inn ki ibadat sirf iss liye kertay hain kay yeh hamen Allah say qareeb kerden   unn kay darmiyan Allah unn baaton ka faisla keray ga jinn mein woh ikhtilaf ker rahey hain . yaqeen rakho kay Allah kissi aesay shaks ko raastay per nahi lata jo jhoota ho , kufr per jama huwa ho .
verses.translation: yaad rakho kay khalis bandagi Allah hi ka haq hai . aur jinn logon  ney uss kay bajaye doosray rakhwalay bana liye hain ( yeh keh ker kay : )  hum inn ki ibadat sirf iss liye kertay hain kay yeh hamen Allah say qareeb kerden   unn kay darmiyan Allah unn baaton ka faisla keray ga jinn mein woh ikhtilaf ker rahey hain . yaqeen rakho kay Allah kissi aesay shaks ko raastay per nahi lata jo jhoota ho , kufr per jama huwa ho .

verses.text: agar Allah yeh chahta kay kissi ko aulad banaye to woh apni makhlooq mein say jiss ko chahta muntakhib kerleta , ( lekin ) woh pak hai ( iss baat say kay uss ki koi aulad ho ) woh to Allah hai , aik , aur zabardast iqtidar ka malik !
verses.translation: agar Allah yeh chahta kay kissi ko aulad banaye to woh apni makhlooq mein say jiss ko chahta muntakhib kerleta , ( lekin ) woh pak hai ( iss baat say kay uss ki koi aulad ho ) woh to Allah hai , aik , aur zabardast iqtidar ka malik !

verses.text: uss ney saray aasman aur zameen bar-haq peda kiye hain . woh raat ko din per lapet deta hai , aur din ko raat per lapet deta hai , aur uss ney sooraj aur chaand ko kaam per lagaya huwa hai . her aik kissi moyyan mauddat tak kay liye rawan dawan hai . yaad rakho woh baray iqtidar ka malik , boht bakhshney wala hai .
verses.translation: uss ney saray aasman aur zameen bar-haq peda kiye hain . woh raat ko din per lapet deta hai , aur din ko raat per lapet deta hai , aur uss ney sooraj aur chaand ko kaam per lagaya huwa hai . her aik kissi moyyan mauddat tak kay liye rawan dawan hai . yaad rakho woh baray iqtidar ka malik , boht bakhshney wala hai .

verses.text: uss ney tum sabb ko aik shaks say peda kiya ,   phir ussi say uss ka jorra banaya , aur tumharay liye maweshiyon mein say aath jooray peda kiye .   woh tumhari takhleeq tumhari maon kay pet mein iss tarah kerta hai kay teen andheriyon kay darmiyan tum banawat kay aik marhalay kay baad doosray marhalay say guzartay ho .   woh hai Allah jo tumhara perwerdigar hai ! sari badshahi ussi ki hai , uss kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi hai . phir bhi tumhara mun aakhir koi kahan say morr deta hai-?
verses.translation: uss ney tum sabb ko aik shaks say peda kiya ,   phir ussi say uss ka jorra banaya , aur tumharay liye maweshiyon mein say aath jooray peda kiye .   woh tumhari takhleeq tumhari maon kay pet mein iss tarah kerta hai kay teen andheriyon kay darmiyan tum banawat kay aik marhalay kay baad doosray marhalay say guzartay ho .   woh hai Allah jo tumhara perwerdigar hai ! sari badshahi ussi ki hai , uss kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi hai . phir bhi tumhara mun aakhir koi kahan say morr deta hai-?

verses.text: agar tum kufr ikhtiyar kero gay to yaqeen rakho kay Allah tum say bey niaz hai , aur woh apney bandon kay liye kufr pasand nahi kerta , aur agar tum shukar kero gay to woh ussay tumharay liye pasand keray ga , aur koi bojh uthaney wala kissi doosray ka bojh nahi uthaye ga . phir tum sabb ko apney perwerdigar hi kay paas loat ker jana hai , uss waqt woh tumhen bataye ga kay tum kiya kuch kiya kertay thay . yaqeenan woh dilon ki baaten bhi khoob janta hai .
verses.translation: agar tum kufr ikhtiyar kero gay to yaqeen rakho kay Allah tum say bey niaz hai , aur woh apney bandon kay liye kufr pasand nahi kerta , aur agar tum shukar kero gay to woh ussay tumharay liye pasand keray ga , aur koi bojh uthaney wala kissi doosray ka bojh nahi uthaye ga . phir tum sabb ko apney perwerdigar hi kay paas loat ker jana hai , uss waqt woh tumhen bataye ga kay tum kiya kuch kiya kertay thay . yaqeenan woh dilon ki baaten bhi khoob janta hai .

verses.text: aur jab insan ko koi takleef choo jati hai to woh apney perwerdigar ko ussi say lo laga ker pukarta hai , phir jab woh insan ko apni taraf say koi naimat bakhsh deta hai to woh uss ( takleef ) ko bhool jata hai jiss kay liye pehlay Allah ko pukar raha tha , aur Allah kay liye shareek gharr leta hai , jiss kay nateejay mein doosron ko bhi Allah kay raastay say bhatkata hai . keh do kay :  kuch din apney kufr kay mazay uraley , yaqeenan tu dozakh walon mein shamil hai .
verses.translation: aur jab insan ko koi takleef choo jati hai to woh apney perwerdigar ko ussi say lo laga ker pukarta hai , phir jab woh insan ko apni taraf say koi naimat bakhsh deta hai to woh uss ( takleef ) ko bhool jata hai jiss kay liye pehlay Allah ko pukar raha tha , aur Allah kay liye shareek gharr leta hai , jiss kay nateejay mein doosron ko bhi Allah kay raastay say bhatkata hai . keh do kay :  kuch din apney kufr kay mazay uraley , yaqeenan tu dozakh walon mein shamil hai .

verses.text: bhala ( kiya aisa shaks uss kay barabar hosakta hai ) jo raat ki gharriyon mein ibadat kerta hai , kabhi sajday mein , kabhi qayam mein , aakhirat say darta hai , aur apney perwerdigar ki rehmat ka umeedwaar hai-? kaho kay :  kiya woh jo jantay hain , aur jo nahi jantay , sabb barabar hain-?    ( magar ) naseehat to wohi log qubool kertay hain jo aqal walay hain .
verses.translation: bhala ( kiya aisa shaks uss kay barabar hosakta hai ) jo raat ki gharriyon mein ibadat kerta hai , kabhi sajday mein , kabhi qayam mein , aakhirat say darta hai , aur apney perwerdigar ki rehmat ka umeedwaar hai-? kaho kay :  kiya woh jo jantay hain , aur jo nahi jantay , sabb barabar hain-?    ( magar ) naseehat to wohi log qubool kertay hain jo aqal walay hain .

verses.text: keh do kay :  aey meray emaan walay bando ! apney perwerdigar ka khof dil mein rakho . bhalai unhi ki hai jinhon ney iss duniya mein bhalai ki hai , aur Allah ki zameen boht wasee hai ,   jo log sabar say kaam letay hain , unn ka sawab unhen bey hisab diya jaye ga .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  aey meray emaan walay bando ! apney perwerdigar ka khof dil mein rakho . bhalai unhi ki hai jinhon ney iss duniya mein bhalai ki hai , aur Allah ki zameen boht wasee hai ,   jo log sabar say kaam letay hain , unn ka sawab unhen bey hisab diya jaye ga .

verses.text: keh do kay :  mujhay to hukum diya gaya hai kay mein Allah ki iss tarah ibadat kerun kay meri bandagi khalis ussi kay liye ho ,
verses.translation: keh do kay :  mujhay to hukum diya gaya hai kay mein Allah ki iss tarah ibadat kerun kay meri bandagi khalis ussi kay liye ho ,

verses.text: aur mujhay hukum diya gaya hai kay sabb say pehla farmanbardaar mein banun .
verses.translation: aur mujhay hukum diya gaya hai kay sabb say pehla farmanbardaar mein banun .

verses.text: keh do kay :  agar mein apney perwerdigar ki nafarmani kerun to mujhay aik zabardast din kay azab ka andesha hai .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  agar mein apney perwerdigar ki nafarmani kerun to mujhay aik zabardast din kay azab ka andesha hai .

verses.text: keh do kay :  mein to Allah ki ibadat iss tarah kerta hun kay mein ney apni bandagi sirf ussi kay liye khalis kerli hai .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  mein to Allah ki ibadat iss tarah kerta hun kay mein ney apni bandagi sirf ussi kay liye khalis kerli hai .

verses.text: abb tum ussay chorr ker jiss ki chahao , ibadat kero .    keh do kay :  ghatay ka soda kernay walay to woh hain jo qayamat kay din apni janon aur apney ghar walon sabb ko hara bethen gay . yaad rakho kay khula huwa ghaata yehi hai .
verses.translation: abb tum ussay chorr ker jiss ki chahao , ibadat kero .    keh do kay :  ghatay ka soda kernay walay to woh hain jo qayamat kay din apni janon aur apney ghar walon sabb ko hara bethen gay . yaad rakho kay khula huwa ghaata yehi hai .

verses.text: aesay logon  kay liye unn kay oopper bhi aag kay badal hain , aur unn kay neechay bhi wesay hi badal . yeh wohi cheez hai jiss say Allah apney bandon ko darata hai . lehaza aey meray bando ! mera khof dil mein rakho .
verses.translation: aesay logon  kay liye unn kay oopper bhi aag kay badal hain , aur unn kay neechay bhi wesay hi badal . yeh wohi cheez hai jiss say Allah apney bandon ko darata hai . lehaza aey meray bando ! mera khof dil mein rakho .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney iss baat say perhez kiya hai kay woh taghoot ki ibadat kernay lagen ,   aur unhon ney Allah say lo lagai hai , khushi ki khabar unhi kay liye hai , lehaza meray unn bandon ko khushi ki khabar suna do

verses.text: jo baat ko ghor say suntay hain to uss mein jo behtareen hoti hai , uss ki perwi kertay hain .   yehi woh log hain jinhen Allah ney hidayat di hai , aur yehi hain jo aqal walay hain .

verses.text: albatta jinhon ney apney perwerdigar ka khof dil mein rakha hai , unn kay liye oopper talay bani hoi oonchi oonchi imaraten hain , jinn kay neechay nehren behti hain . yeh Allah ka wada hai . Allah kabhi waday ki khilaf warzi nahi kerta .
verses.translation: albatta jinhon ney apney perwerdigar ka khof dil mein rakha hai , unn kay liye oopper talay bani hoi oonchi oonchi imaraten hain , jinn kay neechay nehren behti hain . yeh Allah ka wada hai . Allah kabhi waday ki khilaf warzi nahi kerta .

verses.text: kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay Allah ney aasman say paani utaara , phir ussay zameen kay sooton mein piro diya-?   phir woh uss paani say aesi khetiyan wajood mein lata hai jinn kay rang mukhtalif hain , phir woh khetiyan sookh jati hain to tum unhen dekhtay ho kay peeli parr-gai hain , phir woh unhen choora choora ker deta hai . yaqeenan inn baaton mein unn logon  kay liye bara sabaq hai jo aqal rakhtay hain .
verses.translation: kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay Allah ney aasman say paani utaara , phir ussay zameen kay sooton mein piro diya-?   phir woh uss paani say aesi khetiyan wajood mein lata hai jinn kay rang mukhtalif hain , phir woh khetiyan sookh jati hain to tum unhen dekhtay ho kay peeli parr-gai hain , phir woh unhen choora choora ker deta hai . yaqeenan inn baaton mein unn logon  kay liye bara sabaq hai jo aqal rakhtay hain .

verses.text: bhala kiya woh shaks jiss ka seena Allah ney Islam kay liye khol diya hai , jiss kay nateejay mein woh apney perwerdigar ki ata ki hoi roshni mein aa-chuka hai , ( sang dilon kay barabar hosakta hai ? ) haan ! barbadi unn ki hai jinn kay dil Allah kay ziker say sakht hochukay hain . yeh log khuli gumrahi mein parray huye hain .
verses.translation: bhala kiya woh shaks jiss ka seena Allah ney Islam kay liye khol diya hai , jiss kay nateejay mein woh apney perwerdigar ki ata ki hoi roshni mein aa-chuka hai , ( sang dilon kay barabar hosakta hai ? ) haan ! barbadi unn ki hai jinn kay dil Allah kay ziker say sakht hochukay hain . yeh log khuli gumrahi mein parray huye hain .

verses.text: Allah ney behtareen kalam nazil farmaya hai , aik aesi kitab jiss kay mazameen aik doosray say miltay jultay hain , jiss ki baaten baar baar dohrai gaee hain . woh log jinn kay dilon mein apney perwerdigar ka roab hai inn/unn ki khalen iss say kaanp uthti hain , phir unn kay jism aur unn kay dil naram ho ker Allah ki yaad ki taraf mutawajjah hojatay hain . yeh Allah ki hidayat hai jiss kay zariye woh jiss ko chahta hai , raah-e-raast per ley aata hai , aur jissay Allah raastay say bhatka dey , ussay koi raastay per laney wala nahi .
verses.translation: Allah ney behtareen kalam nazil farmaya hai , aik aesi kitab jiss kay mazameen aik doosray say miltay jultay hain , jiss ki baaten baar baar dohrai gaee hain . woh log jinn kay dilon mein apney perwerdigar ka roab hai inn/unn ki khalen iss say kaanp uthti hain , phir unn kay jism aur unn kay dil naram ho ker Allah ki yaad ki taraf mutawajjah hojatay hain . yeh Allah ki hidayat hai jiss kay zariye woh jiss ko chahta hai , raah-e-raast per ley aata hai , aur jissay Allah raastay say bhatka dey , ussay koi raastay per laney wala nahi .

( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney logon  kay faeeday kay liye tum per yeh kitab bar-haq nazil ki hai . abb jo shaks raah-e-raast per aajaye ga , woh apni hi bhalai kay liye aaye ga , aur jo gumrahi ikhtiyar keray ga , woh apni gumrahi say apna hi nuqsan keray ga , aur tum uss kay zimma daar nahi ho .

verses.text: Allah tamam roohon ko unn ki moat kay waqt qabz kerleta hai , aur jinn ko abhi moat nahi aai hoti , unn ko bhi unn ki neend ki halat mein ( qabz kerleta hai , ) phir jinn kay baaray mein uss ney moat ka faisla kerliya , unhen apney paas rok leta hai , aur doosri roohon ko aik moyyan waqt tak kay liye chorr deta hai .   yaqeenan iss baat mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo ghor o fiker say kaam letay hain .
verses.translation: Allah tamam roohon ko unn ki moat kay waqt qabz kerleta hai , aur jinn ko abhi moat nahi aai hoti , unn ko bhi unn ki neend ki halat mein ( qabz kerleta hai , ) phir jinn kay baaray mein uss ney moat ka faisla kerliya , unhen apney paas rok leta hai , aur doosri roohon ko aik moyyan waqt tak kay liye chorr deta hai .   yaqeenan iss baat mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo ghor o fiker say kaam letay hain .

verses.text: bhala kiya inn logon  ney Allah ( ki ijazat ) kay baghair kuch sirfarishi gharr rakhay hain-? ( inn say ) kaho kay :  chahye yeh naa koi ikhtiyar rakhtay hon , naa kuch samajhtay hon ( phir bhi tum unhen sirfarishi mantay raho gay-? )
verses.translation: bhala kiya inn logon  ney Allah ( ki ijazat ) kay baghair kuch sirfarishi gharr rakhay hain-? ( inn say ) kaho kay :  chahye yeh naa koi ikhtiyar rakhtay hon , naa kuch samajhtay hon ( phir bhi tum unhen sirfarishi mantay raho gay-? )

verses.text: kaho kay : " sifarish to sari ki sari Allah hi kay ikhtiyar mein hai . ussi kay qabazay mein aasmano aur zameen ki badshahi hai , phir ussi ki taraf tumhen lotaya jaye ga .
verses.translation: kaho kay : " sifarish to sari ki sari Allah hi kay ikhtiyar mein hai . ussi kay qabazay mein aasmano aur zameen ki badshahi hai , phir ussi ki taraf tumhen lotaya jaye ga .

verses.text: aur jab kabhi tanha Allah ka ziker kiya jata hai to jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , unn kay dil beyzar hojatay hain , aur jab uss kay siwa doosron ka ziker kiya jata hai to yeh log khushi say khil uthtay hain .
verses.translation: aur jab kabhi tanha Allah ka ziker kiya jata hai to jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , unn kay dil beyzar hojatay hain , aur jab uss kay siwa doosron ka ziker kiya jata hai to yeh log khushi say khil uthtay hain .

verses.text: kaho : " aey Allah ! aey aasmano aur zameen ko peda kernay walay , her ghaeeb o hazir kay janney walay ! tu hi apney bandon kay darmiyan unn baaton ka faisla keray ga jinn mein woh ikhtilaf kertay rahey hain .
verses.translation: kaho : " aey Allah ! aey aasmano aur zameen ko peda kernay walay , her ghaeeb o hazir kay janney walay ! tu hi apney bandon kay darmiyan unn baaton ka faisla keray ga jinn mein woh ikhtilaf kertay rahey hain .
