verses.translation: aur qayamat kay din tum dekho gay kay jinn logon  ney Allah per jhoot baandha hai , unn kay chehray siyah parray huye hain . kiya jahannum mein aesay mutakabbiron ka thikana nahi hoga-?

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya hai , Allah unn ko nijat dey ker unn ki murad ko phoncha dey ga , unhen koi takleef chooay gi bhi nahi , aur naa unhen kissi baat ka ghum hoga .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya hai , Allah unn ko nijat dey ker unn ki murad ko phoncha dey ga , unhen koi takleef chooay gi bhi nahi , aur naa unhen kissi baat ka ghum hoga .

verses.text: Allah her cheez ka peda kernay wala hai , aur wohi her cheez ka rakhwala hai .
verses.translation: Allah her cheez ka peda kernay wala hai , aur wohi her cheez ka rakhwala hai .

verses.text: saray aasmano aur zameen ki kunjiyan ussi kay paas hain , aur jinhon ney Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kiya hai ghatay mein rehney walay wohi hain .
verses.translation: saray aasmano aur zameen ki kunjiyan ussi kay paas hain , aur jinhon ney Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kiya hai ghatay mein rehney walay wohi hain .

verses.text: keh do kay :  kiya phir bhi aey jahilo ! tum mujh say kehtay ho kay Allah kay siwa kissi aur ki ibadat kerun-?
verses.translation: keh do kay :  kiya phir bhi aey jahilo ! tum mujh say kehtay ho kay Allah kay siwa kissi aur ki ibadat kerun-?

verses.text: aur yeh haqeeqat hai kay tum say aur tum say pehlay tamam payghumberon say wahi kay zariye yeh baat keh di gaee thi kay agar tum ney shirk ka irtikab kiya to tumhara kiya keraya sabb gharat hojaye ga , aur tum yaqeeni tor per sakht nuqsan uthaney walon mein shamil hojao gay .
verses.translation: aur yeh haqeeqat hai kay tum say aur tum say pehlay tamam payghumberon say wahi kay zariye yeh baat keh di gaee thi kay agar tum ney shirk ka irtikab kiya to tumhara kiya keraya sabb gharat hojaye ga , aur tum yaqeeni tor per sakht nuqsan uthaney walon mein shamil hojao gay .

verses.text: lehaza uss kay bajaye tum Allah hi ki ibadat kero , aur shukar guzaar logon  mein shamil hojao .
verses.translation: lehaza uss kay bajaye tum Allah hi ki ibadat kero , aur shukar guzaar logon  mein shamil hojao .

verses.text: aur inn logon  ney Allah taalaa ki qadar hi nahi pehchani jaisa kay uss ki qadar pehchanney ka haq tha , halankay poori ki poori zameen qayamat kay din uss ki mutthi mein hogi , aur saray kay saray aasman uss kay dayen haath mein liptay huye hon gay . woh pak hai , aur boht baala o bartar uss shirk say jiss ka irtikab yeh log ker rahey hain .
verses.translation: aur inn logon  ney Allah taalaa ki qadar hi nahi pehchani jaisa kay uss ki qadar pehchanney ka haq tha , halankay poori ki poori zameen qayamat kay din uss ki mutthi mein hogi , aur saray kay saray aasman uss kay dayen haath mein liptay huye hon gay . woh pak hai , aur boht baala o bartar uss shirk say jiss ka irtikab yeh log ker rahey hain .

verses.text: aur soor phoonka jaye ga to aasmano aur zameen mein jitney hain , woh sabb bey hosh hojayen gay , siwaye uss kay jissay Allah chahye . phir doosri baar phoonka jaye ga to woh sabb log pal bhar mein kharray ho ker dekhney lagen gay .
verses.translation: aur soor phoonka jaye ga to aasmano aur zameen mein jitney hain , woh sabb bey hosh hojayen gay , siwaye uss kay jissay Allah chahye . phir doosri baar phoonka jaye ga to woh sabb log pal bhar mein kharray ho ker dekhney lagen gay .

verses.text: aur zameen apney perwerdigar kay noor say chamak uthay gi , aur nama aemal samney rakh diya jaye ga , aur anbiya aur sabb gawahon ko hazir kerdiya jaye ga , aur logon  kay darmiyan bilkul bar-haq faisla kiya jaye ga , aur unn per koi zulm nahi hoga .
verses.translation: aur zameen apney perwerdigar kay noor say chamak uthay gi , aur nama aemal samney rakh diya jaye ga , aur anbiya aur sabb gawahon ko hazir kerdiya jaye ga , aur logon  kay darmiyan bilkul bar-haq faisla kiya jaye ga , aur unn per koi zulm nahi hoga .

verses.text: aur her shaks ko uss kay amal ka poora poora badla diya jaye ga , aur jo kuch log kertay hain , Allah ussay khoob janta hai .
verses.translation: aur her shaks ko uss kay amal ka poora poora badla diya jaye ga , aur jo kuch log kertay hain , Allah ussay khoob janta hai .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya tha , unhen jahannum ki taraf girohon ki shakal mein haanka jaye ga , yahan tak kay jab woh uss kay paas phonch jayen gay to uss kay darwazay kholay jayen gay , aur uss kay mohafiz unn say kahen gay kay :  kiya tumharay paas tumharay apney logon  mein say payghumber nahi aaye thay jo tumhen tumharay rab ki aayaten parh ker sunatay hon , aur tumhen iss din ka samna kernay say khabar daar kertay hon-?  woh kahen gay kay :  beyshak aaye thay , lekin azab ki baat kafiron per sachi ho ker rahi .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya tha , unhen jahannum ki taraf girohon ki shakal mein haanka jaye ga , yahan tak kay jab woh uss kay paas phonch jayen gay to uss kay darwazay kholay jayen gay , aur uss kay mohafiz unn say kahen gay kay :  kiya tumharay paas tumharay apney logon  mein say payghumber nahi aaye thay jo tumhen tumharay rab ki aayaten parh ker sunatay hon , aur tumhen iss din ka samna kernay say khabar daar kertay hon-?  woh kahen gay kay :  beyshak aaye thay , lekin azab ki baat kafiron per sachi ho ker rahi .

verses.text: kaha jaye ga kay :  jahannum kay darwazon mein hamesha hamesha rehney kay liye dakhil hojao , kiyonkay boht bura thikana hai unn ka jo takabbur say kaam letay hain .
verses.translation: kaha jaye ga kay :  jahannum kay darwazon mein hamesha hamesha rehney kay liye dakhil hojao , kiyonkay boht bura thikana hai unn ka jo takabbur say kaam letay hain .

verses.text: aur jinhon ney apney perwerdigar say taqwa ka moamla rakha tha unhen jannat ki taraf girohon ki shakal mein ley jaya jaye ga , yahan tak kay jab woh uss kay paas phonchen gay , jabkay uss kay darwazay unn kay liye pehlay say kholay jaa chukay hon gay , ( to woh ajeeb aalam hoga . ) aur uss kay mohafiz unn say kahen gay kay :  salam ho aap per , khoob rahey aap log ! abb iss jannat mein hamesha hamesha rehney kay liye aa jaiye .
verses.translation: aur jinhon ney apney perwerdigar say taqwa ka moamla rakha tha unhen jannat ki taraf girohon ki shakal mein ley jaya jaye ga , yahan tak kay jab woh uss kay paas phonchen gay , jabkay uss kay darwazay unn kay liye pehlay say kholay jaa chukay hon gay , ( to woh ajeeb aalam hoga . ) aur uss kay mohafiz unn say kahen gay kay :  salam ho aap per , khoob rahey aap log ! abb iss jannat mein hamesha hamesha rehney kay liye aa jaiye .

verses.text: aur woh ( jannati ) kahen gay kay :  tamam tarr shukar Allah ka hai jiss ney hum say apney waday ko sacha ker dikhaya , aur hamen iss sarzameen ka aisa waris bana diya kay hum jannat mein jahan chahen apna thikana bana len . sabit huwa kay behtareen inaam ( naik ) amal kernay walon ka hai .
verses.translation: aur woh ( jannati ) kahen gay kay :  tamam tarr shukar Allah ka hai jiss ney hum say apney waday ko sacha ker dikhaya , aur hamen iss sarzameen ka aisa waris bana diya kay hum jannat mein jahan chahen apna thikana bana len . sabit huwa kay behtareen inaam ( naik ) amal kernay walon ka hai .

verses.text: aur tum farishton ko dekho gay kay arsh kay gird halqa banaye huye apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh ker rahey hon gay , aur logon  kay darmiyan bar-haq faisla kerdiya jaye ga , aur kehney walay kahen gay kay :  tamam tarr tareef Allah ki hai jo saray jahano ka perwerdigar hai .
verses.translation: aur tum farishton ko dekho gay kay arsh kay gird halqa banaye huye apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh ker rahey hon gay , aur logon  kay darmiyan bar-haq faisla kerdiya jaye ga , aur kehney walay kahen gay kay :  tamam tarr tareef Allah ki hai jo saray jahano ka perwerdigar hai .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai .

ayahs.text: yeh kitab Allah ki taraf say nazil ki jarahi hai , jo baray iqtidar ka malik hai , boht hikmat wala .
ayahs.translation: yeh kitab Allah ki taraf say nazil ki jarahi hai , jo baray iqtidar ka malik hai , boht hikmat wala .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) beyshak yeh kitab hum ney tum per bar-haq nazil ki hai , iss liye Allah ki iss tarah ibadat kero kay bandagi khalis ussi kay liye ho .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) beyshak yeh kitab hum ney tum per bar-haq nazil ki hai , iss liye Allah ki iss tarah ibadat kero kay bandagi khalis ussi kay liye ho .

ayahs.text: yaad rakho kay khalis bandagi Allah hi ka haq hai . aur jinn logon  ney uss kay bajaye doosray rakhwalay bana liye hain ( yeh keh ker kay : )  hum inn ki ibadat sirf iss liye kertay hain kay yeh hamen Allah say qareeb kerden   unn kay darmiyan Allah unn baaton ka faisla keray ga jinn mein woh ikhtilaf ker rahey hain . yaqeen rakho kay Allah kissi aesay shaks ko raastay per nahi lata jo jhoota ho , kufr per jama huwa ho .
ayahs.translation: yaad rakho kay khalis bandagi Allah hi ka haq hai . aur jinn logon  ney uss kay bajaye doosray rakhwalay bana liye hain ( yeh keh ker kay : )  hum inn ki ibadat sirf iss liye kertay hain kay yeh hamen Allah say qareeb kerden   unn kay darmiyan Allah unn baaton ka faisla keray ga jinn mein woh ikhtilaf ker rahey hain . yaqeen rakho kay Allah kissi aesay shaks ko raastay per nahi lata jo jhoota ho , kufr per jama huwa ho .

ayahs.text: agar Allah yeh chahta kay kissi ko aulad banaye to woh apni makhlooq mein say jiss ko chahta muntakhib kerleta , ( lekin ) woh pak hai ( iss baat say kay uss ki koi aulad ho ) woh to Allah hai , aik , aur zabardast iqtidar ka malik !
ayahs.translation: agar Allah yeh chahta kay kissi ko aulad banaye to woh apni makhlooq mein say jiss ko chahta muntakhib kerleta , ( lekin ) woh pak hai ( iss baat say kay uss ki koi aulad ho ) woh to Allah hai , aik , aur zabardast iqtidar ka malik !

ayahs.text: uss ney saray aasman aur zameen bar-haq peda kiye hain . woh raat ko din per lapet deta hai , aur din ko raat per lapet deta hai , aur uss ney sooraj aur chaand ko kaam per lagaya huwa hai . her aik kissi moyyan mauddat tak kay liye rawan dawan hai . yaad rakho woh baray iqtidar ka malik , boht bakhshney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: uss ney saray aasman aur zameen bar-haq peda kiye hain . woh raat ko din per lapet deta hai , aur din ko raat per lapet deta hai , aur uss ney sooraj aur chaand ko kaam per lagaya huwa hai . her aik kissi moyyan mauddat tak kay liye rawan dawan hai . yaad rakho woh baray iqtidar ka malik , boht bakhshney wala hai .

ayahs.text: uss ney tum sabb ko aik shaks say peda kiya ,   phir ussi say uss ka jorra banaya , aur tumharay liye maweshiyon mein say aath jooray peda kiye .   woh tumhari takhleeq tumhari maon kay pet mein iss tarah kerta hai kay teen andheriyon kay darmiyan tum banawat kay aik marhalay kay baad doosray marhalay say guzartay ho .   woh hai Allah jo tumhara perwerdigar hai ! sari badshahi ussi ki hai , uss kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi hai . phir bhi tumhara mun aakhir koi kahan say morr deta hai-?
ayahs.translation: uss ney tum sabb ko aik shaks say peda kiya ,   phir ussi say uss ka jorra banaya , aur tumharay liye maweshiyon mein say aath jooray peda kiye .   woh tumhari takhleeq tumhari maon kay pet mein iss tarah kerta hai kay teen andheriyon kay darmiyan tum banawat kay aik marhalay kay baad doosray marhalay say guzartay ho .   woh hai Allah jo tumhara perwerdigar hai ! sari badshahi ussi ki hai , uss kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi hai . phir bhi tumhara mun aakhir koi kahan say morr deta hai-?

ayahs.text: agar tum kufr ikhtiyar kero gay to yaqeen rakho kay Allah tum say bey niaz hai , aur woh apney bandon kay liye kufr pasand nahi kerta , aur agar tum shukar kero gay to woh ussay tumharay liye pasand keray ga , aur koi bojh uthaney wala kissi doosray ka bojh nahi uthaye ga . phir tum sabb ko apney perwerdigar hi kay paas loat ker jana hai , uss waqt woh tumhen bataye ga kay tum kiya kuch kiya kertay thay . yaqeenan woh dilon ki baaten bhi khoob janta hai .
ayahs.translation: agar tum kufr ikhtiyar kero gay to yaqeen rakho kay Allah tum say bey niaz hai , aur woh apney bandon kay liye kufr pasand nahi kerta , aur agar tum shukar kero gay to woh ussay tumharay liye pasand keray ga , aur koi bojh uthaney wala kissi doosray ka bojh nahi uthaye ga . phir tum sabb ko apney perwerdigar hi kay paas loat ker jana hai , uss waqt woh tumhen bataye ga kay tum kiya kuch kiya kertay thay . yaqeenan woh dilon ki baaten bhi khoob janta hai .

ayahs.text: aur jab insan ko koi takleef choo jati hai to woh apney perwerdigar ko ussi say lo laga ker pukarta hai , phir jab woh insan ko apni taraf say koi naimat bakhsh deta hai to woh uss ( takleef ) ko bhool jata hai jiss kay liye pehlay Allah ko pukar raha tha , aur Allah kay liye shareek gharr leta hai , jiss kay nateejay mein doosron ko bhi Allah kay raastay say bhatkata hai . keh do kay :  kuch din apney kufr kay mazay uraley , yaqeenan tu dozakh walon mein shamil hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jab insan ko koi takleef choo jati hai to woh apney perwerdigar ko ussi say lo laga ker pukarta hai , phir jab woh insan ko apni taraf say koi naimat bakhsh deta hai to woh uss ( takleef ) ko bhool jata hai jiss kay liye pehlay Allah ko pukar raha tha , aur Allah kay liye shareek gharr leta hai , jiss kay nateejay mein doosron ko bhi Allah kay raastay say bhatkata hai . keh do kay :  kuch din apney kufr kay mazay uraley , yaqeenan tu dozakh walon mein shamil hai .

ayahs.text: bhala ( kiya aisa shaks uss kay barabar hosakta hai ) jo raat ki gharriyon mein ibadat kerta hai , kabhi sajday mein , kabhi qayam mein , aakhirat say darta hai , aur apney perwerdigar ki rehmat ka umeedwaar hai-? kaho kay :  kiya woh jo jantay hain , aur jo nahi jantay , sabb barabar hain-?    ( magar ) naseehat to wohi log qubool kertay hain jo aqal walay hain .
ayahs.translation: bhala ( kiya aisa shaks uss kay barabar hosakta hai ) jo raat ki gharriyon mein ibadat kerta hai , kabhi sajday mein , kabhi qayam mein , aakhirat say darta hai , aur apney perwerdigar ki rehmat ka umeedwaar hai-? kaho kay :  kiya woh jo jantay hain , aur jo nahi jantay , sabb barabar hain-?    ( magar ) naseehat to wohi log qubool kertay hain jo aqal walay hain .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  aey meray emaan walay bando ! apney perwerdigar ka khof dil mein rakho . bhalai unhi ki hai jinhon ney iss duniya mein bhalai ki hai , aur Allah ki zameen boht wasee hai ,   jo log sabar say kaam letay hain , unn ka sawab unhen bey hisab diya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  aey meray emaan walay bando ! apney perwerdigar ka khof dil mein rakho . bhalai unhi ki hai jinhon ney iss duniya mein bhalai ki hai , aur Allah ki zameen boht wasee hai ,   jo log sabar say kaam letay hain , unn ka sawab unhen bey hisab diya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  mujhay to hukum diya gaya hai kay mein Allah ki iss tarah ibadat kerun kay meri bandagi khalis ussi kay liye ho ,
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  mujhay to hukum diya gaya hai kay mein Allah ki iss tarah ibadat kerun kay meri bandagi khalis ussi kay liye ho ,

ayahs.text: aur mujhay hukum diya gaya hai kay sabb say pehla farmanbardaar mein banun .
ayahs.translation: aur mujhay hukum diya gaya hai kay sabb say pehla farmanbardaar mein banun .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  agar mein apney perwerdigar ki nafarmani kerun to mujhay aik zabardast din kay azab ka andesha hai .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  agar mein apney perwerdigar ki nafarmani kerun to mujhay aik zabardast din kay azab ka andesha hai .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  mein to Allah ki ibadat iss tarah kerta hun kay mein ney apni bandagi sirf ussi kay liye khalis kerli hai .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  mein to Allah ki ibadat iss tarah kerta hun kay mein ney apni bandagi sirf ussi kay liye khalis kerli hai .

ayahs.text: abb tum ussay chorr ker jiss ki chahao , ibadat kero .    keh do kay :  ghatay ka soda kernay walay to woh hain jo qayamat kay din apni janon aur apney ghar walon sabb ko hara bethen gay . yaad rakho kay khula huwa ghaata yehi hai .
ayahs.translation: abb tum ussay chorr ker jiss ki chahao , ibadat kero .    keh do kay :  ghatay ka soda kernay walay to woh hain jo qayamat kay din apni janon aur apney ghar walon sabb ko hara bethen gay . yaad rakho kay khula huwa ghaata yehi hai .

ayahs.text: aesay logon  kay liye unn kay oopper bhi aag kay badal hain , aur unn kay neechay bhi wesay hi badal . yeh wohi cheez hai jiss say Allah apney bandon ko darata hai . lehaza aey meray bando ! mera khof dil mein rakho .
ayahs.translation: aesay logon  kay liye unn kay oopper bhi aag kay badal hain , aur unn kay neechay bhi wesay hi badal . yeh wohi cheez hai jiss say Allah apney bandon ko darata hai . lehaza aey meray bando ! mera khof dil mein rakho .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney iss baat say perhez kiya hai kay woh taghoot ki ibadat kernay lagen ,   aur unhon ney Allah say lo lagai hai , khushi ki khabar unhi kay liye hai , lehaza meray unn bandon ko khushi ki khabar suna do
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney iss baat say perhez kiya hai kay woh taghoot ki ibadat kernay lagen ,   aur unhon ney Allah say lo lagai hai , khushi ki khabar unhi kay liye hai , lehaza meray unn bandon ko khushi ki khabar suna do

ayahs.text: jo baat ko ghor say suntay hain to uss mein jo behtareen hoti hai , uss ki perwi kertay hain .   yehi woh log hain jinhen Allah ney hidayat di hai , aur yehi hain jo aqal walay hain .
ayahs.translation: jo baat ko ghor say suntay hain to uss mein jo behtareen hoti hai , uss ki perwi kertay hain .   yehi woh log hain jinhen Allah ney hidayat di hai , aur yehi hain jo aqal walay hain .

ayahs.text: bhala jiss shaks per azab ki baat tey hochuki , to kiya tum ussay bacha lo gay jo aag kay andar phonch chuka hai ?
ayahs.translation: bhala jiss shaks per azab ki baat tey hochuki , to kiya tum ussay bacha lo gay jo aag kay andar phonch chuka hai ?

ayahs.text: albatta jinhon ney apney perwerdigar ka khof dil mein rakha hai , unn kay liye oopper talay bani hoi oonchi oonchi imaraten hain , jinn kay neechay nehren behti hain . yeh Allah ka wada hai . Allah kabhi waday ki khilaf warzi nahi kerta .
ayahs.translation: albatta jinhon ney apney perwerdigar ka khof dil mein rakha hai , unn kay liye oopper talay bani hoi oonchi oonchi imaraten hain , jinn kay neechay nehren behti hain . yeh Allah ka wada hai . Allah kabhi waday ki khilaf warzi nahi kerta .

ayahs.text: kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay Allah ney aasman say paani utaara , phir ussay zameen kay sooton mein piro diya-?   phir woh uss paani say aesi khetiyan wajood mein lata hai jinn kay rang mukhtalif hain , phir woh khetiyan sookh jati hain to tum unhen dekhtay ho kay peeli parr-gai hain , phir woh unhen choora choora ker deta hai . yaqeenan inn baaton mein unn logon  kay liye bara sabaq hai jo aqal rakhtay hain .
ayahs.translation: kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay Allah ney aasman say paani utaara , phir ussay zameen kay sooton mein piro diya-?   phir woh uss paani say aesi khetiyan wajood mein lata hai jinn kay rang mukhtalif hain , phir woh khetiyan sookh jati hain to tum unhen dekhtay ho kay peeli parr-gai hain , phir woh unhen choora choora ker deta hai . yaqeenan inn baaton mein unn logon  kay liye bara sabaq hai jo aqal rakhtay hain .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya woh shaks jiss ka seena Allah ney Islam kay liye khol diya hai , jiss kay nateejay mein woh apney perwerdigar ki ata ki hoi roshni mein aa-chuka hai , ( sang dilon kay barabar hosakta hai ? ) haan ! barbadi unn ki hai jinn kay dil Allah kay ziker say sakht hochukay hain . yeh log khuli gumrahi mein parray huye hain .
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya woh shaks jiss ka seena Allah ney Islam kay liye khol diya hai , jiss kay nateejay mein woh apney perwerdigar ki ata ki hoi roshni mein aa-chuka hai , ( sang dilon kay barabar hosakta hai ? ) haan ! barbadi unn ki hai jinn kay dil Allah kay ziker say sakht hochukay hain . yeh log khuli gumrahi mein parray huye hain .

ayahs.text: Allah ney behtareen kalam nazil farmaya hai , aik aesi kitab jiss kay mazameen aik doosray say miltay jultay hain , jiss ki baaten baar baar dohrai gaee hain . woh log jinn kay dilon mein apney perwerdigar ka roab hai inn/unn ki khalen iss say kaanp uthti hain , phir unn kay jism aur unn kay dil naram ho ker Allah ki yaad ki taraf mutawajjah hojatay hain . yeh Allah ki hidayat hai jiss kay zariye woh jiss ko chahta hai , raah-e-raast per ley aata hai , aur jissay Allah raastay say bhatka dey , ussay koi raastay per laney wala nahi .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney behtareen kalam nazil farmaya hai , aik aesi kitab jiss kay mazameen aik doosray say miltay jultay hain , jiss ki baaten baar baar dohrai gaee hain . woh log jinn kay dilon mein apney perwerdigar ka roab hai inn/unn ki khalen iss say kaanp uthti hain , phir unn kay jism aur unn kay dil naram ho ker Allah ki yaad ki taraf mutawajjah hojatay hain . yeh Allah ki hidayat hai jiss kay zariye woh jiss ko chahta hai , raah-e-raast per ley aata hai , aur jissay Allah raastay say bhatka dey , ussay koi raastay per laney wala nahi .

ayahs.text: bhala ( uss shaks ka kaisa bura haal hoga ) jo qayamat kay din apney chehray hi say bad-tareen azab ko rokna chahye ga-?   aur zalimon say kaha jaye ga kay :  chakho maza uss kamai ka jo tum ney ker rakhi thi .
ayahs.translation: bhala ( uss shaks ka kaisa bura haal hoga ) jo qayamat kay din apney chehray hi say bad-tareen azab ko rokna chahye ga-?   aur zalimon say kaha jaye ga kay :  chakho maza uss kamai ka jo tum ney ker rakhi thi .

ayahs.text: jo log inn say pehlay thay , unhon ney bhi ( payghumberon ko ) jhutlaya tha jiss kay nateejay mein unn per azab aesi jagah say aaya jiss ki taraf unn ka gumaan bhi nahi jasakta tha ,
ayahs.translation: jo log inn say pehlay thay , unhon ney bhi ( payghumberon ko ) jhutlaya tha jiss kay nateejay mein unn per azab aesi jagah say aaya jiss ki taraf unn ka gumaan bhi nahi jasakta tha ,

ayahs.text: chunacheh Allah ney unn ko issi dunyawi zindagi mein ruswai ka maza chakhaya , aur aakhirat ka azab to aur bhi bara hai . kaash yeh log jantay !
ayahs.translation: chunacheh Allah ney unn ko issi dunyawi zindagi mein ruswai ka maza chakhaya , aur aakhirat ka azab to aur bhi bara hai . kaash yeh log jantay !

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney iss Quran mein logon  ki khatir her qisam ki misalen biyan ki hain , takay log sabaq hasil keren ,
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney iss Quran mein logon  ki khatir her qisam ki misalen biyan ki hain , takay log sabaq hasil keren ,

ayahs.text: yeh arbi Quran jiss mein koi tairrah nahi ! takay log taqwa ikhtiyar keren .
ayahs.translation: yeh arbi Quran jiss mein koi tairrah nahi ! takay log taqwa ikhtiyar keren .

ayahs.text: Allah ney aik misal yeh di hai kay aik ( ghulam ) shaks hai jiss ki milkiyat mein kaee log shareek hain jinn kay darmiyan aapas mein kheench taan bhi hai , aur doosra ( ghulam ) shaks woh hai jo pooray ka poora aik hi aadmi ki milkiyat hai . kiya inn dono ki halat aik jaisi hosakti hai-?   Alhamdulillah ! ( iss misal say baat bilkul wazeh hogaee ) lekin inn mein say aksar log samajhtay nahi .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney aik misal yeh di hai kay aik ( ghulam ) shaks hai jiss ki milkiyat mein kaee log shareek hain jinn kay darmiyan aapas mein kheench taan bhi hai , aur doosra ( ghulam ) shaks woh hai jo pooray ka poora aik hi aadmi ki milkiyat hai . kiya inn dono ki halat aik jaisi hosakti hai-?   Alhamdulillah ! ( iss misal say baat bilkul wazeh hogaee ) lekin inn mein say aksar log samajhtay nahi .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) moat tumhen bhi aani hai , aur moat unhen bhi aani hai ,
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) moat tumhen bhi aani hai , aur moat unhen bhi aani hai ,

ayahs.text: phir tum sabb qayamat kay din apney perwerdigar kay paas apna muqadma paish kero gay .
ayahs.translation: phir tum sabb qayamat kay din apney perwerdigar kay paas apna muqadma paish kero gay .

ayahs.text: abb batao kay uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay , aur jab sachi baat uss kay paas aaye to woh uss ko jhutla dey-? kiya jahannum mein aesay kafiron ka thikana nahi hoga-?
ayahs.translation: abb batao kay uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay , aur jab sachi baat uss kay paas aaye to woh uss ko jhutla dey-? kiya jahannum mein aesay kafiron ka thikana nahi hoga-?

ayahs.text: aur jo log sachi baat ley ker ayen , aur khud bhi ussay sach maanen woh hain jo muttaqi hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log sachi baat ley ker ayen , aur khud bhi ussay sach maanen woh hain jo muttaqi hain .

ayahs.text: unn ko apney perwerdigar kay paas her woh cheez milay gi jo woh chahen gay . yeh hai naik logon  ka badla ,
ayahs.translation: unn ko apney perwerdigar kay paas her woh cheez milay gi jo woh chahen gay . yeh hai naik logon  ka badla ,

ayahs.text: takay unhon ney jo bad-tareen kaam kiye thay , Allah unn ka kaffara kerday , aur jo behtareen kaam kertay rahey thay , unn ka sawab unhen ata farmaye .
ayahs.translation: takay unhon ney jo bad-tareen kaam kiye thay , Allah unn ka kaffara kerday , aur jo behtareen kaam kertay rahey thay , unn ka sawab unhen ata farmaye .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya Allah apney banday kay liye kafi nahi hai-? aur yeh log tumhen uss kay siwa doosron say daratay hain , aur jissay Allah raastay say bhatka dey , ussay koi raastay per laney wala nahi ,
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya Allah apney banday kay liye kafi nahi hai-? aur yeh log tumhen uss kay siwa doosron say daratay hain , aur jissay Allah raastay say bhatka dey , ussay koi raastay per laney wala nahi ,

ayahs.text: aur jissay Allah raah-e-raast per ley aaye , ussay koi raastay say bhatkaney wala nahi . kiya Allah zabardast , intiqam lenay wala nahi-?
ayahs.translation: aur jissay Allah raah-e-raast per ley aaye , ussay koi raastay say bhatkaney wala nahi . kiya Allah zabardast , intiqam lenay wala nahi-?

ayahs.text: aur agar tum inn say poocho kay aasmano ko aur zameen ko kiss ney peda kiya hai-? to woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay Allah ney . ( unn say ) kaho kay : " zara mujhay yeh batao kay tum Allah ko chorr ker jinn ( button ) ko pukartay ho , agar Allah mujhay koi nuqsan phonchaney ka irada kerlay to kiya yeh uss kay phonchaye huye nuqsan ko door ker-saktay hain-? ya agar Allah mujh per meharbani farmana chahye to kiya yeh uss ki rehmat ko rok saktay hain-?   kaho kay : " meray liye Allah hi kafi hai . bharosa rakhney walay ussi per bharosa rakhtay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur agar tum inn say poocho kay aasmano ko aur zameen ko kiss ney peda kiya hai-? to woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay Allah ney . ( unn say ) kaho kay : " zara mujhay yeh batao kay tum Allah ko chorr ker jinn ( button ) ko pukartay ho , agar Allah mujhay koi nuqsan phonchaney ka irada kerlay to kiya yeh uss kay phonchaye huye nuqsan ko door ker-saktay hain-? ya agar Allah mujh per meharbani farmana chahye to kiya yeh uss ki rehmat ko rok saktay hain-?   kaho kay : " meray liye Allah hi kafi hai . bharosa rakhney walay ussi per bharosa rakhtay hain .

ayahs.text: keh do kay : " aey meri qoam kay logo ! tum apney tareeqay per amal kiye jao , mein ( apney tareeqay per ) amal ker raha hun , phir unqareeb tumhen pata chal jaye ga
ayahs.translation: keh do kay : " aey meri qoam kay logo ! tum apney tareeqay per amal kiye jao , mein ( apney tareeqay per ) amal ker raha hun , phir unqareeb tumhen pata chal jaye ga

ayahs.text: kay kiss per woh azab aata hai jo ussay ruswa ker kay rakh dey ga , aur kiss per woh azab nazil hota hai jo hamesha jamm ker rahey ga .
ayahs.translation: kay kiss per woh azab aata hai jo ussay ruswa ker kay rakh dey ga , aur kiss per woh azab nazil hota hai jo hamesha jamm ker rahey ga .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney logon  kay faeeday kay liye tum per yeh kitab bar-haq nazil ki hai . abb jo shaks raah-e-raast per aajaye ga , woh apni hi bhalai kay liye aaye ga , aur jo gumrahi ikhtiyar keray ga , woh apni gumrahi say apna hi nuqsan keray ga , aur tum uss kay zimma daar nahi ho .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney logon  kay faeeday kay liye tum per yeh kitab bar-haq nazil ki hai . abb jo shaks raah-e-raast per aajaye ga , woh apni hi bhalai kay liye aaye ga , aur jo gumrahi ikhtiyar keray ga , woh apni gumrahi say apna hi nuqsan keray ga , aur tum uss kay zimma daar nahi ho .

ayahs.text: Allah tamam roohon ko unn ki moat kay waqt qabz kerleta hai , aur jinn ko abhi moat nahi aai hoti , unn ko bhi unn ki neend ki halat mein ( qabz kerleta hai , ) phir jinn kay baaray mein uss ney moat ka faisla kerliya , unhen apney paas rok leta hai , aur doosri roohon ko aik moyyan waqt tak kay liye chorr deta hai .   yaqeenan iss baat mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo ghor o fiker say kaam letay hain .
ayahs.translation: Allah tamam roohon ko unn ki moat kay waqt qabz kerleta hai , aur jinn ko abhi moat nahi aai hoti , unn ko bhi unn ki neend ki halat mein ( qabz kerleta hai , ) phir jinn kay baaray mein uss ney moat ka faisla kerliya , unhen apney paas rok leta hai , aur doosri roohon ko aik moyyan waqt tak kay liye chorr deta hai .   yaqeenan iss baat mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo ghor o fiker say kaam letay hain .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya inn logon  ney Allah ( ki ijazat ) kay baghair kuch sirfarishi gharr rakhay hain-? ( inn say ) kaho kay :  chahye yeh naa koi ikhtiyar rakhtay hon , naa kuch samajhtay hon ( phir bhi tum unhen sirfarishi mantay raho gay-? )
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya inn logon  ney Allah ( ki ijazat ) kay baghair kuch sirfarishi gharr rakhay hain-? ( inn say ) kaho kay :  chahye yeh naa koi ikhtiyar rakhtay hon , naa kuch samajhtay hon ( phir bhi tum unhen sirfarishi mantay raho gay-? )

ayahs.text: kaho kay : " sifarish to sari ki sari Allah hi kay ikhtiyar mein hai . ussi kay qabazay mein aasmano aur zameen ki badshahi hai , phir ussi ki taraf tumhen lotaya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: kaho kay : " sifarish to sari ki sari Allah hi kay ikhtiyar mein hai . ussi kay qabazay mein aasmano aur zameen ki badshahi hai , phir ussi ki taraf tumhen lotaya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur jab kabhi tanha Allah ka ziker kiya jata hai to jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , unn kay dil beyzar hojatay hain , aur jab uss kay siwa doosron ka ziker kiya jata hai to yeh log khushi say khil uthtay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jab kabhi tanha Allah ka ziker kiya jata hai to jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , unn kay dil beyzar hojatay hain , aur jab uss kay siwa doosron ka ziker kiya jata hai to yeh log khushi say khil uthtay hain .

ayahs.text: kaho : " aey Allah ! aey aasmano aur zameen ko peda kernay walay , her ghaeeb o hazir kay janney walay ! tu hi apney bandon kay darmiyan unn baaton ka faisla keray ga jinn mein woh ikhtilaf kertay rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: kaho : " aey Allah ! aey aasmano aur zameen ko peda kernay walay , her ghaeeb o hazir kay janney walay ! tu hi apney bandon kay darmiyan unn baaton ka faisla keray ga jinn mein woh ikhtilaf kertay rahey hain .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney zulm ka irtikab kiya hai , agar unn kay paas woh sabb kuch ho jo zameen mein hai , aur uss kay sath itna hi aur bhi , to qayamat kay din badd tareen azab say bachnay kay liye woh sabb fidya kay tor per denay lagen gay , aur Allah ki taraf say woh kuch unn kay samney aajaye ga jiss ka unhen gumaan bhi nahi tha ,
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney zulm ka irtikab kiya hai , agar unn kay paas woh sabb kuch ho jo zameen mein hai , aur uss kay sath itna hi aur bhi , to qayamat kay din badd tareen azab say bachnay kay liye woh sabb fidya kay tor per denay lagen gay , aur Allah ki taraf say woh kuch unn kay samney aajaye ga jiss ka unhen gumaan bhi nahi tha ,

ayahs.text: unhon ney jo kamai ki thi , uss ki buraiyan unn kay samney zahir hojayen gi , aur jinn baaton ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay , woh unhen chaaron taraf say gher len gi .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney jo kamai ki thi , uss ki buraiyan unn kay samney zahir hojayen gi , aur jinn baaton ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay , woh unhen chaaron taraf say gher len gi .

ayahs.text: phir   insan ( ka haal yeh hai kay jab uss ) ko koi takleef choo jati hai to woh hamen pukarta hai , uss kay baad jab hum ussay apni taraf say kissi naimat say nawaztay hain to woh kehta hai kay : " yeh to mujhay ( apney ) hunar ki wajeh say mili hai .   nahi ! balkay yeh aazmaesh hai , lekin inn mein say aksar log nahi jantay .
ayahs.translation: phir   insan ( ka haal yeh hai kay jab uss ) ko koi takleef choo jati hai to woh hamen pukarta hai , uss kay baad jab hum ussay apni taraf say kissi naimat say nawaztay hain to woh kehta hai kay : " yeh to mujhay ( apney ) hunar ki wajeh say mili hai .   nahi ! balkay yeh aazmaesh hai , lekin inn mein say aksar log nahi jantay .

ayahs.text: yehi baat inn say pehlay ( kuch ) logon  ney bhi kahi thi ,   nateeja yeh huwa kay jo kuch woh kamatay thay , woh unn kay kaam nahi aaya ,
ayahs.translation: yehi baat inn say pehlay ( kuch ) logon  ney bhi kahi thi ,   nateeja yeh huwa kay jo kuch woh kamatay thay , woh unn kay kaam nahi aaya ,

ayahs.text: aur unhon ney jo kamai ki thi , uss ki buraiyan unhi per aa parren , aur inn ( arab kay ) logon  mein say jinhon ney zulm ka irtikab kiya hai , unn ki kamai ki buraiyan bhi unqareeb unn per aa parren gi , aur yeh ( Allah ) ko aajiz nahi ker-saktay .
ayahs.translation: aur unhon ney jo kamai ki thi , uss ki buraiyan unhi per aa parren , aur inn ( arab kay ) logon  mein say jinhon ney zulm ka irtikab kiya hai , unn ki kamai ki buraiyan bhi unqareeb unn per aa parren gi , aur yeh ( Allah ) ko aajiz nahi ker-saktay .

ayahs.text: aur kiya enhen yeh maloom nahi hai kay Allah jiss kay liye chahta hai , rizq mein wusat ker deta hai , aur wohi tangi bhi ker deta hai-? yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo emaan latay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur kiya enhen yeh maloom nahi hai kay Allah jiss kay liye chahta hai , rizq mein wusat ker deta hai , aur wohi tangi bhi ker deta hai-? yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo emaan latay hain .

ayahs.text: keh do kay : " aey meray woh bando ! jinhon ney apni janon per ziyadti ker rakhi hai , Allah ki rehmat say mayyus naa ho . yaqeen jano Allah saray kay saray gunah moaaf ker deta hai .   yaqeenan woh boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay : " aey meray woh bando ! jinhon ney apni janon per ziyadti ker rakhi hai , Allah ki rehmat say mayyus naa ho . yaqeen jano Allah saray kay saray gunah moaaf ker deta hai .   yaqeenan woh boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: aur tum apney perwerdigar say lo lagao , aur uss kay farmanbardar ban jao qabal iss kay kay tumharay paas azab aa phonchay , phir tumhari madad nahi ki jaye gi .
ayahs.translation: aur tum apney perwerdigar say lo lagao , aur uss kay farmanbardar ban jao qabal iss kay kay tumharay paas azab aa phonchay , phir tumhari madad nahi ki jaye gi .

ayahs.text: aur tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say tumharay paas jo behtareen baaten nazil ki gaee hain , unn ki perwi kero , qabal iss kay kay tum per achanak azab aajaye , aur tumhen pata bhi naa chalay ,
ayahs.translation: aur tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say tumharay paas jo behtareen baaten nazil ki gaee hain , unn ki perwi kero , qabal iss kay kay tum per achanak azab aajaye , aur tumhen pata bhi naa chalay ,

ayahs.text: kahen aisa naa ho kay kissi shaks ko yeh kehna parray kay : " haaye afsos meri uss kotahi per jo mein ney Allah kay moamlay mein barti ! aur sachi baat yeh hai kay mein to ( Allah taalaa kay ehkaam ka ) mazaq uraney walon mein shamil hogaya tha .
ayahs.translation: kahen aisa naa ho kay kissi shaks ko yeh kehna parray kay : " haaye afsos meri uss kotahi per jo mein ney Allah kay moamlay mein barti ! aur sachi baat yeh hai kay mein to ( Allah taalaa kay ehkaam ka ) mazaq uraney walon mein shamil hogaya tha .

ayahs.text: ya koi yeh kahey kay :  agar mujhay Allah hidayat deta to mein bhi muttaqi logon  mein shamil hota .
ayahs.translation: ya koi yeh kahey kay :  agar mujhay Allah hidayat deta to mein bhi muttaqi logon  mein shamil hota .

ayahs.text: ya jab azab aankhon say dekh ley to yeh kahey kay : " kaash mujhay aik martaba wapis janey ka moaqa mil jaye to mein naik logon  mein shamil hojaon !
ayahs.translation: ya jab azab aankhon say dekh ley to yeh kahey kay : " kaash mujhay aik martaba wapis janey ka moaqa mil jaye to mein naik logon  mein shamil hojaon !

ayahs.text: . ( tujhay hidayat ) kiyon nahi ( di gaee-? ) meri aayaten teray paas aa-chuki then , phir tu ney unhen jhutlaya , aur barai kay ghamand mein parr-gaya , aur kafiron mein shamil raha .
ayahs.translation: . ( tujhay hidayat ) kiyon nahi ( di gaee-? ) meri aayaten teray paas aa-chuki then , phir tu ney unhen jhutlaya , aur barai kay ghamand mein parr-gaya , aur kafiron mein shamil raha .

ayahs.text: aur qayamat kay din tum dekho gay kay jinn logon  ney Allah per jhoot baandha hai , unn kay chehray siyah parray huye hain . kiya jahannum mein aesay mutakabbiron ka thikana nahi hoga-?
ayahs.translation: aur qayamat kay din tum dekho gay kay jinn logon  ney Allah per jhoot baandha hai , unn kay chehray siyah parray huye hain . kiya jahannum mein aesay mutakabbiron ka thikana nahi hoga-?

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya hai , Allah unn ko nijat dey ker unn ki murad ko phoncha dey ga , unhen koi takleef chooay gi bhi nahi , aur naa unhen kissi baat ka ghum hoga .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya hai , Allah unn ko nijat dey ker unn ki murad ko phoncha dey ga , unhen koi takleef chooay gi bhi nahi , aur naa unhen kissi baat ka ghum hoga .

ayahs.text: Allah her cheez ka peda kernay wala hai , aur wohi her cheez ka rakhwala hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah her cheez ka peda kernay wala hai , aur wohi her cheez ka rakhwala hai .

ayahs.text: saray aasmano aur zameen ki kunjiyan ussi kay paas hain , aur jinhon ney Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kiya hai ghatay mein rehney walay wohi hain .
ayahs.translation: saray aasmano aur zameen ki kunjiyan ussi kay paas hain , aur jinhon ney Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kiya hai ghatay mein rehney walay wohi hain .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  kiya phir bhi aey jahilo ! tum mujh say kehtay ho kay Allah kay siwa kissi aur ki ibadat kerun-?
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  kiya phir bhi aey jahilo ! tum mujh say kehtay ho kay Allah kay siwa kissi aur ki ibadat kerun-?

ayahs.text: aur yeh haqeeqat hai kay tum say aur tum say pehlay tamam payghumberon say wahi kay zariye yeh baat keh di gaee thi kay agar tum ney shirk ka irtikab kiya to tumhara kiya keraya sabb gharat hojaye ga , aur tum yaqeeni tor per sakht nuqsan uthaney walon mein shamil hojao gay .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh haqeeqat hai kay tum say aur tum say pehlay tamam payghumberon say wahi kay zariye yeh baat keh di gaee thi kay agar tum ney shirk ka irtikab kiya to tumhara kiya keraya sabb gharat hojaye ga , aur tum yaqeeni tor per sakht nuqsan uthaney walon mein shamil hojao gay .

ayahs.text: lehaza uss kay bajaye tum Allah hi ki ibadat kero , aur shukar guzaar logon  mein shamil hojao .
ayahs.translation: lehaza uss kay bajaye tum Allah hi ki ibadat kero , aur shukar guzaar logon  mein shamil hojao .

ayahs.text: aur inn logon  ney Allah taalaa ki qadar hi nahi pehchani jaisa kay uss ki qadar pehchanney ka haq tha , halankay poori ki poori zameen qayamat kay din uss ki mutthi mein hogi , aur saray kay saray aasman uss kay dayen haath mein liptay huye hon gay . woh pak hai , aur boht baala o bartar uss shirk say jiss ka irtikab yeh log ker rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: aur inn logon  ney Allah taalaa ki qadar hi nahi pehchani jaisa kay uss ki qadar pehchanney ka haq tha , halankay poori ki poori zameen qayamat kay din uss ki mutthi mein hogi , aur saray kay saray aasman uss kay dayen haath mein liptay huye hon gay . woh pak hai , aur boht baala o bartar uss shirk say jiss ka irtikab yeh log ker rahey hain .

ayahs.text: aur soor phoonka jaye ga to aasmano aur zameen mein jitney hain , woh sabb bey hosh hojayen gay , siwaye uss kay jissay Allah chahye . phir doosri baar phoonka jaye ga to woh sabb log pal bhar mein kharray ho ker dekhney lagen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur soor phoonka jaye ga to aasmano aur zameen mein jitney hain , woh sabb bey hosh hojayen gay , siwaye uss kay jissay Allah chahye . phir doosri baar phoonka jaye ga to woh sabb log pal bhar mein kharray ho ker dekhney lagen gay .

ayahs.text: aur zameen apney perwerdigar kay noor say chamak uthay gi , aur nama aemal samney rakh diya jaye ga , aur anbiya aur sabb gawahon ko hazir kerdiya jaye ga , aur logon  kay darmiyan bilkul bar-haq faisla kiya jaye ga , aur unn per koi zulm nahi hoga .
ayahs.translation: aur zameen apney perwerdigar kay noor say chamak uthay gi , aur nama aemal samney rakh diya jaye ga , aur anbiya aur sabb gawahon ko hazir kerdiya jaye ga , aur logon  kay darmiyan bilkul bar-haq faisla kiya jaye ga , aur unn per koi zulm nahi hoga .

ayahs.text: aur her shaks ko uss kay amal ka poora poora badla diya jaye ga , aur jo kuch log kertay hain , Allah ussay khoob janta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur her shaks ko uss kay amal ka poora poora badla diya jaye ga , aur jo kuch log kertay hain , Allah ussay khoob janta hai .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya tha , unhen jahannum ki taraf girohon ki shakal mein haanka jaye ga , yahan tak kay jab woh uss kay paas phonch jayen gay to uss kay darwazay kholay jayen gay , aur uss kay mohafiz unn say kahen gay kay :  kiya tumharay paas tumharay apney logon  mein say payghumber nahi aaye thay jo tumhen tumharay rab ki aayaten parh ker sunatay hon , aur tumhen iss din ka samna kernay say khabar daar kertay hon-?  woh kahen gay kay :  beyshak aaye thay , lekin azab ki baat kafiron per sachi ho ker rahi .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya tha , unhen jahannum ki taraf girohon ki shakal mein haanka jaye ga , yahan tak kay jab woh uss kay paas phonch jayen gay to uss kay darwazay kholay jayen gay , aur uss kay mohafiz unn say kahen gay kay :  kiya tumharay paas tumharay apney logon  mein say payghumber nahi aaye thay jo tumhen tumharay rab ki aayaten parh ker sunatay hon , aur tumhen iss din ka samna kernay say khabar daar kertay hon-?  woh kahen gay kay :  beyshak aaye thay , lekin azab ki baat kafiron per sachi ho ker rahi .

ayahs.text: kaha jaye ga kay :  jahannum kay darwazon mein hamesha hamesha rehney kay liye dakhil hojao , kiyonkay boht bura thikana hai unn ka jo takabbur say kaam letay hain .
ayahs.translation: kaha jaye ga kay :  jahannum kay darwazon mein hamesha hamesha rehney kay liye dakhil hojao , kiyonkay boht bura thikana hai unn ka jo takabbur say kaam letay hain .

ayahs.text: aur jinhon ney apney perwerdigar say taqwa ka moamla rakha tha unhen jannat ki taraf girohon ki shakal mein ley jaya jaye ga , yahan tak kay jab woh uss kay paas phonchen gay , jabkay uss kay darwazay unn kay liye pehlay say kholay jaa chukay hon gay , ( to woh ajeeb aalam hoga . ) aur uss kay mohafiz unn say kahen gay kay :  salam ho aap per , khoob rahey aap log ! abb iss jannat mein hamesha hamesha rehney kay liye aa jaiye .
ayahs.translation: aur jinhon ney apney perwerdigar say taqwa ka moamla rakha tha unhen jannat ki taraf girohon ki shakal mein ley jaya jaye ga , yahan tak kay jab woh uss kay paas phonchen gay , jabkay uss kay darwazay unn kay liye pehlay say kholay jaa chukay hon gay , ( to woh ajeeb aalam hoga . ) aur uss kay mohafiz unn say kahen gay kay :  salam ho aap per , khoob rahey aap log ! abb iss jannat mein hamesha hamesha rehney kay liye aa jaiye .

ayahs.text: aur woh ( jannati ) kahen gay kay :  tamam tarr shukar Allah ka hai jiss ney hum say apney waday ko sacha ker dikhaya , aur hamen iss sarzameen ka aisa waris bana diya kay hum jannat mein jahan chahen apna thikana bana len . sabit huwa kay behtareen inaam ( naik ) amal kernay walon ka hai .
ayahs.translation: aur woh ( jannati ) kahen gay kay :  tamam tarr shukar Allah ka hai jiss ney hum say apney waday ko sacha ker dikhaya , aur hamen iss sarzameen ka aisa waris bana diya kay hum jannat mein jahan chahen apna thikana bana len . sabit huwa kay behtareen inaam ( naik ) amal kernay walon ka hai .

ayahs.text: aur tum farishton ko dekho gay kay arsh kay gird halqa banaye huye apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh ker rahey hon gay , aur logon  kay darmiyan bar-haq faisla kerdiya jaye ga , aur kehney walay kahen gay kay :  tamam tarr tareef Allah ki hai jo saray jahano ka perwerdigar hai .
ayahs.translation: aur tum farishton ko dekho gay kay arsh kay gird halqa banaye huye apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh ker rahey hon gay , aur logon  kay darmiyan bar-haq faisla kerdiya jaye ga , aur kehney walay kahen gay kay :  tamam tarr tareef Allah ki hai jo saray jahano ka perwerdigar hai .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: Haa-Meem
verses.translation: Haa-Meem

verses.text: yeh kitab Allah ki taraf say utaari jaa rahi hai jo bara sahib-e-aqtidaar , baray ilm ka malik hai ,
verses.translation: yeh kitab Allah ki taraf say utaari jaa rahi hai jo bara sahib-e-aqtidaar , baray ilm ka malik hai ,

verses.text: jo gunah ko moaaf kernay wala , tauba qubool kernay wala , sakht saza denay wala , bari taqat ka malik hai . uss kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi . ussi ki taraf sabb ko loat ker jana hai .
verses.translation: jo gunah ko moaaf kernay wala , tauba qubool kernay wala , sakht saza denay wala , bari taqat ka malik hai . uss kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi . ussi ki taraf sabb ko loat ker jana hai .

verses.text: Allah ki aayaton mein jhagray wohi log peda kertay hain jinhon ney kufr apna liya hai . lehaza inn logon  ka shehron mein dandanatay phirna tumhen dhokay mein naa daalay .
verses.translation: Allah ki aayaton mein jhagray wohi log peda kertay hain jinhon ney kufr apna liya hai . lehaza inn logon  ka shehron mein dandanatay phirna tumhen dhokay mein naa daalay .

verses.text: inn say pehlay nooh ki qoam aur unn kay baad boht say girohon ney bhi ( payghumberon ko ) jhutlaya tha , aur her qoam ney apney payghumber kay baaray mein yeh irada kiya tha kay unhen girftaar kerlay , aur unhon ney batil ka sahara ley ker jhagray kiye thay takay uss kay zariye haq ko mita den . nateeja yeh huwa kay mein ney unn ko pakar mein ley liya . abb ( dekh lo kay ) meri saza kissi ( sakht ) thi ?
verses.translation: inn say pehlay nooh ki qoam aur unn kay baad boht say girohon ney bhi ( payghumberon ko ) jhutlaya tha , aur her qoam ney apney payghumber kay baaray mein yeh irada kiya tha kay unhen girftaar kerlay , aur unhon ney batil ka sahara ley ker jhagray kiye thay takay uss kay zariye haq ko mita den . nateeja yeh huwa kay mein ney unn ko pakar mein ley liya . abb ( dekh lo kay ) meri saza kissi ( sakht ) thi ?

verses.text: aur issi tarah jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay baaray mein tumharay perwerdigar ki yeh baat bhi pakki hochuki hai kay woh dozakhi log hain .
verses.translation: aur issi tarah jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay baaray mein tumharay perwerdigar ki yeh baat bhi pakki hochuki hai kay woh dozakhi log hain .

verses.text: woh ( farishtay ) jo arsh ko uthaye huye hain , aur jo uss kay gird mojood hain , woh sabb apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh kertay rehtay hain , aur uss per emaan rakhtay hain , aur jo log emaan ley ayen hain unn kay liye maghfirat ki dua kertay hain ( kay ) :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! teri rehmat aur ilm her cheez per hawi hai , iss liye jinn logon  ney tauba kerli hai , aur teray raastay per chal parray hain , unn ki bakhshish farma dey , aur unhen dozakh kay azab say bacha ley .
verses.translation: woh ( farishtay ) jo arsh ko uthaye huye hain , aur jo uss kay gird mojood hain , woh sabb apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh kertay rehtay hain , aur uss per emaan rakhtay hain , aur jo log emaan ley ayen hain unn kay liye maghfirat ki dua kertay hain ( kay ) :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! teri rehmat aur ilm her cheez per hawi hai , iss liye jinn logon  ney tauba kerli hai , aur teray raastay per chal parray hain , unn ki bakhshish farma dey , aur unhen dozakh kay azab say bacha ley .

verses.text: aur aey perwerdigar ! unhen hamesha rehney wali unn jannaton mein dakhil farma jiss ka tu ney unn say wada kiya hai . neez unn kay maa baap aur biwi bacchon mein say jo naik hon , unhen bhi . yaqeenan teri aur sirf teri zaat woh hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .
verses.translation: aur aey perwerdigar ! unhen hamesha rehney wali unn jannaton mein dakhil farma jiss ka tu ney unn say wada kiya hai . neez unn kay maa baap aur biwi bacchon mein say jo naik hon , unhen bhi . yaqeenan teri aur sirf teri zaat woh hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .

verses.text: aur unn ko her tarah ki buraiyon say mehfooz rakh .   aur uss din jissay tu ney buraiyon say mehfooz kerliya , uss per tu ney bara reham farmaya . aur yehi zabardast kamiyabi hai .
verses.translation: aur unn ko her tarah ki buraiyon say mehfooz rakh .   aur uss din jissay tu ney buraiyon say mehfooz kerliya , uss per tu ney bara reham farmaya . aur yehi zabardast kamiyabi hai .

verses.text: jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya hai , unn say pukar ker kaha jaye ga kay :  ( aaj ) tumhen jitni beyzari apney aap say ho rahi hai ,   uss say ziyada beyzari Allah ko uss waqt hoti thi jab tumhen emaan ki dawat di jati thi , aur tum inkar kertay thay .
verses.translation: jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya hai , unn say pukar ker kaha jaye ga kay :  ( aaj ) tumhen jitni beyzari apney aap say ho rahi hai ,   uss say ziyada beyzari Allah ko uss waqt hoti thi jab tumhen emaan ki dawat di jati thi , aur tum inkar kertay thay .

verses.text: woh kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! tu ney hamen do martaba moat di ,   aur do martaba zindagi di , abb hum apney gunahon ka aetraaf kertay hain , to kiya ( humaray dozakh say ) nikalney ka koi raasta hai-?
verses.translation: woh kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! tu ney hamen do martaba moat di ,   aur do martaba zindagi di , abb hum apney gunahon ka aetraaf kertay hain , to kiya ( humaray dozakh say ) nikalney ka koi raasta hai-?

verses.text: . ( jawab diya jaye ga kay : )  tumhari yeh halat iss liye hai kay jab Allah ko tanha pukara jata tha to tum inkar kertay thay , aur agar uss kay sath kissi aur ko shareek thehraya jata tha to tum maan letay thay . abb to faisla Allah hi ka hai jiss ki shaan boht oonchi , jiss ki zaat boht bari hai .
verses.translation: . ( jawab diya jaye ga kay : )  tumhari yeh halat iss liye hai kay jab Allah ko tanha pukara jata tha to tum inkar kertay thay , aur agar uss kay sath kissi aur ko shareek thehraya jata tha to tum maan letay thay . abb to faisla Allah hi ka hai jiss ki shaan boht oonchi , jiss ki zaat boht bari hai .

verses.text: wohi hai jo tumhen apni nishaniyan dikhata , aur tumharay liye aasman say rizq utaarta hai . aur naseehat to wohi maana kerta hai jo ( hidayat kay liye ) dil say rujoo ho .
verses.translation: wohi hai jo tumhen apni nishaniyan dikhata , aur tumharay liye aasman say rizq utaarta hai . aur naseehat to wohi maana kerta hai jo ( hidayat kay liye ) dil say rujoo ho .

verses.text: lehaza ( aey logo ! ) Allah ko iss tarah pukaro kay tumhari tabeydaari khalis ussi kay liye ho , chahye kafiron ko kitna bura lagay .
verses.translation: lehaza ( aey logo ! ) Allah ko iss tarah pukaro kay tumhari tabeydaari khalis ussi kay liye ho , chahye kafiron ko kitna bura lagay .

verses.text: woh oonchay darjon wala , arsh ka malik hai . woh apney bandon mai say jiss per chahta hai apney hukum say rooh ( yani wahi ) nazil ker deta hai takay mulaqat kay uss din say ( logon  ko ) khabrdar keray
verses.translation: woh oonchay darjon wala , arsh ka malik hai . woh apney bandon mai say jiss per chahta hai apney hukum say rooh ( yani wahi ) nazil ker deta hai takay mulaqat kay uss din say ( logon  ko ) khabrdar keray

verses.text: jiss din woh sabb khul ker samney aajayen gay , Allah say unn ki koi cheez posheeda nahi hogi . ( kaha-jaye ga : )  kiss ki badshahi hai aaj-?  ( jawab aik hi hoga kay : )  sirf Allah ki jo wahid o qahaar hai .
verses.translation: jiss din woh sabb khul ker samney aajayen gay , Allah say unn ki koi cheez posheeda nahi hogi . ( kaha-jaye ga : )  kiss ki badshahi hai aaj-?  ( jawab aik hi hoga kay : )  sirf Allah ki jo wahid o qahaar hai .

verses.text: aaj kay din her shaks ko uss kay kiye ka badla diya jaye ga . aaj koi zulm nahi hoga . yaqeenan Allah boht jald hisab lenay wala hai .
verses.translation: aaj kay din her shaks ko uss kay kiye ka badla diya jaye ga . aaj koi zulm nahi hoga . yaqeenan Allah boht jald hisab lenay wala hai .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) inn logon  ko aik aesi museebat kay din say darao jo qareeb aaney wali hai , jab logon  kay kalejay ghutt ghutt ker mun ko aajayen gay , zalimon ka naa koi dost hoga , aur naa koi aisa sirfarishi jiss ki baat maani jaye .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) inn logon  ko aik aesi museebat kay din say darao jo qareeb aaney wali hai , jab logon  kay kalejay ghutt ghutt ker mun ko aajayen gay , zalimon ka naa koi dost hoga , aur naa koi aisa sirfarishi jiss ki baat maani jaye .

verses.text: Allah aankhon ki chori ko bhi janta hai , aur unn baaton ko bhi jinn ko seenon ney chupa rakha hai .
verses.translation: Allah aankhon ki chori ko bhi janta hai , aur unn baaton ko bhi jinn ko seenon ney chupa rakha hai .

verses.text: aur Allah bar-haq faislay kerta hai , aur ussay chorr ker jinn ( jhootay khudaon ) ko yeh pukartay hain , woh kissi cheez ka faisla nahi ker-saktay . yaqeenan Allah hi hai jo her baat sunta , sabb kuch dekhta hai .
verses.translation: aur Allah bar-haq faislay kerta hai , aur ussay chorr ker jinn ( jhootay khudaon ) ko yeh pukartay hain , woh kissi cheez ka faisla nahi ker-saktay . yaqeenan Allah hi hai jo her baat sunta , sabb kuch dekhta hai .

verses.text: aur kiya inn logon  ney zameen mein chal phir ker yeh nahi dekha kay jo log inn say pehlay thay , unn ka kaisa anjam hochuka hai . woh taqat mein bhi inn say ziyada mazboot thay , aur zameen mein chorri hoi yaadgaaron kay aetbar say bhi . phir Allah ney unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say unhen pakar mein ley liya , aur koi nahi tha jo unhen Allah say bachaye .
verses.translation: aur kiya inn logon  ney zameen mein chal phir ker yeh nahi dekha kay jo log inn say pehlay thay , unn ka kaisa anjam hochuka hai . woh taqat mein bhi inn say ziyada mazboot thay , aur zameen mein chorri hoi yaadgaaron kay aetbar say bhi . phir Allah ney unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say unhen pakar mein ley liya , aur koi nahi tha jo unhen Allah say bachaye .

verses.text: yeh sabb kuch iss liye huwa kay unn kay paas unn kay payghumber khuli khuli daleelen ley ker aatay thay , to yeh inkar kertay thay , iss liye Allah ney unhen pakar mein liya . yaqeenan woh bari quooat wala , saza denay mein bara sakht hai .
verses.translation: yeh sabb kuch iss liye huwa kay unn kay paas unn kay payghumber khuli khuli daleelen ley ker aatay thay , to yeh inkar kertay thay , iss liye Allah ney unhen pakar mein liya . yaqeenan woh bari quooat wala , saza denay mein bara sakht hai .

verses.text: aur hum ney musa ko apni nishaniyon aur bari wazeh daleel dey ker firon , hamaan aur qaroon kay paas bheja tha ,
verses.translation: aur hum ney musa ko apni nishaniyon aur bari wazeh daleel dey ker firon , hamaan aur qaroon kay paas bheja tha ,

verses.text: to unhon ney kaha kay yeh jhoota jadoogar hai .
verses.translation: to unhon ney kaha kay yeh jhoota jadoogar hai .

verses.text: phir jab woh logon  kay paas woh haq baat ley ker gaye jo humari taraf say aai thi   to unhon ney kaha kay :  jo log unn kay sath emaan ley aaye hain , unn kay beton ko qatal ker daalo , aur unn ki aurton ko zinda rakho .  halankay kafiron ki chaal ka anjam iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay woh maqsad tak naa phonch saken .
verses.translation: phir jab woh logon  kay paas woh haq baat ley ker gaye jo humari taraf say aai thi   to unhon ney kaha kay :  jo log unn kay sath emaan ley aaye hain , unn kay beton ko qatal ker daalo , aur unn ki aurton ko zinda rakho .  halankay kafiron ki chaal ka anjam iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay woh maqsad tak naa phonch saken .

verses.text: aur firon ney kaha :  lao mein musa ko qatal hi ker daalun , aur ussay chahiye kay apney rab ko pukar ley . mujhay darr hai kay yeh tumhara deen badal daalay ga , ya zameen mein fasad barpa kerday ga .
verses.translation: aur firon ney kaha :  lao mein musa ko qatal hi ker daalun , aur ussay chahiye kay apney rab ko pukar ley . mujhay darr hai kay yeh tumhara deen badal daalay ga , ya zameen mein fasad barpa kerday ga .

verses.text: aur musa ney kaha :  mein ney to her uss mutakabbir say jo yoam-e-hisab per emaan nahi rakhta , uss ki panah ley li hai jo mera bhi perwerdigar hai aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar .
verses.translation: aur musa ney kaha :  mein ney to her uss mutakabbir say jo yoam-e-hisab per emaan nahi rakhta , uss ki panah ley li hai jo mera bhi perwerdigar hai aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar .

verses.text: aur firon kay khandan mein say aik momin shaks jo abhi tak apna emaan chupaye huye tha ,   bol utha kay :  kiya tum aik shaks ko sirf iss liye qatal ker rahey ho kay woh kehta hai mera perwerdigar Allah hai-? halankay woh tumharay paas tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say roshan daleelen ley ker aaya hai . aur agar woh jhoota hi ho to uss ka jhoot ussi per parray ga ,   aur agar sacha ho to jiss cheez say woh tumhen dara raha hai , uss mein say kuch to tum per aa hi parray gi . Allah kissi aesay shaks ko hidayat nahi deta jo hadd say guzar janey wala ( aur ) jhoot bolney ka aadi ho .
verses.translation: aur firon kay khandan mein say aik momin shaks jo abhi tak apna emaan chupaye huye tha ,   bol utha kay :  kiya tum aik shaks ko sirf iss liye qatal ker rahey ho kay woh kehta hai mera perwerdigar Allah hai-? halankay woh tumharay paas tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say roshan daleelen ley ker aaya hai . aur agar woh jhoota hi ho to uss ka jhoot ussi per parray ga ,   aur agar sacha ho to jiss cheez say woh tumhen dara raha hai , uss mein say kuch to tum per aa hi parray gi . Allah kissi aesay shaks ko hidayat nahi deta jo hadd say guzar janey wala ( aur ) jhoot bolney ka aadi ho .

verses.text: aey meri qoam ! aaj to tumhen aesi saltanat hasil hai kay zameen mein tumhara raj hai , lekin agar Allah ka azab hum per aagaya to kon hai jo uss kay muqablay mein humari madad keray-?  firon ney kaha :  mein to tumhen wohi raye dun ga jissay mein durust samajhta hun , aur mein tumhari jo rehnumai ker raha hun , woh bilkul theek raastay ki taraf ker raha hun .
verses.translation: aey meri qoam ! aaj to tumhen aesi saltanat hasil hai kay zameen mein tumhara raj hai , lekin agar Allah ka azab hum per aagaya to kon hai jo uss kay muqablay mein humari madad keray-?  firon ney kaha :  mein to tumhen wohi raye dun ga jissay mein durust samajhta hun , aur mein tumhari jo rehnumai ker raha hun , woh bilkul theek raastay ki taraf ker raha hun .

verses.text: aur jo shaks emaan ley aaya tha uss ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! mujhay darr hai kay tum per wesa hi din naa aajaye jaisa boht say girohon per aa-chuka hai .
verses.translation: aur jo shaks emaan ley aaya tha uss ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! mujhay darr hai kay tum per wesa hi din naa aajaye jaisa boht say girohon per aa-chuka hai .

verses.text: . ( aur tumhara haal bhi wesa naa ho ) jaisa haal nooh ( aleh-assalam ) ki qoam ka , aur aad o samood ka aur unn kay baad kay logon  ka huwa tha . aur Allah bandon per zulm kerna nahi chahta .
verses.translation: . ( aur tumhara haal bhi wesa naa ho ) jaisa haal nooh ( aleh-assalam ) ki qoam ka , aur aad o samood ka aur unn kay baad kay logon  ka huwa tha . aur Allah bandon per zulm kerna nahi chahta .

verses.text: aur aey meri qoam ! mujhay tum per uss din ka khof hai jiss mein cheekh pukar machi hogi ,
verses.translation: aur aey meri qoam ! mujhay tum per uss din ka khof hai jiss mein cheekh pukar machi hogi ,

verses.text: jiss din tum peeth pher ker iss tarah bhago gay kay koi bhi tumhen Allah say bachaney wala nahi hoga , aur jissay Allah bhatka dey , ussay koi raasta dikhaney wala moyassar nahi aata .
verses.translation: jiss din tum peeth pher ker iss tarah bhago gay kay koi bhi tumhen Allah say bachaney wala nahi hoga , aur jissay Allah bhatka dey , ussay koi raasta dikhaney wala moyassar nahi aata .

verses.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay iss say pehlay yousuf ( aleh-assalam ) tumharay paas roshan daleelen ley ker aaye thay ,   tab bhi tum unn ki laee hoi baaton kay mutalliq shak mein parray rahey . phir jab woh wafaat paagaye to tum ney kaha kay unn kay baad Allah abb koi payghumber nahi bhejay ga .   issi tarah Allah unn tamam logon  ko gumrahi mein daalay rakhta hai jo hadd say guzray huye , shakki hotay hain ,

verses.text: jo apney paas kissi wazeh daleel kay aaye baghair Allah ki aayaton mein jhagray nikala kertay hain . yeh baat Allah kay nazdeek bhi qabil-e-nafrat hai , aur unn logon  kay nazdeek bhi jo emaan ley aaye hain . issi tarah Allah her mutakabbir jabir shaks kay dil per mohar laga deta hai .
verses.translation: jo apney paas kissi wazeh daleel kay aaye baghair Allah ki aayaton mein jhagray nikala kertay hain . yeh baat Allah kay nazdeek bhi qabil-e-nafrat hai , aur unn logon  kay nazdeek bhi jo emaan ley aaye hain . issi tarah Allah her mutakabbir jabir shaks kay dil per mohar laga deta hai .

verses.text: aur firon ney ( apney wazir say ) kaha kay :  aey hamaan ! meray liye aik oonchi imarat bana do , takay mein unn raaston tak phonchun

verses.text: jo aasmano kay raastay hain , phir mein musa kay khuda ko jhank ker dekhun .   aur yaqeen rakho kay mein to ussay jhoota hi samajhta hun .  issi tarah firon ki badd kiradaari uss ki nazar mein khushnuma bana di gaee thi , aur ussay raastay say rok diya gaya tha .   aur firon ki koi chaal aesi nahi thi jo barbadi mein naa gaee ho .
verses.translation: jo aasmano kay raastay hain , phir mein musa kay khuda ko jhank ker dekhun .   aur yaqeen rakho kay mein to ussay jhoota hi samajhta hun .  issi tarah firon ki badd kiradaari uss ki nazar mein khushnuma bana di gaee thi , aur ussay raastay say rok diya gaya tha .   aur firon ki koi chaal aesi nahi thi jo barbadi mein naa gaee ho .

verses.text: aur jo shaks emaan ley aaya tha uss ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! meri baat maano , mein tumhen hidayat kay raastay per ley jaon ga .
verses.translation: aur jo shaks emaan ley aaya tha uss ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! meri baat maano , mein tumhen hidayat kay raastay per ley jaon ga .

verses.text: aey meri qoam ! yeh dunyawi zindagi to bus thora saa maza hai , aur yaqeen jano kay aakhirat hi rehney basney ka asal ghar hai .
verses.translation: aey meri qoam ! yeh dunyawi zindagi to bus thora saa maza hai , aur yaqeen jano kay aakhirat hi rehney basney ka asal ghar hai .

verses.text: aur jiss shaks ney koi burai ki hogi , ussay ussi kay barabar badla diya jaye ga , aur jiss ney naik kaam kiya hoga , chahye woh mard ho ya aurat , jabkay woh momin ho , to aesay log jannat mein dakhil hon gay . wahan unhen bey hisab rizq diya jaye ga .
verses.translation: aur jiss shaks ney koi burai ki hogi , ussay ussi kay barabar badla diya jaye ga , aur jiss ney naik kaam kiya hoga , chahye woh mard ho ya aurat , jabkay woh momin ho , to aesay log jannat mein dakhil hon gay . wahan unhen bey hisab rizq diya jaye ga .

verses.text: aur aey meri qoam ! yeh kiya baat hai kay mein tumhen nijat ki taraf dawat dey raha hun , aur tum mujhay aag ki taraf bula rahey ho ?
verses.translation: aur aey meri qoam ! yeh kiya baat hai kay mein tumhen nijat ki taraf dawat dey raha hun , aur tum mujhay aag ki taraf bula rahey ho ?

verses.text: tum mujhay yeh dawat dey rahey ho kay Allah ka inkar kerun , aur uss kay sath aesi cheezon ko shareek maanun jinn kay baaray mein mujhay koi ilm nahi hai , aur mein tumhen uss zaat ki taraf bula raha hun jo bari sahab-e-iqtidar , boht bakhshney wali hai .
verses.translation: tum mujhay yeh dawat dey rahey ho kay Allah ka inkar kerun , aur uss kay sath aesi cheezon ko shareek maanun jinn kay baaray mein mujhay koi ilm nahi hai , aur mein tumhen uss zaat ki taraf bula raha hun jo bari sahab-e-iqtidar , boht bakhshney wali hai .

verses.text: sach to yeh hai kay jinn cheezon ki taraf tum mujhay bula rahey ho , woh kisi dawat kay ehal nahi hain , naa duniya mein , naa aakhirat mein ,   aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum sabb ko Allah ki taraf palat ker jana hai , aur yeh kay jo log hadd say guzarney walay hain , woh aag kay baasi hain .
verses.translation: sach to yeh hai kay jinn cheezon ki taraf tum mujhay bula rahey ho , woh kisi dawat kay ehal nahi hain , naa duniya mein , naa aakhirat mein ,   aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum sabb ko Allah ki taraf palat ker jana hai , aur yeh kay jo log hadd say guzarney walay hain , woh aag kay baasi hain .

verses.text: gharz tum unqareeb meri yeh baaten yaad kero gay jo mein tum say keh raha hun , aur mein apna moamla Allah kay supurd kerta hun . yaqeenan Allah saray bandon ko khoob dekhney wala hai .
verses.translation: gharz tum unqareeb meri yeh baaten yaad kero gay jo mein tum say keh raha hun , aur mein apna moamla Allah kay supurd kerta hun . yaqeenan Allah saray bandon ko khoob dekhney wala hai .

verses.text: nateeja yeh huwa kay unn logon  ney jo buray buray mansoobay bana rakhay thay , Allah ney uss ( mard-e-momin ) ko unn sabb say mehfooz rakha , aur firon kay logon  ko badd tareen azab ney aa ghera .
verses.translation: nateeja yeh huwa kay unn logon  ney jo buray buray mansoobay bana rakhay thay , Allah ney uss ( mard-e-momin ) ko unn sabb say mehfooz rakha , aur firon kay logon  ko badd tareen azab ney aa ghera .

verses.text: aag hai jiss kay samney unhen subha o shaam paish kiya jata hai ,   aur jiss din qayamat aajaye gi , ( uss din hukum hoga kay : )  firon kay logon  ko sakht tareen azab mein dakhil kerdo .
verses.translation: aag hai jiss kay samney unhen subha o shaam paish kiya jata hai ,   aur jiss din qayamat aajaye gi , ( uss din hukum hoga kay : )  firon kay logon  ko sakht tareen azab mein dakhil kerdo .

verses.text: aur uss waqt ( ka dhiyan rakho ) jab yeh log dozakh mein aik doosray say jhagarr rahey hon gay , chunacheh jo ( duniya mein ) kamzor thay , woh unn logon  say kahen gay jo baray banay huye thay kay :  hum to tumharay peechay chalney walay log thay , to kiya tum aag ka kuch hissa humaray badlay khud ley lo gay ?
verses.translation: aur uss waqt ( ka dhiyan rakho ) jab yeh log dozakh mein aik doosray say jhagarr rahey hon gay , chunacheh jo ( duniya mein ) kamzor thay , woh unn logon  say kahen gay jo baray banay huye thay kay :  hum to tumharay peechay chalney walay log thay , to kiya tum aag ka kuch hissa humaray badlay khud ley lo gay ?

verses.text: woh jo baray banay huye thay , kahen gay kay :  hum sabb hi iss dozakh mein hain . Allah tamam bandon kay darmiyan faisla ker-chuka hai .
verses.translation: woh jo baray banay huye thay , kahen gay kay :  hum sabb hi iss dozakh mein hain . Allah tamam bandon kay darmiyan faisla ker-chuka hai .

verses.text: aur yeh sabb jo aag mein parray hon gay , dozakh kay nigranon say kahen gay kay :  apney perwerdigar say dua kero kay woh kissi din hum say azab ko halka kerday .
verses.translation: aur yeh sabb jo aag mein parray hon gay , dozakh kay nigranon say kahen gay kay :  apney perwerdigar say dua kero kay woh kissi din hum say azab ko halka kerday .

verses.text: woh kahen gay kay :  kiya tumharay paas tumharay payghumber khuli khuli nishaniyan ley ker aatay nahi rahey thay-?  dozakhi jawab den gay kay :  beyshak ( aatay to rahey thay . )  woh kahen gay :  phir to tum hi dua kero , aur kafiron ki dua ka koi anjam ikarat janey kay siwa nahi hai .
verses.translation: woh kahen gay kay :  kiya tumharay paas tumharay payghumber khuli khuli nishaniyan ley ker aatay nahi rahey thay-?  dozakhi jawab den gay kay :  beyshak ( aatay to rahey thay . )  woh kahen gay :  phir to tum hi dua kero , aur kafiron ki dua ka koi anjam ikarat janey kay siwa nahi hai .

verses.text: yaqeen rakho kay hum apney payghumberon aur emaan laney walon ki dunyawi zindagi mein bhi madad kertay hain , aur uss din bhi keren gay jab gawahi denay walay kharray hon gay ,
verses.translation: yaqeen rakho kay hum apney payghumberon aur emaan laney walon ki dunyawi zindagi mein bhi madad kertay hain , aur uss din bhi keren gay jab gawahi denay walay kharray hon gay ,

verses.text: jiss din zalimon ko unn ki maazrat kuch bhi faeeda nahi dey gi , aur unn kay hissay mein phitkaar hogi , aur unn kay liye rehaeesh ki bad-tareen jagah .
verses.translation: jiss din zalimon ko unn ki maazrat kuch bhi faeeda nahi dey gi , aur unn kay hissay mein phitkaar hogi , aur unn kay liye rehaeesh ki bad-tareen jagah .

verses.text: aur hum ney musa ko hidayat ata ki , aur bani Israel ko uss kitab ka waris banaya
verses.translation: aur hum ney musa ko hidayat ata ki , aur bani Israel ko uss kitab ka waris banaya

verses.text: jo aqal walon kay liye sarapa hidayat aur naseehat thi .
verses.translation: jo aqal walon kay liye sarapa hidayat aur naseehat thi .

verses.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) sabar say kaam lo , yaqeen rakho kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , aur apney qusoor per astaghfaar kertay raho ,   aur subha o shaam apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath tasbeeh kertay raho .
verses.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) sabar say kaam lo , yaqeen rakho kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , aur apney qusoor per astaghfaar kertay raho ,   aur subha o shaam apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath tasbeeh kertay raho .

verses.text: yaqeen jano kay jo log Allah ki aayaton kay baaray mein jhagray nikaltay hain , jabkay unn kay paas ( apney daway ki ) koi sanad nahi aai , unn kay seenon mein aur kuch nahi , balkay uss barai ka aik ghamand hai jiss tak woh kabhi phonchney walay nahi hain .   lehaza tum Allah ki panah maango . yaqeenan wohi hai jo her baat sunney wala , sabb kuch dekhney wala hai .
verses.translation: yaqeen jano kay jo log Allah ki aayaton kay baaray mein jhagray nikaltay hain , jabkay unn kay paas ( apney daway ki ) koi sanad nahi aai , unn kay seenon mein aur kuch nahi , balkay uss barai ka aik ghamand hai jiss tak woh kabhi phonchney walay nahi hain .   lehaza tum Allah ki panah maango . yaqeenan wohi hai jo her baat sunney wala , sabb kuch dekhney wala hai .

verses.text: yaqeeni baat hai kay aasmano aur zameen ka peda kerna insanon kay peda kernay say ziyada bara kaam hai , lekin aksar log ( itni si baat ) nahi samajhtay .
verses.translation: yaqeeni baat hai kay aasmano aur zameen ka peda kerna insanon kay peda kernay say ziyada bara kaam hai , lekin aksar log ( itni si baat ) nahi samajhtay .

verses.text: aur andha aur beenai rakhney wala dono barabar nahi hotay , aur naa woh log jo emaan laye , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye , woh aur bad-kaar barabar hain , ( lekin ) tum log boht kam dhiyan detay ho .
verses.translation: aur andha aur beenai rakhney wala dono barabar nahi hotay , aur naa woh log jo emaan laye , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye , woh aur bad-kaar barabar hain , ( lekin ) tum log boht kam dhiyan detay ho .

verses.text: yaqeen rakho kay qayamat ki gharri zaroor aaney wali hai , jiss mein kissi shak ki gunjaeesh nahi hai , lekin aksar log emaan nahi latay .
verses.translation: yaqeen rakho kay qayamat ki gharri zaroor aaney wali hai , jiss mein kissi shak ki gunjaeesh nahi hai , lekin aksar log emaan nahi latay .

verses.text: aur tumharay perwerdigar ney kaha hai kay :  mujhay pukaro , mein tumhari duayen qubool kerun ga , beyshak jo log takabbur ki bana per meri ibadat say mun morrtay hain , woh zaleel ho ker jahannum mein dakhil hon gay .
verses.translation: aur tumharay perwerdigar ney kaha hai kay :  mujhay pukaro , mein tumhari duayen qubool kerun ga , beyshak jo log takabbur ki bana per meri ibadat say mun morrtay hain , woh zaleel ho ker jahannum mein dakhil hon gay .

verses.text: Allah hi to hai jiss ney tumharay liye raat banai , takay tum uss mein sukoon hasil kero , aur din ko dekhney wala banaya . haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah logon  per fazal farmaney wala hai , lekin aksar log shukar ada nahi kertay .
verses.translation: Allah hi to hai jiss ney tumharay liye raat banai , takay tum uss mein sukoon hasil kero , aur din ko dekhney wala banaya . haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah logon  per fazal farmaney wala hai , lekin aksar log shukar ada nahi kertay .

verses.text: woh hai Allah jo tumhara perwerdigar hai , her cheez ka peda kernay wala . uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . phir kahan say koi cheez tumhen ondha chala deti hai ?
verses.translation: woh hai Allah jo tumhara perwerdigar hai , her cheez ka peda kernay wala . uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . phir kahan say koi cheez tumhen ondha chala deti hai ?

verses.text: issi tarah woh log bhi ondhay chalay thay jo ( pehlay ) Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: issi tarah woh log bhi ondhay chalay thay jo ( pehlay ) Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: Allah hi to hai jiss ney tumharay liye zameen ko qarar ki jagah banaya , aur aasman ko aik gunmbad , aur tumhari soorat giri ki , aur tumhari soorton ko acha banaya , aur pakeezah cheezon mein say tumhen rizq ata kiya . woh hai Allah jo tumhara perwerdigar hai . gharz bari barkat wala hai Allah , saray jahano ka perwerdigar !
verses.translation: Allah hi to hai jiss ney tumharay liye zameen ko qarar ki jagah banaya , aur aasman ko aik gunmbad , aur tumhari soorat giri ki , aur tumhari soorton ko acha banaya , aur pakeezah cheezon mein say tumhen rizq ata kiya . woh hai Allah jo tumhara perwerdigar hai . gharz bari barkat wala hai Allah , saray jahano ka perwerdigar !

verses.text: wohi sada zinda hai , uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi . iss liye uss ko iss tarah pukaro kay tumhari tabey daari khalis ussi kay liye ho . tamam tareefen Allah kay liye hain jo saray jahano ka perwerdigar hai .
verses.translation: wohi sada zinda hai , uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi . iss liye uss ko iss tarah pukaro kay tumhari tabey daari khalis ussi kay liye ho . tamam tareefen Allah kay liye hain jo saray jahano ka perwerdigar hai .

verses.text: wohi hai jo zindagi deta aur moat deta hai . aur jab woh kissi kaam ka faisla kerleta hai to uss say sirf itna kehta hai kay :  hoja  bus woh hojata hai .
verses.translation: wohi hai jo zindagi deta aur moat deta hai . aur jab woh kissi kaam ka faisla kerleta hai to uss say sirf itna kehta hai kay :  hoja  bus woh hojata hai .

verses.translation: phir unn say kaha jaye ga :  kahan hain Allah kay siwa woh ( tumharay mabood ) jinhen tum khudai mein uss ka shareek maana kertay thay-?

verses.translation: . ( inn say yeh pehlay hi keh diya gaya hoga kay : )  yeh sabb kuch iss liye huwa kay tum zameen mein nahaq baat per itraya kertay thay , aur iss liye kay tum akarr dikhatay thay .
