verses.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum sabar say kaam lo . yaqeen rakho kay Allah ka wada sacha hai . abb hum inn ( kafiron ko ) jiss ( azab ) say dara rahey hain , chahye uss ka kuch hissa hum tumhen bhi ( tumhari zindagi mein ) dikhla den , ya tumhen duniya say utha len , bahar-soorat inn ko humaray paas hi wapis laya jaye ga .
verses.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum sabar say kaam lo . yaqeen rakho kay Allah ka wada sacha hai . abb hum inn ( kafiron ko ) jiss ( azab ) say dara rahey hain , chahye uss ka kuch hissa hum tumhen bhi ( tumhari zindagi mein ) dikhla den , ya tumhen duniya say utha len , bahar-soorat inn ko humaray paas hi wapis laya jaye ga .

verses.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney tum say pehlay bhi boht say payghumber bhejay hain . unn mein say kuch woh hain jinn kay waqiyaat hum ney tumhen bata diye hain , aur kuch woh hain jinn kay waqiyaat hum ney tumhen nahi bataye . aur kissi payghumber ko yeh ikhtiyar nahi hai kay woh Allah ki ijazat kay baghair koi moajza ley aaye .   phir jab Allah ka hukum aaye ga to sachai ka faisla hojaye ga , aur jo log batil ki perwi ker rahey hain , woh uss moaqa per sakht nuqsan uthayen gay .
verses.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney tum say pehlay bhi boht say payghumber bhejay hain . unn mein say kuch woh hain jinn kay waqiyaat hum ney tumhen bata diye hain , aur kuch woh hain jinn kay waqiyaat hum ney tumhen nahi bataye . aur kissi payghumber ko yeh ikhtiyar nahi hai kay woh Allah ki ijazat kay baghair koi moajza ley aaye .   phir jab Allah ka hukum aaye ga to sachai ka faisla hojaye ga , aur jo log batil ki perwi ker rahey hain , woh uss moaqa per sakht nuqsan uthayen gay .

verses.text: Allah woh hai jiss ney tumharay liye maweshi peda kiye , takay unn mein say kuch per tum sawari kero , aur unhi mein say woh bhi hain jinhen tum khatay ho .
verses.translation: Allah woh hai jiss ney tumharay liye maweshi peda kiye , takay unn mein say kuch per tum sawari kero , aur unhi mein say woh bhi hain jinhen tum khatay ho .

verses.text: aur tumharay liye unn mein boht say faeeday hain , aur unn ka maqsad yeh bhi hai kay tumharay dilon mein ( kahen janey ki ) jo hajat ho uss tak phonch sako . aur tumhen unn janweron per aur kashtiyon per utha kerlay jaya jata hai .
verses.translation: aur tumharay liye unn mein boht say faeeday hain , aur unn ka maqsad yeh bhi hai kay tumharay dilon mein ( kahen janey ki ) jo hajat ho uss tak phonch sako . aur tumhen unn janweron per aur kashtiyon per utha kerlay jaya jata hai .

verses.text: aur Allah tumhen apni nishaniyan dikha raha hai , phir tum Allah ki kinn kinn nishaniyon ka inkar kero gay ?
verses.translation: aur Allah tumhen apni nishaniyan dikha raha hai , phir tum Allah ki kinn kinn nishaniyon ka inkar kero gay ?

verses.text: bhala kiya unhon ney zameen mein chal phir ker nahi dekha kay unn say pehlay jo log thay , unn ka anjam kaisa huwa ? woh inn say tadaad mein ziyada thay , aur taqat mein bhi inn say barhay huye thay , aur unn yaadgaaron mein bhi jo woh zameen mein chorr ker gaye hain . phir bhi jo kuch woh kamatay thay , woh unn kay kuch kaam nahi aaya .
verses.translation: bhala kiya unhon ney zameen mein chal phir ker nahi dekha kay unn say pehlay jo log thay , unn ka anjam kaisa huwa ? woh inn say tadaad mein ziyada thay , aur taqat mein bhi inn say barhay huye thay , aur unn yaadgaaron mein bhi jo woh zameen mein chorr ker gaye hain . phir bhi jo kuch woh kamatay thay , woh unn kay kuch kaam nahi aaya .

verses.text: chunacheh jab unn kay payghumber unn kay paas khuli khuli daleelen ley ker aaye , tab bhi woh apney uss ilm per hi naaz kertay rahey jo unn kay paas tha , aur jiss cheez ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay , ussi ney unn ko aa ghera .
verses.translation: chunacheh jab unn kay payghumber unn kay paas khuli khuli daleelen ley ker aaye , tab bhi woh apney uss ilm per hi naaz kertay rahey jo unn kay paas tha , aur jiss cheez ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay , ussi ney unn ko aa ghera .

verses.text: phir jab unhon ney humara azab aankhon say dekh liya to uss waqt kaha kay :  hum khudaye wahid per emaan ley aaye , aur unn sabb ka hum ney inkar kerdiya jinn ko hum Allah kay sath shareek thehraya kertay thay .
verses.translation: phir jab unhon ney humara azab aankhon say dekh liya to uss waqt kaha kay :  hum khudaye wahid per emaan ley aaye , aur unn sabb ka hum ney inkar kerdiya jinn ko hum Allah kay sath shareek thehraya kertay thay .

verses.text: lekin jab humara azab unhon ney dekh liya tha to uss kay baad unn ka emaan lana unhen faeeda nahi phoncha sakta tha . khabar daar raho kay Allah taalaa ka yehi mamool hai jo uss kay bandon mein pehlay say chala aata hai . aur uss moaqa per kafiron ney sakht nuqsan uthaya .
verses.translation: lekin jab humara azab unhon ney dekh liya tha to uss kay baad unn ka emaan lana unhen faeeda nahi phoncha sakta tha . khabar daar raho kay Allah taalaa ka yehi mamool hai jo uss kay bandon mein pehlay say chala aata hai . aur uss moaqa per kafiron ney sakht nuqsan uthaya .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: Haa-Meem
ayahs.translation: Haa-Meem

ayahs.text: yeh kitab Allah ki taraf say utaari jaa rahi hai jo bara sahib-e-aqtidaar , baray ilm ka malik hai ,
ayahs.translation: yeh kitab Allah ki taraf say utaari jaa rahi hai jo bara sahib-e-aqtidaar , baray ilm ka malik hai ,

ayahs.text: jo gunah ko moaaf kernay wala , tauba qubool kernay wala , sakht saza denay wala , bari taqat ka malik hai . uss kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi . ussi ki taraf sabb ko loat ker jana hai .
ayahs.translation: jo gunah ko moaaf kernay wala , tauba qubool kernay wala , sakht saza denay wala , bari taqat ka malik hai . uss kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi . ussi ki taraf sabb ko loat ker jana hai .

ayahs.text: Allah ki aayaton mein jhagray wohi log peda kertay hain jinhon ney kufr apna liya hai . lehaza inn logon  ka shehron mein dandanatay phirna tumhen dhokay mein naa daalay .
ayahs.translation: Allah ki aayaton mein jhagray wohi log peda kertay hain jinhon ney kufr apna liya hai . lehaza inn logon  ka shehron mein dandanatay phirna tumhen dhokay mein naa daalay .

ayahs.text: inn say pehlay nooh ki qoam aur unn kay baad boht say girohon ney bhi ( payghumberon ko ) jhutlaya tha , aur her qoam ney apney payghumber kay baaray mein yeh irada kiya tha kay unhen girftaar kerlay , aur unhon ney batil ka sahara ley ker jhagray kiye thay takay uss kay zariye haq ko mita den . nateeja yeh huwa kay mein ney unn ko pakar mein ley liya . abb ( dekh lo kay ) meri saza kissi ( sakht ) thi ?
ayahs.translation: inn say pehlay nooh ki qoam aur unn kay baad boht say girohon ney bhi ( payghumberon ko ) jhutlaya tha , aur her qoam ney apney payghumber kay baaray mein yeh irada kiya tha kay unhen girftaar kerlay , aur unhon ney batil ka sahara ley ker jhagray kiye thay takay uss kay zariye haq ko mita den . nateeja yeh huwa kay mein ney unn ko pakar mein ley liya . abb ( dekh lo kay ) meri saza kissi ( sakht ) thi ?

ayahs.text: aur issi tarah jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay baaray mein tumharay perwerdigar ki yeh baat bhi pakki hochuki hai kay woh dozakhi log hain .
ayahs.translation: aur issi tarah jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay baaray mein tumharay perwerdigar ki yeh baat bhi pakki hochuki hai kay woh dozakhi log hain .

ayahs.text: woh ( farishtay ) jo arsh ko uthaye huye hain , aur jo uss kay gird mojood hain , woh sabb apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh kertay rehtay hain , aur uss per emaan rakhtay hain , aur jo log emaan ley ayen hain unn kay liye maghfirat ki dua kertay hain ( kay ) :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! teri rehmat aur ilm her cheez per hawi hai , iss liye jinn logon  ney tauba kerli hai , aur teray raastay per chal parray hain , unn ki bakhshish farma dey , aur unhen dozakh kay azab say bacha ley .
ayahs.translation: woh ( farishtay ) jo arsh ko uthaye huye hain , aur jo uss kay gird mojood hain , woh sabb apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh kertay rehtay hain , aur uss per emaan rakhtay hain , aur jo log emaan ley ayen hain unn kay liye maghfirat ki dua kertay hain ( kay ) :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! teri rehmat aur ilm her cheez per hawi hai , iss liye jinn logon  ney tauba kerli hai , aur teray raastay per chal parray hain , unn ki bakhshish farma dey , aur unhen dozakh kay azab say bacha ley .

ayahs.text: aur aey perwerdigar ! unhen hamesha rehney wali unn jannaton mein dakhil farma jiss ka tu ney unn say wada kiya hai . neez unn kay maa baap aur biwi bacchon mein say jo naik hon , unhen bhi . yaqeenan teri aur sirf teri zaat woh hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .
ayahs.translation: aur aey perwerdigar ! unhen hamesha rehney wali unn jannaton mein dakhil farma jiss ka tu ney unn say wada kiya hai . neez unn kay maa baap aur biwi bacchon mein say jo naik hon , unhen bhi . yaqeenan teri aur sirf teri zaat woh hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .

ayahs.text: aur unn ko her tarah ki buraiyon say mehfooz rakh .   aur uss din jissay tu ney buraiyon say mehfooz kerliya , uss per tu ney bara reham farmaya . aur yehi zabardast kamiyabi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur unn ko her tarah ki buraiyon say mehfooz rakh .   aur uss din jissay tu ney buraiyon say mehfooz kerliya , uss per tu ney bara reham farmaya . aur yehi zabardast kamiyabi hai .

ayahs.text: jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya hai , unn say pukar ker kaha jaye ga kay :  ( aaj ) tumhen jitni beyzari apney aap say ho rahi hai ,   uss say ziyada beyzari Allah ko uss waqt hoti thi jab tumhen emaan ki dawat di jati thi , aur tum inkar kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya hai , unn say pukar ker kaha jaye ga kay :  ( aaj ) tumhen jitni beyzari apney aap say ho rahi hai ,   uss say ziyada beyzari Allah ko uss waqt hoti thi jab tumhen emaan ki dawat di jati thi , aur tum inkar kertay thay .

ayahs.text: woh kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! tu ney hamen do martaba moat di ,   aur do martaba zindagi di , abb hum apney gunahon ka aetraaf kertay hain , to kiya ( humaray dozakh say ) nikalney ka koi raasta hai-?
ayahs.translation: woh kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! tu ney hamen do martaba moat di ,   aur do martaba zindagi di , abb hum apney gunahon ka aetraaf kertay hain , to kiya ( humaray dozakh say ) nikalney ka koi raasta hai-?

ayahs.text: . ( jawab diya jaye ga kay : )  tumhari yeh halat iss liye hai kay jab Allah ko tanha pukara jata tha to tum inkar kertay thay , aur agar uss kay sath kissi aur ko shareek thehraya jata tha to tum maan letay thay . abb to faisla Allah hi ka hai jiss ki shaan boht oonchi , jiss ki zaat boht bari hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( jawab diya jaye ga kay : )  tumhari yeh halat iss liye hai kay jab Allah ko tanha pukara jata tha to tum inkar kertay thay , aur agar uss kay sath kissi aur ko shareek thehraya jata tha to tum maan letay thay . abb to faisla Allah hi ka hai jiss ki shaan boht oonchi , jiss ki zaat boht bari hai .

ayahs.text: wohi hai jo tumhen apni nishaniyan dikhata , aur tumharay liye aasman say rizq utaarta hai . aur naseehat to wohi maana kerta hai jo ( hidayat kay liye ) dil say rujoo ho .
ayahs.translation: wohi hai jo tumhen apni nishaniyan dikhata , aur tumharay liye aasman say rizq utaarta hai . aur naseehat to wohi maana kerta hai jo ( hidayat kay liye ) dil say rujoo ho .

ayahs.translation: lehaza ( aey logo ! ) Allah ko iss tarah pukaro kay tumhari tabeydaari khalis ussi kay liye ho , chahye kafiron ko kitna bura lagay .

ayahs.text: woh oonchay darjon wala , arsh ka malik hai . woh apney bandon mai say jiss per chahta hai apney hukum say rooh ( yani wahi ) nazil ker deta hai takay mulaqat kay uss din say ( logon  ko ) khabrdar keray

ayahs.text: jiss din woh sabb khul ker samney aajayen gay , Allah say unn ki koi cheez posheeda nahi hogi . ( kaha-jaye ga : )  kiss ki badshahi hai aaj-?  ( jawab aik hi hoga kay : )  sirf Allah ki jo wahid o qahaar hai .
ayahs.translation: jiss din woh sabb khul ker samney aajayen gay , Allah say unn ki koi cheez posheeda nahi hogi . ( kaha-jaye ga : )  kiss ki badshahi hai aaj-?  ( jawab aik hi hoga kay : )  sirf Allah ki jo wahid o qahaar hai .

ayahs.text: aaj kay din her shaks ko uss kay kiye ka badla diya jaye ga . aaj koi zulm nahi hoga . yaqeenan Allah boht jald hisab lenay wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aaj kay din her shaks ko uss kay kiye ka badla diya jaye ga . aaj koi zulm nahi hoga . yaqeenan Allah boht jald hisab lenay wala hai .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) inn logon  ko aik aesi museebat kay din say darao jo qareeb aaney wali hai , jab logon  kay kalejay ghutt ghutt ker mun ko aajayen gay , zalimon ka naa koi dost hoga , aur naa koi aisa sirfarishi jiss ki baat maani jaye .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) inn logon  ko aik aesi museebat kay din say darao jo qareeb aaney wali hai , jab logon  kay kalejay ghutt ghutt ker mun ko aajayen gay , zalimon ka naa koi dost hoga , aur naa koi aisa sirfarishi jiss ki baat maani jaye .

ayahs.text: Allah aankhon ki chori ko bhi janta hai , aur unn baaton ko bhi jinn ko seenon ney chupa rakha hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah aankhon ki chori ko bhi janta hai , aur unn baaton ko bhi jinn ko seenon ney chupa rakha hai .

ayahs.text: aur Allah bar-haq faislay kerta hai , aur ussay chorr ker jinn ( jhootay khudaon ) ko yeh pukartay hain , woh kissi cheez ka faisla nahi ker-saktay . yaqeenan Allah hi hai jo her baat sunta , sabb kuch dekhta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah bar-haq faislay kerta hai , aur ussay chorr ker jinn ( jhootay khudaon ) ko yeh pukartay hain , woh kissi cheez ka faisla nahi ker-saktay . yaqeenan Allah hi hai jo her baat sunta , sabb kuch dekhta hai .

ayahs.text: aur kiya inn logon  ney zameen mein chal phir ker yeh nahi dekha kay jo log inn say pehlay thay , unn ka kaisa anjam hochuka hai . woh taqat mein bhi inn say ziyada mazboot thay , aur zameen mein chorri hoi yaadgaaron kay aetbar say bhi . phir Allah ney unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say unhen pakar mein ley liya , aur koi nahi tha jo unhen Allah say bachaye .
ayahs.translation: aur kiya inn logon  ney zameen mein chal phir ker yeh nahi dekha kay jo log inn say pehlay thay , unn ka kaisa anjam hochuka hai . woh taqat mein bhi inn say ziyada mazboot thay , aur zameen mein chorri hoi yaadgaaron kay aetbar say bhi . phir Allah ney unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say unhen pakar mein ley liya , aur koi nahi tha jo unhen Allah say bachaye .

ayahs.text: yeh sabb kuch iss liye huwa kay unn kay paas unn kay payghumber khuli khuli daleelen ley ker aatay thay , to yeh inkar kertay thay , iss liye Allah ney unhen pakar mein liya . yaqeenan woh bari quooat wala , saza denay mein bara sakht hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh sabb kuch iss liye huwa kay unn kay paas unn kay payghumber khuli khuli daleelen ley ker aatay thay , to yeh inkar kertay thay , iss liye Allah ney unhen pakar mein liya . yaqeenan woh bari quooat wala , saza denay mein bara sakht hai .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney musa ko apni nishaniyon aur bari wazeh daleel dey ker firon , hamaan aur qaroon kay paas bheja tha ,

ayahs.text: to unhon ney kaha kay yeh jhoota jadoogar hai .
ayahs.translation: to unhon ney kaha kay yeh jhoota jadoogar hai .

ayahs.text: phir jab woh logon  kay paas woh haq baat ley ker gaye jo humari taraf say aai thi   to unhon ney kaha kay :  jo log unn kay sath emaan ley aaye hain , unn kay beton ko qatal ker daalo , aur unn ki aurton ko zinda rakho .  halankay kafiron ki chaal ka anjam iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay woh maqsad tak naa phonch saken .
ayahs.translation: phir jab woh logon  kay paas woh haq baat ley ker gaye jo humari taraf say aai thi   to unhon ney kaha kay :  jo log unn kay sath emaan ley aaye hain , unn kay beton ko qatal ker daalo , aur unn ki aurton ko zinda rakho .  halankay kafiron ki chaal ka anjam iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay woh maqsad tak naa phonch saken .

ayahs.text: aur firon ney kaha :  lao mein musa ko qatal hi ker daalun , aur ussay chahiye kay apney rab ko pukar ley . mujhay darr hai kay yeh tumhara deen badal daalay ga , ya zameen mein fasad barpa kerday ga .
ayahs.translation: aur firon ney kaha :  lao mein musa ko qatal hi ker daalun , aur ussay chahiye kay apney rab ko pukar ley . mujhay darr hai kay yeh tumhara deen badal daalay ga , ya zameen mein fasad barpa kerday ga .

ayahs.text: aur musa ney kaha :  mein ney to her uss mutakabbir say jo yoam-e-hisab per emaan nahi rakhta , uss ki panah ley li hai jo mera bhi perwerdigar hai aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar .
ayahs.translation: aur musa ney kaha :  mein ney to her uss mutakabbir say jo yoam-e-hisab per emaan nahi rakhta , uss ki panah ley li hai jo mera bhi perwerdigar hai aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar .

ayahs.text: aur firon kay khandan mein say aik momin shaks jo abhi tak apna emaan chupaye huye tha ,   bol utha kay :  kiya tum aik shaks ko sirf iss liye qatal ker rahey ho kay woh kehta hai mera perwerdigar Allah hai-? halankay woh tumharay paas tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say roshan daleelen ley ker aaya hai . aur agar woh jhoota hi ho to uss ka jhoot ussi per parray ga ,   aur agar sacha ho to jiss cheez say woh tumhen dara raha hai , uss mein say kuch to tum per aa hi parray gi . Allah kissi aesay shaks ko hidayat nahi deta jo hadd say guzar janey wala ( aur ) jhoot bolney ka aadi ho .

ayahs.text: aur firon ney ( apney wazir say ) kaha kay :  aey hamaan ! meray liye aik oonchi imarat bana do , takay mein unn raaston tak phonchun
ayahs.translation: aur firon ney ( apney wazir say ) kaha kay :  aey hamaan ! meray liye aik oonchi imarat bana do , takay mein unn raaston tak phonchun

ayahs.text: jo aasmano kay raastay hain , phir mein musa kay khuda ko jhank ker dekhun .   aur yaqeen rakho kay mein to ussay jhoota hi samajhta hun .  issi tarah firon ki badd kiradaari uss ki nazar mein khushnuma bana di gaee thi , aur ussay raastay say rok diya gaya tha .   aur firon ki koi chaal aesi nahi thi jo barbadi mein naa gaee ho .
ayahs.translation: jo aasmano kay raastay hain , phir mein musa kay khuda ko jhank ker dekhun .   aur yaqeen rakho kay mein to ussay jhoota hi samajhta hun .  issi tarah firon ki badd kiradaari uss ki nazar mein khushnuma bana di gaee thi , aur ussay raastay say rok diya gaya tha .   aur firon ki koi chaal aesi nahi thi jo barbadi mein naa gaee ho .

ayahs.text: aur jo shaks emaan ley aaya tha uss ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! meri baat maano , mein tumhen hidayat kay raastay per ley jaon ga .
ayahs.translation: aur jo shaks emaan ley aaya tha uss ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! meri baat maano , mein tumhen hidayat kay raastay per ley jaon ga .

ayahs.text: aey meri qoam ! yeh dunyawi zindagi to bus thora saa maza hai , aur yaqeen jano kay aakhirat hi rehney basney ka asal ghar hai .
ayahs.translation: aey meri qoam ! yeh dunyawi zindagi to bus thora saa maza hai , aur yaqeen jano kay aakhirat hi rehney basney ka asal ghar hai .

ayahs.text: aur jiss shaks ney koi burai ki hogi , ussay ussi kay barabar badla diya jaye ga , aur jiss ney naik kaam kiya hoga , chahye woh mard ho ya aurat , jabkay woh momin ho , to aesay log jannat mein dakhil hon gay . wahan unhen bey hisab rizq diya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: aur jiss shaks ney koi burai ki hogi , ussay ussi kay barabar badla diya jaye ga , aur jiss ney naik kaam kiya hoga , chahye woh mard ho ya aurat , jabkay woh momin ho , to aesay log jannat mein dakhil hon gay . wahan unhen bey hisab rizq diya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur aey meri qoam ! yeh kiya baat hai kay mein tumhen nijat ki taraf dawat dey raha hun , aur tum mujhay aag ki taraf bula rahey ho ?
ayahs.translation: aur aey meri qoam ! yeh kiya baat hai kay mein tumhen nijat ki taraf dawat dey raha hun , aur tum mujhay aag ki taraf bula rahey ho ?

ayahs.text: tum mujhay yeh dawat dey rahey ho kay Allah ka inkar kerun , aur uss kay sath aesi cheezon ko shareek maanun jinn kay baaray mein mujhay koi ilm nahi hai , aur mein tumhen uss zaat ki taraf bula raha hun jo bari sahab-e-iqtidar , boht bakhshney wali hai .
ayahs.translation: tum mujhay yeh dawat dey rahey ho kay Allah ka inkar kerun , aur uss kay sath aesi cheezon ko shareek maanun jinn kay baaray mein mujhay koi ilm nahi hai , aur mein tumhen uss zaat ki taraf bula raha hun jo bari sahab-e-iqtidar , boht bakhshney wali hai .

ayahs.text: sach to yeh hai kay jinn cheezon ki taraf tum mujhay bula rahey ho , woh kisi dawat kay ehal nahi hain , naa duniya mein , naa aakhirat mein ,   aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum sabb ko Allah ki taraf palat ker jana hai , aur yeh kay jo log hadd say guzarney walay hain , woh aag kay baasi hain .
ayahs.translation: sach to yeh hai kay jinn cheezon ki taraf tum mujhay bula rahey ho , woh kisi dawat kay ehal nahi hain , naa duniya mein , naa aakhirat mein ,   aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum sabb ko Allah ki taraf palat ker jana hai , aur yeh kay jo log hadd say guzarney walay hain , woh aag kay baasi hain .

ayahs.text: gharz tum unqareeb meri yeh baaten yaad kero gay jo mein tum say keh raha hun , aur mein apna moamla Allah kay supurd kerta hun . yaqeenan Allah saray bandon ko khoob dekhney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: gharz tum unqareeb meri yeh baaten yaad kero gay jo mein tum say keh raha hun , aur mein apna moamla Allah kay supurd kerta hun . yaqeenan Allah saray bandon ko khoob dekhney wala hai .

ayahs.text: nateeja yeh huwa kay unn logon  ney jo buray buray mansoobay bana rakhay thay , Allah ney uss ( mard-e-momin ) ko unn sabb say mehfooz rakha , aur firon kay logon  ko badd tareen azab ney aa ghera .
ayahs.translation: nateeja yeh huwa kay unn logon  ney jo buray buray mansoobay bana rakhay thay , Allah ney uss ( mard-e-momin ) ko unn sabb say mehfooz rakha , aur firon kay logon  ko badd tareen azab ney aa ghera .

ayahs.text: aag hai jiss kay samney unhen subha o shaam paish kiya jata hai ,   aur jiss din qayamat aajaye gi , ( uss din hukum hoga kay : )  firon kay logon  ko sakht tareen azab mein dakhil kerdo .
ayahs.translation: aag hai jiss kay samney unhen subha o shaam paish kiya jata hai ,   aur jiss din qayamat aajaye gi , ( uss din hukum hoga kay : )  firon kay logon  ko sakht tareen azab mein dakhil kerdo .

ayahs.text: aur uss waqt ( ka dhiyan rakho ) jab yeh log dozakh mein aik doosray say jhagarr rahey hon gay , chunacheh jo ( duniya mein ) kamzor thay , woh unn logon  say kahen gay jo baray banay huye thay kay :  hum to tumharay peechay chalney walay log thay , to kiya tum aag ka kuch hissa humaray badlay khud ley lo gay ?
ayahs.translation: aur uss waqt ( ka dhiyan rakho ) jab yeh log dozakh mein aik doosray say jhagarr rahey hon gay , chunacheh jo ( duniya mein ) kamzor thay , woh unn logon  say kahen gay jo baray banay huye thay kay :  hum to tumharay peechay chalney walay log thay , to kiya tum aag ka kuch hissa humaray badlay khud ley lo gay ?

ayahs.text: woh jo baray banay huye thay , kahen gay kay :  hum sabb hi iss dozakh mein hain . Allah tamam bandon kay darmiyan faisla ker-chuka hai .
ayahs.translation: woh jo baray banay huye thay , kahen gay kay :  hum sabb hi iss dozakh mein hain . Allah tamam bandon kay darmiyan faisla ker-chuka hai .

ayahs.text: aur yeh sabb jo aag mein parray hon gay , dozakh kay nigranon say kahen gay kay :  apney perwerdigar say dua kero kay woh kissi din hum say azab ko halka kerday .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh sabb jo aag mein parray hon gay , dozakh kay nigranon say kahen gay kay :  apney perwerdigar say dua kero kay woh kissi din hum say azab ko halka kerday .

ayahs.text: woh kahen gay kay :  kiya tumharay paas tumharay payghumber khuli khuli nishaniyan ley ker aatay nahi rahey thay-?  dozakhi jawab den gay kay :  beyshak ( aatay to rahey thay . )  woh kahen gay :  phir to tum hi dua kero , aur kafiron ki dua ka koi anjam ikarat janey kay siwa nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: woh kahen gay kay :  kiya tumharay paas tumharay payghumber khuli khuli nishaniyan ley ker aatay nahi rahey thay-?  dozakhi jawab den gay kay :  beyshak ( aatay to rahey thay . )  woh kahen gay :  phir to tum hi dua kero , aur kafiron ki dua ka koi anjam ikarat janey kay siwa nahi hai .

ayahs.text: yaqeen rakho kay hum apney payghumberon aur emaan laney walon ki dunyawi zindagi mein bhi madad kertay hain , aur uss din bhi keren gay jab gawahi denay walay kharray hon gay ,
ayahs.translation: yaqeen rakho kay hum apney payghumberon aur emaan laney walon ki dunyawi zindagi mein bhi madad kertay hain , aur uss din bhi keren gay jab gawahi denay walay kharray hon gay ,

ayahs.text: jiss din zalimon ko unn ki maazrat kuch bhi faeeda nahi dey gi , aur unn kay hissay mein phitkaar hogi , aur unn kay liye rehaeesh ki bad-tareen jagah .
ayahs.translation: jiss din zalimon ko unn ki maazrat kuch bhi faeeda nahi dey gi , aur unn kay hissay mein phitkaar hogi , aur unn kay liye rehaeesh ki bad-tareen jagah .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney musa ko hidayat ata ki , aur bani Israel ko uss kitab ka waris banaya
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney musa ko hidayat ata ki , aur bani Israel ko uss kitab ka waris banaya

ayahs.text: jo aqal walon kay liye sarapa hidayat aur naseehat thi .
ayahs.translation: jo aqal walon kay liye sarapa hidayat aur naseehat thi .

ayahs.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) sabar say kaam lo , yaqeen rakho kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , aur apney qusoor per astaghfaar kertay raho ,   aur subha o shaam apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath tasbeeh kertay raho .
ayahs.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) sabar say kaam lo , yaqeen rakho kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , aur apney qusoor per astaghfaar kertay raho ,   aur subha o shaam apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath tasbeeh kertay raho .

ayahs.text: yaqeen jano kay jo log Allah ki aayaton kay baaray mein jhagray nikaltay hain , jabkay unn kay paas ( apney daway ki ) koi sanad nahi aai , unn kay seenon mein aur kuch nahi , balkay uss barai ka aik ghamand hai jiss tak woh kabhi phonchney walay nahi hain .   lehaza tum Allah ki panah maango . yaqeenan wohi hai jo her baat sunney wala , sabb kuch dekhney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: yaqeen jano kay jo log Allah ki aayaton kay baaray mein jhagray nikaltay hain , jabkay unn kay paas ( apney daway ki ) koi sanad nahi aai , unn kay seenon mein aur kuch nahi , balkay uss barai ka aik ghamand hai jiss tak woh kabhi phonchney walay nahi hain .   lehaza tum Allah ki panah maango . yaqeenan wohi hai jo her baat sunney wala , sabb kuch dekhney wala hai .

ayahs.text: yaqeeni baat hai kay aasmano aur zameen ka peda kerna insanon kay peda kernay say ziyada bara kaam hai , lekin aksar log ( itni si baat ) nahi samajhtay .
ayahs.translation: yaqeeni baat hai kay aasmano aur zameen ka peda kerna insanon kay peda kernay say ziyada bara kaam hai , lekin aksar log ( itni si baat ) nahi samajhtay .

ayahs.text: aur andha aur beenai rakhney wala dono barabar nahi hotay , aur naa woh log jo emaan laye , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye , woh aur bad-kaar barabar hain , ( lekin ) tum log boht kam dhiyan detay ho .
ayahs.translation: aur andha aur beenai rakhney wala dono barabar nahi hotay , aur naa woh log jo emaan laye , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye , woh aur bad-kaar barabar hain , ( lekin ) tum log boht kam dhiyan detay ho .

ayahs.text: yaqeen rakho kay qayamat ki gharri zaroor aaney wali hai , jiss mein kissi shak ki gunjaeesh nahi hai , lekin aksar log emaan nahi latay .
ayahs.translation: yaqeen rakho kay qayamat ki gharri zaroor aaney wali hai , jiss mein kissi shak ki gunjaeesh nahi hai , lekin aksar log emaan nahi latay .

ayahs.text: aur tumharay perwerdigar ney kaha hai kay :  mujhay pukaro , mein tumhari duayen qubool kerun ga , beyshak jo log takabbur ki bana per meri ibadat say mun morrtay hain , woh zaleel ho ker jahannum mein dakhil hon gay .
ayahs.translation: aur tumharay perwerdigar ney kaha hai kay :  mujhay pukaro , mein tumhari duayen qubool kerun ga , beyshak jo log takabbur ki bana per meri ibadat say mun morrtay hain , woh zaleel ho ker jahannum mein dakhil hon gay .

ayahs.text: Allah hi to hai jiss ney tumharay liye raat banai , takay tum uss mein sukoon hasil kero , aur din ko dekhney wala banaya . haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah logon  per fazal farmaney wala hai , lekin aksar log shukar ada nahi kertay .
ayahs.translation: Allah hi to hai jiss ney tumharay liye raat banai , takay tum uss mein sukoon hasil kero , aur din ko dekhney wala banaya . haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah logon  per fazal farmaney wala hai , lekin aksar log shukar ada nahi kertay .

ayahs.text: woh hai Allah jo tumhara perwerdigar hai , her cheez ka peda kernay wala . uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . phir kahan say koi cheez tumhen ondha chala deti hai ?
ayahs.translation: woh hai Allah jo tumhara perwerdigar hai , her cheez ka peda kernay wala . uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . phir kahan say koi cheez tumhen ondha chala deti hai ?

ayahs.text: issi tarah woh log bhi ondhay chalay thay jo ( pehlay ) Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: issi tarah woh log bhi ondhay chalay thay jo ( pehlay ) Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: Allah hi to hai jiss ney tumharay liye zameen ko qarar ki jagah banaya , aur aasman ko aik gunmbad , aur tumhari soorat giri ki , aur tumhari soorton ko acha banaya , aur pakeezah cheezon mein say tumhen rizq ata kiya . woh hai Allah jo tumhara perwerdigar hai . gharz bari barkat wala hai Allah , saray jahano ka perwerdigar !
ayahs.translation: Allah hi to hai jiss ney tumharay liye zameen ko qarar ki jagah banaya , aur aasman ko aik gunmbad , aur tumhari soorat giri ki , aur tumhari soorton ko acha banaya , aur pakeezah cheezon mein say tumhen rizq ata kiya . woh hai Allah jo tumhara perwerdigar hai . gharz bari barkat wala hai Allah , saray jahano ka perwerdigar !

ayahs.text: wohi sada zinda hai , uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi . iss liye uss ko iss tarah pukaro kay tumhari tabey daari khalis ussi kay liye ho . tamam tareefen Allah kay liye hain jo saray jahano ka perwerdigar hai .
ayahs.translation: wohi sada zinda hai , uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi . iss liye uss ko iss tarah pukaro kay tumhari tabey daari khalis ussi kay liye ho . tamam tareefen Allah kay liye hain jo saray jahano ka perwerdigar hai .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! kafiron say ) keh do kay :  mujhay iss baat say mana kerdiya gaya hai kay jab meray paas meray rab ki taraf say khuli khuli nishaniyan aa chuki hain , to phir bhi mein unn ki ibadat kerun jinhen tum Allah kay bajaye pukartay ho . aur mujhay yeh hukum diya gaya hai kay mein tamam jahano kay perwerdigar kay aagay sar jhuka dun .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! kafiron say ) keh do kay :  mujhay iss baat say mana kerdiya gaya hai kay jab meray paas meray rab ki taraf say khuli khuli nishaniyan aa chuki hain , to phir bhi mein unn ki ibadat kerun jinhen tum Allah kay bajaye pukartay ho . aur mujhay yeh hukum diya gaya hai kay mein tamam jahano kay perwerdigar kay aagay sar jhuka dun .

ayahs.text: wohi hai jiss ney tumhen mitti say peda kiya , phir nutfay say , phir jamay huye khoon say . phir woh tumhen bacchay ki shakal mein bahir lata hai , phir ( woh tumhari perwerish kerta hai ) takay tum apni bharpoor taqat ko phonch jao , aur phir boorhay hojao aur tum mein say kuch woh bhi hain jo iss say pehlay hi wafaat paajatay hain aur takay tum aik muqarrar miyaad tak phoncho , aur takay tum aqal say kaam lo .
ayahs.translation: wohi hai jiss ney tumhen mitti say peda kiya , phir nutfay say , phir jamay huye khoon say . phir woh tumhen bacchay ki shakal mein bahir lata hai , phir ( woh tumhari perwerish kerta hai ) takay tum apni bharpoor taqat ko phonch jao , aur phir boorhay hojao aur tum mein say kuch woh bhi hain jo iss say pehlay hi wafaat paajatay hain aur takay tum aik muqarrar miyaad tak phoncho , aur takay tum aqal say kaam lo .

ayahs.text: wohi hai jo zindagi deta aur moat deta hai . aur jab woh kissi kaam ka faisla kerleta hai to uss say sirf itna kehta hai kay :  hoja  bus woh hojata hai .
ayahs.translation: wohi hai jo zindagi deta aur moat deta hai . aur jab woh kissi kaam ka faisla kerleta hai to uss say sirf itna kehta hai kay :  hoja  bus woh hojata hai .

ayahs.text: kiya tum ney unn logon  ko dekha jo Allah ki aayaton mein jhagray nikaltay hain-? koi kahan say unn ka rukh pher deta hai-?
ayahs.translation: kiya tum ney unn logon  ko dekha jo Allah ki aayaton mein jhagray nikaltay hain-? koi kahan say unn ka rukh pher deta hai-?

ayahs.text: yeh log woh hain jinhon ney iss kitab ko bhi jhutlaya hai , aur uss ( taleem ) ko bhi jiss ka hamil bana ker hum ney apney payghumber bhejay thay . chunacheh unhen unqareeb pata lagg jaye ga
ayahs.translation: yeh log woh hain jinhon ney iss kitab ko bhi jhutlaya hai , aur uss ( taleem ) ko bhi jiss ka hamil bana ker hum ney apney payghumber bhejay thay . chunacheh unhen unqareeb pata lagg jaye ga

ayahs.text: jab unn kay galon mein toq aur zanjeeren hon gi , unhen garam paani mein ghaseeta jaye ga ,
ayahs.translation: jab unn kay galon mein toq aur zanjeeren hon gi , unhen garam paani mein ghaseeta jaye ga ,

ayahs.text: phir aag mein jhonk diya jaye ga ,
ayahs.translation: phir aag mein jhonk diya jaye ga ,

ayahs.text: phir unn say kaha jaye ga :  kahan hain Allah kay siwa woh ( tumharay mabood ) jinhen tum khudai mein uss ka shareek maana kertay thay-?
ayahs.translation: phir unn say kaha jaye ga :  kahan hain Allah kay siwa woh ( tumharay mabood ) jinhen tum khudai mein uss ka shareek maana kertay thay-?

ayahs.text: yeh kahen gay :  woh sabb to hum say khoye gaye , balkay hum pehlay kissi cheez ko nahi pukara kertay thay .    iss tarah Allah kafiron ko badd hawaas ker deta hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh kahen gay :  woh sabb to hum say khoye gaye , balkay hum pehlay kissi cheez ko nahi pukara kertay thay .    iss tarah Allah kafiron ko badd hawaas ker deta hai .

ayahs.text: . ( inn say yeh pehlay hi keh diya gaya hoga kay : )  yeh sabb kuch iss liye huwa kay tum zameen mein nahaq baat per itraya kertay thay , aur iss liye kay tum akarr dikhatay thay .
ayahs.translation: . ( inn say yeh pehlay hi keh diya gaya hoga kay : )  yeh sabb kuch iss liye huwa kay tum zameen mein nahaq baat per itraya kertay thay , aur iss liye kay tum akarr dikhatay thay .

ayahs.text: jao , jahannum kay darwazon mein hamesha rehney kay liye dakhil hojao , kiyonkay takabbur kernay walon ka thikana boht hi bura hai .
ayahs.translation: jao , jahannum kay darwazon mein hamesha rehney kay liye dakhil hojao , kiyonkay takabbur kernay walon ka thikana boht hi bura hai .

ayahs.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum sabar say kaam lo . yaqeen rakho kay Allah ka wada sacha hai . abb hum inn ( kafiron ko ) jiss ( azab ) say dara rahey hain , chahye uss ka kuch hissa hum tumhen bhi ( tumhari zindagi mein ) dikhla den , ya tumhen duniya say utha len , bahar-soorat inn ko humaray paas hi wapis laya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum sabar say kaam lo . yaqeen rakho kay Allah ka wada sacha hai . abb hum inn ( kafiron ko ) jiss ( azab ) say dara rahey hain , chahye uss ka kuch hissa hum tumhen bhi ( tumhari zindagi mein ) dikhla den , ya tumhen duniya say utha len , bahar-soorat inn ko humaray paas hi wapis laya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney tum say pehlay bhi boht say payghumber bhejay hain . unn mein say kuch woh hain jinn kay waqiyaat hum ney tumhen bata diye hain , aur kuch woh hain jinn kay waqiyaat hum ney tumhen nahi bataye . aur kissi payghumber ko yeh ikhtiyar nahi hai kay woh Allah ki ijazat kay baghair koi moajza ley aaye .   phir jab Allah ka hukum aaye ga to sachai ka faisla hojaye ga , aur jo log batil ki perwi ker rahey hain , woh uss moaqa per sakht nuqsan uthayen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney tum say pehlay bhi boht say payghumber bhejay hain . unn mein say kuch woh hain jinn kay waqiyaat hum ney tumhen bata diye hain , aur kuch woh hain jinn kay waqiyaat hum ney tumhen nahi bataye . aur kissi payghumber ko yeh ikhtiyar nahi hai kay woh Allah ki ijazat kay baghair koi moajza ley aaye .   phir jab Allah ka hukum aaye ga to sachai ka faisla hojaye ga , aur jo log batil ki perwi ker rahey hain , woh uss moaqa per sakht nuqsan uthayen gay .

ayahs.text: Allah woh hai jiss ney tumharay liye maweshi peda kiye , takay unn mein say kuch per tum sawari kero , aur unhi mein say woh bhi hain jinhen tum khatay ho .
ayahs.translation: Allah woh hai jiss ney tumharay liye maweshi peda kiye , takay unn mein say kuch per tum sawari kero , aur unhi mein say woh bhi hain jinhen tum khatay ho .

ayahs.text: aur tumharay liye unn mein boht say faeeday hain , aur unn ka maqsad yeh bhi hai kay tumharay dilon mein ( kahen janey ki ) jo hajat ho uss tak phonch sako . aur tumhen unn janweron per aur kashtiyon per utha kerlay jaya jata hai .
ayahs.translation: aur tumharay liye unn mein boht say faeeday hain , aur unn ka maqsad yeh bhi hai kay tumharay dilon mein ( kahen janey ki ) jo hajat ho uss tak phonch sako . aur tumhen unn janweron per aur kashtiyon per utha kerlay jaya jata hai .

ayahs.text: aur Allah tumhen apni nishaniyan dikha raha hai , phir tum Allah ki kinn kinn nishaniyon ka inkar kero gay ?
ayahs.translation: aur Allah tumhen apni nishaniyan dikha raha hai , phir tum Allah ki kinn kinn nishaniyon ka inkar kero gay ?

ayahs.text: bhala kiya unhon ney zameen mein chal phir ker nahi dekha kay unn say pehlay jo log thay , unn ka anjam kaisa huwa ? woh inn say tadaad mein ziyada thay , aur taqat mein bhi inn say barhay huye thay , aur unn yaadgaaron mein bhi jo woh zameen mein chorr ker gaye hain . phir bhi jo kuch woh kamatay thay , woh unn kay kuch kaam nahi aaya .
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya unhon ney zameen mein chal phir ker nahi dekha kay unn say pehlay jo log thay , unn ka anjam kaisa huwa ? woh inn say tadaad mein ziyada thay , aur taqat mein bhi inn say barhay huye thay , aur unn yaadgaaron mein bhi jo woh zameen mein chorr ker gaye hain . phir bhi jo kuch woh kamatay thay , woh unn kay kuch kaam nahi aaya .

ayahs.text: chunacheh jab unn kay payghumber unn kay paas khuli khuli daleelen ley ker aaye , tab bhi woh apney uss ilm per hi naaz kertay rahey jo unn kay paas tha , aur jiss cheez ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay , ussi ney unn ko aa ghera .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh jab unn kay payghumber unn kay paas khuli khuli daleelen ley ker aaye , tab bhi woh apney uss ilm per hi naaz kertay rahey jo unn kay paas tha , aur jiss cheez ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay , ussi ney unn ko aa ghera .

ayahs.text: phir jab unhon ney humara azab aankhon say dekh liya to uss waqt kaha kay :  hum khudaye wahid per emaan ley aaye , aur unn sabb ka hum ney inkar kerdiya jinn ko hum Allah kay sath shareek thehraya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: phir jab unhon ney humara azab aankhon say dekh liya to uss waqt kaha kay :  hum khudaye wahid per emaan ley aaye , aur unn sabb ka hum ney inkar kerdiya jinn ko hum Allah kay sath shareek thehraya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: lekin jab humara azab unhon ney dekh liya tha to uss kay baad unn ka emaan lana unhen faeeda nahi phoncha sakta tha . khabar daar raho kay Allah taalaa ka yehi mamool hai jo uss kay bandon mein pehlay say chala aata hai . aur uss moaqa per kafiron ney sakht nuqsan uthaya .
ayahs.translation: lekin jab humara azab unhon ney dekh liya tha to uss kay baad unn ka emaan lana unhen faeeda nahi phoncha sakta tha . khabar daar raho kay Allah taalaa ka yehi mamool hai jo uss kay bandon mein pehlay say chala aata hai . aur uss moaqa per kafiron ney sakht nuqsan uthaya .

verses.text: jo zakat ada nahi kertay ,   aur unn ka haal yeh hai kay aakhirat kay woh bilkul hi munkir hain .
verses.translation: jo zakat ada nahi kertay ,   aur unn ka haal yeh hai kay aakhirat kay woh bilkul hi munkir hain .

verses.text: . ( albatta ) jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn kay liye beyshak aisa ajar hai jiss ka silsila kabhi tootney wala nahi hai .
verses.translation: . ( albatta ) jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn kay liye beyshak aisa ajar hai jiss ka silsila kabhi tootney wala nahi hai .

verses.text: keh do kay :  kiya tum waqaee uss zaat kay sath kufr ka moamla kertay ho jiss ney zameen ko do din mein peda kiya , aur uss kay sath doosron ko shareek thehratay ho-? woh zaat to saray jahano ki perwerish kernay wali hai .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  kiya tum waqaee uss zaat kay sath kufr ka moamla kertay ho jiss ney zameen ko do din mein peda kiya , aur uss kay sath doosron ko shareek thehratay ho-? woh zaat to saray jahano ki perwerish kernay wali hai .

verses.text: aur uss ney zameen mein jamay huye pahar peda kiye jo uss kay oopper ubhray huye hain , aur uss mein barkat daal di ,   aur uss mein tawazun kay sath uss ki ghizayen peda ken sabb kuch chaar din mein   tamam sawal kernay walon kay liye barabar !
verses.translation: aur uss ney zameen mein jamay huye pahar peda kiye jo uss kay oopper ubhray huye hain , aur uss mein barkat daal di ,   aur uss mein tawazun kay sath uss ki ghizayen peda ken sabb kuch chaar din mein   tamam sawal kernay walon kay liye barabar !

verses.text: phir woh aasman ki taraf mutawajjah huwa , jabkay woh uss waqt dhuyen ki shakal mein tha ,   aur uss say aur zameen say kaha :  chalay aao , chahye khushi say ya zabardasti .  dono ney kaha :  hum khushi khushi aatay hain .
verses.translation: phir woh aasman ki taraf mutawajjah huwa , jabkay woh uss waqt dhuyen ki shakal mein tha ,   aur uss say aur zameen say kaha :  chalay aao , chahye khushi say ya zabardasti .  dono ney kaha :  hum khushi khushi aatay hain .

verses.text: chunacheh uss ney do din mein apney faislay kay tehat unn kay saat aasman bana diye , aur her aasman mein uss kay munasib hukum bhej diya .   aur hum ney uss qareeb walay aasman ko chiraghon say sajaya , aur ussay khoob mehfooz kerdiya . yeh uss zaat ki napi tuli mansooba bandi hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ka ilm bhi mukammal .
verses.translation: chunacheh uss ney do din mein apney faislay kay tehat unn kay saat aasman bana diye , aur her aasman mein uss kay munasib hukum bhej diya .   aur hum ney uss qareeb walay aasman ko chiraghon say sajaya , aur ussay khoob mehfooz kerdiya . yeh uss zaat ki napi tuli mansooba bandi hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ka ilm bhi mukammal .

verses.text: phir bhi agar yeh log mun morren to keh do kay :  mein ne tumhen uss karrkay say khabar daar kerdiya hai jaisa karrka aad aur samood per nazil huwa tha .
verses.translation: phir bhi agar yeh log mun morren to keh do kay :  mein ne tumhen uss karrkay say khabar daar kerdiya hai jaisa karrka aad aur samood per nazil huwa tha .

verses.text: yeh uss waqt ki baat hai jab unn kay paas payghumber ( kabhi ) unn kay aagay say aur ( kabhi ) unn kay peechay say   yeh paygham ley ker aaye kay Allah kay siwa kissi cheez ki ibadat naa kero . unhon ney kaha kay :  agar humara perwerdigar chahta to farishtay bhejta . lehaza jiss baat kay sath tumhen bheja gaya hai , hum uss ko manney say inkar kertay hain .
verses.translation: yeh uss waqt ki baat hai jab unn kay paas payghumber ( kabhi ) unn kay aagay say aur ( kabhi ) unn kay peechay say   yeh paygham ley ker aaye kay Allah kay siwa kissi cheez ki ibadat naa kero . unhon ney kaha kay :  agar humara perwerdigar chahta to farishtay bhejta . lehaza jiss baat kay sath tumhen bheja gaya hai , hum uss ko manney say inkar kertay hain .

verses.text: phir aad ka qissa to yeh huwa kay unhon ney zameen mein nahaq takabbur ka ravaiyya ikhtiyar kiya , aur kaha kay :  kon hai jo taqat mein hum say ziyada ho ?  bhala kiya unn ko yeh nahi soojha kay jiss Allah ney unn ko peda kiya hai , woh taqat mein unn say kahen ziyada hai ? aur woh humari aayaton ka inkar kertay rahey .
verses.translation: phir aad ka qissa to yeh huwa kay unhon ney zameen mein nahaq takabbur ka ravaiyya ikhtiyar kiya , aur kaha kay :  kon hai jo taqat mein hum say ziyada ho ?  bhala kiya unn ko yeh nahi soojha kay jiss Allah ney unn ko peda kiya hai , woh taqat mein unn say kahen ziyada hai ? aur woh humari aayaton ka inkar kertay rahey .

verses.text: chunacheh hum ney kuch manhoos dino mein   unn per aandhi ki shakal mein hawa bheji takay unhen dunyawi zindagi mein ruswai kay azab ka maza chakhayen . aur aakhirat ka azab uss say bhi ziyada ruswa kernay wala hai , aur unn ko koi madad moyassar nahi aaye gi .
verses.translation: chunacheh hum ney kuch manhoos dino mein   unn per aandhi ki shakal mein hawa bheji takay unhen dunyawi zindagi mein ruswai kay azab ka maza chakhayen . aur aakhirat ka azab uss say bhi ziyada ruswa kernay wala hai , aur unn ko koi madad moyassar nahi aaye gi .

verses.text: rahey samood , to hum ney unhen seedha raasta dikhaya tha . lekin unhon ney seedha raasta ikhtiyar kernay kay muqablay mein andha rehney ko ziyada pasand kiya , chunacheh unhon ney jo kamai ker rakhi thi , uss ki wajeh say unn ko aesay azab kay karrkay ney aa pakra jo sarapa zillat tha ,
verses.translation: rahey samood , to hum ney unhen seedha raasta dikhaya tha . lekin unhon ney seedha raasta ikhtiyar kernay kay muqablay mein andha rehney ko ziyada pasand kiya , chunacheh unhon ney jo kamai ker rakhi thi , uss ki wajeh say unn ko aesay azab kay karrkay ney aa pakra jo sarapa zillat tha ,

verses.text: aur jo log emaan ley aaye thay , aur taqwa ikhtiyar kiye huye thay , unn ko hum ney nijat dey di .
verses.translation: aur jo log emaan ley aaye thay , aur taqwa ikhtiyar kiye huye thay , unn ko hum ney nijat dey di .

verses.text: aur uss din ka dhiyan rakho jab Allah kay dushmanon ko jama ker kay aag ki taraf ley jaya jaye ga , chunacheh unhen toliyon mein baant diya jaye ga .
verses.translation: aur uss din ka dhiyan rakho jab Allah kay dushmanon ko jama ker kay aag ki taraf ley jaya jaye ga , chunacheh unhen toliyon mein baant diya jaye ga .

verses.text: yahan tak kay jab woh uss ( aag ) kay paas phonch jayen gay to unn kay kaan , unn ki aankhen aur unn ki khalen unn kay khilaf gawahi den gi kay woh kiya kuch kertay rahey hain .
verses.translation: yahan tak kay jab woh uss ( aag ) kay paas phonch jayen gay to unn kay kaan , unn ki aankhen aur unn ki khalen unn kay khilaf gawahi den gi kay woh kiya kuch kertay rahey hain .

verses.text: woh apni khalon say kahen gay kay :  tum ney humaray khilaf kiyon gawahi di . ?  woh kahen gi kay :  hamen ussi zaat ney bolney ki taqat dey di hai jiss ney her cheez ko goyai ata farmaee .  aur wohi hai jiss ney tumhen pehli baar peda kiya tha , aur ussi ki taraf tumhen wapis ley jaya jaa raha hai .
verses.translation: woh apni khalon say kahen gay kay :  tum ney humaray khilaf kiyon gawahi di . ?  woh kahen gi kay :  hamen ussi zaat ney bolney ki taqat dey di hai jiss ney her cheez ko goyai ata farmaee .  aur wohi hai jiss ney tumhen pehli baar peda kiya tha , aur ussi ki taraf tumhen wapis ley jaya jaa raha hai .

verses.text: aur tum ( gunah kertay waqt ) iss baat say to chup hi nahi saktay thay kay tumharay kaan , tumhari aankhen aur tumhari khalen tumharay khilaf gawahi den , lekin tumhara gumaan yeh tha kay Allah ko tumharay boht say aemal ka ilm nahi hai .
verses.translation: aur tum ( gunah kertay waqt ) iss baat say to chup hi nahi saktay thay kay tumharay kaan , tumhari aankhen aur tumhari khalen tumharay khilaf gawahi den , lekin tumhara gumaan yeh tha kay Allah ko tumharay boht say aemal ka ilm nahi hai .

verses.text: apney perwerdigar kay baaray mein tumhara yehi gumaan tha jiss ney tumhen barbad kiya , aur issi kay nateejay mein tum unn logon  mein shamil hogaye jo sarasar khasaray mein hain .
verses.translation: apney perwerdigar kay baaray mein tumhara yehi gumaan tha jiss ney tumhen barbad kiya , aur issi kay nateejay mein tum unn logon  mein shamil hogaye jo sarasar khasaray mein hain .

verses.text: abb inn logon  ka haal yeh hai kay agar yeh sabar keren tab bhi aag hi inn ka thikana hai , aur agar yeh maazrat chahen to yeh unn logon  mein say nahi hain jinn ki maazrat qubool ki jati hai .
verses.translation: abb inn logon  ka haal yeh hai kay agar yeh sabar keren tab bhi aag hi inn ka thikana hai , aur agar yeh maazrat chahen to yeh unn logon  mein say nahi hain jinn ki maazrat qubool ki jati hai .

verses.text: aur hum ney ( duniya mein ) inn per kuch sathi musallat ker-diye thay jinhon ney inn kay aagay peechay kay saray kamon ko khushnuma bana diya tha ,   chunacheh jo doosray jinnaat aur insan inn say pehlay guzar chukay hain , unn kay sath mil ker ( azab ki ) baat inn per bhi sachi hoi . yaqeenan woh sabb khasara uthaney walon mein say hain .
verses.translation: aur hum ney ( duniya mein ) inn per kuch sathi musallat ker-diye thay jinhon ney inn kay aagay peechay kay saray kamon ko khushnuma bana diya tha ,   chunacheh jo doosray jinnaat aur insan inn say pehlay guzar chukay hain , unn kay sath mil ker ( azab ki ) baat inn per bhi sachi hoi . yaqeenan woh sabb khasara uthaney walon mein say hain .

verses.text: aur yeh kafir ( aik doosray say ) kehtay hain kay :  iss Quran ko suno hi nahi , aur iss kay beech mein ghull macha diya kero takay tum hi ghalib raho .

verses.text: iss liye hum inn kafiron ko sakht azab ka maza chakhayen gay , aur yeh ( duniya mein ) jo bad-tareen kaam kiya kertay thay , uss ka poora poora badla den gay .
verses.translation: iss liye hum inn kafiron ko sakht azab ka maza chakhayen gay , aur yeh ( duniya mein ) jo bad-tareen kaam kiya kertay thay , uss ka poora poora badla den gay .

verses.text: yehi hai saza Allah kay dushmanon ki jo aag ki soorat mein hogi . ussi mein unn ka daemi thikana hoga , jo iss baat ka badla hoga kay woh humari aayaton ka inkar kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: yehi hai saza Allah kay dushmanon ki jo aag ki soorat mein hogi . ussi mein unn ka daemi thikana hoga , jo iss baat ka badla hoga kay woh humari aayaton ka inkar kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: aur yeh kafir log kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen unn jinnaat aur insanon dono ki soorat dikhaiye jinhon ney hamen gumrah kiya tha , takay hum unhen apney paon talay aisa ronden kay woh khoob zaleel hon .
verses.translation: aur yeh kafir log kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen unn jinnaat aur insanon dono ki soorat dikhaiye jinhon ney hamen gumrah kiya tha , takay hum unhen apney paon talay aisa ronden kay woh khoob zaleel hon .

verses.text: . ( doosri taraf ) jinn logon  ney kaha hai kay :  humara rab Allah hai  aur phir woh uss per sabit qadam rahey to unn per beyshak farishtay ( yeh kehtay huye ) utren gay kay :  naa koi khof dil mein lao , naa kissi baat ka ghum kero , aur uss jannat say khush hojao jiss ka tum say wada kiya jata tha .

verses.text: yeh sabb kuch uss zaat ki taraf say pehli pehli meyzbani hai jiss ki bakhshish bhi boht hai , jiss ki rehmat bhi kamil .

verses.text: aur uss shaks say behtar baat kiss ki hogi jo Allah ki taraf dawat dey , aur naik amal keray , aur yeh kahey kay mein farmanbardaron mein shamil hun .
verses.translation: aur uss shaks say behtar baat kiss ki hogi jo Allah ki taraf dawat dey , aur naik amal keray , aur yeh kahey kay mein farmanbardaron mein shamil hun .

verses.text: aur naiki aur badi barabar nahi hoti . tum badi ka difaa aesay tareeqay say kero jo behtareen ho .   nateeja yeh hoga kay jiss kay aur tumharay darmiyan dushmani thi , woh dekhtay hi dekhtay aisa hojaye ga jaisay woh ( tumhara ) jigri dost ho .
verses.translation: aur naiki aur badi barabar nahi hoti . tum badi ka difaa aesay tareeqay say kero jo behtareen ho .   nateeja yeh hoga kay jiss kay aur tumharay darmiyan dushmani thi , woh dekhtay hi dekhtay aisa hojaye ga jaisay woh ( tumhara ) jigri dost ho .

verses.text: aur yeh baat sirf unhi ko ata hoti hai jo sabar say kaam letay hain , aur yeh baat ussi ko ata hoti hai jo baray naseebay wala ho .
verses.translation: aur yeh baat sirf unhi ko ata hoti hai jo sabar say kaam letay hain , aur yeh baat ussi ko ata hoti hai jo baray naseebay wala ho .

verses.text: aur agar tumhen shetan ki taraf say kabhi koi kachoka lagay to shetan mardood say Allah ki panah maang liya kero .   beyshak woh her baat sunney wala , her baat janney wala hai .
verses.translation: aur agar tumhen shetan ki taraf say kabhi koi kachoka lagay to shetan mardood say Allah ki panah maang liya kero .   beyshak woh her baat sunney wala , her baat janney wala hai .

verses.text: aur ussi ki nishaniyon mein say hain yeh raat aur din aur sooraj aur chaand . naa sooraj ko sajda kero , naa chaand ko , aur sajda uss Allah ko kero jiss ney unhen peda kiya hai , agar waqaee tumhen ussi ki ibadat kerni hai .
verses.translation: aur ussi ki nishaniyon mein say hain yeh raat aur din aur sooraj aur chaand . naa sooraj ko sajda kero , naa chaand ko , aur sajda uss Allah ko kero jiss ney unhen peda kiya hai , agar waqaee tumhen ussi ki ibadat kerni hai .

( acha ) jo chahao , kerlo , yaqeen jano kay woh tumharay her kaam ko khoob dekh raha hai .

verses.text: beyshak ( unn logon  ney boht bura kiya hai ) jinhon ney naseehat ki iss kitab ka inkar kiya jabkay woh unn kay paas aa-chuki thi , halankay woh bari izzat wali kitab hai ,
verses.translation: beyshak ( unn logon  ney boht bura kiya hai ) jinhon ney naseehat ki iss kitab ka inkar kiya jabkay woh unn kay paas aa-chuki thi , halankay woh bari izzat wali kitab hai ,

verses.text: jiss tak batil ki koi rasai nahi hai , naa uss kay aagay say , naa uss kay peechay say . yeh uss zaat ki taraf say utaari jaa rahi hai jo hikmat ka malik hai , tamam tareefen ussi ki taraf loatti hain .
verses.translation: jiss tak batil ki koi rasai nahi hai , naa uss kay aagay say , naa uss kay peechay say . yeh uss zaat ki taraf say utaari jaa rahi hai jo hikmat ka malik hai , tamam tareefen ussi ki taraf loatti hain .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) tum say jo baaten kahi jaa rahi hain , woh wohi hain jo tum say pehlay payghumberon say kahi gaee then . yaqeen rakho tumhara perwerdigar maghfirat kernay wala bhi hai , aur dardnak saza denay wala bhi .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) tum say jo baaten kahi jaa rahi hain , woh wohi hain jo tum say pehlay payghumberon say kahi gaee then . yaqeen rakho tumhara perwerdigar maghfirat kernay wala bhi hai , aur dardnak saza denay wala bhi .

verses.text: aur agar hum iss ( Quran ) ko ajmi Quran banatay to yeh log kehtay kay :  iss ki aayaten khol khol ker kiyon nahi biyan ki gaeen-? yeh kiya baat hai kay Quran ajmi hai , aur payghumber arbi-?    keh do kay :  jo log emaan layen , unn kay liye yeh hidayat aur shifa ka saman hai , aur jo emaan nahi latay , unn kay kanon mein daat lagi hoi hai , aur yeh ( Quran ) unn kay liye andheray mein bhatakney ka saman hai . aesay logon  ko kissi door daraz jagah say pukara jaa raha hai .
verses.translation: aur agar hum iss ( Quran ) ko ajmi Quran banatay to yeh log kehtay kay :  iss ki aayaten khol khol ker kiyon nahi biyan ki gaeen-? yeh kiya baat hai kay Quran ajmi hai , aur payghumber arbi-?    keh do kay :  jo log emaan layen , unn kay liye yeh hidayat aur shifa ka saman hai , aur jo emaan nahi latay , unn kay kanon mein daat lagi hoi hai , aur yeh ( Quran ) unn kay liye andheray mein bhatakney ka saman hai . aesay logon  ko kissi door daraz jagah say pukara jaa raha hai .

verses.text: aur hum ney musa ko bhi kitab di thi , phir uss mein bhi ikhtilaf huwa . aur agar tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik baat pehlay hi tey naa kerdi gaee hoti , to inn logon  ka moamla chuka hi diya gaya hota . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh log aesay shak mein parray huye hain jiss ney inn ko khaljaan mein daal rakha hai .
verses.translation: aur hum ney musa ko bhi kitab di thi , phir uss mein bhi ikhtilaf huwa . aur agar tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik baat pehlay hi tey naa kerdi gaee hoti , to inn logon  ka moamla chuka hi diya gaya hota . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh log aesay shak mein parray huye hain jiss ney inn ko khaljaan mein daal rakha hai .

verses.text: jo koi naik amal kerta hai , woh apney hi faeeday kay liye kerta hai , aur jo koi burai kerta hai , woh apney hi nuqsan kay liye kerta hai , aur tumhara perwerdigar bandon per zulm kernay wala nahi hai .
verses.translation: jo koi naik amal kerta hai , woh apney hi faeeday kay liye kerta hai , aur jo koi burai kerta hai , woh apney hi nuqsan kay liye kerta hai , aur tumhara perwerdigar bandon per zulm kernay wala nahi hai .

verses.text: qayamat ka ilm ussi ki taraf lotaya jata hai . aur Allah kay ilm kay baghair naa phalon mein say koi phal apney shagoofon say nikalta hai , aur naa kissi mada ko hamal thehrta hai , aur naa uss kay koi baccha peda hota hai . aur jiss din woh inn ( mushrikon ) ko pukaray ga kay :  kahan hain meray woh shareek-?  to woh kahen gay kay :  hum to aap say yehi arz kertay hain kay hum mein say koi abb iss baat ka gawah nahi hai ( kay aap ka koi shareek hai )
verses.translation: qayamat ka ilm ussi ki taraf lotaya jata hai . aur Allah kay ilm kay baghair naa phalon mein say koi phal apney shagoofon say nikalta hai , aur naa kissi mada ko hamal thehrta hai , aur naa uss kay koi baccha peda hota hai . aur jiss din woh inn ( mushrikon ) ko pukaray ga kay :  kahan hain meray woh shareek-?  to woh kahen gay kay :  hum to aap say yehi arz kertay hain kay hum mein say koi abb iss baat ka gawah nahi hai ( kay aap ka koi shareek hai )

verses.text: aur pehlay yeh log jinn ( jhootay khudaon ) ko pukara kertay thay , unn ko abb unn ka koi suragh nahi milay ga , aur woh samajh jayen gay kay unn kay liye abb bachao ka koi raasta nahi hai .
verses.translation: aur pehlay yeh log jinn ( jhootay khudaon ) ko pukara kertay thay , unn ko abb unn ka koi suragh nahi milay ga , aur woh samajh jayen gay kay unn kay liye abb bachao ka koi raasta nahi hai .

verses.text: insan ka haal yeh hai kay woh bhalai maangney say nahi thakta , aur agar ussay koi burai choo jaye to aisa mayyus hojata hai kay her umeed chorr bethta hai .
verses.translation: insan ka haal yeh hai kay woh bhalai maangney say nahi thakta , aur agar ussay koi burai choo jaye to aisa mayyus hojata hai kay her umeed chorr bethta hai .

verses.text: aur jo takleef ussay phonchi thi , agar uss kay baad hum ussay apni taraf say kissi rehmat ka maza chakha den to woh laziman yeh kahey ga kay :  yeh to mera haq tha , aur mein nahi samajhta kay qayamat aaney wali hai , aur agar mujhay apney rab kay paas wapis bheja bhi gaya to mujhay yaqeen hai kay uss kay paas bhi mujhay khush haali hi zaroor milay gi .  abb hum inn kafiron ko yeh zaroor jatlayen gay kay unhon ney kiya amal kiye hain , aur unhen aik sakht azab ka maza zaroor chakhayen gay .
verses.translation: aur jo takleef ussay phonchi thi , agar uss kay baad hum ussay apni taraf say kissi rehmat ka maza chakha den to woh laziman yeh kahey ga kay :  yeh to mera haq tha , aur mein nahi samajhta kay qayamat aaney wali hai , aur agar mujhay apney rab kay paas wapis bheja bhi gaya to mujhay yaqeen hai kay uss kay paas bhi mujhay khush haali hi zaroor milay gi .  abb hum inn kafiron ko yeh zaroor jatlayen gay kay unhon ney kiya amal kiye hain , aur unhen aik sakht azab ka maza zaroor chakhayen gay .

verses.text: aur jab hum insan per koi inaam kertay hain to woh mun morr leta aur pehlo badal ker door chala jata hai , aur jab ussay koi burai choo jati hai to woh lambi chorri duayen kernay lagta hai .
verses.translation: aur jab hum insan per koi inaam kertay hain to woh mun morr leta aur pehlo badal ker door chala jata hai , aur jab ussay koi burai choo jati hai to woh lambi chorri duayen kernay lagta hai .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn kafiron say ) kaho kay :  zara mujhay batao kay agar yeh ( Quran ) Allah ki taraf say aaya hai , phir bhi tum ney iss ka inkar kiya to uss shaks say ziyada gumrah kon hoga jo ( uss ki ) mukhalifat mein boht door nikal gaya ho-?
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn kafiron say ) kaho kay :  zara mujhay batao kay agar yeh ( Quran ) Allah ki taraf say aaya hai , phir bhi tum ney iss ka inkar kiya to uss shaks say ziyada gumrah kon hoga jo ( uss ki ) mukhalifat mein boht door nikal gaya ho-?

verses.text: hum unhen apni nishaniyan kainat mein bhi dikhayen gay aur khud unn kay apney wajood mein bhi , yahan tak kay unn per yeh baat khul ker samney aajaye kay yehi haq hai . kiya tumharay rab ki yeh baat kafi nahi hai kay woh her cheez ka gawah hai-?
verses.translation: hum unhen apni nishaniyan kainat mein bhi dikhayen gay aur khud unn kay apney wajood mein bhi , yahan tak kay unn per yeh baat khul ker samney aajaye kay yehi haq hai . kiya tumharay rab ki yeh baat kafi nahi hai kay woh her cheez ka gawah hai-?

verses.text: yaad rakho kay yeh log apney rab ka samna kernay kay moamlay mein shak mein parray huye hain . yaad rakho kay woh her cheez ko ehatay mein liye huye hai .
verses.translation: yaad rakho kay yeh log apney rab ka samna kernay kay moamlay mein shak mein parray huye hain . yaad rakho kay woh her cheez ko ehatay mein liye huye hai .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: Haa-Meem
ayahs.translation: Haa-Meem

ayahs.text: yeh kalam uss zaat ki taraf say nazil kiya jaraha hai jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh kalam uss zaat ki taraf say nazil kiya jaraha hai jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai .

ayahs.text: arbi Quran ki shakal mein yeh woh kitab hai jiss ki aayaten ilm hasil kernay walon kay liye tafseel say biyan ki gaee hain ,
ayahs.translation: arbi Quran ki shakal mein yeh woh kitab hai jiss ki aayaten ilm hasil kernay walon kay liye tafseel say biyan ki gaee hain ,

ayahs.text: yeh Quran khushkhabri denay wala bhi hai , aur khabrdar kernay wala bhi . phir bhi inn mein say aksar logon  ney mun morr rakha hai jiss kay nateejay mein woh suntay nahi hain ,
ayahs.translation: yeh Quran khushkhabri denay wala bhi hai , aur khabrdar kernay wala bhi . phir bhi inn mein say aksar logon  ney mun morr rakha hai jiss kay nateejay mein woh suntay nahi hain ,

ayahs.text: aur ( payghumber SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam say ) kehtay hain kay :  jiss cheez ki taraf tum hamen bula rahey ho , uss kay liye humaray dil ghilafon mein liptay huye hain , humaray kaan behray hain , aur humaray aur tumharay darmiyan aik perda haeel hai . lehaza tum apna kaam kertay raho , hum apna kaam ker rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: aur ( payghumber SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam say ) kehtay hain kay :  jiss cheez ki taraf tum hamen bula rahey ho , uss kay liye humaray dil ghilafon mein liptay huye hain , humaray kaan behray hain , aur humaray aur tumharay darmiyan aik perda haeel hai . lehaza tum apna kaam kertay raho , hum apna kaam ker rahey hain .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay :  mein to tum hi jaisa aik insan hun . ( albatta ) mujh per yeh wahi nazil hoti hai kay tumhara khuda bus aik hi khuda hai . lehaza tum apna rukh seedha ussi ki taraf rakho , aur ussi say maghfirat maango . aur bari tabahi hai unn mushrikon kay liye
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay :  mein to tum hi jaisa aik insan hun . ( albatta ) mujh per yeh wahi nazil hoti hai kay tumhara khuda bus aik hi khuda hai . lehaza tum apna rukh seedha ussi ki taraf rakho , aur ussi say maghfirat maango . aur bari tabahi hai unn mushrikon kay liye

ayahs.text: jo zakat ada nahi kertay ,   aur unn ka haal yeh hai kay aakhirat kay woh bilkul hi munkir hain .
ayahs.translation: jo zakat ada nahi kertay ,   aur unn ka haal yeh hai kay aakhirat kay woh bilkul hi munkir hain .

ayahs.text: . ( albatta ) jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn kay liye beyshak aisa ajar hai jiss ka silsila kabhi tootney wala nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( albatta ) jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn kay liye beyshak aisa ajar hai jiss ka silsila kabhi tootney wala nahi hai .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  kiya tum waqaee uss zaat kay sath kufr ka moamla kertay ho jiss ney zameen ko do din mein peda kiya , aur uss kay sath doosron ko shareek thehratay ho-? woh zaat to saray jahano ki perwerish kernay wali hai .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  kiya tum waqaee uss zaat kay sath kufr ka moamla kertay ho jiss ney zameen ko do din mein peda kiya , aur uss kay sath doosron ko shareek thehratay ho-? woh zaat to saray jahano ki perwerish kernay wali hai .

ayahs.text: aur uss ney zameen mein jamay huye pahar peda kiye jo uss kay oopper ubhray huye hain , aur uss mein barkat daal di ,   aur uss mein tawazun kay sath uss ki ghizayen peda ken sabb kuch chaar din mein   tamam sawal kernay walon kay liye barabar !
ayahs.translation: aur uss ney zameen mein jamay huye pahar peda kiye jo uss kay oopper ubhray huye hain , aur uss mein barkat daal di ,   aur uss mein tawazun kay sath uss ki ghizayen peda ken sabb kuch chaar din mein   tamam sawal kernay walon kay liye barabar !

ayahs.text: phir woh aasman ki taraf mutawajjah huwa , jabkay woh uss waqt dhuyen ki shakal mein tha ,   aur uss say aur zameen say kaha :  chalay aao , chahye khushi say ya zabardasti .  dono ney kaha :  hum khushi khushi aatay hain .
ayahs.translation: phir woh aasman ki taraf mutawajjah huwa , jabkay woh uss waqt dhuyen ki shakal mein tha ,   aur uss say aur zameen say kaha :  chalay aao , chahye khushi say ya zabardasti .  dono ney kaha :  hum khushi khushi aatay hain .

ayahs.text: chunacheh uss ney do din mein apney faislay kay tehat unn kay saat aasman bana diye , aur her aasman mein uss kay munasib hukum bhej diya .   aur hum ney uss qareeb walay aasman ko chiraghon say sajaya , aur ussay khoob mehfooz kerdiya . yeh uss zaat ki napi tuli mansooba bandi hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ka ilm bhi mukammal .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh uss ney do din mein apney faislay kay tehat unn kay saat aasman bana diye , aur her aasman mein uss kay munasib hukum bhej diya .   aur hum ney uss qareeb walay aasman ko chiraghon say sajaya , aur ussay khoob mehfooz kerdiya . yeh uss zaat ki napi tuli mansooba bandi hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ka ilm bhi mukammal .

ayahs.text: phir bhi agar yeh log mun morren to keh do kay :  mein ne tumhen uss karrkay say khabar daar kerdiya hai jaisa karrka aad aur samood per nazil huwa tha .
ayahs.translation: phir bhi agar yeh log mun morren to keh do kay :  mein ne tumhen uss karrkay say khabar daar kerdiya hai jaisa karrka aad aur samood per nazil huwa tha .

ayahs.text: yeh uss waqt ki baat hai jab unn kay paas payghumber ( kabhi ) unn kay aagay say aur ( kabhi ) unn kay peechay say   yeh paygham ley ker aaye kay Allah kay siwa kissi cheez ki ibadat naa kero . unhon ney kaha kay :  agar humara perwerdigar chahta to farishtay bhejta . lehaza jiss baat kay sath tumhen bheja gaya hai , hum uss ko manney say inkar kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: yeh uss waqt ki baat hai jab unn kay paas payghumber ( kabhi ) unn kay aagay say aur ( kabhi ) unn kay peechay say   yeh paygham ley ker aaye kay Allah kay siwa kissi cheez ki ibadat naa kero . unhon ney kaha kay :  agar humara perwerdigar chahta to farishtay bhejta . lehaza jiss baat kay sath tumhen bheja gaya hai , hum uss ko manney say inkar kertay hain .

ayahs.text: phir aad ka qissa to yeh huwa kay unhon ney zameen mein nahaq takabbur ka ravaiyya ikhtiyar kiya , aur kaha kay :  kon hai jo taqat mein hum say ziyada ho ?  bhala kiya unn ko yeh nahi soojha kay jiss Allah ney unn ko peda kiya hai , woh taqat mein unn say kahen ziyada hai ? aur woh humari aayaton ka inkar kertay rahey .
ayahs.translation: phir aad ka qissa to yeh huwa kay unhon ney zameen mein nahaq takabbur ka ravaiyya ikhtiyar kiya , aur kaha kay :  kon hai jo taqat mein hum say ziyada ho ?  bhala kiya unn ko yeh nahi soojha kay jiss Allah ney unn ko peda kiya hai , woh taqat mein unn say kahen ziyada hai ? aur woh humari aayaton ka inkar kertay rahey .

ayahs.text: chunacheh hum ney kuch manhoos dino mein   unn per aandhi ki shakal mein hawa bheji takay unhen dunyawi zindagi mein ruswai kay azab ka maza chakhayen . aur aakhirat ka azab uss say bhi ziyada ruswa kernay wala hai , aur unn ko koi madad moyassar nahi aaye gi .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh hum ney kuch manhoos dino mein   unn per aandhi ki shakal mein hawa bheji takay unhen dunyawi zindagi mein ruswai kay azab ka maza chakhayen . aur aakhirat ka azab uss say bhi ziyada ruswa kernay wala hai , aur unn ko koi madad moyassar nahi aaye gi .

ayahs.text: rahey samood , to hum ney unhen seedha raasta dikhaya tha . lekin unhon ney seedha raasta ikhtiyar kernay kay muqablay mein andha rehney ko ziyada pasand kiya , chunacheh unhon ney jo kamai ker rakhi thi , uss ki wajeh say unn ko aesay azab kay karrkay ney aa pakra jo sarapa zillat tha ,
ayahs.translation: rahey samood , to hum ney unhen seedha raasta dikhaya tha . lekin unhon ney seedha raasta ikhtiyar kernay kay muqablay mein andha rehney ko ziyada pasand kiya , chunacheh unhon ney jo kamai ker rakhi thi , uss ki wajeh say unn ko aesay azab kay karrkay ney aa pakra jo sarapa zillat tha ,

ayahs.text: aur jo log emaan ley aaye thay , aur taqwa ikhtiyar kiye huye thay , unn ko hum ney nijat dey di .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log emaan ley aaye thay , aur taqwa ikhtiyar kiye huye thay , unn ko hum ney nijat dey di .

ayahs.text: aur uss din ka dhiyan rakho jab Allah kay dushmanon ko jama ker kay aag ki taraf ley jaya jaye ga , chunacheh unhen toliyon mein baant diya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: aur uss din ka dhiyan rakho jab Allah kay dushmanon ko jama ker kay aag ki taraf ley jaya jaye ga , chunacheh unhen toliyon mein baant diya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: yahan tak kay jab woh uss ( aag ) kay paas phonch jayen gay to unn kay kaan , unn ki aankhen aur unn ki khalen unn kay khilaf gawahi den gi kay woh kiya kuch kertay rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: yahan tak kay jab woh uss ( aag ) kay paas phonch jayen gay to unn kay kaan , unn ki aankhen aur unn ki khalen unn kay khilaf gawahi den gi kay woh kiya kuch kertay rahey hain .

ayahs.text: woh apni khalon say kahen gay kay :  tum ney humaray khilaf kiyon gawahi di . ?  woh kahen gi kay :  hamen ussi zaat ney bolney ki taqat dey di hai jiss ney her cheez ko goyai ata farmaee .  aur wohi hai jiss ney tumhen pehli baar peda kiya tha , aur ussi ki taraf tumhen wapis ley jaya jaa raha hai .
ayahs.translation: woh apni khalon say kahen gay kay :  tum ney humaray khilaf kiyon gawahi di . ?  woh kahen gi kay :  hamen ussi zaat ney bolney ki taqat dey di hai jiss ney her cheez ko goyai ata farmaee .  aur wohi hai jiss ney tumhen pehli baar peda kiya tha , aur ussi ki taraf tumhen wapis ley jaya jaa raha hai .

ayahs.text: aur tum ( gunah kertay waqt ) iss baat say to chup hi nahi saktay thay kay tumharay kaan , tumhari aankhen aur tumhari khalen tumharay khilaf gawahi den , lekin tumhara gumaan yeh tha kay Allah ko tumharay boht say aemal ka ilm nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur tum ( gunah kertay waqt ) iss baat say to chup hi nahi saktay thay kay tumharay kaan , tumhari aankhen aur tumhari khalen tumharay khilaf gawahi den , lekin tumhara gumaan yeh tha kay Allah ko tumharay boht say aemal ka ilm nahi hai .

ayahs.text: apney perwerdigar kay baaray mein tumhara yehi gumaan tha jiss ney tumhen barbad kiya , aur issi kay nateejay mein tum unn logon  mein shamil hogaye jo sarasar khasaray mein hain .
ayahs.translation: apney perwerdigar kay baaray mein tumhara yehi gumaan tha jiss ney tumhen barbad kiya , aur issi kay nateejay mein tum unn logon  mein shamil hogaye jo sarasar khasaray mein hain .

ayahs.text: abb inn logon  ka haal yeh hai kay agar yeh sabar keren tab bhi aag hi inn ka thikana hai , aur agar yeh maazrat chahen to yeh unn logon  mein say nahi hain jinn ki maazrat qubool ki jati hai .
ayahs.translation: abb inn logon  ka haal yeh hai kay agar yeh sabar keren tab bhi aag hi inn ka thikana hai , aur agar yeh maazrat chahen to yeh unn logon  mein say nahi hain jinn ki maazrat qubool ki jati hai .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney ( duniya mein ) inn per kuch sathi musallat ker-diye thay jinhon ney inn kay aagay peechay kay saray kamon ko khushnuma bana diya tha ,   chunacheh jo doosray jinnaat aur insan inn say pehlay guzar chukay hain , unn kay sath mil ker ( azab ki ) baat inn per bhi sachi hoi . yaqeenan woh sabb khasara uthaney walon mein say hain .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney ( duniya mein ) inn per kuch sathi musallat ker-diye thay jinhon ney inn kay aagay peechay kay saray kamon ko khushnuma bana diya tha ,   chunacheh jo doosray jinnaat aur insan inn say pehlay guzar chukay hain , unn kay sath mil ker ( azab ki ) baat inn per bhi sachi hoi . yaqeenan woh sabb khasara uthaney walon mein say hain .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kafir ( aik doosray say ) kehtay hain kay :  iss Quran ko suno hi nahi , aur iss kay beech mein ghull macha diya kero takay tum hi ghalib raho .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kafir ( aik doosray say ) kehtay hain kay :  iss Quran ko suno hi nahi , aur iss kay beech mein ghull macha diya kero takay tum hi ghalib raho .

ayahs.text: iss liye hum inn kafiron ko sakht azab ka maza chakhayen gay , aur yeh ( duniya mein ) jo bad-tareen kaam kiya kertay thay , uss ka poora poora badla den gay .
ayahs.translation: iss liye hum inn kafiron ko sakht azab ka maza chakhayen gay , aur yeh ( duniya mein ) jo bad-tareen kaam kiya kertay thay , uss ka poora poora badla den gay .

ayahs.text: yehi hai saza Allah kay dushmanon ki jo aag ki soorat mein hogi . ussi mein unn ka daemi thikana hoga , jo iss baat ka badla hoga kay woh humari aayaton ka inkar kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: yehi hai saza Allah kay dushmanon ki jo aag ki soorat mein hogi . ussi mein unn ka daemi thikana hoga , jo iss baat ka badla hoga kay woh humari aayaton ka inkar kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kafir log kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen unn jinnaat aur insanon dono ki soorat dikhaiye jinhon ney hamen gumrah kiya tha , takay hum unhen apney paon talay aisa ronden kay woh khoob zaleel hon .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kafir log kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen unn jinnaat aur insanon dono ki soorat dikhaiye jinhon ney hamen gumrah kiya tha , takay hum unhen apney paon talay aisa ronden kay woh khoob zaleel hon .
