ayahs.text: aur uss shaks say behtar baat kiss ki hogi jo Allah ki taraf dawat dey , aur naik amal keray , aur yeh kahey kay mein farmanbardaron mein shamil hun .
ayahs.translation: aur uss shaks say behtar baat kiss ki hogi jo Allah ki taraf dawat dey , aur naik amal keray , aur yeh kahey kay mein farmanbardaron mein shamil hun .

ayahs.text: aur naiki aur badi barabar nahi hoti . tum badi ka difaa aesay tareeqay say kero jo behtareen ho .   nateeja yeh hoga kay jiss kay aur tumharay darmiyan dushmani thi , woh dekhtay hi dekhtay aisa hojaye ga jaisay woh ( tumhara ) jigri dost ho .
ayahs.translation: aur naiki aur badi barabar nahi hoti . tum badi ka difaa aesay tareeqay say kero jo behtareen ho .   nateeja yeh hoga kay jiss kay aur tumharay darmiyan dushmani thi , woh dekhtay hi dekhtay aisa hojaye ga jaisay woh ( tumhara ) jigri dost ho .

ayahs.text: aur yeh baat sirf unhi ko ata hoti hai jo sabar say kaam letay hain , aur yeh baat ussi ko ata hoti hai jo baray naseebay wala ho .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh baat sirf unhi ko ata hoti hai jo sabar say kaam letay hain , aur yeh baat ussi ko ata hoti hai jo baray naseebay wala ho .

ayahs.text: aur agar tumhen shetan ki taraf say kabhi koi kachoka lagay to shetan mardood say Allah ki panah maang liya kero .   beyshak woh her baat sunney wala , her baat janney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur agar tumhen shetan ki taraf say kabhi koi kachoka lagay to shetan mardood say Allah ki panah maang liya kero .   beyshak woh her baat sunney wala , her baat janney wala hai .

ayahs.text: aur ussi ki nishaniyon mein say hain yeh raat aur din aur sooraj aur chaand . naa sooraj ko sajda kero , naa chaand ko , aur sajda uss Allah ko kero jiss ney unhen peda kiya hai , agar waqaee tumhen ussi ki ibadat kerni hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ussi ki nishaniyon mein say hain yeh raat aur din aur sooraj aur chaand . naa sooraj ko sajda kero , naa chaand ko , aur sajda uss Allah ko kero jiss ney unhen peda kiya hai , agar waqaee tumhen ussi ki ibadat kerni hai .

ayahs.text: phir bhi agar yeh ( kafir ) takabbur say kaam len , to ( kertay rahen ) kiyonkay jo ( farishtay ) tumharay rab kay paas hain , woh din raat uss ki tasbeeh kertay hain , aur woh uktatay nahi hain .
ayahs.translation: phir bhi agar yeh ( kafir ) takabbur say kaam len , to ( kertay rahen ) kiyonkay jo ( farishtay ) tumharay rab kay paas hain , woh din raat uss ki tasbeeh kertay hain , aur woh uktatay nahi hain .

ayahs.text: aur uss ki nishaniyon mein say yeh bhi hai kay tum zameen ko dekhtay ho kay woh murjhai parri hai . phir junhi hum ney uss per paani utaara , woh harkat mein aagae , aur uss mein barhotry peda hogaee . haqeeqat yeh hai kay jiss ney uss zameen ko zinda kiya , wohi murdon ko bhi zinda kernay wala hai . yaqeenan woh her cheez per qadir hai .
ayahs.translation: aur uss ki nishaniyon mein say yeh bhi hai kay tum zameen ko dekhtay ho kay woh murjhai parri hai . phir junhi hum ney uss per paani utaara , woh harkat mein aagae , aur uss mein barhotry peda hogaee . haqeeqat yeh hai kay jiss ney uss zameen ko zinda kiya , wohi murdon ko bhi zinda kernay wala hai . yaqeenan woh her cheez per qadir hai .

ayahs.text: jo log humari aayaton kay baaray mein tairrah raasta ikhtiyar kertay hain ,   woh hum say chup nahi saktay . bhala batao kay jiss shaks ko aag mein daal diya jaye , woh behtar hai , ya woh shaks jo qayamat kay din bey khof o khatar aaye ga ? ( acha ) jo chahao , kerlo , yaqeen jano kay woh tumharay her kaam ko khoob dekh raha hai .
ayahs.translation: jo log humari aayaton kay baaray mein tairrah raasta ikhtiyar kertay hain ,   woh hum say chup nahi saktay . bhala batao kay jiss shaks ko aag mein daal diya jaye , woh behtar hai , ya woh shaks jo qayamat kay din bey khof o khatar aaye ga ? ( acha ) jo chahao , kerlo , yaqeen jano kay woh tumharay her kaam ko khoob dekh raha hai .

ayahs.text: beyshak ( unn logon  ney boht bura kiya hai ) jinhon ney naseehat ki iss kitab ka inkar kiya jabkay woh unn kay paas aa-chuki thi , halankay woh bari izzat wali kitab hai ,
ayahs.translation: beyshak ( unn logon  ney boht bura kiya hai ) jinhon ney naseehat ki iss kitab ka inkar kiya jabkay woh unn kay paas aa-chuki thi , halankay woh bari izzat wali kitab hai ,

ayahs.text: jiss tak batil ki koi rasai nahi hai , naa uss kay aagay say , naa uss kay peechay say . yeh uss zaat ki taraf say utaari jaa rahi hai jo hikmat ka malik hai , tamam tareefen ussi ki taraf loatti hain .
ayahs.translation: jiss tak batil ki koi rasai nahi hai , naa uss kay aagay say , naa uss kay peechay say . yeh uss zaat ki taraf say utaari jaa rahi hai jo hikmat ka malik hai , tamam tareefen ussi ki taraf loatti hain .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) tum say jo baaten kahi jaa rahi hain , woh wohi hain jo tum say pehlay payghumberon say kahi gaee then . yaqeen rakho tumhara perwerdigar maghfirat kernay wala bhi hai , aur dardnak saza denay wala bhi .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) tum say jo baaten kahi jaa rahi hain , woh wohi hain jo tum say pehlay payghumberon say kahi gaee then . yaqeen rakho tumhara perwerdigar maghfirat kernay wala bhi hai , aur dardnak saza denay wala bhi .

ayahs.text: aur agar hum iss ( Quran ) ko ajmi Quran banatay to yeh log kehtay kay :  iss ki aayaten khol khol ker kiyon nahi biyan ki gaeen-? yeh kiya baat hai kay Quran ajmi hai , aur payghumber arbi-?    keh do kay :  jo log emaan layen , unn kay liye yeh hidayat aur shifa ka saman hai , aur jo emaan nahi latay , unn kay kanon mein daat lagi hoi hai , aur yeh ( Quran ) unn kay liye andheray mein bhatakney ka saman hai . aesay logon  ko kissi door daraz jagah say pukara jaa raha hai .
ayahs.translation: aur agar hum iss ( Quran ) ko ajmi Quran banatay to yeh log kehtay kay :  iss ki aayaten khol khol ker kiyon nahi biyan ki gaeen-? yeh kiya baat hai kay Quran ajmi hai , aur payghumber arbi-?    keh do kay :  jo log emaan layen , unn kay liye yeh hidayat aur shifa ka saman hai , aur jo emaan nahi latay , unn kay kanon mein daat lagi hoi hai , aur yeh ( Quran ) unn kay liye andheray mein bhatakney ka saman hai . aesay logon  ko kissi door daraz jagah say pukara jaa raha hai .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney musa ko bhi kitab di thi , phir uss mein bhi ikhtilaf huwa . aur agar tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik baat pehlay hi tey naa kerdi gaee hoti , to inn logon  ka moamla chuka hi diya gaya hota . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh log aesay shak mein parray huye hain jiss ney inn ko khaljaan mein daal rakha hai .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney musa ko bhi kitab di thi , phir uss mein bhi ikhtilaf huwa . aur agar tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik baat pehlay hi tey naa kerdi gaee hoti , to inn logon  ka moamla chuka hi diya gaya hota . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh log aesay shak mein parray huye hain jiss ney inn ko khaljaan mein daal rakha hai .

ayahs.text: jo koi naik amal kerta hai , woh apney hi faeeday kay liye kerta hai , aur jo koi burai kerta hai , woh apney hi nuqsan kay liye kerta hai , aur tumhara perwerdigar bandon per zulm kernay wala nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: jo koi naik amal kerta hai , woh apney hi faeeday kay liye kerta hai , aur jo koi burai kerta hai , woh apney hi nuqsan kay liye kerta hai , aur tumhara perwerdigar bandon per zulm kernay wala nahi hai .

ayahs.text: qayamat ka ilm ussi ki taraf lotaya jata hai . aur Allah kay ilm kay baghair naa phalon mein say koi phal apney shagoofon say nikalta hai , aur naa kissi mada ko hamal thehrta hai , aur naa uss kay koi baccha peda hota hai . aur jiss din woh inn ( mushrikon ) ko pukaray ga kay :  kahan hain meray woh shareek-?  to woh kahen gay kay :  hum to aap say yehi arz kertay hain kay hum mein say koi abb iss baat ka gawah nahi hai ( kay aap ka koi shareek hai )
ayahs.translation: qayamat ka ilm ussi ki taraf lotaya jata hai . aur Allah kay ilm kay baghair naa phalon mein say koi phal apney shagoofon say nikalta hai , aur naa kissi mada ko hamal thehrta hai , aur naa uss kay koi baccha peda hota hai . aur jiss din woh inn ( mushrikon ) ko pukaray ga kay :  kahan hain meray woh shareek-?  to woh kahen gay kay :  hum to aap say yehi arz kertay hain kay hum mein say koi abb iss baat ka gawah nahi hai ( kay aap ka koi shareek hai )

ayahs.text: aur pehlay yeh log jinn ( jhootay khudaon ) ko pukara kertay thay , unn ko abb unn ka koi suragh nahi milay ga , aur woh samajh jayen gay kay unn kay liye abb bachao ka koi raasta nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur pehlay yeh log jinn ( jhootay khudaon ) ko pukara kertay thay , unn ko abb unn ka koi suragh nahi milay ga , aur woh samajh jayen gay kay unn kay liye abb bachao ka koi raasta nahi hai .

ayahs.text: insan ka haal yeh hai kay woh bhalai maangney say nahi thakta , aur agar ussay koi burai choo jaye to aisa mayyus hojata hai kay her umeed chorr bethta hai .
ayahs.translation: insan ka haal yeh hai kay woh bhalai maangney say nahi thakta , aur agar ussay koi burai choo jaye to aisa mayyus hojata hai kay her umeed chorr bethta hai .

ayahs.text: aur jo takleef ussay phonchi thi , agar uss kay baad hum ussay apni taraf say kissi rehmat ka maza chakha den to woh laziman yeh kahey ga kay :  yeh to mera haq tha , aur mein nahi samajhta kay qayamat aaney wali hai , aur agar mujhay apney rab kay paas wapis bheja bhi gaya to mujhay yaqeen hai kay uss kay paas bhi mujhay khush haali hi zaroor milay gi .  abb hum inn kafiron ko yeh zaroor jatlayen gay kay unhon ney kiya amal kiye hain , aur unhen aik sakht azab ka maza zaroor chakhayen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur jo takleef ussay phonchi thi , agar uss kay baad hum ussay apni taraf say kissi rehmat ka maza chakha den to woh laziman yeh kahey ga kay :  yeh to mera haq tha , aur mein nahi samajhta kay qayamat aaney wali hai , aur agar mujhay apney rab kay paas wapis bheja bhi gaya to mujhay yaqeen hai kay uss kay paas bhi mujhay khush haali hi zaroor milay gi .  abb hum inn kafiron ko yeh zaroor jatlayen gay kay unhon ney kiya amal kiye hain , aur unhen aik sakht azab ka maza zaroor chakhayen gay .

ayahs.text: aur jab hum insan per koi inaam kertay hain to woh mun morr leta aur pehlo badal ker door chala jata hai , aur jab ussay koi burai choo jati hai to woh lambi chorri duayen kernay lagta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jab hum insan per koi inaam kertay hain to woh mun morr leta aur pehlo badal ker door chala jata hai , aur jab ussay koi burai choo jati hai to woh lambi chorri duayen kernay lagta hai .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn kafiron say ) kaho kay :  zara mujhay batao kay agar yeh ( Quran ) Allah ki taraf say aaya hai , phir bhi tum ney iss ka inkar kiya to uss shaks say ziyada gumrah kon hoga jo ( uss ki ) mukhalifat mein boht door nikal gaya ho-?
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn kafiron say ) kaho kay :  zara mujhay batao kay agar yeh ( Quran ) Allah ki taraf say aaya hai , phir bhi tum ney iss ka inkar kiya to uss shaks say ziyada gumrah kon hoga jo ( uss ki ) mukhalifat mein boht door nikal gaya ho-?

ayahs.text: hum unhen apni nishaniyan kainat mein bhi dikhayen gay aur khud unn kay apney wajood mein bhi , yahan tak kay unn per yeh baat khul ker samney aajaye kay yehi haq hai . kiya tumharay rab ki yeh baat kafi nahi hai kay woh her cheez ka gawah hai-?
ayahs.translation: hum unhen apni nishaniyan kainat mein bhi dikhayen gay aur khud unn kay apney wajood mein bhi , yahan tak kay unn per yeh baat khul ker samney aajaye kay yehi haq hai . kiya tumharay rab ki yeh baat kafi nahi hai kay woh her cheez ka gawah hai-?

ayahs.text: yaad rakho kay yeh log apney rab ka samna kernay kay moamlay mein shak mein parray huye hain . yaad rakho kay woh her cheez ko ehatay mein liye huye hai .
ayahs.translation: yaad rakho kay yeh log apney rab ka samna kernay kay moamlay mein shak mein parray huye hain . yaad rakho kay woh her cheez ko ehatay mein liye huye hai .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: Haa-Meem .
verses.translation: Haa-Meem .

verses.text: Aen-Seen-Qaaf
verses.translation: Aen-Seen-Qaaf

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) Allah jo aziz o hakeem hai , tum per aur tum say pehlay jo ( payghumber ) huye hain , unn per issi tarah wahi nazil kerta hai .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) Allah jo aziz o hakeem hai , tum per aur tum say pehlay jo ( payghumber ) huye hain , unn per issi tarah wahi nazil kerta hai .

verses.text: jo kuch aasmano mein hai aur jo kuch zameen mein hai , sabb ussi ka hai , aur wohi hai jo bartari aur azmat ka malik hai .
verses.translation: jo kuch aasmano mein hai aur jo kuch zameen mein hai , sabb ussi ka hai , aur wohi hai jo bartari aur azmat ka malik hai .

verses.text: aisa lagta hai kay aasman oopper say phatt parren gay ,   aur farishtay apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh ker rahey hain , aur zameen walon kay liye astaghfaar ker rahey hain . yaad rakho kay Allah hi hai jo boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: aisa lagta hai kay aasman oopper say phatt parren gay ,   aur farishtay apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh ker rahey hain , aur zameen walon kay liye astaghfaar ker rahey hain . yaad rakho kay Allah hi hai jo boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney uss kay siwa doosray rakhwalay bana rakhay hain , Allah unn per nigrani rakhay huye hai , aur tum unn kay zimma daar nahi ho .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney uss kay siwa doosray rakhwalay bana rakhay hain , Allah unn per nigrani rakhay huye hai , aur tum unn kay zimma daar nahi ho .

verses.text: aur issi tarah hum ney yeh arbi Quran tum per wahi kay zariye bheja hai , takay tum markazi basti ( makkah ) aur uss kay irdgird walon ko uss din say khabrdar kero jiss mein sabb ko jama kiya jaye ga , jiss kay aaney mein koi shak nahi hai . aik giroh jannat mein jaye ga , aur aik giroh bharakti hoi aag mein .
verses.translation: aur issi tarah hum ney yeh arbi Quran tum per wahi kay zariye bheja hai , takay tum markazi basti ( makkah ) aur uss kay irdgird walon ko uss din say khabrdar kero jiss mein sabb ko jama kiya jaye ga , jiss kay aaney mein koi shak nahi hai . aik giroh jannat mein jaye ga , aur aik giroh bharakti hoi aag mein .

verses.text: aur agar Allah chahta to inn sabb ko aik hi jamat bana deta ,   lekin woh jiss ko chahta hai , apni rehmat mein dakhil kerta hai , aur jo zalim log hain , unn ka naa koi rakhwala hai , naa koi madadgaar .
verses.translation: aur agar Allah chahta to inn sabb ko aik hi jamat bana deta ,   lekin woh jiss ko chahta hai , apni rehmat mein dakhil kerta hai , aur jo zalim log hain , unn ka naa koi rakhwala hai , naa koi madadgaar .

verses.text: kiya inn logon  ney uss ko chorr ker doosray rakhwalay bana liye hain-? sach to yeh hai kay rakhwala Allah hi hai , aur wohi murdon ko zinda kerta hai , aur wohi her cheez per qadir hai .
verses.translation: kiya inn logon  ney uss ko chorr ker doosray rakhwalay bana liye hain-? sach to yeh hai kay rakhwala Allah hi hai , aur wohi murdon ko zinda kerta hai , aur wohi her cheez per qadir hai .

verses.text: aur tum jiss baat mein bhi ikhtilaf kertay ho , uss ka faisla Allah hi kay supurd hai . logo ! wohi Allah hai jo mera perwerdigar hai . ussi per mein ney bharosa kiya hai , aur ussi say mein lo lagata hun .
verses.translation: aur tum jiss baat mein bhi ikhtilaf kertay ho , uss ka faisla Allah hi kay supurd hai . logo ! wohi Allah hai jo mera perwerdigar hai . ussi per mein ney bharosa kiya hai , aur ussi say mein lo lagata hun .

verses.text: woh aasmano aur zameen ka peda kernay wala hai . uss ney tumharay liye tumhari hi jins say jooray peda kiye hain , aur maweshiyon kay bhi jooray banaye hain . issi zariye say woh tumhari nasal chalata hai . koi cheez uss kay misil nahi hai , aur wohi hai jo her baat sunta , sabb kuch dekhta hai .
verses.translation: woh aasmano aur zameen ka peda kernay wala hai . uss ney tumharay liye tumhari hi jins say jooray peda kiye hain , aur maweshiyon kay bhi jooray banaye hain . issi zariye say woh tumhari nasal chalata hai . koi cheez uss kay misil nahi hai , aur wohi hai jo her baat sunta , sabb kuch dekhta hai .

verses.text: aasmano aur zameen ki sari kunjiyan ussi kay qabazay mein hain . woh jiss kay liye chahta hai rizq mein wusat aur tangi kerta hai , yaqeenan woh her cheez ka janney wala hai .
verses.translation: aasmano aur zameen ki sari kunjiyan ussi kay qabazay mein hain . woh jiss kay liye chahta hai rizq mein wusat aur tangi kerta hai , yaqeenan woh her cheez ka janney wala hai .

verses.text: uss ney tumharay liye deen ka wohi tareeqa tey kiya hai jiss ka hukum uss ney nooh ko diya tha , aur jo ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumharay paas wahi kay zariye bheja hai aur jiss ka hukum hum ney Ibrahim , musa aur essa ko diya tha kay tum deen ko qaeem kero , aur uss mein tafarqa naa daalna . ( phir bhi ) mushrikeen ko woh baat boht giraan guzarti hai jiss ki taraf tum unhen dawat dey rahey ho . Allah jiss ko chahta hai , chunn ker apni taraf kheench leta hai , aur jo koi uss say lo lagata hai , ussay apney paas phoncha deta hai .
verses.translation: uss ney tumharay liye deen ka wohi tareeqa tey kiya hai jiss ka hukum uss ney nooh ko diya tha , aur jo ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumharay paas wahi kay zariye bheja hai aur jiss ka hukum hum ney Ibrahim , musa aur essa ko diya tha kay tum deen ko qaeem kero , aur uss mein tafarqa naa daalna . ( phir bhi ) mushrikeen ko woh baat boht giraan guzarti hai jiss ki taraf tum unhen dawat dey rahey ho . Allah jiss ko chahta hai , chunn ker apni taraf kheench leta hai , aur jo koi uss say lo lagata hai , ussay apney paas phoncha deta hai .

verses.text: aur logon  ney aapas ki adawaton ki wajeh say ( deen mein ) jo tafarqa daala hai woh uss kay baad hi daala hai jab unn kay paas yaqeeni ilm aa-chuka tha . aur agar tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik moyyan mauddat tak kay liye aik baat pehlay say tey naa hoti to unn ka faisla hochuka hota .   aur inn logon  kay baad jinn ko kitab ka waris banaya gaya hai , woh uss kay baaray mein aesay shak mein parray huye hain jiss ney unhen khaljaan mein daal rakha hai .
verses.translation: aur logon  ney aapas ki adawaton ki wajeh say ( deen mein ) jo tafarqa daala hai woh uss kay baad hi daala hai jab unn kay paas yaqeeni ilm aa-chuka tha . aur agar tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik moyyan mauddat tak kay liye aik baat pehlay say tey naa hoti to unn ka faisla hochuka hota .   aur inn logon  kay baad jinn ko kitab ka waris banaya gaya hai , woh uss kay baaray mein aesay shak mein parray huye hain jiss ney unhen khaljaan mein daal rakha hai .

verses.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum ussi baat ki taraf logon  ko dawat detay raho , aur jiss tarah tumhen hukum diya gaya hai , ( issi deen per ) jamay raho , aur inn logon  ki khuwaishaat kay peechay naa chalo , aur keh do kay :  mein to uss kitab per emaan laya hun jo Allah ney nazil ki hai , aur mujhay hukum diya gaya hai kay mein tumharay darmiyan insaf kerun . Allah humara bhi rab hai , aur tumhara bhi rab . humaray aemal humaray liye hain , aur tumharay aemal tumharay liye . humaray aur tumharay darmiyan ( abb ) koi behas nahi . Allah hum sabb ko jama keray ga , aur ussi kay paas aakhir sabb ko loattna hai .
verses.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum ussi baat ki taraf logon  ko dawat detay raho , aur jiss tarah tumhen hukum diya gaya hai , ( issi deen per ) jamay raho , aur inn logon  ki khuwaishaat kay peechay naa chalo , aur keh do kay :  mein to uss kitab per emaan laya hun jo Allah ney nazil ki hai , aur mujhay hukum diya gaya hai kay mein tumharay darmiyan insaf kerun . Allah humara bhi rab hai , aur tumhara bhi rab . humaray aemal humaray liye hain , aur tumharay aemal tumharay liye . humaray aur tumharay darmiyan ( abb ) koi behas nahi . Allah hum sabb ko jama keray ga , aur ussi kay paas aakhir sabb ko loattna hai .

verses.text: aur jo log Allah kay baaray mein behasen nikaltay hain jabkay log uss ki baat maan chukay hain , unn ki behas unn kay perwerdigar kay nazdeek batil hai , aur unn per ( Allah ka ) ghazab hai , aur unn kay liye sakht azab .
verses.translation: aur jo log Allah kay baaray mein behasen nikaltay hain jabkay log uss ki baat maan chukay hain , unn ki behas unn kay perwerdigar kay nazdeek batil hai , aur unn per ( Allah ka ) ghazab hai , aur unn kay liye sakht azab .

verses.text: Allah woh hai jiss ney haq per mushtamil yeh kitab aur insaf ki tarazoo utaari hai . aur tumhen kiya pata , shayad kay qayamat ki gharri qareeb hi ho .
verses.translation: Allah woh hai jiss ney haq per mushtamil yeh kitab aur insaf ki tarazoo utaari hai . aur tumhen kiya pata , shayad kay qayamat ki gharri qareeb hi ho .

verses.text: jo log uss per emaan nahi rakhtay , woh uss kay aaney ki jaldi machatay hain , aur jo log emaan laye hain , woh uss say sehmay rehtay hain , aur jantay hain kay woh bar-haq hai . aray jo log qayamat kay baaray mein behasen ker rahey hain , woh gumrahi mein boht door chalay gaye hain .
verses.translation: jo log uss per emaan nahi rakhtay , woh uss kay aaney ki jaldi machatay hain , aur jo log emaan laye hain , woh uss say sehmay rehtay hain , aur jantay hain kay woh bar-haq hai . aray jo log qayamat kay baaray mein behasen ker rahey hain , woh gumrahi mein boht door chalay gaye hain .

verses.text: Allah apney bandon per boht meharban hai , woh jiss ko chahta hai , rizq deta hai , aur wohi hai jo quooat ka bhi malik hai , iqtidar ka bhi malik .
verses.translation: Allah apney bandon per boht meharban hai , woh jiss ko chahta hai , rizq deta hai , aur wohi hai jo quooat ka bhi malik hai , iqtidar ka bhi malik .

verses.text: jo shaks aakhirat ki kheti chahta ho , hum uss ki kheti mein aur izafa keren gay , aur jo shaks ( sirf ) duniya ki kheti chahta ho , hum ussay ussi mein say dey den gay ,   aur aakhirat mein uss ka koi hissa nahi .
verses.translation: jo shaks aakhirat ki kheti chahta ho , hum uss ki kheti mein aur izafa keren gay , aur jo shaks ( sirf ) duniya ki kheti chahta ho , hum ussay ussi mein say dey den gay ,   aur aakhirat mein uss ka koi hissa nahi .

verses.text: kiya inn ( kafiron ) kay kuch aesay shareek hain jinhon ney inn kay liye aisa deen tey kerdiya hai jiss ki Allah ney ijazat nahi di hai ? aur agar ( Allah ki taraf say ) faisla kunn baat tey shuda naa hoti to inn ka moamla chuka diya gaya hota . aur yaqeen rakho kay inn zalimon kay liye bara dardnak azab hai .
verses.translation: kiya inn ( kafiron ) kay kuch aesay shareek hain jinhon ney inn kay liye aisa deen tey kerdiya hai jiss ki Allah ney ijazat nahi di hai ? aur agar ( Allah ki taraf say ) faisla kunn baat tey shuda naa hoti to inn ka moamla chuka diya gaya hota . aur yaqeen rakho kay inn zalimon kay liye bara dardnak azab hai .

verses.text: . ( uss waqt ) tum inn zalimon ko dekho gay kay unhon ney jo kamai ki hai , uss ( kay wabal ) say sehmay huye hon gay , aur woh unn per parr ker rahey ga . aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , woh jannaton ki kiyariyon mein hon gay . unhen apney perwerdigar kay paas woh sabb kuch milay ga jo woh chahen gay . yehi bara fazal hai .
verses.translation: . ( uss waqt ) tum inn zalimon ko dekho gay kay unhon ney jo kamai ki hai , uss ( kay wabal ) say sehmay huye hon gay , aur woh unn per parr ker rahey ga . aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , woh jannaton ki kiyariyon mein hon gay . unhen apney perwerdigar kay paas woh sabb kuch milay ga jo woh chahen gay . yehi bara fazal hai .

verses.text: yehi woh cheez hai jiss ki khushkhabri Allah apney unn bandon ko deta hai jo emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain . ( aey payghumber ! kafiron say ) keh do kay :  mein tum say iss ( tableegh ) per koi ujrat nahi maangta , siwaye rishta daari ki mohabbat kay .    aur jo shaks koi bhalai keray ga , hum uss ki khatir uss bhalai mein mazeed khoobi ka izafa kerden gay .   yaqeen jano Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara qadardaan hai .
verses.translation: yehi woh cheez hai jiss ki khushkhabri Allah apney unn bandon ko deta hai jo emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain . ( aey payghumber ! kafiron say ) keh do kay :  mein tum say iss ( tableegh ) per koi ujrat nahi maangta , siwaye rishta daari ki mohabbat kay .    aur jo shaks koi bhalai keray ga , hum uss ki khatir uss bhalai mein mazeed khoobi ka izafa kerden gay .   yaqeen jano Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara qadardaan hai .

verses.text: bhala kiya yeh log yun kehtay hain kay iss shaks ney yeh kalam khud gharr ker jhoot moott Allah kay zimmay laga diya hai ? halankay agar Allah chahye to tumharay dil per mohar laga dey , aur Allah to batil ko mitatta hai , aur haq ko apney kalmaat kay zariye sabit kerta hai .   yaqeenan woh seenon mein chupi hoi baaton tak ko janta hai .
verses.translation: bhala kiya yeh log yun kehtay hain kay iss shaks ney yeh kalam khud gharr ker jhoot moott Allah kay zimmay laga diya hai ? halankay agar Allah chahye to tumharay dil per mohar laga dey , aur Allah to batil ko mitatta hai , aur haq ko apney kalmaat kay zariye sabit kerta hai .   yaqeenan woh seenon mein chupi hoi baaton tak ko janta hai .

verses.text: aur wohi hai jo apney bandon ki tauba qubool kerta hai , aur gunahon ko moaaf kerta hai , aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , uss ka poora ilm rakhta hai .
verses.translation: aur wohi hai jo apney bandon ki tauba qubool kerta hai , aur gunahon ko moaaf kerta hai , aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , uss ka poora ilm rakhta hai .

verses.text: aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , woh unn ki dua sunta hai , aur unhen apney fazal say aur ziyada deta hai . aur kafiron kay liye sakht azab hai .
verses.translation: aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , woh unn ki dua sunta hai , aur unhen apney fazal say aur ziyada deta hai . aur kafiron kay liye sakht azab hai .

verses.text: aur agar Allah apney tamam bandon kay liye rizq ko khulay tor per phela deta to woh zameen mein sarkashi kernay lagtay , magar woh aik khaas andazay say jitna chahta hai ( rizq ) utaarta hai . yaqeenan woh apney bandon say poori tarah ba-khabar , unn per nazar rakhney wala hai .
verses.translation: aur agar Allah apney tamam bandon kay liye rizq ko khulay tor per phela deta to woh zameen mein sarkashi kernay lagtay , magar woh aik khaas andazay say jitna chahta hai ( rizq ) utaarta hai . yaqeenan woh apney bandon say poori tarah ba-khabar , unn per nazar rakhney wala hai .

verses.text: aur wohi hai jo logon  kay naa umeed honey kay baad barish barsata aur apni rehmat phela deta hai , aur wohi hai jo ( sabb ka ) qabil-e-tareef rakhwala hai .
verses.translation: aur wohi hai jo logon  kay naa umeed honey kay baad barish barsata aur apni rehmat phela deta hai , aur wohi hai jo ( sabb ka ) qabil-e-tareef rakhwala hai .

verses.text: aur uss ki nishaniyon mein say hai aasmano aur zameen ki pedaeesh aur woh jandaar jo uss ney unn dono mein phela rakhay hain . aur woh jab chahye , unn ko jama kernay per poori qudrat rakhta hai .
verses.translation: aur uss ki nishaniyon mein say hai aasmano aur zameen ki pedaeesh aur woh jandaar jo uss ney unn dono mein phela rakhay hain . aur woh jab chahye , unn ko jama kernay per poori qudrat rakhta hai .

verses.text: aur tumhen jo koi museebat phonchti hai , woh tumharay apney haathon kiye huye kamon ki wajeh say phonchti hai , aur boht say kamon say to woh darguzar hi kerta hai .
verses.translation: aur tumhen jo koi museebat phonchti hai , woh tumharay apney haathon kiye huye kamon ki wajeh say phonchti hai , aur boht say kamon say to woh darguzar hi kerta hai .

verses.text: aur tumhari majal nahi hai kay zameen mein ( Allah ko ) aajiz ker-sako , aur Allah kay siwa tumhara naa koi rakhwala hai , naa madadgaar .
verses.translation: aur tumhari majal nahi hai kay zameen mein ( Allah ko ) aajiz ker-sako , aur Allah kay siwa tumhara naa koi rakhwala hai , naa madadgaar .

verses.text: aur uss ki nishaniyon mein say hain samandar mein yeh paharon jaisay jahaz !
verses.translation: aur uss ki nishaniyon mein say hain samandar mein yeh paharon jaisay jahaz !

verses.text: agar woh chahye to hawa ko thehra dey , jiss say yeh samandar ki pusht per kharray kay kharray reh jayen yaqeenan iss mein her uss shaks kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo sabar ka bhi khoogar ho , shukar ka bhi

verses.translation: aur jo baray baray gunahon aur bey hayai kay kamon say perhez kertay hain , aur jab unn ko ghussa aata hai to woh darguzar say kaam letay hain .

verses.translation: aur jab unn per koi ziyadti hoti hai to woh apna difaa kertay hain .
