ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) Allah jo aziz o hakeem hai , tum per aur tum say pehlay jo ( payghumber ) huye hain , unn per issi tarah wahi nazil kerta hai .

ayahs.text: jo kuch aasmano mein hai aur jo kuch zameen mein hai , sabb ussi ka hai , aur wohi hai jo bartari aur azmat ka malik hai .
ayahs.translation: jo kuch aasmano mein hai aur jo kuch zameen mein hai , sabb ussi ka hai , aur wohi hai jo bartari aur azmat ka malik hai .

ayahs.text: aisa lagta hai kay aasman oopper say phatt parren gay ,   aur farishtay apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh ker rahey hain , aur zameen walon kay liye astaghfaar ker rahey hain . yaad rakho kay Allah hi hai jo boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: aisa lagta hai kay aasman oopper say phatt parren gay ,   aur farishtay apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh ker rahey hain , aur zameen walon kay liye astaghfaar ker rahey hain . yaad rakho kay Allah hi hai jo boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney uss kay siwa doosray rakhwalay bana rakhay hain , Allah unn per nigrani rakhay huye hai , aur tum unn kay zimma daar nahi ho .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney uss kay siwa doosray rakhwalay bana rakhay hain , Allah unn per nigrani rakhay huye hai , aur tum unn kay zimma daar nahi ho .

ayahs.text: aur issi tarah hum ney yeh arbi Quran tum per wahi kay zariye bheja hai , takay tum markazi basti ( makkah ) aur uss kay irdgird walon ko uss din say khabrdar kero jiss mein sabb ko jama kiya jaye ga , jiss kay aaney mein koi shak nahi hai . aik giroh jannat mein jaye ga , aur aik giroh bharakti hoi aag mein .
ayahs.translation: aur issi tarah hum ney yeh arbi Quran tum per wahi kay zariye bheja hai , takay tum markazi basti ( makkah ) aur uss kay irdgird walon ko uss din say khabrdar kero jiss mein sabb ko jama kiya jaye ga , jiss kay aaney mein koi shak nahi hai . aik giroh jannat mein jaye ga , aur aik giroh bharakti hoi aag mein .

ayahs.text: aur agar Allah chahta to inn sabb ko aik hi jamat bana deta ,   lekin woh jiss ko chahta hai , apni rehmat mein dakhil kerta hai , aur jo zalim log hain , unn ka naa koi rakhwala hai , naa koi madadgaar .
ayahs.translation: aur agar Allah chahta to inn sabb ko aik hi jamat bana deta ,   lekin woh jiss ko chahta hai , apni rehmat mein dakhil kerta hai , aur jo zalim log hain , unn ka naa koi rakhwala hai , naa koi madadgaar .

ayahs.text: kiya inn logon  ney uss ko chorr ker doosray rakhwalay bana liye hain-? sach to yeh hai kay rakhwala Allah hi hai , aur wohi murdon ko zinda kerta hai , aur wohi her cheez per qadir hai .
ayahs.translation: kiya inn logon  ney uss ko chorr ker doosray rakhwalay bana liye hain-? sach to yeh hai kay rakhwala Allah hi hai , aur wohi murdon ko zinda kerta hai , aur wohi her cheez per qadir hai .

ayahs.text: aur tum jiss baat mein bhi ikhtilaf kertay ho , uss ka faisla Allah hi kay supurd hai . logo ! wohi Allah hai jo mera perwerdigar hai . ussi per mein ney bharosa kiya hai , aur ussi say mein lo lagata hun .
ayahs.translation: aur tum jiss baat mein bhi ikhtilaf kertay ho , uss ka faisla Allah hi kay supurd hai . logo ! wohi Allah hai jo mera perwerdigar hai . ussi per mein ney bharosa kiya hai , aur ussi say mein lo lagata hun .

ayahs.text: woh aasmano aur zameen ka peda kernay wala hai . uss ney tumharay liye tumhari hi jins say jooray peda kiye hain , aur maweshiyon kay bhi jooray banaye hain . issi zariye say woh tumhari nasal chalata hai . koi cheez uss kay misil nahi hai , aur wohi hai jo her baat sunta , sabb kuch dekhta hai .
ayahs.translation: woh aasmano aur zameen ka peda kernay wala hai . uss ney tumharay liye tumhari hi jins say jooray peda kiye hain , aur maweshiyon kay bhi jooray banaye hain . issi zariye say woh tumhari nasal chalata hai . koi cheez uss kay misil nahi hai , aur wohi hai jo her baat sunta , sabb kuch dekhta hai .

ayahs.text: aasmano aur zameen ki sari kunjiyan ussi kay qabazay mein hain . woh jiss kay liye chahta hai rizq mein wusat aur tangi kerta hai , yaqeenan woh her cheez ka janney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aasmano aur zameen ki sari kunjiyan ussi kay qabazay mein hain . woh jiss kay liye chahta hai rizq mein wusat aur tangi kerta hai , yaqeenan woh her cheez ka janney wala hai .

ayahs.text: uss ney tumharay liye deen ka wohi tareeqa tey kiya hai jiss ka hukum uss ney nooh ko diya tha , aur jo ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumharay paas wahi kay zariye bheja hai aur jiss ka hukum hum ney Ibrahim , musa aur essa ko diya tha kay tum deen ko qaeem kero , aur uss mein tafarqa naa daalna . ( phir bhi ) mushrikeen ko woh baat boht giraan guzarti hai jiss ki taraf tum unhen dawat dey rahey ho . Allah jiss ko chahta hai , chunn ker apni taraf kheench leta hai , aur jo koi uss say lo lagata hai , ussay apney paas phoncha deta hai .
ayahs.translation: uss ney tumharay liye deen ka wohi tareeqa tey kiya hai jiss ka hukum uss ney nooh ko diya tha , aur jo ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumharay paas wahi kay zariye bheja hai aur jiss ka hukum hum ney Ibrahim , musa aur essa ko diya tha kay tum deen ko qaeem kero , aur uss mein tafarqa naa daalna . ( phir bhi ) mushrikeen ko woh baat boht giraan guzarti hai jiss ki taraf tum unhen dawat dey rahey ho . Allah jiss ko chahta hai , chunn ker apni taraf kheench leta hai , aur jo koi uss say lo lagata hai , ussay apney paas phoncha deta hai .

ayahs.text: aur logon  ney aapas ki adawaton ki wajeh say ( deen mein ) jo tafarqa daala hai woh uss kay baad hi daala hai jab unn kay paas yaqeeni ilm aa-chuka tha . aur agar tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik moyyan mauddat tak kay liye aik baat pehlay say tey naa hoti to unn ka faisla hochuka hota .   aur inn logon  kay baad jinn ko kitab ka waris banaya gaya hai , woh uss kay baaray mein aesay shak mein parray huye hain jiss ney unhen khaljaan mein daal rakha hai .
ayahs.translation: aur logon  ney aapas ki adawaton ki wajeh say ( deen mein ) jo tafarqa daala hai woh uss kay baad hi daala hai jab unn kay paas yaqeeni ilm aa-chuka tha . aur agar tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik moyyan mauddat tak kay liye aik baat pehlay say tey naa hoti to unn ka faisla hochuka hota .   aur inn logon  kay baad jinn ko kitab ka waris banaya gaya hai , woh uss kay baaray mein aesay shak mein parray huye hain jiss ney unhen khaljaan mein daal rakha hai .

ayahs.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum ussi baat ki taraf logon  ko dawat detay raho , aur jiss tarah tumhen hukum diya gaya hai , ( issi deen per ) jamay raho , aur inn logon  ki khuwaishaat kay peechay naa chalo , aur keh do kay :  mein to uss kitab per emaan laya hun jo Allah ney nazil ki hai , aur mujhay hukum diya gaya hai kay mein tumharay darmiyan insaf kerun . Allah humara bhi rab hai , aur tumhara bhi rab . humaray aemal humaray liye hain , aur tumharay aemal tumharay liye . humaray aur tumharay darmiyan ( abb ) koi behas nahi . Allah hum sabb ko jama keray ga , aur ussi kay paas aakhir sabb ko loattna hai .
ayahs.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum ussi baat ki taraf logon  ko dawat detay raho , aur jiss tarah tumhen hukum diya gaya hai , ( issi deen per ) jamay raho , aur inn logon  ki khuwaishaat kay peechay naa chalo , aur keh do kay :  mein to uss kitab per emaan laya hun jo Allah ney nazil ki hai , aur mujhay hukum diya gaya hai kay mein tumharay darmiyan insaf kerun . Allah humara bhi rab hai , aur tumhara bhi rab . humaray aemal humaray liye hain , aur tumharay aemal tumharay liye . humaray aur tumharay darmiyan ( abb ) koi behas nahi . Allah hum sabb ko jama keray ga , aur ussi kay paas aakhir sabb ko loattna hai .

ayahs.text: aur jo log Allah kay baaray mein behasen nikaltay hain jabkay log uss ki baat maan chukay hain , unn ki behas unn kay perwerdigar kay nazdeek batil hai , aur unn per ( Allah ka ) ghazab hai , aur unn kay liye sakht azab .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log Allah kay baaray mein behasen nikaltay hain jabkay log uss ki baat maan chukay hain , unn ki behas unn kay perwerdigar kay nazdeek batil hai , aur unn per ( Allah ka ) ghazab hai , aur unn kay liye sakht azab .

ayahs.text: Allah woh hai jiss ney haq per mushtamil yeh kitab aur insaf ki tarazoo utaari hai . aur tumhen kiya pata , shayad kay qayamat ki gharri qareeb hi ho .
ayahs.translation: Allah woh hai jiss ney haq per mushtamil yeh kitab aur insaf ki tarazoo utaari hai . aur tumhen kiya pata , shayad kay qayamat ki gharri qareeb hi ho .

ayahs.text: jo log uss per emaan nahi rakhtay , woh uss kay aaney ki jaldi machatay hain , aur jo log emaan laye hain , woh uss say sehmay rehtay hain , aur jantay hain kay woh bar-haq hai . aray jo log qayamat kay baaray mein behasen ker rahey hain , woh gumrahi mein boht door chalay gaye hain .
ayahs.translation: jo log uss per emaan nahi rakhtay , woh uss kay aaney ki jaldi machatay hain , aur jo log emaan laye hain , woh uss say sehmay rehtay hain , aur jantay hain kay woh bar-haq hai . aray jo log qayamat kay baaray mein behasen ker rahey hain , woh gumrahi mein boht door chalay gaye hain .

ayahs.text: Allah apney bandon per boht meharban hai , woh jiss ko chahta hai , rizq deta hai , aur wohi hai jo quooat ka bhi malik hai , iqtidar ka bhi malik .
ayahs.translation: Allah apney bandon per boht meharban hai , woh jiss ko chahta hai , rizq deta hai , aur wohi hai jo quooat ka bhi malik hai , iqtidar ka bhi malik .

ayahs.text: jo shaks aakhirat ki kheti chahta ho , hum uss ki kheti mein aur izafa keren gay , aur jo shaks ( sirf ) duniya ki kheti chahta ho , hum ussay ussi mein say dey den gay ,   aur aakhirat mein uss ka koi hissa nahi .
ayahs.translation: jo shaks aakhirat ki kheti chahta ho , hum uss ki kheti mein aur izafa keren gay , aur jo shaks ( sirf ) duniya ki kheti chahta ho , hum ussay ussi mein say dey den gay ,   aur aakhirat mein uss ka koi hissa nahi .

ayahs.text: kiya inn ( kafiron ) kay kuch aesay shareek hain jinhon ney inn kay liye aisa deen tey kerdiya hai jiss ki Allah ney ijazat nahi di hai ? aur agar ( Allah ki taraf say ) faisla kunn baat tey shuda naa hoti to inn ka moamla chuka diya gaya hota . aur yaqeen rakho kay inn zalimon kay liye bara dardnak azab hai .
ayahs.translation: kiya inn ( kafiron ) kay kuch aesay shareek hain jinhon ney inn kay liye aisa deen tey kerdiya hai jiss ki Allah ney ijazat nahi di hai ? aur agar ( Allah ki taraf say ) faisla kunn baat tey shuda naa hoti to inn ka moamla chuka diya gaya hota . aur yaqeen rakho kay inn zalimon kay liye bara dardnak azab hai .

ayahs.text: . ( uss waqt ) tum inn zalimon ko dekho gay kay unhon ney jo kamai ki hai , uss ( kay wabal ) say sehmay huye hon gay , aur woh unn per parr ker rahey ga . aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , woh jannaton ki kiyariyon mein hon gay . unhen apney perwerdigar kay paas woh sabb kuch milay ga jo woh chahen gay . yehi bara fazal hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( uss waqt ) tum inn zalimon ko dekho gay kay unhon ney jo kamai ki hai , uss ( kay wabal ) say sehmay huye hon gay , aur woh unn per parr ker rahey ga . aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , woh jannaton ki kiyariyon mein hon gay . unhen apney perwerdigar kay paas woh sabb kuch milay ga jo woh chahen gay . yehi bara fazal hai .

ayahs.text: yehi woh cheez hai jiss ki khushkhabri Allah apney unn bandon ko deta hai jo emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain . ( aey payghumber ! kafiron say ) keh do kay :  mein tum say iss ( tableegh ) per koi ujrat nahi maangta , siwaye rishta daari ki mohabbat kay .    aur jo shaks koi bhalai keray ga , hum uss ki khatir uss bhalai mein mazeed khoobi ka izafa kerden gay .   yaqeen jano Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara qadardaan hai .
ayahs.translation: yehi woh cheez hai jiss ki khushkhabri Allah apney unn bandon ko deta hai jo emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain . ( aey payghumber ! kafiron say ) keh do kay :  mein tum say iss ( tableegh ) per koi ujrat nahi maangta , siwaye rishta daari ki mohabbat kay .    aur jo shaks koi bhalai keray ga , hum uss ki khatir uss bhalai mein mazeed khoobi ka izafa kerden gay .   yaqeen jano Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara qadardaan hai .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya yeh log yun kehtay hain kay iss shaks ney yeh kalam khud gharr ker jhoot moott Allah kay zimmay laga diya hai ? halankay agar Allah chahye to tumharay dil per mohar laga dey , aur Allah to batil ko mitatta hai , aur haq ko apney kalmaat kay zariye sabit kerta hai .   yaqeenan woh seenon mein chupi hoi baaton tak ko janta hai .
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya yeh log yun kehtay hain kay iss shaks ney yeh kalam khud gharr ker jhoot moott Allah kay zimmay laga diya hai ? halankay agar Allah chahye to tumharay dil per mohar laga dey , aur Allah to batil ko mitatta hai , aur haq ko apney kalmaat kay zariye sabit kerta hai .   yaqeenan woh seenon mein chupi hoi baaton tak ko janta hai .

ayahs.text: aur wohi hai jo apney bandon ki tauba qubool kerta hai , aur gunahon ko moaaf kerta hai , aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , uss ka poora ilm rakhta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur wohi hai jo apney bandon ki tauba qubool kerta hai , aur gunahon ko moaaf kerta hai , aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , uss ka poora ilm rakhta hai .

ayahs.text: aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , woh unn ki dua sunta hai , aur unhen apney fazal say aur ziyada deta hai . aur kafiron kay liye sakht azab hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , woh unn ki dua sunta hai , aur unhen apney fazal say aur ziyada deta hai . aur kafiron kay liye sakht azab hai .

ayahs.text: aur agar Allah apney tamam bandon kay liye rizq ko khulay tor per phela deta to woh zameen mein sarkashi kernay lagtay , magar woh aik khaas andazay say jitna chahta hai ( rizq ) utaarta hai . yaqeenan woh apney bandon say poori tarah ba-khabar , unn per nazar rakhney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur agar Allah apney tamam bandon kay liye rizq ko khulay tor per phela deta to woh zameen mein sarkashi kernay lagtay , magar woh aik khaas andazay say jitna chahta hai ( rizq ) utaarta hai . yaqeenan woh apney bandon say poori tarah ba-khabar , unn per nazar rakhney wala hai .

ayahs.text: aur wohi hai jo logon  kay naa umeed honey kay baad barish barsata aur apni rehmat phela deta hai , aur wohi hai jo ( sabb ka ) qabil-e-tareef rakhwala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur wohi hai jo logon  kay naa umeed honey kay baad barish barsata aur apni rehmat phela deta hai , aur wohi hai jo ( sabb ka ) qabil-e-tareef rakhwala hai .

ayahs.text: aur uss ki nishaniyon mein say hai aasmano aur zameen ki pedaeesh aur woh jandaar jo uss ney unn dono mein phela rakhay hain . aur woh jab chahye , unn ko jama kernay per poori qudrat rakhta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur uss ki nishaniyon mein say hai aasmano aur zameen ki pedaeesh aur woh jandaar jo uss ney unn dono mein phela rakhay hain . aur woh jab chahye , unn ko jama kernay per poori qudrat rakhta hai .

ayahs.text: aur tumhen jo koi museebat phonchti hai , woh tumharay apney haathon kiye huye kamon ki wajeh say phonchti hai , aur boht say kamon say to woh darguzar hi kerta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur tumhen jo koi museebat phonchti hai , woh tumharay apney haathon kiye huye kamon ki wajeh say phonchti hai , aur boht say kamon say to woh darguzar hi kerta hai .

ayahs.text: aur tumhari majal nahi hai kay zameen mein ( Allah ko ) aajiz ker-sako , aur Allah kay siwa tumhara naa koi rakhwala hai , naa madadgaar .
ayahs.translation: aur tumhari majal nahi hai kay zameen mein ( Allah ko ) aajiz ker-sako , aur Allah kay siwa tumhara naa koi rakhwala hai , naa madadgaar .

ayahs.text: aur uss ki nishaniyon mein say hain samandar mein yeh paharon jaisay jahaz !
ayahs.translation: aur uss ki nishaniyon mein say hain samandar mein yeh paharon jaisay jahaz !

ayahs.text: agar woh chahye to hawa ko thehra dey , jiss say yeh samandar ki pusht per kharray kay kharray reh jayen yaqeenan iss mein her uss shaks kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo sabar ka bhi khoogar ho , shukar ka bhi
ayahs.translation: agar woh chahye to hawa ko thehra dey , jiss say yeh samandar ki pusht per kharray kay kharray reh jayen yaqeenan iss mein her uss shaks kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo sabar ka bhi khoogar ho , shukar ka bhi

ayahs.text: ya ( agar Allah Chahye ) to in jahazon ko logon kay baaz aemal ki wajeh sy tabah hi karday , aur boht son say darguzar kar jaye ,
ayahs.translation: ya ( agar Allah Chahye ) to in jahazon ko logon kay baaz aemal ki wajeh sy tabah hi karday , aur boht son say darguzar kar jaye ,

ayahs.text: aur jo log humari aayaton mein jhagray daaltay hain , unhen pata chal jaye kay unn kay liye koi bachao ki jagah nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log humari aayaton mein jhagray daaltay hain , unhen pata chal jaye kay unn kay liye koi bachao ki jagah nahi hai .

ayahs.text: gharz tumhen jo koi cheez di gaee hai , woh dunyawi zindagi ki poonji hai , aur jo kuch Allah kay paas hai , woh unn logon  kay liye kahen behtar aur payedaar hai jo emaan laye hain , aur apney perwerdigar per bharosa kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: gharz tumhen jo koi cheez di gaee hai , woh dunyawi zindagi ki poonji hai , aur jo kuch Allah kay paas hai , woh unn logon  kay liye kahen behtar aur payedaar hai jo emaan laye hain , aur apney perwerdigar per bharosa kertay hain .

ayahs.text: aur jo baray baray gunahon aur bey hayai kay kamon say perhez kertay hain , aur jab unn ko ghussa aata hai to woh darguzar say kaam letay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jo baray baray gunahon aur bey hayai kay kamon say perhez kertay hain , aur jab unn ko ghussa aata hai to woh darguzar say kaam letay hain .

ayahs.text: aur jinhon ney apney perwerdigar ki baat maani hai , aur namaz qaeem ki hai , aur unn kay moamlaat aapas kay mashwaray say tey hotay hain , aur hum ney unhen jo rizq diya hai , uss mein say woh ( naiki kay kamon mein ) kharch kertay hain ,
ayahs.translation: aur jinhon ney apney perwerdigar ki baat maani hai , aur namaz qaeem ki hai , aur unn kay moamlaat aapas kay mashwaray say tey hotay hain , aur hum ney unhen jo rizq diya hai , uss mein say woh ( naiki kay kamon mein ) kharch kertay hain ,

ayahs.text: aur jab unn per koi ziyadti hoti hai to woh apna difaa kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jab unn per koi ziyadti hoti hai to woh apna difaa kertay hain .

ayahs.text: aur kissi burai ka badla ussi jaisi burai hai .   phir bhi jo koi moaaf kerday , aur islaah say kaam ley to uss ka sawab Allah ney zimmay liya hai . yaqeenan woh zalimon ko pasand nahi kerta .
ayahs.translation: aur kissi burai ka badla ussi jaisi burai hai .   phir bhi jo koi moaaf kerday , aur islaah say kaam ley to uss ka sawab Allah ney zimmay liya hai . yaqeenan woh zalimon ko pasand nahi kerta .

ayahs.text: aur jo shaks apney oopper zulm honey kay baad ( barabar ka ) badla ley to aesay logon  per koi ilzam nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jo shaks apney oopper zulm honey kay baad ( barabar ka ) badla ley to aesay logon  per koi ilzam nahi hai .

ayahs.text: ilzam to unn per hai jo logon  per zulm kertay aur zameen mein nahaq ziyadtiyan kertay hain . aesay logon  kay liye dardnak azab hai .
ayahs.translation: ilzam to unn per hai jo logon  per zulm kertay aur zameen mein nahaq ziyadtiyan kertay hain . aesay logon  kay liye dardnak azab hai .

ayahs.text: aur yeh haqeeqat hai kay jo koi sabar say kaam ley , aur darguzar ker jaye to yeh bari himmat ki baat hai .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh haqeeqat hai kay jo koi sabar say kaam ley , aur darguzar ker jaye to yeh bari himmat ki baat hai .

ayahs.text: aur jissay Allah gumrah kerday , to uss kay baad koi nahi hai jo uss ka madadgaar banay . aur jab zalimon ko azab nazar aajaye ga to tum unhen yeh kehta huwa dekho gay kay :  kiya wapis janey ka bhi koi raasta hai-?
ayahs.translation: aur jissay Allah gumrah kerday , to uss kay baad koi nahi hai jo uss ka madadgaar banay . aur jab zalimon ko azab nazar aajaye ga to tum unhen yeh kehta huwa dekho gay kay :  kiya wapis janey ka bhi koi raasta hai-?

ayahs.text: aur tum unhen dekho gay kay dozakh kay samney unhen iss tarah paish kiya jaye ga kay woh zillat kay maaray jhukay huye kinn ankhiyon say dekh rahey hon gay . aur jo log emaan laa-chukay hain woh keh rahey hon gay kay :  waqaee asal khasaray mein woh log hain jinhon ney qayamat kay din apney aap ko aur apney ghar walon ko khasaray mein daal diya .  yaad rakho kay zalim log aesay azab mein hon gay jo hamesha qaeem rahey ga ,
ayahs.translation: aur tum unhen dekho gay kay dozakh kay samney unhen iss tarah paish kiya jaye ga kay woh zillat kay maaray jhukay huye kinn ankhiyon say dekh rahey hon gay . aur jo log emaan laa-chukay hain woh keh rahey hon gay kay :  waqaee asal khasaray mein woh log hain jinhon ney qayamat kay din apney aap ko aur apney ghar walon ko khasaray mein daal diya .  yaad rakho kay zalim log aesay azab mein hon gay jo hamesha qaeem rahey ga ,

ayahs.text: aur unn ko aesay koi madadgaar moyassar nahi ayen gay jo Allah ko chorr ker unn ki koi madad keren . aur jissay Allah gumrah kerday , uss kay liye bachao ka koi raasta nahi hota .
ayahs.translation: aur unn ko aesay koi madadgaar moyassar nahi ayen gay jo Allah ko chorr ker unn ki koi madad keren . aur jissay Allah gumrah kerday , uss kay liye bachao ka koi raasta nahi hota .

ayahs.text: . ( logo ! ) apney perwerdigar ki baat uss din kay aaney say pehlay pehlay maan lo jissay Allah ki taraf say taala nahi jaye ga . uss din tumharay liye koi jaye panah nahi hogi , aur naa tumharay liye pooch gich ka koi moaqa hoga .
ayahs.translation: . ( logo ! ) apney perwerdigar ki baat uss din kay aaney say pehlay pehlay maan lo jissay Allah ki taraf say taala nahi jaye ga . uss din tumharay liye koi jaye panah nahi hogi , aur naa tumharay liye pooch gich ka koi moaqa hoga .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh log agar phir bhi mun morren to hum ney tumhen inn per nigran bana ker nahi bheja hai . tum per baat phoncha denay kay siwa koi zimma daari nahi hai . aur ( insan ka haal yeh hai kay ) jab hum insan ko apni taraf say kissi rehmat ka maza chakha detay hain to woh uss per itra jata hai , aur agar khud apney haathon kay kartoot ki wajeh say aesay logon  ko koi museebat paish aajati hai to wohi insan paka nashukra ban jata hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh log agar phir bhi mun morren to hum ney tumhen inn per nigran bana ker nahi bheja hai . tum per baat phoncha denay kay siwa koi zimma daari nahi hai . aur ( insan ka haal yeh hai kay ) jab hum insan ko apni taraf say kissi rehmat ka maza chakha detay hain to woh uss per itra jata hai , aur agar khud apney haathon kay kartoot ki wajeh say aesay logon  ko koi museebat paish aajati hai to wohi insan paka nashukra ban jata hai .

ayahs.text: saray aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat Allah hi ki hai . woh jo chahta hai , peda kerta hai . woh jiss ko chahta hai , larkiyan deta hai , aur jiss ko chahta hai , larkay deta hai ,
ayahs.translation: saray aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat Allah hi ki hai . woh jo chahta hai , peda kerta hai . woh jiss ko chahta hai , larkiyan deta hai , aur jiss ko chahta hai , larkay deta hai ,

ayahs.text: ya phir unn ko mila jula ker larkay bhi deta hai , aur larkiyan bhi , aur jiss ko chahta hai , baanjh bana deta hai . yaqeenan woh ilm ka bhi malik hai , qudrat ka bhi malik .
ayahs.translation: ya phir unn ko mila jula ker larkay bhi deta hai , aur larkiyan bhi , aur jiss ko chahta hai , baanjh bana deta hai . yaqeenan woh ilm ka bhi malik hai , qudrat ka bhi malik .

ayahs.text: aur kissi insan mein yeh taqat nahi hai kay Allah uss say ( roobaroo ) baat keray ,   siwaye iss kay kay woh wahi kay zariye ho , ya kissi perday kay peechay say , ya phir woh koi paygham laney wala ( farishta ) bhej dey , aur woh uss kay hukum say jo woh chahye wahi ka paygham phoncha dey . yaqeenan woh boht oonchi shaan wala , bari hikmat ka malik hai .
ayahs.translation: aur kissi insan mein yeh taqat nahi hai kay Allah uss say ( roobaroo ) baat keray ,   siwaye iss kay kay woh wahi kay zariye ho , ya kissi perday kay peechay say , ya phir woh koi paygham laney wala ( farishta ) bhej dey , aur woh uss kay hukum say jo woh chahye wahi ka paygham phoncha dey . yaqeenan woh boht oonchi shaan wala , bari hikmat ka malik hai .

ayahs.text: aur issi tarah hum ney tumharay paas apney hukum say aik rooh bator wahi nazil ki hai .   tumhen iss say pehlay naa yeh maloom tha kay kitab kiya hoti hai , aur naa yeh kay emaan kiya hai , lekin hum ney iss ( Quran ) ko aik noor banaya hai jiss kay zariye hum apney bandon mein say jiss ko chahtay hain , hidayat detay hain . aur iss mein koi shak nahi kay tum logon  ko woh seedha raasta dikha rahey ho
ayahs.translation: aur issi tarah hum ney tumharay paas apney hukum say aik rooh bator wahi nazil ki hai .   tumhen iss say pehlay naa yeh maloom tha kay kitab kiya hoti hai , aur naa yeh kay emaan kiya hai , lekin hum ney iss ( Quran ) ko aik noor banaya hai jiss kay zariye hum apney bandon mein say jiss ko chahtay hain , hidayat detay hain . aur iss mein koi shak nahi kay tum logon  ko woh seedha raasta dikha rahey ho

ayahs.text: jo Allah ka raasta hai , woh Allah jiss ki milkiyat mein woh sabb kuch hai jo aasmano mein hai , aur woh sabb kuch jo zameen mein hai . yaad rakho kay saray moamlaat aakhir kaar Allah hi ki taraf loten gay .
ayahs.translation: jo Allah ka raasta hai , woh Allah jiss ki milkiyat mein woh sabb kuch hai jo aasmano mein hai , aur woh sabb kuch jo zameen mein hai . yaad rakho kay saray moamlaat aakhir kaar Allah hi ki taraf loten gay .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: Haa-Meem .
verses.translation: Haa-Meem .

verses.text: qasam hai iss wazeh kitab ki ,
verses.translation: qasam hai iss wazeh kitab ki ,

verses.text: hum ney issay arbi zaban ka Quran banaya hai , takay tum samjho
verses.translation: hum ney issay arbi zaban ka Quran banaya hai , takay tum samjho

verses.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh humaray paas loah-e-mehfooz mein baray oonchay darjay ki hikmat say bhari hoi kitab hai .
verses.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh humaray paas loah-e-mehfooz mein baray oonchay darjay ki hikmat say bhari hoi kitab hai .

verses.text: bhala kiya hum mun morr ker iss naseehat namay ko tum say iss bana per hata len kay tum hadd say guzray huye log ho-?
verses.translation: bhala kiya hum mun morr ker iss naseehat namay ko tum say iss bana per hata len kay tum hadd say guzray huye log ho-?

verses.text: aur kitney hi nabi hum ney pichlay logon  mein bhi bhejay hain ,
verses.translation: aur kitney hi nabi hum ney pichlay logon  mein bhi bhejay hain ,

verses.text: aur unn logon  kay paas koi nabi aisa nahi aaya jiss ka woh mazaq naa uratay hon .
verses.translation: aur unn logon  kay paas koi nabi aisa nahi aaya jiss ka woh mazaq naa uratay hon .

verses.text: phir jo log inn ( makkah walon ) say kahen ziyada zor aawar thay , hum ney unhen halak kerdiya , aur unn pichlay logon  ka haal peechay guzar chuka hai .
verses.translation: phir jo log inn ( makkah walon ) say kahen ziyada zor aawar thay , hum ney unhen halak kerdiya , aur unn pichlay logon  ka haal peechay guzar chuka hai .

verses.text: aur agar tum inn ( mushrikon ) say poocho kay saray aasman aur zameen kiss ney peda kiye hain , to woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay :  unhen uss zaat ney peda kiya hai jo iqtidar ki bhi malik hai , ilm ki bhi malik .
verses.translation: aur agar tum inn ( mushrikon ) say poocho kay saray aasman aur zameen kiss ney peda kiye hain , to woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay :  unhen uss zaat ney peda kiya hai jo iqtidar ki bhi malik hai , ilm ki bhi malik .

verses.text: yeh woh zaat hai jiss ney tumharay liye zameen ko bichona banaya , aur uss mein tumharay liye raastay banaye , takay tum manzil tak phonch sako ,
verses.translation: yeh woh zaat hai jiss ney tumharay liye zameen ko bichona banaya , aur uss mein tumharay liye raastay banaye , takay tum manzil tak phonch sako ,

verses.text: aur jiss ney aasman say aik khaas andazay say paani utaara , phir hum ney uss kay zariye aik murda ilaqay ko naee zindagi dey di issi tarah tumhen ( qabron say ) nikal ker naee zindagi di jaye gi
verses.translation: aur jiss ney aasman say aik khaas andazay say paani utaara , phir hum ney uss kay zariye aik murda ilaqay ko naee zindagi dey di issi tarah tumhen ( qabron say ) nikal ker naee zindagi di jaye gi

verses.text: aur jiss ney her tarah kay jooray peda kiye , aur tumharay liye woh kashtiyan aur chopaye banaye jinn per tum sawari kertay ho ,
verses.translation: aur jiss ney her tarah kay jooray peda kiye , aur tumharay liye woh kashtiyan aur chopaye banaye jinn per tum sawari kertay ho ,

verses.text: takay tum unn ki pusht per charrho , phir jab unn per charh ker beth jao to apney perwerdigar ki naimat ko yaad kero , aur yeh kaho kay :  pak hai woh zaat jiss ney iss sawari ko humaray bus mein dey diya , werna hum mein yeh taqat nahi thi kay iss ko qaboo mein laasaktay .
verses.translation: takay tum unn ki pusht per charrho , phir jab unn per charh ker beth jao to apney perwerdigar ki naimat ko yaad kero , aur yeh kaho kay :  pak hai woh zaat jiss ney iss sawari ko humaray bus mein dey diya , werna hum mein yeh taqat nahi thi kay iss ko qaboo mein laasaktay .

verses.text: aur beyshak hum apney perwerdigar ki taraf loat ker janey walay hain .
verses.translation: aur beyshak hum apney perwerdigar ki taraf loat ker janey walay hain .

verses.text: aur inn ( mushrik ) logon  ney yeh baat banai hai kay Allah ka khud uss kay bandon mein say koi juzz hai .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay insan khullam khula nashukra hai .
verses.translation: aur inn ( mushrik ) logon  ney yeh baat banai hai kay Allah ka khud uss kay bandon mein say koi juzz hai .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay insan khullam khula nashukra hai .

verses.text: bhala kiya Allah ney apni makhlooq mein say apney liye to betiyan pasand ki hain , aur tumhen beton kay liye muntakhib kiya hai-?
verses.translation: bhala kiya Allah ney apni makhlooq mein say apney liye to betiyan pasand ki hain , aur tumhen beton kay liye muntakhib kiya hai-?

verses.text: halankay unn mein say kissi ko jab uss ( beti ) ki ( wiladat ) ki khushkhabri di jati hai jo uss ney khudaye rehman ki taraf mansoob ker rakhi hai to uss ka chehra siyah parr-jata hai , aur woh dil hi dil mein ghutta rehta hai .
verses.translation: halankay unn mein say kissi ko jab uss ( beti ) ki ( wiladat ) ki khushkhabri di jati hai jo uss ney khudaye rehman ki taraf mansoob ker rakhi hai to uss ka chehra siyah parr-jata hai , aur woh dil hi dil mein ghutta rehta hai .

verses.text: aur kiya ( Allah ney aesi aulad pasand ki hai ) jo zewaron mein paali posi jati hai , aur jo behas mubahisay mein apni baat khul ker bhi nahi keh sakti-?
verses.translation: aur kiya ( Allah ney aesi aulad pasand ki hai ) jo zewaron mein paali posi jati hai , aur jo behas mubahisay mein apni baat khul ker bhi nahi keh sakti-?

verses.text: iss kay ilawa unhon ney farishton ko jo khudaye rehman kay banday hain , moannis bana diya hai . kiya yeh log unn ki takhleeq kay waqt mojood thay-? inn ka yeh dawa likh liya jaye ga , aur inn say baaz purs hogi .
verses.translation: iss kay ilawa unhon ney farishton ko jo khudaye rehman kay banday hain , moannis bana diya hai . kiya yeh log unn ki takhleeq kay waqt mojood thay-? inn ka yeh dawa likh liya jaye ga , aur inn say baaz purs hogi .

verses.text: aur yeh kehtay hain kay :  agar khudaye rehman chahta to hum inn ( farishton ) ki ibadat naa kertay .  inn ko iss baat ki haqeeqat ka zara bhi ilm nahi hai , aur inn ka kaam iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay andazon kay teer chalatay hain .
verses.translation: aur yeh kehtay hain kay :  agar khudaye rehman chahta to hum inn ( farishton ) ki ibadat naa kertay .  inn ko iss baat ki haqeeqat ka zara bhi ilm nahi hai , aur inn ka kaam iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay andazon kay teer chalatay hain .

verses.text: bhala kiya hum ney unhen iss say pehlay koi kitab di thi jissay yeh thamay bethay hain-?
verses.translation: bhala kiya hum ney unhen iss say pehlay koi kitab di thi jissay yeh thamay bethay hain-?

verses.text: nahi , balkay inn ka kehna yeh hai kay hum ney apney baap dadon ko aik tareeqay per paya hai , aur hum unhi kay naqsh-e-qadam kay mutabiq theek theek raastay per jarahey hain .
verses.translation: nahi , balkay inn ka kehna yeh hai kay hum ney apney baap dadon ko aik tareeqay per paya hai , aur hum unhi kay naqsh-e-qadam kay mutabiq theek theek raastay per jarahey hain .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum say pehlay jab bhi kissi basti mein koi khabrdar kernay wala ( payghumber ) bheja to wahan kay dolat mand logon  ney yehi kaha kay :  hum ney apney baap dadon ko aik tareeqay per paya hai , aur hum unhi kay naqsh-e-qadam kay peechay chal rahey hain .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum say pehlay jab bhi kissi basti mein koi khabrdar kernay wala ( payghumber ) bheja to wahan kay dolat mand logon  ney yehi kaha kay :  hum ney apney baap dadon ko aik tareeqay per paya hai , aur hum unhi kay naqsh-e-qadam kay peechay chal rahey hain .

verses.text: payghumber ney kaha kay :  tum ney apney baap dadon ko jiss tareeqay per paya hai , agar mein tumharay paas uss say ziyada hidayat ki baat ley ker aaya hun to kiya phir bhi ( tum apney tareeqay per chalay jao gay-? )  unhon ney jawab diya kay :  tum jo paygham dey ker bhejay gaye ho hum to uss ko manney walay nahi hain .
verses.translation: payghumber ney kaha kay :  tum ney apney baap dadon ko jiss tareeqay per paya hai , agar mein tumharay paas uss say ziyada hidayat ki baat ley ker aaya hun to kiya phir bhi ( tum apney tareeqay per chalay jao gay-? )  unhon ney jawab diya kay :  tum jo paygham dey ker bhejay gaye ho hum to uss ko manney walay nahi hain .

verses.text: nateeja yeh huwa kay hum ney unn say intiqam liya , abb dekh lo kay jhutlaney walon ka anjam kaisa huwa-?
verses.translation: nateeja yeh huwa kay hum ney unn say intiqam liya , abb dekh lo kay jhutlaney walon ka anjam kaisa huwa-?

verses.text: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab Ibrahim ney apney baap aur apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  mein unn cheezon say beyzar hun jinn ki tum ibadat kertay ho ,
verses.translation: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab Ibrahim ney apney baap aur apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  mein unn cheezon say beyzar hun jinn ki tum ibadat kertay ho ,

verses.text: siwaye uss zaat kay jiss ney mujhay peda kiya hai , chunacheh wohi meri rehnumai kerta hai .
verses.translation: siwaye uss zaat kay jiss ney mujhay peda kiya hai , chunacheh wohi meri rehnumai kerta hai .

verses.text: aur Ibrahim ney iss ( aqeeday ) ko aesi baat bana diya jo unn ki aulad mein baqi rahi , takay log ( shirk say ) baaz ayen .
verses.translation: aur Ibrahim ney iss ( aqeeday ) ko aesi baat bana diya jo unn ki aulad mein baqi rahi , takay log ( shirk say ) baaz ayen .

verses.text: . ( phir bhi boht say log baaz naa aaye ) uss kay bawajood mein ney unn ko aur unn kay baap dadon ko zindagi kay faeeday diye , yahan tak kay unn kay paas haq aur saaf saaf hidayat denay wala payghumber aagaya .
verses.translation: . ( phir bhi boht say log baaz naa aaye ) uss kay bawajood mein ney unn ko aur unn kay baap dadon ko zindagi kay faeeday diye , yahan tak kay unn kay paas haq aur saaf saaf hidayat denay wala payghumber aagaya .

verses.text: aur jab woh haq unn kay paas aaya to woh kehney lagay kay :  yeh to jadoo hai , aur hum iss ka inkar kertay hain .
verses.translation: aur jab woh haq unn kay paas aaya to woh kehney lagay kay :  yeh to jadoo hai , aur hum iss ka inkar kertay hain .

verses.text: aur kehney lagay kay :  yeh Quran do bastiyon mein say kissi baray aadmi per kiyon nazil nahi kiya gaya-?
verses.translation: aur kehney lagay kay :  yeh Quran do bastiyon mein say kissi baray aadmi per kiyon nazil nahi kiya gaya-?

verses.text: bhala kiya yeh log hain jo tumharay perwerdigar ki rehmat taqseem keren gay-?   dunyawi zindagi mein inn ki rozi kay zaraye bhi hum ney hi inn kay darmiyan taqseem ker rakhay hain , aur hum ney hi inn mein say aik ko doosray per darjaat mein foqiyat di hai , takay woh aik doosray say kaam ley saken . aur tumharay perwerdigar ki rehmat to uss ( dolat ) say kahen behtar cheez hai jo yeh jama ker rahey hain .
verses.translation: bhala kiya yeh log hain jo tumharay perwerdigar ki rehmat taqseem keren gay-?   dunyawi zindagi mein inn ki rozi kay zaraye bhi hum ney hi inn kay darmiyan taqseem ker rakhay hain , aur hum ney hi inn mein say aik ko doosray per darjaat mein foqiyat di hai , takay woh aik doosray say kaam ley saken . aur tumharay perwerdigar ki rehmat to uss ( dolat ) say kahen behtar cheez hai jo yeh jama ker rahey hain .

verses.text: aur agar yeh andesha naa hota kay tamam insan aik hi tareeqay kay ( yani kafir ) hojayen gay to jo log khudaye rehman kay munkir hain , hum unn kay liye unn kay gharon ki chatten bhi chaandi ki bana detay , aur woh serhiyan bhi jinn per woh charrhtay hain ,
verses.translation: aur agar yeh andesha naa hota kay tamam insan aik hi tareeqay kay ( yani kafir ) hojayen gay to jo log khudaye rehman kay munkir hain , hum unn kay liye unn kay gharon ki chatten bhi chaandi ki bana detay , aur woh serhiyan bhi jinn per woh charrhtay hain ,

verses.text: aur unn kay gharon kay darwazay bhi , aur woh takht bhi jinn per woh takiya laga ker bethtay hain .
verses.translation: aur unn kay gharon kay darwazay bhi , aur woh takht bhi jinn per woh takiya laga ker bethtay hain .

verses.text: balkay unhen sona bana detay . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh sabb kuch bhi nahi , sirf dunyawi zindagi ka saman hai .   aur aakhirat tumharay perwerdigar kay nazdeek perhezgaron kay liye hai .
verses.translation: balkay unhen sona bana detay . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh sabb kuch bhi nahi , sirf dunyawi zindagi ka saman hai .   aur aakhirat tumharay perwerdigar kay nazdeek perhezgaron kay liye hai .

verses.text: aur jo shaks khudaye rehman kay ziker say andha ban jaye , hum uss per aik shetan musallat ker-detay hain jo uss ka sathi ban jata hai .
verses.translation: aur jo shaks khudaye rehman kay ziker say andha ban jaye , hum uss per aik shetan musallat ker-detay hain jo uss ka sathi ban jata hai .

verses.text: aesay shayateen unn ko raastay say roktay rehtay hain , aur woh samajhtay hain kay hum theek raastay per hain .
verses.translation: aesay shayateen unn ko raastay say roktay rehtay hain , aur woh samajhtay hain kay hum theek raastay per hain .

verses.text: yahan tak kay jab aisa shaks humaray paas aaye ga to ( apney shetan sathi say ) kahey ga kay :  kaash ! meray aur teray darmiyan mashriq o maghrib ka fasla hota , kiyonkay tu boht bura sathi tha .
verses.translation: yahan tak kay jab aisa shaks humaray paas aaye ga to ( apney shetan sathi say ) kahey ga kay :  kaash ! meray aur teray darmiyan mashriq o maghrib ka fasla hota , kiyonkay tu boht bura sathi tha .

verses.text: aur aaj jab tum zulm ker-chukay ho to tumhen yeh baat hergiz koi faeeda nahi phonchaye gi kay tum azab mein aik doosray kay shareek ho .
verses.translation: aur aaj jab tum zulm ker-chukay ho to tumhen yeh baat hergiz koi faeeda nahi phonchaye gi kay tum azab mein aik doosray kay shareek ho .

verses.text: to phir ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya tum behron ko sunao gay , ya andhon ko aur unn logon  ko raastay per lao gay jo khuli gumrahi mein parray huye hain-?
verses.translation: to phir ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya tum behron ko sunao gay , ya andhon ko aur unn logon  ko raastay per lao gay jo khuli gumrahi mein parray huye hain-?

verses.text: abb to yehi hoga kay agar hum tumhen duniya say uthalen , tab bhi hum inn say badla lenay walay hain ,
verses.translation: abb to yehi hoga kay agar hum tumhen duniya say uthalen , tab bhi hum inn say badla lenay walay hain ,

verses.text: ya agar tumhen bhi woh ( azab ) dikha den jiss ka hum ney inn say wada kiya hai , tab bhi hamen inn per her tarah ki qudrat hasil hai .
verses.translation: ya agar tumhen bhi woh ( azab ) dikha den jiss ka hum ney inn say wada kiya hai , tab bhi hamen inn per her tarah ki qudrat hasil hai .

verses.text: lehaza tum per jo wahi nazil ki gaee hai , ussay mazbooti say thamay rakho , yaqeenan tum seedhay raastay per ho .
verses.translation: lehaza tum per jo wahi nazil ki gaee hai , ussay mazbooti say thamay rakho , yaqeenan tum seedhay raastay per ho .

verses.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh wahi tumharay liye aur tumhari qoam kay liye aik naik naami ka zariya hai , aur tum sabb say poocha jaye ga ( kay tum ney iss ka kiya haq ada kiya-? )
verses.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh wahi tumharay liye aur tumhari qoam kay liye aik naik naami ka zariya hai , aur tum sabb say poocha jaye ga ( kay tum ney iss ka kiya haq ada kiya-? )

verses.text: aur tum say pehlay hum ney apney jo payghumber bhejay hain , unn say pooch lo   kay kiya hum ney khudaye rehman kay siwa koi aur mabood bhi muqarrar kiye thay jinn ki ibadat ki jaye-?
verses.translation: aur tum say pehlay hum ney apney jo payghumber bhejay hain , unn say pooch lo   kay kiya hum ney khudaye rehman kay siwa koi aur mabood bhi muqarrar kiye thay jinn ki ibadat ki jaye-?

verses.text: aur hum ney musa ko apni nishaniyan dey ker firon aur uss kay sardaron kay paas bheja tha , chunacheh musa ney kaha kay :  mein Rabb-ul-Aalameen ka bheja huwa payghumber hun .
verses.translation: aur hum ney musa ko apni nishaniyan dey ker firon aur uss kay sardaron kay paas bheja tha , chunacheh musa ney kaha kay :  mein Rabb-ul-Aalameen ka bheja huwa payghumber hun .

verses.text: phir jab unhon ney humari nishaniyan unn kay samney paish ken to woh unn ka mazaq uraney lagay .
verses.translation: phir jab unhon ney humari nishaniyan unn kay samney paish ken to woh unn ka mazaq uraney lagay .

verses.text: aur hum unhen jo nishani bhi dikhatay , woh pehli nishani say barh charh ker hoti thi , aur hum ney unhen azab mein bhi pakra , takay woh baaz aajayen .
verses.translation: aur hum unhen jo nishani bhi dikhatay , woh pehli nishani say barh charh ker hoti thi , aur hum ney unhen azab mein bhi pakra , takay woh baaz aajayen .

verses.text: aur woh yeh kehney lagay kay :  aey jadoogar ! tum say tumharay perwerdigar ney jo ehad ker rakha hai , uss ka wasta dey ker uss say humaray liye dua kero , hum yaqeenan raah-e-raast per aajayen gay .
verses.translation: aur woh yeh kehney lagay kay :  aey jadoogar ! tum say tumharay perwerdigar ney jo ehad ker rakha hai , uss ka wasta dey ker uss say humaray liye dua kero , hum yaqeenan raah-e-raast per aajayen gay .

verses.text: phir jab hum unn say azab ko door ker-detay to pal bhar mein woh apna wada torr daaltay thay .
verses.translation: phir jab hum unn say azab ko door ker-detay to pal bhar mein woh apna wada torr daaltay thay .

verses.text: aur firon ney apni qoam kay darmiyan pukar ker kaha kay :  aey meri qoam ! kiya misir ki saltanat meray qabazay mein nahi hai-? aur ( dekho ) yeh darya meray neechay beh rahey hain . kiya tumhen dikhai nahi deta-?
verses.translation: aur firon ney apni qoam kay darmiyan pukar ker kaha kay :  aey meri qoam ! kiya misir ki saltanat meray qabazay mein nahi hai-? aur ( dekho ) yeh darya meray neechay beh rahey hain . kiya tumhen dikhai nahi deta-?

verses.text: ya phir maano kay mein iss shaks say kahen behtar hun jo bara haqeer qisam ka hai , aur apni baat khul ker kehna bhi iss kay liye mushkil hai .
verses.translation: ya phir maano kay mein iss shaks say kahen behtar hun jo bara haqeer qisam ka hai , aur apni baat khul ker kehna bhi iss kay liye mushkil hai .

verses.text: bhala ( agar yeh payghumber hai to ) iss per soney kay kanggan kiyon nahi daalay gaye-? ya phir iss kay sath farishtay paray baandhay huye kiyon naa aaye-?
verses.translation: bhala ( agar yeh payghumber hai to ) iss per soney kay kanggan kiyon nahi daalay gaye-? ya phir iss kay sath farishtay paray baandhay huye kiyon naa aaye-?

verses.text: iss tarah uss ney apni qoam ko beywaqoof banaya , aur unhon ney uss ka kehna maan liya . haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh sabb gunehgaar log thay .
verses.translation: iss tarah uss ney apni qoam ko beywaqoof banaya , aur unhon ney uss ka kehna maan liya . haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh sabb gunehgaar log thay .

verses.text: chunacheh jab unhon ney hamen naraz kerdiya to hum ney unn say intiqam liya , aur unn sabb ko gharq kerdiya .
verses.translation: chunacheh jab unhon ney hamen naraz kerdiya to hum ney unn say intiqam liya , aur unn sabb ko gharq kerdiya .

verses.text: aur hum ney unhen aik gaee guzri qoam aur baad walon kay liye ibrat ka namoona banadiya .
verses.translation: aur hum ney unhen aik gaee guzri qoam aur baad walon kay liye ibrat ka namoona banadiya .

verses.text: aur jab ( essa ) ibn-e-maryam ki misal di gaee to tumhari qoam kay log yakayak shor machaney lagay .
verses.translation: aur jab ( essa ) ibn-e-maryam ki misal di gaee to tumhari qoam kay log yakayak shor machaney lagay .

verses.text: aur kehney lagay kay :  humaray mabood behtar hain ya woh-?  unhon ney tumharay samney yeh misal mehaz katt hujjati kay liye di hai , balkay yeh log hain hi jhagrraloo .
verses.translation: aur kehney lagay kay :  humaray mabood behtar hain ya woh-?  unhon ney tumharay samney yeh misal mehaz katt hujjati kay liye di hai , balkay yeh log hain hi jhagrraloo .

verses.text: woh ( yani essa aleh-assalam ) to bus humaray aik banday thay jinn per hum ney inaam kiya tha , aur bani Israel kay liye unn ko aik namoona banaya tha .
verses.translation: woh ( yani essa aleh-assalam ) to bus humaray aik banday thay jinn per hum ney inaam kiya tha , aur bani Israel kay liye unn ko aik namoona banaya tha .

verses.text: aur agar hum chahen to tum say farishtay peda kerden jo zameen mein aik doosray kay janasheen ban ker raha keren .
verses.translation: aur agar hum chahen to tum say farishtay peda kerden jo zameen mein aik doosray kay janasheen ban ker raha keren .

verses.text: aur yaqeen rakho kay woh ( yani essa aleh-assalam ) qayamat ki aik nishani hain ,   iss liye tum uss mein shak naa kero , aur meri baat maano . yehi seedha raasta hai .
verses.translation: aur yaqeen rakho kay woh ( yani essa aleh-assalam ) qayamat ki aik nishani hain ,   iss liye tum uss mein shak naa kero , aur meri baat maano . yehi seedha raasta hai .

verses.text: aur aisa hergiz naa honey paye kay shetan tumhen iss raastay say rok dey . yaqeen jano woh tumhara khula dushman hai .
verses.translation: aur aisa hergiz naa honey paye kay shetan tumhen iss raastay say rok dey . yaqeen jano woh tumhara khula dushman hai .

verses.text: aur jab essa khuli hoi nishaniyan ley ker aaye thay to unhon ney ( logon  say ) kaha tha kay :  mein tumharay paas danai ki baat ley ker aaya hun , aur iss liye laya hun kay tumharay samney kuch woh cheezen wazeh kerdun jinn mein tum ikhtilaf kertay ho . lehaza tum Allah say daro , aur meri baat maan lo .
verses.translation: aur jab essa khuli hoi nishaniyan ley ker aaye thay to unhon ney ( logon  say ) kaha tha kay :  mein tumharay paas danai ki baat ley ker aaya hun , aur iss liye laya hun kay tumharay samney kuch woh cheezen wazeh kerdun jinn mein tum ikhtilaf kertay ho . lehaza tum Allah say daro , aur meri baat maan lo .

verses.text: yaqeenan Allah hi mera bhi rab hai , aur tumhara bhi rab hai , iss liye uss ki ibadat kero . yehi seedha raasta hai .
verses.translation: yaqeenan Allah hi mera bhi rab hai , aur tumhara bhi rab hai , iss liye uss ki ibadat kero . yehi seedha raasta hai .

verses.text: phir bhi unn mein say kaee girohon ney ikhtilaf peda kiya , chunacheh unn zalimon kay liye aik dardnak din kay azab ki wajeh say bari kharabi hogi .
verses.translation: phir bhi unn mein say kaee girohon ney ikhtilaf peda kiya , chunacheh unn zalimon kay liye aik dardnak din kay azab ki wajeh say bari kharabi hogi .

verses.text: yeh log bus iss baat ka intizar ker rahey hain kay qayamat inn kay samney achanak aa-khari ho , aur enhen khabar bhi naa ho .
verses.translation: yeh log bus iss baat ka intizar ker rahey hain kay qayamat inn kay samney achanak aa-khari ho , aur enhen khabar bhi naa ho .

verses.text: uss din tamam dost aik doosray kay dushman hon gay , siwaye muttaqi logon  kay ,
verses.translation: uss din tamam dost aik doosray kay dushman hon gay , siwaye muttaqi logon  kay ,

verses.text: . ( jinn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  aey meray bando ! aaj tum per naa koi khof taari hoga , aur naa tum ghumgeen hogay .
verses.translation: . ( jinn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  aey meray bando ! aaj tum per naa koi khof taari hoga , aur naa tum ghumgeen hogay .

verses.text: aey meray woh bando jo humari aayaton per emaan laye thay , aur farmanbardaar rahey thay !
verses.translation: aey meray woh bando jo humari aayaton per emaan laye thay , aur farmanbardaar rahey thay !

verses.text: tum bhi aur tumhari biwiyan bhi , khushi say chamaktay chehron kay sath jannat mein dakhil hojao .
verses.translation: tum bhi aur tumhari biwiyan bhi , khushi say chamaktay chehron kay sath jannat mein dakhil hojao .

verses.text: unn kay aagay soney kay piyalay aur glass gardish mein laye jayen gay . aur uss jannat mein her woh cheez hogi jiss ki dilon ko khuwaish hogi , aur jiss say aankhon ko lazzat hasil hogi . ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  iss jannat mein tum hamesha raho gay .
verses.translation: unn kay aagay soney kay piyalay aur glass gardish mein laye jayen gay . aur uss jannat mein her woh cheez hogi jiss ki dilon ko khuwaish hogi , aur jiss say aankhon ko lazzat hasil hogi . ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  iss jannat mein tum hamesha raho gay .

verses.text: aur yeh woh jannat hai jiss ka tumhen apney aemal kay badlay waris bana diya gaya hai .
verses.translation: aur yeh woh jannat hai jiss ka tumhen apney aemal kay badlay waris bana diya gaya hai .

verses.text: iss mein tumharay liye khoob ifraat kay sath meway hain jinn mein say tum khao gay .
verses.translation: iss mein tumharay liye khoob ifraat kay sath meway hain jinn mein say tum khao gay .

verses.text: albatta jo log mujrim thay , woh dozakh kay azab mein hamesha rahen gay .
verses.translation: albatta jo log mujrim thay , woh dozakh kay azab mein hamesha rahen gay .

verses.text: woh azab unn kay liye halka nahi parrney diya jaye ga , aur woh uss mein mayyus parray hon gay .
verses.translation: woh azab unn kay liye halka nahi parrney diya jaye ga , aur woh uss mein mayyus parray hon gay .

verses.text: aur hum ney unn per koi zulm nahi kiya , lekin woh khud hi zalim log thay .
verses.translation: aur hum ney unn per koi zulm nahi kiya , lekin woh khud hi zalim log thay .

verses.text: aur woh ( dozakh kay farishtay say ) pukar ker kahen gay kay :  aey malik ! tumhara perwerdigar humara kaam hi tamam kerday .    woh kahey ga kay :  tumhen issi haal mein rehna hai .
verses.translation: aur woh ( dozakh kay farishtay say ) pukar ker kahen gay kay :  aey malik ! tumhara perwerdigar humara kaam hi tamam kerday .    woh kahey ga kay :  tumhen issi haal mein rehna hai .

verses.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum tumharay paas haq baat ley ker aaye thay , lekin tum mein say aksar log haq baat hi ko bura samajhtay hain .
verses.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum tumharay paas haq baat ley ker aaye thay , lekin tum mein say aksar log haq baat hi ko bura samajhtay hain .

verses.text: haan kiya inn logon  ney kuch kernay ka faisla kerliya hai ? acha to hum bhi kuch kernay ka faisla kernay walay hain .
verses.translation: haan kiya inn logon  ney kuch kernay ka faisla kerliya hai ? acha to hum bhi kuch kernay ka faisla kernay walay hain .

verses.text: kiya unhon ney yeh samajh rakha hai kay hum inn ki khufiya baaten aur inn ki sargoshiyan nahi suntay-? kaisay nahi suntay-? neez humaray farishtay inn kay paas hain , woh sabb kuch likhtay rehtay hain .
verses.translation: kiya unhon ney yeh samajh rakha hai kay hum inn ki khufiya baaten aur inn ki sargoshiyan nahi suntay-? kaisay nahi suntay-? neez humaray farishtay inn kay paas hain , woh sabb kuch likhtay rehtay hain .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay :  agar khudaye rehman ki koi aulad hoti to sabb say pehla ibadat kernay wala mein hota .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay :  agar khudaye rehman ki koi aulad hoti to sabb say pehla ibadat kernay wala mein hota .

verses.text: woh jo aasmano aur zameen ka bhi malik hai , arsh ka bhi malik , woh unn sari baaton say pak hai jo yeh banaya kertay hain .
verses.translation: woh jo aasmano aur zameen ka bhi malik hai , arsh ka bhi malik , woh unn sari baaton say pak hai jo yeh banaya kertay hain .

verses.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) unhen apney haal per chorr do kay yeh unn baaton mein doobay rahen , aur hansi khel kertay rahen , yahan tak kay woh apney uss din say ja-milen jiss ka unn say wada kiya jaraha hai .
verses.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) unhen apney haal per chorr do kay yeh unn baaton mein doobay rahen , aur hansi khel kertay rahen , yahan tak kay woh apney uss din say ja-milen jiss ka unn say wada kiya jaraha hai .

verses.text: wohi ( Allah ) hai jo aasman mein bhi mabood hai , aur zameen mein bhi mabood . aur wohi hai jo hikmat ka bhi malik hai , ilm ka bhi malik .
verses.translation: wohi ( Allah ) hai jo aasman mein bhi mabood hai , aur zameen mein bhi mabood . aur wohi hai jo hikmat ka bhi malik hai , ilm ka bhi malik .

verses.text: aur bari shaan hai uss ki jiss kay qabazay mein aasmano aur zameen aur unn kay darmiyan tamam cheezon ki saltanat hai , aur ussi kay paas qayamat ka ilm hai , aur ussi kay paas tum sabb ko wapis ley jaya jaye ga .
verses.translation: aur bari shaan hai uss ki jiss kay qabazay mein aasmano aur zameen aur unn kay darmiyan tamam cheezon ki saltanat hai , aur ussi kay paas qayamat ka ilm hai , aur ussi kay paas tum sabb ko wapis ley jaya jaye ga .

verses.text: aur yeh log ussay chorr ker jinn maboodon ko pukartay hain , unhen koi sifarish kernay ka ikhtiyar nahi hoga , haan albatta jinn logon  ney haq baat ki gawahi di ho , aur unhen uss ka ilm bhi ho .
verses.translation: aur yeh log ussay chorr ker jinn maboodon ko pukartay hain , unhen koi sifarish kernay ka ikhtiyar nahi hoga , haan albatta jinn logon  ney haq baat ki gawahi di ho , aur unhen uss ka ilm bhi ho .

verses.text: aur agar tum unn logon  say poocho kay unn ko kiss ney peda kiya hai to woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay Allah ney . iss kay bawajood koi unhen kahan say ondha chala deta hai-?
verses.translation: aur agar tum unn logon  say poocho kay unn ko kiss ney peda kiya hai to woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay Allah ney . iss kay bawajood koi unhen kahan say ondha chala deta hai-?

verses.text: aur Allah ko payghumber ki iss baat ka bhi ilm hai kay :  ya rab ! yeh aesay log hain jo emaan nahi latay .
verses.translation: aur Allah ko payghumber ki iss baat ka bhi ilm hai kay :  ya rab ! yeh aesay log hain jo emaan nahi latay .

verses.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn ki perwa naa kero , aur keh do :  salam !    kiyonkay unqareeb enhen khud sabb pata chal jaye ga .
verses.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn ki perwa naa kero , aur keh do :  salam !    kiyonkay unqareeb enhen khud sabb pata chal jaye ga .

ayahs.translation: aur unn logon  kay paas koi nabi aisa nahi aaya jiss ka woh mazaq naa uratay hon .

ayahs.translation: phir jo log inn ( makkah walon ) say kahen ziyada zor aawar thay , hum ney unhen halak kerdiya , aur unn pichlay logon  ka haal peechay guzar chuka hai .

ayahs.text: aur agar tum inn ( mushrikon ) say poocho kay saray aasman aur zameen kiss ney peda kiye hain , to woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay :  unhen uss zaat ney peda kiya hai jo iqtidar ki bhi malik hai , ilm ki bhi malik .

ayahs.text: takay tum unn ki pusht per charrho , phir jab unn per charh ker beth jao to apney perwerdigar ki naimat ko yaad kero , aur yeh kaho kay :  pak hai woh zaat jiss ney iss sawari ko humaray bus mein dey diya , werna hum mein yeh taqat nahi thi kay iss ko qaboo mein laasaktay .
ayahs.translation: takay tum unn ki pusht per charrho , phir jab unn per charh ker beth jao to apney perwerdigar ki naimat ko yaad kero , aur yeh kaho kay :  pak hai woh zaat jiss ney iss sawari ko humaray bus mein dey diya , werna hum mein yeh taqat nahi thi kay iss ko qaboo mein laasaktay .

ayahs.text: aur beyshak hum apney perwerdigar ki taraf loat ker janey walay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur beyshak hum apney perwerdigar ki taraf loat ker janey walay hain .

ayahs.text: aur inn ( mushrik ) logon  ney yeh baat banai hai kay Allah ka khud uss kay bandon mein say koi juzz hai .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay insan khullam khula nashukra hai .
ayahs.translation: aur inn ( mushrik ) logon  ney yeh baat banai hai kay Allah ka khud uss kay bandon mein say koi juzz hai .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay insan khullam khula nashukra hai .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya Allah ney apni makhlooq mein say apney liye to betiyan pasand ki hain , aur tumhen beton kay liye muntakhib kiya hai-?
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya Allah ney apni makhlooq mein say apney liye to betiyan pasand ki hain , aur tumhen beton kay liye muntakhib kiya hai-?

ayahs.text: halankay unn mein say kissi ko jab uss ( beti ) ki ( wiladat ) ki khushkhabri di jati hai jo uss ney khudaye rehman ki taraf mansoob ker rakhi hai to uss ka chehra siyah parr-jata hai , aur woh dil hi dil mein ghutta rehta hai .
ayahs.translation: halankay unn mein say kissi ko jab uss ( beti ) ki ( wiladat ) ki khushkhabri di jati hai jo uss ney khudaye rehman ki taraf mansoob ker rakhi hai to uss ka chehra siyah parr-jata hai , aur woh dil hi dil mein ghutta rehta hai .

ayahs.text: aur kiya ( Allah ney aesi aulad pasand ki hai ) jo zewaron mein paali posi jati hai , aur jo behas mubahisay mein apni baat khul ker bhi nahi keh sakti-?
ayahs.translation: aur kiya ( Allah ney aesi aulad pasand ki hai ) jo zewaron mein paali posi jati hai , aur jo behas mubahisay mein apni baat khul ker bhi nahi keh sakti-?

ayahs.text: iss kay ilawa unhon ney farishton ko jo khudaye rehman kay banday hain , moannis bana diya hai . kiya yeh log unn ki takhleeq kay waqt mojood thay-? inn ka yeh dawa likh liya jaye ga , aur inn say baaz purs hogi .
ayahs.translation: iss kay ilawa unhon ney farishton ko jo khudaye rehman kay banday hain , moannis bana diya hai . kiya yeh log unn ki takhleeq kay waqt mojood thay-? inn ka yeh dawa likh liya jaye ga , aur inn say baaz purs hogi .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kehtay hain kay :  agar khudaye rehman chahta to hum inn ( farishton ) ki ibadat naa kertay .  inn ko iss baat ki haqeeqat ka zara bhi ilm nahi hai , aur inn ka kaam iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay andazon kay teer chalatay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kehtay hain kay :  agar khudaye rehman chahta to hum inn ( farishton ) ki ibadat naa kertay .  inn ko iss baat ki haqeeqat ka zara bhi ilm nahi hai , aur inn ka kaam iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay andazon kay teer chalatay hain .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya hum ney unhen iss say pehlay koi kitab di thi jissay yeh thamay bethay hain-?
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya hum ney unhen iss say pehlay koi kitab di thi jissay yeh thamay bethay hain-?

ayahs.text: nahi , balkay inn ka kehna yeh hai kay hum ney apney baap dadon ko aik tareeqay per paya hai , aur hum unhi kay naqsh-e-qadam kay mutabiq theek theek raastay per jarahey hain .
ayahs.translation: nahi , balkay inn ka kehna yeh hai kay hum ney apney baap dadon ko aik tareeqay per paya hai , aur hum unhi kay naqsh-e-qadam kay mutabiq theek theek raastay per jarahey hain .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum say pehlay jab bhi kissi basti mein koi khabrdar kernay wala ( payghumber ) bheja to wahan kay dolat mand logon  ney yehi kaha kay :  hum ney apney baap dadon ko aik tareeqay per paya hai , aur hum unhi kay naqsh-e-qadam kay peechay chal rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum say pehlay jab bhi kissi basti mein koi khabrdar kernay wala ( payghumber ) bheja to wahan kay dolat mand logon  ney yehi kaha kay :  hum ney apney baap dadon ko aik tareeqay per paya hai , aur hum unhi kay naqsh-e-qadam kay peechay chal rahey hain .

ayahs.text: payghumber ney kaha kay :  tum ney apney baap dadon ko jiss tareeqay per paya hai , agar mein tumharay paas uss say ziyada hidayat ki baat ley ker aaya hun to kiya phir bhi ( tum apney tareeqay per chalay jao gay-? )  unhon ney jawab diya kay :  tum jo paygham dey ker bhejay gaye ho hum to uss ko manney walay nahi hain .
ayahs.translation: payghumber ney kaha kay :  tum ney apney baap dadon ko jiss tareeqay per paya hai , agar mein tumharay paas uss say ziyada hidayat ki baat ley ker aaya hun to kiya phir bhi ( tum apney tareeqay per chalay jao gay-? )  unhon ney jawab diya kay :  tum jo paygham dey ker bhejay gaye ho hum to uss ko manney walay nahi hain .

ayahs.text: nateeja yeh huwa kay hum ney unn say intiqam liya , abb dekh lo kay jhutlaney walon ka anjam kaisa huwa-?
ayahs.translation: nateeja yeh huwa kay hum ney unn say intiqam liya , abb dekh lo kay jhutlaney walon ka anjam kaisa huwa-?

ayahs.text: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab Ibrahim ney apney baap aur apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  mein unn cheezon say beyzar hun jinn ki tum ibadat kertay ho ,
ayahs.translation: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab Ibrahim ney apney baap aur apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  mein unn cheezon say beyzar hun jinn ki tum ibadat kertay ho ,

ayahs.text: siwaye uss zaat kay jiss ney mujhay peda kiya hai , chunacheh wohi meri rehnumai kerta hai .
ayahs.translation: siwaye uss zaat kay jiss ney mujhay peda kiya hai , chunacheh wohi meri rehnumai kerta hai .

ayahs.text: aur Ibrahim ney iss ( aqeeday ) ko aesi baat bana diya jo unn ki aulad mein baqi rahi , takay log ( shirk say ) baaz ayen .
ayahs.translation: aur Ibrahim ney iss ( aqeeday ) ko aesi baat bana diya jo unn ki aulad mein baqi rahi , takay log ( shirk say ) baaz ayen .

ayahs.text: . ( phir bhi boht say log baaz naa aaye ) uss kay bawajood mein ney unn ko aur unn kay baap dadon ko zindagi kay faeeday diye , yahan tak kay unn kay paas haq aur saaf saaf hidayat denay wala payghumber aagaya .
ayahs.translation: . ( phir bhi boht say log baaz naa aaye ) uss kay bawajood mein ney unn ko aur unn kay baap dadon ko zindagi kay faeeday diye , yahan tak kay unn kay paas haq aur saaf saaf hidayat denay wala payghumber aagaya .

ayahs.text: aur jab woh haq unn kay paas aaya to woh kehney lagay kay :  yeh to jadoo hai , aur hum iss ka inkar kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jab woh haq unn kay paas aaya to woh kehney lagay kay :  yeh to jadoo hai , aur hum iss ka inkar kertay hain .

ayahs.text: aur kehney lagay kay :  yeh Quran do bastiyon mein say kissi baray aadmi per kiyon nazil nahi kiya gaya-?
ayahs.translation: aur kehney lagay kay :  yeh Quran do bastiyon mein say kissi baray aadmi per kiyon nazil nahi kiya gaya-?

ayahs.text: bhala kiya yeh log hain jo tumharay perwerdigar ki rehmat taqseem keren gay-?   dunyawi zindagi mein inn ki rozi kay zaraye bhi hum ney hi inn kay darmiyan taqseem ker rakhay hain , aur hum ney hi inn mein say aik ko doosray per darjaat mein foqiyat di hai , takay woh aik doosray say kaam ley saken . aur tumharay perwerdigar ki rehmat to uss ( dolat ) say kahen behtar cheez hai jo yeh jama ker rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya yeh log hain jo tumharay perwerdigar ki rehmat taqseem keren gay-?   dunyawi zindagi mein inn ki rozi kay zaraye bhi hum ney hi inn kay darmiyan taqseem ker rakhay hain , aur hum ney hi inn mein say aik ko doosray per darjaat mein foqiyat di hai , takay woh aik doosray say kaam ley saken . aur tumharay perwerdigar ki rehmat to uss ( dolat ) say kahen behtar cheez hai jo yeh jama ker rahey hain .

ayahs.text: aur agar yeh andesha naa hota kay tamam insan aik hi tareeqay kay ( yani kafir ) hojayen gay to jo log khudaye rehman kay munkir hain , hum unn kay liye unn kay gharon ki chatten bhi chaandi ki bana detay , aur woh serhiyan bhi jinn per woh charrhtay hain ,
ayahs.translation: aur agar yeh andesha naa hota kay tamam insan aik hi tareeqay kay ( yani kafir ) hojayen gay to jo log khudaye rehman kay munkir hain , hum unn kay liye unn kay gharon ki chatten bhi chaandi ki bana detay , aur woh serhiyan bhi jinn per woh charrhtay hain ,

ayahs.text: aur unn kay gharon kay darwazay bhi , aur woh takht bhi jinn per woh takiya laga ker bethtay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur unn kay gharon kay darwazay bhi , aur woh takht bhi jinn per woh takiya laga ker bethtay hain .

ayahs.text: balkay unhen sona bana detay . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh sabb kuch bhi nahi , sirf dunyawi zindagi ka saman hai .   aur aakhirat tumharay perwerdigar kay nazdeek perhezgaron kay liye hai .
ayahs.translation: balkay unhen sona bana detay . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh sabb kuch bhi nahi , sirf dunyawi zindagi ka saman hai .   aur aakhirat tumharay perwerdigar kay nazdeek perhezgaron kay liye hai .

ayahs.text: aur jo shaks khudaye rehman kay ziker say andha ban jaye , hum uss per aik shetan musallat ker-detay hain jo uss ka sathi ban jata hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jo shaks khudaye rehman kay ziker say andha ban jaye , hum uss per aik shetan musallat ker-detay hain jo uss ka sathi ban jata hai .

ayahs.text: aesay shayateen unn ko raastay say roktay rehtay hain , aur woh samajhtay hain kay hum theek raastay per hain .
ayahs.translation: aesay shayateen unn ko raastay say roktay rehtay hain , aur woh samajhtay hain kay hum theek raastay per hain .

ayahs.text: yahan tak kay jab aisa shaks humaray paas aaye ga to ( apney shetan sathi say ) kahey ga kay :  kaash ! meray aur teray darmiyan mashriq o maghrib ka fasla hota , kiyonkay tu boht bura sathi tha .
ayahs.translation: yahan tak kay jab aisa shaks humaray paas aaye ga to ( apney shetan sathi say ) kahey ga kay :  kaash ! meray aur teray darmiyan mashriq o maghrib ka fasla hota , kiyonkay tu boht bura sathi tha .

ayahs.text: aur aaj jab tum zulm ker-chukay ho to tumhen yeh baat hergiz koi faeeda nahi phonchaye gi kay tum azab mein aik doosray kay shareek ho .
ayahs.translation: aur aaj jab tum zulm ker-chukay ho to tumhen yeh baat hergiz koi faeeda nahi phonchaye gi kay tum azab mein aik doosray kay shareek ho .

ayahs.text: to phir ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya tum behron ko sunao gay , ya andhon ko aur unn logon  ko raastay per lao gay jo khuli gumrahi mein parray huye hain-?
ayahs.translation: to phir ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya tum behron ko sunao gay , ya andhon ko aur unn logon  ko raastay per lao gay jo khuli gumrahi mein parray huye hain-?

ayahs.text: abb to yehi hoga kay agar hum tumhen duniya say uthalen , tab bhi hum inn say badla lenay walay hain ,
ayahs.translation: abb to yehi hoga kay agar hum tumhen duniya say uthalen , tab bhi hum inn say badla lenay walay hain ,

ayahs.text: ya agar tumhen bhi woh ( azab ) dikha den jiss ka hum ney inn say wada kiya hai , tab bhi hamen inn per her tarah ki qudrat hasil hai .
ayahs.translation: ya agar tumhen bhi woh ( azab ) dikha den jiss ka hum ney inn say wada kiya hai , tab bhi hamen inn per her tarah ki qudrat hasil hai .

ayahs.text: lehaza tum per jo wahi nazil ki gaee hai , ussay mazbooti say thamay rakho , yaqeenan tum seedhay raastay per ho .
ayahs.translation: lehaza tum per jo wahi nazil ki gaee hai , ussay mazbooti say thamay rakho , yaqeenan tum seedhay raastay per ho .

ayahs.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh wahi tumharay liye aur tumhari qoam kay liye aik naik naami ka zariya hai , aur tum sabb say poocha jaye ga ( kay tum ney iss ka kiya haq ada kiya-? )
ayahs.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh wahi tumharay liye aur tumhari qoam kay liye aik naik naami ka zariya hai , aur tum sabb say poocha jaye ga ( kay tum ney iss ka kiya haq ada kiya-? )

ayahs.text: aur tum say pehlay hum ney apney jo payghumber bhejay hain , unn say pooch lo   kay kiya hum ney khudaye rehman kay siwa koi aur mabood bhi muqarrar kiye thay jinn ki ibadat ki jaye-?
ayahs.translation: aur tum say pehlay hum ney apney jo payghumber bhejay hain , unn say pooch lo   kay kiya hum ney khudaye rehman kay siwa koi aur mabood bhi muqarrar kiye thay jinn ki ibadat ki jaye-?

ayahs.text: aur hum ney musa ko apni nishaniyan dey ker firon aur uss kay sardaron kay paas bheja tha , chunacheh musa ney kaha kay :  mein Rabb-ul-Aalameen ka bheja huwa payghumber hun .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney musa ko apni nishaniyan dey ker firon aur uss kay sardaron kay paas bheja tha , chunacheh musa ney kaha kay :  mein Rabb-ul-Aalameen ka bheja huwa payghumber hun .

ayahs.text: phir jab unhon ney humari nishaniyan unn kay samney paish ken to woh unn ka mazaq uraney lagay .
ayahs.translation: phir jab unhon ney humari nishaniyan unn kay samney paish ken to woh unn ka mazaq uraney lagay .

ayahs.text: aur hum unhen jo nishani bhi dikhatay , woh pehli nishani say barh charh ker hoti thi , aur hum ney unhen azab mein bhi pakra , takay woh baaz aajayen .
ayahs.translation: aur hum unhen jo nishani bhi dikhatay , woh pehli nishani say barh charh ker hoti thi , aur hum ney unhen azab mein bhi pakra , takay woh baaz aajayen .

ayahs.text: aur woh yeh kehney lagay kay :  aey jadoogar ! tum say tumharay perwerdigar ney jo ehad ker rakha hai , uss ka wasta dey ker uss say humaray liye dua kero , hum yaqeenan raah-e-raast per aajayen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur woh yeh kehney lagay kay :  aey jadoogar ! tum say tumharay perwerdigar ney jo ehad ker rakha hai , uss ka wasta dey ker uss say humaray liye dua kero , hum yaqeenan raah-e-raast per aajayen gay .

ayahs.text: phir jab hum unn say azab ko door ker-detay to pal bhar mein woh apna wada torr daaltay thay .
ayahs.translation: phir jab hum unn say azab ko door ker-detay to pal bhar mein woh apna wada torr daaltay thay .

ayahs.text: aur firon ney apni qoam kay darmiyan pukar ker kaha kay :  aey meri qoam ! kiya misir ki saltanat meray qabazay mein nahi hai-? aur ( dekho ) yeh darya meray neechay beh rahey hain . kiya tumhen dikhai nahi deta-?
ayahs.translation: aur firon ney apni qoam kay darmiyan pukar ker kaha kay :  aey meri qoam ! kiya misir ki saltanat meray qabazay mein nahi hai-? aur ( dekho ) yeh darya meray neechay beh rahey hain . kiya tumhen dikhai nahi deta-?

ayahs.text: ya phir maano kay mein iss shaks say kahen behtar hun jo bara haqeer qisam ka hai , aur apni baat khul ker kehna bhi iss kay liye mushkil hai .
ayahs.translation: ya phir maano kay mein iss shaks say kahen behtar hun jo bara haqeer qisam ka hai , aur apni baat khul ker kehna bhi iss kay liye mushkil hai .

ayahs.text: bhala ( agar yeh payghumber hai to ) iss per soney kay kanggan kiyon nahi daalay gaye-? ya phir iss kay sath farishtay paray baandhay huye kiyon naa aaye-?
ayahs.translation: bhala ( agar yeh payghumber hai to ) iss per soney kay kanggan kiyon nahi daalay gaye-? ya phir iss kay sath farishtay paray baandhay huye kiyon naa aaye-?

ayahs.text: iss tarah uss ney apni qoam ko beywaqoof banaya , aur unhon ney uss ka kehna maan liya . haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh sabb gunehgaar log thay .
ayahs.translation: iss tarah uss ney apni qoam ko beywaqoof banaya , aur unhon ney uss ka kehna maan liya . haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh sabb gunehgaar log thay .

ayahs.text: chunacheh jab unhon ney hamen naraz kerdiya to hum ney unn say intiqam liya , aur unn sabb ko gharq kerdiya .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh jab unhon ney hamen naraz kerdiya to hum ney unn say intiqam liya , aur unn sabb ko gharq kerdiya .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney unhen aik gaee guzri qoam aur baad walon kay liye ibrat ka namoona banadiya .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney unhen aik gaee guzri qoam aur baad walon kay liye ibrat ka namoona banadiya .

ayahs.text: aur jab ( essa ) ibn-e-maryam ki misal di gaee to tumhari qoam kay log yakayak shor machaney lagay .
ayahs.translation: aur jab ( essa ) ibn-e-maryam ki misal di gaee to tumhari qoam kay log yakayak shor machaney lagay .

ayahs.text: aur kehney lagay kay :  humaray mabood behtar hain ya woh-?  unhon ney tumharay samney yeh misal mehaz katt hujjati kay liye di hai , balkay yeh log hain hi jhagrraloo .
ayahs.translation: aur kehney lagay kay :  humaray mabood behtar hain ya woh-?  unhon ney tumharay samney yeh misal mehaz katt hujjati kay liye di hai , balkay yeh log hain hi jhagrraloo .

ayahs.text: woh ( yani essa aleh-assalam ) to bus humaray aik banday thay jinn per hum ney inaam kiya tha , aur bani Israel kay liye unn ko aik namoona banaya tha .
ayahs.translation: woh ( yani essa aleh-assalam ) to bus humaray aik banday thay jinn per hum ney inaam kiya tha , aur bani Israel kay liye unn ko aik namoona banaya tha .

ayahs.text: aur agar hum chahen to tum say farishtay peda kerden jo zameen mein aik doosray kay janasheen ban ker raha keren .
ayahs.translation: aur agar hum chahen to tum say farishtay peda kerden jo zameen mein aik doosray kay janasheen ban ker raha keren .

ayahs.text: aur yaqeen rakho kay woh ( yani essa aleh-assalam ) qayamat ki aik nishani hain ,   iss liye tum uss mein shak naa kero , aur meri baat maano . yehi seedha raasta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur yaqeen rakho kay woh ( yani essa aleh-assalam ) qayamat ki aik nishani hain ,   iss liye tum uss mein shak naa kero , aur meri baat maano . yehi seedha raasta hai .

ayahs.text: aur aisa hergiz naa honey paye kay shetan tumhen iss raastay say rok dey . yaqeen jano woh tumhara khula dushman hai .
ayahs.translation: aur aisa hergiz naa honey paye kay shetan tumhen iss raastay say rok dey . yaqeen jano woh tumhara khula dushman hai .

ayahs.text: aur jab essa khuli hoi nishaniyan ley ker aaye thay to unhon ney ( logon  say ) kaha tha kay :  mein tumharay paas danai ki baat ley ker aaya hun , aur iss liye laya hun kay tumharay samney kuch woh cheezen wazeh kerdun jinn mein tum ikhtilaf kertay ho . lehaza tum Allah say daro , aur meri baat maan lo .
ayahs.translation: aur jab essa khuli hoi nishaniyan ley ker aaye thay to unhon ney ( logon  say ) kaha tha kay :  mein tumharay paas danai ki baat ley ker aaya hun , aur iss liye laya hun kay tumharay samney kuch woh cheezen wazeh kerdun jinn mein tum ikhtilaf kertay ho . lehaza tum Allah say daro , aur meri baat maan lo .

ayahs.text: yaqeenan Allah hi mera bhi rab hai , aur tumhara bhi rab hai , iss liye uss ki ibadat kero . yehi seedha raasta hai .
ayahs.translation: yaqeenan Allah hi mera bhi rab hai , aur tumhara bhi rab hai , iss liye uss ki ibadat kero . yehi seedha raasta hai .

ayahs.text: phir bhi unn mein say kaee girohon ney ikhtilaf peda kiya , chunacheh unn zalimon kay liye aik dardnak din kay azab ki wajeh say bari kharabi hogi .
ayahs.translation: phir bhi unn mein say kaee girohon ney ikhtilaf peda kiya , chunacheh unn zalimon kay liye aik dardnak din kay azab ki wajeh say bari kharabi hogi .

ayahs.text: yeh log bus iss baat ka intizar ker rahey hain kay qayamat inn kay samney achanak aa-khari ho , aur enhen khabar bhi naa ho .
ayahs.translation: yeh log bus iss baat ka intizar ker rahey hain kay qayamat inn kay samney achanak aa-khari ho , aur enhen khabar bhi naa ho .

ayahs.text: . ( jinn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  aey meray bando ! aaj tum per naa koi khof taari hoga , aur naa tum ghumgeen hogay .
ayahs.translation: . ( jinn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  aey meray bando ! aaj tum per naa koi khof taari hoga , aur naa tum ghumgeen hogay .

ayahs.text: aey meray woh bando jo humari aayaton per emaan laye thay , aur farmanbardaar rahey thay !
ayahs.translation: aey meray woh bando jo humari aayaton per emaan laye thay , aur farmanbardaar rahey thay !

ayahs.text: tum bhi aur tumhari biwiyan bhi , khushi say chamaktay chehron kay sath jannat mein dakhil hojao .
ayahs.translation: tum bhi aur tumhari biwiyan bhi , khushi say chamaktay chehron kay sath jannat mein dakhil hojao .

ayahs.text: unn kay aagay soney kay piyalay aur glass gardish mein laye jayen gay . aur uss jannat mein her woh cheez hogi jiss ki dilon ko khuwaish hogi , aur jiss say aankhon ko lazzat hasil hogi . ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  iss jannat mein tum hamesha raho gay .
ayahs.translation: unn kay aagay soney kay piyalay aur glass gardish mein laye jayen gay . aur uss jannat mein her woh cheez hogi jiss ki dilon ko khuwaish hogi , aur jiss say aankhon ko lazzat hasil hogi . ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  iss jannat mein tum hamesha raho gay .

ayahs.text: aur yeh woh jannat hai jiss ka tumhen apney aemal kay badlay waris bana diya gaya hai .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh woh jannat hai jiss ka tumhen apney aemal kay badlay waris bana diya gaya hai .

ayahs.text: iss mein tumharay liye khoob ifraat kay sath meway hain jinn mein say tum khao gay .
ayahs.translation: iss mein tumharay liye khoob ifraat kay sath meway hain jinn mein say tum khao gay .

ayahs.text: albatta jo log mujrim thay , woh dozakh kay azab mein hamesha rahen gay .
ayahs.translation: albatta jo log mujrim thay , woh dozakh kay azab mein hamesha rahen gay .

ayahs.text: woh azab unn kay liye halka nahi parrney diya jaye ga , aur woh uss mein mayyus parray hon gay .
ayahs.translation: woh azab unn kay liye halka nahi parrney diya jaye ga , aur woh uss mein mayyus parray hon gay .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney unn per koi zulm nahi kiya , lekin woh khud hi zalim log thay .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney unn per koi zulm nahi kiya , lekin woh khud hi zalim log thay .

ayahs.text: aur woh ( dozakh kay farishtay say ) pukar ker kahen gay kay :  aey malik ! tumhara perwerdigar humara kaam hi tamam kerday .    woh kahey ga kay :  tumhen issi haal mein rehna hai .
ayahs.translation: aur woh ( dozakh kay farishtay say ) pukar ker kahen gay kay :  aey malik ! tumhara perwerdigar humara kaam hi tamam kerday .    woh kahey ga kay :  tumhen issi haal mein rehna hai .

ayahs.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum tumharay paas haq baat ley ker aaye thay , lekin tum mein say aksar log haq baat hi ko bura samajhtay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum tumharay paas haq baat ley ker aaye thay , lekin tum mein say aksar log haq baat hi ko bura samajhtay hain .

ayahs.text: haan kiya inn logon  ney kuch kernay ka faisla kerliya hai ? acha to hum bhi kuch kernay ka faisla kernay walay hain .
ayahs.translation: haan kiya inn logon  ney kuch kernay ka faisla kerliya hai ? acha to hum bhi kuch kernay ka faisla kernay walay hain .
