ayahs.text: aur agar tum mujh per emaan nahi latay to mujh say alag hojao .
ayahs.translation: aur agar tum mujh per emaan nahi latay to mujh say alag hojao .

ayahs.text: phir unhon ney apney perwerdigar ko pukara kay yeh mujrim log hain .
ayahs.translation: phir unhon ney apney perwerdigar ko pukara kay yeh mujrim log hain .

ayahs.text: . ( Allah taalaa ney farmaya kay : )  acha tum meray bandon ko ley ker raaton raat rawana hojao . tumhara peecha zaroor kiya jaye ga ,
ayahs.translation: . ( Allah taalaa ney farmaya kay : )  acha tum meray bandon ko ley ker raaton raat rawana hojao . tumhara peecha zaroor kiya jaye ga ,

ayahs.text: aur tum samandar ko thehra huwa chorr dena ,   yaqeenan yeh lashkar duboya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: aur tum samandar ko thehra huwa chorr dena ,   yaqeenan yeh lashkar duboya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: kitney baaghaat aur chashmay thay jo yeh log chorr gaye ,
ayahs.translation: kitney baaghaat aur chashmay thay jo yeh log chorr gaye ,

ayahs.text: aur kitney khet aur shandaar makanaat ,
ayahs.translation: aur kitney khet aur shandaar makanaat ,

ayahs.text: aur aesh kay kitney saman jinn mein woh mazay ker rahey thay !
ayahs.translation: aur aesh kay kitney saman jinn mein woh mazay ker rahey thay !

ayahs.text: unn ka anjam issi tarah huwa , aur hum ney unn sabb cheezon ka waris aik doosri qoam ko bana diya .
ayahs.translation: unn ka anjam issi tarah huwa , aur hum ney unn sabb cheezon ka waris aik doosri qoam ko bana diya .

ayahs.text: phir naa unn per aasman roya naa zameen , aur naa unn ko kuch mohlat di gaee .
ayahs.translation: phir naa unn per aasman roya naa zameen , aur naa unn ko kuch mohlat di gaee .

ayahs.text: aur bani Israel ko hum ney zillat kay azab say nijat dey di ,
ayahs.translation: aur bani Israel ko hum ney zillat kay azab say nijat dey di ,

ayahs.text: yani firon say . haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh bara sarkash , hadd say guzray huye logon  mein say tha .
ayahs.translation: yani firon say . haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh bara sarkash , hadd say guzray huye logon  mein say tha .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney unn ko apney ilm kay mutabiq duniya jahan walon per foqiyat di ,
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney unn ko apney ilm kay mutabiq duniya jahan walon per foqiyat di ,

ayahs.text: aur unn ko aesi nishaniyan den jinn mein khula huwa inaam tha .
ayahs.translation: aur unn ko aesi nishaniyan den jinn mein khula huwa inaam tha .

ayahs.text: yeh log saaf kehtay hain
ayahs.translation: yeh log saaf kehtay hain

ayahs.text: kay :  aur kuch nahi hai , bus humari wohi pehli moat hogi , aur hamen dobara zinda nahi kiya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: kay :  aur kuch nahi hai , bus humari wohi pehli moat hogi , aur hamen dobara zinda nahi kiya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: agar tum sachay ho to humaray baap dadon ko utha lao .
ayahs.translation: agar tum sachay ho to humaray baap dadon ko utha lao .

ayahs.text: bhala yeh log behtar hain ya tabaa ki qoam   aur woh log jo inn say pehlay thay-? hum ney unn sabb ko halak kerdiya , ( kiyonkay ) woh yaqeeni tor per mujrim log thay .
ayahs.translation: bhala yeh log behtar hain ya tabaa ki qoam   aur woh log jo inn say pehlay thay-? hum ney unn sabb ko halak kerdiya , ( kiyonkay ) woh yaqeeni tor per mujrim log thay .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney aasmano aur zameen aur unn kay darmiyan ki cheezen bey faeeda khel kernay kay liye peda nahi kerdi hain .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney aasmano aur zameen aur unn kay darmiyan ki cheezen bey faeeda khel kernay kay liye peda nahi kerdi hain .

ayahs.text: hum ney unhen bar-haq maqsad hi kay liye peda kiya hai ,   lekin inn mein say aksar log samajhtay nahi hain .
ayahs.translation: hum ney unhen bar-haq maqsad hi kay liye peda kiya hai ,   lekin inn mein say aksar log samajhtay nahi hain .

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay faislay ka din inn sabb ki muqarrara miyaad hai ,
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay faislay ka din inn sabb ki muqarrara miyaad hai ,

ayahs.text: jiss din koi himayati kissi himayati kay zara bhi kaam nahi aaye ga , aur unn mein say kissi ki koi madad nahi ki jaye gi ,
ayahs.translation: jiss din koi himayati kissi himayati kay zara bhi kaam nahi aaye ga , aur unn mein say kissi ki koi madad nahi ki jaye gi ,

ayahs.text: siwaye uss kay jiss per Allah reham farmaye . yaqeenan woh mukammal iqtidar ka malik bhi hai , boht meharban bhi .
ayahs.translation: siwaye uss kay jiss per Allah reham farmaye . yaqeenan woh mukammal iqtidar ka malik bhi hai , boht meharban bhi .

ayahs.text: yaqeen jano kay zaqoom ka darkht
ayahs.translation: yaqeen jano kay zaqoom ka darkht

ayahs.text: gunehgaar ka khana hoga ,
ayahs.translation: gunehgaar ka khana hoga ,

ayahs.text: tel ki talchat jaisa . woh logon  kay pet mein iss tarah josh maaray ga
ayahs.translation: tel ki talchat jaisa . woh logon  kay pet mein iss tarah josh maaray ga

ayahs.text: jaisay kholta huwa paani .
ayahs.translation: jaisay kholta huwa paani .

ayahs.text: . ( farishton say kaha jaye ga : )  iss ko pakro , aur ghaseet ker dozakh kay beechon beech tak ley jao ,
ayahs.translation: . ( farishton say kaha jaye ga : )  iss ko pakro , aur ghaseet ker dozakh kay beechon beech tak ley jao ,

ayahs.text: phir uss kay sar kay oopper kholtay huye paani ka azab undel do .
ayahs.translation: phir uss kay sar kay oopper kholtay huye paani ka azab undel do .

ayahs.text: . ( kaha jaye ga kay : )  ley chakh . tu hi hai woh bara sahab-e-iqtidar , bara izzat wala !
ayahs.translation: . ( kaha jaye ga kay : )  ley chakh . tu hi hai woh bara sahab-e-iqtidar , bara izzat wala !

ayahs.text: yeh wohi cheez hai jiss kay baaray mein tum log shak kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: yeh wohi cheez hai jiss kay baaray mein tum log shak kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: . ( doosri taraf ) perhezgar log yaqeenan aman o aman wali jagah mein hon gay ,
ayahs.translation: . ( doosri taraf ) perhezgar log yaqeenan aman o aman wali jagah mein hon gay ,

ayahs.text: baaghaat mein aur chashmon mein !
ayahs.translation: baaghaat mein aur chashmon mein !

ayahs.text: woh aamney samney bethay huye sundus aur istabraq ka libas pehnay hon gay .
ayahs.translation: woh aamney samney bethay huye sundus aur istabraq ka libas pehnay hon gay .

ayahs.text: unn kay sath yehi moamla hoga , aur hum bari bari aankhon wali huroon ka unn say biyah kerden gay .
ayahs.translation: unn kay sath yehi moamla hoga , aur hum bari bari aankhon wali huroon ka unn say biyah kerden gay .

ayahs.text: woh wahan baray itminan say her qisam kay meway mangwatay hon gay .
ayahs.translation: woh wahan baray itminan say her qisam kay meway mangwatay hon gay .

ayahs.text: jo moat unn ko pehle aa-chuki thi , uss kay ilawa wahan woh kissi aur moat ka maza nahi chaken gay , aur Allah unhen dozakh kay azab say mehfooz rakhay ga ,
ayahs.translation: jo moat unn ko pehle aa-chuki thi , uss kay ilawa wahan woh kissi aur moat ka maza nahi chaken gay , aur Allah unhen dozakh kay azab say mehfooz rakhay ga ,

ayahs.text: yeh sabb tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say fazal hoga . ( insan kay liye ) zabardast kamiyabi yehi hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh sabb tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say fazal hoga . ( insan kay liye ) zabardast kamiyabi yehi hai .

ayahs.text: gharz ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney iss ( Quran ) ko tumhari zaban mein aasaan bana diya hai , takay log naseehat hasil keren .
ayahs.translation: gharz ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney iss ( Quran ) ko tumhari zaban mein aasaan bana diya hai , takay log naseehat hasil keren .

ayahs.text: abb tum bhi intizar kero , yeh log bhi intizar ker rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: abb tum bhi intizar kero , yeh log bhi intizar ker rahey hain .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: Haa-Meem .
verses.translation: Haa-Meem .

verses.text: yeh kitab Allah ki taraf say utaari jarahi hai jo bara sahab-e-iqtidar , bara sahab-e-hikmat hai .
verses.translation: yeh kitab Allah ki taraf say utaari jarahi hai jo bara sahab-e-iqtidar , bara sahab-e-hikmat hai .

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay aasmano aur zameen mein manney walon kay liye boht si nishaniyan hain .
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay aasmano aur zameen mein manney walon kay liye boht si nishaniyan hain .

verses.text: aur khud tumhari pedaeesh mein , aur unn janweron mein jo uss ney ( zameen mein ) phela rakhay hain , unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo yaqeen keren .
verses.translation: aur khud tumhari pedaeesh mein , aur unn janweron mein jo uss ney ( zameen mein ) phela rakhay hain , unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo yaqeen keren .

verses.text: neez raat aur din kay aaney janey mein , aur Allah ney aasman say rizq ka jo zariya utaara , phir uss say zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad naee zindagi di , uss mein aur hawaon ki gardish mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo aqal say kaam len .
verses.translation: neez raat aur din kay aaney janey mein , aur Allah ney aasman say rizq ka jo zariya utaara , phir uss say zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad naee zindagi di , uss mein aur hawaon ki gardish mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo aqal say kaam len .

verses.text: yeh Allah ki aayaten hain jo hum tumhen theek theek parh ker suna rahey hain . abb Allah aur uss ki aayaton kay baad kon si baat hai jiss per yeh log emaan layen gay-?
verses.translation: yeh Allah ki aayaten hain jo hum tumhen theek theek parh ker suna rahey hain . abb Allah aur uss ki aayaton kay baad kon si baat hai jiss per yeh log emaan layen gay-?

verses.text: bura ho har uss jhootay gunehgaar ka
verses.translation: bura ho har uss jhootay gunehgaar ka

verses.text: jo Allah ki aayaten sunta hai jabkay woh ussay parh ker sunai jarahi hoti hain , phir bhi woh takabbur kay aalam mein iss tarah ( kufr per ) arra rehta hai jaisay uss ney woh aayaten suni hi nahi . lehaza aesay shaks ko dardnak azab ki  khushkhabri  suna do .
verses.translation: jo Allah ki aayaten sunta hai jabkay woh ussay parh ker sunai jarahi hoti hain , phir bhi woh takabbur kay aalam mein iss tarah ( kufr per ) arra rehta hai jaisay uss ney woh aayaten suni hi nahi . lehaza aesay shaks ko dardnak azab ki  khushkhabri  suna do .

verses.text: aur jab humari aayaton mein say koi aayat aesay shaks kay ilm mein aati hai to woh uss ka mazaq banata hai . aesay logon  ko woh azab hoga jo zaleel ker kay rakh dey ga .
verses.translation: aur jab humari aayaton mein say koi aayat aesay shaks kay ilm mein aati hai to woh uss ka mazaq banata hai . aesay logon  ko woh azab hoga jo zaleel ker kay rakh dey ga .

verses.text: unn kay aagay jahannum hai , aur jo kuch unhon ney kamaya hai , naa woh unn kay kuch kaam aaye ga , aur naa woh kaam ayen gay jinn ko unhon ney Allah kay bajaye apna rakhwala bana rakha hai . aur unn kay hissay mein aik zabardast azab aaye ga .
verses.translation: unn kay aagay jahannum hai , aur jo kuch unhon ney kamaya hai , naa woh unn kay kuch kaam aaye ga , aur naa woh kaam ayen gay jinn ko unhon ney Allah kay bajaye apna rakhwala bana rakha hai . aur unn kay hissay mein aik zabardast azab aaye ga .

verses.text: yeh ( Quran ) sarapa hidayat hai , aur jinn logon  ney apney perwerdigar ki aayaton ka inkar kiya hai , unn kay liye bala ka dardnak azab hai .
verses.translation: yeh ( Quran ) sarapa hidayat hai , aur jinn logon  ney apney perwerdigar ki aayaton ka inkar kiya hai , unn kay liye bala ka dardnak azab hai .

verses.text: Allah woh hai jiss ney samandar ko tumharay kaam mein laga diya hai , takay uss kay hukum say uss mein kashtiyan chalen , aur takay tum uss ka fazal talash kero ,   aur takay tum shukar ada kero .
verses.translation: Allah woh hai jiss ney samandar ko tumharay kaam mein laga diya hai , takay uss kay hukum say uss mein kashtiyan chalen , aur takay tum uss ka fazal talash kero ,   aur takay tum shukar ada kero .

verses.text: aur aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , uss sabb ko uss ney apni taraf say tumharay kaam mein laga rakha hai . yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo ghor-o-fiker say kaam len .
verses.translation: aur aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , uss sabb ko uss ney apni taraf say tumharay kaam mein laga rakha hai . yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo ghor-o-fiker say kaam len .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) jo log emaan ley aaye hain , unn say kaho kay jo log Allah kay dino ka andesha nahi rakhtay   unn say darguzar keren ,   takay Allah logon  ko unn kamon ka badla dey jo woh kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) jo log emaan ley aaye hain , unn say kaho kay jo log Allah kay dino ka andesha nahi rakhtay   unn say darguzar keren ,   takay Allah logon  ko unn kamon ka badla dey jo woh kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: jo shaks bhi naik kaam kerta hai , woh apney hi faeeday kay liye kerta hai , aur jo bura kaam kerta hai , woh apna hi nuqsan kerta hai , phir tum sabb ko apney perwerdigar hi kay paas wapis laya jaye ga .
verses.translation: jo shaks bhi naik kaam kerta hai , woh apney hi faeeday kay liye kerta hai , aur jo bura kaam kerta hai , woh apna hi nuqsan kerta hai , phir tum sabb ko apney perwerdigar hi kay paas wapis laya jaye ga .

verses.text: aur hum ney bano Israel ko kitab , aur hukoomat aur nabwooat ata ki thi , aur unhen pakeezah cheezon ka rizq diya tha , aur unhen duniya jahan kay logon  per foqiyat bakhshi thi ,
verses.translation: aur hum ney bano Israel ko kitab , aur hukoomat aur nabwooat ata ki thi , aur unhen pakeezah cheezon ka rizq diya tha , aur unhen duniya jahan kay logon  per foqiyat bakhshi thi ,

verses.text: aur unhen khulay khulay ehkaam diye thay . iss kay baad unn mein jo ikhtilaf peda huwa , woh unn kay paas ilm aajaney kay baad hi huwa , sirf iss liye kay unn ko aik doosray say zidd hogaee thi .   yaqeenan tumhara perwerdigar unn kay darmiyan qayamat kay din unn baaton ka faisla kerday ga jinn mein woh ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: aur unhen khulay khulay ehkaam diye thay . iss kay baad unn mein jo ikhtilaf peda huwa , woh unn kay paas ilm aajaney kay baad hi huwa , sirf iss liye kay unn ko aik doosray say zidd hogaee thi .   yaqeenan tumhara perwerdigar unn kay darmiyan qayamat kay din unn baaton ka faisla kerday ga jinn mein woh ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: phir ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen deen ki aik khaas shariyat per rakha hai , lehaza tum ussi ki perwi kero , aur unn logon  ki khuwaishaat kay peechay naa chalna jo haqeeqat ka ilm nahi rakhtay .
verses.translation: phir ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen deen ki aik khaas shariyat per rakha hai , lehaza tum ussi ki perwi kero , aur unn logon  ki khuwaishaat kay peechay naa chalna jo haqeeqat ka ilm nahi rakhtay .

verses.text: woh Allah kay muqablay mein tumharay zara bhi kaam nahi aa-saktay . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay zalim log aik doosray kay dost hain , aur Allah muttaqi logon  ka dost hai .
verses.translation: woh Allah kay muqablay mein tumharay zara bhi kaam nahi aa-saktay . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay zalim log aik doosray kay dost hain , aur Allah muttaqi logon  ka dost hai .

verses.text: yeh ( Quran ) tamam logon  kay liye baseeraton ka majmooa hai , aur jo log yaqeen keren , unn kay liye manzil tak phonchaney ka zariya aur sarapa rehmat hai .
verses.translation: yeh ( Quran ) tamam logon  kay liye baseeraton ka majmooa hai , aur jo log yaqeen keren , unn kay liye manzil tak phonchaney ka zariya aur sarapa rehmat hai .

verses.text: jinn logon  ney buray buray kamon ka irtikab kiya hai , kiya woh yeh samjhay huye hain kay enhen/unhen hum inn/unn logon  kay barabar kerden gay jo emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , jiss kay nateejay mein inn/unn ka jeena aur marna aik hi jaisa hojaye-?   kitni buri baat hai jo yeh tey kiye huye hain !
verses.translation: jinn logon  ney buray buray kamon ka irtikab kiya hai , kiya woh yeh samjhay huye hain kay enhen/unhen hum inn/unn logon  kay barabar kerden gay jo emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , jiss kay nateejay mein inn/unn ka jeena aur marna aik hi jaisa hojaye-?   kitni buri baat hai jo yeh tey kiye huye hain !

verses.text: Allah ney saray aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq maqsad kay liye peda kiya hai , aur iss liye kiya hai kay her shaks ko uss kay kiye huye kamon ka badla diya jaye , aur detay waqt unn per koi zulm naa kiya jaye .
verses.translation: Allah ney saray aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq maqsad kay liye peda kiya hai , aur iss liye kiya hai kay her shaks ko uss kay kiye huye kamon ka badla diya jaye , aur detay waqt unn per koi zulm naa kiya jaye .

verses.text: phir kiya tum ney ussay bhi dekha jiss ney apna khuda apni nafsani khuwaish ko bana liya hai , aur ilm kay bawajood Allah ney ussay gumrahi mein daal diya , aur uss kay kaan aur dil per mohar laga di , aur uss ki aankh per perda daal diya ? abb Allah kay baad kon hai jo ussay raastay per laye-? kiya phir bhi tum log sabaq nahi letay-?
verses.translation: phir kiya tum ney ussay bhi dekha jiss ney apna khuda apni nafsani khuwaish ko bana liya hai , aur ilm kay bawajood Allah ney ussay gumrahi mein daal diya , aur uss kay kaan aur dil per mohar laga di , aur uss ki aankh per perda daal diya ? abb Allah kay baad kon hai jo ussay raastay per laye-? kiya phir bhi tum log sabaq nahi letay-?

verses.text: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  jo kuch zindagi hai , bus yehi humari dunyawi zindagi hai , ( issi mein ) hum martay aur jeetay hain aur hamen koi aur nahi , zamana hi halak ker deta hai .  halankay iss baat ka unhen kuch bhi ilm nahi hai , bus wehmi andazay lagatay hain .
verses.translation: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  jo kuch zindagi hai , bus yehi humari dunyawi zindagi hai , ( issi mein ) hum martay aur jeetay hain aur hamen koi aur nahi , zamana hi halak ker deta hai .  halankay iss baat ka unhen kuch bhi ilm nahi hai , bus wehmi andazay lagatay hain .

verses.text: aur jab humari aayaten poori wazahat kay sath unn ko parh ker sunai jati hain to yeh kehney kay siwa unn ki koi daleel nahi hoti kay :  agar tum sachay ho to humaray baap dadon ko ( zinda ker kay ) ley aao .
verses.translation: aur jab humari aayaten poori wazahat kay sath unn ko parh ker sunai jati hain to yeh kehney kay siwa unn ki koi daleel nahi hoti kay :  agar tum sachay ho to humaray baap dadon ko ( zinda ker kay ) ley aao .

verses.text: keh do kay Allah hi tumhen zindagi deta hai , phir woh tumhen moat dey ga , phir tum sabb ko qayamat kay din jama keray ga   jiss mein kissi qisam ka koi shak nahi hai , lekin aksar log samajhtay nahi hain .
verses.translation: keh do kay Allah hi tumhen zindagi deta hai , phir woh tumhen moat dey ga , phir tum sabb ko qayamat kay din jama keray ga   jiss mein kissi qisam ka koi shak nahi hai , lekin aksar log samajhtay nahi hain .

verses.text: aur aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat Allah hi ki hai , aur jiss din qayamat aa-khari hogi , uss din jo log batil per hain , woh sakht nuqsan uthayen gay .
verses.translation: aur aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat Allah hi ki hai , aur jiss din qayamat aa-khari hogi , uss din jo log batil per hain , woh sakht nuqsan uthayen gay .

verses.text: aur tum her giroh ko dekho gay kay woh ghuttnon kay ball gira huwa hai .   her giroh ko uss kay aemal namay ki taraf bulaya jaye ga , ( aur kaha jaye ga kay : )  aaj tumhen unn aemal ka badla diya jaye ga jo tum kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: aur tum her giroh ko dekho gay kay woh ghuttnon kay ball gira huwa hai .   her giroh ko uss kay aemal namay ki taraf bulaya jaye ga , ( aur kaha jaye ga kay : )  aaj tumhen unn aemal ka badla diya jaye ga jo tum kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: yeh humara ( likhwaya huwa ) daftar hai jo tumharay baaray mein theek theek bol raha hai . tum jo kuch kertay thay , hum uss sabb ko likhwa liya kertay thay .
verses.translation: yeh humara ( likhwaya huwa ) daftar hai jo tumharay baaray mein theek theek bol raha hai . tum jo kuch kertay thay , hum uss sabb ko likhwa liya kertay thay .

verses.text: chunacheh jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ko to unn ka perwerdigar apni rehmat mein dakhil keray ga yehi khuli hoi kamiyabi hai
verses.translation: chunacheh jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ko to unn ka perwerdigar apni rehmat mein dakhil keray ga yehi khuli hoi kamiyabi hai

verses.text: rahey woh log jinhon ney kufr apna liya tha , ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  bhala kiya tumharay samney meri aayaten nahi parhi jati then-? phir bhi tum ney takabbur say kaam liya , aur mujrim banay rahey ,
verses.translation: rahey woh log jinhon ney kufr apna liya tha , ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  bhala kiya tumharay samney meri aayaten nahi parhi jati then-? phir bhi tum ney takabbur say kaam liya , aur mujrim banay rahey ,

verses.text: aur jab tum say kaha jata tha kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , aur qayamat woh haqeeqat hai jiss mein koi bhi shak nahi hai , to tum yeh kehtay thay kay :  hum nahi jantay kay qayamat kiya hoti hai ? uss kay baaray mein hum jo kuch khayal kertay hain , bus aik gumaan saa hota hai , aur hamen yaqeen bilkul nahi hai .
verses.translation: aur jab tum say kaha jata tha kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , aur qayamat woh haqeeqat hai jiss mein koi bhi shak nahi hai , to tum yeh kehtay thay kay :  hum nahi jantay kay qayamat kiya hoti hai ? uss kay baaray mein hum jo kuch khayal kertay hain , bus aik gumaan saa hota hai , aur hamen yaqeen bilkul nahi hai .

verses.text: aur ( uss moaqa per ) unhon ney jo aemal kiye thay , unn ki buraiyan khul ker unn kay samney aajayen gi , aur jiss cheez ka woh mazaq uratay thay , wohi unn ko aa-gheray gi ,
verses.translation: aur ( uss moaqa per ) unhon ney jo aemal kiye thay , unn ki buraiyan khul ker unn kay samney aajayen gi , aur jiss cheez ka woh mazaq uratay thay , wohi unn ko aa-gheray gi ,

verses.text: aur unn say kaha jaye ga kay :  aaj hum tumhen ussi tarah bhula den gay jaisay tum ney yeh baat bhula daali thi kay tumhen apney iss din ka samna kerna hoga , aur tumhara thikana aag hai , aur tumhen kissi qisam kay madadgaar moyassar nahi ayen gay .
verses.translation: aur unn say kaha jaye ga kay :  aaj hum tumhen ussi tarah bhula den gay jaisay tum ney yeh baat bhula daali thi kay tumhen apney iss din ka samna kerna hoga , aur tumhara thikana aag hai , aur tumhen kissi qisam kay madadgaar moyassar nahi ayen gay .

verses.text: yeh sabb iss liye kay tum ney Allah ki aayaton ko mazaq banaya tha , aur dunyawi zindagi ney tumhen dhokay mein daal diya tha .  chunacheh aaj aesay logon  ko naa wahan say nikala jaye ga , aur naa unn say moaafi maangney ko kaha jaye ga .
verses.translation: yeh sabb iss liye kay tum ney Allah ki aayaton ko mazaq banaya tha , aur dunyawi zindagi ney tumhen dhokay mein daal diya tha .  chunacheh aaj aesay logon  ko naa wahan say nikala jaye ga , aur naa unn say moaafi maangney ko kaha jaye ga .

verses.text: gharz tareef tamam tarr Allah ki hai jo saray aasmano ka bhi malik hai , zameen ka bhi malik , aur tamam jahano ka bhi malik .
verses.translation: gharz tareef tamam tarr Allah ki hai jo saray aasmano ka bhi malik hai , zameen ka bhi malik , aur tamam jahano ka bhi malik .

verses.text: aur tamam tarr barai ussi ko hasil hai , aasmano mein bhi , aur zameen mein bhi , aur wohi hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .
verses.translation: aur tamam tarr barai ussi ko hasil hai , aasmano mein bhi , aur zameen mein bhi , aur wohi hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: Haa-Meem .
ayahs.translation: Haa-Meem .

ayahs.text: yeh kitab Allah ki taraf say utaari jarahi hai jo bara sahab-e-iqtidar , bara sahab-e-hikmat hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh kitab Allah ki taraf say utaari jarahi hai jo bara sahab-e-iqtidar , bara sahab-e-hikmat hai .

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay aasmano aur zameen mein manney walon kay liye boht si nishaniyan hain .
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay aasmano aur zameen mein manney walon kay liye boht si nishaniyan hain .

ayahs.text: aur khud tumhari pedaeesh mein , aur unn janweron mein jo uss ney ( zameen mein ) phela rakhay hain , unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo yaqeen keren .
ayahs.translation: aur khud tumhari pedaeesh mein , aur unn janweron mein jo uss ney ( zameen mein ) phela rakhay hain , unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo yaqeen keren .

ayahs.text: neez raat aur din kay aaney janey mein , aur Allah ney aasman say rizq ka jo zariya utaara , phir uss say zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad naee zindagi di , uss mein aur hawaon ki gardish mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo aqal say kaam len .
ayahs.translation: neez raat aur din kay aaney janey mein , aur Allah ney aasman say rizq ka jo zariya utaara , phir uss say zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad naee zindagi di , uss mein aur hawaon ki gardish mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo aqal say kaam len .

ayahs.text: yeh Allah ki aayaten hain jo hum tumhen theek theek parh ker suna rahey hain . abb Allah aur uss ki aayaton kay baad kon si baat hai jiss per yeh log emaan layen gay-?
ayahs.translation: yeh Allah ki aayaten hain jo hum tumhen theek theek parh ker suna rahey hain . abb Allah aur uss ki aayaton kay baad kon si baat hai jiss per yeh log emaan layen gay-?

ayahs.text: bura ho har uss jhootay gunehgaar ka
ayahs.translation: bura ho har uss jhootay gunehgaar ka

ayahs.text: jo Allah ki aayaten sunta hai jabkay woh ussay parh ker sunai jarahi hoti hain , phir bhi woh takabbur kay aalam mein iss tarah ( kufr per ) arra rehta hai jaisay uss ney woh aayaten suni hi nahi . lehaza aesay shaks ko dardnak azab ki  khushkhabri  suna do .
ayahs.translation: jo Allah ki aayaten sunta hai jabkay woh ussay parh ker sunai jarahi hoti hain , phir bhi woh takabbur kay aalam mein iss tarah ( kufr per ) arra rehta hai jaisay uss ney woh aayaten suni hi nahi . lehaza aesay shaks ko dardnak azab ki  khushkhabri  suna do .

ayahs.text: aur jab humari aayaton mein say koi aayat aesay shaks kay ilm mein aati hai to woh uss ka mazaq banata hai . aesay logon  ko woh azab hoga jo zaleel ker kay rakh dey ga .
ayahs.translation: aur jab humari aayaton mein say koi aayat aesay shaks kay ilm mein aati hai to woh uss ka mazaq banata hai . aesay logon  ko woh azab hoga jo zaleel ker kay rakh dey ga .

ayahs.text: unn kay aagay jahannum hai , aur jo kuch unhon ney kamaya hai , naa woh unn kay kuch kaam aaye ga , aur naa woh kaam ayen gay jinn ko unhon ney Allah kay bajaye apna rakhwala bana rakha hai . aur unn kay hissay mein aik zabardast azab aaye ga .
ayahs.translation: unn kay aagay jahannum hai , aur jo kuch unhon ney kamaya hai , naa woh unn kay kuch kaam aaye ga , aur naa woh kaam ayen gay jinn ko unhon ney Allah kay bajaye apna rakhwala bana rakha hai . aur unn kay hissay mein aik zabardast azab aaye ga .

ayahs.text: yeh ( Quran ) sarapa hidayat hai , aur jinn logon  ney apney perwerdigar ki aayaton ka inkar kiya hai , unn kay liye bala ka dardnak azab hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh ( Quran ) sarapa hidayat hai , aur jinn logon  ney apney perwerdigar ki aayaton ka inkar kiya hai , unn kay liye bala ka dardnak azab hai .

ayahs.text: Allah woh hai jiss ney samandar ko tumharay kaam mein laga diya hai , takay uss kay hukum say uss mein kashtiyan chalen , aur takay tum uss ka fazal talash kero ,   aur takay tum shukar ada kero .
ayahs.translation: Allah woh hai jiss ney samandar ko tumharay kaam mein laga diya hai , takay uss kay hukum say uss mein kashtiyan chalen , aur takay tum uss ka fazal talash kero ,   aur takay tum shukar ada kero .

ayahs.text: aur aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , uss sabb ko uss ney apni taraf say tumharay kaam mein laga rakha hai . yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo ghor-o-fiker say kaam len .
ayahs.translation: aur aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , uss sabb ko uss ney apni taraf say tumharay kaam mein laga rakha hai . yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo ghor-o-fiker say kaam len .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) jo log emaan ley aaye hain , unn say kaho kay jo log Allah kay dino ka andesha nahi rakhtay   unn say darguzar keren ,   takay Allah logon  ko unn kamon ka badla dey jo woh kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) jo log emaan ley aaye hain , unn say kaho kay jo log Allah kay dino ka andesha nahi rakhtay   unn say darguzar keren ,   takay Allah logon  ko unn kamon ka badla dey jo woh kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: jo shaks bhi naik kaam kerta hai , woh apney hi faeeday kay liye kerta hai , aur jo bura kaam kerta hai , woh apna hi nuqsan kerta hai , phir tum sabb ko apney perwerdigar hi kay paas wapis laya jaye ga .
ayahs.translation: jo shaks bhi naik kaam kerta hai , woh apney hi faeeday kay liye kerta hai , aur jo bura kaam kerta hai , woh apna hi nuqsan kerta hai , phir tum sabb ko apney perwerdigar hi kay paas wapis laya jaye ga .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney bano Israel ko kitab , aur hukoomat aur nabwooat ata ki thi , aur unhen pakeezah cheezon ka rizq diya tha , aur unhen duniya jahan kay logon  per foqiyat bakhshi thi ,
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney bano Israel ko kitab , aur hukoomat aur nabwooat ata ki thi , aur unhen pakeezah cheezon ka rizq diya tha , aur unhen duniya jahan kay logon  per foqiyat bakhshi thi ,

ayahs.text: aur unhen khulay khulay ehkaam diye thay . iss kay baad unn mein jo ikhtilaf peda huwa , woh unn kay paas ilm aajaney kay baad hi huwa , sirf iss liye kay unn ko aik doosray say zidd hogaee thi .   yaqeenan tumhara perwerdigar unn kay darmiyan qayamat kay din unn baaton ka faisla kerday ga jinn mein woh ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: aur unhen khulay khulay ehkaam diye thay . iss kay baad unn mein jo ikhtilaf peda huwa , woh unn kay paas ilm aajaney kay baad hi huwa , sirf iss liye kay unn ko aik doosray say zidd hogaee thi .   yaqeenan tumhara perwerdigar unn kay darmiyan qayamat kay din unn baaton ka faisla kerday ga jinn mein woh ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: phir ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen deen ki aik khaas shariyat per rakha hai , lehaza tum ussi ki perwi kero , aur unn logon  ki khuwaishaat kay peechay naa chalna jo haqeeqat ka ilm nahi rakhtay .
ayahs.translation: phir ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen deen ki aik khaas shariyat per rakha hai , lehaza tum ussi ki perwi kero , aur unn logon  ki khuwaishaat kay peechay naa chalna jo haqeeqat ka ilm nahi rakhtay .

ayahs.text: woh Allah kay muqablay mein tumharay zara bhi kaam nahi aa-saktay . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay zalim log aik doosray kay dost hain , aur Allah muttaqi logon  ka dost hai .
ayahs.translation: woh Allah kay muqablay mein tumharay zara bhi kaam nahi aa-saktay . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay zalim log aik doosray kay dost hain , aur Allah muttaqi logon  ka dost hai .

ayahs.text: yeh ( Quran ) tamam logon  kay liye baseeraton ka majmooa hai , aur jo log yaqeen keren , unn kay liye manzil tak phonchaney ka zariya aur sarapa rehmat hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh ( Quran ) tamam logon  kay liye baseeraton ka majmooa hai , aur jo log yaqeen keren , unn kay liye manzil tak phonchaney ka zariya aur sarapa rehmat hai .

ayahs.text: jinn logon  ney buray buray kamon ka irtikab kiya hai , kiya woh yeh samjhay huye hain kay enhen/unhen hum inn/unn logon  kay barabar kerden gay jo emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , jiss kay nateejay mein inn/unn ka jeena aur marna aik hi jaisa hojaye-?   kitni buri baat hai jo yeh tey kiye huye hain !
ayahs.translation: jinn logon  ney buray buray kamon ka irtikab kiya hai , kiya woh yeh samjhay huye hain kay enhen/unhen hum inn/unn logon  kay barabar kerden gay jo emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , jiss kay nateejay mein inn/unn ka jeena aur marna aik hi jaisa hojaye-?   kitni buri baat hai jo yeh tey kiye huye hain !

ayahs.text: Allah ney saray aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq maqsad kay liye peda kiya hai , aur iss liye kiya hai kay her shaks ko uss kay kiye huye kamon ka badla diya jaye , aur detay waqt unn per koi zulm naa kiya jaye .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney saray aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq maqsad kay liye peda kiya hai , aur iss liye kiya hai kay her shaks ko uss kay kiye huye kamon ka badla diya jaye , aur detay waqt unn per koi zulm naa kiya jaye .

ayahs.text: phir kiya tum ney ussay bhi dekha jiss ney apna khuda apni nafsani khuwaish ko bana liya hai , aur ilm kay bawajood Allah ney ussay gumrahi mein daal diya , aur uss kay kaan aur dil per mohar laga di , aur uss ki aankh per perda daal diya ? abb Allah kay baad kon hai jo ussay raastay per laye-? kiya phir bhi tum log sabaq nahi letay-?
ayahs.translation: phir kiya tum ney ussay bhi dekha jiss ney apna khuda apni nafsani khuwaish ko bana liya hai , aur ilm kay bawajood Allah ney ussay gumrahi mein daal diya , aur uss kay kaan aur dil per mohar laga di , aur uss ki aankh per perda daal diya ? abb Allah kay baad kon hai jo ussay raastay per laye-? kiya phir bhi tum log sabaq nahi letay-?

ayahs.text: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  jo kuch zindagi hai , bus yehi humari dunyawi zindagi hai , ( issi mein ) hum martay aur jeetay hain aur hamen koi aur nahi , zamana hi halak ker deta hai .  halankay iss baat ka unhen kuch bhi ilm nahi hai , bus wehmi andazay lagatay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  jo kuch zindagi hai , bus yehi humari dunyawi zindagi hai , ( issi mein ) hum martay aur jeetay hain aur hamen koi aur nahi , zamana hi halak ker deta hai .  halankay iss baat ka unhen kuch bhi ilm nahi hai , bus wehmi andazay lagatay hain .

ayahs.text: aur jab humari aayaten poori wazahat kay sath unn ko parh ker sunai jati hain to yeh kehney kay siwa unn ki koi daleel nahi hoti kay :  agar tum sachay ho to humaray baap dadon ko ( zinda ker kay ) ley aao .
ayahs.translation: aur jab humari aayaten poori wazahat kay sath unn ko parh ker sunai jati hain to yeh kehney kay siwa unn ki koi daleel nahi hoti kay :  agar tum sachay ho to humaray baap dadon ko ( zinda ker kay ) ley aao .

ayahs.text: keh do kay Allah hi tumhen zindagi deta hai , phir woh tumhen moat dey ga , phir tum sabb ko qayamat kay din jama keray ga   jiss mein kissi qisam ka koi shak nahi hai , lekin aksar log samajhtay nahi hain .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay Allah hi tumhen zindagi deta hai , phir woh tumhen moat dey ga , phir tum sabb ko qayamat kay din jama keray ga   jiss mein kissi qisam ka koi shak nahi hai , lekin aksar log samajhtay nahi hain .

ayahs.text: aur aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat Allah hi ki hai , aur jiss din qayamat aa-khari hogi , uss din jo log batil per hain , woh sakht nuqsan uthayen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat Allah hi ki hai , aur jiss din qayamat aa-khari hogi , uss din jo log batil per hain , woh sakht nuqsan uthayen gay .

ayahs.text: aur tum her giroh ko dekho gay kay woh ghuttnon kay ball gira huwa hai .   her giroh ko uss kay aemal namay ki taraf bulaya jaye ga , ( aur kaha jaye ga kay : )  aaj tumhen unn aemal ka badla diya jaye ga jo tum kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: aur tum her giroh ko dekho gay kay woh ghuttnon kay ball gira huwa hai .   her giroh ko uss kay aemal namay ki taraf bulaya jaye ga , ( aur kaha jaye ga kay : )  aaj tumhen unn aemal ka badla diya jaye ga jo tum kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: yeh humara ( likhwaya huwa ) daftar hai jo tumharay baaray mein theek theek bol raha hai . tum jo kuch kertay thay , hum uss sabb ko likhwa liya kertay thay .

verses.text: hum ney aasmano aur zameen ko aur inn kay darmiyan ki cheezon ko kissi bar-haq maqsad kay baghair aur kissi mutayyan miyaad kay baghair peda nahi kerdiya hai . aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh uss cheez say mun morray huye hain jiss say unhen khabrdar kiya gaya hai .
verses.translation: hum ney aasmano aur zameen ko aur inn kay darmiyan ki cheezon ko kissi bar-haq maqsad kay baghair aur kissi mutayyan miyaad kay baghair peda nahi kerdiya hai . aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh uss cheez say mun morray huye hain jiss say unhen khabrdar kiya gaya hai .

verses.text: tum unn say kaho kay :  kiya tum ney unn cheezon per kabhi ghor kiya hai jinn ko tum Allah kay siwa pukartay ho-? mujhay dikhao to sahi kay unhon ney zameen ki konsi cheez peda ki hai ? ya aasmano ( ki takhleeq ) mein unn ka koi hissa hai-? meray paas koi aesi kitab lao jo iss Quran say pehlay ki ho , ya phir koi riwayat jiss ki buniyad ilm per ho ,   agar tum waqaee sachay ho .
verses.translation: tum unn say kaho kay :  kiya tum ney unn cheezon per kabhi ghor kiya hai jinn ko tum Allah kay siwa pukartay ho-? mujhay dikhao to sahi kay unhon ney zameen ki konsi cheez peda ki hai ? ya aasmano ( ki takhleeq ) mein unn ka koi hissa hai-? meray paas koi aesi kitab lao jo iss Quran say pehlay ki ho , ya phir koi riwayat jiss ki buniyad ilm per ho ,   agar tum waqaee sachay ho .

verses.text: uss shaks say bara gumrah kon hoga jo Allah ko chorr ker unn ( mann gharrat deotaon ) ko pukaray jo qayamat kay din tak uss ki pukar ka jawab nahi dey saktay , aur jinn ko inn ki pukar ki khabar tak nahi hai .
verses.translation: uss shaks say bara gumrah kon hoga jo Allah ko chorr ker unn ( mann gharrat deotaon ) ko pukaray jo qayamat kay din tak uss ki pukar ka jawab nahi dey saktay , aur jinn ko inn ki pukar ki khabar tak nahi hai .

verses.text: aur jab logon  ko mehshar mein jama kiya jaye ga to woh inn kay dushman ban jayen gay , aur inn ki ibadat hi say munkir hon gay .
verses.translation: aur jab logon  ko mehshar mein jama kiya jaye ga to woh inn kay dushman ban jayen gay , aur inn ki ibadat hi say munkir hon gay .

verses.text: aur jab inn kay samney humari aayaten apni poori wazahat kay sath parh ker sunai jati hain , to yeh kafir log haq baat kay unn tak phonch janey kay baad bhi uss kay baaray mein yun keh detay hain kay yeh to khula huwa jadoo hai .
verses.translation: aur jab inn kay samney humari aayaten apni poori wazahat kay sath parh ker sunai jati hain , to yeh kafir log haq baat kay unn tak phonch janey kay baad bhi uss kay baaray mein yun keh detay hain kay yeh to khula huwa jadoo hai .

verses.text: kiya inn ka kehna yeh hai kay issay payghumber ney apni taraf say gharr liya hai ? keh do kay :  agar mein ney issay apni taraf say gharr liya hai to tum mujhay Allah ki pakar say zara bhi nahi bacha sako gay .   jo baaten tum banatay ho , woh unhen khoob janta hai . meray aur tumharay darmiyan gawah banney kay liye woh kafi hai , aur wohi hai jo boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
verses.translation: kiya inn ka kehna yeh hai kay issay payghumber ney apni taraf say gharr liya hai ? keh do kay :  agar mein ney issay apni taraf say gharr liya hai to tum mujhay Allah ki pakar say zara bhi nahi bacha sako gay .   jo baaten tum banatay ho , woh unhen khoob janta hai . meray aur tumharay darmiyan gawah banney kay liye woh kafi hai , aur wohi hai jo boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

verses.text: kaho kay :  mein payghumberon mein koi anokha payghumber nahi hun . mujhay maloom nahi hai kay meray sath kiya kiya jaye ga , aur naa yeh maloom hai kay tumharay sath kiya hoga-? .   mein kissi aur cheez ki nahi , sirf uss wahi ki perwi kerta hun jo mujhay bheji jati hai . aur mein to sirf aik wazeh andaz say khabrdar kernay wala hun .
verses.translation: kaho kay :  mein payghumberon mein koi anokha payghumber nahi hun . mujhay maloom nahi hai kay meray sath kiya kiya jaye ga , aur naa yeh maloom hai kay tumharay sath kiya hoga-? .   mein kissi aur cheez ki nahi , sirf uss wahi ki perwi kerta hun jo mujhay bheji jati hai . aur mein to sirf aik wazeh andaz say khabrdar kernay wala hun .

verses.text: kaho kay :  zara mujhay yeh batao kay agar yeh ( Quran ) Allah ki taraf say ho , aur tum ney uss ka inkar kerdiya , aur bano Israel mein say aik gawah ney iss jaisi baat kay haq mein gawahi bhi dey di , aur uss per emaan bhi ley aaya ,   aur tum apney ghamand mein mubtala rahey ( to yeh kitney zulm ki baat hai-? ) yaqeen jano kay Allah aesay logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata jo zalim hon .
verses.translation: kaho kay :  zara mujhay yeh batao kay agar yeh ( Quran ) Allah ki taraf say ho , aur tum ney uss ka inkar kerdiya , aur bano Israel mein say aik gawah ney iss jaisi baat kay haq mein gawahi bhi dey di , aur uss per emaan bhi ley aaya ,   aur tum apney ghamand mein mubtala rahey ( to yeh kitney zulm ki baat hai-? ) yaqeen jano kay Allah aesay logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata jo zalim hon .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh emaan laney walon kay baaray mein yun kehtay hain kay :  agar yeh ( emaan lana ) koi achi baat hoti to yeh log iss baaray mein hum say sabqat naa ley jasaktay .    aur jab inn kafiron ney iss say khud hidayat hasil nahi ki to woh to yehi kahen gay kay yeh wohi puraney zamaney ka jhoot hai .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh emaan laney walon kay baaray mein yun kehtay hain kay :  agar yeh ( emaan lana ) koi achi baat hoti to yeh log iss baaray mein hum say sabqat naa ley jasaktay .    aur jab inn kafiron ney iss say khud hidayat hasil nahi ki to woh to yehi kahen gay kay yeh wohi puraney zamaney ka jhoot hai .

verses.text: aur iss say pehlay musa ki kitab rehnuma aur rehmat ban ker aa-chuki hai . aur yeh ( Quran ) woh kitab hai jo arbi zaban mein hotay huye uss ko sacha bata rahi hai ,   takay inn zalimon ko khabrdar keray , aur naik kaam kernay walon kay liye khushkhabri ban jaye .
verses.translation: aur iss say pehlay musa ki kitab rehnuma aur rehmat ban ker aa-chuki hai . aur yeh ( Quran ) woh kitab hai jo arbi zaban mein hotay huye uss ko sacha bata rahi hai ,   takay inn zalimon ko khabrdar keray , aur naik kaam kernay walon kay liye khushkhabri ban jaye .

verses.text: yaqeenan jinn logon  ney yeh keh diya hai kay :  humara perwerdigar Allah hai  phir woh uss per sabit qadam rahey ,   to unn per naa koi khof taari hoga , aur naa woh ghumgeen hon gay .
verses.translation: yaqeenan jinn logon  ney yeh keh diya hai kay :  humara perwerdigar Allah hai  phir woh uss per sabit qadam rahey ,   to unn per naa koi khof taari hoga , aur naa woh ghumgeen hon gay .

verses.text: woh jannat walay log hain jo hamesha uss mein rahen gay . yeh unn aemal ka badla hoga jo woh kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: woh jannat walay log hain jo hamesha uss mein rahen gay . yeh unn aemal ka badla hoga jo woh kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: aur hum ney insan ko apney walaiden say acha bartao kernay ka hukum diya hai .   uss ki maa ney bari mushaqqat say ussay ( pet mein ) uthaye rakha , aur bari mushaqqat say uss ko jana , aur uss ko uthaye rakhney aur uss kay doodh churraney ki mauddat tees maheenay hoti hai ,   yahan tak kay jab woh apni poori tawanai ko phonch gaya , aur chaalees saal ki umar tak phonch gaya to woh kehta hai kay :  yaar rab ! mujhay tofiq dijiye kay mein aap ki uss naimat ka shukar ada kerun jo aap ney mujhay aur meray maa baap ko ata farmaee , aur aesay naik amal kerun jinn say aap razi hojayen , aur meray liye meri aulad ko bhi salahiyat dey dijiye . mein aap kay huzoor tauba kerta hun , aur mein farmanbardaaron mein shamil hun .
verses.translation: aur hum ney insan ko apney walaiden say acha bartao kernay ka hukum diya hai .   uss ki maa ney bari mushaqqat say ussay ( pet mein ) uthaye rakha , aur bari mushaqqat say uss ko jana , aur uss ko uthaye rakhney aur uss kay doodh churraney ki mauddat tees maheenay hoti hai ,   yahan tak kay jab woh apni poori tawanai ko phonch gaya , aur chaalees saal ki umar tak phonch gaya to woh kehta hai kay :  yaar rab ! mujhay tofiq dijiye kay mein aap ki uss naimat ka shukar ada kerun jo aap ney mujhay aur meray maa baap ko ata farmaee , aur aesay naik amal kerun jinn say aap razi hojayen , aur meray liye meri aulad ko bhi salahiyat dey dijiye . mein aap kay huzoor tauba kerta hun , aur mein farmanbardaaron mein shamil hun .

verses.text: yeh woh log hain jinn say hum unn kay behtareen aemal qubool keren gay , aur unn ki khataon say darguzar keren gay , ( jiss kay nateejay mein ) woh jannat walon mein shamil hon gay , uss sachay waday ki badolat jo unn say kiya jata tha .
verses.translation: yeh woh log hain jinn say hum unn kay behtareen aemal qubool keren gay , aur unn ki khataon say darguzar keren gay , ( jiss kay nateejay mein ) woh jannat walon mein shamil hon gay , uss sachay waday ki badolat jo unn say kiya jata tha .

verses.text: aur aik woh shaks hai jiss ney apney walaiden say kaha hai kay :  tuff hai tum per ! kiya tum mujh say yeh wada kertay ho kay mujhay zinda ker kay qabar say nikala jaye ga , halankay mujh say pehlay boht si naslen guzar chuki hain .  aur walaiden Allah say fariyad kertay hain , ( aur betay say kehtay hain kay : )  afsos hai tujh per , emaan ley aa . yaqeen jaan kay Allah ka wada sacha hai .  to woh kehta hai kay :  inn baaton ki iss kay siwa koi haqeeqat nahi hai kay yeh mehaz afsaney hain jo pichlay logon  say naqal hotay chalay aarahey hain .
verses.translation: aur aik woh shaks hai jiss ney apney walaiden say kaha hai kay :  tuff hai tum per ! kiya tum mujh say yeh wada kertay ho kay mujhay zinda ker kay qabar say nikala jaye ga , halankay mujh say pehlay boht si naslen guzar chuki hain .  aur walaiden Allah say fariyad kertay hain , ( aur betay say kehtay hain kay : )  afsos hai tujh per , emaan ley aa . yaqeen jaan kay Allah ka wada sacha hai .  to woh kehta hai kay :  inn baaton ki iss kay siwa koi haqeeqat nahi hai kay yeh mehaz afsaney hain jo pichlay logon  say naqal hotay chalay aarahey hain .

verses.text: yeh woh log hain jinn kay baaray mein jinnaat aur insanon kay unn girohon samet jo inn say pehlay guzray hain , ( azab ki ) baat tey hochuki hai . haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh sabb bara nuqsan uthaney walay hain .
verses.translation: yeh woh log hain jinn kay baaray mein jinnaat aur insanon kay unn girohon samet jo inn say pehlay guzray hain , ( azab ki ) baat tey hochuki hai . haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh sabb bara nuqsan uthaney walay hain .

verses.text: aur her aik ( giroh ) kay apney aemal ki wajeh say mukhtalif darjay hain , aur iss liye hain takay Allah unn ko unn kay aemal ka poora poora badla dey . aur unn per koi zulm nahi hoga .
verses.translation: aur her aik ( giroh ) kay apney aemal ki wajeh say mukhtalif darjay hain , aur iss liye hain takay Allah unn ko unn kay aemal ka poora poora badla dey . aur unn per koi zulm nahi hoga .

verses.text: aur uss din ko yaad rakho jab inn kafiron ko aag kay samney paish kiya jaye ga , ( aur kaha jaye ga kay : )  tum ney apney hissay ki achi cheezen apni dunyawi zindagi mein khatam ker daalen ,   aur inn say khoob maza ley liya , lehaza aaj tumhen badlay mein zillat ki saza milay gi , kiyonkay tum zameen mein nahaq takabbur kiya kertay thay , aur kiyonkay tum nafarmani kay aadi thay .
verses.translation: aur uss din ko yaad rakho jab inn kafiron ko aag kay samney paish kiya jaye ga , ( aur kaha jaye ga kay : )  tum ney apney hissay ki achi cheezen apni dunyawi zindagi mein khatam ker daalen ,   aur inn say khoob maza ley liya , lehaza aaj tumhen badlay mein zillat ki saza milay gi , kiyonkay tum zameen mein nahaq takabbur kiya kertay thay , aur kiyonkay tum nafarmani kay aadi thay .

verses.text: aur qoam-e-aad kay bhai ( hazrat Hood aleh-assalam ) ka tazkarah kero , jab unhon ney apni qoam ko kham daar teelo ki sarzameen mein   khabrdar kiya tha aur aesay khabrdar kernay walay unn say pehlay bhi guzar chukay hain , aur unn kay baad bhi kay :  Allah kay siwa kissi ki ibadat naa kero , mujhay tum per aik zabardast din kay azab ka andesha hai .
verses.translation: aur qoam-e-aad kay bhai ( hazrat Hood aleh-assalam ) ka tazkarah kero , jab unhon ney apni qoam ko kham daar teelo ki sarzameen mein   khabrdar kiya tha aur aesay khabrdar kernay walay unn say pehlay bhi guzar chukay hain , aur unn kay baad bhi kay :  Allah kay siwa kissi ki ibadat naa kero , mujhay tum per aik zabardast din kay azab ka andesha hai .

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  kiya tum humaray paas iss liye aaye ho kay humaray khudaon say hamen bargushta kero-? acha agar tum sachay ho to ley aao hum per woh ( azab ) jiss ki dhamki dey rahey ho .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  kiya tum humaray paas iss liye aaye ho kay humaray khudaon say hamen bargushta kero-? acha agar tum sachay ho to ley aao hum per woh ( azab ) jiss ki dhamki dey rahey ho .

verses.text: unhon ney farmaya :  theek theek ilm to Allah kay paas hai ( kay woh azab kab aaye ga-? ) mujhay jo paygham dey ker bheja gaya hai , mein to tumhen wohi paygham phoncha raha hun , albatta mein yeh zaroor dekh raha hun kay tum aesay log ho jo nadani ki baaten ker rahey ho .
verses.translation: unhon ney farmaya :  theek theek ilm to Allah kay paas hai ( kay woh azab kab aaye ga-? ) mujhay jo paygham dey ker bheja gaya hai , mein to tumhen wohi paygham phoncha raha hun , albatta mein yeh zaroor dekh raha hun kay tum aesay log ho jo nadani ki baaten ker rahey ho .

verses.text: phir huwa yeh kay jab unhon ney uss ( azab ) ko aik badal ki shakal mein aata dekha jo unn ki wadiyon ka rukh ker raha tha to unhon ney kaha kay :  yeh badal hai jo hum per barish barsaye ga .  nahi ! balkay yeh woh cheez hai jiss ki tum ney jaldi machai thi aik aandhi jiss mein dardnak azab hai ,
verses.translation: phir huwa yeh kay jab unhon ney uss ( azab ) ko aik badal ki shakal mein aata dekha jo unn ki wadiyon ka rukh ker raha tha to unhon ney kaha kay :  yeh badal hai jo hum per barish barsaye ga .  nahi ! balkay yeh woh cheez hai jiss ki tum ney jaldi machai thi aik aandhi jiss mein dardnak azab hai ,

verses.text: jo apney perwerdigar kay hukum say her cheez ko tehas nehas ker daalay gi ! gharz unn ki halat yeh hogaee kay unn kay gharon kay siwa kuch nazar nahi aata tha . aesay mujrim logon  ko hum aesi hi saza detay hain .
verses.translation: jo apney perwerdigar kay hukum say her cheez ko tehas nehas ker daalay gi ! gharz unn ki halat yeh hogaee kay unn kay gharon kay siwa kuch nazar nahi aata tha . aesay mujrim logon  ko hum aesi hi saza detay hain .

verses.text: aur ( aey arab kay logo ! ) hum ney unn logon  ko unn baaton ki taqat di thi jinn ki taqat tumhen nahi di , aur hum ney unn ko kaan , aankhen aur dil sabb kuch dey rakhay thay , lekin naa unn kay kaan aur unn ki aankhen unn kay kuch kaam ayen , aur naa unn kay dil , kiyonkay woh Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kertay thay , aur jiss cheez ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay , ussi ney unhen aa-ghera .
verses.translation: aur ( aey arab kay logo ! ) hum ney unn logon  ko unn baaton ki taqat di thi jinn ki taqat tumhen nahi di , aur hum ney unn ko kaan , aankhen aur dil sabb kuch dey rakhay thay , lekin naa unn kay kaan aur unn ki aankhen unn kay kuch kaam ayen , aur naa unn kay dil , kiyonkay woh Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kertay thay , aur jiss cheez ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay , ussi ney unhen aa-ghera .

verses.text: aur hum ney aur bastiyon ko bhi halak kiya hai jo tumharay ird-gird waqay then ,   jabkay hum tarah tarah ki nishaniyan ( unn kay ) samney laa-chukay thay , takay woh baaz aajayen .
verses.translation: aur hum ney aur bastiyon ko bhi halak kiya hai jo tumharay ird-gird waqay then ,   jabkay hum tarah tarah ki nishaniyan ( unn kay ) samney laa-chukay thay , takay woh baaz aajayen .

verses.text: phir unhon ney Allah ka taqarrub  hasil kernay kay liye jinn cheezon ko Allah kay siwa mabood bana rakha tha , unhon ney unn ki kiyon madad naa kerli-? iss kay bajaye woh sabb unn kay liye bey nishan hogaye . yeh to unn ka sarasar jhoot tha , aur bohtan tha jo unhon ney tarash rakha tha .
verses.translation: phir unhon ney Allah ka taqarrub  hasil kernay kay liye jinn cheezon ko Allah kay siwa mabood bana rakha tha , unhon ney unn ki kiyon madad naa kerli-? iss kay bajaye woh sabb unn kay liye bey nishan hogaye . yeh to unn ka sarasar jhoot tha , aur bohtan tha jo unhon ney tarash rakha tha .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) yaad kero jab hum ney jinnaat mein say aik giroh ko tumhari taraf mutawajjah kiya kay woh Quran sunen ,   chunacheh jab woh wahan phonchay to unhon ney ( aik doosray say ) kaha kay :  khamosh hojao  phir jab woh parha ja-chuka to woh apni qoam kay paas unhen khabrdar kertay huye wapis phonchay .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) yaad kero jab hum ney jinnaat mein say aik giroh ko tumhari taraf mutawajjah kiya kay woh Quran sunen ,   chunacheh jab woh wahan phonchay to unhon ney ( aik doosray say ) kaha kay :  khamosh hojao  phir jab woh parha ja-chuka to woh apni qoam kay paas unhen khabrdar kertay huye wapis phonchay .

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  aey humari qoam kay logo ! yaqeen jano hum ney aik aesi kitab suni hai jo musa ( aleh-assalam ) kay baad nazil ki gaee hai , apney say pehli kitabon ki tasdeeq kerti hai , haq baat aur seedhay raastay ki taraf raahnumai kerti hai .
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  aey humari qoam kay logo ! yaqeen jano hum ney aik aesi kitab suni hai jo musa ( aleh-assalam ) kay baad nazil ki gaee hai , apney say pehli kitabon ki tasdeeq kerti hai , haq baat aur seedhay raastay ki taraf raahnumai kerti hai .

verses.text: aey humari qoam kay logo ! Allah kay daee ki baat maan lo , aur uss per emaan ley aao , Allah tumharay gunahon ko moaaf kerday ga , aur tumhen aik dardnak azab say panah dey dey ga .
verses.translation: aey humari qoam kay logo ! Allah kay daee ki baat maan lo , aur uss per emaan ley aao , Allah tumharay gunahon ko moaaf kerday ga , aur tumhen aik dardnak azab say panah dey dey ga .

verses.text: aur jo koi Allah kay daee ki baat naa maaney to woh sari zameen mein kahen bhi jaker Allah ko aajiz nahi ker-sakta , aur Allah kay siwa uss ko kissi qisam kay rakhwalay bhi nahi milen gay . aesay log khuli gumrahi mein mubtala hain .
verses.translation: aur jo koi Allah kay daee ki baat naa maaney to woh sari zameen mein kahen bhi jaker Allah ko aajiz nahi ker-sakta , aur Allah kay siwa uss ko kissi qisam kay rakhwalay bhi nahi milen gay . aesay log khuli gumrahi mein mubtala hain .

verses.text: kiya inn ko yeh sujhai nahi diya kay woh Allah jiss ney saray aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya , aur unn ko peda kernay say uss ko zara bhi thakan nahi hoi , woh yaqeenan iss baat per poori tarah qadir hai kay murdon ko zinda kerday-? aur kiyon naa ho-? woh beyshak her cheez ki poori qudrat rakhney wala hai .
verses.translation: kiya inn ko yeh sujhai nahi diya kay woh Allah jiss ney saray aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya , aur unn ko peda kernay say uss ko zara bhi thakan nahi hoi , woh yaqeenan iss baat per poori tarah qadir hai kay murdon ko zinda kerday-? aur kiyon naa ho-? woh beyshak her cheez ki poori qudrat rakhney wala hai .

verses.text: aur jiss din kafiron ko aag kay samney paish kiya jaye ga , uss din ( unn say poocha jaye ga ) kay kiya yeh ( dozakh ) sach nahi hai ? woh kahen gay kay :  humaray rab ki qasam ! yeh waqaee sach hai .  Allah irshad farmaye ga kay :  phir chakho maza azab ka , uss kufr kay badlay mein jo tum ney ikhtiyar ker rakha tha .
verses.translation: aur jiss din kafiron ko aag kay samney paish kiya jaye ga , uss din ( unn say poocha jaye ga ) kay kiya yeh ( dozakh ) sach nahi hai ? woh kahen gay kay :  humaray rab ki qasam ! yeh waqaee sach hai .  Allah irshad farmaye ga kay :  phir chakho maza azab ka , uss kufr kay badlay mein jo tum ney ikhtiyar ker rakha tha .

verses.text: gharz ( aey payghumber ! ) tum ussi tarah sabar kiye jao jaisay oolool-azm payghumberon ney sabar kiya hai , aur inn kay moamlay mein jaldi naa kero . jiss din yeh log woh cheez dekh len gay jiss say enhen daraya jaraha hai , uss din ( enhen ) yun mehsoos hoga jaisay woh ( duniya mein ) din ki aik gharri say ziyada nahi rahey .   yeh hai woh paygham jo phoncha diya gaya hai ! abb barbad to wohi log hon gay jo nafarman hain .
verses.translation: gharz ( aey payghumber ! ) tum ussi tarah sabar kiye jao jaisay oolool-azm payghumberon ney sabar kiya hai , aur inn kay moamlay mein jaldi naa kero . jiss din yeh log woh cheez dekh len gay jiss say enhen daraya jaraha hai , uss din ( enhen ) yun mehsoos hoga jaisay woh ( duniya mein ) din ki aik gharri say ziyada nahi rahey .   yeh hai woh paygham jo phoncha diya gaya hai ! abb barbad to wohi log hon gay jo nafarman hain .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai .

ayahs.text: Haa-Meem .
ayahs.translation: Haa-Meem .

ayahs.text: yeh kitab Allah ki taraf say utaari jarahi hai jo bara sahab-e-iqtidar , bara sahab-e-hikmat hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh kitab Allah ki taraf say utaari jarahi hai jo bara sahab-e-iqtidar , bara sahab-e-hikmat hai .

ayahs.text: hum ney aasmano aur zameen ko aur inn kay darmiyan ki cheezon ko kissi bar-haq maqsad kay baghair aur kissi mutayyan miyaad kay baghair peda nahi kerdiya hai . aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh uss cheez say mun morray huye hain jiss say unhen khabrdar kiya gaya hai .
ayahs.translation: hum ney aasmano aur zameen ko aur inn kay darmiyan ki cheezon ko kissi bar-haq maqsad kay baghair aur kissi mutayyan miyaad kay baghair peda nahi kerdiya hai . aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh uss cheez say mun morray huye hain jiss say unhen khabrdar kiya gaya hai .

ayahs.text: tum unn say kaho kay :  kiya tum ney unn cheezon per kabhi ghor kiya hai jinn ko tum Allah kay siwa pukartay ho-? mujhay dikhao to sahi kay unhon ney zameen ki konsi cheez peda ki hai ? ya aasmano ( ki takhleeq ) mein unn ka koi hissa hai-? meray paas koi aesi kitab lao jo iss Quran say pehlay ki ho , ya phir koi riwayat jiss ki buniyad ilm per ho ,   agar tum waqaee sachay ho .
ayahs.translation: tum unn say kaho kay :  kiya tum ney unn cheezon per kabhi ghor kiya hai jinn ko tum Allah kay siwa pukartay ho-? mujhay dikhao to sahi kay unhon ney zameen ki konsi cheez peda ki hai ? ya aasmano ( ki takhleeq ) mein unn ka koi hissa hai-? meray paas koi aesi kitab lao jo iss Quran say pehlay ki ho , ya phir koi riwayat jiss ki buniyad ilm per ho ,   agar tum waqaee sachay ho .

ayahs.text: uss shaks say bara gumrah kon hoga jo Allah ko chorr ker unn ( mann gharrat deotaon ) ko pukaray jo qayamat kay din tak uss ki pukar ka jawab nahi dey saktay , aur jinn ko inn ki pukar ki khabar tak nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: uss shaks say bara gumrah kon hoga jo Allah ko chorr ker unn ( mann gharrat deotaon ) ko pukaray jo qayamat kay din tak uss ki pukar ka jawab nahi dey saktay , aur jinn ko inn ki pukar ki khabar tak nahi hai .

ayahs.text: aur jab logon  ko mehshar mein jama kiya jaye ga to woh inn kay dushman ban jayen gay , aur inn ki ibadat hi say munkir hon gay .
ayahs.translation: aur jab logon  ko mehshar mein jama kiya jaye ga to woh inn kay dushman ban jayen gay , aur inn ki ibadat hi say munkir hon gay .

ayahs.text: aur jab inn kay samney humari aayaten apni poori wazahat kay sath parh ker sunai jati hain , to yeh kafir log haq baat kay unn tak phonch janey kay baad bhi uss kay baaray mein yun keh detay hain kay yeh to khula huwa jadoo hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jab inn kay samney humari aayaten apni poori wazahat kay sath parh ker sunai jati hain , to yeh kafir log haq baat kay unn tak phonch janey kay baad bhi uss kay baaray mein yun keh detay hain kay yeh to khula huwa jadoo hai .

ayahs.text: kiya inn ka kehna yeh hai kay issay payghumber ney apni taraf say gharr liya hai ? keh do kay :  agar mein ney issay apni taraf say gharr liya hai to tum mujhay Allah ki pakar say zara bhi nahi bacha sako gay .   jo baaten tum banatay ho , woh unhen khoob janta hai . meray aur tumharay darmiyan gawah banney kay liye woh kafi hai , aur wohi hai jo boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: kiya inn ka kehna yeh hai kay issay payghumber ney apni taraf say gharr liya hai ? keh do kay :  agar mein ney issay apni taraf say gharr liya hai to tum mujhay Allah ki pakar say zara bhi nahi bacha sako gay .   jo baaten tum banatay ho , woh unhen khoob janta hai . meray aur tumharay darmiyan gawah banney kay liye woh kafi hai , aur wohi hai jo boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

ayahs.text: kaho kay :  mein payghumberon mein koi anokha payghumber nahi hun . mujhay maloom nahi hai kay meray sath kiya kiya jaye ga , aur naa yeh maloom hai kay tumharay sath kiya hoga-? .   mein kissi aur cheez ki nahi , sirf uss wahi ki perwi kerta hun jo mujhay bheji jati hai . aur mein to sirf aik wazeh andaz say khabrdar kernay wala hun .
ayahs.translation: kaho kay :  mein payghumberon mein koi anokha payghumber nahi hun . mujhay maloom nahi hai kay meray sath kiya kiya jaye ga , aur naa yeh maloom hai kay tumharay sath kiya hoga-? .   mein kissi aur cheez ki nahi , sirf uss wahi ki perwi kerta hun jo mujhay bheji jati hai . aur mein to sirf aik wazeh andaz say khabrdar kernay wala hun .

ayahs.text: kaho kay :  zara mujhay yeh batao kay agar yeh ( Quran ) Allah ki taraf say ho , aur tum ney uss ka inkar kerdiya , aur bano Israel mein say aik gawah ney iss jaisi baat kay haq mein gawahi bhi dey di , aur uss per emaan bhi ley aaya ,   aur tum apney ghamand mein mubtala rahey ( to yeh kitney zulm ki baat hai-? ) yaqeen jano kay Allah aesay logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata jo zalim hon .
ayahs.translation: kaho kay :  zara mujhay yeh batao kay agar yeh ( Quran ) Allah ki taraf say ho , aur tum ney uss ka inkar kerdiya , aur bano Israel mein say aik gawah ney iss jaisi baat kay haq mein gawahi bhi dey di , aur uss per emaan bhi ley aaya ,   aur tum apney ghamand mein mubtala rahey ( to yeh kitney zulm ki baat hai-? ) yaqeen jano kay Allah aesay logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata jo zalim hon .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh emaan laney walon kay baaray mein yun kehtay hain kay :  agar yeh ( emaan lana ) koi achi baat hoti to yeh log iss baaray mein hum say sabqat naa ley jasaktay .    aur jab inn kafiron ney iss say khud hidayat hasil nahi ki to woh to yehi kahen gay kay yeh wohi puraney zamaney ka jhoot hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh emaan laney walon kay baaray mein yun kehtay hain kay :  agar yeh ( emaan lana ) koi achi baat hoti to yeh log iss baaray mein hum say sabqat naa ley jasaktay .    aur jab inn kafiron ney iss say khud hidayat hasil nahi ki to woh to yehi kahen gay kay yeh wohi puraney zamaney ka jhoot hai .

ayahs.text: aur iss say pehlay musa ki kitab rehnuma aur rehmat ban ker aa-chuki hai . aur yeh ( Quran ) woh kitab hai jo arbi zaban mein hotay huye uss ko sacha bata rahi hai ,   takay inn zalimon ko khabrdar keray , aur naik kaam kernay walon kay liye khushkhabri ban jaye .
ayahs.translation: aur iss say pehlay musa ki kitab rehnuma aur rehmat ban ker aa-chuki hai . aur yeh ( Quran ) woh kitab hai jo arbi zaban mein hotay huye uss ko sacha bata rahi hai ,   takay inn zalimon ko khabrdar keray , aur naik kaam kernay walon kay liye khushkhabri ban jaye .

ayahs.text: yaqeenan jinn logon  ney yeh keh diya hai kay :  humara perwerdigar Allah hai  phir woh uss per sabit qadam rahey ,   to unn per naa koi khof taari hoga , aur naa woh ghumgeen hon gay .
ayahs.translation: yaqeenan jinn logon  ney yeh keh diya hai kay :  humara perwerdigar Allah hai  phir woh uss per sabit qadam rahey ,   to unn per naa koi khof taari hoga , aur naa woh ghumgeen hon gay .

ayahs.text: woh jannat walay log hain jo hamesha uss mein rahen gay . yeh unn aemal ka badla hoga jo woh kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: woh jannat walay log hain jo hamesha uss mein rahen gay . yeh unn aemal ka badla hoga jo woh kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney insan ko apney walaiden say acha bartao kernay ka hukum diya hai .   uss ki maa ney bari mushaqqat say ussay ( pet mein ) uthaye rakha , aur bari mushaqqat say uss ko jana , aur uss ko uthaye rakhney aur uss kay doodh churraney ki mauddat tees maheenay hoti hai ,   yahan tak kay jab woh apni poori tawanai ko phonch gaya , aur chaalees saal ki umar tak phonch gaya to woh kehta hai kay :  yaar rab ! mujhay tofiq dijiye kay mein aap ki uss naimat ka shukar ada kerun jo aap ney mujhay aur meray maa baap ko ata farmaee , aur aesay naik amal kerun jinn say aap razi hojayen , aur meray liye meri aulad ko bhi salahiyat dey dijiye . mein aap kay huzoor tauba kerta hun , aur mein farmanbardaaron mein shamil hun .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney insan ko apney walaiden say acha bartao kernay ka hukum diya hai .   uss ki maa ney bari mushaqqat say ussay ( pet mein ) uthaye rakha , aur bari mushaqqat say uss ko jana , aur uss ko uthaye rakhney aur uss kay doodh churraney ki mauddat tees maheenay hoti hai ,   yahan tak kay jab woh apni poori tawanai ko phonch gaya , aur chaalees saal ki umar tak phonch gaya to woh kehta hai kay :  yaar rab ! mujhay tofiq dijiye kay mein aap ki uss naimat ka shukar ada kerun jo aap ney mujhay aur meray maa baap ko ata farmaee , aur aesay naik amal kerun jinn say aap razi hojayen , aur meray liye meri aulad ko bhi salahiyat dey dijiye . mein aap kay huzoor tauba kerta hun , aur mein farmanbardaaron mein shamil hun .

ayahs.text: yeh woh log hain jinn say hum unn kay behtareen aemal qubool keren gay , aur unn ki khataon say darguzar keren gay , ( jiss kay nateejay mein ) woh jannat walon mein shamil hon gay , uss sachay waday ki badolat jo unn say kiya jata tha .
ayahs.translation: yeh woh log hain jinn say hum unn kay behtareen aemal qubool keren gay , aur unn ki khataon say darguzar keren gay , ( jiss kay nateejay mein ) woh jannat walon mein shamil hon gay , uss sachay waday ki badolat jo unn say kiya jata tha .

ayahs.text: aur aik woh shaks hai jiss ney apney walaiden say kaha hai kay :  tuff hai tum per ! kiya tum mujh say yeh wada kertay ho kay mujhay zinda ker kay qabar say nikala jaye ga , halankay mujh say pehlay boht si naslen guzar chuki hain .  aur walaiden Allah say fariyad kertay hain , ( aur betay say kehtay hain kay : )  afsos hai tujh per , emaan ley aa . yaqeen jaan kay Allah ka wada sacha hai .  to woh kehta hai kay :  inn baaton ki iss kay siwa koi haqeeqat nahi hai kay yeh mehaz afsaney hain jo pichlay logon  say naqal hotay chalay aarahey hain .
ayahs.translation: aur aik woh shaks hai jiss ney apney walaiden say kaha hai kay :  tuff hai tum per ! kiya tum mujh say yeh wada kertay ho kay mujhay zinda ker kay qabar say nikala jaye ga , halankay mujh say pehlay boht si naslen guzar chuki hain .  aur walaiden Allah say fariyad kertay hain , ( aur betay say kehtay hain kay : )  afsos hai tujh per , emaan ley aa . yaqeen jaan kay Allah ka wada sacha hai .  to woh kehta hai kay :  inn baaton ki iss kay siwa koi haqeeqat nahi hai kay yeh mehaz afsaney hain jo pichlay logon  say naqal hotay chalay aarahey hain .

ayahs.text: yeh woh log hain jinn kay baaray mein jinnaat aur insanon kay unn girohon samet jo inn say pehlay guzray hain , ( azab ki ) baat tey hochuki hai . haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh sabb bara nuqsan uthaney walay hain .
ayahs.translation: yeh woh log hain jinn kay baaray mein jinnaat aur insanon kay unn girohon samet jo inn say pehlay guzray hain , ( azab ki ) baat tey hochuki hai . haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh sabb bara nuqsan uthaney walay hain .

ayahs.text: aur her aik ( giroh ) kay apney aemal ki wajeh say mukhtalif darjay hain , aur iss liye hain takay Allah unn ko unn kay aemal ka poora poora badla dey . aur unn per koi zulm nahi hoga .
ayahs.translation: aur her aik ( giroh ) kay apney aemal ki wajeh say mukhtalif darjay hain , aur iss liye hain takay Allah unn ko unn kay aemal ka poora poora badla dey . aur unn per koi zulm nahi hoga .

ayahs.text: aur uss din ko yaad rakho jab inn kafiron ko aag kay samney paish kiya jaye ga , ( aur kaha jaye ga kay : )  tum ney apney hissay ki achi cheezen apni dunyawi zindagi mein khatam ker daalen ,   aur inn say khoob maza ley liya , lehaza aaj tumhen badlay mein zillat ki saza milay gi , kiyonkay tum zameen mein nahaq takabbur kiya kertay thay , aur kiyonkay tum nafarmani kay aadi thay .
ayahs.translation: aur uss din ko yaad rakho jab inn kafiron ko aag kay samney paish kiya jaye ga , ( aur kaha jaye ga kay : )  tum ney apney hissay ki achi cheezen apni dunyawi zindagi mein khatam ker daalen ,   aur inn say khoob maza ley liya , lehaza aaj tumhen badlay mein zillat ki saza milay gi , kiyonkay tum zameen mein nahaq takabbur kiya kertay thay , aur kiyonkay tum nafarmani kay aadi thay .

ayahs.text: aur qoam-e-aad kay bhai ( hazrat Hood aleh-assalam ) ka tazkarah kero , jab unhon ney apni qoam ko kham daar teelo ki sarzameen mein   khabrdar kiya tha aur aesay khabrdar kernay walay unn say pehlay bhi guzar chukay hain , aur unn kay baad bhi kay :  Allah kay siwa kissi ki ibadat naa kero , mujhay tum per aik zabardast din kay azab ka andesha hai .
ayahs.translation: aur qoam-e-aad kay bhai ( hazrat Hood aleh-assalam ) ka tazkarah kero , jab unhon ney apni qoam ko kham daar teelo ki sarzameen mein   khabrdar kiya tha aur aesay khabrdar kernay walay unn say pehlay bhi guzar chukay hain , aur unn kay baad bhi kay :  Allah kay siwa kissi ki ibadat naa kero , mujhay tum per aik zabardast din kay azab ka andesha hai .

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha :  kiya tum humaray paas iss liye aaye ho kay humaray khudaon say hamen bargushta kero-? acha agar tum sachay ho to ley aao hum per woh ( azab ) jiss ki dhamki dey rahey ho .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha :  kiya tum humaray paas iss liye aaye ho kay humaray khudaon say hamen bargushta kero-? acha agar tum sachay ho to ley aao hum per woh ( azab ) jiss ki dhamki dey rahey ho .

ayahs.text: unhon ney farmaya :  theek theek ilm to Allah kay paas hai ( kay woh azab kab aaye ga-? ) mujhay jo paygham dey ker bheja gaya hai , mein to tumhen wohi paygham phoncha raha hun , albatta mein yeh zaroor dekh raha hun kay tum aesay log ho jo nadani ki baaten ker rahey ho .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney farmaya :  theek theek ilm to Allah kay paas hai ( kay woh azab kab aaye ga-? ) mujhay jo paygham dey ker bheja gaya hai , mein to tumhen wohi paygham phoncha raha hun , albatta mein yeh zaroor dekh raha hun kay tum aesay log ho jo nadani ki baaten ker rahey ho .

ayahs.text: phir huwa yeh kay jab unhon ney uss ( azab ) ko aik badal ki shakal mein aata dekha jo unn ki wadiyon ka rukh ker raha tha to unhon ney kaha kay :  yeh badal hai jo hum per barish barsaye ga .  nahi ! balkay yeh woh cheez hai jiss ki tum ney jaldi machai thi aik aandhi jiss mein dardnak azab hai ,
ayahs.translation: phir huwa yeh kay jab unhon ney uss ( azab ) ko aik badal ki shakal mein aata dekha jo unn ki wadiyon ka rukh ker raha tha to unhon ney kaha kay :  yeh badal hai jo hum per barish barsaye ga .  nahi ! balkay yeh woh cheez hai jiss ki tum ney jaldi machai thi aik aandhi jiss mein dardnak azab hai ,

ayahs.text: jo apney perwerdigar kay hukum say her cheez ko tehas nehas ker daalay gi ! gharz unn ki halat yeh hogaee kay unn kay gharon kay siwa kuch nazar nahi aata tha . aesay mujrim logon  ko hum aesi hi saza detay hain .
ayahs.translation: jo apney perwerdigar kay hukum say her cheez ko tehas nehas ker daalay gi ! gharz unn ki halat yeh hogaee kay unn kay gharon kay siwa kuch nazar nahi aata tha . aesay mujrim logon  ko hum aesi hi saza detay hain .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey arab kay logo ! ) hum ney unn logon  ko unn baaton ki taqat di thi jinn ki taqat tumhen nahi di , aur hum ney unn ko kaan , aankhen aur dil sabb kuch dey rakhay thay , lekin naa unn kay kaan aur unn ki aankhen unn kay kuch kaam ayen , aur naa unn kay dil , kiyonkay woh Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kertay thay , aur jiss cheez ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay , ussi ney unhen aa-ghera .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey arab kay logo ! ) hum ney unn logon  ko unn baaton ki taqat di thi jinn ki taqat tumhen nahi di , aur hum ney unn ko kaan , aankhen aur dil sabb kuch dey rakhay thay , lekin naa unn kay kaan aur unn ki aankhen unn kay kuch kaam ayen , aur naa unn kay dil , kiyonkay woh Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kertay thay , aur jiss cheez ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay , ussi ney unhen aa-ghera .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney aur bastiyon ko bhi halak kiya hai jo tumharay ird-gird waqay then ,   jabkay hum tarah tarah ki nishaniyan ( unn kay ) samney laa-chukay thay , takay woh baaz aajayen .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney aur bastiyon ko bhi halak kiya hai jo tumharay ird-gird waqay then ,   jabkay hum tarah tarah ki nishaniyan ( unn kay ) samney laa-chukay thay , takay woh baaz aajayen .

ayahs.text: phir unhon ney Allah ka taqarrub  hasil kernay kay liye jinn cheezon ko Allah kay siwa mabood bana rakha tha , unhon ney unn ki kiyon madad naa kerli-? iss kay bajaye woh sabb unn kay liye bey nishan hogaye . yeh to unn ka sarasar jhoot tha , aur bohtan tha jo unhon ney tarash rakha tha .
ayahs.translation: phir unhon ney Allah ka taqarrub  hasil kernay kay liye jinn cheezon ko Allah kay siwa mabood bana rakha tha , unhon ney unn ki kiyon madad naa kerli-? iss kay bajaye woh sabb unn kay liye bey nishan hogaye . yeh to unn ka sarasar jhoot tha , aur bohtan tha jo unhon ney tarash rakha tha .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) yaad kero jab hum ney jinnaat mein say aik giroh ko tumhari taraf mutawajjah kiya kay woh Quran sunen ,   chunacheh jab woh wahan phonchay to unhon ney ( aik doosray say ) kaha kay :  khamosh hojao  phir jab woh parha ja-chuka to woh apni qoam kay paas unhen khabrdar kertay huye wapis phonchay .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) yaad kero jab hum ney jinnaat mein say aik giroh ko tumhari taraf mutawajjah kiya kay woh Quran sunen ,   chunacheh jab woh wahan phonchay to unhon ney ( aik doosray say ) kaha kay :  khamosh hojao  phir jab woh parha ja-chuka to woh apni qoam kay paas unhen khabrdar kertay huye wapis phonchay .

ayahs.text: unhon ney kaha :  aey humari qoam kay logo ! yaqeen jano hum ney aik aesi kitab suni hai jo musa ( aleh-assalam ) kay baad nazil ki gaee hai , apney say pehli kitabon ki tasdeeq kerti hai , haq baat aur seedhay raastay ki taraf raahnumai kerti hai .
ayahs.translation: unhon ney kaha :  aey humari qoam kay logo ! yaqeen jano hum ney aik aesi kitab suni hai jo musa ( aleh-assalam ) kay baad nazil ki gaee hai , apney say pehli kitabon ki tasdeeq kerti hai , haq baat aur seedhay raastay ki taraf raahnumai kerti hai .

ayahs.text: aey humari qoam kay logo ! Allah kay daee ki baat maan lo , aur uss per emaan ley aao , Allah tumharay gunahon ko moaaf kerday ga , aur tumhen aik dardnak azab say panah dey dey ga .
ayahs.translation: aey humari qoam kay logo ! Allah kay daee ki baat maan lo , aur uss per emaan ley aao , Allah tumharay gunahon ko moaaf kerday ga , aur tumhen aik dardnak azab say panah dey dey ga .

ayahs.text: aur jo koi Allah kay daee ki baat naa maaney to woh sari zameen mein kahen bhi jaker Allah ko aajiz nahi ker-sakta , aur Allah kay siwa uss ko kissi qisam kay rakhwalay bhi nahi milen gay . aesay log khuli gumrahi mein mubtala hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jo koi Allah kay daee ki baat naa maaney to woh sari zameen mein kahen bhi jaker Allah ko aajiz nahi ker-sakta , aur Allah kay siwa uss ko kissi qisam kay rakhwalay bhi nahi milen gay . aesay log khuli gumrahi mein mubtala hain .

ayahs.text: kiya inn ko yeh sujhai nahi diya kay woh Allah jiss ney saray aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya , aur unn ko peda kernay say uss ko zara bhi thakan nahi hoi , woh yaqeenan iss baat per poori tarah qadir hai kay murdon ko zinda kerday-? aur kiyon naa ho-? woh beyshak her cheez ki poori qudrat rakhney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: kiya inn ko yeh sujhai nahi diya kay woh Allah jiss ney saray aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya , aur unn ko peda kernay say uss ko zara bhi thakan nahi hoi , woh yaqeenan iss baat per poori tarah qadir hai kay murdon ko zinda kerday-? aur kiyon naa ho-? woh beyshak her cheez ki poori qudrat rakhney wala hai .

ayahs.text: aur jiss din kafiron ko aag kay samney paish kiya jaye ga , uss din ( unn say poocha jaye ga ) kay kiya yeh ( dozakh ) sach nahi hai ? woh kahen gay kay :  humaray rab ki qasam ! yeh waqaee sach hai .  Allah irshad farmaye ga kay :  phir chakho maza azab ka , uss kufr kay badlay mein jo tum ney ikhtiyar ker rakha tha .
ayahs.translation: aur jiss din kafiron ko aag kay samney paish kiya jaye ga , uss din ( unn say poocha jaye ga ) kay kiya yeh ( dozakh ) sach nahi hai ? woh kahen gay kay :  humaray rab ki qasam ! yeh waqaee sach hai .  Allah irshad farmaye ga kay :  phir chakho maza azab ka , uss kufr kay badlay mein jo tum ney ikhtiyar ker rakha tha .

ayahs.text: gharz ( aey payghumber ! ) tum ussi tarah sabar kiye jao jaisay oolool-azm payghumberon ney sabar kiya hai , aur inn kay moamlay mein jaldi naa kero . jiss din yeh log woh cheez dekh len gay jiss say enhen daraya jaraha hai , uss din ( enhen ) yun mehsoos hoga jaisay woh ( duniya mein ) din ki aik gharri say ziyada nahi rahey .   yeh hai woh paygham jo phoncha diya gaya hai ! abb barbad to wohi log hon gay jo nafarman hain .
ayahs.translation: gharz ( aey payghumber ! ) tum ussi tarah sabar kiye jao jaisay oolool-azm payghumberon ney sabar kiya hai , aur inn kay moamlay mein jaldi naa kero . jiss din yeh log woh cheez dekh len gay jiss say enhen daraya jaraha hai , uss din ( enhen ) yun mehsoos hoga jaisay woh ( duniya mein ) din ki aik gharri say ziyada nahi rahey .   yeh hai woh paygham jo phoncha diya gaya hai ! abb barbad to wohi log hon gay jo nafarman hain .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kerliya hai , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roka hai , Allah ney unn kay aemal ikarat kerdiye hain .
verses.translation: jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kerliya hai , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roka hai , Allah ney unn kay aemal ikarat kerdiye hain .

verses.text: aur jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , aur her uss baat ko dil say maana hai jo Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) per nazil ki gaee hai aur wohi haq hai jo unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say aaya hai Allah ney unn ki buraiyon ko moaaf kerdiya hai , aur unn ki halat sanwaar di hai .
verses.translation: aur jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , aur her uss baat ko dil say maana hai jo Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) per nazil ki gaee hai aur wohi haq hai jo unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say aaya hai Allah ney unn ki buraiyon ko moaaf kerdiya hai , aur unn ki halat sanwaar di hai .

verses.text: yeh iss liye kay jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya hai , woh batil kay peechay chalay hain , aur jo log emaan laye hain , woh uss haq kay peechay chalay hain jo unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say aaya hai . issi tarah Allah logon  ko bata raha hai kay unn kay halaat kiya kiya hain .
verses.translation: yeh iss liye kay jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya hai , woh batil kay peechay chalay hain , aur jo log emaan laye hain , woh uss haq kay peechay chalay hain jo unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say aaya hai . issi tarah Allah logon  ko bata raha hai kay unn kay halaat kiya kiya hain .

verses.text: aur jab unn logon  say tumhara muqabla ho jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar ker rakha hai , to gardanen maaro , yahan tak kay jab tum unn ki taqat kuchal chukay ho , to mazbooti say girftaar kerlo , phir chahye ehsan ker kay chorr do , ya fidya ley ker ,   yahan tak kay jang apney hathiyaar phenk ker khatam hojaye .   tumhen to yehi hukum hai , aur agar Allah chahta to khud unn say intiqam ley leta , lekin ( tumhen yeh hukum iss liye diya hai ) takay tumhara aik doosray kay zariye imtihan ley .   aur jo log Allah kay raastay mein qatal huye , Allah unn kay aemal ko hergiz ikarat nahi keray ga .
