verses.translation: aur jab unn logon  say tumhara muqabla ho jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar ker rakha hai , to gardanen maaro , yahan tak kay jab tum unn ki taqat kuchal chukay ho , to mazbooti say girftaar kerlo , phir chahye ehsan ker kay chorr do , ya fidya ley ker ,   yahan tak kay jang apney hathiyaar phenk ker khatam hojaye .   tumhen to yehi hukum hai , aur agar Allah chahta to khud unn say intiqam ley leta , lekin ( tumhen yeh hukum iss liye diya hai ) takay tumhara aik doosray kay zariye imtihan ley .   aur jo log Allah kay raastay mein qatal huye , Allah unn kay aemal ko hergiz ikarat nahi keray ga .

verses.text: woh unhen manzil tak phoncha dey ga , aur unn ki halat sanwaar dey ga ,
verses.translation: woh unhen manzil tak phoncha dey ga , aur unn ki halat sanwaar dey ga ,

verses.text: aur unhen jannat mein dakhil keray ga jiss ki unhen khoob pehchan keradi hogi .
verses.translation: aur unhen jannat mein dakhil keray ga jiss ki unhen khoob pehchan keradi hogi .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! agar tum Allah ( kay deen ) ki madad kero gay to woh tumhari madad keray ga , aur tumharay qadam jama dey ga .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! agar tum Allah ( kay deen ) ki madad kero gay to woh tumhari madad keray ga , aur tumharay qadam jama dey ga .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay liye tabahi hai , aur Allah ney unn kay aemal ikarat kerdiye hain .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay liye tabahi hai , aur Allah ney unn kay aemal ikarat kerdiye hain .

verses.text: yeh iss liye kay unhon ney uss baat ko napasand kiya jo Allah ney nazil ki thi , chunacheh Allah ney unn kay aemal zaya kerdiye .
verses.translation: yeh iss liye kay unhon ney uss baat ko napasand kiya jo Allah ney nazil ki thi , chunacheh Allah ney unn kay aemal zaya kerdiye .

verses.text: bhala kiya inn logon  ney zameen mein chal phir ker nahi dekha kay unn logon  ka anjam kaisa huwa jo inn say pehlay guzray hain-? Allah ney unn per tabahi daali , aur kafiron kay liye issi jaisay anjam muqaddar hain .
verses.translation: bhala kiya inn logon  ney zameen mein chal phir ker nahi dekha kay unn logon  ka anjam kaisa huwa jo inn say pehlay guzray hain-? Allah ney unn per tabahi daali , aur kafiron kay liye issi jaisay anjam muqaddar hain .

verses.text: yeh iss liye kay Allah unn logon  ka rakhwala hai jo emaan layen , aur kafiron ka koi rakhwala nahi hai .
verses.translation: yeh iss liye kay Allah unn logon  ka rakhwala hai jo emaan layen , aur kafiron ka koi rakhwala nahi hai .

verses.text: yaqeen rakho kay jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , Allah unn ko aesay baaghaat mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi . aur jinhon ney kufr apna liya hai , woh ( yahan to ) mazay urra rahey hain , aur iss tarah kha rahey hain jaisay chopaye khatay hain , aur jahannum unn ka aakhri thikana hai .
verses.translation: yaqeen rakho kay jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , Allah unn ko aesay baaghaat mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi . aur jinhon ney kufr apna liya hai , woh ( yahan to ) mazay urra rahey hain , aur iss tarah kha rahey hain jaisay chopaye khatay hain , aur jahannum unn ka aakhri thikana hai .

verses.text: aur kitni bastiyan hain jo taqat mein tumhari uss basti say ziyada mazboot then jiss ney ( aey payghumber ! ) tumhen nikala hai ,   unn sabb ko hum ney halak kerdiya , aur unn ka koi madadgaar naa huwa .
verses.translation: aur kitni bastiyan hain jo taqat mein tumhari uss basti say ziyada mazboot then jiss ney ( aey payghumber ! ) tumhen nikala hai ,   unn sabb ko hum ney halak kerdiya , aur unn ka koi madadgaar naa huwa .

verses.text: abb batao kay jo log apney perwerdigar ki taraf say aik roshan raastay per hon , kiya woh unn jaisay hosaktay hain jinn ki bad-kaari hi unn kay liye khushnuma bana di gaee ho , aur woh apni nafsani khuwaishaat kay peechay chaltay hon-?
verses.translation: abb batao kay jo log apney perwerdigar ki taraf say aik roshan raastay per hon , kiya woh unn jaisay hosaktay hain jinn ki bad-kaari hi unn kay liye khushnuma bana di gaee ho , aur woh apni nafsani khuwaishaat kay peechay chaltay hon-?

verses.text: muttaqi logon  say jiss jannat ka wada kiya gaya hai , uss ka haal yeh hai kay uss mein aesay paani ki nehren hain jo kharab honey wala nahi , aesay doodh ki nehren hain jiss ka zaiqa nahi badlay ga , aesi sharab ki nehren hain jo peenay walon kay liye sarapa lazzat hogi , aur aesay shehad ki nehren hain jo nithra huwa hoga , aur inn jannatiyon kay liye wahan her qisam kay phal hon gay , aur inn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say maghfirat ! kiya yeh log unn jaisay hosaktay hain jo hamesha dozakh mein rahen gay , aur unhen garam paani pilaya jaye ga , chunacheh woh unn ki aanton ko tukrray tukrray kerday ga-?
verses.translation: muttaqi logon  say jiss jannat ka wada kiya gaya hai , uss ka haal yeh hai kay uss mein aesay paani ki nehren hain jo kharab honey wala nahi , aesay doodh ki nehren hain jiss ka zaiqa nahi badlay ga , aesi sharab ki nehren hain jo peenay walon kay liye sarapa lazzat hogi , aur aesay shehad ki nehren hain jo nithra huwa hoga , aur inn jannatiyon kay liye wahan her qisam kay phal hon gay , aur inn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say maghfirat ! kiya yeh log unn jaisay hosaktay hain jo hamesha dozakh mein rahen gay , aur unhen garam paani pilaya jaye ga , chunacheh woh unn ki aanton ko tukrray tukrray kerday ga-?

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn mein say kuch log woh hain jo tumhari baaten kanon say to suntay hain , lekin jab tumharay paas say nikal ker jatay hain to jinhen ilm ata huwa hai , unn say poochtay hain kay :  abhi abhi aap ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) ney kiya kaha tha-?    yeh woh log hain jinn kay dilon per Allah ney mohar laga di hai , aur jo apni nafsani khuwaishaat kay peechay lagg gaye hain .
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn mein say kuch log woh hain jo tumhari baaten kanon say to suntay hain , lekin jab tumharay paas say nikal ker jatay hain to jinhen ilm ata huwa hai , unn say poochtay hain kay :  abhi abhi aap ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) ney kiya kaha tha-?    yeh woh log hain jinn kay dilon per Allah ney mohar laga di hai , aur jo apni nafsani khuwaishaat kay peechay lagg gaye hain .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney hidayat ka raasta ikhtiyar kiya hai , Allah ney unhen hidayat mein aur taraqqi di hai , aur unhen unn kay hissay ka taqwa ata farmaya hai .
verses.translation: aur jinn logon  ney hidayat ka raasta ikhtiyar kiya hai , Allah ney unhen hidayat mein aur taraqqi di hai , aur unhen unn kay hissay ka taqwa ata farmaya hai .

verses.text: abb kiya yeh ( kafir ) log qayamat hi ka intizar ker rahey hain kay woh yakayak inn per aan parray-? ( agar aisa hai ) to uss ki alamaten to aa-chuki hain . phir jab woh aa-hi jaye gi to uss waqt unn kay liye naseehat manney ka moaqa kahan say aaye ga-?
verses.translation: abb kiya yeh ( kafir ) log qayamat hi ka intizar ker rahey hain kay woh yakayak inn per aan parray-? ( agar aisa hai ) to uss ki alamaten to aa-chuki hain . phir jab woh aa-hi jaye gi to uss waqt unn kay liye naseehat manney ka moaqa kahan say aaye ga-?

verses.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) yaqeen jano kay Allah kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi hai , aur apney qusoor per bhi bakhshish ki dua maangtay raho ,   aur musalman mardon aur aurton ki bakhshish ki bhi , aur Allah tum sabb ki naqal o harkat aur tumhari qayam gaah ko khoob janta hai .
verses.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) yaqeen jano kay Allah kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi hai , aur apney qusoor per bhi bakhshish ki dua maangtay raho ,   aur musalman mardon aur aurton ki bakhshish ki bhi , aur Allah tum sabb ki naqal o harkat aur tumhari qayam gaah ko khoob janta hai .

verses.text: aur jo log emaan laye hain , woh kehtay hain kay :  kiya acha ho kay koi ( naee ) surat nazil hojaye-?    phir jab koi jachi tuli surat nazil hojaye , aur uss mein larraee ka ziker ho to jinn logon  kay dilon mein rog hai , tum unhen dekho gay kay woh tumhari taraf iss tarah nazren uthaye huye hain jaisay kissi per moat ki ghashi taari ho . bari kharabi hai aesay logon  ki .
verses.translation: aur jo log emaan laye hain , woh kehtay hain kay :  kiya acha ho kay koi ( naee ) surat nazil hojaye-?    phir jab koi jachi tuli surat nazil hojaye , aur uss mein larraee ka ziker ho to jinn logon  kay dilon mein rog hai , tum unhen dekho gay kay woh tumhari taraf iss tarah nazren uthaye huye hain jaisay kissi per moat ki ghashi taari ho . bari kharabi hai aesay logon  ki .

verses.text: yeh farmanbardaari ka izhar aur achi achi baaten kertay hain , lekin jab ( jihad ka ) hukum paka hojaye , uss waqt agar yeh Allah kay sath sachay niklen to inn kay haq mein acha ho .
verses.translation: yeh farmanbardaari ka izhar aur achi achi baaten kertay hain , lekin jab ( jihad ka ) hukum paka hojaye , uss waqt agar yeh Allah kay sath sachay niklen to inn kay haq mein acha ho .

verses.text: phir agar tum ney ( jihad say ) mun morra to tum say kiya tawaqqo rakhi jaye-? yehi kay tum zameen mein fasad machao , aur apney khooni rishtay kaat daalo !
verses.translation: phir agar tum ney ( jihad say ) mun morra to tum say kiya tawaqqo rakhi jaye-? yehi kay tum zameen mein fasad machao , aur apney khooni rishtay kaat daalo !

verses.text: yeh woh log hain jinn ko Allah ney apni rehmat say door kerdiya hai , chunacheh unhen behra bana diya hai , aur unn ki aankhen andhi kerdi hain .
verses.translation: yeh woh log hain jinn ko Allah ney apni rehmat say door kerdiya hai , chunacheh unhen behra bana diya hai , aur unn ki aankhen andhi kerdi hain .

verses.text: bhala kiya yeh log Quran per ghor nahi kertay , ya dilon per woh taalay parray huye hain jo dilon per parra kertay hain-?
verses.translation: bhala kiya yeh log Quran per ghor nahi kertay , ya dilon per woh taalay parray huye hain jo dilon per parra kertay hain-?

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log haq baat say peeth pher ker murr gaye hain , bawajood-yeh-kay hidayat unn kay samney khoob wazeh hochuki thi , unhen shetan ney patti parhai hai , aur unhen door daraz ki umeeden dilai hain .
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log haq baat say peeth pher ker murr gaye hain , bawajood-yeh-kay hidayat unn kay samney khoob wazeh hochuki thi , unhen shetan ney patti parhai hai , aur unhen door daraz ki umeeden dilai hain .

verses.text: yeh sabb iss liye huwa kay jo log Allah ki nazil ki hoi baaton ko napasand kertay hain , inn ( munafiqon ) ney unn say yeh kaha hai kay :  baaz moamlaat mein hum tumhari baat maanen gay .  aur Allah unn ki khufiya baaton ko khoob janta hai .
verses.translation: yeh sabb iss liye huwa kay jo log Allah ki nazil ki hoi baaton ko napasand kertay hain , inn ( munafiqon ) ney unn say yeh kaha hai kay :  baaz moamlaat mein hum tumhari baat maanen gay .  aur Allah unn ki khufiya baaton ko khoob janta hai .

verses.text: phir uss waqt unn ka kiya haal banay ga jab farishtay unn ki rooh iss tarah qabz keren gay kay unn kay chehron per aur peethon per maartay jatay hon gay-?
verses.translation: phir uss waqt unn ka kiya haal banay ga jab farishtay unn ki rooh iss tarah qabz keren gay kay unn kay chehron per aur peethon per maartay jatay hon gay-?

verses.text: yeh sabb iss liye kay yeh uss tareeqay per chalay jiss ney Allah ko naraz kiya , aur uss ki raza mandi hasil kernay ko khud unhon ney napasand kiya , iss liye Allah ney unn kay aemal ikarat kerdiye .
verses.translation: yeh sabb iss liye kay yeh uss tareeqay per chalay jiss ney Allah ko naraz kiya , aur uss ki raza mandi hasil kernay ko khud unhon ney napasand kiya , iss liye Allah ney unn kay aemal ikarat kerdiye .

verses.text: jinn logon  kay dilon mein ( nifaq ka ) rog hai , kiya woh yeh samajhtay hain kay unn kay chupay huye keenon ko Allah kabhi zahir nahi keray ga-?
verses.translation: jinn logon  kay dilon mein ( nifaq ka ) rog hai , kiya woh yeh samajhtay hain kay unn kay chupay huye keenon ko Allah kabhi zahir nahi keray ga-?

verses.text: aur ( musalmano ! ) agar hum chahen to tumhen yeh log iss tarah dikha den kay tum unn ki alamat say unhen pehchan jao , aur ( abb bhi ) tum unhen baat kernay kay dhap say zaroor pehchan hi jao gay , aur Allah tum sabb kay aemal ko khoob janta hai .
verses.translation: aur ( musalmano ! ) agar hum chahen to tumhen yeh log iss tarah dikha den kay tum unn ki alamat say unhen pehchan jao , aur ( abb bhi ) tum unhen baat kernay kay dhap say zaroor pehchan hi jao gay , aur Allah tum sabb kay aemal ko khoob janta hai .

verses.text: aur hum zaroor tumhen aazmaesh mein daalen gay , takay hum yeh dekh len kay tum mein say kon hain jo mujahid aur sabit qadam rehney walay hain , aur takay tumharay halaat ki janch parrtaal kerlen .
verses.translation: aur hum zaroor tumhen aazmaesh mein daalen gay , takay hum yeh dekh len kay tum mein say kon hain jo mujahid aur sabit qadam rehney walay hain , aur takay tumharay halaat ki janch parrtaal kerlen .

verses.text: yaqeen rakho kay jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roka hai , aur payghumber say dushmani thaani hai bawajood-yeh-kay unn kay samney hidayat wazeh ho ker aagae thi , woh Allah ko hergiz koi nuqsan nahi phoncha saktay , aur unqareeb Allah unn ka sara kiya dhara gharat kerday ga .
verses.translation: yaqeen rakho kay jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roka hai , aur payghumber say dushmani thaani hai bawajood-yeh-kay unn kay samney hidayat wazeh ho ker aagae thi , woh Allah ko hergiz koi nuqsan nahi phoncha saktay , aur unqareeb Allah unn ka sara kiya dhara gharat kerday ga .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah ki itaat kero , aur Rasool ki itaat kero , aur apney aemal ko barbad naa kero .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah ki itaat kero , aur Rasool ki itaat kero , aur apney aemal ko barbad naa kero .

verses.text: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roka hai , phir kufr hi ki halat mein mar-gaye hain , Allah kabhi unn ko nahi bakhshay ga .
verses.translation: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roka hai , phir kufr hi ki halat mein mar-gaye hain , Allah kabhi unn ko nahi bakhshay ga .

verses.text: lehaza ( aey musalmano ! ) tum kamzor parr ker sulah ki dawat naa do ,   tum hi sarbuland raho gay , Allah tumharay sath hai , aur woh tumharay aemal ko hergiz barbad nahi keray ga .
verses.translation: lehaza ( aey musalmano ! ) tum kamzor parr ker sulah ki dawat naa do ,   tum hi sarbuland raho gay , Allah tumharay sath hai , aur woh tumharay aemal ko hergiz barbad nahi keray ga .

verses.text: yeh dunyawi zindagi to bus khel tamasha hai , aur agar tum emaan lao , aur taqwa ikhtiyar kero to Allah tumharay ajar tumhen dey ga , aur tumharay maal tum say nahi maangay ga .
verses.translation: yeh dunyawi zindagi to bus khel tamasha hai , aur agar tum emaan lao , aur taqwa ikhtiyar kero to Allah tumharay ajar tumhen dey ga , aur tumharay maal tum say nahi maangay ga .

verses.text: agar woh tum say tumharay maal talab keray , aur tum say sabb kuch samett ley to tum bukhul say kaam lo gay , aur woh tumharay dil ki naraziyon ko zahir kerday ga .
verses.translation: agar woh tum say tumharay maal talab keray , aur tum say sabb kuch samett ley to tum bukhul say kaam lo gay , aur woh tumharay dil ki naraziyon ko zahir kerday ga .

verses.text: dekho ! tum aesay ho kay tumhen Allah kay raastay mein kharch kernay kay liye bulaya jata hai to tum mein say kuch log hain jo bukhul say kaam letay hain , aur jo shaks bhi bukhul kerta hai , woh khud apney aap hi say bukhul kerta hai .   aur Allah bey niaz hai , aur tum ho jo mohtaj ho . aur agar tum mun morro gay to woh tumhari jagah doosri qoam peda kerday ga , phir woh tum jaisay nahi hon gay .
verses.translation: dekho ! tum aesay ho kay tumhen Allah kay raastay mein kharch kernay kay liye bulaya jata hai to tum mein say kuch log hain jo bukhul say kaam letay hain , aur jo shaks bhi bukhul kerta hai , woh khud apney aap hi say bukhul kerta hai .   aur Allah bey niaz hai , aur tum ho jo mohtaj ho . aur agar tum mun morro gay to woh tumhari jagah doosri qoam peda kerday ga , phir woh tum jaisay nahi hon gay .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kerliya hai , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roka hai , Allah ney unn kay aemal ikarat kerdiye hain .
ayahs.translation: jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kerliya hai , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roka hai , Allah ney unn kay aemal ikarat kerdiye hain .

ayahs.text: aur jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , aur her uss baat ko dil say maana hai jo Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) per nazil ki gaee hai aur wohi haq hai jo unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say aaya hai Allah ney unn ki buraiyon ko moaaf kerdiya hai , aur unn ki halat sanwaar di hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , aur her uss baat ko dil say maana hai jo Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) per nazil ki gaee hai aur wohi haq hai jo unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say aaya hai Allah ney unn ki buraiyon ko moaaf kerdiya hai , aur unn ki halat sanwaar di hai .

ayahs.text: yeh iss liye kay jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya hai , woh batil kay peechay chalay hain , aur jo log emaan laye hain , woh uss haq kay peechay chalay hain jo unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say aaya hai . issi tarah Allah logon  ko bata raha hai kay unn kay halaat kiya kiya hain .
ayahs.translation: yeh iss liye kay jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya hai , woh batil kay peechay chalay hain , aur jo log emaan laye hain , woh uss haq kay peechay chalay hain jo unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say aaya hai . issi tarah Allah logon  ko bata raha hai kay unn kay halaat kiya kiya hain .

ayahs.text: aur jab unn logon  say tumhara muqabla ho jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar ker rakha hai , to gardanen maaro , yahan tak kay jab tum unn ki taqat kuchal chukay ho , to mazbooti say girftaar kerlo , phir chahye ehsan ker kay chorr do , ya fidya ley ker ,   yahan tak kay jang apney hathiyaar phenk ker khatam hojaye .   tumhen to yehi hukum hai , aur agar Allah chahta to khud unn say intiqam ley leta , lekin ( tumhen yeh hukum iss liye diya hai ) takay tumhara aik doosray kay zariye imtihan ley .   aur jo log Allah kay raastay mein qatal huye , Allah unn kay aemal ko hergiz ikarat nahi keray ga .
ayahs.translation: aur jab unn logon  say tumhara muqabla ho jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar ker rakha hai , to gardanen maaro , yahan tak kay jab tum unn ki taqat kuchal chukay ho , to mazbooti say girftaar kerlo , phir chahye ehsan ker kay chorr do , ya fidya ley ker ,   yahan tak kay jang apney hathiyaar phenk ker khatam hojaye .   tumhen to yehi hukum hai , aur agar Allah chahta to khud unn say intiqam ley leta , lekin ( tumhen yeh hukum iss liye diya hai ) takay tumhara aik doosray kay zariye imtihan ley .   aur jo log Allah kay raastay mein qatal huye , Allah unn kay aemal ko hergiz ikarat nahi keray ga .

ayahs.text: woh unhen manzil tak phoncha dey ga , aur unn ki halat sanwaar dey ga ,
ayahs.translation: woh unhen manzil tak phoncha dey ga , aur unn ki halat sanwaar dey ga ,

ayahs.text: aur unhen jannat mein dakhil keray ga jiss ki unhen khoob pehchan keradi hogi .
ayahs.translation: aur unhen jannat mein dakhil keray ga jiss ki unhen khoob pehchan keradi hogi .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! agar tum Allah ( kay deen ) ki madad kero gay to woh tumhari madad keray ga , aur tumharay qadam jama dey ga .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! agar tum Allah ( kay deen ) ki madad kero gay to woh tumhari madad keray ga , aur tumharay qadam jama dey ga .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay liye tabahi hai , aur Allah ney unn kay aemal ikarat kerdiye hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay liye tabahi hai , aur Allah ney unn kay aemal ikarat kerdiye hain .

ayahs.text: yeh iss liye kay unhon ney uss baat ko napasand kiya jo Allah ney nazil ki thi , chunacheh Allah ney unn kay aemal zaya kerdiye .
ayahs.translation: yeh iss liye kay unhon ney uss baat ko napasand kiya jo Allah ney nazil ki thi , chunacheh Allah ney unn kay aemal zaya kerdiye .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya inn logon  ney zameen mein chal phir ker nahi dekha kay unn logon  ka anjam kaisa huwa jo inn say pehlay guzray hain-? Allah ney unn per tabahi daali , aur kafiron kay liye issi jaisay anjam muqaddar hain .
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya inn logon  ney zameen mein chal phir ker nahi dekha kay unn logon  ka anjam kaisa huwa jo inn say pehlay guzray hain-? Allah ney unn per tabahi daali , aur kafiron kay liye issi jaisay anjam muqaddar hain .

ayahs.text: yeh iss liye kay Allah unn logon  ka rakhwala hai jo emaan layen , aur kafiron ka koi rakhwala nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh iss liye kay Allah unn logon  ka rakhwala hai jo emaan layen , aur kafiron ka koi rakhwala nahi hai .

ayahs.text: yaqeen rakho kay jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , Allah unn ko aesay baaghaat mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi . aur jinhon ney kufr apna liya hai , woh ( yahan to ) mazay urra rahey hain , aur iss tarah kha rahey hain jaisay chopaye khatay hain , aur jahannum unn ka aakhri thikana hai .
ayahs.translation: yaqeen rakho kay jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , Allah unn ko aesay baaghaat mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi . aur jinhon ney kufr apna liya hai , woh ( yahan to ) mazay urra rahey hain , aur iss tarah kha rahey hain jaisay chopaye khatay hain , aur jahannum unn ka aakhri thikana hai .

ayahs.text: aur kitni bastiyan hain jo taqat mein tumhari uss basti say ziyada mazboot then jiss ney ( aey payghumber ! ) tumhen nikala hai ,   unn sabb ko hum ney halak kerdiya , aur unn ka koi madadgaar naa huwa .
ayahs.translation: aur kitni bastiyan hain jo taqat mein tumhari uss basti say ziyada mazboot then jiss ney ( aey payghumber ! ) tumhen nikala hai ,   unn sabb ko hum ney halak kerdiya , aur unn ka koi madadgaar naa huwa .

ayahs.text: abb batao kay jo log apney perwerdigar ki taraf say aik roshan raastay per hon , kiya woh unn jaisay hosaktay hain jinn ki bad-kaari hi unn kay liye khushnuma bana di gaee ho , aur woh apni nafsani khuwaishaat kay peechay chaltay hon-?
ayahs.translation: abb batao kay jo log apney perwerdigar ki taraf say aik roshan raastay per hon , kiya woh unn jaisay hosaktay hain jinn ki bad-kaari hi unn kay liye khushnuma bana di gaee ho , aur woh apni nafsani khuwaishaat kay peechay chaltay hon-?

ayahs.text: muttaqi logon  say jiss jannat ka wada kiya gaya hai , uss ka haal yeh hai kay uss mein aesay paani ki nehren hain jo kharab honey wala nahi , aesay doodh ki nehren hain jiss ka zaiqa nahi badlay ga , aesi sharab ki nehren hain jo peenay walon kay liye sarapa lazzat hogi , aur aesay shehad ki nehren hain jo nithra huwa hoga , aur inn jannatiyon kay liye wahan her qisam kay phal hon gay , aur inn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say maghfirat ! kiya yeh log unn jaisay hosaktay hain jo hamesha dozakh mein rahen gay , aur unhen garam paani pilaya jaye ga , chunacheh woh unn ki aanton ko tukrray tukrray kerday ga-?
ayahs.translation: muttaqi logon  say jiss jannat ka wada kiya gaya hai , uss ka haal yeh hai kay uss mein aesay paani ki nehren hain jo kharab honey wala nahi , aesay doodh ki nehren hain jiss ka zaiqa nahi badlay ga , aesi sharab ki nehren hain jo peenay walon kay liye sarapa lazzat hogi , aur aesay shehad ki nehren hain jo nithra huwa hoga , aur inn jannatiyon kay liye wahan her qisam kay phal hon gay , aur inn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say maghfirat ! kiya yeh log unn jaisay hosaktay hain jo hamesha dozakh mein rahen gay , aur unhen garam paani pilaya jaye ga , chunacheh woh unn ki aanton ko tukrray tukrray kerday ga-?

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn mein say kuch log woh hain jo tumhari baaten kanon say to suntay hain , lekin jab tumharay paas say nikal ker jatay hain to jinhen ilm ata huwa hai , unn say poochtay hain kay :  abhi abhi aap ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) ney kiya kaha tha-?    yeh woh log hain jinn kay dilon per Allah ney mohar laga di hai , aur jo apni nafsani khuwaishaat kay peechay lagg gaye hain .
ayahs.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn mein say kuch log woh hain jo tumhari baaten kanon say to suntay hain , lekin jab tumharay paas say nikal ker jatay hain to jinhen ilm ata huwa hai , unn say poochtay hain kay :  abhi abhi aap ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) ney kiya kaha tha-?    yeh woh log hain jinn kay dilon per Allah ney mohar laga di hai , aur jo apni nafsani khuwaishaat kay peechay lagg gaye hain .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney hidayat ka raasta ikhtiyar kiya hai , Allah ney unhen hidayat mein aur taraqqi di hai , aur unhen unn kay hissay ka taqwa ata farmaya hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney hidayat ka raasta ikhtiyar kiya hai , Allah ney unhen hidayat mein aur taraqqi di hai , aur unhen unn kay hissay ka taqwa ata farmaya hai .

ayahs.text: abb kiya yeh ( kafir ) log qayamat hi ka intizar ker rahey hain kay woh yakayak inn per aan parray-? ( agar aisa hai ) to uss ki alamaten to aa-chuki hain . phir jab woh aa-hi jaye gi to uss waqt unn kay liye naseehat manney ka moaqa kahan say aaye ga-?
ayahs.translation: abb kiya yeh ( kafir ) log qayamat hi ka intizar ker rahey hain kay woh yakayak inn per aan parray-? ( agar aisa hai ) to uss ki alamaten to aa-chuki hain . phir jab woh aa-hi jaye gi to uss waqt unn kay liye naseehat manney ka moaqa kahan say aaye ga-?

ayahs.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) yaqeen jano kay Allah kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi hai , aur apney qusoor per bhi bakhshish ki dua maangtay raho ,   aur musalman mardon aur aurton ki bakhshish ki bhi , aur Allah tum sabb ki naqal o harkat aur tumhari qayam gaah ko khoob janta hai .
ayahs.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) yaqeen jano kay Allah kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi hai , aur apney qusoor per bhi bakhshish ki dua maangtay raho ,   aur musalman mardon aur aurton ki bakhshish ki bhi , aur Allah tum sabb ki naqal o harkat aur tumhari qayam gaah ko khoob janta hai .

ayahs.text: aur jo log emaan laye hain , woh kehtay hain kay :  kiya acha ho kay koi ( naee ) surat nazil hojaye-?    phir jab koi jachi tuli surat nazil hojaye , aur uss mein larraee ka ziker ho to jinn logon  kay dilon mein rog hai , tum unhen dekho gay kay woh tumhari taraf iss tarah nazren uthaye huye hain jaisay kissi per moat ki ghashi taari ho . bari kharabi hai aesay logon  ki .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log emaan laye hain , woh kehtay hain kay :  kiya acha ho kay koi ( naee ) surat nazil hojaye-?    phir jab koi jachi tuli surat nazil hojaye , aur uss mein larraee ka ziker ho to jinn logon  kay dilon mein rog hai , tum unhen dekho gay kay woh tumhari taraf iss tarah nazren uthaye huye hain jaisay kissi per moat ki ghashi taari ho . bari kharabi hai aesay logon  ki .

ayahs.text: yeh farmanbardaari ka izhar aur achi achi baaten kertay hain , lekin jab ( jihad ka ) hukum paka hojaye , uss waqt agar yeh Allah kay sath sachay niklen to inn kay haq mein acha ho .
ayahs.translation: yeh farmanbardaari ka izhar aur achi achi baaten kertay hain , lekin jab ( jihad ka ) hukum paka hojaye , uss waqt agar yeh Allah kay sath sachay niklen to inn kay haq mein acha ho .

ayahs.text: phir agar tum ney ( jihad say ) mun morra to tum say kiya tawaqqo rakhi jaye-? yehi kay tum zameen mein fasad machao , aur apney khooni rishtay kaat daalo !
ayahs.translation: phir agar tum ney ( jihad say ) mun morra to tum say kiya tawaqqo rakhi jaye-? yehi kay tum zameen mein fasad machao , aur apney khooni rishtay kaat daalo !

ayahs.text: yeh woh log hain jinn ko Allah ney apni rehmat say door kerdiya hai , chunacheh unhen behra bana diya hai , aur unn ki aankhen andhi kerdi hain .
ayahs.translation: yeh woh log hain jinn ko Allah ney apni rehmat say door kerdiya hai , chunacheh unhen behra bana diya hai , aur unn ki aankhen andhi kerdi hain .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya yeh log Quran per ghor nahi kertay , ya dilon per woh taalay parray huye hain jo dilon per parra kertay hain-?
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya yeh log Quran per ghor nahi kertay , ya dilon per woh taalay parray huye hain jo dilon per parra kertay hain-?

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log haq baat say peeth pher ker murr gaye hain , bawajood-yeh-kay hidayat unn kay samney khoob wazeh hochuki thi , unhen shetan ney patti parhai hai , aur unhen door daraz ki umeeden dilai hain .
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log haq baat say peeth pher ker murr gaye hain , bawajood-yeh-kay hidayat unn kay samney khoob wazeh hochuki thi , unhen shetan ney patti parhai hai , aur unhen door daraz ki umeeden dilai hain .

ayahs.text: yeh sabb iss liye huwa kay jo log Allah ki nazil ki hoi baaton ko napasand kertay hain , inn ( munafiqon ) ney unn say yeh kaha hai kay :  baaz moamlaat mein hum tumhari baat maanen gay .  aur Allah unn ki khufiya baaton ko khoob janta hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh sabb iss liye huwa kay jo log Allah ki nazil ki hoi baaton ko napasand kertay hain , inn ( munafiqon ) ney unn say yeh kaha hai kay :  baaz moamlaat mein hum tumhari baat maanen gay .  aur Allah unn ki khufiya baaton ko khoob janta hai .

ayahs.text: phir uss waqt unn ka kiya haal banay ga jab farishtay unn ki rooh iss tarah qabz keren gay kay unn kay chehron per aur peethon per maartay jatay hon gay-?
ayahs.translation: phir uss waqt unn ka kiya haal banay ga jab farishtay unn ki rooh iss tarah qabz keren gay kay unn kay chehron per aur peethon per maartay jatay hon gay-?

ayahs.text: yeh sabb iss liye kay yeh uss tareeqay per chalay jiss ney Allah ko naraz kiya , aur uss ki raza mandi hasil kernay ko khud unhon ney napasand kiya , iss liye Allah ney unn kay aemal ikarat kerdiye .
ayahs.translation: yeh sabb iss liye kay yeh uss tareeqay per chalay jiss ney Allah ko naraz kiya , aur uss ki raza mandi hasil kernay ko khud unhon ney napasand kiya , iss liye Allah ney unn kay aemal ikarat kerdiye .

ayahs.text: jinn logon  kay dilon mein ( nifaq ka ) rog hai , kiya woh yeh samajhtay hain kay unn kay chupay huye keenon ko Allah kabhi zahir nahi keray ga-?
ayahs.translation: jinn logon  kay dilon mein ( nifaq ka ) rog hai , kiya woh yeh samajhtay hain kay unn kay chupay huye keenon ko Allah kabhi zahir nahi keray ga-?

ayahs.text: aur ( musalmano ! ) agar hum chahen to tumhen yeh log iss tarah dikha den kay tum unn ki alamat say unhen pehchan jao , aur ( abb bhi ) tum unhen baat kernay kay dhap say zaroor pehchan hi jao gay , aur Allah tum sabb kay aemal ko khoob janta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur ( musalmano ! ) agar hum chahen to tumhen yeh log iss tarah dikha den kay tum unn ki alamat say unhen pehchan jao , aur ( abb bhi ) tum unhen baat kernay kay dhap say zaroor pehchan hi jao gay , aur Allah tum sabb kay aemal ko khoob janta hai .

ayahs.text: aur hum zaroor tumhen aazmaesh mein daalen gay , takay hum yeh dekh len kay tum mein say kon hain jo mujahid aur sabit qadam rehney walay hain , aur takay tumharay halaat ki janch parrtaal kerlen .
ayahs.translation: aur hum zaroor tumhen aazmaesh mein daalen gay , takay hum yeh dekh len kay tum mein say kon hain jo mujahid aur sabit qadam rehney walay hain , aur takay tumharay halaat ki janch parrtaal kerlen .

ayahs.text: yaqeen rakho kay jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roka hai , aur payghumber say dushmani thaani hai bawajood-yeh-kay unn kay samney hidayat wazeh ho ker aagae thi , woh Allah ko hergiz koi nuqsan nahi phoncha saktay , aur unqareeb Allah unn ka sara kiya dhara gharat kerday ga .
ayahs.translation: yaqeen rakho kay jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roka hai , aur payghumber say dushmani thaani hai bawajood-yeh-kay unn kay samney hidayat wazeh ho ker aagae thi , woh Allah ko hergiz koi nuqsan nahi phoncha saktay , aur unqareeb Allah unn ka sara kiya dhara gharat kerday ga .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah ki itaat kero , aur Rasool ki itaat kero , aur apney aemal ko barbad naa kero .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah ki itaat kero , aur Rasool ki itaat kero , aur apney aemal ko barbad naa kero .

ayahs.text: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roka hai , phir kufr hi ki halat mein mar-gaye hain , Allah kabhi unn ko nahi bakhshay ga .
ayahs.translation: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roka hai , phir kufr hi ki halat mein mar-gaye hain , Allah kabhi unn ko nahi bakhshay ga .

ayahs.text: lehaza ( aey musalmano ! ) tum kamzor parr ker sulah ki dawat naa do ,   tum hi sarbuland raho gay , Allah tumharay sath hai , aur woh tumharay aemal ko hergiz barbad nahi keray ga .
ayahs.translation: lehaza ( aey musalmano ! ) tum kamzor parr ker sulah ki dawat naa do ,   tum hi sarbuland raho gay , Allah tumharay sath hai , aur woh tumharay aemal ko hergiz barbad nahi keray ga .

ayahs.text: yeh dunyawi zindagi to bus khel tamasha hai , aur agar tum emaan lao , aur taqwa ikhtiyar kero to Allah tumharay ajar tumhen dey ga , aur tumharay maal tum say nahi maangay ga .
ayahs.translation: yeh dunyawi zindagi to bus khel tamasha hai , aur agar tum emaan lao , aur taqwa ikhtiyar kero to Allah tumharay ajar tumhen dey ga , aur tumharay maal tum say nahi maangay ga .

ayahs.text: agar woh tum say tumharay maal talab keray , aur tum say sabb kuch samett ley to tum bukhul say kaam lo gay , aur woh tumharay dil ki naraziyon ko zahir kerday ga .
ayahs.translation: agar woh tum say tumharay maal talab keray , aur tum say sabb kuch samett ley to tum bukhul say kaam lo gay , aur woh tumharay dil ki naraziyon ko zahir kerday ga .

ayahs.text: dekho ! tum aesay ho kay tumhen Allah kay raastay mein kharch kernay kay liye bulaya jata hai to tum mein say kuch log hain jo bukhul say kaam letay hain , aur jo shaks bhi bukhul kerta hai , woh khud apney aap hi say bukhul kerta hai .   aur Allah bey niaz hai , aur tum ho jo mohtaj ho . aur agar tum mun morro gay to woh tumhari jagah doosri qoam peda kerday ga , phir woh tum jaisay nahi hon gay .
ayahs.translation: dekho ! tum aesay ho kay tumhen Allah kay raastay mein kharch kernay kay liye bulaya jata hai to tum mein say kuch log hain jo bukhul say kaam letay hain , aur jo shaks bhi bukhul kerta hai , woh khud apney aap hi say bukhul kerta hai .   aur Allah bey niaz hai , aur tum ho jo mohtaj ho . aur agar tum mun morro gay to woh tumhari jagah doosri qoam peda kerday ga , phir woh tum jaisay nahi hon gay .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yaqeen jano , hum ney tumhen khuli hoi fatah ata kerdi hai ,
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) yaqeen jano , hum ney tumhen khuli hoi fatah ata kerdi hai ,

verses.text: takay Allah tumhari agli pichli tamam kotahiyon ko moaaf kerday ,   aur takay apni naimat tum per mukammal kerday , aur tumhen seedhay raastay per ley chalay ,
verses.translation: takay Allah tumhari agli pichli tamam kotahiyon ko moaaf kerday ,   aur takay apni naimat tum per mukammal kerday , aur tumhen seedhay raastay per ley chalay ,

verses.text: aur ( takay ) Allah tumhari aesi madad keray jo sabb per ghalib aajaye .
verses.translation: aur ( takay ) Allah tumhari aesi madad keray jo sabb per ghalib aajaye .

verses.text: wohi hai jiss ney emaan walon kay dilon mein sakeenat utaar di ,   takay unn kay emaan mein mazeed emaan ka izafa ho aur aasmano aur zameen kay tamam lashkar Allah hi kay hain , aur Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik
verses.translation: wohi hai jiss ney emaan walon kay dilon mein sakeenat utaar di ,   takay unn kay emaan mein mazeed emaan ka izafa ho aur aasmano aur zameen kay tamam lashkar Allah hi kay hain , aur Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik

verses.text: takay woh momin mardon aur aurton ko aesay baaghaat mein dakhil keray jinn kay neechay nehren behti hain , jahan woh hamesha basay rahen gay , aur unn ki buraiyon ko unn say door kerday aur Allah kay nazdeek yeh bari zabardast kamiyabi hai
verses.translation: takay woh momin mardon aur aurton ko aesay baaghaat mein dakhil keray jinn kay neechay nehren behti hain , jahan woh hamesha basay rahen gay , aur unn ki buraiyon ko unn say door kerday aur Allah kay nazdeek yeh bari zabardast kamiyabi hai

verses.text: aur takay unn munafiq mardon aur munafiq aurton aur mushrik mardon aur mushrik aurton ko azab dey jo Allah kay sath bad-gumaniyan rakhtay hain . burai ka pher unhi per parra huwa hai ,   aur Allah unn say naraz hai , uss ney unn ko apni rehmat say door kerdiya hai , aur unn kay liye jahannum tayyar ker rakhi hai , aur woh boht hi bura thikana hai .
verses.translation: aur takay unn munafiq mardon aur munafiq aurton aur mushrik mardon aur mushrik aurton ko azab dey jo Allah kay sath bad-gumaniyan rakhtay hain . burai ka pher unhi per parra huwa hai ,   aur Allah unn say naraz hai , uss ney unn ko apni rehmat say door kerdiya hai , aur unn kay liye jahannum tayyar ker rakhi hai , aur woh boht hi bura thikana hai .

verses.text: aur aasmano aur zameen kay tamam lashkar Allah hi kay hain , aur Allah iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
verses.translation: aur aasmano aur zameen kay tamam lashkar Allah hi kay hain , aur Allah iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen gawahi denay wala , khushkhabri denay wala aur khabrdar kernay wala bana ker bheja hai ,
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen gawahi denay wala , khushkhabri denay wala aur khabrdar kernay wala bana ker bheja hai ,

verses.text: takay ( aey logo ! ) tum Allah aur uss kay Rasool per emaan lao , aur uss ki madad kero , aur uss ki taazeem kero , aur subha o shaam Allah ki tasbeeh kertay raho .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) jo log tum say beyat ker rahey hain woh dar-haqeeqat Allah say beyat ker-rahey hain .   Allah ka haath unn kay haathon per hai . uss kay baad jo koi ehad torray ga , uss kay ehad torrney ka wabal ussi per parray ga , aur jo koi uss ehad ko poora keray ga jo uss ney Allah say kiya hai , to Allah uss ko zabardast sawab ata keray ga .

verses.text: woh dehaati jo ( hudaibia kay safar mein ) peechay reh gaye thay ,   abb woh tum say zaroor yeh kahen gay kay :  humaray maal o dolat aur humaray ehal o ayaal ney hamen mashghool kerliya tha , iss liye humaray liye maghfirat ki dua ker-dijiye .  woh apni zabanon say woh baaten kehtay hain jo unn kay dilon mein nahi hoten . ( unn say ) kaho kay :  acha to agar Allah tumhen koi nuqsan phonchana chahye ya faeeda phonchana chahye to kon hai jo Allah kay samney tumharay moamlay mein kuch bhi kernay ki taqat rakhta ho-?   balkay jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

( unn say ) kaho kay :  acha to agar Allah tumhen koi nuqsan phonchana chahye ya faeeda phonchana chahye to kon hai jo Allah kay samney tumharay moamlay mein kuch bhi kernay ki taqat rakhta ho-?   balkay jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: haqeeqat to yeh hai kay tum ney yeh samjha tha kay Rasool ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) aur doosray musalman kabhi apney ghar walon kay paas loat ker nahi ayen gay ,   aur yehi baat tumharay dilon ko achi maloom hoti thi , aur tum ney buray buray gumaan kiye thay , aur tum aesay log ban gaye thay jinhen barbad hona tha .
verses.translation: haqeeqat to yeh hai kay tum ney yeh samjha tha kay Rasool ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) aur doosray musalman kabhi apney ghar walon kay paas loat ker nahi ayen gay ,   aur yehi baat tumharay dilon ko achi maloom hoti thi , aur tum ney buray buray gumaan kiye thay , aur tum aesay log ban gaye thay jinhen barbad hona tha .

verses.text: aur jo shaks Allah aur uss kay Rasool per emaan naa laye , to ( woh yaad rakhay kay ) hum ney kafiron kay liye bharakti hoi aag tayyar ker rakhi hai .
verses.translation: aur jo shaks Allah aur uss kay Rasool per emaan naa laye , to ( woh yaad rakhay kay ) hum ney kafiron kay liye bharakti hoi aag tayyar ker rakhi hai .

verses.text: aur aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat tamam tarr Allah hi ki hai , woh jiss ko chahye , bakhsh dey , aur jiss ko chahye , azab dey , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .
verses.translation: aur aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat tamam tarr Allah hi ki hai , woh jiss ko chahye , bakhsh dey , aur jiss ko chahye , azab dey , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .

verses.text: . ( musalmano ! ) jab tum ghaneemat kay maal lenay kay liye chalo gay to yeh ( hudaibia kay safar say ) peechay rehney walay tum say kahen gay kay :  hamen bhi apney sath chalney do .    woh chahen gay kay Allah ki baat ko badal den .   tum keh dena kay :  tum hergiz humaray sath nahi chalo gay . Allah ney pehlay say yun hi farma rakha hai .    iss per woh kahen gay kay :  darasal aap log hum say hasad rakhtay hain .    nahi ! balkay haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh log khud hi aesay hain kay boht kam baat samajhtay hain .
verses.translation: . ( musalmano ! ) jab tum ghaneemat kay maal lenay kay liye chalo gay to yeh ( hudaibia kay safar say ) peechay rehney walay tum say kahen gay kay :  hamen bhi apney sath chalney do .    woh chahen gay kay Allah ki baat ko badal den .   tum keh dena kay :  tum hergiz humaray sath nahi chalo gay . Allah ney pehlay say yun hi farma rakha hai .    iss per woh kahen gay kay :  darasal aap log hum say hasad rakhtay hain .    nahi ! balkay haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh log khud hi aesay hain kay boht kam baat samajhtay hain .

verses.text: inn peechay rehney walay dehaatiyon say keh dena kay :  unqareeb tumhen aesay logon  kay paas ( larrney kay liye ) bulaya jaye ga jo baray sakht jangjoo hon gay , kay ya to unn say larrtay raho , ya woh itaat qubool kerlen .   uss waqt agar tum ( jihad kay uss hukum ki ) itaat kero gay to Allah tumhen acha ajar dey ga , aur agar tum mun morro gay jaisa kay tum ney pehlay mun morra tha to Allah tumhen dardnak azab dey ga .
verses.translation: inn peechay rehney walay dehaatiyon say keh dena kay :  unqareeb tumhen aesay logon  kay paas ( larrney kay liye ) bulaya jaye ga jo baray sakht jangjoo hon gay , kay ya to unn say larrtay raho , ya woh itaat qubool kerlen .   uss waqt agar tum ( jihad kay uss hukum ki ) itaat kero gay to Allah tumhen acha ajar dey ga , aur agar tum mun morro gay jaisa kay tum ney pehlay mun morra tha to Allah tumhen dardnak azab dey ga .

verses.text: andhay aadmi per ( jihad naa kernay ka ) koi gunah nahi hai , naa langray aadmi per koi gunah hai , aur naa beemar aadmi per gunah hai . aur jo shaks bhi Allah aur uss kay Rasool ka kehna maaney , Allah uss ko aesi jannaton mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi . aur jo koi mun morray ga , ussay dardnak azab dey ga .
verses.translation: andhay aadmi per ( jihad naa kernay ka ) koi gunah nahi hai , naa langray aadmi per koi gunah hai , aur naa beemar aadmi per gunah hai . aur jo shaks bhi Allah aur uss kay Rasool ka kehna maaney , Allah uss ko aesi jannaton mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi . aur jo koi mun morray ga , ussay dardnak azab dey ga .

verses.text: yaqeenan Allah unn mominon say bara khush huwa jab woh darkht kay neechay tum say beyat ker rahey thay , aur unn kay dilon mein jo kuch tha woh bhi Allah ko maloom tha ,   iss liye uss ney unn per sakeenat utaar di , aur unn ko inaam mein aik qareebi fatah ata farma di ,
verses.translation: yaqeenan Allah unn mominon say bara khush huwa jab woh darkht kay neechay tum say beyat ker rahey thay , aur unn kay dilon mein jo kuch tha woh bhi Allah ko maloom tha ,   iss liye uss ney unn per sakeenat utaar di , aur unn ko inaam mein aik qareebi fatah ata farma di ,

verses.text: aur ghaneemat mein milney walay boht say maal bhi jo unn kay haath ayen gay ! aur Allah iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
verses.translation: aur ghaneemat mein milney walay boht say maal bhi jo unn kay haath ayen gay ! aur Allah iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

verses.text: Allah ney tum say boht say maal-e-ghaneemat ka wada ker rakha hai jo tum hasil kero gay ,   abb fori tor per uss ney tumhen yeh fatah dey di hai , aur logon  kay haathon ko tum say rok diya ,   takay yeh mominon kay liye aik nishani ban jaye , aur tumhen Allah seedhay raastay per daal dey ,
verses.translation: Allah ney tum say boht say maal-e-ghaneemat ka wada ker rakha hai jo tum hasil kero gay ,   abb fori tor per uss ney tumhen yeh fatah dey di hai , aur logon  kay haathon ko tum say rok diya ,   takay yeh mominon kay liye aik nishani ban jaye , aur tumhen Allah seedhay raastay per daal dey ,

verses.text: aur aik fatah aur bhi hai jo abhi tumharay qaboo mein nahi aai , lekin Allah ney uss ko apney ehatay mein ley rakha hai ,   aur Allah her cheez per poori tarah qadir hai .
verses.translation: aur aik fatah aur bhi hai jo abhi tumharay qaboo mein nahi aai , lekin Allah ney uss ko apney ehatay mein ley rakha hai ,   aur Allah her cheez per poori tarah qadir hai .

verses.text: aur yeh kafir log tum say larrtay to yaqeenan peeth pher ker bhag jatay , phir enhen koi yaar o madadgaar bhi naa milta ,
verses.translation: aur yeh kafir log tum say larrtay to yaqeenan peeth pher ker bhag jatay , phir enhen koi yaar o madadgaar bhi naa milta ,

verses.text: jaisa kay Allah ka yehi dastoor hai jo pehlay say chala aata hai , aur tum Allah kay dastoor mein hergiz tabdeeli nahi pao gay .
verses.translation: jaisa kay Allah ka yehi dastoor hai jo pehlay say chala aata hai , aur tum Allah kay dastoor mein hergiz tabdeeli nahi pao gay .

verses.text: aur wohi Allah hai jiss ney makkah ki wadi mein unn kay haathon ko tum tak phonchney say , aur tumharay haathon ko unn tak phonchney say rok diya , jabkay woh tumhen unn per qaboo dey chuka tha ,   aur jo kuch tum ker rahey thay Allah ussay dekh raha tha .
verses.translation: aur wohi Allah hai jiss ney makkah ki wadi mein unn kay haathon ko tum tak phonchney say , aur tumharay haathon ko unn tak phonchney say rok diya , jabkay woh tumhen unn per qaboo dey chuka tha ,   aur jo kuch tum ker rahey thay Allah ussay dekh raha tha .

verses.text: yehi log to hain jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya , aur tumhen masjid-e-haram say roka , aur qurbani kay janweron ko jo thehray huye kharray thay , apni jagah phonchney say rok diya .   aur agar kuch musalman mard aur musalman aurten ( makkah mein ) naa hoten jinn kay baaray mein tumhen khabar bhi naa hoti kay tum unhen pees daalo gay , aur uss ki wajeh say bey khabri mein tum ko nuqsan phonch jata   ( to hum inn kafiron say tumhari sulah kay bajaye jang kerwa detay , lekin hum ney jang ko iss liye roka ) takay Allah jiss ko chahye , apni rehmat mein dakhil kerday .   ( albatta ) agar woh musalman wahan say hatt jatay to hum inn ( ehal-e-makkah ) mein say jo kafir thay , unhen dardnak saza detay .
verses.translation: yehi log to hain jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya , aur tumhen masjid-e-haram say roka , aur qurbani kay janweron ko jo thehray huye kharray thay , apni jagah phonchney say rok diya .   aur agar kuch musalman mard aur musalman aurten ( makkah mein ) naa hoten jinn kay baaray mein tumhen khabar bhi naa hoti kay tum unhen pees daalo gay , aur uss ki wajeh say bey khabri mein tum ko nuqsan phonch jata   ( to hum inn kafiron say tumhari sulah kay bajaye jang kerwa detay , lekin hum ney jang ko iss liye roka ) takay Allah jiss ko chahye , apni rehmat mein dakhil kerday .   ( albatta ) agar woh musalman wahan say hatt jatay to hum inn ( ehal-e-makkah ) mein say jo kafir thay , unhen dardnak saza detay .

verses.text: . ( chunacheh ) jab inn kafiron ney apney dilon mein uss hamiyat ko jagah di jo jahiliyat ki hamiyat thi to Allah ney apni taraf say apney payghumber aur musalmanon per sakeenat nazil farmaee ,   aur unn ko taqwa ki baat per jamaye rakha ,   aur woh issi kay ziyada haq daar aur iss kay ehal thay , aur Allah her cheez ko khoob janney wala hai .
verses.translation: . ( chunacheh ) jab inn kafiron ney apney dilon mein uss hamiyat ko jagah di jo jahiliyat ki hamiyat thi to Allah ney apni taraf say apney payghumber aur musalmanon per sakeenat nazil farmaee ,   aur unn ko taqwa ki baat per jamaye rakha ,   aur woh issi kay ziyada haq daar aur iss kay ehal thay , aur Allah her cheez ko khoob janney wala hai .

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah ney apney Rasool ko sacha khuwab dikhaya hai jo waqaey kay bilkul mutabiq hai . tum log inn sha Allah zaroor masjid-e-haram mein iss tarah aman o aman kay sath dakhil hogay kay tum ( mein say kuch ) ney apney saron ko bey khof o khatar mundwaya hoga , aur ( kuch ney ) baal tarashney hon gay .   Allah woh baaten janta hai jo tumhen maloom nahi hain . chunacheh uss ney woh khuwab poora honey say pehlay aik qareebi fatah tey kerdi hai .
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah ney apney Rasool ko sacha khuwab dikhaya hai jo waqaey kay bilkul mutabiq hai . tum log inn sha Allah zaroor masjid-e-haram mein iss tarah aman o aman kay sath dakhil hogay kay tum ( mein say kuch ) ney apney saron ko bey khof o khatar mundwaya hoga , aur ( kuch ney ) baal tarashney hon gay .   Allah woh baaten janta hai jo tumhen maloom nahi hain . chunacheh uss ney woh khuwab poora honey say pehlay aik qareebi fatah tey kerdi hai .

verses.text: wohi hai jiss ney apney Rasool ko hidayat aur sacha deen dey ker bheja hai , takay ussay her doosray deen per ghalib kerday . aur ( uss ki ) gawahi denay kay liye Allah kafi hai .
verses.translation: wohi hai jiss ney apney Rasool ko hidayat aur sacha deen dey ker bheja hai , takay ussay her doosray deen per ghalib kerday . aur ( uss ki ) gawahi denay kay liye Allah kafi hai .

verses.text: Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) Allah kay Rasool hain ,   aur jo log unn kay sath hain , woh kafiron kay muqablay mein sakht hain , ( aur ) aapas mein aik doosray kay liye reham dil hain . tum unhen dekho gay kay kabhi rukoo mein hain , kabhi sajday mein , ( gharz ) Allah kay fazal aur khushnoodi ki talash mein lagay huye hain . unn ki alamaten sajday kay asar say unn kay chehron per numaya hain . yeh hain unn kay woh osaaf jo toraat mein mazkoor hain .   aur injeel mein unn ki misal yeh hai kay jaisay aik kheti ho jiss ney apni konpal nikali , phir uss ko mazboot kiya , phir woh moti hogaee , phir woh apney taney per iss tarah seedhi kharri hogaee kay kaashtkaar uss say khush hotay hain ,   takay Allah unn ( ki iss taraqqi ) say kafiron ka dil jalaye . yeh log jo emaan laye hain , aur enhon ney naik amal kiye hain , Allah ney inn say maghfirat aur zabardast sawab ka wada kerliya hai .
