ayahs.translation: aur jo shaks Allah aur uss kay Rasool per emaan naa laye , to ( woh yaad rakhay kay ) hum ney kafiron kay liye bharakti hoi aag tayyar ker rakhi hai .

ayahs.text: aur aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat tamam tarr Allah hi ki hai , woh jiss ko chahye , bakhsh dey , aur jiss ko chahye , azab dey , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: aur aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat tamam tarr Allah hi ki hai , woh jiss ko chahye , bakhsh dey , aur jiss ko chahye , azab dey , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .

ayahs.text: . ( musalmano ! ) jab tum ghaneemat kay maal lenay kay liye chalo gay to yeh ( hudaibia kay safar say ) peechay rehney walay tum say kahen gay kay :  hamen bhi apney sath chalney do .    woh chahen gay kay Allah ki baat ko badal den .   tum keh dena kay :  tum hergiz humaray sath nahi chalo gay . Allah ney pehlay say yun hi farma rakha hai .    iss per woh kahen gay kay :  darasal aap log hum say hasad rakhtay hain .    nahi ! balkay haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh log khud hi aesay hain kay boht kam baat samajhtay hain .
ayahs.translation: . ( musalmano ! ) jab tum ghaneemat kay maal lenay kay liye chalo gay to yeh ( hudaibia kay safar say ) peechay rehney walay tum say kahen gay kay :  hamen bhi apney sath chalney do .    woh chahen gay kay Allah ki baat ko badal den .   tum keh dena kay :  tum hergiz humaray sath nahi chalo gay . Allah ney pehlay say yun hi farma rakha hai .    iss per woh kahen gay kay :  darasal aap log hum say hasad rakhtay hain .    nahi ! balkay haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh log khud hi aesay hain kay boht kam baat samajhtay hain .

ayahs.text: inn peechay rehney walay dehaatiyon say keh dena kay :  unqareeb tumhen aesay logon  kay paas ( larrney kay liye ) bulaya jaye ga jo baray sakht jangjoo hon gay , kay ya to unn say larrtay raho , ya woh itaat qubool kerlen .   uss waqt agar tum ( jihad kay uss hukum ki ) itaat kero gay to Allah tumhen acha ajar dey ga , aur agar tum mun morro gay jaisa kay tum ney pehlay mun morra tha to Allah tumhen dardnak azab dey ga .
ayahs.translation: inn peechay rehney walay dehaatiyon say keh dena kay :  unqareeb tumhen aesay logon  kay paas ( larrney kay liye ) bulaya jaye ga jo baray sakht jangjoo hon gay , kay ya to unn say larrtay raho , ya woh itaat qubool kerlen .   uss waqt agar tum ( jihad kay uss hukum ki ) itaat kero gay to Allah tumhen acha ajar dey ga , aur agar tum mun morro gay jaisa kay tum ney pehlay mun morra tha to Allah tumhen dardnak azab dey ga .

ayahs.text: andhay aadmi per ( jihad naa kernay ka ) koi gunah nahi hai , naa langray aadmi per koi gunah hai , aur naa beemar aadmi per gunah hai . aur jo shaks bhi Allah aur uss kay Rasool ka kehna maaney , Allah uss ko aesi jannaton mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi . aur jo koi mun morray ga , ussay dardnak azab dey ga .
ayahs.translation: andhay aadmi per ( jihad naa kernay ka ) koi gunah nahi hai , naa langray aadmi per koi gunah hai , aur naa beemar aadmi per gunah hai . aur jo shaks bhi Allah aur uss kay Rasool ka kehna maaney , Allah uss ko aesi jannaton mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi . aur jo koi mun morray ga , ussay dardnak azab dey ga .

ayahs.text: yaqeenan Allah unn mominon say bara khush huwa jab woh darkht kay neechay tum say beyat ker rahey thay , aur unn kay dilon mein jo kuch tha woh bhi Allah ko maloom tha ,   iss liye uss ney unn per sakeenat utaar di , aur unn ko inaam mein aik qareebi fatah ata farma di ,
ayahs.translation: yaqeenan Allah unn mominon say bara khush huwa jab woh darkht kay neechay tum say beyat ker rahey thay , aur unn kay dilon mein jo kuch tha woh bhi Allah ko maloom tha ,   iss liye uss ney unn per sakeenat utaar di , aur unn ko inaam mein aik qareebi fatah ata farma di ,

ayahs.text: aur ghaneemat mein milney walay boht say maal bhi jo unn kay haath ayen gay ! aur Allah iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
ayahs.translation: aur ghaneemat mein milney walay boht say maal bhi jo unn kay haath ayen gay ! aur Allah iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

ayahs.text: Allah ney tum say boht say maal-e-ghaneemat ka wada ker rakha hai jo tum hasil kero gay ,   abb fori tor per uss ney tumhen yeh fatah dey di hai , aur logon  kay haathon ko tum say rok diya ,   takay yeh mominon kay liye aik nishani ban jaye , aur tumhen Allah seedhay raastay per daal dey ,
ayahs.translation: Allah ney tum say boht say maal-e-ghaneemat ka wada ker rakha hai jo tum hasil kero gay ,   abb fori tor per uss ney tumhen yeh fatah dey di hai , aur logon  kay haathon ko tum say rok diya ,   takay yeh mominon kay liye aik nishani ban jaye , aur tumhen Allah seedhay raastay per daal dey ,

ayahs.text: aur aik fatah aur bhi hai jo abhi tumharay qaboo mein nahi aai , lekin Allah ney uss ko apney ehatay mein ley rakha hai ,   aur Allah her cheez per poori tarah qadir hai .
ayahs.translation: aur aik fatah aur bhi hai jo abhi tumharay qaboo mein nahi aai , lekin Allah ney uss ko apney ehatay mein ley rakha hai ,   aur Allah her cheez per poori tarah qadir hai .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kafir log tum say larrtay to yaqeenan peeth pher ker bhag jatay , phir enhen koi yaar o madadgaar bhi naa milta ,
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kafir log tum say larrtay to yaqeenan peeth pher ker bhag jatay , phir enhen koi yaar o madadgaar bhi naa milta ,

ayahs.text: jaisa kay Allah ka yehi dastoor hai jo pehlay say chala aata hai , aur tum Allah kay dastoor mein hergiz tabdeeli nahi pao gay .
ayahs.translation: jaisa kay Allah ka yehi dastoor hai jo pehlay say chala aata hai , aur tum Allah kay dastoor mein hergiz tabdeeli nahi pao gay .

ayahs.text: aur wohi Allah hai jiss ney makkah ki wadi mein unn kay haathon ko tum tak phonchney say , aur tumharay haathon ko unn tak phonchney say rok diya , jabkay woh tumhen unn per qaboo dey chuka tha ,   aur jo kuch tum ker rahey thay Allah ussay dekh raha tha .
ayahs.translation: aur wohi Allah hai jiss ney makkah ki wadi mein unn kay haathon ko tum tak phonchney say , aur tumharay haathon ko unn tak phonchney say rok diya , jabkay woh tumhen unn per qaboo dey chuka tha ,   aur jo kuch tum ker rahey thay Allah ussay dekh raha tha .

ayahs.text: yehi log to hain jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya , aur tumhen masjid-e-haram say roka , aur qurbani kay janweron ko jo thehray huye kharray thay , apni jagah phonchney say rok diya .   aur agar kuch musalman mard aur musalman aurten ( makkah mein ) naa hoten jinn kay baaray mein tumhen khabar bhi naa hoti kay tum unhen pees daalo gay , aur uss ki wajeh say bey khabri mein tum ko nuqsan phonch jata   ( to hum inn kafiron say tumhari sulah kay bajaye jang kerwa detay , lekin hum ney jang ko iss liye roka ) takay Allah jiss ko chahye , apni rehmat mein dakhil kerday .   ( albatta ) agar woh musalman wahan say hatt jatay to hum inn ( ehal-e-makkah ) mein say jo kafir thay , unhen dardnak saza detay .
ayahs.translation: yehi log to hain jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya , aur tumhen masjid-e-haram say roka , aur qurbani kay janweron ko jo thehray huye kharray thay , apni jagah phonchney say rok diya .   aur agar kuch musalman mard aur musalman aurten ( makkah mein ) naa hoten jinn kay baaray mein tumhen khabar bhi naa hoti kay tum unhen pees daalo gay , aur uss ki wajeh say bey khabri mein tum ko nuqsan phonch jata   ( to hum inn kafiron say tumhari sulah kay bajaye jang kerwa detay , lekin hum ney jang ko iss liye roka ) takay Allah jiss ko chahye , apni rehmat mein dakhil kerday .   ( albatta ) agar woh musalman wahan say hatt jatay to hum inn ( ehal-e-makkah ) mein say jo kafir thay , unhen dardnak saza detay .

ayahs.text: . ( chunacheh ) jab inn kafiron ney apney dilon mein uss hamiyat ko jagah di jo jahiliyat ki hamiyat thi to Allah ney apni taraf say apney payghumber aur musalmanon per sakeenat nazil farmaee ,   aur unn ko taqwa ki baat per jamaye rakha ,   aur woh issi kay ziyada haq daar aur iss kay ehal thay , aur Allah her cheez ko khoob janney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( chunacheh ) jab inn kafiron ney apney dilon mein uss hamiyat ko jagah di jo jahiliyat ki hamiyat thi to Allah ney apni taraf say apney payghumber aur musalmanon per sakeenat nazil farmaee ,   aur unn ko taqwa ki baat per jamaye rakha ,   aur woh issi kay ziyada haq daar aur iss kay ehal thay , aur Allah her cheez ko khoob janney wala hai .

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah ney apney Rasool ko sacha khuwab dikhaya hai jo waqaey kay bilkul mutabiq hai . tum log inn sha Allah zaroor masjid-e-haram mein iss tarah aman o aman kay sath dakhil hogay kay tum ( mein say kuch ) ney apney saron ko bey khof o khatar mundwaya hoga , aur ( kuch ney ) baal tarashney hon gay .   Allah woh baaten janta hai jo tumhen maloom nahi hain . chunacheh uss ney woh khuwab poora honey say pehlay aik qareebi fatah tey kerdi hai .
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah ney apney Rasool ko sacha khuwab dikhaya hai jo waqaey kay bilkul mutabiq hai . tum log inn sha Allah zaroor masjid-e-haram mein iss tarah aman o aman kay sath dakhil hogay kay tum ( mein say kuch ) ney apney saron ko bey khof o khatar mundwaya hoga , aur ( kuch ney ) baal tarashney hon gay .   Allah woh baaten janta hai jo tumhen maloom nahi hain . chunacheh uss ney woh khuwab poora honey say pehlay aik qareebi fatah tey kerdi hai .

ayahs.text: wohi hai jiss ney apney Rasool ko hidayat aur sacha deen dey ker bheja hai , takay ussay her doosray deen per ghalib kerday . aur ( uss ki ) gawahi denay kay liye Allah kafi hai .
ayahs.translation: wohi hai jiss ney apney Rasool ko hidayat aur sacha deen dey ker bheja hai , takay ussay her doosray deen per ghalib kerday . aur ( uss ki ) gawahi denay kay liye Allah kafi hai .

ayahs.text: Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) Allah kay Rasool hain ,   aur jo log unn kay sath hain , woh kafiron kay muqablay mein sakht hain , ( aur ) aapas mein aik doosray kay liye reham dil hain . tum unhen dekho gay kay kabhi rukoo mein hain , kabhi sajday mein , ( gharz ) Allah kay fazal aur khushnoodi ki talash mein lagay huye hain . unn ki alamaten sajday kay asar say unn kay chehron per numaya hain . yeh hain unn kay woh osaaf jo toraat mein mazkoor hain .   aur injeel mein unn ki misal yeh hai kay jaisay aik kheti ho jiss ney apni konpal nikali , phir uss ko mazboot kiya , phir woh moti hogaee , phir woh apney taney per iss tarah seedhi kharri hogaee kay kaashtkaar uss say khush hotay hain ,   takay Allah unn ( ki iss taraqqi ) say kafiron ka dil jalaye . yeh log jo emaan laye hain , aur enhon ney naik amal kiye hain , Allah ney inn say maghfirat aur zabardast sawab ka wada kerliya hai .
ayahs.translation: Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) Allah kay Rasool hain ,   aur jo log unn kay sath hain , woh kafiron kay muqablay mein sakht hain , ( aur ) aapas mein aik doosray kay liye reham dil hain . tum unhen dekho gay kay kabhi rukoo mein hain , kabhi sajday mein , ( gharz ) Allah kay fazal aur khushnoodi ki talash mein lagay huye hain . unn ki alamaten sajday kay asar say unn kay chehron per numaya hain . yeh hain unn kay woh osaaf jo toraat mein mazkoor hain .   aur injeel mein unn ki misal yeh hai kay jaisay aik kheti ho jiss ney apni konpal nikali , phir uss ko mazboot kiya , phir woh moti hogaee , phir woh apney taney per iss tarah seedhi kharri hogaee kay kaashtkaar uss say khush hotay hain ,   takay Allah unn ( ki iss taraqqi ) say kafiron ka dil jalaye . yeh log jo emaan laye hain , aur enhon ney naik amal kiye hain , Allah ney inn say maghfirat aur zabardast sawab ka wada kerliya hai .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah aur uss kay Rasool kay aagay naa barha kero ,   aur Allah say dartay raho . Allah yaqeenan sabb kuch sunta , sabb kuch janta hai .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah aur uss kay Rasool kay aagay naa barha kero ,   aur Allah say dartay raho . Allah yaqeenan sabb kuch sunta , sabb kuch janta hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! apni aawazen nabi ki aawaz say buland matt kiya kero , aur naa unn say baat kertay huye iss tarah zor say bola kero jaisay tum aik doosray say zor say boltay ho , kahen aisa naa ho kay tumharay aemal barbad hojayen , aur tumhen pata bhi naa chalay .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! apni aawazen nabi ki aawaz say buland matt kiya kero , aur naa unn say baat kertay huye iss tarah zor say bola kero jaisay tum aik doosray say zor say boltay ho , kahen aisa naa ho kay tumharay aemal barbad hojayen , aur tumhen pata bhi naa chalay .

verses.text: yaqeen jano jo log Allah kay Rasool ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) kay paas apni aawazen neechi rakhtay hain , yeh wohi log hain jinn kay dilon ko Allah ney khoob janch ker taqwa kay liye muntakhib kerliya hai . unn ko maghfirat bhi hasil hai , aur zabardast ajar bhi .
verses.translation: yaqeen jano jo log Allah kay Rasool ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) kay paas apni aawazen neechi rakhtay hain , yeh wohi log hain jinn kay dilon ko Allah ney khoob janch ker taqwa kay liye muntakhib kerliya hai . unn ko maghfirat bhi hasil hai , aur zabardast ajar bhi .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) jo log tumhen hujron kay peechay say aawaz detay hain , unn mein say aksar ko aqal nahi hai .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) jo log tumhen hujron kay peechay say aawaz detay hain , unn mein say aksar ko aqal nahi hai .

verses.text: aur agar yeh log uss waqt tak sabar kertay jab tak tum khud bahir nikal ker unn kay paas aajatay , to unn kay liye behtar hota , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .
verses.translation: aur agar yeh log uss waqt tak sabar kertay jab tak tum khud bahir nikal ker unn kay paas aajatay , to unn kay liye behtar hota , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! agar koi fasiq tumharay paas koi khabar ley ker aaye , to achi tarah tehqeeq kerliya kero ,   kahen aisa naa ho kay tum nadani say kuch logon  ko nuqsan phoncha betho , aur phir apney kiye per pachtao .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! agar koi fasiq tumharay paas koi khabar ley ker aaye , to achi tarah tehqeeq kerliya kero ,   kahen aisa naa ho kay tum nadani say kuch logon  ko nuqsan phoncha betho , aur phir apney kiye per pachtao .

verses.text: aur yeh baat achi tarah samajh lo kay tumharay darmiyan Allah kay Rasool mojood hain . boht si baaten hain jinn mein woh agar tumhari baat maan len to khud tum mushkil mein parr-jao . lekin Allah ney tumharay dil mein emaan ki mohabbat daal di hai , aur ussay tumharay dilon mein purkashish bana diya hai , aur tumharay andar kufr ki aur gunahon aur nafarmani ki nafrat bitha di hai .   aesay hi log hain jo theek theek raastay per aa-chukay hain ,
verses.translation: aur yeh baat achi tarah samajh lo kay tumharay darmiyan Allah kay Rasool mojood hain . boht si baaten hain jinn mein woh agar tumhari baat maan len to khud tum mushkil mein parr-jao . lekin Allah ney tumharay dil mein emaan ki mohabbat daal di hai , aur ussay tumharay dilon mein purkashish bana diya hai , aur tumharay andar kufr ki aur gunahon aur nafarmani ki nafrat bitha di hai .   aesay hi log hain jo theek theek raastay per aa-chukay hain ,

verses.text: jo Allah ki taraf say fazal aur naimat ka nateeja hai , aur Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
verses.translation: jo Allah ki taraf say fazal aur naimat ka nateeja hai , aur Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

verses.text: aur agar musalmanon kay do giroh aapas mein larr parren to unn kay darmiyan sulah kerao . phir agar unn mein say aik giroh doosray kay sath ziyadti keray to uss giroh say larro jo ziyadti ker raha ho , yahan tak kay woh Allah kay hukum ki taraf loat aaye . chunacheh agar woh loat aaye , to unn kay darmiyan insaf kay sath sulah kerado , aur ( her moamlay mein ) insaf say kaam liya kero , beyshak Allah insaf kernay walon say mohabbat kerta hai .
verses.translation: aur agar musalmanon kay do giroh aapas mein larr parren to unn kay darmiyan sulah kerao . phir agar unn mein say aik giroh doosray kay sath ziyadti keray to uss giroh say larro jo ziyadti ker raha ho , yahan tak kay woh Allah kay hukum ki taraf loat aaye . chunacheh agar woh loat aaye , to unn kay darmiyan insaf kay sath sulah kerado , aur ( her moamlay mein ) insaf say kaam liya kero , beyshak Allah insaf kernay walon say mohabbat kerta hai .

verses.text: haqeeqat to yeh hai kay tamam musalman bhai bhai hain , iss liye apney do bhaiyon kay darmiyan talluqaat achay banao , aur Allah say daro takay tumharay sath rehmat ka moamla kiya jaye .
verses.translation: haqeeqat to yeh hai kay tamam musalman bhai bhai hain , iss liye apney do bhaiyon kay darmiyan talluqaat achay banao , aur Allah say daro takay tumharay sath rehmat ka moamla kiya jaye .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! naa to mard doosray mardon ka mazaq urayen , hosakta hai kay woh ( jinn ka mazaq urra rahey hain ) khud inn say behtar hon , aur naa doosri aurten doosri aurton ka mazaq urayen , hosakta hai kay woh ( jinn ka mazaq urra rahi hain ) khud inn say behtar hon . aur tum aik doosray ko taana naa diya kero , aur naa aik doosray ko buray alqaab say pukaro . emaan laney kay baad gunah ka naam lagna boht buri baat hai .   aur jo log inn baaton say baaz naa ayen , to woh zalim log hain .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! naa to mard doosray mardon ka mazaq urayen , hosakta hai kay woh ( jinn ka mazaq urra rahey hain ) khud inn say behtar hon , aur naa doosri aurten doosri aurton ka mazaq urayen , hosakta hai kay woh ( jinn ka mazaq urra rahi hain ) khud inn say behtar hon . aur tum aik doosray ko taana naa diya kero , aur naa aik doosray ko buray alqaab say pukaro . emaan laney kay baad gunah ka naam lagna boht buri baat hai .   aur jo log inn baaton say baaz naa ayen , to woh zalim log hain .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! boht say gumanon say bacho , baaz gumaan gunah hotay hain .   aur kissi ki toh mein naa lago ,   aur aik doosray ki gheebat naa kero .   kiya tum mein say koi yeh pasand keray ga kay woh apney maray huye bhai ka gosht khaye-? iss say to khud tum nafrat kertay ho ! aur Allah say daro . beyshak Allah bara tauba qubool kernay wala , boht meharban hai .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! boht say gumanon say bacho , baaz gumaan gunah hotay hain .   aur kissi ki toh mein naa lago ,   aur aik doosray ki gheebat naa kero .   kiya tum mein say koi yeh pasand keray ga kay woh apney maray huye bhai ka gosht khaye-? iss say to khud tum nafrat kertay ho ! aur Allah say daro . beyshak Allah bara tauba qubool kernay wala , boht meharban hai .

verses.text: aey logo ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney tum sabb ko aik mard aur aik aurat say peda kiya hai , aur tumhen mukhtalif qoamon aur khandano mein iss liye taqseem kiya hai takay tum aik doosray ki pehchan ker-sako .   dar-haqeeqat Allah kay nazdeek tum mein sabb say ziyada izzat wala woh hai jo tum mein sabb say ziyada muttaqi ho . yaqeen rakho kay Allah sabb kuch janney wala , her cheez say ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: aey logo ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney tum sabb ko aik mard aur aik aurat say peda kiya hai , aur tumhen mukhtalif qoamon aur khandano mein iss liye taqseem kiya hai takay tum aik doosray ki pehchan ker-sako .   dar-haqeeqat Allah kay nazdeek tum mein sabb say ziyada izzat wala woh hai jo tum mein sabb say ziyada muttaqi ho . yaqeen rakho kay Allah sabb kuch janney wala , her cheez say ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: yeh dehaati kehtay hain kay :  hum emaan ley aaye hain .  inn say kaho kay :  tum emaan to nahi laye , albatta yeh kaho kay hum ney hathiyaar daal diye hain .   aur emaan abhi tumharay dilon mein dakhil nahi huwa . aur agar tum waqaee Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki itaat kero gay to Allah tumharay aemal ( kay sawab ) mein zara bhi kami nahi keray ga . yaqeenan Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .
verses.translation: yeh dehaati kehtay hain kay :  hum emaan ley aaye hain .  inn say kaho kay :  tum emaan to nahi laye , albatta yeh kaho kay hum ney hathiyaar daal diye hain .   aur emaan abhi tumharay dilon mein dakhil nahi huwa . aur agar tum waqaee Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki itaat kero gay to Allah tumharay aemal ( kay sawab ) mein zara bhi kami nahi keray ga . yaqeenan Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .

verses.text: emaan laney walay to woh hain jinhon ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool ko dil say maana hai , phir kissi shak mein nahi parray , aur jinhon ney apney maal o dolat aur apni janon say Allah kay raastay mein jihad kiya hai . wohi log hain jo sachay hain .
verses.translation: emaan laney walay to woh hain jinhon ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool ko dil say maana hai , phir kissi shak mein nahi parray , aur jinhon ney apney maal o dolat aur apni janon say Allah kay raastay mein jihad kiya hai . wohi log hain jo sachay hain .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn dehaatiyon say ) kaho kay :  kiya tum Allah ko apney deen ki itlaa dey rahey ho-? halankay Allah unn tamam cheezon ko khoob janta hai jo aasmano mein hain aur jo zameen mein hain , aur Allah her cheez ka poora poora ilm rakhta hai .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn dehaatiyon say ) kaho kay :  kiya tum Allah ko apney deen ki itlaa dey rahey ho-? halankay Allah unn tamam cheezon ko khoob janta hai jo aasmano mein hain aur jo zameen mein hain , aur Allah her cheez ka poora poora ilm rakhta hai .

verses.text: yeh log tum per ehsan rakhtay hain kay yeh Islam ley aaye hain . inn say kaho kay :  mujh per apney Islam laney ka ehsan naa jatlao . balkay agar tum waqaee ( apney daway mein ) sachay ho to yeh Allah ka tum per ehsan hai kay uss ney tumhen emaan ki hidayat di .
verses.translation: yeh log tum per ehsan rakhtay hain kay yeh Islam ley aaye hain . inn say kaho kay :  mujh per apney Islam laney ka ehsan naa jatlao . balkay agar tum waqaee ( apney daway mein ) sachay ho to yeh Allah ka tum per ehsan hai kay uss ney tumhen emaan ki hidayat di .

verses.text: waqiaa yeh hai kay Allah aasmano aur zameen ki her posheeda baat ko khoob janta hai , aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah ussay achi tarah dekh raha hai .
verses.translation: waqiaa yeh hai kay Allah aasmano aur zameen ki her posheeda baat ko khoob janta hai , aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah ussay achi tarah dekh raha hai .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah aur uss kay Rasool kay aagay naa barha kero ,   aur Allah say dartay raho . Allah yaqeenan sabb kuch sunta , sabb kuch janta hai .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah aur uss kay Rasool kay aagay naa barha kero ,   aur Allah say dartay raho . Allah yaqeenan sabb kuch sunta , sabb kuch janta hai .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! apni aawazen nabi ki aawaz say buland matt kiya kero , aur naa unn say baat kertay huye iss tarah zor say bola kero jaisay tum aik doosray say zor say boltay ho , kahen aisa naa ho kay tumharay aemal barbad hojayen , aur tumhen pata bhi naa chalay .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! apni aawazen nabi ki aawaz say buland matt kiya kero , aur naa unn say baat kertay huye iss tarah zor say bola kero jaisay tum aik doosray say zor say boltay ho , kahen aisa naa ho kay tumharay aemal barbad hojayen , aur tumhen pata bhi naa chalay .

ayahs.text: yaqeen jano jo log Allah kay Rasool ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) kay paas apni aawazen neechi rakhtay hain , yeh wohi log hain jinn kay dilon ko Allah ney khoob janch ker taqwa kay liye muntakhib kerliya hai . unn ko maghfirat bhi hasil hai , aur zabardast ajar bhi .
ayahs.translation: yaqeen jano jo log Allah kay Rasool ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) kay paas apni aawazen neechi rakhtay hain , yeh wohi log hain jinn kay dilon ko Allah ney khoob janch ker taqwa kay liye muntakhib kerliya hai . unn ko maghfirat bhi hasil hai , aur zabardast ajar bhi .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) jo log tumhen hujron kay peechay say aawaz detay hain , unn mein say aksar ko aqal nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) jo log tumhen hujron kay peechay say aawaz detay hain , unn mein say aksar ko aqal nahi hai .

ayahs.text: aur agar yeh log uss waqt tak sabar kertay jab tak tum khud bahir nikal ker unn kay paas aajatay , to unn kay liye behtar hota , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: aur agar yeh log uss waqt tak sabar kertay jab tak tum khud bahir nikal ker unn kay paas aajatay , to unn kay liye behtar hota , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! agar koi fasiq tumharay paas koi khabar ley ker aaye , to achi tarah tehqeeq kerliya kero ,   kahen aisa naa ho kay tum nadani say kuch logon  ko nuqsan phoncha betho , aur phir apney kiye per pachtao .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! agar koi fasiq tumharay paas koi khabar ley ker aaye , to achi tarah tehqeeq kerliya kero ,   kahen aisa naa ho kay tum nadani say kuch logon  ko nuqsan phoncha betho , aur phir apney kiye per pachtao .

ayahs.text: aur yeh baat achi tarah samajh lo kay tumharay darmiyan Allah kay Rasool mojood hain . boht si baaten hain jinn mein woh agar tumhari baat maan len to khud tum mushkil mein parr-jao . lekin Allah ney tumharay dil mein emaan ki mohabbat daal di hai , aur ussay tumharay dilon mein purkashish bana diya hai , aur tumharay andar kufr ki aur gunahon aur nafarmani ki nafrat bitha di hai .   aesay hi log hain jo theek theek raastay per aa-chukay hain ,
ayahs.translation: aur yeh baat achi tarah samajh lo kay tumharay darmiyan Allah kay Rasool mojood hain . boht si baaten hain jinn mein woh agar tumhari baat maan len to khud tum mushkil mein parr-jao . lekin Allah ney tumharay dil mein emaan ki mohabbat daal di hai , aur ussay tumharay dilon mein purkashish bana diya hai , aur tumharay andar kufr ki aur gunahon aur nafarmani ki nafrat bitha di hai .   aesay hi log hain jo theek theek raastay per aa-chukay hain ,

ayahs.text: jo Allah ki taraf say fazal aur naimat ka nateeja hai , aur Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
ayahs.translation: jo Allah ki taraf say fazal aur naimat ka nateeja hai , aur Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

ayahs.text: aur agar musalmanon kay do giroh aapas mein larr parren to unn kay darmiyan sulah kerao . phir agar unn mein say aik giroh doosray kay sath ziyadti keray to uss giroh say larro jo ziyadti ker raha ho , yahan tak kay woh Allah kay hukum ki taraf loat aaye . chunacheh agar woh loat aaye , to unn kay darmiyan insaf kay sath sulah kerado , aur ( her moamlay mein ) insaf say kaam liya kero , beyshak Allah insaf kernay walon say mohabbat kerta hai .
ayahs.translation: aur agar musalmanon kay do giroh aapas mein larr parren to unn kay darmiyan sulah kerao . phir agar unn mein say aik giroh doosray kay sath ziyadti keray to uss giroh say larro jo ziyadti ker raha ho , yahan tak kay woh Allah kay hukum ki taraf loat aaye . chunacheh agar woh loat aaye , to unn kay darmiyan insaf kay sath sulah kerado , aur ( her moamlay mein ) insaf say kaam liya kero , beyshak Allah insaf kernay walon say mohabbat kerta hai .

ayahs.text: haqeeqat to yeh hai kay tamam musalman bhai bhai hain , iss liye apney do bhaiyon kay darmiyan talluqaat achay banao , aur Allah say daro takay tumharay sath rehmat ka moamla kiya jaye .
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat to yeh hai kay tamam musalman bhai bhai hain , iss liye apney do bhaiyon kay darmiyan talluqaat achay banao , aur Allah say daro takay tumharay sath rehmat ka moamla kiya jaye .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! naa to mard doosray mardon ka mazaq urayen , hosakta hai kay woh ( jinn ka mazaq urra rahey hain ) khud inn say behtar hon , aur naa doosri aurten doosri aurton ka mazaq urayen , hosakta hai kay woh ( jinn ka mazaq urra rahi hain ) khud inn say behtar hon . aur tum aik doosray ko taana naa diya kero , aur naa aik doosray ko buray alqaab say pukaro . emaan laney kay baad gunah ka naam lagna boht buri baat hai .   aur jo log inn baaton say baaz naa ayen , to woh zalim log hain .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! naa to mard doosray mardon ka mazaq urayen , hosakta hai kay woh ( jinn ka mazaq urra rahey hain ) khud inn say behtar hon , aur naa doosri aurten doosri aurton ka mazaq urayen , hosakta hai kay woh ( jinn ka mazaq urra rahi hain ) khud inn say behtar hon . aur tum aik doosray ko taana naa diya kero , aur naa aik doosray ko buray alqaab say pukaro . emaan laney kay baad gunah ka naam lagna boht buri baat hai .   aur jo log inn baaton say baaz naa ayen , to woh zalim log hain .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! boht say gumanon say bacho , baaz gumaan gunah hotay hain .   aur kissi ki toh mein naa lago ,   aur aik doosray ki gheebat naa kero .   kiya tum mein say koi yeh pasand keray ga kay woh apney maray huye bhai ka gosht khaye-? iss say to khud tum nafrat kertay ho ! aur Allah say daro . beyshak Allah bara tauba qubool kernay wala , boht meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! boht say gumanon say bacho , baaz gumaan gunah hotay hain .   aur kissi ki toh mein naa lago ,   aur aik doosray ki gheebat naa kero .   kiya tum mein say koi yeh pasand keray ga kay woh apney maray huye bhai ka gosht khaye-? iss say to khud tum nafrat kertay ho ! aur Allah say daro . beyshak Allah bara tauba qubool kernay wala , boht meharban hai .

ayahs.text: aey logo ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney tum sabb ko aik mard aur aik aurat say peda kiya hai , aur tumhen mukhtalif qoamon aur khandano mein iss liye taqseem kiya hai takay tum aik doosray ki pehchan ker-sako .   dar-haqeeqat Allah kay nazdeek tum mein sabb say ziyada izzat wala woh hai jo tum mein sabb say ziyada muttaqi ho . yaqeen rakho kay Allah sabb kuch janney wala , her cheez say ba-khabar hai .
ayahs.translation: aey logo ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney tum sabb ko aik mard aur aik aurat say peda kiya hai , aur tumhen mukhtalif qoamon aur khandano mein iss liye taqseem kiya hai takay tum aik doosray ki pehchan ker-sako .   dar-haqeeqat Allah kay nazdeek tum mein sabb say ziyada izzat wala woh hai jo tum mein sabb say ziyada muttaqi ho . yaqeen rakho kay Allah sabb kuch janney wala , her cheez say ba-khabar hai .

verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: Qaaf , Quran majeed ki qasam ! ( inn kafiron ney payghumber ko kissi daleel ki wajeh say nahi jhutlaya )
verses.translation: Qaaf , Quran majeed ki qasam ! ( inn kafiron ney payghumber ko kissi daleel ki wajeh say nahi jhutlaya )

verses.text: balkay enhon ney iss baat per hayrat ka izhar kiya hai kay koi ( aakhirat say ) daraney wala khud unhi mein say ( kaisay ) aagaya , chunacheh inn kafiron ney yeh kaha hai kay :  yeh to bari ajeeb baat hai ,
verses.translation: balkay enhon ney iss baat per hayrat ka izhar kiya hai kay koi ( aakhirat say ) daraney wala khud unhi mein say ( kaisay ) aagaya , chunacheh inn kafiron ney yeh kaha hai kay :  yeh to bari ajeeb baat hai ,

verses.text: bhala kiya jab hum mar khapp jayen aur mitti hojayen gay , ( uss waqt hamen phir zinda kiya jaye ga-? ) yeh wapsi to humari samajh say door hai .
verses.translation: bhala kiya jab hum mar khapp jayen aur mitti hojayen gay , ( uss waqt hamen phir zinda kiya jaye ga-? ) yeh wapsi to humari samajh say door hai .

verses.text: waqiaa to yeh hai kay zameen inn kay jinn hisson ko ( kha ker ) ghata deti hai , hamen unn ka poora ilm hai ,   aur humaray paas aik kitab hai jo sabb kuch mehfooz rakhti hai .
verses.translation: waqiaa to yeh hai kay zameen inn kay jinn hisson ko ( kha ker ) ghata deti hai , hamen unn ka poora ilm hai ,   aur humaray paas aik kitab hai jo sabb kuch mehfooz rakhti hai .

verses.text: darasal enhon ney sach ko ussi waqt jhutla diya tha jab woh inn kay paas aaya tha , chunacheh woh mutazaad baaton mein parray huye hain .
verses.translation: darasal enhon ney sach ko ussi waqt jhutla diya tha jab woh inn kay paas aaya tha , chunacheh woh mutazaad baaton mein parray huye hain .

verses.text: bhala kiya enhon ney apney oopper aasman ko nahi dekha kay hum ney ussay kaisay banaya hai ? aur hum ney ussay khoobsurti bakhshi hai , aur uss mein kissi qisam kay rakhney nahi hain ,
verses.translation: bhala kiya enhon ney apney oopper aasman ko nahi dekha kay hum ney ussay kaisay banaya hai ? aur hum ney ussay khoobsurti bakhshi hai , aur uss mein kissi qisam kay rakhney nahi hain ,

verses.text: aur zameen hai kay hum ney ussay phela diya hai , aur uss mein paharon kay langar daal diye hain , aur uss mein her tarah ki khushnuma cheezen ugai hain ,
verses.translation: aur zameen hai kay hum ney ussay phela diya hai , aur uss mein paharon kay langar daal diye hain , aur uss mein her tarah ki khushnuma cheezen ugai hain ,

verses.text: takay woh Allah say lo laganey walay her banday kay liye baseerat aur naseehat ka saman ho ,
verses.translation: takay woh Allah say lo laganey walay her banday kay liye baseerat aur naseehat ka saman ho ,

verses.text: aur hum ney aasman say barkaton wala paani utaara , phir uss kay zariye baaghaat aur woh anaj kay daney ugaye jinn ki katai hoti hai ,
verses.translation: aur hum ney aasman say barkaton wala paani utaara , phir uss kay zariye baaghaat aur woh anaj kay daney ugaye jinn ki katai hoti hai ,

verses.text: aur khujoor kay oonchay oonchay darkht jinn mein teh bar teh khoshay hotay hain !
verses.translation: aur khujoor kay oonchay oonchay darkht jinn mein teh bar teh khoshay hotay hain !

verses.text: takay hum bandon ko rizq ata keren , aur ( iss tarah ) hum ney uss paani say aik murda parray huye shehar ko zindagi dey di . bus issi tarah ( insanon ka qabron say ) nikalna bhi hoga .
verses.translation: takay hum bandon ko rizq ata keren , aur ( iss tarah ) hum ney uss paani say aik murda parray huye shehar ko zindagi dey di . bus issi tarah ( insanon ka qabron say ) nikalna bhi hoga .

verses.text: inn say pehlay nooh ki qoam aur ashaab-ur-Rass aur samood kay logon  ney bhi ( iss baat ko ) jhutlaya tha ,
verses.translation: inn say pehlay nooh ki qoam aur ashaab-ur-Rass aur samood kay logon  ney bhi ( iss baat ko ) jhutlaya tha ,

verses.text: neez qoam-e-aad aur qoam-e-firon aur loot kay bhaiyon ney bhi ,
verses.translation: neez qoam-e-aad aur qoam-e-firon aur loot kay bhaiyon ney bhi ,

verses.text: aur ashaab al-aeka aur tabaa qoam ney bhi . inn sabb ney payghumberon ko jhutlaya tha , iss liye mein ney jiss azab say daraya tha , woh sach ho ker raha .
verses.translation: aur ashaab al-aeka aur tabaa qoam ney bhi . inn sabb ney payghumberon ko jhutlaya tha , iss liye mein ney jiss azab say daraya tha , woh sach ho ker raha .

verses.text: bhala kiya hum pehli baar peda kernay say thak gaye thay ?   nahi ! lekin yeh log az sar no peda kernay kay baaray mein dhokay mein parray huye hain .
verses.translation: bhala kiya hum pehli baar peda kernay say thak gaye thay ?   nahi ! lekin yeh log az sar no peda kernay kay baaray mein dhokay mein parray huye hain .

verses.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney insan ko peda kiya hai , aur uss kay dil mein jo khayalaat aatay hain , unn ( tak ) say hum khoob waqif hain , aur hum uss ki sheh rag say bhi ziyada uss kay qareeb hain ,
verses.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney insan ko peda kiya hai , aur uss kay dil mein jo khayalaat aatay hain , unn ( tak ) say hum khoob waqif hain , aur hum uss ki sheh rag say bhi ziyada uss kay qareeb hain ,

verses.text: uss waqt bhi jab ( aemal ko ) likhney walay do farishtay likh rahey hotay hain ,   aik dayen janib aur doosra bayen janib betha hota hai .
verses.translation: uss waqt bhi jab ( aemal ko ) likhney walay do farishtay likh rahey hotay hain ,   aik dayen janib aur doosra bayen janib betha hota hai .

verses.text: insan koi lafz zaban say nikal nahi pata , magar uss per aik nigran muqarrar hota hai , her waqt ( likhney kay liye ) tayyar !
verses.translation: insan koi lafz zaban say nikal nahi pata , magar uss per aik nigran muqarrar hota hai , her waqt ( likhney kay liye ) tayyar !

verses.text: aur moat ki sakhti sach mooch aaney hi wali hai . ( aey insan ! ) yeh woh cheez hai jiss say to bidakta tha .
verses.translation: aur moat ki sakhti sach mooch aaney hi wali hai . ( aey insan ! ) yeh woh cheez hai jiss say to bidakta tha .

verses.text: aur soor phoonka janey wala hai . yeh woh din hoga jiss say daraya jata tha .
verses.translation: aur soor phoonka janey wala hai . yeh woh din hoga jiss say daraya jata tha .

verses.text: aur her shaks iss tarah aaye ga kay uss kay sath aik haankney wala hoga , aur aik gawahi denay wala .
verses.translation: aur her shaks iss tarah aaye ga kay uss kay sath aik haankney wala hoga , aur aik gawahi denay wala .

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay tu uss waqaey ki taraf say ghaflat mein parra huwa tha , abb hum ney tujh say woh perda hata diya hai jo tujh per parra huwa tha , chunacheh aaj teri nigah khoob tez hogaee hai .
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay tu uss waqaey ki taraf say ghaflat mein parra huwa tha , abb hum ney tujh say woh perda hata diya hai jo tujh per parra huwa tha , chunacheh aaj teri nigah khoob tez hogaee hai .

verses.text: aur uss ka sathi kahey ga kay :  yeh hai woh ( aemal nama ) jo meray paas tayyar hai .
verses.translation: aur uss ka sathi kahey ga kay :  yeh hai woh ( aemal nama ) jo meray paas tayyar hai .

verses.text: . ( hukum diya jaye ga kay ) tum dono   her uss shaks ko jahannum mein daal do jo kattar kafir aur haq ka paka dushman tha ,
verses.translation: . ( hukum diya jaye ga kay ) tum dono   her uss shaks ko jahannum mein daal do jo kattar kafir aur haq ka paka dushman tha ,

verses.translation: inn ( jannatiyon ) ko woh sabb kuch milay ga jo wahan woh chahen gay , aur humaray paas kuch aur ziyada bhi hai .

verses.translation: yaqeenan iss mein uss shaks kay liye bari naseehat ka saman hai jiss kay paas dil ho , ya jo hazir dimagh ban ker kaan dahray .

verses.text: aur hum ney saray aasmano aur zameen ko aur unn kay darmiyan ki cheezon ko cheh din mein peda kiya , aur hamen zara si thakawat bhi choo ker nahi guzri .
verses.translation: aur hum ney saray aasmano aur zameen ko aur unn kay darmiyan ki cheezon ko cheh din mein peda kiya , aur hamen zara si thakawat bhi choo ker nahi guzri .

verses.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) jo kuch yeh log keh rahey hain , tum uss per sabar kero , aur apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath tasbeeh kertay raho , sooraj nikalney say pehlay bhi , aur sooraj doobney say pehlay bhi .
verses.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) jo kuch yeh log keh rahey hain , tum uss per sabar kero , aur apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath tasbeeh kertay raho , sooraj nikalney say pehlay bhi , aur sooraj doobney say pehlay bhi .

verses.text: aur raat kay hisson mein bhi uss ki tasbeeh kero ,   aur sajdon kay baad bhi .
verses.translation: aur raat kay hisson mein bhi uss ki tasbeeh kero ,   aur sajdon kay baad bhi .

verses.text: aur zara tawajjah say suno ! jiss din aik pukarney wala aik qareebi jagah say pukaray ga ,
verses.translation: aur zara tawajjah say suno ! jiss din aik pukarney wala aik qareebi jagah say pukaray ga ,

verses.text: jiss din log sach mooch uss pukar ki aawaz sunen gay ,   woh qabron say nikalney ka din hoga .
verses.translation: jiss din log sach mooch uss pukar ki aawaz sunen gay ,   woh qabron say nikalney ka din hoga .

verses.text: yaqeen rakho hum hi hain jo zindagi bhi detay hain , aur moat bhi , aur aakhir kaar sabb ko humaray paas hi loattna hai ,
verses.translation: yaqeen rakho hum hi hain jo zindagi bhi detay hain , aur moat bhi , aur aakhir kaar sabb ko humaray paas hi loattna hai ,

verses.text: uss din jab zameen phatt ker unn ko iss tarah bahir kerday gi kay woh jaldi jaldi nikal rahey hon gay . iss tarah sabb ko jama kerlna humaray liye boht aasaan hai .
verses.translation: uss din jab zameen phatt ker unn ko iss tarah bahir kerday gi kay woh jaldi jaldi nikal rahey hon gay . iss tarah sabb ko jama kerlna humaray liye boht aasaan hai .

verses.text: jo kuch yeh log kehtay hain , hamen khoob maloom hai , aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn per zabardasti kernay walay nahi ho .   lehaza Quran kay zariye her uss shaks ko naseehat kertay raho jo meri waeed say darta ho .
verses.translation: jo kuch yeh log kehtay hain , hamen khoob maloom hai , aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn per zabardasti kernay walay nahi ho .   lehaza Quran kay zariye her uss shaks ko naseehat kertay raho jo meri waeed say darta ho .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: Qaaf , Quran majeed ki qasam ! ( inn kafiron ney payghumber ko kissi daleel ki wajeh say nahi jhutlaya )
ayahs.translation: Qaaf , Quran majeed ki qasam ! ( inn kafiron ney payghumber ko kissi daleel ki wajeh say nahi jhutlaya )

ayahs.text: balkay enhon ney iss baat per hayrat ka izhar kiya hai kay koi ( aakhirat say ) daraney wala khud unhi mein say ( kaisay ) aagaya , chunacheh inn kafiron ney yeh kaha hai kay :  yeh to bari ajeeb baat hai ,
ayahs.translation: balkay enhon ney iss baat per hayrat ka izhar kiya hai kay koi ( aakhirat say ) daraney wala khud unhi mein say ( kaisay ) aagaya , chunacheh inn kafiron ney yeh kaha hai kay :  yeh to bari ajeeb baat hai ,

ayahs.text: bhala kiya jab hum mar khapp jayen aur mitti hojayen gay , ( uss waqt hamen phir zinda kiya jaye ga-? ) yeh wapsi to humari samajh say door hai .
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya jab hum mar khapp jayen aur mitti hojayen gay , ( uss waqt hamen phir zinda kiya jaye ga-? ) yeh wapsi to humari samajh say door hai .

ayahs.text: waqiaa to yeh hai kay zameen inn kay jinn hisson ko ( kha ker ) ghata deti hai , hamen unn ka poora ilm hai ,   aur humaray paas aik kitab hai jo sabb kuch mehfooz rakhti hai .
ayahs.translation: waqiaa to yeh hai kay zameen inn kay jinn hisson ko ( kha ker ) ghata deti hai , hamen unn ka poora ilm hai ,   aur humaray paas aik kitab hai jo sabb kuch mehfooz rakhti hai .

ayahs.text: darasal enhon ney sach ko ussi waqt jhutla diya tha jab woh inn kay paas aaya tha , chunacheh woh mutazaad baaton mein parray huye hain .
ayahs.translation: darasal enhon ney sach ko ussi waqt jhutla diya tha jab woh inn kay paas aaya tha , chunacheh woh mutazaad baaton mein parray huye hain .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya enhon ney apney oopper aasman ko nahi dekha kay hum ney ussay kaisay banaya hai ? aur hum ney ussay khoobsurti bakhshi hai , aur uss mein kissi qisam kay rakhney nahi hain ,
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya enhon ney apney oopper aasman ko nahi dekha kay hum ney ussay kaisay banaya hai ? aur hum ney ussay khoobsurti bakhshi hai , aur uss mein kissi qisam kay rakhney nahi hain ,

ayahs.text: aur zameen hai kay hum ney ussay phela diya hai , aur uss mein paharon kay langar daal diye hain , aur uss mein her tarah ki khushnuma cheezen ugai hain ,
ayahs.translation: aur zameen hai kay hum ney ussay phela diya hai , aur uss mein paharon kay langar daal diye hain , aur uss mein her tarah ki khushnuma cheezen ugai hain ,

ayahs.text: takay woh Allah say lo laganey walay her banday kay liye baseerat aur naseehat ka saman ho ,
ayahs.translation: takay woh Allah say lo laganey walay her banday kay liye baseerat aur naseehat ka saman ho ,

ayahs.text: aur hum ney aasman say barkaton wala paani utaara , phir uss kay zariye baaghaat aur woh anaj kay daney ugaye jinn ki katai hoti hai ,
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney aasman say barkaton wala paani utaara , phir uss kay zariye baaghaat aur woh anaj kay daney ugaye jinn ki katai hoti hai ,

ayahs.text: aur khujoor kay oonchay oonchay darkht jinn mein teh bar teh khoshay hotay hain !
ayahs.translation: aur khujoor kay oonchay oonchay darkht jinn mein teh bar teh khoshay hotay hain !

ayahs.text: takay hum bandon ko rizq ata keren , aur ( iss tarah ) hum ney uss paani say aik murda parray huye shehar ko zindagi dey di . bus issi tarah ( insanon ka qabron say ) nikalna bhi hoga .
ayahs.translation: takay hum bandon ko rizq ata keren , aur ( iss tarah ) hum ney uss paani say aik murda parray huye shehar ko zindagi dey di . bus issi tarah ( insanon ka qabron say ) nikalna bhi hoga .

ayahs.text: inn say pehlay nooh ki qoam aur ashaab-ur-Rass aur samood kay logon  ney bhi ( iss baat ko ) jhutlaya tha ,
ayahs.translation: inn say pehlay nooh ki qoam aur ashaab-ur-Rass aur samood kay logon  ney bhi ( iss baat ko ) jhutlaya tha ,

ayahs.text: neez qoam-e-aad aur qoam-e-firon aur loot kay bhaiyon ney bhi ,
ayahs.translation: neez qoam-e-aad aur qoam-e-firon aur loot kay bhaiyon ney bhi ,

ayahs.text: aur ashaab al-aeka aur tabaa qoam ney bhi . inn sabb ney payghumberon ko jhutlaya tha , iss liye mein ney jiss azab say daraya tha , woh sach ho ker raha .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya hum pehli baar peda kernay say thak gaye thay ?   nahi ! lekin yeh log az sar no peda kernay kay baaray mein dhokay mein parray huye hain .
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya hum pehli baar peda kernay say thak gaye thay ?   nahi ! lekin yeh log az sar no peda kernay kay baaray mein dhokay mein parray huye hain .

verses.translation: kay unn ka perwerdigar unhen jo kuch dey ga , ussay wasool ker rahey hon gay . woh log iss say pehlay hi naik amal kernay walay thay ,

verses.translation: woh raat kay waqt kam sotay thay ,

verses.translation: aur sehri kay oqaat mein woh astaghfaar kertay thay ,

verses.translation: aur unn kay maal o dolat mein saeelon aur mehroom logon  ka ( ba-qaeeda ) haq hota tha .

verses.translation: aur unn kay liye jo yaqeen kernay walay hon , zameen mein boht si nishaniyan hain ,

verses.text: aur khud tumharay apney wajood mein bhi ! kiya phir bhi tumhen dikhai nahi deta-?
verses.translation: aur khud tumharay apney wajood mein bhi ! kiya phir bhi tumhen dikhai nahi deta-?

verses.text: aur aasman hi mein tumhara rizq bhi hai , aur woh cheez bhi jiss ka tum say wada kiya jaraha hai .
verses.translation: aur aasman hi mein tumhara rizq bhi hai , aur woh cheez bhi jiss ka tum say wada kiya jaraha hai .

verses.text: lehaza aasman aur zameen kay perwerdigar ki qasam ! yeh baat yaqeenan aesi hi sachi hai jaisay yeh baat kay tum boltay ho .
verses.translation: lehaza aasman aur zameen kay perwerdigar ki qasam ! yeh baat yaqeenan aesi hi sachi hai jaisay yeh baat kay tum boltay ho .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya Ibrahim kay moaziz mehmano ka waqiaa tumhen phoncha hai ?
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya Ibrahim kay moaziz mehmano ka waqiaa tumhen phoncha hai ?

verses.text: jab woh Ibrahim kay paas aaye , to unhon ney salam kaha . Ibrahim ney bhi salam kaha . ( aur dil mein socha kay ) yeh kuch anjan log hain .
verses.translation: jab woh Ibrahim kay paas aaye , to unhon ney salam kaha . Ibrahim ney bhi salam kaha . ( aur dil mein socha kay ) yeh kuch anjan log hain .

verses.text: phir woh chupkay say apney ghar walon kay paas gaye , aur aik mota saa bachrra ley aaye ,
verses.translation: phir woh chupkay say apney ghar walon kay paas gaye , aur aik mota saa bachrra ley aaye ,

verses.text: aur ussay inn mehmano kay samney rakha . kehney lagay :  kiya aap log khatay nahi-?
verses.translation: aur ussay inn mehmano kay samney rakha . kehney lagay :  kiya aap log khatay nahi-?

verses.text: iss say Ibrahim ney unn ki taraf say apney dil mein darr mehsoos kiya .   unhon ney kaha :  dariye nahi  aur unhen aik larkay ki khushkhabri di jo bara aalim hoga .
verses.translation: iss say Ibrahim ney unn ki taraf say apney dil mein darr mehsoos kiya .   unhon ney kaha :  dariye nahi  aur unhen aik larkay ki khushkhabri di jo bara aalim hoga .

verses.text: iss per unn ki biwi zor say bolti hoi ayen , aur unhon ney apna chehra peet liya , aur kehney lagen :  ( kiya ) aik baanjh burhiya ( baccha janay gi-? )
verses.translation: iss per unn ki biwi zor say bolti hoi ayen , aur unhon ney apna chehra peet liya , aur kehney lagen :  ( kiya ) aik baanjh burhiya ( baccha janay gi-? )

verses.text: mehmano ney kaha :  tumharay perwerdigar ney aisa hi farmaya hai . yaqeen jano wohi hai jo bari hikmat ka , baray ilm ka malik hai .
verses.translation: mehmano ney kaha :  tumharay perwerdigar ney aisa hi farmaya hai . yaqeen jano wohi hai jo bari hikmat ka , baray ilm ka malik hai .

verses.text: Ibrahim ney kaha :  Allah kay bhejay huye farishto ! tum kiss mohim per ho-?
verses.translation: Ibrahim ney kaha :  Allah kay bhejay huye farishto ! tum kiss mohim per ho-?

verses.text: unhon ney kaha :  hamen kuch mujrim logon  kay paas bheja gaya hai ,
verses.translation: unhon ney kaha :  hamen kuch mujrim logon  kay paas bheja gaya hai ,

verses.text: takay hum unn per pakki mitti kay pathar barsayen
verses.translation: takay hum unn per pakki mitti kay pathar barsayen

verses.text: jinn per hadd say guzray huye logon  kay liye tumharay perwerdigar kay paas say khaas nishan bhi laga hoga .
verses.translation: jinn per hadd say guzray huye logon  kay liye tumharay perwerdigar kay paas say khaas nishan bhi laga hoga .

verses.text: phir huwa yeh kay uss basti mein jo koi momin tha , uss ko hum ney wahan say nikal liya ,
verses.translation: phir huwa yeh kay uss basti mein jo koi momin tha , uss ko hum ney wahan say nikal liya ,

verses.text: aur uss mein aik ghar kay siwa hum ney kissi aur ghar ko momin nahi paya ,
verses.translation: aur uss mein aik ghar kay siwa hum ney kissi aur ghar ko momin nahi paya ,

verses.text: aur hum ney uss basti mein unn logon  kay liye ( ibrat ki ) aik nishani chorr di jo dardnak azab say dartay hon .
verses.translation: aur hum ney uss basti mein unn logon  kay liye ( ibrat ki ) aik nishani chorr di jo dardnak azab say dartay hon .

verses.text: aur musa ( kay waqaey ) mein bhi ( hum ney aesi hi nishani chorri thi ) jab hum ney unhen aik khuli hoi daleel kay sath firon kay paas bheja tha ,
verses.translation: aur musa ( kay waqaey ) mein bhi ( hum ney aesi hi nishani chorri thi ) jab hum ney unhen aik khuli hoi daleel kay sath firon kay paas bheja tha ,

verses.text: to firon ney apni quooat-e-bazoo kay ball per mun morra , aur kaha kay :  yeh jadoogar hai , ya deewana hai .
verses.translation: to firon ney apni quooat-e-bazoo kay ball per mun morra , aur kaha kay :  yeh jadoogar hai , ya deewana hai .

verses.text: chunacheh hum ney ussay aur uss kay lashkar ko pakra aur sabb ko samandar mein phenk diya , aur woh tha hi malamat kay laeeq !
verses.translation: chunacheh hum ney ussay aur uss kay lashkar ko pakra aur sabb ko samandar mein phenk diya , aur woh tha hi malamat kay laeeq !

verses.text: neez qoam-e-aad mein ( bhi hum ney aesi hi nishani chorri thi ) jab hum ney unn per aik aesi aandhi bheji jo her behtari say baanjh di ,
verses.translation: neez qoam-e-aad mein ( bhi hum ney aesi hi nishani chorri thi ) jab hum ney unn per aik aesi aandhi bheji jo her behtari say baanjh di ,

verses.text: woh jiss cheez per bhi guzarti , ussay aisa ker chorti jaisay woh gal ker choora choora hogaee ho .
verses.translation: woh jiss cheez per bhi guzarti , ussay aisa ker chorti jaisay woh gal ker choora choora hogaee ho .

verses.text: aur samood mein bhi ( aesi hi nishani thi ) , jab unn say kaha gaya tha kay :  thoray waqt tak mazay urra lo .  ( phir seedhay naa huye to azab aaye ga )
verses.translation: aur samood mein bhi ( aesi hi nishani thi ) , jab unn say kaha gaya tha kay :  thoray waqt tak mazay urra lo .  ( phir seedhay naa huye to azab aaye ga )

verses.text: iss per bhi unhon ney apney perwerdigar ka hukum manney say sarkashi ikhtiyar ki to unhen karrkay ney aa-pakra , aur woh dekhtay reh gaye .
verses.translation: iss per bhi unhon ney apney perwerdigar ka hukum manney say sarkashi ikhtiyar ki to unhen karrkay ney aa-pakra , aur woh dekhtay reh gaye .

verses.text: nateeja yeh kay naa to unn mein yeh sakat rahi kay kharray hosaken , aur naa woh iss qabil thay kay apna bachao kertay .
verses.translation: nateeja yeh kay naa to unn mein yeh sakat rahi kay kharray hosaken , aur naa woh iss qabil thay kay apna bachao kertay .

verses.text: aur iss say bhi pehlay nooh ki qoam ko bhi hum ney pakar mein liya tha .   yaqeen jano woh baray nafarman log thay .
verses.translation: aur iss say bhi pehlay nooh ki qoam ko bhi hum ney pakar mein liya tha .   yaqeen jano woh baray nafarman log thay .

verses.text: aur aasman ko hum ney quooat say banaya hai , aur hum yaqeenan wusat peda kerney walay hain .
verses.translation: aur aasman ko hum ney quooat say banaya hai , aur hum yaqeenan wusat peda kerney walay hain .

verses.text: aur zameen ko hum ney farsh banaya hai , chunacheh hum kiya khoob bichaney walay hain !
verses.translation: aur zameen ko hum ney farsh banaya hai , chunacheh hum kiya khoob bichaney walay hain !

verses.text: aur her cheez kay hum ney jooray peda kiye hain ,   takay tum naseehat hasil kero .
verses.translation: aur her cheez kay hum ney jooray peda kiye hain ,   takay tum naseehat hasil kero .

verses.text: lehaza dorro Allah ki taraf .   yaqeen jano , mein uss ki taraf say tumharay liye saaf saaf khabrdar kernay wala ( ban ker aaya ) hun .
verses.translation: lehaza dorro Allah ki taraf .   yaqeen jano , mein uss ki taraf say tumharay liye saaf saaf khabrdar kernay wala ( ban ker aaya ) hun .

verses.text: aur Allah kay sath koi aur mabood naa banao . yaqeen jano mein uss ki taraf say tumharay liye saaf saaf khabrdar kernay wala ( ban ker aaya ) hun .
verses.translation: aur Allah kay sath koi aur mabood naa banao . yaqeen jano mein uss ki taraf say tumharay liye saaf saaf khabrdar kernay wala ( ban ker aaya ) hun .

verses.text: issi tarah inn say pehlay jo log thay , unn kay paas bhi koi payghumber aisa nahi aaya jiss kay baaray mein unhon ney yeh naa kaha ho kay :  jadoogar hai , ya deewana hai .
verses.translation: issi tarah inn say pehlay jo log thay , unn kay paas bhi koi payghumber aisa nahi aaya jiss kay baaray mein unhon ney yeh naa kaha ho kay :  jadoogar hai , ya deewana hai .

verses.text: kiya yeh aik doosray ko iss baat ki wasiyyat kertay chalay aaye hain-? nahi , balkay yeh sarkash log hain .
verses.translation: kiya yeh aik doosray ko iss baat ki wasiyyat kertay chalay aaye hain-? nahi , balkay yeh sarkash log hain .

verses.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn say bey rukhi ikhtiyar kero , kiyonkay tum qabil-e-malamat nahi ho .
verses.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn say bey rukhi ikhtiyar kero , kiyonkay tum qabil-e-malamat nahi ho .

verses.text: aur naseehat kertay raho , kiyonkay naseehat emaan laney walon ko faeeda deti hai .
verses.translation: aur naseehat kertay raho , kiyonkay naseehat emaan laney walon ko faeeda deti hai .

verses.text: aur mein ney jinnaat aur insanon ko iss kay siwa kissi aur kaam kay liye peda nahi kiya kay woh meri ibadat keren .
verses.translation: aur mein ney jinnaat aur insanon ko iss kay siwa kissi aur kaam kay liye peda nahi kiya kay woh meri ibadat keren .

verses.text: mein unn say kissi qisam ka rizq nahi chahta , aur naa yeh chahta hun kay woh mujhay khilayen .
verses.translation: mein unn say kissi qisam ka rizq nahi chahta , aur naa yeh chahta hun kay woh mujhay khilayen .

verses.text: Allah to khud hi razzaq hai , mustehkam quooat wala !
verses.translation: Allah to khud hi razzaq hai , mustehkam quooat wala !

verses.text: abb to jinn logon  ney zulm kiya hai , unn ki bhi aesi hi baari aaye gi jaisay unn kay ( pichlay ) sathiyon ki baari aai thi , iss liye woh mujh say jaldi ( azab laney ) ka mutalba naa keren .

ayahs.translation: jinn per hadd say guzray huye logon  kay liye tumharay perwerdigar kay paas say khaas nishan bhi laga hoga .

ayahs.text: phir huwa yeh kay uss basti mein jo koi momin tha , uss ko hum ney wahan say nikal liya ,
ayahs.translation: phir huwa yeh kay uss basti mein jo koi momin tha , uss ko hum ney wahan say nikal liya ,

ayahs.text: aur uss mein aik ghar kay siwa hum ney kissi aur ghar ko momin nahi paya ,
ayahs.translation: aur uss mein aik ghar kay siwa hum ney kissi aur ghar ko momin nahi paya ,

ayahs.text: aur hum ney uss basti mein unn logon  kay liye ( ibrat ki ) aik nishani chorr di jo dardnak azab say dartay hon .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney uss basti mein unn logon  kay liye ( ibrat ki ) aik nishani chorr di jo dardnak azab say dartay hon .

ayahs.text: aur musa ( kay waqaey ) mein bhi ( hum ney aesi hi nishani chorri thi ) jab hum ney unhen aik khuli hoi daleel kay sath firon kay paas bheja tha ,
ayahs.translation: aur musa ( kay waqaey ) mein bhi ( hum ney aesi hi nishani chorri thi ) jab hum ney unhen aik khuli hoi daleel kay sath firon kay paas bheja tha ,

ayahs.text: to firon ney apni quooat-e-bazoo kay ball per mun morra , aur kaha kay :  yeh jadoogar hai , ya deewana hai .
ayahs.translation: to firon ney apni quooat-e-bazoo kay ball per mun morra , aur kaha kay :  yeh jadoogar hai , ya deewana hai .

ayahs.text: chunacheh hum ney ussay aur uss kay lashkar ko pakra aur sabb ko samandar mein phenk diya , aur woh tha hi malamat kay laeeq !
ayahs.translation: chunacheh hum ney ussay aur uss kay lashkar ko pakra aur sabb ko samandar mein phenk diya , aur woh tha hi malamat kay laeeq !

ayahs.text: neez qoam-e-aad mein ( bhi hum ney aesi hi nishani chorri thi ) jab hum ney unn per aik aesi aandhi bheji jo her behtari say baanjh di ,
ayahs.translation: neez qoam-e-aad mein ( bhi hum ney aesi hi nishani chorri thi ) jab hum ney unn per aik aesi aandhi bheji jo her behtari say baanjh di ,

ayahs.text: woh jiss cheez per bhi guzarti , ussay aisa ker chorti jaisay woh gal ker choora choora hogaee ho .
ayahs.translation: woh jiss cheez per bhi guzarti , ussay aisa ker chorti jaisay woh gal ker choora choora hogaee ho .

ayahs.text: aur samood mein bhi ( aesi hi nishani thi ) , jab unn say kaha gaya tha kay :  thoray waqt tak mazay urra lo .  ( phir seedhay naa huye to azab aaye ga )

ayahs.text: iss per bhi unhon ney apney perwerdigar ka hukum manney say sarkashi ikhtiyar ki to unhen karrkay ney aa-pakra , aur woh dekhtay reh gaye .
ayahs.translation: iss per bhi unhon ney apney perwerdigar ka hukum manney say sarkashi ikhtiyar ki to unhen karrkay ney aa-pakra , aur woh dekhtay reh gaye .

ayahs.text: nateeja yeh kay naa to unn mein yeh sakat rahi kay kharray hosaken , aur naa woh iss qabil thay kay apna bachao kertay .
ayahs.translation: nateeja yeh kay naa to unn mein yeh sakat rahi kay kharray hosaken , aur naa woh iss qabil thay kay apna bachao kertay .

ayahs.text: aur iss say bhi pehlay nooh ki qoam ko bhi hum ney pakar mein liya tha .   yaqeen jano woh baray nafarman log thay .
ayahs.translation: aur iss say bhi pehlay nooh ki qoam ko bhi hum ney pakar mein liya tha .   yaqeen jano woh baray nafarman log thay .

ayahs.text: aur aasman ko hum ney quooat say banaya hai , aur hum yaqeenan wusat peda kerney walay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur aasman ko hum ney quooat say banaya hai , aur hum yaqeenan wusat peda kerney walay hain .

ayahs.text: aur zameen ko hum ney farsh banaya hai , chunacheh hum kiya khoob bichaney walay hain !
ayahs.translation: aur zameen ko hum ney farsh banaya hai , chunacheh hum kiya khoob bichaney walay hain !

ayahs.text: aur her cheez kay hum ney jooray peda kiye hain ,   takay tum naseehat hasil kero .
ayahs.translation: aur her cheez kay hum ney jooray peda kiye hain ,   takay tum naseehat hasil kero .

ayahs.text: lehaza dorro Allah ki taraf .   yaqeen jano , mein uss ki taraf say tumharay liye saaf saaf khabrdar kernay wala ( ban ker aaya ) hun .
ayahs.translation: lehaza dorro Allah ki taraf .   yaqeen jano , mein uss ki taraf say tumharay liye saaf saaf khabrdar kernay wala ( ban ker aaya ) hun .

ayahs.text: aur Allah kay sath koi aur mabood naa banao . yaqeen jano mein uss ki taraf say tumharay liye saaf saaf khabrdar kernay wala ( ban ker aaya ) hun .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah kay sath koi aur mabood naa banao . yaqeen jano mein uss ki taraf say tumharay liye saaf saaf khabrdar kernay wala ( ban ker aaya ) hun .

ayahs.text: issi tarah inn say pehlay jo log thay , unn kay paas bhi koi payghumber aisa nahi aaya jiss kay baaray mein unhon ney yeh naa kaha ho kay :  jadoogar hai , ya deewana hai .

ayahs.translation: kiya yeh aik doosray ko iss baat ki wasiyyat kertay chalay aaye hain-? nahi , balkay yeh sarkash log hain .

ayahs.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn say bey rukhi ikhtiyar kero , kiyonkay tum qabil-e-malamat nahi ho .

ayahs.text: aur naseehat kertay raho , kiyonkay naseehat emaan laney walon ko faeeda deti hai .
ayahs.translation: aur naseehat kertay raho , kiyonkay naseehat emaan laney walon ko faeeda deti hai .

ayahs.text: aur mein ney jinnaat aur insanon ko iss kay siwa kissi aur kaam kay liye peda nahi kiya kay woh meri ibadat keren .
ayahs.translation: aur mein ney jinnaat aur insanon ko iss kay siwa kissi aur kaam kay liye peda nahi kiya kay woh meri ibadat keren .

ayahs.text: mein unn say kissi qisam ka rizq nahi chahta , aur naa yeh chahta hun kay woh mujhay khilayen .
ayahs.translation: mein unn say kissi qisam ka rizq nahi chahta , aur naa yeh chahta hun kay woh mujhay khilayen .

ayahs.text: Allah to khud hi razzaq hai , mustehkam quooat wala !
ayahs.translation: Allah to khud hi razzaq hai , mustehkam quooat wala !

verses.translation: dakhil hojao iss mein ! phir tum sabar kero , ya naa kero , tumharay liye barabar hai . tumhen unhi kamon ka badla diya jaye ga jo tum kiya kertay thay .

verses.translation: muttaqi log beyshak baaghon aur naimaton mein hon gay ,

verses.text: unn kay perwerdigar ney unhen jiss tarah nawaza aur unn kay perwerdigar hi ney unhen dozakh kay azab say jiss tarah bachaya , uss ka lutf utha rahey hon gay .
verses.translation: unn kay perwerdigar ney unhen jiss tarah nawaza aur unn kay perwerdigar hi ney unhen dozakh kay azab say jiss tarah bachaya , uss ka lutf utha rahey hon gay .

verses.translation: . ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  khoob mazay say khao piyo , unn aemal kay silay mein jo tum kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: woh aik qetar mein lagi hoi oonchi nishiston per takiya lagaye huye hon gay , aur hum bari bari aankhon wali huroon say unn ka biyah kerden gay .
verses.translation: woh aik qetar mein lagi hoi oonchi nishiston per takiya lagaye huye hon gay , aur hum bari bari aankhon wali huroon say unn ka biyah kerden gay .

verses.text: aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur unn ki aulad ney bhi emaan mein unn ki perwi ki hai , to unn ki aulad ko hum unhi kay sath shamil kerden gay , aur unn kay amal mein say kissi cheez ki kami nahi keren gay .   her insan ki jaan apni kamai kay badlay rehan rakhi hoi hai .
verses.translation: aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur unn ki aulad ney bhi emaan mein unn ki perwi ki hai , to unn ki aulad ko hum unhi kay sath shamil kerden gay , aur unn kay amal mein say kissi cheez ki kami nahi keren gay .   her insan ki jaan apni kamai kay badlay rehan rakhi hoi hai .

verses.text: aur hum unhen aik kay baad aik phal aur gosht , jo bhi unn ka dil chahye ga , diye chalay jayen gay .
verses.translation: aur hum unhen aik kay baad aik phal aur gosht , jo bhi unn ka dil chahye ga , diye chalay jayen gay .

verses.text: wahan woh aesay jaam sharab per ( dostana ) cheena jhapti ker rahey hon gay jiss mein naa koi beyhoodgi hogi , aur naa koi gunah hoga .
verses.translation: wahan woh aesay jaam sharab per ( dostana ) cheena jhapti ker rahey hon gay jiss mein naa koi beyhoodgi hogi , aur naa koi gunah hoga .

verses.text: aur unn kay ird-gird woh nojawan phir rahey hon gay jo unhi ( ki khidmat ) kay liye makhsoos hon gay , aesay ( khoobsurat ) jaisay chupa ker rakhay huye moti !
verses.translation: aur unn kay ird-gird woh nojawan phir rahey hon gay jo unhi ( ki khidmat ) kay liye makhsoos hon gay , aesay ( khoobsurat ) jaisay chupa ker rakhay huye moti !

verses.text: aur woh aik doosray ki taraf mutawajjah ho ker halaat poochen gay ,
verses.translation: aur woh aik doosray ki taraf mutawajjah ho ker halaat poochen gay ,

verses.text: kahen gay kay :  hum pehlay jab apney ghar walon ( yani duniya ) mein thay to daray sehmay rehtay thay ,
verses.translation: kahen gay kay :  hum pehlay jab apney ghar walon ( yani duniya ) mein thay to daray sehmay rehtay thay ,

verses.text: aakhir Allah ney hum per bara ehsan farmaya , aur hamen jhulsaney wali hawa kay azab say bacha liya .
verses.translation: aakhir Allah ney hum per bara ehsan farmaya , aur hamen jhulsaney wali hawa kay azab say bacha liya .

verses.text: hum iss say pehlay uss say duayen maanga kertay thay . haqeeqat yeh hai kay wohi hai jo bara mohsin , boht meharban hai .
verses.translation: hum iss say pehlay uss say duayen maanga kertay thay . haqeeqat yeh hai kay wohi hai jo bara mohsin , boht meharban hai .

verses.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum naseehat kertay raho , kiyonkay tum apney perwerdigar kay fazal say naa kahin ho , naa majnoon .
verses.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum naseehat kertay raho , kiyonkay tum apney perwerdigar kay fazal say naa kahin ho , naa majnoon .

verses.text: bhala kiya yeh log yun kehtay hain kay :  yeh sahab shaeer hain jinn kay baaray mein hum zamaney ki gardish ka intizar ker rahey hain-?
verses.translation: bhala kiya yeh log yun kehtay hain kay :  yeh sahab shaeer hain jinn kay baaray mein hum zamaney ki gardish ka intizar ker rahey hain-?

verses.text: keh do kay :  kerlo intizar ! mein bhi tumharay sath intizar ker-raha hun .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  kerlo intizar ! mein bhi tumharay sath intizar ker-raha hun .

verses.text: kiya inn ki aqlen inn ko yehi kuch kernay ko kehti hain , ya woh hain hi sarkash log-?
verses.translation: kiya inn ki aqlen inn ko yehi kuch kernay ko kehti hain , ya woh hain hi sarkash log-?

verses.text: haan kiya woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  inn sahab ney yeh ( Quran ) khud gharr liya hai ?  nahi ! balkay yeh ( zidd mein ) emaan nahi laarahey .
verses.translation: haan kiya woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  inn sahab ney yeh ( Quran ) khud gharr liya hai ?  nahi ! balkay yeh ( zidd mein ) emaan nahi laarahey .

verses.text: agar yeh waqaee sachay hain to iss jaisa koi kalam ( gharr ker ) ley ayen .
verses.translation: agar yeh waqaee sachay hain to iss jaisa koi kalam ( gharr ker ) ley ayen .

verses.text: kiya yeh log baghair kissi kay aap say aap peda hogaye , ya yeh khud ( apney ) khaliq hain-?
verses.translation: kiya yeh log baghair kissi kay aap say aap peda hogaye , ya yeh khud ( apney ) khaliq hain-?

verses.text: ya kiya aasman aur zameen enhon ney peda kiye hain-? nahi ! balkay asal baat yeh hai kay yeh yaqeen nahi rakhtay .
verses.translation: ya kiya aasman aur zameen enhon ney peda kiye hain-? nahi ! balkay asal baat yeh hai kay yeh yaqeen nahi rakhtay .

verses.translation: kiya tumharay perwerdigar kay khazaney inn kay paas hain , ya woh darogha banay huye hain-?

verses.text: ya inn kay pass koi seerhi hai jiss per charh ker yeh ( aalam-e-baala ki baaten ) sunn letay hain . agar aisa hai to inn mein say jo sunta ho , woh koi wazeh saboot to laye .

verses.text: kiya Allah kay hissay mein to betiyan hain , aur betay tumharay hissay mein aaye hain-?
verses.translation: kiya Allah kay hissay mein to betiyan hain , aur betay tumharay hissay mein aaye hain-?

verses.text: aur kiya tum inn say koi ujrat maang rahey ho jiss ki wajeh say yeh tawaan kay bojh mein dabay jarahey hain-?

verses.text: kiya yeh koi makar kerna chahtay hain-? to dar-haqeeqat jo kafir hain , makar to unhi per parray ga .
verses.translation: kiya yeh koi makar kerna chahtay hain-? to dar-haqeeqat jo kafir hain , makar to unhi per parray ga .

verses.text: kiya Allah kay siwa inn ka koi aur khuda hai-? pak hai Allah uss shirk say jo yeh ker rahey hain !

verses.text: aur agar yeh aasman ka koi tukrra girtay huye bhi dekh len to yeh kahen gay kay yeh koi gehra badal hai .
