ayahs.translation: bhala kiya yeh jadoo hai ya tumhen ( abb bhi ) kuch nazar nahi aaraha-?

ayahs.text: dakhil hojao iss mein ! phir tum sabar kero , ya naa kero , tumharay liye barabar hai . tumhen unhi kamon ka badla diya jaye ga jo tum kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: dakhil hojao iss mein ! phir tum sabar kero , ya naa kero , tumharay liye barabar hai . tumhen unhi kamon ka badla diya jaye ga jo tum kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: muttaqi log beyshak baaghon aur naimaton mein hon gay ,
ayahs.translation: muttaqi log beyshak baaghon aur naimaton mein hon gay ,

ayahs.text: unn kay perwerdigar ney unhen jiss tarah nawaza aur unn kay perwerdigar hi ney unhen dozakh kay azab say jiss tarah bachaya , uss ka lutf utha rahey hon gay .
ayahs.translation: unn kay perwerdigar ney unhen jiss tarah nawaza aur unn kay perwerdigar hi ney unhen dozakh kay azab say jiss tarah bachaya , uss ka lutf utha rahey hon gay .

ayahs.text: . ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  khoob mazay say khao piyo , unn aemal kay silay mein jo tum kiya kertay thay .
ayahs.translation: . ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  khoob mazay say khao piyo , unn aemal kay silay mein jo tum kiya kertay thay .

ayahs.text: woh aik qetar mein lagi hoi oonchi nishiston per takiya lagaye huye hon gay , aur hum bari bari aankhon wali huroon say unn ka biyah kerden gay .
ayahs.translation: woh aik qetar mein lagi hoi oonchi nishiston per takiya lagaye huye hon gay , aur hum bari bari aankhon wali huroon say unn ka biyah kerden gay .

ayahs.text: aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur unn ki aulad ney bhi emaan mein unn ki perwi ki hai , to unn ki aulad ko hum unhi kay sath shamil kerden gay , aur unn kay amal mein say kissi cheez ki kami nahi keren gay .   her insan ki jaan apni kamai kay badlay rehan rakhi hoi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur unn ki aulad ney bhi emaan mein unn ki perwi ki hai , to unn ki aulad ko hum unhi kay sath shamil kerden gay , aur unn kay amal mein say kissi cheez ki kami nahi keren gay .   her insan ki jaan apni kamai kay badlay rehan rakhi hoi hai .

ayahs.text: aur hum unhen aik kay baad aik phal aur gosht , jo bhi unn ka dil chahye ga , diye chalay jayen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur hum unhen aik kay baad aik phal aur gosht , jo bhi unn ka dil chahye ga , diye chalay jayen gay .

ayahs.text: wahan woh aesay jaam sharab per ( dostana ) cheena jhapti ker rahey hon gay jiss mein naa koi beyhoodgi hogi , aur naa koi gunah hoga .
ayahs.translation: wahan woh aesay jaam sharab per ( dostana ) cheena jhapti ker rahey hon gay jiss mein naa koi beyhoodgi hogi , aur naa koi gunah hoga .

ayahs.text: aur unn kay ird-gird woh nojawan phir rahey hon gay jo unhi ( ki khidmat ) kay liye makhsoos hon gay , aesay ( khoobsurat ) jaisay chupa ker rakhay huye moti !
ayahs.translation: aur unn kay ird-gird woh nojawan phir rahey hon gay jo unhi ( ki khidmat ) kay liye makhsoos hon gay , aesay ( khoobsurat ) jaisay chupa ker rakhay huye moti !

ayahs.text: aur woh aik doosray ki taraf mutawajjah ho ker halaat poochen gay ,
ayahs.translation: aur woh aik doosray ki taraf mutawajjah ho ker halaat poochen gay ,

ayahs.text: kahen gay kay :  hum pehlay jab apney ghar walon ( yani duniya ) mein thay to daray sehmay rehtay thay ,
ayahs.translation: kahen gay kay :  hum pehlay jab apney ghar walon ( yani duniya ) mein thay to daray sehmay rehtay thay ,

ayahs.text: aakhir Allah ney hum per bara ehsan farmaya , aur hamen jhulsaney wali hawa kay azab say bacha liya .
ayahs.translation: aakhir Allah ney hum per bara ehsan farmaya , aur hamen jhulsaney wali hawa kay azab say bacha liya .

ayahs.text: hum iss say pehlay uss say duayen maanga kertay thay . haqeeqat yeh hai kay wohi hai jo bara mohsin , boht meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: hum iss say pehlay uss say duayen maanga kertay thay . haqeeqat yeh hai kay wohi hai jo bara mohsin , boht meharban hai .

ayahs.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum naseehat kertay raho , kiyonkay tum apney perwerdigar kay fazal say naa kahin ho , naa majnoon .
ayahs.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum naseehat kertay raho , kiyonkay tum apney perwerdigar kay fazal say naa kahin ho , naa majnoon .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya yeh log yun kehtay hain kay :  yeh sahab shaeer hain jinn kay baaray mein hum zamaney ki gardish ka intizar ker rahey hain-?
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya yeh log yun kehtay hain kay :  yeh sahab shaeer hain jinn kay baaray mein hum zamaney ki gardish ka intizar ker rahey hain-?

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  kerlo intizar ! mein bhi tumharay sath intizar ker-raha hun .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  kerlo intizar ! mein bhi tumharay sath intizar ker-raha hun .

ayahs.text: kiya inn ki aqlen inn ko yehi kuch kernay ko kehti hain , ya woh hain hi sarkash log-?
ayahs.translation: kiya inn ki aqlen inn ko yehi kuch kernay ko kehti hain , ya woh hain hi sarkash log-?

ayahs.text: haan kiya woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  inn sahab ney yeh ( Quran ) khud gharr liya hai ?  nahi ! balkay yeh ( zidd mein ) emaan nahi laarahey .
ayahs.translation: haan kiya woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  inn sahab ney yeh ( Quran ) khud gharr liya hai ?  nahi ! balkay yeh ( zidd mein ) emaan nahi laarahey .

ayahs.text: agar yeh waqaee sachay hain to iss jaisa koi kalam ( gharr ker ) ley ayen .
ayahs.translation: agar yeh waqaee sachay hain to iss jaisa koi kalam ( gharr ker ) ley ayen .

ayahs.text: kiya yeh log baghair kissi kay aap say aap peda hogaye , ya yeh khud ( apney ) khaliq hain-?
ayahs.translation: kiya yeh log baghair kissi kay aap say aap peda hogaye , ya yeh khud ( apney ) khaliq hain-?

ayahs.text: ya kiya aasman aur zameen enhon ney peda kiye hain-? nahi ! balkay asal baat yeh hai kay yeh yaqeen nahi rakhtay .
ayahs.translation: ya kiya aasman aur zameen enhon ney peda kiye hain-? nahi ! balkay asal baat yeh hai kay yeh yaqeen nahi rakhtay .

ayahs.text: kiya tumharay perwerdigar kay khazaney inn kay paas hain , ya woh darogha banay huye hain-?
ayahs.translation: kiya tumharay perwerdigar kay khazaney inn kay paas hain , ya woh darogha banay huye hain-?

ayahs.text: ya inn kay pass koi seerhi hai jiss per charh ker yeh ( aalam-e-baala ki baaten ) sunn letay hain . agar aisa hai to inn mein say jo sunta ho , woh koi wazeh saboot to laye .
ayahs.translation: ya inn kay pass koi seerhi hai jiss per charh ker yeh ( aalam-e-baala ki baaten ) sunn letay hain . agar aisa hai to inn mein say jo sunta ho , woh koi wazeh saboot to laye .

ayahs.text: kiya Allah kay hissay mein to betiyan hain , aur betay tumharay hissay mein aaye hain-?
ayahs.translation: kiya Allah kay hissay mein to betiyan hain , aur betay tumharay hissay mein aaye hain-?

ayahs.text: aur kiya tum inn say koi ujrat maang rahey ho jiss ki wajeh say yeh tawaan kay bojh mein dabay jarahey hain-?
ayahs.translation: aur kiya tum inn say koi ujrat maang rahey ho jiss ki wajeh say yeh tawaan kay bojh mein dabay jarahey hain-?

ayahs.text: ya inn kay paas ghaib ka ilm hai jissay yeh likh letay hon-?
ayahs.translation: ya inn kay paas ghaib ka ilm hai jissay yeh likh letay hon-?

ayahs.text: kiya yeh koi makar kerna chahtay hain-? to dar-haqeeqat jo kafir hain , makar to unhi per parray ga .
ayahs.translation: kiya yeh koi makar kerna chahtay hain-? to dar-haqeeqat jo kafir hain , makar to unhi per parray ga .

ayahs.text: kiya Allah kay siwa inn ka koi aur khuda hai-? pak hai Allah uss shirk say jo yeh ker rahey hain !
ayahs.translation: kiya Allah kay siwa inn ka koi aur khuda hai-? pak hai Allah uss shirk say jo yeh ker rahey hain !

ayahs.text: aur agar yeh aasman ka koi tukrra girtay huye bhi dekh len to yeh kahen gay kay yeh koi gehra badal hai .
ayahs.translation: aur agar yeh aasman ka koi tukrra girtay huye bhi dekh len to yeh kahen gay kay yeh koi gehra badal hai .

ayahs.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum enhen ( inn kay haal per ) chorr do , yahan tak kay yeh apney uss din say jaa milen jiss mein inn kay hosh jatay rahen gay ,
ayahs.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum enhen ( inn kay haal per ) chorr do , yahan tak kay yeh apney uss din say jaa milen jiss mein inn kay hosh jatay rahen gay ,

ayahs.text: jiss din inn ki makkaari inn kay kuch kaam nahi aaye gi , aur naa enhen koi madad mil sakay gi .
ayahs.translation: jiss din inn ki makkaari inn kay kuch kaam nahi aaye gi , aur naa enhen koi madad mil sakay gi .

ayahs.text: aur iss say pehlay bhi inn zalimon kay liye aik azab hai ,   lekin inn mein say aksar logon  ko pata nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: aur iss say pehlay bhi inn zalimon kay liye aik azab hai ,   lekin inn mein say aksar logon  ko pata nahi hai .

ayahs.text: aur tum apney perwerdigar kay hukum per jamay raho , kiyonkay tum humari nigahon mein ho ,   aur jab tum uthtay ho , uss waqt apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh kiya kero ,
ayahs.translation: aur tum apney perwerdigar kay hukum per jamay raho , kiyonkay tum humari nigahon mein ho ,   aur jab tum uthtay ho , uss waqt apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh kiya kero ,

ayahs.text: aur kuch raat ko bhi uss ki tasbeeh kero , aur uss waqt bhi jab sitaray doobtay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur kuch raat ko bhi uss ki tasbeeh kero , aur uss waqt bhi jab sitaray doobtay hain .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: qasam hai sitaray ki jab woh giray ,
verses.translation: qasam hai sitaray ki jab woh giray ,

verses.text: . ( aey makkay kay bashindo ! ) yeh tumharay sath rehney walay sahab naa raasta bhoolay hain , naa bhatkay hain ,
verses.translation: . ( aey makkay kay bashindo ! ) yeh tumharay sath rehney walay sahab naa raasta bhoolay hain , naa bhatkay hain ,

verses.text: aur yeh apni khuwaish say kuch nahi boltay ,
verses.translation: aur yeh apni khuwaish say kuch nahi boltay ,

verses.text: yeh to khalis wahi hai jo inn kay paas bheji jati hai ,
verses.translation: yeh to khalis wahi hai jo inn kay paas bheji jati hai ,

verses.text: enhen aik aesay mazboot taqat walay ( farishtay ) ney taleem di hai
verses.translation: enhen aik aesay mazboot taqat walay ( farishtay ) ney taleem di hai

verses.text: jo quooat ka hamil hai .   chunacheh woh samney aagaya ,
verses.translation: jo quooat ka hamil hai .   chunacheh woh samney aagaya ,

verses.text: jabkay woh buland ufaq per tha .
verses.translation: jabkay woh buland ufaq per tha .

verses.text: phir woh qareeb aaya , aur jhuk parra ,
verses.translation: phir woh qareeb aaya , aur jhuk parra ,

verses.text: yahan tak kay woh do kamanon  kay faslay kay barabar qareeb aagaya ,   balkay uss say bhi ziyada nazdeek .
verses.translation: yahan tak kay woh do kamanon  kay faslay kay barabar qareeb aagaya ,   balkay uss say bhi ziyada nazdeek .

verses.text: iss tarah Allah ko apney banday per jo wahi nazil farmani thi , woh nazil farmaee .
verses.translation: iss tarah Allah ko apney banday per jo wahi nazil farmani thi , woh nazil farmaee .

verses.text: jo kuch unhon ney dekha , dil ney uss mein koi ghalati nahi ki .
verses.translation: jo kuch unhon ney dekha , dil ney uss mein koi ghalati nahi ki .

verses.text: kiya phir bhi tum unn say uss cheez kay baaray mein jhagarrtay ho jissay woh dekhtay hain-?
verses.translation: kiya phir bhi tum unn say uss cheez kay baaray mein jhagarrtay ho jissay woh dekhtay hain-?

verses.text: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay unhon ney uss ( farishtay ) ko aik aur martaba dekha hai ,
verses.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay unhon ney uss ( farishtay ) ko aik aur martaba dekha hai ,

verses.text: uss bair kay darkht kay paas jiss ka naam sidra-tul-muntaha hai ,
verses.translation: uss bair kay darkht kay paas jiss ka naam sidra-tul-muntaha hai ,

verses.text: ussi kay paas jannat-ul-Maawa hai .
verses.translation: ussi kay paas jannat-ul-Maawa hai .

verses.text: uss waqt uss bair kay darkht per woh cheezen chai hoi then jo bhi uss per chai hoi then .
verses.translation: uss waqt uss bair kay darkht per woh cheezen chai hoi then jo bhi uss per chai hoi then .

verses.text: . ( payghumber ki ) aankh naa to chakrai , aur naa hadd say aagay barhi .
verses.translation: . ( payghumber ki ) aankh naa to chakrai , aur naa hadd say aagay barhi .

verses.text: sach to yeh hai kay unhon ney apney perwerdigar ki bari bari nishaniyon mein say boht kuch dekha .
verses.translation: sach to yeh hai kay unhon ney apney perwerdigar ki bari bari nishaniyon mein say boht kuch dekha .

verses.text: bhala kiya tum ney laat aur uzza ( ki haqeeqat ) per bhi ghor kiya hai-?
verses.translation: bhala kiya tum ney laat aur uzza ( ki haqeeqat ) per bhi ghor kiya hai-?

verses.text: aur uss aik aur teesray per jiss ka naam manaat hai-?
verses.translation: aur uss aik aur teesray per jiss ka naam manaat hai-?

verses.text: kiya tumharay liye to betay hon , aur Allah kay liye betiyan-?
verses.translation: kiya tumharay liye to betay hon , aur Allah kay liye betiyan-?

verses.text: phir to yeh bari bhondi taqseem hoi !
verses.translation: phir to yeh bari bhondi taqseem hoi !

verses.text: unn ki haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch nahi hai kay yeh kuch naam hain jo tum ney aur tumharay baap dadon ney rakh liye hain , Allah ney unn kay haq mein koi saboot nazil nahi kiya . dar-haqeeqat yeh ( kafir ) log mehaz weham o gumaan aur nafsani khuwaishaat kay peechay chal rahey hain , halankay inn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say inn kay paas hidayat aa-chuki hai .
verses.translation: unn ki haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch nahi hai kay yeh kuch naam hain jo tum ney aur tumharay baap dadon ney rakh liye hain , Allah ney unn kay haq mein koi saboot nazil nahi kiya . dar-haqeeqat yeh ( kafir ) log mehaz weham o gumaan aur nafsani khuwaishaat kay peechay chal rahey hain , halankay inn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say inn kay paas hidayat aa-chuki hai .

verses.text: kiya insan ko her uss cheez ka haq phonchta hai jiss ki woh tamanna keray-?
verses.translation: kiya insan ko her uss cheez ka haq phonchta hai jiss ki woh tamanna keray-?

verses.text: . ( nahi ! ) kiyonkay aakhirat aur duniya to tamam tarr Allah hi kay ikhtiyar mein hain .
verses.translation: . ( nahi ! ) kiyonkay aakhirat aur duniya to tamam tarr Allah hi kay ikhtiyar mein hain .

verses.text: aur aasmano mein kitney hi farishtay hain jinn ki sifarish kissi kay kuch bhi kaam nahi aa-sakti , albatta iss kay baad hi kaam aa-sakti hai kay Allah jiss kay liye chahye ijazat deydey , aur uss per razi hojaye .
verses.translation: aur aasmano mein kitney hi farishtay hain jinn ki sifarish kissi kay kuch bhi kaam nahi aa-sakti , albatta iss kay baad hi kaam aa-sakti hai kay Allah jiss kay liye chahye ijazat deydey , aur uss per razi hojaye .

verses.text: jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , woh farishton ko zananey naamon say yaad kertay hain ,
verses.translation: jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , woh farishton ko zananey naamon say yaad kertay hain ,

verses.text: halankay unhen iss baat ka zara bhi ilm nahi hai . woh mehaz weham o gumaan kay peechay chal rahey hain , aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay weham o gumaan haq kay moamlay mein bilkul kaar aamad nahi .
verses.translation: halankay unhen iss baat ka zara bhi ilm nahi hai . woh mehaz weham o gumaan kay peechay chal rahey hain , aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay weham o gumaan haq kay moamlay mein bilkul kaar aamad nahi .

verses.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum aesay aadmi ki fiker naa kero jiss ney humari naseehat hidayat say mun morr liya hai , aur dunyawi zindagi kay siwa woh kuch aur chahta hi nahi .
verses.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum aesay aadmi ki fiker naa kero jiss ney humari naseehat hidayat say mun morr liya hai , aur dunyawi zindagi kay siwa woh kuch aur chahta hi nahi .

verses.text: aesay logon  kay ilm ki phonch bus yahin tak hai .   tumhara perwerdigar hi khoob janta hai kay kon uss kay raastay say bhatak chuka hai , aur wohi khoob janta hai kon raah paagaya hai .
verses.translation: aesay logon  kay ilm ki phonch bus yahin tak hai .   tumhara perwerdigar hi khoob janta hai kay kon uss kay raastay say bhatak chuka hai , aur wohi khoob janta hai kon raah paagaya hai .

verses.text: aur aasmano mein jo kuch hai , woh bhi aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , woh bhi Allah hi ka hai . nateeja yeh hai kay jinhon ney buray kaam kiye hain , woh unn ko unn kay amal ka bhi badla dey ga , aur jinhon ney naik kaam kiye hain , unn ko behtareen badla ata keray ga .
verses.translation: aur aasmano mein jo kuch hai , woh bhi aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , woh bhi Allah hi ka hai . nateeja yeh hai kay jinhon ney buray kaam kiye hain , woh unn ko unn kay amal ka bhi badla dey ga , aur jinhon ney naik kaam kiye hain , unn ko behtareen badla ata keray ga .

verses.text: unn logon  ko jo baray baray gunahon aur bey hayai kay kamon say bachtay hain , albatta kabhi kabhar phisal janey ki baat aur hai .   yaqeen rakho tumhara perwerdigar boht wasee maghfirat wala hai , woh tumhen khoob janta hai jab uss ney tumhen zameen say peda kiya , aur jab tum apni maon kay pet mein bacchay thay , lehaza tum apney aap ko pakeezah naa thehrao . woh khoob janta hai kay kon muttaqi hai .
verses.translation: unn logon  ko jo baray baray gunahon aur bey hayai kay kamon say bachtay hain , albatta kabhi kabhar phisal janey ki baat aur hai .   yaqeen rakho tumhara perwerdigar boht wasee maghfirat wala hai , woh tumhen khoob janta hai jab uss ney tumhen zameen say peda kiya , aur jab tum apni maon kay pet mein bacchay thay , lehaza tum apney aap ko pakeezah naa thehrao . woh khoob janta hai kay kon muttaqi hai .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) bhala tum ney uss shaks ko bhi dekha jo ( haq say ) mun morr gaya ,
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) bhala tum ney uss shaks ko bhi dekha jo ( haq say ) mun morr gaya ,

verses.text: aur jiss ney thora saa diya , phir ruk gaya-?
verses.translation: aur jiss ney thora saa diya , phir ruk gaya-?

verses.text: kiya uss kay paas ghaib ka ilm hai jo woh dekh raha ho-?
verses.translation: kiya uss kay paas ghaib ka ilm hai jo woh dekh raha ho-?

verses.text: kiya ussay unn baaton ki khabar nahi mili jo musa kay saheefon mein darj hai ,
verses.translation: kiya ussay unn baaton ki khabar nahi mili jo musa kay saheefon mein darj hai ,

verses.text: aur Ibrahim kay saheefon mein bhi , jo mukammal wafadaar rahey-?
verses.translation: aur Ibrahim kay saheefon mein bhi , jo mukammal wafadaar rahey-?

verses.text: yani yeh kay koi bojh uthaney wala kissi doosray ( kay gunah ) ka bojh nahi utha sakta ,
verses.translation: yani yeh kay koi bojh uthaney wala kissi doosray ( kay gunah ) ka bojh nahi utha sakta ,

verses.text: aur yeh kay insan ko khud apni koshish kay siwa kissi aur cheez ka ( badla lenay ka ) haq nahi phonchta ,
verses.translation: aur yeh kay insan ko khud apni koshish kay siwa kissi aur cheez ka ( badla lenay ka ) haq nahi phonchta ,

verses.text: aur yeh kay uss ki koshish unqareeb dekhi jaye gi ,
verses.translation: aur yeh kay uss ki koshish unqareeb dekhi jaye gi ,

verses.text: phir uss ka badla ussay poora poora diya jaye ga .
verses.translation: phir uss ka badla ussay poora poora diya jaye ga .

verses.text: aur yeh kay aakhir kaar ( sabb ko ) tumharay perwerdigar hi kay paas phonchna hai ,
verses.translation: aur yeh kay aakhir kaar ( sabb ko ) tumharay perwerdigar hi kay paas phonchna hai ,

verses.text: aur yeh kay wohi hai jo hansata aur rulata hai ,
verses.translation: aur yeh kay wohi hai jo hansata aur rulata hai ,

verses.text: aur yeh kay wohi hai jo moat bhi deta hai , aur zindagi bhi ,
verses.translation: aur yeh kay wohi hai jo moat bhi deta hai , aur zindagi bhi ,

verses.text: aur yeh kay ussi ney nar aur mada kay do jooray peda kiye hain
verses.translation: aur yeh kay ussi ney nar aur mada kay do jooray peda kiye hain

verses.text: . ( woh bhi sirf ) aik boond say jab woh tapkai jati hai ,
verses.translation: . ( woh bhi sirf ) aik boond say jab woh tapkai jati hai ,

verses.text: aur yeh kay doosri zindagi denay ka bhi ussi ney zimma liya hai ,
verses.translation: aur yeh kay doosri zindagi denay ka bhi ussi ney zimma liya hai ,

verses.text: aur yeh kay wohi hai jo maal daar banata aur dolat ko mehfooz kerata hai ,
verses.translation: aur yeh kay wohi hai jo maal daar banata aur dolat ko mehfooz kerata hai ,

verses.translation: to kiya tum issi baat per hayrat kertay ho-?

verses.translation: aur ( uss ka mazaq bana ker ) hanstay ho , aur rotay nahi ho ,

ayahs.translation: qasam hai sitaray ki jab woh giray ,

ayahs.translation: . ( aey makkay kay bashindo ! ) yeh tumharay sath rehney walay sahab naa raasta bhoolay hain , naa bhatkay hain ,

ayahs.text: aur yeh apni khuwaish say kuch nahi boltay ,
ayahs.translation: aur yeh apni khuwaish say kuch nahi boltay ,

ayahs.translation: yeh to khalis wahi hai jo inn kay paas bheji jati hai ,

ayahs.translation: enhen aik aesay mazboot taqat walay ( farishtay ) ney taleem di hai

ayahs.translation: jo quooat ka hamil hai .   chunacheh woh samney aagaya ,

ayahs.translation: jabkay woh buland ufaq per tha .

ayahs.translation: phir woh qareeb aaya , aur jhuk parra ,

ayahs.translation: yahan tak kay woh do kamanon  kay faslay kay barabar qareeb aagaya ,   balkay uss say bhi ziyada nazdeek .

ayahs.translation: iss tarah Allah ko apney banday per jo wahi nazil farmani thi , woh nazil farmaee .

ayahs.text: jo kuch unhon ney dekha , dil ney uss mein koi ghalati nahi ki .
ayahs.translation: jo kuch unhon ney dekha , dil ney uss mein koi ghalati nahi ki .

ayahs.translation: kiya phir bhi tum unn say uss cheez kay baaray mein jhagarrtay ho jissay woh dekhtay hain-?

ayahs.translation: aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay unhon ney uss ( farishtay ) ko aik aur martaba dekha hai ,

ayahs.translation: uss bair kay darkht kay paas jiss ka naam sidra-tul-muntaha hai ,

ayahs.text: ussi kay paas jannat-ul-Maawa hai .
ayahs.translation: ussi kay paas jannat-ul-Maawa hai .

ayahs.translation: uss waqt uss bair kay darkht per woh cheezen chai hoi then jo bhi uss per chai hoi then .

ayahs.text: . ( payghumber ki ) aankh naa to chakrai , aur naa hadd say aagay barhi .
ayahs.translation: . ( payghumber ki ) aankh naa to chakrai , aur naa hadd say aagay barhi .

ayahs.text: sach to yeh hai kay unhon ney apney perwerdigar ki bari bari nishaniyon mein say boht kuch dekha .
ayahs.translation: sach to yeh hai kay unhon ney apney perwerdigar ki bari bari nishaniyon mein say boht kuch dekha .

ayahs.text: bhala kiya tum ney laat aur uzza ( ki haqeeqat ) per bhi ghor kiya hai-?
ayahs.translation: bhala kiya tum ney laat aur uzza ( ki haqeeqat ) per bhi ghor kiya hai-?

ayahs.text: aur uss aik aur teesray per jiss ka naam manaat hai-?
ayahs.translation: aur uss aik aur teesray per jiss ka naam manaat hai-?

ayahs.text: kiya tumharay liye to betay hon , aur Allah kay liye betiyan-?
ayahs.translation: kiya tumharay liye to betay hon , aur Allah kay liye betiyan-?

ayahs.text: phir to yeh bari bhondi taqseem hoi !
ayahs.translation: phir to yeh bari bhondi taqseem hoi !

ayahs.text: unn ki haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch nahi hai kay yeh kuch naam hain jo tum ney aur tumharay baap dadon ney rakh liye hain , Allah ney unn kay haq mein koi saboot nazil nahi kiya . dar-haqeeqat yeh ( kafir ) log mehaz weham o gumaan aur nafsani khuwaishaat kay peechay chal rahey hain , halankay inn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say inn kay paas hidayat aa-chuki hai .
ayahs.translation: unn ki haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch nahi hai kay yeh kuch naam hain jo tum ney aur tumharay baap dadon ney rakh liye hain , Allah ney unn kay haq mein koi saboot nazil nahi kiya . dar-haqeeqat yeh ( kafir ) log mehaz weham o gumaan aur nafsani khuwaishaat kay peechay chal rahey hain , halankay inn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say inn kay paas hidayat aa-chuki hai .

ayahs.text: kiya insan ko her uss cheez ka haq phonchta hai jiss ki woh tamanna keray-?
ayahs.translation: kiya insan ko her uss cheez ka haq phonchta hai jiss ki woh tamanna keray-?

ayahs.text: . ( nahi ! ) kiyonkay aakhirat aur duniya to tamam tarr Allah hi kay ikhtiyar mein hain .
ayahs.translation: . ( nahi ! ) kiyonkay aakhirat aur duniya to tamam tarr Allah hi kay ikhtiyar mein hain .

ayahs.text: aur aasmano mein kitney hi farishtay hain jinn ki sifarish kissi kay kuch bhi kaam nahi aa-sakti , albatta iss kay baad hi kaam aa-sakti hai kay Allah jiss kay liye chahye ijazat deydey , aur uss per razi hojaye .
ayahs.translation: aur aasmano mein kitney hi farishtay hain jinn ki sifarish kissi kay kuch bhi kaam nahi aa-sakti , albatta iss kay baad hi kaam aa-sakti hai kay Allah jiss kay liye chahye ijazat deydey , aur uss per razi hojaye .

ayahs.text: jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , woh farishton ko zananey naamon say yaad kertay hain ,
ayahs.translation: jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , woh farishton ko zananey naamon say yaad kertay hain ,

ayahs.text: halankay unhen iss baat ka zara bhi ilm nahi hai . woh mehaz weham o gumaan kay peechay chal rahey hain , aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay weham o gumaan haq kay moamlay mein bilkul kaar aamad nahi .
ayahs.translation: halankay unhen iss baat ka zara bhi ilm nahi hai . woh mehaz weham o gumaan kay peechay chal rahey hain , aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay weham o gumaan haq kay moamlay mein bilkul kaar aamad nahi .

ayahs.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum aesay aadmi ki fiker naa kero jiss ney humari naseehat hidayat say mun morr liya hai , aur dunyawi zindagi kay siwa woh kuch aur chahta hi nahi .
ayahs.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum aesay aadmi ki fiker naa kero jiss ney humari naseehat hidayat say mun morr liya hai , aur dunyawi zindagi kay siwa woh kuch aur chahta hi nahi .

ayahs.text: aesay logon  kay ilm ki phonch bus yahin tak hai .   tumhara perwerdigar hi khoob janta hai kay kon uss kay raastay say bhatak chuka hai , aur wohi khoob janta hai kon raah paagaya hai .
ayahs.translation: aesay logon  kay ilm ki phonch bus yahin tak hai .   tumhara perwerdigar hi khoob janta hai kay kon uss kay raastay say bhatak chuka hai , aur wohi khoob janta hai kon raah paagaya hai .

ayahs.text: aur aasmano mein jo kuch hai , woh bhi aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , woh bhi Allah hi ka hai . nateeja yeh hai kay jinhon ney buray kaam kiye hain , woh unn ko unn kay amal ka bhi badla dey ga , aur jinhon ney naik kaam kiye hain , unn ko behtareen badla ata keray ga .
ayahs.translation: aur aasmano mein jo kuch hai , woh bhi aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , woh bhi Allah hi ka hai . nateeja yeh hai kay jinhon ney buray kaam kiye hain , woh unn ko unn kay amal ka bhi badla dey ga , aur jinhon ney naik kaam kiye hain , unn ko behtareen badla ata keray ga .

ayahs.text: unn logon  ko jo baray baray gunahon aur bey hayai kay kamon say bachtay hain , albatta kabhi kabhar phisal janey ki baat aur hai .   yaqeen rakho tumhara perwerdigar boht wasee maghfirat wala hai , woh tumhen khoob janta hai jab uss ney tumhen zameen say peda kiya , aur jab tum apni maon kay pet mein bacchay thay , lehaza tum apney aap ko pakeezah naa thehrao . woh khoob janta hai kay kon muttaqi hai .

ayahs.translation: iss ko wohi log chootay hain jo khoob pak hain ,

ayahs.text: yeh tamam jahano kay perwerdigar ki taraf say thora thora ker kay utaara jaraha hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh tamam jahano kay perwerdigar ki taraf say thora thora ker kay utaara jaraha hai .

ayahs.text: kiya phir bhi tum iss kalam say bey perwai barattay ho-?
ayahs.translation: kiya phir bhi tum iss kalam say bey perwai barattay ho-?

ayahs.text: aur tum ney issi ko apna rozgar bana liya hai kay ( iss ko ) jhutlatay raho-?
ayahs.translation: aur tum ney issi ko apna rozgar bana liya hai kay ( iss ko ) jhutlatay raho-?

ayahs.text: phir aisa kiyon nahi hota hai kay jab ( kissi ki ) jaan galay tak phonch jati hai ,
ayahs.translation: phir aisa kiyon nahi hota hai kay jab ( kissi ki ) jaan galay tak phonch jati hai ,

ayahs.text: aur uss waqt tum ( hasrat say uss ko ) dekh rahey hotay ho ,
ayahs.translation: aur uss waqt tum ( hasrat say uss ko ) dekh rahey hotay ho ,

ayahs.text: . aur tum say ziyada hum uss kay qareeb hotay hain , magar tumhen nazar nahi aata
ayahs.translation: . aur tum say ziyada hum uss kay qareeb hotay hain , magar tumhen nazar nahi aata

ayahs.text: agar tumhara hisab kitab honey wala nahi hai to aisa kiyon nahi hota
ayahs.translation: agar tumhara hisab kitab honey wala nahi hai to aisa kiyon nahi hota

ayahs.text: kay tum uss jaan ko wapis ley aao , agar tum sachay ho-?
ayahs.translation: kay tum uss jaan ko wapis ley aao , agar tum sachay ho-?

ayahs.text: phir agar woh ( marney wala ) Allah kay muqarrab bandon mein say ho
ayahs.translation: phir agar woh ( marney wala ) Allah kay muqarrab bandon mein say ho

ayahs.text: to ( uss kay liye ) aaram hi aaram hai , khushboo hi khushboo hai , aur naimaton say bhara baagh hai .
ayahs.translation: to ( uss kay liye ) aaram hi aaram hai , khushboo hi khushboo hai , aur naimaton say bhara baagh hai .

ayahs.text: aur agar woh dayen haath walon mein say ho
ayahs.translation: aur agar woh dayen haath walon mein say ho

ayahs.text: to ( uss say kaha jaye ga kay : )  tumharay liye salamti hi salamti hai kay tum dayen haath walon mein say ho .
ayahs.translation: to ( uss say kaha jaye ga kay : )  tumharay liye salamti hi salamti hai kay tum dayen haath walon mein say ho .

ayahs.text: aur agar woh unn gumrahon mein say ho jo haq ko jhutlaney walay thay
ayahs.translation: aur agar woh unn gumrahon mein say ho jo haq ko jhutlaney walay thay

ayahs.text: to ( uss kay liye ) kholtay huye paani ki mehmani hai ,
ayahs.translation: to ( uss kay liye ) kholtay huye paani ki mehmani hai ,

ayahs.text: aur dozakh ka dakhila hai !
ayahs.translation: aur dozakh ka dakhila hai !

ayahs.text: uss mein koi shak nahi kay bilkul sahih maani mein yehi yaqeeni baat hai .
ayahs.translation: uss mein koi shak nahi kay bilkul sahih maani mein yehi yaqeeni baat hai .

ayahs.text: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum apney azeem perwerdigar ka naam ley ker uss ki tasbeeh kero .
ayahs.translation: lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum apney azeem perwerdigar ka naam ley ker uss ki tasbeeh kero .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: aasmano aur zameen mein jo cheez bhi hai , woh Allah ki tasbeeh kerti hai ,   aur wohi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
verses.translation: aasmano aur zameen mein jo cheez bhi hai , woh Allah ki tasbeeh kerti hai ,   aur wohi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

verses.text: aasmano aur zameen ki badshahat ussi ki hai , wohi zindagi bakhshta aur moat deta hai , aur woh her cheez per poori qudrat rakhney wala hai .
verses.translation: aasmano aur zameen ki badshahat ussi ki hai , wohi zindagi bakhshta aur moat deta hai , aur woh her cheez per poori qudrat rakhney wala hai .

verses.text: wohi awwal bhi hai , aur aakhir bhi , zahir bhi hai, aur chupa huwa bhi ,   aur woh her cheez ko poori tarah janney wala hai .
verses.translation: wohi awwal bhi hai , aur aakhir bhi , zahir bhi hai, aur chupa huwa bhi ,   aur woh her cheez ko poori tarah janney wala hai .

verses.text: wohi hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko cheh din mein peda kiya , phir arsh per istawa farmaya .   woh her uss cheez ko janta hai jo zameen mein dakhil hoti hai , aur jo uss say nikalti hai , aur her uss cheez ko jo aasman say utarti hai , aur jo uss mein charrhti hai , aur tum jahan kahen ho , woh tumharay sath hai . aur jo kaam bhi tum kertay ho , Allah uss ko dekhta hai .
verses.translation: wohi hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko cheh din mein peda kiya , phir arsh per istawa farmaya .   woh her uss cheez ko janta hai jo zameen mein dakhil hoti hai , aur jo uss say nikalti hai , aur her uss cheez ko jo aasman say utarti hai , aur jo uss mein charrhti hai , aur tum jahan kahen ho , woh tumharay sath hai . aur jo kaam bhi tum kertay ho , Allah uss ko dekhta hai .

verses.text: aasmano aur zameen ki badshahat ussi ki hai , aur tamam moamlaat Allah hi ki taraf lotaye jatay hain .
verses.translation: aasmano aur zameen ki badshahat ussi ki hai , aur tamam moamlaat Allah hi ki taraf lotaye jatay hain .

verses.text: woh raat ko din mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur din ko raat mein dakhil ker deta hai ,   aur woh seenon mein chupi hoi baaton ko khoob janta hai .
verses.translation: woh raat ko din mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur din ko raat mein dakhil ker deta hai ,   aur woh seenon mein chupi hoi baaton ko khoob janta hai .

verses.text: Allah aur uss kay Rasool per emaan rakho , aur jiss ( maal ) mein Allah ney tumhen qaeem maqam banaya hai ,   uss mein say ( Allah kay raastay mein ) kharch kero . chunacheh tum mein say jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney ( Allah kay raastay mein ) kharch kiya hai , unn kay liye bara ajar hai .
verses.translation: Allah aur uss kay Rasool per emaan rakho , aur jiss ( maal ) mein Allah ney tumhen qaeem maqam banaya hai ,   uss mein say ( Allah kay raastay mein ) kharch kero . chunacheh tum mein say jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney ( Allah kay raastay mein ) kharch kiya hai , unn kay liye bara ajar hai .

verses.text: aur tumharay liye konsi wajeh hai kay tum Allah per emaan naa rakho , halankay Rasool tumhen dawat dey rahey hain kay tum apney perwerdigar per emaan rakho , aur woh tum say ehad ley chukay hain , agar tum waqaee momin ho .
verses.translation: aur tumharay liye konsi wajeh hai kay tum Allah per emaan naa rakho , halankay Rasool tumhen dawat dey rahey hain kay tum apney perwerdigar per emaan rakho , aur woh tum say ehad ley chukay hain , agar tum waqaee momin ho .

verses.text: Allah wohi to hai jo apney banday per khuli khuli aayaten nazil farmata hai , takay tumhen andheriyon say nikal ker roshni mein laye . aur yaqeen jano Allah tum per boht shafiq , boht meharban hai .
verses.translation: Allah wohi to hai jo apney banday per khuli khuli aayaten nazil farmata hai , takay tumhen andheriyon say nikal ker roshni mein laye . aur yaqeen jano Allah tum per boht shafiq , boht meharban hai .

verses.text: aur tumharay liye konsi wajeh hai kay tum Allah kay raastay mein kharch naa kero , halankay aasmano aur zameen ki sari meeras Allah hi kay liye hai . tum mein say jinhon ney ( makkah ki ) fatah say pehlay kharch kiya , aur larraee larri , woh ( baad walon kay ) barabar nahi hain . woh darjay mein unn logon  say barhay huye hain jinhon ney ( fatah makkah kay ) baad kharch kiya , aur larraee larri .   yun Allah ney bhalai ka wada unn sabb say ker rakha hai , aur tum jo kuch kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: aur tumharay liye konsi wajeh hai kay tum Allah kay raastay mein kharch naa kero , halankay aasmano aur zameen ki sari meeras Allah hi kay liye hai . tum mein say jinhon ney ( makkah ki ) fatah say pehlay kharch kiya , aur larraee larri , woh ( baad walon kay ) barabar nahi hain . woh darjay mein unn logon  say barhay huye hain jinhon ney ( fatah makkah kay ) baad kharch kiya , aur larraee larri .   yun Allah ney bhalai ka wada unn sabb say ker rakha hai , aur tum jo kuch kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: kon hai jo Allah ko qarz dey-? acha qarz !   jiss kay nateejay mein Allah ussay denay walay kay liye kaee guna barha dey-? aur aesay shaks ko bara ba-izzat ajar milay ga
verses.translation: kon hai jo Allah ko qarz dey-? acha qarz !   jiss kay nateejay mein Allah ussay denay walay kay liye kaee guna barha dey-? aur aesay shaks ko bara ba-izzat ajar milay ga

verses.text: uss din jab tum momin mardon aur momin aurton ko dekho gay kay unn ka noor unn kay samney aur unn kay dayen janib dorr raha hoga ,   ( aur unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  aaj tumhen khushkhabri hai unn baaghaat ki jinn kay neechay nehren behti hain , jinn mein tum hamesha hamesha raho gay . yehi hai jo bari zabardast kamiyabi hai .
verses.translation: uss din jab tum momin mardon aur momin aurton ko dekho gay kay unn ka noor unn kay samney aur unn kay dayen janib dorr raha hoga ,   ( aur unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  aaj tumhen khushkhabri hai unn baaghaat ki jinn kay neechay nehren behti hain , jinn mein tum hamesha hamesha raho gay . yehi hai jo bari zabardast kamiyabi hai .

verses.text: uss din jab munafiq mard aur munafiq aurten emaan walon say kahen gay kay :  zara humara intizar kerlo kay tumharay noor say hum bhi kuch roshni hasil kerlen .    unn say kaha jaye ga kay :  tum apney peechay loat jao , phir noor talash kero .    phir unn kay darmiyan aik deewar haeel kerdi jaye gi jiss mein aik darwaza hoga jiss kay andar ki taraf rehmat hogi , aur bahir ki taraf azab hoga .
verses.translation: uss din jab munafiq mard aur munafiq aurten emaan walon say kahen gay kay :  zara humara intizar kerlo kay tumharay noor say hum bhi kuch roshni hasil kerlen .    unn say kaha jaye ga kay :  tum apney peechay loat jao , phir noor talash kero .    phir unn kay darmiyan aik deewar haeel kerdi jaye gi jiss mein aik darwaza hoga jiss kay andar ki taraf rehmat hogi , aur bahir ki taraf azab hoga .

verses.text: woh mominon ko pukaren gay kay :  kiya hum tumharay sath nahi thay-?  momin kahen gay kay :  haan ! thay to sahi , lekin tum ney khud apney aap ko fitney mein daal liya , aur intizar mein rahey ,   shak mein parray rahey , aur jhooti aarzoon ney tumhen dhokay mein daalay rakha ,   yahan tak kay Allah ka hukum aagaya , aur woh bara dhokay baaz ( yani shetan ) tumhen Allah kay baaray mein dhoka hi deta raha .
verses.translation: woh mominon ko pukaren gay kay :  kiya hum tumharay sath nahi thay-?  momin kahen gay kay :  haan ! thay to sahi , lekin tum ney khud apney aap ko fitney mein daal liya , aur intizar mein rahey ,   shak mein parray rahey , aur jhooti aarzoon ney tumhen dhokay mein daalay rakha ,   yahan tak kay Allah ka hukum aagaya , aur woh bara dhokay baaz ( yani shetan ) tumhen Allah kay baaray mein dhoka hi deta raha .

verses.text: chunacheh aaj naa tum say koi fidya qubool kiya jaye ga , aur naa unn logon  say jinhon ney ( khulay bandon ) kufr ikhtiyar kiya tha . tumhara thikana dozakh hai , wohi tumhari rakhwali hai , aur yeh boht bura anjam hai .
verses.translation: chunacheh aaj naa tum say koi fidya qubool kiya jaye ga , aur naa unn logon  say jinhon ney ( khulay bandon ) kufr ikhtiyar kiya tha . tumhara thikana dozakh hai , wohi tumhari rakhwali hai , aur yeh boht bura anjam hai .

verses.text: jo log emaan ley aaye hain , kiya unn kay liye abb bhi waqt nahi aaya kay unn kay dil Allah kay ziker kay liye aur jo haq utra hai , uss kay liye paseej jayen-? aur woh unn logon  ki tarah naa banen jinn ko pehlay kitab di gaee thi , phir unn per aik lambi mauddat guzar gaee , aur unn kay dil sakht hogaye , aur ( aaj ) unn mein say boht say nafarman hain-?
verses.translation: jo log emaan ley aaye hain , kiya unn kay liye abb bhi waqt nahi aaya kay unn kay dil Allah kay ziker kay liye aur jo haq utra hai , uss kay liye paseej jayen-? aur woh unn logon  ki tarah naa banen jinn ko pehlay kitab di gaee thi , phir unn per aik lambi mauddat guzar gaee , aur unn kay dil sakht hogaye , aur ( aaj ) unn mein say boht say nafarman hain-?

verses.text: khoob samajh lo kay Allah zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad zindagi bakhshta hai .   hum ney tumharay liye nishaniyan khol khol ker wazeh kerdi hain , takay tum samajh say kaam lo .
verses.translation: khoob samajh lo kay Allah zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad zindagi bakhshta hai .   hum ney tumharay liye nishaniyan khol khol ker wazeh kerdi hain , takay tum samajh say kaam lo .

verses.text: yaqeenan woh jo sadqa denay walay mard aur sadqa denay wali aurten hain aur unhon ney Allah ko qarz diya hai , acha qarz unn kay liye uss ( sadqay ) ko kaee guna barha diya jaye ga , aur unn kay liye ba-izzat ajar hai .
verses.translation: yaqeenan woh jo sadqa denay walay mard aur sadqa denay wali aurten hain aur unhon ney Allah ko qarz diya hai , acha qarz unn kay liye uss ( sadqay ) ko kaee guna barha diya jaye ga , aur unn kay liye ba-izzat ajar hai .

verses.text: aur jo log Allah per aur uss kay Rasoolon per emaan laye hain , wohi apney rab kay nazdeek siddiq aur shaheed hain .   unn kay liye unn ka ajar aur unn ka noor hai . aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya , aur humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya , woh dozakhi log hain .
verses.translation: aur jo log Allah per aur uss kay Rasoolon per emaan laye hain , wohi apney rab kay nazdeek siddiq aur shaheed hain .   unn kay liye unn ka ajar aur unn ka noor hai . aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya , aur humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya , woh dozakhi log hain .

verses.text: khoob samajh lo kay iss duniya wali zindagi ki haqeeqat bus yeh hai kay woh naam hai khel kood ka , zahiri sajawat ka , tumharay aik doosray per fakhar jataney ka , aur maal aur aulad mein aik doosray say barhney ki koshish kernay ka .   iss ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik barish jiss say ugney wali cheezen kisano ko boht achi lagti hain , phir woh apna zor dikhati hai , phir tum uss ko dekhtay ho kay zard parr-gai hai , phir woh choora choora hojati hai . aur aakhirat mein ( aik toh ) sakht azab hai , aur ( doosray ) Allah ki taraf say bakhshish hai , aur khushnoodi aur duniya wali zindagi dhokay kay saman kay siwa kuch bhi nahi hai .
verses.translation: khoob samajh lo kay iss duniya wali zindagi ki haqeeqat bus yeh hai kay woh naam hai khel kood ka , zahiri sajawat ka , tumharay aik doosray per fakhar jataney ka , aur maal aur aulad mein aik doosray say barhney ki koshish kernay ka .   iss ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik barish jiss say ugney wali cheezen kisano ko boht achi lagti hain , phir woh apna zor dikhati hai , phir tum uss ko dekhtay ho kay zard parr-gai hai , phir woh choora choora hojati hai . aur aakhirat mein ( aik toh ) sakht azab hai , aur ( doosray ) Allah ki taraf say bakhshish hai , aur khushnoodi aur duniya wali zindagi dhokay kay saman kay siwa kuch bhi nahi hai .

verses.text: aik doosray say aagay barhney ki koshish karo apney perwerdigar ki bakhshish ki taraf aur uss jannat ki taraf jiss ki chorai sare aasmano aur zameen ki chorai jaisi hai , yeh unn logon  kay liye tayyar ki gaee hai jo Allah aur uss kay Rasoolon per emaan laye hain . yeh Allah ka fazal hai jo woh jiss ko chahta hai deta hai . aur Allah baray fazal wala hai .
verses.translation: aik doosray say aagay barhney ki koshish karo apney perwerdigar ki bakhshish ki taraf aur uss jannat ki taraf jiss ki chorai sare aasmano aur zameen ki chorai jaisi hai , yeh unn logon  kay liye tayyar ki gaee hai jo Allah aur uss kay Rasoolon per emaan laye hain . yeh Allah ka fazal hai jo woh jiss ko chahta hai deta hai . aur Allah baray fazal wala hai .

verses.text: koi museebat aesi nahi hai jo zameen mein nazil hoti ya tumhari janon ko laahaq hoti ho , magar woh aik kitab mein uss waqt say darj hai jab hum ney inn janon ko peda bhi nahi kiya tha .   yaqeen jano yeh baat Allah kay liye boht aasaan hai .
verses.translation: koi museebat aesi nahi hai jo zameen mein nazil hoti ya tumhari janon ko laahaq hoti ho , magar woh aik kitab mein uss waqt say darj hai jab hum ney inn janon ko peda bhi nahi kiya tha .   yaqeen jano yeh baat Allah kay liye boht aasaan hai .

verses.text: yeh iss liye takay jo cheez tum say jati rahey , uss per tum ghum mein naa parro , aur jo cheez Allah tumhen ata farmadey , uss per tum itrao nahi ,   aur Allah kissi aesay shaks ko pasand nahi kerta jo itrahat mein mubtala ho , shekhi bgharney wala ho ,
verses.translation: yeh iss liye takay jo cheez tum say jati rahey , uss per tum ghum mein naa parro , aur jo cheez Allah tumhen ata farmadey , uss per tum itrao nahi ,   aur Allah kissi aesay shaks ko pasand nahi kerta jo itrahat mein mubtala ho , shekhi bgharney wala ho ,

verses.text: woh aesay log hain jo kanjoosi kertay hain , aur doosray logon  ko bhi kanjoosi ki talqeen kertay hain .   aur jo shaks mun morr ley to yaad rakho kay Allah hi hai jo sabb say bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef !
verses.translation: woh aesay log hain jo kanjoosi kertay hain , aur doosray logon  ko bhi kanjoosi ki talqeen kertay hain .   aur jo shaks mun morr ley to yaad rakho kay Allah hi hai jo sabb say bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef !

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney apney payghumberon ko khuli hoi nishaniyan dey ker bheja , aur unn kay sath kitab bhi utaari , aur tarazoo bhi ,   takay log insaf per qaeem rahen , aur hum ney loha utaara jiss mein jangi taqat bhi hai , aur logon  kay liye doosray faeeday bhi ,   aur yeh iss liye takay Allah jaan ley kay kon hai jo uss ko dekhay baghair uss ( kay deen ) ki aur uss kay payghumberon ki madad kerta hai . yaqeen rakho kay Allah bari quooat ka , baray iqtidar ka malik hai .
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney apney payghumberon ko khuli hoi nishaniyan dey ker bheja , aur unn kay sath kitab bhi utaari , aur tarazoo bhi ,   takay log insaf per qaeem rahen , aur hum ney loha utaara jiss mein jangi taqat bhi hai , aur logon  kay liye doosray faeeday bhi ,   aur yeh iss liye takay Allah jaan ley kay kon hai jo uss ko dekhay baghair uss ( kay deen ) ki aur uss kay payghumberon ki madad kerta hai . yaqeen rakho kay Allah bari quooat ka , baray iqtidar ka malik hai .

verses.text: aur hum ney nooh ko aur Ibrahim ko payghumber bana ker bheja , aur unn dono ki aulad mein nabwooat aur kitab ka silsila jari kiya . phir unn mein say kuch to hidayat per aagaye , aur unn mein say boht say log nafarman rahey .
verses.translation: aur hum ney nooh ko aur Ibrahim ko payghumber bana ker bheja , aur unn dono ki aulad mein nabwooat aur kitab ka silsila jari kiya . phir unn mein say kuch to hidayat per aagaye , aur unn mein say boht say log nafarman rahey .

verses.text: phir hum ney unn kay peechay unhi kay naqsh-e-qadam per apney aur payghumber bhejay , aur unn kay peechay essa ibn-e-maryam ko bheja , aur unhen injeel ata ki , aur jinn logon  ney unn ki perwi ki , unn kay dilon mein hum ney shafqat aur reham dili peda kerdi .   aur jahan tak rahbaniyat ka talluq hai , woh unhon ney khud ejaad kerli thi , hum ney uss ko unn kay zimmay wajib nahi kiya tha ,   lekin unhon ney Allah ki khushnoodi hasil kerni chahi , phir uss ki wesi riyat naa ker-sakay jaisay uss ka haq tha .   gharz unn mein say jo emaan laye thay , unn ko hum ney unn ka ajar diya , aur unn mein say boht log nafarman hi rahey .
verses.translation: phir hum ney unn kay peechay unhi kay naqsh-e-qadam per apney aur payghumber bhejay , aur unn kay peechay essa ibn-e-maryam ko bheja , aur unhen injeel ata ki , aur jinn logon  ney unn ki perwi ki , unn kay dilon mein hum ney shafqat aur reham dili peda kerdi .   aur jahan tak rahbaniyat ka talluq hai , woh unhon ney khud ejaad kerli thi , hum ney uss ko unn kay zimmay wajib nahi kiya tha ,   lekin unhon ney Allah ki khushnoodi hasil kerni chahi , phir uss ki wesi riyat naa ker-sakay jaisay uss ka haq tha .   gharz unn mein say jo emaan laye thay , unn ko hum ney unn ka ajar diya , aur unn mein say boht log nafarman hi rahey .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah say daro , aur uss kay payghumber per emaan lao , takay woh tumhen apni rehmat kay do hissay ata farmaye ,   aur tumharay liye woh noor peda keray jiss kay zariye tum chal sako ,   aur tumhari bakhshish farmadey . aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah say daro , aur uss kay payghumber per emaan lao , takay woh tumhen apni rehmat kay do hissay ata farmaye ,   aur tumharay liye woh noor peda keray jiss kay zariye tum chal sako ,   aur tumhari bakhshish farmadey . aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .

verses.text: takay ehal-e-kitab ko maloom hojaye kay Allah kay fazal mein say kissi cheez per unhen koi ikhtiyar nahi hai ,   aur yeh kay fazal tamam tarr Allah kay haath mein hai jo woh jiss ko chahta hai , ata farmata hai , aur Allah fazal-e-azeem ka malik hai .
verses.translation: takay ehal-e-kitab ko maloom hojaye kay Allah kay fazal mein say kissi cheez per unhen koi ikhtiyar nahi hai ,   aur yeh kay fazal tamam tarr Allah kay haath mein hai jo woh jiss ko chahta hai , ata farmata hai , aur Allah fazal-e-azeem ka malik hai .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: aasmano aur zameen mein jo cheez bhi hai , woh Allah ki tasbeeh kerti hai ,   aur wohi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
ayahs.translation: aasmano aur zameen mein jo cheez bhi hai , woh Allah ki tasbeeh kerti hai ,   aur wohi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

ayahs.text: aasmano aur zameen ki badshahat ussi ki hai , wohi zindagi bakhshta aur moat deta hai , aur woh her cheez per poori qudrat rakhney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aasmano aur zameen ki badshahat ussi ki hai , wohi zindagi bakhshta aur moat deta hai , aur woh her cheez per poori qudrat rakhney wala hai .

ayahs.text: wohi awwal bhi hai , aur aakhir bhi , zahir bhi hai, aur chupa huwa bhi ,   aur woh her cheez ko poori tarah janney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: wohi awwal bhi hai , aur aakhir bhi , zahir bhi hai, aur chupa huwa bhi ,   aur woh her cheez ko poori tarah janney wala hai .

ayahs.text: wohi hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko cheh din mein peda kiya , phir arsh per istawa farmaya .   woh her uss cheez ko janta hai jo zameen mein dakhil hoti hai , aur jo uss say nikalti hai , aur her uss cheez ko jo aasman say utarti hai , aur jo uss mein charrhti hai , aur tum jahan kahen ho , woh tumharay sath hai . aur jo kaam bhi tum kertay ho , Allah uss ko dekhta hai .
ayahs.translation: wohi hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko cheh din mein peda kiya , phir arsh per istawa farmaya .   woh her uss cheez ko janta hai jo zameen mein dakhil hoti hai , aur jo uss say nikalti hai , aur her uss cheez ko jo aasman say utarti hai , aur jo uss mein charrhti hai , aur tum jahan kahen ho , woh tumharay sath hai . aur jo kaam bhi tum kertay ho , Allah uss ko dekhta hai .

ayahs.text: aasmano aur zameen ki badshahat ussi ki hai , aur tamam moamlaat Allah hi ki taraf lotaye jatay hain .
ayahs.translation: aasmano aur zameen ki badshahat ussi ki hai , aur tamam moamlaat Allah hi ki taraf lotaye jatay hain .

ayahs.text: woh raat ko din mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur din ko raat mein dakhil ker deta hai ,   aur woh seenon mein chupi hoi baaton ko khoob janta hai .
ayahs.translation: woh raat ko din mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur din ko raat mein dakhil ker deta hai ,   aur woh seenon mein chupi hoi baaton ko khoob janta hai .

ayahs.text: Allah aur uss kay Rasool per emaan rakho , aur jiss ( maal ) mein Allah ney tumhen qaeem maqam banaya hai ,   uss mein say ( Allah kay raastay mein ) kharch kero . chunacheh tum mein say jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney ( Allah kay raastay mein ) kharch kiya hai , unn kay liye bara ajar hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah aur uss kay Rasool per emaan rakho , aur jiss ( maal ) mein Allah ney tumhen qaeem maqam banaya hai ,   uss mein say ( Allah kay raastay mein ) kharch kero . chunacheh tum mein say jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney ( Allah kay raastay mein ) kharch kiya hai , unn kay liye bara ajar hai .

ayahs.text: aur tumharay liye konsi wajeh hai kay tum Allah per emaan naa rakho , halankay Rasool tumhen dawat dey rahey hain kay tum apney perwerdigar per emaan rakho , aur woh tum say ehad ley chukay hain , agar tum waqaee momin ho .
ayahs.translation: aur tumharay liye konsi wajeh hai kay tum Allah per emaan naa rakho , halankay Rasool tumhen dawat dey rahey hain kay tum apney perwerdigar per emaan rakho , aur woh tum say ehad ley chukay hain , agar tum waqaee momin ho .

ayahs.text: Allah wohi to hai jo apney banday per khuli khuli aayaten nazil farmata hai , takay tumhen andheriyon say nikal ker roshni mein laye . aur yaqeen jano Allah tum per boht shafiq , boht meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah wohi to hai jo apney banday per khuli khuli aayaten nazil farmata hai , takay tumhen andheriyon say nikal ker roshni mein laye . aur yaqeen jano Allah tum per boht shafiq , boht meharban hai .

ayahs.text: aur tumharay liye konsi wajeh hai kay tum Allah kay raastay mein kharch naa kero , halankay aasmano aur zameen ki sari meeras Allah hi kay liye hai . tum mein say jinhon ney ( makkah ki ) fatah say pehlay kharch kiya , aur larraee larri , woh ( baad walon kay ) barabar nahi hain . woh darjay mein unn logon  say barhay huye hain jinhon ney ( fatah makkah kay ) baad kharch kiya , aur larraee larri .   yun Allah ney bhalai ka wada unn sabb say ker rakha hai , aur tum jo kuch kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
ayahs.translation: aur tumharay liye konsi wajeh hai kay tum Allah kay raastay mein kharch naa kero , halankay aasmano aur zameen ki sari meeras Allah hi kay liye hai . tum mein say jinhon ney ( makkah ki ) fatah say pehlay kharch kiya , aur larraee larri , woh ( baad walon kay ) barabar nahi hain . woh darjay mein unn logon  say barhay huye hain jinhon ney ( fatah makkah kay ) baad kharch kiya , aur larraee larri .   yun Allah ney bhalai ka wada unn sabb say ker rakha hai , aur tum jo kuch kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

ayahs.text: kon hai jo Allah ko qarz dey-? acha qarz !   jiss kay nateejay mein Allah ussay denay walay kay liye kaee guna barha dey-? aur aesay shaks ko bara ba-izzat ajar milay ga
ayahs.translation: kon hai jo Allah ko qarz dey-? acha qarz !   jiss kay nateejay mein Allah ussay denay walay kay liye kaee guna barha dey-? aur aesay shaks ko bara ba-izzat ajar milay ga

ayahs.text: uss din jab tum momin mardon aur momin aurton ko dekho gay kay unn ka noor unn kay samney aur unn kay dayen janib dorr raha hoga ,   ( aur unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  aaj tumhen khushkhabri hai unn baaghaat ki jinn kay neechay nehren behti hain , jinn mein tum hamesha hamesha raho gay . yehi hai jo bari zabardast kamiyabi hai .
ayahs.translation: uss din jab tum momin mardon aur momin aurton ko dekho gay kay unn ka noor unn kay samney aur unn kay dayen janib dorr raha hoga ,   ( aur unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  aaj tumhen khushkhabri hai unn baaghaat ki jinn kay neechay nehren behti hain , jinn mein tum hamesha hamesha raho gay . yehi hai jo bari zabardast kamiyabi hai .

ayahs.text: uss din jab munafiq mard aur munafiq aurten emaan walon say kahen gay kay :  zara humara intizar kerlo kay tumharay noor say hum bhi kuch roshni hasil kerlen .    unn say kaha jaye ga kay :  tum apney peechay loat jao , phir noor talash kero .    phir unn kay darmiyan aik deewar haeel kerdi jaye gi jiss mein aik darwaza hoga jiss kay andar ki taraf rehmat hogi , aur bahir ki taraf azab hoga .
ayahs.translation: uss din jab munafiq mard aur munafiq aurten emaan walon say kahen gay kay :  zara humara intizar kerlo kay tumharay noor say hum bhi kuch roshni hasil kerlen .    unn say kaha jaye ga kay :  tum apney peechay loat jao , phir noor talash kero .    phir unn kay darmiyan aik deewar haeel kerdi jaye gi jiss mein aik darwaza hoga jiss kay andar ki taraf rehmat hogi , aur bahir ki taraf azab hoga .

ayahs.text: woh mominon ko pukaren gay kay :  kiya hum tumharay sath nahi thay-?  momin kahen gay kay :  haan ! thay to sahi , lekin tum ney khud apney aap ko fitney mein daal liya , aur intizar mein rahey ,   shak mein parray rahey , aur jhooti aarzoon ney tumhen dhokay mein daalay rakha ,   yahan tak kay Allah ka hukum aagaya , aur woh bara dhokay baaz ( yani shetan ) tumhen Allah kay baaray mein dhoka hi deta raha .
ayahs.translation: woh mominon ko pukaren gay kay :  kiya hum tumharay sath nahi thay-?  momin kahen gay kay :  haan ! thay to sahi , lekin tum ney khud apney aap ko fitney mein daal liya , aur intizar mein rahey ,   shak mein parray rahey , aur jhooti aarzoon ney tumhen dhokay mein daalay rakha ,   yahan tak kay Allah ka hukum aagaya , aur woh bara dhokay baaz ( yani shetan ) tumhen Allah kay baaray mein dhoka hi deta raha .

ayahs.text: chunacheh aaj naa tum say koi fidya qubool kiya jaye ga , aur naa unn logon  say jinhon ney ( khulay bandon ) kufr ikhtiyar kiya tha . tumhara thikana dozakh hai , wohi tumhari rakhwali hai , aur yeh boht bura anjam hai .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh aaj naa tum say koi fidya qubool kiya jaye ga , aur naa unn logon  say jinhon ney ( khulay bandon ) kufr ikhtiyar kiya tha . tumhara thikana dozakh hai , wohi tumhari rakhwali hai , aur yeh boht bura anjam hai .

ayahs.text: jo log emaan ley aaye hain , kiya unn kay liye abb bhi waqt nahi aaya kay unn kay dil Allah kay ziker kay liye aur jo haq utra hai , uss kay liye paseej jayen-? aur woh unn logon  ki tarah naa banen jinn ko pehlay kitab di gaee thi , phir unn per aik lambi mauddat guzar gaee , aur unn kay dil sakht hogaye , aur ( aaj ) unn mein say boht say nafarman hain-?
ayahs.translation: jo log emaan ley aaye hain , kiya unn kay liye abb bhi waqt nahi aaya kay unn kay dil Allah kay ziker kay liye aur jo haq utra hai , uss kay liye paseej jayen-? aur woh unn logon  ki tarah naa banen jinn ko pehlay kitab di gaee thi , phir unn per aik lambi mauddat guzar gaee , aur unn kay dil sakht hogaye , aur ( aaj ) unn mein say boht say nafarman hain-?

ayahs.text: khoob samajh lo kay Allah zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad zindagi bakhshta hai .   hum ney tumharay liye nishaniyan khol khol ker wazeh kerdi hain , takay tum samajh say kaam lo .
ayahs.translation: khoob samajh lo kay Allah zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad zindagi bakhshta hai .   hum ney tumharay liye nishaniyan khol khol ker wazeh kerdi hain , takay tum samajh say kaam lo .

ayahs.text: yaqeenan woh jo sadqa denay walay mard aur sadqa denay wali aurten hain aur unhon ney Allah ko qarz diya hai , acha qarz unn kay liye uss ( sadqay ) ko kaee guna barha diya jaye ga , aur unn kay liye ba-izzat ajar hai .
ayahs.translation: yaqeenan woh jo sadqa denay walay mard aur sadqa denay wali aurten hain aur unhon ney Allah ko qarz diya hai , acha qarz unn kay liye uss ( sadqay ) ko kaee guna barha diya jaye ga , aur unn kay liye ba-izzat ajar hai .

ayahs.text: aur jo log Allah per aur uss kay Rasoolon per emaan laye hain , wohi apney rab kay nazdeek siddiq aur shaheed hain .   unn kay liye unn ka ajar aur unn ka noor hai . aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya , aur humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya , woh dozakhi log hain .
ayahs.translation: aur jo log Allah per aur uss kay Rasoolon per emaan laye hain , wohi apney rab kay nazdeek siddiq aur shaheed hain .   unn kay liye unn ka ajar aur unn ka noor hai . aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya , aur humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya , woh dozakhi log hain .

ayahs.text: khoob samajh lo kay iss duniya wali zindagi ki haqeeqat bus yeh hai kay woh naam hai khel kood ka , zahiri sajawat ka , tumharay aik doosray per fakhar jataney ka , aur maal aur aulad mein aik doosray say barhney ki koshish kernay ka .   iss ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik barish jiss say ugney wali cheezen kisano ko boht achi lagti hain , phir woh apna zor dikhati hai , phir tum uss ko dekhtay ho kay zard parr-gai hai , phir woh choora choora hojati hai . aur aakhirat mein ( aik toh ) sakht azab hai , aur ( doosray ) Allah ki taraf say bakhshish hai , aur khushnoodi aur duniya wali zindagi dhokay kay saman kay siwa kuch bhi nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: khoob samajh lo kay iss duniya wali zindagi ki haqeeqat bus yeh hai kay woh naam hai khel kood ka , zahiri sajawat ka , tumharay aik doosray per fakhar jataney ka , aur maal aur aulad mein aik doosray say barhney ki koshish kernay ka .   iss ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik barish jiss say ugney wali cheezen kisano ko boht achi lagti hain , phir woh apna zor dikhati hai , phir tum uss ko dekhtay ho kay zard parr-gai hai , phir woh choora choora hojati hai . aur aakhirat mein ( aik toh ) sakht azab hai , aur ( doosray ) Allah ki taraf say bakhshish hai , aur khushnoodi aur duniya wali zindagi dhokay kay saman kay siwa kuch bhi nahi hai .

ayahs.text: aik doosray say aagay barhney ki koshish karo apney perwerdigar ki bakhshish ki taraf aur uss jannat ki taraf jiss ki chorai sare aasmano aur zameen ki chorai jaisi hai , yeh unn logon  kay liye tayyar ki gaee hai jo Allah aur uss kay Rasoolon per emaan laye hain . yeh Allah ka fazal hai jo woh jiss ko chahta hai deta hai . aur Allah baray fazal wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aik doosray say aagay barhney ki koshish karo apney perwerdigar ki bakhshish ki taraf aur uss jannat ki taraf jiss ki chorai sare aasmano aur zameen ki chorai jaisi hai , yeh unn logon  kay liye tayyar ki gaee hai jo Allah aur uss kay Rasoolon per emaan laye hain . yeh Allah ka fazal hai jo woh jiss ko chahta hai deta hai . aur Allah baray fazal wala hai .

ayahs.text: koi museebat aesi nahi hai jo zameen mein nazil hoti ya tumhari janon ko laahaq hoti ho , magar woh aik kitab mein uss waqt say darj hai jab hum ney inn janon ko peda bhi nahi kiya tha .   yaqeen jano yeh baat Allah kay liye boht aasaan hai .
ayahs.translation: koi museebat aesi nahi hai jo zameen mein nazil hoti ya tumhari janon ko laahaq hoti ho , magar woh aik kitab mein uss waqt say darj hai jab hum ney inn janon ko peda bhi nahi kiya tha .   yaqeen jano yeh baat Allah kay liye boht aasaan hai .

ayahs.text: yeh iss liye takay jo cheez tum say jati rahey , uss per tum ghum mein naa parro , aur jo cheez Allah tumhen ata farmadey , uss per tum itrao nahi ,   aur Allah kissi aesay shaks ko pasand nahi kerta jo itrahat mein mubtala ho , shekhi bgharney wala ho ,
ayahs.translation: yeh iss liye takay jo cheez tum say jati rahey , uss per tum ghum mein naa parro , aur jo cheez Allah tumhen ata farmadey , uss per tum itrao nahi ,   aur Allah kissi aesay shaks ko pasand nahi kerta jo itrahat mein mubtala ho , shekhi bgharney wala ho ,

ayahs.text: woh aesay log hain jo kanjoosi kertay hain , aur doosray logon  ko bhi kanjoosi ki talqeen kertay hain .   aur jo shaks mun morr ley to yaad rakho kay Allah hi hai jo sabb say bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef !
ayahs.translation: woh aesay log hain jo kanjoosi kertay hain , aur doosray logon  ko bhi kanjoosi ki talqeen kertay hain .   aur jo shaks mun morr ley to yaad rakho kay Allah hi hai jo sabb say bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef !

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney apney payghumberon ko khuli hoi nishaniyan dey ker bheja , aur unn kay sath kitab bhi utaari , aur tarazoo bhi ,   takay log insaf per qaeem rahen , aur hum ney loha utaara jiss mein jangi taqat bhi hai , aur logon  kay liye doosray faeeday bhi ,   aur yeh iss liye takay Allah jaan ley kay kon hai jo uss ko dekhay baghair uss ( kay deen ) ki aur uss kay payghumberon ki madad kerta hai . yaqeen rakho kay Allah bari quooat ka , baray iqtidar ka malik hai .
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney apney payghumberon ko khuli hoi nishaniyan dey ker bheja , aur unn kay sath kitab bhi utaari , aur tarazoo bhi ,   takay log insaf per qaeem rahen , aur hum ney loha utaara jiss mein jangi taqat bhi hai , aur logon  kay liye doosray faeeday bhi ,   aur yeh iss liye takay Allah jaan ley kay kon hai jo uss ko dekhay baghair uss ( kay deen ) ki aur uss kay payghumberon ki madad kerta hai . yaqeen rakho kay Allah bari quooat ka , baray iqtidar ka malik hai .

ayahs.text: aur hum ney nooh ko aur Ibrahim ko payghumber bana ker bheja , aur unn dono ki aulad mein nabwooat aur kitab ka silsila jari kiya . phir unn mein say kuch to hidayat per aagaye , aur unn mein say boht say log nafarman rahey .
ayahs.translation: aur hum ney nooh ko aur Ibrahim ko payghumber bana ker bheja , aur unn dono ki aulad mein nabwooat aur kitab ka silsila jari kiya . phir unn mein say kuch to hidayat per aagaye , aur unn mein say boht say log nafarman rahey .

ayahs.text: phir hum ney unn kay peechay unhi kay naqsh-e-qadam per apney aur payghumber bhejay , aur unn kay peechay essa ibn-e-maryam ko bheja , aur unhen injeel ata ki , aur jinn logon  ney unn ki perwi ki , unn kay dilon mein hum ney shafqat aur reham dili peda kerdi .   aur jahan tak rahbaniyat ka talluq hai , woh unhon ney khud ejaad kerli thi , hum ney uss ko unn kay zimmay wajib nahi kiya tha ,   lekin unhon ney Allah ki khushnoodi hasil kerni chahi , phir uss ki wesi riyat naa ker-sakay jaisay uss ka haq tha .   gharz unn mein say jo emaan laye thay , unn ko hum ney unn ka ajar diya , aur unn mein say boht log nafarman hi rahey .
ayahs.translation: phir hum ney unn kay peechay unhi kay naqsh-e-qadam per apney aur payghumber bhejay , aur unn kay peechay essa ibn-e-maryam ko bheja , aur unhen injeel ata ki , aur jinn logon  ney unn ki perwi ki , unn kay dilon mein hum ney shafqat aur reham dili peda kerdi .   aur jahan tak rahbaniyat ka talluq hai , woh unhon ney khud ejaad kerli thi , hum ney uss ko unn kay zimmay wajib nahi kiya tha ,   lekin unhon ney Allah ki khushnoodi hasil kerni chahi , phir uss ki wesi riyat naa ker-sakay jaisay uss ka haq tha .   gharz unn mein say jo emaan laye thay , unn ko hum ney unn ka ajar diya , aur unn mein say boht log nafarman hi rahey .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah say daro , aur uss kay payghumber per emaan lao , takay woh tumhen apni rehmat kay do hissay ata farmaye ,   aur tumharay liye woh noor peda keray jiss kay zariye tum chal sako ,   aur tumhari bakhshish farmadey . aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah say daro , aur uss kay payghumber per emaan lao , takay woh tumhen apni rehmat kay do hissay ata farmaye ,   aur tumharay liye woh noor peda keray jiss kay zariye tum chal sako ,   aur tumhari bakhshish farmadey . aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .

ayahs.translation: takay ehal-e-kitab ko maloom hojaye kay Allah kay fazal mein say kissi cheez per unhen koi ikhtiyar nahi hai ,   aur yeh kay fazal tamam tarr Allah kay haath mein hai jo woh jiss ko chahta hai , ata farmata hai , aur Allah fazal-e-azeem ka malik hai .
