verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) Allah ney uss aurat ki baat sunn li hai jo tum say apney shohar kay baaray mein behas ker rahi hai , aur Allah say fariyad kerti jati hai .   aur Allah tum dono ki guftoogo sunn raha hai . yaqeenan Allah sabb kuch sunney dekhney wala hai .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) Allah ney uss aurat ki baat sunn li hai jo tum say apney shohar kay baaray mein behas ker rahi hai , aur Allah say fariyad kerti jati hai .   aur Allah tum dono ki guftoogo sunn raha hai . yaqeenan Allah sabb kuch sunney dekhney wala hai .

verses.text: tum mein say jo log apni biwiyon say zihar kertay hain , ( unn kay iss amal say ) woh biwiyan unn ki mayen nahi hojaten . unn ki mayen to wohi hain jinhon ney unn ko janam diya hai . haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh log aesi baat kehtay hain jo boht buri hai , aur jhoot hai ,   aur Allah boht moaaf kernay wala , boht bakhshney wala hai .
verses.translation: tum mein say jo log apni biwiyon say zihar kertay hain , ( unn kay iss amal say ) woh biwiyan unn ki mayen nahi hojaten . unn ki mayen to wohi hain jinhon ney unn ko janam diya hai . haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh log aesi baat kehtay hain jo boht buri hai , aur jhoot hai ,   aur Allah boht moaaf kernay wala , boht bakhshney wala hai .

verses.text: aur jo log apni biwiyon say zihar kertay hain , phir unhon ney jo kuch kaha hai , uss say rujoo kertay hain , to unn kay zimmay aik ghulam azad kerna hai , qabal iss kay kay woh ( miyan biwi ) aik doosray ko haath lagayen .   yeh hai woh baat jiss ki tumhen naseehat ki jarahi hai , aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: aur jo log apni biwiyon say zihar kertay hain , phir unhon ney jo kuch kaha hai , uss say rujoo kertay hain , to unn kay zimmay aik ghulam azad kerna hai , qabal iss kay kay woh ( miyan biwi ) aik doosray ko haath lagayen .   yeh hai woh baat jiss ki tumhen naseehat ki jarahi hai , aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: phir jiss shaks ko ghulam moyassar naa ho , uss kay zimmay do mutawatir maheenon kay rozay hain , qabal iss kay kay woh ( miyan biwi ) aik doosray ko haath lagayen . phir jiss ko iss ki bhi istataat naa ho , uss kay zimmay saat miskeeno ko khana khilana hai . yeh iss liye takay tum Allah aur uss kay Rasool per emaan lao . aur yeh Allah ki muqarrar ki hoi haden hain , aur kafiron kay liye dardnak azab hai .
verses.translation: phir jiss shaks ko ghulam moyassar naa ho , uss kay zimmay do mutawatir maheenon kay rozay hain , qabal iss kay kay woh ( miyan biwi ) aik doosray ko haath lagayen . phir jiss ko iss ki bhi istataat naa ho , uss kay zimmay saat miskeeno ko khana khilana hai . yeh iss liye takay tum Allah aur uss kay Rasool per emaan lao . aur yeh Allah ki muqarrar ki hoi haden hain , aur kafiron kay liye dardnak azab hai .

verses.text: yaqeen rakho kay jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki mukhalifat kertay hain , woh aesay hi zaleel hon gay jaisay inn say pehlay log zaleel huye thay , aur hum ney khuli khuli aayaten nazil kerdi hain , aur kafiron kay liye aisa azab hai jo khuwar ker kay rakh dey ga ,
verses.translation: yaqeen rakho kay jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki mukhalifat kertay hain , woh aesay hi zaleel hon gay jaisay inn say pehlay log zaleel huye thay , aur hum ney khuli khuli aayaten nazil kerdi hain , aur kafiron kay liye aisa azab hai jo khuwar ker kay rakh dey ga ,

verses.text: uss din jab Allah unn sabb ko dobara zinda keray ga , phir unhen bataye ga kay unhon ney kiya kuch kiya tha . Allah ney ussay ginn ginn ker mehfooz rakha hai , aur yeh ussay bhool gaye hain . aur Allah her cheez ka gawah hai .
verses.translation: uss din jab Allah unn sabb ko dobara zinda keray ga , phir unhen bataye ga kay unhon ney kiya kuch kiya tha . Allah ney ussay ginn ginn ker mehfooz rakha hai , aur yeh ussay bhool gaye hain . aur Allah her cheez ka gawah hai .

verses.text: kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , Allah ussay janta hai ? kabhi teen aadmiyon mein koi sargoshi aesi nahi hoti jiss mein chotha woh naa ho , aur naa paanch aadmiyon ki koi sargoshi aesi hoti hai jiss mein chata woh naa ho , aur chahye sargoshi kernay walay iss say kam hun ya ziyada , woh jahan bhi hon , Allah unn kay sath hota hai .   phir woh qayamat kay din unhen bataye ga kay unhon ney kiya kuch kiya tha . beyshak Allah her cheez ko janney wala hai .
verses.translation: kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , Allah ussay janta hai ? kabhi teen aadmiyon mein koi sargoshi aesi nahi hoti jiss mein chotha woh naa ho , aur naa paanch aadmiyon ki koi sargoshi aesi hoti hai jiss mein chata woh naa ho , aur chahye sargoshi kernay walay iss say kam hun ya ziyada , woh jahan bhi hon , Allah unn kay sath hota hai .   phir woh qayamat kay din unhen bataye ga kay unhon ney kiya kuch kiya tha . beyshak Allah her cheez ko janney wala hai .

verses.text: kiya tum ney unn logon  ko nahi dekha jinhen sargoshi kernay say mana kerdiya gaya tha , phir bhi woh wohi kaam kertay hain jiss say unhen mana kiya gaya tha-? aur woh aik doosray kay sath aesi sargoshiyan kertay hain jo gunah , ziyadti aur Rasool ki nafarmani per mushtamil hoti hain . aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab woh tumharay paas aatay hain to tumhen aesay tareeqay say salam kertay hain jiss say Allah ney tumhen salam nahi kiya ,   aur apney dilon mein kehtay hain kay :  hum jo kuch keh rahey hain , uss per Allah hamen saza kiyon nahi dey deta-?    jahannum hi unn ( ki khabar lenay ) kay liye kafi hai , woh ussi mein jaa phonchen gay , aur woh phonchney ki boht buri jagah hai .
verses.translation: kiya tum ney unn logon  ko nahi dekha jinhen sargoshi kernay say mana kerdiya gaya tha , phir bhi woh wohi kaam kertay hain jiss say unhen mana kiya gaya tha-? aur woh aik doosray kay sath aesi sargoshiyan kertay hain jo gunah , ziyadti aur Rasool ki nafarmani per mushtamil hoti hain . aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab woh tumharay paas aatay hain to tumhen aesay tareeqay say salam kertay hain jiss say Allah ney tumhen salam nahi kiya ,   aur apney dilon mein kehtay hain kay :  hum jo kuch keh rahey hain , uss per Allah hamen saza kiyon nahi dey deta-?    jahannum hi unn ( ki khabar lenay ) kay liye kafi hai , woh ussi mein jaa phonchen gay , aur woh phonchney ki boht buri jagah hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! jab tum aapas mein aik doosray say sargoshi kero to aesi sargoshi naa kero jo gunah , ziyadti aur Rasool ki nafarmani per mushtamil ho , haan aesi sargoshi kero jo naik kamon aur taqwa per mushtamil ho , aur Allah say dartay raho , jiss kay paas tum sabb ko jama ker kay ley jaya jaye ga .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! jab tum aapas mein aik doosray say sargoshi kero to aesi sargoshi naa kero jo gunah , ziyadti aur Rasool ki nafarmani per mushtamil ho , haan aesi sargoshi kero jo naik kamon aur taqwa per mushtamil ho , aur Allah say dartay raho , jiss kay paas tum sabb ko jama ker kay ley jaya jaye ga .

verses.text: aesi sargoshi to shetan ki taraf say hoti hai , takay woh emaan walon ko ghum mein mubtala keray , aur woh Allah kay hukum kay baghair unhen zara bhi nuqsan nahi phoncha sakta . aur mominon ko Allah hi per bharosa rakhna chahiye .
verses.translation: aesi sargoshi to shetan ki taraf say hoti hai , takay woh emaan walon ko ghum mein mubtala keray , aur woh Allah kay hukum kay baghair unhen zara bhi nuqsan nahi phoncha sakta . aur mominon ko Allah hi per bharosa rakhna chahiye .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! jab tum say kaha jaye kay majlison mein doosron kay liye gunjaeesh peda kero , to gunjaeesh peda kerdiya kero ,   Allah tumharay liye wusat peda keray ga , aur jab kaha jaye kay uth jao , to uth jao , tum mein say jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinn ko ilm ata kiya gaya hai , Allah unn ko darjon mein buland keray ga . aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! jab tum say kaha jaye kay majlison mein doosron kay liye gunjaeesh peda kero , to gunjaeesh peda kerdiya kero ,   Allah tumharay liye wusat peda keray ga , aur jab kaha jaye kay uth jao , to uth jao , tum mein say jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinn ko ilm ata kiya gaya hai , Allah unn ko darjon mein buland keray ga . aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! jab tum Rasool say tanhai mein koi baat kerna chahao to apni uss tanhai ki baat say pehlay kuch sadqa kerdiya kero .   yeh tareeqa tumharay haq mein behtar aur ziyada suthra tareeqa hai . haan agar tumharay paas ( sadqa kernay kay liye ) kuch naa ho to Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! jab tum Rasool say tanhai mein koi baat kerna chahao to apni uss tanhai ki baat say pehlay kuch sadqa kerdiya kero .   yeh tareeqa tumharay haq mein behtar aur ziyada suthra tareeqa hai . haan agar tumharay paas ( sadqa kernay kay liye ) kuch naa ho to Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .

verses.text: kiya tum iss baat say darr gaye kay apni tanhai ki baat say pehlay sadqaat diya kero-? abb jabkay tum aisa nahi ker-sakay , aur Allah ney tumhen moaaf kerdiya to tum namaz qaeem kertay raho , aur zakat detay raho , aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki farmanbardaari kertay raho .   aur jo kaam bhi tum kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: kiya tum iss baat say darr gaye kay apni tanhai ki baat say pehlay sadqaat diya kero-? abb jabkay tum aisa nahi ker-sakay , aur Allah ney tumhen moaaf kerdiya to tum namaz qaeem kertay raho , aur zakat detay raho , aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki farmanbardaari kertay raho .   aur jo kaam bhi tum kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: kiya tum ney unn ko nahi dekha jinhon ney aesay logon  ko dost banaya huwa hai jinn per Allah ka ghazab hai-?   yeh naa to tumharay hain , aur naa unn kay , aur yeh jantay boojhtay jhooti baaton per qasmen kha jatay hain .
verses.translation: kiya tum ney unn ko nahi dekha jinhon ney aesay logon  ko dost banaya huwa hai jinn per Allah ka ghazab hai-?   yeh naa to tumharay hain , aur naa unn kay , aur yeh jantay boojhtay jhooti baaton per qasmen kha jatay hain .

verses.text: Allah ney inn kay liye sakht azab tayyar ker rakha hai . haqeeqat yeh hai kay boht buray hain woh kaam jo yeh kertay rahey hain .
verses.translation: Allah ney inn kay liye sakht azab tayyar ker rakha hai . haqeeqat yeh hai kay boht buray hain woh kaam jo yeh kertay rahey hain .

verses.text: enhon ney apni qasmon ko aik dhaal bana liya hai ,   phir woh doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roktay rahey hain . iss liye inn kay liye aisa azab hai jo zaleel ker kay rakh dey ga .
verses.translation: enhon ney apni qasmon ko aik dhaal bana liya hai ,   phir woh doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roktay rahey hain . iss liye inn kay liye aisa azab hai jo zaleel ker kay rakh dey ga .

verses.text: inn kay maal aur inn ki aulad Allah kay muqablay mein inn kay kuch kaam nahi ayen gay . yeh dozakh walay log hain . yeh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .
verses.translation: inn kay maal aur inn ki aulad Allah kay muqablay mein inn kay kuch kaam nahi ayen gay . yeh dozakh walay log hain . yeh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .

verses.text: jiss din Allah inn sabb ko dobara zinda keray ga to uss kay samney bhi yeh ussi tarah qasmen khayen gay jaisay tumharay samney khatay hain , aur yeh samjhen gay kay enhen koi sahara mil gaya hai . yaad rakho yeh log bilkul jhootay hain .
verses.translation: jiss din Allah inn sabb ko dobara zinda keray ga to uss kay samney bhi yeh ussi tarah qasmen khayen gay jaisay tumharay samney khatay hain , aur yeh samjhen gay kay enhen koi sahara mil gaya hai . yaad rakho yeh log bilkul jhootay hain .

verses.text: inn per shetan ney poori tarah qabza jama ker enhen Allah ki yaad say ghafil kerdiya hai . yeh shetan ka giroh hai . yaad rakho shetan ka giroh hi na-murad honey wala hai .
verses.translation: inn per shetan ney poori tarah qabza jama ker enhen Allah ki yaad say ghafil kerdiya hai . yeh shetan ka giroh hai . yaad rakho shetan ka giroh hi na-murad honey wala hai .

verses.text: beyshak jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki mukhalifat kertay hain , woh zaleel tareen logon  mein shamil hain .
verses.translation: beyshak jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki mukhalifat kertay hain , woh zaleel tareen logon  mein shamil hain .

verses.text: Allah ney yeh baat likh di hai kay mein aur meray payghumber zaroor ghalib ayen gay . yaqeen rakho kay Allah bari quooat wala , baray iqtidar wala hai .
verses.translation: Allah ney yeh baat likh di hai kay mein aur meray payghumber zaroor ghalib ayen gay . yaqeen rakho kay Allah bari quooat wala , baray iqtidar wala hai .

verses.text: jo log Allah aur aakhirat kay din per emaan rakhtay hain , unn ko tum aisa nahi pao gay kay woh unn say dosti rakhtay hon jinhon ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki mukhalifat ki hai , chahye woh unn kay baap hon , ya unn kay betay ya unn kay bhai ya unn kay khandan walay .   yeh woh log hain jinn kay dilon mein Allah ney emaan naqsh kerdiya hai , aur apni rooh say unn ki madad ki hai , aur unhen woh aesay baaghon mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jahan woh hamesha rahen gay . Allah unn say razi hogaya hai , aur woh Allah say razi hogaye hain . yeh Allah ka giroh hai . yaad rakho kay Allah ka giroh hi falah paaney wala hai .
verses.translation: jo log Allah aur aakhirat kay din per emaan rakhtay hain , unn ko tum aisa nahi pao gay kay woh unn say dosti rakhtay hon jinhon ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki mukhalifat ki hai , chahye woh unn kay baap hon , ya unn kay betay ya unn kay bhai ya unn kay khandan walay .   yeh woh log hain jinn kay dilon mein Allah ney emaan naqsh kerdiya hai , aur apni rooh say unn ki madad ki hai , aur unhen woh aesay baaghon mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jahan woh hamesha rahen gay . Allah unn say razi hogaya hai , aur woh Allah say razi hogaye hain . yeh Allah ka giroh hai . yaad rakho kay Allah ka giroh hi falah paaney wala hai .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) Allah ney uss aurat ki baat sunn li hai jo tum say apney shohar kay baaray mein behas ker rahi hai , aur Allah say fariyad kerti jati hai .   aur Allah tum dono ki guftoogo sunn raha hai . yaqeenan Allah sabb kuch sunney dekhney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) Allah ney uss aurat ki baat sunn li hai jo tum say apney shohar kay baaray mein behas ker rahi hai , aur Allah say fariyad kerti jati hai .   aur Allah tum dono ki guftoogo sunn raha hai . yaqeenan Allah sabb kuch sunney dekhney wala hai .

ayahs.text: tum mein say jo log apni biwiyon say zihar kertay hain , ( unn kay iss amal say ) woh biwiyan unn ki mayen nahi hojaten . unn ki mayen to wohi hain jinhon ney unn ko janam diya hai . haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh log aesi baat kehtay hain jo boht buri hai , aur jhoot hai ,   aur Allah boht moaaf kernay wala , boht bakhshney wala hai .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! jab tum Rasool say tanhai mein koi baat kerna chahao to apni uss tanhai ki baat say pehlay kuch sadqa kerdiya kero .   yeh tareeqa tumharay haq mein behtar aur ziyada suthra tareeqa hai . haan agar tumharay paas ( sadqa kernay kay liye ) kuch naa ho to Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! jab tum Rasool say tanhai mein koi baat kerna chahao to apni uss tanhai ki baat say pehlay kuch sadqa kerdiya kero .   yeh tareeqa tumharay haq mein behtar aur ziyada suthra tareeqa hai . haan agar tumharay paas ( sadqa kernay kay liye ) kuch naa ho to Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .

ayahs.text: kiya tum iss baat say darr gaye kay apni tanhai ki baat say pehlay sadqaat diya kero-? abb jabkay tum aisa nahi ker-sakay , aur Allah ney tumhen moaaf kerdiya to tum namaz qaeem kertay raho , aur zakat detay raho , aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki farmanbardaari kertay raho .   aur jo kaam bhi tum kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
ayahs.translation: kiya tum iss baat say darr gaye kay apni tanhai ki baat say pehlay sadqaat diya kero-? abb jabkay tum aisa nahi ker-sakay , aur Allah ney tumhen moaaf kerdiya to tum namaz qaeem kertay raho , aur zakat detay raho , aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki farmanbardaari kertay raho .   aur jo kaam bhi tum kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

ayahs.text: kiya tum ney unn ko nahi dekha jinhon ney aesay logon  ko dost banaya huwa hai jinn per Allah ka ghazab hai-?   yeh naa to tumharay hain , aur naa unn kay , aur yeh jantay boojhtay jhooti baaton per qasmen kha jatay hain .
ayahs.translation: kiya tum ney unn ko nahi dekha jinhon ney aesay logon  ko dost banaya huwa hai jinn per Allah ka ghazab hai-?   yeh naa to tumharay hain , aur naa unn kay , aur yeh jantay boojhtay jhooti baaton per qasmen kha jatay hain .

ayahs.text: Allah ney inn kay liye sakht azab tayyar ker rakha hai . haqeeqat yeh hai kay boht buray hain woh kaam jo yeh kertay rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney inn kay liye sakht azab tayyar ker rakha hai . haqeeqat yeh hai kay boht buray hain woh kaam jo yeh kertay rahey hain .

ayahs.text: enhon ney apni qasmon ko aik dhaal bana liya hai ,   phir woh doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roktay rahey hain . iss liye inn kay liye aisa azab hai jo zaleel ker kay rakh dey ga .
ayahs.translation: enhon ney apni qasmon ko aik dhaal bana liya hai ,   phir woh doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roktay rahey hain . iss liye inn kay liye aisa azab hai jo zaleel ker kay rakh dey ga .

ayahs.text: inn kay maal aur inn ki aulad Allah kay muqablay mein inn kay kuch kaam nahi ayen gay . yeh dozakh walay log hain . yeh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .
ayahs.translation: inn kay maal aur inn ki aulad Allah kay muqablay mein inn kay kuch kaam nahi ayen gay . yeh dozakh walay log hain . yeh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .

ayahs.text: jiss din Allah inn sabb ko dobara zinda keray ga to uss kay samney bhi yeh ussi tarah qasmen khayen gay jaisay tumharay samney khatay hain , aur yeh samjhen gay kay enhen koi sahara mil gaya hai . yaad rakho yeh log bilkul jhootay hain .
ayahs.translation: jiss din Allah inn sabb ko dobara zinda keray ga to uss kay samney bhi yeh ussi tarah qasmen khayen gay jaisay tumharay samney khatay hain , aur yeh samjhen gay kay enhen koi sahara mil gaya hai . yaad rakho yeh log bilkul jhootay hain .

ayahs.text: inn per shetan ney poori tarah qabza jama ker enhen Allah ki yaad say ghafil kerdiya hai . yeh shetan ka giroh hai . yaad rakho shetan ka giroh hi na-murad honey wala hai .
ayahs.translation: inn per shetan ney poori tarah qabza jama ker enhen Allah ki yaad say ghafil kerdiya hai . yeh shetan ka giroh hai . yaad rakho shetan ka giroh hi na-murad honey wala hai .

ayahs.text: beyshak jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki mukhalifat kertay hain , woh zaleel tareen logon  mein shamil hain .
ayahs.translation: beyshak jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki mukhalifat kertay hain , woh zaleel tareen logon  mein shamil hain .

ayahs.text: Allah ney yeh baat likh di hai kay mein aur meray payghumber zaroor ghalib ayen gay . yaqeen rakho kay Allah bari quooat wala , baray iqtidar wala hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah ney yeh baat likh di hai kay mein aur meray payghumber zaroor ghalib ayen gay . yaqeen rakho kay Allah bari quooat wala , baray iqtidar wala hai .

ayahs.text: jo log Allah aur aakhirat kay din per emaan rakhtay hain , unn ko tum aisa nahi pao gay kay woh unn say dosti rakhtay hon jinhon ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki mukhalifat ki hai , chahye woh unn kay baap hon , ya unn kay betay ya unn kay bhai ya unn kay khandan walay .   yeh woh log hain jinn kay dilon mein Allah ney emaan naqsh kerdiya hai , aur apni rooh say unn ki madad ki hai , aur unhen woh aesay baaghon mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jahan woh hamesha rahen gay . Allah unn say razi hogaya hai , aur woh Allah say razi hogaye hain . yeh Allah ka giroh hai . yaad rakho kay Allah ka giroh hi falah paaney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: jo log Allah aur aakhirat kay din per emaan rakhtay hain , unn ko tum aisa nahi pao gay kay woh unn say dosti rakhtay hon jinhon ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki mukhalifat ki hai , chahye woh unn kay baap hon , ya unn kay betay ya unn kay bhai ya unn kay khandan walay .   yeh woh log hain jinn kay dilon mein Allah ney emaan naqsh kerdiya hai , aur apni rooh say unn ki madad ki hai , aur unhen woh aesay baaghon mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jahan woh hamesha rahen gay . Allah unn say razi hogaya hai , aur woh Allah say razi hogaye hain . yeh Allah ka giroh hai . yaad rakho kay Allah ka giroh hi falah paaney wala hai .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: aasmano aur zameen mein jo bhi koi cheez hai , uss ney Allah ki tasbeeh ki hai , aur wohi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
verses.translation: aasmano aur zameen mein jo bhi koi cheez hai , uss ney Allah ki tasbeeh ki hai , aur wohi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

verses.text: wohi hai jiss ney ehal-e-kitab mein say kafir logon  ko unn kay gharon say pehlay ijtima kay moaqa per nikal diya .   ( musalmano ! ) tumhen yeh khayal bhi nahi tha kay woh niklen gay , aur woh bhi yeh samjhay huye thay kay unn kay qalay enhen/unhen Allah say bacha len gay . phir Allah unn kay paas aesi jagah say aaya jahan unn ka gumaan bhi nahi tha , aur Allah ney unn kay dilon mein roab daal diya kay woh apney gharon ko khud apney haathon say bhi aur musalmanon kay haathon say bhi ujaarr rahey thay .   lehaza aey aankhon walo ! ibrat hasil kerlo .
verses.translation: wohi hai jiss ney ehal-e-kitab mein say kafir logon  ko unn kay gharon say pehlay ijtima kay moaqa per nikal diya .   ( musalmano ! ) tumhen yeh khayal bhi nahi tha kay woh niklen gay , aur woh bhi yeh samjhay huye thay kay unn kay qalay enhen/unhen Allah say bacha len gay . phir Allah unn kay paas aesi jagah say aaya jahan unn ka gumaan bhi nahi tha , aur Allah ney unn kay dilon mein roab daal diya kay woh apney gharon ko khud apney haathon say bhi aur musalmanon kay haathon say bhi ujaarr rahey thay .   lehaza aey aankhon walo ! ibrat hasil kerlo .

verses.text: aur agar Allah ney unn ki qismat mein jala watni naa likh di hoti to woh duniya hi mein unn ko azab dey deta ,   albatta aakhirat mein unn kay liye dozakh ka azab hai .
verses.translation: aur agar Allah ney unn ki qismat mein jala watni naa likh di hoti to woh duniya hi mein unn ko azab dey deta ,   albatta aakhirat mein unn kay liye dozakh ka azab hai .

verses.text: yeh iss liye kay unhon ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool say dushmani thaani , aur jo shaks Allah say dushmani kerta hai , to Allah bara sakht azab denay wala hai .
verses.translation: yeh iss liye kay unhon ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool say dushmani thaani , aur jo shaks Allah say dushmani kerta hai , to Allah bara sakht azab denay wala hai .

verses.text: tum ney khujoor kay jo darkht kaatay , ya unhen apni jarron per kharra rehney diya , to yeh sabb kuch Allah kay hukum say tha ,   aur iss liye tha takay Allah nafarmano ko ruswa keray .
verses.translation: tum ney khujoor kay jo darkht kaatay , ya unhen apni jarron per kharra rehney diya , to yeh sabb kuch Allah kay hukum say tha ,   aur iss liye tha takay Allah nafarmano ko ruswa keray .

verses.text: aur Allah ney apney Rasool ko unn ka jo maal bhi fey kay tor per dlwaya , uss kay liye tum ney naa apney ghorray dorraye , naa oont , lekin Allah apney payghumberon ko jiss per chahta hai , tasallut ata farma deta hai .   aur Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhney wala hai .
verses.translation: aur Allah ney apney Rasool ko unn ka jo maal bhi fey kay tor per dlwaya , uss kay liye tum ney naa apney ghorray dorraye , naa oont , lekin Allah apney payghumberon ko jiss per chahta hai , tasallut ata farma deta hai .   aur Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhney wala hai .

verses.text: Allah apney Rasool ko ( doosri ) bastiyon say jo maal bhi fey kay tor per dilwa dey , to woh Allah ka haq hai , aur uss kay Rasool ka , aur qraabat daaron ka , aur yateemon , miskeeno aur musfiron ka , takay woh maal sirf unhi kay darmiyan gardish kerta naa reh jaye jo tum mein dolat mand log hain . aur Rasool tumhen jo kuch den , woh ley lo , aur jiss cheez say mana keren , uss say ruk jao , aur Allah say dartay raho . beyshak Allah sakht saza denay wala hai .
verses.translation: Allah apney Rasool ko ( doosri ) bastiyon say jo maal bhi fey kay tor per dilwa dey , to woh Allah ka haq hai , aur uss kay Rasool ka , aur qraabat daaron ka , aur yateemon , miskeeno aur musfiron ka , takay woh maal sirf unhi kay darmiyan gardish kerta naa reh jaye jo tum mein dolat mand log hain . aur Rasool tumhen jo kuch den , woh ley lo , aur jiss cheez say mana keren , uss say ruk jao , aur Allah say dartay raho . beyshak Allah sakht saza denay wala hai .

verses.text: . ( neez yeh maal fey ) unn hajat mand mohajreen ka haq hai jinhen apney gharon aur apney maalon say bey dakhal kiya gaya hai .   woh Allah ki taraf say fazal aur uss ki khushnoodi kay talab gaar hain , aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki madad kertay hain . yehi log hain jo raast baaz hain .
verses.translation: . ( neez yeh maal fey ) unn hajat mand mohajreen ka haq hai jinhen apney gharon aur apney maalon say bey dakhal kiya gaya hai .   woh Allah ki taraf say fazal aur uss ki khushnoodi kay talab gaar hain , aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki madad kertay hain . yehi log hain jo raast baaz hain .

verses.text: . ( aur yeh maal fey ) unn logon  ka haq hai jo pehlay hi say iss jagah ( yani madina mein ) emaan kay sath muqeem hain ,   jo koi unn kay paas hijrat ker kay aata hai , yeh uss say mohabbat kertay hain , aur jo kuch unn ( mohajreen ) ko diya jata hai , yeh apney seenon mein uss ki koi khuwaish bhi mehsoos nahi kertay , aur unn ko apney aap per tarjeeh detay hain , chahye unn per tang dasti ki halat guzar rahi ho .   aur jo log apni tabiyat kay bukhul say mehfooz hojayen , wohi hain jo falah paaney walay hain .
verses.translation: . ( aur yeh maal fey ) unn logon  ka haq hai jo pehlay hi say iss jagah ( yani madina mein ) emaan kay sath muqeem hain ,   jo koi unn kay paas hijrat ker kay aata hai , yeh uss say mohabbat kertay hain , aur jo kuch unn ( mohajreen ) ko diya jata hai , yeh apney seenon mein uss ki koi khuwaish bhi mehsoos nahi kertay , aur unn ko apney aap per tarjeeh detay hain , chahye unn per tang dasti ki halat guzar rahi ho .   aur jo log apni tabiyat kay bukhul say mehfooz hojayen , wohi hain jo falah paaney walay hain .

verses.text: aur ( yeh maal fey ) unn logon  ka bhi haq hai jo inn ( mohajreen aur ansaar ) kay baad aaye ,   woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! humari bhi maghfirat farmaiye , aur humaray unn bhaiyon ki bhi jo hum say pehlay emaan laa-chukay hain , aur humaray dilon mein emaan laney walon kay liye koi bughz naa rakhiye . aey humaray perwerdigar ! aap boht shafiq , boht meharban hain .
verses.translation: aur ( yeh maal fey ) unn logon  ka bhi haq hai jo inn ( mohajreen aur ansaar ) kay baad aaye ,   woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! humari bhi maghfirat farmaiye , aur humaray unn bhaiyon ki bhi jo hum say pehlay emaan laa-chukay hain , aur humaray dilon mein emaan laney walon kay liye koi bughz naa rakhiye . aey humaray perwerdigar ! aap boht shafiq , boht meharban hain .

verses.text: kiya tum ney unn ko nahi dekha jinhon ney munafiqat say kaam liya hai kay woh apney unn bhaiyon say jo kafir ehal-e-kitab mein say hain yeh kehtay hain kay :  agar tumhen nikala gaya to hum bhi tumharay sath niklen gay , aur tumharay baaray mein kabhi kissi aur ka kehna nahi maanen gay , aur agar tum say jang ki gaee to hum tumhari madad keren gay .  aur Allah gawahi deta hai kay yeh log bilkul jhootay hain .
verses.translation: kiya tum ney unn ko nahi dekha jinhon ney munafiqat say kaam liya hai kay woh apney unn bhaiyon say jo kafir ehal-e-kitab mein say hain yeh kehtay hain kay :  agar tumhen nikala gaya to hum bhi tumharay sath niklen gay , aur tumharay baaray mein kabhi kissi aur ka kehna nahi maanen gay , aur agar tum say jang ki gaee to hum tumhari madad keren gay .  aur Allah gawahi deta hai kay yeh log bilkul jhootay hain .

verses.text: yeh pakki baat hai kay agar inn ( ehal-e-kitab ) ko nikala gaya to yeh unn kay sath nahi niklen gay ,   aur agar unn say jang ki gaee to yeh unn ki madad nahi keren gay , aur agar bil-farz unn ki madad ki bhi to peeth pher ker bhagen gay , phir inn ki koi madad nahi keray ga .
verses.translation: yeh pakki baat hai kay agar inn ( ehal-e-kitab ) ko nikala gaya to yeh unn kay sath nahi niklen gay ,   aur agar unn say jang ki gaee to yeh unn ki madad nahi keren gay , aur agar bil-farz unn ki madad ki bhi to peeth pher ker bhagen gay , phir inn ki koi madad nahi keray ga .

verses.text: . ( musalmano ! ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn kay dilon mein tumhari dehshat Allah say ziyada hai . yeh iss liye kay yeh woh log hain jinhen samajh nahi hai .
verses.translation: . ( musalmano ! ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn kay dilon mein tumhari dehshat Allah say ziyada hai . yeh iss liye kay yeh woh log hain jinhen samajh nahi hai .

verses.text: yeh sabb log ikatthay ho ker bhi tum say jang nahi keren gay , magar aesi bastiyon mein jo qalon mein mehfooz hon , ya phir deewaron kay peechay chup ker . inn ki aapas ki mukhalfaten boht sakht hain . tum enhen ikattha samajhtay ho , halankay inn kay dil phatay huye hain . yeh iss liye kay yeh woh log hain jinhen aqal nahi hai .
verses.translation: yeh sabb log ikatthay ho ker bhi tum say jang nahi keren gay , magar aesi bastiyon mein jo qalon mein mehfooz hon , ya phir deewaron kay peechay chup ker . inn ki aapas ki mukhalfaten boht sakht hain . tum enhen ikattha samajhtay ho , halankay inn kay dil phatay huye hain . yeh iss liye kay yeh woh log hain jinhen aqal nahi hai .

verses.text: inn ki halat unn logon  ki si hai jo inn say kuch hi pehlay apney kartoot ka maza chakh chukay hain   aur inn kay liye dardnak azab hai .
verses.translation: inn ki halat unn logon  ki si hai jo inn say kuch hi pehlay apney kartoot ka maza chakh chukay hain   aur inn kay liye dardnak azab hai .

verses.text: inn ki misal shetan ki si hai kay woh insan say kehta hai kay :  kafir hoja  phir jab woh kafir hojata hai to kehta hai kay :  mein tujh say bari hun , mein to Allah say darta hun jo saray jahano ka perwerdigar hai .
verses.translation: inn ki misal shetan ki si hai kay woh insan say kehta hai kay :  kafir hoja  phir jab woh kafir hojata hai to kehta hai kay :  mein tujh say bari hun , mein to Allah say darta hun jo saray jahano ka perwerdigar hai .

verses.text: chunacheh inn dono ka anjam yeh hai kay woh dono dozakh mein hon gay jahan woh hamesha rahen gay . aur yehi zulm kernay walon ki saza hai .
verses.translation: chunacheh inn dono ka anjam yeh hai kay woh dono dozakh mein hon gay jahan woh hamesha rahen gay . aur yehi zulm kernay walon ki saza hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah say daro , aur her shaks yeh dekhay kay uss ney kal kay liye kiya aagay bheja hai . aur Allah say daro . yaqeen rakho kay jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah say daro , aur her shaks yeh dekhay kay uss ney kal kay liye kiya aagay bheja hai . aur Allah say daro . yaqeen rakho kay jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: aur tum unn jaisay naa hojana jo Allah ko bhool bethay thay , to Allah ney unhen khud apney aap say ghafil kerdiya .   wohi log hain jo nafarman hain .
verses.translation: aur tum unn jaisay naa hojana jo Allah ko bhool bethay thay , to Allah ney unhen khud apney aap say ghafil kerdiya .   wohi log hain jo nafarman hain .

verses.text: jannat walay aur dozakh walay barabar nahi hosaktay . jannat walay hi woh hain jo kamiyab hain .
verses.translation: jannat walay aur dozakh walay barabar nahi hosaktay . jannat walay hi woh hain jo kamiyab hain .

verses.text: agar hum ney yeh Quran kissi pahar per utaara hota to tum ussay dekhtay kay woh Allah kay roab say jhuka jaraha hai , aur phata parrta hai . aur hum yeh misalen logon  kay samney iss liye biyan kertay hain takay woh ghor-o-fiker say kaam len .
verses.translation: agar hum ney yeh Quran kissi pahar per utaara hota to tum ussay dekhtay kay woh Allah kay roab say jhuka jaraha hai , aur phata parrta hai . aur hum yeh misalen logon  kay samney iss liye biyan kertay hain takay woh ghor-o-fiker say kaam len .

verses.text: woh Allah wohi hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi . woh chupi aur khuli her baat ko janney wala hai . wohi hai jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai .
verses.translation: woh Allah wohi hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi . woh chupi aur khuli her baat ko janney wala hai . wohi hai jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai .

verses.text: woh Allah wohi hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai , jo badshah hai , taqadduss ka malik hai , salamti denay wala hai , aman bakhshney wala hai , sabb ka nigehban hai , baray iqtidar wala hai , her kharabi ki islaah kernay wala hai , barai ka malik hai . pak hai Allah uss shirk say jo yeh log kertay hain .
verses.translation: woh Allah wohi hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai , jo badshah hai , taqadduss ka malik hai , salamti denay wala hai , aman bakhshney wala hai , sabb ka nigehban hai , baray iqtidar wala hai , her kharabi ki islaah kernay wala hai , barai ka malik hai . pak hai Allah uss shirk say jo yeh log kertay hain .

verses.text: woh Allah wohi hai jo peda kernay wala hai , wajood mein laney wala hai , soorat bananey wala hai ,   ussi kay sabb say achay naam hain . aasmano aur zameen mein jitni cheezen hain , woh uss ki tasbeeh kerti hain , aur wohi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
verses.translation: woh Allah wohi hai jo peda kernay wala hai , wajood mein laney wala hai , soorat bananey wala hai ,   ussi kay sabb say achay naam hain . aasmano aur zameen mein jitni cheezen hain , woh uss ki tasbeeh kerti hain , aur wohi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.translation: aasmano aur zameen mein jo bhi koi cheez hai , uss ney Allah ki tasbeeh ki hai , aur wohi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

ayahs.text: wohi hai jiss ney ehal-e-kitab mein say kafir logon  ko unn kay gharon say pehlay ijtima kay moaqa per nikal diya .   ( musalmano ! ) tumhen yeh khayal bhi nahi tha kay woh niklen gay , aur woh bhi yeh samjhay huye thay kay unn kay qalay enhen/unhen Allah say bacha len gay . phir Allah unn kay paas aesi jagah say aaya jahan unn ka gumaan bhi nahi tha , aur Allah ney unn kay dilon mein roab daal diya kay woh apney gharon ko khud apney haathon say bhi aur musalmanon kay haathon say bhi ujaarr rahey thay .   lehaza aey aankhon walo ! ibrat hasil kerlo .
ayahs.translation: wohi hai jiss ney ehal-e-kitab mein say kafir logon  ko unn kay gharon say pehlay ijtima kay moaqa per nikal diya .   ( musalmano ! ) tumhen yeh khayal bhi nahi tha kay woh niklen gay , aur woh bhi yeh samjhay huye thay kay unn kay qalay enhen/unhen Allah say bacha len gay . phir Allah unn kay paas aesi jagah say aaya jahan unn ka gumaan bhi nahi tha , aur Allah ney unn kay dilon mein roab daal diya kay woh apney gharon ko khud apney haathon say bhi aur musalmanon kay haathon say bhi ujaarr rahey thay .   lehaza aey aankhon walo ! ibrat hasil kerlo .

ayahs.text: aur agar Allah ney unn ki qismat mein jala watni naa likh di hoti to woh duniya hi mein unn ko azab dey deta ,   albatta aakhirat mein unn kay liye dozakh ka azab hai .
ayahs.translation: aur agar Allah ney unn ki qismat mein jala watni naa likh di hoti to woh duniya hi mein unn ko azab dey deta ,   albatta aakhirat mein unn kay liye dozakh ka azab hai .

ayahs.text: yeh iss liye kay unhon ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool say dushmani thaani , aur jo shaks Allah say dushmani kerta hai , to Allah bara sakht azab denay wala hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh iss liye kay unhon ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool say dushmani thaani , aur jo shaks Allah say dushmani kerta hai , to Allah bara sakht azab denay wala hai .

ayahs.text: tum ney khujoor kay jo darkht kaatay , ya unhen apni jarron per kharra rehney diya , to yeh sabb kuch Allah kay hukum say tha ,   aur iss liye tha takay Allah nafarmano ko ruswa keray .
ayahs.translation: tum ney khujoor kay jo darkht kaatay , ya unhen apni jarron per kharra rehney diya , to yeh sabb kuch Allah kay hukum say tha ,   aur iss liye tha takay Allah nafarmano ko ruswa keray .

ayahs.text: aur Allah ney apney Rasool ko unn ka jo maal bhi fey kay tor per dlwaya , uss kay liye tum ney naa apney ghorray dorraye , naa oont , lekin Allah apney payghumberon ko jiss per chahta hai , tasallut ata farma deta hai .   aur Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: aur Allah ney apney Rasool ko unn ka jo maal bhi fey kay tor per dlwaya , uss kay liye tum ney naa apney ghorray dorraye , naa oont , lekin Allah apney payghumberon ko jiss per chahta hai , tasallut ata farma deta hai .   aur Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhney wala hai .

ayahs.text: Allah apney Rasool ko ( doosri ) bastiyon say jo maal bhi fey kay tor per dilwa dey , to woh Allah ka haq hai , aur uss kay Rasool ka , aur qraabat daaron ka , aur yateemon , miskeeno aur musfiron ka , takay woh maal sirf unhi kay darmiyan gardish kerta naa reh jaye jo tum mein dolat mand log hain . aur Rasool tumhen jo kuch den , woh ley lo , aur jiss cheez say mana keren , uss say ruk jao , aur Allah say dartay raho . beyshak Allah sakht saza denay wala hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah apney Rasool ko ( doosri ) bastiyon say jo maal bhi fey kay tor per dilwa dey , to woh Allah ka haq hai , aur uss kay Rasool ka , aur qraabat daaron ka , aur yateemon , miskeeno aur musfiron ka , takay woh maal sirf unhi kay darmiyan gardish kerta naa reh jaye jo tum mein dolat mand log hain . aur Rasool tumhen jo kuch den , woh ley lo , aur jiss cheez say mana keren , uss say ruk jao , aur Allah say dartay raho . beyshak Allah sakht saza denay wala hai .

ayahs.text: . ( neez yeh maal fey ) unn hajat mand mohajreen ka haq hai jinhen apney gharon aur apney maalon say bey dakhal kiya gaya hai .   woh Allah ki taraf say fazal aur uss ki khushnoodi kay talab gaar hain , aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki madad kertay hain . yehi log hain jo raast baaz hain .
ayahs.translation: . ( neez yeh maal fey ) unn hajat mand mohajreen ka haq hai jinhen apney gharon aur apney maalon say bey dakhal kiya gaya hai .   woh Allah ki taraf say fazal aur uss ki khushnoodi kay talab gaar hain , aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki madad kertay hain . yehi log hain jo raast baaz hain .

ayahs.text: . ( aur yeh maal fey ) unn logon  ka haq hai jo pehlay hi say iss jagah ( yani madina mein ) emaan kay sath muqeem hain ,   jo koi unn kay paas hijrat ker kay aata hai , yeh uss say mohabbat kertay hain , aur jo kuch unn ( mohajreen ) ko diya jata hai , yeh apney seenon mein uss ki koi khuwaish bhi mehsoos nahi kertay , aur unn ko apney aap per tarjeeh detay hain , chahye unn per tang dasti ki halat guzar rahi ho .   aur jo log apni tabiyat kay bukhul say mehfooz hojayen , wohi hain jo falah paaney walay hain .
ayahs.translation: . ( aur yeh maal fey ) unn logon  ka haq hai jo pehlay hi say iss jagah ( yani madina mein ) emaan kay sath muqeem hain ,   jo koi unn kay paas hijrat ker kay aata hai , yeh uss say mohabbat kertay hain , aur jo kuch unn ( mohajreen ) ko diya jata hai , yeh apney seenon mein uss ki koi khuwaish bhi mehsoos nahi kertay , aur unn ko apney aap per tarjeeh detay hain , chahye unn per tang dasti ki halat guzar rahi ho .   aur jo log apni tabiyat kay bukhul say mehfooz hojayen , wohi hain jo falah paaney walay hain .

ayahs.text: aur ( yeh maal fey ) unn logon  ka bhi haq hai jo inn ( mohajreen aur ansaar ) kay baad aaye ,   woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! humari bhi maghfirat farmaiye , aur humaray unn bhaiyon ki bhi jo hum say pehlay emaan laa-chukay hain , aur humaray dilon mein emaan laney walon kay liye koi bughz naa rakhiye . aey humaray perwerdigar ! aap boht shafiq , boht meharban hain .
ayahs.translation: aur ( yeh maal fey ) unn logon  ka bhi haq hai jo inn ( mohajreen aur ansaar ) kay baad aaye ,   woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! humari bhi maghfirat farmaiye , aur humaray unn bhaiyon ki bhi jo hum say pehlay emaan laa-chukay hain , aur humaray dilon mein emaan laney walon kay liye koi bughz naa rakhiye . aey humaray perwerdigar ! aap boht shafiq , boht meharban hain .

ayahs.text: kiya tum ney unn ko nahi dekha jinhon ney munafiqat say kaam liya hai kay woh apney unn bhaiyon say jo kafir ehal-e-kitab mein say hain yeh kehtay hain kay :  agar tumhen nikala gaya to hum bhi tumharay sath niklen gay , aur tumharay baaray mein kabhi kissi aur ka kehna nahi maanen gay , aur agar tum say jang ki gaee to hum tumhari madad keren gay .  aur Allah gawahi deta hai kay yeh log bilkul jhootay hain .
ayahs.translation: kiya tum ney unn ko nahi dekha jinhon ney munafiqat say kaam liya hai kay woh apney unn bhaiyon say jo kafir ehal-e-kitab mein say hain yeh kehtay hain kay :  agar tumhen nikala gaya to hum bhi tumharay sath niklen gay , aur tumharay baaray mein kabhi kissi aur ka kehna nahi maanen gay , aur agar tum say jang ki gaee to hum tumhari madad keren gay .  aur Allah gawahi deta hai kay yeh log bilkul jhootay hain .

ayahs.text: yeh pakki baat hai kay agar inn ( ehal-e-kitab ) ko nikala gaya to yeh unn kay sath nahi niklen gay ,   aur agar unn say jang ki gaee to yeh unn ki madad nahi keren gay , aur agar bil-farz unn ki madad ki bhi to peeth pher ker bhagen gay , phir inn ki koi madad nahi keray ga .
ayahs.translation: yeh pakki baat hai kay agar inn ( ehal-e-kitab ) ko nikala gaya to yeh unn kay sath nahi niklen gay ,   aur agar unn say jang ki gaee to yeh unn ki madad nahi keren gay , aur agar bil-farz unn ki madad ki bhi to peeth pher ker bhagen gay , phir inn ki koi madad nahi keray ga .

ayahs.text: . ( musalmano ! ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn kay dilon mein tumhari dehshat Allah say ziyada hai . yeh iss liye kay yeh woh log hain jinhen samajh nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: . ( musalmano ! ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn kay dilon mein tumhari dehshat Allah say ziyada hai . yeh iss liye kay yeh woh log hain jinhen samajh nahi hai .

ayahs.text: yeh sabb log ikatthay ho ker bhi tum say jang nahi keren gay , magar aesi bastiyon mein jo qalon mein mehfooz hon , ya phir deewaron kay peechay chup ker . inn ki aapas ki mukhalfaten boht sakht hain . tum enhen ikattha samajhtay ho , halankay inn kay dil phatay huye hain . yeh iss liye kay yeh woh log hain jinhen aqal nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: yeh sabb log ikatthay ho ker bhi tum say jang nahi keren gay , magar aesi bastiyon mein jo qalon mein mehfooz hon , ya phir deewaron kay peechay chup ker . inn ki aapas ki mukhalfaten boht sakht hain . tum enhen ikattha samajhtay ho , halankay inn kay dil phatay huye hain . yeh iss liye kay yeh woh log hain jinhen aqal nahi hai .

ayahs.text: inn ki halat unn logon  ki si hai jo inn say kuch hi pehlay apney kartoot ka maza chakh chukay hain   aur inn kay liye dardnak azab hai .
ayahs.translation: inn ki halat unn logon  ki si hai jo inn say kuch hi pehlay apney kartoot ka maza chakh chukay hain   aur inn kay liye dardnak azab hai .

ayahs.text: inn ki misal shetan ki si hai kay woh insan say kehta hai kay :  kafir hoja  phir jab woh kafir hojata hai to kehta hai kay :  mein tujh say bari hun , mein to Allah say darta hun jo saray jahano ka perwerdigar hai .
ayahs.translation: inn ki misal shetan ki si hai kay woh insan say kehta hai kay :  kafir hoja  phir jab woh kafir hojata hai to kehta hai kay :  mein tujh say bari hun , mein to Allah say darta hun jo saray jahano ka perwerdigar hai .

ayahs.text: chunacheh inn dono ka anjam yeh hai kay woh dono dozakh mein hon gay jahan woh hamesha rahen gay . aur yehi zulm kernay walon ki saza hai .
ayahs.translation: chunacheh inn dono ka anjam yeh hai kay woh dono dozakh mein hon gay jahan woh hamesha rahen gay . aur yehi zulm kernay walon ki saza hai .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah say daro , aur her shaks yeh dekhay kay uss ney kal kay liye kiya aagay bheja hai . aur Allah say daro . yaqeen rakho kay jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! Allah say daro , aur her shaks yeh dekhay kay uss ney kal kay liye kiya aagay bheja hai . aur Allah say daro . yaqeen rakho kay jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

ayahs.text: aur tum unn jaisay naa hojana jo Allah ko bhool bethay thay , to Allah ney unhen khud apney aap say ghafil kerdiya .   wohi log hain jo nafarman hain .
ayahs.translation: aur tum unn jaisay naa hojana jo Allah ko bhool bethay thay , to Allah ney unhen khud apney aap say ghafil kerdiya .   wohi log hain jo nafarman hain .

ayahs.text: jannat walay aur dozakh walay barabar nahi hosaktay . jannat walay hi woh hain jo kamiyab hain .
ayahs.translation: jannat walay aur dozakh walay barabar nahi hosaktay . jannat walay hi woh hain jo kamiyab hain .

ayahs.text: agar hum ney yeh Quran kissi pahar per utaara hota to tum ussay dekhtay kay woh Allah kay roab say jhuka jaraha hai , aur phata parrta hai . aur hum yeh misalen logon  kay samney iss liye biyan kertay hain takay woh ghor-o-fiker say kaam len .
ayahs.translation: agar hum ney yeh Quran kissi pahar per utaara hota to tum ussay dekhtay kay woh Allah kay roab say jhuka jaraha hai , aur phata parrta hai . aur hum yeh misalen logon  kay samney iss liye biyan kertay hain takay woh ghor-o-fiker say kaam len .

ayahs.text: woh Allah wohi hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi . woh chupi aur khuli her baat ko janney wala hai . wohi hai jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: woh Allah wohi hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi . woh chupi aur khuli her baat ko janney wala hai . wohi hai jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai .

ayahs.text: woh Allah wohi hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai , jo badshah hai , taqadduss ka malik hai , salamti denay wala hai , aman bakhshney wala hai , sabb ka nigehban hai , baray iqtidar wala hai , her kharabi ki islaah kernay wala hai , barai ka malik hai . pak hai Allah uss shirk say jo yeh log kertay hain .
ayahs.translation: woh Allah wohi hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai , jo badshah hai , taqadduss ka malik hai , salamti denay wala hai , aman bakhshney wala hai , sabb ka nigehban hai , baray iqtidar wala hai , her kharabi ki islaah kernay wala hai , barai ka malik hai . pak hai Allah uss shirk say jo yeh log kertay hain .

ayahs.text: woh Allah wohi hai jo peda kernay wala hai , wajood mein laney wala hai , soorat bananey wala hai ,   ussi kay sabb say achay naam hain . aasmano aur zameen mein jitni cheezen hain , woh uss ki tasbeeh kerti hain , aur wohi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
ayahs.translation: woh Allah wohi hai jo peda kernay wala hai , wajood mein laney wala hai , soorat bananey wala hai ,   ussi kay sabb say achay naam hain . aasmano aur zameen mein jitni cheezen hain , woh uss ki tasbeeh kerti hain , aur wohi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

english_meaning: She that is to be examined

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! agar tum meray raastay mein jihad kernay ki khatir aur meri khushnoodi hasil kernay kay liye ( gharon say ) niklay ho to meray dushmanon aur apney dushmanon ko aisa dost matt banao kay unn ko mohabbat kay paygham bhejney lago , halankay tumharay paas jo haq aaya hai , unhon ney uss ko itna jhutlaya hai kay woh Rasool ko bhi aur tumhen bhi sirf iss wajeh say ( makkay say ) bahir nikaltay rahey hain kay tum apney perwerdigar Allah per emaan laye ho . tum unn say khufiya tor per dosti ki baat kertay ho , halankay jo kuch tum khufiya tor per kertay ho , aur jo kuch aelania kertay ho , mein uss sabb ko poori tarah janta hun . aur tum mein say koi bhi aisa keray , woh raah-e-raast say bhatak gaya .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! agar tum meray raastay mein jihad kernay ki khatir aur meri khushnoodi hasil kernay kay liye ( gharon say ) niklay ho to meray dushmanon aur apney dushmanon ko aisa dost matt banao kay unn ko mohabbat kay paygham bhejney lago , halankay tumharay paas jo haq aaya hai , unhon ney uss ko itna jhutlaya hai kay woh Rasool ko bhi aur tumhen bhi sirf iss wajeh say ( makkay say ) bahir nikaltay rahey hain kay tum apney perwerdigar Allah per emaan laye ho . tum unn say khufiya tor per dosti ki baat kertay ho , halankay jo kuch tum khufiya tor per kertay ho , aur jo kuch aelania kertay ho , mein uss sabb ko poori tarah janta hun . aur tum mein say koi bhi aisa keray , woh raah-e-raast say bhatak gaya .

verses.text: agar tum unn kay haath aajao to woh tumharay dushman ban jayen gay , aur apney haath aur zabanen phela phela ker tumharay sath burai keren gay , aur unn ki khuwaish yeh hai kay tum kafir ban jao .
verses.translation: agar tum unn kay haath aajao to woh tumharay dushman ban jayen gay , aur apney haath aur zabanen phela phela ker tumharay sath burai keren gay , aur unn ki khuwaish yeh hai kay tum kafir ban jao .

verses.text: qayamat kay din naa tumhari rishta daariyan hergiz tumharay kaam ayen gi , aur naa tumhari aulad . Allah hi tumharay darmiyan faisla keray ga , aur tum jo kuch kertay ho , Allah ussay poori tarah dekhta hai .
verses.translation: qayamat kay din naa tumhari rishta daariyan hergiz tumharay kaam ayen gi , aur naa tumhari aulad . Allah hi tumharay darmiyan faisla keray ga , aur tum jo kuch kertay ho , Allah ussay poori tarah dekhta hai .

verses.text: tumharay liye Ibrahim aur unn kay sathiyon mein behtareen namoona hai , jab unhon ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  humara tum say aur Allah kay siwa tum jinn jinn ki ibadat kertay ho , unn say koi talluq nahi hai . hum tumharay ( aqaeed kay ) munkir hain , aur humaray aur tumharay darmiyan hamesha kay liye dushmani aur bughz peda hogaya hai jab tak tum sirf aik Allah per emaan naa lao . albatta Ibrahim ney apney baap say yeh zaroor kaha tha kay :  mein aap kay liye Allah say maghfirat ki dua zaroor maangun ga , agar-cheh Allah kay samney mein aap ko koi faeeda phonchaney ka koi ikhtiyar nahi rakhta .   aey humaray perwerdigar ! aap hi per hum ney bharosa kiya hai , aur aap hi ki taraf hum rujoo huye hain , aur aap hi ki taraf sabb ko loat ker jana hai .
verses.translation: tumharay liye Ibrahim aur unn kay sathiyon mein behtareen namoona hai , jab unhon ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  humara tum say aur Allah kay siwa tum jinn jinn ki ibadat kertay ho , unn say koi talluq nahi hai . hum tumharay ( aqaeed kay ) munkir hain , aur humaray aur tumharay darmiyan hamesha kay liye dushmani aur bughz peda hogaya hai jab tak tum sirf aik Allah per emaan naa lao . albatta Ibrahim ney apney baap say yeh zaroor kaha tha kay :  mein aap kay liye Allah say maghfirat ki dua zaroor maangun ga , agar-cheh Allah kay samney mein aap ko koi faeeda phonchaney ka koi ikhtiyar nahi rakhta .   aey humaray perwerdigar ! aap hi per hum ney bharosa kiya hai , aur aap hi ki taraf hum rujoo huye hain , aur aap hi ki taraf sabb ko loat ker jana hai .

verses.text: aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen kafiron ka takhta mashq naa banaiye , aur humaray perwerdigar ! humari maghfirat farma dijiye . yaqeenan aap , aur sirf aap ki zaat woh hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .
verses.translation: aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen kafiron ka takhta mashq naa banaiye , aur humaray perwerdigar ! humari maghfirat farma dijiye . yaqeenan aap , aur sirf aap ki zaat woh hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .

verses.text: . ( musalmano ! ) yaqeenan tumharay liye inn logon  kay tarz-e-amal mein behtareen namoona hai , her uss shaks kay liye jo Allah aur roz-e-aakhirat say umeed rakhta ho . aur jo shaks mun morray , to ( woh yaad rakhay kay ) Allah sabb say bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef .
verses.translation: . ( musalmano ! ) yaqeenan tumharay liye inn logon  kay tarz-e-amal mein behtareen namoona hai , her uss shaks kay liye jo Allah aur roz-e-aakhirat say umeed rakhta ho . aur jo shaks mun morray , to ( woh yaad rakhay kay ) Allah sabb say bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef .

verses.text: kuch baeed nahi hai kay Allah tumharay aur jinn logon  say tumhari dushmani hai , unn kay darmiyan dosti peda kerday , aur Allah bari qudrat wala hai , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .
verses.translation: kuch baeed nahi hai kay Allah tumharay aur jinn logon  say tumhari dushmani hai , unn kay darmiyan dosti peda kerday , aur Allah bari qudrat wala hai , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .

verses.text: Allah tumhen iss baat say mana nahi kerta kay jinn logon  ney deen kay moamlay mein tum say jang nahi ki , aur tumhen tumharay gharon say nahi nikala , unn kay sath tum koi naiki ka ya insaf ka moamla kero , yaqeenan Allah insaf kernay walon ko pasand kerta hai .
verses.translation: Allah tumhen iss baat say mana nahi kerta kay jinn logon  ney deen kay moamlay mein tum say jang nahi ki , aur tumhen tumharay gharon say nahi nikala , unn kay sath tum koi naiki ka ya insaf ka moamla kero , yaqeenan Allah insaf kernay walon ko pasand kerta hai .

verses.text: Allah to tumhen iss baat say mana kerta hai kay jinn logon  ney tumharay sath deen kay moamlay mein jang ki hai , aur tumhen apney gharon say nikala hai , aur tumhen nikalney mein aik doosray ki madad ki hai , tum unn say dosti rakho . aur jo log unn say dosti rakhen gay , woh zalim log hain .
verses.translation: Allah to tumhen iss baat say mana kerta hai kay jinn logon  ney tumharay sath deen kay moamlay mein jang ki hai , aur tumhen apney gharon say nikala hai , aur tumhen nikalney mein aik doosray ki madad ki hai , tum unn say dosti rakho . aur jo log unn say dosti rakhen gay , woh zalim log hain .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! jab tumharay paas musalman aurten hijrat ker kay ayen to tum unn ko janch liya kero . Allah hi unn kay emaan kay baaray mein behtar janta hai . phir jab tumhen yeh maloom hojaye kay woh momin aurten hain to tum unhen kafiron kay paas wapis naa bhejna . woh unn kafiron kay liye halal nahi hain , aur woh kafir inn kay liye halal nahi hain .   aur inn kafiron ney jo kuch ( inn aurton per mehar ki soorat mein ) kharch kiya ho , woh unhen ada kerdo .   aur tum per inn aurton say nikah kernay mein koi gunah nahi hai , jabkay tum ney unn kay mehar unhen ada kerdiye hon . aur tum kafir aurton ki asmaten apney qabazay mein baqi naa rakho , aur jo kuch tum ney ( unn kafir biwiyon per mehar ki soorat mein ) kharch kiya tha , woh tum ( unn kay naye shohron say ) maang lo ,   aur unhon ney jo kuch ( apni musalman hojaney wali biwiyon per ) kharch kiya tha , woh ( unn kay naye musalman shohron say ) maang len . yeh Allah ka faisla hai , wohi tumharay darmiyan faisla kerta hai , aur Allah baray ilm wala , bari hikmat wala hai .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! jab tumharay paas musalman aurten hijrat ker kay ayen to tum unn ko janch liya kero . Allah hi unn kay emaan kay baaray mein behtar janta hai . phir jab tumhen yeh maloom hojaye kay woh momin aurten hain to tum unhen kafiron kay paas wapis naa bhejna . woh unn kafiron kay liye halal nahi hain , aur woh kafir inn kay liye halal nahi hain .   aur inn kafiron ney jo kuch ( inn aurton per mehar ki soorat mein ) kharch kiya ho , woh unhen ada kerdo .   aur tum per inn aurton say nikah kernay mein koi gunah nahi hai , jabkay tum ney unn kay mehar unhen ada kerdiye hon . aur tum kafir aurton ki asmaten apney qabazay mein baqi naa rakho , aur jo kuch tum ney ( unn kafir biwiyon per mehar ki soorat mein ) kharch kiya tha , woh tum ( unn kay naye shohron say ) maang lo ,   aur unhon ney jo kuch ( apni musalman hojaney wali biwiyon per ) kharch kiya tha , woh ( unn kay naye musalman shohron say ) maang len . yeh Allah ka faisla hai , wohi tumharay darmiyan faisla kerta hai , aur Allah baray ilm wala , bari hikmat wala hai .

verses.text: aur agar tumhari biwiyon mein say koi kafiron kay paas jaker tumharay haath say nikal jaye , phir tumhari noabat aaye   to jinn logon  ki biwiyan jati rahi hain , unn ko itni raqam ada kerdo   jitni unhon ney ( apni unn biwiyon per ) kharch ki thi , aur Allah say dartay raho jiss per tum emaan laye ho .
verses.translation: aur agar tumhari biwiyon mein say koi kafiron kay paas jaker tumharay haath say nikal jaye , phir tumhari noabat aaye   to jinn logon  ki biwiyan jati rahi hain , unn ko itni raqam ada kerdo   jitni unhon ney ( apni unn biwiyon per ) kharch ki thi , aur Allah say dartay raho jiss per tum emaan laye ho .

verses.text: aey nabi ! jab tumharay paas musalman aurten iss baat per beyat kernay kay liye ayen kay woh Allah kay sath kissi bhi cheez ko shareek nahi maanen gi , aur chori nahi keren gi , aur zina nahi keren gi , aur apni aulad ko qatal nahi keren gi , aur naa koi aisa bohtan baandhen gi jo unhon ney apney haathon aur paon kay darmiyan gharr liya ho ,   aur naa kissi bhalay kaam mein tumhari nafarmani keren gi , to tum unn ko beyat kerliya kero , aur unn kay haq mein Allah say maghfirat ki dua kiya kero . yaqeenan Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .
verses.translation: aey nabi ! jab tumharay paas musalman aurten iss baat per beyat kernay kay liye ayen kay woh Allah kay sath kissi bhi cheez ko shareek nahi maanen gi , aur chori nahi keren gi , aur zina nahi keren gi , aur apni aulad ko qatal nahi keren gi , aur naa koi aisa bohtan baandhen gi jo unhon ney apney haathon aur paon kay darmiyan gharr liya ho ,   aur naa kissi bhalay kaam mein tumhari nafarmani keren gi , to tum unn ko beyat kerliya kero , aur unn kay haq mein Allah say maghfirat ki dua kiya kero . yaqeenan Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! unn logon  ko dost naa banao jinn per Allah ney ghazab farmaya hai . Who to aakhirat say issi tarah mayyus hochukay hain jaisay kafir log qabron mein madfoon logon  say mayyus hain .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! unn logon  ko dost naa banao jinn per Allah ney ghazab farmaya hai . Who to aakhirat say issi tarah mayyus hochukay hain jaisay kafir log qabron mein madfoon logon  say mayyus hain .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! agar tum meray raastay mein jihad kernay ki khatir aur meri khushnoodi hasil kernay kay liye ( gharon say ) niklay ho to meray dushmanon aur apney dushmanon ko aisa dost matt banao kay unn ko mohabbat kay paygham bhejney lago , halankay tumharay paas jo haq aaya hai , unhon ney uss ko itna jhutlaya hai kay woh Rasool ko bhi aur tumhen bhi sirf iss wajeh say ( makkay say ) bahir nikaltay rahey hain kay tum apney perwerdigar Allah per emaan laye ho . tum unn say khufiya tor per dosti ki baat kertay ho , halankay jo kuch tum khufiya tor per kertay ho , aur jo kuch aelania kertay ho , mein uss sabb ko poori tarah janta hun . aur tum mein say koi bhi aisa keray , woh raah-e-raast say bhatak gaya .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! agar tum meray raastay mein jihad kernay ki khatir aur meri khushnoodi hasil kernay kay liye ( gharon say ) niklay ho to meray dushmanon aur apney dushmanon ko aisa dost matt banao kay unn ko mohabbat kay paygham bhejney lago , halankay tumharay paas jo haq aaya hai , unhon ney uss ko itna jhutlaya hai kay woh Rasool ko bhi aur tumhen bhi sirf iss wajeh say ( makkay say ) bahir nikaltay rahey hain kay tum apney perwerdigar Allah per emaan laye ho . tum unn say khufiya tor per dosti ki baat kertay ho , halankay jo kuch tum khufiya tor per kertay ho , aur jo kuch aelania kertay ho , mein uss sabb ko poori tarah janta hun . aur tum mein say koi bhi aisa keray , woh raah-e-raast say bhatak gaya .

ayahs.text: agar tum unn kay haath aajao to woh tumharay dushman ban jayen gay , aur apney haath aur zabanen phela phela ker tumharay sath burai keren gay , aur unn ki khuwaish yeh hai kay tum kafir ban jao .
ayahs.translation: agar tum unn kay haath aajao to woh tumharay dushman ban jayen gay , aur apney haath aur zabanen phela phela ker tumharay sath burai keren gay , aur unn ki khuwaish yeh hai kay tum kafir ban jao .

ayahs.text: qayamat kay din naa tumhari rishta daariyan hergiz tumharay kaam ayen gi , aur naa tumhari aulad . Allah hi tumharay darmiyan faisla keray ga , aur tum jo kuch kertay ho , Allah ussay poori tarah dekhta hai .
ayahs.translation: qayamat kay din naa tumhari rishta daariyan hergiz tumharay kaam ayen gi , aur naa tumhari aulad . Allah hi tumharay darmiyan faisla keray ga , aur tum jo kuch kertay ho , Allah ussay poori tarah dekhta hai .

ayahs.text: tumharay liye Ibrahim aur unn kay sathiyon mein behtareen namoona hai , jab unhon ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  humara tum say aur Allah kay siwa tum jinn jinn ki ibadat kertay ho , unn say koi talluq nahi hai . hum tumharay ( aqaeed kay ) munkir hain , aur humaray aur tumharay darmiyan hamesha kay liye dushmani aur bughz peda hogaya hai jab tak tum sirf aik Allah per emaan naa lao . albatta Ibrahim ney apney baap say yeh zaroor kaha tha kay :  mein aap kay liye Allah say maghfirat ki dua zaroor maangun ga , agar-cheh Allah kay samney mein aap ko koi faeeda phonchaney ka koi ikhtiyar nahi rakhta .   aey humaray perwerdigar ! aap hi per hum ney bharosa kiya hai , aur aap hi ki taraf hum rujoo huye hain , aur aap hi ki taraf sabb ko loat ker jana hai .
ayahs.translation: tumharay liye Ibrahim aur unn kay sathiyon mein behtareen namoona hai , jab unhon ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  humara tum say aur Allah kay siwa tum jinn jinn ki ibadat kertay ho , unn say koi talluq nahi hai . hum tumharay ( aqaeed kay ) munkir hain , aur humaray aur tumharay darmiyan hamesha kay liye dushmani aur bughz peda hogaya hai jab tak tum sirf aik Allah per emaan naa lao . albatta Ibrahim ney apney baap say yeh zaroor kaha tha kay :  mein aap kay liye Allah say maghfirat ki dua zaroor maangun ga , agar-cheh Allah kay samney mein aap ko koi faeeda phonchaney ka koi ikhtiyar nahi rakhta .   aey humaray perwerdigar ! aap hi per hum ney bharosa kiya hai , aur aap hi ki taraf hum rujoo huye hain , aur aap hi ki taraf sabb ko loat ker jana hai .

ayahs.text: aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen kafiron ka takhta mashq naa banaiye , aur humaray perwerdigar ! humari maghfirat farma dijiye . yaqeenan aap , aur sirf aap ki zaat woh hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .
ayahs.translation: aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen kafiron ka takhta mashq naa banaiye , aur humaray perwerdigar ! humari maghfirat farma dijiye . yaqeenan aap , aur sirf aap ki zaat woh hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .

ayahs.text: . ( musalmano ! ) yaqeenan tumharay liye inn logon  kay tarz-e-amal mein behtareen namoona hai , her uss shaks kay liye jo Allah aur roz-e-aakhirat say umeed rakhta ho . aur jo shaks mun morray , to ( woh yaad rakhay kay ) Allah sabb say bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef .
ayahs.translation: . ( musalmano ! ) yaqeenan tumharay liye inn logon  kay tarz-e-amal mein behtareen namoona hai , her uss shaks kay liye jo Allah aur roz-e-aakhirat say umeed rakhta ho . aur jo shaks mun morray , to ( woh yaad rakhay kay ) Allah sabb say bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef .

ayahs.text: kuch baeed nahi hai kay Allah tumharay aur jinn logon  say tumhari dushmani hai , unn kay darmiyan dosti peda kerday , aur Allah bari qudrat wala hai , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: kuch baeed nahi hai kay Allah tumharay aur jinn logon  say tumhari dushmani hai , unn kay darmiyan dosti peda kerday , aur Allah bari qudrat wala hai , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .

ayahs.text: Allah tumhen iss baat say mana nahi kerta kay jinn logon  ney deen kay moamlay mein tum say jang nahi ki , aur tumhen tumharay gharon say nahi nikala , unn kay sath tum koi naiki ka ya insaf ka moamla kero , yaqeenan Allah insaf kernay walon ko pasand kerta hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah tumhen iss baat say mana nahi kerta kay jinn logon  ney deen kay moamlay mein tum say jang nahi ki , aur tumhen tumharay gharon say nahi nikala , unn kay sath tum koi naiki ka ya insaf ka moamla kero , yaqeenan Allah insaf kernay walon ko pasand kerta hai .

ayahs.text: Allah to tumhen iss baat say mana kerta hai kay jinn logon  ney tumharay sath deen kay moamlay mein jang ki hai , aur tumhen apney gharon say nikala hai , aur tumhen nikalney mein aik doosray ki madad ki hai , tum unn say dosti rakho . aur jo log unn say dosti rakhen gay , woh zalim log hain .
ayahs.translation: Allah to tumhen iss baat say mana kerta hai kay jinn logon  ney tumharay sath deen kay moamlay mein jang ki hai , aur tumhen apney gharon say nikala hai , aur tumhen nikalney mein aik doosray ki madad ki hai , tum unn say dosti rakho . aur jo log unn say dosti rakhen gay , woh zalim log hain .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai .
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai .

verses.text: aasmano aur zameen mein jo bhi koi cheez hai , uss ney Allah ki tasbeeh ki hai , aur wohi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
verses.translation: aasmano aur zameen mein jo bhi koi cheez hai , uss ney Allah ki tasbeeh ki hai , aur wohi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! tum aesi baat kiyon kehtay ho jo kertay nahi ho ?
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! tum aesi baat kiyon kehtay ho jo kertay nahi ho ?

verses.text: Allah kay nazdeek yeh baat bari qabil-e-nafrat hai kay tum aesi baat kaho jo kero nahi .
verses.translation: Allah kay nazdeek yeh baat bari qabil-e-nafrat hai kay tum aesi baat kaho jo kero nahi .

verses.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah unn logon  say mohabbat kerta hai jo uss kay raastay mein iss tarah saff bana ker larrtay hain jaisay woh seesa pilai hoi imarat hon .
verses.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah unn logon  say mohabbat kerta hai jo uss kay raastay mein iss tarah saff bana ker larrtay hain jaisay woh seesa pilai hoi imarat hon .

verses.text: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  aey meri qoam kay logo ! tum mujhay takleef kiyon phonchatay ho , halankay tum jantay ho kay mein tumharay paas Allah ka payghumber ban ker aaya hun-?    phir jab unhon ney tairrh raah ikhtiyar ki to Allah ney unn kay dilon ko tairrah kerdiya ,   aur Allah nafarman logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .
verses.translation: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  aey meri qoam kay logo ! tum mujhay takleef kiyon phonchatay ho , halankay tum jantay ho kay mein tumharay paas Allah ka payghumber ban ker aaya hun-?    phir jab unhon ney tairrh raah ikhtiyar ki to Allah ney unn kay dilon ko tairrah kerdiya ,   aur Allah nafarman logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .

verses.text: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab essa ban maryam ney kaha tha kay :  aey bano Israel ! mein tumharay paas Allah ka aisa payghumber ban ker aaya hun kay mujh say pehlay jo toraat ( nazil hoi ) thi , mein uss ki tasdeeq kernay wala hun , aur uss Rasool ki khushkhabri denay wala hun jo meray baad aaye ga , jiss ka naam Ahmed hai .    phir jab woh unn kay paas khuli khuli nishaniyan ley ker aaye to woh kehney lagay kay :  yeh to khula huwa jadoo hai .
verses.translation: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab essa ban maryam ney kaha tha kay :  aey bano Israel ! mein tumharay paas Allah ka aisa payghumber ban ker aaya hun kay mujh say pehlay jo toraat ( nazil hoi ) thi , mein uss ki tasdeeq kernay wala hun , aur uss Rasool ki khushkhabri denay wala hun jo meray baad aaye ga , jiss ka naam Ahmed hai .    phir jab woh unn kay paas khuli khuli nishaniyan ley ker aaye to woh kehney lagay kay :  yeh to khula huwa jadoo hai .

verses.text: aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay , jabkay ussay Islam ki taraf bulaya jaraha ho-?   aur Allah aesay zalim logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .
verses.translation: aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay , jabkay ussay Islam ki taraf bulaya jaraha ho-?   aur Allah aesay zalim logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .

verses.text: yeh log chahtay hain kay apney mun say Allah kay noor ko bujha den , halankay Allah apney noor ki takmeel ker kay rahey ga , chahye kafiron ko yeh baat kitni buri lagay .
verses.translation: yeh log chahtay hain kay apney mun say Allah kay noor ko bujha den , halankay Allah apney noor ki takmeel ker kay rahey ga , chahye kafiron ko yeh baat kitni buri lagay .

verses.text: wohi to hai jiss ney apney Rasool ko hidayat aur sachai ka deen dey ker bheja hai takay woh ussay tamam doosray deeno per ghalib kerday ,   chahye mushrik logon  ko yeh baat kitni buri lagay .
verses.translation: wohi to hai jiss ney apney Rasool ko hidayat aur sachai ka deen dey ker bheja hai takay woh ussay tamam doosray deeno per ghalib kerday ,   chahye mushrik logon  ko yeh baat kitni buri lagay .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! kiya mein tumhen aik aesi tijarat ka pata dun jo tumhen dardnak azab say nijat dila dey-?
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! kiya mein tumhen aik aesi tijarat ka pata dun jo tumhen dardnak azab say nijat dila dey-?

verses.text: . ( woh yeh hai kay ) tum Allah aur uss kay Rasool per emaan lao , aur apney maal o dolat aur apni janon say Allah kay raastay mein jihad kero . yeh tumharay liye behtareen baat hai , agar tum samjho .
verses.translation: . ( woh yeh hai kay ) tum Allah aur uss kay Rasool per emaan lao , aur apney maal o dolat aur apni janon say Allah kay raastay mein jihad kero . yeh tumharay liye behtareen baat hai , agar tum samjho .

verses.text: iss kay nateejay mein Allah tumhari khatir tumharay gunahon ko bakhsh dey ga , aur tumhen unn baaghon mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , aur aesay umda gharon mein basaye ga jo hamesha hamesha rehney wali jannaton mein waqay hon gay . yehi zabardast kamiyabi hai .
verses.translation: iss kay nateejay mein Allah tumhari khatir tumharay gunahon ko bakhsh dey ga , aur tumhen unn baaghon mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , aur aesay umda gharon mein basaye ga jo hamesha hamesha rehney wali jannaton mein waqay hon gay . yehi zabardast kamiyabi hai .

verses.text: aur aik aur cheez tumhen dey ga jo tumhen pasand hai , ( aur woh hai ) Allah ki taraf say madad , aur aik aesi fatah jo unqareeb hasil hogi ! aur ( aey payghumber ! ) emaan walon ko ( iss baat ki ) khushkhabri suna do .
verses.translation: aur aik aur cheez tumhen dey ga jo tumhen pasand hai , ( aur woh hai ) Allah ki taraf say madad , aur aik aesi fatah jo unqareeb hasil hogi ! aur ( aey payghumber ! ) emaan walon ko ( iss baat ki ) khushkhabri suna do .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! tum Allah ( kay deen ) kay madadgaar ban jao , ussi tarah jaisay essa ban maryam ( aleh-assalam ) ney hawariyon   say kaha tha kay :  woh kon hain jo Allah kay wastay meray madadgaar banen-?  hawariyon ney kaha :  hum Allah kay ( deen kay ) madadgaar hain .  phir bani Israel ka aik giroh emaan ley aaya , aur aik giroh ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya . chunacheh jo log emaan laye thay , hum ney unn kay dushmanon kay khilaf unn ki madad ki , nateeja yeh huwa kay woh ghalib aaye .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! tum Allah ( kay deen ) kay madadgaar ban jao , ussi tarah jaisay essa ban maryam ( aleh-assalam ) ney hawariyon   say kaha tha kay :  woh kon hain jo Allah kay wastay meray madadgaar banen-?  hawariyon ney kaha :  hum Allah kay ( deen kay ) madadgaar hain .  phir bani Israel ka aik giroh emaan ley aaya , aur aik giroh ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya . chunacheh jo log emaan laye thay , hum ney unn kay dushmanon kay khilaf unn ki madad ki , nateeja yeh huwa kay woh ghalib aaye .

ayahs.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai .

ayahs.text: aasmano aur zameen mein jo bhi koi cheez hai , uss ney Allah ki tasbeeh ki hai , aur wohi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
ayahs.translation: aasmano aur zameen mein jo bhi koi cheez hai , uss ney Allah ki tasbeeh ki hai , aur wohi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! tum aesi baat kiyon kehtay ho jo kertay nahi ho ?
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! tum aesi baat kiyon kehtay ho jo kertay nahi ho ?

ayahs.text: Allah kay nazdeek yeh baat bari qabil-e-nafrat hai kay tum aesi baat kaho jo kero nahi .
ayahs.translation: Allah kay nazdeek yeh baat bari qabil-e-nafrat hai kay tum aesi baat kaho jo kero nahi .

ayahs.text: haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah unn logon  say mohabbat kerta hai jo uss kay raastay mein iss tarah saff bana ker larrtay hain jaisay woh seesa pilai hoi imarat hon .
ayahs.translation: haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah unn logon  say mohabbat kerta hai jo uss kay raastay mein iss tarah saff bana ker larrtay hain jaisay woh seesa pilai hoi imarat hon .

ayahs.text: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  aey meri qoam kay logo ! tum mujhay takleef kiyon phonchatay ho , halankay tum jantay ho kay mein tumharay paas Allah ka payghumber ban ker aaya hun-?    phir jab unhon ney tairrh raah ikhtiyar ki to Allah ney unn kay dilon ko tairrah kerdiya ,   aur Allah nafarman logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .
ayahs.translation: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  aey meri qoam kay logo ! tum mujhay takleef kiyon phonchatay ho , halankay tum jantay ho kay mein tumharay paas Allah ka payghumber ban ker aaya hun-?    phir jab unhon ney tairrh raah ikhtiyar ki to Allah ney unn kay dilon ko tairrah kerdiya ,   aur Allah nafarman logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .

ayahs.text: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab essa ban maryam ney kaha tha kay :  aey bano Israel ! mein tumharay paas Allah ka aisa payghumber ban ker aaya hun kay mujh say pehlay jo toraat ( nazil hoi ) thi , mein uss ki tasdeeq kernay wala hun , aur uss Rasool ki khushkhabri denay wala hun jo meray baad aaye ga , jiss ka naam Ahmed hai .    phir jab woh unn kay paas khuli khuli nishaniyan ley ker aaye to woh kehney lagay kay :  yeh to khula huwa jadoo hai .
ayahs.translation: aur woh waqt yaad kero jab essa ban maryam ney kaha tha kay :  aey bano Israel ! mein tumharay paas Allah ka aisa payghumber ban ker aaya hun kay mujh say pehlay jo toraat ( nazil hoi ) thi , mein uss ki tasdeeq kernay wala hun , aur uss Rasool ki khushkhabri denay wala hun jo meray baad aaye ga , jiss ka naam Ahmed hai .    phir jab woh unn kay paas khuli khuli nishaniyan ley ker aaye to woh kehney lagay kay :  yeh to khula huwa jadoo hai .

ayahs.text: aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay , jabkay ussay Islam ki taraf bulaya jaraha ho-?   aur Allah aesay zalim logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .
ayahs.translation: aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay , jabkay ussay Islam ki taraf bulaya jaraha ho-?   aur Allah aesay zalim logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .

ayahs.text: yeh log chahtay hain kay apney mun say Allah kay noor ko bujha den , halankay Allah apney noor ki takmeel ker kay rahey ga , chahye kafiron ko yeh baat kitni buri lagay .
ayahs.translation: yeh log chahtay hain kay apney mun say Allah kay noor ko bujha den , halankay Allah apney noor ki takmeel ker kay rahey ga , chahye kafiron ko yeh baat kitni buri lagay .

ayahs.text: wohi to hai jiss ney apney Rasool ko hidayat aur sachai ka deen dey ker bheja hai takay woh ussay tamam doosray deeno per ghalib kerday ,   chahye mushrik logon  ko yeh baat kitni buri lagay .
ayahs.translation: wohi to hai jiss ney apney Rasool ko hidayat aur sachai ka deen dey ker bheja hai takay woh ussay tamam doosray deeno per ghalib kerday ,   chahye mushrik logon  ko yeh baat kitni buri lagay .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! kiya mein tumhen aik aesi tijarat ka pata dun jo tumhen dardnak azab say nijat dila dey-?
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! kiya mein tumhen aik aesi tijarat ka pata dun jo tumhen dardnak azab say nijat dila dey-?

ayahs.text: . ( woh yeh hai kay ) tum Allah aur uss kay Rasool per emaan lao , aur apney maal o dolat aur apni janon say Allah kay raastay mein jihad kero . yeh tumharay liye behtareen baat hai , agar tum samjho .
ayahs.translation: . ( woh yeh hai kay ) tum Allah aur uss kay Rasool per emaan lao , aur apney maal o dolat aur apni janon say Allah kay raastay mein jihad kero . yeh tumharay liye behtareen baat hai , agar tum samjho .

ayahs.text: iss kay nateejay mein Allah tumhari khatir tumharay gunahon ko bakhsh dey ga , aur tumhen unn baaghon mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , aur aesay umda gharon mein basaye ga jo hamesha hamesha rehney wali jannaton mein waqay hon gay . yehi zabardast kamiyabi hai .
ayahs.translation: iss kay nateejay mein Allah tumhari khatir tumharay gunahon ko bakhsh dey ga , aur tumhen unn baaghon mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , aur aesay umda gharon mein basaye ga jo hamesha hamesha rehney wali jannaton mein waqay hon gay . yehi zabardast kamiyabi hai .
