verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: aasmano aur zameen mein jo cheez bhi hai , woh Allah ki tasbeeh kerti hai jo badshah hai baray taqadduss ka malik hai , jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .
verses.translation: aasmano aur zameen mein jo cheez bhi hai , woh Allah ki tasbeeh kerti hai jo badshah hai baray taqadduss ka malik hai , jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .

verses.text: wohi hai jiss ney ummi logon  mein unhi mein say aik Rasool ko bheja jo unn kay samney uss ki aayaton ki tilawat keren , aur unn ko pakeezah banayen , aur unhen kitab aur hikmat ki taleem den , jabkay woh iss say pehlay khuli gumrahi mein parray huye thay ,
verses.translation: wohi hai jiss ney ummi logon  mein unhi mein say aik Rasool ko bheja jo unn kay samney uss ki aayaton ki tilawat keren , aur unn ko pakeezah banayen , aur unhen kitab aur hikmat ki taleem den , jabkay woh iss say pehlay khuli gumrahi mein parray huye thay ,

verses.text: aur ( yeh Rasool jinn ki taraf bhejay gaye hain ) unn mein kuch aur bhi hain jo abhi unn kay sath aa-ker nahi milay .   aur woh baray iqtidar wala , bari hikmat wala hai .
verses.translation: aur ( yeh Rasool jinn ki taraf bhejay gaye hain ) unn mein kuch aur bhi hain jo abhi unn kay sath aa-ker nahi milay .   aur woh baray iqtidar wala , bari hikmat wala hai .

verses.text: yeh Allah ka fazal hai , woh jissay chahta hai deta hai , aur Allah baray fazal wala hai .
verses.translation: yeh Allah ka fazal hai , woh jissay chahta hai deta hai , aur Allah baray fazal wala hai .

verses.text: jinn logon  per toraat ka bojh daala gaya , phir unhon ney iss ka bojh nahi uthaya ,   unn ki misal uss gadhay ki si hai jo boht si kitaben laadey huye ho . boht buri misal hai unn logon  ki jinhon ney Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlaya , aur Allah aesay zalim logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .
verses.translation: jinn logon  per toraat ka bojh daala gaya , phir unhon ney iss ka bojh nahi uthaya ,   unn ki misal uss gadhay ki si hai jo boht si kitaben laadey huye ho . boht buri misal hai unn logon  ki jinhon ney Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlaya , aur Allah aesay zalim logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho kay :  aey logo jo yahudi ban gaye ho ! agar tumhara dawa yeh hai kay saray logon  ko chorr ker tum hi Allah kay dost ho , to moat ki tamanna kero , agar tum sachay ho .
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho kay :  aey logo jo yahudi ban gaye ho ! agar tumhara dawa yeh hai kay saray logon  ko chorr ker tum hi Allah kay dost ho , to moat ki tamanna kero , agar tum sachay ho .

verses.text: aur unhon ney apney haathon jo aemal aagay bhej rakhay hain , unn ki wajeh say yeh kabhi moat ki tamanna nahi keren gay , aur Allah inn zalimon ko khoob janta hai .
verses.translation: aur unhon ney apney haathon jo aemal aagay bhej rakhay hain , unn ki wajeh say yeh kabhi moat ki tamanna nahi keren gay , aur Allah inn zalimon ko khoob janta hai .

verses.text: kaho kay :  jiss moat say tum bhagtay ho , woh tum say aa-milney wali hai , phir tumhen uss ( Allah ) ki taraf lotaya jaye ga jissay tamam posheeda aur khuli hoi baaton ka poora ilm hai , phir woh tumhen bataye ga kay tum kiya kuch kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: kaho kay :  jiss moat say tum bhagtay ho , woh tum say aa-milney wali hai , phir tumhen uss ( Allah ) ki taraf lotaya jaye ga jissay tamam posheeda aur khuli hoi baaton ka poora ilm hai , phir woh tumhen bataye ga kay tum kiya kuch kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! jab jumaa kay din namaz kay liye pukara jaye to Allah kay ziker ki taraf lapko , aur kharido farokht chorr do .   yeh tumharay liye behtar hai , agar tum samjho .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! jab jumaa kay din namaz kay liye pukara jaye to Allah kay ziker ki taraf lapko , aur kharido farokht chorr do .   yeh tumharay liye behtar hai , agar tum samjho .

verses.text: phir jab namaz poori hojaye to zameen mein muntashir hojao , aur Allah ka fazal talash kero ,   aur Allah ko kasrat say yaad kero , takay tumhen falah naseeb ho .
verses.translation: phir jab namaz poori hojaye to zameen mein muntashir hojao , aur Allah ka fazal talash kero ,   aur Allah ko kasrat say yaad kero , takay tumhen falah naseeb ho .

verses.text: aur jab kuch logon  ney koi tijarat ya koi khel dekha to uss ki taraf toot parray , aur tumhen kharra huwa chorr diya .   keh do kay :  jo kuch Allah kay paas hai , woh khel aur tijarat say kahen ziyada behtar hai , aur Allah sabb say behtar rizq denay wala hai .
verses.translation: aur jab kuch logon  ney koi tijarat ya koi khel dekha to uss ki taraf toot parray , aur tumhen kharra huwa chorr diya .   keh do kay :  jo kuch Allah kay paas hai , woh khel aur tijarat say kahen ziyada behtar hai , aur Allah sabb say behtar rizq denay wala hai .

verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: jab munafiq log tumharay paas aatay hain to kehtay hain :  hum gawahi detay hain kay aap Allah kay Rasool hain  aur Allah janta hai kay aap waqaee uss kay Rasool hain , aur Allah ( yeh bhi ) gawahi deta hai kay yeh munafiq log jhootay hain .
verses.translation: jab munafiq log tumharay paas aatay hain to kehtay hain :  hum gawahi detay hain kay aap Allah kay Rasool hain  aur Allah janta hai kay aap waqaee uss kay Rasool hain , aur Allah ( yeh bhi ) gawahi deta hai kay yeh munafiq log jhootay hain .

verses.text: enhon ney apni qasmon ko aik dhaal bana rakha hai ,   phir yeh log doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roktay hain . haqeeqat yeh hai kay boht hi buray hain woh kaam jo yeh log kertay rahey hain .
verses.translation: enhon ney apni qasmon ko aik dhaal bana rakha hai ,   phir yeh log doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roktay hain . haqeeqat yeh hai kay boht hi buray hain woh kaam jo yeh log kertay rahey hain .

verses.text: yeh sari baaten iss wajeh say hain kay yeh ( shuroo mein ba-zahir ) emaan ley aaye , phir enhon ney kufr apna liya , iss liye inn kay dilon per mohar laga di gaee , nateeja yeh kay yeh log ( haq baat ) samajhtay hi nahi hain .
verses.translation: yeh sari baaten iss wajeh say hain kay yeh ( shuroo mein ba-zahir ) emaan ley aaye , phir enhon ney kufr apna liya , iss liye inn kay dilon per mohar laga di gaee , nateeja yeh kay yeh log ( haq baat ) samajhtay hi nahi hain .

verses.text: jab tum inn ko dekho to inn kay deel dol tumhen boht achay lagen , aur agar woh baat keren to tum unn ki baaten suntay reh jao ,   unn ki misal aesi hai jaisay yeh lakriyan hain jo kissi saharay say lagi rakhi hain .   yeh her cheekh pukar ko apney khilaf samajhtay hain .   yehi hain jo ( tumharay ) dushman hain , iss liye inn say hoshiyar raho . Allah ki maar ho inn per ! yeh kahan ondhay chalay jarahey hain-?
verses.translation: jab tum inn ko dekho to inn kay deel dol tumhen boht achay lagen , aur agar woh baat keren to tum unn ki baaten suntay reh jao ,   unn ki misal aesi hai jaisay yeh lakriyan hain jo kissi saharay say lagi rakhi hain .   yeh her cheekh pukar ko apney khilaf samajhtay hain .   yehi hain jo ( tumharay ) dushman hain , iss liye inn say hoshiyar raho . Allah ki maar ho inn per ! yeh kahan ondhay chalay jarahey hain-?

verses.text: aur jab inn say kaha jata hai kay aao , Allah kay Rasool tumharay haq mein maghfirat ki dua keren , to yeh apney saron ko matkatay hain ,   aur tum enhen dekho gay kay woh baray ghamand kay aalam mein bey rukhi say kaam letay hain .

verses.text: yehi to hain jo kehtay hain kay jo log Rasool Allah kay paas hain unn per kuch kharch naa kero , yahan tak kay yeh khud hi muntashir hojayen gay ,   halankay aasmano aur zameen kay tamam khazaney Allah hi kay hain , lekin munafiq log samajhtay nahi hain .
verses.translation: yehi to hain jo kehtay hain kay jo log Rasool Allah kay paas hain unn per kuch kharch naa kero , yahan tak kay yeh khud hi muntashir hojayen gay ,   halankay aasmano aur zameen kay tamam khazaney Allah hi kay hain , lekin munafiq log samajhtay nahi hain .

verses.text: kehtay hain kay :  agar hum madina ko loat ker jayen gay to jo izzat wala hai , woh wahan say zillat walay ko nikal bahir keray ga    halankay izzat to Allah hi ko hasil hai , aur uss kay Rasool ko , aur emaan walon ko , lekin munafiq log nahi jantay .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! tumhari dolat aur tumhari aulad tumhen Allah ki yaad say ghafil naa kernay payen . aur jo log aisa keren gay , woh baray ghatay ka soda kernay walay hon gay .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! tumhari dolat aur tumhari aulad tumhen Allah ki yaad say ghafil naa kernay payen . aur jo log aisa keren gay , woh baray ghatay ka soda kernay walay hon gay .

verses.text: aur hum ney tumhen jo rizq diya hai , uss mein say ( Allah kay hukum kay mutabiq ) kharch kerlo , qabal iss kay kay tum mein say kissi kay paas moat aajaye to woh yeh kahey kay :  aey meray perwerdigar ! tu ney mujhay thori dair kay liye aur mohlat kiyon naa dey di kay mein khoob sadqa kerta , aur naik logon  mein shamil hojata .

verses.text: aur jab kissi shaks ka moyyan waqt aajaye ga to Allah ussay hergiz mohlat nahi dey ga , aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

ayahs.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

ayahs.text: jab munafiq log tumharay paas aatay hain to kehtay hain :  hum gawahi detay hain kay aap Allah kay Rasool hain  aur Allah janta hai kay aap waqaee uss kay Rasool hain , aur Allah ( yeh bhi ) gawahi deta hai kay yeh munafiq log jhootay hain .
ayahs.translation: jab munafiq log tumharay paas aatay hain to kehtay hain :  hum gawahi detay hain kay aap Allah kay Rasool hain  aur Allah janta hai kay aap waqaee uss kay Rasool hain , aur Allah ( yeh bhi ) gawahi deta hai kay yeh munafiq log jhootay hain .

ayahs.text: enhon ney apni qasmon ko aik dhaal bana rakha hai ,   phir yeh log doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roktay hain . haqeeqat yeh hai kay boht hi buray hain woh kaam jo yeh log kertay rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: enhon ney apni qasmon ko aik dhaal bana rakha hai ,   phir yeh log doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roktay hain . haqeeqat yeh hai kay boht hi buray hain woh kaam jo yeh log kertay rahey hain .

ayahs.text: yeh sari baaten iss wajeh say hain kay yeh ( shuroo mein ba-zahir ) emaan ley aaye , phir enhon ney kufr apna liya , iss liye inn kay dilon per mohar laga di gaee , nateeja yeh kay yeh log ( haq baat ) samajhtay hi nahi hain .

ayahs.text: jab tum inn ko dekho to inn kay deel dol tumhen boht achay lagen , aur agar woh baat keren to tum unn ki baaten suntay reh jao ,   unn ki misal aesi hai jaisay yeh lakriyan hain jo kissi saharay say lagi rakhi hain .   yeh her cheekh pukar ko apney khilaf samajhtay hain .   yehi hain jo ( tumharay ) dushman hain , iss liye inn say hoshiyar raho . Allah ki maar ho inn per ! yeh kahan ondhay chalay jarahey hain-?

verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: aasmano aur zameen mein jo cheez bhi hai , woh Allah ki tasbeeh kerti hai , aur badshahi ussi ki hai , aur tareef ussi ki , aur woh her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai .
verses.translation: aasmano aur zameen mein jo cheez bhi hai , woh Allah ki tasbeeh kerti hai , aur badshahi ussi ki hai , aur tareef ussi ki , aur woh her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai .

verses.text: wohi hai jiss ney tumhen peda kiya , phir tum mein say koi kafir hai , aur koi momin . aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah ussay khoob dekhta hai .
verses.translation: wohi hai jiss ney tumhen peda kiya , phir tum mein say koi kafir hai , aur koi momin . aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah ussay khoob dekhta hai .

verses.text: uss ney aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq peda kiya hai , aur tumhari soorten banai hain , aur tumhari soorten achi banai hain , aur ussi ki taraf aakhir kaar ( sabb ko ) palat ker jana hai .
verses.translation: uss ney aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq peda kiya hai , aur tumhari soorten banai hain , aur tumhari soorten achi banai hain , aur ussi ki taraf aakhir kaar ( sabb ko ) palat ker jana hai .

verses.text: aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , woh ussay janta hai , aur jo kuch tum chup ker kertay ho aur jo kuch khullam khula kertay ho , uss ka bhi ussay poora ilm hai , aur Allah dilon ki baaton tak ka khoob janney wala hai .
verses.translation: aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , woh ussay janta hai , aur jo kuch tum chup ker kertay ho aur jo kuch khullam khula kertay ho , uss ka bhi ussay poora ilm hai , aur Allah dilon ki baaton tak ka khoob janney wala hai .

verses.text: kiya tumharay paas unn logon  kay waqiyaat nahi phonchay jinhon ney pehlay kufr ikhtiyar kiya tha , phir apney kamon ka wabal chakha , aur ( aaenda ) unn kay hissay mein aik dardnak azab hai-?
verses.translation: kiya tumharay paas unn logon  kay waqiyaat nahi phonchay jinhon ney pehlay kufr ikhtiyar kiya tha , phir apney kamon ka wabal chakha , aur ( aaenda ) unn kay hissay mein aik dardnak azab hai-?

verses.text: yeh sabb kuch iss liye huwa kay unn kay paas unn kay payghumber roshan dalaeel ley ker aatay thay to woh kehtay thay kay :  kiya ( hum jaisay ) insan hain jo hamen hidayat den gay-? gharz unhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya , aur mun morra , aur Allah ney bhi bey niazi barti , aur Allah bilkul bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef !
verses.translation: yeh sabb kuch iss liye huwa kay unn kay paas unn kay payghumber roshan dalaeel ley ker aatay thay to woh kehtay thay kay :  kiya ( hum jaisay ) insan hain jo hamen hidayat den gay-? gharz unhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya , aur mun morra , aur Allah ney bhi bey niazi barti , aur Allah bilkul bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef !

verses.text: jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh yeh dawa kertay hain kay unhen kabhi dobara zinda nahi kiya jaye ga . keh do :  kiyon nahi-? meray perwerdigar ki qasam ! tumhen zaroor dobara zinda kiya jaye ga , phir tumhen bataya jaye ga kay tum ney kiya kuch kiya tha , aur yeh Allah kay liye mamooli si baat hai .

verses.text: lehaza Allah per aur uss kay Rasool per aur uss roshni per emaan lao jo hum ney nazil ki hai , aur tum jo kuch kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: lehaza Allah per aur uss kay Rasool per aur uss roshni per emaan lao jo hum ney nazil ki hai , aur tum jo kuch kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: . ( yeh doosri zindagi ) uss din ( hogi ) jab Allah tumhen roz-e-hashar mein ikattha keray ga . woh aisa din hoga jiss mein kuch log doosron ko hasrat mein daal den gay ,   aur jo shaks Allah per emaan laya hoga , aur uss ney naik amal kiye hon gay , Allah uss kay gunahon ko moaaf kerday ga , aur uss ko aesay baaghon mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jinn mein woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay . yeh hai bari kamiyabi .
verses.translation: . ( yeh doosri zindagi ) uss din ( hogi ) jab Allah tumhen roz-e-hashar mein ikattha keray ga . woh aisa din hoga jiss mein kuch log doosron ko hasrat mein daal den gay ,   aur jo shaks Allah per emaan laya hoga , aur uss ney naik amal kiye hon gay , Allah uss kay gunahon ko moaaf kerday ga , aur uss ko aesay baaghon mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jinn mein woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay . yeh hai bari kamiyabi .

verses.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya hoga , aur humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hoga , woh dozakh walay hon gay jiss mein woh hamesha rahen gay , aur woh boht bura thikana hai .

verses.text: koi museebat Allah kay hukum kay baghair nahi aati , aur jo koi Allah per emaan lata hai , woh uss kay dil ko hidayat bakhshta hai ,   aur Allah her cheez ko khoob janney wala hai .

verses.text: aur tum Allah ki farmanbardaari kero , aur Rasool ki farmanbardaari kero . phir agar tum ney mun morra to humaray Rasool ki zimma daari sirf yeh hai kay woh saaf saaf baat phoncha dey .

verses.text: Allah woh hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai , aur mominon ko Allah hi per bharosa kerna chahiye .

ayahs.text: lehaza Allah per aur uss kay Rasool per aur uss roshni per emaan lao jo hum ney nazil ki hai , aur tum jo kuch kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
ayahs.translation: lehaza Allah per aur uss kay Rasool per aur uss roshni per emaan lao jo hum ney nazil ki hai , aur tum jo kuch kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

ayahs.text: . ( yeh doosri zindagi ) uss din ( hogi ) jab Allah tumhen roz-e-hashar mein ikattha keray ga . woh aisa din hoga jiss mein kuch log doosron ko hasrat mein daal den gay ,   aur jo shaks Allah per emaan laya hoga , aur uss ney naik amal kiye hon gay , Allah uss kay gunahon ko moaaf kerday ga , aur uss ko aesay baaghon mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jinn mein woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay . yeh hai bari kamiyabi .
ayahs.translation: . ( yeh doosri zindagi ) uss din ( hogi ) jab Allah tumhen roz-e-hashar mein ikattha keray ga . woh aisa din hoga jiss mein kuch log doosron ko hasrat mein daal den gay ,   aur jo shaks Allah per emaan laya hoga , aur uss ney naik amal kiye hon gay , Allah uss kay gunahon ko moaaf kerday ga , aur uss ko aesay baaghon mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jinn mein woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay . yeh hai bari kamiyabi .

ayahs.text: aur jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya hoga , aur humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hoga , woh dozakh walay hon gay jiss mein woh hamesha rahen gay , aur woh boht bura thikana hai .
ayahs.translation: aur jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya hoga , aur humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hoga , woh dozakh walay hon gay jiss mein woh hamesha rahen gay , aur woh boht bura thikana hai .

ayahs.text: koi museebat Allah kay hukum kay baghair nahi aati , aur jo koi Allah per emaan lata hai , woh uss kay dil ko hidayat bakhshta hai ,   aur Allah her cheez ko khoob janney wala hai .
ayahs.translation: koi museebat Allah kay hukum kay baghair nahi aati , aur jo koi Allah per emaan lata hai , woh uss kay dil ko hidayat bakhshta hai ,   aur Allah her cheez ko khoob janney wala hai .

ayahs.text: aur tum Allah ki farmanbardaari kero , aur Rasool ki farmanbardaari kero . phir agar tum ney mun morra to humaray Rasool ki zimma daari sirf yeh hai kay woh saaf saaf baat phoncha dey .
ayahs.translation: aur tum Allah ki farmanbardaari kero , aur Rasool ki farmanbardaari kero . phir agar tum ney mun morra to humaray Rasool ki zimma daari sirf yeh hai kay woh saaf saaf baat phoncha dey .

ayahs.text: Allah woh hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai , aur mominon ko Allah hi per bharosa kerna chahiye .
ayahs.translation: Allah woh hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai , aur mominon ko Allah hi per bharosa kerna chahiye .

ayahs.text: aey emaan walo ! tumhari biwiyon aur tumhari aulad mein say kuch tumharay dushman hain , iss liye unn say hoshiyar raho . aur agar tum moaaf kerdo , aur darguzar kero , aur bakhsh do to Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .
ayahs.translation: aey emaan walo ! tumhari biwiyon aur tumhari aulad mein say kuch tumharay dushman hain , iss liye unn say hoshiyar raho . aur agar tum moaaf kerdo , aur darguzar kero , aur bakhsh do to Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .

ayahs.text: tumharay maal aur tumhari aulad to tumharay liye aik aazmaesh hain ,   aur woh Allah hi hai jiss kay paas bara ajar hai .
ayahs.translation: tumharay maal aur tumhari aulad to tumharay liye aik aazmaesh hain ,   aur woh Allah hi hai jiss kay paas bara ajar hai .

ayahs.text: lehaza jahan tak tum say hosakay Allah say dartay raho ,   aur suno aur maano , aur ( Allah kay hukum kay mutabiq ) kharch kero , yeh tumharay hi liye behtar hai . aur jo log apney dil ki lalach say mehfooz hojayen , wohi falah paaney walay hain .
ayahs.translation: lehaza jahan tak tum say hosakay Allah say dartay raho ,   aur suno aur maano , aur ( Allah kay hukum kay mutabiq ) kharch kero , yeh tumharay hi liye behtar hai . aur jo log apney dil ki lalach say mehfooz hojayen , wohi falah paaney walay hain .

ayahs.text: agar tum Allah ko achi tarah qarz do gay to Allah tumharay liye uss ko kaee guna barha dey ga ,   aur tumharay gunah bakhsh dey ga , aur Allah bara qadardaan , boht burdbaar hai .
ayahs.translation: agar tum Allah ko achi tarah qarz do gay to Allah tumharay liye uss ko kaee guna barha dey ga ,   aur tumharay gunah bakhsh dey ga , aur Allah bara qadardaan , boht burdbaar hai .

ayahs.text: woh her bhed ka aur her khuli hoi cheez ka janney wala hai , baray iqtidar ka , bari hikmat ka malik !
ayahs.translation: woh her bhed ka aur her khuli hoi cheez ka janney wala hai , baray iqtidar ka , bari hikmat ka malik !

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai .
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai .

verses.text: aey nabi ! jab tum log aurton ko talaq denay lago to unhen unn ki iddat kay waqt talaq do ,   aur iddat ko achi tarah shumar kero , aur Allah say daro jo tumhara perwerdigar hai . unn aurton ko unn kay gharon say naa nikalo , aur naa woh khud niklen , illa yeh kay woh kissi khuli bey hayai ka irtikab keren .   aur yeh Allah ki ( muqarrar ki hoi ) hudood hain , aur jo koi Allah ki ( muqarrar ki hoi ) hudood say aagay niklay , uss ney khud apni jaan per zulm kiya . tum nahi jantay , shayad Allah uss kay baad koi naee baat peda kerday .
verses.translation: aey nabi ! jab tum log aurton ko talaq denay lago to unhen unn ki iddat kay waqt talaq do ,   aur iddat ko achi tarah shumar kero , aur Allah say daro jo tumhara perwerdigar hai . unn aurton ko unn kay gharon say naa nikalo , aur naa woh khud niklen , illa yeh kay woh kissi khuli bey hayai ka irtikab keren .   aur yeh Allah ki ( muqarrar ki hoi ) hudood hain , aur jo koi Allah ki ( muqarrar ki hoi ) hudood say aagay niklay , uss ney khud apni jaan per zulm kiya . tum nahi jantay , shayad Allah uss kay baad koi naee baat peda kerday .

verses.text: phir jab woh aurten apni ( iddat ki ) miyaad ko phonchney lagen to tum ya to unhen bhalay tareeqay per ( apney nikah mein ) rok rakho , ya phir bhalay tareeqay say unn ko alag kerdo ,   aur apney mein say do aesay aadmiyon ko gawah bana lo jo adal walay hon .   aur Allah ki khatir seedhi seedhi gawahi do .   logo ! yeh woh baat hai jiss ki naseehat uss shaks ko ki jarahi hai jo Allah per aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan rakhta ho . aur jo koi Allah say daray ga , Allah uss kay liye mushkil say nikalney ka koi raasta peda kerday ga ,

verses.text: aur ussay aesi jagah say rizq ata keray ga jahan say ussay gumaan bhi nahi hoga . aur jo koi Allah per bharosa keray , to Allah uss ( ka kaam bananey ) kay liye kafi hai . yaqeen rakho kay Allah apna kaam poora ker kay rehta hai . ( albatta ) Allah ney her cheez ka aik andaza muqarrar ker rakha hai .
verses.translation: aur ussay aesi jagah say rizq ata keray ga jahan say ussay gumaan bhi nahi hoga . aur jo koi Allah per bharosa keray , to Allah uss ( ka kaam bananey ) kay liye kafi hai . yaqeen rakho kay Allah apna kaam poora ker kay rehta hai . ( albatta ) Allah ney her cheez ka aik andaza muqarrar ker rakha hai .

verses.text: aur tumhari aurton mein say jo maahwaari aaney say mayyus hochuki hun agar tumhen ( unn ki iddat kay baaray mein ) shak ho to ( yaad rakho kay ) unn ki iddat teen maheenay hai ,   aur unn aurton ki ( iddat ) bhi ( yehi hai ) jinhen abhi maahwaari aai hi nahi . aur jo aurten hamila hon , unn ki ( iddat ki ) miyaad yeh hai kay woh apney pet ka baccha jann len . aur jo koi Allah say daray ga , Allah uss kay kaam mein aasani peda kerday ga .

verses.text: yeh Allah ka hukum hai jo uss ney tum per utaara hai , aur jo koi Allah say daray ga , Allah uss kay gunahon ko moaaf kerday ga , aur uss ko zabardast sawab dey ga .
verses.translation: yeh Allah ka hukum hai jo uss ney tum per utaara hai , aur jo koi Allah say daray ga , Allah uss kay gunahon ko moaaf kerday ga , aur uss ko zabardast sawab dey ga .

verses.text: inn aurton ko apni haisiyat kay mutabiq ussi jagah rehaeesh mohaiyya kero jahan tum rehtay ho , aur unhen tang kernay kay liye unhen satao nahi ,   aur agar woh hamila hon to unn ko uss waqt tak nafqa detay raho jab tak woh apney pet ka baccha jann len .   phir agar woh tumharay liye bacchay ko doodh pilayen to unhen unn ki ujrat ada kero , aur ( ujrat muqarrar kernay kay liye ) aapas mein bhalay tareeqay say baat tey kerliya kero , aur agar tum aik doosray kay liye mushkil peda kero gay to ussay koi aur aurat doodh pilaye gi .

verses.text: her wusat rakhney wala apni wusat kay mutabiq nafqa dey . aur jiss shaks kay liye uss ka rizq tang kerdiya gaya ho , to jo kuch Allah ney ussay diya hai , woh ussi mein say nafqa dey . Allah ney kissi ko jitna diya hai , uss per uss say ziyada ka bojh nahi daalta .   koi mushkil ho to Allah uss kay baad koi aasani bhi peda kerday ga .
verses.translation: her wusat rakhney wala apni wusat kay mutabiq nafqa dey . aur jiss shaks kay liye uss ka rizq tang kerdiya gaya ho , to jo kuch Allah ney ussay diya hai , woh ussi mein say nafqa dey . Allah ney kissi ko jitna diya hai , uss per uss say ziyada ka bojh nahi daalta .   koi mushkil ho to Allah uss kay baad koi aasani bhi peda kerday ga .

verses.text: aur kitni hi bastiyan aesi hain jinhon ney apney perwerdigar aur uss kay Rasoolon kay hukum say sarkashi ki to hum ney unn ka sakht hisab liya , aur unhen saza di , aesi buri saza jo unhon ney pehlay kabhi naa dekhi thi !

verses.translation: chunacheh unhon ney apney aemal ka wabal chakha , aur unn kay aemal ka aakhri anjam nuqsan hi nuqsan huwa .

verses.text: . ( aur aakhirat mein ) hum ney unn kay liye aik sakht azab tayyar ker rakha hai . lehaza aey aqal walo jo emaan ley aaye ho , Allah say dartay raho .   Allah ney tumharay paas aik sarapa naseehat bheji hai ,

verses.text: yani woh Rasool jo tumharay samney roshni denay wali Allah ki aayaten parh ker sunatay hain , takay jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ko andheron say nikal ker roshni mein ley ayen . aur jo shaks Allah per emaan ley aaye , aur naik amal keray , Allah uss ko aesay baaghaat mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jahan jannati log hamesha hamesha rahen gay . Allah ney aesay shaks kay liye behtareen rizq tey kerdiya hai .

Allah ney aesay shaks kay liye behtareen rizq tey kerdiya hai .

verses.text: Allah woh hai jiss ney saat aasman peda kiye , aur zameen bhi unhi ki tarah .   Allah ka hukum unn kay darmiyan utarta rehta hai , takay tumhen maloom hojaye kay Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai , aur yeh kay Allah kay ilm ney her cheez ka ehata kiya huwa hai .

ayahs.translation: . ( aur aakhirat mein ) hum ney unn kay liye aik sakht azab tayyar ker rakha hai . lehaza aey aqal walo jo emaan ley aaye ho , Allah say dartay raho .   Allah ney tumharay paas aik sarapa naseehat bheji hai ,

ayahs.text: yani woh Rasool jo tumharay samney roshni denay wali Allah ki aayaten parh ker sunatay hain , takay jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ko andheron say nikal ker roshni mein ley ayen . aur jo shaks Allah per emaan ley aaye , aur naik amal keray , Allah uss ko aesay baaghaat mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jahan jannati log hamesha hamesha rahen gay . Allah ney aesay shaks kay liye behtareen rizq tey kerdiya hai .
ayahs.translation: yani woh Rasool jo tumharay samney roshni denay wali Allah ki aayaten parh ker sunatay hain , takay jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ko andheron say nikal ker roshni mein ley ayen . aur jo shaks Allah per emaan ley aaye , aur naik amal keray , Allah uss ko aesay baaghaat mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jahan jannati log hamesha hamesha rahen gay . Allah ney aesay shaks kay liye behtareen rizq tey kerdiya hai .

ayahs.text: Allah woh hai jiss ney saat aasman peda kiye , aur zameen bhi unhi ki tarah .   Allah ka hukum unn kay darmiyan utarta rehta hai , takay tumhen maloom hojaye kay Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai , aur yeh kay Allah kay ilm ney her cheez ka ehata kiya huwa hai .
ayahs.translation: Allah woh hai jiss ney saat aasman peda kiye , aur zameen bhi unhi ki tarah .   Allah ka hukum unn kay darmiyan utarta rehta hai , takay tumhen maloom hojaye kay Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai , aur yeh kay Allah kay ilm ney her cheez ka ehata kiya huwa hai .

verses.text: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
verses.translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

verses.text: aey nabi ! jo cheez Allah ney tumharay liye halal ki hai , tum apni biwiyon ki khushnoodi hasil kernay kay liye ussay kiyon haram kertay ho-?   aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .
verses.translation: aey nabi ! jo cheez Allah ney tumharay liye halal ki hai , tum apni biwiyon ki khushnoodi hasil kernay kay liye ussay kiyon haram kertay ho-?   aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .

verses.text: Allah ney tumhari qasmon say nikalney ka tareeqa muqarrar kerdiya hai .   aur Allah tumhara kaarsaz hai , aur wohi hai jiss ka ilm bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil .
verses.translation: Allah ney tumhari qasmon say nikalney ka tareeqa muqarrar kerdiya hai .   aur Allah tumhara kaarsaz hai , aur wohi hai jiss ka ilm bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil .

verses.text: aur yaad kero jab nabi ney apni kissi biwi say raz kay tor per aik baat kahi thi .   phir jab uss biwi ney woh baat kissi aur ko batla di ,   aur Allah ney yeh baat nabi per zahir kerdi to uss ney uss ka kuch hissa jatla diya , aur kuch hissay ko taal gaye .   phir jab unhon ney uss biwi ko woh baat jatlai to woh kehney lagen kay :  aap ko yeh baat kiss ney batai-?  nabi ney kaha kay :  mujhay uss ney batai jo baray ilm wala , boht ba-khabar hai .
verses.translation: aur yaad kero jab nabi ney apni kissi biwi say raz kay tor per aik baat kahi thi .   phir jab uss biwi ney woh baat kissi aur ko batla di ,   aur Allah ney yeh baat nabi per zahir kerdi to uss ney uss ka kuch hissa jatla diya , aur kuch hissay ko taal gaye .   phir jab unhon ney uss biwi ko woh baat jatlai to woh kehney lagen kay :  aap ko yeh baat kiss ney batai-?  nabi ney kaha kay :  mujhay uss ney batai jo baray ilm wala , boht ba-khabar hai .

verses.text: . ( aey nabi ki biwiyo ! ) agar tum Allah kay huzoor tauba kerlo ( to yehi munasib hai ) kiyonkay tum dono kay dil maeel hogaye hain ,   aur agar tum nabi kay muqablay mein tum ney aik doosri ki madad ki , to ( yaad rakho kay ) unn ka sathi Allah hai , aur jibraeel hain , aur naik musalman hain , aur iss kay ilawa farishtay unn kay madadgaar hain .
verses.translation: . ( aey nabi ki biwiyo ! ) agar tum Allah kay huzoor tauba kerlo ( to yehi munasib hai ) kiyonkay tum dono kay dil maeel hogaye hain ,   aur agar tum nabi kay muqablay mein tum ney aik doosri ki madad ki , to ( yaad rakho kay ) unn ka sathi Allah hai , aur jibraeel hain , aur naik musalman hain , aur iss kay ilawa farishtay unn kay madadgaar hain .

verses.text: agar woh tumhen talaq dey den to unn kay perwerdigar ko iss baat mein dair nahi lagay gi kay woh unn ko ( tumharay ) badlay mein aesi biwiyan ata farma dey jo tum sabb say behtar hon , musalman , emaan wali , itaat shiaar , tauba kernay wali , ibadat guzaar aur roza daar hon , chahye pehlay unn kay shohar rahey hon , ya woh kanwari hun .
verses.translation: agar woh tumhen talaq dey den to unn kay perwerdigar ko iss baat mein dair nahi lagay gi kay woh unn ko ( tumharay ) badlay mein aesi biwiyan ata farma dey jo tum sabb say behtar hon , musalman , emaan wali , itaat shiaar , tauba kernay wali , ibadat guzaar aur roza daar hon , chahye pehlay unn kay shohar rahey hon , ya woh kanwari hun .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! apney aap ko aur apney ghar walon ko uss aag say bachao jiss ka endhan insan aur pathar hon gay .   uss per sakht karray mizaj kay farishtay muqarrar hain jo Allah kay kissi hukum mein uss ki nafarmani nahi kertay , aur wohi kertay hain jiss ka unhen hukum diya jata hai .
verses.translation: aey emaan walo ! apney aap ko aur apney ghar walon ko uss aag say bachao jiss ka endhan insan aur pathar hon gay .   uss per sakht karray mizaj kay farishtay muqarrar hain jo Allah kay kissi hukum mein uss ki nafarmani nahi kertay , aur wohi kertay hain jiss ka unhen hukum diya jata hai .

verses.text: aey kufr ikhtiyar kernay walo ! aaj maazraten paish matt kero . tumhen unhi aemal ka badla diya jaraha hai jo tum kiya kertay thay .
verses.translation: aey kufr ikhtiyar kernay walo ! aaj maazraten paish matt kero . tumhen unhi aemal ka badla diya jaraha hai jo tum kiya kertay thay .

verses.text: aey emaan walo ! Allah kay huzoor sachi tauba kero . kuch baeed nahi kay tumhara perwerdigar tumhari buraiyan tum say jhaarr dey , aur tumhen aesay baaghaat mein dakhil kerday jinn kay neechay nehren behti hain , uss din jab Allah nabi ko aur jo log unn kay sath emaan laye hain unn ko ruswa nahi keray ga . unn ka noor unn kay aagay aur unn ki dayen taraf dorr raha hoga .   woh keh rahey hon gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! humaray liye iss noor ko mukammal ker-dijiye ,   aur humari maghfirat farma dijiye . yaqeenan aap her cheez per poori qudrat rakhney walay hain .

verses.text: jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya hai , Allah unn kay liye nooh ki biwi aur loat ki biwi ko misal kay tor per paish kerta hai . yeh dono humaray do aesay bandon kay nikah mein then jo boht naik thay . phir unhon ney unn kay sath bey wafai ki ,   to woh dono Allah kay muqablay mein unn kay kuch bhi kaam nahi aaye , aur ( unn biwiyon say ) kaha gaya kay :  doosray janey walon kay sath tum bhi jahannum mein chali jao .

verses.text: bari shaan hai uss zaat ki jiss kay haath mein sari badshahi hai , aur woh her cheez per poori tarah qadir hai .
verses.translation: bari shaan hai uss zaat ki jiss kay haath mein sari badshahi hai , aur woh her cheez per poori tarah qadir hai .

verses.text: jiss ney moat aur zindagi iss liye peda ki takay woh tumhen aazamaye kay tum mein say kon amal mein ziyada behtar hai , aur wohi hai jo mukammal iqtidar ka malik , boht bakhshney wala hai ,

verses.text: phir baar baar nazar dorrao , nateeja yehi hoga kay nazar thak haar ker tumharay paas na-murad loat aaye gi .
verses.translation: phir baar baar nazar dorrao , nateeja yehi hoga kay nazar thak haar ker tumharay paas na-murad loat aaye gi .

verses.text: jab woh uss mein daalay jayen gay to uss kay daharney ki aawaz sunen gay , aur woh josh maarti hogi ,

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do :  meray paas wahi aai hai kay jinnaat ki aik jamat ney ( Quran ) ghor say suna , aur ( apni qoam say jaker ) kaha kay : hum ney aik ajeeb Quran suna hai ,
verses.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do :  meray paas wahi aai hai kay jinnaat ki aik jamat ney ( Quran ) ghor say suna , aur ( apni qoam say jaker ) kaha kay : hum ney aik ajeeb Quran suna hai ,

verses.text: jo raah-e-raast ki taraf rehnumai kerta hai , iss liye hum uss per emaan ley aaye hain , aur abb apney perwerdigar kay sath kissi ko ( ibadat mein ) hergiz shareek nahi maanen gay .
verses.translation: jo raah-e-raast ki taraf rehnumai kerta hai , iss liye hum uss per emaan ley aaye hain , aur abb apney perwerdigar kay sath kissi ko ( ibadat mein ) hergiz shareek nahi maanen gay .

verses.text: aur yeh kay : humaray perwerdigar ki boht oonchi shaan hai , uss ney naa koi biwi rakhi hai , aur naa koi beta .
verses.translation: aur yeh kay : humaray perwerdigar ki boht oonchi shaan hai , uss ney naa koi biwi rakhi hai , aur naa koi beta .

verses.text: aur yeh kay : hum mein say beywaqoof log Allah kay baaray mein aesi baaten kehtay thay jo haqeeqat say boht door hain .
verses.translation: aur yeh kay : hum mein say beywaqoof log Allah kay baaray mein aesi baaten kehtay thay jo haqeeqat say boht door hain .

verses.text: aur yeh kay : hum ney yeh samjha tha kay insan aur jinnaat Allah kay baaray mein jhooti baat nahi kahen gay .
verses.translation: aur yeh kay : hum ney yeh samjha tha kay insan aur jinnaat Allah kay baaray mein jhooti baat nahi kahen gay .

verses.text: aur yeh kay : insanon mein say kuch log jinnaat kay kuch logon  ki panah liya kertay thay , iss tarah inn logon  ney jinnaat ko aur sar par charha diya tha .
verses.translation: aur yeh kay : insanon mein say kuch log jinnaat kay kuch logon  ki panah liya kertay thay , iss tarah inn logon  ney jinnaat ko aur sar par charha diya tha .

verses.text: aur yeh kay : jaisa gumaan tum logon  ka tha , insanon ney bhi yehi gumaan kiya tha kay Allah kissi ko bhi marney kay baad doosri zindagi nahi dey ga .
verses.translation: aur yeh kay : jaisa gumaan tum logon  ka tha , insanon ney bhi yehi gumaan kiya tha kay Allah kissi ko bhi marney kay baad doosri zindagi nahi dey ga .

verses.text: aur yeh kay : hum ney aasman ko tatolna chaha to hum ney paya kay woh baray sakht pehray daaron aur sholon say bhara huwa hai .
verses.translation: aur yeh kay : hum ney aasman ko tatolna chaha to hum ney paya kay woh baray sakht pehray daaron aur sholon say bhara huwa hai .

verses.text: aur yeh kay : hum pehlay sunn gunn lenay kay liye aasman ki kuch jagahon per jaa betha kertay thay . lekin abb jo koi sunna chahta hai , woh dekhta hai kay aik shola uss ki ghaat mein laga huwa hai ,
verses.translation: aur yeh kay : hum pehlay sunn gunn lenay kay liye aasman ki kuch jagahon per jaa betha kertay thay . lekin abb jo koi sunna chahta hai , woh dekhta hai kay aik shola uss ki ghaat mein laga huwa hai ,

verses.text: aur yeh kay : hamen yeh pata nahi tha kay aaya zameen walon say koi bura moamla kernay ka irada kiya gaya hai , ya unn kay perwerdigar ney unn ko raah-e-raast dikhaney ka irada farmaya hai .
verses.translation: aur yeh kay : hamen yeh pata nahi tha kay aaya zameen walon say koi bura moamla kernay ka irada kiya gaya hai , ya unn kay perwerdigar ney unn ko raah-e-raast dikhaney ka irada farmaya hai .

verses.text: aur yeh kay : hum mein kuch naik hain , aur kuch aesay nahi hain , aur hum mukhtalif tareeqon per chalay aarahey hain .
verses.translation: aur yeh kay : hum mein kuch naik hain , aur kuch aesay nahi hain , aur hum mukhtalif tareeqon per chalay aarahey hain .

verses.text: aur yeh kay : hum yeh samajh chukay hain kay naa hum zameen mein Allah ko aajiz ker-saktay hain , aur naa ( kahen aur ) bhag ker ussay bey bus ker-saktay hain .
verses.translation: aur yeh kay : hum yeh samajh chukay hain kay naa hum zameen mein Allah ko aajiz ker-saktay hain , aur naa ( kahen aur ) bhag ker ussay bey bus ker-saktay hain .

verses.text: aur yeh kay : jab hum ney hidayat ki baat sunn li to hum uss per emaan ley aaye . chunacheh jo koi apney perwerdigar per emaan ley aaye to uss ko naa kissi ghatay ka andesha hoga , aur naa kissi ziyadti ka .
verses.translation: aur yeh kay : jab hum ney hidayat ki baat sunn li to hum uss per emaan ley aaye . chunacheh jo koi apney perwerdigar per emaan ley aaye to uss ko naa kissi ghatay ka andesha hoga , aur naa kissi ziyadti ka .

verses.text: aur yeh kay : hum mein say kuch to musalman hogaye hain , aur hum mein say ( abb bhi ) kuch zalim hain . chunacheh jo Islam laa-chukay hain , unhon ney hidayat ka raasta dhoond liya hai .
verses.translation: aur yeh kay : hum mein say kuch to musalman hogaye hain , aur hum mein say ( abb bhi ) kuch zalim hain . chunacheh jo Islam laa-chukay hain , unhon ney hidayat ka raasta dhoond liya hai .

verses.text: aur rahey woh log jo zalim hain to woh jahannum ka endhan hain .
verses.translation: aur rahey woh log jo zalim hain to woh jahannum ka endhan hain .

verses.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! Ehal-e-makkah say kaho kay mujh per ) yeh ( wahi bhi aai hai ) kay :  agar yeh log raastay per aa-ker seedhay hojayen to hum enhen wafir miqdaar mein paani say sairaab keren ,
verses.translation: aur ( aey payghumber ! Ehal-e-makkah say kaho kay mujh per ) yeh ( wahi bhi aai hai ) kay :  agar yeh log raastay per aa-ker seedhay hojayen to hum enhen wafir miqdaar mein paani say sairaab keren ,

verses.text: takay uss kay zariye unn ko aazmayen .   aur jo koi apney perwerdigar ki yaad say mun morray ga , Allah ussay charrhtay huye azab mein piro dey ga .
verses.translation: takay uss kay zariye unn ko aazmayen .   aur jo koi apney perwerdigar ki yaad say mun morray ga , Allah ussay charrhtay huye azab mein piro dey ga .

verses.text: aur yeh kay :  sajday to tamam tarr Allah hi ka haq hain ,   iss liye Allah kay sath kissi aur ki ibadat matt kero .
verses.translation: aur yeh kay :  sajday to tamam tarr Allah hi ka haq hain ,   iss liye Allah kay sath kissi aur ki ibadat matt kero .

verses.text: aur yeh kay :  jab Allah ka banda uss ki ibadat kernay kay liye kharra huwa to aisa maloom huwa jaisay yeh log uss per tootay parr rahey hain .
verses.translation: aur yeh kay :  jab Allah ka banda uss ki ibadat kernay kay liye kharra huwa to aisa maloom huwa jaisay yeh log uss per tootay parr rahey hain .

verses.text: keh do kay :  mein to sirf apney perwerdigar ki ibadat kerta hun , aur uss kay sath koi shareek nahi manta .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  mein to sirf apney perwerdigar ki ibadat kerta hun , aur uss kay sath koi shareek nahi manta .

verses.text: keh do kay :  naa tumhara koi nuqsan meray ikhtiyar mein hai , aur naa koi bhalai .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  naa tumhara koi nuqsan meray ikhtiyar mein hai , aur naa koi bhalai .

verses.text: keh do kay :  mujhay Allah say naa koi bacha sakta hai , aur naa mein ussay chorr ker koi panah ki jagah paasakta hun .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  mujhay Allah say naa koi bacha sakta hai , aur naa mein ussay chorr ker koi panah ki jagah paasakta hun .

verses.text: albatta ( jiss cheez per mujhay ikhtiyar diya gaya hai , woh ) Allah ki taraf say baat phoncha dena , aur uss kay payghamaat hain . aur jo koi Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki nafarmani keray ga , to uss kay liye jahannum ki aag hai jiss mein aesay log hamesha hamesha rahen gay .
verses.translation: albatta ( jiss cheez per mujhay ikhtiyar diya gaya hai , woh ) Allah ki taraf say baat phoncha dena , aur uss kay payghamaat hain . aur jo koi Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki nafarmani keray ga , to uss kay liye jahannum ki aag hai jiss mein aesay log hamesha hamesha rahen gay .

verses.text: . ( aur yeh log nafarmani kertay rahen gay ) yahan tak kay jab woh cheez unhen nazar aajaye gi jiss say unhen daraya jaraha hai to uss waqt unhen pata chal jaye ga kay kiss kay madadgaar kamzor hain , aur kon tadaad mein kam hai .
verses.translation: . ( aur yeh log nafarmani kertay rahen gay ) yahan tak kay jab woh cheez unhen nazar aajaye gi jiss say unhen daraya jaraha hai to uss waqt unhen pata chal jaye ga kay kiss kay madadgaar kamzor hain , aur kon tadaad mein kam hai .

verses.text: keh do kay :  mujhay maloom nahi hai kay jiss cheez say tumhen daraya jaraha hai , aaya woh nazdeek hai ya mera perwerdigar uss kay liye koi lambi mauddat muqarrar farmata hai .
verses.translation: keh do kay :  mujhay maloom nahi hai kay jiss cheez say tumhen daraya jaraha hai , aaya woh nazdeek hai ya mera perwerdigar uss kay liye koi lambi mauddat muqarrar farmata hai .

ayahs.translation: . ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do :  meray paas wahi aai hai kay jinnaat ki aik jamat ney ( Quran ) ghor say suna , aur ( apni qoam say jaker ) kaha kay : hum ney aik ajeeb Quran suna hai ,

ayahs.text: jo raah-e-raast ki taraf rehnumai kerta hai , iss liye hum uss per emaan ley aaye hain , aur abb apney perwerdigar kay sath kissi ko ( ibadat mein ) hergiz shareek nahi maanen gay .
ayahs.translation: jo raah-e-raast ki taraf rehnumai kerta hai , iss liye hum uss per emaan ley aaye hain , aur abb apney perwerdigar kay sath kissi ko ( ibadat mein ) hergiz shareek nahi maanen gay .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kay : humaray perwerdigar ki boht oonchi shaan hai , uss ney naa koi biwi rakhi hai , aur naa koi beta .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kay : humaray perwerdigar ki boht oonchi shaan hai , uss ney naa koi biwi rakhi hai , aur naa koi beta .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kay : hum mein say beywaqoof log Allah kay baaray mein aesi baaten kehtay thay jo haqeeqat say boht door hain .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kay : hum mein say beywaqoof log Allah kay baaray mein aesi baaten kehtay thay jo haqeeqat say boht door hain .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kay : hum ney yeh samjha tha kay insan aur jinnaat Allah kay baaray mein jhooti baat nahi kahen gay .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kay : hum ney yeh samjha tha kay insan aur jinnaat Allah kay baaray mein jhooti baat nahi kahen gay .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kay : insanon mein say kuch log jinnaat kay kuch logon  ki panah liya kertay thay , iss tarah inn logon  ney jinnaat ko aur sar par charha diya tha .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kay : insanon mein say kuch log jinnaat kay kuch logon  ki panah liya kertay thay , iss tarah inn logon  ney jinnaat ko aur sar par charha diya tha .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kay : jaisa gumaan tum logon  ka tha , insanon ney bhi yehi gumaan kiya tha kay Allah kissi ko bhi marney kay baad doosri zindagi nahi dey ga .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kay : jaisa gumaan tum logon  ka tha , insanon ney bhi yehi gumaan kiya tha kay Allah kissi ko bhi marney kay baad doosri zindagi nahi dey ga .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kay : hum ney aasman ko tatolna chaha to hum ney paya kay woh baray sakht pehray daaron aur sholon say bhara huwa hai .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kay : hum ney aasman ko tatolna chaha to hum ney paya kay woh baray sakht pehray daaron aur sholon say bhara huwa hai .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kay : hum pehlay sunn gunn lenay kay liye aasman ki kuch jagahon per jaa betha kertay thay . lekin abb jo koi sunna chahta hai , woh dekhta hai kay aik shola uss ki ghaat mein laga huwa hai ,
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kay : hum pehlay sunn gunn lenay kay liye aasman ki kuch jagahon per jaa betha kertay thay . lekin abb jo koi sunna chahta hai , woh dekhta hai kay aik shola uss ki ghaat mein laga huwa hai ,

ayahs.text: aur yeh kay : hamen yeh pata nahi tha kay aaya zameen walon say koi bura moamla kernay ka irada kiya gaya hai , ya unn kay perwerdigar ney unn ko raah-e-raast dikhaney ka irada farmaya hai .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kay : hamen yeh pata nahi tha kay aaya zameen walon say koi bura moamla kernay ka irada kiya gaya hai , ya unn kay perwerdigar ney unn ko raah-e-raast dikhaney ka irada farmaya hai .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kay : hum mein kuch naik hain , aur kuch aesay nahi hain , aur hum mukhtalif tareeqon per chalay aarahey hain .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kay : hum mein kuch naik hain , aur kuch aesay nahi hain , aur hum mukhtalif tareeqon per chalay aarahey hain .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kay : hum yeh samajh chukay hain kay naa hum zameen mein Allah ko aajiz ker-saktay hain , aur naa ( kahen aur ) bhag ker ussay bey bus ker-saktay hain .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kay : hum yeh samajh chukay hain kay naa hum zameen mein Allah ko aajiz ker-saktay hain , aur naa ( kahen aur ) bhag ker ussay bey bus ker-saktay hain .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kay : jab hum ney hidayat ki baat sunn li to hum uss per emaan ley aaye . chunacheh jo koi apney perwerdigar per emaan ley aaye to uss ko naa kissi ghatay ka andesha hoga , aur naa kissi ziyadti ka .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kay : jab hum ney hidayat ki baat sunn li to hum uss per emaan ley aaye . chunacheh jo koi apney perwerdigar per emaan ley aaye to uss ko naa kissi ghatay ka andesha hoga , aur naa kissi ziyadti ka .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kay : hum mein say kuch to musalman hogaye hain , aur hum mein say ( abb bhi ) kuch zalim hain . chunacheh jo Islam laa-chukay hain , unhon ney hidayat ka raasta dhoond liya hai .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kay : hum mein say kuch to musalman hogaye hain , aur hum mein say ( abb bhi ) kuch zalim hain . chunacheh jo Islam laa-chukay hain , unhon ney hidayat ka raasta dhoond liya hai .

ayahs.text: aur rahey woh log jo zalim hain to woh jahannum ka endhan hain .
ayahs.translation: aur rahey woh log jo zalim hain to woh jahannum ka endhan hain .

ayahs.text: aur ( aey payghumber ! Ehal-e-makkah say kaho kay mujh per ) yeh ( wahi bhi aai hai ) kay :  agar yeh log raastay per aa-ker seedhay hojayen to hum enhen wafir miqdaar mein paani say sairaab keren ,

ayahs.text: takay uss kay zariye unn ko aazmayen .   aur jo koi apney perwerdigar ki yaad say mun morray ga , Allah ussay charrhtay huye azab mein piro dey ga .
ayahs.translation: takay uss kay zariye unn ko aazmayen .   aur jo koi apney perwerdigar ki yaad say mun morray ga , Allah ussay charrhtay huye azab mein piro dey ga .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kay :  sajday to tamam tarr Allah hi ka haq hain ,   iss liye Allah kay sath kissi aur ki ibadat matt kero .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kay :  sajday to tamam tarr Allah hi ka haq hain ,   iss liye Allah kay sath kissi aur ki ibadat matt kero .

ayahs.text: aur yeh kay :  jab Allah ka banda uss ki ibadat kernay kay liye kharra huwa to aisa maloom huwa jaisay yeh log uss per tootay parr rahey hain .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh kay :  jab Allah ka banda uss ki ibadat kernay kay liye kharra huwa to aisa maloom huwa jaisay yeh log uss per tootay parr rahey hain .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  mein to sirf apney perwerdigar ki ibadat kerta hun , aur uss kay sath koi shareek nahi manta .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  mein to sirf apney perwerdigar ki ibadat kerta hun , aur uss kay sath koi shareek nahi manta .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  naa tumhara koi nuqsan meray ikhtiyar mein hai , aur naa koi bhalai .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  naa tumhara koi nuqsan meray ikhtiyar mein hai , aur naa koi bhalai .

ayahs.text: keh do kay :  mujhay Allah say naa koi bacha sakta hai , aur naa mein ussay chorr ker koi panah ki jagah paasakta hun .
ayahs.translation: keh do kay :  mujhay Allah say naa koi bacha sakta hai , aur naa mein ussay chorr ker koi panah ki jagah paasakta hun .

ayahs.text: albatta ( jiss cheez per mujhay ikhtiyar diya gaya hai , woh ) Allah ki taraf say baat phoncha dena , aur uss kay payghamaat hain . aur jo koi Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki nafarmani keray ga , to uss kay liye jahannum ki aag hai jiss mein aesay log hamesha hamesha rahen gay .

verses.translation: . ( jhutlaney walo ! ) yaqeen jano hum ney tumharay paas tum per gawah banney wala aik Rasool ussi tarah bheja hai , jaisay hum ney firon kay paas aik Rasool bheja tha .

verses.translation: phir firon ney Rasool ka kehna nahi maana , to hum ney ussay aesi pakar mein ley liya jo uss kay liye zabardast wabal thi .

verses.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) tumhara perwerdigar janta hai kay tum do tehai raat kay qareeb , aur kabhi aadhi raat aur kabhi aik tehai raat ( tahajjud ki namaz kay liye ) kharray hotay ho , aur tumharay sathiyon mein say bhi aik jamat ( aisa hi kerti hai )   aur raat aur din ki theek theek miqdaar Allah hi muqarrar farmata hai . ussay maloom hai kay tum uss ka theek hisab nhi rakh sako gay , iss liye uss ney tum per inayat farma di hai .   abb tum itna Quran parh liya kero jitna aasaan ho .   Allah ko ilm hai kay tum mein kuch log beemar hon gay , aur kuch doosray aesay hon gay jo Allah ka fazal talash kernay kay liye zameen mein safar ker rahey hon gay ,   aur kuch aesay jo Allah kay raastay mein jang ker rahey hon gay . lehaza tum uss ( Quran ) mein say utna hi parh liya kero jitna aasaan ho . aur namaz qaeem kero ,   aur zakat ada kero , aur Allah ko qarz do , acha wala qarz !   aur tum apney aap kay liye jo bhalai bhi aagay bhejo gay , ussay Allah kay paas jaker iss tarah pao gay kay woh kahen behtar halat mein aur baray zabardast sawab ki shakal mein mojood hai . aur Allah say maghfirat maangtay raho . yaqeen rakho kay Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .

ayahs.text: . ( aey payghumber ! ) tumhara perwerdigar janta hai kay tum do tehai raat kay qareeb , aur kabhi aadhi raat aur kabhi aik tehai raat ( tahajjud ki namaz kay liye ) kharray hotay ho , aur tumharay sathiyon mein say bhi aik jamat ( aisa hi kerti hai )   aur raat aur din ki theek theek miqdaar Allah hi muqarrar farmata hai . ussay maloom hai kay tum uss ka theek hisab nhi rakh sako gay , iss liye uss ney tum per inayat farma di hai .   abb tum itna Quran parh liya kero jitna aasaan ho .   Allah ko ilm hai kay tum mein kuch log beemar hon gay , aur kuch doosray aesay hon gay jo Allah ka fazal talash kernay kay liye zameen mein safar ker rahey hon gay ,   aur kuch aesay jo Allah kay raastay mein jang ker rahey hon gay . lehaza tum uss ( Quran ) mein say utna hi parh liya kero jitna aasaan ho . aur namaz qaeem kero ,   aur zakat ada kero , aur Allah ko qarz do , acha wala qarz !   aur tum apney aap kay liye jo bhalai bhi aagay bhejo gay , ussay Allah kay paas jaker iss tarah pao gay kay woh kahen behtar halat mein aur baray zabardast sawab ki shakal mein mojood hai . aur Allah say maghfirat maangtay raho . yaqeen rakho kay Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .

ayahs.translation: aur hum roz-e-jaza ko jhoot qarar detay thay ,

ayahs.translation: yahan tak kay woh yaqeeni baat humaray paas aa-hi gaee .

ayahs.translation: chunacheh sifarish kernay walon ki sifarish aesay logon  kay kaam nahi aaye gi .

ayahs.text: abb inn logon  ko kiya hogaya hai kay yeh naseehat ki baat say mun morray huye hain-?
ayahs.translation: abb inn logon  ko kiya hogaya hai kay yeh naseehat ki baat say mun morray huye hain-?

ayahs.translation: iss tarah jaisay woh jangli gadhay hon

ayahs.translation: jo kissi sher say ( darr ker ) bhag parray hon .

ayahs.text: hergiz nahi !   baat asal mein yeh hai kay inn ko aakhirat ka khof nahi hai .
ayahs.translation: hergiz nahi !   baat asal mein yeh hai kay inn ko aakhirat ka khof nahi hai .

ayahs.translation: hergiz nahi ! yeh ( Quran hi ) aik naseehat hai ,

ayahs.text: abb jo chahye , iss say naseehat hasil kerlay .
ayahs.translation: abb jo chahye , iss say naseehat hasil kerlay .

ayahs.text: aur yeh log naseehat hasil keren gay nahi , illa yeh kay Allah hi aisa chahye . wohi iss baat ka ehal hai kay uss say dara jaye , aur wohi iss ka ehal hai kay logon  ki maghfirat keray .
ayahs.translation: aur yeh log naseehat hasil keren gay nahi , illa yeh kay Allah hi aisa chahye . wohi iss baat ka ehal hai kay uss say dara jaye , aur wohi iss ka ehal hai kay logon  ki maghfirat keray .

verses.text: beyshak naik log aesay jaam say mashroobat piyen gay jiss mein kafoor ki aamezish hogi ,
verses.translation: beyshak naik log aesay jaam say mashroobat piyen gay jiss mein kafoor ki aamezish hogi ,

verses.text: yeh mashroobat aik aesay chashmay kay hon gay jo Allah kay ( naik ) bandon kay peenay kay liye makhsoos hai , woh ussay ( jahan chahen gay ) aasani say baha kerlay jayen gay .

verses.text: yeh woh log hain jo apni mannaten poori kertay hain , aur uss din ka khof dil mein rakhtay hain jiss kay buray asraat her taraf phelay huye hon gay .

verses.text: aur woh Allah ki mohabbat ki khatir miskeeno , yateemon aur qediyon ko khana khilatay hain ,

verses.text: . ( aur unn say kehtay hain kay : )  hum to tumhen sirf Allah taalaa ki khushnoodi hasil kernay kay liye khila rahey hain . hum tum say naa koi badla chahtay hain , aur naa koi shukriya !

verses.text: hamen to apney perwerdigar ki taraf say uss din ka darr laga huwa hai jiss mein chehray buri tarah bigrey huye hon gay .

verses.text: iss ka nateeja yeh hai kay Allah aesay logon  ko uss din kay buray asraat say bacha ley ga , aur unn ko shadabi aur suroor say nawazay ga ,
verses.translation: iss ka nateeja yeh hai kay Allah aesay logon  ko uss din kay buray asraat say bacha ley ga , aur unn ko shadabi aur suroor say nawazay ga ,

verses.text: aur unhon ney jo sabar say kaam liya tha , uss kay badlay mein unhen jannat aur reshami libas ata farmaye ga .

verses.text: woh unn baaghon mein aaram deh oonchi nishiston per takiya lagaye howe bethay hon gay , jahan naa woh dhoop ki tapish dekhen gay , aur naa karrakay ki sardi .
verses.translation: woh unn baaghon mein aaram deh oonchi nishiston per takiya lagaye howe bethay hon gay , jahan naa woh dhoop ki tapish dekhen gay , aur naa karrakay ki sardi .

verses.text: aur halat yeh hogi kay unn baaghon kay saye unn per jhukay huye hon gay , aur unn kay phal mukammal tor say unn kay aagay raam kerdiye jayen gay .

verses.text: aur unn kay samney chaandi kay bartan aur woh piyalay gardish mein laye jayen gay jo sheeshay kay hon gay ,
